name: AclGeom.Perfection.mem_pairAut
statement:
theorem mem_pairAut {Φ : RingAut π.carrier} :
    Φ ∈ π.pairAut k ↔ CrossBase.Compatible (k := π.basePerf k) (l := π.basePerf k) Φ
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: AclGeom.Perfection.pairAutAction_apply
statement:
theorem pairAutAction_apply (Φ : π.pairAut k) :
    π.pairAutAction k Φ = π.inducedIso π ((π.mem_pairAut).1 Φ.2)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AclGeom.Perfection.pairAutAction_surjective
statement:
theorem pairAutAction_surjective (hk : IsRAC (⊥ : IntermediateField k K))
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K) : Function.Surjective (π.pairAutAction k)
proof:
:= by
  intro φ
  obtain ⟨-, Φ, hΦ, h, -⟩ := reconstruction_target π π hk hk htr φ
  exact ⟨⟨Φ, hΦ⟩, ((induces_iff_eq_inducedIso hΦ).1 h).symm⟩

name: AclGeom.Perfection.frobZPow_mem_pairAut
statement:
theorem frobZPow_mem_pairAut (hk : IsRAC (⊥ : IntermediateField k K)) (n : ℤ) :
    π.frobZPow n ∈ π.pairAut k
proof:
:=
  π.compatible_frobZPow hk n

name: AclGeom.Perfection.frob_zpow
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [SubgroupClass.coe_zpow]
  simp only [frobZPow, frobeniusZPow, zpow_one]

name: AclGeom.Perfection.ker_pairAutAction
statement:
theorem ker_pairAutAction (hk : IsRAC (⊥ : IntermediateField k K))
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K) :
    (π.pairAutAction k).ker = Subgroup.zpowers ⟨π.frobZPow 1, π.frobZPow_mem_pairAut hk 1⟩
proof:
:= by
  ext Φ
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff]
  have h1 : π.Induces π (OrderIso.refl (ClosedIF k K)) (RingEquiv.refl π.carrier) := by
    have h := induces_inducedIso (π := π) (ρ := π) (CrossBase.compatible_refl (k := π.basePerf k))
    rwa [inducedIso_refl] at h
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hΦ : π.Induces π (OrderIso.refl (ClosedIF k K)) (Φ : RingAut π.carrier) := by
      have h' := induces_inducedIso (π := π) (ρ := π) ((π.mem_pairAut).1 Φ.2)
      rw [← pairAutAction_apply, h] at h'
      exact h'
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (h1.iff_exists_eq_trans_frobZPow htr).1 hΦ
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    rw [π.frob_zpow hk]
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (hn.trans (RingEquiv.ext fun _ ↦ rfl)).symm
  · rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
    rw [π.frob_zpow hk, pairAutAction_apply]
    exact π.inducedIso_frobZPow hk n

name: AclGeom.Perfection.ker_pairAutAction_eq_bot
statement:
theorem ker_pairAutAction_eq_bot (hk : IsRAC (⊥ : IntermediateField k K))
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K) (hp : π.p = 1) : (π.pairAutAction k).ker = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [π.ker_pairAutAction hk htr, Subgroup.zpowers_eq_bot]
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact frobeniusZPow_eq_one_of_eq_one (K := π.carrier) π.p hp 1

name: AclGeom.exists_induces_of_five_le_trdeg
statement:
private theorem exists_induces_of_five_le_trdeg (π : Perfection K) (ρ : Perfection L)
    (hk : IsRAC (⊥ : IntermediateField k K)) (hl : IsRAC (⊥ : IntermediateField l L))
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K) (φ : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L) :
    ∃ Φ : π.carrier ≃+* ρ.carrier,
      CrossBase.Compatible (k := π.basePerf k) (l := ρ.basePerf l) Φ ∧ π.Induces ρ φ Φ
proof:
:= by
  have : IsAlgClosed ↥(algebraicClosure (↥(π.basePerf k)) (AlgebraicClosure π.carrier)) :=
    IsAlgClosure.isAlgClosed (↥(π.basePerf k))
  have : IsAlgClosed ↥(algebraicClosure (↥(ρ.basePerf l)) (AlgebraicClosure ρ.carrier)) :=
    IsAlgClosure.isAlgClosed (↥(ρ.basePerf l))
  exact π.exists_induces ρ hk hl htr
    (jCompletenessACF (five_le_trdeg_algebraicClosure
      (Perfection.five_le_trdeg_basePerf π (OrderIso.refl (ClosedIF k K)) htr)))
    (jCompletenessACF (five_le_trdeg_algebraicClosure
      (Perfection.five_le_trdeg_basePerf ρ φ htr))) φ

name: AclGeom.exists_reconstruction
statement:
theorem exists_reconstruction (π : Perfection K) (ρ : Perfection L)
    (hk : IsRAC (⊥ : IntermediateField k K)) (hl : IsRAC (⊥ : IntermediateField l L))
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K) (φ : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L) :
    ∃ Φ : π.carrier ≃+* ρ.carrier, Reconstructs π ρ φ Φ
proof:
:=
  (exists_induces_of_five_le_trdeg π ρ hk hl htr φ).imp fun _ h ↦ h.2

name: AclGeom.reconstruction_target
statement:
theorem reconstruction_target (π : Perfection K) (ρ : Perfection L)
    (hk : IsRAC (⊥ : IntermediateField k K)) (hl : IsRAC (⊥ : IntermediateField l L))
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K) (φ : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L) :
    Cardinal.lift.{v} (Algebra.trdeg k K) = Cardinal.lift.{u} (Algebra.trdeg l L) ∧
      ∃ Φ : π.carrier ≃+* ρ.carrier,
        CrossBase.Compatible (k := π.basePerf k) (l := ρ.basePerf l) Φ ∧
        Reconstructs π ρ φ Φ ∧
        (∀ (M : ClosedIF k K) (y : L),
          y ∈ φ M ↔ ρ.incl y ∈ (π.perfSubfield M.1.toSubfield).map Φ.toRingHom) ∧
        (∀ Ψ : π.carrier ≃+* ρ.carrier,
          Reconstructs π ρ φ Ψ ↔ ∃ n : ℤ, Ψ = Φ.trans (ρ.frobZPow n)) ∧
        (ρ.p = 1 → ∀ Ψ : π.carrier ≃+* ρ.carrier, Reconstructs π ρ φ Ψ → Ψ = Φ) ∧
        (ρ.p ≠ 1 → Function.Injective fun n : ℤ ↦ Φ.trans (ρ.frobZPow n)) ∧
        ∀ (Ψ : π.carrier ≃+* ρ.carrier)
          (hΨ : CrossBase.Compatible (k := π.basePerf k) (l := ρ.basePerf l) Ψ),
          Reconstructs π ρ (π.inducedIso ρ hΨ) Ψ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ, h⟩ := exists_induces_of_five_le_trdeg π ρ hk hl htr φ
  exact ⟨lift_trdeg_eq_of_orderIso φ, Φ, hΦ, h, fun _ _ ↦ h.mem_iff,
    fun _ ↦ h.iff_exists_eq_trans_frobZPow htr,
    fun hp _ hΨ ↦ (h.eq_of_p_eq_one hΨ htr hp).symm,
    fun hp ↦ Perfection.trans_frobZPow_injective φ htr hp Φ,
    fun _ hΨ ↦ Perfection.induces_inducedIso hΨ⟩

name: GroupConfig.FiniteSetCode.coeff_coeff_codePoly_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_coeff_codePoly_eq_zero (S : Finset (ι → R)) {i : ℕ} {m : ι →₀ ℕ}
    (h : i + m.degree ≠ S.card) : ((codePoly S).coeff i).coeff m = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  let Q : MvPolynomial (Option ι) R := ∏ s ∈ S, (X none - ∑ j, C (s j) * X (some j))
  have hQ : optionEquivLeft R ι Q = codePoly S := by
    simp only [Q, codePoly, linForm, map_prod, map_sub, map_sum, map_mul,
      optionEquivLeft_X_none, optionEquivLeft_X_some, optionEquivLeft_C]
  have hhom : Q.IsHomogeneous S.card := by
    have := IsHomogeneous.prod S (fun s ↦ X none - ∑ j, C (s j) * X (some j)) (fun _ ↦ 1)
      fun s _ ↦ (isHomogeneous_X R none).sub
        (IsHomogeneous.sum _ _ 1 fun j _ ↦ isHomogeneous_C_mul_X (s j) (some j))
    simpa only [Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using this
  have hdeg : (m.optionElim i).degree = i + m.degree := by
    rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_sum, Fintype.sum_option, Finsupp.degree_eq_sum]
    simp only [Finsupp.optionElim_apply_none, Finsupp.optionElim_apply_some]
  rw [← hQ, optionEquivLeft_coeff_coeff]
  exact hhom.coeff_eq_zero (hdeg.trans_ne h)

name: GroupConfig.FiniteSetCode.range_codeVec_diff_zero
statement:
theorem range_codeVec_diff_zero {d : ℕ} {S : Finset (ι → R)} (hS : S.card ≤ d) :
    range (codeVec d S) \ {0} = code S
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨p, rfl⟩, hx⟩
    exact coeff_coeff_mem_code hx
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := mem_coeffs_iff.1 hi
    have hne : ((codePoly S).coeff i).coeff m ≠ 0 := mem_support_iff.1 hm
    have hdeg : i + m.degree = S.card :=
      by_contra fun h ↦ hne (coeff_coeff_codePoly_eq_zero S h)
    exact ⟨⟨⟨(i, m), hdeg.le.trans hS⟩, rfl⟩, hne⟩

name: GroupConfig.FiniteSetCode.codeVec_map
statement:
theorem codeVec_map {R' : Type*} [CommRing R'] (f : R →+* R') (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (d : ℕ) (S : Finset (ι → R)) : codeVec d (S.map (compEmb f hf)) = f ∘ codeVec d S
proof:
:=
  funext fun p ↦ (map_coeff_coeff_codePoly f hf S p.1.1 p.1.2).symm

name: GroupConfig.FiniteSetCode.codeVec_injective
statement:
theorem codeVec_injective [IsDomain R] {d : ℕ} {S S' : Finset (ι → R)} (hS : S.card = d)
    (hS' : S'.card = d) (h : codeVec d S = codeVec d S') : S = S'
proof:
:= by
  apply codePoly_injective
  ext i m
  by_cases hd : i + m.degree = d
  · exact congrFun h ⟨(i, m), hd.le⟩
  · rw [coeff_coeff_codePoly_eq_zero S fun h' ↦ hd (h'.trans hS),
      coeff_coeff_codePoly_eq_zero S' fun h' ↦ hd (h'.trans hS')]

name: GroupConfig.FiniteSetCode.range_codeVec_subset_adjoin
statement:
theorem range_codeVec_subset_adjoin (d : ℕ) (S : Finset (ι → K)) :
    range (codeVec d S) ⊆ (Algebra.adjoin k (coords S) : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩
  by_cases hp : codeVec d S p = 0
  · rw [hp]
    exact zero_mem _
  · exact code_subset_adjoin S (coeff_coeff_mem_code hp)

name: GroupConfig.FiniteSetCode.fixes_codeVec_iff
statement:
theorem fixes_codeVec_iff (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) {d : ℕ} {S : Finset (ι → K)} (hS : S.card ≤ d) :
    ⇑σ ∘ codeVec d S = codeVec d S ↔ S.map (compEmb σ σ.injective) = S
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fixes_code_iff_algEquiv σ S]
  constructor
  · intro h x hx
    rw [← range_codeVec_diff_zero hS] at hx
    obtain ⟨⟨p, rfl⟩, -⟩ := hx
    exact congrFun h p
  · intro h
    funext p
    by_cases hp : codeVec d S p = 0
    · simp only [Function.comp_apply, hp, map_zero]
    · exact h _ (coeff_coeff_mem_code hp)

name: GroupConfig.FiniteSetCode.racl_range_codeVec
statement:
theorem racl_range_codeVec {d : ℕ} {S : Finset (ι → K)} (hS : S.card ≤ d) :
    racl k (range (codeVec d S)) = racl k (coords S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← racl_code_eq S]
  refine le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_) (racl_mono ?_)
  · rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩
    by_cases hp : codeVec d S p = 0
    · rw [hp]
      exact zero_mem _
    · exact subset_racl k _ (coeff_coeff_mem_code hp)
  · rw [← range_codeVec_diff_zero hS]
    exact sdiff_subset

name: GroupConfig.FiniteSetCode.range_codeVec_subset_dcl
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩
  by_cases hp : codeVec d S p = 0
  · rw [hp]
    exact zero_mem _
  · exact code_subset_dcl h (coeff_coeff_mem_code hp)

name: GroupConfig.compEmb_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem compEmb_apply (f : R → R') (hf : Function.Injective f) (s : ι → R) :
    compEmb f hf s = f ∘ s
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.coeff_linForm_single
statement:
theorem coeff_linForm_single (s : ι → R) (j : ι) :
    (linForm s).coeff (Finsupp.single j 1) = s j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [linForm, coeff_sum, coeff_C_mul, coeff_X]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · simp
  · intro j' _ hj'
    have : Finsupp.single j' (1 : ℕ) ≠ Finsupp.single j 1 := fun h ↦
      hj' ((Finsupp.single_left_inj one_ne_zero).1 h)
    simp [this]
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ j) h

name: GroupConfig.linForm_injective
statement: theorem linForm_injective : Function.Injective (linForm (R := R) (ι := ι))
proof:
:= by
  intro s s' h
  funext j
  rw [← coeff_linForm_single s j, ← coeff_linForm_single s' j, h]

name: GroupConfig.map_linForm
statement:
theorem map_linForm {R' : Type*} [CommRing R'] (f : R →+* R') (s : ι → R) :
    MvPolynomial.map f (linForm s) = linForm (f ∘ s)
proof:
:= by
  simp [linForm, map_sum]

name: GroupConfig.codePoly_monic
statement: theorem codePoly_monic (S : Finset (ι → R)) : (codePoly S).Monic
proof:
:=
  Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic _ _ fun s _ ↦ Polynomial.monic_X_sub_C (linForm s)

name: GroupConfig.codePoly_map
statement:
theorem codePoly_map {R' : Type*} [CommRing R'] (f : R →+* R') (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (S : Finset (ι → R)) :
    codePoly (S.map (compEmb f hf)) = (codePoly S).map (MvPolynomial.map f)
proof:
:= by
  unfold codePoly
  rw [Finset.prod_map, Polynomial.map_prod]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun s _ ↦ ?_
  rw [Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.map_C, map_linForm, compEmb_apply]

name: GroupConfig.roots_codePoly
statement:
theorem roots_codePoly [IsDomain R] (S : Finset (ι → R)) :
    (codePoly S).roots = S.val.map linForm
proof:
:= by
  unfold codePoly
  rw [Finset.prod_eq_multiset_prod,
    ← Polynomial.roots_multiset_prod_X_sub_C (S.val.map linForm), Multiset.map_map]
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.codePoly_injective
statement: theorem codePoly_injective [IsDomain R] : Function.Injective (codePoly (R := R) (ι := ι))
proof:
:= by
  intro S S' h
  have h' := congrArg Polynomial.roots h
  rw [roots_codePoly, roots_codePoly] at h'
  exact Finset.val_injective (Multiset.map_injective linForm_injective h')

name: GroupConfig.mem_code_iff
statement:
theorem mem_code_iff {S : Finset (ι → R)} {x : R} :
    x ∈ code S ↔ ∃ i, x ∈ ((codePoly S).coeff i).coeffs
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: GroupConfig.code_finite
statement: theorem code_finite (S : Finset (ι → R)) : (code S).Finite
proof:
:= by
  refine ((Finset.range ((codePoly S).natDegree + 1)).finite_toSet.biUnion
    fun i _ ↦ ((codePoly S).coeff i).coeffs.finite_toSet).subset ?_
  rintro x ⟨i, hi⟩
  refine mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨i, Finset.mem_range.2 ?_, hi⟩
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by omega)] at hi
  simp [coeffs_zero] at hi

name: GroupConfig.coeff_coeff_mem_code
statement:
theorem coeff_coeff_mem_code {S : Finset (ι → R)} {i : ℕ} {m : ι →₀ ℕ}
    (h : ((codePoly S).coeff i).coeff m ≠ 0) : ((codePoly S).coeff i).coeff m ∈ code S
proof:
:=
  ⟨i, mem_coeffs_iff.2 ⟨m, mem_support_iff.2 h, rfl⟩⟩

name: GroupConfig.code_map
statement:
theorem code_map {R' : Type*} [CommRing R'] (f : R →+* R') (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (S : Finset (ι → R)) : code (S.map (compEmb f hf)) = f '' code S
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_code_iff, codePoly_map f hf, Polynomial.coeff_map, mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := mem_coeffs_iff.1 hi
    rw [coeff_map]
    refine ⟨((codePoly S).coeff i).coeff m, ⟨i, mem_coeffs_iff.2 ⟨m, ?_, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩
    rwa [support_map_of_injective _ hf] at hm
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨i, hi⟩, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := mem_coeffs_iff.1 hi
    refine ⟨i, mem_coeffs_iff.2 ⟨m, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · rwa [support_map_of_injective _ hf]
    · rw [coeff_map]

name: GroupConfig.map_coeff_coeff_codePoly
statement:
theorem map_coeff_coeff_codePoly {R' : Type*} [CommRing R'] (f : R →+* R')
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (S : Finset (ι → R)) (i : ℕ) (m : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    f (((codePoly S).coeff i).coeff m) = ((codePoly (S.map (compEmb f hf))).coeff i).coeff m
proof:
:= by
  rw [codePoly_map f hf, Polynomial.coeff_map, coeff_map]

name: GroupConfig.fixes_code_iff
statement:
theorem fixes_code_iff [IsDomain R] (f : R →+* R) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (S : Finset (ι → R)) :
    (∀ x ∈ code S, f x = x) ↔ S.map (compEmb f hf) = S
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply codePoly_injective
    rw [codePoly_map f hf]
    ext i m
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_map, coeff_map]
    by_cases hm : ((codePoly S).coeff i).coeff m = 0
    · rw [hm, map_zero]
    · exact h _ (coeff_coeff_mem_code hm)
  · intro h x hx
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨m, -, rfl⟩ := mem_coeffs_iff.1 hi
    rw [map_coeff_coeff_codePoly f hf, h]

name: GroupConfig.fixes_code_iff_algEquiv
statement:
theorem fixes_code_iff_algEquiv (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (S : Finset (ι → K)) :
    (∀ x ∈ code S, σ x = x) ↔ S.map (compEmb σ σ.injective) = S
proof:
:=
  fixes_code_iff σ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom σ.injective S

name: GroupConfig.code_subset_adjoin
statement:
theorem code_subset_adjoin (S : Finset (ι → K)) :
    code S ⊆ (Algebra.adjoin k (coords S) : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have hS : ∀ s ∈ S, ∀ j, s j ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (coords S) := fun s hs j ↦
    Algebra.subset_adjoin (mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨s, hs, mem_range_self j⟩)
  let lift : {s // s ∈ S} ↪ (ι → Algebra.adjoin k (coords S)) :=
    ⟨fun s j ↦ ⟨s.1 j, hS s.1 s.2 j⟩, fun s s' h ↦ Subtype.ext (funext fun j ↦
      congrArg Subtype.val (congrFun h j))⟩
  have hinj : Function.Injective ⇑(algebraMap (Algebra.adjoin k (coords S)) K) :=
    Subtype.val_injective
  have hS' : (S.attach.map lift).map (compEmb _ hinj) = S := by
    rw [Finset.map_map,
      show lift.trans (compEmb _ hinj) = Function.Embedding.subtype _ from
        Function.Embedding.ext fun s ↦ rfl,
      Finset.attach_map_val]
  have hcode : code S =
      ⇑(algebraMap (Algebra.adjoin k (coords S)) K) '' code (S.attach.map lift) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hS']
    exact code_map (algebraMap (Algebra.adjoin k (coords S)) K) hinj (S.attach.map lift)
  rw [hcode]
  rintro _ ⟨y, -, rfl⟩
  exact y.2

name: GroupConfig.aeval_single_linForm
statement:
theorem aeval_single_linForm (s : ι → K) (j : ι) :
    aeval (Pi.single j (1 : K)) (linForm s) = s j
proof:
:= by
  simp [linForm, Pi.single_apply]

name: GroupConfig.map_aeval_single_codePoly
statement:
theorem map_aeval_single_codePoly (S : Finset (ι → K)) (j : ι) :
    (codePoly S).map (aeval (Pi.single j (1 : K))).toRingHom =
      ∏ s ∈ S, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (s j))
proof:
:= by
  unfold codePoly
  rw [Polynomial.map_prod]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun s _ ↦ ?_
  rw [Polynomial.map_sub, Polynomial.map_X, Polynomial.map_C]
  congr 2
  exact aeval_single_linForm s j

name: GroupConfig.aeval_single_mem_adjoin
statement:
theorem aeval_single_mem_adjoin (p : MvPolynomial ι K) (j : ι) :
    aeval (Pi.single j (1 : K)) p ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (p.coeffs : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  change eval (Pi.single j (1 : K)) p ∈ _
  rw [eval_eq]
  refine Subalgebra.sum_mem _ fun m hm ↦ Subalgebra.mul_mem _ ?_
    (Subalgebra.prod_mem _ fun i _ ↦ Subalgebra.pow_mem _ ?_ _)
  · exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (mem_coeffs_iff.2 ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩)
  · rw [Pi.single_apply]
    split_ifs
    · exact Subalgebra.one_mem _
    · exact Subalgebra.zero_mem _

name: GroupConfig.mem_racl_code
statement:
theorem mem_racl_code {S : Finset (ι → K)} {s : ι → K} (hs : s ∈ S) (j : ι) :
    s j ∈ racl k (code S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [mem_racl_iff_isAlgebraic_adjoin]
  
  have hq : (codePoly S).map (aeval (Pi.single j (1 : K))).toRingHom ∈
      Polynomial.lifts (algebraMap (Algebra.adjoin k (code S)) K) := by
    rw [Polynomial.lifts_iff_coeff_lifts]
    intro i
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_map]
    refine ⟨⟨_, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
    refine (Algebra.adjoin_mono ?_) (aeval_single_mem_adjoin (k := k) _ j)
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := mem_coeffs_iff.1 (Finset.mem_coe.1 hx)
    exact coeff_coeff_mem_code (mem_support_iff.1 hm)
  obtain ⟨q', hq'map, -, hq'monic⟩ :=
    Polynomial.lifts_and_degree_eq_and_monic hq ((codePoly_monic S).map _)
  
  refine IsIntegral.isAlgebraic ⟨q', hq'monic, ?_⟩
  rw [← Polynomial.eval_map, hq'map, map_aeval_single_codePoly, Polynomial.eval_prod]
  exact Finset.prod_eq_zero hs (by simp)

name: GroupConfig.racl_code_eq
statement: theorem racl_code_eq (S : Finset (ι → K)) : racl k (code S) = racl k (coords S)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_) (racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_)
  · intro x hx
    exact Algebra.adjoin_le (S := (racl k (coords S)).toSubalgebra) (subset_racl k _)
      (code_subset_adjoin (k := k) S hx)
  · intro x hx
    unfold coords at hx
    obtain ⟨s, hs, j, rfl⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.1 hx
    exact mem_racl_code hs j

name: GroupConfig.aeval_termPolynomial
proof:
:= by
  let f := ringLanguageHom (R := MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) (S := K) (aeval x).toRingHom
  have h := HomClass.realize_term f (t := t) (v := Sum.elim Empty.elim X)
  have he : f ∘ (Sum.elim Empty.elim X) = Sum.elim (default : Empty → K) x := by
    funext i
    cases i with
    | inl i => exact i.elim
    | inr i => exact aeval_X x i
  rw [he] at h
  exact h.symm

name: GroupConfig.isConstructibleOver_realize
proof:
:= by
  induction φ with
  | falsum => exact IsConstructibleOver.empty
  | equal t₁ t₂ =>
    convert IsConstructibleOver.polynomial_zero
      (termPolynomial (k := k) t₁ - termPolynomial (k := k) t₂) using 1
    ext x
    simp only [mem_ofPred_eq, map_sub, aeval_termPolynomial, sub_eq_zero,
      BoundedFormula.Realize]
  | rel R _ => exact R.elim
  | imp φ ψ hφ hψ =>
    convert hφ.compl.union hψ using 1
    ext x
    simp only [mem_ofPred_eq, mem_union, mem_compl_iff, BoundedFormula.Realize,
      imp_iff_not_or]
  | @all n φ hφ =>
    let q : Fin (n + 1) → MvPolynomial (Fin n ⊕ Fin 1) k :=
      Fin.snoc (fun i ↦ X (Sum.inl i)) (X (Sum.inr 0))
    have heval (z : (Fin n ⊕ Fin 1) → K) :
        (fun i ↦ aeval z (q i)) = Fin.snoc (z ∘ Sum.inl) (z (Sum.inr 0)) := by
      funext i
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j ↦ ?_) i <;> simp [q, Function.comp_def]
    have hpre := hφ.preimage_polynomial q
    have hquant := IsConstructibleOver.forall
      (φ := fun (x : Fin n → K) (y : Fin 1 → K) ↦ φ.Realize default (Fin.snoc x (y 0)))
      (by simpa only [preimage_ofPred_eq, heval, Function.comp_def] using hpre)
    convert hquant using 1
    ext x
    change (∀ a : K, φ.Realize default (Fin.snoc x a)) ↔
      (∀ y : Fin 1 → K, φ.Realize default (Fin.snoc x (y 0)))
    exact ⟨fun h y ↦ h (y 0), fun h a ↦ h (fun _ ↦ a)⟩

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.erk_abcxyz
statement:
theorem erk_abcxyz :
    erk k ∅ (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z) =
      erk k ∅ (range a) + erk k ∅ (range a) + erk k ∅ (range x)
proof:
:= by
  
  have ha : range a ⊆ racl k (range a ∪ range b ∪ range y) :=
    (subset_union_left.trans subset_union_left).trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hb : range b ⊆ racl k (range a ∪ range b ∪ range y) :=
    (subset_union_right.trans subset_union_left).trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hy : range y ⊆ racl k (range a ∪ range b ∪ range y) :=
    subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hsub : range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z ⊆
      racl k (range a ∪ range b ∪ range y) := by
    refine union_subset (union_subset (union_subset (union_subset (union_subset ha hb) ?_) ?_)
      hy) ?_
    · exact hc.range_c_subset_racl_ab.trans (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset ha hb))
    · have hx : range x ⊆ racl k (range a ∪ range y) := by
        rw [← hc.racl_ax_ay]
        exact subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
      exact hx.trans (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset ha hy))
    · exact hc.range_z_subset_racl_by.trans (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset hb hy))
  have hracl : racl k (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z) =
      racl k (range a ∪ range b ∪ range y) := by
    refine le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl hsub) (racl_mono (k := k) ?_)
    intro w hw
    rcases hw with (hw | hw) | hw
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl hw))))
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr hw))))
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hw)
  have t : erk k ∅ (range a ∪ range b ∪ range y) =
      erk k ∅ (range a) + erk k ∅ (range b) + erk k ∅ (range y) :=
    hc.indep 0 1 4 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
  rw [erk_eq_of_racl_eq hracl, t, hc.erk_b_eq, hc.erk_y_eq]

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.one_le_erk_x
statement: theorem one_le_erk_x : 1 ≤ erk k ∅ (range x)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hx
  have hx0 : erk k ∅ (range x) = 0 := Order.lt_one_iff.1 (not_le.1 hx)
  have hxs : range x ⊆ racl k (∅ : Set K) := (erk_eq_zero_iff k).1 hx0
  have hys : range y ⊆ racl k (∅ : Set K) := (erk_eq_zero_iff k).1 (hc.erk_y_eq.trans hx0)
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (∅ : Set K)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hxy : range (Sum.elim x y) ⊆ racl k (∅ : Set K) := by
    rw [Sum.elim_range]
    exact union_subset hxs hys
  have hL : range (Sum.elim x y) ⊆ racl k (racl k (∅ : Set K) : Set K) :=
    hxy.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hLM : range (Sum.elim x y) ⊆
      racl k ((racl k (∅ : Set K) : Set K) ∪ (racl k (range a) : Set K)) :=
    hxy.trans (subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _))
  have hind : IndepOver k (racl k (∅ : Set K) : Set K) (range (Sum.elim x y))
      (racl k (range a) : Set K) := by
    refine indepOver_of_erk_eq (finite_range _) ?_
    rw [(erk_eq_zero_iff k).2 hLM, (erk_eq_zero_iff k).2 hL]
  have hcb := canonicalBase_eq_of_indepOver (IsSmall.of_finite (k := k) finite_empty).racl
    (IsSmall.of_finite (k := k) (finite_range a)).racl (racl_mono (empty_subset _)) hind
  have ha : range a ⊆ racl k (∅ : Set K) := by
    have h := hc.cb_a
    rw [hcb] at h
    exact h.trans (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2
      (racl_le_of_isAlgClosed (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 (canonicalBase_le _ _))))
  have h1 := hc.one_le_erk
  rw [(erk_eq_zero_iff k).2 ha] at h1
  exact not_le.2 zero_lt_one h1

:= by

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCore.exists_constructibleGroupSpace
statement:
theorem PsiCore.exists_constructibleGroupSpace [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K]
    [UniversalDomain k K] (hw : w.PsiCore) :
    ∃ E : Set K, E.Finite ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ E (range w.aTuple ∪ range w.bTuple ∪ range w.cTuple ∪ range w.xTuple ∪
        range w.yTuple ∪ range w.zTuple) ∧
      ∃ (_ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k E)) (_ : UniversalDomain (↥(racl k E)) K) (ν ν' : Type u)
        (_ : Fintype ν) (_ : Finite ν') (v : ν → K) (v' : ν' → K)
        (f₀ : Germ (↥(racl k E)) v v') (ga gb gc : Germ (↥(racl k E)) v v) (y' : ν → K)
        (hb : f₀.IsHWBij) (hga : ga ∈ f₀.diffSet)
        (_ : Fintype (CodeIndex (ν ⊕ ν') (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal))),
        gb ∈ f₀.diffSet ∧ gc ∈ f₀.diffSet ∧ gb = gc * ga ∧
        IsGen (↥(racl k E)) v y' ∧
        IndepTriple (↥(racl k E)) (ga.cb : Set K) (gb.cb : Set K) (range y') ∧
        gc.evalGen (ga.evalGen y') = gb.evalGen y' ∧
        GroupConfiguration (↥(racl k E)) ga.codeTuple gb.codeTuple gc.codeTuple (ga.evalGen y')
          y' (gb.evalGen y') ∧
        racl (↥(racl k E)) (range w.aTuple) = racl (↥(racl k E)) (range ga.codeTuple) ∧
        racl (↥(racl k E)) (range w.bTuple) = racl (↥(racl k E)) (range gb.codeTuple) ∧
        racl (↥(racl k E)) (range w.cTuple) = racl (↥(racl k E)) (range gc.codeTuple) ∧
        racl (↥(racl k E)) (range w.xTuple) = racl (↥(racl k E)) (range (ga.evalGen y')) ∧
        racl (↥(racl k E)) (range w.yTuple) = racl (↥(racl k E)) (range y') ∧
        racl (↥(racl k E)) (range w.zTuple) = racl (↥(racl k E)) (range (gb.evalGen y')) ∧
        erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range v) = erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range w.xTuple) ∧
        erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range v') = erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range w.xTuple) ∧
        erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (f₀.cb : Set K) = erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range w.aTuple) ∧
        erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range w.aTuple) = 2 ∧ erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range w.xTuple) = 1 ∧
        ∃ y₀ : ν → K, IsGenericOver (racl (↥(racl k E)) (range w.aTuple ∪ range w.bTuple ∪
            range w.cTuple ∪ range w.xTuple ∪ range w.yTuple ∪ range w.zTuple)) v y₀ ∧
          ∃ (F : QuasiRational (↥(racl k E)) (CodeIndex (ν ⊕ ν') (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal) ⊕ ν) ν')
            (hF : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[↥(racl k E)] K, ∃ hu : F.IsAdmissible v v' (⇑σ ∘ f₀.code),
              F.parameterGerm hu = f₀.map σ)
            (hdim : erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range v) = erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range v'))
            (S₀ : Set K)
            (t₁ : Fin (2 * (6 * Fintype.card (CodeIndex (ν ⊕ ν') (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal)) +
              Fintype.card ν) + 1) → CodeIndex (ν ⊕ ν') (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal) → K),
            IndepOver k ∅ (E ∪ (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) (range w.aTuple ∪ range w.bTuple ∪
              range w.cTuple ∪ range w.xTuple ∪ range w.yTuple ∪ range w.zTuple) ∧
            (∀ γ ∈ IsHW.prodSet ga, erk (↥(racl k E)) (racl (↥(racl k E))
              ((adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) :
                IntermediateField (↥(racl k E)) K) : Set K) : Set K) (γ.cb : Set K) ≤ 2) ∧
            (∀ γ ∈ IsHW.prodSet ga, erk (↥(racl k E)) (racl (↥(racl k E))
              ((adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) :
                IntermediateField (↥(racl k E)) K) : Set K) : Set K) (γ.cb : Set K) = 2 ↔
              γ ∈ orbit ga ∧ IndepOver (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (γ.cb : Set K) (racl (↥(racl k E))
                ((adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) :
                  IntermediateField (↥(racl k E)) K) : Set K) : Set K)) ∧
            (∀ γ ∈ IsHW.prodSet ga, ∃ γ₁ ∈ IsHW.prodSet ga, ∃ γ₂ ∈ IsHW.prodSet ga, γ = γ₁ * γ₂ ∧
              erk (↥(racl k E)) (racl (↥(racl k E))
                ((adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) :
                  IntermediateField (↥(racl k E)) K) : Set K) : Set K) (γ₁.cb : Set K) = 2 ∧
              erk (↥(racl k E)) (racl (↥(racl k E))
                ((adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) :
                  IntermediateField (↥(racl k E)) K) : Set K) : Set K) (γ₂.cb : Set K) = 2) ∧
            (∀ γ ∈ IsHW.prodSet ga, ∀ γ' ∈ IsHW.prodSet ga,
              erk (↥(racl k E)) (racl (↥(racl k E))
                ((adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) :
                  IntermediateField (↥(racl k E)) K) : Set K) : Set K) (γ.cb : Set K) = 2 →
              erk (↥(racl k E)) (racl (↥(racl k E))
                ((adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) :
                  IntermediateField (↥(racl k E)) K) : Set K) : Set K) (γ'.cb : Set K) = 2 →
              ∃ σ : K ≃ₐ[↥(racl (↥(racl k E))
                ((adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) :
                  IntermediateField (↥(racl k E)) K) : Set K))] K,
                γ.map (σ.restrictScalars (↥(racl k E))) = γ') ∧
            S₀.Finite ∧
            IndepOver (↥(racl k E)) ∅ S₀ (racl (↥(racl k E)) (range w.aTuple ∪ range w.bTuple ∪
              range w.cTuple ∪ range w.xTuple ∪ range w.yTuple ∪ range w.zTuple ∪ range y₀) :
                Set K) ∧
            (∃ T : List (Σ τ : Type u, (τ → K) × (τ → K)),
              (∀ p ∈ T, ((⟨p.1, p.2.1⟩ : Σ τ : Type u, τ → K) = ⟨ν, v⟩ ∨
                  (⟨p.1, p.2.1⟩ : Σ τ : Type u, τ → K) = ⟨ν', v'⟩) ∧
                IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField (↥(racl k E)) K) p.2.1 p.2.2) ∧
              S₀ = (⋃ p ∈ T, range p.2.2) ∧
              erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ S₀ = (T.map fun p ↦ erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range p.2.2)).sum) ∧
            HasGenericSamples (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) S₀) v
              (8 * Fintype.card (CodeIndex (ν ⊕ ν') (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal))) ∧
            HasGenericSamples (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) S₀) v'
              (Fintype.card (CodeIndex (ν ⊕ ν') (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal))) ∧
            (∀ i, IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField (↥(racl k E)) K) f₀.code (t₁ i)) ∧
            (∀ i, IsGenericOver (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) S₀) f₀.code (t₁ i)) ∧
            erk (↥(racl k E)) (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) S₀ : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) =
              ∑ i, erk (↥(racl k E)) (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) S₀ : Set K) (range (t₁ i)) ∧
            IndepOver (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) (racl (↥(racl k E))
              (range w.aTuple ∪ range w.bTuple ∪ range w.cTuple ∪ range w.xTuple ∪
                range w.yTuple ∪ range w.zTuple ∪ range y₀) : Set K) ∧
            erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) =
              erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ S₀ + ∑ i, erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range (t₁ i)) ∧
            ∃ hL : IsSmall (↥(racl k E)) ((adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) :
                IntermediateField (↥(racl k E)) K) : Set K),
              ConstructibleGroupPresentation (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)))
                (F.pairDomain (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) f₀.code v v')
                (F.pairDomainMap (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) hL hb hga
                  f₀.adjoin_range_code hF hdim) ∧
              ∀ (y₁ : ν → K) (hy₁ : IsGen (↥(racl k E)) v y₁),
                IsConstructibleOver
                  (↥(adjoin (↥(racl k E)) ((S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) ∪ range y₁)))
                  {d | ∃ hd : d ∈ F.pairDomain (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)))
                      f₀.code v v',
                    F.pairDomainMap (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) hL hb hga
                        f₀.adjoin_range_code hF hdim ⟨d, hd⟩ • (hb.isHW hga).iota hy₁ =
                      (hb.isHW hga).iota hy₁} ∧
                ConstructibleGSetPresentation
                  (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) ((S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) ∪ range y₁))
                  (F.pairDomain (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) f₀.code v v')
                  (F.pairDomainMap (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) hL hb hga
                    f₀.adjoin_range_code hF hdim)
                  (F.pairDomain (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) f₀.code v v')
                  (F.pairDomainSpaceMap (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) hL hb
                    hga f₀.adjoin_range_code hF hdim hy₁)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hc, ha, hx⟩ := hw.groupConfiguration_with_ranks
  obtain ⟨E, hEfin, hEind, hacl, hud, ν, ν', hν, hν', v, v', f₀, ga, gb, gc, y', hb, hga, hC, hgb,
    hgc, hmul, hy', hind, heval, hconf, r₁, r₂, r₃, r₄, r₅, r₆, hv, hv', hcb, hmc⟩ :=
    hc.exists_main_constructible
                                                                   
  have hrk : ∀ {X : Set K}, X ⊆ range w.aTuple ∪ range w.bTuple ∪ range w.cTuple ∪
      range w.xTuple ∪ range w.yTuple ∪ range w.zTuple → X.Finite →
      erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ X = erk k ∅ X := fun hX hfin ↦ by
    rw [erk_base_empty, erk_racl_base]
    have := hEind.symm hX hfin
    rwa [empty_union] at this
  have hPfin : (range w.aTuple ∪ range w.bTuple ∪ range w.cTuple ∪ range w.xTuple ∪
      range w.yTuple ∪ range w.zTuple).Finite :=
    (((((finite_range _).union (finite_range _)).union (finite_range _)).union
      (finite_range _)).union (finite_range _)).union (finite_range _)
  
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀⟩ := exists_isGenericOver (IsSmall.of_finite (k := ↥(racl k E)) hPfin).racl v
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hdim, S₀, t₁, hind₀, h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, hrest⟩ := hmc y₀ hy₀
  
  rw [ha] at h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄
  exact ⟨E, hEfin, hEind, hacl, hud, ν, ν', hν, hν', v, v', f₀, ga, gb, gc, y', hb, hga, hC, hgb,
    hgc, hmul, hy', hind, heval, hconf, r₁, r₂, r₃, r₄, r₅, r₆, hv, hv', hcb,
    (hrk (fun _ h ↦ Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl h))))) (finite_range _)).trans ha,
    (hrk (fun _ h ↦ Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr h))) (finite_range _)).trans hx, y₀, hy₀, F, hF, hdim,
    S₀, t₁, hind₀, h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, hrest⟩

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCore.exists_isMainConclusion
statement:
theorem PsiCore.exists_isMainConclusion [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K]
    (hw : w.PsiCore) :
    ∃ E : Set K, E.Finite ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ E (range w.aTuple ∪ range w.bTuple ∪ range w.cTuple ∪ range w.xTuple ∪
        range w.yTuple ∪ range w.zTuple) ∧
      IsMainConclusion k (racl k E) w.aTuple w.bTuple w.cTuple w.xTuple w.yTuple w.zTuple ∧
      erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range w.aTuple) = 2 ∧ erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range w.xTuple) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hc, ha, hx⟩ := hw.groupConfiguration_with_ranks
  obtain ⟨E, hEfin, hEind, hmain⟩ := hc.exists_main
                                                                   
  have hrk : ∀ {X : Set K}, X ⊆ range w.aTuple ∪ range w.bTuple ∪ range w.cTuple ∪
      range w.xTuple ∪ range w.yTuple ∪ range w.zTuple → X.Finite →
      erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ X = erk k ∅ X := fun hX hfin ↦ by
    rw [erk_base_empty, erk_racl_base]
    have := hEind.symm hX hfin
    rwa [empty_union] at this
  refine ⟨E, hEfin, hEind, hmain, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hrk (fun _ h ↦ Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl h))))) (finite_range _), ha]
  · rw [hrk (fun _ h ↦ Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr h))) (finite_range _), hx]

name: GroupConfig.finite_conjugates
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine (Set.Finite.pi fun i ↦
    ((minpoly (↥L) (z i)).aroots K).toFinset.finite_toSet).subset ?_
  rintro _ ⟨σ, rfl⟩
  rw [Set.mem_univ_pi]
  intro i
  rw [Finset.mem_coe, Multiset.mem_toFinset, Polynomial.mem_aroots]
  refine ⟨minpoly.ne_zero (hz i), ?_⟩
  have := Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply σ.toAlgHom (z i) (minpoly (↥L) (z i))
  rw [minpoly.aeval, map_zero] at this
  exact this

name: GroupConfig.conjSet_eq
statement: theorem conjSet_eq : conjSet L z = (finite_conjugates hz).toFinset
proof:
:= by
  unfold conjSet
  split_ifs with h
  · rfl
  · exact absurd (finite_conjugates hz) h

name: GroupConfig.mem_conjSet
statement: theorem mem_conjSet {w : μ → K} : w ∈ conjSet L z ↔ ∃ σ : K ≃ₐ[↥L] K, ⇑σ ∘ z = w
proof:
:= by
  rw [conjSet_eq hz, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: GroupConfig.self_mem_conjSet
statement: theorem self_mem_conjSet : z ∈ conjSet L z
proof: := (mem_conjSet hz).2 ⟨AlgEquiv.refl, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.conjSet_map
statement:
theorem conjSet_map (σ : K ≃ₐ[↥L] K) :
    (conjSet L z).map (compEmb (σ.restrictScalars k) (σ.restrictScalars k).injective) =
      conjSet L z
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  rw [Finset.mem_map]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨τ, rfl⟩ := (mem_conjSet hz).1 hv
    refine (mem_conjSet hz).2 ⟨τ.trans σ, ?_⟩
    rw [compEmb_apply]
    rfl
  · intro hw
    obtain ⟨ρ, rfl⟩ := (mem_conjSet hz).1 hw
    refine ⟨⇑σ.symm ∘ (⇑ρ ∘ z), (mem_conjSet hz).2 ⟨ρ.trans σ.symm, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [compEmb_apply]
    funext i
    change σ (σ.symm (ρ (z i))) = ρ (z i)
    exact σ.apply_symm_apply _

name: GroupConfig.conjCode_finite
statement: theorem conjCode_finite : (conjCode L z).Finite

name: GroupConfig.range_tupleOf

name: GroupConfig.code_subset_dcl
statement:
theorem code_subset_dcl [IsAlgClosed K] [Fintype μ] {S : Finset (μ → K)}
    (h : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[↥L] K,
      S.map (compEmb (σ.restrictScalars k) (σ.restrictScalars k).injective) = S) :
    code S ⊆ dcl L
proof:
:= fun x hx ↦
  mem_dcl_iff_forall_fixed.2 fun σ ↦
    (fixes_code_iff_algEquiv (σ.restrictScalars k) S).2 (h σ) x hx

statement: theorem conjCode_subset_dcl [IsAlgClosed K] : conjCode L z ⊆ dcl L
