name: GroupConfig.racl_conjCode_eq_racl_coords
statement:
theorem racl_conjCode_eq_racl_coords :
    racl k (conjCode L z) = racl k (letI := Fintype.ofFinite μ; coords (conjSet L z))
proof:
:=
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite μ
  racl_code_eq _

name: GroupConfig.range_subset_racl_conjCode
statement: theorem range_subset_racl_conjCode : range z ⊆ racl k (conjCode L z)
proof:
:= by
  let _ := Fintype.ofFinite μ
  rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
  exact mem_racl_code (self_mem_conjSet hz) j

name: GroupConfig.racl_conjCode_eq
statement:
theorem racl_conjCode_eq (h : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[↥L] K, ∀ i, σ (z i) ∈ racl k (range z)) :
    racl k (conjCode L z) = racl k (range z)
proof:
:= by
  let _ := Fintype.ofFinite μ
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (racl_le_of_subset_racl (range_subset_racl_conjCode hz))
  rw [racl_conjCode_eq_racl_coords]
  refine racl_le_of_subset_racl fun x hx ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨s, hs, j, rfl⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.1 hx
  obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := (mem_conjSet hz).1 hs
  exact h σ j

name: GroupConfig.mem_dclAdjoin_conjCode
statement:
theorem mem_dclAdjoin_conjCode [IsAlgClosed K] {L₀ : IntermediateField k K} (hL : L₀ ≤ L)
    {ν : Type*} [Finite ν] {w : ν → K} (hw : ∀ j, w j ∈ dclAdjoin L₀ z) (hwL : ∀ j, w j ∈ L)
    (j : ν) : w j ∈ dclAdjoin L₀ (fun x : conjCode L z ↦ (x : K))
proof:
:= by
  let _ := Fintype.ofFinite μ
  obtain ⟨f, -, hfw⟩ := exists_quasiRational_of_mem_dclAdjoin hw
  unfold dclAdjoin
  refine mem_dcl_iff_forall_fixed.2 fun σ ↦ ?_
  have hfixL₀ : ∀ x ∈ L₀, (σ.restrictScalars k) x = x := fun x hx ↦ by
    change σ x = x
    exact σ.commutes
      ⟨x, (mem_restrictScalars k).2 (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ (⟨x, hx⟩ : ↥L₀))⟩
  have hfixc : ∀ x ∈ conjCode L z, (σ.restrictScalars k) x = x := fun x hx ↦ by
    change σ x = x
    exact σ.commutes ⟨x, (mem_restrictScalars k).2 (subset_adjoin (↥L₀) _ ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩)⟩
  have hS := (fixes_code_iff_algEquiv (σ.restrictScalars k) (conjSet L z)).1 hfixc
  have hz' : ⇑(σ.restrictScalars k) ∘ z ∈ conjSet L z := by
    rw [← hS]
    exact Finset.mem_map_of_mem _ (self_mem_conjSet hz)
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := (mem_conjSet hz).1 hz'
  let σ₀ : K ≃ₐ[↥L₀] K :=
    AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := (σ.restrictScalars k).toRingEquiv) fun c ↦ hfixL₀ c c.2
  let τ₀ : K ≃ₐ[↥L₀] K := AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := τ.toRingEquiv) fun c ↦ τ.commutes ⟨c, hL c.2⟩
  have e1 : ⇑σ₀ ∘ w = f.eval (⇑σ₀ ∘ z) := by
    rw [← hfw, f.eval_comp σ₀ z]
  have e2 : ⇑σ₀ ∘ z = ⇑τ₀ ∘ z := hτ.symm
  have e3 : f.eval (⇑τ₀ ∘ z) = ⇑τ₀ ∘ w := by
    rw [f.eval_comp τ₀ z, hfw]
  have e4 : ⇑τ₀ ∘ w = w := funext fun j ↦ τ.commutes ⟨w j, hwL j⟩
  change σ (w j) = w j
  exact congrFun (e1.trans ((congrArg f.eval e2).trans (e3.trans e4))) j

name: GroupConfig.subset_racl_of_indepOver
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := (indepOver_union_right_iff.1 (he.mono_right (union_subset hX hY))).2
  rw [empty_union] at h₁
  have h₀ : erk k (X ∪ K₀) Y = 0 := (erk_eq_zero_iff k).2 (by rwa [union_comm])
  rw [h₁.symm.erk_eq (subset_refl _) hYfin] at h₀
  exact (erk_eq_zero_iff k).1 h₀

name: GroupConfig.cb_descend
statement:
private theorem cb_descend (K₀ : IntermediateField k K) (hs : IsSmall k (K₀ : Set K))
    {W : Set K} (hW : IndepOver k ∅ (K₀ : Set K) W) {ι ι' : Type*} [Finite ι] [Finite ι']
    {p : ι → K} {t : ι' → K} (hp : range p ⊆ W) (ht : range t ⊆ W)
    (h : range p ⊆ racl (↥K₀) (canonicalBase (racl (↥K₀) (range p)) t : Set K)) :
    range p ⊆ racl k (canonicalBase (racl k (range p)) t : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (range p)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hW' : IndepOver k ∅ (K₀ : Set K) (racl k W : Set K) := by
    have := indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hW
    rwa [empty_union] at this
  rw [racl_canonicalBase_base, union_comm (K₀ : Set K) (range p),
    ← racl_union_left (range p) (K₀ : Set K),
    canonicalBase_racl_union_eq (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range p)).racl hs] at h
  · exact subset_racl_of_indepOver hW'
      ((SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 (canonicalBase_le _ _)).trans (racl_mono (k := k) hp))
      (hp.trans (subset_racl k W)) (finite_range p) h
  · exact hW'.mono_right (union_subset (ht.trans (subset_racl k W)) (racl_mono (k := k) hp))

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.descend
statement:
theorem descend (K₀ : IntermediateField k K) (hs : IsSmall k (K₀ : Set K))
    (he : IndepOver k ∅ (K₀ : Set K)
      (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z))
    (h : GroupConfiguration (↥K₀) a b c x y z) : GroupConfiguration k a b c x y z
proof:
:= by
  have hP : ∀ i, gcPoints a b c x y z i ⊆
      range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z := gcPoints_subset
  have hall : (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z).Finite :=
    (((((finite_range a).union (finite_range b)).union (finite_range c)).union
      (finite_range x)).union (finite_range y)).union (finite_range z)
  
  have key : ∀ X ⊆ range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z,
      X.Finite → erk (↥K₀) ∅ X = erk k ∅ X := fun X hX hfin ↦ by
    rw [erk_base_empty]
    have := (he.symm.mono_left hX).erk_eq (subset_refl _) hfin
    rwa [empty_union] at this
  
  have hracl : ∀ A B : Set K, A ⊆ range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z →
      B ⊆ range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z →
      racl (↥K₀) A = racl (↥K₀) B → racl k A = racl k B := by
    intro A B hA hB hAB
    have h' : (racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ A) : Set K) = racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ B) := by
      rw [← racl_base_coe K₀ A, ← racl_base_coe K₀ B, hAB]
    have hBA : B ⊆ racl k A := subset_racl_of_indepOver he hA hB (hall.subset hB) (by
      rw [h']
      exact subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _))
    have hAB' : A ⊆ racl k B := subset_racl_of_indepOver he hB hA (hall.subset hA) (by
      rw [← h']
      exact subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _))
    exact le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl hAB') (racl_le_of_subset_racl hBA)
  exact
    { racl_ab_ac := hracl _ _ (union_subset (hP 0) (hP 1)) (union_subset (hP 0) (hP 2))
        h.racl_ab_ac
      racl_ab_bc := hracl _ _ (union_subset (hP 0) (hP 1)) (union_subset (hP 1) (hP 2))
        h.racl_ab_bc
      racl_ax_ay := hracl _ _ (union_subset (hP 0) (hP 3)) (union_subset (hP 0) (hP 4))
        h.racl_ax_ay
      racl_by_bz := hracl _ _ (union_subset (hP 1) (hP 4)) (union_subset (hP 1) (hP 5))
        h.racl_by_bz
      racl_cx_cz := hracl _ _ (union_subset (hP 2) (hP 3)) (union_subset (hP 2) (hP 5))
        h.racl_cx_cz
      indep i j l hij hil hjl hcol := by
        have h' := h.indep i j l hij hil hjl hcol
        unfold IndepTriple at h' ⊢
        rwa [key _ (union_subset (union_subset (hP i) (hP j)) (hP l))
            (((gcPoints_finite a b c x y z i).union (gcPoints_finite a b c x y z j)).union
              (gcPoints_finite a b c x y z l)),
          key _ (hP i) (gcPoints_finite a b c x y z i),
          key _ (hP j) (gcPoints_finite a b c x y z j),
          key _ (hP l) (gcPoints_finite a b c x y z l)] at h'
      cb_a := cb_descend K₀ hs he (hP 0)
        (by rw [Sum.elim_range]; exact union_subset (hP 3) (hP 4)) h.cb_a
      cb_b := cb_descend K₀ hs he (hP 1)
        (by rw [Sum.elim_range]; exact union_subset (hP 4) (hP 5)) h.cb_b
      cb_c := cb_descend K₀ hs he (hP 2)
        (by rw [Sum.elim_range]; exact union_subset (hP 3) (hP 5)) h.cb_c
      one_le_erk := by
        rw [← key (range a) (hP 0) (finite_range a)]
        exact h.one_le_erk }

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.of_isMainConclusion
statement:
theorem of_isMainConclusion {E : Set K} (hE : E.Finite)
    (hind : IndepOver k ∅ E (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z))
    (h : IsMainConclusion k (racl k E) a b c x y z) : GroupConfiguration k a b c x y z
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsMainConclusion at h
  obtain ⟨_, _, ν, ν', _, _, v, v', f₀, ga, gb, gc, y', _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, hconf, r₁, r₂, r₃,
    r₄, r₅, r₆, _⟩ := h
  
  have hconf' : GroupConfiguration (↥(racl k E)) a b c x y z :=
    hconf.ofRaclEq r₁ r₂ r₃ r₄ r₅ r₆
  have hind' : IndepOver k ∅ (racl k E : Set K)
      (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z) := by
    have := indepOver_racl_left_iff.2 hind
    rwa [empty_union] at this
  exact hconf'.descend (racl k E) (IsSmall.of_finite hE).racl hind'

name: GroupConfig.idealOf_quotient_generic
proof:
:= by
  set A := MvPolynomial ι F ⧸ Q
  set E := FractionRing A
  have hφ : (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F A E).comp (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ F Q) =
      MvPolynomial.aeval fun i ↦ algebraMap A E (Ideal.Quotient.mk Q (X i)) :=
    MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun i ↦ by simp; rfl
  ext f
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, ← hφ, AlgHom.comp_apply, Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk,
    IsScalarTower.coe_toAlgHom', map_eq_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective A E),
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]

name: GroupConfig.exists_idealOf_eq_of_isPrime
statement:
theorem exists_idealOf_eq_of_isPrime (Q : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι F)) [Q.IsPrime] :
    ∃ a : ι → K, idealOf F a = Q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := MvPolynomial ι F ⧸ Q
  set E := FractionRing A
  let b₀ : ι → E := fun i ↦ algebraMap A E (Ideal.Quotient.mk Q (X i))
  have hb₀ : idealOf F b₀ = Q := idealOf_quotient_generic Q
  let L₀ : IntermediateField F E := IntermediateField.adjoin F (Set.range b₀)
  
  obtain ⟨ι', t, ht⟩ := exists_isTranscendenceBasis' F ↥L₀
  have hfin : Algebra.trdeg F ↥L₀ < Cardinal.aleph0 := by
    rw [← Cardinal.toENat_ne_top,
      ← AlgebraicIndependent.matroid_eRk_eq_toENat_trdeg F (Set.range b₀)]
    exact (((AlgebraicIndependent.matroid F E).eRk_le_encard _).trans_lt
      (finite_range b₀).encard_lt_top).ne
  have hι' : Finite ι' := by
    rw [← Cardinal.lt_aleph0_iff_finite, ht.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg]
    exact hfin
  obtain ⟨n, ⟨e⟩⟩ := Finite.exists_equiv_fin ι'
  
  obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀ind, hs₀inj⟩ :=
    exists_fresh_tuple (k := F) (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_empty : (∅ : Set K).Finite)) n
  have hs₀ : AlgebraicIndependent F s₀ := by
    have h1 : (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid F K).Indep (Set.range s₀) := by
      rw [← rkMatroid_empty]
      exact hs₀ind
    exact (algebraicIndependent_subtype_range hs₀inj).1
      (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid_indep_iff.1 h1)
  have hsind : AlgebraicIndependent F (s₀ ∘ e) := hs₀.comp e e.injective
  
  let φ₀ : ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin F (Set.range t)) →ₐ[F] K :=
    ((IntermediateField.adjoin F (Set.range (s₀ ∘ e))).val.comp
      hsind.aevalEquivField.toAlgHom).comp ht.1.aevalEquivField.symm.toAlgHom
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin F (Set.range t))) ↥L₀ :=
    ht.isAlgebraic_field
  let _ : Algebra (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin F (Set.range t))) K := φ₀.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower F (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin F (Set.range t))) K :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun c ↦ (φ₀.commutes c).symm
  let ψ : ↥L₀ →ₐ[↥(IntermediateField.adjoin F (Set.range t))] K := IsAlgClosed.lift
  let ψ' : ↥L₀ →ₐ[F] K := ψ.restrictScalars F
  let b₀' : ι → ↥L₀ := fun i ↦ ⟨b₀ i, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin _ _ ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩
  refine ⟨fun i ↦ ψ' (b₀' i), ?_⟩
  have h1 : idealOf F (⇑ψ' ∘ b₀') = idealOf F b₀' := idealOf_comp_algHom F ψ' b₀'
  have h2 : idealOf F (⇑L₀.val ∘ b₀') = idealOf F b₀' := idealOf_comp_algHom F L₀.val b₀'
  have h3 : (⇑L₀.val ∘ b₀') = b₀ := funext fun i ↦ rfl
  rw [h3] at h2
  exact h1.trans (h2.symm.trans hb₀)

name: GroupConfig.exists_locusIdeal_eq
statement:
theorem exists_locusIdeal_eq (P : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)) [P.IsPrime]
    (hP : P ≤ (P.comap (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap F K))).map
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap F K))) :
    ∃ a : ι → K, locusIdeal F a = P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_idealOf_eq_of_isPrime (K := K)
    (P.comap (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap F K)))
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  unfold locusIdeal
  rw [ha]
  exact le_antisymm Ideal.map_comap_le hP

name: GroupConfig.le_map_comap_of_le
statement:
theorem le_map_comap_of_le {F M : IntermediateField k K} (hFM : F ≤ M)
    {P : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)}
    (hP : P ≤ (P.comap (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥F) K))).map
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥F) K))) :
    P ≤ (P.comap (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥M) K))).map
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥M) K))
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : (algebraMap (↥M) K).comp (IntermediateField.inclusion hFM).toRingHom =
      algebraMap (↥F) K := by
    ext x
    rfl
  refine hP.trans (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 fun f hf ↦ ?_)
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, ← hcomp, ← MvPolynomial.map_map]
  refine Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ?_
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, MvPolynomial.map_map, hcomp]
  exact hf

name: GroupConfig.exists_locusIdeal_eq_of_isSmall
statement:
theorem exists_locusIdeal_eq_of_isSmall [UniversalDomain k K] {M : IntermediateField k K}
    (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K)) (P : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)) [P.IsPrime]
    (hP : P ≤ (P.comap (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥M) K))).map
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥M) K))) :
    ∃ a : ι → K, locusIdeal (↥M) a = P
proof:
:= by
  have := universalDomain_of_isSmall M hM
  exact exists_locusIdeal_eq P hP

name: GroupConfig.locusIdeal_eq_of_le
statement:
theorem locusIdeal_eq_of_le {F M : IntermediateField k K} (hFM : F ≤ M)
    {P : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)}
    (hP : P ≤ (P.comap (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥F) K))).map
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥F) K)))
    {a : ι → K} (h : locusIdeal (↥M) a = P) : locusIdeal (↥F) a = P
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (h ▸ locusIdeal_mono hFM a) (hP.trans (Ideal.map_mono fun f hf ↦ ?_))
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap] at hf
  refine (mem_idealOf_iff (↥F)).2 ?_
  rw [← MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap K]
  exact aeval_eq_zero_of_mem_locusIdeal (↥M) (h.symm ▸ hf)

name: GroupConfig.erk_eq_of_locusIdeal_eq_locusIdeal
proof:
:= by
  have hab : idealOf (↥M) a = idealOf (↥M) b := by
    rw [← locusIdeal_comap (↥M) a, h, locusIdeal_comap]
  rw [← union_empty (M : Set K), erk_coe_union, erk_coe_union]
  exact erk_empty_range_eq_of_idealOf_eq hab

name: GroupConfig.erk_eq_of_locusIdeal_eq_of_le
statement:
theorem erk_eq_of_locusIdeal_eq_of_le {F N : IntermediateField k K} (hFN : F ≤ N)
    {P : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)}
    (hP : P ≤ (P.comap (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥F) K))).map
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥F) K)))
    {b : ι → K} (hb : locusIdeal (↥N) b = P) :
    erk k (F : Set K) (range b) = erk k (N : Set K) (range b)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra (↥F) (↥N) := (IntermediateField.inclusion hFN).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower (↥F) (↥N) K := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  have hF := locusIdeal_eq_of_le hFN hP hb
  
  have hgen : idealOf (↥N) b =
      (idealOf (↥F) b).map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥F) (↥N))) := by
    have hmap : (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥N) K)).comp
        (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥F) (↥N))) =
          MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥F) K) (σ := ι) := by
      refine RingHom.ext fun p ↦ ?_
      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, MvPolynomial.map_map, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq]
    rw [← locusIdeal_comap (↥N) b, hb, ← hF, locusIdeal, ← hmap, ← Ideal.map_map,
      comap_map_mvPolynomial_eq_self]
  rw [erk_coe_eq_toENat_trdeg, erk_coe_eq_toENat_trdeg, trdeg_adjoin_of_isGeneric hgen]

name: GroupConfig.erk_eq_of_locusIdeal_eq
statement:
theorem erk_eq_of_locusIdeal_eq [UniversalDomain k K] {M₁ M₂ : IntermediateField k K}
    (hM₁ : IsSmall k (M₁ : Set K)) (hM₂ : IsSmall k (M₂ : Set K))
    {P : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)} [P.IsPrime]
    (hP₁ : P ≤ (P.comap (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥M₁) K))).map
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥M₁) K)))
    (hP₂ : P ≤ (P.comap (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥M₂) K))).map
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥M₂) K)))
    {a₁ a₂ : ι → K} (h₁ : locusIdeal (↥M₁) a₁ = P) (h₂ : locusIdeal (↥M₂) a₂ = P) :
    erk k (M₁ : Set K) (range a₁) = erk k (M₂ : Set K) (range a₂)
proof:
:= by
  
  let N : IntermediateField k K := racl k ((M₁ : Set K) ∪ M₂)
  have hN : IsSmall k (N : Set K) := (hM₁.union hM₂).racl
  have h₁N : M₁ ≤ N := subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have h₂N : M₂ ≤ N := subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_locusIdeal_eq_of_isSmall hN P (le_map_comap_of_le h₁N hP₁)
  rw [erk_eq_of_locusIdeal_eq_locusIdeal ((h₁.trans (locusIdeal_eq_of_le h₁N hP₁ hb).symm)),
    erk_eq_of_locusIdeal_eq_locusIdeal ((h₂.trans (locusIdeal_eq_of_le h₂N hP₂ hb).symm)),
    erk_eq_of_locusIdeal_eq_of_le h₁N hP₁ hb, erk_eq_of_locusIdeal_eq_of_le h₂N hP₂ hb]

name: GroupConfig.exists_leading
statement:
theorem exists_leading {v : 𝓜 → R} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    ∃ μ, v μ ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ ν < μ, v ν = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Matrix.IsLeadingEntry, and_comm] using
    (Matrix.row_ne_zero_iff_exists_isLeadingEntry (A := fun _ : Unit ↦ v) (i := ())).mp hv

name: GroupConfig.pivotProj_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pivotProj_apply (v : W) (μ : Pivots W) : pivotProj W v μ = (v : 𝓜 → R) μ
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.pivotProj_injective
statement: theorem pivotProj_injective : Function.Injective (pivotProj W)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, LinearMap.ker_eq_bot']
  intro v hv
  by_contra hne
  have hv0 : (v : 𝓜 → R) ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hne (Subtype.ext h)
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ, hlt⟩ := exists_leading hv0
  have hpiv : IsPivot W μ := ⟨v, v.2, hμ, hlt⟩
  exact hμ (congrFun hv ⟨μ, hpiv⟩)

name: GroupConfig.linearIndependent_of_leading
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_of_leading {ι : Type*} (w : ι → W) (lead : ι → 𝓜)
    (hinj : Function.Injective lead) (hne : ∀ i, (w i : 𝓜 → R) (lead i) ≠ 0)
    (hlt : ∀ i ν, ν < lead i → (w i : 𝓜 → R) ν = 0) : LinearIndependent R w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [linearIndependent_iff']
  intro s g hsum
  by_contra hex
  push Not at hex
  obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀s, hg₀⟩ := hex
  
  let t : Finset ι := s.filter fun i ↦ g i ≠ 0
  have ht : t.Nonempty := ⟨i₀, by simp [t, hi₀s, hg₀]⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hit, hmin⟩ := t.exists_min_image lead ht
  have his : i ∈ s := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hit).1
  have hgi : g i ≠ 0 := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hit).2
  
  have heval := congrArg (fun v : W ↦ (v : 𝓜 → R) (lead i)) hsum
  simp only [Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, Submodule.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at heval
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i] at heval
  · exact hgi (mul_eq_zero.1 heval |>.resolve_right (hne i))
  · intro j hjs hji
    by_cases hgj : g j = 0
    · simp [hgj]
    · have hjt : j ∈ t := Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hjs, hgj⟩
      have hle : lead i ≤ lead j := hmin j hjt
      have hlt' : lead i < lead j := lt_of_le_of_ne hle fun h ↦ hji (hinj h).symm
      rw [hlt j _ hlt', mul_zero]
  · intro h
    exact absurd his h

name: GroupConfig.pivotWitness_ne_zero
statement: theorem pivotWitness_ne_zero (μ : Pivots W) : (pivotWitness W μ : 𝓜 → R) μ ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec μ.2).2.1

name: GroupConfig.pivotWitness_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem pivotWitness_eq_zero_of_lt (μ : Pivots W) {ν : 𝓜} (hν : ν < μ) :
    (pivotWitness W μ : 𝓜 → R) ν = 0
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec μ.2).2.2 ν hν

name: GroupConfig.card_pivots_le_finrank
statement: theorem card_pivots_le_finrank : Nat.card (Pivots W) ≤ finrank R W
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite (Pivots W)
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  refine LinearIndependent.fintype_card_le_finrank
    (linearIndependent_of_leading W (pivotWitness W) (fun μ ↦ (μ : 𝓜)) Subtype.val_injective
      (pivotWitness_ne_zero W) fun μ ν hν ↦ pivotWitness_eq_zero_of_lt W μ hν)

name: GroupConfig.finrank_le_card_pivots
statement: theorem finrank_le_card_pivots : finrank R W ≤ Nat.card (Pivots W)
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite (Pivots W)
  have h := LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective (pivotProj_injective W)
  rwa [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] at h

name: GroupConfig.finrank_eq_card_pivots
statement: theorem finrank_eq_card_pivots : finrank R W = Nat.card (Pivots W)
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (finrank_le_card_pivots W) (card_pivots_le_finrank W)

name: GroupConfig.pivotProj_bijective
statement: theorem pivotProj_bijective : Function.Bijective (pivotProj W)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite (Pivots W)
  refine ⟨pivotProj_injective W, ?_⟩
  refine (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank ?_).1 (pivotProj_injective W)
  rw [finrank_eq_card_pivots, Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]

name: GroupConfig.pivotEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pivotEquiv_apply (v : W) (μ : Pivots W) : pivotEquiv W v μ = (v : 𝓜 → R) μ
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.rref_mem
statement: theorem rref_mem (μ : Pivots W) : rref W μ ∈ W
proof:
:=
  ((pivotEquiv W).symm (Pi.single μ 1)).2

name: GroupConfig.rref_apply_pivot
statement:
theorem rref_apply_pivot (μ ν : Pivots W) :
    rref W μ (ν : 𝓜) = if ν = μ then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := (pivotEquiv W).apply_symm_apply (Pi.single μ (1 : R))
  have h' := congrFun h ν
  rw [pivotEquiv_apply] at h'
  rw [rref, h', Pi.single_apply]

name: GroupConfig.rref_apply_self
statement: theorem rref_apply_self (μ : Pivots W) : rref W μ (μ : 𝓜) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [rref_apply_pivot]
  simp

name: GroupConfig.rref_apply_of_ne
statement: theorem rref_apply_of_ne {μ ν : Pivots W} (h : ν ≠ μ) : rref W μ (ν : 𝓜) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [rref_apply_pivot]
  simp [h]

name: GroupConfig.rref_eq_of_pivot_coords
statement:
theorem rref_eq_of_pivot_coords {w : Pivots W → (𝓜 → R)} (hw : ∀ μ, w μ ∈ W)
    (hcoord : ∀ μ ν : Pivots W, w μ (ν : 𝓜) = if ν = μ then 1 else 0) :
    w = rref W
proof:
:= by
  classical
  funext μ
  have h : pivotProj W ⟨w μ, hw μ⟩ = pivotProj W ⟨rref W μ, rref_mem W μ⟩ := by
    funext ν
    change w μ ν = rref W μ ν
    rw [hcoord, rref_apply_pivot]
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (pivotProj_injective W h)

name: GroupConfig.rref_apply_of_lt
statement: theorem rref_apply_of_lt (μ : Pivots W) {ν : 𝓜} (hν : ν < μ) : rref W μ ν = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ, hlt⟩ := exists_leading (v := rref W μ) fun h ↦ hne (by rw [h]; rfl)
  have hpiv : IsPivot W ℓ := ⟨rref W μ, rref_mem W μ, hℓ, hlt⟩
  have hℓμ : (⟨ℓ, hpiv⟩ : Pivots W) = μ := by
    by_contra h
    exact hℓ (rref_apply_of_ne W h)
  have hℓ' : ℓ = μ := congrArg Subtype.val hℓμ
  have : ν < ℓ := hℓ' ▸ hν
  exact hne (hlt ν this)

name: GroupConfig.span_range_rref
statement: theorem span_range_rref : Submodule.span R (range (rref W)) = W
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine le_antisymm (Submodule.span_le.2 (range_subset_iff.2 (rref_mem W))) ?_
  intro v hv
  have := Fintype.ofFinite (Pivots W)
  set c : Pivots W → R := pivotEquiv W ⟨v, hv⟩ with hc
  have hrepr : (⟨v, hv⟩ : W) = ∑ μ : Pivots W, c μ • (pivotEquiv W).symm (Pi.single μ 1) := by
    have h0 : (⟨v, hv⟩ : W) = (pivotEquiv W).symm (∑ μ, Pi.single μ (c μ)) := by
      rw [Finset.univ_sum_single, hc, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rw [h0, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun μ _ ↦ ?_
    rw [← map_smul, ← Pi.single_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  have hcoe : v = ∑ μ : Pivots W, c μ • rref W μ := by
    have := congrArg Subtype.val hrepr
    simpa [rref] using this
  rw [hcoe]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun μ _ ↦
    Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨μ, rfl⟩)

name: GroupConfig.rref_isReducedRowEchelon
statement:
theorem rref_isReducedRowEchelon :
    Matrix.IsReducedRowEchelon (rref W : Matrix (Pivots W) 𝓜 R)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro μ ν hμν j hj
    by_cases hjν : j < (ν : 𝓜)
    · exact rref_apply_of_lt W ν hjν
    · have hμj : (μ : 𝓜) < j := lt_of_lt_of_le hμν (le_of_not_gt hjν)
      have h := hj μ hμj
      rw [rref_apply_self] at h
      exact (one_ne_zero h).elim
  · intro μ c hc
    have hμ : Matrix.IsLeadingEntry (rref W) μ (μ : 𝓜) :=
      ⟨fun j hj ↦ rref_apply_of_lt W μ hj, by rw [rref_apply_self]; exact one_ne_zero⟩
    rw [hc.unique hμ]
    exact rref_apply_self W μ
  · intro μ ν c hμν hc
    have hν : Matrix.IsLeadingEntry (rref W) ν (ν : 𝓜) :=
      ⟨fun j hj ↦ rref_apply_of_lt W ν hj, by rw [rref_apply_self]; exact one_ne_zero⟩
    rw [hc.unique hν]
    exact rref_apply_of_ne W hμν.ne'

name: GroupConfig.eq_rref_of_basis_isReducedRowEchelon
statement:
theorem eq_rref_of_basis_isReducedRowEchelon {α : Type*} [Finite α] [LinearOrder α]
    (B : Basis α R W)
    (hB : Matrix.IsReducedRowEchelon (fun i ↦ (B i : 𝓜 → R))) :
    ∃ e : α ≃ Pivots W, StrictMono e ∧ ∀ i, (B i : 𝓜 → R) = rref W (e i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite α
  have := Fintype.ofFinite (Pivots W)
  have hne (i : α) : (B i : 𝓜 → R) ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ B.ne_zero i (Subtype.ext h)
  choose lead hlead using fun i ↦ exists_leading (hne i)
  have hm : StrictMono lead := by
    intro i j hij
    by_contra h
    have hle : lead j ≤ lead i := le_of_not_gt h
    exact (hlead j).1 (hB.isRowEchelon hij fun q hq ↦
      (hlead i).2 q (lt_of_lt_of_le hq hle))
  let f : α → Pivots W := fun i ↦ ⟨lead i, B i, (B i).2, hlead i⟩
  have hfm : StrictMono f := fun _ _ hij ↦ hm hij
  have hcard : Fintype.card α = Fintype.card (Pivots W) := by
    calc
      _ = finrank R W := (Module.finrank_eq_card_basis B).symm
      _ = Nat.card (Pivots W) := finrank_eq_card_pivots W
      _ = _ := Nat.card_eq_fintype_card
  have hbij : Function.Bijective f :=
    (Fintype.bijective_iff_injective_and_card f).2 ⟨hfm.injective, hcard⟩
  let e : α ≃ Pivots W := Equiv.ofBijective f hbij
  have he (μ : Pivots W) : lead (e.symm μ) = (μ : 𝓜) :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (e.apply_symm_apply μ)
  have heq : (fun μ : Pivots W ↦ (B (e.symm μ) : 𝓜 → R)) = rref W := by
    refine rref_eq_of_pivot_coords W (fun μ ↦ (B (e.symm μ)).2) ?_
    intro μ ν
    have hlead' : Matrix.IsLeadingEntry (fun i ↦ (B i : 𝓜 → R)) (e.symm ν) (ν : 𝓜) := by
      rw [← he ν]
      exact ⟨(hlead (e.symm ν)).2, (hlead (e.symm ν)).1⟩
    split_ifs with h
    · subst ν
      exact hB.eq_one hlead'
    · exact hB.eq_zero_of_ne_of_isLeadingEntry
        (fun h' ↦ h (e.symm.injective h').symm) hlead'
  refine ⟨e, hfm, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  simpa using congrFun heq (e i)

name: GroupConfig.rref_apply_mem_fod
statement: theorem rref_apply_mem_fod (μ : Pivots W) (ν : 𝓜) : rref W μ ν ∈ fod W
proof:
:=
  Subfield.subset_closure ⟨(μ, ν), rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.exists_finset_closure_eq_fod
statement:
theorem exists_finset_closure_eq_fod :
    ∃ s : Finset R, Subfield.closure (s : Set R) = fod W
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs : (fodSet W).Finite := Set.finite_range _
  exact ⟨hs.toFinset, by rw [Set.Finite.coe_toFinset]; rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.DefinedOver.of_fod_le
statement: theorem DefinedOver.of_fod_le {F : Subfield R} (h : fod W ≤ F) : DefinedOver W F
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (Submodule.span_le.2 fun v hv ↦ hv.1)
  conv_lhs => rw [← span_range_rref W]
  refine Submodule.span_mono ?_
  rintro _ ⟨μ, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨rref_mem W μ, fun ν ↦ h (rref_apply_mem_fod W μ ν)⟩

name: GroupConfig.coeVec_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeVec_apply (u : 𝓜 → F) (ν : 𝓜) : coeVec F u ν = (u ν : R)
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.coeVec_injective
statement: theorem coeVec_injective : Function.Injective (coeVec (𝓜 := 𝓜) F)
proof:
:= by
  intro u u' h
  funext ν
  exact Subtype.ext (congrFun h ν)

name: GroupConfig.DefinedOver.fod_le
statement: theorem DefinedOver.fod_le {F : Subfield R} (h : DefinedOver W F) : fod W ≤ F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  let U : Submodule F (𝓜 → F) := (W.restrictScalars F).comap (coeVec F)
  have hUW : ∀ u ∈ U, coeVec F u ∈ W := fun u hu ↦ hu
  
  have hspan : W = Submodule.span R (coeVec F '' (U : Set (𝓜 → F))) := by
    have hset : {v : 𝓜 → R | v ∈ W ∧ ∀ ν, v ν ∈ F} = coeVec F '' (U : Set (𝓜 → F)) := by
      ext v
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hvW, hvF⟩
        have hval : coeVec F (fun ν ↦ ⟨v ν, hvF ν⟩) = v := funext fun ν ↦ rfl
        refine ⟨fun ν ↦ ⟨v ν, hvF ν⟩, ?_, hval⟩
        change coeVec F _ ∈ W
        rw [hval]
        exact hvW
      · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨hUW u hu, fun ν ↦ (u ν).2⟩
    rw [← hset]
    exact h
  
  have hpiv : ∀ μ, IsPivot U μ → IsPivot W μ := by
    rintro μ ⟨u, hu, huμ, hult⟩
    refine ⟨coeVec F u, hUW u hu, ?_, fun ν hν ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [coeVec_apply]
      exact fun h ↦ huμ (Subtype.ext h)
    · rw [coeVec_apply, hult ν hν]
      rfl
  
  have hspan' : W ≤ Submodule.span R (range fun μ : Pivots U ↦ coeVec F (rref U μ)) := by
    rw [hspan]
    refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    have hu' : u ∈ Submodule.span F (range (rref U)) := by
      rw [span_range_rref]; exact hu
    have hmap := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := coeVec F) hu'
    rw [Submodule.map_span, ← range_comp] at hmap
    have hle : Submodule.span F (range (coeVec F ∘ rref U)) ≤
        (Submodule.span R (range fun μ : Pivots U ↦ coeVec F (rref U μ))).restrictScalars F :=
      Submodule.span_le.2 fun _ ⟨μ, hμ⟩ ↦ Submodule.subset_span ⟨μ, hμ⟩
    exact hle hmap
  have hfU := Fintype.ofFinite (Pivots U)
  have hfW := Fintype.ofFinite (Pivots W)
  have hcard : Fintype.card (Pivots W) ≤ Fintype.card (Pivots U) := by
    rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ← finrank_eq_card_pivots W]
    refine (Submodule.finrank_mono hspan').trans ?_
    refine (finrank_span_le_card _).trans ?_
    simpa using
      Finset.card_image_le (s := Finset.univ) (f := fun μ : Pivots U ↦ coeVec F (rref U μ))
  
  have hpiv' : ∀ μ, IsPivot W μ → IsPivot U μ := by
    by_contra hex
    push Not at hex
    obtain ⟨μ₀, hμ₀W, hμ₀U⟩ := hex
    have hinj : Function.Injective fun μ : Pivots U ↦ (⟨μ.1, hpiv μ.1 μ.2⟩ : Pivots W) :=
      fun μ μ' h ↦ Subtype.ext (by simpa using congrArg Subtype.val h)
    have hlt : Fintype.card (Pivots U) < Fintype.card (Pivots W) :=
      Fintype.card_lt_of_injective_of_notMem _ hinj (b := ⟨μ₀, hμ₀W⟩) fun ⟨μ, hμ⟩ ↦ by
        have h : (μ : 𝓜) = μ₀ := by simpa using congrArg Subtype.val hμ
        exact hμ₀U (h ▸ μ.2)
    exact absurd hcard (not_le.2 hlt)
  
  let w : Pivots W → (𝓜 → R) := fun μ ↦ coeVec F (rref U ⟨μ.1, hpiv' μ.1 μ.2⟩)
  have hw : w = rref W := by
    refine rref_eq_of_pivot_coords W (fun μ ↦ hUW _ (rref_mem U _)) fun μ ν ↦ ?_
    simp only [w, coeVec_apply]
    rw [rref_apply_pivot U ⟨μ.1, hpiv' μ.1 μ.2⟩ ⟨ν.1, hpiv' ν.1 ν.2⟩]
    by_cases hνμ : ν = μ
    · subst hνμ
      simp
    · have : (⟨ν.1, hpiv' ν.1 ν.2⟩ : Pivots U) ≠ ⟨μ.1, hpiv' μ.1 μ.2⟩ :=
        fun h ↦ hνμ (Subtype.ext (by simpa using congrArg Subtype.val h))
      simp [hνμ, this]
  refine Subfield.closure_le.2 ?_
  rintro _ ⟨⟨μ, ν⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [← hw]
  exact (rref U ⟨μ.1, hpiv' μ.1 μ.2⟩ ν).2

name: GroupConfig.definedOver_iff
statement: theorem definedOver_iff {F : Subfield R} : DefinedOver W F ↔ fod W ≤ F
proof:
:=
  ⟨DefinedOver.fod_le, DefinedOver.of_fod_le⟩

name: GroupConfig.mapVec_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapVec_apply (v : 𝓜 → R) (ν : 𝓜) : mapVec σ v ν = σ (v ν)
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.isPivot_map_iff
statement: theorem isPivot_map_iff (μ : 𝓜) : IsPivot (W.map (mapVec σ)) μ ↔ IsPivot W μ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩, hμ, hlt⟩
    refine ⟨v, hv, fun h ↦ hμ (by simp [h]), fun ν hν ↦ ?_⟩
    have := hlt ν hν
    rw [mapVec_apply] at this
    exact (map_eq_zero_iff σ σ.injective).1 this
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, hμ, hlt⟩
    exact ⟨mapVec σ v, Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hv, by simp [hμ], fun ν hν ↦ by simp [hlt ν hν]⟩

name: GroupConfig.rref_map
statement:
theorem rref_map (μ : Pivots (W.map (mapVec σ))) :
    rref (W.map (mapVec σ)) μ = mapVec σ (rref W (pivotsMapEquiv W σ μ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have key : (fun μ' : Pivots (W.map (mapVec σ)) ↦ mapVec σ (rref W (pivotsMapEquiv W σ μ'))) =
      rref (W.map (mapVec σ)) := by
    refine rref_eq_of_pivot_coords _ (fun μ' ↦ Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (rref_mem W _)) ?_
    intro μ' ν'
    rw [mapVec_apply]
    have : (ν' : 𝓜) = ((pivotsMapEquiv W σ ν' : Pivots W) : 𝓜) := rfl
    rw [this, rref_apply_pivot]
    by_cases h : ν' = μ'
    · subst h
      simp
    · have h' : pivotsMapEquiv W σ ν' ≠ pivotsMapEquiv W σ μ' :=
        fun h'' ↦ h ((pivotsMapEquiv W σ).injective h'')
      simp [h, h']
  exact (congrFun key μ).symm

name: GroupConfig.fodSet_map
statement: theorem fodSet_map : fodSet (W.map (mapVec σ)) = σ '' fodSet W
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨μ, ν⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨rref W (pivotsMapEquiv W σ μ) ν, ⟨(pivotsMapEquiv W σ μ, ν), rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    dsimp only
    rw [rref_map]
    rfl
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨⟨μ, ν⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨((pivotsMapEquiv W σ).symm μ, ν), ?_⟩
    simp only [rref_map, mapVec_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: GroupConfig.fod_map
statement: theorem fod_map : fod (W.map (mapVec σ)) = (fod W).map σ.toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  unfold fod
  rw [fodSet_map]
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · refine Subfield.closure_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x, Subfield.subset_closure hx, rfl⟩
  · rw [Subfield.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    refine Subfield.closure_le.2 fun x hx ↦ ?_
    change σ x ∈ Subfield.closure (σ '' fodSet W)
    exact Subfield.subset_closure ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.map_eq_self_iff
statement: theorem map_eq_self_iff : W.map (mapVec σ) = W ↔ ∀ x ∈ fod W, σ x = x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hW x hx
    have key : (fun μ' : Pivots W ↦ mapVec σ (rref W μ')) = rref W := by
      refine rref_eq_of_pivot_coords W (fun μ' ↦ ?_) fun μ' ν ↦ ?_
      · have hmem : mapVec σ (rref W μ') ∈ W.map (mapVec σ) :=
          Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (rref_mem W μ')
        rwa [hW] at hmem
      rw [mapVec_apply, rref_apply_pivot]
      split_ifs <;> simp
    have hsub : fodSet W ⊆ RingHom.eqLocusField σ.toRingHom (RingHom.id R) := by
      rintro _ ⟨⟨μ, ν⟩, rfl⟩
      change σ.toRingHom (rref W μ ν) = RingHom.id R (rref W μ ν)
      exact congrFun (congrFun key μ) ν
    exact (Subfield.closure_le.2 hsub) hx
  · intro hfix
    have hrref : ∀ μ, mapVec σ (rref W μ) = rref W μ := fun μ ↦
      funext fun ν ↦ hfix _ (rref_apply_mem_fod W μ ν)
    have h1 : W.map (mapVec σ) = Submodule.span R (mapVec σ '' range (rref W)) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← span_range_rref W]
      exact Submodule.map_span _ _
    rw [h1, ← range_comp]
    have h2 : (mapVec σ ∘ rref W) = rref W := funext hrref
    rw [h2, span_range_rref]

name: GroupConfig.racl_eq_of_racl_union_eq
proof:
:= by
  have h' := congrArg (fun F : IntermediateField (↥K₀) K ↦ (F : Set K)) h
  simp only [racl_base_coe] at h'
  refine SetLike.coe_injective ?_
  rw [racl_base_coe, racl_base_coe, racl_union_left, racl_union_left, union_assoc, union_assoc,
    union_comm T A, union_comm T B]
  exact h'

name: GroupConfig.racl_eq_of_racl_eq
statement:
theorem racl_eq_of_racl_eq (T : Set K) {A B : Set K} (h : racl (↥K₀) A = racl (↥K₀) B) :
    racl (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ T))) A = racl (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ T))) B
proof:
:=
  racl_eq_of_racl_union_eq K₀ (racl_union_congr h rfl)

name: GroupConfig.racl_union_congr_of_subset
statement:
theorem racl_union_congr_of_subset {C C' A B : Set K} (h : racl k (C ∪ A) = racl k (C ∪ B))
    (hC : C ⊆ racl k C') : racl k (C' ∪ A) = racl k (C' ∪ B)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ X : Set K, racl k (C' ∪ X) = racl k (C' ∪ (C ∪ X)) := fun X ↦ by
    refine le_antisymm (racl_mono (k := k) (union_subset_union_right _ subset_union_right))
      (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset ?_ (union_subset ?_ ?_)))
    · exact subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
    · exact hC.trans (racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_left)
    · exact subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
  rw [key A, key B, union_comm C' (C ∪ A), union_comm C' (C ∪ B), ← racl_union_left (C ∪ A) C',
    ← racl_union_left (C ∪ B) C', h]

name: GroupConfig.racl_union_union_congr
statement:
theorem racl_union_union_congr {C A A' B B' : Set K} (hA : racl k (C ∪ A) = racl k (C ∪ A'))
    (hB : racl k (C ∪ B) = racl k (C ∪ B')) :
    racl k (C ∪ (A ∪ B)) = racl k (C ∪ (A' ∪ B'))
proof:
:= by
  rw [union_union_distrib_left C A B, union_union_distrib_left C A' B', ← racl_union_left (C ∪ A),
    ← racl_union_right _ (C ∪ B), hA, hB, racl_union_left, racl_union_right]

name: GroupConfig.indepOver_congr_base
statement:
theorem indepOver_congr_base {C C' A B : Set K} (h : racl k C = racl k C') :
    IndepOver k C A B ↔ IndepOver k C' A B
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ {C C' : Set K}, racl k C = racl k C' → IndepOver k C A B → IndepOver k C' A B :=
    fun h hi a ha hfin ↦ by
      rw [← erk_congr_base k (racl_union_congr h rfl) a, ← erk_congr_base k h a]
      exact hi ha hfin
  exact ⟨key h, key h.symm⟩

name: GroupConfig.indepOver_congr
statement:
theorem indepOver_congr {C A A' B B' : Set K} (hA : racl k (C ∪ A) = racl k (C ∪ A'))
    (hB : racl k (C ∪ B) = racl k (C ∪ B')) : IndepOver k C A B ↔ IndepOver k C A' B'
proof:
:= by
  rw [indepOver_congr_left hA.symm, indepOver_comm, indepOver_congr_left hB.symm, indepOver_comm]

name: GroupConfig.indepOver_congr₀
statement:
theorem indepOver_congr₀ {A A' B B' : Set K} (hA : racl k A = racl k A')
    (hB : racl k B = racl k B') : IndepOver k ∅ A B ↔ IndepOver k ∅ A' B'
proof:
:=
  indepOver_congr (by rwa [empty_union, empty_union]) (by rwa [empty_union, empty_union])

name: GroupConfig.indepOver_of_subset_racl
statement:
theorem indepOver_of_subset_racl {A A' B B' : Set K} (hA : A' ⊆ racl k A) (hB : B' ⊆ racl k B)
    (h : IndepOver k ∅ A B) : IndepOver k ∅ A' B'
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : IndepOver k ∅ (racl k (∅ ∪ A) : Set K) (racl k (∅ ∪ B) : Set K) :=
    indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 (indepOver_racl_left_iff.2 h)
  rw [empty_union, empty_union] at h1
  exact (h1.mono_left hA).mono_right hB

name: GroupConfig.racl_union_eq_of_subset_racl_of_subset
statement:
theorem racl_union_eq_of_subset_racl_of_subset {C A B : Set K} (hA : A ⊆ racl k (C ∪ B))
    (hB : B ⊆ A) : racl k (C ∪ A) = racl k (C ∪ B)
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset (subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)) hA))
    (racl_mono (k := k) (union_subset_union_right _ hB))

name: GroupConfig.coe_subset_racl_union_left
statement: theorem coe_subset_racl_union_left : (K₀ : Set K) ⊆ racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S)
proof:
:=
  subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)

name: GroupConfig.coe_subset_adjoin
statement: theorem coe_subset_adjoin (T : Set K) : (K₀ : Set K) ⊆ adjoin (↥K₀) T
proof:
:= fun w hw ↦
  IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ (⟨w, hw⟩ : ↥K₀)

name: GroupConfig.coe_adjoin_base
statement:
theorem coe_adjoin_base (T : Set K) :
    ((adjoin (↥K₀) T : IntermediateField (↥K₀) K) : Set K) =
      ((adjoin k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ T) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← restrictScalars_adjoin, coe_restrictScalars]

name: GroupConfig.mem_racl_nested
statement:
theorem mem_racl_nested (T : Set K) (x : K) :
    x ∈ racl (↥(racl (↥K₀) S)) T ↔ x ∈ racl (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S))) T
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_racl_base_iff (racl (↥K₀) S) T x, mem_racl_base_iff K₀,
    mem_racl_base_iff (racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S)) T x, racl_base_coe K₀ S, ← union_assoc,
    union_eq_right.2 (coe_subset_racl_union_left K₀ S)]

name: GroupConfig.racl_nested_coe
statement:
theorem racl_nested_coe (T : Set K) :
    ((racl (↥(racl (↥K₀) S)) T : IntermediateField (↥(racl (↥K₀) S)) K) : Set K) =
      ((racl (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S))) T :
        IntermediateField (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S))) K) : Set K)
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun x ↦ mem_racl_nested K₀ S T x

name: GroupConfig.erk_nested
statement:
theorem erk_nested (X : Set K) :
    erk (↥(racl (↥K₀) S)) ∅ X = erk (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S))) ∅ X
proof:
:= by
  rw [erk_base_empty (racl (↥K₀) S), erk_base_empty (racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S)),
    ← erk_coe_union K₀, racl_base_coe K₀ S, union_eq_right.2 (coe_subset_racl_union_left K₀ S)]

name: GroupConfig.indepOver_nested
statement:
theorem indepOver_nested (A B : Set K) :
    IndepOver (↥(racl (↥K₀) S)) ∅ A B ↔ IndepOver (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S))) ∅ A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [indepOver_base_iff (racl (↥K₀) S), indepOver_base_iff (racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S)),
    ← indepOver_coe_union_iff K₀, racl_base_coe K₀ S,
    union_eq_right.2 (coe_subset_racl_union_left K₀ S)]

name: GroupConfig.racl_canonicalBase_nested
statement:
theorem racl_canonicalBase_nested [Finite ι] (P : Set K) (t : ι → K) :
    ((racl (↥(racl (↥K₀) S)) (canonicalBase (racl (↥(racl (↥K₀) S)) P) t : Set K) :
        IntermediateField (↥(racl (↥K₀) S)) K) : Set K) =
      ((racl (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S)))
          (canonicalBase (racl (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S))) P) t : Set K) :
        IntermediateField (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S))) K) : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have hK₀ := coe_subset_racl_union_left K₀ S
  have hI : locusIdeal (↥(racl (↥K₀)
      (((racl (↥K₀) S : IntermediateField (↥K₀) K) : Set K) ∪ P))) t =
      locusIdeal (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S ∪ P))) t := by
    rw [locusIdeal_racl_base K₀, racl_base_coe K₀ S, ← union_assoc, union_eq_right.2 hK₀,
      racl_union_left]
  have hI' : locusIdeal (↥(racl k
      (((racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) ∪ P))) t =
      locusIdeal (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S ∪ P))) t := by
    rw [racl_union_left]
  rw [racl_canonicalBase_base (racl (↥K₀) S) P t,
    racl_canonicalBase_base (racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S)) P t]
  unfold canonicalBase
  rw [hI, hI', racl_base_coe K₀, racl_base_coe K₀ S, coe_adjoin_base K₀, ← union_assoc,
    union_eq_right.2 hK₀, racl_union_adjoin, racl_union_adjoin, ← union_assoc,
    union_eq_left.2 hK₀]

name: GroupConfig.mem_dclAdjoin_mono'
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : x ∈ dcl ((adjoin (↥L) (range u)).restrictScalars k) := hx
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := mem_dcl_iff.1 hx'
  change x ∈ dcl ((adjoin (↥L') (range u')).restrictScalars k')
  refine mem_dcl_iff.2 ⟨n, (mem_restrictScalars k').2 ?_⟩
  have hn' : x ^ ringExpChar K ^ n ∈ adjoin (↥L) (range u) := (mem_restrictScalars k).1 hn
  rw [← mem_toSubfield, adjoin_toSubfield, range_algebraMap_coe] at hn' ⊢
  exact Subfield.closure_mono h hn'

name: GroupConfig.mem_dclAdjoin_congr
proof:
:=
  ⟨mem_dclAdjoin_mono' (by rw [h]), mem_dclAdjoin_mono' (by rw [h])⟩

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.ofNested
statement:
theorem ofNested (K₀ : IntermediateField k K) (S : Set K)
    (hc : GroupConfiguration (↥(racl (↥K₀) S)) a b c x y z) :
    GroupConfiguration (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S))) a b c x y z
proof:
:= by
  have hracl : ∀ A B : Set K, racl (↥(racl (↥K₀) S)) A = racl (↥(racl (↥K₀) S)) B →
      racl (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S))) A = racl (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S))) B :=
    fun A B h ↦ SetLike.coe_injective (by rw [← racl_nested_coe, ← racl_nested_coe, h])
  refine
    { racl_ab_ac := hracl _ _ hc.racl_ab_ac
      racl_ab_bc := hracl _ _ hc.racl_ab_bc
      racl_ax_ay := hracl _ _ hc.racl_ax_ay
      racl_by_bz := hracl _ _ hc.racl_by_bz
      racl_cx_cz := hracl _ _ hc.racl_cx_cz
      indep := fun i j l hij hil hjl hcol ↦ ?_
      cb_a := ?_
      cb_b := ?_
      cb_c := ?_
      one_le_erk := ?_ }
  · have h := hc.indep i j l hij hil hjl hcol
    unfold IndepTriple at h ⊢
    simp only [erk_nested K₀ S] at h
    exact h
  · have h := hc.cb_a
    rwa [racl_canonicalBase_nested K₀ S] at h
  · have h := hc.cb_b
    rwa [racl_canonicalBase_nested K₀ S] at h
  · have h := hc.cb_c
    rwa [racl_canonicalBase_nested K₀ S] at h
  · have h := hc.one_le_erk
    rwa [erk_nested K₀ S] at h

name: GroupConfig.IsMainConclusion.baseChange_racl
statement:
theorem IsMainConclusion.baseChange_racl {F : IntermediateField k K}
    (hF : IsSmall k (F : Set K)) (h : IsMainConclusion k F a b c x y z)
    {S : Set K} (hS : S.Finite)
    (hind : IndepOver (↥F) ∅ S
      (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z)) :
    IsMainConclusion k (racl k ((F : Set K) ∪ S)) a b c x y z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨iF, uF, ν, ν', _, _, v, v', f₀, ga, gb, gc, y₀, hb, hga, hgb, -, -, hy₀, -, -,
    hcfg, ha, hb₀, hc, hx, hy, hz, hv, hv', -⟩ := h
  let F₁ := racl k ((F : Set K) ∪ S)
  have hF₁ : IsSmall k (F₁ : Set K) := (hF.union (IsSmall.of_finite hS)).racl
  have i₁ : IsAlgClosed ↥F₁ := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have u₁ : UniversalDomain (↥F₁) K := universalDomain_of_isSmall _ hF₁
  have h₀₁ : F ≤ F₁ := fun t ht ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl ht)
  have hrel : IsSmall (↥F) (F₁ : Set K) := isSmall_coe_of_isSmall F hF₁
  have lift : ∀ {A B : Set K}, racl (↥F) A = racl (↥F) B →
      racl (↥F₁) A = racl (↥F₁) B :=
    fun hAB ↦ racl_eq_of_racl_eq F S hAB
  let P := range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z
  let Q := range ga.codeTuple ∪ range gb.codeTuple ∪ range gc.codeTuple ∪
    range (ga.evalGen y₀) ∪ range y₀ ∪ range (gb.evalGen y₀)
  have hPQ : racl (↥F) P = racl (↥F) Q :=
    racl_union_congr (racl_union_congr (racl_union_congr (racl_union_congr
      (racl_union_congr ha hb₀) hc) hx) hy) hz
  have hSQ : IndepOver (↥F) ∅ S Q := (indepOver_congr₀ rfl hPQ).1 hind
  have fresh : ∀ {A : Set K}, IndepOver (↥F) ∅ S A →
      IndepOver (↥F) ∅ A (F₁ : Set K) := by
    intro A hA
    change IndepOver (↥F) ∅ A (racl k ((F : Set K) ∪ S) : Set K)
    rw [← racl_base_coe F S]
    simpa only [empty_union] using indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hA.symm
  have hPK : IndepOver (↥F) ∅ P (F₁ : Set K) := fresh hind
  have hQK : IndepOver (↥F) ∅ Q (F₁ : Set K) := fresh hSQ
  have hsub := fun i ↦ GroupConfiguration.gcPoints_subset (a := ga.codeTuple) (b := gb.codeTuple)
    (c := gc.codeTuple) (x := ga.evalGen y₀) (y := y₀) (z := gb.evalGen y₀) i
  have hyK : IndepOver (↥F) ∅ (range y₀) (F₁ : Set K) :=
    hQK.mono_left (hsub 4)
  have hgaK : IndepOver (↥F) ∅ (ga.cb : Set K) (F₁ : Set K) :=
    indepOver_of_subset_racl (cb_subset_racl_codeTuple ga) (subset_racl _ _)
      (hQK.mono_left (hsub 0))
  have hgbK : IndepOver (↥F) ∅ (gb.cb : Set K) (F₁ : Set K) :=
    indepOver_of_subset_racl (cb_subset_racl_codeTuple gb) (subset_racl _ _)
      (hQK.mono_left (hsub 1))
  have hxK : IndepOver (↥F) ∅ (range x) (F₁ : Set K) :=
    hPK.mono_left (GroupConfiguration.gcPoints_subset (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) (x := x) (y := y)
      (z := z) 3)
  
  obtain ⟨v₁, hv₁, hv₁K⟩ := exists_idealOf_eq_indepOver F F₁ hrel v
  obtain ⟨v₁', hv₁', hv₁'K⟩ := exists_idealOf_eq_indepOver F F₁ hrel v'
  obtain ⟨f₁, hf₁, hf₁K⟩ := exists_mem_orbit_indepOver f₀ hrel
  have hdiff : diffSet f₁ = diffSet f₀ := by
    unfold diffSet
    rw [orbit_eq_of_mem hf₁]
  let B : Germ (↥F₁) v₁ v₁' :=
    (f₁.transport hv₁ hv₁').baseChange F F₁ h₀₁ hrel hv₁K hv₁'K
  let Ga : Germ (↥F₁) v₁ v₁ :=
    (ga.transport hv₁ hv₁).baseChange F F₁ h₀₁ hrel hv₁K hv₁K
  let Gb : Germ (↥F₁) v₁ v₁ :=
    (gb.transport hv₁ hv₁).baseChange F F₁ h₀₁ hrel hv₁K hv₁K
  have hB : IsHWBij B :=
    hb.baseChange_transport F F₁ h₀₁ hrel hv₁ hv₁' hv₁K hv₁'K hf₁ hf₁K
  have hGa : Ga ∈ diffSet B :=
    baseChange_transport_mem_diffSet F F₁ h₀₁ hrel hv₁ hv₁' hv₁K hv₁'K hf₁K
      (by rw [hdiff]; exact hga) hgaK
  have hGb : Gb ∈ diffSet B :=
    baseChange_transport_mem_diffSet F F₁ h₀₁ hrel hv₁ hv₁' hv₁K hv₁'K hf₁K
      (by rw [hdiff]; exact hgb) hgbK
  have code (g : Germ (↥F) v v) :
      racl (↥F₁)
        (range ((g.transport hv₁ hv₁).baseChange F F₁ h₀₁ hrel hv₁K hv₁K).codeTuple) =
      racl (↥F₁) (range g.codeTuple) := by
    rw [racl_codeTuple_baseChange F F₁ h₀₁ hrel hv₁K hv₁K]
    refine lift ?_
    rw [racl_codeTuple, cb_transport, ← racl_codeTuple]
  have hcodeA : racl (↥F₁) (range Ga.codeTuple) =
      racl (↥F₁) (range ga.codeTuple) := code ga
  have hcodeB : racl (↥F₁) (range Gb.codeTuple) =
      racl (↥F₁) (range gb.codeTuple) := code gb
  have hcfg₁ : GroupConfiguration (↥F₁) Ga.codeTuple Gb.codeTuple gc.codeTuple
      (ga.evalGen y₀) y₀ (gb.evalGen y₀) :=
    (GroupConfiguration.baseChange_racl F hcfg hS hSQ).ofRaclEq
      hcodeA hcodeB rfl rfl rfl rfl
  have hy₁ : IsGen (↥F₁) v₁ y₀ :=
    (isGen_base_iff F F₁ h₀₁ hrel hv₁K).2
      ⟨(isGen_iff_of_idealOf_eq hv₁ y₀).2 hy₀, hyK⟩
  have hyGa : IndepOver (↥F₁) ∅ (range y₀) (Ga.cb : Set K) :=
    indepOver_of_subset_racl (subset_racl _ _) (cb_subset_racl_codeTuple Ga)
      hcfg₁.indepOver_ay.symm
  have hyGb : IndepOver (↥F₁) ∅ (range y₀) (Gb.cb : Set K) :=
    indepOver_of_subset_racl (subset_racl _ _) (cb_subset_racl_codeTuple Gb)
      hcfg₁.indepOver_by.symm
  have hGay : Ga.evalGen y₀ = ga.evalGen y₀ := by
    exact (evalGen_baseChange F F₁ h₀₁ hrel hv₁K hv₁K
      (ga.transport hv₁ hv₁) hy₁ hyGa).trans (evalGen_transport hv₁ hv₁ ga y₀)
  have hGby : Gb.evalGen y₀ = gb.evalGen y₀ := by
    exact (evalGen_baseChange F F₁ h₀₁ hrel hv₁K hv₁K
      (gb.transport hv₁ hv₁) hy₁ hyGb).trans (evalGen_transport hv₁ hv₁ gb y₀)
  have hcfg₂ : GroupConfiguration (↥F₁) Ga.codeTuple Gb.codeTuple gc.codeTuple
      (Ga.evalGen y₀) y₀ (Gb.evalGen y₀) := by
    rw [hGay, hGby]
    exact hcfg₁
  
  have hw := hB.isHW hGb
  have hGaorb : Ga ∈ orbit Gb := by
    rw [← diffSet_eq_orbit hGb]
    exact hGa
  obtain ⟨Ga', hGa'⟩ := isUnit_iff.1 (hw.isUnit_of_mem hGaorb)
  have ht : IndepTriple (↥F₁) (range Ga.codeTuple) (range Gb.codeTuple) (range y₀) :=
    hcfg₂.indep 0 1 4 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
  have hind₃ : IndepTriple (↥F₁) (Ga.cb : Set K) (Gb.cb : Set K) (range y₀) :=
    indepTriple_of_racl_eq (racl_codeTuple Ga) (racl_codeTuple Gb) rfl ht
  have hv₁pos : 1 ≤ erk (↥F₁) ∅ (range v₁) := by
    rw [erk_empty_range_eq_of_idealOf_eq hy₁.symm]
    exact hcfg₂.one_le_erk_y
  obtain ⟨hconv, hGcx, hGcGa⟩ := hw.groupConfiguration hGaorb (self_mem_orbit Gb)
    hy₁ hind₃ hv₁pos hGa'
  have hGa'mem : Ga' ∈ diffSet B := inv_mem_diffSet hB.isInvertible hGa hGa'
  have hGbGa' : IndepOver (↥F₁) ∅ (Gb.cb : Set K) (Ga'.cb : Set K) := by
    refine indepOver_of_subset_racl (cb_subset_racl_codeTuple Gb) ?_ hcfg₂.indepOver_ab.symm
    rw [racl_codeTuple]
    exact SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 hGa'.cb_le
  have hGcmem : Gb * Ga' ∈ diffSet B := hB.mul_mem_diffSet hGb hGa'mem hGbGa'
  have hfa : racl (↥F₁) (range a) = racl (↥F₁) (range Ga.codeTuple) :=
    (lift ha).trans hcodeA.symm
  have hfb : racl (↥F₁) (range b) = racl (↥F₁) (range Gb.codeTuple) :=
    (lift hb₀).trans hcodeB.symm
  have hfc : racl (↥F₁) (range c) = racl (↥F₁) (range (Gb * Ga').codeTuple) :=
    (lift hc).trans (hcfg₂.racl_range_c_eq hconv)
  have hfx : racl (↥F₁) (range x) = racl (↥F₁) (range (Ga.evalGen y₀)) := by
    rw [hGay]
    exact lift hx
  have hfz : racl (↥F₁) (range z) = racl (↥F₁) (range (Gb.evalGen y₀)) := by
    rw [hGby]
    exact lift hz
  have rank_base : ∀ {X : Set K}, X.Finite → IndepOver (↥F) ∅ X (F₁ : Set K) →
      erk (↥F₁) ∅ X = erk (↥F) ∅ X := by
    intro X hX hXK
    rw [erk_base_le F F₁ h₀₁, ← empty_union (F₁ : Set K)]
    exact hXK (subset_refl _) hX
  have hrv : erk (↥F₁) ∅ (range v₁) = erk (↥F₁) ∅ (range x) :=
    (rank_base (finite_range _) hv₁K).trans
      ((erk_empty_range_eq_of_idealOf_eq hv₁).trans
        (hv.trans (rank_base (finite_range _) hxK).symm))
  have hrv' : erk (↥F₁) ∅ (range v₁') = erk (↥F₁) ∅ (range x) :=
    (rank_base (finite_range _) hv₁'K).trans
      ((erk_empty_range_eq_of_idealOf_eq hv₁').trans
        (hv'.trans (rank_base (finite_range _) hxK).symm))
  have hrB : erk (↥F₁) ∅ (B.cb : Set K) = erk (↥F₁) ∅ (range a) :=
    (hB.rank Ga hGa).symm.trans ((erk_eq_of_racl_eq (racl_codeTuple Ga).symm).trans
      (erk_eq_of_racl_eq hfa).symm)
  exact ⟨i₁, u₁, ν, ν', inferInstance, inferInstance, v₁, v₁', B, Ga, Gb, Gb * Ga', y₀,
    hB, hGa, hGb, hGcmem, hGcGa.symm, hy₁, hind₃, hGcx, hconv, hfa, hfb, hfc, hfx,
    lift hy, hfz, hrv, hrv', hrB⟩

name: GroupConfig.Ideal.map_eq_comap_of_inverse
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 ?_) ?_
  · rw [Ideal.comap_comap, h₁, Ideal.comap_id]
  · intro p hp
    have : ρ (ρ' p) = p := RingHom.congr_fun h₂ p
    rw [← this]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hp

name: GroupConfig.rename_comp_rename_symm_eq_id
statement:
theorem rename_comp_rename_symm_eq_id {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (e : ι ≃ ι') :
    (rename e.symm : MvPolynomial ι' R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial ι R).toRingHom.comp
      (rename e : MvPolynomial ι R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial ι' R).toRingHom = RingHom.id _
proof:
:=
  RingHom.ext fun p ↦ by
    change rename e.symm (rename e p) = p
    rw [rename_rename, e.symm_comp_self, rename_id_apply]

name: GroupConfig.mapF_comp_rename
statement:
theorem mapF_comp_rename (F : Subfield K) (e : ι → ι') :
    (mapF F (ι := ι')).comp
        (rename e : MvPolynomial ι (↥F) →ₐ[↥F] MvPolynomial ι' (↥F)).toRingHom =
      (rename e : MvPolynomial ι K →ₐ[K] MvPolynomial ι' K).toRingHom.comp (mapF F)
proof:
:=
  RingHom.ext fun p ↦ map_rename _ _ p

name: GroupConfig.idealDefinedOver_map_rename
statement:
theorem idealDefinedOver_map_rename (F : Subfield K) (e : ι ≃ ι')
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)) :
    IdealDefinedOver F
      (I.map (rename e : MvPolynomial ι K →ₐ[K] MvPolynomial ι' K).toRingHom) ↔
      IdealDefinedOver F I
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := rename_comp_rename_symm_eq_id (R := K) e
  have h₂ := rename_comp_rename_symm_eq_id (R := K) e.symm
  have hF₁ := rename_comp_rename_symm_eq_id (R := ↥F) e
  have hF₂ := rename_comp_rename_symm_eq_id (R := ↥F) e.symm
  rw [Equiv.symm_symm] at h₂ hF₂
  have key1 : ∀ J : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K),
      (J.map (rename e : MvPolynomial ι K →ₐ[K] _).toRingHom).comap (mapF F) =
        (J.comap (mapF F)).map (rename e : MvPolynomial ι (↥F) →ₐ[↥F] _).toRingHom := by
    intro J
    rw [Ideal.map_eq_comap_of_inverse h₁ h₂, Ideal.comap_comap, ← mapF_comp_rename,
      ← Ideal.comap_comap, Ideal.map_eq_comap_of_inverse hF₁ hF₂]
  have key2 : ∀ J : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι (↥F)),
      (J.map (rename e : MvPolynomial ι (↥F) →ₐ[↥F] _).toRingHom).map (mapF F) =
        (J.map (mapF F)).map (rename e : MvPolynomial ι K →ₐ[K] _).toRingHom := by
    intro J
    rw [Ideal.map_map, Ideal.map_map, mapF_comp_rename]
  unfold IdealDefinedOver
  rw [key1, key2]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := congrArg (Ideal.map (rename e.symm : MvPolynomial ι' K →ₐ[K] _).toRingHom) h
    rwa [Ideal.map_map, Ideal.map_map, h₁, Ideal.map_id, Ideal.map_id] at this
  · intro h
    exact congrArg (Ideal.map (rename e : MvPolynomial ι K →ₐ[K] _).toRingHom) h

name: GroupConfig.idealFod_map_rename
statement:
theorem idealFod_map_rename [Finite ι] [Finite ι'] (e : ι ≃ ι') (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)) :
    idealFod (I.map (rename e : MvPolynomial ι K →ₐ[K] MvPolynomial ι' K).toRingHom) =
      idealFod I
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm
    (idealDefinedOver_iff.1 ((idealDefinedOver_map_rename _ e I).2 (idealDefinedOver_idealFod I)))
    (idealDefinedOver_iff.1 ((idealDefinedOver_map_rename _ e I).1 (idealDefinedOver_idealFod _)))

name: GroupConfig.idealOf_comp_equiv
statement:
theorem idealOf_comp_equiv (L : Type*) [Field L] [Algebra L K] (a : ι' → K) (e : ι ≃ ι') :
    idealOf L (a ∘ e) =
      (idealOf L a).comap
        (rename e : MvPolynomial ι L →ₐ[L] MvPolynomial ι' L).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, mem_idealOf_iff, mem_idealOf_iff]
  change aeval (a ∘ e) f = 0 ↔ aeval a (rename e f) = 0
  rw [aeval_rename]

name: GroupConfig.locusIdeal_comp_equiv
statement:
theorem locusIdeal_comp_equiv (L : Type*) [Field L] [Algebra L K] (a : ι' → K) (e : ι ≃ ι') :
    locusIdeal L (a ∘ e) =
      (locusIdeal L a).map
        (rename e.symm : MvPolynomial ι' K →ₐ[K] MvPolynomial ι K).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  have hL₁ := rename_comp_rename_symm_eq_id (R := L) e
  have hL₂ := rename_comp_rename_symm_eq_id (R := L) e.symm
  rw [Equiv.symm_symm] at hL₂
  unfold locusIdeal
  rw [idealOf_comp_equiv, ← Ideal.map_eq_comap_of_inverse hL₂ hL₁, Ideal.map_map, Ideal.map_map]
  congr 1
  exact RingHom.ext fun p ↦ map_rename _ _ _

name: GroupConfig.canonicalBase_comp_equiv
statement:
theorem canonicalBase_comp_equiv [Finite ι] [Finite ι'] (L : IntermediateField k K) (a : ι' → K)
    (e : ι ≃ ι') : canonicalBase L (a ∘ e) = canonicalBase L a
proof:
:= by
  unfold canonicalBase
  rw [locusIdeal_comp_equiv, idealFod_map_rename]

name: GroupConfig.canonicalBase_sum_elim_swap
statement:
theorem canonicalBase_sum_elim_swap [Finite ι] [Finite ι'] (L : IntermediateField k K)
    (x : ι → K) (y : ι' → K) : canonicalBase L (Sum.elim y x) = canonicalBase L (Sum.elim x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← canonicalBase_comp_equiv L (Sum.elim x y) (Equiv.sumComm ι' ι)]
  congr 1
  funext s
  cases s <;> rfl

name: GroupConfig.IndepTriple.perm_left
statement: theorem perm_left (h : IndepTriple k A B C) : IndepTriple k B A C
proof:
:= by
  unfold IndepTriple at h ⊢
  rw [union_comm B A, add_comm (erk k ∅ B)]
  exact h

name: GroupConfig.IndepTriple.perm_right
statement: theorem perm_right (h : IndepTriple k A B C) : IndepTriple k A C B
proof:
:= by
  unfold IndepTriple at h ⊢
  rw [union_assoc, union_comm C B, ← union_assoc, add_assoc, add_comm (erk k ∅ C), ← add_assoc]
  exact h

name: GroupConfig.IndepTriple.rotate
statement: theorem rotate (h : IndepTriple k A B C) : IndepTriple k B C A
proof: := h.perm_left.perm_right

name: GroupConfig.IndepTriple.erk_union_left
statement:
theorem erk_union_left (h : IndepTriple k A B C) (hC : C.Finite) :
    erk k ∅ (A ∪ B) = erk k ∅ A + erk k ∅ B
proof:
:= by
  refine WithTop.add_right_cancel (erk_lt_top k hC ∅).ne (le_antisymm ?_ ?_)
  · exact add_le_add_left (erk_union_le k ∅ A B) _
  · exact h.symm.le.trans (erk_union_le k ∅ (A ∪ B) C)

name: GroupConfig.IndepTriple.indepOver_left
statement:
theorem indepOver_left (h : IndepTriple k A B C) (hA : A.Finite) (hB : B.Finite)
    (hC : C.Finite) : IndepOver k ∅ A B
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := h.erk_union_left hC
  rw [erk_union_eq] at h1
  refine (indepOver_of_erk_eq hB ?_).symm
  exact WithTop.add_left_cancel (erk_lt_top k hA ∅).ne h1

name: GroupConfig.IndepTriple.indepOver_union
statement:
theorem indepOver_union (h : IndepTriple k A B C) (hA : A.Finite) (hB : B.Finite)
    (hC : C.Finite) : IndepOver k ∅ A (B ∪ C)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : erk k ∅ (A ∪ (B ∪ C)) = erk k ∅ A + erk k ∅ (B ∪ C) := by
    rw [← union_assoc, h, h.rotate.erk_union_left hA, add_assoc]
  rw [erk_union_eq] at h1
  refine (indepOver_of_erk_eq (hB.union hC) ?_).symm
  exact WithTop.add_left_cancel (erk_lt_top k hA ∅).ne h1

name: GroupConfig.swapBCIdx_swapBCIdx
statement: theorem swapBCIdx_swapBCIdx (i : Fin 6) : swapBCIdx (swapBCIdx i) = i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: GroupConfig.forall_of_sorted
statement:
theorem forall_of_sorted {P : Fin 6 → Fin 6 → Fin 6 → Prop}
    (hswap : ∀ i j l, P i j l → P j i l) (hswap' : ∀ i j l, P i j l → P i l j)
    (hs : ∀ i j l, i < j → j < l → ¬ GCCollinear i j l → P i j l) :
    ∀ i j l, i ≠ j → i ≠ l → j ≠ l → ¬ GCCollinear i j l → P i j l
proof:
:= by
  intro i j l hij hil hjl hcol
  rcases lt_trichotomy i j with h1 | h1 | h1
  · rcases lt_trichotomy j l with h2 | h2 | h2
    · exact hs i j l h1 h2 hcol
    · exact absurd h2 hjl
    · rcases lt_trichotomy i l with h3 | h3 | h3
      · exact hswap' _ _ _ (hs i l j h3 h2 fun h ↦ hcol h.swap')
      · exact absurd h3 hil
      · exact hswap' _ _ _ (hswap _ _ _ (hs l i j h3 h1 fun h ↦ hcol h.swap.swap'))
  · exact absurd h1 hij
  · rcases lt_trichotomy i l with h2 | h2 | h2
    · exact hswap _ _ _ (hs j i l h1 h2 fun h ↦ hcol h.swap)
    · exact absurd h2 hil
    · rcases lt_trichotomy j l with h3 | h3 | h3
      · exact hswap _ _ _ (hswap' _ _ _ (hs j l i h3 h2 fun h ↦ hcol h.swap'.swap))
      · exact absurd h3 hjl
      · exact hswap _ _ _ (hswap' _ _ _ (hswap _ _ _
          (hs l j i h3 h1 fun h ↦ hcol h.swap.swap'.swap)))

name: GroupConfig.indep_of_sixteen
statement:
theorem indep_of_sixteen {pts : Fin 6 → Set K}
    (h013 : IndepTriple k (pts 0) (pts 1) (pts 3))
    (h014 : IndepTriple k (pts 0) (pts 1) (pts 4))
    (h015 : IndepTriple k (pts 0) (pts 1) (pts 5))
    (h023 : IndepTriple k (pts 0) (pts 2) (pts 3))
    (h024 : IndepTriple k (pts 0) (pts 2) (pts 4))
    (h025 : IndepTriple k (pts 0) (pts 2) (pts 5))
    (h035 : IndepTriple k (pts 0) (pts 3) (pts 5))
    (h045 : IndepTriple k (pts 0) (pts 4) (pts 5))
    (h123 : IndepTriple k (pts 1) (pts 2) (pts 3))
    (h124 : IndepTriple k (pts 1) (pts 2) (pts 4))
    (h125 : IndepTriple k (pts 1) (pts 2) (pts 5))
    (h134 : IndepTriple k (pts 1) (pts 3) (pts 4))
    (h135 : IndepTriple k (pts 1) (pts 3) (pts 5))
    (h234 : IndepTriple k (pts 2) (pts 3) (pts 4))
    (h245 : IndepTriple k (pts 2) (pts 4) (pts 5))
    (h345 : IndepTriple k (pts 3) (pts 4) (pts 5)) :
    ∀ i j l : Fin 6, i ≠ j → i ≠ l → j ≠ l → ¬ GCCollinear i j l →
      IndepTriple k (pts i) (pts j) (pts l)
proof:
:= by
  refine forall_of_sorted (fun _ _ _ h ↦ h.perm_left) (fun _ _ _ h ↦ h.perm_right) ?_
  intro i j l hij hjl hcol
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> fin_cases l
  all_goals
    first
    | exact absurd hij (by decide)
    | exact absurd hjl (by decide)
    | exact absurd (by decide) hcol
    | skip
  exacts [h013, h014, h015, h023, h024, h025, h035, h045, h123, h124, h125, h134, h135, h234,
    h245, h345]

name: GroupConfig.erk_union_of_indepOver
statement:
theorem erk_union_of_indepOver {A B : Set K} (hB : B.Finite) (h : IndepOver k ∅ A B) :
    erk k ∅ (A ∪ B) = erk k ∅ A + erk k ∅ B
proof:
:= by
  rw [erk_union_eq, h.symm.erk_eq (subset_refl _) hB]

name: GroupConfig.erk_eq_of_racl_eq
statement: theorem erk_eq_of_racl_eq {A B : Set K} (h : racl k A = racl k B) : erk k ∅ A = erk k ∅ B
proof:
:= by
  rw [← erk_racl k ∅ A, ← erk_racl k ∅ B, empty_union, empty_union, h]

name: GroupConfig.racl_union_congr
statement:
theorem racl_union_congr {A A' B B' : Set K} (hA : racl k A = racl k A')
    (hB : racl k B = racl k B') : racl k (A ∪ B) = racl k (A' ∪ B')
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ A A' B B' : Set K, racl k A = racl k A' → racl k B = racl k B' →
      racl k (A ∪ B) ≤ racl k (A' ∪ B') := by
    intro A A' B B' hA hB
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset ?_ ?_)
    · exact (subset_racl k A).trans (hA ▸ racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_left)
    · exact (subset_racl k B).trans (hB ▸ racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_right)
  exact le_antisymm (key A A' B B' hA hB) (key A' A B' B hA.symm hB.symm)

name: GroupConfig.indepTriple_of_racl_eq
statement:
theorem indepTriple_of_racl_eq {A A' B B' C C' : Set K} (hA : racl k A = racl k A')
    (hB : racl k B = racl k B') (hC : racl k C = racl k C') (h : IndepTriple k A B C) :
    IndepTriple k A' B' C'
proof:
:= by
  unfold IndepTriple at h ⊢
  rw [← erk_eq_of_racl_eq (racl_union_congr (racl_union_congr hA hB) hC), ← erk_eq_of_racl_eq hA,
    ← erk_eq_of_racl_eq hB, ← erk_eq_of_racl_eq hC]
  exact h

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.indepOver_pts
statement:
theorem indepOver_pts {i j : Fin 6} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    IndepOver k ∅ (gcPoints a b c x y z i) (gcPoints a b c x y z j)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ i j : Fin 6, i ≠ j → ∃ l, i ≠ l ∧ j ≠ l ∧ ¬ GCCollinear i j l := by decide
  obtain ⟨l, hil, hjl, hcol⟩ := key i j hij
  exact (hc.indep i j l hij hil hjl hcol).indepOver_left (gcPoints_finite a b c x y z i)
    (gcPoints_finite a b c x y z j) (gcPoints_finite a b c x y z l)

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.erk_b_eq
statement: theorem erk_b_eq : erk k ∅ (range b) = erk k ∅ (range a)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := erk_eq_of_racl_eq hc.racl_ab_bc
  rw [erk_union_of_indepOver (finite_range b) hc.indepOver_ab,
    erk_union_of_indepOver (finite_range c) hc.indepOver_bc] at h1
  have h2 := erk_eq_of_racl_eq hc.racl_ab_ac
  rw [erk_union_of_indepOver (finite_range b) hc.indepOver_ab,
    erk_union_of_indepOver (finite_range c) hc.indepOver_ac] at h2
  have h3 := WithTop.add_left_cancel (erk_lt_top k (finite_range a) ∅).ne h2
  rw [h3, add_comm] at h1
  exact h3.trans (WithTop.add_left_cancel (erk_lt_top k (finite_range c) ∅).ne h1).symm

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.erk_c_eq
statement: theorem erk_c_eq : erk k ∅ (range c) = erk k ∅ (range a)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 := erk_eq_of_racl_eq hc.racl_ab_ac
  rw [erk_union_of_indepOver (finite_range b) hc.indepOver_ab,
    erk_union_of_indepOver (finite_range c) hc.indepOver_ac] at h2
  rw [← hc.erk_b_eq]
  exact (WithTop.add_left_cancel (erk_lt_top k (finite_range a) ∅).ne h2).symm

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.erk_y_eq
statement: theorem erk_y_eq : erk k ∅ (range y) = erk k ∅ (range x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := erk_eq_of_racl_eq hc.racl_ax_ay
  rw [erk_union_of_indepOver (finite_range x) hc.indepOver_ax,
    erk_union_of_indepOver (finite_range y) hc.indepOver_ay] at h
  exact (WithTop.add_left_cancel (erk_lt_top k (finite_range a) ∅).ne h).symm

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.erk_z_eq
statement: theorem erk_z_eq : erk k ∅ (range z) = erk k ∅ (range x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := erk_eq_of_racl_eq hc.racl_by_bz
  rw [erk_union_of_indepOver (finite_range y) hc.indepOver_by,
    erk_union_of_indepOver (finite_range z) hc.indepOver_bz] at h
  rw [← hc.erk_y_eq]
  exact (WithTop.add_left_cancel (erk_lt_top k (finite_range b) ∅).ne h).symm

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.one_le_erk_b
statement: theorem one_le_erk_b : 1 ≤ erk k ∅ (range b)
proof: := hc.erk_b_eq ▸ hc.one_le_erk
