name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.swapBC
statement:
theorem swapBC : GroupConfiguration k a c b y x z where
  racl_ab_ac
proof:
:= hc.racl_ab_ac.symm
  racl_ab_bc := by rw [← hc.racl_ab_ac, hc.racl_ab_bc, union_comm]
  racl_ax_ay := hc.racl_ax_ay.symm
  racl_by_bz := hc.racl_cx_cz
  racl_cx_cz := hc.racl_by_bz
  indep i j l hij hil hjl hcol := by
    rw [gcPoints_swapBC i, gcPoints_swapBC j, gcPoints_swapBC l]
    exact hc.indep (swapBCIdx i) (swapBCIdx j) (swapBCIdx l) (fun h ↦ hij (swapBCIdx_injective h))
      (fun h ↦ hil (swapBCIdx_injective h)) (fun h ↦ hjl (swapBCIdx_injective h))
      (fun h ↦ hcol (gcCollinear_of_swapBCIdx h))
  cb_a := by
    rw [canonicalBase_sum_elim_swap]
    exact hc.cb_a
  cb_b := hc.cb_c
  cb_c := hc.cb_b
  one_le_erk := hc.one_le_erk

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.swapAB
statement:
theorem swapAB : GroupConfiguration k b a c z y x where
  racl_ab_ac
proof:
:= by rw [union_comm, hc.racl_ab_bc]
  racl_ab_bc := by rw [union_comm, hc.racl_ab_ac]
  racl_ax_ay := hc.racl_by_bz.symm
  racl_by_bz := hc.racl_ax_ay.symm
  racl_cx_cz := hc.racl_cx_cz.symm
  indep i j l hij hil hjl hcol := by
    rw [gcPoints_swapAB i, gcPoints_swapAB j, gcPoints_swapAB l]
    exact hc.indep (swapABIdx i) (swapABIdx j) (swapABIdx l) (fun h ↦ hij (swapABIdx_injective h))
      (fun h ↦ hil (swapABIdx_injective h)) (fun h ↦ hjl (swapABIdx_injective h))
      (fun h ↦ hcol (gcCollinear_of_swapABIdx h))
  cb_a := by
    rw [canonicalBase_sum_elim_swap]
    exact hc.cb_b
  cb_b := by
    rw [canonicalBase_sum_elim_swap]
    exact hc.cb_a
  cb_c := by
    rw [canonicalBase_sum_elim_swap]
    exact hc.cb_c
  one_le_erk := hc.one_le_erk_b

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.gcPoints_map
statement:
theorem gcPoints_map (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (i : Fin 6) :
    gcPoints (⇑σ ∘ a) (⇑σ ∘ b) (⇑σ ∘ c) (⇑σ ∘ x) (⇑σ ∘ y) (⇑σ ∘ z) i =
      ⇑σ '' gcPoints a b c x y z i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> exact range_comp _ _

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.racl_range_comp_union
statement:
theorem racl_range_comp_union (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) {ι ι' : Type*} (u : ι → K) (v : ι' → K) :
    racl k (range (⇑σ ∘ u) ∪ range (⇑σ ∘ v)) =
      (racl k (range u ∪ range v)).map σ.toAlgHom
proof:
:= by
  rw [range_comp, range_comp, ← image_union, racl_map]

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.IndepTriple.image
statement:
theorem IndepTriple.image {A B C : Set K} (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (h : IndepTriple k A B C) :
    IndepTriple k (⇑σ '' A) (⇑σ '' B) (⇑σ '' C)
proof:
:= by
  unfold IndepTriple at h ⊢
  rw [← image_union, ← image_union, ← image_empty ⇑σ, erk_image, erk_image, erk_image, erk_image]
  exact h

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.erk_range_comp
statement:
theorem erk_range_comp (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) {ι : Type*} (u : ι → K) :
    erk k ∅ (range (⇑σ ∘ u)) = erk k ∅ (range u)
proof:
:= by
  calc erk k ∅ (range (⇑σ ∘ u)) = erk k (⇑σ '' ∅) (⇑σ '' range u) := by
        rw [image_empty, range_comp]
    _ = erk k ∅ (range u) := erk_image σ ∅ (range u)

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.map
statement:
theorem map (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) :
    GroupConfiguration k (⇑σ ∘ a) (⇑σ ∘ b) (⇑σ ∘ c) (⇑σ ∘ x) (⇑σ ∘ y) (⇑σ ∘ z) where
  racl_ab_ac
proof:
:= by rw [racl_range_comp_union, racl_range_comp_union, hc.racl_ab_ac]
  racl_ab_bc := by rw [racl_range_comp_union, racl_range_comp_union, hc.racl_ab_bc]
  racl_ax_ay := by rw [racl_range_comp_union, racl_range_comp_union, hc.racl_ax_ay]
  racl_by_bz := by rw [racl_range_comp_union, racl_range_comp_union, hc.racl_by_bz]
  racl_cx_cz := by rw [racl_range_comp_union, racl_range_comp_union, hc.racl_cx_cz]
  indep i j l hij hil hjl hcol := by
    rw [gcPoints_map σ i, gcPoints_map σ j, gcPoints_map σ l]
    exact IndepTriple.image σ (hc.indep i j l hij hil hjl hcol)
  cb_a := by
    rw [← Sum.comp_elim, range_comp, ← racl_map, canonicalBase_map, coe_map,
      AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, ← racl_map, coe_map, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom]
    exact image_mono hc.cb_a
  cb_b := by
    rw [← Sum.comp_elim, range_comp, ← racl_map, canonicalBase_map, coe_map,
      AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, ← racl_map, coe_map, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom]
    exact image_mono hc.cb_b
  cb_c := by
    rw [← Sum.comp_elim, range_comp, ← racl_map, canonicalBase_map, coe_map,
      AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, ← racl_map, coe_map, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom]
    exact image_mono hc.cb_c
  one_le_erk := by
    rw [erk_range_comp]
    exact hc.one_le_erk

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.ofRaclEq
statement:
theorem ofRaclEq [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K] {ι₁' ι₂' ι₃' ι₄' ι₅' ι₆' : Type*}
    [Finite ι₁'] [Finite ι₂'] [Finite ι₃'] [Finite ι₄'] [Finite ι₅'] [Finite ι₆']
    {a' : ι₁' → K} {b' : ι₂' → K} {c' : ι₃' → K} {x' : ι₄' → K} {y' : ι₅' → K} {z' : ι₆' → K}
    (ha : racl k (range a') = racl k (range a)) (hb : racl k (range b') = racl k (range b))
    (hc' : racl k (range c') = racl k (range c)) (hx : racl k (range x') = racl k (range x))
    (hy : racl k (range y') = racl k (range y)) (hz : racl k (range z') = racl k (range z)) :
    GroupConfiguration k a' b' c' x' y' z'
proof:
:= by
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (range a)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (range b)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (range c)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hpts : ∀ i, racl k (gcPoints a' b' c' x' y' z' i) = racl k (gcPoints a b c x y z i) := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    exacts [ha, hb, hc', hx, hy, hz]
  have hxy : racl k (range (Sum.elim x y)) = racl k (range (Sum.elim x' y')) := by
    rw [Sum.elim_range, Sum.elim_range]
    exact (racl_union_congr hx hy).symm
  have hyz : racl k (range (Sum.elim y z)) = racl k (range (Sum.elim y' z')) := by
    rw [Sum.elim_range, Sum.elim_range]
    exact (racl_union_congr hy hz).symm
  have hxz : racl k (range (Sum.elim x z)) = racl k (range (Sum.elim x' z')) := by
    rw [Sum.elim_range, Sum.elim_range]
    exact (racl_union_congr hx hz).symm
  exact
    { racl_ab_ac := by rw [racl_union_congr ha hb, racl_union_congr ha hc', hc.racl_ab_ac]
      racl_ab_bc := by rw [racl_union_congr ha hb, racl_union_congr hb hc', hc.racl_ab_bc]
      racl_ax_ay := by rw [racl_union_congr ha hx, racl_union_congr ha hy, hc.racl_ax_ay]
      racl_by_bz := by rw [racl_union_congr hb hy, racl_union_congr hb hz, hc.racl_by_bz]
      racl_cx_cz := by rw [racl_union_congr hc' hx, racl_union_congr hc' hz, hc.racl_cx_cz]
      indep i j l hij hil hjl hcol :=
        indepTriple_of_racl_eq (hpts i).symm (hpts j).symm (hpts l).symm
          (hc.indep i j l hij hil hjl hcol)
      cb_a := by
        have hL : IsSmall k ((racl k (range a) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
          (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range a)).racl
        have e : racl k (canonicalBase (racl k (range a)) (Sum.elim x y) : Set K) =
            racl k (canonicalBase (racl k (range a)) (Sum.elim x' y') : Set K) :=
          racl_canonicalBase_eq_of_racl_eq hL hxy
        have h1 : (racl k (range a) : Set K) ⊆
            (racl k (canonicalBase (racl k (range a)) (Sum.elim x' y') : Set K) : Set K) := by
          rw [← e]
          exact SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 (racl_le_of_subset_racl hc.cb_a)
        refine (subset_racl k (range a')).trans ?_
        rw [ha]
        exact h1
      cb_b := by
        have hL : IsSmall k ((racl k (range b) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
          (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range b)).racl
        have e : racl k (canonicalBase (racl k (range b)) (Sum.elim y z) : Set K) =
            racl k (canonicalBase (racl k (range b)) (Sum.elim y' z') : Set K) :=
          racl_canonicalBase_eq_of_racl_eq hL hyz
        have h1 : (racl k (range b) : Set K) ⊆
            (racl k (canonicalBase (racl k (range b)) (Sum.elim y' z') : Set K) : Set K) := by
          rw [← e]
          exact SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 (racl_le_of_subset_racl hc.cb_b)
        refine (subset_racl k (range b')).trans ?_
        rw [hb]
        exact h1
      cb_c := by
        have hL : IsSmall k ((racl k (range c) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
          (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range c)).racl
        have e : racl k (canonicalBase (racl k (range c)) (Sum.elim x z) : Set K) =
            racl k (canonicalBase (racl k (range c)) (Sum.elim x' z') : Set K) :=
          racl_canonicalBase_eq_of_racl_eq hL hxz
        have h1 : (racl k (range c) : Set K) ⊆
            (racl k (canonicalBase (racl k (range c)) (Sum.elim x' z') : Set K) : Set K) := by
          rw [← e]
          exact SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 (racl_le_of_subset_racl hc.cb_c)
        refine (subset_racl k (range c')).trans ?_
        rw [hc']
        exact h1
      one_le_erk := by
        rw [erk_eq_of_racl_eq ha]
        exact hc.one_le_erk }

name: AclGeom.racl_baseClosure_coe
statement:
theorem racl_baseClosure_coe (S : Set K) :
    ((racl (↥(racl k (∅ : Set K))) S : IntermediateField _ K) : Set K) = racl k S
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  have h : x ∈ racl (↥(racl k (∅ : Set K))) S ↔
      x ∈ racl k ((racl k (∅ : Set K) : Set K) ∪ S) := by
    rw [mem_racl_iff (↥(racl k (∅ : Set K))), mem_racl_iff k, ← restrictScalars_adjoin]
    exact Iff.rfl
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, SetLike.mem_coe, h, racl_union_left, empty_union]

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.isRAC_restrictScalars
statement:
private theorem isRAC_restrictScalars {E : IntermediateField (↥(racl k (∅ : Set K))) K}
    (hE : IsRAC E) : IsRAC (E.restrictScalars k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isRAC_iff_racl_eq] at hE ⊢
  refine SetLike.coe_injective ?_
  rw [coe_restrictScalars, ← racl_baseClosure_coe, hE]

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.baseClosure_le
statement: private theorem baseClosure_le (F : ClosedIF k K) : racl k (∅ : Set K) ≤ F.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isRAC_iff_racl_eq.1 F.2]
  exact racl_mono (k := k) (empty_subset _)

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.isRAC_extendScalars
statement:
private theorem isRAC_extendScalars (F : ClosedIF k K) :
    IsRAC (extendScalars (baseClosure_le F))
proof:
:= by
  rw [isRAC_iff_racl_eq]
  refine SetLike.coe_injective ?_
  rw [coe_extendScalars, racl_baseClosure_coe, isRAC_iff_racl_eq.1 F.2]

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.coe_baseClosureEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_baseClosureEquiv (E : ClosedIF (↥(racl k (∅ : Set K))) K) :
    ((baseClosureEquiv k K E : ClosedIF k K) : Set K) = E
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.coe_baseClosureEquiv_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_baseClosureEquiv_symm (F : ClosedIF k K) :
    (((baseClosureEquiv k K).symm F : ClosedIF (↥(racl k (∅ : Set K))) K) : Set K) = F
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.erk_baseClosure
statement: theorem erk_baseClosure (X : Set K) : erk (↥(racl k (∅ : Set K))) ∅ X = erk k ∅ X
proof:
:= by
  rw [erk_empty_eq (↥(racl k (∅ : Set K))), ← erk_coe_eq k (racl k (∅ : Set K)),
    erk_racl_base k ∅ X]

name: GroupConfig.rkMatroid_ground
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rkMatroid_ground (C : Set K) : (rkMatroid k C).E = univ
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.rkMatroid_closure_eq
statement:
theorem rkMatroid_closure_eq (C S : Set K) :
    (rkMatroid k C).closure S = (racl k (C ∪ S) : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  change (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid (↥(adjoin k C)) K).closure S = _
  rw [algebraicMatroid_closure_eq_racl (k := ↥(adjoin k C)) S]
  ext x
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe]
  exact mem_racl_adjoin_base_iff

name: GroupConfig.mem_rkMatroid_closure_iff
statement:
theorem mem_rkMatroid_closure_iff {C S : Set K} {x : K} :
    x ∈ (rkMatroid k C).closure S ↔ x ∈ racl k (C ∪ S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rkMatroid_closure_eq, SetLike.mem_coe]

name: GroupConfig.rkMatroid_indep_iff
statement:
theorem rkMatroid_indep_iff {C S : Set K} :
    (rkMatroid k C).Indep S ↔ ∀ x ∈ S, x ∉ racl k (C ∪ (S \ {x}))
proof:
:= by
  rw [indep_iff_forall_notMem_closure_sdiff']
  simp only [rkMatroid_ground, subset_univ, true_and, mem_rkMatroid_closure_iff]

name: GroupConfig.rkMatroid_congr
statement:
theorem rkMatroid_congr {C C' : Set K} (h : racl k C = racl k C') :
    rkMatroid k C = rkMatroid k C'
proof:
:= by
  refine Matroid.ext_closure fun X ↦ ?_
  rw [rkMatroid_closure_eq, rkMatroid_closure_eq, ← racl_union_left (k := k) C X, h,
    racl_union_left]

name: GroupConfig.rkMatroid_indep_of_subset_base
statement:
theorem rkMatroid_indep_of_subset_base {C C' S : Set K} (hCC' : C ⊆ C')
    (hS : (rkMatroid k C').Indep S) : (rkMatroid k C).Indep S
proof:
:= by
  rw [rkMatroid_indep_iff] at hS ⊢
  intro x hx hmem
  exact hS x hx (racl_mono (union_subset_union_left _ hCC') hmem)

name: GroupConfig.subset_racl_of_isBasis'
statement:
theorem subset_racl_of_isBasis' {C X I : Set K} (hI : (rkMatroid k C).IsBasis' I X) :
    X ⊆ racl k (C ∪ I)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hI.closure_eq_closure
  rw [rkMatroid_closure_eq, rkMatroid_closure_eq] at h
  rw [h]
  exact subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k (C ∪ X))

name: GroupConfig.erk_le_encard
statement: theorem erk_le_encard (C X : Set K) : erk k C X ≤ X.encard
proof:
:=
  (rkMatroid k C).eRk_le_encard X

name: GroupConfig.erk_lt_top
statement: theorem erk_lt_top {X : Set K} (hX : X.Finite) (C : Set K) : erk k C X < ⊤
proof:
:=
  (erk_le_encard k C X).trans_lt hX.encard_lt_top

name: GroupConfig.erk_ne_top
statement: theorem erk_ne_top {X : Set K} (hX : X.Finite) (C : Set K) : erk k C X ≠ ⊤
proof:
:=
  (erk_lt_top k hX C).ne

name: GroupConfig.erk_mono
statement: theorem erk_mono {X Y : Set K} (C : Set K) (h : X ⊆ Y) : erk k C X ≤ erk k C Y
proof:
:=
  (rkMatroid k C).eRk_mono h

name: GroupConfig.erk_congr_base
statement:
theorem erk_congr_base {C C' : Set K} (h : racl k C = racl k C') (X : Set K) :
    erk k C X = erk k C' X
proof:
:= by
  unfold erk
  rw [rkMatroid_congr k h]

name: GroupConfig.erk_racl_base
statement: theorem erk_racl_base (C X : Set K) : erk k (racl k C) X = erk k C X
proof:
:=
  erk_congr_base k (racl_racl k C) X

name: GroupConfig.erk_base_union_of_subset_racl
statement:
theorem erk_base_union_of_subset_racl {C S : Set K} (hS : S ⊆ racl k C) (X : Set K) :
    erk k (C ∪ S) X = erk k C X
proof:
:= by
  refine erk_congr_base k ?_ X
  refine le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset (subset_racl k C) hS)) ?_
  exact racl_mono subset_union_left

name: GroupConfig.erk_base_mono
statement:
theorem erk_base_mono {C C' : Set K} (h : C ⊆ C') (X : Set K) :
    erk k C' X ≤ erk k C X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := (rkMatroid k C').exists_isBasis' X
  unfold erk
  rw [← hJ.encard_eq_eRk]
  exact (rkMatroid_indep_of_subset_base k h hJ.indep).encard_le_eRk_of_subset hJ.subset

name: GroupConfig.erk_racl
statement: theorem erk_racl (C X : Set K) : erk k C (racl k (C ∪ X)) = erk k C X
proof:
:= by
  unfold erk
  rw [← rkMatroid_closure_eq, eRk_closure_eq]

name: GroupConfig.erk_union_eq_of_subset_racl
statement:
theorem erk_union_eq_of_subset_racl {C X Y : Set K} (hY : Y ⊆ racl k (C ∪ X)) :
    erk k C (X ∪ Y) = erk k C X
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (erk_mono k C subset_union_left)
  calc erk k C (X ∪ Y) ≤ erk k C (racl k (C ∪ X)) :=
        erk_mono k C (union_subset (subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k (C ∪ X))) hY)
    _ = erk k C X := erk_racl k C X

name: GroupConfig.erk_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem erk_eq_zero_iff {C X : Set K} : erk k C X = 0 ↔ X ⊆ racl k C
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : (rkMatroid k C).eRk X = 0 ↔ X ⊆ (rkMatroid k C).loops :=
    eRk_eq_zero_iff (subset_univ X)
  unfold erk
  rw [h0, ← closure_empty, rkMatroid_closure_eq, union_empty]

name: GroupConfig.erk_eq_zero_of_subset_racl
statement: theorem erk_eq_zero_of_subset_racl {C X : Set K} (h : X ⊆ racl k C) : erk k C X = 0
proof:
:=
  (erk_eq_zero_iff k).2 h

name: GroupConfig.erk_singleton_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem erk_singleton_eq_zero_iff {C : Set K} {x : K} :
    erk k C {x} = 0 ↔ x ∈ racl k C
proof:
:= by
  rw [erk_eq_zero_iff, singleton_subset_iff, SetLike.mem_coe]

name: GroupConfig.erk_empty
statement: theorem erk_empty (C : Set K) : erk k C ∅ = 0
proof:
:=
  erk_eq_zero_of_subset_racl k (empty_subset _)

name: GroupConfig.erk_union_comm
statement: theorem erk_union_comm (C X Y : Set K) : erk k C (X ∪ Y) = erk k C (Y ∪ X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [union_comm]

name: GroupConfig.erk_union_le
statement: theorem erk_union_le (C X Y : Set K) : erk k C (X ∪ Y) ≤ erk k C X + erk k C Y
proof:
:=
  (rkMatroid k C).eRk_union_le_eRk_add_eRk X Y

name: GroupConfig.erk_inter_add_erk_union_le
statement:
theorem erk_inter_add_erk_union_le (C X Y : Set K) :
    erk k C (X ∩ Y) + erk k C (X ∪ Y) ≤ erk k C X + erk k C Y
proof:
:=
  (rkMatroid k C).eRk_inter_add_eRk_union_le X Y

name: GroupConfig.disjoint_of_isBasis'_union
statement:
theorem disjoint_of_isBasis'_union {C X Y J : Set K}
    (hJ : (rkMatroid k (C ∪ X)).IsBasis' J Y) : Disjoint X J
proof:
:= by
  rw [disjoint_right]
  intro e heJ heX
  have hind := (rkMatroid_indep_iff k).1 hJ.indep e heJ
  exact hind (subset_racl k _ (mem_union_left _ (mem_union_right _ heX)))

name: GroupConfig.erk_union_eq
statement:
theorem erk_union_eq (C X Y : Set K) :
    erk k C (X ∪ Y) = erk k C X + erk k (C ∪ X) Y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := (rkMatroid k C).exists_isBasis' X
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := (rkMatroid k (C ∪ X)).exists_isBasis' Y
  have hdisjIJ : Disjoint I J := (disjoint_of_isBasis'_union k hJ).mono_left hI.subset
  
  have hJC : (rkMatroid k C).Indep J :=
    rkMatroid_indep_of_subset_base k subset_union_left hJ.indep
  
  have hIJ : (rkMatroid k C).Indep (I ∪ J) := by
    rw [hI.indep.union_indep_iff_forall_notMem_closure_right hJC]
    intro e he hmem
    rw [mem_rkMatroid_closure_iff] at hmem
    have hJe := (rkMatroid_indep_iff k).1 hJ.indep e he.1
    refine hJe (racl_mono ?_ hmem)
    rw [union_assoc]
    exact union_subset_union_right C (union_subset_union_left _ hI.subset)
  
  have hX : X ⊆ racl k (C ∪ I) := subset_racl_of_isBasis' k hI
  have hY : Y ⊆ racl k (C ∪ X ∪ J) := subset_racl_of_isBasis' k hJ
  have hXY : X ∪ Y ⊆ (rkMatroid k C).closure (I ∪ J) := by
    rw [rkMatroid_closure_eq]
    have h1 : (racl k (C ∪ I) : Set K) ⊆ racl k (C ∪ (I ∪ J)) := by
      rw [SetLike.coe_subset_coe]
      exact racl_mono (union_subset_union_right C subset_union_left)
    have h2 : (racl k (C ∪ X ∪ J) : Set K) ⊆ racl k (C ∪ (I ∪ J)) := by
      rw [SetLike.coe_subset_coe]
      refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_
      refine union_subset (union_subset ?_ ?_) ?_
      · exact subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
      · exact hX.trans h1
      · exact (subset_union_right.trans subset_union_right).trans (subset_racl k _)
    exact union_subset (hX.trans h1) (hY.trans h2)
  have hbasis : (rkMatroid k C).IsBasis' (I ∪ J) (X ∪ Y) :=
    (isBasis_iff_indep_subset_closure.2
      ⟨hIJ, union_subset_union hI.subset hJ.subset, hXY⟩).isBasis'
  unfold erk
  rw [← hbasis.encard_eq_eRk, ← hI.encard_eq_eRk, ← hJ.encard_eq_eRk]
  exact encard_union_eq hdisjIJ

name: GroupConfig.ENat.eq_of_add_eq_add_of_le
statement:
private theorem ENat.eq_of_add_eq_add_of_le {x x' y y' : ℕ∞} (hx : x ≤ x') (hy : y ≤ y')
    (hx' : x' ≠ ⊤) (hy' : y' ≠ ⊤) (h : x + y = x' + y') : x = x' ∧ y = y'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · refine le_antisymm hx ?_
    have h1 : x' + y' ≤ x + y' := h ▸ add_le_add_right hy x
    exact (ENat.add_le_add_iff_right hy').1 h1
  · refine le_antisymm hy ?_
    have h1 : x' + y' ≤ x' + y := h ▸ add_le_add_left hx y
    exact (ENat.add_le_add_iff_left hx').1 h1

name: GroupConfig.erk_base_union_eq_of_erk_union_eq
statement:
theorem erk_base_union_eq_of_erk_union_eq {C X Y : Set K} (hX : X.Finite)
    (h : erk k C (X ∪ Y) = erk k C X + erk k C Y) :
    erk k (C ∪ X) Y = erk k C Y
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := erk_union_eq k C X Y
  rw [h] at h1
  exact le_antisymm (erk_base_mono k subset_union_left Y)
    ((ENat.add_le_add_iff_left (erk_ne_top k hX C)).1 h1.le)

name: GroupConfig.exists_finite_subset_erk_union_eq
statement:
theorem exists_finite_subset_erk_union_eq {X : Set K} (hX : X.Finite) (C B : Set K) :
    ∃ b ⊆ B, b.Finite ∧ erk k (C ∪ b) X = erk k (C ∪ B) X
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := (rkMatroid k (C ∪ B)).exists_isBasis' X
  have hXcl : X ⊆ racl k (C ∪ B ∪ J) := subset_racl_of_isBasis' k hJ
  
  choose T hTsub hTmem using fun x : X ↦ exists_finset_racl (hXcl x.2)
  have : Fintype X := hX.fintype
  let b : Set K := ⋃ x : X, ((T x : Set K) ∩ B)
  have hbB : b ⊆ B := iUnion_subset fun x ↦ inter_subset_right
  have hbfin : b.Finite := finite_iUnion fun x ↦ (T x).finite_toSet.subset inter_subset_left
  refine ⟨b, hbB, hbfin, le_antisymm ?_ (erk_base_mono k (union_subset_union_right C hbB) X)⟩
  
  have hXb : X ⊆ racl k (C ∪ b ∪ J) := by
    intro x hx
    have hT : (T ⟨x, hx⟩ : Set K) ⊆ C ∪ b ∪ J := by
      intro y hy
      rcases hTsub ⟨x, hx⟩ hy with (hyC | hyB) | hyJ
      · exact mem_union_left _ (mem_union_left _ hyC)
      · exact mem_union_left _ (mem_union_right _ (mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hy, hyB⟩))
      · exact mem_union_right _ hyJ
    exact racl_mono hT (hTmem ⟨x, hx⟩)
  calc erk k (C ∪ b) X ≤ erk k (C ∪ b) (racl k (C ∪ b ∪ J)) := erk_mono k _ hXb
    _ = erk k (C ∪ b) J := erk_racl k _ J
    _ ≤ J.encard := erk_le_encard k _ J
    _ = erk k (C ∪ B) X := by unfold erk; exact hJ.encard_eq_eRk

name: GroupConfig.IndepOver.erk_eq
statement:
theorem IndepOver.erk_eq {C A B : Set K} (h : IndepOver k C A B) {a : Set K}
    (ha : a ⊆ A) (hfin : a.Finite) : erk k (C ∪ B) a = erk k C a
proof:
:=
  h ha hfin

name: GroupConfig.IndepOver.mono_left
statement:
theorem IndepOver.mono_left {C A A' B : Set K} (h : IndepOver k C A B) (hA : A' ⊆ A) :
    IndepOver k C A' B
proof:
:=
  fun _ ha hfin ↦ h (ha.trans hA) hfin

name: GroupConfig.IndepOver.mono_right
statement:
theorem IndepOver.mono_right {C A B B' : Set K} (h : IndepOver k C A B) (hB : B' ⊆ B) :
    IndepOver k C A B'
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha hfin
  refine le_antisymm (erk_base_mono k subset_union_left a) ?_
  calc erk k C a = erk k (C ∪ B) a := (h ha hfin).symm
    _ ≤ erk k (C ∪ B') a := erk_base_mono k (union_subset_union_right C hB) a

name: GroupConfig.indepOver_iff_forall_finite
statement:
theorem indepOver_iff_forall_finite {C A B : Set K} :
    IndepOver k C A B ↔
      ∀ ⦃a : Set K⦄, a ⊆ A → a.Finite → ∀ ⦃b : Set K⦄, b ⊆ B → b.Finite →
        erk k (C ∪ b) a = erk k C a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha hfin b hb _
    exact (h.mono_right hb) ha hfin
  · intro h a ha hfin
    obtain ⟨b, hbB, hbfin, hb⟩ := exists_finite_subset_erk_union_eq k hfin C B
    rw [← hb]
    exact h ha hfin hbB hbfin

name: GroupConfig.IndepOver.of_racl_base
statement:
theorem IndepOver.of_racl_base {C A B : Set K} (h : IndepOver k C A B) :
    IndepOver k (racl k C) A B
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha hfin
  rw [erk_racl_base, erk_congr_base k (racl_union_left (k := k) C B) a]
  exact h ha hfin

name: GroupConfig.indepOver_racl_left_iff
statement:
theorem indepOver_racl_left_iff {C A B : Set K} :
    IndepOver k C (racl k (C ∪ A)) B ↔ IndepOver k C A B
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ h.mono_left (subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)), fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  intro a' ha' hfin'
  classical
  
  choose T hTsub hTmem using fun x : a' ↦ exists_finset_racl (ha' x.2)
  have : Fintype a' := hfin'.fintype
  let a : Set K := ⋃ x : a', ((T x : Set K) ∩ A)
  have haA : a ⊆ A := iUnion_subset fun x ↦ inter_subset_right
  have hafin : a.Finite := finite_iUnion fun x ↦ (T x).finite_toSet.subset inter_subset_left
  have ha'cl : a' ⊆ racl k (C ∪ a) := by
    intro x hx
    have hT : (T ⟨x, hx⟩ : Set K) ⊆ C ∪ a := by
      intro y hy
      rcases hTsub ⟨x, hx⟩ hy with hyC | hyA
      · exact mem_union_left _ hyC
      · exact mem_union_right _ (mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hy, hyA⟩)
    exact racl_mono hT (hTmem ⟨x, hx⟩)
  have hCB : a' ⊆ racl k (C ∪ B ∪ a) :=
    ha'cl.trans (racl_mono (union_subset_union_left a subset_union_left))
  
  have h1 : erk k C (a ∪ a') = erk k C a' + erk k (C ∪ a') a := by
    rw [union_comm a a']; exact erk_union_eq k C a' a
  have h2 : erk k (C ∪ B) (a ∪ a') = erk k (C ∪ B) a' + erk k (C ∪ B ∪ a') a := by
    rw [union_comm a a']; exact erk_union_eq k (C ∪ B) a' a
  have h3 : erk k C (a ∪ a') = erk k C a := erk_union_eq_of_subset_racl k ha'cl
  have h4 : erk k (C ∪ B) (a ∪ a') = erk k (C ∪ B) a := erk_union_eq_of_subset_racl k hCB
  have h5 : erk k (C ∪ B) a = erk k C a := h haA hafin
  have hle1 : erk k (C ∪ B) a' ≤ erk k C a' := erk_base_mono k subset_union_left a'
  have hle2 : erk k (C ∪ B ∪ a') a ≤ erk k (C ∪ a') a :=
    erk_base_mono k (union_subset_union_left a' subset_union_left) a
  have heq : erk k (C ∪ B) a' + erk k (C ∪ B ∪ a') a = erk k C a' + erk k (C ∪ a') a := by
    rw [← h2, ← h1, h3, h4, h5]
  exact (ENat.eq_of_add_eq_add_of_le hle1 hle2 (erk_ne_top k hfin' C)
    (erk_ne_top k hafin _) heq).1

name: GroupConfig.indepOver_congr_left
statement:
theorem indepOver_congr_left {C A A' B : Set K} (h : racl k (C ∪ A') = racl k (C ∪ A)) :
    IndepOver k C A B ↔ IndepOver k C A' B
proof:
:= by
  rw [← indepOver_racl_left_iff (A := A), ← indepOver_racl_left_iff (A := A'), h]

name: GroupConfig.indepOver_racl_right_iff
statement:
theorem indepOver_racl_right_iff {C A B : Set K} :
    IndepOver k C A (racl k (C ∪ B)) ↔ IndepOver k C A B
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : racl k (C ∪ (racl k (C ∪ B) : Set K)) = racl k (C ∪ B) := by
    rw [racl_union_right, ← union_assoc, union_self]
  constructor
  · intro h a ha hfin
    have h' := h ha hfin
    rwa [erk_congr_base k hbase a] at h'
  · intro h a ha hfin
    rw [erk_congr_base k hbase a]
    exact h ha hfin

name: GroupConfig.IndepOver.symm
statement: theorem IndepOver.symm {C A B : Set K} (h : IndepOver k C A B) : IndepOver k C B A
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb hbfin
  obtain ⟨a, haA, hafin, ha⟩ := exists_finite_subset_erk_union_eq k hbfin C A
  rw [← ha]
  have hab : erk k (C ∪ b) a = erk k C a := (h.mono_right hb) haA hafin
  have h1 : erk k C (a ∪ b) = erk k C a + erk k (C ∪ a) b := erk_union_eq k C a b
  have h2 : erk k C (a ∪ b) = erk k C b + erk k (C ∪ b) a := by
    rw [union_comm a b]; exact erk_union_eq k C b a
  have h3 : erk k C a + erk k (C ∪ a) b = erk k C a + erk k C b := by
    rw [← h1, h2, hab, add_comm]
  exact le_antisymm (erk_base_mono k subset_union_left b)
    ((ENat.add_le_add_iff_left (erk_ne_top k hafin C)).1 h3.symm.le)

name: GroupConfig.indepOver_comm
statement: theorem indepOver_comm {C A B : Set K} : IndepOver k C A B ↔ IndepOver k C B A
proof:
:=
  ⟨IndepOver.symm, IndepOver.symm⟩

name: GroupConfig.indepOver_union_right_iff
statement:
theorem indepOver_union_right_iff {C A B D : Set K} :
    IndepOver k C A (B ∪ D) ↔ IndepOver k C A B ∧ IndepOver k (C ∪ B) A D
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨h.mono_right subset_union_left, fun a ha hfin ↦ ?_⟩
    have h' := h ha hfin
    rw [← union_assoc] at h'
    refine le_antisymm (erk_base_mono k subset_union_left a) ?_
    calc erk k (C ∪ B) a ≤ erk k C a := erk_base_mono k subset_union_left a
      _ = erk k (C ∪ B ∪ D) a := h'.symm
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩ a ha hfin
    rw [← union_assoc, h2 ha hfin, h1 ha hfin]

name: GroupConfig.IndepOver.racl_inter_subset
statement:
theorem IndepOver.racl_inter_subset {C B D : Set K} (h : IndepOver k C B D) :
    (racl k (C ∪ B) : Set K) ∩ racl k (C ∪ D) ⊆ racl k C
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨hxB, hxD⟩
  have hx : IndepOver k C {x} D :=
    (indepOver_racl_left_iff.2 h).mono_left (singleton_subset_iff.2 hxB)
  have h0 : erk k (C ∪ D) {x} = 0 := (erk_singleton_eq_zero_iff k).2 hxD
  have hx' := hx (subset_refl _) (finite_singleton x)
  rw [h0] at hx'
  exact (erk_singleton_eq_zero_iff k).1 hx'.symm

name: GroupConfig.IndepOver.racl_inter_eq
statement:
theorem IndepOver.racl_inter_eq {C B D : Set K} (h : IndepOver k C B D) :
    (racl k (C ∪ B) : Set K) ∩ racl k (C ∪ D) = racl k C
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm h.racl_inter_subset (subset_inter
    (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 (racl_mono subset_union_left))
    (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 (racl_mono subset_union_left)))

name: GroupConfig.IndepOver.subset_racl_of_self
statement:
theorem IndepOver.subset_racl_of_self {C B : Set K} (h : IndepOver k C B B) :
    B ⊆ racl k C
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb
  have h0 : erk k (C ∪ B) {b} = 0 :=
    (erk_singleton_eq_zero_iff k).2 (subset_racl k _ (mem_union_right _ hb))
  have hb' := h (singleton_subset_iff.2 hb) (finite_singleton b)
  rw [h0] at hb'
  exact (erk_singleton_eq_zero_iff k).1 hb'.symm

name: GroupConfig.IndepOver.union_left
statement:
theorem IndepOver.union_left {C A B D : Set K} (h1 : IndepOver k C B D)
    (h2 : IndepOver k C A (B ∪ D)) : IndepOver k C (A ∪ B) D
proof:
:= by
  intro c hc hfin
  have hsplit : c = (c ∩ B) ∪ (c ∩ A) := by
    rw [← inter_union_distrib_left, union_comm, inter_eq_left.2 hc]
  have haA : c ∩ A ⊆ A := inter_subset_right
  have hbB : c ∩ B ⊆ B := inter_subset_right
  have hafin : (c ∩ A).Finite := hfin.subset inter_subset_left
  have hbfin : (c ∩ B).Finite := hfin.subset inter_subset_left
  have h2' : IndepOver k (C ∪ (c ∩ B)) A D :=
    (indepOver_union_right_iff.1 (h2.mono_right (union_subset_union_left D hbB))).2
  have key : erk k (C ∪ D) ((c ∩ B) ∪ (c ∩ A)) = erk k C ((c ∩ B) ∪ (c ∩ A)) := by
    rw [erk_union_eq k (C ∪ D), erk_union_eq k C, h1 hbB hbfin, union_right_comm,
      h2' haA hafin]
  rwa [← hsplit] at key

name: GroupConfig.IndepOver.union_right
statement:
theorem IndepOver.union_right {C A B D : Set K} (h1 : IndepOver k C A B)
    (h2 : IndepOver k C (A ∪ B) D) : IndepOver k C A (B ∪ D)
proof:
:= by
  rw [indepOver_union_right_iff]
  refine ⟨h1, fun a ha hfin ↦ ?_⟩
  
  obtain ⟨b, hbB, hbfin, hb⟩ := exists_finite_subset_erk_union_eq k hfin (C ∪ D) B
  have hb' : erk k (C ∪ B ∪ D) a = erk k (C ∪ D ∪ b) a := by
    rw [union_right_comm, ← hb]
  have hb'' : erk k (C ∪ B) a = erk k (C ∪ b) a := by
    rw [h1 ha hfin, (h1.mono_right hbB) ha hfin]
  rw [hb', hb'']
  
  have hab : erk k (C ∪ D) (b ∪ a) = erk k C (b ∪ a) :=
    h2 (union_subset (hbB.trans subset_union_right) (ha.trans subset_union_left))
      (hbfin.union hfin)
  have hbD : erk k (C ∪ D) b = erk k C b := h2 (hbB.trans subset_union_right) hbfin
  have t1 := erk_union_eq k (C ∪ D) b a
  have t2 := erk_union_eq k C b a
  rw [hab, hbD, t2] at t1
  exact le_antisymm (erk_base_mono k (union_subset_union_left b subset_union_left) a)
    ((ENat.add_le_add_iff_left (erk_ne_top k hbfin C)).1 t1.le)

name: GroupConfig.indepOver_base_union_iff
proof:
:= by
  have hE' : IndepOver k C E (A ∪ B) := by
    have h := (indepOver_union_right_iff.1 hE).2
    rwa [empty_union] at h
  have hAB : IndepOver k C (A ∪ B) E := hE'.symm
  have hAe : IndepOver k C A E := hAB.mono_left subset_union_left
  have hAbe : IndepOver k (C ∪ B) A E := by
    have h' : IndepOver k C E (B ∪ A) := by rwa [union_comm] at hE'
    exact (indepOver_union_right_iff.1 h').2.symm
  constructor
  · intro h a ha hfin
    have e1 : erk k (C ∪ E ∪ B) a = erk k (C ∪ B) a := by
      rw [union_right_comm]; exact hAbe ha hfin
    have e2 : erk k (C ∪ E) a = erk k C a := hAe ha hfin
    rw [e1, e2]; exact h ha hfin
  · intro h a ha hfin
    have e1 : erk k (C ∪ E ∪ B) a = erk k (C ∪ B) a := by
      rw [union_right_comm]; exact hAbe ha hfin
    have e2 : erk k (C ∪ E) a = erk k C a := hAe ha hfin
    rw [← e1, ← e2]; exact h ha hfin

name: GroupConfig.subset_racl_base_union_iff
statement:
theorem subset_racl_base_union_iff {C A E : Set K} (hE : IndepOver k ∅ E (C ∪ A)) :
    A ⊆ racl k C ↔ A ⊆ racl k (C ∪ E)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ h.trans (racl_mono subset_union_left), fun h x hx ↦ ?_⟩
  have hAE : IndepOver k C A E := by
    have h' := (indepOver_union_right_iff.1 hE).2
    rw [empty_union] at h'
    exact h'.symm
  have hx' := hAE (singleton_subset_iff.2 hx) (finite_singleton x)
  rw [(erk_singleton_eq_zero_iff k).2 (h hx)] at hx'
  exact (erk_singleton_eq_zero_iff k).1 hx'.symm

name: GroupConfig.rkMatroid_empty
statement: theorem rkMatroid_empty : rkMatroid k (∅ : Set K) = AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K
proof:
:= by
  refine Matroid.ext_closure fun X ↦ ?_
  rw [rkMatroid_closure_eq, algebraicMatroid_closure_eq_racl, empty_union]

name: GroupConfig.rkMatroid_coe
statement:
theorem rkMatroid_coe (M : IntermediateField k K) :
    rkMatroid k (M : Set K) = AlgebraicIndependent.matroid (↥M) K
proof:
:= by
  refine Matroid.ext_closure fun X ↦ ?_
  rw [rkMatroid_closure_eq, algebraicMatroid_closure_eq_racl (k := ↥M)]
  ext x
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe]
  rw [mem_racl_iff, mem_racl_iff]
  have key : adjoin k ((M : Set K) ∪ X) = (adjoin (↥M) X).restrictScalars k :=
    (restrictScalars_adjoin k M X).symm
  rw [key]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ h, fun h ↦ h⟩

name: GroupConfig.erk_empty_eq
statement:
theorem erk_empty_eq (X : Set K) :
    erk k ∅ X = (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).eRk X
proof:
:= by
  unfold erk
  rw [rkMatroid_empty]

name: GroupConfig.erk_coe_eq
statement:
theorem erk_coe_eq (M : IntermediateField k K) (X : Set K) :
    erk k (M : Set K) X = (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid (↥M) K).eRk X
proof:
:= by
  unfold erk
  rw [rkMatroid_coe]

name: AlgebraicIndependent.matroid_eRk_eq_toENat_trdeg
statement:
theorem _root_.AlgebraicIndependent.matroid_eRk_eq_toENat_trdeg (R : Type*) [Field R]
    [Algebra R K] (S : Set K) :
    (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid R K).eRk S =
      Cardinal.toENat (Algebra.trdeg R ↥(adjoin R S))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ := (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid R K).exists_isBasis' S
  rw [← hI.encard_eq_eRk, ← toENat_cardinalMk]
  congr 1
  set L := adjoin R S with hL
  have hIL : I ⊆ (L : Set K) := hI.subset.trans (subset_adjoin R S)
  let x : I → L := fun i ↦ ⟨(i : K), hIL i.2⟩
  have hx : IsTranscendenceBasis R x := by
    rw [isTranscendenceBasis_iff_algebraicIndependent_isAlgebraic]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have h1 : AlgebraicIndependent R ((↑) : I → K) :=
        AlgebraicIndependent.matroid_indep_iff.1 hI.indep
      exact AlgebraicIndependent.of_comp L.val h1
    · 
      have hScl : S ⊆ racl R I := by
        have h := hI.closure_eq_closure
        rw [algebraicMatroid_closure_eq_racl, algebraicMatroid_closure_eq_racl] at h
        rw [h]
        exact subset_racl R S
      have hLcl : (L : Set K) ⊆ racl R I := by
        rw [SetLike.coe_subset_coe]
        exact adjoin_le_iff.2 hScl
      refine ⟨fun y ↦ ?_⟩
      have hy : IsAlgebraic (Algebra.adjoin R (I : Set K)) (y : K) :=
        (mem_racl_iff_isAlgebraic_adjoin R).1 (hLcl y.2)
      have himg : (Algebra.adjoin R (Set.range x)).map L.val =
          Algebra.adjoin R (I : Set K) := by
        rw [AlgHom.map_adjoin]
        congr 1
        ext z
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
          exact i.2
        · intro hz
          exact ⟨x ⟨z, hz⟩, ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      let e : Algebra.adjoin R (Set.range x) ≃ₐ[R] Algebra.adjoin R (I : Set K) :=
        (Subalgebra.equivMapOfInjective _ L.val Subtype.val_injective).trans
          (Subalgebra.equivOfEq _ _ himg)
      refine IsAlgebraic.of_ringHom_of_comp_eq e L.val hy e.surjective Subtype.val_injective ?_
      ext a
      rfl
  exact hx.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg

name: GroupConfig.erk_coe_eq_toENat_trdeg
statement:
theorem erk_coe_eq_toENat_trdeg (M : IntermediateField k K) (X : Set K) :
    erk k (M : Set K) X = Cardinal.toENat (Algebra.trdeg (↥M) ↥(adjoin (↥M) X))
proof:
:= by
  rw [erk_coe_eq, AlgebraicIndependent.matroid_eRk_eq_toENat_trdeg]

name: GroupConfig.erk_empty_eq_toENat_trdeg
statement:
theorem erk_empty_eq_toENat_trdeg (X : Set K) :
    erk k ∅ X = Cardinal.toENat (Algebra.trdeg k ↥(adjoin k X))
proof:
:= by
  rw [erk_empty_eq, AlgebraicIndependent.matroid_eRk_eq_toENat_trdeg]

name: GroupConfig.rkMatroid_coe_union
statement:
theorem rkMatroid_coe_union (M : IntermediateField k K) (B : Set K) :
    rkMatroid k ((M : Set K) ∪ B) = rkMatroid (↥M) B
proof:
:= by
  refine Matroid.ext_closure fun X ↦ ?_
  rw [rkMatroid_closure_eq, rkMatroid_closure_eq]
  ext x
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe]
  rw [mem_racl_iff, mem_racl_iff]
  have key : adjoin k ((M : Set K) ∪ B ∪ X) = (adjoin (↥M) (B ∪ X)).restrictScalars k := by
    rw [restrictScalars_adjoin k M (B ∪ X), union_assoc]
  rw [key]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ h, fun h ↦ h⟩

name: GroupConfig.erk_coe_union
statement:
theorem erk_coe_union (M : IntermediateField k K) (B X : Set K) :
    erk k ((M : Set K) ∪ B) X = erk (↥M) B X
proof:
:= by
  unfold erk
  rw [rkMatroid_coe_union]

name: GroupConfig.indepOver_coe_union_iff
statement:
theorem indepOver_coe_union_iff (M : IntermediateField k K) (B A D : Set K) :
    IndepOver k ((M : Set K) ∪ B) A D ↔ IndepOver (↥M) B A D
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha hfin
    have h' := h ha hfin
    rwa [union_assoc, erk_coe_union, erk_coe_union] at h'
  · intro h a ha hfin
    rw [union_assoc, erk_coe_union, erk_coe_union]
    exact h ha hfin

name: GroupConfig.indepOver_of_erk_eq
statement:
theorem indepOver_of_erk_eq {C B X : Set K} (hX : X.Finite)
    (h : erk k (C ∪ B) X = erk k C X) : IndepOver k C X B
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha hfin
  have hsplit : X = a ∪ (X \ a) := (union_sdiff_cancel ha).symm
  have t1 := erk_union_eq k (C ∪ B) a (X \ a)
  have t2 := erk_union_eq k C a (X \ a)
  rw [← hsplit] at t1 t2
  have hle1 : erk k (C ∪ B) a ≤ erk k C a := erk_base_mono k subset_union_left a
  have hle2 : erk k (C ∪ B ∪ a) (X \ a) ≤ erk k (C ∪ a) (X \ a) :=
    erk_base_mono k (union_subset_union_left a subset_union_left) (X \ a)
  exact (ENat.eq_of_add_eq_add_of_le hle1 hle2 (erk_ne_top k hfin C)
    (erk_ne_top k (hX.subset sdiff_subset) _) (by rw [← t1, ← t2, h])).1

name: GroupConfig.coefficientExtension_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coefficientExtension_tmul (r : R) (u : coefficientFieldPart W F) :
    coefficientExtension W F (r ⊗ₜ[F] u) = r • coeVec F (u : 𝓜 → F)
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  simp only [coefficientExtension, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul,
    TensorProduct.piScalarRightHom_tmul, Pi.smul_apply, coeVec_apply]
  change (u.1 j : R) * r = r * (u.1 j : R)
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: GroupConfig.coefficientExtension_injective
statement:
theorem coefficientExtension_injective [Finite 𝓜] :
    Function.Injective (coefficientExtension W F)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ := Fintype.ofFinite 𝓜
  exact (TensorProduct.piScalarRight F R R 𝓜).injective.comp
    (Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap
      (coefficientFieldPart W F).subtype (Submodule.injective_subtype _))

name: GroupConfig.coefficientExtension_range
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
    induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul r u =>
      rw [coefficientExtension_tmul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r (Submodule.subset_span ⟨u.2, fun j ↦ (u.1 j).2⟩)
    | add z z' hz hz' => simpa only [map_add] using (Submodule.span R _).add_mem hz hz'
  · refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro v ⟨hv, hvF⟩
    let u : 𝓜 → F := fun j ↦ ⟨v j, hvF j⟩
    have hu : u ∈ coefficientFieldPart W F := hv
    refine ⟨1 ⊗ₜ[F] (⟨u, hu⟩ : coefficientFieldPart W F), ?_⟩
    rw [coefficientExtension_tmul, one_smul]
    rfl

name: GroupConfig.definedOver_iff_coefficientExtension_range
statement:
theorem definedOver_iff_coefficientExtension_range :
    DefinedOver W F ↔ LinearMap.range (coefficientExtension W F) = W
proof:
:= by
  rw [coefficientExtension_range]
  exact eq_comm

name: GroupConfig.DefinedOver.exists_coefficientExtensionEquiv
statement:
theorem DefinedOver.exists_coefficientExtensionEquiv [Finite 𝓜] (h : DefinedOver W F) :
    ∃ e : R ⊗[F] ↥(coefficientFieldPart W F) ≃ₗ[R] W,
      ∀ (r : R) (u : coefficientFieldPart W F),
        (e (r ⊗ₜ[F] u) : 𝓜 → R) = r • coeVec F (u : 𝓜 → F)
proof:
:= by
  have hrange := (definedOver_iff_coefficientExtension_range W F).1 h
  let f := (coefficientExtension W F).codRestrict W fun z ↦ hrange.le ⟨z, rfl⟩
  have hbij : Function.Bijective f := by
    constructor
    · intro z z' heq
      exact coefficientExtension_injective W F (congrArg Subtype.val heq)
    · intro w
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : (w : 𝓜 → R) ∈ LinearMap.range (coefficientExtension W F) := by
        rw [hrange]
        exact w.2
      exact ⟨z, Subtype.ext hz⟩
  exact ⟨LinearEquiv.ofBijective f hbij, fun r u ↦ coefficientExtension_tmul W F r u⟩

statement:
theorem exists_germ (hy : ∀ i, y i ∈ dclAdjoin (adjoin k (range b)) z) :
    ∃ g : Germ k y z, IsInvertible g ∧ g.evalGen y = z ∧
      racl k (g.cb : Set K) = racl k (range b)
proof:

    (hc.isTriple hz).germ_evalGen, (hc.isTriple hz).racl_cb_eq_iff.2 ?_⟩

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.trans_of_config
statement:
theorem trans_of_config (hgz : g.evalGen y = z) :
    ∀ f ∈ orbit g, ∀ y' : ι₅ → K, IsGen k y y' → IndepOver k ∅ (range y') (f.cb : Set K) →
      IndepOver k ∅ (range (f.evalGen y')) (range y')
proof:
:= by
  rintro f ⟨τ, rfl⟩ y' hy' hind
  have hygen : IsGen k y y := rfl
  have hycb : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (g.cb : Set K) := by
    rw [cb_eq_adjoin_of_range_eq hb]
    exact indepOver_of_subset_racl (subset_racl k _) (adjoin_le_racl k _) hc.indepOver_by.symm
  refine indepOver_evalGen_range_of_conj hy' (hygen.map τ) hind ?_ ?_
  · rw [cb_map, coe_map, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom]
    have := hycb.image τ
    rwa [image_empty, ← range_comp] at this
  · rw [evalGen_map τ g hygen hycb, hgz]
    have := hc.indepOver_yz.symm.image τ
    rwa [image_empty, ← range_comp, ← range_comp] at this

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.exists_conj_diff_fresh
statement:
theorem exists_conj_diff_fresh (hg : IsInvertible g) (hgz : g.evalGen y = z) {W : Set K}
    (hW : W.Finite) :
    ∃ (b' : ι₂ → K) (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (δ : Germ k y y),
      IndepOver k ∅ (range b')
        (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z ∪ W) ∧
      ⇑σ ∘ b = b' ∧ ⇑σ ∘ c = c ∧ ⇑σ ∘ x = x ∧ ⇑σ ∘ z = z ∧
      GroupConfiguration k (⇑σ ∘ a) b' c x (⇑σ ∘ y) z ∧
      δ ∈ diffSet g ∧ δ.evalGen y = ⇑σ ∘ y ∧
      δ.cb ≤ racl k (range b ∪ range b') ∧
      range b ⊆ racl k (range b' ∪ δ.cb) ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ (δ.cb : Set K) (range b') ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ (δ.cb : Set K) (g.cb : Set K) ∧
      erk k ∅ (δ.cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (g.cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g', hg'⟩ := hg
  have hgcb : g.cb = adjoin k (range b) := cb_eq_adjoin_of_range_eq hb
  have hracl : racl k (g.cb : Set K) = racl k (range b) := by rw [hgcb, racl_adjoin_coe]
  have hygen : IsGen k y y := rfl
  have hall : (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z).Finite :=
    (((((finite_range a).union (finite_range b)).union (finite_range c)).union
      (finite_range x)).union (finite_range y)).union (finite_range z)
  have hsub := fun i ↦ gcPoints_subset (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) (x := x) (y := y) (z := z) i
  have hycb : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (g.cb : Set K) := by
    rw [hgcb]
    exact indepOver_of_subset_racl (subset_racl k _) (adjoin_le_racl k _) hc.indepOver_by.symm
                                                                                     
                                    
  obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := exists_isGenericOver (IsSmall.of_finite (k := k) (hall.union hW)).racl b
  have hb'indW : IndepOver k ∅ (range b')
      (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z ∪ W) :=
    hb'.indepOver.mono_right (subset_racl k _)
  have hb'ind : IndepOver k ∅ (range b')
      (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z) :=
    hb'indW.mono_right subset_union_left
  have hczx : (range c ∪ range z ∪ range x).Finite :=
    ((finite_range c).union (finite_range z)).union (finite_range x)
  have hczx_sub : range c ∪ range z ∪ range x ⊆
      range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z :=
    union_subset (union_subset (hsub 2) (hsub 5)) (hsub 3)
  have hbN : IsGenericOver (racl k (range c ∪ range z ∪ range x)) b b := by
    refine isGenericOver_self_of_indepOver (IsSmall.of_finite (k := k) hczx).racl ?_
    have := indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hc.indepOver_b_czx
    rwa [empty_union] at this
  have hb'N : IsGenericOver (racl k (range c ∪ range z ∪ range x)) b b' :=
    hb'.of_le (racl_mono (k := k) (hczx_sub.trans subset_union_left))
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := hbN.exists_algEquiv hb'N
  obtain ⟨σ', hσ'⟩ : ∃ τ : K ≃ₐ[k] K, τ = σ.restrictScalars k := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hfix : ∀ s ∈ range c ∪ range z ∪ range x, σ' s = s := fun s hs ↦ by
    rw [hσ']
    change σ s = s
    exact σ.commutes ⟨s, subset_racl k _ hs⟩
  have hσb : ⇑σ' ∘ b = b' := by
    rw [hσ']
    exact funext fun i ↦ hσ i
  have hσc : ⇑σ' ∘ c = c := funext fun i ↦
    hfix _ (subset_union_left (subset_union_left (mem_range_self i)))
  have hσz : ⇑σ' ∘ z = z := funext fun i ↦
    hfix _ (subset_union_left (subset_union_right (mem_range_self i)))
  have hσx : ⇑σ' ∘ x = x := funext fun i ↦ hfix _ (subset_union_right (mem_range_self i))
  obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ : ∃ y' : ι₅ → K, y' = ⇑σ' ∘ y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ : ∃ a' : ι₁ → K, a' = ⇑σ' ∘ a := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hc' := hc.map σ'
  rw [hσb, hσc, hσz, hσx, ← hy', ← ha'] at hc'
                                                                     
  have hy'gen : IsGen k y y' := by
    rw [hy']
    exact hygen.map σ'
  have hσgz : (g.map σ').evalGen y' = z := by
    rw [hy', evalGen_map σ' g hygen hycb, hgz, hσz]
  have hcbσ : (g.map σ').cb = adjoin k (range b') := by
    rw [cb_map, hgcb, adjoin_map, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, ← hσb, range_comp]
  have hraclσ : racl k ((g.map σ').cb : Set K) = racl k (range b') := by
    rw [hcbσ, racl_adjoin_coe]
  have hb'b : IndepOver k ∅ (range b') (range b) := hb'ind.mono_right (hsub 1)
  have hind_cb : IndepOver k ∅ ((g.map σ').cb : Set K) (g.cb : Set K) :=
    (indepOver_congr₀ hraclσ hracl).2 hb'b
                                               
  have hδmem : Germ.comp (g'.map σ') g ∈ diffSet g :=
    ⟨g.map σ', map_mem_orbit (self_mem_orbit g) σ', g, self_mem_orbit g, g'.map σ', hg'.map σ',
      hind_cb, rfl⟩
  have hyb : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (range b ∪ range b') := by
    refine indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨hc.indepOver_by.symm, ?_⟩
    rw [empty_union]
    have h1 : IndepOver k ∅ (range b') (range y ∪ range b) :=
      hb'ind.mono_right (union_subset (hsub 4) (hsub 1))
    have h2 := IndepOver.of_union_right h1
    rw [empty_union] at h2
    exact h2.symm
  have hind₁ : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (((g'.map σ').cb : Set K) ∪ g.cb) := by
    refine indepOver_of_subset_racl (subset_racl k _) (union_subset ?_ ?_) hyb
    · refine (hg'.map σ').cb_le.trans ?_
      rw [hraclσ]
      exact racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_right
    · refine (subset_racl k _).trans ?_
      rw [hracl]
      exact racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_left
  have hy'b' : IndepOver k ∅ (range y') (range b') := hc'.indepOver_by.symm
  have hind₂ : IndepOver k ∅ (range y') ((g.map σ').cb : Set K) := by
    rw [hcbσ]
    exact indepOver_of_subset_racl (subset_racl k _) (adjoin_le_racl k _) hy'b'
  have hδy : (Germ.comp (g'.map σ') g).evalGen y = y' :=
    calc (Germ.comp (g'.map σ') g).evalGen y = (g'.map σ').evalGen (g.evalGen y) :=
          evalGen_comp _ _ hygen hind₁
      _ = (g'.map σ').evalGen ((g.map σ').evalGen y') := by rw [hgz, hσgz]
      _ = y' := (hg'.map σ').evalGen_evalGen hy'gen hind₂
                             
  have hy'bb' : IndepOver k ∅ (range y') (range b ∪ range b') := by
    have h1 : IndepOver k ∅ (range b') (range b ∪ range z) :=
      hb'ind.mono_right (union_subset (hsub 1) (hsub 5))
    have h2 := IndepOver.of_union_right h1
    rw [empty_union] at h2
    have h3 : IndepOver k ∅ (range b) (range z ∪ range b') :=
      indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨hc.indepOver_bz, by rw [empty_union]; exact h2.symm⟩
    rw [union_comm] at h3
    have h4 := (indepOver_union_right_iff.1 h3).2
    rw [empty_union] at h4
    have h5 : IndepOver k (range b') (range y') (range b) :=
      (indepOver_congr_left hc'.racl_by_bz).1 h4.symm
    have h6 : IndepOver k ∅ (range y') (range b' ∪ range b) :=
      indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨hy'b', by rw [empty_union]; exact h5⟩
    rwa [union_comm] at h6
                                                                     
  have hδcb_le' : (Germ.comp (g'.map σ') g).cb ≤ racl k (range b ∪ range b') := by
    refine (cb_comp_le_racl _ _).trans (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset ?_ ?_))
    · refine (subset_racl k _).trans ?_
      rw [hracl]
      exact racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_left
    · refine (hg'.map σ').cb_le.trans ?_
      rw [hraclσ]
      exact racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_right
  have hδcb_le : (Germ.comp (g'.map σ') g).cb ≤ racl k (range (Sum.elim b b')) := by
    rw [Sum.elim_range]
    exact hδcb_le'
  have hδfix : ∀ τ : K ≃ₐ[↥(adjoin k (range (Sum.elim b b')))] K,
      (Germ.comp (g'.map σ') g).map (τ.restrictScalars k) = Germ.comp (g'.map σ') g := by
    intro τ
    have hfixτ : ∀ s ∈ range b ∪ range b', (τ.restrictScalars k) s = s := fun s hs ↦ by
      change τ s = s
      exact τ.commutes ⟨s, subset_adjoin k _ (by rwa [Sum.elim_range])⟩
    have hg_fix : g.map (τ.restrictScalars k) = g := by
      refine map_eq_self_of_fixes_codeSet _ fun w hw ↦ hfixτ w (Or.inl ?_)
      rw [hb]
      exact hw
    have hgσ_fix : (g.map σ').map (τ.restrictScalars k) = g.map σ' := by
      refine (Germ.map_eq_self_iff _ _).2 fun w hw ↦ ?_
      rw [hcbσ] at hw
      have hle : adjoin k (range b') ≤ GroupConfig.fixedBy (τ.restrictScalars k) :=
        IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff.2 fun s hs ↦
          GroupConfig.mem_fixedBy.2 (hfixτ s (Or.inr hs))
      exact GroupConfig.mem_fixedBy.1 (hle hw)
    have hg'σ_fix : (g'.map σ').map (τ.restrictScalars k) = g'.map σ' := by
      have h1 := (hg'.map σ').map (τ.restrictScalars k)
      rw [hgσ_fix] at h1
      exact h1.unique (hg'.map σ')
    rw [Germ.comp_map, hg'σ_fix, hg_fix]
  have hδcb_dcl : (Germ.comp (g'.map σ') g).cb ≤ dcl (adjoin k (range (Sum.elim b b'))) :=
    cb_le_dcl_of_forall_map_eq _ hδfix
  have hind_δy : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) ((Germ.comp (g'.map σ') g).cb : Set K) :=
    indepOver_of_subset_racl (subset_racl k _) hδcb_le' hyb
  have hmem_dcl : ∀ j, y' j ∈ dclAdjoin (adjoin k (range (Sum.elim b b'))) y := fun j ↦ by
    rw [← hδy]
    exact evalGen_mem_dclAdjoin_of_cb_le_dcl _ hδcb_dcl hygen hind_δy j
  have htrip : IsTriple k y y (Sum.elim b b') y y' :=
    { isGen_left := hygen
      isGen_right := hy'gen
      indep_left := by
        rw [Sum.elim_range]
        exact hyb
      indep_right := by
        rw [Sum.elim_range]
        exact hy'bb'
      mem_dcl := hmem_dcl }
  have hδeq : Germ.comp (g'.map σ') g = htrip.germ := htrip.eq_germ hδcb_le hδy
  have hδcb : (Germ.comp (g'.map σ') g).cb =
      canonicalBase (racl k (range (Sum.elim b b'))) (Sum.elim y y') := by
    rw [hδeq, htrip.germ_cb]
                                                                   
  have hy4 : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (range a ∪ range a' ∪ (range b ∪ range b')) := by
    have h1 : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c) := hc.indepOver_y_abc
    have h2 : IndepOver k ∅ (range b') (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range y) :=
      hb'ind.mono_right (union_subset (union_subset (union_subset (hsub 0) (hsub 1)) (hsub 2))
        (hsub 4))
    have h3 := (indepOver_union_right_iff.1 h2).2
    rw [empty_union] at h3
    have h4 : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range b') :=
      indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨h1, by rw [empty_union]; exact h3.symm⟩
    have ha'sub : range a' ⊆ racl k (range b' ∪ range c) := by
      rw [← hc'.racl_ab_bc]
      exact subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
    have hsub4 : range a ∪ range a' ∪ (range b ∪ range b') ⊆
        racl k (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range b') := by
      rintro w ((hw | hw) | (hw | hw))
      · exact subset_racl k _ (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl hw)))
      · exact SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 (racl_mono (k := k)
          (union_subset (fun v hv ↦ Or.inr hv) (fun v hv ↦ Or.inl (Or.inr hv)))) (ha'sub hw)
      · exact subset_racl k _ (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr hw)))
      · exact subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hw)
    exact indepOver_of_subset_racl (subset_racl k _) hsub4 h4
  have hy'_sub_a : range y' ⊆ racl k (range a ∪ range a' ∪ range y) := by
    have h1 : range y' ⊆ racl k (range a' ∪ range x) := by
      rw [hc'.racl_ax_ay]
      exact subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
    have h2 : range x ⊆ racl k (range a ∪ range y) := by
      rw [← hc.racl_ax_ay]
      exact subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
    refine h1.trans (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset ?_ (h2.trans (racl_mono (k := k) ?_))))
    · exact fun w hw ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl (Or.inr hw))
    · exact union_subset (fun w hw ↦ Or.inl (Or.inl hw)) (fun w hw ↦ Or.inr hw)
  have hy'_sub_b : range y' ⊆ racl k (range b ∪ range b' ∪ range y) := by
    have h1 : range y' ⊆ racl k (range b' ∪ range z) := by
      rw [← hc'.racl_by_bz]
      exact subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
    have h2 : range z ⊆ racl k (range b ∪ range y) := by
      rw [hc.racl_by_bz]
      exact subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
    refine h1.trans (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset ?_ (h2.trans (racl_mono (k := k) ?_))))
    · exact fun w hw ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl (Or.inr hw))
    · exact union_subset (fun w hw ↦ Or.inl (Or.inl hw)) (fun w hw ↦ Or.inr hw)
  have hL : IsSmall k ((racl k (range (Sum.elim b b')) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range _)).racl
  have hL' : IsSmall k ((racl k (range (Sum.elim a a')) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range _)).racl
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (range (Sum.elim b b'))) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (range (Sum.elim a a'))) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hyy'_b : racl k (range b ∪ range b' ∪ (range y ∪ range y')) =
      racl k (range b ∪ range b' ∪ range y) :=
    racl_union_eq_of_subset_racl_of_subset (union_subset (fun w hw ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hw))
      hy'_sub_b) subset_union_left
  have hyy'_a : racl k (range a ∪ range a' ∪ (range y ∪ range y')) =
      racl k (range a ∪ range a' ∪ range y) :=
    racl_union_eq_of_subset_racl_of_subset (union_subset (fun w hw ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hw))
      hy'_sub_a) subset_union_left
  have h1 : IndepOver k (racl k (range (Sum.elim b b')) : Set K) (range (Sum.elim y y'))
      (racl k (range (Sum.elim a a')) : Set K) := by
    rw [indepOver_racl_base_iff, Sum.elim_range, Sum.elim_range, Sum.elim_range]
    refine (indepOver_congr hyy'_b (racl_union_right _ _)).2 ?_
    have h := (indepOver_union_right_iff.1 (by rwa [union_comm] at hy4 :
      IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (range b ∪ range b' ∪ (range a ∪ range a')))).2
    rwa [empty_union] at h
  have h2 : IndepOver k (racl k (range (Sum.elim a a')) : Set K) (range (Sum.elim y y'))
      (racl k (range (Sum.elim b b')) : Set K) := by
    rw [indepOver_racl_base_iff, Sum.elim_range, Sum.elim_range, Sum.elim_range]
    refine (indepOver_congr hyy'_a (racl_union_right _ _)).2 ?_
    have h := (indepOver_union_right_iff.1 hy4).2
    rwa [empty_union] at h
  have hcb2 := (canonicalBase_eq_of_indepOver_of_indepOver hL hL' h1 h2).1
  rw [hcb2] at hδcb
                            
  have hb_aa' : IndepOver k ∅ (range b) (range a ∪ range a') := by
    have h1 : IndepOver k ∅ (range b') (range b ∪ range c) :=
      hb'ind.mono_right (union_subset (hsub 1) (hsub 2))
    have h2 := IndepOver.of_union_right h1
    rw [empty_union] at h2
    have ha_sub : range a ⊆ racl k (range c ∪ range b) := by
      rw [union_comm, ← hc.racl_ab_bc]
      exact subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
    have ha'_sub : range a' ⊆ racl k (range c ∪ range b') := by
      rw [union_comm, ← hc'.racl_ab_bc]
      exact subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
    have hA : racl k (range c ∪ range b) = racl k (range c ∪ (range a ∪ range b)) :=
      (racl_union_eq_of_subset_racl_of_subset (union_subset ha_sub
        (fun w hw ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hw))) subset_union_right).symm
    have hB : racl k (range c ∪ range b') = racl k (range c ∪ (range a' ∪ range b')) :=
      (racl_union_eq_of_subset_racl_of_subset (union_subset ha'_sub
        (fun w hw ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hw))) subset_union_right).symm
    have h3 : IndepOver k (range c) (range a ∪ range b) (range a' ∪ range b') :=
      (indepOver_congr hA hB).1 h2.symm
    have h4 : IndepOver k (range c) (range a') (range a ∪ range b) :=
      h3.symm.mono_left subset_union_left
    have h5 : IndepOver k ∅ (range a') (range c ∪ (range a ∪ range b)) :=
      indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨hc'.indepOver_ac, by rw [empty_union]; exact h4⟩
    have h6 : IndepOver k ∅ (range a') (range a ∪ range b) := h5.mono_right subset_union_right
    have h7 := (indepOver_union_right_iff.1 h6).2
    rw [empty_union] at h7
    exact indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨hc.indepOver_ab.symm, by rw [empty_union]; exact h7.symm⟩
                                                                             
  have hδ_g : IndepOver k ∅ ((Germ.comp (g'.map σ') g).cb : Set K) (g.cb : Set K) := by
    rw [hδcb]
    refine indepOver_of_subset_racl ?_ ?_ hb_aa'.symm
    · refine (canonicalBase_le _ _).trans ?_
      rw [Sum.elim_range]
    · exact (subset_racl k _).trans hracl.le
  have hrk := (indepOver_diff_right_iff (hg'.map σ') hind_cb ⟨g', hg'⟩).1 hδ_g
  rw [erk_cb_eq_of_mem_orbit (map_mem_orbit (self_mem_orbit g) σ')] at hrk
  have hδb' : IndepOver k ∅ ((Germ.comp (g'.map σ') g).cb : Set K) (range b') := by
    have h1 := (indepOver_diff_left_iff (hg'.map σ') hind_cb).2 hrk
    rw [hcbσ] at h1
    exact h1.mono_right (subset_adjoin k _)
  have hbsub : range b ⊆ racl k (range b' ∪ (Germ.comp (g'.map σ') g).cb) := by
    have h1 := cb_right_le_diff (f₂ := g) (hg'.map σ')
    rw [hcbσ, union_comm, racl_union_adjoin, union_comm] at h1
    have hbcb : range b ⊆ (g.cb : Set K) := by
      rw [hgcb]
      exact subset_adjoin k _
    exact hbcb.trans h1
  obtain ⟨y'', rfl⟩ := hy'
  obtain ⟨a'', rfl⟩ := ha'
  exact ⟨b', σ', Germ.comp (g'.map σ') g, hb'indW, hσb, hσc, hσx, hσz, hc', hδmem, hδy,
    hδcb_le', hbsub, hδb', hδ_g, hrk⟩

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.exists_conj_diff
statement:
theorem exists_conj_diff (hg : IsInvertible g) (hgz : g.evalGen y = z) :
    ∃ (b' : ι₂ → K) (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (δ : Germ k y y),
      IndepOver k ∅ (range b') (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z) ∧
      ⇑σ ∘ b = b' ∧ ⇑σ ∘ c = c ∧ ⇑σ ∘ x = x ∧ ⇑σ ∘ z = z ∧
      GroupConfiguration k (⇑σ ∘ a) b' c x (⇑σ ∘ y) z ∧
      δ ∈ diffSet g ∧ δ.evalGen y = ⇑σ ∘ y ∧
      δ.cb ≤ racl k (range b ∪ range b') ∧
      range b ⊆ racl k (range b' ∪ δ.cb) ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ (δ.cb : Set K) (range b') ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ (δ.cb : Set K) (g.cb : Set K) ∧
      erk k ∅ (δ.cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (g.cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b', σ, δ, hb', h⟩ := exists_conj_diff_fresh hb hc hg hgz finite_empty
  rw [union_empty] at hb'
  exact ⟨b', σ, δ, hb', h⟩

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.rank_of_config
statement:
theorem rank_of_config (hg : IsInvertible g) (hgz : g.evalGen y = z) :
    ∀ δ ∈ diffSet g, erk k ∅ (δ.cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (g.cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, -, -, -, -, -, -, hδmem, -, -, -, -, -, hrk⟩ := exists_conj_diff hb hc hg hgz
  exact IsHWBij.rank_of_exists hδmem hrk

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.isHWBij_of_config
statement:
theorem isHWBij_of_config (hg : IsInvertible g) (hgz : g.evalGen y = z) : IsHWBij g where
  isInvertible
proof:
:= hg
  trans := trans_of_config hb hc hgz
  rank := rank_of_config hb hc hg hgz

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.exists_isHWBij
statement:
theorem exists_isHWBij (hc : GroupConfiguration k a b c x y z)
    (hz : ∀ j, z j ∈ dclAdjoin (adjoin k (range b)) y)
    (hy : ∀ i, y i ∈ dclAdjoin (adjoin k (range b)) z) :
    ∃ g : Germ k y z, IsHWBij g ∧ g.evalGen y = z ∧
      GroupConfiguration k a g.codeTuple c x y z ∧
      racl k (range g.codeTuple) = racl k (range b)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgz, hracl⟩ := hc.exists_germ hz hy
  have hrc : racl k (range g.codeTuple) = racl k (range b) := by rw [racl_codeTuple, hracl]
  have hc' : GroupConfiguration k a g.codeTuple c x y z := hc.ofRaclEq rfl hrc rfl rfl rfl rfl
  exact ⟨g, isHWBij_of_config (range_codeTuple g) hc' hg hgz, hgz, hc', hrc⟩

name: GroupConfig.inLocus_algebraMap_comp
statement:
theorem inLocus_algebraMap_comp {e : ι → K} {u : ι → k}
    (hu : u ∈ zeroLocus k (idealOf k e)) : InLocus (k := k) e (algebraMap k K ∘ u)
proof:
:= by
  unfold InLocus locusIdeal
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro g hg
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, mem_idealOf_iff, aeval_map_algebraMap, aeval_algebraMap_apply,
    hu g hg, map_zero]

name: GroupConfig.exists_kpoint_of_notMem_locusIdeal
statement:
theorem exists_kpoint_of_notMem_locusIdeal [IsAlgClosed k] [Finite ι] (e : ι → K)
    {f : MvPolynomial ι K} (hf : f ∉ locusIdeal k e) :
    ∃ u : ι → k, InLocus (k := k) e (algebraMap k K ∘ u) ∧
      aeval (algebraMap k K ∘ u) f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b := Basis.ofVectorSpace k K
  set J₀ := f.support.biUnion fun m ↦ (b.repr (f.coeff m)).support
  have hrepr := sum_smul_map_coordPoly b f
  
  have hex : ∃ j ∈ J₀, coordPoly (b.coord j) f ∉ idealOf k e := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    apply hf
    rw [← hrepr]
    exact Ideal.sum_mem _ fun j hj ↦
      Submodule.smul_of_tower_mem _ (b j) (map_mem_locusIdeal k (h j hj))
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hgj⟩ := hex
  
  have hrad : (idealOf k e).radical = idealOf k e :=
    (RingHom.ker_isPrime (aeval e).toRingHom).radical
  have hnot : coordPoly (b.coord j) f ∉ vanishingIdeal k (zeroLocus k (idealOf k e)) := by
    rwa [vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical, hrad]
  rw [mem_vanishingIdeal_iff] at hnot
  push Not at hnot
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hne⟩ := hnot
  refine ⟨u, inLocus_algebraMap_comp hu, fun h0 ↦ hne ?_⟩
  
  rw [← hrepr, map_sum] at h0
  simp only [map_smul, aeval_map_algebraMap, aeval_algebraMap_apply] at h0
  have h0' : ∑ j' ∈ J₀, aeval u (coordPoly (b.coord j') f) • b j' =
      ∑ j' ∈ J₀, b j' • algebraMap k K (aeval u (coordPoly (b.coord j') f)) :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j' _ ↦ by rw [Algebra.smul_def, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  exact (linearIndependent_iff'.1 b.linearIndependent) J₀ _ (h0'.trans h0) j hj

name: GroupConfig.IsConstructibleOver.exists_kpoint
statement:
theorem IsConstructibleOver.exists_kpoint [IsAlgClosed k] [Finite ι]
    {s : Set (ι → K)} (hs : IsConstructibleOver k s) (hne : s.Nonempty) :
    ∃ u : ι → k, algebraMap k K ∘ u ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hne
  obtain ⟨cells, hcells⟩ := isConstructibleOver_iff_exists_polynomial_data.mp hs
  obtain ⟨cell, hcell, hg, hf⟩ := (hcells e).mp he
  have hf' : map (algebraMap k K) cell.f ∉ locusIdeal k e := by
    intro h
    exact hf ((mem_idealOf_iff k).mp ((map_mem_locusIdeal_iff k).mp h))
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hnu⟩ := exists_kpoint_of_notMem_locusIdeal e hf'
  refine ⟨u, (hcells _).mpr ⟨cell, hcell, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro i
    have h := (inLocus_iff.mp hu) _ (map_mem_locusIdeal k ((mem_idealOf_iff k).mpr (hg i)))
    simpa only [aeval_map_algebraMap] using h
  · simpa only [aeval_map_algebraMap] using hnu

name: GroupConfig.descent
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  let M : IntermediateField k K := racl k (range w)
  have hMsmall : IsSmall k (M : Set K) := (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range w)).racl
  
  have h1 : IndepOver k ∅ (range e) (M : Set K) := by
    have := (indepOver_racl_right_iff (k := k) (C := ∅) (A := range e) (B := range w)).2 hind
    rwa [empty_union] at this
  have hindM : IndepOver k ∅ (range e)
      ((racl k (M : Set K) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) := by
    have := (indepOver_racl_right_iff (k := k) (C := ∅) (A := range e) (B := (M : Set K))).2 h1
    rwa [empty_union] at this
  have hgen : IsGenericOver (racl k (M : Set K)) e e :=
    isGenericOver_self_of_indepOver hMsmall.racl hindM
  
  have hfib : IsConstructibleOver (↥(racl k (M : Set K))) {u : ι → K | Sum.elim u w ∈ Φ} := by
    have hw : ∀ j, w j ∈ racl k (M : Set K) := fun j ↦
      subset_racl k _ (subset_racl k _ (mem_range_self j))
    have hp := (hΦ.extend_base (L := ↥(racl k (M : Set K)))).preimage_polynomial
      (Sum.elim (fun i : ι ↦ X i) fun j : κ ↦ C (⟨w j, hw j⟩ : ↥(racl k (M : Set K))))
    convert hp using 1
    ext u
    have hfun : (fun i ↦ aeval u (Sum.elim (fun i : ι ↦ X i)
        (fun j : κ ↦ C (⟨w j, hw j⟩ : ↥(racl k (M : Set K)))) i)) = Sum.elim u w := by
      funext i
      cases i <;> simp
    simp only [mem_preimage, mem_ofPred_eq, hfun]
  
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := IsNoetherian.noetherian (idealOf k e)
  have hG' : Ideal.span (G : Set (MvPolynomial ι k)) = idealOf k e := hG
  have hloc : IsConstructibleOver (↥(racl k (M : Set K))) {u : ι → K | InLocus (k := k) e u} := by
    have hset : {u : ι → K | InLocus (k := k) e u} = ⋂ g : G, {u | aeval u g.1 = 0} := by
      ext u
      simp only [mem_ofPred_eq, mem_iInter, Subtype.forall]
      constructor
      · intro hu g hg
        have hgI : g ∈ idealOf k e := by
          rw [← hG']
          exact Ideal.subset_span hg
        have := (mem_idealOf_iff K).1 (hu (map_mem_locusIdeal k hgI))
        rwa [aeval_map_algebraMap] at this
      · intro hu
        unfold InLocus locusIdeal
        rw [← hG', Ideal.map_span, Ideal.span_le]
        rintro _ ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
        rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_idealOf_iff, aeval_map_algebraMap]
        exact hu g hg
    have hGc : IsConstructibleOver k (⋂ g : G, {u : ι → K | aeval u g.1 = 0}) :=
      IsConstructibleOver.iInter fun g ↦ IsConstructibleOver.polynomial_zero g.1
    rw [hset]
    exact hGc.extend_base
  
  
  let s : Set (ι → K) := {u | InLocus (k := k) e u} ∩ {u | Sum.elim u w ∈ Φ}ᶜ
  have hsc : IsConstructibleOver (↥(racl k (M : Set K))) s := hloc.inter hfib.compl
  have hV : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ p ∈ locusIdeal k e, aeval x p = 0 := fun x hx p hp ↦
    (mem_idealOf_iff K).1 (hx.1 hp)
  have hno : ∀ y, IsGenericOver
      (racl k ((racl k (M : Set K) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K)) e y → y ∉ s := by
    intro y hy hys
    have hy' : IsGenericOver (racl k (M : Set K)) e y := hy.of_le (subset_racl k _)
    have hinv : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[↥(racl k (M : Set K))] K, ∀ v,
        (σ ∘ v) ∈ {u : ι → K | Sum.elim u w ∈ Φ} ↔ v ∈ {u : ι → K | Sum.elim u w ∈ Φ} :=
      fun σ v ↦ hfib.mem_comp_algEquiv_iff σ v
    exact hys.2 ((hy'.mem_iff_of_invariant hgen hinv).2 he)
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hps⟩ :=
    exists_polynomial_zero_of_no_generic (racl k (M : Set K)) hMsmall.racl e hsc hV hno
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hune⟩ := exists_kpoint_of_notMem_locusIdeal e hp
  refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
  by_contra hcon
  apply hune
  rw [aeval_map_algebraMap]
  exact hps _ ⟨hu, hcon⟩

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCore.exists_isMainConclusion_fresh
statement:
theorem PsiCore.exists_isMainConclusion_fresh [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K]
    [UniversalDomain k K] (hw : w.PsiCore) {W : Set K} (hW : W.Finite) :
    ∃ E : Set K, E.Finite ∧ erk k ∅ E = 10 ∧ IndepOver k ∅ E (range w.repTuple ∪ W) ∧
      IsMainConclusion k (racl k E) w.aTuple w.bTuple w.cTuple w.xTuple w.yTuple w.zTuple ∧
      erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range w.aTuple) = 2 ∧ erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range w.xTuple) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hc, ha, hx⟩ := hw.groupConfiguration_with_ranks
  obtain ⟨E, hEfin, hErank, hEind, hmain⟩ :=
    hc.exists_main_fresh_with_parameterRank ((finite_range w.repTuple).union hW)
                                                                   
  have hrk : ∀ {X : Set K}, X ⊆ range w.repTuple → erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ X = erk k ∅ X :=
    fun hX ↦ by
      rw [erk_base_empty, erk_racl_base]
      have := hEind.symm (hX.trans (subset_union_left.trans subset_union_right))
        ((finite_range _).subset hX)
      rwa [empty_union] at this
  have hA : range w.aTuple ⊆ range w.repTuple := by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    fin_cases i
    exacts [⟨0, rfl⟩, ⟨1, rfl⟩]
  have hX : range w.xTuple ⊆ range w.repTuple := by
    rintro _ ⟨_, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨18, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨E, hEfin, ?_, hEind.mono_right subset_union_right, hmain, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hErank, ha]
    norm_num
  · rw [hrk hA, ha]
  · rw [hrk hX, hx]

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.exists_rankOne_isMainConclusion_fresh
statement:
theorem Psi.exists_rankOne_isMainConclusion_fresh [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K]
    [UniversalDomain k K] (hw : w.Psi) {W : Set K} (hW : W.Finite) :
    ∃ S' T' U' : Point k K, IsPartialQuadrangle ![w.S, w.T, w.U, S', T', U'] ∧
      ∃ E : Set K, E.Finite ∧ erk k ∅ E = 5 ∧
        IndepOver k ∅ E (range w.repTuple ∪ range ![S'.rep, T'.rep, U'.rep] ∪ W) ∧
        IsMainConclusion k (racl k E) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.S.rep) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.T.rep)
          (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.U.rep) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ T'.rep) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ U'.rep)
          (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ S'.rep) ∧
        erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.S.rep)) = 1 ∧
        erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ T'.rep)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S', T', U', hq⟩ := hw.quad
  obtain ⟨E, hEfin, hErank, hEind, hmain⟩ :=
    hq.groupConfiguration.exists_main_fresh_with_parameterRank
      (((finite_range w.repTuple).union (finite_range ![S'.rep, T'.rep, U'.rep])).union hW)
  have hpt : ∀ P : Point k K, erk k ∅ (range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ P.rep)) = 1 := fun P ↦ by
    simpa using ClosedIF.erk_eq_of_racl_eq (Point.racl_repTuple P) P.rankEq_one
  refine ⟨S', T', U', hq, E, hEfin, ?_, hEind.mono_right subset_union_right, hmain, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hErank]
    change 5 * erk k ∅ (range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.S.rep)) = 5
    rw [hpt]
    norm_num
  · have h1 : erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.S.rep)) =
        erk k ∅ (range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.S.rep)) := by
      rw [erk_base_empty, erk_racl_base]
      have := hEind.symm (fun _ h ↦ Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl h))))))
        (finite_range _)
      rwa [empty_union] at this
    rw [h1, hpt]
  · have h1 : erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ T'.rep)) =
        erk k ∅ (range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ T'.rep)) := by
      rw [erk_base_empty, erk_racl_base]
      have := hEind.symm (fun _ h ↦ Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr h)))) (finite_range _)
      rwa [empty_union] at this
    rw [h1, hpt]

name: GroupConfig.pRoot_pow
statement: theorem pRoot_pow (e : ℕ) (x : K) : pRoot K e x ^ ringExpChar K ^ e = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← iterateFrobeniusEquiv_def]
  exact RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ _

name: GroupConfig.pRoot_eq_of_pow_eq
statement:
theorem pRoot_eq_of_pow_eq {e : ℕ} {x y : K} (h : y ^ ringExpChar K ^ e = x) :
    pRoot K e x = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h, ← iterateFrobeniusEquiv_def]
  exact RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply _ _

name: GroupConfig.pRoot_pow_add
statement:
theorem pRoot_pow_add (e e' : ℕ) (x : K) :
    pRoot K e x ^ ringExpChar K ^ (e + e') = x ^ ringExpChar K ^ e'
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_add, pow_mul, pRoot_pow]

name: GroupConfig.pRoot_eq_pRoot_iff
statement:
theorem pRoot_eq_pRoot_iff {e e' : ℕ} {x x' : K} :
    pRoot K e x = pRoot K e' x' ↔ x ^ ringExpChar K ^ e' = x' ^ ringExpChar K ^ e
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← pRoot_pow_add e e' x, h, add_comm, pRoot_pow_add]
  · intro h
    apply (iterateFrobeniusEquiv K (ringExpChar K) (e + e')).injective
    rw [iterateFrobeniusEquiv_def, iterateFrobeniusEquiv_def, pRoot_pow_add, add_comm,
      pRoot_pow_add, h]

name: GroupConfig.map_pRoot
statement:
theorem map_pRoot {F : Type*} [FunLike F K K] [RingHomClass F K K] (σ : F) (e : ℕ) (x : K) :
    σ (pRoot K e x) = pRoot K e (σ x)
proof:
:=
  (pRoot_eq_of_pow_eq (by rw [← map_pow, pRoot_pow])).symm

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.eval_apply
statement:
theorem eval_apply (f : QuasiRational L ι κ) (u : ι → K) (j : κ) :
    f.eval u j = pRoot K f.e (aeval u (f.num j) / aeval u (f.den j))
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.aeval_comp_algEquiv
statement:
theorem aeval_comp_algEquiv (σ : K ≃ₐ[L] K) (u : ι → K) (P : MvPolynomial ι L) :
    aeval (⇑σ ∘ u) P = σ (aeval u P)
proof:
:= by
  change aeval (fun i ↦ σ.toAlgHom (u i)) P = σ.toAlgHom (aeval u P)
  rw [← comp_aeval_apply]

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isDefinedAt_comp_iff
statement:
theorem isDefinedAt_comp_iff (f : QuasiRational L ι κ) (σ : K ≃ₐ[L] K) (u : ι → K) :
    f.IsDefinedAt (⇑σ ∘ u) ↔ f.IsDefinedAt u
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsDefinedAt
  simp only [aeval_comp_algEquiv, ne_eq, map_eq_zero_iff _ σ.injective]

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.eval_comp
statement:
theorem eval_comp (f : QuasiRational L ι κ) (σ : K ≃ₐ[L] K) (u : ι → K) :
    f.eval (⇑σ ∘ u) = ⇑σ ∘ f.eval u
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  simp only [eval, Function.comp_apply, aeval_comp_algEquiv, ← map_div₀, map_pRoot]

name: GroupConfig.aeval_map_inclusion
statement:
theorem aeval_map_inclusion {M M₁ : IntermediateField k K} (h : M ≤ M₁) (u : ι → K)
    (P : MvPolynomial ι (↥M)) :
    aeval u (MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion h).toRingHom P) = aeval u P
proof:
:= by
  rw [aeval_def, aeval_def, eval₂_map]
  congr 1

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isDefinedAt_map_iff
statement:
theorem QuasiRational.isDefinedAt_map_iff {M M₁ : IntermediateField k K} (h : M ≤ M₁)
    (f : QuasiRational (↥M) ι κ) (u : ι → K) :
    (f.map (IntermediateField.inclusion h).toRingHom).IsDefinedAt u ↔ f.IsDefinedAt u
proof:
:= by
  unfold QuasiRational.IsDefinedAt
  simp only [QuasiRational.map]
  exact forall_congr' fun j ↦ by rw [aeval_map_inclusion]

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.eval_map
statement:
theorem QuasiRational.eval_map {M M₁ : IntermediateField k K} (h : M ≤ M₁)
    (f : QuasiRational (↥M) ι κ) (u : ι → K) :
    (f.map (IntermediateField.inclusion h).toRingHom).eval u = f.eval u
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  simp only [QuasiRational.eval, QuasiRational.map, aeval_map_inclusion]

name: GroupConfig.map_algebraMap_mem_range
statement:
theorem map_algebraMap_mem_range {M N : IntermediateField k K} (h : M ≤ N)
    (P : MvPolynomial ι (↥M)) :
    MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥M) K) P ∈ (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥N) K)).range
proof:
:= by
  refine RingHom.mem_range.2 ⟨MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion h).toRingHom P, ?_⟩
  rw [MvPolynomial.map_map]
  congr 1

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.eval_eq_of_eval_eq
statement:
theorem QuasiRational.eval_eq_of_eval_eq {M M' N : IntermediateField k K} (hMN : M ≤ N)
    (hM'N : M' ≤ N) {a y' y : ι → K} (hy' : IsGenericOver N a y') (hy : InLocus (k := k) a y)
    {f : QuasiRational (↥M) ι κ} {f' : QuasiRational (↥M') ι κ}
    (hfy' : f.IsDefinedAt y') (hf'y' : f'.IsDefinedAt y') (hfy : f.IsDefinedAt y)
    (hf'y : f'.IsDefinedAt y) (heq : f.eval y' = f'.eval y') : f.eval y = f'.eval y
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  have hj := congrFun heq j
  simp only [QuasiRational.eval_apply, pRoot_eq_pRoot_iff, div_pow] at hj ⊢
  rw [div_eq_div_iff (pow_ne_zero _ (hfy' j)) (pow_ne_zero _ (hf'y' j))] at hj
  rw [div_eq_div_iff (pow_ne_zero _ (hfy j)) (pow_ne_zero _ (hf'y j))]
  
  
  set A : MvPolynomial ι K :=
    MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥M) K) (f.num j) ^ ringExpChar K ^ f'.e *
        MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥M') K) (f'.den j) ^ ringExpChar K ^ f.e -
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥M') K) (f'.num j) ^ ringExpChar K ^ f.e *
        MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥M) K) (f.den j) ^ ringExpChar K ^ f'.e with hA
  have hAmem : A ∈ (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥N) K)).range :=
    sub_mem (mul_mem (pow_mem (map_algebraMap_mem_range hMN _) _)
        (pow_mem (map_algebraMap_mem_range hM'N _) _))
      (mul_mem (pow_mem (map_algebraMap_mem_range hM'N _) _)
        (pow_mem (map_algebraMap_mem_range hMN _) _))
  obtain ⟨A₀, hA₀⟩ := RingHom.mem_range.1 hAmem
  have hAy' : aeval y' A = 0 := by
    simp only [hA, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, aeval_map_algebraMap]
    rw [hj, sub_self]
  have hA₀I : MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥N) K) A₀ ∈ locusIdeal k a := by
    rw [← hy'.locusIdeal_eq]
    refine map_mem_locusIdeal (↥N) ((mem_idealOf_iff (↥N)).2 ?_)
    rw [← aeval_map_algebraMap (A := K), hA₀]
    exact hAy'
  have hAy := (mem_idealOf_iff K).1 (hy hA₀I)
  rw [hA₀] at hAy
  simp only [hA, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, aeval_map_algebraMap] at hAy
  exact sub_eq_zero.1 hAy

name: GroupConfig.expChar_of_algebra
statement:
theorem expChar_of_algebra (L K : Type*) [Field L] [Field K] [Algebra L K] :
    ExpChar L (ringExpChar K)
proof:
:=
  RingHom.expChar (algebraMap L K) (algebraMap L K).injective _

name: GroupConfig.pRoot_add
statement: theorem pRoot_add (e e' : ℕ) (x : K) : pRoot K (e + e') x = pRoot K e (pRoot K e' x)
proof:
:=
  pRoot_eq_of_pow_eq (by rw [pow_add, pow_mul, pRoot_pow, pRoot_pow])

name: GroupConfig.pRoot_aeval_twist
statement:
theorem pRoot_aeval_twist [ExpChar L (ringExpChar K)] (e : ℕ) (R : κ → K)
    (N : MvPolynomial κ L) :
    pRoot K e (aeval R (MvPolynomial.map (iterateFrobenius L (ringExpChar K) e) N)) =
      aeval (fun j ↦ pRoot K e (R j)) N
proof:
:= by
  rw [aeval_def, aeval_def, eval₂_map]
  change (pRoot K e).toRingHom (eval₂ _ R N) = _
  rw [eval₂_comp_left]
  congr 1
  ext c
  change pRoot K e (algebraMap L K (iterateFrobenius L (ringExpChar K) e c)) = algebraMap L K c
  rw [RingHom.map_iterateFrobenius]
  exact pRoot_eq_of_pow_eq (iterateFrobenius_def _ _ _).symm

name: GroupConfig.aeval_substFrac
statement:
theorem aeval_substFrac {N : MvPolynomial κ L} {d : ℕ} (hd : N.totalDegree ≤ d)
    (P Q : κ → MvPolynomial ι L) {u : ι → K} (hQ : ∀ j, aeval u (Q j) ≠ 0) :
    aeval u (substFrac N P Q d) =
      aeval (fun j ↦ aeval u (P j) / aeval u (Q j)) N * ∏ j, aeval u (Q j) ^ d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hm : ∀ m ∈ N.support, ∀ j, m j ≤ d := by
    intro m hmN j
    refine le_trans ?_ ((le_totalDegree hmN).trans hd)
    by_cases hj : j ∈ m.support
    · exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i ↦ m i) (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) hj
    · simp [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hj]
  rw [aeval_def (fun j ↦ aeval u (P j) / aeval u (Q j)), eval₂_eq, Finset.sum_mul]
  unfold substFrac
  simp only [map_sum, map_mul, map_prod, map_pow, aeval_C]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m hmN ↦ ?_
  rw [mul_assoc]
  congr 1
  rw [Finset.prod_subset (Finset.subset_univ m.support)
    (fun j _ hj ↦ by simp [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hj]), ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  have hdm : d = m j + (d - m j) := (Nat.add_sub_cancel' (hm m hmN j)).symm
  rw [hdm, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, pow_add, div_pow]
  field_simp
  rw [mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ (pow_ne_zero _ (hQ j))]

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isDefinedAt_comp
statement:
theorem QuasiRational.isDefinedAt_comp (g : QuasiRational L κ μ) (f : QuasiRational L ι κ)
    {u : ι → K}
    (hf : f.IsDefinedAt u) (hg : g.IsDefinedAt (f.eval u)) :
    (g.comp (ringExpChar K) f).IsDefinedAt u
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  simp only [QuasiRational.comp]
  rw [aeval_substFrac (le_max_right _ _) _ _ hf]
  refine mul_ne_zero ?_ (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun j _ ↦ pow_ne_zero _ (hf j))
  intro h0
  apply hg m
  have hval := pRoot_aeval_twist (K := K) f.e (fun j ↦ aeval u (f.num j) / aeval u (f.den j))
    (g.den m)
  rw [h0, map_zero] at hval
  exact hval.symm

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.comp_eval
statement:
theorem QuasiRational.comp_eval (g : QuasiRational L κ μ) (f : QuasiRational L ι κ) {u : ι → K}
    (hf : f.IsDefinedAt u) : (g.comp (ringExpChar K) f).eval u = g.eval (f.eval u)
proof:
:= by
  funext m
  simp only [QuasiRational.eval_apply, QuasiRational.comp]
  rw [aeval_substFrac (le_max_left _ _) _ _ hf, aeval_substFrac (le_max_right _ _) _ _ hf,
    mul_div_mul_right _ _ (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun j _ ↦ pow_ne_zero _ (hf j)), pRoot_add,
    map_div₀, pRoot_aeval_twist, pRoot_aeval_twist]
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.coeffVec_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeffVec_apply (d : ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial ι K) (m : Monomials ι d) :
    coeffVec d f m = f.coeff m.1
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.coeffVec_injOn
statement:
theorem coeffVec_injOn (d : ℕ) :
    InjOn (coeffVec (K := K) (ι := ι) d) (restrictTotalDegree ι K d : Set (MvPolynomial ι K))
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf g hg h
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_restrictTotalDegree] at hf hg
  ext m
  by_cases hm : m.sum (fun _ e ↦ e) ≤ d
  · exact congrFun h ⟨m, hm⟩
  · push Not at hm
    rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_totalDegree_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt hf hm),
      coeff_eq_zero_of_totalDegree_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt hg hm)]

name: GroupConfig.mem_degSubspace_iff
statement:
theorem mem_degSubspace_iff {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)} {d : ℕ} {w : Monomials ι d → K} :
    w ∈ degSubspace I d ↔ ∃ f ∈ I, f.totalDegree ≤ d ∧ coeffVec d f = w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [degSubspace, Submodule.mem_map, Submodule.mem_inf, Submodule.restrictScalars_mem,
    mem_restrictTotalDegree]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, ⟨hfI, hfd⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨f, hfI, hfd, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨f, hfI, hfd, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨f, ⟨hfI, hfd⟩, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.coeffVec_mem_degSubspace
statement:
