theorem coeffVec_mem_degSubspace {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)} {d : ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial ι K}
    (hfI : f ∈ I) (hfd : f.totalDegree ≤ d) : coeffVec d f ∈ degSubspace I d
proof:
:=
  mem_degSubspace_iff.2 ⟨f, hfI, hfd, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.coeff_mapF
statement: theorem coeff_mapF (g : MvPolynomial ι F) (m : ι →₀ ℕ) : (mapF F g).coeff m = (g.coeff m : K)
proof:
:=
  coeff_map _ _ _

name: GroupConfig.exists_mapF_eq_of_coeff_mem
statement:
theorem exists_mapF_eq_of_coeff_mem {f : MvPolynomial ι K} (hf : ∀ m, f.coeff m ∈ F) :
    ∃ g : MvPolynomial ι F, mapF F g = f
proof:
:= by
  apply mem_range_map_iff_coeffs_subset.mpr
  intro c hc
  obtain ⟨m, -, rfl⟩ := mem_coeffs_iff.mp hc
  exact ⟨⟨f.coeff m, hf m⟩, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.totalDegree_mapF
statement: theorem totalDegree_mapF (g : MvPolynomial ι F) : (mapF F g).totalDegree = g.totalDegree
proof:
:= by
  unfold totalDegree
  rw [support_map_of_injective _ F.subtype_injective]

name: GroupConfig.idealDefinedOver_iff_le
statement:
theorem idealDefinedOver_iff_le {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)} :
    IdealDefinedOver F I ↔ I ≤ (I.comap (mapF F)).map (mapF F)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact h.le
  · intro h
    exact le_antisymm h Ideal.map_comap_le

name: GroupConfig.map_comap_eq_span
statement:
theorem map_comap_eq_span (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)) :
    (I.comap (mapF F)).map (mapF F) = Ideal.span {f | f ∈ I ∧ ∀ m, f.coeff m ∈ F}
proof:
:= by
  change Ideal.span _ = _
  congr 1
  ext f
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨Ideal.mem_comap.1 hg, fun m ↦ by rw [coeff_mapF]; exact Subtype.mem _⟩
  · rintro ⟨hfI, hf⟩
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := exists_mapF_eq_of_coeff_mem F hf
    exact ⟨g, Ideal.mem_comap.2 hfI, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.idealDefinedOver_iff_span
statement:
theorem idealDefinedOver_iff_span {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)} :
    IdealDefinedOver F I ↔ I = Ideal.span {f | f ∈ I ∧ ∀ m, f.coeff m ∈ F}
proof:
:= by
  unfold IdealDefinedOver
  rw [map_comap_eq_span]

name: GroupConfig.idealDefinedOver_of_le_span
statement:
theorem idealDefinedOver_of_le_span {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)}
    (h : I ≤ Ideal.span {f | f ∈ I ∧ ∀ m, f.coeff m ∈ F}) : IdealDefinedOver F I
proof:
:= by
  rw [idealDefinedOver_iff_le, map_comap_eq_span]
  exact h

name: GroupConfig.IdealDefinedOver.span_eq
statement:
theorem IdealDefinedOver.span_eq {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)} (h : IdealDefinedOver F I) :
    Ideal.span {f | f ∈ I ∧ ∀ m, f.coeff m ∈ F} = I
proof:
:=
  ((idealDefinedOver_iff_span F).1 h).symm

name: GroupConfig.coeff_coordPoly
statement:
theorem coeff_coordPoly (l : K →ₗ[R] R) (p : MvPolynomial ι K) (m : ι →₀ ℕ) :
    (coordPoly l p).coeff m = l (p.coeff m)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold coordPoly
  rw [coeff_sum]
  simp only [coeff_monomial]
  by_cases hm : m ∈ p.support
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single m]
    · simp
    · intro m' _ hm'
      simp [hm']
    · intro h
      exact absurd hm h
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero]
    · rw [notMem_support_iff.1 hm, map_zero]
    · intro m' hm'
      have : m' ≠ m := fun h ↦ hm (h ▸ hm')
      simp [this]

name: GroupConfig.coordPoly_add
statement:
theorem coordPoly_add (l : K →ₗ[R] R) (p q : MvPolynomial ι K) :
    coordPoly l (p + q) = coordPoly l p + coordPoly l q
proof:
:= by
  refine MvPolynomial.ext _ _ fun m ↦ ?_
  simp [coeff_coordPoly]

name: GroupConfig.coordPoly_sum
statement:
theorem coordPoly_sum (l : K →ₗ[R] R) {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (p : α → MvPolynomial ι K) :
    coordPoly l (∑ i ∈ s, p i) = ∑ i ∈ s, coordPoly l (p i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    refine MvPolynomial.ext _ _ fun m ↦ ?_
    simp [coeff_coordPoly]
  | insert i s hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi, coordPoly_add, ih]

name: GroupConfig.coordPoly_mul_map
statement:
theorem coordPoly_mul_map (l : K →ₗ[R] R) (c : MvPolynomial ι K) (g : MvPolynomial ι R) :
    coordPoly l (c * MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap R K) g) = coordPoly l c * g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine MvPolynomial.ext _ _ fun m ↦ ?_
  simp only [coeff_coordPoly, coeff_mul, map_sum, coeff_map]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ ↦ ?_
  have : c.coeff x.1 * algebraMap R K (g.coeff x.2) = (g.coeff x.2) • c.coeff x.1 := by
    rw [Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm]
  rw [this, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: GroupConfig.coordPoly_mem_of_mem_map
proof:
:= by
  have hf' : f ∈ Submodule.span (MvPolynomial ι K)
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap R K) '' (J : Set (MvPolynomial ι R))) := hf
  obtain ⟨n, c, g, hsum⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_set'.1 hf'
  choose gJ hgJ hgJeq using fun i ↦ (Set.mem_image _ _ _).1 (g i).2
  rw [← hsum, coordPoly_sum]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ ?_
  rw [smul_eq_mul, ← hgJeq i, coordPoly_mul_map]
  exact J.mul_mem_left _ (hgJ i)

name: GroupConfig.totalDegree_coordPoly_le
statement:
theorem totalDegree_coordPoly_le (l : K →ₗ[R] R) (p : MvPolynomial ι K) :
    (coordPoly l p).totalDegree ≤ p.totalDegree
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.sup_le fun m hm ↦ le_totalDegree ?_
  rw [mem_support_iff, coeff_coordPoly] at hm
  rw [mem_support_iff]
  exact fun h ↦ hm (by rw [h, map_zero])

name: GroupConfig.sum_smul_map_coordPoly
statement:
theorem sum_smul_map_coordPoly {J : Type*} [DecidableEq J] (b : Basis J R K)
    (p : MvPolynomial ι K) :
    ∑ j ∈ p.support.biUnion (fun m ↦ (b.repr (p.coeff m)).support),
      b j • MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap R K) (coordPoly (b.coord j) p) = p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine MvPolynomial.ext _ _ fun m ↦ ?_
  simp only [coeff_sum, coeff_smul, coeff_map, coeff_coordPoly, Basis.coord_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have hx := b.linearCombination_repr (p.coeff m)
  rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply] at hx
  by_cases hm : m ∈ p.support
  · have hsub : (b.repr (p.coeff m)).support ⊆
        p.support.biUnion fun m ↦ (b.repr (p.coeff m)).support :=
      Finset.subset_biUnion_of_mem (fun m ↦ (b.repr (p.coeff m)).support) hm
    rw [Finsupp.sum_of_support_subset _ hsub (fun i a ↦ a • b i) (by simp)] at hx
    conv_rhs => rw [← hx]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    rw [Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm]
  · rw [notMem_support_iff.1 hm]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j _ ↦ ?_
    simp

name: GroupConfig.coordPoly_mul_mapF
statement:
theorem coordPoly_mul_mapF (l : K →ₗ[F] F) (c : MvPolynomial ι K) (g : MvPolynomial ι F) :
    coordPoly l (c * mapF F g) = coordPoly l c * g
proof:
:=
  coordPoly_mul_map l c g

name: GroupConfig.mem_map_comap_of_definedOver
proof:
:= by
  set T : Set (MvPolynomial ι F) :=
    {g | g ∈ I.comap (mapF F) ∧ (mapF F g).totalDegree ≤ d}
  
  have hS : {v : Monomials ι d → K | v ∈ degSubspace I d ∧ ∀ m, v m ∈ F} ⊆
      coeffVec d '' (mapF F '' T) := by
    rintro v ⟨hv, hvF⟩
    obtain ⟨f₁, hf₁I, hf₁d, rfl⟩ := mem_degSubspace_iff.1 hv
    have hcoef : ∀ m, f₁.coeff m ∈ F := by
      intro m
      by_cases hm : m.sum (fun _ e ↦ e) ≤ d
      · exact hvF ⟨m, hm⟩
      · push Not at hm
        rw [coeff_eq_zero_of_totalDegree_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt hf₁d hm)]
        exact F.zero_mem
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := exists_mapF_eq_of_coeff_mem F hcoef
    exact ⟨mapF F g, ⟨g, ⟨Ideal.mem_comap.2 hf₁I, hf₁d⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  have hdef : degSubspace I d =
      Submodule.span K {v : Monomials ι d → K | v ∈ degSubspace I d ∧ ∀ m, v m ∈ F} := h
  have hw : coeffVec d f ∈
      Submodule.span K {v : Monomials ι d → K | v ∈ degSubspace I d ∧ ∀ m, v m ∈ F} := by
    rw [← hdef]
    exact coeffVec_mem_degSubspace hf hfd
  have hw' := Submodule.span_mono hS hw
  rw [← Submodule.map_span (coeffVec d)] at hw'
  obtain ⟨f', hf', hff'⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.1 hw'
  
  have hTdeg : Submodule.span K (mapF F '' T) ≤ restrictTotalDegree ι K d := by
    refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨g, ⟨-, hgd⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_restrictTotalDegree]
    exact hgd
  have hfd' : f ∈ restrictTotalDegree ι K d := (mem_restrictTotalDegree ι d f).2 hfd
  have heq : f' = f := coeffVec_injOn d (hTdeg hf') hfd' hff'
  have hsub : Submodule.span K (mapF F '' T) ≤
      ((I.comap (mapF F)).map (mapF F)).restrictScalars K := by
    refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨g, ⟨hg, -⟩, rfl⟩
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hg
  rw [← heq]
  exact hsub hf'

name: GroupConfig.idealDefinedOver_of_degSubspace
statement:
theorem idealDefinedOver_of_degSubspace {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)}
    (h : ∀ d, DefinedOver (degSubspace I d) F) : IdealDefinedOver F I
proof:
:= by
  rw [idealDefinedOver_iff_le]
  exact fun f hf ↦ mem_map_comap_of_definedOver F (h _) hf le_rfl

name: GroupConfig.idealDefinedOver_of_span
proof:
:= by
  subst hS
  rw [idealDefinedOver_iff_le]
  exact Ideal.span_le.2 fun f hf ↦
    mem_map_comap_of_definedOver F h (Ideal.subset_span hf) (hd f hf)

name: GroupConfig.degSubspace_definedOver
statement:
theorem degSubspace_definedOver {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)} (h : IdealDefinedOver F I)
    (d : ℕ) : DefinedOver (degSubspace I d) F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold DefinedOver
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (Submodule.span_le.2 fun v hv ↦ hv.1)
  intro w hw
  obtain ⟨f, hfI, hfd, rfl⟩ := mem_degSubspace_iff.1 hw
  set J := I.comap (mapF F)
  have hIJ : I = J.map (mapF F) := h
  
  have hcomp : ∀ l : K →ₗ[F] F, coordPoly l f ∈ J := fun l ↦
    coordPoly_mem_of_mem_map l (hIJ ▸ hfI)
  have hmem : ∀ l : K →ₗ[F] F, coeffVec d (mapF F (coordPoly l f)) ∈ degSubspace I d :=
    fun l ↦ coeffVec_mem_degSubspace (Ideal.mem_comap.1 (hcomp l))
      ((totalDegree_mapF F _).trans_le ((totalDegree_coordPoly_le l f).trans hfd))
  have hval : ∀ l : K →ₗ[F] F, ∀ m, coeffVec d (mapF F (coordPoly l f)) m ∈ F := by
    intro l m
    rw [coeffVec_apply, coeff_mapF]
    exact Subtype.mem _
  
  let b := Basis.ofVectorSpace F K
  let J₀ : Finset (Basis.ofVectorSpaceIndex F K) :=
    f.support.biUnion fun m ↦ (b.repr (f.coeff m)).support
  have hrepr : coeffVec d f =
      ∑ j ∈ J₀, (b j : K) • coeffVec d (mapF F (coordPoly (b.coord j) f)) := by
    funext m
    simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, coeffVec_apply, coeff_mapF, coeff_coordPoly,
      Basis.coord_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    have hx := b.linearCombination_repr (f.coeff m.1)
    rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply] at hx
    by_cases hm : m.1 ∈ f.support
    · have hsub : (b.repr (f.coeff m.1)).support ⊆ J₀ :=
        Finset.subset_biUnion_of_mem (fun m ↦ (b.repr (f.coeff m)).support) hm
      rw [Finsupp.sum_of_support_subset _ hsub (fun i a ↦ a • b i) (by simp)] at hx
      conv_lhs => rw [← hx]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
      rw [Subfield.smul_def, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
    · rw [notMem_support_iff.1 hm]
      refine (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j _ ↦ ?_).symm
      simp
  rw [hrepr]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j _ ↦
    Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨hmem _, hval _⟩)

name: GroupConfig.degSubspace_definedOver_of_le
statement:
theorem degSubspace_definedOver_of_le (F : Subfield K)
    {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)} {d d' : ℕ} (hd : d' ≤ d)
    (h : DefinedOver (degSubspace I d) F) : DefinedOver (degSubspace I d') F
proof:
:= by
  let J := (I.comap (mapF F)).map (mapF F)
  have hJ : IdealDefinedOver F J := by
    unfold IdealDefinedOver J
    exact (Ideal.map_comap_map (I := I.comap (mapF F)) (f := mapF F)).symm
  have heq : degSubspace I d' = degSubspace J d' := by
    ext v
    rw [mem_degSubspace_iff, mem_degSubspace_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨f, hf, hfd, hfv⟩
      exact ⟨f, mem_map_comap_of_definedOver F h hf (hfd.trans hd), hfd, hfv⟩
    · rintro ⟨f, hf, hfd, hfv⟩
      exact ⟨f, Ideal.map_comap_le hf, hfd, hfv⟩
  rw [heq]
  exact degSubspace_definedOver F hJ d'

name: GroupConfig.idealDefinedOver_iff_forall_degSubspace
statement:
theorem idealDefinedOver_iff_forall_degSubspace {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)} :
    IdealDefinedOver F I ↔ ∀ d, DefinedOver (degSubspace I d) F
proof:
:=
  ⟨degSubspace_definedOver F, idealDefinedOver_of_degSubspace F⟩

name: GroupConfig.totalDegree_map_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem totalDegree_map_ringEquiv (p : MvPolynomial ι K) :
    (MvPolynomial.map σ.toRingHom p).totalDegree = p.totalDegree
proof:
:= by
  unfold totalDegree
  rw [support_map_of_injective _ σ.injective]

name: GroupConfig.coeffVec_map
statement:
theorem coeffVec_map (d : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial ι K) :
    coeffVec d (MvPolynomial.map σ.toRingHom p) = mapVec σ (coeffVec d p)
proof:
:= by
  funext m
  simp [coeff_map]

name: GroupConfig.degSubspace_map
statement:
theorem degSubspace_map (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)) (d : ℕ) :
    degSubspace (I.map (MvPolynomial.map σ.toRingHom)) d =
      (degSubspace I d).map (mapVec σ)
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  rw [mem_degSubspace_iff, Submodule.mem_map]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, hfd, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩ :=
      (Ideal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective _ (map_surjective σ.toRingHom σ.surjective)).1 hf
    rw [totalDegree_map_ringEquiv] at hfd
    exact ⟨coeffVec d g, coeffVec_mem_degSubspace hg hfd, (coeffVec_map σ d g).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hgd, rfl⟩ := mem_degSubspace_iff.1 hv
    exact ⟨MvPolynomial.map σ.toRingHom g, Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hg,
      by rw [totalDegree_map_ringEquiv]; exact hgd, coeffVec_map σ d g⟩

name: GroupConfig.fod_degSubspace_mono
statement:
theorem fod_degSubspace_mono (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)) :
    Monotone fun d ↦ fod (degSubspace I d)
proof:
:= by
  intro d' d hd
  apply DefinedOver.fod_le
  exact degSubspace_definedOver_of_le _ hd (DefinedOver.of_fod_le le_rfl)

name: GroupConfig.fod_degSubspace_le_idealFod
statement:
theorem fod_degSubspace_le_idealFod (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)) (d : ℕ) :
    fod (degSubspace I d) ≤ idealFod I
proof:
:=
  le_iSup (fun d ↦ fod (degSubspace I d)) d

name: GroupConfig.mem_idealFod_iff
statement:
theorem mem_idealFod_iff (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)) {x : K} :
    x ∈ idealFod I ↔ ∃ d, x ∈ fod (degSubspace I d)
proof:
:=
  Subfield.mem_iSup_of_directed (fod_degSubspace_mono I).directed_le

name: GroupConfig.exists_forall_idealDefinedOver_iff
statement:
theorem exists_forall_idealDefinedOver_iff (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)) :
    ∃ d₀ : ℕ, Ideal.span {f | f ∈ I ∧ f.totalDegree ≤ d₀} = I ∧
      ∀ d, d₀ ≤ d → ∀ F : Subfield K,
        IdealDefinedOver F I ↔ DefinedOver (degSubspace I d) F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := IsNoetherian.noetherian I
  let d₀ := S.sup fun f ↦ f.totalDegree
  have hspan : Ideal.span {f | f ∈ I ∧ f.totalDegree ≤ d₀} = I := by
    refine le_antisymm (Ideal.span_le.2 fun _ hf ↦ hf.1) ?_
    refine hS.symm.le.trans (Ideal.span_mono ?_)
    intro f hf
    have hfI : f ∈ I := by
      rw [← hS]
      exact Ideal.subset_span hf
    exact ⟨hfI, Finset.le_sup (f := fun f ↦ f.totalDegree) (Finset.mem_coe.1 hf)⟩
  refine ⟨d₀, hspan, fun d hd F ↦ ⟨fun h ↦ degSubspace_definedOver F h d, ?_⟩⟩
  intro h
  exact idealDefinedOver_of_span F hspan (fun _ hf ↦ hf.2.trans hd) h

name: GroupConfig.idealDefinedOver_iff
statement:
theorem idealDefinedOver_iff {F : Subfield K} {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)} :
    IdealDefinedOver F I ↔ idealFod I ≤ F
proof:
:= by
  rw [idealDefinedOver_iff_forall_degSubspace]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact iSup_le fun d ↦ (h d).fod_le
  · intro h d
    exact DefinedOver.of_fod_le ((fod_degSubspace_le_idealFod I d).trans h)

name: GroupConfig.idealDefinedOver_idealFod
statement:
theorem idealDefinedOver_idealFod (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)) :
    IdealDefinedOver (idealFod I) I
proof:
:=
  idealDefinedOver_iff.2 le_rfl

name: GroupConfig.exists_forall_idealFod_eq
statement:
theorem exists_forall_idealFod_eq (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)) :
    ∃ d₀ : ℕ, ∀ d, d₀ ≤ d → idealFod I = fod (degSubspace I d)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := IsNoetherian.noetherian I
  refine ⟨S.sup fun f ↦ f.totalDegree, fun d hd ↦ ?_⟩
  refine le_antisymm (idealDefinedOver_iff.1 ?_) (fod_degSubspace_le_idealFod I d)
  refine idealDefinedOver_of_span _ hS (fun f hf ↦ ?_) (DefinedOver.of_fod_le le_rfl)
  exact (Finset.le_sup (f := fun f ↦ f.totalDegree) (Finset.mem_coe.1 hf)).trans hd

name: GroupConfig.exists_finset_closure_eq_idealFod
statement:
theorem exists_finset_closure_eq_idealFod (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)) :
    ∃ s : Finset K, Subfield.closure (s : Set K) = idealFod I
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d₀, hd₀⟩ := exists_forall_idealFod_eq I
  rw [hd₀ d₀ le_rfl]
  exact exists_finset_closure_eq_fod (W := degSubspace I d₀)

name: GroupConfig.idealFod_map
statement:
theorem idealFod_map (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)) :
    idealFod (I.map (MvPolynomial.map σ.toRingHom)) = (idealFod I).map σ.toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  unfold idealFod
  rw [Subfield.map_iSup]
  exact iSup_congr fun d ↦ by rw [degSubspace_map, fod_map]

name: GroupConfig.ideal_map_eq_self_iff
statement:
theorem ideal_map_eq_self_iff (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)) :
    I.map (MvPolynomial.map σ.toRingHom) = I ↔ ∀ x ∈ idealFod I, σ x = x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hI
    have hfix : ∀ d, ∀ y ∈ fod (degSubspace I d), σ y = y := fun d ↦
      (map_eq_self_iff (degSubspace I d) σ).1 (by rw [← degSubspace_map σ I d, hI])
    exact fun x hx ↦ (iSup_le fun d ↦ fun y hy ↦ hfix d y hy :
      idealFod I ≤ RingHom.eqLocusField σ.toRingHom (RingHom.id K)) hx
  · intro hfix
    set F := RingHom.eqLocusField σ.toRingHom (RingHom.id K)
    have hI : I = (I.comap (mapF F)).map (mapF F) :=
      idealDefinedOver_iff.2 fun x hx ↦ hfix x hx
    have hsub : σ.toRingHom.comp F.subtype = F.subtype := RingHom.ext fun x ↦ x.2
    have hcomp : (MvPolynomial.map σ.toRingHom).comp (mapF F) =
        (mapF F : MvPolynomial ι F →+* MvPolynomial ι K) :=
      RingHom.ext fun g ↦ by simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, mapF, map_map, hsub]
    conv_lhs => rw [hI]
    rw [Ideal.map_map, hcomp]
    exact hI.symm

name: GroupConfig.orbit_eq_of_transcendental
proof:
:= by
  ext x'
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨σ, rfl⟩ halg
    apply hx
    simpa using halg.algHom σ.symm.toAlgHom
  · intro hx'
    have hx'' : Transcendental (↥L) x' := hx'
    have hideal : idealOf (↥L) (fun _ : Unit ↦ x) = idealOf (↥L) (fun _ : Unit ↦ x') := by
      rw [(idealOf_eq_bot_iff (↥L)).2 (algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff.2 hx),
        (idealOf_eq_bot_iff (↥L)).2 (algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff.2 hx'')]
    obtain ⟨σ, -, hσ⟩ := exists_ambientAutomorphism_of_idealOf_eq hideal
    exact ⟨σ, hσ ()⟩

name: GroupConfig.finite_orbit_iff
statement:
theorem finite_orbit_iff (L : IntermediateField k K) (x : K) :
    (range fun σ : K ≃ₐ[↥L] K ↦ σ x).Finite ↔ x ∈ racl k (L : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_racl_iff, adjoin_self]
  constructor
  · intro hfin
    by_contra hx
    have hxt : Transcendental (↥L) x := hx
    rw [orbit_eq_of_transcendental hxt] at hfin
    
    have hinj : Function.Injective fun n : ℕ ↦ x ^ (n + 1) := by
      intro i j hij
      have h := (transcendental_iff_injective.1 hxt)
        (show Polynomial.aeval x (Polynomial.X ^ (i + 1)) =
          Polynomial.aeval x (Polynomial.X ^ (j + 1)) by simpa using hij)
      simpa using congrArg Polynomial.natDegree h
    exact Set.infinite_of_injective_forall_mem hinj (fun n ↦ hxt.pow n.succ_pos) hfin
  · intro hx
    have h := finite_conjugates (L := L) (z := fun _ : Unit ↦ x) fun _ ↦ hx.isIntegral
    refine (h.image fun z ↦ z ()).subset ?_
    rintro _ ⟨σ, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, ⟨σ, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.finite_orbit_tuple_iff
statement:
theorem finite_orbit_tuple_iff (L : IntermediateField k K) {μ : Type*} [Finite μ] (z : μ → K) :
    (range fun σ : K ≃ₐ[↥L] K ↦ ⇑σ ∘ z).Finite ↔ ∀ i, z i ∈ racl k (L : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hfin i
    refine (finite_orbit_iff L (z i)).1 ((hfin.image fun w ↦ w i).subset ?_)
    rintro _ ⟨σ, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, ⟨σ, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  · intro hz
    refine finite_conjugates fun i ↦ ?_
    have h := hz i
    rw [mem_racl_iff, adjoin_self] at h
    exact h.isIntegral

name: GroupConfig.locusIdeal_comap
statement:
theorem locusIdeal_comap (a : ι → K) :
    (locusIdeal L a).comap (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap L K)) = idealOf L a
proof:
:=
  comap_map_mvPolynomial_eq_self _

name: GroupConfig.map_mem_locusIdeal
statement:
theorem map_mem_locusIdeal {a : ι → K} {f : MvPolynomial ι L} (hf : f ∈ idealOf L a) :
    MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap L K) f ∈ locusIdeal L a
proof:
:=
  Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hf

name: GroupConfig.map_mem_locusIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem map_mem_locusIdeal_iff {a : ι → K} {f : MvPolynomial ι L} :
    MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap L K) f ∈ locusIdeal L a ↔ f ∈ idealOf L a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ideal.mem_comap, locusIdeal_comap]

name: GroupConfig.aeval_eq_zero_of_mem_locusIdeal
statement:
theorem aeval_eq_zero_of_mem_locusIdeal {a : ι → K} {f : MvPolynomial ι K}
    (hf : f ∈ locusIdeal L a) : MvPolynomial.aeval a f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hle : locusIdeal L a ≤ idealOf K a := by
    rw [locusIdeal, Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro g hg
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, mem_idealOf_iff, MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap]
    exact (mem_idealOf_iff L).1 hg
  exact (mem_idealOf_iff K).1 (hle hf)

name: GroupConfig.locusIdeal_base_le
statement:
theorem locusIdeal_base_le (M : IntermediateField k K) (a : ι → K) :
    locusIdeal k a ≤ locusIdeal (↥M) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [locusIdeal, Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro g hg
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k (↥M) K, ← MvPolynomial.map_map]
  refine map_mem_locusIdeal (↥M) ?_
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap]
  exact (mem_idealOf_iff k).1 hg

name: GroupConfig.locusIdeal_mono
statement:
theorem locusIdeal_mono {F M : IntermediateField k K} (hFM : F ≤ M) (a : ι → K) :
    locusIdeal (↥F) a ≤ locusIdeal (↥M) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [locusIdeal, Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro g hg
  have hcomp : (algebraMap (↥M) K).comp (IntermediateField.inclusion hFM).toRingHom =
      algebraMap (↥F) K := by
    ext x
    rfl
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, ← hcomp, ← MvPolynomial.map_map]
  refine map_mem_locusIdeal (↥M) ?_
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, MvPolynomial.aeval_def, MvPolynomial.eval₂_map, hcomp,
    ← MvPolynomial.aeval_def]
  exact (mem_idealOf_iff ↥F).1 hg

name: GroupConfig.map_comp_map_algebraMap
statement:
theorem map_comp_map_algebraMap (M : IntermediateField k K) :
    (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥M) K)).comp (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥M)) =
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) (σ := ι)
proof:
:= by
  ext p <;> simp

name: GroupConfig.isGenericOver_iff_locusIdeal_eq
statement:
theorem isGenericOver_iff_locusIdeal_eq :
    IsGenericOver M a a' ↔ locusIdeal (↥M) a' = locusIdeal k a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    unfold locusIdeal
    rw [h, Ideal.map_map, map_comp_map_algebraMap]
  · intro h
    unfold IsGenericOver
    rw [← locusIdeal_comap (↥M) a', h, locusIdeal, ← map_comp_map_algebraMap M,
      ← Ideal.map_map, comap_map_mvPolynomial_eq_self]

name: GroupConfig.IsGenericOver.locusIdeal_eq
statement:
theorem IsGenericOver.locusIdeal_eq (h : IsGenericOver M a a') :
    locusIdeal (↥M) a' = locusIdeal k a
proof:
:=
  isGenericOver_iff_locusIdeal_eq.1 h

name: GroupConfig.IsGenericOver.idealOf_eq
statement: theorem IsGenericOver.idealOf_eq (h : IsGenericOver M a a') : idealOf k a' = idealOf k a
proof:
:=
  (isGeneric_baseChange h).1

name: GroupConfig.IsGenericOver.erk_coe_eq
statement:
theorem IsGenericOver.erk_coe_eq (h : IsGenericOver M a a') :
    erk k (M : Set K) (range a') = erk k ∅ (range a')
proof:
:= by
  rw [erk_coe_eq_toENat_trdeg, erk_empty_eq_toENat_trdeg, trdeg_adjoin_of_isGeneric h]

name: GroupConfig.erk_empty_range_eq_of_idealOf_eq
statement:
theorem erk_empty_range_eq_of_idealOf_eq {b : ι → K} (h : idealOf k a = idealOf k b) :
    erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [erk_empty_eq_toENat_trdeg, erk_empty_eq_toENat_trdeg,
    (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq h).trdeg_eq]

name: GroupConfig.IsGenericOver.erk_empty_eq
statement:
theorem IsGenericOver.erk_empty_eq (h : IsGenericOver M a a') :
    erk k ∅ (range a') = erk k ∅ (range a)
proof:
:=
  erk_empty_range_eq_of_idealOf_eq h.idealOf_eq

name: GroupConfig.IsGenericOver.indepOver
statement:
theorem IsGenericOver.indepOver [Finite ι] (h : IsGenericOver M a a') :
    IndepOver k ∅ (range a') (M : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  refine indepOver_of_erk_eq (finite_range a') ?_
  rw [empty_union]
  exact h.erk_coe_eq

name: GroupConfig.IsGenericOver.of_le
statement:
theorem IsGenericOver.of_le {F : IntermediateField k K} (hFM : F ≤ M)
    (h : IsGenericOver M a a') : IsGenericOver F a a'
proof:
:= by
  have hk : idealOf k a' = idealOf k a := h.idealOf_eq
  rw [isGenericOver_iff_locusIdeal_eq] at h ⊢
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rw [← h]
    exact locusIdeal_mono hFM a'
  · have h1 : locusIdeal k a = locusIdeal k a' := by
      unfold locusIdeal
      rw [hk]
    rw [h1]
    exact locusIdeal_base_le F a'

name: GroupConfig.IsGenericOver.exists_algEquiv
statement:
theorem IsGenericOver.exists_algEquiv [IsAlgClosed K] [Finite ι] (h1 : IsGenericOver M a a')
    (h2 : IsGenericOver M a a'') : ∃ σ : K ≃ₐ[↥M] K, ∀ i, σ (a' i) = a'' i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, -, hσ⟩ := exists_ambientAutomorphism_of_idealOf_eq (k := ↥M) (h1.trans h2.symm)
  exact ⟨σ, hσ⟩

name: GroupConfig.IsGenericOver.comp
statement:
theorem IsGenericOver.comp (h : IsGenericOver M a a') (σ : K ≃ₐ[↥M] K) :
    IsGenericOver M a (fun i ↦ σ (a' i))
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsGenericOver at h ⊢
  rw [← h]
  refine idealOf_eq_of_aeval_iff (↥M) fun f ↦ ?_
  have hfun : (fun i ↦ σ (a' i)) = fun i ↦ (σ : K →ₐ[↥M] K) (a' i) := rfl
  rw [hfun, ← MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply]
  exact map_eq_zero_iff _ σ.injective

name: GroupConfig.IsGenericOver.iff_idealOf_eq
statement:
theorem IsGenericOver.iff_idealOf_eq (h : IsGenericOver M a a') :
    IsGenericOver M a a'' ↔ idealOf (↥M) a'' = idealOf (↥M) a'
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsGenericOver at h ⊢
  rw [h]

name: GroupConfig.universalDomain_of_isSmall
statement:
theorem universalDomain_of_isSmall [UniversalDomain k K] (M : IntermediateField k K)
    (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K)) : UniversalDomain (↥M) K
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  have htower := trdeg_add_eq k (↥M) (A := K)
  have hsmall : Algebra.trdeg k ↥M < Cardinal.aleph0 := by
    have h := hM
    unfold IsSmall at h
    rw [erk_empty_eq_toENat_trdeg, Cardinal.toENat_ne_top, adjoin_self] at h
    exact h
  by_contra hlt
  push Not at hlt
  have := Cardinal.add_lt_aleph0 hsmall hlt
  rw [htower] at this
  exact (not_le.2 this) UniversalDomain.aleph0_le_trdeg

name: GroupConfig.exists_isGenericOver
statement:
theorem exists_isGenericOver [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K] [Finite ι]
    {M : IntermediateField k K} (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K)) (a : ι → K) :
    ∃ a' : ι → K, IsGenericOver M a a'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨K₀, _, _, _, _, b₀, hb₀, -, -⟩ :=
    exists_genericPoint_baseChange (k := k) (E := ↥M) (F := K) a
  let L₀ : IntermediateField (↥M) K₀ := IntermediateField.adjoin (↥M) (Set.range b₀)
  
  obtain ⟨ι', t, ht⟩ := exists_isTranscendenceBasis' (↥M) ↥L₀
  have hfin : Algebra.trdeg (↥M) ↥L₀ < Cardinal.aleph0 := by
    rw [← Cardinal.toENat_ne_top,
      ← AlgebraicIndependent.matroid_eRk_eq_toENat_trdeg (↥M) (Set.range b₀)]
    exact (((AlgebraicIndependent.matroid (↥M) K₀).eRk_le_encard _).trans_lt
      (finite_range b₀).encard_lt_top).ne
  have hι' : Finite ι' := by
    rw [← Cardinal.lt_aleph0_iff_finite, ht.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg]
    exact hfin
  obtain ⟨n, ⟨e⟩⟩ := Finite.exists_equiv_fin ι'
  
  obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀ind, hs₀inj⟩ := exists_fresh_tuple hM n
  have hs₀ : AlgebraicIndependent (↥M) s₀ := by
    have h1 : (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid (↥M) K).Indep (Set.range s₀) := by
      rw [← rkMatroid_coe]
      exact hs₀ind
    exact (algebraicIndependent_subtype_range hs₀inj).1
      (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid_indep_iff.1 h1)
  have hsind : AlgebraicIndependent (↥M) (s₀ ∘ e) := hs₀.comp e e.injective
  
  let φ₀ : ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin (↥M) (Set.range t)) →ₐ[↥M] K :=
    ((IntermediateField.adjoin (↥M) (Set.range (s₀ ∘ e))).val.comp
      hsind.aevalEquivField.toAlgHom).comp ht.1.aevalEquivField.symm.toAlgHom
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin (↥M) (Set.range t))) ↥L₀ :=
    ht.isAlgebraic_field
  let _ : Algebra (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin (↥M) (Set.range t))) K := φ₀.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower (↥M) (↥(IntermediateField.adjoin (↥M) (Set.range t))) K :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun c ↦ (φ₀.commutes c).symm
  let ψ : ↥L₀ →ₐ[↥(IntermediateField.adjoin (↥M) (Set.range t))] K := IsAlgClosed.lift
  let ψ' : ↥L₀ →ₐ[↥M] K := ψ.restrictScalars (↥M)
  let b₀' : ι → ↥L₀ := fun i ↦ ⟨b₀ i, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin _ _ ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩
  refine ⟨fun i ↦ ψ' (b₀' i), ?_⟩
  unfold IsGenericOver
  rw [← hb₀]
  have h1 : idealOf (↥M) (⇑ψ' ∘ b₀') = idealOf (↥M) b₀' := idealOf_comp_algHom (↥M) ψ' b₀'
  have h2 : idealOf (↥M) (⇑L₀.val ∘ b₀') = idealOf (↥M) b₀' :=
    idealOf_comp_algHom (↥M) L₀.val b₀'
  have h3 : (⇑L₀.val ∘ b₀') = b₀ := funext fun i ↦ rfl
  rw [h3] at h2
  exact h1.trans h2.symm

name: GroupConfig.isGenericOver_self_of_indepOver
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hM a
  have hle : idealOf (↥M) b ≤ idealOf (↥M) a := by
    rw [hb, Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro f hf
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, mem_idealOf_iff, MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap]
    exact (mem_idealOf_iff k).1 hf
  have herk : erk k (M : Set K) (Set.range a) = erk k (M : Set K) (Set.range b) := by
    rw [hb.erk_coe_eq, hb.erk_empty_eq]
    have h' := h (subset_refl _) (finite_range a)
    rwa [empty_union] at h'
  have heq := idealOf_eq_of_le_of_erk_eq M hle herk
  unfold IsGenericOver at hb ⊢
  rw [← heq, hb]

name: GroupConfig.isGenericOver_self_iff
statement:
theorem isGenericOver_self_iff [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K] [Finite ι]
    {M : IntermediateField k K} (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K)) {a : ι → K} :
    IsGenericOver M a a ↔ IndepOver k ∅ (Set.range a) (M : Set K)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ h.indepOver, isGenericOver_self_of_indepOver hM⟩

name: GroupConfig.isSmall_coe_of_isSmall
statement:
theorem isSmall_coe_of_isSmall (M : IntermediateField k K) {C : Set K} (hC : IsSmall k C) :
    IsSmall (↥M) C
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsSmall at hC ⊢
  rw [← erk_coe_union (k := k) M ∅ C, union_empty]
  exact fun htop ↦ hC (top_le_iff.1 (htop ▸ erk_base_mono k (empty_subset _) C))

name: GroupConfig.exists_algEquiv_indepOver
statement:
theorem exists_algEquiv_indepOver [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K] [Finite ι]
    {M : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed (↥M)] (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K)) (a : ι → K)
    {w : Set K} (hw : IsSmall k w) :
    ∃ σ : K ≃ₐ[↥M] K, IndepOver k (M : Set K) (Set.range (fun i ↦ σ (a i))) w
proof:
:= by
  have := universalDomain_of_isSmall M hM
  
  
  let M' : IntermediateField (↥M) K := racl (↥M) w
  have hM' : IsSmall (↥M) (M' : Set K) := (isSmall_coe_of_isSmall M hw).racl
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_isGenericOver (k := ↥M) hM' a
  obtain ⟨σ, -, hσ⟩ := exists_ambientAutomorphism_of_idealOf_eq (k := ↥M) hb.idealOf_eq.symm
  refine ⟨σ, ?_⟩
  have hfun : (fun i ↦ σ (a i)) = b := funext hσ
  rw [hfun]
  have hind : IndepOver (↥M) ∅ (Set.range b) (M' : Set K) := hb.indepOver
  have hind' : IndepOver (↥M) ∅ (Set.range b) w := hind.mono_right (subset_racl _ w)
  have := (indepOver_coe_union_iff M ∅ (Set.range b) w).2 hind'
  rwa [union_empty] at this

name: AclGeom.erk_point
statement: private theorem erk_point (P : Point k K) : erk k ∅ (range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ P.rep)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa using ClosedIF.erk_eq_of_racl_eq (Point.racl_repTuple P) P.rankEq_one

name: AclGeom.not_le_of_ne
statement: private theorem not_le_of_ne {P Q : Point k K} (h : P ≠ Q) : ¬ Q.1 ≤ P.1
proof:
:= fun hle ↦
  h (Subtype.ext ((P.2.le_iff.1 hle).resolve_left Q.2.1).symm)

name: AclGeom.line_eq
statement:
private theorem line_eq {P Q R : Point k K} (hPQ : P ≠ Q) (hPR : P ≠ R) (hQR : Q ≠ R)
    (h : RankEq 2 (P.1 ⊔ (Q.1 ⊔ R.1))) :
    P.1 ⊔ Q.1 = P.1 ⊔ (Q.1 ⊔ R.1) ∧ P.1 ⊔ R.1 = P.1 ⊔ (Q.1 ⊔ R.1) ∧
      Q.1 ⊔ R.1 = P.1 ⊔ (Q.1 ⊔ R.1)
proof:
:=
  ⟨RankEq.eq_of_le (sup_le_sup_left le_sup_left _)
      (P.rankEq_one.sup_point_of_not_le (not_le_of_ne hPQ)) h,
    RankEq.eq_of_le (sup_le_sup_left le_sup_right _)
      (P.rankEq_one.sup_point_of_not_le (not_le_of_ne hPR)) h,
    RankEq.eq_of_le le_sup_right (Q.rankEq_one.sup_point_of_not_le (not_le_of_ne hQR)) h⟩

name: AclGeom.subset_racl_canonicalBase_of_line
statement:
private theorem subset_racl_canonicalBase_of_line [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K]
    {P Q R : Point k K} (hQR : Q ≠ R) (hR : R.1 ≤ P.1 ⊔ Q.1) :
    range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ P.rep) ⊆ racl k (canonicalBase (racl k (range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ P.rep)))
      (Sum.elim (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ Q.rep) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ R.rep)) : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hMdef⟩ : ∃ M, M = racl k (range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ P.rep)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hMdef]
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥M := hMdef ▸ isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K) := hMdef ▸ (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range _)).racl
  have hMP : M = P.1.1 := hMdef.trans (Point.racl_repTuple P)
  have hMr : racl k (M : Set K) = P.1.1 := by
    rw [hMdef]
    exact (isRAC_iff_racl_eq.1 (isRAC_racl _)).trans (Point.racl_repTuple P)
  have hb : range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ R.rep) ⊆
      racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ Q.rep)) := by
    rw [ClosedIF.racl_union_eq_sup hMr (Point.racl_repTuple Q)]
    rintro _ ⟨_, rfl⟩
    exact hR R.mem_rep
  have hcap := GroupConfig.range_subset_racl_canonicalBase M hM (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ Q.rep)
    (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ R.rep) hb
  let cb := canonicalBase M (Sum.elim (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ Q.rep) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ R.rep))
  let C : ClosedIF k K := ⟨racl k (cb : Set K), isRAC_racl _⟩
  have hCP : C ≤ P.1 := by
    rw [ClosedIF.le_iff, ← hMP]
    exact racl_le_of_isAlgClosed (canonicalBase_le M _)
  rcases P.2.le_iff.1 hCP with hC | hC
  · 
    exfalso
    have hcbQ : (cb : Set K) ⊆ racl k (range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ Q.rep)) := by
      intro x hx
      have hxC : x ∈ C := subset_racl k _ hx
      have hCQ : C ≤ Q.1 := hC ▸ bot_le
      rw [Point.racl_repTuple Q]
      exact hCQ hxC
    have hle : racl k ((cb : Set K) ∪ range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ Q.rep)) ≤
        racl k (range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ Q.rep)) :=
      racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset hcbQ (subset_racl k _))
    have hRQ : R.rep ∈ Q.1.1 := by
      rw [← Point.racl_repTuple Q]
      exact hle (hcap ⟨0, rfl⟩)
    apply not_le_of_ne hQR
    rw [← R.point_rep]
    exact ClosedIF.point_le_iff.2 hRQ
  · rintro _ ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hPC : P.rep ∈ C := hC ▸ P.mem_rep
    exact hPC

name: AclGeom.quadIdx_triple
statement:
private theorem quadIdx_triple : ∀ i j l : Fin 6, i ≠ j → i ≠ l → j ≠ l → ¬ GCCollinear i j l →
    ({quadIdx i, quadIdx j, quadIdx l} : Finset (Fin 6)).card = 3 ∧
      ({quadIdx i, quadIdx j, quadIdx l} : Finset (Fin 6)) ∉ quadTriples
proof:
:= by
  decide

name: AclGeom.IsPartialQuadrangle.groupConfiguration
statement:
theorem IsPartialQuadrangle.groupConfiguration [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K]
    {f : Fin 6 → Point k K} (h : IsPartialQuadrangle f) :
    GroupConfiguration k (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ (f 0).rep) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ (f 1).rep)
      (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ (f 2).rep) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ (f 4).rep) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ (f 5).rep)
      (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ (f 3).rep)
proof:
:= by
  have hne : ∀ i j : Fin 6, i ≠ j → f i ≠ f j := fun i j hij ↦ h.injective.ne hij
  have l₁ := line_eq (hne 0 1 (by decide)) (hne 0 2 (by decide)) (hne 1 2 (by decide))
    h.rank_STU
  have l₂ := line_eq (hne 0 4 (by decide)) (hne 0 5 (by decide)) (hne 4 5 (by decide))
    h.rank_STU'
  have l₃ := line_eq (hne 1 3 (by decide)) (hne 1 5 (by decide)) (hne 3 5 (by decide))
    h.rank_S'TU'
  have l₄ := line_eq (hne 2 3 (by decide)) (hne 2 4 (by decide)) (hne 3 4 (by decide))
    h.rank_S'T'U
  have hsup : ∀ i j : Fin 6, racl k (range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ (f i).rep) ∪
      range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ (f j).rep)) = ((f i).1 ⊔ (f j).1).1 :=
    fun i j ↦ ClosedIF.racl_union_eq_sup (Point.racl_repTuple _) (Point.racl_repTuple _)
  have hg : ∀ m : Fin 6, gcPoints (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ (f 0).rep) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ (f 1).rep)
      (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ (f 2).rep) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ (f 4).rep) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ (f 5).rep)
      (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ (f 3).rep) m = range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ (f (quadIdx m)).rep) := by
    intro m
    fin_cases m <;> rfl
  refine
    { racl_ab_ac := by rw [hsup, hsup, l₁.1, l₁.2.1]
      racl_ab_bc := by rw [hsup, hsup, l₁.2.2, l₁.1]
      racl_ax_ay := by rw [hsup, hsup, l₂.1, l₂.2.1]
      racl_by_bz := by rw [hsup, hsup, l₃.2.1, l₃.1]
      racl_cx_cz := by rw [hsup, hsup, l₄.2.1, l₄.1]
      indep := ?_
      cb_a := subset_racl_canonicalBase_of_line (hne 4 5 (by decide))
        (by rw [l₂.1]; exact le_sup_right.trans le_sup_right)
      cb_b := subset_racl_canonicalBase_of_line (hne 5 3 (by decide))
        (by rw [l₃.2.1]; exact (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_right))
      cb_c := subset_racl_canonicalBase_of_line (hne 4 3 (by decide))
        (by rw [l₄.2.1]; exact (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_right))
      one_le_erk := by rw [erk_point] }
  intro i j l hij hil hjl hcol
  obtain ⟨hcard, hnot⟩ := quadIdx_triple i j l hij hil hjl hcol
  have hr := h.rank_free _ hcard hnot
  rw [hg, hg, hg]
  unfold IndepTriple
  rw [erk_point, erk_point, erk_point]
  have hracl : racl k (range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ (f (quadIdx i)).rep) ∪
      range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ (f (quadIdx j)).rep) ∪
      range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ (f (quadIdx l)).rep)) =
      (({quadIdx i, quadIdx j, quadIdx l} : Finset (Fin 6)).sup fun m ↦ (f m).1).1 := by
    rw [ClosedIF.racl_union_eq_sup
        (ClosedIF.racl_union_eq_sup (Point.racl_repTuple _) (Point.racl_repTuple _))
        (Point.racl_repTuple _),
      Finset.sup_insert, Finset.sup_insert, Finset.sup_singleton, sup_assoc]
  rw [ClosedIF.erk_eq_of_racl_eq hracl hr]
  norm_num

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.exists_rankOne_isMainConclusion
statement:
theorem QWitness.Psi.exists_rankOne_isMainConclusion [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K]
    [UniversalDomain k K] {w : QWitness k K} (hw : w.Psi) :
    ∃ S' T' U' : Point k K, IsPartialQuadrangle ![w.S, w.T, w.U, S', T', U'] ∧
      ∃ E : Set K, E.Finite ∧ erk k ∅ E = 5 ∧
        IndepOver k ∅ E (range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.S.rep) ∪ range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.T.rep) ∪
          range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.U.rep) ∪ range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ T'.rep) ∪
          range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ U'.rep) ∪ range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ S'.rep)) ∧
        IsMainConclusion k (racl k E) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.S.rep) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.T.rep)
          (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.U.rep) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ T'.rep) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ U'.rep)
          (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ S'.rep) ∧
        erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.S.rep)) = 1 ∧
        erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ T'.rep)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S', T', U', hq⟩ := hw.quad
  obtain ⟨E, hEfin, hErank, hEind, hmain⟩ :=
    hq.groupConfiguration.exists_main_with_parameterRank
  refine ⟨S', T', U', hq, E, hEfin, ?_, hEind, hmain, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hErank]
    change 5 * erk k ∅ (range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.S.rep)) = 5
    rw [erk_point]
    norm_num
  · have h1 : erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.S.rep)) =
        erk k ∅ (range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.S.rep)) := by
      rw [erk_base_empty, erk_racl_base]
      have := hEind.symm (fun _ h ↦ Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl h)))))
        (finite_range _)
      rwa [empty_union] at this
    rw [h1, erk_point]
  · have h1 : erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ T'.rep)) =
        erk k ∅ (range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ T'.rep)) := by
      rw [erk_base_empty, erk_racl_base]
      have := hEind.symm (fun _ h ↦ Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr h))) (finite_range _)
      rwa [empty_union] at this
    rw [h1, erk_point]

name: GroupConfig.erk_biUnion_le
statement:
theorem erk_biUnion_le (C : Set K) (X : α → Set K) (s : Finset α) :
    erk k C (⋃ i ∈ s, X i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, erk k C (X i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [erk_empty]
  | insert i s hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.set_biUnion_insert, Finset.sum_insert hi]
    exact (erk_union_le k C _ _).trans (add_le_add le_rfl ih)

name: GroupConfig.erk_biUnion_eq_sum
statement:
theorem erk_biUnion_eq_sum [Fintype α] (C : Set K) {X : α → Set K} (hX : ∀ i, (X i).Finite)
    (h : erk k C (⋃ i, X i) = ∑ i, erk k C (X i)) (s : Finset α) :
    erk k C (⋃ i ∈ s, X i) = ∑ i ∈ s, erk k C (X i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine le_antisymm (erk_biUnion_le k C X s) ?_
  have hsplit : (⋃ i, X i) = (⋃ i ∈ s, X i) ∪ ⋃ i ∈ sᶜ, X i := by
    rw [← Finset.set_biUnion_union, Finset.union_compl]
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ, iUnion_true]
  have hle : ∑ i ∈ s, erk k C (X i) + ∑ i ∈ sᶜ, erk k C (X i) ≤
      erk k C (⋃ i ∈ s, X i) + ∑ i ∈ sᶜ, erk k C (X i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_add_sum_compl, ← h, hsplit]
    exact (erk_union_le k C _ _).trans (add_le_add le_rfl (erk_biUnion_le k C X sᶜ))
  exact (ENat.add_le_add_iff_right (ENat.sum_ne_top.2 fun i _ ↦ erk_ne_top k (hX i) C)).1 hle

name: GroupConfig.indepOver_biUnion_of_erk_iUnion_eq_sum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs : (⋃ i ∈ s, X i).Finite :=
    (finite_iUnion hX).subset (iUnion₂_subset fun i _ ↦ subset_iUnion X i)
  have hadd := erk_biUnion_eq_sum k C hX h (insert i₀ s)
  rw [Finset.set_biUnion_insert, Finset.sum_insert hi₀, ← erk_biUnion_eq_sum k C hX h s,
    union_comm, add_comm] at hadd
  exact indepOver_of_erk_eq (hX i₀) (erk_base_union_eq_of_erk_union_eq k hs hadd)

name: GroupConfig.exists_algEquiv_of_erk_iUnion_eq
statement:
theorem exists_algEquiv_of_erk_iUnion_eq [IsAlgClosed k] [UniversalDomain k K]
    {a y y' : (i : α) → ι i → K} (hy : ∀ i, IsGen k (a i) (y i))
    (hy' : ∀ i, IsGen k (a i) (y' i))
    (hind : erk k ∅ (⋃ i, range (y i)) = ∑ i, erk k ∅ (range (a i)))
    (hind' : erk k ∅ (⋃ i, range (y' i)) = ∑ i, erk k ∅ (range (a i))) :
    ∃ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K, ∀ i j, σ (y i j) = y' i j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hblock (z : (i : α) → ι i → K) (hz : ∀ i, IsGen k (a i) (z i))
      (hzind : erk k ∅ (⋃ i, range (z i)) = ∑ i, erk k ∅ (range (a i))) {s : Finset α}
      {i₀ : α} (hi₀ : i₀ ∉ s) : IndepOver k ∅ (range (z i₀)) (⋃ i ∈ s, range (z i)) := by
    refine indepOver_biUnion_of_erk_iUnion_eq_sum (fun i ↦ finite_range (z i)) ?_ hi₀
    rw [hzind]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ (erk_empty_range_eq_of_idealOf_eq (hz i)).symm
  suffices h : ∀ s : Finset α, ∃ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K, ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j, σ (y i j) = y' i j by
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := h Finset.univ
    exact ⟨σ, fun i ↦ hσ i (Finset.mem_univ i)⟩
  intro s
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact ⟨AlgEquiv.refl, fun i hi ↦ absurd hi (Finset.notMem_empty i)⟩
  | insert i₀ s hi₀ ih =>
    obtain ⟨σ₁, hσ₁⟩ := ih
    have hB : IsSmall k (⋃ i ∈ s, range (y' i)) :=
      IsSmall.of_finite ((finite_iUnion fun i ↦ finite_range (y' i)).subset
        (iUnion₂_subset fun i _ ↦ subset_iUnion (fun i ↦ range (y' i)) i))
    have hσB : (⋃ i ∈ s, ⇑σ₁ '' range (y i)) = ⋃ i ∈ s, range (y' i) :=
      iUnion₂_congr fun i hi ↦ by
        rw [← range_comp]
        exact congrArg range (funext (hσ₁ i hi))
    
    have h₁ : IndepOver k ∅ (range (⇑σ₁ ∘ y i₀)) (⋃ i ∈ s, range (y' i)) := by
      have h := (hblock y hy hind hi₀).image σ₁
      rwa [image_empty, ← range_comp, image_iUnion₂, hσB] at h
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := (((hy i₀).map σ₁).isGenericOver_racl hB h₁).exists_algEquiv
      ((hy' i₀).isGenericOver_racl hB (hblock y' hy' hind' hi₀))
    refine ⟨σ₁.trans (τ.restrictScalars k), fun i hi j ↦ ?_⟩
    change τ (σ₁ (y i j)) = y' i j
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hi with rfl | hi
    · exact hτ j
    · rw [hσ₁ i hi j]
      exact τ.commutes ⟨y' i j, subset_racl k _ (mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨i, hi, mem_range_self j⟩)⟩

name: GroupConfig.exists_algEquiv_of_erk_iUnion_eq_of_isGenericOver
statement:
theorem exists_algEquiv_of_erk_iUnion_eq_of_isGenericOver [UniversalDomain k K]
    {M : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed ↥M] (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K))
    {a y y' : (i : α) → ι i → K} (hy : ∀ i, IsGenericOver M (a i) (y i))
    (hy' : ∀ i, IsGenericOver M (a i) (y' i))
    (hind : erk k (M : Set K) (⋃ i, range (y i)) = ∑ i, erk k ∅ (range (a i)))
    (hind' : erk k (M : Set K) (⋃ i, range (y' i)) = ∑ i, erk k ∅ (range (a i))) :
    ∃ σ : K ≃ₐ[↥M] K, ∀ i j, σ (y i j) = y' i j
proof:
:= by
  have := universalDomain_of_isSmall M hM
  
  have hbase (X : Set K) : erk (↥M) ∅ X = erk k (M : Set K) X := by
    rw [erk_empty_eq (↥M), ← erk_coe_eq k M]
  have hrk (i : α) : erk (↥M) ∅ (range (y i)) = erk k ∅ (range (a i)) := by
    rw [hbase, (hy i).erk_coe_eq, (hy i).erk_empty_eq]
  refine exists_algEquiv_of_erk_iUnion_eq (k := ↥M) (a := y) (fun i ↦ rfl)
    (fun i ↦ (hy' i).trans (hy i).symm) ?_ ?_
  · rw [hbase, hind]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ (hrk i).symm
  · rw [hbase, hind']
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ (hrk i).symm

name: GroupConfig.rkMatroid_image
statement:
theorem rkMatroid_image (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (C : Set K) :
    rkMatroid k (σ '' C) = (rkMatroid k C).map σ σ.injective.injOn
proof:
:= by
  refine Matroid.ext_closure fun X ↦ ?_
  rw [map_closure_eq, rkMatroid_closure_eq, rkMatroid_closure_eq]
  calc (racl k (σ '' C ∪ X) : Set K) = racl k (σ '' (C ∪ σ ⁻¹' X)) := by
        rw [image_union, image_preimage_eq X σ.surjective]
    _ = ((racl k (C ∪ σ ⁻¹' X)).map σ.toAlgHom : Set K) := by rw [racl_map]
    _ = σ '' (racl k (C ∪ σ ⁻¹' X) : Set K) := by
        rw [IntermediateField.coe_map]
        rfl

name: GroupConfig.erk_image
statement:
theorem erk_image (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (C X : Set K) :
    erk k (σ '' C) (σ '' X) = erk k C X
proof:
:= by
  unfold erk
  rw [rkMatroid_image]
  exact eRk_map _ _ (subset_univ X)

name: GroupConfig.IndepOver.image
statement:
theorem IndepOver.image (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) {C A B : Set K} (h : IndepOver k C A B) :
    IndepOver k (σ '' C) (σ '' A) (σ '' B)
proof:
:= by
  intro a' ha' hfin'
  have ha : σ ⁻¹' a' ⊆ A := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := ha' hy
    rwa [← σ.injective hzy]
  have hfin : (σ ⁻¹' a').Finite := hfin'.preimage σ.injective.injOn
  have hrepr : a' = σ '' (σ ⁻¹' a') := (image_preimage_eq a' σ.surjective).symm
  rw [hrepr, ← image_union, erk_image, erk_image]
  exact h ha hfin

name: GroupConfig.indepOver_image_iff
statement:
theorem indepOver_image_iff (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) {C A B : Set K} :
    IndepOver k (σ '' C) (σ '' A) (σ '' B) ↔ IndepOver k C A B
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, IndepOver.image σ⟩
  have h' := h.image σ.symm
  simpa [image_image] using h'

name: GroupConfig.coordPoly_rename
statement:
theorem coordPoly_rename (l : K →ₗ[R] R) {f : ι → κ} (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (p : MvPolynomial ι K) : coordPoly l (rename f p) = rename f (coordPoly l p)
proof:
:= by
  refine MvPolynomial.ext _ _ fun d ↦ ?_
  rw [coeff_coordPoly]
  by_cases hd : ∃ u : ι →₀ ℕ, u.mapDomain f = d
  · obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hd
    rw [coeff_rename_mapDomain _ hf, coeff_rename_mapDomain _ hf, coeff_coordPoly]
  · push Not at hd
    have h1 : (rename f p).coeff d = 0 := by
      by_contra h
      obtain ⟨u, hu, -⟩ := coeff_rename_ne_zero _ _ _ h
      exact hd u hu
    have h2 : (rename f (coordPoly l p)).coeff d = 0 := by
      by_contra h
      obtain ⟨u, hu, -⟩ := coeff_rename_ne_zero _ _ _ h
      exact hd u hu
    rw [h1, h2, map_zero]

name: GroupConfig.comap_rename_map_eq
statement:
theorem comap_rename_map_eq {ι₁ ι₂ : Type*} {f : ι₁ → ι₂} (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (J : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι₂ M)) :
    (J.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap M K))).comap
        (rename f : MvPolynomial ι₁ K →ₐ[K] MvPolynomial ι₂ K) =
      (J.comap (rename f : MvPolynomial ι₁ M →ₐ[M] MvPolynomial ι₂ M)).map
        (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap M K))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · intro g hg
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap] at hg
    
    let b := Basis.ofVectorSpace M K
    rw [← sum_smul_map_coordPoly b g]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j _ ↦ Submodule.smul_of_tower_mem _ (b j) ?_
    refine Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ?_
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, ← coordPoly_rename _ hf]
    exact coordPoly_mem_of_mem_map _ hg
  · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro g hg
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap] at hg
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_comap, ← map_rename]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hg

name: GroupConfig.racl_union_union_eq_of_subset
statement:
theorem racl_union_union_eq_of_subset {A B C : Set K} (h : C ⊆ racl k (A ∪ B)) :
    racl k (A ∪ (B ∪ C)) = racl k (A ∪ B)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset ?_ (union_subset ?_ h)))
    (racl_mono (k := k) (union_subset_union_right _ subset_union_left))
  · exact subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
  · exact subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.exists_defStep_fresh_with_parameterRank
statement:
theorem exists_defStep_fresh_with_parameterRank {W : Set K} (hW : W.Finite) :
    ∃ (e : ι₁ → K) (p₂' : ι₃ → K) (q₂' : ι₄ → K),
      erk k ∅ (range e) = erk k ∅ (range a) ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ (range e)
        (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z ∪ W) ∧
      range p₂' ⊆ racl k (range e ∪ range b) ∧ range q₂' ⊆ racl k (range e ∪ range y) ∧
      conjCode (adjoin k (range b ∪ range y ∪ range p₂' ∪ range q₂')) z ⊆
        dcl (adjoin k (range b ∪ range y ∪ range p₂' ∪ range q₂')) ∧
      racl k (conjCode (adjoin k (range b ∪ range y ∪ range p₂' ∪ range q₂')) z) =
        racl k (range z) ∧
      racl k (range e ∪ (range b ∪ range p₂')) = racl k (range e ∪ range b) ∧
      racl k (range e ∪ (range y ∪ range q₂')) = racl k (range e ∪ range y) ∧
      GroupConfiguration (↥(racl k (range e))) a (Sum.elim b p₂') c x (Sum.elim y q₂')
        (tupleOf (conjCode (adjoin k (range b ∪ range y ∪ range p₂' ∪ range q₂')) z)) ∧
      (∀ s : conjCode (adjoin k (range b ∪ range y ∪ range p₂' ∪ range q₂')) z,
        (s : K) ∈ dclAdjoin (racl k (range e))
          (Sum.elim (Sum.elim b p₂') (Sum.elim y q₂'))) ∧
      ((∀ i, y i ∈ dclAdjoin (adjoin k (range b)) z) →
        (∀ i, x i ∈ dclAdjoin (adjoin k (range c)) z) →
        ∀ j, Sum.elim y q₂' j ∈
          dclAdjoin (adjoin k ((racl k (range e) : Set K) ∪ (range b ∪ range p₂')))
            (tupleOf (conjCode (adjoin k (range b ∪ range y ∪ range p₂' ∪ range q₂')) z)))
proof:
:= by
  
  have hall : (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z).Finite :=
    (((((finite_range a).union (finite_range b)).union (finite_range c)).union
      (finite_range x)).union (finite_range y)).union (finite_range z)
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_isGenericOver (IsSmall.of_finite (k := k) (hall.union hW)).racl a
  have he_indW : IndepOver k ∅ (range e)
      (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z ∪ W) :=
    he.indepOver.mono_right (subset_racl k _)
  have he_ind :
      IndepOver k ∅ (range e) (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z) :=
    he_indW.mono_right subset_union_left
  
  have hbyz : (range b ∪ range y ∪ range z).Finite :=
    ((finite_range b).union (finite_range y)).union (finite_range z)
  have hbyz_sub : range b ∪ range y ∪ range z ⊆
      range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z :=
    union_subset (union_subset
      (subset_union_right.trans (subset_union_left.trans (subset_union_left.trans
        (subset_union_left.trans subset_union_left))))
      (subset_union_right.trans subset_union_left)) subset_union_right
  have haN : IsGenericOver (racl k (range b ∪ range y ∪ range z)) a a := by
    refine isGenericOver_self_of_indepOver (IsSmall.of_finite (k := k) hbyz).racl ?_
    have := indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hc.indepOver_a_byz
    rwa [empty_union] at this
  have heN : IsGenericOver (racl k (range b ∪ range y ∪ range z)) a e :=
    he.of_le (racl_mono (k := k) (hbyz_sub.trans subset_union_left))
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := haN.exists_algEquiv heN
  have hfix : ∀ s ∈ range b ∪ range y ∪ range z, (σ.restrictScalars k) s = s := fun s hs ↦ by
    change σ s = s
    exact σ.commutes ⟨s, subset_racl k _ hs⟩
  have hσa : ⇑(σ.restrictScalars k) ∘ a = e := funext fun i ↦ hσ i
  have hσb : ⇑(σ.restrictScalars k) ∘ b = b := funext fun i ↦
    hfix _ (subset_union_left (subset_union_left (mem_range_self i)))
  have hσy : ⇑(σ.restrictScalars k) ∘ y = y := funext fun i ↦
    hfix _ (subset_union_left (subset_union_right (mem_range_self i)))
  have hσz : ⇑(σ.restrictScalars k) ∘ z = z := funext fun i ↦
    hfix _ (subset_union_right (mem_range_self i))
  
  obtain ⟨p₂', hp⟩ : ∃ p : ι₃ → K, p = ⇑(σ.restrictScalars k) ∘ c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨q₂', hq⟩ : ∃ q : ι₄ → K, q = ⇑(σ.restrictScalars k) ∘ x := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hσc := hc.map (σ.restrictScalars k)
  rw [hσa, hσb, hσy, hσz, ← hp, ← hq] at hσc
  have hp₂' : range p₂' ⊆ racl k (range e ∪ range b) := by
    rw [hσc.racl_ab_ac]
    exact subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hq₂' : range q₂' ⊆ racl k (range e ∪ range y) := by
    rw [← hσc.racl_ax_ay]
    exact subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hzdcl := hσc.conjCode_z_subset_dcl
  have hzracl := hσc.racl_conjCode_z
  
  have hK₁s : IsSmall k ((racl k (range e) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range e)).racl
  have hK₁ind : IndepOver k ∅ ((racl k (range e) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K)
      (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z) := by
    have := indepOver_racl_left_iff.2 he_ind
    rwa [empty_union] at this
  have hc₁ := hc.baseChange _ hK₁s hK₁ind
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (range e)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have _ : UniversalDomain ↥(racl k (range e)) K := universalDomain_of_isSmall _ hK₁s
  have he_sub : range e ⊆ ((racl k (range e) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    subset_racl k _
  have hb₁ : racl k (((racl k (range e) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) ∪
      (range b ∪ range p₂')) = racl k (((racl k (range e) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) ∪
      range b) :=
    racl_union_union_eq_of_subset
      (hp₂'.trans (racl_mono (k := k) (union_subset_union_left _ he_sub)))
  have hy₁ : racl k (((racl k (range e) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) ∪
      (range y ∪ range q₂')) = racl k (((racl k (range e) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) ∪
      range y) :=
    racl_union_union_eq_of_subset
      (hq₂'.trans (racl_mono (k := k) (union_subset_union_left _ he_sub)))
  refine ⟨e, p₂', q₂', he.erk_empty_eq, he_indW, hp₂', hq₂', hzdcl, hzracl,
    racl_union_union_eq_of_subset hp₂', racl_union_union_eq_of_subset hq₂', ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    refine hc₁.ofRaclEq rfl ?_ rfl rfl ?_ ?_
    · refine SetLike.coe_injective ?_
      rw [racl_base_coe, racl_base_coe, Sum.elim_range, hb₁]
    · refine SetLike.coe_injective ?_
      rw [racl_base_coe, racl_base_coe, Sum.elim_range, hy₁]
    · refine SetLike.coe_injective ?_
      rw [racl_base_coe, racl_base_coe, range_tupleOf, racl_union_congr rfl hzracl]
  · 
    intro s
    unfold dclAdjoin
    rw [restrictScalars_adjoin]
    refine dcl_mono ?_ (hzdcl s.2)
    refine adjoin_le_iff.2 (subset_trans ?_ (subset_adjoin k _))
    rw [Sum.elim_range, Sum.elim_range, Sum.elim_range]
    refine (union_subset (union_subset (union_subset ?_ ?_) ?_) ?_).trans subset_union_right
    · exact subset_union_left.trans subset_union_left
    · exact subset_union_left.trans subset_union_right
    · exact subset_union_right.trans subset_union_left
    · exact subset_union_right.trans subset_union_right
  · 
    intro hq₁ hq₂ j
    have hL₀L : adjoin k (range b ∪ range p₂') ≤
        adjoin k (range b ∪ range y ∪ range p₂' ∪ range q₂') :=
      adjoin.mono k _ _ (union_subset
        (subset_union_left.trans (subset_union_left.trans subset_union_left))
        (subset_union_right.trans subset_union_left))
    have hw : ∀ j, Sum.elim y q₂' j ∈ dclAdjoin (adjoin k (range b ∪ range p₂')) z := by
      intro j
      cases j with
      | inl i =>
        exact dclAdjoin_mono (adjoin.mono k _ _ subset_union_left) z (hq₁ i)
      | inr i =>
        have := mem_dclAdjoin_map (σ.restrictScalars k) (hq₂ i)
        rw [adjoin_map, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, ← range_comp, hσz, ← hp] at this
        change q₂' i ∈ _
        rw [hq]
        exact dclAdjoin_mono (adjoin.mono k _ _ subset_union_right) z this
    have hwL : ∀ j, Sum.elim y q₂' j ∈ adjoin k (range b ∪ range y ∪ range p₂' ∪ range q₂') := by
      intro j
      cases j with
      | inl i =>
        exact subset_adjoin k _
          (subset_union_left (subset_union_left (subset_union_right (mem_range_self i))))
      | inr i => exact subset_adjoin k _ (subset_union_right (mem_range_self i))
    have key := mem_dclAdjoin_conjCode hσc.isIntegral_z hL₀L hw hwL j
    exact dclAdjoin_mono (adjoin.mono k _ _ subset_union_right) _ key

statement:
theorem exists_defStep_base_fresh_with_parameterRank (K₀ : IntermediateField k K)
    [IsAlgClosed (↥K₀)] [UniversalDomain (↥K₀) K] (hc : GroupConfiguration (↥K₀) a b c x y z)
    {W : Set K} (hW : W.Finite) :
    ∃ (e : ι₁ → K) (p₂' : ι₃ → K) (q₂' : ι₄ → K) (Z : Set K) (_ : Finite ↥Z),
      erk k (K₀ : Set K) (range e) = erk k (K₀ : Set K) (range a) ∧
      IndepOver k (K₀ : Set K) (range e)
        (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z ∪ W) ∧
      range p₂' ⊆ racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e ∪ range b) ∧
      range q₂' ⊆ racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e ∪ range y) ∧
      racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ Z) = racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range z) ∧
      racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e ∪ (range b ∪ range p₂')) =
        racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e ∪ range b) ∧
      racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e ∪ (range y ∪ range q₂')) =
        racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e ∪ range y) ∧
      GroupConfiguration (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e))) a (Sum.elim b p₂') c x
        (Sum.elim y q₂') (tupleOf Z) ∧
      (∀ s ∈ Z, s ∈ dclAdjoin (racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e))
        (Sum.elim (Sum.elim b p₂') (Sum.elim y q₂'))) ∧
      ((∀ i, y i ∈ dclAdjoin (adjoin k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b)) z) →
        (∀ i, x i ∈ dclAdjoin (adjoin k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range c)) z) →
        ∀ j, Sum.elim y q₂' j ∈
          dclAdjoin
            (adjoin k ((racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e) : Set K) ∪ (range b ∪ range p₂')))
            (tupleOf Z))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, p₂', q₂', hrank, he, hp, hq, -, hZ, hbp, hyq, hc', hdcl, himp⟩ :=
    hc.exists_defStep_fresh_with_parameterRank hW
  have hK₀ : (K₀ : Set K) ⊆ racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e) :=
    subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
  refine ⟨e, p₂', q₂', conjCode (adjoin (↥K₀) (range b ∪ range y ∪ range p₂' ∪ range q₂')) z,
    inferInstance, (by simpa only [erk_base_empty] using hrank),
    (indepOver_base_iff K₀ _ _).1 he, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_,
    ofNested K₀ (range e) hc', ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [union_assoc, ← racl_base_coe K₀ (range e ∪ range b)]
    exact hp
  · rw [union_assoc, ← racl_base_coe K₀ (range e ∪ range y)]
    exact hq
  · exact SetLike.coe_injective (by rw [← racl_base_coe K₀, ← racl_base_coe K₀, hZ])
  · exact SetLike.coe_injective (by
      rw [union_assoc, union_assoc, ← racl_base_coe K₀ (range e ∪ (range b ∪ range p₂')),
        ← racl_base_coe K₀ (range e ∪ range b), hbp])
  · exact SetLike.coe_injective (by
      rw [union_assoc, union_assoc, ← racl_base_coe K₀ (range e ∪ (range y ∪ range q₂')),
        ← racl_base_coe K₀ (range e ∪ range y), hyq])
  · exact fun s hs ↦ (mem_dclAdjoin_congr (racl_base_coe K₀ (range e)) _ s).1 (hdcl ⟨s, hs⟩)
  · intro hy hx j
    have hy' : ∀ i, y i ∈ dclAdjoin (adjoin (↥K₀) (range b)) z := fun i ↦
      (mem_dclAdjoin_congr (coe_adjoin_base K₀ (range b)) z _).2 (hy i)
    have hx' : ∀ i, x i ∈ dclAdjoin (adjoin (↥K₀) (range c)) z := fun i ↦
      (mem_dclAdjoin_congr (coe_adjoin_base K₀ (range c)) z _).2 (hx i)
    refine (mem_dclAdjoin_congr ?_ _ _).1 (himp hy' hx' j)
    rw [coe_adjoin_base K₀, racl_base_coe K₀ (range e), ← union_assoc, union_eq_right.2 hK₀]

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.exists_defStep_base_with_parameterRank
statement:
theorem exists_defStep_base_with_parameterRank (K₀ : IntermediateField k K) [IsAlgClosed (↥K₀)]
    [UniversalDomain (↥K₀) K] (hc : GroupConfiguration (↥K₀) a b c x y z) :
    ∃ (e : ι₁ → K) (p₂' : ι₃ → K) (q₂' : ι₄ → K) (Z : Set K) (_ : Finite ↥Z),
      erk k (K₀ : Set K) (range e) = erk k (K₀ : Set K) (range a) ∧
      IndepOver k (K₀ : Set K) (range e)
        (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z) ∧
      range p₂' ⊆ racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e ∪ range b) ∧
      range q₂' ⊆ racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e ∪ range y) ∧
      racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ Z) = racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range z) ∧
      racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e ∪ (range b ∪ range p₂')) =
        racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e ∪ range b) ∧
      racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e ∪ (range y ∪ range q₂')) =
        racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e ∪ range y) ∧
      GroupConfiguration (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e))) a (Sum.elim b p₂') c x
        (Sum.elim y q₂') (tupleOf Z) ∧
      (∀ s ∈ Z, s ∈ dclAdjoin (racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e))
        (Sum.elim (Sum.elim b p₂') (Sum.elim y q₂'))) ∧
      ((∀ i, y i ∈ dclAdjoin (adjoin k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b)) z) →
        (∀ i, x i ∈ dclAdjoin (adjoin k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range c)) z) →
        ∀ j, Sum.elim y q₂' j ∈
          dclAdjoin
            (adjoin k ((racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e) : Set K) ∪ (range b ∪ range p₂')))
            (tupleOf Z))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, p₂', q₂', Z, hZ, hrank, he, h⟩ :=
    exists_defStep_base_fresh_with_parameterRank K₀ hc finite_empty
  rw [union_empty] at he
  exact ⟨e, p₂', q₂', Z, hZ, hrank, he, h⟩

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.exists_defStep_base
statement:
theorem exists_defStep_base (K₀ : IntermediateField k K) [IsAlgClosed (↥K₀)]
    [UniversalDomain (↥K₀) K] (hc : GroupConfiguration (↥K₀) a b c x y z) :
    ∃ (e : ι₁ → K) (p₂' : ι₃ → K) (q₂' : ι₄ → K) (Z : Set K) (_ : Finite ↥Z),
      IndepOver k (K₀ : Set K) (range e)
        (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z) ∧
      range p₂' ⊆ racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e ∪ range b) ∧
      range q₂' ⊆ racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e ∪ range y) ∧
      racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ Z) = racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range z) ∧
      racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e ∪ (range b ∪ range p₂')) =
        racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e ∪ range b) ∧
      racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e ∪ (range y ∪ range q₂')) =
        racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e ∪ range y) ∧
      GroupConfiguration (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e))) a (Sum.elim b p₂') c x
        (Sum.elim y q₂') (tupleOf Z) ∧
      (∀ s ∈ Z, s ∈ dclAdjoin (racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e))
        (Sum.elim (Sum.elim b p₂') (Sum.elim y q₂'))) ∧
      ((∀ i, y i ∈ dclAdjoin (adjoin k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b)) z) →
        (∀ i, x i ∈ dclAdjoin (adjoin k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range c)) z) →
        ∀ j, Sum.elim y q₂' j ∈
          dclAdjoin
            (adjoin k ((racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range e) : Set K) ∪ (range b ∪ range p₂')))
            (tupleOf Z))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, p₂', q₂', Z, hZ, -, h⟩ := exists_defStep_base_with_parameterRank K₀ hc
  exact ⟨e, p₂', q₂', Z, hZ, h⟩

name: GroupConfig.range_subset_racl_canonicalBase
statement:
theorem range_subset_racl_canonicalBase [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K]
    [Finite ι] [Finite κ] (M : IntermediateField k K) [IsAlgClosed (↥M)]
    (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K)) (a : ι → K) (b : κ → K)
    (hb : range b ⊆ racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ range a)) :
    range b ⊆ racl k ((canonicalBase M (Sum.elim a b) : Set K) ∪ range a)
proof:
:= by
  let C := canonicalBase M (Sum.elim a b)
  have hrange := Sum.elim_range a b
  have htotal : erk k (C : Set K) (range a ∪ range b) =
      erk k (M : Set K) (range a) := by
    rw [← hrange, erk_canonicalBase_eq M hM, hrange]
    exact erk_union_eq_of_subset_racl k hb
  have hlow : erk k (M : Set K) (range a) ≤ erk k (C : Set K) (range a) :=
    erk_base_mono k (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 (canonicalBase_le M (Sum.elim a b))) _
  have hsum : erk k (C : Set K) (range a) +
      erk k ((C : Set K) ∪ range a) (range b) ≤ erk k (C : Set K) (range a) + 0 := by
    rw [← erk_union_eq, add_zero]
    exact htotal.le.trans hlow
  have hz := (ENat.add_le_add_iff_left (erk_ne_top k (finite_range a) (C : Set K))).1 hsum
  exact (erk_eq_zero_iff k).1 (bot_unique hz)

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.exists_main_constructible
statement:
theorem exists_main_constructible (hc : GroupConfiguration k a b c x y z) :
    ∃ E : Set K, E.Finite ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ E (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z) ∧
      ∃ (_ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k E)) (_ : UniversalDomain (↥(racl k E)) K) (ν ν' : Type u)
        (_ : Fintype ν) (_ : Finite ν') (v : ν → K) (v' : ν' → K)
        (f₀ : Germ (↥(racl k E)) v v') (ga gb gc : Germ (↥(racl k E)) v v) (y' : ν → K)
        (hb : f₀.IsHWBij) (hga : ga ∈ f₀.diffSet)
        (_ : Fintype (CodeIndex (ν ⊕ ν') (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal))),
        gb ∈ f₀.diffSet ∧ gc ∈ f₀.diffSet ∧ gb = gc * ga ∧
        IsGen (↥(racl k E)) v y' ∧
        IndepTriple (↥(racl k E)) (ga.cb : Set K) (gb.cb : Set K) (range y') ∧
        gc.evalGen (ga.evalGen y') = gb.evalGen y' ∧
        GroupConfiguration (↥(racl k E)) ga.codeTuple gb.codeTuple gc.codeTuple (ga.evalGen y')
          y' (gb.evalGen y') ∧
        racl (↥(racl k E)) (range a) = racl (↥(racl k E)) (range ga.codeTuple) ∧
        racl (↥(racl k E)) (range b) = racl (↥(racl k E)) (range gb.codeTuple) ∧
        racl (↥(racl k E)) (range c) = racl (↥(racl k E)) (range gc.codeTuple) ∧
        racl (↥(racl k E)) (range x) = racl (↥(racl k E)) (range (ga.evalGen y')) ∧
        racl (↥(racl k E)) (range y) = racl (↥(racl k E)) (range y') ∧
        racl (↥(racl k E)) (range z) = racl (↥(racl k E)) (range (gb.evalGen y')) ∧
        erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range v) = erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range x) ∧
        erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range v') = erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range x) ∧
        erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (f₀.cb : Set K) = erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range a) ∧
        ∀ y₀ : ν → K, IsGenericOver (racl (↥(racl k E))
            (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z)) v y₀ →
          ∃ (F : QuasiRational (↥(racl k E)) (CodeIndex (ν ⊕ ν') (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal) ⊕ ν) ν')
            (hF : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[↥(racl k E)] K, ∃ hu : F.IsAdmissible v v' (⇑σ ∘ f₀.code),
              F.parameterGerm hu = f₀.map σ)
            (hdim : erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range v) = erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range v'))
            (S₀ : Set K)
            (t₁ : Fin (2 * (6 * Fintype.card (CodeIndex (ν ⊕ ν') (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal)) +
              Fintype.card ν) + 1) → CodeIndex (ν ⊕ ν') (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal) → K),
            IndepOver k ∅ (E ∪ (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)))
              (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z) ∧
            (∀ γ ∈ IsHW.prodSet ga, erk (↥(racl k E)) (racl (↥(racl k E))
              ((adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) :
                IntermediateField (↥(racl k E)) K) : Set K) : Set K) (γ.cb : Set K) ≤
                erk k ∅ (range a)) ∧
            (∀ γ ∈ IsHW.prodSet ga, erk (↥(racl k E)) (racl (↥(racl k E))
              ((adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) :
                IntermediateField (↥(racl k E)) K) : Set K) : Set K) (γ.cb : Set K) =
                erk k ∅ (range a) ↔
              γ ∈ orbit ga ∧ IndepOver (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (γ.cb : Set K) (racl (↥(racl k E))
                ((adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) :
                  IntermediateField (↥(racl k E)) K) : Set K) : Set K)) ∧
            (∀ γ ∈ IsHW.prodSet ga, ∃ γ₁ ∈ IsHW.prodSet ga, ∃ γ₂ ∈ IsHW.prodSet ga, γ = γ₁ * γ₂ ∧
              erk (↥(racl k E)) (racl (↥(racl k E))
                ((adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) :
                  IntermediateField (↥(racl k E)) K) : Set K) : Set K) (γ₁.cb : Set K) =
                erk k ∅ (range a) ∧
              erk (↥(racl k E)) (racl (↥(racl k E))
                ((adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) :
                  IntermediateField (↥(racl k E)) K) : Set K) : Set K) (γ₂.cb : Set K) =
                erk k ∅ (range a)) ∧
            (∀ γ ∈ IsHW.prodSet ga, ∀ γ' ∈ IsHW.prodSet ga,
              erk (↥(racl k E)) (racl (↥(racl k E))
                ((adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) :
                  IntermediateField (↥(racl k E)) K) : Set K) : Set K) (γ.cb : Set K) =
                erk k ∅ (range a) →
              erk (↥(racl k E)) (racl (↥(racl k E))
                ((adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) :
                  IntermediateField (↥(racl k E)) K) : Set K) : Set K) (γ'.cb : Set K) =
                erk k ∅ (range a) →
              ∃ σ : K ≃ₐ[↥(racl (↥(racl k E))
                ((adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) :
                  IntermediateField (↥(racl k E)) K) : Set K))] K,
                γ.map (σ.restrictScalars (↥(racl k E))) = γ') ∧
            S₀.Finite ∧
            IndepOver (↥(racl k E)) ∅ S₀ (racl (↥(racl k E)) (range a ∪ range b ∪
              range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z ∪ range y₀) :
                Set K) ∧
            (∃ T : List (Σ τ : Type u, (τ → K) × (τ → K)),
              (∀ p ∈ T, ((⟨p.1, p.2.1⟩ : Σ τ : Type u, τ → K) = ⟨ν, v⟩ ∨
                  (⟨p.1, p.2.1⟩ : Σ τ : Type u, τ → K) = ⟨ν', v'⟩) ∧
                IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField (↥(racl k E)) K) p.2.1 p.2.2) ∧
              S₀ = (⋃ p ∈ T, range p.2.2) ∧
              erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ S₀ = (T.map fun p ↦ erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range p.2.2)).sum) ∧
            HasGenericSamples (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) S₀) v
              (8 * Fintype.card (CodeIndex (ν ⊕ ν') (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal))) ∧
            HasGenericSamples (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) S₀) v'
              (Fintype.card (CodeIndex (ν ⊕ ν') (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal))) ∧
            (∀ i, IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField (↥(racl k E)) K) f₀.code (t₁ i)) ∧
            (∀ i, IsGenericOver (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) S₀) f₀.code (t₁ i)) ∧
            erk (↥(racl k E)) (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) S₀ : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) =
              ∑ i, erk (↥(racl k E)) (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) S₀ : Set K) (range (t₁ i)) ∧
            IndepOver (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) (racl (↥(racl k E))
              (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪
                range y ∪ range z ∪ range y₀) : Set K) ∧
            erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) =
              erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ S₀ + ∑ i, erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range (t₁ i)) ∧
            ∃ hL : IsSmall (↥(racl k E)) ((adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) :
                IntermediateField (↥(racl k E)) K) : Set K),
              ConstructibleGroupPresentation (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)))
                (F.pairDomain (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) f₀.code v v')
                (F.pairDomainMap (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) hL hb hga
                  f₀.adjoin_range_code hF hdim) ∧
              ∀ (y₁ : ν → K) (hy₁ : IsGen (↥(racl k E)) v y₁),
                IsConstructibleOver
                  (↥(adjoin (↥(racl k E)) ((S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) ∪ range y₁)))
                  {d | ∃ hd : d ∈ F.pairDomain (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)))
                      f₀.code v v',
                    F.pairDomainMap (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) hL hb hga
                        f₀.adjoin_range_code hF hdim ⟨d, hd⟩ • (hb.isHW hga).iota hy₁ =
                      (hb.isHW hga).iota hy₁} ∧
                ConstructibleGSetPresentation
                  (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) ((S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) ∪ range y₁))
                  (F.pairDomain (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) f₀.code v v')
                  (F.pairDomainMap (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) hL hb hga
                    f₀.adjoin_range_code hF hdim)
                  (F.pairDomain (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) f₀.code v v')
                  (F.pairDomainSpaceMap (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) hL hb
                    hga f₀.adjoin_range_code hF hdim hy₁)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, hEfin, hEind, hmain⟩ := hc.exists_main
  unfold IsMainConclusion at hmain
  obtain ⟨hacl, hud, ν, ν', _, _, v, v', f₀, ga, gb, gc, y', hb, hga, hgb, hgc, hmul, hy', hind,
    heval, hconf, r₁, r₂, r₃, r₄, r₅, r₆, hv, hv', hcb⟩ := hmain
  let : Fintype ν := Fintype.ofFinite ν
  let : Fintype (CodeIndex (ν ⊕ ν') (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal)) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hPfin : (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z).Finite :=
    (((((finite_range _).union (finite_range _)).union (finite_range _)).union
      (finite_range _)).union (finite_range _)).union (finite_range _)
  
  have hra : erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a) := by
    rw [erk_base_empty, erk_racl_base]
    have := hEind.symm (fun _ h ↦ Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl h))))) (finite_range a)
    rwa [empty_union] at this
  have hn : erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (ga.cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (range a) :=
    (hb.rank ga hga).trans (hcb.trans hra)
  refine ⟨E, hEfin, hEind, hacl, hud, ν, ν', inferInstance, inferInstance, v, v', f₀, ga, gb, gc,
    y', hb, hga, inferInstance, hgb, hgc, hmul, hy', hind, heval, hconf, r₁, r₂, r₃, r₄, r₅, r₆,
    hv, hv', hcb, fun y₀ _ ↦ ?_⟩
  
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hdim, S₀, t₁, hS₀, hS₀ind, hT, hs, hs', ht₁, ht₁', htrk, hfresh, hrk, hL,
    hpres⟩ := hb.exists_fresh_canonicalGroupSpacePresentation hga _
      (IsSmall.of_finite (k := ↥(racl k E)) (hPfin.union (finite_range y₀))).racl
  have hM := hL.racl
  refine ⟨F, hF, hdim, S₀, t₁, ?_, fun γ hγ ↦ ?_, fun γ hγ ↦ ?_, fun γ hγ ↦ ?_,
    fun γ hγ γ' hγ' hr hr' ↦ ?_, hS₀, hS₀ind, hT, hs, hs', ht₁, ht₁', htrk, hfresh, hrk, hL,
    hpres⟩
  · 
    have h₁ : IndepOver (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))
        (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z) :=
      hfresh.mono_right (subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl (↥(racl k E)) _))
    have h₂ := (indepOver_racl_base_iff E _ _).1 ((indepOver_base_iff (racl k E) _ _).1 h₁)
    exact (indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨hEind.symm, by rw [empty_union]; exact h₂.symm⟩).symm
  · rw [← hn]
    exact (hb.isHW hga).erk_base_cb_le _ hγ
  · rw [← hn]
    exact (hb.isHW hga).erk_base_cb_eq_iff hγ
  · rw [← hn]
    exact (hb.isHW hga).exists_mul_eq_of_mem_prodSet hM hγ
  · exact (hb.isHW hga).exists_algEquiv_of_erk_base_eq hM hγ hγ' (hr.trans hn.symm)
      (hr'.trans hn.symm)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.exists_joint_isMainConclusion
statement:
theorem QWitness.Psi.exists_joint_isMainConclusion [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K]
    [UniversalDomain k K] {w : QWitness k K} (hw : w.Psi) {W : Set K} (hW : W.Finite) :
    ∃ S' T' U' : Point k K, IsPartialQuadrangle ![w.S, w.T, w.U, S', T', U'] ∧
      ∃ E₁ E₂ : Set K, E₁.Finite ∧ E₂.Finite ∧ erk k ∅ E₁ = 5 ∧ erk k ∅ E₂ = 10 ∧
        erk k ∅ (E₁ ∪ E₂) = 15 ∧
        IndepOver k ∅ (E₁ ∪ E₂) (range w.repTuple ∪ range ![S'.rep, T'.rep, U'.rep] ∪ W) ∧
        IsMainConclusion k (racl k (E₁ ∪ E₂))
          w.aTuple w.bTuple w.cTuple w.xTuple w.yTuple w.zTuple ∧
        IsMainConclusion k (racl k (E₁ ∪ E₂)) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.S.rep)
          (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.T.rep) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.U.rep) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ T'.rep)
          (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ U'.rep) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ S'.rep) ∧
        erk (↥(racl k (E₁ ∪ E₂))) ∅ (range w.aTuple) = 2 ∧
        erk (↥(racl k (E₁ ∪ E₂))) ∅ (range w.xTuple) = 1 ∧
        erk (↥(racl k (E₁ ∪ E₂))) ∅ (range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.S.rep)) = 1 ∧
        erk (↥(racl k (E₁ ∪ E₂))) ∅ (range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ T'.rep)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S', T', U', hquad, E₁, hE₁fin, hE₁rank, hE₁ind, hmain₁, -, -⟩ :=
    hw.exists_rankOne_isMainConclusion_fresh hW
  obtain ⟨E₂, hE₂fin, hE₂rank, hE₂ind, hmain₂, -, -⟩ :=
    hw.toCore.exists_isMainConclusion_fresh
      (((finite_range ![S'.rep, T'.rep, U'.rep]).union hW).union hE₁fin)
  let R := range w.repTuple ∪ range ![S'.rep, T'.rep, U'.rep] ∪ W
  let P := range w.aTuple ∪ range w.bTuple ∪ range w.cTuple ∪ range w.xTuple ∪
    range w.yTuple ∪ range w.zTuple
  let Q := range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.S.rep) ∪ range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.T.rep) ∪
    range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.U.rep) ∪ range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ T'.rep) ∪
    range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ U'.rep) ∪ range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ S'.rep)
  have hE₂ : IndepOver k ∅ E₂ (R ∪ E₁) := by
    simpa only [R, union_assoc] using hE₂ind
  have hE₂E₁ : IndepOver k ∅ E₂ E₁ := hE₂.mono_right subset_union_right
  have hrel : IndepOver k E₁ R E₂ := by
    have ht : IndepOver k ∅ E₂ (E₁ ∪ R) := by
      rw [union_comm E₁ R]
      exact hE₂
    simpa only [empty_union] using (indepOver_union_right_iff.1 ht).2.symm
  have hJ : IndepOver k ∅ (E₁ ∪ E₂) R := by
    exact (indepOver_union_right_iff.2
      ⟨hE₁ind.symm, by simpa only [empty_union] using hrel⟩).symm
  have hPRep : P ⊆ range w.repTuple := by
    refine union_subset (union_subset (union_subset (union_subset
      (union_subset ?_ ?_) ?_) ?_) ?_) ?_
    · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      fin_cases i
      exacts [⟨0, rfl⟩, ⟨1, rfl⟩]
    · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      fin_cases i
      exacts [⟨2, rfl⟩, ⟨3, rfl⟩]
    · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      fin_cases i
      exacts [⟨4, rfl⟩, ⟨5, rfl⟩]
    · rintro _ ⟨_, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨18, rfl⟩
    · rintro _ ⟨_, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨19, rfl⟩
    · rintro _ ⟨_, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨20, rfl⟩
  have hP : P ⊆ R := hPRep.trans (subset_union_left.trans subset_union_left)
  have hQ : Q ⊆ R := by
    refine union_subset (union_subset (union_subset (union_subset
      (union_subset ?_ ?_) ?_) ?_) ?_) ?_
    · rintro _ ⟨_, rfl⟩
      exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨15, rfl⟩)
    · rintro _ ⟨_, rfl⟩
      exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨16, rfl⟩)
    · rintro _ ⟨_, rfl⟩
      exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨17, rfl⟩)
    · rintro _ ⟨_, rfl⟩
      exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨1, rfl⟩)
    · rintro _ ⟨_, rfl⟩
      exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨2, rfl⟩)
    · rintro _ ⟨_, rfl⟩
      exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨0, rfl⟩)
  have hind₁ : IndepOver (↥(racl k E₁)) ∅ E₂ Q := by
    apply (indepOver_base_iff (racl k E₁) E₂ Q).2
    apply (indepOver_racl_base_iff E₁ E₂ Q).2
    exact hrel.symm.mono_right hQ
  have hind₂ : IndepOver (↥(racl k E₂)) ∅ E₁ P := by
    apply (indepOver_base_iff (racl k E₂) E₁ P).2
    apply (indepOver_racl_base_iff E₂ E₁ P).2
    have ht : IndepOver k ∅ R (E₂ ∪ E₁) := by
      rw [union_comm E₂ E₁]
      exact hJ.symm
    have ht' : IndepOver k E₂ R E₁ := by
      simpa only [empty_union] using (indepOver_union_right_iff.1 ht).2
    exact ht'.symm.mono_right hP
  have hm₁ := IsMainConclusion.baseChange_racl (IsSmall.of_finite hE₁fin).racl
    hmain₁ hE₂fin hind₁
  have hm₂ := IsMainConclusion.baseChange_racl (IsSmall.of_finite hE₂fin).racl
    hmain₂ hE₁fin hind₂
  rw [racl_union_left] at hm₁ hm₂
  rw [union_comm E₂ E₁] at hm₂
  have keep : ∀ {X : Set K}, X ⊆ R → X.Finite →
      erk (↥(racl k (E₁ ∪ E₂))) ∅ X = erk k ∅ X := by
    intro X hX hXfin
    rw [erk_base_empty, erk_racl_base]
    have ht := hJ.symm hX hXfin
    rwa [empty_union] at ht
  have hsubP := fun i ↦ GroupConfiguration.gcPoints_subset (a := w.aTuple) (b := w.bTuple)
    (c := w.cTuple) (x := w.xTuple) (y := w.yTuple) (z := w.zTuple) i
  have hsubQ := fun i ↦ GroupConfiguration.gcPoints_subset (a := fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.S.rep)
    (b := fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.T.rep) (c := fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.U.rep)
    (x := fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ T'.rep) (y := fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ U'.rep)
    (z := fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ S'.rep) i
  refine ⟨S', T', U', hquad, E₁, E₂, hE₁fin, hE₂fin, hE₁rank, hE₂rank, ?_, hJ,
    hm₂, hm₁, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hr : erk k E₁ E₂ = 10 := by
      have ht := hE₂E₁ (subset_refl _) hE₂fin
      rw [empty_union] at ht
      exact ht.trans hE₂rank
    rw [erk_union_eq, empty_union, hE₁rank, hr]
    norm_num
  · rw [keep (X := range w.aTuple) ((hsubP 0).trans hP) (finite_range _)]
    exact hw.toCore.groupConfiguration_with_ranks.2.1
  · rw [keep (X := range w.xTuple) ((hsubP 3).trans hP) (finite_range _)]
    exact hw.toCore.groupConfiguration_with_ranks.2.2
  · rw [keep (X := range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.S.rep)) ((hsubQ 0).trans hQ) (finite_range _)]
    simpa using ClosedIF.erk_eq_of_racl_eq (Point.racl_repTuple w.S) w.S.rankEq_one
  · rw [keep (X := range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ T'.rep)) ((hsubQ 3).trans hQ) (finite_range _)]
    simpa using ClosedIF.erk_eq_of_racl_eq (Point.racl_repTuple T') T'.rankEq_one

name: GroupConfig.affine_coeff_unique
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hα : α = α'
  · refine ⟨hα, ?_⟩
    subst hα
    exact (algebraMap K L).injective (add_left_cancel h)
