  · exfalso
    apply hz
    have hne : algebraMap K L (α - α') ≠ 0 := (map_ne_zero _).2 (sub_ne_zero.2 hα)
    have hz' : z = algebraMap K L ((β' - β) / (α - α')) := by
      rw [map_div₀, eq_div_iff hne, map_sub, map_sub]
      linear_combination h
    rw [hz']
    exact isAlgebraic_algebraMap _

name: GroupConfig.exists_aut_indep
statement:
private theorem exists_aut_indep [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K] {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    (d : ι → K) {M : Set K} (hM : IsSmall k M) :
    ∃ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K, IndepOver k ∅ (range (⇑σ ∘ d)) M
proof:
:= by
  have : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (∅ : Set K)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := exists_algEquiv_indepOver (M := racl k (∅ : Set K))
    (IsSmall.of_finite finite_empty).racl d hM
  refine ⟨τ.restrictScalars k, fun a ha hfin ↦ ?_⟩
  have h := hτ ha hfin
  rwa [erk_congr_base k (racl_union_left (k := k) ∅ M) a, erk_racl_base] at h

name: GroupConfig.exists_prodSubgroup_val
proof:
:= by
  have hu := hw.isUnit_of_mem hg
  refine ⟨⟨hu.unit, ?_⟩, hu.unit_spec⟩
  rw [hw.mem_prodSubgroup, hu.unit_spec]
  exact hw.mem_prodSet_of_mem hg

name: GroupConfig.cb_val_inv
statement:
private theorem cb_val_inv [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K]
    {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] {v : ι → K} {g₀ : Germ k v v} (hw : g₀.IsHW)
    (γ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) : (hw.val γ⁻¹).cb = (hw.val γ).cb
proof:
:= by
  refine Germ.IsInverse.cb_eq ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · change ((γ⁻¹ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) : (Germ k v v)ˣ).val * (γ : (Germ k v v)ˣ).val = 1
    rw [Subgroup.coe_inv, Units.inv_mul]
  · change (γ : (Germ k v v)ˣ).val * ((γ⁻¹ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) : (Germ k v v)ˣ).val = 1
    rw [Subgroup.coe_inv, Units.mul_inv]

name: GroupConfig.indepOver_range_comp_mono
proof:
:= by
  refine h.mono_left ?_
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hf i
  exact ⟨j, by simp only [Function.comp_apply, hj]⟩

name: GroupConfig.indep_point_union
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : IndepOver k (∅ ∪ Cd) M Y := (indepOver_union_right_iff.1 hjoint.symm).2
  have h3 : IndepOver k ∅ Y (Cd ∪ M) := indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨hYC, h2.symm⟩
  have h4 : IndepOver k ∅ Y (racl k (∅ ∪ (Cd ∪ M))) := indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 h3
  refine h4.mono_right (union_subset ?_ ?_)
  · exact fun z hz ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr (Or.inr hz))
  · intro z hz
    have hz' : z ∈ racl k Cd := hF ▸ subset_racl k F hz
    exact racl_mono (subset_union_left.trans subset_union_right) hz'

name: GroupConfig.racl_slEntries_sqrtMat
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : ({x ^ 2} : Set K) ⊆ {a, b} := singleton_subset_iff.2 (Or.inl ha)
  have hxm : x ∈ racl F ({a, b} : Set K) :=
    racl_mono hsq (mem_racl_singleton_pow (k := F) (x := x) two_ne_zero)
  have hbm : b ∈ racl F ({a, b} : Set K) := subset_racl F _ (Or.inr rfl)
  refine le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_) (racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_)
  · rintro _ ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · exact hxm
    · exact div_mem hbm hxm
    · exact zero_mem _
    · exact inv_mem hxm
  · have hx' : x ∈ racl F (slEntries (sqrtMat x b hx)) := subset_racl F _ ⟨(0, 0), rfl⟩
    have hb' : b / x ∈ racl F (slEntries (sqrtMat x b hx)) := subset_racl F _ ⟨(0, 1), rfl⟩
    rintro z (rfl | rfl)
    · rw [← ha]
      exact pow_mem hx' 2
    · have h := mul_mem hb' hx'
      rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hx] at h

name: GroupConfig.racl_singleton_sq
statement:
private theorem racl_singleton_sq {F : Type*} [Field F] [Algebra F K] {x a : K}
    (ha : x ^ 2 = a) : racl F ({a} : Set K) = racl F ({x} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ha]
  exact racl_pow x two_ne_zero

name: GroupConfig.erk_image_aut
statement:
private theorem erk_image_aut (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (X : Set K) :
    erk k ∅ (⇑σ '' X) = erk k ∅ X
proof:
:= by
  have h := erk_image σ ∅ X
  rwa [image_empty] at h

name: GroupConfig.exists_initial_chart_generic
statement:
theorem exists_initial_chart_generic [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K]
    {ι κ : Type u} [Finite ι] [Finite κ] {v : ι → K} {v' : κ → K} {f₀ : Germ k v v'}
    (hb : f₀.IsHWBij) {ga gb gc : Germ k v v} (hga : ga ∈ f₀.diffSet) (hgb : gb ∈ f₀.diffSet)
    (hgc : gc ∈ f₀.diffSet) (hprod : gb = gc * ga) (hv : erk k ∅ (range v) = 1)
    (hr : erk k ∅ (ga.cb : Set K) = 2) {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k v y)
    (hind : IndepTriple k (ga.cb : Set K) gb.cb (range y))
    {μ : Type} [Finite μ] (extra : μ → K) {s t w₀ : K}
    (hs : s ∈ racl k (ga.cb : Set K)) (ht : t ∈ racl k (gb.cb : Set K))
    (hw₀ : w₀ ∈ racl k (gc.cb : Set K))
    (hst : erk k ∅ ({s, t} : Set K) = 2) (hsw : erk k ∅ ({s, w₀} : Set K) = 2)
    (hstw : erk k ∅ ({s, t, w₀} : Set K) = 2) :
    ∃ (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (M : IntermediateField k K) (_ : IsAlgClosed ↥M),
      IsSmall k (M : Set K) ∧ IndepOver k ∅ (range (⇑σ ∘ extra)) (M : Set K) ∧
      ∃ a b c d x : K,
        racl (↥M) ({a, b} : Set K) = racl (↥M) ((ga.map σ).cb : Set K) ∧
        racl (↥M) ({c, d} : Set K) = racl (↥M) ((gb.map σ).cb : Set K) ∧
        racl (↥M) ({a * c, b * c + d} : Set K) = racl (↥M) ((gc.map σ).cb : Set K) ∧
        racl (↥M) ({a} : Set K) = racl (↥M) ({σ s} : Set K) ∧
        racl (↥M) ({c} : Set K) = racl (↥M) ({σ t} : Set K) ∧
        racl (↥M) ({a * c} : Set K) = racl (↥M) ({σ w₀} : Set K) ∧
        racl (↥M) ({x} : Set K) = racl (↥M) (range ((ga.map σ).evalGen (⇑σ ∘ y))) ∧
        racl (↥M) ({a * x + b} : Set K) = racl (↥M) (range (⇑σ ∘ y)) ∧
        racl (↥M) ({c * (a * x + b) + d} : Set K) =
          racl (↥M) (range ((gb.map σ).evalGen (⇑σ ∘ y)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hw : ga.IsHW := hb.isHW hga
  
  obtain ⟨u, M, iM, hMs, hu, -, ⟨P, Q, hQ, hPQ⟩, hcoef⟩ :=
    hb.exists_affine_generator_parameters hga hv hr
  
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_aut_indep (Sum.elim extra (Sum.elim ![s, t, w₀]
    (Sum.elim ga.codeTuple (Sum.elim gb.codeTuple (Sum.elim gc.codeTuple y))))) hMs
  
  have horb : f₀.diffSet = Germ.orbit ga := Germ.diffSet_eq_orbit hga
  obtain ⟨γa, hγa⟩ := exists_prodSubgroup_val hw (horb ▸ Germ.map_mem_diffSet hga σ)
  obtain ⟨γb, hγb⟩ := exists_prodSubgroup_val hw (horb ▸ Germ.map_mem_diffSet hgb σ)
  obtain ⟨γc, hγc⟩ := exists_prodSubgroup_val hw (horb ▸ Germ.map_mem_diffSet hgc σ)
  have hrel : γb = γc * γa := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Units.ext
    change hw.val γb = hw.val γc * hw.val γa
    rw [hγa, hγb, hγc, hprod]
    simpa only [Germ.mapHom_apply] using map_mul (Germ.mapHom σ) gc ga
  
  obtain ⟨α, β, hα0, hacta, hra⟩ := hcoef γa⁻¹
  obtain ⟨α', β', hα'0, hactb, hrb⟩ := hcoef γb⁻¹
  obtain ⟨α'', β'', -, hactc, hrc⟩ := hcoef γc⁻¹
  rw [cb_val_inv, hγa] at hra
  rw [cb_val_inv, hγb] at hrb
  rw [cb_val_inv, hγc] at hrc
  have hco : α' = α'' * α ∧ β' = α'' * β + β'' := by
    have hinv : γb⁻¹ = γa⁻¹ * γc⁻¹ := by rw [hrel, _root_.mul_inv_rev]
    have e := DFunLike.congr_fun (map_mul (hw.functionFieldAction hv) γa⁻¹ γc⁻¹) u
    rw [← hinv, AlgEquiv.mul_apply, hactb, hactc, map_add, map_mul, AlgEquiv.commutes,
      AlgEquiv.commutes, hacta] at e
    refine affine_coeff_unique hu ?_
    rw [e, map_mul, map_add, map_mul]
    ring
  
  have hcodeA : racl k (((ga.map σ).cb : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) =
      racl k (range (⇑σ ∘ ga.codeTuple)) :=
    (Germ.racl_codeTuple (ga.map σ)).symm.trans (Germ.racl_codeTuple_map σ ga)
  have hcodeB : racl k (((gb.map σ).cb : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) =
      racl k (range (⇑σ ∘ gb.codeTuple)) :=
    (Germ.racl_codeTuple (gb.map σ)).symm.trans (Germ.racl_codeTuple_map σ gb)
  have hindc : IndepTriple k (range ga.codeTuple) (range gb.codeTuple) (range y) :=
    indepTriple_of_racl_eq (Germ.racl_codeTuple ga).symm (Germ.racl_codeTuple gb).symm rfl hind
  have hindσ := GroupConfiguration.IndepTriple.image σ hindc
  rw [← range_comp, ← range_comp, ← range_comp] at hindσ
  have hYA : IndepOver k ∅ (range (⇑σ ∘ y)) (range (⇑σ ∘ ga.codeTuple)) :=
    hindσ.rotate.rotate.indepOver_left (finite_range _) (finite_range _) (finite_range _)
  have hYB : IndepOver k ∅ (range (⇑σ ∘ y)) (range (⇑σ ∘ gb.codeTuple)) :=
    (hindσ.rotate.indepOver_left (finite_range _) (finite_range _) (finite_range _)).symm
  have hjA : IndepOver k ∅ (range (⇑σ ∘ ga.codeTuple) ∪ range (⇑σ ∘ y)) (M : Set K) := by
    have h := indepOver_range_comp_mono hσ (Sum.elim ga.codeTuple y) (fun i ↦ by
      cases i with
      | inl c => exact ⟨Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl c)), rfl⟩
      | inr j => exact ⟨Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr j)))), rfl⟩)
    rwa [Sum.comp_elim, Sum.elim_range] at h
  have hjB : IndepOver k ∅ (range (⇑σ ∘ gb.codeTuple) ∪ range (⇑σ ∘ y)) (M : Set K) := by
    have h := indepOver_range_comp_mono hσ (Sum.elim gb.codeTuple y) (fun i ↦ by
      cases i with
      | inl c => exact ⟨Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl c))), rfl⟩
      | inr j => exact ⟨Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr j)))), rfl⟩)
    rwa [Sum.comp_elim, Sum.elim_range] at h
  have hyA : IsGenericOver (racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ ((ga.map σ).cb : Set K))) v (⇑σ ∘ y) :=
    (hy.map σ).isGenericOver_racl (hMs.union (ga.map σ).isSmall_cb)
      (indep_point_union hcodeA hYA hjA)
  have hyB : IsGenericOver (racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ ((gb.map σ).cb : Set K))) v (⇑σ ∘ y) :=
    (hy.map σ).isGenericOver_racl (hMs.union (gb.map σ).isSmall_cb)
      (indep_point_union hcodeB hYB hjB)
  have hyM : IsGenericOver M v (⇑σ ∘ y) :=
    hyA.of_le fun z hz ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl hz)
  
  have hbase : ∀ {S : Set K} {z : K}, z ∈ racl (↥M) S → z ∈ racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ S) :=
    fun hz ↦ (mem_racl_base_iff M _ _).1 hz
  have hαm : α ∈ racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ ((hw.val γa).cb : Set K)) := by
    rw [hγa]
    exact hbase (hra ▸ subset_racl (↥M) _ (Or.inl rfl))
  have hβm : β ∈ racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ ((hw.val γa).cb : Set K)) := by
    rw [hγa]
    exact hbase (hra ▸ subset_racl (↥M) _ (Or.inr rfl))
  have hα'm : α' ∈ racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ ((hw.val γb).cb : Set K)) := by
    rw [hγb]
    exact hbase (hrb ▸ subset_racl (↥M) _ (Or.inl rfl))
  have hβ'm : β' ∈ racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ ((hw.val γb).cb : Set K)) := by
    rw [hγb]
    exact hbase (hrb ▸ subset_racl (↥M) _ (Or.inr rfl))
  obtain ⟨x₀, z₀, hx₀, -, hz₀eq, hrx₀, hrz₀⟩ := affine_coordinate_evalGen hw hv hMs hu P Q hQ
    hPQ γa α β hαm hβm hacta (by rw [hγa]; exact hyA)
  obtain ⟨x₁, z₁, hx₁, -, hz₁eq, -, hrz₁⟩ := affine_coordinate_evalGen hw hv hMs hu P Q hQ
    hPQ γb α' β' hα'm hβ'm hactb (by rw [hγb]; exact hyB)
  have hx₁₀ : x₁ = x₀ := LocusFunctionField.HasValue.eq_value hyM hx₁ hx₀
  rw [hγa] at hrz₀
  rw [hγb] at hrz₁
  
  have hY : α⁻¹ * z₀ + -(β * α⁻¹) = x₀ := by
    rw [hz₀eq, mul_add, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hα0, one_mul]
    ring
  have hZ : α' * (α⁻¹ * z₀ + -(β * α⁻¹)) + β' = z₁ := by
    rw [hY, hz₁eq, hx₁₀]
  have hAc : α⁻¹ * α' = α'' := by
    rw [hco.1, mul_comm α'' α, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hα0, one_mul]
  have hCc : -(β * α⁻¹) * α' + β' = β'' := by
    rw [hco.1, hco.2]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hApair : racl (↥M) ({α⁻¹, -(β * α⁻¹)} : Set K) = racl (↥M) ({α, β} : Set K) := by
    have hαM : α ∈ racl (↥M) ({α, β} : Set K) := subset_racl (↥M) _ (Or.inl rfl)
    have hβM : β ∈ racl (↥M) ({α, β} : Set K) := subset_racl (↥M) _ (Or.inr rfl)
    have hiM : α⁻¹ ∈ racl (↥M) ({α⁻¹, -(β * α⁻¹)} : Set K) := subset_racl (↥M) _ (Or.inl rfl)
    have hjM : -(β * α⁻¹) ∈ racl (↥M) ({α⁻¹, -(β * α⁻¹)} : Set K) :=
      subset_racl (↥M) _ (Or.inr rfl)
    refine le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_) (racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_)
    · rintro z (rfl | rfl)
      · exact inv_mem hαM
      · exact neg_mem (mul_mem hβM (inv_mem hαM))
    · rintro z (rfl | rfl)
      · have h := inv_mem hiM
        rwa [inv_inv] at h
      · have h := mul_mem (neg_mem hjM) (inv_mem hiM)
        rwa [neg_neg, inv_inv, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hα0, mul_one] at h
  
  have : UniversalDomain ↥M K := universalDomain_of_isSmall M hMs
  have hαi0 : α⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero hα0
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq α⁻¹ two_pos
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq α' two_pos
  have hl0 : l ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hαi0 (by rw [← hl]; ring)
  have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hα'0 (by rw [← hm]; ring)
  have hErk : ∀ {X : Set K}, X.Finite → IndepOver k ∅ X (M : Set K) →
      erk (↥M) ∅ X = erk k ∅ X := fun {X} hX hi ↦ by
    rw [erk_base_empty M X]
    have h := hi.erk_eq subset_rfl hX
    rwa [empty_union] at h
  have hrM : ∀ {X Y : Set K}, racl k X = racl k Y → racl (↥M) X = racl (↥M) Y :=
    fun h ↦ racl_base_congr M h
  have hmapcb : ∀ g : Germ k v v, (⇑σ '' (g.cb : Set K)) = ((g.map σ).cb : Set K) := fun g ↦ by
    rw [Germ.cb_map, IntermediateField.coe_map]
    rfl
  have hmemM : ∀ {z : K} {g : Germ k v v}, z ∈ racl k (g.cb : Set K) →
      σ z ∈ racl (↥M) ((g.map σ).cb : Set K) := fun hz ↦ by
    have h := mem_racl_map σ hz
    rw [hmapcb] at h
    exact (mem_racl_base_iff M _ _).2 (racl_mono subset_union_right h)
  have hDmem : ∀ {z : K}, z ∈ ({s, t, w₀} : Set K) →
      σ z ∈ range (⇑σ ∘ Sum.elim extra (Sum.elim ![s, t, w₀]
        (Sum.elim ga.codeTuple (Sum.elim gb.codeTuple (Sum.elim gc.codeTuple y))))) := by
    rintro z (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    · exact ⟨Sum.inr (Sum.inl 0), rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨Sum.inr (Sum.inl 1), rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨Sum.inr (Sum.inl 2), rfl⟩
  have hpairM : ∀ {X : Set K}, X ⊆ ({s, t, w₀} : Set K) →
      erk (↥M) ∅ (⇑σ '' X) = erk k ∅ X := fun hX ↦ by
    rw [hErk ((((toFinite ({s, t, w₀} : Set K)).subset hX).image _))
      (hσ.mono_left (by rintro _ ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩; exact hDmem (hX hz))), erk_image_aut]
  obtain ⟨g, hgdef⟩ : ∃ g, g = sqrtMat l (-(β * α⁻¹)) hl0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨h, hhdef⟩ : ∃ h, h = sqrtMat m β' hm0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hg10 : g 1 0 = 0 := by rw [hgdef]; rfl
  have hh10 : h 1 0 = 0 := by rw [hhdef]; rfl
  have hg00 : g 0 0 = l := by rw [hgdef]; rfl
  have hh00 : h 0 0 = m := by rw [hhdef]; rfl
  have hg01 : g 0 1 = -(β * α⁻¹) / l := by rw [hgdef]; rfl
  have hg11 : g 1 1 = l⁻¹ := by rw [hgdef]; rfl
  have hh01 : h 0 1 = β' / m := by rw [hhdef]; rfl
  have hmul : ∀ i j, (h * g) i j = h i 0 * g 0 j + h i 1 * g 1 j := fun i j ↦ by
    rw [SpecialLinearGroup.coe_mul, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  have hp00 : (h * g) 0 0 = m * l := by
    rw [hmul, hg10, mul_zero, add_zero, hg00, hh00]
  have hp01 : (h * g) 0 1 = m * (-(β * α⁻¹) / l) + β' / m * l⁻¹ := by
    rw [hmul, hh00, hg01, hh01, hg11]
  have hgE : racl (↥M) (slEntries g) = racl (↥M) ({α⁻¹, -(β * α⁻¹)} : Set K) := by
    rw [hgdef]
    exact racl_slEntries_sqrtMat hl0 hl
  have hhE : racl (↥M) (slEntries h) = racl (↥M) ({α', β'} : Set K) := by
    rw [hhdef]
    exact racl_slEntries_sqrtMat hm0 hm
  have hpE : ({α⁻¹ * α', -(β * α⁻¹) * α' + β'} : Set K) ⊆ racl (↥M) (slEntries (h * g)) := by
    have h0 : (h * g) 0 0 ∈ racl (↥M) (slEntries (h * g)) := subset_racl (↥M) _ ⟨(0, 0), rfl⟩
    have h1 : (h * g) 0 1 ∈ racl (↥M) (slEntries (h * g)) := subset_racl (↥M) _ ⟨(0, 1), rfl⟩
    have e1 : α⁻¹ * α' = (h * g) 0 0 ^ 2 := by
      rw [hp00, mul_pow, hm, hl, mul_comm]
    have e2 : -(β * α⁻¹) * α' + β' = (h * g) 0 0 * (h * g) 0 1 := by
      rw [hp00, hp01, ← hm]
      field_simp
    rintro z (rfl | rfl)
    · rw [e1]
      exact pow_mem h0 2
    · rw [e2]
      exact mul_mem h0 h1
  
  have hjAB : IndepOver k ∅ (range (⇑σ ∘ ga.codeTuple) ∪ range (⇑σ ∘ gb.codeTuple))
      (M : Set K) := by
    have h' := indepOver_range_comp_mono hσ (Sum.elim ga.codeTuple gb.codeTuple) (fun i ↦ by
      cases i with
      | inl c => exact ⟨Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl c)), rfl⟩
      | inr c => exact ⟨Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl c))), rfl⟩)
    rwa [Sum.comp_elim, Sum.elim_range] at h'
  have hcA2 : erk k ∅ (range (⇑σ ∘ ga.codeTuple)) = 2 := by
    rw [range_comp, erk_image_aut, erk_eq_of_racl_eq (Germ.racl_codeTuple ga), hr]
  have hcB2 : erk k ∅ (range (⇑σ ∘ gb.codeTuple)) = 2 := by
    rw [range_comp, erk_image_aut, erk_eq_of_racl_eq (Germ.racl_codeTuple gb),
      Germ.erk_cb_eq_of_mem_orbit (horb ▸ hgb), hr]
  have hgh4 : erk (↥M) ∅ (slEntries g ∪ slEntries h) = 4 := by
    have hr4 : racl (↥M) (slEntries g ∪ slEntries h) =
        racl (↥M) (range (⇑σ ∘ ga.codeTuple) ∪ range (⇑σ ∘ gb.codeTuple)) :=
      racl_union_congr (hgE.trans (hApair.trans (hra.trans (hrM hcodeA))))
        (hhE.trans (hrb.trans (hrM hcodeB)))
    rw [erk_eq_of_racl_eq hr4, hErk ((finite_range _).union (finite_range _)) hjAB,
      hindσ.erk_union_left (finite_range _), hcA2, hcB2]
    norm_num
  have hs' : σ s ∈ racl (↥M) (slEntries g) := by
    rw [hgE, hApair, hra]
    exact hmemM hs
  have ht' : σ t ∈ racl (↥M) (slEntries h) := by
    rw [hhE, hrb]
    exact hmemM ht
  have hw' : σ w₀ ∈ racl (↥M) (slEntries (h * g)) := by
    have h' := hmemM hw₀
    rw [← hrc, ← hAc, ← hCc] at h'
    exact racl_le_of_subset_racl hpE h'
  have hst' : erk (↥M) ∅ ({σ s, σ t} : Set K) = 2 := by
    rw [← image_pair (⇑σ) s t, hpairM (by
      rintro z (rfl | rfl)
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)), hst]
  have hsw' : erk (↥M) ∅ ({σ s, σ w₀} : Set K) = 2 := by
    rw [← image_pair (⇑σ) s w₀, hpairM (by
      rintro z (rfl | rfl)
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)), hsw]
  have hstw' : erk (↥M) ∅ ({σ s, σ t, σ w₀} : Set K) = 2 := by
    rw [← image_pair (⇑σ) t w₀, ← image_insert_eq, hpairM subset_rfl, hstw]
  obtain ⟨hS, hT, hU⟩ :=
    upper_curve_diagonal_rows (k := ↥M) g h hg10 hh10 hgh4 hs' ht' hw' hst' hsw' hstw'
  rw [hg00] at hS
  rw [hh00] at hT
  rw [hp00] at hU
  refine ⟨σ, M, iM, hMs, indepOver_range_comp_mono hσ extra (fun i ↦ ⟨Sum.inl i, rfl⟩),
    α⁻¹, -(β * α⁻¹), α', β', z₀,
    hApair.trans hra, hrb, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, hrz₀, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hAc, hCc]
    exact hrc
  · rw [racl_singleton_sq hl, hS]
  · rw [racl_singleton_sq hm, hT]
  · rw [racl_singleton_sq (x := m * l) (by rw [mul_pow, hm, hl, mul_comm]), hU]
  · rw [hY]
    exact hrx₀
  · rw [hZ]
    exact hrz₁

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfig.racl_restrictScalars_coe
statement:
private theorem racl_restrictScalars_coe {F₀ : IntermediateField k K}
    (M : IntermediateField (↥F₀) K) (X : Set K) :
    ((racl (↥(M.restrictScalars k)) X : IntermediateField _ K) : Set K) =
      ((racl (↥M) X : IntermediateField _ K) : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have hF : (F₀ : Set K) ⊆ (M : Set K) := fun z hz ↦ M.algebraMap_mem (⟨z, hz⟩ : F₀)
  rw [racl_base_coe (M.restrictScalars k), racl_base_coe M, racl_base_coe F₀, ← union_assoc,
    union_eq_right.2 hF, IntermediateField.coe_restrictScalars]

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfig.racl_restrictScalars_eq
proof:
:= by
  apply SetLike.coe_injective
  rw [racl_restrictScalars_coe, racl_restrictScalars_coe, h]

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfig.racl_image_congr
statement:
private theorem racl_image_congr (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) {X Y : Set K} (h : racl k X = racl k Y) :
    racl k (⇑σ '' X) = racl k (⇑σ '' Y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← racl_map, ← racl_map, h]

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfig.AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.exists_initial_chart_rows
statement:
theorem Psi.exists_initial_chart_rows [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K]
    {w : QWitness k K} (hw : w.Psi) :
    ∃ (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (L : IntermediateField k K),
      IndepOver k ∅ (L : Set K) (range (⇑σ ∘ w.repTuple)) ∧ ∃ a b c d x : K,
        racl (↥L) (range ![σ w.A₁.rep, σ w.A₂.rep]) = racl (↥L) (range ![a, b]) ∧
        racl (↥L) (range ![σ w.B₁.rep, σ w.B₂.rep]) = racl (↥L) (range ![c, d]) ∧
        racl (↥L) (range ![σ w.C₁.rep, σ w.C₂.rep]) =
          racl (↥L) (range ![a * c, b * c + d]) ∧
        racl (↥L) ({σ w.S.rep} : Set K) = racl (↥L) ({a} : Set K) ∧
        racl (↥L) ({σ w.T.rep} : Set K) = racl (↥L) ({c} : Set K) ∧
        racl (↥L) ({σ w.U.rep} : Set K) = racl (↥L) ({a * c} : Set K) ∧
        racl (↥L) ({σ w.X.rep} : Set K) = racl (↥L) ({x} : Set K) ∧
        racl (↥L) ({σ w.Y.rep} : Set K) = racl (↥L) ({a * x + b} : Set K) ∧
        racl (↥L) ({σ w.Z.rep} : Set K) = racl (↥L) ({c * (a * x + b) + d} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S', T', U', hq⟩ := hw.quad
  obtain ⟨E, -, -, hEind, hmain, haR, hxR⟩ :=
    hw.toCore.exists_isMainConclusion_fresh (W := ∅) finite_empty
  rw [union_empty] at hEind
  generalize hF₀ : racl k E = F₀ at hmain haR hxR
  obtain ⟨iF, uF, ν, ν', _, _, v, v', f₀, ga, gb, gc, y', hb, hga, hgb, hgc, hprod, hy, hind, -,
    -, hA, hB, hC, hX, hY, hZ, hvx, -, -⟩ := hmain
  
  have hrk : ∀ {X : Set K}, X ⊆ range w.repTuple → erk (↥F₀) ∅ X = erk k ∅ X := fun hX ↦ by
    rw [erk_base_empty, ← hF₀, erk_racl_base]
    have := hEind.symm hX ((finite_range _).subset hX)
    rwa [empty_union] at this
  have hnle : ∀ {P₁ Q₁ : Point k K}, P₁ ≠ Q₁ → ¬ Q₁.1 ≤ P₁.1 := fun {P₁ Q₁} hPQ hle ↦
    hPQ (Subtype.ext ((P₁.2.le_iff_eq Q₁.2.1).1 hle).symm)
  have hpair : ∀ {P₁ Q₁ : Point k K}, P₁ ≠ Q₁ → erk k ∅ ({P₁.rep, Q₁.rep} : Set K) = 2 :=
      fun {P₁ Q₁} hPQ ↦ by
    have hr : racl k ({P₁.rep, Q₁.rep} : Set K) = (P₁.1 ⊔ Q₁.1).1 := by
      rw [← coe_sup_point₂, P₁.point_rep, Q₁.point_rep]
    have h := ClosedIF.erk_eq_of_racl_eq hr
      ((Point.rankEq_one P₁).sup_point_of_not_le (hnle hPQ))
    norm_num at h
    exact h
  have hST : w.S ≠ w.T := hq.injective.ne (by decide : (0 : Fin 6) ≠ 1)
  have hSU : w.S ≠ w.U := hq.injective.ne (by decide : (0 : Fin 6) ≠ 2)
  have hr3 : racl k ({w.S.rep, w.T.rep, w.U.rep} : Set K) = (w.S.1 ⊔ (w.T.1 ⊔ w.U.1)).1 := by
    rw [insert_eq]
    exact ClosedIF.racl_union_eq_sup (congrArg Subtype.val w.S.point_rep)
      (by rw [← coe_sup_point₂, w.T.point_rep, w.U.point_rep])
  have hsub : ({w.S.rep, w.T.rep, w.U.rep} : Set K) ⊆ range w.repTuple := by
    rintro z (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    exacts [⟨15, rfl⟩, ⟨16, rfl⟩, ⟨17, rfl⟩]
  have hst : erk (↥F₀) ∅ ({w.S.rep, w.T.rep} : Set K) = 2 := by
    rw [hrk ((show ({w.S.rep, w.T.rep} : Set K) ⊆ {w.S.rep, w.T.rep, w.U.rep} from
      insert_subset_insert (singleton_subset_iff.2 (Or.inl rfl))).trans hsub), hpair hST]
  have hsu : erk (↥F₀) ∅ ({w.S.rep, w.U.rep} : Set K) = 2 := by
    rw [hrk ((show ({w.S.rep, w.U.rep} : Set K) ⊆ {w.S.rep, w.T.rep, w.U.rep} from
      insert_subset_insert (singleton_subset_iff.2 (Or.inr rfl))).trans hsub), hpair hSU]
  have hstu : erk (↥F₀) ∅ ({w.S.rep, w.T.rep, w.U.rep} : Set K) = 2 := by
    have h := ClosedIF.erk_eq_of_racl_eq hr3 hw.rank_STU
    rw [hrk hsub]
    exact_mod_cast h
  
  have hmem : ∀ {P₁ Q₁ R₁ : Point k K}, R₁.1 ≤ P₁.1 ⊔ Q₁.1 →
      R₁.rep ∈ racl k ({P₁.rep, Q₁.rep} : Set K) := fun {P₁ Q₁ R₁} h ↦ by
    have h1 : ClosedIF.point k R₁.rep ≤ ClosedIF.point k P₁.rep ⊔ ClosedIF.point k Q₁.rep := by
      rw [R₁.point_rep, P₁.point_rep, Q₁.point_rep]
      exact h
    have h2 : R₁.rep ∈
        ((ClosedIF.point k P₁.rep ⊔ ClosedIF.point k Q₁.rep).1 : IntermediateField k K) :=
      ClosedIF.point_le_iff.1 h1
    rwa [coe_sup_point₂] at h2
  have hcbA : racl (↥F₀) (ga.cb : Set K) = racl (↥F₀) ({w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep} : Set K) := by
    rw [← Germ.racl_codeTuple, ← hA, aTuple, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty]
  have hcbB : racl (↥F₀) (gb.cb : Set K) = racl (↥F₀) ({w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep} : Set K) := by
    rw [← Germ.racl_codeTuple, ← hB, bTuple, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty]
  have hcbC : racl (↥F₀) (gc.cb : Set K) = racl (↥F₀) ({w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep} : Set K) := by
    rw [← Germ.racl_codeTuple, ← hC, cTuple, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty]
  have hs : w.S.rep ∈ racl (↥F₀) (ga.cb : Set K) := by
    rw [hcbA]
    exact racl_subset_racl_base F₀ _ (hmem (P₁ := w.A₁) (Q₁ := w.A₂) hw.S_le)
  have ht : w.T.rep ∈ racl (↥F₀) (gb.cb : Set K) := by
    rw [hcbB]
    exact racl_subset_racl_base F₀ _ (hmem (P₁ := w.B₁) (Q₁ := w.B₂) hw.T_le)
  have hu : w.U.rep ∈ racl (↥F₀) (gc.cb : Set K) := by
    rw [hcbC]
    exact racl_subset_racl_base F₀ _ (hmem (P₁ := w.C₁) (Q₁ := w.C₂) hw.U_le)
  have hv : erk (↥F₀) ∅ (range v) = 1 := hvx.trans hxR
  have hr : erk (↥F₀) ∅ (ga.cb : Set K) = 2 := by
    rw [← erk_eq_of_racl_eq (Germ.racl_codeTuple ga), ← erk_eq_of_racl_eq hA, haR]
  
  obtain ⟨σ, M, -, -, hσM, a, b, c, d, x, r1, r2, r3, r4, r5, r6, r7, r8, r9⟩ :=
    exists_initial_chart_generic hb hga hgb hgc hprod hv hr hy hind w.repTuple hs ht hu hst hsu
      hstu
  
  have hindc : IndepTriple (↥F₀) (range ga.codeTuple) (range gb.codeTuple) (range y') :=
    indepTriple_of_racl_eq (Germ.racl_codeTuple ga).symm (Germ.racl_codeTuple gb).symm rfl hind
  have hyA : IndepOver (↥F₀) ∅ (range y') (ga.cb : Set K) := by
    have h := hindc.rotate.rotate.indepOver_left (finite_range _) (finite_range _)
      (finite_range _)
    refine (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 h).mono_right ?_
    rw [empty_union]
    exact Germ.cb_subset_racl_codeTuple ga
  have hyB : IndepOver (↥F₀) ∅ (range y') (gb.cb : Set K) := by
    have h := (hindc.rotate.indepOver_left (finite_range _) (finite_range _)
      (finite_range _)).symm
    refine (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 h).mono_right ?_
    rw [empty_union]
    exact Germ.cb_subset_racl_codeTuple gb
  have hmapA : racl (↥F₀) ((ga.map σ).cb : Set K) =
      racl (↥F₀) ({σ w.A₁.rep, σ w.A₂.rep} : Set K) := by
    rw [← Germ.racl_codeTuple, Germ.racl_codeTuple_map, range_comp, racl_image_congr σ hA.symm,
      aTuple, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty, image_pair]
  have hmapB : racl (↥F₀) ((gb.map σ).cb : Set K) =
      racl (↥F₀) ({σ w.B₁.rep, σ w.B₂.rep} : Set K) := by
    rw [← Germ.racl_codeTuple, Germ.racl_codeTuple_map, range_comp, racl_image_congr σ hB.symm,
      bTuple, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty, image_pair]
  have hmapC : racl (↥F₀) ((gc.map σ).cb : Set K) =
      racl (↥F₀) ({σ w.C₁.rep, σ w.C₂.rep} : Set K) := by
    rw [← Germ.racl_codeTuple, Germ.racl_codeTuple_map, range_comp, racl_image_congr σ hC.symm,
      cTuple, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty, image_pair]
  have hmapX : racl (↥F₀) (range ((ga.map σ).evalGen (⇑σ ∘ y'))) =
      racl (↥F₀) ({σ w.X.rep} : Set K) := by
    rw [Germ.evalGen_map σ ga hy hyA, range_comp, racl_image_congr σ hX.symm,
      show w.xTuple = fun _ ↦ w.X.rep from rfl,
      range_const, image_singleton]
  have hmapY : racl (↥F₀) (range (⇑σ ∘ y')) = racl (↥F₀) ({σ w.Y.rep} : Set K) := by
    rw [range_comp, racl_image_congr σ hY.symm,
      show w.yTuple = fun _ ↦ w.Y.rep from rfl, range_const, image_singleton]
  have hmapZ : racl (↥F₀) (range ((gb.map σ).evalGen (⇑σ ∘ y'))) =
      racl (↥F₀) ({σ w.Z.rep} : Set K) := by
    rw [Germ.evalGen_map σ gb hy hyB, range_comp, racl_image_congr σ hZ.symm,
      show w.zTuple = fun _ ↦ w.Z.rep from rfl,
      range_const, image_singleton]
  
  obtain ⟨σk, hσk⟩ : ∃ σk : K ≃ₐ[k] K, ⇑σk = ⇑σ := ⟨σ.restrictScalars k, rfl⟩
  have hσE : ⇑σ '' E = E := by
    have hfix : ∀ z ∈ E, σ z = z := fun z hz ↦ by
      have h : z ∈ F₀ := hF₀ ▸ subset_racl k E hz
      exact σ.commutes (⟨z, h⟩ : F₀)
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z', hz', rfl⟩
      rwa [hfix z' hz']
    · intro hz
      exact ⟨z, hz, hfix z hz⟩
  have h1 : IndepOver k ∅ (range (⇑σ ∘ w.repTuple)) E := by
    have h := hEind.image σk
    rw [image_empty, hσk, hσE, ← range_comp] at h
    exact h.symm
  have h2 : IndepOver k (∅ ∪ E) (range (⇑σ ∘ w.repTuple)) (M : Set K) := by
    have h := (indepOver_base_iff F₀ _ _).1 hσM
    exact (indepOver_congr_base (by rw [← hF₀, racl_racl, empty_union])).1 h
  have hfresh : IndepOver k ∅ (M : Set K) (range (⇑σ ∘ w.repTuple)) :=
    ((indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨h1, h2⟩).mono_right subset_union_right).symm
  refine ⟨σk, M.restrictScalars k, ?_, a, b, c, d, x, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hσk, IntermediateField.coe_restrictScalars]
    exact hfresh
  · rw [hσk, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty]
    exact racl_restrictScalars_eq (r1.trans (racl_base_congr M hmapA)).symm
  · rw [hσk, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty]
    exact racl_restrictScalars_eq (r2.trans (racl_base_congr M hmapB)).symm
  · rw [hσk, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty]
    exact racl_restrictScalars_eq (r3.trans (racl_base_congr M hmapC)).symm
  · rw [hσk]
    exact racl_restrictScalars_eq r4.symm
  · rw [hσk]
    exact racl_restrictScalars_eq r5.symm
  · rw [hσk]
    exact racl_restrictScalars_eq r6.symm
  · rw [hσk]
    exact racl_restrictScalars_eq (r7.trans (racl_base_congr M hmapX)).symm
  · rw [hσk]
    exact racl_restrictScalars_eq (r8.trans (racl_base_congr M hmapY)).symm
  · rw [hσk]
    exact racl_restrictScalars_eq (r9.trans (racl_base_congr M hmapZ)).symm

name: GroupConfig.IsSmall.of_finite
statement: theorem IsSmall.of_finite {C : Set K} (hC : C.Finite) : IsSmall k C
proof:
:=
  erk_ne_top k hC ∅

name: GroupConfig.IsSmall.mono
statement: theorem IsSmall.mono {C C' : Set K} (hC : IsSmall k C) (h : C' ⊆ C) : IsSmall k C'
proof:
:=
  fun htop ↦ hC (eq_top_iff.2 (htop ▸ erk_mono k ∅ h))

name: GroupConfig.IsSmall.union
statement:
theorem IsSmall.union {C D : Set K} (hC : IsSmall k C) (hD : IsSmall k D) :
    IsSmall k (C ∪ D)
proof:
:= by
  intro htop
  have h := erk_union_le k ∅ C D
  rw [htop] at h
  exact (ENat.add_lt_top.2 ⟨lt_top_iff_ne_top.2 hC, lt_top_iff_ne_top.2 hD⟩).ne
    (top_le_iff.1 h)

name: GroupConfig.IsSmall.racl
statement: theorem IsSmall.racl {C : Set K} (hC : IsSmall k C) : IsSmall k (racl k C : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have h := erk_racl k ∅ C
  rw [empty_union] at h
  exact fun htop ↦ hC (h ▸ htop)

name: GroupConfig.IsSmall.exists_finite_racl_eq
statement:
theorem IsSmall.exists_finite_racl_eq {C : Set K} (hC : IsSmall k C) :
    ∃ S ⊆ C, S.Finite ∧ AclGeom.racl k S = AclGeom.racl k C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := (rkMatroid k ∅).exists_isBasis' C
  have hJfin : J.Finite := by
    rw [← encard_lt_top_iff, hJ.encard_eq_eRk]
    exact lt_top_iff_ne_top.2 hC
  refine ⟨J, hJ.subset, hJfin, le_antisymm (racl_mono hJ.subset) ?_⟩
  have h := subset_racl_of_isBasis' k hJ
  rw [empty_union] at h
  exact racl_le_of_subset_racl h

name: GroupConfig.exists_notMem_racl_of_isSmall
statement:
theorem exists_notMem_racl_of_isSmall [UniversalDomain k K] {C : Set K} (hC : IsSmall k C) :
    ∃ z : K, z ∉ racl k C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, -, hSfin, hS⟩ := hC.exists_finite_racl_eq
  rw [← hS]
  refine exists_notMem_racl_of_mk_lt_trdeg S ?_
  exact (Cardinal.lt_aleph0_iff_set_finite.2 hSfin).trans_le UniversalDomain.aleph0_le_trdeg

name: GroupConfig.exists_fresh_tuple
statement:
theorem exists_fresh_tuple [UniversalDomain k K] {C : Set K} (hC : IsSmall k C) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ t : Fin n → K, (rkMatroid k C).Indep (range t) ∧ Function.Injective t
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨Fin.elim0, ?_, fun i ↦ i.elim0⟩
    rw [range_eq_empty]
    exact (rkMatroid k C).empty_indep
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨t, htind, htinj⟩ := ih
    have hsmall : IsSmall k (C ∪ range t) := hC.union (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range t))
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_notMem_racl_of_isSmall hsmall
    have hzrange : z ∉ range t := fun hzt ↦ hz (subset_racl k _ (mem_union_right _ hzt))
    refine ⟨Fin.cons z t, ?_, Fin.cons_injective_iff.2 ⟨hzrange, htinj⟩⟩
    rw [Fin.range_cons, htind.insert_indep_iff]
    left
    refine ⟨mem_univ z, ?_⟩
    rw [mem_rkMatroid_closure_iff]
    exact hz

name: GroupConfig.erk_range_eq_of_indep_of_injective
proof:
:= by
  unfold erk
  rw [hind.eRk_eq_encard, hinj.encard_range, ENat.card_eq_coe_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fin]

name: GroupConfig.exists_erk_range_eq
statement:
theorem exists_erk_range_eq [UniversalDomain k K] {C : Set K} (hC : IsSmall k C) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ t : Fin n → K, erk k C (range t) = n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, hind, hinj⟩ := exists_fresh_tuple hC n
  exact ⟨t, erk_range_eq_of_indep_of_injective hind hinj⟩

name: GroupConfig.locusIdeal_eq_span
proof:
:= by
  unfold locusIdeal
  change Ideal.span _ = _
  congr 1
  ext f
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨fun m ↦ ⟨g.coeff m, (coeff_map _ _ _).symm⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [aeval_map_algebraMap]
    exact (mem_idealOf_iff L).1 hg
  · rintro ⟨hcoef, hf⟩
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ : f ∈ range (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap L K)) :=
      mem_range_map_iff_coeffs_subset.mpr fun c hc ↦ by
        obtain ⟨m, -, rfl⟩ := mem_coeffs_iff.mp hc
        exact hcoef m
    rw [aeval_map_algebraMap] at hf
    exact ⟨g, (mem_idealOf_iff L).2 hf, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.locusIdeal_congr
statement:
theorem locusIdeal_congr {L' : Type*} [Field L'] [Algebra L' K]
    (h : range (algebraMap L K) = range (algebraMap L' K)) (a : ι → K) :
    locusIdeal L a = locusIdeal L' a
proof:
:= by
  rw [locusIdeal_eq_span, locusIdeal_eq_span, h]

name: GroupConfig.range_algebraMap_coe
statement:
theorem range_algebraMap_coe {k' : Type*} [Field k'] [Algebra k' K]
    (L : IntermediateField k' K) : range (algebraMap (↥L) K) = (L : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact y.2
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.locusIdeal_extendScalars
statement:
theorem locusIdeal_extendScalars {F L : IntermediateField k K} (h : F ≤ L) (a : ι → K) :
    locusIdeal (↥(extendScalars h)) a = locusIdeal (↥L) a
proof:
:=
  locusIdeal_congr _ (by rw [range_algebraMap_coe, range_algebraMap_coe, coe_extendScalars]) a

name: GroupConfig.aeval_comp_map
statement:
theorem aeval_comp_map (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (a : ι → K) (f : MvPolynomial ι K) :
    aeval (σ ∘ a) (MvPolynomial.map σ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom f) = σ (aeval a f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [aeval_def, aeval_def, eval₂_map]
  change _ = σ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom (eval₂ (algebraMap K K) a f)
  rw [eval₂_comp_left, Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_comp, RingHom.comp_id]
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.locusIdeal_map
statement:
theorem locusIdeal_map (L : IntermediateField k K) (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (a : ι → K) :
    (locusIdeal (↥L) a).map (MvPolynomial.map σ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom) =
      locusIdeal (↥(L.map σ.toAlgHom)) (σ ∘ a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [locusIdeal_eq_span, locusIdeal_eq_span, Ideal.map_span, range_algebraMap_coe,
    range_algebraMap_coe, coe_map]
  congr 1
  ext f
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, ⟨hcoef, hg⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨fun m ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [coeff_map]
      exact ⟨g.coeff m, hcoef m, rfl⟩
    · rw [aeval_comp_map, hg, map_zero]
  · rintro ⟨hcoef, hf⟩
    refine ⟨MvPolynomial.map σ.symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom f, ⟨fun m ↦ ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [coeff_map]
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hyf⟩ := hcoef m
      rw [← hyf]
      simpa using hy
    · have hfun : ⇑σ.symm ∘ (⇑σ ∘ a) = a := funext fun i ↦ σ.symm_apply_apply (a i)
      have := aeval_comp_map σ.symm (σ ∘ a) f
      rw [hfun, hf, map_zero] at this
      exact this
    · have hcomp : σ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom.comp σ.symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom = RingHom.id K :=
        RingHom.ext fun x ↦ by simp
      rw [MvPolynomial.map_map, hcomp, MvPolynomial.map_id]

name: GroupConfig.idealDefinedOver_locusIdeal
statement:
theorem idealDefinedOver_locusIdeal (L : IntermediateField k K) (a : ι → K) :
    IdealDefinedOver L.toSubfield (locusIdeal (↥L) a)
proof:
:= by
  refine idealDefinedOver_of_le_span _ ?_
  conv_lhs => rw [locusIdeal_eq_span, range_algebraMap_coe]
  refine Ideal.span_le.2 fun f hf ↦ Ideal.subset_span ⟨?_, fun m ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [locusIdeal_eq_span, range_algebraMap_coe]
    exact Ideal.subset_span hf
  · exact (mem_toSubfield L _).2 (hf.1 m)

name: GroupConfig.locusIdeal_eq_of_idealDefinedOver
statement:
theorem locusIdeal_eq_of_idealDefinedOver {F L : IntermediateField k K} (hFL : F ≤ L)
    {a : ι → K} (h : IdealDefinedOver F.toSubfield (locusIdeal (↥L) a)) :
    locusIdeal (↥F) a = locusIdeal (↥L) a
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (locusIdeal_mono hFL a) ?_
  conv_lhs => rw [← IdealDefinedOver.span_eq _ h]
  refine Ideal.span_le.2 fun f hf ↦ ?_
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, locusIdeal_eq_span, range_algebraMap_coe]
  exact Ideal.subset_span
    ⟨fun m ↦ (mem_toSubfield F _).1 (hf.2 m), aeval_eq_zero_of_mem_locusIdeal (↥L) hf.1⟩

name: GroupConfig.locusIdeal_eq_iff_exists_algEquiv
statement:
theorem locusIdeal_eq_iff_exists_algEquiv [IsAlgClosed K] [Finite ι]
    (L : IntermediateField k K) (a b : ι → K) :
    locusIdeal (↥L) b = locusIdeal (↥L) a ↔ ∃ τ : K ≃ₐ[↥L] K, ∀ i, τ (a i) = b i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' : idealOf (↥L) a = idealOf (↥L) b := by
      rw [← locusIdeal_comap (↥L) a, ← locusIdeal_comap (↥L) b, h]
    obtain ⟨τ, -, hτ⟩ := exists_ambientAutomorphism_of_idealOf_eq (k := ↥L) h'
    exact ⟨τ, hτ⟩
  · rintro ⟨τ, hτ⟩
    have hb : b = ⇑(τ : K →ₐ[↥L] K) ∘ a := funext fun i ↦ (hτ i).symm
    rw [hb]
    unfold locusIdeal
    rw [idealOf_comp_algHom (↥L)]

name: GroupConfig.isRAC_of_isAlgClosed
statement:
theorem isRAC_of_isAlgClosed [IsAlgClosed K] (L : IntermediateField k K) [IsAlgClosed (↥L)] :
    IsRAC L
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hbot : algebraicClosure (↥L) K = ⊥ :=
    (IsAlgClosed.algebraicClosure_eq_bot_iff (↥L) K).2 inferInstance
  have hx' : x ∈ algebraicClosure (↥L) K := mem_algebraicClosure_iff.2 hx
  rw [hbot, IntermediateField.mem_bot] at hx'
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx'
  exact y.2

name: GroupConfig.racl_le_of_isAlgClosed
statement:
theorem racl_le_of_isAlgClosed [IsAlgClosed K] {L : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed (↥L)]
    {C : Set K} (hC : C ⊆ L) : racl k C ≤ L
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isRAC_iff_racl_eq.1 (isRAC_of_isAlgClosed L)]
  exact racl_mono (k := k) hC

name: GroupConfig.isAlgClosed_racl
statement: theorem isAlgClosed_racl [IsAlgClosed K] (C : Set K) : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k C)
proof:
:= by
  apply (IsAlgClosed.algebraicClosure_eq_bot_iff ↥(racl k C) K).mp
  apply bot_unique
  intro x hx
  exact IntermediateField.mem_bot.mpr
    ⟨⟨x, isRAC_racl C x (mem_algebraicClosure_iff.mp hx)⟩, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.IndepOver.of_union_right
statement:
theorem IndepOver.of_union_right {C A B E : Set K} (h : IndepOver k C E (A ∪ B)) :
    IndepOver k (C ∪ B) E A
proof:
:= by
  intro e he hfin
  have h1 : erk k (C ∪ (A ∪ B)) e = erk k C e := h he hfin
  have h4 : C ∪ B ∪ A = C ∪ (A ∪ B) := by rw [union_assoc, union_comm B A]
  refine le_antisymm (erk_base_mono k subset_union_left e) ?_
  calc erk k (C ∪ B) e ≤ erk k C e := erk_base_mono k subset_union_left e
    _ = erk k (C ∪ B ∪ A) e := by rw [h4, h1]

name: GroupConfig.locusIdeal_eq_of_indepOver
statement:
theorem locusIdeal_eq_of_indepOver [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K]
    {L M : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed (↥L)] (hL : IsSmall k (L : Set K))
    (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K)) (hLM : L ≤ M) {a : ι → K}
    (h : IndepOver k (L : Set K) (range a) (M : Set K)) :
    locusIdeal (↥M) a = locusIdeal (↥L) a
proof:
:= by
  have _ : UniversalDomain (↥L) K := universalDomain_of_isSmall L hL
  have hind : IndepOver (↥L) ∅ (range a) (M : Set K) := by
    rw [← indepOver_coe_union_iff, union_empty]
    exact h
  have hgen : IsGenericOver (k := ↥L) (extendScalars hLM) a a :=
    isGenericOver_self_of_indepOver (isSmall_coe_of_isSmall L hM) hind
  rw [← locusIdeal_extendScalars hLM a]
  exact hgen.locusIdeal_eq

name: GroupConfig.canonicalBase_le
statement: theorem canonicalBase_le (L : IntermediateField k K) (a : ι → K) : canonicalBase L a ≤ L
proof:
:= by
  refine adjoin_le_iff.2 fun x hx ↦ ?_
  exact (mem_toSubfield L x).1 (idealDefinedOver_iff.1 (idealDefinedOver_locusIdeal L a) hx)

name: GroupConfig.isSmall_canonicalBase
statement:
theorem isSmall_canonicalBase (L : IntermediateField k K) (a : ι → K) :
    IsSmall k (canonicalBase L a : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_finset_closure_eq_idealFod (locusIdeal (↥L) a)
  have hle : canonicalBase L a ≤ racl k (s : Set K) := by
    refine adjoin_le_iff.2 ?_
    rw [← hs]
    intro x hx
    exact (Subfield.closure_le (t := (racl k (s : Set K)).toSubfield)).2
      (subset_racl k (s : Set K)) hx
  exact ((IsSmall.of_finite s.finite_toSet).racl).mono hle

name: GroupConfig.canonicalBase_eq_of_indepOver
statement:
theorem canonicalBase_eq_of_indepOver [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K]
    {L M : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed (↥L)] (hL : IsSmall k (L : Set K))
    (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K)) (hLM : L ≤ M) {a : ι → K}
    (h : IndepOver k (L : Set K) (range a) (M : Set K)) :
    canonicalBase M a = canonicalBase L a
proof:
:= by
  unfold canonicalBase
  rw [locusIdeal_eq_of_indepOver hL hM hLM h]

name: GroupConfig.erk_canonicalBase_eq
statement:
theorem erk_canonicalBase_eq [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K] (L : IntermediateField k K)
    [IsAlgClosed (↥L)] (hL : IsSmall k (L : Set K)) (a : ι → K) :
    erk k (canonicalBase L a : Set K) (range a) = erk k (L : Set K) (range a)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hFL : racl k (canonicalBase L a : Set K) ≤ L := racl_le_of_isAlgClosed (canonicalBase_le L a)
  have hFsmall : IsSmall k ((racl k (canonicalBase L a : Set K) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (isSmall_canonicalBase L a).racl
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (canonicalBase L a : Set K)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  
  have hdef : IdealDefinedOver (racl k (canonicalBase L a : Set K)).toSubfield
      (locusIdeal (↥L) a) := by
    refine idealDefinedOver_iff.2 fun x hx ↦ ?_
    exact (mem_toSubfield _ x).2 (subset_racl k _ (subset_adjoin k _ hx))
  have hloc := locusIdeal_eq_of_idealDefinedOver hFL hdef
  
  have _ : UniversalDomain ↥(racl k (canonicalBase L a : Set K)) K :=
    universalDomain_of_isSmall _ hFsmall
  have hgen : IsGenericOver (k := ↥(racl k (canonicalBase L a : Set K))) (extendScalars hFL)
      a a := by
    rw [isGenericOver_iff_locusIdeal_eq, locusIdeal_extendScalars, hloc]
  have hind := (isGenericOver_self_iff (M := extendScalars hFL)
    (isSmall_coe_of_isSmall _ hL)).1 hgen
  have hind' : IndepOver k ((racl k (canonicalBase L a : Set K) : Set K) ∪ ∅) (range a)
      (L : Set K) := by
    rw [indepOver_coe_union_iff]
    exact hind
  rw [union_empty] at hind'
  have h := hind' (subset_refl _) (finite_range a)
  rw [union_eq_right.2 (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 hFL), erk_racl_base] at h
  exact h.symm

name: GroupConfig.indepOver_iff_canonicalBase_le
statement:
theorem indepOver_iff_canonicalBase_le [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K]
    {C L : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed (↥C)] [IsAlgClosed (↥L)]
    (hL : IsSmall k (L : Set K)) (hCL : C ≤ L) (a : ι → K) :
    IndepOver k (C : Set K) (range a) (L : Set K) ↔ canonicalBase L a ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [canonicalBase_eq_of_indepOver (hL.mono hCL) hL hCL h]
    exact canonicalBase_le C a
  · intro h
    have h1 := erk_canonicalBase_eq L hL a
    have hle1 : erk k (L : Set K) (range a) ≤ erk k (C : Set K) (range a) :=
      erk_base_mono k (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 hCL) _
    have hle2 : erk k (C : Set K) (range a) ≤ erk k (canonicalBase L a : Set K) (range a) :=
      erk_base_mono k (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 h) _
    have heq : erk k (C : Set K) (range a) = erk k (L : Set K) (range a) :=
      le_antisymm (hle2.trans h1.le) hle1
    refine indepOver_of_erk_eq (finite_range a) ?_
    rw [union_eq_right.2 (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 hCL), heq]

name: GroupConfig.canonicalBase_map
statement:
theorem canonicalBase_map (L : IntermediateField k K) (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (a : ι → K) :
    canonicalBase (L.map σ.toAlgHom) (σ ∘ a) = (canonicalBase L a).map σ.toAlgHom
proof:
:= by
  unfold canonicalBase
  rw [adjoin_map, ← locusIdeal_map, idealFod_map, Subfield.coe_map]
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.mem_fixedBy
statement: theorem mem_fixedBy {σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K} {x : K} : x ∈ fixedBy σ ↔ σ x = x
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: GroupConfig.map_eq_self_of_fixes
statement:
theorem map_eq_self_of_fixes (L : IntermediateField k K) (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K)
    (hσ : ∀ x ∈ L, σ x = x) : L.map σ.toAlgHom = L
proof:
:= by
  refine SetLike.ext' ?_
  rw [coe_map, image_congr (f := ⇑σ.toAlgHom) (g := id) fun x hx ↦ hσ x hx, image_id]

name: GroupConfig.fixes_canonicalBase_iff
statement:
theorem fixes_canonicalBase_iff (L : IntermediateField k K) (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K)
    (hσ : ∀ x ∈ L, σ x = x) (a : ι → K) :
    (∀ x ∈ canonicalBase L a, σ x = x) ↔ locusIdeal (↥L) (σ ∘ a) = locusIdeal (↥L) a
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : locusIdeal (↥L) (σ ∘ a) =
      (locusIdeal (↥L) a).map (MvPolynomial.map σ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom) := by
    have h := locusIdeal_map L σ a
    rw [map_eq_self_of_fixes L σ hσ] at h
    exact h.symm
  rw [hmap, ideal_map_eq_self_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h x hx
    exact h x (subset_adjoin k _ hx)
  · intro h
    have hle : canonicalBase L a ≤ fixedBy σ := adjoin_le_iff.2 fun x hx ↦ h x hx
    exact fun x hx ↦ hle hx

name: GroupConfig.fixes_canonicalBase_iff_exists_algEquiv
statement:
theorem fixes_canonicalBase_iff_exists_algEquiv [IsAlgClosed K] (L : IntermediateField k K)
    (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (hσ : ∀ x ∈ L, σ x = x) (a : ι → K) :
    (∀ x ∈ canonicalBase L a, σ x = x) ↔ ∃ τ : K ≃ₐ[↥L] K, ∀ i, τ (a i) = σ (a i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fixes_canonicalBase_iff L σ hσ a, locusIdeal_eq_iff_exists_algEquiv]
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.canonicalBase_eq_of_indepOver_of_indepOver
statement:
theorem canonicalBase_eq_of_indepOver_of_indepOver [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K]
    {L L' : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed (↥L)] [IsAlgClosed (↥L')]
    (hL : IsSmall k (L : Set K)) (hL' : IsSmall k (L' : Set K)) {a : ι → K}
    (h1 : IndepOver k (L : Set K) (range a) (L' : Set K))
    (h2 : IndepOver k (L' : Set K) (range a) (L : Set K)) :
    canonicalBase L a = canonicalBase L' a ∧
      canonicalBase L a = canonicalBase (racl k ((L : Set K) ∪ (L' : Set K))) a
proof:
:= by
  have hM : IsSmall k ((racl k ((L : Set K) ∪ (L' : Set K)) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (hL.union hL').racl
  have e1 : canonicalBase (racl k ((L : Set K) ∪ (L' : Set K))) a = canonicalBase L a :=
    canonicalBase_eq_of_indepOver hL hM (subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _))
      (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 h1)
  have e2 : canonicalBase (racl k ((L : Set K) ∪ (L' : Set K))) a = canonicalBase L' a := by
    rw [union_comm]
    exact canonicalBase_eq_of_indepOver hL' (by rwa [union_comm])
      (subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)) (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 h2)
  exact ⟨e1.symm.trans e2, e1.symm⟩

name: GroupConfig.racl_canonicalBase_le_of_racl_eq_aux
statement:
private theorem racl_canonicalBase_le_of_racl_eq_aux [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K]
    {L : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed (↥L)] (hL : IsSmall k (L : Set K))
    {κ : Type*} [Finite κ] {a : ι → K} {a' : κ → K}
    (h : racl k (range a) = racl k (range a')) :
    racl k (canonicalBase L a : Set K) ≤ racl k (canonicalBase L a' : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (canonicalBase L a' : Set K)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hCL : racl k (canonicalBase L a' : Set K) ≤ L :=
    racl_le_of_isAlgClosed (canonicalBase_le L a')
  have hind' : IndepOver k ((racl k (canonicalBase L a' : Set K) : IntermediateField k K) :
      Set K) (range a') (L : Set K) := by
    refine indepOver_of_erk_eq (finite_range a') ?_
    rw [union_eq_right.2 (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 hCL), erk_racl_base,
      erk_canonicalBase_eq L hL a']
  have hind : IndepOver k ((racl k (canonicalBase L a' : Set K) : IntermediateField k K) :
      Set K) (range a) (L : Set K) := by
    refine (indepOver_racl_left_iff.2 hind').mono_left ?_
    calc range a ⊆ (racl k (range a) : Set K) := subset_racl k _
      _ = (racl k (range a') : Set K) := by rw [h]
      _ ⊆ (racl k (((racl k (canonicalBase L a' : Set K) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) ∪
          range a') : Set K) := racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_right
  exact racl_le_of_subset_racl ((indepOver_iff_canonicalBase_le hL hCL a).1 hind)

name: GroupConfig.racl_canonicalBase_eq_of_racl_eq
statement:
theorem racl_canonicalBase_eq_of_racl_eq [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K]
    {L : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed (↥L)] (hL : IsSmall k (L : Set K))
    {κ : Type*} [Finite κ] {a : ι → K} {a' : κ → K}
    (h : racl k (range a) = racl k (range a')) :
    racl k (canonicalBase L a : Set K) = racl k (canonicalBase L a' : Set K)
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (racl_canonicalBase_le_of_racl_eq_aux hL h)
    (racl_canonicalBase_le_of_racl_eq_aux hL h.symm)

name: GroupConfig.canonicalBase_racl_union_eq
statement:
theorem canonicalBase_racl_union_eq [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K]
    {L : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed (↥L)] (hL : IsSmall k (L : Set K)) {E : Set K}
    (hE : IsSmall k E) {a : ι → K} (h : IndepOver k ∅ E (range a ∪ L)) :
    canonicalBase (racl k ((L : Set K) ∪ E)) a = canonicalBase L a
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : IndepOver k (∅ ∪ (L : Set K)) E (range a) := h.of_union_right
  rw [empty_union] at h1
  have h2 : IndepOver k (L : Set K) (range a) (racl k ((L : Set K) ∪ E)) :=
    indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 h1.symm
  exact canonicalBase_eq_of_indepOver hL (hL.union hE).racl
    (subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)) h2

name: GroupConfig.mem_racl_base_iff
statement:
theorem mem_racl_base_iff (S : Set K) (x : K) :
    x ∈ racl (↥K₀) S ↔ x ∈ racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_racl_iff (↥K₀), mem_racl_iff k, ← restrictScalars_adjoin]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ h, fun h ↦ h⟩

name: GroupConfig.racl_base_coe
statement:
theorem racl_base_coe (S : Set K) :
    ((racl (↥K₀) S : IntermediateField (↥K₀) K) : Set K) =
      ((racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K)
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun x ↦ mem_racl_base_iff K₀ S x

name: GroupConfig.racl_base_congr
statement: theorem racl_base_congr {S T : Set K} (h : racl k S = racl k T) : racl (↥K₀) S = racl (↥K₀) T
proof:
:= by
  apply SetLike.coe_injective
  rw [racl_base_coe, racl_base_coe, ← racl_union_right, h, racl_union_right]

name: GroupConfig.erk_base_empty
statement: theorem erk_base_empty (X : Set K) : erk (↥K₀) ∅ X = erk k (K₀ : Set K) X
proof:
:= by
  rw [erk_empty_eq (↥K₀), ← erk_coe_eq k K₀]

name: GroupConfig.indepOver_base_iff
statement:
theorem indepOver_base_iff (A B : Set K) :
    IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ A B ↔ IndepOver k (K₀ : Set K) A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [← indepOver_coe_union_iff K₀ ∅ A B, union_empty]

name: GroupConfig.racl_union_adjoin
statement:
theorem racl_union_adjoin (A B : Set K) :
    racl k (A ∪ (adjoin k B : IntermediateField k K)) = racl k (A ∪ B)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset ?_ ?_)) ?_
  · exact subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
  · exact (adjoin_le_racl k B).trans (racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_right)
  · exact racl_mono (k := k) (union_subset_union_right _ (subset_adjoin k B))

name: GroupConfig.locusIdeal_racl_base
statement:
theorem locusIdeal_racl_base (S : Set K) (t : ι → K) :
    locusIdeal (↥(racl (↥K₀) S)) t = locusIdeal (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S))) t
proof:
:=
  locusIdeal_congr _ (by rw [range_algebraMap_coe, range_algebraMap_coe, racl_base_coe]) t

name: GroupConfig.racl_canonicalBase_base
statement:
theorem racl_canonicalBase_base [Finite ι] (S : Set K) (t : ι → K) :
    ((racl (↥K₀) (canonicalBase (racl (↥K₀) S) t : Set K) : IntermediateField (↥K₀) K) :
        Set K) =
      ((racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ (canonicalBase (racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S)) t : Set K)) :
        IntermediateField k K) : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  unfold canonicalBase
  have e1 : ((adjoin (↥K₀) (idealFod (locusIdeal (↥(racl (↥K₀) S)) t) : Set K) :
      IntermediateField (↥K₀) K) : Set K) =
      ((adjoin k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ (idealFod (locusIdeal (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S))) t) :
        Set K)) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) := by
    rw [locusIdeal_racl_base, ← restrictScalars_adjoin, coe_restrictScalars]
  rw [racl_base_coe, e1, racl_union_adjoin, ← union_assoc, union_self, racl_union_adjoin]

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.gcPoints_subset
statement:
theorem gcPoints_subset (i : Fin 6) :
    gcPoints a b c x y z i ⊆
      range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · exact subset_union_left.trans (subset_union_left.trans (subset_union_left.trans
      (subset_union_left.trans subset_union_left)))
  · exact subset_union_right.trans (subset_union_left.trans (subset_union_left.trans
      (subset_union_left.trans subset_union_left)))
  · exact subset_union_right.trans (subset_union_left.trans (subset_union_left.trans
      subset_union_left))
  · exact subset_union_right.trans (subset_union_left.trans subset_union_left)
  · exact subset_union_right.trans subset_union_left
  · exact subset_union_right

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.cb_baseChange
proof:
:= by
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (range p)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  rw [racl_canonicalBase_base, union_comm (K₀ : Set K) (range p),
    ← racl_union_left (range p) (K₀ : Set K),
    canonicalBase_racl_union_eq (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range p)).racl hs]
  · exact h.trans (racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_right)
  · refine (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hW).mono_right ?_
    rw [empty_union]
    exact union_subset (ht.trans (subset_racl k _)) (racl_mono (k := k) hp)

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.baseChange
statement:
theorem baseChange (K₀ : IntermediateField k K) (hs : IsSmall k (K₀ : Set K))
    (he : IndepOver k ∅ (K₀ : Set K)
      (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z)) :
    GroupConfiguration (↥K₀) a b c x y z
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ X ⊆ range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z,
      X.Finite → erk (↥K₀) ∅ X = erk k ∅ X := fun X hX hfin ↦ by
    rw [erk_base_empty]
    have := (he.symm.mono_left hX).erk_eq (subset_refl _) hfin
    rwa [empty_union] at this
  have hall : (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z).Finite :=
    (((((finite_range a).union (finite_range b)).union (finite_range c)).union
      (finite_range x)).union (finite_range y)).union (finite_range z)
  have hracl : ∀ A B : Set K, racl k A = racl k B →
      racl (↥K₀) A = racl (↥K₀) B := fun A B h ↦
    SetLike.coe_injective (by rw [racl_base_coe, racl_base_coe, racl_union_congr rfl h])
  exact
    { racl_ab_ac := hracl _ _ hc.racl_ab_ac
      racl_ab_bc := hracl _ _ hc.racl_ab_bc
      racl_ax_ay := hracl _ _ hc.racl_ax_ay
      racl_by_bz := hracl _ _ hc.racl_by_bz
      racl_cx_cz := hracl _ _ hc.racl_cx_cz
      indep i j l hij hil hjl hcol := by
        have h := hc.indep i j l hij hil hjl hcol
        unfold IndepTriple at h ⊢
        rw [key _ (union_subset (union_subset (gcPoints_subset i) (gcPoints_subset j))
            (gcPoints_subset l)) (((gcPoints_finite a b c x y z i).union
            (gcPoints_finite a b c x y z j)).union (gcPoints_finite a b c x y z l)),
          key _ (gcPoints_subset i) (gcPoints_finite a b c x y z i),
          key _ (gcPoints_subset j) (gcPoints_finite a b c x y z j),
          key _ (gcPoints_subset l) (gcPoints_finite a b c x y z l)]
        exact h
      cb_a := cb_baseChange K₀ hs he (gcPoints_subset (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) (x := x)
        (y := y) (z := z) 0) (by
          rw [Sum.elim_range]
          exact union_subset (gcPoints_subset (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) (x := x) (y := y)
            (z := z) 3) (gcPoints_subset (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) (x := x) (y := y)
            (z := z) 4)) hc.cb_a
      cb_b := cb_baseChange K₀ hs he (gcPoints_subset (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) (x := x)
        (y := y) (z := z) 1) (by
          rw [Sum.elim_range]
          exact union_subset (gcPoints_subset (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) (x := x) (y := y)
            (z := z) 4) (gcPoints_subset (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) (x := x) (y := y)
            (z := z) 5)) hc.cb_b
      cb_c := cb_baseChange K₀ hs he (gcPoints_subset (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) (x := x)
        (y := y) (z := z) 2) (by
          rw [Sum.elim_range]
          exact union_subset (gcPoints_subset (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) (x := x) (y := y)
            (z := z) 3) (gcPoints_subset (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) (x := x) (y := y)
            (z := z) 5)) hc.cb_c
      one_le_erk := by
        rw [key (range a) (gcPoints_subset (a := a) (b := b) (c := c) (x := x) (y := y)
          (z := z) 0) (finite_range a)]
        exact hc.one_le_erk }

name: GroupConfig.subset_racl_line
statement:
private theorem subset_racl_line :
    ({s, s', t} : Set K) ⊆ racl k (range ![t, s * t + s'] ∪ {s})
proof:
:= by
  have ht : t ∈ racl k (range ![t, s * t + s'] ∪ {s}) :=
    subset_racl k _ (Or.inl ⟨0, by simp⟩)
  have hst : s * t + s' ∈ racl k (range ![t, s * t + s'] ∪ {s}) :=
    subset_racl k _ (Or.inl ⟨1, by simp⟩)
  have hs : s ∈ racl k (range ![t, s * t + s'] ∪ {s}) := subset_racl k _ (Or.inr rfl)
  have hs' : s' ∈ racl k (range ![t, s * t + s'] ∪ {s}) := by
    have h := sub_mem hst (mul_mem hs ht)
    rwa [add_sub_cancel_left] at h
  rintro x (rfl | rfl | rfl)
  exacts [hs, hs', ht]

name: GroupConfig.three_le_erk_line
statement: private theorem three_le_erk_line : 3 ≤ erk k ∅ (range ![t, s * t + s'] ∪ {s})
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hind, ← erk_racl k ∅ (range ![t, s * t + s'] ∪ {s}), empty_union]
  exact erk_mono k ∅ subset_racl_line

name: GroupConfig.erk_line
statement: theorem erk_line : erk k ∅ (range ![t, s * t + s']) = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hpair : range ![t, s * t + s'] = {t, s * t + s'} := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_range, Fin.exists_fin_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      mem_insert_iff, mem_singleton_iff]
    tauto
  have hle : erk k ∅ (range ![t, s * t + s']) ≤ 2 := by
    refine (erk_le_encard k ∅ _).trans ?_
    rw [hpair]
    exact (encard_insert_le _ _).trans (by rw [encard_singleton]; norm_num)
  have hs1 : erk k ∅ ({s} : Set K) ≤ 1 := (erk_le_encard k ∅ _).trans (by simp)
  have h3 : (2 : ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ erk k ∅ (range ![t, s * t + s']) + 1 :=
    calc (2 : ℕ∞) + 1 = 3 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ _ := three_le_erk_line hind
      _ ≤ _ := erk_union_le k ∅ _ _
      _ ≤ _ := add_le_add_right hs1 _
  exact le_antisymm hle ((ENat.add_le_add_iff_right ENat.one_ne_top).1 h3)

name: GroupConfig.not_mem_racl_line
statement: theorem not_mem_racl_line : s ∉ racl k (range ![t, s * t + s'])
proof:
:= by
  intro hs
  have hsub : range ![t, s * t + s'] ∪ {s} ⊆ racl k (∅ ∪ range ![t, s * t + s']) := by
    rw [empty_union]
    exact union_subset (subset_racl k _) (singleton_subset_iff.2 hs)
  have hle := (erk_mono k ∅ hsub).trans_eq (erk_racl k ∅ _)
  rw [erk_line hind] at hle
  have h := (three_le_erk_line hind).trans hle
  norm_num at h

name: GroupConfig.transcendental_line
statement:
private theorem transcendental_line (hind : erk k ∅ ({s, s', t} : Set K) = 3) :
    Transcendental (↥(racl k ({s, s'} : Set K))) t
proof:
:= by
  intro halg
  have ht : t ∈ racl k ({s, s'} : Set K) := by
    rw [← racl_racl k ({s, s'} : Set K)]
    refine (mem_racl_iff k).2 ?_
    rw [adjoin_self]
    exact halg
  have hsub : ({s, s', t} : Set K) ⊆ racl k (∅ ∪ ({s, s'} : Set K)) := by
    rw [empty_union]
    rintro x (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    exacts [subset_racl k _ (Or.inl rfl), subset_racl k _ (Or.inr rfl), ht]
  have h := (erk_mono k ∅ hsub).trans_eq (erk_racl k ∅ _)
  rw [hind] at h
  have h2 : (3 : ℕ∞) ≤ 1 + 1 := h.trans ((erk_le_encard k ∅ _).trans
    ((encard_insert_le _ _).trans (by rw [encard_singleton])))
  norm_num at h2

name: GroupConfig.unshiftL_comp_shiftL
statement:
private theorem unshiftL_comp_shiftL :
    (unshiftL L hs hs').comp (shiftL L hs hs') = AlgHom.id L _
proof:
:= by
  refine MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun i ↦ ?_
  fin_cases i
  · simp [shiftL, unshiftL, lineL]
  · simp [shiftL, unshiftL, lineL]
    ring

name: GroupConfig.aeval_comp_shiftL
statement:
private theorem aeval_comp_shiftL :
    (aeval ![(0 : K), t]).comp (shiftL L hs hs') = aeval ![t, s * t + s']
proof:
:= by
  refine MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun i ↦ ?_
  fin_cases i <;> simp [shiftL]

name: GroupConfig.X_zero_dvd_sub_aeval
statement:
private theorem X_zero_dvd_sub_aeval (q : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) L) :
    X 0 ∣ q - aeval ![(0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) L), X 1] q
proof:
:= by
  induction q using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a => simp
  | add p q hp hq =>
    rw [map_add, add_sub_add_comm]
    exact dvd_add hp hq
  | mul_X p i hp =>
    fin_cases i
    · simp only [map_mul, aeval_X, Fin.zero_eta, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_zero, mul_zero,
        sub_zero]
      exact dvd_mul_left _ _
    · simp only [map_mul, aeval_X, Fin.mk_one, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_one,
        Matrix.cons_val_fin_one]
      rw [← sub_mul]
      exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left hp _

name: GroupConfig.X_zero_dvd_of_aeval_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem X_zero_dvd_of_aeval_eq_zero (ht : Transcendental L t)
    {q : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) L} (hq : aeval ![(0 : K), t] q = 0) : X 0 ∣ q
proof:
:= by
  
  have hcomp : (aeval ![(0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) L), X 1] :
      MvPolynomial (Fin 2) L →ₐ[L] MvPolynomial (Fin 2) L) =
        (rename fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ (1 : Fin 2)).comp
          (aeval ![(0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 1) L), X 0]) := by
    refine MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun i ↦ ?_
    fin_cases i <;> simp
  have hkill : (aeval ![(0 : K), t]).comp
      (aeval ![(0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) L), X 1]) = aeval ![(0 : K), t] := by
    refine MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun i ↦ ?_
    fin_cases i <;> simp
  have hr : aeval ![t] (aeval ![(0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 1) L), X 0] q) = 0 := by
    have h1 : aeval ![(0 : K), t] (rename (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ (1 : Fin 2))
        (aeval ![(0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 1) L), X 0] q)) =
          aeval ![t] (aeval ![(0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 1) L), X 0] q) := by
      have hf : (![(0 : K), t] ∘ fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ (1 : Fin 2)) = ![t] := by
        funext i
        fin_cases i
        rfl
      rw [aeval_rename, hf]
    rw [← h1, ← AlgHom.comp_apply (rename _), ← hcomp, ← AlgHom.comp_apply, hkill, hq]
  have hinj : Function.Injective (aeval ![t] : MvPolynomial (Fin 1) L →ₐ[L] K) :=
    (algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff (x := ![t])).2 ht
  have hr0 := hinj (hr.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  have h := X_zero_dvd_sub_aeval L q
  rwa [hcomp, AlgHom.comp_apply, hr0, map_zero, sub_zero] at h

name: GroupConfig.idealOf_line
statement:
private theorem idealOf_line (ht : Transcendental L t) :
    idealOf (↥L) ![t, s * t + s'] = Ideal.span {lineL L hs hs'}
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun p hp ↦ ?_) ((Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem _).2 ?_)
  · rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    have hq : aeval ![(0 : K), t] (shiftL L hs hs' p) = 0 := by
      rw [← AlgHom.comp_apply, aeval_comp_shiftL]
      exact (mem_idealOf_iff _).1 hp
    have h := map_dvd (unshiftL L hs hs') (X_zero_dvd_of_aeval_eq_zero L ht hq)
    rwa [← AlgHom.comp_apply (unshiftL L hs hs'), unshiftL_comp_shiftL, AlgHom.id_apply,
      show unshiftL L hs hs' (X 0) = lineL L hs hs' by simp [unshiftL]] at h
  · rw [mem_idealOf_iff]
    simp [lineL]

name: GroupConfig.locusIdeal_affineLine
proof:
:= by
  unfold locusIdeal
  rw [idealOf_line L hs hs' ht, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  simp [lineL]

name: GroupConfig.locusIdeal_line
proof:
:=
  locusIdeal_affineLine _ (subset_racl k _ (Or.inl rfl)) (subset_racl k _ (Or.inr rfl))
    (transcendental_line hind)

name: GroupConfig.coeff_line
statement:
private theorem coeff_line (m : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) :
    (X 1 - C s * X 0 - C s' : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K).coeff m =
      (if Finsupp.single 1 1 = m then 1 else 0) -
        s * (if Finsupp.single 0 1 = m then 1 else 0) - (if 0 = m then s' else 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coeff_sub, coeff_C_mul, coeff_X, coeff_C]

name: GroupConfig.coeff_line_one
statement:
private theorem coeff_line_one :
    (X 1 - C s * X 0 - C s' : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K).coeff (Finsupp.single 1 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : (0 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) ≠ Finsupp.single 1 1 := (Finsupp.single_ne_zero.2 one_ne_zero).symm
  rw [coeff_line]
  simp [Finsupp.single_left_inj, h]

name: GroupConfig.coeff_line_zero
statement:
private theorem coeff_line_zero :
    (X 1 - C s * X 0 - C s' : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K).coeff (Finsupp.single 0 1) = -s
proof:
:= by
  have h : (0 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) ≠ Finsupp.single 0 1 := (Finsupp.single_ne_zero.2 one_ne_zero).symm
  rw [coeff_line]
  simp [Finsupp.single_left_inj, h]

name: GroupConfig.coeff_line_const
statement:
private theorem coeff_line_const :
    (X 1 - C s * X 0 - C s' : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K).coeff 0 = -s'
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_line]
  simp

name: GroupConfig.canonicalBase_affineLine
statement:
theorem canonicalBase_affineLine {s s' t : K} (L : IntermediateField k K) (hs : s ∈ L)
    (hs' : s' ∈ L) (ht : Transcendental (↥L) t) :
    canonicalBase L ![t, s * t + s'] = adjoin k ({s, s'} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  unfold canonicalBase
  rw [locusIdeal_affineLine L hs hs' ht]
  have hg1 := coeff_line_one (s := s) (s' := s')
  have hg0 := coeff_line_zero (s := s) (s' := s')
  have hgc := coeff_line_const (s := s) (s' := s')
  have hgdeg : (X 1 - C s * X 0 - C s' : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K).totalDegree ≤ 1 := by
    refine (totalDegree_sub _ _).trans (max_le ((totalDegree_sub _ _).trans (max_le ?_ ?_)) ?_)
    · simp [totalDegree_X]
    · exact (totalDegree_mul _ _).trans (by simp [totalDegree_X, totalDegree_C])
    · simp [totalDegree_C]
  have hgdeg1 : 1 ≤ (X 1 - C s * X 0 - C s' : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K).totalDegree := by
    have h := le_totalDegree (s := Finsupp.single 1 1)
      (p := (X 1 - C s * X 0 - C s' : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K))
      (by rw [mem_support_iff, hg1]; exact one_ne_zero)
    simpa using h
  have hg0' : (X 1 - C s * X 0 - C s' : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    simp [h] at hg1
  refine le_antisymm (adjoin_le_iff.2 ?_) (adjoin_le_iff.2 ?_)
  · 
    have hs : s ∈ adjoin k ({s, s'} : Set K) := subset_adjoin k _ (Or.inl rfl)
    have hs' : s' ∈ adjoin k ({s, s'} : Set K) := subset_adjoin k _ (Or.inr rfl)
    have hdef : IdealDefinedOver (adjoin k ({s, s'} : Set K)).toSubfield
        (Ideal.span {(X 1 - C s * X 0 - C s' : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K)}) := by
      refine idealDefinedOver_of_le_span _ (Ideal.span_le.2 ?_)
      rintro _ rfl
      refine Ideal.subset_span ⟨Ideal.subset_span rfl, fun m ↦ ?_⟩
      rw [coeff_line]
      refine sub_mem (sub_mem ?_ (mul_mem hs ?_)) ?_ <;> split_ifs <;>
        first | exact one_mem _ | exact zero_mem _ | exact hs'
    exact fun x hx ↦ idealDefinedOver_iff.1 hdef hx
  · 
    set I := Ideal.span {(X 1 - C s * X 0 - C s' : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K)} with hI
    have hF : degSubspace I 1 = Submodule.span K
        {v | v ∈ degSubspace I 1 ∧ ∀ ν, v ν ∈ idealFod I} :=
      degSubspace_definedOver _ (idealDefinedOver_idealFod I) 1
    have hw₀ : coeffVec 1 (X 1 - C s * X 0 - C s' : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) ∈ degSubspace I 1 :=
      coeffVec_mem_degSubspace (Ideal.subset_span rfl) hgdeg
    let m₁ : Monomials (Fin 2) 1 := ⟨Finsupp.single 1 1, by simp⟩
    let m₀ : Monomials (Fin 2) 1 := ⟨Finsupp.single 0 1, by simp⟩
    let mc : Monomials (Fin 2) 1 := ⟨0, by simp⟩
    obtain ⟨v, ⟨hvW, hvF⟩, hv0⟩ :
        ∃ v ∈ {v | v ∈ degSubspace I 1 ∧ ∀ ν, v ν ∈ idealFod I}, v ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      push Not at hne
      have hbot : degSubspace I 1 = ⊥ := by
        rw [hF, Submodule.span_eq_bot]
        exact hne
      have h1 := congrFun (show coeffVec 1 (X 1 - C s * X 0 - C s' : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) = 0
        from (Submodule.mem_bot K).1 (hbot ▸ hw₀)) m₁
      rw [coeffVec_apply, hg1] at h1
      exact one_ne_zero h1
    obtain ⟨f, hfI, hfdeg, rfl⟩ := mem_degSubspace_iff.1 hvW
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 hfI
    have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      exact hv0 (by rw [zero_mul, map_zero])
    have hcdeg : c.totalDegree = 0 := by
      rw [totalDegree_mul_of_isDomain hc0 hg0'] at hfdeg
      omega
    obtain ⟨c₀, rfl⟩ : ∃ c₀, c = C c₀ := ⟨_, totalDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C.1 hcdeg⟩
    have hv : ∀ ν : Monomials (Fin 2) 1, coeffVec 1 (C c₀ * (X 1 - C s * X 0 - C s')) ν =
        c₀ * (X 1 - C s * X 0 - C s' : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K).coeff ν.1 := fun ν ↦ by
      rw [coeffVec_apply, coeff_C_mul]
    have h₁ := hvF m₁
    have h₀ := hvF m₀
    have hc := hvF mc
    rw [hv, hg1, mul_one] at h₁
    rw [hv, hg0] at h₀
    rw [hv, hgc] at hc
    have hc' : c₀ ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      exact hc0 (map_zero _)
    have hsF : s ∈ idealFod I := by
      have h := (idealFod I).div_mem (neg_mem h₀) h₁
      rwa [mul_neg, neg_neg, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hc'] at h
    have hs'F : s' ∈ idealFod I := by
      have h := (idealFod I).div_mem (neg_mem hc) h₁
      rwa [mul_neg, neg_neg, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hc'] at h
    rintro x (rfl | rfl)
    exacts [subset_adjoin k _ hsF, subset_adjoin k _ hs'F]

name: GroupConfig.canonicalBase_line
statement:
theorem canonicalBase_line {s s' t : K} (hind : erk k ∅ ({s, s', t} : Set K) = 3) :
    canonicalBase (racl k ({s, s'} : Set K)) ![t, s * t + s'] =
      adjoin k ({s, s'} : Set K)
proof:
:=
  canonicalBase_affineLine _ (subset_racl k _ (Or.inl rfl)) (subset_racl k _ (Or.inr rfl))
    (transcendental_line hind)

name: GroupConfig.canonicalBase_line_not_subset_racl
statement:
theorem canonicalBase_line_not_subset_racl {s s' t : K}
    (hind : erk k ∅ ({s, s', t} : Set K) = 3) :
    ¬ ((canonicalBase (racl k ({s, s'} : Set K)) ![t, s * t + s'] : Set K) ⊆
      racl k (range ![t, s * t + s']))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  refine not_mem_racl_line hind (h ?_)
  rw [canonicalBase_line hind]
  exact subset_adjoin k _ (Or.inl rfl)

name: GroupConfig.IsConstructibleOver.finite_or_finite_compl
statement:
theorem IsConstructibleOver.finite_or_finite_compl {s : Set (Fin 1 → K)}
    (hs : IsConstructibleOver k s) : s.Finite ∨ sᶜ.Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨cells, hcells⟩ := isConstructibleOver_iff_exists_polynomial_data.1 hs
  
  let φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 1) k →ₐ[k] Polynomial k := MvPolynomial.aeval fun _ ↦ Polynomial.X
  have hφ (u : Fin 1 → K) (g : MvPolynomial (Fin 1) k) :
      MvPolynomial.aeval u g = Polynomial.aeval (u 0) (φ g) := by
    have h : (MvPolynomial.aeval u : MvPolynomial (Fin 1) k →ₐ[k] K) =
        (Polynomial.aeval (u 0)).comp φ := by
      refine MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun i ↦ ?_
      rw [Subsingleton.elim i 0]
      simp [φ]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun h g
  
  have hroots (p : Polynomial k) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
      {u : Fin 1 → K | Polynomial.aeval (u 0) p = 0}.Finite := by
    refine ((p.rootSet_finite K).image fun x _ ↦ x).subset fun u hu ↦
      ⟨u 0, Polynomial.mem_rootSet.2 ⟨hp, hu⟩, funext fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [Subsingleton.elim i 0]
  let Z : PrimeSpectrum.BasicConstructibleSetData (MvPolynomial (Fin 1) k) → Set (Fin 1 → K) :=
    fun cell ↦ {u | (∀ i, MvPolynomial.aeval u (cell.g i) = 0) ∧ MvPolynomial.aeval u cell.f ≠ 0}
  
  have hcell (cell) : (Z cell).Finite ∨ (Z cell)ᶜ.Finite := by
    by_cases hg : ∃ i, φ (cell.g i) ≠ 0
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hg
      exact Or.inl ((hroots _ hi).subset fun u hu ↦ (hφ u _).symm.trans (hu.1 i))
    · push Not at hg
      by_cases hf : φ cell.f = 0
      · refine Or.inl (finite_empty.subset fun u hu ↦ hu.2 ?_)
        rw [hφ, hf, map_zero]
      · refine Or.inr ((hroots _ hf).subset fun u hu ↦ ?_)
        rw [mem_ofPred_eq, ← hφ]
        by_contra hne
        exact hu ⟨fun i ↦ by rw [hφ, hg i, map_zero], hne⟩
  have hs' : s = ⋃ cell ∈ (cells : Set _), Z cell := by
    ext u
    simp only [hcells, mem_iUnion, Finset.mem_coe, exists_prop, Z, mem_ofPred_eq]
  by_cases hall : ∀ cell ∈ (cells : Set _), (Z cell).Finite
  · rw [hs']
    exact Or.inl (cells.finite_toSet.biUnion hall)
  · push Not at hall
    obtain ⟨cell, hc, hinf⟩ := hall
    refine Or.inr (((hcell cell).resolve_left hinf).subset (compl_subset_compl.2 ?_))
    rw [hs']
    exact subset_biUnion_of_mem hc

name: GroupConfig.not_isConstructibleOver_range_algebraMap
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  let e : K → Fin 1 → K := fun x _ ↦ x
  have he : Function.Injective e := fun x y hxy ↦ congrFun hxy 0
  rcases h.finite_or_finite_compl with hfin | hfin
  · 
    refine infinite_range_of_injective (he.comp (algebraMap k K).injective) (hfin.subset ?_)
    rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨c, rfl⟩
  · 
    refine infinite_range_of_injective (f := fun c : k ↦ e (t + algebraMap k K c))
      (fun c d hcd ↦ (algebraMap k K).injective (add_left_cancel (he hcd))) (hfin.subset ?_)
    rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩ ⟨d, hd⟩
    change algebraMap k K d = t + algebraMap k K c at hd
    exact ht ⟨d - c, by rw [map_sub, hd, add_sub_cancel_right]⟩

name: GroupConfig.setOf_exists_natDegree_le_one_aeval_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  ext u
  simp only [mem_ofPred_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨P, hP, hdeg, hu⟩
    rw [Polynomial.eq_X_add_C_of_natDegree_le_one hdeg] at hP hu
    simp only [map_add, map_mul, Polynomial.aeval_C, Polynomial.aeval_X] at hu
    by_cases h1 : P.coeff 1 = 0
    · rw [h1, map_zero, zero_mul, zero_add] at hu
      rw [h1, map_zero, zero_mul, zero_add, ne_eq, Polynomial.C_eq_zero] at hP
      exact absurd ((algebraMap k K).injective (hu.trans (map_zero _).symm)) hP
    · refine ⟨-P.coeff 0 / P.coeff 1, ?_⟩
      rw [map_div₀, map_neg, div_eq_iff ((map_ne_zero _).2 h1)]
      linear_combination -hu
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C c, Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero c,
      (Polynomial.natDegree_X_sub_C c).le, ?_⟩
    rw [map_sub, Polynomial.aeval_X, Polynomial.aeval_C, hc, sub_self]

name: GroupConfig.not_isConstructibleOver_setOf_exists_natDegree_le_one
proof:
:= by
  rw [setOf_exists_natDegree_le_one_aeval_eq_zero]
  exact not_isConstructibleOver_range_algebraMap ht

name: Algebra.trdeg_lt_of_surjective_of_ker_ne_bot
statement:
theorem _root_.Algebra.trdeg_lt_of_surjective_of_ker_ne_bot {F : Type*} {A A' : Type u}
    [Field F] [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Algebra F A] [CommRing A'] [IsDomain A'] [Algebra F A']
    (π : A →ₐ[F] A') (hπ : Function.Surjective π) (hker : RingHom.ker π ≠ ⊥)
    (hfin : Algebra.trdeg F A < Cardinal.aleph0) :
    Algebra.trdeg F A' < Algebra.trdeg F A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne (trdeg_le_of_surjective π hπ) fun heq ↦ ?_
  
  obtain ⟨ι, t, ht⟩ := exists_isTranscendenceBasis' F A'
  choose s hs using fun i ↦ hπ (t i)
  have hπs : (⇑π) ∘ s = t := funext hs
  have hsind : AlgebraicIndependent F s := by
    refine AlgebraicIndependent.of_comp π ?_
    rw [hπs]
    exact ht.1
  have hfinι : Finite ι := by
    rw [← Cardinal.lt_aleph0_iff_finite, ht.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg, heq]
    exact hfin
  have hsbasis : IsTranscendenceBasis F s := by
    refine hsind.isTranscendenceBasis_of_trdeg_le_of_finite ?_
    rw [ht.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg, heq]
  have halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (Algebra.adjoin F (Set.range s)) A := hsbasis.isAlgebraic
  
  obtain ⟨f, hfker, hf0⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).1 hker
  have hcontr : (RingHom.ker π).under (Algebra.adjoin F (Set.range s)) ≠ ⊥ :=
    Ideal.under_ne_bot_of_algebraic_mem hf0 hfker (halg.isAlgebraic f)
  obtain ⟨c, hcker, hc0⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).1 hcontr
  have hπc : π (c : A) = 0 := by
    have h := hcker
    simp only [Ideal.under, Ideal.mem_comap, RingHom.mem_ker] at h
    exact h
  
  have hc : (c : A) ∈ (MvPolynomial.aeval s : MvPolynomial ι F →ₐ[F] A).range :=
    (Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_aeval F s).le c.2
  obtain ⟨q, hq'⟩ := hc
  have hq : MvPolynomial.aeval s q = (c : A) := hq'
  rw [← hq, MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply] at hπc
  have hq0 : q = 0 := by
    apply ht.1
    rw [map_zero, ← hπs]
    exact hπc
  apply hc0
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [← hq, hq0, map_zero]
  rfl

name: Algebra.trdeg_adjoin_eq_trdeg_intermediateField_adjoin
statement:
theorem _root_.Algebra.trdeg_adjoin_eq_trdeg_intermediateField_adjoin (R : Type*) [Field R]
    [Algebra R K] (S : Set K) :
    Algebra.trdeg R ↥(Algebra.adjoin R S) =
      Algebra.trdeg R ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin R S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← trdeg_add_eq R ↥(Algebra.adjoin R S) (A := ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin R S)),
    trdeg_eq_zero (R := ↥(Algebra.adjoin R S)), add_zero]

name: AlgebraicIndependent.matroid_eRk_eq_toENat_trdeg_adjoin
statement:
theorem _root_.AlgebraicIndependent.matroid_eRk_eq_toENat_trdeg_adjoin (R : Type*) [Field R]
    [Algebra R K] (S : Set K) :
    (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid R K).eRk S =
      Cardinal.toENat (Algebra.trdeg R ↥(Algebra.adjoin R S))
proof:
:= by
  rw [AlgebraicIndependent.matroid_eRk_eq_toENat_trdeg,
    Algebra.trdeg_adjoin_eq_trdeg_intermediateField_adjoin]

name: GroupConfig.erk_coe_eq_toENat_trdeg_adjoin
statement:
theorem erk_coe_eq_toENat_trdeg_adjoin (M : IntermediateField k K) (X : Set K) :
    erk k (M : Set K) X = Cardinal.toENat (Algebra.trdeg (↥M) ↥(Algebra.adjoin (↥M) X))
proof:
:= by
  rw [erk_coe_eq, AlgebraicIndependent.matroid_eRk_eq_toENat_trdeg_adjoin]

name: GroupConfig.trdeg_adjoin_range_lt_aleph0
statement:
theorem trdeg_adjoin_range_lt_aleph0 (M : IntermediateField k K) {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    (a : ι → K) :
    Algebra.trdeg (↥M) ↥(Algebra.adjoin (↥M) (Set.range a)) < Cardinal.aleph0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Cardinal.toENat_ne_top, ← erk_coe_eq_toENat_trdeg_adjoin]
  exact erk_ne_top k (finite_range a) _

name: GroupConfig.exists_surjective_adjoin_of_idealOf_le
statement:
theorem exists_surjective_adjoin_of_idealOf_le (M : IntermediateField k K) {ι : Type*}
    {a b : ι → K} (hle : idealOf (↥M) a ≤ idealOf (↥M) b) :
    ∃ π : ↥(Algebra.adjoin (↥M) (Set.range a)) →ₐ[↥M] ↥(Algebra.adjoin (↥M) (Set.range b)),
      Function.Surjective π ∧
        (∀ p : MvPolynomial ι ↥M,
          π ⟨MvPolynomial.aeval a p, by
            rw [Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_aeval]; exact ⟨p, rfl⟩⟩ =
          ⟨MvPolynomial.aeval b p, by
            rw [Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_aeval]; exact ⟨p, rfl⟩⟩)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let fa : MvPolynomial ι ↥M →ₐ[↥M] ↥(Algebra.adjoin (↥M) (Set.range a)) :=
    (MvPolynomial.aeval a).codRestrict _ fun p ↦ by
      rw [Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_aeval]; exact ⟨p, rfl⟩
  let fb : MvPolynomial ι ↥M →ₐ[↥M] ↥(Algebra.adjoin (↥M) (Set.range b)) :=
    (MvPolynomial.aeval b).codRestrict _ fun p ↦ by
      rw [Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_aeval]; exact ⟨p, rfl⟩
  have hfa : Function.Surjective fa := by
    rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_aeval] at hy
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨p, rfl⟩
  have hfb : Function.Surjective fb := by
    rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rw [Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_aeval] at hy
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨p, rfl⟩
  have hkera : RingHom.ker fa = idealOf (↥M) a := by
    ext p
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker, mem_idealOf_iff]
    exact ⟨fun h ↦ congrArg Subtype.val h, fun h ↦ Subtype.ext h⟩
  have hkerb : RingHom.ker fb = idealOf (↥M) b := by
    ext p
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker, mem_idealOf_iff]
    exact ⟨fun h ↦ congrArg Subtype.val h, fun h ↦ Subtype.ext h⟩
  have hle' : RingHom.ker fa ≤ RingHom.ker fb := by rw [hkera, hkerb]; exact hle
  let ea := Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective hfa
  let eb := Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective hfb
  refine ⟨(eb.toAlgHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ (↥M) hle')).comp ea.symm.toAlgHom,
    ?_, fun p ↦ ?_⟩
  · refine eb.surjective.comp ((Ideal.Quotient.factor_surjective hle').comp ea.symm.surjective)
  · have h1 : ea.symm (fa p) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p := by
      apply ea.injective
      rw [AlgEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      exact (Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective_mk hfa p).symm
    change eb (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ (↥M) hle' (ea.symm (fa p))) = fb p
    rw [h1]
    exact Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective_mk hfb p

name: GroupConfig.erk_lt_of_idealOf_lt
statement:
theorem erk_lt_of_idealOf_lt (M : IntermediateField k K) {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    {a b : ι → K} (hlt : idealOf (↥M) a < idealOf (↥M) b) :
    erk k (M : Set K) (Set.range b) < erk k (M : Set K) (Set.range a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ, hπp⟩ := exists_surjective_adjoin_of_idealOf_le M hlt.le
  have hker : RingHom.ker π ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hbot
    obtain ⟨f, hfb, hfa⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt hlt
    rw [mem_idealOf_iff] at hfb hfa
    have hmem : (⟨MvPolynomial.aeval a f, by
        rw [Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_aeval]; exact ⟨f, rfl⟩⟩ :
        ↥(Algebra.adjoin (↥M) (Set.range a))) ∈ RingHom.ker π := by
      rw [RingHom.mem_ker, hπp]
      exact Subtype.ext hfb
    rw [hbot, Ideal.mem_bot] at hmem
    exact hfa (congrArg Subtype.val hmem)
  have hfin := trdeg_adjoin_range_lt_aleph0 M a
  have hlt' := Algebra.trdeg_lt_of_surjective_of_ker_ne_bot π hπ hker hfin
  rw [erk_coe_eq_toENat_trdeg_adjoin, erk_coe_eq_toENat_trdeg_adjoin]
  exact (Cardinal.toENat_strictMonoOn (le_of_lt (hlt'.trans hfin)) hfin.le hlt')

name: GroupConfig.idealOf_eq_of_le_of_erk_eq
statement:
theorem idealOf_eq_of_le_of_erk_eq (M : IntermediateField k K) {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    {a b : ι → K} (hle : idealOf (↥M) a ≤ idealOf (↥M) b)
    (herk : erk k (M : Set K) (Set.range b) = erk k (M : Set K) (Set.range a)) :
    idealOf (↥M) a = idealOf (↥M) b
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  exact (erk_lt_of_idealOf_lt M (lt_of_le_of_ne hle hne)).ne herk

name: GroupConfig.coe_racl_subset_of_le
statement:
theorem coe_racl_subset_of_le {K₁ : IntermediateField k K} (h₀₁ : K₀ ≤ K₁) (S : Set K) :
    ((racl (↥K₀) S : IntermediateField (↥K₀) K) : Set K) ⊆ racl (↥K₁) S
proof:
:= by
  rw [racl_base_coe, racl_base_coe]
  exact SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 (racl_mono (union_subset_union_left S
