    (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 h₀₁)))

name: GroupConfig.indepOver_racl_racl
statement:
theorem indepOver_racl_racl {S T A : Set K} (h₁ : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ A S)
    (h₂ : IndepOver (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S))) ∅ A T) :
    IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ A (racl k ((racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S) : Set K) ∪ T) : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have hle : K₀ ≤ racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S) := fun w hw ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl hw)
  have hcl : racl (↥K₀) ((racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) =
      racl (↥K₀) S := by
    refine SetLike.coe_injective ?_
    rw [racl_base_coe, racl_base_coe, racl_union_right, ← union_assoc, union_self]
  have h₂' : IndepOver (↥K₀) S A T :=
    (indepOver_congr_base hcl).1 ((indepOver_base_le_iff K₀ _ hle A T).1 h₂)
  have h : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ A (S ∪ T) :=
    indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨h₁, by rwa [empty_union]⟩
  have e : ((racl k ((racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S) : Set K) ∪ T) : IntermediateField k K) :
      Set K) = ((racl (↥K₀) (∅ ∪ (S ∪ T)) : IntermediateField (↥K₀) K) : Set K) := by
    rw [empty_union, racl_base_coe, racl_union_left, union_assoc]
  rw [e]
  exact indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 h

name: GroupConfig.racl_racl_base_eq
statement:
theorem racl_racl_base_eq {E A B : Set K} (h : racl k (E ∪ A) = racl k (E ∪ B)) :
    racl (↥(racl k E)) A = racl (↥(racl k E)) B
proof:
:= by
  refine SetLike.coe_injective ?_
  rw [racl_base_coe, racl_base_coe, racl_union_left, racl_union_left, h]

name: GroupConfig.racl_union_eq_of_subset
statement:
theorem racl_union_eq_of_subset {A B T : Set K} (hA : A ⊆ racl k (B ∪ T))
    (hB : B ⊆ racl k (A ∪ T)) : racl k (A ∪ T) = racl k (B ∪ T)
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset hA fun _ hw ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hw)))
    (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset hB fun _ hw ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hw)))

name: GroupConfig.Germ.cb_subset_racl_codeTuple_of_le
statement:
theorem cb_subset_racl_codeTuple_of_le (g : Germ (↥K₀) a a') :
    (g.cb : Set K) ⊆ racl (↥K₁) (range g.codeTuple)
proof:
:=
  (cb_subset_racl_codeTuple g).trans (coe_racl_subset_of_le K₀ h₀₁ _)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.racl_codeTuple_baseChange
statement:
theorem racl_codeTuple_baseChange (g : Germ (↥K₀) a a') :
    racl (↥K₁) (range (g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').codeTuple) =
      racl (↥K₁) (range g.codeTuple)
proof:
:= by
  rw [racl_codeTuple, racl_cb_baseChange]
  refine SetLike.coe_injective ?_
  rw [coe_racl_base_eq K₀ K₁ h₀₁, coe_racl_base_eq K₀ K₁ h₀₁,
    racl_union_congr rfl (racl_codeTuple g).symm]

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.indepOver_x_ab
statement: theorem indepOver_x_ab : IndepOver k ∅ (range x) (range a ∪ range b)
proof:
:=
  (hc.indep 0 1 3 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)).rotate.rotate.indepOver_union
    (finite_range x) (finite_range a) (finite_range b)

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.racl_c_eq_canonicalBase
statement:
theorem racl_c_eq_canonicalBase :
    racl k (range c) =
      racl k (canonicalBase (racl k (range a ∪ range b)) (Sum.elim x z) : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (range c)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (range a ∪ range b)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hcab : range c ⊆ racl k (range a ∪ range b) := by
    rw [hc.racl_ab_bc]
    exact fun w hw ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hw)
  have hLM : racl k (range c) ≤ racl k (range a ∪ range b) := racl_le_of_isAlgClosed hcab
  have hzc : range z ⊆ racl k (range c ∪ range x) := by
    rw [hc.racl_cx_cz]
    exact fun w hw ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hw)
  have hzL : range z ⊆ racl k ((racl k (range c) : Set K) ∪ range x) := by
    rw [racl_union_left]
    exact hzc
  have hzM : range z ⊆ racl k ((racl k (range a ∪ range b) : Set K) ∪ range x) := by
    exact hzc.trans (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 (racl_mono (union_subset_union_left _ hcab)))
  have hrkL : erk k (racl k (range c) : Set K) (range x ∪ range z) = erk k ∅ (range x) := by
    rw [erk_union_eq_of_subset_racl k hzL, erk_racl_base]
    have := hc.indepOver_cx.symm (subset_refl _) (finite_range x)
    rwa [empty_union] at this
  have hrkM : erk k ((racl k (range c) : Set K) ∪ (racl k (range a ∪ range b) : Set K))
      (range x ∪ range z) = erk k ∅ (range x) := by
    rw [union_eq_right.2 (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 hLM), erk_union_eq_of_subset_racl k hzM,
      erk_racl_base]
    have := hc.indepOver_x_ab (subset_refl _) (finite_range x)
    rwa [empty_union] at this
  have hind : IndepOver k (racl k (range c) : Set K) (range (Sum.elim x z))
      (racl k (range a ∪ range b) : Set K) := by
    refine indepOver_of_erk_eq (finite_range _) ?_
    rw [Sum.elim_range, hrkL, hrkM]
  rw [canonicalBase_eq_of_indepOver (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range c)).racl
    (IsSmall.of_finite ((finite_range a).union (finite_range b))).racl hLM hind]
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (canonicalBase (racl k (range c)) (Sum.elim x z) : Set K)) :=
    isAlgClosed_racl _
  exact le_antisymm (racl_le_of_isAlgClosed hc.cb_c)
    (racl_le_of_isAlgClosed (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 (canonicalBase_le _ _)))

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.racl_range_c_eq
statement:
theorem racl_range_c_eq {ι₃' : Type*} [Finite ι₃'] {c' : ι₃' → K}
    (hc' : GroupConfiguration k a b c' x y z) : racl k (range c) = racl k (range c')
proof:
:= by
  rw [hc.racl_c_eq_canonicalBase, hc'.racl_c_eq_canonicalBase]

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.baseChange_racl
statement:
theorem baseChange_racl [IsAlgClosed K] (K₀ : IntermediateField k K) [UniversalDomain (↥K₀) K]
    (hc : GroupConfiguration (↥K₀) a b c x y z) {S : Set K} (hS : S.Finite)
    (h : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ S (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z)) :
    GroupConfiguration (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S))) a b c x y z
proof:
:= by
  refine ofNested K₀ S (hc.baseChange (racl (↥K₀) S) (IsSmall.of_finite hS).racl ?_)
  have h' := indepOver_racl_left_iff.2 h
  rwa [empty_union] at h'

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.exists_conj_c
statement:
theorem exists_conj_c [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K]
    (hc : GroupConfiguration k a b c x y z) {W : Set K} (hW : W.Finite) :
    ∃ (c'' : ι₃ → K) (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K), IndepOver k ∅ (range c'') W ∧ ⇑σ ∘ a = a ∧
      ⇑σ ∘ x = x ∧ ⇑σ ∘ y = y ∧ ⇑σ ∘ c = c''
proof:
:= by
  have hN : (range a ∪ range x ∪ range y).Finite :=
    ((finite_range a).union (finite_range x)).union (finite_range y)
  obtain ⟨c'', hc''⟩ := exists_isGenericOver (IsSmall.of_finite (k := k) (hW.union hN)).racl c
  have hcN : IsGenericOver (racl k (range a ∪ range x ∪ range y)) c c := by
    refine isGenericOver_self_of_indepOver (IsSmall.of_finite (k := k) hN).racl ?_
    have := indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hc.indepOver_c_axy
    rwa [empty_union] at this
  have hc''N : IsGenericOver (racl k (range a ∪ range x ∪ range y)) c c'' :=
    hc''.of_le (racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_right)
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := hcN.exists_algEquiv hc''N
  have hfix : ∀ s ∈ range a ∪ range x ∪ range y, (σ.restrictScalars k) s = s := fun s hs ↦ by
    change σ s = s
    exact σ.commutes ⟨s, subset_racl k _ hs⟩
  refine ⟨c'', σ.restrictScalars k, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, funext fun i ↦ hσ i⟩
  · exact (hc''.indepOver.mono_right (subset_racl k _)).mono_right subset_union_left
  · exact funext fun i ↦ hfix _ (subset_union_left (subset_union_left (mem_range_self i)))
  · exact funext fun i ↦ hfix _ (subset_union_left (subset_union_right (mem_range_self i)))
  · exact funext fun i ↦ hfix _ (subset_union_right (mem_range_self i))

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.iota_eq_smul
statement:
theorem IsHWBij.iota_eq_smul {f₀ : Germ k a a'} (hb : IsHWBij f₀) {ga gb gc : Germ k a a}
    (hga : ga ∈ diffSet f₀) (hgb : gb ∈ diffSet f₀) (hgc : gc ∈ diffSet f₀) {y : ι → K}
    (hy : IsGen k a y)
    (hc : GroupConfiguration k ga.codeTuple gb.codeTuple gc.codeTuple (ga.evalGen y) y
      (gb.evalGen y))
    (hmul : gb = gc * ga) (heval : gc.evalGen (ga.evalGen y) = gb.evalGen y) :
    ∃ (hx : IsGen k a (ga.evalGen y)) (hz : IsGen k a (gb.evalGen y))
      (ha : ga ∈ IsHW.prodSet gb) (hb' : gb ∈ IsHW.prodSet gb) (hc' : gc ∈ IsHW.prodSet gb),
      (hb.isHW hgb).iota hx = (hb.isHW hgb).ofMem ha • (hb.isHW hgb).iota hy ∧
      (hb.isHW hgb).iota hz = (hb.isHW hgb).ofMem hb' • (hb.isHW hgb).iota hy ∧
      (hb.isHW hgb).iota hz = (hb.isHW hgb).ofMem hc' • (hb.isHW hgb).iota hx ∧
      (hb.isHW hgb).ofMem hb' = (hb.isHW hgb).ofMem hc' * (hb.isHW hgb).ofMem ha
proof:
:= by
  have hw := hb.isHW hgb
  have horb := diffSet_eq_orbit hgb
  have ha := hw.mem_prodSet_of_mem (horb ▸ hga)
  have hb' := hw.mem_prodSet_of_mem (horb ▸ hgb)
  have hc' := hw.mem_prodSet_of_mem (horb ▸ hgc)
  have hya : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (ga.cb : Set K) :=
    indepOver_of_subset_racl (subset_racl k _) (cb_subset_racl_codeTuple ga) hc.indepOver_ay.symm
  have hyb : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (gb.cb : Set K) :=
    indepOver_of_subset_racl (subset_racl k _) (cb_subset_racl_codeTuple gb) hc.indepOver_by.symm
  have hxc : IndepOver k ∅ (range (ga.evalGen y)) (gc.cb : Set K) :=
    indepOver_of_subset_racl (subset_racl k _) (cb_subset_racl_codeTuple gc) hc.indepOver_cx.symm
  have hx := ga.isGen_evalGen hy hya
  refine ⟨hx, gb.isGen_evalGen hy hyb, ha, hb', hc', ((hb.isHW hgb).smul_iota ha hy hya).symm,
    ((hb.isHW hgb).smul_iota hb' hy hyb).symm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [(hb.isHW hgb).smul_iota hc' hx hxc]
    exact (hb.isHW hgb).iota_congr _ _ heval.symm
  · refine (hb.isHW hgb).val_injective ?_
    rw [IsHW.val_mul, IsHW.val_ofMem, IsHW.val_ofMem, IsHW.val_ofMem]
    exact hmul

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.exists_stepIII_one_fresh_with_parameterRank
statement:
theorem exists_stepIII_one_fresh_with_parameterRank (K₀ : IntermediateField k K)
    [IsAlgClosed (↥K₀)] [UniversalDomain (↥K₀) K] (hK₀ : IsSmall k (K₀ : Set K))
    {g : Germ (↥K₀) y z} (hc : GroupConfiguration (↥K₀) a g.codeTuple c x y z) (hg : IsHWBij g)
    (hgz : g.evalGen y = z) {W : Set K} (hW : W.Finite) :
    ∃ (b' : ↥g.codeSet → K) (δ : Germ (↥K₀) y y) (y₁ : ι₅ → K),
      erk (↥K₀) ∅ (range b') = erk (↥K₀) ∅ (range g.codeTuple) ∧
      IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range b')
        (range a ∪ range g.codeTuple ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z ∪ W) ∧
      δ ∈ diffSet g ∧ δ.evalGen y = y₁ ∧ IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (δ.cb : Set K) (range b') ∧
      IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range y) (δ.cb : Set K) ∧
      racl (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b'))) (range δ.codeTuple) =
        racl (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b'))) (range g.codeTuple) ∧
      racl (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b'))) (range y₁) =
        racl (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b'))) (range z) ∧
      GroupConfiguration (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b'))) a δ.codeTuple c x y y₁
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b', σ, δ, hb'indW, hσb, -, -, -, hc', hδmem, hδy, hδcb_le, hbsub, hδb', -, -⟩ :=
    exists_conj_diff_fresh (range_codeTuple g) hc hg.isInvertible hgz hW
  have hb'ind : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range b')
      (range a ∪ range g.codeTuple ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z) :=
    hb'indW.mono_right subset_union_left
  have hb'rank : erk (↥K₀) ∅ (range b') = erk (↥K₀) ∅ (range g.codeTuple) := by
    rw [← hσb, range_comp]
    simpa only [image_empty] using erk_image σ (∅ : Set K) (range g.codeTuple)
  have hsub := fun i ↦ gcPoints_subset (a := a) (b := g.codeTuple) (c := c) (x := x) (y := y)
    (z := z) i
  have hK₁s : IsSmall k ((racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b') : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (hK₀.union (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range b'))).racl
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b')) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have _ : UniversalDomain ↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b')) K :=
    universalDomain_of_isSmall _ hK₁s
                                                             
  have hδcode : racl (↥K₀) (range δ.codeTuple ∪ range b') =
      racl (↥K₀) (range g.codeTuple ∪ range b') := by
    refine racl_union_eq_of_subset ?_ ?_
    · have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl (↥K₀) (range g.codeTuple ∪ range b')) := isAlgClosed_racl _
      rw [range_codeTuple δ]
      exact (codeSet_subset_racl_cb δ).trans (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2
        (racl_le_of_isAlgClosed (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 hδcb_le)))
    · refine hbsub.trans (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset ?_ ?_)))
      · exact fun w hw ↦ subset_racl (↥K₀) _ (Or.inr hw)
      · exact (cb_subset_racl_codeTuple δ).trans
          (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 (racl_mono subset_union_left))
  obtain ⟨y₁, hy₁⟩ : ∃ y₁ : ι₅ → K, y₁ = ⇑σ ∘ y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hracl_z : racl (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b'))) (range y₁) =
      racl (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b'))) (range z) := by
    refine racl_eq_of_racl_union_eq K₀ ?_
    rw [union_comm (range y₁), hy₁, hc'.racl_by_bz, union_comm]
  have hc₁ : GroupConfiguration (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b'))) a δ.codeTuple c x y y₁ :=
    (baseChange_racl K₀ hc (finite_range b') hb'ind).ofRaclEq rfl
      (racl_eq_of_racl_union_eq K₀ hδcode) rfl rfl rfl hracl_z
                                    
  have hyδ : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range y) (δ.cb : Set K) := by
    have h₁ : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range y) (range b') :=
      (hb'ind.mono_right (hsub 4)).symm
    have h₂ : IndepOver (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b'))) ∅ (range y)
        (range δ.codeTuple) := hc₁.indepOver_by.symm
    refine (indepOver_racl_racl K₀ h₁ h₂).mono_right ((cb_subset_racl_codeTuple δ).trans ?_)
    rw [racl_base_coe]
    exact SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 (racl_mono (union_subset_union_left _
      fun w hw ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl hw)))
  exact ⟨b', δ, y₁, hb'rank, hb'indW, hδmem, hδy.trans hy₁.symm, hδb', hyδ,
    racl_eq_of_racl_union_eq K₀ hδcode, hracl_z, hc₁⟩

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.exists_stepIII_one_with_parameterRank
statement:
theorem exists_stepIII_one_with_parameterRank (K₀ : IntermediateField k K) [IsAlgClosed (↥K₀)]
    [UniversalDomain (↥K₀) K] (hK₀ : IsSmall k (K₀ : Set K)) {g : Germ (↥K₀) y z}
    (hc : GroupConfiguration (↥K₀) a g.codeTuple c x y z) (hg : IsHWBij g)
    (hgz : g.evalGen y = z) :
    ∃ (b' : ↥g.codeSet → K) (δ : Germ (↥K₀) y y) (y₁ : ι₅ → K),
      erk (↥K₀) ∅ (range b') = erk (↥K₀) ∅ (range g.codeTuple) ∧
      IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range b')
        (range a ∪ range g.codeTuple ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z) ∧
      δ ∈ diffSet g ∧ δ.evalGen y = y₁ ∧ IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (δ.cb : Set K) (range b') ∧
      IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range y) (δ.cb : Set K) ∧
      racl (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b'))) (range δ.codeTuple) =
        racl (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b'))) (range g.codeTuple) ∧
      racl (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b'))) (range y₁) =
        racl (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b'))) (range z) ∧
      GroupConfiguration (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b'))) a δ.codeTuple c x y y₁
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b', δ, y₁, hrank, hb', h⟩ :=
    exists_stepIII_one_fresh_with_parameterRank K₀ hK₀ hc hg hgz finite_empty
  rw [union_empty] at hb'
  exact ⟨b', δ, y₁, hrank, hb', h⟩

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.exists_stepIII_one
statement:
theorem exists_stepIII_one (K₀ : IntermediateField k K) [IsAlgClosed (↥K₀)]
    [UniversalDomain (↥K₀) K] (hK₀ : IsSmall k (K₀ : Set K)) {g : Germ (↥K₀) y z}
    (hc : GroupConfiguration (↥K₀) a g.codeTuple c x y z) (hg : IsHWBij g)
    (hgz : g.evalGen y = z) :
    ∃ (b' : ↥g.codeSet → K) (δ : Germ (↥K₀) y y) (y₁ : ι₅ → K),
      IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range b')
        (range a ∪ range g.codeTuple ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z) ∧
      δ ∈ diffSet g ∧ δ.evalGen y = y₁ ∧ IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (δ.cb : Set K) (range b') ∧
      IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range y) (δ.cb : Set K) ∧
      racl (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b'))) (range δ.codeTuple) =
        racl (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b'))) (range g.codeTuple) ∧
      racl (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b'))) (range y₁) =
        racl (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b'))) (range z) ∧
      GroupConfiguration (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b'))) a δ.codeTuple c x y y₁
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b', δ, y₁, -, h⟩ := exists_stepIII_one_with_parameterRank K₀ hK₀ hc hg hgz
  exact ⟨b', δ, y₁, h⟩

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.exists_stepIII_fresh_with_parameterRank
statement:
theorem exists_stepIII_fresh_with_parameterRank (K₀ : IntermediateField k K)
    [IsAlgClosed (↥K₀)] [UniversalDomain (↥K₀) K] (hK₀ : IsSmall k (K₀ : Set K))
    {g : Germ (↥K₀) y z} (hc : GroupConfiguration (↥K₀) a g.codeTuple c x y z) (hg : IsHWBij g)
    (hgz : g.evalGen y = z) {W : Set K} (hW : W.Finite) {μ₁ μ₂ μ₃ μ₄ μ₅ μ₆ : Type*}
    {a₀ : μ₁ → K} {b₀ : μ₂ → K} {c₀ : μ₃ → K} {x₀ : μ₄ → K} {y₀ : μ₅ → K} {z₀ : μ₆ → K}
    (ha₀ : racl (↥K₀) (range a₀) = racl (↥K₀) (range a))
    (hb₀ : racl (↥K₀) (range b₀) = racl (↥K₀) (range g.codeTuple))
    (hc₀ : racl (↥K₀) (range c₀) = racl (↥K₀) (range c))
    (hx₀ : racl (↥K₀) (range x₀) = racl (↥K₀) (range x))
    (hy₀ : racl (↥K₀) (range y₀) = racl (↥K₀) (range y))
    (hz₀ : racl (↥K₀) (range z₀) = racl (↥K₀) (range z)) :
    ∃ S : Set K, S.Finite ∧ erk (↥K₀) ∅ S = 2 * erk (↥K₀) ∅ (range a) ∧
      IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ S
        (range a ∪ range g.codeTuple ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z ∪ W) ∧
      IsMainConclusion k (racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S)) a₀ b₀ c₀ x₀ y₀ z₀
proof:
:= by
                   
  obtain ⟨b', δ, y₁, hb'rank, hb'indW, hδmem, hδy, hδb', hyδ, hracl_b, hracl_z, hc₁⟩ :=
    exists_stepIII_one_fresh_with_parameterRank K₀ hK₀ hc hg hgz hW
  have hb'ind : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range b')
      (range a ∪ range g.codeTuple ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z) :=
    hb'indW.mono_right subset_union_left
  have hb'rank' := hb'rank.trans hc.erk_b_eq
  have hsub := fun i ↦ gcPoints_subset (a := a) (b := g.codeTuple) (c := c) (x := x) (y := y)
    (z := z) i
  have hK₁s : IsSmall k ((racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b') : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (hK₀.union (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range b'))).racl
  have i₁ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b')) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have u₁ : UniversalDomain ↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b')) K :=
    universalDomain_of_isSmall _ hK₁s
  have h₀₁ : K₀ ≤ racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b') := fun w hw ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl hw)
  have hb'K₁ : range b' ⊆ (racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b') : Set K) :=
    fun w hw ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hw)
  have lift₁ : ∀ {A B : Set K}, racl (↥K₀) A = racl (↥K₀) B →
      racl (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b'))) A =
        racl (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b'))) B :=
    fun h ↦ racl_eq_of_racl_eq K₀ _ h
  have two_step : ∀ {A T : Set K}, IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ A (range b') →
      IndepOver (↥(racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b'))) ∅ A T →
      IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ A (racl k ((racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b') : Set K) ∪ T) : Set K) :=
    fun h₁ h₂ ↦ indepOver_racl_racl K₀ h₁ h₂
  have hK₂eq : ∀ T : Set K, racl k ((racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b') : Set K) ∪ T) =
      racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ (range b' ∪ T)) := fun T ↦ by
    rw [racl_union_left, union_assoc]
  revert hracl_b hracl_z hc₁ lift₁ two_step hK₂eq
  generalize hK₁ : racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ range b') = K₁ at hK₁s i₁ u₁ h₀₁ hb'K₁ ⊢
  intro hracl_b hracl_z hc₁ lift₁ two_step hK₂eq
  have hK₁base : (K₁ : Set K) = (racl (↥K₀) (range b') : Set K) := by
    rw [racl_base_coe K₀, hK₁]
  have hcrank : erk (↥K₁) ∅ (range c) = erk (↥K₀) ∅ (range a) := by
    rw [erk_base_le K₀ K₁ h₀₁, hK₁base, erk_racl_base]
    simpa only [empty_union] using
      ((hb'ind.mono_right (hsub 2)).symm.erk_eq (a := range c)
        (subset_refl _) (finite_range c)).trans hc.erk_c_eq
                                                                                   
  have hWfin : (range a ∪ range δ.codeTuple ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range y₁ ∪
      (range g.codeTuple ∪ range z)).Finite :=
    ((((((finite_range a).union (finite_range _)).union (finite_range c)).union
      (finite_range x)).union (finite_range y)).union (finite_range y₁)).union
      ((finite_range _).union (finite_range z))
  obtain ⟨c'', σ₂, hc''WW, hσ₂a, hσ₂x, hσ₂y, hσ₂c⟩ := hc₁.exists_conj_c (hWfin.union hW)
  have hc''W := hc''WW.mono_right subset_union_left
  have hc''rank : erk (↥K₁) ∅ (range c'') = erk (↥K₁) ∅ (range c) := by
    rw [← hσ₂c, range_comp]
    simpa only [image_empty] using erk_image σ₂ (∅ : Set K) (range c)
  have hSrank : erk (↥K₀) ∅ (range b' ∪ range c'') = 2 * erk (↥K₀) ∅ (range a) := by
    have hbase : erk (↥K₀) (range b') (range c'') = erk (↥K₁) ∅ (range c'') := by
      rw [erk_base_le K₀ K₁ h₀₁, hK₁base, erk_racl_base]
    rw [erk_union_eq, empty_union, hb'rank', hbase, hc''rank, hcrank]
    ring
  have hyW : range y ⊆ range a ∪ range δ.codeTuple ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range y₁ ∪
      (range g.codeTuple ∪ range z) := fun _ h ↦ Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr h))
  have hzW : range z ⊆ range a ∪ range δ.codeTuple ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range y₁ ∪
      (range g.codeTuple ∪ range z) := fun _ h ↦ Or.inr (Or.inr h)
  have hgW : range g.codeTuple ⊆ range a ∪ range δ.codeTuple ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪
      range y₁ ∪ (range g.codeTuple ∪ range z) := fun _ h ↦ Or.inr (Or.inl h)
  have hδW : range δ.codeTuple ⊆ range a ∪ range δ.codeTuple ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪
      range y₁ ∪ (range g.codeTuple ∪ range z) :=
    fun _ h ↦ Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr h)))))
  have hptsW : range a ∪ range g.codeTuple ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z ⊆
      range a ∪ range δ.codeTuple ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range y₁ ∪
        (range g.codeTuple ∪ range z) :=
    union_subset (union_subset (union_subset (union_subset (union_subset
      (fun _ h ↦ Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl h)))))) hgW)
      (fun _ h ↦ Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr h))))))
      (fun _ h ↦ Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr h))))) hyW) hzW
  obtain ⟨σ₂₀, hσ₂₀⟩ : ∃ τ : K ≃ₐ[↥K₀] K, ⇑τ = ⇑σ₂ :=
    ⟨restrictBase K₀ K₁ h₀₁ σ₂, coe_restrictBase K₀ K₁ h₀₁ σ₂⟩
  obtain ⟨g'', hg''⟩ : ∃ g'' : Germ (↥K₀) y y, g'' = δ.map σ₂₀ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨z'', hz''⟩ : ∃ z'' : ι₅ → K, z'' = ⇑σ₂ ∘ y₁ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hg''mem : g'' ∈ diffSet g := by
    rw [hg'']
    exact map_mem_diffSet hδmem σ₂₀
  have hg''y : g''.evalGen y = z'' := by
    have h := evalGen_map σ₂₀ δ (rfl : IsGen (↥K₀) y y) hyδ
    have hy : ⇑σ₂₀ ∘ y = y := by
      rw [hσ₂₀]
      exact hσ₂y
    rw [hy, hδy, hσ₂₀, ← hz'', ← hg''] at h
    exact h
                                              
  have hc₁σ : GroupConfiguration (↥K₁) a g''.codeTuple c'' x y z'' := by
    have h := hc₁.map σ₂
    rw [hσ₂a, hσ₂x, hσ₂y, hσ₂c, ← hz''] at h
    refine h.ofRaclEq rfl ?_ rfl rfl rfl rfl
    rw [← hσ₂₀]
    refine lift₁ ?_
    rw [hg'']
    exact racl_codeTuple_map σ₂₀ δ
                                                                  
  have hK₂s : IsSmall k ((racl k ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ range c'') : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (hK₁s.union (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range c''))).racl
  have i₂ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ range c'')) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have u₂ : UniversalDomain ↥(racl k ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ range c'')) K :=
    universalDomain_of_isSmall _ hK₂s
  have hra : racl (↥(racl k ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ range c''))) (range g''.codeTuple) =
      racl (↥(racl k ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ range c''))) (range a) :=
    racl_eq_of_racl_union_eq K₁ (hc₁σ.racl_ab_bc.symm.trans hc₁σ.racl_ab_ac)
  have hrx : racl (↥(racl k ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ range c''))) (range z'') =
      racl (↥(racl k ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ range c''))) (range x) :=
    racl_eq_of_racl_union_eq K₁ (by rw [union_comm (range z''), ← hc₁σ.racl_cx_cz, union_comm])
  have hc₂ : GroupConfiguration (↥(racl k ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ range c''))) g''.codeTuple
      δ.codeTuple c z'' y y₁ :=
    (baseChange_racl K₁ hc₁ (finite_range c'') (hc''W.mono_right subset_union_left)).ofRaclEq
      hra rfl rfl hrx rfl rfl
                                                                        
  have hyK : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range y) (racl k ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ range c'') : Set K) :=
    two_step (hb'ind.mono_right (hsub 4)).symm (hc''W.mono_right hyW).symm
  have hzK : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range z) (racl k ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ range c'') : Set K) :=
    two_step (hb'ind.mono_right (hsub 5)).symm (hc''W.mono_right hzW).symm
  have hgK : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (g.cb : Set K) (racl k ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ range c'') : Set K) :=
    two_step (indepOver_of_subset_racl (cb_subset_racl_codeTuple g) (subset_racl _ _)
        (hb'ind.mono_right (hsub 1)).symm)
      (indepOver_of_subset_racl (cb_subset_racl_codeTuple_of_le K₀ K₁ h₀₁ g) (subset_racl _ _)
        (hc''W.mono_right hgW).symm)
  have hδK : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (δ.cb : Set K) (racl k ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ range c'') : Set K) :=
    two_step hδb'
      (indepOver_of_subset_racl (cb_subset_racl_codeTuple_of_le K₀ K₁ h₀₁ δ) (subset_racl _ _)
        (hc''W.mono_right hδW).symm)
  have hσ₂b' : ⇑σ₂₀ '' range b' = range b' := by
    rw [← range_comp, hσ₂₀]
    congr 1
    funext i
    change σ₂ (b' i) = b' i
    exact σ₂.commutes ⟨b' i, hb'K₁ (mem_range_self i)⟩
  have hg''b' : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (g''.cb : Set K) (range b') := by
    have h := hδb'.image σ₂₀
    rwa [image_empty, hσ₂b', ← AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, ← coe_map, ← cb_map, ← hg''] at h
  have hg''K : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (g''.cb : Set K) (racl k ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ range c'') : Set K) :=
    two_step hg''b'
      (indepOver_of_subset_racl (cb_subset_racl_codeTuple_of_le K₀ K₁ h₀₁ g'')
        (subset_racl _ _) hc₁σ.indepOver_bc)
  have hptsK : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅
      (range a ∪ range g.codeTuple ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z ∪ W)
      (racl k ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ range c'') : Set K) :=
    two_step hb'indW.symm (hc''WW.mono_right (union_subset_union_left W hptsW)).symm
  have h₀₂ : K₀ ≤ racl k ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ range c'') :=
    fun w hw ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl (h₀₁ hw))
  have lift₂ : ∀ {A B : Set K}, racl (↥K₁) A = racl (↥K₁) B →
      racl (↥(racl k ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ range c''))) A =
        racl (↥(racl k ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ range c''))) B :=
    fun h ↦ racl_eq_of_racl_eq K₁ _ h
  refine ⟨range b' ∪ range c'', (finite_range b').union (finite_range c''), hSrank, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine hptsK.symm.mono_left (union_subset ?_ fun w hw ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hw))
    exact hb'K₁.trans fun w hw ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl hw)
  rw [← hK₂eq (range c'')]
  revert hra hrx hc₂ hyK hzK hgK hδK hg''K lift₂
  generalize hK₂ : racl k ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ range c'') = K₂ at hK₂s i₂ u₂ h₀₂ ⊢
  intro hra hrx hc₂ hyK hzK hgK hδK hg''K lift₂
                                                        
  have hK₂₀ : IsSmall (↥K₀) (K₂ : Set K) := isSmall_coe_of_isSmall K₀ hK₂s
  obtain ⟨F₀, hF₀⟩ : ∃ f : Germ (↥K₂) y z, f = g.baseChange K₀ K₂ h₀₂ hK₂₀ hyK hzK := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Gb, hGb⟩ : ∃ f : Germ (↥K₂) y y, f = δ.baseChange K₀ K₂ h₀₂ hK₂₀ hyK hyK := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨Ga, hGa⟩ : ∃ f : Germ (↥K₂) y y, f = g''.baseChange K₀ K₂ h₀₂ hK₂₀ hyK hyK :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hF₀b : IsHWBij F₀ := by
    rw [hF₀]
    exact IsHWBij.baseChange K₀ K₂ h₀₂ hK₂₀ hyK hzK hg hgK
  have hGbmem : Gb ∈ diffSet F₀ := by
    rw [hF₀, hGb]
    exact baseChange_mem_diffSet K₀ K₂ h₀₂ hK₂₀ hyK hzK hgK hδmem hδK
  have hGamem : Ga ∈ diffSet F₀ := by
    rw [hF₀, hGa]
    exact baseChange_mem_diffSet K₀ K₂ h₀₂ hK₂₀ hyK hzK hgK hg''mem hg''K
  have hcodeA : racl (↥K₂) (range Ga.codeTuple) = racl (↥K₂) (range g''.codeTuple) := by
    rw [hGa]
    exact racl_codeTuple_baseChange K₀ K₂ h₀₂ hK₂₀ hyK hyK g''
  have hcodeB : racl (↥K₂) (range Gb.codeTuple) = racl (↥K₂) (range δ.codeTuple) := by
    rw [hGb]
    exact racl_codeTuple_baseChange K₀ K₂ h₀₂ hK₂₀ hyK hyK δ
  have hc₃ : GroupConfiguration (↥K₂) Ga.codeTuple Gb.codeTuple c z'' y y₁ :=
    hc₂.ofRaclEq hcodeA hcodeB rfl rfl rfl rfl
  have hyGa : IndepOver (↥K₂) ∅ (range y) (Ga.cb : Set K) :=
    indepOver_of_subset_racl (subset_racl _ _) (cb_subset_racl_codeTuple Ga)
      hc₃.indepOver_ay.symm
  have hyGb : IndepOver (↥K₂) ∅ (range y) (Gb.cb : Set K) :=
    indepOver_of_subset_racl (subset_racl _ _) (cb_subset_racl_codeTuple Gb)
      hc₃.indepOver_by.symm
  have hGay : Ga.evalGen y = z'' := by
    have h := evalGen_baseChange K₀ K₂ h₀₂ hK₂₀ hyK hyK g'' (rfl : IsGen (↥K₂) y y)
      (by rw [← hGa]; exact hyGa)
    rw [← hGa, hg''y] at h
    exact h
  have hGby : Gb.evalGen y = y₁ := by
    have h := evalGen_baseChange K₀ K₂ h₀₂ hK₂₀ hyK hyK δ (rfl : IsGen (↥K₂) y y)
      (by rw [← hGb]; exact hyGb)
    rw [← hGb, hδy] at h
    exact h
  have hc₄ : GroupConfiguration (↥K₂) Ga.codeTuple Gb.codeTuple c (Ga.evalGen y) y
      (Gb.evalGen y) := by
    rw [hGay, hGby]
    exact hc₃
                                                   
  have hw := hF₀b.isHW hGbmem
  have hGaorb : Ga ∈ orbit Gb := by
    rw [← diffSet_eq_orbit hGbmem]
    exact hGamem
  obtain ⟨Ga', hGa'⟩ := isUnit_iff.1 (hw.isUnit_of_mem hGaorb)
  have ht : IndepTriple (↥K₂) (range Ga.codeTuple) (range Gb.codeTuple) (range y) :=
    hc₄.indep 0 1 4 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
  have hind₃ : IndepTriple (↥K₂) (Ga.cb : Set K) (Gb.cb : Set K) (range y) :=
    indepTriple_of_racl_eq (racl_codeTuple Ga) (racl_codeTuple Gb) rfl ht
  obtain ⟨hconv, hGcx, hGcGa⟩ := hw.groupConfiguration hGaorb (self_mem_orbit Gb)
    (rfl : IsGen (↥K₂) y y) hind₃ hc₄.one_le_erk_y hGa'
  have hGa'mem : Ga' ∈ diffSet F₀ := inv_mem_diffSet hF₀b.isInvertible hGamem hGa'
  have hGbGa' : IndepOver (↥K₂) ∅ (Gb.cb : Set K) (Ga'.cb : Set K) := by
    refine indepOver_of_subset_racl (cb_subset_racl_codeTuple Gb) ?_ hc₄.indepOver_ab.symm
    rw [racl_codeTuple]
    exact SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 hGa'.cb_le
  have hGcmem : Gb * Ga' ∈ diffSet F₀ := hF₀b.mul_mem_diffSet hGbmem hGa'mem hGbGa'
                                                
  have lift₀₂ : ∀ {A B : Set K}, racl (↥K₀) A = racl (↥K₀) B → racl (↥K₂) A = racl (↥K₂) B :=
    fun h ↦ lift₂ (lift₁ h)
  have hfa : racl (↥K₂) (range a₀) = racl (↥K₂) (range Ga.codeTuple) :=
    (lift₀₂ ha₀).trans (hra.symm.trans hcodeA.symm)
  have hfb : racl (↥K₂) (range b₀) = racl (↥K₂) (range Gb.codeTuple) :=
    (lift₀₂ hb₀).trans ((lift₂ hracl_b.symm).trans hcodeB.symm)
  have hfc : racl (↥K₂) (range c₀) = racl (↥K₂) (range (Gb * Ga').codeTuple) :=
    (lift₀₂ hc₀).trans (hc₄.racl_range_c_eq hconv)
  have hfx : racl (↥K₂) (range x₀) = racl (↥K₂) (range (Ga.evalGen y)) := by
    rw [hGay]
    exact (lift₀₂ hx₀).trans hrx.symm
  have hfz : racl (↥K₂) (range z₀) = racl (↥K₂) (range (Gb.evalGen y)) := by
    rw [hGby]
    exact (lift₀₂ hz₀).trans (lift₂ hracl_z.symm)
              
  have hbase : ∀ {X : Set K}, X.Finite → IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ X (K₂ : Set K) →
      erk (↥K₂) ∅ X = erk (↥K₀) ∅ X := fun hX h ↦ by
    rw [erk_base_le K₀ K₂ h₀₂, ← empty_union (K₂ : Set K)]
    exact h (subset_refl _) hX
  have hrkx : erk (↥K₂) ∅ (range (Ga.evalGen y)) = erk (↥K₂) ∅ (range x₀) :=
    (erk_eq_of_racl_eq hfx).symm
  have hrky : erk (↥K₂) ∅ (range y) = erk (↥K₂) ∅ (range x₀) := hc₄.erk_y_eq.trans hrkx
  have hrkz : erk (↥K₂) ∅ (range z) = erk (↥K₂) ∅ (range x₀) := by
    rw [← hrky, hbase (finite_range z) hzK, hbase (finite_range y) hyK, hc.erk_z_eq, hc.erk_y_eq]
  have hrkf : erk (↥K₂) ∅ (F₀.cb : Set K) = erk (↥K₂) ∅ (range a₀) :=
    (hF₀b.rank Ga hGamem).symm.trans ((erk_eq_of_racl_eq (racl_codeTuple Ga).symm).trans
      (erk_eq_of_racl_eq hfa).symm)
  unfold IsMainConclusion
  exact ⟨i₂, u₂, ι₅, ι₆, inferInstance, inferInstance, y, z, F₀, Ga, Gb, Gb * Ga', y, hF₀b,
    hGamem, hGbmem, hGcmem, hGcGa.symm, rfl, hind₃, hGcx, hconv, hfa, hfb, hfc, hfx,
    lift₀₂ hy₀, hfz, hrky, hrkz, hrkf⟩

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.exists_stepIII_with_parameterRank
statement:
theorem exists_stepIII_with_parameterRank (K₀ : IntermediateField k K) [IsAlgClosed (↥K₀)]
    [UniversalDomain (↥K₀) K] (hK₀ : IsSmall k (K₀ : Set K)) {g : Germ (↥K₀) y z}
    (hc : GroupConfiguration (↥K₀) a g.codeTuple c x y z) (hg : IsHWBij g)
    (hgz : g.evalGen y = z) {μ₁ μ₂ μ₃ μ₄ μ₅ μ₆ : Type*} {a₀ : μ₁ → K} {b₀ : μ₂ → K}
    {c₀ : μ₃ → K} {x₀ : μ₄ → K} {y₀ : μ₅ → K} {z₀ : μ₆ → K}
    (ha₀ : racl (↥K₀) (range a₀) = racl (↥K₀) (range a))
    (hb₀ : racl (↥K₀) (range b₀) = racl (↥K₀) (range g.codeTuple))
    (hc₀ : racl (↥K₀) (range c₀) = racl (↥K₀) (range c))
    (hx₀ : racl (↥K₀) (range x₀) = racl (↥K₀) (range x))
    (hy₀ : racl (↥K₀) (range y₀) = racl (↥K₀) (range y))
    (hz₀ : racl (↥K₀) (range z₀) = racl (↥K₀) (range z)) :
    ∃ S : Set K, S.Finite ∧ erk (↥K₀) ∅ S = 2 * erk (↥K₀) ∅ (range a) ∧
      IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ S (range a ∪ range g.codeTuple ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z) ∧
      IsMainConclusion k (racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S)) a₀ b₀ c₀ x₀ y₀ z₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hSfin, hSrank, hS, h⟩ := exists_stepIII_fresh_with_parameterRank K₀ hK₀ hc hg hgz
    finite_empty ha₀ hb₀ hc₀ hx₀ hy₀ hz₀
  rw [union_empty] at hS
  exact ⟨S, hSfin, hSrank, hS, h⟩

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.exists_stepIII
statement:
theorem exists_stepIII (K₀ : IntermediateField k K) [IsAlgClosed (↥K₀)]
    [UniversalDomain (↥K₀) K] (hK₀ : IsSmall k (K₀ : Set K)) {g : Germ (↥K₀) y z}
    (hc : GroupConfiguration (↥K₀) a g.codeTuple c x y z) (hg : IsHWBij g)
    (hgz : g.evalGen y = z) {μ₁ μ₂ μ₃ μ₄ μ₅ μ₆ : Type*} {a₀ : μ₁ → K} {b₀ : μ₂ → K}
    {c₀ : μ₃ → K} {x₀ : μ₄ → K} {y₀ : μ₅ → K} {z₀ : μ₆ → K}
    (ha₀ : racl (↥K₀) (range a₀) = racl (↥K₀) (range a))
    (hb₀ : racl (↥K₀) (range b₀) = racl (↥K₀) (range g.codeTuple))
    (hc₀ : racl (↥K₀) (range c₀) = racl (↥K₀) (range c))
    (hx₀ : racl (↥K₀) (range x₀) = racl (↥K₀) (range x))
    (hy₀ : racl (↥K₀) (range y₀) = racl (↥K₀) (range y))
    (hz₀ : racl (↥K₀) (range z₀) = racl (↥K₀) (range z)) :
    ∃ S : Set K, S.Finite ∧
      IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ S (range a ∪ range g.codeTuple ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z) ∧
      IsMainConclusion k (racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ S)) a₀ b₀ c₀ x₀ y₀ z₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hSfin, -, h⟩ := exists_stepIII_with_parameterRank K₀ hK₀ hc hg hgz
    ha₀ hb₀ hc₀ hx₀ hy₀ hz₀
  exact ⟨S, hSfin, h⟩

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.exists_main_fresh_with_parameterRank
statement:
theorem exists_main_fresh_with_parameterRank (hc : GroupConfiguration k a b c x y z) {W : Set K}
    (hW : W.Finite) :
    ∃ E : Set K, E.Finite ∧ erk k ∅ E = 5 * erk k ∅ (range a) ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ E (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z ∪ W) ∧
      IsMainConclusion k (racl k E) a b c x y z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, hEfin, hErank, hEind, κ₁, κ₂, κ₃, κ₄, κ₅, κ₆, _, _, _, _, _, _, a₁, b₁, c₁, x₁, y₁, z₁,
    hc₁, ha₁, hb₁, hc₁', hx₁, hy₁, hz₁, hzdcl, hydcl⟩ :=
    hc.exists_stepI_fresh_with_parameterRank hW
  have hEs : IsSmall k ((racl k E : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (IsSmall.of_finite hEfin).racl
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k E) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have _ : UniversalDomain ↥(racl k E) K := universalDomain_of_isSmall _ hEs
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgz, hc₂, hgb⟩ := hc₁.exists_isHWBij hzdcl hydcl
  have ha₀ := racl_racl_base_eq ha₁.symm
  have hb₀ : racl (↥(racl k E)) (range b) = racl (↥(racl k E)) (range g.codeTuple) :=
    (racl_racl_base_eq hb₁.symm).trans hgb.symm
  have hc₀ := racl_racl_base_eq hc₁'.symm
  have hx₀ := racl_racl_base_eq hx₁.symm
  have hy₀ := racl_racl_base_eq hy₁.symm
  have hz₀ := racl_racl_base_eq hz₁.symm
  obtain ⟨S, hSfin, hSrank, hSind, hmain⟩ :=
    exists_stepIII_fresh_with_parameterRank (racl k E) hEs hc₂ hg hgz hW ha₀ hb₀ hc₀ hx₀ hy₀ hz₀
  have harank : erk (↥(racl k E)) ∅ (range a₁) = erk k ∅ (range a) := by
    rw [← erk_eq_of_racl_eq ha₀, erk_base_empty, erk_racl_base]
    simpa only [empty_union] using hEind.symm.erk_eq
      (fun _ h ↦ Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl h)))))) (finite_range a)
  have hSrank' : erk k E S = 2 * erk k ∅ (range a) := by
    rw [← erk_racl_base k E S, ← erk_base_empty (racl k E)]
    simpa only [harank] using hSrank
  have hrank : erk k ∅ (E ∪ S) = 5 * erk k ∅ (range a) := by
    rw [erk_union_eq, empty_union, hErank, hSrank']
    ring
  refine ⟨E ∪ S, hEfin.union hSfin, hrank, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hpts : racl (↥(racl k E))
        (range a₁ ∪ range g.codeTuple ∪ range c₁ ∪ range x₁ ∪ range y₁ ∪ range z₁ ∪ W) =
        racl (↥(racl k E)) (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z ∪ W) :=
      racl_union_congr (racl_union_congr (racl_union_congr (racl_union_congr (racl_union_congr
        (racl_union_congr ha₀.symm hb₀.symm) hc₀.symm) hx₀.symm) hy₀.symm) hz₀.symm) rfl
    have h1 : IndepOver (↥(racl k E)) ∅ S
        (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z ∪ W) :=
      (indepOver_congr₀ rfl hpts).1 hSind
    have h2 : IndepOver k E S
        (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z ∪ W) :=
      (indepOver_racl_base_iff E _ _).1 ((indepOver_base_iff (racl k E) _ _).1 h1)
    have h3 : IndepOver k ∅ (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z ∪ W)
        (E ∪ S) :=
      indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨hEind.symm, by rw [empty_union]; exact h2.symm⟩
    exact h3.symm
  · rw [← racl_union_left E S]
    exact hmain

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.exists_main_with_parameterRank
statement:
theorem exists_main_with_parameterRank (hc : GroupConfiguration k a b c x y z) :
    ∃ E : Set K, E.Finite ∧ erk k ∅ E = 5 * erk k ∅ (range a) ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ E (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z) ∧
      IsMainConclusion k (racl k E) a b c x y z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, hEfin, hErank, hEind, h⟩ := hc.exists_main_fresh_with_parameterRank finite_empty
  rw [union_empty] at hEind
  exact ⟨E, hEfin, hErank, hEind, h⟩

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.exists_main
statement:
theorem exists_main (hc : GroupConfiguration k a b c x y z) :
    ∃ E : Set K, E.Finite ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ E (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z) ∧
      IsMainConclusion k (racl k E) a b c x y z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, hEfin, -, h⟩ := hc.exists_main_with_parameterRank
  exact ⟨E, hEfin, h⟩

name: GroupConfig.exists_polynomial_parameters
statement:
private theorem exists_polynomial_parameters {ι α : Type u} [Finite α]
    (L : IntermediateField k K) (P : α → MvPolynomial ι L) :
    ∃ (η : Type u) (_ : Finite η) (e : η → L) (F : α → MvPolynomial (η ⊕ ι) k),
      ∀ a z, aeval (Sum.elim (algebraMap L K ∘ e) z) (F a) = aeval z (P a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let η := Σ a, ↥(P a).support
  let e : η → L := fun p ↦ (P p.1).coeff p.2
  let F (a : α) : MvPolynomial (η ⊕ ι) k :=
    ∑ m ∈ (P a).support.attach,
      X (Sum.inl ⟨a, m⟩) * rename Sum.inr (monomial (m : ι →₀ ℕ) (1 : k))
  refine ⟨η, inferInstance, e, F, fun a z ↦ ?_⟩
  have hmono (m : ι →₀ ℕ) :
      aeval (Sum.elim (algebraMap L K ∘ e) z)
          (rename Sum.inr (monomial m (1 : k))) =
        m.prod (fun i n ↦ z i ^ n) := by
    rw [aeval_rename]
    simp [aeval_monomial]
  simp only [F, map_sum, map_mul, aeval_X, Sum.elim_inl, Function.comp_apply, hmono]
  dsimp only [e]
  exact (Finset.sum_attach (P a).support (fun m ↦
    algebraMap L K ((P a).coeff m) * m.prod (fun i n ↦ z i ^ n))).trans
      (MvPolynomial.eval₂_eq (algebraMap L K) z (P a)).symm

name: GroupConfig.sum_clear_denominators
statement:
private theorem sum_clear_denominators {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (p q : α → K) (d : α → ℕ) (y : K) (hq : ∀ i, q i ≠ 0) :
    (∑ i, p i * (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, q j) * y ^ d i) =
      (∏ i, q i) * (∑ i, p i / q i * y ^ d i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ q (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  field_simp [hq]

name: GroupConfig.mem_racl_of_cleared_relation
statement:
private theorem mem_racl_of_cleared_relation {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    {S : Set K} (d : α → ℕ) (hd : Function.Injective d) (j : α) (p q : α → K) (y : K)
    (hpS : ∀ i, p i ∈ racl k S) (hqS : ∀ i, q i ∈ racl k S)
    (hq : ∀ i, q i ≠ 0) (hpj : p j ≠ 0)
    (hz : (∑ i, p i * (∏ r ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, q r) * y ^ d i) = 0) :
    y ∈ racl k S
proof:
:= by
  let R := racl k S
  let c (i : α) : R := ⟨p i / q i, div_mem (hpS i) (hqS i)⟩
  let f : Polynomial R := ∑ i, Polynomial.monomial (d i) (c i)
  have hcoeff : f.coeff (d j) = c j := by
    simp [f, Polynomial.coeff_monomial, hd.eq_iff]
  have hf : f ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hc := hcoeff
    rw [h0, Polynomial.coeff_zero] at hc
    have hcz := congrArg (fun x : R ↦ (x : K)) hc
    exact (div_ne_zero hpj (hq j)) hcz.symm
  have hprod : (∏ i, q i) ≠ 0 := Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun i _ ↦ hq i
  have hsum : (∑ i, p i / q i * y ^ d i) = 0 := by
    rw [sum_clear_denominators p q d y hq] at hz
    exact (mul_eq_zero.1 hz).resolve_left hprod
  have hy : IsAlgebraic R y := ⟨f, hf, by simpa [f, c] using hsum⟩
  exact (isRAC_racl (k := k) S) y hy

name: GroupConfig.exists_fraction_nonzero
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, Q, h⟩ := (mem_adjoin_range_iff (↥L) z c).1 hc
  by_cases hQ : aeval z Q = 0
  · refine ⟨0, 1, by simp, ?_⟩
    simpa [hQ] using h
  · exact ⟨P, Q, hQ, h⟩

name: GroupConfig.isConstructible_cleared_relation
statement:
private theorem isConstructible_cleared_relation {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (d : α → ℕ) (j : α) : IsConstructibleOver k
      {c : ((α ⊕ α) ⊕ Unit) → K |
        (∏ i, c (Sum.inl (Sum.inr i))) ≠ 0 ∧ c (Sum.inl (Sum.inl j)) ≠ 0 ∧
          (∑ i, c (Sum.inl (Sum.inl i)) *
            (∏ r ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, c (Sum.inl (Sum.inr r))) *
              c (Sum.inr ()) ^ d i) = 0}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let R : MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ α) ⊕ Unit) k :=
    ∑ i, X (Sum.inl (Sum.inl i)) *
      (∏ r ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, X (Sum.inl (Sum.inr r))) * X (Sum.inr ()) ^ d i
  let D : MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ α) ⊕ Unit) k := ∏ i, X (Sum.inl (Sum.inr i))
  convert ((IsConstructibleOver.polynomial_ne_zero D).inter
    (IsConstructibleOver.polynomial_ne_zero (X (Sum.inl (Sum.inl j))))).inter
      (IsConstructibleOver.polynomial_zero R) using 1
  ext c
  simp only [mem_ofPred_eq, mem_inter_iff, R, D, map_sum, map_mul, map_prod, map_pow, aeval_X]
  tauto

name: GroupConfig.exists_constructible_algebraicity_witness
statement:
private theorem exists_constructible_algebraicity_witness {ι : Type} [Finite ι]
    (L : IntermediateField k K) (z : ι → K) (y : K) (hy : y ∈ racl (↥L) (range z)) :
    ∃ (η : Type) (_ : Finite η) (e : η → L)
      (Φ : Set ((η ⊕ (ι ⊕ Unit)) → K)), IsConstructibleOver k Φ ∧
        Sum.elim (algebraMap L K ∘ e) (Sum.elim z fun _ ↦ y) ∈ Φ ∧
        ∀ (e₀ : η → k) (z₀ : ι → K) (y₀ : K),
          Sum.elim (algebraMap k K ∘ e₀) (Sum.elim z₀ fun _ ↦ y₀) ∈ Φ →
            y₀ ∈ racl k (range z₀)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqy, hc⟩ := exists_poly_of_isAlgebraic ((mem_racl_iff _).1 hy)
  let α := ↥q.support
  let d : α → ℕ := fun i ↦ i
  have hd : Function.Injective d := Subtype.val_injective
  have hsupp : q.support.Nonempty := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 (by simpa using hq)
  obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := hsupp
  let j : α := ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩
  choose P Q hQ hfrac using fun i : α ↦ exists_fraction_nonzero z (hc i)
  obtain ⟨η, iη, e, F, hF⟩ := exists_polynomial_parameters L (Sum.elim P Q)
  let emb : η ⊕ ι → η ⊕ (ι ⊕ Unit) := Sum.map id Sum.inl
  let f : ((α ⊕ α) ⊕ Unit) → MvPolynomial (η ⊕ (ι ⊕ Unit)) k :=
    Sum.elim (fun i ↦ rename emb (F i)) fun _ ↦ X (Sum.inr (Sum.inr ()))
  let Φ : Set ((η ⊕ (ι ⊕ Unit)) → K) :=
    {θ | (∏ i, aeval θ (f (Sum.inl (Sum.inr i)))) ≠ 0 ∧
      aeval θ (f (Sum.inl (Sum.inl j))) ≠ 0 ∧
        (∑ i, aeval θ (f (Sum.inl (Sum.inl i))) *
          (∏ r ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, aeval θ (f (Sum.inl (Sum.inr r)))) *
            aeval θ (f (Sum.inr ())) ^ d i) = 0}
  have hf (a : α ⊕ α) (e' : η → K) (z' : ι → K) (y' : K) :
      aeval (Sum.elim e' (Sum.elim z' fun _ ↦ y')) (f (Sum.inl a)) =
        aeval (Sum.elim e' z') (F a) := by
    rw [show f (Sum.inl a) = rename emb (F a) from rfl, aeval_rename]
    have he : Sum.elim e' (Sum.elim z' fun _ ↦ y') ∘ emb = Sum.elim e' z' := by
      funext i
      cases i <;> rfl
    rw [he]
  have hfy (e' : η → K) (z' : ι → K) (y' : K) :
      aeval (Sum.elim e' (Sum.elim z' fun _ ↦ y')) (f (Sum.inr ())) = y' := by
    rw [show f (Sum.inr ()) = X (Sum.inr (Sum.inr ())) from rfl, aeval_X]
    rfl
  refine ⟨η, iη, e, Φ, (isConstructible_cleared_relation d j).preimage_polynomial f, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change _ ∧ _ ∧ _
    simp only [hf, hfy, hF, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]
    refine ⟨Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 (fun i _ ↦ hQ i), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hpj
      have h := Polynomial.mem_support_iff.1 j.2
      rw [hfrac j, hpj, zero_div] at h
      exact h rfl
    · rw [sum_clear_denominators _ _ d y hQ]
      have heval : (∑ i : α, q.coeff i * y ^ d i) = q.eval y := by
        rw [Polynomial.eval_eq_sum, Polynomial.sum_def, ← Finset.sum_attach q.support]
        simp only [Finset.attach_eq_univ]
        rfl
      simp_rw [← hfrac]
      rw [heval, hqy, mul_zero]
  · intro e₀ z₀ y₀ hθ
    change _ ∧ _ ∧ _ at hθ
    simp only [hf, hfy] at hθ
    have hD : ∀ i, aeval (Sum.elim (algebraMap k K ∘ e₀) z₀) (F (Sum.inr i)) ≠ 0 :=
      fun i ↦ (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.1 hθ.1) i (Finset.mem_univ i)
    have hmem (a : α ⊕ α) :
        aeval (Sum.elim (algebraMap k K ∘ e₀) z₀) (F a) ∈ racl k (range z₀) := by
      apply MvPolynomial.eval₂_mem (fun m _ ↦ (racl k (range z₀)).algebraMap_mem _)
      intro i
      cases i with
      | inl i => exact (racl k (range z₀)).algebraMap_mem (e₀ i)
      | inr i => exact subset_racl k _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact mem_racl_of_cleared_relation d hd j _ _ y₀
      (fun i ↦ hmem (Sum.inl i)) (fun i ↦ hmem (Sum.inr i)) hD hθ.2.1 hθ.2.2

name: GroupConfig.exists_finite_incidence_descent_to
statement:
private theorem exists_finite_incidence_descent_to [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K]
    [UniversalDomain k K] {J ι κ μ : Type} [Finite J] [Finite ι] [Finite κ] [Finite μ]
    {F : Type*} [Field F] [Algebra k F] [IsAlgClosed F] (f : F →ₐ[k] K)
    (L : IntermediateField k K) (w : κ → F) (v : ι → K)
    (hind : IndepOver k ∅ (L : Set K) (range (f ∘ w)))
    (S : J → μ → MvPolynomial (κ ⊕ ι) k) (T : J → MvPolynomial (κ ⊕ ι) k)
    (hinc : ∀ j, aeval (Sum.elim (f ∘ w) v) (T j) ∈
      racl (↥L) (range fun i ↦ aeval (Sum.elim (f ∘ w) v) (S j i))) :
    ∃ v₀ : ι → F, ∀ j, aeval (Sum.elim w v₀) (T j) ∈
      racl k (range fun i ↦ aeval (Sum.elim w v₀) (S j i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Algebra F K := f.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower k F K := IsScalarTower.of_algHom f
  choose η iη e Φ hΦ hactual hspecial using fun j ↦
    exists_constructible_algebraicity_witness L
      (fun i ↦ aeval (Sum.elim (f ∘ w) v) (S j i)) (aeval (Sum.elim (f ∘ w) v) (T j)) (hinc j)
  let (j : J) : Finite (η j) := iη j
  let Ε := Σ j, η j
  let E : Ε → K := fun p ↦ algebraMap L K (e p.1 p.2)
  let emb : κ ⊕ ι → (Ε ⊕ κ) ⊕ ι := Sum.map Sum.inr id
  let p (j : J) : (η j ⊕ (μ ⊕ Unit)) → MvPolynomial ((Ε ⊕ κ) ⊕ ι) k :=
    Sum.elim (fun i ↦ X (Sum.inl (Sum.inl ⟨j, i⟩)))
      (Sum.elim (fun i ↦ rename emb (S j i)) fun _ ↦ rename emb (T j))
  let H : Set (((Ε ⊕ κ) ⊕ ι) → K) := {θ | ∀ j, (fun i ↦ aeval θ (p j i)) ∈ Φ j}
  have hH : IsConstructibleOver k H := by
    have h := IsConstructibleOver.iInter fun j ↦ (hΦ j).preimage_polynomial (p j)
    convert h using 1
    ext θ
    simp only [H, mem_ofPred_eq, mem_iInter, mem_preimage]
  have heval (j : J) (e' : Ε → K) (w' : κ → K) (v' : ι → K) :
      (fun i ↦ aeval (Sum.elim (Sum.elim e' w') v') (p j i)) =
        Sum.elim (fun i ↦ e' ⟨j, i⟩)
          (Sum.elim (fun i ↦ aeval (Sum.elim w' v') (S j i))
            fun _ ↦ aeval (Sum.elim w' v') (T j)) := by
    have hraw : Sum.elim (Sum.elim e' w') v' ∘ emb = Sum.elim w' v' := by
      funext i
      cases i <;> rfl
    funext i
    cases i with
    | inl i => simp only [p, Sum.elim_inl, aeval_X]
    | inr i =>
      cases i with
      | inl i => simp only [p, Sum.elim_inr, Sum.elim_inl, aeval_rename, hraw]
      | inr i => simp only [p, Sum.elim_inr, aeval_rename, hraw]
  have hEx : IsConstructibleOver k
      {cv : (Ε ⊕ κ) → K | ∃ v', Sum.elim cv v' ∈ H} := by
    apply IsConstructibleOver.exists
    convert hH using 1
    ext θ
    have hθ : Sum.elim (θ ∘ Sum.inl) (θ ∘ Sum.inr) = θ := by
      funext i
      cases i <;> rfl
    simp only [mem_ofPred_eq, hθ]
  have hEL : range E ⊆ L := by
    rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩
    exact (e p.1 p.2).2
  have hact : Sum.elim E (f ∘ w) ∈ {cv : (Ε ⊕ κ) → K | ∃ v', Sum.elim cv v' ∈ H} := by
    refine ⟨v, fun j ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [heval]
    exact hactual j
  obtain ⟨e₀, vΩ, hvΩ⟩ := descent hEx (hind.mono_left hEL) hact
  
  let q : ((Ε ⊕ κ) ⊕ ι) → MvPolynomial ι F :=
    Sum.elim (Sum.elim (fun i ↦ C (algebraMap k F (e₀ i))) (fun i ↦ C (w i))) X
  have hq (z : ι → K) : (fun i ↦ aeval z (q i)) =
      Sum.elim (Sum.elim (algebraMap k K ∘ e₀) (f ∘ w)) z := by
    funext i
    cases i with
    | inl i =>
      cases i with
      | inl i => simp only [q, Sum.elim_inl, aeval_C, Function.comp_apply]; exact f.commutes _
      | inr i => simp only [q, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, aeval_C]; rfl
    | inr i => simp only [q, Sum.elim_inr, aeval_X]
  have hFiber := (hH.extend_base (L := F)).preimage_polynomial q
  obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩ := hFiber.exists_kpoint ⟨vΩ, by
    change (fun i ↦ aeval vΩ (q i)) ∈ H
    rw [hq]
    exact hvΩ⟩
  change (fun i ↦ aeval (algebraMap F K ∘ v₀) (q i)) ∈ H at hv₀
  rw [hq] at hv₀
  have hpoly (P : MvPolynomial (κ ⊕ ι) k) :
      aeval (Sum.elim (f ∘ w) (f ∘ v₀)) P = f (aeval (Sum.elim w v₀) P) := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply]
    have he : Sum.elim (f ∘ w) (f ∘ v₀) = fun i ↦ f (Sum.elim w v₀ i) := by
      funext i
      cases i <;> rfl
    rw [he]
  refine ⟨v₀, fun j ↦ ?_⟩
  have hj := hv₀ j
  rw [heval] at hj
  have hmem := hspecial j (fun i ↦ e₀ ⟨j, i⟩)
    (fun i ↦ aeval (Sum.elim (f ∘ w) (f ∘ v₀)) (S j i))
    (aeval (Sum.elim (f ∘ w) (f ∘ v₀)) (T j)) hj
  apply (algHom_mem_racl_image_iff f).1
  simp only [hpoly] at hmem
  change f (aeval (Sum.elim w v₀) (T j)) ∈
    racl k (range (f ∘ fun i ↦ aeval (Sum.elim w v₀) (S j i))) at hmem
  rwa [range_comp] at hmem

name: GroupConfig.exists_polynomial_closure_table_descent_to
statement:
theorem exists_polynomial_closure_table_descent_to [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K]
    [UniversalDomain k K] {J ι κ μ : Type} [Finite J] [Finite ι] [Finite κ] [Finite μ]
    {F : Type*} [Field F] [Algebra k F] [IsAlgClosed F] (f : F →ₐ[k] K)
    (L : IntermediateField k K) (w : κ → F) (v : ι → K)
    (hind : IndepOver k ∅ (L : Set K) (range (f ∘ w)))
    (R : J → μ → MvPolynomial κ k) (C : J → μ → MvPolynomial ι k)
    (hrows : ∀ j, racl (↥L) (range fun i ↦ aeval (f ∘ w) (R j i)) =
      racl (↥L) (range fun i ↦ aeval v (C j i))) :
    ∃ v₀ : ι → F, ∀ j, racl k (range fun i ↦ aeval w (R j i)) =
      racl k (range fun i ↦ aeval v₀ (C j i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S (p : J × Bool × μ) (i : μ) : MvPolynomial (κ ⊕ ι) k :=
    if p.2.1 then rename Sum.inl (R p.1 i) else rename Sum.inr (C p.1 i)
  let T (p : J × Bool × μ) : MvPolynomial (κ ⊕ ι) k :=
    if p.2.1 then rename Sum.inr (C p.1 p.2.2) else rename Sum.inl (R p.1 p.2.2)
  have hl (w' : κ → K) (v' : ι → K) (P : MvPolynomial κ k) :
      aeval (Sum.elim w' v') (rename Sum.inl P) = aeval w' P := by
    rw [aeval_rename]
    rfl
  have hr (w' : κ → K) (v' : ι → K) (P : MvPolynomial ι k) :
      aeval (Sum.elim w' v') (rename Sum.inr P) = aeval v' P := by
    rw [aeval_rename]
    rfl
  have hinc (p : J × Bool × μ) : aeval (Sum.elim (f ∘ w) v) (T p) ∈
      racl (↥L) (range fun i ↦ aeval (Sum.elim (f ∘ w) v) (S p i)) := by
    rcases p with ⟨j, b, i⟩
    cases b
    · simpa only [S, T, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, hl, hr] using
        (hrows j ▸ subset_racl (↥L) (range fun i ↦ aeval (f ∘ w) (R j i)) (mem_range_self i))
    · simpa only [S, T, ↓reduceIte, hl, hr] using
        ((hrows j).symm ▸ subset_racl (↥L) (range fun i ↦ aeval v (C j i)) (mem_range_self i))
  obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩ := exists_finite_incidence_descent_to f L w v hind S T hinc
  refine ⟨v₀, fun j ↦ le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_) (racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_)⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    change aeval w (R j i) ∈ racl k (range fun i ↦ aeval v₀ (C j i))
    simpa only [S, T, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, aeval_rename, Function.comp_def,
      Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] using hv₀ (j, false, i)
  · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    change aeval v₀ (C j i) ∈ racl k (range fun i ↦ aeval w (R j i))
    simpa only [S, T, ↓reduceIte, aeval_rename, Function.comp_def,
      Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] using hv₀ (j, true, i)

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.exists_stepI_fresh_with_parameterRank
statement:
theorem exists_stepI_fresh_with_parameterRank {W : Set K} (hW : W.Finite) :
    ∃ E : Set K, E.Finite ∧ erk k ∅ E = 3 * erk k ∅ (range a) ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ E (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z ∪ W) ∧
      ∃ (κ₁ κ₂ κ₃ κ₄ κ₅ κ₆ : Type u) (_ : Finite κ₁) (_ : Finite κ₂) (_ : Finite κ₃)
        (_ : Finite κ₄) (_ : Finite κ₅) (_ : Finite κ₆) (a' : κ₁ → K) (b' : κ₂ → K)
        (c' : κ₃ → K) (x' : κ₄ → K) (y' : κ₅ → K) (z' : κ₆ → K),
        GroupConfiguration (↥(racl k E)) a' b' c' x' y' z' ∧
        racl k (E ∪ range a') = racl k (E ∪ range a) ∧
        racl k (E ∪ range b') = racl k (E ∪ range b) ∧
        racl k (E ∪ range c') = racl k (E ∪ range c) ∧
        racl k (E ∪ range x') = racl k (E ∪ range x) ∧
        racl k (E ∪ range y') = racl k (E ∪ range y) ∧
        racl k (E ∪ range z') = racl k (E ∪ range z) ∧
        (∀ j, z' j ∈ dclAdjoin (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (range b')) y') ∧
        (∀ j, y' j ∈ dclAdjoin (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (range b')) z')
proof:
:= by
                                                                       
  obtain ⟨e₁, c', x', he₁rank, he₁, -, -, -, hZ₁, hb₁, hy₁, hc₁, hzt, -⟩ :=
    hc.exists_defStep_fresh_with_parameterRank hW
  obtain ⟨Z₁, _, hZ₁, hc₁, hzt⟩ : ∃ (Z : Set K) (_ : Finite ↥Z), racl k Z = racl k (range z) ∧
      GroupConfiguration (↥(racl k (range e₁))) a (Sum.elim b c') c x (Sum.elim y x')
        (tupleOf Z) ∧
      ∀ s ∈ Z, s ∈ dclAdjoin (racl k (range e₁)) (Sum.elim (Sum.elim b c') (Sum.elim y x')) :=
    ⟨_, inferInstance, hZ₁, hc₁, fun s hs ↦ hzt ⟨s, hs⟩⟩
                                                                                              
                                                              
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (range e₁)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have _ : UniversalDomain ↥(racl k (range e₁)) K :=
    universalDomain_of_isSmall _ (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range e₁)).racl
  obtain ⟨e₂, c'', z'', Z₂, _, he₂rank, he₂, -, -, hZ₂, ha₂, hy₂, hc₂, hxt, -⟩ :=
    hc₁.swapAB.exists_defStep_base_fresh_with_parameterRank (racl k (range e₁)) hW
  replace hc₂ := hc₂.swapAB
                                                                                    
                                                                                                
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k ((racl k (range e₁) : Set K) ∪ range e₂)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have _ : UniversalDomain ↥(racl k ((racl k (range e₁) : Set K) ∪ range e₂)) K :=
    universalDomain_of_isSmall _
      ((IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range e₁)).racl.union (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range e₂))).racl
  obtain ⟨e₃, a', x''', Z₃, _, he₃rank, he₃, -, -, hZ₃, hb₃, hz₃, hc₃, hyt, himp₃⟩ :=
    hc₂.swapBC.swapAB.swapBC.exists_defStep_base_fresh_with_parameterRank
      (racl k ((racl k (range e₁) : Set K) ∪ range e₂)) hW
  replace hc₃ := hc₃.swapBC.swapAB.swapBC
  
  have hA₁ : erk k (range e₁) (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a) := by
    simpa only [empty_union] using he₁.symm.erk_eq
      (fun _ h ↦ Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl h)))))) (finite_range a)
  have hB₁ : erk k (racl k (range e₁) : Set K) (range (Sum.elim b c')) =
      erk k ∅ (range a) := by
    rw [← erk_base_empty (racl k (range e₁)), hc₁.erk_b_eq, erk_base_empty, erk_racl_base]
    exact hA₁
  have he₂rank' : erk k (range e₁) (range e₂) = erk k ∅ (range a) :=
    (erk_racl_base k _ _).symm.trans (he₂rank.trans hB₁)
  have hB₂ : erk k ((racl k (range e₁) : Set K) ∪ range e₂) (range (Sum.elim b c')) =
      erk k (racl k (range e₁) : Set K) (range (Sum.elim b c')) :=
    he₂.symm.erk_eq (fun _ h ↦ Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl h))))))
      (finite_range (Sum.elim b c'))
  have hC₂ : erk k (racl k ((racl k (range e₁) : Set K) ∪ range e₂) : Set K) (range c) =
      erk k ∅ (range a) := by
    rw [← erk_base_empty (racl k ((racl k (range e₁) : Set K) ∪ range e₂)),
      hc₂.erk_c_eq, ← hc₂.erk_b_eq, erk_base_empty, erk_racl_base, hB₂, hB₁]
  have he₃rank' : erk k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂) (range e₃) = erk k ∅ (range a) := by
    have h := he₃rank.trans hC₂
    rwa [racl_union_left, erk_racl_base] at h
  have hErank : erk k ∅ (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃) = 3 * erk k ∅ (range a) := by
    rw [erk_union_eq, erk_union_eq]
    simp only [empty_union, he₁rank, he₂rank', he₃rank']
    ring
                                               
  have hK₃ : racl k ((racl k ((racl k (range e₁) : Set K) ∪ range e₂) : Set K) ∪ range e₃) =
      racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃) := by
    rw [racl_union_left, union_assoc, racl_union_left, ← union_assoc]
  rw [hK₃] at hc₃ hyt himp₃
  have hEfin : (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃).Finite :=
    ((finite_range e₁).union (finite_range e₂)).union (finite_range e₃)
  have _ : UniversalDomain ↥(racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃)) K :=
    universalDomain_of_isSmall _ (IsSmall.of_finite hEfin).racl
  
  have hE₁ : range e₁ ⊆ racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃) :=
    (subset_union_left.trans subset_union_left).trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hE₁₂ : range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ⊆ racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃) :=
    subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hK₁ : (racl k (range e₁) : Set K) ⊆ racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃) :=
    racl_mono (k := k) (subset_union_left.trans subset_union_left)
  have hK₁e₂ : (racl k (range e₁) : Set K) ∪ range e₂ ⊆
      racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃) :=
    union_subset hK₁ ((subset_union_right.trans subset_union_left).trans (subset_racl k _))
  have hK₂ : (racl k ((racl k (range e₁) : Set K) ∪ range e₂) : Set K) ⊆
      racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃) :=
    racl_le_of_subset_racl hK₁e₂
  have hK₂e₃ : (racl k ((racl k (range e₁) : Set K) ∪ range e₂) : Set K) ∪ range e₃ ⊆
      racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃) :=
    union_subset hK₂ (subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _))
  have hK₁K₂ : (racl k (range e₁) : Set K) ⊆
      racl k ((racl k (range e₁) : Set K) ∪ range e₂) :=
    subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
  
  simp only [Sum.elim_range, range_tupleOf] at hb₁ hy₁ ha₂ hy₂ hZ₃ hb₃ hz₃ he₂ he₃
  have ia : racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃ ∪ (range a ∪ range c'')) =
      racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃ ∪ range a) :=
    racl_union_congr_of_subset ha₂ hK₁e₂
  have ib₁ : racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃ ∪ (range b ∪ range c')) =
      racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃ ∪ range b) :=
    racl_union_congr_of_subset hb₁ hE₁
  have ib : racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃ ∪ (range b ∪ range c' ∪ range a')) =
      racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃ ∪ range b) :=
    (racl_union_congr_of_subset hb₃ hK₂e₃).trans ib₁
  have ix : racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃ ∪ Z₂) =
      racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃ ∪ range x) :=
    racl_union_congr_of_subset hZ₂ hK₁
  have iy₁ : racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃ ∪ (range y ∪ range x')) =
      racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃ ∪ range y) :=
    racl_union_congr_of_subset hy₁ hE₁
  have iy₂ : racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃ ∪ (range y ∪ range x' ∪ range z'')) =
      racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃ ∪ range y) :=
    (racl_union_congr_of_subset hy₂ hK₁e₂).trans iy₁
  have iy : racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃ ∪ Z₃) =
      racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃ ∪ range y) :=
    (racl_union_congr_of_subset hZ₃ hK₂).trans iy₂
  have iz₁ : racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃ ∪ Z₁) =
      racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃ ∪ range z) :=
    racl_union_congr rfl hZ₁
  have iz : racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃ ∪ (Z₁ ∪ range x''')) =
      racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃ ∪ range z) :=
    (racl_union_congr_of_subset hz₃ hK₂e₃).trans iz₁
  
  have hind : IndepOver k ∅ (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z ∪ W)
      (range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃) := by
    refine indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨he₁.symm, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [empty_union]
      refine (indepOver_congr_left ?_).1 ((indepOver_racl_base_iff _ _ _).1 he₂.symm)
      have hperm : range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z =
          range b ∪ range a ∪ range c ∪ range z ∪ range y ∪ range x := by ac_rfl
      rw [hperm]
      exact racl_union_union_congr (racl_union_union_congr (racl_union_union_congr
        (racl_union_union_congr (racl_union_union_congr (racl_union_union_congr hb₁.symm rfl)
        rfl) (racl_union_congr rfl hZ₁.symm)) hy₁.symm) rfl) rfl
    · rw [empty_union]
      have h := (indepOver_congr_base (racl_union_left (k := k) (range e₁) (range e₂))).1
        ((indepOver_racl_base_iff _ _ _).1 he₃.symm)
      refine (indepOver_congr_left ?_).1 h
      have hperm : range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z =
          range c ∪ range b ∪ range a ∪ range x ∪ range z ∪ range y := by ac_rfl
      rw [hperm]
      have hE₁' : range e₁ ⊆ racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂) :=
        subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
      have hK₁' : (racl k (range e₁) : Set K) ⊆ racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂) :=
        racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_left
      have hK₁e₂' : (racl k (range e₁) : Set K) ∪ range e₂ ⊆ racl k (range e₁ ∪ range e₂) :=
        union_subset hK₁' (subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _))
      exact racl_union_union_congr (racl_union_union_congr (racl_union_union_congr
        (racl_union_union_congr (racl_union_union_congr (racl_union_union_congr rfl
          (racl_union_congr_of_subset hb₁ hE₁').symm)
          (racl_union_congr_of_subset ha₂ hK₁e₂').symm)
          (racl_union_congr_of_subset hZ₂ hK₁').symm)
          (racl_union_congr rfl hZ₁.symm))
        ((racl_union_congr_of_subset hy₁ hE₁').symm.trans
          (racl_union_congr_of_subset hy₂ hK₁e₂').symm)) rfl
  
  have hyp1 : ∀ i, tupleOf Z₁ i ∈ dclAdjoin (adjoin k
      ((racl k ((racl k (range e₁) : Set K) ∪ range e₂) : Set K) ∪ range (Sum.elim b c')))
      (Sum.elim (Sum.elim y x') z'') := fun i ↦
    mem_dclAdjoin_mono' (by
      rw [Sum.elim_range (Sum.elim b c') (Sum.elim y x'), Sum.elim_range (Sum.elim y x') z'']
      exact union_subset
        ((hK₁K₂.trans (subset_union_left.trans (subset_adjoin k _))).trans subset_union_left)
        (union_subset ((subset_union_right.trans (subset_adjoin k _)).trans subset_union_left)
          (subset_union_left.trans subset_union_right))) (hzt i i.2)
  have hyp2 : ∀ i, tupleOf Z₂ i ∈ dclAdjoin (adjoin k
      ((racl k ((racl k (range e₁) : Set K) ∪ range e₂) : Set K) ∪ range (Sum.elim a c'')))
      (Sum.elim (Sum.elim y x') z'') := fun i ↦
    mem_dclAdjoin_mono' (by
      rw [Sum.elim_range (Sum.elim a c'') (Sum.elim (Sum.elim y x') z'')]
      exact union_subset ((subset_union_left.trans (subset_adjoin k _)).trans subset_union_left)
        (union_subset ((subset_union_right.trans (subset_adjoin k _)).trans subset_union_left)
          subset_union_right)) (hxt i i.2)
  have hzdcl := himp₃ hyp1 hyp2
  
  refine ⟨range e₁ ∪ range e₂ ∪ range e₃, hEfin, hErank, hind.symm, ↥(range (Sum.elim a c'')),
    ↥(range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim b c') a')), ↥(range c), ↥Z₂, ↥Z₃, ↥Z₁ ⊕ ↥Z₂, inferInstance,
    inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    tupleOf (range (Sum.elim a c'')), tupleOf (range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim b c') a')),
    tupleOf (range c), tupleOf Z₂, tupleOf Z₃, Sum.elim (tupleOf Z₁) x''',
    hc₃.ofRaclEq (by rw [range_tupleOf]) (by rw [range_tupleOf]) (by rw [range_tupleOf]) rfl rfl
      rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rwa [range_tupleOf, Sum.elim_range]
  · rwa [range_tupleOf, Sum.elim_range, Sum.elim_range]
  · rw [range_tupleOf]
  · rwa [range_tupleOf]
  · rwa [range_tupleOf]
  · rwa [Sum.elim_range, range_tupleOf]
  · intro j
    refine (mem_dclAdjoin_congr ?_ _ _).1 (hzdcl j)
    simp only [range_tupleOf, Sum.elim_range, coe_adjoin_base]
  · intro j
    refine mem_dclAdjoin_mono' ?_ (hyt j j.2)
    rw [range_tupleOf, Sum.elim_range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim b c') a') (Sum.elim (tupleOf Z₁) x''')]
    exact union_subset ((coe_subset_adjoin _ _).trans subset_union_left)
      (union_subset ((subset_adjoin _ _).trans subset_union_left) subset_union_right)

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.exists_stepI_with_parameterRank
statement:
theorem exists_stepI_with_parameterRank :
    ∃ E : Set K, E.Finite ∧ erk k ∅ E = 3 * erk k ∅ (range a) ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ E (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z) ∧
      ∃ (κ₁ κ₂ κ₃ κ₄ κ₅ κ₆ : Type u) (_ : Finite κ₁) (_ : Finite κ₂) (_ : Finite κ₃)
        (_ : Finite κ₄) (_ : Finite κ₅) (_ : Finite κ₆) (a' : κ₁ → K) (b' : κ₂ → K)
        (c' : κ₃ → K) (x' : κ₄ → K) (y' : κ₅ → K) (z' : κ₆ → K),
        GroupConfiguration (↥(racl k E)) a' b' c' x' y' z' ∧
        racl k (E ∪ range a') = racl k (E ∪ range a) ∧
        racl k (E ∪ range b') = racl k (E ∪ range b) ∧
        racl k (E ∪ range c') = racl k (E ∪ range c) ∧
        racl k (E ∪ range x') = racl k (E ∪ range x) ∧
        racl k (E ∪ range y') = racl k (E ∪ range y) ∧
        racl k (E ∪ range z') = racl k (E ∪ range z) ∧
        (∀ j, z' j ∈ dclAdjoin (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (range b')) y') ∧
        (∀ j, y' j ∈ dclAdjoin (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (range b')) z')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, hEfin, hErank, hEind, h⟩ := hc.exists_stepI_fresh_with_parameterRank finite_empty
  rw [union_empty] at hEind
  exact ⟨E, hEfin, hErank, hEind, h⟩

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.exists_stepI
statement:
theorem exists_stepI :
    ∃ E : Set K, E.Finite ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ E (range a ∪ range b ∪ range c ∪ range x ∪ range y ∪ range z) ∧
      ∃ (κ₁ κ₂ κ₃ κ₄ κ₅ κ₆ : Type u) (_ : Finite κ₁) (_ : Finite κ₂) (_ : Finite κ₃)
        (_ : Finite κ₄) (_ : Finite κ₅) (_ : Finite κ₆) (a' : κ₁ → K) (b' : κ₂ → K)
        (c' : κ₃ → K) (x' : κ₄ → K) (y' : κ₅ → K) (z' : κ₆ → K),
        GroupConfiguration (↥(racl k E)) a' b' c' x' y' z' ∧
        racl k (E ∪ range a') = racl k (E ∪ range a) ∧
        racl k (E ∪ range b') = racl k (E ∪ range b) ∧
        racl k (E ∪ range c') = racl k (E ∪ range c) ∧
        racl k (E ∪ range x') = racl k (E ∪ range x) ∧
        racl k (E ∪ range y') = racl k (E ∪ range y) ∧
        racl k (E ∪ range z') = racl k (E ∪ range z) ∧
        (∀ j, z' j ∈ dclAdjoin (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (range b')) y') ∧
        (∀ j, y' j ∈ dclAdjoin (adjoin (↥(racl k E)) (range b')) z')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, hEfin, -, h⟩ := hc.exists_stepI_with_parameterRank
  exact ⟨E, hEfin, h⟩

name: Matrix.IsReducedRowEchelon.map
statement:
theorem Matrix.IsReducedRowEchelon.map {m n R S : Type*} [LT m] [LT n] [Zero R] [One R]
    [Zero S] [One S] {A : Matrix m n R} (hA : A.IsReducedRowEchelon) {f : R → S}
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (h0 : f 0 = 0) (h1 : f 1 = 1) :
    (A.map f).IsReducedRowEchelon
proof:
:= by
  have hz (x : R) : f x = 0 ↔ x = 0 := ⟨fun h ↦ hf (h.trans h0.symm), fun h ↦ h ▸ h0⟩
  have hlead (i : m) (c : n) : (A.map f).IsLeadingEntry i c ↔ A.IsLeadingEntry i c := by
    simp only [Matrix.IsLeadingEntry, Matrix.map_apply, ne_eq, hz]
  refine ⟨fun i₁ i₂ hlt j₂ hj ↦ ?_, fun i c h ↦ ?_, fun i₁ i₂ c hlt h ↦ ?_⟩
  · simp only [Matrix.map_apply, hz] at hj ⊢
    exact hA.isRowEchelon hlt hj
  · rw [Matrix.map_apply, hA.eq_one ((hlead i c).1 h), h1]
  · rw [Matrix.map_apply, hA.eq_zero hlt ((hlead i₂ c).1 h), h0]

name: GroupConfig.span_range_comp_rref
statement:
theorem span_range_comp_rref :
    Submodule.span K (range fun μ : Pivots W ↦ ⇑f ∘ rref W μ) = spanMap f W
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_) (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_)
  · rintro _ ⟨μ, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, rref_mem W μ, rfl⟩
  · let T := Submodule.span K (range fun μ : Pivots W ↦ ⇑f ∘ rref W μ)
    rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    rw [← span_range_rref W] at hv
    induction hv using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨μ, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨μ, rfl⟩
    | zero =>
      change ⇑f ∘ (0 : 𝓜 → L) ∈ (T : Set (𝓜 → K))
      rw [show ⇑f ∘ (0 : 𝓜 → L) = 0 from funext fun _ ↦ map_zero f]
      exact T.zero_mem
    | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
      change ⇑f ∘ (x + y) ∈ (T : Set (𝓜 → K))
      rw [show ⇑f ∘ (x + y) = ⇑f ∘ x + ⇑f ∘ y from funext fun _ ↦ map_add f _ _]
      exact T.add_mem hx hy
    | smul c x _ hx =>
      change ⇑f ∘ (c • x) ∈ (T : Set (𝓜 → K))
      rw [show ⇑f ∘ (c • x) = f c • (⇑f ∘ x) from funext fun _ ↦ map_mul f _ _]
      exact T.smul_mem (f c) hx

name: GroupConfig.exists_rref_spanMap
statement:
theorem exists_rref_spanMap :
    ∃ e : Pivots W ≃ Pivots (spanMap f W), StrictMono e ∧
      ∀ μ, rref (spanMap f W) (e μ) = ⇑f ∘ rref W μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let v : Pivots W → 𝓜 → K := fun μ ↦ ⇑f ∘ rref W μ
  have hv : LinearIndependent K v := by
    let w : Pivots W → (⊤ : Submodule K (𝓜 → K)) := fun μ ↦ ⟨v μ, trivial⟩
    have hw : LinearIndependent K w :=
      linearIndependent_of_leading ⊤ w (fun μ ↦ (μ : 𝓜)) Subtype.val_injective
        (fun μ ↦ by simp [w, v, rref_apply_self])
        (fun μ ν hν ↦ by simp [w, v, rref_apply_of_lt W μ hν])
    exact hw.map' (⊤ : Submodule K (𝓜 → K)).subtype (Submodule.ker_subtype _)
  let B : Basis (Pivots W) K (spanMap f W) :=
    (Basis.span hv).map (LinearEquiv.ofEq _ _ (span_range_comp_rref f W))
  have hBv (μ : Pivots W) : (B μ : 𝓜 → K) = v μ := by
    simp [B, Basis.span_apply]
  have hB : Matrix.IsReducedRowEchelon (fun μ ↦ (B μ : 𝓜 → K)) := by
    have hM : (fun μ ↦ (B μ : 𝓜 → K)) = Matrix.map (rref W) f :=
      funext fun μ ↦ by rw [hBv]; rfl
    rw [hM]
    exact (rref_isReducedRowEchelon W).map f.injective f.map_zero f.map_one
  obtain ⟨e, he, hBe⟩ := eq_rref_of_basis_isReducedRowEchelon (spanMap f W) B hB
  exact ⟨e, he, fun μ ↦ (hBe μ).symm.trans (hBv μ)⟩

name: GroupConfig.fod_spanMap
statement: theorem fod_spanMap : fod (spanMap f W) = (fod W).map f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, -, he⟩ := exists_rref_spanMap f W
  have hset : fodSet (spanMap f W) = f '' fodSet W := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨μ', ν⟩, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨μ, rfl⟩ := e.surjective μ'
      refine ⟨rref W μ ν, ⟨(μ, ν), rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      change f (rref W μ ν) = rref (spanMap f W) (e μ) ν
      rw [he μ]
      rfl
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨⟨μ, ν⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨(e μ, ν), ?_⟩
      change rref (spanMap f W) (e μ) ν = f (rref W μ ν)
      rw [he μ]
      rfl
  unfold fod
  rw [hset]
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · refine Subfield.closure_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x, Subfield.subset_closure hx, rfl⟩
  · rw [Subfield.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    refine Subfield.closure_le.2 fun x hx ↦ ?_
    change f x ∈ Subfield.closure (f '' fodSet W)
    exact Subfield.subset_closure ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.degSubspace_map_algebraMap
statement:
theorem degSubspace_map_algebraMap (J : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι L)) (d : ℕ) :
    degSubspace (J.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap L K))) d =
      spanMap (algebraMap L K) (degSubspace J d)
proof:
:= by
  set φ : MvPolynomial ι L →+* MvPolynomial ι K := MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap L K)
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap L K) := (algebraMap L K).injective
  have hdeg (q : MvPolynomial ι L) : (φ q).totalDegree = q.totalDegree := by
    unfold totalDegree
    rw [support_map_of_injective _ hinj]
  have hvec (q : MvPolynomial ι L) :
      coeffVec d (φ q) = ⇑(algebraMap L K) ∘ coeffVec d q := by
    funext m
    simp [φ, coeffVec_apply, coeff_map]
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_)
  · 
    let F : Subfield K := (algebraMap L K).fieldRange
    have hdef : IdealDefinedOver F (J.map φ) := by
      refine idealDefinedOver_of_le_span F (Ideal.span_le.2 ?_)
      rintro _ ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
      exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨Ideal.mem_map_of_mem φ hq, fun m ↦ by
        rw [coeff_map]
        exact ⟨q.coeff m, rfl⟩⟩
    calc degSubspace (J.map φ) d
        = Submodule.span K {w | w ∈ degSubspace (J.map φ) d ∧ ∀ ν, w ν ∈ F} :=
          degSubspace_definedOver F hdef d
      _ ≤ spanMap (algebraMap L K) (degSubspace J d) := by
          refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
          rintro _ ⟨hw, hwF⟩
          obtain ⟨g, hgI, hgd, rfl⟩ := mem_degSubspace_iff.1 hw
          
          have hcoeff : (g.coeffs : Set K) ⊆ (algebraMap L K).range := by
            intro c hc
            obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := mem_coeffs_iff.1 hc
            have hmd : m.sum (fun _ e ↦ e) ≤ d :=
              (le_totalDegree hm).trans hgd
            exact hwF ⟨m, hmd⟩
          obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := mem_range_map_iff_coeffs_subset.2 hcoeff
          have hqJ : q ∈ J := by
            rw [← AclGeom.comap_map_mvPolynomial_eq_self (E := K) J]
            exact hgI
          refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨coeffVec d q, coeffVec_mem_degSubspace hqJ ?_, ?_⟩
          · rw [← hdeg q]
            exact hgd
          · exact (hvec q).symm
  · rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hqJ, hqd, rfl⟩ := mem_degSubspace_iff.1 hw
    have h := coeffVec_mem_degSubspace (I := J.map φ) (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem φ hqJ)
      ((hdeg q).le.trans hqd)
    rw [hvec q] at h
    exact h

name: GroupConfig.idealFod_map_algebraMap
statement:
theorem idealFod_map_algebraMap [Finite ι] (J : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι L)) :
    idealFod (J.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap L K))) =
      (idealFod J).map (algebraMap L K)
proof:
:= by
  unfold idealFod
  rw [Subfield.map_iSup]
  exact iSup_congr fun d ↦ by rw [degSubspace_map_algebraMap, fod_spanMap]

name: GroupConfig.map_iterateFrobenius_map
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subfield.map_map, iterateFrobenius_add]

name: GroupConfig.map_iterateFrobenius_zero
statement:
private theorem map_iterateFrobenius_zero (S : Subfield K) :
    S.map (iterateFrobenius K p 0) = S
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [Subfield.mem_map]

name: GroupConfig.map_iterateFrobenius_le
statement:
private theorem map_iterateFrobenius_le (E : Subfield K) (n : ℕ) :
    E.map (iterateFrobenius K p n) ≤ E
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  rw [iterateFrobenius_def]
  exact pow_mem hx _

name: GroupConfig.map_iterateFrobenius_injective
statement:
private theorem map_iterateFrobenius_injective (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective fun S : Subfield K ↦ S.map (iterateFrobenius K p n)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ {S T : Subfield K}, S.map (iterateFrobenius K p n) =
      T.map (iterateFrobenius K p n) → S ≤ T := by
    intro S T h x hx
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hwx⟩ : iterateFrobenius K p n x ∈ T.map (iterateFrobenius K p n) :=
      h ▸ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rwa [iterateFrobenius_inj K p n hwx] at hw
  exact fun S T h ↦ le_antisymm (key h) (key h.symm)

name: GroupConfig.subset_closure_singleton
statement:
private theorem subset_closure_singleton {C : Set K} {x : K} :
    x ∈ Subfield.closure (C ∪ {x})
proof:
:=
  Subfield.subset_closure (mem_union_right _ (mem_singleton x))

name: GroupConfig.map_closure_union
statement:
private theorem map_closure_union {C : Set K} (hC : ∀ c ∈ C, ∃ w ∈ C, w ^ p = c) (n : ℕ)
    (S : Set K) :
    (Subfield.closure (C ∪ S)).map (iterateFrobenius K p n) =
      Subfield.closure (C ∪ iterateFrobenius K p n '' S)
proof:
:= by
  have hCn : ∀ c ∈ C, ∃ w ∈ C, iterateFrobenius K p n w = c := by
    induction n with
    | zero => exact fun c hc ↦ ⟨c, hc, iterateFrobenius_zero_apply K p c⟩
    | succ n ih =>
      intro c hc
      obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := ih c hc
      obtain ⟨w', hw', rfl⟩ := hC w hw
      exact ⟨w', hw', by rw [iterateFrobenius_add_apply, iterateFrobenius_one_apply]⟩
  rw [RingHom.map_field_closure, image_union]
  refine le_antisymm (Subfield.closure_le.2 (union_subset ?_ ?_))
    (Subfield.closure_le.2 (union_subset ?_ ?_))
  · rintro _ ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
    rw [iterateFrobenius_def]
    exact pow_mem (Subfield.subset_closure (mem_union_left _ hc)) _
  · exact fun x hx ↦ Subfield.subset_closure (mem_union_right _ hx)
  · intro c hc
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hCn c hc
    exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩)
  · exact fun x hx ↦ Subfield.subset_closure (mem_union_right _ hx)

name: GroupConfig.map_closure_image
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm : (iterateFrobenius K p j).comp σ = σ.comp (iterateFrobenius K p j) :=
    RingHom.ext fun t ↦ by simp [iterateFrobenius_def]
  rw [← RingHom.map_field_closure, Subfield.map_map, Subfield.map_map, hcomm]

name: GroupConfig.map_closure_le
statement:
private theorem map_closure_le {C : Set K} {ν ν' : Type*} (w : ν → K) (w' : ν' → K) (j : ℕ)
    (hw : ∀ i, w i ^ p ^ j ∈ Subfield.closure (C ∪ range w')) :
    (Subfield.closure (C ∪ range w)).map (iterateFrobenius K p j) ≤
      Subfield.closure (C ∪ range w')
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subfield.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  refine Subfield.closure_le.2 (union_subset (fun c hc ↦ ?_) ?_)
  · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Subfield.mem_comap, iterateFrobenius_def]
    exact pow_mem (Subfield.subset_closure (mem_union_left _ hc)) _
  · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Subfield.mem_comap, iterateFrobenius_def]
    exact hw i

name: GroupConfig.notMem_closure_pow_of_transcendental
statement:
theorem notMem_closure_pow_of_transcendental (hp : p.Prime) {k : Type*} [Field k] [Algebra k K]
    {N : IntermediateField k K} {x : K} (hx : Transcendental N x) :
    x ∉ Subfield.closure ((N : Set K) ∪ {x ^ p})
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hmem' : x ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin N {x ^ p} := by
    rw [← IntermediateField.mem_toSubfield, IntermediateField.adjoin_toSubfield]
    refine Subfield.closure_mono (union_subset_union_left _ ?_) hmem
    intro c hc
    exact ⟨⟨c, hc⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨r, s, hrs⟩ := (IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_iff _ _).1 hmem'
  by_cases hs : aeval (x ^ p) s = 0
  · rw [hs, div_zero] at hrs
    exact hx (hrs ▸ isAlgebraic_zero)
  have h0 : aeval x (X * expand N p s - expand N p r) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, map_mul, aeval_X, expand_aeval, expand_aeval, (eq_div_iff hs).1 hrs, sub_self]
  have h1 := sub_eq_zero.1 (transcendental_iff.1 hx _ h0)
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp at hs
  have hndvd : ¬p ∣ s.natDegree * p + 1 := fun hdvd ↦
    hp.one_lt.ne' (Nat.dvd_one.1 ((Nat.dvd_add_right (dvd_mul_left p _)).1 hdvd))
  have hcoeff : (X * expand N p s).coeff (s.natDegree * p + 1) =
      (expand N p r).coeff (s.natDegree * p + 1) := by rw [h1]
  rw [coeff_X_mul, coeff_expand_mul hp.pos, coeff_expand hp.pos] at hcoeff
  simp only [hndvd, ↓reduceIte] at hcoeff
  exact leadingCoeff_ne_zero.2 hs0 hcoeff

name: GroupConfig.relfinrank_closure_pow_eq
proof:
:= by
  set A' := Subfield.closure (C ∪ {x ^ p})
  have hA'A : A' ≤ Subfield.closure (C ∪ {x}) :=
    Subfield.closure_le.2 (union_subset (fun c hc ↦ Subfield.subset_closure (mem_union_left _ hc))
      (singleton_subset_iff.2 (pow_mem subset_closure_singleton p)))
  have hxA' : x ^ p ∈ A' := subset_closure_singleton
  rw [Subfield.relfinrank_eq_finrank_of_le hA'A]
  have hE : Subfield.extendScalars hA'A = IntermediateField.adjoin A' {x} := by
    apply IntermediateField.toSubfield_injective
    rw [Subfield.extendScalars_toSubfield, IntermediateField.adjoin_toSubfield]
    refine le_antisymm (Subfield.closure_le.2 (union_subset ?_ ?_))
      (Subfield.closure_le.2 (union_subset ?_ ?_))
    · exact fun c hc ↦ Subfield.subset_closure
        (mem_union_left _ ⟨⟨c, Subfield.subset_closure (mem_union_left _ hc)⟩, rfl⟩)
    · exact fun _ hy ↦ Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr hy)
    · rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
      exact hA'A c.2
    · exact singleton_subset_iff.2 subset_closure_singleton
  have hirr : Irreducible (X ^ p - Polynomial.C (⟨x ^ p, hxA'⟩ : A')) := by
    refine X_pow_sub_C_irreducible_of_prime hp fun b hb ↦ hxp ?_
    have hb' : (b : K) ^ p = x ^ p := congrArg Subtype.val hb
    rw [← frobenius_def, ← frobenius_def] at hb'
    have hbx : (b : K) = x := frobenius_inj K p hb'
    exact hbx ▸ b.2
  have haeval : aeval x (X ^ p - Polynomial.C (⟨x ^ p, hxA'⟩ : A')) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, map_pow, aeval_X, aeval_C]
    exact sub_self (x ^ p)
  have hint : IsIntegral A' x :=
    ⟨X ^ p - Polynomial.C (⟨x ^ p, hxA'⟩ : A'), monic_X_pow_sub_C _ hp.ne_zero, by
      rw [← aeval_def, haeval]⟩
  rw [hE, IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank hint,
