    ← minpoly.eq_of_irreducible_of_monic hirr haeval (monic_X_pow_sub_C _ hp.ne_zero),
    natDegree_X_pow_sub_C]

name: GroupConfig.relfinrank_map_frobenius_eq
statement:
theorem relfinrank_map_frobenius_eq (hp : p.Prime) {C : Set K}
    (hC : ∀ c ∈ C, ∃ w ∈ C, w ^ p = c) {F : Subfield K} {x : K} (hCF : C ⊆ F) (hxF : x ∈ F)
    (hxp : x ∉ Subfield.closure (C ∪ {x ^ p}))
    (hfin : Subfield.relfinrank (Subfield.closure (C ∪ {x})) F ≠ 0) :
    Subfield.relfinrank (F.map (frobenius K p)) F = p
proof:
:= by
  set A := Subfield.closure (C ∪ {x})
  set A' := Subfield.closure (C ∪ {x ^ p})
  have hAmap : A.map (frobenius K p) = A' := by
    have h := map_closure_union p hC 1 {x}
    rwa [iterateFrobenius_one, image_singleton, frobenius_def] at h
  have hA'A : A' ≤ A :=
    Subfield.closure_le.2 (union_subset (fun c hc ↦ Subfield.subset_closure (mem_union_left _ hc))
      (singleton_subset_iff.2 (pow_mem subset_closure_singleton p)))
  have hAF : A ≤ F := Subfield.closure_le.2 (union_subset hCF (singleton_subset_iff.2 hxF))
  have hFF : F.map (frobenius K p) ≤ F := by
    simpa using map_iterateFrobenius_le p F 1
  have hA'F : A' ≤ F.map (frobenius K p) := hAmap ▸ (Subfield.gc_map_comap _).monotone_l hAF
  have h1 := Subfield.relfinrank_mul_relfinrank hA'A hAF
  have h2 := Subfield.relfinrank_mul_relfinrank hA'F hFF
  have h3 : Subfield.relfinrank A' (F.map (frobenius K p)) = Subfield.relfinrank A F := by
    rw [← hAmap]
    exact Subfield.relfinrank_map_map A F _
  rw [relfinrank_closure_pow_eq p hp hxp, ← h2, h3] at h1
  exact (Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hfin) ((mul_comm _ _).trans h1)).symm

name: GroupConfig.exists_eq_map_iterateFrobenius
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing F with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨0, le_rfl, ?_⟩
    rw [map_iterateFrobenius_zero] at h₁ ⊢
    exact le_antisymm h₂ h₁
  | succ n ih =>
    have hsucc : ∀ (S : Subfield K) (j : ℕ), (S.map (frobenius K p)).map
        (iterateFrobenius K p j) = S.map (iterateFrobenius K p (j + 1)) := fun S j ↦ by
      rw [← iterateFrobenius_one, map_iterateFrobenius_map]
    by_cases hE : E ≤ F.map (frobenius K p)
    · have hF' : Subfield.relfinrank ((F.map (frobenius K p)).map (frobenius K p))
          (F.map (frobenius K p)) = p := by
        rw [Subfield.relfinrank_map_map]
        exact hF
      obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := ih hF' (by rwa [hsucc]) hE
      exact ⟨j + 1, by omega, hsucc F j⟩
    · have hFF : F.map (frobenius K p) ≤ F := by
        simpa using map_iterateFrobenius_le p F 1
      have hsup : F ≤ E ⊔ F.map (frobenius K p) := by
        have htower := Subfield.relfinrank_mul_relfinrank (le_sup_right (a := E))
          (sup_le h₂ hFF)
        rw [hF] at htower
        rcases (Nat.dvd_prime hp).1 (Dvd.intro _ htower) with h | h
        · exact absurd (le_sup_left.trans (Subfield.relfinrank_eq_one_iff.1 h)) hE
        · rw [h] at htower
          exact Subfield.relfinrank_eq_one_iff.1
            (Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hp.pos (htower.trans (mul_one p).symm))
      have hall : ∀ m, F ≤ E ⊔ F.map (iterateFrobenius K p m) := by
        intro m
        induction m with
        | zero =>
          rw [map_iterateFrobenius_zero]
          exact le_sup_right
        | succ m ihm =>
          refine hsup.trans (sup_le le_sup_left ?_)
          calc F.map (frobenius K p)
              ≤ (E ⊔ F.map (iterateFrobenius K p m)).map (frobenius K p) :=
                (Subfield.gc_map_comap _).monotone_l ihm
            _ = E.map (frobenius K p) ⊔ (F.map (iterateFrobenius K p m)).map (frobenius K p) :=
                Subfield.map_sup _ _ _
            _ ≤ E ⊔ F.map (iterateFrobenius K p (m + 1)) := by
              refine sup_le_sup (by simpa using map_iterateFrobenius_le p E 1) (le_of_eq ?_)
              rw [← iterateFrobenius_one, map_iterateFrobenius_map, add_comm]
      refine ⟨0, Nat.zero_le _, ?_⟩
      rw [map_iterateFrobenius_zero]
      exact le_antisymm h₂ ((hall (n + 1)).trans (sup_le le_rfl h₁))

name: GroupConfig.eq_of_map_iterateFrobenius_eq
proof:
:= by
  wlog hab : a ≤ b generalizing a b
  · exact (this h.symm (le_of_not_ge hab)).symm
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hab
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos d with rfl | hd
  · rfl
  exfalso
  have hFd : F = F.map (iterateFrobenius K p d) := by
    apply map_iterateFrobenius_injective p a
    simp only
    rw [h, map_iterateFrobenius_map]
  obtain ⟨d', rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt hd
  rw [zero_add] at hFd
  have hle : F ≤ F.map (frobenius K p) := by
    calc F = F.map (iterateFrobenius K p (d' + 1)) := hFd
      _ = (F.map (iterateFrobenius K p d')).map (frobenius K p) := by
        rw [← iterateFrobenius_one, map_iterateFrobenius_map, add_comm]
      _ ≤ F.map (frobenius K p) :=
        (Subfield.gc_map_comap _).monotone_l (map_iterateFrobenius_le p F _)
  have h1 := Subfield.relfinrank_eq_one_iff.2 hle
  rw [hF] at h1
  exact hp.one_lt.ne' h1

name: GroupConfig.IsFrobIndex.mono
statement:
theorem IsFrobIndex.mono {C' : Set K} (hCC' : C ⊆ C') (hC' : ∀ c ∈ C', ∃ w ∈ C', w ^ p = c)
    (h : IsFrobIndex p C y z δ) : IsFrobIndex p C' y z δ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, n, hδ, h⟩ := h
  refine ⟨m, n, hδ, ?_⟩
  have key : ∀ (S : Set K) (j : ℕ), (Subfield.closure (C' ∪ S)).map (iterateFrobenius K p j) =
      Subfield.closure C' ⊔ (Subfield.closure (C ∪ S)).map (iterateFrobenius K p j) := by
    intro S j
    have hsplit : Subfield.closure (C' ∪ S) = Subfield.closure C' ⊔ Subfield.closure (C ∪ S) :=
      le_antisymm (Subfield.closure_le.2 (union_subset
          (fun c hc ↦ le_sup_left (a := Subfield.closure C') (Subfield.subset_closure hc))
          (fun s hs ↦ le_sup_right (b := Subfield.closure (C ∪ S))
            (Subfield.subset_closure (mem_union_right _ hs)))))
        (sup_le (Subfield.closure_mono subset_union_left)
          (Subfield.closure_mono (union_subset_union_left _ hCC')))
    have hC'j : (Subfield.closure C').map (iterateFrobenius K p j) = Subfield.closure C' := by
      simpa using map_closure_union p hC' j ∅
    rw [hsplit, Subfield.map_sup, hC'j]
  rw [key, key, h]

name: GroupConfig.IsFrobIndex.trans
statement:
theorem IsFrobIndex.trans (h₁ : IsFrobIndex p C y z δ) (h₂ : IsFrobIndex p C z x δ') :
    IsFrobIndex p C y x (δ + δ')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, n, rfl, h₁⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨m', n', rfl, h₂⟩ := h₂
  refine ⟨m + m', n' + n, by push_cast; ring, ?_⟩
  calc (Subfield.closure (C ∪ range x)).map (iterateFrobenius K p (m + m'))
      = ((Subfield.closure (C ∪ range x)).map (iterateFrobenius K p m')).map
          (iterateFrobenius K p m) := (map_iterateFrobenius_map p _ _ _).symm
    _ = ((Subfield.closure (C ∪ range z)).map (iterateFrobenius K p n')).map
          (iterateFrobenius K p m) := by rw [h₂]
    _ = ((Subfield.closure (C ∪ range z)).map (iterateFrobenius K p m)).map
          (iterateFrobenius K p n') := by rw [map_iterateFrobenius_map, map_iterateFrobenius_map,
            add_comm]
    _ = ((Subfield.closure (C ∪ range y)).map (iterateFrobenius K p n)).map
          (iterateFrobenius K p n') := by rw [h₁]
    _ = (Subfield.closure (C ∪ range y)).map (iterateFrobenius K p (n' + n)) :=
      map_iterateFrobenius_map p _ _ _

name: GroupConfig.IsFrobIndex.map
statement:
theorem IsFrobIndex.map (σ : K →+* K) (h : IsFrobIndex p C y z δ) :
    IsFrobIndex p (σ '' C) (σ ∘ y) (σ ∘ z) δ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, n, hδ, h⟩ := h
  refine ⟨m, n, hδ, ?_⟩
  have hz : σ '' C ∪ range (σ ∘ z) = σ '' (C ∪ range z) := by rw [range_comp, image_union]
  have hy : σ '' C ∪ range (σ ∘ y) = σ '' (C ∪ range y) := by rw [range_comp, image_union]
  rw [hz, hy, map_closure_image, map_closure_image, h]

name: GroupConfig.IsFrobIndex.unique
statement:
theorem IsFrobIndex.unique (hp : p.Prime)
    (hF : Subfield.relfinrank ((Subfield.closure (C ∪ range y)).map (frobenius K p))
      (Subfield.closure (C ∪ range y)) = p)
    (h : IsFrobIndex p C y z δ) (h' : IsFrobIndex p C y z δ') : δ = δ'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, n, rfl, h⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨m', n', rfl, h'⟩ := h'
  have heq : (Subfield.closure (C ∪ range y)).map (iterateFrobenius K p (m' + n)) =
      (Subfield.closure (C ∪ range y)).map (iterateFrobenius K p (m + n')) :=
    calc (Subfield.closure (C ∪ range y)).map (iterateFrobenius K p (m' + n))
        = ((Subfield.closure (C ∪ range y)).map (iterateFrobenius K p n)).map
            (iterateFrobenius K p m') := (map_iterateFrobenius_map p _ _ _).symm
      _ = ((Subfield.closure (C ∪ range z)).map (iterateFrobenius K p m)).map
            (iterateFrobenius K p m') := by rw [h]
      _ = ((Subfield.closure (C ∪ range z)).map (iterateFrobenius K p m')).map
            (iterateFrobenius K p m) := by rw [map_iterateFrobenius_map,
              map_iterateFrobenius_map, add_comm]
      _ = ((Subfield.closure (C ∪ range y)).map (iterateFrobenius K p n')).map
            (iterateFrobenius K p m) := by rw [h']
      _ = (Subfield.closure (C ∪ range y)).map (iterateFrobenius K p (m + n')) :=
        map_iterateFrobenius_map p _ _ _
  have := eq_of_map_iterateFrobenius_eq p hp hF heq
  omega

name: GroupConfig.IsFrobIndex.exists
statement:
theorem IsFrobIndex.exists (hp : p.Prime)
    (hF : Subfield.relfinrank ((Subfield.closure (C ∪ range y)).map (frobenius K p))
      (Subfield.closure (C ∪ range y)) = p) {m n : ℕ}
    (hz : ∀ j, z j ^ p ^ m ∈ Subfield.closure (C ∪ range y))
    (hy : ∀ i, y i ^ p ^ n ∈ Subfield.closure (C ∪ range z)) :
    ∃ δ, IsFrobIndex p C y z δ
proof:
:= by
  have hYE : (Subfield.closure (C ∪ range y)).map (iterateFrobenius K p (m + n)) ≤
      (Subfield.closure (C ∪ range z)).map (iterateFrobenius K p m) := by
    rw [← map_iterateFrobenius_map]
    exact (Subfield.gc_map_comap _).monotone_l (map_closure_le p y z n hy)
  obtain ⟨j, -, hj⟩ := exists_eq_map_iterateFrobenius p hp hF hYE (map_closure_le p z y m hz)
  exact ⟨(j : ℤ) - m, m, j, rfl, hj⟩

name: GroupConfig.IsFrobIndex.closure_eq_of_zero
statement:
theorem IsFrobIndex.closure_eq_of_zero (h : IsFrobIndex p C y z 0) :
    Subfield.closure (C ∪ range z) = Subfield.closure (C ∪ range y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, n, hmn, h⟩ := h
  obtain rfl : n = m := by omega
  exact map_iterateFrobenius_injective p n h

name: GroupConfig.image_eq_self_of_forall_fixed
statement:
theorem image_eq_self_of_forall_fixed {S : Set K} (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (h : ∀ s ∈ S, σ s = s) :
    ⇑σ '' S = S
proof:
:= by
  ext w
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    rw [h s hs]
    exact hs
  · intro hw
    exact ⟨w, hw, h w hw⟩

name: GroupConfig.apply_mem_racl_of_forall_fixed
statement:
theorem apply_mem_racl_of_forall_fixed (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) {S : Set K} (hS : ∀ s ∈ S, σ s = s)
    {w : K} (hw : w ∈ racl k S) : σ w ∈ racl k S
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : σ w ∈ ⇑σ '' (racl k S : Set K) := mem_image_of_mem σ hw
  rwa [← AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, ← coe_map, racl_map, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom,
    image_eq_self_of_forall_fixed σ hS] at h1

name: GroupConfig.isIntegral_of_mem_racl_coe

proof:

  exact hw.isIntegral

name: GroupConfig.racl_union_eq_of_subset_racl
statement:
theorem racl_union_eq_of_subset_racl {A B : Set K} (h : A ⊆ racl k B) :
    racl k (A ∪ B) = racl k B
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset h (subset_racl k B)))
    (racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_right)

statement:

proof:
:= by
  rw [union_comm]
  exact racl_union_eq_of_subset_racl h

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.indepOver_lines_z
statement:
theorem indepOver_lines_z [Finite ι₂] [Finite ι₃] :
    IndepOver k (range z) (range b ∪ range y) (range c ∪ range x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hc.indep 1 5 2 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
  have h1 : IndepOver k ∅ (range b) (range z ∪ range c) :=
    h.indepOver_union (finite_range b) (finite_range z) (finite_range c)
  have h2 : IndepOver k (∅ ∪ range z) (range b) (range c) :=
    (indepOver_union_right_iff.1 h1).2
  rw [empty_union] at h2
  have e1 : racl k (range z ∪ (range b ∪ range y)) = racl k (range z ∪ range b) := by
    rw [← union_assoc]
    exact racl_union_eq_of_subset_racl' hc.range_y_subset_racl_zb
  have e2 : racl k (range z ∪ (range c ∪ range x)) = racl k (range z ∪ range c) := by
    rw [← union_assoc]
    exact racl_union_eq_of_subset_racl' hc.range_x_subset_racl_zc
  have h3 : IndepOver k (range z) (range b ∪ range y) (range c) :=
    (indepOver_congr_left e1).1 h2
  exact ((indepOver_congr_left e2).1 h3.symm).symm

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.isIntegral_z
statement:
theorem isIntegral_z (i : ι₆) :
    IsIntegral (↥(adjoin k (range b ∪ range y ∪ range c ∪ range x))) (z i)
proof:
:= by
  refine isIntegral_of_mem_racl_coe (racl_mono (k := k) ?_ (hc.range_z_subset_racl_by
    (mem_range_self i)))
  exact (subset_union_left.trans subset_union_left).trans (subset_adjoin k _)

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration.conj_z_mem_racl
statement:
theorem conj_z_mem_racl [Finite ι₂] [Finite ι₃]
    (σ : K ≃ₐ[↥(adjoin k (range b ∪ range y ∪ range c ∪ range x))] K)
    (i : ι₆) : σ (z i) ∈ racl k (range z)
proof:
:= by
  have hfix : ∀ s ∈ range b ∪ range y ∪ range c ∪ range x, (σ.restrictScalars k) s = s :=
    fun s hs ↦ by
      change σ s = s
      exact σ.commutes ⟨s, subset_adjoin k _ hs⟩
  have h1 : σ (z i) ∈ racl k (range b ∪ range y) :=
    apply_mem_racl_of_forall_fixed (σ.restrictScalars k)
      (fun s hs ↦ hfix s ((subset_union_left.trans subset_union_left) hs))
      (hc.range_z_subset_racl_by (mem_range_self i))
  have h2 : σ (z i) ∈ racl k (range c ∪ range x) :=
    apply_mem_racl_of_forall_fixed (σ.restrictScalars k)
      (fun s hs ↦ hfix s ((union_subset (subset_union_right.trans subset_union_left)
        subset_union_right) hs))
      (hc.range_z_subset_racl_cx (mem_range_self i))
  have hmeet := hc.indepOver_lines_z.racl_inter_eq
  rw [racl_union_eq_of_subset_racl hc.range_z_subset_racl_by,
    racl_union_eq_of_subset_racl hc.range_z_subset_racl_cx] at hmeet
  rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, ← hmeet]
  exact ⟨h1, h2⟩

statement:
theorem IndepTriple.of_indepOver {A B C : Set K} (hAB : IndepOver k ∅ A B)

proof:
:= by
  unfold IndepTriple

    IndepTriple k A C P

name: GroupConfig.IndepTriple.of_racl_union_eq'

    IndepTriple k A B P
proof:

    ← union_right_comm]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.codeSet_inv_subset
statement:
theorem codeSet_inv_subset {h : Germ k a' a} {g : Germ k a a'} (hi : IsInverse h g) :
    (h.codeSet : Set K) ⊆ racl k (g.codeSet : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [racl_codeSet]
  exact (codeSet_subset_racl_cb h).trans (racl_le_of_subset_racl hi.cb_le)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.cb_eq_canonicalBase_eval
statement:
theorem cb_eq_canonicalBase_eval (g : Germ k a a') {F : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed ↥F]
    (hF : IsSmall k (F : Set K)) (hcb : g.cb ≤ F) {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGenericOver F a y) :
    g.cb = canonicalBase F (Sum.elim y (g.eval F y))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl, hrM⟩ := g.exists_rep_M_eq hF hcb
  have hyM : IsGenericOver r.M a y := hrM ▸ hy
  rw [cb_mk_eq_canonicalBase r hyM, eval_eq_rep r hF hcb hrM.ge hyM]
  exact congrArg (fun L : IntermediateField k K ↦ canonicalBase L (r.graphPoint y)) hrM

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsInverse.cb_eq
statement:
theorem IsInverse.cb_eq {h : Germ k a' a} {g : Germ k a a'} (hi : IsInverse h g) :
    h.cb = g.cb
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M : IntermediateField k K, M = racl k ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ h.cb) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥M := hM ▸ isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hMs : IsSmall k (M : Set K) := hM ▸ (g.isSmall_cb.union h.isSmall_cb).racl
  have hg : g.cb ≤ M := by
    rw [hM]
    exact fun x hx ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl hx)
  have hh : h.cb ≤ M := by
    rw [hM]
    exact fun x hx ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hx)
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hMs a
  have hz : IsGenericOver M a' (g.eval M y) := g.isGenericOver_eval hMs hg hy
  have hhz : h.eval M (g.eval M y) = y := by
    rw [← comp_eval h g hMs hg hh hy, hi.1, eval_id hMs hy]
  rw [cb_eq_canonicalBase_eval h hMs hh hz, hhz, cb_eq_canonicalBase_eval g hMs hg hy,
    canonicalBase_sum_elim_swap]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsInverse.graphIdeal_eq
statement:
theorem IsInverse.graphIdeal_eq {h : Germ k a' a} {g : Germ k a a'} (hi : IsInverse h g) :
    h.graphIdeal = g.graphIdeal.map
      (MvPolynomial.rename (Equiv.sumComm ι κ) :
        MvPolynomial (ι ⊕ κ) K →ₐ[K] MvPolynomial (κ ⊕ ι) K).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M : IntermediateField k K, M = racl k ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ h.cb) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥M := hM ▸ isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hMs : IsSmall k (M : Set K) := hM ▸ (g.isSmall_cb.union h.isSmall_cb).racl
  have hg : g.cb ≤ M := by
    rw [hM]
    exact fun x hx ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl hx)
  have hh : h.cb ≤ M := by
    rw [hM]
    exact fun x hx ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hx)
  obtain ⟨r, rfl, hrM⟩ := g.exists_rep_M_eq hMs hg
  obtain ⟨r', rfl, hr'M⟩ := h.exists_rep_M_eq hMs hh
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hMs a
  have hyM : IsGenericOver r.M a y := hrM ▸ hy
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : ∃ z, z = r.f.eval y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hzr : IsGenericOver r.M a' z := hz ▸ r.isGenericOver y hyM
  have hzM : IsGenericOver r'.M a' z := by
    rw [hr'M, ← hrM]
    exact hzr
  have hinv : r'.f.eval z = y := by
    rw [← eval_eq_rep r' hMs hh hr'M.ge hzM, hz, ← eval_eq_rep r hMs hg hrM.ge hyM,
      ← comp_eval _ _ hMs hg hh hy, hi.1, eval_id hMs hy]
  have e₁ : Germ.graphIdeal (⟦r⟧ : Germ k a a') = locusIdeal (↥M) (Sum.elim y z) := by
    rw [graphIdeal_mk, r.graphIdeal_eq hyM]
    unfold Representative.graphPoint
    rw [← hz]
    exact locusIdeal_congr _ (by rw [range_algebraMap_coe, range_algebraMap_coe, hrM]) _
  have e₂ : Germ.graphIdeal (⟦r'⟧ : Germ k a' a) = locusIdeal (↥M) (Sum.elim z y) := by
    rw [graphIdeal_mk, r'.graphIdeal_eq hzM]
    unfold Representative.graphPoint
    rw [hinv]
    exact locusIdeal_congr _ (by rw [range_algebraMap_coe, range_algebraMap_coe, hr'M]) _
  have hswap : Sum.elim z y = Sum.elim y z ∘ Equiv.sumComm κ ι := by
    funext s
    cases s <;> rfl
  rw [e₂, e₁, hswap, locusIdeal_comp_equiv, Equiv.sumComm_symm]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.groupConfiguration
statement:
theorem groupConfiguration {g₀ : Germ k a a} (hw : IsHW g₀) {g h : Germ k a a}
    (hg : g ∈ orbit g₀) (hh : h ∈ orbit g₀) {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k a y)
    (hind : IndepTriple k (g.cb : Set K) (h.cb : Set K) (range y))
    (hm : 1 ≤ erk k ∅ (range a)) {g' : Germ k a a} (hg' : IsInverse g' g) :
    GroupConfiguration k g.codeTuple h.codeTuple (h * g').codeTuple (g.evalGen y) y
        (h.evalGen y) ∧
      (h * g').evalGen (g.evalGen y) = h.evalGen y ∧ h * g' * g = h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h', hh'⟩ := isUnit_iff.1 (hw.isUnit_of_mem hh)
  
  have hc' : IsInverse (g * h') (h * g') := by
    constructor
    · change g * h' * (h * g') = 1
      rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc h', show h' * h = 1 from hh'.1, one_mul,
        show g * g' = 1 from hg'.2]
    · change h * g' * (g * h') = 1
      rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc g', show g' * g = 1 from hg'.1, one_mul,
        show h * h' = 1 from hh'.2]
  have hcg : h * g' * g = h := by rw [mul_assoc, show g' * g = 1 from hg'.1, mul_one]
  have hgh'h : g * h' * h = g := by rw [mul_assoc, show h' * h = 1 from hh'.1, mul_one]
  
  have hAfin : (g.codeSet : Set K).Finite := g.codeSet.finite_toSet
  have hBfin : (h.codeSet : Set K).Finite := h.codeSet.finite_toSet
  have hCfin : ((h * g').codeSet : Set K).Finite := (h * g').codeSet.finite_toSet
  have hYfin : (range y).Finite := finite_range y
  have hXfin : (range (g.evalGen y)).Finite := finite_range _
  have hZfin : (range (h.evalGen y)).Finite := finite_range _
  
  have hind' : IndepTriple k (g.codeSet : Set K) (h.codeSet : Set K) (range y) :=
    indepTriple_of_racl_eq (racl_codeSet g).symm (racl_codeSet h).symm rfl hind
  have hAB : IndepOver k ∅ (g.codeSet : Set K) (h.codeSet : Set K) :=
    hind'.indepOver_left hAfin hBfin hYfin
  have hYA : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (g.codeSet : Set K) :=
    (hind'.perm_right.indepOver_left hAfin hYfin hBfin).symm
  have hYB : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (h.codeSet : Set K) :=
    (hind'.perm_left.perm_right.indepOver_left hBfin hYfin hAfin).symm
  have hA_BY : IndepOver k ∅ (g.codeSet : Set K) ((h.codeSet : Set K) ∪ range y) :=
    hind'.indepOver_union hAfin hBfin hYfin
  have hB_AY : IndepOver k ∅ (h.codeSet : Set K) ((g.codeSet : Set K) ∪ range y) :=
    hind'.perm_left.indepOver_union hBfin hAfin hYfin
  have hY_AB : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) ((g.codeSet : Set K) ∪ h.codeSet) :=
    hind'.rotate.rotate.indepOver_union hYfin hAfin hBfin
  have hY_BA : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) ((h.codeSet : Set K) ∪ g.codeSet) := by
    rw [union_comm]
    exact hY_AB
  have hYAcb : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (g.cb : Set K) := (indepOver_codeSet_iff g ∅ _).1 hYA
  have hYBcb : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (h.cb : Set K) := (indepOver_codeSet_iff h ∅ _).1 hYB
  
  have hBAcb : IndepOver k ∅ (h.cb : Set K) (g.cb : Set K) :=
    (indepOver_codeSet_iff g ∅ _).1 ((indepOver_cb_iff h ∅ _).2 hAB.symm)
  have hhg' : IndepOver k ∅ (h.cb : Set K) (g'.cb : Set K) :=
    (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hBAcb).mono_right (by
      rw [empty_union]
      exact hg'.cb_le)
  have hcmem : h * g' ∈ orbit g₀ := hw.comp h hh g' (hw.inv g hg g' hg') hhg'
  have hrkA : erk k ∅ (g.codeSet : Set K) = erk k ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K) := by
    rw [erk_codeSet_eq, erk_cb_eq_of_mem_orbit hg]
  have hrkB : erk k ∅ (h.codeSet : Set K) = erk k ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K) := by
    rw [erk_codeSet_eq, erk_cb_eq_of_mem_orbit hh]
  have hrkC : erk k ∅ ((h * g').codeSet : Set K) = erk k ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K) := by
    rw [erk_codeSet_eq, erk_cb_eq_of_mem_orbit hcmem]
  
  have hx : IsGen k a (g.evalGen y) := g.isGen_evalGen hy hYAcb
  have hz : IsGen k a (h.evalGen y) := h.isGen_evalGen hy hYBcb
  have hrkY : erk k ∅ (range y) = erk k ∅ (range a) := erk_empty_range_eq_of_idealOf_eq hy
  have hrkX : erk k ∅ (range (g.evalGen y)) = erk k ∅ (range a) :=
    erk_empty_range_eq_of_idealOf_eq hx
  have hrkZ : erk k ∅ (range (h.evalGen y)) = erk k ∅ (range a) :=
    erk_empty_range_eq_of_idealOf_eq hz
  
  have hXAcb : IndepOver k ∅ (range (g.evalGen y)) (g.cb : Set K) := g.indepOver_evalGen hy hYAcb
  have hZBcb : IndepOver k ∅ (range (h.evalGen y)) (h.cb : Set K) := h.indepOver_evalGen hy hYBcb
  have hXA : IndepOver k ∅ (range (g.evalGen y)) (g.codeSet : Set K) :=
    (indepOver_codeSet_iff g ∅ _).2 hXAcb
  have hZB : IndepOver k ∅ (range (h.evalGen y)) (h.codeSet : Set K) :=
    (indepOver_codeSet_iff h ∅ _).2 hZBcb
  have hXg' : IndepOver k ∅ (range (g.evalGen y)) (g'.cb : Set K) :=
    (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hXAcb).mono_right (by
      rw [empty_union]
      exact hg'.cb_le)
  have hZh' : IndepOver k ∅ (range (h.evalGen y)) (h'.cb : Set K) :=
    (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hZBcb).mono_right (by
      rw [empty_union]
      exact hh'.cb_le)
  have hX_AY : range (g.evalGen y) ⊆ racl k ((g.codeSet : Set K) ∪ range y) := by
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    rw [racl_union_congr (racl_codeSet g) rfl]
    exact g.evalGen_mem_racl hy hYAcb j
  have hZ_BY : range (h.evalGen y) ⊆ racl k ((h.codeSet : Set K) ∪ range y) := by
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    rw [racl_union_congr (racl_codeSet h) rfl]
    exact h.evalGen_mem_racl hy hYBcb j
  have hY_AX : range y ⊆ racl k ((g.codeSet : Set K) ∪ range (g.evalGen y)) := by
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    have hmem := g'.evalGen_mem_racl hx hXg' j
    rw [congrFun (hg'.evalGen_evalGen hy hYAcb) j] at hmem
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset ?_ (subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)))
      hmem
    exact hg'.cb_le.trans (racl_le_of_subset_racl ((cb_subset_racl_codeSet g).trans
      (racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_left)))
  have hY_BZ : range y ⊆ racl k ((h.codeSet : Set K) ∪ range (h.evalGen y)) := by
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    have hmem := h'.evalGen_mem_racl hz hZh' j
    rw [congrFun (hh'.evalGen_evalGen hy hYBcb) j] at hmem
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset ?_ (subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)))
      hmem
    exact hh'.cb_le.trans (racl_le_of_subset_racl ((cb_subset_racl_codeSet h).trans
      (racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_left)))
  
  have hAX : racl k ((g.codeSet : Set K) ∪ range (g.evalGen y)) =
      racl k ((g.codeSet : Set K) ∪ range y) :=
    le_antisymm
      (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset (subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)) hX_AY))
      (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset (subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)) hY_AX))
  have hBY : racl k ((h.codeSet : Set K) ∪ range y) =
      racl k ((h.codeSet : Set K) ∪ range (h.evalGen y)) :=
    le_antisymm
      (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset (subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)) hY_BZ))
      (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset (subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)) hZ_BY))
  
  have hAXB : IndepOver k (g.codeSet : Set K) (range (g.evalGen y)) (h.codeSet : Set K) := by
    have h1 : IndepOver k (∅ ∪ (g.codeSet : Set K)) (range y) (h.codeSet : Set K) :=
      (indepOver_union_right_iff.1 hY_AB).2
    rw [empty_union] at h1
    exact (indepOver_congr_left hAX).1 h1
  have hX_AB : IndepOver k ∅ (range (g.evalGen y)) ((g.codeSet : Set K) ∪ h.codeSet) :=
    indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨hXA, by
      rw [empty_union]
      exact hAXB⟩
  have hBZA : IndepOver k (h.codeSet : Set K) (range (h.evalGen y)) (g.codeSet : Set K) := by
    have h1 : IndepOver k (∅ ∪ (h.codeSet : Set K)) (range y) (g.codeSet : Set K) :=
      (indepOver_union_right_iff.1 hY_BA).2
    rw [empty_union] at h1
    exact (indepOver_congr_left hBY.symm).1 h1
  have hZ_BA : IndepOver k ∅ (range (h.evalGen y)) ((h.codeSet : Set K) ∪ g.codeSet) :=
    indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨hZB, by
      rw [empty_union]
      exact hBZA⟩
  have hZ_AB : IndepOver k ∅ (range (h.evalGen y)) ((g.codeSet : Set K) ∪ h.codeSet) := by
    rw [union_comm]
    exact hZ_BA
  
  have hC_AB : ((h * g').codeSet : Set K) ⊆ racl k ((g.codeSet : Set K) ∪ h.codeSet) := by
    refine (codeSet_mul_subset h g').trans (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset ?_ ?_))
    · exact subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
    · exact (codeSet_inv_subset hg').trans (racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_left)
  have hB_AC : (h.codeSet : Set K) ⊆ racl k ((g.codeSet : Set K) ∪ (h * g').codeSet) := by
    have e1 : ((h * g' * g).codeSet : Set K) = (h.codeSet : Set K) :=
      congrArg (fun u : Germ k a a ↦ (u.codeSet : Set K)) hcg
    exact (e1.symm.subset.trans (codeSet_mul_subset (h * g') g)).trans
      (racl_mono (k := k) (union_comm _ _).le)
  have hA_BC : (g.codeSet : Set K) ⊆ racl k ((h.codeSet : Set K) ∪ (h * g').codeSet) := by
    have e1 : ((g * h' * h).codeSet : Set K) = (g.codeSet : Set K) :=
      congrArg (fun u : Germ k a a ↦ (u.codeSet : Set K)) hgh'h
    refine (e1.symm.subset.trans (codeSet_mul_subset (g * h') h)).trans
      (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset ?_ (subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _))))
    exact (codeSet_inv_subset hc').trans (racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_right)
  have hAB_AC : racl k ((g.codeSet : Set K) ∪ h.codeSet) =
      racl k ((g.codeSet : Set K) ∪ (h * g').codeSet) :=
    le_antisymm
      (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset (subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)) hB_AC))
      (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset (subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)) hC_AB))
  have hAB_BC : racl k ((g.codeSet : Set K) ∪ h.codeSet) =
      racl k ((h.codeSet : Set K) ∪ (h * g').codeSet) :=
    le_antisymm
      (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset hA_BC (subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _))))
      (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset (subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)) hC_AB))
  
  have hXC : IndepOver k ∅ (range (g.evalGen y)) ((h * g').codeSet : Set K) :=
    (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hX_AB).mono_right (by
      rw [empty_union]
      exact hC_AB)
  have hZC : IndepOver k ∅ (range (h.evalGen y)) ((h * g').codeSet : Set K) :=
    (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hZ_AB).mono_right (by
      rw [empty_union]
      exact hC_AB)
  have hXCcb : IndepOver k ∅ (range (g.evalGen y)) ((h * g').cb : Set K) :=
    (indepOver_codeSet_iff _ ∅ _).1 hXC
  have hZCcb : IndepOver k ∅ (range (h.evalGen y)) ((h * g').cb : Set K) :=
    (indepOver_codeSet_iff _ ∅ _).1 hZC
  have hXBg' : IndepOver k ∅ (range (g.evalGen y)) ((h.cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb) := by
    refine (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hX_AB).mono_right ?_
    rw [empty_union]
    exact union_subset ((cb_subset_racl_codeSet h).trans (racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_right))
      (hg'.cb_le.trans (racl_le_of_subset_racl ((cb_subset_racl_codeSet g).trans
        (racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_left))))
  have hcx : (h * g').evalGen (g.evalGen y) = h.evalGen y := by
    rw [evalGen_mul h g' hx hXBg', hg'.evalGen_evalGen hy hYAcb]
  have hZc' : IndepOver k ∅ (range (h.evalGen y)) ((g * h').cb : Set K) :=
    (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hZCcb).mono_right (by
      rw [empty_union]
      exact hc'.cb_le)
  have hZ_CX : range (h.evalGen y) ⊆
      racl k (((h * g').codeSet : Set K) ∪ range (g.evalGen y)) := by
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    have hmem := (h * g').evalGen_mem_racl hx hXCcb j
    rw [congrFun hcx j, ← racl_union_congr (racl_codeSet (h * g')) rfl] at hmem
    exact hmem
  have hX_CZ : range (g.evalGen y) ⊆
      racl k (((h * g').codeSet : Set K) ∪ range (h.evalGen y)) := by
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    have e := hc'.evalGen_evalGen hx hXCcb
    rw [hcx] at e
    have hmem := (g * h').evalGen_mem_racl hz hZc' j
    rw [congrFun e j] at hmem
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset ?_ (subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)))
      hmem
    exact hc'.cb_le.trans (racl_le_of_subset_racl ((cb_subset_racl_codeSet _).trans
      (racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_left)))
  have hCX_CZ : racl k (((h * g').codeSet : Set K) ∪ range (g.evalGen y)) =
      racl k (((h * g').codeSet : Set K) ∪ range (h.evalGen y)) :=
    le_antisymm
      (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset (subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)) hX_CZ))
      (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset (subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)) hZ_CX))
  
  have hrkC_B : erk k ∅ ((h * g').codeSet : Set K) = erk k ∅ (h.codeSet : Set K) :=
    hrkC.trans hrkB.symm
  have hrkC_A : erk k ∅ ((h * g').codeSet : Set K) = erk k ∅ (g.codeSet : Set K) :=
    hrkC.trans hrkA.symm
  have hrkX_Y : erk k ∅ (range (g.evalGen y)) = erk k ∅ (range y) := hrkX.trans hrkY.symm
  have hrkZ_Y : erk k ∅ (range (h.evalGen y)) = erk k ∅ (range y) := hrkZ.trans hrkY.symm
  have hXY : IndepOver k ∅ (range (g.evalGen y)) (range y) := hw.trans g hg y hy hYAcb
  have hZY : IndepOver k ∅ (range (h.evalGen y)) (range y) := hw.trans h hh y hy hYBcb
  have t_aby : IndepTriple k (g.codeSet : Set K) (h.codeSet : Set K) (range y) := hind'
  have t_abx : IndepTriple k (g.codeSet : Set K) (h.codeSet : Set K) (range (g.evalGen y)) :=
    IndepTriple.of_indepOver hAB hX_AB hBfin hXfin
  have t_abz : IndepTriple k (g.codeSet : Set K) (h.codeSet : Set K) (range (h.evalGen y)) :=
    IndepTriple.of_indepOver hAB hZ_AB hBfin hZfin
  have hBC_BA : racl k ((h.codeSet : Set K) ∪ (h * g').codeSet) =
      racl k ((h.codeSet : Set K) ∪ g.codeSet) := by
    rw [← hAB_BC, union_comm]
  have t_acx := t_abx.of_racl_union_eq hAB_AC.symm hrkC_B
  have t_acy := t_aby.of_racl_union_eq hAB_AC.symm hrkC_B
  have t_acz := t_abz.of_racl_union_eq hAB_AC.symm hrkC_B
  have t_bcx := t_abx.perm_left.of_racl_union_eq hBC_BA hrkC_A
  have t_bcy := t_aby.perm_left.of_racl_union_eq hBC_BA hrkC_A
  have t_bcz := t_abz.perm_left.of_racl_union_eq hBC_BA hrkC_A
  have hA_YZ : IndepOver k ∅ (g.codeSet : Set K) (range y ∪ range (h.evalGen y)) :=
    (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hA_BY).mono_right (by
      rw [empty_union]
      exact union_subset (subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)) hZ_BY)
  have hB_XY : IndepOver k ∅ (h.codeSet : Set K) (range (g.evalGen y) ∪ range y) :=
    (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hB_AY).mono_right (by
      rw [empty_union]
      exact union_subset hX_AY (subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)))
  have t_ayz : IndepTriple k (g.codeSet : Set K) (range y) (range (h.evalGen y)) :=
    (IndepTriple.of_indepOver hZY.symm hA_YZ hZfin hAfin).rotate.rotate
  have t_axz := t_ayz.of_racl_union_eq hAX hrkX_Y
  have t_bxy : IndepTriple k (h.codeSet : Set K) (range (g.evalGen y)) (range y) :=
    (IndepTriple.of_indepOver hXY hB_XY hYfin hBfin).rotate.rotate
  have t_bxz := t_bxy.of_racl_union_eq' hBY.symm hrkZ_Y
  
  have hXYA_B : erk k (range (g.evalGen y) ∪ range y ∪ (g.codeSet : Set K))
      (h.codeSet : Set K) = erk k ∅ (h.codeSet : Set K) := by
    rw [union_assoc, union_comm (range (g.evalGen y)),
      erk_base_union_of_subset_racl k (hX_AY.trans (racl_mono (k := k) (union_comm _ _).le))]
    have := hB_AY.erk_eq (subset_refl _) hBfin
    rwa [empty_union, union_comm] at this
  have hC_XY : IndepOver k ∅ ((h * g').codeSet : Set K) (range (g.evalGen y) ∪ range y) := by
    refine indepOver_of_erk_eq hCfin (le_antisymm ?_ ?_)
    · rw [empty_union]
      exact erk_base_mono k (empty_subset _) _
    · rw [empty_union]
      calc erk k ∅ ((h * g').codeSet : Set K) = erk k ∅ (h.codeSet : Set K) := hrkC_B
        _ = erk k (range (g.evalGen y) ∪ range y ∪ (g.codeSet : Set K)) (h.codeSet : Set K) :=
          hXYA_B.symm
        _ = erk k (range (g.evalGen y) ∪ range y ∪ (g.codeSet : Set K))
              ((h * g').codeSet : Set K) := by
          refine (erk_eq_of_subset_racl ?_ ?_).symm
          · exact hC_AB.trans (racl_mono (k := k) (union_subset
              (subset_union_right.trans subset_union_left) subset_union_right))
          · exact hB_AC.trans (racl_mono (k := k) (union_subset
              (subset_union_right.trans subset_union_left) subset_union_right))
        _ ≤ erk k (range (g.evalGen y) ∪ range y) ((h * g').codeSet : Set K) :=
          erk_base_mono k subset_union_left _
  have t_cxy : IndepTriple k ((h * g').codeSet : Set K) (range (g.evalGen y)) (range y) :=
    (IndepTriple.of_indepOver hXY hC_XY hYfin hCfin).rotate.rotate
  
  have hYZB_A : erk k (range y ∪ range (h.evalGen y) ∪ (h.codeSet : Set K))
      (g.codeSet : Set K) = erk k ∅ (g.codeSet : Set K) := by
    rw [union_right_comm,
      erk_base_union_of_subset_racl k (hZ_BY.trans (racl_mono (k := k) (union_comm _ _).le))]
    have := hA_BY.erk_eq (subset_refl _) hAfin
    rwa [empty_union, union_comm] at this
  have hC_YZ : IndepOver k ∅ ((h * g').codeSet : Set K) (range y ∪ range (h.evalGen y)) := by
    refine indepOver_of_erk_eq hCfin (le_antisymm ?_ ?_)
    · rw [empty_union]
      exact erk_base_mono k (empty_subset _) _
    · rw [empty_union]
      calc erk k ∅ ((h * g').codeSet : Set K) = erk k ∅ (g.codeSet : Set K) := hrkC_A
        _ = erk k (range y ∪ range (h.evalGen y) ∪ (h.codeSet : Set K)) (g.codeSet : Set K) :=
          hYZB_A.symm
        _ = erk k (range y ∪ range (h.evalGen y) ∪ (h.codeSet : Set K))
              ((h * g').codeSet : Set K) := by
          refine (erk_eq_of_subset_racl ?_ ?_).symm
          · exact hC_AB.trans (racl_mono (k := k) (union_subset subset_union_right
              (subset_union_right.trans subset_union_left)))
          · exact hA_BC.trans (racl_mono (k := k) (union_subset
              (subset_union_right.trans subset_union_left) subset_union_right))
        _ ≤ erk k (range y ∪ range (h.evalGen y)) ((h * g').codeSet : Set K) :=
          erk_base_mono k subset_union_left _
  have t_cyz : IndepTriple k ((h * g').codeSet : Set K) (range y) (range (h.evalGen y)) :=
    (IndepTriple.of_indepOver hZY.symm hC_YZ hZfin hCfin).rotate.rotate
  
  have hZ_YA : IndepOver k ∅ (range (h.evalGen y)) (range y ∪ (g.codeSet : Set K)) := by
    have h1 : IndepOver k (∅ ∪ range y) (g.codeSet : Set K) (range (h.evalGen y)) :=
      (indepOver_union_right_iff.1 hA_YZ).2
    exact indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨hZY, h1.symm⟩
  have hZ_XY : IndepOver k ∅ (range (h.evalGen y)) (range (g.evalGen y) ∪ range y) := by
    refine indepOver_of_erk_eq hZfin (le_antisymm ?_ ?_)
    · rw [empty_union]
      exact erk_base_mono k (empty_subset _) _
    · rw [empty_union]
      calc erk k ∅ (range (h.evalGen y))
          = erk k (∅ ∪ (range y ∪ (g.codeSet : Set K))) (range (h.evalGen y)) :=
            (hZ_YA.erk_eq (subset_refl _) hZfin).symm
        _ = erk k (range (g.evalGen y) ∪ range y ∪ (g.codeSet : Set K)) (range (h.evalGen y)) := by
            rw [empty_union, union_assoc, union_comm (range (g.evalGen y)),
              erk_base_union_of_subset_racl k
                (hX_AY.trans (racl_mono (k := k) (union_comm _ _).le))]
        _ ≤ erk k (range (g.evalGen y) ∪ range y) (range (h.evalGen y)) :=
            erk_base_mono k subset_union_left _
  have t_xyz : IndepTriple k (range (g.evalGen y)) (range y) (range (h.evalGen y)) :=
    IndepTriple.of_indepOver hXY hZ_XY hYfin hZfin
  
  have hA' : racl k (range g.codeTuple) = racl k (g.codeSet : Set K) := by rw [range_codeTuple]
  have hB' : racl k (range h.codeTuple) = racl k (h.codeSet : Set K) := by rw [range_codeTuple]
  have hC' : racl k (range (h * g').codeTuple) = racl k ((h * g').codeSet : Set K) := by
    rw [range_codeTuple]
  
  have ht_a : IsTriple k a a g.codeTuple y (g.evalGen y) :=
    { isGen_left := hy
      isGen_right := hx
      indep_left := by
        rw [range_codeTuple]
        exact hYA
      indep_right := by
        rw [range_codeTuple]
        exact hXA
      mem_dcl := fun j ↦ by
        rw [range_codeTuple, adjoin_codeSet]
        exact g.evalGen_mem_dclAdjoin hy hYAcb j }
  have ht_b : IsTriple k a a h.codeTuple y (h.evalGen y) :=
    { isGen_left := hy
      isGen_right := hz
      indep_left := by
        rw [range_codeTuple]
        exact hYB
      indep_right := by
        rw [range_codeTuple]
        exact hZB
      mem_dcl := fun j ↦ by
        rw [range_codeTuple, adjoin_codeSet]
        exact h.evalGen_mem_dclAdjoin hy hYBcb j }
  have ht_c : IsTriple k a a (h * g').codeTuple (g.evalGen y) (h.evalGen y) :=
    { isGen_left := hx
      isGen_right := hz
      indep_left := by
        rw [range_codeTuple]
        exact hXC
      indep_right := by
        rw [range_codeTuple]
        exact hZC
      mem_dcl := fun j ↦ by
        rw [range_codeTuple, adjoin_codeSet]
        have := (h * g').evalGen_mem_dclAdjoin hx hXCcb j
        rw [congrFun hcx j] at this
        exact this }
  have hga : g = ht_a.germ := ht_a.eq_germ (by
    rw [racl_codeTuple]
    exact subset_racl k _) rfl
  have hhb : h = ht_b.germ := ht_b.eq_germ (by
    rw [racl_codeTuple]
    exact subset_racl k _) rfl
  have hcc : h * g' = ht_c.germ := ht_c.eq_germ (by
    rw [racl_codeTuple]
    exact subset_racl k _) hcx
  have hcb_a := ht_a.germ_cb
  rw [← hga] at hcb_a
  have hcb_b := ht_b.germ_cb
  rw [← hhb] at hcb_b
  have hcb_c := ht_c.germ_cb
  rw [← hcc] at hcb_c
  
  have hn : 1 ≤ erk k ∅ (g.codeSet : Set K) := by
    refine Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 fun h0 ↦ ?_
    have hA0 : (g.codeSet : Set K) ⊆ (racl k (∅ : Set K) : Set K) := (erk_eq_zero_iff k).1 h0
    have hXY' : range (g.evalGen y) ⊆ racl k (range y) :=
      hX_AY.trans (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset
        (hA0.trans (racl_mono (k := k) (empty_subset _))) (subset_racl k _)))
    have e := hXY.erk_eq (subset_refl _) hXfin
    rw [empty_union, erk_eq_zero_of_subset_racl k hXY', hrkX] at e
    rw [← e] at hm
    exact absurd hm (by decide)
  refine ⟨?_, hcx, hcg⟩
  exact
    { racl_ab_ac := by rw [racl_union_congr hA' hB', racl_union_congr hA' hC', hAB_AC]
      racl_ab_bc := by rw [racl_union_congr hA' hB', racl_union_congr hB' hC', hAB_BC]
      racl_ax_ay := by rw [racl_union_congr hA' rfl, racl_union_congr hA' rfl, hAX]
      racl_by_bz := by rw [racl_union_congr hB' rfl, racl_union_congr hB' rfl, hBY]
      racl_cx_cz := by rw [racl_union_congr hC' rfl, racl_union_congr hC' rfl, hCX_CZ]
      indep := indep_of_sixteen
        (indepTriple_of_racl_eq hA'.symm hB'.symm rfl t_abx)
        (indepTriple_of_racl_eq hA'.symm hB'.symm rfl t_aby)
        (indepTriple_of_racl_eq hA'.symm hB'.symm rfl t_abz)
        (indepTriple_of_racl_eq hA'.symm hC'.symm rfl t_acx)
        (indepTriple_of_racl_eq hA'.symm hC'.symm rfl t_acy)
        (indepTriple_of_racl_eq hA'.symm hC'.symm rfl t_acz)
        (indepTriple_of_racl_eq hA'.symm rfl rfl t_axz)
        (indepTriple_of_racl_eq hA'.symm rfl rfl t_ayz)
        (indepTriple_of_racl_eq hB'.symm hC'.symm rfl t_bcx)
        (indepTriple_of_racl_eq hB'.symm hC'.symm rfl t_bcy)
        (indepTriple_of_racl_eq hB'.symm hC'.symm rfl t_bcz)
        (indepTriple_of_racl_eq hB'.symm rfl rfl t_bxy)
        (indepTriple_of_racl_eq hB'.symm rfl rfl t_bxz)
        (indepTriple_of_racl_eq hC'.symm rfl rfl t_cxy)
        (indepTriple_of_racl_eq hC'.symm rfl rfl t_cyz)
        t_xyz
      cb_a := by
        rw [canonicalBase_sum_elim_swap, ← hcb_a, ← racl_codeTuple]
        exact subset_racl k _
      cb_b := by
        rw [← hcb_b, ← racl_codeTuple]
        exact subset_racl k _
      cb_c := by
        rw [← hcb_c, ← racl_codeTuple]
        exact subset_racl k _
      one_le_erk := by
        rw [GroupConfig.erk_eq_of_racl_eq hA']
        exact hn }

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.groupConfiguration_code
statement:
theorem groupConfiguration_code {g₀ : Germ k a a} (hw : IsHW g₀) {g h : Germ k a a}
    (hg : g ∈ orbit g₀) (hh : h ∈ orbit g₀) {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k a y)
    (hind : IndepTriple k (g.cb : Set K) (h.cb : Set K) (range y))
    (hm : 1 ≤ erk k ∅ (range a)) :
    ∃ c : Germ k a a,
      GroupConfiguration k g.code h.code c.code (g.evalGen y) y (h.evalGen y) ∧
      erk k ∅ (range g.code) = erk k ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K) ∧
      erk k ∅ (range y) = erk k ∅ (range a) ∧
      c.evalGen (g.evalGen y) = h.evalGen y ∧ c * g = h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g', hg'⟩ := isUnit_iff.1 (hw.isUnit_of_mem hg)
  obtain ⟨hc, heval, hcomp⟩ := hw.groupConfiguration hg hh hy hind hm hg'
  have he (f : Germ k a a) : racl k (range f.code) = racl k (range f.codeTuple) := by
    rw [← racl_adjoin_coe (range f.code), adjoin_range_code, racl_codeTuple]
  have hrank : erk k ∅ (range g.code) = erk k ∅ (g.cb : Set K) :=
    GroupConfig.erk_eq_of_racl_eq (by
      rw [← racl_adjoin_coe (range g.code), adjoin_range_code])
  exact ⟨h * g', hc.ofRaclEq (he g) (he h) (he (h * g')) rfl rfl rfl,
    hrank.trans (erk_cb_eq_of_mem_orbit hg), erk_empty_range_eq_of_idealOf_eq hy,
    heval, hcomp⟩

name: GroupConfig.expChar_intermediateField
statement:
theorem expChar_intermediateField (L : IntermediateField k K) :
    ExpChar (↥L) (ringExpChar K)
proof:
:=
  RingHom.expChar (algebraMap (↥L) K) (algebraMap (↥L) K).injective _

name: GroupConfig.mem_dcl_iff
statement:
theorem mem_dcl_iff {L : IntermediateField k K} {x : K} :
    x ∈ dcl L ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, x ^ ringExpChar K ^ n ∈ L
proof:
:= by
  have := expChar_intermediateField L
  rw [dcl, mem_restrictScalars, mem_perfectClosure_iff_pow_mem (ringExpChar K)]
  simp only [RingHom.mem_range]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    rw [← hc]
    exact c.2
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    exact ⟨n, ⟨_, hn⟩, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.le_dcl
statement: theorem le_dcl (L : IntermediateField k K) : L ≤ dcl L
proof:
:= fun _ hx ↦
  mem_dcl_iff.2 ⟨0, by rwa [pow_zero, pow_one]⟩

name: GroupConfig.dcl_mono
statement: theorem dcl_mono {L L' : IntermediateField k K} (h : L ≤ L') : dcl L ≤ dcl L'
proof:
:= fun _ hx ↦ by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := mem_dcl_iff.1 hx
  exact mem_dcl_iff.2 ⟨n, h hn⟩

name: GroupConfig.dcl_dcl
statement: theorem dcl_dcl (L : IntermediateField k K) : dcl (dcl L) = dcl L
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) (le_dcl _)
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := mem_dcl_iff.1 hx
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := mem_dcl_iff.1 hn
  refine mem_dcl_iff.2 ⟨n + m, ?_⟩
  rwa [pow_add, pow_mul]

name: GroupConfig.isIntegral_of_mem_dcl
statement:
theorem isIntegral_of_mem_dcl {L : IntermediateField k K} {x : K} (hx : x ∈ dcl L) :
    IsIntegral (↥L) x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := mem_dcl_iff.1 hx
  refine IsIntegral.of_pow (expChar_pow_pos K (ringExpChar K) n) ?_
  exact isIntegral_algebraMap (x := (⟨_, hn⟩ : ↥L))

name: GroupConfig.dcl_le_racl
statement: theorem dcl_le_racl (L : IntermediateField k K) : dcl L ≤ racl k (L : Set K)
proof:
:= fun _ hx ↦ by
  rw [mem_racl_iff k, adjoin_self]
  exact (isIntegral_of_mem_dcl hx).isAlgebraic

name: GroupConfig.dcl_map
statement:
theorem dcl_map (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (L : IntermediateField k K) :
    (dcl L).map σ.toAlgHom = dcl (L.map σ.toAlgHom)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := mem_dcl_iff.1 hy
    exact mem_dcl_iff.2 ⟨n, ⟨_, hn, map_pow σ _ _⟩⟩
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨n, y, hy, heq⟩ := mem_dcl_iff.1 hx
    refine ⟨σ.symm x, mem_dcl_iff.2 ⟨n, ?_⟩, σ.apply_symm_apply x⟩
    have hpow : (σ.symm x) ^ ringExpChar K ^ n = y := by
      apply σ.injective
      rw [map_pow, σ.apply_symm_apply]
      exact heq.symm
    rwa [hpow]

name: GroupConfig.racl_dcl
statement:
theorem racl_dcl (L : IntermediateField k K) :
    racl k (dcl L : Set K) = racl k (L : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  exact le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl (dcl_le_racl L))
    (racl_mono (le_dcl L))

name: GroupConfig.racl_eq_of_dcl_eq
statement:
theorem racl_eq_of_dcl_eq {L L' : IntermediateField k K} (h : dcl L = dcl L') :
    racl k (L : Set K) = racl k (L' : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← racl_dcl L, h, racl_dcl L']

name: GroupConfig.dcl_adjoin_image
statement:
theorem dcl_adjoin_image (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (A : Set K) :
    (dcl (adjoin k A)).map σ.toAlgHom = dcl (adjoin k (σ '' A))
proof:
:= by
  rw [dcl_map, adjoin_map, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom]

name: GroupConfig.racl_eq_of_dcl_adjoin_eq
statement:
theorem racl_eq_of_dcl_adjoin_eq {A B : Set K}
    (h : dcl (adjoin k A) = dcl (adjoin k B)) : racl k A = racl k B
proof:
:= by
  have hA : racl k ((adjoin k A) : Set K) = racl k A :=
    le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl (adjoin_le_racl k A))
      (racl_mono (subset_adjoin k A))
  have hB : racl k ((adjoin k B) : Set K) = racl k B :=
    le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl (adjoin_le_racl k B))
      (racl_mono (subset_adjoin k B))
  simpa only [hA, hB] using racl_eq_of_dcl_eq h

name: GroupConfig.apply_eq_self_of_mem_dcl
statement:
theorem apply_eq_self_of_mem_dcl {L : IntermediateField k K} {x : K} (hx : x ∈ dcl L)
    (σ : K ≃ₐ[↥L] K) : σ x = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := mem_dcl_iff.1 hx
  apply iterateFrobenius_inj K (ringExpChar K) n
  rw [iterateFrobenius_def, iterateFrobenius_def, ← map_pow]
  exact σ.commutes ⟨_, hn⟩

name: GroupConfig.apply_eq_self_of_mem_dcl_of_fixes
statement:
theorem apply_eq_self_of_mem_dcl_of_fixes {L : IntermediateField k K} (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K)
    (hσ : ∀ x ∈ L, σ x = x) {x : K} (hx : x ∈ dcl L) : σ x = x
proof:
:=
  apply_eq_self_of_mem_dcl hx (AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := σ.toRingEquiv) fun c ↦ hσ c c.2)

name: GroupConfig.aeval_const_unit
statement:
theorem aeval_const_unit {L : Type*} [Field L] [Algebra L K] (x : K) (f : MvPolynomial Unit L) :
    aeval (fun _ : Unit ↦ x) f =
      Polynomial.aeval x (aeval (fun _ : Unit ↦ (Polynomial.X : Polynomial L)) f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply]
  simp only [Polynomial.aeval_X]

name: GroupConfig.idealOf_const_unit_eq_of_minpoly_eq
proof:
:= by
  refine idealOf_eq_of_aeval_iff (↥L) fun f ↦ ?_
  rw [aeval_const_unit, aeval_const_unit]
  constructor
  · intro h0
    have := minpoly.dvd (↥L) x h0
    rw [h] at this
    exact Polynomial.aeval_eq_zero_of_dvd_aeval_eq_zero this (minpoly.aeval (↥L) x')
  · intro h0
    have := minpoly.dvd (↥L) x' h0
    rw [← h] at this
    exact Polynomial.aeval_eq_zero_of_dvd_aeval_eq_zero this (minpoly.aeval (↥L) x)

name: GroupConfig.mem_dcl_iff_forall_fixed
statement:
theorem mem_dcl_iff_forall_fixed [IsAlgClosed K] {L : IntermediateField k K} {x : K} :
    x ∈ dcl L ↔ ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[↥L] K, σ x = x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hx σ ↦ apply_eq_self_of_mem_dcl hx σ, fun h ↦ by_contra fun hx ↦ ?_⟩
  suffices hex : ∃ x' : K,
      idealOf (↥L) (fun _ : Unit ↦ x) = idealOf (↥L) (fun _ : Unit ↦ x') ∧ x' ≠ x by
    obtain ⟨x', hx', hne⟩ := hex
    obtain ⟨σ, -, hσ⟩ := exists_ambientAutomorphism_of_idealOf_eq (k := ↥L) hx'
    exact hne ((hσ ()).symm.trans (h σ))
  by_cases halg : IsIntegral (↥L) x
  · classical
    have hsep : (minpoly (↥L) x).natSepDegree ≠ 1 := fun h1 ↦ hx (by
      rw [dcl, mem_restrictScalars, mem_perfectClosure_iff_natSepDegree_eq_one]
      exact h1)
    rw [Polynomial.natSepDegree_eq_of_isAlgClosed K] at hsep
    have hxmem : x ∈ ((minpoly (↥L) x).aroots K).toFinset := by
      rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, Polynomial.mem_aroots]
      exact ⟨minpoly.ne_zero halg, minpoly.aeval _ _⟩
    obtain ⟨x', hx'mem, hne⟩ : ∃ x' ∈ ((minpoly (↥L) x).aroots K).toFinset, x' ≠ x := by
      by_contra hall
      refine hsep (Finset.card_eq_one.2 ⟨x, Finset.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.2 ⟨hxmem, ?_⟩⟩)
      exact fun x' hx' ↦ by_contra fun hne ↦ hall ⟨x', hx', hne⟩
    have hroot : Polynomial.aeval x' (minpoly (↥L) x) = 0 :=
      (Polynomial.mem_aroots.1 (Multiset.mem_toFinset.1 hx'mem)).2
    refine ⟨x', idealOf_const_unit_eq_of_minpoly_eq ?_, hne⟩
    exact minpoly.eq_of_irreducible_of_monic (minpoly.irreducible halg) hroot (minpoly.monic halg)
  · refine ⟨x + 1, ?_, by simp⟩
    have htr : Transcendental (↥L) x := fun h ↦ halg (isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral.1 h)
    have htr' : Transcendental (↥L) (x + 1) := fun h ↦
      halg (by simpa using (isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral.1 h).sub isIntegral_one)
    rw [(idealOf_eq_bot_iff (↥L)).2 (algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff.2 htr),
      (idealOf_eq_bot_iff (↥L)).2 (algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff.2 htr')]

name: GroupConfig.mem_dclAdjoin_iff
statement:
theorem mem_dclAdjoin_iff {L : IntermediateField k K} {u : ι → K} {x : K} :
    x ∈ dclAdjoin L u ↔ ∃ (n : ℕ) (P Q : MvPolynomial ι (↥L)),
      aeval u Q ≠ 0 ∧ x ^ ringExpChar K ^ n = aeval u P / aeval u Q
proof:
:= by
  rw [dclAdjoin, mem_dcl_iff]
  simp only [mem_restrictScalars]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    obtain ⟨r, hr, s, hs, hx⟩ := mem_adjoin_iff_div.1 hn
    rw [Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_aeval, AlgHom.mem_range] at hr hs
    obtain ⟨P, rfl⟩ := hr
    obtain ⟨Q, rfl⟩ := hs
    by_cases hQ : aeval u Q = 0
    · refine ⟨n, 0, 1, by simp, ?_⟩
      rw [hx, hQ, div_zero, map_zero, zero_div]
    · exact ⟨n, P, Q, hQ, hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨n, P, Q, -, hx⟩
    refine ⟨n, mem_adjoin_iff_div.2 ⟨aeval u P, ?_, aeval u Q, ?_, hx⟩⟩
    · rw [Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_aeval, AlgHom.mem_range]
      exact ⟨P, rfl⟩
    · rw [Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_aeval, AlgHom.mem_range]
      exact ⟨Q, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.dclAdjoin_mono
statement:
theorem dclAdjoin_mono {L L' : IntermediateField k K} (h : L ≤ L') (u : ι → K) :
    dclAdjoin L u ≤ dclAdjoin L' u
proof:
:= fun _ hx ↦ by
  obtain ⟨n, P, Q, hQ, hx⟩ := mem_dclAdjoin_iff.1 hx
  refine mem_dclAdjoin_iff.2 ⟨n, MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion h).toRingHom P,
    MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion h).toRingHom Q, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rwa [aeval_map_inclusion]
  · rwa [aeval_map_inclusion, aeval_map_inclusion]

name: GroupConfig.le_dclAdjoin
statement: theorem le_dclAdjoin (L : IntermediateField k K) (u : ι → K) : L ≤ dclAdjoin L u
proof:
:=
  fun x hx ↦
    le_dcl _ ((mem_restrictScalars k).2 (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ (⟨x, hx⟩ : ↥L)))

name: GroupConfig.range_subset_dclAdjoin
statement:
theorem range_subset_dclAdjoin (L : IntermediateField k K) (u : ι → K) :
    range u ⊆ dclAdjoin L u
proof:
:=
  fun _ hx ↦ le_dcl _ ((mem_restrictScalars k).2 (subset_adjoin (↥L) _ hx))

name: GroupConfig.dclAdjoin_le_racl
statement:
theorem dclAdjoin_le_racl (L : IntermediateField k K) (u : ι → K) :
    dclAdjoin L u ≤ racl k ((L : Set K) ∪ range u)
proof:
:= by
  refine (dcl_le_racl _).trans ?_
  rw [restrictScalars_adjoin]
  exact racl_le_of_subset_racl (adjoin_le_racl k _)

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.eval_mem_dclAdjoin
statement:
theorem QuasiRational.eval_mem_dclAdjoin (f : QuasiRational (↥L) ι κ) {u : ι → K}
    (hf : f.IsDefinedAt u) (j : κ) : f.eval u j ∈ dclAdjoin L u
proof:
:=
  mem_dclAdjoin_iff.2 ⟨f.e, f.num j, f.den j, hf j, by rw [QuasiRational.eval_apply, pRoot_pow]⟩

name: GroupConfig.exists_quasiRational_of_mem_dclAdjoin
proof:
:= by
  choose n P Q hQ hw' using fun j ↦ mem_dclAdjoin_iff.1 (hw j)
  let _ := Fintype.ofFinite κ
  have hle : ∀ j, n j ≤ Finset.univ.sup n := fun j ↦ Finset.le_sup (f := n) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  refine ⟨⟨Finset.univ.sup n, fun j ↦ P j ^ ringExpChar K ^ (Finset.univ.sup n - n j),
    fun j ↦ Q j ^ ringExpChar K ^ (Finset.univ.sup n - n j)⟩, fun j ↦ ?_, funext fun j ↦ ?_⟩
  · change aeval u (Q j ^ ringExpChar K ^ (Finset.univ.sup n - n j)) ≠ 0
    rw [map_pow]
    exact pow_ne_zero _ (hQ j)
  · change pRoot K _ (aeval u (P j ^ _) / aeval u (Q j ^ _)) = w j
    refine pRoot_eq_of_pow_eq ?_
    rw [map_pow, map_pow, ← div_pow, ← hw' j, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' (hle j)]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.cb_le_dcl_of_forall_map_eq
statement:
theorem cb_le_dcl_of_forall_map_eq (g : Germ k a a') {L : IntermediateField k K}
    (h : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[↥L] K, g.map (σ.restrictScalars k) = g) : g.cb ≤ dcl L
proof:
:=
  fun x hx ↦ mem_dcl_iff_forall_fixed.2 fun σ ↦ (map_eq_self_iff _ _).1 (h σ) x hx

name: GroupConfig.Germ.evalGen_mem_dclAdjoin_of_cb_le_dcl
statement:
theorem evalGen_mem_dclAdjoin_of_cb_le_dcl (g : Germ k a a') {L : IntermediateField k K}
    (hL : g.cb ≤ dcl L) {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k a y)
    (h : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (g.cb : Set K)) (j : κ) :
    g.evalGen y j ∈ dclAdjoin L y
proof:
:= by
  unfold dclAdjoin
  refine mem_dcl_iff_forall_fixed.2 fun σ ↦ ?_
  have hfixL : ∀ x ∈ L, (σ.restrictScalars k) x = x := fun x hx ↦ by
    change σ x = x
    exact σ.commutes
      ⟨x, (mem_restrictScalars k).2 (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ (⟨x, hx⟩ : ↥L))⟩
  have hfixy : ⇑(σ.restrictScalars k) ∘ y = y := funext fun i ↦ by
    change σ (y i) = y i
    exact σ.commutes
      ⟨y i, (mem_restrictScalars k).2 (subset_adjoin (↥L) _ (mem_range_self i))⟩
  have hg : g.map (σ.restrictScalars k) = g :=
    (map_eq_self_iff _ _).2 fun x hx ↦ apply_eq_self_of_mem_dcl_of_fixes _ hfixL (hL hx)
  have e := evalGen_map (σ.restrictScalars k) g hy h
  rw [hg, hfixy] at e
  exact (congrFun e j).symm

name: GroupConfig.Germ.evalGen_mem_dclAdjoin
statement:
theorem evalGen_mem_dclAdjoin (g : Germ k a a') {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k a y)
    (h : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (g.cb : Set K)) (j : κ) :
    g.evalGen y j ∈ dclAdjoin g.cb y
proof:
:=
  g.evalGen_mem_dclAdjoin_of_cb_le_dcl (le_dcl _) hy h j

name: GroupConfig.Germ.map_eq_of_cb_le
statement:
theorem map_eq_of_cb_le (g : Germ k a a') {L : IntermediateField k K} (hL : g.cb ≤ L)
    (σ : K ≃ₐ[↥L] K) : g.map (σ.restrictScalars k) = g
proof:
:=
  (map_eq_self_iff _ _).2 fun x hx ↦ by
    change σ x = x
    exact σ.commutes ⟨x, hL hx⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.comp_map_eq_of_map_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [Germ.comp_map, hg', hg]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsInverse.map_eq_of_map_eq
statement:
theorem IsInverse.map_eq_of_map_eq {h : Germ k a' a} {g : Germ k a a'} (hi : IsInverse h g)
    {σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K} (hg : g.map σ = g) : h.map σ = h
proof:
:= by
  have h' := hi.map σ
  rw [hg] at h'
  exact h'.unique hi

name: GroupConfig.Germ.evalGen_mem_dclAdjoin_of_forall_map_eq
statement:
theorem evalGen_mem_dclAdjoin_of_forall_map_eq {μ : Type*} {c : μ → K} (w : Germ k a a')
    (hw : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[↥(adjoin k (range c))] K, w.map (σ.restrictScalars k) = w) {y : ι → K}
    (hy : IsGen k a y) (hind : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (range c)) :
    IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (w.cb : Set K) ∧
      ∀ j, w.evalGen y j ∈ dclAdjoin (adjoin k (range c)) y
proof:
:= by
  have hcb := w.cb_le_dcl_of_forall_map_eq hw
  have hcbr : (w.cb : Set K) ⊆ racl k (∅ ∪ range c) := fun x hx ↦ by
    rw [empty_union]
    exact racl_le_of_subset_racl (adjoin_le_racl k _) (dcl_le_racl _ (hcb hx))
  have hyw : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (w.cb : Set K) :=
    (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hind).mono_right hcbr
  exact ⟨hyw, fun j ↦ w.evalGen_mem_dclAdjoin_of_cb_le_dcl hcb hy hyw j⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.eval_mem_dclAdjoin
statement:
theorem eval_mem_dclAdjoin (g : Germ k a a') {F : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed ↥F]
    (hF : IsSmall k (F : Set K)) (hcb : g.cb ≤ F) {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGenericOver F a y)
    (j : κ) : g.eval F y j ∈ dclAdjoin F y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← evalGen_eq g hF hcb hy]
  exact dclAdjoin_mono hcb y (g.evalGen_mem_dclAdjoin hy.isGen (hy.indepOver.mono_right hcb) j)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.exists_rep_M_eq
statement:
theorem exists_rep_M_eq (g : Germ k a a') {F : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed ↥F]
    (hF : IsSmall k (F : Set K)) (hcb : g.cb ≤ F) :
    ∃ r : Representative k K a a', (⟦r⟧ : Germ k a a') = g ∧ r.M = F
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hF a
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfy⟩ := exists_quasiRational_of_mem_dclAdjoin (g.eval_mem_dclAdjoin hF hcb hy)
  have hgen : IsGenericOver F a' (f.eval y) := by
    rw [hfy]
    exact g.isGenericOver_eval hF hcb hy
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r : Representative k K a a',
      r = Representative.ofQuasiRational ‹IsAlgClosed ↥F› hF f hy hf hgen := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hrM : r.M = F := by
    subst hr
    rfl
  have hrf : r.f.eval y = f.eval y := by
    subst hr
    rfl
  have hyM : IsGenericOver r.M a y := by
    rw [hrM]
    exact hy
  have hcbr : Germ.cb (⟦r⟧ : Germ k a a') ≤ F := hrM ▸ cb_mk_le r
  refine ⟨r, ?_, hrM⟩
  exact eq_of_eval_eq hF hcbr hcb hy ((eval_eq_rep r hF hcbr hrM.ge hyM).trans (hrf.trans hfy))

name: GroupConfig.Germ.isInvertible_iff_mem_dclAdjoin
proof:
:= by
  have hz : IsGenericOver F a' (g.eval F y) := g.isGenericOver_eval hF hcb hy
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h, hi⟩ i
    have hcbh : h.cb ≤ F := hi.cb_le.trans (racl_le_of_isAlgClosed hcb)
    have : h.eval F (g.eval F y) = y :=
      (comp_eval h g hF hcb hcbh hy).symm.trans (by
        rw [hi.1]
        exact eval_id hF hy)
    exact (congrArg (fun z ↦ z ∈ dclAdjoin F (g.eval F y)) (congrFun this i)).mp
      (h.eval_mem_dclAdjoin hF hcbh hz i)
  · intro hdef
    obtain ⟨f', hf', hf'z⟩ := exists_quasiRational_of_mem_dclAdjoin hdef
    have hgen : IsGenericOver F a (f'.eval (g.eval F y)) := by
      rw [hf'z]
      exact hy
    obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ : ∃ r' : Representative k K a' a,
        r' = Representative.ofQuasiRational ‹IsAlgClosed ↥F› hF f' hz hf' hgen := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hrM : r'.M = F := by
      subst hr'
      rfl
    have hrf : r'.f.eval (g.eval F y) = f'.eval (g.eval F y) := by
      subst hr'
      rfl
    have hzM : IsGenericOver r'.M a' (g.eval F y) := by
      rw [hrM]
      exact hz
    have hcbh : Germ.cb (⟦r'⟧ : Germ k a' a) ≤ F := hrM ▸ cb_mk_le r'
    have hr'' : Germ.eval (⟦r'⟧ : Germ k a' a) F (g.eval F y) = y :=
      (eval_eq_rep r' hF hcbh hrM.ge hzM).trans (hrf.trans hf'z)
    refine ⟨⟦r'⟧, ?_⟩
    constructor
    · exact eq_of_eval_eq hF (cb_comp_le _ _ hF hcb hcbh) (cb_id_le a F) hy
        ((comp_eval _ _ hF hcb hcbh hy).trans (hr''.trans (eval_id hF hy).symm))
    · exact eq_of_eval_eq hF (cb_comp_le _ _ hF hcbh hcb) (cb_id_le a' F) hz
        ((comp_eval _ _ hF hcbh hcb hz).trans
          ((congrArg (g.eval F) hr'').trans (eval_id hF hz).symm))

name: GroupConfig.Germ.evalGen_mk_eq
statement:
theorem evalGen_mk_eq (r : Representative k K a a') {u : ι → K} (hu : IsGenericOver r.M a u) :
    Germ.evalGen (⟦r⟧ : Germ k a a') u = r.f.eval u
proof:
:= by
  have _ := r.isAlgClosed
  exact (evalGen_eq _ r.isSmall (cb_mk_le r) hu).trans
    (eval_eq_rep r r.isSmall (cb_mk_le r) le_rfl hu)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.evalGen_comp_of_indepOver
statement:
theorem evalGen_comp_of_indepOver {μ : Type*} [Finite μ] {a'' : μ → K} (h : Germ k a' a'')
    (g : Germ k a a') {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k a y)
    (hyg : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (g.cb : Set K))
    (hyhg : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) ((Germ.comp h g).cb : Set K))
    (hz : IndepOver k ∅ (range (g.evalGen y)) (h.cb : Set K)) :
    (Germ.comp h g).evalGen y = h.evalGen (g.evalGen y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have _ := Fintype.ofFinite κ
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k ((Germ.comp h g).cb : Set K)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (g.cb : Set K)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (h.cb : Set K)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
                                                                       
  obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁, hr₁M⟩ := (Germ.comp h g).exists_rep_M_eq (Germ.comp h g).isSmall_cb.racl
    fun x hx ↦ subset_racl k _ hx
  obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂, hr₂M⟩ := g.exists_rep_M_eq g.isSmall_cb.racl fun x hx ↦ subset_racl k _ hx
  obtain ⟨r₃, hr₃, hr₃M⟩ := h.exists_rep_M_eq h.isSmall_cb.racl fun x hx ↦ subset_racl k _ hx
                                                                                  
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ : ∃ N : IntermediateField k K, N = racl k ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ h.cb) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥N := hN ▸ isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hNs : IsSmall k (N : Set K) := hN ▸ (g.isSmall_cb.union h.isSmall_cb).racl
  have h₁N : r₁.M ≤ N := by
    rw [hr₁M, hN]
    exact racl_le_of_subset_racl (cb_comp_le_racl h g)
  have h₂N : r₂.M ≤ N := by
    rw [hr₂M, hN]
    exact racl_mono subset_union_left
  have h₃N : r₃.M ≤ N := by
    rw [hr₃M, hN]
    exact racl_mono subset_union_right
  have _ : ExpChar (↥N) (ringExpChar K) := expChar_of_algebra (↥N) K
  obtain ⟨f₂, hf₂⟩ : ∃ f, f = r₂.f.map (IntermediateField.inclusion h₂N).toRingHom := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨f₃, hf₃⟩ : ∃ f, f = r₃.f.map (IntermediateField.inclusion h₃N).toRingHom := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hf₂def : ∀ u, f₂.IsDefinedAt u ↔ r₂.f.IsDefinedAt u := fun u ↦ by
    rw [hf₂]
    exact QuasiRational.isDefinedAt_map_iff h₂N r₂.f u
  have hf₃def : ∀ u, f₃.IsDefinedAt u ↔ r₃.f.IsDefinedAt u := fun u ↦ by
    rw [hf₃]
    exact QuasiRational.isDefinedAt_map_iff h₃N r₃.f u
  have hf₂eval : ∀ u, f₂.eval u = r₂.f.eval u := fun u ↦ by
    rw [hf₂]
    exact QuasiRational.eval_map h₂N r₂.f u
  have hf₃eval : ∀ u, f₃.eval u = r₃.f.eval u := fun u ↦ by
    rw [hf₃]
    exact QuasiRational.eval_map h₃N r₃.f u
                                                                                           
                                                   
  have hcomp : ∀ u, IsGenericOver r₂.M a u → IsGenericOver r₃.M a' (r₂.f.eval u) →
      (f₃.comp (ringExpChar K) f₂).IsDefinedAt u ∧
        (f₃.comp (ringExpChar K) f₂).eval u = h.evalGen (g.evalGen u) := fun u hu hgu ↦ by
    have hdef₂ : f₂.IsDefinedAt u := (hf₂def u).2 (r₂.isDefinedAt u hu)
    have hdef₃ : f₃.IsDefinedAt (f₂.eval u) := by
      rw [hf₂eval, hf₃def]
      exact r₃.isDefinedAt _ hgu
    refine ⟨QuasiRational.isDefinedAt_comp f₃ f₂ hdef₂ hdef₃, ?_⟩
    rw [QuasiRational.comp_eval f₃ f₂ hdef₂, hf₂eval, hf₃eval, ← evalGen_mk_eq r₃ hgu,
      ← evalGen_mk_eq r₂ hu, hr₂, hr₃]
                                              
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hNs a
  have hy₀₂ : IsGenericOver r₂.M a y₀ := hy₀.of_le h₂N
  have hgy₀ : IsGenericOver r₃.M a' (r₂.f.eval y₀) := by
    have hg₀ : g.cb ≤ N := by
      rw [hN]
      exact fun x hx ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl hx)
    have e : r₂.f.eval y₀ = g.eval N y₀ := by
      rw [← evalGen_mk_eq r₂ hy₀₂, hr₂, evalGen_eq g hNs hg₀ hy₀]
    rw [e]
    exact (g.isGenericOver_eval hNs hg₀ hy₀).of_le h₃N
  have hind₀ : IndepOver k ∅ (range y₀) ((h.cb : Set K) ∪ g.cb) := by
    refine hy₀.indepOver.mono_right ?_
    rw [hN]
    exact union_subset (fun x hx ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hx))
      (fun x hx ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl hx))
  obtain ⟨hF₀, hFe₀⟩ := hcomp y₀ hy₀₂ hgy₀
  have heq₀ : r₁.f.eval y₀ = (f₃.comp (ringExpChar K) f₂).eval y₀ := by
    rw [hFe₀, ← evalGen_mk_eq r₁ (hy₀.of_le h₁N), hr₁]
    exact evalGen_comp h g hy₀.isGen hind₀
                        
  have hy₁ : IsGenericOver r₁.M a y := by
    rw [hr₁M]
    exact hy.isGenericOver_racl (Germ.comp h g).isSmall_cb hyhg
  have hy₂ : IsGenericOver r₂.M a y := by
    rw [hr₂M]
    exact hy.isGenericOver_racl g.isSmall_cb hyg
  have hgy : IsGenericOver r₃.M a' (r₂.f.eval y) := by
    rw [← evalGen_mk_eq r₂ hy₂, hr₂, hr₃M]
    exact (g.isGen_evalGen hy hyg).isGenericOver_racl h.isSmall_cb hz
  obtain ⟨hF, hFe⟩ := hcomp y hy₂ hgy
  have := QuasiRational.eval_eq_of_eval_eq h₁N le_rfl hy₀ hy₂.inLocus
    (r₁.isDefinedAt y₀ (hy₀.of_le h₁N)) hF₀ (r₁.isDefinedAt y hy₁) hF heq₀
  rw [← hr₁, evalGen_mk_eq r₁ hy₁, this, hFe]

name: GroupConfig.BaseFunctionField.equiv_coord
statement:
theorem equiv_coord (i : ι) :
    equiv k v (coord k v i) =
      ⟨v i, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ (mem_range_self i)⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [coord, equiv, IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv_algebraMap, locusCoordinateRingEquiv_mk]
  apply Subtype.ext
  change aeval v (X i) = v i
  rw [aeval_X]

name: GroupConfig.BaseFunctionField.essFiniteType
statement: theorem essFiniteType [Finite ι] : Algebra.EssFiniteType k (BaseFunctionField k v)
proof:
:=
  inferInstance

name: GroupConfig.BaseFunctionField.trdeg_eq_one
statement:
theorem trdeg_eq_one (hv : erk k ∅ (range v) = 1) :
    Algebra.trdeg k (BaseFunctionField k v) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hE : Algebra.trdeg k (IntermediateField.adjoin k (range v)) = 1 := by
    rw [← Cardinal.toENat_eq_one, ← erk_empty_eq_toENat_trdeg, hv]
  have h := (equiv k v).lift_trdeg_eq
  rw [hE, Cardinal.lift_one] at h
  exact Cardinal.lift_eq_one.1 h

name: GroupConfig.BaseFunctionField.exists_separating_transcendental
statement:
theorem exists_separating_transcendental [PerfectField k] [Finite ι]
    (hv : erk k ∅ (range v) = 1) :
    ∃ t : BaseFunctionField k v, Transcendental k t ∧
      FiniteDimensional (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set (BaseFunctionField k v)))
        (BaseFunctionField k v) ∧
      Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set (BaseFunctionField k v)))
        (BaseFunctionField k v)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsep⟩ :=
    exists_isTranscendenceBasis_and_isSeparable_of_perfectField k (BaseFunctionField k v)
  have hcard : s.card = 1 := by
    have h := hs.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg
    rw [Cardinal.mk_coe_finset, trdeg_eq_one k v hv] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.1 hcard
  have halg := hs.isAlgebraic_field
  have hr : range ((↑) : ({t} : Finset (BaseFunctionField k v)) → BaseFunctionField k v) =
      {t} := by
    ext
    simp
  rw [hr] at halg
  rw [Finset.coe_singleton] at hsep
  have _ : Algebra.EssFiniteType (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set (BaseFunctionField k v)))
      (BaseFunctionField k v) := Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_comp k _ _
  have hfin := Algebra.finite_of_essFiniteType_of_isAlgebraic
    (F := IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set (BaseFunctionField k v)))
    (E := BaseFunctionField k v)
  exact ⟨t, hs.1.transcendental ⟨t, Finset.mem_singleton_self t⟩, hfin, hsep⟩

name: GroupConfig.BaseFunctionField.isFunctionFieldOneVar
statement:
theorem isFunctionFieldOneVar [PerfectField k] [Finite ι] (hv : erk k ∅ (range v) = 1) :
    AclGeom.IsFunctionFieldOneVar k (BaseFunctionField k v)
proof:
:=
  let ⟨t, ht, hfd, _⟩ := exists_separating_transcendental k v hv
  ⟨⟨t, ht, hfd⟩⟩

name: GroupConfig.isGenericOver_iff_of_idealOf_eq
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsGenericOver
  rw [h]

name: GroupConfig.isGen_iff_of_idealOf_eq
statement:
theorem isGen_iff_of_idealOf_eq (h : idealOf k a₁ = idealOf k a) (y : ι → K) :
    IsGen k a₁ y ↔ IsGen k a y
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsGen
  rw [h]

name: GroupConfig.Representative.equivalent_transport_iff
statement:
theorem equivalent_transport_iff {r r' : Representative k K a a'} :
    (r.transport h h').Equivalent (r'.transport h h') ↔ r.Equivalent r'
proof:
:=
  forall_congr' fun y ↦ imp_congr_left (isGenericOver_iff_of_idealOf_eq h y)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.transport_mk
statement:
theorem transport_mk (r : Representative k K a a') :
    transport h h' (⟦r⟧ : Germ k a a') = ⟦r.transport h h'⟧
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.transport_transport
statement:
theorem transport_transport (g : Germ k a a') :
    (g.transport h h').transport h.symm h'.symm = g
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn g fun _ ↦ rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.transport_injective
statement: theorem transport_injective : Function.Injective (transport h h' : Germ k a a' → _)
proof:
:=
  (transportEquiv h h').injective

name: GroupConfig.Germ.transport_surjective
statement: theorem transport_surjective : Function.Surjective (transport h h' : Germ k a a' → _)
proof:
:=
  (transportEquiv h h').surjective

name: GroupConfig.Germ.graphIdeal_transport
statement: theorem graphIdeal_transport (g : Germ k a a') : (g.transport h h').graphIdeal = g.graphIdeal
proof:
:= by
  induction g using Quotient.inductionOn with
  | h r =>
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver r.isSmall a
    change Representative.graphIdeal (r.transport h h') = r.graphIdeal
    rw [Representative.graphIdeal_eq (r.transport h h')
      ((isGenericOver_iff_of_idealOf_eq h y).2 hy), Representative.graphIdeal_eq r hy]
    rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.cb_transport
statement: theorem cb_transport (g : Germ k a a') : (g.transport h h').cb = g.cb
proof:
:= by
  unfold cb
  rw [graphIdeal_transport]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.eval_transport
statement:
theorem eval_transport (g : Germ k a a') (F : IntermediateField k K) (y : ι → K) :
    (g.transport h h').eval F y = g.eval F y
proof:
:= by
  unfold eval IsGraphGeneric
  rw [graphIdeal_transport]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.evalGen_transport
statement:
theorem evalGen_transport (g : Germ k a a') (y : ι → K) :
    (g.transport h h').evalGen y = g.evalGen y
proof:
:= by
  unfold evalGen
  rw [cb_transport, eval_transport]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.map_transport
statement:
theorem map_transport (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (g : Germ k a a') :
    (g.map σ).transport h h' = (g.transport h h').map σ
proof:
:=
  
  Quotient.inductionOn g fun _ ↦ Quotient.sound fun _ _ ↦ rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.comp_transport
statement:
theorem comp_transport (g' : Germ k a' a'') (g : Germ k a a') :
    (Germ.comp g' g).transport h h'' = Germ.comp (g'.transport h' h'') (g.transport h h')
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn₂ g' g fun _ _ ↦ rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.id_transport
statement: theorem id_transport : (Germ.id a).transport h h = Germ.id a₁
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.isInverse_transport_iff
statement:
theorem isInverse_transport_iff {g : Germ k a a'} {f : Germ k a' a} :
    IsInverse (f.transport h' h) (g.transport h h') ↔ IsInverse f g
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsInverse
  rw [← comp_transport, ← comp_transport, ← id_transport h, ← id_transport h',
    (transport_injective h h).eq_iff, (transport_injective h' h').eq_iff]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.isInvertible_transport_iff
statement:
theorem isInvertible_transport_iff {g : Germ k a a'} :
    IsInvertible (g.transport h h') ↔ IsInvertible g
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf⟩
    rw [← transport_transport h'.symm h.symm f] at hf
    exact ⟨_, (isInverse_transport_iff h h').1 hf⟩
  · rintro ⟨f, hf⟩
    exact ⟨_, (isInverse_transport_iff h h').2 hf⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.transport_mem_orbit_iff
statement:
theorem transport_mem_orbit_iff {g₀ g : Germ k a a'} :
    g.transport h h' ∈ orbit (g₀.transport h h') ↔ g ∈ orbit g₀
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨σ, hσ⟩
    exact ⟨σ, transport_injective h h' (((map_transport h h' σ g₀)).trans hσ)⟩
  · rintro ⟨σ, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨σ, (map_transport h h' σ g₀).symm⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.exists_of_mem_orbit_transport
statement:
theorem exists_of_mem_orbit_transport {g₀ : Germ k a a'} {f : Germ k a₁ a'₁}
    (hf : f ∈ orbit (g₀.transport h h')) : ∃ g ∈ orbit g₀, g.transport h h' = f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := transport_surjective h h' f
  exact ⟨g, (transport_mem_orbit_iff h h').1 hf, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.transport_mem_diffSet_iff
statement:
theorem transport_mem_diffSet_iff {f₀ : Germ k a a'} {δ : Germ k a a} :
    δ.transport h h ∈ diffSet (f₀.transport h h') ↔ δ ∈ diffSet f₀
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e₁, he₁, e₂, he₂, d₁, hd₁, hind, hδ⟩
    obtain ⟨f₁, hf₁, rfl⟩ := exists_of_mem_orbit_transport h h' he₁
    obtain ⟨f₂, hf₂, rfl⟩ := exists_of_mem_orbit_transport h h' he₂
    obtain ⟨g₁, rfl⟩ := transport_surjective h' h d₁
    rw [cb_transport, cb_transport] at hind
    rw [← comp_transport] at hδ
    exact ⟨f₁, hf₁, f₂, hf₂, g₁, (isInverse_transport_iff h h').1 hd₁, hind,
      transport_injective h h hδ⟩
  · rintro ⟨f₁, hf₁, f₂, hf₂, g₁, hg₁, hind, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨_, (transport_mem_orbit_iff h h').2 hf₁, _, (transport_mem_orbit_iff h h').2 hf₂,
      _, (isInverse_transport_iff h h').2 hg₁, ?_, comp_transport h h' h g₁ f₂⟩
    rwa [cb_transport, cb_transport]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.exists_of_mem_diffSet_transport
statement:
theorem exists_of_mem_diffSet_transport {f₀ : Germ k a a'} {δ : Germ k a₁ a₁}
    (hδ : δ ∈ diffSet (f₀.transport h h')) : ∃ δ₀ ∈ diffSet f₀, δ₀.transport h h = δ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ₀, rfl⟩ := transport_surjective h h δ
  exact ⟨δ₀, (transport_mem_diffSet_iff h h').1 hδ, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.transport
statement: theorem IsHWBij.transport {f₀ : Germ k a a'} (hb : IsHWBij f₀) : IsHWBij (f₀.transport h h')
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(isInvertible_transport_iff h h').2 hb.isInvertible, fun f hf y hy hind ↦ ?_,
    fun δ hδ ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩ := exists_of_mem_orbit_transport h h' hf
    rw [cb_transport] at hind
    rw [evalGen_transport]
    exact hb.trans g hg y ((isGen_iff_of_idealOf_eq h y).1 hy) hind
  · obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, rfl⟩ := exists_of_mem_diffSet_transport h h' hδ
    rw [cb_transport, cb_transport]
    exact hb.rank δ₀ hδ₀

name: GroupConfig.Germ.transportMulEquiv_apply
statement: theorem transportMulEquiv_apply (g : Germ k a a) : transportMulEquiv h g = g.transport h h
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.transport
statement: theorem IsHW.transport {g₀ : Germ k a a} (hw : IsHW g₀) : IsHW (g₀.transport h h)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun e he y hy hind ↦ ?_, fun e he d hd ↦ ?_, fun e₁ he₁ e₂ he₂ hind ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← transportMulEquiv_apply]
    exact hw.isUnit.map _
  · obtain ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩ := exists_of_mem_orbit_transport h h he
    rw [cb_transport] at hind
    rw [evalGen_transport]
    exact hw.trans g hg y ((isGen_iff_of_idealOf_eq h y).1 hy) hind
  · obtain ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩ := exists_of_mem_orbit_transport h h he
    obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := transport_surjective h h d
    exact (transport_mem_orbit_iff h h).2
      (hw.inv g hg f ((isInverse_transport_iff h h).1 hd))
  · obtain ⟨g₁, hg₁, rfl⟩ := exists_of_mem_orbit_transport h h he₁
    obtain ⟨g₂, hg₂, rfl⟩ := exists_of_mem_orbit_transport h h he₂
    rw [cb_transport, cb_transport] at hind
    rw [mul_def, ← comp_transport]
    exact (transport_mem_orbit_iff h h).2 (hw.comp g₁ hg₁ g₂ hg₂ hind)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.transport_mem_prodSet_iff
statement:
theorem transport_mem_prodSet_iff {g₀ γ : Germ k a a} :
    γ.transport h h ∈ IsHW.prodSet (g₀.transport h h) ↔ γ ∈ IsHW.prodSet g₀
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f₁, hf₁, f₂, hf₂, hγ⟩
    obtain ⟨g₁, hg₁, rfl⟩ := exists_of_mem_orbit_transport h h hf₁
    obtain ⟨g₂, hg₂, rfl⟩ := exists_of_mem_orbit_transport h h hf₂
    rw [mul_def, ← comp_transport] at hγ
    exact ⟨g₁, hg₁, g₂, hg₂, transport_injective h h hγ⟩
  · rintro ⟨g₁, hg₁, g₂, hg₂, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, (transport_mem_orbit_iff h h).2 hg₁, _, (transport_mem_orbit_iff h h).2 hg₂,
      comp_transport h h h g₁ g₂⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.val_transportGroupHom
statement:
theorem val_transportGroupHom (δ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) :
    (hw.transport h).val (hw.transportGroupHom h δ) = (hw.val δ).transport h h
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.transportGroupHom_bijective
statement: theorem transportGroupHom_bijective : Function.Bijective (hw.transportGroupHom h)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun δ δ' hδ ↦ hw.val_injective ?_, fun ε ↦ ?_⟩
  · have e := congrArg (hw.transport h).val hδ
    rw [val_transportGroupHom, val_transportGroupHom] at e
    exact transport_injective h h e
  · obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := transport_surjective h h ((hw.transport h).val ε)
    have hmem : γ ∈ prodSet g₀ := by
      rw [← transport_mem_prodSet_iff h, hγ]
      exact (hw.transport h).val_mem ε
    refine ⟨hw.ofMem hmem, (hw.transport h).val_injective ?_⟩
    rw [val_transportGroupHom, val_ofMem, hγ]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.val_transportGroupEquiv
statement:
theorem val_transportGroupEquiv (δ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) :
    (hw.transport h).val (hw.transportGroupEquiv h δ) = (hw.val δ).transport h h
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.base_transportPair
statement: theorem base_transportPair (p : Pair g₀) : (transportPair h p).base = p.base
proof:
:= by
  change ((p.γ.transport h h).cb : Set K) ∪ range p.pt = (p.γ.cb : Set K) ∪ range p.pt
  rw [cb_transport]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.rel_transportPair_iff
statement:
theorem rel_transportPair_iff {p q : Pair g₀} :
    (transportPair h p).Rel (transportPair h q) ↔ p.Rel q
proof:
:= by
  unfold Pair.Rel
  rw [base_transportPair, base_transportPair]
  constructor
  · intro hr f hf hind
    have e := hr (f.transport h h) ((transport_mem_orbit_iff h h).2 hf) (by rwa [cb_transport])
    change (f.transport h h * p.γ.transport h h).evalGen p.pt =
      (f.transport h h * q.γ.transport h h).evalGen q.pt at e
    rwa [mul_def, mul_def, ← comp_transport, ← comp_transport, evalGen_transport,
      evalGen_transport] at e
  · intro hr f hf hind
    obtain ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩ := exists_of_mem_orbit_transport h h hf
    rw [cb_transport] at hind
    change (g.transport h h * p.γ.transport h h).evalGen p.pt =
      (g.transport h h * q.γ.transport h h).evalGen q.pt
    rw [mul_def, mul_def, ← comp_transport, ← comp_transport, evalGen_transport,
      evalGen_transport]
    exact hr g hg hind

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.transportSpace_ofPair
statement:
theorem transportSpace_ofPair (p : Pair g₀) :
    hw.transportSpace h (hw.ofPair p) = (hw.transport h).ofPair (transportPair h p)
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.transportSpace_bijective
statement: theorem transportSpace_bijective : Function.Bijective (hw.transportSpace h)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun s t ↦ ?_, fun s ↦ ?_⟩
  · refine hw.ind (fun p ↦ ?_) s
    refine hw.ind (fun q ↦ ?_) t
    intro hst
    rw [transportSpace_ofPair, transportSpace_ofPair, ofPair_eq_ofPair] at hst
    exact hw.ofPair_eq_ofPair.2 ((rel_transportPair_iff h).1 hst)
  · refine (hw.transport h).ind (fun p ↦ ?_) s
    obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := transport_surjective h h p.γ
    have hmem : γ ∈ prodSet g₀ := by
      rw [← transport_mem_prodSet_iff h, hγ]
      exact p.mem
    refine ⟨hw.ofPair ⟨γ, hmem, p.pt, (isGen_iff_of_idealOf_eq h p.pt).1 p.isGen⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [transportSpace_ofPair]
    exact congrArg (hw.transport h).ofPair (Pair.ext hγ rfl)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.transportSpaceEquiv_ofPair
statement:
theorem transportSpaceEquiv_ofPair (p : Pair g₀) :
    hw.transportSpaceEquiv h (hw.ofPair p) = (hw.transport h).ofPair (transportPair h p)
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.transportSpaceEquiv_smul
statement:
theorem transportSpaceEquiv_smul (δ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) (s : hw.Space) :
    hw.transportSpaceEquiv h (δ • s) = hw.transportGroupEquiv h δ • hw.transportSpaceEquiv h s
proof:
:= by
  refine hw.ind (fun p ↦ ?_) s
  rw [smul_ofPair, transportSpaceEquiv_ofPair, transportSpaceEquiv_ofPair, smul_ofPair]
  refine congrArg (hw.transport h).ofPair (Pair.ext ?_ rfl)
  change (hw.val δ * p.γ).transport h h = (hw.val δ).transport h h * p.γ.transport h h
  exact comp_transport h h h _ _

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.transportSpaceEquiv_iota
statement:
theorem transportSpaceEquiv_iota {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k a y) :
    hw.transportSpaceEquiv h (hw.iota hy) =
      (hw.transport h).iota ((isGen_iff_of_idealOf_eq h y).2 hy)
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.moebiusVal_mul
statement:
private theorem moebiusVal_mul {s : L} (hs : Transcendental K s) (X Y : SL(2, K)) :
    moebiusVal X (moebiusVal Y s) = moebiusVal (X * Y) s
proof:
:= by
  have hY := sl2_denom_ne_zero hs Y
  have hXY := sl2_denom_ne_zero hs (X * Y)
  obtain ⟨φ, hφdef⟩ : ∃ φ, φ = moebiusVal Y s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hφ : φ * (algebraMap K L (Y 1 0) * s + algebraMap K L (Y 1 1)) =
      algebraMap K L (Y 0 0) * s + algebraMap K L (Y 0 1) := by
    rw [hφdef]
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ hY
  rw [← hφdef]
  have hX : algebraMap K L (X 1 0) * φ + algebraMap K L (X 1 1) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hXY
    have hprod : (algebraMap K L (X 1 0) * φ + algebraMap K L (X 1 1)) *
        (algebraMap K L (Y 1 0) * s + algebraMap K L (Y 1 1)) =
        algebraMap K L ((X * Y) 1 0) * s + algebraMap K L ((X * Y) 1 1) := by
