      simp only [SpecialLinearGroup.coe_mul, mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, map_add, map_mul]
      linear_combination (algebraMap K L (X 1 0)) * hφ
    rw [← hprod, h, zero_mul]
  unfold moebiusVal
  rw [div_eq_div_iff hX hXY]
  simp only [SpecialLinearGroup.coe_mul, mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, map_add, map_mul]
  linear_combination (algebraMap K L (X 0 0) * algebraMap K L (X 1 1) -
    algebraMap K L (X 0 1) * algebraMap K L (X 1 0)) * hφ

name: GroupConfig.moebiusVal_one
statement: private theorem moebiusVal_one (s : L) : moebiusVal (1 : SL(2, K)) s = s
proof:
:= by
  simp [moebiusVal]

name: GroupConfig.moebiusVal_algEquiv
statement:
private theorem moebiusVal_algEquiv (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (X : SL(2, K)) (s : L) :
    σ (moebiusVal X s) = moebiusVal X (σ s)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [moebiusVal, map_div₀, map_add, map_mul, AlgEquiv.commutes]

name: GroupConfig.moebiusVal_generator
statement:
private theorem moebiusVal_generator {s : L} (hs : Transcendental K s)
    (htop : IntermediateField.adjoin K ({s} : Set L) = ⊤) (A : SL(2, K)) :
    Transcendental K (moebiusVal A s) ∧
      IntermediateField.adjoin K ({moebiusVal A s} : Set L) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  
  have hsu : moebiusVal A⁻¹ (moebiusVal A s) = s := by
    rw [moebiusVal_mul hs, inv_mul_cancel, moebiusVal_one]
  have hsmem : s ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin K ({moebiusVal A s} : Set L) := by
    have h : moebiusVal A⁻¹ (moebiusVal A s) ∈
        IntermediateField.adjoin K ({moebiusVal A s} : Set L) := by
      obtain ⟨u, hudef⟩ : ∃ u, u = moebiusVal A s := ⟨_, rfl⟩
      rw [← hudef]
      have hu := IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self K u
      unfold moebiusVal
      exact div_mem
        (add_mem (mul_mem (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ _) hu)
          (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ _))
        (add_mem (mul_mem (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ _) hu)
          (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ _))
    rwa [hsu] at h
  refine ⟨fun halg ↦ ?_, top_unique (htop ▸ IntermediateField.adjoin_simple_le_iff.2 hsmem)⟩
  
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic K (IntermediateField.adjoin K ({moebiusVal A s} : Set L)) :=
    IntermediateField.isAlgebraic_adjoin_simple halg.isIntegral
  exact hs (IntermediateField.isAlgebraic_iff.1
    (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic (⟨s, hsmem⟩ :
      IntermediateField.adjoin K ({moebiusVal A s} : Set L))))

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.racl_union_entries_conj
statement:
private theorem racl_union_entries_conj {F : Set K} {A : SL(2, K)} (hA : ∀ i j, A i j ∈ F)
    (hA' : ∀ i j, A⁻¹ i j ∈ F) (m : SL(2, K)) :
    racl k (F ∪ range fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ (A * m * A⁻¹) ij.1 ij.2) =
      racl k (F ∪ range fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ m ij.1 ij.2)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ B X : SL(2, K), (∀ i j, B i j ∈ F) → (∀ i j, B⁻¹ i j ∈ F) →
      racl k (F ∪ range fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ (B * X * B⁻¹) ij.1 ij.2) ≤
        racl k (F ∪ range fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ X ij.1 ij.2) := by
    intro B X hB hB'
    have hF : ∀ c ∈ F, c ∈ racl k (F ∪ range fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ X ij.1 ij.2) :=
      fun c hc ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl hc)
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset hF ?_)
    rintro _ ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩
    exact sl_mul_entries_mem _ (sl_mul_entries_mem _ (fun i j ↦ hF _ (hB i j))
      (fun i j ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩))) (fun i j ↦ hF _ (hB' i j)) i j
  refine le_antisymm (key A m hA hA') ?_
  have h := key A⁻¹ (A * m * A⁻¹) hA' (by simpa only [inv_inv] using hA)
  rwa [show A⁻¹ * (A * m * A⁻¹) * A⁻¹⁻¹ = m by group] at h

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.racl_union_affineCoeffs
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : n 0 0 * n 1 1 = 1 := by
    have h := n.det_coe
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, hn, mul_zero, sub_zero] at h
    exact h
  have h11 : n 1 1 = (n 0 0)⁻¹ := eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right hdet
  have h11ne : n 1 1 ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one hdet
  refine le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset
    (fun c hc ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl hc)) ?_)) (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset
    (fun c hc ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl hc)) ?_))
  · have he : ∀ i j, n i j ∈ racl k (F ∪ range fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ n ij.1 ij.2) :=
      fun i j ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩)
    rintro _ (rfl | rfl)
    · exact div_mem (he 0 0) (he 1 1)
    · exact div_mem (he 0 1) (he 1 1)
  · have ha : n 0 0 / n 1 1 ∈ racl k (F ∪ {n 0 0 / n 1 1, n 0 1 / n 1 1}) :=
      subset_racl k _ (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
    have hb : n 0 1 / n 1 1 ∈ racl k (F ∪ {n 0 0 / n 1 1, n 0 1 / n 1 1}) :=
      subset_racl k _ (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl))
    have hsq : n 0 0 ^ 2 = n 0 0 / n 1 1 := by
      rw [h11, div_inv_eq_mul, sq]
    have h00 : n 0 0 ∈ racl k (F ∪ {n 0 0 / n 1 1, n 0 1 / n 1 1}) := by
      rw [mem_racl_iff k] at ha ⊢
      exact IsAlgebraic.of_pow two_pos (by rw [hsq]; exact ha)
    have h11m : n 1 1 ∈ racl k (F ∪ {n 0 0 / n 1 1, n 0 1 / n 1 1}) := by
      have h := inv_mem h00
      rwa [← h11] at h
    have h01 : n 0 1 ∈ racl k (F ∪ {n 0 0 / n 1 1, n 0 1 / n 1 1}) := by
      have h := mul_mem hb h11m
      rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ h11ne] at h
    have h10 : n 1 0 ∈ racl k (F ∪ {n 0 0 / n 1 1, n 0 1 / n 1 1}) := by
      rw [hn]
      exact zero_mem _
    have hall : ∀ i j, n i j ∈ racl k (F ∪ {n 0 0 / n 1 1, n 0 1 / n 1 1}) :=
      Fin.forall_fin_two.2 ⟨Fin.forall_fin_two.2 ⟨h00, h01⟩, Fin.forall_fin_two.2 ⟨h10, h11m⟩⟩
    rintro _ ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩
    exact hall i j

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.functionFieldAction_moebiusVal_of_triangular
statement:
private theorem functionFieldAction_moebiusVal_of_triangular {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    {v : ι → K} {g₀ : Germ k v v} (hw : IsHW g₀) (hv : erk k ∅ (range v) = 1)
    {t : LocusFunctionField k v} (ht : Transcendental K t) (A : SL(2, K))
    {γ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup} {m : SL(2, K)} (hm : hw.IsMoebiusLift hv t γ m)
    (hn : (A * m * A⁻¹) 1 0 = 0) :
    hw.functionFieldAction hv γ (moebiusVal A t) =
      algebraMap K _ ((A * m * A⁻¹) 0 0 / (A * m * A⁻¹) 1 1) * moebiusVal A t +
        algebraMap K _ ((A * m * A⁻¹) 0 1 / (A * m * A⁻¹) 1 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hden, hm⟩ := hm
  have hσt : hw.functionFieldAction hv γ t = moebiusVal m t := by
    unfold moebiusVal
    rw [eq_div_iff hden]
    exact hm
  have hσu : hw.functionFieldAction hv γ (moebiusVal A t) =
      moebiusVal (A * m * A⁻¹) (moebiusVal A t) := by
    rw [moebiusVal_algEquiv, hσt, moebiusVal_mul ht, moebiusVal_mul ht,
      show A * m * A⁻¹ * A = A * m by group]
  obtain ⟨n, hndef⟩ : ∃ n, n = A * m * A⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hndef] at hσu hn ⊢
  have hdet : n 0 0 * n 1 1 = 1 := by
    have h := n.det_coe
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, hn, mul_zero, sub_zero] at h
    exact h
  have h11' : algebraMap K (LocusFunctionField k v) (n 1 1) ≠ 0 :=
    (map_ne_zero _).2 (right_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one hdet)
  rw [hσu]
  unfold moebiusVal
  rw [hn, map_zero, zero_mul, zero_add, map_div₀, map_div₀]
  field_simp

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.exists_affine_generator_parameters
statement:
theorem exists_affine_generator_parameters {ι κ : Type w} [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    {v : ι → K} {v' : κ → K} {f₀ : Germ k v v'} (hb : f₀.IsHWBij) {δ₀ : Germ k v v}
    (hδ₀ : δ₀ ∈ f₀.diffSet) (hv : erk k ∅ (range v) = 1)
    (hr : erk k ∅ (δ₀.cb : Set K) = 2) :
    ∃ (u : LocusFunctionField k v) (M : IntermediateField k K) (_ : IsAlgClosed ↥M),
      IsSmall k (M : Set K) ∧ Transcendental K u ∧
      IntermediateField.adjoin K ({u} : Set (LocusFunctionField k v)) = ⊤ ∧
      (∃ A B : MvPolynomial ι M, (∀ y, IsGenericOver M v y → MvPolynomial.aeval y B ≠ 0) ∧
        u = LocusFunctionField.mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap M K) A) /
          LocusFunctionField.mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap M K) B)) ∧
      ∀ γ : ↥(hb.isHW hδ₀).prodSubgroup, ∃ a b : K, a ≠ 0 ∧
        (hb.isHW hδ₀).functionFieldAction hv γ u = algebraMap K _ a * u + algebraMap K _ b ∧
        racl (↥M) ({a, b} : Set K) = racl (↥M) (((hb.isHW hδ₀).val γ).cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, M, iM, Γ, ht, htop, hM, hlift, hΓ, _, _, hcons, hcl, hle, hex⟩ :=
    hb.exists_constructible_slLift hδ₀ hv (by rw [hr])
  let : IsAlgClosed ↥M := iM
  let : UniversalDomain ↥M K := universalDomain_of_isSmall M hM
  have hrank (γ : ↥(hb.isHW hδ₀).prodSubgroup) (m : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K)
      (hm : (hb.isHW hδ₀).IsMoebiusLift hv t γ m) :
      erk ↥M ∅ (range fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ m ij.1 ij.2) =
        erk ↥M ∅ (((hb.isHW hδ₀).val γ).cb : Set K) := by
    have he := congrArg (fun F : IntermediateField ↥M K ↦ erk ↥M ∅ (F : Set K)) (hcl γ m hm)
    have er (S : Set K) : erk ↥M ∅ (racl ↥M S : Set K) = erk ↥M ∅ S := by
      simpa only [empty_union] using erk_racl (↥M) (∅ : Set K) S
    simpa only [er] using he
  have hleΓ : ∀ m ∈ Γ, erk ↥M ∅ (range fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ m ij.1 ij.2) ≤ 2 := by
    intro m hm
    obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := (hΓ m).1 hm
    rw [hrank γ m hγ]
    exact (hle γ).trans_eq hr
  have hrΓ : ∃ m ∈ Γ, erk ↥M ∅ (range fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ m ij.1 ij.2) = 2 := by
    obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := hex
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hlift γ
    exact ⟨m, (hΓ m).2 ⟨γ, hm⟩, (hrank γ m hm).trans (hγ.trans hr)⟩
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := exists_borel_conj_of_constructible_rank_two (k := ↥M) Γ hcons hleΓ hrΓ
  obtain ⟨hu, htop'⟩ := moebiusVal_generator ht htop A
  
  obtain ⟨C, hCfin, hC⟩ := LocusFunctionField.exists_fraction_of_subset (moebiusVal A t)
  obtain ⟨T, hTdef⟩ : ∃ T : Set K, T = (range fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ A ij.1 ij.2) ∪
      (range fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ A⁻¹ ij.1 ij.2) ∪ C := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hT : T.Finite := hTdef ▸ ((finite_range _).union (finite_range _)).union hCfin
  obtain ⟨M', hM'def⟩ : ∃ M' : IntermediateField k K, M' = racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ T) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have iM' : IsAlgClosed ↥M' := hM'def ▸ isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hM' : IsSmall k (M' : Set K) := hM'def ▸ (hM.union (IsSmall.of_finite hT)).racl
  have hTM' : T ⊆ M' := hM'def ▸ fun c hc ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hc)
  have hAM' : ∀ i j, A i j ∈ (M' : Set K) := fun i j ↦
    hTM' (hTdef ▸ Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩))
  have hA'M' : ∀ i j, A⁻¹ i j ∈ (M' : Set K) := fun i j ↦
    hTM' (hTdef ▸ Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩))
  obtain ⟨P, Q, hQ, hPQ⟩ := hC M' fun c hc ↦ hTM' (hTdef ▸ Or.inr hc)
  refine ⟨moebiusVal A t, M', iM', hM', hu, htop', ⟨P, Q, hQ, hPQ⟩, fun γ ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hlift γ
  have hn := (hA m).1 ((hΓ m).2 ⟨γ, hm⟩)
  have hdet : (A * m * A⁻¹) 0 0 * (A * m * A⁻¹) 1 1 = 1 := by
    have h := (A * m * A⁻¹).det_coe
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, hn, mul_zero, sub_zero] at h
    exact h
  refine ⟨_, _, div_ne_zero (left_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one hdet)
    (right_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one hdet),
    functionFieldAction_moebiusVal_of_triangular (hb.isHW hδ₀) hv ht A hm hn, ?_⟩
  
  have hbase : racl k ((M' : Set K) ∪ range fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ m ij.1 ij.2) =
      racl k ((M' : Set K) ∪ (((hb.isHW hδ₀).val γ).cb : Set K)) := by
    rw [hM'def]
    have h := congrArg (fun F : IntermediateField _ K ↦ (F : Set K))
      (racl_eq_of_racl_eq M T (hcl γ m hm))
    simp only [racl_base_coe] at h
    exact SetLike.coe_injective h
  apply SetLike.coe_injective
  rw [racl_base_coe, racl_base_coe, racl_union_affineCoeffs hn,
    racl_union_entries_conj hAM' hA'M' m, hbase]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.exists_affine_generator
statement:
theorem exists_affine_generator {ι κ : Type w} [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    {v : ι → K} {v' : κ → K} {f₀ : Germ k v v'} (hb : f₀.IsHWBij) {δ₀ : Germ k v v}
    (hδ₀ : δ₀ ∈ f₀.diffSet) (hv : erk k ∅ (range v) = 1)
    (hr : erk k ∅ (δ₀.cb : Set K) = 2) :
    ∃ u : LocusFunctionField k v, Transcendental K u ∧
      IntermediateField.adjoin K ({u} : Set (LocusFunctionField k v)) = ⊤ ∧
      ∀ γ : ↥(hb.isHW hδ₀).prodSubgroup, ∃ a b : K, a ≠ 0 ∧
        (hb.isHW hδ₀).functionFieldAction hv γ u = algebraMap K _ a * u + algebraMap K _ b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, _, _, -, hu, htop, -, hcoef⟩ := hb.exists_affine_generator_parameters hδ₀ hv hr
  refine ⟨u, hu, htop, fun γ ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hact, -⟩ := hcoef γ
  exact ⟨a, b, ha, hact⟩

name: GroupConfig.mem_of_forall_algEquiv_fixed
statement:
theorem mem_of_forall_algEquiv_fixed {L : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed (↥L)]
    (hL : IsSmall k (L : Set K)) {x : K} (h : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[↥L] K, σ x = x) : x ∈ L
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_algEquiv_indepOver hL (fun _ : Unit ↦ x)
    (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_singleton x))
  have hfix : (fun _ : Unit ↦ σ x) = fun _ : Unit ↦ x := funext fun _ ↦ h σ
  have hind : IndepOver k (L : Set K) {x} {x} := by
    have h' := hσ
    rw [hfix, range_const] at h'
    exact h'
  have hx : ({x} : Set K) ⊆ (racl k (L : Set K) : Set K) := hind.subset_racl_of_self
  have hL' : racl k (L : Set K) = L := isRAC_iff_racl_eq.1 (isRAC_of_isAlgClosed L)
  rw [hL'] at hx
  exact hx (mem_singleton x)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.map_id
statement: theorem map_id (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (a : ι → K) : (Germ.id a).map σ = Germ.id a
proof:
:= by
  have hF : IsSmall k ((racl k (∅ : Set K) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (IsSmall.of_finite finite_empty).racl
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (∅ : Set K)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have _ := isAlgClosed_map σ (racl k (∅ : Set K))
  have hF' := isSmall_map σ hF
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hF a
  have hy' : IsGenericOver ((racl k (∅ : Set K)).map σ.toAlgHom) a (⇑σ ∘ y) :=
    (isGenericOver_map_iff σ _ a y).2 hy
  refine eq_of_eval_eq hF' (cb_map_le σ (cb_id_le a _)) (cb_id_le a _) hy' ?_
  rw [eval_map _ σ hF (cb_id_le a _) hy, eval_id hF hy, eval_id hF' hy']

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsInverse.symm
statement:
theorem IsInverse.symm {h : Germ k a' a} {g : Germ k a a'} (hi : IsInverse h g) :
    IsInverse g h

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsInverse.unique
statement:
theorem IsInverse.unique {h h' : Germ k a' a} {g : Germ k a a'} (hi : IsInverse h g)
    (hi' : IsInverse h' g) : h = h'
proof:
:= by
  calc h = Germ.comp h (Germ.id a') := (comp_id h).symm
    _ = Germ.comp h (Germ.comp g h') := by rw [hi'.2]
    _ = Germ.comp (Germ.comp h g) h' := (comp_assoc h g h').symm
    _ = Germ.comp (Germ.id a) h' := by rw [hi.1]
    _ = h' := id_comp h'

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsInverse.map
statement:
theorem IsInverse.map {h : Germ k a' a} {g : Germ k a a'} (hi : IsInverse h g)
    (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) : IsInverse (h.map σ) (g.map σ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rw [← comp_map, hi.1, map_id], by rw [← comp_map, hi.2, map_id]⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsInverse.cb_le
statement:
theorem IsInverse.cb_le {h : Germ k a' a} {g : Germ k a a'} (hi : IsInverse h g) :
    h.cb ≤ racl k (g.cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (g.cb : Set K)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hL : IsSmall k ((racl k (g.cb : Set K) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    g.isSmall_cb.racl
  intro x hx
  refine mem_of_forall_algEquiv_fixed hL fun σ ↦ ?_
  
  have hσg : g.map (σ.restrictScalars k) = g :=
    (map_eq_self_iff _ g).2 fun y hy ↦ σ.commutes ⟨y, subset_racl k _ hy⟩
  have hσh : h.map (σ.restrictScalars k) = h := by
    have := hi.map (σ.restrictScalars k)
    rw [hσg] at this
    exact this.unique hi
  exact (map_eq_self_iff (σ.restrictScalars k) h).1 hσh x hx

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsInverse.racl_cb_eq
statement:
theorem IsInverse.racl_cb_eq {h : Germ k a' a} {g : Germ k a a'} (hi : IsInverse h g) :
    racl k (h.cb : Set K) = racl k (g.cb : Set K)
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl hi.cb_le) (racl_le_of_subset_racl hi.symm.cb_le)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsInverse.erk_eq
statement:
theorem IsInverse.erk_eq {h : Germ k a' a} {g : Germ k a a'} (hi : IsInverse h g) :
    erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hF_def⟩ : ∃ F : IntermediateField k K, F = racl k ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ h.cb) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hF : IsSmall k (F : Set K) := hF_def ▸ (g.isSmall_cb.union h.isSmall_cb).racl
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥F := hF_def ▸ isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hcb : g.cb ≤ F := hF_def ▸ subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hcb' : h.cb ≤ F := hF_def ▸ subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hF a
  have hz : IsGenericOver F a' (g.eval F y) := g.isGenericOver_eval hF hcb hy
  
  have hyz : y = h.eval F (g.eval F y) := by
    rw [← comp_eval _ _ hF hcb hcb' hy, hi.1, eval_id hF hy]
  have h1 : range (g.eval F y) ⊆ racl k ((F : Set K) ∪ range y) := by
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact g.eval_mem_racl hF hcb hy j
  have h2 : range y ⊆ racl k ((F : Set K) ∪ range (g.eval F y)) := by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    have hyi : y i = h.eval F (g.eval F y) i := congrFun hyz i
    rw [hyi]
    exact h.eval_mem_racl hF hcb' hz i
  rw [← hy.erk_empty_eq, ← hy.erk_coe_eq, ← hz.erk_empty_eq, ← hz.erk_coe_eq,
    ← erk_union_eq_of_subset_racl k h1, ← erk_union_eq_of_subset_racl k h2, union_comm]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.cb_comp_le_racl
statement:
theorem cb_comp_le_racl {μ : Type*} [Finite μ] {a'' : μ → K} (g' : Germ k a' a'')
    (g : Germ k a a') : (Germ.comp g' g).cb ≤ racl k ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hF_def⟩ : ∃ F : IntermediateField k K, F = racl k ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hF : IsSmall k (F : Set K) := hF_def ▸ (g.isSmall_cb.union g'.isSmall_cb).racl
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥F := hF_def ▸ isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hcb : g.cb ≤ F := hF_def ▸ subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hcb' : g'.cb ≤ F := hF_def ▸ subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
  rw [← hF_def]
  exact cb_comp_le g' g hF hcb hcb'

name: GroupConfig.Germ.cb_le_of_isInverse
statement:
theorem cb_le_of_isInverse {μ : Type*} [Finite μ] {a'' : μ → K} (g' : Germ k a' a'')
    {g : Germ k a a'} {h : Germ k a' a} (hi : IsInverse h g) :
    g'.cb ≤ racl k (((Germ.comp g' g).cb : Set K) ∪ g.cb)
proof:
:= by
  have hg' : g' = Germ.comp (Germ.comp g' g) h := by
    rw [comp_assoc, hi.2, comp_id]
  have hle : (Germ.comp (Germ.comp g' g) h).cb ≤ racl k ((h.cb : Set K) ∪ (Germ.comp g' g).cb) :=
    cb_comp_le_racl (Germ.comp g' g) h
  rw [← hg'] at hle
  have h1 : ((Germ.comp g' g).cb : Set K) ⊆ racl k (((Germ.comp g' g).cb : Set K) ∪ g.cb) :=
    subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have h2 : (h.cb : Set K) ⊆ racl k (((Germ.comp g' g).cb : Set K) ∪ g.cb) :=
    hi.cb_le.trans (racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_right)
  exact hle.trans (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset h2 h1))

name: GroupConfig.Germ.map_eq_map_iff_parameter_eq
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hg
    have hfix : g.map (σ.trans τ.symm) = g := by
      rw [← map_map, hg, map_map]
      have hr : τ.trans τ.symm = AlgEquiv.refl :=
        AlgEquiv.ext fun x ↦ τ.symm_apply_apply x
      rw [hr, map_refl]
    funext i
    have hmem : c i ∈ g.cb := hc ▸ subset_adjoin k _ (mem_range_self i)
    have hi : τ.symm (σ (c i)) = c i := (map_eq_self_iff _ _).1 hfix _ hmem
    exact (τ.apply_symm_apply _).symm.trans (congrArg τ hi)
  · intro heq
    have hle : adjoin k (range c) ≤ fixedBy (σ.trans τ.symm) := by
      refine adjoin_le_iff.2 ?_
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      change τ.symm (σ (c i)) = c i
      have hi : σ (c i) = τ (c i) := congrFun heq i
      rw [hi]
      exact τ.symm_apply_apply _
    have hfix : g.map (σ.trans τ.symm) = g :=
      (map_eq_self_iff _ _).2 fun x hx ↦ hle (hc.symm ▸ hx)
    calc g.map σ = g.map ((σ.trans τ.symm).trans τ) := by
          congr 1
          exact AlgEquiv.ext fun x ↦ (τ.apply_symm_apply (σ x)).symm
      _ = (g.map (σ.trans τ.symm)).map τ := (map_map _ _ _).symm
      _ = g.map τ := congrArg (Germ.map τ) hfix

name: GroupConfig.Germ.existsUnique_orbit_parameter
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, -, hσ⟩ := exists_ambientAutomorphism_of_idealOf_eq (k := k) hp.symm
  have hσc : ⇑σ ∘ c = p := funext hσ
  refine ⟨⟨g.map σ, ⟨σ, rfl⟩⟩, ⟨σ, hσc, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro h ⟨τ, hτc, hτg⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact hτg.symm.trans ((g.map_eq_map_iff_parameter_eq hc τ σ).2 (hτc.trans hσc.symm))

name: GroupConfig.Germ.evalGen_mem_dcl_parameterPair
statement:
private theorem evalGen_mem_dcl_parameterPair (g : Germ k a a') {c : μ → K}
    (hc : adjoin k (range c) = g.cb) {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k a y)
    (hind : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (g.cb : Set K)) (j : κ) :
    g.evalGen y j ∈ dclAdjoin (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) (Sum.elim c y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold dclAdjoin
  refine mem_dcl_iff_forall_fixed.2 fun σ ↦ ?_
  let τ : K ≃ₐ[k] K := σ.restrictScalars k
  have hfixc : ⇑τ ∘ c = c := funext fun i ↦ by
    change σ (c i) = c i
    exact σ.commutes ⟨c i, (mem_restrictScalars k).2
      (subset_adjoin (↥(⊥ : IntermediateField k K)) _
        (mem_range_self (f := Sum.elim c y) (Sum.inl i)))⟩
  have hfixy : ⇑τ ∘ y = y := funext fun i ↦ by
    change σ (y i) = y i
    exact σ.commutes ⟨y i, (mem_restrictScalars k).2
      (subset_adjoin (↥(⊥ : IntermediateField k K)) _
        (mem_range_self (f := Sum.elim c y) (Sum.inr i)))⟩
  have hfixg : g.map τ = g := by
    have he : g.map τ = g.map AlgEquiv.refl :=
      (g.map_eq_map_iff_parameter_eq hc τ AlgEquiv.refl).2 hfixc
    exact he.trans (map_refl g)
  have he := evalGen_map τ g hy hind
  rw [hfixg, hfixy] at he
  exact (congrFun he j).symm

name: GroupConfig.Germ.aeval_map_botEquiv
proof:
:= by
  rw [aeval_def, aeval_def, eval₂_map]
  congr 1
  exact (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq (↥(⊥ : IntermediateField k K)) k K).symm

name: GroupConfig.Germ.exists_orbit_uniformExpression
statement:
theorem exists_orbit_uniformExpression (g : Germ k a a') {c : μ → K}
    (hc : adjoin k (range c) = g.cb) :
    ∃ F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ, ∀ (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (u : ι → K),
      IsGenericOver (racl k (range (⇑σ ∘ c))) a u →
      F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim (⇑σ ∘ c) u) ∧
      F.eval (Sum.elim (⇑σ ∘ c) u) = (g.map σ).evalGen u
proof:
:= by
  have hM : IsSmall k ((racl k (range c) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range c)).racl
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hM a
  have hind : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (g.cb : Set K) :=
    hy.indepOver.mono_right (hc ▸ adjoin_le_racl k (range c))
  obtain ⟨F₀, hF₀, he₀⟩ := exists_quasiRational_of_mem_dclAdjoin
    (g.evalGen_mem_dcl_parameterPair hc hy.isGen hind)
  let F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ := F₀.map (botEquiv k K).toRingHom
  have heval (v : (μ ⊕ ι) → K) : F.eval v = F₀.eval v := by
    funext j
    simp only [F, QuasiRational.eval, QuasiRational.map, aeval_map_botEquiv]
  have hF : F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim c y) := by
    intro j
    simpa only [F, QuasiRational.map, aeval_map_botEquiv] using hF₀ j
  have he : F.eval (Sum.elim c y) = g.evalGen y := (heval _).trans he₀
  refine ⟨F, ?_⟩
  intro σ u hu
  have hyσ : IsGenericOver (racl k (range (⇑σ ∘ c))) a (⇑σ ∘ y) := by
    have h := (isGenericOver_map_iff σ (racl k (range c)) a y).2 hy
    rw [racl_map, ← range_comp] at h
    exact h
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := hyσ.exists_algEquiv hu
  let θ : K ≃ₐ[k] K := σ.trans (ρ.restrictScalars k)
  have hθc : ⇑θ ∘ c = ⇑σ ∘ c := funext fun i ↦ by
    change ρ (σ (c i)) = σ (c i)
    exact ρ.commutes ⟨σ (c i), subset_racl k _
      (mem_range_self (f := ⇑σ ∘ c) i)⟩
  have hθy : ⇑θ ∘ y = u := funext fun i ↦ hρ i
  have hθg : g.map θ = g.map σ :=
    (g.map_eq_map_iff_parameter_eq hc θ σ).2 hθc
  have hsum : ⇑θ ∘ Sum.elim c y = Sum.elim (⇑σ ∘ c) u := by
    funext i
    cases i with
    | inl i => exact congrFun hθc i
    | inr i => exact congrFun hθy i
  constructor
  · rw [← hsum]
    exact (F.isDefinedAt_comp_iff θ _).2 hF
  · rw [← hsum, F.eval_comp θ, he, ← evalGen_map θ g hy.isGen hind, hθg, hθy]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.exists_orbit_admissibleFamily
statement:
theorem exists_orbit_admissibleFamily (g : Germ k a a') {c : μ → K}
    (hc : adjoin k (range c) = g.cb) :
    ∃ F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ, ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K,
      ∃ hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' (⇑σ ∘ c), F.parameterGerm hu = g.map σ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := g.exists_orbit_uniformExpression hc
  refine ⟨F, fun σ ↦ ?_⟩
  have hcσ : adjoin k (range (⇑σ ∘ c)) = (g.map σ).cb := by
    rw [cb_map, ← hc, adjoin_map, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, range_comp]
  have hcb : (g.map σ).cb ≤ racl k (range (⇑σ ∘ c)) := by
    rw [← hcσ]
    exact adjoin_le_racl k _
  have hM : IsSmall k ((racl k (range (⇑σ ∘ c)) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range _)).racl
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (range (⇑σ ∘ c))) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' (⇑σ ∘ c) := by
    intro y hy
    refine ⟨(hF σ y hy).1, ?_⟩
    rw [(hF σ y hy).2, (g.map σ).evalGen_eq hM hcb hy]
    exact (g.map σ).isGenericOver_eval hM hcb hy
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hM a
  refine ⟨hu, eq_of_eval_eq hM (F.cb_parameterGerm_le hu) hcb hy ?_⟩
  exact (F.eval_parameterGerm hu hy).trans
    ((hF σ y hy).2.trans ((g.map σ).evalGen_eq hM hcb hy))

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsInvertible.map
statement:
theorem IsInvertible.map {g : Germ k a a'} (hg : IsInvertible g) (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) :
    IsInvertible (g.map σ)
proof:
:=
  let ⟨h, hi⟩ := hg
  ⟨h.map σ, hi.map σ⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.isInvertible_of_mem_orbit
statement:
theorem isInvertible_of_mem_orbit {g₀ g : Germ k a a'} (h₀ : IsInvertible g₀)
    (hg : g ∈ orbit g₀) : IsInvertible g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := hg
  exact h₀.map σ

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsInverse.comp
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [comp_assoc, ← comp_assoc h' g' g, hi'.1, id_comp, hi.1]
  · rw [comp_assoc, ← comp_assoc g h h', hi.2, id_comp, hi'.2]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.comp_diff
statement: theorem comp_diff : Germ.comp f₁ (Germ.comp g₁ f₂) = f₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comp_assoc, hg₁.2, id_comp]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.cb_diff_le
statement: theorem cb_diff_le : (Germ.comp g₁ f₂).cb ≤ racl k ((f₁.cb : Set K) ∪ f₂.cb)
proof:
:= by
  refine (cb_comp_le_racl g₁ f₂).trans (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset ?_ ?_))
  · exact subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
  · exact hg₁.cb_le.trans (racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_left)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.cb_right_le_diff
statement: theorem cb_right_le_diff : f₂.cb ≤ racl k ((f₁.cb : Set K) ∪ (Germ.comp g₁ f₂).cb)
proof:
:= by
  have := cb_comp_le_racl f₁ (Germ.comp g₁ f₂)
  rw [comp_diff hg₁] at this
  exact this.trans (racl_mono (k := k) (union_comm _ _).le)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.cb_left_le_diff
statement:
theorem cb_left_le_diff (hf₂ : IsInvertible f₂) :
    f₁.cb ≤ racl k ((f₂.cb : Set K) ∪ (Germ.comp g₁ f₂).cb)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g₂, hg₂⟩ := hf₂
  have h1 : g₁.cb ≤ racl k (((Germ.comp g₁ f₂).cb : Set K) ∪ f₂.cb) :=
    cb_le_of_isInverse g₁ hg₂
  exact hg₁.symm.cb_le.trans
    (racl_le_of_subset_racl (h1.trans (racl_mono (k := k) (union_comm _ _).le)))

name: GroupConfig.Germ.erk_diff_eq
statement:
theorem erk_diff_eq :
    erk k (f₁.cb : Set K) ((Germ.comp g₁ f₂).cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (f₂.cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [erk_eq_of_subset_racl (cb_diff_le hg₁) (cb_right_le_diff hg₁)]
  have := erk_cb_eq_of_indepOver hind.symm
  rwa [empty_union] at this

name: GroupConfig.Germ.erk_diff_eq'
statement:
theorem erk_diff_eq' (hf₂ : IsInvertible f₂) :
    erk k (f₂.cb : Set K) ((Germ.comp g₁ f₂).cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (f₁.cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [erk_eq_of_subset_racl ((cb_diff_le hg₁).trans (racl_mono (k := k) (union_comm _ _).le))
    (cb_left_le_diff hg₁ hf₂)]
  have := erk_cb_eq_of_indepOver hind
  rwa [empty_union] at this

name: GroupConfig.Germ.erk_cb_le_erk_diff
statement:
theorem erk_cb_le_erk_diff :
    erk k ∅ (f₂.cb : Set K) ≤ erk k ∅ ((Germ.comp g₁ f₂).cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← erk_diff_eq hg₁ hind]
  exact erk_base_mono k (empty_subset _) _

name: GroupConfig.Germ.indepOver_diff_left_iff
statement:
theorem indepOver_diff_left_iff :
    IndepOver k ∅ ((Germ.comp g₁ f₂).cb : Set K) f₁.cb ↔
      erk k ∅ ((Germ.comp g₁ f₂).cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (f₂.cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← erk_cb_eq_of_indepOver h, empty_union, erk_diff_eq hg₁ hind]
  · intro h
    refine indepOver_cb_of_erk_eq _ ?_
    rw [empty_union, erk_diff_eq hg₁ hind, h]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.indepOver_diff_right_iff
statement:
theorem indepOver_diff_right_iff (hf₂ : IsInvertible f₂) :
    IndepOver k ∅ ((Germ.comp g₁ f₂).cb : Set K) f₂.cb ↔
      erk k ∅ ((Germ.comp g₁ f₂).cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (f₁.cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← erk_cb_eq_of_indepOver h, empty_union, erk_diff_eq' hg₁ hind hf₂]
  · intro h
    refine indepOver_cb_of_erk_eq _ ?_
    rw [empty_union, erk_diff_eq' hg₁ hind hf₂, h]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.diffSet_nonempty
statement: theorem diffSet_nonempty (hf₀ : IsInvertible f₀) : (diffSet f₀).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f₂, hf₂, hind⟩ := exists_mem_orbit_indepOver f₀ f₀.isSmall_cb
  obtain ⟨g₀, hg₀⟩ := hf₀
  exact ⟨_, f₀, self_mem_orbit f₀, f₂, hf₂, g₀, hg₀, hind.symm, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.isInvertible_of_mem_diffSet
statement:
theorem isInvertible_of_mem_diffSet (hf₀ : IsInvertible f₀) {δ : Germ k a a}
    (hδ : δ ∈ diffSet f₀) : IsInvertible δ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f₁, h₁, f₂, h₂, g₁, hg₁, -, rfl⟩ := hδ
  obtain ⟨g₂, hg₂⟩ := isInvertible_of_mem_orbit hf₀ h₂
  exact ⟨Germ.comp g₂ f₁, hg₂.comp hg₁.symm⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.inv_mem_diffSet
statement:
theorem inv_mem_diffSet (hf₀ : IsInvertible f₀) {δ δ' : Germ k a a} (hδ : δ ∈ diffSet f₀)
    (hi : IsInverse δ' δ) : δ' ∈ diffSet f₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f₁, h₁, f₂, h₂, g₁, hg₁, hind, rfl⟩ := hδ
  obtain ⟨g₂, hg₂⟩ := isInvertible_of_mem_orbit hf₀ h₂
  rw [← (hg₂.comp hg₁.symm).unique hi]
  exact ⟨f₂, h₂, f₁, h₁, g₂, hg₂, hind.symm, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.map_mem_diffSet
statement:
theorem map_mem_diffSet {δ : Germ k a a} (hδ : δ ∈ diffSet f₀) (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) :
    δ.map σ ∈ diffSet f₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f₁, h₁, f₂, h₂, g₁, hg₁, hind, rfl⟩ := hδ
  refine ⟨f₁.map σ, map_mem_orbit h₁ σ, f₂.map σ, map_mem_orbit h₂ σ, g₁.map σ, hg₁.map σ,
    ?_, comp_map σ g₁ f₂⟩
  have := hind.image σ
  rwa [image_empty, ← AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, ← coe_map, ← coe_map, ← cb_map, ← cb_map]
    at this

name: GroupConfig.Germ.diffSet_eq_orbit
statement:
theorem diffSet_eq_orbit {δ₀ : Germ k a a} (hδ₀ : δ₀ ∈ diffSet f₀) :
    diffSet f₀ = orbit δ₀
proof:
:= by
  ext δ
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f₁', h₁', f₂', h₂', g₁', hg₁', hind', rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨f₁, h₁, f₂, h₂, g₁, hg₁, hind, rfl⟩ := hδ₀
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ : ∃ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K, f₁.map σ = f₁' := by
      rw [← orbit_eq_of_mem h₁] at h₁'
      exact h₁'
    have hind₂ : IndepOver k ∅ ((f₂.map σ).cb : Set K) f₁'.cb := by
      have := hind.symm.image σ
      rwa [image_empty, ← AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, ← coe_map, ← coe_map, ← cb_map, ← cb_map,
        hσ] at this
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ :=
      exists_algEquiv_of_mem_orbit (map_mem_orbit h₂ σ) h₂' f₁'.isSmall_cb hind₂ hind'.symm
    have hfix : f₁'.map (τ.restrictScalars k) = f₁' := by
      refine (map_eq_self_iff _ _).2 fun x hx ↦ ?_
      change τ x = x
      exact τ.commutes ⟨x, subset_racl k _ hx⟩
    have hinv : IsInverse ((g₁.map σ).map (τ.restrictScalars k)) f₁' := by
      have := (hg₁.map σ).map (τ.restrictScalars k)
      rwa [hσ, hfix] at this
    refine ⟨σ.trans (τ.restrictScalars k), ?_⟩
    change (Germ.comp g₁ f₂).map (σ.trans (τ.restrictScalars k)) = Germ.comp g₁' f₂'
    rw [← map_map, comp_map, comp_map, hτ, hinv.unique hg₁']
  · rintro ⟨σ, rfl⟩
    exact map_mem_diffSet hδ₀ σ

name: GroupConfig.Germ.erk_cb_eq_of_mem_diffSet
statement:
theorem erk_cb_eq_of_mem_diffSet {δ δ' : Germ k a a} (hδ : δ ∈ diffSet f₀)
    (hδ' : δ' ∈ diffSet f₀) : erk k ∅ (δ.cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (δ'.cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [diffSet_eq_orbit hδ'] at hδ
  exact erk_cb_eq_of_mem_orbit hδ

name: GroupConfig.Germ.erk_cb_le_of_mem_diffSet
statement:
theorem erk_cb_le_of_mem_diffSet {δ : Germ k a a} (hδ : δ ∈ diffSet f₀) :
    erk k ∅ (f₀.cb : Set K) ≤ erk k ∅ (δ.cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f₁, h₁, f₂, h₂, g₁, hg₁, hind, rfl⟩ := hδ
  rw [← erk_cb_eq_of_mem_orbit h₂]
  exact erk_cb_le_erk_diff hg₁ hind

name: GroupConfig.transcendental_iff_not_mem_racl
statement:
theorem transcendental_iff_not_mem_racl (M : IntermediateField k K) (x : K) :
    Transcendental (↥M) x ↔ x ∉ racl k (M : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_racl_iff k, adjoin_self]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: GroupConfig.erk_singleton_eq_one
statement:
theorem erk_singleton_eq_one {C : Set K} {x : K} (h : x ∉ racl k C) :
    erk k C ({x} : Set K) = 1
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm ((erk_le_encard k C _).trans (by simp))
    (Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 fun h0 ↦ h ((erk_eq_zero_iff k).1 h0 (mem_singleton x)))

name: GroupConfig.not_mem_racl_of_indepOver
statement:
theorem not_mem_racl_of_indepOver {x : K} {B : Set K} (hx : x ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    (h : IndepOver k ∅ ({x} : Set K) B) : x ∉ racl k B
proof:
:= by
  intro hxB
  have h1 := h.erk_eq (subset_refl _) (finite_singleton x)
  rw [empty_union, erk_eq_zero_of_subset_racl k (singleton_subset_iff.2 hxB)] at h1
  exact hx ((erk_eq_zero_iff k).1 h1.symm (mem_singleton x))

name: GroupConfig.range_fin_one
statement: private theorem range_fin_one {α : Type*} (y : Fin 1 → α) : range y = {y 0}
proof: := range_unique

name: GroupConfig.Germ.idealOf_eq_bot_iff
statement:
private theorem idealOf_eq_bot_iff (M : Type*) [Field M] [Algebra M K] (y : Fin 1 → K) :
    idealOf M y = ⊥ ↔ Transcendental M (y 0)
proof:
:=
  (RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot _).symm.trans algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff

name: GroupConfig.Germ.idealOf_eq_bot
statement: private theorem idealOf_eq_bot (hx₀ : x₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) : idealOf k ![x₀] = ⊥
proof:
:=
  (idealOf_eq_bot_iff k ![x₀]).2 fun h ↦ hx₀ (mem_racl_empty_of_isAlgebraic h)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.isGenericOver_translation_iff
statement:
theorem isGenericOver_translation_iff (hx₀ : x₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    (M : IntermediateField k K) (y : Fin 1 → K) :
    IsGenericOver M ![x₀] y ↔ Transcendental (↥M) (y 0)
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsGenericOver
  rw [idealOf_eq_bot hx₀, Ideal.map_bot]
  exact idealOf_eq_bot_iff (↥M) y

name: GroupConfig.Germ.isGen_translation_iff
statement:
theorem isGen_translation_iff (hx₀ : x₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) (y : Fin 1 → K) :
    IsGen k ![x₀] y ↔ y 0 ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsGen
  rw [idealOf_eq_bot hx₀, idealOf_eq_bot_iff k y]
  exact not_congr ⟨mem_racl_empty_of_isAlgebraic, isAlgebraic_of_mem_racl_empty⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.translationExpr_eval
statement:
private theorem translationExpr_eval (c : K) (y : Fin 1 → K) :
    (translationExpr (k := k) c).eval y = fun _ ↦ y 0 + c
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  simp [translationExpr, QuasiRational.eval_apply, pRoot_zero]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.mk_eq_translation
proof:
:=
  Quotient.sound fun y hy ↦ (h y hy).trans (translationExpr_eval c y).symm

name: GroupConfig.Germ.translation_injective
statement:
theorem translation_injective (hx₀ : x₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) :
    Function.Injective (translation (k := k) hx₀)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  have he : (translationRep hx₀ a).Equivalent (translationRep hx₀ b) := Quotient.exact h
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver (k := k)
    (((IsSmall.of_finite (finite_singleton a)).racl.union
      (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_singleton b)).racl).racl) ![x₀]
  have h2 : (translationExpr (k := k) a).eval y = (translationExpr b).eval y := he y hy
  rw [translationExpr_eval, translationExpr_eval] at h2
  exact add_left_cancel (congrFun h2 0)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.translation_mul
statement:
theorem translation_mul (hx₀ : x₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) (c d : K) :
    translation hx₀ c * translation hx₀ d = translation hx₀ (c + d)
proof:
:= by
  change Germ.comp (⟦translationRep hx₀ c⟧ : Germ k ![x₀] ![x₀]) ⟦translationRep hx₀ d⟧ = _
  rw [comp_mk]
  refine mk_eq_translation hx₀ fun y hy ↦ ?_
  rw [Representative.comp_eval _ _ (hy.of_le fun x hx ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl hx))]
  change (translationExpr c).eval ((translationExpr d).eval y) = _
  rw [translationExpr_eval, translationExpr_eval]
  funext j
  ring

name: GroupConfig.Germ.translation_zero
statement: theorem translation_zero (hx₀ : x₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) : translation hx₀ (0 : K) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change translation hx₀ (0 : K) = (⟦Representative.id ![x₀]⟧ : Germ k ![x₀] ![x₀])
  refine (mk_eq_translation hx₀ fun y _ ↦ ?_).symm
  change (QuasiRational.id _ (Fin 1)).eval y = _
  rw [QuasiRational.id_eval]
  funext j
  fin_cases j
  simp

name: GroupConfig.Germ.map_translation
statement:
theorem map_translation (hx₀ : x₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (c : K) :
    (translation hx₀ c).map σ = translation hx₀ (σ c)
proof:
:= by
  change Germ.map σ (⟦translationRep hx₀ c⟧ : Germ k ![x₀] ![x₀]) = _
  rw [map_mk]
  refine mk_eq_translation hx₀ fun y _ ↦ ?_
  funext j
  simp [Representative.map, translationRep, translationExpr, QuasiRational.eval_apply,
    QuasiRational.map, pRoot_zero, intermediateFieldMap_apply_coe]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.cb_translation
statement:
theorem cb_translation (hx₀ : x₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) (c : K) :
    (translation hx₀ c).cb = adjoin k ({c} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver (k := k)
    (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_singleton c)).racl ![x₀]
  have hy' : IsGenericOver (translationRep hx₀ c).M ![x₀] y := hy
  have hgp : (translationRep hx₀ c).graphPoint y =
      ![y 0, 1 * y 0 + c] ∘ (finSumFinEquiv : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1 ≃ Fin 2) := by
    have h1 : (translationRep hx₀ c).graphPoint y = Sum.elim y fun _ ↦ y 0 + c :=
      congrArg (Sum.elim y) (translationExpr_eval c y)
    rw [h1]
    funext i
    rcases i with i | i <;> fin_cases i
    · rfl
    · change y 0 + c = 1 * y 0 + c
      rw [one_mul]
  change Germ.cb (⟦translationRep hx₀ c⟧ : Germ k ![x₀] ![x₀]) = _
  rw [cb_mk_eq_canonicalBase _ hy']
  have hc : c ∈ (translationRep hx₀ c).M := subset_racl k ({c} : Set K) (mem_singleton c)
  rw [hgp, canonicalBase_comp_equiv, canonicalBase_affineLine (translationRep hx₀ c).M
    (one_mem _) hc ((isGenericOver_translation_iff hx₀ _ y).1 hy')]
  refine le_antisymm (adjoin_le_iff.2 ?_) (adjoin_le_iff.2 ?_)
  · rintro x (rfl | rfl)
    · exact one_mem _
    · exact subset_adjoin k _ rfl
  · rintro x rfl
    exact subset_adjoin k _ (Or.inr rfl)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.evalGen_translation
proof:
:=
  (evalGen_mk_eq (translationRep hx₀ c)
    (hy.isGenericOver_racl (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_singleton c)) hind)).trans
      (translationExpr_eval c y)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.orbit_translation
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨σ, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨σ c₀, fun h ↦ hc₀ ?_, (map_translation hx₀ σ c₀).symm⟩
    exact mem_racl_empty_of_isAlgebraic ((isAlgebraic_algHom_iff σ.toAlgHom σ.injective).1
      (isAlgebraic_of_mem_racl_empty h))
  · rintro ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
    have hgen (d : K) (hd : d ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) :
        IsGenericOver (racl k (∅ : Set K)) ![x₀] ![d] := by
      rw [isGenericOver_translation_iff hx₀, transcendental_iff_not_mem_racl, racl_racl]
      exact hd
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := (hgen c₀ hc₀).exists_algEquiv (hgen c hc)
    refine ⟨σ.restrictScalars k, ?_⟩
    change (translation hx₀ c₀).map (σ.restrictScalars k) = _
    rw [map_translation]
    exact congrArg _ (by simpa using hσ 0)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.translation_mem_orbit
proof:
:= by
  rw [orbit_translation hx₀ hc₀]
  exact ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.isInverse_translation
statement:
theorem isInverse_translation (hx₀ : x₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) (c : K) :
    IsInverse (translation hx₀ (-c)) (translation hx₀ c)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · change translation hx₀ (-c) * translation hx₀ c = 1
    rw [translation_mul, neg_add_cancel, translation_zero]
  · change translation hx₀ c * translation hx₀ (-c) = 1
    rw [translation_mul, add_neg_cancel, translation_zero]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.isHW_translation
proof:
:= isUnit_iff.2 ⟨_, isInverse_translation hx₀ c₀⟩
  trans g hg y hy hind := by
    rw [orbit_translation hx₀ hc₀] at hg
    obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := hg
    rw [cb_translation] at hind
    have hyc : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) ({c} : Set K) :=
      hind.mono_right (subset_adjoin k _)
    rw [evalGen_translation hx₀ c hy hyc, range_const, range_fin_one]
    have hy0 : y 0 ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) := (isGen_translation_iff hx₀ y).1 hy
    have hcy : c ∉ racl k ({y 0} : Set K) := by
      refine not_mem_racl_of_indepOver hc ?_
      rw [range_fin_one] at hyc
      exact hyc.symm
    have hsum : y 0 + c ∉ racl k ({y 0} : Set K) := fun h ↦
      hcy (by simpa using sub_mem h (subset_racl k ({y 0} : Set K) (mem_singleton (y 0))))
    refine indepOver_of_erk_eq (finite_singleton _) ?_
    rw [empty_union, erk_singleton_eq_one hsum,
      erk_singleton_eq_one fun h ↦ hsum (racl_mono (k := k) (empty_subset _) h)]
  inv g hg h hi := by
    rw [orbit_translation hx₀ hc₀] at hg
    obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := hg
    rw [hi.unique (isInverse_translation hx₀ c)]
    exact translation_mem_orbit hx₀ hc₀ fun h ↦ hc (by simpa using neg_mem h)
  comp g₁ hg₁ g₂ hg₂ hind := by
    rw [orbit_translation hx₀ hc₀] at hg₁ hg₂
    obtain ⟨c₁, hc₁, rfl⟩ := hg₁
    obtain ⟨c₂, hc₂, rfl⟩ := hg₂
    rw [cb_translation, cb_translation] at hind
    have h12 : c₁ ∉ racl k ({c₂} : Set K) := not_mem_racl_of_indepOver hc₁
      ((hind.mono_left (subset_adjoin k _)).mono_right (subset_adjoin k _))
    rw [translation_mul]
    refine translation_mem_orbit hx₀ hc₀ fun h ↦ h12 ?_
    have h' := sub_mem (racl_mono (k := k) (empty_subset ({c₂} : Set K)) h)
      (subset_racl k ({c₂} : Set K) (mem_singleton c₂))
    simpa using h'

name: GroupConfig.Germ.prodSet_translation
proof:
:= by
  ext γ
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g₁, hg₁, g₂, hg₂, rfl⟩
    rw [orbit_translation hx₀ hc₀] at hg₁ hg₂
    obtain ⟨c₁, -, rfl⟩ := hg₁
    obtain ⟨c₂, -, rfl⟩ := hg₂
    exact ⟨c₁ + c₂, (translation_mul hx₀ c₁ c₂).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver (k := k)
      (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_singleton a)).racl ![x₀]
    have hya : y 0 ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K) := by
      have h := (isGenericOver_translation_iff hx₀ _ y).1 hy
      rwa [transcendental_iff_not_mem_racl, racl_racl] at h
    have ha : a ∈ racl k ({a} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (mem_singleton a)
    refine ⟨translation hx₀ (a + y 0), translation_mem_orbit hx₀ hc₀ fun h ↦ hya ?_,
      translation hx₀ (-y 0), translation_mem_orbit hx₀ hc₀ fun h ↦ hya ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa using sub_mem (racl_mono (k := k) (empty_subset ({a} : Set K)) h) ha
    · simpa using neg_mem (racl_mono (k := k) (empty_subset ({a} : Set K)) h)
    · rw [translation_mul, add_neg_cancel_right]

name: GroupConfig.pRoot_zero
statement: theorem pRoot_zero [PerfectField K] (x : K) : pRoot K 0 x = x
proof:
:=
  pRoot_eq_of_pow_eq (by simp)

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.id_isDefinedAt
statement:
theorem QuasiRational.id_isDefinedAt {L : Type*} [Field L] [PerfectField K] [Algebra L K]
    (u : ι → K) : (QuasiRational.id L ι).IsDefinedAt u
proof:
:= fun _ ↦ by
  simp [QuasiRational.id]

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.id_eval
statement:
theorem QuasiRational.id_eval {L : Type*} [Field L] [PerfectField K] [Algebra L K] (u : ι → K) :
    (QuasiRational.id L ι).eval u = u
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp [QuasiRational.eval, QuasiRational.id, pRoot_zero]

name: GroupConfig.isAlgClosed_map
statement:
theorem isAlgClosed_map (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (F : IntermediateField k K) [IsAlgClosed (↥F)] :
    IsAlgClosed ↥(F.map σ.toAlgHom)
proof:
:=
  IsAlgClosed.of_ringEquiv (↥F) _ (intermediateFieldMap σ F).toRingEquiv

name: GroupConfig.isSmall_map
statement:
theorem isSmall_map (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) {F : IntermediateField k K} (hF : IsSmall k (F : Set K)) :
    IsSmall k ((F.map σ.toAlgHom : IntermediateField k K) : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsSmall at hF ⊢
  rwa [coe_map, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, ← image_empty ⇑σ, erk_image]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.cb_map_le
statement:
theorem cb_map_le (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) {g : Germ k a a'} {F : IntermediateField k K} (h : g.cb ≤ F) :
    (g.map σ).cb ≤ F.map σ.toAlgHom
proof:
:= by
  rw [cb_map]
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨x, h hx, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.cb_id_le
statement:
theorem cb_id_le (a : ι → K) (F : IntermediateField k K) [IsAlgClosed (↥F)] :
    (Germ.id a).cb ≤ F
proof:
:=
  (cb_mk_le _).trans (racl_le_of_isAlgClosed (empty_subset _))

name: GroupConfig.Germ.eval_id
statement:
theorem eval_id {F : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed (↥F)] (hF : IsSmall k (F : Set K))
    {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGenericOver F a y) : (Germ.id a).eval F y = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hFM, hind⟩ :=
    (Germ.id a).exists_rep hF (cb_id_le a F) (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range y))
  have _ := r.isAlgClosed
  have hyM : IsGenericOver r.M a y :=
    (hy.isGenericOver_iff_indepOver hF r.isSmall hFM).2 hind.symm
  have heq : r.Equivalent (Representative.id a) := Quotient.exact hr
  have hM : racl k ((r.M : Set K) ∪ ((racl k (∅ : Set K) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K)) =
      r.M :=
    le_antisymm (racl_le_of_isAlgClosed
      (union_subset le_rfl (racl_le_of_isAlgClosed (empty_subset _))))
      (subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _))
  rw [← hr, eval_eq_rep r hF (by rw [hr]; exact cb_id_le a F) hFM hyM,
    heq y (by
      change IsGenericOver (racl k ((r.M : Set K) ∪ ((racl k (∅ : Set K) :
        IntermediateField k K) : Set K))) a y
      rw [hM]
      exact hyM)]
  exact QuasiRational.id_eval y

name: GroupConfig.Germ.comp_id
statement: theorem comp_id (g : Germ k a a') : Germ.comp g (Germ.id a) = g
proof:
:= by
  have hF : IsSmall k ((racl k (g.cb : Set K) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    g.isSmall_cb.racl
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (g.cb : Set K)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hcb : g.cb ≤ racl k (g.cb : Set K) := subset_racl k _
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hF a
  refine eq_of_eval_eq hF (cb_comp_le _ _ hF (cb_id_le a _) hcb) hcb hy ?_
  rw [comp_eval _ _ hF (cb_id_le a _) hcb hy, eval_id hF hy]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.id_comp
statement: theorem id_comp (g : Germ k a a') : Germ.comp (Germ.id a') g = g
proof:
:= by
  have hF : IsSmall k ((racl k (g.cb : Set K) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    g.isSmall_cb.racl
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (g.cb : Set K)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hcb : g.cb ≤ racl k (g.cb : Set K) := subset_racl k _
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hF a
  refine eq_of_eval_eq hF (cb_comp_le _ _ hF hcb (cb_id_le a' _)) hcb hy ?_
  rw [comp_eval _ _ hF hcb (cb_id_le a' _) hy, eval_id hF (g.isGenericOver_eval hF hcb hy)]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.comp_assoc
statement:
theorem comp_assoc (g'' : Germ k a'' a''') (g' : Germ k a' a'') (g : Germ k a a') :
    Germ.comp (Germ.comp g'' g') g = Germ.comp g'' (Germ.comp g' g)
proof:
:= by
  have hF : IsSmall k ((racl k ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb ∪ g''.cb) : IntermediateField k K) :
      Set K) :=
    ((g.isSmall_cb.union g'.isSmall_cb).union g''.isSmall_cb).racl
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb ∪ g''.cb)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hcb : g.cb ≤ racl k ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb ∪ g''.cb) :=
    (subset_union_left.trans subset_union_left).trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hcb' : g'.cb ≤ racl k ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb ∪ g''.cb) :=
    (subset_union_right.trans subset_union_left).trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hcb'' : g''.cb ≤ racl k ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb ∪ g''.cb) :=
    subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hF a
  refine eq_of_eval_eq hF (cb_comp_le _ _ hF hcb (cb_comp_le _ _ hF hcb' hcb''))
    (cb_comp_le _ _ hF (cb_comp_le _ _ hF hcb hcb') hcb'') hy ?_
  rw [comp_eval _ _ hF hcb (cb_comp_le _ _ hF hcb' hcb'') hy,
    comp_eval _ _ hF hcb' hcb'' (g.isGenericOver_eval hF hcb hy),
    comp_eval _ _ hF (cb_comp_le _ _ hF hcb hcb') hcb'' hy, comp_eval _ _ hF hcb hcb' hy]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.comp_map
statement:
theorem comp_map (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (g' : Germ k a' a'') (g : Germ k a a') :
    (Germ.comp g' g).map σ = Germ.comp (g'.map σ) (g.map σ)
proof:
:= by
  have hF : IsSmall k ((racl k ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (g.isSmall_cb.union g'.isSmall_cb).racl
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hcb : g.cb ≤ racl k ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb) := subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hcb' : g'.cb ≤ racl k ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb) :=
    subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hcomp := cb_comp_le g' g hF hcb hcb'
  have _ := isAlgClosed_map σ (racl k ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb))
  have hF' := isSmall_map σ hF
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hF a
  have hy' : IsGenericOver ((racl k ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb)).map σ.toAlgHom) a (⇑σ ∘ y) :=
    (isGenericOver_map_iff σ _ a y).2 hy
  refine eq_of_eval_eq hF' (cb_map_le σ hcomp)
    (cb_comp_le _ _ hF' (cb_map_le σ hcb) (cb_map_le σ hcb')) hy' ?_
  rw [eval_map _ σ hF hcomp hy, comp_eval _ _ hF hcb hcb' hy,
    comp_eval _ _ hF' (cb_map_le σ hcb) (cb_map_le σ hcb') hy', eval_map g σ hF hcb hy,
    eval_map g' σ hF hcb' (g.isGenericOver_eval hF hcb hy)]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.Translation.translation_mem_prodSet
statement:
theorem translation_mem_prodSet (hx₀ : x₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    (hc₀ : c₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) (a : K) :
    translation hx₀ a ∈ IsHW.prodSet (translation hx₀ c₀)
proof:
:=
  (Set.ext_iff.1 (prodSet_translation hx₀ hc₀) _).2 ⟨a, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.Translation.translation_translationParam
statement:
theorem translation_translationParam (hx₀ : x₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    (hc₀ : c₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) {γ : Germ k ![x₀] ![x₀]}
    (hγ : γ ∈ IsHW.prodSet (translation hx₀ c₀)) :
    translation hx₀ (translationParam hx₀ hc₀ hγ) = γ
proof:
:=
  ((Set.ext_iff.1 (prodSet_translation hx₀ hc₀) γ).1 hγ).choose_spec

name: GroupConfig.Germ.Translation.translationParam_eq
proof:
:=
  translation_injective hx₀ ((translation_translationParam hx₀ hc₀ hγ).trans h)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.Translation.evalGen_mul_translation
proof:
:= by
  rw [translation_mul]
  refine evalGen_translation hx₀ (c + a) hy ?_
  have hca : c + a ∉ racl k (range y) := fun h ↦ hc (by
    have h' := sub_mem (racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_right h)
      (subset_racl k _ (Or.inl (mem_singleton a) : a ∈ ({a} : Set K) ∪ range y))
    simpa using h')
  refine IndepOver.symm (indepOver_of_erk_eq (finite_singleton _) ?_)
  rw [empty_union, erk_singleton_eq_one hca,
    erk_singleton_eq_one fun h ↦ hca (racl_mono (k := k) (empty_subset _) h)]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.Translation.rel_iff_pairValue_eq
statement:
theorem rel_iff_pairValue_eq (hx₀ : x₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) (hc₀ : c₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    (p q : Pair (translation hx₀ c₀)) :
    p.Rel q ↔ pairValue hx₀ hc₀ p = pairValue hx₀ hc₀ q
proof:
:= by
  have hpa := (translation_translationParam hx₀ hc₀ p.mem).symm
  have hqb := (translation_translationParam hx₀ hc₀ q.mem).symm
  have hmem {r : Pair (translation hx₀ c₀)} {d : K} (hd : r.γ = translation hx₀ d) :
      ({d} : Set K) ∪ range r.pt ⊆ r.base := by
    refine union_subset (singleton_subset_iff.2 (r.cb_subset_base ?_)) r.range_subset_base
    rw [hd, cb_translation]
    exact subset_adjoin k _ rfl
  have key : ∀ h ∈ orbit (translation hx₀ c₀),
      IndepOver k ∅ (h.cb : Set K) (p.base ∪ q.base) →
        ((h * p.γ).evalGen p.pt = (h * q.γ).evalGen q.pt ↔
          pairValue hx₀ hc₀ p = pairValue hx₀ hc₀ q) := by
    intro h hh hind
    rw [orbit_translation hx₀ hc₀] at hh
    obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := hh
    rw [cb_translation] at hind
    have hcB : c ∉ racl k (p.base ∪ q.base) :=
      not_mem_racl_of_indepOver hc (hind.mono_left (subset_adjoin k _))
    conv_lhs => rw [hpa, hqb]
    rw [evalGen_mul_translation hx₀ p.isGen
        fun h ↦ hcB (racl_mono (k := k) ((hmem hpa).trans subset_union_left) h),
      evalGen_mul_translation hx₀ q.isGen
        fun h ↦ hcB (racl_mono (k := k) ((hmem hqb).trans subset_union_right) h)]
    unfold pairValue
    constructor
    · intro he
      linear_combination congrFun he 0
    · intro he
      funext j
      linear_combination he
  constructor
  · intro hr
    obtain ⟨h, hh, hind⟩ := exists_mem_orbit_indepOver (translation hx₀ c₀)
      (p.isSmall_base.union q.isSmall_base)
    exact (key h hh hind).1 (hr h hh hind)
  · intro hv h hh hind
    exact (key h hh hind).2 hv

name: GroupConfig.Germ.Translation.spaceEquiv_ofPair
statement:
theorem spaceEquiv_ofPair (hx₀ : x₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) (hc₀ : c₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    (p : Pair (translation hx₀ c₀)) {a : K} (ha : p.γ = translation hx₀ a) :
    spaceEquiv hx₀ hc₀ ((isHW_translation hx₀ hc₀).ofPair p) = a + p.pt 0
proof:
:= by
  change translationParam hx₀ hc₀ p.mem + p.pt 0 = _
  rw [translationParam_eq hx₀ hc₀ p.mem ha]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.Translation.ofPair_eq_ofPair_iff_add
statement:
theorem ofPair_eq_ofPair_iff_add (hx₀ : x₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    (hc₀ : c₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) (p q : Pair (translation hx₀ c₀)) {a b : K}
    (ha : p.γ = translation hx₀ a) (hb : q.γ = translation hx₀ b) :
    (isHW_translation hx₀ hc₀).ofPair p = (isHW_translation hx₀ hc₀).ofPair q ↔
      a + p.pt 0 = b + q.pt 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [(isHW_translation hx₀ hc₀).ofPair_eq_ofPair, rel_iff_pairValue_eq hx₀ hc₀]
  unfold pairValue
  rw [translationParam_eq hx₀ hc₀ p.mem ha, translationParam_eq hx₀ hc₀ q.mem hb]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.Translation.spaceEquiv_iota
statement:
theorem spaceEquiv_iota (hx₀ : x₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) (hc₀ : c₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    {y : Fin 1 → K} (hy : IsGen k ![x₀] y) :
    spaceEquiv hx₀ hc₀ ((isHW_translation hx₀ hc₀).iota hy) = y 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsHW.iota, spaceEquiv_ofPair hx₀ hc₀ ((isHW_translation hx₀ hc₀).onePair hy)
    (translation_zero hx₀).symm, zero_add]
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.Translation.range_spaceEquiv_iota
statement:
theorem range_spaceEquiv_iota (hx₀ : x₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    (hc₀ : c₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) :
    (range fun y : {y : Fin 1 → K // IsGen k ![x₀] y} ↦
      spaceEquiv hx₀ hc₀ ((isHW_translation hx₀ hc₀).iota y.2)) =
        {x | x ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, rfl⟩
    change spaceEquiv hx₀ hc₀ ((isHW_translation hx₀ hc₀).iota hy) ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)
    rw [spaceEquiv_iota]
    exact (isGen_translation_iff hx₀ y).1 hy
  · intro hx
    refine ⟨⟨![x], (isGen_translation_iff hx₀ _).2 (show ![x] 0 ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) from hx)⟩, ?_⟩
    change spaceEquiv hx₀ hc₀ ((isHW_translation hx₀ hc₀).iota _) = x
    rw [spaceEquiv_iota]
    rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.Translation.spaceEquiv_smul
statement:
theorem spaceEquiv_smul (hx₀ : x₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) (hc₀ : c₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    (a : K) (s : (isHW_translation hx₀ hc₀).Space) :
    spaceEquiv hx₀ hc₀ ((isHW_translation hx₀ hc₀).ofMem (translation_mem_prodSet hx₀ hc₀ a) • s) =
      a + spaceEquiv hx₀ hc₀ s
proof:
:= by
  refine (isHW_translation hx₀ hc₀).ind (fun p ↦ ?_) s
  have hpb := (translation_translationParam hx₀ hc₀ p.mem).symm
  have hγ : ((isHW_translation hx₀ hc₀).smulPair
      ((isHW_translation hx₀ hc₀).ofMem (translation_mem_prodSet hx₀ hc₀ a)) p).γ =
        translation hx₀ (a + translationParam hx₀ hc₀ p.mem) := by
    change (isHW_translation hx₀ hc₀).val _ * p.γ = _
    conv_lhs => rw [IsHW.val_ofMem, hpb]
    rw [translation_mul]
  rw [IsHW.smul_ofPair, spaceEquiv_ofPair hx₀ hc₀ _ hγ, spaceEquiv_ofPair hx₀ hc₀ p hpb,
    add_assoc]
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.Translation.spaceEquiv_zeroClass
statement:
theorem spaceEquiv_zeroClass (hx₀ : x₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) (hc₀ : c₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    {t : K} (ht : IsGen k ![x₀] ![t]) :
    spaceEquiv hx₀ hc₀ ((isHW_translation hx₀ hc₀).ofPair
      ⟨translation hx₀ (-t), translation_mem_prodSet hx₀ hc₀ _, ![t], ht⟩) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [spaceEquiv_ofPair hx₀ hc₀ _ rfl]
  change -t + t = 0
  exact neg_add_cancel t

name: GroupConfig.Germ.Translation.zeroClass_ne_smul_iota
statement:
theorem zeroClass_ne_smul_iota (hx₀ : x₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    (hc₀ : c₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) {t : K} (ht : IsGen k ![x₀] ![t])
    (γ : ↥(isHW_translation hx₀ hc₀).prodSubgroup) {y : Fin 1 → K} (hy : IsGen k ![x₀] y)
    (hind : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (((isHW_translation hx₀ hc₀).val γ).cb : Set K)) :
    (isHW_translation hx₀ hc₀).ofPair
        ⟨translation hx₀ (-t), translation_mem_prodSet hx₀ hc₀ _, ![t], ht⟩ ≠
      γ • (isHW_translation hx₀ hc₀).iota hy
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hγ : γ = (isHW_translation hx₀ hc₀).ofMem ((isHW_translation hx₀ hc₀).val_mem γ) :=
    (isHW_translation hx₀ hc₀).val_injective
      ((IsHW.val_ofMem _ ((isHW_translation hx₀ hc₀).val_mem γ)).symm)
  rw [hγ, IsHW.smul_iota _ _ hy hind] at h
  have h0 := congrArg (spaceEquiv hx₀ hc₀) h
  rw [spaceEquiv_zeroClass, spaceEquiv_iota] at h0
  have hgen := (isGen_translation_iff hx₀ _).1 (Germ.isGen_evalGen _ hy hind)
  exact hgen (by rw [← h0]; exact zero_mem _)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.Pair.cb_subset_base
statement: theorem cb_subset_base (p : Pair g₀) : (p.γ.cb : Set K) ⊆ p.base
proof: := subset_union_left

name: GroupConfig.Germ.Pair.range_subset_base
statement: theorem range_subset_base (p : Pair g₀) : range p.pt ⊆ p.base
proof: := subset_union_right

name: GroupConfig.Germ.Pair.isSmall_base
statement: theorem isSmall_base (p : Pair g₀) : IsSmall k p.base
proof:
:=
  p.γ.isSmall_cb.union (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range _))

name: GroupConfig.Germ.Pair.Rel.refl
statement: theorem Rel.refl (p : Pair g₀) : p.Rel p
proof: := fun _ _ _ ↦ rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.Pair.Rel.symm
statement: theorem Rel.symm {p q : Pair g₀} (h : p.Rel q) : q.Rel p
proof:
:= fun g hg hind ↦
  (h g hg (by rwa [union_comm])).symm

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.rel_of_witness
statement:
theorem rel_of_witness {p q : Pair g₀} {h : Germ k a a} (hh : h ∈ orbit g₀)
    (hind : IndepOver k ∅ (h.cb : Set K) (p.base ∪ q.base))
    (heq : (h * p.γ).evalGen p.pt = (h * q.γ).evalGen q.pt) : p.Rel q
proof:
:= by
  intro h' hh' hind'
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ :=
    exists_algEquiv_of_mem_orbit hh hh' (p.isSmall_base.union q.isSmall_base) hind hind'
  have hfix : ∀ x ∈ p.base ∪ q.base, (τ.restrictScalars k) x = x := fun x hx ↦ by
    change τ x = x
    exact τ.commutes ⟨x, subset_racl k _ hx⟩
  have hγp : p.γ.map (τ.restrictScalars k) = p.γ :=
    (map_eq_self_iff _ _).2 fun x hx ↦ hfix x (subset_union_left (p.cb_subset_base hx))
  have hγq : q.γ.map (τ.restrictScalars k) = q.γ :=
    (map_eq_self_iff _ _).2 fun x hx ↦ hfix x (subset_union_right (q.cb_subset_base hx))
  have hyp : ⇑(τ.restrictScalars k) ∘ p.pt = p.pt :=
    funext fun i ↦ hfix _ (subset_union_left (p.range_subset_base (mem_range_self i)))
  have hyq : ⇑(τ.restrictScalars k) ∘ q.pt = q.pt :=
    funext fun i ↦ hfix _ (subset_union_right (q.range_subset_base (mem_range_self i)))
  have hdp : IndepOver k ∅ (range p.pt) ((h * p.γ).cb : Set K) :=
    (hw.keyrank p.mem hh (hind.mono_right subset_union_left)).2.symm
  have hdq : IndepOver k ∅ (range q.pt) ((h * q.γ).cb : Set K) :=
    (hw.keyrank q.mem hh (hind.mono_right subset_union_right)).2.symm
  have hmp : (h * p.γ).map (τ.restrictScalars k) = h' * p.γ := by
    rw [mul_def h p.γ, comp_map, ← mul_def, hτ, hγp]
  have hmq : (h * q.γ).map (τ.restrictScalars k) = h' * q.γ := by
    rw [mul_def h q.γ, comp_map, ← mul_def, hτ, hγq]
  have e1 := evalGen_map (τ.restrictScalars k) (h * p.γ) p.isGen hdp
  have e2 := evalGen_map (τ.restrictScalars k) (h * q.γ) q.isGen hdq
  rw [hmp, hyp] at e1
  rw [hmq, hyq] at e2
  rw [e1, e2, heq]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.exists_witness
statement:
theorem exists_witness (p q : Pair g₀) :
    ∃ h ∈ orbit g₀, IndepOver k ∅ (h.cb : Set K) (p.base ∪ q.base)
proof:
:=
  exists_mem_orbit_indepOver g₀ (p.isSmall_base.union q.isSmall_base)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.rel_iff
statement:
theorem rel_iff {p q : Pair g₀} :
    p.Rel q ↔ ∃ h ∈ orbit g₀, IndepOver k ∅ (h.cb : Set K) (p.base ∪ q.base) ∧
      (h * p.γ).evalGen p.pt = (h * q.γ).evalGen q.pt
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hr ↦ ?_, fun ⟨h, hh, hind, heq⟩ ↦ hw.rel_of_witness hh hind heq⟩
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hind⟩ := exists_witness p q
  exact ⟨h, hh, hind, hr h hh hind⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.rel_trans
statement: theorem rel_trans {p q r : Pair g₀} (hpq : p.Rel q) (hqr : q.Rel r) : p.Rel r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hind⟩ := exists_mem_orbit_indepOver g₀
    ((p.isSmall_base.union q.isSmall_base).union r.isSmall_base)
  refine hw.rel_of_witness hh (hind.mono_right ?_) ?_
  · exact union_subset (subset_union_left.trans subset_union_left) subset_union_right
  · rw [hpq h hh (hind.mono_right subset_union_left), hqr h hh (hind.mono_right ?_)]
    exact union_subset (subset_union_right.trans subset_union_left) subset_union_right

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.ofPair_eq_ofPair
statement: theorem ofPair_eq_ofPair {p q : Pair g₀} : hw.ofPair p = hw.ofPair q ↔ p.Rel q
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ Quotient.exact (s := hw.setoid) h, fun h ↦ Quotient.sound (s := hw.setoid) h⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.ind
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem ind {motive : hw.Space → Prop} (h : ∀ p, motive (hw.ofPair p)) (s : hw.Space) :
    motive s
proof:
:=
  Quotient.ind h s

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.val_mem
statement: theorem val_mem (δ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) : hw.val δ ∈ prodSet g₀
proof: := hw.mem_prodSubgroup.1 δ.2

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.val_mul
statement: theorem val_mul (δ₁ δ₂ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) : hw.val (δ₁ * δ₂) = hw.val δ₁ * hw.val δ₂
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.val_one
statement: theorem val_one : hw.val 1 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.val_injective
statement: theorem val_injective : Function.Injective hw.val
proof: := fun _ _ h ↦ Subtype.ext (Units.ext h)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.val_ofMem
statement: theorem val_ofMem {γ : Germ k a a} (hγ : γ ∈ prodSet g₀) : hw.val (hw.ofMem hγ) = γ
proof:
:=
  IsUnit.unit_spec _

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.base_smulPair_subset
statement:
theorem base_smulPair_subset (δ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) (p : Pair g₀) :
    (hw.smulPair δ p).base ⊆ racl k (((hw.val δ).cb : Set K) ∪ p.base)
proof:
:= by
  change ((hw.val δ * p.γ).cb : Set K) ∪ range p.pt ⊆ _
  refine union_subset ?_ ((p.range_subset_base.trans subset_union_right).trans (subset_racl k _))
  refine (cb_comp_le_racl (hw.val δ) p.γ).trans (racl_mono (k := k) ?_)
  exact union_subset (p.cb_subset_base.trans subset_union_right) subset_union_left

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.rel_smulPair
statement:
theorem rel_smulPair (δ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) {p q : Pair g₀} (hr : p.Rel q) :
    (hw.smulPair δ p).Rel (hw.smulPair δ q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hind⟩ := exists_mem_orbit_indepOver g₀
    ((hw.val δ).isSmall_cb.union (p.isSmall_base.union q.isSmall_base))
  obtain ⟨hmem, hind'⟩ := hw.keyrank (hw.val_mem δ) hh hind
  have heq := hr _ hmem hind'
  refine hw.rel_of_witness hh ((indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hind).mono_right ?_) ?_
  · rw [empty_union]
    refine union_subset ((hw.base_smulPair_subset δ p).trans (racl_mono (k := k) ?_))
      ((hw.base_smulPair_subset δ q).trans (racl_mono (k := k) ?_))
    · exact union_subset subset_union_left (subset_union_left.trans subset_union_right)
    · exact union_subset subset_union_left (subset_union_right.trans subset_union_right)
  · change (h * (hw.val δ * p.γ)).evalGen p.pt = (h * (hw.val δ * q.γ)).evalGen q.pt
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc]
    exact heq

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.smul_ofPair
statement:
theorem smul_ofPair (δ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) (p : Pair g₀) :
    δ • hw.ofPair p = hw.ofPair (hw.smulPair δ p)
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.iota_congr
statement:
theorem iota_congr {y y' : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k a y) (hy' : IsGen k a y') (h : y = y') :
    hw.iota hy = hw.iota hy'
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.ofPair_eq_smul_iota
statement: theorem ofPair_eq_smul_iota (p : Pair g₀) : hw.ofPair p = hw.ofMem p.mem • hw.iota p.isGen
proof:
:= by
  refine congr_arg hw.ofPair
    (Pair.ext ?_ rfl : p = hw.smulPair (hw.ofMem p.mem) (hw.onePair p.isGen))
  change p.γ = hw.val (hw.ofMem p.mem) * 1
  rw [val_ofMem, mul_one]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.smul_iota
statement:
theorem smul_iota {γ : Germ k a a} (hγ : γ ∈ prodSet g₀) {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k a y)
    (hind : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (γ.cb : Set K)) :
    hw.ofMem hγ • hw.iota hy = hw.iota (γ.isGen_evalGen hy hind)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : hw.smulPair (hw.ofMem hγ) (hw.onePair hy) = ⟨γ, hγ, y, hy⟩ := by
    refine Pair.ext ?_ rfl
    change hw.val (hw.ofMem hγ) * 1 = γ
    rw [val_ofMem, mul_one]
  change hw.ofPair (hw.smulPair (hw.ofMem hγ) (hw.onePair hy)) = hw.ofPair (hw.onePair _)
  rw [hp]
  refine hw.ofPair_eq_ofPair.2 ?_
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hind'⟩ :=
    exists_witness (⟨γ, hγ, y, hy⟩ : Pair g₀) (hw.onePair (γ.isGen_evalGen hy hind))
  refine hw.rel_of_witness hh hind' ?_
  change (h * γ).evalGen y = (h * 1).evalGen (γ.evalGen y)
  rw [mul_one]
  have hhγ : IndepOver k ∅ (h.cb : Set K) ((γ.cb : Set K) ∪ range y) :=
    hind'.mono_right subset_union_left
  have hyγh : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) ((h.cb : Set K) ∪ γ.cb) := by
    rw [union_comm]
    exact indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨hind, (indepOver_union_right_iff.1 hhγ).2.symm⟩
  exact evalGen_mul h γ hy hyγh

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.iota_injective
statement:
theorem iota_injective {y y' : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k a y) (hy' : IsGen k a y')
    (h : hw.iota hy = hw.iota hy') : y = y'
proof:
:= by
  have hr : (hw.onePair hy).Rel (hw.onePair hy') := hw.ofPair_eq_ofPair.1 h
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hind⟩ := exists_witness (hw.onePair hy) (hw.onePair hy')
  have heq := hr g hg hind
  change (g * 1).evalGen y = (g * 1).evalGen y' at heq
  rw [mul_one] at heq
  obtain ⟨g', hg'⟩ := isUnit_iff.1 (hw.isUnit_of_mem hg)
  have h1 : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (g.cb : Set K) :=
    (hind.mono_right ((hw.onePair hy).range_subset_base.trans subset_union_left)).symm
  have h2 : IndepOver k ∅ (range y') (g.cb : Set K) :=
    (hind.mono_right ((hw.onePair hy').range_subset_base.trans subset_union_right)).symm
  rw [← hg'.evalGen_evalGen hy h1, heq, hg'.evalGen_evalGen hy' h2]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.exists_mem_orbit_evalGen_eq
statement:
theorem exists_mem_orbit_evalGen_eq {y c : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k a y) (hc : IsGen k a c)
    (hind : IndepOver k ∅ (range c) (range y)) :
    ∃ g ∈ orbit g₀, IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (g.cb : Set K) ∧ g.evalGen y = c
proof:
:= by
  have hsmall : IsSmall k (range y) := IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range y)
  obtain ⟨g₁, hg₁, hind₁⟩ := exists_mem_orbit_indepOver g₀ hsmall
  have hyg₁ : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (g₁.cb : Set K) := hind₁.symm
  have hz : IsGen k a (g₁.evalGen y) := g₁.isGen_evalGen hy hyg₁
  have hzy : IndepOver k ∅ (range (g₁.evalGen y)) (range y) := hw.trans g₁ hg₁ y hy hyg₁
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ :=
    (hz.isGenericOver_racl hsmall hzy).exists_algEquiv (hc.isGenericOver_racl hsmall hind)
  have hyfix : ⇑(σ.restrictScalars k) ∘ y = y := funext fun i ↦ by
    change σ (y i) = y i
    exact σ.commutes ⟨y i, subset_racl k _ (mem_range_self i)⟩
  refine ⟨g₁.map (σ.restrictScalars k), map_mem_orbit hg₁ _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := hyg₁.image (σ.restrictScalars k)
    rwa [image_empty, ← range_comp, hyfix, ← AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, ← coe_map, ← cb_map]
      at this
  · have e := evalGen_map (σ.restrictScalars k) g₁ hy hyg₁
    rw [hyfix] at e
    rw [e]
    exact funext hσ

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.exists_smul_eq
statement: theorem exists_smul_eq (s s' : hw.Space) : ∃ δ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup, δ • s = s'
proof:
:= by
  refine hw.ind (fun p ↦ hw.ind (fun p' ↦ ?_) s') s
  have hsmall : IsSmall k (range p.pt ∪ range p'.pt) :=
    IsSmall.of_finite ((finite_range _).union (finite_range _))
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hsmall.racl a
  have hcgen : IsGen k a c := hc.isGen
  have hcind : IndepOver k ∅ (range c) (range p.pt ∪ range p'.pt) :=
    hc.indepOver.mono_right (subset_racl k _)
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgy, hgc⟩ :=
    hw.exists_mem_orbit_evalGen_eq p.isGen hcgen (hcind.mono_right subset_union_left)
  obtain ⟨g', hg', hg'c, hg'y'⟩ := hw.exists_mem_orbit_evalGen_eq hcgen p'.isGen
    (hcind.mono_right subset_union_right).symm
  have e1 := hw.smul_iota (hw.mem_prodSet_of_mem hg) p.isGen hgy
  rw [hw.iota_congr _ hcgen hgc] at e1
  have e2 := hw.smul_iota (hw.mem_prodSet_of_mem hg') hcgen hg'c
  rw [hw.iota_congr _ p'.isGen hg'y'] at e2
  refine ⟨hw.ofMem p'.mem * (hw.ofMem (hw.mem_prodSet_of_mem hg') *
    hw.ofMem (hw.mem_prodSet_of_mem hg)) * (hw.ofMem p.mem)⁻¹, ?_⟩
  rw [hw.ofPair_eq_smul_iota p, hw.ofPair_eq_smul_iota p', mul_smul, mul_smul, inv_smul_smul,
    mul_smul, e1, e2]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.eq_one_of_forall_smul_eq
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_forall_smul_eq {δ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup} (h : ∀ s : hw.Space, δ • s = s) :
    δ = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver (hw.val δ).isSmall_cb.racl a
  have hyGen : IsGen k a y := hy.isGen
  have hyδ : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) ((hw.val δ).cb : Set K) :=
    hy.indepOver.mono_right (subset_racl k _)
  have h1 : (hw.smulPair δ (hw.onePair hyGen)).Rel (hw.onePair hyGen) :=
    hw.ofPair_eq_ofPair.1 (h (hw.iota hyGen))
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hind⟩ := exists_mem_orbit_indepOver g₀
    ((hw.val δ).isSmall_cb.union (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range y)))
  have hbase : (hw.smulPair δ (hw.onePair hyGen)).base ∪ (hw.onePair hyGen).base ⊆
      racl k (((hw.val δ).cb : Set K) ∪ range y) := by
    have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (((hw.val δ).cb : Set K) ∪ range y)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
    have h1cb : ((1 : Germ k a a).cb : Set K) ⊆ racl k (((hw.val δ).cb : Set K) ∪ range y) :=
      cb_id_le a _
    have hpb : (hw.onePair hyGen).base ⊆ racl k (((hw.val δ).cb : Set K) ∪ range y) :=
      union_subset h1cb (subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _))
    refine union_subset ((hw.base_smulPair_subset δ _).trans ?_) hpb
    exact racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset (subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)) hpb)
  have heq := h1 g hg ((indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hind).mono_right (by
    rw [empty_union]
    exact hbase))
  change (g * (hw.val δ * 1)).evalGen y = (g * 1).evalGen y at heq
  rw [mul_one, mul_one] at heq
  have hyg : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ (hw.val δ).cb) := by
    rw [union_comm]
    exact indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨hyδ, (indepOver_union_right_iff.1 hind).2.symm⟩
  have hyF : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (((g * hw.val δ).cb : Set K) ∪ g.cb) := by
    refine (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hyg).mono_right ?_
    rw [empty_union]
    exact union_subset
      ((cb_comp_le_racl g (hw.val δ)).trans (racl_mono (k := k) (union_comm _ _).le))
      (subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _))
  obtain ⟨F, hF_def⟩ : ∃ F : IntermediateField k K,
      F = racl k (((g * hw.val δ).cb : Set K) ∪ g.cb) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥F := hF_def ▸ isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hF : IsSmall k (F : Set K) :=
    hF_def ▸ ((g * hw.val δ).isSmall_cb.union g.isSmall_cb).racl
  have hcb1 : (g * hw.val δ).cb ≤ F := by
    rw [hF_def]
    exact subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hcb2 : g.cb ≤ F := by
    rw [hF_def]
    exact subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hyF' : IsGenericOver F a y := by
    rw [hF_def]
    exact hyGen.isGenericOver_racl ((g * hw.val δ).isSmall_cb.union g.isSmall_cb) hyF
  have hgδg : g * hw.val δ = g := by
    refine eq_of_eval_eq hF hcb1 hcb2 hyF' ?_
    rw [← evalGen_eq _ hF hcb1 hyF', ← evalGen_eq _ hF hcb2 hyF']
    exact heq
  obtain ⟨g', hg'⟩ := isUnit_iff.1 (hw.isUnit_of_mem hg)
  have hδ1 : hw.val δ = 1 := by
    calc hw.val δ = g' * (g * hw.val δ) := by
          rw [← mul_assoc, show g' * g = 1 from hg'.1, one_mul]
      _ = g' * g := by rw [hgδg]
      _ = 1 := hg'.1
  exact hw.val_injective (hδ1.trans hw.val_one.symm)

name: GroupConfig.Representative.graphPoint_comp
statement:
theorem graphPoint_comp (r : Representative k K a a') (σ : K ≃ₐ[↥r.M] K) (y : ι → K) :
    r.graphPoint (⇑σ ∘ y) = ⇑σ ∘ r.graphPoint y
proof:
:= by
  unfold graphPoint
  rw [r.f.eval_comp σ y]
  funext i
  cases i <;> rfl

name: GroupConfig.Representative.locusIdeal_graphPoint_eq
statement:
theorem locusIdeal_graphPoint_eq [Finite ι] [Finite κ] (r : Representative k K a a')
    {y z : ι → K} (hy : IsGenericOver r.M a y) (hz : IsGenericOver r.M a z) :
    locusIdeal (↥r.M) (r.graphPoint y) = locusIdeal (↥r.M) (r.graphPoint z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := hy.exists_algEquiv hz
  have hyz : ⇑σ ∘ y = z := funext hσ
  rw [← hyz, graphPoint_comp]
  exact ((locusIdeal_eq_iff_exists_algEquiv r.M _ _).2 ⟨σ, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩).symm

name: GroupConfig.Representative.graphIdeal_eq
statement:
theorem graphIdeal_eq [IsAlgClosed k] [UniversalDomain k K] [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (r : Representative k K a a') {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGenericOver r.M a y) :
    r.graphIdeal = locusIdeal (↥r.M) (r.graphPoint y)
proof:
:=
  locusIdeal_graphPoint_eq r (Classical.choose_spec (exists_isGenericOver r.isSmall a)) hy

name: GroupConfig.Representative.erk_graphPoint
proof:
:= by
  unfold graphPoint
  rw [Sum.elim_range, erk_union_eq_of_subset_racl k ?_, hy.erk_coe_eq, hy.erk_empty_eq]
  rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
  exact racl_mono (k := k) (union_subset_union_left _ hMN) (r.eval_mem_racl (hy.of_le hMN) j)

name: GroupConfig.Representative.locusIdeal_graphPoint_eq_of_le
statement:
theorem locusIdeal_graphPoint_eq_of_le [UniversalDomain k K] [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (r : Representative k K a a') {N : IntermediateField k K} (hN : IsSmall k (N : Set K))
    (hMN : r.M ≤ N) {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGenericOver N a y) :
    locusIdeal (↥N) (r.graphPoint y) = locusIdeal (↥r.M) (r.graphPoint y)
proof:
:= by
  have _ := r.isAlgClosed
  refine locusIdeal_eq_of_indepOver r.isSmall hN hMN ?_
  refine indepOver_of_erk_eq (finite_range _) ?_
  rw [union_eq_right.2 (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 hMN), erk_graphPoint r hMN hy,
    erk_graphPoint r le_rfl (hy.of_le hMN)]

name: GroupConfig.Representative.graphIdeal_eq_of_equivalent
statement:
theorem graphIdeal_eq_of_equivalent [IsAlgClosed k] [UniversalDomain k K] [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    {r r' : Representative k K a a'} (h : r.Equivalent r') : r.graphIdeal = r'.graphIdeal
proof:
:= by
  have hN : IsSmall k ((racl k ((r.M : Set K) ∪ r'.M) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (r.isSmall.union r'.isSmall).racl
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hN a
  have hMN : r.M ≤ racl k ((r.M : Set K) ∪ r'.M) := subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hM'N : r'.M ≤ racl k ((r.M : Set K) ∪ r'.M) :=
    subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hpt : r.graphPoint y = r'.graphPoint y := by
    unfold graphPoint
    rw [h y hy]
  rw [r.graphIdeal_eq (hy.of_le hMN), r'.graphIdeal_eq (hy.of_le hM'N),
    ← r.locusIdeal_graphPoint_eq_of_le hN hMN hy, ← r'.locusIdeal_graphPoint_eq_of_le hN hM'N hy,
    hpt]

name: GroupConfig.Representative.comap_rename_inl_idealOf
statement:
theorem comap_rename_inl_idealOf (L : Type*) [Field L] [Algebra L K] (w₁ : ι → K)
    (w₂ : κ → K) :
    (idealOf L (Sum.elim w₁ w₂)).comap
        (rename (Sum.inl : ι → ι ⊕ κ) : MvPolynomial ι L →ₐ[L] MvPolynomial (ι ⊕ κ) L) =
      idealOf L w₁
proof:
:= by
  ext P
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, mem_idealOf_iff, mem_idealOf_iff, aeval_rename, Sum.elim_comp_inl]

name: GroupConfig.Representative.comap_rename_inr_idealOf
statement:
theorem comap_rename_inr_idealOf (L : Type*) [Field L] [Algebra L K] (w₁ : ι → K)
    (w₂ : κ → K) :
    (idealOf L (Sum.elim w₁ w₂)).comap
        (rename (Sum.inr : κ → ι ⊕ κ) : MvPolynomial κ L →ₐ[L] MvPolynomial (ι ⊕ κ) L) =
      idealOf L w₂
proof:
:= by
  ext P
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, mem_idealOf_iff, mem_idealOf_iff, aeval_rename, Sum.elim_comp_inr]

name: GroupConfig.Representative.comap_rename_inl_graphIdeal
statement:
theorem comap_rename_inl_graphIdeal [IsAlgClosed k] [UniversalDomain k K] [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (r : Representative k K a a') :
    r.graphIdeal.comap
        (rename (Sum.inl : ι → ι ⊕ κ) : MvPolynomial ι K →ₐ[K] MvPolynomial (ι ⊕ κ) K) =
      locusIdeal k a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver r.isSmall a
  rw [r.graphIdeal_eq hy, graphPoint, locusIdeal, comap_rename_map_eq _ Sum.inl_injective,
    comap_rename_inl_idealOf]
  exact hy.locusIdeal_eq

name: GroupConfig.Representative.comap_rename_inr_graphIdeal
statement:
theorem comap_rename_inr_graphIdeal [IsAlgClosed k] [UniversalDomain k K] [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (r : Representative k K a a') :
    r.graphIdeal.comap
        (rename (Sum.inr : κ → ι ⊕ κ) : MvPolynomial κ K →ₐ[K] MvPolynomial (ι ⊕ κ) K) =
      locusIdeal k a'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver r.isSmall a
  rw [r.graphIdeal_eq hy, graphPoint, locusIdeal, comap_rename_map_eq _ Sum.inr_injective,
    comap_rename_inr_idealOf]
  exact (r.isGenericOver y hy).locusIdeal_eq

name: GroupConfig.Representative.equivalent_of_graphIdeal_eq
statement:
theorem equivalent_of_graphIdeal_eq [IsAlgClosed k] [UniversalDomain k K] [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    {r r' : Representative k K a a'} (h : r.graphIdeal = r'.graphIdeal) : r.Equivalent r'
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have hN : IsSmall k ((racl k ((r.M : Set K) ∪ r'.M) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (r.isSmall.union r'.isSmall).racl
  have hMN : r.M ≤ racl k ((r.M : Set K) ∪ r'.M) := subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hM'N : r'.M ≤ racl k ((r.M : Set K) ∪ r'.M) :=
    subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
  
  have h1 : locusIdeal (↥(racl k ((r.M : Set K) ∪ r'.M))) (r'.graphPoint y) =
      locusIdeal (↥(racl k ((r.M : Set K) ∪ r'.M))) (r.graphPoint y) := by
    rw [r.locusIdeal_graphPoint_eq_of_le hN hMN hy, r'.locusIdeal_graphPoint_eq_of_le hN hM'N hy,
      ← r.graphIdeal_eq (hy.of_le hMN), ← r'.graphIdeal_eq (hy.of_le hM'N), h]
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := (locusIdeal_eq_iff_exists_algEquiv _ _ _).1 h1
  have hy' : ⇑σ ∘ y = y := funext fun i ↦ hσ (Sum.inl i)
  have hz : ⇑σ ∘ r.f.eval y = r'.f.eval y := funext fun j ↦ hσ (Sum.inr j)
  
  have hcomp : r.f.eval (⇑σ ∘ y) = ⇑σ ∘ r.f.eval y := by
    rw [← QuasiRational.eval_map hMN, ← QuasiRational.eval_map hMN, QuasiRational.eval_comp]
  rw [← hz, ← hcomp, hy']

name: GroupConfig.Germ.graphIdeal_mk
statement:
theorem graphIdeal_mk (r : Representative k K a a') :
    Germ.graphIdeal (⟦r⟧ : Germ k a a') = r.graphIdeal
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.graphIdeal_injective
statement: theorem graphIdeal_injective : Function.Injective (graphIdeal : Germ k a a' → _)
proof:
:= by
  intro g g' h
  induction g using Quotient.inductionOn with
  | h r =>
    induction g' using Quotient.inductionOn with
    | h r' => exact Quotient.sound (Representative.equivalent_of_graphIdeal_eq h)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.indepOver_cb_comp
statement:
theorem indepOver_cb_comp (hw : IsHW δ₀) {f : Germ k a a'} (hf : f ∈ orbit f₀)
    {G : Germ k a a} (hG : G ∈ IsHW.prodSet δ₀) {Y : Set K}
    (hind : IndepOver k ∅ (f.cb : Set K) ((G.cb : Set K) ∪ Y)) :
    IndepOver k ∅ ((Germ.comp f G).cb : Set K) ((G.cb : Set K) ∪ Y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G', hG'⟩ := isUnit_iff.1 (hw.isUnit_of_mem_prodSet hG)
  obtain ⟨hfG, -⟩ := hb.comp_mem_orbit hδ₀ hf hG (hind.mono_right subset_union_left).symm
  have heq : erk k ((G.cb : Set K) ∪ Y) ((Germ.comp f G).cb : Set K) =
      erk k ((G.cb : Set K) ∪ Y) (f.cb : Set K) := by
    refine erk_eq_of_subset_racl ?_ ?_
    · exact (cb_comp_le_racl f G).trans (racl_mono (k := k)
        (union_subset (subset_union_left.trans subset_union_left) subset_union_right))
    · exact (cb_le_of_isInverse f hG').trans (racl_mono (k := k)
        (union_subset subset_union_right (subset_union_left.trans subset_union_left)))
  refine indepOver_cb_of_erk_eq _ ?_
  rw [empty_union, heq, ← empty_union ((G.cb : Set K) ∪ Y), erk_cb_eq_of_indepOver hind,
    erk_cb_eq_of_mem_orbit hf, erk_cb_eq_of_mem_orbit hfG]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.smul_iota_eq_iff
statement:
theorem smul_iota_eq_iff (hw : IsHW δ₀) (γ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) {y₀ : ι → K} (hy₀ : IsGen k a y₀)
    {f : Germ k a a'} (hf : f ∈ orbit f₀)
    (hind : IndepOver k ∅ (f.cb : Set K) (((hw.val γ).cb : Set K) ∪ range y₀)) :
    γ • hw.iota hy₀ = hw.iota hy₀ ↔
      (Germ.comp f (hw.val γ)).evalGen y₀ = f.evalGen y₀
proof:
:= by
  
  have mono : ∀ {A A' B B' : Set K}, A' ⊆ racl k A → B' ⊆ racl k B → IndepOver k ∅ A B →
      IndepOver k ∅ A' B' := fun {A _ B _} hA hB h ↦ by
    have h1 : IndepOver k ∅ (racl k (∅ ∪ A) : Set K) (racl k (∅ ∪ B) : Set K) :=
      indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 (indepOver_racl_left_iff.2 h)
    rw [empty_union, empty_union] at h1
    exact (h1.mono_left hA).mono_right hB
  set G := hw.val γ with hG
  set C : Set K := (G.cb : Set K) ∪ range y₀ with hC
  have hGmem : G ∈ IsHW.prodSet δ₀ := hw.val_mem γ
  
  have hfGC : IndepOver k ∅ ((Germ.comp f G).cb : Set K) C :=
    hb.indepOver_cb_comp hδ₀ hw hf hGmem hind
                                                                                        
  obtain ⟨f₁, hf₁, hf₁ind⟩ := exists_mem_orbit_indepOver f₀ (f.isSmall_cb.union
