    (G.isSmall_cb.union (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range y₀))))
  obtain ⟨g₁, hg₁⟩ := isInvertible_of_mem_orbit hb.isInvertible hf₁
  have hg₁le : (g₁.cb : Set K) ⊆ racl k (f₁.cb : Set K) := hg₁.cb_le
  have hh : Germ.comp g₁ f ∈ orbit δ₀ := by
    rw [← diffSet_eq_orbit hδ₀]
    exact ⟨f₁, hf₁, f, hf, g₁, hg₁, hf₁ind.mono_right subset_union_left, rfl⟩
  have hf₁fC : IndepOver k ∅ ((f₁.cb : Set K) ∪ f.cb) C := hind.union_left hf₁ind
  have hfGW : ((Germ.comp f G).cb : Set K) ∪ range y₀ ⊆ racl k ((f.cb : Set K) ∪ C) :=
    union_subset ((cb_comp_le_racl f G).trans (racl_mono (k := k)
      (union_subset (subset_union_left.trans subset_union_right) subset_union_left)))
      ((subset_union_right.trans subset_union_right).trans (subset_racl k _))
  have hf₁fG : IndepOver k ∅ (f₁.cb : Set K) (((Germ.comp f G).cb : Set K) ∪ range y₀) :=
    mono (subset_racl k _) hfGW hf₁ind
  have hf₁f : IndepOver k ∅ (f₁.cb : Set K) ((f.cb : Set K) ∪ range y₀) :=
    hf₁ind.mono_right (union_subset_union_right _ subset_union_right)
  
  have hyfG : IndepOver k ∅ (range y₀) ((g₁.cb : Set K) ∪ (Germ.comp f G).cb) :=
    mono (subset_racl k _) (union_subset (hg₁le.trans (racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_left))
      (subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)))
      ((hfGC.mono_right subset_union_right).union_left hf₁fG).symm
  have hyf : IndepOver k ∅ (range y₀) ((g₁.cb : Set K) ∪ f.cb) :=
    mono (subset_racl k _) (union_subset (hg₁le.trans (racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_left))
      (subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)))
      ((hind.mono_right subset_union_right).union_left hf₁f).symm
                                                                                           
  have hwit : IndepOver k ∅ ((Germ.comp g₁ f).cb : Set K)
      ((hw.smulPair γ (hw.onePair hy₀)).base ∪ (hw.onePair hy₀).base) := by
    refine mono ((cb_comp_le_racl g₁ f).trans (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset
      (subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _))
      (hg₁le.trans (racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_left))))) ?_ hf₁fC
    change (((G * 1).cb : Set K) ∪ range y₀) ∪ (((1 : Germ k a a).cb : Set K) ∪ range y₀) ⊆ _
    rw [mul_one]
    refine union_subset (union_subset (subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _))
      (subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _))) (union_subset ?_
      (subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)))
    exact (cb_id_le a (racl k (∅ : Set K))).trans (racl_mono (k := k) (empty_subset _))
                                                                                  
  have hzind (g : Germ k a a') (hgy : IndepOver k ∅ (range y₀) (g.cb : Set K))
      (hf₁g : IndepOver k ∅ (f₁.cb : Set K) ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ range y₀)) :
      IndepOver k ∅ (range (g.evalGen y₀)) (g₁.cb : Set K) := by
    refine mono (?_ : range (g.evalGen y₀) ⊆ racl k ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ range y₀)) hg₁le hf₁g.symm
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact g.evalGen_mem_racl hy₀ hgy j
  have hfGy : IndepOver k ∅ (range y₀) ((Germ.comp f G).cb : Set K) :=
    (hfGC.mono_right subset_union_right).symm
  have hfy : IndepOver k ∅ (range y₀) (f.cb : Set K) := (hind.mono_right subset_union_right).symm
  have hz := hzind _ hfGy hf₁fG
  have hz' := hzind _ hfy hf₁f
  have hinj : g₁.evalGen ((Germ.comp f G).evalGen y₀) = g₁.evalGen (f.evalGen y₀) ↔
      (Germ.comp f G).evalGen y₀ = f.evalGen y₀ := by
    refine ⟨fun e ↦ ?_, fun e ↦ by rw [e]⟩
    rw [← hg₁.symm.evalGen_evalGen ((Germ.comp f G).isGen_evalGen hy₀ hfGy) hz,
      ← hg₁.symm.evalGen_evalGen (f.isGen_evalGen hy₀ hfy) hz', e]
  have key : (Germ.comp g₁ f * (hw.smulPair γ (hw.onePair hy₀)).γ).evalGen y₀ =
      (Germ.comp g₁ f * (hw.onePair hy₀).γ).evalGen y₀ ↔
        (Germ.comp f G).evalGen y₀ = f.evalGen y₀ := by
    change (Germ.comp g₁ f * (G * 1)).evalGen y₀ = (Germ.comp g₁ f * 1).evalGen y₀ ↔ _
    rw [mul_one, mul_one, mul_def, comp_assoc, evalGen_comp g₁ _ hy₀ hyfG,
      evalGen_comp g₁ f hy₀ hyf, hinj]
  change hw.ofPair (hw.smulPair γ (hw.onePair hy₀)) = hw.ofPair (hw.onePair hy₀) ↔ _
  rw [hw.ofPair_eq_ofPair]
  exact ⟨fun hr ↦ key.1 (hr _ hh hwit), fun he ↦ hw.rel_of_witness hh hwit (key.2 he)⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.mem_stabilizer_iota_iff
statement:
theorem mem_stabilizer_iota_iff (hw : IsHW δ₀) (γ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) {y₀ : ι → K}
    (hy₀ : IsGen k a y₀) {f : Germ k a a'} (hf : f ∈ orbit f₀)
    (hind : IndepOver k ∅ (f.cb : Set K) (((hw.val γ).cb : Set K) ∪ range y₀)) :
    γ ∈ MulAction.stabilizer (↥hw.prodSubgroup) (hw.iota hy₀) ↔
      (Germ.comp f (hw.val γ)).evalGen y₀ = f.evalGen y₀
proof:
:=
  MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.trans (hb.smul_iota_eq_iff hδ₀ hw γ hy₀ hf hind)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.cb_le_of_isInverse_left
statement:
theorem cb_le_of_isInverse_left (g : Germ k a a') {g' : Germ k a' a''} {h' : Germ k a'' a'}
    (hi : IsInverse h' g') : g.cb ≤ racl k (((Germ.comp g' g).cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb)
proof:
:= by
  have hg : g = Germ.comp h' (Germ.comp g' g) := by
    rw [← comp_assoc, hi.1, id_comp]
  have hle : (Germ.comp h' (Germ.comp g' g)).cb ≤
      racl k (((Germ.comp g' g).cb : Set K) ∪ h'.cb) := cb_comp_le_racl h' (Germ.comp g' g)
  rw [← hg] at hle
  have h1 : ((Germ.comp g' g).cb : Set K) ⊆ racl k (((Germ.comp g' g).cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb) :=
    subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have h2 : (h'.cb : Set K) ⊆ racl k (((Germ.comp g' g).cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb) :=
    hi.cb_le.trans (racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_right)
  exact hle.trans (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset h1 h2))

name: GroupConfig.Germ.erk_cb_comp_eq_of_isInverse
proof:
:= by
  refine erk_eq_of_subset_racl ?_ ?_
  · refine (cb_comp_le_racl g' g).trans (racl_mono (k := k) ?_)
    rw [union_assoc]
    exact subset_union_right
  · refine (cb_le_of_isInverse g' hi).trans (racl_mono (k := k) ?_)
    exact union_subset subset_union_right (subset_union_right.trans subset_union_left)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.erk_cb_comp_eq_of_isInverse_left
proof:
:= by
  refine erk_eq_of_subset_racl ?_ ?_
  · refine (cb_comp_le_racl g' g).trans (racl_mono (k := k) ?_)
    exact union_subset subset_union_right (subset_union_right.trans subset_union_left)
  · refine (cb_le_of_isInverse_left g hi).trans (racl_mono (k := k) ?_)
    exact union_subset subset_union_right (subset_union_right.trans subset_union_left)

name: GroupConfig.erk_eq_of_subset_racl
statement:
theorem erk_eq_of_subset_racl {C X Y : Set K} (hX : X ⊆ racl k (C ∪ Y))
    (hY : Y ⊆ racl k (C ∪ X)) : erk k C X = erk k C Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← erk_union_eq_of_subset_racl k hY, ← erk_union_eq_of_subset_racl k hX, union_comm]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.map_map
statement: theorem map_map (σ τ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (g : Germ k a a') : (g.map σ).map τ = g.map (σ.trans τ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hF_def⟩ : ∃ F : IntermediateField k K, F = racl k (g.cb : Set K) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hF : IsSmall k (F : Set K) := hF_def ▸ g.isSmall_cb.racl
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥F := hF_def ▸ isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hcb : g.cb ≤ F := hF_def ▸ subset_racl k _
  have hcomp : (σ.trans τ).toAlgHom = τ.toAlgHom.comp σ.toAlgHom := AlgHom.ext fun _ ↦ rfl
  have hF' : F.map (σ.trans τ).toAlgHom = (F.map σ.toAlgHom).map τ.toAlgHom := by
    rw [hcomp, IntermediateField.map_map]
  have _ := isAlgClosed_map σ F
  have _ := isAlgClosed_map τ (F.map σ.toAlgHom)
  have hF2 := isSmall_map τ (isSmall_map σ hF)
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hF a
  have hy1 : IsGenericOver (F.map σ.toAlgHom) a (⇑σ ∘ y) := (isGenericOver_map_iff σ _ a y).2 hy
  have hy2 : IsGenericOver ((F.map σ.toAlgHom).map τ.toAlgHom) a (⇑τ ∘ (⇑σ ∘ y)) :=
    (isGenericOver_map_iff τ _ a _).2 hy1
  have hcb2 : (g.map (σ.trans τ)).cb ≤ (F.map σ.toAlgHom).map τ.toAlgHom := by
    rw [← hF']
    exact cb_map_le _ hcb
  refine eq_of_eval_eq hF2 (cb_map_le τ (cb_map_le σ hcb)) hcb2 hy2 ?_
  have h1 := eval_map g (σ.trans τ) hF hcb hy
  rw [hF', AlgEquiv.coe_trans, Function.comp_assoc] at h1
  rw [h1, eval_map _ τ (isSmall_map σ hF) (cb_map_le σ hcb) hy1, eval_map g σ hF hcb hy]
  exact (Function.comp_assoc _ _ _).symm

name: GroupConfig.Germ.mul_def
statement: theorem mul_def (g g' : Germ k a a) : g * g' = Germ.comp g g'
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.one_def
statement: theorem one_def : (1 : Germ k a a) = Germ.id a
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.isUnit_iff
statement: theorem isUnit_iff {g : Germ k a a} : IsUnit g ↔ ∃ h, IsInverse h g
proof:
:= by
  rw [isUnit_iff_exists]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h, h1, h2⟩
    exact ⟨h, h2, h1⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, h1, h2⟩
    exact ⟨h, h2, h1⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.mapHom_apply
statement: theorem mapHom_apply (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (g : Germ k a a) : mapHom σ g = g.map σ
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.erk_cb_map
statement:
theorem erk_cb_map (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (g : Germ k a a') :
    erk k ∅ ((g.map σ).cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (g.cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cb_map, coe_map, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, ← image_empty ⇑σ, erk_image, image_empty]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.erk_cb_mul_eq
statement:
theorem erk_cb_mul_eq {γ δ : Germ k a a} (hγ : IsUnit γ) (C : Set K) :
    erk k (C ∪ γ.cb) ((δ * γ).cb : Set K) = erk k (C ∪ γ.cb) (δ.cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨γ', hγ'⟩ := isUnit_iff.1 hγ
  refine erk_eq_of_subset_racl ?_ ?_
  · refine (cb_comp_le_racl δ γ).trans (racl_mono (k := k) ?_)
    rw [union_assoc]
    exact subset_union_right
  · refine (cb_le_of_isInverse δ hγ').trans (racl_mono (k := k) ?_)
    exact union_subset subset_union_right (subset_union_right.trans subset_union_left)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.mem_prodSet_iff
statement:
theorem mem_prodSet_iff {δ₀ : Germ k a a} (hδ₀ : δ₀ ∈ diffSet f₀) {γ : Germ k a a} :
    γ ∈ IsHW.prodSet δ₀ ↔ ∃ f₁ ∈ orbit f₀, ∃ f₂ ∈ orbit f₀, ∃ g₁ : Germ k a' a,
      IsInverse g₁ f₁ ∧ γ = Germ.comp g₁ f₂
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hγ
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hind⟩ := exists_mem_orbit_indepOver f₀ γ.isSmall_cb
    obtain ⟨hmem, -⟩ := hb.comp_mem_orbit hδ₀ hf hγ hind.symm
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := isInvertible_of_mem_orbit hb.isInvertible hf
    refine ⟨f, hf, Germ.comp f γ, hmem, g, hg, ?_⟩
    rw [← comp_assoc, hg.1, id_comp]
  · rintro ⟨f₁, hf₁, f₂, hf₂, g₁, hg₁, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hind⟩ := exists_mem_orbit_indepOver f₀ (f₁.isSmall_cb.union f₂.isSmall_cb)
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := isInvertible_of_mem_orbit hb.isInvertible hf
    have h₁ : Germ.comp g₁ f ∈ diffSet f₀ :=
      ⟨f₁, hf₁, f, hf, g₁, hg₁, (hind.mono_right subset_union_left).symm, rfl⟩
    have h₂ : Germ.comp g f₂ ∈ diffSet f₀ :=
      ⟨f, hf, f₂, hf₂, g, hg, hind.mono_right subset_union_right, rfl⟩
    rw [diffSet_eq_orbit hδ₀] at h₁ h₂
    refine ⟨_, h₁, _, h₂, ?_⟩
    rw [mul_def, ← comp_assoc, comp_assoc g₁ f g, hg.2, comp_id]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.bijective_ofQuotientStabilizer
statement:
theorem bijective_ofQuotientStabilizer (s : hw.Space) :
    Function.Bijective (MulAction.ofQuotientStabilizer (↥hw.prodSubgroup) s)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨MulAction.injective_ofQuotientStabilizer _ s, fun t ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨δ, rfl⟩ := hw.exists_smul_eq s t
  exact ⟨QuotientGroup.mk δ, MulAction.ofQuotientStabilizer_mk _ _ _⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.quotientStabilizerEquiv_mk
statement:
theorem quotientStabilizerEquiv_mk (s : hw.Space) (γ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) :
    hw.quotientStabilizerEquiv s (QuotientGroup.mk γ) = γ • s
proof:
:= by
  change MulAction.ofQuotientStabilizer (↥hw.prodSubgroup) s (QuotientGroup.mk γ) = γ • s
  exact MulAction.ofQuotientStabilizer_mk _ _ _

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.quotientStabilizerEquiv_smul
statement:
theorem quotientStabilizerEquiv_smul (s : hw.Space) (γ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup)
    (q : ↥hw.prodSubgroup ⧸ MulAction.stabilizer (↥hw.prodSubgroup) s) :
    hw.quotientStabilizerEquiv s (γ • q) = γ • hw.quotientStabilizerEquiv s q
proof:
:= by
  change MulAction.ofQuotientStabilizer (↥hw.prodSubgroup) s (γ • q) =
    γ • MulAction.ofQuotientStabilizer (↥hw.prodSubgroup) s q
  exact MulAction.ofQuotientStabilizer_smul _ _ _ _

name: GroupConfig.inLocus_iff
statement:
theorem inLocus_iff {a y : ι → K} :
    InLocus (k := k) a y ↔ ∀ f ∈ locusIdeal k a, aeval y f = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h f hf
    exact (mem_idealOf_iff K).1 (h hf)
  · intro h f hf
    exact (mem_idealOf_iff K).2 (h f hf)

name: GroupConfig.inLocus_self
statement: theorem inLocus_self (a : ι → K) : InLocus (k := k) a a
proof:
:= fun _ hf ↦
  (mem_idealOf_iff K).2 (aeval_eq_zero_of_mem_locusIdeal k hf)

name: GroupConfig.IsGenericOver.inLocus
statement:
theorem IsGenericOver.inLocus {M : IntermediateField k K} {a y : ι → K}
    (h : IsGenericOver M a y) : InLocus (k := k) a y
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf
  rw [← h.locusIdeal_eq] at hf
  exact (mem_idealOf_iff K).2 (aeval_eq_zero_of_mem_locusIdeal (↥M) hf)

name: GroupConfig.map_idealOf_le_of_inLocus
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro f hf
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, mem_idealOf_iff, MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap]
  have hK := (mem_idealOf_iff K).1 (h (map_mem_locusIdeal k hf))
  rwa [MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap] at hK

name: GroupConfig.inLocus_iff_idealOf_le
statement:
theorem inLocus_iff_idealOf_le (a x : ι → K) :
    InLocus (k := k) a x ↔ idealOf k a ≤ idealOf k x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h q hq
    rw [mem_idealOf_iff]
    have hx := (mem_idealOf_iff K).1 (h (map_mem_locusIdeal k hq))
    rwa [MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap] at hx
  · intro h
    change (idealOf k a).map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K)) ≤ idealOf K x
    rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro q hq
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, mem_idealOf_iff, MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap]
    exact (mem_idealOf_iff k).1 (h hq)

name: GroupConfig.aeval_eq_zero_of_inLocus_base
statement:
theorem aeval_eq_zero_of_inLocus_base {a x : ι → K} (h : InLocus (k := k) a x)
    {P : MvPolynomial ι k} (hP : aeval a P = 0) : aeval x P = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hK := (mem_idealOf_iff K).1 (h (map_mem_locusIdeal k ((mem_idealOf_iff k).2 hP)))
  rwa [MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap] at hK

name: GroupConfig.aeval_eq_zero_of_isGenericOver
proof:
:= by
  have hPy : P ∈ idealOf (↥M) y := (mem_idealOf_iff _).2 hP
  have hg : idealOf (↥M) y = (idealOf k a).map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k M)) := hy
  rw [hg] at hPy
  exact (mem_idealOf_iff _).1 (map_idealOf_le_of_inLocus M hx hPy)

name: GroupConfig.inLocus_polynomial_image
proof:
:= by
  change (idealOf k (fun j ↦ aeval a (p j))).map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K)) ≤ _
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro q hq
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, mem_idealOf_iff, MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap]
  let f : MvPolynomial ι M := aeval p (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k M) q)
  have he (y : ι → K) : aeval y f = aeval (fun j ↦ aeval y (p j)) q := by
    dsimp only [f]
    rw [MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply, MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap]
  rw [← he]
  exact aeval_eq_zero_of_isGenericOver ha hx ((he a).trans ((mem_idealOf_iff k).1 hq))

name: GroupConfig.erk_le_of_idealOf_le
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ, -⟩ := exists_surjective_adjoin_of_idealOf_le M hle
  rw [erk_coe_eq_toENat_trdeg_adjoin, erk_coe_eq_toENat_trdeg_adjoin]
  exact OrderHomClass.monotone Cardinal.toENat (trdeg_le_of_surjective π hπ)

name: GroupConfig.erk_le_of_inLocus
statement:
theorem erk_le_of_inLocus [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K] [Finite ι]
    {M : IntermediateField k K} (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K)) {a y : ι → K}
    (h : InLocus (k := k) a y) :
    erk k (M : Set K) (range y) ≤ erk k ∅ (range a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hM a
  have hgen : idealOf (↥M) a' = (idealOf k a).map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥M)) := ha'
  have hle : idealOf (↥M) a' ≤ idealOf (↥M) y := by
    rw [hgen]
    exact map_idealOf_le_of_inLocus M h
  calc erk k (M : Set K) (range y) ≤ erk k (M : Set K) (range a') := erk_le_of_idealOf_le M hle
    _ = erk k ∅ (range a') := ha'.erk_coe_eq
    _ = erk k ∅ (range a) := ha'.erk_empty_eq

name: GroupConfig.isGenericOver_iff_erk_eq
statement:
theorem isGenericOver_iff_erk_eq [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K]
    [Finite ι] {M : IntermediateField k K} (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K)) {a y : ι → K}
    (h : InLocus (k := k) a y) :
    IsGenericOver M a y ↔ erk k (M : Set K) (range y) = erk k ∅ (range a)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hy
    rw [hy.erk_coe_eq, hy.erk_empty_eq]
  · intro heq
    obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hM a
    have hgen : idealOf (↥M) a' = (idealOf k a).map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥M)) :=
      ha'
    have hle : idealOf (↥M) a' ≤ idealOf (↥M) y := by
      rw [hgen]
      exact map_idealOf_le_of_inLocus M h
    have herk : erk k (M : Set K) (range y) = erk k (M : Set K) (range a') := by
      rw [heq, ha'.erk_coe_eq, ha'.erk_empty_eq]
    exact ha'.iff_idealOf_eq.2 (idealOf_eq_of_le_of_erk_eq M hle herk).symm

name: GroupConfig.IsGenericOver.isGenericOver_iff_indepOver
statement:
theorem IsGenericOver.isGenericOver_iff_indepOver [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K]
    [Finite ι] {M M' : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed (↥M)] (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K))
    (hM' : IsSmall k (M' : Set K)) (hMM' : M ≤ M') {a y : ι → K} (hy : IsGenericOver M a y) :
    IsGenericOver M' a y ↔ IndepOver k (M : Set K) (range y) (M' : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hy'
    refine indepOver_of_erk_eq (finite_range y) ?_
    rw [union_eq_right.2 (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 hMM'), hy'.erk_coe_eq, hy.erk_coe_eq]
  · intro hind
    rw [isGenericOver_iff_locusIdeal_eq, locusIdeal_eq_of_indepOver hM hM' hMM' hind]
    exact hy.locusIdeal_eq

name: GroupConfig.erk_union_eq_of_subset_racl_of_isGenericOver
proof:
:= by
  rw [erk_union_eq_of_subset_racl k hZ, hy.erk_coe_eq, hy.erk_empty_eq]

name: GroupConfig.rrefVec_of_isPivot
statement:
theorem rrefVec_of_isPivot {μ : 𝓜} (h : IsPivot W μ) (ν : 𝓜) :
    rrefVec W (μ, ν) = rref W ⟨μ, h⟩ ν
proof:
:= by
  unfold rrefVec
  split_ifs with h'
  · rfl
  · exact absurd h h'

name: GroupConfig.rrefVec_of_not_isPivot
statement: theorem rrefVec_of_not_isPivot {μ : 𝓜} (h : ¬ IsPivot W μ) (ν : 𝓜) : rrefVec W (μ, ν) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold rrefVec
  split_ifs with h'
  · exact absurd h' h
  · rfl

name: GroupConfig.rrefVec_mem_fod
statement: theorem rrefVec_mem_fod (p : 𝓜 × 𝓜) : rrefVec W p ∈ fod W
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with ⟨μ, ν⟩
  by_cases h : IsPivot W μ
  · rw [rrefVec_of_isPivot W h]
    exact rref_apply_mem_fod W _ _
  · rw [rrefVec_of_not_isPivot W h]
    exact zero_mem _

name: GroupConfig.closure_range_rrefVec
statement: theorem closure_range_rrefVec : Subfield.closure (range (rrefVec W)) = fod W
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Subfield.closure_le.2 ?_) ?_
  · rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩
    exact rrefVec_mem_fod W p
  · change Subfield.closure (fodSet W) ≤ _
    refine Subfield.closure_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨⟨μ, ν⟩, rfl⟩
    exact Subfield.subset_closure ⟨(μ.1, ν), rrefVec_of_isPivot W μ.2 ν⟩

name: GroupConfig.rrefVec_map
statement: theorem rrefVec_map (σ : R ≃+* R) : rrefVec (W.map (mapVec σ)) = ⇑σ ∘ rrefVec W
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨μ, ν⟩
  by_cases h : IsPivot W μ
  · rw [Function.comp_apply, rrefVec_of_isPivot _ ((isPivot_map_iff W σ μ).2 h), rref_map,
      mapVec_apply, rrefVec_of_isPivot W h]
    rfl
  · rw [Function.comp_apply, rrefVec_of_not_isPivot _ fun h' ↦ h ((isPivot_map_iff W σ μ).1 h'),
      rrefVec_of_not_isPivot W h, map_zero]

name: GroupConfig.eq_of_rrefVec_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_rrefVec_eq {W W' : Submodule R (𝓜 → R)} (h : rrefVec W = rrefVec W') :
    W = W'
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ V : Submodule R (𝓜 → R), V = Submodule.span R
      {v | ∃ μ, rrefVec V (μ, μ) = 1 ∧ v = fun ν ↦ rrefVec V (μ, ν)} := by
    intro V
    conv_lhs => rw [← span_range_rref V]
    congr 1
    ext v
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨μ, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨μ.1, ?_, funext fun ν ↦ (rrefVec_of_isPivot V μ.2 ν).symm⟩
      rw [rrefVec_of_isPivot V μ.2]
      exact rref_apply_self V μ
    · rintro ⟨μ, hμ, rfl⟩
      have hp : IsPivot V μ := by
        by_contra hp
        rw [rrefVec_of_not_isPivot V hp] at hμ
        exact zero_ne_one hμ
      exact ⟨⟨μ, hp⟩, funext fun ν ↦ (rrefVec_of_isPivot V hp ν).symm⟩
  rw [key W, key W', h]

name: GroupConfig.codeVec_map
statement:
theorem codeVec_map (D : ℕ) (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)) (σ : K ≃+* K) :
    codeVec D (I.map (MvPolynomial.map σ.toRingHom)) = ⇑σ ∘ codeVec D I
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp only [codeVec, Function.comp_apply, degSubspace_map, rrefVec_map]

name: GroupConfig.exists_span_eq
statement:
theorem exists_span_eq (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)) :
    ∃ d, Ideal.span {f | f ∈ I ∧ f.totalDegree ≤ d} = I
proof:
:=
  (exists_forall_idealDefinedOver_iff I).imp fun _ h ↦ h.1

name: GroupConfig.span_eq_of_genDeg_le
statement:
theorem span_eq_of_genDeg_le {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)} {D : ℕ} (hD : genDeg I ≤ D) :
    Ideal.span {f | f ∈ I ∧ f.totalDegree ≤ D} = I
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h0 : Ideal.span {f | f ∈ I ∧ f.totalDegree ≤ genDeg I} = I :=
    Nat.find_spec (exists_span_eq I)
  refine le_antisymm (Ideal.span_le.2 fun f hf ↦ hf.1) ?_
  conv_lhs => rw [← h0]
  exact Ideal.span_mono fun f hf ↦ ⟨hf.1, hf.2.trans hD⟩

name: GroupConfig.genDeg_le
statement:
theorem genDeg_le {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)} {D : ℕ}
    (h : Ideal.span {f | f ∈ I ∧ f.totalDegree ≤ D} = I) : genDeg I ≤ D
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Nat.find_min' (exists_span_eq I) h

name: GroupConfig.idealFod_eq_fod_of_span
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (idealDefinedOver_iff.1 (idealDefinedOver_of_span _ hd (fun _ hf ↦ hf.2)
    (DefinedOver.of_fod_le le_rfl))) (fod_degSubspace_le_idealFod I d)

name: GroupConfig.closure_range_codeVec
statement:
theorem closure_range_codeVec {D : ℕ} {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)} (hD : genDeg I ≤ D) :
    Subfield.closure (range (codeVec D I)) = idealFod I
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Subfield.closure_le.2 ?_) ?_
  · rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩
    exact fod_degSubspace_le_idealFod I p.1 (rrefVec_mem_fod _ p.2)
  · rw [idealFod_eq_fod_of_span (span_eq_of_genDeg_le hD), ← closure_range_rrefVec]
    exact Subfield.closure_mono fun _ ⟨q, hq⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨⟨D, Nat.lt_succ_self D⟩, q⟩, hq⟩

name: GroupConfig.eq_of_codeVec_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_codeVec_eq {D : ℕ} {I J : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)} (hI : genDeg I ≤ D)
    (hJ : genDeg J ≤ D) (h : codeVec D I = codeVec D J) : I = J
proof:
:= by
  have hW : degSubspace I D = degSubspace J D :=
    eq_of_rrefVec_eq (funext fun q ↦ congrFun h ⟨⟨D, Nat.lt_succ_self D⟩, q⟩)
  have key : ∀ L : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K), {f | f ∈ L ∧ f.totalDegree ≤ D} =
      {f | f.totalDegree ≤ D ∧ coeffVec D f ∈ degSubspace L D} := by
    intro L
    ext f
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hfL, hfd⟩
      exact ⟨hfd, coeffVec_mem_degSubspace hfL hfd⟩
    · rintro ⟨hfd, hf⟩
      obtain ⟨f', hf'L, hf'd, hf'⟩ := mem_degSubspace_iff.1 hf
      have hmem : ∀ {p : MvPolynomial ι K}, p.totalDegree ≤ D →
          p ∈ (restrictTotalDegree ι K D : Set (MvPolynomial ι K)) := fun hp ↦ by
        rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_restrictTotalDegree]
        exact hp
      have hff : f' = f := coeffVec_injOn D (hmem hf'd) (hmem hfd) hf'
      exact ⟨hff ▸ hf'L, hfd⟩
  rw [← span_eq_of_genDeg_le hI, ← span_eq_of_genDeg_le hJ, key I, key J, hW]

name: GroupConfig.genDeg_map
statement:
theorem genDeg_map (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)) (σ : K ≃+* K) :
    genDeg (I.map (MvPolynomial.map σ.toRingHom)) = genDeg I
proof:
:= by
  have hψφ : ∀ p : MvPolynomial ι K,
      MvPolynomial.map σ.symm.toRingHom (MvPolynomial.map σ.toRingHom p) = p := fun p ↦ by
    simp [MvPolynomial.map_map, MvPolynomial.map_id]
  have hφψ : ∀ p : MvPolynomial ι K,
      MvPolynomial.map σ.toRingHom (MvPolynomial.map σ.symm.toRingHom p) = p := fun p ↦ by
    simp [MvPolynomial.map_map, MvPolynomial.map_id]
  have hcomp : (MvPolynomial.map σ.symm.toRingHom).comp (MvPolynomial.map σ.toRingHom) =
      RingHom.id (MvPolynomial ι K) := RingHom.ext hψφ
  have hJ : ∀ J : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K),
      (J.map (MvPolynomial.map σ.toRingHom)).map (MvPolynomial.map σ.symm.toRingHom) = J :=
    fun J ↦ by rw [Ideal.map_map, hcomp, Ideal.map_id]
                                                                                           
  have himage : ∀ d, {f | f ∈ I.map (MvPolynomial.map σ.toRingHom) ∧ f.totalDegree ≤ d} =
      MvPolynomial.map σ.toRingHom '' {f | f ∈ I ∧ f.totalDegree ≤ d} := fun d ↦ by
    ext f
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hf, hfd⟩
      refine ⟨MvPolynomial.map σ.symm.toRingHom f, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, hφψ f⟩
      · rw [← hJ I]
        exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hf
      · rwa [totalDegree_map_ringEquiv]
    · rintro ⟨g, ⟨hg, hgd⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hg, by rwa [totalDegree_map_ringEquiv]⟩
  have hiff : ∀ d, Ideal.span {f | f ∈ I.map (MvPolynomial.map σ.toRingHom) ∧
      f.totalDegree ≤ d} = I.map (MvPolynomial.map σ.toRingHom) ↔
      Ideal.span {f | f ∈ I ∧ f.totalDegree ≤ d} = I := fun d ↦ by
    rw [himage, ← Ideal.map_span]
    refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ by rw [h]⟩
    have h' := congrArg (Ideal.map (MvPolynomial.map σ.symm.toRingHom)) h
    rwa [hJ, hJ] at h'
  exact le_antisymm (genDeg_le ((hiff _).2 (span_eq_of_genDeg_le le_rfl)))
    (genDeg_le ((hiff _).1 (span_eq_of_genDeg_le le_rfl)))

name: GroupConfig.Germ.adjoin_range_code
statement: theorem adjoin_range_code (g : Germ k a a') : adjoin k (range g.code) = g.cb
proof:
:= by
  change adjoin k (range (codeVec (genDeg g.graphIdeal) g.graphIdeal)) = g.cb
  rw [cb, ← closure_range_codeVec (le_refl (genDeg g.graphIdeal)), adjoin_coe_closure]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.genDeg_graphIdeal_map
statement:
theorem genDeg_graphIdeal_map (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (g : Germ k a a') :
    genDeg (g.map σ).graphIdeal = genDeg g.graphIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rw [graphIdeal_map, genDeg_map]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.codeVec_graphIdeal_map
statement:
theorem codeVec_graphIdeal_map (D : ℕ) (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (g : Germ k a a') :
    codeVec D (g.map σ).graphIdeal = ⇑σ ∘ codeVec D g.graphIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rw [graphIdeal_map]
  exact codeVec_map D _ σ.toRingEquiv

name: GroupConfig.Germ.eq_of_codeVec_graphIdeal_eq
proof:
:=
  graphIdeal_injective (GroupConfig.eq_of_codeVec_eq hg hg' h)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.genDeg_graphIdeal_of_mem_orbit
statement:
theorem genDeg_graphIdeal_of_mem_orbit {g₀ g : Germ k a a'} (hg : g ∈ orbit g₀) :
    genDeg g.graphIdeal = genDeg g₀.graphIdeal
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := hg
  exact genDeg_graphIdeal_map σ g₀

name: GroupConfig.Germ.isGen_codeVec_of_mem_orbit
statement:
theorem isGen_codeVec_of_mem_orbit (D : ℕ) {g₀ g : Germ k a a'} (hg : g ∈ orbit g₀) :
    IsGen k (codeVec D g₀.graphIdeal) (codeVec D g.graphIdeal)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := hg
  dsimp only
  rw [codeVec_graphIdeal_map]
  exact IsGen.map rfl σ

name: GroupConfig.Germ.exists_mem_orbit_codeVec_eq
statement:
theorem exists_mem_orbit_codeVec_eq (D : ℕ) (g₀ : Germ k a a')
    {c : CodeIndex (ι ⊕ κ) D → K} (hc : IsGen k (codeVec D g₀.graphIdeal) c) :
    ∃ g ∈ orbit g₀, codeVec D g.graphIdeal = c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, -, hσ⟩ := exists_ambientAutomorphism_of_idealOf_eq (k := k) hc.symm
  exact ⟨g₀.map σ, ⟨σ, rfl⟩, by rw [codeVec_graphIdeal_map]; exact funext hσ⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.eq_of_mem_orbit_of_codeVec_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_mem_orbit_of_codeVec_eq {g₀ g g' : Germ k a a'} (hg : g ∈ orbit g₀)
    (hg' : g' ∈ orbit g₀)
    (h : codeVec (genDeg g₀.graphIdeal) g.graphIdeal =
      codeVec (genDeg g₀.graphIdeal) g'.graphIdeal) : g = g'
proof:
:=
  eq_of_codeVec_graphIdeal_eq (genDeg_graphIdeal_of_mem_orbit hg).le
    (genDeg_graphIdeal_of_mem_orbit hg').le h

name: GroupConfig.rref_derivation_eq_zero'
statement:
private theorem rref_derivation_eq_zero' {M : Type*} [Finite M] [LinearOrder M]
    (D : Derivation k C C) (W : Submodule C (M → C))
    (hW : ∀ w ∈ W, (fun i ↦ D (w i)) ∈ W) (μ : Pivots W) (i : M) :
    D (rref W μ i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let w : W := ⟨fun j ↦ D (rref W μ j), hW _ (rref_mem W μ)⟩
  have hw : pivotProj W w = pivotProj W 0 := by
    ext ν
    change D (rref W μ ν) = 0
    rw [rref_apply_pivot]
    split_ifs <;> simp only [Derivation.map_one_eq_zero, map_zero]
  have hw0 : w = 0 := pivotProj_injective W hw
  exact congrArg (fun u : W ↦ (u : M → C) i) hw0

name: GroupConfig.fod_le_derivationConstants'
statement:
private theorem fod_le_derivationConstants' {M : Type*} [Finite M] [LinearOrder M]
    (D : Derivation k C C) (W : Submodule C (M → C))
    (hW : ∀ w ∈ W, (fun i ↦ D (w i)) ∈ W) : fod W ≤ derivationConstants' D
proof:
:= by
  apply Subfield.closure_le.mpr
  rintro _ ⟨⟨μ, i⟩, rfl⟩
  exact rref_derivation_eq_zero' D W hW μ i

name: GroupConfig.coefficientDerivative_coeff
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.coefficientDerivative_C
statement:
private theorem coefficientDerivative_C {ι : Type*} (D : Derivation k C C) (c : C) :
    coefficientDerivative (ι := ι) D (MvPolynomial.C c) = MvPolynomial.C (D c)
proof:
:= by

  ext m

name: GroupConfig.coefficientDerivative_add
proof:
:= by

  simp only [coefficientDerivative_coeff, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add,

name: GroupConfig.coefficientDerivative_mul_X

name: GroupConfig.derivation_aeval_of_coordinates_zero'
statement:
private theorem derivation_aeval_of_coordinates_zero' {E ι : Type*} [CommRing E]
    [Algebra k E] [Algebra C E] (D : Derivation k C C) (D₀ : Derivation k E E)
    (hcoeff : ∀ c, D₀ (algebraMap C E c) = algebraMap C E (D c))
    (x : ι → E) (hx : ∀ i, D₀ (x i) = 0) (p : MvPolynomial ι C) :
    D₀ (aeval x p) = aeval x (coefficientDerivative D p)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C c => simpa only [aeval_C, coefficientDerivative_C] using hcoeff c
  | add p q hp hq =>
    simp only [coefficientDerivative_add, map_add, hp, hq]
  | mul_X p i hp =>
    rw [map_mul, Derivation.leibniz, aeval_X, hx, smul_zero, zero_add, hp,
      coefficientDerivative_mul_X, map_mul, aeval_X, smul_eq_mul]
    exact mul_comm _ _

name: GroupConfig.coefficientDerivative_mem_ker
statement:
private theorem coefficientDerivative_mem_ker {E ι : Type*} [CommRing E]
    [Algebra k E] [Algebra C E] (D : Derivation k C C) (D₀ : Derivation k E E)
    (hcoeff : ∀ c, D₀ (algebraMap C E c) = algebraMap C E (D c))
    (x : ι → E) (hx : ∀ i, D₀ (x i) = 0) {p : MvPolynomial ι C}
    (hp : p ∈ RingHom.ker (aeval x).toRingHom) :
    coefficientDerivative D p ∈ RingHom.ker (aeval x).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  change aeval x (coefficientDerivative D p) = 0
  rw [← derivation_aeval_of_coordinates_zero' D D₀ hcoeff x hx,
    show aeval x p = 0 from hp, map_zero]

name: GroupConfig.coefficientDerivative_totalDegree_le
statement:
private theorem coefficientDerivative_totalDegree_le {ι : Type*} (D : Derivation k C C)
    (p : MvPolynomial ι C) : (coefficientDerivative D p).totalDegree ≤ p.totalDegree
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply totalDegree_le_of_support_subset
  intro m hm
  apply mem_support_iff.mpr
  intro h0
  have h := mem_support_iff.mp hm
  exact h (by rw [coefficientDerivative_coeff, h0, map_zero])

name: GroupConfig.idealFod_le_derivationConstants'
statement:
private theorem idealFod_le_derivationConstants' {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    (D : Derivation k C C) (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι C))
    (hI : ∀ p ∈ I, coefficientDerivative D p ∈ I) : idealFod I ≤ derivationConstants' D
proof:
:= by
  apply iSup_le
  intro d
  apply fod_le_derivationConstants'
  intro w hw
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpd, rfl⟩ := mem_degSubspace_iff.mp hw
  refine mem_degSubspace_iff.mpr ⟨coefficientDerivative D p, hI p hp,
    (coefficientDerivative_totalDegree_le D p).trans hpd, ?_⟩
  ext m
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.coefficientDerivative_mem_variationGraphKernel
statement:
theorem coefficientDerivative_mem_variationGraphKernel
    (g : FractionRing (C ⊗[k] F) ≃ₐ[C] FractionRing (C ⊗[k] F))
    (D : Derivation k C C) (hD : coefficientVariation (k := k) g D = 0) (u : ι → F) :
    let x : ι → FractionRing (C ⊗[k] F)
proof:
:= fun i ↦ algebraMap (C ⊗[k] F) _ ((1 : C) ⊗ₜ[k] u i)
    let z := Sum.elim x (fun i ↦ g (x i))
    ∀ P ∈ RingHom.ker (aeval (R := C) z).toRingHom,
      coefficientDerivative D P ∈ RingHom.ker (aeval (R := C) z).toRingHom := by
  intro x z P hP
  let conn := coefficientConnection (F := F) D
  have hcomm := (coefficientVariation_eq_zero_iff (k := k) g D).mp hD
  have hx (i : ι) : conn (x i) = 0 := by
    change coefficientConnection D (algebraMap F (FractionRing (C ⊗[k] F)) (u i)) = 0
    exact coefficientConnection_function D _
  have hz (j : ι ⊕ ι) : conn (z j) = 0 := by
    cases j with
    | inl i => exact hx i
    | inr i =>
      change conn (g (x i)) = 0
      exact (hcomm (x i)).trans (by rw [hx, map_zero])
  exact coefficientDerivative_mem_ker D (conn.restrictScalars k)
    (fun c ↦ coefficientConnection_coeff D c) z hz hP

name: GroupConfig.Germ.derivation_eq_zero_of_graph_stable
statement:
theorem Germ.derivation_eq_zero_of_graph_stable (g : Germ k v v)
    (D : Derivation k g.cb g.cb)
    (hD : ∀ p ∈ g.graphIdeal.comap (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap g.cb K)),
      coefficientDerivative D p ∈
        g.graphIdeal.comap (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap g.cb K))) : D = 0
proof:
:= by
  let J := g.graphIdeal.comap (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap g.cb K))
  let U := derivationConstantsIntermediate' D
  have hJ : idealFod J ≤ U.toSubfield := idealFod_le_derivationConstants' D J hD
  have hdef := Germ.idealDefinedOver_graphIdeal g le_rfl
  change g.graphIdeal = J.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap g.cb K)) at hdef
  have hfod : idealFod g.graphIdeal = (idealFod J).map (algebraMap g.cb K) := by
    rw [hdef, idealFod_map_algebraMap]
  have hcb : g.cb ≤ U.map g.cb.val := by
    apply IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff.mpr
    intro c hc
    rw [hfod] at hc
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hc
    exact ⟨a, hJ ha, rfl⟩
  apply Derivation.ext
  intro c
  change D c = 0
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hac⟩ := hcb c.property
  have heq : a = c := Subtype.val_injective hac
  exact heq ▸ ha

name: GroupConfig.Germ.erk_cb_mul_eq'
statement:
theorem erk_cb_mul_eq' {γ δ : Germ k a a} (hδ : IsUnit δ) (C : Set K) :
    erk k (C ∪ δ.cb) ((δ * γ).cb : Set K) = erk k (C ∪ δ.cb) (γ.cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ', hδ'⟩ := isUnit_iff.1 hδ
  refine erk_eq_of_subset_racl ?_ ?_
  · refine (cb_comp_le_racl δ γ).trans (racl_mono (k := k) ?_)
    exact union_subset subset_union_right (subset_union_right.trans subset_union_left)
  · have hγ : γ = δ' * (δ * γ) := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, show δ' * δ = 1 from hδ'.1, one_mul]
    have h1 : γ.cb ≤ racl k (((δ * γ).cb : Set K) ∪ δ'.cb) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [hγ]
      exact cb_comp_le_racl δ' (δ * γ)
    refine h1.trans (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset ?_ ?_))
    · exact subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
    · exact hδ'.cb_le.trans (racl_mono (k := k) (subset_union_right.trans subset_union_left))

name: GroupConfig.Germ.indepOver_of_cb_le
proof:
:= by
  refine (indepOver_racl_left_iff.2 hg).mono_left ?_
  rw [empty_union]
  exact hle

name: GroupConfig.Germ.evalGen_map
statement:
theorem evalGen_map {κ : Type*} [Finite κ] {a' : κ → K} (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (g : Germ k a a')
    {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k a y) (h : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (g.cb : Set K)) :
    (g.map σ).evalGen (⇑σ ∘ y) = ⇑σ ∘ g.evalGen y
proof:
:= by
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (g.cb : Set K)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hF : IsSmall k ((racl k (g.cb : Set K) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    g.isSmall_cb.racl
  have hmap : racl k ((g.map σ).cb : Set K) = (racl k (g.cb : Set K)).map σ.toAlgHom := by
    rw [cb_map, coe_map, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, racl_map]
  unfold evalGen
  rw [hmap]
  exact g.eval_map σ hF (subset_racl k _) (g.isGenericOver_racl_cb hy h)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.evalGen_id
statement: theorem evalGen_id {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k a y) : (Germ.id (k := k) a).evalGen y = y
proof:
:= by
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k ((Germ.id (k := k) a).cb : Set K)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (∅ : Set K)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hF :
      IsSmall k ((racl k ((Germ.id (k := k) a).cb : Set K) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (Germ.id (k := k) a).isSmall_cb.racl
  have hind : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) ((Germ.id (k := k) a).cb : Set K) := by
    have h0 : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (∅ : Set K) := fun _ _ _ ↦ by rw [union_empty]
    refine (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 h0).mono_right ?_
    rw [empty_union]
    exact cb_id_le a (racl k ∅)
  unfold evalGen
  exact eval_id hF ((Germ.id (k := k) a).isGenericOver_racl_cb hy hind)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.evalGen_one
statement: theorem evalGen_one {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k a y) : (1 : Germ k a a).evalGen y = y
proof:
:=
  evalGen_id hy

name: GroupConfig.Germ.evalGen_comp
statement:
theorem evalGen_comp {κ μ : Type*} [Finite κ] [Finite μ] {a' : κ → K} {a'' : μ → K}
    (g' : Germ k a' a'') (g : Germ k a a') {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k a y)
    (h : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) ((g'.cb : Set K) ∪ g.cb)) :
    (Germ.comp g' g).evalGen y = g'.evalGen (g.evalGen y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hF_def⟩ : ∃ F : IntermediateField k K, F = racl k ((g'.cb : Set K) ∪ g.cb) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥F := hF_def ▸ isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hF : IsSmall k (F : Set K) := hF_def ▸ (g'.isSmall_cb.union g.isSmall_cb).racl
  have hg' : g'.cb ≤ F := by
    rw [hF_def]
    exact subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hg : g.cb ≤ F := by
    rw [hF_def]
    exact subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hgg' : (Germ.comp g' g).cb ≤ F := cb_comp_le g' g hF hg hg'
  have hyF : IsGenericOver F a y := by
    rw [hF_def]
    exact hy.isGenericOver_racl (g'.isSmall_cb.union g.isSmall_cb) h
  rw [evalGen_eq _ hF hgg' hyF, evalGen_eq g hF hg hyF,
    evalGen_eq g' hF hg' (g.isGenericOver_eval hF hg hyF)]
  exact comp_eval g' g hF hg hg' hyF

name: GroupConfig.Germ.evalGen_mul
statement:
theorem evalGen_mul (γ δ : Germ k a a) {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k a y)
    (h : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) ((γ.cb : Set K) ∪ δ.cb)) :
    (γ * δ).evalGen y = γ.evalGen (δ.evalGen y)
proof:
:=
  evalGen_comp γ δ hy h

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsInverse.evalGen_evalGen
proof:
:= by
  have hind' : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) ((h'.cb : Set K) ∪ h.cb) := by
    refine (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hind).mono_right ?_
    rw [empty_union]
    exact union_subset hi.cb_le (subset_racl k _)
  rw [← evalGen_comp h' h hy hind', hi.1, evalGen_id hy]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.isUnit_of_mem
statement: theorem isUnit_of_mem {g : Germ k a a} (hg : g ∈ orbit g₀) : IsUnit g
proof:
:=
  isUnit_of_mem_orbit hw.isUnit hg

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.erk_cb_of_mem
statement:
theorem erk_cb_of_mem {g : Germ k a a} (hg : g ∈ orbit g₀) :
    erk k ∅ (g.cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K)
proof:
:=
  erk_cb_eq_of_mem_orbit hg

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.prod_indep
statement:
theorem prod_indep {g₁ g₂ : Germ k a a} (h₁ : g₁ ∈ orbit g₀) (h₂ : g₂ ∈ orbit g₀)
    (hind : IndepOver k ∅ (g₁.cb : Set K) g₂.cb) (hprod : g₁ * g₂ ∈ orbit g₀) :
    IndepOver k ∅ ((g₁ * g₂).cb : Set K) g₁.cb ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ ((g₁ * g₂).cb : Set K) g₂.cb
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · refine indepOver_cb_of_erk_eq _ ?_
    rw [erk_cb_mul_eq' (hw.isUnit_of_mem h₁) ∅, erk_cb_eq_of_indepOver hind.symm,
      erk_cb_of_mem h₂, erk_cb_of_mem hprod]
  · refine indepOver_cb_of_erk_eq _ ?_
    rw [erk_cb_mul_eq (hw.isUnit_of_mem h₂) ∅, erk_cb_eq_of_indepOver hind,
      erk_cb_of_mem h₁, erk_cb_of_mem hprod]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.threetwo
statement:
theorem threetwo {g₁ g₂ g₃ : Germ k a a} (h₁ : g₁ ∈ orbit g₀) (h₂ : g₂ ∈ orbit g₀)
    (h₃ : g₃ ∈ orbit g₀) :
    ∃ g₅ ∈ orbit g₀, ∃ g₆ ∈ orbit g₀, g₁ * g₂ * g₃ = g₅ * g₆
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgind⟩ := exists_mem_orbit_indepOver g₀
    ((g₁.isSmall_cb.union g₂.isSmall_cb).union g₃.isSmall_cb)
  obtain ⟨g', hg'⟩ := isUnit_iff.1 (hw.isUnit_of_mem hg)
  have hg'mem : g' ∈ orbit g₀ := hw.inv g hg g' hg'
  have hg'ind : IndepOver k ∅ (g'.cb : Set K) ((g₁.cb : Set K) ∪ g₂.cb ∪ g₃.cb) :=
    indepOver_of_cb_le hg'.cb_le hgind
  
  have h12 : IndepOver k ∅ (g'.cb : Set K) g₂.cb :=
    hg'ind.mono_right (subset_union_right.trans subset_union_left)
  have hg''mem : g' * g₂ ∈ orbit g₀ := hw.comp g' hg'mem g₂ h₂ h12
  have hrk : erk k ((g₃.cb : Set K) ∪ g₂.cb) ((g' * g₂).cb : Set K) =
      erk k ∅ ((g' * g₂).cb : Set K) := by
    rw [erk_cb_mul_eq (hw.isUnit_of_mem h₂) (g₃.cb : Set K), erk_cb_of_mem hg''mem]
    have h23 : (g₃.cb : Set K) ∪ g₂.cb ⊆ (g₁.cb : Set K) ∪ g₂.cb ∪ g₃.cb :=
      union_subset subset_union_right (subset_union_right.trans subset_union_left)
    have := erk_cb_eq_of_indepOver (hg'ind.mono_right h23)
    rw [empty_union] at this
    rw [this, erk_cb_of_mem hg'mem]
  have h''3 : IndepOver k ∅ ((g' * g₂).cb : Set K) g₃.cb := by
    refine indepOver_cb_of_erk_eq _ (le_antisymm ?_ ?_)
    · rw [empty_union]
      exact erk_base_mono k (empty_subset _) _
    · rw [empty_union, ← hrk]
      exact erk_base_mono k subset_union_left _
  have h1g : IndepOver k ∅ (g₁.cb : Set K) g.cb :=
    (hgind.mono_right (subset_union_left.trans subset_union_left)).symm
  refine ⟨g₁ * g, hw.comp g₁ h₁ g hg h1g, g' * g₂ * g₃, hw.comp _ hg''mem g₃ h₃ h''3, ?_⟩
  have hgg' : g * g' = 1 := hg'.2
  calc g₁ * g₂ * g₃ = g₁ * (1 * (g₂ * g₃)) := by rw [one_mul, mul_assoc]
    _ = g₁ * ((g * g') * (g₂ * g₃)) := by rw [hgg']
    _ = g₁ * g * (g' * g₂ * g₃) := by simp only [mul_assoc]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.mem_prodSet_of_mem
statement: theorem mem_prodSet_of_mem {g : Germ k a a} (hg : g ∈ orbit g₀) : g ∈ prodSet g₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hind⟩ := exists_mem_orbit_indepOver g₀ g.isSmall_cb
  obtain ⟨h', hh'⟩ := isUnit_iff.1 (hw.isUnit_of_mem hh)
  refine ⟨g * h, hw.comp g hg h hh hind.symm, h', hw.inv h hh h' hh', ?_⟩
  rw [mul_assoc, show h * h' = 1 from hh'.2, mul_one]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.one_mem_prodSet
statement: theorem one_mem_prodSet : (1 : Germ k a a) ∈ prodSet g₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g₀', hg₀'⟩ := isUnit_iff.1 hw.isUnit
  exact ⟨g₀, self_mem_orbit g₀, g₀', hw.inv g₀ (self_mem_orbit g₀) g₀' hg₀', hg₀'.2.symm⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.mul_mem_prodSet
statement:
theorem mul_mem_prodSet {γ δ : Germ k a a} (hγ : γ ∈ prodSet g₀) (hδ : δ ∈ prodSet g₀) :
    γ * δ ∈ prodSet g₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g₁, h₁, g₂, h₂, rfl⟩ := hγ
  obtain ⟨g₃, h₃, g₄, h₄, rfl⟩ := hδ
  obtain ⟨g₅, h₅, g₆, h₆, h56⟩ := hw.threetwo h₁ h₂ h₃
  obtain ⟨g₇, h₇, g₈, h₈, h78⟩ := hw.threetwo h₅ h₆ h₄
  refine ⟨g₇, h₇, g₈, h₈, ?_⟩
  rw [← h78, ← h56, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_assoc]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.inv_mem_prodSet
statement:
theorem inv_mem_prodSet {γ γ' : Germ k a a} (hγ : γ ∈ prodSet g₀) (hi : IsInverse γ' γ) :
    γ' ∈ prodSet g₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g₁, h₁, g₂, h₂, rfl⟩ := hγ
  obtain ⟨g₁', hg₁'⟩ := isUnit_iff.1 (hw.isUnit_of_mem h₁)
  obtain ⟨g₂', hg₂'⟩ := isUnit_iff.1 (hw.isUnit_of_mem h₂)
  have hinv : IsInverse (g₂' * g₁') (g₁ * g₂) := by
    constructor
    · change g₂' * g₁' * (g₁ * g₂) = 1
      rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc g₁', show g₁' * g₁ = 1 from hg₁'.1, one_mul,
        show g₂' * g₂ = 1 from hg₂'.1]
    · change g₁ * g₂ * (g₂' * g₁') = 1
      rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc g₂, show g₂ * g₂' = 1 from hg₂'.2, one_mul,
        show g₁ * g₁' = 1 from hg₁'.2]
  rw [hi.unique hinv]
  exact ⟨g₂', hw.inv g₂ h₂ g₂' hg₂', g₁', hw.inv g₁ h₁ g₁' hg₁', rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.map_mem_prodSet
statement:
theorem map_mem_prodSet {γ : Germ k a a} (hγ : γ ∈ prodSet g₀) (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) :
    γ.map σ ∈ prodSet g₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g₁, h₁, g₂, h₂, rfl⟩ := hγ
  exact ⟨g₁.map σ, map_mem_orbit h₁ σ, g₂.map σ, map_mem_orbit h₂ σ, comp_map σ g₁ g₂⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.mem_prodSubgroup
statement:
theorem mem_prodSubgroup {u : (Germ k a a)ˣ} :
    u ∈ hw.prodSubgroup ↔ (u : Germ k a a) ∈ prodSet g₀
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.closure_eq
statement:
theorem closure_eq :
    Subgroup.closure {u : (Germ k a a)ˣ | (u : Germ k a a) ∈ orbit g₀} = hw.prodSubgroup
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ((Subgroup.closure_le _).2 fun u hu ↦ hw.mem_prodSet_of_mem hu) ?_
  intro u hu
  obtain ⟨g₁, h₁, g₂, h₂, hu'⟩ := hu
  obtain ⟨g₁', hg₁'⟩ := isUnit_iff.1 (hw.isUnit_of_mem h₁)
  obtain ⟨g₂', hg₂'⟩ := isUnit_iff.1 (hw.isUnit_of_mem h₂)
  let u₁ : (Germ k a a)ˣ := ⟨g₁, g₁', hg₁'.2, hg₁'.1⟩
  let u₂ : (Germ k a a)ˣ := ⟨g₂, g₂', hg₂'.2, hg₂'.1⟩
  have hu₁ : u₁ ∈ Subgroup.closure {u : (Germ k a a)ˣ | (u : Germ k a a) ∈ orbit g₀} :=
    Subgroup.subset_closure h₁
  have hu₂ : u₂ ∈ Subgroup.closure {u : (Germ k a a)ˣ | (u : Germ k a a) ∈ orbit g₀} :=
    Subgroup.subset_closure h₂
  have : u = u₁ * u₂ := Units.ext hu'
  rw [this]
  exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ hu₁ hu₂

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.isUnit_of_mem_prodSet
statement: theorem isUnit_of_mem_prodSet {γ : Germ k a a} (hγ : γ ∈ prodSet g₀) : IsUnit γ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g₁, h₁, g₂, h₂, rfl⟩ := hγ
  exact (hw.isUnit_of_mem h₁).mul (hw.isUnit_of_mem h₂)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.prod_mul_mem
statement:
theorem prod_mul_mem {g₁ g₂ h : Germ k a a} (h₁ : g₁ ∈ orbit g₀) (h₂ : g₂ ∈ orbit g₀)
    (hh : h ∈ orbit g₀) (hind : IndepOver k ∅ (h.cb : Set K) ((g₁.cb : Set K) ∪ g₂.cb)) :
    g₁ * g₂ * h ∈ orbit g₀ ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ ((g₁ * g₂ * h).cb : Set K) ((g₁.cb : Set K) ∪ g₂.cb)
proof:
:= by
  have hhC : erk k ((g₁.cb : Set K) ∪ g₂.cb) (h.cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (h.cb : Set K) := by
    have := erk_cb_eq_of_indepOver hind
    rwa [empty_union] at this
  have hg₂h : g₂ * h ∈ orbit g₀ :=
    hw.comp g₂ h₂ h hh (hind.mono_right subset_union_right).symm
  have hrk : erk k ((g₁.cb : Set K) ∪ g₂.cb) ((g₂ * h).cb : Set K) =
      erk k ∅ ((g₂ * h).cb : Set K) := by
    rw [erk_cb_mul_eq' (hw.isUnit_of_mem h₂) (g₁.cb : Set K), hhC, erk_cb_of_mem hh,
      erk_cb_of_mem hg₂h]
  have hg₂h1 : IndepOver k ∅ ((g₂ * h).cb : Set K) g₁.cb := by
    refine indepOver_cb_of_erk_eq _ (le_antisymm ?_ ?_)
    · rw [empty_union]
      exact erk_base_mono k (empty_subset _) _
    · rw [empty_union, ← hrk]
      exact erk_base_mono k subset_union_left _
  have hmem : g₁ * g₂ * h ∈ orbit g₀ := by
    rw [mul_assoc]
    exact hw.comp g₁ h₁ _ hg₂h hg₂h1.symm
  refine ⟨hmem, indepOver_cb_of_erk_eq _ ?_⟩
  have hγcb : ((g₁ * g₂).cb : Set K) ⊆ racl k ((g₁.cb : Set K) ∪ g₂.cb) :=
    (cb_comp_le_racl g₁ g₂).trans (racl_mono (k := k) (union_comm _ _).le)
  rw [empty_union, ← erk_base_union_of_subset_racl k hγcb,
    erk_cb_mul_eq' ((hw.isUnit_of_mem h₁).mul (hw.isUnit_of_mem h₂)),
    erk_base_union_of_subset_racl k hγcb, hhC, erk_cb_of_mem hh, erk_cb_of_mem hmem]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.mul_mem_of_indepOver
statement:
theorem mul_mem_of_indepOver {γ h : Germ k a a} (hγ : γ ∈ prodSet g₀) (hh : h ∈ orbit g₀)
    (hind : IndepOver k ∅ (h.cb : Set K) γ.cb) :
    γ * h ∈ orbit g₀ ∧ IndepOver k ∅ ((γ * h).cb : Set K) γ.cb
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g₁, h₁, g₂, h₂, rfl⟩ := hγ
  obtain ⟨h', hh', hind'⟩ :=
    exists_mem_orbit_indepOver g₀ (g₁.isSmall_cb.union g₂.isSmall_cb)
  obtain ⟨hmem', hind''⟩ := hw.prod_mul_mem h₁ h₂ hh' hind'
  have hγcb : ((g₁ * g₂).cb : Set K) ⊆ racl k ((g₁.cb : Set K) ∪ g₂.cb) :=
    (cb_comp_le_racl g₁ g₂).trans (racl_mono (k := k) (union_comm _ _).le)
  have hind'γ : IndepOver k ∅ (h'.cb : Set K) (g₁ * g₂).cb := by
    refine (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hind').mono_right ?_
    rw [empty_union]
    exact hγcb
  have hind''γ : IndepOver k ∅ ((g₁ * g₂ * h').cb : Set K) (g₁ * g₂).cb := by
    refine (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hind'').mono_right ?_
    rw [empty_union]
    exact hγcb
  
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := exists_algEquiv_of_mem_orbit hh' hh (g₁ * g₂).isSmall_cb hind'γ hind
  have hfix : (g₁ * g₂).map (τ.restrictScalars k) = g₁ * g₂ := by
    refine (map_eq_self_iff _ _).2 fun x hx ↦ ?_
    change τ x = x
    exact τ.commutes ⟨x, subset_racl k _ hx⟩
  have hmap : (g₁ * g₂ * h').map (τ.restrictScalars k) = g₁ * g₂ * h := by
    rw [mul_def (g₁ * g₂) h', comp_map, ← mul_def, hfix, hτ]
  refine ⟨hmap ▸ map_mem_orbit hmem' _, ?_⟩
  have hγimg : ⇑(τ.restrictScalars k) '' ((g₁ * g₂).cb : Set K) = (g₁ * g₂).cb := by
    conv_rhs => rw [← hfix]
    rw [cb_map, coe_map, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom]
  have := hind''γ.image (τ.restrictScalars k)
  rwa [image_empty, hγimg, ← AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, ← coe_map, ← cb_map, hmap] at this

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.mem_mul_of_indepOver
statement:
theorem mem_mul_of_indepOver {γ h : Germ k a a} (hγ : γ ∈ prodSet g₀) (hh : h ∈ orbit g₀)
    (hind : IndepOver k ∅ (h.cb : Set K) γ.cb) :
    h * γ ∈ orbit g₀ ∧ IndepOver k ∅ ((h * γ).cb : Set K) γ.cb
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨γ', hγ'⟩ := isUnit_iff.1 (hw.isUnit_of_mem_prodSet hγ)
  obtain ⟨h', hh'⟩ := isUnit_iff.1 (hw.isUnit_of_mem hh)
  have hind' : IndepOver k ∅ (h'.cb : Set K) γ'.cb := by
    refine indepOver_of_cb_le hh'.cb_le ((indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hind).mono_right ?_)
    rw [empty_union]
    exact hγ'.cb_le
  obtain ⟨hmem, hindm⟩ :=
    hw.mul_mem_of_indepOver (hw.inv_mem_prodSet hγ hγ') (hw.inv h hh h' hh') hind'
  have hinv : IsInverse (h * γ) (γ' * h') := by
    constructor
    · change h * γ * (γ' * h') = 1
      rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc γ, show γ * γ' = 1 from hγ'.2, one_mul,
        show h * h' = 1 from hh'.2]
    · change γ' * h' * (h * γ) = 1
      rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc h', show h' * h = 1 from hh'.1, one_mul,
        show γ' * γ = 1 from hγ'.1]
  refine ⟨hw.inv _ hmem _ hinv, ?_⟩
  refine (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 (indepOver_of_cb_le hinv.cb_le hindm)).mono_right ?_
  rw [empty_union]
  exact hγ'.symm.cb_le

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.erk_cb_le_of_mem_prodSet
statement:
theorem erk_cb_le_of_mem_prodSet {γ : Germ k a a} (hγ : γ ∈ prodSet g₀) :
    erk k ∅ (γ.cb : Set K) ≤ erk k ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hind⟩ := exists_mem_orbit_indepOver g₀ γ.isSmall_cb
  obtain ⟨hmem, -⟩ := hw.mem_mul_of_indepOver hγ hh hind
  rw [← erk_cb_eq_of_indepOver hind.symm, ← erk_cb_mul_eq' (hw.isUnit_of_mem hh) ∅,
    ← erk_cb_of_mem hmem]
  exact erk_base_mono k (empty_subset _) _

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.mem_orbit_iff_erk_eq
statement:
theorem mem_orbit_iff_erk_eq {γ : Germ k a a} (hγ : γ ∈ prodSet g₀) :
    γ ∈ orbit g₀ ↔ erk k ∅ (γ.cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨erk_cb_of_mem, fun hrk ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hind⟩ := exists_mem_orbit_indepOver g₀ γ.isSmall_cb
  obtain ⟨hmem, -⟩ := hw.mem_mul_of_indepOver hγ hh hind
  obtain ⟨h', hh'⟩ := isUnit_iff.1 (hw.isUnit_of_mem hh)
  have hind2 : IndepOver k ∅ ((h * γ).cb : Set K) h.cb := by
    refine indepOver_cb_of_erk_eq _ ?_
    rw [erk_cb_mul_eq' (hw.isUnit_of_mem hh) ∅, erk_cb_eq_of_indepOver hind.symm, hrk,
      erk_cb_of_mem hmem]
  have : h' * (h * γ) = γ := by rw [← mul_assoc, show h' * h = 1 from hh'.1, one_mul]
  rw [← this]
  exact hw.comp h' (hw.inv h hh h' hh') _ hmem (indepOver_of_cb_le hh'.cb_le hind2.symm)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.keyrank
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hmem, -⟩ := hw.mem_mul_of_indepOver hγ hh (hind.mono_right subset_union_left)
  refine ⟨hmem, indepOver_cb_of_erk_eq _ (le_antisymm ?_ ?_)⟩
  · rw [empty_union]
    exact erk_base_mono k (empty_subset _) _
  · rw [empty_union]
    calc erk k ∅ ((h * γ).cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K) := erk_cb_of_mem hmem
      _ = erk k ∅ (h.cb : Set K) := (erk_cb_of_mem hh).symm
      _ = erk k (∅ ∪ ((γ.cb : Set K) ∪ w)) (h.cb : Set K) :=
          (erk_cb_eq_of_indepOver hind).symm
      _ = erk k (w ∪ γ.cb) (h.cb : Set K) := by rw [empty_union, union_comm]
      _ = erk k (w ∪ γ.cb) ((h * γ).cb : Set K) :=
          (erk_cb_mul_eq (hw.isUnit_of_mem_prodSet hγ) w).symm
      _ ≤ erk k w ((h * γ).cb : Set K) := erk_base_mono k subset_union_left _

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.exists_parameterGerm_eq_germ
statement:
theorem exists_parameterGerm_eq_germ (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ)
    (hF : F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim b y)) (hFz : F.eval (Sum.elim b y) = z) :
    ∃ hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' b, F.parameterGerm hu = h.germ
proof:
:= by
  have hy := h.isGenericOver_left
  have hz := h.isGenericOver_right
  have hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' b := by
    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := hy.exists_algEquiv hu
    
    have hθ : ⇑(ρ.restrictScalars k) ∘ Sum.elim b y = Sum.elim b u := by
      funext i
      cases i with
      | inl i => exact ρ.commutes ⟨b i, subset_racl k _ (mem_range_self i)⟩
      | inr i => exact hρ i
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hθ]
      exact (F.isDefinedAt_comp_iff _ _).2 hF
    · rw [← hθ, F.eval_comp, hFz]
      exact hz.comp ρ
  refine ⟨hu, h.eq_germ (F.cb_parameterGerm_le hu) ?_⟩
  have hM : IsSmall k ((racl k (range b) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range b)).racl
  rw [Germ.evalGen_eq _ hM (F.cb_parameterGerm_le hu) hy, F.eval_parameterGerm hu hy, hFz]

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.exists_parameterGerm_eq
statement:
theorem exists_parameterGerm_eq (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ)
    (hF : F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim b y)) (hFz : F.eval (Sum.elim b y) = z) (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) :
    ∃ hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' (⇑σ ∘ b), F.parameterGerm hu = h.germ.map σ
proof:
:= by
  have hσ : ⇑σ ∘ Sum.elim b y = Sum.elim (⇑σ ∘ b) (⇑σ ∘ y) := Sum.comp_elim _ _ _
  rw [h.germ_map σ]
  refine (h.map σ).exists_parameterGerm_eq_germ F ?_ ?_
  · rw [← hσ]
    exact (F.isDefinedAt_comp_iff _ _).2 hF
  · rw [← hσ, F.eval_comp, hFz]

:=

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsGraphGeneric.of_le
statement:
theorem IsGraphGeneric.of_le {g : Germ k a a'} {F F' : IntermediateField k K} (hF : g.cb ≤ F)
    (hFF' : F ≤ F') {w : (ι ⊕ κ) → K} (h : g.IsGraphGeneric F' w) : g.IsGraphGeneric F w
proof:
:= by

name: GroupConfig.Germ.comap_rename_inl_graphIdeal
statement:
theorem comap_rename_inl_graphIdeal (g : Germ k a a') :
    g.graphIdeal.comap
        (rename (Sum.inl : ι → ι ⊕ κ) : MvPolynomial ι K →ₐ[K] MvPolynomial (ι ⊕ κ) K) =
      locusIdeal k a
proof:

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsGraphGeneric.isGenericOver_fst
statement:
theorem IsGraphGeneric.isGenericOver_fst {g : Germ k a a'} {F : IntermediateField k K}
    {y : ι → K} {z : κ → K} (h : g.IsGraphGeneric F (Sum.elim y z)) : IsGenericOver F a y
proof:
:= by

  unfold locusIdeal

statement:
theorem IsGraphGeneric.isGenericOver_snd {g : Germ k a a'} {F : IntermediateField k K}
    {y : ι → K} {z : κ → K} (h : g.IsGraphGeneric F (Sum.elim y z)) : IsGenericOver F a' z
proof:

  unfold locusIdeal
  rw [comap_rename_map_eq _ Sum.inr_injective, Representative.comap_rename_inr_idealOf]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.exists_rep
statement:
theorem exists_rep (g : Germ k a a') {F : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed (↥F)]
    (hF : IsSmall k (F : Set K)) (hcb : g.cb ≤ F) {W : Set K} (hW : IsSmall k W) :
    ∃ r : Representative k K a a',
      (⟦r⟧ : Germ k a a') = g ∧ F ≤ r.M ∧ IndepOver k (F : Set K) (r.M : Set K) W
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r₀, rfl⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep g
  
  have hM₁ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k ((F : Set K) ∪ r₀.M)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hM₁s : IsSmall k ((racl k ((F : Set K) ∪ r₀.M) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (hF.union r₀.isSmall).racl
  have hle : r₀.M ≤ racl k ((F : Set K) ∪ r₀.M) := subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hFle : F ≤ racl k ((F : Set K) ∪ r₀.M) := subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hr₁ : (⟦r₀.extend hM₁ hM₁s hle⟧ : Germ k a a') = ⟦r₀⟧ :=
    Quotient.sound (r₀.extend_equivalent hM₁ hM₁s hle)
  
  obtain ⟨S, -, hSfin, hS⟩ := hM₁s.exists_finite_racl_eq
  have hM₁eq : racl k S = racl k ((F : Set K) ∪ r₀.M) := by rw [hS, racl_racl]
  have _ : Finite ↥S := hSfin.to_subtype
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := exists_algEquiv_indepOver (M := F) hF (fun s : S ↦ (s : K)) hW
  let τ' : K ≃ₐ[k] K := τ.restrictScalars k
  have hτF : ∀ x ∈ F, τ' x = x := fun x hx ↦ τ.commutes ⟨x, hx⟩
  refine ⟨(r₀.extend hM₁ hM₁s hle).map τ', ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Germ.map_mk, hr₁]
    rw [← hr₁]
    exact (Germ.map_eq_self_iff τ' _).2 fun x hx ↦ hτF x (hcb (hr₁ ▸ hx))
  · intro x hx
    exact ⟨x, hFle hx, hτF x hx⟩
  · 
    have himage : (((r₀.extend hM₁ hM₁s hle).map τ').M : Set K) =
        racl k ((F : Set K) ∪ ⇑τ' '' S) := by
      rw [Representative.map_M, coe_map, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom]
      change ⇑τ' '' ((racl k ((F : Set K) ∪ r₀.M) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) = _
      rw [← hM₁eq, ← AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, ← coe_map, racl_map, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom]
      congr 1
      refine le_antisymm (racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_right)
        (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset ?_ (subset_racl k _)))
      intro x hx
      have hxS : x ∈ racl k S := hM₁eq ▸ hFle hx
      have : τ' x ∈ (racl k S).map τ'.toAlgHom := ⟨x, hxS, rfl⟩
      rw [racl_map] at this
      rwa [hτF x hx] at this
    rw [himage]
    refine indepOver_racl_left_iff.2 ?_
    rw [image_eq_range]
    exact hτ

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsGraphGeneric.eq_graphPoint
proof:
:= by
  have _ := r.isAlgClosed
  rw [← Sum.elim_range] at hind
  
  have hM : IsGraphGeneric (⟦r⟧ : Germ k a a') r.M (Sum.elim y z) := by
    unfold IsGraphGeneric
    rw [locusIdeal_eq_of_indepOver hF r.isSmall hFM hind]
    exact h
  have hyM : IsGenericOver r.M a y := hM.isGenericOver_fst
  
  have hloc : locusIdeal (↥r.M) (Sum.elim y z) = locusIdeal (↥r.M) (r.graphPoint y) := by
    rw [hM, Germ.graphIdeal_mk, r.graphIdeal_eq hyM]
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := (locusIdeal_eq_iff_exists_algEquiv _ _ _).1 hloc
  have hy : ⇑σ ∘ y = y := funext fun i ↦ hσ (Sum.inl i)
  have hz : ⇑σ ∘ r.f.eval y = z := funext fun j ↦ hσ (Sum.inr j)
  rw [← hz, ← r.f.eval_comp σ y, hy]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.exists_isGraphGeneric
statement:
theorem exists_isGraphGeneric (g : Germ k a a') {F : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed (↥F)]
    (hF : IsSmall k (F : Set K)) (hcb : g.cb ≤ F) {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGenericOver F a y) :
    ∃ z, g.IsGraphGeneric F (Sum.elim y z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl, hFM, hind⟩ := g.exists_rep hF hcb (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range y))
  have _ := r.isAlgClosed
  have hyM : IsGenericOver r.M a y :=
    (hy.isGenericOver_iff_indepOver hF r.isSmall hFM).2 hind.symm
  exact ⟨r.f.eval y, (isGraphGeneric_graphPoint r hyM).of_le hcb hFM⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.isGraphGeneric_eval
statement:
theorem isGraphGeneric_eval (g : Germ k a a') {F : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed (↥F)]
    (hF : IsSmall k (F : Set K)) (hcb : g.cb ≤ F) {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGenericOver F a y) :
    g.IsGraphGeneric F (Sum.elim y (g.eval F y))
proof:
:=
  Classical.epsilon_spec (g.exists_isGraphGeneric hF hcb hy)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsGraphGeneric.eq_eval
proof:
:= by
  have hy : IsGenericOver F a y := h.isGenericOver_fst
  have h' := g.isGraphGeneric_eval hF hcb hy
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hFM, hind⟩ := g.exists_rep hF hcb
    (W := range y ∪ range z ∪ range (g.eval F y))
    (((IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range y)).union (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range z))).union
      (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range _)))
  subst hr
  rw [h.eq_graphPoint hF hFM (hind.symm.mono_left subset_union_left),
    h'.eq_graphPoint hF hFM (hind.symm.mono_left ?_)]
  exact union_subset (subset_union_left.trans subset_union_left) subset_union_right

name: GroupConfig.Germ.eval_eq_rep
statement:
theorem eval_eq_rep (r : Representative k K a a') {F : IntermediateField k K}
    [IsAlgClosed (↥F)] (hF : IsSmall k (F : Set K)) (hcb : Germ.cb (⟦r⟧ : Germ k a a') ≤ F)
    (hFM : F ≤ r.M) {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGenericOver r.M a y) :
    Germ.eval (⟦r⟧ : Germ k a a') F y = r.f.eval y
proof:
:=
  (((isGraphGeneric_graphPoint r hy).of_le hcb hFM).eq_eval hF hcb).symm

name: GroupConfig.Germ.isGenericOver_eval
statement:
theorem isGenericOver_eval (g : Germ k a a') {F : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed (↥F)]
    (hF : IsSmall k (F : Set K)) (hcb : g.cb ≤ F) {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGenericOver F a y) :
    IsGenericOver F a' (g.eval F y)
proof:
:=
  (g.isGraphGeneric_eval hF hcb hy).isGenericOver_snd

name: GroupConfig.Germ.eval_eq_of_le
statement:
theorem eval_eq_of_le (g : Germ k a a') {F F' : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed (↥F)]
    [IsAlgClosed (↥F')] (hF : IsSmall k (F : Set K)) (hF' : IsSmall k (F' : Set K))
    (hcb : g.cb ≤ F) (hFF' : F ≤ F') {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGenericOver F' a y) :
    g.eval F y = g.eval F' y
proof:
:=
  (((g.isGraphGeneric_eval hF' (hcb.trans hFF') hy).of_le hcb hFF').eq_eval hF hcb).symm

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsGraphGeneric.map
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsGraphGeneric at h ⊢
  rw [← locusIdeal_map, h, graphIdeal_map]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.eval_map
proof:
:= by
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(F.map σ.toAlgHom) :=
    IsAlgClosed.of_ringEquiv (↥F) _ (intermediateFieldMap σ F).toRingEquiv
  have hFs : IsSmall k ((F.map σ.toAlgHom : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) := by
    have := hF
    unfold IsSmall at this ⊢
    rwa [coe_map, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, ← image_empty ⇑σ, erk_image]
  have hcb' : (g.map σ).cb ≤ F.map σ.toAlgHom := by
    rw [cb_map]
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x, hcb hx, rfl⟩
  have h := (g.isGraphGeneric_eval hF hcb hy).map σ
  have hsum : ⇑σ ∘ Sum.elim y (g.eval F y) = Sum.elim (⇑σ ∘ y) (⇑σ ∘ g.eval F y) := by
    funext i
    cases i <;> rfl
  rw [hsum] at h
  exact (h.eq_eval hFs hcb').symm

name: GroupConfig.Germ.eq_of_eval_eq
proof:
:= by
  apply graphIdeal_injective
  have h1 := g.isGraphGeneric_eval hF hcb hy
  have h2 := g'.isGraphGeneric_eval hF hcb' hy
  unfold IsGraphGeneric at h1 h2
  rw [← h1, ← h2, h]

name: GroupConfig.Representative.extend_f
statement:
theorem extend_f [UniversalDomain k K] [Finite ι] [Finite κ] (r : Representative k K a a')
    {M₁ : IntermediateField k K} (hM₁ : IsAlgClosed (↥M₁)) (hsmall : IsSmall k (M₁ : Set K))
    (h : r.M ≤ M₁) :
    (r.extend hM₁ hsmall h).f = r.f.map (IntermediateField.inclusion h).toRingHom
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Representative.extend_eval
statement:
theorem extend_eval [UniversalDomain k K] [Finite ι] [Finite κ] (r : Representative k K a a')
    {M₁ : IntermediateField k K} (hM₁ : IsAlgClosed (↥M₁)) (hsmall : IsSmall k (M₁ : Set K))
    (h : r.M ≤ M₁) (u : ι → K) : (r.extend hM₁ hsmall h).f.eval u = r.f.eval u
proof:
:=
  QuasiRational.eval_map h r.f u

name: GroupConfig.Representative.isSmall_joinField
statement:
theorem isSmall_joinField (r' : Representative k K a' a'') (r : Representative k K a a') :
    IsSmall k (joinField r' r : Set K)
proof:
:=
  (r.isSmall.union r'.isSmall).racl

name: GroupConfig.Representative.le_joinField_left
statement:
theorem le_joinField_left (r' : Representative k K a' a'') (r : Representative k K a a') :
    r.M ≤ joinField r' r
proof:
:=
  subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)

name: GroupConfig.Representative.le_joinField_right
statement:
theorem le_joinField_right (r' : Representative k K a' a'') (r : Representative k K a a') :
    r'.M ≤ joinField r' r
proof:
:=
  subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)

name: GroupConfig.Representative.compOver_eval
statement:
theorem compOver_eval {N : IntermediateField k K} (hN : IsAlgClosed (↥N))
    (hNs : IsSmall k (N : Set K)) (f : QuasiRational (↥N) ι κ) (f' : QuasiRational (↥N) κ μ)
    (hf : ∀ y, IsGenericOver N a y → f.IsDefinedAt y)
    (hfg : ∀ y, IsGenericOver N a y → IsGenericOver N a' (f.eval y))
    (hf' : ∀ z, IsGenericOver N a' z → f'.IsDefinedAt z)
    (hf'g : ∀ z, IsGenericOver N a' z → IsGenericOver N a'' (f'.eval z)) {y : ι → K}
    (hy : IsGenericOver N a y) :
    (compOver hN hNs f f' hf hfg hf' hf'g).f.eval y = f'.eval (f.eval y)
proof:
:= by
  let _ := Fintype.ofFinite κ
  have := expChar_of_algebra (↥N) K
  exact QuasiRational.comp_eval f' f (hf y hy)

name: GroupConfig.Representative.comp_M
statement:
theorem comp_M (r' : Representative k K a' a'') (r : Representative k K a a') :
    (r'.comp r).M = joinField r' r
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Representative.comp_eval
proof:
:= by
  refine (compOver_eval _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hy).trans ?_
  exact (extend_eval r' _ _ _ _).trans (congrArg _ (extend_eval r _ _ _ _))

name: GroupConfig.Representative.comp_equivalent
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have hB : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (((r₁'.comp r₁).M : Set K) ∪ (r₂'.comp r₂).M)) :=
    isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hBs : IsSmall k ((racl k (((r₁'.comp r₁).M : Set K) ∪ (r₂'.comp r₂).M) :
      IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    ((r₁'.comp r₁).isSmall.union (r₂'.comp r₂).isSmall).racl
  have h1 : (r₁'.comp r₁).M ≤ racl k (((r₁'.comp r₁).M : Set K) ∪ (r₂'.comp r₂).M) :=
    subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have h2 : (r₂'.comp r₂).M ≤ racl k (((r₁'.comp r₁).M : Set K) ∪ (r₂'.comp r₂).M) :=
    subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
  rw [comp_eval _ _ (hy.of_le h1), comp_eval _ _ (hy.of_le h2)]
  
  have hz : IsGenericOver (racl k (((r₁'.comp r₁).M : Set K) ∪ (r₂'.comp r₂).M)) a'
      (r₁.f.eval y) := by
    have := (r₁.extend hB hBs ((le_joinField_left r₁' r₁).trans h1)).isGenericOver y hy
    rwa [extend_eval] at this
  have hle12 : racl k ((r₁.M : Set K) ∪ r₂.M) ≤
      racl k (((r₁'.comp r₁).M : Set K) ∪ (r₂'.comp r₂).M) :=
    racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset ((le_joinField_left r₁' r₁).trans h1)
      ((le_joinField_left r₂' r₂).trans h2))
  have hle12' : racl k ((r₁'.M : Set K) ∪ r₂'.M) ≤
      racl k (((r₁'.comp r₁).M : Set K) ∪ (r₂'.comp r₂).M) :=
    racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset ((le_joinField_right r₁' r₁).trans h1)
      ((le_joinField_right r₂' r₂).trans h2))
  rw [h' _ (hz.of_le hle12'), h y (hy.of_le hle12)]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsGraphGeneric.erk_eq
statement:
theorem IsGraphGeneric.erk_eq {g : Germ k a a'} {F : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed (↥F)]
    (hF : IsSmall k (F : Set K)) (hcb : g.cb ≤ F) {y : ι → K} {z : κ → K}
    (h : g.IsGraphGeneric F (Sum.elim y z)) :
    erk k (F : Set K) (range (Sum.elim y z)) = erk k ∅ (range a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl, hFM, hind⟩ :=
    g.exists_rep hF hcb (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range (Sum.elim y z)))
  have _ := r.isAlgClosed
  have hind' : IndepOver k (F : Set K) (range (Sum.elim y z)) (r.M : Set K) := hind.symm
  have hz : z = r.f.eval y := h.eq_graphPoint hF hFM (by rwa [← Sum.elim_range])
  have hM : IsGraphGeneric (⟦r⟧ : Germ k a a') r.M (Sum.elim y z) := by
    unfold IsGraphGeneric
    rw [locusIdeal_eq_of_indepOver hF r.isSmall hFM hind']
    exact h
  have hyM : IsGenericOver r.M a y := hM.isGenericOver_fst
  have hrk := hind' (subset_refl _) (finite_range _)
  rw [union_eq_right.2 (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 hFM)] at hrk
  rw [← hrk, hz]
  exact r.erk_graphPoint le_rfl hyM

name: GroupConfig.Germ.eval_mem_racl
statement:
theorem eval_mem_racl (g : Germ k a a') {F : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed (↥F)]
    (hF : IsSmall k (F : Set K)) (hcb : g.cb ≤ F) {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGenericOver F a y)
    (j : κ) : g.eval F y j ∈ racl k ((F : Set K) ∪ range y)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (g.isGraphGeneric_eval hF hcb hy).erk_eq hF hcb
  rw [Sum.elim_range, erk_union_eq, hy.erk_coe_eq, hy.erk_empty_eq] at h1
  have hne : erk k ∅ (range a) ≠ ⊤ := erk_ne_top k (finite_range a) _
  have h2 : erk k ((F : Set K) ∪ range y) (range (g.eval F y)) = 0 := by
    refine nonpos_iff_eq_zero.1 ((ENat.add_le_add_iff_left hne).1 ?_)
    rw [add_zero]
    exact h1.le
  exact (erk_eq_zero_iff k).1 h2 (mem_range_self j)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.compRep_mk
statement:
theorem compRep_mk (r' : Representative k K a' a'') (r : Representative k K a a') :
    compRep r' (⟦r⟧ : Germ k a a') = ⟦r'.comp r⟧
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.compRep_congr
statement:
theorem compRep_congr {r₁' r₂' : Representative k K a' a''} (h' : r₁'.Equivalent r₂')
    (g : Germ k a a') : compRep r₁' g = compRep r₂' g
proof:
:= by
  induction g using Quotient.inductionOn with
  | h r =>
    exact Quotient.sound (Representative.comp_equivalent (Representative.equivalent_refl r) h')

name: GroupConfig.Germ.comp_mk
statement:
theorem comp_mk (r' : Representative k K a' a'') (r : Representative k K a a') :
    Germ.comp (⟦r'⟧ : Germ k a' a'') (⟦r⟧ : Germ k a a') = ⟦r'.comp r⟧
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.cb_comp_le
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hF a
  obtain ⟨r, rfl, hFM, hind⟩ := g.exists_rep hF hcb (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range y))
  obtain ⟨r', rfl, hFM', hind'⟩ :=
    g'.exists_rep hF hcb' (r.isSmall.union (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range y)))
  have _ := r.isAlgClosed
  have _ := r'.isAlgClosed
  have hyM : IsGenericOver r.M a y :=
    (hy.isGenericOver_iff_indepOver hF r.isSmall hFM).2 hind.symm
  
  have hN := Representative.isSmall_joinField r' r
  have hFN : F ≤ Representative.joinField r' r :=
    hFM.trans (Representative.le_joinField_left r' r)
  have hyind : IndepOver k (F : Set K) (range y) (Representative.joinField r' r : Set K) := by
    have h1 : IndepOver k (F : Set K) (range y) ((r.M : Set K) ∪ r'.M) :=
      hind.symm.union_right (by rw [union_comm]; exact hind'.symm)
    have h2 := indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 h1
    rwa [union_eq_right.2 (fun x hx ↦ subset_union_left (hFM hx) : (F : Set K) ⊆ ↑r.M ∪ ↑r'.M)]
      at h2
  have hyN : IsGenericOver (Representative.joinField r' r) a y :=
    (hy.isGenericOver_iff_indepOver hF hN hFN).2 hyind
  
  have hz : IsGenericOver (Representative.joinField r' r) a' (r.f.eval y) := by
    have := (r.extend (isAlgClosed_racl _) hN (Representative.le_joinField_left r' r)).isGenericOver
      y hyN
    rwa [Representative.extend_eval] at this
  have hzM' : IsGenericOver r'.M a' (r.f.eval y) :=
    hz.of_le (Representative.le_joinField_right r' r)
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(Representative.joinField r' r) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  
  have hgraph : range ((r'.comp r).graphPoint y) ⊆ racl k ((F : Set K) ∪ range y) := by
    unfold Representative.graphPoint
    rw [Sum.elim_range, Representative.comp_eval _ _ hyN]
    refine union_subset (subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)) ?_
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    have hval : r'.f.eval (r.f.eval y) j ∈ racl k ((F : Set K) ∪ range (r.f.eval y)) := by
      rw [← eval_eq_rep r' hF hcb' hFM' hzM']
      exact eval_mem_racl _ hF hcb' (hz.of_le hFN) j
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset (subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)) ?_)
      hval
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [← eval_eq_rep r hF hcb hFM hyM]
    exact eval_mem_racl _ hF hcb hy i
  rw [comp_mk, cb_mk_eq_canonicalBase (r'.comp r) hyN]
  refine (indepOver_iff_canonicalBase_le hN hFN _).1 ?_
  exact (indepOver_racl_left_iff.2 hyind).mono_left hgraph

name: GroupConfig.Germ.comp_eval
statement:
theorem comp_eval (g' : Germ k a' a'') (g : Germ k a a') {F : IntermediateField k K}
    [IsAlgClosed (↥F)] (hF : IsSmall k (F : Set K)) (hcb : g.cb ≤ F) (hcb' : g'.cb ≤ F)
    {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGenericOver F a y) :
    (Germ.comp g' g).eval F y = g'.eval F (g.eval F y)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp := cb_comp_le g' g hF hcb hcb'
  obtain ⟨r, rfl, hFM, hind⟩ := g.exists_rep hF hcb (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range y))
  obtain ⟨r', rfl, hFM', hind'⟩ :=
    g'.exists_rep hF hcb' (r.isSmall.union (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range y)))
  have _ := r.isAlgClosed
  have _ := r'.isAlgClosed
  have hyM : IsGenericOver r.M a y :=
    (hy.isGenericOver_iff_indepOver hF r.isSmall hFM).2 hind.symm
  have hN := Representative.isSmall_joinField r' r
  have hFN : F ≤ Representative.joinField r' r :=
    hFM.trans (Representative.le_joinField_left r' r)
  have hyind : IndepOver k (F : Set K) (range y) (Representative.joinField r' r : Set K) := by
    have h1 : IndepOver k (F : Set K) (range y) ((r.M : Set K) ∪ r'.M) :=
      hind.symm.union_right (by rw [union_comm]; exact hind'.symm)
    have h2 := indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 h1
    rwa [union_eq_right.2 (fun x hx ↦ subset_union_left (hFM hx) : (F : Set K) ⊆ ↑r.M ∪ ↑r'.M)]
      at h2
  have hyN : IsGenericOver (Representative.joinField r' r) a y :=
    (hy.isGenericOver_iff_indepOver hF hN hFN).2 hyind
  have hz : IsGenericOver (Representative.joinField r' r) a' (r.f.eval y) := by
    have := (r.extend (isAlgClosed_racl _) hN (Representative.le_joinField_left r' r)).isGenericOver
      y hyN
    rwa [Representative.extend_eval] at this
  have hzM' : IsGenericOver r'.M a' (r.f.eval y) :=
    hz.of_le (Representative.le_joinField_right r' r)
  rw [comp_mk] at hcomp ⊢
  rw [eval_eq_rep (r'.comp r) hF hcomp hFN hyN, Representative.comp_eval _ _ hyN,
    eval_eq_rep r hF hcb hFM hyM, eval_eq_rep r' hF hcb' hFM' hzM']

name: GroupConfig.Germ.baseChangeHom_apply
statement:
theorem baseChangeHom_apply (g : Germ (↥K₀) a a) :
    baseChangeHom K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha g = g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.baseChange_mem_prodSet
statement:
theorem baseChange_mem_prodSet {γ : Germ (↥K₀) a a} (hγ : γ ∈ prodSet g₀) :
    γ.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha ∈ prodSet (g₀.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha)
proof:
:= by
                                                                                             
                                                                            
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hind⟩ := exists_mem_orbit_indepOver g₀ (γ.isSmall_cb.union hK₁)
  obtain ⟨hmem, hmemK⟩ := hw.keyrank hγ hh hind
  obtain ⟨h', hh'⟩ := isUnit_iff.1 (hw.isUnit_of_mem hh)
  have hγeq : γ = h' * (h * γ) := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, show h' * h = 1 from hh'.1, one_mul]
  refine ⟨_, baseChange_mem_orbit K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha h₀ (hw.inv h hh h' hh')
    (indepOver_of_cb_le hh'.cb_le (hind.mono_right subset_union_right)), _,
    baseChange_mem_orbit K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha h₀ hmem hmemK, ?_⟩
  rw [← baseChangeHom_apply K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha, ← baseChangeHom_apply K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha,
    ← baseChangeHom_apply K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha, ← map_mul, ← hγeq]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.exists_of_mem_prodSet_baseChange
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f₁, hf₁, f₂, hf₂, rfl⟩ := hγ
  obtain ⟨g₁, hg₁, -, rfl⟩ := exists_of_mem_orbit_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha h₀ hf₁
  obtain ⟨g₂, hg₂, -, rfl⟩ := exists_of_mem_orbit_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha h₀ hf₂
  exact ⟨g₁ * g₂, ⟨g₁, hg₁, g₂, hg₂, rfl⟩, map_mul (baseChangeHom K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha) g₁ g₂⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.val_prodSubgroupHom
statement:
theorem val_prodSubgroupHom (δ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) :
    (hw.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀).val (prodSubgroupHom K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha hw h₀ δ) =
      (hw.val δ).baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.prodSubgroupHom_bijective
statement:
theorem prodSubgroupHom_bijective :
    Function.Bijective (prodSubgroupHom K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha hw h₀)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun δ δ' h ↦ hw.val_injective ?_, fun ε ↦ ?_⟩
  · have h' := congrArg (hw.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀).val h
    rw [val_prodSubgroupHom, val_prodSubgroupHom] at h'
    exact baseChange_injective K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha h'
  · obtain ⟨γ₀, hγ₀, hγ₀eq⟩ := exists_of_mem_prodSet_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀
      ((hw.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀).val_mem ε)
    refine ⟨hw.ofMem hγ₀, (hw.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀).val_injective ?_⟩
    rw [val_prodSubgroupHom, val_ofMem, hγ₀eq]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.val_prodSubgroupEquiv
statement:
theorem val_prodSubgroupEquiv (δ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) :
    (hw.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀).val (prodSubgroupEquiv K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha hw h₀ δ) =
      (hw.val δ).baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.baseChange_lowerPair
statement:
theorem baseChange_lowerPair (p : Pair (g₀.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha)) :
    (lowerPair K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀ p).γ.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha = p.γ
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (exists_of_mem_prodSet_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀ p.mem)).2

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.racl_base_lowerPair
statement:
theorem racl_base_lowerPair (p : Pair (g₀.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha)) :
    racl (↥K₁) (lowerPair K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀ p).base = racl (↥K₁) p.base
proof:
:= by
  refine racl_union_congr ?_ rfl
  exact (racl_cb_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha _).symm.trans
    (congrArg (fun f : Germ (↥K₁) a a ↦ racl (↥K₁) (f.cb : Set K))
      (baseChange_lowerPair K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀ p))

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.evalGen_mul_lowerPair
statement:
theorem evalGen_mul_lowerPair (p : Pair (g₀.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha)) {h : Germ (↥K₀) a a}
    (hh : h ∈ orbit g₀)
    (hind : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (h.cb : Set K)
      ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ (lowerPair K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀ p).base)) :
    (h.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha * p.γ).evalGen p.pt =
      (h * (lowerPair K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀ p).γ).evalGen p.pt
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q, q = lowerPair K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀ p := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hbc : q.γ.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha = p.γ := by
    rw [hq]
    exact baseChange_lowerPair K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀ p
  have hpt : q.pt = p.pt := by
    rw [hq]
    rfl
  rw [← hq] at hind ⊢
                                                                            
  have hind' : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (h.cb : Set K)
      ((q.γ.cb : Set K) ∪ ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ range q.pt)) :=
    hind.mono_right (union_subset (q.cb_subset_base.trans subset_union_right)
      (union_subset subset_union_left (q.range_subset_base.trans subset_union_right)))
  obtain ⟨-, hK⟩ := hw.keyrank q.mem hh hind'
  have hK' : IndepOver (↥K₀) (K₁ : Set K) (range p.pt) ((h * q.γ).cb : Set K) := by
    have := (indepOver_union_right_iff.1 hK).2
    rw [empty_union, hpt] at this
    exact this.symm
  have hy : IndepOver (↥K₁) ∅ (range p.pt)
      (((h * q.γ).baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha).cb : Set K) :=
    (indepOver_cb_baseChange_iff K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha _ _).2 hK'
  rw [← hbc, ← baseChangeHom_apply K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha, ← baseChangeHom_apply K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha,
    ← map_mul, baseChangeHom_apply]
  exact evalGen_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha _ p.isGen hy

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.rel_lowerPair_iff
statement:
theorem rel_lowerPair_iff (p q : Pair (g₀.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha)) :
    (lowerPair K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀ p).Rel (lowerPair K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀ q) ↔ p.Rel q
proof:
:= by
                                                                       
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hind⟩ := exists_mem_orbit_indepOver g₀
    (hK₁.union ((lowerPair K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀ p).isSmall_base.union
      (lowerPair K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀ q).isSmall_base))
  have hhK : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (h.cb : Set K) (K₁ : Set K) := hind.mono_right subset_union_left
  have hhb : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (h.cb : Set K)
      ((lowerPair K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀ p).base ∪ (lowerPair K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀ q).base) :=
    hind.mono_right subset_union_right
                                               
  have hh'' := baseChange_mem_orbit K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha h₀ hh hhK
  have hind'' : IndepOver (↥K₁) ∅ ((h.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha).cb : Set K)
      (p.base ∪ q.base) := by
    have h1 : IndepOver (↥K₀) (K₁ : Set K) (h.cb : Set K)
        ((lowerPair K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀ p).base ∪ (lowerPair K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀ q).base) := by
      have := (indepOver_union_right_iff.1 hind).2
      rwa [empty_union] at this
    refine (indepOver_congr₀ (racl_cb_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha h).symm
      (racl_union_congr (racl_base_lowerPair K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀ p)
        (racl_base_lowerPair K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀ q))).1 ?_
    exact (indepOver_base_le_iff K₀ K₁ h₀₁ _ _).2 h1
  have hep := evalGen_mul_lowerPair K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha hw h₀ p hh
    (hind.mono_right (union_subset_union_right _ subset_union_left))
  have heq := evalGen_mul_lowerPair K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha hw h₀ q hh
    (hind.mono_right (union_subset_union_right _ subset_union_right))
  constructor
  · intro hr
    refine (hw.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀).rel_of_witness hh'' hind'' ?_
    rw [hep, heq]
    exact hr h hh hhb
  · intro hr
    refine hw.rel_of_witness hh hhb ?_
    have := hr _ hh'' hind''
    rwa [hep, heq] at this

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.spaceMap_ofPair
statement:
theorem spaceMap_ofPair (p : Pair (g₀.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha)) :
    spaceMap K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha hw h₀ ((hw.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀).ofPair p) =
      hw.ofPair (lowerPair K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀ p)
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.lowerPair_eq
statement:
theorem lowerPair_eq {γ : Germ (↥K₀) a a} (hγ : γ ∈ prodSet g₀) {y : ι → K}
    (hy : IsGen (↥K₁) a y) :
    lowerPair K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀
      ⟨γ.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha, baseChange_mem_prodSet K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha hw h₀ hγ, y, hy⟩ =
      ⟨γ, hγ, y, ((isGen_base_iff K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha).1 hy).1⟩
proof:
:=
  Pair.ext (baseChange_injective K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha
    (baseChange_lowerPair K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀ _)) rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.spaceMap_bijective
statement: theorem spaceMap_bijective : Function.Bijective (spaceMap K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha hw h₀)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun s s' ↦ ?_, fun s ↦ ?_⟩
  · refine (hw.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀).ind (fun p ↦ ?_) s
    refine (hw.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀).ind (fun p' ↦ ?_) s'
    intro h
    rw [spaceMap_ofPair, spaceMap_ofPair] at h
    exact (hw.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀).ofPair_eq_ofPair.2
      ((rel_lowerPair_iff K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha hw h₀ _ _).1 (hw.ofPair_eq_ofPair.1 h))
