  ·                                                                                     
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver (k := ↥K₀) hK₁.racl a
    have hyK : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range y) (K₁ : Set K) :=
      hy.indepOver.mono_right (subset_racl (↥K₀) _)
    have hy₁ : IsGen (↥K₁) a y := (isGen_base_iff K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha).2 ⟨hy.isGen, hyK⟩
    obtain ⟨δ, rfl⟩ := hw.exists_smul_eq (hw.iota hy.isGen) s
    refine ⟨(hw.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀).ofPair
      ⟨(hw.val δ).baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha,
        baseChange_mem_prodSet K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha hw h₀ (hw.val_mem δ), y, hy₁⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [spaceMap_ofPair, lowerPair_eq K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha hw h₀ (hw.val_mem δ) hy₁,
      hw.ofPair_eq_smul_iota]
    congr 1
    exact hw.val_injective (by rw [val_ofMem])

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.spaceEquiv_smul
statement:
theorem spaceEquiv_smul (δ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) (s : (hw.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀).Space) :
    spaceEquiv K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha hw h₀ (prodSubgroupEquiv K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha hw h₀ δ • s) =
      δ • spaceEquiv K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha hw h₀ s
proof:
:= by
  refine (hw.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀).ind (fun p ↦ ?_) s
  change spaceMap K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha hw h₀ ((hw.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀).ofPair
      ((hw.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀).smulPair _ p)) =
    δ • spaceMap K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha hw h₀ ((hw.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀).ofPair p)
  rw [spaceMap_ofPair, spaceMap_ofPair, smul_ofPair]
  refine congrArg hw.ofPair (Pair.ext ?_ rfl)
  refine baseChange_injective K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha ?_
  change _ = (hw.val δ * (lowerPair K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀ p).γ).baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha
  rw [baseChange_lowerPair,
    ← baseChangeHom_apply K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha (hw.val δ * (lowerPair K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀ p).γ),
    map_mul, baseChangeHom_apply K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha (hw.val δ),
    baseChangeHom_apply K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha (lowerPair K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀ p).γ,
    baseChange_lowerPair]
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.spaceEquiv_iota
statement:
theorem spaceEquiv_iota {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen (↥K₁) a y) :
    spaceEquiv K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha hw h₀ ((hw.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀).iota hy) =
      hw.iota ((isGen_base_iff K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha).1 hy).1
proof:
:= by
  change spaceMap K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha hw h₀ ((hw.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀).ofPair
    ((hw.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha h₀).onePair hy)) = _
  rw [spaceMap_ofPair]
  refine congrArg hw.ofPair (Pair.ext ?_ rfl)
  refine baseChange_injective K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha ?_
  rw [baseChange_lowerPair]
  exact (id_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha).symm

name: GroupConfig.Germ.indepOver_evalGen_range_of_conj
statement:
theorem indepOver_evalGen_range_of_conj {g : Germ k a a'} {y y' : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k a y)
    (hy' : IsGen k a y') (hind : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (g.cb : Set K))
    (hind' : IndepOver k ∅ (range y') (g.cb : Set K))
    (h : IndepOver k ∅ (range (g.evalGen y')) (range y')) :
    IndepOver k ∅ (range (g.evalGen y)) (range y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := (hy'.isGenericOver_racl g.isSmall_cb hind').exists_algEquiv
    (hy.isGenericOver_racl g.isSmall_cb hind)
  have hyeq : ⇑(σ.restrictScalars k) ∘ y' = y := funext hσ
  have hfix : g.map (σ.restrictScalars k) = g := by
    refine (map_eq_self_iff _ _).2 fun x hx ↦ ?_
    change σ x = x
    exact σ.commutes ⟨x, subset_racl k _ hx⟩
  have e := evalGen_map (σ.restrictScalars k) g hy' hind'
  rw [hfix, hyeq] at e
  have := h.image (σ.restrictScalars k)
  rwa [image_empty, ← range_comp, ← range_comp, hyeq, ← e] at this

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.rank_of_exists
statement:
theorem rank_of_exists {δ₀ : Germ k a a} (hδ₀ : δ₀ ∈ diffSet f₀)
    (h : erk k ∅ (δ₀.cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (f₀.cb : Set K)) :
    ∀ δ ∈ diffSet f₀, erk k ∅ (δ.cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (f₀.cb : Set K)
proof:
:= fun _ hδ ↦
  (erk_cb_eq_of_mem_diffSet hδ hδ₀).trans h

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.indepOver_diff_left
statement:
theorem indepOver_diff_left {f₁ f₂ : Germ k a a'} {g₁ : Germ k a' a} (hg₁ : IsInverse g₁ f₁)
    (h₁ : f₁ ∈ orbit f₀) (h₂ : f₂ ∈ orbit f₀) (hind : IndepOver k ∅ (f₁.cb : Set K) f₂.cb) :
    IndepOver k ∅ ((Germ.comp g₁ f₂).cb : Set K) f₁.cb
proof:
:= by
  refine (indepOver_diff_left_iff hg₁ hind).2 ?_
  rw [hb.rank _ ⟨f₁, h₁, f₂, h₂, g₁, hg₁, hind, rfl⟩, erk_cb_eq_of_mem_orbit h₂]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.indepOver_diff_right
statement:
theorem indepOver_diff_right {f₁ f₂ : Germ k a a'} {g₁ : Germ k a' a} (hg₁ : IsInverse g₁ f₁)
    (h₁ : f₁ ∈ orbit f₀) (h₂ : f₂ ∈ orbit f₀) (hind : IndepOver k ∅ (f₁.cb : Set K) f₂.cb) :
    IndepOver k ∅ ((Germ.comp g₁ f₂).cb : Set K) f₂.cb
proof:
:= by
  refine (indepOver_diff_right_iff hg₁ hind (isInvertible_of_mem_orbit hb.isInvertible h₂)).2 ?_
  rw [hb.rank _ ⟨f₁, h₁, f₂, h₂, g₁, hg₁, hind, rfl⟩, erk_cb_eq_of_mem_orbit h₁]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.comp_mem_orbit_of_mem_diffSet
statement:
theorem comp_mem_orbit_of_mem_diffSet {f : Germ k a a'} {δ : Germ k a a} (hf : f ∈ orbit f₀)
    (hδ : δ ∈ diffSet f₀) (hind : IndepOver k ∅ (δ.cb : Set K) f.cb) :
    Germ.comp f δ ∈ orbit f₀ ∧ IndepOver k ∅ ((Germ.comp f δ).cb : Set K) f.cb ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ ((Germ.comp f δ).cb : Set K) δ.cb
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f₁, h₁, f₂, h₂, g₁, hg₁, hind₁₂, rfl⟩ := hδ
  have hδf₁ := hb.indepOver_diff_left hg₁ h₁ h₂ hind₁₂
  have hδf₂ := hb.indepOver_diff_right hg₁ h₁ h₂ hind₁₂
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ :=
    exists_algEquiv_of_mem_orbit h₁ hf (Germ.comp g₁ f₂).isSmall_cb hδf₁.symm hind.symm
  have hfix : (Germ.comp g₁ f₂).map (τ.restrictScalars k) = Germ.comp g₁ f₂ := by
    refine (map_eq_self_iff _ _).2 fun x hx ↦ ?_
    change τ x = x
    exact τ.commutes ⟨x, subset_racl k _ hx⟩
  have hcomp : Germ.comp f (Germ.comp g₁ f₂) = f₂.map (τ.restrictScalars k) := by
    calc Germ.comp f (Germ.comp g₁ f₂)
        = Germ.comp (f₁.map (τ.restrictScalars k))
            ((Germ.comp g₁ f₂).map (τ.restrictScalars k)) := by rw [hτ, hfix]
      _ = (Germ.comp f₁ (Germ.comp g₁ f₂)).map (τ.restrictScalars k) :=
          (comp_map (τ.restrictScalars k) f₁ (Germ.comp g₁ f₂)).symm
      _ = f₂.map (τ.restrictScalars k) := by rw [comp_diff hg₁]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hcomp]
    exact map_mem_orbit h₂ _
  · have := hind₁₂.symm.image (τ.restrictScalars k)
    rwa [image_empty, ← AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, ← coe_map, ← coe_map, ← cb_map, ← cb_map, hτ,
      ← hcomp] at this
  · have := hδf₂.symm.image (τ.restrictScalars k)
    rwa [image_empty, ← AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, ← coe_map, ← coe_map, ← cb_map, ← cb_map, hfix,
      ← hcomp] at this

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.trans_diff
statement:
theorem trans_diff {δ : Germ k a a} (hδ : δ ∈ diffSet f₀) {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k a y)
    (hind : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (δ.cb : Set K)) :
    IndepOver k ∅ (range (δ.evalGen y)) (range y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f₁, h₁, f₂, h₂, g₁, hg₁, hind₁₂, rfl⟩ := hδ
  have hsmall : IsSmall k ((f₁.cb : Set K) ∪ f₂.cb) := f₁.isSmall_cb.union f₂.isSmall_cb
  obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hsmall.racl a
  have hy'gen : IsGen k a y' := hy'.isGen
  have hy'ind : IndepOver k ∅ (range y') ((f₁.cb : Set K) ∪ f₂.cb) :=
    hy'.indepOver.mono_right (subset_racl k _)
  refine indepOver_evalGen_range_of_conj hy hy'gen hind ?_ ?_
  · refine (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hy'ind).mono_right ?_
    rw [empty_union]
    exact cb_diff_le hg₁
  have hy'f₂ : IndepOver k ∅ (range y') (f₂.cb : Set K) := hy'ind.mono_right subset_union_right
  have hc : IsGen k a' (f₂.evalGen y') := f₂.isGen_evalGen hy'gen hy'f₂
  have hcy' : IndepOver k ∅ (range (f₂.evalGen y')) (range y') :=
    hb.trans f₂ h₂ y' hy'gen hy'f₂
  have hcmem : range (f₂.evalGen y') ⊆ racl k ((f₂.cb : Set K) ∪ range y') := by
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact f₂.evalGen_mem_racl hy'gen hy'f₂ j
  
  have hf₁ : IndepOver k ∅ (f₁.cb : Set K) ((f₂.cb : Set K) ∪ range y') :=
    hind₁₂.union_right hy'ind.symm
  have hf₁' : IndepOver k ∅ (f₁.cb : Set K) (range y' ∪ range (f₂.evalGen y')) := by
    refine (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hf₁).mono_right ?_
    rw [empty_union]
    exact union_subset (subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)) hcmem
  
  have hc' : IndepOver k ∅ (range (f₂.evalGen y')) (range y' ∪ f₁.cb) :=
    indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨hcy', (indepOver_union_right_iff.1 hf₁').2.symm⟩
  have hsmall' : IsSmall k ((f₁.cb : Set K) ∪ range y') :=
    f₁.isSmall_cb.union (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range _))
  obtain ⟨F, hF_def⟩ : ∃ F : IntermediateField k K, F = racl k ((f₁.cb : Set K) ∪ range y') :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥F := hF_def ▸ isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hF : IsSmall k (F : Set K) := hF_def ▸ hsmall'.racl
  have hcF : IsGenericOver F a' (f₂.evalGen y') := by
    rw [hF_def]
    refine hc.isGenericOver_racl hsmall' ?_
    rw [union_comm]
    exact hc'
  have hg₁F : g₁.cb ≤ F := by
    rw [hF_def]
    exact hg₁.cb_le.trans (racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_left)
  
  have hz : IsGenericOver F a (g₁.eval F (f₂.evalGen y')) := g₁.isGenericOver_eval hF hg₁F hcF
  have hzy' : IndepOver k ∅ (range (g₁.eval F (f₂.evalGen y'))) (range y') := by
    refine hz.indepOver.mono_right ?_
    rw [hF_def]
    exact subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
  rw [evalGen_comp g₁ f₂ hy'gen ?_, evalGen_eq g₁ hF hg₁F hcF]
  · exact hzy'
  · refine (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hy'ind).mono_right ?_
    rw [empty_union]
    exact union_subset (hg₁.cb_le.trans (racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_left))
      (subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _))

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.mul_mem_diffSet
statement:
theorem mul_mem_diffSet {δ δ' : Germ k a a} (hδ : δ ∈ diffSet f₀) (hδ' : δ' ∈ diffSet f₀)
    (hind : IndepOver k ∅ (δ.cb : Set K) δ'.cb) : δ * δ' ∈ diffSet f₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfind⟩ := exists_mem_orbit_indepOver f₀ (δ.isSmall_cb.union δ'.isSmall_cb)
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := isInvertible_of_mem_orbit hb.isInvertible hf
  
  obtain ⟨f₁', hf₁', g₁', hg₁', hind₁, hδeq⟩ : ∃ f₁' ∈ orbit f₀, ∃ g₁' : Germ k a' a,
      IsInverse g₁' f₁' ∧ IndepOver k ∅ (f₁'.cb : Set K) f.cb ∧ δ = Germ.comp g₁' f := by
    obtain ⟨f₁, h₁, f₂, h₂, g₁, hg₁, hind₁₂, rfl⟩ := hδ
    have hδf₂ := hb.indepOver_diff_right hg₁ h₁ h₂ hind₁₂
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := exists_algEquiv_of_mem_orbit h₂ hf (Germ.comp g₁ f₂).isSmall_cb
      hδf₂.symm (hfind.mono_right subset_union_left)
    have hfix : (Germ.comp g₁ f₂).map (τ.restrictScalars k) = Germ.comp g₁ f₂ := by
      refine (map_eq_self_iff _ _).2 fun x hx ↦ ?_
      change τ x = x
      exact τ.commutes ⟨x, subset_racl k _ hx⟩
    refine ⟨f₁.map (τ.restrictScalars k), map_mem_orbit h₁ _, g₁.map (τ.restrictScalars k),
      hg₁.map _, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have := hind₁₂.image (τ.restrictScalars k)
      rwa [image_empty, ← AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, ← coe_map, ← coe_map, ← cb_map, ← cb_map, hτ]
        at this
    · calc Germ.comp g₁ f₂ = (Germ.comp g₁ f₂).map (τ.restrictScalars k) := hfix.symm
        _ = Germ.comp (g₁.map (τ.restrictScalars k)) (f₂.map (τ.restrictScalars k)) :=
            comp_map _ g₁ f₂
        _ = Germ.comp (g₁.map (τ.restrictScalars k)) f :=
            congrArg (Germ.comp (g₁.map (τ.restrictScalars k))) hτ
  
  obtain ⟨f₂', hf₂', hind₂, hδ'eq⟩ : ∃ f₂' ∈ orbit f₀,
      IndepOver k ∅ (f.cb : Set K) f₂'.cb ∧ δ' = Germ.comp g f₂' := by
    obtain ⟨f₁, h₁, f₂, h₂, g₁, hg₁, hind₁₂, rfl⟩ := hδ'
    have hδf₁ := hb.indepOver_diff_left hg₁ h₁ h₂ hind₁₂
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := exists_algEquiv_of_mem_orbit h₁ hf (Germ.comp g₁ f₂).isSmall_cb
      hδf₁.symm (hfind.mono_right subset_union_right)
    have hfix : (Germ.comp g₁ f₂).map (τ.restrictScalars k) = Germ.comp g₁ f₂ := by
      refine (map_eq_self_iff _ _).2 fun x hx ↦ ?_
      change τ x = x
      exact τ.commutes ⟨x, subset_racl k _ hx⟩
    refine ⟨f₂.map (τ.restrictScalars k), map_mem_orbit h₂ _, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have := hind₁₂.image (τ.restrictScalars k)
      rwa [image_empty, ← AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, ← coe_map, ← coe_map, ← cb_map, ← cb_map, hτ]
        at this
    · have hinv : IsInverse (g₁.map (τ.restrictScalars k)) f := by
        have := hg₁.map (τ.restrictScalars k)
        rwa [hτ] at this
      calc Germ.comp g₁ f₂ = (Germ.comp g₁ f₂).map (τ.restrictScalars k) := hfix.symm
        _ = Germ.comp (g₁.map (τ.restrictScalars k)) (f₂.map (τ.restrictScalars k)) :=
            comp_map _ g₁ f₂
        _ = Germ.comp g (f₂.map (τ.restrictScalars k)) :=
            congrArg (fun x ↦ Germ.comp x (f₂.map (τ.restrictScalars k))) (hinv.unique hg)
  
  have hprod : δ * δ' = Germ.comp g₁' f₂' := by
    rw [hδeq, hδ'eq, mul_def, comp_assoc g₁' f (Germ.comp g f₂'), ← comp_assoc f g f₂', hg.2,
      id_comp]
  have hδδ' : IndepOver k (f.cb : Set K) (δ.cb : Set K) δ'.cb := by
    have hE : IndepOver k ∅ (f.cb : Set K) (∅ ∪ ((δ.cb : Set K) ∪ δ'.cb)) := by
      rwa [empty_union]
    have := (indepOver_base_union_iff hE).1 hind
    rwa [empty_union] at this
  have hracl₁ : racl k ((f.cb : Set K) ∪ f₁'.cb) = racl k ((f.cb : Set K) ∪ δ.cb) := by
    rw [hδeq]
    refine le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset ?_ ?_))
      (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset ?_ ?_))
    · exact subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
    · exact cb_left_le_diff hg₁' ⟨g, hg⟩
    · exact subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
    · exact (cb_diff_le hg₁').trans (racl_mono (k := k) (union_comm _ _).le)
  have hracl₂ : racl k ((f.cb : Set K) ∪ f₂'.cb) = racl k ((f.cb : Set K) ∪ δ'.cb) := by
    rw [hδ'eq]
    refine le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset ?_ ?_))
      (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset ?_ ?_))
    · exact subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
    · exact cb_right_le_diff hg
    · exact subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
    · exact cb_diff_le hg
  have h12 : IndepOver k (f.cb : Set K) (f₁'.cb : Set K) f₂'.cb := by
    have h1 : IndepOver k (f.cb : Set K) (f₁'.cb : Set K) δ'.cb :=
      (indepOver_congr_left hracl₁).1 hδδ'
    exact ((indepOver_congr_left hracl₂).1 h1.symm).symm
  have hfinal : IndepOver k ∅ (f₁'.cb : Set K) f₂'.cb := by
    refine (indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨hind₁, ?_⟩).mono_right subset_union_right
    rwa [empty_union]
  exact ⟨f₁', hf₁', f₂', hf₂', g₁', hg₁', hfinal, hprod⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.isHW
statement:
theorem isHW {δ₀ : Germ k a a} (hδ₀ : δ₀ ∈ diffSet f₀) : IsHW δ₀ where
  isUnit
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := isInvertible_of_mem_diffSet hb.isInvertible hδ₀
    exact isUnit_iff.2 ⟨h, hh⟩
  trans g hg y hy hind := by
    rw [← diffSet_eq_orbit hδ₀] at hg
    exact hb.trans_diff hg hy hind
  inv g hg h hi := by
    rw [← diffSet_eq_orbit hδ₀] at hg ⊢
    exact inv_mem_diffSet hb.isInvertible hg hi
  comp g₁ hg₁ g₂ hg₂ hind := by
    rw [← diffSet_eq_orbit hδ₀] at hg₁ hg₂ ⊢
    exact hb.mul_mem_diffSet hg₁ hg₂ hind

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.comp_mem_orbit
statement:
theorem comp_mem_orbit {δ₀ : Germ k a a} (hδ₀ : δ₀ ∈ diffSet f₀) {f : Germ k a a'}
    {γ : Germ k a a} (hf : f ∈ orbit f₀) (hγ : γ ∈ IsHW.prodSet δ₀)
    (hind : IndepOver k ∅ (γ.cb : Set K) f.cb) :
    Germ.comp f γ ∈ orbit f₀ ∧ IndepOver k ∅ ((Germ.comp f γ).cb : Set K) γ.cb
proof:
:= by
  have hw := hb.isHW hδ₀
  have hγinv : IsInvertible γ := isUnit_iff.1 (hw.isUnit_of_mem_prodSet hγ)
  obtain ⟨δ₁, h₁, δ₂, h₂, rfl⟩ := hγ
  rw [← diffSet_eq_orbit hδ₀] at h₁ h₂
  obtain ⟨f', hf', hf'ind⟩ :=
    exists_mem_orbit_indepOver f₀ (δ₁.isSmall_cb.union δ₂.isSmall_cb)
  
  obtain ⟨hf₂', -, -⟩ :=
    hb.comp_mem_orbit_of_mem_diffSet hf' h₁ (hf'ind.mono_right subset_union_left).symm
  obtain ⟨g₁, hg₁⟩ := isInvertible_of_mem_diffSet hb.isInvertible h₁
  have hC : erk k ((δ₁.cb : Set K) ∪ δ₂.cb) ((Germ.comp f' δ₁).cb : Set K) =
      erk k ((δ₁.cb : Set K) ∪ δ₂.cb) (f'.cb : Set K) := by
    refine erk_eq_of_subset_racl ?_ ?_
    · exact (cb_comp_le_racl f' δ₁).trans (racl_mono (k := k)
        (union_subset (subset_union_left.trans subset_union_left) subset_union_right))
    · exact (cb_le_of_isInverse f' hg₁).trans (racl_mono (k := k)
        (union_subset subset_union_right (subset_union_left.trans subset_union_left)))
  have hf₂'δ₂ : IndepOver k ∅ ((Germ.comp f' δ₁).cb : Set K) δ₂.cb := by
    refine indepOver_cb_of_erk_eq _ (le_antisymm ?_ ?_)
    · rw [empty_union]
      exact erk_base_mono k (empty_subset _) _
    · rw [empty_union]
      calc erk k ∅ ((Germ.comp f' δ₁).cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (f₀.cb : Set K) :=
            erk_cb_eq_of_mem_orbit hf₂'
        _ = erk k ∅ (f'.cb : Set K) := (erk_cb_eq_of_mem_orbit hf').symm
        _ = erk k (∅ ∪ ((δ₁.cb : Set K) ∪ δ₂.cb)) (f'.cb : Set K) :=
            (erk_cb_eq_of_indepOver hf'ind).symm
        _ = erk k ((δ₁.cb : Set K) ∪ δ₂.cb) ((Germ.comp f' δ₁).cb : Set K) := by
            rw [empty_union, hC]
        _ ≤ erk k (δ₂.cb : Set K) ((Germ.comp f' δ₁).cb : Set K) :=
            erk_base_mono k subset_union_right _
  
  obtain ⟨hmem, -, -⟩ := hb.comp_mem_orbit_of_mem_diffSet hf₂' h₂ hf₂'δ₂.symm
  have hmem' : Germ.comp f' (δ₁ * δ₂) ∈ orbit f₀ := by
    rwa [mul_def, ← comp_assoc]
  have hγcb : ((δ₁ * δ₂).cb : Set K) ⊆ racl k ((δ₁.cb : Set K) ∪ δ₂.cb) :=
    (cb_comp_le_racl δ₁ δ₂).trans (racl_mono (k := k) (union_comm _ _).le)
  obtain ⟨gγ, hgγ⟩ := hγinv
  have hC' : erk k ((δ₁.cb : Set K) ∪ δ₂.cb) ((Germ.comp f' (δ₁ * δ₂)).cb : Set K) =
      erk k ((δ₁.cb : Set K) ∪ δ₂.cb) (f'.cb : Set K) := by
    refine erk_eq_of_subset_racl ?_ ?_
    · exact (cb_comp_le_racl f' _).trans (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset
        (hγcb.trans (racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_left))
        (subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _))))
    · exact (cb_le_of_isInverse f' hgγ).trans (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset
        (subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _))
        (hγcb.trans (racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_left))))
  have hf'γγ : IndepOver k ∅ ((Germ.comp f' (δ₁ * δ₂)).cb : Set K) (δ₁ * δ₂).cb := by
    refine indepOver_cb_of_erk_eq _ (le_antisymm ?_ ?_)
    · rw [empty_union]
      exact erk_base_mono k (empty_subset _) _
    · rw [empty_union]
      calc erk k ∅ ((Germ.comp f' (δ₁ * δ₂)).cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (f₀.cb : Set K) :=
            erk_cb_eq_of_mem_orbit hmem'
        _ = erk k ∅ (f'.cb : Set K) := (erk_cb_eq_of_mem_orbit hf').symm
        _ = erk k (∅ ∪ ((δ₁.cb : Set K) ∪ δ₂.cb)) (f'.cb : Set K) :=
            (erk_cb_eq_of_indepOver hf'ind).symm
        _ = erk k ((δ₁.cb : Set K) ∪ δ₂.cb) ((Germ.comp f' (δ₁ * δ₂)).cb : Set K) := by
            rw [empty_union, hC']
        _ = erk k (((δ₁.cb : Set K) ∪ δ₂.cb) ∪ (δ₁ * δ₂).cb)
              ((Germ.comp f' (δ₁ * δ₂)).cb : Set K) :=
            (erk_base_union_of_subset_racl k hγcb _).symm
        _ ≤ erk k ((δ₁ * δ₂).cb : Set K) ((Germ.comp f' (δ₁ * δ₂)).cb : Set K) :=
            erk_base_mono k subset_union_right _
  
  have hf'γ : IndepOver k ∅ (f'.cb : Set K) (δ₁ * δ₂).cb := by
    refine (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hf'ind).mono_right ?_
    rw [empty_union]
    exact hγcb
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := exists_algEquiv_of_mem_orbit hf' hf (δ₁ * δ₂).isSmall_cb hf'γ hind.symm
  have hfix : (δ₁ * δ₂).map (τ.restrictScalars k) = δ₁ * δ₂ := by
    refine (map_eq_self_iff _ _).2 fun x hx ↦ ?_
    change τ x = x
    exact τ.commutes ⟨x, subset_racl k _ hx⟩
  have hmap : (Germ.comp f' (δ₁ * δ₂)).map (τ.restrictScalars k) = Germ.comp f (δ₁ * δ₂) := by
    rw [comp_map (τ.restrictScalars k) f' (δ₁ * δ₂), hτ, hfix]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hmap]
    exact map_mem_orbit hmem' _
  have := hf'γγ.image (τ.restrictScalars k)
  rwa [image_empty, ← AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, ← coe_map, ← coe_map, ← cb_map, ← cb_map, hmap,
    hfix] at this

name: GroupConfig.Representative.equivalent_refl
statement: theorem equivalent_refl (r : Representative k K a a') : r.Equivalent r
proof: := fun _ _ ↦ rfl

name: GroupConfig.Representative.Equivalent.symm
statement:
theorem Equivalent.symm {r r' : Representative k K a a'} (h : r.Equivalent r') :
    r'.Equivalent r
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  rw [union_comm] at hy
  exact (h y hy).symm

name: GroupConfig.Representative.Equivalent.trans
statement:
theorem Equivalent.trans [IsAlgClosed k] [UniversalDomain k K] [Finite ι]
    {r r' r'' : Representative k K a a'} (h : r.Equivalent r') (h' : r'.Equivalent r'') :
    r.Equivalent r''
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  
  have hsmall : IsSmall k
      ((racl k ((r.M : Set K) ∪ r'.M ∪ r''.M) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    ((r.isSmall.union r'.isSmall).union r''.isSmall).racl
  obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hsmall a
  have h1 : IsGenericOver (racl k ((r.M : Set K) ∪ r'.M)) a y' :=
    hy'.of_le (racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_left)
  have h2 : IsGenericOver (racl k ((r'.M : Set K) ∪ r''.M)) a y' :=
    hy'.of_le (racl_mono (k := k)
      (union_subset (subset_union_right.trans subset_union_left) subset_union_right))
  have heq : r.f.eval y' = r''.f.eval y' := (h y' h1).trans (h' y' h2)
  have hMN : r.M ≤ racl k ((r.M : Set K) ∪ r'.M ∪ r''.M) :=
    (subset_union_left.trans subset_union_left).trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hM''N : r''.M ≤ racl k ((r.M : Set K) ∪ r'.M ∪ r''.M) :=
    subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hMy : r.M ≤ racl k ((r.M : Set K) ∪ r''.M) := subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hM''y : r''.M ≤ racl k ((r.M : Set K) ∪ r''.M) :=
    subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
  exact QuasiRational.eval_eq_of_eval_eq hMN hM''N hy' hy.inLocus
    (r.isDefinedAt y' (hy'.of_le hMN)) (r''.isDefinedAt y' (hy'.of_le hM''N))
    (r.isDefinedAt y (hy.of_le hMy)) (r''.isDefinedAt y (hy.of_le hM''y)) heq

name: GroupConfig.Representative.eval_mem_racl
statement:
theorem eval_mem_racl (r : Representative k K a a') {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGenericOver r.M a y)
    (j : κ) : r.f.eval y j ∈ racl k ((r.M : Set K) ∪ range y)
proof:
:= by
  have hdef := r.isDefinedAt y hy j
  have hle : r.M ≤ racl k ((r.M : Set K) ∪ range y) := subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
  
  have hpoly : ∀ P : MvPolynomial ι (↥r.M), aeval y P ∈ racl k ((r.M : Set K) ∪ range y) := by
    intro P
    have hmem : aeval y P ∈ Algebra.adjoin (↥r.M) (range y) := by
      rw [Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_aeval]
      exact ⟨P, rfl⟩
    exact (Algebra.adjoin_le (S := (extendScalars hle).toSubalgebra)
      (subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _))) hmem
  have hp : ringExpChar K ≠ 0 := by
    unfold ringExpChar
    exact Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.1 (le_max_right _ _)
  refine (isRAC_racl _).mem_of_pow_mem (m := ringExpChar K ^ r.f.e) (pow_ne_zero _ hp) ?_
  rw [QuasiRational.eval_apply, pRoot_pow]
  exact div_mem (hpoly _) (hpoly _)

name: GroupConfig.Representative.extend_equivalent
statement:
theorem extend_equivalent [UniversalDomain k K] [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (r : Representative k K a a') {M₁ : IntermediateField k K} (hM₁ : IsAlgClosed (↥M₁))
    (hsmall : IsSmall k (M₁ : Set K)) (h : r.M ≤ M₁) :
    (r.extend hM₁ hsmall h).Equivalent r
proof:
:=
  fun y _ ↦ QuasiRational.eval_map h r.f y

name: GroupConfig.exists_pow_eq_of_isAlgClosed
statement:
private theorem exists_pow_eq_of_isAlgClosed {N : IntermediateField k K} (hN : IsAlgClosed ↥N)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : 0 < p) : ∀ c ∈ (N : Set K), ∃ w ∈ (N : Set K), w ^ p = c
proof:
:= by
  intro c hc
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq (⟨c, hc⟩ : N) hp
  exact ⟨w, w.2, congrArg Subtype.val hw⟩

name: GroupConfig.isAlgebraic_subfield_of_range_subset
statement:
private theorem isAlgebraic_subfield_of_range_subset {R : Type*} [Field R] [Algebra R K]
    {T : Subfield K} (hRT : range (algebraMap R K) ⊆ T) {x : K} (hx : IsAlgebraic R x) :
    IsAlgebraic T x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq0, hq⟩ := hx
  let φ : R →+* T := (algebraMap R K).codRestrict T fun c ↦ hRT ⟨c, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨q.map φ, (Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff φ.injective).2 hq0, ?_⟩
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, Polynomial.eval₂_map]
  exact hq

name: GroupConfig.aeval_mem_closure
proof:
:= by
  induction P using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C c =>
    rw [aeval_C, IntermediateField.algebraMap_apply]
    exact Subfield.subset_closure (mem_union_left _ (h c.2))
  | add P Q hP hQ =>
    rw [map_add]
    exact add_mem hP hQ
  | mul_X P i hP =>
    rw [map_mul, aeval_X]
    exact mul_mem hP (Subfield.subset_closure (mem_union_right _ ⟨i, rfl⟩))

name: GroupConfig.eval_comp_of_le
proof:
:=
  QuasiRational.eval_comp f (algEquivOfLE h σ) y

name: GroupConfig.image_algEquiv_eq
statement:
private theorem image_algEquiv_eq {N : IntermediateField k K} (σ : K ≃ₐ[↥N] K) :
    ⇑σ '' (N : Set K) = N
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rw [show σ y = y from σ.commutes ⟨y, hy⟩]
    exact hy
  · exact fun hx ↦ ⟨x, hx, σ.commutes ⟨x, hx⟩⟩

name: GroupConfig.relfinrank_frobenius_of_isGenericOver
statement:
private theorem relfinrank_frobenius_of_isGenericOver (hp : (ringExpChar K).Prime)
    (hv : erk k ∅ (range v) = 1) {N : IntermediateField k K} (hN : IsAlgClosed ↥N)
    {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGenericOver N v y) :
    Subfield.relfinrank ((Subfield.closure ((N : Set K) ∪ range y)).map
      (frobenius K (ringExpChar K))) (Subfield.closure ((N : Set K) ∪ range y)) =
      ringExpChar K
proof:
:= by
  have hrank : erk k (N : Set K) (range y) = 1 := hy.erk_coe_eq.trans (hy.erk_empty_eq.trans hv)
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, y i ∉ racl k (N : Set K) := by
    by_contra! hall
    have h0 : erk k (N : Set K) (range y) = 0 := (erk_eq_zero_iff k).2 (by
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact hall i)
    rw [hrank] at h0
    exact one_ne_zero h0
  have htr : Transcendental N (y i) := fun halg ↦
    hi ((mem_racl_iff k).2 (by rw [adjoin_self]; exact halg))
  have hone : ∀ {C : Set K} {x : K}, x ∉ racl k C → erk k C {x} = 1 := fun hx ↦
    le_antisymm ((erk_le_encard k _ _).trans_eq (encard_singleton _))
      (Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 fun h0 ↦ hx ((erk_singleton_eq_zero_iff k).1 h0))
  have halg : ∀ j, y j ∈ racl k ((N : Set K) ∪ {y i}) := by
    intro j
    by_contra hj
    have h2 := erk_union_eq k (N : Set K) {y i} {y j}
    rw [hone hi, hone hj] at h2
    have h3 := (erk_mono k (N : Set K) (show {y i} ∪ {y j} ⊆ range y from
      union_subset (singleton_subset_iff.2 ⟨i, rfl⟩) (singleton_subset_iff.2 ⟨j, rfl⟩))).trans_eq
      hrank
    rw [h2] at h3
    norm_num at h3
  set A := Subfield.closure ((N : Set K) ∪ {y i})
  set F := Subfield.closure ((N : Set K) ∪ range y)
  have hNA : (N : Set K) ⊆ A := fun c hc ↦ Subfield.subset_closure (mem_union_left _ hc)
  have hAF : A ≤ F := Subfield.closure_le.2 (union_subset (fun c hc ↦
    Subfield.subset_closure (mem_union_left _ hc)) (singleton_subset_iff.2
      (Subfield.subset_closure (mem_union_right _ ⟨i, rfl⟩))))
  have hint : ∀ j, IsIntegral A (y j) := by
    intro j
    refine (isAlgebraic_subfield_of_range_subset ?_ ((mem_racl_iff k).1 (halg j))).isIntegral
    rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
    have hc : (c : K) ∈ (adjoin k ((N : Set K) ∪ {y i})).toSubfield := c.2
    rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_toSubfield] at hc
    refine Subfield.closure_le.2 (union_subset ?_ Subfield.subset_closure) hc
    rintro _ ⟨d, rfl⟩
    exact Subfield.subset_closure (mem_union_left _ (N.algebraMap_mem d))
  have hE : Subfield.extendScalars hAF = IntermediateField.adjoin A (range y) := by
    apply IntermediateField.toSubfield_injective
    rw [Subfield.extendScalars_toSubfield, IntermediateField.adjoin_toSubfield]
    refine le_antisymm (Subfield.closure_le.2 (union_subset ?_ ?_))
      (Subfield.closure_le.2 (union_subset ?_ ?_))
    · exact fun c hc ↦ Subfield.subset_closure (mem_union_left _ ⟨⟨c, hNA hc⟩, rfl⟩)
    · exact fun _ hz ↦ Subfield.subset_closure (mem_union_right _ hz)
    · rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
      exact hAF c.2
    · exact fun _ hz ↦ Subfield.subset_closure (mem_union_right _ hz)
  have hfin : Subfield.relfinrank A F ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Subfield.relfinrank_eq_finrank_of_le hAF, hE]
    have _ : FiniteDimensional A (IntermediateField.adjoin A (range y)) :=
      IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_adjoin fun _ ⟨j, hj⟩ ↦ hj ▸ hint j
    exact Module.finrank_pos.ne'
  exact relfinrank_map_frobenius_eq (ringExpChar K) hp (exists_pow_eq_of_isAlgClosed hN hp.pos)
    (fun c hc ↦ Subfield.subset_closure (mem_union_left _ hc))
    (Subfield.subset_closure (mem_union_right _ ⟨i, rfl⟩))
    (notMem_closure_pow_of_transcendental (ringExpChar K) hp htr) hfin

name: GroupConfig.Germ.exists_rep_e_eq_zero_of_ringExpChar_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_rep_e_eq_zero_of_ringExpChar_eq_one (h1 : ringExpChar K = 1) (g : Germ k v v) :
    ∃ r : Representative k K v v, (⟦r⟧ : Germ k v v) = g ∧ r.f.e = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep g
  let f : QuasiRational r.M ι ι := ⟨0, r.f.num, r.f.den⟩
  have heval : ∀ u : ι → K, f.eval u = r.f.eval u := fun u ↦ funext fun j ↦ by
    change pRoot K 0 _ = pRoot K r.f.e _
    rw [pRoot_zero]
    exact (pRoot_eq_of_pow_eq (by rw [h1, one_pow, pow_one])).symm
  let r' : Representative k K v v :=
    { M := r.M
      isAlgClosed := r.isAlgClosed
      isSmall := r.isSmall
      f := f
      isDefinedAt := fun y hy ↦ r.isDefinedAt y hy
      isGenericOver := fun y hy ↦ by rw [heval]; exact r.isGenericOver y hy }
  exact ⟨r', Quotient.sound (show r'.Equivalent r from fun u _ ↦ heval u), rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.isFrobIndex_transport
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := hy.exists_algEquiv (hy'.of_le hNN')
  have hy'σ : y' = ⇑σ ∘ y := funext fun i ↦ (hσ i).symm
  have h' := h.map (σ : K →+* K)
  rw [RingHom.coe_coe, image_algEquiv_eq σ, ← eval_comp_of_le hrN r.f σ y, ← hy'σ] at h'
  exact h'.mono (fun x hx ↦ hNN' hx) (exists_pow_eq_of_isAlgClosed hN' hp.pos)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.HasFrobIndex.unique
statement:
theorem HasFrobIndex.unique (hp : (ringExpChar K).Prime) (hv : erk k ∅ (range v) = 1)
    {g : Germ k v v} {δ δ' : ℤ} (h : g.HasFrobIndex δ) (h' : g.HasFrobIndex δ') : δ = δ'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, N, hrN, -, hNs, y, hy, hδ⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨r', hr', N', hrN', -, hN's, y', hy', hδ'⟩ := h'
  have hN'' : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k ((N : Set K) ∪ N')) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have h1 : N ≤ racl k ((N : Set K) ∪ N') := subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have h2 : N' ≤ racl k ((N : Set K) ∪ N') := subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_isGenericOver (hNs.union hN's).racl v
  have e1 := isFrobIndex_transport hp hrN h1 hN'' hy hu hδ
  have e2 := isFrobIndex_transport hp hrN' h2 hN'' hy' hu hδ'
  have hrr' : r.Equivalent r' := Quotient.exact (hr.trans hr'.symm)
  rw [hrr' u (hu.of_le (racl_mono (union_subset_union hrN hrN')))] at e1
  exact e1.unique hp (relfinrank_frobenius_of_isGenericOver hp hv hN'' hu) e2

name: GroupConfig.Germ.HasFrobIndex.map
statement:
theorem HasFrobIndex.map {g : Germ k v v} {δ : ℤ} (h : g.HasFrobIndex δ) (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) :
    (g.map σ).HasFrobIndex δ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl, N, hrN, hN, hNs, y, hy, hδ⟩ := h
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥N := hN
  refine ⟨r.map σ, (map_mk σ r).symm, N.map σ.toAlgHom, ?_, isAlgClosed_map σ N, isSmall_map σ hNs,
    ⇑σ ∘ y, (isGenericOver_map_iff σ N v y).2 hy, ?_⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x, hrN hx, rfl⟩
  · rw [Representative.map_eval, IntermediateField.coe_map]
    simpa using hδ.map (σ : K →+* K)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.HasFrobIndex.mul
statement:
theorem HasFrobIndex.mul {g₁ g₂ : Germ k v v} {δ₁ δ₂ : ℤ} (h₁ : g₁.HasFrobIndex δ₁)
    (hp : (ringExpChar K).Prime) (h₂ : g₂.HasFrobIndex δ₂) :
    (g₁ * g₂).HasFrobIndex (δ₂ + δ₁)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r₁, rfl, N₁, hrN₁, -, hN₁s, y₁, hy₁, hδ₁⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨r₂, rfl, N₂, hrN₂, -, hN₂s, y₂, hy₂, hδ₂⟩ := h₂
  have hN : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k ((N₁ : Set K) ∪ N₂)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hNs : IsSmall k ((racl k ((N₁ : Set K) ∪ N₂) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (hN₁s.union hN₂s).racl
  have h1 : N₁ ≤ racl k ((N₁ : Set K) ∪ N₂) := subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have h2 : N₂ ≤ racl k ((N₁ : Set K) ∪ N₂) := subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hj : Representative.joinField r₁ r₂ ≤ racl k ((N₁ : Set K) ∪ N₂) :=
    racl_mono (union_subset (fun x hx ↦ Or.inr (hrN₂ hx)) fun x hx ↦ Or.inl (hrN₁ hx))
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hNs v
  have hz : IsGenericOver (racl k ((N₁ : Set K) ∪ N₂)) v (r₂.f.eval y) := by
    have := (r₂.extend hN hNs (hrN₂.trans h2)).isGenericOver y hy
    rwa [Representative.extend_eval] at this
  have e₂ := isFrobIndex_transport hp hrN₂ h2 hN hy₂ hy hδ₂
  have e₁ := isFrobIndex_transport hp hrN₁ h1 hN hy₁ hz hδ₁
  refine ⟨r₁.comp r₂, rfl, _, hj, hN, hNs, y, hy, ?_⟩
  rw [Representative.comp_eval r₁ r₂ (hy.of_le hj)]
  exact e₂.trans e₁

name: GroupConfig.Germ.exists_hasFrobIndex
statement:
theorem exists_hasFrobIndex (hp : (ringExpChar K).Prime) (hv : erk k ∅ (range v) = 1)
    {g : Germ k v v} (hg : IsUnit g) : ∃ δ, g.HasFrobIndex δ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep g
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := isUnit_iff.1 hg
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep h
  have hsr : (s.comp r).Equivalent (Representative.id v) :=
    Quotient.exact (hh.1 : (⟦s.comp r⟧ : Germ k v v) = ⟦Representative.id (k := k) v⟧)
  set N := racl k ((Representative.joinField s r : Set K) ∪ (Representative.id (k := k) v).M)
  have hN : IsAlgClosed ↥N := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hNs : IsSmall k (N : Set K) :=
    ((Representative.isSmall_joinField s r).union (Representative.id (k := k) v).isSmall).racl
  have hjN : Representative.joinField s r ≤ N := subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hrN : r.M ≤ N := (Representative.le_joinField_left s r).trans hjN
  have hsN : s.M ≤ N := (Representative.le_joinField_right s r).trans hjN
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hNs v
  have hsz : s.f.eval (r.f.eval y) = y := by
    rw [← Representative.comp_eval s r (hy.of_le hjN), hsr y hy]
    exact QuasiRational.id_eval y
  have hz : ∀ j, r.f.eval y j ^ ringExpChar K ^ r.f.e ∈
      Subfield.closure ((N : Set K) ∪ range y) := by
    intro j
    rw [QuasiRational.eval_apply, pRoot_pow]
    exact div_mem (aeval_mem_closure hrN y _) (aeval_mem_closure hrN y _)
  have hy' : ∀ i, y i ^ ringExpChar K ^ s.f.e ∈
      Subfield.closure ((N : Set K) ∪ range (r.f.eval y)) := by
    intro i
    rw [← congrFun hsz i, QuasiRational.eval_apply, pRoot_pow]
    exact div_mem (aeval_mem_closure hsN _ _) (aeval_mem_closure hsN _ _)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ := IsFrobIndex.exists hp (relfinrank_frobenius_of_isGenericOver hp hv hN hy) hz hy'
  exact ⟨δ, r, rfl, N, hrN, hN, hNs, y, hy, hδ⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.HasFrobIndex.exists_rep_e_eq_zero
statement:
theorem HasFrobIndex.exists_rep_e_eq_zero {g : Germ k v v} (h : g.HasFrobIndex 0) :
    ∃ r : Representative k K v v, (⟦r⟧ : Germ k v v) = g ∧ r.f.e = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨r, rfl, N, hrN, hN, hNs, y, hy, h0⟩ := h
  have hmem : ∀ j, r.f.eval y j ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin N (range y) := by
    intro j
    have hj : r.f.eval y j ∈ Subfield.closure ((N : Set K) ∪ range y) :=
      h0.closure_eq_of_zero ▸ Subfield.subset_closure (mem_union_right _ ⟨j, rfl⟩)
    rw [← IntermediateField.mem_toSubfield, IntermediateField.adjoin_toSubfield]
    refine Subfield.closure_mono (union_subset_union_left _ ?_) hj
    intro c hc
    exact ⟨⟨c, hc⟩, rfl⟩
  choose P Q hPQ using fun j ↦ (IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_range_iff N y _).1 (hmem j)
  let P' : ι → MvPolynomial ι N := fun j ↦ if aeval y (Q j) = 0 then 0 else P j
  let Q' : ι → MvPolynomial ι N := fun j ↦ if aeval y (Q j) = 0 then 1 else Q j
  have hQ' : ∀ j, aeval y (Q' j) ≠ 0 := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj : aeval y (Q j) = 0 <;> simp [Q', hj]
  have hPQ' : ∀ j, r.f.eval y j = aeval y (P' j) / aeval y (Q' j) := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj : aeval y (Q j) = 0 <;> simp [P', Q', hj, hPQ j]
  let f : QuasiRational N ι ι := ⟨0, P', Q'⟩
  have hfy : f.eval y = r.f.eval y := funext fun j ↦ by
    change pRoot K 0 (aeval y (P' j) / aeval y (Q' j)) = _
    rw [pRoot_zero, hPQ' j]
  have hagree : ∀ y', IsGenericOver N v y' → f.eval y' = r.f.eval y' := by
    intro y' hy'
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := hy.exists_algEquiv hy'
    have hy'σ : y' = ⇑σ ∘ y := funext fun i ↦ (hσ i).symm
    rw [hy'σ, QuasiRational.eval_comp, eval_comp_of_le hrN r.f σ y, hfy]
  have hdef : ∀ y', IsGenericOver N v y' → f.IsDefinedAt y' := by
    intro y' hy'
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := hy.exists_algEquiv hy'
    have hy'σ : y' = ⇑σ ∘ y := funext fun i ↦ (hσ i).symm
    rw [hy'σ, QuasiRational.isDefinedAt_comp_iff]
    exact hQ'
  let r' : Representative k K v v :=
    { M := N
      isAlgClosed := hN
      isSmall := hNs
      f := f
      isDefinedAt := hdef
      isGenericOver := fun y' hy' ↦ by
        have := (r.extend hN hNs hrN).isGenericOver y' hy'
        rwa [Representative.extend_eval, ← hagree y' hy'] at this }
  refine ⟨r', Quotient.sound (show r'.Equivalent r from fun y' hy' ↦ ?_), rfl⟩
  exact hagree y' (hy'.of_le (subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)))

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.exists_rational_representative
statement:
theorem IsHW.exists_rational_representative {g₀ : Germ k v v} (hw : IsHW g₀)
    (hv : erk k ∅ (range v) = 1) {γ : Germ k v v} (hγ : γ ∈ IsHW.prodSet g₀) :
    ∃ r : Representative k K v v, (⟦r⟧ : Germ k v v) = γ ∧ r.f.e = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases expChar_is_prime_or_one K (ringExpChar K) with hp | h1
  swap
  · exact exists_rep_e_eq_zero_of_ringExpChar_eq_one h1 γ
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ := exists_hasFrobIndex hp hv hw.isUnit
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hind⟩ := exists_mem_orbit_indepOver g₀ g₀.isSmall_cb
  have hmul : g₀ * h ∈ orbit g₀ := hw.comp g₀ (self_mem_orbit g₀) h hh hind.symm
  obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := hh
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := hmul
  have hτ' : g₀.map τ = g₀ * g₀.map σ := hτ
  have e1 : (g₀ * g₀.map σ).HasFrobIndex δ := by
    rw [← hτ']
    exact hδ.map τ
  have e2 : (g₀ * g₀.map σ).HasFrobIndex (δ + δ) := hδ.mul hp (hδ.map σ)
  obtain rfl : δ = 0 := by
    have := e1.unique hp hv e2
    omega
  obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀, he₀⟩ := hδ.exists_rep_e_eq_zero
  obtain ⟨g₁, ⟨σ₁, rfl⟩, g₂, ⟨σ₂, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := hγ
  refine ⟨(r₀.map σ₁).comp (r₀.map σ₂), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hr₀]
    rfl
  · change r₀.f.e + r₀.f.e = 0
    rw [he₀]

name: GroupConfig.indepOver_racl_base_iff
statement:
theorem indepOver_racl_base_iff (C A B : Set K) :
    IndepOver k (racl k C) A B ↔ IndepOver k C A B
proof:
:= by
  unfold IndepOver
  refine forall_congr' fun a ↦ forall_congr' fun _ ↦ forall_congr' fun _ ↦ ?_
  rw [erk_racl_base, erk_congr_base k (racl_union_left (k := k) C B)]

name: GroupConfig.IsGenericOver.isGen
statement:
theorem IsGenericOver.isGen {M : IntermediateField k K} {y : ι → K}
    (h : IsGenericOver M a y) : IsGen k a y
proof:
:=
  h.idealOf_eq

name: GroupConfig.IsGen.map
statement: theorem IsGen.map {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k a y) (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) : IsGen k a (⇑σ ∘ y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsGen at hy ⊢
  rw [show ⇑σ ∘ y = ⇑σ.toAlgHom ∘ y from rfl, idealOf_comp_algHom, hy]

name: GroupConfig.IsGen.isGenericOver_of_indepOver
statement:
theorem IsGen.isGenericOver_of_indepOver {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k a y)
    {M : IntermediateField k K} (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K))
    (h : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (M : Set K)) : IsGenericOver M a y
proof:
:= by
  have := isGenericOver_self_of_indepOver hM h
  unfold IsGenericOver at this ⊢
  rw [this, hy]

name: GroupConfig.IsGen.isGenericOver_racl
statement:
theorem IsGen.isGenericOver_racl {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k a y) {w : Set K} (hw : IsSmall k w)
    (h : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) w) : IsGenericOver (racl k w) a y
proof:
:= by
  refine hy.isGenericOver_of_indepOver hw.racl ?_
  have := indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 h
  rwa [empty_union] at this

name: GroupConfig.exists_isGen
statement: theorem exists_isGen (a : ι → K) : ∃ y, IsGen k a y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver (IsSmall.of_finite (k := k) finite_empty).racl a
  exact ⟨y, hy.isGen⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.indepOver_cb_iff
statement:
theorem indepOver_cb_iff (g : Germ k a a') (C w : Set K) :
    IndepOver k C (g.cb : Set K) w ↔ IndepOver k C (g.codeSet : Set K) w
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine h.mono_left ?_
    rw [← adjoin_codeSet]
    exact subset_adjoin k _
  · intro h
    refine (indepOver_racl_left_iff.2 h).mono_left ?_
    rw [← adjoin_codeSet]
    exact adjoin_le_iff.2 (subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _))

name: GroupConfig.Germ.indepOver_cb_iff'
statement:
theorem indepOver_cb_iff' (g : Germ k a a') (C w : Set K) :
    IndepOver k C w (g.cb : Set K) ↔ IndepOver k C w (g.codeSet : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [indepOver_comm, indepOver_cb_iff, indepOver_comm]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.indepOver_cb_of_erk_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [indepOver_cb_iff]
  refine indepOver_of_erk_eq g.codeSet.finite_toSet ?_
  rw [erk_codeSet_eq, erk_codeSet_eq]
  exact h

name: GroupConfig.Germ.erk_cb_eq_of_indepOver
proof:
:= by
  have := (indepOver_cb_iff g C w).1 h (subset_refl _) g.codeSet.finite_toSet
  rwa [erk_codeSet_eq, erk_codeSet_eq] at this

name: GroupConfig.Germ.map_refl
statement: theorem map_refl (g : Germ k a a') : g.map AlgEquiv.refl = g
proof:
:=
  (map_eq_self_iff AlgEquiv.refl g).2 fun _ _ ↦ rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.self_mem_orbit
statement: theorem self_mem_orbit (g₀ : Germ k a a') : g₀ ∈ orbit g₀
proof: := ⟨AlgEquiv.refl, map_refl g₀⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.map_mem_orbit
statement:
theorem map_mem_orbit {g₀ g : Germ k a a'} (h : g ∈ orbit g₀) (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) :
    g.map σ ∈ orbit g₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨τ, rfl⟩ := h
  exact ⟨τ.trans σ, (map_map τ σ g₀).symm⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.orbit_eq_of_mem
statement: theorem orbit_eq_of_mem {g₀ g : Germ k a a'} (h : g ∈ orbit g₀) : orbit g = orbit g₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨τ, rfl⟩ := h
  ext g'
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨σ, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨τ.trans σ, (map_map τ σ g₀).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨σ, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨τ.symm.trans σ, ?_⟩
    change (g₀.map τ).map (τ.symm.trans σ) = g₀.map σ
    rw [map_map]
    congr 1
    exact AlgEquiv.ext fun x ↦ by simp

name: GroupConfig.Germ.erk_cb_eq_of_mem_orbit
statement:
theorem erk_cb_eq_of_mem_orbit {g₀ g : Germ k a a'} (h : g ∈ orbit g₀) :
    erk k ∅ (g.cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := h
  exact erk_cb_map σ g₀

name: GroupConfig.Germ.isUnit_of_mem_orbit
statement:
theorem isUnit_of_mem_orbit {g₀ g : Germ k a a} (h₀ : IsUnit g₀) (h : g ∈ orbit g₀) :
    IsUnit g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨h₀', hi⟩ := isUnit_iff.1 h₀
  exact isUnit_iff.2 ⟨h₀'.map σ, hi.map σ⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.orbit_inv
statement:
theorem orbit_inv {g₀ h₀ : Germ k a a} (hi : IsInverse h₀ g₀) {g h : Germ k a a}
    (hg : g ∈ orbit g₀) (hgh : IsInverse h g) : h ∈ orbit h₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := hg
  exact ⟨σ, (hi.map σ).unique hgh⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.exists_mem_orbit_indepOver
statement:
theorem exists_mem_orbit_indepOver (g₀ : Germ k a a') {w : Set K} (hw : IsSmall k w) :
    ∃ g ∈ orbit g₀, IndepOver k ∅ (g.cb : Set K) w
proof:
:= by
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (∅ : Set K)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hM : IsSmall k ((racl k (∅ : Set K) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (IsSmall.of_finite finite_empty).racl
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_algEquiv_indepOver (M := racl k (∅ : Set K)) hM
    (fun s : g₀.codeSet ↦ (s : K)) hw
  refine ⟨g₀.map (σ.restrictScalars k), ⟨_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [indepOver_cb_iff, ← indepOver_racl_base_iff]
  have hcode : (((g₀.map (σ.restrictScalars k)).codeSet : Finset K) : Set K) ⊆
      racl k (((racl k (∅ : Set K) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) ∪
        range fun s : g₀.codeSet ↦ σ (s : K)) := by
    have h1 : (((g₀.map (σ.restrictScalars k)).codeSet : Finset K) : Set K) ⊆
        ((g₀.map (σ.restrictScalars k)).cb : Set K) := by
      rw [← adjoin_codeSet]
      exact subset_adjoin k _
    refine h1.trans ?_
    rw [cb_map, ← adjoin_codeSet, adjoin_map]
    refine adjoin_le_iff.2 ?_
    rw [image_eq_range]
    exact subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)
  exact (indepOver_racl_left_iff.2 hσ).mono_left hcode

name: GroupConfig.Germ.map_eq_self_of_fixes_codeSet
statement:
theorem map_eq_self_of_fixes_codeSet {g : Germ k a a'} (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ g.codeSet, σ x = x) : g.map σ = g
proof:
:= by
  refine (map_eq_self_iff σ g).2 fun x hx ↦ ?_
  have hle : g.cb ≤ fixedBy σ := by
    rw [← adjoin_codeSet]
    exact adjoin_le_iff.2 fun x hx ↦ h x hx
  exact hle hx

name: GroupConfig.Germ.exists_algEquiv_of_mem_orbit
statement:
theorem exists_algEquiv_of_mem_orbit {g₀ g g' : Germ k a a'} (hg : g ∈ orbit g₀)
    (hg' : g' ∈ orbit g₀) {w : Set K} (hw : IsSmall k w)
    (h : IndepOver k ∅ (g.cb : Set K) w) (h' : IndepOver k ∅ (g'.cb : Set K) w) :
    ∃ τ : K ≃ₐ[↥(racl k w)] K, g.map (τ.restrictScalars k) = g'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ : ∃ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K, g.map σ = g' := by
    rw [← orbit_eq_of_mem hg] at hg'
    exact hg'
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k w) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  
  let c : g.codeSet → K := fun s ↦ (s : K)
  have hrange : range c = (g.codeSet : Set K) := Subtype.range_coe_subtype
  have hc : IsGen k c c := rfl
  have hc' : IsGen k c (⇑σ ∘ c) := by
    have : ⇑σ ∘ c = ⇑σ.toAlgHom ∘ c := rfl
    unfold IsGen
    rw [this, idealOf_comp_algHom]
  have hcind : IndepOver k ∅ (range c) ((racl k w : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) := by
    have := indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 ((indepOver_cb_iff g ∅ w).1 h)
    rwa [empty_union, ← hrange] at this
  have hc'ind : IndepOver k ∅ (range (⇑σ ∘ c)) ((racl k w : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) := by
    have := indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 h'
    rw [empty_union] at this
    refine this.mono_left ?_
    rw [← hσ, cb_map, coe_map, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, range_comp, hrange, ← adjoin_codeSet]
    exact image_mono (subset_adjoin k _)
  have hcgen : IsGenericOver (racl k w) c c := hc.isGenericOver_of_indepOver hw.racl hcind
  have hcgen' : IsGenericOver (racl k w) c (⇑σ ∘ c) :=
    hc'.isGenericOver_of_indepOver hw.racl hc'ind
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := hcgen.exists_algEquiv hcgen'
  refine ⟨τ, ?_⟩
  
  have hfix : (g.map (τ.restrictScalars k)).map ((τ.restrictScalars k).symm.trans σ) =
      g.map (τ.restrictScalars k) := by
    refine (map_eq_self_iff _ _).2 fun x hx ↦ ?_
    rw [cb_map, ← adjoin_codeSet, adjoin_map] at hx
    have hle : adjoin k (⇑(τ.restrictScalars k).toAlgHom '' (g.codeSet : Set K)) ≤
        fixedBy ((τ.restrictScalars k).symm.trans σ) := by
      refine adjoin_le_iff.2 ?_
      rintro _ ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
      change σ ((τ.restrictScalars k).symm ((τ.restrictScalars k) s)) = (τ.restrictScalars k) s
      rw [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
      exact (hτ ⟨s, hs⟩).symm
    exact hle hx
  calc g.map (τ.restrictScalars k)
      = (g.map (τ.restrictScalars k)).map ((τ.restrictScalars k).symm.trans σ) := hfix.symm
    _ = g.map ((τ.restrictScalars k).trans ((τ.restrictScalars k).symm.trans σ)) := map_map _ _ _
    _ = g.map σ := by
        congr 1
        exact AlgEquiv.ext fun x ↦ by simp
    _ = g' := hσ

name: GroupConfig.Germ.isGenericOver_racl_cb
statement:
theorem isGenericOver_racl_cb (g : Germ k a a') {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k a y)
    (h : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (g.cb : Set K)) : IsGenericOver (racl k (g.cb : Set K)) a y
proof:
:=
  hy.isGenericOver_racl g.isSmall_cb h

name: GroupConfig.Germ.evalGen_eq
statement:
theorem evalGen_eq (g : Germ k a a') {F : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed (↥F)]
    (hF : IsSmall k (F : Set K)) (hcb : g.cb ≤ F) {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGenericOver F a y) :
    g.evalGen y = g.eval F y
proof:
:= by
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (g.cb : Set K)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  exact eval_eq_of_le g g.isSmall_cb.racl hF (subset_racl k _) (racl_le_of_isAlgClosed hcb) hy

name: GroupConfig.Germ.isGen_evalGen
statement:
theorem isGen_evalGen (g : Germ k a a') {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k a y)
    (h : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (g.cb : Set K)) : IsGen k a' (g.evalGen y)
proof:
:= by
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (g.cb : Set K)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  exact (g.isGenericOver_eval g.isSmall_cb.racl (subset_racl k _)
    (g.isGenericOver_racl_cb hy h)).isGen

name: GroupConfig.Germ.indepOver_evalGen
statement:
theorem indepOver_evalGen (g : Germ k a a') {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k a y)
    (h : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (g.cb : Set K)) :
    IndepOver k ∅ (range (g.evalGen y)) (g.cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (g.cb : Set K)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  exact (g.isGenericOver_eval g.isSmall_cb.racl (subset_racl k _)
    (g.isGenericOver_racl_cb hy h)).indepOver.mono_right (subset_racl k _)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.evalGen_mem_racl
statement:
theorem evalGen_mem_racl (g : Germ k a a') {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k a y)
    (h : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (g.cb : Set K)) (j : κ) :
    g.evalGen y j ∈ racl k ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ range y)
proof:
:= by
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k (g.cb : Set K)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have := g.eval_mem_racl g.isSmall_cb.racl (subset_racl k _) (g.isGenericOver_racl_cb hy h) j
  rwa [racl_union_left] at this

name: GroupConfig.Representative.hasValue_subst_coord
statement:
private theorem hasValue_subst_coord (hr : r.f.e = 0) {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGenericOver r.M v y)
    (i : ι) : HasValue r.M y (r.subst hr (coord k v i)) (r.f.eval y i)
proof:
:=
  ⟨r.f.num i, r.f.den i, r.isDefinedAt y hy i, r.subst_coord hr i, by
    rw [QuasiRational.eval_apply, hr, pRoot_zero]⟩

name: GroupConfig.Representative.hasValue_aeval_graph
statement:
private theorem hasValue_aeval_graph (hr : r.f.e = 0) {C : IntermediateField k K}
    (hCM : C ≤ r.M) {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGenericOver r.M v y) (P : MvPolynomial (ι ⊕ ι) C) :
    HasValue r.M y (aeval (Sum.elim (coord k v) fun i ↦ r.subst hr (coord k v i)) P)
      (aeval (r.graphPoint y) P)
proof:
:= by
  induction P using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C c =>
    rw [aeval_C, aeval_C]
    exact hasValue_algebraMap hCM c
  | add p q hp hq =>
    rw [map_add, map_add]
    exact HasValue.add hy hp hq
  | mul_X p j hp =>
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, aeval_X, aeval_X]
    refine HasValue.mul hp ?_
    cases j with
    | inl i => exact hasValue_coord i
    | inr i => exact r.hasValue_subst_coord hr hy i

name: GroupConfig.Representative.ker_aeval_graph
statement:
theorem ker_aeval_graph (hr : r.f.e = 0) (C : IntermediateField k K) (hCM : C ≤ r.M) :
    RingHom.ker (aeval (Sum.elim (coord k v) fun i ↦ r.subst hr (coord k v i)) :
        MvPolynomial (ι ⊕ ι) C →ₐ[C] LocusFunctionField k v).toRingHom =
      r.graphIdeal.comap (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap C K))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver r.isSmall v
  ext P
  have hval := r.hasValue_aeval_graph hr hCM hy P
  have hzero : HasValue r.M y (0 : LocusFunctionField k v) 0 := by
    simpa using hasValue_mk (k := k) (v := v) (M := r.M) (y := y) 0
  have hmap : MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap C K) P = MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap r.M K)
      (MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion hCM).toRingHom P) := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.map_map]
    rfl
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker, Ideal.mem_comap, r.graphIdeal_eq hy, hmap, map_mem_locusIdeal_iff,
    mem_idealOf_iff, aeval_map_inclusion]
  change aeval (Sum.elim (coord k v) fun i ↦ r.subst hr (coord k v i)) P = 0 ↔ _
  constructor
  · intro h0
    rw [h0] at hval
    exact hval.eq_value hy hzero
  · intro h0
    rw [h0] at hval
    exact hval.eq hy hzero

name: GroupConfig.isSmall_univ_of_trdeg_lt
statement:
theorem isSmall_univ_of_trdeg_lt (h : Algebra.trdeg k K < Cardinal.aleph0) :
    IsSmall k (univ : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsSmall
  rw [erk_empty_eq_toENat_trdeg,
    ((equivOfEq (adjoin_univ k K)).trans topEquiv).trdeg_eq]
  exact Cardinal.toENat_ne_top.2 h

name: GroupConfig.not_isGenericOver_of_top_le
statement:
theorem not_isGenericOver_of_top_le [Finite ι] {M : IntermediateField k K} (hM : ⊤ ≤ M)
    {a : ι → K} (ha : 1 ≤ erk k ∅ (range a)) (y : ι → K) : ¬ IsGenericOver M a y
proof:
:= by
  intro hy
  have h0 : erk k (M : Set K) (range y) = 0 :=
    (erk_eq_zero_iff k).2 fun _ _ ↦ subset_racl k (M : Set K) (hM mem_top)
  rw [hy.erk_coe_eq, hy.erk_empty_eq] at h0
  rw [h0] at ha
  simp at ha

name: GroupConfig.Representative.top_equivalent
statement:
theorem top_equivalent (hK : IsSmall k (univ : Set K)) (ha : 1 ≤ erk k ∅ (range a))
    (f : QuasiRational (↥(⊤ : IntermediateField k K)) ι κ) (r : Representative k K a a') :
    (top hK ha f).Equivalent r
proof:
:= fun y hy ↦
  absurd hy (not_isGenericOver_of_top_le
    (fun _ _ ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl (mem_top : _ ∈ (⊤ : IntermediateField k K)))) ha y)

name: GroupConfig.Representative.eqvGen_equivalent
statement:
theorem eqvGen_equivalent (hK : IsSmall k (univ : Set K)) (ha : 1 ≤ erk k ∅ (range a))
    (r r' : Representative k K a a') : Relation.EqvGen Representative.Equivalent r r'
proof:
:= by
  let r₀ : Representative k K a a' := top hK ha ⟨0, fun _ ↦ 0, fun _ ↦ 1⟩
  exact .trans _ r₀ _ (.symm _ _ (.rel _ _ (top_equivalent hK ha _ r)))
    (.rel _ _ (top_equivalent hK ha _ r'))

name: GroupConfig.tensorCoordinateQuotientEquiv'_tmul
statement:
private theorem tensorCoordinateQuotientEquiv'_tmul (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι k))
    (c : C) (P : MvPolynomial ι k) :
    tensorCoordinateQuotientEquiv' I (c ⊗ₜ[k] Ideal.Quotient.mk I P) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k C)))
        (c • MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k C) P)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tensorCoordinateQuotientEquiv', AlgEquiv.trans_apply,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.tensorQuotientEquiv_apply_tmul, Ideal.quotientEquivAlg_mk,
    MvPolynomial.algebraTensorAlgEquiv_tmul]

name: GroupConfig.tensorCoordinateQuotientEquiv'_X
statement:
private theorem tensorCoordinateQuotientEquiv'_X (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι k)) (i : ι) :
    tensorCoordinateQuotientEquiv' (C := C) I
      ((1 : C) ⊗ₜ[k] Ideal.Quotient.mk I (X i : MvPolynomial ι k)) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k C))) (X i : MvPolynomial ι C)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [MvPolynomial.map_X, one_smul] using
    tensorCoordinateQuotientEquiv'_tmul (k := k) (C := C) I 1 (X i : MvPolynomial ι k)

name: GroupConfig.ker_aeval_eq_of_injective'
statement:
private theorem ker_aeval_eq_of_injective' {R A B ι : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing A]
    [CommRing B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (hφ : Function.Injective φ) (x : ι → A) (y : ι → B) (hxy : ∀ i, φ (x i) = y i) :
    RingHom.ker (aeval (R := R) x).toRingHom =
      RingHom.ker (aeval (R := R) y).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  have heval (P : MvPolynomial ι R) : φ (aeval x P) = aeval y P := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply]
    exact congrArg (fun z ↦ aeval z P) (funext hxy)
  ext P
  change aeval x P = 0 ↔ aeval y P = 0
  rw [← heval, map_eq_zero_iff _ hφ]

name: GroupConfig.transportDerivation'_regular
statement:
private theorem transportDerivation'_regular (e : A ≃ₐ[R] B) (D : Derivation R A A)
    (hD : ∀ W : ValuationSubring A, (∀ c : R, algebraMap R A c ∈ W) → W ≠ ⊤ →
      ∀ x ∈ W, D x ∈ W)
    (V : ValuationSubring B) (hRV : ∀ c : R, algebraMap R B c ∈ V) (hV : V ≠ ⊤)
    {x : B} (hx : x ∈ V) : D.transport e x ∈ V
proof:
:= by
  let W := V.comap e.toRingHom
  have hRW (c : R) : algebraMap R A c ∈ W := by
    change e (algebraMap R A c) ∈ V
    rw [e.commutes]
    exact hRV c
  have hW : W ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro h
    apply hV
    apply top_unique
    intro z _
    have hz : e.symm z ∈ W := by rw [h]; exact ValuationSubring.mem_top _
    change e (e.symm z) ∈ V at hz
    simpa only [e.apply_symm_apply] using hz
  have hix : e.symm x ∈ W := by
    change e (e.symm x) ∈ V
    simpa only [e.apply_symm_apply] using hx
  exact hD W hRW hW _ hix

name: GroupConfig.coordPoly_sub'
statement:
private theorem coordPoly_sub' (l : K →ₗ[C] C) (P Q : MvPolynomial ι K) :
    coordPoly l (P - Q) = coordPoly l P - coordPoly l Q
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  simp only [coeff_coordPoly, coeff_sub, map_sub]

name: GroupConfig.coordPoly_mul_X'
statement:
private theorem coordPoly_mul_X' (l : K →ₗ[C] C) (P : MvPolynomial ι K) (i : ι) :
    coordPoly l (P * X i) = coordPoly l P * X i
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [MvPolynomial.map_X] using coordPoly_mul_map l P (X i)

name: GroupConfig.exists_fraction_relation
statement:
private theorem exists_fraction_relation {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (ι ⊕ κ) K)}
    {J : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K)}
    (hI : I = (I.comap (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap C K))).map
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap C K)))
    {P Q : MvPolynomial ι K} (hQ : Q ∉ J) (j : κ)
    (hPQ : rename Sum.inl Q * X (Sum.inr j) - rename Sum.inl P ∈ I) :
    ∃ p q : MvPolynomial ι C, MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap C K) q ∉ J ∧
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap C K)
        (rename Sum.inl q * X (Sum.inr j) - rename Sum.inl p) ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b := Module.Basis.ofVectorSpace C K
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap C K) (coordPoly (b.coord i) Q) ∉ J := by
    by_contra! hall
    apply hQ
    rw [← sum_smul_map_coordPoly b Q]
    exact J.sum_mem fun i _ ↦ Submodule.smul_of_tower_mem J (b i) (hall i)
  refine ⟨coordPoly (b.coord i) P, coordPoly (b.coord i) Q, hi, ?_⟩
  have hcomp := coordPoly_mem_of_mem_map (b.coord i) (hI ▸ hPQ)
  rw [coordPoly_sub', coordPoly_mul_X', coordPoly_rename _ Sum.inl_injective,
    coordPoly_rename _ Sum.inl_injective] at hcomp
  exact hcomp

name: GroupConfig.coefficientIdeal'_eq_comap
proof:
:= by
  rw [locusIdeal, ← map_comp_map_algebraMap C, ← Ideal.map_map,
    comap_map_mvPolynomial_eq_self]

name: GroupConfig.coefficient_aeval_eq_zero_iff'
proof:
:= by
  have h : aeval (LocusFunctionField.coord k v) P =
      LocusFunctionField.mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap C K) P) := by
    rw [← LocusFunctionField.aeval_coord, aeval_map_algebraMap]
  rw [h, LocusFunctionField.mk_eq_zero_iff, coefficientIdeal'_eq_comap]
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.coefficientRingMap'_injective
statement:
private theorem coefficientRingMap'_injective (C : IntermediateField k K) :
    Function.Injective (coefficientRingMap' (v := v) C)
proof:
:= by
  apply (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mpr
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨P, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  change aeval (LocusFunctionField.coord k v) P = 0 at hx
  exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr ((coefficient_aeval_eq_zero_iff' C P).mp hx)

name: GroupConfig.coefficientRingMap'_range
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MvPolynomial.aeval_range]
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨P, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective q
    exact ⟨P, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨P, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk (coefficientIdeal' (v := v) C) P, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.rational_graph_relation
statement:
private theorem rational_graph_relation (r : Representative k K v v) (hr : r.f.e = 0)
    (j : ι) :
    rename Sum.inl (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap r.M K) (r.f.den j)) * X (Sum.inr j) -
      rename Sum.inl (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap r.M K) (r.f.num j)) ∈ r.graphIdeal
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver r.isSmall v
  rw [r.graphIdeal_eq hy]
  have h := map_mem_locusIdeal (↥r.M) ((mem_idealOf_iff (↥r.M)).2 (show
      aeval (r.graphPoint y)
        (rename Sum.inl (r.f.den j) * X (Sum.inr j) - rename Sum.inl (r.f.num j)) = 0 by
    simp only [map_sub, map_mul, aeval_X, aeval_rename, Representative.graphPoint,
      Sum.elim_comp_inl, Sum.elim_inr]
    rw [QuasiRational.eval_apply, hr, pRoot_zero]
    field_simp [r.isDefinedAt y hy j]
    simp))
  simpa only [map_sub, map_mul, MvPolynomial.map_X,
    MvPolynomial.map_rename] using h

name: GroupConfig.exists_rational_over_field_strong
statement:
private theorem exists_rational_over_field_strong (r : Representative k K v v) (hr : r.f.e = 0)
    (C : IntermediateField k K) (hC : IdealDefinedOver C.toSubfield r.graphIdeal)
    (hCM : C ≤ r.M) :
    ∃ f : QuasiRational C ι ι, f.e = 0 ∧
      (∀ j, MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap C K) (f.den j) ∉ locusIdeal k v) ∧
      (∀ y, IsGenericOver C v y → f.IsDefinedAt y) ∧
      (∀ y, IsGenericOver r.M v y → f.eval y = r.f.eval y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hI : r.graphIdeal = (r.graphIdeal.comap (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap C K))).map
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap C K)) := hC
  have hex (j : ι) : ∃ p q : MvPolynomial ι C,
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap C K) q ∉ locusIdeal k v ∧
        MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap C K)
          (rename Sum.inl q * X (Sum.inr j) - rename Sum.inl p) ∈ r.graphIdeal := by
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver r.isSmall v
    have hQ : MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap r.M K) (r.f.den j) ∉ locusIdeal k v := by
      rw [LocusFunctionField.map_mem_locusIdeal_iff_aeval hy]
      exact r.isDefinedAt y hy j
    exact exists_fraction_relation hI hQ j (rational_graph_relation r hr j)
  choose P Q hQ hrel using hex
  let f : QuasiRational C ι ι := ⟨0, P, Q⟩
  have hden (y : ι → K) (hy : IsGenericOver C v y) (j : ι) : aeval y (Q j) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    exact hQ j ((LocusFunctionField.map_mem_locusIdeal_iff_aeval hy (Q j)).2 h0)
  refine ⟨f, rfl, hQ, hden, fun y hy ↦ funext fun j ↦ ?_⟩
  have hzero := aeval_eq_zero_of_mem_locusIdeal (↥r.M)
    ((r.graphIdeal_eq hy) ▸ hrel j)
  simp only [aeval_map_algebraMap, map_sub, map_mul, aeval_rename, aeval_X,
    Representative.graphPoint, Sum.elim_comp_inl, Sum.elim_inr] at hzero
  have heq : r.f.eval y j = aeval y (P j) / aeval y (Q j) :=
    (eq_div_iff (hden y (hy.of_le hCM) j)).2
      (by simpa only [mul_comm] using sub_eq_zero.mp hzero)
  change pRoot K 0 (aeval y (P j) / aeval y (Q j)) = _
  rw [pRoot_zero, heq]

name: GroupConfig.subst_coord_eq_fraction_over_field'
statement:
private theorem subst_coord_eq_fraction_over_field' (r : Representative k K v v)
    (hr : r.f.e = 0) (C : IntermediateField k K) (hCM : C ≤ r.M)
    (f : QuasiRational C ι ι) (hf0 : f.e = 0)
    (hdef : ∀ y, IsGenericOver C v y → f.IsDefinedAt y)
    (heval : ∀ y, IsGenericOver r.M v y → f.eval y = r.f.eval y) (i : ι) :
    r.subst hr (LocusFunctionField.coord k v i) =
      LocusFunctionField.mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap C K) (f.num i)) /
        LocusFunctionField.mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap C K) (f.den i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver r.isSmall v
  have hmap (P : MvPolynomial ι C) :
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap r.M K)
          (MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion hCM).toRingHom P) =
        MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap C K) P := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.map_map]
    rfl
  have h₁ : LocusFunctionField.HasValue r.M y
      (r.subst hr (LocusFunctionField.coord k v i)) (r.f.eval y i) := by
    refine ⟨r.f.num i, r.f.den i, r.isDefinedAt y hy i, r.subst_coord hr i, ?_⟩
    rw [QuasiRational.eval_apply, hr, pRoot_zero]
  apply LocusFunctionField.HasValue.eq hy h₁
  refine ⟨MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion hCM).toRingHom (f.num i),
    MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion hCM).toRingHom (f.den i), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [aeval_map_inclusion]
    exact hdef y (hy.of_le hCM) i
  · rw [hmap, hmap]
  · rw [aeval_map_inclusion, aeval_map_inclusion]
    calc
      r.f.eval y i = f.eval y i := congrFun (heval y hy).symm i
      _ = _ := by rw [QuasiRational.eval_apply, hf0, pRoot_zero]

name: GroupConfig.coefficientFractionMap'_fieldRange
statement:
private theorem coefficientFractionMap'_fieldRange (C : IntermediateField k K) :
    (coefficientFractionMap' (v := v) C).fieldRange = coefficientField' (v := v) C
proof:
:=
  IsFractionRing.liftAlgHom_fieldRange_eq_of_range_eq
    (coefficientRingMap'_injective C) (coefficientRingMap'_range C)

name: GroupConfig.coefficientFractionEquiv'_coord
statement:
private theorem coefficientFractionEquiv'_coord (C : IntermediateField k K) (i : ι) :
    ((coefficientFractionEquiv' (v := v) C (algebraMap (coefficientRing' (v := v) C)
      (FractionRing (coefficientRing' (v := v) C))
        (tensorCoordinateQuotientEquiv' (C := C) (idealOf k v)
          ((1 : C) ⊗ₜ[k] Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealOf k v) (X i : MvPolynomial ι k))))).val :
            LocusFunctionField k v) = LocusFunctionField.coord k v i
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensorCoordinateQuotientEquiv'_X]
  change coefficientFractionMap' C (algebraMap (coefficientRing' C)
    (FractionRing (coefficientRing' C)) (Ideal.Quotient.mk (coefficientIdeal' C) (X i))) = _
  rw [coefficientFractionMap', IsFractionRing.liftAlgHom_apply, IsFractionRing.lift_algebraMap]
  change aeval (R := C) (LocusFunctionField.coord k v) (X i) = _
  exact aeval_X _ _

name: GroupConfig.exists_tensorLocusFieldEquiv'
statement:
private theorem exists_tensorLocusFieldEquiv' :
    ∃ e : FractionRing (K ⊗[k] FractionRing (baseCoordinateRing' (k := k) (v := v))) ≃ₐ[K]
        LocusFunctionField k v,
      ∀ (i : ι), e (algebraMap (K ⊗[k] FractionRing (baseCoordinateRing' (k := k) (v := v)))
          (FractionRing (K ⊗[k] FractionRing (baseCoordinateRing' (k := k) (v := v))))
          ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[k] algebraMap (baseCoordinateRing' (k := k) (v := v))
            (FractionRing (baseCoordinateRing' (k := k) (v := v)))
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealOf k v) (X i)))) =
        LocusFunctionField.coord k v i
proof:
:= by
  let A := baseCoordinateRing' (k := k) (v := v)
  let q : K ⊗[k] A ≃ₐ[K] MvPolynomial ι K ⧸ locusIdeal k v :=
    tensorCoordinateQuotientEquiv' (idealOf k v)
  have : IsDomain (K ⊗[k] A) :=
    MulEquiv.isDomain (MvPolynomial ι K ⧸ locusIdeal k v) q.toRingEquiv.toMulEquiv
  obtain ⟨_, e₁, he₁⟩ := isDomain_and_exists_tensorFractionEquiv (k := k) (C := K) (A := A)
  let e₀ : FractionRing (K ⊗[k] A) ≃ₐ[K] LocusFunctionField k v :=
    IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv q
  refine ⟨e₁.trans e₀, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  change e₀ (e₁ (algebraMap (K ⊗[k] FractionRing A) (FractionRing (K ⊗[k] FractionRing A))
    ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[k] algebraMap A (FractionRing A)
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealOf k v) (X i))))) = _
  rw [he₁]
  change IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv q (algebraMap (K ⊗[k] A)
    (FractionRing (K ⊗[k] A)) ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[k] Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealOf k v) (X i))) = _
  rw [IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv_algebraMap]
  change algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι K ⧸ locusIdeal k v) (LocusFunctionField k v)
    (tensorCoordinateQuotientEquiv' (C := K) (idealOf k v)
      ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[k] Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealOf k v) (X i : MvPolynomial ι k))) = _
  rw [tensorCoordinateQuotientEquiv'_X]
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.exists_tensorCoefficientFieldEquiv'
statement:
private theorem exists_tensorCoefficientFieldEquiv' (C : IntermediateField k K) :
    ∃ e : FractionRing (C ⊗[k] FractionRing (baseCoordinateRing' (k := k) (v := v))) ≃ₐ[C]
        coefficientField' (v := v) C,
      ∀ (i : ι), (e (algebraMap (C ⊗[k] FractionRing (baseCoordinateRing' (k := k) (v := v)))
          (FractionRing (C ⊗[k] FractionRing (baseCoordinateRing' (k := k) (v := v))))
          ((1 : C) ⊗ₜ[k] algebraMap (baseCoordinateRing' (k := k) (v := v))
            (FractionRing (baseCoordinateRing' (k := k) (v := v)))
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealOf k v) (X i))))).val =
        LocusFunctionField.coord k v i
proof:
:= by
  let A := baseCoordinateRing' (k := k) (v := v)
  let q : C ⊗[k] A ≃ₐ[C] coefficientRing' (v := v) C :=
    tensorCoordinateQuotientEquiv' (idealOf k v)
  have : IsDomain (C ⊗[k] A) :=
    MulEquiv.isDomain (coefficientRing' (v := v) C) q.toRingEquiv.toMulEquiv
  obtain ⟨_, e₁, he₁⟩ := isDomain_and_exists_tensorFractionEquiv (k := k) (C := C) (A := A)
  let e₀ : FractionRing (C ⊗[k] A) ≃ₐ[C] FractionRing (coefficientRing' (v := v) C) :=
    IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv q
  let e := e₁.trans (e₀.trans (coefficientFractionEquiv' (v := v) C))
  refine ⟨e, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  have hinner : e₀ (e₁ (algebraMap (C ⊗[k] FractionRing A)
      (FractionRing (C ⊗[k] FractionRing A))
      ((1 : C) ⊗ₜ[k] algebraMap A (FractionRing A)
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealOf k v) (X i))))) =
      algebraMap (coefficientRing' (v := v) C) (FractionRing (coefficientRing' (v := v) C))
        (q ((1 : C) ⊗ₜ[k] Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealOf k v) (X i))) := by
    rw [he₁]
    exact IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv_algebraMap q _
  exact (congrArg (fun a ↦ (coefficientFractionEquiv' (v := v) C a).val) hinner).trans
    (coefficientFractionEquiv'_coord (k := k) (K := K) (v := v) C i)

name: GroupConfig.mk_map_mem_coefficientField'
statement:
private theorem mk_map_mem_coefficientField' (C : IntermediateField k K)
    (P : MvPolynomial ι C) :
    LocusFunctionField.mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap C K) P) ∈
      coefficientField' (v := v) C
proof:
:= by
  have h : aeval (LocusFunctionField.coord k v) P ∈ coefficientField' (v := v) C := by
    induction P using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
    | C c => simpa only [aeval_C] using (coefficientField' (v := v) C).algebraMap_mem c
    | add p q hp hq => simpa only [map_add] using (coefficientField' C).add_mem hp hq
    | mul_X p i hp =>
      rw [map_mul, aeval_X]
      exact (coefficientField' C).mul_mem hp
        (IntermediateField.subset_adjoin C _ (mem_range_self i))
  rw [← LocusFunctionField.aeval_coord]
  simpa only [aeval_map_algebraMap] using h

name: GroupConfig.subst_coord_mem_coefficientField'
statement:
private theorem subst_coord_mem_coefficientField' (r : Representative k K v v)
    (hr : r.f.e = 0) (C : IntermediateField k K)
    (hC : IdealDefinedOver C.toSubfield r.graphIdeal) (hCM : C ≤ r.M) (i : ι) :
    r.subst hr (LocusFunctionField.coord k v i) ∈ coefficientField' (v := v) C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf0, _, hdef, heval⟩ := exists_rational_over_field_strong r hr C hC hCM
  rw [subst_coord_eq_fraction_over_field' r hr C hCM f hf0 hdef heval]
  exact (coefficientField' C).div_mem
    (mk_map_mem_coefficientField' C _) (mk_map_mem_coefficientField' C _)

name: GroupConfig.subst_mem_coefficientField'
statement:
private theorem subst_mem_coefficientField' (r : Representative k K v v) (hr : r.f.e = 0)
    (C : IntermediateField k K) (hC : IdealDefinedOver C.toSubfield r.graphIdeal) (hCM : C ≤ r.M)
    {x : LocusFunctionField k v} (hx : x ∈ coefficientField' (v := v) C) :
    r.subst hr x ∈ coefficientField' (v := v) C
proof:
:= by
  have hle : (coefficientField' (v := v) C).map ((r.subst hr).restrictScalars C) ≤
      coefficientField' (v := v) C := by
    rw [coefficientField', IntermediateField.adjoin_map]
    apply IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact subst_coord_mem_coefficientField' r hr C hC hCM i
  exact hle ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.subst_comp_eq_id_of_inverse'
statement:
private theorem subst_comp_eq_id_of_inverse' (r s : Representative k K v v)
    (hr : r.f.e = 0) (hs : s.f.e = 0)
    (hi : Germ.IsInverse (⟦s⟧ : Germ k v v) (⟦r⟧ : Germ k v v)) :
    (r.subst hr).comp (s.subst hs) = AlgHom.id K (LocusFunctionField k v)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (s.comp r).subst (Representative.comp_f_e_eq_zero hr hs) :=
      (Representative.subst_comp hr hs).symm
    _ = (Representative.id v).subst rfl :=
      Representative.subst_eq_of_equivalent _ _ (Quotient.exact hi.1)
    _ = _ := Representative.subst_id

name: GroupConfig.idealDefinedOver_rename'
proof:
:= by
  let J := I.comap (mapF F)
  have heq : I.map (rename f : MvPolynomial σ K →ₐ[K] MvPolynomial τ K) =
      (J.map (rename f : MvPolynomial σ F →ₐ[F] MvPolynomial τ F)).map (mapF F) := by
    calc
      _ = (J.map (mapF F)).map
          (rename f : MvPolynomial σ K →ₐ[K] MvPolynomial τ K) :=
        congrArg (fun A : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ K) ↦
          A.map (rename f : MvPolynomial σ K →ₐ[K] MvPolynomial τ K)) hI
      _ = _ := by
        change (J.map (mapF F)).map
            (rename f : MvPolynomial σ K →ₐ[K] MvPolynomial τ K).toRingHom =
          (J.map (rename f : MvPolynomial σ F →ₐ[F] MvPolynomial τ F).toRingHom).map (mapF F)
        rw [Ideal.map_map (mapF F)
          (rename f : MvPolynomial σ K →ₐ[K] MvPolynomial τ K).toRingHom,
          Ideal.map_map (rename f : MvPolynomial σ F →ₐ[F] MvPolynomial τ F).toRingHom
            (mapF F)]
        congr 1
        exact (MvPolynomial.map_comp_rename F.subtype f).symm
  rw [heq]
  exact (Ideal.map_comap_map
    (I := J.map (rename f : MvPolynomial σ F →ₐ[F] MvPolynomial τ F)) (f := mapF F)).symm

name: GroupConfig.locusIdeal_swap'
statement:
private theorem locusIdeal_swap' (N : IntermediateField k K) (y z : ι → K) :
    (locusIdeal (↥N) (Sum.elim y z)).map
        (rename Sum.swap : MvPolynomial (ι ⊕ ι) K →ₐ[K] MvPolynomial (ι ⊕ ι) K) =
      locusIdeal (↥N) (Sum.elim z y)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (locusIdeal (↥N) (Sum.elim z y)).comap
      (rename Sum.swap : MvPolynomial (ι ⊕ ι) K →ₐ[K] MvPolynomial (ι ⊕ ι) K) =
      locusIdeal (↥N) (Sum.elim y z) := by
    unfold locusIdeal
    rw [comap_rename_map_eq (K := K) (↥N) (f := (Sum.swap : ι ⊕ ι → ι ⊕ ι))
      (by intro a b h; simpa using congrArg Sum.swap h)]
    congr 1
    ext P
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, mem_idealOf_iff, mem_idealOf_iff, aeval_rename]
    have he : (Sum.elim z y) ∘ Sum.swap = Sum.elim y z := by
      funext i
      cases i <;> rfl
    rw [he]
  rw [← hc]
  exact Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective _ (renameEquiv K (Equiv.sumComm ι ι)).surjective _

name: GroupConfig.inverse_graph_eq'
statement:
private theorem inverse_graph_eq' (r s : Representative k K v v)
    (hi : Germ.IsInverse (⟦s⟧ : Germ k v v) (⟦r⟧ : Germ k v v)) :
    s.graphIdeal = r.graphIdeal.map
      (rename Sum.swap : MvPolynomial (ι ⊕ ι) K →ₐ[K] MvPolynomial (ι ⊕ ι) K)
proof:
:= by
  have hsr : (s.comp r).Equivalent (Representative.id v) := Quotient.exact hi.1
  let N := racl k (((s.comp r).M : Set K) ∪ (Representative.id (k := k) v).M)
  have hN : IsAlgClosed ↥N := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hNs : IsSmall k (N : Set K) :=
    ((s.comp r).isSmall.union (Representative.id (k := k) v).isSmall).racl
  have hcN : (s.comp r).M ≤ N := subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
  have hrN : r.M ≤ N := (Representative.le_joinField_left s r).trans hcN
  have hsN : s.M ≤ N := (Representative.le_joinField_right s r).trans hcN
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hNs v
  have hz : IsGenericOver N v (r.f.eval y) := by
    have := (r.extend hN hNs hrN).isGenericOver y hy
    rwa [Representative.extend_eval] at this
  have hsy : s.f.eval (r.f.eval y) = y := by
    rw [← Representative.comp_eval s r (hy.of_le hcN), hsr y hy]
    exact QuasiRational.id_eval y
  have hR : r.graphIdeal = locusIdeal (↥N) (r.graphPoint y) :=
    (r.graphIdeal_eq (hy.of_le hrN)).trans
      (r.locusIdeal_graphPoint_eq_of_le hNs hrN hy).symm
  have hS : s.graphIdeal = locusIdeal (↥N) (s.graphPoint (r.f.eval y)) :=
    (s.graphIdeal_eq (hz.of_le hsN)).trans
      (s.locusIdeal_graphPoint_eq_of_le hNs hsN hz).symm
  rw [hR, hS]
  change locusIdeal (↥N) (Sum.elim (r.f.eval y) (s.f.eval (r.f.eval y))) =
    (locusIdeal (↥N) (Sum.elim y (r.f.eval y))).map _
  rw [hsy, locusIdeal_swap']

name: GroupConfig.inverse_cb_le'
proof:
:= by
  let C := Germ.cb (⟦r⟧ : Germ k v v)
  have hdef : IdealDefinedOver C.toSubfield s.graphIdeal := by
    rw [inverse_graph_eq' r s hi]
    exact idealDefinedOver_rename' C.toSubfield
      (Germ.idealDefinedOver_graphIdeal (⟦r⟧ : Germ k v v) le_rfl) Sum.swap
  change IntermediateField.adjoin k (idealFod s.graphIdeal : Set K) ≤ C
  exact IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff.mpr (idealDefinedOver_iff.mp hdef)

name: GroupConfig.inverse_cb_eq'
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (inverse_cb_le' r s hi) (inverse_cb_le' s r hi.symm)

name: GroupConfig.cb_fg'
statement: private theorem cb_fg' (g : Germ k v v) : (Germ.cb g).FG
proof:
:=
  ⟨Germ.codeSet g, Germ.adjoin_codeSet g⟩

name: GroupConfig.cb_essFiniteType'
statement:
private theorem cb_essFiniteType' (g : Germ k v v) :
    Algebra.EssFiniteType k (Germ.cb g)
proof:
:=
  IntermediateField.essFiniteType_iff.mpr (cb_fg' g)

name: GroupConfig.exists_cb_derivations'
proof:
:= by
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType k g.cb := cb_essFiniteType' g
  apply exists_linearIndependent_derivations
  apply (Cardinal.natCast_le_toENat (n := 2)).mp
  rw [erk_empty_eq_toENat_trdeg] at hr
  rw [show IntermediateField.adjoin k (g.cb : Set K) = g.cb from
    IntermediateField.adjoin_self k g.cb] at hr
  simpa using hr

name: GroupConfig.exists_coefficient_automorphism'
statement:
private theorem exists_coefficient_automorphism' {g₀ : Germ k v v} (hw : Germ.IsHW g₀)
    (hv : erk k ∅ (range v) = 1) {γ : Germ k v v} (hγ : γ ∈ Germ.IsHW.prodSet g₀) :
    ∃ r s : Representative k K v v, (⟦r⟧ : Germ k v v) = γ ∧
      Germ.IsInverse (⟦s⟧ : Germ k v v) γ ∧ r.f.e = 0 ∧ s.f.e = 0 ∧
      ∃ g : coefficientField' (v := v) γ.cb ≃ₐ[γ.cb] coefficientField' (v := v) γ.cb,
        ∀ i, (g ⟨LocusFunctionField.coord k v i,
            IntermediateField.subset_adjoin γ.cb _ (mem_range_self i)⟩ : LocusFunctionField k v) =
          LocusFunctionField.mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap r.M K) (r.f.num i)) /
            LocusFunctionField.mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap r.M K) (r.f.den i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ := Germ.isUnit_iff.mp (hw.isUnit_of_mem_prodSet hγ)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hr0⟩ := hw.exists_rational_representative hv hγ
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hs0⟩ := hw.exists_rational_representative hv (hw.inv_mem_prodSet hγ hδ)
  have hi : Germ.IsInverse (⟦s⟧ : Germ k v v) γ := by simpa only [hs] using hδ
  have hinv : Germ.IsInverse (⟦s⟧ : Germ k v v) (⟦r⟧ : Germ k v v) := by
    rw [hr]
    exact hi
  have hCr : Germ.cb (⟦r⟧ : Germ k v v) = γ.cb := congrArg Germ.cb hr
  have hCs : Germ.cb (⟦s⟧ : Germ k v v) = γ.cb := (inverse_cb_eq' r s hinv).trans hCr
  let g := coefficientSubstEquiv' r s hr0 hs0 hinv γ.cb
    (Germ.idealDefinedOver_graphIdeal (⟦r⟧ : Germ k v v) hCr.le)
    (Germ.idealDefinedOver_graphIdeal (⟦s⟧ : Germ k v v) hCs.le)
    (hCr.symm.le.trans (Germ.cb_mk_le r)) (hCs.symm.le.trans (Germ.cb_mk_le s))
  refine ⟨r, s, hr, hi, hr0, hs0, g, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  change r.subst hr0 (LocusFunctionField.coord k v i) = _
  exact r.subst_coord hr0 i

name: GroupConfig.ker_aeval_formal_graph'
statement:
private theorem ker_aeval_formal_graph'
    {F : Type*} [Field F] [Algebra k F] (γ : Germ k v v)
    (r : Representative k K v v) (hr : (⟦r⟧ : Germ k v v) = γ) (hr0 : r.f.e = 0) (u : ι → F)
    (g : FractionRing (γ.cb ⊗[k] F) ≃ₐ[γ.cb]
      FractionRing (γ.cb ⊗[k] F))
    (φ : FractionRing (γ.cb ⊗[k] F) →ₐ[γ.cb] LocusFunctionField k v)
    (hφx : ∀ i : ι, φ (algebraMap (γ.cb ⊗[k] F) _
      ((1 : γ.cb) ⊗ₜ[k] u i)) = LocusFunctionField.coord k v i)
    (hφgx : ∀ i : ι, φ (g (algebraMap (γ.cb ⊗[k] F) _
      ((1 : γ.cb) ⊗ₜ[k] u i))) =
      r.subst hr0 (LocusFunctionField.coord k v i)) :
    let x : ι → FractionRing (γ.cb ⊗[k] F)
proof:
:= fun i ↦
      algebraMap (γ.cb ⊗[k] F) _ ((1 : γ.cb) ⊗ₜ[k] u i)
    RingHom.ker (aeval (R := γ.cb) (Sum.elim x (fun i ↦ g (x i)))).toRingHom =
      γ.graphIdeal.comap (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap γ.cb K)) := by
  intro x
  let C := γ.cb
  let z := Sum.elim x (fun i ↦ g (x i))
  have hCM : C ≤ r.M := by
    have h := Germ.cb_mk_le r
    rwa [hr] at h
  have hxy : ∀ j, φ (z j) = Sum.elim (LocusFunctionField.coord k v)
      (fun i ↦ r.subst hr0 (LocusFunctionField.coord k v i)) j := by
    intro j
    cases j with
    | inl i => exact hφx i
    | inr i => exact hφgx i
  have hg : r.graphIdeal = γ.graphIdeal := by rw [← hr]; rfl
  exact (ker_aeval_eq_of_injective' φ φ.injective z _ hxy).trans
    ((r.ker_aeval_graph hr0 C hCM).trans
      (congrArg (fun I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (ι ⊕ ι) K) ↦
        I.comap (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap C K))) hg))

name: GroupConfig.coefficientVariationLinear_injective_of_graph'
statement:
private theorem coefficientVariationLinear_injective_of_graph'
    {F : Type*} [Field F] [Algebra k F] (γ : Germ k v v)
    (r : Representative k K v v) (hr : (⟦r⟧ : Germ k v v) = γ) (hr0 : r.f.e = 0) (u : ι → F)
    (g : FractionRing (γ.cb ⊗[k] F) ≃ₐ[γ.cb]
      FractionRing (γ.cb ⊗[k] F))
    (φ : FractionRing (γ.cb ⊗[k] F) →ₐ[γ.cb] LocusFunctionField k v)
    (hφx : ∀ i : ι, φ (algebraMap (γ.cb ⊗[k] F) _
      ((1 : γ.cb) ⊗ₜ[k] u i)) = LocusFunctionField.coord k v i)
    (hφgx : ∀ i : ι, φ (g (algebraMap (γ.cb ⊗[k] F) _
      ((1 : γ.cb) ⊗ₜ[k] u i))) =
      r.subst hr0 (LocusFunctionField.coord k v i)) :
    Function.Injective (coefficientVariationLinear (k := k) g)
proof:
:= by
  have hker := ker_aeval_formal_graph' γ r hr hr0 u g φ hφx hφgx
  apply coefficientVariationLinear_injective (k := k) g
  intro D hD
  apply Germ.derivation_eq_zero_of_graph_stable γ D
  intro P hP
  rw [← hker] at hP ⊢
  exact coefficientDerivative_mem_variationGraphKernel g D hD u P hP

name: GroupConfig.exists_faithful_coefficient_variation'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, s, hr, _, hr0, _, gC, hgC⟩ := exists_coefficient_automorphism' hw hv hγ
  let C := γ.cb
  let F := BaseFunctionField k v
  let E := FractionRing (C ⊗[k] F)
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_tensorCoefficientFieldEquiv' (k := k) (v := v) C
  let g : E ≃ₐ[C] E := e.trans (gC.trans e.symm)
  let x : ι → E := fun i ↦ algebraMap (C ⊗[k] F) E ((1 : C) ⊗ₜ[k] BaseFunctionField.coord k v i)
