  let φ : E →ₐ[C] LocusFunctionField k v := (coefficientField' (v := v) C).val.comp e.toAlgHom
  have hφx (i : ι) : φ (x i) = LocusFunctionField.coord k v i := he i
  have hφgx (i : ι) : φ (g (x i)) = r.subst hr0 (LocusFunctionField.coord k v i) := by
    have hei : e (x i) = ⟨LocusFunctionField.coord k v i,
        IntermediateField.subset_adjoin C _ (mem_range_self i)⟩ := Subtype.ext (he i)
    change (e (e.symm (gC (e (x i))))).val = _
    rw [e.apply_symm_apply, hei, hgC]
    exact (r.subst_coord hr0 i).symm
  exact ⟨g, coefficientVariationLinear_injective_of_graph' γ r hr hr0
      (BaseFunctionField.coord k v) g φ hφx hφgx⟩

name: GroupConfig.exists_independent_regular_locus_derivations'
statement:
private theorem exists_independent_regular_locus_derivations' {g₀ : Germ k v v}
    (hw : Germ.IsHW g₀) (hv : erk k ∅ (range v) = 1)
    (hr : 2 ≤ erk k ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K)) :
    ∃ D : Fin 2 → Derivation K (LocusFunctionField k v) (LocusFunctionField k v),
      LinearIndependent K D ∧
        ∀ i (V : ValuationSubring (LocusFunctionField k v)),
          (∀ c : K, algebraMap K _ c ∈ V) → V ≠ ⊤ → ∀ x ∈ V, D i x ∈ V
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := exists_faithful_coefficient_variation' hw hv
    (hw.mem_prodSet_of_mem (Germ.self_mem_orbit g₀))
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := exists_cb_derivations' g₀ hr
  let _ : IsFunctionFieldOneVar k (BaseFunctionField k v) :=
    BaseFunctionField.isFunctionFieldOneVar k v hv
  obtain ⟨t, ht, _, hsep⟩ := BaseFunctionField.exists_separating_transcendental k v hv
  let _ := hsep
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hreg⟩ := exists_independent_regular_variations ht g hg D hD
  obtain ⟨δ', hδ', _, hreg'⟩ := exists_regular_derivations_baseChange (K := K) ht δ hδ hreg
  obtain ⟨e, _⟩ := exists_tensorLocusFieldEquiv' (k := k) (K := K) (v := v)
  let L := Derivation.transportLinear e
  refine ⟨L ∘ δ', hδ'.map' L (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr
    (Derivation.transportLinear_injective e)), ?_⟩
  intro i V hKV hV x hx
  exact transportDerivation'_regular e (δ' i) (hreg' i) V hKV hV hx

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.genus_eq_zero
statement:
theorem Germ.IsHW.genus_eq_zero {g₀ : Germ k v v} (hw : Germ.IsHW g₀)
    (hv : erk k ∅ (range v) = 1) (hr : 2 ≤ erk k ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K)) :
    let _
proof:
:= LocusFunctionField.isFunctionFieldOneVar (k := k) (v := v) hv
    genus K (LocusFunctionField k v) = 0 := by
  let _ := LocusFunctionField.isFunctionFieldOneVar (k := k) (v := v) hv
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hreg⟩ := exists_independent_regular_locus_derivations' hw hv hr
  exact genus_eq_zero_of_linearIndependent_regular D hD hreg

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.exists_fresh_rational_representative
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀, he⟩ := hw.exists_rational_representative hv hγ
  
  obtain ⟨F, hFdef⟩ : ∃ F : IntermediateField k K, F = racl k (γ.cb : Set K) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hF : IsSmall k (F : Set K) := hFdef ▸ γ.isSmall_cb.racl
  have : IsAlgClosed ↥F := hFdef ▸ isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hcbF : γ.cb ≤ F := hFdef ▸ fun x hx ↦ subset_racl k _ hx
  have : IsAlgClosed ↥r₀.M := r₀.isAlgClosed
  obtain ⟨B, -, hBfin, hBr⟩ := r₀.isSmall.exists_finite_racl_eq
  have hr₀B : racl k B = r₀.M :=
    hBr.trans (le_antisymm (racl_le_of_isAlgClosed fun _ hx ↦ hx) fun _ hx ↦ subset_racl k _ hx)
  have : Finite ↥B := hBfin.to_subtype
  
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := exists_algEquiv_indepOver (M := F) hF (fun b : ↥B ↦ (b : K))
    (w := (M : Set K) ∪ range y) (hM.union (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range y)))
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ : ∃ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K, σ = τ.restrictScalars k := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hστ : ∀ x, σ x = τ x := fun x ↦ by rw [hσ]; rfl
  have hτ' : IndepOver k (F : Set K) (σ '' B) ((M : Set K) ∪ range y) := by
    convert hτ using 2
    rw [image_eq_range]
    exact congrArg range (funext fun b ↦ hστ b)
  
  have hrγ : (⟦r₀.map σ⟧ : Germ k v v) = γ := by
    change Germ.map σ (⟦r₀⟧ : Germ k v v) = γ
    rw [hr₀, Germ.map_eq_self_iff]
    intro x hx
    rw [hστ]
    exact τ.commutes ⟨x, hcbF hx⟩
  have hrM : (((r₀.map σ).M : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) = racl k (σ '' B) := by
    rw [Representative.map_M, ← hr₀B, racl_map]
  have hcbr : (γ.cb : Set K) ⊆ racl k (σ '' B) := by
    rw [← hrM, ← hrγ]
    exact Germ.cb_mk_le _
  refine ⟨r₀.map σ, racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ ((r₀.map σ).M : Set K)), hrγ, he,
    isAlgClosed_racl _, (hM.union (r₀.map σ).isSmall).racl,
    fun x hx ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl hx), fun x hx ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hx), ?_⟩
  
  have hG : IsSmall k ((racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ (γ.cb : Set K)) : IntermediateField k K) :
      Set K) := (hM.union γ.isSmall_cb).racl
  have hN : IsSmall k ((racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ ((r₀.map σ).M : Set K)) :
      IntermediateField k K) : Set K) := (hM.union (r₀.map σ).isSmall).racl
  have hyG := (isGenericOver_iff_erk_eq hG hy.inLocus).1 hy
  refine (isGenericOver_iff_erk_eq hN hy.inLocus).2 ?_
  have hind : IndepOver k ((F : Set K) ∪ M) (range y) (σ '' B) :=
    ((indepOver_union_right_iff.1 hτ').2).symm
  have hFM : racl k ((F : Set K) ∪ M) = racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ (γ.cb : Set K)) := by
    rw [hFdef, racl_union_left, union_comm]
  have hbase : racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ ((r₀.map σ).M : Set K)) =
      racl k (((F : Set K) ∪ M) ∪ σ '' B) := by
    rw [hrM, racl_union_right]
    refine le_antisymm (racl_mono (union_subset (fun x hx ↦ Or.inl (Or.inr hx))
      fun x hx ↦ Or.inr hx)) (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset (union_subset ?_
      fun x hx ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl hx)) fun x hx ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hx)))
    intro x hx
    exact racl_mono subset_union_right (racl_le_of_subset_racl hcbr (hFdef ▸ hx))
  calc erk k ((racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ ((r₀.map σ).M : Set K)) : IntermediateField k K) :
        Set K) (range y)
      = erk k ((racl k (((F : Set K) ∪ M) ∪ σ '' B) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K)
          (range y) := by rw [hbase]
    _ = erk k (((F : Set K) ∪ M) ∪ σ '' B) (range y) := erk_racl_base k _ _
    _ = erk k ((F : Set K) ∪ M) (range y) := hind.erk_eq (subset_refl _) (finite_range y)
    _ = erk k ((racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ (γ.cb : Set K)) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K)
          (range y) := (erk_racl_base k _ _).symm.trans (by rw [hFM])
    _ = erk k ∅ (range v) := hyG

name: GroupConfig.hasValue_mono
statement:
private theorem hasValue_mono {M N : IntermediateField k K} (hMN : M ≤ N) {y : ι → K}
    {u : LocusFunctionField k v} {x : K} (hx : HasValue M y u x) : HasValue N y u x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, B, hB, hu, hx⟩ := hx
  have he (P : MvPolynomial ι M) :
      aeval y (MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion hMN).toRingHom P) = aeval y P := by
    change eval₂ _ _ (MvPolynomial.map _ P) = eval₂ _ _ P
    rw [eval₂_map]
    rfl
  refine ⟨MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion hMN).toRingHom A,
    MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion hMN).toRingHom B, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rwa [he]
  · rwa [map_map_inclusion, map_map_inclusion]
  · rwa [he, he]

name: GroupConfig.hasValue_mem_racl
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, B, -, -, rfl⟩ := hx
  have hp (P : MvPolynomial ι M) : aeval y P ∈ racl (↥M) (range y) := by
    exact MvPolynomial.eval₂_mem (fun i _ ↦ (racl (↥M) (range y)).algebraMap_mem (P.coeff i))
      (fun i ↦ subset_racl (↥M) _ ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  exact div_mem (hp A) (hp B)

name: GroupConfig.hasValue_transcendental
proof:
:= by
  intro halg
  let c : M := ⟨x, isRAC_of_isAlgClosed M x halg⟩
  have hc : algebraMap M K c = x := rfl
  have hconst := hasValue_algebraMap (k := k) (v := v) (M := M) (y := y) le_rfl c
  have he : u = algebraMap K (LocusFunctionField k v) x := by
    have he := HasValue.eq hy hx (by simpa only [hc] using hconst)
    rw [he, ← hc]
    exact (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply (↥M) K _ c).symm
  exact hu (he.symm ▸ isAlgebraic_algebraMap x)

name: GroupConfig.hasValue_racl_eq_of_curve
statement:
private theorem hasValue_racl_eq_of_curve {M : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed ↥M]
    {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGenericOver M v y) (hv : erk k ∅ (range v) = 1)
    {u : LocusFunctionField k v} (hu : Transcendental K u) {x : K} (hx : HasValue M y u x) :
    racl (↥M) ({x} : Set K) = racl (↥M) (range y)
proof:
:= by
  have hxm := hasValue_mem_racl hx
  have hxtr := hasValue_transcendental hy hu hx
  have hry : erk (↥M) ∅ (range y) = 1 :=
    by
      rw [erk_empty_eq (↥M), ← erk_coe_eq k M]
      exact hy.erk_coe_eq.trans (hy.erk_empty_eq.trans hv)
  have hrx : erk (↥M) ∅ ({x} : Set K) = 1 := by
    apply le_antisymm ((erk_le_encard _ _ _).trans (by simp))
    exact Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 fun h0 ↦ hxtr
      (isAlgebraic_of_mem_racl_empty ((erk_singleton_eq_zero_iff _).1 h0))
  have htotal : erk (↥M) ∅ ({x} ∪ range y) = 1 := by
    rw [union_comm]
    exact (erk_union_eq_of_subset_racl _ (by simpa using singleton_subset_iff.2 hxm)).trans hry
  have hzero : erk (↥M) {x} (range y) = 0 := by
    have he := erk_union_eq (↥M) ∅ ({x} : Set K) (range y)
    rw [empty_union, htotal, hrx] at he
    exact ENat.add_right_injective_of_ne_top (n := 1) (by norm_num)
      (he.symm.trans (by norm_num : (1 : ℕ∞) = 1 + 0))
  exact le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl (singleton_subset_iff.2 hxm))
    (racl_le_of_subset_racl ((erk_eq_zero_iff _).1 hzero))

name: GroupConfig.hasValue_constant
statement:
private theorem hasValue_constant {M : IntermediateField k K} {y : ι → K} {a : K}
    (ha : a ∈ M) : HasValue M y (algebraMap K (LocusFunctionField k v) a) a
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasValue_algebraMap (k := k) (v := v) (M := M) (y := y) le_rfl (⟨a, ha⟩ : M)
  convert h using 1
  · exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply (↥M) K _ ⟨a, ha⟩
  · rfl

name: GroupConfig.affine_coordinate_evalGen
statement:
theorem affine_coordinate_evalGen {g₀ : Germ k v v} (hw : g₀.IsHW)
    (hv : erk k ∅ (range v) = 1) {M : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed ↥M]
    (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K)) {u : LocusFunctionField k v} (hu : Transcendental K u)
    (P Q : MvPolynomial ι M)
    (hQ : ∀ y, IsGenericOver M v y → aeval y Q ≠ 0)
    (huPQ : u = mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap M K) P) /
      mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap M K) Q))
    (γ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) (a b : K)
    (ha : a ∈ racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ ((hw.val γ).cb : Set K)))
    (hb : b ∈ racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ ((hw.val γ).cb : Set K)))
    (hact : hw.functionFieldAction hv γ⁻¹ u = algebraMap K _ a * u + algebraMap K _ b)
    {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGenericOver (racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ ((hw.val γ).cb : Set K))) v y) :
    ∃ x z : K, HasValue M y u x ∧ HasValue M ((hw.val γ).evalGen y) u z ∧
      z = a * x + b ∧ racl (↥M) ({x} : Set K) = racl (↥M) (range y) ∧
      racl (↥M) ({z} : Set K) = racl (↥M) (range ((hw.val γ).evalGen y))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, N, hr, he, iN, hNs, hMN, hrN, hyN⟩ :=
    hw.exists_fresh_rational_representative hv (hw.val_mem γ) hM hy
  let : IsAlgClosed ↥N := iN
  let : IsAlgClosed ↥r.M := r.isAlgClosed
  have hcbN : (hw.val γ).cb ≤ N := by
    rw [← hr]
    exact (Germ.cb_mk_le r).trans hrN
  have hFN : racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ ((hw.val γ).cb : Set K)) ≤ N :=
    racl_le_of_isAlgClosed (union_subset hMN hcbN)
  have hyM : IsGenericOver M v y := hyN.of_le hMN
  have hzN : IsGenericOver N v ((hw.val γ).evalGen y) := by
    rw [(hw.val γ).evalGen_eq hNs hcbN hyN]
    exact (hw.val γ).isGenericOver_eval hNs hcbN hyN
  have hreval : (hw.val γ).evalGen y = r.f.eval y := by
    rw [← hr, Germ.evalGen_eq _ r.isSmall (Germ.cb_mk_le r) (hyN.of_le hrN)]
    exact Germ.eval_eq_rep r r.isSmall (Germ.cb_mk_le r) le_rfl (hyN.of_le hrN)
  have hvalue (z : ι → K) (hz : IsGenericOver M v z) :
      HasValue M z u (aeval z P / aeval z Q) := ⟨P, Q, hQ z hz, huPQ, rfl⟩
  let x := aeval y P / aeval y Q
  let z := aeval ((hw.val γ).evalGen y) P / aeval ((hw.val γ).evalGen y) Q
  have hx : HasValue M y u x := hvalue y hyM
  have hz : HasValue M ((hw.val γ).evalGen y) u z := hvalue _ (hzN.of_le hMN)
  have hsub : HasValue N y (hw.functionFieldAction hv γ⁻¹ u) z := by
    apply hw.hasValue_functionFieldAction hv γ⁻¹ he (by simpa [Germ.IsHW.val] using hr) hrN hyN
    rw [← hreval]
    exact hasValue_mono hMN hz
  have hlinear : HasValue N y (algebraMap K _ a * u + algebraMap K _ b) (a * x + b) :=
    ((hasValue_constant (hFN ha)).mul (hasValue_mono hMN hx)).add hyN
      (hasValue_constant (hFN hb))
  refine ⟨x, z, hx, hz, ?_, hasValue_racl_eq_of_curve hyM hv hu hx,
    hasValue_racl_eq_of_curve (hzN.of_le hMN) hv hu hz⟩
  rw [hact] at hsub
  exact hsub.eq_value hyN hlinear

name: GroupConfig.adjoin_coe_closure
statement:
theorem adjoin_coe_closure (s : Set K) :
    adjoin k ((Subfield.closure s : Subfield K) : Set K) = adjoin k s
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (adjoin_le_iff.2 ?_) (adjoin_le_iff.2 ((Subfield.subset_closure).trans ?_))
  · intro x hx
    exact (Subfield.closure_le (t := (adjoin k s).toSubfield)).2 (subset_adjoin k s) hx
  · exact subset_adjoin k _

name: GroupConfig.erk_adjoin_eq
statement:
theorem erk_adjoin_eq (C s : Set K) : erk k C ((adjoin k s : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) =
    erk k C s
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (erk_mono k C (subset_adjoin k s))
  calc erk k C ((adjoin k s : IntermediateField k K) : Set K)
      ≤ erk k C (racl k (C ∪ s)) :=
        erk_mono k C (adjoin_le_iff.2 (subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _)))
    _ = erk k C s := erk_racl k C s

name: GroupConfig.Germ.cb_mk
statement:
theorem cb_mk (r : Representative k K a a') :
    Germ.cb (⟦r⟧ : Germ k a a') = adjoin k (idealFod r.graphIdeal : Set K)
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.cb_mk_eq_canonicalBase
proof:
:= by
  rw [cb_mk, r.graphIdeal_eq hy]
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.cb_mk_le
statement: theorem cb_mk_le (r : Representative k K a a') : Germ.cb (⟦r⟧ : Germ k a a') ≤ r.M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver r.isSmall a
  rw [cb_mk_eq_canonicalBase r hy]
  exact canonicalBase_le _ _

name: GroupConfig.Germ.isSmall_cb
statement: theorem isSmall_cb (g : Germ k a a') : IsSmall k (g.cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  induction g using Quotient.inductionOn with
  | h r =>
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver r.isSmall a
    rw [cb_mk_eq_canonicalBase r hy]
    exact isSmall_canonicalBase _ _

name: GroupConfig.Germ.idealDefinedOver_graphIdeal
statement:
theorem idealDefinedOver_graphIdeal (g : Germ k a a') {F : IntermediateField k K}
    (h : g.cb ≤ F) : IdealDefinedOver F.toSubfield g.graphIdeal
proof:
:= by
  refine idealDefinedOver_iff.2 fun x hx ↦ ?_
  exact (mem_toSubfield F x).2 (h (subset_adjoin k _ hx))

name: GroupConfig.Germ.closure_codeSet
statement:
theorem closure_codeSet (g : Germ k a a') :
    Subfield.closure (g.codeSet : Set K) = idealFod g.graphIdeal
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (exists_finset_closure_eq_idealFod g.graphIdeal)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.adjoin_codeSet
statement: theorem adjoin_codeSet (g : Germ k a a') : adjoin k (g.codeSet : Set K) = g.cb
proof:
:= by
  rw [cb, ← closure_codeSet, adjoin_coe_closure]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.erk_codeSet_eq
statement:
theorem erk_codeSet_eq (g : Germ k a a') (C : Set K) :
    erk k C (g.codeSet : Set K) = erk k C (g.cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← adjoin_codeSet, erk_adjoin_eq]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.erk_cb_map_restrictScalars
statement:
theorem erk_cb_map_restrictScalars {κ : Type*} [Finite κ] {a' : κ → K}
    {M : IntermediateField k K} (σ : K ≃ₐ[↥M] K) (g : Germ k a a') :
    erk k (M : Set K) ((g.map (σ.restrictScalars k)).cb : Set K) =
      erk k (M : Set K) (g.cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have hM : (σ.restrictScalars k) '' (M : Set K) = M := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      change σ y ∈ M
      rw [show σ y = y from σ.commutes ⟨y, hy⟩]
      exact hy
    · intro hx
      exact ⟨x, hx, σ.commutes ⟨x, hx⟩⟩
  rw [cb_map, coe_map, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom,
    ← erk_image (σ.restrictScalars k) (M : Set K) (g.cb : Set K), hM]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.erk_base_cb_le
statement:
theorem erk_base_cb_le (C : Set K) {γ : Germ k a a} (hγ : γ ∈ prodSet g₀) :
    erk k C (γ.cb : Set K) ≤ erk k ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K)
proof:
:=
  (erk_base_mono k (empty_subset C) _).trans (hw.erk_cb_le_of_mem_prodSet hγ)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.erk_base_cb_eq_iff
statement:
theorem erk_base_cb_eq_iff {M : Set K} {γ : Germ k a a} (hγ : γ ∈ prodSet g₀) :
    erk k M (γ.cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K) ↔
      γ ∈ orbit g₀ ∧ IndepOver k ∅ (γ.cb : Set K) M
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h0 : erk k ∅ (γ.cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K) :=
      le_antisymm (hw.erk_cb_le_of_mem_prodSet hγ)
        (h.symm.le.trans (erk_base_mono k (empty_subset M) _))
    refine ⟨(hw.mem_orbit_iff_erk_eq hγ).2 h0, indepOver_cb_of_erk_eq γ ?_⟩
    rw [empty_union, h, h0]
  · rintro ⟨hmem, hind⟩
    have h := erk_cb_eq_of_indepOver hind
    rw [empty_union] at h
    rw [h, erk_cb_of_mem hmem]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.exists_mul_eq_of_mem_prodSet
statement:
theorem exists_mul_eq_of_mem_prodSet {M : Set K} (hM : IsSmall k M) {γ : Germ k a a}
    (hγ : γ ∈ prodSet g₀) :
    ∃ γ₁ ∈ prodSet g₀, ∃ γ₂ ∈ prodSet g₀, γ = γ₁ * γ₂ ∧
      erk k M (γ₁.cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K) ∧
      erk k M (γ₂.cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfind⟩ := exists_mem_orbit_indepOver g₀ (hM.union γ.isSmall_cb)
  obtain ⟨hγf, -⟩ := hw.mul_mem_of_indepOver hγ hf (hfind.mono_right subset_union_right)
  obtain ⟨γ', hγ'⟩ := isUnit_iff.1 (hw.isUnit_of_mem_prodSet hγ)
  obtain ⟨f', hf'⟩ := isUnit_iff.1 (hw.isUnit_of_mem hf)
  have hfM : erk k M (f.cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K) := by
    have h := erk_cb_eq_of_indepOver (hfind.mono_right subset_union_left)
    rw [empty_union] at h
    rw [h, erk_cb_of_mem hf]
  
  have h₁ : erk k M ((γ * f).cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K) := by
    refine le_antisymm (hw.erk_base_cb_le M (hw.mem_prodSet_of_mem hγf)) ?_
    have h := erk_cb_eq_of_indepOver hfind
    rw [empty_union, erk_cb_of_mem hf] at h
    calc erk k ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K) = erk k (M ∪ γ.cb) (f.cb : Set K) := h.symm
      _ = erk k (M ∪ γ.cb) ((γ * f).cb : Set K) := by
          rw [mul_def, erk_cb_comp_eq_of_isInverse_left M f hγ']
      _ ≤ erk k M ((γ * f).cb : Set K) := erk_base_mono k subset_union_left _
  
  have hsub {A B : Set K} (h : racl k A = racl k B) : A ⊆ racl k (M ∪ B) :=
    (subset_racl k A).trans (h ▸ racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_right)
  have h₂ : erk k M (f'.cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K) :=
    (erk_eq_of_subset_racl (hsub hf'.racl_cb_eq) (hsub hf'.racl_cb_eq.symm)).trans hfM
  refine ⟨γ * f, hw.mem_prodSet_of_mem hγf, f', hw.inv_mem_prodSet (hw.mem_prodSet_of_mem hf) hf',
    ?_, h₁, h₂⟩
  have hff : f * f' = 1 := hf'.2
  rw [mul_assoc, hff, mul_one]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.exists_algEquiv_of_erk_base_eq
statement:
theorem exists_algEquiv_of_erk_base_eq {M : IntermediateField k K} (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K))
    {γ γ' : Germ k a a} (hγ : γ ∈ prodSet g₀) (hγ' : γ' ∈ prodSet g₀)
    (hr : erk k (M : Set K) (γ.cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K))
    (hr' : erk k (M : Set K) (γ'.cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K)) :
    ∃ σ : K ≃ₐ[↥M] K, γ.map (σ.restrictScalars k) = γ'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hmem, hind⟩ := (hw.erk_base_cb_eq_iff hγ).1 hr
  obtain ⟨hmem', hind'⟩ := (hw.erk_base_cb_eq_iff hγ').1 hr'
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := exists_algEquiv_of_mem_orbit hmem hmem' hM hind hind'
  
  let σ : K ≃ₐ[↥M] K :=
    { τ.toRingEquiv with commutes' := fun x ↦ τ.commutes ⟨x, subset_racl k _ x.2⟩ }
  have hστ : σ.restrictScalars k = τ.restrictScalars k := AlgEquiv.ext fun _ ↦ rfl
  exact ⟨σ, hστ ▸ hτ⟩

name: GroupConfig.locusIdeal_base_comp
statement:
theorem locusIdeal_base_comp (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (a : ι → K) :
    locusIdeal k (⇑σ ∘ a) = locusIdeal k a
proof:
:= by
  have h : ⇑σ ∘ a = ⇑σ.toAlgHom ∘ a := rfl
  unfold locusIdeal
  rw [h, idealOf_comp_algHom k]

name: GroupConfig.map_locusIdeal_base
statement:
theorem map_locusIdeal_base (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (a : ι → K) :
    (locusIdeal k a).map (MvPolynomial.map σ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom) = locusIdeal k a
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : σ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap k K) = algebraMap k K :=
    RingHom.ext fun c ↦ σ.commutes c
  have hmap : (MvPolynomial.map σ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom).comp
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) : MvPolynomial ι k →+* MvPolynomial ι K) =
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) :=
    RingHom.ext fun p ↦ by rw [RingHom.comp_apply, MvPolynomial.map_map, hcomp]
  unfold locusIdeal
  rw [Ideal.map_map, hmap]

name: GroupConfig.map_toRingHom_bijective
statement:
theorem map_toRingHom_bijective (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) :
    Function.Bijective (MvPolynomial.map (σ := ι) σ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom)
proof:
:=
  ⟨MvPolynomial.map_injective _ σ.injective, MvPolynomial.map_surjective _ σ.surjective⟩

name: GroupConfig.isGenericOver_map_iff
statement:
theorem isGenericOver_map_iff (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (M : IntermediateField k K) (a y : ι → K) :
    IsGenericOver (M.map σ.toAlgHom) a (⇑σ ∘ y) ↔ IsGenericOver M a y
proof:
:= by
  rw [isGenericOver_iff_locusIdeal_eq, isGenericOver_iff_locusIdeal_eq, ← locusIdeal_map]
  conv_lhs => rw [← map_locusIdeal_base σ a]
  exact (Function.LeftInverse.injective (g := Ideal.comap (MvPolynomial.map (σ := ι)
    σ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom)) fun I ↦ Ideal.comap_map_of_bijective _
    (map_toRingHom_bijective σ)).eq_iff

name: GroupConfig.aeval_map_intermediateFieldMap
statement:
theorem aeval_map_intermediateFieldMap (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (M : IntermediateField k K)
    (y : ι → K) (P : MvPolynomial ι (↥M)) :
    aeval (⇑σ ∘ y) (MvPolynomial.map (intermediateFieldMap σ M).toRingHom P) =
      σ (aeval y P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [aeval_def, aeval_def, eval₂_map]
  change _ = σ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom (eval₂ (algebraMap (↥M) K) y P)
  rw [eval₂_comp_left]
  congr 1

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isDefinedAt_mapAlgEquiv_iff
proof:
:= by
  unfold QuasiRational.IsDefinedAt
  simp only [QuasiRational.map, aeval_map_intermediateFieldMap, ne_eq,
    map_eq_zero_iff _ σ.injective]

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.eval_mapAlgEquiv
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  simp only [QuasiRational.eval, QuasiRational.map, Function.comp_apply,
    aeval_map_intermediateFieldMap, ← map_div₀, map_pRoot]

name: GroupConfig.Representative.map_M
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_M (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (r : Representative k K a a') : (r.map σ).M = r.M.map σ.toAlgHom
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.Representative.map_eval
statement:
theorem map_eval (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (r : Representative k K a a') (y : ι → K) :
    (r.map σ).f.eval (⇑σ ∘ y) = ⇑σ ∘ r.f.eval y
proof:
:=
  QuasiRational.eval_mapAlgEquiv σ r.f y

name: GroupConfig.Representative.racl_union_map
statement:
theorem racl_union_map (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (M M' : IntermediateField k K) :
    racl k (((M.map σ.toAlgHom : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) ∪ (M'.map σ.toAlgHom)) =
      (racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ M')).map σ.toAlgHom
proof:
:= by
  rw [racl_map, image_union, coe_map, coe_map, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom]

name: GroupConfig.Representative.Equivalent.map
statement:
theorem Equivalent.map {r r' : Representative k K a a'} (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K)
    (h : r.Equivalent r') : (r.map σ).Equivalent (r'.map σ)
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have hyy : y = ⇑σ ∘ (⇑σ.symm ∘ y) := by
    funext i
    simp
  have hy₀ : IsGenericOver (racl k ((r.M : Set K) ∪ r'.M)) a (⇑σ.symm ∘ y) := by
    rw [← isGenericOver_map_iff σ, ← hyy, ← racl_union_map]
    exact hy
  rw [hyy, map_eval, map_eval, h _ hy₀]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.map_mk
statement:
theorem map_mk (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (r : Representative k K a a') :
    Germ.map σ (⟦r⟧ : Germ k a a') = ⟦r.map σ⟧
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Representative.graphIdeal_map
statement:
theorem _root_.GroupConfig.Representative.graphIdeal_map (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K)
    (r : Representative k K a a') :
    (r.map σ).graphIdeal = r.graphIdeal.map (MvPolynomial.map σ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver r.isSmall a
  have hy' : IsGenericOver (r.map σ).M a (⇑σ ∘ y) := (isGenericOver_map_iff σ r.M a y).2 hy
  rw [(r.map σ).graphIdeal_eq hy', r.graphIdeal_eq hy, Representative.map_M, locusIdeal_map]
  congr 1
  funext i
  cases i with
  | inl i => rfl
  | inr j => exact congrFun (r.map_eval σ y) j

name: GroupConfig.Germ.graphIdeal_map
statement:
theorem graphIdeal_map (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (g : Germ k a a') :
    (g.map σ).graphIdeal = g.graphIdeal.map (MvPolynomial.map σ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  induction g using Quotient.inductionOn with
  | h r => exact r.graphIdeal_map σ

name: GroupConfig.Germ.cb_map
statement: theorem cb_map (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (g : Germ k a a') : (g.map σ).cb = g.cb.map σ.toAlgHom
proof:
:= by
  unfold cb
  rw [graphIdeal_map, idealFod_map, adjoin_map, Subfield.coe_map]
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.map_eq_self_iff
statement:
theorem map_eq_self_iff (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (g : Germ k a a') :
    g.map σ = g ↔ ∀ x ∈ g.cb, σ x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← graphIdeal_injective.eq_iff, graphIdeal_map, ideal_map_eq_self_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h x hx
    have hle : g.cb ≤ fixedBy σ := adjoin_le_iff.2 fun x hx ↦ h x hx
    exact hle hx
  · intro h x hx
    exact h x (subset_adjoin k _ hx)

name: GroupConfig.eq_zero_of_quadratic
proof:
:= by
  have hp : Polynomial.aeval t
      (Polynomial.C α * Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C β * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C γ) = 0 := by
    simpa only [map_add, map_mul, map_pow, Polynomial.aeval_C, Polynomial.aeval_X] using h
  have h0 := (transcendental_iff.1 ht) _ hp
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using congrArg (Polynomial.coeff · 2) h0
  · simpa using congrArg (Polynomial.coeff · 1) h0
  · simpa using congrArg (Polynomial.coeff · 0) h0

name: GroupConfig.linear_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem linear_ne_zero (ht : Transcendental K t) {c d : K} (hcd : c ≠ 0 ∨ d ≠ 0) :
    algebraMap K L c * t + algebraMap K L d ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h' : algebraMap K L 0 * t ^ 2 + algebraMap K L c * t + algebraMap K L d = 0 := by
    rw [map_zero, zero_mul, zero_add, h]
  obtain ⟨-, hc, hd⟩ := eq_zero_of_quadratic ht h'
  exact hcd.elim (· hc) (· hd)

name: GroupConfig.sl2_denom_ne_zero
statement:
theorem sl2_denom_ne_zero (ht : Transcendental K t) (m : SL(2, K)) :
    algebraMap K L (m 1 0) * t + algebraMap K L (m 1 1) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine linear_ne_zero ht ?_
  by_contra! h
  have hdet := m.det_coe
  rw [det_fin_two, h.1, h.2] at hdet
  simp at hdet

name: GroupConfig.algEquiv_ext_of_adjoin_eq_top
statement:
private theorem algEquiv_ext_of_adjoin_eq_top (htop : IntermediateField.adjoin K {t} = ⊤)
    {φ ψ : L ≃ₐ[K] L} (h : φ t = ψ t) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  refine AlgEquiv.ext fun x ↦ ?_
  have hx : x ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin K {t} := by
    rw [htop]
    trivial
  induction hx using IntermediateField.adjoin_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    rw [mem_singleton_iff.1 hx]
    exact h
  | algebraMap x => rw [AlgEquiv.commutes, AlgEquiv.commutes]
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | inv x _ hx => rw [map_inv₀, map_inv₀, hx]
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_mul, map_mul, hx, hy]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.isMoebiusLift_one
statement: theorem isMoebiusLift_one (ht : Transcendental K t) : hw.IsMoebiusLift hv t 1 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨sl2_denom_ne_zero ht 1, ?_⟩
  rw [map_one]
  simp

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.IsMoebiusLift.neg
statement:
theorem IsMoebiusLift.neg {γ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup} {m : SL(2, K)} (h : hw.IsMoebiusLift hv t γ m) :
    hw.IsMoebiusLift hv t γ (-m)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hd, he⟩ := h
  refine ⟨fun h0 ↦ hd ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [SpecialLinearGroup.coe_neg, Matrix.neg_apply, map_neg] at h0
    linear_combination -h0
  · simp only [SpecialLinearGroup.coe_neg, Matrix.neg_apply, map_neg]
    linear_combination -he

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.IsMoebiusLift.eq_or_eq_neg
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hd, he⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hd', he'⟩ := h'
  
  have hq : algebraMap K _ (m 0 0 * m' 1 0 - m' 0 0 * m 1 0) * t ^ 2 +
      algebraMap K _ (m 0 0 * m' 1 1 + m 0 1 * m' 1 0 - m' 0 0 * m 1 1 - m' 0 1 * m 1 0) * t +
      algebraMap K _ (m 0 1 * m' 1 1 - m' 0 1 * m 1 1) = 0 := by
    have hrel : (algebraMap K _ (m 0 0) * t + algebraMap K _ (m 0 1)) *
        (algebraMap K _ (m' 1 0) * t + algebraMap K _ (m' 1 1)) =
        (algebraMap K _ (m' 0 0) * t + algebraMap K _ (m' 0 1)) *
          (algebraMap K _ (m 1 0) * t + algebraMap K _ (m 1 1)) := by
      rw [← he, ← he']
      ring
    simp only [map_sub, map_add, map_mul]
    linear_combination hrel
  obtain ⟨h2, h1, h0⟩ := eq_zero_of_quadratic ht hq
  have hdet := m.det_coe
  have hdet' := m'.det_coe
  rw [det_fin_two] at hdet hdet'
  
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ : ∃ l, l = m 1 1 * m' 0 0 - m 0 1 * m' 1 0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have e00 : m' 0 0 = l * m 0 0 := by
    linear_combination (-m' 0 0) * hdet + m 0 1 * h2 - m 0 0 * hl
  have e01 : m' 0 1 = l * m 0 1 := by
    linear_combination (-m' 0 1) * hdet - m 0 0 * h0 + m 0 1 * h1 - m 0 1 * hl
  have e10 : m' 1 0 = l * m 1 0 := by
    linear_combination (-m' 1 0) * hdet + m 1 1 * h2 - m 1 0 * hl
  have e11 : m' 1 1 = l * m 1 1 := by
    linear_combination (-m' 1 1) * hdet - m 1 0 * h0 + m 1 1 * h1 - m 1 1 * hl
  have hl2 : (l - 1) * (l + 1) = 0 := by
    rw [e00, e01, e10, e11] at hdet'
    linear_combination hdet' - l ^ 2 * hdet
  rcases mul_eq_zero.1 hl2 with hl1 | hl1
  · left
    have hl1' : l = 1 := sub_eq_zero.1 hl1
    refine SpecialLinearGroup.ext _ _ fun i j ↦ ?_
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · simpa [hl1'] using e00
    · simpa [hl1'] using e01
    · simpa [hl1'] using e10
    · simpa [hl1'] using e11
  · right
    have hl1' : l = -1 := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hl1
    refine SpecialLinearGroup.ext _ _ fun i j ↦ ?_
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · simpa [hl1'] using e00
    · simpa [hl1'] using e01
    · simpa [hl1'] using e10
    · simpa [hl1'] using e11

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.IsMoebiusLift.mul
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, he⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨-, he'⟩ := h'
  refine ⟨sl2_denom_ne_zero ht _, ?_⟩
  
  have hG := congrArg (hw.functionFieldAction hv γ) he'
  simp only [map_mul, map_add, AlgEquiv.commutes] at hG
  rw [map_mul, AlgEquiv.mul_apply]
  simp only [SpecialLinearGroup.coe_mul, mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, map_add, map_mul]
  linear_combination (algebraMap K _ (n 0 0) -
      hw.functionFieldAction hv γ (hw.functionFieldAction hv δ t) * algebraMap K _ (n 1 0)) * he +
    (algebraMap K _ (m 1 0) * t + algebraMap K _ (m 1 1)) * hG

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.IsMoebiusLift.injective
statement:
theorem IsMoebiusLift.injective (htop : IntermediateField.adjoin K {t} = ⊤)
    {γ δ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup} {m : SL(2, K)} (h : hw.IsMoebiusLift hv t γ m)
    (h' : hw.IsMoebiusLift hv t δ m) : γ = δ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hd, he⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨-, he'⟩ := h'
  refine hw.functionFieldAction_injective hv (algEquiv_ext_of_adjoin_eq_top htop ?_)
  rw [← mul_left_inj' hd, he, he']

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.exists_generator_isMoebiusLift
statement:
theorem exists_generator_isMoebiusLift (hr : 2 ≤ erk k ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K)) :
    ∃ t : LocusFunctionField k v, Transcendental K t ∧
      IntermediateField.adjoin K ({t} : Set (LocusFunctionField k v)) = ⊤ ∧
      ∀ γ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup, ∃ m : SL(2, K), hw.IsMoebiusLift hv t γ m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htop, hγ⟩ := hw.exists_generator_moebius hv hr
  refine ⟨t, ht, htop, fun γ ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, d, hdet, hden, he⟩ := hγ γ
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq (a * d - b * c)⁻¹ (n := 2) two_pos
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [zero_pow two_ne_zero] at hs
    exact inv_ne_zero hdet hs.symm
  let m : SL(2, K) := ⟨!![s * a, s * b; s * c, s * d], by
    rw [det_fin_two_of]
    linear_combination (a * d - b * c) * hs + mul_inv_cancel₀ hdet⟩
  refine ⟨m, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change algebraMap K _ (s * c) * t + algebraMap K _ (s * d) ≠ 0
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, mul_assoc, ← mul_add]
    exact mul_ne_zero ((map_ne_zero _).2 hs0) hden
  · change hw.functionFieldAction hv γ t * (algebraMap K _ (s * c) * t + algebraMap K _ (s * d)) =
      algebraMap K _ (s * a) * t + algebraMap K _ (s * b)
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_mul, map_mul]
    linear_combination (algebraMap K (LocusFunctionField k v) s) * he

name: GroupConfig.mem_dclAdjoin_map
statement:
theorem mem_dclAdjoin_map (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) {L : IntermediateField k K} {u : ι → K} {x : K}
    (hx : x ∈ dclAdjoin L u) : σ x ∈ dclAdjoin (L.map σ.toAlgHom) (⇑σ ∘ u)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, P, Q, hQ, hx⟩ := mem_dclAdjoin_iff.1 hx
  refine mem_dclAdjoin_iff.2 ⟨n, MvPolynomial.map (intermediateFieldMap σ L).toRingHom P,
    MvPolynomial.map (intermediateFieldMap σ L).toRingHom Q, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [aeval_map_intermediateFieldMap]
    exact (map_ne_zero_iff _ σ.injective).2 hQ
  · rw [aeval_map_intermediateFieldMap, aeval_map_intermediateFieldMap, ← map_div₀, ← hx,
      map_pow]

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.isSmall_racl
statement:
theorem isSmall_racl (b : μ → K) :
    IsSmall k ((racl k (range b) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K)
proof:
:=
  (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range b)).racl

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.map_racl_eq
statement:
theorem map_racl_eq (b : μ → K) (σ : K ≃ₐ[↥(adjoin k (range b))] K) :
    (racl k (range b)).map (σ.restrictScalars k).toAlgHom = racl k (range b)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : ⇑(σ.restrictScalars k) '' range b = range b := by
    rw [← range_comp]
    refine congrArg range (funext fun i ↦ ?_)
    change σ (b i) = b i
    exact σ.commutes ⟨b i, subset_adjoin k _ (mem_range_self i)⟩
  rw [racl_map, hb]

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.map
statement:
theorem map (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) : IsTriple k a a' (⇑σ ∘ b) (⇑σ ∘ y) (⇑σ ∘ z) where
  isGen_left
proof:
:= h.isGen_left.map σ
  isGen_right := h.isGen_right.map σ
  indep_left := by
    have := h.indep_left.image σ
    rwa [image_empty, ← range_comp, ← range_comp] at this
  indep_right := by
    have := h.indep_right.image σ
    rwa [image_empty, ← range_comp, ← range_comp] at this
  mem_dcl j := by
    have := mem_dclAdjoin_map σ (h.mem_dcl j)
    rwa [adjoin_map, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, ← range_comp] at this

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.isGenericOver_left
statement: theorem isGenericOver_left : IsGenericOver (racl k (range b)) a y
proof:
:=
  h.isGen_left.isGenericOver_racl (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range b)) h.indep_left

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.isGenericOver_right
statement: theorem isGenericOver_right : IsGenericOver (racl k (range b)) a' z
proof:
:=
  h.isGen_right.isGenericOver_racl (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range b)) h.indep_right

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.qr_spec
statement: theorem qr_spec : h.qr.IsDefinedAt y ∧ h.qr.eval y = z
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (exists_quasiRational_of_mem_dclAdjoin h.mem_dcl)

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.qrM_eval
statement: theorem qrM_eval (u : ι → K) : h.qrM.eval u = h.qr.eval u
proof:
:= by
  rw [qrM, QuasiRational.eval_map]

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.qrM_isDefinedAt
statement: theorem qrM_isDefinedAt : h.qrM.IsDefinedAt y
proof:
:=
  (QuasiRational.isDefinedAt_map_iff _ _ _).2 h.qr_spec.1

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.rep_M
statement: theorem rep_M : h.rep.M = racl k (range b)
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.rep_f_eval
statement: theorem rep_f_eval : h.rep.f.eval y = z
proof:
:= by
  change h.qrM.eval y = z
  rw [h.qrM_eval, h.qr_spec.2]

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.rep_f_eval_comp
statement:
theorem rep_f_eval_comp (σ : K ≃ₐ[↥(adjoin k (range b))] K) :
    h.rep.f.eval (⇑(σ.restrictScalars k) ∘ y) = ⇑(σ.restrictScalars k) ∘ z
proof:
:= by
  change h.qrM.eval (⇑(σ.restrictScalars k) ∘ y) = _
  rw [h.qrM_eval, show ⇑(σ.restrictScalars k) ∘ y = ⇑σ ∘ y from rfl, h.qr.eval_comp σ y,
    h.qr_spec.2]
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.germ_cb_le
statement: theorem germ_cb_le : h.germ.cb ≤ racl k (range b)
proof: := Germ.cb_mk_le h.rep

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.indep_cb
statement: theorem indep_cb : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (h.germ.cb : Set K)
proof:
:=
  (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 h.indep_left).mono_right (by
    rw [empty_union]
    exact h.germ_cb_le)

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.germ_eval
statement: theorem germ_eval : h.germ.eval (racl k (range b)) y = z
proof:
:=
  (Germ.eval_eq_rep h.rep (isSmall_racl b) h.germ_cb_le le_rfl h.isGenericOver_left).trans
    h.rep_f_eval

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.germ_evalGen
statement: theorem germ_evalGen : h.germ.evalGen y = z
proof:
:=
  (Germ.evalGen_eq h.germ (isSmall_racl b) h.germ_cb_le h.isGenericOver_left).trans h.germ_eval

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.eq_germ
statement:
theorem eq_germ {g : Germ k a a'} (hcb : g.cb ≤ racl k (range b)) (hg : g.evalGen y = z) :
    g = h.germ
proof:
:= by
  refine Germ.eq_of_eval_eq (isSmall_racl b) hcb h.germ_cb_le h.isGenericOver_left ?_
  exact ((Germ.evalGen_eq g (isSmall_racl b) hcb h.isGenericOver_left).symm.trans hg).trans
    h.germ_eval.symm

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.germ_graphIdeal
statement:
theorem germ_graphIdeal :
    h.germ.graphIdeal = locusIdeal (↥(racl k (range b))) (Sum.elim y z)
proof:
:= by
  change Germ.graphIdeal ⟦h.rep⟧ = _
  rw [Germ.graphIdeal_mk, h.rep.graphIdeal_eq h.isGenericOver_left]
  unfold Representative.graphPoint
  rw [h.rep_f_eval]
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.germ_cb
statement: theorem germ_cb : h.germ.cb = canonicalBase (racl k (range b)) (Sum.elim y z)
proof:
:= by
  change Germ.cb ⟦h.rep⟧ = _
  rw [Germ.cb_mk_eq_canonicalBase h.rep h.isGenericOver_left]
  unfold Representative.graphPoint
  rw [h.rep_f_eval]
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.map_germ_eq_self
statement:
theorem map_germ_eq_self (σ : K ≃ₐ[↥(adjoin k (range b))] K) :
    h.germ.map (σ.restrictScalars k) = h.germ
proof:
:= by
  have hyσ : IsGenericOver (racl k (range b)) a (⇑(σ.restrictScalars k) ∘ y) := by
    have := (isGenericOver_map_iff (σ.restrictScalars k) _ a y).2 h.isGenericOver_left
    rwa [map_racl_eq b σ] at this
  have hcb' : (h.germ.map (σ.restrictScalars k)).cb ≤ racl k (range b) := by
    rw [Germ.cb_map]
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := (IntermediateField.mem_map _).1 hx
    rw [← map_racl_eq b σ]
    exact (IntermediateField.mem_map _).2 ⟨w, h.germ_cb_le hw, rfl⟩
  have e1 : (h.germ.map (σ.restrictScalars k)).evalGen (⇑(σ.restrictScalars k) ∘ y) =
      ⇑(σ.restrictScalars k) ∘ z := by
    rw [Germ.evalGen_map _ h.germ h.isGen_left h.indep_cb, h.germ_evalGen]
  have e2 : h.germ.evalGen (⇑(σ.restrictScalars k) ∘ y) = ⇑(σ.restrictScalars k) ∘ z :=
    (Germ.evalGen_eq h.germ (isSmall_racl b) h.germ_cb_le hyσ).trans
      ((Germ.eval_eq_rep h.rep (isSmall_racl b) h.germ_cb_le le_rfl hyσ).trans
        (h.rep_f_eval_comp σ))
  refine Germ.eq_of_eval_eq (isSmall_racl b) hcb' h.germ_cb_le hyσ ?_
  exact ((Germ.evalGen_eq _ (isSmall_racl b) hcb' hyσ).symm.trans e1).trans
    (e2.symm.trans (Germ.evalGen_eq _ (isSmall_racl b) h.germ_cb_le hyσ))

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.germ_cb_le_dcl
statement: theorem germ_cb_le_dcl : h.germ.cb ≤ dcl (adjoin k (range b))
proof:
:=
  Germ.cb_le_dcl_of_forall_map_eq h.germ h.map_germ_eq_self

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.isInvertible_iff
statement:
theorem isInvertible_iff :
    Germ.IsInvertible h.germ ↔ ∀ i, y i ∈ dclAdjoin (adjoin k (range b)) z
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g', hi⟩ i
    have hg'cb : g'.cb ≤ dcl (adjoin k (range b)) := by
      refine Germ.cb_le_dcl_of_forall_map_eq g' fun σ ↦ ?_
      have e := hi.map (σ.restrictScalars k)
      rw [h.map_germ_eq_self σ] at e
      exact e.unique hi
    have hzg' : IndepOver k ∅ (range z) (g'.cb : Set K) := by
      refine (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 h.indep_right).mono_right ?_
      rw [empty_union]
      exact hi.cb_le.trans (racl_le_of_subset_racl h.germ_cb_le)
    have e : g'.evalGen z = y := by
      have := hi.evalGen_evalGen h.isGen_left h.indep_cb
      rwa [h.germ_evalGen] at this
    exact (congrArg (fun w ↦ w ∈ dclAdjoin (adjoin k (range b)) z) (congrFun e i)).mp
      (g'.evalGen_mem_dclAdjoin_of_cb_le_dcl hg'cb h.isGen_right hzg' i)
  · intro hdef
    refine (Germ.isInvertible_iff_mem_dclAdjoin h.germ (isSmall_racl b) h.germ_cb_le
      h.isGenericOver_left).2 fun i ↦ ?_
    rw [h.germ_eval]
    exact dclAdjoin_mono (adjoin_le_racl k _) z (hdef i)

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.germ_map
statement: theorem germ_map (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) : h.germ.map σ = (h.map σ).germ
proof:
:= by
  refine (h.map σ).eq_germ ?_ ?_
  · rw [Germ.cb_map, range_comp, ← racl_map]
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := (IntermediateField.mem_map _).1 hx
    exact (IntermediateField.mem_map _).2 ⟨w, h.germ_cb_le hw, rfl⟩
  · rw [Germ.evalGen_map σ h.germ h.isGen_left h.indep_cb, h.germ_evalGen]

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.germ_map_eq_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem germ_map_eq_of_comp_eq {σ τ : K ≃ₐ[k] K} (hστ : ⇑σ ∘ b = ⇑τ ∘ b) :
    h.germ.map σ = h.germ.map τ
proof:
:= by
  have hfix : ∀ x ∈ adjoin k (range b), (τ.trans σ.symm) x = x := by
    intro x hx
    have hle : adjoin k (range b) ≤ fixedBy (τ.trans σ.symm) := by
      refine adjoin_le_iff.2 ?_
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      change σ.symm (τ (b i)) = b i
      have e : τ (b i) = σ (b i) := (congrFun hστ i).symm
      rw [e]
      exact σ.symm_apply_apply _
    exact hle hx
  have h1 : h.germ.map (τ.trans σ.symm) = h.germ :=
    (Germ.map_eq_self_iff _ _).2 fun x hx ↦
      apply_eq_self_of_mem_dcl_of_fixes _ hfix (h.germ_cb_le_dcl hx)
  symm
  calc h.germ.map τ = h.germ.map ((τ.trans σ.symm).trans σ) := by
        congr 1
        exact AlgEquiv.ext fun x ↦ (σ.apply_symm_apply (τ x)).symm
    _ = (h.germ.map (τ.trans σ.symm)).map σ := (Germ.map_map _ _ _).symm
    _ = h.germ.map σ := congrArg (Germ.map σ) h1

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.indepOver_evalGen
statement:
theorem indepOver_evalGen (hyz : IndepOver k ∅ (range y) (range z)) (τ : K ≃ₐ[k] K)
    (hτ : IndepOver k ∅ (range (⇑τ ∘ b)) (range y)) :
    IndepOver k ∅ (range ((h.map τ).germ.evalGen y)) (range y)
proof:
:= by
  have hsmall' : IsSmall k (range (⇑τ ∘ b)) := IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range _)
  have hy1 : IsGenericOver (racl k (range (⇑τ ∘ b))) a y :=
    h.isGen_left.isGenericOver_racl hsmall' hτ.symm
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := (h.map τ).isGenericOver_left.exists_algEquiv hy1
  have hσb : ⇑(τ.trans (ρ.restrictScalars k)) ∘ b = ⇑τ ∘ b := funext fun i ↦ by
    change ρ (τ (b i)) = τ (b i)
    exact ρ.commutes ⟨τ (b i), subset_racl k _ (mem_range_self (f := ⇑τ ∘ b) i)⟩
  have hσy : ⇑(τ.trans (ρ.restrictScalars k)) ∘ y = y := funext fun i ↦ by
    change ρ (τ (y i)) = y i
    exact hρ i
  have hg : (h.map τ).germ = h.germ.map (τ.trans (ρ.restrictScalars k)) :=
    (h.germ_map τ).symm.trans (h.germ_map_eq_of_comp_eq hσb.symm)
  have hind := hyz.symm.image (τ.trans (ρ.restrictScalars k))
  rw [image_empty, ← range_comp, ← range_comp, hσy] at hind
  have e : (h.germ.map (τ.trans (ρ.restrictScalars k))).evalGen y =
      ⇑(τ.trans (ρ.restrictScalars k)) ∘ z := by
    have := Germ.evalGen_map (τ.trans (ρ.restrictScalars k)) h.germ h.isGen_left h.indep_cb
    rwa [hσy, h.germ_evalGen] at this
  rw [hg, e]
  exact hind

name: GroupConfig.IsTriple.racl_cb_eq_iff
statement:
theorem racl_cb_eq_iff :
    racl k (h.germ.cb : Set K) = racl k (range b) ↔ range b ⊆ racl k (h.germ.cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro e
    rw [e]
    exact subset_racl k _
  · intro hb
    exact le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl h.germ_cb_le) (racl_le_of_subset_racl hb)

name: GroupConfig.map_map_inclusion
statement:
theorem map_map_inclusion {M M₁ : IntermediateField k K} (h : M ≤ M₁) (P : MvPolynomial ι M) :
    MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap M₁ K)
      (MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion h).toRingHom P) =
        MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap M K) P
proof:
:= by
  rw [MvPolynomial.map_map]
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.LocusFunctionField.mk_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem mk_eq_zero_iff {P : MvPolynomial ι K} : mk k v P = 0 ↔ P ∈ locusIdeal k v
proof:
:= by
  change algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι K ⧸ locusIdeal k v) _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ P) = 0 ↔ _
  rw [map_eq_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective _ _), Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]

name: GroupConfig.LocusFunctionField.aeval_coord
statement: theorem aeval_coord (P : MvPolynomial ι K) : aeval (coord k v) P = mk k v P
proof:
:= by
  have h : aeval (coord k v) = mk k v := MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun i ↦ by
    rw [aeval_X]
    rfl
  rw [h]

name: GroupConfig.LocusFunctionField.exists_fraction
statement:
theorem exists_fraction (h : LocusFunctionField k v) :
    ∃ A B : MvPolynomial ι K, B ∉ locusIdeal k v ∧ h = mk k v A / mk k v B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (A := MvPolynomial ι K ⧸ locusIdeal k v) h
  obtain ⟨A, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a
  obtain ⟨B, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective b
  refine ⟨A, B, fun hB ↦ ?_, rfl⟩
  exact nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hb (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.2 hB)

name: GroupConfig.LocusFunctionField.map_mem_locusIdeal_iff_aeval
statement:
theorem map_mem_locusIdeal_iff_aeval (hy : IsGenericOver M v y) (P : MvPolynomial ι M) :
    MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap M K) P ∈ locusIdeal k v ↔ aeval y P = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hy.locusIdeal_eq, map_mem_locusIdeal_iff, mem_idealOf_iff]

name: GroupConfig.LocusFunctionField.mk_map_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mk_map_ne_zero (hy : IsGenericOver M v y) {P : MvPolynomial ι M} (hP : aeval y P ≠ 0) :
    mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap M K) P) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ne, mk_eq_zero_iff, map_mem_locusIdeal_iff_aeval hy]
  exact hP

name: GroupConfig.LocusFunctionField.mk_map_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem mk_map_eq_zero_iff (hy : IsGenericOver M v y) (P : MvPolynomial ι M) :
    mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap M K) P) = 0 ↔ aeval y P = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_eq_zero_iff, map_mem_locusIdeal_iff_aeval hy]

name: GroupConfig.LocusFunctionField.exists_fraction_of_subset
statement:
theorem exists_fraction_of_subset (h : LocusFunctionField k v) :
    ∃ C : Set K, C.Finite ∧ ∀ N : IntermediateField k K, C ⊆ N →
      ∃ A B : MvPolynomial ι N, (∀ y, IsGenericOver N v y → aeval y B ≠ 0) ∧
        h = mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap N K) A) /
          mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap N K) B)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, B, hB, rfl⟩ := exists_fraction h
  refine ⟨↑A.coeffs ∪ ↑B.coeffs, A.coeffs.finite_toSet.union B.coeffs.finite_toSet,
    fun N hN ↦ ?_⟩
  have hcoeff : ∀ P : MvPolynomial ι K, ↑P.coeffs ⊆ (N : Set K) →
      ∃ P₀ : MvPolynomial ι N, MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap N K) P₀ = P := fun P hP ↦
    MvPolynomial.mem_range_map_iff_coeffs_subset.mpr fun c hc ↦ ⟨⟨c, hP hc⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨A₀, hA₀⟩ := hcoeff A fun c hc ↦ hN (Or.inl hc)
  obtain ⟨B₀, hB₀⟩ := hcoeff B fun c hc ↦ hN (Or.inr hc)
  refine ⟨A₀, B₀, fun y hy ↦ ?_, by rw [hA₀, hB₀]⟩
  rw [Ne, ← map_mem_locusIdeal_iff_aeval hy, hB₀]
  exact hB

name: GroupConfig.LocusFunctionField.hasValue_mk
statement:
theorem hasValue_mk (P : MvPolynomial ι M) :
    HasValue M y (mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap M K) P)) (aeval y P)
proof:
:=
  ⟨P, 1, by simp, by simp, by simp⟩

name: GroupConfig.LocusFunctionField.hasValue_coord
statement: theorem hasValue_coord (i : ι) : HasValue M y (coord k v i) (y i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasValue_mk (k := k) (v := v) (M := M) (y := y) (X i)
  rwa [MvPolynomial.map_X, aeval_X] at h

name: GroupConfig.LocusFunctionField.HasValue.eq_value
statement:
theorem HasValue.eq_value (hy : IsGenericOver M v y) {h : LocusFunctionField k v} {c c' : K}
    (h₁ : HasValue M y h c) (h₂ : HasValue M y h c') : c = c'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, B, hB, rfl, rfl⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨A', B', hB', heq, rfl⟩ := h₂
  rw [div_eq_div_iff (mk_map_ne_zero hy hB) (mk_map_ne_zero hy hB'), ← map_mul, ← map_mul,
    ← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, ← map_sub, mk_map_eq_zero_iff hy] at heq
  rw [div_eq_div_iff hB hB', ← sub_eq_zero, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_sub]
  exact heq

name: GroupConfig.LocusFunctionField.HasValue.eq
statement:
theorem HasValue.eq (hy : IsGenericOver M v y) {h h' : LocusFunctionField k v} {c : K}
    (h₁ : HasValue M y h c) (h₂ : HasValue M y h' c) : h = h'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, B, hB, rfl, rfl⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨A', B', hB', rfl, heq⟩ := h₂
  rw [div_eq_div_iff hB hB', ← sub_eq_zero, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_sub] at heq
  rw [div_eq_div_iff (mk_map_ne_zero hy hB) (mk_map_ne_zero hy hB'), ← map_mul, ← map_mul,
    ← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, ← map_sub, mk_map_eq_zero_iff hy]
  exact heq

name: GroupConfig.LocusFunctionField.HasValue.add
statement:
theorem HasValue.add (hy : IsGenericOver M v y) {h h' : LocusFunctionField k v} {c c' : K}
    (h₁ : HasValue M y h c) (h₂ : HasValue M y h' c') : HasValue M y (h + h') (c + c')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, B, hB, rfl, rfl⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨A', B', hB', rfl, rfl⟩ := h₂
  refine ⟨A * B' + B * A', B * B', by rw [map_mul]; exact mul_ne_zero hB hB', ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [div_add_div _ _ (mk_map_ne_zero hy hB) (mk_map_ne_zero hy hB')]
    simp only [map_add, map_mul]
  · rw [div_add_div _ _ hB hB']
    simp only [map_add, map_mul]

name: GroupConfig.LocusFunctionField.HasValue.mul
statement:
theorem HasValue.mul {h h' : LocusFunctionField k v} {c c' : K} (h₁ : HasValue M y h c)
    (h₂ : HasValue M y h' c') : HasValue M y (h * h') (c * c')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, B, hB, rfl, rfl⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨A', B', hB', rfl, rfl⟩ := h₂
  refine ⟨A * A', B * B', by rw [map_mul]; exact mul_ne_zero hB hB', ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [div_mul_div_comm]
    simp only [map_mul]
  · rw [div_mul_div_comm]
    simp only [map_mul]

name: GroupConfig.LocusFunctionField.hasValue_algebraMap
statement:
theorem hasValue_algebraMap {C : IntermediateField k K} (hCM : C ≤ M) (c : C) :
    HasValue M y (algebraMap C (LocusFunctionField k v) c) (algebraMap C K c)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasValue_mk (k := k) (v := v) (y := y) (MvPolynomial.C
    (IntermediateField.inclusion hCM c))
  rw [MvPolynomial.map_C, aeval_C] at h
  convert h using 1
  · rw [← MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq, AlgHom.commutes]
    rfl
  · rfl

name: GroupConfig.LocusFunctionField.exists_hasValue
statement:
theorem exists_hasValue (h : LocusFunctionField k v) {T : Set K} (hT : IsSmall k T) :
    ∃ N : IntermediateField k K, T ⊆ N ∧ IsAlgClosed ↥N ∧ IsSmall k (N : Set K) ∧
      ∀ y, IsGenericOver N v y → ∃ c, HasValue N y h c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, B, hB, rfl⟩ := exists_fraction h
  set N := racl k (T ∪ (↑A.coeffs ∪ ↑B.coeffs))
  have hcoeff : ∀ P : MvPolynomial ι K, ↑P.coeffs ⊆ (N : Set K) →
      ∃ P₀ : MvPolynomial ι N, MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap N K) P₀ = P := fun P hP ↦
    mem_range_map_iff_coeffs_subset.mpr fun c hc ↦ ⟨⟨c, hP hc⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨A₀, hA₀⟩ := hcoeff A fun c hc ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr (Or.inl hc))
  obtain ⟨B₀, hB₀⟩ := hcoeff B fun c hc ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr (Or.inr hc))
  refine ⟨N, fun c hc ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl hc), isAlgClosed_racl _,
    (hT.union (IsSmall.of_finite (A.coeffs.finite_toSet.union B.coeffs.finite_toSet))).racl,
    fun y hy ↦ ⟨_, A₀, B₀, ?_, by rw [hA₀, hB₀], rfl⟩⟩
  rw [Ne, ← map_mem_locusIdeal_iff_aeval hy, hB₀]
  exact hB

name: GroupConfig.LocusFunctionField.isFunctionFieldOneVar
statement:
theorem isFunctionFieldOneVar (hv : erk k ∅ (range v) = 1) :
    AclGeom.IsFunctionFieldOneVar K (LocusFunctionField k v)
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, v i ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) := by
    by_contra! hall
    have h0 : erk k ∅ (range v) = 0 := (erk_eq_zero_iff k).2 (by
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact hall i)
    rw [hv] at h0
    exact one_ne_zero h0
  have hone : ∀ {C : Set K} {x : K}, x ∉ racl k C → erk k C {x} = 1 := fun hx ↦
    le_antisymm ((erk_le_encard k _ _).trans_eq (encard_singleton _))
      (Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 fun h0 ↦ hx ((erk_singleton_eq_zero_iff k).1 h0))
  set x := coord k v i
  
  have htr : Transcendental K x := by
    rw [transcendental_iff]
    intro q hq
    by_contra hq0
    have hQ : Polynomial.aeval (X i : MvPolynomial ι K) q ∈ locusIdeal k v := by
      rw [← mk_eq_zero_iff, ← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply]
      exact hq
    set N := racl k (↑q.coeffs : Set K)
    have hNs : IsSmall k (N : Set K) := (IsSmall.of_finite q.coeffs.finite_toSet).racl
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hNs v
    obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀⟩ : q ∈ Polynomial.lifts (algebraMap N K) :=
      (Polynomial.lifts_iff_coeff_lifts q).2 fun n ↦ by
        by_cases hn : q.coeff n = 0
        · exact ⟨0, by rw [hn, map_zero]⟩
        · exact ⟨⟨q.coeff n, subset_racl k _ (Polynomial.coeff_mem_coeffs hn)⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [Polynomial.coe_mapRingHom] at hq₀
    have hmap : ∀ p : Polynomial N, Polynomial.aeval (X i : MvPolynomial ι K)
        (p.map (algebraMap N K)) =
          MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap N K) (Polynomial.aeval (X i) p) := by
      intro p
      induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
      | add p p' hp hp' => rw [Polynomial.map_add, map_add, hp, hp', map_add, map_add]
      | monomial n c => simp [Polynomial.aeval_monomial, MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
    rw [← hq₀, hmap, map_mem_locusIdeal_iff_aeval hy, ← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply,
      aeval_X] at hQ
    have hyi : y i ∈ N :=
      mem_racl_iff_exists_poly.2 ⟨q, hq0, by
        rw [← hq₀, Polynomial.eval_map_algebraMap]; exact hQ, fun n ↦ by
          by_cases hn : q.coeff n = 0
          · rw [hn]; exact zero_mem _
          · exact IntermediateField.subset_adjoin _ _ (Polynomial.coeff_mem_coeffs hn)⟩
    have hind := hy.indepOver.erk_eq (a := {y i}) (singleton_subset_iff.2 ⟨i, rfl⟩)
      (finite_singleton _)
    rw [empty_union, (erk_singleton_eq_zero_iff k).2 (subset_racl k _ hyi)] at hind
    have hvi : erk k ∅ ({y i} : Set K) = erk k ∅ {v i} := by
      have hid : idealOf k (fun _ : Unit ↦ y i) = idealOf k (fun _ : Unit ↦ v i) := by
        ext f
        rw [mem_idealOf_iff, mem_idealOf_iff]
        have hy' : aeval (fun _ : Unit ↦ y i) f = aeval y (rename (fun _ ↦ i) f) := by
          rw [aeval_rename]
          rfl
        have hv' : aeval (fun _ : Unit ↦ v i) f = aeval v (rename (fun _ ↦ i) f) := by
          rw [aeval_rename]
          rfl
        rw [hy', hv', ← mem_idealOf_iff k, ← mem_idealOf_iff k, hy.idealOf_eq]
      have h := erk_empty_range_eq_of_idealOf_eq (k := k) hid
      simpa [range_const] using h
    rw [hvi, hone hi] at hind
    exact zero_ne_one hind
  
  have hindx : AlgebraicIndependent K fun _ : Unit ↦ x :=
    algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff.2 htr
  have halg : ∀ j, IsIntegral (IntermediateField.adjoin K {x}) (coord k v j) := by
    intro j
    have hj : v j ∈ racl k ({v i} : Set K) := by
      by_contra hj
      have h2 := erk_union_eq k ∅ {v i} {v j}
      rw [hone hi, empty_union, hone hj] at h2
      have h3 := (erk_mono k ∅ (show {v i} ∪ {v j} ⊆ range v from
        union_subset (singleton_subset_iff.2 ⟨i, rfl⟩)
          (singleton_subset_iff.2 ⟨j, rfl⟩))).trans_eq hv
      rw [h2] at h3
      norm_num at h3
    
    have hdep : ¬ AlgebraicIndependent k fun o : Option Unit ↦ o.elim (v j) fun _ ↦ v i := by
      rw [AlgebraicIndependent.option_iff, range_const]
      rintro ⟨-, htr'⟩
      rw [← IntermediateField.transcendental_adjoin_iff] at htr'
      exact htr' ((mem_racl_iff k).1 hj)
    rw [algebraicIndependent_iff] at hdep
    push Not at hdep
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hP0⟩ := hdep
    set e : Option Unit → ι := fun o ↦ o.elim j fun _ ↦ i
    have hve : (fun o : Option Unit ↦ o.elim (v j) fun _ ↦ v i) = v ∘ e := by
      funext o
      cases o <;> rfl
    have hmem : MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) (rename e P) ∈ locusIdeal k v := by
      refine map_mem_locusIdeal k ((mem_idealOf_iff k).2 ?_)
      rw [aeval_rename, ← hve]
      exact hP
    have hdepK : ¬ AlgebraicIndependent K fun o : Option Unit ↦ o.elim (coord k v j)
        fun _ ↦ x := by
      rw [algebraicIndependent_iff]
      push Not
      refine ⟨MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) P, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [← mk_eq_zero_iff, ← aeval_coord, map_rename, aeval_rename] at hmem
        have hfam : (fun o : Option Unit ↦ o.elim (coord k v j) fun _ ↦ x) = coord k v ∘ e := by
          funext o
          cases o <;> rfl
        rw [hfam]
        exact hmem
      · exact fun h0 ↦ hP0 (MvPolynomial.map_injective _ (algebraMap k K).injective
          (h0.trans (map_zero _).symm))
    rw [AlgebraicIndependent.option_iff, not_and, range_const] at hdepK
    have hnt := hdepK hindx
    rw [← IntermediateField.transcendental_adjoin_iff, Transcendental, not_not] at hnt
    exact hnt.isIntegral
  
  refine ⟨x, htr, ?_⟩
  have htop : IntermediateField.adjoin (IntermediateField.adjoin K {x}) (range (coord k v)) =
      ⊤ := by
    rw [eq_top_iff]
    intro z _
    obtain ⟨A, B, -, rfl⟩ := exists_fraction z
    have hmk : ∀ P : MvPolynomial ι K, mk k v P ∈
        IntermediateField.adjoin (IntermediateField.adjoin K {x}) (range (coord k v)) := by
      intro P
      rw [← aeval_coord]
      have hP : aeval (coord k v) P ∈ Algebra.adjoin K (range (coord k v)) := by
        rw [Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_aeval]
        exact ⟨P, rfl⟩
      have hle : Algebra.adjoin K (range (coord k v)) ≤
          ((IntermediateField.adjoin (IntermediateField.adjoin K {x})
            (range (coord k v))).restrictScalars K).toSubalgebra := by
        rw [IntermediateField.restrictScalars_adjoin]
        exact (Algebra.adjoin_mono subset_union_right).trans
          (IntermediateField.algebra_adjoin_le_adjoin K _)
      exact hle hP
    exact div_mem (hmk A) (hmk B)
  have hfd : FiniteDimensional (IntermediateField.adjoin K {x})
      (IntermediateField.adjoin (IntermediateField.adjoin K {x}) (range (coord k v))) :=
    IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_adjoin fun _ ⟨j, hj⟩ ↦ hj ▸ halg j
  rw [htop] at hfd
  exact (IntermediateField.topEquiv.toLinearEquiv).finiteDimensional

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.exists_generator_moebius
statement:
theorem Germ.IsHW.exists_generator_moebius {g₀ : Germ k v v} (hw : Germ.IsHW g₀)
    (hv : erk k ∅ (range v) = 1) (hr : 2 ≤ erk k ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K)) :
    ∃ t : LocusFunctionField k v, Transcendental K t ∧
      IntermediateField.adjoin K ({t} : Set (LocusFunctionField k v)) = ⊤ ∧
      ∀ γ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup, ∃ a b c d : K, a * d - b * c ≠ 0 ∧
        algebraMap K _ c * t + algebraMap K _ d ≠ 0 ∧
        hw.functionFieldAction hv γ t * (algebraMap K _ c * t + algebraMap K _ d) =
          algebraMap K _ a * t + algebraMap K _ b
proof:
:= by
  let _ := LocusFunctionField.isFunctionFieldOneVar (k := k) (v := v) hv
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htop, hσ⟩ := exists_generator_moebius_of_genus_eq_zero
    (k := K) (F := LocusFunctionField k v) (hw.genus_eq_zero hv hr)
  exact ⟨t, ht, htop, fun γ ↦ hσ (hw.functionFieldAction hv γ)⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.cb_subset_racl_codeTuple
statement:
theorem cb_subset_racl_codeTuple (g : Germ k' b b') :
    (g.cb : Set K) ⊆ racl k' (range g.codeTuple)
proof:
:= by
  rw [racl_codeTuple]
  exact subset_racl k' _

name: GroupConfig.Germ.racl_codeTuple_map
statement:
theorem racl_codeTuple_map (σ : K ≃ₐ[k'] K) (g : Germ k' b b') :
    racl k' (range (g.map σ).codeTuple) = racl k' (range (⇑σ ∘ g.codeTuple))
proof:
:= by
  rw [racl_codeTuple, cb_map, range_comp, range_codeTuple, coe_map, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom,
    ← racl_map σ, ← racl_map σ, racl_codeSet]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.exists_diff_rep_indepOver
statement:
theorem exists_diff_rep_indepOver {f₀ : Germ k' b b'} {δ : Germ k' b b} (hδ : δ ∈ diffSet f₀)
    {w : Set K} (hw : IsSmall k' w) (h : IndepOver k' ∅ (δ.cb : Set K) w) :
    ∃ f₁ ∈ orbit f₀, ∃ f₂ ∈ orbit f₀, ∃ g₁ : Germ k' b' b, IsInverse g₁ f₁ ∧
      δ = Germ.comp g₁ f₂ ∧ IndepOver k' ∅ (f₁.cb : Set K) w ∧
      IndepOver k' ∅ (f₂.cb : Set K) w ∧ IndepOver k' w (f₁.cb : Set K) f₂.cb
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f₁, hf₁, f₂, hf₂, g₁, hg₁, hind, rfl⟩ := hδ
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k' ((Germ.comp g₁ f₂).cb : Set K)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  obtain ⟨ρ₀, hρ⟩ := exists_algEquiv_indepOver (Germ.comp g₁ f₂).isSmall_cb.racl
    (Sum.elim f₁.codeTuple f₂.codeTuple) hw
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρdef⟩ : ∃ τ : K ≃ₐ[k'] K, τ = ρ₀.restrictScalars k' := ⟨_, rfl⟩
                                  
  have hδfix : (Germ.comp g₁ f₂).map ρ = Germ.comp g₁ f₂ := by
    refine (Germ.map_eq_self_iff _ _).2 fun x hx ↦ ?_
    rw [hρdef]
    change ρ₀ x = x
    exact ρ₀.commutes ⟨x, subset_racl k' _ hx⟩
  have hfun : (fun i ↦ ρ₀ (Sum.elim f₁.codeTuple f₂.codeTuple i)) =
      Sum.elim (⇑ρ ∘ f₁.codeTuple) (⇑ρ ∘ f₂.codeTuple) := by
    rw [hρdef]
    funext i
    cases i <;> rfl
  have hrange : racl k' (range fun i ↦ ρ₀ (Sum.elim f₁.codeTuple f₂.codeTuple i)) =
      racl k' (((f₁.map ρ).cb : Set K) ∪ (f₂.map ρ).cb) := by
    rw [hfun, Sum.elim_range]
    exact (racl_union_congr (racl_codeTuple_map ρ f₁).symm (racl_codeTuple_map ρ f₂).symm).trans
      (racl_union_congr (racl_codeTuple _) (racl_codeTuple _))
  have hpair : IndepOver k' ((Germ.comp g₁ f₂).cb : Set K)
      (((f₁.map ρ).cb : Set K) ∪ (f₂.map ρ).cb) w :=
    (indepOver_congr_left (racl_union_congr rfl hrange).symm).1
      ((indepOver_racl_base_iff _ _ _).1 hρ)
                                                                       
  have hδ' : Germ.comp g₁ f₂ = Germ.comp (g₁.map ρ) (f₂.map ρ) := by
    rw [← Germ.comp_map, hδfix]
  have hind' : IndepOver k' ∅ ((f₁.map ρ).cb : Set K) (f₂.map ρ).cb := by
    have h' := hind.image ρ
    rwa [image_empty, ← AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, ← coe_map, ← coe_map, ← cb_map, ← cb_map] at h'
  have hE : IndepOver k' ∅ w
      (((Germ.comp g₁ f₂).cb : Set K) ∪ (((f₁.map ρ).cb : Set K) ∪ (f₂.map ρ).cb)) :=
    indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨h.symm, by rw [empty_union]; exact hpair.symm⟩
  have hC : IndepOver k' ∅ (((f₁.map ρ).cb : Set K) ∪ (f₂.map ρ).cb) w :=
    (hE.mono_right subset_union_right).symm
  have hC₁₂ : IndepOver k' w ((f₁.map ρ).cb : Set K) (f₂.map ρ).cb := by
    have h1 := IndepOver.of_union_right hC.symm
    rw [empty_union] at h1
    have h2 : IndepOver k' ∅ ((f₁.map ρ).cb : Set K) (((f₂.map ρ).cb : Set K) ∪ w) :=
      indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨hind', by rw [empty_union]; exact h1.symm⟩
    rw [union_comm] at h2
    have h3 := (indepOver_union_right_iff.1 h2).2
    rwa [empty_union] at h3
  exact ⟨f₁.map ρ, map_mem_orbit hf₁ ρ, f₂.map ρ, map_mem_orbit hf₂ ρ, g₁.map ρ, hg₁.map ρ, hδ',
    hC.mono_left subset_union_left, hC.mono_left subset_union_right, hC₁₂⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.image_coe_restrictBase
statement:
theorem image_coe_restrictBase (σ : K ≃ₐ[↥K₁] K) :
    ⇑(restrictBase K₀ K₁ h₀₁ σ) '' (K₁ : Set K) = K₁
proof:
:= by
  have hfix : ∀ x ∈ (K₁ : Set K), restrictBase K₀ K₁ h₀₁ σ x = x := fun x hx ↦ by
    rw [coe_restrictBase]
    exact σ.commutes ⟨x, hx⟩
  ext w
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [hfix x hx]
    exact hx
  · intro hw
    exact ⟨w, hw, hfix w hw⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.indepOver_cb_map_restrictBase
proof:
:= by
  have h' := h.image (restrictBase K₀ K₁ h₀₁ σ)
  rwa [image_empty, image_coe_restrictBase, ← AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom, ← coe_map, ← cb_map] at h'

name: GroupConfig.Germ.baseChange_injective
statement: theorem baseChange_injective : Function.Injective (baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha')
proof:
:=
  fun g g' h ↦ graphIdeal_injective
    (by rw [← graphIdeal_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' g, h, graphIdeal_baseChange])

name: GroupConfig.Germ.exists_restrictBase_map_eq
statement:
theorem exists_restrictBase_map_eq {g₀ : Germ (↥K₀) a a'}
    (h₀ : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K) (K₁ : Set K)) (σ : K ≃ₐ[↥K₀] K)
    (h : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ ((g₀.map σ).cb : Set K) (K₁ : Set K)) :
    ∃ τ : K ≃ₐ[↥K₁] K, g₀.map σ = g₀.map (restrictBase K₀ K₁ h₀₁ τ)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hc₀ : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range g₀.codeTuple) (K₁ : Set K) := by
    rw [range_codeTuple]
    exact indepOver_of_subset_racl (codeSet_subset_racl_cb g₀) (subset_racl (↥K₀) _) h₀
  have hσc₀ : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range (⇑σ ∘ g₀.codeTuple)) (K₁ : Set K) := by
    refine indepOver_of_subset_racl ?_ (subset_racl (↥K₀) _) h
    rw [range_comp, range_codeTuple, cb_map, coe_map, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom]
    have e : ⇑σ '' (racl (↥K₀) (g₀.cb : Set K) : Set K) = racl (↥K₀) (⇑σ '' (g₀.cb : Set K)) := by
      rw [← racl_map σ, coe_map, AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom]
    exact (image_mono (codeSet_subset_racl_cb g₀)).trans e.subset
  have hgen₁ : IsGenericOver (racl (↥K₀) (K₁ : Set K)) g₀.codeTuple g₀.codeTuple :=
    IsGen.isGenericOver_racl (rfl : IsGen (↥K₀) g₀.codeTuple g₀.codeTuple) hK₁ hc₀
  have hgen₂ : IsGenericOver (racl (↥K₀) (K₁ : Set K)) g₀.codeTuple (⇑σ ∘ g₀.codeTuple) :=
    (IsGen.map (rfl : IsGen (↥K₀) g₀.codeTuple g₀.codeTuple) σ).isGenericOver_racl hK₁ hσc₀
  obtain ⟨τ₀, hτ⟩ := hgen₁.exists_algEquiv hgen₂
  have hsub : range (algebraMap (↥K₁) K) ⊆
      range (algebraMap (↥(racl (↥K₀) (K₁ : Set K))) K) := by
    rw [range_algebraMap_coe, range_algebraMap_coe, coe_racl_base_self K₀ K₁ h₀₁]
  refine ⟨algEquivRestrict hsub τ₀, ?_⟩
  have hfix : g₀.map (σ.trans (restrictBase K₀ K₁ h₀₁ (algEquivRestrict hsub τ₀)).symm) = g₀ := by
    refine map_eq_self_of_fixes_codeSet _ fun x hx ↦ ?_
    change (restrictBase K₀ K₁ h₀₁ (algEquivRestrict hsub τ₀)).symm (σ x) = x
    have hx' := hτ ⟨x, hx⟩
    change τ₀ x = σ x at hx'
    rw [← hx']
    exact (restrictBase K₀ K₁ h₀₁ (algEquivRestrict hsub τ₀)).symm_apply_apply x
  have hcomp : (σ.trans (restrictBase K₀ K₁ h₀₁ (algEquivRestrict hsub τ₀)).symm).trans
      (restrictBase K₀ K₁ h₀₁ (algEquivRestrict hsub τ₀)) = σ :=
    AlgEquiv.ext fun x ↦ by simp
  rw [← hcomp, ← map_map, hfix]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.baseChange_mem_orbit
statement:
theorem baseChange_mem_orbit {g₀ g : Germ (↥K₀) a a'}
    (h₀ : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K) (K₁ : Set K)) (hg : g ∈ orbit g₀)
    (h : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (g.cb : Set K) (K₁ : Set K)) :
    g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' ∈ orbit (g₀.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := hg
  dsimp only at h ⊢
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := exists_restrictBase_map_eq K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ h₀ σ h
  rw [hτ, map_baseChange]
  exact map_mem_orbit (self_mem_orbit _) τ

name: GroupConfig.Germ.exists_of_mem_orbit_baseChange
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨τ, rfl⟩ := hf
  exact ⟨g₀.map (restrictBase K₀ K₁ h₀₁ τ), map_mem_orbit (self_mem_orbit _) _,
    indepOver_cb_map_restrictBase K₀ K₁ h₀₁ h₀ τ, map_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' g₀ τ⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.baseChange_mem_diffSet
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f₁, hf₁, f₂, hf₂, g₁, hg₁, rfl, hC₁, hC₂, hC₁₂⟩ := exists_diff_rep_indepOver hδ hK₁ h
  have hind : IndepOver (↥K₁) ∅ ((f₁.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').cb : Set K)
      ((f₂.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').cb : Set K) :=
    (indepOver_congr₀ (racl_cb_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' f₁).symm rfl).1
      ((indepOver_cb_baseChange_iff K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' f₂ _).2 hC₁₂)
  rw [comp_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' ha g₁ f₂]
  exact ⟨_, baseChange_mem_orbit K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' h₀ hf₁ hC₁, _,
    baseChange_mem_orbit K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' h₀ hf₂ hC₂, _,
    hg₁.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha', hind, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.exists_of_mem_diffSet_baseChange
statement:
theorem exists_of_mem_diffSet_baseChange {f₀ : Germ (↥K₀) a a'} (hf₀ : IsInvertible f₀)
    (h₀ : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (f₀.cb : Set K) (K₁ : Set K)) {δ : Germ (↥K₁) a a}
    (hδ : δ ∈ diffSet (f₀.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha')) :
    ∃ δ₀ ∈ diffSet f₀, IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (δ₀.cb : Set K) (K₁ : Set K) ∧
      δ₀.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha = δ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂⟩ := diffSet_nonempty hf₀
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hδ₁K⟩ := exists_mem_orbit_indepOver δ₂ hK₁
  rw [← diffSet_eq_orbit hδ₂] at hδ₁
  have hδ₁' := baseChange_mem_diffSet K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' h₀ hδ₁ hδ₁K
  rw [diffSet_eq_orbit hδ₁'] at hδ
  obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, hδ₀K, rfl⟩ := exists_of_mem_orbit_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha hδ₁K hδ
  exact ⟨δ₀, by rwa [diffSet_eq_orbit hδ₁], hδ₀K, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.erk_base_le
statement: theorem erk_base_le (X : Set K) : erk (↥K₁) ∅ X = erk (↥K₀) (K₁ : Set K) X
proof:
:= by
  rw [erk_base_empty K₁, ← erk_coe_union K₀, union_eq_right.2 (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 h₀₁)]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.erk_cb_baseChange
proof:
:= by
  rw [erk_base_le K₀ K₁ h₀₁, coe_cb_baseChange, erk_adjoin_eq (k := ↥K₀), union_comm,
    erk_union_eq_of_subset_racl (↥K₀) (fun w hw ↦ subset_racl (↥K₀) _ (Or.inl hw))]
  have := erk_cb_eq_of_indepOver hg
  rwa [empty_union] at this

name: GroupConfig.Germ.trans_baseChange
statement:
theorem trans_baseChange {f₀ : Germ (↥K₀) a a'}
    (htrans : ∀ g ∈ orbit f₀, ∀ y : ι → K, IsGen (↥K₀) a y →
      IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range y) (g.cb : Set K) →
        IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range (g.evalGen y)) (range y))
    (h₀ : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (f₀.cb : Set K) (K₁ : Set K))
    {f : Germ (↥K₁) a a'} (hf : f ∈ orbit (f₀.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha')) {y : ι → K}
    (hy : IsGen (↥K₁) a y) (hind : IndepOver (↥K₁) ∅ (range y) (f.cb : Set K)) :
    IndepOver (↥K₁) ∅ (range (f.evalGen y)) (range y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgK, rfl⟩ := exists_of_mem_orbit_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' h₀ hf
  have hyk := (isGen_base_iff K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha).1 hy
  have hyg : IndepOver (↥K₀) (K₁ : Set K) (range y) (g.cb : Set K) :=
    (indepOver_cb_baseChange_iff K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' g _).1 hind
  have hyKg : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range y) ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ g.cb) :=
    indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨hyk.2, by rw [empty_union]; exact hyg⟩
  have hyg₀ : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range y) (g.cb : Set K) := hyKg.mono_right subset_union_right
  have htrans := htrans g hg y hyk.1 hyg₀
  rw [evalGen_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' g hy hind, indepOver_base_le_iff K₀ K₁ h₀₁]
                                                     
  have hK : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (K₁ : Set K) ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ range y) := by
    refine indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨hgK.symm, ?_⟩
    rw [empty_union]
    have h1 := IndepOver.of_union_right hyKg
    rw [empty_union] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  have hsub : range (g.evalGen y) ∪ range y ⊆
      racl (↥K₀) (∅ ∪ ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ range y)) := by
    rw [empty_union]
    refine union_subset ?_ (fun w hw ↦ subset_racl (↥K₀) _ (Or.inr hw))
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact g.evalGen_mem_racl hyk.1 hyg₀ j
  have hK' : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (K₁ : Set K) (∅ ∪ (range (g.evalGen y) ∪ range y)) := by
    rw [empty_union]
    exact (indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hK).mono_right hsub
  have := (indepOver_base_union_iff hK').1 htrans
  rwa [empty_union] at this

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.baseChange
statement:
theorem IsHWBij.baseChange {f₀ : Germ (↥K₀) a a'} (hb : IsHWBij f₀)
    (h₀ : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (f₀.cb : Set K) (K₁ : Set K)) :
    IsHWBij (f₀.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha')
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hb.isInvertible.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha',
    fun f hf y hy hind ↦ trans_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' hb.trans h₀ hf hy hind, ?_⟩
                                                                
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁⟩ := diffSet_nonempty hb.isInvertible
  obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, hδ₀K⟩ := exists_mem_orbit_indepOver δ₁ hK₁
  rw [← diffSet_eq_orbit hδ₁] at hδ₀
  refine IsHWBij.rank_of_exists (baseChange_mem_diffSet K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' h₀ hδ₀ hδ₀K) ?_
  rw [erk_cb_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha hδ₀K, erk_cb_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' h₀]
  exact hb.rank δ₀ hδ₀

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.baseChange
statement:
theorem IsHW.baseChange {g₀ : Germ (↥K₀) a a} (hw : IsHW g₀)
    (h₀ : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (g₀.cb : Set K) (K₁ : Set K)) :
    IsHW (g₀.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun f hf y hy hind ↦ trans_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha hw.trans h₀ hf hy hind,
    ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨g₀', hg₀'⟩ := isUnit_iff.1 hw.isUnit
    exact isUnit_iff.2 ⟨_, hg₀'.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha⟩
  · intro f hf h hh
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hgK, rfl⟩ := exists_of_mem_orbit_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha h₀ hf
    obtain ⟨g', hg'⟩ := isUnit_iff.1 (hw.isUnit_of_mem hg)
    rw [hh.unique (hg'.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha)]
    exact baseChange_mem_orbit K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha h₀ (hw.inv g hg g' hg')
      (indepOver_of_cb_le hg'.cb_le hgK)
  · intro f₁ hf₁ f₂ hf₂ hind
    obtain ⟨g₁, hg₁, hg₁K, rfl⟩ := exists_of_mem_orbit_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha h₀ hf₁
    obtain ⟨g₂, hg₂, -, rfl⟩ := exists_of_mem_orbit_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha h₀ hf₂
    have h12 : IndepOver (↥K₀) (K₁ : Set K) (g₁.cb : Set K) g₂.cb :=
      (indepOver_cb_baseChange_iff K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha g₂ _).1
        ((indepOver_congr₀ (racl_cb_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha g₁) rfl).1 hind)
    have h1 : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (g₁.cb : Set K) ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ g₂.cb) :=
      indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨hg₁K, by rwa [empty_union]⟩
    obtain ⟨hmem, hK⟩ := hw.keyrank (hw.mem_prodSet_of_mem hg₂) hg₁ (by rwa [union_comm] at h1)
    rw [mul_def, ← comp_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha ha g₁ g₂, ← mul_def]
    exact baseChange_mem_orbit K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha h₀ hmem hK

name: GroupConfig.aeval_map_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem aeval_map_of_comp_eq (φ : L →+* L') (hφ : (algebraMap L' K).comp φ = algebraMap L K)
    (u : ι → K) (P : MvPolynomial ι L) : aeval u (MvPolynomial.map φ P) = aeval u P
proof:
:= by
  rw [aeval_def, aeval_def, eval₂_map, hφ]

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isDefinedAt_map_iff_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem QuasiRational.isDefinedAt_map_iff_of_comp_eq (φ : L →+* L')
    (hφ : (algebraMap L' K).comp φ = algebraMap L K) (f : QuasiRational L ι κ) (u : ι → K) :
    (f.map φ).IsDefinedAt u ↔ f.IsDefinedAt u
proof:
:= by
  unfold QuasiRational.IsDefinedAt
  simp only [QuasiRational.map]
  exact forall_congr' fun j ↦ by rw [aeval_map_of_comp_eq φ hφ]

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.eval_map_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem QuasiRational.eval_map_of_comp_eq [PerfectField K] (φ : L →+* L')
    (hφ : (algebraMap L' K).comp φ = algebraMap L K) (f : QuasiRational L ι κ) (u : ι → K) :
    (f.map φ).eval u = f.eval u
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  simp only [QuasiRational.eval, QuasiRational.map, aeval_map_of_comp_eq φ hφ]

name: GroupConfig.coe_algEquivRestrict
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_algEquivRestrict (h : range (algebraMap L K) ⊆ range (algebraMap L' K))
    (σ : K ≃ₐ[L'] K) : ⇑(algEquivRestrict h σ) = ⇑σ
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.algebraMap_comp_inclBase
statement:
theorem algebraMap_comp_inclBase (M : IntermediateField k₀ K) (N : IntermediateField k₁ K)
    (h : (M : Set K) ⊆ N) : (algebraMap (↥N) K).comp (inclBase M N h) = algebraMap (↥M) K
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.coe_restrictBase
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_restrictBase (σ : K ≃ₐ[↥K₁] K) : ⇑(restrictBase K₀ K₁ h₀₁ σ) = ⇑σ
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.isSmall_base_of_coe_eq
statement:
theorem isSmall_base_of_coe_eq {F : IntermediateField (↥K₀) K} (hF : IsSmall (↥K₀) (F : Set K))
    {F'' : IntermediateField (↥K₁) K} (h : (F'' : Set K) = (F : Set K)) :
    IsSmall (↥K₁) (F'' : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsSmall at hF ⊢
  rw [erk_base_empty K₁, h]
  rw [erk_base_empty K₀] at hF
  exact fun htop ↦ hF (eq_top_iff.2 (htop ▸ erk_base_mono k h₀₁ _))

name: GroupConfig.isSmall_base_mono
statement: theorem isSmall_base_mono {C : Set K} (hC : IsSmall (↥K₀) C) : IsSmall (↥K₁) C
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsSmall at hC ⊢
  rw [erk_base_empty K₁]
  rw [erk_base_empty K₀] at hC
  exact fun htop ↦ hC (eq_top_iff.2 (htop ▸ erk_base_mono k h₀₁ _))

name: GroupConfig.indepOver_base_le_iff
statement:
theorem indepOver_base_le_iff (A B : Set K) :
    IndepOver (↥K₁) ∅ A B ↔ IndepOver (↥K₀) (K₁ : Set K) A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [indepOver_base_iff K₁, ← indepOver_coe_union_iff K₀,
    union_eq_right.2 (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 h₀₁)]

name: GroupConfig.coe_racl_base_self
statement:
theorem coe_racl_base_self : ((racl (↥K₀) (K₁ : Set K) : IntermediateField (↥K₀) K) : Set K) =
    (K₁ : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have h : racl k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ K₁) = K₁ :=
    le_antisymm (racl_le_of_isAlgClosed (union_subset h₀₁ le_rfl))
      (fun w hw ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hw))
  rw [racl_base_coe K₀, h]

name: GroupConfig.coe_racl_base_of_le
statement:
theorem coe_racl_base_of_le (F : IntermediateField (↥K₀) K) [IsAlgClosed (↥F)]
    (hK₁F : (K₁ : Set K) ⊆ F) :
    ((racl (↥K₁) (F : Set K) : IntermediateField (↥K₁) K) : Set K) = (F : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have h : racl (↥K₀) ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ F) = F :=
    le_antisymm (racl_le_of_isAlgClosed (union_subset hK₁F le_rfl))
      (fun w hw ↦ subset_racl (↥K₀) _ (Or.inr hw))
  rw [racl_base_coe K₁, ← union_eq_right.2 (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 h₀₁), union_assoc,
    ← racl_base_coe K₀, h]

name: GroupConfig.coe_racl_base_eq
statement:
theorem coe_racl_base_eq (S : Set K) :
    ((racl (↥K₁) S : IntermediateField (↥K₁) K) : Set K) =
      ((racl (↥K₀) ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ S) : IntermediateField (↥K₀) K) : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [racl_base_coe K₁, racl_base_coe K₀, ← union_assoc,
    union_eq_right.2 (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 h₀₁)]

name: GroupConfig.locusIdeal_coe_eq
statement: theorem locusIdeal_coe_eq : locusIdeal (↥K₁) a = locusIdeal (↥K₀) a
proof:
:= by
  have hind : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range a)
      ((racl (↥K₀) (K₁ : Set K) : IntermediateField (↥K₀) K) : Set K) := by
    have h := indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 ha
    rwa [empty_union] at h
  have haa : IsGenericOver (racl (↥K₀) (K₁ : Set K)) a a :=
    isGenericOver_self_of_indepOver hK₁.racl hind
  rw [← haa.locusIdeal_eq]
  exact locusIdeal_congr _ (by rw [range_algebraMap_coe, range_algebraMap_coe,
    coe_racl_base_self K₀ K₁ h₀₁]) a

name: GroupConfig.isGenericOver_base_iff
proof:
:= by
  rw [isGenericOver_iff_locusIdeal_eq, isGenericOver_iff_locusIdeal_eq,
    locusIdeal_coe_eq K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha, locusIdeal_congr (↥N) (L' := ↥M)
      (by rw [range_algebraMap_coe, range_algebraMap_coe, hNM]) y]

name: GroupConfig.isGen_iff_locusIdeal_eq
statement:
theorem isGen_iff_locusIdeal_eq (L : Type*) [Field L] [Algebra L K] {y : ι → K} :
    IsGen L a y ↔ locusIdeal L y = locusIdeal L a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    unfold locusIdeal
    rw [h]
  · intro h
    unfold IsGen
    rw [← locusIdeal_comap L y, ← locusIdeal_comap L a, h]

name: GroupConfig.isGen_base_iff
statement:
theorem isGen_base_iff {y : ι → K} :
    IsGen (↥K₁) a y ↔ IsGen (↥K₀) a y ∧ IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range y) (K₁ : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have hind : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range a)
      ((racl (↥K₀) (K₁ : Set K) : IntermediateField (↥K₀) K) : Set K) := by
    have h := indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 ha
    rwa [empty_union] at h
  have haa : IsGenericOver (racl (↥K₀) (K₁ : Set K)) a a :=
    isGenericOver_self_of_indepOver hK₁.racl hind
  have hcongr : ∀ u : ι → K, locusIdeal (↥K₁) u = locusIdeal (↥(racl (↥K₀) (K₁ : Set K))) u :=
    fun u ↦ locusIdeal_congr _ (by rw [range_algebraMap_coe, range_algebraMap_coe,
      coe_racl_base_self K₀ K₁ h₀₁]) u
  have e1 : IsGen (↥K₁) a y ↔ IsGenericOver (racl (↥K₀) (K₁ : Set K)) a y := by
    rw [isGen_iff_locusIdeal_eq, isGenericOver_iff_locusIdeal_eq, ← haa.locusIdeal_eq, hcongr y,
      hcongr a]
  rw [e1]
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨h.isGen, ?_⟩
    have := h.indepOver
    rwa [coe_racl_base_self K₀ K₁ h₀₁] at this
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact h1.isGenericOver_racl hK₁ h2

name: GroupConfig.Representative.coe_racl_base_M
statement:
theorem coe_racl_base_M (h₀₁ : K₀ ≤ K₁) (r : Representative (↥K₀) K a a') :
    ((racl (↥K₁) (r.M : Set K) : IntermediateField (↥K₁) K) : Set K) =
      ((racl (↥K₀) ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ r.M) : IntermediateField (↥K₀) K) : Set K)
proof:
:=
  coe_racl_base_eq K₀ K₁ h₀₁ _

name: GroupConfig.Representative.M_le_racl_union
statement:
theorem M_le_racl_union (r : Representative (↥K₀) K a a') :
    r.M ≤ racl (↥K₀) ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ r.M)
proof:
:=
  fun _ hw ↦ subset_racl (↥K₀) _ (Or.inr hw)

name: GroupConfig.Representative.M_subset_racl_base
statement:
theorem M_subset_racl_base (h₀₁ : K₀ ≤ K₁) (r : Representative (↥K₀) K a a') :
    (r.M : Set K) ⊆ racl (↥K₁) (r.M : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_racl_base_M K₀ K₁ h₀₁]
  exact M_le_racl_union K₀ K₁ r

name: GroupConfig.Representative.isGenericOver_M_of_racl_base
statement:
theorem isGenericOver_M_of_racl_base (r : Representative (↥K₀) K a a') {y : ι → K}
    (hy : IsGenericOver (racl (↥K₁) (r.M : Set K)) a y) : IsGenericOver r.M a y
proof:
:=
  ((isGenericOver_base_iff K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha (coe_racl_base_M K₀ K₁ h₀₁ r)).1 hy).of_le
    (M_le_racl_union K₀ K₁ r)

name: GroupConfig.Representative.indepOver_racl_union_of_racl_base
statement:
theorem indepOver_racl_union_of_racl_base (r : Representative (↥K₀) K a a') {y : ι → K}
    (hy : IsGenericOver (racl (↥K₁) (r.M : Set K)) a y) :
    IndepOver (↥K₀) (r.M : Set K) (range y)
      ((racl (↥K₀) ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ r.M) : IntermediateField (↥K₀) K) : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have _ := r.isAlgClosed
  exact ((isGenericOver_M_of_racl_base K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha r hy).isGenericOver_iff_indepOver
    r.isSmall (hK₁.union r.isSmall).racl (M_le_racl_union K₀ K₁ r)).1
    ((isGenericOver_base_iff K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha (coe_racl_base_M K₀ K₁ h₀₁ r)).1 hy)

name: GroupConfig.Representative.isGenericOver_eval_racl_base
proof:
:= by
  have _ := r.isAlgClosed
