  have hyM : IsGenericOver r.M a y := isGenericOver_M_of_racl_base K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha r hy
  have hz := r.isGenericOver y hyM
  refine (isGenericOver_base_iff K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha' (coe_racl_base_M K₀ K₁ h₀₁ r)).2 ?_
  refine (hz.isGenericOver_iff_indepOver r.isSmall (hK₁.union r.isSmall).racl
    (M_le_racl_union K₀ K₁ r)).2 ?_
  refine (indepOver_racl_left_iff.2
    (indepOver_racl_union_of_racl_base K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha r hy)).mono_left ?_
  rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
  exact r.eval_mem_racl hyM j

name: GroupConfig.Representative.isDefinedAt_map_inclBase
proof:
:=
  QuasiRational.isDefinedAt_map_iff_of_comp_eq (inclBase r.M N h)
    (algebraMap_comp_inclBase r.M N h) r.f u

name: GroupConfig.Representative.eval_map_inclBase
proof:
:=
  QuasiRational.eval_map_of_comp_eq (inclBase r.M N h) (algebraMap_comp_inclBase r.M N h) r.f u

name: GroupConfig.Representative.baseChange_M
statement:
theorem baseChange_M (r : Representative (↥K₀) K a a') :
    (r.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').M = racl (↥K₁) (r.M : Set K)
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Representative.baseChange_eval
statement:
theorem baseChange_eval (r : Representative (↥K₀) K a a') (u : ι → K) :
    (r.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').f.eval u = r.f.eval u
proof:
:=
  eval_map_inclBase K₀ K₁ r (M_subset_racl_base K₀ K₁ h₀₁ r) u

name: GroupConfig.Representative.Equivalent.baseChange
statement:
theorem Equivalent.baseChange {r r' : Representative (↥K₀) K a a'} (h : r.Equivalent r') :
    (r.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').Equivalent (r'.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha')
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  rw [baseChange_eval, baseChange_eval]
  refine h y ?_
  have hy' := (isGenericOver_base_iff K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha (coe_racl_base_eq K₀ K₁ h₀₁ _)).1 hy
  refine hy'.of_le (racl_mono (k := ↥K₀) ?_)
  refine union_subset (fun w hw ↦ Or.inr (Or.inl ?_)) (fun w hw ↦ Or.inr (Or.inr ?_))
  · exact M_subset_racl_base K₀ K₁ h₀₁ r hw
  · exact M_subset_racl_base K₀ K₁ h₀₁ r' hw

name: GroupConfig.Representative.graphIdeal_baseChange
statement:
theorem graphIdeal_baseChange (r : Representative (↥K₀) K a a') :
    (r.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').graphIdeal = r.graphIdeal
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨rb, hrb⟩ : ∃ rb, rb = r.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨re, hre⟩ : ∃ re, re = r.extend (isAlgClosed_racl _) (hK₁.union r.isSmall).racl
      (M_le_racl_union K₀ K₁ r) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hrbM : (rb.M : Set K) = ((racl (↥K₀) ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ r.M) :
      IntermediateField (↥K₀) K) : Set K) := by
    rw [hrb]
    exact coe_racl_base_M K₀ K₁ h₀₁ r
  have hreM : re.M = racl (↥K₀) ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ r.M) := by
    rw [hre]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver (k := ↥K₁) rb.isSmall a
  have hy₁ : IsGenericOver re.M a y := by
    rw [hreM]
    exact (isGenericOver_base_iff K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha hrbM).1 hy
  have e1 : rb.graphIdeal = locusIdeal (↥rb.M) (rb.graphPoint y) :=
    Representative.graphIdeal_eq rb hy
  have e2 : re.graphIdeal = r.graphIdeal := by
    rw [hre]
    exact graphIdeal_eq_of_equivalent (r.extend_equivalent _ _ _)
  have e3 : re.graphIdeal = locusIdeal (↥re.M) (re.graphPoint y) :=
    Representative.graphIdeal_eq re hy₁
  have hpt : rb.graphPoint y = re.graphPoint y := by
    unfold graphPoint
    rw [hrb, hre, baseChange_eval, extend_eval]
  rw [← hrb, ← e2, e1, e3, hpt]
  exact locusIdeal_congr _ (by rw [range_algebraMap_coe, range_algebraMap_coe, hrbM, hreM]) _

name: GroupConfig.Germ.baseChange_mk
statement:
theorem baseChange_mk (r : Representative (↥K₀) K a a') :
    Germ.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' (⟦r⟧ : Germ (↥K₀) a a') =
      ⟦r.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha'⟧
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.graphIdeal_baseChange
statement:
theorem graphIdeal_baseChange (g : Germ (↥K₀) a a') :
    (g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').graphIdeal = g.graphIdeal
proof:
:= by
  induction g using Quotient.inductionOn with
  | h r => exact Representative.graphIdeal_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' r

name: GroupConfig.Germ.codeSet_baseChange
statement:
theorem codeSet_baseChange (g : Germ (↥K₀) a a') :
    (g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').codeSet = g.codeSet
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun I ↦ Classical.choose (exists_finset_closure_eq_idealFod I))
    (graphIdeal_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' g)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.cb_baseChange
statement:
theorem cb_baseChange (g : Germ (↥K₀) a a') :
    (g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').cb = adjoin (↥K₁) (idealFod g.graphIdeal : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  unfold cb
  rw [graphIdeal_baseChange]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.coe_cb_baseChange
statement:
theorem coe_cb_baseChange (g : Germ (↥K₀) a a') :
    ((g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').cb : Set K) =
      ((adjoin (↥K₀) ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ g.cb) : IntermediateField (↥K₀) K) : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cb_baseChange, coe_adjoin_base, coe_adjoin_base]
  congr 1
  have hcb : (g.cb : Set K) = ((adjoin k ((K₀ : Set K) ∪ (idealFod g.graphIdeal : Set K)) :
      IntermediateField k K) : Set K) := coe_adjoin_base K₀ _
  rw [hcb]
  refine le_antisymm (adjoin_le_iff.2 (union_subset ?_ ?_)) (adjoin_le_iff.2 (union_subset ?_ ?_))
  · exact fun w hw ↦ subset_adjoin k _ (Or.inr (Or.inl hw))
  · exact fun w hw ↦ subset_adjoin k _ (Or.inr (Or.inr (subset_adjoin k _ (Or.inr hw))))
  · exact fun w hw ↦ subset_adjoin k _ (Or.inl (h₀₁ hw))
  · refine union_subset (fun w hw ↦ subset_adjoin k _ (Or.inl hw)) (adjoin_le_iff.2 ?_)
    exact union_subset (fun w hw ↦ subset_adjoin k _ (Or.inl (h₀₁ hw)))
      (fun w hw ↦ subset_adjoin k _ (Or.inr hw))

name: GroupConfig.Germ.racl_cb_baseChange
statement:
theorem racl_cb_baseChange (g : Germ (↥K₀) a a') :
    racl (↥K₁) ((g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').cb : Set K) = racl (↥K₁) (g.cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  refine SetLike.coe_injective ?_
  rw [coe_racl_base_eq K₀ K₁ h₀₁, coe_racl_base_eq K₀ K₁ h₀₁, coe_cb_baseChange,
    racl_union_adjoin, ← union_assoc, union_self]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.indepOver_cb_baseChange_iff
statement:
theorem indepOver_cb_baseChange_iff (g : Germ (↥K₀) a a') (W : Set K) :
    IndepOver (↥K₁) ∅ W ((g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').cb : Set K) ↔
      IndepOver (↥K₀) (K₁ : Set K) W (g.cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : IndepOver (↥K₁) ∅ W ((g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').cb : Set K) ↔
      IndepOver (↥K₁) ∅ W (g.cb : Set K) := by
    rw [← indepOver_racl_right_iff (C := ∅) (B := ((g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').cb : Set K)),
      ← indepOver_racl_right_iff (C := ∅) (B := (g.cb : Set K)), empty_union, empty_union,
      racl_cb_baseChange]
  rw [h1, indepOver_base_le_iff K₀ K₁ h₀₁]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.eval_baseChange
statement:
theorem eval_baseChange (g : Germ (↥K₀) a a') {F : IntermediateField (↥K₀) K} [IsAlgClosed (↥F)]
    (hF : IsSmall (↥K₀) (F : Set K)) (hK₁F : (K₁ : Set K) ⊆ F) (hcb : g.cb ≤ F)
    {F'' : IntermediateField (↥K₁) K} [IsAlgClosed (↥F'')] (hF'' : (F'' : Set K) = (F : Set K))
    {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGenericOver F a y) :
    (g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').eval F'' y = g.eval F y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl, hrM⟩ := g.exists_rep_M_eq hF hcb
  have hM'' : (r.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').M = F'' := by
    refine SetLike.coe_injective ?_
    rw [Representative.baseChange_M, hrM, coe_racl_base_of_le K₀ K₁ h₀₁ F hK₁F, hF'']
  have hyr : IsGenericOver r.M a y := by
    rw [hrM]
    exact hy
  have hy'' : IsGenericOver (r.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').M a y := by
    rw [hM'']
    exact (isGenericOver_base_iff K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha hF'').2 hy
  have hcb'' : Germ.cb (⟦r.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha'⟧ : Germ (↥K₁) a a') ≤ F'' := by
    have e : Germ.cb (⟦r.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha'⟧ : Germ (↥K₁) a a') =
        adjoin (↥K₁) (idealFod (Germ.graphIdeal (⟦r⟧ : Germ (↥K₀) a a')) : Set K) :=
      cb_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' ⟦r⟧
    rw [e, adjoin_le_iff]
    intro w hw
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, ← SetLike.mem_coe, hF'']
    exact hcb (subset_adjoin (↥K₀) _ hw)
  rw [baseChange_mk, eval_eq_rep (r.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha')
    (isSmall_base_of_coe_eq K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hF hF'') hcb'' hM''.ge hy'', eval_eq_rep r hF hcb hrM.ge hyr]
  exact Representative.baseChange_eval K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' r y

name: GroupConfig.Germ.evalGen_baseChange
statement:
theorem evalGen_baseChange (g : Germ (↥K₀) a a') {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen (↥K₁) a y)
    (hind : IndepOver (↥K₁) ∅ (range y) ((g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').cb : Set K)) :
    (g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').evalGen y = g.evalGen y
proof:
:= by
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl (↥K₀) ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ g.cb)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl (↥K₁) ((g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').cb : Set K)) :=
    isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hF : IsSmall (↥K₀) ((racl (↥K₀) ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ g.cb) :
      IntermediateField (↥K₀) K) : Set K) := (hK₁.union g.isSmall_cb).racl
  have hcb : g.cb ≤ racl (↥K₀) ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ g.cb) :=
    fun w hw ↦ subset_racl (↥K₀) _ (Or.inr hw)
  have hK₁F : (K₁ : Set K) ⊆ racl (↥K₀) ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ g.cb) :=
    fun w hw ↦ subset_racl (↥K₀) _ (Or.inl hw)
  have hF'' : ((racl (↥K₁) ((g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').cb : Set K) :
      IntermediateField (↥K₁) K) : Set K) =
      ((racl (↥K₀) ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ g.cb) : IntermediateField (↥K₀) K) : Set K) := by
    rw [racl_cb_baseChange, coe_racl_base_eq K₀ K₁ h₀₁]
  have hy'' : IsGenericOver (racl (↥K₁) ((g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').cb : Set K)) a y :=
    hy.isGenericOver_racl (g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').isSmall_cb hind
  have hyF : IsGenericOver (racl (↥K₀) ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ g.cb)) a y :=
    (isGenericOver_base_iff K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha hF'').1 hy''
  rw [evalGen_eq _ (g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').isSmall_cb.racl
      (fun w hw ↦ subset_racl (↥K₁) _ hw) hy'',
    evalGen_eq g hF hcb hyF]
  exact eval_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' g hF hK₁F hcb hF'' hyF

name: GroupConfig.Germ.map_baseChange
statement:
theorem map_baseChange (g : Germ (↥K₀) a a') (σ : K ≃ₐ[↥K₁] K) :
    (g.map (restrictBase K₀ K₁ h₀₁ σ)).baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' =
      (g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').map σ
proof:
:= by
  apply graphIdeal_injective
  rw [graphIdeal_baseChange, graphIdeal_map, graphIdeal_map, graphIdeal_baseChange]
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.eq_of_evalGen_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_evalGen_eq {g g' : Germ (↥K₀) a a'} {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen (↥K₀) a y)
    (h : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range y) ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb)) (heq : g.evalGen y = g'.evalGen y) :
    g = g'
proof:
:= by
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl (↥K₀) ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hF : IsSmall (↥K₀) ((racl (↥K₀) ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb) :
      IntermediateField (↥K₀) K) : Set K) := (g.isSmall_cb.union g'.isSmall_cb).racl
  have hcb : g.cb ≤ racl (↥K₀) ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb) :=
    fun w hw ↦ subset_racl (↥K₀) _ (Or.inl hw)
  have hcb' : g'.cb ≤ racl (↥K₀) ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb) :=
    fun w hw ↦ subset_racl (↥K₀) _ (Or.inr hw)
  have hyF : IsGenericOver (racl (↥K₀) ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb)) a y :=
    hy.isGenericOver_racl (g.isSmall_cb.union g'.isSmall_cb) h
  refine eq_of_eval_eq hF hcb hcb' hyF ?_
  rw [← evalGen_eq g hF hcb hyF, ← evalGen_eq g' hF hcb' hyF, heq]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.indepOver_evalGen_union
statement:
theorem indepOver_evalGen_union (g : Germ (↥K₀) a a') {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen (↥K₀) a y)
    {W : Set K} (h : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range y) ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ W)) :
    IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range (g.evalGen y)) ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ W)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := indepOver_union_right_iff.1 h
  rw [empty_union] at h1
  refine indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨g.indepOver_evalGen hy h1.1, ?_⟩
  rw [empty_union]
  refine (indepOver_racl_left_iff.2 h1.2).mono_left ?_
  rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
  exact g.evalGen_mem_racl hy h1.1 j

name: GroupConfig.indepOver_empty_right
statement: theorem indepOver_empty_right {C A : Set K} : IndepOver k C A ∅
proof:
:= fun _ _ _ ↦ by
  rw [union_empty]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.comp_baseChange
statement:
theorem comp_baseChange {μ : Type*} [Finite μ] {a'' : μ → K}
    (ha'' : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range a'') (K₁ : Set K)) (g' : Germ (↥K₀) a' a'')
    (g : Germ (↥K₀) a a') :
    (Germ.comp g' g).baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha'' =
      Germ.comp (g'.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha' ha'') (g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha')
proof:
:= by
                                                                                      
  have hW : IsSmall (↥K₁) ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb) :=
    isSmall_base_mono K₀ K₁ h₀₁ (g.isSmall_cb.union g'.isSmall_cb)
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver (k := ↥K₁) hW.racl a
  have hygen : IsGen (↥K₁) a y := hy.isGen
  have hyk := (isGen_base_iff K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha).1 hygen
  have hyW : IndepOver (↥K₁) ∅ (range y) ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb) := by
    refine indepOver_racl_right_iff.1 ?_
    rw [empty_union]
    exact hy.indepOver
  have h : IndepOver (↥K₀) (K₁ : Set K) (range y) ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb) := by
    exact (indepOver_base_le_iff K₀ K₁ h₀₁ _ _).1 hyW
  have hracl : IndepOver (↥K₀) (K₁ : Set K) (range y)
      (racl (↥K₀) ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb)) : Set K) :=
    indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 h
  have hyg : IndepOver (↥K₁) ∅ (range y) ((g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').cb : Set K) :=
    (indepOver_cb_baseChange_iff K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' g _).2 (h.mono_right subset_union_left)
  have hyg' : IndepOver (↥K₁) ∅ (range y) ((g'.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha' ha'').cb : Set K) :=
    (indepOver_cb_baseChange_iff K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha' ha'' g' _).2 (h.mono_right subset_union_right)
  have hcbsub : ((g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').cb : Set K) ∪
      (g'.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha' ha'').cb ⊆
      racl (↥K₀) ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb)) := by
    rw [coe_cb_baseChange, coe_cb_baseChange]
    refine union_subset ((adjoin_le_racl (↥K₀) _).trans (racl_mono (k := ↥K₀) ?_))
      ((adjoin_le_racl (↥K₀) _).trans (racl_mono (k := ↥K₀) ?_))
    · exact union_subset (fun w hw ↦ Or.inl hw) (fun w hw ↦ Or.inr (Or.inl hw))
    · exact union_subset (fun w hw ↦ Or.inl hw) (fun w hw ↦ Or.inr (Or.inr hw))
  have hyW'' : IndepOver (↥K₁) ∅ (range y)
      (((g'.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha' ha'').cb : Set K) ∪
        (g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').cb) := by
    rw [indepOver_base_le_iff K₀ K₁ h₀₁, union_comm]
    exact hracl.mono_right hcbsub
                                                                    
  have hlhs : IndepOver (↥K₁) ∅ (range y)
      (((Germ.comp g' g).baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha'').cb : Set K) := by
    rw [indepOver_cb_baseChange_iff]
    refine hracl.mono_right ((cb_comp_le_racl g' g).trans (racl_mono (k := ↥K₀) ?_))
    exact fun w hw ↦ Or.inr hw
                                 
  have hyk' : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range y) ((g'.cb : Set K) ∪ g.cb) := by
    have h2 : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range y) ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ ((g.cb : Set K) ∪ g'.cb)) :=
      indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨hyk.2, by rw [empty_union]; exact h⟩
    exact h2.mono_right
      (union_subset (fun w hw ↦ Or.inr (Or.inr hw)) (fun w hw ↦ Or.inr (Or.inl hw)))
  have hyW₂ : IndepOver (↥K₁) ∅ (range y) (((g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').cb : Set K) ∪
      (g'.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha' ha'').cb) := by
    rw [union_comm]
    exact hyW''
  have hz : IsGen (↥K₁) a' (g.evalGen y) := by
    have hz := isGen_evalGen (g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha') hygen hyg
    rwa [evalGen_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' g hygen hyg] at hz
  have hzind : IndepOver (↥K₁) ∅ (range (g.evalGen y))
      ((g'.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha' ha'').cb : Set K) := by
    have hz := (indepOver_evalGen_union K₁ (g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha') hygen
      hyW₂).mono_right (subset_union_right (s := ((g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').cb : Set K)))
    rwa [evalGen_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' g hygen hyg] at hz
  refine eq_of_evalGen_eq K₁ hygen (hy.indepOver.mono_right (union_subset ?_ ?_)) ?_
  · rw [coe_cb_baseChange, coe_racl_base_eq K₀ K₁ h₀₁]
    refine (adjoin_le_racl (↥K₀) _).trans (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset ?_ ?_))
    · exact fun w hw ↦ subset_racl (↥K₀) _ (Or.inl hw)
    · exact (cb_comp_le_racl g' g).trans (racl_mono (k := ↥K₀) fun w hw ↦ Or.inr hw)
  · refine (cb_comp_le_racl _ _).trans (racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_)
    rw [coe_racl_base_eq K₀ K₁ h₀₁]
    exact hcbsub
  · calc ((Germ.comp g' g).baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha'').evalGen y
        = (Germ.comp g' g).evalGen y := evalGen_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha'' _ hygen hlhs
      _ = g'.evalGen (g.evalGen y) := evalGen_comp g' g hyk.1 hyk'
      _ = (g'.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha' ha'').evalGen (g.evalGen y) :=
          (evalGen_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha' ha'' g' hz hzind).symm
      _ = (g'.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha' ha'').evalGen
            ((g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha').evalGen y) := by
          rw [evalGen_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' g hygen hyg]
      _ = (Germ.comp (g'.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha' ha'')
            (g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha')).evalGen y :=
          (evalGen_comp _ _ hygen hyW'').symm

name: GroupConfig.Germ.id_baseChange
statement:
theorem id_baseChange :
    (Germ.id (k := ↥K₀) a).baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha = Germ.id (k := ↥K₁) a
proof:
:= by
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl (↥K₀) (K₁ : Set K)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl (↥K₁) (∅ : Set K)) := isAlgClosed_racl _
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ :=
    exists_isGenericOver (k := ↥K₁) (IsSmall.of_finite (k := ↥K₁) finite_empty).racl a
  have hygen : IsGen (↥K₁) a y := hy.isGen
  have hyk := (isGen_base_iff K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha).1 hygen
  have hy0 : IndepOver (↥K₁) ∅ (range y) (racl (↥K₁) (∅ : Set K) : Set K) := hy.indepOver
  have hK₁racl : (racl (↥K₀) (K₁ : Set K) : Set K) ⊆ racl (↥K₁) (∅ : Set K) := by
    rw [coe_racl_base_self K₀ K₁ h₀₁, racl_base_coe K₁, union_empty]
    exact subset_racl k _
  have hidcb : IndepOver (↥K₁) ∅ (range y)
      (((Germ.id a).baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha).cb : Set K) := by
    rw [indepOver_cb_baseChange_iff]
    have h0 : IndepOver (↥K₀) (K₁ : Set K) (range y)
        (racl (↥K₀) ((K₁ : Set K) ∪ ∅) : Set K) :=
      indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 indepOver_empty_right
    rw [union_empty] at h0
    exact h0.mono_right (cb_id_le a _)
  refine eq_of_evalGen_eq K₁ hygen (hy0.mono_right (union_subset ?_ ?_)) ?_
  · rw [coe_cb_baseChange]
    exact fun w hw ↦ hK₁racl (racl_le_of_subset_racl
      (union_subset (subset_racl (↥K₀) _) (cb_id_le a _)) (adjoin_le_racl (↥K₀) _ hw))
  · exact cb_id_le a _
  · rw [evalGen_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha _ hygen hidcb, evalGen_id hyk.1, evalGen_id hygen]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsInverse.baseChange
statement:
theorem IsInverse.baseChange {h : Germ (↥K₀) a' a} {g : Germ (↥K₀) a a'} (hi : IsInverse h g) :
    IsInverse (h.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha' ha) (g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha')
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rw [← comp_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' ha h g, hi.1, id_baseChange],
    by rw [← comp_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha' ha ha' g h, hi.2, id_baseChange]⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsInvertible.baseChange
statement:
theorem IsInvertible.baseChange {g : Germ (↥K₀) a a'} (hg : IsInvertible g) :
    IsInvertible (g.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hi⟩ := hg
  exact ⟨_, hi.baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha'⟩

name: GroupConfig.map_substFrac
statement:
private theorem map_substFrac {ι L L' : Type*} [Field L] [Field L'] (φ : L →+* L') {κ : Type*}
    [Fintype κ] (N : MvPolynomial κ L) (P Q : κ → MvPolynomial ι L) (d : ℕ) :
    MvPolynomial.map φ (substFrac N P Q d) =
      substFrac (MvPolynomial.map φ N) (fun j ↦ MvPolynomial.map φ (P j))
        (fun j ↦ MvPolynomial.map φ (Q j)) d
proof:
:= by
  simp only [substFrac, map_sum, map_mul, map_C, map_prod, map_pow,
    support_map_of_injective _ φ.injective, coeff_map]

name: GroupConfig.totalDegree_map_le
statement:
private theorem totalDegree_map_le {ι L L' : Type*} [CommSemiring L] [CommSemiring L']
    (φ : L →+* L') (P : MvPolynomial ι L) :
    (MvPolynomial.map φ P).totalDegree ≤ P.totalDegree
proof:
:= by
  unfold MvPolynomial.totalDegree
  exact Finset.sup_mono (support_map_subset _ _)

name: GroupConfig.Representative.mk_den_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem mk_den_ne_zero (i : ι) :
    LocusFunctionField.mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap r.M K) (r.f.den i)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver r.isSmall v
  exact mk_map_ne_zero hy (r.isDefinedAt y hy i)

name: GroupConfig.Representative.aeval_denIn_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem aeval_denIn_ne_zero {M : IntermediateField k K} (hrM : r.M ≤ M) {y : ι → K}
    (hy : IsGenericOver r.M v y) (i : ι) : aeval y (r.denIn hrM i) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [denIn, aeval_map_inclusion]
  exact r.isDefinedAt y hy i

name: GroupConfig.Representative.aeval_prod_denIn_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_prod]
  exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun i _ ↦ by
    rw [map_pow]
    exact pow_ne_zero _ (r.aeval_denIn_ne_zero hrM hy i)

name: GroupConfig.Representative.substPoly_mul_eq
statement:
private theorem substPoly_mul_eq [Fintype ι] {M : IntermediateField k K} (hrM : r.M ≤ M)
    (P : MvPolynomial ι M) {D : ℕ} (hD : P.totalDegree ≤ D) :
    r.substPoly (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap M K) P) *
        LocusFunctionField.mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap M K) (∏ i, r.denIn hrM i ^ D)) =
      LocusFunctionField.mk k v
        (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap M K) (substFrac P (r.numIn hrM) (r.denIn hrM) D))
proof:
:= by
  have hden : ∀ i, aeval (coord k v)
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap M K) (r.denIn hrM i)) ≠ 0 := fun i ↦ by
    rw [denIn, map_map_inclusion, aeval_coord]
    exact r.mk_den_ne_zero i
  conv_rhs => rw [map_substFrac, ← aeval_coord,
    aeval_substFrac ((totalDegree_map_le _ P).trans hD) _ _ hden]
  simp only [numIn, denIn, map_map_inclusion, aeval_coord, map_prod, map_pow]
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.Representative.aeval_substFrac_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hden : ∀ i, aeval y (r.denIn hrM i) ≠ 0 := r.aeval_denIn_ne_zero hrM hy
  have hfun : (fun i ↦ aeval y (r.numIn hrM i) / aeval y (r.denIn hrM i)) = r.f.eval y := by
    funext i
    rw [QuasiRational.eval_apply, hr, pRoot_zero, numIn, denIn, aeval_map_inclusion,
      aeval_map_inclusion]
  rw [aeval_substFrac hD _ _ hden, hfun, map_prod]
  simp only [map_pow]

name: GroupConfig.Representative.substPoly_eq_zero_iff
statement:
private theorem substPoly_eq_zero_iff (hr : r.f.e = 0) (P : MvPolynomial ι K) :
    r.substPoly P = 0 ↔ P ∈ locusIdeal k v
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  set M := racl k ((r.M : Set K) ∪ ↑P.coeffs)
  have hM : IsAlgClosed ↥M := isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hMs : IsSmall k (M : Set K) :=
    (r.isSmall.union (IsSmall.of_finite P.coeffs.finite_toSet)).racl
  have hrM : r.M ≤ M := subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
  obtain ⟨P₀, hP₀⟩ : P ∈ range (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap M K)) :=
    mem_range_map_iff_coeffs_subset.mpr fun c hc ↦ ⟨⟨c, subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hc)⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [← hP₀]
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hMs v
  have hz : IsGenericOver M v (r.f.eval y) := by
    have := (r.extend hM hMs hrM).isGenericOver y hy
    rwa [extend_eval] at this
  have hyr : IsGenericOver r.M v y := hy.of_le hrM
  have hprod : aeval y (∏ i, r.denIn hrM i ^ P₀.totalDegree) ≠ 0 :=
    r.aeval_prod_denIn_ne_zero hrM hyr _
  have heq := r.substPoly_mul_eq hrM P₀ le_rfl
  rw [map_mem_locusIdeal_iff_aeval hz]
  constructor
  · intro h0
    rw [h0, zero_mul, eq_comm, mk_map_eq_zero_iff hy, r.aeval_substFrac_eq hr hrM hyr P₀ le_rfl,
      mul_eq_zero] at heq
    exact heq.resolve_right hprod
  · intro h0
    have hmk : LocusFunctionField.mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap M K)
        (∏ i, r.denIn hrM i ^ P₀.totalDegree)) ≠ 0 := mk_map_ne_zero hy hprod
    rw [(mk_map_eq_zero_iff hy (substFrac P₀ (r.numIn hrM) (r.denIn hrM) P₀.totalDegree)).2
      (by rw [r.aeval_substFrac_eq hr hrM hyr P₀ le_rfl, h0, zero_mul])] at heq
    exact (mul_eq_zero.1 heq).resolve_right hmk

name: GroupConfig.Representative.subst_mk
statement:
private theorem subst_mk (hr : r.f.e = 0) (P : MvPolynomial ι K) :
    r.subst hr (LocusFunctionField.mk k v P) = r.substPoly P
proof:
:= by
  rw [subst, IsFractionRing.liftAlgHom_apply]
  change IsFractionRing.lift _ (algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι K ⧸ locusIdeal k v) _
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ P)) = _
  rw [IsFractionRing.lift_algebraMap]
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.Representative.subst_coord
statement:
theorem subst_coord (hr : r.f.e = 0) (i : ι) :
    r.subst hr (coord k v i) =
      LocusFunctionField.mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap r.M K) (r.f.num i)) /
        LocusFunctionField.mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap r.M K) (r.f.den i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [coord, subst_mk, substPoly, aeval_X]

name: GroupConfig.Representative.hasValue_subst
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  obtain ⟨A, B, hB, rfl, rfl⟩ := hh
  have hyr : IsGenericOver r.M v y := hy.of_le hrM
  set D := max A.totalDegree B.totalDegree
  have hprod : aeval y (∏ i, r.denIn hrM i ^ D) ≠ 0 := r.aeval_prod_denIn_ne_zero hrM hyr D
  have hmk := mk_map_ne_zero hy hprod
  have hA := r.substPoly_mul_eq hrM A (D := D) (le_max_left A.totalDegree B.totalDegree)
  have hB' := r.substPoly_mul_eq hrM B (D := D) (le_max_right A.totalDegree B.totalDegree)
  have hvA := r.aeval_substFrac_eq hr hrM hyr A (D := D) (le_max_left A.totalDegree B.totalDegree)
  have hvB := r.aeval_substFrac_eq hr hrM hyr B (D := D)
    (le_max_right A.totalDegree B.totalDegree)
  refine ⟨substFrac A (r.numIn hrM) (r.denIn hrM) D, substFrac B (r.numIn hrM) (r.denIn hrM) D,
    by rw [hvB]; exact mul_ne_zero hB hprod, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [map_div₀, subst_mk, subst_mk, ← hA, ← hB', mul_div_mul_right _ _ hmk]
  · rw [hvA, hvB, mul_div_mul_right _ _ hprod]

name: GroupConfig.Representative.subst_eq_of_equivalent
statement:
theorem subst_eq_of_equivalent {r r' : Representative k K v v} (hr : r.f.e = 0)
    (hr' : r'.f.e = 0) (h : r.Equivalent r') : r.subst hr = r'.subst hr'
proof:
:= by
  refine AlgHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨N, hTN, hN, hNs, hval⟩ := exists_hasValue x (r.isSmall.union r'.isSmall)
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥N := hN
  have hrN : r.M ≤ N := fun z hz ↦ hTN (Or.inl hz)
  have hr'N : r'.M ≤ N := fun z hz ↦ hTN (Or.inr hz)
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hNs v
  have hz : IsGenericOver N v (r.f.eval y) := by
    have := (r.extend hN hNs hrN).isGenericOver y hy
    rwa [extend_eval] at this
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hval _ hz
  have heq : r.f.eval y = r'.f.eval y :=
    h y (hy.of_le (racl_le_of_isAlgClosed (union_subset hrN hr'N)))
  exact HasValue.eq hy (r.hasValue_subst hr hrN hy hc) (r'.hasValue_subst hr' hr'N hy (heq ▸ hc))

name: GroupConfig.Representative.comp_f_e_eq_zero
statement:
theorem comp_f_e_eq_zero {r r' : Representative k K v v} (hr : r.f.e = 0) (hr' : r'.f.e = 0) :
    (r'.comp r).f.e = 0
proof:
:= by
  change r'.f.e + r.f.e = 0
  rw [hr, hr']

name: GroupConfig.Representative.subst_comp
statement:
theorem subst_comp {r r' : Representative k K v v} (hr : r.f.e = 0) (hr' : r'.f.e = 0) :
    (r'.comp r).subst (comp_f_e_eq_zero hr hr') = (r.subst hr).comp (r'.subst hr')
proof:
:= by
  refine AlgHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨N, hTN, hN, hNs, hval⟩ := exists_hasValue x (r.isSmall.union r'.isSmall)
  have _ : IsAlgClosed ↥N := hN
  have hrN : r.M ≤ N := fun z hz ↦ hTN (Or.inl hz)
  have hr'N : r'.M ≤ N := fun z hz ↦ hTN (Or.inr hz)
  have hjN : joinField r' r ≤ N := racl_le_of_isAlgClosed (union_subset hrN hr'N)
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hNs v
  have hz : IsGenericOver N v (r.f.eval y) := by
    have := (r.extend hN hNs hrN).isGenericOver y hy
    rwa [extend_eval] at this
  have hw : IsGenericOver N v (r'.f.eval (r.f.eval y)) := by
    have := (r'.extend hN hNs hr'N).isGenericOver _ hz
    rwa [extend_eval] at this
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hval _ hw
  have h1 := (r'.comp r).hasValue_subst (comp_f_e_eq_zero hr hr') hjN hy
    (by rwa [comp_eval r' r (hy.of_le hjN)])
  exact HasValue.eq hy h1 (r.hasValue_subst hr hrN hy (r'.hasValue_subst hr' hr'N hz hc))

name: GroupConfig.Representative.subst_id
statement: theorem subst_id : (Representative.id v).subst (k := k) rfl = AlgHom.id K _
proof:
:= by
  refine AlgHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨N, hTN, hN, hNs, hval⟩ := exists_hasValue x (Representative.id (k := k) v).isSmall
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hNs v
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hval y hy
  have heval : (Representative.id (k := k) v).f.eval y = y := QuasiRational.id_eval y
  exact HasValue.eq hy ((Representative.id v).hasValue_subst rfl hTN hy
    (by rw [heval]; exact hc)) hc

name: GroupConfig.Representative.equivalent_id_of_subst_eq_id
statement:
theorem equivalent_id_of_subst_eq_id (hr : r.f.e = 0) (h : r.subst hr = AlgHom.id K _) :
    r.Equivalent (Representative.id v)
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have hN : IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k ((r.M : Set K) ∪ (Representative.id (k := k) v).M)) :=
    isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hNs : IsSmall k ((racl k ((r.M : Set K) ∪ (Representative.id (k := k) v).M) :
      IntermediateField k K) : Set K) := (r.isSmall.union (Representative.id v).isSmall).racl
  have hrN : r.M ≤ racl k ((r.M : Set K) ∪ (Representative.id (k := k) v).M) :=
    subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _)
  rw [show (Representative.id (k := k) v).f.eval y = y from QuasiRational.id_eval y]
  funext i
  have h1 := r.hasValue_subst hr hrN hy (hasValue_coord (k := k) (v := v) i)
  rw [h, AlgHom.id_apply] at h1
  exact HasValue.eq_value hy h1 (hasValue_coord i)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.exists_rep
proof:
:=
  hw.exists_rational_representative hv (hw.mem_prodSubgroup.1 δ.2)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.substOf_eq
proof:
:=
  Representative.subst_eq_of_equivalent _ _
    (Quotient.exact ((Classical.choose_spec (hw.exists_rep hv δ)).1.trans hrδ.symm))

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.substOf_mul
statement:
private theorem substOf_mul (δ₁ δ₂ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) :
    hw.substOf hv (δ₁ * δ₂) = (hw.substOf hv δ₂).comp (hw.substOf hv δ₁)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₁e⟩ := Classical.choose_spec (hw.exists_rep hv δ₁)
  obtain ⟨h₂, h₂e⟩ := Classical.choose_spec (hw.exists_rep hv δ₂)
  have hprod : (⟦(Classical.choose (hw.exists_rep hv δ₁)).comp
      (Classical.choose (hw.exists_rep hv δ₂))⟧ : Germ k v v) =
        (((δ₁ * δ₂ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) : (Germ k v v)ˣ) : Germ k v v) := by
    change Germ.comp (⟦Classical.choose (hw.exists_rep hv δ₁)⟧ : Germ k v v)
      ⟦Classical.choose (hw.exists_rep hv δ₂)⟧ = _
    rw [h₁, h₂]
    rfl
  rw [hw.substOf_eq hv (δ₁ * δ₂) (Representative.comp_f_e_eq_zero h₂e h₁e) hprod,
    Representative.subst_comp]
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.substOf_one
statement: private theorem substOf_one : hw.substOf hv 1 = AlgHom.id K _
proof:
:= by
  rw [hw.substOf_eq hv 1 (r := Representative.id v) rfl rfl, Representative.subst_id]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.functionFieldAction_coord
statement:
theorem functionFieldAction_coord (γ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) {r : Representative k K v v}
    (hr : r.f.e = 0)
    (hrγ : (⟦r⟧ : Germ k v v) = (((γ⁻¹ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) : (Germ k v v)ˣ) : Germ k v v))
    (i : ι) :
    hw.functionFieldAction hv γ (coord k v i) =
      LocusFunctionField.mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap r.M K) (r.f.num i)) /
        LocusFunctionField.mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap r.M K) (r.f.den i))
proof:
:= by
  change hw.substOf hv γ⁻¹ (coord k v i) = _
  rw [hw.substOf_eq hv γ⁻¹ hr hrγ, Representative.subst_coord]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.functionFieldAction_injective
statement: theorem functionFieldAction_injective : Function.Injective (hw.functionFieldAction hv)
proof:
:= by
  refine (injective_iff_map_eq_one _).2 fun γ hγ ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨hr₁, hr₂⟩ := Classical.choose_spec (hw.exists_rep hv γ⁻¹)
  have hid : hw.substOf hv γ⁻¹ = AlgHom.id K _ := AlgHom.ext fun x ↦ by
    have := AlgEquiv.ext_iff.1 hγ x
    exact this
  have hequiv := (Classical.choose (hw.exists_rep hv γ⁻¹)).equivalent_id_of_subst_eq_id hr₂ hid
  have h1 : (((γ⁻¹ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) : (Germ k v v)ˣ) : Germ k v v) = 1 :=
    hr₁.symm.trans (Quotient.sound hequiv)
  have h2 : γ⁻¹ = 1 := Subtype.ext (Units.ext h1)
  exact inv_eq_one.1 h2

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.hasValue_functionFieldAction
statement:
theorem hasValue_functionFieldAction (γ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) {r : Representative k K v v}
    (hr : r.f.e = 0)
    (hrγ : (⟦r⟧ : Germ k v v) = (((γ⁻¹ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) : (Germ k v v)ˣ) : Germ k v v))
    {M : IntermediateField k K} (hrM : r.M ≤ M) {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGenericOver M v y)
    {h : LocusFunctionField k v} {c : K} (hh : HasValue M (r.f.eval y) h c) :
    HasValue M y (hw.functionFieldAction hv γ h) c
proof:
:= by
  change HasValue M y (hw.substOf hv γ⁻¹ h) c
  rw [hw.substOf_eq hv γ⁻¹ hr hrγ]
  exact r.hasValue_subst hr hrM hy hh

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.of_mem_orbit
statement:
theorem IsHWBij.of_mem_orbit {f₀ f : Germ k a a'} (hb : IsHWBij f₀) (hf : f ∈ orbit f₀) :
    IsHWBij f
proof:
:= by
  have ho := orbit_eq_of_mem hf
  have hd : diffSet f = diffSet f₀ := by
    unfold diffSet
    rw [ho]
  refine ⟨isInvertible_of_mem_orbit hb.isInvertible hf, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [ho]
    exact hb.trans
  · rw [hd, erk_cb_eq_of_mem_orbit hf]
    exact hb.rank

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.of_mem_orbit
statement: theorem IsHW.of_mem_orbit {g₀ g : Germ k a a} (hw : IsHW g₀) (hg : g ∈ orbit g₀) : IsHW g
proof:
:= by
  have ho := orbit_eq_of_mem hg
  refine ⟨isUnit_of_mem_orbit hw.isUnit hg, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [ho]
    exact hw.trans
  · rw [ho]
    exact hw.inv
  · rw [ho]
    exact hw.comp

name: GroupConfig.Germ.exists_idealOf_eq_indepOver
statement:
theorem exists_idealOf_eq_indepOver (a : ι → K) :
    ∃ a₁ : ι → K, idealOf (↥K₀) a₁ = idealOf (↥K₀) a ∧
      IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (range a₁) (K₁ : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a₁, ha₁⟩ := exists_isGenericOver (k := ↥K₀) hK₁.racl a
  exact ⟨a₁, ha₁.isGen, ha₁.indepOver.mono_right (subset_racl (↥K₀) _)⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.indepOver_cb_transport_iff
statement:
theorem indepOver_cb_transport_iff {g : Germ (↥K₀) a a'} :
    IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ ((g.transport h h').cb : Set K) (K₁ : Set K) ↔
      IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (g.cb : Set K) (K₁ : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cb_transport]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.baseChange_transport_mem_orbit
statement:
theorem baseChange_transport_mem_orbit {f₀ g : Germ (↥K₀) a a'}
    (h₀ : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (f₀.cb : Set K) (K₁ : Set K)) (hg : g ∈ orbit f₀)
    (hgK : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (g.cb : Set K) (K₁ : Set K)) :
    (g.transport h h').baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' ∈
      orbit ((f₀.transport h h').baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha')
proof:
:=
  baseChange_mem_orbit K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' ((indepOver_cb_transport_iff K₀ K₁ h h').2 h₀)
    ((transport_mem_orbit_iff h h').2 hg) ((indepOver_cb_transport_iff K₀ K₁ h h').2 hgK)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.exists_of_mem_orbit_baseChange_transport
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g', hg', hgK, rfl⟩ := exists_of_mem_orbit_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha'
    ((indepOver_cb_transport_iff K₀ K₁ h h').2 h₀) hf
  obtain ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩ := exists_of_mem_orbit_transport h h' hg'
  exact ⟨g, hg, (indepOver_cb_transport_iff K₀ K₁ h h').1 hgK, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.baseChange_transport_mem_diffSet
proof:
:=
  baseChange_mem_diffSet K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha' ((indepOver_cb_transport_iff K₀ K₁ h h').2 h₀)
    ((transport_mem_diffSet_iff h h').2 hδ) ((indepOver_cb_transport_iff K₀ K₁ h h).2 hδK)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.exists_of_mem_diffSet_baseChange_transport
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ', hδ', hδ'K, rfl⟩ := exists_of_mem_diffSet_baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha'
    ((isInvertible_transport_iff h h').2 hf₀) ((indepOver_cb_transport_iff K₀ K₁ h h').2 h₀) hδ
  obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, rfl⟩ := exists_of_mem_diffSet_transport h h' hδ'
  exact ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, (indepOver_cb_transport_iff K₀ K₁ h h).1 hδ'K, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.baseChange_transport
statement:
theorem IsHWBij.baseChange_transport {f₀ f₁ : Germ (↥K₀) a a'} (hb : IsHWBij f₀)
    (hf₁ : f₁ ∈ orbit f₀) (h₁ : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (f₁.cb : Set K) (K₁ : Set K)) :
    IsHWBij ((f₁.transport h h').baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha')
proof:
:=
  ((hb.of_mem_orbit hf₁).transport h h').baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha'
    ((indepOver_cb_transport_iff K₀ K₁ h h').2 h₁)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.baseChange_transport
statement:
theorem IsHW.baseChange_transport {g₀ g₁ : Germ (↥K₀) a a} (hw : IsHW g₀)
    (hg₁ : g₁ ∈ orbit g₀) (h₁ : IndepOver (↥K₀) ∅ (g₁.cb : Set K) (K₁ : Set K)) :
    IsHW ((g₁.transport h h).baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha)
proof:
:=
  ((hw.of_mem_orbit hg₁).transport h).baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha
    ((indepOver_cb_transport_iff K₀ K₁ h h).2 h₁)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.val_baseChangeTransportGroupEquiv
statement:
theorem val_baseChangeTransportGroupEquiv (δ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) :
    ((hw.transport h).baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha
      ((indepOver_cb_transport_iff K₀ K₁ h h).2 h₀)).val
        (baseChangeTransportGroupEquiv K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ h ha hw h₀ δ) =
      ((hw.val δ).transport h h).baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha ha
proof: := rfl

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.baseChangeTransportSpaceEquiv_smul
statement:
theorem baseChangeTransportSpaceEquiv_smul (δ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup)
    (s : ((hw.transport h).baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha
      ((indepOver_cb_transport_iff K₀ K₁ h h).2 h₀)).Space) :
    baseChangeTransportSpaceEquiv K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ h ha hw h₀
        (baseChangeTransportGroupEquiv K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ h ha hw h₀ δ • s) =
      δ • baseChangeTransportSpaceEquiv K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ h ha hw h₀ s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [baseChangeTransportSpaceEquiv, baseChangeTransportGroupEquiv, Equiv.trans_apply,
    MulEquiv.trans_apply]
  rw [spaceEquiv_smul, Equiv.symm_apply_eq, transportSpaceEquiv_smul, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.baseChangeTransportSpaceEquiv_iota
statement:
theorem baseChangeTransportSpaceEquiv_iota {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen (↥K₁) a₁ y) :
    baseChangeTransportSpaceEquiv K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ h ha hw h₀
        (((hw.transport h).baseChange K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha
          ((indepOver_cb_transport_iff K₀ K₁ h h).2 h₀)).iota hy) =
      hw.iota ((isGen_iff_of_idealOf_eq h y).1 ((isGen_base_iff K₀ K₁ h₀₁ hK₁ ha).1 hy).1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [baseChangeTransportSpaceEquiv, Equiv.trans_apply]
  rw [spaceEquiv_iota, Equiv.symm_apply_eq, transportSpaceEquiv_iota]

name: GroupConfig.IsConstructibleOver.preimage_comp
proof:
:= by
  convert hs.preimage_polynomial (fun i ↦ (X (f i) : MvPolynomial ι k)) using 1
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, aeval_X, Function.comp_def]

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.eq_eval_of_isInverse
proof:
:= by
  have hM : IsSmall k ((racl k (range u) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range u)).racl
  have hcb := F.cb_parameterGerm_le hu
  have hcbh : h.cb ≤ racl k (range u) := hi.cb_le.trans (racl_le_of_isAlgClosed hcb)
  
  have hyg := F.isGenericOver_of_eval_eq hdim hw hyV hyD hyw
  rw [← hyw, ← F.eval_parameterGerm hu hyg, ← Germ.comp_eval h _ hM hcb hcbh hyg, hi.1,
    Germ.eval_id hM hyg]

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.mem_fibre_eval_of_isInverse
proof:
:= by
  have hM : IsSmall k ((racl k (range u) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range u)).racl
  have hcb := F.cb_parameterGerm_le hu
  have hcbh : h.cb ≤ racl k (range u) := hi.cb_le.trans (racl_le_of_isAlgClosed hcb)
  have hy := h.isGenericOver_eval hM hcbh hw
  refine ⟨hy.inLocus, (hu _ hy).1, ?_⟩
  rw [← F.eval_parameterGerm hu hy, ← Germ.comp_eval _ h hM hcbh hcb hw, hi.2, Germ.eval_id hM hw]

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isInvertible_parameterGerm_iff
statement:
theorem isInvertible_parameterGerm_iff (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ) {a : ι → K}
    {a' : κ → K} (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a')) {u : μ → K}
    (hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' u) :
    Germ.IsInvertible (F.parameterGerm hu) ↔
      ∀ w : κ → K, IsGenericOver (racl k (range u)) a' w →
        ∃! y : ι → K, InLocus (k := k) a y ∧ F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim u y) ∧
          F.eval (Sum.elim u y) = w
proof:
:= by
  have hM : IsSmall k ((racl k (range u) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range u)).racl
  have hcb := F.cb_parameterGerm_le hu
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h, hi⟩ w hw
    
    have hinv (y : ι → K) (hy : InLocus (k := k) a y ∧ F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim u y) ∧
        F.eval (Sum.elim u y) = w) : y = h.eval (racl k (range u)) w :=
      F.eq_eval_of_isInverse hdim hu hi hw hy.1 hy.2.1 hy.2.2
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (F.isAdmissible_iff_generic_surjective a a' hdim u).1 hu w hw
    exact ⟨y, hy, fun y' hy' ↦ (hinv y' hy').trans (hinv y hy).symm⟩
  · intro huniq
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hM a
    have hw := (hu y hy).2
    refine ((F.parameterGerm hu).isInvertible_iff_mem_dclAdjoin hM hcb hy).2 fun i ↦ ?_
    rw [F.eval_parameterGerm hu hy]
    unfold dclAdjoin
    refine mem_dcl_iff_forall_fixed.2 fun σ ↦ ?_
    
    let σM : K ≃ₐ[↥(racl k (range u))] K :=
      { σ.toRingEquiv with
        commutes' := fun r ↦ σ.commutes ⟨r, (mem_restrictScalars k).2
          (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem
            (adjoin (↥(racl k (range u))) (range (F.eval (Sum.elim u y)))) r)⟩ }
    have hσw (j : κ) : σM (F.eval (Sum.elim u y) j) = F.eval (Sum.elim u y) j :=
      σ.commutes ⟨_, (mem_restrictScalars k).2 (subset_adjoin _ _ (mem_range_self j))⟩
    have hfy : (F.specialize u).IsDefinedAt y := (F.specialize_isDefinedAt_iff u y).2 (hu y hy).1
    have hσy : InLocus (k := k) a (⇑σM ∘ y) ∧ F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim u (⇑σM ∘ y)) ∧
        F.eval (Sum.elim u (⇑σM ∘ y)) = F.eval (Sum.elim u y) := by
      refine ⟨(hy.comp σM).inLocus, (F.specialize_isDefinedAt_iff u _).1
        (((F.specialize u).isDefinedAt_comp_iff σM y).2 hfy), ?_⟩
      rw [← F.specialize_eval, (F.specialize u).eval_comp σM, F.specialize_eval]
      exact funext hσw
    exact congrFun ((huniq _ hw).unique hσy ⟨hy.inLocus, (hu y hy).1, rfl⟩) i

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isConstructibleOver_invertibleAdmissible
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_invertibleAdmissible [Fintype μ] {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ) (a : ι → K) (a' : κ → K)
    (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a')) (t : α → κ → K)
    (ht : ∀ i, IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) a' (t i))
    (hind : erk k ((⊥ : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t i)) =
      ∑ i, erk k ((⊥ : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) (range (t i)))
    (hr : 2 * Fintype.card μ + 1 ≤ Fintype.card α) :
    IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k (⋃ i, range (t i))))
      {u : μ → K | ∃ hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' u, Germ.IsInvertible (F.parameterGerm hu)}
proof:
:= by
                                                                            
  let Q : ((μ ⊕ κ) → K) → (ι → K) → Prop := fun v y ↦ InLocus (k := k) a y ∧
    F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim (v ∘ Sum.inl) y) ∧ F.eval (Sum.elim (v ∘ Sum.inl) y) = v ∘ Sum.inr
  have hR : IsConstructibleOver k {z : ((μ ⊕ κ) ⊕ ι) → K | Q (z ∘ Sum.inl) (z ∘ Sum.inr)} :=
    F.isConstructibleOver_fibre a
  have hEq : IsConstructibleOver k {z : ((μ ⊕ κ) ⊕ (ι ⊕ ι)) → K |
      (z ∘ Sum.inr) ∘ Sum.inl = (z ∘ Sum.inr) ∘ Sum.inr} := by
    convert IsConstructibleOver.iInter fun i : ι ↦ IsConstructibleOver.polynomial_zero (K := K)
      (X (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i)) - X (Sum.inr (Sum.inr i)) :
        MvPolynomial ((μ ⊕ κ) ⊕ (ι ⊕ ι)) k) using 1
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iInter, map_sub, aeval_X, sub_eq_zero, funext_iff,
      Function.comp_apply]
  have hT : IsConstructibleOver k {z : ((μ ⊕ κ) ⊕ (ι ⊕ ι)) → K |
      (fun (v : (μ ⊕ κ) → K) (p : (ι ⊕ ι) → K) ↦
        Q v (p ∘ Sum.inl) ∧ Q v (p ∘ Sum.inr) ∧ p ∘ Sum.inl ≠ p ∘ Sum.inr)
        (z ∘ Sum.inl) (z ∘ Sum.inr)} :=
    (hR.preimage_comp (Sum.map _root_.id Sum.inl)).inter
      ((hR.preimage_comp (Sum.map _root_.id Sum.inr)).inter hEq.compl)
  have hs : IsConstructibleOver k {v : (μ ⊕ κ) → K | ∀ y y' : ι → K, Q v y → Q v y' → y = y'} := by
    convert (hT.exists (φ := fun v p ↦
      Q v (p ∘ Sum.inl) ∧ Q v (p ∘ Sum.inr) ∧ p ∘ Sum.inl ≠ p ∘ Sum.inr)).compl using 1
    ext v
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_compl_iff, not_exists]
    constructor
    · rintro h p ⟨h₁, h₂, hne⟩
      exact hne (h _ _ h₁ h₂)
    · intro h y y' hy hy'
      by_contra hne
      exact h (Sum.elim y y') ⟨hy, hy', hne⟩
  have h := (F.isConstructibleOver_admissible a a' hdim t ht hind hr).inter
    (isConstructibleOver_forall_generic a' t ht hind hr hs)
  convert h using 1
  ext u
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Q, Sum.elim_comp_inl, Sum.elim_comp_inr]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hu, hinv⟩
    exact ⟨hu, fun w hw y y' hy hy' ↦
      ((F.isInvertible_parameterGerm_iff hdim hu).1 hinv w hw).unique hy hy'⟩
  · rintro ⟨hu, huniq⟩
    refine ⟨hu, (F.isInvertible_parameterGerm_iff hdim hu).2 fun w hw ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (F.isAdmissible_iff_generic_surjective a a' hdim u).1 hu w hw
    exact ⟨y, hy, fun y' hy' ↦ huniq w hw y' y hy' hy⟩

name: GroupConfig.ConstructibleGroupPresentation.of_le
proof:
:= IsConstructibleOver.of_le_intermediateField h hp.domain
  surjective := hp.surjective
  kernel := IsConstructibleOver.of_le_intermediateField h hp.kernel
  multiplication := IsConstructibleOver.of_le_intermediateField h hp.multiplication
  inverse := IsConstructibleOver.of_le_intermediateField h hp.inverse

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isConstructibleOver_graph_comp
statement:
theorem QuasiRational.isConstructibleOver_graph_comp [IsAlgClosed K] {μ κ τ X : Type*} [Finite τ]
    (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ κ) τ) (e₁ : μ → X) (e₂ : κ → X) (e₃ : τ → X) :
    IsConstructibleOver k {z : X → K | F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim (z ∘ e₁) (z ∘ e₂)) ∧
      F.eval (Sum.elim (z ∘ e₁) (z ∘ e₂)) = z ∘ e₃}
proof:
:= by
  convert (F.isConstructibleOver_graph (K := K)).preimage_comp
    (Sum.elim (Sum.elim e₁ e₂) e₃) using 1
  ext z
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_preimage, Sum.comp_elim, Sum.elim_comp_inl,
    Sum.elim_comp_inr]

name: GroupConfig.Word.IsGerm.cb_le
statement:
theorem IsGerm.cb_le {κ : Type v} {b : κ → K} {w : Word k P a b} [hκ : Finite κ] {u : P → K}
    {g : Germ k a b} (hg : w.IsGerm u g) : g.cb ≤ racl k (range u)
proof:
:= by
  have hM : IsSmall k ((racl k (range u) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range u)).racl
  
  revert hκ
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    intro _
    obtain rfl : g = Germ.id a := hg
    exact Germ.cb_id_le a _
  | fwd w c F ρ hdim ih =>
    intro _
    obtain ⟨g₀, hu, hg₀, rfl⟩ := hg
    exact Germ.cb_comp_le _ _ hM (ih hg₀)
      ((F.cb_parameterGerm_le hu).trans (racl_mono (k := k) (range_comp_subset_range ρ u)))
  | inv w c F ρ hdim ih =>
    intro _
    obtain ⟨g₀, hu, h, hg₀, hi, rfl⟩ := hg
    exact Germ.cb_comp_le _ _ hM (ih hg₀) (hi.cb_le.trans (racl_le_of_isAlgClosed
      ((F.cb_parameterGerm_le hu).trans (racl_mono (k := k) (range_comp_subset_range ρ u)))))

name: GroupConfig.Word.IsGerm.chain_iff
proof:
:= by
  have hM : IsSmall k ((racl k (range u) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range u)).racl
  revert hκ
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    intro _
    obtain rfl : g = Germ.id a := hg
    change InLocus (k := k) a y ∧ z = y ↔ _
    rw [Germ.eval_id hM hy]
    exact ⟨fun h ↦ h.2, fun h ↦ ⟨hy.inLocus, h⟩⟩
  | @fwd κ' τ μ _ _ _ b w c F ρ hdim ih =>
    intro _
    obtain ⟨g₀, hu, hg₀, rfl⟩ := hg
    have hcb₀ := hg₀.cb_le
    have hle : racl k (range (u ∘ ρ)) ≤ racl k (range u) :=
      racl_mono (k := k) (range_comp_subset_range ρ u)
    have hM' : IsSmall k ((racl k (range (u ∘ ρ)) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
      (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range _)).racl
    have hx₀ := g₀.isGenericOver_eval hM hcb₀ hy
    have hx₀' := hx₀.of_le hle
    have hval : F.eval (Sum.elim (u ∘ ρ) (g₀.eval (racl k (range u)) y)) =
        (Germ.comp (F.parameterGerm hu) g₀).eval (racl k (range u)) y := by
      rw [Germ.comp_eval _ _ hM hcb₀ ((F.cb_parameterGerm_le hu).trans hle) hy,
        ← Germ.eval_eq_of_le _ hM' hM (F.cb_parameterGerm_le hu) hle hx₀,
        F.eval_parameterGerm hu hx₀']
    change (∃ x, w.Chain u y x ∧ InLocus (k := k) c z ∧ F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim (u ∘ ρ) x) ∧
      F.eval (Sum.elim (u ∘ ρ) x) = z) ↔ _
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, -, -, rfl⟩
      obtain rfl := (ih hg₀ x).1 hx
      exact hval
    · rintro rfl
      refine ⟨_, (ih hg₀ _).2 rfl, ?_, (hu _ hx₀').1, hval⟩
      rw [← hval]
      exact (hu _ hx₀').2.inLocus
  | @inv κ' τ μ _ _ _ b w c F ρ hdim ih =>
    intro _
    obtain ⟨g₀, hu, h, hg₀, hi, rfl⟩ := hg
    have hcb₀ := hg₀.cb_le
    have hle : racl k (range (u ∘ ρ)) ≤ racl k (range u) :=
      racl_mono (k := k) (range_comp_subset_range ρ u)
    have hM' : IsSmall k ((racl k (range (u ∘ ρ)) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
      (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range _)).racl
    have hcbh : h.cb ≤ racl k (range (u ∘ ρ)) :=
      hi.cb_le.trans (racl_le_of_isAlgClosed (F.cb_parameterGerm_le hu))
    have hx₀ := g₀.isGenericOver_eval hM hcb₀ hy
    have hx₀' := hx₀.of_le hle
    have hval : h.eval (racl k (range (u ∘ ρ))) (g₀.eval (racl k (range u)) y) =
        (Germ.comp h g₀).eval (racl k (range u)) y := by
      rw [Germ.comp_eval _ _ hM hcb₀ (hcbh.trans hle) hy,
        Germ.eval_eq_of_le _ hM' hM hcbh hle hx₀]
    change (∃ x, w.Chain u y x ∧ InLocus (k := k) c z ∧ F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim (u ∘ ρ) z) ∧
      F.eval (Sum.elim (u ∘ ρ) z) = x) ↔ _
    rw [← hval]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, hzV, hzD, hzx⟩
      obtain rfl := (ih hg₀ x).1 hx
      exact F.eq_eval_of_isInverse hdim hu hi hx₀' hzV hzD hzx
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨_, (ih hg₀ _).2 rfl, F.mem_fibre_eval_of_isInverse hu hi hx₀'⟩

name: GroupConfig.Word.IsGerm.eq_iff
statement:
theorem IsGerm.eq_iff {κ : Type v} {b : κ → K} {w₁ w₂ : Word k P a b} [Finite κ] {u : P → K}
    {g₁ g₂ : Germ k a b} (h₁ : w₁.IsGerm u g₁) (h₂ : w₂.IsGerm u g₂) :
    g₁ = g₂ ↔ ∀ y, IsGenericOver (racl k (range u)) a y →
      ∃ z, w₁.Chain u y z ∧ w₂.Chain u y z
proof:
:= by
  have hM : IsSmall k ((racl k (range u) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range u)).racl
  constructor
  · rintro rfl y hy
    exact ⟨_, (h₁.chain_iff hy _).2 rfl, (h₂.chain_iff hy _).2 rfl⟩
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hM a
    obtain ⟨z, hz₁, hz₂⟩ := h y hy
    exact Germ.eq_of_eval_eq hM h₁.cb_le h₂.cb_le hy
      (((h₁.chain_iff hy z).1 hz₁).symm.trans ((h₂.chain_iff hy z).1 hz₂))

name: GroupConfig.Word.IsGerm.unique
statement:
theorem IsGerm.unique {κ : Type v} {b : κ → K} {w : Word k P a b} [Finite κ] {u : P → K}
    {g g' : Germ k a b} (hg : w.IsGerm u g) (hg' : w.IsGerm u g') : g = g'
proof:
:=
  (hg.eq_iff hg').2 fun _ hy ↦ ⟨_, (hg.chain_iff hy _).2 rfl, (hg.chain_iff hy _).2 rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.Word.isConstructibleOver_chain
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    have hEq : IsConstructibleOver k {v : ((P ⊕ ι) ⊕ ι) → K |
        v ∘ Sum.inr = (v ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr} := by
      convert IsConstructibleOver.iInter fun i : ι ↦ IsConstructibleOver.polynomial_zero (K := K)
        (X (Sum.inr i) - X (Sum.inl (Sum.inr i)) : MvPolynomial ((P ⊕ ι) ⊕ ι) k) using 1
      ext v
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iInter, map_sub, aeval_X, sub_eq_zero, funext_iff,
        Function.comp_apply]
    exact ((isConstructibleOver_inLocus a).preimage_comp (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr)).inter hEq
  | @fwd κ' τ μ _ _ _ b w c F ρ hdim ih =>
    have hT : IsConstructibleOver k {z : (((P ⊕ ι) ⊕ τ) ⊕ κ') → K |
        w.Chain (((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) (((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr)
          (z ∘ Sum.inr) ∧ InLocus (k := k) c ((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr) ∧
        F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim ((((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ ρ) (z ∘ Sum.inr)) ∧
        F.eval (Sum.elim ((((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ ρ) (z ∘ Sum.inr)) =
          (z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr} :=
      (ih.preimage_comp (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl) Sum.inr)).inter
        (((isConstructibleOver_inLocus c).preimage_comp (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr)).inter
          (F.isConstructibleOver_graph_comp (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl ∘ ρ) Sum.inr
            (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr)))
    exact hT.exists (φ := fun v x ↦
      w.Chain ((v ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) ((v ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr) x ∧
      InLocus (k := k) c (v ∘ Sum.inr) ∧
      F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim (((v ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ ρ) x) ∧
      F.eval (Sum.elim (((v ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ ρ) x) = v ∘ Sum.inr)
  | @inv κ' τ μ _ _ _ b w c F ρ hdim ih =>
    have hT : IsConstructibleOver k {z : (((P ⊕ ι) ⊕ τ) ⊕ κ') → K |
        w.Chain (((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) (((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr)
          (z ∘ Sum.inr) ∧ InLocus (k := k) c ((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr) ∧
        F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim ((((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ ρ)
          ((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr)) ∧
        F.eval (Sum.elim ((((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ ρ)
          ((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr)) = z ∘ Sum.inr} :=
      (ih.preimage_comp (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl) Sum.inr)).inter
        (((isConstructibleOver_inLocus c).preimage_comp (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr)).inter
          (F.isConstructibleOver_graph_comp (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl ∘ ρ)
            (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) Sum.inr))
    exact hT.exists (φ := fun v x ↦
      w.Chain ((v ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) ((v ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr) x ∧
      InLocus (k := k) c (v ∘ Sum.inr) ∧
      F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim (((v ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ ρ) (v ∘ Sum.inr)) ∧
      F.eval (Sum.elim (((v ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ ρ) (v ∘ Sum.inr)) = x)

name: GroupConfig.Word.isConstructibleOver_isGerm
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    convert (IsConstructibleOver.univ : IsConstructibleOver (↥L) (univ : Set (P → K))) using 1
    exact eq_univ_of_forall fun u ↦ ⟨Germ.id a, rfl⟩
  | @fwd κ' τ μ _ _ _ b w c F ρ hdim ih =>
    obtain ⟨hw, n, t, ht, hind, hn, htL⟩ := hL
    have hA := IsConstructibleOver.of_le_intermediateField (adjoin_le_iff.2 (iUnion_subset htL))
      (F.isConstructibleOver_admissible b c hdim t ht hind (by rwa [Fintype.card_fin]))
    convert (ih hw).inter (hA.preimage_comp ρ) using 1
    ext u
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, g₀, hu, hg₀, -⟩
      exact ⟨⟨g₀, hg₀⟩, hu⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨g₀, hg₀⟩, hu⟩
      exact ⟨_, g₀, hu, hg₀, rfl⟩
  | @inv κ' τ μ _ _ _ b w c F ρ hdim ih =>
    obtain ⟨hw, n, t, ht, hind, hn, htL⟩ := hL
    have hA := IsConstructibleOver.of_le_intermediateField (adjoin_le_iff.2 (iUnion_subset htL))
      (F.isConstructibleOver_invertibleAdmissible c b hdim t ht hind (by rwa [Fintype.card_fin]))
    convert (ih hw).inter (hA.preimage_comp ρ) using 1
    ext u
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, g₀, hu, h, hg₀, hi, -⟩
      exact ⟨⟨g₀, hg₀⟩, hu, h, hi⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨g₀, hg₀⟩, hu, h, hi⟩
      exact ⟨_, g₀, hu, h, hg₀, hi, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.Word.isConstructibleOver_germ_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hS := (w₁.isConstructibleOver_chain.inter w₂.isConstructibleOver_chain).exists
    (φ := fun (v : (P ⊕ ι) → K) (z : κ → K) ↦
      w₁.Chain (v ∘ Sum.inl) (v ∘ Sum.inr) z ∧ w₂.Chain (v ∘ Sum.inl) (v ∘ Sum.inr) z)
  obtain ⟨n, t, ht, hind, hn, htL⟩ := ha
  have hQ := IsConstructibleOver.of_le_intermediateField (adjoin_le_iff.2 (iUnion_subset htL))
    (QuasiRational.isConstructibleOver_forall_generic a t ht hind (by rwa [Fintype.card_fin]) hS)
  convert ((w₁.isConstructibleOver_isGerm h₁).inter (w₂.isConstructibleOver_isGerm h₂)).inter hQ
    using 1
  ext u
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Sum.elim_comp_inl, Sum.elim_comp_inr]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg₁, hg₂⟩
    exact ⟨⟨⟨g, hg₁⟩, ⟨g, hg₂⟩⟩, (hg₁.eq_iff hg₂).1 rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨⟨g₁, hg₁⟩, ⟨g₂, hg₂⟩⟩, hq⟩
    obtain rfl := (hg₁.eq_iff hg₂).2 hq
    exact ⟨g₁, hg₁, hg₂⟩

name: GroupConfig.Word.isConstructibleOver_isInvertiblyAdmissible
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => exact IsConstructibleOver.univ
  | @fwd κ' τ μ _ _ _ b w c F ρ hdim ih =>
    obtain ⟨hw, n, t, ht, hind, hn, htL⟩ := hL
    have hA := IsConstructibleOver.of_le_intermediateField (adjoin_le_iff.2 (iUnion_subset htL))
      (F.isConstructibleOver_invertibleAdmissible b c hdim t ht hind (by rwa [Fintype.card_fin]))
    exact (ih hw).inter (hA.preimage_comp ρ)
  | @inv κ' τ μ _ _ _ b w c F ρ hdim ih =>
    obtain ⟨hw, n, t, ht, hind, hn, htL⟩ := hL
    have hA := IsConstructibleOver.of_le_intermediateField (adjoin_le_iff.2 (iUnion_subset htL))
      (F.isConstructibleOver_invertibleAdmissible c b hdim t ht hind (by rwa [Fintype.card_fin]))
    exact (ih hw).inter (hA.preimage_comp ρ)

name: GroupConfig.Word.isConstructibleOver_eq_parameterGerm
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_eq_parameterGerm [Fintype P] {κ : Type v} [Finite κ] {b : κ → K}
    (w : Word k P a b) {μ' : Type v} [Fintype μ'] (F' : QuasiRational k (μ' ⊕ ι) κ)
    (ρ' : μ' → P) (hdim' : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range b))
    {L : IntermediateField k K} (hw : w.HasSamples L)
    (hF' : HasGenericSamples L b (Fintype.card μ'))
    (ha : HasGenericSamples L a (Fintype.card P)) :
    IsConstructibleOver (↥L) {u : P → K | w.IsInvertiblyAdmissible u ∧
      ∃ hu' : F'.IsAdmissible a b (u ∘ ρ'), w.IsGerm u (F'.parameterGerm hu')}
proof:
:= by
  convert (w.isConstructibleOver_isInvertiblyAdmissible hw).inter
    (isConstructibleOver_germ_eq w (fwd nil b F' ρ' hdim') hw ⟨trivial, hF'⟩ ha) using 1
  ext u
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hinv, hu', hg⟩
    exact ⟨hinv, _, hg, _, hu', rfl, (Germ.comp_id _).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨hinv, g, hg, g₀, hu', rfl, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨hinv, hu', ?_⟩
    rwa [Germ.comp_id] at hg

name: GroupConfig.Word.hasSamples_mapParams_iff
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => exact Iff.rfl
  | fwd w c F ρ hdim ih => exact and_congr ih Iff.rfl
  | inv w c F ρ hdim ih => exact and_congr ih Iff.rfl

name: GroupConfig.Word.isGerm_mapParams_iff
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => exact Iff.rfl
  | fwd w c F ρ hdim ih =>
    exact exists_congr fun g₀ ↦ exists_congr fun _ ↦ and_congr (ih g₀) Iff.rfl
  | inv w c F ρ hdim ih =>
    exact exists_congr fun g₀ ↦ exists_congr fun _ ↦ exists_congr fun _ ↦
      and_congr (ih g₀) Iff.rfl

name: GroupConfig.Word.isInvertiblyAdmissible_mapParams_iff
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => exact Iff.rfl
  | fwd w c F ρ hdim ih => exact and_congr ih Iff.rfl
  | inv w c F ρ hdim ih => exact and_congr ih Iff.rfl

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.exists_fresh_constructible_parameterRelations
statement:
theorem QuasiRational.exists_fresh_constructible_parameterRelations
    (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ) (a : ι → K) (b : κ → K)
    (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range b))
    (M : IntermediateField k K) (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K)) :
    ∃ (t : Fin (2 * Fintype.card (μ ⊕ μ) + 1) → ι → K)
      (s : Fin (2 * Fintype.card (μ ⊕ μ) + 1) → κ → K),
      (∀ i, IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) a (t i)) ∧
      erk k ((⊥ : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t i)) =
        ∑ i, erk k ((⊥ : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) (range (t i)) ∧
      (∀ i, IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) b (s i)) ∧
      erk k ((⊥ : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) (⋃ i, range (s i)) =
        ∑ i, erk k ((⊥ : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) (range (s i)) ∧
      IndepOver k (M : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t i)) (⋃ i, range (s i)) ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ ((⋃ i, range (t i)) ∪ ⋃ i, range (s i)) (M : Set K) ∧
      IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k ((⋃ i, range (t i)) ∪ ⋃ i, range (s i))))
        {u : μ → K | F.IsAdmissible a b u} ∧
      IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k ((⋃ i, range (t i)) ∪ ⋃ i, range (s i))))
        {u : μ → K | ∃ hu : F.IsAdmissible a b u,
        Germ.IsInvertible (F.parameterGerm hu)} ∧
      IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k ((⋃ i, range (t i)) ∪ ⋃ i, range (s i))))
        {v : (μ ⊕ μ) → K |
        ∃ (hu : F.IsAdmissible a b (v ∘ Sum.inl))
          (hu' : F.IsAdmissible a b (v ∘ Sum.inr)),
          F.parameterGerm hu = F.parameterGerm hu'}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let n := 2 * Fintype.card (μ ⊕ μ) + 1
  obtain ⟨t, s, ht, hrt, hs, hrs, hcross, hfresh⟩ :=
    exists_joint_fresh_genericSamples M hM a b n n
  let L := adjoin k ((⋃ i, range (t i)) ∪ ⋃ i, range (s i))
  have htL : HasGenericSamples L a (Fintype.card (μ ⊕ μ)) :=
    ⟨n, t, ht, hrt, le_rfl, fun i ↦ (subset_iUnion (fun j ↦ range (t j)) i).trans
      (subset_union_left.trans (subset_adjoin k _))⟩
  have hn : 2 * Fintype.card μ + 1 ≤ n := by
    simp only [n, Fintype.card_sum]
    omega
  have hsL : HasGenericSamples L b (Fintype.card μ) :=
    ⟨n, s, hs, hrs, hn, fun i ↦ (subset_iUnion (fun j ↦ range (s j)) i).trans
      (subset_union_right.trans (subset_adjoin k _))⟩
  have hfield : adjoin k (⋃ i, range (s i)) ≤ L :=
    adjoin_le_iff.2 (subset_union_right.trans (subset_adjoin k _))
  have hA := IsConstructibleOver.of_le_intermediateField hfield
    (F.isConstructibleOver_admissible a b hdim s hs hrs
      (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hn))
  have hI := IsConstructibleOver.of_le_intermediateField hfield
    (F.isConstructibleOver_invertibleAdmissible a b hdim s hs hrs
      (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hn))
  let w₁ : Word k (μ ⊕ μ) a b := .fwd .nil b F Sum.inl hdim
  let w₂ : Word k (μ ⊕ μ) a b := .fwd .nil b F Sum.inr hdim
  have hw₁ : w₁.HasSamples L := ⟨trivial, hsL⟩
  have hw₂ : w₂.HasSamples L := ⟨trivial, hsL⟩
  have hE := Word.isConstructibleOver_germ_eq w₁ w₂ hw₁ hw₂ htL
  refine ⟨t, s, ht, hrt, hs, hrs, hcross, hfresh, hA, hI, ?_⟩
  convert hE using 1
  ext v
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, w₁, w₂, Word.IsGerm]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hu, hu', heq⟩
    refine ⟨F.parameterGerm hu, ⟨Germ.id a, hu, rfl, (Germ.comp_id _).symm⟩,
      ⟨Germ.id a, hu', rfl, ?_⟩⟩
    rw [Germ.comp_id]
    exact heq
  · rintro ⟨g, ⟨g₁, hu, rfl, h₁⟩, ⟨g₂, hu', rfl, h₂⟩⟩
    rw [Germ.comp_id] at h₁ h₂
    exact ⟨hu, hu', h₁.symm.trans h₂⟩

name: GroupConfig.Word.finite_of_mem_sampleReqs
statement:
theorem finite_of_mem_sampleReqs {κ : Type v} {b : κ → K} (w : Word k P a b)
    {r : Σ τ : Type v, (τ → K) × ℕ} (hr : r ∈ w.sampleReqs) : Finite r.1
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [sampleReqs] at hr
  | @fwd κ' τ μ _ _ _ b w c F ρ hdim ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hr with rfl | hr
    · exact inferInstanceAs (Finite τ)
    · exact ih hr
  | @inv κ' τ μ _ _ _ b w c F ρ hdim ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hr with rfl | hr
    · exact inferInstanceAs (Finite κ')
    · exact ih hr

name: GroupConfig.Word.hasSamples_iff
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [HasSamples, sampleReqs]
  | fwd w c F ρ hdim ih =>
    simp only [HasSamples, sampleReqs, List.forall_mem_cons, ih]
    exact and_comm
  | inv w c F ρ hdim ih =>
    simp only [HasSamples, sampleReqs, List.forall_mem_cons, ih]
    exact and_comm

name: GroupConfig.HasGenericSamples.of_le
statement:
theorem HasGenericSamples.of_le {L : IntermediateField k K} {κ : Type*} {b : κ → K} {N N' : ℕ}
    (h : HasGenericSamples L b N) (hN : N' ≤ N) : HasGenericSamples L b N'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, t, ht, hr, hn, htL⟩ := h
  exact ⟨n, t, ht, hr, by omega, htL⟩

name: GroupConfig.exists_fresh_samples_reqs
statement:
theorem exists_fresh_samples_reqs (R : List (Σ τ : Type v, (τ → K) × ℕ))
    (hR : ∀ r ∈ R, Finite r.1) (M : IntermediateField k K) (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K)) :
    ∃ S : Set K, S.Finite ∧ IndepOver k ∅ S (M : Set K) ∧
      (∀ r ∈ R, HasGenericSamples (adjoin k S) r.2.1 r.2.2) ∧
      ∃ T : List (Σ τ : Type v, (τ → K) × (τ → K)),
        (∀ p ∈ T, (∃ N, (⟨p.1, p.2.1, N⟩ : Σ τ : Type v, (τ → K) × ℕ) ∈ R) ∧
          IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) p.2.1 p.2.2) ∧
        S = (⋃ p ∈ T, range p.2.2) ∧
        erk k ∅ S = (T.map fun p ↦ erk k ∅ (range p.2.2)).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction R with
  | nil =>
    refine ⟨∅, finite_empty, ?_, by simp, [], by simp, by simp, by simp [erk_empty]⟩
    intro s hs _
    obtain rfl : s = ∅ := subset_empty_iff.1 hs
    simp only [erk_empty]
  | cons r R ih =>
    obtain ⟨S, hS, hfresh, hreq, T, hT, hSeq, hrk⟩ :=
      ih fun r' hr' ↦ hR r' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hr')
    have _ : Finite r.1 := hR r List.mem_cons_self
    have hN : IsSmall k ((racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ S) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
      (hM.union (IsSmall.of_finite hS)).racl
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hrt, htfresh⟩ := exists_fresh_genericSamples _ hN r.2.1 (2 * r.2.2 + 1)
    let B : Set K := ⋃ i, range (t i)
    have hB : B.Finite := finite_iUnion fun i ↦ finite_range (t i)
    have hBSM : IndepOver k ∅ B (S ∪ (M : Set K)) := by
      rw [union_comm]
      exact htfresh.mono_right (subset_racl k _)
    
    have hbot (X : Set K) : erk k ((⊥ : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) X = erk k ∅ X :=
      erk_congr_base k (le_antisymm
        (racl_le_of_subset_racl (bot_le : (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) ≤ racl k ∅))
        (racl_mono (empty_subset _))) X
    refine ⟨S ∪ B, hS.union hB, by simpa only [union_comm] using hfresh.union_left hBSM, ?_,
      T ++ List.ofFn (fun i ↦ ⟨r.1, r.2.1, t i⟩), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro r' hr'
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hr' with rfl | hr'
      · exact ⟨_, t, ht, hrt, le_rfl, fun i ↦ (subset_iUnion (fun j ↦ range (t j)) i).trans
          (subset_union_right.trans (subset_adjoin k _))⟩
      · exact (hreq r' hr').mono (adjoin.mono k _ _ subset_union_left)
    · intro p hp
      rcases List.mem_append.1 hp with hp | hp
      · obtain ⟨⟨N, hN⟩, hgen⟩ := hT p hp
        exact ⟨⟨N, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hN⟩, hgen⟩
      · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.1 hp
        exact ⟨⟨r.2.2, List.mem_cons_self⟩, ht i⟩
    · rw [hSeq]
      ext x
      simp only [mem_union, mem_iUnion, List.mem_append, List.mem_ofFn, exists_prop, B]
      constructor
      · rintro (⟨p, hp, hx⟩ | ⟨i, hx⟩)
        · exact ⟨p, Or.inl hp, hx⟩
        · exact ⟨⟨r.1, r.2.1, t i⟩, Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩, hx⟩
      · rintro ⟨p, hp | ⟨i, rfl⟩, hx⟩
        · exact Or.inl ⟨p, hp, hx⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨i, hx⟩
    · have hBS : IndepOver k ∅ B S := hBSM.mono_right subset_union_left
      rw [erk_union_eq, hBS.erk_eq (subset_refl _) hB, hrk, List.map_append,
        List.sum_append, List.map_ofFn, List.sum_ofFn, ← hbot, hrt]
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, hbot]

name: GroupConfig.exists_fresh_genericSamples_over_adjoin
statement:
theorem exists_fresh_genericSamples_over_adjoin (M₀ : IntermediateField k K)
    (hM₀ : IsSmall k (M₀ : Set K)) {S₀ : Set K} (hS₀ : S₀.Finite)
    (hfresh₀ : IndepOver k ∅ S₀ (M₀ : Set K)) {μ : Type*} [Finite μ] (c : μ → K) (r : ℕ) :
    ∃ t : Fin r → μ → K,
      (∀ i, IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) c (t i)) ∧
      (∀ i, IsGenericOver (adjoin k S₀) c (t i)) ∧
      erk k (adjoin k S₀ : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t i)) =
        ∑ i, erk k (adjoin k S₀ : Set K) (range (t i)) ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t i)) (M₀ : Set K) ∧
      erk k ∅ (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t i)) = erk k ∅ S₀ + ∑ i, erk k ∅ (range (t i))
proof:
:= by
  have hN : IsSmall k ((racl k ((M₀ : Set K) ∪ S₀) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (hM₀.union (IsSmall.of_finite hS₀)).racl
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hrt, htfresh⟩ := exists_fresh_genericSamples _ hN c r
  set T : Set K := ⋃ i, range (t i)
  have hT : T.Finite := finite_iUnion fun i ↦ finite_range (t i)
  have hbot (X : Set K) : erk k ((⊥ : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) X = erk k ∅ X :=
    erk_congr_base k (le_antisymm
      (racl_le_of_subset_racl (bot_le : (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) ≤ racl k ∅))
      (racl_mono (empty_subset _))) X
  
  have hL₀ : IsSmall k ((adjoin k S₀ : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (IsSmall.of_finite hS₀).racl.mono (adjoin_le_racl k S₀)
  have hL₀N : ((adjoin k S₀ : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) ⊆
      racl k ((M₀ : Set K) ∪ S₀) :=
    (adjoin_le_racl k S₀).trans (racl_mono subset_union_right)
  have hTL : IndepOver k ∅ T (adjoin k S₀ : Set K) := htfresh.mono_right hL₀N
  have hTi (i : Fin r) : IndepOver k ∅ (range (t i)) (adjoin k S₀ : Set K) :=
    hTL.mono_left (subset_iUnion (fun j ↦ range (t j)) i)
  have hsum : erk k ∅ T = ∑ i, erk k ∅ (range (t i)) := by
    rw [← hbot T, hrt]
    simp only [hbot]
  refine ⟨t, ht, fun i ↦ (ht i).isGen.isGenericOver_of_indepOver hL₀ (hTi i), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← empty_union (adjoin k S₀ : Set K), hTL.erk_eq (subset_refl _) hT, hsum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
    rw [(hTi i).erk_eq (subset_refl _) (finite_range _)]
  · have hTSM : IndepOver k ∅ T (S₀ ∪ (M₀ : Set K)) := by
      rw [union_comm]
      exact htfresh.mono_right (subset_racl k _)
    simpa only [union_comm] using hfresh₀.union_left hTSM
  · have hTS : IndepOver k ∅ T S₀ :=
      htfresh.mono_right (subset_union_right.trans (subset_racl k _))
    rw [erk_union_eq, hTS.erk_eq (subset_refl _) hT, hsum]

name: GroupConfig.exists_groupSamples
statement:
theorem exists_groupSamples (M₀ : IntermediateField k K) (hM₀ : IsSmall k (M₀ : Set K))
    {ι κ μ : Type v} [Finite ι] [Finite κ] [Finite μ] (a : ι → K) (a' : κ → K) (c : μ → K)
    (Na Na' r : ℕ) :
    ∃ (S₀ : Set K) (t₁ : Fin r → μ → K),
      S₀.Finite ∧ IndepOver k ∅ S₀ (M₀ : Set K) ∧
      (∃ T : List (Σ τ : Type v, (τ → K) × (τ → K)),
        (∀ p ∈ T, ((⟨p.1, p.2.1⟩ : Σ τ : Type v, τ → K) = ⟨ι, a⟩ ∨
            (⟨p.1, p.2.1⟩ : Σ τ : Type v, τ → K) = ⟨κ, a'⟩) ∧
          IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) p.2.1 p.2.2) ∧
        S₀ = (⋃ p ∈ T, range p.2.2) ∧
        erk k ∅ S₀ = (T.map fun p ↦ erk k ∅ (range p.2.2)).sum) ∧
      HasGenericSamples (adjoin k S₀) a Na ∧ HasGenericSamples (adjoin k S₀) a' Na' ∧
      (∀ i, IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) c (t₁ i)) ∧
      (∀ i, IsGenericOver (adjoin k S₀) c (t₁ i)) ∧
      erk k (adjoin k S₀ : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) =
        ∑ i, erk k (adjoin k S₀ : Set K) (range (t₁ i)) ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) (M₀ : Set K) ∧
      erk k ∅ (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) = erk k ∅ S₀ + ∑ i, erk k ∅ (range (t₁ i)) ∧
      adjoin k ((adjoin k S₀ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) =
        adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))
proof:
:= by
  let R : List (Σ τ : Type v, (τ → K) × ℕ) := [⟨ι, a, Na⟩, ⟨κ, a', Na'⟩]
  have hR : ∀ q ∈ R, Finite q.1 := by
    intro q hq
    simp only [R, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hq
    rcases hq with rfl | rfl
    · exact inferInstanceAs (Finite ι)
    · exact inferInstanceAs (Finite κ)
  obtain ⟨S₀, hS₀, hfresh₀, hreq, T, hT, hSeq, hrk⟩ := exists_fresh_samples_reqs R hR M₀ hM₀
  obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁, ht₁L, hadd, hfresh, hrk₁⟩ :=
    exists_fresh_genericSamples_over_adjoin M₀ hM₀ hS₀ hfresh₀ c r
  refine ⟨S₀, t₁, hS₀, hfresh₀, ⟨T, fun p hp ↦ ⟨?_, (hT p hp).2⟩, hSeq, hrk⟩,
    hreq _ List.mem_cons_self, hreq _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ List.mem_cons_self),
    ht₁, ht₁L, hadd, hfresh, hrk₁, ?_⟩
  · 
    let pr (q : Σ τ : Type v, (τ → K) × ℕ) : Σ τ : Type v, τ → K := ⟨q.1, q.2.1⟩
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := (hT p hp).1
    simp only [R, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hN
    rcases hN with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (congrArg pr h)
    · exact Or.inr (congrArg pr h)
  · refine le_antisymm (adjoin_le_iff.2 (union_subset (adjoin.mono k _ _ subset_union_left)
      (subset_union_right.trans (subset_adjoin k _)))) ?_
    exact adjoin.mono k _ _ (union_subset_union_left _ (subset_adjoin k S₀))

name: GroupConfig.isConstructibleOver_forall_invertibleAdmissible
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_forall_invertibleAdmissible {E : Type*} [Finite E] {P : Type*}
    {μ ι κ : E → Type v} [∀ e, Fintype (μ e)] [∀ e, Finite (ι e)] [∀ e, Finite (κ e)]
    {a : ∀ e, ι e → K} {b : ∀ e, κ e → K} (F : ∀ e, QuasiRational k (μ e ⊕ ι e) (κ e))
    (ρ : ∀ e, μ e → P) (hdim : ∀ e, erk k ∅ (range (a e)) = erk k ∅ (range (b e)))
    {L : IntermediateField k K} (hL : ∀ e, HasGenericSamples L (b e) (Fintype.card (μ e))) :
    IsConstructibleOver (↥L) {u : P → K | ∀ e, ∃ hu : (F e).IsAdmissible (a e) (b e) (u ∘ ρ e),
      Germ.IsInvertible ((F e).parameterGerm hu)}
proof:
:= by
  have h (e : E) : IsConstructibleOver (↥L) ((fun u : P → K ↦ u ∘ ρ e) ⁻¹'
      {v | ∃ hu : (F e).IsAdmissible (a e) (b e) v,
        Germ.IsInvertible ((F e).parameterGerm hu)}) := by
    obtain ⟨n, t, ht, hind, hn, htL⟩ := hL e
    exact (IsConstructibleOver.of_le_intermediateField (adjoin_le_iff.2 (iUnion_subset htL))
      ((F e).isConstructibleOver_invertibleAdmissible (a e) (b e) (hdim e) t ht hind
        (by rwa [Fintype.card_fin]))).preimage_comp (ρ e)
  convert IsConstructibleOver.iInter h using 1
  ext u
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_preimage]

name: GroupConfig.Word.isConstructibleOver_sourceRelation
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_sourceRelation [Fintype P] {κ : Type v} [Finite κ] {b : κ → K}
    (w : Word k P a b) {μ' : Type v} [Fintype μ'] (F' : QuasiRational k (μ' ⊕ ι) κ)
    (ρ' : μ' → P) (hdim' : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range b))
    {E : Type*} [Finite E] {μ ιE κE : E → Type v} [∀ e, Fintype (μ e)] [∀ e, Finite (ιE e)]
    [∀ e, Finite (κE e)] {aE : ∀ e, ιE e → K} {bE : ∀ e, κE e → K}
    (F : ∀ e, QuasiRational k (μ e ⊕ ιE e) (κE e)) (ρ : ∀ e, μ e → P)
    (hdim : ∀ e, erk k ∅ (range (aE e)) = erk k ∅ (range (bE e)))
    {L : IntermediateField k K} (hw : w.HasSamples L)
    (hF' : HasGenericSamples L b (Fintype.card μ'))
    (ha : HasGenericSamples L a (Fintype.card P))
    (hE : ∀ e, HasGenericSamples L (bE e) (Fintype.card (μ e))) :
    IsConstructibleOver (↥L) {u : P → K |
      (∀ e, ∃ hu : (F e).IsAdmissible (aE e) (bE e) (u ∘ ρ e),
        Germ.IsInvertible ((F e).parameterGerm hu)) ∧
      w.IsInvertiblyAdmissible u ∧
      ∃ hu' : F'.IsAdmissible a b (u ∘ ρ'), w.IsGerm u (F'.parameterGerm hu')}
proof:
:=
  (isConstructibleOver_forall_invertibleAdmissible F ρ hdim hE).inter
    (w.isConstructibleOver_eq_parameterGerm F' ρ' hdim' hw hF' ha)

name: GroupConfig.Word.exists_fresh_constructible_family
statement:
theorem Word.exists_fresh_constructible_family {J : Type*} [Finite J] {P : J → Type u₃}
    {ι κ μ' : J → Type v} [∀ j, Finite (ι j)] [∀ j, Finite (κ j)] [∀ j, Finite (P j)]
    [∀ j, Finite (μ' j)] {a : ∀ j, ι j → K} {b : ∀ j, κ j → K}
    (w : ∀ j, Word k (P j) (a j) (b j)) (F' : ∀ j, QuasiRational k (μ' j ⊕ ι j) (κ j))
    (ρ' : ∀ j, μ' j → P j) (hdim' : ∀ j, erk k ∅ (range (a j)) = erk k ∅ (range (b j)))
    (M : IntermediateField k K) (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K)) :
    ∃ S : Set K, S.Finite ∧ IndepOver k ∅ S (M : Set K) ∧
      (∃ T : List (Σ τ : Type v, (τ → K) × (τ → K)),
        (∀ p ∈ T, (∃ j N, (⟨p.1, p.2.1, N⟩ : Σ τ : Type v, (τ → K) × ℕ) ∈ (w j).sampleReqs ∨
            (⟨p.1, p.2.1⟩ : Σ τ : Type v, τ → K) = ⟨κ j, b j⟩ ∨
            (⟨p.1, p.2.1⟩ : Σ τ : Type v, τ → K) = ⟨ι j, a j⟩) ∧
          IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) p.2.1 p.2.2) ∧
        S = (⋃ p ∈ T, range p.2.2) ∧
        erk k ∅ S = (T.map fun p ↦ erk k ∅ (range p.2.2)).sum) ∧
      ∀ j, IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k S)) {u : P j → K | (w j).IsInvertiblyAdmissible u ∧
        ∃ hu' : (F' j).IsAdmissible (a j) (b j) (u ∘ ρ' j),
          (w j).IsGerm u ((F' j).parameterGerm hu')}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ (j : J) : Fintype (P j) := Fintype.ofFinite (P j)
  let _ (j : J) : Fintype (μ' j) := Fintype.ofFinite (μ' j)
  let e := Finite.equivFin J
  let reqs (j : J) : List (Σ τ : Type v, (τ → K) × ℕ) := (w j).sampleReqs ++
    [⟨κ j, b j, Fintype.card (μ' j)⟩, ⟨ι j, a j, Fintype.card (P j)⟩]
  let R : List (Σ τ : Type v, (τ → K) × ℕ) := (List.ofFn fun i ↦ reqs (e.symm i)).flatten
  have hmem {j : J} {r : Σ τ : Type v, (τ → K) × ℕ} (hr : r ∈ reqs j) : r ∈ R :=
    List.mem_flatten.2 ⟨reqs j, List.mem_ofFn.2 ⟨e j, by simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]⟩, hr⟩
  have hR : ∀ r ∈ R, Finite r.1 := by
    intro r hr
    obtain ⟨l, hl, hrl⟩ := List.mem_flatten.1 hr
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.1 hl
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hrl with hr' | hr'
    · exact (w (e.symm i)).finite_of_mem_sampleReqs hr'
    · simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hr'
      rcases hr' with rfl | rfl
      · exact inferInstanceAs (Finite (κ (e.symm i)))
      · exact inferInstanceAs (Finite (ι (e.symm i)))
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hfresh, hreq, T, hT, hSeq, hrk⟩ := exists_fresh_samples_reqs R hR M hM
  refine ⟨S, hS, hfresh, ⟨T, fun p hp ↦ ⟨?_, (hT p hp).2⟩, hSeq, hrk⟩, fun j ↦ ?_⟩
  · 
    let pr (r : Σ τ : Type v, (τ → K) × ℕ) : Σ τ : Type v, τ → K := ⟨r.1, r.2.1⟩
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := (hT p hp).1
    obtain ⟨l, hl, hrl⟩ := List.mem_flatten.1 hN
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.1 hl
    refine ⟨e.symm i, N, ?_⟩
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hrl with h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at h
      rcases h with h | h
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (congrArg pr h))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (congrArg pr h))
  have hw : (w j).HasSamples (adjoin k S) :=
    (w j).hasSamples_iff.2 fun r hr ↦ hreq r (hmem (List.mem_append_left _ hr))
  have hF' : HasGenericSamples (adjoin k S) (b j) (Fintype.card (μ' j)) :=
    hreq _ (hmem (List.mem_append_right _ List.mem_cons_self))
  have ha : HasGenericSamples (adjoin k S) (a j) (Fintype.card (P j)) :=
    hreq _ (hmem (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ List.mem_cons_self)))
  exact (w j).isConstructibleOver_eq_parameterGerm (F' j) (ρ' j) (hdim' j) hw hF' ha

name: GroupConfig.Word.exists_fresh_constructible_sourceRelation_family
statement:
theorem Word.exists_fresh_constructible_sourceRelation_family {E : Type*} [Finite E]
    {μE ιE κE : E → Type v} [∀ e, Finite (μE e)] [∀ e, Finite (ιE e)] [∀ e, Finite (κE e)]
    {aE : ∀ e, ιE e → K} {bE : ∀ e, κE e → K} (FE : ∀ e, QuasiRational k (μE e ⊕ ιE e) (κE e))
    (hdimE : ∀ e, erk k ∅ (range (aE e)) = erk k ∅ (range (bE e)))
    {J : Type*} [Finite J] {P : J → Type u₃} {ι κ μ' : J → Type v} [∀ j, Finite (ι j)]
    [∀ j, Finite (κ j)] [∀ j, Finite (P j)] [∀ j, Finite (μ' j)] {a : ∀ j, ι j → K}
    {b : ∀ j, κ j → K} (w : ∀ j, Word k (P j) (a j) (b j))
    (F' : ∀ j, QuasiRational k (μ' j ⊕ ι j) (κ j)) (ρ' : ∀ j, μ' j → P j)
    (hdim' : ∀ j, erk k ∅ (range (a j)) = erk k ∅ (range (b j)))
    (ρE : ∀ j e, μE e → P j) (M : IntermediateField k K) (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K)) :
    ∃ S : Set K, S.Finite ∧ IndepOver k ∅ S (M : Set K) ∧
      (∃ T : List (Σ τ : Type v, (τ → K) × (τ → K)),
        (∀ p ∈ T, ((∃ j N, (⟨p.1, p.2.1, N⟩ : Σ τ : Type v, (τ → K) × ℕ) ∈ (w j).sampleReqs ∨
            (⟨p.1, p.2.1⟩ : Σ τ : Type v, τ → K) = ⟨κ j, b j⟩ ∨
            (⟨p.1, p.2.1⟩ : Σ τ : Type v, τ → K) = ⟨ι j, a j⟩) ∨
            ∃ e, (⟨p.1, p.2.1⟩ : Σ τ : Type v, τ → K) = ⟨κE e, bE e⟩) ∧
          IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) p.2.1 p.2.2) ∧
        S = (⋃ p ∈ T, range p.2.2) ∧
        erk k ∅ S = (T.map fun p ↦ erk k ∅ (range p.2.2)).sum) ∧
      ∀ j, IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k S)) {u : P j → K |
        (∀ e, ∃ hu : (FE e).IsAdmissible (aE e) (bE e) (u ∘ ρE j e),
          Germ.IsInvertible ((FE e).parameterGerm hu)) ∧
        (w j).IsInvertiblyAdmissible u ∧
        ∃ hu' : (F' j).IsAdmissible (a j) (b j) (u ∘ ρ' j),
          (w j).IsGerm u ((F' j).parameterGerm hu')}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ (j : J) : Fintype (P j) := Fintype.ofFinite (P j)
  let _ (j : J) : Fintype (μ' j) := Fintype.ofFinite (μ' j)
  let _ (x : E) : Fintype (μE x) := Fintype.ofFinite (μE x)
  let e := Finite.equivFin J
  let eE := Finite.equivFin E
  let reqs (j : J) : List (Σ τ : Type v, (τ → K) × ℕ) := (w j).sampleReqs ++
    [⟨κ j, b j, Fintype.card (μ' j)⟩, ⟨ι j, a j, Fintype.card (P j)⟩]
  
  let D : List (Σ τ : Type v, (τ → K) × ℕ) :=
    List.ofFn fun i ↦ ⟨κE (eE.symm i), bE (eE.symm i), Fintype.card (μE (eE.symm i))⟩
  let R : List (Σ τ : Type v, (τ → K) × ℕ) := (List.ofFn fun i ↦ reqs (e.symm i)).flatten ++ D
  have hmem {j : J} {r : Σ τ : Type v, (τ → K) × ℕ} (hr : r ∈ reqs j) : r ∈ R :=
    List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_flatten.2
      ⟨reqs j, List.mem_ofFn.2 ⟨e j, by simp only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]⟩, hr⟩)
  have hmemE (x : E) : (⟨κE x, bE x, Fintype.card (μE x)⟩ : Σ τ : Type v, (τ → K) × ℕ) ∈ R :=
    List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_ofFn.2 ⟨eE x, by rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]⟩)
  have hR : ∀ r ∈ R, Finite r.1 := by
    intro r hr
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hr with hr | hr
    · obtain ⟨l, hl, hrl⟩ := List.mem_flatten.1 hr
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.1 hl
      rcases List.mem_append.1 hrl with hr' | hr'
      · exact (w (e.symm i)).finite_of_mem_sampleReqs hr'
      · simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hr'
        rcases hr' with rfl | rfl
        · exact inferInstanceAs (Finite (κ (e.symm i)))
