        · exact inferInstanceAs (Finite (ι (e.symm i)))
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.1 hr
      exact inferInstanceAs (Finite (κE (eE.symm i)))
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hfresh, hreq, T, hT, hSeq, hrk⟩ := exists_fresh_samples_reqs R hR M hM
  refine ⟨S, hS, hfresh, ⟨T, fun p hp ↦ ⟨?_, (hT p hp).2⟩, hSeq, hrk⟩, fun j ↦ ?_⟩
  · 
    let pr (r : Σ τ : Type v, (τ → K) × ℕ) : Σ τ : Type v, τ → K := ⟨r.1, r.2.1⟩
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := (hT p hp).1
    rcases List.mem_append.1 hN with hN | hN
    · obtain ⟨l, hl, hrl⟩ := List.mem_flatten.1 hN
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.1 hl
      refine Or.inl ⟨e.symm i, N, ?_⟩
      rcases List.mem_append.1 hrl with h | h
      · exact Or.inl h
      · simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at h
        rcases h with h | h
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (congrArg pr h))
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (congrArg pr h))
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.1 hN
      exact Or.inr ⟨eE.symm i, (congrArg pr hi).symm⟩
  have hw : (w j).HasSamples (adjoin k S) :=
    (w j).hasSamples_iff.2 fun r hr ↦ hreq r (hmem (List.mem_append_left _ hr))
  have hF' : HasGenericSamples (adjoin k S) (b j) (Fintype.card (μ' j)) :=
    hreq _ (hmem (List.mem_append_right _ List.mem_cons_self))
  have ha : HasGenericSamples (adjoin k S) (a j) (Fintype.card (P j)) :=
    hreq _ (hmem (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ List.mem_cons_self)))
  exact (w j).isConstructibleOver_sourceRelation (F' j) (ρ' j) (hdim' j) FE (ρE j) hdimE hw hF'
    ha fun x ↦ hreq _ (hmemE x)

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isConstructibleOver_pairSpaceKernel
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_pairSpaceKernel
    (hsrc : HasGenericSamples L₀ a (Fintype.card ((((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ μ) ⊕ μ)))
    (hr : 2 * Fintype.card (((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ ι) + 1 ≤ Fintype.card α)
    (hD : IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k (((L₀ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (t i)) ∪ range y₀)))
      (F.pairDomain M c a a')) :
    IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k (((L₀ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (t i)) ∪ range y₀)))
      {d : ((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) → K |
        ∃ (hL : d ∘ Sum.inl ∈ F.pairDomain M c a a')
          (hR : d ∘ Sum.inr ∈ F.pairDomain M c a a'),
          F.pairDomainSpaceMap M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim hy₀ ⟨d ∘ Sum.inl, hL⟩ =
            F.pairDomainSpaceMap M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim hy₀ ⟨d ∘ Sum.inr, hR⟩}
proof:
:= by
  let hw := hb.isHW hδ₀
  let ρ := F.pairDomainMap M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim
  let D := {d : ((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) → K |
    d ∘ Sum.inl ∈ F.pairDomain M c a a' ∧ d ∘ Sum.inr ∈ F.pairDomain M c a a'}
  let Γ : D → ↥hw.prodSubgroup := fun d ↦
    (ρ ⟨d.val ∘ Sum.inl, d.property.1⟩)⁻¹ * ρ ⟨d.val ∘ Sum.inr, d.property.2⟩
  have hDD : IsConstructibleOver
      (↥(adjoin k (((L₀ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (t i)) ∪ range y₀))) D :=
    (hD.preimage_comp Sum.inl).inter (hD.preimage_comp Sum.inr)
  have hrep : ∀ d : D, (F.spaceKernelWord hdim).IsGerm d (hw.val (Γ d)) := by
    intro d
    change (F.spaceKernelWord hdim).IsGerm d.val
      (hw.val ((ρ ⟨d.val ∘ Sum.inl, d.property.1⟩)⁻¹ *
        ρ ⟨d.val ∘ Sum.inr, d.property.2⟩))
    rw [hw.val_mul, F.val_pairDomainMap_inv M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim,
      F.val_pairDomainMap M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim]
    exact F.isGerm_spaceKernelWord hdim d.property.1.choose d.property.2.choose
  have hInv : ∀ d : D, (F.spaceKernelWord hdim).IsInvertiblyAdmissible d := fun d ↦
    (F.isInvertiblyAdmissible_spaceKernelWord_iff hdim d).2
      ⟨d.property.1.choose, d.property.2.choose⟩
  have hS := F.isConstructibleOver_wordStabilizer c (F.spaceKernelWord hdim) hdim hb hδ₀ hc hF
    hL₀ (F.hasSamples_spaceKernelWord hdim hFt) hFt hsrc t ht hind hr hy₀ hDD Γ hrep hInv
  convert hS using 1
  ext d
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hL, hR, heq⟩
    refine ⟨⟨hL, hR⟩, ?_⟩
    change ((ρ ⟨d ∘ Sum.inl, hL⟩)⁻¹ * ρ ⟨d ∘ Sum.inr, hR⟩) • hw.iota hy₀ = hw.iota hy₀
    rw [mul_smul, inv_smul_eq_iff]
    exact heq.symm
  · rintro ⟨hd, hfix⟩
    refine ⟨hd.1, hd.2, ?_⟩
    change ((ρ ⟨d ∘ Sum.inl, hd.1⟩)⁻¹ * ρ ⟨d ∘ Sum.inr, hd.2⟩) • hw.iota hy₀ =
      hw.iota hy₀ at hfix
    rw [mul_smul, inv_smul_eq_iff] at hfix
    exact hfix.symm

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isConstructibleOver_pairSpaceAction
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_pairSpaceAction
    (hsrc : HasGenericSamples L₀ a
      (Fintype.card (((((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ μ) ⊕ μ)))
    (hr : 2 * Fintype.card ((((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ ι) + 1 ≤ Fintype.card α)
    (hD : IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k (((L₀ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (t i)) ∪ range y₀)))
      (F.pairDomain M c a a')) :
    IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k (((L₀ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (t i)) ∪ range y₀)))
      {d : (((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) → K |
        ∃ (hG : (d ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl ∈ F.pairDomain M c a a')
          (hX : (d ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr ∈ F.pairDomain M c a a')
          (hT : d ∘ Sum.inr ∈ F.pairDomain M c a a'),
          F.pairDomainMap M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim ⟨(d ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl, hG⟩ •
            F.pairDomainSpaceMap M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim hy₀ ⟨(d ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr, hX⟩ =
              F.pairDomainSpaceMap M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim hy₀ ⟨d ∘ Sum.inr, hT⟩}
proof:
:= by
  let hw := hb.isHW hδ₀
  let ρ := F.pairDomainMap M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim
  let D := {d : (((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) → K |
    (d ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl ∈ F.pairDomain M c a a' ∧
      (d ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr ∈ F.pairDomain M c a a' ∧
        d ∘ Sum.inr ∈ F.pairDomain M c a a'}
  let Γ : D → ↥hw.prodSubgroup := fun d ↦
    (ρ ⟨d.val ∘ Sum.inr, d.property.2.2⟩)⁻¹ *
      (ρ ⟨(d.val ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl, d.property.1⟩ *
        ρ ⟨(d.val ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr, d.property.2.1⟩)
  have hDD : IsConstructibleOver
      (↥(adjoin k (((L₀ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (t i)) ∪ range y₀))) D :=
    (hD.preimage_comp (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl)).inter
      ((hD.preimage_comp (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr)).inter (hD.preimage_comp Sum.inr))
  have hrep : ∀ d : D, (F.spaceActionWord hdim).IsGerm d (hw.val (Γ d)) := by
    intro d
    change (F.spaceActionWord hdim).IsGerm d.val
      (hw.val ((ρ ⟨d.val ∘ Sum.inr, d.property.2.2⟩)⁻¹ *
        (ρ ⟨(d.val ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl, d.property.1⟩ *
          ρ ⟨(d.val ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr, d.property.2.1⟩)))
    rw [hw.val_mul, hw.val_mul, F.val_pairDomainMap_inv M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim,
      F.val_pairDomainMap M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim,
      F.val_pairDomainMap M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim]
    exact F.isGerm_spaceActionWord hdim d.property.1.choose d.property.2.1.choose
      d.property.2.2.choose
  have hInv : ∀ d : D, (F.spaceActionWord hdim).IsInvertiblyAdmissible d := fun d ↦
    (F.isInvertiblyAdmissible_spaceActionWord_iff hdim d).2
      ⟨d.property.1.choose, d.property.2.1.choose, d.property.2.2.choose⟩
  have hS := F.isConstructibleOver_wordStabilizer c (F.spaceActionWord hdim) hdim hb hδ₀ hc hF
    hL₀ (F.hasSamples_spaceActionWord hdim hFt) hFt hsrc t ht hind hr hy₀ hDD Γ hrep hInv
  convert hS using 1
  ext d
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hG, hX, hT, heq⟩
    refine ⟨⟨hG, hX, hT⟩, ?_⟩
    change ((ρ ⟨d ∘ Sum.inr, hT⟩)⁻¹ *
      (ρ ⟨(d ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl, hG⟩ * ρ ⟨(d ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr, hX⟩)) •
      hw.iota hy₀ = hw.iota hy₀
    rw [mul_smul, inv_smul_eq_iff, mul_smul]
    exact heq
  · rintro ⟨hd, hfix⟩
    refine ⟨hd.1, hd.2.1, hd.2.2, ?_⟩
    change ((ρ ⟨d ∘ Sum.inr, hd.2.2⟩)⁻¹ *
      (ρ ⟨(d ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl, hd.1⟩ * ρ ⟨(d ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr, hd.2.1⟩)) •
      hw.iota hy₀ = hw.iota hy₀ at hfix
    rw [mul_smul, inv_smul_eq_iff, mul_smul] at hfix
    exact hfix

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.constructibleGSetPresentation_pairDomain
statement:
theorem constructibleGSetPresentation_pairDomain
    (hsrc : HasGenericSamples L₀ a
      (Fintype.card (((((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ μ) ⊕ μ)))
    (hr : 2 * Fintype.card ((((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ ι) + 1 ≤ Fintype.card α)
    (hG : ConstructibleGroupPresentation
      (adjoin k (((L₀ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (t i)) ∪ range y₀))
      (F.pairDomain M c a a') (F.pairDomainMap M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim)) :
    ConstructibleGSetPresentation (adjoin k (((L₀ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (t i)) ∪ range y₀))
      (F.pairDomain M c a a') (F.pairDomainMap M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim)
      (F.pairDomain M c a a') (F.pairDomainSpaceMap M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim hy₀)
proof:
:= by
  have hs6 : HasGenericSamples L₀ a
      (Fintype.card ((((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ μ) ⊕ μ)) :=
    hsrc.of_le (by simp only [Fintype.card_sum]; omega)
  have hr4 : 2 * Fintype.card (((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ ι) + 1 ≤ Fintype.card α := by
    simp only [Fintype.card_sum] at hr ⊢
    omega
  exact ⟨hG, hG.domain, F.pairDomainSpaceMap_surjective M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim hy₀,
    F.isConstructibleOver_pairSpaceKernel M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim hL₀ hFt t ht hind hy₀ hs6 hr4
      hG.domain,
    F.isConstructibleOver_pairSpaceAction M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim hL₀ hFt t ht hind hy₀ hsrc hr
      hG.domain⟩

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.exists_fresh_constructibleGroupSpacePresentation
statement:
theorem exists_fresh_constructibleGroupSpacePresentation
    (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ) {f₀ : Germ k a a'} (hb : Germ.IsHWBij f₀) {δ₀ : Germ k a a}
    (hδ₀ : δ₀ ∈ Germ.diffSet f₀) {c : μ → K} (hc : adjoin k (range c) = f₀.cb)
    (hF : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K, ∃ hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' (⇑σ ∘ c),
      F.parameterGerm hu = f₀.map σ)
    (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a')) (M₀ : IntermediateField k K)
    (hM₀ : IsSmall k (M₀ : Set K)) :
    ∃ (S₀ : Set K) (t₁ : Fin (2 * (6 * Fintype.card μ + Fintype.card ι) + 1) → μ → K),
      S₀.Finite ∧ IndepOver k ∅ S₀ (M₀ : Set K) ∧
      (∃ T : List (Σ τ : Type w, (τ → K) × (τ → K)),
        (∀ p ∈ T, ((⟨p.1, p.2.1⟩ : Σ τ : Type w, τ → K) = ⟨ι, a⟩ ∨
            (⟨p.1, p.2.1⟩ : Σ τ : Type w, τ → K) = ⟨κ, a'⟩) ∧
          IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) p.2.1 p.2.2) ∧
        S₀ = (⋃ p ∈ T, range p.2.2) ∧
        erk k ∅ S₀ = (T.map fun p ↦ erk k ∅ (range p.2.2)).sum) ∧
      HasGenericSamples (adjoin k S₀) a (8 * Fintype.card μ) ∧
      HasGenericSamples (adjoin k S₀) a' (Fintype.card μ) ∧
      (∀ i, IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) c (t₁ i)) ∧
      (∀ i, IsGenericOver (adjoin k S₀) c (t₁ i)) ∧
      erk k (adjoin k S₀ : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) =
        ∑ i, erk k (adjoin k S₀ : Set K) (range (t₁ i)) ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) (M₀ : Set K) ∧
      erk k ∅ (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) = erk k ∅ S₀ + ∑ i, erk k ∅ (range (t₁ i)) ∧
      ∃ hL : IsSmall k ((adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K),
        ConstructibleGroupPresentation (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)))
          (F.pairDomain (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) c a a')
          (F.pairDomainMap (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) hL hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim) ∧
        ∀ (y₀ : ι → K) (hy₀ : IsGen k a y₀),
          IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k ((S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) ∪ range y₀)))
            {d | ∃ hd : d ∈ F.pairDomain (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) c a a',
              F.pairDomainMap (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) hL hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim
                ⟨d, hd⟩ • (hb.isHW hδ₀).iota hy₀ = (hb.isHW hδ₀).iota hy₀} ∧
          ConstructibleGSetPresentation (adjoin k ((S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) ∪ range y₀))
            (F.pairDomain (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) c a a')
            (F.pairDomainMap (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) hL hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim)
            (F.pairDomain (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) c a a')
            (F.pairDomainSpaceMap (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) hL hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim
              hy₀)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S₀, t₁, hS₀, hfresh₀, hT, hsa, hsa', ht₁, ht₁L, hadd, hfresh, hrk, hL, hP, hH⟩ :=
    F.exists_fresh_constructibleGroupPresentation hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim M₀ hM₀
  have hL₀ : IsSmall k ((adjoin k S₀ : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (IsSmall.of_finite hS₀).racl.mono (adjoin_le_racl k S₀)
  have hsrc : HasGenericSamples (adjoin k S₀) a
      (Fintype.card (((((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ μ) ⊕ μ)) :=
    hsa.of_le (by simp only [Fintype.card_sum]; omega)
  have hr : 2 * Fintype.card ((((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ ι) + 1 ≤
      Fintype.card (Fin (2 * (6 * Fintype.card μ + Fintype.card ι) + 1)) := by
    simp only [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_fin]
    omega
  refine ⟨S₀, t₁, hS₀, hfresh₀, hT, hsa, hsa', ht₁, ht₁L, hadd, hfresh, hrk, hL, hP,
    fun y₀ hy₀ ↦ ⟨hH y₀ hy₀, ?_⟩⟩
  have hfield : adjoin k (((adjoin k S₀ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) ∪ range y₀) =
      adjoin k ((S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) ∪ range y₀) := by
    simp only [adjoin_union, adjoin_self]
  have hGE : ConstructibleGroupPresentation
      (adjoin k (((adjoin k S₀ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) ∪ range y₀))
      (F.pairDomain (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) c a a')
      (F.pairDomainMap (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) hL hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim) := by
    rw [hfield]
    exact ConstructibleGroupPresentation.of_le (adjoin.mono k _ _ subset_union_left) hP
  have h := F.constructibleGSetPresentation_pairDomain (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)))
    hL hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim hL₀ hsa' t₁ ht₁L hadd hy₀ hsrc hr hGE
  rw [hfield] at h
  exact h

name: GroupConfig.IsConstructibleOver.empty
statement: theorem IsConstructibleOver.empty : IsConstructibleOver k (∅ : Set (ι → K))
proof:
:=
  ⟨∅, .empty, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.IsConstructibleOver.univ
statement: theorem IsConstructibleOver.univ : IsConstructibleOver k (Set.univ : Set (ι → K))
proof:
:=
  ⟨Set.univ, .univ, rfl⟩

name: GroupConfig.IsConstructibleOver.union
statement:
theorem IsConstructibleOver.union (hs : IsConstructibleOver k s)
    (ht : IsConstructibleOver k t) :
    IsConstructibleOver k (s ∪ t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, rfl⟩ := hs
  obtain ⟨D, hD, rfl⟩ := ht
  exact ⟨C ∪ D, hC.union hD, Set.preimage_union.symm⟩

name: GroupConfig.IsConstructibleOver.inter
statement:
theorem IsConstructibleOver.inter (hs : IsConstructibleOver k s)
    (ht : IsConstructibleOver k t) :
    IsConstructibleOver k (s ∩ t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, rfl⟩ := hs
  obtain ⟨D, hD, rfl⟩ := ht
  exact ⟨C ∩ D, hC.inter hD, Set.preimage_inter.symm⟩

name: GroupConfig.IsConstructibleOver.compl
statement:
theorem IsConstructibleOver.compl (hs : IsConstructibleOver k s) :
    IsConstructibleOver k sᶜ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, rfl⟩ := hs
  exact ⟨Cᶜ, hC.compl, Set.preimage_compl.symm⟩

name: GroupConfig.IsConstructibleOver.iUnion
statement:
theorem IsConstructibleOver.iUnion {α : Type*} [Finite α] {s : α → Set (ι → K)}
    (hs : ∀ i, IsConstructibleOver k (s i)) : IsConstructibleOver k (⋃ i, s i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose C hC heq using hs
  refine ⟨⋃ i, C i, .iUnion hC, ?_⟩
  rw [Set.preimage_iUnion]
  exact congrArg (fun f ↦ ⋃ i, f i) (funext heq)

name: GroupConfig.IsConstructibleOver.iInter
statement:
theorem IsConstructibleOver.iInter {α : Type*} [Finite α] {s : α → Set (ι → K)}
    (hs : ∀ i, IsConstructibleOver k (s i)) : IsConstructibleOver k (⋂ i, s i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose C hC heq using hs
  refine ⟨⋂ i, C i, .iInter hC, ?_⟩
  rw [Set.preimage_iInter]
  exact congrArg (fun f ↦ ⋂ i, f i) (funext heq)

name: GroupConfig.IsConstructibleOver.polynomial_zero
statement:
theorem IsConstructibleOver.polynomial_zero (p : MvPolynomial ι k) :
    IsConstructibleOver k {x : ι → K | MvPolynomial.aeval x p = 0}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply isConstructibleOver_iff_exists_polynomial_data.mpr
  refine ⟨{⟨1, 1, fun _ ↦ p⟩}, ?_⟩
  intro x
  simp

name: GroupConfig.IsConstructibleOver.polynomial_ne_zero
statement:
theorem IsConstructibleOver.polynomial_ne_zero (p : MvPolynomial ι k) :
    IsConstructibleOver k {x : ι → K | MvPolynomial.aeval x p ≠ 0}
proof:
:=
  (IsConstructibleOver.polynomial_zero p).compl

name: GroupConfig.IsConstructibleOver.preimage_polynomial
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, rfl⟩ := hs
  obtain ⟨cells, rfl⟩ := PrimeSpectrum.exists_constructibleSetData_iff.mpr hC
  let f : MvPolynomial κ k →+* MvPolynomial ι k :=
    (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := k) q).toRingHom
  refine ⟨(cells.map f).toSet, (cells.map f).isConstructible_toSet, ?_⟩
  rw [PrimeSpectrum.ConstructibleSetData.toSet_map]
  ext x
  suffices MvPolynomial.pointToPoint (fun i ↦ MvPolynomial.aeval x (q i)) =
      PrimeSpectrum.comap f (MvPolynomial.pointToPoint x) by
    exact (congrArg (fun p ↦ p ∈ cells.toSet) this).to_iff
  apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
  ext p
  simp only [MvPolynomial.pointToPoint, PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal, Ideal.mem_comap,
    MvPolynomial.mem_vanishingIdeal_singleton_iff]
  rw [show MvPolynomial.aeval x (f p) =
      MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i ↦ MvPolynomial.aeval x (q i)) p from
    MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply (f := q) (MvPolynomial.aeval x) p]

name: GroupConfig.IsConstructibleOver.extend_base
statement:
theorem IsConstructibleOver.extend_base {L : Type*} [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    [Algebra L K] [IsScalarTower k L K] (hs : IsConstructibleOver k s) :
    IsConstructibleOver L s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, rfl⟩ := hs
  obtain ⟨cells, rfl⟩ := PrimeSpectrum.exists_constructibleSetData_iff.mpr hC
  let f : MvPolynomial ι k →+* MvPolynomial ι L :=
    MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k L)
  refine ⟨(cells.map f).toSet, (cells.map f).isConstructible_toSet, ?_⟩
  rw [PrimeSpectrum.ConstructibleSetData.toSet_map]
  ext x
  suffices PrimeSpectrum.comap f (MvPolynomial.pointToPoint (k := L) x) =
      MvPolynomial.pointToPoint (k := k) x by
    exact (congrArg (fun p ↦ p ∈ cells.toSet) this).symm.to_iff
  apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
  ext p
  simp [MvPolynomial.pointToPoint, f, MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap]

name: GroupConfig.IsConstructibleOver.of_le_intermediateField
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra ↥E ↥E' := (IntermediateField.inclusion h).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower ↥E ↥E' K := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  exact hs.extend_base

name: GroupConfig.IsConstructibleOver.of_restrictScalars_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hmem (x : ↥E) : (x : K) ∈ E' := hE ▸ (IntermediateField.mem_restrictScalars k).2 x.2
  let _ : Algebra ↥E ↥E' := RingHom.toAlgebra
    { toFun := fun x ↦ ⟨x, hmem x⟩
      map_one' := rfl
      map_mul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
      map_zero' := rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
  have : IsScalarTower ↥E ↥E' K := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  exact h.extend_base

name: GroupConfig.IsConstructibleOver.exists
proof:
:= by
  convert hφ.image_projection using 1
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    exact ⟨Sum.elim x y, hy, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨z ∘ Sum.inr, hz⟩

name: GroupConfig.IsConstructibleOver.forall
proof:
:= by
  have hn : IsConstructibleOver k {x : ι → K | ∃ y, ¬φ x y} := hφ.compl.exists
  convert hn.compl using 1
  ext x
  simp

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isInvertiblePair_comp_swap_iff
statement:
theorem isInvertiblePair_comp_swap_iff {x : (μ ⊕ μ) → K} :
    F.IsInvertiblePair a a' (x ∘ Sum.swap) ↔ F.IsInvertiblePair a a' x

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isGerm_spaceKernelWord
statement:
theorem isGerm_spaceKernelWord (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a'))
    {d : ((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) → K} (hL : F.IsInvertiblePair a a' (d ∘ Sum.inl))
    (hR : F.IsInvertiblePair a a' (d ∘ Sum.inr)) :
    (F.spaceKernelWord hdim).IsGerm d
      (Germ.comp (F.pairGerm (d := (d ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.swap) ⟨hL.2, hL.1⟩) (F.pairGerm hR))
proof:
:=
  ((F.pairProductWord hdim).isGerm_mapParams_iff _ d _).2
    (F.isGerm_pairProductWord hdim (d := d ∘ Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.swap) Sum.inr)
      ⟨hL.2, hL.1⟩ hR)

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isInvertiblyAdmissible_spaceKernelWord_iff
statement:
theorem isInvertiblyAdmissible_spaceKernelWord_iff
    (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a')) (d : ((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) → K) :
    (F.spaceKernelWord hdim).IsInvertiblyAdmissible d ↔
      F.IsInvertiblePair a a' (d ∘ Sum.inl) ∧ F.IsInvertiblePair a a' (d ∘ Sum.inr)
proof:
:=
  ((F.pairProductWord hdim).isInvertiblyAdmissible_mapParams_iff _ d).trans
    ((F.isInvertiblyAdmissible_pairProductWord_iff hdim _).trans
      (and_congr (F.isInvertiblePair_comp_swap_iff (x := d ∘ Sum.inl)) Iff.rfl))

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.hasSamples_spaceKernelWord
statement:
theorem hasSamples_spaceKernelWord (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a'))
    {L : IntermediateField k K} (h : HasGenericSamples L a' (Fintype.card μ)) :
    (F.spaceKernelWord hdim).HasSamples L
proof:
:=
  ((F.pairProductWord hdim).hasSamples_mapParams_iff _).2 (F.hasSamples_pairProductWord hdim h)

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isGerm_spaceActionWord
statement:
theorem isGerm_spaceActionWord (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a'))
    {d : (((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) → K}
    (hG : F.IsInvertiblePair a a' ((d ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl))
    (hX : F.IsInvertiblePair a a' ((d ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr))
    (hT : F.IsInvertiblePair a a' (d ∘ Sum.inr)) :
    (F.spaceActionWord hdim).IsGerm d
      (Germ.comp (F.pairGerm (d := (d ∘ Sum.inr) ∘ Sum.swap) ⟨hT.2, hT.1⟩)
        (Germ.comp (F.pairGerm hG) (F.pairGerm hX)))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Germ.comp (F.parameterGerm hT.1.choose) (Germ.comp (F.pairGerm hG) (F.pairGerm hX)),
    hT.2.choose, Classical.choose hT.2.choose_spec, ?_, Classical.choose_spec hT.2.choose_spec,
    ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨Germ.comp (F.pairGerm hG) (F.pairGerm hX), hT.1.choose, ?_, rfl⟩
    exact ((F.pairProductWord hdim).isGerm_mapParams_iff Sum.inl d _).2
      (F.isGerm_pairProductWord hdim hG hX)
  · exact Germ.comp_assoc _ _ _

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isInvertiblyAdmissible_spaceActionWord_iff
statement:
theorem isInvertiblyAdmissible_spaceActionWord_iff
    (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a'))
    (d : (((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) → K) :
    (F.spaceActionWord hdim).IsInvertiblyAdmissible d ↔
      F.IsInvertiblePair a a' ((d ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) ∧
        F.IsInvertiblePair a a' ((d ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr) ∧
        F.IsInvertiblePair a a' (d ∘ Sum.inr)
proof:
:= by
  have hP := (F.pairProductWord hdim).isInvertiblyAdmissible_mapParams_iff Sum.inl d
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hw, h₁⟩, h₂⟩
    obtain ⟨hG, hX⟩ := (F.isInvertiblyAdmissible_pairProductWord_iff hdim _).1 (hP.1 hw)
    exact ⟨hG, hX, h₁, h₂⟩
  · rintro ⟨hG, hX, h₁, h₂⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hP.2 ((F.isInvertiblyAdmissible_pairProductWord_iff hdim _).2 ⟨hG, hX⟩), h₁⟩, h₂⟩

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.hasSamples_spaceActionWord
statement:
theorem hasSamples_spaceActionWord (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a'))
    {L : IntermediateField k K} (h : HasGenericSamples L a' (Fintype.card μ)) :
    (F.spaceActionWord hdim).HasSamples L
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨((F.pairProductWord hdim).hasSamples_mapParams_iff Sum.inl).2
    (F.hasSamples_pairProductWord hdim h), h⟩, h⟩

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isConstructibleOver_domain
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_domain [Finite κ] (f : QuasiRational L ι κ) :
    IsConstructibleOver L {u : ι → K | f.IsDefinedAt u}
proof:
:= by
  have h := IsConstructibleOver.iInter fun j ↦
    IsConstructibleOver.polynomial_ne_zero (K := K) (f.den j)
  convert h using 1
  ext u
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iInter, IsDefinedAt]

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.eval_eq_iff
statement:
private theorem eval_eq_iff {f : QuasiRational L ι κ} {u : ι → K}
    (hf : f.IsDefinedAt u) (w : κ → K) :
    f.eval u = w ↔ ∀ j,
      w j ^ (ringExpChar K ^ f.e) * aeval u (f.den j) = aeval u (f.num j)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h j
    rw [← congrFun h j, eval_apply, pRoot_pow]
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hf j)
  · intro h
    funext j
    exact pRoot_eq_of_pow_eq ((eq_div_iff (hf j)).2 (h j))

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isConstructibleOver_graph
proof:
:= by
  let P (j : κ) : MvPolynomial (ι ⊕ κ) L :=
    X (Sum.inr j) ^ (ringExpChar K ^ f.e) * rename (Sum.inl : ι → ι ⊕ κ) (f.den j) -
      rename (Sum.inl : ι → ι ⊕ κ) (f.num j)
  have hD : IsConstructibleOver L {z : (ι ⊕ κ) → K |
      f.IsDefinedAt (z ∘ Sum.inl)} := by
    have h := IsConstructibleOver.iInter fun j ↦
      IsConstructibleOver.polynomial_ne_zero (K := K) (rename (Sum.inl : ι → ι ⊕ κ) (f.den j))
    convert h using 1
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iInter, IsDefinedAt, aeval_rename]
  have hP := IsConstructibleOver.iInter fun j ↦
    IsConstructibleOver.polynomial_zero (K := K) (P j)
  have h : IsConstructibleOver L {z : (ι ⊕ κ) → K |
      f.IsDefinedAt (z ∘ Sum.inl) ∧ ∀ j,
        z (Sum.inr j) ^ (ringExpChar K ^ f.e) * aeval (z ∘ Sum.inl) (f.den j) =
          aeval (z ∘ Sum.inl) (f.num j)} := by
    convert hD.inter hP using 1
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_iInter,
      P, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, aeval_X, aeval_rename, sub_eq_zero]
  convert h using 1
  ext z
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  exact and_congr_right fun hf ↦ eval_eq_iff hf (z ∘ Sum.inr)

name: GroupConfig.exists_algHom_of_injective_of_finiteType
statement:
private theorem exists_algHom_of_injective_of_finiteType {A B K : Type*}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [IsDomain B]
    [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] [Algebra A B] [Algebra A K]
    [Algebra.FiniteType A B]
    (hB : Function.Injective (algebraMap A B))
    (hK : Function.Injective (algebraMap A K)) : Nonempty (B →ₐ[A] K)
proof:
:= by
  let : Nontrivial (K ⊗[A] B) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.nontrivial_of_algebraMap_injective_of_isDomain A K B hK hB
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Ideal.exists_maximal (K ⊗[A] B)
  let : m.IsMaximal := hm
  let : Field ((K ⊗[A] B) ⧸ m) := Ideal.Quotient.field m
  let : Module.Finite K ((K ⊗[A] B) ⧸ m) :=
    finite_of_finite_type_of_isJacobsonRing K ((K ⊗[A] B) ⧸ m)
  let φ : K ⊗[A] B →ₐ[K] K :=
    (IsAlgClosed.lift : ((K ⊗[A] B) ⧸ m) →ₐ[K] K).comp
      (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ K m)
  exact ⟨(φ.restrictScalars A).comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight⟩

name: GroupConfig.exists_ringHom_of_ker_eq
statement:
private theorem exists_ringHom_of_ker_eq {R B K : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [IsDomain B]
    [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] (f : R →+* B) (g : R →+* K)
    (hf : f.FiniteType) (hker : RingHom.ker f = RingHom.ker g) :
    ∃ h : B →+* K, h.comp f = g
proof:
:= by
  let f' : R ⧸ RingHom.ker f →+* B := f.kerLift
  have hzero : ∀ r, r ∈ RingHom.ker f → g r = 0 := by
    intro r hr
    exact RingHom.mem_ker.mp (hker ▸ hr)
  let g' : R ⧸ RingHom.ker f →+* K := Ideal.Quotient.lift _ g hzero
  have hf' : f'.FiniteType := by
    apply RingHom.FiniteType.of_comp_finiteType (f := Ideal.Quotient.mk _)
    have hcomp : f'.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) = f := by
      ext r
      exact f.kerLift_mk r
    exact hcomp.symm ▸ hf
  have hg' : Function.Injective g' :=
    RingHom.lift_injective_of_ker_le_ideal _ hzero hker.ge
  algebraize_only [f', g']
  let : Algebra.FiniteType (R ⧸ RingHom.ker f) B := hf'
  obtain ⟨h⟩ := exists_algHom_of_injective_of_finiteType (f.kerLift_injective) hg'
  refine ⟨h.toRingHom, ?_⟩
  ext r
  exact h.commutes (Ideal.Quotient.mk (RingHom.ker f) r)

name: GroupConfig.exists_ringHom_of_prime
statement:
private theorem exists_ringHom_of_prime {R S K : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K]
    (f : R →+* S) (g : R →+* K) (hf : f.FiniteType)
    (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime] (hq : q.comap f = RingHom.ker g)
    (b : S) (hb : b ∉ q) :
    ∃ h : S →+* K, h.comp f = g ∧ (∀ s ∈ q, h s = 0) ∧ h b ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let B := Localization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk q b)
  have hb' : Ideal.Quotient.mk q b ≠ 0 :=
    fun h ↦ hb (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp h)
  let : IsDomain B := Localization.Away.isDomain hb'
  let j : S →+* B := (algebraMap (S ⧸ q) B).comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk q)
  have hj : j.FiniteType :=
    (RingHom.finiteType_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance).comp
      (RingHom.FiniteType.of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk q) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective)
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap (S ⧸ q) B) :=
    IsLocalization.injective B (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors hb')
  have hker : RingHom.ker (j.comp f) = RingHom.ker g := by
    rw [← hq]
    ext r
    change algebraMap (S ⧸ q) B (Ideal.Quotient.mk q (f r)) = 0 ↔ f r ∈ q
    rw [← map_zero (algebraMap (S ⧸ q) B), hinj.eq_iff, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := exists_ringHom_of_ker_eq (j.comp f) g (hj.comp hf) hker
  refine ⟨h.comp j, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hh
  · intro s hs
    change h (algebraMap (S ⧸ q) B (Ideal.Quotient.mk q s)) = 0
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hs, map_zero, map_zero]
  · exact ((IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk q b)).map h).ne_zero

name: GroupConfig.exists_ringHom_of_constructible
statement:
private theorem exists_ringHom_of_constructible {R S K : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K]
    (f : R →+* S) (hf : f.FiniteType) (g : R →+* K)
    (C : Set (PrimeSpectrum S)) (hC : Topology.IsConstructible C)
    (hg : PrimeSpectrum.comap g ⟨⊥, inferInstance⟩ ∈ PrimeSpectrum.comap f '' C) :
    ∃ h : S →+* K, h.comp f = g ∧ PrimeSpectrum.comap h ⟨⊥, inferInstance⟩ ∈ C
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q, hq, heq⟩ := hg
  obtain ⟨cells, rfl⟩ := PrimeSpectrum.exists_constructibleSetData_iff.mpr hC
  obtain ⟨cell, hcell, hqcell⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hq
  have hker : q.asIdeal.comap f = RingHom.ker g := by
    have heq' := congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal heq
    simpa only [PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal, ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot] using heq'
  have hn : cell.f ∉ q.asIdeal := by
    simpa only [PrimeSpectrum.mem_zeroLocus, Set.singleton_subset_iff, SetLike.mem_coe]
      using hqcell.2
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hqzero, hnzero⟩ := exists_ringHom_of_prime f g hf q.asIdeal hker cell.f hn
  refine ⟨h, hh, Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨cell, hcell, ?_⟩⟩
  constructor
  · rw [PrimeSpectrum.mem_zeroLocus]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact hqzero _ ((PrimeSpectrum.mem_zeroLocus q _).mp hqcell.1 ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  · simpa only [PrimeSpectrum.mem_zeroLocus, Set.singleton_subset_iff, SetLike.mem_coe,
      PrimeSpectrum.comap_asIdeal, Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_bot] using hnzero

name: GroupConfig.isConstructibleOver_iff_exists_polynomial_data
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_iff_exists_polynomial_data {k K ι : Type*}
    [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K] {s : Set (ι → K)} :
    IsConstructibleOver k s ↔
      ∃ cells : PrimeSpectrum.ConstructibleSetData (MvPolynomial ι k),
        ∀ x, x ∈ s ↔ ∃ cell ∈ cells,
          (∀ i, MvPolynomial.aeval x (cell.g i) = 0) ∧
            MvPolynomial.aeval x cell.f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hd (cells : PrimeSpectrum.ConstructibleSetData (MvPolynomial ι k)) (x : ι → K) :
      MvPolynomial.pointToPoint x ∈ cells.toSet ↔ ∃ cell ∈ cells,
        (∀ i, MvPolynomial.aeval x (cell.g i) = 0) ∧
          MvPolynomial.aeval x cell.f ≠ 0 := by
    simp [PrimeSpectrum.ConstructibleSetData.toSet,
      PrimeSpectrum.BasicConstructibleSetData.toSet, PrimeSpectrum.mem_zeroLocus,
      MvPolynomial.pointToPoint, Set.range_subset_iff, and_left_comm]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨C, hC, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨cells, rfl⟩ := PrimeSpectrum.exists_constructibleSetData_iff.mpr hC
    exact ⟨cells, hd cells⟩
  · rintro ⟨cells, hcells⟩
    exact ⟨cells.toSet, cells.isConstructible_toSet, Set.ext fun x ↦ (hcells x).trans
      (hd cells x).symm⟩

name: GroupConfig.pointToPoint_eq_comap
statement:
private theorem pointToPoint_eq_comap {k K ι : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (x : ι → K) : MvPolynomial.pointToPoint (k := k) x =
      PrimeSpectrum.comap (MvPolynomial.aeval x).toRingHom ⟨⊥, inferInstance⟩
proof:
:= by
  apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
  ext p
  simp [MvPolynomial.pointToPoint]

name: GroupConfig.IsConstructibleOver.image_projection
statement:
theorem IsConstructibleOver.image_projection {k K ι κ : Type*}
    [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K] [IsAlgClosed K]
    [Finite ι] [Finite κ] {s : Set ((ι ⊕ κ) → K)} (hs : IsConstructibleOver k s) :
    IsConstructibleOver k ((fun x i ↦ x (Sum.inl i)) '' s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, rfl⟩ := hs
  let f : MvPolynomial ι k →+* MvPolynomial (ι ⊕ κ) k :=
    (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inl).toRingHom
  have hf : f.FiniteType := by
    apply RingHom.FiniteType.of_comp_finiteType (f := MvPolynomial.C)
    have hc : f.comp MvPolynomial.C = MvPolynomial.C := by
      exact RingHom.ext fun c ↦ MvPolynomial.rename_C _ c
    rw [hc]
    exact RingHom.finiteType_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance
  have hp (x : (ι ⊕ κ) → K) : PrimeSpectrum.comap f
      (MvPolynomial.pointToPoint (k := k) x) =
      MvPolynomial.pointToPoint (k := k) (fun i ↦ x (Sum.inl i)) := by
    rw [pointToPoint_eq_comap, pointToPoint_eq_comap, ← PrimeSpectrum.comap_comp_apply]
    congr 1
    exact RingHom.ext fun p ↦ MvPolynomial.aeval_rename _ _ p
  refine ⟨PrimeSpectrum.comap f '' C,
    PrimeSpectrum.isConstructible_comap_image
      (RingHom.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType.mp hf) hC, ?_⟩
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨MvPolynomial.pointToPoint w, hw, hp w⟩
  · intro hx
    rw [Set.mem_preimage, pointToPoint_eq_comap] at hx
    obtain ⟨h, hh, hmem⟩ := exists_ringHom_of_constructible f hf
      (MvPolynomial.aeval x).toRingHom C hC hx
    let w : (ι ⊕ κ) → K := fun i ↦ h (MvPolynomial.X i)
    have hc (c : k) : h (MvPolynomial.C c) = algebraMap k K c := by
      have he := RingHom.congr_fun hh (MvPolynomial.C c)
      simpa [f] using he
    have hw : h = (MvPolynomial.aeval w).toRingHom := by
      apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
      · intro c
        simpa using hc c
      · intro i
        simp [w]
    refine ⟨w, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change MvPolynomial.pointToPoint w ∈ C
      rw [pointToPoint_eq_comap, ← hw]
      exact hmem
    · funext i
      have he := RingHom.congr_fun hh (MvPolynomial.X i)
      simpa [f, w] using he

name: GroupConfig.isConstructibleOver_groupWitness
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_groupWitness (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ)
    (c : μ → K) (w : Word k P a a)
    (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a')) {L₀ : IntermediateField k K}
    (hw : w.HasSamples L₀) (hFt : HasGenericSamples L₀ a' (Fintype.card μ))
    (hsrc : HasGenericSamples L₀ a (Fintype.card ((P ⊕ μ) ⊕ μ))) :
    IsConstructibleOver (↥L₀) (groupWitness F c w hdim)
proof:
:= by
  have hA : IsConstructibleOver (↥L₀) ((fun Z : ((P ⊕ μ) ⊕ μ) → K ↦ Z ∘ Sum.inr) ⁻¹'
      {u' | InLocus (k := k) c u'}) :=
    ((isConstructibleOver_inLocus c).preimage_comp Sum.inr).extend_base
  obtain ⟨n, t, ht, hind, hn, htL⟩ := hFt
  have hB := (IsConstructibleOver.of_le_intermediateField (adjoin_le_iff.2 (iUnion_subset htL))
    (F.isConstructibleOver_invertibleAdmissible a a' hdim t ht hind
      (by rwa [Fintype.card_fin]))).preimage_comp (Sum.inr : μ → ((P ⊕ μ) ⊕ μ))
  have hCD := (stabWord w F hdim).isConstructibleOver_eq_parameterGerm F Sum.inr hdim
    ⟨(w.hasSamples_mapParams_iff _).2 hw, n, t, ht, hind, hn, htL⟩
    ⟨n, t, ht, hind, hn, htL⟩ hsrc
  exact hA.inter (hB.inter hCD)

name: GroupConfig.isConstructibleOver_groupInner
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_groupInner (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ)
    (c : μ → K) (w : Word k P a a)
    (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a')) {L₀ : IntermediateField k K}
    (hw : w.HasSamples L₀) (hFt : HasGenericSamples L₀ a' (Fintype.card μ))
    (hsrc : HasGenericSamples L₀ a (Fintype.card ((P ⊕ μ) ⊕ μ))) :
    IsConstructibleOver (↥L₀) (groupInner F c w hdim)
proof:
:= by
  let φ : ((P ⊕ μ) → K) → (μ → K) → Prop := fun e u' ↦
    InLocus (k := k) c u' ∧
    (∃ hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' u', Germ.IsInvertible (F.parameterGerm hu)) ∧
    (stabWord w F hdim).IsInvertiblyAdmissible (Sum.elim e u') ∧
    ∃ hu' : F.IsAdmissible a a' u',
      (stabWord w F hdim).IsGerm (Sum.elim e u') (F.parameterGerm hu')
  have hT : IsConstructibleOver (↥L₀)
      {Z : ((P ⊕ μ) ⊕ μ) → K | φ (Z ∘ Sum.inl) (Z ∘ Sum.inr)} := by
    convert isConstructibleOver_groupWitness F c w hdim hw hFt hsrc using 1
    ext Z
    have hZ : Sum.elim (Z ∘ Sum.inl) (Z ∘ Sum.inr) = Z := by
      funext q
      cases q <;> rfl
    simp only [φ, groupWitness, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hZ]
  exact hT.exists (φ := φ)

name: GroupConfig.isConstructibleOver_groupRel
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_groupRel (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ)
    (c : μ → K) (w : Word k P a a)
    (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a')) {L₀ : IntermediateField k K}
    (hL₀ : IsSmall k (L₀ : Set K)) (hw : w.HasSamples L₀)
    (hFt : HasGenericSamples L₀ a' (Fintype.card μ))
    (hsrc : HasGenericSamples L₀ a (Fintype.card ((P ⊕ μ) ⊕ μ)))
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (t : α → μ → K) (ht : ∀ i, IsGenericOver L₀ c (t i))
    (hind : erk k (L₀ : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t i)) = ∑ i, erk k (L₀ : Set K) (range (t i)))
    (hr : 2 * Fintype.card P + 1 ≤ Fintype.card α) :
    IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k ((L₀ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (t i))))
      (groupRel L₀ F c w hdim)
proof:
:= by
  have h := constructible_generic_quantifier L₀ hL₀ c t ht hind hr
    (isConstructibleOver_groupInner F c w hdim hw hFt hsrc)
  have hbase (S : Set K) : (racl (↥L₀) S).restrictScalars k = racl k ((L₀ : Set K) ∪ S) :=
    SetLike.coe_injective (racl_base_coe L₀ S)
  refine IsConstructibleOver.of_restrictScalars_eq (restrictScalars_adjoin k L₀ _) ?_
  convert h using 1
  ext d
  simp only [groupRel, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hbase]

name: GroupConfig.exists_joint_fresh_genericSamples
statement:
theorem exists_joint_fresh_genericSamples (M : IntermediateField k K)
    (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K)) (a : ι → K) (b : κ → K) (n m : ℕ) :
    ∃ (t : Fin n → ι → K) (s : Fin m → κ → K),
      (∀ i, IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) a (t i)) ∧
      erk k ((⊥ : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t i)) =
        ∑ i, erk k ((⊥ : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) (range (t i)) ∧
      (∀ i, IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) b (s i)) ∧
      erk k ((⊥ : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) (⋃ i, range (s i)) =
        ∑ i, erk k ((⊥ : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) (range (s i)) ∧
      IndepOver k (M : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t i)) (⋃ i, range (s i)) ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ ((⋃ i, range (t i)) ∪ ⋃ i, range (s i)) (M : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hrt, htM⟩ := exists_fresh_genericSamples M hM a n
  let T : Set K := ⋃ i, range (t i)
  have hT : T.Finite := finite_iUnion fun i ↦ finite_range (t i)
  have hMT : IsSmall k ((racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ T) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (hM.union (IsSmall.of_finite hT)).racl
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hrs, hsMT⟩ := exists_fresh_genericSamples _ hMT b m
  have hsMT' : IndepOver k ∅ (⋃ i, range (s i)) ((M : Set K) ∪ T) :=
    hsMT.mono_right (subset_racl k _)
  have hsTM : IndepOver k ∅ (⋃ i, range (s i)) (T ∪ (M : Set K)) := by
    rwa [union_comm] at hsMT'
  have hcross : IndepOver k (M : Set K) T (⋃ i, range (s i)) := by
    have h := (indepOver_union_right_iff.1 hsMT').2
    rw [empty_union] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hfresh : IndepOver k ∅ (M : Set K) (T ∪ ⋃ i, range (s i)) := by
    refine indepOver_union_right_iff.2 ⟨htM.symm, ?_⟩
    rw [empty_union]
    have h := (indepOver_union_right_iff.1 hsTM).2
    rw [empty_union] at h
    exact h.symm
  exact ⟨t, s, ht, hrt, hs, hrs, hcross, hfresh.symm⟩

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.mem_groupInner_pairWord_iff
statement:
theorem mem_groupInner_pairWord_iff (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ)
    (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a')) {d : (μ ⊕ μ) → K}
    (hd : F.IsInvertiblePair a a' d) (c v : μ → K) :
    Sum.elim d v ∈ groupInner F c (F.pairWord hdim) hdim ↔
      ∃ hv : F.IsAdmissible a a' v, Germ.IsInvertible (F.parameterGerm hv) ∧
        ∃ (u' : μ → K) (hu' : F.IsAdmissible a a' u'), InLocus (k := k) c u' ∧
          Germ.IsInvertible (F.parameterGerm hu') ∧
          Germ.comp (F.parameterGerm hv) (F.pairGerm hd) = F.parameterGerm hu'
proof:
:= by
  have hgerm := F.isGerm_pairGerm hdim hd
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u', hV, ⟨hu, hinv⟩, ⟨-, hv, hvinv⟩, hu', g₀, hv', hg₀, hcomp⟩
    obtain rfl : g₀ = F.pairGerm hd :=
      ((Word.isGerm_mapParams_iff _ _ _ _).1 hg₀).unique hgerm
    exact ⟨hv, hvinv, u', hu', hV, hinv, hcomp.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨hv, hvinv, u', hu', hV, hinv, hcomp⟩
    exact ⟨u', hV, ⟨hu', hinv⟩,
      ⟨(Word.isInvertiblyAdmissible_mapParams_iff _ _ _).2
        ((F.isInvertiblyAdmissible_pairWord_iff hdim _).2 hd), hv, hvinv⟩,
      hu', F.pairGerm hd, hv, (Word.isGerm_mapParams_iff _ _ _ _).2 hgerm, hcomp.symm⟩

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.pairDomain_eq_inter_groupRel
statement:
theorem pairDomain_eq_inter_groupRel (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ)
    (M : IntermediateField k K) {f₀ : Germ k a a'} (hf₀ : Germ.IsInvertible f₀) {c : μ → K}
    (hF : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K, ∃ hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' (⇑σ ∘ c),
      F.parameterGerm hu = f₀.map σ)
    (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a')) :
    F.pairDomain M c a a' =
      {d | F.IsInvertiblePair a a' d} ∩ groupRel M F c (F.pairWord hdim) hdim
proof:
:= by
  ext d
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hd, hstar⟩
    refine ⟨hd, fun v hv ↦ (F.mem_groupInner_pairWord_iff hdim hd c v).2 ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hv', u', hu', hV, hinv, hcomp⟩ := hstar v hv
    
    obtain ⟨hv'', hmem⟩ := exists_parameterGerm_mem_orbit_of_isGen hF hv.isGen
    exact ⟨hv', Germ.isInvertible_of_mem_orbit hf₀ hmem, u', hu', hV, hinv, hcomp⟩
  · rintro ⟨hd, hrel⟩
    refine ⟨hd, fun v hv ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hv', -, u', hu', hV, hinv, hcomp⟩ :=
      (F.mem_groupInner_pairWord_iff hdim hd c v).1 (hrel v hv)
    exact ⟨hv', u', hu', hV, hinv, hcomp⟩

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isConstructibleOver_pairDomain
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_pairDomain (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ) {f₀ : Germ k a a'}
    (hb : Germ.IsHWBij f₀) {δ₀ : Germ k a a} (hδ₀ : δ₀ ∈ Germ.diffSet f₀) {c : μ → K}
    (hc : adjoin k (range c) = f₀.cb)
    (hF : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K, ∃ hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' (⇑σ ∘ c),
      F.parameterGerm hu = f₀.map σ)
    (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a')) {L₀ : IntermediateField k K}
    (hL₀ : IsSmall k (L₀ : Set K)) (hFt : HasGenericSamples L₀ a' (Fintype.card μ))
    (hsrc : HasGenericSamples L₀ a (Fintype.card (((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ μ) ⊕ μ)))
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (t : α → μ → K) (ht : ∀ i, IsGenericOver L₀ c (t i))
    (hind : erk k (L₀ : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t i)) = ∑ i, erk k (L₀ : Set K) (range (t i)))
    (hr : 2 * Fintype.card (μ ⊕ μ) + 1 ≤ Fintype.card α) :
    IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k ((L₀ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (t i))))
      (F.pairDomain (adjoin k ((L₀ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (t i))) c a a')
proof:
:= by
  set L₁ := adjoin k ((L₀ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (t i))
  have hL₁ : IsSmall k (L₁ : Set K) :=
    ((hL₀.union (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_iUnion fun i ↦ finite_range (t i)))).racl).mono
      (adjoin_le_racl k _)
  have hle : L₀ ≤ L₁ := fun x hx ↦ subset_adjoin k _ (Or.inl hx)
  rw [F.pairDomain_eq L₁ L₀ hL₁ hL₀ hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim,
    F.pairDomain_eq_inter_groupRel L₀ hb.isInvertible hF hdim]
  refine IsConstructibleOver.inter ?_ (isConstructibleOver_groupRel F c (F.pairWord hdim) hdim
    hL₀ ⟨⟨trivial, hFt⟩, hFt⟩ hFt hsrc t ht hind hr)
  
  obtain ⟨n, s, hs, hsind, hn, hsL⟩ := hFt
  have hI := IsConstructibleOver.of_le_intermediateField
    ((adjoin_le_iff.2 (iUnion_subset hsL)).trans hle)
    (F.isConstructibleOver_invertibleAdmissible a a' hdim s hs hsind (by rwa [Fintype.card_fin]))
  exact (hI.preimage_comp Sum.inl).inter (hI.preimage_comp Sum.inr)

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isConstructibleOver_wordStabilizer
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_wordStabilizer {P : Type*} [Fintype P] [Fintype ι]
    (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ) (c : μ → K) (w : Word k P a a)
    (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a')) {f₀ : Germ k a a'} (hb : Germ.IsHWBij f₀)
    {δ₀ : Germ k a a} (hδ₀ : δ₀ ∈ Germ.diffSet f₀) (hc : adjoin k (range c) = f₀.cb)
    (hF : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K, ∃ hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' (⇑σ ∘ c),
      F.parameterGerm hu = f₀.map σ)
    {L₀ : IntermediateField k K} (hL₀ : IsSmall k (L₀ : Set K)) (hws : w.HasSamples L₀)
    (hFt : HasGenericSamples L₀ a' (Fintype.card μ))
    (hsrc : HasGenericSamples L₀ a (Fintype.card ((P ⊕ μ) ⊕ μ)))
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (t : α → μ → K) (ht : ∀ i, IsGenericOver L₀ c (t i))
    (hind : erk k (L₀ : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t i)) = ∑ i, erk k (L₀ : Set K) (range (t i)))
    (hr : 2 * Fintype.card (P ⊕ ι) + 1 ≤ Fintype.card α) {y₀ : ι → K} (hy₀ : IsGen k a y₀)
    {D : Set (P → K)}
    (hD : IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k (((L₀ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (t i)) ∪ range y₀))) D)
    (Γ : D → ↥(hb.isHW hδ₀).prodSubgroup)
    (hrep : ∀ d : D, w.IsGerm d ((hb.isHW hδ₀).val (Γ d)))
    (hInv : ∀ d : D, w.IsInvertiblyAdmissible d) :
    IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k (((L₀ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (t i)) ∪ range y₀)))
      {d | ∃ hd : d ∈ D, Γ ⟨d, hd⟩ • (hb.isHW hδ₀).iota hy₀ = (hb.isHW hδ₀).iota hy₀}
proof:
:= by
  convert hD.inter
    (isConstructibleOver_stabilizerFibre F c w hdim hL₀ hws hFt hsrc t ht hind hr y₀) using 1
  ext d
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hd, hfix⟩
    exact ⟨hd, (mem_stabilizerRel_iff hL₀ hb hδ₀ (hb.isHW hδ₀) (Γ ⟨d, hd⟩) hc hF hdim
      (hrep ⟨d, hd⟩) (hInv ⟨d, hd⟩) hy₀).2 hfix⟩
  · rintro ⟨hd, hst⟩
    exact ⟨hd, (mem_stabilizerRel_iff hL₀ hb hδ₀ (hb.isHW hδ₀) (Γ ⟨d, hd⟩) hc hF hdim
      (hrep ⟨d, hd⟩) (hInv ⟨d, hd⟩) hy₀).1 hst⟩

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isConstructibleOver_pairStabilizer
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_pairStabilizer [Fintype ι] (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ)
    {f₀ : Germ k a a'} (hb : Germ.IsHWBij f₀) {δ₀ : Germ k a a} (hδ₀ : δ₀ ∈ Germ.diffSet f₀)
    {c : μ → K} (hc : adjoin k (range c) = f₀.cb)
    (hF : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K, ∃ hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' (⇑σ ∘ c),
      F.parameterGerm hu = f₀.map σ)
    (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a')) {L₀ : IntermediateField k K}
    (hL₀ : IsSmall k (L₀ : Set K)) (hFt : HasGenericSamples L₀ a' (Fintype.card μ))
    (hsrc : HasGenericSamples L₀ a (Fintype.card (((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ μ) ⊕ μ)))
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (t : α → μ → K) (ht : ∀ i, IsGenericOver L₀ c (t i))
    (hind : erk k (L₀ : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t i)) = ∑ i, erk k (L₀ : Set K) (range (t i)))
    (hr : 2 * Fintype.card ((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ ι) + 1 ≤ Fintype.card α) {y₀ : ι → K}
    (hy₀ : IsGen k a y₀) :
    IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k (((L₀ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (t i)) ∪ range y₀)))
      {d | ∃ (hd : d ∈ F.pairDomain (adjoin k ((L₀ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (t i))) c a a')
          (hmem : F.pairDomainGerm (adjoin k ((L₀ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (t i))) c a a' ⟨d, hd⟩ ∈
            Germ.IsHW.prodSet δ₀),
        (hb.isHW hδ₀).ofMem hmem • (hb.isHW hδ₀).iota hy₀ = (hb.isHW hδ₀).iota hy₀}
proof:
:= by
  set L₁ := adjoin k ((L₀ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (t i))
  have hL₁ : IsSmall k (L₁ : Set K) :=
    ((hL₀.union (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_iUnion fun i ↦ finite_range (t i)))).racl).mono
      (adjoin_le_racl k _)
  have hrD : 2 * Fintype.card (μ ⊕ μ) + 1 ≤ Fintype.card α := by
    simp only [Fintype.card_sum] at hr ⊢
    omega
  have hD : IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k (((L₀ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (t i)) ∪ range y₀)))
      (F.pairDomain L₁ c a a') :=
    IsConstructibleOver.of_le_intermediateField (adjoin.mono k _ _ subset_union_left)
      (F.isConstructibleOver_pairDomain hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim hL₀ hFt hsrc t ht hind hrD)
  
  let Γ : F.pairDomain L₁ c a a' → ↥(hb.isHW hδ₀).prodSubgroup :=
    fun d ↦ (hb.isHW hδ₀).ofMem (F.pairDomainGerm_mem L₁ hL₁ hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim d)
  have h := F.isConstructibleOver_wordStabilizer c (F.pairWord hdim) hdim hb hδ₀ hc hF hL₀
    ⟨⟨trivial, hFt⟩, hFt⟩ hFt hsrc t ht hind hr hy₀ hD Γ
    (fun d ↦ by
      change (F.pairWord hdim).IsGerm d ((hb.isHW hδ₀).val
        ((hb.isHW hδ₀).ofMem (F.pairDomainGerm_mem L₁ hL₁ hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim d)))
      rw [(hb.isHW hδ₀).val_ofMem]
      exact F.isGerm_pairGerm hdim d.2.choose)
    (fun d ↦ (F.isInvertiblyAdmissible_pairWord_iff hdim _).2 d.2.choose)
  convert h using 1
  ext d
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hd, hmem, hfix⟩
    exact ⟨hd, hfix⟩
  · rintro ⟨hd, hfix⟩
    exact ⟨hd, F.pairDomainGerm_mem L₁ hL₁ hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim ⟨d, hd⟩, hfix⟩

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.exists_fresh_isConstructibleOver_pairDomain_stabilizer
statement:
theorem exists_fresh_isConstructibleOver_pairDomain_stabilizer [Fintype ι]
    (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ) {f₀ : Germ k a a'} (hb : Germ.IsHWBij f₀) {δ₀ : Germ k a a}
    (hδ₀ : δ₀ ∈ Germ.diffSet f₀) {c : μ → K} (hc : adjoin k (range c) = f₀.cb)
    (hF : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K, ∃ hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' (⇑σ ∘ c),
      F.parameterGerm hu = f₀.map σ)
    (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a')) (M₀ : IntermediateField k K)
    (hM₀ : IsSmall k (M₀ : Set K)) :
    ∃ (S₀ : Set K) (t₁ : Fin (2 * (6 * Fintype.card μ + Fintype.card ι) + 1) → μ → K),
      S₀.Finite ∧ IndepOver k ∅ S₀ (M₀ : Set K) ∧
      (∃ T : List (Σ τ : Type w, (τ → K) × (τ → K)),
        (∀ p ∈ T, ((⟨p.1, p.2.1⟩ : Σ τ : Type w, τ → K) = ⟨ι, a⟩ ∨
            (⟨p.1, p.2.1⟩ : Σ τ : Type w, τ → K) = ⟨κ, a'⟩) ∧
          IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) p.2.1 p.2.2) ∧
        S₀ = (⋃ p ∈ T, range p.2.2) ∧
        erk k ∅ S₀ = (T.map fun p ↦ erk k ∅ (range p.2.2)).sum) ∧
      HasGenericSamples (adjoin k S₀) a (8 * Fintype.card μ) ∧
      HasGenericSamples (adjoin k S₀) a' (Fintype.card μ) ∧
      (∀ i, IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) c (t₁ i)) ∧
      (∀ i, IsGenericOver (adjoin k S₀) c (t₁ i)) ∧
      erk k (adjoin k S₀ : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) =
        ∑ i, erk k (adjoin k S₀ : Set K) (range (t₁ i)) ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) (M₀ : Set K) ∧
      erk k ∅ (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) = erk k ∅ S₀ + ∑ i, erk k ∅ (range (t₁ i)) ∧
      IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))))
        (F.pairDomain (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) c a a') ∧
      ∀ (y₀ : ι → K) (hy₀ : IsGen k a y₀),
        IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k ((S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) ∪ range y₀)))
          {d | ∃ (hd : d ∈ F.pairDomain (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) c a a')
              (hmem : F.pairDomainGerm (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) c a a' ⟨d, hd⟩ ∈
                Germ.IsHW.prodSet δ₀),
            (hb.isHW hδ₀).ofMem hmem • (hb.isHW hδ₀).iota hy₀ = (hb.isHW hδ₀).iota hy₀}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S₀, t₁, hS₀, hfresh₀, hT, hsa, hsa', ht₁, ht₁L, hadd, hfresh, hrk, hfield⟩ :=
    exists_groupSamples M₀ hM₀ a a' c (8 * Fintype.card μ) (Fintype.card μ)
      (2 * (6 * Fintype.card μ + Fintype.card ι) + 1)
  have hL₀ : IsSmall k ((adjoin k S₀ : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (IsSmall.of_finite hS₀).racl.mono (adjoin_le_racl k S₀)
  have hsrc : HasGenericSamples (adjoin k S₀) a (Fintype.card (((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ μ) ⊕ μ)) :=
    hsa.of_le (by simp only [Fintype.card_sum]; omega)
  have hr : 2 * Fintype.card ((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ ι) + 1 ≤
      Fintype.card (Fin (2 * (6 * Fintype.card μ + Fintype.card ι) + 1)) := by
    simp only [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_fin]
    omega
  have hrD : 2 * Fintype.card (μ ⊕ μ) + 1 ≤
      Fintype.card (Fin (2 * (6 * Fintype.card μ + Fintype.card ι) + 1)) := by
    simp only [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_fin]
    omega
  have hD := F.isConstructibleOver_pairDomain hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim hL₀ hsa' hsrc t₁ ht₁L hadd hrD
  rw [hfield] at hD
  refine ⟨S₀, t₁, hS₀, hfresh₀, hT, hsa, hsa', ht₁, ht₁L, hadd, hfresh, hrk, hD, fun y₀ hy₀ ↦ ?_⟩
  have h := F.isConstructibleOver_pairStabilizer hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim hL₀ hsa' hsrc t₁ ht₁L hadd hr
    hy₀
  
  have hfield' : adjoin k (((adjoin k S₀ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) ∪ range y₀) =
      adjoin k ((S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) ∪ range y₀) := by
    refine le_antisymm (adjoin_le_iff.2 (union_subset (union_subset
      (adjoin.mono k _ _ (subset_union_left.trans subset_union_left))
      ((subset_union_right.trans subset_union_left).trans (subset_adjoin k _)))
      (subset_union_right.trans (subset_adjoin k _)))) ?_
    exact adjoin.mono k _ _ (union_subset_union_left _
      (union_subset_union_left _ (subset_adjoin k S₀)))
  rw [hfield, hfield'] at h
  exact h

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.exists_fresh_isConstructibleOver_pairDomain
statement:
theorem exists_fresh_isConstructibleOver_pairDomain [Fintype ι] (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ)
    {f₀ : Germ k a a'} (hb : Germ.IsHWBij f₀) {δ₀ : Germ k a a} (hδ₀ : δ₀ ∈ Germ.diffSet f₀)
    {c : μ → K} (hc : adjoin k (range c) = f₀.cb)
    (hF : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K, ∃ hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' (⇑σ ∘ c),
      F.parameterGerm hu = f₀.map σ)
    (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a')) (M₀ : IntermediateField k K)
    (hM₀ : IsSmall k (M₀ : Set K)) :
    ∃ (S₀ : Set K) (t₁ : Fin (2 * (6 * Fintype.card μ + Fintype.card ι) + 1) → μ → K),
      S₀.Finite ∧ IndepOver k ∅ S₀ (M₀ : Set K) ∧
      (∃ T : List (Σ τ : Type w, (τ → K) × (τ → K)),
        (∀ p ∈ T, ((⟨p.1, p.2.1⟩ : Σ τ : Type w, τ → K) = ⟨ι, a⟩ ∨
            (⟨p.1, p.2.1⟩ : Σ τ : Type w, τ → K) = ⟨κ, a'⟩) ∧
          IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) p.2.1 p.2.2) ∧
        S₀ = (⋃ p ∈ T, range p.2.2) ∧
        erk k ∅ S₀ = (T.map fun p ↦ erk k ∅ (range p.2.2)).sum) ∧
      HasGenericSamples (adjoin k S₀) a (8 * Fintype.card μ) ∧
      HasGenericSamples (adjoin k S₀) a' (Fintype.card μ) ∧
      (∀ i, IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) c (t₁ i)) ∧
      (∀ i, IsGenericOver (adjoin k S₀) c (t₁ i)) ∧
      erk k (adjoin k S₀ : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) =
        ∑ i, erk k (adjoin k S₀ : Set K) (range (t₁ i)) ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) (M₀ : Set K) ∧
      erk k ∅ (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) = erk k ∅ S₀ + ∑ i, erk k ∅ (range (t₁ i)) ∧
      IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))))
        (F.pairDomain (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) c a a')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S₀, t₁, h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, h₅, h₆, h₇, h₈, h₉, h₁₀, hD, -⟩ :=
    F.exists_fresh_isConstructibleOver_pairDomain_stabilizer hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim M₀ hM₀
  exact ⟨S₀, t₁, h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, h₅, h₆, h₇, h₈, h₉, h₁₀, hD⟩

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isGerm_pairProductWord
statement:
theorem isGerm_pairProductWord (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a'))
    {d : ((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) → K}
    (hL : F.IsInvertiblePair a a' (d ∘ Sum.inl))
    (hR : F.IsInvertiblePair a a' (d ∘ Sum.inr)) :
    (F.pairProductWord hdim).IsGerm d (Germ.comp (F.pairGerm hL) (F.pairGerm hR))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Germ.comp (F.parameterGerm hL.2.choose) (F.pairGerm hR), hL.1.choose,
    Classical.choose hL.1.choose_spec, ?_, Classical.choose_spec hL.1.choose_spec, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨F.pairGerm hR, hL.2.choose, ?_, rfl⟩
    exact ((F.pairWord hdim).isGerm_mapParams_iff Sum.inr d _).2
      (F.isGerm_pairGerm hdim hR)
  · exact Germ.comp_assoc _ _ _

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isInvertiblyAdmissible_pairProductWord_iff
statement:
theorem isInvertiblyAdmissible_pairProductWord_iff
    (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a'))
    (d : ((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) → K) :
    (F.pairProductWord hdim).IsInvertiblyAdmissible d ↔
      F.IsInvertiblePair a a' (d ∘ Sum.inl) ∧ F.IsInvertiblePair a a' (d ∘ Sum.inr)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pairProductWord, Word.IsInvertiblyAdmissible,
    Word.isInvertiblyAdmissible_mapParams_iff, isInvertiblyAdmissible_pairWord_iff]
  change ((_ ∧ _) ∧ _) ↔ ((_ ∧ _) ∧ _)
  exact ⟨fun ⟨⟨hR, h₂⟩, h₁⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨h₁, h₂⟩, hR⟩,
    fun ⟨⟨h₁, h₂⟩, hR⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨hR, h₂⟩, h₁⟩⟩

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.hasSamples_pairWord
statement:
theorem hasSamples_pairWord (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a'))
    {L : IntermediateField k K} (h : HasGenericSamples L a' (Fintype.card μ)) :
    (F.pairWord hdim).HasSamples L
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨trivial, h⟩, h⟩

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.hasSamples_pairProductWord
statement:
theorem hasSamples_pairProductWord (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a'))
    {L : IntermediateField k K} (h : HasGenericSamples L a' (Fintype.card μ)) :
    (F.pairProductWord hdim).HasSamples L
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨((F.pairWord hdim).hasSamples_mapParams_iff Sum.inr).2
    (F.hasSamples_pairWord hdim h), h⟩, h⟩

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isConstructibleOver_pairKernel
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_pairKernel (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a'))
    {L : IntermediateField k K} (hFt : HasGenericSamples L a' (Fintype.card μ))
    (hsrc : HasGenericSamples L a (Fintype.card ((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)))) :
    IsConstructibleOver (↥L) {d : ((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) → K |
      ∃ (hL : F.IsInvertiblePair a a' (d ∘ Sum.inl))
        (hR : F.IsInvertiblePair a a' (d ∘ Sum.inr)), F.pairGerm hL = F.pairGerm hR}
proof:
:= by
  let wL := (F.pairWord hdim).mapParams (Sum.inl : (μ ⊕ μ) → (μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ))
  let wR := (F.pairWord hdim).mapParams (Sum.inr : (μ ⊕ μ) → (μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ))
  have hsL : wL.HasSamples L :=
    ((F.pairWord hdim).hasSamples_mapParams_iff Sum.inl).2 (F.hasSamples_pairWord hdim hFt)
  have hsR : wR.HasSamples L :=
    ((F.pairWord hdim).hasSamples_mapParams_iff Sum.inr).2 (F.hasSamples_pairWord hdim hFt)
  convert (wL.isConstructibleOver_isInvertiblyAdmissible hsL).inter
    ((wR.isConstructibleOver_isInvertiblyAdmissible hsR).inter
      (Word.isConstructibleOver_germ_eq wL wR hsL hsR hsrc)) using 1
  ext d
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff]
  have hInv (ρ : (μ ⊕ μ) → (μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) :
      ((F.pairWord hdim).mapParams ρ).IsInvertiblyAdmissible d ↔
        F.IsInvertiblePair a a' (d ∘ ρ) :=
    ((F.pairWord hdim).isInvertiblyAdmissible_mapParams_iff ρ d).trans
      (F.isInvertiblyAdmissible_pairWord_iff hdim (d ∘ ρ))
  have hG (ρ : (μ ⊕ μ) → (μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ))
      (hd : F.IsInvertiblePair a a' (d ∘ ρ)) :
      ((F.pairWord hdim).mapParams ρ).IsGerm d (F.pairGerm hd) :=
    ((F.pairWord hdim).isGerm_mapParams_iff ρ d _).2 (F.isGerm_pairGerm hdim hd)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hL, hR, heq⟩
    refine ⟨(hInv Sum.inl).2 hL, (hInv Sum.inr).2 hR, F.pairGerm hL, hG Sum.inl hL, ?_⟩
    rw [heq]
    exact hG Sum.inr hR
  · rintro ⟨hL, hR, g, hgL, hgR⟩
    let hdL := (hInv Sum.inl).1 hL
    let hdR := (hInv Sum.inr).1 hR
    exact ⟨hdL, hdR, ((hG Sum.inl hdL).unique hgL).trans ((hG Sum.inr hdR).unique hgR).symm⟩

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isInverse_pairGerm_swap
statement:
theorem isInverse_pairGerm_swap {d : (μ ⊕ μ) → K} (hd : F.IsInvertiblePair a a' d) :
    Germ.IsInverse (F.pairGerm (d := d ∘ Sum.swap) ⟨hd.2, hd.1⟩) (F.pairGerm hd)
proof:
:= by
  let g₁ := F.parameterGerm hd.1.choose
  let g₂ := F.parameterGerm hd.2.choose
  let h₁ := Classical.choose hd.1.choose_spec
  let h₂ := Classical.choose hd.2.choose_spec
  have hi₁ : Germ.IsInverse h₁ g₁ := Classical.choose_spec hd.1.choose_spec
  have hi₂ : Germ.IsInverse h₂ g₂ := Classical.choose_spec hd.2.choose_spec
  constructor
  · change Germ.comp (Germ.comp h₂ g₁) (Germ.comp h₁ g₂) = Germ.id a
    rw [Germ.comp_assoc, ← Germ.comp_assoc g₁ h₁ g₂, hi₁.2, Germ.id_comp, hi₂.1]
  · change Germ.comp (Germ.comp h₁ g₂) (Germ.comp h₂ g₁) = Germ.id a
    rw [Germ.comp_assoc, ← Germ.comp_assoc g₂ h₂ g₁, hi₂.2, Germ.id_comp, hi₁.1]

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isConstructibleOver_pairProduct
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_pairProduct (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a'))
    {L : IntermediateField k K} (hFt : HasGenericSamples L a' (Fintype.card μ))
    (hsrc : HasGenericSamples L a (Fintype.card (((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)))) :
    IsConstructibleOver (↥L) {d : (((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) → K |
      ∃ (hL : F.IsInvertiblePair a a' ((d ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl))
        (hR : F.IsInvertiblePair a a' ((d ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr))
        (hT : F.IsInvertiblePair a a' (d ∘ Sum.inr)),
        Germ.comp (F.pairGerm hL) (F.pairGerm hR) = F.pairGerm hT}
proof:
:= by
  let wP := (F.pairProductWord hdim).mapParams
    (Sum.inl : ((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) → ((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ))
  let wT := (F.pairWord hdim).mapParams
    (Sum.inr : (μ ⊕ μ) → ((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ))
  have hsP : wP.HasSamples L :=
    ((F.pairProductWord hdim).hasSamples_mapParams_iff Sum.inl).2
      (F.hasSamples_pairProductWord hdim hFt)
  have hsT : wT.HasSamples L :=
    ((F.pairWord hdim).hasSamples_mapParams_iff Sum.inr).2 (F.hasSamples_pairWord hdim hFt)
  convert (wP.isConstructibleOver_isInvertiblyAdmissible hsP).inter
    ((wT.isConstructibleOver_isInvertiblyAdmissible hsT).inter
      (Word.isConstructibleOver_germ_eq wP wT hsP hsT hsrc)) using 1
  ext d
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff]
  have hP : wP.IsInvertiblyAdmissible d ↔
      F.IsInvertiblePair a a' ((d ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) ∧
        F.IsInvertiblePair a a' ((d ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr) :=
    ((F.pairProductWord hdim).isInvertiblyAdmissible_mapParams_iff Sum.inl d).trans
      (F.isInvertiblyAdmissible_pairProductWord_iff hdim (d ∘ Sum.inl))
  have hT : wT.IsInvertiblyAdmissible d ↔ F.IsInvertiblePair a a' (d ∘ Sum.inr) :=
    ((F.pairWord hdim).isInvertiblyAdmissible_mapParams_iff Sum.inr d).trans
      (F.isInvertiblyAdmissible_pairWord_iff hdim (d ∘ Sum.inr))
  have hGP (hL : F.IsInvertiblePair a a' ((d ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl))
      (hR : F.IsInvertiblePair a a' ((d ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr)) :
      wP.IsGerm d (Germ.comp (F.pairGerm hL) (F.pairGerm hR)) :=
    ((F.pairProductWord hdim).isGerm_mapParams_iff Sum.inl d _).2
      (F.isGerm_pairProductWord hdim hL hR)
  have hGT (h : F.IsInvertiblePair a a' (d ∘ Sum.inr)) : wT.IsGerm d (F.pairGerm h) :=
    ((F.pairWord hdim).isGerm_mapParams_iff Sum.inr d _).2 (F.isGerm_pairGerm hdim h)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hL, hR, hTar, heq⟩
    refine ⟨hP.2 ⟨hL, hR⟩, hT.2 hTar, _, hGP hL hR, ?_⟩
    rw [heq]
    exact hGT hTar
  · rintro ⟨hProd, hTar, g, hgP, hgT⟩
    obtain ⟨hL, hR⟩ := hP.1 hProd
    let hTar' := hT.1 hTar
    exact ⟨hL, hR, hTar', ((hGP hL hR).unique hgP).trans ((hGT hTar').unique hgT).symm⟩

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isConstructibleOver_pairInverse
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_pairInverse (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a'))
    {L : IntermediateField k K} (hFt : HasGenericSamples L a' (Fintype.card μ))
    (hsrc : HasGenericSamples L a (Fintype.card ((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)))) :
    IsConstructibleOver (↥L) {d : ((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) → K |
      ∃ (hL : F.IsInvertiblePair a a' (d ∘ Sum.inl))
        (hR : F.IsInvertiblePair a a' (d ∘ Sum.inr)),
        Germ.IsInverse (F.pairGerm hR) (F.pairGerm hL)}
proof:
:= by
  let e : ((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) → ((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) :=
    Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.swap) Sum.inr
  convert (F.isConstructibleOver_pairKernel hdim hFt hsrc).preimage_comp e using 1
  ext d
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_preimage]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hL, hR, hinv⟩
    refine ⟨⟨hL.2, hL.1⟩, hR, ?_⟩
    exact (F.isInverse_pairGerm_swap hL).unique hinv
  · rintro ⟨hL, hR, heq⟩
    let hOrig : F.IsInvertiblePair a a' (d ∘ Sum.inl) := ⟨hL.2, hL.1⟩
    have hinv : Germ.IsInverse (F.pairGerm hL) (F.pairGerm hOrig) :=
      F.isInverse_pairGerm_swap hOrig
    rw [heq] at hinv
    exact ⟨hOrig, hR, hinv⟩

name: GroupConfig.isConstructibleOver_inLocus
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_inLocus [Finite ι] (a : ι → K) :
    IsConstructibleOver k {y : ι → K | InLocus (k := k) a y}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := IsNoetherian.noetherian (idealOf k a)
  have h := IsConstructibleOver.iInter fun p : ↥S ↦
    IsConstructibleOver.polynomial_zero (K := K) p.1
  convert h using 1
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iInter]
  unfold InLocus locusIdeal
  rw [← hS, Ideal.map_span, Ideal.span_le, Set.image_subset_iff]
  simp only [Set.subset_def, Set.mem_preimage, SetLike.mem_coe, mem_idealOf_iff,
    MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap]
  constructor
  · intro hy p
    exact hy p.1 p.2
  · intro hy p hp
    exact hy ⟨p, hp⟩

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.aeval_specializeMap
proof:
:= by
  unfold specializeMap
  change ((MvPolynomial.aeval y).restrictScalars k) (MvPolynomial.aeval _ P) = _
  rw [MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply]
  refine congrArg (fun v ↦ aeval v P) (funext fun i ↦ ?_)
  cases i <;> simp only [Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, AlgHom.restrictScalars_apply, aeval_C,
    aeval_X]
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.specialize_isDefinedAt_iff
statement:
theorem specialize_isDefinedAt_iff [PerfectField K]
    (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ) (u : μ → K) (y : ι → K) :
    (F.specialize u).IsDefinedAt y ↔ F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim u y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsDefinedAt specialize
  simp only [aeval_specializeMap]

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.specialize_eval
statement:
theorem specialize_eval [PerfectField K]
    (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ) (u : μ → K) (y : ι → K) :
    (F.specialize u).eval y = F.eval (Sum.elim u y)
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  simp only [eval, specialize, aeval_specializeMap]

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isSmall_parameterClosure
statement:
private theorem isSmall_parameterClosure (u : μ → K) :
    IsSmall k ((racl k (range u) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K)
proof:
:=
  (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range u)).racl

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.cb_parameterGerm_le
proof: := Germ.cb_mk_le _

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.eval_parameterGerm
proof:
:=
  (Germ.eval_eq_rep (F.representative hu) (isSmall_parameterClosure u)
    (F.cb_parameterGerm_le hu) le_rfl hy).trans (F.specialize_eval u y)

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isGenericOver_of_eval_eq
proof:
:= by
  let M := racl k (range u)
  have hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K) := isSmall_parameterClosure u
  let f := F.specialize u
  have hf : f.IsDefinedAt y := (F.specialize_isDefinedAt_iff u y).2 hyD
  have hfw : f.eval y = w := (F.specialize_eval u y).trans hyw
  have hwy : range w ⊆ racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ range y) := by
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    rw [← congrFun hfw j]
    exact dclAdjoin_le_racl M y (f.eval_mem_dclAdjoin hf j)
  have hrw : erk k (M : Set K) (range w) = erk k ∅ (range a) := by
    rw [hw.erk_coe_eq, hw.erk_empty_eq, hdim]
  refine (isGenericOver_iff_erk_eq hM hyV).2 (le_antisymm (erk_le_of_inLocus hM hyV) ?_)
  rw [← hrw]
  exact (erk_mono k (M : Set K) hwy).trans (erk_racl k (M : Set K) (range y)).le

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isAdmissible_iff_generic_surjective
statement:
theorem isAdmissible_iff_generic_surjective (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ)
    (a : ι → K) (a' : κ → K)
    (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a')) (u : μ → K) :
    F.IsAdmissible a a' u ↔
      ∀ w : κ → K, IsGenericOver (racl k (range u)) a' w →
        ∃ y : ι → K, InLocus (k := k) a y ∧
          F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim u y) ∧ F.eval (Sum.elim u y) = w
proof:
:= by
  let M := racl k (range u)
  have hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K) := isSmall_parameterClosure u
  let f := F.specialize u
  constructor
  · intro hu w hw
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hM a
    have hz : IsGenericOver M a' (f.eval y) := by
      rw [F.specialize_eval]
      exact (hu y hy).2
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := hz.exists_algEquiv hw
    have hyσ : IsGenericOver M a (⇑σ ∘ y) := hy.comp σ
    refine ⟨⇑σ ∘ y, hyσ.inLocus, (hu _ hyσ).1, ?_⟩
    rw [← F.specialize_eval, f.eval_comp σ]
    exact funext hσ
  · intro hcover
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hM a'
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀V, hy₀D, hy₀w⟩ := hcover w hw
    have hf₀ : f.IsDefinedAt y₀ := (F.specialize_isDefinedAt_iff u y₀).2 hy₀D
    have hfw : f.eval y₀ = w := (F.specialize_eval u y₀).trans hy₀w
    have hy₀ : IsGenericOver M a y₀ := F.isGenericOver_of_eval_eq hdim hw hy₀V hy₀D hy₀w
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := hy₀.exists_algEquiv hy
    have hσy : ⇑σ ∘ y₀ = y := funext hσ
    have hfy : f.IsDefinedAt y := by
      rw [← hσy]
      exact (f.isDefinedAt_comp_iff σ y₀).2 hf₀
    refine ⟨(F.specialize_isDefinedAt_iff u y).1 hfy, ?_⟩
    rw [← F.specialize_eval, ← hσy, f.eval_comp σ y₀, hfw]
    exact hw.comp σ

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isConstructibleOver_fibre
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_fibre (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ) (a : ι → K) :
    IsConstructibleOver k {z : ((μ ⊕ κ) ⊕ ι) → K |
      InLocus (k := k) a (z ∘ Sum.inr) ∧
      F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim ((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) (z ∘ Sum.inr)) ∧
      F.eval (Sum.elim ((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) (z ∘ Sum.inr)) =
        (z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr}
proof:
:= by
  let q : ((μ ⊕ ι) ⊕ κ) → MvPolynomial ((μ ⊕ κ) ⊕ ι) k :=
    Sum.elim (Sum.elim
      (fun i ↦ X (Sum.inl (Sum.inl i))) (fun j ↦ X (Sum.inr j)))
      (fun j ↦ X (Sum.inl (Sum.inr j)))
  have hgraph := (F.isConstructibleOver_graph (K := K)).preimage_polynomial q
  have hlocus := (isConstructibleOver_inLocus a).preimage_polynomial
    (fun j ↦ (X (Sum.inr j) : MvPolynomial ((μ ⊕ κ) ⊕ ι) k))
  have hpoint (z : ((μ ⊕ κ) ⊕ ι) → K) :
      (fun j ↦ aeval z (q j)) =
        Sum.elim (Sum.elim ((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) (z ∘ Sum.inr))
          ((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr) := by
    funext i
    rcases i with (i | j) | j <;>
      simp only [q, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, aeval_X, Function.comp_apply]
  convert hlocus.inter hgraph using 1
  ext z
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, hpoint,
    Function.comp_def, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, aeval_X]

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isConstructibleOver_forall_generic
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_forall_generic [Fintype μ] {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (a' : κ → K) (t : α → κ → K)
    (ht : ∀ i, IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) a' (t i))
    (hind : erk k ((⊥ : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t i)) =
      ∑ i, erk k ((⊥ : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) (range (t i)))
    (hr : 2 * Fintype.card μ + 1 ≤ Fintype.card α) {s : Set ((μ ⊕ κ) → K)}
    (hs : IsConstructibleOver k s) :
    IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k (⋃ i, range (t i))))
      {u : μ → K | ∀ w, IsGenericOver (racl k (range u)) a' w → Sum.elim u w ∈ s}
proof:
:= by
  let M : IntermediateField k K := ⊥
  have hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K) :=
    ((IsSmall.of_finite (finite_empty : (∅ : Set K).Finite)).racl).mono
      (bot_le : (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) ≤ racl k (∅ : Set K))
  have hfield : (adjoin (↥M) (⋃ i, range (t i))).restrictScalars k =
      adjoin k (⋃ i, range (t i)) := by
    rw [restrictScalars_adjoin, adjoin_union, adjoin_self]
    exact bot_sup_eq _
  have h := IsConstructibleOver.of_restrictScalars_eq hfield
    (constructible_generic_quantifier M hM a' t ht hind hr hs.extend_base)
  convert h using 1
  ext u
  have hadj : (adjoin (↥M) (range u)).restrictScalars k = adjoin k (range u) := by
    rw [restrictScalars_adjoin, adjoin_union, adjoin_self]
    exact bot_sup_eq _
  have hbase : (racl (↥M) (range u)).restrictScalars k = racl k (range u) := by
    ext x
    rw [mem_restrictScalars, mem_racl_iff (↥M), mem_racl_iff k, ← hadj]
    exact Iff.rfl
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hbase]

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isConstructibleOver_admissible
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_admissible [Fintype μ] {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ) (a : ι → K) (a' : κ → K)
    (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a')) (t : α → κ → K)
    (ht : ∀ i, IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) a' (t i))
    (hind : erk k ((⊥ : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t i)) =
      ∑ i, erk k ((⊥ : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) (range (t i)))
    (hr : 2 * Fintype.card μ + 1 ≤ Fintype.card α) :
    IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k (⋃ i, range (t i))))
      {u : μ → K | F.IsAdmissible a a' u}
proof:
:= by
  have h := isConstructibleOver_forall_generic a' t ht hind hr
    ((F.isConstructibleOver_fibre a).exists (φ := fun v y ↦ InLocus (k := k) a y ∧
      F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim (v ∘ Sum.inl) y) ∧ F.eval (Sum.elim (v ∘ Sum.inl) y) = v ∘ Sum.inr))
  convert h using 1
  ext u
  simpa only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Function.comp_def, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]
    using F.isAdmissible_iff_generic_surjective a a' hdim u

name: GroupConfig.erk_iUnion_le_sum
statement:
private theorem erk_iUnion_le_sum {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (C : Set K)
    (S : α → Set K) : erk k C (⋃ i, S i) ≤ ∑ i, erk k C (S i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h (s : Finset α) : erk k C (⋃ i ∈ s, S i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, erk k C (S i) := by
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp [erk_empty]
    | @insert i s hi ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.set_biUnion_insert]
      exact (erk_union_le k C _ _).trans (add_le_add le_rfl ih)
  simpa using h Finset.univ

name: GroupConfig.card_rank_drop_le
statement:
theorem card_rank_drop_le {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (C U : Set K)
    (S : α → Set K) (hS : ∀ i, (S i).Finite)
    (hind : erk k C (⋃ i, S i) = ∑ i, erk k C (S i)) :
    ((Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦ erk k (C ∪ U) (S i) < erk k C (S i)).card : ℕ∞) ≤
      erk k C U
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let d (i : α) : ℕ∞ := if erk k (C ∪ U) (S i) < erk k C (S i) then 1 else 0
  have hdrop (i : α) : erk k (C ∪ U) (S i) + d i ≤ erk k C (S i) := by
    dsimp only [d]
    split_ifs with h
    · exact (ENat.add_one_le_iff (erk_ne_top k (hS i) _)).2 h
    · simpa using erk_base_mono k (subset_union_left : C ⊆ C ∪ U) (S i)
  have hsum : (∑ i, erk k (C ∪ U) (S i)) + (∑ i, d i) ≤
      ∑ i, erk k C (S i) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ ↦ hdrop i
  have hbound : (∑ i, erk k C (S i)) ≤ erk k C U + ∑ i, erk k (C ∪ U) (S i) := by
    calc (∑ i, erk k C (S i)) = erk k C (⋃ i, S i) := hind.symm
      _ ≤ erk k C (U ∪ ⋃ i, S i) := erk_mono k C subset_union_right
      _ = erk k C U + erk k (C ∪ U) (⋃ i, S i) := erk_union_eq k C U _
      _ ≤ erk k C U + ∑ i, erk k (C ∪ U) (S i) :=
        add_le_add le_rfl (erk_iUnion_le_sum (k := k) (C ∪ U) S)
  have hfinite : (∑ i, erk k (C ∪ U) (S i)) ≠ ⊤ :=
    ENat.sum_ne_top.2 fun i _ ↦ erk_ne_top k (hS i) _
  have hcount : (∑ i, d i) ≤ erk k C U :=
    (ENat.add_le_add_iff_left hfinite).1 (by
      simpa only [add_comm (erk k C U)] using hsum.trans hbound)
  simpa [d, ← Finset.sum_filter] using hcount

name: GroupConfig.IsConstructibleOver.card_le
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hc : IsConstructibleOver k
      (⋃ I : {I : Finset α // n ≤ I.card}, ⋂ i : (I : Finset α), s (i : α)) :=
    IsConstructibleOver.iUnion fun I ↦ IsConstructibleOver.iInter fun i ↦ hs i
  convert hc using 1
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_iInter]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    refine ⟨⟨Finset.univ.filter (fun i ↦ x ∈ s i), hx⟩, ?_⟩
    intro i
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.1 i.2).2
  · rintro ⟨I, hI⟩
    refine I.2.trans (Finset.card_le_card ?_)
    intro i hi
    exact Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, hI ⟨i, hi⟩⟩

name: GroupConfig.IsConstructibleOver.mem_comp_algEquiv_iff
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨cells, hcells⟩ := isConstructibleOver_iff_exists_polynomial_data.mp hs
  rw [hcells, hcells]
  have hzero (p : MvPolynomial ι k) :
      MvPolynomial.aeval (σ ∘ x) p = 0 ↔ MvPolynomial.aeval x p = 0 := by
    change MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i ↦ σ.toAlgHom (x i)) p = 0 ↔
      MvPolynomial.aeval x p = 0
    rw [← MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply (f := x) σ.toAlgHom p]
    exact map_eq_zero_iff _ σ.injective
  simp only [ne_eq, hzero]

name: GroupConfig.IsGenericOver.mem_iff_of_invariant
statement:
theorem IsGenericOver.mem_iff_of_invariant [IsAlgClosed K] [Finite κ]
    {M : IntermediateField k K} {a y z : κ → K} {s : Set (κ → K)}
    (hy : IsGenericOver M a y) (hz : IsGenericOver M a z)
    (hinv : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[↥M] K, ∀ v, (σ ∘ v) ∈ s ↔ v ∈ s) : y ∈ s ↔ z ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := hy.exists_algEquiv hz
  simpa only [show σ ∘ y = z from funext hσ] using (hinv σ y).symm

name: GroupConfig.racl_restrictScalars
statement:
private theorem racl_restrictScalars (M : IntermediateField k K) (U : Set K) :
    (racl (↥M) U).restrictScalars k = racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ U)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  change z ∈ racl (↥M) U ↔ z ∈ racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ U)
  rw [mem_racl_iff, mem_racl_iff, ← restrictScalars_adjoin k M U]
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.constructible_left_fiber
proof:
:= by
  have hp := hs.preimage_polynomial (Sum.elim (fun i : ι ↦ C (x i))
    (fun j : κ ↦ X j))
  have hmap : (fun (y : κ → K) i ↦ aeval y
      (Sum.elim (fun i : ι ↦ C (x i)) (fun j : κ ↦ X j) i)) =
      (fun y ↦ Sum.elim (fun i ↦ algebraMap k K (x i)) y) := by
    funext y i
    cases i <;> simp
  convert hp using 1
  ext y
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  exact (congrArg (fun z ↦ z ∈ s) (congrFun hmap y)).symm.to_iff

name: GroupConfig.constructible_right_fiber
proof:
:= by
  have hp := hs.preimage_polynomial (Sum.elim (fun i : ι ↦ X i)
    (fun j : κ ↦ C (y j)))
  have hmap : (fun (x : ι → K) i ↦ aeval x
      (Sum.elim (fun i : ι ↦ X i) (fun j : κ ↦ C (y j)) i)) =
      (fun x ↦ Sum.elim x (fun j ↦ algebraMap k K (y j))) := by
    funext x i
    cases i <;> simp
  convert hp using 1
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  exact (congrArg (fun z ↦ z ∈ s) (congrFun hmap x)).symm.to_iff

name: GroupConfig.sampling_iff
statement:
private theorem sampling_iff {Y : Type*} [Fintype α] (n : ℕ) (t : α → Y)
    (bad : α → Prop) [DecidablePred bad] (P Q : Y → Prop)
    (hb : (Finset.univ.filter bad).card ≤ n) (hr : 2 * n + 1 ≤ Fintype.card α)
    (hg : ∀ i, ¬bad i → P (t i))
    (hu : ∀ y z, P y → P z → (Q y ↔ Q z)) :
    ((∀ y, P y → Q y) ↔ n + 1 ≤ (Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦ Q (t i)).card) ∧
    ((∀ y, P y → Q y) ↔ ∃ y, P y ∧ Q y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hgood : ∃ i, ¬bad i := by
    by_contra! h
    have heq : Finset.univ.filter bad = Finset.univ := by
      ext i
      simp [h i]
    rw [heq, Finset.card_univ] at hb
    omega
  constructor
  · constructor
    · intro h
      have hsub : (Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦ ¬Q (t i)) ⊆ Finset.univ.filter bad := by
        intro i hi
        refine Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, ?_⟩
        by_contra hbi
        exact (Finset.mem_filter.1 hi).2 (h (t i) (hg i hbi))
      have hle := (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans hb
      have hc := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := Finset.univ)
        (fun i ↦ Q (t i))
      rw [Finset.card_univ] at hc
      omega
    · intro h
      have hex : ∃ i, Q (t i) ∧ ¬bad i := by
        by_contra! hnot
        have hsub : (Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦ Q (t i)) ⊆ Finset.univ.filter bad := by
          intro i hi
          exact Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, hnot i (Finset.mem_filter.1 hi).2⟩
        have hle := (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans hb
        omega
      obtain ⟨i, hqi, hbi⟩ := hex
      intro y hy
      exact (hu (t i) y (hg i hbi) hy).1 hqi
  · constructor
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hgood
      exact ⟨t i, hg i hi, h (t i) (hg i hi)⟩
    · rintro ⟨z, hz, hqz⟩ y hy
      exact (hu z y hz hy).1 hqz

name: GroupConfig.generic_quantifier_iff
statement:
theorem generic_quantifier_iff [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K]
    [Fintype ι] [Finite κ] [Fintype α] (M : IntermediateField k K)
    (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K)) (a : κ → K) (t : α → κ → K)
    (ht : ∀ i, IsGenericOver M a (t i))
    (hind : erk k (M : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t i)) = ∑ i, erk k (M : Set K) (range (t i)))
    (hr : 2 * Fintype.card ι + 1 ≤ Fintype.card α)
    {s : Set ((ι ⊕ κ) → K)} (hs : IsConstructibleOver (↥M) s) (x : ι → K) :
    ((∀ y, IsGenericOver ((racl (↥M) (range x)).restrictScalars k) a y → Sum.elim x y ∈ s) ↔
      Fintype.card ι + 1 ≤ (Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦ Sum.elim x (t i) ∈ s).card) ∧
    ((∀ y, IsGenericOver ((racl (↥M) (range x)).restrictScalars k) a y → Sum.elim x y ∈ s) ↔
      ∃ y, IsGenericOver ((racl (↥M) (range x)).restrictScalars k) a y ∧ Sum.elim x y ∈ s)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let E := racl (↥M) (range x)
  have hE : E.restrictScalars k = racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ range x) :=
    racl_restrictScalars M (range x)
  have hsmall : IsSmall k ((E.restrictScalars k : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) := by
    rw [hE]
    exact (hM.union (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range x))).racl
  have hcount := card_rank_drop_le (k := k) (M : Set K) (range x)
    (fun i ↦ range (t i)) (fun i ↦ finite_range (t i)) hind
  have hbound : erk k (M : Set K) (range x) ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℕ∞) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (range x).encard := erk_le_encard k _ _
      _ ≤ (Set.univ : Set ι).encard := by
        simpa only [Set.image_univ] using Set.encard_image_le x Set.univ
      _ = _ := by simp [ENat.card_eq_coe_fintype_card]
  have hb : (Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦
      erk k ((M : Set K) ∪ range x) (range (t i)) < erk k (M : Set K) (range (t i))).card ≤
      Fintype.card ι := by
    exact_mod_cast hcount.trans hbound
  have hg (i : α) (hi : ¬erk k ((M : Set K) ∪ range x) (range (t i)) <
      erk k (M : Set K) (range (t i))) :
      IsGenericOver ((racl (↥M) (range x)).restrictScalars k) a (t i) := by
    have heq : erk k ((M : Set K) ∪ range x) (range (t i)) =
        erk k (M : Set K) (range (t i)) :=
