      le_antisymm (erk_base_mono k subset_union_left _) (not_lt.1 hi)
    have hind' : IndepOver k ∅ (range (t i)) (E.restrictScalars k : Set K) := by
      apply indepOver_of_erk_eq (finite_range (t i))
      rw [empty_union, hE, erk_racl_base, heq, (ht i).erk_coe_eq]
    have hself := isGenericOver_self_of_indepOver hsmall hind'
    change AclGeom.idealOf (↥((racl (↥M) (range x)).restrictScalars k)) (t i) = _
    rw [hself, (ht i).idealOf_eq]
  have hf : IsConstructibleOver (↥E) {y | Sum.elim x y ∈ s} := by
    let xE : ι → E := fun i ↦ ⟨x i, subset_racl (↥M) (range x) (mem_range_self i)⟩
    exact constructible_left_fiber xE hs.extend_base
  have hu (y z : κ → K) (hy : IsGenericOver ((racl (↥M) (range x)).restrictScalars k) a y)
      (hz : IsGenericOver ((racl (↥M) (range x)).restrictScalars k) a z) :
      Sum.elim x y ∈ s ↔ Sum.elim x z ∈ s := by
    apply hy.mem_iff_of_invariant hz
    intro σ v
    
    let σE : K ≃ₐ[↥E] K :=
      { σ.toRingEquiv with commutes' := σ.commutes }
    exact hf.mem_comp_algEquiv_iff σE v
  exact sampling_iff (Fintype.card ι) t
    (fun i ↦ erk k ((M : Set K) ∪ range x) (range (t i)) < erk k (M : Set K) (range (t i)))
    (fun y ↦ IsGenericOver ((racl (↥M) (range x)).restrictScalars k) a y)
    (fun y ↦ Sum.elim x y ∈ s) hb hr hg hu

name: GroupConfig.constructible_generic_quantifier
statement:
theorem constructible_generic_quantifier [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K]
    [UniversalDomain k K] [Fintype ι] [Finite κ] [Fintype α]
    (M : IntermediateField k K) (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K))
    (a : κ → K) (t : α → κ → K) (ht : ∀ i, IsGenericOver M a (t i))
    (hind : erk k (M : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t i)) = ∑ i, erk k (M : Set K) (range (t i)))
    (hr : 2 * Fintype.card ι + 1 ≤ Fintype.card α)
    {s : Set ((ι ⊕ κ) → K)} (hs : IsConstructibleOver (↥M) s) :
    IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin (↥M) (⋃ i, range (t i))))
      {x | ∀ y, IsGenericOver ((racl (↥M) (range x)).restrictScalars k) a y →
        Sum.elim x y ∈ s}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let E := adjoin (↥M) (⋃ i, range (t i))
  have hf (i : α) : IsConstructibleOver (↥E) {x | Sum.elim x (t i) ∈ s} := by
    let ti : κ → E := fun j ↦ ⟨t i j,
      subset_adjoin (↥M) _ (mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, mem_range_self j⟩)⟩
    exact constructible_right_fiber ti hs.extend_base
  have h := IsConstructibleOver.card_le (fun i ↦ {x | Sum.elim x (t i) ∈ s}) hf
    (Fintype.card ι + 1)
  convert h using 1
  ext x
  exact (generic_quantifier_iff M hM a t ht hind hr hs x).1

name: GroupConfig.separating_polynomial
statement:
private theorem separating_polynomial {s : Set (ι → K)} (hs : IsConstructibleOver k s)
    (e : ι → K) (he : e ∉ s)
    (hspec : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ p : MvPolynomial ι k, aeval e p = 0 → aeval x p = 0) :
    ∃ p : MvPolynomial ι k, aeval e p ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, aeval x p = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨cells, hcells⟩ := isConstructibleOver_iff_exists_polynomial_data.mp hs
  have hcell (c : {c // c ∈ cells}) : ∃ p : MvPolynomial ι k,
      aeval e p ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ x ∈ s,
        (∀ i, aeval x (c.1.g i) = 0) → aeval x c.1.f ≠ 0 → aeval x p = 0 := by
    by_cases hg : ∃ i, aeval e (c.1.g i) ≠ 0
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hg
      exact ⟨c.1.g i, hi, fun x _ hx _ ↦ hx i⟩
    · have hge : ∀ i, aeval e (c.1.g i) = 0 := by simpa using hg
      have hfe : aeval e c.1.f = 0 := by
        by_contra hf
        exact he ((hcells e).2 ⟨c.1, c.2, hge, hf⟩)
      exact ⟨1, by simp, fun x hx _ hfx ↦ (hfx (hspec x hx c.1.f hfe)).elim⟩
  choose p hpe hpx using hcell
  refine ⟨∏ c, p c, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [map_prod]
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun c _ ↦ hpe c
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hcg, hcf⟩ := (hcells x).1 hx
    rw [map_prod]
    exact Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ (⟨c, hc⟩ : {c // c ∈ cells}))
      (hpx ⟨c, hc⟩ x hx hcg hcf)

name: GroupConfig.exists_polynomial_zero_of_no_generic
statement:
theorem exists_polynomial_zero_of_no_generic [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K]
    [UniversalDomain k K] [Finite ι] (M : IntermediateField k K)
    (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K)) (a : ι → K) {s : Set (ι → K)}
    (hs : IsConstructibleOver (↥M) s)
    (hV : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ p ∈ locusIdeal k a, aeval x p = 0)
    (hno : ∀ e, IsGenericOver (racl k (M : Set K)) a e → e ∉ s) :
    ∃ p : MvPolynomial ι (↥M),
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (↥M) K) p ∉ locusIdeal k a ∧
      ∀ x ∈ s, aeval x p = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hM.racl a
  have hMN : M ≤ racl k (M : Set K) := subset_racl k (M : Set K)
  have heM := he.of_le hMN
  have hspec : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ p : MvPolynomial ι (↥M),
      aeval e p = 0 → aeval x p = 0 := by
    intro x hx p hp
    have hmap := map_mem_locusIdeal (↥M) ((mem_idealOf_iff (↥M)).2 hp)
    rw [heM.locusIdeal_eq] at hmap
    have hz := hV x hx _ hmap
    simpa only [MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap] using hz
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hps⟩ := separating_polynomial hs e (hno e he) hspec
  refine ⟨p, ?_, hps⟩
  rw [← heM.locusIdeal_eq, map_mem_locusIdeal_iff]
  exact fun h ↦ hp ((mem_idealOf_iff (↥M)).1 h)

name: GroupConfig.enat_eq_sub_of_add_eq
statement:
private theorem enat_eq_sub_of_add_eq {a c : ℕ} {x : ℕ∞} (h : (a : ℕ∞) + x = c) :
    x = ((c - a : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using ENat.recTopCoe with
  | top => simp at h
  | coe n =>
    norm_cast at h ⊢
    omega

name: GroupConfig.erk_singleton_of_notMem
statement:
private theorem erk_singleton_of_notMem {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {C : Set K} {x : K} (h : x ∉ racl k C) : erk k C ({x} : Set K) = 1
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm ((erk_le_encard k C _).trans (by simp))
    (Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 fun h0 ↦ h ((erk_eq_zero_iff k).1 h0 (mem_singleton x)))

name: GroupConfig.erk_slEntries_upper_le_two
statement:
private theorem erk_slEntries_upper_le_two {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (C : Set K) (m : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K) (hm : m 1 0 = 0) :
    erk k C (slEntries m) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : m 0 0 * m 1 1 = 1 := by
    have h := m.det_coe
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, hm, mul_zero, sub_zero] at h
    exact h
  have hsub : slEntries m ⊆ racl k (C ∪ {m 0 0, m 0 1}) := by
    have h0 : m 0 0 ∈ racl k (C ∪ {m 0 0, m 0 1}) := subset_racl k _ (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
    have h1 : m 0 1 ∈ racl k (C ∪ {m 0 0, m 0 1}) := subset_racl k _ (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl))
    have h3 : m 1 1 ∈ racl k (C ∪ {m 0 0, m 0 1}) := by
      rw [eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right hdet]
      exact inv_mem h0
    have h2 : m 1 0 ∈ racl k (C ∪ {m 0 0, m 0 1}) := by
      rw [hm]
      exact zero_mem _
    rintro _ ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · exact h0
    · exact h1
    · exact h2
    · exact h3
  calc erk k C (slEntries m) ≤ erk k C (racl k (C ∪ {m 0 0, m 0 1}) : Set K) :=
        erk_mono k C hsub
    _ = erk k C {m 0 0, m 0 1} := erk_racl k C _
    _ ≤ 2 := (erk_le_encard k C _).trans ((encard_insert_le _ _).trans (by simp; norm_num))

name: GroupConfig.enat_eq_two_of_add
statement:
private theorem enat_eq_two_of_add {x y : ℕ∞} (hx : x ≤ 2) (hy : y ≤ 2) (h : 4 ≤ x + y) :
    x = 2 ∧ y = 2
proof:
:= by
  induction x using ENat.recTopCoe with
  | top => simp at hx
  | coe a =>
    induction y using ENat.recTopCoe with
    | top => simp at hy
    | coe b =>
      norm_cast at hx hy h ⊢
      omega

name: GroupConfig.notMem_racl_singleton_of_pair
statement:
private theorem notMem_racl_singleton_of_pair {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {x y : K} (h : erk k ∅ ({x, y} : Set K) = 2) : y ∉ racl k ({x} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  intro hy
  have hle : erk k ∅ ({x, y} : Set K) ≤ 1 := by
    have hsub : ({x, y} : Set K) ⊆ racl k ({x} : Set K) := by
      rintro z (rfl | rfl)
      · exact subset_racl k _ rfl
      · exact hy
    calc erk k ∅ ({x, y} : Set K) ≤ erk k ∅ (racl k ({x} : Set K) : Set K) := erk_mono k ∅ hsub
      _ = erk k ∅ ({x} : Set K) := by
          simpa only [empty_union] using erk_racl k (∅ : Set K) ({x} : Set K)
      _ ≤ 1 := (erk_le_encard k ∅ _).trans (by simp)
  rw [h] at hle
  norm_num at hle

name: GroupConfig.erk_pair_base_eq
statement:
private theorem erk_pair_base_eq {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {P X : Set K} {a b : ℕ} (hP : erk k ∅ P = a) (hPX : erk k ∅ (P ∪ X) = (a + b : ℕ)) :
    erk k P X = b
proof:
:= by
  have h := erk_union_eq k ∅ P X
  rw [empty_union, hP, hPX] at h
  have h' := enat_eq_sub_of_add_eq h.symm
  rw [h']
  norm_num

name: GroupConfig.upper_curve_ranks
statement:
private theorem upper_curve_ranks {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (g h : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K) (hg10 : g 1 0 = 0) (hh10 : h 1 0 = 0)
    (hgh : erk k ∅ (slEntries g ∪ slEntries h) = 4) {s t u : K}
    (hs : s ∈ racl k (slEntries g)) (ht : t ∈ racl k (slEntries h))
    (hu : u ∈ racl k (slEntries (h * g)))
    (hst : erk k ∅ ({s, t} : Set K) = 2) (hsu : erk k ∅ ({s, u} : Set K) = 2)
    (hstu : erk k ∅ ({s, t, u} : Set K) = 2) :
    erk k ∅ (slEntries g) = 2 ∧ erk k {s, t} (slEntries g) = 1 ∧
      erk k {s, t} (slEntries h) = 1 ∧ erk k {s, t} (slEntries g ∪ slEntries h) = 2 ∧
      erk k {s, t} (slEntries (h * g)) = 1 ∧ u ∈ racl k ({s, t} : Set K) ∧
      erk k {s} (slEntries g) = 1 ∧ erk k {t} (slEntries h) = 1 ∧
      erk k {u} (slEntries (h * g)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  
  have hp10 : (h * g) 1 0 = 0 := by
    rw [sl_mul_apply, hh10, hg10, zero_mul, mul_zero, add_zero]
  obtain ⟨hG2, hH2⟩ := enat_eq_two_of_add (erk_slEntries_upper_le_two ∅ g hg10)
    (erk_slEntries_upper_le_two ∅ h hh10) (by rw [← hgh]; exact erk_union_le k ∅ _ _)
  have hGH : erk k (slEntries g) (slEntries h) = 2 :=
    erk_pair_base_eq (a := 2) (b := 2) hG2 (by rw [hgh]; rfl)
  have hinGH : (racl k (slEntries g) : Set K) ∩ racl k (slEntries h) ⊆ racl k (∅ : Set K) := by
    have hind : IndepOver k ∅ (slEntries h) (slEntries g) :=
      indepOver_of_erk_eq (finite_range _) (by rw [empty_union, hGH, hH2])
    have h := hind.racl_inter_eq
    rw [empty_union, empty_union] at h
    rw [inter_comm, h]
  have hPG : racl k (slEntries (h * g) ∪ slEntries g) = racl k (slEntries h ∪ slEntries g) :=
    racl_sl_product_union h g
  have hPG4 : erk k ∅ (slEntries (h * g) ∪ slEntries g) = 4 := by
    rw [erk_eq_of_racl_eq hPG, union_comm]
    exact hgh
  obtain ⟨hP2, -⟩ := enat_eq_two_of_add (erk_slEntries_upper_le_two ∅ (h * g) hp10)
    (erk_slEntries_upper_le_two ∅ g hg10) (by rw [← hPG4]; exact erk_union_le k ∅ _ _)
  have hGP : erk k (slEntries g) (slEntries (h * g)) = 2 :=
    erk_pair_base_eq (a := 2) (b := 2) hG2 (by rw [union_comm, hPG4]; rfl)
  have hinGP : (racl k (slEntries g) : Set K) ∩ racl k (slEntries (h * g)) ⊆
      racl k (∅ : Set K) := by
    have hind : IndepOver k ∅ (slEntries (h * g)) (slEntries g) :=
      indepOver_of_erk_eq (finite_range _) (by rw [empty_union, hGP, hP2])
    have h := hind.racl_inter_eq
    rw [empty_union, empty_union] at h
    rw [inter_comm, h]
  
  have hs0 : s ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) := fun h0 ↦ notMem_racl_singleton_of_pair
    (by rw [pair_comm]; exact hst) (racl_mono (empty_subset _) h0)
  have ht0 : t ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) := fun h0 ↦ notMem_racl_singleton_of_pair hst
    (racl_mono (empty_subset _) h0)
  have hu0 : u ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) := fun h0 ↦ notMem_racl_singleton_of_pair hsu
    (racl_mono (empty_subset _) h0)
  have hs1 : erk k ∅ ({s} : Set K) = 1 := erk_singleton_of_notMem hs0
  have ht1 : erk k ∅ ({t} : Set K) = 1 := erk_singleton_of_notMem ht0
  have hu1 : erk k ∅ ({u} : Set K) = 1 := erk_singleton_of_notMem hu0
  have htG : t ∉ racl k (slEntries g) := fun h0 ↦ ht0 (hinGH ⟨h0, ht⟩)
  have hsH : s ∉ racl k (slEntries h) := fun h0 ↦ hs0 (hinGH ⟨hs, h0⟩)
  have hsP : s ∉ racl k (slEntries (h * g)) := fun h0 ↦ hs0 (hinGP ⟨hs, h0⟩)
  
  have hmem3 : ∀ {x y z : K}, erk k ∅ ({x, y} : Set K) = 2 →
      erk k ∅ ({x, y} ∪ {z} : Set K) = 2 → z ∈ racl k ({x, y} : Set K) := by
    intro x y z hxy hxyz
    have h := erk_pair_base_eq (a := 2) (b := 0) hxy (by rw [hxyz]; rfl)
    exact (erk_singleton_eq_zero_iff k).1 h
  have huE : u ∈ racl k ({s, t} : Set K) := hmem3 hst (by
    rw [insert_union, singleton_union]
    exact hstu)
  have htSU : t ∈ racl k ({s, u} : Set K) := hmem3 hsu (by
    rw [insert_union, singleton_union, pair_comm u t]
    exact hstu)
  
  have h3 : ∀ {X : Set K} {x : K}, erk k ∅ X = 2 → x ∉ racl k X →
      erk k ∅ (X ∪ {x}) = ((2 + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by
    intro X x hX hx
    rw [erk_union_eq k ∅ X {x}, empty_union, hX, erk_singleton_of_notMem hx]
    norm_num
  have hpairB : ∀ {X : Set K} {a b : K}, b ∈ racl k (X ∪ {a}) →
      racl k ({a, b} ∪ X) = racl k (X ∪ {a}) := by
    intro X a b hb
    refine le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset ?_
      fun z hz ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl hz))) (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset
      (fun z hz ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hz)) ?_))
    · rintro z (rfl | rfl)
      · exact subset_racl k _ (Or.inr rfl)
      · exact hb
    · rintro z rfl
      exact subset_racl k _ (Or.inl (Or.inl rfl))
  have hsingle : ∀ {X : Set K} {x : K}, erk k ∅ X = 2 → erk k ∅ ({x} : Set K) = 1 →
      x ∈ racl k X → erk k {x} X = 1 := by
    intro X x hX hx hxX
    refine erk_pair_base_eq (a := 1) (b := 1) hx ?_
    rw [union_comm, erk_union_eq_of_subset_racl k (by
      rintro z rfl
      rwa [empty_union]), hX]
    rfl
  have hcG : racl k ({s, t} ∪ slEntries g) = racl k (slEntries g ∪ {t}) := by
    rw [pair_comm]
    exact hpairB (racl_mono subset_union_left hs)
  have hcH : racl k ({s, t} ∪ slEntries h) = racl k (slEntries h ∪ {s}) :=
    hpairB (racl_mono subset_union_left ht)
  have htPs : t ∈ racl k (slEntries (h * g) ∪ {s}) := by
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ htSU
    rintro z (rfl | rfl)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Or.inr rfl)
    · exact racl_mono subset_union_left hu
  have hcP : racl k ({s, t} ∪ slEntries (h * g)) = racl k (slEntries (h * g) ∪ {s}) :=
    hpairB htPs
  refine ⟨hG2, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, huE, hsingle hG2 hs1 hs, hsingle hH2 ht1 ht,
    hsingle hP2 hu1 hu⟩
  · exact erk_pair_base_eq (a := 2) (b := 1) hst (by rw [erk_eq_of_racl_eq hcG]; exact h3 hG2 htG)
  · exact erk_pair_base_eq (a := 2) (b := 1) hst (by rw [erk_eq_of_racl_eq hcH]; exact h3 hH2 hsH)
  · refine erk_pair_base_eq (a := 2) (b := 2) hst ?_
    rw [union_comm, erk_union_eq_of_subset_racl k (by
      rintro z (rfl | rfl)
      · rw [empty_union]
        exact racl_mono subset_union_left hs
      · rw [empty_union]
        exact racl_mono subset_union_right ht), hgh]
    rfl
  · exact erk_pair_base_eq (a := 2) (b := 1) hst (by rw [erk_eq_of_racl_eq hcP]; exact h3 hP2 hsP)

name: GroupConfig.indep_copy_claim
statement:
private theorem indep_copy_claim {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {E F X Y : Set K} (hFE : F ⊆ E) (hX : X.Finite) (hY : Y.Finite)
    (hXF : erk k F X = 1) (hXE : erk k E X = 1) (hYF : erk k F Y = 1) (hYE : erk k E Y = 1)
    (hind : IndepOver k E Y X) :
    (racl k (F ∪ X) : Set K) ∩ racl k (F ∪ Y) ⊆ racl k F ∧
      (racl k (F ∪ (X ∪ Y)) : Set K) ∩ racl k (F ∪ E) ⊆ racl k F
proof:
:= by
  have hXYE : erk k E (X ∪ Y) = 2 := by
    rw [erk_union_eq, hXE, hind.erk_eq subset_rfl hY, hYE]
    norm_num
  have hXYF : erk k F (X ∪ Y) = 2 := by
    refine le_antisymm ((erk_union_le k F X Y).trans_eq (by rw [hXF, hYF]; norm_num)) ?_
    rw [← hXYE]
    exact erk_base_mono k hFE _
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have hYX : erk k (F ∪ Y) X = 1 := by
      have h := erk_union_eq k F Y X
      rw [union_comm, hXYF, hYF] at h
      have h' := enat_eq_sub_of_add_eq (a := 1) (c := 2) (by exact_mod_cast h.symm)
      rw [h']
      norm_num
    have hi : IndepOver k F X Y := indepOver_of_erk_eq hX (by rw [hYX, hXF])
    rw [hi.racl_inter_eq]
  · have hi : IndepOver k F (X ∪ Y) E := indepOver_of_erk_eq (hX.union hY)
      (by rw [union_eq_right.2 hFE, hXYE, hXYF])
    rw [hi.racl_inter_eq]

name: GroupConfig.slAct_mul
proof:
:= by
  have hd : m₂ 0 0 * m₂ 1 1 = 1 := by
    have h := m₂.det_coe
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, h₂, mul_zero, sub_zero] at h
    exact h
  simp only [slAct, sl_mul_apply, h₂, mul_zero, add_zero]
  linear_combination (m₁ 0 0 * m₁ 0 1) * hd

name: GroupConfig.slAct_one
statement:
private theorem slAct_one {K : Type*} [Field K] (z : K) :
    slAct (1 : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K) z = z
proof:
:= by
  simp [slAct]

name: GroupConfig.inv_apply_one_zero
statement:
private theorem inv_apply_one_zero {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K}
    (hm : m 1 0 = 0) : m⁻¹ 1 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [SpecialLinearGroup.SL2_inv_expl]
  simp [hm]

name: GroupConfig.slAct_inv_slAct
statement:
private theorem slAct_inv_slAct {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K}
    (hm : m 1 0 = 0) (z : K) : slAct m⁻¹ (slAct m z) = z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← slAct_mul m⁻¹ hm, inv_mul_cancel, slAct_one]

name: GroupConfig.slAct_slAct_inv
statement:
private theorem slAct_slAct_inv {K : Type*} [Field K] {m : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K}
    (hm : m 1 0 = 0) (z : K) : slAct m (slAct m⁻¹ z) = z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← slAct_mul m (inv_apply_one_zero hm), mul_inv_cancel, slAct_one]

name: GroupConfig.slAct_mem
proof:
:=
  add_mem (mul_mem (pow_mem (hm 0 0) 2) hz) (mul_mem (hm 0 0) (hm 0 1))

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfig.sl_inv_apply
statement:
private theorem sl_inv_apply {K : Type*} [Field K] (m : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K) :
    m⁻¹ 0 0 = m 1 1 ∧ m⁻¹ 0 1 = -m 0 1 ∧ m⁻¹ 1 0 = -m 1 0 ∧ m⁻¹ 1 1 = m 0 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> rw [SpecialLinearGroup.SL2_inv_expl] <;> rfl

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfig.racl_inter_of_pair
statement:
private theorem racl_inter_of_pair {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {x y : K} (h : erk k ∅ ({x, y} : Set K) = 2) :
    (racl k ({x} : Set K) : Set K) ∩ racl k ({y} : Set K) ⊆ racl k (∅ : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have hy : y ∉ racl k ({x} : Set K) := notMem_racl_singleton_of_pair h
  have hy0 : y ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) := fun h0 ↦ hy (racl_mono (empty_subset _) h0)
  have hind : IndepOver k ∅ ({y} : Set K) ({x} : Set K) := indepOver_of_erk_eq (toFinite _)
    (by rw [empty_union, erk_singleton_of_notMem hy, erk_singleton_of_notMem hy0])
  have hi := hind.racl_inter_eq
  rw [empty_union, empty_union] at hi
  rw [inter_comm, hi]

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfig.false_of_indep_of_subset
statement:
private theorem false_of_indep_of_subset {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {E X Y : Set K} (hind : IndepOver k E Y X) (hY : erk k E Y = 1)
    (hsub : Y ⊆ racl k (E ∪ X)) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hi := hind.racl_inter_eq
  have hYE : Y ⊆ racl k E := fun y hy ↦ hi ▸ ⟨subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hy), hsub hy⟩
  have h0 : erk k E Y = 0 := (erk_eq_zero_iff k).2 hYE
  rw [hY] at h0
  exact one_ne_zero h0

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfig.exists_indep_copy
statement:
private theorem exists_indep_copy {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K] {E : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed ↥E]
    (hE : IsSmall k (E : Set K)) (x : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K) :
    ∃ x' : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K,
      IndepOver k (E : Set K) (slEntries x') (slEntries x) ∧
      idealOf (↥E) (slTuple x') = idealOf (↥E) (slTuple x) ∧
      ∀ F : Set K, F ⊆ E → erk k F (slEntries x') = erk k F (slEntries x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_algEquiv_indepOver (M := E) hE (slTuple x)
    (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range (slTuple x)))
  refine ⟨SpecialLinearGroup.map σ.toRingHom x, hσ, idealOf_comp_algHom (↥E) σ.toAlgHom _,
    fun F hFE ↦ ?_⟩
  have hfix : (σ.restrictScalars k) '' F = F := EqOn.image_eq_self fun z hz ↦
    σ.commutes ⟨z, hFE hz⟩
  have himg : (σ.restrictScalars k) '' slEntries x =
      slEntries (SpecialLinearGroup.map σ.toRingHom x) := by
    rw [← range_comp]
    rfl
  rw [← himg]
  have h := erk_image (σ.restrictScalars k) F (slEntries x)
  rwa [hfix] at h

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfig.slEntries_upper_subset
statement:
private theorem slEntries_upper_subset {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {S : Set K} (m : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K) (hm : m 1 0 = 0)
    (h0 : m 0 0 ∈ racl k S) (h1 : m 0 1 ∈ racl k S) : slEntries m ⊆ racl k S
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : m 0 0 * m 1 1 = 1 := by
    have h := m.det_coe
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, hm, mul_zero, sub_zero] at h
    exact h
  have h3 : m 1 1 ∈ racl k S := by
    rw [eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right hdet]
    exact inv_mem h0
  have h2 : m 1 0 ∈ racl k S := by
    rw [hm]
    exact zero_mem _
  rintro _ ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  · exact h0
  · exact h1
  · exact h2
  · exact h3

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfig.upper_curve_multiplier
statement:
private theorem upper_curve_multiplier {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K]
    (g h : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K) (hg10 : g 1 0 = 0) (hh10 : h 1 0 = 0)
    (hgh : erk k ∅ (slEntries g ∪ slEntries h) = 4) {s t u : K}
    (hs : s ∈ racl k (slEntries g)) (ht : t ∈ racl k (slEntries h))
    (hu : u ∈ racl k (slEntries (h * g)))
    (hst : erk k ∅ ({s, t} : Set K) = 2) (hsu : erk k ∅ ({s, u} : Set K) = 2)
    (hstu : erk k ∅ ({s, t, u} : Set K) = 2) :
    g 0 0 ∈ racl k ({s} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hG2, hEg, hEh, hEgh, hEp, huE, hsg, hth, hup⟩ :=
    upper_curve_ranks g h hg10 hh10 hgh hs ht hu hst hsu hstu
  have hp10 : (h * g) 1 0 = 0 := by
    rw [sl_mul_apply, hh10, hg10, zero_mul, mul_zero, add_zero]
  
  obtain ⟨E, hEdef⟩ : ∃ E : IntermediateField k K, E = racl k ({s, t} : Set K) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hEs : IsSmall k (E : Set K) := hEdef ▸ (IsSmall.of_finite (toFinite _)).racl
  have : IsAlgClosed ↥E := hEdef ▸ isAlgClosed_racl _
  have : UniversalDomain ↥E K := universalDomain_of_isSmall E hEs
  have hEk : ∀ X : Set K, erk k (E : Set K) X = erk k ({s, t} : Set K) X := fun X ↦ by
    rw [hEdef]
    exact erk_racl_base k _ X
  have hEE : ∀ X : Set K, erk (↥E) ∅ X = erk k ({s, t} : Set K) X := fun X ↦
    (erk_base_empty E X).trans (hEk X)
  have hsE : ({s} : Set K) ⊆ E := by
    rintro z rfl
    rw [hEdef]
    exact subset_racl k _ (Or.inl rfl)
  have htE : ({t} : Set K) ⊆ E := by
    rintro z rfl
    rw [hEdef]
    exact subset_racl k _ (Or.inr rfl)
  have huEs : ({u} : Set K) ⊆ E := by
    rintro z rfl
    rw [hEdef]
    exact huE
  have hsubE : ∀ {F : Set K}, F ⊆ E → racl k F ≤ E := fun hF ↦ by
    rw [hEdef]
    exact racl_le_of_subset_racl (hF.trans (by rw [hEdef]))
  
  obtain ⟨n, hn10, hn1, H1, H2, hR, hL⟩ := exists_upper_curve_cosets (k := ↥E) g h hg10
    ((hEE _).trans hEg) ((hEE _).trans hEh) ((hEE _).trans hEgh) ((hEE _).trans hEp)
  have hdich := upper_locus_unipotent_or_torus (k := ↥E) n hn10 hn1 H1 fun d hd _ m ↦ H2 d hd m
  
  obtain ⟨g₂, hg₂i, hg₂I, hg₂r⟩ := exists_indep_copy hEs g
  obtain ⟨h₂, hh₂i, hh₂I, hh₂r⟩ := exists_indep_copy hEs h
  obtain ⟨p₂, hp₂i, hp₂I, hp₂r⟩ := exists_indep_copy hEs (h * g)
  have hEset : (E : Set K) ⊆ E := subset_rfl
  have cg := indep_copy_claim (k := k) hsE (finite_range _) (finite_range _) hsg
    ((hEk _).trans hEg) ((hg₂r _ hsE).trans hsg) ((hg₂r _ hEset).trans ((hEk _).trans hEg)) hg₂i
  have ch := indep_copy_claim (k := k) htE (finite_range _) (finite_range _) hth
    ((hEk _).trans hEh) ((hh₂r _ htE).trans hth) ((hh₂r _ hEset).trans ((hEk _).trans hEh)) hh₂i
  have cp := indep_copy_claim (k := k) huEs (finite_range _) (finite_range _) hup
    ((hEk _).trans hEp) ((hp₂r _ huEs).trans hup) ((hp₂r _ hEset).trans ((hEk _).trans hEp))
    hp₂i
  have hlocus : ∀ {x x' : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K},
      idealOf (↥E) (slTuple x') = idealOf (↥E) (slTuple x) →
      InLocus (k := ↥E) (slTuple x) (slTuple x') := fun hI ↦
    (inLocus_iff_idealOf_le _ _).2 hI.ge
  have hupper : ∀ {x x' : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K}, x 1 0 = 0 →
      idealOf (↥E) (slTuple x') = idealOf (↥E) (slTuple x) → x' 1 0 = 0 := by
    intro x x' hx hI
    have he := aeval_eq_zero_of_inLocus_base (hlocus hI) (P := MvPolynomial.X (1, 0)) (by
      rw [MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
      exact hx)
    rwa [MvPolynomial.aeval_X] at he
  have hg₂10 : g₂ 1 0 = 0 := hupper hg10 hg₂I
  have hh₂10 : h₂ 1 0 = 0 := hupper hh10 hh₂I
  have hp₂10 : p₂ 1 0 = 0 := hupper hp10 hp₂I
  have hdetg : g 0 0 * g 1 1 = 1 := by
    have h := g.det_coe
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, hg10, mul_zero, sub_zero] at h
    exact h
  rcases hdich with hU | ⟨c, hT⟩
  · 
    have hd := hU _ ((hR g₂).1 (hlocus hg₂I))
    rw [sl_mul_apply, (sl_inv_apply g).1, (sl_inv_apply g).2.2.1, hg10, neg_zero, mul_zero,
      add_zero] at hd
    have hgg : g₂ 0 0 = g 0 0 := by
      rw [eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left hd, eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left hdetg]
    refine cg.1 ⟨subset_racl k _ (Or.inr ⟨(0, 0), rfl⟩), ?_⟩
    rw [← hgg]
    exact subset_racl k _ (Or.inr ⟨(0, 0), rfl⟩)
  · exfalso
    obtain ⟨cK, hcK⟩ : ∃ cK : K, cK = algebraMap (↥E) K c := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hcKE : cK ∈ E := hcK ▸ c.2
    have hT' : ∀ d, InLocus (k := ↥E) (slTuple n) (slTuple d) →
        d 0 1 * d 0 0 = cK * (d 0 0 ^ 2 - 1) := fun d hd ↦ hcK ▸ hT d hd
    have hTfix : ∀ d, InLocus (k := ↥E) (slTuple n) (slTuple d) → slAct d (-cK) = -cK :=
      fun d hd ↦ by
        have h := hT' d hd
        unfold slAct
        linear_combination h
    
    have hupp : ∀ {x m : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K}, x 1 0 = 0 →
        InLocus (k := ↥E) (slTuple x) (slTuple m) → m 1 0 = 0 := by
      intro x m hx hm
      have he := aeval_eq_zero_of_inLocus_base hm (P := MvPolynomial.X (1, 0)) (by
        rw [MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
        exact hx)
      rwa [MvPolynomial.aeval_X] at he
    
    have hsq : ∀ {X Y : Set K} {d : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K},
        InLocus (k := ↥E) (slTuple n) (slTuple d) → d 1 0 = 0 →
        IndepOver k (E : Set K) Y X → erk k (E : Set K) Y = 1 →
        ((∀ i j, d i j ∈ racl k ((E : Set K) ∪ X)) → Y ⊆ racl k ((E : Set K) ∪ X)) →
        d 0 0 ^ 2 ≠ 1 := by
      intro X Y d hd hd10 hind hY hsub h1
      have hdet : d 0 0 * d 1 1 = 1 := by
        have h := d.det_coe
        rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, hd10, mul_zero, sub_zero] at h
        exact h
      have h00 : d 0 0 ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one hdet
      have h01 : d 0 1 = 0 := by
        have h := hT' d hd
        rw [h1, sub_self, mul_zero] at h
        exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h).resolve_right h00
      have halg : d 0 0 ∈ racl k (∅ : Set K) := by
        refine mem_racl_empty_of_isAlgebraic ?_
        by_contra hc
        exact sq_ne_one_of_transcendental hc h1
      have hd0 : ∀ z ∈ racl k (∅ : Set K), z ∈ racl k ((E : Set K) ∪ X) :=
        fun z hz ↦ racl_mono (empty_subset _) hz
      refine false_of_indep_of_subset hind hY (hsub fun i j ↦ ?_)
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
      · exact hd0 _ halg
      · change d 0 1 ∈ _
        rw [h01]
        exact zero_mem _
      · change d 1 0 ∈ _
        rw [hd10]
        exact zero_mem _
      · change d 1 1 ∈ _
        rw [eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right hdet]
        exact hd0 _ (inv_mem halg)
    
    have hconst : ∀ {d : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K} {S : Set K},
        InLocus (k := ↥E) (slTuple n) (slTuple d) → d 0 0 ^ 2 ≠ 1 →
        (∀ i j, d i j ∈ racl k S) → cK ∈ racl k S := by
      intro d S hd h1 hS
      have hl : d 0 0 ^ 2 - 1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 h1
      have h := hT' d hd
      rw [show cK = d 0 1 * d 0 0 / (d 0 0 ^ 2 - 1) from (eq_div_iff hl).2 h.symm]
      exact div_mem (mul_mem (hS 0 1) (hS 0 0)) (sub_mem (pow_mem (hS 0 0) 2) (one_mem _))
    have hentries : ∀ (x : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K) {S : Set K}, slEntries x ⊆ S →
        ∀ i j, x i j ∈ racl k S := fun x S hx i j ↦ subset_racl k _ (hx ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩)
    
    have hcs : cK ∈ racl k ({s} : Set K) := by
      have hd := (hR g₂).1 (hlocus hg₂I)
      have hd10 : (g₂ * g⁻¹) 1 0 = 0 := by
        rw [sl_mul_apply, hg₂10, (sl_inv_apply g).2.2.1, hg10, neg_zero, zero_mul, mul_zero,
          add_zero]
      have hmemd : ∀ i j, (g₂ * g⁻¹) i j ∈ racl k (slEntries g ∪ slEntries g₂) :=
        sl_mul_entries_mem _ (hentries g₂ subset_union_right)
          (sl_inv_entries_mem _ (hentries g subset_union_left))
      have h1 : (g₂ * g⁻¹) 0 0 ^ 2 ≠ 1 := hsq hd hd10 hg₂i
        ((hg₂r _ hEset).trans ((hEk _).trans hEg)) fun hdE ↦ by
          rintro _ ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩
          have h := sl_mul_entries_mem _ (A := g₂ * g⁻¹) (B := g) hdE
            (hentries g subset_union_right) i j
          rwa [inv_mul_cancel_right] at h
      refine cg.2 ⟨racl_mono subset_union_right (hconst hd h1 hmemd), ?_⟩
      exact subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hcKE)
    have hct : cK ∈ racl k ({t} : Set K) := by
      have hd := (hL h₂).1 (hlocus hh₂I)
      have hd10 : (h⁻¹ * h₂) 1 0 = 0 := by
        rw [sl_mul_apply, (sl_inv_apply h).2.2.1, hh10, hh₂10, neg_zero, zero_mul, mul_zero,
          add_zero]
      have hmemd : ∀ i j, (h⁻¹ * h₂) i j ∈ racl k (slEntries h ∪ slEntries h₂) :=
        sl_mul_entries_mem _ (sl_inv_entries_mem _ (hentries h subset_union_left))
          (hentries h₂ subset_union_right)
      have h1 : (h⁻¹ * h₂) 0 0 ^ 2 ≠ 1 := hsq hd hd10 hh₂i
        ((hh₂r _ hEset).trans ((hEk _).trans hEh)) fun hdE ↦ by
          rintro _ ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩
          have h' := sl_mul_entries_mem _ (A := h) (B := h⁻¹ * h₂)
            (hentries h subset_union_right) hdE i j
          rwa [mul_inv_cancel_left] at h'
      refine ch.2 ⟨racl_mono subset_union_right (hconst hd h1 hmemd), ?_⟩
      exact subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hcKE)
    have hc0 : cK ∈ racl k (∅ : Set K) := racl_inter_of_pair hst ⟨hcs, hct⟩
    obtain ⟨μ, hμdef⟩ : ∃ μ : K, μ = -cK := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hμ0 : μ ∈ racl k (∅ : Set K) := hμdef ▸ neg_mem hc0
    have hμS : ∀ S : Set K, μ ∈ racl k S := fun S ↦ racl_mono (empty_subset _) hμ0
    
    obtain ⟨μ₁, hμ₁def⟩ : ∃ x : K, x = slAct g⁻¹ μ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hfixg : ∀ m, InLocus (k := ↥E) (slTuple g) (slTuple m) → slAct m μ₁ = μ :=
      fun m hm ↦ by
        have hx := hTfix _ ((hR m).1 hm)
        rwa [slAct_mul m (inv_apply_one_zero hg10), ← hμdef, ← hμ₁def] at hx
    have hμ₁ : μ₁ ∈ racl k ({s} : Set K) := by
      have h2 : μ₁ = slAct g₂⁻¹ μ := by
        rw [← hfixg g₂ (hlocus hg₂I), slAct_inv_slAct hg₂10]
      refine cg.1 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hμ₁def]
        exact slAct_mem _ (sl_inv_entries_mem _ (hentries g subset_union_right)) (hμS _)
      · rw [h2]
        exact slAct_mem _ (sl_inv_entries_mem _ (hentries g₂ subset_union_right)) (hμS _)
    
    obtain ⟨μ₂, hμ₂def⟩ : ∃ x : K, x = slAct h μ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hfixh : ∀ m, InLocus (k := ↥E) (slTuple h) (slTuple m) → slAct m μ = μ₂ :=
      fun m hm ↦ by
        have hx := hTfix _ ((hL m).1 hm)
        rw [slAct_mul h⁻¹ (hupp hh10 hm), ← hμdef] at hx
        calc slAct m μ = slAct h (slAct h⁻¹ (slAct m μ)) := (slAct_slAct_inv hh10 _).symm
          _ = μ₂ := by rw [hx, hμ₂def]
    have hμ₂ : μ₂ ∈ racl k ({t} : Set K) := by
      refine ch.1 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hμ₂def]
        exact slAct_mem _ (hentries h subset_union_right) (hμS _)
      · rw [← hfixh h₂ (hlocus hh₂I)]
        exact slAct_mem _ (hentries h₂ subset_union_right) (hμS _)
    
    have hμ₁E : μ₁ ∈ E := hsubE hsE hμ₁
    have hμ₂E : μ₂ ∈ E := hsubE htE hμ₂
    have hpeq : slAct (h * g) μ₁ = μ₂ := by
      rw [slAct_mul h hg10, hμ₁def, slAct_slAct_inv hg10, hμ₂def]
    have hp₂eq : slAct p₂ μ₁ = μ₂ := by
      have he := aeval_eq_zero_of_inLocus_base (hlocus hp₂I)
        (P := MvPolynomial.X (0, 0) ^ 2 * MvPolynomial.C ⟨_, hμ₁E⟩ +
          MvPolynomial.X (0, 0) * MvPolynomial.X (0, 1) - MvPolynomial.C ⟨_, hμ₂E⟩) (by
          simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, MvPolynomial.aeval_X,
            MvPolynomial.aeval_C]
          change slAct (h * g) μ₁ - μ₂ = 0
          rw [hpeq, sub_self])
      simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, MvPolynomial.aeval_X,
        MvPolynomial.aeval_C] at he
      change slAct p₂ μ₁ - μ₂ = 0 at he
      exact sub_eq_zero.1 he
    have hp00 : (h * g) 0 0 ∉ racl k (E : Set K) := by
      intro h0
      have hdet : (h * g) 0 0 * (h * g) 1 1 = 1 := by
        have h' := (h * g).det_coe
        rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, hp10, mul_zero, sub_zero] at h'
        exact h'
      have hne : (h * g) 0 0 ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one hdet
      have h01 : (h * g) 0 1 ∈ racl k (E : Set K) := by
        have hx : (h * g) 0 1 = (μ₂ - (h * g) 0 0 ^ 2 * μ₁) / (h * g) 0 0 := by
          rw [eq_div_iff hne, ← hpeq]
          unfold slAct
          ring
        rw [hx]
        exact div_mem (sub_mem (subset_racl k _ hμ₂E) (mul_mem (pow_mem h0 2)
          (subset_racl k _ hμ₁E))) h0
      have hz := (erk_eq_zero_iff k).2 (slEntries_upper_subset (h * g) hp10 h0 h01)
      rw [hEk, hEp] at hz
      exact one_ne_zero hz
    have hpp : (h * g) 0 0 ^ 2 ≠ p₂ 0 0 ^ 2 := by
      intro hsq2
      have hp₂0 : p₂ 0 0 ∈ racl k ((E : Set K) ∪ slEntries p₂) :=
        subset_racl k _ (Or.inr ⟨(0, 0), rfl⟩)
      have hmem : (h * g) 0 0 ∈ racl k ((E : Set K) ∪ slEntries p₂) := by
        rcases sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg.1 hsq2 with h' | h'
        · rw [h']
          exact hp₂0
        · rw [h']
          exact neg_mem hp₂0
      have hmem2 : (h * g) 0 0 ∈ (racl k ((E : Set K) ∪ slEntries p₂) : Set K) ∩
          racl k ((E : Set K) ∪ slEntries (h * g)) :=
        ⟨hmem, subset_racl k _ (Or.inr ⟨(0, 0), rfl⟩)⟩
      rw [hp₂i.racl_inter_eq] at hmem2
      exact hp00 hmem2
    have hden : (h * g) 0 0 ^ 2 - p₂ 0 0 ^ 2 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hpp
    have hx : μ₁ = (p₂ 0 0 * p₂ 0 1 - (h * g) 0 0 * (h * g) 0 1) /
        ((h * g) 0 0 ^ 2 - p₂ 0 0 ^ 2) := by
      rw [eq_div_iff hden]
      unfold slAct at hpeq hp₂eq
      linear_combination hpeq - hp₂eq
    have hμ₁u : μ₁ ∈ racl k ({u} : Set K) := by
      refine cp.2 ⟨?_, subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hμ₁E)⟩
      rw [hx]
      have hP := hentries (h * g) (S := {u} ∪ (slEntries (h * g) ∪ slEntries p₂))
        (subset_union_left.trans subset_union_right)
      have hP₂ := hentries p₂ (S := {u} ∪ (slEntries (h * g) ∪ slEntries p₂))
        (subset_union_right.trans subset_union_right)
      exact div_mem (sub_mem (mul_mem (hP₂ 0 0) (hP₂ 0 1)) (mul_mem (hP 0 0) (hP 0 1)))
        (sub_mem (pow_mem (hP 0 0) 2) (pow_mem (hP₂ 0 0) 2))
    
    have hμ₁0 : μ₁ ∈ racl k (∅ : Set K) := racl_inter_of_pair hsu ⟨hμ₁, hμ₁u⟩
    have hgfix : slAct g μ₁ = μ := by rw [hμ₁def, slAct_slAct_inv hg10]
    have hg00 : g 0 0 ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one hdetg
    have hgS : g 0 0 ∈ racl k ({g 0 0} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ rfl
    have h01 : g 0 1 ∈ racl k ({g 0 0} : Set K) := by
      have hxg : g 0 1 = (μ - g 0 0 ^ 2 * μ₁) / g 0 0 := by
        rw [eq_div_iff hg00, ← hgfix]
        unfold slAct
        ring
      rw [hxg]
      exact div_mem (sub_mem (hμS _) (mul_mem (pow_mem hgS 2)
        (racl_mono (empty_subset _) hμ₁0))) hgS
    have hle : erk k ∅ (slEntries g) ≤ 1 :=
      calc erk k ∅ (slEntries g) ≤ erk k ∅ (racl k ({g 0 0} : Set K) : Set K) :=
            erk_mono k ∅ (slEntries_upper_subset g hg10 hgS h01)
        _ = erk k ∅ ({g 0 0} : Set K) := by
            simpa only [empty_union] using erk_racl k (∅ : Set K) ({g 0 0} : Set K)
        _ ≤ 1 := (erk_le_encard k ∅ _).trans (by simp)
    rw [hG2] at hle
    norm_num at hle

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfig.GroupConfig.racl_singleton_eq_of_mem
statement:
private theorem racl_singleton_eq_of_mem {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {x y : K} (hxy : x ∈ racl k ({y} : Set K)) (hx : x ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) :
    racl k ({x} : Set K) = racl k ({y} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have hyx : y ∈ racl k ({x} : Set K) := by
    have h := racl_exchange (S := (∅ : Set K)) (by rwa [insert_empty_eq]) hx
    rwa [insert_empty_eq] at h
  exact le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl (singleton_subset_iff.2 hxy))
    (racl_le_of_subset_racl (singleton_subset_iff.2 hyx))

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfig.GroupConfig.diag_notMem_of_erk_two
statement:
private theorem diag_notMem_of_erk_two {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (m : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K) (hm : m 1 0 = 0) (h2 : erk k ∅ (slEntries m) = 2) :
    m 0 0 ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  have hsub := slEntries_upper_subset (S := {m 0 1}) m hm (racl_mono (empty_subset _) h0)
    (subset_racl k _ rfl)
  have hle : erk k ∅ (slEntries m) ≤ 1 :=
    calc erk k ∅ (slEntries m) ≤ erk k ∅ (racl k ({m 0 1} : Set K) : Set K) := erk_mono k ∅ hsub
      _ = erk k ∅ ({m 0 1} : Set K) := by
          simpa only [empty_union] using erk_racl k (∅ : Set K) ({m 0 1} : Set K)
      _ ≤ 1 := (erk_le_encard k ∅ _).trans (by simp)
  rw [h2] at hle
  norm_num at hle

name: GroupConfig.GroupConfig.GroupConfig.upper_curve_diagonal_rows
statement:
theorem upper_curve_diagonal_rows {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K]
    (g h : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K) (hg10 : g 1 0 = 0) (hh10 : h 1 0 = 0)
    (hgh : erk k ∅ (slEntries g ∪ slEntries h) = 4) {s t u : K}
    (hs : s ∈ racl k (slEntries g)) (ht : t ∈ racl k (slEntries h))
    (hu : u ∈ racl k (slEntries (h * g)))
    (hst : erk k ∅ ({s, t} : Set K) = 2) (hsu : erk k ∅ ({s, u} : Set K) = 2)
    (hstu : erk k ∅ ({s, t, u} : Set K) = 2) :
    racl k ({s} : Set K) = racl k ({g 0 0} : Set K) ∧
      racl k ({t} : Set K) = racl k ({h 0 0} : Set K) ∧
      racl k ({u} : Set K) = racl k ({(h * g) 0 0} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have hmult := upper_curve_multiplier g h hg10 hh10 hgh hs ht hu hst hsu hstu
  obtain ⟨hG2, -, -, -, -, huE, -, -, -⟩ :=
    upper_curve_ranks g h hg10 hh10 hgh hs ht hu hst hsu hstu
  have hp10 : (h * g) 1 0 = 0 := by
    rw [sl_mul_apply, hh10, hg10, zero_mul, mul_zero, add_zero]
  have hp00 : (h * g) 0 0 = h 0 0 * g 0 0 := by
    rw [sl_mul_apply, hg10, mul_zero, add_zero]
  obtain ⟨-, hH2⟩ := enat_eq_two_of_add (erk_slEntries_upper_le_two ∅ g hg10)
    (erk_slEntries_upper_le_two ∅ h hh10) (by rw [← hgh]; exact erk_union_le k ∅ _ _)
  have hGH : erk k (slEntries g) (slEntries h) = 2 :=
    erk_pair_base_eq (a := 2) (b := 2) hG2 (by rw [hgh]; rfl)
  have hinGH : (racl k (slEntries g) : Set K) ∩ racl k (slEntries h) ⊆ racl k (∅ : Set K) := by
    have hind : IndepOver k ∅ (slEntries h) (slEntries g) :=
      indepOver_of_erk_eq (finite_range _) (by rw [empty_union, hGH, hH2])
    have h' := hind.racl_inter_eq
    rw [empty_union, empty_union] at h'
    rw [inter_comm, h']
  have hPG : racl k (slEntries (h * g) ∪ slEntries g) = racl k (slEntries h ∪ slEntries g) :=
    racl_sl_product_union h g
  have hPG4 : erk k ∅ (slEntries (h * g) ∪ slEntries g) = 4 := by
    rw [erk_eq_of_racl_eq hPG, union_comm]
    exact hgh
  obtain ⟨hP2, -⟩ := enat_eq_two_of_add (erk_slEntries_upper_le_two ∅ (h * g) hp10)
    (erk_slEntries_upper_le_two ∅ g hg10) (by rw [← hPG4]; exact erk_union_le k ∅ _ _)
  have hg0 := diag_notMem_of_erk_two g hg10 hG2
  have hh0 := diag_notMem_of_erk_two h hh10 hH2
  have hp0 := diag_notMem_of_erk_two (h * g) hp10 hP2
  have hu0 : u ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) := fun h0 ↦ notMem_racl_singleton_of_pair hsu
    (racl_mono (empty_subset _) h0)
  have ht0 : t ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) := fun h0 ↦ notMem_racl_singleton_of_pair hst
    (racl_mono (empty_subset _) h0)
  have hgG : g 0 0 ∈ racl k (slEntries g) := subset_racl k _ ⟨(0, 0), rfl⟩
  have hhH : h 0 0 ∈ racl k (slEntries h) := subset_racl k _ ⟨(0, 0), rfl⟩
  have hgH : g 0 0 ∉ racl k (slEntries h) := fun h0 ↦ hg0 (hinGH ⟨hgG, h0⟩)
  
  have hS : racl k ({s} : Set K) = racl k ({g 0 0} : Set K) :=
    (racl_singleton_eq_of_mem hmult hg0).symm
  have hsg : s ∈ racl k ({g 0 0} : Set K) := hS ▸ subset_racl k _ rfl
  
  have hU : racl k ({u} : Set K) = racl k ({(h * g) 0 0} : Set K) := by
    have hC1 : erk k ∅ ({(h * g) 0 0} : Set K) = 1 := erk_singleton_of_notMem hp0
    have hp0X : (h * g) 0 0 ∈ racl k (slEntries h ∪ {g 0 0}) := by
      rw [hp00]
      exact mul_mem (racl_mono subset_union_left hhH) (subset_racl k _ (Or.inr rfl))
    have hCX : erk k ({(h * g) 0 0} : Set K) ({g 0 0} ∪ slEntries h) = 2 := by
      refine erk_pair_base_eq (a := 1) (b := 2) hC1 ?_
      have hr : racl k ({(h * g) 0 0} ∪ ({g 0 0} ∪ slEntries h)) =
          racl k (slEntries h ∪ {g 0 0}) := by
        rw [union_comm {g 0 0}]
        exact le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset (singleton_subset_iff.2 hp0X)
          (subset_racl k _))) (racl_mono subset_union_right)
      rw [erk_eq_of_racl_eq hr, erk_union_eq k ∅ _ {g 0 0}, empty_union, hH2,
        erk_singleton_of_notMem hgH]
      norm_num
    have hCY : erk k ∅ ({(h * g) 0 0} ∪ slEntries (h * g)) = 2 := by
      rw [union_comm, erk_union_eq_of_subset_racl k (by
        rintro z rfl
        rw [empty_union]
        exact subset_racl k _ ⟨(0, 0), rfl⟩), hP2]
    have hCYX : erk k ({(h * g) 0 0} ∪ slEntries (h * g)) ({g 0 0} ∪ slEntries h) = 2 := by
      refine erk_pair_base_eq (a := 2) (b := 2) hCY ?_
      have hr : racl k (({(h * g) 0 0} ∪ slEntries (h * g)) ∪ ({g 0 0} ∪ slEntries h)) =
          racl k (slEntries g ∪ slEntries h) := by
        refine le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_) (racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_)
        · have hPsub : slEntries (h * g) ⊆ racl k (slEntries g ∪ slEntries h) := by
            rintro _ ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩
            exact sl_mul_entries_mem (racl k (slEntries g ∪ slEntries h))
              (fun i j ↦ subset_racl k (slEntries g ∪ slEntries h) (Or.inr ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩))
              (fun i j ↦ subset_racl k (slEntries g ∪ slEntries h) (Or.inl ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩)) i j
          refine union_subset (union_subset ?_ hPsub) (union_subset ?_ ?_)
          · exact singleton_subset_iff.2 (hPsub ⟨(0, 0), rfl⟩)
          · exact singleton_subset_iff.2 (racl_mono subset_union_left hgG)
          · exact fun z hz ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hz)
        · refine union_subset ?_ (fun z hz ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr (Or.inr hz)))
          rintro _ ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩
          have hm := sl_mul_entries_mem (racl k (({(h * g) 0 0} ∪ slEntries (h * g)) ∪
            ({g 0 0} ∪ slEntries h))) (A := h⁻¹) (B := h * g)
            (sl_inv_entries_mem _ fun i j ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩)))
            (fun i j ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩))) i j
          rwa [inv_mul_cancel_left] at hm
      rw [erk_eq_of_racl_eq hr, hgh]
      rfl
    have hind : IndepOver k ({(h * g) 0 0} : Set K) ({g 0 0} ∪ slEntries h)
        (slEntries (h * g)) :=
      indepOver_of_erk_eq ((finite_singleton _).union (finite_range _)) (by rw [hCYX, hCX])
    have hi := hind.racl_inter_eq
    have huX : u ∈ racl k ({(h * g) 0 0} ∪ ({g 0 0} ∪ slEntries h)) := by
      refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ huE
      rintro z (rfl | rfl)
      · have hg' : g 0 0 ∈ racl k ({(h * g) 0 0} ∪ ({g 0 0} ∪ slEntries h)) :=
          subset_racl k _ (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
        exact racl_le_of_subset_racl (singleton_subset_iff.2 hg') hsg
      · exact racl_mono (subset_union_right.trans subset_union_right) ht
    have huY : u ∈ racl k ({(h * g) 0 0} ∪ slEntries (h * g)) := racl_mono subset_union_right hu
    have hmem : u ∈ (racl k ({(h * g) 0 0} ∪ ({g 0 0} ∪ slEntries h)) : Set K) ∩
        racl k ({(h * g) 0 0} ∪ slEntries (h * g)) := ⟨huX, huY⟩
    rw [hi] at hmem
    exact racl_singleton_eq_of_mem hmem hu0
  
  have hT : racl k ({t} : Set K) = racl k ({h 0 0} : Set K) := by
    have hgh0 : g 0 0 ∉ racl k ({h 0 0} : Set K) := fun h0 ↦
      hgH (racl_le_of_subset_racl (singleton_subset_iff.2 hhH) h0)
    have hCX : erk k ({h 0 0} : Set K) {g 0 0} = 1 := erk_singleton_of_notMem hgh0
    have hCYX : erk k ({h 0 0} ∪ slEntries h) {g 0 0} = 1 := erk_singleton_of_notMem
      fun h0 ↦ hgH (by
        rwa [show racl k ({h 0 0} ∪ slEntries h) = racl k (slEntries h) from
          le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl (union_subset (singleton_subset_iff.2 hhH)
            (subset_racl k _))) (racl_mono subset_union_right)] at h0)
    have hind : IndepOver k ({h 0 0} : Set K) {g 0 0} (slEntries h) :=
      indepOver_of_erk_eq (finite_singleton _) (by rw [hCYX, hCX])
    have hi := hind.racl_inter_eq
    have htSU : t ∈ racl k ({s, u} : Set K) := by
      have h' := erk_pair_base_eq (a := 2) (b := 0) hsu
        (X := {t}) (by rw [insert_union, singleton_union, pair_comm u t, hstu]; rfl)
      exact (erk_singleton_eq_zero_iff k).1 h'
    have htX : t ∈ racl k ({h 0 0} ∪ {g 0 0}) := by
      refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ htSU
      rintro z (rfl | rfl)
      · have hg' : g 0 0 ∈ racl k ({h 0 0} ∪ {g 0 0}) := subset_racl k _ (Or.inr rfl)
        exact racl_le_of_subset_racl (singleton_subset_iff.2 hg') hsg
      · have hpm : (h * g) 0 0 ∈ racl k ({h 0 0} ∪ {g 0 0}) := by
          rw [hp00]
          exact mul_mem (subset_racl k _ (Or.inl rfl)) (subset_racl k _ (Or.inr rfl))
        have huP : z ∈ racl k ({(h * g) 0 0} : Set K) := hU ▸ subset_racl k _ rfl
        exact racl_le_of_subset_racl (singleton_subset_iff.2 hpm) huP
    have htY : t ∈ racl k ({h 0 0} ∪ slEntries h) := racl_mono subset_union_right ht
    have hmem : t ∈ (racl k ({h 0 0} ∪ {g 0 0}) : Set K) ∩ racl k ({h 0 0} ∪ slEntries h) :=
      ⟨htX, htY⟩
    rw [hi] at hmem
    exact racl_singleton_eq_of_mem hmem ht0
  exact ⟨hS, hT, hU⟩

name: GroupConfig.exists_fraction_small
statement:
private theorem exists_fraction_small {ι : Type w} [Finite ι] {v : ι → K}
    (h : LocusFunctionField k v) :
    ∃ N : IntermediateField k K, IsSmall k (N : Set K) ∧
      ∃ A B : MvPolynomial ι N, (∀ y, IsGenericOver N v y → aeval y B ≠ 0) ∧
        h = mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap N K) A) /
          mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap N K) B)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hfrac⟩ := exists_fraction_of_subset h
  exact ⟨racl k C, (IsSmall.of_finite hC).racl, hfrac _ (subset_racl k C)⟩

name: GroupConfig.isConstructibleOver_liftTest
proof:
:= by
  
  let ey : ι → (((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (Fin 2 × Fin 2)) ⊕ ι) ⊕ ι := Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr
  let ez : ι → (((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (Fin 2 × Fin 2)) ⊕ ι) ⊕ ι := Sum.inr
  let em : Fin 2 × Fin 2 → MvPolynomial ((((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (Fin 2 × Fin 2)) ⊕ ι) ⊕ ι) N :=
    fun ij ↦ X (Sum.inl (Sum.inl (Sum.inr ij)))
  let L : MvPolynomial ((((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (Fin 2 × Fin 2)) ⊕ ι) ⊕ ι) N :=
    em (1, 0) * rename ey A + em (1, 1) * rename ey B
  let R : MvPolynomial ((((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (Fin 2 × Fin 2)) ⊕ ι) ⊕ ι) N :=
    rename ez A * L - rename ez B * (em (0, 0) * rename ey A + em (0, 1) * rename ey B)
  
  let e : ((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ ι) ⊕ ι → (((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (Fin 2 × Fin 2)) ⊕ ι) ⊕ ι :=
    Sum.elim (Sum.elim (fun p ↦ Sum.inl (Sum.inl (Sum.inl (Sum.swap p)))) ey) ez
  have hchain : IsConstructibleOver (↥N)
      ((fun u : ((((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (Fin 2 × Fin 2)) ⊕ ι) ⊕ ι) → K ↦ u ∘ e) ⁻¹'
        {v' : ((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ ι) ⊕ ι → K |
          w.Chain ((v' ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) ((v' ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr) (v' ∘ Sum.inr)}) :=
    ((Word.isConstructibleOver_chain w).preimage_comp e).extend_base
  refine IsConstructibleOver.exists ?_
  convert hchain.inter ((IsConstructibleOver.polynomial_ne_zero (rename ez B)).inter
    ((IsConstructibleOver.polynomial_ne_zero (rename ey B)).inter
    ((IsConstructibleOver.polynomial_ne_zero L).inter (IsConstructibleOver.polynomial_zero R))))
    using 1
  ext u
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, aeval_rename, L, R, em,
    map_add, map_mul, map_sub, aeval_X, sub_eq_zero]
  have he1 : ((u ∘ e) ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl = (((u ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.swap := by
    funext p
    rfl
  have he2 : ((u ∘ e) ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr = (u ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr := rfl
  have he3 : (u ∘ e) ∘ Sum.inr = u ∘ Sum.inr := rfl
  rw [he1, he2, he3]
  rfl

name: GroupConfig.hasValue_const
statement:
private theorem hasValue_const {M : IntermediateField k K} {y : ι → K} {c : K} (hc : c ∈ M) :
    HasValue M y (algebraMap K (LocusFunctionField k v) c) c
proof:
:= by
  have h := hasValue_algebraMap (k := k) (v := v) (M := M) (y := y) le_rfl ⟨c, hc⟩
  rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply (↥M) K (LocusFunctionField k v)] at h
  exact h

name: GroupConfig.isMoebiusLift_iff_values
statement:
private theorem isMoebiusLift_iff_values {N : IntermediateField k K}
    {A B : MvPolynomial ι N} {t : LocusFunctionField k v}
    (htAB : t = mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap N K) A) /
      mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap N K) B))
    (γ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) {r : Representative k K v v} (hr : r.f.e = 0)
    (hrγ : (⟦r⟧ : Germ k v v) = (((γ⁻¹ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) : (Germ k v v)ˣ) : Germ k v v))
    (hNr : N ≤ r.M) (m : SL(2, K)) (hm : ∀ i j, m i j ∈ r.M) {y : ι → K}
    (hy : IsGenericOver r.M v y) (hBy : aeval y B ≠ 0) (hBz : aeval (r.f.eval y) B ≠ 0) :
    hw.IsMoebiusLift hv t γ m ↔
      (m 1 0 * aeval y A + m 1 1 * aeval y B ≠ 0 ∧
        aeval (r.f.eval y) A * (m 1 0 * aeval y A + m 1 1 * aeval y B) =
          aeval (r.f.eval y) B * (m 0 0 * aeval y A + m 0 1 * aeval y B))
proof:
:= by
  let A' := MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion hNr).toRingHom A
  let B' := MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion hNr).toRingHom B
  have hmap : ∀ P : MvPolynomial ι N, MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap N K) P =
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap r.M K)
        (MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion hNr).toRingHom P) := fun P ↦ by
    rw [MvPolynomial.map_map]
    rfl
  have htAB' : t = mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap r.M K) A') /
      mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap r.M K) B') := by
    rw [htAB, hmap A, hmap B]
  have hA'y : ∀ u, aeval u A' = aeval u A := fun u ↦ aeval_map_inclusion hNr u A
  have hB'y : ∀ u, aeval u B' = aeval u B := fun u ↦ aeval_map_inclusion hNr u B
  
  have hvt : HasValue r.M y t (aeval y A / aeval y B) :=
    ⟨A', B', by rw [hB'y]; exact hBy, htAB', by rw [hA'y, hB'y]⟩
  have hvγ : HasValue r.M y (hw.functionFieldAction hv γ t)
      (aeval (r.f.eval y) A / aeval (r.f.eval y) B) :=
    hw.hasValue_functionFieldAction hv γ hr hrγ le_rfl hy
      ⟨A', B', by rw [hB'y]; exact hBz, htAB', by rw [hA'y, hB'y]⟩
  have hvD : HasValue r.M y (algebraMap K _ (m 1 0) * t + algebraMap K _ (m 1 1))
      (m 1 0 * (aeval y A / aeval y B) + m 1 1) :=
    ((hasValue_const (hm 1 0)).mul hvt).add hy (hasValue_const (hm 1 1))
  have hvN : HasValue r.M y (algebraMap K _ (m 0 0) * t + algebraMap K _ (m 0 1))
      (m 0 0 * (aeval y A / aeval y B) + m 0 1) :=
    ((hasValue_const (hm 0 0)).mul hvt).add hy (hasValue_const (hm 0 1))
  have hv0 : HasValue r.M y (0 : LocusFunctionField k v) 0 := by
    simpa using hasValue_mk (k := k) (v := v) (M := r.M) (y := y) 0
  have hD : algebraMap K (LocusFunctionField k v) (m 1 0) * t +
      algebraMap K (LocusFunctionField k v) (m 1 1) ≠ 0 ↔
      m 1 0 * aeval y A + m 1 1 * aeval y B ≠ 0 := by
    have hval : m 1 0 * (aeval y A / aeval y B) + m 1 1 =
        (m 1 0 * aeval y A + m 1 1 * aeval y B) / aeval y B := by
      field_simp
    constructor
    · intro hne h0
      refine hne (hvD.eq hy ?_)
      rw [hval, h0, zero_div]
      exact hv0
    · intro hne h0
      rw [h0] at hvD
      have := hv0.eq_value hy hvD
      rw [hval] at this
      exact hne ((div_eq_zero_iff.1 this.symm).resolve_right hBy)
  have hE : hw.functionFieldAction hv γ t *
      (algebraMap K (LocusFunctionField k v) (m 1 0) * t +
        algebraMap K (LocusFunctionField k v) (m 1 1)) =
      algebraMap K _ (m 0 0) * t + algebraMap K _ (m 0 1) ↔
      aeval (r.f.eval y) A * (m 1 0 * aeval y A + m 1 1 * aeval y B) =
        aeval (r.f.eval y) B * (m 0 0 * aeval y A + m 0 1 * aeval y B) := by
    have hvL := hvγ.mul hvD
    constructor
    · intro h
      rw [h] at hvL
      have := hvN.eq_value hy hvL
      field_simp at this
      linear_combination -this
    · intro h
      refine hvL.eq hy ?_
      convert hvN using 1
      field_simp
      linear_combination h
  exact and_congr hD hE

name: GroupConfig.forall_liftTest_iff
statement:
private theorem forall_liftTest_iff {μ : Type w} [Finite μ] (wd : Word k (μ ⊕ μ) v v)
    {N : IntermediateField k K} {A B : MvPolynomial ι N} {t : LocusFunctionField k v}
    (htAB : t = mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap N K) A) /
      mk k v (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap N K) B))
    (hBgen : ∀ y, IsGenericOver N v y → aeval y B ≠ 0)
    {M₁ : IntermediateField k K} (hM₁ : IsSmall k (M₁ : Set K)) (hNM₁ : N ≤ M₁)
    (γ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) {d : (μ ⊕ μ) → K} (hdγ : wd.IsGerm (d ∘ Sum.swap) (hw.val γ⁻¹))
    (m : SL(2, K)) :
    (∀ y, IsGenericOver ((racl (↥M₁)
          (range (Sum.elim d fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ m ij.1 ij.2))).restrictScalars k) v y →
        LiftTest wd A B (Sum.elim d fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ m ij.1 ij.2) y) ↔
      hw.IsMoebiusLift hv t γ m
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : ((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (Fin 2 × Fin 2)) → K,
      x = Sum.elim d fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ m ij.1 ij.2 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hx]
  obtain ⟨Mx, hMx⟩ : ∃ Mx : IntermediateField k K,
      Mx = (racl (↥M₁) (range x)).restrictScalars k := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hMx]
  have hMxs : IsSmall k (Mx : Set K) := by
    rw [hMx]
    change IsSmall k ((racl (↥M₁) (range x) : IntermediateField (↥M₁) K) : Set K)
    rw [racl_base_coe]
    exact (hM₁.union (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range x))).racl
  have hxMx : range x ⊆ (Mx : Set K) := by
    rw [hMx]
    exact subset_racl (↥M₁) _
  have hM₁Mx : M₁ ≤ Mx := by
    rw [hMx]
    intro c hc
    change c ∈ ((racl (↥M₁) (range x) : IntermediateField (↥M₁) K) : Set K)
    rw [racl_base_coe]
    exact subset_racl k _ (Or.inl hc)
  
  obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀γ, hr₀⟩ := hw.exists_rational_representative hv (hw.val_mem γ⁻¹)
  have hMs : IsSmall k ((racl k ((Mx : Set K) ∪ r₀.M) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (hMxs.union r₀.isSmall).racl
  have hr₀M : r₀.M ≤ racl k ((Mx : Set K) ∪ r₀.M) := fun c hc ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hc)
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r : Representative k K v v,
      r = r₀.extend (isAlgClosed_racl _) hMs hr₀M := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hre : r.f.e = 0 := by
    rw [hr]
    exact hr₀
  have hrγ : (⟦r⟧ : Germ k v v) = (((γ⁻¹ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) : (Germ k v v)ˣ) : Germ k v v) := by
    rw [hr, Quotient.sound (r₀.extend_equivalent _ hMs hr₀M)]
    exact hr₀γ
  have hrM : r.M = racl k ((Mx : Set K) ∪ r₀.M) := by
    rw [hr]
    rfl
  have hMxr : Mx ≤ r.M := by
    rw [hrM]
    exact fun c hc ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl hc)
  have hNr : N ≤ r.M := hNM₁.trans (hM₁Mx.trans hMxr)
  have hm : ∀ i j, m i j ∈ r.M := fun i j ↦ hMxr (hxMx ⟨Sum.inr (i, j), by rw [hx]; rfl⟩)
  have hxl : (x ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.swap = d ∘ Sum.swap := by
    rw [hx]
    rfl
  have hxr : ∀ i j, x (Sum.inr (i, j)) = m i j := fun i j ↦ by
    rw [hx]
    rfl
  
  have hchain : ∀ y, IsGenericOver r.M v y → ∀ z,
      wd.Chain ((x ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.swap) y z ↔ z = r.f.eval y := by
    intro y hy z
    have _ := r.isAlgClosed
    have hds : racl k (range (d ∘ Sum.swap)) ≤ r.M := by
      refine racl_le_of_isAlgClosed (k := k) (fun c hc ↦ ?_)
      obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hc
      refine hMxr (hxMx ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.swap p), ?_⟩)
      rw [hx]
      rfl
    have hyd : IsGenericOver (racl k (range (d ∘ Sum.swap))) v y := hy.of_le hds
    rw [hxl, hdγ.chain_iff hyd z]
    have hcb : (hw.val γ⁻¹).cb ≤ racl k (range (d ∘ Sum.swap)) := hdγ.cb_le
    rw [(hw.val γ⁻¹).eval_eq_of_le (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range _)).racl r.isSmall hcb hds hy]
    change z = Germ.eval (((γ⁻¹ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) : (Germ k v v)ˣ) : Germ k v v) r.M y ↔ _
    rw [← hrγ, Germ.eval_eq_rep r r.isSmall (by rw [hrγ]; exact hcb.trans hds) le_rfl hy]
  
  have htest : ∀ y, IsGenericOver r.M v y →
      (LiftTest wd A B x y ↔ hw.IsMoebiusLift hv t γ m) := by
    intro y hy
    have hBy : aeval y B ≠ 0 := hBgen y (hy.of_le hNr)
    have hz : IsGenericOver r.M v (r.f.eval y) := r.isGenericOver y hy
    have hBz : aeval (r.f.eval y) B ≠ 0 := hBgen _ (hz.of_le hNr)
    rw [isMoebiusLift_iff_values hw hv htAB γ hre hrγ hNr m hm hy hBy hBz]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z, hz, -, -, hL, hE⟩
      rw [hchain y hy z] at hz
      subst hz
      simp only [hxr] at hL hE
      exact ⟨hL, hE⟩
    · rintro ⟨hL, hE⟩
      refine ⟨r.f.eval y, (hchain y hy _).2 rfl, hBz, hBy, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp only [hxr]
      · exact hL
      · exact hE
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀⟩ := exists_isGenericOver r.isSmall v
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact (htest y₀ hy₀).1 (h y₀ (hy₀.of_le hMxr))
  · intro hlift y hy
    have hs := (isConstructibleOver_liftTest wd A B).of_le_intermediateField (hNM₁.trans hM₁Mx)
    have hinv : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[↥Mx] K, ∀ y' : ι → K,
        (⇑σ ∘ y') ∈ {y | LiftTest wd A B x y} ↔ y' ∈ {y | LiftTest wd A B x y} := by
      intro σ y'
      have hσx : ⇑σ ∘ x = x := funext fun i ↦ σ.commutes ⟨x i, hxMx ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩
      have h := hs.mem_comp_algEquiv_iff σ (Sum.elim x y')
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at h ⊢
      rwa [Sum.comp_elim, hσx, Sum.elim_comp_inl, Sum.elim_comp_inr, Sum.elim_comp_inl,
        Sum.elim_comp_inr] at h
    exact ((hy₀.of_le hMxr).mem_iff_of_invariant hy hinv).1 ((htest y₀ hy₀).2 hlift)

name: GroupConfig.racl_entries_eq
statement:
private theorem racl_entries_eq {t : LocusFunctionField k v} (ht : Transcendental K t)
    (htop : IntermediateField.adjoin K ({t} : Set (LocusFunctionField k v)) = ⊤)
    {P : Type w} {D : Set (P → K)} (ρ : D → ↥hw.prodSubgroup) (hρ : Function.Surjective ρ)
    (hρσ : ∀ (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (d : D), ∃ hσd : ⇑σ ∘ d.1 ∈ D,
      hw.val (ρ ⟨_, hσd⟩) = (hw.val (ρ d)).map σ)
    {M : IntermediateField k K} [IsAlgClosed ↥M] (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K))
    {G : Set ((P ⊕ (Fin 2 × Fin 2)) → K)} (hG : IsConstructibleOver (↥M) G)
    (hKE : ∀ (d : D) (m : SL(2, K)),
      Sum.elim d.1 (fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ m ij.1 ij.2) ∈ G ↔ hw.IsMoebiusLift hv t (ρ d) m)
    (γ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) (m : SL(2, K)) (hγm : hw.IsMoebiusLift hv t γ m) :
    racl (↥M) (range fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ m ij.1 ij.2) =
      racl (↥M) ((hw.val γ).cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := hρ γ
  have hmem := (hKE d m).2 hγm
  
  have hmove : ∀ {E : IntermediateField k K}, M ≤ E → ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[↥E] K,
      Sum.elim (⇑(σ.restrictScalars k) ∘ d.1)
        (⇑(σ.restrictScalars k) ∘ fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ m ij.1 ij.2) ∈ G := by
    intro E hME σ
    have h := ((hG.of_le_intermediateField hME).mem_comp_algEquiv_iff σ _).2 hmem
    rwa [Sum.comp_elim] at h
  have hentries : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K, (⇑σ ∘ fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ m ij.1 ij.2) =
      fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map (σ : K →+* K) m ij.1 ij.2 := by
    intro σ
    funext ij
    simp [Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map_apply_coe]
  
  have hA : range (fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ m ij.1 ij.2) ⊆
      racl (↥M) ((hw.val (ρ d)).cb : Set K) := by
    rintro _ ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [racl_base_coe]
    have hE : IsSmall k ((racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ (hw.val (ρ d)).cb) : IntermediateField k K) :
        Set K) := (hM.union (hw.val (ρ d)).isSmall_cb).racl
    have hME : M ≤ racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ (hw.val (ρ d)).cb) :=
      fun c hc ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl hc)
    refine (isRAC_racl _).mem_of_pow_mem two_ne_zero (mem_of_forall_algEquiv_fixed hE fun σ ↦ ?_)
    obtain ⟨hσd, hval⟩ := hρσ (σ.restrictScalars k) d
    have hfix : (hw.val (ρ d)).map (σ.restrictScalars k) = hw.val (ρ d) :=
      (Germ.map_eq_self_iff _ _).2 fun c hc ↦ σ.commutes ⟨c, subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hc)⟩
    have hρeq : ρ ⟨_, hσd⟩ = ρ d := hw.val_injective (hval.trans hfix)
    have h2 := (hKE ⟨_, hσd⟩ (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map ((σ.restrictScalars k : K ≃ₐ[k] K) :
      K →+* K) m)).1 (by rw [← hentries]; exact hmove hME σ)
    rw [hρeq] at h2
    have hσm : σ (m i j) = m i j ∨ σ (m i j) = -m i j := by
      rcases hγm.eq_or_eq_neg ht h2 with h | h
      · left
        have := congrArg (fun g : SL(2, K) ↦ g i j) h
        simpa [Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map_apply_coe] using this
      · right
        have := congrArg (fun g : SL(2, K) ↦ g i j) h
        simpa [Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map_apply_coe] using this
    rcases hσm with h | h
    · rw [map_pow, h]
    · rw [map_pow, h, neg_sq]
  
  have hB : ((hw.val (ρ d)).cb : Set K) ⊆
      racl (↥M) (range fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ m ij.1 ij.2) := by
    intro c hc
    rw [racl_base_coe]
    have hE : IsSmall k ((racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ range fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ m ij.1 ij.2) :
        IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
      (hM.union (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range _))).racl
    have hME : M ≤ racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ range fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ m ij.1 ij.2) :=
      fun c hc ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl hc)
    refine mem_of_forall_algEquiv_fixed hE fun σ ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨hσd, hval⟩ := hρσ (σ.restrictScalars k) d
    have hfixm : (⇑(σ.restrictScalars k) ∘ fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ m ij.1 ij.2) =
        fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ m ij.1 ij.2 :=
      funext fun ij ↦ σ.commutes ⟨m ij.1 ij.2, subset_racl k _ (Or.inr ⟨ij, rfl⟩)⟩
    have hmv := hmove hME σ
    rw [hfixm] at hmv
    have h2 := (hKE ⟨_, hσd⟩ m).1 hmv
    have hρeq : ρ ⟨_, hσd⟩ = ρ d := h2.injective htop hγm
    have hfix : (hw.val (ρ d)).map (σ.restrictScalars k) = hw.val (ρ d) := by
      rw [← hval, hρeq]
    exact (Germ.map_eq_self_iff _ _).1 hfix c hc
  exact le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl hA) (racl_le_of_subset_racl hB)

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.exists_constructible_slLift
statement:
theorem exists_constructible_slLift {ι κ : Type w} [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    {v : ι → K} {v' : κ → K} {f₀ : Germ k v v'} (hb : f₀.IsHWBij) {δ₀ : Germ k v v}
    (hδ₀ : δ₀ ∈ f₀.diffSet) (hv : erk k ∅ (range v) = 1)
    (hr : 2 ≤ erk k ∅ (δ₀.cb : Set K)) :
    ∃ (t : LocusFunctionField k v) (M : IntermediateField k K) (_ : IsAlgClosed ↥M)
      (Γ : Subgroup SL(2, K)),
      Transcendental K t ∧ IntermediateField.adjoin K ({t} : Set (LocusFunctionField k v)) = ⊤ ∧
      IsSmall k (M : Set K) ∧
      (∀ γ, ∃ m, (hb.isHW hδ₀).IsMoebiusLift hv t γ m) ∧
      (∀ m, m ∈ Γ ↔ ∃ γ, (hb.isHW hδ₀).IsMoebiusLift hv t γ m) ∧
      (∀ γ m m', (hb.isHW hδ₀).IsMoebiusLift hv t γ m →
        (hb.isHW hδ₀).IsMoebiusLift hv t γ m' → m' = m ∨ m' = -m) ∧
      (∀ γ δ m n, (hb.isHW hδ₀).IsMoebiusLift hv t γ m →
        (hb.isHW hδ₀).IsMoebiusLift hv t δ n →
          (hb.isHW hδ₀).IsMoebiusLift hv t (γ * δ) (n * m)) ∧
      IsConstructibleOver (↥M) {x : Fin 2 × Fin 2 → K | ∃ m ∈ Γ, ∀ i j, m i j = x (i, j)} ∧
      (∀ γ m, (hb.isHW hδ₀).IsMoebiusLift hv t γ m →
        racl (↥M) (range fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ m ij.1 ij.2) =
          racl (↥M) (((hb.isHW hδ₀).val γ).cb : Set K)) ∧
      (∀ γ, erk (↥M) ∅ (((hb.isHW hδ₀).val γ).cb : Set K) ≤ erk k ∅ (δ₀.cb : Set K)) ∧
      ∃ γ, erk (↥M) ∅ (((hb.isHW hδ₀).val γ).cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ (δ₀.cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htop, hlift⟩ := (hb.isHW hδ₀).exists_generator_isMoebiusLift hv hr
  obtain ⟨N, hN, A, B, hBgen, htAB⟩ := exists_fraction_small t
  
  let _ : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  let _ : Fintype (CodeIndex (ι ⊕ κ) (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal)) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hdim, S₀, t₁, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, hL, hpres, -⟩ :=
    hb.exists_fresh_canonicalGroupSpacePresentation hδ₀ N hN
  generalize adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) = L at hL hpres
  
  obtain ⟨M₁, hM₁def⟩ : ∃ M₁ : IntermediateField k K, M₁ = racl k ((N : Set K) ∪ L) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have iM₁ : IsAlgClosed ↥M₁ := hM₁def ▸ isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hM₁ : IsSmall k (M₁ : Set K) := hM₁def ▸ (hN.union hL).racl
  have hNM₁ : N ≤ M₁ := hM₁def ▸ fun c hc ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl hc)
  have hLM₁ : L ≤ M₁ := hM₁def ▸ fun c hc ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr hc)
  have hs := (isConstructibleOver_liftTest (F.pairWord hdim) A B).of_le_intermediateField hNM₁
  obtain ⟨ts, hts, hrk, -⟩ := exists_genericSamples M₁ hM₁ v
    (2 * Fintype.card (((CodeIndex (ι ⊕ κ) (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal)) ⊕
      (CodeIndex (ι ⊕ κ) (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal))) ⊕ (Fin 2 × Fin 2)) + 1)
  have hind : erk k (M₁ : Set K) (⋃ i, range (ts i)) =
      ∑ i, erk k (M₁ : Set K) (range (ts i)) := by
    rw [hrk]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ((hts i).erk_coe_eq.trans (hts i).erk_empty_eq).symm
  have hG := constructible_generic_quantifier M₁ hM₁ v ts hts hind (by simp) hs
  
  obtain ⟨M, hMdef⟩ : ∃ M : IntermediateField k K,
      M = racl k ((M₁ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (ts i)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have iM : IsAlgClosed ↥M := hMdef ▸ isAlgClosed_racl _
  have hMs : IsSmall k (M : Set K) :=
    hMdef ▸ (hM₁.union (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_iUnion fun i ↦ finite_range (ts i)))).racl
  have hM₁M : M₁ ≤ M := hMdef ▸ fun c hc ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl hc)
  have hEM : (adjoin (↥M₁) (⋃ i, range (ts i))).restrictScalars k ≤ M := by
    rw [restrictScalars_adjoin, hMdef]
    exact adjoin_le_racl k _
  have hGM := (hG.of_restrictScalars_eq rfl).of_le_intermediateField hEM
  
  have hKE : ∀ (d : F.pairDomain L f₀.code v v') (m : SL(2, K)),
      Sum.elim d.1 (fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ m ij.1 ij.2) ∈
        {x | ∀ y, IsGenericOver ((racl (↥M₁) (range x)).restrictScalars k) v y →
          Sum.elim x y ∈ {u | LiftTest (F.pairWord hdim) A B (u ∘ Sum.inl) (u ∘ Sum.inr)}} ↔
      (hb.isHW hδ₀).IsMoebiusLift hv t
        (F.pairDomainMap L hL hb hδ₀ f₀.adjoin_range_code hF hdim d) m := by
    intro d m
    have hdγ : (F.pairWord hdim).IsGerm (d.1 ∘ Sum.swap)
        ((hb.isHW hδ₀).val (F.pairDomainMap L hL hb hδ₀ f₀.adjoin_range_code hF hdim d)⁻¹) := by
      rw [F.val_pairDomainMap_inv L hL hb hδ₀ f₀.adjoin_range_code hF hdim d]
      exact F.isGerm_pairGerm hdim _
    rw [← forall_liftTest_iff (hb.isHW hδ₀) hv (F.pairWord hdim) htAB hBgen hM₁ hNM₁ _ hdγ m]
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Sum.elim_comp_inl, Sum.elim_comp_inr]
  
  let Γ : Subgroup SL(2, K) :=
    { carrier := {m | ∃ γ, (hb.isHW hδ₀).IsMoebiusLift hv t γ m}
      one_mem' := ⟨1, Germ.IsHW.isMoebiusLift_one (hw := hb.isHW hδ₀) (hv := hv) ht⟩
      mul_mem' := by
        rintro a b ⟨γ, hγ⟩ ⟨δ, hδ⟩
        exact ⟨δ * γ, hδ.mul ht hγ⟩
      inv_mem' := by
        rintro a ⟨γ, hγ⟩
        obtain ⟨m', hm'⟩ := hlift γ⁻¹
        have h1 := hγ.mul ht hm'
        rw [mul_inv_cancel] at h1
        refine ⟨γ⁻¹, ?_⟩
        have h0 := Germ.IsHW.isMoebiusLift_one (hw := hb.isHW hδ₀) (hv := hv) ht
        rcases h0.eq_or_eq_neg ht h1 with h | h
        · rw [← eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left h]
          exact hm'
        · have h' : -m' * a = 1 := by rw [neg_mul, h, neg_neg]
          rw [← eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left h']
          exact hm'.neg }
  have hΓ : ∀ m, m ∈ Γ ↔ ∃ γ, (hb.isHW hδ₀).IsMoebiusLift hv t γ m := fun _ ↦ Iff.rfl
  
  have hdet : IsConstructibleOver (↥M) {x : ((CodeIndex (ι ⊕ κ) (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal) ⊕
      CodeIndex (ι ⊕ κ) (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal)) ⊕ (Fin 2 × Fin 2)) → K |
      x (Sum.inr (0, 0)) * x (Sum.inr (1, 1)) - x (Sum.inr (0, 1)) * x (Sum.inr (1, 0)) = 1} := by
    convert IsConstructibleOver.polynomial_zero (k := ↥M) (K := K)
      (X (Sum.inr (0, 0)) * X (Sum.inr (1, 1)) - X (Sum.inr (0, 1)) * X (Sum.inr (1, 0)) - 1 :
        MvPolynomial ((CodeIndex (ι ⊕ κ) (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal) ⊕
          CodeIndex (ι ⊕ κ) (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal)) ⊕ (Fin 2 × Fin 2)) ↥M) using 1
    ext x
    simp [sub_eq_zero]
  have hD := (hpres.domain.of_le_intermediateField (hLM₁.trans hM₁M)).preimage_comp
    (Sum.inl : (CodeIndex (ι ⊕ κ) (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal) ⊕
      CodeIndex (ι ⊕ κ) (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal)) → _ ⊕ (Fin 2 × Fin 2))
  obtain ⟨S, hSdef⟩ : ∃ S : Set (((CodeIndex (ι ⊕ κ) (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal) ⊕
      CodeIndex (ι ⊕ κ) (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal)) ⊕ (Fin 2 × Fin 2)) → K),
      S = ((fun x ↦ x ∘ Sum.inl) ⁻¹' F.pairDomain L f₀.code v v') ∩
        ({x | ∀ y, IsGenericOver ((racl (↥M₁) (range x)).restrictScalars k) v y →
          Sum.elim x y ∈ {u | LiftTest (F.pairWord hdim) A B (u ∘ Sum.inl) (u ∘ Sum.inr)}} ∩
        {x | x (Sum.inr (0, 0)) * x (Sum.inr (1, 1)) -
          x (Sum.inr (0, 1)) * x (Sum.inr (1, 0)) = 1}) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hS : IsConstructibleOver (↥M) S := hSdef ▸ hD.inter (hGM.inter hdet)
  have hR : IsConstructibleOver (↥M) {y : Fin 2 × Fin 2 → K | ∃ d, Sum.elim d y ∈ S} := by
    refine IsConstructibleOver.exists (φ := fun y d ↦ Sum.elim d y ∈ S) ?_
    convert hS.preimage_comp Sum.swap using 1
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_preimage]
    rw [show Sum.elim (z ∘ Sum.inr) (z ∘ Sum.inl) = z ∘ Sum.swap from by
      funext i
      cases i <;> rfl]
  have hset : {x : Fin 2 × Fin 2 → K | ∃ m ∈ Γ, ∀ i j, m i j = x (i, j)} =
      {x | ∃ d, Sum.elim d x ∈ S} := by
    rw [hSdef]
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨m, ⟨γ, hγ⟩, hmx⟩
      obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := hpres.surjective γ
      have hx : x = fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ m ij.1 ij.2 := funext fun ij ↦ (hmx ij.1 ij.2).symm
      subst hx
      refine ⟨d.1, ?_, (hKE d m).2 hγ, ?_⟩
      · simpa only [Set.mem_preimage, Sum.elim_comp_inl] using d.2
      · have := m.det_coe
        rw [Matrix.det_fin_two] at this
        simpa only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Sum.elim_inr] using this
    · rintro ⟨d, hdD, hdG, hdet⟩
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Sum.elim_comp_inl] at hdD
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Sum.elim_inr] at hdet
      let m : SL(2, K) :=
        ⟨Matrix.of fun i j ↦ x (i, j), by rw [Matrix.det_fin_two]; simpa using hdet⟩
      have hm : (fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ m ij.1 ij.2) = x := rfl
      refine ⟨m, ⟨_, (hKE ⟨d, hdD⟩ m).1 (by rw [hm]; exact hdG)⟩, fun i j ↦ rfl⟩
  have hΓc : IsConstructibleOver (↥M)
      {x : Fin 2 × Fin 2 → K | ∃ m ∈ Γ, ∀ i j, m i j = x (i, j)} := by
    rw [hset]
    exact hR
  
  have hρσ : ∀ (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (d : F.pairDomain L f₀.code v v'), ∃ hσd : ⇑σ ∘ d.1 ∈ _,
      (hb.isHW hδ₀).val (F.pairDomainMap L hL hb hδ₀ f₀.adjoin_range_code hF hdim ⟨_, hσd⟩) =
        ((hb.isHW hδ₀).val (F.pairDomainMap L hL hb hδ₀ f₀.adjoin_range_code hF hdim d)).map σ :=
    fun σ d ↦ ⟨_, F.val_pairDomainMap_comp_algEquiv L hL hb hδ₀ f₀.adjoin_range_code hF hdim σ d⟩
  have hracl := racl_entries_eq (hb.isHW hδ₀) hv ht htop _ hpres.surjective hρσ hMs hGM hKE
  
  refine ⟨t, M, iM, Γ, ht, htop, hMs, hlift, hΓ, fun γ m m' h h' ↦ h.eq_or_eq_neg ht h',
    fun γ δ m n h h' ↦ h.mul ht h', hΓc, hracl, fun γ ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [erk_base_empty]
    exact (hb.isHW hδ₀).erk_base_cb_le _ ((hb.isHW hδ₀).val_mem γ)
  · obtain ⟨g, hg, hgM⟩ := Germ.exists_mem_orbit_indepOver δ₀ hMs
    refine ⟨(hb.isHW hδ₀).ofMem ((hb.isHW hδ₀).mem_prodSet_of_mem hg), ?_⟩
    rw [erk_base_empty, (hb.isHW hδ₀).val_ofMem]
    exact ((hb.isHW hδ₀).erk_base_cb_eq_iff ((hb.isHW hδ₀).mem_prodSet_of_mem hg)).2 ⟨hg, hgM⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHW.isInverse_val_inv
statement:
theorem isInverse_val_inv {g₀ : Germ k a a} (hw : Germ.IsHW g₀)
    (γ : ↥hw.prodSubgroup) : Germ.IsInverse (hw.val γ⁻¹) (hw.val γ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · change hw.val (γ⁻¹ * γ) = Germ.id a
    rw [inv_mul_cancel, hw.val_one]
    rfl
  · change hw.val (γ * γ⁻¹) = Germ.id a
    rw [mul_inv_cancel, hw.val_one]
    rfl

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.val_pairDomainMap
statement:
theorem val_pairDomainMap (d : F.pairDomain M c a a') :
    (hb.isHW hδ₀).val (F.pairDomainMap M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim d) =
      F.pairDomainGerm M c a a' d
proof: := (hb.isHW hδ₀).val_ofMem _

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.val_pairDomainMap_inv
statement:
theorem val_pairDomainMap_inv (d : F.pairDomain M c a a') :
    (hb.isHW hδ₀).val (F.pairDomainMap M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim d)⁻¹ =
      F.pairGerm (d := d.val ∘ Sum.swap) ⟨d.property.choose.2, d.property.choose.1⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hi := (hb.isHW hδ₀).isInverse_val_inv (F.pairDomainMap M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim d)
  rw [F.val_pairDomainMap M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim d] at hi
  exact hi.unique (F.isInverse_pairGerm_swap d.property.choose)

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.pairDomainMap_surjective
statement:
theorem pairDomainMap_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (F.pairDomainMap M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim)
proof:
:= by
  intro γ
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := F.exists_pairDomainGerm_eq M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim
    ((hb.isHW hδ₀).val_mem γ)
  refine ⟨d, (hb.isHW hδ₀).val_injective ?_⟩
  change (hb.isHW hδ₀).val ((hb.isHW hδ₀).ofMem _) = (hb.isHW hδ₀).val γ
  rw [Germ.IsHW.val_ofMem, hd]

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.pairDomainSpaceMap_surjective
statement:
theorem pairDomainSpaceMap_surjective {y₀ : ι → K} (hy₀ : IsGen k a y₀) :
    Function.Surjective (F.pairDomainSpaceMap M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim hy₀)
proof:
:= by
  intro s
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := (hb.isHW hδ₀).exists_smul_eq ((hb.isHW hδ₀).iota hy₀) s
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := F.pairDomainMap_surjective M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim γ
  exact ⟨d, by change F.pairDomainMap M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim d • _ = s; rw [hd, hγ]⟩

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isConstructibleOver_pairDomainKernel
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_pairDomainKernel {L : IntermediateField k K}
    (hD : IsConstructibleOver (↥L) (F.pairDomain M c a a'))
    (hFt : HasGenericSamples L a' (Fintype.card μ))
    (hsrc : HasGenericSamples L a (Fintype.card ((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)))) :
    IsConstructibleOver (↥L) {d : ((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) → K |
      ∃ (hL : d ∘ Sum.inl ∈ F.pairDomain M c a a')
        (hR : d ∘ Sum.inr ∈ F.pairDomain M c a a'),
        F.pairDomainGerm M c a a' ⟨d ∘ Sum.inl, hL⟩ =
          F.pairDomainGerm M c a a' ⟨d ∘ Sum.inr, hR⟩}
proof:
:= by
  convert (hD.preimage_comp Sum.inl).inter ((hD.preimage_comp Sum.inr).inter
    (F.isConstructibleOver_pairKernel hdim hFt hsrc)) using 1
  ext d
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hL, hR, heq⟩
    exact ⟨hL, hR, hL.choose, hR.choose, heq⟩
  · rintro ⟨hL, hR, _, _, heq⟩
    exact ⟨hL, hR, heq⟩

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isConstructibleOver_pairDomainProduct
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_pairDomainProduct {L : IntermediateField k K}
    (hD : IsConstructibleOver (↥L) (F.pairDomain M c a a'))
    (hFt : HasGenericSamples L a' (Fintype.card μ))
    (hsrc : HasGenericSamples L a (Fintype.card (((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)))) :
    IsConstructibleOver (↥L) {d : (((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) → K |
      ∃ (hL : (d ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl ∈ F.pairDomain M c a a')
        (hR : (d ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr ∈ F.pairDomain M c a a')
        (hT : d ∘ Sum.inr ∈ F.pairDomain M c a a'),
        Germ.comp (F.pairDomainGerm M c a a' ⟨(d ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl, hL⟩)
          (F.pairDomainGerm M c a a' ⟨(d ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr, hR⟩) =
            F.pairDomainGerm M c a a' ⟨d ∘ Sum.inr, hT⟩}
proof:
:= by
  convert (hD.preimage_comp (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl)).inter
    ((hD.preimage_comp (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr)).inter
      ((hD.preimage_comp Sum.inr).inter
        (F.isConstructibleOver_pairProduct hdim hFt hsrc))) using 1
  ext d
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hL, hR, hT, heq⟩
    exact ⟨hL, hR, hT, hL.choose, hR.choose, hT.choose, heq⟩
  · rintro ⟨hL, hR, hT, _, _, _, heq⟩
    exact ⟨hL, hR, hT, heq⟩

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isConstructibleOver_pairDomainInverse
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_pairDomainInverse {L : IntermediateField k K}
    (hD : IsConstructibleOver (↥L) (F.pairDomain M c a a'))
    (hFt : HasGenericSamples L a' (Fintype.card μ))
    (hsrc : HasGenericSamples L a (Fintype.card ((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)))) :
    IsConstructibleOver (↥L) {d : ((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) → K |
      ∃ (hL : d ∘ Sum.inl ∈ F.pairDomain M c a a')
        (hR : d ∘ Sum.inr ∈ F.pairDomain M c a a'),
        Germ.IsInverse (F.pairDomainGerm M c a a' ⟨d ∘ Sum.inr, hR⟩)
          (F.pairDomainGerm M c a a' ⟨d ∘ Sum.inl, hL⟩)}
proof:
:= by
  convert (hD.preimage_comp Sum.inl).inter ((hD.preimage_comp Sum.inr).inter
    (F.isConstructibleOver_pairInverse hdim hFt hsrc)) using 1
  ext d
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hL, hR, hinv⟩
    exact ⟨hL, hR, hL.choose, hR.choose, hinv⟩
  · rintro ⟨hL, hR, _, _, hinv⟩
    exact ⟨hL, hR, hinv⟩

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.constructibleGroupPresentation_pairDomain
statement:
theorem constructibleGroupPresentation_pairDomain {L : IntermediateField k K}
    (hD : IsConstructibleOver (↥L) (F.pairDomain M c a a'))
    (hFt : HasGenericSamples L a' (Fintype.card μ))
    (hsrc : HasGenericSamples L a (Fintype.card (((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)))) :
    ConstructibleGroupPresentation L (F.pairDomain M c a a')
      (F.pairDomainMap M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim)
proof:
:= by
  let hw := hb.isHW hδ₀
  let ρ := F.pairDomainMap M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim
  have hval (d : F.pairDomain M c a a') : hw.val (ρ d) = F.pairDomainGerm M c a a' d :=
    hw.val_ofMem _
  have hs4 : HasGenericSamples L a (Fintype.card ((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ))) :=
    hsrc.of_le (by simp only [Fintype.card_sum]; omega)
  refine ⟨hD, F.pairDomainMap_surjective M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · convert F.isConstructibleOver_pairDomainKernel M hdim hD hFt hs4 using 1
    ext d
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    refine exists_congr fun hL ↦ exists_congr fun hR ↦ ?_
    change (ρ _ = ρ _) ↔ _
    rw [← hw.val_injective.eq_iff, hval, hval]
  · convert F.isConstructibleOver_pairDomainProduct M hdim hD hFt hsrc using 1
    ext d
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    refine exists_congr fun hL ↦ exists_congr fun hR ↦ exists_congr fun hT ↦ ?_
    change (ρ _ * ρ _ = ρ _) ↔ _
    rw [← hw.val_injective.eq_iff, hw.val_mul, hval, hval, hval, Germ.mul_def]
  · convert F.isConstructibleOver_pairDomainInverse M hdim hD hFt hs4 using 1
    ext d
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    refine exists_congr fun hL ↦ exists_congr fun hR ↦ ?_
    have hi := hw.isInverse_val_inv
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h' := hi (ρ ⟨d ∘ Sum.inl, hL⟩)
      rw [h, hval, hval] at h'
      exact h'
    · intro h
      apply hw.val_injective
      have h' := hi (ρ ⟨d ∘ Sum.inl, hL⟩)
      rw [hval] at h'
      apply h'.unique
      change Germ.IsInverse (hw.val (ρ ⟨d ∘ Sum.inr, hR⟩)) _
      rw [hval]
      exact h

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.exists_fresh_constructibleGroupPresentation
statement:
theorem exists_fresh_constructibleGroupPresentation [Fintype ι]
    (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ) {f₀ : Germ k a a'} (hb : Germ.IsHWBij f₀) {δ₀ : Germ k a a}
    (hδ₀ : δ₀ ∈ Germ.diffSet f₀) {c : μ → K} (hc : adjoin k (range c) = f₀.cb)
    (hF : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K, ∃ hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' (⇑σ ∘ c),
      F.parameterGerm hu = f₀.map σ)
    (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a')) (M₀ : IntermediateField k K)
    (hM₀ : IsSmall k (M₀ : Set K)) :
    ∃ (S₀ : Set K) (t₁ : Fin (2 * (6 * Fintype.card μ + Fintype.card ι) + 1) → μ → K),
      S₀.Finite ∧ IndepOver k ∅ S₀ (M₀ : Set K) ∧
      (∃ T : List (Σ τ : Type w, (τ → K) × (τ → K)),
        (∀ p ∈ T, ((⟨p.1, p.2.1⟩ : Σ τ : Type w, τ → K) = ⟨ι, a⟩ ∨
            (⟨p.1, p.2.1⟩ : Σ τ : Type w, τ → K) = ⟨κ, a'⟩) ∧
          IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) p.2.1 p.2.2) ∧
        S₀ = (⋃ p ∈ T, range p.2.2) ∧
        erk k ∅ S₀ = (T.map fun p ↦ erk k ∅ (range p.2.2)).sum) ∧
      HasGenericSamples (adjoin k S₀) a (8 * Fintype.card μ) ∧
      HasGenericSamples (adjoin k S₀) a' (Fintype.card μ) ∧
      (∀ i, IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) c (t₁ i)) ∧
      (∀ i, IsGenericOver (adjoin k S₀) c (t₁ i)) ∧
      erk k (adjoin k S₀ : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) =
        ∑ i, erk k (adjoin k S₀ : Set K) (range (t₁ i)) ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) (M₀ : Set K) ∧
      erk k ∅ (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) = erk k ∅ S₀ + ∑ i, erk k ∅ (range (t₁ i)) ∧
      ∃ hL : IsSmall k ((adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K),
        ConstructibleGroupPresentation (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)))
          (F.pairDomain (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) c a a')
          (F.pairDomainMap (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) hL hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim) ∧
        ∀ (y₀ : ι → K) (hy₀ : IsGen k a y₀),
          IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k ((S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) ∪ range y₀)))
            {d | ∃ hd : d ∈ F.pairDomain (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) c a a',
              F.pairDomainMap (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) hL hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim
                ⟨d, hd⟩ • (hb.isHW hδ₀).iota hy₀ = (hb.isHW hδ₀).iota hy₀}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S₀, t₁, hS₀, hfresh₀, hT, hsa, hsa', ht₁, ht₁L, hadd, hfresh, hrk, hD, hH⟩ :=
    F.exists_fresh_isConstructibleOver_pairDomain_stabilizer hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim M₀ hM₀
  let L := adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))
  have hL : IsSmall k (L : Set K) :=
    (IsSmall.of_finite (hS₀.union (finite_iUnion fun i ↦ finite_range (t₁ i)))).racl.mono
      (adjoin_le_racl k _)
  have hle : adjoin k S₀ ≤ L := adjoin.mono k _ _ subset_union_left
  have hFt : HasGenericSamples L a' (Fintype.card μ) := HasGenericSamples.mono hle hsa'
  have hsrc : HasGenericSamples L a
      (Fintype.card (((μ ⊕ μ) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ)) ⊕ (μ ⊕ μ))) :=
    (HasGenericSamples.mono hle hsa).of_le (by simp only [Fintype.card_sum]; omega)
  have hP := F.constructibleGroupPresentation_pairDomain L hL hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim hD hFt hsrc
  refine ⟨S₀, t₁, hS₀, hfresh₀, hT, hsa, hsa', ht₁, ht₁L, hadd, hfresh, hrk, hL, hP,
    fun y₀ hy₀ ↦ ?_⟩
  convert hH y₀ hy₀ using 1
  ext d
