      have h3 : γ 1 0 * (γ 0 0 - (γ 0 0)⁻¹) + (γ 0 0)⁻¹ * γ 1 0 =
          γ 1 0 * γ 0 0 + 1 * 0 := by ring
      have h4 : γ 1 0 * 0 + (γ 0 0)⁻¹ * 1 = γ 1 0 * 0 + 1 * (γ 0 0)⁻¹ := by ring
      rw [h1, h2, h3, h4]
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := exists_slDiag_conj_of_eigen γ l !![γ 0 0 - (γ 0 0)⁻¹, 0; γ 1 0, 1]
      (by simpa only [Matrix.det_fin_two_of, mul_one, zero_mul, sub_zero] using hD)
      ((congrArg (· * !![γ 0 0 - (γ 0 0)⁻¹, 0; γ 1 0, 1])
        (Matrix.eta_fin_two (γ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K))).trans key)
    exact ⟨R, l, hl, hR⟩
  · 
    obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_root
      (Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C (γ 0 0 + γ 1 1) * Polynomial.X + 1) (by
        rw [show (Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C (γ 0 0 + γ 1 1) * Polynomial.X + 1 :
          Polynomial K).degree = 2 by compute_degree!]
        decide)
    have hroot : μ * μ - (γ 0 0 + γ 1 1) * μ + 1 = 0 := by
      simpa [Polynomial.IsRoot, sq] using hμ
    have hμ0 : μ ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      simp at hroot
    let l : Kˣ := Units.mk0 μ hμ0
    have hinv : μ * μ⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hμ0
    have htr : γ 0 0 + γ 1 1 = μ + μ⁻¹ := by
      field_simp
      linear_combination -hroot
    have hl : Transcendental k (l : K) := by
      refine transcendental_of_add_inv_notMem ?_
      change μ + μ⁻¹ ∉ _
      rwa [← htr]
    have hsq := sq_ne_one_of_transcendental hl
    have hD : γ 0 1 * (μ⁻¹ - γ 0 0) - γ 0 1 * (μ - γ 0 0) ≠ 0 := by
      have he : γ 0 1 * (μ⁻¹ - γ 0 0) - γ 0 1 * (μ - γ 0 0) = γ 0 1 * (μ⁻¹ - μ) := by ring
      rw [he]
      refine mul_ne_zero hb fun h ↦ hsq ?_
      change μ ^ 2 = 1
      have h' : μ⁻¹ = μ := sub_eq_zero.1 h
      calc μ ^ 2 = μ * μ := sq _
        _ = μ * μ⁻¹ := by rw [h']
        _ = 1 := hinv
    have key : !![γ 0 0, γ 0 1; γ 1 0, γ 1 1] * !![γ 0 1, γ 0 1; μ - γ 0 0, μ⁻¹ - γ 0 0] =
        !![γ 0 1, γ 0 1; μ - γ 0 0, μ⁻¹ - γ 0 0] * !![(l : K), 0; 0, (l : K)⁻¹] := by
      change _ = _ * !![μ, 0; 0, μ⁻¹]
      rw [Matrix.mul_fin_two, Matrix.mul_fin_two]
      have h1 : γ 0 0 * γ 0 1 + γ 0 1 * (μ - γ 0 0) = γ 0 1 * μ + γ 0 1 * 0 := by ring
      have h2 : γ 0 0 * γ 0 1 + γ 0 1 * (μ⁻¹ - γ 0 0) = γ 0 1 * 0 + γ 0 1 * μ⁻¹ := by ring
      have h3 : γ 1 0 * γ 0 1 + γ 1 1 * (μ - γ 0 0) =
          (μ - γ 0 0) * μ + (μ⁻¹ - γ 0 0) * 0 := by
        linear_combination -hroot - hdet
      have h4 : γ 1 0 * γ 0 1 + γ 1 1 * (μ⁻¹ - γ 0 0) =
          (μ - γ 0 0) * 0 + (μ⁻¹ - γ 0 0) * μ⁻¹ := by
        linear_combination (-(μ⁻¹ ^ 2)) * hroot +
          (μ * μ⁻¹ + 1 - (γ 0 0 + γ 1 1) * μ⁻¹) * hinv - hdet
      rw [h1, h2, h3, h4]
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := exists_slDiag_conj_of_eigen γ l
      !![γ 0 1, γ 0 1; μ - γ 0 0, μ⁻¹ - γ 0 0]
      (by rw [Matrix.det_fin_two_of]; exact hD)
      ((congrArg (· * !![γ 0 1, γ 0 1; μ - γ 0 0, μ⁻¹ - γ 0 0])
        (Matrix.eta_fin_two (γ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K))).trans key)
    exact ⟨R, l, hl, hR⟩

name: GroupConfig.infinite_torus_params_of_trace_notMem
statement:
private theorem infinite_torus_params_of_trace_notMem {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K]
    [Algebra k K] [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K]
    (Γ : Subgroup (SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K)) {γ : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K}
    (hγΓ : γ ∈ Γ) (hγ : γ 0 0 + γ 1 1 ∉ range (algebraMap k K)) :
    ∃ (R : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K) (l : Kˣ), Transcendental k (l : K) ∧
      γ = R * slDiag l * R⁻¹ ∧ {r : Kˣ | R * slDiag r * R⁻¹ ∈ Γ}.Infinite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, l, hl, hγR⟩ := exists_slDiag_conj_of_trace_notMem γ hγ
  refine ⟨R, l, hl, hγR, ?_⟩
  have hpow : ∀ n : ℕ, l ^ n ∈ {r : Kˣ | R * slDiag r * R⁻¹ ∈ Γ} := by
    intro n
    change R * slDiag (l ^ n) * R⁻¹ ∈ Γ
    rw [map_pow, ← conj_pow, ← hγR]
    exact Γ.pow_mem hγΓ n
  have hinj : Function.Injective fun n : ℕ ↦ l ^ n := by
    refine injective_pow_iff_not_isOfFinOrder.2 fun hfin ↦ hl ?_
    obtain ⟨n, hn, hln⟩ := isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one.1 hfin
    refine ⟨Polynomial.X ^ n - 1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa using Polynomial.X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero hn (1 : k)
    · have : (l : K) ^ n = 1 := by rw [← Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, hln, Units.val_one]
      simp [this]
  exact Set.infinite_of_injective_forall_mem hinj hpow

name: GroupConfig.sl_mul_entries_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [SpecialLinearGroup.coe_mul, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  exact S.add_mem (S.mul_mem (hA i 0) (hB 0 j)) (S.mul_mem (hA i 1) (hB 1 j))

name: GroupConfig.sl_inv_entries_mem
statement:
theorem sl_inv_entries_mem {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (S : IntermediateField k K) {A : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K} (hA : ∀ i j, A i j ∈ S)
    (i j : Fin 2) : A⁻¹ i j ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  rw [SpecialLinearGroup.SL2_inv_expl]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  · exact hA 1 1
  · exact S.neg_mem (hA 0 1)
  · exact S.neg_mem (hA 1 0)
  · exact hA 0 0

name: GroupConfig.slEntries_conj_subset
statement:
private theorem slEntries_conj_subset {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (N : IntermediateField k K) {R : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K} (hR : ∀ i j, R i j ∈ N)
    (g : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K) :
    slEntries (R⁻¹ * g * R) ⊆ racl k ((N : Set K) ∪ slEntries g)
proof:
:= by
  let S := racl k ((N : Set K) ∪ slEntries g)
  have hRS : ∀ i j, R i j ∈ S := fun i j ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inl (hR i j))
  have hgS : ∀ i j, g i j ∈ S := fun i j ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩)
  rintro _ ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩
  exact sl_mul_entries_mem S (sl_mul_entries_mem S (sl_inv_entries_mem S hRS) hgS) hRS i j

name: GroupConfig.erk_slEntries_conj
statement:
private theorem erk_slEntries_conj {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (N : IntermediateField k K) {R : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K} (hR : ∀ i j, R i j ∈ N)
    (g : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K) :
    erk k (N : Set K) (slEntries (R⁻¹ * g * R)) = erk k (N : Set K) (slEntries g)
proof:
:= by
  have hRinv : ∀ i j, R⁻¹ i j ∈ N := sl_inv_entries_mem N hR
  have hback : R⁻¹⁻¹ * (R⁻¹ * g * R) * R⁻¹ = g := by group
  refine le_antisymm ((erk_mono k _ (slEntries_conj_subset N hR g)).trans_eq (erk_racl k _ _))
    ?_
  have h := slEntries_conj_subset N hRinv (R⁻¹ * g * R)
  rw [hback] at h
  exact (erk_mono k _ h).trans_eq (erk_racl k _ _)

name: GroupConfig.conj_rank_of_constructible_rank_two
statement:
private theorem conj_rank_of_constructible_rank_two {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K]
    [Algebra k K] [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K]
    (Γ : Subgroup (SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K)) (hΓ : IsConstructibleOver k (slCarrier Γ))
    (hle : ∀ m ∈ Γ, erk k ∅ (slEntries m) ≤ 2) (hr : ∃ m ∈ Γ, erk k ∅ (slEntries m) = 2)
    (N : IntermediateField k K) (hN : IsSmall k (N : Set K))
    (R : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K) (hR : ∀ i j, R i j ∈ N) :
    (∀ h ∈ Γ.map (MulAut.conj R⁻¹).toMonoidHom, erk k (N : Set K) (slEntries h) ≤ 2) ∧
      ∃ h ∈ Γ.map (MulAut.conj R⁻¹).toMonoidHom, erk k (N : Set K) (slEntries h) = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hconj : ∀ g : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K,
      (MulAut.conj R⁻¹).toMonoidHom g = R⁻¹ * g * R := fun g ↦ by
    rw [MulEquiv.coe_toMonoidHom, MulAut.conj_apply, inv_inv]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
    rw [hconj, erk_slEntries_conj N hR]
    exact (erk_base_mono k (empty_subset _) _).trans (hle g hg)
  · obtain ⟨m, hm, hmr⟩ := hr
    
    let a : Fin 2 × Fin 2 → K := fun ij ↦ m ij.1 ij.2
    have hN₁ : IsSmall k ((racl k ((N : Set K) ∪ range a) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
      (hN.union (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range a))).racl
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hN₁ a
    obtain ⟨σ, -, hσ⟩ := exists_ambientAutomorphism_of_idealOf_eq (k := k) hu.idealOf_eq.symm
    let n := SpecialLinearGroup.map σ.toRingHom m
    have hncoeff (i j : Fin 2) : n i j = u (i, j) := hσ (i, j)
    have hna : slEntries n = range u := by
      change range (fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ n ij.1 ij.2) = _
      congr 1
      funext ij
      exact hncoeff ij.1 ij.2
    have hn : n ∈ Γ := by
      have hm' : a ∈ slCarrier Γ := ⟨m, hm, fun _ _ ↦ rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨n', hn', heq⟩ := (hΓ.mem_comp_algEquiv_iff σ a).2 hm'
      have he : n' = n := SpecialLinearGroup.ext _ _ fun i j ↦ heq i j
      exact he ▸ hn'
    have hnr : erk k (N : Set K) (slEntries n) = 2 := by
      have hind : IndepOver k ∅ (range u) (N : Set K) :=
        hu.indepOver.mono_right ((subset_union_left).trans (subset_racl k _))
      have h := hind (subset_refl _) (finite_range u)
      rw [empty_union] at h
      rw [hna, h, hu.erk_empty_eq]
      exact hmr
    refine ⟨R⁻¹ * n * R, ⟨n, hn, hconj n⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [erk_slEntries_conj N hR]
    exact hnr

name: GroupConfig.matrix_diag_middle_apply
statement:
private theorem matrix_diag_middle_apply {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (A B : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) (r z : K) (i j : Fin 2) :
    (A * !![r, 0; 0, z] * B) i j = A i 0 * r * B 0 j + A i 1 * z * B 1 j
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]

name: GroupConfig.sl_torus_entry
statement:
private theorem sl_torus_entry {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (R : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K) (r : Kˣ) (i j : Fin 2) :
    (R * slDiag r * R⁻¹) i j =
      R i 0 * (r : K) * R⁻¹ 0 j + R i 1 * (r : K)⁻¹ * R⁻¹ 1 j
proof:
:= by
  change ((R : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) * !![(r : K), 0; 0, (r : K)⁻¹] *
    ((R⁻¹ : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K)) i j = _
  exact matrix_diag_middle_apply _ _ _ _ i j

name: GroupConfig.isConstructibleOver_torus_parameters
proof:
:= by
  let q : (Fin 2 × Fin 2) → MvPolynomial (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) K := fun ij ↦
    C (R ij.1 0) * X (Sum.inl 0) * C (R⁻¹ 0 ij.2) +
      C (R ij.1 1) * X (Sum.inr 0) * C (R⁻¹ 1 ij.2)
  have hq (x z : Fin 1 → K) (ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
      aeval (Sum.elim x z) (q ij) =
        R ij.1 0 * x 0 * R⁻¹ 0 ij.2 + R ij.1 1 * z 0 * R⁻¹ 1 ij.2 := by
    simp [q]
  let φ (x z : Fin 1 → K) : Prop :=
    (fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ aeval (Sum.elim x z) (q ij)) ∈ slCarrier Γ ∧ x 0 * z 0 = 1
  have hc : IsConstructibleOver K {u : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) → K | φ (u ∘ Sum.inl) (u ∘ Sum.inr)} := by
    have hp := (hΓ.extend_base (L := K)).preimage_polynomial q
    have hzero := IsConstructibleOver.polynomial_zero (k := K) (K := K)
      (X (Sum.inl 0) * X (Sum.inr 0) - 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) K)
    convert hp.inter hzero using 1
    ext u
    simp [φ, sub_eq_zero]
  have hset : {x : Fin 1 → K | ∃ r : Kˣ, R * slDiag r * R⁻¹ ∈ Γ ∧ (r : K) = x 0} =
      {x : Fin 1 → K | ∃ z : Fin 1 → K, φ x z} := by
    ext x
    change (∃ r : Kˣ, R * slDiag r * R⁻¹ ∈ Γ ∧ (r : K) = x 0) ↔ ∃ z : Fin 1 → K, φ x z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨r, hr, hx⟩
      refine ⟨fun _ ↦ (r : K)⁻¹, ?_, ?_⟩
      · refine ⟨R * slDiag r * R⁻¹, hr, fun i j ↦ ?_⟩
        have hv := hq x (fun _ ↦ (r : K)⁻¹) (i, j)
        rw [← hx] at hv
        exact (sl_torus_entry R r i j).trans hv.symm
      · change x 0 * (r : K)⁻¹ = 1
        rw [← hx]
        exact mul_inv_cancel₀ r.ne_zero
    · rintro ⟨z, ⟨m, hm, hmx⟩, hxz⟩
      let r : Kˣ := Units.mk0 (x 0) (left_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one hxz)
      have hz : z 0 = (r : K)⁻¹ := eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right hxz
      have he : m = R * slDiag r * R⁻¹ := by
        apply SpecialLinearGroup.ext
        intro i j
        calc m i j = aeval (Sum.elim x z) (q (i, j)) := hmx i j
          _ = R i 0 * x 0 * R⁻¹ 0 j + R i 1 * z 0 * R⁻¹ 1 j := hq x z (i, j)
          _ = (R * slDiag r * R⁻¹) i j := by
            rw [hz]
            exact (sl_torus_entry R r i j).symm
      exact ⟨r, he ▸ hm, rfl⟩
  rw [hset]
  exact hc.exists

name: GroupConfig.full_torus_of_infinite_parameters
statement:
private theorem full_torus_of_infinite_parameters {k K : Type*}
    [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K] [IsAlgClosed K]
    (Γ : Subgroup (SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K)) (hΓ : IsConstructibleOver k (slCarrier Γ))
    (R : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K)
    (hInf : {r : Kˣ | R * slDiag r * R⁻¹ ∈ Γ}.Infinite) :
    ∀ r : Kˣ, R * slDiag r * R⁻¹ ∈ Γ
proof:
:= by
  let S : Subgroup Kˣ := Γ.comap ((MulAut.conj R).toMonoidHom.comp slDiag)
  have hSInf : (S : Set Kˣ).Infinite := hInf
  have : Infinite Kˣ := infinite_univ_iff.1 (hSInf.mono (subset_univ _))
  have hS : S = ⊤ := constructible_units_subgroup_eq_top S hSInf
    (isConstructibleOver_torus_parameters Γ hΓ R)
  intro r
  have hr : r ∈ S := by rw [hS]; trivial
  exact hr

name: GroupConfig.sl_mul_apply
statement:
theorem sl_mul_apply {K : Type*} [Field K] (A B : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K)
    (i j : Fin 2) : (A * B) i j = A i 0 * B 0 j + A i 1 * B 1 j
proof:
:= by
  rw [SpecialLinearGroup.coe_mul, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]

name: GroupConfig.sl_entries_forall
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> assumption

name: GroupConfig.sl_ext_entries
proof:
:= by
  refine SpecialLinearGroup.ext _ _ fun i j ↦ ?_
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> assumption

name: GroupConfig.slEntries_subset_of
statement:
private theorem slEntries_subset_of {K : Type*} [Field K] {S : Set K}
    (m : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K) (h : ∀ i j, m i j ∈ S) : slEntries m ⊆ S
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩
  exact h i j

name: GroupConfig.erk_slEntries_le_one_of_offdiag
statement:
private theorem erk_slEntries_le_one_of_offdiag {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (m : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K) (h01 : m 0 1 = 0) (h10 : m 1 0 = 0) :
    erk k ∅ (slEntries m) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : m 0 0 * m 1 1 = 1 := by
    simpa only [Matrix.det_fin_two, h01, zero_mul, sub_zero] using m.prop
  let F := racl k ({m 0 0} : Set K)
  have ha : m 0 0 ∈ F := subset_racl k _ (mem_singleton _)
  have hd : m 1 1 ∈ F := by
    rw [eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right hdet]
    exact F.inv_mem ha
  have hsub : slEntries m ⊆ F := slEntries_subset_of m (sl_entries_forall (P := (· ∈ F)) m ha
    (show m 0 1 ∈ F by rw [h01]; exact F.zero_mem) (show m 1 0 ∈ F by rw [h10]; exact F.zero_mem)
    hd)
  have hr := (erk_mono k ∅ hsub).trans_eq (by
    simpa only [empty_union] using erk_racl k (∅ : Set K) ({m 0 0} : Set K))
  exact hr.trans ((erk_le_encard k ∅ _).trans (by simp))

name: GroupConfig.erk_slEntries_le_one_of_diag
statement:
private theorem erk_slEntries_le_one_of_diag {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (m : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K) (h00 : m 0 0 = 0) (h11 : m 1 1 = 0) :
    erk k ∅ (slEntries m) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : m 0 1 * -m 1 0 = 1 := by
    have h := m.prop
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_two, h00, zero_mul, zero_sub] at h
    linear_combination h
  let F := racl k ({m 0 1} : Set K)
  have hb : m 0 1 ∈ F := subset_racl k _ (mem_singleton _)
  have hc : m 1 0 ∈ F := by
    rw [← neg_neg (m 1 0), eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right hdet]
    exact F.neg_mem (F.inv_mem hb)
  have hsub : slEntries m ⊆ F := slEntries_subset_of m (sl_entries_forall (P := (· ∈ F)) m
    (show m 0 0 ∈ F by rw [h00]; exact F.zero_mem) hb hc
    (show m 1 1 ∈ F by rw [h11]; exact F.zero_mem))
  have hr := (erk_mono k ∅ hsub).trans_eq (by
    simpa only [empty_union] using erk_racl k (∅ : Set K) ({m 0 1} : Set K))
  exact hr.trans ((erk_le_encard k ∅ _).trans (by simp))

name: GroupConfig.not_witness_of_entries_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem not_witness_of_entries_ne_zero {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K]
    (H : Subgroup (SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K)) (hD : ∀ r : Kˣ, slDiag r ∈ H)
    (hle : ∀ h ∈ H, erk k ∅ (slEntries h) ≤ 2) (R : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K)
    (hR : ∀ i j, R i j ≠ 0) (hRT : ∀ r : Kˣ, R * slDiag r * R⁻¹ ∈ H) : False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, h3⟩ := exists_rank_three_of_two_tori (k := k) H R hR hD hRT
  have := h3.trans (hle m hm)
  norm_num at this

name: GroupConfig.upper_transvection_apply
statement:
private theorem upper_transvection_apply {K : Type*} [Field K] (z : K) :
    (SpecialLinearGroup.transvection fin_zero_ne_one z : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K) 0 0 = 1 ∧
      (SpecialLinearGroup.transvection fin_zero_ne_one z : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K) 0 1 = z ∧
      (SpecialLinearGroup.transvection fin_zero_ne_one z : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K) 1 0 = 0 ∧
      (SpecialLinearGroup.transvection fin_zero_ne_one z : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K) 1 1 =
        1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> rw [upper_transvection_coe] <;> rfl

name: GroupConfig.mem_iff_upper_of_witness
statement:
private theorem mem_iff_upper_of_witness {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K]
    (H : Subgroup (SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K)) (hD : ∀ r : Kˣ, slDiag r ∈ H)
    (hle : ∀ h ∈ H, erk k ∅ (slEntries h) ≤ 2) (R : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K)
    (hR10 : R 1 0 = 0) (hR01 : R 0 1 ≠ 0) (hRT : ∀ r : Kˣ, R * slDiag r * R⁻¹ ∈ H) :
    ∀ g : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K, g ∈ H ↔ g 1 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, hRa, -⟩ := eq_transvection_mul_slDiag R hR10
  have hdet : R 0 0 * R 1 1 = 1 := by
    simpa only [Matrix.det_fin_two, hR10, mul_zero, sub_zero] using R.prop
  have hR00 : R 0 0 ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one hdet
  have hb : R 0 1 * R 0 0 ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hR01 hR00
  
  have hUD : ∀ r : Kˣ, SpecialLinearGroup.transvection fin_zero_ne_one (R 0 1 * R 0 0) *
      slDiag r * SpecialLinearGroup.transvection fin_zero_ne_one (-(R 0 1 * R 0 0)) ∈ H := by
    intro r
    have hcomm : slDiag a * slDiag r * (slDiag a)⁻¹ = slDiag r := by
      rw [← map_inv, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, mul_comm a r, mul_inv_cancel_right]
    have h := hRT r
    rw [hRa, _root_.mul_inv_rev, SpecialLinearGroup.transvection_inv,
      show ∀ x y z w : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K, x * y * z * (y⁻¹ * w) =
        x * (y * z * y⁻¹) * w from fun _ _ _ _ ↦ by group, hcomm] at h
    exact h
  have hupper := upper_mem_of_two_tori H hb hD hUD
  have hU : ∀ z : K, SpecialLinearGroup.transvection fin_zero_ne_one z ∈ H := fun z ↦
    hupper _ (upper_transvection_apply z).2.2.1
  intro g
  refine ⟨fun hg ↦ ?_, hupper g⟩
  by_contra hc
  
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : K, g 0 0 + x * g 1 0 ≠ 0 := by
    by_cases h0 : g 0 0 = 0
    · exact ⟨1, by rw [h0, zero_add, one_mul]; exact hc⟩
    · exact ⟨0, by rw [zero_mul, add_zero]; exact h0⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Infinite.exists_notMem_finset
    ({-(g 0 1 + x * g 1 1) / (g 0 0 + x * g 1 0), -g 1 1 / g 1 0} : Finset K)
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, not_or] at hy
  obtain ⟨hy1, hy2⟩ := hy
  obtain ⟨R', hR'def⟩ : ∃ R', R' = SpecialLinearGroup.transvection fin_zero_ne_one x * g *
      SpecialLinearGroup.transvection fin_zero_ne_one y := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨u00, u01, u10, u11⟩ := upper_transvection_apply (K := K) x
  obtain ⟨v00, v01, v10, v11⟩ := upper_transvection_apply (K := K) y
  have e00 : R' 0 0 = g 0 0 + x * g 1 0 := by
    rw [hR'def]
    simp only [sl_mul_apply, u00, u01, v00, v10]
    ring
  have e01 : R' 0 1 = (g 0 0 + x * g 1 0) * y + (g 0 1 + x * g 1 1) := by
    rw [hR'def]
    simp only [sl_mul_apply, u00, u01, v01, v11]
    ring
  have e10 : R' 1 0 = g 1 0 := by
    rw [hR'def]
    simp only [sl_mul_apply, u10, u11, v00, v10]
    ring
  have e11 : R' 1 1 = g 1 0 * y + g 1 1 := by
    rw [hR'def]
    simp only [sl_mul_apply, u10, u11, v01, v11]
    ring
  have hR' : R' ∈ H := by
    rw [hR'def]
    exact H.mul_mem (H.mul_mem (hU x) hg) (hU y)
  refine not_witness_of_entries_ne_zero H hD hle R' (sl_entries_forall (P := (· ≠ 0)) R'
    (show R' 0 0 ≠ 0 by rw [e00]; exact hx) (show R' 0 1 ≠ 0 by
      rw [e01]
      intro h
      apply hy1
      rw [eq_div_iff hx]
      linear_combination h)
    (show R' 1 0 ≠ 0 by rw [e10]; exact hc) (show R' 1 1 ≠ 0 by
      rw [e11]
      intro h
      apply hy2
      rw [eq_div_iff hc]
      linear_combination h))
    (fun r ↦ H.mul_mem (H.mul_mem hR' (hD r)) (H.inv_mem hR'))

name: GroupConfig.slSwap_apply
statement:
private theorem slSwap_apply (K : Type*) [Field K] :
    (slSwap K 0 0 = 0 ∧ slSwap K 0 1 = 1 ∧ slSwap K 1 0 = -1 ∧ slSwap K 1 1 = 0) ∧
      ((slSwap K)⁻¹ 0 0 = 0 ∧ (slSwap K)⁻¹ 0 1 = -1 ∧ (slSwap K)⁻¹ 1 0 = 1 ∧
        (slSwap K)⁻¹ 1 1 = 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [SpecialLinearGroup.SL2_inv_expl]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp [slSwap]

name: GroupConfig.slSwap_conj_apply
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨w00, w01, w10, w11⟩, ⟨i00, i01, i10, i11⟩⟩ := slSwap_apply K
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    simp only [sl_mul_apply, w00, w01, w10, w11, i00, i01, i10, i11] <;> ring

name: GroupConfig.erk_slEntries_swap_conj
statement:
private theorem erk_slEntries_swap_conj {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (g : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K) :
    erk k ∅ (slEntries (slSwap K * g * (slSwap K)⁻¹)) = erk k ∅ (slEntries g)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e00, e01, e10, e11⟩ := slSwap_conj_apply g
  obtain ⟨W, hWdef⟩ : ∃ W, W = slSwap K * g * (slSwap K)⁻¹ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hWdef] at e00 e01 e10 e11 ⊢
  have hg : ∀ i j, g i j ∈ racl k (∅ ∪ slEntries g) :=
    fun i j ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩)
  have hW : ∀ i j, W i j ∈ racl k (∅ ∪ slEntries W) :=
    fun i j ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩)
  have h1 : slEntries W ⊆ racl k (∅ ∪ slEntries g) :=
    slEntries_subset_of W (sl_entries_forall (P := (· ∈ racl k (∅ ∪ slEntries g))) W
      (show W 0 0 ∈ _ by rw [e00]; exact hg 1 1)
      (show W 0 1 ∈ _ by rw [e01]; exact (racl k _).neg_mem (hg 1 0))
      (show W 1 0 ∈ _ by rw [e10]; exact (racl k _).neg_mem (hg 0 1))
      (show W 1 1 ∈ _ by rw [e11]; exact hg 0 0))
  have h2 : slEntries g ⊆ racl k (∅ ∪ slEntries W) :=
    slEntries_subset_of g (sl_entries_forall (P := (· ∈ racl k (∅ ∪ slEntries W))) g
      (show g 0 0 ∈ _ by rw [← e11]; exact hW 1 1)
      (show g 0 1 ∈ _ by rw [← neg_neg (g 0 1), ← e10]; exact (racl k _).neg_mem (hW 1 0))
      (show g 1 0 ∈ _ by rw [← neg_neg (g 1 0), ← e01]; exact (racl k _).neg_mem (hW 0 1))
      (show g 1 1 ∈ _ by rw [← e00]; exact hW 0 0))
  exact le_antisymm ((erk_mono k ∅ h1).trans_eq (erk_racl k _ _))
    ((erk_mono k ∅ h2).trans_eq (erk_racl k _ _))

name: GroupConfig.slSwap_conj_slDiag
statement:
private theorem slSwap_conj_slDiag {K : Type*} [Field K] (r : Kˣ) :
    slSwap K * slDiag r * (slSwap K)⁻¹ = slDiag r⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e00, e01, e10, e11⟩ := slSwap_conj_apply (slDiag r)
  refine sl_ext_entries ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [e00, slDiag_coe, slDiag_coe, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]
    rfl
  · rw [e01, slDiag_coe, slDiag_coe]
    exact neg_zero
  · rw [e10, slDiag_coe, slDiag_coe]
    exact neg_zero
  · rw [e11, slDiag_coe, slDiag_coe, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, inv_inv]
    rfl

name: GroupConfig.exists_borel_conj_of_rank_two
statement:
private theorem exists_borel_conj_of_rank_two {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K]
    (H : Subgroup (SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K)) (hD : ∀ r : Kˣ, slDiag r ∈ H)
    (hle : ∀ h ∈ H, erk k ∅ (slEntries h) ≤ 2) (hr : ∃ h ∈ H, erk k ∅ (slEntries h) = 2) :
    ∃ A : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K, ∀ g, g ∈ H ↔ (A * g * A⁻¹) 1 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδr⟩ := hr
  
  have hlower : ∀ R : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K, R 0 1 = 0 → R 1 0 ≠ 0 →
      (∀ r : Kˣ, R * slDiag r * R⁻¹ ∈ H) →
      ∃ A : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K, ∀ g, g ∈ H ↔ (A * g * A⁻¹) 1 0 = 0 := by
    intro R hR01 hR10 hRT
    let H' := H.map (MulAut.conj (slSwap K)).toMonoidHom
    have hmem : ∀ g : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K,
        g ∈ H' ↔ (slSwap K)⁻¹ * g * slSwap K ∈ H := by
      intro g
      rw [Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, MulAut.conj_symm_apply]
    have hinv : ∀ r : Kˣ, (slSwap K)⁻¹ * slDiag r * slSwap K = slDiag r⁻¹ := fun r ↦ by
      have h := slSwap_conj_slDiag (K := K) r⁻¹
      rw [inv_inv] at h
      rw [← h]
      group
    have hconj : ∀ g : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K,
        (slSwap K)⁻¹ * (slSwap K * g * (slSwap K)⁻¹) * slSwap K = g := fun g ↦ by group
    have hD' : ∀ r : Kˣ, slDiag r ∈ H' := by
      intro r
      rw [hmem, ← inv_inv r, ← slSwap_conj_slDiag r⁻¹, hconj]
      exact hD r⁻¹
    have hle' : ∀ h ∈ H', erk k ∅ (slEntries h) ≤ 2 := by
      intro h hh
      rw [hmem] at hh
      have := hle _ hh
      rwa [← erk_slEntries_swap_conj,
        show slSwap K * ((slSwap K)⁻¹ * h * slSwap K) * (slSwap K)⁻¹ = h by group] at this
    obtain ⟨e00, e01, e10, e11⟩ := slSwap_conj_apply R
    have hW := mem_iff_upper_of_witness H' hD' hle' (slSwap K * R * (slSwap K)⁻¹)
      (by rw [e10, hR01, neg_zero]) (by rw [e01]; exact neg_ne_zero.2 hR10) (fun r ↦ by
        rw [hmem, show (slSwap K)⁻¹ * (slSwap K * R * (slSwap K)⁻¹ * slDiag r *
            (slSwap K * R * (slSwap K)⁻¹)⁻¹) * slSwap K =
            R * ((slSwap K)⁻¹ * slDiag r * slSwap K) * R⁻¹ by group, hinv]
        exact hRT r⁻¹)
    refine ⟨slSwap K, fun g ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [← hW, hmem, hconj]
  
  have hnd : ¬ (δ 0 1 = 0 ∧ δ 1 0 = 0) := fun h ↦ by
    have := erk_slEntries_le_one_of_offdiag (k := k) δ h.1 h.2
    rw [hδr] at this
    norm_num at this
  have hna : ¬ (δ 0 0 = 0 ∧ δ 1 1 = 0) := fun h ↦ by
    have := erk_slEntries_le_one_of_diag (k := k) δ h.1 h.2
    rw [hδr] at this
    norm_num at this
  have hδT : ∀ r : Kˣ, δ * slDiag r * δ⁻¹ ∈ H := fun r ↦
    H.mul_mem (H.mul_mem hδ (hD r)) (H.inv_mem hδ)
  have hδWT : ∀ r : Kˣ, (δ * slSwap K) * slDiag r * (δ * slSwap K)⁻¹ ∈ H := by
    intro r
    have h := hδT r⁻¹
    convert h using 1
    rw [← slSwap_conj_slDiag r]
    group
  obtain ⟨⟨w00, w01, w10, w11⟩, -⟩ := slSwap_apply K
  have d01 : (δ * slSwap K) 0 1 = δ 0 0 := by
    simp only [sl_mul_apply, w01, w11]
    ring
  have d10 : (δ * slSwap K) 1 0 = -δ 1 1 := by
    simp only [sl_mul_apply, w00, w10]
    ring
  have hupperA : ∀ R : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K, R 1 0 = 0 → R 0 1 ≠ 0 →
      (∀ r : Kˣ, R * slDiag r * R⁻¹ ∈ H) →
      ∃ A : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K, ∀ g, g ∈ H ↔ (A * g * A⁻¹) 1 0 = 0 := by
    intro R hR10 hR01 hRT
    refine ⟨1, fun g ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [mem_iff_upper_of_witness H hD hle R hR10 hR01 hRT g, one_mul, inv_one, mul_one]
  by_cases h10 : δ 1 0 = 0
  · exact hupperA δ h10 (fun h ↦ hnd ⟨h, h10⟩) hδT
  by_cases h01 : δ 0 1 = 0
  · exact hlower δ h01 h10 hδT
  by_cases h00 : δ 0 0 = 0
  · exact hlower (δ * slSwap K) (by rw [d01, h00])
      (by rw [d10]; exact neg_ne_zero.2 fun h ↦ hna ⟨h00, h⟩) hδWT
  by_cases h11 : δ 1 1 = 0
  · exact hupperA (δ * slSwap K) (by rw [d10, h11, neg_zero]) (by rw [d01]; exact h00) hδWT
  exact (not_witness_of_entries_ne_zero H hD hle δ
    (sl_entries_forall (P := (· ≠ 0)) δ h00 h01 h10 h11) hδT).elim

name: GroupConfig.exists_borel_conj_of_constructible_rank_two
statement:
theorem exists_borel_conj_of_constructible_rank_two {k K : Type*}
    [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K] [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K]
    [UniversalDomain k K] (Γ : Subgroup (SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K))
    (hΓ : IsConstructibleOver k {x : Fin 2 × Fin 2 → K |
      ∃ m ∈ Γ, ∀ i j, m i j = x (i, j)})
    (hle : ∀ m ∈ Γ, erk k ∅ (range fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ m ij.1 ij.2) ≤ 2)
    (hr : ∃ m ∈ Γ, erk k ∅ (range fun ij : Fin 2 × Fin 2 ↦ m ij.1 ij.2) = 2) :
    ∃ A : SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) K, ∀ m, m ∈ Γ ↔ (A * m * A⁻¹) 1 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ, htrace⟩ := exists_nonbase_trace_of_constructible_rank_two Γ hΓ hr
  obtain ⟨R, _, _, _, hInf⟩ := infinite_torus_params_of_trace_notMem Γ hγ htrace
  have hfull := full_torus_of_infinite_parameters Γ hΓ R hInf
  
  let N := racl k (slEntries R)
  have hN : IsSmall k (N : Set K) := (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range _)).racl
  let : IsAlgClosed ↥N := isAlgClosed_racl _
  let : UniversalDomain ↥N K := universalDomain_of_isSmall N hN
  have hR (i j : Fin 2) : R i j ∈ N := subset_racl k _ ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩
  let H := Γ.map (MulAut.conj R⁻¹).toMonoidHom
  obtain ⟨hHle, hHr⟩ := conj_rank_of_constructible_rank_two Γ hΓ hle hr N hN R hR
  have hD (r : Kˣ) : slDiag r ∈ H := by
    refine ⟨R * slDiag r * R⁻¹, hfull r, ?_⟩
    change R⁻¹ * (R * slDiag r * R⁻¹) * R⁻¹⁻¹ = slDiag r
    group
  have hleN : ∀ m ∈ H, erk ↥N ∅ (slEntries m) ≤ 2 := by
    intro m hm
    rw [erk_base_empty N]
    exact hHle m hm
  have hrN : ∃ m ∈ H, erk ↥N ∅ (slEntries m) = 2 := by
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hmr⟩ := hHr
    exact ⟨m, hm, (erk_base_empty N _).trans hmr⟩
  obtain ⟨A₀, hA₀⟩ := exists_borel_conj_of_rank_two (k := ↥N) H hD hleN hrN
  refine ⟨A₀ * R⁻¹, fun m ↦ ?_⟩
  have hm : R⁻¹ * m * R ∈ H ↔ m ∈ Γ := by
    rw [Subgroup.mem_map_equiv, MulAut.conj_symm_apply, inv_inv]
    rw [show R * (R⁻¹ * m * R) * R⁻¹ = m by group]
  rw [← hm, hA₀]
  group

name: GroupConfig.exists_genericSamples
statement:
theorem exists_genericSamples (M : IntermediateField k K) (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K))
    (a : ι → K) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ t : Fin n → ι → K,
      (∀ i, IsGenericOver M a (t i)) ∧
      erk k (M : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t i)) = ∑ _i : Fin n, erk k ∅ (range a) ∧
      erk k ∅ (⋃ i, range (t i)) = ∑ _i : Fin n, erk k ∅ (range a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨Fin.elim0, fun i ↦ Fin.elim0 i, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp [erk_empty]
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hr, hr₀⟩ := ih
    let T : Set K := ⋃ i, range (t i)
    have hT : T.Finite := finite_iUnion fun i ↦ finite_range (t i)
    have hN : IsSmall k ((racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ T) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
      (hM.union (IsSmall.of_finite hT)).racl
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hN a
    have hyM : IsGenericOver M a y :=
      hy.of_le (subset_union_left.trans (subset_racl k _))
    have hry : erk k ((M : Set K) ∪ T) (range y) = erk k ∅ (range a) := by
      rw [← erk_racl_base, hy.erk_coe_eq, hy.erk_empty_eq]
    have hsum : erk k (M : Set K) (range y ∪ T) =
        ∑ _i : Fin (n + 1), erk k ∅ (range a) := by
      rw [union_comm, erk_union_eq, hr, hry, Fin.sum_univ_succ, add_comm]
    refine ⟨Fin.cons y t, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      cases i using Fin.cases with
      | zero => exact hyM
      | succ j => exact ht j
    · simpa only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, iUnion_fin_add_one_eq_iUnion_succ,
        Function.comp_def] using hsum
    · have hupper : erk k ∅ (range y ∪ T) ≤
          ∑ _i : Fin (n + 1), erk k ∅ (range a) := by
        calc
          erk k ∅ (range y ∪ T) ≤ erk k ∅ (range y) + erk k ∅ T :=
            erk_union_le k ∅ _ _
          _ = ∑ _i : Fin (n + 1), erk k ∅ (range a) := by
            rw [hy.erk_empty_eq, hr₀, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
      have hlower : (∑ _i : Fin (n + 1), erk k ∅ (range a)) ≤
          erk k ∅ (range y ∪ T) := by
        rw [← hsum]
        exact erk_base_mono k (empty_subset _) _
      simpa only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, iUnion_fin_add_one_eq_iUnion_succ,
        Function.comp_def] using le_antisymm hupper hlower

name: GroupConfig.exists_fresh_genericSamples
statement:
theorem exists_fresh_genericSamples (M : IntermediateField k K)
    (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K)) (a : ι → K) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ t : Fin n → ι → K,
      (∀ i, IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) a (t i)) ∧
      erk k ((⊥ : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t i)) =
        ∑ i, erk k ((⊥ : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) (range (t i)) ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ (⋃ i, range (t i)) (M : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hr, hr₀⟩ := exists_genericSamples M hM a n
  have hbot (i : Fin n) : IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) a (t i) :=
    (ht i).of_le bot_le
  have hrbot : erk k ((⊥ : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t i)) =
      ∑ _i : Fin n, erk k ∅ (range a) := by
    refine le_antisymm ((erk_base_mono k (empty_subset _) _).trans hr₀.le) ?_
    rw [← hr]
    exact erk_base_mono k (show (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) ≤ M from bot_le) _
  refine ⟨t, hbot, ?_, indepOver_of_erk_eq (finite_iUnion fun i ↦ finite_range (t i)) ?_⟩
  · rw [hrbot]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ((hbot i).erk_coe_eq.trans (ht i).erk_empty_eq).symm
  · rw [empty_union, hr, hr₀]

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.exists_fresh_constructible_admissible_samples
statement:
theorem QuasiRational.exists_fresh_constructible_admissible_samples
    {μ κ : Type*} [Fintype μ] [Finite κ] (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ)
    (a : ι → K) (a' : κ → K) (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a'))
    (M : IntermediateField k K) (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K)) :
    ∃ t : Fin (2 * Fintype.card μ + 1) → κ → K,
      IndepOver k ∅ (⋃ i, range (t i)) (M : Set K) ∧
      IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k (⋃ i, range (t i))))
        {u : μ → K | F.IsAdmissible a a' u} ∧
      IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k (⋃ i, range (t i))))
        {u : μ → K | ∃ hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' u,
          Germ.IsInvertible (F.parameterGerm hu)}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hind, hindM⟩ := exists_fresh_genericSamples M hM a' (2 * Fintype.card μ + 1)
  exact ⟨t, hindM, F.isConstructibleOver_admissible a a' hdim t ht hind (by simp),
    F.isConstructibleOver_invertibleAdmissible a a' hdim t ht hind (by simp)⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.exists_fresh_canonicalGroupSpacePresentation
statement:
theorem exists_fresh_canonicalGroupSpacePresentation {ι κ : Type w} [Fintype ι] [Finite κ]
    {a : ι → K} {a' : κ → K} {f₀ : Germ k a a'} (hb : f₀.IsHWBij)
    [Fintype (CodeIndex (ι ⊕ κ) (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal))] {δ₀ : Germ k a a}
    (hδ₀ : δ₀ ∈ f₀.diffSet) (M₀ : IntermediateField k K) (hM₀ : IsSmall k (M₀ : Set K)) :
    ∃ (F : QuasiRational k (CodeIndex (ι ⊕ κ) (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal) ⊕ ι) κ)
      (hF : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K, ∃ hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' (⇑σ ∘ f₀.code),
        F.parameterGerm hu = f₀.map σ)
      (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a')),
    ∃ (S₀ : Set K) (t₁ : Fin (2 * (6 * Fintype.card (CodeIndex (ι ⊕ κ) (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal)) +
        Fintype.card ι) + 1) → CodeIndex (ι ⊕ κ) (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal) → K),
      S₀.Finite ∧ IndepOver k ∅ S₀ (M₀ : Set K) ∧
      (∃ T : List (Σ τ : Type w, (τ → K) × (τ → K)),
        (∀ p ∈ T, ((⟨p.1, p.2.1⟩ : Σ τ : Type w, τ → K) = ⟨ι, a⟩ ∨
            (⟨p.1, p.2.1⟩ : Σ τ : Type w, τ → K) = ⟨κ, a'⟩) ∧
          IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) p.2.1 p.2.2) ∧
        S₀ = (⋃ p ∈ T, range p.2.2) ∧
        erk k ∅ S₀ = (T.map fun p ↦ erk k ∅ (range p.2.2)).sum) ∧
      HasGenericSamples (adjoin k S₀) a
        (8 * Fintype.card (CodeIndex (ι ⊕ κ) (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal))) ∧
      HasGenericSamples (adjoin k S₀) a' (Fintype.card (CodeIndex (ι ⊕ κ) (genDeg f₀.graphIdeal))) ∧
      (∀ i, IsGenericOver (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) f₀.code (t₁ i)) ∧
      (∀ i, IsGenericOver (adjoin k S₀) f₀.code (t₁ i)) ∧
      erk k (adjoin k S₀ : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) =
        ∑ i, erk k (adjoin k S₀ : Set K) (range (t₁ i)) ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) (M₀ : Set K) ∧
      erk k ∅ (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) = erk k ∅ S₀ + ∑ i, erk k ∅ (range (t₁ i)) ∧
      ∃ hL : IsSmall k ((adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K),
        ConstructibleGroupPresentation (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)))
          (F.pairDomain (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) f₀.code a a')
          (F.pairDomainMap (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) hL hb hδ₀ f₀.adjoin_range_code hF
            hdim) ∧
        ∀ (y₀ : ι → K) (hy₀ : IsGen k a y₀),
          IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k ((S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) ∪ range y₀)))
            {d | ∃ hd : d ∈ F.pairDomain (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) f₀.code a a',
              F.pairDomainMap (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) hL hb hδ₀ f₀.adjoin_range_code
                hF hdim
                ⟨d, hd⟩ • (hb.isHW hδ₀).iota hy₀ = (hb.isHW hδ₀).iota hy₀} ∧
          ConstructibleGSetPresentation (adjoin k ((S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i)) ∪ range y₀))
            (F.pairDomain (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) f₀.code a a')
            (F.pairDomainMap (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) hL hb hδ₀ f₀.adjoin_range_code hF
              hdim)
            (F.pairDomain (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) f₀.code a a')
            (F.pairDomainSpaceMap (adjoin k (S₀ ∪ ⋃ i, range (t₁ i))) hL hb hδ₀ f₀.adjoin_range_code
              hF hdim hy₀)
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := exists_orbit_admissibleFamily f₀ f₀.adjoin_range_code
  
  obtain ⟨h, hi⟩ := hb.isInvertible
  exact ⟨F, hF, hi.erk_eq, F.exists_fresh_constructibleGroupSpacePresentation hb hδ₀
    f₀.adjoin_range_code hF hi.erk_eq M₀ hM₀⟩

name: GroupConfig.racl_range_comp
statement:
private theorem racl_range_comp (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (u : μ → K) :
    racl k (range (⇑σ ∘ u)) = (racl k (range u)).map σ.toAlgHom
proof:
:= by
  rw [racl_map, range_comp]

name: GroupConfig.isGenericOver_symm_comp
proof:
:= by
  have hyy : y = ⇑σ ∘ (⇑σ.symm ∘ y) := by
    funext i
    simp
  rw [← isGenericOver_map_iff σ, ← hyy, ← racl_range_comp]
  exact hy

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isAdmissible_comp_algEquiv
statement:
theorem isAdmissible_comp_algEquiv (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) {u : μ → K} (hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' u) :
    F.IsAdmissible a a' (⇑σ ∘ u)
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have hy₀ := isGenericOver_symm_comp σ hy
  have hsum : Sum.elim (⇑σ ∘ u) y = ⇑σ ∘ Sum.elim u (⇑σ.symm ∘ y) := by
    funext i
    cases i <;> simp
  obtain ⟨hdef, hgen⟩ := hu _ hy₀
  rw [hsum, F.isDefinedAt_comp_iff, F.eval_comp, racl_range_comp]
  exact ⟨hdef, (isGenericOver_map_iff σ _ a' _).2 hgen⟩

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.parameterGerm_comp_algEquiv
statement:
theorem parameterGerm_comp_algEquiv (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) {u : μ → K} (hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' u) :
    F.parameterGerm (F.isAdmissible_comp_algEquiv σ hu) = (F.parameterGerm hu).map σ
proof:
:= by
  have hN : IsSmall k ((racl k (range (⇑σ ∘ u)) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range _)).racl
  have hM : IsSmall k ((racl k (range u) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range _)).racl
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hN a
  have hcb : ((F.parameterGerm hu).map σ).cb ≤ racl k (range (⇑σ ∘ u)) := by
    rw [Germ.cb_map, racl_range_comp]
    exact IntermediateField.map_mono _ (F.cb_parameterGerm_le hu)
  refine Germ.eq_of_eval_eq hN (F.cb_parameterGerm_le _) hcb hy ?_
  have hy₀ := isGenericOver_symm_comp σ hy
  have hyy : ⇑σ ∘ (⇑σ.symm ∘ y) = y := by
    funext i
    simp
  have h := (F.parameterGerm hu).eval_map σ hM (F.cb_parameterGerm_le hu) hy₀
  rw [hyy, ← racl_range_comp, F.eval_parameterGerm hu hy₀, ← F.eval_comp] at h
  rw [F.eval_parameterGerm _ hy, h]
  congr 1
  funext i
  cases i <;> simp

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.isInvertiblePair_comp_algEquiv
statement:
theorem isInvertiblePair_comp_algEquiv (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) {d : (μ ⊕ μ) → K}
    (hd : F.IsInvertiblePair a a' d) : F.IsInvertiblePair a a' (⇑σ ∘ d)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨hu₁, hi₁⟩, ⟨hu₂, hi₂⟩⟩ := hd
  refine ⟨⟨F.isAdmissible_comp_algEquiv σ hu₁, ?_⟩, ⟨F.isAdmissible_comp_algEquiv σ hu₂, ?_⟩⟩
  · rw [F.parameterGerm_comp_algEquiv σ hu₁]
    exact hi₁.map σ
  · rw [F.parameterGerm_comp_algEquiv σ hu₂]
    exact hi₂.map σ

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.pairGerm_comp_algEquiv
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : F.parameterGerm hd'.1.choose = (F.parameterGerm hd.1.choose).map σ :=
    F.parameterGerm_comp_algEquiv σ hd.1.choose
  have h₂ : F.parameterGerm hd'.2.choose = (F.parameterGerm hd.2.choose).map σ :=
    F.parameterGerm_comp_algEquiv σ hd.2.choose
  have hinv : Classical.choose hd'.1.choose_spec =
      (Classical.choose hd.1.choose_spec).map σ := by
    refine (Classical.choose_spec hd'.1.choose_spec).unique ?_
    rw [h₁]
    exact (Classical.choose_spec hd.1.choose_spec).map σ
  change Germ.comp (Classical.choose hd'.1.choose_spec) (F.parameterGerm hd'.2.choose) =
    (Germ.comp (Classical.choose hd.1.choose_spec) (F.parameterGerm hd.2.choose)).map σ
  rw [hinv, h₂, Germ.comp_map]

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.comp_algEquiv_mem_pairDomain
statement:
theorem comp_algEquiv_mem_pairDomain (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) {d : (μ ⊕ μ) → K}
    (hd : d ∈ F.pairDomain M c a a') : ⇑σ ∘ d ∈ F.pairDomain M c a a'
proof:
:= by
  have hd' := F.isInvertiblePair_comp_algEquiv σ hd.choose
  refine (F.mem_pairDomain_iff M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim hd').2 ?_
  rw [F.pairGerm_comp_algEquiv σ hd.choose hd']
  exact Germ.IsHW.map_mem_prodSet ((F.mem_pairDomain_iff M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim hd.choose).1 hd) σ

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.val_pairDomainMap_comp_algEquiv
statement:
theorem val_pairDomainMap_comp_algEquiv (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (d : F.pairDomain M c a a') :
    (hb.isHW hδ₀).val (F.pairDomainMap M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim
        ⟨⇑σ ∘ d.1, F.comp_algEquiv_mem_pairDomain M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim σ d.2⟩) =
      ((hb.isHW hδ₀).val (F.pairDomainMap M hM hb hδ₀ hc hF hdim d)).map σ
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.val_pairDomainMap, F.val_pairDomainMap]
  exact F.pairGerm_comp_algEquiv σ d.2.choose _

name: GroupConfig.isConstructibleOver_eval_eq
statement:
private theorem isConstructibleOver_eval_eq [IsAlgClosed K] {X : Type*} [Finite X]
    (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ) (e₁ e₂ : μ → X) (e : ι → X) :
    IsConstructibleOver k {Z : X → K | F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim (Z ∘ e₁) (Z ∘ e)) ∧
      F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim (Z ∘ e₂) (Z ∘ e)) ∧
      F.eval (Sum.elim (Z ∘ e₁) (Z ∘ e)) = F.eval (Sum.elim (Z ∘ e₂) (Z ∘ e))}
proof:
:= by
  have hG : IsConstructibleOver k {z : (X ⊕ κ) → K |
      (F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim ((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ e₁) ((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ e)) ∧
        F.eval (Sum.elim ((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ e₁) ((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ e)) = z ∘ Sum.inr) ∧
      (F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim ((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ e₂) ((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ e)) ∧
        F.eval (Sum.elim ((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ e₂) ((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ e)) = z ∘ Sum.inr)} :=
    (F.isConstructibleOver_graph_comp (Sum.inl ∘ e₁) (Sum.inl ∘ e) Sum.inr).inter
      (F.isConstructibleOver_graph_comp (Sum.inl ∘ e₂) (Sum.inl ∘ e) Sum.inr)
  convert hG.exists (φ := fun Z s ↦
    (F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim (Z ∘ e₁) (Z ∘ e)) ∧ F.eval (Sum.elim (Z ∘ e₁) (Z ∘ e)) = s) ∧
    (F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim (Z ∘ e₂) (Z ∘ e)) ∧ F.eval (Sum.elim (Z ∘ e₂) (Z ∘ e)) = s))
    using 1
  ext Z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩
    exact ⟨_, ⟨h₁, rfl⟩, h₂, h₃.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨s, ⟨h₁, rfl⟩, h₂, h₃⟩
    exact ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃.symm⟩

name: GroupConfig.isConstructibleOver_stabilizerInner
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_stabilizerInner [Fintype P] [Fintype μ] (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ)
    (c : μ → K) (w : Word k P a a) (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a'))
    {L₀ : IntermediateField k K} (hw : w.HasSamples L₀)
    (hFt : HasGenericSamples L₀ a' (Fintype.card μ))
    (hsrc : HasGenericSamples L₀ a (Fintype.card ((P ⊕ μ) ⊕ μ))) :
    IsConstructibleOver (↥L₀) (stabilizerInner F c w hdim)
proof:
:= by
  let φ : (((P ⊕ ι) ⊕ μ) → K) → (μ → K) → Prop := fun z u' ↦
    InLocus (k := k) c u' ∧
    (∃ hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' u', Germ.IsInvertible (F.parameterGerm hu)) ∧
    (stabWord w F hdim).IsInvertiblyAdmissible
      (Sum.elim (Sum.elim ((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) (z ∘ Sum.inr)) u') ∧
    (∃ hu' : F.IsAdmissible a a' u', (stabWord w F hdim).IsGerm
      (Sum.elim (Sum.elim ((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) (z ∘ Sum.inr)) u') (F.parameterGerm hu')) ∧
    F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim u' ((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr)) ∧
    F.IsDefinedAt (Sum.elim (z ∘ Sum.inr) ((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr)) ∧
    F.eval (Sum.elim u' ((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr)) =
      F.eval (Sum.elim (z ∘ Sum.inr) ((z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr))
  
  let π : ((P ⊕ μ) ⊕ μ) → (((P ⊕ ι) ⊕ μ) ⊕ μ) :=
    Sum.elim (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl) (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr)) Sum.inr
  have hπ (Z : (((P ⊕ ι) ⊕ μ) ⊕ μ) → K) : Z ∘ π =
      Sum.elim (Sum.elim (((Z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inl) ((Z ∘ Sum.inl) ∘ Sum.inr))
        (Z ∘ Sum.inr) := by
    funext q
    rcases q with (p | m) | m <;> rfl
  have hW := (isConstructibleOver_groupWitness F c w hdim hw hFt hsrc).preimage_comp π
  have hE := (isConstructibleOver_eval_eq (K := K) F (Sum.inr : μ → ((P ⊕ ι) ⊕ μ) ⊕ μ)
    (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr)).extend_base (L := ↥L₀)
  have hT : IsConstructibleOver (↥L₀)
      {Z : (((P ⊕ ι) ⊕ μ) ⊕ μ) → K | φ (Z ∘ Sum.inl) (Z ∘ Sum.inr)} := by
    convert hW.inter hE using 1
    ext Z
    simp only [φ, groupWitness, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage]
    rw [hπ Z]
    simp only [and_assoc, Sum.elim_comp_inr]
    rfl
  exact hT.exists (φ := φ)

name: GroupConfig.isConstructibleOver_stabilizerRel
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_stabilizerRel [Fintype P] [Fintype ι] [Fintype μ]
    (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ) (c : μ → K) (w : Word k P a a)
    (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a')) {L₀ : IntermediateField k K}
    (hL₀ : IsSmall k (L₀ : Set K)) (hw : w.HasSamples L₀)
    (hFt : HasGenericSamples L₀ a' (Fintype.card μ))
    (hsrc : HasGenericSamples L₀ a (Fintype.card ((P ⊕ μ) ⊕ μ)))
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (t : α → μ → K) (ht : ∀ i, IsGenericOver L₀ c (t i))
    (hind : erk k (L₀ : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t i)) = ∑ i, erk k (L₀ : Set K) (range (t i)))
    (hr : 2 * Fintype.card (P ⊕ ι) + 1 ≤ Fintype.card α) :
    IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k ((L₀ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (t i))))
      (stabilizerRel L₀ F c w hdim)
proof:
:= by
  have h := constructible_generic_quantifier L₀ hL₀ c t ht hind hr
    (isConstructibleOver_stabilizerInner F c w hdim hw hFt hsrc)
  have hbase (S : Set K) : (racl (↥L₀) S).restrictScalars k = racl k ((L₀ : Set K) ∪ S) :=
    SetLike.coe_injective (racl_base_coe L₀ S)
  refine IsConstructibleOver.of_restrictScalars_eq (restrictScalars_adjoin k L₀ _) ?_
  convert h using 1
  ext e
  simp only [stabilizerRel, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hbase]

name: GroupConfig.isConstructibleOver_stabilizerFibre
statement:
theorem isConstructibleOver_stabilizerFibre [Fintype P] [Fintype ι] [Fintype μ]
    (F : QuasiRational k (μ ⊕ ι) κ) (c : μ → K) (w : Word k P a a)
    (hdim : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range a')) {L₀ : IntermediateField k K}
    (hL₀ : IsSmall k (L₀ : Set K)) (hw : w.HasSamples L₀)
    (hFt : HasGenericSamples L₀ a' (Fintype.card μ))
    (hsrc : HasGenericSamples L₀ a (Fintype.card ((P ⊕ μ) ⊕ μ)))
    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (t : α → μ → K) (ht : ∀ i, IsGenericOver L₀ c (t i))
    (hind : erk k (L₀ : Set K) (⋃ i, range (t i)) = ∑ i, erk k (L₀ : Set K) (range (t i)))
    (hr : 2 * Fintype.card (P ⊕ ι) + 1 ≤ Fintype.card α) (y₀ : ι → K) :
    IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k (((L₀ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (t i)) ∪ range y₀)))
      {d : P → K | Sum.elim d y₀ ∈ stabilizerRel L₀ F c w hdim}
proof:
:= by
  let E := adjoin k (((L₀ : Set K) ∪ ⋃ i, range (t i)) ∪ range y₀)
  have h : IsConstructibleOver (↥E) (stabilizerRel L₀ F c w hdim) :=
    IsConstructibleOver.of_le_intermediateField (adjoin.mono k _ _ subset_union_left)
      (isConstructibleOver_stabilizerRel F c w hdim hL₀ hw hFt hsrc t ht hind hr)
  
  let q : (P ⊕ ι) → MvPolynomial P ↥E := Sum.elim MvPolynomial.X
    fun j ↦ MvPolynomial.C ⟨y₀ j, subset_adjoin k _ (Or.inr ⟨j, rfl⟩)⟩
  convert h.preimage_polynomial q using 1
  ext d
  have hq : (fun i ↦ MvPolynomial.aeval d (q i)) = Sum.elim d y₀ := by
    funext i
    rcases i with i | i
    · exact MvPolynomial.aeval_X _ _
    · exact MvPolynomial.aeval_C _ _
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_preimage, hq]

name: GroupConfig.stabilizerRel_eq_of_le
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  have hle : racl k ((L₀ : Set K) ∪ range e) ≤ racl k ((L₁ : Set K) ∪ range e) :=
    racl_mono (k := k) (union_subset_union_left _ hL₀₁)
  constructor
  · intro h v hv
    exact h v (hv.of_le hle)
  · intro h v hv
    have hs : IsSmall k ((racl k ((L₁ : Set K) ∪ range e) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
      (hL₁.union (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range e))).racl
    
    obtain ⟨v', hv'⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hs c
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := (hv'.of_le hle).exists_algEquiv hv
    let σ₀ : K ≃ₐ[↥L₀] K :=
      { σ.toRingEquiv with
        commutes' := fun x ↦ σ.commutes ⟨x, subset_racl k _ (Or.inl x.2)⟩ }
    have he : ⇑σ₀ ∘ Sum.elim e v' = Sum.elim e v := by
      funext i
      rcases i with i | i
      · exact σ.commutes ⟨e i, subset_racl k _ (Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩)⟩
      · exact hσ i
    rw [← he]
    exact (hin.mem_comp_algEquiv_iff σ₀ _).2 (h v' hv')

name: GroupConfig.eval_eq_evalGen
proof:
:=
  (F.eval_parameterGerm hu hy).symm.trans ((F.parameterGerm hu).evalGen_eq
    (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range u)).racl (F.cb_parameterGerm_le hu) hy).symm

name: GroupConfig.isGenericOver_racl_of_mem_orbit
statement:
private theorem isGenericOver_racl_of_mem_orbit [Finite μ] {f₀ g : Germ k a a'}
    (hg : g ∈ Germ.orbit f₀)
    {c u : μ → K} (hc : adjoin k (range c) = f₀.cb) (hu : InLocus (k := k) c u)
    (hcb : g.cb ≤ racl k (range u)) {y : ι → K} (hy : IsGen k a y)
    (hind : IndepOver k ∅ (g.cb : Set K) (range y)) :
    IsGenericOver (racl k (range u)) a y
proof:
:= by
  refine hy.isGenericOver_racl (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range u))
    (indepOver_of_erk_eq (finite_range u)
      (le_antisymm (erk_base_mono k (empty_subset _) _) ?_)).symm
  have hle := erk_le_of_inLocus (IsSmall.of_finite (k := k) finite_empty).racl hu
  rw [erk_racl_base] at hle
  calc erk k ∅ (range u) ≤ erk k ∅ (range c) := hle
    _ = erk k ∅ (f₀.cb : Set K) := by rw [← hc, erk_adjoin_eq]
    _ = erk k ∅ (g.cb : Set K) := (Germ.erk_cb_eq_of_mem_orbit hg).symm
    _ = erk k (∅ ∪ range y) (g.cb : Set K) := (Germ.erk_cb_eq_of_indepOver hind).symm
    _ ≤ erk k (∅ ∪ range y) (racl k ((∅ ∪ range y) ∪ range u) : Set K) :=
      erk_mono k _ fun x hx ↦ racl_mono (k := k) subset_union_right (hcb hx)
    _ = erk k (∅ ∪ range y) (range u) := erk_racl k _ _

name: GroupConfig.mem_stabilizerRel_iff
proof:
:= by
  have hG := hw.val_mem γ
  have hcb : ((hw.val γ).cb : Set K) ∪ range y₀ ⊆
      (racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ range (Sum.elim d y₀)) : Set K) :=
    union_subset (fun x hx ↦ racl_mono (k := k)
      (show range d ⊆ (M : Set K) ∪ range (Sum.elim d y₀) from
        fun _ ⟨i, hi⟩ ↦ Or.inr ⟨Sum.inl i, hi⟩) (hd.cb_le hx))
      fun _ ⟨i, hi⟩ ↦ subset_racl k _ (Or.inr ⟨Sum.inr i, hi⟩)
  have hs : IsSmall k
      ((racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ range (Sum.elim d y₀)) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (hM.union (IsSmall.of_finite (finite_range _))).racl
                                                                                            
                                   
  have key (v : μ → K) (hv : IsGenericOver (racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ range (Sum.elim d y₀))) c v) :
      ∃ hv' : F.IsAdmissible a a' v, F.parameterGerm hv' ∈ Germ.orbit f₀ ∧
        IndepOver k ∅ ((F.parameterGerm hv').cb : Set K) (((hw.val γ).cb : Set K) ∪ range y₀) := by
    obtain ⟨hu, hmem⟩ := QuasiRational.exists_parameterGerm_mem_orbit_of_isGen hF hv.isGen
    refine ⟨hu, hmem, ((indepOver_racl_left_iff.2 hv.indepOver).mono_left ?_).mono_right hcb⟩
    rw [empty_union]
    exact F.cb_parameterGerm_le hu
  constructor
  · intro hrel
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hs c
    obtain ⟨hv', hvo, hvind⟩ := key v hv
    obtain ⟨u', hu'V, -, -, ⟨hu', g₀, hv'', hg₀, hgeq⟩, -, -, heq⟩ := hrel v hv
    obtain rfl : g₀ = hw.val γ := ((w.isGerm_mapParams_iff _ _ _).1 hg₀).unique hd
    have hgeq' : F.parameterGerm hu' = Germ.comp (F.parameterGerm hv') (hw.val γ) := hgeq
    have hgo : F.parameterGerm hu' ∈ Germ.orbit f₀ := hgeq' ▸
      (hb.comp_mem_orbit hδ₀ hvo hG (hvind.mono_right subset_union_left).symm).1
    have hgind : IndepOver k ∅ ((F.parameterGerm hu').cb : Set K) (range y₀) := by
      rw [hgeq']
      exact (hb.indepOver_cb_comp hδ₀ hw hvo hG hvind).mono_right subset_union_right
    have hy₁ := isGenericOver_racl_of_mem_orbit hgo hc hu'V (F.cb_parameterGerm_le hu') hy₀
      hgind
    have hy₂ := isGenericOver_racl_of_mem_orbit hvo hc hv.inLocus (F.cb_parameterGerm_le hv')
      hy₀ (hvind.mono_right subset_union_right)
    rw [hb.smul_iota_eq_iff hδ₀ hw γ hy₀ hvo hvind, ← hgeq', ← eval_eq_evalGen F hu' hy₁,
      ← eval_eq_evalGen F hv' hy₂]
    exact heq
  · intro hfix v hv
    obtain ⟨hv', hvo, hvind⟩ := key v hv
    obtain ⟨⟨τ, hτ⟩, -⟩ :=
      hb.comp_mem_orbit hδ₀ hvo hG (hvind.mono_right subset_union_left).symm
    obtain ⟨hu', hu'g⟩ := hF τ
    have hgeq : F.parameterGerm hu' = Germ.comp (F.parameterGerm hv') (hw.val γ) :=
      hu'g.trans hτ
    have hgo : F.parameterGerm hu' ∈ Germ.orbit f₀ := ⟨τ, hu'g.symm⟩
    have hgind : IndepOver k ∅ ((F.parameterGerm hu').cb : Set K) (range y₀) := by
      rw [hgeq]
      exact (hb.indepOver_cb_comp hδ₀ hw hvo hG hvind).mono_right subset_union_right
    have hu'V : InLocus (k := k) c (⇑τ ∘ c) := IsGen.inLocus (IsGen.map (rfl : IsGen k c c) τ)
    have hy₁ := isGenericOver_racl_of_mem_orbit hgo hc hu'V (F.cb_parameterGerm_le hu') hy₀
      hgind
    have hy₂ := isGenericOver_racl_of_mem_orbit hvo hc hv.inLocus (F.cb_parameterGerm_le hv')
      hy₀ (hvind.mono_right subset_union_right)
    have hval : F.eval (Sum.elim (⇑τ ∘ c) y₀) = F.eval (Sum.elim v y₀) := by
      rw [eval_eq_evalGen F hu' hy₁, eval_eq_evalGen F hv' hy₂, hgeq]
      exact (hb.smul_iota_eq_iff hδ₀ hw γ hy₀ hvo hvind).1 hfix
    exact ⟨⇑τ ∘ c, hu'V, ⟨hu', Germ.isInvertible_of_mem_orbit hb.isInvertible hgo⟩,
      ⟨(w.isInvertiblyAdmissible_mapParams_iff _ _).2 hdInv, hv',
        Germ.isInvertible_of_mem_orbit hb.isInvertible hvo⟩,
      ⟨hu', hw.val γ, hv', (w.isGerm_mapParams_iff _ _ _).2 hd, hgeq⟩,
      (hu' y₀ hy₁).1, (hv' y₀ hy₂).1, hval⟩

name: GroupConfig.HasGenericSamples.mono
statement:
theorem HasGenericSamples.mono {L L' : IntermediateField k K} (h : L ≤ L')
    {ι : Type*} {a : ι → K} {N : ℕ} (ha : HasGenericSamples L a N) :
    HasGenericSamples L' a N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, t, ht, hr, hn, htL⟩ := ha
  exact ⟨n, t, ht, hr, hn, fun i ↦ (htL i).trans h⟩

name: GroupConfig.Word.HasSamples.mono
statement:
theorem Word.HasSamples.mono {L L' : IntermediateField k K} (h : L ≤ L')
    {κ : Type v} {b : κ → K} {w : Word k P a b} (hw : w.HasSamples L) :
    w.HasSamples L'
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => trivial
  | fwd w c F ρ hdim ih => exact ⟨ih hw.1, hw.2.mono h⟩
  | inv w c F ρ hdim ih => exact ⟨ih hw.1, hw.2.mono h⟩

name: GroupConfig.Word.exists_fresh_samples
statement:
theorem Word.exists_fresh_samples {κ : Type v} {b : κ → K} (w : Word k P a b)
    (M : IntermediateField k K) (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K)) :
    ∃ S : Set K, S.Finite ∧ IndepOver k ∅ S (M : Set K) ∧
      w.HasSamples (adjoin k S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have extend {τ : Type v} [Finite τ] (c : τ → K) (N : ℕ) (S : Set K)
      (hS : S.Finite) (hfresh : IndepOver k ∅ S (M : Set K)) :
      ∃ S' : Set K, S'.Finite ∧ S ⊆ S' ∧ IndepOver k ∅ S' (M : Set K) ∧
        HasGenericSamples (adjoin k S') c N := by
    have hN : IsSmall k ((racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ S) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
      (hM.union (IsSmall.of_finite hS)).racl
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hr, htfresh⟩ := exists_fresh_genericSamples _ hN c (2 * N + 1)
    let T : Set K := ⋃ i, range (t i)
    have hT : T.Finite := finite_iUnion fun i ↦ finite_range (t i)
    have htSM : IndepOver k ∅ T (S ∪ (M : Set K)) := by
      rw [union_comm]
      exact htfresh.mono_right (subset_racl k _)
    refine ⟨S ∪ T, hS.union hT, subset_union_left, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [union_comm] using hfresh.union_left htSM
    · exact ⟨_, t, ht, hr, le_rfl, fun i ↦
        (subset_iUnion (fun j ↦ range (t j)) i).trans
          (subset_union_right.trans (subset_adjoin k _))⟩
  induction w with
  | nil =>
    refine ⟨∅, finite_empty, ?_, trivial⟩
    intro s hs _
    obtain rfl : s = ∅ := subset_empty_iff.1 hs
    simp only [erk_empty]
  | @fwd κ τ μ _ _ _ b w c F ρ hdim ih =>
    obtain ⟨S, hS, hfresh, hw⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨S', hS', hSS', hfresh', hc⟩ := extend c (Fintype.card μ) S hS hfresh
    exact ⟨S', hS', hfresh', hw.mono (adjoin.mono k _ _ hSS'), hc⟩
  | @inv κ τ μ _ _ _ b w c F ρ hdim ih =>
    obtain ⟨S, hS, hfresh, hw⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨S', hS', hSS', hfresh', hb⟩ := extend b (Fintype.card μ) S hS hfresh
    exact ⟨S', hS', hfresh', hw.mono (adjoin.mono k _ _ hSS'), hb⟩

name: GroupConfig.Word.exists_fresh_samples_with
statement:
theorem Word.exists_fresh_samples_with {κ : Type v} [Finite κ] {b : κ → K}
    (w : Word k P a b) (N N' : ℕ) (M : IntermediateField k K)
    (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K)) :
    ∃ S : Set K, S.Finite ∧ IndepOver k ∅ S (M : Set K) ∧
      w.HasSamples (adjoin k S) ∧ HasGenericSamples (adjoin k S) a N ∧
      HasGenericSamples (adjoin k S) b N'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hfresh, hw⟩ := w.exists_fresh_samples M hM
  have hN : IsSmall k ((racl k ((M : Set K) ∪ S) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (hM.union (IsSmall.of_finite hS)).racl
  obtain ⟨t, s, ht, hrt, hs, hrs, -, htsfresh⟩ := exists_joint_fresh_genericSamples
    _ hN a b (2 * N + 1) (2 * N' + 1)
  let T : Set K := (⋃ i, range (t i)) ∪ ⋃ i, range (s i)
  have hT : T.Finite :=
    (finite_iUnion fun i ↦ finite_range (t i)).union
      (finite_iUnion fun i ↦ finite_range (s i))
  have htSM : IndepOver k ∅ T (S ∪ (M : Set K)) := by
    rw [union_comm]
    exact htsfresh.mono_right (subset_racl k _)
  refine ⟨S ∪ T, hS.union hT, ?_, hw.mono (adjoin.mono k _ _ subset_union_left), ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [union_comm] using hfresh.union_left htSM
  · refine ⟨_, t, ht, hrt, le_rfl, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    exact (subset_iUnion (fun j ↦ range (t j)) i).trans
      (subset_union_left.trans (subset_union_right.trans (subset_adjoin k _)))
  · refine ⟨_, s, hs, hrs, le_rfl, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
    exact (subset_iUnion (fun j ↦ range (s j)) i).trans
      (subset_union_right.trans (subset_union_right.trans (subset_adjoin k _)))

name: GroupConfig.Word.exists_fresh_constructible_eq_parameterGerm
statement:
theorem Word.exists_fresh_constructible_eq_parameterGerm [Finite P]
    {κ : Type v} [Finite κ] {b : κ → K} (w : Word k P a b)
    {μ' : Type v} [Finite μ'] (F' : QuasiRational k (μ' ⊕ ι) κ) (ρ' : μ' → P)
    (hdim' : erk k ∅ (range a) = erk k ∅ (range b))
    (M : IntermediateField k K) (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K)) :
    ∃ S : Set K, S.Finite ∧ IndepOver k ∅ S (M : Set K) ∧
      IsConstructibleOver (↥(adjoin k S)) {u : P → K | w.IsInvertiblyAdmissible u ∧
        ∃ hu' : F'.IsAdmissible a b (u ∘ ρ'), w.IsGerm u (F'.parameterGerm hu')}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ := Fintype.ofFinite P
  let _ := Fintype.ofFinite μ'
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hfresh, hw, ha, hb⟩ :=
    w.exists_fresh_samples_with (Fintype.card P) (Fintype.card μ') M hM
  exact ⟨S, hS, hfresh, w.isConstructibleOver_eq_parameterGerm F' ρ' hdim' hw hb ha⟩

name: GroupConfig.IsGen.inLocus
statement: theorem IsGen.inLocus {c u : μ → K} (h : IsGen k c u) : InLocus (k := k) c u
proof:
:= by
  change locusIdeal k c ≤ idealOf K u
  have h1 : locusIdeal k u = locusIdeal k c := by
    unfold locusIdeal
    rw [show idealOf k u = idealOf k c from h]
  rw [← h1]
  exact inLocus_self (k := k) u

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.exists_parameterGerm_mem_orbit_of_isGen
statement:
theorem exists_parameterGerm_mem_orbit_of_isGen
    (hF : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K, ∃ hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' (⇑σ ∘ c),
      F.parameterGerm hu = f₀.map σ)
    {v : μ → K} (hv : IsGen k c v) :
    ∃ hv' : F.IsAdmissible a a' v, F.parameterGerm hv' ∈ Germ.orbit f₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, -, hσ⟩ := exists_ambientAutomorphism_of_idealOf_eq (k := k)
    (show idealOf k c = idealOf k v from hv.symm)
  obtain ⟨hu, hug⟩ := hF σ
  obtain rfl : ⇑σ ∘ c = v := funext hσ
  exact ⟨hu, σ, hug.symm⟩

name: GroupConfig.QuasiRational.parameterGerm_mem_orbit_of_inLocus
statement:
theorem parameterGerm_mem_orbit_of_inLocus (hc : adjoin k (range c) = f₀.cb)
    (hF : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K, ∃ hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' (⇑σ ∘ c),
      F.parameterGerm hu = f₀.map σ)
    {u' : μ → K} (hu' : F.IsAdmissible a a' u') (hV : InLocus (k := k) c u')
    (hrk : erk k ∅ (f₀.cb : Set K) ≤ erk k ∅ ((F.parameterGerm hu').cb : Set K)) :
    F.parameterGerm hu' ∈ Germ.orbit f₀
proof:
:= by
  have hs : IsSmall k ((racl k (∅ : Set K) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    (IsSmall.of_finite finite_empty).racl
  have hle := erk_le_of_inLocus hs hV
  rw [erk_racl_base] at hle
  have hge : erk k ∅ (range c) ≤ erk k ∅ (range u') :=
    calc erk k ∅ (range c) = erk k ∅ (f₀.cb : Set K) := by rw [← hc, erk_adjoin_eq]
      _ ≤ erk k ∅ ((F.parameterGerm hu').cb : Set K) := hrk
      _ ≤ erk k ∅ (racl k (∅ ∪ range u') : Set K) := erk_mono k _ fun x hx ↦ by
          rw [empty_union]
          exact F.cb_parameterGerm_le hu' hx
      _ = erk k ∅ (range u') := erk_racl k _ _
  have hgen : IsGenericOver (racl k (∅ : Set K)) c u' := by
    refine (isGenericOver_iff_erk_eq hs hV).2 ?_
    rw [erk_racl_base]
    exact le_antisymm hle hge
  obtain ⟨hu'', hmem⟩ := exists_parameterGerm_mem_orbit_of_isGen hF hgen.isGen
  exact hmem

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.exists_indepOver_of_isGenericOver
statement:
private theorem exists_indepOver_of_isGenericOver
    (hF : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K, ∃ hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' (⇑σ ∘ c),
      F.parameterGerm hu = f₀.map σ)
    {γ : Germ k a a} {M : IntermediateField k K} (hγM : γ.cb ≤ M) {v : μ → K}
    (hv : IsGenericOver M c v) :
    ∃ hv' : F.IsAdmissible a a' v, F.parameterGerm hv' ∈ orbit f₀ ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ (γ.cb : Set K) ((F.parameterGerm hv').cb : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hv', hmem⟩ := QuasiRational.exists_parameterGerm_mem_orbit_of_isGen hF hv.isGen
  refine ⟨hv', hmem, ?_⟩
  have h := indepOver_racl_left_iff.2 hv.indepOver
  rw [empty_union] at h
  exact ((h.mono_left (F.cb_parameterGerm_le hv')).mono_right hγM).symm

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.forall_isGenericOver_of_mem_prodSet
statement:
theorem forall_isGenericOver_of_mem_prodSet
    (hF : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K, ∃ hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' (⇑σ ∘ c),
      F.parameterGerm hu = f₀.map σ)
    {γ : Germ k a a} (hγ : γ ∈ IsHW.prodSet δ₀) {M : IntermediateField k K} (hγM : γ.cb ≤ M) :
    ∀ v, IsGenericOver M c v → ∃ (hv : F.IsAdmissible a a' v) (u' : μ → K)
      (hu' : F.IsAdmissible a a' u'), InLocus (k := k) c u' ∧
        IsInvertible (F.parameterGerm hu') ∧
        Germ.comp (F.parameterGerm hv) γ = F.parameterGerm hu'
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨hv', hmem, hind⟩ := exists_indepOver_of_isGenericOver hF hγM hv
  obtain ⟨⟨τ, hτ⟩, -⟩ := hb.comp_mem_orbit hδ₀ hmem hγ hind
  obtain ⟨hu', hu'g⟩ := hF τ
  exact ⟨hv', ⇑τ ∘ c, hu', IsGen.inLocus (IsGen.map (rfl : IsGen k c c) τ),
    isInvertible_of_mem_orbit hb.isInvertible ⟨τ, hu'g.symm⟩, (hu'g.trans hτ).symm⟩

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.mem_prodSet_of_isGenericOver
statement:
theorem mem_prodSet_of_isGenericOver (hc : adjoin k (range c) = f₀.cb)
    (hF : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K, ∃ hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' (⇑σ ∘ c),
      F.parameterGerm hu = f₀.map σ)
    {γ : Germ k a a} (hγinv : IsInvertible γ) {M : IntermediateField k K} (hγM : γ.cb ≤ M)
    {v : μ → K} (hv : IsGenericOver M c v)
    (hwit : ∃ (hv : F.IsAdmissible a a' v) (u' : μ → K) (hu' : F.IsAdmissible a a' u'),
      InLocus (k := k) c u' ∧ Germ.comp (F.parameterGerm hv) γ = F.parameterGerm hu') :
    γ ∈ IsHW.prodSet δ₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hv', hmem, hind⟩ := exists_indepOver_of_isGenericOver hF hγM hv
  obtain ⟨hv₀, u', hu', hV, hcomp⟩ := hwit
  have hcomp' : Germ.comp (F.parameterGerm hv') γ = F.parameterGerm hu' := hcomp
  obtain ⟨γ', hγ'⟩ := hγinv
  
  have hrk : erk k ∅ (f₀.cb : Set K) ≤ erk k ∅ ((F.parameterGerm hu').cb : Set K) := by
    rw [← hcomp']
    calc erk k ∅ (f₀.cb : Set K) = erk k ∅ ((F.parameterGerm hv').cb : Set K) :=
          (erk_cb_eq_of_mem_orbit hmem).symm
      _ = erk k (∅ ∪ γ.cb) ((F.parameterGerm hv').cb : Set K) :=
          (erk_cb_eq_of_indepOver hind.symm).symm
      _ = erk k (∅ ∪ γ.cb) ((Germ.comp (F.parameterGerm hv') γ).cb : Set K) :=
          (erk_cb_comp_eq_of_isInverse ∅ hγ' _).symm
      _ ≤ erk k ∅ ((Germ.comp (F.parameterGerm hv') γ).cb : Set K) :=
          erk_base_mono k (empty_subset _) _
  have hfγ := QuasiRational.parameterGerm_mem_orbit_of_inLocus hc hF hu' hV hrk
  rw [← hcomp'] at hfγ
  obtain ⟨g₁, hg₁⟩ := isInvertible_of_mem_orbit hb.isInvertible hmem
  refine (hb.mem_prodSet_iff hδ₀).2 ⟨_, hmem, _, hfγ, g₁, hg₁, ?_⟩
  rw [← comp_assoc, hg₁.1, id_comp]

name: GroupConfig.Germ.IsHWBij.mem_prodSet_iff_forall_isGenericOver
statement:
theorem mem_prodSet_iff_forall_isGenericOver (hc : adjoin k (range c) = f₀.cb)
    (hF : ∀ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K, ∃ hu : F.IsAdmissible a a' (⇑σ ∘ c),
      F.parameterGerm hu = f₀.map σ)
    {γ : Germ k a a} (hγinv : IsInvertible γ) {M : IntermediateField k K}
    (hM : IsSmall k (M : Set K)) (hγM : γ.cb ≤ M) :
    γ ∈ IsHW.prodSet δ₀ ↔ ∀ v, IsGenericOver M c v → ∃ (hv : F.IsAdmissible a a' v)
      (u' : μ → K) (hu' : F.IsAdmissible a a' u'), InLocus (k := k) c u' ∧
        IsInvertible (F.parameterGerm hu') ∧
        Germ.comp (F.parameterGerm hv) γ = F.parameterGerm hu'
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hγ ↦ hb.forall_isGenericOver_of_mem_prodSet hδ₀ hF hγ hγM, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := exists_isGenericOver hM c
  obtain ⟨hv', u', hu', hV, -, hcomp⟩ := h v hv
  exact hb.mem_prodSet_of_isGenericOver hδ₀ hc hF hγinv hγM hv ⟨hv', u', hu', hV, hcomp⟩

name: AclGeom.mvPolynomial_eq_C_of_isIntegral
statement:
theorem mvPolynomial_eq_C_of_isIntegral {p : MvPolynomial σ F} (hp : IsIntegral F p) :
    p = C (p.coeff 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine totalDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C.1 ?_
  by_contra hD
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hD (by simp)
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqp⟩ := hp
  have hn : q.natDegree ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [Polynomial.eq_one_of_monic_natDegree_zero hq h0, Polynomial.eval₂_one] at hqp
    exact one_ne_zero hqp
  
  have hpow : ∀ k : ℕ, (p ^ k).totalDegree = k * p.totalDegree := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => simp
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [pow_succ, totalDegree_mul_of_isDomain (pow_ne_zero k hp0) hp0, ih, add_one_mul]
  
  have heval : Polynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap F (MvPolynomial σ F)) p q =
      p ^ q.natDegree + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range q.natDegree, C (q.coeff i) * p ^ i := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hq.as_sum]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval₂_add, Polynomial.eval₂_X_pow, Polynomial.eval₂_finsetSum,
      Polynomial.eval₂_mul, Polynomial.eval₂_C, MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
  
  have hlt : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range q.natDegree, C (q.coeff i) * p ^ i).totalDegree <
      (p ^ q.natDegree).totalDegree := by
    rw [hpow]
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt (totalDegree_finsetSum _ _) ?_
    rw [Finset.sup_lt_iff (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Nat.mul_ne_zero hn hD))]
    intro i hi
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt (totalDegree_mul _ _) ?_
    rw [totalDegree_C, zero_add, hpow]
    exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (Finset.mem_range.1 hi) (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hD)
  have hdeg := totalDegree_add_eq_left_of_totalDegree_lt hlt
  rw [← heval, hqp, totalDegree_zero, hpow] at hdeg
  exact Nat.mul_ne_zero hn hD hdeg.symm

name: AclGeom.mem_range_algebraMap_of_isAlgebraic_fractionRing
statement:
theorem mem_range_algebraMap_of_isAlgebraic_fractionRing
    {x : FractionRing (MvPolynomial σ F)} (hx : IsAlgebraic F x) :
    ∃ c : F, algebraMap F (FractionRing (MvPolynomial σ F)) c = x
proof:
:= by
  have hint : IsIntegral F x := isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral.1 hx
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff.1
    (hint.tower_top (A := MvPolynomial σ F))
  have hp : IsIntegral F p := by
    refine (isIntegral_algHom_iff
      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F (MvPolynomial σ F) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial σ F)))
      (IsFractionRing.injective _ _)).1 ?_
    exact hint
  refine ⟨p.coeff 0, ?_⟩
  rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F (MvPolynomial σ F) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial σ F)),
    MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq, ← mvPolynomial_eq_C_of_isIntegral hp]

name: AclGeom.not_isSquare_algebraMap_C_mul_X
statement:
theorem not_isSquare_algebraMap_C_mul_X {c : F} (hc : c ≠ 0) (i : σ) :
    ¬ IsSquare (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ F) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial σ F)) (C c * X i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
  obtain ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (A := MvPolynomial σ F) y
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hb
  have hbK : algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ F) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial σ F)) b ≠ 0 :=
    IsFractionRing.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors hb
  have hC : (C c : MvPolynomial σ F) ≠ 0 := by simpa using hc
  have hcX : (C c * X i : MvPolynomial σ F) ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hC (X_ne_zero i)
  
  have hab : a * a = C c * X i * (b * b) := by
    apply IsFractionRing.injective (MvPolynomial σ F) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial σ F))
    rw [map_mul, map_mul (algebraMap _ _) (C c * X i), hy, map_mul, div_mul_div_comm,
      div_mul_cancel₀ _ (mul_ne_zero hbK hbK)]
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [zero_mul] at hab
    exact mul_ne_zero hcX (mul_ne_zero hb0 hb0) hab.symm
  
  have hdeg := congrArg (degreeOf i) hab
  rw [degreeOf_mul_eq ha0 ha0, degreeOf_mul_eq hcX (mul_ne_zero hb0 hb0),
    degreeOf_mul_eq hC (X_ne_zero i), degreeOf_mul_eq hb0 hb0, degreeOf_C,
    degreeOf_X_self] at hdeg
  omega

name: AclGeom.algebraicIndependent_algebraMap_X
statement:
theorem algebraicIndependent_algebraMap_X (σ : Type*) :
    AlgebraicIndependent k fun i : σ ↦
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ k) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial σ k)) (MvPolynomial.X i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (MvPolynomial.algebraicIndependent_X σ k).map
    (f := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k (MvPolynomial σ k) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial σ k)))
    (Set.injOn_of_injective
      (IsFractionRing.injective (MvPolynomial σ k) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial σ k))))
  exact h

name: AclGeom.not_isAlgebraic_X_div_sq
statement:
theorem not_isAlgebraic_X_div_sq {σ : Type*} (i : σ) (x : FractionRing (MvPolynomial σ k))
    (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    ¬ IsAlgebraic k
      (algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ k) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial σ k)) (MvPolynomial.X i) /
        x ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := mem_range_algebraMap_of_isAlgebraic_fractionRing h
  have hs0 : algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ k) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial σ k))
      (MvPolynomial.X i) ≠ 0 :=
    (map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective _ _)).2 (MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero i)
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [map_zero, eq_comm, div_eq_zero_iff] at hc
    exact hc.elim hs0 (pow_ne_zero 2 hx)
  refine not_isSquare_algebraMap_C_mul_X (inv_ne_zero hc0) i ⟨x, ?_⟩
  rw [map_mul, ← MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq,
    ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k (MvPolynomial σ k) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial σ k)),
    map_inv₀, hc, inv_div, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hs0, sq]

name: AclGeom.mem_racl_iff_exists_poly
statement:
theorem mem_racl_iff_exists_poly {S : Set Ω} {x : Ω} :
    x ∈ racl k S ↔ ∃ p : Polynomial Ω, p ≠ 0 ∧ p.eval x = 0 ∧
      ∀ n, p.coeff n ∈ adjoin k S
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨g, hg0, hgx⟩ := (mem_racl_iff k).1 hx
    refine ⟨g.map (algebraMap (adjoin k S) Ω), ?_, ?_, fun n ↦ ?_⟩
    · exact (Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff
        (algebraMap (adjoin k S) Ω).injective).2 hg0
    · rw [Polynomial.eval_map, ← Polynomial.aeval_def, hgx]
    · rw [Polynomial.coeff_map]
      exact (g.coeff n).2
  · rintro ⟨p, hp0, hpx, hpc⟩
    exact (mem_racl_iff k).2 (isAlgebraic_of_coeff_mem hp0 hpx hpc)

name: AclGeom.algHom_mem_racl_image_iff
statement:
theorem algHom_mem_racl_image_iff {N : Type*} [Field N] [Algebra k N]
    (ι : N →ₐ[k] Ω) {S : Set N} {x : N} :
    ι x ∈ racl k (⇑ι '' S) ↔ x ∈ racl k S
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective ι.toRingHom := ι.toRingHom.injective
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨p, hp0, hpx, hpc⟩ := mem_racl_iff_exists_poly.1 hx
    
    have hadj : adjoin k (⇑ι '' S) = (adjoin k S).map ι :=
      (adjoin_map k S ι).symm
    have hN : ∀ n, p.coeff n ∈ Set.range ι.toRingHom := fun n ↦ by
      have h1 := hpc n
      rw [hadj] at h1
      obtain ⟨c₀, -, hc⟩ := h1
      exact ⟨c₀, hc⟩
    obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀⟩ := (Polynomial.mem_lifts (f := ι.toRingHom) p).1 <|
      (Polynomial.lifts_iff_coeff_lifts p).2 hN
    refine mem_racl_iff_exists_poly.2 ⟨q₀, ?_, ?_, fun n ↦ ?_⟩
    · intro h0
      rw [h0, Polynomial.map_zero] at hq₀
      exact hp0 hq₀.symm
    · have h1 : ι.toRingHom (q₀.eval x) = p.eval (ι x) := by
        rw [← hq₀, Polynomial.eval_map,
          show ι x = ι.toRingHom x from rfl, Polynomial.eval₂_at_apply]
      rw [hpx] at h1
      exact hinj (by rw [h1, map_zero])
    · have h1 : ι.toRingHom (q₀.coeff n) = p.coeff n := by
        rw [← hq₀, Polynomial.coeff_map]
      have h2 := hpc n
      rw [hadj] at h2
      obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀, hc⟩ := h2
      have h3 : c₀ = q₀.coeff n := hinj (hc.trans h1.symm)
      rwa [← h3]
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨q₀, hq0, hqx, hqc⟩ :=
      (mem_racl_iff_exists_poly (S := S) (x := x)).1 hx
    refine mem_racl_iff_exists_poly.2
      ⟨q₀.map ι.toRingHom, ?_, ?_, fun n ↦ ?_⟩
    · exact (Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff hinj).2 hq0
    · rw [Polynomial.eval_map, show ι x = ι.toRingHom x from rfl,
        Polynomial.eval₂_at_apply, hqx, map_zero]
    · rw [Polynomial.coeff_map]
      have h1 : ι.toRingHom (q₀.coeff n) ∈ (adjoin k S).map ι :=
        ⟨q₀.coeff n, hqc n, rfl⟩
      rwa [adjoin_map k S ι] at h1

name: AclGeom.algHom_racl_image_eq_of_racl_eq
statement:
theorem algHom_racl_image_eq_of_racl_eq
    {N : Type*} [Field N] [Algebra k N]
    (ι : N →ₐ[k] Ω) {S T : Set N}
    (h : racl k S = racl k T) :
    racl k (⇑ι '' S) = racl k (⇑ι '' T)
proof:
:= by
  apply racl_congr_of_subset_racl
  · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    apply (algHom_mem_racl_image_iff ι).2
    rw [← h]
    exact subset_racl k S hx
  · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    apply (algHom_mem_racl_image_iff ι).2
    rw [h]
    exact subset_racl k T hx

name: AclGeom.algHom_mem_racl_singleton_iff
statement:
theorem algHom_mem_racl_singleton_iff {N : Type*} [Field N] [Algebra k N]
    (ι : N →ₐ[k] Ω) {w x : N} :
    ι x ∈ racl k ({ι w} : Set Ω) ↔ x ∈ racl k ({w} : Set N)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Set.image_singleton] using
    algHom_mem_racl_image_iff ι (S := ({w} : Set N)) (x := x)

name: AclGeom.algHom_mem_racl_empty_iff
statement:
theorem algHom_mem_racl_empty_iff {N : Type*} [Field N] [Algebra k N]
    (ι : N →ₐ[k] Ω) {x : N} :
    ι x ∈ racl k (∅ : Set Ω) ↔ x ∈ racl k (∅ : Set N)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Set.image_empty] using
    algHom_mem_racl_image_iff ι (S := (∅ : Set N)) (x := x)

name: AclGeom.algHom_mem_racl_singleton_map
statement:
theorem algHom_mem_racl_singleton_map {N : Type*} [Field N] [Algebra k N]
    (ι : N →ₐ[k] Ω) (σ : N ≃ₐ[k] N) {z w : N}
    (h : ι z ∈ racl k ({ι w} : Set Ω)) :
    ι (σ z) ∈ racl k ({ι (σ w)} : Set Ω)
proof:
:= by
  rw [algHom_mem_racl_singleton_iff] at h ⊢
  simpa [Set.image_singleton] using mem_racl_map σ h

name: AclGeom.coe_mem_racl_image_iff
proof:
:=
  algHom_mem_racl_image_iff N.val

name: AclGeom.coe_mem_racl_singleton_iff
statement:
theorem coe_mem_racl_singleton_iff {N : IntermediateField k Ω} {w x : N} :
    (x : Ω) ∈ racl k ({(w : Ω)} : Set Ω) ↔ x ∈ racl k ({w} : Set N)
proof:
:=
  algHom_mem_racl_singleton_iff N.val

name: AclGeom.coe_mem_racl_empty_iff
statement:
theorem coe_mem_racl_empty_iff {N : IntermediateField k Ω} {x : N} :
    (x : Ω) ∈ racl k (∅ : Set Ω) ↔ x ∈ racl k (∅ : Set N)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Set.image_empty] using
    coe_mem_racl_image_iff (S := (∅ : Set N)) (x := x)

name: AclGeom.coe_mem_racl_pair_iff
statement:
theorem coe_mem_racl_pair_iff {N : IntermediateField k Ω} {w₁ w₂ x : N} :
    (x : Ω) ∈ racl k ({(w₁ : Ω), (w₂ : Ω)} : Set Ω) ↔
      x ∈ racl k ({w₁, w₂} : Set N)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Set.image_pair] using
    coe_mem_racl_image_iff (S := ({w₁, w₂} : Set N)) (x := x)

name: AclGeom.mem_racl_base_iff_of_algebraic
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    
    
    have h1 : IsAlgebraic (adjoin (↥K₀) S) z := (mem_racl_iff (↥K₀)).1 hz
    have h2 : z ∈ racl k ((K₀ : Set Ω) ∪ S) := by
      refine mem_racl_iff_exists_poly.2 ?_
      obtain ⟨p, hp0, hpz⟩ := h1
      refine ⟨p.map (algebraMap (adjoin (↥K₀) S) Ω),
        (Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff
          (algebraMap (adjoin (↥K₀) S) Ω).injective).2 hp0,
        ?_, fun n ↦ ?_⟩
      · rw [Polynomial.eval_map, ← Polynomial.aeval_def, hpz]
      · rw [Polynomial.coeff_map]
        have h3 : ((p.coeff n : ↥(adjoin (↥K₀) S)) : Ω) ∈
            (adjoin (↥K₀) S).restrictScalars k :=
          (mem_restrictScalars k).2 (p.coeff n).2
        rwa [restrictScalars_adjoin] at h3
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ h2
    rintro y (hy | hy)
    · exact racl_mono (Set.empty_subset S)
        (mem_racl_empty_of_isAlgebraic (halg y hy))
    · exact subset_racl k S hy
  · intro hz
    exact racl_subset_racl_base K₀ S hz

name: AclGeom.algebraicIndependent_pair_base_of_algebraic
statement:
theorem algebraicIndependent_pair_base_of_algebraic
    {K₀ : IntermediateField k Ω} (halg : ∀ y ∈ K₀, IsAlgebraic k y)
    {x a : Ω} (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, a]) :
    AlgebraicIndependent (↥K₀) ![x, a]
proof:
:= by
  refine algebraicIndependent_pair ?_ ?_
  · rw [mem_racl_base_iff_of_algebraic halg]
    exact AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_pair' hind
  · rw [mem_racl_base_iff_of_algebraic halg]
    exact AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_pair hind

name: AclGeom.coe_mem_racl_singleton_map
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_mem_racl_singleton_iff] at h ⊢
  simpa [Set.image_singleton] using mem_racl_map σ h

name: AclGeom.coe_notMem_racl_empty_map
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  rw [coe_mem_racl_empty_iff] at hmem
  have h2 := mem_racl_map σ.symm hmem
  rw [Set.image_empty, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at h2
  exact h ((coe_mem_racl_empty_iff (N := N)).2 h2)

name: AclGeom.IsRAC.mem_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem IsRAC.mem_of_isAlgebraic {E : IntermediateField k K} (hE : IsRAC E) {x : K}
    (hx : IsAlgebraic E x) : x ∈ E
proof: := hE x hx

name: AclGeom.IsRAC.mem_of_pow_mem
statement:
theorem IsRAC.mem_of_pow_mem {E : IntermediateField k K} (hE : IsRAC E) {x : K}
    {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) (hx : x ^ m ∈ E) : x ∈ E
proof:
:= by
  refine hE x (isAlgebraic_of_coeff_mem
    (p := Polynomial.X ^ m - Polynomial.C (x ^ m))
    (Polynomial.X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm) _) (by simp) fun n ↦ ?_)
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, Polynomial.coeff_C]
  rcases eq_or_ne n m with rfl | hnm
  · simp [hm]
  · rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn0
    · simpa [hnm] using neg_mem hx
    · simp [hnm, hn0]

name: AclGeom.isRAC_iff_racl_eq
statement:
theorem isRAC_iff_racl_eq {E : IntermediateField k K} :
    IsRAC E ↔ racl k (E : Set K) = E
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hE
    refine le_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) (fun x hx ↦ subset_racl k _ hx)
    rw [mem_racl_iff, adjoin_self] at hx
    exact hE x hx
  · intro hE x hx
    rw [← hE, mem_racl_iff, adjoin_self]
    exact hx

name: AclGeom.isRAC_racl
statement: theorem isRAC_racl (S : Set K) : IsRAC (racl k S)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have : x ∈ racl k (racl k S : Set K) := by
    rw [mem_racl_iff, adjoin_self]
    exact hx
  rwa [racl_racl] at this

name: AclGeom.isRAC_top
statement: theorem isRAC_top : IsRAC (⊤ : IntermediateField k K)
proof: := fun _ _ ↦ trivial

name: AclGeom.isRAC_sInf
statement:
theorem isRAC_sInf {s : Set (IntermediateField k K)} (hs : ∀ E ∈ s, IsRAC E) :
    IsRAC (sInf s)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [mem_sInf]
  intro E hE
  exact hs E hE x (isAlgebraic_of_le (sInf_le hE) hx)

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.mem_val
statement: @[simp] theorem mem_val {E : ClosedIF k K} {x : K} : x ∈ E.1 ↔ x ∈ E
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.coe_val
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_val (E : ClosedIF k K) : (E.1 : Set K) = (E : Set K)
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.isRAC
statement: theorem isRAC (E : ClosedIF k K) : IsRAC E.1

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.le_iff
statement: theorem le_iff {E F : ClosedIF k K} : E ≤ F ↔ E.1 ≤ F.1
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.coe_sInf
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_sInf (s : Set (ClosedIF k K)) :
    ((sInf s).1 : IntermediateField k K) = sInf (Subtype.val '' s)
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.coe_sSup
statement:
theorem coe_sSup (s : Set (ClosedIF k K)) :
    ((sSup s).1 : IntermediateField k K) =
      racl k ((sSup (Subtype.val '' s) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K)
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.coe_top
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_top : ((⊤ : ClosedIF k K).1 : IntermediateField k K) = ⊤
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.coe_bot
statement:
theorem coe_bot : ((⊥ : ClosedIF k K).1 : IntermediateField k K) =
    racl k ((⊥ : IntermediateField k K) : Set K)
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.mem_bot_iff
statement:
theorem mem_bot_iff {x : K} :
    x ∈ (⊥ : ClosedIF k K) ↔ IsAlgebraic k x
proof:
:= by
  change x ∈ ((⊥ : ClosedIF k K)).1 ↔ _
  rw [coe_bot, mem_racl_iff, adjoin_self]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hbot : Algebra.IsIntegral k (⊥ : IntermediateField k K) := by
      constructor
      intro y
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := IntermediateField.mem_bot.1 y.2
      have : IsIntegral k (y : K) := hz ▸ isIntegral_algebraMap
      exact (isIntegral_algHom_iff (⊥ : IntermediateField k K).val
        Subtype.val_injective).1 this
