    rw [isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral] at h ⊢
    exact isIntegral_trans x h
  · intro h
    exact h.tower_top _

name: AclGeom.IsRAC.map
statement:
theorem _root_.AclGeom.IsRAC.map {E : IntermediateField k K} (hE : IsRAC E)
    (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] L) : IsRAC (E.map σ.toAlgHom)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isRAC_iff_racl_eq] at hE ⊢
  calc racl k ((E.map σ.toAlgHom : IntermediateField k L) : Set L)
      = racl k (σ '' (E : Set K)) := by rw [IntermediateField.coe_map]; rfl
    _ = (racl k (E : Set K)).map σ.toAlgHom := (racl_map σ (E : Set K)).symm
    _ = E.map σ.toAlgHom := by rw [hE]

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.mem_sInf
statement:
theorem mem_sInf {s : Set (ClosedIF k K)} {x : K} :
    x ∈ sInf s ↔ ∀ E ∈ s, x ∈ E
proof:
:= by
  change x ∈ (sInf s).1 ↔ _
  rw [coe_sInf, IntermediateField.mem_sInf]
  constructor
  · intro h E hE
    exact h E.1 ⟨E, hE, rfl⟩
  · rintro h - ⟨E, hE, rfl⟩
    exact h E hE

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.mem_sSup_iff_mem_racl
statement:
theorem mem_sSup_iff_mem_racl {s : Set (ClosedIF k K)} {x : K} :
    x ∈ sSup s ↔
      x ∈ racl k ((sSup (Subtype.val '' s) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.coe_sup
statement:
theorem coe_sup (E F : ClosedIF k K) :
    ((E ⊔ F).1 : IntermediateField k K) = racl k ((E : Set K) ∪ F)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · have h : E ⊔ F ≤ ⟨racl k ((E : Set K) ∪ F), isRAC_racl _⟩ := by
      refine sup_le (le_iff.2 ?_) (le_iff.2 ?_)
      · calc E.1 ≤ racl k (E : Set K) := fun x hx ↦ subset_racl k _ hx
          _ ≤ racl k ((E : Set K) ∪ F) := racl_mono Set.subset_union_left
      · calc F.1 ≤ racl k (F : Set K) := fun x hx ↦ subset_racl k _ hx
          _ ≤ racl k ((E : Set K) ∪ F) := racl_mono Set.subset_union_right
    exact le_iff.1 h
  · have hsub : (E : Set K) ∪ F ⊆ ((E ⊔ F).1 : Set K) :=
      Set.union_subset (le_iff.1 le_sup_left) (le_iff.1 le_sup_right)
    calc racl k ((E : Set K) ∪ F) ≤ racl k ((E ⊔ F).1 : Set K) :=
          racl_mono hsub
      _ = (E ⊔ F).1 := isRAC_iff_racl_eq.1 (E ⊔ F).2

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.mem_sup_iff
statement:
theorem mem_sup_iff {E F : ClosedIF k K} {x : K} :
    x ∈ E ⊔ F ↔ x ∈ racl k ((E : Set K) ∪ F)
proof:
:= by
  change x ∈ ((E ⊔ F).1 : IntermediateField k K) ↔ _
  rw [coe_sup]

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.coe_set_sup
statement:
theorem coe_set_sup (E F : ClosedIF k K) :
    ((E ⊔ F : ClosedIF k K) : Set K) =
      (racl k ((E : Set K) ∪ F) : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have h := coe_sup E F
  calc ((E ⊔ F : ClosedIF k K) : Set K) = ((E ⊔ F).1 : Set K) := rfl
    _ = (racl k ((E : Set K) ∪ F) : Set K) := by rw [h]

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.mem_inf_iff
statement:
theorem mem_inf_iff {E F : ClosedIF k K} {x : K} :
    x ∈ E ⊓ F ↔ x ∈ E ∧ x ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sInf_pair, mem_sInf]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h E (by simp), h F (by simp)⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩ G hG
    rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.1 hG with rfl | hG
    · exact h1
    · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.1 hG]
      exact h2

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.coe_eq_racl_of_le
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (le_iff.1 h1) ?_
  calc racl k S ≤ racl k (E : Set K) := racl_mono h2
    _ = E.1 := isRAC_iff_racl_eq.1 E.2

name: AclGeom.mem_racl_iff
statement:
theorem mem_racl_iff {S : Set K} {x : K} :
    x ∈ racl k S ↔ IsAlgebraic (adjoin k S) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [racl, mem_restrictScalars, mem_algebraicClosure_iff]

name: AclGeom.mem_racl_iff_isAlgebraic_adjoin
statement:
theorem mem_racl_iff_isAlgebraic_adjoin {S : Set K} {x : K} :
    x ∈ racl k S ↔ IsAlgebraic (Algebra.adjoin k S) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_racl_iff]
  exact (IsFractionRing.isAlgebraic_iff (Algebra.adjoin k S)
    (adjoin k S) K).symm

name: AclGeom.adjoin_le_racl
statement: theorem adjoin_le_racl (S : Set K) : adjoin k S ≤ racl k S
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [mem_racl_iff]
  exact isAlgebraic_algebraMap (⟨x, hx⟩ : adjoin k S)

name: AclGeom.subset_racl
statement: theorem subset_racl (S : Set K) : S ⊆ (racl k S : Set K)
proof:
:=
  (subset_adjoin k S).trans (adjoin_le_racl k S)

name: AclGeom.le_racl_iff
statement:
theorem le_racl_iff {S : Set K} {E : IntermediateField k K} :
    E ≤ racl k S ↔ ∀ x ∈ E, IsAlgebraic (adjoin k S) x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _ hx ↦ (mem_racl_iff k).1 (h hx), fun h x hx ↦ (mem_racl_iff k).2 (h x hx)⟩

name: AclGeom.isAlgebraic_of_coeff_mem
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_of_coeff_mem {E : IntermediateField k K} {x : K} {p : Polynomial K}
    (hp : p ≠ 0) (hpx : p.eval x = 0) (hc : ∀ n, p.coeff n ∈ E) : IsAlgebraic E x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := (Polynomial.mem_lifts (f := algebraMap E K) p).1 <|
    (Polynomial.lifts_iff_coeff_lifts p).2 fun n ↦ ⟨(⟨p.coeff n, hc n⟩ : E), rfl⟩
  refine ⟨q, fun h0 ↦ hp ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hq, h0, Polynomial.map_zero]
  · rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, ← Polynomial.eval_map, hq, hpx]

name: AclGeom.isAlgebraic_of_le
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_of_le {E₁ E₂ : IntermediateField k K} (h : E₁ ≤ E₂) {x : K}
    (hx : IsAlgebraic E₁ x) : IsAlgebraic E₂ x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp0, hpx⟩ := hx
  refine isAlgebraic_of_coeff_mem ((Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff
    (algebraMap E₁ K).injective).2 hp0) ?_ fun n ↦ ?_
  · rw [Polynomial.eval_map, ← Polynomial.aeval_def, hpx]
  · rw [Polynomial.coeff_map]
    exact h (p.coeff n).2

name: AclGeom.racl_mono
statement: theorem racl_mono {S T : Set K} (h : S ⊆ T) : racl k S ≤ racl k T
proof:
:= fun _ hx ↦
  (mem_racl_iff k).2 (isAlgebraic_of_le (adjoin.mono k S T h) ((mem_racl_iff k).1 hx))

name: AclGeom.racl_racl
statement: theorem racl_racl (S : Set K) : racl k (racl k S : Set K) = racl k S
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (fun x hx ↦ (racl_mono (subset_racl k S)) hx)
  intro x hx
  rw [mem_racl_iff, adjoin_self] at hx
  rw [mem_racl_iff]
  
  
  
  
  
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral (adjoin k S) (algebraicClosure (adjoin k S) K) :=
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isIntegral
  rw [isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral] at hx ⊢
  have hx' : IsIntegral (algebraicClosure (adjoin k S) K) x := hx
  exact isIntegral_trans x hx'

name: AclGeom.racl_le_of_subset_racl
statement:
theorem racl_le_of_subset_racl {S T : Set K} (h : T ⊆ racl k S) :
    racl k T ≤ racl k S
proof:
:= by
  rw [← racl_racl k S]
  exact racl_mono h

name: AclGeom.racl_insert_of_mem
statement:
theorem racl_insert_of_mem {S : Set K} {y : K} (hy : y ∈ racl k S) :
    racl k (insert y S) = racl k S
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.insert_subset hy (subset_racl k S)))
    (racl_mono (Set.subset_insert y S))

name: AclGeom.notMem_racl_empty_of_transcendental
statement:
theorem notMem_racl_empty_of_transcendental {x : K} (hx : Transcendental k x) :
    x ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  refine hx ?_
  have halg : IsAlgebraic ↥(adjoin k (∅ : Set K)) x := (mem_racl_iff k).1 hmem
  rw [adjoin_empty] at halg
  haveI : Algebra.IsIntegral k ↥(⊥ : IntermediateField k K) := by
    refine ⟨fun z ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := IntermediateField.mem_bot.1 z.2
    have hz : z = algebraMap k ↥(⊥ : IntermediateField k K) c :=
      Subtype.ext hc.symm
    rw [hz]
    exact isIntegral_algebraMap
  rw [isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral] at halg ⊢
  exact isIntegral_trans x halg

name: AclGeom.exists_poly_of_isAlgebraic
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp0, hpx⟩ := hx
  refine ⟨p.map (algebraMap E K),
    (Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff (algebraMap E K).injective).2 hp0, ?_, fun n ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [Polynomial.eval_map, ← Polynomial.aeval_def, hpx]
  · rw [Polynomial.coeff_map]
    exact (p.coeff n).2

name: AclGeom.exists_finset_racl
statement:
theorem exists_finset_racl {S : Set K} {x : K} (hx : x ∈ racl k S) :
    ∃ T : Finset K, ↑T ⊆ S ∧ x ∈ racl k (T : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q, hq0, hqx, hcoeff⟩ := exists_poly_of_isAlgebraic ((mem_racl_iff k).1 hx)
  
  
  choose T hTS hTmem using fun n ↦ exists_finset_of_mem_adjoin (hcoeff n)
  refine ⟨q.support.biUnion T, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨n, -, hn⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.1 hy
    exact hTS n hn
  · rw [mem_racl_iff]
    refine isAlgebraic_of_coeff_mem hq0 hqx fun n ↦ ?_
    by_cases hn : n ∈ q.support
    · exact adjoin.mono _ _ _ (by exact_mod_cast Finset.subset_biUnion_of_mem T hn)
        (hTmem n)
    · simp [Polynomial.notMem_support_iff.1 hn]

name: AclGeom.isAlgebraic_adjoin_exchange
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hy
  
  have hy' : Transcendental (Algebra.adjoin F ({x} : Set K)) y := fun h ↦
    hy ((IsFractionRing.isAlgebraic_iff (Algebra.adjoin F ({x} : Set K)) (adjoin F {x}) K).1 h)
  
  have hxInd : AlgebraicIndependent F (fun _ : Unit ↦ x) :=
    algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff.2 hx'
  have hpair : AlgebraicIndependent F (fun o : Option Unit ↦ o.elim y fun _ ↦ x) := by
    refine (hxInd.option_iff_transcendental y).2 ?_
    rwa [Set.range_const]
  
  
  have hfun : ((fun o : Option Unit ↦ o.elim y fun _ ↦ x) ∘ Equiv.swap none (some ())) =
      fun o : Option Unit ↦ o.elim x fun _ ↦ y := by
    funext o
    rcases o with - | -
    · simp
    · simp
  have hswap : AlgebraicIndependent F (fun o : Option Unit ↦ o.elim x fun _ ↦ y) :=
    hfun ▸ hpair.comp (Equiv.swap none (some ())) (Equiv.injective _)
  have hyInd : AlgebraicIndependent F (fun _ : Unit ↦ y) :=
    hswap.comp some (Option.some_injective Unit)
  have hxTr : Transcendental (Algebra.adjoin F (Set.range fun _ : Unit ↦ y)) x :=
    (hyInd.option_iff_transcendental x).1 hswap
  rw [Set.range_const] at hxTr
  exact hxTr
    ((IsFractionRing.isAlgebraic_iff (Algebra.adjoin F ({y} : Set K)) (adjoin F {y}) K).2 hx)

name: AclGeom.mem_racl_insert_iff
statement:
theorem mem_racl_insert_iff {S : Set K} {z x : K} :
    x ∈ racl k (insert z S) ↔
      IsAlgebraic ↥(adjoin ↥(adjoin k S) ({z} : Set K)) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_racl_iff]
  have key : adjoin k (insert z S) =
      (adjoin (adjoin k S) {z}).restrictScalars k := by
    rw [adjoin_adjoin_left, Set.union_singleton]
  rw [key]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ h, fun h ↦ h⟩

name: AclGeom.mem_racl_adjoin_base_iff
statement:
theorem mem_racl_adjoin_base_iff {P S : Set K} {x : K} :
    x ∈ racl ↥(adjoin k P) S ↔ x ∈ racl k (P ∪ S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_racl_iff, mem_racl_iff]
  have key : adjoin k (P ∪ S) =
      (adjoin (adjoin k P) S).restrictScalars k := by
    rw [adjoin_adjoin_left]
  rw [key]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ h, fun h ↦ h⟩

name: AclGeom.racl_exchange
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_racl_iff] at hxy hx ⊢
  have key : ∀ z : K, adjoin k (insert z S) =
      (adjoin (adjoin k S) {z}).restrictScalars k := fun z ↦ by
    rw [adjoin_adjoin_left, Set.union_singleton]
  rw [key y] at hxy
  rw [key x]
  
  
  have hxy' : IsAlgebraic (adjoin (adjoin k S) {y}) x := hxy
  have h := isAlgebraic_adjoin_exchange hxy' hx
  exact h

name: AclGeom.mem_racl_map
statement:
theorem mem_racl_map (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] L) {S : Set K} {x : K} (hx : x ∈ racl k S) :
    σ x ∈ racl k (σ '' S)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq0, hqx, hc⟩ := exists_poly_of_isAlgebraic ((mem_racl_iff k).1 hx)
  rw [mem_racl_iff]
  refine isAlgebraic_of_coeff_mem (p := q.map (σ : K →+* L))
    ((Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff (σ : K →+* L).injective).2 hq0) ?_ fun n ↦ ?_
  · rw [Polynomial.eval_map,
      show σ x = (σ : K →+* L) x from rfl, Polynomial.eval₂_at_apply, hqx, map_zero]
  · rw [Polynomial.coeff_map]
    have h1 : σ (q.coeff n) ∈ (adjoin k S).map σ.toAlgHom := ⟨q.coeff n, hc n, rfl⟩
    rw [adjoin_map] at h1
    simpa using h1

name: AclGeom.mem_racl_map_iff
statement:
theorem mem_racl_map_iff (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] L) {S : Set K} {x : K} :
    σ x ∈ racl k (σ '' S) ↔ x ∈ racl k S
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, mem_racl_map σ⟩
  have h2 := mem_racl_map σ.symm h
  rwa [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply,
    show σ.symm '' (σ '' S) = S by rw [← Set.image_comp]; simp] at h2

name: AclGeom.racl_map
statement:
theorem racl_map (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] L) (S : Set K) :
    (racl k S).map σ.toAlgHom = racl k (σ '' S)
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    simpa using mem_racl_map σ hx
  · intro hy
    refine ⟨σ.symm y, ?_, by simp⟩
    have h2 := mem_racl_map σ.symm hy
    rwa [show σ.symm '' (σ '' S) = S by rw [← Set.image_comp]; simp] at h2

name: AclGeom.racl_image_pow
statement:
theorem racl_image_pow {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) (S : Set K) :
    racl k ((· ^ m) '' S) = racl k S
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · 
    refine (racl_mono ?_).trans_eq (racl_racl k S)
    rintro - ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    exact pow_mem (subset_racl k S hs) m
  · 
    refine (racl_mono ?_).trans_eq (racl_racl k _)
    intro s hs
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_racl_iff]
    have hsm : s ^ m ∈ adjoin k ((· ^ m) '' S) := subset_adjoin _ _ ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
    refine isAlgebraic_of_coeff_mem (p := Polynomial.X ^ m - Polynomial.C (s ^ m))
      (Polynomial.X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm) _) (by simp) fun n ↦ ?_
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, Polynomial.coeff_C]
    rcases eq_or_ne n m with rfl | hnm
    · simp [hm]
    · rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn0
      · simpa [hnm] using neg_mem hsm
      · simp [hnm, hn0]

name: AclGeom.algebraicIndependent_iff_forall_notMem_racl
statement:
theorem algebraicIndependent_iff_forall_notMem_racl {ι : Type*} {v : ι → K} :
    AlgebraicIndependent k v ↔ ∀ i, v i ∉ racl k (v '' {i}ᶜ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h i hmem
    refine ((AlgebraicIndependent.iff_transcendental_adjoin_image (x := v) i).1 h).2 ?_
    exact (IsFractionRing.isAlgebraic_iff (Algebra.adjoin k (v '' {i}ᶜ))
      (adjoin k (v '' {i}ᶜ)) K).2 ((mem_racl_iff k).1 hmem)
  · intro h
    refine algebraicIndependent_of_finite_type' (algebraMap k K).injective
      fun t _ _ i hit halg ↦ h i ?_
    rw [mem_racl_iff]
    have h2 : IsAlgebraic (adjoin k (v '' t)) (v i) :=
      (IsFractionRing.isAlgebraic_iff (Algebra.adjoin k (v '' t))
        (adjoin k (v '' t)) K).1 halg
    refine isAlgebraic_of_le (adjoin.mono _ _ _ (Set.image_mono ?_)) h2
    exact fun j hj hji ↦ hit (hji ▸ hj)

name: AclGeom.algebraicIndependent_snoc
proof:
:= by
  have htr : Transcendental (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range t)) z := by
    intro halg
    refine hz ?_
    rw [mem_racl_iff]
    exact (IsFractionRing.isAlgebraic_iff (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range t))
      (adjoin k (Set.range t)) K).1 halg
  have h1 : AlgebraicIndependent k (fun o : Option (Fin n) ↦ o.elim z t) :=
    (AlgebraicIndependent.option_iff_transcendental ht z).2 htr
  have h2 := AlgebraicIndependent.comp h1 finSuccEquivLast
    (Equiv.injective _)
  have heq : ((fun o : Option (Fin n) ↦ o.elim z t) ∘ finSuccEquivLast) =
      Fin.snoc t z := by
    funext i
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j ↦ ?_) i
    · simp [finSuccEquivLast_last]
    · simp [finSuccEquivLast_castSucc]
  rwa [heq] at h2

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_pair
statement:
theorem AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_pair {x y : K}
    (h : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, y]) : y ∉ racl k {x}
proof:
:= by
  intro hy
  have h1 := algebraicIndependent_iff_forall_notMem_racl.1 h 1
  refine h1 ?_
  refine racl_mono ?_ hy
  intro z hz
  refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp
  · simpa using hz.symm

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_pair'
statement:
theorem AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_pair' {x y : K}
    (h : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, y]) : x ∉ racl k {y}
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  have h0 := algebraicIndependent_iff_forall_notMem_racl.1 h 0
  refine h0 ?_
  refine racl_mono ?_ hx
  intro z hz
  refine ⟨1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp
  · simpa using hz.symm

name: AclGeom.racl_subset_racl_base
statement:
theorem racl_subset_racl_base (K₀ : IntermediateField k K) (S : Set K) :
    (racl k S : Set K) ⊆ (racl ↥K₀ S : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_racl_iff] at hx
  obtain ⟨q, hq0, hqx, hqc⟩ := exists_poly_of_isAlgebraic hx
  have hsub : (adjoin k S : Set K) ⊆ ((adjoin ↥K₀ S : IntermediateField ↥K₀ K) : Set K) := by
    have hle : adjoin k S ≤ (adjoin ↥K₀ S).restrictScalars k :=
      adjoin_le_iff.2 fun y hy ↦ subset_adjoin ↥K₀ S hy
    exact fun y hy ↦ hle hy
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_racl_iff]
  exact isAlgebraic_of_coeff_mem (E := adjoin ↥K₀ S) hq0 hqx fun m ↦ hsub (hqc m)

name: AclGeom.mem_racl_of_mem_racl_insert
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hw
  have hbex : b ∈ racl k (insert w A) := racl_exchange hwb hw
  have hwsub : (insert w A : Set K) ⊆ racl k (insert a A) := by
    rintro z (rfl | hz)
    · exact hwa
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ hz)
  exact hb (racl_le_of_subset_racl hwsub hbex)

name: AclGeom.isAlgebraic_of_mem_racl_empty
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_of_mem_racl_empty {x : K}
    (hx : x ∈ racl k (∅ : Set K)) : IsAlgebraic k x
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  exact notMem_racl_empty_of_transcendental h hx

name: AclGeom.mem_racl_singleton_pow
statement:
theorem mem_racl_singleton_pow {x : K} {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    x ∈ racl k {x ^ n}
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_racl_iff]
  refine ⟨Polynomial.X ^ n - Polynomial.C ⟨x ^ n, subset_adjoin k _ rfl⟩,
    Polynomial.X_pow_sub_C_ne_zero (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn) _, ?_⟩
  rw [map_sub, Polynomial.aeval_X_pow, Polynomial.aeval_C]
  exact sub_self _

name: AclGeom.mem_racl_singleton_zpow
statement:
theorem mem_racl_singleton_zpow {x : K} {a : ℤ} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    x ∈ racl k {x ^ a}
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with n | n
  · rw [Int.ofNat_eq_natCast, zpow_natCast]
    exact mem_racl_singleton_pow (Int.ofNat_ne_zero.1 ha)
  · rw [zpow_negSucc]
    have hx : x ^ (n + 1) ∈ racl k {(x ^ (n + 1))⁻¹} := by
      have hgen : (x ^ (n + 1))⁻¹ ∈ racl k {(x ^ (n + 1))⁻¹} :=
        subset_racl k _ rfl
    
      have hinv := inv_mem hgen
      rwa [inv_inv] at hinv
    exact racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hx)
      (mem_racl_singleton_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero n))

name: AclGeom.mem_racl_empty_of_zpow
statement:
theorem mem_racl_empty_of_zpow {x : K} {a : ℤ} (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (h : x ^ a ∈ racl k (∅ : Set K)) : x ∈ racl k (∅ : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : x ∈ racl k {x ^ a} := mem_racl_singleton_zpow ha
  have h2 : racl k ({x ^ a} : Set K) = racl k (∅ : Set K) := by
    have h3 := racl_insert_of_mem (S := (∅ : Set K)) h
    simpa using h3
  rwa [h2] at h1

name: AclGeom.racl_singleton_congr
statement:
theorem racl_singleton_congr {z w : K} (hzw : z ∈ racl k {w})
    (hwz : w ∈ racl k {z}) : racl k ({z} : Set K) = racl k {w}
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hzw))
    (racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hwz))

name: AclGeom.racl_algebraMap_mul
statement:
theorem racl_algebraMap_mul {e : k} (he : e ≠ 0) (z : K) :
    racl k ({algebraMap k K e * z} : Set K) = racl k {z}
proof:
:= by
  refine racl_singleton_congr ?_ ?_
  · exact MulMemClass.mul_mem (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ _)
      (subset_racl k _ rfl)
  · have hmem : algebraMap k K e⁻¹ * (algebraMap k K e * z) ∈
        racl k ({algebraMap k K e * z} : Set K) :=
      MulMemClass.mul_mem (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ _)
        (subset_racl k _ rfl)
    have h : algebraMap k K e⁻¹ * (algebraMap k K e * z) = z := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ he, map_one, one_mul]
    rwa [h] at hmem

name: AclGeom.racl_add_algebraMap
statement:
theorem racl_add_algebraMap (z : K) (e : k) :
    racl k ({z + algebraMap k K e} : Set K) = racl k {z}
proof:
:= by
  refine racl_singleton_congr ?_ ?_
  · exact add_mem (subset_racl k _ rfl) (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ _)
  · have hmem : (z + algebraMap k K e) - algebraMap k K e ∈
        racl k ({z + algebraMap k K e} : Set K) :=
      sub_mem (subset_racl k _ rfl) (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ _)
    rwa [add_sub_cancel_right] at hmem

name: AclGeom.racl_one_add
statement:
theorem racl_one_add (z : K) :
    racl k ({1 + z} : Set K) = racl k {z}
proof:
:= by
  refine racl_singleton_congr ?_ ?_
  · exact add_mem (one_mem _) (subset_racl k _ rfl)
  · have hmem : (1 + z) - 1 ∈ racl k ({1 + z} : Set K) :=
      sub_mem (subset_racl k _ rfl) (one_mem _)
    have h : (1 + z) - 1 = z := by ring
    rwa [h] at hmem

name: AclGeom.racl_pow
statement:
theorem racl_pow (z : K) {w : ℕ} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    racl k ({z ^ w} : Set K) = racl k {z}
proof:
:= by
  have hz : z ∈ racl k ({z} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ rfl
  exact racl_singleton_congr (pow_mem hz w) (mem_racl_singleton_pow hw)

name: AclGeom.racl_inv
statement:
theorem racl_inv (z : K) :
    racl k ({z⁻¹} : Set K) = racl k {z}
proof:
:= by
  refine racl_singleton_congr ?_ ?_
  · exact inv_mem (subset_racl k _ rfl)
  · have hmem : (z⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ racl k ({z⁻¹} : Set K) :=
      inv_mem (subset_racl k _ rfl)
    rwa [inv_inv] at hmem

name: AclGeom.racl_neg
statement:
theorem racl_neg (z : K) :
    racl k ({-z} : Set K) = racl k {z}
proof:
:= by
  refine racl_singleton_congr ?_ ?_
  · exact neg_mem (subset_racl k _ rfl)
  · have hmem : -(-z) ∈ racl k ({-z} : Set K) :=
      neg_mem (subset_racl k _ rfl)
    rwa [neg_neg] at hmem

name: AclGeom.racl_congr_of_subset_racl
statement:
theorem racl_congr_of_subset_racl {S T : Set K} (hST : S ⊆ racl k T)
    (hTS : T ⊆ racl k S) : racl k S = racl k T
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl hST) (racl_le_of_subset_racl hTS)

name: AclGeom.mem_racl_empty_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem mem_racl_empty_of_isAlgebraic {x : K} (hx : IsAlgebraic k x) :
    x ∈ racl k (∅ : Set K)
proof:
:=
  (mem_racl_iff k).2 (hx.tower_top _)

name: AclGeom.racl_union_left
statement:
theorem racl_union_left (S T : Set K) :
    racl k ((racl k S : Set K) ∪ T) = racl k (S ∪ T)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · have h1 : (racl k S : Set K) ∪ T ⊆ (racl k (S ∪ T) : Set K) := by
      refine Set.union_subset ?_ ?_
      · exact SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 (racl_mono Set.subset_union_left)
      · exact fun z hz ↦ subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_union_right _ hz)
    calc racl k ((racl k S : Set K) ∪ T)
        ≤ racl k (racl k (S ∪ T) : Set K) := racl_mono h1
      _ = racl k (S ∪ T) := racl_racl _ _
  · refine racl_mono (Set.union_subset_union_left T ?_)
    exact subset_racl k S

name: AclGeom.racl_union_right
statement:
theorem racl_union_right (S T : Set K) :
    racl k (S ∪ (racl k T : Set K)) = racl k (S ∪ T)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.union_comm S, Set.union_comm S]
  exact racl_union_left T S

name: AclGeom.algebraicIndependent_pair
statement:
theorem algebraicIndependent_pair {z₁ z₂ : K} (h₁ : z₁ ∉ racl k {z₂})
    (h₂ : z₂ ∉ racl k {z₁}) : AlgebraicIndependent k ![z₁, z₂]
proof:
:= by
  rw [algebraicIndependent_iff_forall_notMem_racl, Fin.forall_fin_two]
  constructor
  · have himg : ((![z₁, z₂] : Fin 2 → K) ''
        ({(0 : Fin 2)}ᶜ : Set (Fin 2))) = {z₂} := by
      have hcompl : ({(0 : Fin 2)}ᶜ : Set (Fin 2)) = {1} := by
        ext i
        fin_cases i <;> simp
      rw [hcompl, Set.image_singleton]
      simp
    rw [himg]
    exact h₁
  · have himg : ((![z₁, z₂] : Fin 2 → K) ''
        ({(1 : Fin 2)}ᶜ : Set (Fin 2))) = {z₁} := by
      have hcompl : ({(1 : Fin 2)}ᶜ : Set (Fin 2)) = {0} := by
        ext i
        fin_cases i <;> simp
      rw [hcompl, Set.image_singleton]
      simp
    rw [himg]
    exact h₂

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_image
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  refine algebraicIndependent_iff_forall_notMem_racl.1 hv i ?_
  refine racl_mono (Set.image_mono ?_) hmem
  exact fun j hj hji ↦ hi ((hji : j = i) ▸ hj)

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicIndependent.comp_pair
proof:
:= by
  refine algebraicIndependent_pair ?_ ?_
  · have h := AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_image hv (S := {j}) hij
    rwa [Set.image_singleton] at h
  · have h := AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_image hv (S := {i})
      (Ne.symm hij)
    rwa [Set.image_singleton] at h

name: AclGeom.four_le_trdeg_freshAmbient
statement:
theorem four_le_trdeg_freshAmbient (k Ω : Type*) [Field k] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω] :
    (4 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k (FreshAmbient Ω)
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom Ω (MvPolynomial (Fin 4) Ω) (FreshAmbient Ω)) := by
    change Function.Injective (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin 4) Ω) (FreshAmbient Ω))
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq (MvPolynomial (Fin 4) Ω)
      (FractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin 4) Ω)) (FreshAmbient Ω)]
    exact (algebraMap (FractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin 4) Ω)) (FreshAmbient Ω)).injective.comp
      (IsFractionRing.injective _ _)
  have hX := ((MvPolynomial.algebraicIndependent_X (Fin 4) Ω).map' hinj).restrictScalars
    (R := k) (algebraMap k Ω).injective
  simpa using hX.lift_cardinalMk_le_trdeg

name: AclGeom.CrossBase.Compatible.image_range
statement:
theorem Compatible.image_range (hσ : Compatible (k := k) (l := l) σ) :
    σ '' Set.range (algebraMap k K) = Set.range (algebraMap l L)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun F : Subfield L ↦ (F : Set L)) hσ
  simpa only [Subfield.coe_map, RingHom.coe_fieldRange, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe,
    RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom] using h

name: AclGeom.CrossBase.Compatible.symm
statement:
theorem Compatible.symm (hσ : Compatible (k := k) (l := l) σ) :
    Compatible (k := l) (l := k) σ.symm
proof:
:= by
  unfold Compatible
  apply SetLike.coe_injective
  rw [Subfield.coe_map, ← hσ, Subfield.coe_map, Set.image_image]
  simp

name: AclGeom.CrossBase.compatible_refl
statement: theorem compatible_refl : Compatible (k := k) (l := k) (RingEquiv.refl K)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Compatible
  apply SetLike.coe_injective
  simp [Subfield.coe_map]

name: AclGeom.CrossBase.Compatible.trans
proof:
:= by
  unfold Compatible at *
  rw [← hτ, ← hσ, Subfield.map_map]
  rfl

name: AclGeom.CrossBase.Compatible.map_algebraMap_mem
statement:
theorem Compatible.map_algebraMap_mem (hσ : Compatible (k := k) (l := l) σ) (c : k) :
    σ (algebraMap k K c) ∈ (algebraMap l L).fieldRange
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hσ]
  exact ⟨algebraMap k K c, ⟨c, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: AclGeom.CrossBase.algebraMap_baseRingHom
statement:
theorem algebraMap_baseRingHom (hσ : Compatible (k := k) (l := l) σ) (c : k) :
    algebraMap l L (baseRingHom σ hσ c) = σ (algebraMap k K c)
proof:
:= by
  simp [baseRingHom]

name: AclGeom.CrossBase.algebraMap_baseRingEquiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem algebraMap_baseRingEquiv (hσ : Compatible (k := k) (l := l) σ) (c : k) :
    algebraMap l L (baseRingEquiv σ hσ c) = σ (algebraMap k K c)
proof:
:=
  algebraMap_baseRingHom hσ c

name: AclGeom.CrossBase.adjoin_map
statement:
theorem adjoin_map (hσ : Compatible (k := k) (l := l) σ) (S : Set K) :
    (adjoin k S).toSubfield.map σ.toRingHom = (adjoin l (σ '' S)).toSubfield
proof:
:= by
  rw [adjoin_toSubfield, adjoin_toSubfield, RingHom.map_field_closure, Set.image_union]
  congr 2
  simpa only [RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom] using hσ.image_range

name: AclGeom.CrossBase.map_mem_adjoin
statement:
theorem map_mem_adjoin (hσ : Compatible (k := k) (l := l) σ) {S : Set K} {x : K}
    (hx : x ∈ adjoin k S) : σ x ∈ adjoin l (σ '' S)
proof:
:= by
  have h : σ x ∈ (adjoin k S).toSubfield.map σ.toRingHom := ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  rwa [adjoin_map hσ] at h

name: AclGeom.CrossBase.map_mem_racl
statement:
theorem map_mem_racl (hσ : Compatible (k := k) (l := l) σ) {S : Set K} {x : K}
    (hx : x ∈ racl k S) : σ x ∈ racl l (σ '' S)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq0, hqx, hc⟩ := exists_poly_of_isAlgebraic ((mem_racl_iff k).1 hx)
  rw [mem_racl_iff]
  refine isAlgebraic_of_coeff_mem (p := q.map (σ : K →+* L))
    ((Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff (σ : K →+* L).injective).2 hq0) ?_ fun n ↦ ?_
  · rw [Polynomial.eval_map,
      show σ x = (σ : K →+* L) x from rfl, Polynomial.eval₂_at_apply, hqx, map_zero]
  · rw [Polynomial.coeff_map]
    exact map_mem_adjoin hσ (hc n)

name: AclGeom.CrossBase.map_mem_racl_iff
statement:
theorem map_mem_racl_iff (hσ : Compatible (k := k) (l := l) σ) {S : Set K} {x : K} :
    σ x ∈ racl l (σ '' S) ↔ x ∈ racl k S
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, map_mem_racl hσ⟩
  have h2 := map_mem_racl hσ.symm h
  rwa [RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply,
    show σ.symm '' (σ '' S) = S by rw [← Set.image_comp]; simp] at h2

name: AclGeom.CrossBase.image_racl
statement:
theorem image_racl (hσ : Compatible (k := k) (l := l) σ) (S : Set K) :
    σ '' (racl k S : Set K) = racl l (σ '' S)
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact map_mem_racl hσ hx
  · intro hy
    refine ⟨σ.symm y, (map_mem_racl_iff hσ).1 ?_, by simp⟩
    rwa [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: AclGeom.CrossBase.image_closed
statement:
theorem image_closed (hσ : Compatible (k := k) (l := l) σ) (E : ClosedIF k K) :
    σ '' (E.1 : Set K) = racl l (σ '' (E.1 : Set K))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← image_racl hσ, isRAC_iff_racl_eq.1 E.2]

name: AclGeom.CrossBase.coe_closedIFMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_closedIFMap (hσ : Compatible (k := k) (l := l) σ) (E : ClosedIF k K) :
    ((closedIFMap σ hσ E).1 : Set L) = σ '' (E.1 : Set K)
proof:
:=
  (image_closed hσ E).symm

name: AclGeom.CrossBase.closedIFMap_point
statement:
theorem closedIFMap_point (hσ : Compatible (k := k) (l := l) σ) (x : K) :
    closedIFMap σ hσ (ClosedIF.point k x) = ClosedIF.point l (σ x)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply SetLike.coe_injective
  rw [coe_closedIFMap, ClosedIF.coe_point, ClosedIF.coe_point, image_racl hσ,
    Set.image_singleton]

name: AclGeom.CrossBase.closedIFMap_symm
statement:
theorem closedIFMap_symm (hσ : Compatible (k := k) (l := l) σ) :
    (closedIFMap σ hσ).symm = closedIFMap σ.symm hσ.symm
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AclGeom.CrossBase.closedIFMap_refl
statement:
theorem closedIFMap_refl :
    closedIFMap (RingEquiv.refl K) (compatible_refl (k := k)) = OrderIso.refl _
proof:
:= by
  refine OrderIso.ext (funext fun E ↦ ?_)
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply SetLike.coe_injective
  rw [coe_closedIFMap]
  simp

name: AclGeom.CrossBase.closedIFMap_trans
proof:
:= by
  refine OrderIso.ext (funext fun E ↦ ?_)
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply SetLike.coe_injective
  rw [OrderIso.trans_apply, coe_closedIFMap, coe_closedIFMap, coe_closedIFMap, RingEquiv.coe_trans,
    Set.image_comp]

name: AclGeom.blueprintRatioMulGraph_map_iff
statement:
theorem blueprintRatioMulGraph_map_iff (e : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L)
    (b : Fin 5 → Point k K)
    (r s t : Option ({u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq b u} ×
      {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq b u})) :
    BlueprintRatioMulGraph (Point.map e ∘ b)
        (r.map (Prod.map (frobEqClassMap e b) (frobEqClassMap e b)))
        (s.map (Prod.map (frobEqClassMap e b) (frobEqClassMap e b)))
        (t.map (Prod.map (frobEqClassMap e b) (frobEqClassMap e b))) ↔
      BlueprintRatioMulGraph b r s t
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ∀ u, (frobEqClassMap e b u).1 = Point.map e ∘ u.1 := fun _ ↦ rfl
  have hR : ∀ p₁ p₂ q₁ q₂ : {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq b u},
      BlueprintRatioEq (Point.map e ∘ b) ((frobEqClassMap e b p₁).1, (frobEqClassMap e b p₂).1)
          ((frobEqClassMap e b q₁).1, (frobEqClassMap e b q₂).1) ↔
        BlueprintRatioEq b (p₁.1, p₂.1) (q₁.1, q₂.1) := fun _ _ _ _ ↦ by
    rw [hc, hc, hc, hc]
    exact blueprintRatioEq_map_iff e
  have hM : ∀ u v w : {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq b u},
      BlueprintJMul (frobEqClassMap e b u).1 (frobEqClassMap e b v).1 (frobEqClassMap e b w).1 ↔
        BlueprintJMul u.1 v.1 w.1 := fun _ _ _ ↦ by
    rw [hc, hc, hc]
    exact blueprintJMul_map_iff e
  have hS := (frobEqClassMap e b).surjective
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨hrs, ht⟩ | ⟨r₀, s₀, t₀, hr, hs, ht, u₁, u₂, v₁, v₂, w₁, w₂, h₁, h₂, m₁, m₂, h₃⟩)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hrs.imp Option.map_eq_none_iff.1 Option.map_eq_none_iff.1,
        Option.map_eq_none_iff.1 ht⟩
    · obtain ⟨r₀, rfl, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hr
      obtain ⟨s₀, rfl, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hs
      obtain ⟨t₀, rfl, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 ht
      obtain ⟨u₁, rfl⟩ := hS u₁
      obtain ⟨u₂, rfl⟩ := hS u₂
      obtain ⟨v₁, rfl⟩ := hS v₁
      obtain ⟨v₂, rfl⟩ := hS v₂
      obtain ⟨w₁, rfl⟩ := hS w₁
      obtain ⟨w₂, rfl⟩ := hS w₂
      exact Or.inr ⟨r₀, s₀, t₀, rfl, rfl, rfl, u₁, u₂, v₁, v₂, w₁, w₂, (hR _ _ _ _).1 h₁,
        (hR _ _ _ _).1 h₂, (hM _ _ _).1 m₁, (hM _ _ _).1 m₂, (hR _ _ _ _).1 h₃⟩
  · rintro (⟨hrs, rfl⟩ | ⟨r₀, s₀, t₀, rfl, rfl, rfl, u₁, u₂, v₁, v₂, w₁, w₂, h₁, h₂, m₁, m₂, h₃⟩)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hrs.imp Option.map_eq_none_iff.2 Option.map_eq_none_iff.2, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨_, _, _, rfl, rfl, rfl, frobEqClassMap e b u₁, frobEqClassMap e b u₂,
        frobEqClassMap e b v₁, frobEqClassMap e b v₂, frobEqClassMap e b w₁,
        frobEqClassMap e b w₂, (hR _ _ _ _).2 h₁, (hR _ _ _ _).2 h₂, (hM _ _ _).2 m₁,
        (hM _ _ _).2 m₂, (hR _ _ _ _).2 h₃⟩

name: AclGeom.blueprintRatioAddGraph_map_iff
statement:
theorem blueprintRatioAddGraph_map_iff (e : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L)
    (b : Fin 5 → Point k K)
    (r s t : Option ({u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq b u} ×
      {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq b u})) :
    BlueprintRatioAddGraph (Point.map e ∘ b)
        (r.map (Prod.map (frobEqClassMap e b) (frobEqClassMap e b)))
        (s.map (Prod.map (frobEqClassMap e b) (frobEqClassMap e b)))
        (t.map (Prod.map (frobEqClassMap e b) (frobEqClassMap e b))) ↔
      BlueprintRatioAddGraph b r s t
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ∀ u, (frobEqClassMap e b u).1 = Point.map e ∘ u.1 := fun _ ↦ rfl
  have hR : ∀ p₁ p₂ q₁ q₂ : {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq b u},
      BlueprintRatioEq (Point.map e ∘ b) ((frobEqClassMap e b p₁).1, (frobEqClassMap e b p₂).1)
          ((frobEqClassMap e b q₁).1, (frobEqClassMap e b q₂).1) ↔
        BlueprintRatioEq b (p₁.1, p₂.1) (q₁.1, q₂.1) := fun _ _ _ _ ↦ by
    rw [hc, hc, hc, hc]
    exact blueprintRatioEq_map_iff e
  have hN : ∀ u v : {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq b u},
      BlueprintJNeg (Point.map e ∘ b) (frobEqClassMap e b u).1 (frobEqClassMap e b v).1 ↔
        BlueprintJNeg b u.1 v.1 := fun _ _ ↦ by
    rw [hc, hc]
    exact blueprintJNeg_map_iff e
  have hA : ∀ u v w : {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq b u},
      BlueprintJAddTotalNZ (Point.map e ∘ b) (frobEqClassMap e b u).1 (frobEqClassMap e b v).1
          (frobEqClassMap e b w).1 ↔ BlueprintJAddTotalNZ b u.1 v.1 w.1 := fun _ _ _ ↦ by
    rw [hc, hc, hc]
    exact blueprintJAddTotalNZ_map_iff e
  have hS := (frobEqClassMap e b).surjective
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      (Option.map (Prod.map (frobEqClassMap e b) (frobEqClassMap e b))) :=
    Option.map_injective ((frobEqClassMap e b).prodCongr (frobEqClassMap e b)).injective
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨hr, hts⟩ | ⟨hs, htr⟩ | ⟨r₀, s₀, hr, hs, u, v, e', h₁, h₂, hbr⟩)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨Option.map_eq_none_iff.1 hr, hinj hts⟩
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨Option.map_eq_none_iff.1 hs, hinj htr⟩)
    · obtain ⟨r₀, rfl, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hr
      obtain ⟨s₀, rfl, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hs
      obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hS u
      obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hS v
      obtain ⟨e', rfl⟩ := hS e'
      refine Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨r₀, s₀, rfl, rfl, u, v, e', (hR _ _ _ _).1 h₁, (hR _ _ _ _).1 h₂, ?_⟩)
      rcases hbr with ⟨hneg, ht⟩ | ⟨w, t₀, ht, hsum, h₃⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨(hN _ _).1 hneg, Option.map_eq_none_iff.1 ht⟩
      · obtain ⟨t₀, rfl, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 ht
        obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hS w
        exact Or.inr ⟨w, t₀, rfl, (hA _ _ _).1 hsum, (hR _ _ _ _).1 h₃⟩
  · rintro (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨r₀, s₀, rfl, rfl, u, v, e', h₁, h₂, hbr⟩)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    · refine Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨_, _, rfl, rfl, frobEqClassMap e b u, frobEqClassMap e b v,
        frobEqClassMap e b e', (hR _ _ _ _).2 h₁, (hR _ _ _ _).2 h₂, ?_⟩)
      rcases hbr with ⟨hneg, rfl⟩ | ⟨w, t₀, rfl, hsum, h₃⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨(hN _ _).2 hneg, rfl⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨frobEqClassMap e b w, _, rfl, (hA _ _ _).2 hsum, (hR _ _ _ _).2 h₃⟩

name: AclGeom.blueprintRatioEq_of_mul_eq
statement:
theorem blueprintRatioEq_of_mul_eq (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K)
    {x₀ a p₁ p₂ q₁ q₂ : K} (h₀ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x₀, a])
    (h₁ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![p₁, a]) (h₂ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![p₂, a])
    (h₃ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![q₁, a]) (h₄ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![q₂, a])
    (h : p₁ * q₂ = p₂ * q₁) :
    BlueprintRatioEq (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) (jTupleOf p₁ a h₁, jTupleOf p₂ a h₂)
      (jTupleOf q₁ a h₃, jTupleOf q₂ a h₄)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hne : ∀ {w : K}, AlgebraicIndependent k ![w, a] → w ≠ 0 := fun {w} hw h0 ↦
    hw.transcendental 0 (by
      change IsAlgebraic k w
      rw [h0]
      exact isAlgebraic_zero)
  have hp₁0 := hne h₁
  have hp₂0 := hne h₂
  have hq₂0 := hne h₄
  
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := fresh_four_of_five_le_trdeg htr {a, p₁, p₂, q₁} Finset.card_le_four
  have ht' : t ∉ racl k ({a, p₁, p₂, q₁} : Set K) := by simpa using ht
  have haF : a ∈ racl k ({a, p₁, p₂, q₁} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  have hp₁F : p₁ ∈ racl k ({a, p₁, p₂, q₁} : Set K) :=
    subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert _ _))
  have hp₂F : p₂ ∈ racl k ({a, p₁, p₂, q₁} : Set K) :=
    subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)))
  have hq₁F : q₁ ∈ racl k ({a, p₁, p₂, q₁} : Set K) :=
    subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _
      (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_singleton _))))
  have hq₂F : q₂ ∈ racl k ({a, p₁, p₂, q₁} : Set K) := by
    have hq : q₂ = p₂ * q₁ / p₁ := (eq_div_iff hp₁0).2 (by rw [mul_comm, h])
    rw [hq]
    exact div_mem (mul_mem hp₂F hq₁F) hp₁F
  
  have hgen : ∀ {p c : K}, AlgebraicIndependent k ![p, a] → p ∈ racl k ({a, p₁, p₂, q₁} : Set K) →
      c ∈ racl k ({a, p₁, p₂, q₁} : Set K) → c ≠ 0 → AlgebraicIndependent k ![p, c * t, a] :=
    fun {p c} hp hpF hcF hc0 ↦ AlgebraicIndependent.insert_middle hp fun hm ↦ ht' (by
      have hle : racl k ({p, a} : Set K) ≤ racl k ({a, p₁, p₂, q₁} : Set K) :=
        racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.insert_subset hpF (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 haF))
      have h' := div_mem (hle hm) hcF
      rwa [mul_div_cancel_left₀ t hc0] at h')
  have T₁ := hgen h₁ hp₁F hq₂F hq₂0
  have T₂ := hgen h₂ hp₂F hq₂F hq₂0
  have T₃ := hgen h₃ hq₁F hp₂F hp₂0
  have T₄ := hgen h₄ hq₂F hp₂F hp₂0
  
  obtain ⟨d₁, hd₁, M₁, rfl⟩ : ∃ (d : K) (hd : AlgebraicIndependent k ![d, a]),
      BlueprintJMul (jTupleOf p₁ a h₁) (jTupleOf (q₂ * t) a (AlgebraicIndependent.pair_one_two T₁))
        (jTupleOf d a hd) ∧ d = algebraMap k K 1 * p₁ * (q₂ * t) :=
    ⟨_, _, blueprintJMul_kappa T₁ htr (one_ne_zero : (1 : k) ≠ 0), rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨d₂, hd₂, M₂, rfl⟩ : ∃ (d : K) (hd : AlgebraicIndependent k ![d, a]),
      BlueprintJMul (jTupleOf p₂ a h₂) (jTupleOf (q₂ * t) a (AlgebraicIndependent.pair_one_two T₁))
        (jTupleOf d a hd) ∧ d = algebraMap k K 1 * p₂ * (q₂ * t) :=
    ⟨_, _, blueprintJMul_kappa T₂ htr (one_ne_zero : (1 : k) ≠ 0), rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨d₃, hd₃, M₃, rfl⟩ : ∃ (d : K) (hd : AlgebraicIndependent k ![d, a]),
      BlueprintJMul (jTupleOf q₁ a h₃) (jTupleOf (p₂ * t) a (AlgebraicIndependent.pair_one_two T₃))
        (jTupleOf d a hd) ∧ d = algebraMap k K 1 * q₁ * (p₂ * t) :=
    ⟨_, _, blueprintJMul_kappa T₃ htr (one_ne_zero : (1 : k) ≠ 0), rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨d₄, hd₄, M₄, rfl⟩ : ∃ (d : K) (hd : AlgebraicIndependent k ![d, a]),
      BlueprintJMul (jTupleOf q₂ a h₄) (jTupleOf (p₂ * t) a (AlgebraicIndependent.pair_one_two T₃))
        (jTupleOf d a hd) ∧ d = algebraMap k K 1 * q₂ * (p₂ * t) :=
    ⟨_, _, blueprintJMul_kappa T₄ htr (one_ne_zero : (1 : k) ≠ 0), rfl⟩
  
  rw [jTupleOf_congr hd₃ hd₁ (by rw [map_one, one_mul, one_mul]; linear_combination -t * h)]
    at M₃
  rw [jTupleOf_congr hd₄ hd₂ (by rw [map_one, one_mul, one_mul]; ring)] at M₄
  have hJ : ∀ (w : K) (hw : AlgebraicIndependent k ![w, a]),
      FrobEq (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) (jTupleOf w a hw) := fun _ hw ↦
    frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr h₀ hw
  exact ⟨_, _, _, _, hJ _ _, hJ _ _, hJ _ hd₁, hJ _ hd₂, M₁, M₂, M₃, M₄⟩

name: AclGeom.MulPoint.incidence
statement:
private theorem MulPoint.incidence {U V W : Point k K} (h : MulPoint U V W) :
    U ≠ V ∧ V ≠ W ∧ W.1 ≤ U.1 ⊔ V.1 ∧ V.1 ≤ U.1 ⊔ W.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, R, _, _, _, _, -, hd⟩ := h
  have hUV : U ≠ V := by simpa using hd.distinct.ne (show (0 : Fin 8) ≠ 1 by decide)
  have hUW : U ≠ W := by simpa using hd.distinct.ne (show (0 : Fin 8) ≠ 3 by decide)
  have hVW : V ≠ W := by simpa using hd.distinct.ne (show (1 : Fin 8) ≠ 3 by decide)
  have hV : V.1 ≤ U.1 ⊔ (V.1 ⊔ (W.1 ⊔ R.1)) := le_sup_of_le_right le_sup_left
  have hW : W.1 ≤ U.1 ⊔ (V.1 ⊔ (W.1 ⊔ R.1)) :=
    le_sup_of_le_right (le_sup_of_le_right le_sup_left)
  have hUV' : U.1 ⊔ V.1 = U.1 ⊔ (V.1 ⊔ (W.1 ⊔ R.1)) :=
    RankEq.eq_of_le (sup_le le_sup_left hV) (rankEq_two_sup_of_ne hUV) hd.line_XYEV
  have hUW' : U.1 ⊔ W.1 = U.1 ⊔ (V.1 ⊔ (W.1 ⊔ R.1)) :=
    RankEq.eq_of_le (sup_le le_sup_left hW) (rankEq_two_sup_of_ne hUW) hd.line_XYEV
  exact ⟨hUV, hVW, hW.trans hUV'.ge, hV.trans hUW'.ge⟩

name: AclGeom.not_two_lines
proof:
:= by
  have hCD : RankEq 2 (C.1 ⊔ D.1) := rankEq_two_sup_of_ne hDC.symm
  have hL : C.1 ⊔ D.1 = P.1 ⊔ C.1 :=
    RankEq.eq_of_le (sup_le le_sup_right hD) hCD (rankEq_two_sup_of_ne hPC)
  have hL' : C.1 ⊔ D.1 = P'.1 ⊔ C.1 :=
    RankEq.eq_of_le (sup_le le_sup_right hD') hCD (rankEq_two_sup_of_ne hP'C)
  have hle : E ≤ P.1 ⊔ C.1 :=
    hEle.trans (sup_le le_sup_left (sup_le ((le_sup_left.trans hL'.ge).trans hL.le) le_sup_right))
  have hmono := (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).eRk_mono
    (show (E : Set K) ⊆ ((P.1 ⊔ C.1 : ClosedIF k K) : Set K) from
      fun _ hz ↦ ClosedIF.le_iff.1 hle hz)
  rw [rankEq_iff_eRk.1 hE, rankEq_iff_eRk.1 (rankEq_two_sup_of_ne hPC)] at hmono
  exact absurd (Nat.cast_le.1 hmono) (by decide)

name: AclGeom.not_blueprintRatioEq_sq
statement:
private theorem not_blueprintRatioEq_sq (b : Fin 5 → Point k K) {x a : K}
    (h₁ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, a]) (h₂ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x ^ 2, a]) :
    ¬ BlueprintRatioEq b (jTupleOf x a h₁, jTupleOf x a h₁)
      (jTupleOf x a h₁, jTupleOf (x ^ 2) a h₂)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨c₁, c₂, _, d₂, -, -, -, -, ⟨-, -, hind, hX₁, -, hQ₁, -⟩, ⟨-, -, -, -, -, hQ₂, -⟩,
    ⟨-, -, -, hX₃, -, hQ₃, -⟩, ⟨-, -, -, -, -, hQ₄, -⟩⟩
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ h₁.transcendental 0 (by
    change IsAlgebraic k x
    rw [h0]
    exact isAlgebraic_zero)
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ h₁.transcendental 1 (by
    change IsAlgebraic k a
    rw [h0]
    exact isAlgebraic_zero)
  
  have hA : (jTupleOf x a h₁ 4).1 ≤ (jTupleOf x a h₁ 0).1 ⊔ (jTupleOf x a h₁ 2).1 := by
    change point k a ≤ point k x ⊔ point k (x * a)
    refine ClosedIF.point_le_iff.2 ?_
    change a ∈ ((point k x ⊔ point k (x * a)).1 : IntermediateField k K)
    rw [coe_sup_point₂]
    have h := div_mem (subset_racl k ({x, x * a} : Set K)
      (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_singleton _))) (subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _))
    rwa [mul_div_cancel_left₀ a hx0] at h
  have hX : (jTupleOf x a h₁ 0).1 ≤ (jTupleOf x a h₁ 2).1 ⊔ (jTupleOf (x ^ 2) a h₂ 2).1 := by
    change point k x ≤ point k (x * a) ⊔ point k (x ^ 2 * a)
    refine ClosedIF.point_le_iff.2 ?_
    change x ∈ ((point k (x * a) ⊔ point k (x ^ 2 * a)).1 : IntermediateField k K)
    rw [coe_sup_point₂]
    have h := div_mem (subset_racl k ({x * a, x ^ 2 * a} : Set K)
      (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_singleton _))) (subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _))
    rwa [(div_eq_iff (mul_ne_zero hx0 ha0)).2 (by ring : x ^ 2 * a = x * (x * a))] at h
  have hA' : (jTupleOf x a h₁ 4).1 ≤ (jTupleOf x a h₁ 2).1 ⊔ (jTupleOf (x ^ 2) a h₂ 2).1 := by
    change point k a ≤ point k (x * a) ⊔ point k (x ^ 2 * a)
    refine ClosedIF.point_le_iff.2 ?_
    change a ∈ ((point k (x * a) ⊔ point k (x ^ 2 * a)).1 : IntermediateField k K)
    rw [coe_sup_point₂]
    have h := div_mem (pow_mem (subset_racl k ({x * a, x ^ 2 * a} : Set K)
      (Set.mem_insert _ _)) 2) (subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_singleton _)))
    rwa [(div_eq_iff (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 hx0) ha0)).2
      (by ring : (x * a) ^ 2 = a * (x ^ 2 * a))] at h
  
  have hC : c₂ 0 = c₁ 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨hXC, -, hD₁, -⟩ := hX₁.incidence
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, hC₂X⟩ := hX₃.incidence
    obtain ⟨hQC, -, hE₁, -⟩ := hQ₁.incidence
    obtain ⟨-, -, -, hC₂Q⟩ := hQ₃.incidence
    exact not_two_lines (P := jTupleOf x a h₁ 0) (P' := jTupleOf x a h₁ 2) (C := c₁ 0)
      (D := c₂ 0) hind (sup_le le_sup_left (sup_le (le_sup_of_le_right le_sup_right)
        (hA.trans (sup_le le_sup_left (le_sup_of_le_right le_sup_left)))))
      hXC hQC hne (hC₂X.trans (sup_le le_sup_left hD₁)) (hC₂Q.trans (sup_le le_sup_left hE₁))
  
  rw [hC] at hQ₄
  obtain ⟨hQC, hCE, hE, -⟩ := hQ₂.incidence
  obtain ⟨hQ'C, -, hE', -⟩ := hQ₄.incidence
  exact not_two_lines (P := jTupleOf x a h₁ 2) (P' := jTupleOf (x ^ 2) a h₂ 2) (C := c₁ 0)
    (D := d₂ 2) hind (sup_le (hX.trans (sup_le le_sup_left (le_sup_of_le_right le_sup_left)))
      (sup_le (le_sup_of_le_right le_sup_right)
        (hA'.trans (sup_le le_sup_left (le_sup_of_le_right le_sup_left)))))
    hQC hQ'C hCE.symm hE hE'

name: AclGeom.BlueprintJMul.of_right
statement:
private theorem BlueprintJMul.of_right {u v v' w : Fin 5 → Point k K} (h : BlueprintJMul u v w)
    (h₀ : v' 0 = v 0) (h₄ : v' 4 = v 4) : BlueprintJMul u v' w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, hi, hm₀, hs, hm₂, hm₃⟩ := h
  rw [← h₀] at hi hm₀ hm₂ hm₃
  rw [← h₄] at e₁ e₂
  exact ⟨e₁, e₂, hi, hm₀, hs, hm₂, hm₃⟩

name: AclGeom.pair_mul_of_triple
statement:
private theorem pair_mul_of_triple {p q a : K} (h : AlgebraicIndependent k ![p, q, a]) :
    AlgebraicIndependent k ![p * q, a]
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ h.transcendental 1 (by
    change IsAlgebraic k q
    rw [h0]
    exact isAlgebraic_zero)
  have h' : AlgebraicIndependent k ![p * q, q, a] := by
    refine AlgebraicIndependent.triple_of_mem h (fun i ↦ ?_) (fun i ↦ ?_)
    · fin_cases i
      · exact mul_mem (subset_racl k _ ⟨0, rfl⟩) (subset_racl k _ ⟨1, rfl⟩)
      · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨1, rfl⟩
      · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨2, rfl⟩
    · fin_cases i
      · have hpq : p * q ∈ racl k (Set.range ![p * q, q, a]) := subset_racl k _ ⟨0, rfl⟩
        have hq : q ∈ racl k (Set.range ![p * q, q, a]) := subset_racl k _ ⟨1, rfl⟩
        have hp := div_mem hpq hq
        rwa [mul_div_cancel_right₀ p hq0] at hp
      · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨1, rfl⟩
      · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨2, rfl⟩
  exact AlgebraicIndependent.pair_zero_two h'

name: AclGeom.blueprintJMul_of_mul
statement:
private theorem blueprintJMul_of_mul {p q d a : K} (hpq : AlgebraicIndependent k ![p, q, a])
    (hd : AlgebraicIndependent k ![d, a]) (h : p * q = d) :
    BlueprintJMul (jTupleOf p a (AlgebraicIndependent.pair_zero_two hpq))
      (jTupleOf q a (AlgebraicIndependent.pair_one_two hpq)) (jTupleOf d a hd)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (u v : Fin 5 → Point k K) (t : K) (ht : AlgebraicIndependent k ![t, a]),
      t = d → BlueprintJMul u v (jTupleOf t a ht) → BlueprintJMul u v (jTupleOf d a hd) := by
    rintro _ _ _ _ rfl hj
    exact hj
  exact key _ _ _ _ (by rw [map_one, one_mul, h])
    (blueprintJMul_kappa hpq htr (one_ne_zero : (1 : k) ≠ 0))

name: AclGeom.blueprintRatioEq_not_transitive
statement:
theorem blueprintRatioEq_not_transitive :
    ∃ (x₀ a : K) (h₀ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x₀, a]),
      ¬ IsTrans ({u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) u} ×
          {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) u}) fun r s ↦
        BlueprintRatioEq (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) (r.1.1, r.2.1) (s.1.1, s.2.1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, y, a, hind⟩ := exists_algebraicIndependent_triple htr
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := fresh_four_of_five_le_trdeg htr {x, y, a}
    (Finset.card_le_three.trans (by norm_num))
  have hz' : z ∉ racl k ({x, y, a} : Set K) := by simpa using hz
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hind.transcendental 0 (by
    change IsAlgebraic k x
    rw [h0]
    exact isAlgebraic_zero)
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hind.transcendental 1 (by
    change IsAlgebraic k y
    rw [h0]
    exact isAlgebraic_zero)
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hz' (by rw [h0]; exact zero_mem _)
  have hxw : x * x⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hx0
  have hyw : y * y⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hy0
  
  have hxF : x ∈ racl k ({x, y, a} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  have hyF : y ∈ racl k ({x, y, a} : Set K) :=
    subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert _ _))
  have haF : a ∈ racl k ({x, y, a} : Set K) :=
    subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_singleton _)))
  have hsub : ∀ p ∈ racl k ({x, y, a} : Set K),
      racl k ({p, a} : Set K) ≤ racl k ({x, y, a} : Set K) := fun p hp ↦
    racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.insert_subset hp (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 haF))
  have hxa : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, a] := AlgebraicIndependent.pair_zero_two hind
  have hya : AlgebraicIndependent k ![y, a] := AlgebraicIndependent.pair_one_two hind
  have hza : AlgebraicIndependent k ![z, a] :=
    AlgebraicIndependent.pair_zero_two (AlgebraicIndependent.insert_left hya fun h ↦
      hz' (racl_mono (Set.subset_insert _ _) h))
  have hx2a : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x ^ 2, a] :=
    (algebraicIndependent_congr_racl (v := ![x, a]) (w := ![x ^ 2, a])
      (Fin.forall_fin_two.2 ⟨(racl_pow x two_ne_zero).symm, rfl⟩)).1 hxa
  have hxya : x ∉ racl k ({y, a} : Set K) := by
    have h := AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_image hind (S := {1, 2}) (i := 0) (by decide)
    rwa [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton] at h
  
  have T₁ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, z / y, a] :=
    AlgebraicIndependent.insert_middle hxa fun h ↦ hz' (by
      have h' := mul_mem (hsub x hxF h) hyF
      rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ z hy0] at h')
  have T₂ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, (z / y) ^ 2, a] :=
    AlgebraicIndependent.insert_middle hxa fun h ↦ hz' (by
      have h' := mul_mem ((isRAC_racl _).mem_of_pow_mem two_ne_zero (hsub x hxF h)) hyF
      rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ z hy0] at h')
  have T₃ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![y, x * z / y ^ 2, a] :=
    AlgebraicIndependent.insert_middle hya fun h ↦ hz' (by
      have h' := div_mem (mul_mem (hsub y hyF h) (pow_mem hyF 2)) hxF
      rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (pow_ne_zero 2 hy0), mul_div_cancel_left₀ z hx0] at h')
  have T₄ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![z, x * z / y ^ 2, a] :=
    AlgebraicIndependent.insert_middle hza fun h ↦ hz' (by
      have hG : racl k ({z, a} : Set K) ≤ racl k (insert z ({y, a} : Set K)) :=
        racl_mono (Set.insert_subset_insert (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2
          (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_singleton a))))
      have hyG : y ∈ racl k (insert z ({y, a} : Set K)) :=
        subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert _ _))
      have hzG : z ∈ racl k (insert z ({y, a} : Set K)) := subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
      have hx := div_mem (mul_mem (hG h) (pow_mem hyG 2)) hzG
      rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (pow_ne_zero 2 hy0), mul_div_cancel_right₀ x hz0] at hx
      exact racl_exchange hx hxya)
  have T₅ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, z / (x * y), a] :=
    AlgebraicIndependent.insert_middle hxa fun h ↦ hz' (by
      have h' := mul_mem (hsub x hxF h) (mul_mem hxF hyF)
      rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ z (mul_ne_zero hx0 hy0)] at h')
  have T₆ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x ^ 2, (z / (x * y)) ^ 2, a] :=
    AlgebraicIndependent.insert_middle hx2a fun h ↦ hz' (by
      have h' := mul_mem ((isRAC_racl _).mem_of_pow_mem two_ne_zero
        (hsub (x ^ 2) (pow_mem hxF 2) h)) (mul_mem hxF hyF)
      rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ z (mul_ne_zero hx0 hy0)] at h')
  have T₇ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![y, z / y ^ 2, a] :=
    AlgebraicIndependent.insert_middle hya fun h ↦ hz' (by
      have h' := mul_mem (hsub y hyF h) (pow_mem hyF 2)
      rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ z (pow_ne_zero 2 hy0)] at h')
  have T₈ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![z, z / y ^ 2, a] :=
    AlgebraicIndependent.insert_middle hza fun h ↦ hz' (by
      have hy2 := div_mem (subset_racl k ({z, a} : Set K) (Set.mem_insert _ _)) h
      rw [div_div_cancel₀ hz0] at hy2
      have hy := racl_exchange ((isRAC_racl _).mem_of_pow_mem two_ne_zero hy2)
        (AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_pair' hya)
      exact racl_mono (Set.subset_insert _ _) hy)
  
  have hJ : ∀ (p : K) (hp : AlgebraicIndependent k ![p, a]),
      FrobEq (jTupleOf x a hxa) (jTupleOf p a hp) := fun _ hp ↦
    frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr hxa hp
  
  have hrm : BlueprintRatioEq (jTupleOf x a hxa) (jTupleOf x a hxa, jTupleOf x a hxa)
      (jTupleOf y a hya, jTupleOf z a hza) :=
    ⟨_, _, _, _, hJ _ (AlgebraicIndependent.pair_one_two T₁),
      hJ _ (AlgebraicIndependent.pair_one_two T₃),
      hJ _ (pair_mul_of_triple T₁), hJ _ (pair_mul_of_triple T₂),
      blueprintJMul_of_mul htr T₁ (pair_mul_of_triple T₁) rfl,
      (blueprintJMul_of_mul htr T₂ (pair_mul_of_triple T₂) rfl).of_right
        (Subtype.ext (point_pow (z / y) two_ne_zero).symm) (jTupleOf_four_eq _ _),
      blueprintJMul_of_mul htr T₃ (pair_mul_of_triple T₁) (by linear_combination (x * z / y) * hyw),
      blueprintJMul_of_mul htr T₄ (pair_mul_of_triple T₂) (by ring)⟩
  
  have hmt : BlueprintRatioEq (jTupleOf x a hxa) (jTupleOf y a hya, jTupleOf z a hza)
      (jTupleOf x a hxa, jTupleOf (x ^ 2) a hx2a) :=
    ⟨_, _, _, _, hJ _ (AlgebraicIndependent.pair_one_two T₇),
      hJ _ (AlgebraicIndependent.pair_one_two T₅),
      hJ _ (pair_mul_of_triple T₅), hJ _ (pair_mul_of_triple T₆),
      blueprintJMul_of_mul htr T₇ (pair_mul_of_triple T₅)
        (by linear_combination (z / y) * hyw - (z / y) * hxw),
      blueprintJMul_of_mul htr T₈ (pair_mul_of_triple T₆)
        (by linear_combination (-(z ^ 2 / y ^ 2) * (x * x⁻¹ + 1)) * hxw),
      blueprintJMul_of_mul htr T₅ (pair_mul_of_triple T₅) rfl,
      (blueprintJMul_of_mul htr T₆ (pair_mul_of_triple T₆) rfl).of_right
        (Subtype.ext (point_pow (z / (x * y)) two_ne_zero).symm) (jTupleOf_four_eq _ _)⟩
  refine ⟨x, a, hxa, fun htrans ↦ not_blueprintRatioEq_sq (jTupleOf x a hxa) hxa hx2a ?_⟩
  exact @IsTrans.trans _ _ htrans (⟨_, hJ x hxa⟩, ⟨_, hJ x hxa⟩) (⟨_, hJ y hya⟩, ⟨_, hJ z hza⟩)
    (⟨_, hJ x hxa⟩, ⟨_, hJ _ hx2a⟩) hrm hmt

name: AclGeom.exists_common_denominator
statement:
private theorem exists_common_denominator (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K)
    {x₀ a p q p' q' : K} (h₀ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x₀, a])
    (hp : AlgebraicIndependent k ![p, a]) (hq : AlgebraicIndependent k ![q, a])
    (hp' : AlgebraicIndependent k ![p', a]) (hq' : AlgebraicIndependent k ![q', a])
    (r s : {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) u} ×
      {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) u})
    (hr : (r.1.1, r.2.1) = (jTupleOf p a hp, jTupleOf q a hq))
    (hs : (s.1.1, s.2.1) = (jTupleOf p' a hp', jTupleOf q' a hq')) :
    ∃ (e : K) (he : AlgebraicIndependent k ![e, a])
      (hce : AlgebraicIndependent k ![p / q * e, a])
      (hde : AlgebraicIndependent k ![p' / q' * e, a]),
      e ∉ racl k ({a, p / q, p' / q'} : Set K) ∧
      BlueprintRatioEq (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) (r.1.1, r.2.1)
        (jTupleOf (p / q * e) a hce, jTupleOf e a he) ∧
      BlueprintRatioEq (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) (s.1.1, s.2.1)
        (jTupleOf (p' / q' * e) a hde, jTupleOf e a he)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hne : ∀ {w : K}, AlgebraicIndependent k ![w, a] → w ≠ 0 := fun {w} hw h0 ↦
    hw.transcendental 0 (by
      change IsAlgebraic k w
      rw [h0]
      exact isAlgebraic_zero)
  have hq0 := hne hq
  have hq'0 := hne hq'
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := fresh_four_of_five_le_trdeg htr {a, p / q, p' / q'}
    (Finset.card_le_three.trans (by norm_num))
  have he' : e ∉ racl k ({a, p / q, p' / q'} : Set K) := by simpa using he
  have hmono : racl k ({a} : Set K) ≤ racl k ({a, p / q, p' / q'} : Set K) :=
    racl_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (Set.mem_insert _ _))
  have hcF : p / q ∈ racl k ({a, p / q, p' / q'} : Set K) :=
    subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert _ _))
  have hdF : p' / q' ∈ racl k ({a, p / q, p' / q'} : Set K) :=
    subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_singleton _)))
  have hea : AlgebraicIndependent k ![e, a] := pair_of_notMem h₀ fun hm ↦ he' (hmono hm)
  have hmul : ∀ {c : K}, c ∈ racl k ({a, p / q, p' / q'} : Set K) → c ≠ 0 →
      AlgebraicIndependent k ![c * e, a] := fun {c} hcm hc0 ↦ pair_of_notMem h₀ fun hm ↦ he' (by
    have h' := div_mem (hmono hm) hcm
    rwa [mul_div_cancel_left₀ e hc0] at h')
  have hce := hmul hcF (div_ne_zero (hne hp) hq0)
  have hde := hmul hdF (div_ne_zero (hne hp') hq'0)
  refine ⟨e, hea, hce, hde, he', ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hr]
    exact blueprintRatioEq_of_mul_eq htr h₀ hp hq hce hea
      (by linear_combination (-e) * div_mul_cancel₀ p hq0)
  · rw [hs]
    exact blueprintRatioEq_of_mul_eq htr h₀ hp' hq' hde hea
      (by linear_combination (-e) * div_mul_cancel₀ p' hq'0)

name: AclGeom.blueprintRatioAddGraph_of_add_ratio_eq_zero
statement:
theorem blueprintRatioAddGraph_of_add_ratio_eq_zero (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K)
    {x₀ a p q p' q' : K} (h₀ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x₀, a])
    (hp : AlgebraicIndependent k ![p, a]) (hq : AlgebraicIndependent k ![q, a])
    (hp' : AlgebraicIndependent k ![p', a]) (hq' : AlgebraicIndependent k ![q', a])
    (r s : {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) u} ×
      {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) u})
    (hr : (r.1.1, r.2.1) = (jTupleOf p a hp, jTupleOf q a hq))
    (hs : (s.1.1, s.2.1) = (jTupleOf p' a hp', jTupleOf q' a hq'))
    (h : p * q' + p' * q = 0) :
    BlueprintRatioAddGraph (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) (some r) (some s) none
proof:
:= by
  have hne : ∀ {w : K}, AlgebraicIndependent k ![w, a] → w ≠ 0 := fun {w} hw h0 ↦
    hw.transcendental 0 (by
      change IsAlgebraic k w
      rw [h0]
      exact isAlgebraic_zero)
  have hq0 := hne hq
  have hq'0 := hne hq'
  obtain ⟨e, he, hce, hde, -, R₁, R₂⟩ := exists_common_denominator htr h₀ hp hq hp' hq' r s hr hs
  have hm1 : (-1 : k) ≠ 0 := neg_ne_zero.2 one_ne_zero
  
  have hsum : p / q + p' / q' = 0 := by
    rw [div_add_div _ _ hq0 hq'0, div_eq_zero_iff]
    exact Or.inl (by linear_combination h)
  have hdc : algebraMap k K (-1) * (p / q * e) = p' / q' * e := by
    rw [map_neg, map_one]
    linear_combination (-e) * hsum
  have N := blueprintJNeg_smul htr h₀ hce hm1
  rw [jTupleOf_congr (AlgebraicIndependent.smul_left hce hm1) hde hdc] at N
  have hJ : ∀ (w : K) (hw : AlgebraicIndependent k ![w, a]),
      FrobEq (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) (jTupleOf w a hw) := fun _ hw ↦
    frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr h₀ hw
  exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨r, s, rfl, rfl, ⟨_, hJ _ hce⟩, ⟨_, hJ _ hde⟩, ⟨_, hJ _ he⟩, R₁, R₂,
    Or.inl ⟨N, rfl⟩⟩)

name: AclGeom.blueprintRatioAddGraph_of_add_ratio
statement:
theorem blueprintRatioAddGraph_of_add_ratio (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K)
    {x₀ a p q p' q' p'' q'' : K} (h₀ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x₀, a])
    (hp : AlgebraicIndependent k ![p, a]) (hq : AlgebraicIndependent k ![q, a])
    (hp' : AlgebraicIndependent k ![p', a]) (hq' : AlgebraicIndependent k ![q', a])
    (hp'' : AlgebraicIndependent k ![p'', a]) (hq'' : AlgebraicIndependent k ![q'', a])
    (r s t : {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) u} ×
      {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) u})
    (hr : (r.1.1, r.2.1) = (jTupleOf p a hp, jTupleOf q a hq))
    (hs : (s.1.1, s.2.1) = (jTupleOf p' a hp', jTupleOf q' a hq'))
    (ht : (t.1.1, t.2.1) = (jTupleOf p'' a hp'', jTupleOf q'' a hq''))
    (h : p'' * (q * q') = q'' * (p * q' + p' * q)) :
    BlueprintRatioAddGraph (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) (some r) (some s) (some t)
proof:
:= by
  have hne : ∀ {w : K}, AlgebraicIndependent k ![w, a] → w ≠ 0 := fun {w} hw h0 ↦
    hw.transcendental 0 (by
      change IsAlgebraic k w
      rw [h0]
      exact isAlgebraic_zero)
  have hq0 := hne hq
  have hq'0 := hne hq'
  obtain ⟨e, he, hce, hde, he', R₁, R₂⟩ := exists_common_denominator htr h₀ hp hq hp' hq' r s hr hs
  
  have hsum : p / q + p' / q' ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ by
    rw [div_add_div _ _ hq0 hq'0, div_eq_zero_iff] at h0
    have hS : p * q' + p' * q = 0 := by
      linear_combination h0.resolve_right (mul_ne_zero hq0 hq'0)
    rw [hS, mul_zero] at h
    exact hne hp'' ((mul_eq_zero.1 h).resolve_right (mul_ne_zero hq0 hq'0))
  have hcF : p / q ∈ racl k ({a, p / q, p' / q'} : Set K) :=
    subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert _ _))
  have hdF : p' / q' ∈ racl k ({a, p / q, p' / q'} : Set K) :=
    subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_singleton _)))
  have hcde : AlgebraicIndependent k ![p / q * e + p' / q' * e, a] := pair_of_notMem h₀ fun hm ↦
    he' (by
      have h' := div_mem (racl_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (Set.mem_insert _ _)) hm)
        (add_mem hcF hdF)
      rwa [← add_mul, mul_div_cancel_left₀ e hsum] at h')
  
  have A := blueprintJAddTotalNZ_of_pairs htr h₀ hce hde hcde
  have hval : (p / q + p' / q') * q'' = p'' :=
    mul_right_cancel₀ (mul_ne_zero hq0 hq'0) (by
      linear_combination (q' * q'') * div_mul_cancel₀ p hq0 + (q * q'') * div_mul_cancel₀ p' hq'0
        - h)
  have R₃ : BlueprintRatioEq (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀)
      (jTupleOf (p / q * e + p' / q' * e) a hcde, jTupleOf e a he) (t.1.1, t.2.1) := by
    rw [ht]
    exact blueprintRatioEq_of_mul_eq htr h₀ hcde he hp'' hq'' (by linear_combination e * hval)
  have hJ : ∀ (w : K) (hw : AlgebraicIndependent k ![w, a]),
      FrobEq (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) (jTupleOf w a hw) := fun _ hw ↦
    frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr h₀ hw
  exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨r, s, rfl, rfl, ⟨_, hJ _ hce⟩, ⟨_, hJ _ hde⟩, ⟨_, hJ _ he⟩, R₁, R₂,
    Or.inr ⟨⟨_, hJ _ hcde⟩, t, rfl, A, R₃⟩⟩)

name: AclGeom.blueprintRatioAddGraph_total
statement:
theorem blueprintRatioAddGraph_total [PerfectField K] (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K)
    {x₀ a : K} (h₀ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x₀, a])
    (r s : Option ({u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) u} ×
      {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) u})) :
    ∃ t, BlueprintRatioAddGraph (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) r s t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases r with _ | r
  · exact ⟨s, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  rcases s with _ | s
  · exact ⟨some r, Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)⟩
  
  have : IsAlgClosed ↥(algebraicClosure k (AlgebraicClosure K)) := IsAlgClosure.isAlgClosed k
  have hcomp : JCompletenessACF (↥(algebraicClosure k (AlgebraicClosure K)))
      (AlgebraicClosure K) := jCompletenessACF (five_le_trdeg_algebraicClosure htr)
  have hnorm := fun {w : Fin 5 → Point k K} (hw : FrobEq (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) w) ↦
    (frobEq_jTupleOf_iff (ringExpChar K) htr hcomp h₀).1 hw
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpe⟩ := hnorm r.1.2
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqe⟩ := hnorm r.2.2
  obtain ⟨p', hp', hp'e⟩ := hnorm s.1.2
  obtain ⟨q', hq', hq'e⟩ := hnorm s.2.2
  by_cases hS : p * q' + p' * q = 0
  · exact ⟨none, blueprintRatioAddGraph_of_add_ratio_eq_zero htr h₀ hp hq hp' hq' r s
      (Prod.ext hpe hqe) (Prod.ext hp'e hq'e) hS⟩
  have hne : ∀ {w : K}, AlgebraicIndependent k ![w, a] → w ≠ 0 := fun {w} hw h0 ↦
    hw.transcendental 0 (by
      change IsAlgebraic k w
      rw [h0]
      exact isAlgebraic_zero)
  have hq0 := hne hq
  have hq'0 := hne hq'
  have hsum : p / q + p' / q' ≠ 0 := by
    rw [div_add_div _ _ hq0 hq'0]
    exact div_ne_zero (fun h0 ↦ hS (by linear_combination h0)) (mul_ne_zero hq0 hq'0)
  
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := fresh_four_of_five_le_trdeg htr {a, p / q + p' / q'}
    (Finset.card_le_two.trans (by norm_num))
  have he' : e ∉ racl k ({a, p / q + p' / q'} : Set K) := by simpa using he
  have hea : AlgebraicIndependent k ![e, a] := pair_of_notMem h₀ fun hm ↦ he' (racl_mono
    (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (Set.mem_insert _ _)) hm)
  have hcdea : AlgebraicIndependent k ![(p / q + p' / q') * e, a] := pair_of_notMem h₀ fun hm ↦
    he' (by
      have h' := div_mem (racl_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (Set.mem_insert _ _)) hm)
        (subset_racl k ({a, p / q + p' / q'} : Set K)
          (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_singleton _)))
      rwa [mul_div_cancel_left₀ e hsum] at h')
  refine ⟨some (⟨_, frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr h₀ hcdea⟩,
    ⟨_, frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr h₀ hea⟩), ?_⟩
  exact blueprintRatioAddGraph_of_add_ratio htr h₀ hp hq hp' hq' hcdea hea r s _
    (Prod.ext hpe hqe) (Prod.ext hp'e hq'e) rfl (by
      linear_combination (e * q') * div_mul_cancel₀ p hq0 + (e * q) * div_mul_cancel₀ p' hq'0)

name: AclGeom.triple_smul_left
statement:
private theorem triple_smul_left {x y a : K} (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, y, a])
    {κ : k} (hκ : κ ≠ 0) : AlgebraicIndependent k ![algebraMap k K κ * x, y, a]
proof:
:= by
  refine (algebraicIndependent_congr_racl (v := ![x, y, a])
    (w := ![algebraMap k K κ * x, y, a]) fun i ↦ ?_).1 hind
  fin_cases i
  · exact (racl_algebraMap_mul hκ x).symm
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: AclGeom.blueprintJNeg_smul
statement:
theorem blueprintJNeg_smul {x₀ x a : K} (h₀ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x₀, a])
    (hx : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, a]) {c : k} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    BlueprintJNeg (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) (jTupleOf x a hx)
      (jTupleOf (algebraMap k K c * x) a (AlgebraicIndependent.smul_left hx hc))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := fresh_four_of_five_le_trdeg htr {x, a}
    (Finset.card_le_two.trans (by norm_num))
  have hz' : z ∉ racl k ({x, a} : Set K) := by simpa using hz
  have hxm : x ∈ racl k ({x, a} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert x _)
  
  have T₁ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, z, a] := AlgebraicIndependent.insert_middle hx hz'
  have T₂ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![algebraMap k K c * x, algebraMap k K (-c) * x + z, a] := by
    refine AlgebraicIndependent.insert_middle (AlgebraicIndependent.smul_left hx hc)
      fun h ↦ hz' ?_
    have hle : racl k ({algebraMap k K c * x, a} : Set K) ≤ racl k ({x, a} : Set K) :=
      racl_le_of_subset_racl (by
        rintro w (rfl | rfl)
        · exact mul_mem (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ c) hxm
        · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem x rfl))
    exact mem_racl_of_eq (show z = algebraMap k K (-c) * x + z - algebraMap k K (-c) * x by ring)
      (sub_mem (hle h) (mul_mem (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ (-c)) hxm))
  refine ⟨jTupleOf z a (AlgebraicIndependent.pair_one_two T₁),
    jTupleOf (algebraMap k K (-c) * x + z) a (AlgebraicIndependent.pair_one_two T₂),
    frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr h₀ _, frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr h₀ _,
    blueprintJAdd_kappa T₁ htr (neg_ne_zero.2 hc), ?_⟩
  convert blueprintJAdd_kappa T₂ htr one_ne_zero using 1
  exact jTupleOf_congr _ _ (by rw [map_one, map_neg]; ring)

name: AclGeom.blueprintJNeg_not_functional
statement:
theorem blueprintJNeg_not_functional {x₀ x a : K} (h₀ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x₀, a])
    (hx : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, a]) {c : k} (hc : c ≠ 0) (hc1 : c ≠ -1) :
    BlueprintJNeg (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) (jTupleOf x a hx)
        (jTupleOf (algebraMap k K c * x) a (AlgebraicIndependent.smul_left hx hc)) ∧
      BlueprintJNeg (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) (jTupleOf x a hx)
        (jTupleOf (algebraMap k K (-1) * x) a
          (AlgebraicIndependent.smul_left hx (neg_ne_zero.2 one_ne_zero))) ∧
      jTupleOf (algebraMap k K c * x) a (AlgebraicIndependent.smul_left hx hc) ≠
        jTupleOf (algebraMap k K (-1) * x) a
          (AlgebraicIndependent.smul_left hx (neg_ne_zero.2 one_ne_zero))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨blueprintJNeg_smul htr h₀ hx hc,
    blueprintJNeg_smul htr h₀ hx (neg_ne_zero.2 one_ne_zero), fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  have h1 := congrArg (fun t ↦ (t 1).1) h
  simp only [jTupleOf_one] at h1
  have hx0 : x ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) := fun h' ↦
    AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_pair' hx (racl_mono (Set.empty_subset _) h')
  have hxx : x ∈ racl k ({x} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ rfl
  refine point_ne_of_sub (κ := c + 1) (r := x) (fun h' ↦ hc1 (eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h'))
    ?_ hx0 (fun h' ↦ ?_) h1
  · rw [map_add, map_neg, map_one]
    ring
  · exact AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_pair hx (mem_racl_of_eq
      (show a = algebraMap k K (-1) * x + a - x + (x + x) by rw [map_neg, map_one]; ring)
      (add_mem h' (add_mem hxx hxx)))

name: AclGeom.blueprintJNeg_self
statement:
theorem blueprintJNeg_self {x₀ x a : K} (h₀ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x₀, a])
    (hx : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, a]) (h2 : (2 : k) ≠ 0) :
    BlueprintJNeg (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) (jTupleOf x a hx) (jTupleOf x a hx) ∧
      jTupleOf x a hx ≠ jTupleOf (algebraMap k K (-1) * x) a
        (AlgebraicIndependent.smul_left hx (neg_ne_zero.2 one_ne_zero))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, -, h3⟩ := blueprintJNeg_not_functional htr h₀ hx one_ne_zero
    fun h ↦ h2 (by linear_combination h)
  have e : jTupleOf (algebraMap k K 1 * x) a (AlgebraicIndependent.smul_left hx one_ne_zero) =
      jTupleOf x a hx :=
    jTupleOf_congr _ _ (by rw [map_one, one_mul])
  rw [e] at h1 h3
  exact ⟨h1, h3⟩

name: AclGeom.blueprintJNeg_not_functional_on_class
statement:
theorem blueprintJNeg_not_functional_on_class :
    ∃ u v₁ v₂ : Fin 5 → Point k K, FrobEq u u ∧ FrobEq u v₁ ∧ FrobEq u v₂ ∧
      BlueprintJNeg u u v₁ ∧ BlueprintJNeg u u v₂ ∧ v₁ ≠ v₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, y, a, hind⟩ := exists_algebraicIndependent_triple htr
  have hx := AlgebraicIndependent.pair_zero_two hind
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Infinite.exists_notMem_finset ({0, -1} : Finset k)
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, not_or] at hc
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := blueprintJNeg_not_functional htr hx hx hc.1 hc.2
  exact ⟨_, _, _, frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr hx hx, frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr hx _,
    frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr hx _, h1, h2, h3⟩

name: AclGeom.blueprintJAddTotalNZ_kappa
statement:
theorem blueprintJAddTotalNZ_kappa {x₀ x y a : K} (h₀ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x₀, a])
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, y, a]) {κ : k} (hκ : κ ≠ 0) :
    BlueprintJAddTotalNZ (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) (jTupleOf x a (AlgebraicIndependent.pair_zero_two hind))
      (jTupleOf y a (AlgebraicIndependent.pair_one_two hind))
      (jTupleOf (algebraMap k K κ * x + y) a (JArith.pair_add_a (triple_smul_left hind hκ)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := fresh_four_of_five_le_trdeg htr {x, y, a}
    (Finset.card_le_three.trans (by norm_num))
  have hz' : z ∉ racl k ({x, y, a} : Set K) := by simpa using hz
  have hx : x ∈ racl k ({x, y, a} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert x _)
  have hy : y ∈ racl k ({x, y, a} : Set K) :=
    subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem x (Set.mem_insert y _))
  have ha : a ∈ racl k ({x, y, a} : Set K) :=
    subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem x (Set.mem_insert_of_mem y rfl))
  have hsub : ∀ {p q : K}, p ∈ racl k ({x, y, a} : Set K) → q ∈ racl k ({x, y, a} : Set K) →
      z ∉ racl k ({p, q} : Set K) := fun hp hq hm ↦ hz' (racl_le_of_subset_racl (by
        rintro w (rfl | rfl)
        · exact hp
        · exact hq) hm)
  have hm1 : (-1 : k) ≠ 0 := neg_ne_zero.2 one_ne_zero
  
  have T₁ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, z, a] :=
    AlgebraicIndependent.insert_middle (AlgebraicIndependent.pair_zero_two hind) (hsub hx ha)
  have hza : AlgebraicIndependent k ![z, a] := AlgebraicIndependent.pair_one_two T₁
  have T₂ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![y, algebraMap k K (-1) * z, a] := by
    refine AlgebraicIndependent.insert_middle (AlgebraicIndependent.pair_one_two hind)
      fun h ↦ hsub hy ha ?_
    simpa using mul_mem (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ (-1 : k)) h
  have hr : AlgebraicIndependent k ![algebraMap k K κ * x + z, a] :=
    JArith.pair_add_a (triple_smul_left T₁ hκ)
  have hw : AlgebraicIndependent k ![algebraMap k K κ * x + y, a] :=
    JArith.pair_add_a (triple_smul_left hind hκ)
  have T₃ : AlgebraicIndependent k
      ![algebraMap k K κ * x + z, algebraMap k K 1 * y + algebraMap k K (-1) * z, a] := by
    refine AlgebraicIndependent.insert_middle hr fun h ↦ hz' ?_
    
    
    have hsum : algebraMap k K κ * x + y ∈
        racl k (insert (algebraMap k K κ * x + z) ({a} : Set K)) :=
      mem_racl_of_eq (show algebraMap k K κ * x + y =
          (algebraMap k K 1 * y + algebraMap k K (-1) * z) + (algebraMap k K κ * x + z) by
            rw [map_neg, map_one]; ring)
        (add_mem h (subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)))
    have hle : racl k (insert (algebraMap k K κ * x + y) ({a} : Set K)) ≤
        racl k ({x, y, a} : Set K) :=
      racl_le_of_subset_racl (by
        rintro w (rfl | rfl)
        · exact add_mem (mul_mem (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ κ) hx) hy
        · exact ha)
    exact mem_racl_of_eq (show z = algebraMap k K κ * x + z - algebraMap k K κ * x by ring)
      (sub_mem (hle (racl_exchange hsum (AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_pair' hw)))
        (mul_mem (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ κ) hx))
  refine ⟨jTupleOf z a hza,
    jTupleOf (algebraMap k K (-1) * z) a (AlgebraicIndependent.smul_left hza hm1),
    jTupleOf (algebraMap k K κ * x + z) a hr,
    jTupleOf (algebraMap k K 1 * y + algebraMap k K (-1) * z) a
      (AlgebraicIndependent.pair_one_two T₃),
    frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr h₀ _, frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr h₀ _,
    frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr h₀ _, frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr h₀ _,
    blueprintJNeg_smul htr h₀ hza hm1, blueprintJAdd_kappa T₁ htr hκ,
    blueprintJAdd_kappa T₂ htr one_ne_zero, ?_⟩
  convert blueprintJAdd_kappa T₃ htr one_ne_zero using 1
  exact jTupleOf_congr _ _ (by rw [map_neg, map_one]; ring)

name: AclGeom.blueprintJAddTotalNZ_not_functional
statement:
theorem blueprintJAddTotalNZ_not_functional {x₀ x y a : K}
    (h₀ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x₀, a]) (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, y, a]) {κ : k}
    (hκ : κ ≠ 0) (hκ1 : κ ≠ 1) :
    BlueprintJAddTotalNZ (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) (jTupleOf x a (AlgebraicIndependent.pair_zero_two hind))
        (jTupleOf y a (AlgebraicIndependent.pair_one_two hind))
        (jTupleOf (algebraMap k K κ * x + y) a (JArith.pair_add_a (triple_smul_left hind hκ))) ∧
      BlueprintJAddTotalNZ (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀)
        (jTupleOf x a (AlgebraicIndependent.pair_zero_two hind))
        (jTupleOf y a (AlgebraicIndependent.pair_one_two hind))
        (jTupleOf (algebraMap k K 1 * x + y) a
          (JArith.pair_add_a (triple_smul_left hind one_ne_zero))) ∧
      jTupleOf (algebraMap k K κ * x + y) a (JArith.pair_add_a (triple_smul_left hind hκ)) ≠
        jTupleOf (algebraMap k K 1 * x + y) a
          (JArith.pair_add_a (triple_smul_left hind one_ne_zero))
proof:
:=
  ⟨blueprintJAddTotalNZ_kappa htr h₀ hind hκ, blueprintJAddTotalNZ_kappa htr h₀ hind one_ne_zero,
    (blueprintJAdd_not_functional hind htr hκ hκ1).2.2⟩

name: AclGeom.blueprintJAddTotalNZ_not_functional_on_class
statement:
theorem blueprintJAddTotalNZ_not_functional_on_class :
    ∃ u v w₁ w₂ : Fin 5 → Point k K, FrobEq u u ∧ FrobEq u v ∧ FrobEq u w₁ ∧ FrobEq u w₂ ∧
      BlueprintJAddTotalNZ u u v w₁ ∧ BlueprintJAddTotalNZ u u v w₂ ∧ w₁ ≠ w₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, y, a, hind⟩ := exists_algebraicIndependent_triple htr
  have hx := AlgebraicIndependent.pair_zero_two hind
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ⟩ := Infinite.exists_notMem_finset ({0, 1} : Finset k)
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, not_or] at hκ
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := blueprintJAddTotalNZ_not_functional htr hx hind hκ.1 hκ.2
  exact ⟨_, _, _, _, frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr hx hx, frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr hx _,
    frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr hx _, frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr hx _, h1, h2, h3⟩

name: AclGeom.blueprintRatioAddGraph_not_functional_after_map
statement:
theorem blueprintRatioAddGraph_not_functional_after_map
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K) {x a : K}
    (h₀ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, a]) (h2 : (2 : k) ≠ 0)
    (f : ({u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x a h₀) u} ×
      {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x a h₀) u}) → A) :
    ¬ ∀ r s t t' : Option ({u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x a h₀) u} ×
        {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x a h₀) u}),
      BlueprintRatioAddGraph (jTupleOf x a h₀) r s t →
      BlueprintRatioAddGraph (jTupleOf x a h₀) r s t' → t.map f = t'.map f
proof:
:= by
  have hJ := frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr h₀ h₀
  let u : {w : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x a h₀) w} :=
    ⟨jTupleOf x a h₀, hJ⟩
  let r := (u, u)
  have hR : BlueprintRatioEq (jTupleOf x a h₀) (u.1, u.1) (u.1, u.1) :=
    blueprintRatioEq_of_mul_eq htr h₀ h₀ h₀ h₀ h₀ rfl
  have hN := (blueprintJNeg_self htr h₀ h₀ h2).1
  have hzero : BlueprintRatioAddGraph (jTupleOf x a h₀) (some r) (some r) none :=
    Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨r, r, rfl, rfl, u, u, u, hR, hR, Or.inl ⟨hN, rfl⟩⟩)
  have hx2 : AlgebraicIndependent k ![algebraMap k K 2 * x, a] :=
    AlgebraicIndependent.smul_left h₀ h2
  let v : {w : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x a h₀) w} :=
    ⟨jTupleOf (algebraMap k K 2 * x) a hx2, frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr h₀ hx2⟩
  let t := (v, u)
  have hnonzero : BlueprintRatioAddGraph (jTupleOf x a h₀) (some r) (some r) (some t) :=
    blueprintRatioAddGraph_of_add_ratio htr h₀ h₀ h₀ h₀ h₀ hx2 h₀ r r t rfl rfl rfl
      (by rw [map_ofNat]; ring)
  intro h
  have heq := h (some r) (some r) none (some t) hzero hnonzero
  cases heq

name: AclGeom.mul_notMem_racl_singleton
statement:
theorem mul_notMem_racl_singleton {s t c : K} (hs : s ∉ racl k ({t} : Set K))
    (hc : c ∈ racl k ({t} : Set K)) (hc0 : c ≠ 0) : s * c ∉ racl k ({t} : Set K)
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  hs (by simpa only [mul_div_cancel_right₀ s hc0] using div_mem h hc)

name: AclGeom.mul_notMem_bot
statement:
theorem mul_notMem_bot {s t c : K} (hst : AlgebraicIndependent k ![s, t])
    (hc : c ∈ racl k ({t} : Set K)) (hc0 : c ≠ 0) : s * c ∉ (⊥ : ClosedIF k K)
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  mul_notMem_racl_singleton (AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_pair' hst) hc hc0
    (racl_mono (Set.empty_subset _) (mem_racl_empty_of_isAlgebraic (mem_bot_iff.1 h)))

name: AclGeom.isAlgebraic_div_sq_of_qLocus
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_div_sq_of_qLocus [IsAlgClosed M] [CharZero M] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    {S T U V : Ω} (hST : AlgebraicIndependent M ![S, T])
    (hUS : U ∈ racl M ({S} : Set Ω)) (hSU : S ∈ racl M ({U} : Set Ω))
    (hVW : V ∈ racl M ({S * T ^ 2} : Set Ω)) (hWV : S * T ^ 2 ∈ racl M ({V} : Set Ω))
    (hZ : U + V ∈ racl M ({S * (1 + T) ^ 2} : Set Ω))
    (hZ' : S * (1 + T) ^ 2 ∈ racl M ({U + V} : Set Ω))
    (hGT : V / U ∈ racl M ({T} : Set Ω)) (hTG : T ∈ racl M ({V / U} : Set Ω)) :
    IsAlgebraic M (S / U ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hS_T : S ∉ racl M ({T} : Set Ω) := AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_pair' hST
  have hTe : T ∉ racl M (∅ : Set Ω) := fun h ↦
    AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_pair hST (racl_mono (Set.empty_subset _) h)
  have hGe : V / U ∉ racl M (∅ : Set Ω) := notMem_racl_empty_of_mem_singleton hTe hTG
  have hT0 : T ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_notMem_racl_empty hTe
  have h1T0 : 1 + T ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_notMem_racl_empty (one_add_notMem_racl_empty hTe)
  have hG0 : V / U ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_notMem_racl_empty hGe
  have h1G0 : 1 + V / U ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_notMem_racl_empty (one_add_notMem_racl_empty hGe)
  have hTT : T ∈ racl M ({T} : Set Ω) := subset_racl M _ rfl
  have hnot : ∀ {z w : Ω}, z ∈ racl M ({w} : Set Ω) → z ∉ racl M ({T} : Set Ω) →
      w ∉ racl M ({T} : Set Ω) := fun hzw hz hw ↦
    hz (racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hw) hzw)
  have hU_T : U ∉ racl M ({T} : Set Ω) := hnot hSU hS_T
  have hW_T : S * T ^ 2 ∉ racl M ({T} : Set Ω) :=
    mul_notMem_racl_singleton hS_T (pow_mem hTT 2) (pow_ne_zero 2 hT0)
  have hZ_T : S * (1 + T) ^ 2 ∉ racl M ({T} : Set Ω) :=
    mul_notMem_racl_singleton hS_T (pow_mem (add_mem (one_mem _) hTT) 2) (pow_ne_zero 2 h1T0)
  have hV_T : V ∉ racl M ({T} : Set Ω) := hnot hWV hW_T
  have hUV_T : U + V ∉ racl M ({T} : Set Ω) := hnot hZ' hZ_T
  have hS0 : S ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hS_T (by rw [h]; exact zero_mem _)
  have hU0 : U ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hU_T (by rw [h]; exact zero_mem _)
  have hNt : ∀ {z : Ω}, z ∉ racl M ({T} : Set Ω) →
      Transcendental ↥(racl M ({T} : Set Ω)) z := fun hz ↦ transcendental_racl_of_notMem hz
  have hSM : Transcendental M S := fun h ↦ hNt hS_T (h.tower_top _)
  
  obtain ⟨F, hFp, hF⟩ := exists_prime_span_idealOf M hSM hUS
  have hF0 : F ≠ 0 := hFp.ne_zero
  have hFx : MvPolynomial.aeval ![S, U] F = 0 :=
    (mem_idealOf_iff M).1 (hF ▸ Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  have hGU : V / U * U = V := div_mul_cancel₀ V hU0
  have h1GU : (1 + V / U) * U = U + V := by rw [add_mul, one_mul, hGU]
  
  have hchar₁ : ∀ {m₁ m₂ : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ}, m₁ ∈ F.support → m₂ ∈ F.support →
      ∃ r : M, (T ^ 2) ^ ((m₁ 0 : ℤ) - m₂ 0) * (V / U) ^ ((m₁ 1 : ℤ) - m₂ 1) =
        algebraMap M Ω r := fun hm₁ hm₂ ↦
    exists_character_of_scaled_locus (pow_mem hTT 2) hGT (pow_ne_zero 2 hT0) hG0
      (hNt hS_T) (hNt hU_T) hUS hSU
      (hNt (by rw [mul_comm (T ^ 2) S]; exact hW_T)) (hNt (by rw [hGU]; exact hV_T))
      (by rw [hGU, mul_comm (T ^ 2) S]; exact hVW) (by rw [hGU, mul_comm (T ^ 2) S]; exact hWV)
      hF0 hF hm₁ hm₂
