name: AclGeom.ratFunc_X_notMem_adjoin_sq
statement:
private theorem ratFunc_X_notMem_adjoin_sq (k : Type*) [Field k] :
    (RatFunc.X : RatFunc k) ∉ adjoin k {(RatFunc.X : RatFunc k) ^ 2}
proof:
:= by
  have hdegree : Module.finrank (adjoin k {(RatFunc.X : RatFunc k) ^ 2}) (RatFunc k) = 2 := by
    rw [show (RatFunc.X : RatFunc k) ^ 2 =
      algebraMap (Polynomial k) (RatFunc k) (Polynomial.X ^ 2) by simp,
      RatFunc.finrank_eq_max_natDegree, RatFunc.num_algebraMap, RatFunc.denom_algebraMap]
    simp
  intro hmem
  have htop : adjoin k {(RatFunc.X : RatFunc k) ^ 2} = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    rw [← RatFunc.adjoin_X]
    exact adjoin_simple_le_iff.mpr hmem
  rw [htop, IntermediateField.finrank_top] at hdegree
  exact (by decide : (1 : ℕ) ≠ 2) hdegree

name: AclGeom.adjoin_sq_lt_of_transcendental
proof:
:= by
  let f : RatFunc k →ₐ[k] Ω :=
    (adjoin k {t}).val.comp (RatFunc.algEquivOfTranscendental t ht).toAlgHom
  have hfX : f RatFunc.X = t := by
    simp [f]
  have hmap : (adjoin k {(RatFunc.X : RatFunc k) ^ 2}).map f = adjoin k {t ^ 2} := by
    rw [adjoin_map, Set.image_singleton, map_pow, hfX]
  have hnot : t ∉ adjoin k {t ^ 2} := by
    rw [← hmap, ← hfX, map_mem_map]
    exact ratFunc_X_notMem_adjoin_sq k
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne (adjoin_simple_le_iff.mpr (pow_mem (mem_adjoin_simple_self k t) 2)) ?_
  intro heq
  rw [heq] at hnot
  exact hnot (mem_adjoin_simple_self k t)

name: AclGeom.exists_compositeBranchField_lt_chainField
statement:
theorem exists_compositeBranchField_lt_chainField
    {k Ω : Type*} [Field k] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω] {t : Ω}
    (ht : Transcendental k t) :
    ∃ (P Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) (h : P.target = Q.source),
      (P.comp Q h).branchField < P.chainField Q
proof:
:= by
  have ht0 : t ∉ racl k (∅ : Set Ω) := notMem_racl_empty_of_transcendental ht
  have ht2 : t ^ 2 ∉ racl k (∅ : Set Ω) := by
    intro h
    exact ht0 (racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr h)
      (mem_racl_singleton_pow (k := k) (x := t) (by decide : 2 ≠ 0)))
  let P : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω :=
    { source := t ^ 2
      target := t
      source_generic := ht2
      target_mem_source := mem_racl_singleton_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0)
      source_mem_target := pow_mem (subset_racl k {t} rfl) 2 }
  refine ⟨P, P.swap, rfl, ?_⟩
  change adjoin k {t ^ 2, t ^ 2} < adjoin k {t ^ 2, t, t ^ 2}
  have hchain : adjoin k {t ^ 2, t, t ^ 2} = adjoin k {t} := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · refine adjoin_le_iff.mpr ?_
      simp only [Set.insert_subset_iff, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
      exact ⟨pow_mem (mem_adjoin_simple_self k t) 2,
        mem_adjoin_simple_self k t, pow_mem (mem_adjoin_simple_self k t) 2⟩
    · exact adjoin_simple_le_iff.mpr (subset_adjoin k _ (by simp))
  simpa only [Set.insert_eq_of_mem (Set.mem_singleton _), hchain] using
    adjoin_sq_lt_of_transcendental ht

name: AclGeom.blueprintJAddTotalNZ_of_pairs
statement:
theorem blueprintJAddTotalNZ_of_pairs (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K)
    {x₀ x y a : K} (h₀ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x₀, a])
    (hx : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, a]) (hy : AlgebraicIndependent k ![y, a])
    (hxy : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x + y, a]) :
    BlueprintJAddTotalNZ (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) (jTupleOf x a hx) (jTupleOf y a hy)
      (jTupleOf (x + y) a hxy)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := fresh_four_of_five_le_trdeg htr {x, y, a}
    (Finset.card_le_three.trans (by norm_num))
  have hz' : z ∉ racl k ({x, y, a} : Set K) := by simpa using hz
  have hxF : x ∈ racl k ({x, y, a} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert x _)
  have hyF : y ∈ racl k ({x, y, a} : Set K) :=
    subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem x (Set.mem_insert y _))
  have haF : a ∈ racl k ({x, y, a} : Set K) :=
    subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem x (Set.mem_insert_of_mem y rfl))
  have hsub : ∀ {p : K}, p ∈ racl k ({x, y, a} : Set K) → z ∉ racl k ({p, a} : Set K) :=
    fun hp hm ↦ hz' (racl_le_of_subset_racl (by
      rintro w (rfl | rfl)
      · exact hp
      · exact haF) hm)
  have hm1 : (-1 : k) ≠ 0 := neg_ne_zero.2 one_ne_zero
  
  have T₁ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, z, a] := AlgebraicIndependent.insert_middle hx (hsub hxF)
  have hza : AlgebraicIndependent k ![z, a] := AlgebraicIndependent.pair_one_two T₁
  have T₂ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![y, algebraMap k K (-1) * z, a] := by
    refine AlgebraicIndependent.insert_middle hy fun h ↦ hsub hyF ?_
    exact mem_racl_of_eq (show z = algebraMap k K (-1) * (algebraMap k K (-1) * z) by
      rw [map_neg, map_one]; ring) (mul_mem (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ (-1 : k)) h)
  have hr : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x + z, a] := JArith.pair_add_a T₁
  have hs : AlgebraicIndependent k ![y + algebraMap k K (-1) * z, a] := JArith.pair_add_a T₂
  have T₃ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x + z, y + algebraMap k K (-1) * z, a] := by
    refine AlgebraicIndependent.insert_middle hr fun h ↦ hz' ?_
    
    
    have hsum : x + y ∈ racl k (insert (x + z) ({a} : Set K)) :=
      mem_racl_of_eq (show x + y = (y + algebraMap k K (-1) * z) + (x + z) by
          rw [map_neg, map_one]; ring)
        (add_mem h (subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)))
    have hle : racl k (insert (x + y) ({a} : Set K)) ≤ racl k ({x, y, a} : Set K) :=
      racl_le_of_subset_racl (by
        rintro w (rfl | rfl)
        · exact add_mem hxF hyF
        · exact haF)
    exact mem_racl_of_eq (show z = x + z - x by ring)
      (sub_mem (hle (racl_exchange hsum (AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_pair' hxy))) hxF)
  
  obtain ⟨r, _, A₁, hreq⟩ : ∃ (r : K) (hr' : AlgebraicIndependent k ![r, a]),
      BlueprintJAdd (jTupleOf x a hx) (jTupleOf z a hza) (jTupleOf r a hr') ∧
        r = algebraMap k K 1 * x + z :=
    ⟨_, _, blueprintJAdd_kappa T₁ htr one_ne_zero, rfl⟩
  rw [map_one, one_mul] at hreq
  subst hreq
  obtain ⟨s, _, A₂, hseq⟩ : ∃ (s : K) (hs' : AlgebraicIndependent k ![s, a]),
      BlueprintJAdd (jTupleOf y a hy)
        (jTupleOf (algebraMap k K (-1) * z) a (AlgebraicIndependent.smul_left hza hm1))
        (jTupleOf s a hs') ∧ s = algebraMap k K 1 * y + algebraMap k K (-1) * z :=
    ⟨_, _, blueprintJAdd_kappa T₂ htr one_ne_zero, rfl⟩
  rw [map_one, one_mul] at hseq
  subst hseq
  obtain ⟨w, _, A₃, hweq⟩ : ∃ (w : K) (hw : AlgebraicIndependent k ![w, a]),
      BlueprintJAdd (jTupleOf (x + z) a hr) (jTupleOf (y + algebraMap k K (-1) * z) a hs)
        (jTupleOf w a hw) ∧ w = algebraMap k K 1 * (x + z) + (y + algebraMap k K (-1) * z) :=
    ⟨_, _, blueprintJAdd_kappa T₃ htr one_ne_zero, rfl⟩
  rw [show algebraMap k K 1 * (x + z) + (y + algebraMap k K (-1) * z) = x + y by
    rw [map_neg, map_one]; ring] at hweq
  subst hweq
  
  exact ⟨jTupleOf z a hza,
    jTupleOf (algebraMap k K (-1) * z) a (AlgebraicIndependent.smul_left hza hm1),
    jTupleOf (x + z) a hr, jTupleOf (y + algebraMap k K (-1) * z) a hs,
    frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr h₀ _, frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr h₀ _,
    frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr h₀ _, frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr h₀ _,
    blueprintJNeg_smul htr h₀ hza hm1, A₁, A₂, A₃⟩

name: AclGeom.sumPoint_map_iff
statement:
theorem sumPoint_map_iff (e : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L) {U V W : Point k K} :
    SumPoint (Point.map e U) (Point.map e V) (Point.map e W) ↔ SumPoint U V W
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨R, hR⟩
    obtain ⟨R₀, rfl⟩ := (Point.map e).surjective R
    exact ⟨R₀, (qGeom_map_iff e).1 hR⟩
  · rintro ⟨R, hR⟩
    exact ⟨Point.map e R, (qGeom_map_iff e).2 hR⟩

name: AclGeom.blueprintJAdd_map_iff
statement:
theorem blueprintJAdd_map_iff (e : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L) {u v w : Fin 5 → Point k K} :
    BlueprintJAdd (Point.map e ∘ u) (Point.map e ∘ v) (Point.map e ∘ w) ↔ BlueprintJAdd u v w
proof:
:=
  and_congr (Point.map e).injective.eq_iff <| and_congr (Point.map e).injective.eq_iff <|
    and_congr (pointTripleIndependent_map_iff e) <| and_congr (sumPoint_map_iff e) <|
      and_congr (sumPoint_map_iff e) <| and_congr (sumPoint_map_iff e) (sumPoint_map_iff e)

name: AclGeom.blueprintJMul_map_iff
statement:
theorem blueprintJMul_map_iff (e : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L) {u v w : Fin 5 → Point k K} :
    BlueprintJMul (Point.map e ∘ u) (Point.map e ∘ v) (Point.map e ∘ w) ↔ BlueprintJMul u v w
proof:
:=
  and_congr (Point.map e).injective.eq_iff <| and_congr (Point.map e).injective.eq_iff <|
    and_congr (pointTripleIndependent_map_iff e) <| and_congr (mulPoint_map_iff e) <|
      and_congr (sumPoint_map_iff e) <| and_congr (mulPoint_map_iff e) (mulPoint_map_iff e)

name: AclGeom.blueprintRatioEq_map_iff
statement:
theorem blueprintRatioEq_map_iff (e : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L)
    {b r₁ r₂ s₁ s₂ : Fin 5 → Point k K} :
    BlueprintRatioEq (Point.map e ∘ b) (Point.map e ∘ r₁, Point.map e ∘ r₂)
        (Point.map e ∘ s₁, Point.map e ∘ s₂) ↔
      BlueprintRatioEq b (r₁, r₂) (s₁, s₂)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hT : ∀ x : Fin 5 → Point l L, ∃ x₀, Point.map e ∘ x₀ = x :=
    (Equiv.piCongrRight fun _ : Fin 5 ↦ Point.map e).surjective
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c₁, c₂, d₁, d₂, hc₁, hc₂, hd₁, hd₂, m₁, m₂, m₃, m₄⟩
    obtain ⟨c₁₀, rfl⟩ := hT c₁
    obtain ⟨c₂₀, rfl⟩ := hT c₂
    obtain ⟨d₁₀, rfl⟩ := hT d₁
    obtain ⟨d₂₀, rfl⟩ := hT d₂
    exact ⟨c₁₀, c₂₀, d₁₀, d₂₀, (frobEq_map_iff e).1 hc₁, (frobEq_map_iff e).1 hc₂,
      (frobEq_map_iff e).1 hd₁, (frobEq_map_iff e).1 hd₂, (blueprintJMul_map_iff e).1 m₁,
      (blueprintJMul_map_iff e).1 m₂, (blueprintJMul_map_iff e).1 m₃,
      (blueprintJMul_map_iff e).1 m₄⟩
  · rintro ⟨c₁, c₂, d₁, d₂, hc₁, hc₂, hd₁, hd₂, m₁, m₂, m₃, m₄⟩
    exact ⟨Point.map e ∘ c₁, Point.map e ∘ c₂, Point.map e ∘ d₁, Point.map e ∘ d₂,
      (frobEq_map_iff e).2 hc₁, (frobEq_map_iff e).2 hc₂, (frobEq_map_iff e).2 hd₁,
      (frobEq_map_iff e).2 hd₂, (blueprintJMul_map_iff e).2 m₁, (blueprintJMul_map_iff e).2 m₂,
      (blueprintJMul_map_iff e).2 m₃, (blueprintJMul_map_iff e).2 m₄⟩

name: AclGeom.blueprintJNeg_map_iff
statement:
theorem blueprintJNeg_map_iff (e : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L) {b u v : Fin 5 → Point k K} :
    BlueprintJNeg (Point.map e ∘ b) (Point.map e ∘ u) (Point.map e ∘ v) ↔ BlueprintJNeg b u v
proof:
:= by
  have hT : ∀ x : Fin 5 → Point l L, ∃ x₀, Point.map e ∘ x₀ = x :=
    (Equiv.piCongrRight fun _ : Fin 5 ↦ Point.map e).surjective
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, r, hz, hr, m₁, m₂⟩
    obtain ⟨z₀, rfl⟩ := hT z
    obtain ⟨r₀, rfl⟩ := hT r
    exact ⟨z₀, r₀, (frobEq_map_iff e).1 hz, (frobEq_map_iff e).1 hr,
      (blueprintJAdd_map_iff e).1 m₁, (blueprintJAdd_map_iff e).1 m₂⟩
  · rintro ⟨z, r, hz, hr, m₁, m₂⟩
    exact ⟨Point.map e ∘ z, Point.map e ∘ r, (frobEq_map_iff e).2 hz, (frobEq_map_iff e).2 hr,
      (blueprintJAdd_map_iff e).2 m₁, (blueprintJAdd_map_iff e).2 m₂⟩

name: AclGeom.blueprintJAddTotalNZ_map_iff
statement:
theorem blueprintJAddTotalNZ_map_iff (e : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L)
    {b u v w : Fin 5 → Point k K} :
    BlueprintJAddTotalNZ (Point.map e ∘ b) (Point.map e ∘ u) (Point.map e ∘ v)
        (Point.map e ∘ w) ↔ BlueprintJAddTotalNZ b u v w
proof:
:= by
  have hT : ∀ x : Fin 5 → Point l L, ∃ x₀, Point.map e ∘ x₀ = x :=
    (Equiv.piCongrRight fun _ : Fin 5 ↦ Point.map e).surjective
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, nz, r, s, hz, hnz, hr, hs, hneg, m₁, m₂, m₃⟩
    obtain ⟨z₀, rfl⟩ := hT z
    obtain ⟨nz₀, rfl⟩ := hT nz
    obtain ⟨r₀, rfl⟩ := hT r
    obtain ⟨s₀, rfl⟩ := hT s
    exact ⟨z₀, nz₀, r₀, s₀, (frobEq_map_iff e).1 hz, (frobEq_map_iff e).1 hnz,
      (frobEq_map_iff e).1 hr, (frobEq_map_iff e).1 hs, (blueprintJNeg_map_iff e).1 hneg,
      (blueprintJAdd_map_iff e).1 m₁, (blueprintJAdd_map_iff e).1 m₂,
      (blueprintJAdd_map_iff e).1 m₃⟩
  · rintro ⟨z, nz, r, s, hz, hnz, hr, hs, hneg, m₁, m₂, m₃⟩
    exact ⟨Point.map e ∘ z, Point.map e ∘ nz, Point.map e ∘ r, Point.map e ∘ s,
      (frobEq_map_iff e).2 hz, (frobEq_map_iff e).2 hnz, (frobEq_map_iff e).2 hr,
      (frobEq_map_iff e).2 hs, (blueprintJNeg_map_iff e).2 hneg, (blueprintJAdd_map_iff e).2 m₁,
      (blueprintJAdd_map_iff e).2 m₂, (blueprintJAdd_map_iff e).2 m₃⟩

name: AclGeom.blueprintRatioAddGraph_wrong_sum
statement:
theorem blueprintRatioAddGraph_wrong_sum [Infinite k] [PerfectField K]
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K) :
    ∃ (x y a : K) (κ : k) (hx : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, a])
      (hy : AlgebraicIndependent k ![y, a])
      (hp : AlgebraicIndependent k ![algebraMap k K κ * x + y, a])
      (r s t : {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x a hx) u} ×
        {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x a hx) u}),
      (r.1.1, r.2.1) = (jTupleOf x a hx, jTupleOf y a hy) ∧
      (s.1.1, s.2.1) = (jTupleOf y a hy, jTupleOf y a hy) ∧
      (t.1.1, t.2.1) = (jTupleOf (algebraMap k K κ * x + y) a hp, jTupleOf y a hy) ∧
      BlueprintRatioAddGraph (jTupleOf x a hx) (some r) (some s) (some t) ∧
      (algebraMap k K κ * x + y) / y ≠ x / y + y / y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, y, a, hind⟩ := exists_algebraicIndependent_triple htr
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ⟩ := Infinite.exists_notMem_finset ({0, 1} : Finset k)
  have hκ0 : κ ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hκ (by rw [h]; exact Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
  have hκ1 : κ ≠ 1 := fun h ↦ hκ (by
    rw [h]
    exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self _))
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hind.transcendental 0 (by
    change IsAlgebraic k x
    rw [h0]
    exact isAlgebraic_zero)
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hind.transcendental 1 (by
    change IsAlgebraic k y
    rw [h0]
    exact isAlgebraic_zero)
  have hx : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, a] := AlgebraicIndependent.pair_zero_two hind
  have hy : AlgebraicIndependent k ![y, a] := AlgebraicIndependent.pair_one_two hind
  
  obtain ⟨p, hp, A, rfl⟩ : ∃ (p : K) (hp : AlgebraicIndependent k ![p, a]),
      BlueprintJAddTotalNZ (jTupleOf x a hx) (jTupleOf x a hx) (jTupleOf y a hy)
        (jTupleOf p a hp) ∧ p = algebraMap k K κ * x + y :=
    ⟨_, _, blueprintJAddTotalNZ_kappa htr hx hind hκ0, rfl⟩
  have hJ : ∀ (w : K) (hw : AlgebraicIndependent k ![w, a]),
      FrobEq (jTupleOf x a hx) (jTupleOf w a hw) := fun _ hw ↦
    frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr hx hw
  let r : {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x a hx) u} ×
      {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x a hx) u} :=
    (⟨_, hJ x hx⟩, ⟨_, hJ y hy⟩)
  let s : {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x a hx) u} ×
      {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x a hx) u} :=
    (⟨_, hJ y hy⟩, ⟨_, hJ y hy⟩)
  let t : {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x a hx) u} ×
      {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x a hx) u} :=
    (⟨_, hJ _ hp⟩, ⟨_, hJ y hy⟩)
  refine ⟨x, y, a, κ, hx, hy, hp, r, s, t, rfl, rfl, rfl,
    Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨r, s, rfl, rfl, r.1, s.1, r.2, blueprintRatioEq_refl htr hx r,
      blueprintRatioEq_refl htr hx s,
      Or.inr ⟨t.1, t, rfl, A, blueprintRatioEq_refl htr hx t⟩⟩), ?_⟩
  
  intro h
  rw [add_div, div_self hy0] at h
  have h' : algebraMap k K κ * x = x := (div_left_inj' hy0).1 (add_right_cancel h)
  exact hκ1 ((algebraMap k K).injective ((mul_right_cancel₀ hx0
    (h'.trans (one_mul x).symm)).trans (map_one _).symm))

name: AclGeom.blueprintRatioMulGraph_wrong_product
statement:
theorem blueprintRatioMulGraph_wrong_product [Infinite k] [PerfectField K]
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K) :
    ∃ (x y a : K) (κ : k) (hx : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, a])
      (hy : AlgebraicIndependent k ![y, a])
      (hp : AlgebraicIndependent k ![algebraMap k K κ * x * y, a])
      (hq : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x * y, a])
      (r s t : {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x a hx) u} ×
        {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x a hx) u}),
      (r.1.1, r.2.1) = (jTupleOf x a hx, jTupleOf y a hy) ∧
      (s.1.1, s.2.1) = (jTupleOf y a hy, jTupleOf x a hx) ∧
      (t.1.1, t.2.1) = (jTupleOf (algebraMap k K κ * x * y) a hp, jTupleOf (x * y) a hq) ∧
      BlueprintRatioMulGraph (jTupleOf x a hx) (some r) (some s) (some t) ∧
      algebraMap k K κ * x * y / (x * y) ≠ x / y * (y / x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, y, a, hind⟩ := exists_algebraicIndependent_triple htr
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ⟩ := Infinite.exists_notMem_finset ({0, 1} : Finset k)
  have hκ0 : κ ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hκ (by rw [h]; exact Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
  have hκ1 : κ ≠ 1 := fun h ↦ hκ (by
    rw [h]
    exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self _))
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hind.transcendental 0 (by
    change IsAlgebraic k x
    rw [h0]
    exact isAlgebraic_zero)
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hind.transcendental 1 (by
    change IsAlgebraic k y
    rw [h0]
    exact isAlgebraic_zero)
  have hx : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, a] := AlgebraicIndependent.pair_zero_two hind
  have hy : AlgebraicIndependent k ![y, a] := AlgebraicIndependent.pair_one_two hind
  
  have hind' : AlgebraicIndependent k ![y, x, a] :=
    (by funext i; fin_cases i <;> rfl : ![x, y, a] ∘ ![1, 0, 2] = ![y, x, a]) ▸
      hind.comp ![1, 0, 2] (by decide)
  
  obtain ⟨p, hp, M, rfl⟩ : ∃ (p : K) (hp : AlgebraicIndependent k ![p, a]),
      BlueprintJMul (jTupleOf x a hx) (jTupleOf y a hy) (jTupleOf p a hp) ∧
        p = algebraMap k K κ * x * y :=
    ⟨_, _, blueprintJMul_kappa hind htr hκ0, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hq', M', hq'eq⟩ : ∃ (q : K) (hq : AlgebraicIndependent k ![q, a]),
      BlueprintJMul (jTupleOf y a hy) (jTupleOf x a hx) (jTupleOf q a hq) ∧
        q = algebraMap k K 1 * y * x :=
    ⟨_, _, blueprintJMul_kappa hind' htr (one_ne_zero : (1 : k) ≠ 0), rfl⟩
  rw [map_one, one_mul, mul_comm] at hq'eq
  subst hq'eq
  have hJ : ∀ (w : K) (hw : AlgebraicIndependent k ![w, a]),
      FrobEq (jTupleOf x a hx) (jTupleOf w a hw) := fun _ hw ↦
    frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr hx hw
  let r : {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x a hx) u} ×
      {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x a hx) u} :=
    (⟨_, hJ x hx⟩, ⟨_, hJ y hy⟩)
  let s : {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x a hx) u} ×
      {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x a hx) u} :=
    (⟨_, hJ y hy⟩, ⟨_, hJ x hx⟩)
  let t : {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x a hx) u} ×
      {u : Fin 5 → Point k K // FrobEq (jTupleOf x a hx) u} :=
    (⟨_, hJ _ hp⟩, ⟨_, hJ _ hq'⟩)
  refine ⟨x, y, a, κ, hx, hy, hp, hq', r, s, t, rfl, rfl, rfl,
    Or.inr ⟨r, s, t, rfl, rfl, rfl, r.1, r.2, s.1, s.2, t.1, t.2,
      blueprintRatioEq_refl htr hx r, blueprintRatioEq_refl htr hx s, M, M',
      blueprintRatioEq_refl htr hx t⟩, ?_⟩
  
  have hxy : x * y ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hx0 hy0
  rw [mul_assoc, mul_div_assoc, div_self hxy, mul_one, div_mul_div_comm, mul_comm y x,
    div_self hxy]
  exact fun h ↦ hκ1 ((algebraMap k K).injective (h.trans (map_one _).symm))

name: AclGeom.Perfection.frobZPow_injective
statement:
theorem frobZPow_injective (π : Perfection K) (hp : π.p ≠ 1)
    (htr : 0 < Algebra.trdeg k K) : Function.Injective π.frobZPow
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < Algebra.trdeg (π.basePerf k) π.carrier :=
    Cardinal.lift_lt.1 ((Cardinal.lift_lt.2 htr).trans_le
      (lift_trdeg_le_of_orderIso (π.latticeIso k)))
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_notMem_racl_of_mk_lt_trdeg (k := π.basePerf k)
    (∅ : Set π.carrier) (by simpa using hpos)
  exact fun m n h ↦ frobeniusZPow_injective (k := π.basePerf k) π.p hp hz h

name: AclGeom.Test.isRAC_bot_ratFn
statement: theorem isRAC_bot_ratFn : IsRAC (⊥ : IntermediateField k (RatFn k n))
proof:
:= by
  have hbot : (⊥ : ClosedIF k (RatFn k n)).1 = ⊥ := by
    refine le_antisymm (fun x hx ↦ ?_) bot_le
    have hxalg : IsAlgebraic k x := ClosedIF.mem_bot_iff.1 (ClosedIF.mem_val.1 hx)
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ :=
      mem_range_algebraMap_of_isAlgebraic_fractionRing (F := k) (σ := Fin n) hxalg
    exact IntermediateField.mem_bot.2 ⟨c, hc⟩
  rw [← hbot]
  exact (⊥ : ClosedIF k (RatFn k n)).2

name: AclGeom.Test.trdeg_ratFn
statement: theorem trdeg_ratFn : Algebra.trdeg k (RatFn k n) = n
proof:
:= by
  have hb := (isTranscendenceBasis_iff_racl_range_eq_top (algebraicIndependent_t k n)).2
    (racl_range_t k n)
  simpa using hb.lift_cardinalMk_eq_trdeg.symm

name: AclGeom.reconstruction_ratFn
statement:
theorem reconstruction_ratFn {k l : Type*} [Field k] [Field l] {n m : ℕ} (hn : 5 ≤ n)
    (π : Perfection (Test.RatFn k n)) (ρ : Perfection (Test.RatFn l m))
    (φ : ClosedIF k (Test.RatFn k n) ≃o ClosedIF l (Test.RatFn l m)) :
    n = m ∧ ∃ Φ : π.carrier ≃+* ρ.carrier,
      CrossBase.Compatible (k := π.basePerf k) (l := ρ.basePerf l) Φ ∧ Reconstructs π ρ φ Φ ∧
        ∀ Ψ : π.carrier ≃+* ρ.carrier,
          Reconstructs π ρ φ Ψ ↔ ∃ n : ℤ, Ψ = Φ.trans (ρ.frobZPow n)
proof:
:= by
  have htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k (Test.RatFn k n) := by
    rw [Test.trdeg_ratFn]
    exact_mod_cast hn
  obtain ⟨hrank, Φ, hΦ, h, -, hfib, -⟩ :=
    reconstruction_target π ρ (Test.isRAC_bot_ratFn k n) (Test.isRAC_bot_ratFn l m) htr φ
  refine ⟨?_, Φ, hΦ, h, hfib⟩
  rw [Test.trdeg_ratFn, Test.trdeg_ratFn] at hrank
  simpa using hrank

name: AclGeom.twoGeneric_A5
statement:
private theorem twoGeneric_A5 (x y : K) :
    ι y ∈ racl k ({ι x} : Set Ω) ↔ y ∈ racl k ({x} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Set.image_singleton, algHom_mem_racl_image_iff]

name: AclGeom.racl_insert_closure
statement:
private theorem racl_insert_closure (x : K) (a : Ω) :
    racl k (insert a (racl k ({ι x} : Set Ω) : Set Ω)) = racl k ({a, ι x} : Set Ω)
proof:
:= by
  apply racl_congr_of_subset_racl
  · exact Set.insert_subset (subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _))
      (racl_mono (Set.subset_insert a _))
  · exact (Set.insert_subset_insert (subset_racl k _)).trans (subset_racl k _)

name: AclGeom.twoGeneric_A0
proof:
:= by
  have ht0' : ι t ≠ 0 := (map_ne_zero ι).2 ht0
  apply racl_congr_of_subset_racl
  · rintro z (rfl | rfl)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
    · exact mul_mem (subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _))
        (subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ ⟨x, subset_racl k _ rfl, rfl⟩))
  · rintro z (rfl | ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
    · have hx : ι x ∈ racl k ({ι t, ι t * ι x} : Set Ω) := by
        have h1 : ι t * ι x ∈ racl k ({ι t, ι t * ι x} : Set Ω) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
        have h := div_mem h1 (subset_racl k ({ι t, ι t * ι x} : Set Ω) (Set.mem_insert _ _))
        rwa [mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ ht0'] at h
      have hw' : ι w ∈ racl k ({ι x} : Set Ω) := by
        rw [← Set.image_singleton]
        exact (algHom_mem_racl_image_iff ι).2 hw
      exact racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hx) hw'

name: AclGeom.notMem_racl_insert_closure
statement:
private theorem notMem_racl_insert_closure {x s t : K} (ht : t ∉ racl k ({x, s} : Set K)) :
    ι t ∉ racl k (insert (ι s) (racl k ({ι x} : Set Ω) : Set Ω))
proof:
:= by
  rw [racl_insert_closure, Set.pair_comm, ← Set.image_singleton, ← Set.image_insert_eq,
    algHom_mem_racl_image_iff]
  exact ht

name: AclGeom.twoGeneric_A2
statement:
private theorem twoGeneric_A2 {x s t : K} (ht : t ∉ racl k ({x, s} : Set K)) :
    racl k (insert (ι t) (racl k ({ι x} : Set Ω) : Set Ω)) ⊓
        racl k (insert (ι s) (racl k ({ι x} : Set Ω) : Set Ω)) =
      racl k ({ι x} : Set Ω)
proof:
:= by
  rw [racl_insert_inf_racl_insert (notMem_racl_insert_closure ht), racl_racl]

name: AclGeom.notMem_racl_swap
statement:
private theorem notMem_racl_swap {x s t : K} (hs : s ∉ racl k ({x} : Set K))
    (ht : t ∉ racl k ({x, s} : Set K)) : s ∉ racl k ({x, t} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  intro hst
  refine hs (mem_racl_of_mem_racl_insert (a := s) (b := t) (subset_racl k _ (by simp)) ?_ ?_)
  · rwa [Set.pair_comm] at hst
  · rwa [Set.pair_comm] at ht

name: AclGeom.mem_racl_insert_of_isAlgebraic
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_racl_iff, ← Set.union_singleton, ← restrictScalars_adjoin]
  exact h

name: AclGeom.twoGeneric_A4
statement:
private theorem twoGeneric_A4 {x s t : K} (ht : t ∉ racl k ({x, s} : Set K)) {z : Ω}
    (hzt : IsAlgebraic (adjoin (racl k ({ι x} : Set Ω)) {ι t}) z)
    (hzs : IsAlgebraic (adjoin (racl k ({ι x} : Set Ω)) {ι s}) z) :
    z ∈ racl k ({ι x} : Set Ω)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← twoGeneric_A2 ht]
  exact IntermediateField.mem_inf.2
    ⟨mem_racl_insert_of_isAlgebraic hzt, mem_racl_insert_of_isAlgebraic hzs⟩

name: AclGeom.transcendental_adjoin_closure
proof:
:= by
  intro halg
  exact notMem_racl_insert_closure (Ω := Ω) (notMem_racl_swap hs ht)
    (mem_racl_insert_of_isAlgebraic halg)

name: AclGeom.twoGeneric_A1
statement:
private theorem twoGeneric_A1 {x s t : K} (hs : s ∉ racl k ({x} : Set K))
    (ht : t ∉ racl k ({x, s} : Set K)) :
    (adjoin (racl k ({ι x} : Set Ω)) {ι t}).LinearDisjoint
      (adjoin (racl k ({ι x} : Set Ω)) {ι s})
proof:
:=
  linearDisjoint_adjoin_simple_of_transcendental _ (transcendental_adjoin_closure hs ht)

name: AclGeom.transcendental_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
private theorem transcendental_of_isAlgebraic {x s t : K} (hs : s ∉ racl k ({x} : Set K))
    (ht : t ∉ racl k ({x, s} : Set K))
    (N : IntermediateField (adjoin (racl k ({ι x} : Set Ω)) {ι t}) Ω)
    (hN : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (adjoin (racl k ({ι x} : Set Ω)) {ι t}) N) :
    Transcendental N (ι s)
proof:
:= by
  have := hN
  exact (transcendental_adjoin_closure hs ht).extendScalars N

name: AclGeom.twoGeneric_A3_linearDisjoint
statement:
private theorem twoGeneric_A3_linearDisjoint {x s t : K} (hs : s ∉ racl k ({x} : Set K))
    (ht : t ∉ racl k ({x, s} : Set K))
    (N : IntermediateField (adjoin (racl k ({ι x} : Set Ω)) {ι t}) Ω)
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic (adjoin (racl k ({ι x} : Set Ω)) {ι t}) N] :
    (N.restrictScalars (racl k ({ι x} : Set Ω))).LinearDisjoint
      (adjoin (racl k ({ι x} : Set Ω)) {ι s})
proof:
:=
  linearDisjoint_adjoin_simple_of_transcendental _ (transcendental_of_isAlgebraic hs ht N ‹_›)

name: AclGeom.twoGeneric_A3_extension
statement:
private theorem twoGeneric_A3_extension {x s t : K} (hs : s ∉ racl k ({x} : Set K))
    (ht : t ∉ racl k ({x, s} : Set K))
    (N : IntermediateField (adjoin (racl k ({ι x} : Set Ω)) {ι t}) Ω)
    [Normal (adjoin (racl k ({ι x} : Set Ω)) {ι t}) N]
    (τ : N →ₐ[adjoin (racl k ({ι x} : Set Ω)) {ι t}] Ω) :
    ∃ τ' : adjoin N {ι s} →+* Ω,
      (∀ n : N, τ' (algebraMap N (adjoin N {ι s}) n) = τ n) ∧
        ∀ (z : Ω) (hz : z ∈ adjoin N {ι s}),
          z ∈ adjoin (racl k ({ι x} : Set Ω)) {ι s} → τ' ⟨z, hz⟩ = z
proof:
:= by
  have hN : Transcendental N (ι s) := transcendental_of_isAlgebraic hs ht N Normal.toIsAlgebraic
  have hrange : ∀ n : N, τ n ∈ N := fun n ↦ by
    have hmem : τ n ∈ τ.fieldRange := ⟨n, rfl⟩
    rwa [AlgHom.fieldRange_of_normal τ] at hmem
  let σ : N →+* N := τ.toRingHom.codRestrict N hrange
  have hσ : (algebraMap N Ω).comp σ = τ.toRingHom := by
    ext n
    rfl
  let φ : Polynomial N →+* Ω := Polynomial.eval₂RingHom τ.toRingHom (ι s)
  have hφ : (nonZeroDivisors (Polynomial N)) ≤ (nonZeroDivisors Ω).comap φ := by
    intro p hp
    rw [Submonoid.mem_comap, mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero]
    have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hp
    have hmap : p.map σ ≠ 0 :=
      (Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff σ.injective).2 hp0
    change Polynomial.eval₂ τ.toRingHom (ι s) p ≠ 0
    rw [← hσ, ← Polynomial.eval₂_map, ← Polynomial.aeval_def]
    exact fun h0 ↦ hmap ((transcendental_iff.1 hN) _ h0)
  let e := RatFunc.algEquivOfTranscendental (K := N) (ι s) hN
  let τ' : adjoin N {ι s} →+* Ω := (RatFunc.liftRingHom φ hφ).comp e.symm.toRingHom
  have hagree : ∀ n : N, τ' (algebraMap N (adjoin N {ι s}) n) = τ n := fun n ↦ by
    have he : e.symm (algebraMap N (adjoin N {ι s}) n) = algebraMap N (RatFunc N) n :=
      e.symm.commutes n
    change RatFunc.liftRingHom φ hφ (e.symm (algebraMap N (adjoin N {ι s}) n)) = τ n
    rw [he, RatFunc.algebraMap_eq_C, ← RatFunc.algebraMap_C, RatFunc.liftRingHom_algebraMap]
    exact Polynomial.eval₂_C _ _
  have hgen : τ' (AdjoinSimple.gen N (ι s)) = ι s := by
    have he : e.symm (AdjoinSimple.gen N (ι s)) = RatFunc.X := by
      rw [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
      ext
      rw [AdjoinSimple.coe_gen, RatFunc.algEquivOfTranscendental_X]
    change RatFunc.liftRingHom φ hφ (e.symm (AdjoinSimple.gen N (ι s))) = ι s
    rw [he, RatFunc.liftRingHom_X]
    exact Polynomial.eval₂_X _ _
  refine ⟨τ', hagree, fun z hz hzs ↦ ?_⟩
  let S : Subfield Ω := (τ'.eqLocusField (algebraMap (adjoin N {ι s}) Ω)).map
    (algebraMap (adjoin N {ι s}) Ω)
  have hle : (adjoin (racl k ({ι x} : Set Ω)) {ι s}).toSubfield ≤ S := by
    rw [adjoin_toSubfield, Subfield.closure_le]
    rintro w (⟨c, rfl⟩ | rfl)
    · let r := algebraMap (racl k ({ι x} : Set Ω)) (adjoin (racl k ({ι x} : Set Ω)) {ι t}) c
      refine ⟨algebraMap N (adjoin N {ι s}) ⟨_, N.algebraMap_mem r⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
      change τ' (algebraMap N (adjoin N {ι s}) ⟨_, N.algebraMap_mem r⟩) = _
      rw [hagree]
      exact τ.commutes r
    · exact ⟨AdjoinSimple.gen N (ι s), hgen, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hwz⟩ := Subfield.mem_map.1 (hle hzs)
  have hw' : w = ⟨z, hz⟩ := Subtype.ext hwz
  rw [← hw']
  exact hw.trans hwz

name: AclGeom.twoGeneric_finite_normal_envelope
statement:
private theorem twoGeneric_finite_normal_envelope {F Ω : Type*} [Field F] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra F Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] {z : Ω} (hz : IsAlgebraic F z) :
    ∃ N : IntermediateField F Ω, z ∈ N ∧ Normal F N ∧ FiniteDimensional F N
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional F F⟮z⟯ :=
    IntermediateField.adjoin.finiteDimensional (isAlgebraic_iff_isIntegral.1 hz)
  have hN : IsNormalClosure F F⟮z⟯ (normalClosure F F⟮z⟯ Ω) :=
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isNormalClosure_normalClosure fun _ ↦ IsAlgClosed.splits _
  exact ⟨normalClosure F F⟮z⟯ Ω,
    IntermediateField.le_normalClosure _ (IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self F z),
    IsNormalClosure.normal (h := hN), inferInstance⟩

name: AclGeom.Test.algebraicIndependent_t
statement: theorem algebraicIndependent_t : AlgebraicIndependent k (t k n)
proof:
:=
  algebraicIndependent_algebraMap_X k (Fin n)

name: AclGeom.Test.transcendental_t
statement: theorem transcendental_t (i : Fin n) : Transcendental k (t k n i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (algebraicIndependent_t k n).comp (fun _ : Unit ↦ i)
    (fun a b _ ↦ Subsingleton.elim a b)
  exact algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff.1 h

name: AclGeom.Test.t_notMem_bot
statement: theorem t_notMem_bot (i : Fin n) : t k n i ∉ (⊥ : ClosedIF k (RatFn k n))
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ transcendental_t k n i (ClosedIF.mem_bot_iff.1 h)

name: AclGeom.Test.adjoin_range_t
statement: theorem adjoin_range_t : adjoin k (Set.range (t k n)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro z _
  obtain ⟨p, q, -, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) z
  have key : ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k,
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) (RatFn k n) p ∈ adjoin k (Set.range (t k n)) := by
    intro p
    have hp : p ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (X : Fin n → MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) := by
      rw [MvPolynomial.adjoin_range_X]
      trivial
    have himg : algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) (RatFn k n) p ∈
        (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (X : Fin n → MvPolynomial (Fin n) k))).map
          (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) (RatFn k n)) :=
      ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    rw [AlgHom.map_adjoin (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) (RatFn k n)),
      ← Set.range_comp] at himg
    exact algebra_adjoin_le_adjoin k _ himg
  exact div_mem (key p) (key q)

name: AclGeom.Test.racl_range_t
statement: theorem racl_range_t : racl k (Set.range (t k n)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff, ← adjoin_range_t k n]
  exact adjoin_le_racl k _

name: AclGeom.Test.rankLE_top
statement: theorem rankLE_top : RankLE n (⊤ : ClosedIF k (RatFn k n))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tPoint k n, ?_⟩
  have h1 : (⨆ i, (tPoint k n i).1) =
      sSup ((fun x ↦ ClosedIF.point k x) '' Set.range (t k n)) := by
    rw [iSup, ← Set.range_comp]
    rfl
  have h2 : (sSup ((fun x ↦ ClosedIF.point k x) '' Set.range (t k n))).1 = ⊤ := by
    rw [sSup_point_image, racl_range_t]
  rw [h1, ClosedIF.le_iff, ClosedIF.coe_top, h2]

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.repeatedSGroupedStableAlignmentAut_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem repeatedSGroupedStableAlignmentAut_apply
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b))
    (x : (R.selectedGraphRightSourceCover L hind).field) :
    R.repeatedSGroupedStableAlignmentAut L hind
        (R.selectedGraphRightSourceToGroupedStableSource L hind x) =
      R.selectedGraphRightSourceToGroupedStableSource L hind
        (R.repeatedSSelectedGraphRightSourceAlignmentAut L hind x)

:=
  R.groupedStableSourceChartAut_apply L hind
    (R.repeatedSSelectedGraphRightSourceAlignmentAut L hind) x

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.fourSemilinearCommon_right_comp_selectedRightBranch
statement:
theorem fourSemilinearCommon_right_comp_selectedRightBranch
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :
    (R.seRightSemilinearCommonCompositionTriangle L hind).right.toRingHom.comp
          (R.seSelectedRightBranchToSemilinearCommonMiddleRingHom L hind) =
        R.seSelectedRightBranchToSemilinearCommonTargetRingHom L hind ∧
      (R.sAaRightSemilinearCommonCompositionTriangle L hind).right.toRingHom.comp
          (R.sAaSelectedRightBranchToSemilinearCommonMiddleRingHom L hind) =
        R.sAaSelectedRightBranchToSemilinearCommonTargetRingHom L hind ∧
      (R.sbRightSemilinearCommonCompositionTriangle L hind).right.toRingHom.comp
          (R.sbSelectedRightBranchToSemilinearCommonMiddleRingHom L hind) =
        R.sbSelectedRightBranchToSemilinearCommonTargetRingHom L hind ∧
      (R.sAcRightSemilinearCommonCompositionTriangle L hind).right.toRingHom.comp
          (R.sAcSelectedRightBranchToSemilinearCommonMiddleRingHom L hind) =
        R.sAcSelectedRightBranchToSemilinearCommonTargetRingHom L hind
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨R.seSemilinearCommon_right_comp_selectedRightBranch L hind,
    R.sAaSemilinearCommon_right_comp_selectedRightBranch L hind,
    R.sbSemilinearCommon_right_comp_selectedRightBranch L hind,
    R.sAcSemilinearCommon_right_comp_selectedRightBranch L hind⟩

name: AclGeom.QWitness.racl_pair
statement:
private theorem racl_pair (P Q : Point k K) :
    racl k (range (![P.rep, Q.rep] : Fin 2 → K)) = (P.1 ⊔ Q.1).1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty, ← coe_sup_point₂, P.point_rep, Q.point_rep]

name: AclGeom.QWitness.triple_of_rank
statement:
private theorem triple_of_rank {A B C : Set K} {E F G : ClosedIF k K} {m n r : ℕ}
    (hA : racl k A = E.1) (hB : racl k B = F.1) (hC : racl k C = G.1)
    (hE : RankEq m E) (hF : RankEq n F) (hG : RankEq r G)
    (hEFG : RankEq (m + n + r) (E ⊔ F ⊔ G)) : IndepTriple k A B C
proof:
:= by
  unfold IndepTriple
  rw [ClosedIF.erk_eq_of_racl_eq
      (ClosedIF.racl_union_eq_sup (ClosedIF.racl_union_eq_sup hA hB) hC) hEFG,
    ClosedIF.erk_eq_of_racl_eq hA hE, ClosedIF.erk_eq_of_racl_eq hB hF,
    ClosedIF.erk_eq_of_racl_eq hC hG,
    Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_add]

name: AclGeom.QWitness.triple_plane_pair_point
statement:
private theorem triple_plane_pair_point {A B C : Set K} {E F : ClosedIF k K}
    {P : Point k K} (hA : racl k A = E.1) (hB : racl k B = F.1)
    (hC : racl k C = P.1.1) (hE : RankEq 2 E) (hF : RankEq 2 F)
    (hEF : RankEq 4 (E ⊔ F)) (hP : ¬ P.1 ≤ E ⊔ F) : IndepTriple k A B C
proof:
:=
  triple_of_rank hA hB hC hE hF P.rankEq_one (hEF.sup_point_of_not_le hP)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.triple_of_indep_union
statement:
private theorem triple_of_indep_union {A B C : Set K} {m : ℕ}
    (hBCfin : (B ∪ C).Finite) (h : IndepOver k ∅ A (B ∪ C))
    (hA : erk k ∅ A = m) (hB : erk k ∅ B = 1) (hC : erk k ∅ C = 1)
    (hBC : erk k ∅ (B ∪ C) = 2) : IndepTriple k A B C
proof:
:= by
  unfold IndepTriple
  rw [union_assoc, erk_union_of_indepOver hBCfin h, hA, hBC, hB, hC]
  norm_num [add_assoc]

name: AclGeom.QWitness.triple_replace_second
proof:
:= by
  unfold IndepTriple at h ⊢
  rw [← erk_eq_of_racl_eq (racl_union_congr hAB rfl), ← hB]
  exact h

name: AclGeom.QWitness.subset_line
proof:
:= by
  rw [ClosedIF.racl_union_eq_sup hA hQ]
  rintro x (hx | hx)
  · exact (le_sup_right : Y.1 ≤ E ⊔ Y.1) (hQ ▸ subset_racl k Q hx)
  · exact hXY (hP ▸ subset_racl k P hx)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCore.groupConfiguration
statement:
theorem PsiCore.groupConfiguration [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K] (hw : w.PsiCore) :
    GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration k w.aTuple w.bTuple w.cTuple w.xTuple w.yTuple w.zTuple
proof:
:= by
  have hA : racl k (range w.aTuple) = w.A.1 := racl_pair w.A₁ w.A₂
  have hB : racl k (range w.bTuple) = w.B.1 := racl_pair w.B₁ w.B₂
  have hC : racl k (range w.cTuple) = w.C.1 := racl_pair w.C₁ w.C₂
  have hX : racl k (range w.xTuple) = w.X.1.1 := Point.racl_repTuple w.X
  have hY : racl k (range w.yTuple) = w.Y.1.1 := Point.racl_repTuple w.Y
  have hZ : racl k (range w.zTuple) = w.Z.1.1 := Point.racl_repTuple w.Z
  have rA := ClosedIF.erk_eq_of_racl_eq hA hw.rankEq_A
  have rB := ClosedIF.erk_eq_of_racl_eq hB hw.rankEq_B
  have rC := ClosedIF.erk_eq_of_racl_eq hC hw.rankEq_C
  have rX := ClosedIF.erk_eq_of_racl_eq hX w.X.rankEq_one
  have rY := ClosedIF.erk_eq_of_racl_eq hY w.Y.rankEq_one
  have rZ := ClosedIF.erk_eq_of_racl_eq hZ w.Z.rankEq_one
  have ab : w.A ⊔ w.B = w.A ⊔ w.B ⊔ w.C :=
    RankEq.eq_of_le le_sup_left hw.rank_AB hw.rank_ABC
  have ac : w.A ⊔ w.C = w.A ⊔ w.B ⊔ w.C :=
    RankEq.eq_of_le (sup_le (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left) le_sup_right)
      hw.rank_AC hw.rank_ABC
  have bc : w.B ⊔ w.C = w.A ⊔ w.B ⊔ w.C :=
    RankEq.eq_of_le (sup_le (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left) le_sup_right)
      hw.rank_BC hw.rank_ABC
  have nXA : ¬ w.X.1 ≤ w.A := fun h ↦ hw.X_notLe (h.trans (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left))
  have nYA : ¬ w.Y.1 ≤ w.A := fun h ↦ hw.Y_notLe (h.trans (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left))
  have nYB : ¬ w.Y.1 ≤ w.B := fun h ↦ hw.Y_notLe (h.trans (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left))
  have nZB : ¬ w.Z.1 ≤ w.B := fun h ↦ hw.Z_notLe (h.trans (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left))
  have nXC : ¬ w.X.1 ≤ w.C := fun h ↦ hw.X_notLe (h.trans le_sup_right)
  have nZC : ¬ w.Z.1 ≤ w.C := fun h ↦ hw.Z_notLe (h.trans le_sup_right)
  have axay : w.A ⊔ w.X.1 = w.A ⊔ w.Y.1 :=
    RankEq.eq_of_le (sup_le le_sup_left hw.X_le)
      (hw.rankEq_A.sup_point_of_not_le nXA) (hw.rankEq_A.sup_point_of_not_le nYA)
  have bzby : w.B ⊔ w.Z.1 = w.B ⊔ w.Y.1 :=
    RankEq.eq_of_le (sup_le le_sup_left (hw.Z_le.trans inf_le_left))
      (hw.rankEq_B.sup_point_of_not_le nZB) (hw.rankEq_B.sup_point_of_not_le nYB)
  have czcx : w.C ⊔ w.Z.1 = w.C ⊔ w.X.1 :=
    RankEq.eq_of_le (sup_le le_sup_left (hw.Z_le.trans inf_le_right))
      (hw.rankEq_C.sup_point_of_not_le nZC) (hw.rankEq_C.sup_point_of_not_le nXC)
  have eqAXAY : racl k (range w.aTuple ∪ range w.xTuple) =
      racl k (range w.aTuple ∪ range w.yTuple) := by
    rw [ClosedIF.racl_union_eq_sup hA hX, ClosedIF.racl_union_eq_sup hA hY, axay]
  have eqBYBZ : racl k (range w.bTuple ∪ range w.yTuple) =
      racl k (range w.bTuple ∪ range w.zTuple) := by
    rw [ClosedIF.racl_union_eq_sup hB hY, ClosedIF.racl_union_eq_sup hB hZ, bzby]
  have eqCXCZ : racl k (range w.cTuple ∪ range w.xTuple) =
      racl k (range w.cTuple ∪ range w.zTuple) := by
    rw [ClosedIF.racl_union_eq_sup hC hX, ClosedIF.racl_union_eq_sup hC hZ, czcx]
  have nXY : ¬ w.X.1 ≤ w.Y.1 := fun h ↦ hw.X_free w.A₁ le_sup_left (h.trans le_sup_right)
  have nZY : ¬ w.Z.1 ≤ w.Y.1 := fun h ↦ hw.Z_freeB w.B₁ le_sup_left (h.trans le_sup_right)
  have nZX : ¬ w.Z.1 ≤ w.X.1 := fun h ↦ hw.Z_freeC w.C₁ le_sup_left (h.trans le_sup_right)
  have rXY : erk k ∅ (range w.xTuple ∪ range w.yTuple) = 2 :=
    ClosedIF.erk_eq_of_racl_eq (ClosedIF.racl_union_eq_sup hX hY)
      ((w.Y.rankEq_one.sup_point_of_not_le nXY).congr (sup_comm _ _))
  have rYZ : erk k ∅ (range w.yTuple ∪ range w.zTuple) = 2 :=
    ClosedIF.erk_eq_of_racl_eq (ClosedIF.racl_union_eq_sup hY hZ)
      (w.Y.rankEq_one.sup_point_of_not_le nZY)
  have rXZ : erk k ∅ (range w.xTuple ∪ range w.zTuple) = 2 :=
    ClosedIF.erk_eq_of_racl_eq (ClosedIF.racl_union_eq_sup hX hZ)
      (w.X.rankEq_one.sup_point_of_not_le nZX)
  have abX := triple_plane_pair_point hA hB hX hw.rankEq_A hw.rankEq_B hw.rank_AB
    (by rw [ab]; exact hw.X_notLe)
  have abY := triple_plane_pair_point hA hB hY hw.rankEq_A hw.rankEq_B hw.rank_AB
    (by rw [ab]; exact hw.Y_notLe)
  have abZ := triple_plane_pair_point hA hB hZ hw.rankEq_A hw.rankEq_B hw.rank_AB
    (by rw [ab]; exact hw.Z_notLe)
  have acX := triple_plane_pair_point hA hC hX hw.rankEq_A hw.rankEq_C hw.rank_AC
    (by rw [ac]; exact hw.X_notLe)
  have acY := triple_plane_pair_point hA hC hY hw.rankEq_A hw.rankEq_C hw.rank_AC
    (by rw [ac]; exact hw.Y_notLe)
  have acZ := triple_plane_pair_point hA hC hZ hw.rankEq_A hw.rankEq_C hw.rank_AC
    (by rw [ac]; exact hw.Z_notLe)
  have bcX := triple_plane_pair_point hB hC hX hw.rankEq_B hw.rankEq_C hw.rank_BC
    (by rw [bc]; exact hw.X_notLe)
  have bcY := triple_plane_pair_point hB hC hY hw.rankEq_B hw.rankEq_C hw.rank_BC
    (by rw [bc]; exact hw.Y_notLe)
  have bcZ := triple_plane_pair_point hB hC hZ hw.rankEq_B hw.rankEq_C hw.rank_BC
    (by rw [bc]; exact hw.Z_notLe)
  have finA := finite_range w.aTuple
  have finB := finite_range w.bTuple
  have finC := finite_range w.cTuple
  have finX := finite_range w.xTuple
  have finY := finite_range w.yTuple
  have finZ := finite_range w.zTuple
  have subYZ : range w.yTuple ∪ range w.zTuple ⊆
      racl k (range w.bTuple ∪ range w.yTuple) :=
    subset_line hB hY hZ (hw.Z_le.trans inf_le_left)
  have subXZ : range w.xTuple ∪ range w.zTuple ⊆
      racl k (range w.cTuple ∪ range w.xTuple) :=
    subset_line hC hX hZ (hw.Z_le.trans inf_le_right)
  have subYX : range w.yTuple ∪ range w.xTuple ⊆
      racl k (range w.aTuple ∪ range w.yTuple) := subset_line hA hY hX hw.X_le
  have ayz : IndepTriple k (range w.aTuple) (range w.yTuple) (range w.zTuple) := by
    have hind := abY.indepOver_union finA finB finY
    have hcl : IndepOver k ∅ (range w.aTuple)
        (racl k (range w.bTuple ∪ range w.yTuple)) := by
      simpa only [empty_union] using indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hind
    exact triple_of_indep_union (finY.union finZ) (hcl.mono_right subYZ) rA rY rZ rYZ
  have bxz : IndepTriple k (range w.bTuple) (range w.xTuple) (range w.zTuple) := by
    have hind := bcX.indepOver_union finB finC finX
    have hcl : IndepOver k ∅ (range w.bTuple)
        (racl k (range w.cTuple ∪ range w.xTuple)) := by
      simpa only [empty_union] using indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hind
    exact triple_of_indep_union (finX.union finZ) (hcl.mono_right subXZ) rB rX rZ rXZ
  have cxy : IndepTriple k (range w.cTuple) (range w.xTuple) (range w.yTuple) := by
    have hind := acY.perm_left.indepOver_union finC finA finY
    have hcl : IndepOver k ∅ (range w.cTuple)
        (racl k (range w.aTuple ∪ range w.yTuple)) := by
      simpa only [empty_union] using indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hind
    have hyx : erk k ∅ (range w.yTuple ∪ range w.xTuple) = 2 := by
      rw [union_comm]; exact rXY
    exact (triple_of_indep_union (finY.union finX) (hcl.mono_right subYX)
      rC rY rX hyx).perm_right
  have axz := triple_replace_second (rY.trans rX.symm) eqAXAY.symm ayz
  have bxy := (triple_replace_second (rZ.trans rY.symm) eqBYBZ.symm bxz.perm_right).perm_right
  have cyz := (triple_replace_second (rX.trans rZ.symm) eqCXCZ cxy).perm_right
  have xyz : IndepTriple k (range w.xTuple) (range w.yTuple) (range w.zTuple) := by
    have hind := ayz.rotate.rotate.indepOver_union finZ finA finY
    have hcl : IndepOver k ∅ (range w.zTuple)
        (racl k (range w.aTuple ∪ range w.yTuple)) := by
      simpa only [empty_union] using indepOver_racl_right_iff.2 hind
    have subXY : range w.xTuple ∪ range w.yTuple ⊆
        racl k (range w.aTuple ∪ range w.yTuple) := by
      rw [union_comm]; exact subYX
    exact (triple_of_indep_union (finX.union finY) (hcl.mono_right subXY)
      rZ rX rY rXY).rotate
  refine {
    racl_ab_ac := by rw [ClosedIF.racl_union_eq_sup hA hB, ClosedIF.racl_union_eq_sup hA hC, ab, ac]
    racl_ab_bc := by rw [ClosedIF.racl_union_eq_sup hA hB, ClosedIF.racl_union_eq_sup hB hC, ab, bc]
    racl_ax_ay := eqAXAY
    racl_by_bz := eqBYBZ
    racl_cx_cz := eqCXCZ
    indep := indep_of_sixteen abX abY abZ acX acY acZ axz ayz bcX bcY bcZ bxy bxz cxy cyz xyz
    cb_a := ?_
    cb_b := ?_
    cb_c := ?_
    one_le_erk := by rw [rA]; norm_num }
  · change range w.aTuple ⊆ racl k (canonicalBase (racl k (range w.aTuple))
      (Sum.elim (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.X.rep) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.Y.rep)) : Set K)
    rw [hA]
    change range w.aTuple ⊆ racl k (canonicalBase w.A.1
      (Sum.elim (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.X.rep) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.Y.rep)) : Set K)
    rw [hw.racl_canonicalBase_XY_eq_A]
    intro t ht
    change t ∈ w.A.1
    rw [← hA]
    exact subset_racl k _ ht
  · change range w.bTuple ⊆ racl k (canonicalBase (racl k (range w.bTuple))
      (Sum.elim (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.Y.rep) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.Z.rep)) : Set K)
    rw [hB]
    change range w.bTuple ⊆ racl k (canonicalBase w.B.1
      (Sum.elim (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.Y.rep) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.Z.rep)) : Set K)
    rw [hw.racl_canonicalBase_YZ_eq_B]
    intro t ht
    change t ∈ w.B.1
    rw [← hB]
    exact subset_racl k _ ht
  · change range w.cTuple ⊆ racl k (canonicalBase (racl k (range w.cTuple))
      (Sum.elim (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.X.rep) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.Z.rep)) : Set K)
    rw [hC]
    change range w.cTuple ⊆ racl k (canonicalBase w.C.1
      (Sum.elim (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.X.rep) (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w.Z.rep)) : Set K)
    rw [hw.racl_canonicalBase_XZ_eq_C]
    intro t ht
    change t ∈ w.C.1
    rw [← hC]
    exact subset_racl k _ ht

statement:
@[simp] theorem groupedStableSourceChartAut_apply
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b))
    (σ : (R.selectedGraphRightSourceCover L hind).field
      ≃ₐ[groupedAlignmentSemanticSourceType R]
      (R.selectedGraphRightSourceCover L hind).field)
    (x : (R.selectedGraphRightSourceCover L hind).field) :
    R.groupedStableSourceChartAut L hind σ
        (R.selectedGraphRightSourceToGroupedStableSource L hind x) =
      R.selectedGraphRightSourceToGroupedStableSource L hind (σ x)
proof:
:= by
  let : Normal (groupedAlignmentSemanticSourceType R)
      (R.groupedStableSourceField L hind) :=
    R.groupedStableSourceField_normal L hind
  exact NormalBranchEmbedding.extendAlong_apply _ _ _

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.fourSelectedGraphJointCover_finite_over_semantic
statement:
theorem fourSelectedGraphJointCover_finite_over_semantic
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :
    FiniteDimensional (groupedStableSemanticSourceType R)
      (groupedStableJointCoverType R L hind)
proof:
:= by
    letI : Algebra (groupedStableSemanticSourceType R)
        (groupedStableJointSourceType R) :=
      R.semanticSourceToRightSourceJoint.toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower (groupedStableSemanticSourceType R)
        (groupedStableJointSourceType R)
        (groupedStableJointCoverType R L hind) :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
    letI : FiniteDimensional (groupedStableSemanticSourceType R)
        (groupedStableJointSourceType R) := by
      change FiniteDimensional (↥R.semanticCommonSourceField)
        (↥R.rightSourceJointOverSemantic)
      exact R.rightSourceJointOverSemantic_finiteDimensional
    letI : FiniteDimensional (groupedStableJointSourceType R)
        (groupedStableJointCoverType R L hind) :=
      (R.fourSelectedGraphJointCover L hind).finiteDimensional
    exact FiniteDimensional.trans
      (groupedStableSemanticSourceType R)
      (groupedStableJointSourceType R)
      (groupedStableJointCoverType R L hind)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.fourSelectedGraphJointCover_algebraMap_mem_groupedStableNormalField
statement:
theorem fourSelectedGraphJointCover_algebraMap_mem_groupedStableNormalField
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b))
    (x : groupedStableJointCoverType R L hind) :
    algebraMap (groupedStableJointCoverType R L hind)
        (AlgebraicClosure (groupedStableJointCoverType R L hind)) x ∈
      R.groupedStableNormalField L hind
proof:
:= by
  let φ : groupedStableJointCoverType R L hind →ₐ[
      groupedStableSemanticSourceType R]
      AlgebraicClosure (groupedStableJointCoverType R L hind) :=
    { algebraMap _ _ with
      commutes' := fun _ ↦ rfl }
  apply AlgHom.fieldRange_le_normalClosure φ
  exact ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.groupedJointCoverAlgebraicClosure_normal_over_semantic
statement:
theorem groupedJointCoverAlgebraicClosure_normal_over_semantic
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :
    Normal (groupedStableSemanticSourceType R)
      (AlgebraicClosure (groupedStableJointCoverType R L hind))
proof:
:= by
  let S := groupedStableSemanticSourceType R
  let P := groupedStableJointCoverType R L hind
  let Ω := AlgebraicClosure P
  letI : FiniteDimensional S P :=
    R.fourSelectedGraphJointCover_finite_over_semantic L hind
  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic S P := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_finite S P
  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic S Ω :=
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic.trans S P Ω
  rw [normal_iff]
  intro x
  exact ⟨(Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic x).isIntegral,
    IsAlgClosed.splits _⟩

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.groupedStableSourceField_normal
statement:
theorem groupedStableSourceField_normal
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :
    Normal (groupedStableSemanticSourceType R)
      (↥(R.groupedStableSourceField L hind))
proof:
:= by
  change Normal (groupedStableSemanticSourceType R)
    (↥(R.groupedStableNormalField L hind))
  letI : FiniteDimensional (groupedStableSemanticSourceType R)
      (groupedStableJointCoverType R L hind) :=
    R.fourSelectedGraphJointCover_finite_over_semantic L hind
  letI : Normal (groupedStableSemanticSourceType R)
      (AlgebraicClosure (groupedStableJointCoverType R L hind)) :=
    R.groupedJointCoverAlgebraicClosure_normal_over_semantic L hind
  exact normalClosure.normal _ _ _

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.groupedStableSourceField_finite_over_semantic
statement:
theorem groupedStableSourceField_finite_over_semantic
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :
    FiniteDimensional (groupedStableSemanticSourceType R)
      (↥(R.groupedStableSourceField L hind))
proof:
:= by
  change FiniteDimensional (groupedStableSemanticSourceType R)
    (↥(R.groupedStableNormalField L hind))
  letI : FiniteDimensional (groupedStableSemanticSourceType R)
      (groupedStableJointCoverType R L hind) :=
    R.fourSelectedGraphJointCover_finite_over_semantic L hind
  exact normalClosure.is_finiteDimensional _ _ _

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.groupedStableSourceField_finite_over_jointCover
statement:

    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :
    FiniteDimensional (groupedStableJointCoverType R L hind)
      (↥(R.groupedStableSourceField L hind))
proof:
:= by
  let S := groupedStableSemanticSourceType R
  let P := groupedStableJointCoverType R L hind
  let Q := ↥(R.groupedStableSourceField L hind)

    R.groupedStableSourceField_finite_over_semantic L hind

  exact FiniteDimensional.right S P Q

name: AclGeom.RankTwoFiniteCorrespondenceMultiplication.FourArrowDifferenceDiagram.s_sA_a_c_independent
statement:

    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :
    AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s D.sA a D.c)
proof:
:= by
  apply algebraicIndependent_of_racl_range_eq
    (D.s_sA_a_uB_independent hind)
  have h := D.sA_c_uB.racl_four_firstRight_eq_firstOutput s a
  rw [rankTwoFourTuple_range, rankTwoFourTuple_range] at h ⊢
  simpa only [Set.union_assoc, Set.union_left_comm, Set.union_comm] using h.symm

name: AclGeom.RankTwoFiniteCorrespondenceMultiplication.FourArrowDifferenceDiagram.racl_s_e_a_b_eq_s_sA_a_c
statement:
theorem racl_s_e_a_b_eq_s_sA_a_c :
    racl k (Set.range (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) =
      racl k (Set.range (rankTwoFourTuple s D.sA a D.c))
proof:
:= by
  have hlast := D.sA_c_uB.racl_four_firstRight_eq_firstOutput s a
  rw [rankTwoFourTuple_range, rankTwoFourTuple_range] at hlast
  have hlast' :
      racl k (Set.range (rankTwoFourTuple s D.sA a D.uB)) =
        racl k (Set.range (rankTwoFourTuple s D.sA a D.c)) := by
    rw [rankTwoFourTuple_range, rankTwoFourTuple_range]
    simpa only [Set.union_assoc, Set.union_left_comm, Set.union_comm]
      using hlast.symm
  exact (D.se_u.racl_four_leftRight_eq_leftOutput a b).trans
    ((D.sA_a_u.racl_four_outputRight_eq_leftRight s b).trans
      ((D.s_b_uB.racl_four_firstRight_eq_firstOutput D.sA a).trans hlast'))

name: AclGeom.QWitness.notMem_racl_composition_of_base
statement:
private theorem notMem_racl_composition_of_base
    {p q r : Fin 2 → K} {base : Fin 4 → K} {x : K}
    (hx : x ∉ racl k (Set.range base))
    (hparam : ∀ i,
      compositionParameterTuple p q r i ∈ racl k (Set.range base)) :
    x ∉ racl k (Set.range (compositionParameterTuple p q r))
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  apply hx
  exact racl_le_of_subset_racl
    (by rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact hparam i) hmem

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiParameterFourArrowDifferenceDiagram.a_zero_notMem_racl_se_parameters
statement:
theorem a_zero_notMem_racl_se_parameters
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :
    a 0 ∉ racl k
      (Set.range (compositionParameterTuple s e D.u))
proof:
:= by
  let S : Set (Fin 8) := {0, 1, 2, 3}
  have himage : rankTwoFourTuple s e a b '' S =
      Set.range (rankTwoPairTuple s e) := by
    ext z
    simp [S, rankTwoFourTuple, rankTwoPairTuple]
    tauto
  have hx := AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_image hind
    (S := S) (i := (4 : Fin 8)) (by simp [S])
  rw [himage] at hx
  have hx' : a 0 ∉ racl k (Set.range (rankTwoPairTuple s e)) := by
    simpa [rankTwoFourTuple] using hx
  exact notMem_racl_composition_of_base hx' fun i ↦ by
    fin_cases i
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_range_self 0)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_range_self 1)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_range_self 2)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_range_self 3)
    · exact D.se_u.output_mem_left_right 0
    · exact D.se_u.output_mem_left_right 1

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiParameterFourArrowDifferenceDiagram.b_zero_notMem_racl_sAa_parameters

  rw [himage] at hx
  have hx' : b 0 ∉ racl k (Set.range (rankTwoPairTuple D.sA a)) := by
    simpa [q, rankTwoFourTuple] using hx
  exact notMem_racl_composition_of_base hx' fun i ↦ by
    fin_cases i
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_range_self 0)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_range_self 1)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_range_self 2)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_range_self 3)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiParameterFourArrowDifferenceDiagram.s_zero_notMem_racl_sAc_parameters
statement:
theorem s_zero_notMem_racl_sAc_parameters
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :

      (Set.range (compositionParameterTuple D.sA D.c D.uB))
proof:

  let q : Fin 8 → K := rankTwoFourTuple s D.sA a D.uB

name: AclGeom.QWitness.exists_psiCurveFourArrowRealizations
statement:
theorem exists_psiCurveFourArrowRealizations [IsAlgClosed K]
    (hψ : w.Psi) {s a b e : Fin 2 → K}
    (D : w.PsiParameterFourArrowDifferenceDiagram hψ s a b e)
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :
    Nonempty (w.PsiCurveFourArrowRealizations hψ D)
proof:
:= by
  have hse : w.psiFamilyCompositionRelation s e D.u :=
    (w.psiFamilyCompositionRelation_iff_isRealization hψ s e D.u).2 D.se_u
  have hsAa : w.psiFamilyCompositionRelation D.sA a D.u :=
    (w.psiFamilyCompositionRelation_iff_isRealization
      hψ D.sA a D.u).2 D.sA_a_u
  have hsb : w.psiFamilyCompositionRelation s b D.uB :=
    (w.psiFamilyCompositionRelation_iff_isRealization hψ s b D.uB).2
      D.s_b_uB
  have hsAc : w.psiFamilyCompositionRelation D.sA D.c D.uB :=
    (w.psiFamilyCompositionRelation_iff_isRealization
      hψ D.sA D.c D.uB).2 D.sA_c_uB
  obtain ⟨Rse, hRse⟩ := w.exists_psiCurveCompositionRealization hψ hse
    (D.a_zero_notMem_racl_se_parameters hind)
  obtain ⟨RsAa, hRsAa⟩ := w.exists_psiCurveCompositionRealization hψ hsAa
    (D.b_zero_notMem_racl_sAa_parameters hind)
  obtain ⟨Rsb, hRsb⟩ := w.exists_psiCurveCompositionRealization hψ hsb
    (D.e_zero_notMem_racl_sb_parameters hind)
  obtain ⟨RsAc, hRsAc⟩ := w.exists_psiCurveCompositionRealization hψ hsAc
    (D.s_zero_notMem_racl_sAc_parameters hind)
  exact ⟨⟨Rse, hRse, RsAa, hRsAa, Rsb, hRsb, RsAc, hRsAc⟩⟩
