name: AclGeom.reciprocal_Q_tuple_independent
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : Fin 4 → Fin 5 := ![2, 3, 1, 0]
  have he : Function.Injective e := by decide
  have heq : (fun q : Fin 4 ↦ (![a, b, c, d, x] : Fin 5 → K) (e q)) =
      ![c, d, b, a] := by
    funext q
    fin_cases q <;> rfl
  have h4 : AlgebraicIndependent k ![c, d, b, a] := heq ▸ hind.comp e he
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := hind.ne_zero 2
  have hi : c * (a * c)⁻¹ = a⁻¹ := by
    rw [mul_inv_rev, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc0, one_mul]
  refine AlgebraicIndependent.of_racl_range_eq h4 (racl_range_eq_of_mem ?_ ?_)
  · have hm (i : Fin 4) : ![c, d, b, a] i ∈ racl k (Set.range ![c, d, b, a]) :=
      subset_racl k _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact hm 0
    · exact hm 1
    · exact hm 2
    · exact inv_mem (mul_mem (hm 3) (hm 0))
  · have hm (i : Fin 4) : ![c, d, b, (a * c)⁻¹] i ∈
        racl k (Set.range ![c, d, b, (a * c)⁻¹]) :=
      subset_racl k _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact hm 0
    · exact hm 1
    · exact hm 2
    · have h := inv_mem (mul_mem (hm 0) (hm 3))
      change (c * (a * c)⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ _ at h
      rwa [hi, inv_inv] at h

name: AclGeom.reciprocal_pair_closure
statement:
private theorem reciprocal_pair_closure (u v : K) :
    racl k ({u⁻¹, v} : Set K) = racl k ({u, v} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg
    (fun L : IntermediateField k K ↦ racl k ((L : Set K) ∪ ({v} : Set K)))
    (racl_inv (k := k) u)
  simpa only [racl_union_left, Set.singleton_union] using h

name: AclGeom.reciprocal_Q_from_raw
statement:
private theorem reciprocal_Q_from_raw [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K] {a b c d x q g h : K}
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b, c, d, x])
    (hqc : q ∈ racl k ({c, d} : Set K)) (hqT : q ∉ racl k ({c} : Set K))
    (hgPT : g ∈ racl k ({b, c} : Set K))
    (hgQR : g ∈ racl k ({q, b * c + d} : Set K))
    (hgT : g ∉ racl k ({c} : Set K))
    (hhUG : h ∈ racl k ({a * c, g} : Set K))
    (hhA : h ∈ racl k ({a, b} : Set K))
    (hhS : h ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K)) :
    ∃ F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k ({h⁻¹} : Set K)),
      Prime F ∧
      idealOf ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k ({h⁻¹} : Set K)) ![a⁻¹, b] =
        Ideal.span {F} ∧
      ∀ t : ℕ → K,
        (∀ n < 2 * F.totalDegree + 1,
          t n ∉ racl k ({c, d, b, (a * c)⁻¹} ∪ t '' Set.Iio n)) →
        ∃ η : k, racl k ({q} : Set K) =
          racl k ({d + (c - 1) * algebraMap k K η} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have h4 := reciprocal_Q_tuple_independent hind
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := hind.ne_zero 2
  have hi : c * (a * c)⁻¹ = a⁻¹ := by
    rw [mul_inv_rev, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc0, one_mul]
  have hδx : g ∈ racl k ({c, b} : Set K) := by
    simpa only [Set.pair_comm] using hgPT
  have hδy : g ∈ racl k ({q, c * b + d} : Set K) := by
    simpa only [mul_comm c b] using hgQR
  have hf : h⁻¹ ∈ racl k ({(a * c)⁻¹, g} : Set K) := by
    rw [reciprocal_pair_closure]
    exact inv_mem hhUG
  have hfm : h⁻¹ ∈ racl k ({c * (a * c)⁻¹, b} : Set K) := by
    rw [hi, reciprocal_pair_closure]
    exact inv_mem hhA
  have hfu : h⁻¹ ∉ racl k ({c * (a * c)⁻¹} : Set K) := by
    rw [hi, racl_inv]
    intro hh
    exact hhS (by simpa only [inv_inv] using inv_mem hh)
  have H := racl_normalized_P_of_supplied_fresh_inputs h4 hqc hqT
    hδx hgT hδy hf hfm hfu
  simpa only [hi] using H

name: AclGeom.pair_closure_of_singleton_eq
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg
    (fun L : IntermediateField k K ↦ racl k ((L : Set K) ∪ ({w} : Set K))) huv
  simpa only [racl_union_left, Set.singleton_union] using h

name: AclGeom.affine_pair_shift
proof:
:= by
  refine racl_congr_of_subset_racl ?_ ?_
  · have hu : u ∈ racl k ({u, v} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
    have hv : v ∈ racl k ({u, v} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
    exact Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨hu, Set.singleton_subset_iff.2
      (add_mem hv (mul_mem (sub_mem hu (one_mem _)) ((racl k _).algebraMap_mem κ)))⟩
  · have hu : u ∈ racl k ({u, v + (u - 1) * algebraMap k K κ} : Set K) :=
      subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
    have hv : v + (u - 1) * algebraMap k K κ ∈
        racl k ({u, v + (u - 1) * algebraMap k K κ} : Set K) :=
      subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
    have h := sub_mem hv
      (mul_mem (sub_mem hu (one_mem _)) ((racl k _).algebraMap_mem κ))
    have hv0 : v ∈ racl k ({u, v + (u - 1) * algebraMap k K κ} : Set K) := by
      simpa only [add_sub_cancel_right] using h
    exact Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨hu, Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hv0⟩

name: AclGeom.original_P_tuple_independent
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : Fin 4 → Fin 5 := ![0, 1, 4, 2]
  have he : Function.Injective e := by decide
  have heq : (fun q : Fin 4 ↦ (![a, b, c, d, x] : Fin 5 → K) (e q)) =
      ![a, b, x, c] := by
    funext q
    fin_cases q <;> rfl
  exact heq ▸ hind.comp e he

name: AclGeom.pair_translate
statement:
private theorem pair_translate (u v : K) (κ : k) :
    racl k ({u, v + algebraMap k K κ} : Set K) = racl k ({u, v} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have h := pair_closure_of_singleton_eq (racl_add_algebraMap (k := k) v κ) u
  simpa only [Set.pair_comm] using h

name: AclGeom.two_family_remaining_rows
statement:
private theorem two_family_remaining_rows
    [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K] {a b c d x p δ f ρ q g h i e : K}
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b, c, d, x])
    (hp : p ∈ racl k ({a, b} : Set K)) (hpa : p ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K))
    (hδx : δ ∈ racl k ({a, x} : Set K)) (hδa : δ ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K))
    (hδy : δ ∈ racl k ({p, a * x + b} : Set K)) (hf : f ∈ racl k ({c, δ} : Set K))
    (hfm : f ∈ racl k ({a * c, x} : Set K)) (hfu : f ∉ racl k ({a * c} : Set K))
    (hρFZ : ρ ∈ racl k ({f, c * (a * x + b) + d} : Set K))
    (hρC : ρ ∈ racl k ({a * c, b * c + d} : Set K))
    (hρ0 : ρ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    (hqc : q ∈ racl k ({c, d} : Set K)) (hqT : q ∉ racl k ({c} : Set K))
    (hgPT : g ∈ racl k ({p, c} : Set K))
    (hgQR : g ∈ racl k ({q, ρ} : Set K)) (hgT : g ∉ racl k ({c} : Set K))
    (hhUG : h ∈ racl k ({a * c, g} : Set K))
    (hhA : h ∈ racl k ({a, b} : Set K)) (hhS : h ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K))
    (hiH : i ∈ racl k ({h, x} : Set K))
    (hiP : i ∈ racl k ({p, a * x + b} : Set K)) (hi0 : i ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    (heT : e ∈ racl k ({c, a * x + b} : Set K))
    (heQ : e ∈ racl k ({q, c * (a * x + b) + d} : Set K))
    (he0 : e ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) :
    ∃ FP : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k ({f} : Set K)), Prime FP ∧
      idealOf ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k ({f} : Set K)) ![a * c, x] = Ideal.span {FP} ∧
      ∀ tP : ℕ → K,
        (∀ n < 2 * FP.totalDegree + 1,
          tP n ∉ racl k ({a, b, x, c} ∪ tP '' Set.Iio n)) →
        ∃ κ : k, racl k ({p} : Set K) =
            racl k ({b + (a - 1) * algebraMap k K κ} : Set K) ∧
          racl k ({δ} : Set K) = racl k ({a * (x - algebraMap k K κ)} : Set K) ∧
          racl k ({f} : Set K) = racl k ({a * c * (x - algebraMap k K κ)} : Set K) ∧
          racl k ({ρ} : Set K) =
            racl k ({b * c + d + a * c * algebraMap k K κ} : Set K) ∧
          let B
proof:
:= b + (a - 1) * algebraMap k K κ
          let D := d + (c - 1) * algebraMap k K κ
          ∃ FQ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k ({h⁻¹} : Set K)),
            Prime FQ ∧
            idealOf ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k ({h⁻¹} : Set K)) ![a⁻¹, B] =
              Ideal.span {FQ} ∧
            ∀ tQ : ℕ → K,
              (∀ n < 2 * FQ.totalDegree + 1,
                tQ n ∉ racl k ({c, D, B, (a * c)⁻¹} ∪ tQ '' Set.Iio n)) →
              ∃ η : k, racl k ({q} : Set K) =
                  racl k ({D + (c - 1) * algebraMap k K η} : Set K) ∧
                AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, B - algebraMap k K η,
                  c, D + (c - 1) * algebraMap k K η, x - algebraMap k K κ] ∧
                racl k ({g} : Set K) = racl k ({(B - algebraMap k K η) * c} : Set K) ∧
                racl k ({h} : Set K) = racl k ({a / (B - algebraMap k K η)} : Set K) ∧
                racl k ({i} : Set K) =
                  racl k ({a * (x - algebraMap k K κ) / (B - algebraMap k K η)} : Set K) ∧
                racl k ({e} : Set K) =
                  racl k ({c * (a * (x - algebraMap k K κ) +
                    (B - algebraMap k K η))} : Set K) := by
  obtain ⟨FP, hFP, hSpanP, HP⟩ := racl_normalized_P_of_supplied_fresh_inputs
    (original_P_tuple_independent hind) hp hpa hδx hδa hδy hf hfm hfu
  refine ⟨FP, hFP, hSpanP, fun tP htP ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨κ, hP⟩ := HP tP htP
  have hRows := racl_shifted_D_F_R_of_normalized_P hind κ hP
    hδx hδy hδa hf hfm hfu hρFZ hρC hρ0
  have hStar := algebraicIndependent_table_shift hind κ
  let B := b + (a - 1) * algebraMap k K κ
  let D := d + (c - 1) * algebraMap k K κ
  have hA : racl k ({a, B} : Set K) = racl k ({a, b} : Set K) :=
    affine_pair_shift a b κ
  have hB : racl k ({c, D} : Set K) = racl k ({c, d} : Set K) :=
    affine_pair_shift c d κ
  have hqD : q ∈ racl k ({c, D} : Set K) := by
    rw [hB]
    exact hqc
  have hhAB : h ∈ racl k ({a, B} : Set K) := by
    rw [hA]
    exact hhA
  have hgBC : g ∈ racl k ({B, c} : Set K) := by
    rw [← pair_closure_of_singleton_eq hP c]
    exact hgPT
  have heq : b * c + d + a * c * algebraMap k K κ =
      (B * c + D) + algebraMap k K κ := by
    dsimp [B, D]
    ring
  have hρW : racl k ({ρ} : Set K) = racl k ({B * c + D} : Set K) :=
    hRows.2.2.trans (by rw [heq]; exact racl_add_algebraMap (B * c + D) κ)
  have hgQW : g ∈ racl k ({q, B * c + D} : Set K) := by
    have h : g ∈ racl k ({ρ, q} : Set K) := by
      simpa only [Set.pair_comm] using hgQR
    rw [pair_closure_of_singleton_eq hρW q] at h
    simpa only [Set.pair_comm] using h
  obtain ⟨FQ, hFQ, hSpanQ, HQ⟩ := reciprocal_Q_from_raw hStar
    hqD hqT hgBC hgQW hgT hhUG hhAB hhS
  refine ⟨κ, hP, hRows.1, hRows.2.1, hRows.2.2, FQ, hFQ, hSpanQ, fun tQ htQ ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨η, hQ⟩ := HQ tQ htQ
  have hFinal := algebraicIndependent_table_Q_shift hStar η
  have hx : x = (x - algebraMap k K κ) + algebraMap k K κ := by ring
  have hy : a * x + b =
      (a * (x - algebraMap k K κ) + B) + algebraMap k K κ := by
    dsimp [B]
    ring
  have hz : c * (a * x + b) + d =
      (c * (a * (x - algebraMap k K κ) + B) + D) + algebraMap k K κ := by
    dsimp [B, D]
    ring
  have hiHXstar : i ∈ racl k ({h, x - algebraMap k K κ} : Set K) := by
    have hI := hiH
    rw [hx, pair_translate] at hI
    exact hI
  have hiPstar : i ∈ racl k ({p, a * (x - algebraMap k K κ) + B} : Set K) := by
    have hI := hiP
    rw [hy, pair_translate] at hI
    exact hI
  have heTstar : e ∈ racl k ({c, a * (x - algebraMap k K κ) + B} : Set K) := by
    have hE := heT
    rw [hy, pair_translate] at hE
    exact hE
  have heQstar : e ∈ racl k
      ({q, c * (a * (x - algebraMap k K κ) + B) + D} : Set K) := by
    have hE := heQ
    rw [hz, pair_translate] at hE
    exact hE
  have hg0 : g ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) :=
    fun h0 ↦ hgT (racl_mono (Set.empty_subset _) h0)
  have hh0 : h ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) :=
    fun h0 ↦ hhS (racl_mono (Set.empty_subset _) h0)
  have hNew := racl_shifted_G_H_I_E_of_normalized_P_Q hStar η hP hQ hρW
    hgPT hgQR hg0 hhUG hhAB hh0 hiHXstar hiPstar hi0 heTstar heQstar he0
  exact ⟨η, hQ, hFinal, hNew.1, hNew.2.1, hNew.2.2.1, hNew.2.2.2⟩

name: AclGeom.point_rep_notMem_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hle : P.1 ≤ S.1 := by
    rw [← P.point_rep, hS]
    exact ClosedIF.point_le_iff.2 (ClosedIF.mem_point.2 hmem)
  exact hPS (Subtype.ext ((S.2.le_iff_eq P.2.1).1 hle))

name: AclGeom.guarded_raw_inputs
statement:
private theorem guarded_raw_inputs {w : QWitness k K}
    (hw : w.Psi) (hID : w.I ≠ w.D) {a b c d x : K}
    (hA : w.A = ClosedIF.point k a ⊔ ClosedIF.point k b)
    (hB : w.B = ClosedIF.point k c ⊔ ClosedIF.point k d)
    (hC : w.C = ClosedIF.point k (a * c) ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (b * c + d))
    (hS : w.S.1 = ClosedIF.point k a) (hT : w.T.1 = ClosedIF.point k c)
    (hU : w.U.1 = ClosedIF.point k (a * c)) (hX : w.X.1 = ClosedIF.point k x)
    (hY : w.Y.1 = ClosedIF.point k (a * x + b))
    (hZ : w.Z.1 = ClosedIF.point k (c * (a * x + b) + d)) :
    w.P.rep ∈ racl k ({a, b} : Set K) ∧ w.P.rep ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K) ∧
      w.D.rep ∈ racl k ({a, x} : Set K) ∧ w.D.rep ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K) ∧
      w.D.rep ∈ racl k ({w.P.rep, a * x + b} : Set K) ∧
      w.F.rep ∈ racl k ({c, w.D.rep} : Set K) ∧ w.F.rep ∈ racl k ({a * c, x} : Set K) ∧
      w.F.rep ∉ racl k ({a * c} : Set K) ∧
      w.R.rep ∈ racl k ({w.F.rep, c * (a * x + b) + d} : Set K) ∧
      w.R.rep ∈ racl k ({a * c, b * c + d} : Set K) ∧ w.R.rep ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) ∧
      w.Q.rep ∈ racl k ({c, d} : Set K) ∧ w.Q.rep ∉ racl k ({c} : Set K) ∧
      w.G.rep ∈ racl k ({w.P.rep, c} : Set K) ∧
      w.G.rep ∈ racl k ({w.Q.rep, w.R.rep} : Set K) ∧ w.G.rep ∉ racl k ({c} : Set K) ∧
      w.H.rep ∈ racl k ({a * c, w.G.rep} : Set K) ∧ w.H.rep ∈ racl k ({a, b} : Set K) ∧
      w.H.rep ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K) ∧ w.I.rep ∈ racl k ({w.H.rep, x} : Set K) ∧
      w.I.rep ∈ racl k ({w.P.rep, a * x + b} : Set K) ∧ w.I.rep ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) ∧
      w.E.rep ∈ racl k ({c, a * x + b} : Set K) ∧
      w.E.rep ∈ racl k ({w.Q.rep, c * (a * x + b) + d} : Set K) ∧
      w.E.rep ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : w.P.rep ∈ racl k ({a, b} : Set K) := by
    apply point_rep_mem_of_le
    rw [← hA]
    exact hw.P_le_A hID
  have hpa : w.P.rep ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K) :=
    point_rep_notMem_of_ne hS hw.P_ne_S
  have hδx : w.D.rep ∈ racl k ({a, x} : Set K) := by
    apply point_rep_mem_of_le
    rw [← hw.meet_D, hS, hX]
    exact inf_le_right
  have hδa : w.D.rep ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K) :=
    point_rep_notMem_of_ne hS (hw.D_ne_S hID)
  have hδy : w.D.rep ∈ racl k ({w.P.rep, a * x + b} : Set K) := by
    apply point_rep_mem_of_le
    rw [w.P.point_rep, ← hw.meet_D, hY]
    exact inf_le_left
  have hf : w.F.rep ∈ racl k ({c, w.D.rep} : Set K) := by
    apply point_rep_mem_of_le
    rw [w.D.point_rep, ← hw.meet_F, hT]
    exact inf_le_right
  have hfm : w.F.rep ∈ racl k ({a * c, x} : Set K) := by
    apply point_rep_mem_of_le
    rw [← hw.meet_F, hU, hX]
    exact inf_le_left
  have hfu : w.F.rep ∉ racl k ({a * c} : Set K) :=
    point_rep_notMem_of_ne hU (hw.F_ne_U hID)
  have hρFZ : w.R.rep ∈ racl k ({w.F.rep, c * (a * x + b) + d} : Set K) := by
    apply point_rep_mem_of_le
    rw [w.F.point_rep, ← hw.meet_R, hZ]
    exact inf_le_left
  have hρC : w.R.rep ∈ racl k ({a * c, b * c + d} : Set K) := by
    apply point_rep_mem_of_le
    rw [← hw.meet_R, hC]
    exact inf_le_right
  have hρ0 : w.R.rep ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) := point_rep_notMem_empty w.R
  have hqc : w.Q.rep ∈ racl k ({c, d} : Set K) := by
    apply point_rep_mem_of_le
    rw [← hB]
    exact hw.Q_le_B
  have hqT : w.Q.rep ∉ racl k ({c} : Set K) :=
    point_rep_notMem_of_ne hT (hw.Q_ne_T hID)
  have hgPT : w.G.rep ∈ racl k ({w.P.rep, c} : Set K) := by
    apply point_rep_mem_of_le
    rw [w.P.point_rep, ← hw.meet_G, hT]
    exact inf_le_left
  have hgQR : w.G.rep ∈ racl k ({w.Q.rep, w.R.rep} : Set K) := by
    apply point_rep_mem_of_le
    rw [w.Q.point_rep, w.R.point_rep, ← hw.meet_G]
    exact inf_le_right
  have hgT : w.G.rep ∉ racl k ({c} : Set K) :=
    point_rep_notMem_of_ne hT (hw.G_ne_T hID)
  have hhUG : w.H.rep ∈ racl k ({a * c, w.G.rep} : Set K) := by
    apply point_rep_mem_of_le
    rw [w.G.point_rep, ← hw.meet_H, hU]
    exact inf_le_left
  have hhA : w.H.rep ∈ racl k ({a, b} : Set K) := by
    apply point_rep_mem_of_le
    rw [← hw.meet_H, hA]
    exact inf_le_right
  have hhS : w.H.rep ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K) :=
    point_rep_notMem_of_ne hS (hw.H_ne_S hID)
  have hiH : w.I.rep ∈ racl k ({w.H.rep, x} : Set K) := by
    apply point_rep_mem_of_le
    rw [w.H.point_rep, ← hw.meet_I, hX]
    exact inf_le_left
  have hiP : w.I.rep ∈ racl k ({w.P.rep, a * x + b} : Set K) := by
    apply point_rep_mem_of_le
    rw [w.P.point_rep, ← hw.meet_I, hY]
    exact inf_le_right
  have hi0 : w.I.rep ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) := point_rep_notMem_empty w.I
  have heT : w.E.rep ∈ racl k ({c, a * x + b} : Set K) := by
    apply point_rep_mem_of_le
    rw [← hw.meet_E, hT, hY]
    exact inf_le_left
  have heQ : w.E.rep ∈ racl k ({w.Q.rep, c * (a * x + b) + d} : Set K) := by
    apply point_rep_mem_of_le
    rw [w.Q.point_rep, ← hw.meet_E, hZ]
    exact inf_le_right
  have he0 : w.E.rep ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) := point_rep_notMem_empty w.E
  exact ⟨hp, hpa, hδx, hδa, hδy, hf, hfm, hfu, hρFZ, hρC, hρ0, hqc, hqT, hgPT, hgQR, hgT, hhUG,
    hhA, hhS, hiH, hiP, hi0, heT, heQ, he0⟩

name: AclGeom.guarded_two_family_rows
statement:
private theorem guarded_two_family_rows [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K] {w : QWitness k K}
    (hw : w.Psi) (hID : w.I ≠ w.D) {a b c d x : K}
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b, c, d, x])
    (hA : w.A = ClosedIF.point k a ⊔ ClosedIF.point k b)
    (hB : w.B = ClosedIF.point k c ⊔ ClosedIF.point k d)
    (hC : w.C = ClosedIF.point k (a * c) ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (b * c + d))
    (hS : w.S.1 = ClosedIF.point k a) (hT : w.T.1 = ClosedIF.point k c)
    (hU : w.U.1 = ClosedIF.point k (a * c)) (hX : w.X.1 = ClosedIF.point k x)
    (hY : w.Y.1 = ClosedIF.point k (a * x + b))
    (hZ : w.Z.1 = ClosedIF.point k (c * (a * x + b) + d)) :
    ∃ FP : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k ({w.F.rep} : Set K)), Prime FP ∧
      idealOf ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k ({w.F.rep} : Set K)) ![a * c, x] = Ideal.span {FP} ∧
      ∀ tP : ℕ → K,
        (∀ n < 2 * FP.totalDegree + 1,
          tP n ∉ racl k ({a, b, x, c} ∪ tP '' Set.Iio n)) →
        ∃ κ : k, racl k ({w.P.rep} : Set K) =
            racl k ({b + (a - 1) * algebraMap k K κ} : Set K) ∧
          racl k ({w.D.rep} : Set K) = racl k ({a * (x - algebraMap k K κ)} : Set K) ∧
          racl k ({w.F.rep} : Set K) = racl k ({a * c * (x - algebraMap k K κ)} : Set K) ∧
          racl k ({w.R.rep} : Set K) =
            racl k ({b * c + d + a * c * algebraMap k K κ} : Set K) ∧
          let B
proof:
:= b + (a - 1) * algebraMap k K κ
          let D := d + (c - 1) * algebraMap k K κ
          ∃ FQ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k ({w.H.rep⁻¹} : Set K)),
            Prime FQ ∧
            idealOf ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k ({w.H.rep⁻¹} : Set K)) ![a⁻¹, B] =
              Ideal.span {FQ} ∧
            ∀ tQ : ℕ → K,
              (∀ n < 2 * FQ.totalDegree + 1,
                tQ n ∉ racl k ({c, D, B, (a * c)⁻¹} ∪ tQ '' Set.Iio n)) →
              ∃ η : k, racl k ({w.Q.rep} : Set K) =
                  racl k ({D + (c - 1) * algebraMap k K η} : Set K) ∧
                AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, B - algebraMap k K η,
                  c, D + (c - 1) * algebraMap k K η, x - algebraMap k K κ] ∧
                racl k ({w.G.rep} : Set K) = racl k ({(B - algebraMap k K η) * c} : Set K) ∧
                racl k ({w.H.rep} : Set K) = racl k ({a / (B - algebraMap k K η)} : Set K) ∧
                racl k ({w.I.rep} : Set K) =
                  racl k ({a * (x - algebraMap k K κ) / (B - algebraMap k K η)} : Set K) ∧
                racl k ({w.E.rep} : Set K) =
                  racl k ({c * (a * (x - algebraMap k K κ) +
                    (B - algebraMap k K η))} : Set K) := by
  obtain ⟨hp, hpa, hδx, hδa, hδy, hf, hfm, hfu, hρFZ, hρC, hρ0, hqc, hqT, hgPT, hgQR, hgT, hhUG,
    hhA, hhS, hiH, hiP, hi0, heT, heQ, he0⟩ :=
    guarded_raw_inputs hw hID hA hB hC hS hT hU hX hY hZ
  exact two_family_remaining_rows hind hp hpa hδx hδa hδy hf hfm hfu
    hρFZ hρC hρ0 hqc hqT hgPT hgQR hgT hhUG hhA hhS hiH hiP hi0 heT heQ he0

name: AclGeom.point_eq_of_rep_racl_eq
statement:
private theorem point_eq_of_rep_racl_eq {P : Point k K} {u : K}
    (h : racl k ({P.rep} : Set K) = racl k ({u} : Set K)) : P.1 = ClosedIF.point k u
proof:
:=
  P.point_rep.symm.trans (Subtype.ext h)

name: AclGeom.point_eq_point_of_sub_mem
statement:
private theorem point_eq_point_of_sub_mem {v v' : K} (h : v - v' ∈ racl k (∅ : Set K)) :
    ClosedIF.point k v = ClosedIF.point k v'
proof:
:= by
  have hv : v ∈ racl k ({v} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ rfl
  have hv' : v' ∈ racl k ({v'} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ rfl
  refine ClosedIF.point_eq_point_iff.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [ClosedIF.mem_point]
    have hmem := add_mem hv' (racl_mono (Set.empty_subset _) h)
    have heq : v' + (v - v') = v := by ring
    rwa [heq] at hmem
  · rw [ClosedIF.mem_point]
    have hmem := sub_mem hv (racl_mono (Set.empty_subset _) h)
    have heq : v - (v - v') = v' := by ring
    rwa [heq] at hmem

name: AclGeom.sup_point_eq_of_sub_mem
statement:
private theorem sup_point_eq_of_sub_mem {u v v' : K} (h : v' - v ∈ racl k ({u} : Set K)) :
    ClosedIF.point k u ⊔ ClosedIF.point k v = ClosedIF.point k u ⊔ ClosedIF.point k v'
proof:
:= by
  have hsub (z : K) : racl k ({u} : Set K) ≤ racl k ({u, z} : Set K) :=
    racl_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (Set.mem_insert _ _))
  have hu (z : K) : u ∈ racl k ({u, z} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  have hz (z : K) : z ∈ racl k ({u, z} : Set K) :=
    subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
  refine le_antisymm (sup_le ?_ ?_) (sup_le ?_ ?_)
  · exact ClosedIF.point_le_iff.2 (ClosedIF.mem_sup_point_iff.2 (hu v'))
  · refine ClosedIF.point_le_iff.2 (ClosedIF.mem_sup_point_iff.2 ?_)
    have hmem := sub_mem (hz v') (hsub v' h)
    have heq : v' - (v' - v) = v := by ring
    rwa [heq] at hmem
  · exact ClosedIF.point_le_iff.2 (ClosedIF.mem_sup_point_iff.2 (hu v))
  · refine ClosedIF.point_le_iff.2 (ClosedIF.mem_sup_point_iff.2 ?_)
    have hmem := add_mem (hz v) (hsub v h)
    have heq : v + (v' - v) = v' := by ring
    rwa [heq] at hmem

name: AclGeom.hasAffineGridCoordinates_of_rows
statement:
private theorem hasAffineGridCoordinates_of_rows {w : QWitness k K} {a b c d x : K}
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b, c, d, x])
    (hA : w.A = ClosedIF.point k a ⊔ ClosedIF.point k b)
    (hB : w.B = ClosedIF.point k c ⊔ ClosedIF.point k d)
    (hC : w.C = ClosedIF.point k (a * c) ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (b * c + d))
    (hD : w.D.1 = ClosedIF.point k (a * x))
    (hE : w.E.1 = ClosedIF.point k (c * (a * x + b)))
    (hF : w.F.1 = ClosedIF.point k (a * c * x)) (hG : w.G.1 = ClosedIF.point k (b * c))
    (hH : w.H.1 = ClosedIF.point k (a / b)) (hI : w.I.1 = ClosedIF.point k (a * x / b))
    (hP : w.P.1 = ClosedIF.point k b) (hQ : w.Q.1 = ClosedIF.point k d)
    (hR : w.R.1 = ClosedIF.point k (b * c + d)) (hS : w.S.1 = ClosedIF.point k a)
    (hT : w.T.1 = ClosedIF.point k c) (hU : w.U.1 = ClosedIF.point k (a * c))
    (hX : w.X.1 = ClosedIF.point k x) (hY : w.Y.1 = ClosedIF.point k (a * x + b))
    (hZ : w.Z.1 = ClosedIF.point k (c * (a * x + b) + d)) :
    w.HasAffineGridCoordinates
proof:
:=
  ⟨a, b, c, d, x, hind, hA, hB, hC, Subtype.ext hD, Subtype.ext hE, Subtype.ext hF,
    Subtype.ext hG, Subtype.ext hH, Subtype.ext hI, Subtype.ext hP, Subtype.ext hQ,
    Subtype.ext hR, Subtype.ext hS, Subtype.ext hT, Subtype.ext hU, Subtype.ext hX,
    Subtype.ext hY, Subtype.ext hZ⟩

name: AclGeom.hasAffineGridCoordinates_of_final_rows
statement:
private theorem hasAffineGridCoordinates_of_final_rows {w : QWitness k K} {a b c d x t s : K}
    (ht : t ∈ racl k (∅ : Set K)) (hs : s ∈ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    (hA : w.A = ClosedIF.point k a ⊔ ClosedIF.point k b)
    (hB : w.B = ClosedIF.point k c ⊔ ClosedIF.point k d)
    (hC : w.C = ClosedIF.point k (a * c) ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (b * c + d))
    (hS : w.S.1 = ClosedIF.point k a) (hT : w.T.1 = ClosedIF.point k c)
    (hU : w.U.1 = ClosedIF.point k (a * c)) (hX : w.X.1 = ClosedIF.point k x)
    (hY : w.Y.1 = ClosedIF.point k (a * x + b))
    (hZ : w.Z.1 = ClosedIF.point k (c * (a * x + b) + d))
    (hFinal : AlgebraicIndependent k
      ![a, b + (a - 1) * t - s, c, d + (c - 1) * t + (c - 1) * s, x - t])
    (hP : racl k ({w.P.rep} : Set K) = racl k ({b + (a - 1) * t} : Set K))
    (hD : racl k ({w.D.rep} : Set K) = racl k ({a * (x - t)} : Set K))
    (hF : racl k ({w.F.rep} : Set K) = racl k ({a * c * (x - t)} : Set K))
    (hR : racl k ({w.R.rep} : Set K) = racl k ({b * c + d + a * c * t} : Set K))
    (hQ : racl k ({w.Q.rep} : Set K) = racl k ({d + (c - 1) * t + (c - 1) * s} : Set K))
    (hG : racl k ({w.G.rep} : Set K) = racl k ({(b + (a - 1) * t - s) * c} : Set K))
    (hH : racl k ({w.H.rep} : Set K) = racl k ({a / (b + (a - 1) * t - s)} : Set K))
    (hI : racl k ({w.I.rep} : Set K) =
      racl k ({a * (x - t) / (b + (a - 1) * t - s)} : Set K))
    (hE : racl k ({w.E.rep} : Set K) =
      racl k ({c * (a * (x - t) + (b + (a - 1) * t - s))} : Set K)) :
    w.HasAffineGridCoordinates
proof:
:= by
  have htS (S : Set K) : t ∈ racl k S := racl_mono (Set.empty_subset S) ht
  have hsS (S : Set K) : s ∈ racl k S := racl_mono (Set.empty_subset S) hs
  
  have hA' : w.A = ClosedIF.point k a ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (b + (a - 1) * t - s) := by
    have ha : a ∈ racl k ({a} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ rfl
    have hdiff : b + (a - 1) * t - s - b = (a - 1) * t - s := by ring
    have hmem : b + (a - 1) * t - s - b ∈ racl k ({a} : Set K) := by
      rw [hdiff]
      exact sub_mem (mul_mem (sub_mem ha (one_mem _)) (htS _)) (hsS _)
    rw [hA]
    exact sup_point_eq_of_sub_mem hmem
  have hB' : w.B =
      ClosedIF.point k c ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (d + (c - 1) * t + (c - 1) * s) := by
    have hc : c ∈ racl k ({c} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ rfl
    have hdiff : d + (c - 1) * t + (c - 1) * s - d = (c - 1) * t + (c - 1) * s := by ring
    have hmem : d + (c - 1) * t + (c - 1) * s - d ∈ racl k ({c} : Set K) := by
      rw [hdiff]
      exact add_mem (mul_mem (sub_mem hc (one_mem _)) (htS _))
        (mul_mem (sub_mem hc (one_mem _)) (hsS _))
    rw [hB]
    exact sup_point_eq_of_sub_mem hmem
  have hC' : w.C = ClosedIF.point k (a * c) ⊔
      ClosedIF.point k ((b + (a - 1) * t - s) * c + (d + (c - 1) * t + (c - 1) * s)) := by
    have hac : a * c ∈ racl k ({a * c} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ rfl
    have hdiff : (b + (a - 1) * t - s) * c + (d + (c - 1) * t + (c - 1) * s) - (b * c + d) =
        a * c * t - t - s := by ring
    have hmem : (b + (a - 1) * t - s) * c + (d + (c - 1) * t + (c - 1) * s) - (b * c + d) ∈
        racl k ({a * c} : Set K) := by
      rw [hdiff]
      exact sub_mem (sub_mem (mul_mem hac (htS _)) (htS _)) (hsS _)
    rw [hC]
    exact sup_point_eq_of_sub_mem hmem
  
  have hP' : w.P.1 = ClosedIF.point k (b + (a - 1) * t - s) := by
    have hdiff : b + (a - 1) * t - (b + (a - 1) * t - s) = s := by ring
    have hmem : b + (a - 1) * t - (b + (a - 1) * t - s) ∈ racl k (∅ : Set K) := by
      rw [hdiff]
      exact hs
    rw [point_eq_of_rep_racl_eq hP]
    exact point_eq_point_of_sub_mem hmem
  have hR' : w.R.1 =
      ClosedIF.point k ((b + (a - 1) * t - s) * c + (d + (c - 1) * t + (c - 1) * s)) := by
    have hdiff : b * c + d + a * c * t -
        ((b + (a - 1) * t - s) * c + (d + (c - 1) * t + (c - 1) * s)) = t + s := by ring
    have hmem : b * c + d + a * c * t -
        ((b + (a - 1) * t - s) * c + (d + (c - 1) * t + (c - 1) * s)) ∈
          racl k (∅ : Set K) := by
      rw [hdiff]
      exact add_mem ht hs
    rw [point_eq_of_rep_racl_eq hR]
    exact point_eq_point_of_sub_mem hmem
  have hX' : w.X.1 = ClosedIF.point k (x - t) := by
    have hdiff : x - (x - t) = t := by ring
    have hmem : x - (x - t) ∈ racl k (∅ : Set K) := by
      rw [hdiff]
      exact ht
    rw [hX]
    exact point_eq_point_of_sub_mem hmem
  have hY' : w.Y.1 = ClosedIF.point k (a * (x - t) + (b + (a - 1) * t - s)) := by
    have hdiff : a * x + b - (a * (x - t) + (b + (a - 1) * t - s)) = t + s := by ring
    have hmem : a * x + b - (a * (x - t) + (b + (a - 1) * t - s)) ∈
        racl k (∅ : Set K) := by
      rw [hdiff]
      exact add_mem ht hs
    rw [hY]
    exact point_eq_point_of_sub_mem hmem
  have hZ' : w.Z.1 = ClosedIF.point k
      (c * (a * (x - t) + (b + (a - 1) * t - s)) + (d + (c - 1) * t + (c - 1) * s)) := by
    have hdiff : c * (a * x + b) + d -
        (c * (a * (x - t) + (b + (a - 1) * t - s)) + (d + (c - 1) * t + (c - 1) * s)) =
          t + s := by ring
    have hmem : c * (a * x + b) + d -
        (c * (a * (x - t) + (b + (a - 1) * t - s)) + (d + (c - 1) * t + (c - 1) * s)) ∈
          racl k (∅ : Set K) := by
      rw [hdiff]
      exact add_mem ht hs
    rw [hZ]
    exact point_eq_point_of_sub_mem hmem
  exact hasAffineGridCoordinates_of_rows hFinal hA' hB' hC' (point_eq_of_rep_racl_eq hD)
    (point_eq_of_rep_racl_eq hE) (point_eq_of_rep_racl_eq hF) (point_eq_of_rep_racl_eq hG)
    (point_eq_of_rep_racl_eq hH) (point_eq_of_rep_racl_eq hI) hP'
    (point_eq_of_rep_racl_eq hQ) hR' hS hT hU hX' hY' hZ'

name: AclGeom.algHom_mem_racl_pair_iff
statement:
private theorem algHom_mem_racl_pair_iff {Ω : Type*} [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω] (τ : K →ₐ[k] Ω)
    {u v z : K} : τ z ∈ racl k ({τ u, τ v} : Set Ω) ↔ z ∈ racl k ({u, v} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Set.image_pair] using
    algHom_mem_racl_image_iff τ (S := ({u, v} : Set K)) (x := z)

name: AclGeom.racl_singleton_eq_of_algHom
statement:
private theorem racl_singleton_eq_of_algHom {Ω : Type*} [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω]
    (τ : K →ₐ[k] Ω) {u v : K} (h : racl k ({τ u} : Set Ω) = racl k ({τ v} : Set Ω)) :
    racl k ({u} : Set K) = racl k ({v} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  apply racl_singleton_congr
  · apply (algHom_mem_racl_singleton_iff τ).1
    rw [← h]
    exact subset_racl k _ rfl
  · apply (algHom_mem_racl_singleton_iff τ).1
    rw [h]
    exact subset_racl k _ rfl

name: AclGeom.final_rows_of_raw_in_extension
statement:
private theorem final_rows_of_raw_in_extension [IsAlgClosed k] {Ω : Type*} [Field Ω]
    [Algebra k Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (τ : K →ₐ[k] Ω)
    (htr : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ Algebra.trdeg k Ω) {a b c d x p δ f ρ q g h i e : K}
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b, c, d, x])
    (hp : p ∈ racl k ({a, b} : Set K)) (hpa : p ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K))
    (hδx : δ ∈ racl k ({a, x} : Set K)) (hδa : δ ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K))
    (hδy : δ ∈ racl k ({p, a * x + b} : Set K)) (hf : f ∈ racl k ({c, δ} : Set K))
    (hfm : f ∈ racl k ({a * c, x} : Set K)) (hfu : f ∉ racl k ({a * c} : Set K))
    (hρFZ : ρ ∈ racl k ({f, c * (a * x + b) + d} : Set K))
    (hρC : ρ ∈ racl k ({a * c, b * c + d} : Set K))
    (hρ0 : ρ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    (hqc : q ∈ racl k ({c, d} : Set K)) (hqT : q ∉ racl k ({c} : Set K))
    (hgPT : g ∈ racl k ({p, c} : Set K))
    (hgQR : g ∈ racl k ({q, ρ} : Set K)) (hgT : g ∉ racl k ({c} : Set K))
    (hhUG : h ∈ racl k ({a * c, g} : Set K))
    (hhA : h ∈ racl k ({a, b} : Set K)) (hhS : h ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K))
    (hiH : i ∈ racl k ({h, x} : Set K))
    (hiP : i ∈ racl k ({p, a * x + b} : Set K)) (hi0 : i ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    (heT : e ∈ racl k ({c, a * x + b} : Set K))
    (heQ : e ∈ racl k ({q, c * (a * x + b) + d} : Set K))
    (he0 : e ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) :
    ∃ κ η : k,
      AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b + (a - 1) * algebraMap k K κ - algebraMap k K η, c,
        d + (c - 1) * algebraMap k K κ + (c - 1) * algebraMap k K η, x - algebraMap k K κ] ∧
      racl k ({p} : Set K) = racl k ({b + (a - 1) * algebraMap k K κ} : Set K) ∧
      racl k ({δ} : Set K) = racl k ({a * (x - algebraMap k K κ)} : Set K) ∧
      racl k ({f} : Set K) = racl k ({a * c * (x - algebraMap k K κ)} : Set K) ∧
      racl k ({ρ} : Set K) = racl k ({b * c + d + a * c * algebraMap k K κ} : Set K) ∧
      racl k ({q} : Set K) =
        racl k ({d + (c - 1) * algebraMap k K κ + (c - 1) * algebraMap k K η} : Set K) ∧
      racl k ({g} : Set K) =
        racl k ({(b + (a - 1) * algebraMap k K κ - algebraMap k K η) * c} : Set K) ∧
      racl k ({h} : Set K) =
        racl k ({a / (b + (a - 1) * algebraMap k K κ - algebraMap k K η)} : Set K) ∧
      racl k ({i} : Set K) = racl k ({a * (x - algebraMap k K κ) /
        (b + (a - 1) * algebraMap k K κ - algebraMap k K η)} : Set K) ∧
      racl k ({e} : Set K) = racl k ({c * (a * (x - algebraMap k K κ) +
        (b + (a - 1) * algebraMap k K κ - algebraMap k K η))} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hτ : Function.Injective τ := τ.toRingHom.injective
  have hindΩ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![τ a, τ b, τ c, τ d, τ x] := by
    have hcomp : (⇑τ ∘ ![a, b, c, d, x]) = ![τ a, τ b, τ c, τ d, τ x] := by
      funext j
      fin_cases j <;> rfl
    rw [← hcomp]
    exact (AlgHom.algebraicIndependent_iff τ hτ).2 hind
  have hpΩ : τ p ∈ racl k ({τ a, τ b} : Set Ω) := (algHom_mem_racl_pair_iff τ).2 hp
  have hpaΩ : τ p ∉ racl k ({τ a} : Set Ω) :=
    fun hmem ↦ hpa ((algHom_mem_racl_singleton_iff τ).1 hmem)
  have hδxΩ : τ δ ∈ racl k ({τ a, τ x} : Set Ω) := (algHom_mem_racl_pair_iff τ).2 hδx
  have hδaΩ : τ δ ∉ racl k ({τ a} : Set Ω) :=
    fun hmem ↦ hδa ((algHom_mem_racl_singleton_iff τ).1 hmem)
  have hδyΩ : τ δ ∈ racl k ({τ p, τ a * τ x + τ b} : Set Ω) := by
    simpa only [map_add, map_mul] using (algHom_mem_racl_pair_iff τ).2 hδy
  have hfΩ : τ f ∈ racl k ({τ c, τ δ} : Set Ω) := (algHom_mem_racl_pair_iff τ).2 hf
  have hfmΩ : τ f ∈ racl k ({τ a * τ c, τ x} : Set Ω) := by
    simpa only [map_mul] using (algHom_mem_racl_pair_iff τ).2 hfm
  have hfuΩ : τ f ∉ racl k ({τ a * τ c} : Set Ω) := fun hmem ↦
    hfu ((algHom_mem_racl_singleton_iff τ).1 (by simpa only [map_mul] using hmem))
  have hρFZΩ : τ ρ ∈ racl k ({τ f, τ c * (τ a * τ x + τ b) + τ d} : Set Ω) := by
    simpa only [map_add, map_mul] using (algHom_mem_racl_pair_iff τ).2 hρFZ
  have hρCΩ : τ ρ ∈ racl k ({τ a * τ c, τ b * τ c + τ d} : Set Ω) := by
    simpa only [map_add, map_mul] using (algHom_mem_racl_pair_iff τ).2 hρC
  have hρ0Ω : τ ρ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set Ω) :=
    fun hmem ↦ hρ0 ((algHom_mem_racl_empty_iff τ).1 hmem)
  have hqcΩ : τ q ∈ racl k ({τ c, τ d} : Set Ω) := (algHom_mem_racl_pair_iff τ).2 hqc
  have hqTΩ : τ q ∉ racl k ({τ c} : Set Ω) :=
    fun hmem ↦ hqT ((algHom_mem_racl_singleton_iff τ).1 hmem)
  have hgPTΩ : τ g ∈ racl k ({τ p, τ c} : Set Ω) := (algHom_mem_racl_pair_iff τ).2 hgPT
  have hgQRΩ : τ g ∈ racl k ({τ q, τ ρ} : Set Ω) := (algHom_mem_racl_pair_iff τ).2 hgQR
  have hgTΩ : τ g ∉ racl k ({τ c} : Set Ω) :=
    fun hmem ↦ hgT ((algHom_mem_racl_singleton_iff τ).1 hmem)
  have hhUGΩ : τ h ∈ racl k ({τ a * τ c, τ g} : Set Ω) := by
    simpa only [map_mul] using (algHom_mem_racl_pair_iff τ).2 hhUG
  have hhAΩ : τ h ∈ racl k ({τ a, τ b} : Set Ω) := (algHom_mem_racl_pair_iff τ).2 hhA
  have hhSΩ : τ h ∉ racl k ({τ a} : Set Ω) :=
    fun hmem ↦ hhS ((algHom_mem_racl_singleton_iff τ).1 hmem)
  have hiHΩ : τ i ∈ racl k ({τ h, τ x} : Set Ω) := (algHom_mem_racl_pair_iff τ).2 hiH
  have hiPΩ : τ i ∈ racl k ({τ p, τ a * τ x + τ b} : Set Ω) := by
    simpa only [map_add, map_mul] using (algHom_mem_racl_pair_iff τ).2 hiP
  have hi0Ω : τ i ∉ racl k (∅ : Set Ω) :=
    fun hmem ↦ hi0 ((algHom_mem_racl_empty_iff τ).1 hmem)
  have heTΩ : τ e ∈ racl k ({τ c, τ a * τ x + τ b} : Set Ω) := by
    simpa only [map_add, map_mul] using (algHom_mem_racl_pair_iff τ).2 heT
  have heQΩ : τ e ∈ racl k ({τ q, τ c * (τ a * τ x + τ b) + τ d} : Set Ω) := by
    simpa only [map_add, map_mul] using (algHom_mem_racl_pair_iff τ).2 heQ
  have he0Ω : τ e ∉ racl k (∅ : Set Ω) :=
    fun hmem ↦ he0 ((algHom_mem_racl_empty_iff τ).1 hmem)
  
  obtain ⟨_, -, -, HP⟩ := two_family_remaining_rows hindΩ hpΩ hpaΩ hδxΩ hδaΩ hδyΩ hfΩ hfmΩ
    hfuΩ hρFZΩ hρCΩ hρ0Ω hqcΩ hqTΩ hgPTΩ hgQRΩ hgTΩ hhUGΩ hhAΩ hhSΩ hiHΩ hiPΩ hi0Ω heTΩ heQΩ
    he0Ω
  obtain ⟨tP, htP⟩ := exists_fresh_sequence_of_aleph0_le_trdeg htr
    (Set.Finite.insert (τ a) (Set.Finite.insert (τ b) (Set.Finite.insert (τ x)
      (Set.finite_singleton (τ c)))))
  obtain ⟨κ, hP, hD, hF, hR, _, -, -, HQ⟩ := HP tP fun n _ ↦ htP n
  
  obtain ⟨tQ, htQ⟩ := exists_fresh_sequence_of_aleph0_le_trdeg htr
    (Set.Finite.insert (τ c) (Set.Finite.insert (τ d + (τ c - 1) * algebraMap k Ω κ)
      (Set.Finite.insert (τ b + (τ a - 1) * algebraMap k Ω κ)
        (Set.finite_singleton (τ a * τ c)⁻¹))))
  obtain ⟨η, hQ, -, hG, hH, hI, hE⟩ := HQ tQ fun n _ ↦ htQ n
  
  refine ⟨κ, η, algebraicIndependent_table_Q_shift (algebraicIndependent_table_shift hind κ) η,
    racl_singleton_eq_of_algHom τ ?_, racl_singleton_eq_of_algHom τ ?_,
    racl_singleton_eq_of_algHom τ ?_, racl_singleton_eq_of_algHom τ ?_,
    racl_singleton_eq_of_algHom τ ?_, racl_singleton_eq_of_algHom τ ?_,
    racl_singleton_eq_of_algHom τ ?_, racl_singleton_eq_of_algHom τ ?_,
    racl_singleton_eq_of_algHom τ ?_⟩
  · simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_mul, map_one, AlgHom.commutes]
    exact hP
  · simp only [map_sub, map_mul, AlgHom.commutes]
    exact hD
  · simp only [map_sub, map_mul, AlgHom.commutes]
    exact hF
  · simp only [map_add, map_mul, AlgHom.commutes]
    exact hR
  · simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_mul, map_one, AlgHom.commutes]
    exact hQ
  · simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_mul, map_one, AlgHom.commutes]
    exact hG
  · simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_mul, map_one, map_div₀, AlgHom.commutes]
    exact hH
  · simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_mul, map_one, map_div₀, AlgHom.commutes]
    exact hI
  · simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_mul, map_one, AlgHom.commutes]
    exact hE

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.hasAffineGridCoordinates_of_chart_supplied_inputs
statement:
theorem Psi.hasAffineGridCoordinates_of_chart_supplied_inputs [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K]
    {w : QWitness k K} (hw : w.Psi) (hID : w.I ≠ w.D) {a b c d x : K}
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b, c, d, x])
    (hA : w.A = ClosedIF.point k a ⊔ ClosedIF.point k b)
    (hB : w.B = ClosedIF.point k c ⊔ ClosedIF.point k d)
    (hC : w.C = ClosedIF.point k (a * c) ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (b * c + d))
    (hS : w.S.1 = ClosedIF.point k a) (hT : w.T.1 = ClosedIF.point k c)
    (hU : w.U.1 = ClosedIF.point k (a * c)) (hX : w.X.1 = ClosedIF.point k x)
    (hY : w.Y.1 = ClosedIF.point k (a * x + b))
    (hZ : w.Z.1 = ClosedIF.point k (c * (a * x + b) + d)) :
    ∃ FP : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k ({w.F.rep} : Set K)), Prime FP ∧
      idealOf ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k ({w.F.rep} : Set K)) ![a * c, x] = Ideal.span {FP} ∧
      ∀ tP : ℕ → K,
        (∀ n < 2 * FP.totalDegree + 1, tP n ∉ racl k ({a, b, x, c} ∪ tP '' Set.Iio n)) →
        ∃ κ : k,
          ∃ FQ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k ({w.H.rep⁻¹} : Set K)),
            Prime FQ ∧
            idealOf ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k ({w.H.rep⁻¹} : Set K))
              ![a⁻¹, b + (a - 1) * algebraMap k K κ] = Ideal.span {FQ} ∧
            ∀ tQ : ℕ → K,
              (∀ n < 2 * FQ.totalDegree + 1,
                tQ n ∉ racl k ({c, d + (c - 1) * algebraMap k K κ,
                  b + (a - 1) * algebraMap k K κ, (a * c)⁻¹} ∪ tQ '' Set.Iio n)) →
              w.HasAffineGridCoordinates
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨FP, hFP, hSpanP, HP⟩ :=
    guarded_two_family_rows hw hID hind hA hB hC hS hT hU hX hY hZ
  refine ⟨FP, hFP, hSpanP, fun tP htP ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨κ, hP, hD, hF, hR, FQ, hFQ, hSpanQ, HQ⟩ := HP tP htP
  refine ⟨κ, FQ, hFQ, hSpanQ, fun tQ htQ ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨η, hQ, hFinal, hG, hH, hI, hE⟩ := HQ tQ htQ
  exact hasAffineGridCoordinates_of_final_rows (t := algebraMap k K κ) (s := algebraMap k K η)
    ((racl k (∅ : Set K)).algebraMap_mem κ) ((racl k (∅ : Set K)).algebraMap_mem η)
    hA hB hC hS hT hU hX hY hZ hFinal hP hD hF hR hQ hG hH hI hE

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.hasAffineGridCoordinates_of_chart
statement:
theorem Psi.hasAffineGridCoordinates_of_chart [IsAlgClosed k]
    {w : QWitness k K} (hw : w.Psi) (hID : w.I ≠ w.D) {a b c d x : K}
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b, c, d, x])
    (hA : w.A = ClosedIF.point k a ⊔ ClosedIF.point k b)
    (hB : w.B = ClosedIF.point k c ⊔ ClosedIF.point k d)
    (hC : w.C = ClosedIF.point k (a * c) ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (b * c + d))
    (hS : w.S.1 = ClosedIF.point k a) (hT : w.T.1 = ClosedIF.point k c)
    (hU : w.U.1 = ClosedIF.point k (a * c)) (hX : w.X.1 = ClosedIF.point k x)
    (hY : w.Y.1 = ClosedIF.point k (a * x + b))
    (hZ : w.Z.1 = ClosedIF.point k (c * (a * x + b) + d)) :
    w.HasAffineGridCoordinates
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hp, hpa, hδx, hδa, hδy, hf, hfm, hfu, hρFZ, hρC, hρ0, hqc, hqT, hgPT, hgQR, hgT, hhUG,
    hhA, hhS, hiH, hiP, hi0, heT, heQ, he0⟩ :=
    guarded_raw_inputs hw hID hA hB hC hS hT hU hX hY hZ
  obtain ⟨κ, η, hFinal, hP, hD, hF, hR, hQ, hG, hH, hI, hE⟩ :=
    final_rows_of_raw_in_extension
      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k K (AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ℕ K))))
      aleph0_le_trdeg_algebraicClosure hind hp hpa hδx hδa hδy hf hfm hfu hρFZ hρC hρ0 hqc hqT
      hgPT hgQR hgT hhUG hhA hhS hiH hiP hi0 heT heQ he0
  exact hasAffineGridCoordinates_of_final_rows (t := algebraMap k K κ) (s := algebraMap k K η)
    ((racl k (∅ : Set K)).algebraMap_mem κ) ((racl k (∅ : Set K)).algebraMap_mem η)
    hA hB hC hS hT hU hX hY hZ hFinal hP hD hF hR hQ hG hH hI hE

statement:
theorem selectedGraphRightSourceToRightB_comp_bGermCoefficient
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :
    (R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightBRingEquiv L hind).toRingHom.comp
        (R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom L hind) =
      R.bGermCoefficientToRightBSourceRingHom L hind
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro x
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply,
    R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom_apply]
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (R.rightBCommonSourceClosureTransport hind).closureEquiv
      (algebraMap (↥R.semanticCommonSourceField)
        (AlgebraicClosure (↥R.semanticCommonSourceField))
        (R.seBGermCoefficientToSemanticSourceAlgHom L hind x)) =
    algebraMap (↥R.semanticCommonSourceField)
      (AlgebraicClosure (↥R.semanticCommonSourceField))
      (R.sbBGermCoefficientToSemanticSourceAlgHom L hind x)
  rw [AlgebraicClosureTransport.commutes_apply]
  exact congrArg
    (algebraMap (↥R.semanticCommonSourceField)
      (AlgebraicClosure (↥R.semanticCommonSourceField)))
    (R.commonSourceRightBAut_comp_seBGermCoefficient L hind x)

        (R.bGermCoefficientToRightBSourceRingHom L hind) =
      R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom L hind
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro x
  have hx := DFunLike.congr_fun
    (R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightB_comp_bGermCoefficient L hind) x
  change R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightBRingEquiv L hind
      (R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom L hind x) =
    R.bGermCoefficientToRightBSourceRingHom L hind x at hx
  change (R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightBRingEquiv L hind).symm
      (R.bGermCoefficientToRightBSourceRingHom L hind x) =
    R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom L hind x
  apply (R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightBRingEquiv L hind).injective
  simpa using hx.symm

name: AclGeom.pair_point_eq_of_racl
statement:
private theorem pair_point_eq_of_racl (P Q : Point k K) (a b : K)
    (h : racl k (range (![P.rep, Q.rep] : Fin 2 → K)) =
      racl k (range (![a, b] : Fin 2 → K))) :
    P.1 ⊔ Q.1 = ClosedIF.point k a ⊔ ClosedIF.point k b
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty,
    ← coe_sup_point₂, ← coe_sup_point₂, P.point_rep, Q.point_rep] at h
  exact Subtype.ext h

name: AclGeom.single_point_eq_of_racl
proof:
:= by

name: AclGeom.initialChart_descent
statement:
private theorem initialChart_descent [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    [UniversalDomain k Ω] {w : QWitness k K} (hw : w.Psi) (hID : w.I ≠ w.D)
    (f : K →ₐ[k] Ω) (L : IntermediateField k Ω)
    (hL : IndepOver k ∅ (L : Set Ω) (range (f ∘ w.repTuple)))
    (v : Fin 5 → Ω)
    (hrows : ∀ j : Fin 9, racl (↥L) (range (f ∘ initialWitnessValues w j)) =
      racl (↥L) (range (initialChartValues v j))) : w.HasAffineGridCoordinates
proof:
:= by
  have htable (j : Fin 9) :
      racl (↥L) (range fun i ↦ aeval (f ∘ w.repTuple) (initialWitnessPolynomials k j i)) =
        racl (↥L) (range fun i ↦ aeval v (initialChartPolynomials k j i)) := by
    have hl : (fun i ↦ aeval (f ∘ w.repTuple) (initialWitnessPolynomials k j i)) =
        f ∘ initialWitnessValues w j := by
      funext i
      exact aeval_initialWitnessPolynomials f w j i
    have hr : (fun i ↦ aeval v (initialChartPolynomials k j i)) =
        initialChartValues v j := by
      funext i
      exact aeval_initialChartPolynomials v j i
    rw [hl, hr]
    exact hrows j
  obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩ := GroupConfig.exists_polynomial_closure_table_descent_to
    f L w.repTuple v hL (initialWitnessPolynomials k) (initialChartPolynomials k) htable
  have htable₀ (j : Fin 9) : racl k (range (initialWitnessValues w j)) =
      racl k (range (initialChartValues v₀ j)) := by
    have he (i : Fin 2) : aeval w.repTuple (initialWitnessPolynomials k j i) =
        initialWitnessValues w j i := by
      simpa only [AlgHom.id_apply, AlgHom.coe_id, Function.id_comp] using
        aeval_initialWitnessPolynomials (AlgHom.id k K) w j i
    simpa only [he, aeval_initialChartPolynomials] using hv₀ j
  have hA : w.A = ClosedIF.point k (v₀ 0) ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (v₀ 1) :=
    pair_point_eq_of_racl w.A₁ w.A₂ _ _ (htable₀ 0)
  have hB : w.B = ClosedIF.point k (v₀ 2) ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (v₀ 3) :=
    pair_point_eq_of_racl w.B₁ w.B₂ _ _ (htable₀ 1)
  have hC : w.C = ClosedIF.point k (v₀ 0 * v₀ 2) ⊔
      ClosedIF.point k (v₀ 1 * v₀ 2 + v₀ 3) :=
    pair_point_eq_of_racl w.C₁ w.C₂ _ _ (htable₀ 2)
  have hS : w.S.1 = ClosedIF.point k (v₀ 0) := single_point_eq_of_racl w.S _ (htable₀ 3)
  have hT : w.T.1 = ClosedIF.point k (v₀ 2) := single_point_eq_of_racl w.T _ (htable₀ 4)
  have hU : w.U.1 = ClosedIF.point k (v₀ 0 * v₀ 2) := single_point_eq_of_racl w.U _ (htable₀ 5)
  have hX : w.X.1 = ClosedIF.point k (v₀ 4) := single_point_eq_of_racl w.X _ (htable₀ 6)
  have hY : w.Y.1 = ClosedIF.point k (v₀ 0 * v₀ 4 + v₀ 1) :=
    single_point_eq_of_racl w.Y _ (htable₀ 7)
  have hZ : w.Z.1 = ClosedIF.point k (v₀ 2 * (v₀ 0 * v₀ 4 + v₀ 1) + v₀ 3) :=
    single_point_eq_of_racl w.Z _ (htable₀ 8)
  have hXnot : ¬ w.X.1 ≤ w.A ⊔ w.B := fun h ↦ hw.X_notLe (h.trans le_sup_left)
  have hrank : RankEq 5 (w.A ⊔ w.B ⊔ w.X.1) := hw.rank_AB.sup_point_of_not_le hXnot
  have hspan : w.A ⊔ w.B ⊔ w.X.1 = ⨆ i : Fin 5, ClosedIF.point k (v₀ i) := by
    rw [hA, hB, hX]
    apply le_antisymm
    · refine sup_le (sup_le (sup_le ?_ ?_) (sup_le ?_ ?_)) ?_
      · exact le_iSup_of_le 0 le_rfl
      · exact le_iSup_of_le 1 le_rfl
      · exact le_iSup_of_le 2 le_rfl
      · exact le_iSup_of_le 3 le_rfl
      · exact le_iSup_of_le 4 le_rfl
    · refine iSup_le fun i ↦ ?_
      fin_cases i
      · exact le_sup_of_le_left (le_sup_of_le_left le_sup_left)
      · exact le_sup_of_le_left (le_sup_of_le_left le_sup_right)
      · exact le_sup_of_le_left (le_sup_of_le_right le_sup_left)
      · exact le_sup_of_le_left (le_sup_of_le_right le_sup_right)
      · exact le_sup_right
  have hi : AlgebraicIndependent k v₀ :=
    algebraicIndependent_of_rankEq_iSup_point (hspan ▸ hrank)
  have hiv : AlgebraicIndependent k ![v₀ 0, v₀ 1, v₀ 2, v₀ 3, v₀ 4] := by
    convert hi using 1
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  exact hw.hasAffineGridCoordinates_of_chart hID hiv hA hB hC hS hT hU hX hY hZ

name: AclGeom.liftPointSameBase_racl
statement:
private theorem liftPointSameBase_racl (f : K →ₐ[k] Ω) (P : Point k K) :
    racl k ({(liftPointSameBase f P).rep} : Set Ω) = racl k ({f P.rep} : Set Ω)
proof:
:= by
  have hP : (liftPointSameBase f P).1 = ClosedIF.point k (f P.rep) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply SetLike.coe_injective
    change ((liftClosed (racl k (∅ : Set Ω)) f P.1).1 : Set Ω) = _
    rw [← P.point_rep, liftClosed_point (fun _ hz ↦ isAlgebraic_of_mem_racl_empty hz) f]
    exact racl_baseClosure_coe _
  exact congrArg Subtype.val ((liftPointSameBase f P).point_rep.trans hP)

name: AclGeom.liftWitnessSameBase_psi
statement:
private theorem liftWitnessSameBase_psi [IsAlgClosed Ω] (f : K →ₐ[k] Ω) {w : QWitness k K}
    (hw : w.Psi) : (liftWitnessSameBase f w).Psi
proof:
:=
  (hw.lift (fun _ hz ↦ isAlgebraic_of_mem_racl_empty hz) f).map
    (ClosedIF.baseClosureEquiv k Ω)

name: AclGeom.repTuple_eq_witnessPoints

name: AclGeom.witnessPoints_liftSame

proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: AclGeom.liftWitnessSameBase_rep_racl
proof:
:= by
  rw [repTuple_eq_witnessPoints, repTuple_eq_witnessPoints]
  change racl k ({(witnessPoints (liftWitnessSameBase f w) i).rep} : Set Ω) = _
  rw [witnessPoints_liftSame]
  exact liftPointSameBase_racl f (witnessPoints w i)

name: AclGeom.racl_range_congr_singletons
proof:
:= by
  apply racl_congr_of_subset_racl
  · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    apply racl_mono (singleton_subset_iff.2 (mem_range_self i))
    rw [← h i]
    exact subset_racl k _ rfl
  · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    apply racl_mono (singleton_subset_iff.2 (mem_range_self i))
    rw [h i]
    exact subset_racl k _ rfl

name: AclGeom.initialWitnessValues_eq_repTuple

private theorem initialWitnessValues_eq_repTuple (w : QWitness k K) (j : Fin 9) (i : Fin 2) :

name: AclGeom.initialChart_descent_of_lift
statement:
private theorem initialChart_descent_of_lift [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    [UniversalDomain k Ω] {w : QWitness k K} (hw : w.Psi) (hID : w.I ≠ w.D)
    (f : K →ₐ[k] Ω) (σ : Ω ≃ₐ[k] Ω) (L : IntermediateField k Ω)
    (hL : IndepOver k ∅ (L : Set Ω) (range (σ ∘ (liftWitnessSameBase f w).repTuple)))
    (v : Fin 5 → Ω)
    (hrows : ∀ j : Fin 9,
      racl (↥L) (range (σ ∘ initialWitnessValues (liftWitnessSameBase f w) j)) =
        racl (↥L) (range (initialChartValues v j))) : w.HasAffineGridCoordinates
proof:
:= by
  let q := liftWitnessSameBase f w
  let g := σ.toAlgHom.comp f
  have hscalar (i : Fin 21) : racl k ({σ (q.repTuple i)} : Set Ω) =
      racl k ({g (w.repTuple i)} : Set Ω) := by
    have h := congrArg (fun E : IntermediateField k Ω ↦ E.map σ.toAlgHom)
      (liftWitnessSameBase_rep_racl f w i)
    rw [racl_map, racl_map, image_singleton, image_singleton] at h
    exact h
  have htuple : racl k (range (σ ∘ q.repTuple)) = racl k (range (g ∘ w.repTuple)) :=
    racl_range_congr_singletons _ _ hscalar
  have hLg : IndepOver k ∅ (L : Set Ω) (range (g ∘ w.repTuple)) :=
    (indepOver_congr₀ rfl htuple).1 hL
  apply initialChart_descent hw hID g L hLg v
  intro j
  have hj : racl k (range (σ ∘ initialWitnessValues q j)) =
      racl k (range (g ∘ initialWitnessValues w j)) := by
    apply racl_range_congr_singletons
    intro i
    change racl k ({σ (initialWitnessValues q j i)} : Set Ω) =
      racl k ({g (initialWitnessValues w j i)} : Set Ω)
    rw [initialWitnessValues_eq_repTuple, initialWitnessValues_eq_repTuple]
    exact hscalar (initialWitnessIndices j i)
  exact (GroupConfig.racl_base_congr L hj).symm.trans (hrows j)

name: AclGeom.guardedAffineGridExtraction
statement:
theorem guardedAffineGridExtraction [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K] :
    GuardedAffineGridExtraction k K
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw hID _hIP
  let Ω := ConfigurationAmbient K
  let f : K →ₐ[k] Ω := configurationEmbedding k K
  let q := liftWitnessSameBase f w
  have hq : q.Psi := liftWitnessSameBase_psi f hw
  obtain ⟨σ, L, hL, a, b, c, d, x, hA, hB, hC, hS, hT, hU, hX, hY, hZ⟩ :=
    hq.exists_initial_chart_rows
  apply initialChart_descent_of_lift hw hID f σ L hL ![a, b, c, d, x]
  simp only [Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty] at hA hB hC
  have hrange (p q : Ω) : range (σ ∘ (![p, q] : Fin 2 → Ω)) = {σ p, σ q} := by
    have he : σ ∘ (![p, q] : Fin 2 → Ω) = ![σ p, σ q] := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl
    rw [he, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty]
  intro j
  fin_cases j
  · change racl (↥L) (range (σ ∘ (![q.A₁.rep, q.A₂.rep] : Fin 2 → Ω))) =
      racl (↥L) (range (![a, b] : Fin 2 → Ω))
    rw [hrange, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty]
    exact hA
  · change racl (↥L) (range (σ ∘ (![q.B₁.rep, q.B₂.rep] : Fin 2 → Ω))) =
      racl (↥L) (range (![c, d] : Fin 2 → Ω))
    rw [hrange, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty]
    exact hB
  · change racl (↥L) (range (σ ∘ (![q.C₁.rep, q.C₂.rep] : Fin 2 → Ω))) =
      racl (↥L) (range (![a * c, b * c + d] : Fin 2 → Ω))
    rw [hrange, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty]
    exact hC
  · change racl (↥L) (range (σ ∘ (![q.S.rep, q.S.rep] : Fin 2 → Ω))) =
      racl (↥L) (range (![a, a] : Fin 2 → Ω))
    rw [hrange, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty]
    simpa only [Set.pair_eq_singleton] using hS
  · change racl (↥L) (range (σ ∘ (![q.T.rep, q.T.rep] : Fin 2 → Ω))) =
      racl (↥L) (range (![c, c] : Fin 2 → Ω))
    rw [hrange, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty]
    simpa only [Set.pair_eq_singleton] using hT
  · change racl (↥L) (range (σ ∘ (![q.U.rep, q.U.rep] : Fin 2 → Ω))) =
      racl (↥L) (range (![a * c, a * c] : Fin 2 → Ω))
    rw [hrange, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty]
    simpa only [Set.pair_eq_singleton] using hU
  · change racl (↥L) (range (σ ∘ (![q.X.rep, q.X.rep] : Fin 2 → Ω))) =
      racl (↥L) (range (![x, x] : Fin 2 → Ω))
    rw [hrange, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty]
    simpa only [Set.pair_eq_singleton] using hX
  · change racl (↥L) (range (σ ∘ (![q.Y.rep, q.Y.rep] : Fin 2 → Ω))) =
      racl (↥L) (range (![a * x + b, a * x + b] : Fin 2 → Ω))
    rw [hrange, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty]
    simpa only [Set.pair_eq_singleton] using hY
  · change racl (↥L) (range (σ ∘ (![q.Z.rep, q.Z.rep] : Fin 2 → Ω))) =
      racl (↥L) (range (![c * (a * x + b) + d, c * (a * x + b) + d] : Fin 2 → Ω))
    rw [hrange, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty]
    simpa only [Set.pair_eq_singleton] using hZ

name: AclGeom.guardedQCompletenessACF
statement:
theorem guardedQCompletenessACF [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K] :
    GuardedQCompletenessACF k K
proof:
:=
  fun _ hw hID hIP ↦ QWitness.qSem_of_hasAffineGridCoordinates
    (guardedAffineGridExtraction _ hw hID hIP)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightC_comp_bGermCoefficient
statement:
theorem selectedGraphRightSourceToRightC_comp_bGermCoefficient
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :
    (R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightCRingEquiv L hind).toRingHom.comp
        (R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom L hind) =
      R.bGermCoefficientToRightCSourceRingHom L hind
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro x
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply,
    R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom_apply]
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (R.rightCSourceClosureTransport hind).closureEquiv
      (algebraMap (↥R.semanticCommonSourceField)
        (AlgebraicClosure (↥R.semanticCommonSourceField))
        (R.seBGermCoefficientToSemanticSourceAlgHom L hind x)) =
    algebraMap (↥R.rightCSourceField)
      (AlgebraicClosure (↥R.rightCSourceField))
      (R.sAcBGermCoefficientToRightCSourceAlgHom L hind x)
  rw [AlgebraicClosureTransport.commutes_apply]
  exact congrArg
    (algebraMap (↥R.rightCSourceField)
      (AlgebraicClosure (↥R.rightCSourceField)))
    (R.commonSourceToRightCSourceEquiv_comp_seBGermCoefficient L hind x)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.rightCSourceChart_comp_bGermCoefficient
statement:
theorem rightCSourceChart_comp_bGermCoefficient
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :
    (R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightCRingEquiv L hind).symm.toRingHom.comp
        (R.bGermCoefficientToRightCSourceRingHom L hind) =
      R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom L hind
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro x
  have hx := DFunLike.congr_fun
    (R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightC_comp_bGermCoefficient L hind) x
  change R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightCRingEquiv L hind
      (R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom L hind x) =
    R.bGermCoefficientToRightCSourceRingHom L hind x at hx
  change (R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightCRingEquiv L hind).symm
      (R.bGermCoefficientToRightCSourceRingHom L hind x) =
    R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom L hind x
  apply (R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightCRingEquiv L hind).injective
  simpa using hx.symm

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.firstFactorAction_apply
statement:
theorem firstFactorAction_apply (g : Kˣ × Kˣ) (x : K) :
    firstFactorAction g x = (g.1 : K) * x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.not_injective_firstFactorAction_of_ne
statement:
private theorem not_injective_firstFactorAction_of_ne {v : K} (hv0 : v ≠ 0) (hv1 : v ≠ 1) :
    ¬ Function.Injective (firstFactorAction (K := K))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h1 : ((1 : Kˣ), Units.mk0 v hv0) = 1 :=
    h (Equiv.ext fun x ↦ by simp [firstFactorAction_apply])
  have h2 := congrArg (fun g : Kˣ × Kˣ ↦ ((g.2 : Kˣ) : K)) h1
  exact hv1 (by simpa using h2)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.encard_le_four
statement: private theorem encard_le_four {α : Type*} (a b c d : α) : ({a, b, c, d} : Set α).encard ≤ 4
proof:
:=
  calc ({a, b, c, d} : Set α).encard ≤ ({b, c, d} : Set α).encard + 1 := encard_insert_le _ _
    _ ≤ ({c, d} : Set α).encard + 1 + 1 := by gcongr; exact encard_insert_le _ _
    _ ≤ ({d} : Set α).encard + 1 + 1 + 1 := by gcongr; exact encard_insert_le _ _
    _ = 4 := by rw [encard_singleton]; norm_num

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.coe_sup_racl
statement:
private theorem coe_sup_racl {E F : ClosedIF k K} {X Y : Set K} (hE : (E : Set K) = racl k X)
    (hF : (F : Set K) = racl k Y) : ((E ⊔ F : ClosedIF k K) : Set K) = racl k (X ∪ Y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ClosedIF.coe_set_sup, hE, hF, racl_union_left, racl_union_right]

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.mem_iff_of_coe
statement:
private theorem mem_iff_of_coe {E : ClosedIF k K} {X : Set K} (hE : (E : Set K) = racl k X)
    {x : K} : x ∈ E ↔ x ∈ racl k X
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, hE, SetLike.mem_coe]

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.racl_eq_of_subset
statement:
private theorem racl_eq_of_subset {X Y : Set K} (h₁ : X ⊆ racl k Y) (h₂ : Y ⊆ racl k X) :
    racl k X = racl k Y
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl h₁) (racl_le_of_subset_racl h₂)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.false_of_subset_racl
statement:
private theorem false_of_subset_racl {Y : Set K} (hY : Y.encard ≤ 4)
    (h : ({s, s', t, u, u'} : Set K) ⊆ racl k Y) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : ({s, s', t, u, u'} : Set K) ⊆ racl k (∅ ∪ Y) := by
    rw [empty_union]
    exact h
  have h1 := (erk_mono k ∅ hsub).trans_eq (erk_racl k ∅ Y)
  rw [hind] at h1
  have h2 := h1.trans ((erk_le_encard k ∅ Y).trans hY)
  norm_num at h2

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.t_not_mem
statement: theorem t_not_mem : t ∉ racl k ({s, u, s', u'} : Set K)
proof:
:= fun ht ↦
  false_of_subset_racl hind (encard_le_four s u s' u') (by
    rintro x (rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl)
    exacts [subset_racl k _ (by simp), subset_racl k _ (by simp), ht, subset_racl k _ (by simp),
      subset_racl k _ (by simp)])

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.s'_not_mem
statement: private theorem s'_not_mem : s' ∉ racl k ({s} : Set K)
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  false_of_subset_racl hind (encard_le_four s t u u') (by
    rintro x (rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl)
    exacts [subset_racl k _ (by simp), racl_mono (k := k) (by simp) h, subset_racl k _ (by simp),
      subset_racl k _ (by simp), subset_racl k _ (by simp)])

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.u'_not_mem
statement: private theorem u'_not_mem : u' ∉ racl k ({u} : Set K)
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  false_of_subset_racl hind (encard_le_four s s' t u) (by
    rintro x (rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl)
    exacts [subset_racl k _ (by simp), subset_racl k _ (by simp), subset_racl k _ (by simp),
      subset_racl k _ (by simp), racl_mono (k := k) (by simp) h])

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.u_not_mem
statement: theorem u_not_mem : u ∉ racl k ({s} : Set K)
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  false_of_subset_racl hind (encard_le_four s s' t u') (by
    rintro x (rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl)
    exacts [subset_racl k _ (by simp), subset_racl k _ (by simp), subset_racl k _ (by simp),
      racl_mono (k := k) (by simp) h, subset_racl k _ (by simp)])

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.s_not_mem_empty
statement: private theorem s_not_mem_empty : s ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  false_of_subset_racl hind (encard_le_four s' t u u') (by
    rintro x (rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl)
    exacts [racl_mono (k := k) (empty_subset _) h, subset_racl k _ (by simp),
      subset_racl k _ (by simp), subset_racl k _ (by simp), subset_racl k _ (by simp)])

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.u_not_mem_empty
statement: private theorem u_not_mem_empty : u ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  u_not_mem hind (racl_mono (k := k) (empty_subset _) h)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.s'_not_mem_empty
statement: private theorem s'_not_mem_empty : s' ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  s'_not_mem hind (racl_mono (k := k) (empty_subset _) h)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.u'_not_mem_empty
statement: private theorem u'_not_mem_empty : u' ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  u'_not_mem hind (racl_mono (k := k) (empty_subset _) h)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.t_not_mem_empty
statement: private theorem t_not_mem_empty : t ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  t_not_mem hind (racl_mono (k := k) (empty_subset _) h)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.s_ne_zero
statement: private theorem s_ne_zero : s ≠ 0
proof: := fun h ↦ s_not_mem_empty hind (h ▸ zero_mem _)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.s'_ne_zero
statement: private theorem s'_ne_zero : s' ≠ 0
proof: := fun h ↦ s'_not_mem_empty hind (h ▸ zero_mem _)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.u_ne_zero
statement: private theorem u_ne_zero : u ≠ 0
proof: := fun h ↦ u_not_mem_empty hind (h ▸ zero_mem _)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.u'_ne_zero
statement: private theorem u'_ne_zero : u' ≠ 0
proof: := fun h ↦ u'_not_mem_empty hind (h ▸ zero_mem _)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.u_ne_one
statement: private theorem u_ne_one : u ≠ 1
proof: := fun h ↦ u_not_mem_empty hind (h ▸ one_mem _)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.not_injective_firstFactorAction
statement: theorem not_injective_firstFactorAction : ¬ Function.Injective (firstFactorAction (K := K))
proof:
:=
  not_injective_firstFactorAction_of_ne (u_ne_zero hind) (u_ne_one hind)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.model
statement:
theorem model :
    ((Units.mk0 s' (s'_ne_zero hind), Units.mk0 u' (u'_ne_zero hind)) : Kˣ × Kˣ) =
        (Units.mk0 (s' / s) (div_ne_zero (s'_ne_zero hind) (s_ne_zero hind)),
          Units.mk0 (u' / u) (div_ne_zero (u'_ne_zero hind) (u_ne_zero hind))) *
        (Units.mk0 s (s_ne_zero hind), Units.mk0 u (u_ne_zero hind)) ∧
      firstFactorAction (Units.mk0 s (s_ne_zero hind), Units.mk0 u (u_ne_zero hind)) t = s * t ∧
      firstFactorAction
          (Units.mk0 (s' / s) (div_ne_zero (s'_ne_zero hind) (s_ne_zero hind)),
            Units.mk0 (u' / u) (div_ne_zero (u'_ne_zero hind) (u_ne_zero hind))) (s * t) =
        s' * t
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Prod.ext (Units.ext ?_) (Units.ext ?_), rfl, ?_⟩
  · simp [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (s_ne_zero hind)]
  · simp [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (u_ne_zero hind)]
  · rw [firstFactorAction_apply]
    change s' / s * (s * t) = s' * t
    field_simp [s_ne_zero hind]

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.sdiv_not_mem_empty
statement: private theorem sdiv_not_mem_empty : s' / s ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)
proof:
:= fun h ↦ s'_not_mem hind (by
  have h' := mul_mem (racl_mono (k := k) (empty_subset ({s} : Set K)) h)
    (subset_racl k ({s} : Set K) (mem_singleton s))
  rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (s_ne_zero hind)] at h')

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.udiv_not_mem_empty
statement: private theorem udiv_not_mem_empty : u' / u ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)
proof:
:= fun h ↦ u'_not_mem hind (by
  have h' := mul_mem (racl_mono (k := k) (empty_subset ({u} : Set K)) h)
    (subset_racl k ({u} : Set K) (mem_singleton u))
  rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (u_ne_zero hind)] at h')

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.st_not_mem_empty
statement: private theorem st_not_mem_empty : s * t ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)
proof:
:= fun h ↦ t_not_mem hind (by
  have h' := div_mem (racl_mono (k := k) (empty_subset ({s, u, s', u'} : Set K)) h)
    (subset_racl k ({s, u, s', u'} : Set K) (show s ∈ ({s, u, s', u'} : Set K) by simp))
  rwa [mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (s_ne_zero hind)] at h')

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.s't_not_mem_empty
statement: private theorem s't_not_mem_empty : s' * t ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)
proof:
:= fun h ↦ t_not_mem hind (by
  have h' := div_mem (racl_mono (k := k) (empty_subset ({s, u, s', u'} : Set K)) h)
    (subset_racl k ({s, u, s', u'} : Set K) (show s' ∈ ({s, u, s', u'} : Set K) by simp))
  rwa [mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (s'_ne_zero hind)] at h')

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.erk_four
statement: private theorem erk_four : erk k ∅ ({s, u, s', u'} : Set K) = 4
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ((erk_le_encard k ∅ _).trans (encard_le_four s u s' u')) ?_
  have hsub : ({s, s', t, u, u'} : Set K) ⊆ ({s, u, s', u'} : Set K) ∪ {t} := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [mem_insert_iff, mem_singleton_iff, mem_union] at hx ⊢
    tauto
  have h1 : (4 : ℕ∞) + 1 ≤ erk k ∅ ({s, u, s', u'} : Set K) + 1 :=
    calc (4 : ℕ∞) + 1 = 5 := by norm_num
      _ = erk k ∅ ({s, s', t, u, u'} : Set K) := hind.symm
      _ ≤ erk k ∅ (({s, u, s', u'} : Set K) ∪ {t}) := erk_mono k ∅ hsub
      _ ≤ erk k ∅ ({s, u, s', u'} : Set K) + erk k ∅ ({t} : Set K) := erk_union_le k ∅ _ _
      _ ≤ _ := by gcongr; exact (erk_le_encard k ∅ _).trans (by simp)
  exact (ENat.add_le_add_iff_right ENat.one_ne_top).1 h1

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.rankEq_four
statement:
private theorem rankEq_four {E : ClosedIF k K}
    (hE : (E : Set K) = racl k ({s, u, s', u'} : Set K)) : RankEq 4 E
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankEq_iff_eRk, hE, ← erk_empty_eq]
  have h := erk_racl k ∅ ({s, u, s', u'} : Set K)
  rw [empty_union] at h
  rw [h, erk_four hind]
  rfl

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.witness_psi_i_iii
statement:
theorem witness_psi_i_iii :
    RankEq 4 ((witness hind).A ⊔ (witness hind).B ⊔ (witness hind).C) ∧
      RankEq 4 ((witness hind).A ⊔ (witness hind).B) ∧
      RankEq 4 ((witness hind).B ⊔ (witness hind).C) ∧
      RankEq 4 ((witness hind).A ⊔ (witness hind).C) ∧
      (witness hind).X.1 ≤ (witness hind).A ⊔ (witness hind).Y.1 ∧
      (witness hind).Z.1 ≤
        ((witness hind).B ⊔ (witness hind).Y.1) ⊓ ((witness hind).C ⊔ (witness hind).X.1) ∧
      ¬ (witness hind).X.1 ≤ (witness hind).A ⊔ (witness hind).B ⊔ (witness hind).C ∧
      ¬ (witness hind).Y.1 ≤ (witness hind).A ⊔ (witness hind).B ⊔ (witness hind).C ∧
      ¬ (witness hind).Z.1 ≤ (witness hind).A ⊔ (witness hind).B ⊔ (witness hind).C
proof:
:= by
  have hs0 := s_ne_zero hind
  have hs'0 := s'_ne_zero hind
  have hu0 := u_ne_zero hind
  have hu'0 := u'_ne_zero hind
  
  have hA : (((witness hind).A : ClosedIF k K) : Set K) = racl k ({s} ∪ {u}) :=
    coe_sup_racl rfl rfl
  have hB : (((witness hind).B : ClosedIF k K) : Set K) = racl k ({s'} ∪ {u'}) :=
    coe_sup_racl rfl rfl
  have hC : (((witness hind).C : ClosedIF k K) : Set K) = racl k ({s' / s} ∪ {u' / u}) :=
    coe_sup_racl rfl rfl
  have hY : (((witness hind).Y.1 : ClosedIF k K) : Set K) = racl k {t} := rfl
  have hX : (((witness hind).X.1 : ClosedIF k K) : Set K) = racl k {s * t} := rfl
  
  have hm (x : K) (hx : x ∈ ({s, u, s', u'} : Set K)) : x ∈ racl k ({s, u, s', u'} : Set K) :=
    subset_racl k _ hx
  have hsd : s' / s ∈ racl k ({s, u, s', u'} : Set K) := div_mem (hm _ (by simp)) (hm _ (by simp))
  have hud : u' / u ∈ racl k ({s, u, s', u'} : Set K) := div_mem (hm _ (by simp)) (hm _ (by simp))
  have hABC : (((witness hind).A ⊔ (witness hind).B ⊔ (witness hind).C : ClosedIF k K) :
      Set K) = racl k ({s, u, s', u'} : Set K) := by
    rw [coe_sup_racl (coe_sup_racl hA hB) hC]
    refine congrArg _ (racl_eq_of_subset ?_ ?_)
    · intro x hx
      simp only [mem_union, mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with ((rfl | rfl) | (rfl | rfl)) | (rfl | rfl)
      exacts [hm _ (by simp), hm _ (by simp), hm _ (by simp), hm _ (by simp), hsd, hud]
    · intro x hx
      exact subset_racl k _ (by simp only [mem_insert_iff, mem_singleton_iff] at hx; simp; tauto)
  have hAB : (((witness hind).A ⊔ (witness hind).B : ClosedIF k K) : Set K) =
      racl k ({s, u, s', u'} : Set K) := by
    rw [coe_sup_racl hA hB]
    refine congrArg _ (racl_eq_of_subset ?_ ?_)
    · intro x hx
      exact subset_racl k _ (by simp only [mem_union, mem_singleton_iff] at hx; simp; tauto)
    · intro x hx
      exact subset_racl k _ (by simp only [mem_insert_iff, mem_singleton_iff] at hx; simp; tauto)
  have hBC : (((witness hind).B ⊔ (witness hind).C : ClosedIF k K) : Set K) =
      racl k ({s, u, s', u'} : Set K) := by
    rw [coe_sup_racl hB hC]
    refine congrArg _ (racl_eq_of_subset ?_ ?_)
    · intro x hx
      simp only [mem_union, mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with (rfl | rfl) | (rfl | rfl)
      exacts [hm _ (by simp), hm _ (by simp), hsd, hud]
    · have hs' : s' ∈ racl k (({s'} ∪ {u'} ∪ ({s' / s} ∪ {u' / u}) : Set K)) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have hu' : u' ∈ racl k (({s'} ∪ {u'} ∪ ({s' / s} ∪ {u' / u}) : Set K)) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have hsd' : s' / s ∈ racl k (({s'} ∪ {u'} ∪ ({s' / s} ∪ {u' / u}) : Set K)) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have hud' : u' / u ∈ racl k (({s'} ∪ {u'} ∪ ({s' / s} ∪ {u' / u}) : Set K)) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      intro x hx
      simp only [mem_insert_iff, mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
      · have h := div_mem hs' hsd'
        rwa [div_div_cancel₀ hs'0] at h
      · have h := div_mem hu' hud'
        rwa [div_div_cancel₀ hu'0] at h
      · exact hs'
      · exact hu'
  have hAC : (((witness hind).A ⊔ (witness hind).C : ClosedIF k K) : Set K) =
      racl k ({s, u, s', u'} : Set K) := by
    rw [coe_sup_racl hA hC]
    refine congrArg _ (racl_eq_of_subset ?_ ?_)
    · intro x hx
      simp only [mem_union, mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with (rfl | rfl) | (rfl | rfl)
      exacts [hm _ (by simp), hm _ (by simp), hsd, hud]
    · have hs : s ∈ racl k (({s} ∪ {u} ∪ ({s' / s} ∪ {u' / u}) : Set K)) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have hu : u ∈ racl k (({s} ∪ {u} ∪ ({s' / s} ∪ {u' / u}) : Set K)) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have hsd' : s' / s ∈ racl k (({s} ∪ {u} ∪ ({s' / s} ∪ {u' / u}) : Set K)) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have hud' : u' / u ∈ racl k (({s} ∪ {u} ∪ ({s' / s} ∪ {u' / u}) : Set K)) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      intro x hx
      simp only [mem_insert_iff, mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact hs
      · exact hu
      · have h := mul_mem hsd' hs
        rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hs0] at h
      · have h := mul_mem hud' hu
        rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hu0] at h
  
  have ht := t_not_mem hind
  refine ⟨rankEq_four hind hABC, rankEq_four hind hAB, rankEq_four hind hBC, rankEq_four hind hAC,
    ?_, le_inf ?_ ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change ClosedIF.point k (s * t) ≤ _
    rw [ClosedIF.point_le_iff, mem_iff_of_coe (coe_sup_racl hA hY)]
    exact mul_mem (subset_racl k _ (by simp)) (subset_racl k _ (by simp))
  · change ClosedIF.point k (s' * t) ≤ _
    rw [ClosedIF.point_le_iff, mem_iff_of_coe (coe_sup_racl hB hY)]
    exact mul_mem (subset_racl k _ (by simp)) (subset_racl k _ (by simp))
  · change ClosedIF.point k (s' * t) ≤ _
    rw [ClosedIF.point_le_iff, mem_iff_of_coe (coe_sup_racl hC hX)]
    have h : s' * t = s' / s * (s * t) := by field_simp
    rw [h]
    exact mul_mem (subset_racl k _ (by simp)) (subset_racl k _ (by simp))
  · change ¬ ClosedIF.point k (s * t) ≤ _
    rw [ClosedIF.point_le_iff, mem_iff_of_coe hABC]
    intro h
    exact ht (by simpa [mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hs0] using div_mem h (hm s (by simp)))
  · change ¬ ClosedIF.point k t ≤ _
    rw [ClosedIF.point_le_iff, mem_iff_of_coe hABC]
    exact ht
  · change ¬ ClosedIF.point k (s' * t) ≤ _
    rw [ClosedIF.point_le_iff, mem_iff_of_coe hABC]
    intro h
    exact ht (by simpa [mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hs'0] using div_mem h (hm s' (by simp)))

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.witness_not_iv

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.ambientReferenceNormalClosureToTransportedSourceCover_algebraMap
statement:
theorem ambientReferenceNormalClosureToTransportedSourceCover_algebraMap
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b))
    (z : R.semanticCommonSourceField) :
    R.ambientReferenceNormalClosureToTransportedSourceCover L hind
        (algebraMap (↥R.semanticCommonSourceField)
          (↥(FiniteCover.normalClosureOver
            (R.semanticCommonSourceField_le_referenceSemanticJoin L hind))) z) =
      algebraMap (↥R.semanticCommonSourceField)
        (↥(R.transportedReferenceSourceCover L hind).field) z
proof:
:= by
  let hSJ := R.semanticCommonSourceField_le_referenceSemanticJoin L hind
  let : FiniteDimensional (↥R.semanticCommonSourceField)
      (↥(extendScalars hSJ)) := by
    change FiniteDimensional (↥R.semanticCommonSourceField)
      (↥(R.referenceSemanticJoinOverSource L hind))
    exact R.referenceSemanticJoinOverSource_finiteDimensional L hind
  let halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (↥R.semanticCommonSourceField)
      (↥(extendScalars hSJ)) := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_finite _ _
  change (FiniteCover.normalClosureOverEquivCanonical hSJ halg)
      (algebraMap (↥R.semanticCommonSourceField)
        (↥(FiniteCover.normalClosureOver hSJ)) z) =
    algebraMap (↥R.semanticCommonSourceField)
      (↥(FiniteCover.canonicalNormalClosure hSJ)) z
  exact (FiniteCover.normalClosureOverEquivCanonical hSJ halg).commutes z

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.referenceNormalCoverToReferenceSemanticSourceCover_algebraMap
statement:
theorem referenceNormalCoverToReferenceSemanticSourceCover_algebraMap
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b))
    (z : D.inputField) :
    R.referenceNormalCoverToReferenceSemanticSourceCover L hind
        (algebraMap (↥D.inputField) (↥L.referenceNormalCover) z) =
      algebraMap (↥R.semanticCommonSourceField)
        (↥(R.referenceSemanticSourceCover L hind).field)
        (R.referenceInputToSemanticSource L z)
proof:
:= by
  let y : FiniteCover.normalClosureOver
      (R.semanticCommonSourceField_le_referenceSemanticJoin L hind) :=
    R.mappedReferenceToAmbientReferenceNormalClosure L hind
      (R.referenceNormalCoverToMappedReference L
        (algebraMap (↥D.inputField) (↥L.referenceNormalCover) z))
  have hy : y = algebraMap (↥R.semanticCommonSourceField)
      (↥(FiniteCover.normalClosureOver
        (R.semanticCommonSourceField_le_referenceSemanticJoin L hind)))
      (R.referenceInputToSemanticSource L z) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  unfold referenceNormalCoverToReferenceSemanticSourceCover
  simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply]
  change R.transportedSourceCoverToReferenceSemanticSourceCover L hind
      (R.ambientReferenceNormalClosureToTransportedSourceCover L hind y) = _
  rw [hy]
  have hcanonical :
      R.ambientReferenceNormalClosureToTransportedSourceCover L hind
          (algebraMap (↥R.semanticCommonSourceField)
            (↥(FiniteCover.normalClosureOver
              (R.semanticCommonSourceField_le_referenceSemanticJoin L hind)))
            (R.referenceInputToSemanticSource L z)) =
        algebraMap (↥R.semanticCommonSourceField)
          (↥(R.transportedReferenceSourceCover L hind).field)
          (R.referenceInputToSemanticSource L z) := by
    exact R.ambientReferenceNormalClosureToTransportedSourceCover_algebraMap
      L hind (R.referenceInputToSemanticSource L z)
  rw [hcanonical]
  rfl
