theorem seRelocatedParameterField_le_commonCoefficientField :
    (R.se.bCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ).parameterField ≤
      R.seCommonBaseData.coefficientField
proof:
:= by
  unfold FiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember.parameterField
    PsiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization.CommonBaseData.coefficientField
  apply adjoin.mono
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  change commonCurveEmbedding (k := k) (K := K) (e i) ∈
    Set.range R.commonInputTuple
  fin_cases i
  · exact ⟨2, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨3, rfl⟩

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom_eq_commonCoefficient
statement:
theorem bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom_eq_commonCoefficient
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :
    R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom L hind =
      (algebraMap (↥R.seCommonBaseData.coefficientField)
        (↥(R.selectedGraphRightSourceCover L hind).field)).comp
          (R.seBGermCoefficientToCommonCoefficientRingHom L)
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro z
  apply Subtype.ext
  rfl

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.seBGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightMiddleRingHom_eq_commonCoefficient
statement:
theorem seBGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightMiddleRingHom_eq_commonCoefficient
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :
    R.seBGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightMiddleRingHom L hind =
      (algebraMap (↥R.seCommonBaseData.coefficientField)
        (↥(FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.OnSourceCover.middleCover
          (PsiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization.CommonBaseData.aCorrespondencePair
            (R := R.se) R.seCommonBaseData hψ)
          (PsiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization.CommonBaseData.bCorrespondencePair
            (R := R.se) R.seCommonBaseData hψ)
          (PsiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization.CommonBaseData.aPair_target_eq_bPair_source
            (R := R.se) R.seCommonBaseData hψ)
          (R.selectedGraphRightSourceCover L hind)).field)).comp
        (R.seBGermCoefficientToCommonCoefficientRingHom L)
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro z
  unfold seBGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightMiddleRingHom
    seBGermCoefficientToSemanticRightBranchRingHom
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe]
  let c := R.seBGermCoefficientToCommonCoefficientRingHom L z
  have hcomm :=
    (R.seSelectedRightBranchInSelectedGraphRightMiddle L hind).toAlgHom.commutes
      (algebraMap (↥R.seCommonBaseData.coefficientField)
        (↥(PsiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization.CommonBaseData.bCorrespondencePair
          (R := R.se) R.seCommonBaseData hψ).sourceField) c)
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hcomm

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.seSelectedGraphRight_left_comp_bGermCoefficient
statement:
theorem seSelectedGraphRight_left_comp_bGermCoefficient
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :
    (R.seSelectedGraphRightCompositionTriangle L hind).left.toRingHom.comp
        (R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom L hind) =
      R.seBGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightMiddleRingHom L hind
proof:
:= by
  let P :=
    PsiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization.CommonBaseData.aCorrespondencePair
      (R := R.se) R.seCommonBaseData hψ
  let Q :=
    PsiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization.CommonBaseData.bCorrespondencePair
      (R := R.se) R.seCommonBaseData hψ
  let h :=
    PsiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization.CommonBaseData.aPair_target_eq_bPair_source
      (R := R.se) R.seCommonBaseData hψ
  let N := R.selectedGraphRightSourceCover L hind
  change
    (FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.OnSourceCover.leftEquiv
      P Q h N).toRingHom.comp
        (R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom L hind) =
      R.seBGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightMiddleRingHom L hind
  calc
    _ = (FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.OnSourceCover.leftEquiv
          P Q h N).toRingHom.comp
        ((algebraMap (↥R.seCommonBaseData.coefficientField)
          (↥N.field)).comp
            (R.seBGermCoefficientToCommonCoefficientRingHom L)) :=
      congrArg
        ((FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.OnSourceCover.leftEquiv
          P Q h N).toRingHom.comp)
        (R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom_eq_commonCoefficient
          L hind)
    _ = (algebraMap (↥R.seCommonBaseData.coefficientField)
          (↥(FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.OnSourceCover.middleCover
            P Q h N).field)).comp
        (R.seBGermCoefficientToCommonCoefficientRingHom L) :=
      onSourceCover_left_comp_algebraMap_comp P Q h N
        (R.seBGermCoefficientToCommonCoefficientRingHom L)
    _ = R.seBGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightMiddleRingHom L hind :=
      (R.seBGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightMiddleRingHom_eq_commonCoefficient
        L hind).symm

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.seSemilinearCommon_left_comp_bGermCoefficient
statement:
theorem seSemilinearCommon_left_comp_bGermCoefficient
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :
    (R.seRightSemilinearCommonCompositionTriangle L hind).left.toRingHom.comp
        (R.bGermCoefficientToSeRightSemilinearExtendedSourceRingHom L hind) =
      R.seBGermCoefficientToSemilinearCommonMiddleRingHom L hind
proof:
:= by
  let T := R.seSelectedGraphRightCompositionTriangle L hind
  let X := R.rightSemilinearCommonSourceField L hind
  have h := T.sourceExtension_left_comp_of_left_comp X
    (R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom L hind)
    (R.seBGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightMiddleRingHom L hind)
    (R.seSelectedGraphRight_left_comp_bGermCoefficient L hind)
  exact h

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.seSemilinearCommon_right_comp_bGermCoefficient
statement:
theorem seSemilinearCommon_right_comp_bGermCoefficient
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :
    (R.seRightSemilinearCommonCompositionTriangle L hind).right.toRingHom.comp
        (R.seBGermCoefficientToSemilinearCommonMiddleRingHom L hind) =
      R.seBGermCoefficientToSemilinearCommonTargetRingHom L hind
proof:
:= by
  let T := R.seSelectedGraphRightCompositionTriangle L hind
  let X := R.rightSemilinearCommonSourceField L hind
  exact T.sourceExtensionRightEquiv_comp_middleRingHom_comp X
    (R.seBGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightMiddleRingHom L hind)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.seSemilinearCommon_direct_comp_bGermCoefficient
statement:
theorem seSemilinearCommon_direct_comp_bGermCoefficient
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :
    (R.seRightSemilinearCommonCompositionTriangle L hind).direct.toRingHom.comp
        (R.bGermCoefficientToSeRightSemilinearExtendedSourceRingHom L hind) =
      R.seBGermCoefficientToSemilinearCommonTargetRingHom L hind
proof:
:= by
  let T := R.seRightSemilinearCommonCompositionTriangle L hind
  exact T.direct_comp_of_left_right
    (R.bGermCoefficientToSeRightSemilinearExtendedSourceRingHom L hind)
    (R.seBGermCoefficientToSemilinearCommonMiddleRingHom L hind)
    (R.seBGermCoefficientToSemilinearCommonTargetRingHom L hind)
    (R.seSemilinearCommon_left_comp_bGermCoefficient L hind)
    (R.seSemilinearCommon_right_comp_bGermCoefficient L hind)

name: AclGeom.mem_racl_intermediate_base_iff
proof:
:= by
  let Result (F : IntermediateField k K) : Prop :=
    x ∈ racl ↥F S ↔ x ∈ racl k ((E : Set K) ∪ S)
  have h : Result (adjoin k (E : Set K)) := mem_racl_adjoin_base_iff
  have hfinal : Result E := (adjoin_self k E) ▸ h
  exact hfinal

name: AclGeom.mem_racl_closed_base_iff
statement:
private theorem mem_racl_closed_base_iff {P S : Set K} {x : K} :
    x ∈ racl ↥(racl k P) S ↔ x ∈ racl k (P ∪ S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_racl_intermediate_base_iff, racl_union_left]

name: AclGeom.common_ratio_of_mul_eq
statement:
private theorem common_ratio_of_mul_eq [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K]
    (S : MulCorrSetup k K) {s : K} (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂})
    (hmul : S.x₁ * S.x₂ = S.y₁ * S.y₂) :
    S.x₁ / S.y₁ ∈ racl k (∅ : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, q, c₁, c₂, hp, hq, -, -, h₁, h₂⟩ := S.exists_coset_equations hs
  have hprod : S.x₁ * S.x₂ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) := by
    intro h
    apply AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_pair' S.indep
    have hm := racl_mono (Set.empty_subset ({S.x₂} : Set K)) h
    have hx₂ := subset_racl k ({S.x₂} : Set K) rfl
    have heq : S.x₁ = S.x₁ * S.x₂ / S.x₂ := by
      rw [mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ S.x₂_ne]
    rw [heq]
    exact div_mem hm hx₂
  have hpower : (S.x₁ * S.x₂) ^ (p + q) = algebraMap k K (c₁ * c₂) := by
    calc
      (S.x₁ * S.x₂) ^ (p + q) =
          (S.x₁ * S.x₂) ^ p * (S.y₁ * S.y₂) ^ q := by
        rw [← hmul, zpow_add₀ S.mul_fst_ne]
      _ = (S.x₁ ^ p * S.y₁ ^ q) * (S.x₂ ^ p * S.y₂ ^ q) := by
        simp only [mul_zpow]
        ring
      _ = algebraMap k K (c₁ * c₂) := by rw [h₁, h₂, map_mul]
  have hsum : p + q = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    apply hprod (mem_racl_empty_of_zpow hne ?_)
    rw [hpower]
    exact IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ _
  have hq' : q = -p := by omega
  have hr : (S.x₁ / S.y₁) ^ p = algebraMap k K c₁ := by
    rw [div_zpow, div_eq_mul_inv, ← zpow_neg, ← hq']
    exact h₁
  apply mem_racl_empty_of_zpow hp
  rw [hr]
  exact IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ _

name: AclGeom.notMem_of_distinct_points
proof:
:= by
  intro hp
  have hle : P.1 ≤ Q.1 := by
    rw [hP, hQ]
    exact ClosedIF.point_le_iff.mpr hp
  exact hPQ (Subtype.ext ((Q.2.le_iff_eq P.2.1).mp hle))

name: AclGeom.third_mem_of_line
proof:
:= by
  have heq := pair_sup_eq_triple_of_rankEq_two hPQ hline
  have hle : R.1 ≤ P.1 ⊔ Q.1 := by
    rw [heq]
    exact le_sup_of_le_right le_sup_right
  rw [hP, hQ, hR] at hle
  exact ClosedIF.mem_sup_point_iff.mp (ClosedIF.point_le_iff.mp hle)

name: AclGeom.multiplication_incidence_data
statement:
private theorem multiplication_incidence_data {X Y V E A B C D : Point k K}
    (h : MulDiagram X Y V E A B C D) {x y : K}
    (hX : X.1 = ClosedIF.point k x) (hY : Y.1 = ClosedIF.point k y)
    (hV : V.1 = ClosedIF.point k (x / y)) :
    AlgebraicIndependent k ![A.rep, x, y] ∧
      B.rep ∈ racl k {A.rep, x} ∧ x ∈ racl k {A.rep, B.rep} ∧
      C.rep ∈ racl k {A.rep, y} ∧ y ∈ racl k {A.rep, C.rep} ∧
      x / y ∈ racl k {B.rep, C.rep} ∧
      D.rep ∈ racl k {B.rep, y} ∧ D.rep ∈ racl k {x, C.rep} ∧
      E.rep ∈ racl k {A.rep, D.rep} ∧ E.rep ∈ racl k {x, y} ∧
      x ∉ racl k {B.rep}
proof:
:= by
  have hAI : AlgebraicIndependent k ![A.rep, x, y] := by
    apply algebraicIndependent_of_rankEq_iSup_point
    apply RankEq.congr _ h.rank_XYA
    calc
      X.1 ⊔ (Y.1 ⊔ A.1) =
          ClosedIF.point k A.rep ⊔ (ClosedIF.point k x ⊔ ClosedIF.point k y) := by
        rw [hX, hY, A.point_rep]
        ac_rfl
      _ = ⨆ i, (![ClosedIF.point k A.rep, ClosedIF.point k x,
          ClosedIF.point k y] : Fin 3 → ClosedIF k K) i := sup_eq_iSup_three _ _ _
      _ = ⨆ i, ClosedIF.point k ((![A.rep, x, y] : Fin 3 → K) i) := by
        congr 1
        funext i
        fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hXA : X ≠ A := by simpa using h.distinct.ne (show (0 : Fin 8) ≠ 4 by decide)
  have hAB : A ≠ B := by simpa using h.distinct.ne (show (4 : Fin 8) ≠ 5 by decide)
  have hAY : A ≠ Y := by simpa using h.distinct.ne (show (4 : Fin 8) ≠ 1 by decide)
  have hAC : A ≠ C := by simpa using h.distinct.ne (show (4 : Fin 8) ≠ 6 by decide)
  have hBC : B ≠ C := by simpa using h.distinct.ne (show (5 : Fin 8) ≠ 6 by decide)
  have hBY : B ≠ Y := by simpa using h.distinct.ne (show (5 : Fin 8) ≠ 1 by decide)
  have hXC : X ≠ C := by simpa using h.distinct.ne (show (0 : Fin 8) ≠ 6 by decide)
  have hAD : A ≠ D := by simpa using h.distinct.ne (show (4 : Fin 8) ≠ 7 by decide)
  have hXY : X ≠ Y := by simpa using h.distinct.ne (show (0 : Fin 8) ≠ 1 by decide)
  have hXB : X ≠ B := by simpa using h.distinct.ne (show (0 : Fin 8) ≠ 5 by decide)
  refine ⟨hAI, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply third_mem_of_line A.point_rep.symm hX B.point_rep.symm hXA.symm
    simpa [sup_assoc, sup_comm, sup_left_comm] using h.line_XAB
  · apply third_mem_of_line A.point_rep.symm B.point_rep.symm hX hAB
    simpa [sup_assoc, sup_comm, sup_left_comm] using h.line_XAB
  · exact third_mem_of_line A.point_rep.symm hY C.point_rep.symm hAY h.line_AYC
  · apply third_mem_of_line A.point_rep.symm C.point_rep.symm hY hAC
    simpa [sup_assoc, sup_comm, sup_left_comm] using h.line_AYC
  · exact third_mem_of_line B.point_rep.symm C.point_rep.symm hV hBC h.line_BCV
  · exact third_mem_of_line B.point_rep.symm hY D.point_rep.symm hBY h.line_BYD
  · exact third_mem_of_line hX C.point_rep.symm D.point_rep.symm hXC h.line_XCD
  · apply third_mem_of_line A.point_rep.symm D.point_rep.symm E.point_rep.symm hAD
    simpa [sup_assoc, sup_comm, sup_left_comm] using h.line_AED
  · have heq : X.1 ⊔ Y.1 = X.1 ⊔ (Y.1 ⊔ (E.1 ⊔ V.1)) :=
      RankEq.eq_of_le (sup_le le_sup_left (le_sup_of_le_right le_sup_left))
        (rankEq_two_sup_of_ne hXY) h.line_XYEV
    have hle : E.1 ≤ X.1 ⊔ Y.1 := by
      rw [heq]
      exact le_sup_of_le_right (le_sup_of_le_right le_sup_left)
    rw [hX, hY, ← E.point_rep] at hle
    exact ClosedIF.mem_sup_point_iff.mp (ClosedIF.point_le_iff.mp hle)
  · exact notMem_of_distinct_points hX B.point_rep.symm hXB

name: AclGeom.product_pair_closure
statement:
private theorem product_pair_closure {u v : K} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    racl k {u * v, v} = racl k {u, v}
proof:
:= by
  apply racl_congr_of_subset_racl
  · refine Set.insert_subset_iff.mpr ⟨?_, Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr ?_⟩
    · exact mul_mem (subset_racl k ({u, v} : Set K) (Set.mem_insert _ _))
        (subset_racl k ({u, v} : Set K) (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl))
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
  · refine Set.insert_subset_iff.mpr ⟨?_, Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr ?_⟩
    · have hu := subset_racl k ({u * v, v} : Set K) (Set.mem_insert _ _)
      have hv' := subset_racl k ({u * v, v} : Set K) (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
      simpa [mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hv] using div_mem hu hv'
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)

name: AclGeom.mem_racl_product_meet
proof:
:= by
  have hax := algebraicIndependent_mul_left h
  have hperm := hax.comp (![0, 2, 1] : Fin 3 → Fin 3) (by decide)
  have haxy : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a * x, y, x] := by
    convert hperm using 1
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hm := algebraicIndependent_mul_left haxy
  have hx : x ∉ racl k {y, a * x * y} := by
    have hi := AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_image hm (S := {0, 1}) (i := 2) (by decide)
    simpa [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.pair_comm] using hi
  have hd₁ : d ∈ racl k {y, a * x * y} := by
    rw [Set.pair_comm, product_pair_closure (u := a * x) (v := y) (h.ne_zero 2)]
    exact h₁
  have hd₂ : d ∈ racl k {x, a * x * y} := by
    have heq : racl k {x, a * x * y} = racl k {x, a * y} := by
      rw [Set.pair_comm]
      convert product_pair_closure (u := a * y) (h.ne_zero 1) using 1 <;>
        simp [Set.pair_comm, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]
    rw [heq]
    exact h₂
  exact mem_racl_of_mem_racl_insert hd₁ hd₂ hx

name: AclGeom.mem_racl_bottom_product_meet
proof:
:= by
  have hp := h.comp (![2, 1, 0] : Fin 3 → Fin 3) (by decide)
  have hyxa : AlgebraicIndependent k ![y, x, a] := by
    convert hp using 1
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hm := algebraicIndependent_mul_left hyxa
  have hx : x ∉ racl k {a, x * y} := by
    have hi := AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_image hm (S := {0, 2}) (i := 1) (by decide)
    simpa [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.pair_comm, mul_comm] using hi
  have he₂ : e ∈ racl k {x, x * y} := by
    have heq : racl k {x, x * y} = racl k {x, y} := by
      rw [Set.pair_comm]
      convert product_pair_closure (u := y) (h.ne_zero 1) using 1 <;>
        simp [Set.pair_comm, mul_comm]
    rw [heq]
    exact h₂
  exact mem_racl_of_mem_racl_insert h₁ he₂ hx

name: AclGeom.independent_over_closed_pair
proof:
:= by
  apply algebraicIndependent_pair
  · intro hx
    rw [mem_racl_closed_base_iff] at hx
    have hi := AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_image h (S := {0, 1, 3}) (i := 2) (by decide)
    apply hi
    have hset : ({a, a₀} : Set K) ∪ {y} =
        (![a, a₀, x, y] : Fin 4 → K) '' {0, 1, 3} := by
      ext z
      simp [Set.image_insert_eq]; tauto
    exact hset ▸ hx
  · intro hy
    rw [mem_racl_closed_base_iff] at hy
    have hi := AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_image h (S := {0, 1, 2}) (i := 3) (by decide)
    apply hi
    have hset : ({a, a₀} : Set K) ∪ {x} =
        (![a, a₀, x, y] : Fin 4 → K) '' {0, 1, 2} := by
      ext z
      simp [Set.image_insert_eq]; tauto
    exact hset ▸ hy

name: AclGeom.exists_fixed_bc_automorphism
statement:
private theorem exists_fixed_bc_automorphism [IsAlgClosed K] {a b c a₀ : K}
    (h : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b, c])
    (ha₀ : a₀ ∉ racl k {a, b, c}) :
    ∃ σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K, σ a = a₀ ∧
      ∀ z ∈ racl k {b, c}, σ z = z
proof:
:= by
  let E₀ := racl k ({b, c} : Set K)
  have ha : a ∉ racl k {b, c} := by
    have hi := AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_image h (S := {1, 2}) (i := 0) (by decide)
    simpa [Set.image_insert_eq] using hi
  have ha₀' : a₀ ∉ racl k {b, c} :=
    fun hx ↦ ha₀ (racl_mono (by intro z hz; simp_all) hx)
  have hA : AlgebraicIndependent ↥E₀ ![a] := by
    rw [algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff]
    change Transcendental ↥E₀ a
    intro hx
    have hm := mem_racl_empty_of_isAlgebraic hx
    rw [mem_racl_closed_base_iff, Set.union_empty] at hm
    exact ha hm
  have hA₀ : AlgebraicIndependent ↥E₀ ![a₀] := by
    rw [algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff]
    change Transcendental ↥E₀ a₀
    intro hx
    have hm := mem_racl_empty_of_isAlgebraic hx
    rw [mem_racl_closed_base_iff, Set.union_empty] at hm
    exact ha₀' hm
  have hI : idealOf ↥E₀ ![a] = idealOf ↥E₀ ![a₀] := by
    rw [(idealOf_eq_bot_iff ↥E₀).mpr hA, (idealOf_eq_bot_iff ↥E₀).mpr hA₀]
  obtain ⟨τ, -, hτ⟩ := exists_ambientAutomorphism_of_idealOf_eq hI
  let σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K := τ.restrictScalars k
  refine ⟨σ, hτ 0, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  exact τ.commutes (⟨z, hz⟩ : E₀)

name: AclGeom.isAlgClosed_closed_parameters
statement:
private theorem isAlgClosed_closed_parameters [IsAlgClosed K] (P : Set K) :
    IsAlgClosed ↥(racl k P)
proof:
:= by
  apply (IsAlgClosed.algebraicClosure_eq_bot_iff ↥(racl k P) K).mp
  apply bot_unique
  intro x hx
  exact IntermediateField.mem_bot.mpr
    ⟨⟨x, isRAC_racl P x (mem_algebraicClosure_iff.mp hx)⟩, rfl⟩

name: AclGeom.exists_fresh_over_closed_pair
statement:
private theorem exists_fresh_over_closed_pair (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K)
    (a a₀ x y : K) : ∃ s, s ∉ racl ↥(racl k {a, a₀}) {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := fresh_four_of_five_le_trdeg htr {a, a₀, x, y} Finset.card_le_four
  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
  intro hm
  rw [mem_racl_closed_base_iff] at hm
  apply hs
  have hset : ({a, a₀} : Set K) ∪ {x, y} =
      (({a, a₀, x, y} : Finset K) : Set K) := by
    ext z
    simp; tauto
  rw [← hset]
  exact hm

name: AclGeom.common_ratio_of_fixed_relocation
statement:
private theorem common_ratio_of_fixed_relocation [IsAlgClosed K]
    {a a₀ b c x y : K} (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K)
    (h : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, a₀, b, c])
    (hxy : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, y])
    (hbx : b ∈ racl k {a, x}) (hxb : x ∈ racl k {a, b})
    (hcy : c ∈ racl k {a, y}) (hyc : y ∈ racl k {a, c})
    (σ : K ≃ₐ[k] K) (ha : σ a = a₀) (hb : σ b = b) (hc : σ c = c)
    (hv : σ (x / y) = x / y) : σ x / x ∈ racl k {a, a₀}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let E := racl k ({a, a₀} : Set K)
  let : IsAlgClosed E := isAlgClosed_closed_parameters _
  have hxb₀ : σ x ∈ racl k {a₀, b} := by
    simpa [Set.image_insert_eq, ha, hb] using mem_racl_map σ hxb
  have hbx₀ : b ∈ racl k {a₀, σ x} := by
    simpa [Set.image_insert_eq, ha, hb] using mem_racl_map σ hbx
  have hyc₀ : σ y ∈ racl k {a₀, c} := by
    simpa [Set.image_insert_eq, ha, hc] using mem_racl_map σ hyc
  have hcy₀ : c ∈ racl k {a₀, σ y} := by
    simpa [Set.image_insert_eq, ha, hc] using mem_racl_map σ hcy
  have hxB : x ∈ racl E {b} := by
    rw [mem_racl_closed_base_iff]
    exact racl_mono (by
      intro z hz
      simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz ⊢
      tauto) hxb
  have hBx : b ∈ racl E {x} := by
    rw [mem_racl_closed_base_iff]
    exact racl_mono (by
      intro z hz
      simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz ⊢
      tauto) hbx
  have hyC : y ∈ racl E {c} := by
    rw [mem_racl_closed_base_iff]
    exact racl_mono (by
      intro z hz
      simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz ⊢
      tauto) hyc
  have hCy : c ∈ racl E {y} := by
    rw [mem_racl_closed_base_iff]
    exact racl_mono (by
      intro z hz
      simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz ⊢
      tauto) hcy
  have hx₀B : σ x ∈ racl E {b} := by
    rw [mem_racl_closed_base_iff]
    exact racl_mono (by
      intro z hz
      simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz ⊢
      tauto) hxb₀
  have hBx₀ : b ∈ racl E {σ x} := by
    rw [mem_racl_closed_base_iff]
    exact racl_mono (by
      intro z hz
      simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz ⊢
      tauto) hbx₀
  have hy₀C : σ y ∈ racl E {c} := by
    rw [mem_racl_closed_base_iff]
    exact racl_mono (by
      intro z hz
      simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz ⊢
      tauto) hyc₀
  have hCy₀ : c ∈ racl E {σ y} := by
    rw [mem_racl_closed_base_iff]
    exact racl_mono (by
      intro z hz
      simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz ⊢
      tauto) hcy₀
  have hBC : AlgebraicIndependent E ![b, c] := independent_over_closed_pair h
  have hXY₀ : AlgebraicIndependent E ![σ x, y] := by
    apply (algebraicIndependent_congr_racl (v := ![b, c]) (w := ![σ x, y]) ?_).mp hBC
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact racl_singleton_congr hBx₀ hx₀B
    · exact racl_singleton_congr hCy hyC
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := hxy.ne_zero 0
  have hy : y ≠ 0 := hxy.ne_zero 1
  have hy₀ : σ y ≠ 0 := (map_ne_zero_iff σ σ.injective).mpr hy
  have hprod : σ x * y = x * σ y := by
    have heq : σ x / σ y = x / y := by rwa [map_div₀] at hv
    exact (div_eq_div_iff hy₀ hy).mp heq
  let S : MulCorrSetup E K := {
    x₁ := σ x, y₁ := x, x₂ := y, y₂ := σ y
    indep := hXY₀, y₁_ne := hx, y₂_ne := hy₀
    y₁_mem := racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hBx₀) hxB
    x₁_mem := racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hBx) hx₀B
    y₂_mem := racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hCy) hy₀C
    x₂_mem := racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hCy₀) hyC
    mul_mem := hprod ▸ subset_racl E {σ x * y} rfl
    mul_mem' := hprod.symm ▸ subset_racl E {x * σ y} rfl }
  obtain ⟨s, hsE⟩ := exists_fresh_over_closed_pair htr a a₀ (σ x) y
  have halg := common_ratio_of_mul_eq S hsE hprod
  rw [mem_racl_closed_base_iff, Set.union_empty] at halg
  exact halg

name: AclGeom.incidence_corners_independent
proof:
:= by
  have ha := subset_racl k (Set.range ![a, x, y]) ⟨0, rfl⟩
  have hx := subset_racl k (Set.range ![a, x, y]) ⟨1, rfl⟩
  have hy := subset_racl k (Set.range ![a, x, y]) ⟨2, rfl⟩
  have ha' := subset_racl k (Set.range ![a, b, c]) ⟨0, rfl⟩
  have hb' := subset_racl k (Set.range ![a, b, c]) ⟨1, rfl⟩
  have hc' := subset_racl k (Set.range ![a, b, c]) ⟨2, rfl⟩
  have heq : racl k (Set.range ![a, x, y]) = racl k (Set.range ![a, b, c]) := by
    apply racl_range_eq_of_mem
    · intro i
      fin_cases i
      · exact ha
      · exact racl_le_of_subset_racl
          (Set.insert_subset_iff.mpr ⟨ha, Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hx⟩) hbx
      · exact racl_le_of_subset_racl
          (Set.insert_subset_iff.mpr ⟨ha, Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hy⟩) hcy
    · intro i
      fin_cases i
      · exact ha'
      · exact racl_le_of_subset_racl
          (Set.insert_subset_iff.mpr ⟨ha', Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hb'⟩) hxb
      · exact racl_le_of_subset_racl
          (Set.insert_subset_iff.mpr ⟨ha', Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hc'⟩) hyc
  refine ⟨AlgebraicIndependent.of_racl_range_eq h heq, ?_⟩
  simpa only [range_triple] using heq.symm

name: AclGeom.independent_four_of_fresh_three
proof:
:= by
  have hrange : Set.range ![a, b, c] = ({a, b, c} : Set K) := by
    ext z
    simp [Matrix.range_cons, Matrix.range_empty]; tauto
  have hs := algebraicIndependent_snoc h (by rwa [hrange])
  have h4 : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b, c, a₀] := by
    convert hs using 1
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hp := h4.comp (![0, 3, 1, 2] : Fin 4 → Fin 4) (by decide)
  convert hp using 1
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: AclGeom.independent_over_closed_singleton
proof:
:= by
  rw [algebraicIndependent_iff_forall_notMem_racl]
  intro i hm
  rw [mem_racl_closed_base_iff] at hm
  have hnot : i.succ ∉ insert (0 : Fin 4) (Fin.succ '' ({i}ᶜ : Set (Fin 3))) := by
    rintro (hi | ⟨j, hj, hji⟩)
    · exact Fin.succ_ne_zero i hi
    · exact hj (by simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using Fin.succ_inj.mp hji)
  have hi := AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_image h hnot
  have hcomp : (![a₀, a, x, y] : Fin 4 → K) ∘ Fin.succ = ![a, x, y] := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> rfl
  have hset : (![a₀, a, x, y] : Fin 4 → K) ''
      insert 0 (Fin.succ '' ({i}ᶜ : Set (Fin 3))) =
      ({a₀} : Set K) ∪ (![a, x, y] '' ({i}ᶜ : Set (Fin 3))) := by
    rw [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_image]
    change insert a₀ (((![a₀, a, x, y] : Fin 4 → K) ∘ Fin.succ) '' {i}ᶜ) = _
    rw [hcomp, Set.singleton_union]
  apply hi
  rw [hset]
  simpa only [Matrix.cons_val_succ] using hm

name: AclGeom.ratio_notMem_fresh_base
proof:
:= by
  intro hratio
  have hr : x₀ / x ∈ racl k {a₀, b} :=
    racl_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr (Set.mem_insert _ _)) hratio
  have hx' : x ∈ racl k {a₀, b} := by
    have heq : x₀ / (x₀ / x) = x := by field_simp
    have hm := div_mem hx₀b hr
    rwa [heq] at hm
  exact hxb' (mem_racl_of_mem_racl_insert hxb hx' ha₀)

name: AclGeom.exists_normalized_corners
statement:
private theorem exists_normalized_corners [IsAlgClosed K] {a b c x y : K}
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K)
    (h : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, x, y])
    (hbx : b ∈ racl k {a, x}) (hxb : x ∈ racl k {a, b})
    (hcy : c ∈ racl k {a, y}) (hyc : y ∈ racl k {a, c})
    (hv : x / y ∈ racl k {b, c}) (hxb' : x ∉ racl k {b}) :
    ∃ a₀ α : K, a₀ ∉ racl k {a, x, y} ∧
      AlgebraicIndependent ↥(racl k {a₀}) ![α, x, y] ∧
      a ∈ racl ↥(racl k {a₀}) {α} ∧
      b ∈ racl ↥(racl k {a₀}) {α * x} ∧
      c ∈ racl ↥(racl k {a₀}) {α * y}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨habc, hclosed⟩ := incidence_corners_independent h hbx hxb hcy hyc
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ := fresh_three_of_five_le_trdeg htr {a, b, c} Finset.card_le_three
  have ha₀' : a₀ ∉ racl k {a, b, c} := by
    simpa only [Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_singleton] using ha₀
  have ha₀xy : a₀ ∉ racl k {a, x, y} := by rwa [← hclosed]
  have h4bc := independent_four_of_fresh_three habc ha₀'
  have h4xy' := independent_four_of_fresh_three h ha₀xy
  have hp := h4xy'.comp (![1, 0, 2, 3] : Fin 4 → Fin 4) (by decide)
  have h4xy : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a₀, a, x, y] := by
    convert hp using 1
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  obtain ⟨σ, hσa, hfix⟩ := exists_fixed_bc_automorphism habc ha₀'
  have hσb := hfix b (subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _))
  have hσc := hfix c (subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl))
  have hσv := hfix (x / y) hv
  have hxy : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, y] := AlgebraicIndependent.pair_one_two h
  let α := σ x / x
  have hα : α ∈ racl k {a, a₀} :=
    common_ratio_of_fixed_relocation htr h4bc hxy hbx hxb hcy hyc σ hσa hσb hσc hσv
  have hσxb : σ x ∈ racl k {a₀, b} := by
    simpa [Set.image_insert_eq, hσa, hσb] using mem_racl_map σ hxb
  have ha₀ab : a₀ ∉ racl k {a, b} := by
    intro hm
    apply ha₀'
    exact racl_mono (by
      intro z hz
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz ⊢
      tauto) hm
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := hxy.ne_zero 0
  have hy : y ≠ 0 := hxy.ne_zero 1
  have hx₀ : σ x ≠ 0 := (map_ne_zero_iff σ σ.injective).mpr hx
  have hy₀ : σ y ≠ 0 := (map_ne_zero_iff σ σ.injective).mpr hy
  have hαnot : α ∉ racl k {a₀} :=
    ratio_notMem_fresh_base hxb hσxb ha₀ab hxb' hx hx₀
  let k₀ := racl k ({a₀} : Set K)
  have hαa : α ∈ racl k₀ {a} := by
    rw [mem_racl_closed_base_iff]
    simpa [Set.singleton_union, Set.pair_comm] using hα
  have hαempty : α ∉ racl k₀ (∅ : Set K) := by
    intro hm
    rw [mem_racl_closed_base_iff, Set.union_empty] at hm
    exact hαnot hm
  have haα : a ∈ racl k₀ {α} := by
    have he := racl_exchange (S := (∅ : Set K)) (by simpa using hαa) hαempty
    simpa using he
  have hai : AlgebraicIndependent k₀ ![a, x, y] := independent_over_closed_singleton h4xy
  have hαi : AlgebraicIndependent k₀ ![α, x, y] := by
    apply (algebraicIndependent_congr_racl (v := ![a, x, y]) (w := ![α, x, y]) ?_).mp hai
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact racl_singleton_congr haα hαa
    · rfl
    · rfl
  have hprod : σ x * y = x * σ y := by
    have heq : σ x / σ y = x / y := by rwa [map_div₀] at hσv
    exact (div_eq_div_iff hy₀ hy).mp heq
  have hxα : σ x = α * x := by
    dsimp [α]
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hx]
  have hyα : σ y = α * y := by
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ hx
    calc
      σ y * x = σ x * y := by simpa only [mul_comm] using hprod.symm
      _ = α * y * x := by rw [hxα]; ring
  have hbα : b ∈ racl k₀ {α * x} := by
    have hm := mem_racl_map σ hbx
    rw [mem_racl_closed_base_iff]
    simpa [Set.image_insert_eq, hσa, hσb, hxα,
      Set.singleton_union, Set.pair_comm] using hm
  have hcα : c ∈ racl k₀ {α * y} := by
    have hm := mem_racl_map σ hcy
    rw [mem_racl_closed_base_iff]
    simpa [Set.image_insert_eq, hσa, hσc, hyα,
      Set.singleton_union, Set.pair_comm] using hm
  exact ⟨a₀, α, ha₀xy, hαi, haα, hbα, hcα⟩

name: AclGeom.product_mem_of_normalized_corners
statement:
private theorem product_mem_of_normalized_corners {α a b c d e x y : K}
    (h : AlgebraicIndependent k ![α, x, y])
    (ha : a ∈ racl k {α}) (hb : b ∈ racl k {α * x})
    (hc : c ∈ racl k {α * y})
    (hd₁ : d ∈ racl k {b, y}) (hd₂ : d ∈ racl k {x, c})
    (he₁ : e ∈ racl k {a, d}) (he₂ : e ∈ racl k {x, y}) :
    e ∈ racl k {x * y}
proof:
:= by
  have hd₁' : d ∈ racl k {α * x, y} := by
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl (S := {α * x, y}) (T := {b, y}) ?_ hd₁
    refine Set.insert_subset_iff.mpr ⟨?_, Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr ?_⟩
    · exact racl_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr (Set.mem_insert _ _)) hb
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
  have hd₂' : d ∈ racl k {x, α * y} := by
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl (S := {x, α * y}) (T := {x, c}) ?_ hd₂
    refine Set.insert_subset_iff.mpr ⟨?_, Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr ?_⟩
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
    · exact racl_mono (Set.subset_insert _ _) hc
  have hd := mem_racl_product_meet h hd₁' hd₂'
  refine mem_racl_bottom_product_meet h ?_ he₂
  refine racl_le_of_subset_racl (S := {α, x * y}) (T := {a, d}) ?_ he₁
  refine Set.insert_subset_iff.mpr ⟨?_, Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr ?_⟩
  · exact racl_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr (Set.mem_insert _ _)) ha
  · refine racl_le_of_subset_racl (S := {α, x * y}) (T := {α * x * y}) ?_ hd
    apply Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr
    have hm := mul_mem (subset_racl k ({α, x * y} : Set K) (Set.mem_insert _ _))
      (subset_racl k ({α, x * y} : Set K) (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl))
    simpa only [SetLike.mem_coe, mul_assoc] using hm

name: AclGeom.q'Sem_of_qSem_of_mulDiagram
statement:
theorem q'Sem_of_qSem_of_mulDiagram [IsAlgClosed K]
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K)
    {X Y S V E A B C D : Point k K}
    (hq : QSem X Y S V) (hmul : MulDiagram X Y V E A B C D) :
    Q'Sem X Y S E
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy, hX, hY, hS, hV⟩ := hq
  obtain ⟨haxy, hb, hx, hc, hy, hv, hd₁, hd₂, he₁, he₂, hxb⟩ :=
    multiplication_incidence_data hmul hX hY hV
  obtain ⟨a₀, α, ha₀, hα, ha, hbα, hcα⟩ :=
    exists_normalized_corners htr haxy hb hx hc hy hv hxb
  let k₀ := racl k ({a₀} : Set K)
  have he : E.rep ∈ racl k₀ {x * y} :=
    product_mem_of_normalized_corners hα ha hbα hcα
      (racl_subset_racl_base k₀ _ hd₁) (racl_subset_racl_base k₀ _ hd₂)
      (racl_subset_racl_base k₀ _ he₁) (racl_subset_racl_base k₀ _ he₂)
  have he' : E.rep ∈ racl k {a₀, x * y} := by
    rw [mem_racl_closed_base_iff] at he
    simpa only [Set.singleton_union] using he
  have hproduct : x * y ∈ racl k {x, y} :=
    mul_mem (subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _))
      (subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl))
  have heproduct : E.rep ∈ racl k {x * y} := by
    by_contra hn
    have hex := racl_exchange he' hn
    have ha₀xy : a₀ ∈ racl k {x, y} :=
      racl_le_of_subset_racl
        (Set.insert_subset_iff.mpr ⟨he₂, Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hproduct⟩) hex
    exact ha₀ (racl_mono (Set.subset_insert _ _) ha₀xy)
  have hle : E.1 ≤ ClosedIF.point k (x * y) := by
    rw [← E.point_rep]
    exact ClosedIF.point_le_iff.mpr (ClosedIF.mem_point.mpr heproduct)
  have hnb : x * y ∉ (⊥ : ClosedIF k K) := by
    intro hm
    have hz := ClosedIF.point_eq_bot_iff.mpr hm
    rw [hz] at hle
    exact E.2.1 (le_bot_iff.mp hle)
  have hE : E.1 = ClosedIF.point k (x * y) :=
    ((ClosedIF.isAtom_point hnb).le_iff_eq E.2.1).mp hle
  exact ⟨x, y, hxy, hX, hY, hS, hE⟩

name: AclGeom.exists_specializable_corners
statement:
private theorem exists_specializable_corners [IsAlgClosed K]
    {a b c x y : K} (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K)
    (h : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, x, y])
    (hbx : b ∈ racl k {a, x}) (hxb : x ∈ racl k {a, b})
    (hcy : c ∈ racl k {a, y}) (hyc : y ∈ racl k {a, c})
    (hv : x / y ∈ racl k {b, c}) (hxb' : x ∉ racl k {b}) :
    ∃ t α : K, t ∉ racl k {a, x, y} ∧ α ≠ 0 ∧ α ∈ racl k {t, a} ∧
      b ∈ racl k {t, α * x} ∧ c ∈ racl k {t, α * y}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, α, ht, hαi, ha, hb, hc⟩ :=
    exists_normalized_corners htr h hbx hxb hcy hyc hv hxb'
  have h4 := independent_four_of_fresh_three h ht
  have hai : AlgebraicIndependent ↥(racl k {t}) ![a, x, y] :=
    independent_over_closed_singleton (by
      convert h4.comp (![1, 0, 2, 3] : Fin 4 → Fin 4) (by decide) using 1
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl)
  have haempty : a ∉ racl ↥(racl k {t}) (∅ : Set K) :=
    notMem_racl_empty_of_transcendental (hai.transcendental 0)
  have hαa : α ∈ racl k {t, a} := by
    have ham : a ∈ racl ↥(racl k {t}) (insert α (∅ : Set K)) := by simpa using ha
    have hm := racl_exchange ham haempty
    have hm' : α ∈ racl ↥(racl k {t}) {a} := by simpa using hm
    rwa [mem_racl_closed_base_iff, Set.singleton_union] at hm'
  have hb' : b ∈ racl k {t, α * x} := by
    rwa [mem_racl_closed_base_iff, Set.singleton_union] at hb
  have hc' : c ∈ racl k {t, α * y} := by
    rwa [mem_racl_closed_base_iff, Set.singleton_union] at hc
  exact ⟨t, α, ht, hαi.ne_zero 0, hαa, hb', hc'⟩

name: AclGeom.exists_descended_corner_memberships
statement:
private theorem exists_descended_corner_memberships [IsAlgClosed K] [Infinite k]
    {a b c x y : K} (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K)
    (h : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, x, y])
    (hbx : b ∈ racl k {a, x}) (hxb : x ∈ racl k {a, b})
    (hcy : c ∈ racl k {a, y}) (hyc : y ∈ racl k {a, c})
    (hv : x / y ∈ racl k {b, c}) (hxb' : x ∉ racl k {b}) :
    ∃ β : K, β ≠ 0 ∧ β ∈ racl k {a} ∧
      b ∈ racl k {β * x} ∧ c ∈ racl k {β * y}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, α, ht, hα0, hαa, hb', hc'⟩ :=
    exists_specializable_corners htr h hbx hxb hcy hyc hv hxb'
  let F := racl k ({a, x, y} : Set K)
  let : IsAlgClosed F := isAlgClosed_closed_parameters _
  have htF : Transcendental F t := by
    intro halg
    exact ht (isRAC_racl _ t halg)
  have haF : a ∈ F := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
  have hxF : x ∈ F := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
  have hyF : y ∈ F := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
  have hbF : b ∈ F := by
    change b ∈ racl k ({a, x, y} : Set K)
    exact racl_mono (k := k) (K := K) (S := {a, x}) (T := {a, x, y})
      (Set.insert_subset (Set.mem_insert _ _) (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr
        (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)))) hbx
  have hcF : c ∈ F := by
    change c ∈ racl k ({a, x, y} : Set K)
    exact racl_mono (k := k) (K := K) (S := {a, y}) (T := {a, x, y})
      (Set.insert_subset (Set.mem_insert _ _) (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr
        (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)))) hcy
  exact exists_multiplier_descent (k := k) (K := K) (F := F) (t := t) (α := α)
    (⟨a, haF⟩ : F) ⟨b, hbF⟩ ⟨c, hcF⟩ ⟨x, hxF⟩ ⟨y, hyF⟩ htF h
    hα0 hαa hb' hc'

name: AclGeom.exists_original_normalized_corners
statement:
private theorem exists_original_normalized_corners [IsAlgClosed K] [Infinite k]
    {a b c x y : K} (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K)
    (h : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, x, y])
    (hbx : b ∈ racl k {a, x}) (hxb : x ∈ racl k {a, b})
    (hcy : c ∈ racl k {a, y}) (hyc : y ∈ racl k {a, c})
    (hv : x / y ∈ racl k {b, c}) (hxb' : x ∉ racl k {b}) :
    ∃ β : K, AlgebraicIndependent k ![β, x, y] ∧
      a ∈ racl k {β} ∧ b ∈ racl k {β * x} ∧ c ∈ racl k {β * y}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨β, -, hβa, hbβ, hcβ⟩ :=
    exists_descended_corner_memberships htr h hbx hxb hcy hyc hv hxb'
  have hβempty : β ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) := by
    intro hm
    have hβx : β * x ∈ racl k {x} := mul_mem
      (racl_mono (Set.empty_subset _) hm) (subset_racl k _ rfl)
    have hbx' : b ∈ racl k {x} := racl_le_of_subset_racl
      (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hβx) hbβ
    obtain ⟨habc, -⟩ := incidence_corners_independent h hbx hxb hcy hyc
    have hbempty : b ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) :=
      notMem_racl_empty_of_transcendental (habc.transcendental 1)
    have hex := racl_exchange (S := (∅ : Set K)) (by simpa using hbx') hbempty
    exact hxb' (by simpa using hex)
  have haβ : a ∈ racl k {β} := by
    have hex := racl_exchange (S := (∅ : Set K)) (by simpa using hβa) hβempty
    simpa using hex
  refine ⟨β, ?_, haβ, hbβ, hcβ⟩
  apply (algebraicIndependent_congr_racl (v := ![a, x, y]) (w := ![β, x, y]) ?_).mp h
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · exact racl_singleton_congr haβ hβa
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: AclGeom.point_eq_of_rep_mem
statement:
private theorem point_eq_of_rep_mem {P : Point k K} {z : K}
    (h : P.rep ∈ racl k {z}) : P.1 = ClosedIF.point k z
proof:
:= by
  have hle : P.1 ≤ ClosedIF.point k z := by
    rw [← P.point_rep]
    exact ClosedIF.point_le_iff.mpr h
  have hz : z ∉ (⊥ : ClosedIF k K) := by
    intro hm
    rw [ClosedIF.point_eq_bot_iff.mpr hm] at hle
    exact P.2.1 (le_bot_iff.mp hle)
  exact ((ClosedIF.isAtom_point hz).le_iff_eq P.2.1).mp hle

name: AclGeom.mulDiagram_coordinates
statement:
theorem mulDiagram_coordinates [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K]
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K)
    {X Y V E A B C D : Point k K} {x y : K}
    (hmul : MulDiagram X Y V E A B C D)
    (hX : X.1 = ClosedIF.point k x) (hY : Y.1 = ClosedIF.point k y)
    (hV : V.1 = ClosedIF.point k (x / y)) :
    ∃ a : K, AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, x, y] ∧
      A.1 = ClosedIF.point k a ∧ B.1 = ClosedIF.point k (a * x) ∧
      C.1 = ClosedIF.point k (a * y) ∧ D.1 = ClosedIF.point k (a * x * y) ∧
      E.1 = ClosedIF.point k (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨haxy, hb, hx, hc, hy, hv, hd₁, hd₂, he₁, he₂, hxb⟩ :=
    multiplication_incidence_data hmul hX hY hV
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hA, hB, hC⟩ :=
    exists_original_normalized_corners htr haxy hb hx hc hy hv hxb
  have hd₁' : D.rep ∈ racl k {a * x, y} := by
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl (S := {a * x, y}) (T := {B.rep, y}) ?_ hd₁
    refine Set.insert_subset_iff.mpr ⟨?_, Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr ?_⟩
    · exact racl_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr (Set.mem_insert _ _)) hB
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
  have hd₂' : D.rep ∈ racl k {x, a * y} := by
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl (S := {x, a * y}) (T := {x, C.rep}) ?_ hd₂
    refine Set.insert_subset_iff.mpr ⟨?_, Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr ?_⟩
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
    · exact racl_mono (Set.subset_insert _ _) hC
  have hD := mem_racl_product_meet ha hd₁' hd₂'
  have hE := product_mem_of_normalized_corners ha hA hB hC hd₁ hd₂ he₁ he₂
  exact ⟨a, ha, point_eq_of_rep_mem hA, point_eq_of_rep_mem hB,
    point_eq_of_rep_mem hC, point_eq_of_rep_mem hD, point_eq_of_rep_mem hE⟩

name: AclGeom.five_le_trdeg_polynomial_algebraicClosure
proof:
:= by
  let Ω := AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K))
  let φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K →ₐ[K] Ω :=
    IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K (MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K) Ω
  have hφ : Function.Injective φ := by
    change Function.Injective (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K) Ω)
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq (MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K)
      (FractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K)) Ω]
    exact (algebraMap (FractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K)) Ω).injective.comp
      (IsFractionRing.injective (MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K)
        (FractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K)))
  have hX := (MvPolynomial.algebraicIndependent_X (Fin 5) K).map' hφ
  have hXk := AlgebraicIndependent.restrictScalars (algebraMap k K).injective hX
  simpa using hXk.lift_cardinalMk_le_trdeg

name: AclGeom.exists_preimage_of_mem_racl_singleton
statement:
private theorem exists_preimage_of_mem_racl_singleton [IsAlgClosed K]
    {Ω : Type*} [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω] [Algebra K Ω] [IsScalarTower k K Ω]
    {a : K} {z : Ω} (hz : z ∈ racl k {algebraMap K Ω a}) :
    ∃ b : K, algebraMap K Ω b = z
proof:
:= by
  let τ : K →ₐ[k] Ω := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k K Ω
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpz, hpc⟩ := mem_racl_iff_exists_poly.mp hz
  have hle : adjoin k ({algebraMap K Ω a} : Set Ω) ≤ τ.fieldRange := by
    apply adjoin_le_iff.mpr
    rintro _ rfl
    exact ⟨a, rfl⟩
  have hcoeff : ∀ n, p.coeff n ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K Ω) := fun n ↦ hle (hpc n)
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := (Polynomial.mem_lifts (f := algebraMap K Ω) p).mp
    ((Polynomial.lifts_iff_coeff_lifts p).mpr hcoeff)
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero, Polynomial.map_zero] at hq
    exact hp hq.symm
  have hza : IsAlgebraic K z := by
    refine ⟨q, hq0, ?_⟩
    rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, ← Polynomial.eval_map, hq]
    exact hpz
  have heq : algebraicClosure K Ω = ⊥ :=
    IntermediateField.eq_bot_of_isAlgClosed_of_isAlgebraic _
  have hm : z ∈ algebraicClosure K Ω := mem_algebraicClosure_iff.mpr hza
  rw [heq] at hm
  exact IntermediateField.mem_bot.mp hm

name: AclGeom.exists_original_normalized_corners_without_trdeg
statement:
private theorem exists_original_normalized_corners_without_trdeg
    [IsAlgClosed K] [Infinite k] {a b c x y : K}
    (h : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, x, y])
    (hbx : b ∈ racl k {a, x}) (hxb : x ∈ racl k {a, b})
    (hcy : c ∈ racl k {a, y}) (hyc : y ∈ racl k {a, c})
    (hv : x / y ∈ racl k {b, c}) (hxb' : x ∉ racl k {b}) :
    ∃ β : K, AlgebraicIndependent k ![β, x, y] ∧
      a ∈ racl k {β} ∧ b ∈ racl k {β * x} ∧ c ∈ racl k {β * y}
proof:
:= by
  let Ω := AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin 5) K))
  let τ : K →ₐ[k] Ω := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k K Ω
  have hmap (u v w : K) : τ ∘ ![u, v, w] = ![τ u, τ v, τ w] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hΩ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![τ a, τ x, τ y] := by
    rw [← hmap]
    exact h.map' τ.injective
  have hpair (z u v : K) : τ z ∈ racl k {τ u, τ v} ↔ z ∈ racl k {u, v} := by
    simpa only [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton] using
      algHom_mem_racl_image_iff τ (x := z) (S := {u, v})
  have hvΩ : τ x / τ y ∈ racl k {τ b, τ c} := by
    rw [← map_div₀]
    exact (hpair _ _ _).mpr hv
  have hxbΩ : τ x ∉ racl k {τ b} := by
    rw [algHom_mem_racl_singleton_iff]
    exact hxb'
  obtain ⟨βΩ, hβΩ, haΩ, hbΩ, hcΩ⟩ :=
    exists_original_normalized_corners (k := k) (K := Ω)
      (five_le_trdeg_polynomial_algebraicClosure (k := k) (K := K)) hΩ
      ((hpair _ _ _).mpr hbx) ((hpair _ _ _).mpr hxb)
      ((hpair _ _ _).mpr hcy) ((hpair _ _ _).mpr hyc) hvΩ hxbΩ
  have haempty : τ a ∉ racl k (∅ : Set Ω) :=
    notMem_racl_empty_of_transcendental (hΩ.transcendental 0)
  have hβa : βΩ ∈ racl k {τ a} := by
    have he := racl_exchange (S := (∅ : Set Ω)) (by simpa using haΩ) haempty
    simpa using he
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := exists_preimage_of_mem_racl_singleton (k := k) (K := K) hβa
  change τ β = βΩ at hβ
  rw [← hβ] at hβΩ haΩ hbΩ hcΩ
  refine ⟨β, ?_, (algHom_mem_racl_singleton_iff τ).mp haΩ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply AlgebraicIndependent.of_comp τ
    rw [hmap]
    exact hβΩ
  · rw [← map_mul] at hbΩ
    exact (algHom_mem_racl_singleton_iff τ).mp hbΩ
  · rw [← map_mul] at hcΩ
    exact (algHom_mem_racl_singleton_iff τ).mp hcΩ

name: AclGeom.MulDiagram.exists_coordinates
statement:
theorem MulDiagram.exists_coordinates [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K]
    {X Y V E A B C D : Point k K} {x y : K}
    (hmul : MulDiagram X Y V E A B C D)
    (hX : X.1 = ClosedIF.point k x) (hY : Y.1 = ClosedIF.point k y)
    (hV : V.1 = ClosedIF.point k (x / y)) :
    ∃ a : K, AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, x, y] ∧
      A.1 = ClosedIF.point k a ∧ B.1 = ClosedIF.point k (a * x) ∧
      C.1 = ClosedIF.point k (a * y) ∧ D.1 = ClosedIF.point k (a * x * y) ∧
      E.1 = ClosedIF.point k (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨haxy, hb, hx, hc, hy, hv, hd₁, hd₂, he₁, he₂, hxb⟩ :=
    multiplication_incidence_data hmul hX hY hV
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hA, hB, hC⟩ :=
    exists_original_normalized_corners_without_trdeg haxy hb hx hc hy hv hxb
  have hd₁' : D.rep ∈ racl k {a * x, y} := by
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl (S := {a * x, y}) (T := {B.rep, y}) ?_ hd₁
    refine Set.insert_subset_iff.mpr ⟨?_, Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr ?_⟩
    · exact racl_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr (Set.mem_insert _ _)) hB
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
  have hd₂' : D.rep ∈ racl k {x, a * y} := by
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl (S := {x, a * y}) (T := {x, C.rep}) ?_ hd₂
    refine Set.insert_subset_iff.mpr ⟨?_, Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr ?_⟩
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
    · exact racl_mono (Set.subset_insert _ _) hC
  have hD := mem_racl_product_meet ha hd₁' hd₂'
  have hE := product_mem_of_normalized_corners ha hA hB hC hd₁ hd₂ he₁ he₂
  exact ⟨a, ha, point_eq_of_rep_mem hA, point_eq_of_rep_mem hB,
    point_eq_of_rep_mem hC, point_eq_of_rep_mem hD, point_eq_of_rep_mem hE⟩

name: AclGeom.single_image_lift_racl
proof:
:= by
  have h := (liftClosed_point
    (fun _ hy ↦ mem_algebraicClosure_iff.1 hy) (configurationEmbedding k K) P.rep).symm
  rw [P.point_rep] at h
  have hpoint :
      ClosedIF.point (↥(configurationBase k K)) ((configurationEmbedding k K) P.rep) =
      (liftPoint (fun _ hy ↦ mem_algebraicClosure_iff.1 hy)
        (configurationEmbedding k K) P).1 := h
  have hr := congrArg Subtype.val hpoint
  rw [← (liftPoint (fun _ hy ↦ mem_algebraicClosure_iff.1 hy)
    (configurationEmbedding k K) P).point_rep] at hr
  exact hr

name: AclGeom.pair_image_lift_racl
statement:
private theorem pair_image_lift_racl (P Q : Point k K) :
    racl (↥(configurationBase k K))
      (range ((configurationEmbedding k K) ∘ (![P.rep, Q.rep] : Fin 2 → K))) =
    racl (↥(configurationBase k K))
      (range (![(liftPoint (fun _ hy ↦ mem_algebraicClosure_iff.1 hy)
        (configurationEmbedding k K) P).rep,
        (liftPoint (fun _ hy ↦ mem_algebraicClosure_iff.1 hy)
          (configurationEmbedding k K) Q).rep] : Fin 2 → ConfigurationAmbient K))
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : (configurationEmbedding k K) ∘ (![P.rep, Q.rep] : Fin 2 → K) =
      ![(configurationEmbedding k K) P.rep, (configurationEmbedding k K) Q.rep] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  rw [hcomp, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty]
  simpa only [singleton_union] using
    racl_union_congr (single_image_lift_racl P) (single_image_lift_racl Q)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCore.groupConfiguration_universalImages
statement:
theorem PsiCore.groupConfiguration_universalImages (hw : w.PsiCore) :
    GroupConfig.GroupConfiguration (↥(configurationBase k K))
      ((configurationEmbedding k K) ∘ w.aTuple) ((configurationEmbedding k K) ∘ w.bTuple)
      ((configurationEmbedding k K) ∘ w.cTuple) ((configurationEmbedding k K) ∘ w.xTuple)
      ((configurationEmbedding k K) ∘ w.yTuple) ((configurationEmbedding k K) ∘ w.zTuple) ∧
      erk (↥(configurationBase k K)) ∅ (range ((configurationEmbedding k K) ∘ w.aTuple)) = 2 ∧
      erk (↥(configurationBase k K)) ∅ (range ((configurationEmbedding k K) ∘ w.xTuple)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hA : racl (↥(configurationBase k K)) (range ((configurationEmbedding k K) ∘ w.aTuple)) =
      racl (↥(configurationBase k K)) (range w.universalLift.aTuple) :=
    pair_image_lift_racl w.A₁ w.A₂
  have hB : racl (↥(configurationBase k K)) (range ((configurationEmbedding k K) ∘ w.bTuple)) =
      racl (↥(configurationBase k K)) (range w.universalLift.bTuple) :=
    pair_image_lift_racl w.B₁ w.B₂
  have hC : racl (↥(configurationBase k K)) (range ((configurationEmbedding k K) ∘ w.cTuple)) =
      racl (↥(configurationBase k K)) (range w.universalLift.cTuple) :=
    pair_image_lift_racl w.C₁ w.C₂
  have hs (P : Point k K) :
      racl (↥(configurationBase k K))
          (range ((configurationEmbedding k K) ∘ (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ P.rep))) =
      racl (↥(configurationBase k K)) (range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦
        (liftPoint (fun _ hy ↦ mem_algebraicClosure_iff.1 hy)
          (configurationEmbedding k K) P).rep)) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, range_const] using single_image_lift_racl P
  have hX := hs w.X
  have hY := hs w.Y
  have hZ := hs w.Z
  have hc := hw.groupConfiguration_universalLift
  refine ⟨hc.1.ofRaclEq hA hB hC hX hY hZ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (erk_eq_of_racl_eq hA).trans hc.2.1
  · exact (erk_eq_of_racl_eq hX).trans hc.2.2

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.racl_rep
statement:
private theorem racl_rep {P : Point k K} {x : K} (hP : P.1 = ClosedIF.point k x) :
    racl k ({P.rep} : Set K) = racl k ({x} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg (fun E : ClosedIF k K ↦ (E.1 : IntermediateField k K))
    ((Point.point_rep P).trans hP)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.racl_range_pair
statement:
private theorem racl_range_pair (p q : K) :
    racl k (range ![p, q]) = racl k ((racl k ({p} : Set K) : Set K) ∪ racl k ({q} : Set K))
proof:
:= by
  rw [racl_union_left, racl_union_right]
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp only [mem_range, Fin.exists_fin_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
    mem_union, mem_singleton_iff]
  tauto

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.not_cb_a
statement:
theorem not_cb_a :
    ¬ (range ![s, u] ⊆
      racl k (canonicalBase (racl k (range ![s, u])) (Sum.elim ![s * t] ![t]) : Set K))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hrange : range ![s, u] = ({s, u} : Set K) := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_range, Fin.exists_fin_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      mem_insert_iff, mem_singleton_iff]
    tauto
  have hsL : s ∈ racl k (range ![s, u]) := subset_racl k _ ⟨0, rfl⟩
  have ht : Transcendental (↥(racl k (range ![s, u]))) t := by
    intro halg
    have h1 : t ∈ racl k ((racl k (range ![s, u]) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
      (mem_racl_iff k).2 (by rw [adjoin_self]; exact halg)
    rw [racl_racl, hrange] at h1
    have hsub : ({s, u} : Set K) ⊆ ({s, u, s', u'} : Set K) := by
      intro x hx
      simp only [mem_insert_iff, mem_singleton_iff] at hx ⊢
      tauto
    exact t_not_mem hind (racl_mono (k := k) hsub h1)
  have hpt : (Sum.elim ![s * t] ![t] : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1 → K) =
      ![t, s * t + 0] ∘ ((Equiv.sumComm (Fin 1) (Fin 1)).trans
        (finSumFinEquiv : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1 ≃ Fin 2)) := by
    rw [add_zero]
    funext i
    rcases i with i | i <;> fin_cases i <;> rfl
  rw [hpt, canonicalBase_comp_equiv, canonicalBase_affineLine _ hsL (zero_mem _) ht] at h
  have hu : u ∈ racl k ((adjoin k ({s, 0} : Set K) : IntermediateField k K) : Set K) :=
    h ⟨1, rfl⟩
  have hle : adjoin k ({s, 0} : Set K) ≤ racl k ({s} : Set K) := by
    refine adjoin_le_iff.2 ?_
    rintro x (rfl | rfl)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (mem_singleton x)
    · exact zero_mem _
  have hu' := racl_mono (k := k) (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.2 hle) hu
  rw [racl_racl] at hu'
  exact u_not_mem hind hu'

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.not_groupConfiguration
statement:
theorem not_groupConfiguration :
    ¬ GroupConfiguration k (witness hind).aTuple (witness hind).bTuple (witness hind).cTuple
      (witness hind).xTuple (witness hind).yTuple (witness hind).zTuple
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  have hpair {P Q : Point k K} {p q : K} (hP : P.1 = ClosedIF.point k p)
      (hQ : Q.1 = ClosedIF.point k q) :
      racl k (range ![p, q]) = racl k (range ![P.rep, Q.rep]) := by
    rw [racl_range_pair, racl_range_pair, racl_rep hP, racl_rep hQ]
  have hsingle {P : Point k K} {p : K} (hP : P.1 = ClosedIF.point k p) :
      racl k (range ![p]) = racl k (range fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ P.rep) := by
    rw [range_const, racl_rep hP]
    congr 1
    ext x
    simp
  have hc' := hc.ofRaclEq (a' := ![s, u]) (b' := ![s', u']) (c' := ![s' / s, u' / u])
    (x' := ![s * t]) (y' := ![t]) (z' := ![s' * t]) (hpair rfl rfl) (hpair rfl rfl)
    (hpair rfl rfl) (hsingle rfl) (hsingle rfl) (hsingle rfl)
  exact not_cb_a hind hc'.cb_a

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Nonfaithful.not_exists_isMainConclusion
statement:
theorem not_exists_isMainConclusion :
    ¬ ∃ E : Set K, E.Finite ∧
      IndepOver k ∅ E (range (witness hind).aTuple ∪ range (witness hind).bTuple ∪
        range (witness hind).cTuple ∪ range (witness hind).xTuple ∪
        range (witness hind).yTuple ∪ range (witness hind).zTuple) ∧
      IsMainConclusion k (racl k E) (witness hind).aTuple (witness hind).bTuple
        (witness hind).cTuple (witness hind).xTuple (witness hind).yTuple (witness hind).zTuple
proof:
:=
  fun ⟨_, hE, hindE, h⟩ ↦
    not_groupConfiguration hind (GroupConfiguration.of_isMainConclusion hE hindE h)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.selectedBCurveEquation_map_relocated
statement:
theorem selectedBCurveEquation_map_relocated
    (G : FiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember
      (k := k) (Ω := CommonCurveAmbient K) 2)
    (h : (mappedSelectedBFamily (w := w) (hψ := hψ)).ideal = G.ideal) :
    MvPolynomial.map
        (selectedBToRelocatedBParameterEquiv
          (w := w) (hψ := hψ) G h).toRingHom
        (w.yzCorrespondencePairOverB hψ).curveEquation =
      G.toPair.curveEquation
proof:
:= by
  let F := w.yzCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ
  let ι := commonCurveEmbedding (k := k) (K := K)
  let e₁ := F.parameterMapEquiv ι
  let e₂ := (F.map ι).parameterEquivOfIdealEq G h
  change MvPolynomial.map (e₁.trans e₂).toRingHom
      F.toPair.curveEquation = G.toPair.curveEquation
  calc
    MvPolynomial.map (e₁.trans e₂).toRingHom
        F.toPair.curveEquation =
        MvPolynomial.map e₂.toRingHom
          (MvPolynomial.map e₁.toRingHom F.toPair.curveEquation) := by
      rw [MvPolynomial.map_map]
      rfl
    _ = MvPolynomial.map e₂.toRingHom
        (F.map ι).toPair.curveEquation := by
      rw [F.curveEquation_map_parameterMapEquiv ι]
    _ = G.toPair.curveEquation :=
      (F.map ι).curveEquation_map_parameterEquivOfIdealEq G h

statement:
theorem bGermCoefficientAlgHom_ext
    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra k F]
    {f g : (↥(w.bGermCoefficientField hψ)) →ₐ[k] F}
    (h : ∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ,
      f (selectedBCurveCoefficient (w := w) (hψ := hψ) d) =
        g (selectedBCurveCoefficient (w := w) (hψ := hψ) d)) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  unfold QWitness.bGermCoefficientField
    FiniteCorrespondencePair.curveCoefficientField

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.projectionParameterTransport_selectedBCurveCoefficient
statement:
theorem projectionParameterTransport_selectedBCurveCoefficient
    (p : Fin 2 → K) (x : K) (hp : w.psiBProjectionRelation p x)
    (G : FiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember
      (k := k) (Ω := CommonCurveAmbient K) 2)
    (h : (mappedSelectedBFamily (w := w) (hψ := hψ)).ideal = G.ideal)
    (hG : G.parameter =
      commonCurveEmbedding (k := k) (K := K) ∘ p)
    (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) :
    rankTwoParameterCurveEquivToFamily
        (k := k) (K := K) p G hG
        (bGermCoefficientToProjectionParameterAlgHom
          (w := w) (hψ := hψ) hp
          (selectedBCurveCoefficient (w := w) (hψ := hψ) d)) =
      G.toPair.curveEquation.coeff d
proof:
:= by
  have hcurve := selectedBCurveEquation_map_relocated
    (w := w) (hψ := hψ) G h
  have hcoeff := congrArg (fun f => f.coeff d) hcurve
  rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_map] at hcoeff
  rw [selectedBToRelocatedBParameterEquiv_eq_projection
    (w := w) (hψ := hψ) p x hp G h hG] at hcoeff
  change rankTwoParameterCurveEquivToFamily
      (k := k) (K := K) p G hG
      (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq
        (rankTwoParameter_ideal_eq_of_scalar_ideal_eq hp.symm)
        (bGermCoefficientToSelectedBParameterAlgHom
          (w := w) (hψ := hψ)
          (selectedBCurveCoefficient (w := w) (hψ := hψ) d))) = _
  rw [bGermCoefficientToSelectedBParameterAlgHom_selectedBCurveCoefficient]
  change rankTwoParameterCurveEquivToFamily
      (k := k) (K := K) p G hG
      (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq
        (rankTwoParameter_ideal_eq_of_scalar_ideal_eq hp.symm)
        ((w.yzCorrespondencePairOverB hψ).curveEquation.coeff d)) = _
    at hcoeff
  exact hcoeff

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.bGermToRelocatedAmbient_fieldRange
statement:
private theorem bGermToRelocatedAmbient_fieldRange
    (p : Fin 2 → K) (x : K) (hp : w.psiBProjectionRelation p x)
    (G : FiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember
      (k := k) (Ω := CommonCurveAmbient K) 2)
    (h : (mappedSelectedBFamily (w := w) (hψ := hψ)).ideal = G.ideal)
    (hG : G.parameter =
      commonCurveEmbedding (k := k) (K := K) ∘ p) :
    (bGermToRelocatedAmbientAlgHom
      (w := w) (hψ := hψ) p x hp G hG).fieldRange =
      G.toPair.curveCoefficientField k G.parameterField
proof:
:= by
  have htop := (w.yzCorrespondencePairOverB hψ).adjoin_curveCoefficientCoordinates_eq_top
    k w.bField
  have htop' : (⊤ : IntermediateField k
      ((w.yzCorrespondencePairOverB hψ).curveCoefficientField k w.bField)) =
      IntermediateField.adjoin k
        (Set.range ((w.yzCorrespondencePairOverB hψ).curveCoefficientCoordinates
          k w.bField)) := htop.symm
  rw [AlgHom.fieldRange_eq_map, htop', IntermediateField.adjoin_map]
  unfold FiniteCorrespondencePair.curveCoefficientField
  congr 1
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨c, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := c.2
    have hc : c = ⟨_, ⟨d, rfl⟩⟩ := Subtype.ext hd.symm
    subst c
    refine ⟨d, ?_⟩
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val
      (bGermCoefficientToRelocatedBParameterAlgHom_selectedBCurveCoefficient
        (w := w) (hψ := hψ) p x hp G h hG d)).symm
  · rintro ⟨d, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨selectedBCurveCoefficient (w := w) (hψ := hψ) d, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨_, ⟨d, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩
    · exact congrArg Subtype.val
        (bGermCoefficientToRelocatedBParameterAlgHom_selectedBCurveCoefficient
          (w := w) (hψ := hψ) p x hp G h hG d)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.bGermToRelocatedAmbient_mem_curveCoefficientField
statement:

    (p : Fin 2 → K) (x : K) (hp : w.psiBProjectionRelation p x)

      (k := k) (Ω := CommonCurveAmbient K) 2)

    bGermToRelocatedAmbientAlgHom
        (w := w) (hψ := hψ) p x hp G hG z ∈
      G.toPair.curveCoefficientField k G.parameterField
proof:

    (w := w) (hψ := hψ) p x hp G h hG]

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.bGermCoefficientToRelocatedBCoefficientAlgEquiv_selected
statement:
@[simp] theorem bGermCoefficientToRelocatedBCoefficientAlgEquiv_selected
    (p : Fin 2 → K) (x : K) (hp : w.psiBProjectionRelation p x)
    (G : FiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember
      (k := k) (Ω := CommonCurveAmbient K) 2)
    (h : (mappedSelectedBFamily (w := w) (hψ := hψ)).ideal = G.ideal)
    (hG : G.parameter =
      commonCurveEmbedding (k := k) (K := K) ∘ p)
    (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) :
    bGermCoefficientToRelocatedBCoefficientAlgEquiv
        (w := w) (hψ := hψ) p x hp G h hG
        (selectedBCurveCoefficient (w := w) (hψ := hψ) d) =
      ⟨((G.toPair.curveEquation.coeff d : G.parameterField) :
          CommonCurveAmbient K),
        G.toPair.coeff_mem_curveCoefficientField k G.parameterField d⟩
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change ((bGermCoefficientToRelocatedBParameterAlgHom
      (w := w) (hψ := hψ) p x hp G hG
      (selectedBCurveCoefficient (w := w) (hψ := hψ) d) :
        G.parameterField) : CommonCurveAmbient K) = _
  exact congrArg Subtype.val
    (bGermCoefficientToRelocatedBParameterAlgHom_selectedBCurveCoefficient
      (w := w) (hψ := hψ) p x hp G h hG d)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.bGermCoefficientToRelocatedBParameterAlgHom_factor_coefficients
statement:
theorem bGermCoefficientToRelocatedBParameterAlgHom_factor_coefficients
    (p : Fin 2 → K) (x : K) (hp : w.psiBProjectionRelation p x)
    (G : FiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember
      (k := k) (Ω := CommonCurveAmbient K) 2)
    (h : (mappedSelectedBFamily (w := w) (hψ := hψ)).ideal = G.ideal)
    (hG : G.parameter =
      commonCurveEmbedding (k := k) (K := K) ∘ p) :
    bGermCoefficientToRelocatedBParameterAlgHom
        (w := w) (hψ := hψ) p x hp G hG =
      (IntermediateField.inclusion
        (G.toPair.curveCoefficientField_le k G.parameterField)).comp
        (bGermCoefficientToRelocatedBCoefficientAlgEquiv
          (w := w) (hψ := hψ) p x hp G h hG).toAlgHom
proof:
:= by
  apply bGermCoefficientAlgHom_ext (w := w) (hψ := hψ)
  intro d
  rw [bGermCoefficientToRelocatedBParameterAlgHom_selectedBCurveCoefficient
    (w := w) (hψ := hψ) p x hp G h hG d]
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact (congrArg Subtype.val
    (bGermCoefficientToRelocatedBCoefficientAlgEquiv_selected
      (w := w) (hψ := hψ) p x hp G h hG d)).symm

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.bGermCoefficientToCompleteRightBranchRingHom_eq_parameter
statement:
theorem bGermCoefficientToCompleteRightBranchRingHom_eq_parameter
    (p : Fin 2 → K) (x : K) (hp : w.psiBProjectionRelation p x)
    (G : FiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember
      (k := k) (Ω := CommonCurveAmbient K) 2)
    (h : (mappedSelectedBFamily (w := w) (hψ := hψ)).ideal = G.ideal)
    (hG : G.parameter =
      commonCurveEmbedding (k := k) (K := K) ∘ p) :
    (algebraMap (↥G.parameterField)
        (↥G.toPair.branchOverSource)).comp
          (bGermCoefficientToRelocatedBParameterAlgHom
            (w := w) (hψ := hψ) p x hp G hG).toRingHom =
      (relocatedBCoefficientToCompleteRightBranchRingHom G).comp
        (bGermCoefficientToRelocatedBCoefficientAlgEquiv
          (w := w) (hψ := hψ) p x hp G h hG).toRingEquiv.toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro z
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe]
  change algebraMap (↥G.parameterField) (↥G.toPair.branchOverSource)
      (bGermCoefficientToRelocatedBParameterAlgHom
        (w := w) (hψ := hψ) p x hp G hG z) =
    relocatedBCoefficientToCompleteRightBranchRingHom G
      (bGermCoefficientToRelocatedBCoefficientAlgEquiv
        (w := w) (hψ := hψ) p x hp G h hG z)
  rw [DFunLike.congr_fun
    (bGermCoefficientToRelocatedBParameterAlgHom_factor_coefficients
      (w := w) (hψ := hψ) p x hp G h hG) z]
  apply Subtype.ext
  rfl

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.fourSelectedBCompleteBranchRingEquiv_parameter
statement:
theorem fourSelectedBCompleteBranchRingEquiv_parameter :
    R.seSelectedBCompleteBranchRingEquiv.toRingHom.comp
          (selectedBParameterToMappedCompleteBranchRingHom
            (w := w) (hψ := hψ)) =
        (algebraMap
          (↥(R.se.bCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ).parameterField)
          (↥(R.se.bCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ).toPair.branchOverSource)).comp
            (selectedBToRelocatedBParameterEquiv
              (w := w) (hψ := hψ)
              (R.se.bCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ)
              R.seMappedSelectedBFamily_ideal_eq).toRingEquiv.toRingHom ∧
      R.sAaSelectedBCompleteBranchRingEquiv.toRingHom.comp
          (selectedBParameterToMappedCompleteBranchRingHom
            (w := w) (hψ := hψ)) =
        (algebraMap
          (↥(R.sAa.bCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ).parameterField)
          (↥(R.sAa.bCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ).toPair.branchOverSource)).comp
            (selectedBToRelocatedBParameterEquiv
              (w := w) (hψ := hψ)
              (R.sAa.bCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ)
              R.sAaMappedSelectedBFamily_ideal_eq).toRingEquiv.toRingHom ∧
      R.sbSelectedBCompleteBranchRingEquiv.toRingHom.comp
          (selectedBParameterToMappedCompleteBranchRingHom
            (w := w) (hψ := hψ)) =
        (algebraMap
          (↥(R.sb.bCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ).parameterField)
          (↥(R.sb.bCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ).toPair.branchOverSource)).comp
            (selectedBToRelocatedBParameterEquiv
              (w := w) (hψ := hψ)
              (R.sb.bCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ)
              R.sbMappedSelectedBFamily_ideal_eq).toRingEquiv.toRingHom ∧
      R.sAcSelectedBCompleteBranchRingEquiv.toRingHom.comp
          (selectedBParameterToMappedCompleteBranchRingHom
            (w := w) (hψ := hψ)) =
        (algebraMap
          (↥(R.sAc.bCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ).parameterField)

            (selectedBToRelocatedBParameterEquiv
              (w := w) (hψ := hψ)
              (R.sAc.bCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ)
              R.sAcMappedSelectedBFamily_ideal_eq).toRingEquiv.toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> apply RingHom.ext <;> intro z
  · exact (mappedSelectedBFamily (w := w) (hψ := hψ)
      |>.completeBranchRingEquivOfIdealEq_algebraMap
        (R.se.bCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ)
        R.seMappedSelectedBFamily_ideal_eq
        ((w.yzCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ).parameterMapEquiv
          (commonCurveEmbedding (k := k) (K := K)) z))
  · exact (mappedSelectedBFamily (w := w) (hψ := hψ)
      |>.completeBranchRingEquivOfIdealEq_algebraMap
        (R.sAa.bCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ)
        R.sAaMappedSelectedBFamily_ideal_eq
        ((w.yzCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ).parameterMapEquiv
          (commonCurveEmbedding (k := k) (K := K)) z))
  · exact (mappedSelectedBFamily (w := w) (hψ := hψ)
      |>.completeBranchRingEquivOfIdealEq_algebraMap
        (R.sb.bCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ)
        R.sbMappedSelectedBFamily_ideal_eq
        ((w.yzCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ).parameterMapEquiv
          (commonCurveEmbedding (k := k) (K := K)) z))
  · exact (mappedSelectedBFamily (w := w) (hψ := hψ)
      |>.completeBranchRingEquivOfIdealEq_algebraMap
        (R.sAc.bCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ)

statement:
theorem fourProjectionParameterTransports_selectedBCurveCoefficient
    (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) :
    rankTwoParameterCurveEquivToFamily
        (k := k) (K := K) e
        (R.se.bCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ)
        R.relocatedBFamily_parameters.1
        (bGermCoefficientToProjectionParameterAlgHom
          (w := w) (hψ := hψ) L.eProjectionRelation
          (selectedBCurveCoefficient (w := w) (hψ := hψ) d)) =
        (R.se.bCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ).toPair.curveEquation.coeff d ∧
      rankTwoParameterCurveEquivToFamily
        (k := k) (K := K) a
        (R.sAa.bCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ)
        R.relocatedBFamily_parameters.2.1
        (bGermCoefficientToProjectionParameterAlgHom
          (w := w) (hψ := hψ) L.aProjectionRelation
          (selectedBCurveCoefficient (w := w) (hψ := hψ) d)) =
        (R.sAa.bCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ).toPair.curveEquation.coeff d ∧
      rankTwoParameterCurveEquivToFamily
        (k := k) (K := K) b
        (R.sb.bCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ)
        R.relocatedBFamily_parameters.2.2.1
        (bGermCoefficientToProjectionParameterAlgHom
          (w := w) (hψ := hψ) L.bProjectionRelation
          (selectedBCurveCoefficient (w := w) (hψ := hψ) d)) =
        (R.sb.bCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ).toPair.curveEquation.coeff d ∧
      rankTwoParameterCurveEquivToFamily
        (k := k) (K := K) D.c
        (R.sAc.bCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ)
        R.relocatedBFamily_parameters.2.2.2
        (bGermCoefficientToProjectionParameterAlgHom
          (w := w) (hψ := hψ) L.cProjectionRelation
          (selectedBCurveCoefficient (w := w) (hψ := hψ) d)) =
        (R.sAc.bCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ).toPair.curveEquation.coeff d
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨projectionParameterTransport_selectedBCurveCoefficient
      (w := w) (hψ := hψ) e L.se_e L.eProjectionRelation
      (R.se.bCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ)
      R.seMappedSelectedBFamily_ideal_eq
      R.relocatedBFamily_parameters.1 d,
    projectionParameterTransport_selectedBCurveCoefficient

theorem Psi.hasAffineGridCoordinates_of_chart_of_aleph0_le_trdeg [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K]
    (htr : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K)
    {w : QWitness k K} (hw : w.Psi) (hID : w.I ≠ w.D) {a b c d x : K}
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b, c, d, x])
    (hA : w.A = ClosedIF.point k a ⊔ ClosedIF.point k b)
    (hB : w.B = ClosedIF.point k c ⊔ ClosedIF.point k d)
    (hC : w.C = ClosedIF.point k (a * c) ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (b * c + d))
    (hS : w.S.1 = ClosedIF.point k a) (hT : w.T.1 = ClosedIF.point k c)
    (hU : w.U.1 = ClosedIF.point k (a * c)) (hX : w.X.1 = ClosedIF.point k x)
    (hY : w.Y.1 = ClosedIF.point k (a * x + b))
    (hZ : w.Z.1 = ClosedIF.point k (c * (a * x + b) + d)) :
    w.HasAffineGridCoordinates
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, -, -, HP⟩ :=
    hw.hasAffineGridCoordinates_of_chart_supplied_inputs hID hind hA hB hC hS hT hU hX hY hZ
  
  obtain ⟨tP, htP⟩ := exists_fresh_sequence_of_aleph0_le_trdeg htr
    (Set.Finite.insert a (Set.Finite.insert b (Set.Finite.insert x (Set.finite_singleton c))))
  obtain ⟨κ, _, -, -, HQ⟩ := HP tP fun n _ ↦ htP n
  
  obtain ⟨tQ, htQ⟩ := exists_fresh_sequence_of_aleph0_le_trdeg htr
    (Set.Finite.insert c (Set.Finite.insert (d + (c - 1) * algebraMap k K κ)
      (Set.Finite.insert (b + (a - 1) * algebraMap k K κ) (Set.finite_singleton (a * c)⁻¹))))
  exact HQ tQ fun n _ ↦ htQ n

    ⟨x, by
      change x ∈ rankTwoScalarField (k := k) p x
      exact subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self (2 : Fin 3))⟩

    (rankTwoScalarLocusBasedNormalEquiv hx hy hxy).map_selected_apply sx

          exact subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self (2 : Fin 3))⟩ :
            rankTwoScalarExtension (k := k) q y) := by

name: AclGeom.iSup_pair
statement:
theorem iSup_pair (P Q : Point k K) :
    ⨆ i, ((![P, Q] : Fin 2 → Point k K) i).1 = line P Q
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (iSup_le fun i ↦ ?_) (sup_le ?_ ?_)
  · fin_cases i
    · exact le_sup_left
    · exact le_sup_right
  · exact le_iSup_of_le 0 (by simp)
  · exact le_iSup_of_le 1 (by simp)

name: AclGeom.memCl_iff_mem_pointCl
proof:
:= by
  rw [MemCl, mem_pointCl_iff]
  have h : (⨆ i, (Q i).1) = sSup (Subtype.val '' Set.range Q) := by
    refine le_antisymm (iSup_le fun i ↦ le_sSup ⟨Q i, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩)
      (sSup_le ?_)
    rintro E ⟨R, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact le_iSup (fun j ↦ (Q j).1) i
  rw [h]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: AclGeom.IsPartialQuadrangle.comp_perm
statement:
theorem comp_perm (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 6))
    (hσ : ∀ s : Finset (Fin 6), s ∈ quadTriples ↔ s.image σ ∈ quadTriples)
    (h : IsPartialQuadrangle f) : IsPartialQuadrangle (f ∘ σ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsup : ∀ s : Finset (Fin 6),
      (s.sup fun i ↦ ((f ∘ σ) i).1) = (s.image σ).sup fun i ↦ (f i).1 := by
    intro s
    rw [Finset.sup_image]
    rfl
  refine ⟨h.injective.comp σ.injective, fun s hs ↦ ?_, fun s hs3 hs ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hsup]
    exact h.rank_dep _ ((hσ s).1 hs)
  · rw [hsup]
    refine h.rank_free _ ?_ fun hmem ↦ hs ((hσ s).2 hmem)
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ σ.injective]
    exact hs3
  · rw [hsup]
    have huniv : (Finset.univ.image σ : Finset (Fin 6)) = Finset.univ := by
      ext i
      simp
    rw [huniv]
    exact h.rank_total

name: AclGeom.canonicalBase_incidence_eq
statement:
private theorem canonicalBase_incidence_eq [IsAlgClosed K] [UniversalDomain k K]
    (E : ClosedIF k K) [IsAlgClosed ↥E.1] (hEsmall : IsSmall k (E : Set K))
    (hE : RankEq 2 E) (Q P : Point k K) (hPQ : P.1 ≤ E ⊔ Q.1)
    (hfree : ∀ R : Point k K, R.1 ≤ E → ¬ P.1 ≤ R.1 ⊔ Q.1) :
    racl k (canonicalBase E.1 (Sum.elim (pointTuple Q) (pointTuple P)) : Set K) = E.1
proof:
:= by
  let B := canonicalBase E.1 (Sum.elim (pointTuple Q) (pointTuple P))
  let C : ClosedIF k K := ⟨racl k (B : Set K), isRAC_racl _⟩
  have hCE : C ≤ E :=
    ClosedIF.le_iff.2 (racl_le_of_isAlgClosed (canonicalBase_le E.1 _))
  have hP : range (pointTuple P) ⊆ racl k ((E : Set K) ∪ range (pointTuple Q)) := by
    rw [← coe_sup_pointTuple]
    rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact hPQ P.mem_rep
  have hcapture := range_subset_racl_canonicalBase E.1 hEsmall
    (pointTuple Q) (pointTuple P) hP
  have hEq : C = E := RankEq.eq_of_le_of_not_le_point hCE hE fun R hRE hCR ↦ by
    apply hfree R hRE
    rw [← P.point_rep]
    refine ClosedIF.point_le_iff.2 ?_
    change P.rep ∈ (R.1 ⊔ Q.1).1
    rw [coe_sup_pointTuple]
    refine (racl_mono (union_subset_union_left _ ?_)) (hcapture (mem_range_self 0))
    exact (subset_racl k _).trans hCR
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hEq

name: AclGeom.closed_isAlgClosed
statement:
private theorem closed_isAlgClosed [IsAlgClosed K] (E : ClosedIF k K) :
    IsAlgClosed ↥E.1
proof:
:= by
  apply (IsAlgClosed.algebraicClosure_eq_bot_iff ↥E.1 K).mp
  apply bot_unique
  intro x hx
  exact IntermediateField.mem_bot.mpr
    ⟨⟨x, E.2 x (mem_algebraicClosure_iff.mp hx)⟩, rfl⟩

name: AclGeom.isSmall_of_rankEq

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiChunkFourArrowEdgeLifts.jointOverInput_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem jointOverInput_finiteDimensional :
    FiniteDimensional (↥D.inputField) (↥L.jointOverInput)
proof:
:= by
  have key : L.jointOverInput =
      adjoin (↥D.inputField) (Set.range L.jointTuple) := by
    refine restrictScalars_injective k ?_
    unfold jointOverInput
    rw [extendScalars_restrictScalars]
    unfold jointField
      RankTwoFiniteCorrespondenceMultiplication.FourArrowDifferenceDiagram.inputField
    rw [adjoin_adjoin_left, adjoin_union]
    exact (sup_eq_right.2 L.inputField_le_jointField).symm
  rw [key]
  letI : Fintype (Set.range L.jointTuple) :=
    Set.Finite.fintype (Set.finite_range L.jointTuple)
  exact finiteDimensional_adjoin fun x hx ↦ by
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ((mem_racl_iff k).1 (L.jointTuple_mem_input_racl i)).isIntegral

  have h := MulMemClass.mul_mem
    (inv_mem (MulMemClass.mul_mem ha hc)) (hsub hmem)
