  have harith : a * c * b * (c * b)⁻¹ = a := by
    rw [mul_assoc a c b, mul_inv_cancel_right₀ (mul_ne_zero
      (qtable_c_ne_zero hind) (qtable_b_ne_zero hind))]
  rw [harith] at h
  exact qtable_a_notMem_cb hind h

name: AclGeom.qQuad_injective
statement: theorem qQuad_injective : Function.Injective (qQuad hind)
proof:
:= by
  have hne : ∀ i j : Fin 6, i < j → qQuad hind i ≠ qQuad hind j := by
    intro i j hlt
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · exact absurd hlt (by decide)
    · show Point.mk' k a (qtable_a_notMem_bot hind) ≠ Point.mk' k c (qtable_c_notMem_bot hind)
      exact Point.mk'_ne (qtable_c_notMem_a hind)
    · show Point.mk' k a (qtable_a_notMem_bot hind) ≠ Point.mk' k (a * c) (qtable_mul_ac_notMem_bot hind)
      exact Point.mk'_ne (qtable_ac_notMem_a hind)
    · show Point.mk' k a (qtable_a_notMem_bot hind) ≠ Point.mk' k b (qtable_b_notMem_bot hind)
      exact Point.mk'_ne' (qtable_a_notMem_b hind)
    · show Point.mk' k a (qtable_a_notMem_bot hind) ≠ Point.mk' k (a * c * b) (qtable_acb_notMem_bot hind)
      exact Point.mk'_ne (qtable_acb_notMem_a hind)
    · show Point.mk' k a (qtable_a_notMem_bot hind) ≠ Point.mk' k (c * b) (qtable_mul_cb_notMem_bot hind)
      exact Point.mk'_ne (qtable_cb_notMem_a hind)
    · exact absurd hlt (by decide)
    · exact absurd hlt (by decide)
    · show Point.mk' k c (qtable_c_notMem_bot hind) ≠ Point.mk' k (a * c) (qtable_mul_ac_notMem_bot hind)
      exact Point.mk'_ne (qtable_ac_notMem_c hind)
    · show Point.mk' k c (qtable_c_notMem_bot hind) ≠ Point.mk' k b (qtable_b_notMem_bot hind)
      exact Point.mk'_ne (qtable_b_notMem_c hind)
    · show Point.mk' k c (qtable_c_notMem_bot hind) ≠ Point.mk' k (a * c * b) (qtable_acb_notMem_bot hind)
      exact Point.mk'_ne (qtable_acb_notMem_c hind)
    · show Point.mk' k c (qtable_c_notMem_bot hind) ≠ Point.mk' k (c * b) (qtable_mul_cb_notMem_bot hind)
      exact Point.mk'_ne (qtable_cb_notMem_c hind)
    · exact absurd hlt (by decide)
    · exact absurd hlt (by decide)
    · exact absurd hlt (by decide)
    · show Point.mk' k (a * c) (qtable_mul_ac_notMem_bot hind) ≠ Point.mk' k b (qtable_b_notMem_bot hind)
      exact Point.mk'_ne' (qtable_ac_notMem_b hind)
    · show Point.mk' k (a * c) (qtable_mul_ac_notMem_bot hind) ≠ Point.mk' k (a * c * b) (qtable_acb_notMem_bot hind)
      exact Point.mk'_ne (qtable_acb_notMem_ac hind)
    · show Point.mk' k (a * c) (qtable_mul_ac_notMem_bot hind) ≠ Point.mk' k (c * b) (qtable_mul_cb_notMem_bot hind)
      exact Point.mk'_ne (qtable_cb_notMem_ac hind)
    · exact absurd hlt (by decide)
    · exact absurd hlt (by decide)
    · exact absurd hlt (by decide)
    · exact absurd hlt (by decide)
    · show Point.mk' k b (qtable_b_notMem_bot hind) ≠ Point.mk' k (a * c * b) (qtable_acb_notMem_bot hind)
      exact Point.mk'_ne (qtable_acb_notMem_b hind)
    · show Point.mk' k b (qtable_b_notMem_bot hind) ≠ Point.mk' k (c * b) (qtable_mul_cb_notMem_bot hind)
      exact Point.mk'_ne (qtable_cb_notMem_b hind)
    · exact absurd hlt (by decide)
    · exact absurd hlt (by decide)
    · exact absurd hlt (by decide)
    · exact absurd hlt (by decide)
    · exact absurd hlt (by decide)
    · show Point.mk' k (a * c * b) (qtable_acb_notMem_bot hind) ≠ Point.mk' k (c * b) (qtable_mul_cb_notMem_bot hind)
      exact Point.mk'_ne' (qtable_acb_notMem_cb hind)
    · exact absurd hlt (by decide)
    · exact absurd hlt (by decide)
    · exact absurd hlt (by decide)
    · exact absurd hlt (by decide)
    · exact absurd hlt (by decide)
    · exact absurd hlt (by decide)
  intro i j hij
  rcases lt_trichotomy i j with h | h | h
  · exact absurd hij (hne i j h)
  · exact h
  · exact absurd hij.symm (hne j i h)

name: AclGeom.mem_of_mul_mem_left
statement:
theorem mem_of_mul_mem_left {E : IntermediateField k K} {u v : K}
    (hu : u ∈ E) (hu0 : u ≠ 0) (huv : u * v ∈ E) : v ∈ E
proof:
:= by
  have h := MulMemClass.mul_mem (inv_mem hu) huv
  rwa [inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hu0] at h

name: AclGeom.mem_of_mul_mem_right
statement:
theorem mem_of_mul_mem_right {E : IntermediateField k K} {u v : K}
    (hv : v ∈ E) (hv0 : v ≠ 0) (huv : u * v ∈ E) : u ∈ E
proof:
:= by
  have h := MulMemClass.mul_mem huv (inv_mem hv)
  rwa [mul_inv_cancel_right₀ hv0] at h

name: AclGeom.range_pair
statement: theorem range_pair (u v : K) : Set.range ![u, v] = ({u, v} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp [Matrix.range_cons, Matrix.range_empty]
  tauto

name: AclGeom.range_triple
statement:
theorem range_triple (u v w : K) :
    Set.range ![u, v, w] = ({u, v, w} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp [Matrix.range_cons, Matrix.range_empty]
  tauto

name: AclGeom.rankEq_two_points
statement:
theorem rankEq_two_points {z₁ z₂ z₃ u v : K}
    (huv : AlgebraicIndependent k ![u, v])
    (h : racl k ({z₁, z₂, z₃} : Set K) = racl k ({u, v} : Set K)) :
    RankEq 2 (ClosedIF.point k z₁ ⊔
      (ClosedIF.point k z₂ ⊔ ClosedIF.point k z₃))
proof:
:= by
  refine rankEq_of_coe_eq_racl huv ?_
  rw [coe_sup_point₃, range_pair]
  exact h

name: AclGeom.rankEq_three_points
statement:
theorem rankEq_three_points {z₁ z₂ z₃ u v w : K}
    (huvw : AlgebraicIndependent k ![u, v, w])
    (h : racl k ({z₁, z₂, z₃} : Set K) = racl k ({u, v, w} : Set K)) :
    RankEq 3 (ClosedIF.point k z₁ ⊔
      (ClosedIF.point k z₂ ⊔ ClosedIF.point k z₃))
proof:
:= by
  refine rankEq_of_coe_eq_racl huvw ?_
  rw [coe_sup_point₃, range_triple]
  exact h

name: AclGeom.qtable_indep_acb
statement: theorem qtable_indep_acb : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, c, b]
proof:
:= by
  have h := AlgebraicIndependent.comp hind
    (![0, 2, 1] : Fin 3 -> Fin 5) (by decide)
  have heq : (![a, b, c, d, x] ∘ (![0, 2, 1] : Fin 3 -> Fin 5)) =
      ![a, c, b] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  rwa [heq] at h

name: AclGeom.qtable_acb_mem_a
statement: theorem qtable_acb_mem_a : a ∈ racl k ({a, c, b} : Set K)
proof:
:=
  subset_racl k _ (by simp)

name: AclGeom.qtable_acb_mem_c
statement: theorem qtable_acb_mem_c : c ∈ racl k ({a, c, b} : Set K)
proof:
:=
  subset_racl k _ (by simp)

name: AclGeom.qtable_acb_mem_b
statement: theorem qtable_acb_mem_b : b ∈ racl k ({a, c, b} : Set K)
proof:
:=
  subset_racl k _ (by simp)

name: AclGeom.qtable_acb_mem_ac
statement: theorem qtable_acb_mem_ac : a * c ∈ racl k ({a, c, b} : Set K)
proof:
:=
  MulMemClass.mul_mem (qtable_acb_mem_a hind) (qtable_acb_mem_c hind)

name: AclGeom.qtable_acb_mem_acb
statement: theorem qtable_acb_mem_acb : a * c * b ∈ racl k ({a, c, b} : Set K)
proof:
:=
  MulMemClass.mul_mem (qtable_acb_mem_ac hind) (qtable_acb_mem_b hind)

name: AclGeom.qtable_acb_mem_cb
statement: theorem qtable_acb_mem_cb : c * b ∈ racl k ({a, c, b} : Set K)
proof:
:=
  MulMemClass.mul_mem (qtable_acb_mem_c hind) (qtable_acb_mem_b hind)

name: AclGeom.qtable_indep_a_cb
statement: theorem qtable_indep_a_cb : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, c * b]
proof:
:= by
  refine algebraicIndependent_pair ?_ (qtable_cb_notMem_a hind)
  intro hmem
  have hsub : racl k ({c * b} : Set K) <= racl k ({c, b} : Set K) := by
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 ?_)
    have hc : c ∈ racl k ({c, b} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
    have hb : b ∈ racl k ({c, b} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
    exact MulMemClass.mul_mem hc hb
  exact qtable_a_notMem_cb hind (hsub hmem)

name: AclGeom.qtable_indep_ac_b
statement: theorem qtable_indep_ac_b : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a * c, b]
proof:
:= by
  refine algebraicIndependent_pair (qtable_ac_notMem_b hind) ?_
  intro hmem
  have hsub : racl k ({a * c} : Set K) <= racl k ({a, c} : Set K) := by
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 ?_)
    have ha : a ∈ racl k ({a, c} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
    have hc : c ∈ racl k ({a, c} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
    exact MulMemClass.mul_mem ha hc
  exact qtable_b_notMem_ac hind (hsub hmem)

name: AclGeom.qtable_indep_ac
statement: theorem qtable_indep_ac : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, c]
proof:
:= by
  simpa using AlgebraicIndependent.comp_pair hind (i := 0) (j := 2)
    (by decide)

name: AclGeom.qtable_indep_cb
statement: theorem qtable_indep_cb : AlgebraicIndependent k ![c, b]
proof:
:= by
  simpa using AlgebraicIndependent.comp_pair hind (i := 2) (j := 1)
    (by decide)

name: AclGeom.qQuad_rank_dep
statement:
theorem qQuad_rank_dep :
    ∀ s ∈ quadTriples, RankEq 2 (s.sup fun i ↦ ((qQuad hind) i).1)
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  fin_cases hs
  · 
    simp only [Finset.sup_insert, Finset.sup_singleton]
    show RankEq 2 (ClosedIF.point k a ⊔
      (ClosedIF.point k c ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (a * c)))
    refine rankEq_two_points (qtable_indep_ac hind) ?_
    refine racl_congr_of_subset_racl ?_ ?_
    · rintro z (rfl | rfl | rfl)
      · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      · have ha : a ∈ racl k ({a, c} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
        have hc : c ∈ racl k ({a, c} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
        exact MulMemClass.mul_mem ha hc
    · rintro z (rfl | rfl)
      · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
  · 
    simp only [Finset.sup_insert, Finset.sup_singleton]
    show RankEq 2 (ClosedIF.point k a ⊔
      (ClosedIF.point k (a * c * b) ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (c * b)))
    refine rankEq_two_points (qtable_indep_a_cb hind) ?_
    refine racl_congr_of_subset_racl ?_ ?_
    · rintro z (rfl | rfl | rfl)
      · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      · have ha : a ∈ racl k ({a, c * b} : Set K) :=
          subset_racl k _ (by simp)
        have hcb : c * b ∈ racl k ({a, c * b} : Set K) :=
          subset_racl k _ (by simp)
        have h := MulMemClass.mul_mem ha hcb
        rwa [← mul_assoc] at h
      · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
    · rintro z (rfl | rfl)
      · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
  · 
    simp only [Finset.sup_insert, Finset.sup_singleton]
    show RankEq 2 (ClosedIF.point k c ⊔
      (ClosedIF.point k b ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (c * b)))
    refine rankEq_two_points (qtable_indep_cb hind) ?_
    refine racl_congr_of_subset_racl ?_ ?_
    · rintro z (rfl | rfl | rfl)
      · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      · have hc : c ∈ racl k ({c, b} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
        have hb : b ∈ racl k ({c, b} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
        exact MulMemClass.mul_mem hc hb
    · rintro z (rfl | rfl)
      · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
  · 
    simp only [Finset.sup_insert, Finset.sup_singleton]
    show RankEq 2 (ClosedIF.point k (a * c) ⊔
      (ClosedIF.point k b ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (a * c * b)))
    refine rankEq_two_points (qtable_indep_ac_b hind) ?_
    refine racl_congr_of_subset_racl ?_ ?_
    · rintro z (rfl | rfl | rfl)
      · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      · have hac : a * c ∈ racl k ({a * c, b} : Set K) :=
          subset_racl k _ (by simp)
        have hb : b ∈ racl k ({a * c, b} : Set K) :=
          subset_racl k _ (by simp)
        exact MulMemClass.mul_mem hac hb
    · rintro z (rfl | rfl)
      · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)

name: AclGeom.qQuad_rank_free
statement:
theorem qQuad_rank_free :
    ∀ s : Finset (Fin 6), s.card = 3 → s ∉ quadTriples →
      RankEq 3 (s.sup fun i ↦ ((qQuad hind) i).1)
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs3 hsnot
  have hall : ∀ t : Finset (Fin 6), t.card = 3 → t ∉ quadTriples →
      t ∈ ({{0,1,3}, {0,2,3}, {1,2,3}, {0,1,4}, {0,2,4}, {1,2,4}, {0,3,4},
        {1,3,4}, {0,1,5}, {0,2,5}, {1,2,5}, {0,3,5}, {2,3,5}, {1,4,5},
        {2,4,5}, {3,4,5}} : Finset (Finset (Fin 6))) := by decide
  have hmem := hall s hs3 hsnot
  fin_cases hmem
  · 
    simp only [Finset.sup_insert, Finset.sup_singleton]
    show RankEq 3 (ClosedIF.point k (a) ⊔
      (ClosedIF.point k (c) ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (b)))
    refine rankEq_three_points (qtable_indep_acb hind) ?_
    refine racl_congr_of_subset_racl ?_ ?_
    · rintro w (rfl | rfl | rfl)
      · exact qtable_acb_mem_a hind
      · exact qtable_acb_mem_c hind
      · exact qtable_acb_mem_b hind
    · 
      have h0 : a ∈ racl k ({a, c, b} : Set K) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have h1 : c ∈ racl k ({a, c, b} : Set K) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have h3 : b ∈ racl k ({a, c, b} : Set K) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have hA := h0
      have hC := h1
      have hB := h3
      rintro w (rfl | rfl | rfl)
      · exact hA
      · exact hC
      · exact hB
  · 
    simp only [Finset.sup_insert, Finset.sup_singleton]
    show RankEq 3 (ClosedIF.point k (a) ⊔
      (ClosedIF.point k (a * c) ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (b)))
    refine rankEq_three_points (qtable_indep_acb hind) ?_
    refine racl_congr_of_subset_racl ?_ ?_
    · rintro w (rfl | rfl | rfl)
      · exact qtable_acb_mem_a hind
      · exact qtable_acb_mem_ac hind
      · exact qtable_acb_mem_b hind
    · 
      have h0 : a ∈ racl k ({a, a * c, b} : Set K) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have h2 : a * c ∈ racl k ({a, a * c, b} : Set K) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have h3 : b ∈ racl k ({a, a * c, b} : Set K) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have hA := h0
      have hC := mem_of_mul_mem_left h0 (qtable_a_ne_zero hind) h2
      have hB := h3
      rintro w (rfl | rfl | rfl)
      · exact hA
      · exact hC
      · exact hB
  · 
    simp only [Finset.sup_insert, Finset.sup_singleton]
    show RankEq 3 (ClosedIF.point k (c) ⊔
      (ClosedIF.point k (a * c) ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (b)))
    refine rankEq_three_points (qtable_indep_acb hind) ?_
    refine racl_congr_of_subset_racl ?_ ?_
    · rintro w (rfl | rfl | rfl)
      · exact qtable_acb_mem_c hind
      · exact qtable_acb_mem_ac hind
      · exact qtable_acb_mem_b hind
    · 
      have h1 : c ∈ racl k ({c, a * c, b} : Set K) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have h2 : a * c ∈ racl k ({c, a * c, b} : Set K) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have h3 : b ∈ racl k ({c, a * c, b} : Set K) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have hA := mem_of_mul_mem_right h1 (qtable_c_ne_zero hind) h2
      have hC := h1
      have hB := h3
      rintro w (rfl | rfl | rfl)
      · exact hA
      · exact hC
      · exact hB
  · 
    simp only [Finset.sup_insert, Finset.sup_singleton]
    show RankEq 3 (ClosedIF.point k (a) ⊔
      (ClosedIF.point k (c) ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (a * c * b)))
    refine rankEq_three_points (qtable_indep_acb hind) ?_
    refine racl_congr_of_subset_racl ?_ ?_
    · rintro w (rfl | rfl | rfl)
      · exact qtable_acb_mem_a hind
      · exact qtable_acb_mem_c hind
      · exact qtable_acb_mem_acb hind
    · 
      have h0 : a ∈ racl k ({a, c, a * c * b} : Set K) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have h1 : c ∈ racl k ({a, c, a * c * b} : Set K) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have h4 : a * c * b ∈ racl k ({a, c, a * c * b} : Set K) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have hA := h0
      have hC := h1
      have hB := mem_of_mul_mem_left (MulMemClass.mul_mem h0 h1) (mul_ne_zero (qtable_a_ne_zero hind) (qtable_c_ne_zero hind)) h4
      rintro w (rfl | rfl | rfl)
      · exact hA
      · exact hC
      · exact hB
  · 
    simp only [Finset.sup_insert, Finset.sup_singleton]
    show RankEq 3 (ClosedIF.point k (a) ⊔
      (ClosedIF.point k (a * c) ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (a * c * b)))
    refine rankEq_three_points (qtable_indep_acb hind) ?_
    refine racl_congr_of_subset_racl ?_ ?_
    · rintro w (rfl | rfl | rfl)
      · exact qtable_acb_mem_a hind
      · exact qtable_acb_mem_ac hind
      · exact qtable_acb_mem_acb hind
    · 
      have h0 : a ∈ racl k ({a, a * c, a * c * b} : Set K) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have h2 : a * c ∈ racl k ({a, a * c, a * c * b} : Set K) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have h4 : a * c * b ∈ racl k ({a, a * c, a * c * b} : Set K) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have hA := h0
      have hC := mem_of_mul_mem_left h0 (qtable_a_ne_zero hind) h2
      have hB := mem_of_mul_mem_left h2 (mul_ne_zero (qtable_a_ne_zero hind) (qtable_c_ne_zero hind)) h4
      rintro w (rfl | rfl | rfl)
      · exact hA
      · exact hC
      · exact hB
  · 
    simp only [Finset.sup_insert, Finset.sup_singleton]
    show RankEq 3 (ClosedIF.point k (c) ⊔
      (ClosedIF.point k (a * c) ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (a * c * b)))
    refine rankEq_three_points (qtable_indep_acb hind) ?_
    refine racl_congr_of_subset_racl ?_ ?_
    · rintro w (rfl | rfl | rfl)
      · exact qtable_acb_mem_c hind
      · exact qtable_acb_mem_ac hind
      · exact qtable_acb_mem_acb hind
    · 
      have h1 : c ∈ racl k ({c, a * c, a * c * b} : Set K) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have h2 : a * c ∈ racl k ({c, a * c, a * c * b} : Set K) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have h4 : a * c * b ∈ racl k ({c, a * c, a * c * b} : Set K) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have hA := mem_of_mul_mem_right h1 (qtable_c_ne_zero hind) h2
      have hC := h1
      have hB := mem_of_mul_mem_left h2 (mul_ne_zero (qtable_a_ne_zero hind) (qtable_c_ne_zero hind)) h4
      rintro w (rfl | rfl | rfl)
      · exact hA
      · exact hC
      · exact hB
  · 
    simp only [Finset.sup_insert, Finset.sup_singleton]
    show RankEq 3 (ClosedIF.point k (a) ⊔
      (ClosedIF.point k (b) ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (a * c * b)))
    refine rankEq_three_points (qtable_indep_acb hind) ?_
    refine racl_congr_of_subset_racl ?_ ?_
    · rintro w (rfl | rfl | rfl)
      · exact qtable_acb_mem_a hind
      · exact qtable_acb_mem_b hind
      · exact qtable_acb_mem_acb hind
    · 
      have h0 : a ∈ racl k ({a, b, a * c * b} : Set K) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have h3 : b ∈ racl k ({a, b, a * c * b} : Set K) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have h4 : a * c * b ∈ racl k ({a, b, a * c * b} : Set K) :=
        subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have hA := h0
      have hac := mem_of_mul_mem_right h3 (qtable_b_ne_zero hind) h4

name: AclGeom.qQuad_rank_total
statement:
theorem qQuad_rank_total :
    RankEq 3 (Finset.univ.sup fun i ↦ ((qQuad hind) i).1)
proof:
:= by
  refine rankEq_of_coe_eq_racl (qtable_indep_acb hind) ?_
  rw [range_triple]
  refine ClosedIF.coe_eq_racl_of_le ?_ ?_
  · refine Finset.sup_le ?_
    intro i _
    fin_cases i
    · exact ClosedIF.point_le_iff.2 (qtable_acb_mem_a hind)
    · exact ClosedIF.point_le_iff.2 (qtable_acb_mem_c hind)
    · exact ClosedIF.point_le_iff.2 (qtable_acb_mem_ac hind)
    · exact ClosedIF.point_le_iff.2 (qtable_acb_mem_b hind)
    · exact ClosedIF.point_le_iff.2 (qtable_acb_mem_acb hind)
    · exact ClosedIF.point_le_iff.2 (qtable_acb_mem_cb hind)
  · rintro w (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    · have hle : ((qQuad hind) 0).1 ≤
          Finset.univ.sup fun i ↦ ((qQuad hind) i).1 :=
        Finset.le_sup (f := fun i ↦ ((qQuad hind) i).1)
          (Finset.mem_univ (0 : Fin 6))
      exact (ClosedIF.le_iff.1 hle) (ClosedIF.mem_point_self w)
    · have hle : ((qQuad hind) 1).1 ≤
          Finset.univ.sup fun i ↦ ((qQuad hind) i).1 :=
        Finset.le_sup (f := fun i ↦ ((qQuad hind) i).1)
          (Finset.mem_univ (1 : Fin 6))
      exact (ClosedIF.le_iff.1 hle) (ClosedIF.mem_point_self w)
    · have hle : ((qQuad hind) 3).1 ≤
          Finset.univ.sup fun i ↦ ((qQuad hind) i).1 :=
        Finset.le_sup (f := fun i ↦ ((qQuad hind) i).1)
          (Finset.mem_univ (3 : Fin 6))
      exact (ClosedIF.le_iff.1 hle) (ClosedIF.mem_point_self w)

name: AclGeom.qQuad_isPartialQuadrangle
statement: theorem qQuad_isPartialQuadrangle : IsPartialQuadrangle (qQuad hind)
proof:
:=
  ⟨qQuad_injective hind, qQuad_rank_dep hind, qQuad_rank_free hind,
    qQuad_rank_total hind⟩

name: AclGeom.qWitness_quad
statement:
theorem qWitness_quad :
    ∃ S' T' U' : Point k K,
      IsPartialQuadrangle
        ![(qWitness hind).S, (qWitness hind).T, (qWitness hind).U,
          S', T', U']
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Point.mk' k b (qtable_b_notMem_bot hind),
    Point.mk' k (a * c * b) (qtable_acb_notMem_bot hind),
    Point.mk' k (c * b) (qtable_mul_cb_notMem_bot hind), ?_⟩
  have heq : ![(qWitness hind).S, (qWitness hind).T, (qWitness hind).U,
      Point.mk' k b (qtable_b_notMem_bot hind),
      Point.mk' k (a * c * b) (qtable_acb_notMem_bot hind),
      Point.mk' k (c * b) (qtable_mul_cb_notMem_bot hind)] = qQuad hind := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  rw [heq]
  exact qQuad_isPartialQuadrangle hind

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightA_comp_bGermCoefficient
statement:
theorem selectedGraphRightSourceToRightA_comp_bGermCoefficient
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :
    (R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightARingEquiv L hind).toRingHom.comp
        (R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom L hind) =
      R.bGermCoefficientToRightASourceRingHom L hind
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro x
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply,
    R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom_apply]
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (R.rightACommonSourceClosureTransport hind).closureEquiv
      (algebraMap (↥R.semanticCommonSourceField)
        (AlgebraicClosure (↥R.semanticCommonSourceField))
        (R.seBGermCoefficientToSemanticSourceAlgHom L hind x)) =
    algebraMap (↥R.semanticCommonSourceField)
      (AlgebraicClosure (↥R.semanticCommonSourceField))
      (R.sAaBGermCoefficientToSemanticSourceAlgHom L hind x)
  rw [AlgebraicClosureTransport.commutes_apply]
  exact congrArg
    (algebraMap (↥R.semanticCommonSourceField)
      (AlgebraicClosure (↥R.semanticCommonSourceField)))
    (R.commonSourceRightAAut_comp_seBGermCoefficient L hind x)

proof:

  have hx := DFunLike.congr_fun
    (R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightA_comp_bGermCoefficient L hind) x
  change R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightARingEquiv L hind
      (R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom L hind x) =
    R.bGermCoefficientToRightASourceRingHom L hind x at hx

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.semilinearStablePullbackSourceChart_comp
statement:
theorem semilinearStablePullbackSourceChart_comp
    {X W : Type u} [Field X] [Semiring W]
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b))
    (sourceChart : X ≃+*
      (↥(R.selectedGraphRightSourceCover L hind).field))
    (σ :
      (↥(R.selectedGraphRightSourceCover L hind).field)
        ≃ₐ[stableTriangleSemanticSourceType R]
        (↥(R.selectedGraphRightSourceCover L hind).field))
    (gX : W →+* X)
    (gN : W →+* (↥(R.selectedGraphRightSourceCover L hind).field))
    (h : sourceChart.toRingHom.comp gX = gN) :
    ((FieldEquiv.CompositionTriangle.commonSourcePullbackChart sourceChart
        (R.rightSemilinearStableSourceField L hind)).trans
      (R.semilinearStableSourceChartAut L hind σ).toRingEquiv).toRingHom.comp
        ((algebraMap X
          (↥(FieldEquiv.CompositionTriangle.commonSourcePullbackField
            sourceChart (R.rightSemilinearStableSourceField L hind)))).comp gX) =
      (R.selectedGraphRightSourceToSemilinearStableSource L hind).toRingHom.comp
        (σ.toRingHom.comp gN)
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro z
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
  calc
    R.semilinearStableSourceChartAut L hind σ
        (FieldEquiv.CompositionTriangle.commonSourcePullbackChart sourceChart
          (R.rightSemilinearStableSourceField L hind)
          (algebraMap X
            (↥(FieldEquiv.CompositionTriangle.commonSourcePullbackField
              sourceChart (R.rightSemilinearStableSourceField L hind)))
            (gX z))) =
      R.semilinearStableSourceChartAut L hind σ
        (algebraMap _ _ (sourceChart (gX z))) :=
          congrArg (R.semilinearStableSourceChartAut L hind σ)
            (FieldEquiv.CompositionTriangle.commonSourcePullbackChart_algebraMap
              sourceChart (R.rightSemilinearStableSourceField L hind) (gX z))
    _ = R.selectedGraphRightSourceToSemilinearStableSource L hind
        (σ (sourceChart (gX z))) :=
      R.semilinearStableSourceChartAut_apply L hind σ (sourceChart (gX z))
    _ = R.selectedGraphRightSourceToSemilinearStableSource L hind
        (σ (gN z)) :=
      congrArg
        (fun y ↦ R.selectedGraphRightSourceToSemilinearStableSource L hind
          (σ y))
        (DFunLike.congr_fun h z)

name: AclGeom.idealOf_sumElim_eq_comap_partialAeval
statement:
private theorem idealOf_sumElim_eq_comap_partialAeval {m n : ℕ} (E : IntermediateField k K)
    (c : Fin m → ↥E) (x : Fin n → K) :

name: AclGeom.QWitness.coefficientClosure_eq
statement:
private theorem coefficientClosure_eq {A : ClosedIF k K}
    (E : IntermediateField k K) (hEA : E ≤ A.1)
    (P : FiniteCorrespondencePair ↥E K) (hRank : RankEq 2 A)
    (hfree : ∀ R : Point k K, R.1 ≤ A →
      ¬ ClosedIF.point k P.target ≤ R.1 ⊔ ClosedIF.point k P.source) :
    racl k (P.curveCoefficientSet k E) = A.1
proof:
:= by
  let C : ClosedIF k K :=
    ⟨racl k (P.curveCoefficientSet k E), isRAC_racl _⟩
  have hCA : C ≤ A := by
    change racl k (P.curveCoefficientSet k E) ≤ A.1
    calc
      racl k (P.curveCoefficientSet k E) ≤ racl k (A : Set K) := by
        apply racl_mono
        rintro _ ⟨d, rfl⟩
        exact hEA (P.curveEquation.coeff d).2
      _ = A.1 := isRAC_iff_racl_eq.mp A.2
  have hEq : C = A := RankEq.eq_of_le_of_not_le_point hCA hRank fun R hRA hCR ↦ by
    apply hfree R hRA
    apply ClosedIF.point_le_iff.mpr
    apply ClosedIF.mem_sup_iff.mpr
    have hmem : P.target ∈ racl k (P.curveCoefficientSet k E ∪ {P.source}) :=
      mem_racl_adjoin_base_iff.mp (P.target_mem_racl_curveCoefficientField_source k E)
    apply racl_mono (Set.union_subset_union ?_ ?_) hmem
    · exact fun z hz ↦ hCR (subset_racl k _ hz)
    · exact Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr (ClosedIF.mem_point_self P.source)
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hEq

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.exists_incidence_germs_with_full_coefficients
statement:
theorem Psi.exists_incidence_germs_with_full_coefficients (hw : w.Psi) :
    ∃ (P_A : FiniteCorrespondencePair
        ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep}) K)
      (P_B : FiniteCorrespondencePair
        ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep}) K)
      (P_C : FiniteCorrespondencePair
        ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep}) K),
      P_A.source = w.Y.rep ∧ P_A.target = w.X.rep ∧
      P_B.source = w.Y.rep ∧ P_B.target = w.Z.rep ∧
      P_C.source = w.X.rep ∧ P_C.target = w.Z.rep ∧
      racl k (P_A.curveCoefficientSet k
        (IntermediateField.adjoin k {w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep})) = w.A.1 ∧
      racl k (P_B.curveCoefficientSet k
        (IntermediateField.adjoin k {w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep})) = w.B.1 ∧
      racl k (P_C.curveCoefficientSet k
        (IntermediateField.adjoin k {w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep})) = w.C.1
proof:
:= by
  have hA : racl k {w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep} = w.A.1 := by
    rw [← coe_sup_point₂, w.A₁.point_rep, w.A₂.point_rep]
    rfl
  have hB : racl k {w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep} = w.B.1 := by
    rw [← coe_sup_point₂, w.B₁.point_rep, w.B₂.point_rep]
    rfl
  have hC : racl k {w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep} = w.C.1 := by
    rw [← coe_sup_point₂, w.C₁.point_rep, w.C₂.point_rep]
    rfl
  have hYnA : ¬ w.Y.1 ≤ w.A := fun h ↦
    hw.Y_notLe (h.trans (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left))
  have hYnB : ¬ w.Y.1 ≤ w.B := fun h ↦
    hw.Y_notLe (h.trans (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left))
  have hXnC : ¬ w.X.1 ≤ w.C := fun h ↦ hw.X_notLe (h.trans le_sup_right)
  have hXnA : ¬ w.X.1 ≤ w.A := fun h ↦
    hw.X_notLe (h.trans (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left))
  have hZnB : ¬ w.Z.1 ≤ w.B := fun h ↦
    hw.Z_notLe (h.trans (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left))
  have hZnC : ¬ w.Z.1 ≤ w.C := fun h ↦ hw.Z_notLe (h.trans le_sup_right)
  let P_A := incidencePair hA w.Y w.X hYnA hXnA hw.X_le
  let P_B := incidencePair hB w.Y w.Z hYnB hZnB (hw.Z_le.trans inf_le_left)
  let P_C := incidencePair hC w.X w.Z hXnC hZnC (hw.Z_le.trans inf_le_right)
  refine ⟨P_A, P_B, P_C, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply coefficientClosure_eq _
      ((adjoin_le_racl k _).trans_eq hA) P_A (Psi.rankEq_A hw)
    intro R hRA
    change ¬ ClosedIF.point k w.X.rep ≤ R.1 ⊔ ClosedIF.point k w.Y.rep
    simpa only [Point.point_rep] using hw.X_free R hRA
  · apply coefficientClosure_eq _
      ((adjoin_le_racl k _).trans_eq hB) P_B (Psi.rankEq_B hw)
    intro R hRB
    change ¬ ClosedIF.point k w.Z.rep ≤ R.1 ⊔ ClosedIF.point k w.Y.rep
    simpa only [Point.point_rep] using hw.Z_freeB R hRB
  · apply coefficientClosure_eq _
      ((adjoin_le_racl k _).trans_eq hC) P_C (Psi.rankEq_C hw)
    intro R hRC
    change ¬ ClosedIF.point k w.Z.rep ≤ R.1 ⊔ ClosedIF.point k w.X.rep
    simpa only [Point.point_rep] using hw.Z_freeC R hRC

name: AclGeom.QWitness.closed_isAlgClosed
statement:
private theorem closed_isAlgClosed [IsAlgClosed K] (E : ClosedIF k K) :
    IsAlgClosed ↥E.1
proof:
:= by
  apply (IsAlgClosed.algebraicClosure_eq_bot_iff ↥E.1 K).mp
  apply bot_unique
  intro x hx
  exact IntermediateField.mem_bot.mpr
    ⟨⟨x, E.2 x (mem_algebraicClosure_iff.mp hx)⟩, rfl⟩

name: AclGeom.QWitness.exists_closed_incidencePair
statement:
private theorem exists_closed_incidencePair (A : ClosedIF k K) (Q P : Point k K)
    (hQ : ¬ Q.1 ≤ A) (hP : ¬ P.1 ≤ A) (hPQ : P.1 ≤ A ⊔ Q.1) :
    ∃ T : FiniteCorrespondencePair ↥A.1 K,
      T.source = Q.rep ∧ T.target = P.rep
proof:
:= by
  let Result (E : IntermediateField k K) : Prop :=
    ∃ T : FiniteCorrespondencePair ↥E K, T.source = Q.rep ∧ T.target = P.rep
  have hresult : Result (IntermediateField.adjoin k (A.1 : Set K)) :=
    ⟨incidencePair (isRAC_iff_racl_eq.mp A.2) Q P hQ hP hPQ, rfl, rfl⟩
  have hfinal : Result A.1 := (IntermediateField.adjoin_self k A.1) ▸ hresult
  exact hfinal

name: AclGeom.QWitness.curveCoefficientSet_eq_of_baseChange
statement:
private theorem curveCoefficientSet_eq_of_baseChange
    (E F : IntermediateField k K) (hEF : E ≤ F) [IsAlgClosed ↥E]
    (P : FiniteCorrespondencePair ↥E K)
    (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair ↥F K)
    (hs : P.source = Q.source) (ht : P.target = Q.target) :
    P.curveCoefficientSet k E = Q.curveCoefficientSet k F
proof:
:= by
  have hspan : Q.ideal =
      Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.map
        (IntermediateField.inclusion hEF).toRingHom P.curveEquation} := by
    have h := idealOf_map_eq_span (k := ↥E)
      (K := IntermediateField.extendScalars hEF)
      (u := Q.source) (v := Q.target)
      Q.source_transcendental'
      (by simpa only [hs, ht] using P.target_mem_source)
      Q.swap.source_transcendental'
      (by simpa only [hs, ht] using P.source_mem_target)
      P.curveEquation_prime.ne_zero
      (by simpa only [FiniteCorrespondencePair.ideal, hs, ht]
        using P.ideal_eq_span_curveEquation)
    exact h
  have hmonic : MonomialOrder.lex.Monic
      (MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion hEF).toRingHom P.curveEquation) := by
    have hsupport :=
      MvPolynomial.support_map_of_injective P.curveEquation
        (IntermediateField.inclusion hEF).injective
    rw [MonomialOrder.Monic, MonomialOrder.leadingCoeff,
      MonomialOrder.degree, hsupport, MvPolynomial.coeff_map]
    change (IntermediateField.inclusion hEF)
      (MonomialOrder.lex.leadingCoeff P.curveEquation) = 1
    rw [P.curveEquation_monic.leadingCoeff_eq_one, map_one]
  have heq : MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion hEF).toRingHom P.curveEquation =
      Q.curveEquation := by
    apply FiniteCorrespondencePair.eq_of_monic_of_associated hmonic Q.curveEquation_monic
    rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton]
    exact hspan.symm.trans Q.ideal_eq_span_curveEquation
  unfold FiniteCorrespondencePair.curveCoefficientSet
  apply congrArg Set.range
  funext d
  rw [← heq, MvPolynomial.coeff_map]
  rfl

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.exists_composing_closed_incidence_germs
statement:
theorem Psi.exists_composing_closed_incidence_germs [IsAlgClosed K] (hw : w.Psi) :
    ∃ (P_A P_B P_C : FiniteCorrespondencePair ↥(w.A ⊔ w.B).1 K),
      P_A.source = w.Y.rep ∧ P_A.target = w.X.rep ∧
      P_B.source = w.Y.rep ∧ P_B.target = w.Z.rep ∧
      P_C.source = w.X.rep ∧ P_C.target = w.Z.rep ∧
      racl k (P_A.curveCoefficientSet k (w.A ⊔ w.B).1) = w.A.1 ∧
      racl k (P_B.curveCoefficientSet k (w.A ⊔ w.B).1) = w.B.1 ∧
      racl k (P_C.curveCoefficientSet k (w.A ⊔ w.B).1) = w.C.1 ∧
      FiniteCorrespondenceGerm.Composes
        (FiniteCorrespondenceGerm.ofPair P_A.swap)
        (FiniteCorrespondenceGerm.ofPair P_B)
        (FiniteCorrespondenceGerm.ofPair P_C)
proof:
:= by
  let F : ClosedIF k K := w.A ⊔ w.B
  have hCF : w.C ≤ F := by
    have h := RankEq.eq_of_le le_sup_left hw.rank_AB hw.rank_ABC
    change w.C ≤ w.A ⊔ w.B
    rw [h]
    exact le_sup_right
  have hXF : ¬ w.X.1 ≤ F := fun h ↦ hw.X_notLe (h.trans le_sup_left)
  have hYF : ¬ w.Y.1 ≤ F := fun h ↦ hw.Y_notLe (h.trans le_sup_left)
  have hZF : ¬ w.Z.1 ≤ F := fun h ↦ hw.Z_notLe (h.trans le_sup_left)
  have hYA : ¬ w.Y.1 ≤ w.A := fun h ↦ hYF (h.trans le_sup_left)
  have hXA : ¬ w.X.1 ≤ w.A := fun h ↦ hXF (h.trans le_sup_left)
  have hYB : ¬ w.Y.1 ≤ w.B := fun h ↦ hYF (h.trans le_sup_right)
  have hZB : ¬ w.Z.1 ≤ w.B := fun h ↦ hZF (h.trans le_sup_right)
  have hXC : ¬ w.X.1 ≤ w.C := fun h ↦ hXF (h.trans hCF)
  have hZC : ¬ w.Z.1 ≤ w.C := fun h ↦ hZF (h.trans hCF)
  obtain ⟨P_A, hPAS, hPAT⟩ := exists_closed_incidencePair w.A
    w.Y w.X hYA hXA hw.X_le
  obtain ⟨P_B, hPBS, hPBT⟩ := exists_closed_incidencePair w.B
    w.Y w.Z hYB hZB (hw.Z_le.trans inf_le_left)
  obtain ⟨P_C, hPCS, hPCT⟩ := exists_closed_incidencePair w.C
    w.X w.Z hXC hZC (hw.Z_le.trans inf_le_right)
  obtain ⟨Q_A, hQAS, hQAT⟩ := exists_closed_incidencePair F
    w.Y w.X hYF hXF (hw.X_le.trans (sup_le_sup le_sup_left le_rfl))
  obtain ⟨Q_B, hQBS, hQBT⟩ := exists_closed_incidencePair F
    w.Y w.Z hYF hZF
      ((hw.Z_le.trans inf_le_left).trans (sup_le_sup le_sup_right le_rfl))
  obtain ⟨Q_C, hQCS, hQCT⟩ := exists_closed_incidencePair F
    w.X w.Z hXF hZF
      ((hw.Z_le.trans inf_le_right).trans (sup_le_sup hCF le_rfl))
  have : IsAlgClosed ↥w.A.1 := closed_isAlgClosed w.A
  have : IsAlgClosed ↥w.B.1 := closed_isAlgClosed w.B
  have : IsAlgClosed ↥w.C.1 := closed_isAlgClosed w.C
  have hcoeffA := curveCoefficientSet_eq_of_baseChange w.A.1 F.1
    (show w.A.1 ≤ F.1 from (le_sup_left : w.A ≤ F)) P_A Q_A
      (hPAS.trans hQAS.symm) (hPAT.trans hQAT.symm)
  have hcoeffB := curveCoefficientSet_eq_of_baseChange w.B.1 F.1
    (show w.B.1 ≤ F.1 from (le_sup_right : w.B ≤ F)) P_B Q_B
      (hPBS.trans hQBS.symm) (hPBT.trans hQBT.symm)
  have hcoeffC := curveCoefficientSet_eq_of_baseChange w.C.1 F.1
    (show w.C.1 ≤ F.1 from hCF) P_C Q_C
      (hPCS.trans hQCS.symm) (hPCT.trans hQCT.symm)
  have hA : racl k (Q_A.curveCoefficientSet k F.1) = w.A.1 := by
    rw [← hcoeffA]
    apply coefficientClosure_eq w.A.1 le_rfl P_A (Psi.rankEq_A hw)
    intro R hRA
    simpa only [hPAS, hPAT, Point.point_rep] using hw.X_free R hRA
  have hB : racl k (Q_B.curveCoefficientSet k F.1) = w.B.1 := by
    rw [← hcoeffB]
    apply coefficientClosure_eq w.B.1 le_rfl P_B (Psi.rankEq_B hw)
    intro R hRB
    simpa only [hPBS, hPBT, Point.point_rep] using hw.Z_freeB R hRB
  have hC : racl k (Q_C.curveCoefficientSet k F.1) = w.C.1 := by
    rw [← hcoeffC]
    apply coefficientClosure_eq w.C.1 le_rfl P_C (Psi.rankEq_C hw)
    intro R hRC
    simpa only [hPCS, hPCT, Point.point_rep] using hw.Z_freeC R hRC
  refine ⟨Q_A, Q_B, Q_C, hQAS, hQAT, hQBS, hQBT, hQCS, hQCT, hA, hB, hC, ?_⟩
  have hshared : Q_A.swap.target = Q_B.source := by
    change Q_A.source = Q_B.source
    exact hQAS.trans hQBS.symm
  refine ⟨Q_A.swap, Q_B, hshared, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  change idealOf ↥F.1 ![Q_C.source, Q_C.target] =
    idealOf ↥F.1 ![Q_A.target, Q_B.target]
  rw [hQCS, hQCT, hQAT, hQBT]

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.exists_literal_composing_incidence_germs
statement:
theorem Psi.exists_literal_composing_incidence_germs (hw : w.Psi) :
    ∃ (G_A G_B : FiniteCorrespondencePair ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k
        {w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep, w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep}) K)
      (hAB : G_A.swap.target = G_B.source)
      (L_A : FiniteCorrespondencePair ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep}) K)
      (L_B : FiniteCorrespondencePair ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep}) K)
      (L_C : FiniteCorrespondencePair ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep}) K),
      G_A.source = w.Y.rep ∧ G_A.target = w.X.rep ∧ G_B.target = w.Z.rep ∧
      L_A.source = w.Y.rep ∧ L_A.target = w.X.rep ∧
      L_B.source = w.Y.rep ∧ L_B.target = w.Z.rep ∧
      L_C.source = w.X.rep ∧ L_C.target = w.Z.rep ∧
      racl k (L_A.curveCoefficientSet k
        (IntermediateField.adjoin k {w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep})) = w.A.1 ∧
      racl k (L_B.curveCoefficientSet k
        (IntermediateField.adjoin k {w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep})) = w.B.1 ∧
      racl k (L_C.curveCoefficientSet k
        (IntermediateField.adjoin k {w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep})) = w.C.1 ∧
      (G_A.swap.comp G_B hAB).ideal ∈ Ideal.minimalPrimes (L_C.ideal.map (MvPolynomial.map
        (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k {w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep}
          {w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep, w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep}
          (by exact (Set.subset_insert _ _).trans <| (Set.subset_insert _ _).trans <|
                (Set.subset_insert _ _).trans <| Set.subset_insert _ _)) : _ →+* _))) ∧
      G_A.ideal ∈ Ideal.minimalPrimes (L_A.ideal.map (MvPolynomial.map
        (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k {w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep}
          {w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep, w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep}
          (by exact Set.insert_subset (Set.mem_insert _ _)
                (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert _ _))))) :
            _ →+* _))) ∧
      G_B.ideal ∈ Ideal.minimalPrimes (L_B.ideal.map (MvPolynomial.map
        (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k {w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep}
          {w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep, w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep}
          (by exact Set.insert_subset
                (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)))
                (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _
                  (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert _ _))))))) : _ →+* _)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L_A, L_B, L_C, hLAS, hLAT, hLBS, hLBT, hLCS, hLCT, hcA, hcB, hcC⟩ :=
    Psi.exists_incidence_germs_with_full_coefficients hw
  have hCF : w.C ≤ w.A ⊔ w.B := by
    have h := RankEq.eq_of_le le_sup_left hw.rank_AB hw.rank_ABC
    rw [h]
    exact le_sup_right
  
  have hspan : racl k {w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep, w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep} =
      (w.A ⊔ w.B).1 := by
    have hmem (P : Point k K) (hP : P.1 ≤ w.A ⊔ w.B) : P.rep ∈ (w.A ⊔ w.B).1 :=
      ClosedIF.le_iff.1 hP P.mem_rep
    have hA : w.A ≤ w.A ⊔ w.B := le_sup_left
    have hB : w.B ≤ w.A ⊔ w.B := le_sup_right
    refine le_antisymm ((racl_mono ?_).trans_eq (isRAC_iff_racl_eq.mp (w.A ⊔ w.B).2)) ?_
    · rintro _ (rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl)
      · exact hmem w.A₁ (le_sup_left.trans hA)
      · exact hmem w.A₂ (le_sup_right.trans hA)
      · exact hmem w.B₁ (le_sup_left.trans hB)
      · exact hmem w.B₂ (le_sup_right.trans hB)
      · exact hmem w.C₁ (le_sup_left.trans hCF)
      · exact hmem w.C₂ (le_sup_right.trans hCF)
    · have hpt (P : Point k K)
          (hP : P.rep ∈ racl k {w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep, w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep}) :
          P.1 ≤ ⟨racl k {w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep, w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep},
            isRAC_racl _⟩ := by
        rw [← P.point_rep]
        exact ClosedIF.point_le_iff.2 hP
      have hle : w.A ⊔ w.B ≤ ⟨racl k {w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep, w.C₁.rep,
          w.C₂.rep}, isRAC_racl _⟩ :=
        sup_le (sup_le (hpt w.A₁ (subset_racl k _ (by simp)))
            (hpt w.A₂ (subset_racl k _ (by simp))))
          (sup_le (hpt w.B₁ (subset_racl k _ (by simp)))
            (hpt w.B₂ (subset_racl k _ (by simp))))
      exact ClosedIF.le_iff.1 hle
  
  have hXF : ¬ w.X.1 ≤ w.A ⊔ w.B := fun h ↦ hw.X_notLe (h.trans le_sup_left)
  have hYF : ¬ w.Y.1 ≤ w.A ⊔ w.B := fun h ↦ hw.Y_notLe (h.trans le_sup_left)
  have hZF : ¬ w.Z.1 ≤ w.A ⊔ w.B := fun h ↦ hw.Z_notLe (h.trans le_sup_left)
  let G_A := incidencePair hspan w.Y w.X hYF hXF
    (hw.X_le.trans (sup_le_sup le_sup_left le_rfl))
  let G_B := incidencePair hspan w.Y w.Z hYF hZF
    ((hw.Z_le.trans inf_le_left).trans (sup_le_sup le_sup_right le_rfl))
  let G_C := incidencePair hspan w.X w.Z hXF hZF
    ((hw.Z_le.trans inf_le_right).trans (sup_le_sup hCF le_rfl))
  have hcomp : G_A.swap.comp G_B rfl = G_C := rfl
  refine ⟨G_A, G_B, rfl, L_A, L_B, L_C, rfl, rfl, rfl, hLAS, hLAT, hLBS, hLBT, hLCS, hLCT,
    hcA, hcB, hcC, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hcomp]
    exact FiniteCorrespondencePair.ideal_mem_minimalPrimes_baseChange _ L_C G_C hLCS hLCT
  · exact FiniteCorrespondencePair.ideal_mem_minimalPrimes_baseChange _ L_A G_A hLAS hLAT
  · exact FiniteCorrespondencePair.ideal_mem_minimalPrimes_baseChange _ L_B G_B hLBS hLBT

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.literal_family_branches_are_conjugates
statement:
theorem Psi.literal_family_branches_are_conjugates [IsAlgClosed K] (hw : w.Psi) :
    (∀ J ∈ Ideal.minimalPrimes ((idealOf ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep})
        ![w.Y.rep, w.X.rep]).map (MvPolynomial.map
        (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k {w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep}
          {w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep, w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep}
          (by exact Set.insert_subset (Set.mem_insert _ _)
                (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert _ _))))) :
            _ →+* _))),
      ∃ (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k
          {w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep, w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep}) K)
        (σ : K ≃ₐ[↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep})] K),
        Q.ideal = J ∧ Q.source = σ w.Y.rep ∧ Q.target = σ w.X.rep) ∧
    (∀ J ∈ Ideal.minimalPrimes ((idealOf ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep})
        ![w.Y.rep, w.Z.rep]).map (MvPolynomial.map
        (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k {w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep}
          {w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep, w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep}
          (by exact Set.insert_subset
                (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)))
                (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _
                  (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert _ _))))))) : _ →+* _))),
      ∃ (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k
          {w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep, w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep}) K)
        (σ : K ≃ₐ[↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep})] K),
        Q.ideal = J ∧ Q.source = σ w.Y.rep ∧ Q.target = σ w.Z.rep) ∧
    (∀ J ∈ Ideal.minimalPrimes ((idealOf ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep})
        ![w.X.rep, w.Z.rep]).map (MvPolynomial.map
        (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k {w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep}
          {w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep, w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep}
          (by exact (Set.subset_insert _ _).trans <| (Set.subset_insert _ _).trans <|
                (Set.subset_insert _ _).trans <| Set.subset_insert _ _)) : _ →+* _))),
      ∃ (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k
          {w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep, w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep}) K)
        (σ : K ≃ₐ[↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep})] K),
        Q.ideal = J ∧ Q.source = σ w.X.rep ∧ Q.target = σ w.Z.rep)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G_A, -, -, L_A, L_B, L_C, -, -, -, hLAS, hLAT, hLBS, hLBT, hLCS, hLCT, -, -, -, -, -,
    -⟩ := Psi.exists_literal_composing_incidence_germs hw
  refine ⟨fun J hJ ↦ ?_, fun J hJ ↦ ?_, fun J hJ ↦ ?_⟩
  · have hL : L_A.ideal = idealOf _ ![w.Y.rep, w.X.rep] := by
      change idealOf _ ![L_A.source, L_A.target] = _
      rw [hLAS, hLAT]
    obtain ⟨Q, σ, hQ, hQs, hQt⟩ :=
      FiniteCorrespondencePair.exists_conjugate_of_mem_minimalPrimes_baseChange _ L_A
        G_A.source_generic (hL ▸ hJ)
    exact ⟨Q, σ, hQ, hQs.trans (by rw [hLAS]), hQt.trans (by rw [hLAT])⟩
  · have hL : L_B.ideal = idealOf _ ![w.Y.rep, w.Z.rep] := by
      change idealOf _ ![L_B.source, L_B.target] = _
      rw [hLBS, hLBT]
    obtain ⟨Q, σ, hQ, hQs, hQt⟩ :=
      FiniteCorrespondencePair.exists_conjugate_of_mem_minimalPrimes_baseChange _ L_B
        G_A.source_generic (hL ▸ hJ)
    exact ⟨Q, σ, hQ, hQs.trans (by rw [hLBS]), hQt.trans (by rw [hLBT])⟩
  · have hL : L_C.ideal = idealOf _ ![w.X.rep, w.Z.rep] := by
      change idealOf _ ![L_C.source, L_C.target] = _
      rw [hLCS, hLCT]
    obtain ⟨Q, σ, hQ, hQs, hQt⟩ :=
      FiniteCorrespondencePair.exists_conjugate_of_mem_minimalPrimes_baseChange _ L_C
        G_A.source_generic (hL ▸ hJ)
    exact ⟨Q, σ, hQ, hQs.trans (by rw [hLCS]), hQt.trans (by rw [hLCT])⟩

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.literal_composite_locus_eq_comap
statement:
theorem Psi.literal_composite_locus_eq_comap (hw : w.Psi) :
    ∃ (G_A G_B : FiniteCorrespondencePair ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k
        {w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep, w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep}) K)
      (hAB : G_A.swap.target = G_B.source),
      G_A.target = w.X.rep ∧ G_B.target = w.Z.rep ∧
      (G_A.swap.comp G_B hAB).ideal ∈ Ideal.minimalPrimes
        ((idealOf ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep}) ![w.X.rep, w.Z.rep]).map
          (MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k
            {w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep} {w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep, w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep}
            (by exact (Set.subset_insert _ _).trans <| (Set.subset_insert _ _).trans <|
                (Set.subset_insert _ _).trans <| Set.subset_insert _ _)) : _ →+* _))) ∧
      idealOf k (Sum.elim
          (Sum.elim ![w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep] ![w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep])
          ![w.X.rep, w.Z.rep]) =
        (G_A.swap.comp G_B hAB).ideal.comap ((partialAeval (Ω := K)
          (IntermediateField.adjoin k
            {w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep, w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep})
          ![⟨w.A₁.rep, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩,
            ⟨w.A₂.rep, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩,
            ⟨w.B₁.rep, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩,
            ⟨w.B₂.rep, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩,
            ⟨w.C₁.rep, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩,
            ⟨w.C₂.rep, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩]).comp
            (MvPolynomial.rename (Sum.map (finSumFinEquiv : (Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 2) ≃ Fin 6) id))) ∧
      idealOf k (Sum.elim ![w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep] ![w.X.rep, w.Z.rep]) =
        (idealOf ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep}) ![w.X.rep, w.Z.rep]).comap
          (partialAeval (Ω := K) (IntermediateField.adjoin k {w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep})
            ![⟨w.C₁.rep, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩,
              ⟨w.C₂.rep, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩])
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G_A, G_B, hAB, -, -, L_C, -, hGAT, hGBT, -, -, -, -, hLCS, hLCT, -, -, -, hC, -,
    -⟩ := Psi.exists_literal_composing_incidence_germs hw
  have hL : L_C.ideal = idealOf _ ![w.X.rep, w.Z.rep] := by
    change idealOf _ ![L_C.source, L_C.target] = _
    rw [hLCS, hLCT]
  have hcomp : (G_A.swap.comp G_B hAB).ideal = idealOf _ ![w.X.rep, w.Z.rep] := by
    change idealOf _ ![G_A.target, G_B.target] = _
    rw [hGAT, hGBT]
  refine ⟨G_A, G_B, hAB, hGAT, hGBT, hL ▸ hC, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hcomp, ← Ideal.comap_comapₐ, ← idealOf_sumElim_eq_comap_partialAeval]
    apply idealOf_eq_comap_rename
    funext i
    rcases i with (i | i) | i <;> fin_cases i <;> rfl
  · rw [← idealOf_sumElim_eq_comap_partialAeval]
    congr 1
    funext i
    rcases i with i | i <;> fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: AclGeom.rankEq_two_sup_of_ne
statement: private theorem rankEq_two_sup_of_ne {P Q : Point k K} (hPQ : P ≠ Q) : RankEq 2 (P.1 ⊔ Q.1)
proof:
:= by
  have hle (A B : Point k K) (hAB : A ≠ B) : A.rep ∉ racl k ({B.rep} : Set K) := by
    intro h
    apply hAB
    have hAB' : A.1 ≤ B.1 := by
      rw [← A.point_rep, ← B.point_rep]
      exact ClosedIF.point_le_iff.2 h
    exact Subtype.ext ((B.2.le_iff.1 hAB').resolve_left A.2.1)
  have hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![P.rep, Q.rep] :=
    algebraicIndependent_pair (hle P Q hPQ) (hle Q P hPQ.symm)
  have hspan : ClosedIF.point k P.rep ⊔ ClosedIF.point k Q.rep =
      ⨆ i : Fin 2, ClosedIF.point k ((![P.rep, Q.rep] : Fin 2 → K) i) := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply sup_le
      · exact le_iSup_of_le 0 (by simp)
      · exact le_iSup_of_le 1 (by simp)
    · apply iSup_le
      intro i
      fin_cases i
      · exact le_sup_left
      · exact le_sup_right
  rw [← P.point_rep, ← Q.point_rep, hspan]
  simpa using rankEq_iSup_point hind

name: AclGeom.le_sup_of_rankEq_two
statement:
private theorem le_sup_of_rankEq_two {A B C : ClosedIF k K} (hAB : RankEq 2 (A ⊔ B))
    (h : RankEq 2 (A ⊔ B ⊔ C)) : C ≤ A ⊔ B
proof:
:= by
  rw [RankEq.eq_of_le le_sup_left hAB h]
  exact le_sup_right

name: AclGeom.not_le_sup_of_rankEq_three
statement:
private theorem not_le_sup_of_rankEq_three {A B C : ClosedIF k K} (hAB : RankEq 2 (A ⊔ B))
    (h : RankEq 3 (A ⊔ B ⊔ C)) : ¬ C ≤ A ⊔ B
proof:
:= fun hC ↦ by
  rw [sup_eq_left.2 hC] at h
  have h2 := rankEq_iff_eRk.1 hAB
  have h3 := rankEq_iff_eRk.1 h
  rw [h2] at h3
  exact absurd (ENat.natCast_inj.1 h3) (by decide)

name: AclGeom.coefficientClosure_eq_point
statement:
private theorem coefficientClosure_eq_point {A : Point k K}
    (E : IntermediateField k K) (hEA : E ≤ A.1.1)
    (P : FiniteCorrespondencePair ↥E K) (hfree : P.target ∉ racl k ({P.source} : Set K)) :
    racl k (P.curveCoefficientSet k E) = A.1.1
proof:
:= by
  let C : ClosedIF k K := ⟨racl k (P.curveCoefficientSet k E), isRAC_racl _⟩
  have hCA : C ≤ A.1 := by
    change racl k (P.curveCoefficientSet k E) ≤ A.1.1
    calc
      racl k (P.curveCoefficientSet k E) ≤ racl k (A.1 : Set K) := by
        apply racl_mono
        rintro _ ⟨d, rfl⟩
        exact hEA (P.curveEquation.coeff d).2
      _ = A.1.1 := isRAC_iff_racl_eq.mp A.1.2
  have hC0 : C ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hC
    apply hfree
    have hbot : ∀ z ∈ P.curveCoefficientSet k E, z ∈ racl k ({P.source} : Set K) := by
      intro z hz
      have hzC : z ∈ C := subset_racl k _ hz
      have hz0 : z ∈ (⊥ : ClosedIF k K) := hC ▸ hzC
      exact racl_mono (Set.empty_subset _)
        (mem_racl_empty_of_isAlgebraic (ClosedIF.mem_bot_iff.1 hz0))
    have hsub : P.curveCoefficientSet k E ∪ {P.source} ⊆
        (racl k ({P.source} : Set K) : Set K) :=
      Set.union_subset hbot (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (subset_racl k _ rfl))
    exact racl_le_of_subset_racl hsub
      (mem_racl_adjoin_base_iff.mp (P.target_mem_racl_curveCoefficientField_source k E))
  exact congrArg Subtype.val ((A.2.le_iff.1 hCA).resolve_left hC0)

name: AclGeom.IsPartialQuadrangle.incidences
statement:
private theorem IsPartialQuadrangle.incidences {f : Fin 6 → Point k K}
    (h : IsPartialQuadrangle f) :
    (f 2).1 ≤ (f 0).1 ⊔ (f 1).1 ∧ (f 5).1 ≤ (f 1).1 ⊔ (f 3).1 ∧
      (f 4).1 ≤ (f 0).1 ⊔ (f 5).1 ∧ (f 4).1 ≤ (f 2).1 ⊔ (f 3).1 ∧
      ¬ (f 3).1 ≤ (f 0).1 ⊔ (f 1).1 ∧ ¬ (f 5).1 ≤ (f 0).1 ⊔ (f 1).1 ∧
      ¬ (f 4).1 ≤ (f 0).1 ⊔ (f 1).1
proof:
:= by
  have hne (i j : Fin 6) (hij : i ≠ j) : f i ≠ f j := h.injective.ne hij
  have hrank3 (s : Finset (Fin 6)) (hs : s.card = 3) (hq : s ∉ quadTriples) :=
    h.rank_free s hs hq
  have hST := rankEq_two_sup_of_ne (hne 0 1 (by decide))
  refine ⟨le_sup_of_rankEq_two hST (by simpa only [sup_assoc] using h.rank_STU),
    le_sup_of_rankEq_two (rankEq_two_sup_of_ne (hne 1 3 (by decide)))
      (by simpa only [sup_assoc] using h.rank_S'TU'),
    le_sup_of_rankEq_two (rankEq_two_sup_of_ne (hne 0 5 (by decide)))
      (by simpa only [sup_assoc, sup_comm ((f 5).1)] using h.rank_STU'),
    le_sup_of_rankEq_two (rankEq_two_sup_of_ne (hne 2 3 (by decide)))
      (by simpa only [sup_assoc] using h.rank_S'T'U),
    not_le_sup_of_rankEq_three hST (by
      have := hrank3 {0, 1, 3} (by decide) (by decide)
      simpa only [Finset.sup_insert, Finset.sup_singleton, sup_assoc] using this),
    not_le_sup_of_rankEq_three hST (by
      have := hrank3 {0, 1, 5} (by decide) (by decide)
      simpa only [Finset.sup_insert, Finset.sup_singleton, sup_assoc] using this),
    not_le_sup_of_rankEq_three hST (by
      have := hrank3 {0, 1, 4} (by decide) (by decide)
      simpa only [Finset.sup_insert, Finset.sup_singleton, sup_assoc] using this)⟩

name: AclGeom.IsPartialQuadrangle.exists_composing_closed_incidence_germs
statement:
theorem IsPartialQuadrangle.exists_composing_closed_incidence_germs [IsAlgClosed K]
    {f : Fin 6 → Point k K} (h : IsPartialQuadrangle f) :
    ∃ (G_T G_S G_U : FiniteCorrespondencePair ↥((f 0).1 ⊔ (f 1).1).1 K),
      G_T.source = (f 3).rep ∧ G_T.target = (f 5).rep ∧
      G_S.source = (f 5).rep ∧ G_S.target = (f 4).rep ∧
      G_U.source = (f 3).rep ∧ G_U.target = (f 4).rep ∧
      racl k (G_T.curveCoefficientSet k ((f 0).1 ⊔ (f 1).1).1) = (f 1).1.1 ∧
      racl k (G_S.curveCoefficientSet k ((f 0).1 ⊔ (f 1).1).1) = (f 0).1.1 ∧
      racl k (G_U.curveCoefficientSet k ((f 0).1 ⊔ (f 1).1).1) = (f 2).1.1 ∧
      FiniteCorrespondenceGerm.Composes (FiniteCorrespondenceGerm.ofPair G_T)
        (FiniteCorrespondenceGerm.ofPair G_S) (FiniteCorrespondenceGerm.ofPair G_U)
proof:
:= by
  have hne (i j : Fin 6) (hij : i ≠ j) : f i ≠ f j := h.injective.ne hij
  have hnle (i j : Fin 6) (hij : i ≠ j) : ¬ (f i).1 ≤ (f j).1 := fun hle ↦
    hne i j hij (Subtype.ext (((f j).2.le_iff.1 hle).resolve_left (f i).2.1))
  have hfree (i j : Fin 6) (hij : i ≠ j) : (f i).rep ∉ racl k ({(f j).rep} : Set K) := by
    intro hm
    apply hnle i j hij
    rw [← (f i).point_rep, ← (f j).point_rep]
    exact ClosedIF.point_le_iff.2 hm
  obtain ⟨hU_ST, hU'_TS', hT'_SU', hT'_US', hS'F, hU'F, hT'F⟩ := h.incidences
  let F : ClosedIF k K := (f 0).1 ⊔ (f 1).1
  
  obtain ⟨P_T, hPTS, hPTT⟩ := QWitness.exists_closed_incidencePair (f 1).1 (f 3) (f 5)
    (hnle 3 1 (by decide)) (hnle 5 1 (by decide)) hU'_TS'
  obtain ⟨P_S, hPSS, hPST⟩ := QWitness.exists_closed_incidencePair (f 0).1 (f 5) (f 4)
    (hnle 5 0 (by decide)) (hnle 4 0 (by decide)) hT'_SU'
  obtain ⟨P_U, hPUS, hPUT⟩ := QWitness.exists_closed_incidencePair (f 2).1 (f 3) (f 4)
    (hnle 3 2 (by decide)) (hnle 4 2 (by decide)) hT'_US'
  
  obtain ⟨Q_T, hQTS, hQTT⟩ := QWitness.exists_closed_incidencePair F (f 3) (f 5) hS'F hU'F
    (hU'_TS'.trans (sup_le_sup_right le_sup_right _))
  obtain ⟨Q_S, hQSS, hQST⟩ := QWitness.exists_closed_incidencePair F (f 5) (f 4) hU'F hT'F
    (hT'_SU'.trans (sup_le_sup_right le_sup_left _))
  obtain ⟨Q_U, hQUS, hQUT⟩ := QWitness.exists_closed_incidencePair F (f 3) (f 4) hS'F hT'F
    (hT'_US'.trans (sup_le_sup_right hU_ST _))
  have : IsAlgClosed ↥(f 0).1.1 := QWitness.closed_isAlgClosed (f 0).1
  have : IsAlgClosed ↥(f 1).1.1 := QWitness.closed_isAlgClosed (f 1).1
  have : IsAlgClosed ↥(f 2).1.1 := QWitness.closed_isAlgClosed (f 2).1
  have hcoeffT := QWitness.curveCoefficientSet_eq_of_baseChange (f 1).1.1 F.1
    (show (f 1).1.1 ≤ F.1 from (le_sup_right : (f 1).1 ≤ F)) P_T Q_T
      (hPTS.trans hQTS.symm) (hPTT.trans hQTT.symm)
  have hcoeffS := QWitness.curveCoefficientSet_eq_of_baseChange (f 0).1.1 F.1
    (show (f 0).1.1 ≤ F.1 from (le_sup_left : (f 0).1 ≤ F)) P_S Q_S
      (hPSS.trans hQSS.symm) (hPST.trans hQST.symm)
  have hcoeffU := QWitness.curveCoefficientSet_eq_of_baseChange (f 2).1.1 F.1
    (show (f 2).1.1 ≤ F.1 from hU_ST) P_U Q_U
      (hPUS.trans hQUS.symm) (hPUT.trans hQUT.symm)
  have hT : racl k (Q_T.curveCoefficientSet k F.1) = (f 1).1.1 := by
    rw [← hcoeffT]
    exact coefficientClosure_eq_point _ le_rfl P_T (by rw [hPTS, hPTT]; exact hfree 5 3 (by decide))
  have hS : racl k (Q_S.curveCoefficientSet k F.1) = (f 0).1.1 := by
    rw [← hcoeffS]
    exact coefficientClosure_eq_point _ le_rfl P_S (by rw [hPSS, hPST]; exact hfree 4 5 (by decide))
  have hU : racl k (Q_U.curveCoefficientSet k F.1) = (f 2).1.1 := by
    rw [← hcoeffU]
    exact coefficientClosure_eq_point _ le_rfl P_U (by rw [hPUS, hPUT]; exact hfree 4 3 (by decide))
  refine ⟨Q_T, Q_S, Q_U, hQTS, hQTT, hQSS, hQST, hQUS, hQUT, hT, hS, hU, ?_⟩
  have hshared : Q_T.target = Q_S.source := hQTT.trans hQSS.symm
  refine ⟨Q_T, Q_S, hshared, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  change idealOf ↥F.1 ![Q_U.source, Q_U.target] = idealOf ↥F.1 ![Q_T.source, Q_S.target]
  rw [hQUS, hQUT, hQTS, hQST]

name: AclGeom.IsPartialQuadrangle.exists_literal_composing_incidence_germs
statement:
theorem IsPartialQuadrangle.exists_literal_composing_incidence_germs
    {f : Fin 6 → Point k K} (h : IsPartialQuadrangle f) :
    ∃ (G_T G_S : FiniteCorrespondencePair
        ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep, (f 2).rep}) K)
      (hTS : G_T.target = G_S.source)
      (L_T : FiniteCorrespondencePair ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {(f 1).rep}) K)
      (L_S : FiniteCorrespondencePair ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {(f 0).rep}) K)
      (L_U : FiniteCorrespondencePair ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {(f 2).rep}) K),
      G_T.source = (f 3).rep ∧ G_T.target = (f 5).rep ∧ G_S.target = (f 4).rep ∧
      L_T.source = (f 3).rep ∧ L_T.target = (f 5).rep ∧
      L_S.source = (f 5).rep ∧ L_S.target = (f 4).rep ∧
      L_U.source = (f 3).rep ∧ L_U.target = (f 4).rep ∧
      (G_T.comp G_S hTS).ideal ∈ Ideal.minimalPrimes (L_U.ideal.map (MvPolynomial.map
        (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k {(f 2).rep}
          {(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep, (f 2).rep} (by simp)) : _ →+* _))) ∧
      G_T.ideal ∈ Ideal.minimalPrimes (L_T.ideal.map (MvPolynomial.map
        (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k {(f 1).rep}
          {(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep, (f 2).rep} (by simp)) : _ →+* _))) ∧
      G_S.ideal ∈ Ideal.minimalPrimes (L_S.ideal.map (MvPolynomial.map
        (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k {(f 0).rep}
          {(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep, (f 2).rep} (by simp)) : _ →+* _)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hU_ST, hU'_TS', hT'_SU', hT'_US', hS'F, hU'F, hT'F⟩ := h.incidences
  have hnle (i j : Fin 6) (hij : i ≠ j) : ¬ (f i).1 ≤ (f j).1 := fun hle ↦
    h.injective.ne hij (Subtype.ext (((f j).2.le_iff.1 hle).resolve_left (f i).2.1))
  
  have hspan (i : Fin 6) : racl k {(f i).rep} = (f i).1.1 := by
    rw [← (f i).point_rep]
    rfl
  have hST : racl k {(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep} = ((f 0).1 ⊔ (f 1).1).1 := by
    rw [← coe_sup_point₂, (f 0).point_rep, (f 1).point_rep]
  have hspanF : racl k {(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep, (f 2).rep} = ((f 0).1 ⊔ (f 1).1).1 := by
    have hu : (f 2).rep ∈ racl k {(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep} := by
      rw [hST]
      exact ClosedIF.le_iff.1 hU_ST (f 2).mem_rep
    rw [← hST]
    refine le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_) (racl_mono ?_)
    · rintro _ (rfl | rfl | rfl)
      · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
      · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_singleton _))
      · exact hu
    · rintro _ (rfl | rfl)
      · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
      · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  
  let L_T := QWitness.incidencePair (hspan 1) (f 3) (f 5) (hnle 3 1 (by decide))
    (hnle 5 1 (by decide)) hU'_TS'
  let L_S := QWitness.incidencePair (hspan 0) (f 5) (f 4) (hnle 5 0 (by decide))
    (hnle 4 0 (by decide)) hT'_SU'
  let L_U := QWitness.incidencePair (hspan 2) (f 3) (f 4) (hnle 3 2 (by decide))
    (hnle 4 2 (by decide)) hT'_US'
  let G_T := QWitness.incidencePair hspanF (f 3) (f 5) hS'F hU'F
    (hU'_TS'.trans (sup_le_sup_right le_sup_right _))
  let G_S := QWitness.incidencePair hspanF (f 5) (f 4) hU'F hT'F
    (hT'_SU'.trans (sup_le_sup_right le_sup_left _))
  let G_U := QWitness.incidencePair hspanF (f 3) (f 4) hS'F hT'F
    (hT'_US'.trans (sup_le_sup_right hU_ST _))
  have hcomp : G_T.comp G_S rfl = G_U := rfl
  refine ⟨G_T, G_S, rfl, L_T, L_S, L_U, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hcomp]
    exact FiniteCorrespondencePair.ideal_mem_minimalPrimes_baseChange _ L_U G_U rfl rfl
  · exact FiniteCorrespondencePair.ideal_mem_minimalPrimes_baseChange _ L_T G_T rfl rfl
  · exact FiniteCorrespondencePair.ideal_mem_minimalPrimes_baseChange _ L_S G_S rfl rfl

name: AclGeom.IsPartialQuadrangle.literal_family_branches_are_conjugates
statement:
theorem IsPartialQuadrangle.literal_family_branches_are_conjugates [IsAlgClosed K]
    {f : Fin 6 → Point k K} (h : IsPartialQuadrangle f) :
    (∀ J ∈ ((idealOf ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {(f 1).rep}) ![(f 3).rep, (f 5).rep]).map
        (MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k
          {(f 1).rep} {(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep, (f 2).rep} (by simp)) : _ →+* _))).minimalPrimes,
      ∃ (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair
          ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep, (f 2).rep}) K)
        (σ : K ≃ₐ[↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {(f 1).rep})] K),
        Q.ideal = J ∧ Q.source = σ (f 3).rep ∧ Q.target = σ (f 5).rep) ∧
    (∀ J ∈ ((idealOf ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {(f 0).rep}) ![(f 5).rep, (f 4).rep]).map
        (MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k
          {(f 0).rep} {(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep, (f 2).rep} (by simp)) : _ →+* _))).minimalPrimes,
      ∃ (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair
          ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep, (f 2).rep}) K)
        (σ : K ≃ₐ[↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {(f 0).rep})] K),
        Q.ideal = J ∧ Q.source = σ (f 5).rep ∧ Q.target = σ (f 4).rep) ∧
    (∀ J ∈ ((idealOf ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {(f 2).rep}) ![(f 3).rep, (f 4).rep]).map
        (MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k
          {(f 2).rep} {(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep, (f 2).rep} (by simp)) : _ →+* _))).minimalPrimes,
      ∃ (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair
          ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep, (f 2).rep}) K)
        (σ : K ≃ₐ[↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {(f 2).rep})] K),
        Q.ideal = J ∧ Q.source = σ (f 3).rep ∧ Q.target = σ (f 4).rep)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G_T, -, -, L_T, L_S, L_U, -, -, -, hLTS, hLTT, hLSS, hLST, hLUS, hLUT, -, -, -⟩ :=
    h.exists_literal_composing_incidence_germs
  refine ⟨fun J hJ ↦ ?_, fun J hJ ↦ ?_, fun J hJ ↦ ?_⟩
  · have hL : L_T.ideal = idealOf _ ![(f 3).rep, (f 5).rep] := by
      change idealOf _ ![L_T.source, L_T.target] = _
      rw [hLTS, hLTT]
    obtain ⟨Q, σ, hQ, hQs, hQt⟩ :=
      FiniteCorrespondencePair.exists_conjugate_of_mem_minimalPrimes_baseChange _ L_T
        G_T.source_generic (hL ▸ hJ)
    exact ⟨Q, σ, hQ, hQs.trans (by rw [hLTS]), hQt.trans (by rw [hLTT])⟩
  · have hL : L_S.ideal = idealOf _ ![(f 5).rep, (f 4).rep] := by
      change idealOf _ ![L_S.source, L_S.target] = _
      rw [hLSS, hLST]
    obtain ⟨Q, σ, hQ, hQs, hQt⟩ :=
      FiniteCorrespondencePair.exists_conjugate_of_mem_minimalPrimes_baseChange _ L_S
        G_T.source_generic (hL ▸ hJ)
    exact ⟨Q, σ, hQ, hQs.trans (by rw [hLSS]), hQt.trans (by rw [hLST])⟩
  · have hL : L_U.ideal = idealOf _ ![(f 3).rep, (f 4).rep] := by
      change idealOf _ ![L_U.source, L_U.target] = _
      rw [hLUS, hLUT]
    obtain ⟨Q, σ, hQ, hQs, hQt⟩ :=
      FiniteCorrespondencePair.exists_conjugate_of_mem_minimalPrimes_baseChange _ L_U
        G_T.source_generic (hL ▸ hJ)
    exact ⟨Q, σ, hQ, hQs.trans (by rw [hLUS]), hQt.trans (by rw [hLUT])⟩

name: AclGeom.IsPartialQuadrangle.literal_composite_locus_eq_comap
statement:
theorem IsPartialQuadrangle.literal_composite_locus_eq_comap {f : Fin 6 → Point k K}
    (h : IsPartialQuadrangle f) :
    ∃ (G_T G_S : FiniteCorrespondencePair
        ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep, (f 2).rep}) K)
      (hTS : G_T.target = G_S.source),
      G_T.source = (f 3).rep ∧ G_S.target = (f 4).rep ∧
      (G_T.comp G_S hTS).ideal ∈ Ideal.minimalPrimes
        ((idealOf ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {(f 2).rep}) ![(f 3).rep, (f 4).rep]).map
          (MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k
            {(f 2).rep} {(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep, (f 2).rep} (by simp)) : _ →+* _))) ∧
      idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim ![(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep] ![(f 2).rep])
          ![(f 3).rep, (f 4).rep]) =
        (G_T.comp G_S hTS).ideal.comap ((partialAeval (Ω := K)
          (IntermediateField.adjoin k {(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep, (f 2).rep})
          ![⟨(f 0).rep, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩,
            ⟨(f 1).rep, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩,
            ⟨(f 2).rep, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩]).comp
            (MvPolynomial.rename (Sum.map (finSumFinEquiv : (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 1) ≃ Fin 3) id))) ∧
      idealOf k (Sum.elim ![(f 2).rep] ![(f 3).rep, (f 4).rep]) =
        (idealOf ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k {(f 2).rep}) ![(f 3).rep, (f 4).rep]).comap
          (partialAeval (Ω := K) (IntermediateField.adjoin k {(f 2).rep})
            ![⟨(f 2).rep, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩])
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G_T, G_S, hTS, -, -, L_U, hGTS, -, hGST, -, -, -, -, hLUS, hLUT, hU, -, -⟩ :=
    h.exists_literal_composing_incidence_germs
  have hL : L_U.ideal = idealOf _ ![(f 3).rep, (f 4).rep] := by
    change idealOf _ ![L_U.source, L_U.target] = _
    rw [hLUS, hLUT]
  have hcomp : (G_T.comp G_S hTS).ideal = idealOf _ ![(f 3).rep, (f 4).rep] := by
    change idealOf _ ![G_T.source, G_S.target] = _
    rw [hGTS, hGST]
  refine ⟨G_T, G_S, hTS, hGTS, hGST, hL ▸ hU, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hcomp, ← Ideal.comap_comapₐ, ← idealOf_sumElim_eq_comap_partialAeval]
    apply idealOf_eq_comap_rename
    funext i
    rcases i with (i | i) | i <;> fin_cases i <;> rfl
  · rw [← idealOf_sumElim_eq_comap_partialAeval]
    congr 1
    funext i
    rcases i with i | i <;> fin_cases i <;> rfl

statement:
theorem sAaGroupedAOrbitSourceChart_bGermCoefficient_apply
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b))

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.rightCFiniteCommonChart_comp_bGermCoefficient
statement:
theorem rightCFiniteCommonChart_comp_bGermCoefficient
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b))
    (x : w.bGermCoefficientField hψ) :
    R.rightCFiniteCommonChart L hind
        ((R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightCJointClosureExtension L hind)
          |>.pullbackBaseRingHom
            (R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom L hind x)) =
      algebraMap (↥R.rightSourceJointField)
        (↥(R.fourSelectedGraphJointCover L hind).field)
        (R.rightCSourceToRightSourceJoint
          (R.sAcBGermCoefficientToRightCSourceAlgHom L hind x))
proof:
:= by
  let old := R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom L hind x
  let srcE := R.seBGermCoefficientToSemanticSourceAlgHom L hind x
  let srcC := R.sAcBGermCoefficientToRightCSourceAlgHom L hind x
  have hbase : R.rightCToJointBaseRingHom hind srcE =
      R.rightCSourceToRightSourceJoint srcC := by
    change R.rightCSourceToRightSourceJoint
        (R.commonSourceToRightCSourceEquiv hind srcE) =
      R.rightCSourceToRightSourceJoint srcC
    exact congrArg R.rightCSourceToRightSourceJoint
      (R.commonSourceToRightCSourceEquiv_comp_seBGermCoefficient L hind x)
  calc
    R.rightCFiniteCommonChart L hind
          ((R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightCJointClosureExtension L hind)
            |>.pullbackBaseRingHom old) =
        R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightCJointRingHom L hind old :=
      (R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightCJointClosureExtension L hind)
        |>.pullbackBaseEquiv_pullbackBaseRingHom old
    _ = R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightCJointRingHom L hind
          (R.semanticSourceToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom L hind srcE) :=
      congrArg (R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightCJointRingHom L hind)
        (R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom_apply L hind x)
    _ = algebraMap (↥R.rightSourceJointField)
          (↥(R.fourSelectedGraphJointCover L hind).field)
          (R.rightCToJointBaseRingHom hind srcE) :=
      R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightCJointRingHom_algebraMap L hind srcE
    _ = algebraMap (↥R.rightSourceJointField)
          (↥(R.fourSelectedGraphJointCover L hind).field)
          (R.rightCSourceToRightSourceJoint srcC) := congrArg _ hbase
    _ = algebraMap (↥R.rightSourceJointField)
          (↥(R.fourSelectedGraphJointCover L hind).field)
          (R.rightCSourceToRightSourceJoint
            (R.sAcBGermCoefficientToRightCSourceAlgHom L hind x)) :=
      rfl

statement:
theorem adjoin_abGermCoordinates_eq_top (hψ : w.Psi) :
    adjoin k (Set.range (w.abGermCoordinates hψ)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let F := w.abGermCoefficientField hψ
  apply F.lift_injective
  rw [F.lift_adjoin, F.lift_top]
  change adjoin k (Subtype.val '' Set.range (w.abGermCoordinates hψ)) = F
  have hrange : Subtype.val '' Set.range (w.abGermCoordinates hψ) =
      ((w.xyCorrespondencePairOverA hψ).swap).curveCoefficientSet k w.aField ∪
        (w.yzCorrespondencePairOverB hψ).curveCoefficientSet k w.bField := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      rcases i with i | i
      · exact Set.mem_union_left _ i.2
      · exact Set.mem_union_right _ i.2
    · rintro (hz | hz)
      · let c : w.aInverseGermCoordinateIndex hψ := ⟨z, hz⟩
        exact ⟨w.abGermCoordinates hψ (Sum.inl c),
          ⟨Sum.inl c, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      · let c : w.bGermCoordinateIndex hψ := ⟨z, hz⟩
        exact ⟨w.abGermCoordinates hψ (Sum.inr c),
          ⟨Sum.inr c, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [hrange, adjoin_union]
  rfl

name: AclGeom.algebraicIndependent_table_Q_shift
statement:
theorem algebraicIndependent_table_Q_shift {a b c d x : K}
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b, c, d, x]) (η : k) :
    AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b - algebraMap k K η,
      c, d + (c - 1) * algebraMap k K η, x]
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t, algebraMap k K η = t := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [ht]
  have htS (S : Set K) : t ∈ racl k S := by
    rw [← ht]
    exact (racl k S).algebraMap_mem η
  refine AlgebraicIndependent.of_racl_range_eq hind (racl_range_eq_of_mem ?_ ?_)
  · have hm (i : Fin 5) : ![a, b, c, d, x] i ∈ racl k (Set.range ![a, b, c, d, x]) :=
      subset_racl k _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact hm 0
    · exact sub_mem (hm 1) (htS _)
    · exact hm 2
    · exact add_mem (hm 3) (mul_mem (sub_mem (hm 2) (one_mem _)) (htS _))
    · exact hm 4
  · have hm (i : Fin 5) : ![a, b - t, c, d + (c - 1) * t, x] i ∈
        racl k (Set.range ![a, b - t, c, d + (c - 1) * t, x]) :=
      subset_racl k _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact hm 0
    · change b ∈ _
      have h := add_mem (hm 1) (htS _)
      change b - t + t ∈ _ at h
      rwa [sub_add_cancel] at h
    · exact hm 2
    · change d ∈ _
      have h := sub_mem (hm 3) (mul_mem (sub_mem (hm 2) (one_mem _)) (htS _))
      change d + (c - 1) * t - (c - 1) * t ∈ _ at h
      rwa [add_sub_cancel_right] at h
    · exact hm 4

name: AclGeom.table_meets_G_H_I_E
statement:
private theorem table_meets_G_H_I_E {a b c d x : K}
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b, c, d, x]) :
    (ClosedIF.point k b ⊔ ClosedIF.point k c) ⊓
        (ClosedIF.point k d ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (b * c + d)) = ClosedIF.point k (b * c) ∧
      (ClosedIF.point k (a * c) ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (b * c)) ⊓
        (ClosedIF.point k a ⊔ ClosedIF.point k b) = ClosedIF.point k (a / b) ∧
      (ClosedIF.point k (a / b) ⊔ ClosedIF.point k x) ⊓
        (ClosedIF.point k b ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (a * x + b)) = ClosedIF.point k (a * x / b) ∧
      (ClosedIF.point k c ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (a * x + b)) ⊓
        (ClosedIF.point k d ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (c * (a * x + b) + d)) =
          ClosedIF.point k (c * (a * x + b))
proof:
:=
  ⟨qWitness_meet_G hind, qWitness_meet_H hind, qWitness_meet_I hind, qWitness_meet_E hind⟩

name: AclGeom.shifted_meet_G
statement:
private theorem shifted_meet_G {c p q r g t B bs ds ws W : K} (ht : t ∈ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    (hb : B = bs + t) (hw : W = ws + t)
    (hG : (ClosedIF.point k bs ⊔ ClosedIF.point k c) ⊓
      (ClosedIF.point k ds ⊔ ClosedIF.point k ws) = ClosedIF.point k (bs * c))
    (hpB : p ∈ racl k ({B} : Set K)) (hqd : q ∈ racl k ({ds} : Set K))
    (hrW : r ∈ racl k ({W} : Set K))
    (hgP : g ∈ racl k ({p, c} : Set K)) (hgQ : g ∈ racl k ({q, r} : Set K))
    (hg0 : g ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) :
    racl k ({g} : Set K) = racl k ({bs * c} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have htS (S : Set K) : t ∈ racl k S := racl_mono (Set.empty_subset S) ht
  have hbs : bs ∈ racl k ({bs, c} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  have hc : c ∈ racl k ({bs, c} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
  have hB : B ∈ racl k ({bs, c} : Set K) := by
    rw [hb]
    exact add_mem hbs (htS _)
  have hp : p ∈ racl k ({bs, c} : Set K) :=
    racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hB) hpB
  have hds : ds ∈ racl k ({ds, ws} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  have hws : ws ∈ racl k ({ds, ws} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
  have hq : q ∈ racl k ({ds, ws} : Set K) :=
    racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hds) hqd
  have hW : W ∈ racl k ({ds, ws} : Set K) := by
    rw [hw]
    exact add_mem hws (htS _)
  have hr : r ∈ racl k ({ds, ws} : Set K) :=
    racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hW) hrW
  exact racl_singleton_eq_of_mem_meet hG (shifted_pair_mem_racl hp hc hgP)
    (shifted_pair_mem_racl hq hr hgQ) hg0

name: AclGeom.shifted_meet_H
statement:
private theorem shifted_meet_H {a c g h t B bs : K} (ht : t ∈ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    (hb : B = bs + t)
    (hH : (ClosedIF.point k (a * c) ⊔ ClosedIF.point k (bs * c)) ⊓
      (ClosedIF.point k a ⊔ ClosedIF.point k bs) = ClosedIF.point k (a / bs))
    (hgG : g ∈ racl k ({bs * c} : Set K))
    (hhU : h ∈ racl k ({a * c, g} : Set K)) (hhA : h ∈ racl k ({a, B} : Set K))
    (hh0 : h ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) :
    racl k ({h} : Set K) = racl k ({a / bs} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have hac : a * c ∈ racl k ({a * c, bs * c} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  have hbc : bs * c ∈ racl k ({a * c, bs * c} : Set K) :=
    subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
  have hg : g ∈ racl k ({a * c, bs * c} : Set K) :=
    racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hbc) hgG
  have ha : a ∈ racl k ({a, bs} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  have hbs : bs ∈ racl k ({a, bs} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
  have hB : B ∈ racl k ({a, bs} : Set K) := by
    rw [hb]
    exact add_mem hbs (racl_mono (Set.empty_subset _) ht)
  exact racl_singleton_eq_of_mem_meet hH (shifted_pair_mem_racl hac hg hhU)
    (shifted_pair_mem_racl ha hB hhA) hh0

name: AclGeom.shifted_meet_I
statement:
private theorem shifted_meet_I {a x p h i t B Y bs ys : K} (ht : t ∈ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    (hb : B = bs + t) (hy : Y = ys + t)
    (hI : (ClosedIF.point k (a / bs) ⊔ ClosedIF.point k x) ⊓
      (ClosedIF.point k bs ⊔ ClosedIF.point k ys) = ClosedIF.point k (a * x / bs))
    (hhH : h ∈ racl k ({a / bs} : Set K)) (hpB : p ∈ racl k ({B} : Set K))
    (hiH : i ∈ racl k ({h, x} : Set K)) (hiP : i ∈ racl k ({p, Y} : Set K))
    (hi0 : i ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) :
    racl k ({i} : Set K) = racl k ({a * x / bs} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have htS (S : Set K) : t ∈ racl k S := racl_mono (Set.empty_subset S) ht
  have hm : a / bs ∈ racl k ({a / bs, x} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  have hx : x ∈ racl k ({a / bs, x} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
  have hh : h ∈ racl k ({a / bs, x} : Set K) :=
    racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hm) hhH
  have hbs : bs ∈ racl k ({bs, ys} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  have hys : ys ∈ racl k ({bs, ys} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
  have hB : B ∈ racl k ({bs, ys} : Set K) := by

  have hp : p ∈ racl k ({bs, ys} : Set K) :=
    racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hB) hpB
  have hY : Y ∈ racl k ({bs, ys} : Set K) := by

  exact racl_singleton_eq_of_mem_meet hI (shifted_pair_mem_racl hh hx hiH)
    (shifted_pair_mem_racl hp hY hiP) hi0

name: AclGeom.shifted_meet_E
statement:
private theorem shifted_meet_E {c q e t Y Z ys ds zs : K} (ht : t ∈ racl k (∅ : Set K))

    (he0 : e ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) :

proof:

  have hY : Y ∈ racl k ({c, ys} : Set K) := by

  have hds : ds ∈ racl k ({ds, zs} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)

name: AclGeom.racl_shifted_G_H_I_E_of_normalized_P_Q
statement:
theorem racl_shifted_G_H_I_E_of_normalized_P_Q {a b c d x p q r g h i e : K}
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b, c, d, x]) (η : k)
    (hP : racl k ({p} : Set K) = racl k ({b} : Set K))
    (hQ : racl k ({q} : Set K) =
      racl k ({d + (c - 1) * algebraMap k K η} : Set K))
    (hR : racl k ({r} : Set K) = racl k ({b * c + d} : Set K))
    (hgP : g ∈ racl k ({p, c} : Set K)) (hgQ : g ∈ racl k ({q, r} : Set K))
    (hg0 : g ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    (hhU : h ∈ racl k ({a * c, g} : Set K))
    (hhA : h ∈ racl k ({a, b} : Set K)) (hh0 : h ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    (hiH : i ∈ racl k ({h, x} : Set K))
    (hiP : i ∈ racl k ({p, a * x + b} : Set K))
    (hi0 : i ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    (heT : e ∈ racl k ({c, a * x + b} : Set K))
    (heQ : e ∈ racl k ({q, c * (a * x + b) + d} : Set K))
    (he0 : e ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)) :
    racl k ({g} : Set K) = racl k ({(b - algebraMap k K η) * c} : Set K) ∧
      racl k ({h} : Set K) = racl k ({a / (b - algebraMap k K η)} : Set K) ∧
      racl k ({i} : Set K) = racl k ({a * x / (b - algebraMap k K η)} : Set K) ∧
      racl k ({e} : Set K) =
        racl k ({c * (a * x + (b - algebraMap k K η))} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have hstar := algebraicIndependent_table_Q_shift hind η
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t, algebraMap k K η = t := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [ht] at hstar hQ
  rw [ht]
  have ht0 : t ∈ racl k (∅ : Set K) := by
    rw [← ht]
    exact (racl k (∅ : Set K)).algebraMap_mem η
  
  obtain ⟨hG, hH, hI, hE⟩ := table_meets_G_H_I_E hstar
  have hpb : p ∈ racl k ({b} : Set K) := by
    rw [← hP]
    exact subset_racl k _ rfl
  have hqd : q ∈ racl k ({d + (c - 1) * t} : Set K) := by
    rw [← hQ]
    exact subset_racl k _ rfl
  have hrw : r ∈ racl k ({b * c + d} : Set K) := by
    rw [← hR]
    exact subset_racl k _ rfl
  have hGeq := shifted_meet_G ht0 (by ring) (by ring) hG hpb hqd hrw hgP hgQ hg0
  have hgG : g ∈ racl k ({(b - t) * c} : Set K) := by
    rw [← hGeq]
    exact subset_racl k _ rfl
  have hHeq := shifted_meet_H ht0 (by ring) hH hgG hhU hhA hh0
  have hhH : h ∈ racl k ({a / (b - t)} : Set K) := by
    rw [← hHeq]
    exact subset_racl k _ rfl
  exact ⟨hGeq, hHeq, shifted_meet_I ht0 (by ring) (by ring) hI hhH hpb hiH hiP hi0,
    shifted_meet_E ht0 (by ring) (by ring) hE hqd heT heQ he0⟩

    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b))
    (z : w.bGermCoefficientField hψ) :

      R.seBGermCoefficientToReferenceInSelectedGraphRingHom L hind z
proof:
:= by

    seRelocatedRightBranchToSelectedNormalRingHom
