    referenceNormalCoverToSelectedGraphSource
    referenceNormalCoverToSelectedSource
    referenceNormalCoverToSelectedNormal
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe]
  apply congrArg
  apply congrArg
  apply Subtype.ext
  calc
    _ = ((R.seBGermCoefficientToRelocatedBParameterAlgHom L z :
          (R.se.bCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ).parameterField) :
            CommonCurveAmbient K) := by
      have hz := DFunLike.congr_fun
        (R.fourBGermCoefficientToRelocatedBParameterAlgHom_factor_coefficients
          L).1 z
      exact (congrArg Subtype.val hz).symm
    _ = commonCurveEmbedding (k := k) (K := K)
        (((rankTwoScalarExtensionEquivOfIdealEq
          (k := k) L.eProjectionRelation.symm).totalEquiv
            ((IntermediateField.inclusion
              (rankTwoParameterField_le_rankTwoScalarField
                (k := k) w.bReps w.T.rep))
              (bGermCoefficientToSelectedBParameterAlgHom
                (w := w) (hψ := hψ) z)) :
                  rankTwoScalarExtension (k := k) e L.se_e) : K) := by
      unfold seBGermCoefficientToRelocatedBParameterAlgHom
        bGermCoefficientToRelocatedBParameterAlgHom
        bGermCoefficientToProjectionParameterAlgHom
      simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply]
      rw [FiniteCover.ExtensionEquiv.commutes_apply]
      rfl

                (k := k) w.bReps w.T.rep))
              (bGermCoefficientToSelectedBParameterAlgHom
                (w := w) (hψ := hψ) z)) :
                  rankTwoScalarExtension (k := k) D.c L.sA_c_c) : K) := by
      unfold sAcBGermCoefficientToRelocatedBParameterAlgHom
        bGermCoefficientToRelocatedBParameterAlgHom
        bGermCoefficientToProjectionParameterAlgHom

      rw [FiniteCover.ExtensionEquiv.commutes_apply]
      rfl

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveCompositionRealization.parameterRelation
statement: theorem parameterRelation : w.psiFamilyCompositionRelation a b c
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin 6 → Fin 9 := ![0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
  have h := idealOf_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq
    (PsiCurveCompositionRealization.locus R) e
  change idealOf k (compositionParameterTuple a b c) =
    idealOf k w.abcReps
  calc
    idealOf k (compositionParameterTuple a b c) =
        idealOf k (R.totalTuple ∘ e) := by
      congr 1
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl
    _ = idealOf k (w.psiSelectedCurveCompositionTuple ∘ e) := h
    _ = idealOf k w.abcReps := by
      congr 1
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: AclGeom.QWitness.exists_psiCurveCompositionRealization
proof:
:= by
  have hparameter :
      idealOf k (compositionParameterTuple a b c) =
        idealOf k w.abcReps := by
    simpa [psiFamilyCompositionRelation] using hrel
  have hsource : w.X.rep ∉ racl k (Set.range w.abcReps) :=
    w.X_rep_notMem_racl_abcReps hψ
  have hfixed :
      idealOf k (psiCurveParameterSourceTuple a b c x) =
        idealOf k (psiCurveParameterSourceTuple
          w.aReps w.bReps w.cReps w.X.rep) := by
    have habc : compositionParameterTuple
        w.aReps w.bReps w.cReps = w.abcReps := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl
    change idealOf k (Fin.snoc (compositionParameterTuple a b c) x) =
      idealOf k (Fin.snoc
        (compositionParameterTuple w.aReps w.bReps w.cReps) w.X.rep)
    rw [habc]
    exact idealOf_snoc_eq_of_idealOf_eq_of_generic
      hparameter hx hsource
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hfix⟩ := exists_tuple_relocation_fixing_locus
    hfixed
    (u := w.psiSelectedCurveCompositionTuple)
    (e := psiCurveParameterSourceIndex)
    (fun i ↦ congrFun
      (w.psiCurveCompositionTuple_comp_parameterSourceIndex
        w.aReps w.bReps w.cReps w.X.rep w.Y.rep w.Z.rep) i)
    (w.psiSelectedCurveCompositionTuple_mem_parameterSource_racl hψ)
  let y : K := v 7
  let z : K := v 8
  have htotal : w.psiCurveCompositionTuple a b c x y z = v := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · simpa [psiCurveParameterSourceIndex,
        psiCurveParameterSourceTuple, compositionParameterTuple,
        psiCurveCompositionTuple] using (hfix 0).symm
    · simpa [psiCurveParameterSourceIndex,
        psiCurveParameterSourceTuple, compositionParameterTuple,
        psiCurveCompositionTuple] using (hfix 1).symm
    · simpa [psiCurveParameterSourceIndex,
        psiCurveParameterSourceTuple, compositionParameterTuple,
        psiCurveCompositionTuple] using (hfix 2).symm
    · simpa [psiCurveParameterSourceIndex,
        psiCurveParameterSourceTuple, compositionParameterTuple,
        psiCurveCompositionTuple] using (hfix 3).symm
    · simpa [psiCurveParameterSourceIndex,
        psiCurveParameterSourceTuple, compositionParameterTuple,
        psiCurveCompositionTuple] using (hfix 4).symm
    · simpa [psiCurveParameterSourceIndex,
        psiCurveParameterSourceTuple, compositionParameterTuple,
        psiCurveCompositionTuple] using (hfix 5).symm
    · simpa [psiCurveParameterSourceIndex,
        psiCurveParameterSourceTuple, compositionParameterTuple,
        psiCurveCompositionTuple] using (hfix 6).symm
    · rfl
    · rfl
  let R : w.PsiCurveCompositionRealization a b c :=
    { source := x
      middle := y
      target := z
      locus := by rw [htotal]; exact hv }
  exact ⟨R, rfl⟩

      (R := R.se) R.seCommonBaseData hψ).branchField.restrictScalars k ≤
      (R.selectedSemanticBranchExtension L).restrictScalars k
proof:
:= by
  let Q :=
    PsiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization.CommonBaseData.bCorrespondencePair
      (R := R.se) R.seCommonBaseData hψ

      (R.selectedSemanticBranchExtension L).restrictScalars k :=
    R.commonCoefficientField_le_selectedSemanticBranchExtension L
  have hQ : Q.branchField ≤ extendScalars hA := by
    unfold FiniteCorrespondencePair.branchField
    apply adjoin_le_iff.2
    intro z hz
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    rcases hz with rfl | rfl
    · change R.se.middle ∈ R.selectedSemanticBranchExtension L
      exact subset_adjoin _ _ ⟨2, rfl⟩
    · change R.se.target ∈ R.selectedSemanticBranchExtension L
      exact subset_adjoin _ _ ⟨3, rfl⟩
  intro z hz

name: AclGeom.enat_le_sub_of_add_le
statement:
private theorem enat_le_sub_of_add_le {r : ℕ∞} {a b : ℕ} (h : r + a ≤ b) :
    r ≤ ((b - a : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r', rfl⟩ : ∃ r' : ℕ, (r' : ℕ∞) = r := by
    refine ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.1 fun hr ↦ ?_
    rw [hr, top_add, top_le_iff] at h
    exact ENat.natCast_ne_top b h
  norm_cast at h ⊢
  omega

name: AclGeom.eRk_sup_le_eRk_union
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : ((E ⊔ F : ClosedIF k K) : Set K) ⊆
      (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).closure ((E : Set K) ∪ (F : Set K)) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [algebraicMatroid_closure_eq_racl]
    exact ClosedIF.mem_sup_iff.1 hx
  exact ((AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).eRk_mono hsub).trans
    ((AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).eRk_closure_eq _).le

statement:
private theorem eRk_sup_le (E F : ClosedIF k K) :
    (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).eRk ((E ⊔ F : ClosedIF k K) : Set K) ≤
      (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).eRk (E : Set K) +
        (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).eRk (F : Set K)
proof:
:=
  (eRk_sup_le_eRk_union E F).trans
    ((AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).eRk_union_le_eRk_add_eRk _ _)

name: AclGeom.eRk_inf_add_eRk_sup_le
statement:
private theorem eRk_inf_add_eRk_sup_le (E F : ClosedIF k K) :
    (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).eRk ((E ⊓ F : ClosedIF k K) : Set K) +
        (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).eRk ((E ⊔ F : ClosedIF k K) : Set K) ≤
      (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).eRk (E : Set K) +
        (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).eRk (F : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have hinf : ((E ⊓ F : ClosedIF k K) : Set K) = (E : Set K) ∩ (F : Set K) := by
    ext x
    exact ClosedIF.mem_inf_iff
  rw [hinf]
  have hsub := (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).eRk_inter_add_eRk_union_le
    (E : Set K) (F : Set K)
  exact (add_le_add_right (eRk_sup_le_eRk_union E F)
    ((AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).eRk ((E : Set K) ∩ (F : Set K)))).trans hsub

name: AclGeom.inf_eq_of_rankEq
proof:
:= by
  have h := eRk_inf_add_eRk_sup_le E F
  rw [rankEq_iff_eRk.1 hE, rankEq_iff_eRk.1 hF, rankEq_iff_eRk.1 hEF, ← Nat.cast_add,
    hmn] at h
  have hle : (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).eRk ((E ⊓ F : ClosedIF k K) : Set K) ≤ i := by
    have h' := enat_le_sub_of_add_le h
    rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] at h'
  have hge : (i : ℕ∞) ≤
      (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).eRk ((E ⊓ F : ClosedIF k K) : Set K) := by
    rw [← rankEq_iff_eRk.1 hG]
    exact (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).eRk_mono
      (hGle : (G : Set K) ⊆ ((E ⊓ F : ClosedIF k K) : Set K))
  exact (RankEq.eq_of_le hGle hG (rankEq_iff_eRk.2 (le_antisymm hle hge))).symm

name: AclGeom.RankEq.sup_point_of_not_le
statement:
theorem RankEq.sup_point_of_not_le {m : ℕ} {E : ClosedIF k K} (hE : RankEq m E)
    {P : Point k K} (hP : ¬ P.1 ≤ E) : RankEq (m + 1) (E ⊔ P.1)
proof:
:= by
  have hEr := rankEq_iff_eRk.1 hE
  have hPr := rankEq_iff_eRk.1 (Point.rankEq_one P)
  have hrep : P.rep ∉ (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).closure (E : Set K) := by
    rw [algebraicMatroid_closure_eq_racl]
    intro hmem
    apply hP
    rw [← P.point_rep]
    exact ClosedIF.point_le_iff.2 ((isRAC_iff_racl_eq.1 E.2).le hmem)
  have hsub : insert P.rep (E : Set K) ⊆ ((E ⊔ P.1 : ClosedIF k K) : Set K) := by
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with rfl | hx
    · exact (le_sup_right : P.1 ≤ E ⊔ P.1) P.mem_rep
    · exact (le_sup_left : E ≤ E ⊔ P.1) hx
  have hlow : (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).eRk (insert P.rep (E : Set K)) =
      (m : ℕ∞) + 1 := by
    rw [Matroid.eRk_insert_eq_add_one (M := AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K)
      (X := (E : Set K)) (e := P.rep) ((Set.mem_sdiff P.rep).2 ⟨by simp, hrep⟩), hEr]
  have hup : (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).eRk ((E ⊔ P.1 : ClosedIF k K) : Set K) ≤
      (m : ℕ∞) + 1 := by
    have h := eRk_sup_le E P.1
    rwa [hEr, hPr, Nat.cast_one] at h
  have hge : (m : ℕ∞) + 1 ≤
      (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).eRk ((E ⊔ P.1 : ClosedIF k K) : Set K) := by
    rw [← hlow]
    exact (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).eRk_mono hsub
  apply rankEq_iff_eRk.2
  rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  exact le_antisymm hup hge

name: AclGeom.le_sup_point_of_le_sup_point
statement:
private theorem le_sup_point_of_le_sup_point {m : ℕ} {E : ClosedIF k K} (hE : RankEq m E)
    {P Q : Point k K} (h : P.1 ≤ E ⊔ Q.1) (hP : ¬ P.1 ≤ E) : Q.1 ≤ E ⊔ P.1
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : ¬ Q.1 ≤ E := fun hQ ↦ hP (h.trans (sup_le le_rfl hQ))
  have heq : E ⊔ P.1 = E ⊔ Q.1 :=
    RankEq.eq_of_le (sup_le le_sup_left h) (RankEq.sup_point_of_not_le hE hP)
      (RankEq.sup_point_of_not_le hE hQ)
  rw [heq]
  exact le_sup_right

name: AclGeom.eRk_le_two
statement:
private theorem eRk_le_two (P Q : Point k K) :
    (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).eRk ((P.1 ⊔ Q.1 : ClosedIF k K) : Set K) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := eRk_sup_le P.1 Q.1
  rw [rankEq_iff_eRk.1 (Point.rankEq_one P), rankEq_iff_eRk.1 (Point.rankEq_one Q)] at h
  exact h.trans (by norm_num)

name: AclGeom.rankEq_two_of_rankEq_four
statement:
private theorem rankEq_two_of_rankEq_four {E F : ClosedIF k K}
    (hE : (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).eRk (E : Set K) ≤ 2)
    (hF : (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).eRk (F : Set K) ≤ 2)
    (hEF : RankEq 4 (E ⊔ F)) : RankEq 2 E
proof:
:= by
  have h := eRk_sup_le E F
  rw [rankEq_iff_eRk.1 hEF] at h
  apply rankEq_iff_eRk.2
  lift (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).eRk (E : Set K) to ℕ using
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (by simp) hE with x
  lift (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid k K).eRk (F : Set K) to ℕ using
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top (by simp) hF with y
  norm_cast at hE hF h ⊢
  omega

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCore.rankEq_A
statement: theorem PsiCore.rankEq_A (hw : w.PsiCore) : RankEq 2 w.A
proof:
:=
  rankEq_two_of_rankEq_four (eRk_le_two w.A₁ w.A₂) (eRk_le_two w.B₁ w.B₂) hw.rank_AB

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCore.rankEq_B
statement: theorem PsiCore.rankEq_B (hw : w.PsiCore) : RankEq 2 w.B
proof:
:=
  rankEq_two_of_rankEq_four (eRk_le_two w.B₁ w.B₂) (eRk_le_two w.A₁ w.A₂)
    (RankEq.congr (sup_comm w.A w.B) hw.rank_AB)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCore.rankEq_C
statement: theorem PsiCore.rankEq_C (hw : w.PsiCore) : RankEq 2 w.C
proof:
:=
  rankEq_two_of_rankEq_four (eRk_le_two w.C₁ w.C₂) (eRk_le_two w.A₁ w.A₂)
    (RankEq.congr (sup_comm w.A w.C) hw.rank_AC)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.rankEq_A
statement: theorem Psi.rankEq_A (hw : w.Psi) : RankEq 2 w.A
proof: := hw.toCore.rankEq_A

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.rankEq_B
statement: theorem Psi.rankEq_B (hw : w.Psi) : RankEq 2 w.B
proof: := hw.toCore.rankEq_B

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.rankEq_C
statement: theorem Psi.rankEq_C (hw : w.Psi) : RankEq 2 w.C
proof: := hw.toCore.rankEq_C

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.A_inf_B
statement: private theorem Psi.A_inf_B (hw : w.Psi) : w.A ⊓ w.B = ⊥
proof:
:=
  inf_eq_of_rankEq (Psi.rankEq_A hw) (Psi.rankEq_B hw) hw.rank_AB (by norm_num)
    rankEq_zero_bot bot_le

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.A_inf_C
statement: private theorem Psi.A_inf_C (hw : w.Psi) : w.A ⊓ w.C = ⊥
proof:
:=
  inf_eq_of_rankEq (Psi.rankEq_A hw) (Psi.rankEq_C hw) hw.rank_AC (by norm_num)
    rankEq_zero_bot bot_le

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.B_inf_C
statement: private theorem Psi.B_inf_C (hw : w.Psi) : w.B ⊓ w.C = ⊥
proof:
:=
  inf_eq_of_rankEq (Psi.rankEq_B hw) (Psi.rankEq_C hw) hw.rank_BC (by norm_num)
    rankEq_zero_bot bot_le

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.AC_eq
statement: private theorem Psi.AC_eq (hw : w.Psi) : w.A ⊔ w.C = w.A ⊔ w.B ⊔ w.C
proof:
:=
  RankEq.eq_of_le (sup_le (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left) le_sup_right) hw.rank_AC
    hw.rank_ABC

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.B_le_AC
statement: private theorem Psi.B_le_AC (hw : w.Psi) : w.B ≤ w.A ⊔ w.C
proof:
:= by
  rw [Psi.AC_eq hw]
  exact le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.X_not_le_A
statement: private theorem Psi.X_not_le_A (hw : w.Psi) : ¬ w.X.1 ≤ w.A
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ hw.X_notLe (h.trans (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left))

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.Y_not_le_B
statement: private theorem Psi.Y_not_le_B (hw : w.Psi) : ¬ w.Y.1 ≤ w.B
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ hw.Y_notLe (h.trans (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left))

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.AX_inf_AC
statement: private theorem Psi.AX_inf_AC (hw : w.Psi) : (w.A ⊔ w.X.1) ⊓ (w.A ⊔ w.C) = w.A
proof:
:= by
  have hXAC : ¬ w.X.1 ≤ w.A ⊔ w.C := by
    rw [Psi.AC_eq hw]
    exact hw.X_notLe
  have h3 := RankEq.sup_point_of_not_le (Psi.rankEq_A hw) (Psi.X_not_le_A hw)
  have h5 := RankEq.sup_point_of_not_le hw.rank_AC hXAC
  have hj : (w.A ⊔ w.X.1) ⊔ (w.A ⊔ w.C) = (w.A ⊔ w.C) ⊔ w.X.1 := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact sup_le (sup_le (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left) le_sup_right) le_sup_left
    · exact sup_le (sup_le (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left) (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_right))
        (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left)
  exact inf_eq_of_rankEq h3 hw.rank_AC (RankEq.congr hj.symm h5) (by norm_num)
    (Psi.rankEq_A hw) (le_inf le_sup_left le_sup_left)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.BY_inf_AC
statement: private theorem Psi.BY_inf_AC (hw : w.Psi) : (w.B ⊔ w.Y.1) ⊓ (w.A ⊔ w.C) = w.B
proof:
:= by
  have hYAC : ¬ w.Y.1 ≤ w.A ⊔ w.C := by
    rw [Psi.AC_eq hw]
    exact hw.Y_notLe
  have hB := Psi.B_le_AC hw
  have h3 := RankEq.sup_point_of_not_le (Psi.rankEq_B hw) (Psi.Y_not_le_B hw)
  have h5 := RankEq.sup_point_of_not_le hw.rank_AC hYAC
  have hj : (w.B ⊔ w.Y.1) ⊔ (w.A ⊔ w.C) = (w.A ⊔ w.C) ⊔ w.Y.1 := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact sup_le (sup_le (hB.trans le_sup_left) le_sup_right) le_sup_left
    · exact sup_le le_sup_right (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left)
  exact inf_eq_of_rankEq h3 hw.rank_AC (RankEq.congr hj.symm h5) (by norm_num)
    (Psi.rankEq_B hw) (le_inf le_sup_left hB)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.S_ne_T
statement: private theorem Psi.S_ne_T (hw : w.Psi) : w.S ≠ w.T
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply Point.not_le_bot w.S
  refine (le_inf hw.S_le ?_).trans (Psi.A_inf_B hw).le
  rw [h]
  exact hw.T_le

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.T_ne_U
statement: private theorem Psi.T_ne_U (hw : w.Psi) : w.T ≠ w.U
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply Point.not_le_bot w.T
  refine (le_inf hw.T_le ?_).trans (Psi.B_inf_C hw).le
  rw [h]
  exact hw.U_le

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.U_le_ST
statement: private theorem Psi.U_le_ST (hw : w.Psi) : w.U.1 ≤ w.S.1 ⊔ w.T.1
proof:
:= by
  have hTS : ¬ w.T.1 ≤ w.S.1 := fun h ↦ Psi.S_ne_T hw (Point.eq_of_le h).symm
  have heq : w.S.1 ⊔ w.T.1 = w.S.1 ⊔ (w.T.1 ⊔ w.U.1) :=
    RankEq.eq_of_le (sup_le_sup_left le_sup_left _)
      (RankEq.sup_point_of_not_le (Point.rankEq_one w.S) hTS) hw.rank_STU
  rw [heq]
  exact le_sup_right.trans le_sup_right

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.S_le_TU
statement: private theorem Psi.S_le_TU (hw : w.Psi) : w.S.1 ≤ w.T.1 ⊔ w.U.1
proof:
:= by
  have hUT : ¬ w.U.1 ≤ w.T.1 := fun h ↦ Psi.T_ne_U hw (Point.eq_of_le h).symm
  have heq : w.T.1 ⊔ w.U.1 = w.S.1 ⊔ (w.T.1 ⊔ w.U.1) :=
    RankEq.eq_of_le le_sup_right
      (RankEq.sup_point_of_not_le (Point.rankEq_one w.T) hUT) hw.rank_STU
  rw [heq]
  exact le_sup_left

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.H_not_le_U
statement: private theorem Psi.H_not_le_U (hw : w.Psi) : ¬ w.H.1 ≤ w.U.1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hHU : w.H = w.U := Point.eq_of_le h
  apply Point.not_le_bot w.U
  refine (le_inf ?_ hw.U_le).trans (Psi.A_inf_C hw).le
  rw [← hHU, ← hw.meet_H]
  exact inf_le_right

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.G_ne_U
statement: private theorem Psi.G_ne_U (hw : w.Psi) : w.G ≠ w.U
proof:
:= by
  intro hGU
  apply Psi.H_not_le_U hw
  rw [← hw.meet_H, hGU, sup_idem]
  exact inf_le_left

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.G_le_AC
statement: private theorem Psi.G_le_AC (hw : w.Psi) : w.G.1 ≤ w.A ⊔ w.C
proof:
:= by
  have hH : w.H.1 ≤ w.U.1 ⊔ w.G.1 := by
    rw [← hw.meet_H]
    exact inf_le_left
  have hHA : w.H.1 ≤ w.A := by
    rw [← hw.meet_H]
    exact inf_le_right
  have hG : w.G.1 ≤ w.U.1 ⊔ w.H.1 :=
    le_sup_point_of_le_sup_point (Point.rankEq_one w.U) hH (Psi.H_not_le_U hw)
  exact hG.trans (sup_le (hw.U_le.trans le_sup_right) (hHA.trans le_sup_left))

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.I_eq_D_of_G_eq_T
statement: private theorem Psi.I_eq_D_of_G_eq_T (hw : w.Psi) (hGT : w.G = w.T) : w.I = w.D
proof:
:= by
  have hSH : w.S.1 ≤ w.H.1 := by
    rw [← hw.meet_H, hGT]
    exact le_inf ((Psi.S_le_TU hw).trans (sup_comm _ _).le) hw.S_le
  have hHS : w.H = w.S := (Point.eq_of_le hSH).symm
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [← hw.meet_I, ← hw.meet_D, hHS]
  exact inf_comm _ _

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.Q_ne_T
statement: theorem Psi.Q_ne_T (hw : w.Psi) (hID : w.I ≠ w.D) : w.Q ≠ w.T
proof:
:= by
  intro hQT
  have hTG : w.T.1 ≤ w.G.1 := by
    rw [← hw.meet_G, hQT]
    exact le_inf le_sup_right le_sup_left
  exact hID (Psi.I_eq_D_of_G_eq_T hw (Point.eq_of_le hTG).symm)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.P_le_A
statement: theorem Psi.P_le_A (hw : w.Psi) (hID : w.I ≠ w.D) : w.P.1 ≤ w.A
proof:
:= by
  
  have hYAX : w.Y.1 ≤ w.A ⊔ w.X.1 :=
    le_sup_point_of_le_sup_point (Psi.rankEq_A hw) hw.X_le (Psi.X_not_le_A hw)
  have hYS : ¬ w.Y.1 ≤ w.S.1 :=
    fun h ↦ hw.Y_notLe (h.trans (hw.S_le.trans (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left)))
  have hYSX : ¬ w.Y.1 ≤ w.S.1 ⊔ w.X.1 := fun h ↦
    hw.X_free w.S hw.S_le (le_sup_point_of_le_sup_point (Point.rankEq_one w.S) h hYS)
  have hDSX : w.D.1 ≤ w.S.1 ⊔ w.X.1 := by
    rw [← hw.meet_D]
    exact inf_le_right
  have hDPY : w.D.1 ≤ w.P.1 ⊔ w.Y.1 := by
    rw [← hw.meet_D]
    exact inf_le_left
  have hDY : ¬ w.D.1 ≤ w.Y.1 := fun h ↦ hYSX (by
    rw [← (Point.eq_of_le h : w.D = w.Y)]
    exact hDSX)
  have hPYD : w.P.1 ≤ w.Y.1 ⊔ w.D.1 :=
    le_sup_point_of_le_sup_point (Point.rankEq_one w.Y) (hDPY.trans (sup_comm _ _).le) hDY
  have hPAX : w.P.1 ≤ w.A ⊔ w.X.1 :=
    hPYD.trans (sup_le hYAX (hDSX.trans (sup_le_sup_right hw.S_le _)))
  
  have hGT : ¬ w.G.1 ≤ w.T.1 :=
    fun h ↦ hID (Psi.I_eq_D_of_G_eq_T hw (Point.eq_of_le h))
  have hGPT : w.G.1 ≤ w.P.1 ⊔ w.T.1 := by
    rw [← hw.meet_G]
    exact inf_le_left
  have hPTG : w.P.1 ≤ w.T.1 ⊔ w.G.1 :=
    le_sup_point_of_le_sup_point (Point.rankEq_one w.T) (hGPT.trans (sup_comm _ _).le) hGT
  have hPAC : w.P.1 ≤ w.A ⊔ w.C :=
    hPTG.trans (sup_le (hw.T_le.trans (Psi.B_le_AC hw)) (Psi.G_le_AC hw))
  rw [← Psi.AX_inf_AC hw]
  exact le_inf hPAX hPAC

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.P_ne_S
statement: theorem Psi.P_ne_S (hw : w.Psi) : w.P ≠ w.S
proof:
:= by
  intro hPS
  apply Psi.G_ne_U hw
  have hSD : w.S.1 ≤ w.D.1 := by
    rw [← hw.meet_D, hPS]
    exact le_inf le_sup_left le_sup_left
  have hDS : w.D = w.S := (Point.eq_of_le hSD).symm
  have hUF : w.U.1 ≤ w.F.1 := by
    rw [← hw.meet_F, hDS]
    exact le_inf le_sup_left ((Psi.U_le_ST hw).trans (sup_comm _ _).le)
  have hFU : w.F = w.U := (Point.eq_of_le hUF).symm
  have hUR : w.U.1 ≤ w.R.1 := by
    rw [← hw.meet_R, hFU]
    exact le_inf le_sup_left hw.U_le
  have hRU : w.R = w.U := (Point.eq_of_le hUR).symm
  have hUG : w.U.1 ≤ w.G.1 := by
    rw [← hw.meet_G, hPS, hRU]
    exact le_inf (Psi.U_le_ST hw) le_sup_right
  exact (Point.eq_of_le hUG).symm

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.Q_le_B
statement: theorem Psi.Q_le_B (hw : w.Psi) : w.Q.1 ≤ w.B
proof:
:= by
  
  have hZTY : ¬ w.Z.1 ≤ w.T.1 ⊔ w.Y.1 := hw.Z_freeB w.T hw.T_le
  have hET : w.E.1 ≤ w.T.1 ⊔ w.Y.1 := by
    rw [← hw.meet_E]
    exact inf_le_left
  have hEQZ : w.E.1 ≤ w.Q.1 ⊔ w.Z.1 := by
    rw [← hw.meet_E]
    exact inf_le_right
  have hEZ : ¬ w.E.1 ≤ w.Z.1 := fun h ↦ hZTY (by
    rw [← (Point.eq_of_le h : w.E = w.Z)]
    exact hET)
  have hQZE : w.Q.1 ≤ w.Z.1 ⊔ w.E.1 :=
    le_sup_point_of_le_sup_point (Point.rankEq_one w.Z) (hEQZ.trans (sup_comm _ _).le) hEZ
  have hQBY : w.Q.1 ≤ w.B ⊔ w.Y.1 :=
    hQZE.trans (sup_le (hw.Z_le.trans inf_le_left) (hET.trans (sup_le_sup_right hw.T_le _)))
  
  have hRC : w.R.1 ≤ w.C := by
    rw [← hw.meet_R]
    exact inf_le_right
  have hGC : ¬ w.G.1 ≤ w.C := by
    intro h
    apply Point.not_le_bot w.H
    have hH : w.H.1 ≤ w.C ⊓ w.A := by
      rw [← hw.meet_H]
      exact inf_le_inf_right _ (sup_le hw.U_le h)
    exact hH.trans ((inf_comm _ _).le.trans (Psi.A_inf_C hw).le)
  have hGR : ¬ w.G.1 ≤ w.R.1 := fun h ↦ hGC (h.trans hRC)
  have hGQR : w.G.1 ≤ w.Q.1 ⊔ w.R.1 := by
    rw [← hw.meet_G]
    exact inf_le_right
  have hQRG : w.Q.1 ≤ w.R.1 ⊔ w.G.1 :=
    le_sup_point_of_le_sup_point (Point.rankEq_one w.R) (hGQR.trans (sup_comm _ _).le) hGR
  have hQAC : w.Q.1 ≤ w.A ⊔ w.C :=
    hQRG.trans (sup_le (hRC.trans le_sup_right) (Psi.G_le_AC hw))
  rw [← Psi.BY_inf_AC hw]
  exact le_inf hQBY hQAC

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.D_not_le_ABC
statement:
theorem Psi.D_not_le_ABC (hw : w.Psi) (hID : w.I ≠ w.D) :
    ¬ w.D.1 ≤ w.A ⊔ w.B ⊔ w.C
proof:
:= by
  intro hD
  have hDSX : w.D.1 ≤ w.S.1 ⊔ w.X.1 := by
    rw [← hw.meet_D]
    exact inf_le_right
  have hDS : w.D.1 ≤ w.S.1 := by
    by_contra h
    have hX := le_sup_point_of_le_sup_point (Point.rankEq_one w.S) hDSX h
    exact hw.X_notLe (hX.trans
      (sup_le (hw.S_le.trans (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left)) hD))
  have hDS' : w.D = w.S := Point.eq_of_le hDS
  have hDP : ¬ w.D.1 ≤ w.P.1 := fun h ↦
    hw.P_ne_S ((Point.eq_of_le h).symm.trans hDS')
  have hDPY : w.D.1 ≤ w.P.1 ⊔ w.Y.1 := by
    rw [← hw.meet_D]
    exact inf_le_left
  have hY := le_sup_point_of_le_sup_point (Point.rankEq_one w.P) hDPY hDP
  exact hw.Y_notLe ((hY.trans (sup_le (hw.P_le_A hID)
    (hDS.trans hw.S_le))).trans (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left))

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.D_ne_S
statement: theorem Psi.D_ne_S (hw : w.Psi) (hID : w.I ≠ w.D) : w.D ≠ w.S
proof:
:= by
  intro hDS
  apply hw.D_not_le_ABC hID
  rw [hDS]
  exact hw.S_le.trans (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.F_ne_U
statement: theorem Psi.F_ne_U (hw : w.Psi) (hID : w.I ≠ w.D) : w.F ≠ w.U
proof:
:= by
  intro hFU
  have hUTD : w.U.1 ≤ w.T.1 ⊔ w.D.1 := by
    rw [← hFU, ← hw.meet_F]
    exact inf_le_right
  have hUT : ¬ w.U.1 ≤ w.T.1 := fun h ↦
    Psi.T_ne_U hw (Point.eq_of_le h).symm
  have hDTU := le_sup_point_of_le_sup_point (Point.rankEq_one w.T) hUTD hUT
  exact hw.D_not_le_ABC hID (hDTU.trans
    (sup_le (hw.T_le.trans (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left))
      (hw.U_le.trans le_sup_right)))

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.G_ne_T
statement: theorem Psi.G_ne_T (hw : w.Psi) (hID : w.I ≠ w.D) : w.G ≠ w.T
proof:
:=
  fun hGT ↦ hID (Psi.I_eq_D_of_G_eq_T hw hGT)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.H_ne_S
statement: theorem Psi.H_ne_S (hw : w.Psi) (hID : w.I ≠ w.D) : w.H ≠ w.S
proof:
:= by
  intro hHS
  apply hID
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [← hw.meet_I, ← hw.meet_D, hHS]
  exact inf_comm _ _

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.sAaGroupedStableSourceChart_bGermCoefficient_apply
statement:
theorem sAaGroupedStableSourceChart_bGermCoefficient_apply
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b))
    (z : w.bGermCoefficientField hψ) :
    R.sAaGroupedStableSourceChart L hind
        (R.bGermCoefficientToSAaGroupedStableSource L hind z) =
      R.groupedStableSourceSA L hind z
proof:
:= by
  let C := R.sAaGroupedSourceClosureExtension L hind
  change C.pullbackEquiv (R.groupedStableSourceField L hind)
      (algebraMap _ _ (R.bGermCoefficientToRightASourceRingHom L hind z)) =
    R.groupedJointCoverToStableSourceRingHom L hind
      (R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightAJointRingHom L hind
        (R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom L hind z))
  rw [C.pullbackEquiv_algebraMap]
  exact congrArg (R.groupedJointCoverToStableSourceRingHom L hind)
    (congrArg (R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightAJointRingHom L hind)
      (DFunLike.congr_fun
        (R.rightASourceChart_comp_bGermCoefficient L hind) z))

name: AclGeom.QWitness.exists_psiChunkProjection_of_relation
statement:
theorem exists_psiChunkProjection_of_relation [IsAlgClosed K]
    (hψ : w.Psi) {a b c : Fin 2 → K}
    (habc : w.psiFamilyCompositionRelation a b c) :
    ∃ s t u : K, w.psiChunkProjectionRelation a b c s t u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : Fin 6 → Fin 9 := ![0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
  have he (i : Fin 6) : w.abcStuReps (e i) = w.abcReps i := by
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hfix⟩ := exists_tuple_relocation_fixing_locus
    habc he (w.abcStuReps_mem_racl_abcReps hψ)
  refine ⟨v 6, v 7, v 8, ?_⟩
  have hvtuple : v = chunkProjectionTuple a b c (v 6) (v 7) (v 8) := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · simpa [e, compositionParameterTuple, chunkProjectionTuple] using
        hfix (0 : Fin 6)
    · simpa [e, compositionParameterTuple, chunkProjectionTuple] using
        hfix (1 : Fin 6)
    · simpa [e, compositionParameterTuple, chunkProjectionTuple] using
        hfix (2 : Fin 6)
    · simpa [e, compositionParameterTuple, chunkProjectionTuple] using
        hfix (3 : Fin 6)
    · simpa [e, compositionParameterTuple, chunkProjectionTuple] using
        hfix (4 : Fin 6)
    · simpa [e, compositionParameterTuple, chunkProjectionTuple] using
        hfix (5 : Fin 6)
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · rfl
  change idealOf k (chunkProjectionTuple a b c (v 6) (v 7) (v 8)) =
    idealOf k w.abcStuReps
  rw [← hvtuple]
  exact hv

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiChunkProjectionRelation.psiFamilyComposition
statement:
theorem PsiChunkProjectionRelation.psiFamilyComposition
    {a b c : Fin 2 → K} {s t u : K}
    (h : w.psiChunkProjectionRelation a b c s t u) :
    w.psiFamilyCompositionRelation a b c
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin 6 → Fin 9 := ![0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
  have ht := idealOf_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq h e
  have hleft :
      chunkProjectionTuple a b c s t u ∘ e =
        compositionParameterTuple a b c := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hright : w.abcStuReps ∘ e = w.abcReps := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  rw [hleft, hright] at ht
  exact ht

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiChunkProjectionRelation.parameterMultiplication
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin 3 → Fin 9 := ![6, 7, 8]
  have ht := idealOf_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq h e
  have hleft : chunkProjectionTuple a b c s t u ∘ e = ![s, t, u] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hright :
      w.abcStuReps ∘ e =
        (IsPartialQuadrangle.parameterMultiplication hquad).tuple := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  rw [hleft, hright] at ht
  exact ht

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiChunkProjectionRelation.cProjection

name: AclGeom.QWitness.bT_span_eq_bReps

      ⨆ i, ClosedIF.point k (w.bReps i)

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.sAcSelectedGraphRight_left_comp_bGermCoefficient
statement:
theorem sAcSelectedGraphRight_left_comp_bGermCoefficient
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :
    (R.sAcSelectedGraphRightCompositionTriangle L hind).left.toRingHom.comp
        (R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom L hind) =
      R.sAcBGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightMiddleCommonRingHom L hind
proof:
:= by
  let P :=
    PsiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization.CommonBaseData.aCorrespondencePair
      (R := R.sAc) R.sAcCommonBaseData hψ
  let Q :=
    PsiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization.CommonBaseData.bCorrespondencePair
      (R := R.sAc) R.sAcCommonBaseData hψ
  let h :=
    PsiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization.CommonBaseData.aPair_target_eq_bPair_source
      (R := R.sAc) R.sAcCommonBaseData hψ
  let N := R.selectedGraphRightSourceCover L hind
  change
    (FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.OnSourceCover.leftEquiv
      P Q h N).toRingHom.comp
        (R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom L hind) =
      R.sAcBGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightMiddleCommonRingHom L hind
  calc
    _ = (FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.OnSourceCover.leftEquiv
          P Q h N).toRingHom.comp
        ((algebraMap (↥R.sAcCommonBaseData.coefficientField)
          (↥N.field)).comp
            (R.seBGermCoefficientToCommonCoefficientRingHom L)) :=
      congrArg
        ((FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.OnSourceCover.leftEquiv
          P Q h N).toRingHom.comp)
        (R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom_eq_commonCoefficient
          L hind)
    _ = (algebraMap (↥R.sAcCommonBaseData.coefficientField)
          (↥(FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.OnSourceCover.middleCover
            P Q h N).field)).comp
        (R.seBGermCoefficientToCommonCoefficientRingHom L) :=
      finiteCoverTriangle_left_comp_algebraMap_comp P Q h N
        (R.seBGermCoefficientToCommonCoefficientRingHom L)
    _ = R.sAcBGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightMiddleCommonRingHom L hind := rfl

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.sAcRightSemilinear_left_comp_bGermCoefficient
statement:
theorem sAcRightSemilinear_left_comp_bGermCoefficient
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :
    (R.sAcRightSemilinearCompositionTriangle L hind).left.toRingHom.comp
        (R.bGermCoefficientToRightCSourceRingHom L hind) =
      R.sAcBGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightMiddleCommonRingHom L hind
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro z
  have hsource := DFunLike.congr_fun
    (R.rightCSourceChart_comp_bGermCoefficient L hind) z
  have hleft := DFunLike.congr_fun
    (R.sAcSelectedGraphRight_left_comp_bGermCoefficient L hind) z
  change (R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightCRingEquiv L hind).symm
      (R.bGermCoefficientToRightCSourceRingHom L hind z) =
    R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom L hind z at hsource
  change (R.sAcSelectedGraphRightCompositionTriangle L hind).left
      (R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom L hind z) =
    R.sAcBGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightMiddleCommonRingHom L hind z at hleft
  change (R.sAcSelectedGraphRightCompositionTriangle L hind).left
      ((R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightCRingEquiv L hind).symm
        (R.bGermCoefficientToRightCSourceRingHom L hind z)) = _
  exact (congrArg
    (R.sAcSelectedGraphRightCompositionTriangle L hind).left hsource).trans hleft

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.repeatedSCommonBranchEquiv_target
statement:
@[simp] theorem repeatedSCommonBranchEquiv_target
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :
    R.repeatedSCommonBranchEquiv hind
        ⟨R.se.middle, by
          change
            (PsiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization.CommonBaseData.aCorrespondencePair
              (R := R.se) R.seCommonBaseData hψ).target ∈
                (PsiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization.CommonBaseData.aCorrespondencePair
                  (R := R.se) R.seCommonBaseData hψ).branchField
          exact subset_adjoin _ _ (by simp)⟩ =
      ⟨R.sb.middle, by
        change
          (PsiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization.CommonBaseData.aCorrespondencePair
            (R := R.sb) R.sbCommonBaseData hψ).target ∈
              (PsiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization.CommonBaseData.aCorrespondencePair
                (R := R.sb) R.sbCommonBaseData hψ).branchField
        exact subset_adjoin _ _ (by simp)⟩
proof:
:= by
  exact FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.branchEquivOfIdealEq_target
    R.seCommonBaseData.coefficientField
    (PsiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization.CommonBaseData.aCorrespondencePair
      (R := R.se) R.seCommonBaseData hψ)
    (PsiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization.CommonBaseData.aCorrespondencePair
      (R := R.sb) R.sbCommonBaseData hψ)
    R.repeatedSCommonCorrespondencePair_source_eq
    (R.repeatedSCommonCorrespondencePair_ideal_eq hind)

    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :

            (commonCurveEmbedding (k := k) (K := K) ∘ D.sA))))
          (Set.range R.repeatedSAAuxiliaryInput)).restrictScalars k))
        ![R.sAa.source, R.sAa.middle] =

          (Set.range R.repeatedSAAuxiliaryInput)).restrictScalars k))
        ![R.sAc.source, R.sAc.middle]
proof:
:= by
  apply pairIdeal_eq_over_independentExtension_of_pairIdeal_eq
    R.repeatedSAPairIdeal_eq_over_parameterField
  · apply auxiliary_independent_over_parameterPairField
    · simpa only [R.sAa_source] using
        R.repeatedSA_auxiliary_parameter_source_independent hind
    · exact (R.sAa.aCorrespondenceFamilyMember hψ).target_mem_parameter_source
  · apply auxiliary_independent_over_parameterPairField
    · simpa only [R.sAc_source] using

    (R.repeatedUAlternativeBasedBranchEquiv hind).map_selected,
    (R.repeatedUBAlternativeBasedBranchEquiv hind).map_selected⟩

statement:
theorem repeatedSACoefficientBranchNormalField_contains
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :
    R.commonCoefficientNormalOverRepeatedSA.restrictScalars k ≤
        (R.repeatedSACoefficientBranchNormalField hind).restrictScalars k ∧
      (FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.firstBranchOverSource
          R.repeatedSAAlternativeInputField
          (R.repeatedSAFirstAlternativePair hind)).restrictScalars k ≤
        (R.repeatedSACoefficientBranchNormalField hind).restrictScalars k ∧
      (FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.secondBranchOverSource
          R.repeatedSAAlternativeInputField
          (R.repeatedSAFirstAlternativePair hind)
          (R.repeatedSASecondAlternativePair hind)
          (R.repeatedSAAlternativePair_source_eq hind)).restrictScalars k ≤
        (R.repeatedSACoefficientBranchNormalField hind).restrictScalars k
proof:
:= by
  letI := R.commonCoefficientNormalOverRepeatedSA_finiteDimensional
  exact ⟨FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.coefficientExtension_le_normalField
      R.repeatedSAAlternativeInputField
      (R.repeatedSAFirstAlternativePair hind)
      (R.repeatedSASecondAlternativePair hind)
      (R.repeatedSAAlternativePair_source_eq hind)
      R.commonCoefficientNormalOverRepeatedSA,
    FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.firstBranch_le_normalField
      R.repeatedSAAlternativeInputField
      (R.repeatedSAFirstAlternativePair hind)
      (R.repeatedSASecondAlternativePair hind)
      (R.repeatedSAAlternativePair_source_eq hind)
      R.commonCoefficientNormalOverRepeatedSA,
    FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.secondBranch_le_normalField
      R.repeatedSAAlternativeInputField
      (R.repeatedSAFirstAlternativePair hind)
      (R.repeatedSASecondAlternativePair hind)
      (R.repeatedSAAlternativePair_source_eq hind)
      R.commonCoefficientNormalOverRepeatedSA⟩

      exact subset_adjoin _ _ (by simp)⟩
  have hmap := congrArg (fun f ↦ f.toAlgHom x)
    (R.repeatedSBranchAlignmentAut_smul hind)
  change R.repeatedSBranchAlignmentAut hind
      ((R.seSelectedLeftBranchInComparisonSourceCover hind).toAlgHom x) =
    (R.sbSelectedLeftBranchInComparisonSourceCover hind).toAlgHom
      (R.repeatedSCommonBranchEquiv hind x) at hmap
  have hxy : R.repeatedSCommonBranchEquiv hind x = y := by
    simpa only [x, y] using R.repeatedSCommonBranchEquiv_target hind
  have htarget := congrArg
    (R.sbSelectedLeftBranchInComparisonSourceCover hind).toAlgHom hxy
  simpa only [x, y] using hmap.trans htarget

name: AclGeom.partialQuad_tuple_span
statement:
private theorem partialQuad_tuple_span {ι : Type*} {f : Fin 6 → Point k K}
    (h : IsPartialQuadrangle f) (v : ι → K)
    (hsub : range v ⊆ range (fun i ↦ (f i).rep))
    (hfreeMem : {(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep, (f 3).rep} ⊆ range v) :
    racl k (range v) = (Finset.univ.sup fun i ↦ (f i).1).1
proof:
:= by
  let T : ClosedIF k K := Finset.univ.sup fun i ↦ (f i).1
  let C : ClosedIF k K := ⟨racl k (range v), isRAC_racl _⟩
  have hpt (i : Fin 6) : (f i).1 ≤ T :=
    Finset.le_sup (f := fun j : Fin 6 ↦ (f j).1) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hmem (i : Fin 6) : (f i).rep ∈ T.1 := ClosedIF.le_iff.1 (hpt i) (f i).mem_rep
  have hCT : C ≤ T := by
    apply ClosedIF.le_iff.2
    refine (racl_mono ?_).trans_eq (isRAC_iff_racl_eq.mp T.2)
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hsub ha
    exact hmem i
  have htoC (i : Fin 6) (hi : (f i).rep ∈ range v) : (f i).1 ≤ C := by
    rw [← (f i).point_rep]
    exact ClosedIF.point_le_iff.2 (subset_racl k _ hi)
  have hfree : RankEq 3 ((f 0).1 ⊔ ((f 1).1 ⊔ (f 3).1)) := by
    simpa [Finset.sup_insert] using h.rank_free {0, 1, 3} (by decide) (by decide)
  have heq : (f 0).1 ⊔ ((f 1).1 ⊔ (f 3).1) = T :=
    RankEq.eq_of_le (sup_le (hpt 0) (sup_le (hpt 1) (hpt 3))) hfree h.rank_total
  have hTC : T ≤ C := by
    rw [← heq]
    exact sup_le (htoC 0 (hfreeMem (by simp)))
      (sup_le (htoC 1 (hfreeMem (by simp))) (htoC 3 (hfreeMem (by simp))))
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (le_antisymm hCT hTC)

name: AclGeom.partialQuad_family_ranks
statement:
private theorem partialQuad_family_ranks {f : Fin 6 → Point k K} (h : IsPartialQuadrangle f) :
    let x : Fin 2 → K
proof:
:= ![(f 1).rep, (f 3).rep]
    let y : Fin 1 → K := ![(f 5).rep]
    let z : Fin 2 → K := ![(f 0).rep, (f 4).rep]
    Algebra.trdeg k (adjoin k (range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z))) = 3 ∧
      Algebra.trdeg k (adjoin k (range y)) = 1 ∧
      Algebra.trdeg k (adjoin k (range (Sum.elim x y))) = 2 ∧
      Algebra.trdeg k (adjoin k (range (Sum.elim y z))) = 2 ∧
      (f 2).rep ∈ racl k (range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z)) := by
  let x : Fin 2 → K := ![(f 1).rep, (f 3).rep]
  let y : Fin 1 → K := ![(f 5).rep]
  let z : Fin 2 → K := ![(f 0).rep, (f 4).rep]
  let v := Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z
  have hspan : racl k (range v) = (Finset.univ.sup fun i ↦ (f i).1).1 :=
    partialQuad_tuple_span h v
      (by
        rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
        rcases i with (i | i) | i
        · fin_cases i <;> exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
        · fin_cases i; exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
        · fin_cases i <;> exact ⟨_, rfl⟩)
      (by
        intro a ha
        rcases ha with rfl | rfl | ha
        · exact ⟨Sum.inr 0, rfl⟩
        · exact ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inl 0), rfl⟩
        · have : a = (f 3).rep := Set.mem_singleton_iff.1 ha
          subst a
          exact ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inl 1), rfl⟩)
  have hxy : racl k (range (Sum.elim x y)) = ((f 1).1 ⊔ ((f 3).1 ⊔ (f 5).1)).1 := by
    have hr : range (Sum.elim x y) = {(f 1).rep, (f 3).rep, (f 5).rep} := by
      ext a
      simp [x, y, Set.Sum.elim_range]
      tauto
    rw [hr]
    exact racl_three_points _ _ _
  have hyz : racl k (range (Sum.elim y z)) = ((f 5).1 ⊔ ((f 0).1 ⊔ (f 4).1)).1 := by
    have hr : range (Sum.elim y z) = {(f 5).rep, (f 0).rep, (f 4).rep} := by
      ext a
      simp [y, z, Set.Sum.elim_range]
      tauto
    rw [hr]
    exact racl_three_points _ _ _
  have hy : racl k (range y) = (f 5).1.1 := by
    simpa [y] using (f 5).racl_repTuple
  have hryz : RankEq 2 ((f 5).1 ⊔ ((f 0).1 ⊔ (f 4).1)) := by
    simpa only [sup_assoc, sup_left_comm, sup_comm] using h.rank_STU'
  exact ⟨trdeg_of_closed_span v hspan h.rank_total,
    trdeg_of_closed_span y hy (f 5).rankEq_one,
    trdeg_of_closed_span (Sum.elim x y) hxy h.rank_S'TU',
    trdeg_of_closed_span (Sum.elim y z) hyz hryz,
    by
      rw [hspan]
      exact ClosedIF.le_iff.1
        (Finset.le_sup (f := fun j : Fin 6 ↦ (f j).1) (Finset.mem_univ 2)) (f 2).mem_rep⟩

name: AclGeom.locusProjection_dense
statement:
private theorem locusProjection_dense {ι κ : Type*} {a : ι → K} {b : κ → K} {g : κ → ι}
    (h : a ∘ g = b) :
    DenseRange (PrimeSpectrum.comap
      (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k a) (rename g)
        (idealOf_eq_comap_rename h).le).toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  apply (PrimeSpectrum.denseRange_comap_iff_ker_le_nilRadical _).2
  have hinj := Ideal.quotientMap_injective'
    (H := (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (k := k) h).le)
    (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (k := k) h).ge
  have hker : RingHom.ker (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k a) (rename g)
      (idealOf_eq_comap_rename h).le).toRingHom = ⊥ :=
    (RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot _).mp hinj
  rw [hker]
  exact bot_le

name: AclGeom.jointIdeal_minimal_of_rank
statement:
private theorem jointIdeal_minimal_of_rank {α β γ : Type*} [Finite α] [Finite β] [Finite γ]
    (x : α → K) (y : β → K) (z : γ → K)
    (hrank :
      Algebra.trdeg k (adjoin k (range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z))) +
          Algebra.trdeg k (adjoin k (range y)) =
        Algebra.trdeg k (adjoin k (range (Sum.elim x y))) +
          Algebra.trdeg k (adjoin k (range (Sum.elim y z)))) :
    idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z) ∈
      (Ideal.map (rename (Sum.inl : α ⊕ β → (α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) :
        MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k)
          (idealOf k (Sum.elim x y)) ⊔
        Ideal.map (rename (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) Sum.inr :
          β ⊕ γ → (α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) :
          MvPolynomial (β ⊕ γ) k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k)
          (idealOf k (Sum.elim y z))).minimalPrimes
proof:
:= by
  have hmin := (locusIncidence_jointPrime_dominating_of_rank (k := k) x y z hrank).1
  rw [Ideal.minimalPrimes_eq_comap]
  refine ⟨_, hmin, ?_⟩
  ext p
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, RingHom.mem_ker, mem_idealOf_iff]
  rfl

name: AclGeom.partialQuad_parameter_family_ranks
proof:
:= ![(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep]
    let y : Fin 1 → K := ![(f 2).rep]
    let z : Fin 2 → K := ![(f 3).rep, (f 4).rep]
    Algebra.trdeg k (adjoin k (range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z))) = 3 ∧
      Algebra.trdeg k (adjoin k (range y)) = 1 ∧
      Algebra.trdeg k (adjoin k (range (Sum.elim x y))) = 2 ∧
      Algebra.trdeg k (adjoin k (range (Sum.elim y z))) = 2 ∧
      (f 5).rep ∈ racl k (range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z)) := by
  let x : Fin 2 → K := ![(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep]
  let y : Fin 1 → K := ![(f 2).rep]
  let z : Fin 2 → K := ![(f 3).rep, (f 4).rep]
  let v := Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z
  have hspan : racl k (range v) = (Finset.univ.sup fun i ↦ (f i).1).1 :=
    partialQuad_tuple_span h v
      (by
        rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
        rcases i with (i | i) | i
        · fin_cases i <;> exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
        · fin_cases i; exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
        · fin_cases i <;> exact ⟨_, rfl⟩)
      (by
        intro a ha
        rcases ha with rfl | rfl | ha
        · exact ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inl 0), rfl⟩
        · exact ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inl 1), rfl⟩
        · have : a = (f 3).rep := Set.mem_singleton_iff.1 ha
          subst a
          exact ⟨Sum.inr 0, rfl⟩)
  have hxy : racl k (range (Sum.elim x y)) = ((f 0).1 ⊔ ((f 1).1 ⊔ (f 2).1)).1 := by
    have hr : range (Sum.elim x y) = {(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep, (f 2).rep} := by
      ext a
      simp [x, y, Set.Sum.elim_range]
      tauto
    rw [hr]
    exact racl_three_points _ _ _
  have hyz : racl k (range (Sum.elim y z)) = ((f 2).1 ⊔ ((f 3).1 ⊔ (f 4).1)).1 := by
    have hr : range (Sum.elim y z) = {(f 2).rep, (f 3).rep, (f 4).rep} := by
      ext a
      simp [y, z, Set.Sum.elim_range]
      tauto
    rw [hr]
    exact racl_three_points _ _ _
  have hy : racl k (range y) = (f 2).1.1 := by
    simpa [y] using (f 2).racl_repTuple
  have hryz : RankEq 2 ((f 2).1 ⊔ ((f 3).1 ⊔ (f 4).1)) := by
    simpa only [sup_assoc, sup_left_comm, sup_comm] using h.rank_S'T'U
  exact ⟨trdeg_of_closed_span v hspan h.rank_total,
    trdeg_of_closed_span y hy (f 2).rankEq_one,
    trdeg_of_closed_span (Sum.elim x y) hxy h.rank_STU,
    trdeg_of_closed_span (Sum.elim y z) hyz hryz,
    by
      rw [hspan]
      exact ClosedIF.le_iff.1
        (Finset.le_sup (f := fun j : Fin 6 ↦ (f j).1) (Finset.mem_univ 5)) (f 5).mem_rep⟩

name: AclGeom.finite_field_cover
statement:
private theorem finite_field_cover {ι κ : Type*} [Finite κ] (a : ι → K) (b : κ → K)
    (hsub : range a ⊆ range b) (halg : ∀ j, b j ∈ racl k (range a)) :
    FiniteDimensional (adjoin k (range a))
      (extendScalars (adjoin.mono k _ _ hsub))
proof:
:= by
  have heq : extendScalars (adjoin.mono k _ _ hsub) =
      adjoin (adjoin k (range a)) (range b) := by
    apply restrictScalars_injective k
    rw [extendScalars_restrictScalars, restrictScalars_adjoin_eq_sup, sup_eq_right.2
      (adjoin.mono k _ _ hsub)]
  rw [heq]
  exact finiteDimensional_adjoin
    (Set.forall_mem_range.2 fun j ↦ ((mem_racl_iff k).1 (halg j)).isIntegral)

name: AclGeom.tuple_dimension_eq
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, ht⟩ := exists_locusCoordinateRing_dimension (k := k) v
  have heq : d = n := by exact_mod_cast ht.symm.trans h
  simpa only [heq] using hd

name: AclGeom.IsPartialQuadrangle.parameter_family_components
proof:
:= ![(f 1).rep, (f 3).rep]
    let y : Fin 1 → K := ![(f 5).rep]
    let z : Fin 2 → K := ![(f 0).rep, (f 4).rep]
    let p : Fin 2 → K := ![(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep]
    let q : Fin 1 → K := ![(f 2).rep]
    let r : Fin 2 → K := ![(f 3).rep, (f 4).rep]
    idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z) ∈
      (Ideal.map (rename (Sum.inl : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 1 → (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin 2) :
          MvPolynomial (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 1) k →ₐ[k]
            MvPolynomial ((Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin 2) k) (idealOf k (Sum.elim x y)) ⊔
        Ideal.map (rename (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) Sum.inr :
          Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 2 → (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin 2) :
          MvPolynomial (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 2) k →ₐ[k]
            MvPolynomial ((Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin 2) k) (idealOf k (Sum.elim y z))).minimalPrimes ∧
    idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim p q) r) ∈
      (Ideal.map (rename (Sum.inl : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 1 → (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin 2) :
          MvPolynomial (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 1) k →ₐ[k]
            MvPolynomial ((Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin 2) k) (idealOf k (Sum.elim p q)) ⊔
        Ideal.map (rename (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) Sum.inr :
          Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 2 → (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin 2) :
          MvPolynomial (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 2) k →ₐ[k]
            MvPolynomial ((Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin 2) k) (idealOf k (Sum.elim q r))).minimalPrimes ∧
    ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial ((Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin 2) k ⧸
      idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z)) = 3 ∧
    ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial ((Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin 2) k ⧸
      idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim p q) r)) = 3 ∧
    ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 1) k ⧸
      idealOf k (Sum.elim p q)) = 2 ∧
    ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 2) k ⧸
      idealOf k (Sum.elim q r)) = 2 := by
  let x : Fin 2 → K := ![(f 1).rep, (f 3).rep]
  let y : Fin 1 → K := ![(f 5).rep]
  let z : Fin 2 → K := ![(f 0).rep, (f 4).rep]
  let p : Fin 2 → K := ![(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep]
  let q : Fin 1 → K := ![(f 2).rep]
  let r : Fin 2 → K := ![(f 3).rep, (f 4).rep]
  obtain ⟨hs, hy, hxy, hyz, -⟩ := partialQuad_family_ranks h
  obtain ⟨ht, hq, hpq, hqr, -⟩ := partialQuad_parameter_family_ranks h
  have hsource := jointIdeal_minimal_of_rank (k := k) x y z
    (by rw [hs, hy, hxy, hyz]; norm_num)
  have htarget := jointIdeal_minimal_of_rank (k := k) p q r
    (by rw [ht, hq, hpq, hqr]; norm_num)
  exact ⟨hsource, htarget, tuple_dimension_eq _ hs, tuple_dimension_eq _ ht,
    tuple_dimension_eq _ hpq, tuple_dimension_eq _ hqr⟩

name: AclGeom.IsPartialQuadrangle.family_common_function_field_cover
proof:
:= ![(f 1).rep, (f 3).rep]
    let y : Fin 1 → K := ![(f 5).rep]
    let z : Fin 2 → K := ![(f 0).rep, (f 4).rep]
    let p : Fin 2 → K := ![(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep]
    let q : Fin 1 → K := ![(f 2).rep]
    let r : Fin 2 → K := ![(f 3).rep, (f 4).rep]
    let W : Fin 6 → K := fun i ↦ (f i).rep
    let gS : ((Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin 2) → Fin 6 :=
      Sum.elim (Sum.elim ![1, 3] ![5]) ![0, 4]
    let gT : ((Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin 2) → Fin 6 :=
      Sum.elim (Sum.elim ![0, 1] ![2]) ![3, 4]
    let gM : (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 1) → Fin 6 := Sum.elim ![0, 1] ![2]
    let gΓ : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 2) → Fin 6 := Sum.elim ![2] ![3, 4]
    ∃ (hS : W ∘ gS = Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z)
      (hT : W ∘ gT = Sum.elim (Sum.elim p q) r)
      (hM : W ∘ gM = Sum.elim p q) (hΓ : W ∘ gΓ = Sum.elim q r),
      DenseRange (PrimeSpectrum.comap
        (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k W) (rename gS)
          (idealOf_eq_comap_rename hS).le).toRingHom) ∧
      DenseRange (PrimeSpectrum.comap
        (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k W) (rename gT)
          (idealOf_eq_comap_rename hT).le).toRingHom) ∧
      DenseRange (PrimeSpectrum.comap
        (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k W) (rename gM)
          (idealOf_eq_comap_rename hM).le).toRingHom) ∧
      DenseRange (PrimeSpectrum.comap
        (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k W) (rename gΓ)
          (idealOf_eq_comap_rename hΓ).le).toRingHom) ∧
      FiniteDimensional (adjoin k (range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z)))
        (extendScalars (adjoin.mono k (range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z)) (range W)
          (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun i ↦ ⟨gS i, congrFun hS i⟩))) ∧
      FiniteDimensional (adjoin k (range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim p q) r)))
        (extendScalars (adjoin.mono k (range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim p q) r)) (range W)
          (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun i ↦ ⟨gT i, congrFun hT i⟩))) := by
  intro x y z p q r W gS gT gM gΓ
  have hS : W ∘ gS = Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z := by
    funext i
    rcases i with (i | i) | i
    · fin_cases i <;> rfl
    · fin_cases i; rfl
    · fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hT : W ∘ gT = Sum.elim (Sum.elim p q) r := by
    funext i
    rcases i with (i | i) | i
    · fin_cases i <;> rfl
    · fin_cases i; rfl
    · fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hM : W ∘ gM = Sum.elim p q := by
    funext i
    rcases i with i | i
    · fin_cases i <;> rfl
    · fin_cases i; rfl
  have hΓ : W ∘ gΓ = Sum.elim q r := by
    funext i
    rcases i with i | i
    · fin_cases i; rfl
    · fin_cases i <;> rfl
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, hu⟩ := partialQuad_family_ranks h
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, hu'⟩ := partialQuad_parameter_family_ranks h
  have hbS : ∀ i, W i ∈ racl k (range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z)) := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨Sum.inr 0, rfl⟩
    · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inl 0), rfl⟩
    · exact hu
    · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inl 1), rfl⟩
    · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨Sum.inr 1, rfl⟩
    · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inr 0), rfl⟩
  have hbT : ∀ i, W i ∈ racl k (range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim p q) r)) := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inl 0), rfl⟩
    · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inl 1), rfl⟩
    · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inr 0), rfl⟩
    · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨Sum.inr 0, rfl⟩
    · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨Sum.inr 1, rfl⟩
    · exact hu'
  exact ⟨hS, hT, hM, hΓ, locusProjection_dense hS, locusProjection_dense hT,
    locusProjection_dense hM, locusProjection_dense hΓ,
    finite_field_cover _ W (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun i ↦ ⟨gS i, congrFun hS i⟩) hbS,
    finite_field_cover _ W (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun i ↦ ⟨gT i, congrFun hT i⟩) hbT⟩

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.source_family_ranks
statement:
private theorem Psi.source_family_ranks (hw : w.Psi) :
    let x : Fin 3 → K
proof:
:= ![w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.X.rep]
    let y : Fin 1 → K := ![w.Y.rep]
    let z : Fin 3 → K := ![w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep, w.Z.rep]
    Algebra.trdeg k (adjoin k (range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z))) = 5 ∧
      Algebra.trdeg k (adjoin k (range y)) = 1 ∧
      Algebra.trdeg k (adjoin k (range (Sum.elim x y))) = 3 ∧
      Algebra.trdeg k (adjoin k (range (Sum.elim y z))) = 3 ∧
      w.C₁.rep ∈ racl k (range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z)) ∧
      w.C₂.rep ∈ racl k (range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z)) := by
  intro x y z
  have hmem (T : ClosedIF k K) (P : Point k K) (h : P.1 ≤ T) : P.rep ∈ T.1 :=
    ClosedIF.le_iff.1 h P.mem_rep
  have hYAB : ¬ w.Y.1 ≤ w.A ⊔ w.B := fun h ↦ hw.Y_notLe (h.trans le_sup_left)
  have hYA : ¬ w.Y.1 ≤ w.A := fun h ↦ hYAB (h.trans le_sup_left)
  have hYB : ¬ w.Y.1 ≤ w.B := fun h ↦ hYAB (h.trans le_sup_right)
  have h5 : RankEq 5 (w.A ⊔ w.B ⊔ w.Y.1) := hw.rank_AB.sup_point_of_not_le hYAB
  have h3A : RankEq 3 (w.A ⊔ w.Y.1) := (Psi.rankEq_A hw).sup_point_of_not_le hYA
  have h3B : RankEq 3 (w.B ⊔ w.Y.1) := (Psi.rankEq_B hw).sup_point_of_not_le hYB
  have hXAY : w.X.1 ≤ w.A ⊔ w.Y.1 := hw.X_le
  have hZBY : w.Z.1 ≤ w.B ⊔ w.Y.1 := hw.Z_le.trans inf_le_left
  have hCAB : w.C ≤ w.A ⊔ w.B := by
    have h := RankEq.eq_of_le le_sup_left hw.rank_AB hw.rank_ABC
    rw [h]
    exact le_sup_right
  let v := Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z
  have hv : racl k (range v) = (w.A ⊔ w.B ⊔ w.Y.1).1 := by
    refine racl_range_eq_of_le v _ (fun i ↦ ?_) ?_
    · rcases i with (i | i) | i
      · fin_cases i
        · exact hmem _ w.A₁ (le_sup_left.trans (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left))
        · exact hmem _ w.A₂ (le_sup_right.trans (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left))
        · exact hmem _ w.X (hXAY.trans (sup_le_sup_right le_sup_left _))
      · fin_cases i
        exact hmem _ w.Y le_sup_right
      · fin_cases i
        · exact hmem _ w.B₁ (le_sup_left.trans (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left))
        · exact hmem _ w.B₂ (le_sup_right.trans (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left))
        · exact hmem _ w.Z (hZBY.trans (sup_le_sup_right le_sup_right _))
    · exact sup_le (sup_le
        (sup_le (point_le_racl_range v w.A₁ (Sum.inl (Sum.inl 0)) rfl)
          (point_le_racl_range v w.A₂ (Sum.inl (Sum.inl 1)) rfl))
        (sup_le (point_le_racl_range v w.B₁ (Sum.inr 0) rfl)
          (point_le_racl_range v w.B₂ (Sum.inr 1) rfl)))
        (point_le_racl_range v w.Y (Sum.inl (Sum.inr 0)) rfl)
  have hxy : racl k (range (Sum.elim x y)) = (w.A ⊔ w.Y.1).1 := by
    refine racl_range_eq_of_le (Sum.elim x y) _ (fun i ↦ ?_) ?_
    · rcases i with i | i
      · fin_cases i
        · exact hmem _ w.A₁ (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left)
        · exact hmem _ w.A₂ (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left)
        · exact hmem _ w.X hXAY
      · fin_cases i
        exact hmem _ w.Y le_sup_right
    · exact sup_le
        (sup_le (point_le_racl_range (Sum.elim x y) w.A₁ (Sum.inl 0) rfl)
          (point_le_racl_range (Sum.elim x y) w.A₂ (Sum.inl 1) rfl))
        (point_le_racl_range (Sum.elim x y) w.Y (Sum.inr 0) rfl)
  have hyz : racl k (range (Sum.elim y z)) = (w.B ⊔ w.Y.1).1 := by
    refine racl_range_eq_of_le (Sum.elim y z) _ (fun i ↦ ?_) ?_
    · rcases i with i | i
      · fin_cases i
        exact hmem _ w.Y le_sup_right
      · fin_cases i
        · exact hmem _ w.B₁ (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left)
        · exact hmem _ w.B₂ (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left)
        · exact hmem _ w.Z hZBY
    · exact sup_le
        (sup_le (point_le_racl_range (Sum.elim y z) w.B₁ (Sum.inr 0) rfl)
          (point_le_racl_range (Sum.elim y z) w.B₂ (Sum.inr 1) rfl))
        (point_le_racl_range (Sum.elim y z) w.Y (Sum.inl 0) rfl)
  have hy : racl k (range y) = w.Y.1.1 := by
    simpa [y] using w.Y.racl_repTuple
  have hC (P : Point k K) (hP : P.1 ≤ w.C) : P.rep ∈ racl k (range v) := by
    rw [hv]
    exact hmem _ P (hP.trans (hCAB.trans le_sup_left))
  exact ⟨trdeg_of_closed_span v hv h5, trdeg_of_closed_span y hy w.Y.rankEq_one,
    trdeg_of_closed_span (Sum.elim x y) hxy h3A, trdeg_of_closed_span (Sum.elim y z) hyz h3B,
    hC w.C₁ le_sup_left, hC w.C₂ le_sup_right⟩

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.parameter_family_ranks
statement:
private theorem Psi.parameter_family_ranks (hw : w.Psi) :
    let x : Fin 4 → K
proof:
:= ![w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep]
    let y : Fin 2 → K := ![w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep]
    let z : Fin 2 → K := ![w.X.rep, w.Z.rep]
    Algebra.trdeg k (adjoin k (range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z))) = 5 ∧
      Algebra.trdeg k (adjoin k (range y)) = 2 ∧
      Algebra.trdeg k (adjoin k (range (Sum.elim x y))) = 4 ∧
      Algebra.trdeg k (adjoin k (range (Sum.elim y z))) = 3 ∧
      w.Y.rep ∈ racl k (range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z)) := by
  intro x y z
  have hmem (T : ClosedIF k K) (P : Point k K) (h : P.1 ≤ T) : P.rep ∈ T.1 :=
    ClosedIF.le_iff.1 h P.mem_rep
  have hXAB : ¬ w.X.1 ≤ w.A ⊔ w.B := fun h ↦ hw.X_notLe (h.trans le_sup_left)
  have hXC : ¬ w.X.1 ≤ w.C := fun h ↦ hw.X_notLe (h.trans le_sup_right)
  have hYAB : ¬ w.Y.1 ≤ w.A ⊔ w.B := fun h ↦ hw.Y_notLe (h.trans le_sup_left)
  have h5X : RankEq 5 (w.A ⊔ w.B ⊔ w.X.1) := hw.rank_AB.sup_point_of_not_le hXAB
  have h5Y : RankEq 5 (w.A ⊔ w.B ⊔ w.Y.1) := hw.rank_AB.sup_point_of_not_le hYAB
  have h3 : RankEq 3 (w.C ⊔ w.X.1) := (Psi.rankEq_C hw).sup_point_of_not_le hXC
  have hXAY : w.X.1 ≤ w.A ⊔ w.Y.1 := hw.X_le
  have hZCX : w.Z.1 ≤ w.C ⊔ w.X.1 := hw.Z_le.trans inf_le_right
  have hCAB : w.C ≤ w.A ⊔ w.B := by
    have h := RankEq.eq_of_le le_sup_left hw.rank_AB hw.rank_ABC
    rw [h]
    exact le_sup_right
  let v := Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z
  have hv : racl k (range v) = (w.A ⊔ w.B ⊔ w.X.1).1 := by
    refine racl_range_eq_of_le v _ (fun i ↦ ?_) ?_
    · rcases i with (i | i) | i
      · fin_cases i
        · exact hmem _ w.A₁ (le_sup_left.trans (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left))
        · exact hmem _ w.A₂ (le_sup_right.trans (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left))
        · exact hmem _ w.B₁ (le_sup_left.trans (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left))
        · exact hmem _ w.B₂ (le_sup_right.trans (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left))
      · fin_cases i
        · exact hmem _ w.C₁ (le_sup_left.trans (hCAB.trans le_sup_left))
        · exact hmem _ w.C₂ (le_sup_right.trans (hCAB.trans le_sup_left))
      · fin_cases i
        · exact hmem _ w.X le_sup_right
        · exact hmem _ w.Z (hZCX.trans (sup_le_sup_right hCAB _))
    · exact sup_le (sup_le
        (sup_le (point_le_racl_range v w.A₁ (Sum.inl (Sum.inl 0)) rfl)
          (point_le_racl_range v w.A₂ (Sum.inl (Sum.inl 1)) rfl))
        (sup_le (point_le_racl_range v w.B₁ (Sum.inl (Sum.inl 2)) rfl)
          (point_le_racl_range v w.B₂ (Sum.inl (Sum.inl 3)) rfl)))
        (point_le_racl_range v w.X (Sum.inr 0) rfl)
  have hxy : racl k (range (Sum.elim x y)) = (w.A ⊔ w.B).1 := by
    refine racl_range_eq_of_le (Sum.elim x y) _ (fun i ↦ ?_) ?_
    · rcases i with i | i
      · fin_cases i
        · exact hmem _ w.A₁ (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left)
        · exact hmem _ w.A₂ (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left)
        · exact hmem _ w.B₁ (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_right)
        · exact hmem _ w.B₂ (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_right)
      · fin_cases i
        · exact hmem _ w.C₁ (le_sup_left.trans hCAB)
        · exact hmem _ w.C₂ (le_sup_right.trans hCAB)
    · exact sup_le
        (sup_le (point_le_racl_range (Sum.elim x y) w.A₁ (Sum.inl 0) rfl)
          (point_le_racl_range (Sum.elim x y) w.A₂ (Sum.inl 1) rfl))
        (sup_le (point_le_racl_range (Sum.elim x y) w.B₁ (Sum.inl 2) rfl)
          (point_le_racl_range (Sum.elim x y) w.B₂ (Sum.inl 3) rfl))
  have hyz : racl k (range (Sum.elim y z)) = (w.C ⊔ w.X.1).1 := by
    refine racl_range_eq_of_le (Sum.elim y z) _ (fun i ↦ ?_) ?_
    · rcases i with i | i
      · fin_cases i
        · exact hmem _ w.C₁ (le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left)
        · exact hmem _ w.C₂ (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left)
      · fin_cases i
        · exact hmem _ w.X le_sup_right
        · exact hmem _ w.Z hZCX
    · exact sup_le
        (sup_le (point_le_racl_range (Sum.elim y z) w.C₁ (Sum.inl 0) rfl)
          (point_le_racl_range (Sum.elim y z) w.C₂ (Sum.inl 1) rfl))
        (point_le_racl_range (Sum.elim y z) w.X (Sum.inr 0) rfl)
  have hy : racl k (range y) = w.C.1 := by
    refine racl_range_eq_of_le y _ (fun i ↦ ?_) ?_
    · fin_cases i
      · exact hmem _ w.C₁ le_sup_left
      · exact hmem _ w.C₂ le_sup_right
    · exact sup_le (point_le_racl_range y w.C₁ 0 rfl) (point_le_racl_range y w.C₂ 1 rfl)
  
  have hY : w.Y.rep ∈ racl k (range v) := by
    have hle : w.A ⊔ w.B ⊔ w.X.1 ≤ w.A ⊔ w.B ⊔ w.Y.1 :=
      sup_le le_sup_left (hXAY.trans (sup_le_sup_right le_sup_left _))
    have heq := RankEq.eq_of_le hle h5X h5Y
    rw [hv, heq]
    exact hmem _ w.Y le_sup_right
  exact ⟨trdeg_of_closed_span v hv h5X, trdeg_of_closed_span y hy (Psi.rankEq_C hw),
    trdeg_of_closed_span (Sum.elim x y) hxy hw.rank_AB,
    trdeg_of_closed_span (Sum.elim y z) hyz h3, hY⟩

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.parameter_family_components
statement:
theorem Psi.parameter_family_components (hw : w.Psi) :
    let x : Fin 3 → K
proof:
:= ![w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.X.rep]
    let y : Fin 1 → K := ![w.Y.rep]
    let z : Fin 3 → K := ![w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep, w.Z.rep]
    let p : Fin 4 → K := ![w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep]
    let q : Fin 2 → K := ![w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep]
    let r : Fin 2 → K := ![w.X.rep, w.Z.rep]
    idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z) ∈
      (Ideal.map (rename (Sum.inl : Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1 → (Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin 3) :
          MvPolynomial (Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1) k →ₐ[k]
            MvPolynomial ((Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin 3) k) (idealOf k (Sum.elim x y)) ⊔
        Ideal.map (rename (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) Sum.inr :
          Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3 → (Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin 3) :
          MvPolynomial (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) k →ₐ[k]
            MvPolynomial ((Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin 3) k) (idealOf k (Sum.elim y z))).minimalPrimes ∧
    idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim p q) r) ∈
      (Ideal.map (rename (Sum.inl : Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 2 → (Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 2) ⊕ Fin 2) :
          MvPolynomial (Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 2) k →ₐ[k]
            MvPolynomial ((Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 2) ⊕ Fin 2) k) (idealOf k (Sum.elim p q)) ⊔
        Ideal.map (rename (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) Sum.inr :
          Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2 → (Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 2) ⊕ Fin 2) :
          MvPolynomial (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) k →ₐ[k]
            MvPolynomial ((Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 2) ⊕ Fin 2) k) (idealOf k (Sum.elim q r))).minimalPrimes ∧
    ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial ((Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin 3) k ⧸
      idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z)) = 5 ∧
    ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial ((Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 2) ⊕ Fin 2) k ⧸
      idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim p q) r)) = 5 ∧
    ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 2) k ⧸
      idealOf k (Sum.elim p q)) = 4 ∧
    ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) k ⧸
      idealOf k (Sum.elim q r)) = 3 := by
  let x : Fin 3 → K := ![w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.X.rep]
  let y : Fin 1 → K := ![w.Y.rep]
  let z : Fin 3 → K := ![w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep, w.Z.rep]
  let p : Fin 4 → K := ![w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep]
  let q : Fin 2 → K := ![w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep]
  let r : Fin 2 → K := ![w.X.rep, w.Z.rep]
  obtain ⟨hs, hy, hxy, hyz, -, -⟩ := Psi.source_family_ranks hw
  obtain ⟨ht, hq, hpq, hqr, -⟩ := Psi.parameter_family_ranks hw
  have hsource := jointIdeal_minimal_of_rank (k := k) x y z
    (by rw [hs, hy, hxy, hyz]; norm_num)
  have htarget := jointIdeal_minimal_of_rank (k := k) p q r
    (by rw [ht, hq, hpq, hqr]; norm_num)
  exact ⟨hsource, htarget, tuple_dimension_eq _ hs, tuple_dimension_eq _ ht,
    tuple_dimension_eq _ hpq, tuple_dimension_eq _ hqr⟩

name: AclGeom.QWitness.Psi.family_common_function_field_cover
statement:
theorem Psi.family_common_function_field_cover (hw : w.Psi) :
    let x : Fin 3 → K
proof:
:= ![w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.X.rep]
    let y : Fin 1 → K := ![w.Y.rep]
    let z : Fin 3 → K := ![w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep, w.Z.rep]
    let p : Fin 4 → K := ![w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep]
    let q : Fin 2 → K := ![w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep]
    let r : Fin 2 → K := ![w.X.rep, w.Z.rep]
    let W : Fin 9 → K :=
      ![w.A₁.rep, w.A₂.rep, w.B₁.rep, w.B₂.rep, w.C₁.rep, w.C₂.rep, w.X.rep, w.Y.rep, w.Z.rep]
    let gS : (Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin 3 → Fin 9 := Sum.elim (Sum.elim ![0, 1, 6] ![7]) ![2, 3, 8]
    let gT : (Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 2) ⊕ Fin 2 → Fin 9 := Sum.elim (Sum.elim ![0, 1, 2, 3] ![4, 5]) ![6, 8]
    let gM : Fin 4 ⊕ Fin 2 → Fin 9 := Sum.elim ![0, 1, 2, 3] ![4, 5]
    let gΓ : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2 → Fin 9 := Sum.elim ![4, 5] ![6, 8]
    ∃ (hS : W ∘ gS = Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z) (hT : W ∘ gT = Sum.elim (Sum.elim p q) r)
      (hM : W ∘ gM = Sum.elim p q) (hΓ : W ∘ gΓ = Sum.elim q r),
      DenseRange (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k W) (rename gS)
        (idealOf_eq_comap_rename hS).le).toRingHom) ∧
      DenseRange (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k W) (rename gT)
        (idealOf_eq_comap_rename hT).le).toRingHom) ∧
      DenseRange (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k W) (rename gM)
        (idealOf_eq_comap_rename hM).le).toRingHom) ∧
      DenseRange (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k W) (rename gΓ)
        (idealOf_eq_comap_rename hΓ).le).toRingHom) ∧
      FiniteDimensional (adjoin k (range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z)))
        (extendScalars (adjoin.mono k (range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z)) (range W)
          (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun i ↦ ⟨gS i, congrFun hS i⟩))) ∧
      FiniteDimensional (adjoin k (range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim p q) r)))
        (extendScalars (adjoin.mono k (range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim p q) r)) (range W)
          (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun i ↦ ⟨gT i, congrFun hT i⟩))) := by
  intro x y z p q r W gS gT gM gΓ
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, hc₁, hc₂⟩ := Psi.source_family_ranks hw
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, hY⟩ := Psi.parameter_family_ranks hw
  have hS : W ∘ gS = Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z := by
    funext i
    rcases i with (i | i) | i <;> fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hT : W ∘ gT = Sum.elim (Sum.elim p q) r := by
    funext i
    rcases i with (i | i) | i <;> fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hM : W ∘ gM = Sum.elim p q := by
    funext i
    rcases i with i | i <;> fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hΓ : W ∘ gΓ = Sum.elim q r := by
    funext i
    rcases i with i | i <;> fin_cases i <;> rfl
  
  have hbS : ∀ j, W j ∈ racl k (range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z)) := by
    intro j
    fin_cases j
    · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inl 0), rfl⟩
    · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inl 1), rfl⟩
    · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨Sum.inr 0, rfl⟩
    · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨Sum.inr 1, rfl⟩
    · exact hc₁
    · exact hc₂
    · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inl 2), rfl⟩
    · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inr 0), rfl⟩
    · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨Sum.inr 2, rfl⟩
  have hbT : ∀ j, W j ∈ racl k (range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim p q) r)) := by
    intro j
    fin_cases j
    · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inl 0), rfl⟩
    · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inl 1), rfl⟩
    · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inl 2), rfl⟩
    · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inl 3), rfl⟩
    · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inr 0), rfl⟩
    · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inr 1), rfl⟩
    · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨Sum.inr 0, rfl⟩
    · exact hY
    · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨Sum.inr 1, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨hS, hT, hM, hΓ, locusProjection_dense hS, locusProjection_dense hT,
    locusProjection_dense hM, locusProjection_dense hΓ,
    finite_field_cover _ W (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun i ↦ ⟨gS i, congrFun hS i⟩) hbS,
    finite_field_cover _ W (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun i ↦ ⟨gT i, congrFun hT i⟩) hbT⟩

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.repeatedSSelectedGraphSourceAlignmentAut_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem repeatedSSelectedGraphSourceAlignmentAut_apply
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b))
    (x : (R.branchComparisonSourceCover hind).field) :
    R.repeatedSSelectedGraphSourceAlignmentAut L hind
        (R.branchComparisonSourceCoverToSelectedGraphSourceCoverOverSource
          L hind x) =
      R.branchComparisonSourceCoverToSelectedGraphSourceCoverOverSource
        L hind (R.repeatedSBranchAlignmentAut hind x)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Normal (groupedSemanticCommonSourceType R)
      (R.selectedGraphSourceCover L hind).field :=
    (R.selectedGraphSourceCover L hind).normal
  exact NormalBranchEmbedding.extendAlong_apply _ _ _

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.repeatedSSelectedGraphRightSourceAlignmentAut_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem repeatedSSelectedGraphRightSourceAlignmentAut_apply
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b))

name: AclGeom.QWitness.exists_psiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization
statement:
theorem exists_psiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (ι : K →ₐ[k] Ω) (hψ : w.Psi) {a b c : Fin 2 → K}
    (hrel : w.psiFamilyCompositionRelation a b c) {x : Ω}
    (hx : x ∉ racl k
      (Set.range (ι ∘ compositionParameterTuple a b c))) :
    ∃ R : w.PsiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization ι
        (ι ∘ a) (ι ∘ b) (ι ∘ c),
      R.source = x
proof:
:= by
  have hparameter :
      idealOf k (ι ∘ compositionParameterTuple a b c) =
        idealOf k (ι ∘ w.abcReps) := by
    calc
      idealOf k (ι ∘ compositionParameterTuple a b c) =
          idealOf k (compositionParameterTuple a b c) :=
        idealOf_comp_algHom k ι _
      _ = idealOf k w.abcReps := by
        simpa [psiFamilyCompositionRelation] using hrel
      _ = idealOf k (ι ∘ w.abcReps) :=
        (idealOf_comp_algHom k ι _).symm
  have hsource :
      ι w.X.rep ∉ racl k (Set.range (ι ∘ w.abcReps)) := by
    intro hmem
    rw [Set.range_comp] at hmem
    exact w.X_rep_notMem_racl_abcReps hψ
      ((algHom_mem_racl_image_iff ι).1 hmem)
  have hfixed :
      idealOf k (w.psiCurveParameterSourceTupleOver
          (ι ∘ a) (ι ∘ b) (ι ∘ c) x) =
        idealOf k (ι ∘ psiCurveParameterSourceTuple
          w.aReps w.bReps w.cReps w.X.rep) := by
    rw [← w.psiCurveParameterSourceTupleOver_map]
    change idealOf k (Fin.snoc
        (compositionParameterTuple (ι ∘ a) (ι ∘ b) (ι ∘ c)) x) =
      idealOf k (Fin.snoc
        (compositionParameterTuple (ι ∘ w.aReps) (ι ∘ w.bReps)
          (ι ∘ w.cReps)) (ι w.X.rep))
    have hmapParameters :
        compositionParameterTuple (ι ∘ a) (ι ∘ b) (ι ∘ c) =
          ι ∘ compositionParameterTuple a b c := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl
    have hmapSelected :
        compositionParameterTuple (ι ∘ w.aReps) (ι ∘ w.bReps)
            (ι ∘ w.cReps) =
          ι ∘ w.abcReps := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl
    rw [hmapParameters, hmapSelected]
    exact idealOf_snoc_eq_of_idealOf_eq_of_generic
      hparameter hx hsource
  have hselectedAlgebraic (j : Fin 9) :
      (ι ∘ w.psiSelectedCurveCompositionTuple) j ∈ racl k
        (Set.range (ι ∘ psiCurveParameterSourceTuple
          w.aReps w.bReps w.cReps w.X.rep)) := by
    rw [Set.range_comp]
    exact (algHom_mem_racl_image_iff ι).2
      (w.psiSelectedCurveCompositionTuple_mem_parameterSource_racl hψ j)
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hfix⟩ := exists_tuple_relocation_fixing_locus
    hfixed
    (u := ι ∘ w.psiSelectedCurveCompositionTuple)
    (e := psiCurveParameterSourceIndex)
    (fun i ↦ by
      change ι (w.psiSelectedCurveCompositionTuple
          (psiCurveParameterSourceIndex i)) =
        ι (psiCurveParameterSourceTuple
          w.aReps w.bReps w.cReps w.X.rep i)
      congr 1
      exact congrFun
        (w.psiCurveCompositionTuple_comp_parameterSourceIndex
          w.aReps w.bReps w.cReps w.X.rep w.Y.rep w.Z.rep) i)
    hselectedAlgebraic
  let y : Ω := v 7
  let z : Ω := v 8
  have htotal :
      w.psiCurveCompositionTupleOver
          (ι ∘ a) (ι ∘ b) (ι ∘ c) x y z = v := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · simpa [psiCurveParameterSourceIndex,
        psiCurveParameterSourceTupleOver, compositionParameterTuple,
        psiCurveCompositionTupleOver] using (hfix 0).symm
    · simpa [psiCurveParameterSourceIndex,
        psiCurveParameterSourceTupleOver, compositionParameterTuple,
        psiCurveCompositionTupleOver] using (hfix 1).symm
    · simpa [psiCurveParameterSourceIndex,
        psiCurveParameterSourceTupleOver, compositionParameterTuple,
        psiCurveCompositionTupleOver] using (hfix 2).symm
    · simpa [psiCurveParameterSourceIndex,
        psiCurveParameterSourceTupleOver, compositionParameterTuple,
        psiCurveCompositionTupleOver] using (hfix 3).symm
    · simpa [psiCurveParameterSourceIndex,
        psiCurveParameterSourceTupleOver, compositionParameterTuple,
        psiCurveCompositionTupleOver] using (hfix 4).symm
    · simpa [psiCurveParameterSourceIndex,
        psiCurveParameterSourceTupleOver, compositionParameterTuple,
        psiCurveCompositionTupleOver] using (hfix 5).symm
    · simpa [psiCurveParameterSourceIndex,
        psiCurveParameterSourceTupleOver, compositionParameterTuple,
        psiCurveCompositionTupleOver] using (hfix 6).symm
    · rfl
    · rfl
  let R : w.PsiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization ι
      (ι ∘ a) (ι ∘ b) (ι ∘ c) :=
    { source := x
      middle := y
      target := z
      locus := by rw [htotal]; exact hv }
  exact ⟨R, rfl⟩

name: AclGeom.QWitness.exists_psiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations
statement:
theorem exists_psiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations
    (hψ : w.Psi) {s a b e : Fin 2 → K}
    (D : w.PsiParameterFourArrowDifferenceDiagram hψ s a b e) :
    Nonempty (w.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations hψ D)
proof:
:= by
  let ι : K →ₐ[k] CommonCurveAmbient K :=
    commonCurveEmbedding (k := k) (K := K)
  have hse : w.psiFamilyCompositionRelation s e D.u :=
    (w.psiFamilyCompositionRelation_iff_isRealization hψ s e D.u).2 D.se_u
  have hsAa : w.psiFamilyCompositionRelation D.sA a D.u :=
    (w.psiFamilyCompositionRelation_iff_isRealization
      hψ D.sA a D.u).2 D.sA_a_u
  have hsb : w.psiFamilyCompositionRelation s b D.uB :=
    (w.psiFamilyCompositionRelation_iff_isRealization hψ s b D.uB).2
      D.s_b_uB
  have hsAc : w.psiFamilyCompositionRelation D.sA D.c D.uB :=
    (w.psiFamilyCompositionRelation_iff_isRealization
      hψ D.sA D.c D.uB).2 D.sA_c_uB
  obtain ⟨Rse, hRse⟩ :=
    w.exists_psiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization ι hψ hse
      (commonCurveSource_notMem_racl
        (k := k) (K := K) (compositionParameterTuple s e D.u))
  obtain ⟨RsAa, hRsAa⟩ :=
    w.exists_psiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization ι hψ hsAa
      (commonCurveSource_notMem_racl
        (k := k) (K := K) (compositionParameterTuple D.sA a D.u))
  obtain ⟨Rsb, hRsb⟩ :=
    w.exists_psiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization ι hψ hsb
      (commonCurveSource_notMem_racl
        (k := k) (K := K) (compositionParameterTuple s b D.uB))
  obtain ⟨RsAc, hRsAc⟩ :=
    w.exists_psiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization ι hψ hsAc
      (commonCurveSource_notMem_racl
        (k := k) (K := K) (compositionParameterTuple D.sA D.c D.uB))
  exact ⟨⟨Rse, hRse, RsAa, hRsAa, Rsb, hRsb, RsAc, hRsAc⟩⟩

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.sbSelectedGraphRight_left_comp_bGermCoefficient
statement:
theorem sbSelectedGraphRight_left_comp_bGermCoefficient
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :
    (R.sbSelectedGraphRightCompositionTriangle L hind).left.toRingHom.comp
        (R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom L hind) =
      R.sbBGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightMiddleCommonRingHom L hind
proof:
:= by
  let P :=
    PsiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization.CommonBaseData.aCorrespondencePair
      (R := R.sb) R.sbCommonBaseData hψ
  let Q :=
    PsiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization.CommonBaseData.bCorrespondencePair
      (R := R.sb) R.sbCommonBaseData hψ
  let h :=
    PsiCurveCompositionBaseChangeRealization.CommonBaseData.aPair_target_eq_bPair_source
      (R := R.sb) R.sbCommonBaseData hψ
  let N := R.selectedGraphRightSourceCover L hind
  change
    (FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.OnSourceCover.leftEquiv
      P Q h N).toRingHom.comp
        (R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom L hind) =
      R.sbBGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightMiddleCommonRingHom L hind
  calc
    _ = (FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.OnSourceCover.leftEquiv
          P Q h N).toRingHom.comp
        ((algebraMap (↥R.sbCommonBaseData.coefficientField)
          (↥N.field)).comp
            (R.seBGermCoefficientToCommonCoefficientRingHom L)) :=
      congrArg
        ((FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.OnSourceCover.leftEquiv
          P Q h N).toRingHom.comp)
        (R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom_eq_commonCoefficient
          L hind)
    _ = (algebraMap (↥R.sbCommonBaseData.coefficientField)
          (↥(FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.OnSourceCover.middleCover
            P Q h N).field)).comp
        (R.seBGermCoefficientToCommonCoefficientRingHom L) :=
      finiteCoverTriangle_left_comp_algebraMap_comp P Q h N
        (R.seBGermCoefficientToCommonCoefficientRingHom L)
    _ = R.sbBGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightMiddleCommonRingHom L hind := rfl

name: AclGeom.QWitness.PsiCurveFourArrowCommonSourceRealizations.sbRightSemilinear_left_comp_bGermCoefficient
statement:
theorem sbRightSemilinear_left_comp_bGermCoefficient
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :

        (R.bGermCoefficientToRightBSourceRingHom L hind) =
      R.sbBGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightMiddleCommonRingHom L hind
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro z
  have hsource := DFunLike.congr_fun
    (R.rightBSourceChart_comp_bGermCoefficient L hind) z
  have hleft := DFunLike.congr_fun
    (R.sbSelectedGraphRight_left_comp_bGermCoefficient L hind) z
  change (R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightBRingEquiv L hind).symm
      (R.bGermCoefficientToRightBSourceRingHom L hind z) =
    R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom L hind z at hsource
  change (R.sbSelectedGraphRightCompositionTriangle L hind).left
      (R.bGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightSourceRingHom L hind z) =
    R.sbBGermCoefficientToSelectedGraphRightMiddleCommonRingHom L hind z at hleft
  change (R.sbSelectedGraphRightCompositionTriangle L hind).left
      ((R.selectedGraphRightSourceToRightBRingEquiv L hind).symm
        (R.bGermCoefficientToRightBSourceRingHom L hind z)) = _
  exact (congrArg
    (R.sbSelectedGraphRightCompositionTriangle L hind).left hsource).trans hleft
