    interpretedRingEquiv q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ (algebraMap k K c) ∈
      Set.range (algebraMap l L)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne c 0 with rfl | hc
  · let σ := interpretedRingEquiv q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ
    exact ⟨0, (map_zero (algebraMap l L)).trans
      ((map_zero σ).symm.trans ((congrArg σ (map_zero (algebraMap k K))).symm))⟩
  
  have hx₀0 : x₀ ≠ 0 := AlgebraicIndependent.ne_zero h₀ 0
  have hcx : AlgebraicIndependent k ![algebraMap k K c * x₀, a] :=
    algebraicIndependent_pair_congr (racl_algebraMap_mul hc x₀).symm rfl h₀
  have hu : FrobEq (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) (jTupleOf (algebraMap k K c * x₀) a hcx) :=
    frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr h₀ hcx
  have hv : FrobEq (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) := frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr h₀ h₀
  have hD : ratioInterpDecode q htr hcomp h₀
      ((Quotient.mk (ratioSetoid q htr hcomp h₀)
        (⟨jTupleOf (algebraMap k K c * x₀) a hcx, hu⟩, ⟨jTupleOf x₀ a h₀, hv⟩) : Quotient _) :
        RatioInterp q htr hcomp h₀) = algebraMap k K c := by
    rw [ratioInterpDecode_coe, jClassEquiv_jTupleOf, jClassEquiv_jTupleOf]
    exact mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hx₀0
  
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyu⟩ := (frobEq_jTupleOf_iff q' htr' hcomp' h₀').1
    (ratioClassMap e h₀ h₀' hφ ⟨jTupleOf (algebraMap k K c * x₀) a hcx, hu⟩).2
  have hCu : ratioClassMap e h₀ h₀' hφ ⟨jTupleOf (algebraMap k K c * x₀) a hcx, hu⟩ =
      ⟨jTupleOf y a' hy, frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr' h₀' hy⟩ := Subtype.ext hyu
  have hCv : ratioClassMap e h₀ h₀' hφ ⟨jTupleOf x₀ a h₀, hv⟩ =
      ⟨jTupleOf x₀' a' h₀', frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr' h₀' h₀'⟩ := Subtype.ext hφ
  have hval : interpretedRingEquiv q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ (algebraMap k K c) =
      y / x₀' := by
    change ratioInterpDecode q' htr' hcomp' h₀'
      (ratioInterpMap q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ
        ((ratioInterpDecode q htr hcomp h₀).symm (algebraMap k K c))) = y / x₀'
    rw [(Equiv.symm_apply_eq _).2 hD.symm]
    change ratioInterpDecode q' htr' hcomp' h₀'
      ((Quotient.mk (ratioSetoid q' htr' hcomp' h₀')
        (ratioClassMap e h₀ h₀' hφ ⟨jTupleOf (algebraMap k K c * x₀) a hcx, hu⟩,
          ratioClassMap e h₀ h₀' hφ ⟨jTupleOf x₀ a h₀, hv⟩) : Quotient _) :
        RatioInterp q' htr' hcomp' h₀') = y / x₀'
    rw [hCu, hCv, ratioInterpDecode_coe, jClassEquiv_jTupleOf, jClassEquiv_jTupleOf]
  
  have hpt : ∀ z : K, point k (algebraMap k K c * z) = point k z := fun z ↦ by
    have hr := racl_algebraMap_mul hc z
    refine point_eq_point_iff.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [mem_point, ← hr]
      exact subset_racl k _ rfl
    · rw [mem_point, hr]
      exact subset_racl k _ rfl
  have hpt2 : point k (algebraMap k K c * x₀ * a) = point k (x₀ * a) := by
    rw [mul_assoc]
    exact hpt (x₀ * a)
  have h0 : point l y = point l x₀' := congrArg Subtype.val
    ((congrFun hyu 0).symm.trans ((congrArg (Point.map e) (Subtype.ext (hpt x₀) :
      jTupleOf (algebraMap k K c * x₀) a hcx 0 = jTupleOf x₀ a h₀ 0)).trans (congrFun hφ 0)))
  have h2 : point l (y * a') = point l (x₀' * a') := congrArg Subtype.val
    ((congrFun hyu 2).symm.trans ((congrArg (Point.map e) (Subtype.ext hpt2 :
      jTupleOf (algebraMap k K c * x₀) a hcx 2 = jTupleOf x₀ a h₀ 2)).trans (congrFun hφ 2)))
  
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := AlgebraicIndependent.ne_zero hy 0
  obtain ⟨hy₁, hy₂⟩ := point_eq_point_iff.1 h0
  obtain ⟨hm₁, hm₂⟩ := point_eq_point_iff.1 h2
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := base_ratio_mem_range hl h₀' hy0 hy₁ hy₂ hm₁ hm₂
  refine ⟨d⁻¹, ?_⟩
  rw [hval, map_inv₀, hd, inv_div]

name: AclGeom.interpretedRingEquiv_symm
statement:
theorem interpretedRingEquiv_symm [PerfectField K] (q : ℕ) [ExpChar K q]
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K)
    (hcomp : JCompletenessACF (↥(algebraicClosure k (AlgebraicClosure K))) (AlgebraicClosure K))
    [PerfectField L] (q' : ℕ) [ExpChar L q']
    (htr' : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg l L)
    (hcomp' : JCompletenessACF (↥(algebraicClosure l (AlgebraicClosure L))) (AlgebraicClosure L))
    (e : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L) {x₀ a : K} (h₀ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x₀, a])
    {x₀' a' : L} (h₀' : AlgebraicIndependent l ![x₀', a'])
    (hφ : Point.map e ∘ jTupleOf x₀ a h₀ = jTupleOf x₀' a' h₀')
    (hφ' : Point.map e.symm ∘ jTupleOf x₀' a' h₀' = jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) :
    (interpretedRingEquiv q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ).symm =
      interpretedRingEquiv q' htr' hcomp' q htr hcomp e.symm h₀' h₀ hφ'
proof:
:= by
  exact RingEquiv.ext fun _ ↦ rfl

name: AclGeom.interpretedRingEquiv_compatible
statement:
theorem interpretedRingEquiv_compatible [PerfectField K] (q : ℕ) [ExpChar K q]
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K)
    (hcomp : JCompletenessACF (↥(algebraicClosure k (AlgebraicClosure K))) (AlgebraicClosure K))
    [PerfectField L] (q' : ℕ) [ExpChar L q']
    (htr' : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg l L)
    (hcomp' : JCompletenessACF (↥(algebraicClosure l (AlgebraicClosure L))) (AlgebraicClosure L))
    (e : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L) {x₀ a : K} (h₀ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x₀, a])
    {x₀' a' : L} (h₀' : AlgebraicIndependent l ![x₀', a'])
    (hφ : Point.map e ∘ jTupleOf x₀ a h₀ = jTupleOf x₀' a' h₀')
    (hk : IsRAC (⊥ : IntermediateField k K)) (hl : IsRAC (⊥ : IntermediateField l L)) :
    CrossBase.Compatible (k := k) (l := l)
      (interpretedRingEquiv q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hφ' : Point.map e.symm ∘ jTupleOf x₀' a' h₀' = jTupleOf x₀ a h₀ := by
    rw [← hφ]
    funext i
    exact Subtype.ext (e.symm_apply_apply _)
  unfold CrossBase.Compatible
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Subfield.mem_map.1 hy
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := RingHom.mem_fieldRange.1 hx
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ :=
      interpretedRingEquiv_algebraMap_mem q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ hl c
    exact RingHom.mem_fieldRange.2 ⟨d, hd⟩
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := RingHom.mem_fieldRange.1 hy
    refine Subfield.mem_map.2 ⟨(interpretedRingEquiv q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ).symm
      (algebraMap l L d), ?_, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ _⟩
    rw [interpretedRingEquiv_symm q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ hφ']
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ :=
      interpretedRingEquiv_algebraMap_mem q' htr' hcomp' q htr hcomp e.symm h₀' h₀ hφ' hk d
    exact RingHom.mem_fieldRange.2 ⟨c, hc⟩

name: AclGeom.Perfection.five_le_trdeg_basePerf
statement:
theorem five_le_trdeg_basePerf (ρ : Perfection L) (φ : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L)
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K) :
    (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg (ρ.basePerf l) ρ.carrier
proof:
:=
  Cardinal.ofNat_le_lift_iff.1 <| (Cardinal.ofNat_le_lift_iff.2 htr).trans
    (lift_trdeg_le_of_orderIso (φ.trans (ρ.latticeIso l)))

name: AclGeom.Perfection.trans_frobZPow_injective
statement:
theorem trans_frobZPow_injective (φ : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L)
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K) (hp : ρ.p ≠ 1) (Φ : π.carrier ≃+* ρ.carrier) :
    Function.Injective fun n : ℤ ↦ Φ.trans (ρ.frobZPow n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := fresh_three_of_five_le_trdeg (five_le_trdeg_basePerf ρ φ htr) ∅ (by simp)
  intro m n hmn
  refine frobeniusZPow_injective (k := ρ.basePerf l) ρ.p hp (x := z) (by simpa using hz) ?_
  ext y
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Φ.surjective y
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hmn x

name: AclGeom.Perfection.Induces.point_symm_trans
statement:
theorem Induces.point_symm_trans (h₁ : π.Induces ρ φ Φ₁) (h₂ : π.Induces ρ φ Φ₂)
    (z : ρ.carrier) :
    ClosedIF.point (ρ.basePerf l) ((Φ₁.symm.trans Φ₂) z) = ClosedIF.point (ρ.basePerf l) z
proof:
:= by
  
  have hfix : ∀ N : ClosedIF (ρ.basePerf l) ρ.carrier,
      (Φ₁.symm.trans Φ₂) '' (N.1 : Set ρ.carrier) = N.1 := by
    intro N
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ : ∃ M, φ M = ρ.comapClosed l N := ⟨_, φ.apply_symm_apply _⟩
    have hN : ρ.perfSubfield (φ M).1.toSubfield = N.1.toSubfield := by
      rw [hM]
      exact congrArg (fun P : ClosedIF (ρ.basePerf l) ρ.carrier ↦ P.1.toSubfield)
        (ρ.perfClosed_comapClosed N)
    have hi : ∀ {Φ : π.carrier ≃+* ρ.carrier}, π.Induces ρ φ Φ →
        Φ '' (π.perfSubfield M.1.toSubfield : Set π.carrier) = (N.1 : Set ρ.carrier) := by
      intro Φ h
      have hS := congrArg (fun F : Subfield ρ.carrier ↦ (F : Set ρ.carrier)) ((h M).symm.trans hN)
      simp only [Subfield.coe_map, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom] at hS
      exact hS
    have hS₁ : Φ₁.symm '' (N.1 : Set ρ.carrier) =
        (π.perfSubfield M.1.toSubfield : Set π.carrier) := by
      rw [← hi h₁]
      exact Φ₁.toEquiv.symm_image_image _
    rw [RingEquiv.coe_trans, Set.image_comp, hS₁]
    exact hi h₂
  refine ClosedIF.point_eq_point_iff.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have hmem : (Φ₁.symm.trans Φ₂) z ∈
        (Φ₁.symm.trans Φ₂) '' ((ClosedIF.point (ρ.basePerf l) z).1 : Set ρ.carrier) :=
      Set.mem_image_of_mem _ (ClosedIF.mem_point_self z)
    rw [hfix] at hmem
    exact hmem
  · have hmem : (Φ₁.symm.trans Φ₂) z ∈
        ((ClosedIF.point (ρ.basePerf l) ((Φ₁.symm.trans Φ₂) z)).1 : Set ρ.carrier) :=
      ClosedIF.mem_point_self _
    rw [← hfix (ClosedIF.point (ρ.basePerf l) ((Φ₁.symm.trans Φ₂) z))] at hmem
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hwz⟩ := hmem
    rw [(Φ₁.symm.trans Φ₂).injective hwz] at hw
    exact hw

name: AclGeom.Perfection.Induces.exists_eq_trans_frobZPow
statement:
theorem Induces.exists_eq_trans_frobZPow (h₁ : π.Induces ρ φ Φ₁) (h₂ : π.Induces ρ φ Φ₂)
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K) : ∃ n : ℤ, Φ₂ = Φ₁.trans (ρ.frobZPow n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_eq_frobeniusZPow_of_point_fixed (k := ρ.basePerf l) ρ.p
    (five_le_trdeg_basePerf ρ φ htr) (Φ₁.symm.trans Φ₂) fun z _ ↦ h₁.point_symm_trans h₂ z
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  change Φ₂ = Φ₁.trans (frobeniusZPow ρ.carrier ρ.p n)
  rw [← hn]
  ext x
  simp

name: AclGeom.Perfection.Induces.iff_exists_eq_trans_frobZPow
statement:
theorem Induces.iff_exists_eq_trans_frobZPow (h₁ : π.Induces ρ φ Φ₁)
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K) :
    π.Induces ρ φ Φ₂ ↔ ∃ n : ℤ, Φ₂ = Φ₁.trans (ρ.frobZPow n)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h₂ ↦ h₁.exists_eq_trans_frobZPow h₂ htr, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
  exact h₁.trans_frobZPow n

name: AclGeom.Perfection.Induces.eq_of_p_eq_one
statement:
theorem Induces.eq_of_p_eq_one (h₁ : π.Induces ρ φ Φ₁) (h₂ : π.Induces ρ φ Φ₂)
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K) (hp : ρ.p = 1) : Φ₁ = Φ₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := h₁.exists_eq_trans_frobZPow h₂ htr
  change Φ₁ = Φ₁.trans (frobeniusZPow ρ.carrier ρ.p n)
  rw [frobeniusZPow_eq_one_of_eq_one (K := ρ.carrier) ρ.p hp n]
  ext x
  rfl

name: AclGeom.interpretedRingEquiv_coord
statement:
theorem interpretedRingEquiv_coord [PerfectField K] (q : ℕ) [ExpChar K q]
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K)
    (hcomp : JCompletenessACF (↥(algebraicClosure k (AlgebraicClosure K))) (AlgebraicClosure K))
    [PerfectField L] (q' : ℕ) [ExpChar L q']
    (htr' : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg l L)
    (hcomp' : JCompletenessACF (↥(algebraicClosure l (AlgebraicClosure L))) (AlgebraicClosure L))
    (e : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L) {x₀ a : K} (h₀ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x₀, a])
    {x₀' a' : L} (h₀' : AlgebraicIndependent l ![x₀', a'])
    (hφ : Point.map e ∘ jTupleOf x₀ a h₀ = jTupleOf x₀' a' h₀')
    {x : K} (hx : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, a]) {y : L} (hy : AlgebraicIndependent l ![y, a'])
    (hxy : Point.map e ∘ jTupleOf x a hx = jTupleOf y a' hy) :
    y * interpretedRingEquiv q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ x₀ =
      interpretedRingEquiv q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ x * x₀'
proof:
:= by
  have hx₀0 : x₀ ≠ 0 := AlgebraicIndependent.ne_zero h₀ 0
  have hx₀'0 : x₀' ≠ 0 := AlgebraicIndependent.ne_zero h₀' 0
  
  have hu : FrobEq (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) (jTupleOf x a hx) := frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr h₀ hx
  have hv : FrobEq (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) (jTupleOf x₀ a h₀) := frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr h₀ h₀
  have hD : ratioInterpDecode q htr hcomp h₀
      ((Quotient.mk (ratioSetoid q htr hcomp h₀)
        (⟨jTupleOf x a hx, hu⟩, ⟨jTupleOf x₀ a h₀, hv⟩) : Quotient _) :
        RatioInterp q htr hcomp h₀) = x / x₀ := by
    rw [ratioInterpDecode_coe, jClassEquiv_jTupleOf, jClassEquiv_jTupleOf]
  
  have hCu : ratioClassMap e h₀ h₀' hφ ⟨jTupleOf x a hx, hu⟩ =
      ⟨jTupleOf y a' hy, frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr' h₀' hy⟩ := Subtype.ext hxy
  have hCv : ratioClassMap e h₀ h₀' hφ ⟨jTupleOf x₀ a h₀, hv⟩ =
      ⟨jTupleOf x₀' a' h₀', frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr' h₀' h₀'⟩ := Subtype.ext hφ
  have hval : interpretedRingEquiv q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ (x / x₀) = y / x₀' := by
    change ratioInterpDecode q' htr' hcomp' h₀'
      (ratioInterpMap q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ
        ((ratioInterpDecode q htr hcomp h₀).symm (x / x₀))) = y / x₀'
    rw [(Equiv.symm_apply_eq _).2 hD.symm]
    change ratioInterpDecode q' htr' hcomp' h₀'
      ((Quotient.mk (ratioSetoid q' htr' hcomp' h₀')
        (ratioClassMap e h₀ h₀' hφ ⟨jTupleOf x a hx, hu⟩,
          ratioClassMap e h₀ h₀' hφ ⟨jTupleOf x₀ a h₀, hv⟩) : Quotient _) :
        RatioInterp q' htr' hcomp' h₀') = y / x₀'
    rw [hCu, hCv, ratioInterpDecode_coe, jClassEquiv_jTupleOf, jClassEquiv_jTupleOf]
  have hH0 : interpretedRingEquiv q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ x₀ ≠ 0 :=
    (map_ne_zero _).2 hx₀0
  rw [map_div₀, div_eq_div_iff hH0 hx₀'0] at hval
  exact hval.symm

name: AclGeom.interpretedRingEquiv_base_coord
statement:
theorem interpretedRingEquiv_base_coord [PerfectField K] (q : ℕ) [ExpChar K q]
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K)
    (hcomp : JCompletenessACF (↥(algebraicClosure k (AlgebraicClosure K))) (AlgebraicClosure K))
    [PerfectField L] (q' : ℕ) [ExpChar L q']
    (htr' : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg l L)
    (hcomp' : JCompletenessACF (↥(algebraicClosure l (AlgebraicClosure L))) (AlgebraicClosure L))
    (e : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L) {x₀ a : K} (h₀ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x₀, a])
    {x₀' a' : L} (h₀' : AlgebraicIndependent l ![x₀', a'])
    (hφ : Point.map e ∘ jTupleOf x₀ a h₀ = jTupleOf x₀' a' h₀') :
    interpretedRingEquiv q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ x₀ = x₀'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hx₀'0 : x₀' ≠ 0 := AlgebraicIndependent.ne_zero h₀' 0
  
  have himg : ∀ (z : K) (hz : AlgebraicIndependent k ![z, a]), ∃ (w : L)
      (hw : AlgebraicIndependent l ![w, a']), Point.map e ∘ jTupleOf z a hz = jTupleOf w a' hw := by
    intro z hz
    have h := (frobEq_map_iff e).2 (frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr h₀ hz)
    rw [hφ] at h
    exact (frobEq_jTupleOf_iff q' htr' hcomp' h₀').1 h
  
  obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁⟩ := fresh_three_of_five_le_trdeg htr {a} (by simp)
  obtain ⟨x₂, hx₂⟩ := fresh_three_of_five_le_trdeg htr {a, x₁}
    (Finset.card_le_two.trans (by norm_num))
  have hx₁' : x₁ ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K) := by simpa using hx₁
  have hx₂' : x₂ ∉ racl k ({x₁, a} : Set K) := by
    rw [Set.pair_comm]
    simpa using hx₂
  have T : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x₁, x₂, a] :=
    AlgebraicIndependent.insert_middle (pair_of_notMem h₀ hx₁') hx₂'
  
  obtain ⟨y₁, hy₁, h₁⟩ := himg x₁ (AlgebraicIndependent.pair_zero_two T)
  obtain ⟨y₂, hy₂, h₂⟩ := himg x₂ (AlgebraicIndependent.pair_one_two T)
  obtain ⟨y₁₂, hy₁₂, h₁₂⟩ := himg (x₁ * x₂) (JArith.pair_mul_a T)
  
  have T' : AlgebraicIndependent l ![y₁, y₂, a'] := by
    have h := (pointTripleIndependent_map_iff e).2 (pointTripleIndependent_jTupleOf T)
    have e0 : Point.map e (jTupleOf x₁ a (AlgebraicIndependent.pair_zero_two T) 0) =
        jTupleOf y₁ a' hy₁ 0 := congrFun h₁ 0
    have e1 : Point.map e (jTupleOf x₂ a (AlgebraicIndependent.pair_one_two T) 0) =
        jTupleOf y₂ a' hy₂ 0 := congrFun h₂ 0
    have e4 : Point.map e (jTupleOf x₁ a (AlgebraicIndependent.pair_zero_two T) 4) =
        jTupleOf y₁ a' hy₁ 4 := congrFun h₁ 4
    rw [e0, e1, e4] at h
    exact algebraicIndependent_of_rankEq_three_points (x := y₁) (y := y₂) (a := a') h
  
  have hmul : JMulRel (jTupleOf y₁ a' hy₁) (jTupleOf y₂ a' hy₂) (jTupleOf y₁₂ a' hy₁₂) := by
    have h := (jMulRel_map_iff e).2 (jMulRel_jTupleOf T)
    rw [h₁, h₂, h₁₂] at h
    exact h
  have hy : y₁₂ = y₁ * y₂ :=
    eq_of_jTupleOf_eq htr' hy₁₂ (JArith.pair_mul_a T') ((jMulRel_jTupleOf_iff T').1 hmul)
  
  have c₁ := interpretedRingEquiv_coord q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ _ hy₁ h₁
  have c₂ := interpretedRingEquiv_coord q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ _ hy₂ h₂
  have c₁₂ := interpretedRingEquiv_coord q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ _ hy₁₂ h₁₂
  rw [map_mul] at c₁₂
  have hx₁0 : x₁ ≠ 0 := AlgebraicIndependent.ne_zero T 0
  have hx₂0 : x₂ ≠ 0 := AlgebraicIndependent.ne_zero T 1
  have hP : interpretedRingEquiv q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ x₁ *
      interpretedRingEquiv q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ x₂ * x₀' ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero ((map_ne_zero _).2 hx₁0) ((map_ne_zero _).2 hx₂0)) hx₀'0
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hP
  linear_combination (-interpretedRingEquiv q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ x₀) * c₁₂ +
    interpretedRingEquiv q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ x₀ ^ 2 * hy +
    (y₂ * interpretedRingEquiv q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ x₀) * c₁ +
    (interpretedRingEquiv q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ x₁ * x₀') * c₂

name: AclGeom.interpretedRingEquiv_point
statement:
theorem interpretedRingEquiv_point [PerfectField K] (q : ℕ) [ExpChar K q]
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K)
    (hcomp : JCompletenessACF (↥(algebraicClosure k (AlgebraicClosure K))) (AlgebraicClosure K))
    [PerfectField L] (q' : ℕ) [ExpChar L q']
    (htr' : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg l L)
    (hcomp' : JCompletenessACF (↥(algebraicClosure l (AlgebraicClosure L))) (AlgebraicClosure L))
    (e : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L) {x₀ a : K} (h₀ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x₀, a])
    {x₀' a' : L} (h₀' : AlgebraicIndependent l ![x₀', a'])
    (hφ : Point.map e ∘ jTupleOf x₀ a h₀ = jTupleOf x₀' a' h₀')
    {x : K} (hx : x ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K)) :
    e (point k x) = point l (interpretedRingEquiv q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ x)
proof:
:= by
  have hx₀'0 : x₀' ≠ 0 := AlgebraicIndependent.ne_zero h₀' 0
  have hxa : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, a] := pair_of_notMem h₀ hx
  
  have h := (frobEq_map_iff e).2 (frobEq_jTupleOf_of_common htr h₀ hxa)
  rw [hφ] at h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := (frobEq_jTupleOf_iff q' htr' hcomp' h₀').1 h
  
  have hc := interpretedRingEquiv_coord q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ hxa hy hxy
  rw [interpretedRingEquiv_base_coord q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ] at hc
  have hyx : y = interpretedRingEquiv q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ x :=
    mul_right_cancel₀ hx₀'0 hc
  
  rw [← hyx]
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (congrFun hxy 0)

name: AclGeom.Perfection.isRAC_basePerf
statement:
theorem isRAC_basePerf (π : Perfection K) (hk : IsRAC (⊥ : IntermediateField k K)) :
    IsRAC (⊥ : IntermediateField (π.basePerf k) π.carrier)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hbot : (⊥ : ClosedIF k K).1.toSubfield = (algebraMap k K).fieldRange := by
    rw [ClosedIF.coe_bot, isRAC_iff_racl_eq.1 hk, IntermediateField.bot_toSubfield]
  
  have heq : π.perfIF k ⊥ = ⊥ := by
    apply IntermediateField.toSubfield_injective
    rw [IntermediateField.bot_toSubfield]
    change π.perfSubfield (⊥ : ClosedIF k K).1.toSubfield = (π.basePerf k).subtype.fieldRange
    rw [hbot]
    exact (Subfield.fieldRange_subtype _).symm
  rw [← heq]
  exact π.isRAC_perfIF ⊥

name: AclGeom.Perfection.exists_induces
statement:
theorem exists_induces (π : Perfection K) (ρ : Perfection L)
    (hk : IsRAC (⊥ : IntermediateField k K)) (hl : IsRAC (⊥ : IntermediateField l L))
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K)
    (hcomp : JCompletenessACF (↥(algebraicClosure (↥(π.basePerf k)) (AlgebraicClosure π.carrier)))
      (AlgebraicClosure π.carrier))
    (hcomp' : JCompletenessACF (↥(algebraicClosure (↥(ρ.basePerf l)) (AlgebraicClosure ρ.carrier)))
      (AlgebraicClosure ρ.carrier))
    (φ : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L) :
    ∃ Φ : π.carrier ≃+* ρ.carrier,
      CrossBase.Compatible (k := π.basePerf k) (l := ρ.basePerf l) Φ ∧ π.Induces ρ φ Φ
proof:
:= by
  have : PerfectField π.carrier := PerfectRing.toPerfectField π.carrier π.p
  have : PerfectField ρ.carrier := PerfectRing.toPerfectField ρ.carrier ρ.p
  
  have htrπ : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg (π.basePerf k) π.carrier :=
    Cardinal.ofNat_le_lift_iff.1 <| (Cardinal.ofNat_le_lift_iff.2 htr).trans
      (lift_trdeg_le_of_orderIso (π.latticeIso k))
  
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ, he⟩ := exists_ringEquiv_closedIFMap_eq π.p htrπ hcomp ρ.p hcomp'
    (π.isRAC_basePerf hk) (ρ.isRAC_basePerf hl)
    ((π.latticeIso k).symm.trans (φ.trans (ρ.latticeIso l)))
  refine ⟨σ, hσ, (induces_iff_eq_inducedIso hσ).2 ?_⟩
  rw [inducedIso, ← he]
  ext M
  simp only [OrderIso.trans_apply, OrderIso.symm_apply_apply]

name: AclGeom.closedIFMap_interpretedRingEquiv
statement:
theorem closedIFMap_interpretedRingEquiv [PerfectField K] (q : ℕ) [ExpChar K q]
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K)
    (hcomp : JCompletenessACF (↥(algebraicClosure k (AlgebraicClosure K))) (AlgebraicClosure K))
    [PerfectField L] (q' : ℕ) [ExpChar L q']
    (htr' : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg l L)
    (hcomp' : JCompletenessACF (↥(algebraicClosure l (AlgebraicClosure L))) (AlgebraicClosure L))
    (e : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L) {x₀ a : K} (h₀ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x₀, a])
    {x₀' a' : L} (h₀' : AlgebraicIndependent l ![x₀', a'])
    (hφ : Point.map e ∘ jTupleOf x₀ a h₀ = jTupleOf x₀' a' h₀')
    (hk : IsRAC (⊥ : IntermediateField k K)) (hl : IsRAC (⊥ : IntermediateField l L)) :
    e = CrossBase.closedIFMap (interpretedRingEquiv q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ)
      (interpretedRingEquiv_compatible q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ hk hl)
proof:
:=
  eq_closedIFMap_of_point_eq e
    (interpretedRingEquiv_compatible q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ hk hl) (a := a)
    fun _ hx ↦ interpretedRingEquiv_point q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ hx

name: AclGeom.exists_ringEquiv_closedIFMap_eq
statement:
theorem exists_ringEquiv_closedIFMap_eq [PerfectField K] (q : ℕ) [ExpChar K q]
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K)
    (hcomp : JCompletenessACF (↥(algebraicClosure k (AlgebraicClosure K))) (AlgebraicClosure K))
    [PerfectField L] (q' : ℕ) [ExpChar L q']
    (hcomp' : JCompletenessACF (↥(algebraicClosure l (AlgebraicClosure L))) (AlgebraicClosure L))
    (hk : IsRAC (⊥ : IntermediateField k K)) (hl : IsRAC (⊥ : IntermediateField l L))
    (e : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L) :
    ∃ (σ : K ≃+* L) (hσ : CrossBase.Compatible (k := k) (l := l) σ),
      e = CrossBase.closedIFMap σ hσ
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := fresh_three_of_five_le_trdeg htr ∅ (by simp)
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx⟩ := fresh_three_of_five_le_trdeg htr {a} (by simp)
  have ha' : a ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) := by simpa using ha
  have hx' : x₀ ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K) := by simpa using hx
  have h₀ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x₀, a] :=
    algebraicIndependent_pair hx' fun h ↦ hx' (racl_exchange_singleton ha' h)
  
  have htr' : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg l L :=
    Cardinal.ofNat_le_lift_iff.1 <| (Cardinal.ofNat_le_lift_iff.2 htr).trans
      (lift_trdeg_le_of_orderIso e)
  obtain ⟨x₀', a', h₀', hφ⟩ := exists_map_jTupleOf_eq q' hcomp' e htr h₀
  exact ⟨_, _, closedIFMap_interpretedRingEquiv q htr hcomp q' htr' hcomp' e h₀ h₀' hφ hk hl⟩

name: AclGeom.j_rigidity_field
statement:
theorem j_rigidity_field (q : ℕ) [ExpChar k q]
    {x a y b : K} (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, a])
    (hy : y ∈ racl k {x}) (hx : x ∈ racl k {y})
    (hb : b ∈ racl k {a}) (ha : a ∈ racl k {b})
    (hadd : y + b ∈ racl k {x + a}) (hadd' : x + a ∈ racl k {y + b})
    (hmul : y * b ∈ racl k {x * a}) (hmul' : x * a ∈ racl k {y * b})
    (hjj : y * (1 + b) ∈ racl k {x * (1 + a)})
    (hjj' : x * (1 + a) ∈ racl k {y * (1 + b)})
    {s s' : K} (hs : s ∉ racl k {x, a}) (hss' : s' ∉ racl k {x, a, s}) :
    ∃ u v : ℕ, y ^ q ^ v = x ^ q ^ u ∧ b ^ q ^ v = a ^ q ^ u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set Ω := AlgebraicClosure K
  set ι : K →ₐ[k] Ω := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k K Ω with hιdef
  have hιinj : Function.Injective ι := ι.toRingHom.injective
  have : IsAlgClosed (↥(algebraicClosure k Ω)) :=
    (algebraicClosure.isAlgClosure k Ω).isAlgClosed
  have : ExpChar (↥(algebraicClosure k Ω)) q :=
    expChar_of_injective_ringHom
      (algebraMap k (↥(algebraicClosure k Ω))).injective q
  have halg : ∀ z ∈ algebraicClosure k Ω, IsAlgebraic k z := fun z hz ↦
    (mem_algebraicClosure_iff (F := k)).1 hz
  have hbase : ∀ {S : Set Ω} {z : Ω},
      z ∈ racl k S ↔ z ∈ racl (↥(algebraicClosure k Ω)) S :=
    fun {S z} ↦ (mem_racl_base_iff_of_algebraic halg).symm
  have tr : ∀ {w z : K}, z ∈ racl k ({w} : Set K) →
      ι z ∈ racl (↥(algebraicClosure k Ω)) ({ι w} : Set Ω) := fun h ↦
    hbase.1 ((algHom_mem_racl_singleton_iff ι).2 h)
  have hpair : (⇑ι '' ({x, a} : Set K)) = ({ι x, ι a} : Set Ω) := by
    simp [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton]
  have htriple : (⇑ι '' ({x, a, s} : Set K)) = ({ι x, ι a, ι s} : Set Ω) := by
    simp [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton]
  have hindΩ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![ι x, ι a] := by
    refine algebraicIndependent_pair ?_ ?_
    · intro h
      exact AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_pair' hind
        ((algHom_mem_racl_singleton_iff ι).1 h)
    · intro h
      exact AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_pair hind
        ((algHom_mem_racl_singleton_iff ι).1 h)
  have hindb : AlgebraicIndependent (↥(algebraicClosure k Ω)) ![ι x, ι a] :=
    algebraicIndependent_pair_base_of_algebraic halg hindΩ
  have hsΩ : ι s ∉ racl (↥(algebraicClosure k Ω)) ({ι x, ι a} : Set Ω) := by
    intro h
    apply hs
    rw [← algHom_mem_racl_image_iff ι, hpair]
    exact hbase.2 h
  have hss'Ω :
      ι s' ∉ racl (↥(algebraicClosure k Ω)) ({ι x, ι a, ι s} : Set Ω) := by
    intro h
    apply hss'
    rw [← algHom_mem_racl_image_iff ι, htriple]
    exact hbase.2 h
  obtain ⟨u, v, h1, h2⟩ := j_rigidity (k := ↥(algebraicClosure k Ω)) q
    (x := ι x) (a := ι a) (y := ι y) (b := ι b) hindb
    (tr hy) (tr hx) (tr hb) (tr ha)
    (by simpa only [map_add] using tr hadd)
    (by simpa only [map_add] using tr hadd')
    (by simpa only [map_mul] using tr hmul)
    (by simpa only [map_mul] using tr hmul')
    (by simpa only [map_add, map_mul, map_one] using tr hjj)
    (by simpa only [map_add, map_mul, map_one] using tr hjj')
    hsΩ hss'Ω
  refine ⟨u, v, hιinj ?_, hιinj ?_⟩
  · rw [map_pow, map_pow]
    exact h1
  · rw [map_pow, map_pow]
    exact h2

name: AclGeom.eq_of_frobeniusZPow_apply_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hd : frobeniusZPow K q (m - n) x = x := by
    rw [frobeniusZPow_sub, RingAut.mul_apply, h]
    exact (frobeniusZPow K q n).symm_apply_apply x
  have hsep : ∀ d : ℕ, frobeniusZPow K q d x = x → d = 0 := fun d hfix ↦ by
    rw [frobeniusZPow_natCast_apply] at hfix
    have h0 : x ^ q ^ d = x ^ q ^ 0 := by rw [hfix, pow_zero, pow_one]
    exact pow_pow_sep_of_notMem_racl_empty hx hq h0
  rcases Int.eq_nat_or_neg (m - n) with ⟨d, hd' | hd'⟩
  · rw [hd'] at hd
    have := hsep d hd
    omega
  · have hd2 : frobeniusZPow K q d x = x := by
      have h3 : frobeniusZPow K q d (frobeniusZPow K q (m - n) x) =
          frobeniusZPow K q d x := by rw [hd]
      rw [← RingAut.mul_apply, frobeniusZPow, frobeniusZPow, ← zpow_add,
        hd', add_neg_cancel, zpow_zero] at h3
      exact h3.symm
    have := hsep d hd2
    omega

name: AclGeom.frobeniusZPow_eq_of_apply_eq
statement:
theorem frobeniusZPow_eq_of_apply_eq {m n : ℤ} {x : K}
    (hx : x ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    (h : frobeniusZPow K q m x = frobeniusZPow K q n x) :
    frobeniusZPow K q m = frobeniusZPow K q n
proof:
:= by
  rcases expChar_is_prime_or_one K q with hq | hq
  · rw [eq_of_frobeniusZPow_apply_eq q hq.two_le hx h]
  · rw [frobeniusZPow_eq_one_of_eq_one q hq m, frobeniusZPow_eq_one_of_eq_one q hq n]

name: AclGeom.racl_exchange_singleton
statement:
theorem racl_exchange_singleton {x y : K} (hx : x ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    (h : x ∈ racl k ({y} : Set K)) : y ∈ racl k ({x} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have h' : x ∈ racl k (insert y (∅ : Set K)) := by simpa using h
  simpa using racl_exchange h' hx

name: AclGeom.add_notMem_racl_empty
statement:
theorem add_notMem_racl_empty {t c : K} (ht : t ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    (hc : c ∈ racl k (∅ : Set K)) : t + c ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply ht
  have := sub_mem h hc
  rwa [add_sub_cancel_right] at this

name: AclGeom.exists_frobeniusZPow_pair
statement:
theorem exists_frobeniusZPow_pair (σ : K ≃+* K)
    (hσ : ∀ z : K, z ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) →
      ClosedIF.point k (σ z) = ClosedIF.point k z)
    (hfresh : ∀ S : Finset K, S.card ≤ 3 → ∃ z, z ∉ racl k (S : Set K))
    {x a : K} (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x, a]) :
    ∃ n : ℤ, σ x = frobeniusZPow K q n x ∧ σ a = frobeniusZPow K q n a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : ExpChar k q := (algebraMap k K).expChar (algebraMap k K).injective q
  obtain ⟨hx, hxa, hmul, hjj, ha⟩ := jCoordinates_notMem_bot hind
  have htrans : ∀ z : K, z ∉ (⊥ : ClosedIF k K) → z ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) :=
    fun z hz h ↦ hz (ClosedIF.mem_bot_iff.2 (isAlgebraic_of_mem_racl_empty h))
  have hx0 := htrans x hx
  have hxa0 := htrans (x + a) hxa
  have hmul0 := htrans (x * a) hmul
  have hjj0 : x * (1 + a) ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) := by
    rw [show x * (1 + a) = x + x * a by ring]
    exact htrans _ hjj
  have ha0 := htrans a ha
  obtain ⟨r₁, r₁'⟩ := ClosedIF.point_eq_point_iff.1 (hσ x hx0)
  obtain ⟨r₂, r₂'⟩ := ClosedIF.point_eq_point_iff.1 (hσ _ hxa0)
  obtain ⟨r₃, r₃'⟩ := ClosedIF.point_eq_point_iff.1 (hσ _ hmul0)
  obtain ⟨r₄, r₄'⟩ := ClosedIF.point_eq_point_iff.1 (hσ _ hjj0)
  obtain ⟨r₅, r₅'⟩ := ClosedIF.point_eq_point_iff.1 (hσ a ha0)
  rw [map_add] at r₂ r₂'
  rw [map_mul] at r₃ r₃'
  rw [map_mul, map_add, map_one] at r₄ r₄'
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hfresh {x, a} ((Finset.card_insert_le _ _).trans (by simp))
  obtain ⟨s', hs'⟩ := hfresh {x, a, s}
    ((Finset.card_insert_le _ _).trans
      (Nat.succ_le_succ ((Finset.card_insert_le _ _).trans (by simp))))
  have hs₂ : s ∉ racl k ({x, a} : Set K) := by simpa using hs
  have hs₂' : s' ∉ racl k ({x, a, s} : Set K) := by simpa using hs'
  obtain ⟨u, v, h1, h2⟩ := j_rigidity_field q hind r₁ r₁' r₅ r₅' r₂ r₂' r₃ r₃'
    r₄ r₄' hs₂ hs₂'
  exact ⟨(u : ℤ) - v, (frobeniusZPow_sub_apply_of_pow_eq q h1).symm,
    (frobeniusZPow_sub_apply_of_pow_eq q h2).symm⟩

name: AclGeom.exists_eq_frobeniusZPow_of_point_fixed
statement:
theorem exists_eq_frobeniusZPow_of_point_fixed
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K) (σ : K ≃+* K)
    (hσ : ∀ z : K, z ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) →
      ClosedIF.point k (σ z) = ClosedIF.point k z) :
    ∃ n : ℤ, σ = frobeniusZPow K q n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : ExpChar k q := (algebraMap k K).expChar (algebraMap k K).injective q
  have hfresh := fresh_three_of_five_le_trdeg htr
  have hfresh4 := fresh_four_of_five_le_trdeg htr
  
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := hfresh ∅ (by simp)
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ := hfresh {x₀} (by simp)
  have hx₀' : x₀ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) := by simpa using hx₀
  have ha₀' : a₀ ∉ racl k ({x₀} : Set K) := by simpa using ha₀
  have hind₀ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x₀, a₀] := by
    refine algebraicIndependent_pair ?_ ha₀'
    intro h
    
    
    exact ha₀' (racl_exchange_singleton hx₀' h)
  obtain ⟨n, hxn, -⟩ := exists_frobeniusZPow_pair q σ hσ hfresh hind₀
  
  have htrans : ∀ z : K, z ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) →
      σ z = frobeniusZPow K q n z := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hfresh4 {x₀, a₀, z}
      ((Finset.card_insert_le _ _).trans
        (Nat.succ_le_succ ((Finset.card_insert_le _ _).trans (by simp))))
    have ht' : t ∉ racl k ({x₀, a₀, z} : Set K) := by simpa using ht
    have hind₁ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x₀, t] := by
      refine algebraicIndependent_pair ?_ ?_
      · intro h
        exact ht' (racl_exchange_singleton hx₀'
          h |> fun h' ↦ racl_mono (by simp) h')
      · intro h
        exact ht' (racl_mono (by simp) h)
    have hind₂ : AlgebraicIndependent k ![z, t] := by
      refine algebraicIndependent_pair ?_ ?_
      · intro h
        exact ht' (racl_exchange_singleton hz h |> fun h' ↦ racl_mono (by simp) h')
      · intro h
        exact ht' (racl_mono (by simp) h)
    obtain ⟨n₁, hx₁, ht₁⟩ := exists_frobeniusZPow_pair q σ hσ hfresh hind₁
    obtain ⟨n₂, hz₂, ht₂⟩ := exists_frobeniusZPow_pair q σ hσ hfresh hind₂
    have ht0 : t ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) := fun h ↦ ht' (racl_mono (by simp) h)
    have e₁ : frobeniusZPow K q n = frobeniusZPow K q n₁ :=
      frobeniusZPow_eq_of_apply_eq q hx₀' (hxn.symm.trans hx₁)
    have e₂ : frobeniusZPow K q n₁ = frobeniusZPow K q n₂ :=
      frobeniusZPow_eq_of_apply_eq q ht0 (ht₁.symm.trans ht₂)
    rw [hz₂, e₁, e₂]
  refine ⟨n, RingEquiv.ext fun c ↦ ?_⟩
  by_cases hc : c ∈ racl k (∅ : Set K)
  · 
    have h1 := htrans (x₀ + c) (add_notMem_racl_empty hx₀' hc)
    have h2 := htrans x₀ hx₀'
    rw [map_add, map_add, h2] at h1
    exact add_left_cancel h1
  · exact htrans c hc

name: AclGeom.frobeniusZPow_injective
proof:
:= by
  rcases expChar_is_prime_or_one K q with hp | hq1
  · exact eq_of_frobeniusZPow_apply_eq q hp.two_le hx (by rw [h])
  · exact absurd hq1 hq

name: AclGeom.eq_refl_of_point_fixed
statement:
theorem eq_refl_of_point_fixed [ExpChar K 1]
    (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K) (σ : K ≃+* K)
    (hσ : ∀ z : K, z ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) →
      ClosedIF.point k (σ z) = ClosedIF.point k z) :
    σ = RingEquiv.refl K
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_eq_frobeniusZPow_of_point_fixed 1 htr σ hσ
  rw [hn, frobeniusZPow_eq_one_of_eq_one 1 rfl n]
  rfl

name: AclGeom.Perfection.p_eq_of_ringEquiv
statement: theorem p_eq_of_ringEquiv (π : Perfection K) (ρ : Perfection L) (σ : K ≃+* L) : π.p = ρ.p
proof:
:= by
  have : ExpChar L π.p := expChar_of_injective_ringHom (f := σ.toRingHom) σ.injective π.p
  exact ExpChar.eq this ρ.expCharBase

name: AclGeom.Perfection.isPRadical_ringEquiv
statement:
theorem isPRadical_ringEquiv (σ : K ≃+* L) (p : ℕ) : IsPRadical σ.toRingHom p where
  pow_mem' x
proof:
:= ⟨0, σ.symm x, by simp⟩
  ker_le' x hx := by
    have hx0 : x = 0 := σ.injective (by simpa using hx)
    rw [hx0]
    exact Ideal.zero_mem _

name: AclGeom.Perfection.reindex
statement:
theorem reindex (σ : K ≃+* L) :
    ∃ _ : ExpChar ρ.carrier π.p, ∃ _ : PerfectRing ρ.carrier π.p,
      IsPerfectClosure (ρ.incl.comp σ.toRingHom) π.p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h⟩ : Nonempty (π.p = ρ.p) := ⟨p_eq_of_ringEquiv π ρ σ⟩
  have e1 : ExpChar ρ.carrier π.p := h ▸ ρ.expCharCarrier
  have e2 : PerfectRing ρ.carrier π.p := by
    have := ρ.perfect
    convert this using 2
  have e3 : ExpChar L π.p := h ▸ ρ.expCharBase
  have e4 : IsPRadical ρ.incl π.p := by
    have := ρ.isPerfectClosure
    convert this using 2
  have := isPRadical_ringEquiv σ π.p
  exact ⟨e1, e2, IsPRadical.trans σ.toRingHom ρ.incl π.p⟩

name: AclGeom.Perfection.liftEquiv_incl
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftEquiv_incl (σ : K ≃+* L) (x : K) :
    π.liftEquiv ρ σ (π.incl x) = ρ.incl (σ x)
proof:
:= by
  have := (π.reindex ρ σ).1
  have := (π.reindex ρ σ).2.1
  have := (π.reindex ρ σ).2.2
  exact IsPerfectClosure.equiv_comp_apply π.incl (ρ.incl.comp σ.toRingHom) π.p x

name: AclGeom.Perfection.liftEquiv_unique
statement:
theorem liftEquiv_unique (σ : K ≃+* L) (f : π.carrier →+* ρ.carrier)
    (hf : ∀ x, f (π.incl x) = ρ.incl (σ x)) : f = (π.liftEquiv ρ σ).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  have := (π.reindex ρ σ).1
  have := (π.reindex ρ σ).2.1
  have := (π.reindex ρ σ).2.2
  have hcomp : f.comp π.incl = ρ.incl.comp σ.toRingHom := RingHom.ext hf
  change f = (IsPerfectClosure.equiv π.incl (ρ.incl.comp σ.toRingHom) π.p).toRingHom
  rw [IsPerfectClosure.equiv_toRingHom, ← hcomp, PerfectRing.comp_lift]

name: AclGeom.Perfection.liftEquiv_ext
statement:
theorem liftEquiv_ext {σ : K ≃+* L} {e : π.carrier ≃+* ρ.carrier}
    (he : ∀ x, e (π.incl x) = ρ.incl (σ x)) : e = π.liftEquiv ρ σ
proof:
:=
  RingEquiv.toRingHom_injective (π.liftEquiv_unique ρ σ e.toRingHom he)

name: AclGeom.Perfection.liftEquiv_refl
statement: theorem liftEquiv_refl : π.liftEquiv π (RingEquiv.refl K) = RingEquiv.refl _
proof:
:=
  (π.liftEquiv_ext π (σ := RingEquiv.refl K) (e := RingEquiv.refl _) fun _ ↦ rfl).symm

name: AclGeom.Perfection.liftEquiv_trans
statement:
theorem liftEquiv_trans (σ : K ≃+* L) (τ : L ≃+* M) :
    π.liftEquiv θ (σ.trans τ) = (π.liftEquiv ρ σ).trans (ρ.liftEquiv θ τ)
proof:
:=
  (π.liftEquiv_ext θ fun x ↦ by simp).symm

name: AclGeom.Perfection.liftEquiv_symm
statement: theorem liftEquiv_symm (σ : K ≃+* L) : (π.liftEquiv ρ σ).symm = ρ.liftEquiv π σ.symm
proof:
:=
  ρ.liftEquiv_ext π fun x ↦ by
    rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_eq, liftEquiv_incl, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: AclGeom.Perfection.perfSubfield_map
statement:
theorem perfSubfield_map (σ : K ≃+* L) (N : Subfield K) :
    (π.perfSubfield N).map (π.liftEquiv ρ σ).toRingHom =
      ρ.perfSubfield (N.map σ.toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  have h := p_eq_of_ringEquiv π ρ σ
  ext y
  simp only [Subfield.mem_map, mem_perfSubfield_iff, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe,
    RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, ⟨n, m, hm, hx⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨n, σ m, ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [← h, ← map_pow, hx, liftEquiv_incl]
  · rintro ⟨n, _, ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩, hy⟩
    refine ⟨(π.liftEquiv ρ σ).symm y, ⟨n, m, hm, ?_⟩, by simp⟩
    apply (π.liftEquiv ρ σ).injective
    rw [map_pow, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply, liftEquiv_incl, h, hy]

name: AclGeom.Perfection.basePerf_map
statement:
theorem basePerf_map {σ : K ≃+* L} (hσ : CrossBase.Compatible (k := k) (l := l) σ) :
    (π.basePerf k).map (π.liftEquiv ρ σ).toRingHom = ρ.basePerf l
proof:
:= by
  rw [basePerf, perfSubfield_map, basePerf]
  exact congrArg ρ.perfSubfield hσ

name: AclGeom.Perfection.compatible_liftEquiv
statement:
theorem compatible_liftEquiv {σ : K ≃+* L} (hσ : CrossBase.Compatible (k := k) (l := l) σ) :
    CrossBase.Compatible (k := π.basePerf k) (l := ρ.basePerf l) (π.liftEquiv ρ σ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold CrossBase.Compatible
  change (π.basePerf k).subtype.fieldRange.map _ = (ρ.basePerf l).subtype.fieldRange
  rw [Subfield.fieldRange_subtype, Subfield.fieldRange_subtype]
  exact π.basePerf_map ρ hσ

name: AclGeom.Perfection.latticeIso_natural
statement:
theorem latticeIso_natural {σ : K ≃+* L} (hσ : CrossBase.Compatible (k := k) (l := l) σ)
    (N : ClosedIF k K) :
    CrossBase.closedIFMap (π.liftEquiv ρ σ) (π.compatible_liftEquiv ρ hσ) (π.latticeIso k N) =
      ρ.latticeIso l (CrossBase.closedIFMap σ hσ N)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply SetLike.coe_injective
  rw [CrossBase.coe_closedIFMap]
  have h := congrArg (fun F : Subfield ρ.carrier ↦ (F : Set ρ.carrier))
    (π.perfSubfield_map ρ σ N.1.toSubfield)
  simp only [Subfield.coe_map, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom] at h
  change (π.liftEquiv ρ σ) '' (π.perfSubfield N.1.toSubfield : Set π.carrier) =
    (ρ.perfSubfield (CrossBase.closedIFMap σ hσ N).1.toSubfield : Set ρ.carrier)
  rw [h]
  congr 2
  apply SetLike.coe_injective
  rw [Subfield.coe_map]
  exact (CrossBase.coe_closedIFMap hσ N).symm

name: AclGeom.Perfection.bot_toSubfield_of_isRAC
statement:
private theorem bot_toSubfield_of_isRAC (hk : IsRAC (⊥ : IntermediateField k K)) :
    (⊥ : ClosedIF k K).1.toSubfield = (algebraMap k K).fieldRange
proof:
:= by
  rw [ClosedIF.coe_bot, isRAC_iff_racl_eq.1 hk, IntermediateField.bot_toSubfield]

name: AclGeom.Perfection.induces_liftEquiv
statement:
theorem induces_liftEquiv {σ : K ≃+* L} (hσ : CrossBase.Compatible (k := k) (l := l) σ) :
    π.Induces ρ (CrossBase.closedIFMap σ hσ) (π.liftEquiv ρ σ)
proof:
:= by
  intro M
  rw [perfSubfield_map]
  congr 1
  apply SetLike.coe_injective
  rw [Subfield.coe_map]
  exact CrossBase.coe_closedIFMap hσ M

name: AclGeom.Perfection.Induces.mem_iff
statement:
theorem Induces.mem_iff (h : π.Induces ρ φ Φ) {M : ClosedIF k K} {y : L} :
    y ∈ φ M ↔ ρ.incl y ∈ (π.perfSubfield M.1.toSubfield).map Φ.toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h M]
  exact ρ.incl_mem_perfIF_iff.symm

name: AclGeom.Perfection.Induces.map_bot
statement:
theorem Induces.map_bot (h : π.Induces ρ φ Φ) :
    (π.perfSubfield (⊥ : ClosedIF k K).1.toSubfield).map Φ.toRingHom =
      ρ.perfSubfield (⊥ : ClosedIF l L).1.toSubfield
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h ⊥, OrderIso.map_bot]

name: AclGeom.Perfection.Induces.unique
statement: theorem Induces.unique (h₁ : π.Induces ρ φ Φ) (h₂ : π.Induces ρ ψ Φ) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  refine OrderIso.ext (funext fun M ↦ Subtype.ext (SetLike.ext fun y ↦ ?_))
  rw [ClosedIF.mem_val, ClosedIF.mem_val, h₁.mem_iff, h₂.mem_iff]

name: AclGeom.Perfection.Induces.compatible
statement:
theorem Induces.compatible (h : π.Induces ρ φ Φ) (hk : IsRAC (⊥ : IntermediateField k K))
    (hl : IsRAC (⊥ : IntermediateField l L)) :
    CrossBase.Compatible (k := π.basePerf k) (l := ρ.basePerf l) Φ
proof:
:= by
  unfold CrossBase.Compatible
  change (π.basePerf k).subtype.fieldRange.map _ = (ρ.basePerf l).subtype.fieldRange
  rw [Subfield.fieldRange_subtype, Subfield.fieldRange_subtype, basePerf, basePerf,
    ← bot_toSubfield_of_isRAC hk, ← bot_toSubfield_of_isRAC hl]
  exact h.map_bot

name: AclGeom.Perfection.Induces.trans_frobZPow
statement:
theorem Induces.trans_frobZPow (h : π.Induces ρ φ Φ) (n : ℤ) :
    π.Induces ρ φ (Φ.trans (ρ.frobZPow n))
proof:
:= by
  intro M
  apply SetLike.coe_injective
  have hM := congrArg (fun F : Subfield ρ.carrier ↦ (F : Set ρ.carrier)) (h M)
  simp only [Subfield.coe_map, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom] at hM ⊢
  rw [RingEquiv.coe_trans, Set.image_comp, ← hM]
  exact (ρ.frobZPow_image_closed n (ρ.perfClosed l (φ M))).symm

name: AclGeom.Perfection.induces_inducedIso
statement:
theorem induces_inducedIso (hΦ : CrossBase.Compatible (k := π.basePerf k) (l := ρ.basePerf l) Φ) :
    π.Induces ρ (π.inducedIso ρ hΦ) Φ
proof:
:= by
  intro M
  apply SetLike.coe_injective
  have hM : ρ.latticeIso l (π.inducedIso ρ hΦ M) =
      CrossBase.closedIFMap Φ hΦ (π.latticeIso k M) := by
    rw [inducedIso, OrderIso.trans_apply, OrderIso.trans_apply, OrderIso.apply_symm_apply]
  have hc := congrArg (fun N : ClosedIF (ρ.basePerf l) ρ.carrier ↦ (N.1 : Set ρ.carrier)) hM
  simp only [CrossBase.coe_closedIFMap] at hc
  rw [Subfield.coe_map, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom]
  exact hc

name: AclGeom.Perfection.induces_iff_eq_inducedIso
statement:
theorem induces_iff_eq_inducedIso
    (hΦ : CrossBase.Compatible (k := π.basePerf k) (l := ρ.basePerf l) Φ) :
    π.Induces ρ φ Φ ↔ φ = π.inducedIso ρ hΦ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ h.unique (induces_inducedIso hΦ), ?_⟩
  rintro rfl
  exact induces_inducedIso hΦ

name: AclGeom.Perfection.inducedIso_refl
statement:
theorem inducedIso_refl (π : Perfection K) :
    π.inducedIso π (CrossBase.compatible_refl (k := π.basePerf k)) = OrderIso.refl _
proof:
:= by
  rw [inducedIso, CrossBase.closedIFMap_refl, OrderIso.refl_trans, OrderIso.self_trans_symm]

name: AclGeom.Perfection.inducedIso_trans
proof:
:= by
  refine OrderIso.ext (funext fun M ↦ ?_)
  simp only [inducedIso, OrderIso.trans_apply, OrderIso.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [CrossBase.closedIFMap_trans hΦ hΨ, OrderIso.trans_apply]

name: AclGeom.Perfection.compatible_frobZPow
statement:
theorem compatible_frobZPow (π : Perfection K) (hk : IsRAC (⊥ : IntermediateField k K))
    (n : ℤ) : CrossBase.Compatible (k := π.basePerf k) (l := π.basePerf k) (π.frobZPow n)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (induces_inducedIso (π := π) (ρ := π)
    (CrossBase.compatible_refl (k := π.basePerf k))).trans_frobZPow n
  have he : (RingEquiv.refl π.carrier).trans (π.frobZPow n) = π.frobZPow n :=
    RingEquiv.ext fun _ ↦ rfl
  rw [he] at h
  exact h.compatible hk hk

name: AclGeom.Perfection.inducedIso_frobZPow
statement:
theorem inducedIso_frobZPow (π : Perfection K) (hk : IsRAC (⊥ : IntermediateField k K))
    (n : ℤ) : π.inducedIso π (π.compatible_frobZPow hk n) = OrderIso.refl _
proof:
:= by
  have h := (induces_inducedIso (π := π) (ρ := π)
    (CrossBase.compatible_refl (k := π.basePerf k))).trans_frobZPow n
  have he : (RingEquiv.refl π.carrier).trans (π.frobZPow n) = π.frobZPow n :=
    RingEquiv.ext fun _ ↦ rfl
  rw [inducedIso_refl, he] at h
  exact ((induces_iff_eq_inducedIso _).1 h).symm

name: AclGeom.Perfection.incl_injective
statement: theorem incl_injective : Function.Injective π.incl
proof:
:=
  π.incl.injective

name: AclGeom.Perfection.exists_pow_incl
statement:
theorem exists_pow_incl (x : π.carrier) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (y : K), π.incl y = x ^ π.p ^ n
proof:
:=
  IsPRadical.pow_mem π.incl π.p x

name: AclGeom.Perfection.mem_perfSubfield_iff
statement:
theorem mem_perfSubfield_iff {M : Subfield K} {x : π.carrier} :
    x ∈ π.perfSubfield M ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ m ∈ M, x ^ π.p ^ n = π.incl m
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: AclGeom.Perfection.perfSubfield_mono
statement:
theorem perfSubfield_mono {M N : Subfield K} (h : M ≤ N) :
    π.perfSubfield M ≤ π.perfSubfield N
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨n, m, hm, hx⟩
  exact ⟨n, m, h hm, hx⟩

name: AclGeom.Perfection.incl_mem_perfSubfield_iff
statement:
theorem incl_mem_perfSubfield_iff {M : Subfield K} {x : K} :
    π.incl x ∈ π.perfSubfield M ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, x ^ π.p ^ n ∈ M
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, m, hm, hx⟩
    rw [← map_pow] at hx
    exact ⟨n, by rw [π.incl_injective hx]; exact hm⟩
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    exact ⟨n, x ^ π.p ^ n, hn, by rw [map_pow]⟩

name: AclGeom.Perfection.incl_mem_perfSubfield
statement:
theorem incl_mem_perfSubfield {M : Subfield K} {x : K} (hx : x ∈ M) :
    π.incl x ∈ π.perfSubfield M
proof:
:=
  π.incl_mem_perfSubfield_iff.2 ⟨0, by simpa using hx⟩

name: AclGeom.Perfection.mem_basePerf_iff
statement:
theorem mem_basePerf_iff {x : π.carrier} :
    x ∈ π.basePerf k ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ c : k, x ^ π.p ^ n = π.incl (algebraMap k K c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [basePerf, mem_perfSubfield_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, m, ⟨c, rfl⟩, h⟩
    exact ⟨n, c, h⟩
  · rintro ⟨n, c, h⟩
    exact ⟨n, algebraMap k K c, ⟨c, rfl⟩, h⟩

name: AclGeom.Perfection.basePerf_le_perfSubfield
statement:
theorem basePerf_le_perfSubfield (M : ClosedIF k K) :
    π.basePerf k ≤ π.perfSubfield M.1.toSubfield
proof:
:=
  π.perfSubfield_mono fun _ hy ↦ by
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact M.1.algebraMap_mem c

name: AclGeom.Perfection.mem_perfIF_iff
statement:
theorem mem_perfIF_iff {M : ClosedIF k K} {x : π.carrier} :
    x ∈ π.perfIF k M ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ m ∈ M, x ^ π.p ^ n = π.incl m
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: AclGeom.Perfection.perfIF_mono
statement:
theorem perfIF_mono {M N : ClosedIF k K} (h : M ≤ N) :
    π.perfIF k M ≤ π.perfIF k N
proof:
:= fun _ hx ↦ by
  obtain ⟨n, m, hm, hxm⟩ := hx
  exact ⟨n, m, ClosedIF.le_iff.1 h hm, hxm⟩

name: AclGeom.Perfection.incl_mem_perfIF_iff
statement:
theorem incl_mem_perfIF_iff {M : ClosedIF k K} {x : K} :
    π.incl x ∈ π.perfIF k M ↔ x ∈ M
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_perfIF_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, m, hm, hx⟩
    rw [← map_pow] at hx
    have hxm : x ^ π.p ^ n ∈ M.1 := by
      rw [π.incl_injective hx]
      exact hm
    exact M.2.mem_of_pow_mem (expChar_pow_pos K π.p n).ne' hxm
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨0, x, hx, by simp⟩

name: AclGeom.Perfection.isRAC_perfIF
statement: theorem isRAC_perfIF (M : ClosedIF k K) : IsRAC (π.perfIF k M)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x hx
  
  obtain ⟨q, hq0, hqx, hqc⟩ := exists_poly_of_isAlgebraic hx
  
  
  choose e m hm hqm using fun n ↦ π.mem_perfIF_iff.1 (hqc n)
  set s := q.support.sup e with hs
  have key : ∀ n, ∃ c ∈ M, q.coeff n ^ π.p ^ s = π.incl c := by
    intro n
    by_cases hn : n ∈ q.support
    · refine ⟨m n ^ π.p ^ (s - e n),
        ClosedIF.mem_val.1 (pow_mem (ClosedIF.mem_val.2 (hm n)) _), ?_⟩
      have hsplit : π.p ^ s = π.p ^ e n * π.p ^ (s - e n) := by
        rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' (Finset.le_sup hn)]
      rw [hsplit, pow_mul, hqm n, ← map_pow]
    · refine ⟨0, zero_mem M.1, ?_⟩
      rw [Polynomial.notMem_support_iff.1 hn, map_zero,
        zero_pow (expChar_pow_pos π.carrier π.p s).ne']
  choose c hc hcq using key
  
  obtain ⟨r, y, hy⟩ := π.exists_pow_incl x
  set z : K := y ^ π.p ^ s with hz
  
  set Q : Polynomial K := ∑ n ∈ q.support, Polynomial.monomial n (c n ^ π.p ^ r) with hQ
  have hQcoeff : ∀ j, Q.coeff j ∈ M.1 := by
    intro j
    rw [hQ, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_monomial]
    rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' q.support j fun n ↦ c n ^ π.p ^ r]
    split_ifs with hj
    · exact pow_mem (ClosedIF.mem_val.2 (hc j)) _
    · exact zero_mem _
  have hcne : ∀ n ∈ q.support, c n ≠ 0 := by
    intro n hn h0
    refine Polynomial.mem_support_iff.1 hn ?_
    have := hcq n
    rw [h0, map_zero, pow_eq_zero_iff (expChar_pow_pos π.carrier π.p s).ne'] at this
    exact this
  have hQ0 : Q ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hd : q.natDegree ∈ q.support := q.natDegree_mem_support_of_nonzero hq0
    have : Q.coeff q.natDegree = c q.natDegree ^ π.p ^ r := by
      rw [hQ, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
      simp only [Polynomial.coeff_monomial]
      rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' q.support _ fun n ↦ c n ^ π.p ^ r, ite_eq_left hd]
    rw [h0, Polynomial.coeff_zero] at this
    exact pow_ne_zero _ (hcne _ hd) this.symm
  
  have hQz : Q.eval z = 0 := by
    refine π.incl_injective ?_
    have hev : π.incl (Q.eval z) =
        Polynomial.eval₂ (iterateFrobenius π.carrier π.p (s + r))
          (iterateFrobenius π.carrier π.p (s + r) x) q := by
      rw [Polynomial.eval₂_eq_sum, Polynomial.sum_def, hQ]
      rw [Polynomial.eval_finsetSum, map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n hn ↦ ?_
      rw [Polynomial.eval_monomial, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow]
      congr 1
      · 
        rw [← hcq n, iterateFrobenius_def, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add]
      · 
        rw [hz, map_pow, hy, iterateFrobenius_def,
          ← pow_mul x (π.p ^ r) (π.p ^ s), ← pow_add, Nat.add_comm r s]
    rw [hev, Polynomial.eval₂_at_apply, hqx, map_zero, map_zero]
  
  have hzM : z ∈ M.1 := M.2 z (isAlgebraic_of_coeff_mem hQ0 hQz hQcoeff)
  refine π.mem_perfIF_iff.2 ⟨r + s, z, ClosedIF.mem_val.1 hzM, ?_⟩
  rw [hz, map_pow, hy, ← pow_mul, ← pow_add]

name: AclGeom.Perfection.perfIF_injective
statement: theorem perfIF_injective : Function.Injective (π.perfIF k (K := K))
proof:
:= by
  intro M N h
  refine SetLike.ext fun x ↦ ?_
  rw [← π.incl_mem_perfIF_iff (M := M), ← π.incl_mem_perfIF_iff (M := N), h]

name: AclGeom.Perfection.perfIF_le_iff
statement:
theorem perfIF_le_iff {M N : ClosedIF k K} :
    π.perfIF k M ≤ π.perfIF k N ↔ M ≤ N
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h x hx
    exact (π.incl_mem_perfIF_iff).1 (h ((π.incl_mem_perfIF_iff).2 hx))
  · exact π.perfIF_mono

name: AclGeom.Perfection.incl_algebraMap_mem_basePerf
statement:
theorem incl_algebraMap_mem_basePerf (c : k) :
    π.incl (algebraMap k K c) ∈ π.basePerf k
proof:
:=
  π.mem_basePerf_iff.2 ⟨0, c, by simp⟩

name: AclGeom.Perfection.mem_comapIF_iff
statement:
theorem mem_comapIF_iff {N : ClosedIF (π.basePerf k) π.carrier} {x : K} :
    x ∈ π.comapIF k N ↔ π.incl x ∈ N
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: AclGeom.Perfection.isRAC_comapIF
statement:
theorem isRAC_comapIF (N : ClosedIF (π.basePerf k) π.carrier) :
    IsRAC (π.comapIF k N)
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨P, hP0, hPy, hPc⟩ := exists_poly_of_isAlgebraic hy
  rw [mem_comapIF_iff]
  refine ClosedIF.mem_val.1 <| N.2 (π.incl y) (isAlgebraic_of_coeff_mem
    (p := P.map π.incl)
    ((Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff π.incl_injective).2 hP0) ?_ fun n ↦ ?_)
  · rw [Polynomial.eval_map, Polynomial.eval₂_at_apply, hPy, map_zero]
  · rw [Polynomial.coeff_map]
    exact ClosedIF.mem_val.2 ((π.mem_comapIF_iff (N := N)).1 (hPc n))

name: AclGeom.Perfection.perfClosed_comapClosed
statement:
theorem perfClosed_comapClosed (N : ClosedIF (π.basePerf k) π.carrier) :
    π.perfClosed k (π.comapClosed k N) = N
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (SetLike.ext fun x ↦ ?_)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, m, hm, hx⟩
    
    have h1 : π.incl m ∈ N.1 := ClosedIF.mem_val.2 ((π.mem_comapIF_iff).1 hm)
    have h2 : x ^ π.p ^ n ∈ N.1 := hx ▸ h1
    exact N.2.mem_of_pow_mem (expChar_pow_pos π.carrier π.p n).ne' h2
  · intro hx
    
    obtain ⟨r, y, hy⟩ := π.exists_pow_incl x
    have h1 : π.incl y ∈ N.1 := by
      rw [hy]
      exact pow_mem hx _
    exact ⟨r, y, (π.mem_comapIF_iff).2 (ClosedIF.mem_val.1 h1), hy.symm⟩

name: AclGeom.Perfection.comapClosed_perfClosed
statement:
theorem comapClosed_perfClosed (M : ClosedIF k K) :
    π.comapClosed k (π.perfClosed k M) = M
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (SetLike.ext fun x ↦ ?_)
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ClosedIF.mem_val.2 (π.incl_mem_perfIF_iff.1 ((π.mem_comapIF_iff).1 h))
  · intro h
    exact (π.mem_comapIF_iff).2
      (ClosedIF.mem_val.1 (π.incl_mem_perfIF_iff.2 (ClosedIF.mem_val.1 h)))

name: AclGeom.Perfection.frobZPow_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem frobZPow_zero : π.frobZPow 0 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.Perfection.frobZPow_add
statement:
theorem frobZPow_add (m n : ℤ) :
    π.frobZPow (m + n) = π.frobZPow m * π.frobZPow n
proof:
:=
  zpow_add _ m n

name: AclGeom.Perfection.frobZPow_neg
statement: theorem frobZPow_neg (n : ℤ) : π.frobZPow (-n) = (π.frobZPow n)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  zpow_neg _ n

name: AclGeom.Perfection.frobZPow_mem_iff
statement:
theorem frobZPow_mem_iff (n : ℤ) {N : ClosedIF (π.basePerf k) π.carrier}
    (x : π.carrier) : π.frobZPow n x ∈ N.1 ↔ x ∈ N.1
proof:
:= by
  set F : RingAut π.carrier := (frobeniusEquiv π.carrier π.p : RingAut π.carrier)
    with hF
  have h1 : ∀ y : π.carrier, F y ∈ N.1 ↔ y ∈ N.1 := by
    intro y
    have hy : F y = y ^ π.p := by
      rw [hF]
      change frobeniusEquiv π.carrier π.p y = y ^ π.p
      rw [frobeniusEquiv_apply, frobenius_def]
    rw [hy]
    exact ⟨fun h ↦ N.2.mem_of_pow_mem (expChar_pos π.carrier π.p).ne' h,
      fun h ↦ pow_mem h _⟩
  have h2 : ∀ y : π.carrier, F⁻¹ y ∈ N.1 ↔ y ∈ N.1 := by
    intro y
    have hFy : F (F⁻¹ y) = y := RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply F y
    constructor
    · intro h
      have := (h1 (F⁻¹ y)).2 h
      rwa [hFy] at this
    · intro h
      refine (h1 (F⁻¹ y)).1 ?_
      rwa [hFy]
  induction n using Int.induction_on generalizing x with
  | zero => simp [frobZPow, frobeniusZPow]
  | succ i ih =>
    rw [frobZPow, frobeniusZPow, zpow_add_one]
    exact (ih (F x)).trans (h1 x)
  | pred i ih =>
    rw [frobZPow, frobeniusZPow, zpow_sub_one]
    exact (ih (F⁻¹ x)).trans (h2 x)

name: AclGeom.Perfection.frobZPow_image_closed
statement:
theorem frobZPow_image_closed (n : ℤ) (N : ClosedIF (π.basePerf k) π.carrier) :
    π.frobZPow n '' (N.1 : Set π.carrier) = (N.1 : Set π.carrier)
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact (π.frobZPow_mem_iff n z).2 hz
  · intro hy
    refine ⟨π.frobZPow (-n) y, (π.frobZPow_mem_iff (-n) y).2 hy, ?_⟩
    rw [frobZPow_neg]
    exact (π.frobZPow n).apply_symm_apply y

name: AclGeom.geomQuot_map_functor_map
statement:
theorem geomQuot_map_functor_map {A B : PerfExt.{u, v}} (Φ : A ⟶ B) :
    geomQuot.map ((CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor frobRel).map Φ) = geomLit.map Φ
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Quotient.lift_map_functor_map _ _ _ _

name: AclGeom.geomQuot_map_bijective
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro q₁ q₂ h
    obtain ⟨Φ₁, rfl⟩ := (CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor frobRel).map_surjective q₁
    obtain ⟨Φ₂, rfl⟩ := (CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor frobRel).map_surjective q₂
    rw [geomQuot_map_functor_map, geomQuot_map_functor_map] at h
    exact CategoryTheory.Quotient.sound _ ((geomLit_map_eq_iff htr Φ₁ Φ₂).1 h)
  · intro f
    obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ⟩ := geomLit_map_surjective (B := B.as) htr f
    exact ⟨(CategoryTheory.Quotient.functor frobRel).map Φ,
      (geomQuot_map_functor_map Φ).trans hΦ⟩

name: AclGeom.geomLit_map_bijective_of_p_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun Φ₁ Φ₂ h ↦ ?_, geomLit_map_surjective htr⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (geomLit_map_eq_iff htr Φ₁ Φ₂).1 h
  rw [hn, B.frobHom_eq_id hp, Category.comp_id]

name: AclGeom.PerfExt.frobHom_one_ne_id
statement:
theorem frobHom_one_ne_id (A : PerfExt.{u, v}) (hp : A.perf.p ≠ 1)
    (htr : 0 < Algebra.trdeg A.base A.ext) : A.frobHom 1 ≠ 𝟙 A
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hpos : 0 < Algebra.trdeg (A.perf.basePerf A.base) A.perf.carrier :=
    Cardinal.lift_lt.1 ((Cardinal.lift_lt.2 htr).trans_le
      (lift_trdeg_le_of_orderIso (A.perf.latticeIso A.base)))
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_notMem_racl_of_mk_lt_trdeg (k := A.perf.basePerf A.base)
    (∅ : Set A.perf.carrier) (by simpa using hpos)
  have h10 : (1 : ℤ) = 0 :=
    frobeniusZPow_injective (k := A.perf.basePerf A.base) A.perf.p hp hz
      (congrArg Hom.toRingEquiv h)
  exact one_ne_zero h10

name: AclGeom.geomLit_map_not_injective
statement:
theorem geomLit_map_not_injective (A : PerfExt.{u, v}) (hp : A.perf.p ≠ 1)
    (htr : 0 < Algebra.trdeg A.base A.ext) :
    ¬ Function.Injective (geomLit.map : (A ⟶ A) → (geomLit.obj A ⟶ geomLit.obj A))
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ A.frobHom_one_ne_id hp htr (h ((A.geomLit_map_frobHom 1).trans (geomLit.map_id A).symm))

name: AclGeom.PerfExt.comparison_incl
statement:
theorem comparison_incl (π : Perfection A.ext) (x : A.ext) :
    (A.comparison π).toRingEquiv (A.perf.incl x) = π.incl x
proof:
:=
  A.perf.liftEquiv_incl π _ x

name: AclGeom.PerfExt.eq_comparison
statement:
theorem eq_comparison {π : Perfection A.ext} (Φ : A ⟶ A.withPerf π)
    (hΦ : ∀ x, Φ.toRingEquiv (A.perf.incl x) = π.incl x) : Φ = A.comparison π
proof:
:=
  hom_ext (A.perf.liftEquiv_ext π (σ := RingEquiv.refl _) hΦ)

name: AclGeom.PerfExt.comparison_self
statement: theorem comparison_self : A.comparison A.perf = 𝟙 A
proof:
:=
  hom_ext A.perf.liftEquiv_refl

name: AclGeom.PerfExt.comparison_comp_comparison
statement:
theorem comparison_comp_comparison (π π' : Perfection A.ext) :
    A.comparison π ≫ (A.withPerf π).comparison π' = A.comparison π'
proof:
:=
  A.eq_comparison (π := π') (A.comparison π ≫ (A.withPerf π).comparison π') fun x ↦ by
    rw [comp_toRingEquiv, RingEquiv.trans_apply, comparison_incl]
    exact (A.withPerf π).comparison_incl π' x

name: AclGeom.PerfExt.comparison_comp_comparison_self
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem comparison_comp_comparison_self (π : Perfection A.ext) :
    A.comparison π ≫ (A.withPerf π).comparison A.perf = 𝟙 A
proof:
:= by
  rw [comparison_comp_comparison, comparison_self]

name: AclGeom.PerfExt.geomLit_map_comparison
statement:
theorem geomLit_map_comparison (π : Perfection A.ext) :
    geomLit.map (A.comparison π) = 𝟙 (geomLit.obj A)
proof:
:= by
  have h := A.perf.induces_liftEquiv π (CrossBase.compatible_refl (k := A.base))
  rw [CrossBase.closedIFMap_refl] at h
  have he := ((Perfection.induces_iff_eq_inducedIso (A.comparison π).compatible).1 h).symm
  exact Core.hom_ext <| PartOrd.ext fun M ↦ congrArg (· M) he

name: AclGeom.PerfExt.trdeg_eq_of_hom
statement:
theorem trdeg_eq_of_hom {A B : PerfExt.{u, v}} (Φ : A ⟶ B) :
    Algebra.trdeg A.base A.ext = Algebra.trdeg B.base B.ext
proof:
:=
  trdeg_eq_of_orderIso (orderIsoOfPartOrdIso (geomLit.map Φ).iso)

name: AclGeom.ofChoice_comparison_comp
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem ofChoice_comparison_comp (c c' : ∀ E : RACExt.{u, v}, Perfection E.ext)
    (E : RACExt.{u, v}) :
    (ofChoice c E).comparison (c' E) ≫ (ofChoice c' E).comparison (c E) = 𝟙 (ofChoice c E)
proof:
:=
  (ofChoice c E).comparison_comp_comparison_self (c' E)

name: AclGeom.choiceTransport_comp_geomLit
statement:
theorem choiceTransport_comp_geomLit :
    choiceTransport c₁ c₂ ⋙ inducedFunctor (ofChoice c₂) ⋙ geomLit =
      inducedFunctor (ofChoice c₁) ⋙ geomLit
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (fun _ ↦ rfl) fun {E E'} Φ ↦ by
    simp [choiceTransport, PerfExt.geomLit_map_comparison]
    rfl

name: AclGeom.PerfExt.hom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem hom_ext {f g : A ⟶ B} (h : f.toRingEquiv = g.toRingEquiv) : f = g
proof:
:=
  Hom.ext h

name: AclGeom.PerfExt.id_toRingEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem id_toRingEquiv (A : PerfExt.{u, v}) : (𝟙 A : A ⟶ A).toRingEquiv = RingEquiv.refl _
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AclGeom.PerfExt.comp_toRingEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_toRingEquiv (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) :
    (f ≫ g).toRingEquiv = f.toRingEquiv.trans g.toRingEquiv
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AclGeom.orderIsoOfPartOrdIso_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem orderIsoOfPartOrdIso_apply {X Y : PartOrd.{v}} (e : X ≅ Y) (x : X) :
    orderIsoOfPartOrdIso e x = e.hom x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AclGeom.geomLit_map_iso_hom_apply
statement:
theorem geomLit_map_iso_hom_apply (Φ : A ⟶ B) (M : ClosedIF A.base A.ext) :
    (geomLit.map Φ).iso.hom M = A.perf.inducedIso B.perf Φ.compatible M
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AclGeom.orderIsoOfPartOrdIso_geomLit_map
statement:
theorem orderIsoOfPartOrdIso_geomLit_map (Φ : A ⟶ B) :
    orderIsoOfPartOrdIso (geomLit.map Φ).iso = A.perf.inducedIso B.perf Φ.compatible
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AclGeom.PerfExt.frobHom_toRingEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem frobHom_toRingEquiv (A : PerfExt.{u, v}) (n : ℤ) :
    (A.frobHom n).toRingEquiv = A.perf.frobZPow n
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AclGeom.PerfExt.frobHom_zero
statement: theorem frobHom_zero (A : PerfExt.{u, v}) : A.frobHom 0 = 𝟙 A
proof:
:=
  hom_ext (RingEquiv.ext fun _ ↦ rfl)

name: AclGeom.PerfExt.frobHom_add
statement:
theorem frobHom_add (A : PerfExt.{u, v}) (m n : ℤ) :
    A.frobHom m ≫ A.frobHom n = A.frobHom (m + n)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [comp_toRingEquiv, frobHom_toRingEquiv, frobHom_toRingEquiv, frobHom_toRingEquiv,
    RingEquiv.trans_apply, add_comm, Perfection.frobZPow_add]
  rfl

name: AclGeom.PerfExt.geomLit_map_frobHom
statement:
theorem geomLit_map_frobHom (A : PerfExt.{u, v}) (n : ℤ) :
    geomLit.map (A.frobHom n) = 𝟙 (geomLit.obj A)
proof:
:=
  Core.hom_ext <| PartOrd.ext fun M ↦
    congrArg (· M) (A.perf.inducedIso_frobZPow A.isRAC n)

name: AclGeom.PerfExt.frobZPow_conj
statement:
private theorem frobZPow_conj (Φ : A ⟶ B) (n : ℤ) (x : A.perf.carrier) :
    Φ.toRingEquiv (A.perf.frobZPow n x) = B.perf.frobZPow n (Φ.toRingEquiv x)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : A.perf.p = B.perf.p := by
    have := expChar_of_injective_ringHom (f := Φ.toRingEquiv.toRingHom) Φ.toRingEquiv.injective
      A.perf.p
    exact ExpChar.eq this inferInstance
  let c : RingAut A.perf.carrier →* RingAut B.perf.carrier :=
    MonoidHom.mk' (fun ψ ↦ Φ.toRingEquiv.symm.trans (ψ.trans Φ.toRingEquiv)) fun a b ↦
      RingEquiv.ext fun y ↦ by simp only [RingAut.mul_apply, RingEquiv.trans_apply,
        RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have h1 :
      c (frobeniusEquiv A.perf.carrier A.perf.p) = frobeniusEquiv B.perf.carrier B.perf.p := by
    ext y
    change Φ.toRingEquiv ((Φ.toRingEquiv.symm y) ^ A.perf.p) = y ^ B.perf.p
    rw [map_pow, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hp]
  have h := congrArg (fun ψ : RingAut B.perf.carrier ↦ ψ (Φ.toRingEquiv x))
    ((map_zpow c (frobeniusEquiv A.perf.carrier A.perf.p) n).trans (by rw [h1]))
  simpa [c, Perfection.frobZPow, frobeniusZPow] using h

name: AclGeom.PerfExt.frobHom_naturality
statement: theorem frobHom_naturality (Φ : A ⟶ B) (n : ℤ) : A.frobHom n ≫ Φ = Φ ≫ B.frobHom n
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact frobZPow_conj Φ n x

name: AclGeom.PerfExt.frobHom_eq_id
statement: theorem frobHom_eq_id (A : PerfExt.{u, v}) (hp : A.perf.p = 1) (n : ℤ) : A.frobHom n = 𝟙 A
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [frobHom_toRingEquiv, Perfection.frobZPow,
    frobeniusZPow_eq_one_of_eq_one (K := A.perf.carrier) A.perf.p hp n]
  rfl

name: AclGeom.PerfExt.frobHom_comp_injective
statement:
theorem frobHom_comp_injective (htr : (5 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg A.base A.ext)
    (hp : B.perf.p ≠ 1) (Φ : A ⟶ B) : Function.Injective fun n : ℤ ↦ Φ ≫ B.frobHom n
proof:
:= by
  intro m n h
  exact Perfection.trans_frobZPow_injective (A.perf.inducedIso B.perf Φ.compatible) htr hp
    Φ.toRingEquiv (congrArg Hom.toRingEquiv h)

name: AclGeom.geomLit_map_surjective
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  obtain ⟨-, Φ, hΦ, h, -⟩ := reconstruction_target A.perf B.perf A.isRAC B.isRAC htr
    (orderIsoOfPartOrdIso f.iso)
  refine ⟨⟨Φ, hΦ⟩, Core.hom_ext <| PartOrd.ext fun M ↦ ?_⟩
  have heq := (Perfection.induces_iff_eq_inducedIso hΦ).1 h
  exact (congrArg (fun e : ClosedIF A.base A.ext ≃o ClosedIF B.base B.ext ↦ e M) heq).symm

name: AclGeom.geomLit_map_eq_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have he : A.perf.inducedIso B.perf Φ₁.compatible = A.perf.inducedIso B.perf Φ₂.compatible := by
      rw [← orderIsoOfPartOrdIso_geomLit_map, ← orderIsoOfPartOrdIso_geomLit_map, h]
    have h₂ := Perfection.induces_inducedIso Φ₂.compatible
    rw [← he] at h₂
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ :=
      ((Perfection.induces_inducedIso Φ₁.compatible).iff_exists_eq_trans_frobZPow htr).1 h₂
    exact ⟨n, hom_ext hn⟩
  · rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
    rw [Functor.map_comp, geomLit_map_frobHom, Category.comp_id]

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.coe_point
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_point (x : K) :
    ((point k x).1 : IntermediateField k K) = racl k {x}
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.mem_point
statement: @[simp] theorem mem_point {x y : K} : y ∈ point k x ↔ y ∈ racl k {x}
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.mem_point_self
statement: theorem mem_point_self (x : K) : x ∈ point k x
proof:
:=
  subset_racl k {x} rfl

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.coe_set_point
statement:
theorem coe_set_point (x : K) :
    ((point k x : ClosedIF k K) : Set K) = (racl k {x} : Set K)
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.point_le_iff
statement: theorem point_le_iff {x : K} {E : ClosedIF k K} : point k x ≤ E ↔ x ∈ E
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact (le_iff.1 h) (mem_point_self x)
  · intro h
    rw [le_iff, coe_point, ← isRAC_iff_racl_eq.1 E.2]
    exact racl_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 h)

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.point_eq_bot_iff
statement: theorem point_eq_bot_iff {x : K} : point k x = ⊥ ↔ x ∈ (⊥ : ClosedIF k K)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← h]
    exact mem_point_self x
  · intro h
    exact le_antisymm (point_le_iff.2 h) bot_le

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.mem_point_symm
statement:
theorem mem_point_symm {x y : K} (hy : y ∈ point k x)
    (hy' : y ∉ (⊥ : ClosedIF k K)) : x ∈ point k y
proof:
:= by
  
  have hyx : y ∈ racl k (insert x (∅ : Set K)) := by
    simpa using hy
  have hyb : y ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) := fun hmem ↦ hy' <| by
    change y ∈ (⊥ : ClosedIF k K).1
    rw [coe_bot]
    exact racl_mono (Set.empty_subset _) hmem
  have := racl_exchange hyx hyb
  simpa using this

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.isAtom_point
statement:
theorem isAtom_point {x : K} (hx : x ∉ (⊥ : ClosedIF k K)) :
    IsAtom (point k x)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact hx (point_eq_bot_iff.1 h)
  · intro b hb
    by_contra hb0
    
    
    obtain ⟨y, hyb, hy0⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt (bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.2 hb0)
    have hy_point : y ∈ point k x := (le_iff.1 hb.le) hyb
    have hx_mem : x ∈ point k y := mem_point_symm hy_point hy0
    have : point k x ≤ b := point_le_iff.2 <| (le_iff.1 (point_le_iff.2 hyb)) hx_mem
    exact absurd (lt_of_le_of_lt this hb) (lt_irrefl _)

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.IsAtom.exists_eq_point
statement:
theorem IsAtom.exists_eq_point {P : ClosedIF k K} (hP : IsAtom P) :
    ∃ x : K, x ∉ (⊥ : ClosedIF k K) ∧ P = point k x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hxP, hx0⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt (bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.2 hP.1)
  refine ⟨x, hx0, ?_⟩
  have h1 : point k x ≤ P := point_le_iff.2 hxP
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h1 with h | h
  · exact h.symm
  · exact absurd (hP.2 _ h) fun hbot ↦ hx0 (point_eq_bot_iff.1 hbot)

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.point_eq_point_iff
statement:
theorem point_eq_point_iff {x y : K} :
    point k x = point k y ↔ x ∈ point k y ∧ y ∈ point k x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h ▸ mem_point_self x, h.symm ▸ mem_point_self y⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, hy⟩
    exact le_antisymm (point_le_iff.2 hx) (point_le_iff.2 hy)

name: AclGeom.pointCl_image_of_equiv
statement:
theorem pointCl_image_of_equiv (e : Point k K ≃ Point l L)
    (hcl : ∀ (S : Set (Point k K)) (P : Point k K),
      e P ∈ pointCl (e '' S) ↔ P ∈ pointCl S)
    (S : Set (Point k K)) : pointCl (e '' S) = e '' pointCl S
proof:
:= by
  ext Q
  obtain ⟨P, rfl⟩ := e.surjective Q
  rw [hcl]
  simp only [Equiv.image_eq_preimage_symm, Set.mem_preimage, e.symm_apply_apply]

name: AclGeom.latticeIsoOfPointEquiv_toPointSet
statement:
theorem latticeIsoOfPointEquiv_toPointSet (e : Point k K ≃ Point l L)
    (hcl : ∀ (S : Set (Point k K)) (P : Point k K),
      e P ∈ pointCl (e '' S) ↔ P ∈ pointCl S)
    (E : ClosedIF k K) :
    ClosedIF.toPointSet (latticeIsoOfPointEquiv e hcl E) =
      e '' ClosedIF.toPointSet E
proof:
:= by
  have h := (ClosedIF.pointSetIso l L).apply_symm_apply
    (closedPointSetIsoOfPointEquiv e hcl (ClosedIF.pointSetIso k K E))
  exact congrArg Subtype.val h

name: AclGeom.ClosedIF.toPointSet_point
statement:
theorem ClosedIF.toPointSet_point (P : Point k K) :
    ClosedIF.toPointSet P.1 = {P}
proof:
:= by
  ext Q
  change Q.1 ≤ P.1 ↔ Q ∈ ({P} : Set (Point k K))
  rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · intro hQ
    exact Subtype.ext ((P.2.le_iff_eq Q.2.ne_bot).1 hQ)
  · rintro rfl
    exact le_rfl

name: AclGeom.latticeIsoOfPointEquiv_apply_point
statement:
theorem latticeIsoOfPointEquiv_apply_point (e : Point k K ≃ Point l L)
    (hcl : ∀ (S : Set (Point k K)) (P : Point k K),
      e P ∈ pointCl (e '' S) ↔ P ∈ pointCl S)
    (P : Point k K) :
    latticeIsoOfPointEquiv e hcl P.1 = (e P).1
proof:
:= by
  apply (ClosedIF.pointSetIso l L).injective
  apply Subtype.ext
  change ClosedIF.toPointSet (latticeIsoOfPointEquiv e hcl P.1) =
    ClosedIF.toPointSet (e P).1
  rw [latticeIsoOfPointEquiv_toPointSet, ClosedIF.toPointSet_point,
    Set.image_singleton, ClosedIF.toPointSet_point]

name: AclGeom.point_map_latticeIsoOfPointEquiv
statement:
theorem point_map_latticeIsoOfPointEquiv (e : Point k K ≃ Point l L)
    (hcl : ∀ (S : Set (Point k K)) (P : Point k K),
      e P ∈ pointCl (e '' S) ↔ P ∈ pointCl S) :
    Point.map (latticeIsoOfPointEquiv e hcl) = e
proof:
:= by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro P
  exact Subtype.ext (latticeIsoOfPointEquiv_apply_point e hcl P)

name: AclGeom.latticeIsoOfPointEquiv_unique
statement:
theorem latticeIsoOfPointEquiv_unique (e : Point k K ≃ Point l L)
    (hcl : ∀ (S : Set (Point k K)) (P : Point k K),
      e P ∈ pointCl (e '' S) ↔ P ∈ pointCl S)
    (g : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L) (hg : Point.map g = e) :
    g = latticeIsoOfPointEquiv e hcl
proof:
:= by
  apply OrderIso.ext
  funext E
  apply (ClosedIF.pointSetIso l L).injective
  apply Subtype.ext
  change ClosedIF.toPointSet (g E) =
    ClosedIF.toPointSet (latticeIsoOfPointEquiv e hcl E)
  rw [latticeIsoOfPointEquiv_toPointSet]
  ext Q
  obtain ⟨P, rfl⟩ := e.surjective Q
  rw [Equiv.image_eq_preimage_symm]
  change (e P).1 ≤ g E ↔ e.symm (e P) ∈ ClosedIF.toPointSet E
  rw [e.symm_apply_apply]
  change (e P).1 ≤ g E ↔ P.1 ≤ E
  have hP : (e P).1 = g P.1 :=
    (congrArg Subtype.val (congrArg
      (fun f : Point k K ≃ Point l L ↦ f P) hg)).symm
  rw [hP]
  exact g.le_iff_le

name: AclGeom.pointIndep_map_iff
statement:
theorem pointIndep_map_iff (e : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L)
    {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → Point k K) :
    PointIndep l L (Point.map e ∘ f) ↔ PointIndep k K f
proof:
:= by
  unfold PointIndep
  apply forall_congr'
  intro i
  have himage : (Point.map e ∘ f) '' {j | j ≠ i} =
      Point.map e '' (f '' {j | j ≠ i}) :=
    (Set.image_image (Point.map e) f _).symm
  rw [himage]
  exact not_congr (pointCl_map_iff e)

name: AclGeom.point_map_iSup
statement:
theorem point_map_iSup (e : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L)
    {n : ℕ} (f : Fin n → Point k K) :
    (⨆ i, (Point.map e (f i)).1) = e (⨆ i, (f i).1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Point.map_coe, e.map_iSup]

name: AclGeom.rankLE_map_iff
statement:
theorem rankLE_map_iff (e : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L)
    (n : ℕ) (E : ClosedIF k K) : RankLE n (e E) ↔ RankLE n E
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf⟩
    refine ⟨Point.map e.symm ∘ f, ?_⟩
    change E ≤ ⨆ i, (Point.map e.symm (f i)).1
    rw [point_map_iSup]
    simpa only [e.symm_apply_apply] using e.symm.monotone hf
  · rintro ⟨f, hf⟩
    refine ⟨Point.map e ∘ f, ?_⟩
    change e E ≤ ⨆ i, (Point.map e (f i)).1
    rw [point_map_iSup]
    exact e.monotone hf

name: AclGeom.rankEq_map_iff
statement:
theorem rankEq_map_iff (e : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L)
    (n : ℕ) (E : ClosedIF k K) : RankEq n (e E) ↔ RankEq n E
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, hE⟩
    refine ⟨Point.map e.symm ∘ f, (pointIndep_map_iff e.symm f).2 hf, ?_⟩
    change E = ⨆ i, (Point.map e.symm (f i)).1
    rw [point_map_iSup]
    simpa only [e.symm_apply_apply] using congrArg e.symm hE
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, hE⟩
    refine ⟨Point.map e ∘ f, (pointIndep_map_iff e f).2 hf, ?_⟩
    change e E = ⨆ i, (Point.map e (f i)).1
    rw [point_map_iSup]
    exact congrArg e hE

name: AclGeom.algebraicIndependent_pointMap_rep
statement:
theorem algebraicIndependent_pointMap_rep {ι : Type*} {v : ι → K}
    (hv : AlgebraicIndependent k v) (e : ClosedIF k K ≃o ClosedIF l L) :
    AlgebraicIndependent l (fun i ↦
      (Point.map e (Point.mk' k (v i)
        (fun hi ↦ hv.transcendental i (ClosedIF.mem_bot_iff.1 hi)))).rep)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : ι → Point k K := fun i ↦ Point.mk' k (v i)
    (fun hi ↦ hv.transcendental i (ClosedIF.mem_bot_iff.1 hi))
  change AlgebraicIndependent l (fun i ↦ (Point.map e (f i)).rep)
  rw [algebraicIndependent_iff_forall_notMem_racl]
  intro i hi
  have hp : Point.map e (f i) ∈ pointCl (Point.map e '' (f '' {i}ᶜ)) := by
    apply mem_pointCl_iff_rep_mem.2
    simpa only [Set.image_image, Function.comp_apply] using hi
  have hpi : f i ∈ pointCl (f '' {i}ᶜ) := (pointCl_map_iff e).1 hp
  have hvspan : v i ∈ sSup (Subtype.val '' (f '' {i}ᶜ)) :=
    ClosedIF.point_le_iff.1 (mem_pointCl_iff.1 hpi)
  have himage : Subtype.val '' (f '' {i}ᶜ) =
      (fun x ↦ ClosedIF.point k x) '' (v '' {i}ᶜ) := by
    exact (Set.image_image (Subtype.val : Point k K → ClosedIF k K) f {i}ᶜ).trans
      (Set.image_image (fun x ↦ ClosedIF.point k x) v {i}ᶜ).symm
  rw [himage] at hvspan
  change v i ∈ (sSup ((fun x ↦ ClosedIF.point k x) '' (v '' {i}ᶜ))).1 at hvspan
  rw [sSup_point_image] at hvspan
  exact (algebraicIndependent_iff_forall_notMem_racl.1 hv i) hvspan

name: AclGeom.lift_trdeg_le_of_orderIso
statement:
theorem lift_trdeg_le_of_orderIso (e : ClosedIF k₁ K₁ ≃o ClosedIF k₂ K₂) :
    Cardinal.lift.{v} (Algebra.trdeg k₁ K₁) ≤
      Cardinal.lift.{u} (Algebra.trdeg k₂ K₂)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := exists_isTranscendenceBasis k₁ K₁
  have hi := algebraicIndependent_pointMap_rep hS.1 e
  have hcard := hi.lift_cardinalMk_le_trdeg
  simpa only [hS.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg] using hcard

name: AclGeom.lift_trdeg_eq_of_orderIso
statement:
theorem lift_trdeg_eq_of_orderIso (e : ClosedIF k₁ K₁ ≃o ClosedIF k₂ K₂) :
    Cardinal.lift.{v} (Algebra.trdeg k₁ K₁) =
      Cardinal.lift.{u} (Algebra.trdeg k₂ K₂)
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (lift_trdeg_le_of_orderIso e) (lift_trdeg_le_of_orderIso e.symm)

name: AclGeom.trdeg_eq_of_orderIso
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Cardinal.lift_id] using lift_trdeg_eq_of_orderIso e

name: AclGeom.isTranscendenceBasis_iff_racl_range_eq_top
proof:
:= by
  rw [hv.isTranscendenceBasis_iff_isAlgebraic]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := h
    apply top_unique
    intro z _
    exact (mem_racl_iff_isAlgebraic_adjoin k).2
      (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic z)
  · intro h
    refine ⟨fun z ↦ (mem_racl_iff_isAlgebraic_adjoin k).1 ?_⟩
    exact h ▸ (show z ∈ (⊤ : IntermediateField k K) from mem_top)

name: AclGeom.RankEq.trdeg_eq
statement:
theorem RankEq.trdeg_eq {n : ℕ} {E : ClosedIF k K} (h : RankEq n E) :
    Algebra.trdeg k (↥E.1) = n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hspan⟩ := h
  have hrep : ∀ i, (f i).rep ∈ E := by
    intro i
    rw [hspan]
    exact (le_iSup (fun j ↦ (f j).1) i) (f i).mem_rep
  let v : Fin n → E.1 := fun i ↦ ⟨(f i).rep, hrep i⟩
  have hv : AlgebraicIndependent k v :=
    AlgebraicIndependent.of_comp E.1.val (algebraicIndependent_rep_of_pointIndep hf)
  have hclosure : racl k (Set.range v) = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    intro z _
    apply (algHom_mem_racl_image_iff E.1.val).1
    have himage : E.1.val '' Set.range v = Set.range fun i ↦ (f i).rep := by
      ext x
      simp [v]
    rw [himage]
    have hE : E.1 = racl k (Set.range fun i ↦ (f i).rep) := by
      rw [hspan, iSup_point_val]
    exact hE ▸ z.2
  have hb : IsTranscendenceBasis k v :=
    (isTranscendenceBasis_iff_racl_range_eq_top hv).2 hclosure
  simpa using hb.lift_cardinalMk_eq_trdeg.symm

name: AclGeom.rankEq_of_trdeg_eq
statement:
theorem rankEq_of_trdeg_eq {n : ℕ} {E : ClosedIF k K}
    (h : Algebra.trdeg k (↥E.1) = n) : RankEq n E
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := exists_isTranscendenceBasis k (↥E.1)
  let e : S ≃ Fin n := (Cardinal.mk_eq_nat_iff.1
    (hS.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg.trans h)).some
  let v : Fin n → E.1 := fun i ↦ (e.symm i).1
  have hb : IsTranscendenceBasis k v := hS.comp_equiv e.symm
  have hv : AlgebraicIndependent k (E.1.val ∘ v) :=
    hb.1.map' E.1.val.injective
  apply rankEq_of_coe_eq_racl hv
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    have hclosure : racl k (Set.range v) = ⊤ :=
      (isTranscendenceBasis_iff_racl_range_eq_top hb.1).1 hb
    have hxv : (⟨x, hx⟩ : E.1) ∈ racl k (Set.range v) :=
      hclosure ▸ mem_top
    have hxK := (algHom_mem_racl_image_iff E.1.val).2 hxv
    simpa only [← Set.range_comp, IntermediateField.coe_val] using hxK
  · have hsubset : Set.range (E.1.val ∘ v) ⊆ (E.1 : Set K) := by
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact (v i).2
    exact (racl_mono hsubset).trans (isRAC_iff_racl_eq.1 E.2).le

name: AclGeom.rankEq_iff_trdeg_eq
statement:
theorem rankEq_iff_trdeg_eq (n : ℕ) (E : ClosedIF k K) :
    RankEq n E ↔ Algebra.trdeg k (↥E.1) = n
proof:
:=
  ⟨RankEq.trdeg_eq, rankEq_of_trdeg_eq⟩

name: AclGeom.exists_fresh_sequence_of_aleph0_le_trdeg
statement:
theorem exists_fresh_sequence_of_aleph0_le_trdeg
    (htr : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ Algebra.trdeg k K) {S : Set K} (hS : S.Finite) :
    ∃ t : ℕ → K, ∀ n, t n ∉ racl k (S ∪ t '' Set.Iio n)
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.seq_of_forall_finite_exists (P := fun z T ↦ z ∉ racl k (S ∪ T)) fun T hT ↦ ?_
  have hfin := hS.union hT
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_notMem_racl_of_card_lt_trdeg (n := hfin.toFinset.card)
    (Cardinal.natCast_lt_aleph0.trans_le htr) hfin.toFinset le_rfl
  rw [Set.Finite.coe_toFinset] at hz
  exact ⟨z, hz⟩

name: AclGeom.aleph0_le_trdeg_algebraicClosure
statement:
theorem aleph0_le_trdeg_algebraicClosure :
    Cardinal.aleph0 ≤
      Algebra.trdeg k (AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ℕ K)))
proof:
:= by
  let Ω := AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ℕ K))
  let φ : MvPolynomial ℕ K →ₐ[K] Ω := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K (MvPolynomial ℕ K) Ω
  have hφ : Function.Injective φ := by
    change Function.Injective (algebraMap (MvPolynomial ℕ K) Ω)
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq (MvPolynomial ℕ K) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ℕ K)) Ω]
    exact (algebraMap (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ℕ K)) Ω).injective.comp
      (IsFractionRing.injective (MvPolynomial ℕ K) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ℕ K)))
  have hX := (MvPolynomial.algebraicIndependent_X ℕ K).map' hφ
  have hXk := AlgebraicIndependent.restrictScalars (algebraMap k K).injective hX
  simpa only [Cardinal.mk_nat, Cardinal.lift_aleph0, Cardinal.lift_id'] using
    hXk.lift_cardinalMk_le_trdeg

name: AclGeom.GeometryTerm.eval_map
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | point i => rfl
  | bot => exact e.map_bot.symm
  | top => exact e.map_top.symm
  | join f => exact point_map_iSup e (ρ ∘ f)
  | sup s t hs ht => simp only [eval, hs, ht, map_sup]
  | inf s t hs ht => simp only [eval, hs, ht, map_inf]

name: AclGeom.GeometryFormula.holds_map_iff
proof:
:= by
  induction φ with
  | equal s t => simp only [Holds, GeometryTerm.eval_map, e.injective.eq_iff]
  | le s t => simp only [Holds, GeometryTerm.eval_map, e.le_iff_le]
  | rankEq r t => simp only [Holds, GeometryTerm.eval_map, rankEq_map_iff]
  | rankLE r t => simp only [Holds, GeometryTerm.eval_map, rankLE_map_iff]
  | neg φ ih => exact not_congr (ih ρ)
  | conj φ ψ ihφ ihψ => exact and_congr (ihφ ρ) (ihψ ρ)
  | disj φ ψ ihφ ihψ => exact or_congr (ihφ ρ) (ihψ ρ)
  | impl φ ψ ihφ ihψ => exact imp_congr (ihφ ρ) (ihψ ρ)
  | existsPoint φ ih =>
    have hcons (P : Point k K) :
        Fin.cons (Point.map e P) (Point.map e ∘ ρ) = Point.map e ∘ Fin.cons P ρ := by
      funext i
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j ↦ ?_) i <;> rfl
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨Q, hQ⟩
      obtain ⟨P, rfl⟩ := (Point.map e).surjective Q
