    have h2 : 1 < P.val.valuation b := by
      rcases lt_or_ge 1 (P.val.valuation b) with h' | h'
      · exact h'
      · exact absurd (P.val.mem_of_valuation_le_one b h') hbP
    rw [map_div₀, div_lt_one₀ (lt_trans zero_lt_one h2)]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt h1 h2
  · have h1 : Q.val.valuation b ≤ 1 := (Q.val.valuation_le_one_iff b).2 hbQ
    have h2 : 1 < Q.val.valuation a := by
      rcases lt_or_ge 1 (Q.val.valuation a) with h' | h'
      · exact h'
      · exact absurd (Q.val.mem_of_valuation_le_one a h') haQ
    rw [map_div₀, lt_div_iff₀ (zero_lt_iff.2 ?_), one_mul]
    · exact lt_of_le_of_lt h1 h2
    · rw [Valuation.ne_zero_iff]
      exact hb0

name: AclGeom.Place.exists_pow_valuation_lt
statement:
theorem exists_pow_valuation_lt (P : Place k F) {y w : F} (hy0 : y ≠ 0)
    (hylt : P.val.valuation y < 1) (hw0 : w ≠ 0) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, P.val.valuation y ^ n < P.val.valuation w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases lt_or_ge (P.val.valuation w) 1 with hwlt | hwge
  · 
    obtain ⟨z, hz0, hz⟩ := exists_valuation_lt_one_of_ne_top P.ne_top
    have htr := transcendental_of_valuation_lt_one P.algebraMap_mem
      (fun v hv ↦ exists_algebraMap_eq_of_isAlgebraic hv) hz0 hz
    haveI := finiteDimensional_adjoin_of_transcendental (k := k) htr
    obtain ⟨t, ht0, htlt, htmax⟩ :=
      exists_valuation_uniformizer P.algebraMap_mem hz0 hz
    have hyv : P.val.valuation y ≠ 0 := (Valuation.ne_zero_iff _).2 hy0
    have hwv : P.val.valuation w ≠ 0 := (Valuation.ne_zero_iff _).2 hw0
    obtain ⟨j, hj0, hj⟩ := valuation_eq_pow_uniformizer P.algebraMap_mem
      hz0 hz ht0 htlt htmax hyv hylt
    obtain ⟨m, hm0, hm⟩ := valuation_eq_pow_uniformizer P.algebraMap_mem
      hz0 hz ht0 htlt htmax hwv hwlt
    refine ⟨m + 1, ?_⟩
    rw [hj, hm, ← pow_mul]
    have hlt : m < j * (m + 1) := by
      have := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hj0.ne'
      calc m < m + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_self m
        _ ≤ j * (m + 1) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ hj0
    exact pow_lt_pow_right_of_lt_one₀ (zero_lt_iff.2 ht0) htlt hlt
  · 
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    rw [pow_one]
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hylt hwge

name: AclGeom.valuation_indicator_of_lt_one
statement:
theorem valuation_indicator_of_lt_one {y : F} (hy : O.valuation y < 1)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    O.valuation (y ^ n / (1 + y ^ n)) = O.valuation y ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : O.valuation (1 + y ^ n) = 1 := by
    have h3 : O.valuation (y ^ n) < 1 := by
      rw [Valuation.map_pow]
      exact pow_lt_one₀ zero_le hy hn
    have h4 := Valuation.map_add_eq_of_lt_left O.valuation
      (x := (1 : F)) (y := y ^ n) (by rwa [Valuation.map_one])
    rwa [Valuation.map_one] at h4
  rw [map_div₀, h2, div_one, Valuation.map_pow]

name: AclGeom.valuation_indicator_of_gt_one
statement:
theorem valuation_indicator_of_gt_one {y : F} (hy : 1 < O.valuation y)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    O.valuation (y ^ n / (1 + y ^ n)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : O.valuation (1 + y ^ n) = O.valuation (y ^ n) := by
    have h3 : O.valuation (1 : F) < O.valuation (y ^ n) := by
      rw [Valuation.map_one, Valuation.map_pow]
      exact one_lt_pow₀ hy hn
    exact Valuation.map_add_eq_of_lt_right O.valuation h3
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, Valuation.map_zero] at hy
    simp at hy
  have h4 : O.valuation (y ^ n) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Valuation.ne_zero_iff]
    exact pow_ne_zero n hy0
  rw [map_div₀, h2, div_self h4]

name: AclGeom.Place.exists_one_lt_forall_lt_one
statement:
theorem Place.exists_one_lt_forall_lt_one {r : ℕ} (P₀ : Place k F)
    (Ps : Fin r → Place k F) (hne : ∀ j, P₀ ≠ Ps j) :
    ∃ z : F, 1 < P₀.val.valuation z ∧
      ∀ j, (Ps j).val.valuation z < 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction r with
  | zero =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : F, x ∉ P₀.val := by
      by_contra hc
      push Not at hc
      exact P₀.ne_top (by ext y; simpa using hc y)
    refine ⟨x, ?_, fun j ↦ j.elim0⟩
    exact lt_of_not_ge fun h ↦ hx (P₀.val.mem_of_valuation_le_one x h)
  | succ r ih =>
    obtain ⟨y, hy₀, hyj⟩ := ih (fun j ↦ Ps j.castSucc)
      (fun j ↦ hne j.castSucc)
    obtain ⟨w, hwlast, hw₀⟩ := exists_lt_one_gt_one (hne (Fin.last r)).symm
    have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      rw [h0, Valuation.map_zero] at hy₀
      simp at hy₀
    have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      rw [h0, Valuation.map_zero] at hw₀
      simp at hw₀
    
    have harch : ∀ j : Fin r, ∃ n : ℕ,
        (Ps j.castSucc).val.valuation y ^ n <
          (Ps j.castSucc).val.valuation w⁻¹ := fun j ↦
      (Ps j.castSucc).exists_pow_valuation_lt hy0 (hyj j)
        (inv_ne_zero hw0)
    choose ns hns using harch
    set n : ℕ := (Finset.univ.sup ns) + 1 with hn
    have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := Nat.succ_ne_zero _
    have hyn : ∀ j : Fin r, (Ps j.castSucc).val.valuation y ^ n *
        (Ps j.castSucc).val.valuation w < 1 := by
      intro j
      have h1 : (Ps j.castSucc).val.valuation y ^ n ≤
          (Ps j.castSucc).val.valuation y ^ ns j :=
        pow_le_pow_right_of_le_one' (hyj j).le
          (le_trans (Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ j)) (Nat.le_succ _))
      have h2 : (Ps j.castSucc).val.valuation y ^ n <
          (Ps j.castSucc).val.valuation w⁻¹ :=
        lt_of_le_of_lt h1 (hns j)
      have hwv : (0 : _) < (Ps j.castSucc).val.valuation w :=
        zero_lt_iff.2 ((Valuation.ne_zero_iff _).2 hw0)
      have h3 := (OrderIso.mulRight₀ _ hwv).strictMono h2
      simp only [OrderIso.mulRight₀_apply] at h3
      rwa [map_inv₀, inv_mul_cancel₀ hwv.ne'] at h3
    rcases lt_trichotomy ((Ps (Fin.last r)).val.valuation y) 1 with
      hcase | hcase | hcase
    · 
      refine ⟨y, hy₀, fun j ↦ ?_⟩
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i ↦ ?_) j
      · exact hcase
      · exact hyj i
    · 
      refine ⟨y ^ n * w, ?_, fun j ↦ ?_⟩
      · rw [Valuation.map_mul, Valuation.map_pow]
        exact one_lt_mul (one_lt_pow₀ hy₀ hn0).le hw₀
      · refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i ↦ ?_) j
        · rw [Valuation.map_mul, Valuation.map_pow, hcase, one_pow,
            one_mul]
          exact hwlast
        · rw [Valuation.map_mul, Valuation.map_pow]
          exact hyn i
    · 
      refine ⟨y ^ n / (1 + y ^ n) * w, ?_, fun j ↦ ?_⟩
      · rw [Valuation.map_mul, valuation_indicator_of_gt_one hy₀ hn0,
          one_mul]
        exact hw₀
      · refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i ↦ ?_) j
        · rw [Valuation.map_mul,
            valuation_indicator_of_gt_one hcase hn0, one_mul]
          exact hwlast
        · rw [Valuation.map_mul,
            valuation_indicator_of_lt_one (hyj i) hn0]
          exact hyn i

name: AclGeom.coefficientVariationLinear_injective_of_generating_coefficients
statement:
theorem coefficientVariationLinear_injective_of_generating_coefficients
    [IsDomain (C ⊗[k] F)]
    (g : FractionRing (C ⊗[k] F) ≃ₐ[C] FractionRing (C ⊗[k] F))
    {ι : Type v} (u : ι → F) {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → F) (hv : LinearIndependent k v)
    (c : Bool → ι → Fin n → C)
    (hgen : IntermediateField.adjoin k
      (Set.range fun p : Bool × ι × Fin n ↦ c p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) = ⊤)
    (hc : ∀ (e : Bool) (i : ι),
      (if e then g else g.symm)
          (algebraMap (C ⊗[k] F) _ (1 ⊗ₜ[k] u i)) =
        ∑ j, algebraMap (C ⊗[k] F) _ (c e i j ⊗ₜ[k] v j)) :
    Function.Injective (coefficientVariationLinear (k := k) g)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let q : C ⊗[k] F →ₐ[C] FractionRing (C ⊗[k] F) :=
    IsScalarTower.toAlgHom C (C ⊗[k] F) (FractionRing (C ⊗[k] F))
  have hq : Function.Injective q :=
    IsFractionRing.injective (C ⊗[k] F) (FractionRing (C ⊗[k] F))
  have hLI : LinearIndependent C (fun j ↦ q (1 ⊗ₜ[k] v j)) :=
    (Module.Flat.linearIndependent_one_tmul (S := C) hv).map' q.toLinearMap
      (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr hq)
  have hsplit (a : C) (f : F) : q (a ⊗ₜ[k] f) =
      algebraMap C (FractionRing (C ⊗[k] F)) a *
        algebraMap F (FractionRing (C ⊗[k] F)) f := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply C (C ⊗[k] F) (FractionRing (C ⊗[k] F)),
      IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F (C ⊗[k] F) (FractionRing (C ⊗[k] F))]
    change q (a ⊗ₜ[k] f) = q (a ⊗ₜ[k] 1) * q (1 ⊗ₜ[k] f)
    rw [← map_mul, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul]
  have hsmul (a : C) (f : F) : q (a ⊗ₜ[k] f) = a • q (1 ⊗ₜ[k] f) := by
    rw [← map_smul]
    congr 1
    change a ⊗ₜ[k] f = (a * 1) ⊗ₜ[k] f
    rw [mul_one]
  apply coefficientVariationLinear_injective
  intro D hD
  have hcomm := (coefficientVariation_eq_zero_iff g D).mp hD
  have hact (e : Bool) (x : FractionRing (C ⊗[k] F)) :
      coefficientConnection D ((if e then g else g.symm) x) =
        (if e then g else g.symm) (coefficientConnection D x) := by
    cases e with
    | true => exact hcomm x
    | false =>
      simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
      apply g.injective
      rw [← hcomm, g.apply_symm_apply, g.apply_symm_apply]
  have hhorizontal (f : F) : coefficientConnection D (q (1 ⊗ₜ[k] f)) = 0 := by
    change coefficientConnection D (algebraMap F (FractionRing (C ⊗[k] F)) f) = 0
    exact coefficientConnection_function D f
  have htmul (a : C) (f : F) :
      coefficientConnection D (q (a ⊗ₜ[k] f)) = q (D a ⊗ₜ[k] f) := by
    rw [hsplit, Derivation.leibniz, coefficientConnection_coeff,
      coefficientConnection_function, smul_zero, zero_add, smul_eq_mul, hsplit]
    exact mul_comm _ _
  have hcoeff (e : Bool) (i : ι) (j : Fin n) : D (c e i j) = 0 := by
    have hz : coefficientConnection D
        ((if e then g else g.symm) (q (1 ⊗ₜ[k] u i))) = 0 := by
      rw [hact, hhorizontal, map_zero]
    have h := congrArg (coefficientConnection D) (hc e i)
    change coefficientConnection D ((if e then g else g.symm) (q (1 ⊗ₜ[k] u i))) =
      coefficientConnection D (∑ l, q (c e i l ⊗ₜ[k] v l)) at h
    rw [hz] at h
    have hraw : ∑ l, q (D (c e i l) ⊗ₜ[k] v l) = 0 := by
      simpa only [map_sum, htmul] using h.symm
    have hsum : ∑ l, D (c e i l) • q (1 ⊗ₜ[k] v l) = 0 := by
      calc
        _ = ∑ l, q (D (c e i l) ⊗ₜ[k] v l) :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun l _ ↦ (hsmul (D (c e i l)) (v l)).symm)
        _ = 0 := hraw
    exact Fintype.linearIndependent_iff.mp hLI (fun l ↦ D (c e i l)) hsum j
  ext x
  change D x = 0
  have hx : x ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin k
      (Set.range fun p : Bool × ι × Fin n ↦ c p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) := by
    rw [hgen]
    trivial
  refine IntermediateField.adjoin_induction k (p := fun x _ ↦ D x = 0) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hx
  · rintro y ⟨⟨e, i, j⟩, rfl⟩
    exact hcoeff e i j
  · intro a
    exact D.map_algebraMap a
  · intro a b _ _ ha hb
    simp only [map_add, ha, hb, add_zero]
  · intro a _ ha
    simp only [Derivation.leibniz_inv, ha, smul_zero]
  · intro a b _ _ ha hb
    simp only [Derivation.leibniz, ha, hb, smul_zero, add_zero]

name: AclGeom.TensorCoefficientDescent.exists_tensorAut_of_generator_images
statement:
theorem exists_tensorAut_of_generator_images (C0 : IntermediateField k C)
    (σ : C ⊗[k] R ≃ₐ[C] C ⊗[k] R) (s : Finset R)
    (hs : Algebra.adjoin k (s : Set R) = ⊤) :
    let j : C0 ⊗[k] R →ₐ[C0] C ⊗[k] R
proof:
:=
      Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId C0 C) (AlgHom.id k R)
    (∀ r ∈ s, σ (1 ⊗ₜ[k] r) ∈ j.range) →
    (∀ r ∈ s, σ.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[k] r) ∈ j.range) →
      ∃ τ : C0 ⊗[k] R ≃ₐ[C0] C0 ⊗[k] R, ∀ x, j (τ x) = σ (j x) := by
  let j : C0 ⊗[k] R →ₐ[C0] C ⊗[k] R :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId C0 C) (AlgHom.id k R)
  dsimp only
  intro hσ hσinv
  let S : Subalgebra C0 (C ⊗[k] R) := j.range
  have hj : Function.Injective j :=
    Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap (M := R) C0.val.toLinearMap
      C0.val.injective
  have stable (τ : C ⊗[k] R ≃ₐ[C0] C ⊗[k] R)
      (hτ : ∀ r ∈ s, τ (1 ⊗ₜ[k] r) ∈ S) :
      ∀ x : C0 ⊗[k] R, τ (j x) ∈ S := by
    let f : R →ₐ[k] C ⊗[k] R :=
      (τ.restrictScalars k).toAlgHom.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
    let T : Subalgebra k R := (S.restrictScalars k).comap f
    have hT : Algebra.adjoin k (s : Set R) ≤ T := by
      apply Algebra.adjoin_le
      intro r hr
      exact hτ r hr
    have hright (r : R) : τ (1 ⊗ₜ[k] r) ∈ S := by
      change r ∈ T
      apply hT
      rw [hs]
      trivial
    intro x
    induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | add x y hx hy =>
      simpa only [map_add] using S.add_mem hx hy
    | tmul c r =>
      change τ (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId C0 C) (AlgHom.id k R)
        (c ⊗ₜ[k] r)) ∈ S
      rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul]
      change τ ((algebraMap C0 C c) ⊗ₜ[k] r) ∈ S
      have hfactor : (algebraMap C0 C c) ⊗ₜ[k] r =
          c • (1 ⊗ₜ[k] r : C ⊗[k] R) := by
        change (algebraMap C0 C c) ⊗ₜ[k] r = (c • (1 : C)) ⊗ₜ[k] r
        simp only [Algebra.smul_def, mul_one]
      rw [hfactor, map_smul]
      exact S.smul_mem (hright r) c
  let a := σ.restrictScalars C0
  have ha := stable a hσ
  have hb := stable a.symm hσinv
  have hS : S.map a.toAlgHom = S := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · rintro x ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hy
      exact ha z
    · rintro x ⟨z, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨a.symm (j z), hb z, a.apply_symm_apply (j z)⟩
  let eD := AlgEquiv.ofInjective j hj
  let eS := (AlgEquiv.subalgebraMap a S).trans (Subalgebra.equivOfEq _ _ hS)
  refine ⟨eD.trans (eS.trans eD.symm), fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  have hback (y : S) : j (eD.symm y) = (y : C ⊗[k] R) := by
    exact congrArg (fun z : S ↦ (z : C ⊗[k] R)) (eD.apply_symm_apply y)
  change j (eD.symm (eS (eD x))) = σ (j x)
  rw [hback]
  rfl

name: AclGeom.TensorCoefficientDescent.exists_effective_tensorAut
statement:
theorem exists_effective_tensorAut
    (σ : C ⊗[k] R ≃ₐ[C] C ⊗[k] R) (s : Finset R)
    (hs : Algebra.adjoin k (s : Set R) = ⊤)
    {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → R) (c : Bool → s → Fin n → C)
    (hc : ∀ (e : Bool) (i : s),
      (if e then σ else σ.symm) (1 ⊗ₜ[k] (i : R)) = ∑ j, c e i j ⊗ₜ[k] v j) :
    ∃ (C0 : IntermediateField k C) (c0 : Bool → s → Fin n → C0),
      C0 = IntermediateField.adjoin k
        (Set.range fun p : Bool × s × Fin n ↦ c p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) ∧
      Algebra.EssFiniteType k C0 ∧
      IntermediateField.adjoin k
        (Set.range fun p : Bool × s × Fin n ↦ c0 p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) = ⊤ ∧
      (∀ e i j, (c0 e i j : C) = c e i j) ∧
      ∃ τ : C0 ⊗[k] R ≃ₐ[C0] C0 ⊗[k] R,
        (∀ x, Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId C0 C) (AlgHom.id k R) (τ x) =
          σ (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId C0 C) (AlgHom.id k R) x)) ∧
        ∀ (e : Bool) (i : s),
          (if e then τ else τ.symm) (1 ⊗ₜ[k] (i : R)) = ∑ j, c0 e i j ⊗ₜ[k] v j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let d : Bool × s × Fin n → C := fun p ↦ c p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2
  let C0 := IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range d)
  let c0 : Bool → s → Fin n → C0 := fun e i j ↦
    ⟨c e i j, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨(e, i, j), rfl⟩⟩
  have hfg : Algebra.EssFiniteType k C0 := by
    apply IntermediateField.essFiniteType_iff.mpr
    simpa only [Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_univ, Set.image_univ] using
      (IntermediateField.fg_adjoin_finset (F := k) (Finset.univ.image d))
  have hgen : IntermediateField.adjoin k
      (Set.range fun p : Bool × s × Fin n ↦ c0 p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) = ⊤ := by
    apply IntermediateField.lift_injective C0
    rw [IntermediateField.lift_adjoin, IntermediateField.lift_top]
    rw [← Set.range_comp]
    rfl
  let j : C0 ⊗[k] R →ₐ[C0] C ⊗[k] R :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId C0 C) (AlgHom.id k R)
  have hj : Function.Injective j :=
    Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap (M := R) C0.val.toLinearMap
      C0.val.injective
  have hsum (e : Bool) (i : s) :
      j (∑ l, c0 e i l ⊗ₜ[k] v l) = ∑ l, c e i l ⊗ₜ[k] v l := by
    rw [map_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro l _
    exact Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul (Algebra.ofId C0 C) (AlgHom.id k R)
      (c0 e i l) (v l)
  have himg (e : Bool) : ∀ r ∈ s,
      (if e then σ else σ.symm) (1 ⊗ₜ[k] r) ∈ j.range := by
    intro r hr
    refine ⟨∑ l, c0 e ⟨r, hr⟩ l ⊗ₜ[k] v l, ?_⟩
    exact (hsum e ⟨r, hr⟩).trans (hc e ⟨r, hr⟩).symm
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := exists_tensorAut_of_generator_images C0 σ s hs
    (himg true)
    (himg false)
  refine ⟨C0, c0, rfl, hfg, hgen, fun _ _ _ ↦ rfl, τ, hτ, ?_⟩
  have hτinv (x : C0 ⊗[k] R) : j (τ.symm x) = σ.symm (j x) := by
    apply σ.injective
    rw [σ.apply_symm_apply, ← hτ, τ.apply_symm_apply]
  intro e i
  apply hj
  have htmul : j (1 ⊗ₜ[k] (i : R)) = 1 ⊗ₜ[k] (i : R) := by
    exact (Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul (Algebra.ofId C0 C) (AlgHom.id k R)
      (1 : C0) (i : R)).trans (by rw [map_one]; rfl)
  cases e with
  | false =>
    change j (τ.symm (1 ⊗ₜ[k] (i : R))) = _
    rw [hτinv, htmul, hsum]
    exact hc false i
  | true =>
    change j (τ (1 ⊗ₜ[k] (i : R))) = _
    rw [hτ, htmul, hsum]
    exact hc true i

name: AclGeom.adeleMulMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adeleMulMap_apply (f : F) (α : (P : Place k F) → F)
    (P : Place k F) : adeleMulMap k f α P = f * α P
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.adeleMulMap_mem_adeleSpace
statement:
theorem adeleMulMap_mem_adeleSpace {f : F} (hf : f ≠ 0)
    {D : Divisor k F} {α : (P : Place k F) → F}
    (hα : α ∈ adeleSpace (D + divisorOf k f)) :
    adeleMulMap k f α ∈ adeleSpace D
proof:
:= by
  intro P
  rcases eq_or_ne (α P) 0 with h0 | h0
  · exact Or.inl (by rw [adeleMulMap_apply, h0, mul_zero])
  have h1 := (hα P).resolve_left h0
  rw [Finsupp.add_apply, divisorOf_apply hf] at h1
  refine Or.inr ?_
  rw [adeleMulMap_apply, P.ord_mul hf h0]
  omega

name: AclGeom.adeleMulMap_mem_adeleSubmodule
statement:
theorem adeleMulMap_mem_adeleSubmodule (f : F)
    {α : (P : Place k F) → F} (hα : α ∈ adeleSubmodule k F) :
    adeleMulMap k f α ∈ adeleSubmodule k F
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne f 0 with rfl | hf0
  · refine Set.Finite.subset Set.finite_empty fun P hP ↦ ?_
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, adeleMulMap_apply, zero_mul] at hP
    exact absurd rfl hP.1
  refine Set.Finite.subset
    (hα.union (finite_setOf_one_lt_valuation hf0)) fun P hP ↦ ?_
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, adeleMulMap_apply] at hP
  obtain ⟨hne, hlt⟩ := hP
  have hα0 : α P ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hne (by rw [h, mul_zero])
  rw [P.ord_mul hf0 hα0] at hlt
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hcon
  have h3 := h1 hα0
  have h4 : 0 ≤ P.ord f := (P.ord_nonneg_iff hf0).2 h2
  omega

name: AclGeom.adeleMulMap_diagonal
statement:
theorem adeleMulMap_diagonal (f g : F) :
    adeleMulMap k f (adeleDiagonal k F g) = adeleDiagonal k F (f * g)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AclGeom.adeleSMul_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adeleSMul_coe (f : F) (α : ↥(adeleSubmodule k F)) :
    (adeleSMul f α : (P : Place k F) → F) = adeleMulMap k f ↑α
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.adeleSMul_add
statement:
theorem adeleSMul_add (f g : F) :
    adeleSMul (k := k) (F := F) (f + g) = adeleSMul f + adeleSMul g
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun α ↦ Subtype.ext (funext fun P ↦ ?_)
  change (f + g) * ((α : (Q : Place k F) → F) P) =
    f * ((α : (Q : Place k F) → F) P) +
      g * ((α : (Q : Place k F) → F) P)
  ring

name: AclGeom.adeleSMul_sub
statement:
theorem adeleSMul_sub (f g : F) :
    adeleSMul (k := k) (F := F) (f - g) = adeleSMul f - adeleSMul g
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun α ↦ Subtype.ext (funext fun P ↦ ?_)
  change (f - g) * ((α : (Q : Place k F) → F) P) =
    f * ((α : (Q : Place k F) → F) P) -
      g * ((α : (Q : Place k F) → F) P)
  ring

name: AclGeom.adeleSMul_smul
statement:
theorem adeleSMul_smul (c : k) (f : F) :
    adeleSMul (k := k) (F := F) (c • f) = c • adeleSMul f
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun α ↦ Subtype.ext (funext fun P ↦ ?_)
  change (c • f) * ((α : (Q : Place k F) → F) P) =
    c • (f * ((α : (Q : Place k F) → F) P))
  rw [Algebra.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def]
  ring

name: AclGeom.mem_weilDifferentialsAt_iff
statement:
theorem mem_weilDifferentialsAt_iff {D : Divisor k F}
    {ω : Module.Dual k ↥(adeleSubmodule k F)} :
    ω ∈ weilDifferentialsAt D ↔
      ∀ α ∈ boundedSubmodule D, ω α = 0
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_dualAnnihilator ω

name: AclGeom.weilDifferentialsAt_antitone
statement:
theorem weilDifferentialsAt_antitone {D E : Divisor k F} (h : D ≤ E) :
    weilDifferentialsAt (E : Divisor k F) ≤ weilDifferentialsAt D
proof:
:= by
  intro ω hω
  rw [mem_weilDifferentialsAt_iff] at hω ⊢
  intro α hα
  exact hω α (boundedSubmodule_mono h hα)

name: AclGeom.finrank_weilDifferentialsAt
statement:
theorem finrank_weilDifferentialsAt (D : Divisor k F) :
    (Module.finrank k (weilDifferentialsAt D) : ℤ) = specialtyIndex D
proof:
:= by
  rw [weilDifferentialsAt, specialtyIndex,
    ← LinearEquiv.finrank_eq
      (Submodule.dualQuotEquivDualAnnihilator (boundedSubmodule D)),
    Subspace.dual_finrank_eq]

name: AclGeom.exists_ne_zero_mem_weilDifferentialsAt
statement:
theorem exists_ne_zero_mem_weilDifferentialsAt :
    ∃ (D : Divisor k F) (ω : Module.Dual k ↥(adeleSubmodule k F)),
      ω ∈ weilDifferentialsAt D ∧ ω ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (Place k F))
  set D : Divisor k F := Finsupp.single P (-2) with hD
  have hdeg : D.deg = -2 := by
    rw [hD, Divisor.deg, Finsupp.sum_single_index rfl]
  have hl : Module.finrank k (RiemannSpace D) = 0 := by
    rw [riemannSpace_eq_bot_of_deg_neg (by omega), finrank_bot]
  have hi : 0 < specialtyIndex D := by
    have h := finrank_riemannSpace_eq_add_specialtyIndex D
    have hg := genus_nonneg (k := k) (F := F)
    rw [hl] at h
    omega
  have hpos : 0 < Module.finrank k
      (weilDifferentialsAt (k := k) (F := F) D) := by
    have h := finrank_weilDifferentialsAt (k := k) (F := F) D
    omega
  obtain ⟨ω, hω, hω0⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot
    (p := weilDifferentialsAt (k := k) (F := F) D)
    (fun hbot ↦ by rw [hbot, finrank_bot] at hpos; omega)
  exact ⟨D, ω, hω, hω0⟩

name: AclGeom.comp_adeleSMul_mem_weilDifferentialsAt
statement:
theorem comp_adeleSMul_mem_weilDifferentialsAt {f : F} (hf : f ≠ 0)
    {D : Divisor k F} {ω : Module.Dual k ↥(adeleSubmodule k F)}
    (hω : ω ∈ weilDifferentialsAt D) :
    ω ∘ₗ adeleSMul f ∈ weilDifferentialsAt (D + divisorOf k f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_weilDifferentialsAt_iff] at hω ⊢
  intro α hα
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  refine hω _ ?_
  rw [mem_boundedSubmodule_iff] at hα ⊢
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, ⟨g, rfl⟩, hxy⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hα
  have hcoe : (adeleSMul f α : (P : Place k F) → F) =
      adeleMulMap k f x + adeleDiagonal k F (f * g) := by
    rw [adeleSMul_coe, ← hxy, map_add, adeleMulMap_diagonal]
  rw [hcoe]
  exact Submodule.add_mem _
    (Submodule.mem_sup_left (adeleMulMap_mem_adeleSpace hf hx))
    (Submodule.mem_sup_right ⟨f * g, rfl⟩)

name: AclGeom.comp_adeleSMul_ne_zero
statement:
theorem comp_adeleSMul_ne_zero {f : F} (hf : f ≠ 0)
    {ω : Module.Dual k ↥(adeleSubmodule k F)} (hω : ω ≠ 0) :
    ω ∘ₗ adeleSMul f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  refine hω ?_
  ext α
  have h1 : adeleSMul f (adeleSMul f⁻¹ α) = α := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext P
    change f * (f⁻¹ * (α : (P : Place k F) → F) P) = _
    field_simp
  have h2 := LinearMap.congr_fun h0 (adeleSMul f⁻¹ α)
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, h1] at h2
  simpa using h2

name: AclGeom.deg_le_of_mem_weilDifferentialsAt
statement:
theorem deg_le_of_mem_weilDifferentialsAt
    {ω : Module.Dual k ↥(adeleSubmodule k F)} (hω0 : ω ≠ 0)
    {D₀ D : Divisor k F} (hD : ω ∈ weilDifferentialsAt D) :
    D.deg ≤ D₀.deg + genus k F - 1 + specialtyIndex D₀
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hmem : ∀ f : ↥(RiemannSpace (D - D₀)),
      ω ∘ₗ adeleSMul (f : F) ∈ weilDifferentialsAt D₀ := by
    intro f
    rcases eq_or_ne (f : F) 0 with h0 | h0
    · rw [h0]
      have hz : adeleSMul (k := k) (F := F) (0 : F) = 0 := by
        refine LinearMap.ext fun α ↦ Subtype.ext (funext fun P ↦ ?_)
        change (0 : F) * ((α : (Q : Place k F) → F) P) = 0
        rw [zero_mul]
      rw [hz, LinearMap.comp_zero]
      exact zero_mem _
    · have h1 := comp_adeleSMul_mem_weilDifferentialsAt h0 hD
      refine weilDifferentialsAt_antitone ?_ h1
      intro P
      have h2 := (mem_riemannSpace_iff.1 f.2).resolve_left h0 P
      rw [Finsupp.sub_apply] at h2
      rw [Finsupp.add_apply, divisorOf_apply h0]
      omega
  set φ : ↥(RiemannSpace (D - D₀)) →ₗ[k]
      ↥(weilDifferentialsAt (k := k) (F := F) D₀) :=
    { toFun := fun f ↦ ⟨ω ∘ₗ adeleSMul (f : F), hmem f⟩
      map_add' := fun f g ↦ by
        apply Subtype.ext
        change ω ∘ₗ adeleSMul ((f : F) + (g : F)) =
          ω ∘ₗ adeleSMul (f : F) + ω ∘ₗ adeleSMul (g : F)
        rw [adeleSMul_add, LinearMap.comp_add]
      map_smul' := fun c f ↦ by
        apply Subtype.ext
        change ω ∘ₗ adeleSMul (c • (f : F)) =
          c • (ω ∘ₗ adeleSMul (f : F))
        rw [adeleSMul_smul, LinearMap.comp_smul] }
  have hinj : Function.Injective φ := by
    intro f g hfg
    have h1 : ω ∘ₗ adeleSMul (f : F) = ω ∘ₗ adeleSMul (g : F) :=
      congrArg Subtype.val hfg
    by_contra hne
    have hsub : (f : F) - (g : F) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      exact hne (Subtype.ext (sub_eq_zero.1 h0))
    have h2 : ω ∘ₗ adeleSMul ((f : F) - (g : F)) = 0 := by
      rw [adeleSMul_sub, LinearMap.comp_sub, h1, sub_self]
    exact comp_adeleSMul_ne_zero hsub hω0 h2
  have hcard := LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective hinj
  have hRR := riemann_inequality (k := k) (F := F) (D - D₀)
  have hdeg : (D - D₀).deg = D.deg - D₀.deg := Divisor.deg_sub D D₀
  have hΩ := finrank_weilDifferentialsAt (k := k) (F := F) D₀
  omega

name: AclGeom.adeleSMul_comp
statement:
theorem adeleSMul_comp (f g : F) :
    adeleSMul (k := k) (F := F) f ∘ₗ adeleSMul g = adeleSMul (f * g)
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun α ↦ Subtype.ext (funext fun P ↦ ?_)
  change f * (g * ((α : (Q : Place k F) → F) P)) =
    (f * g) * ((α : (Q : Place k F) → F) P)
  ring

name: AclGeom.adeleSMul_one
statement:
theorem adeleSMul_one :
    adeleSMul (k := k) (F := F) (1 : F) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun α ↦ Subtype.ext (funext fun P ↦ ?_)
  change (1 : F) * ((α : (Q : Place k F) → F) P) = _
  rw [one_mul]
  rfl

name: AclGeom.comp_adeleSMul_mem_weilDifferentialsAt_iff
statement:
theorem comp_adeleSMul_mem_weilDifferentialsAt_iff {f : F} (hf : f ≠ 0)
    {D : Divisor k F} {ω : Module.Dual k ↥(adeleSubmodule k F)} :
    ω ∘ₗ adeleSMul f ∈ weilDifferentialsAt (D + divisorOf k f) ↔
      ω ∈ weilDifferentialsAt D
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h1 := comp_adeleSMul_mem_weilDifferentialsAt
      (inv_ne_zero hf) h
    rw [LinearMap.comp_assoc, adeleSMul_comp, mul_inv_cancel₀ hf,
      adeleSMul_one, LinearMap.comp_id, divisorOf_inv hf,
      show D + divisorOf k f + -divisorOf k f = D by abel] at h1
    exact h1
  · exact comp_adeleSMul_mem_weilDifferentialsAt hf

name: AclGeom.adeleSpace_add_pos_le_sup
statement:
theorem adeleSpace_add_pos_le_sup (D E : Divisor k F) :
    adeleSpace (D + (E - D).pos) ≤ adeleSpace D ⊔ adeleSpace E
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro α hα
  rw [Submodule.mem_sup]
  refine ⟨fun P ↦ if E P ≤ D P then α P else 0, ?_,
    fun P ↦ if E P ≤ D P then 0 else α P, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro P
    by_cases h : E P ≤ D P
    · simp only [if_pos h]
      rcases hα P with h0 | h0
      · exact Or.inl h0
      · rw [Divisor.add_sub_pos_apply, max_eq_left h] at h0
        exact Or.inr h0
    · exact Or.inl (if_neg h)
  · intro P
    by_cases h : E P ≤ D P
    · exact Or.inl (if_pos h)
    · simp only [if_neg h]
      rcases hα P with h0 | h0
      · exact Or.inl h0
      · rw [Divisor.add_sub_pos_apply,
          max_eq_right (by omega : D P ≤ E P)] at h0
        exact Or.inr h0
  · funext P
    by_cases h : E P ≤ D P <;> simp [h]

name: AclGeom.mem_weilDifferentialsAt_add_pos
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_weilDifferentialsAt_iff] at hD hE ⊢
  intro β hβ
  rw [mem_boundedSubmodule_iff] at hβ
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hβ
  obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁, x₂, hx₂, hxx⟩ :=
    Submodule.mem_sup.1 (adeleSpace_add_pos_le_sup D E hx)
  have hm₁ : x₁ ∈ adeleSubmodule k F :=
    adeleSpace_le_adeleSubmodule D hx₁
  have hm₂ : x₂ + y ∈ adeleSubmodule k F := by
    refine Submodule.add_mem _ (adeleSpace_le_adeleSubmodule E hx₂) ?_
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact adeleDiagonal_mem_adeleSubmodule g
  have hβ' : β = (⟨x₁, hm₁⟩ : ↥(adeleSubmodule k F)) + ⟨x₂ + y, hm₂⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (β : (P : Place k F) → F) = x₁ + (x₂ + y)
    rw [← hxy, ← hxx]
    abel
  have hmem₁ : (⟨x₁, hm₁⟩ : ↥(adeleSubmodule k F)) ∈ boundedSubmodule D :=
    mem_boundedSubmodule_iff.2 (Submodule.mem_sup_left hx₁)
  have hmem₂ : (⟨x₂ + y, hm₂⟩ : ↥(adeleSubmodule k F)) ∈
      boundedSubmodule E :=
    mem_boundedSubmodule_iff.2 (Submodule.add_mem _
      (Submodule.mem_sup_left hx₂) (Submodule.mem_sup_right hy))
  rw [hβ', map_add, hD _ hmem₁, hE _ hmem₂, add_zero]

name: AclGeom.exists_isGreatest_level
statement:
theorem exists_isGreatest_level
    {ω : Module.Dual k ↥(adeleSubmodule k F)} (hω0 : ω ≠ 0)
    {D₁ : Divisor k F} (h₁ : ω ∈ weilDifferentialsAt D₁) :
    ∃ W : Divisor k F, ω ∈ weilDifferentialsAt W ∧
      ∀ D, ω ∈ weilDifferentialsAt D → D ≤ W
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set S : Set ℤ :=
    {n | ∃ D : Divisor k F, ω ∈ weilDifferentialsAt D ∧ D.deg = n}
    with hS
  have hne : S.Nonempty := ⟨D₁.deg, D₁, h₁, rfl⟩
  have hbdd : BddAbove S := by
    refine ⟨D₁.deg + genus k F - 1 + specialtyIndex D₁, ?_⟩
    rintro n ⟨D, hD, rfl⟩
    exact deg_le_of_mem_weilDifferentialsAt hω0 hD
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hWdeg⟩ := Int.csSup_mem hne hbdd
  refine ⟨W, hW, fun D hD ↦ ?_⟩
  have hjoin := mem_weilDifferentialsAt_add_pos hW hD
  have hWle : W ≤ W + (D - W).pos := fun P ↦ by
    rw [Divisor.add_sub_pos_apply]
    exact le_max_left _ _
  have hDle : D ≤ W + (D - W).pos := fun P ↦ by
    rw [Divisor.add_sub_pos_apply]
    exact le_max_right _ _
  have hdegle : (W + (D - W).pos).deg ≤ W.deg := by
    have h2 : (W + (D - W).pos).deg ∈ S := ⟨_, hjoin, rfl⟩
    have h3 := le_csSup hbdd h2
    omega
  have heq := Divisor.eq_of_le_of_deg_le hWle hdegle
  rw [heq]
  exact hDle

name: AclGeom.differentialPairing_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem differentialPairing_coe {W D E : Divisor k F}
    {ω : Module.Dual k ↥(adeleSubmodule k F)}
    (hω : ω ∈ weilDifferentialsAt W) (hDE : D + E ≤ W)
    (f : ↥(RiemannSpace E)) :
    (differentialPairing hω hDE f :
      Module.Dual k ↥(adeleSubmodule k F)) = ω ∘ₗ adeleSMul (f : F)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AclGeom.exists_eq_comp_adeleSMul
statement:
theorem exists_eq_comp_adeleSMul
    {ω₁ ω₂ : Module.Dual k ↥(adeleSubmodule k F)}
    (h₁0 : ω₁ ≠ 0) (h₂0 : ω₂ ≠ 0)
    {W₁ W₂ : Divisor k F} (h₁ : ω₁ ∈ weilDifferentialsAt W₁)
    (h₂ : ω₂ ∈ weilDifferentialsAt W₂) :
    ∃ f : F, f ≠ 0 ∧ ω₂ = ω₁ ∘ₗ adeleSMul f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (Place k F))
  set N : ℕ := (3 * genus k F - 3 - W₁.deg - W₂.deg).toNat + 1 with hN
  set B : Divisor k F := Finsupp.single P (N : ℤ) with hB
  have hdegB : B.deg = (N : ℤ) := by
    rw [hB, Divisor.deg, Finsupp.sum_single_index rfl]
  have hle₁ : (-B) + (W₁ + B) ≤ W₁ := le_of_eq (by abel)
  have hle₂ : (-B) + (W₂ + B) ≤ W₂ := le_of_eq (by abel)
  set Φ := LinearMap.coprod (differentialPairing h₁ hle₁)
    (differentialPairing h₂ hle₂) with hΦ
  have hker : ∀ x, Φ x = 0 → x = 0 := by
    rintro ⟨f, g⟩ h0
    have h1 : ω₁ ∘ₗ adeleSMul (f : F) + ω₂ ∘ₗ adeleSMul (g : F) = 0 :=
      congrArg Subtype.val h0
    rcases eq_or_ne (g : F) 0 with hg0 | hg0
    · 
      have hz : adeleSMul (k := k) (F := F) (0 : F) = 0 := by
        refine LinearMap.ext fun α ↦ Subtype.ext (funext fun Q ↦ ?_)
        change (0 : F) * ((α : (Q' : Place k F) → F) Q) = 0
        rw [zero_mul]
      rw [hg0, hz, LinearMap.comp_zero, add_zero] at h1
      have hf0 : (f : F) = 0 := by
        by_contra hf0
        exact comp_adeleSMul_ne_zero hf0 h₁0 h1
      refine Prod.ext (Subtype.ext hf0) (Subtype.ext hg0)
    · 
      have h2 : ω₂ ∘ₗ adeleSMul (g : F) = ω₁ ∘ₗ adeleSMul (-(f : F)) := by
        have h3 : adeleSMul (k := k) (F := F) (-(f : F)) =
            -adeleSMul (f : F) := by
          refine LinearMap.ext fun α ↦ Subtype.ext (funext fun Q ↦ ?_)
          change (-(f : F)) * ((α : (Q' : Place k F) → F) Q) =
            -((f : F) * ((α : (Q' : Place k F) → F) Q))
          ring
        rw [h3, LinearMap.comp_neg]
        rw [add_comm] at h1
        exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h1
      have h4 : ω₂ = ω₁ ∘ₗ adeleSMul (-(f : F) * (g : F)⁻¹) := by
        have h5 := congrArg (· ∘ₗ adeleSMul ((g : F)⁻¹)) h2
        simp only [LinearMap.comp_assoc, adeleSMul_comp] at h5
        rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hg0, adeleSMul_one, LinearMap.comp_id] at h5
        exact h5
      exact absurd h4 (hcon _ (mul_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.2 (by
        intro hf0
        rw [hf0] at h2
        have hz : adeleSMul (k := k) (F := F) (-(0 : F)) = 0 := by
          refine LinearMap.ext fun α ↦ Subtype.ext (funext fun Q ↦ ?_)
          change (-(0 : F)) * ((α : (Q' : Place k F) → F) Q) = 0
          rw [neg_zero, zero_mul]
        rw [hz, LinearMap.comp_zero] at h2
        exact comp_adeleSMul_ne_zero hg0 h₂0 h2)) (inv_ne_zero hg0)))
  have hinj : Function.Injective Φ := by
    intro x y hxy
    have h6 := hker (x - y) (by rw [map_sub, hxy, sub_self])
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 h6
  have hcard := LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective hinj
  rw [Module.finrank_prod] at hcard
  have hR₁ := riemann_inequality (k := k) (F := F) (W₁ + B)
  have hR₂ := riemann_inequality (k := k) (F := F) (W₂ + B)
  have hΩrk := finrank_weilDifferentialsAt (k := k) (F := F) (-B)
  have hi : specialtyIndex (-B : Divisor k F) =
      (N : ℤ) + genus k F - 1 := by
    have h := finrank_riemannSpace_eq_add_specialtyIndex
      (-B : Divisor k F)
    have hzero : Module.finrank k (RiemannSpace (-B : Divisor k F)) = 0 := by
      rw [riemannSpace_eq_bot_of_deg_neg ?_, finrank_bot]
      rw [Divisor.deg_neg, hdegB]
      omega
    rw [hzero, Divisor.deg_neg, hdegB] at h
    omega
  have hdeg₁ : (W₁ + B).deg = W₁.deg + N := by
    rw [Divisor.deg_add, hdegB]
  have hdeg₂ : (W₂ + B).deg = W₂.deg + N := by
    rw [Divisor.deg_add, hdegB]
  have hg := genus_nonneg (k := k) (F := F)
  have hNbig : 3 * genus k F - 3 - W₁.deg - W₂.deg < (N : ℤ) := by
    rw [hN]
    push_cast
    omega
  omega

name: AclGeom.isGreatest_level_comp
statement:
theorem isGreatest_level_comp
    {ω : Module.Dual k ↥(adeleSubmodule k F)}
    {W : Divisor k F} (hW : ω ∈ weilDifferentialsAt W)
    (hmax : ∀ D, ω ∈ weilDifferentialsAt D → D ≤ W)
    {f : F} (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    ω ∘ₗ adeleSMul f ∈ weilDifferentialsAt (W + divisorOf k f) ∧
      ∀ D, ω ∘ₗ adeleSMul f ∈ weilDifferentialsAt D →
        D ≤ W + divisorOf k f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨comp_adeleSMul_mem_weilDifferentialsAt hf hW, fun D hD ↦ ?_⟩
  have h1 : ω ∈ weilDifferentialsAt (D - divisorOf k f) := by
    refine (comp_adeleSMul_mem_weilDifferentialsAt_iff hf
      (D := D - divisorOf k f)).1 ?_
    rw [show D - divisorOf k f + divisorOf k f = D by abel]
    exact hD
  have h2 := hmax _ h1
  intro P
  have h3 := h2 P
  rw [Finsupp.sub_apply] at h3
  rw [Finsupp.add_apply]
  omega

name: AclGeom.Divisor.defect_mono
statement:
theorem Divisor.defect_mono {D E : Divisor k F} (hDE : D ≤ E) :
    D.defect ≤ E.defect
proof:
:= by
  have h := finrank_riemannSpace_le_of_le hDE
  rw [Divisor.defect, Divisor.defect]
  omega

name: AclGeom.Divisor.defect_add_divisorOf
proof:
:= by
  rw [Divisor.defect, Divisor.defect, Divisor.deg_add,
    deg_divisorOf_eq_zero', add_zero,
    finrank_riemannSpace_add_divisorOf D hz]

name: AclGeom.exists_forall_defect_le
statement:
theorem exists_forall_defect_le :
    ∃ γ : ℤ, ∀ D : Divisor k F, D.defect ≤ γ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, hxtr, hxfin⟩ :=
    IsFunctionFieldOneVar.exists_transcendental_finite (k := k) (F := F)
  haveI := hxfin
  set n := Module.finrank (↥(adjoin k ({x} : Set F))) F with hn
  have hnpos : 0 < n := Module.finrank_pos
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hbound⟩ := exists_effective_riemannSpace_lower_bound hxtr
  set A : Divisor k F := poleDivisor k x with hA
  have hdegA : A.deg = (n : ℤ) := deg_poleDivisor_eq_finrank hxtr
  
  have hlow : ∀ N : ℕ, ((N : ℤ) + 1) * (n : ℤ) - C.deg ≤
      (Module.finrank k (RiemannSpace ((N : ℤ) • A)) : ℤ) := by
    intro N
    have hb : ((N : ℤ) + 1) * (n : ℤ) ≤
        (Module.finrank k (RiemannSpace ((N : ℤ) • A + C)) : ℤ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hbound N
    have hle1 : (N : ℤ) • A ≤ (N : ℤ) • A + C := by
      intro P
      rw [Finsupp.add_apply]
      have h1 : 0 ≤ C P := by simpa using hC0 P
      omega
    have hsub := finrank_riemannSpace_le_of_le hle1
    have hdeg1 : ((N : ℤ) • A + C).deg = ((N : ℤ) • A).deg + C.deg :=
      Divisor.deg_add _ _
    linarith [hb, hsub, hdeg1]
  refine ⟨C.deg + 1 - n, fun D ↦ ?_⟩
  
  have h1 : D.defect ≤ D.pos.defect := Divisor.defect_mono (Divisor.le_pos D)
  set E : Divisor k F := D.pos with hE
  have hE0 : 0 ≤ E := Divisor.pos_nonneg D
  
  set m : ℕ := (C.deg + E.deg).toNat + 1 with hm
  have hkey : (0 : ℤ) <
      Module.finrank k (RiemannSpace ((m : ℤ) • A - E)) := by
    have hle2 : (m : ℤ) • A - E ≤ (m : ℤ) • A := by
      intro P
      rw [Finsupp.sub_apply]
      have h2 : 0 ≤ E P := by simpa using hE0 P
      omega
    have hsub2 := finrank_riemannSpace_le_of_le hle2
    have hdegsub : ((m : ℤ) • A - E).deg = ((m : ℤ) • A).deg - E.deg :=
      Divisor.deg_sub _ _
    have hlowm := hlow m
    have hmbig : (C.deg + E.deg : ℤ) < (m : ℤ) := by
      rw [hm]
      push_cast
      omega
    have hn1 : (1 : ℤ) ≤ (n : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hnpos
    have hmn : ((m : ℤ) + 1) * 1 ≤ ((m : ℤ) + 1) * (n : ℤ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn1 (by positivity)
    linarith [hsub2, hdegsub, hlowm, hmbig, hmn]
  obtain ⟨z, hzmem, hz0⟩ :=
    Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot (p := RiemannSpace ((m : ℤ) • A - E))
      (by
        intro hbot
        rw [hbot, finrank_bot] at hkey
        simp at hkey)
  
  have hle3 : E ≤ (m : ℤ) • A + divisorOf k z := by
    intro P
    rw [mem_riemannSpace_iff] at hzmem
    rcases hzmem with rfl | hzord
    · exact absurd rfl hz0
    have h2 := hzord P
    rw [Finsupp.sub_apply] at h2
    rw [Finsupp.add_apply, divisorOf_apply hz0]
    omega
  
  have h4 : E.defect ≤ ((m : ℤ) • A + divisorOf k z).defect :=
    Divisor.defect_mono hle3
  have h5 : ((m : ℤ) • A + divisorOf k z).defect = ((m : ℤ) • A).defect :=
    Divisor.defect_add_divisorOf _ hz0
  have h6 : ((m : ℤ) • A).defect ≤ C.deg + 1 - n := by
    rw [Divisor.defect]
    have hlowm := hlow m
    have hdegmA : ((m : ℤ) • A).deg = (m : ℤ) * (n : ℤ) := by
      rw [Divisor.deg_smul, hdegA]
    have hexp : ((m : ℤ) + 1) * (n : ℤ) = (m : ℤ) * (n : ℤ) + n := by
      ring
    linarith [hlowm, hdegmA, hexp]
  omega

name: AclGeom.defect_le_genus
statement: theorem defect_le_genus (D : Divisor k F) : D.defect ≤ genus k F
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := exists_forall_defect_le (k := k) (F := F)
  exact le_csSup ⟨γ, by rintro r ⟨D', rfl⟩; exact hγ D'⟩ ⟨D, rfl⟩

name: AclGeom.riemann_inequality
statement:
theorem riemann_inequality (D : Divisor k F) :
    D.deg + 1 - genus k F ≤ (Module.finrank k (RiemannSpace D) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := defect_le_genus D
  rw [Divisor.defect] at h
  omega

name: AclGeom.genus_nonneg
statement: theorem genus_nonneg : 0 ≤ genus k F
proof:
:= by
  have h := defect_le_genus (0 : Divisor k F)
  rw [Divisor.defect, Divisor.deg_zero, riemannSpace_zero] at h
  have h1 : Module.finrank k
      (LinearMap.range (Algebra.linearMap k F)) = 1 := by
    rw [LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj
      (show Function.Injective (Algebra.linearMap k F) from
        (algebraMap k F).injective), Module.finrank_self]
  rw [h1] at h
  omega

name: AclGeom.riemannSpace_eq_bot_of_deg_neg
statement:
theorem riemannSpace_eq_bot_of_deg_neg {D : Divisor k F}
    (hD : D.deg < 0) : RiemannSpace D = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.eq_bot_iff]
  intro f hf
  by_contra hf0
  rw [mem_riemannSpace_iff] at hf
  rcases hf with rfl | hf
  · exact hf0 rfl
  have h1 : 0 ≤ divisorOf k f + D := by
    intro P
    have h2 := hf P
    have h3 : (0 : Divisor k F) P = 0 := rfl
    rw [h3, Finsupp.add_apply, divisorOf_apply hf0]
    omega
  have h2 := Divisor.deg_nonneg h1
  rw [Divisor.deg_add, deg_divisorOf_eq_zero'] at h2
  omega

name: AclGeom.exists_defect_eq_genus
statement:
theorem exists_defect_eq_genus :
    ∃ D : Divisor k F, D.defect = genus k F
proof:
:= by
  have hne : (Set.range fun D : Divisor k F ↦ D.defect).Nonempty :=
    ⟨_, ⟨0, rfl⟩⟩
  have hbdd : BddAbove (Set.range fun D : Divisor k F ↦ D.defect) := by
    obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := exists_forall_defect_le (k := k) (F := F)
    exact ⟨γ, by rintro r ⟨D', rfl⟩; exact hγ D'⟩
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := Int.csSup_mem hne hbdd
  exact ⟨D, hD⟩

name: AclGeom.defect_eq_genus_of_le
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (defect_le_genus E) (hD ▸ Divisor.defect_mono hDE)

name: AclGeom.exists_le_defect_eq_genus
statement:
theorem exists_le_defect_eq_genus (D : Divisor k F) :
    ∃ E : Divisor k F, D ≤ E ∧ E.defect = genus k F
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D₀, hD₀⟩ := exists_defect_eq_genus (k := k) (F := F)
  refine ⟨D₀ + (D - D₀).pos, fun P ↦ ?_,
    defect_eq_genus_of_le hD₀ fun P ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [Finsupp.add_apply, Divisor.pos, Finsupp.mapRange_apply,
      Finsupp.sub_apply]
    rcases le_total (D P - D₀ P) 0 with h | h
    · rw [max_eq_right h]
      omega
    · rw [max_eq_left h]
      omega
  · rw [Finsupp.add_apply, Divisor.pos, Finsupp.mapRange_apply,
      Finsupp.sub_apply]
    rcases le_total (D P - D₀ P) 0 with h | h
    · rw [max_eq_right h]
      omega
    · rw [max_eq_left h]
      omega

name: AclGeom.finrank_riemannSpace_eq_of_defect_eq_genus
proof:
:= by
  rw [Divisor.defect] at hE
  omega

name: AclGeom.intermediateField_eq_top_of_finrank_eq_one
statement:
theorem intermediateField_eq_top_of_finrank_eq_one
    {K : IntermediateField k F} [FiniteDimensional (↥K) F]
    (h1 : Module.finrank (↥K) F = 1) : K = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hspan : Submodule.span (↥K) ({(1 : F)} : Set F) = ⊤ := by
    apply Submodule.eq_top_of_finrank_eq
    rw [finrank_span_singleton (one_ne_zero (α := F)), h1]
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  intro y _
  have hy : y ∈ Submodule.span (↥K) ({(1 : F)} : Set F) := by
    rw [hspan]
    trivial
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.1 hy
  have hc1 : c • (1 : F) = (c : F) := by
    rw [Algebra.smul_def, mul_one]
    rfl
  rw [← hc, hc1]
  exact c.2

name: AclGeom.exists_generator_of_genus_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_generator_of_genus_eq_zero (hg : genus k F = 0)
    (P : Place k F) :
    ∃ t : F, Transcendental k t ∧
      poleDivisor k t = Finsupp.single P 1 ∧
      adjoin k ({t} : Set F) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdeg1 : Divisor.deg (Finsupp.single P 1 : Divisor k F) = 1 := by
    rw [Divisor.deg, Finsupp.sum_single_index rfl]
  
  have hl2 := riemann_inequality (Finsupp.single P 1 : Divisor k F)
  rw [hg, hdeg1] at hl2
  have hmono : RiemannSpace (0 : Divisor k F) ≤
      RiemannSpace (Finsupp.single P 1) := by
    apply riemannSpace_mono
    intro Q
    rcases eq_or_ne Q P with rfl | hQ
    · simp [Finsupp.single_eq_same]
    · simp [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hQ]
  have hfr0 : Module.finrank k (RiemannSpace (0 : Divisor k F)) = 1 := by
    rw [riemannSpace_zero, LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj
      (show Function.Injective (Algebra.linearMap k F) from
        (algebraMap k F).injective), Module.finrank_self]
  
  obtain ⟨t, htmem, htnc⟩ : ∃ t, t ∈ RiemannSpace (Finsupp.single P 1) ∧
      t ∉ RiemannSpace (0 : Divisor k F) := by
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    have heq : RiemannSpace (Finsupp.single P 1 : Divisor k F) =
        RiemannSpace (0 : Divisor k F) :=
      le_antisymm (fun t ht ↦ hcon t ht) hmono
    rw [heq, hfr0] at hl2
    omega
  have htc : ∀ c : k, algebraMap k F c ≠ t := by
    intro c hc
    apply htnc
    rw [riemannSpace_zero]
    exact LinearMap.mem_range.2 ⟨c, hc⟩
  have htr : Transcendental k t := by
    intro halg
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_algebraMap_eq_of_isAlgebraic halg
    exact htc c hc
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ htc 0 (by rw [map_zero, h])
  rw [mem_riemannSpace_iff] at htmem
  rcases htmem with rfl | hord
  · exact absurd rfl ht0
  
  have hpole : ∃ Q : Place k F, Q.ord t < 0 := by
    by_contra hnp
    push Not at hnp
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_algebraMap_eq_of_forall_valuation_le_one
      fun Q ↦ (Q.ord_nonneg_iff ht0).1 (hnp Q)
    exact htc c hc
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hpole
  have hQP : Q = P := by
    by_contra hne
    have h1 := hord Q
    rw [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hne] at h1
    omega
  subst hQP
  have hordP : Q.ord t = -1 := by
    have h1 := hord Q
    rw [Finsupp.single_eq_same] at h1
    omega
  have hpd : poleDivisor k t = Finsupp.single Q 1 := by
    ext R
    rw [poleDivisor_apply ht0]
    rcases eq_or_ne R Q with rfl | hR
    · rw [Finsupp.single_eq_same, hordP]
      rw [show -(-1 : ℤ) = 1 by norm_num, max_eq_left (by norm_num)]
    · have h1 := hord R
      rw [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hR] at h1
      rw [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hR, max_eq_right (by omega)]
  
  have hfr1 : Module.finrank (↥(adjoin k ({t} : Set F))) F = 1 := by
    have h1 := deg_poleDivisor_eq_finrank htr
    rw [hpd, hdeg1] at h1
    exact_mod_cast h1.symm
  haveI := finiteDimensional_adjoin_of_transcendental (k := k) htr
  exact ⟨t, htr, hpd, intermediateField_eq_top_of_finrank_eq_one hfr1⟩

name: AclGeom.Place.mem_orderSubmodule_iff
statement:
theorem Place.mem_orderSubmodule_iff {P : Place k F} {r : ℤ} {x : F} :
    x ∈ P.orderSubmodule r ↔ x = 0 ∨ r ≤ P.ord x
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: AclGeom.Place.orderSubmodule_antitone
statement:
theorem Place.orderSubmodule_antitone (P : Place k F) {r s : ℤ}
    (h : r ≤ s) : P.orderSubmodule s ≤ P.orderSubmodule r
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with rfl | hx
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · exact Or.inr (h.trans hx)

name: AclGeom.Place.mul_mem_orderSubmodule
statement:
theorem Place.mul_mem_orderSubmodule (P : Place k F) {a b : F}
    {r s : ℤ} (ha : a ∈ P.orderSubmodule r)
    (hb : b ∈ P.orderSubmodule s) :
    a * b ∈ P.orderSubmodule (r + s)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with rfl | ha0
  · exact Or.inl (zero_mul b)
  rcases eq_or_ne b 0 with rfl | hb0
  · exact Or.inl (mul_zero a)
  refine Or.inr ?_
  rw [P.ord_mul ha0 hb0]
  have ha' := ha.resolve_left ha0
  have hb' := hb.resolve_left hb0
  omega

name: AclGeom.Place.orderSubmodule_zero
statement:
theorem Place.orderSubmodule_zero (P : Place k F) :
    P.orderSubmodule 0 = P.toSubmodule
proof:
:= by
  rw [← P.filtration_zero]
  ext x
  rw [Place.mem_orderSubmodule_iff, Place.mem_filtration_iff_ord]
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero]

name: AclGeom.Place.pow_pi_mem_orderSubmodule
statement:
theorem Place.pow_pi_mem_orderSubmodule (P : Place k F) (n : ℕ) :
    P.pi ^ n ∈ P.orderSubmodule (n : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  right
  rw [P.ord_pow P.pi_ne_zero, P.ord_pi, mul_one]

name: AclGeom.DerivationIsRegular.at
proof: := hD P

name: AclGeom.DerivationVanishesAt.isRegularAt
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [← P.orderSubmodule_zero]
  exact P.orderSubmodule_antitone (by omega) (hD x hx)

name: AclGeom.derivation_smul_pow
statement:
theorem derivation_smul_pow (D : Derivation k F F) (c : k) (x : F)
    (n : ℕ) :
    D (c • x ^ n) = ((n : k) * c) • (x ^ (n - 1) * D x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Derivation.map_smul, Derivation.leibniz_pow]
  simp only [Algebra.smul_def]
  change algebraMap k F c * ((n : F) * (x ^ (n - 1) * D x)) =
    algebraMap k F ((n : k) * c) * (x ^ (n - 1) * D x)
  rw [map_mul, map_natCast]
  ring

name: AclGeom.Place.residue_zpow_neg_eq_taylorCoeff
statement:
theorem Place.residue_zpow_neg_eq_taylorCoeff (P : Place k F)
    {t : F} {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → k) {b : F}
    (hb : b ∈ P.toSubmodule)
    (ht : t = (∑ j, c j • P.pi ^ (j : ℕ)) + P.pi ^ n * b)
    (i : Fin n) :
    P.residue ((P.pi : F) ^ (-((i : ℕ) : ℤ))) t =
      (i : k) * c i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let ρ : F →ₗ[k] k :=
    { toFun := fun g ↦ P.residue ((P.pi : F) ^ (-((i : ℕ) : ℤ))) g
      map_add' := fun g h ↦ P.residue_add_right _ _ _
      map_smul' := fun a g ↦ by
        rw [P.residue_smul_right]
        rfl }
  have htail : ρ (P.pi ^ n * b) = 0 := by
    rcases eq_or_ne b 0 with rfl | hb0
    · rw [mul_zero, map_zero]
    apply P.residue_eq_zero_of_ord_ge_mirror (m := (i : ℕ))
    · exact zpow_ne_zero _ P.pi_ne_zero
    · exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ P.pi_ne_zero) hb0
    · rw [P.ord_zpow P.pi_ne_zero, P.ord_pi, mul_one]
    · rw [P.ord_mul (pow_ne_zero _ P.pi_ne_zero) hb0,
        P.ord_pow P.pi_ne_zero, P.ord_pi, mul_one]
      have hbOrd : 0 ≤ P.ord b :=
        (P.ord_nonneg_iff hb0).2 (Place.mem_toSubmodule_iff.1 hb)
      have hi := i.isLt
      omega
  have hdiag : ρ (c i • P.pi ^ (i : ℕ)) = (i : k) * c i := by
    rw [map_smul]
    change c i *
      P.residue ((P.pi : F) ^ (-((i : ℕ) : ℤ)))
        ((P.pi : F) ^ (i : ℕ)) = (i : k) * c i
    rw [← zpow_natCast, P.residue_zpow_pi_self (by omega)]
    simp only [Int.toNat_natCast]
    ring
  have hoff : ∀ j : Fin n, j ≠ i →
      ρ (c j • P.pi ^ (j : ℕ)) = 0 := by
    intro j hji
    rw [map_smul]
    change c j *
      P.residue ((P.pi : F) ^ (-((i : ℕ) : ℤ)))
        ((P.pi : F) ^ (j : ℕ)) = 0
    rw [← zpow_natCast,
      P.residue_zpow_pi_zpow_eq_zero (by
        intro hzero
        apply hji
        apply Fin.ext
        omega), mul_zero]
  change ρ t = (i : k) * c i
  rw [ht, map_add, map_sum, htail, add_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · exact hdiag
  · intro j _ hji
    exact hoff j hji
  · intro hi
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) hi

name: AclGeom.order_derivation_ge_level_of_mem_of_depth
statement:
theorem order_derivation_ge_level_of_mem_of_depth
    (D : Derivation k F F) (P : Place k F) {r : ℤ}
    (hdepth : ∀ x ∈ P.toSubmodule, D x ∈ P.orderSubmodule r)
    {t : F} (htP : t ∈ P.toSubmodule) {W : Divisor k F}
    (hW : residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) t ∈
      weilDifferentialsAt W)
    (hmax : ∀ E, residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) t ∈
      weilDifferentialsAt E → E ≤ W) :
    D t ∈ P.orderSubmodule (W P + r)
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt 0 (W P) with hW0 | hWneg
  · set n : ℕ := (W P).toNat + 2 with hn
    have hnInt : (n : ℤ) = W P + 2 := by
      rw [hn, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_ofNat, Int.toNat_of_nonneg hW0]
    obtain ⟨c, b, hb, htaylor⟩ := P.exists_taylor htP n
    have hcoeff : ∀ i : Fin n, (i : ℤ) ≤ W P →
        (i : k) * c i = 0 := by
      intro i hi
      have hlocal :=
        (local_behavior_of_isGreatest_level hW hmax P).1
          ((P.pi : F) ^ (-((i : ℕ) : ℤ))) (Or.inr (by
            rw [P.ord_zpow P.pi_ne_zero, P.ord_pi, mul_one]
            omega))
      rw [residueFunctional_adeleSingle,
        P.residue_zpow_neg_eq_taylorCoeff c hb htaylor i] at hlocal
      exact hlocal
    have hDpi : D P.pi ∈ P.orderSubmodule r := by
      apply hdepth
      rw [Place.mem_toSubmodule_iff]
      exact P.pi_valuation_lt_one.le
    have hDb : D b ∈ P.orderSubmodule r := hdepth b hb
    rw [htaylor, map_add, map_sum]
    refine Submodule.add_mem _ ?_ ?_
    · refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ ↦ ?_
      rw [derivation_smul_pow]
      by_cases hi : (i : ℤ) ≤ W P
      · rw [hcoeff i hi, zero_smul]
        exact Submodule.zero_mem _
      · refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
        have hprod := P.mul_mem_orderSubmodule
          (P.pow_pi_mem_orderSubmodule ((i : ℕ) - 1)) hDpi
        refine P.orderSubmodule_antitone
          (s := ((((i : ℕ) - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + r)) (by omega) ?_
        · exact hprod
    · rw [Derivation.leibniz]
      simp only [smul_eq_mul]
      refine Submodule.add_mem _ ?_ ?_
      · have hprod := P.mul_mem_orderSubmodule
          (P.pow_pi_mem_orderSubmodule n) hDb
        refine P.orderSubmodule_antitone (s := (n : ℤ) + r)
          (by omega) ?_
        · exact hprod
      · have hDpow : D (P.pi ^ n) ∈
            P.orderSubmodule (((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + r) := by
          have hform := derivation_smul_pow D (1 : k) P.pi n
          simp only [one_smul, mul_one] at hform
          rw [hform]
          refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
          simpa using P.mul_mem_orderSubmodule
            (P.pow_pi_mem_orderSubmodule (n - 1)) hDpi
        have hb0 : b ∈ P.orderSubmodule 0 := by
          rw [P.orderSubmodule_zero]
          exact hb
        have hprod := P.mul_mem_orderSubmodule hb0 hDpow
        refine P.orderSubmodule_antitone
          (s := 0 + (((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) + r)) (by omega) ?_
        · exact hprod
  · exact P.orderSubmodule_antitone (s := r) (by omega) (hdepth t htP)

name: AclGeom.order_derivation_ge_level_of_mem
statement:
theorem order_derivation_ge_level_of_mem (D : Derivation k F F)
    (P : Place k F) (hreg : DerivationIsRegularAt D P)
    {t : F} (htP : t ∈ P.toSubmodule) {W : Divisor k F}
    (hW : residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) t ∈
      weilDifferentialsAt W)
    (hmax : ∀ E, residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) t ∈
      weilDifferentialsAt E → E ≤ W) :
    D t ∈ P.orderSubmodule (W P)
proof:
:= by
  have h := order_derivation_ge_level_of_mem_of_depth D P (r := 0)
    (fun x hx ↦ by rw [P.orderSubmodule_zero]; exact hreg x hx)
    htP hW hmax
  simpa using h

name: AclGeom.order_derivation_ge_level_of_ord_neg_of_depth
statement:
theorem order_derivation_ge_level_of_ord_neg_of_depth
    (D : Derivation k F F) (P : Place k F) {r : ℤ}
    (hdepth : ∀ x ∈ P.toSubmodule, D x ∈ P.orderSubmodule r)
    {t : F} (ht : t ≠ 0) (htP : P.ord t < 0)
    {W : Divisor k F}
    (hω0 : residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) t ≠ 0)
    (hW : residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) t ∈
      weilDifferentialsAt W)
    (hmax : ∀ E, residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) t ∈
      weilDifferentialsAt E → E ≤ W) :
    D t ∈ P.orderSubmodule (W P + r)
proof:
:= by
  have htinv : t⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero ht
  have hωinv0 : residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) t⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hω0
    rw [residueFunctional_eq_neg_comp_inv ht, hzero,
      LinearMap.zero_comp, neg_zero]
  obtain ⟨Winv, hWinv, hmaxinv⟩ := exists_isGreatest_level hωinv0
    (residueFunctional_mem_weilDifferentialsAt htinv)
  have htinvP : t⁻¹ ∈ P.toSubmodule := by
    rw [Place.mem_toSubmodule_iff, ← P.ord_nonneg_iff htinv,
      P.ord_inv ht]
    omega
  have hDinv := order_derivation_ge_level_of_mem_of_depth D P hdepth
    htinvP hWinv hmaxinv
  have hlevel := isGreatest_level_residueFunctional_inv_apply ht
    hW hmax hWinv hmaxinv P
  have ht2 : t ^ 2 ∈ P.orderSubmodule (2 * P.ord t) := by
    right
    rw [P.ord_pow ht]
    norm_num
  have hprod := P.mul_mem_orderSubmodule ht2 hDinv
  have hDt : D t = -(t ^ 2 * D t⁻¹) := by
    have h := D.leibniz_of_mul_eq_one (mul_inv_cancel₀ ht)
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h
    rw [h]
    ring
  rw [hDt]
  apply Submodule.neg_mem
  rw [hlevel]
  simpa [add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using hprod

name: AclGeom.order_derivation_ge_level_of_ord_neg
statement:
theorem order_derivation_ge_level_of_ord_neg (D : Derivation k F F)
    (P : Place k F) (hreg : DerivationIsRegularAt D P)
    {t : F} (ht : t ≠ 0) (htP : P.ord t < 0)
    {W : Divisor k F}
    (hω0 : residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) t ≠ 0)
    (hW : residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) t ∈
      weilDifferentialsAt W)
    (hmax : ∀ E, residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) t ∈
      weilDifferentialsAt E → E ≤ W) :
    D t ∈ P.orderSubmodule (W P)
proof:
:= by
  have h := order_derivation_ge_level_of_ord_neg_of_depth D P (r := 0)
    (fun x hx ↦ by rw [P.orderSubmodule_zero]; exact hreg x hx)
    ht htP hω0 hW hmax
  simpa using h

name: AclGeom.derivation_mem_riemannSpace_neg_level
statement:
theorem derivation_mem_riemannSpace_neg_level
    (D : Derivation k F F) (hreg : DerivationIsRegular D)
    {t : F} (ht : t ≠ 0) {W : Divisor k F}
    (hω0 : residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) t ≠ 0)
    (hW : residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) t ∈
      weilDifferentialsAt W)
    (hmax : ∀ E, residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) t ∈
      weilDifferentialsAt E → E ≤ W) :
    D t ∈ RiemannSpace (-W)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_riemannSpace_iff]
  rcases eq_or_ne (D t) 0 with hDt | hDt
  · exact Or.inl hDt
  refine Or.inr fun P ↦ ?_
  rw [Finsupp.neg_apply, neg_neg]
  have hlocal : D t ∈ P.orderSubmodule (W P) := by
    rcases le_or_gt 0 (P.ord t) with htP | htP
    · apply order_derivation_ge_level_of_mem D P (hreg P) _ hW hmax
      rw [Place.mem_toSubmodule_iff, ← P.ord_nonneg_iff ht]
      exact htP
    · exact order_derivation_ge_level_of_ord_neg D P (hreg P)
        ht htP hω0 hW hmax
  exact hlocal.resolve_left hDt

name: AclGeom.derivation_apply_eq_zero_of_two_le_genus
statement:
theorem derivation_apply_eq_zero_of_two_le_genus
    (D : Derivation k F F) (hreg : DerivationIsRegular D)
    (hgenus : 2 ≤ genus k F) {t : F} (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (hω0 : residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) t ≠ 0) :
    D t = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hmax⟩ := exists_isGreatest_level hω0
    (residueFunctional_mem_weilDifferentialsAt ht)
  have hmem := derivation_mem_riemannSpace_neg_level D hreg ht hω0
    hW hmax
  have hdegW := deg_eq_two_mul_genus_sub_two_of_isGreatest_level
    hω0 hW hmax
  have hdeg : (-W).deg < 0 := by
    rw [Divisor.deg_neg, hdegW]
    omega
  rw [riemannSpace_eq_bot_of_deg_neg hdeg] at hmem
  exact hmem

name: AclGeom.derivation_mem_riemannSpace_neg_level_sub_single
statement:
theorem derivation_mem_riemannSpace_neg_level_sub_single
    (D : Derivation k F F) (hreg : DerivationIsRegular D)
    (P₀ : Place k F) (hvan : DerivationVanishesAt D P₀)
    {t : F} (ht : t ≠ 0) {W : Divisor k F}
    (hω0 : residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) t ≠ 0)
    (hW : residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) t ∈
      weilDifferentialsAt W)
    (hmax : ∀ E, residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) t ∈
      weilDifferentialsAt E → E ≤ W) :
    D t ∈ RiemannSpace (-W - Finsupp.single P₀ 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_riemannSpace_iff]
  rcases eq_or_ne (D t) 0 with hDt | hDt
  · exact Or.inl hDt
  refine Or.inr fun Q ↦ ?_
  rw [Finsupp.sub_apply, Finsupp.neg_apply]
  rcases eq_or_ne Q P₀ with rfl | hQ
  · rw [Finsupp.single_eq_same]
    have hlocal : D t ∈ Place.orderSubmodule Q (W Q + 1) := by
      rcases le_or_gt 0 (Q.ord t) with htP | htP
      · apply order_derivation_ge_level_of_mem_of_depth D Q
          (r := 1) hvan _ hW hmax
        rw [Place.mem_toSubmodule_iff, ← Q.ord_nonneg_iff ht]
        exact htP
      · exact order_derivation_ge_level_of_ord_neg_of_depth D Q
          (r := 1) hvan ht htP hω0 hW hmax
    have := hlocal.resolve_left hDt
    omega
  · rw [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hQ]
    have hlocal : D t ∈ Q.orderSubmodule (W Q) := by
      rcases le_or_gt 0 (Q.ord t) with htQ | htQ
      · apply order_derivation_ge_level_of_mem D Q (hreg Q) _ hW hmax
        rw [Place.mem_toSubmodule_iff, ← Q.ord_nonneg_iff ht]
        exact htQ
      · exact order_derivation_ge_level_of_ord_neg D Q (hreg Q)
          ht htQ hω0 hW hmax
    have := hlocal.resolve_left hDt
    omega

name: AclGeom.derivation_apply_eq_zero_of_genus_eq_one
statement:
theorem derivation_apply_eq_zero_of_genus_eq_one
    (D : Derivation k F F) (hreg : DerivationIsRegular D)
    (hgenus : genus k F = 1) (P₀ : Place k F)
    (hvan : DerivationVanishesAt D P₀)
    {t : F} (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (hω0 : residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) t ≠ 0) :
    D t = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hmax⟩ := exists_isGreatest_level hω0
    (residueFunctional_mem_weilDifferentialsAt ht)
  have hmem := derivation_mem_riemannSpace_neg_level_sub_single
    D hreg P₀ hvan ht hω0 hW hmax
  have hdegW := deg_eq_two_mul_genus_sub_two_of_isGreatest_level
    hω0 hW hmax
  have hdeg : (-W - Finsupp.single P₀ 1).deg < 0 := by
    rw [deg_sub_single, Divisor.deg_neg, hdegW, hgenus]
    norm_num
  rw [riemannSpace_eq_bot_of_deg_neg hdeg] at hmem
  exact hmem

name: AclGeom.exists_uniformizer_add_smul_derivation_residue_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_uniformizer_add_smul_derivation_residue_ne_zero
    (D : Derivation k F F) {u : F} (hDu : D u ≠ 0)
    (P : Place k F) :
    ∃ c : k, D (P.pi + c • u) ≠ 0 ∧
      residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) (P.pi + c • u) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let badD : Set k := {c | D (P.pi + c • u) = 0}
  let badω : Set k :=
    {c | residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) (P.pi + c • u) = 0}
  have hbadDsub : badD.Subsingleton := by
    intro a ha b hb
    change D (P.pi + a • u) = 0 at ha
    change D (P.pi + b • u) = 0 at hb
    rw [map_add, Derivation.map_smul] at ha hb
    have hab : a • D u = b • D u :=
      add_left_cancel (ha.trans hb.symm)
    exact smul_left_injective k hDu hab
  have hωpi : residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) P.pi ≠ 0 :=
    residueFunctional_pi_ne_zero P
  have hbadωsub : badω.Subsingleton := by
    intro a ha b hb
    change residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) (P.pi + a • u) = 0 at ha
    change residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) (P.pi + b • u) = 0 at hb
    rw [residueFunctional_add, residueFunctional_smul] at ha hb
    rcases eq_or_ne (residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) u) 0
      with hωu | hωu
    · rw [hωu, smul_zero, add_zero] at ha
      exact (hωpi ha).elim
    · have hab : a • residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) u =
          b • residueFunctional (k := k) (F := F) u :=
        add_left_cancel (ha.trans hb.symm)
      exact smul_left_injective k hωu hab
  have hbad : (badD ∪ badω).Finite :=
    hbadDsub.finite.union hbadωsub.finite
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Infinite.exists_notMem_finset hbad.toFinset
  have hc' : c ∉ badD ∪ badω := by
    simpa only [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] using hc
  rw [Set.mem_union] at hc'
  push Not at hc'
  exact ⟨c, hc'.1, hc'.2⟩

name: AclGeom.derivation_eq_zero_of_two_le_genus
statement:
theorem derivation_eq_zero_of_two_le_genus
    (D : Derivation k F F) (hreg : DerivationIsRegular D)
    (hgenus : 2 ≤ genus k F) : D = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext u
  by_contra hDu
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (Place k F))
  obtain ⟨c, hDt, hωt⟩ :=
    exists_uniformizer_add_smul_derivation_residue_ne_zero D hDu P
  have ht : P.pi + c • u ≠ 0 := by
    intro ht
    rw [ht, map_zero] at hDt
    exact hDt rfl
  exact hDt (derivation_apply_eq_zero_of_two_le_genus D hreg hgenus
    ht hωt)

name: AclGeom.derivation_eq_zero_of_genus_eq_one
statement:
theorem derivation_eq_zero_of_genus_eq_one
    (D : Derivation k F F) (hreg : DerivationIsRegular D)
    (hgenus : genus k F = 1) (P₀ : Place k F)
    (hvan : DerivationVanishesAt D P₀) : D = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext u
  by_contra hDu
  obtain ⟨c, hDt, hωt⟩ :=
    exists_uniformizer_add_smul_derivation_residue_ne_zero D hDu P₀
  have ht : P₀.pi + c • u ≠ 0 := by
    intro ht
    rw [ht, map_zero] at hDt
    exact hDt rfl
  exact hDt (derivation_apply_eq_zero_of_genus_eq_one D hreg hgenus
    P₀ hvan ht hωt)

name: AclGeom.RationalityDescent.exists_algHom_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem exists_algHom_ne_zero {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [Algebra k R] [Algebra.FiniteType k R] {r : R} (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    ∃ φ : R →ₐ[k] k, φ r ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : IsJacobsonRing R := isJacobsonRing_of_finiteType (A := k)
  have hj : (⊥ : Ideal R).jacobson = ⊥ :=
    isJacobsonRing_iff_prime_eq.mp inferInstance ⊥ inferInstance
  have hex : ∃ M : Ideal R, M.IsMaximal ∧ r ∉ M := by
    by_contra! h
    apply hr
    have hm : r ∈ (⊥ : Ideal R).jacobson := by
      exact Ideal.mem_sInf.mpr fun M hM ↦ h M hM.2
    simpa only [hj, Ideal.mem_bot] using hm
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hrM⟩ := hex
  let : M.IsMaximal := hM
  let : Field (R ⧸ M) := Ideal.Quotient.field M
  let : Module.Finite k (R ⧸ M) := finite_of_finite_type_of_isJacobsonRing k (R ⧸ M)
  let ρ : (R ⧸ M) →ₐ[k] k := IsAlgClosed.lift
  let φ : R →ₐ[k] k := ρ.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k M)
  refine ⟨φ, fun hz ↦ hrM ?_⟩
  apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
  apply ρ.toRingHom.injective
  change ρ.toRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk M r) = 0 at hz
  exact hz.trans (map_zero ρ.toRingHom).symm

name: AclGeom.RationalityDescent.exists_tensor_specialization
statement:
private theorem exists_tensor_specialization {F R : Type*} [Field F] [Algebra k F]
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Algebra k R] [Algebra.FiniteType k R]
    (z : F ⊗[k] R) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    ∃ φ : R →ₐ[k] k,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id k F) φ z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b := Module.Free.chooseBasis k F
  let e := equivFinsuppOfBasisLeft (N := R) b
  have hex : ∃ i, e z i ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! h
    apply hz
    apply e.injective
    ext i
    simpa only [map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply] using h i
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hex
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := exists_algHom_ne_zero (k := k) hi
  refine ⟨φ, fun heq ↦ hφ ?_⟩
  have hcoord (w : F ⊗[k] R) :
      equivFinsuppOfBasisLeft b (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id k F) φ w) i =
        φ (e w i) := by
    induction w using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul f r =>
      simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, AlgHom.id_apply,
        equivFinsuppOfBasisLeft_apply_tmul_apply, e, map_smul]
    | add x y hx hy =>
      simp only [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hx, hy]
  simpa only [heq, map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply] using (hcoord z).symm

name: AclGeom.RationalityDescent.exists_finite_constant_model
statement:
private theorem exists_finite_constant_model {F K : Type*} [Field F] [Field K]
    [Algebra k F] [Algebra k K] (c : Finset K) (zs : Finset (F ⊗[k] K)) :
    ∃ R : Subalgebra k K, Algebra.FiniteType k R ∧
      (∀ a ∈ c, a ∈ R) ∧ ∀ z ∈ zs, z ∈ (baseChangeIncl F R).range
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b := Module.Free.chooseBasis k F
  let e := equivFinsuppOfBasisLeft (N := K) b
  let s : Finset K := c ∪ zs.biUnion fun z ↦ (e z).support.image (e z)
  let R := Algebra.adjoin k (s : Set K)
  have hc (a) (ha : a ∈ c) : a ∈ R :=
    Algebra.subset_adjoin (Finset.mem_union_left _ ha)
  have hz (z) (hzz : z ∈ zs) : z ∈ (baseChangeIncl F R).range := by
    apply (mem_range_baseChangeIncl_iff b R z).2
    intro i
    by_cases hi : e z i = 0
    · exact hi ▸ R.zero_mem
    · apply Algebra.subset_adjoin
      exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_biUnion.2
        ⟨z, hzz, Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨i, Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 hi, rfl⟩⟩)
  exact ⟨R, Algebra.FiniteType.adjoin_of_finite s.finite_toSet, hc, hz⟩

name: AclGeom.RationalityDescent.exists_finite_specialization
statement:
private theorem exists_finite_specialization {F K : Type*} [Field F] [Field K]
    [Algebra k F] [Algebra k K] (c : Finset K)
    (zs : Finset (FractionRing (K ⊗[k] F))) :
    let eF : F →ₐ[k] FractionRing (K ⊗[k] F)
proof:
:=
      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k (K ⊗[k] F) (FractionRing (K ⊗[k] F))).comp
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
    ∃ (S : Subalgebra k (FractionRing (K ⊗[k] F)))
      (ψ : S →ₐ[k] F),
      (∀ z ∈ zs, z ∈ S) ∧
      (∀ x : F, ∃ hx : eF x ∈ S, ψ ⟨eF x, hx⟩ = x) ∧
      ∀ a ∈ c, ∃ ha : algebraMap K (FractionRing (K ⊗[k] F)) a ∈ S,
        ψ ⟨algebraMap K (FractionRing (K ⊗[k] F)) a, ha⟩ ∈ (algebraMap k F).range := by
  classical
  let E := FractionRing (K ⊗[k] F)
  let eF : F →ₐ[k] E := (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k (K ⊗[k] F) E).comp
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := IsLocalization.exist_integer_multiples_of_finset
    (nonZeroDivisors (K ⊗[k] F)) zs
  choose n hn using fun z : zs ↦ hd z z.property
  let ys : Finset (K ⊗[k] F) := insert (d : K ⊗[k] F) (Finset.univ.image n)
  let comm := Algebra.TensorProduct.comm k K F
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hc, hy⟩ := exists_finite_constant_model c (ys.image comm)
  have := hR
  let T := F ⊗[k] R
  let χ : T →ₐ[k] K ⊗[k] F := comm.symm.toAlgHom.comp (baseChangeIncl F R)
  have hχ : Function.Injective χ := comm.symm.injective.comp (baseChangeIncl_injective R)
  have hy' (y : K ⊗[k] F) (hyz : y ∈ ys) : y ∈ χ.range := by
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hy (comm y) (Finset.mem_image_of_mem comm hyz)
    exact ⟨w, congrArg comm.symm hw |>.trans (comm.symm_apply_apply y)⟩
  obtain ⟨dR, hdR⟩ := hy' d (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
  change χ dR = (d : K ⊗[k] F) at hdR
  let ν : T →ₐ[k] E := (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k (K ⊗[k] F) E).comp χ
  have hν : Function.Injective ν :=
    (IsFractionRing.injective (K ⊗[k] F) E).comp hχ
  have hdE : ν dR ≠ 0 := by
    change algebraMap (K ⊗[k] F) E (χ dR) ≠ 0
    rw [hdR]
    simpa only [map_zero] using
      (IsFractionRing.injective (K ⊗[k] F) E).ne_iff.mpr (nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero d.property)
  have hdR0 : dR ≠ 0 := fun hz ↦ hdE (hz ▸ map_zero ν)
  let L := Localization.Away dR
  let i : L →ₐ[k] E := IsLocalization.Away.liftAlgHom dR (f := ν) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdE)
  have himap (x : T) : i (algebraMap T L x) = ν x :=
    IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq dR (g := ν.toRingHom) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdE) x
  have hi : Function.Injective i := by
    apply (IsLocalization.injective_iff_map_algebraMap_eq (Submonoid.powers dR)
      i.toRingHom).2
    intro x y
    constructor
    · intro h
      change i (algebraMap T L x) = i (algebraMap T L y)
      exact congrArg i h
    · intro h
      change i (algebraMap T L x) = i (algebraMap T L y) at h
      rw [himap, himap] at h
      exact congrArg (algebraMap T L) (hν h)
  have hinv : i (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf dR : L) = (ν dR)⁻¹ := by
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ hdE
    rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hdE]
    calc
      i (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf dR : L) * ν dR =
          i ((IsLocalization.Away.invSelf dR : L) * algebraMap T L dR) := by
            rw [map_mul, himap]
      _ = i 1 := by rw [mul_comm, IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf]
      _ = 1 := map_one i
  have hz (z : zs) : (z : E) ∈ i.range := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hy' (n z) (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image_of_mem n
      (Finset.mem_univ z)))
    change χ a = n z at ha
    refine ⟨algebraMap T L a * IsLocalization.Away.invSelf dR, ?_⟩
    rw [map_mul]
    change i (algebraMap T L a) * i (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf dR) = z
    rw [himap, hinv]
    change algebraMap (K ⊗[k] F) E (χ a) * (ν dR)⁻¹ = z
    rw [ha, hn z, Algebra.smul_def]
    change algebraMap (K ⊗[k] F) E d * (z : E) * (ν dR)⁻¹ = z
    have hvd : algebraMap (K ⊗[k] F) E d = ν dR := by
      change _ = algebraMap (K ⊗[k] F) E (χ dR)
      rw [hdR]
    rw [hvd, mul_comm (ν dR), mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hdE, mul_one]
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := exists_tensor_specialization dR hdR0
  let g : T →ₐ[k] F := (Algebra.TensorProduct.rid k k F).toAlgHom.comp
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id k F) φ)
  have hgd : g dR ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hφ
    apply (Algebra.TensorProduct.rid k k F).injective
    change (Algebra.TensorProduct.rid k k F)
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id k F) φ dR) = 0 at h
    simpa only [map_zero] using h
  let f : L →ₐ[k] F := IsLocalization.Away.liftAlgHom dR (f := g) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hgd)
  have hfmap (x : T) : f (algebraMap T L x) = g x :=
    IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq dR (g := g.toRingHom) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hgd) x
  let e := AlgEquiv.ofInjective i hi
  let ψ : i.range →ₐ[k] F := f.comp e.symm.toAlgHom
  have hψ (w : L) : ψ (e w) = f w := by
    change f (e.symm (e w)) = f w
    rw [e.symm_apply_apply]
  refine ⟨i.range, ψ, fun z hz' ↦ hz ⟨z, hz'⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    let w : L := algebraMap T L (x ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : R))
    have hw : i w = eF x := by
      rw [himap]
      change algebraMap (K ⊗[k] F) E
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.comm k K F).symm (baseChangeIncl F R (x ⊗ₜ[k] 1))) =
          algebraMap (K ⊗[k] F) E (1 ⊗ₜ[k] x)
      rw [baseChangeIncl_tmul, Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_symm,
        Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul]
      rfl
    refine ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, ?_⟩
    have hs : (⟨eF x, ⟨w, hw⟩⟩ : i.range) = e w := Subtype.ext hw.symm
    rw [hs, hψ, hfmap]
    change (Algebra.TensorProduct.rid k k F)
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id k F) φ (x ⊗ₜ[k] 1)) = x
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul]
    simp only [AlgHom.id_apply, map_one, Algebra.TensorProduct.rid_tmul, one_smul]
  · intro a ha
    let r : R := ⟨a, hc a ha⟩
    let w : L := algebraMap T L ((1 : F) ⊗ₜ[k] r)
    have hw : i w = algebraMap K E a := by
      rw [himap]
      change algebraMap (K ⊗[k] F) E
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.comm k K F).symm (baseChangeIncl F R (1 ⊗ₜ[k] r))) =
          algebraMap (K ⊗[k] F) E (a ⊗ₜ[k] 1)
      rw [baseChangeIncl_tmul, Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_symm,
        Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul]
    refine ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, φ r, ?_⟩
    have hs : (⟨algebraMap K E a, ⟨w, hw⟩⟩ : i.range) = e w := Subtype.ext hw.symm
    rw [hs, hψ, hfmap]
    change algebraMap k F (φ r) = (Algebra.TensorProduct.rid k k F)
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id k F) φ (1 ⊗ₜ[k] r))
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, AlgHom.id_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.rid_tmul]
    simp only [Algebra.smul_def, mul_one]

name: AclGeom.RationalityDescent.exists_generator_of_tensor_generator
statement:
theorem exists_generator_of_tensor_generator {F K : Type*} [Field F] [Field K]
    [Algebra k F] [Algebra k K] [IsFunctionFieldOneVar k F]
    (h : ∃ u : FractionRing (K ⊗[k] F), Transcendental K u ∧
      IntermediateField.adjoin K ({u} : Set (FractionRing (K ⊗[k] F))) = ⊤) :
    ∃ t : F, Transcendental k t ∧ IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let E := FractionRing (K ⊗[k] F)
  let eF : F →ₐ[k] E := (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k (K ⊗[k] F) E).comp
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hfin⟩ := IsFunctionFieldOneVar.exists_transcendental_finite (k := k) (F := F)
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType k (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({x} : Set F)) :=
    IntermediateField.essFiniteType_iff.2
      (IntermediateField.fg_adjoin_of_finite (Set.finite_singleton x))
  have := hfin
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({x} : Set F)) F := inferInstance
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType k F :=
    Algebra.EssFiniteType.comp k (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({x} : Set F)) F
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := IntermediateField.fg_top k F
  obtain ⟨u, _, hu⟩ := h
  have hrat (a : F) : ∃ p q : K[X], Polynomial.aeval u q ≠ 0 ∧
      eF a = Polynomial.aeval u p / Polynomial.aeval u q := by
    by_cases ha : a = 0
    · exact ⟨0, 1, by simp, by simp [ha]⟩
    obtain ⟨p, q, hpq⟩ := (IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_iff K (eF a)).1
      (by rw [hu]; trivial)
    have hq : Polynomial.aeval u q ≠ 0 := by
      intro hq
      rw [hq, div_zero] at hpq
      apply ha
      apply eF.toRingHom.injective
      change eF a = eF 0
      simpa only [map_zero] using hpq
    exact ⟨p, q, hq, hpq⟩
  choose p q hq hpq using fun a : s ↦ hrat a
  let c : Finset K := Finset.univ.biUnion fun a : s ↦ (p a).coeffs ∪ (q a).coeffs
  let zs : Finset E := insert u (Finset.univ.image fun a : s ↦ (Polynomial.aeval u (q a))⁻¹)
  obtain ⟨S, ψ, hz, hF, hC⟩ := exists_finite_specialization c zs
  have huS : u ∈ S := hz u (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
  let uS : S := ⟨u, huS⟩
  let t : F := ψ uS
  let D := IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)
  let B : Subalgebra k E := (D.toSubalgebra.comap ψ).map S.val
  have hB {z : E} (hzS : z ∈ S) : z ∈ B ↔ ψ ⟨z, hzS⟩ ∈ D := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨w, hw, heq⟩
      change ψ w ∈ D at hw
      have hwz : w = ⟨z, hzS⟩ := Subtype.ext heq
      simpa only [hwz] using hw
    · intro hw
      exact ⟨⟨z, hzS⟩, hw, rfl⟩
  have hBS : B ≤ S := by
    rintro z ⟨w, _, rfl⟩
    exact w.property
  have huB : u ∈ B := (hB huS).2 (IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ rfl)
  have hcB (a : K) (ha : a ∈ c) : algebraMap K E a ∈ B := by
    obtain ⟨haS, haψ⟩ := hC a ha
    apply (hB haS).2
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := haψ
    rw [← hb]
    exact D.algebraMap_mem b
  have heval (p : K[X]) (hp : p.coeffs ⊆ c) : Polynomial.aeval u p ∈ B := by
    rw [Polynomial.aeval_eq_sum_range]
    apply B.sum_mem
    intro j _
    rw [Algebra.smul_def]
    apply B.mul_mem ?_ (B.pow_mem huB j)
    by_cases hj : p.coeff j = 0
    · rw [hj, map_zero]
      exact B.zero_mem
    · exact hcB _ (hp (Polynomial.coeff_mem_coeffs hj))
  have hgens (a : s) : (a : F) ∈ D := by
    have hpB : Polynomial.aeval u (p a) ∈ B := heval _ fun b hb ↦
      Finset.mem_biUnion.2 ⟨a, Finset.mem_univ a, Finset.mem_union_left _ hb⟩
    have hqB : Polynomial.aeval u (q a) ∈ B := heval _ fun b hb ↦
      Finset.mem_biUnion.2 ⟨a, Finset.mem_univ a, Finset.mem_union_right _ hb⟩
    have hqS : Polynomial.aeval u (q a) ∈ S := hBS hqB
    have hqiS : (Polynomial.aeval u (q a))⁻¹ ∈ S := hz _
      (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ a)))
    let qS : S := ⟨Polynomial.aeval u (q a), hqS⟩
    let qiS : S := ⟨(Polynomial.aeval u (q a))⁻¹, hqiS⟩
    have hprod : qiS * qS = 1 := Subtype.ext (inv_mul_cancel₀ (hq a))
    have hψprod : ψ qiS * ψ qS = 1 := by
      rw [← map_mul ψ, hprod, map_one ψ]
    have hψq : ψ qS ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      rw [hzero, mul_zero] at hψprod
      exact zero_ne_one hψprod
    have hψqi : ψ qiS = (ψ qS)⁻¹ := (mul_eq_one_iff_eq_inv₀ hψq).1 hψprod
    have hqiB : (Polynomial.aeval u (q a))⁻¹ ∈ B := by
      apply (hB hqiS).2
      change ψ qiS ∈ D
      rw [hψqi]
      exact D.inv_mem ((hB hqS).1 hqB)
    have haB : eF (a : F) ∈ B := by
      rw [hpq a, div_eq_mul_inv]
      exact B.mul_mem hpB hqiB
    obtain ⟨haS, hψa⟩ := hF (a : F)
    have haD := (hB haS).1 haB
    rw [hψa] at haD
    exact haD
  have htop : D = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    rw [← hs]
    apply IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff.2
    intro a ha
    exact hgens ⟨a, ha⟩
  refine ⟨t, ?_, htop⟩
  intro ht
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic k D := IntermediateField.isAlgebraic_adjoin_simple ht.isIntegral
  have hbot : D = ⊥ := IntermediateField.eq_bot_of_isAlgClosed_of_isAlgebraic D
  have hxbot : x ∈ (⊥ : IntermediateField k F) := by
    rw [← hbot, htop]
    trivial
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (IntermediateField.mem_bot).1 hxbot
  apply hx
  rw [← hb]
  exact isAlgebraic_algebraMap b

name: AclGeom.RationalityDescent.genus_eq_zero_of_tensor
statement:
theorem genus_eq_zero_of_tensor {F K : Type*} [Field F] [Field K]
    [Algebra k F] [Algebra k K] [IsFunctionFieldOneVar k F] [IsAlgClosed K]
    [IsFunctionFieldOneVar K (FractionRing (K ⊗[k] F))]
    (h : genus K (FractionRing (K ⊗[k] F)) = 0) : genus k F = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply genus_eq_zero_iff_exists_generator.2
  exact exists_generator_of_tensor_generator (genus_eq_zero_iff_exists_generator.1 h)

name: AclGeom.mem_riemannSpace_iff
statement:
theorem mem_riemannSpace_iff {D : Divisor k F} {f : F} :
    f ∈ RiemannSpace D ↔
      f = 0 ∨ ∀ P : Place k F, -(D P) ≤ P.ord f
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: AclGeom.zero_mem_riemannSpace
statement:
theorem zero_mem_riemannSpace (D : Divisor k F) :
    (0 : F) ∈ RiemannSpace D
proof: := Or.inl rfl

name: AclGeom.riemannSpace_mono
statement:
theorem riemannSpace_mono {D E : Divisor k F} (h : D ≤ E) :
    RiemannSpace D ≤ RiemannSpace E
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf
  rcases hf with rfl | hf
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  refine Or.inr fun P ↦ le_trans ?_ (hf P)
  have h1 : D P ≤ E P := h P
  omega

name: AclGeom.algebraMap_mem_riemannSpace
statement:
theorem algebraMap_mem_riemannSpace {D : Divisor k F} (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (c : k) : algebraMap k F c ∈ RiemannSpace D
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne c 0 with rfl | hc0
  · rw [map_zero]
    exact Or.inl rfl
  refine Or.inr fun P ↦ ?_
  rw [Place.ord_algebraMap P hc0]
  have h1 : (0 : ℤ) ≤ D P := hD P
  omega

name: AclGeom.ord_pos_of_mem_riemannSpace
proof:
:= by
  rcases hf with rfl | hf
  · exact absurd rfl hf0
  have h1 := hf P
  omega

name: AclGeom.sub_single_le
statement:
theorem sub_single_le (D : Divisor k F) (P : Place k F) :
    D - Finsupp.single P 1 ≤ D
proof:
:= by
  intro Q
  rcases eq_or_ne Q P with rfl | hQ
  · simp only [Finsupp.sub_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same]
    omega
  · simp [Finsupp.sub_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hQ]

name: AclGeom.riemannSpace_eq_or_eq_sup
statement:
theorem riemannSpace_eq_or_eq_sup (D : Divisor k F) (P : Place k F) :
    RiemannSpace D = RiemannSpace (D - Finsupp.single P 1) ∨
    ∃ f₀ : F, f₀ ∈ RiemannSpace D ∧
      RiemannSpace D =
        RiemannSpace (D - Finsupp.single P 1) ⊔
          Submodule.span k {f₀}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hD'P : (D - Finsupp.single P 1 : Divisor k F) P = D P - 1 := by
    simp only [Finsupp.sub_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same]
  have hD'Q : ∀ Q : Place k F, Q ≠ P →
      (D - Finsupp.single P 1 : Divisor k F) Q = D Q := by
    intro Q hQ
    simp [Finsupp.sub_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hQ]
  by_cases hex : ∃ f₀ ∈ RiemannSpace D,
      f₀ ∉ RiemannSpace (D - Finsupp.single P 1)
  case neg =>
    left
    push Not at hex
    exact le_antisymm (fun f hf ↦ hex f hf)
      (riemannSpace_mono (sub_single_le D P))
  case pos =>
    right
    obtain ⟨f₀, hf₀D, hf₀D'⟩ := hex
    refine ⟨f₀, hf₀D, ?_⟩
