name: AclGeom.basisEquiv_X
statement:
private theorem basisEquiv_X (s : Finset C) (hs : AlgebraicIndependent k ((↑) : s → C))
    (j : s) : basisEquiv s hs
      (algebraMap (MvPolynomial s k) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial s k)) (X j)) =
      ⟨j, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ j.2⟩
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change ((hs.aevalEquivField
      (algebraMap (MvPolynomial s k) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial s k)) (X j)) :
    IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range ((↑) : s → C))) : C) = j
  rw [hs.aevalEquivField_algebraMap_apply_coe, aeval_X]

name: AclGeom.basisDerivation_apply
statement:
private theorem basisDerivation_apply (s : Finset C)
    (hs : AlgebraicIndependent k ((↑) : s → C))
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k (s : Set C)) C] (i j : s) :
    basisDerivation s hs i (j : C) = algebraMap (IntermediateField.adjoin k (s : Set C)) C
      (basisEquiv s hs (ratDerivation i
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial s k) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial s k)) (X j))))
proof:
:= by
  have hj : (j : C) = algebraMap (IntermediateField.adjoin k (s : Set C)) C
      ⟨j, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ j.2⟩ := rfl
  rw [hj, basisDerivation, Derivation.extendOfFormallyEtale_algebraMap]
  change algebraMap (IntermediateField.adjoin k (s : Set C)) C
    ((ratDerivation i).transport (basisEquiv s hs) ⟨j, _⟩) = _
  rw [Derivation.transport_apply, ← basisEquiv_X s hs j, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: AclGeom.basisDerivation_apply_self
statement:
private theorem basisDerivation_apply_self (s : Finset C)
    (hs : AlgebraicIndependent k ((↑) : s → C))
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k (s : Set C)) C] (i : s) :
    basisDerivation s hs i (i : C) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [basisDerivation_apply, ratDerivation_X_self, map_one, map_one]

name: AclGeom.basisDerivation_apply_of_ne
statement:
private theorem basisDerivation_apply_of_ne (s : Finset C)
    (hs : AlgebraicIndependent k ((↑) : s → C))
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k (s : Set C)) C] {i j : s} (h : i ≠ j) :
    basisDerivation s hs i (j : C) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [basisDerivation_apply, ratDerivation_X_of_ne h, map_zero, map_zero]

name: AclGeom.exists_derivations_dual
statement:
private theorem exists_derivations_dual [PerfectField k] [Algebra.EssFiniteType k C]
    (h : 2 ≤ Algebra.trdeg k C) :
    ∃ (a b : C) (D₀ D₁ : Derivation k C C), D₀ a = 1 ∧ D₀ b = 0 ∧ D₁ a = 0 ∧ D₁ b = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs, _⟩ := exists_isTranscendenceBasis_and_isSeparable_of_perfectField k C
  have h2 : (2 : Cardinal) ≤ (s.card : Cardinal) := by
    rw [← Cardinal.mk_coe_finset, hs.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg]
    exact h
  have hcard : 1 < s.card := by
    have : 2 ≤ s.card := by exact_mod_cast h2
    omega
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.1 hcard
  have hne : (⟨a, ha⟩ : s) ≠ ⟨b, hb⟩ := fun e ↦ hab (congrArg Subtype.val e)
  refine ⟨a, b, basisDerivation s hs.1 ⟨a, ha⟩, basisDerivation s hs.1 ⟨b, hb⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact basisDerivation_apply_self s hs.1 ⟨a, ha⟩
  · exact basisDerivation_apply_of_ne s hs.1 (i := ⟨a, ha⟩) (j := ⟨b, hb⟩) hne
  · exact basisDerivation_apply_of_ne s hs.1 (i := ⟨b, hb⟩) (j := ⟨a, ha⟩) hne.symm
  · exact basisDerivation_apply_self s hs.1 ⟨b, hb⟩

name: AclGeom.exists_linearIndependent_derivations
statement:
theorem exists_linearIndependent_derivations [PerfectField k] [Algebra.EssFiniteType k C]
    (h : 2 ≤ Algebra.trdeg k C) : ∃ D : Fin 2 → Derivation k C C, LinearIndependent C D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, D₀, D₁, h₀a, h₀b, h₁a, h₁b⟩ := exists_derivations_dual h
  refine ⟨![D₀, D₁], LinearIndependent.pair_iff.2 fun c d hcd ↦ ?_⟩
  have ha := congrArg (fun D : Derivation k C C ↦ D a) hcd
  have hb := congrArg (fun D : Derivation k C C ↦ D b) hcd
  simp only [Derivation.add_apply, Derivation.smul_apply, Derivation.zero_apply, h₀a, h₁a, h₀b,
    h₁b, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add] at ha hb
  exact ⟨ha, hb⟩

name: AclGeom.RegularAffineModel.exists_model
statement:
theorem exists_model
    (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (hker : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
      ModObj.pointAct V q = 𝟙 V → q = 1)
    (hdimG : (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDim G.toAlgebraicGroup.carrier)
    (hdimV : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1)
    (N : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k) (i : N.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom G.toAlgebraicGroup)
    [IsMonHom.Normal i.hom.hom] [IsClosedImmersion i.hom.hom.left]
    (hdimN : topologicalKrullDim N.toAlgebraicGroup.carrier = 1) :
    ∃ t : V.left.functionField, Transcendental k t ∧
      IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set V.left.functionField) = ⊤ ∧
    ∃ f : G.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k),
      Function.Injective (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X ↦
        q ≫ f.hom.hom) ∧ IsFinite f.hom.hom.left ∧ Surjective f.hom.hom.left ∧
      (∀ q, (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V q).unop t =
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField
          ((AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom)).multiplier : k) * t +
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField
          (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom)).shift) ∧
      (∀ (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
        (q r : (Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X)
        (c a : Cˣ) (d b : C),
        q ≫ f.hom.hom = AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k c d →
        r ≫ f.hom.hom = AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k a b →
        (q * r) ≫ f.hom.hom =
          AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k (c * a) ((c : C) * b + d)) ∧
    ∃ (χ : G.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom (multiplicativeGroup k))
      (β : N.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1)),
      Surjective χ.hom.hom.left ∧
      χ.hom.hom = f.hom.hom ≫ AffineDilation.projection k ∧
      IsFinite β.hom.hom.left ∧ Surjective β.hom.hom.left ∧
      Function.Injective (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ N.toGroupScheme.X ↦
        q ≫ β.hom.hom) ∧
      β.hom.hom ≫ AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k = i.hom.hom ≫ f.hom.hom ∧
    ∃ ψ : G.toGroupScheme.X ⊗ N.toGroupScheme.X ⟶ N.toGroupScheme.X,
      ψ ≫ i.hom.hom = G.toGroupScheme.X ◁ i.hom.hom ≫ conj G.toGroupScheme.X ∧
      ψ ≫ β.hom.hom = lift
        (fst G.toGroupScheme.X N.toGroupScheme.X ≫ χ.hom.hom)
        (snd G.toGroupScheme.X N.toGroupScheme.X ≫ β.hom.hom) ≫
          AdditiveRigidity.scalarMul k ∧
      (∀ (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
        (q : (Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X)
        (n : (Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ N.toGroupScheme.X)
        (a : Cˣ) (b : C),
        q ≫ χ.hom.hom = AdditiveRigidity.unitPoint k a →
        n ≫ β.hom.hom = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k b →
        (lift q n ≫ ψ) ≫ β.hom.hom =
          AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k ((a : C) * b)) ∧
    ∃ (U T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (j : U ⟶ V)
      (jLine : T ⟶ (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X)
      (e : U ≅ T) (g : (Spec V.left.functionField).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ U),
      IsOpenImmersion j.left ∧ IsOpenImmersion jLine.left ∧
      Nonempty U.left ∧ Nonempty T.left ∧
      g ≫ j = SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter V ∧
      g ≫ e.hom ≫ jLine = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k t ∧
    ∃ (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (jD : D ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X ⊗ V)
      (s z : D ⟶ U), IsOpenImmersion jD.left ∧ Nonempty D.left ∧
      s ≫ j = jD ≫ snd G.toGroupScheme.X V ∧
      z ≫ j = jD ≫ γ[G.toGroupScheme.X, V] ∧
      z ≫ e.hom ≫ jLine = lift (jD ≫ fst G.toGroupScheme.X V ≫ f.hom.hom)
        (s ≫ e.hom ≫ jLine) ≫ AffineSchemeAction.smul k ∧
      ∀ (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
        (p : (Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ D) (a : Cˣ) (b c : C),
        p ≫ jD ≫ fst G.toGroupScheme.X V ≫ f.hom.hom =
          AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k a b →
        p ≫ s ≫ e.hom ≫ jLine = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k c →
        p ≫ z ≫ e.hom ≫ jLine = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k ((a : C) * c + b)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htop, Φ, _, hΦ, f, hfinj, hpoint,
    V₀, jV, x, gV, hjV, _, hgjV, hgx, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _,
    V₁, T₁, j₁, jLine, eV, g₁, hj₁, hjLine, hV₁, hT₁, _, _, hcoord, hgj₁,
    D₁, i₁, s₁, z₁, hi₁, hD₁, hs₁, hz₁, hact₁,
    U, T, jU, jT, π, hjU, hjT, _, hT, hπfin, hπsurj, hsq, _⟩ :=
    SchemeAffineCurveCover.exists_curve_coordinate_cover G V hker hdimG hdimV
  have hglobal := @GroupFinite.finite_surjective k _ _ G.toAlgebraicGroup
    (AffineGroupScheme.connectedAlgebraicGroup k) f hfinj U T jU jT π
      hjU hjT hT hπfin hπsurj hsq
  have : IsFinite f.hom.hom.left := hglobal.1
  have : Surjective f.hom.hom.left := hglobal.2
  obtain ⟨β, hβfin, hβsurj, hβinj, hβfactor⟩ :=
    NormalTranslation.exists_finite_isogeny G.toAlgebraicGroup N i hdimN f hfinj
  obtain ⟨χ, hχsurj, hχ, ψ, hψ, hβconj, hconjC⟩ :=
    NormalCoordinateConjugation.exists_character G.toAlgebraicGroup N.toAlgebraicGroup
      i f β hβfactor
  have hj : IsOpenImmersion (j₁ ≫ jV).left := by
    have := hj₁
    have := hjV
    change IsOpenImmersion (j₁.left ≫ jV.left)
    infer_instance
  have hgj : g₁ ≫ (j₁ ≫ jV) = SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter V := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, hgj₁, hgjV]
  have hgt : g₁ ≫ eV.hom ≫ jLine = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k t := by
    rw [← hcoord, ← Category.assoc, hgj₁, hgx]
  have hact : z₁ ≫ eV.hom ≫ jLine =
      lift (i₁ ≫ fst G.toGroupScheme.X V ≫ f.hom.hom)
        (s₁ ≫ eV.hom ≫ jLine) ≫ AffineSchemeAction.smul k := by
    rw [← hcoord]
    exact hact₁
  refine ⟨t, ht, htop, f, hfinj, hglobal.1, hglobal.2, ?_, ?_,
    χ, β, hχsurj, hχ, hβfin, hβsurj, hβinj, hβfactor, ψ, hψ, hβconj, hconjC,
    V₁, T₁, j₁ ≫ jV, jLine, eV, g₁, hj, hjLine, hV₁, hT₁, hgj, hgt,
    D₁, i₁, s₁, z₁, hi₁, hD₁, hs₁, hz₁, hact, ?_⟩
  · intro q
    simpa only [hpoint] using hΦ q
  · intro C _ _ q r c a d b hq hr
    rw [MonObj.mul_comp, hq, hr, AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint_mul]
  · intro C _ _ p a b c hq hc
    rw [hact, comp_lift_assoc, hq, hc,
      AffineSchemeAction.lift_groupPoint_linePoint_smul]

name: AclGeom.idealOf_eq_comap_rename
statement:
theorem idealOf_eq_comap_rename {ι κ : Type*} {a : ι → Ω} {b : κ → Ω} {g : κ → ι}
    (h : a ∘ g = b) :
    idealOf k b =
      (idealOf k a).comap (rename g : MvPolynomial κ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial ι k)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  ext p
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, mem_idealOf_iff, mem_idealOf_iff, aeval_rename]

name: AclGeom.locusCoordinateRingEquiv_comp_quotientMapₐ
statement:
theorem locusCoordinateRingEquiv_comp_quotientMapₐ {ι κ : Type*} {a : ι → Ω} {b : κ → Ω}
    {g : κ → ι} (h : a ∘ g = b) :
    (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (k := k) a).toAlgHom.comp
        (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k a) (rename g) (idealOf_eq_comap_rename h).le) =
      (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono (s := Set.range b) (t := Set.range a)
          (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun i ↦ ⟨g i, congrFun h i⟩))).comp
        (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (k := k) b).toAlgHom
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  refine Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext k (MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun i ↦ Subtype.ext ?_)
  simp [Ideal.quotient_map_mkₐ]

name: AclGeom.exists_tensorProduct_algEquiv
statement:
private theorem exists_tensorProduct_algEquiv {k R S T R' S' T' : Type*} [CommRing k]
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T] [Algebra R S] [Algebra R T]
    [CommRing R'] [CommRing S'] [CommRing T'] [Algebra R' S'] [Algebra R' T']
    [Algebra k S] [Algebra k S'] [SMulCommClass R k S] [SMulCommClass R' k S']
    (eR : R ≃+* R') (eS : S ≃ₐ[k] S') (eT : T ≃+* T')
    (hS : ∀ r, eS (algebraMap R S r) = algebraMap R' S' (eR r))
    (hT : ∀ r, eT (algebraMap R T r) = algebraMap R' T' (eR r)) :
    ∃ Φ : S ⊗[R] T ≃ₐ[k] S' ⊗[R'] T', (∀ s t, Φ (s ⊗ₜ t) = eS s ⊗ₜ eT t) ∧
      ∀ r, Φ (algebraMap R (S ⊗[R] T) r) = algebraMap R' (S' ⊗[R'] T') (eR r)
proof:
:= by
  have hS' (r : R') : eS.symm (algebraMap R' S' r) = algebraMap R S (eR.symm r) := by
    rw [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_eq, hS, eR.apply_symm_apply]
  have hT' (r : R') : eT.symm (algebraMap R' T' r) = algebraMap R T (eR.symm r) := by
    rw [eT.symm_apply_eq, hT, eR.apply_symm_apply]
  let f := Algebra.TensorProduct.mapRingHom (eR : R →+* R') (eS : S →+* S') (eT : T →+* T')
    (RingHom.ext hS) (RingHom.ext hT)
  let g := Algebra.TensorProduct.mapRingHom (eR.symm : R' →+* R) (eS.symm : S' →+* S)
    (eT.symm : T' →+* T) (RingHom.ext hS') (RingHom.ext hT')
  have hf (s : S) (t : T) : f (s ⊗ₜ t) = eS s ⊗ₜ eT t :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.mapRingHom_tmul _ _ _ _ _ s t
  have hg (s : S') (t : T') : g (s ⊗ₜ t) = eS.symm s ⊗ₜ eT.symm t :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.mapRingHom_tmul _ _ _ _ _ s t
  have hfg : f.comp g = RingHom.id _ := RingHom.ext fun w ↦ by
    induction w using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul s t =>
      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, hg, hf, eS.apply_symm_apply, eT.apply_symm_apply, RingHom.id_apply]
    | add w₁ w₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [map_add, map_add, h₁, h₂]
  have hgf : g.comp f = RingHom.id _ := RingHom.ext fun w ↦ by
    induction w using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul s t =>
      rw [RingHom.comp_apply, hf, hg, eS.symm_apply_apply, eT.symm_apply_apply, RingHom.id_apply]
    | add w₁ w₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [map_add, map_add, h₁, h₂]
  refine ⟨AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := RingEquiv.ofRingHom f g hfg hgf) fun c ↦ ?_, hf,
    fun r ↦ ?_⟩
  · change f (algebraMap k S c ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : T)) = algebraMap k S' c ⊗ₜ[R'] (1 : T')
    rw [hf, map_one, AlgEquiv.commutes]
  · change f (algebraMap R S r ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : T)) = algebraMap R' S' (eR r) ⊗ₜ[R'] (1 : T')
    rw [hf, map_one, hS]

name: AclGeom.exists_locusQuotientTensor_algEquiv
statement:
theorem exists_locusQuotientTensor_algEquiv :
    letI : Algebra 𝒜 ℬ
proof:
:= (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim x y)) (rename Sum.inr)
      (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim x y) (b := y) (g := Sum.inr)
        rfl).le).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra 𝒜 𝒞 := (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim y z)) (rename Sum.inl)
      (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim y z) (b := y) (g := Sum.inl)
        rfl).le).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra 𝔄 𝔅 := (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono
      (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right))).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra 𝔄 ℭ := (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono
      (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left))).toAlgebra
    haveI : IsScalarTower k 𝒜 ℬ := .of_algHom _
    haveI : IsScalarTower k 𝔄 𝔅 := .of_algHom _
    ∃ Φ : ℬ ⊗[𝒜] 𝒞 ≃ₐ[k] 𝔅 ⊗[𝔄] ℭ,
      (∀ (a : ℬ) (b : 𝒞), Φ (a ⊗ₜ b) =
        locusCoordinateRingEquiv (Sum.elim x y) a ⊗ₜ locusCoordinateRingEquiv (Sum.elim y z) b) ∧
      ∀ q : 𝒜, Φ (algebraMap 𝒜 (ℬ ⊗[𝒜] 𝒞) q) =
        algebraMap 𝔄 (𝔅 ⊗[𝔄] ℭ) (locusCoordinateRingEquiv y q) := by
  
  let _ : Algebra 𝒜 ℬ := (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim x y)) (rename Sum.inr)
    (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim x y) (b := y) (g := Sum.inr)
      rfl).le).toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝒜 𝒞 := (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim y z)) (rename Sum.inl)
    (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim y z) (b := y) (g := Sum.inl)
      rfl).le).toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝔄 𝔅 := (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono
    (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right))).toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝔄 ℭ := (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono
    (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left))).toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower k 𝒜 ℬ := .of_algHom _
  have : IsScalarTower k 𝔄 𝔅 := .of_algHom _
  exact exists_tensorProduct_algEquiv (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (k := k) y).toRingEquiv
    (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (k := k) (Sum.elim x y))
    (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (k := k) (Sum.elim y z)).toRingEquiv
    (AlgHom.congr_fun (locusCoordinateRingEquiv_comp_quotientMapₐ (k := k) (a := Sum.elim x y)
      (b := y) (g := Sum.inr) rfl))
    (AlgHom.congr_fun (locusCoordinateRingEquiv_comp_quotientMapₐ (k := k) (a := Sum.elim y z)
      (b := y) (g := Sum.inl) rfl))

name: AclGeom.CurveAffineCoordinate.exists_partial_coordinate
statement:
theorem exists_partial_coordinate (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left]
    (t : V.left.functionField) :
    ∃ P : V.left.PartialMap (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).carrier,
      P.hom ≫ (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).structureMap = P.domain.ι ≫ V.hom ∧
      P.fromFunctionField = (AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k t).left
proof:
:= by
  let L := (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X
  have h : (AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k t).left ≫ L.hom =
      V.left.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint V.left) ≫ V.hom :=
    (Over.w (AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k t)).trans
      (Over.w (SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter V)).symm
  let P := Scheme.PartialMap.ofFromSpecStalk V.hom L.hom
    (AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k t).left h
  exact ⟨P, Scheme.PartialMap.ofFromSpecStalk_comp _ _ _ _,
    Scheme.PartialMap.fromSpecStalkOfMem_ofFromSpecStalk _ _ _ _⟩

name: AclGeom.CurveAffineCoordinate.linePoint_comp_pointAct
statement:
theorem linePoint_comp_pointAct {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
    (a : kˣ) (b : k) (x : C) :
    AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k x ≫
      ModObj.pointAct (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X
        ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k a b) =
    AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (algebraMap k C (a : k) * x + algebraMap k C b)
proof:
:= by
  change AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k x ≫ ((toUnit _ ≫ _) • 𝟙 _) = _
  rw [ModObj.comp_smul, Category.comp_id, ← Category.assoc, comp_toUnit]
  have hgroup : toUnit ((Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k))) ≫
      ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k a b) =
      AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k (Units.map (algebraMap k C) a) (algebraMap k C b) := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k C)) ≫
        (𝟙 _ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineGroupScheme.eval k a b).toRingHom)) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (AffineGroupScheme.eval k (Units.map (algebraMap k C) a) (algebraMap k C b)).toRingHom)
    rw [Category.id_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
    apply congrArg Spec.map
    apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
    exact congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom (show
      (Algebra.ofId k C).comp (AffineGroupScheme.eval k a b) =
        AffineGroupScheme.eval k (Units.map (algebraMap k C) a) (algebraMap k C b) by
      apply AffineGroupScheme.hom_ext <;> simp)
  rw [hgroup]
  exact AffineSchemeAction.lift_groupPoint_linePoint_smul k _ _ _

name: AclGeom.CurveAffineCoordinate.AclGeom.CurveAffineCoordinate.equivariance_on_pullback
statement:
theorem equivariance_on_pullback
    (V U : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left]
    (j : U ⟶ V) [IsOpenImmersion j.left]
    (x : U ⟶ (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X)
    (t : V.left.functionField)
    (g : (Spec V.left.functionField).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ U)
    (hgj : g ≫ j = SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter V)
    (hgx : g ≫ x = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k t)
    (e : V ≅ V) (a : kˣ) (b : k)
    (hfield : ActionFunctionField.algEquivOfIso e t =
      algebraMap k V.left.functionField (a : k) * t + algebraMap k V.left.functionField b) :
    Nonempty (pullback (j ≫ e.hom) j).left ∧
      pullback.snd (j ≫ e.hom) j ≫ x =
        pullback.fst (j ≫ e.hom) j ≫ x ≫
          ModObj.pointAct (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X
            ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k a b)
proof:
:= by
  let σ := ActionFunctionField.algEquivOfIso e
  let δ : (Spec V.left.functionField).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶
      (Spec V.left.functionField).asOver (Spec (.of k)) :=
    (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom σ.toAlgHom).op
  have hnat : SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter V ≫ e.hom =
      δ ≫ SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter V := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    exact (Scheme.Hom.fromFunctionField_toPartialMap e.hom.left).symm.trans
      (Scheme.PartialMap.fromFunctionField_eq_functionFieldMorphismOfHom e.hom.left.toPartialMap)
  have hsq : g ≫ (j ≫ e.hom) = (δ ≫ g) ≫ j := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, hgj, hnat, Category.assoc, hgj]
  let D := pullback (j ≫ e.hom) j
  let l : (Spec V.left.functionField).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ D :=
    pullback.lift g (δ ≫ g) hsq
  have hD : Nonempty D.left := ⟨l.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint V.left.functionField)⟩
  have hpb := (IsPullback.of_hasPullback (j ≫ e.hom) j).map (Over.forget _)
  have : IsOpenImmersion (pullback.fst (j ≫ e.hom) j).left :=
    MorphismProperty.of_isPullback hpb.flip (inferInstance : IsOpenImmersion j.left)
  have : IsOpenImmersion ((pullback.fst (j ≫ e.hom) j) ≫ j).left := by
    change IsOpenImmersion ((pullback.fst (j ≫ e.hom) j).left ≫ j.left)
    infer_instance
  have : IsReduced D.left :=
    isReduced_of_isOpenImmersion ((pullback.fst (j ≫ e.hom) j) ≫ j).left
  have hl : l ≫ (pullback.fst (j ≫ e.hom) j ≫ j) =
      SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter V := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, pullback.lift_fst, hgj]
  have : IsDominant (l.left ≫ (pullback.fst (j ≫ e.hom) j ≫ j).left) := by
    rw [← Over.comp_left, hl]
    exact Scheme.isDominant_fromSpecStalk_genericPoint
  have : IsDominant l.left := IsDominant.of_comp_of_isOpenImmersion l.left
    ((pullback.fst (j ≫ e.hom) j) ≫ j).left
  refine ⟨hD, ?_⟩
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  apply ext_of_isDominant_of_isSeparated
    (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).structureMap
    ((Over.w _).trans (Over.w _).symm) l.left
  change (l ≫ (pullback.snd (j ≫ e.hom) j ≫ x)).left =
    (l ≫ (pullback.fst (j ≫ e.hom) j ≫ x ≫ _)).left
  rw [← Category.assoc l, pullback.lift_snd, Category.assoc, hgx,
    ← Category.assoc l, pullback.lift_fst, ← Category.assoc g, hgx]
  rw [linePoint_comp_pointAct]
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom σ.toRingHom) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval t).toRingHom) =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval
      (algebraMap k V.left.functionField (a : k) * t +
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField b)).toRingHom)
  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
  apply congrArg Spec.map
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  exact congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom (show
    σ.toAlgHom.comp (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval t) =
      AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (algebraMap k V.left.functionField (a : k) * t +
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField b) by
    apply AffineSchemeAction.lineHom_ext
    rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AffineSchemeAction.lineEval_lineCoordinate,
      AffineSchemeAction.lineEval_lineCoordinate]
    exact hfield)

name: AclGeom.exists_tuple_relocation_fixing
statement:
theorem exists_tuple_relocation_fixing [IsAlgClosed Ω] {n m : ℕ}
    {t s : Fin n → Ω} {u : Fin m → Ω} {e : Fin n → Fin m}
    (ht : AlgebraicIndependent k t) (hs : AlgebraicIndependent k s)
    (he : ∀ i, u (e i) = t i)
    (hu : ∀ j, u j ∈ racl k (Set.range t)) :
    ∃ v : Fin m → Ω,
      idealOf k v = idealOf k u ∧ ∀ i, v (e i) = s i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let E := adjoin k (Set.range t)
  let L := adjoin k (Set.range u)
  have hle : E ≤ L := by
    apply adjoin.mono
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    have hti : t i ∈ Set.range u := ⟨e i, he i⟩
    exact hti
  have halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (↥E) (↥(extendScalars hle)) := by
    apply isAlgebraic_extendScalars_adjoin hle
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact (mem_racl_iff k).1 (hu j)
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := exists_extension_of_isAlgebraic
    (halg := halg) hle (adjoinTranscendentalAlgHom ht hs)
  have huMem (j : Fin m) : u j ∈ L :=
    subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self j)
  let ua : Fin m → ↥L := fun j ↦ ⟨u j, huMem j⟩
  let v : Fin m → Ω := fun j ↦ ψ (ua j)
  have hfix (i : Fin n) : v (e i) = s i := by
    have hmem : t i ∈ E := subset_adjoin k _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    have hua : ua (e i) = ⟨t i, hle hmem⟩ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact he i
    change ψ (ua (e i)) = s i
    rw [hua, hψ ⟨t i, hmem⟩]
    exact adjoinTranscendentalAlgHom_apply ht hs i
  refine ⟨v, ?_, hfix⟩
  ext f
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, mem_idealOf_iff]
  have h1 : MvPolynomial.aeval v f =
      ψ (MvPolynomial.aeval ua f) := by
    change MvPolynomial.aeval (fun j ↦ ψ (ua j)) f = _
    rw [MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply]
  have h2 : MvPolynomial.aeval u f =
      L.val (MvPolynomial.aeval ua f) := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply]
    rfl
  rw [h1, h2]
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have ha : ψ (MvPolynomial.aeval ua f) = ψ 0 := by
      rw [map_zero]
      exact hz
    rw [ψ.injective ha, map_zero]
  · intro hz
    have ha : L.val (MvPolynomial.aeval ua f) = L.val 0 := by
      rw [map_zero]
      exact hz
    rw [L.val.injective ha, map_zero]

name: AclGeom.idealOf_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, mem_idealOf_iff]
  have ha : MvPolynomial.aeval (a ∘ e) f =
      MvPolynomial.aeval a (MvPolynomial.rename e f) := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.aeval_rename]
  have hb : MvPolynomial.aeval (b ∘ e) f =
      MvPolynomial.aeval b (MvPolynomial.rename e f) := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.aeval_rename]
  rw [ha, hb]
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hm : MvPolynomial.rename e f ∈ idealOf k a :=
      (mem_idealOf_iff k).2 hz
    exact (mem_idealOf_iff k).1 (h ▸ hm)
  · intro hz
    have hm : MvPolynomial.rename e f ∈ idealOf k b :=
      (mem_idealOf_iff k).2 hz
    exact (mem_idealOf_iff k).1 (h.symm ▸ hm)

name: AclGeom.algebraicIndependent_comp_of_idealOf_eq
statement:
theorem algebraicIndependent_comp_of_idealOf_eq {ι κ : Type*}
    {a b : ι → Ω} (h : idealOf k a = idealOf k b) (e : κ → ι)
    (ha : AlgebraicIndependent k (a ∘ e)) :
    AlgebraicIndependent k (b ∘ e)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← idealOf_eq_bot_iff] at ha ⊢
  rw [← idealOf_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq h e]
  exact ha

name: AclGeom.locusCoordinateRingEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem locusCoordinateRingEquiv_mk {ι : Type*}
    (a : ι → Ω) (p : MvPolynomial ι k) :
    locusCoordinateRingEquiv a (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p) =
      ⟨MvPolynomial.aeval a p, by
        rw [Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_aeval]
        exact AlgHom.mem_range_self _ p⟩
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change ↑(((Ideal.quotientKerEquivRange (MvPolynomial.aeval a)).trans
    (Subalgebra.equivOfEq _ _
      (Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_aeval k a).symm))
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p)) = MvPolynomial.aeval a p
  rw [AlgEquiv.trans_apply]
  rw [Ideal.quotientKerEquivRange]
  rw [AlgEquiv.trans_apply]
  rw [Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq_mk]
  rw [Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective_mk]
  rfl

name: AclGeom.locusCoordinateRingEquivOfIdealEq_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem locusCoordinateRingEquivOfIdealEq_apply {ι : Type*}
    {a b : ι → Ω} (h : idealOf k a = idealOf k b) (i : ι) :
    locusCoordinateRingEquivOfIdealEq h
        ⟨a i, Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩ =
      ⟨b i, Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩
proof:
:= by
  let qa : MvPolynomial ι k ⧸ idealOf k a :=
    Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.X i)
  let qb : MvPolynomial ι k ⧸ idealOf k b :=
    Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.X i)
  have ha : locusCoordinateRingEquiv a qa =
      ⟨a i, Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩ := by
    simp [qa]
  have hb : locusCoordinateRingEquiv b qb =
      ⟨b i, Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩ := by
    simp [qb]
  change locusCoordinateRingEquiv b
      ((Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq k h)
        ((locusCoordinateRingEquiv a).symm
          ⟨a i, Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩)) =
    ⟨b i, Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩
  rw [← ha, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply, ← hb]
  apply congrArg (fun x ↦ locusCoordinateRingEquiv b x)
  dsimp [qa, qb]

name: AclGeom.locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_apply {ι : Type*}
    {a b : ι → Ω} (h : idealOf k a = idealOf k b) (i : ι) :
    locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq h
        ⟨a i, subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩ =
      ⟨b i, subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩
proof:
:= by
  change locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq h
      (algebraMap (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range a))
        (↥(adjoin k (Set.range a)))
        ⟨a i, Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩) =
    algebraMap (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range b))
      (↥(adjoin k (Set.range b)))
      ⟨b i, Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩
  rw [locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq,
    IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv_algebraMap,
    locusCoordinateRingEquivOfIdealEq_apply]

name: AclGeom.locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_refl
statement:
@[simp] theorem locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_refl {ι : Type*}
    (a : ι → Ω) :
    locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq
        (rfl : idealOf k a = idealOf k a) = AlgEquiv.refl
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom_injective
  apply adjoin_algHom_ext k
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  simp

name: AclGeom.locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_symm
statement:
@[simp] theorem locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_symm {ι : Type*}
    {a b : ι → Ω} (h : idealOf k a = idealOf k b) :
    (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq h).symm =
      locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq h.symm
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom_injective
  apply adjoin_algHom_ext k
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  calc
    (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq h).symm
        ⟨b i, subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩ =
        ⟨a i, subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩ :=
      (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq h).symm_apply_eq.mpr
        (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_apply h i).symm
    _ = locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq h.symm
        ⟨b i, subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩ :=
      (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_apply h.symm i).symm

name: AclGeom.locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_trans
statement:
@[simp] theorem locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_trans {ι : Type*}
    {a b c : ι → Ω} (hab : idealOf k a = idealOf k b)
    (hbc : idealOf k b = idealOf k c) :
    (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq hab).trans
        (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq hbc) =
      locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq (hab.trans hbc)
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom_injective
  apply adjoin_algHom_ext k
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  calc
    ((locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq hab).trans
        (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq hbc))
        ⟨a i, subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩ =
        locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq hbc
          (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq hab
            ⟨a i, subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩) := rfl
    _ = locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq hbc
          ⟨b i, subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩ := by
      rw [locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_apply]
    _ = ⟨c i, subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩ :=
      locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_apply hbc i
    _ = locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq (hab.trans hbc)
        ⟨a i, subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩ :=
      (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_apply (hab.trans hbc) i).symm

name: AclGeom.adjoinIndependentEquivOfEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
theorem adjoinIndependentEquivOfEquiv_algebraMap {ι : Type*}
    {E E' : IntermediateField k Ω} (e : E ≃ₐ[k] E')
    {x y : ι → Ω} (hx : AlgebraicIndependent E x)
    (hy : AlgebraicIndependent E' y) (z : E) :
    adjoinIndependentEquivOfEquiv e hx hy
        (algebraMap E (↥(adjoin E (Set.range x))) z) =
      algebraMap E' (↥(adjoin E' (Set.range y))) (e z)
proof:
:= by
  change hy.aevalEquivField
      ((IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv
        (MvPolynomial.mapAlgEquiv ι e))
          (hx.aevalEquivField.symm
            (algebraMap E (↥(adjoin E (Set.range x))) z))) = _
  rw [hx.aevalEquivField.symm.commutes]
  have hbase :
      algebraMap E (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ι E)) z =
        algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι E)
          (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ι E)) (MvPolynomial.C z) := rfl
  rw [hbase, IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv_algebraMap]
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [AlgebraicIndependent.aevalEquivField_algebraMap_apply_coe]
  simp

name: AclGeom.adjoinIndependentEquivOfEquiv_generator
statement:
theorem adjoinIndependentEquivOfEquiv_generator {ι : Type*}
    {E E' : IntermediateField k Ω} (e : E ≃ₐ[k] E')
    {x y : ι → Ω} (hx : AlgebraicIndependent E x)
    (hy : AlgebraicIndependent E' y) (i : ι) :
    adjoinIndependentEquivOfEquiv e hx hy
        ⟨x i, subset_adjoin E _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩ =
      ⟨y i, subset_adjoin E' _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hxgen : hx.aevalEquivField
      (algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι E)
        (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ι E)) (MvPolynomial.X i)) =
        ⟨x i, subset_adjoin E _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [AlgebraicIndependent.aevalEquivField_algebraMap_apply_coe]
    simp
  change hy.aevalEquivField
      ((IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv
        (MvPolynomial.mapAlgEquiv ι e))
          (hx.aevalEquivField.symm ⟨x i, _⟩)) = _
  rw [← hxgen, hx.aevalEquivField.symm_apply_apply,
    IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv_algebraMap]
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [AlgebraicIndependent.aevalEquivField_algebraMap_apply_coe]
  simp

name: AclGeom.adjoinTranscendentalEquivOfEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
theorem adjoinTranscendentalEquivOfEquiv_algebraMap
    {E E' : IntermediateField k Ω} (e : E ≃ₐ[k] E')
    {x y : Ω} (hx : Transcendental E x) (hy : Transcendental E' y)
    (z : E) :
    adjoinTranscendentalEquivOfEquiv e hx hy
        (algebraMap E
          (↥(adjoin E (Set.range (![x] : Fin 1 → Ω)))) z) =
      algebraMap E' (↥(adjoin E' (Set.range (![y] : Fin 1 → Ω)))) (e z)
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : AlgebraicIndependent E (![x] : Fin 1 → Ω) := by
    rw [algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff]
    exact hx
  have hy' : AlgebraicIndependent E' (![y] : Fin 1 → Ω) := by
    rw [algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff]
    exact hy
  change hy'.aevalEquivField
      ((IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv
        (MvPolynomial.mapAlgEquiv (Fin 1) e))
          (hx'.aevalEquivField.symm
            (algebraMap E
              (↥(adjoin E (Set.range (![x] : Fin 1 → Ω)))) z))) = _
  rw [hx'.aevalEquivField.symm.commutes]
  have hbase :
      algebraMap E (FractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin 1) E)) z =
        algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin 1) E)
          (FractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin 1) E)) (MvPolynomial.C z) := rfl
  rw [hbase, IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv_algebraMap]
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [AlgebraicIndependent.aevalEquivField_algebraMap_apply_coe]
  simp

name: AclGeom.adjoinTranscendentalEquivOfEquiv_generator
statement:
theorem adjoinTranscendentalEquivOfEquiv_generator
    {E E' : IntermediateField k Ω} (e : E ≃ₐ[k] E')
    {x y : Ω} (hx : Transcendental E x) (hy : Transcendental E' y) :
    adjoinTranscendentalEquivOfEquiv e hx hy
        ⟨x, subset_adjoin E _ ⟨0, rfl⟩⟩ =
      ⟨y, subset_adjoin E' _ ⟨0, rfl⟩⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : AlgebraicIndependent E (![x] : Fin 1 → Ω) := by
    rw [algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff]
    exact hx
  have hy' : AlgebraicIndependent E' (![y] : Fin 1 → Ω) := by
    rw [algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff]
    exact hy
  have hxgen : hx'.aevalEquivField
      (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin 1) E)
        (FractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin 1) E)) (MvPolynomial.X 0)) =
        ⟨x, subset_adjoin E _ ⟨0, rfl⟩⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [AlgebraicIndependent.aevalEquivField_algebraMap_apply_coe]
    simp
  change hy'.aevalEquivField
      ((IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv
        (MvPolynomial.mapAlgEquiv (Fin 1) e))
          (hx'.aevalEquivField.symm ⟨x, _⟩)) = _
  rw [← hxgen, hx'.aevalEquivField.symm_apply_apply,
    IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv_algebraMap]
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [AlgebraicIndependent.aevalEquivField_algebraMap_apply_coe]
  simp

name: AclGeom.idealOf_snoc_eq_of_idealOf_eq_of_generic
statement:
theorem idealOf_snoc_eq_of_idealOf_eq_of_generic
    {n : ℕ} {a b : Fin n → Ω} {x y : Ω}
    (hab : idealOf k a = idealOf k b)
    (hx : x ∉ racl k (Set.range a))
    (hy : y ∉ racl k (Set.range b)) :
    idealOf k (Fin.snoc a x) = idealOf k (Fin.snoc b y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let E := adjoin k (Set.range a)
  let E' := adjoin k (Set.range b)
  let e : E ≃ₐ[k] E' := locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq hab
  have hxT : Transcendental E x := by
    change ¬IsAlgebraic E x
    exact fun h ↦ hx ((mem_racl_iff k).2 h)
  have hyT : Transcendental E' y := by
    change ¬IsAlgebraic E' y
    exact fun h ↦ hy ((mem_racl_iff k).2 h)
  let L := adjoin E (Set.range (![x] : Fin 1 → Ω))
  let L' := adjoin E' (Set.range (![y] : Fin 1 → Ω))
  let ex : L ≃ₐ[k] L' := adjoinTranscendentalEquivOfEquiv e hxT hyT
  let ax : Fin (n + 1) → L := Fin.snoc
    (fun i ↦ algebraMap E L
      ⟨a i, subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩)
    ⟨x, subset_adjoin E _ ⟨0, rfl⟩⟩
  let bx : Fin (n + 1) → L' := Fin.snoc
    (fun i ↦ algebraMap E' L'
      ⟨b i, subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩)
    ⟨y, subset_adjoin E' _ ⟨0, rfl⟩⟩
  have hax (j : Fin (n + 1)) : (ax j : Ω) =
      (Fin.snoc a x : Fin (n + 1) → Ω) j := by
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i ↦ ?_) j
    · simp [ax]
    · simp [ax]
  have hbx (j : Fin (n + 1)) : (bx j : Ω) =
      (Fin.snoc b y : Fin (n + 1) → Ω) j := by
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i ↦ ?_) j
    · simp [bx]
    · simp [bx]
  have hcoord (j : Fin (n + 1)) : ex (ax j) = bx j := by
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i ↦ ?_) j
    · simpa only [ex, ax, bx, Fin.snoc_last] using
        adjoinTranscendentalEquivOfEquiv_generator e hxT hyT
    · have hei : e ⟨a i, subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩ =
          ⟨b i, subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩ :=
        locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_apply hab i
      have hbase := adjoinTranscendentalEquivOfEquiv_algebraMap e hxT hyT
        ⟨a i, subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩
      rw [hei] at hbase
      simpa only [ex, ax, bx, Fin.snoc_castSucc] using hbase
  ext p
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, mem_idealOf_iff]
  have ha : MvPolynomial.aeval (Fin.snoc a x) p =
      L.val (MvPolynomial.aeval ax p) := by
    have hhom : (L.val.restrictScalars k).comp (MvPolynomial.aeval ax) =
        MvPolynomial.aeval (Fin.snoc a x) := by
      apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
      intro j
      simpa using hax j
    exact congrArg (fun q ↦ q p) hhom.symm
  have hb : MvPolynomial.aeval (Fin.snoc b y) p =
      L'.val (MvPolynomial.aeval bx p) := by
    have hhom : (L'.val.restrictScalars k).comp (MvPolynomial.aeval bx) =
        MvPolynomial.aeval (Fin.snoc b y) := by
      apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
      intro j
      simpa using hbx j
    exact congrArg (fun q ↦ q p) hhom.symm
  have heval : MvPolynomial.aeval bx p = ex (MvPolynomial.aeval ax p) := by
    have hhom : ex.toAlgHom.comp (MvPolynomial.aeval ax) =
        MvPolynomial.aeval bx := by
      apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
      intro j
      simpa using hcoord j
    exact congrArg (fun q ↦ q p) hhom.symm
  rw [ha, hb, heval]
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hz' :
        (MvPolynomial.aeval ax :
          MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k →ₐ[k] L) p = 0 := by
      apply L.val.injective
      change L.val
          ((MvPolynomial.aeval ax :
            MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k →ₐ[k] L) p) = L.val 0
      rw [map_zero]
      exact hz
    rw [hz', map_zero]
    rfl
  · intro hz
    have hz' : ex
        ((MvPolynomial.aeval ax :
          MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k →ₐ[k] L) p) = 0 := by
      apply L'.val.injective
      change L'.val (ex
          ((MvPolynomial.aeval ax :
            MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k →ₐ[k] L) p)) = L'.val 0
      rw [map_zero]
      exact hz
    have :
        (MvPolynomial.aeval ax :
          MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k →ₐ[k] L) p = 0 :=
      ex.injective (by simpa using hz')
    rw [this]
    rfl

name: AclGeom.exists_tuple_relocation_fixing_locus
statement:
theorem exists_tuple_relocation_fixing_locus [IsAlgClosed Ω] {n m : ℕ}
    {t s : Fin n → Ω} {u : Fin m → Ω} {e : Fin n → Fin m}
    (hI : idealOf k s = idealOf k t)
    (he : ∀ i, u (e i) = t i)
    (hu : ∀ j, u j ∈ racl k (Set.range t)) :
    ∃ v : Fin m → Ω,
      idealOf k v = idealOf k u ∧ ∀ i, v (e i) = s i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let E := adjoin k (Set.range t)
  let E' := adjoin k (Set.range u)
  let F := adjoin k (Set.range s)
  have hle : E ≤ E' := by
    apply adjoin.mono
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨e i, he i⟩
  have halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (↥E) (↥(extendScalars hle)) := by
    apply isAlgebraic_extendScalars_adjoin hle
    rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
    exact (mem_racl_iff k).1 (hu j)
  let φ : E →ₐ[k] Ω := F.val.comp
    (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq hI.symm).toAlgHom
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := exists_extension_of_isAlgebraic
    (halg := halg) hle φ
  have huMem (j : Fin m) : u j ∈ E' :=
    subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self j)
  let ua : Fin m → E' := fun j ↦ ⟨u j, huMem j⟩
  let v : Fin m → Ω := fun j ↦ ψ (ua j)
  have hfix (i : Fin n) : v (e i) = s i := by
    have hmem : t i ∈ E := subset_adjoin k _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    have hua : ua (e i) = ⟨t i, hle hmem⟩ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact he i
    change ψ (ua (e i)) = s i
    rw [hua]
    calc
      ψ ⟨t i, hle hmem⟩ = φ ⟨t i, hmem⟩ := hψ ⟨t i, hmem⟩
      _ = s i := by
        change ↑(locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq hI.symm
          ⟨t i, subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩) = s i
        rw [locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_apply]
  refine ⟨v, ?_, hfix⟩
  ext p
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, mem_idealOf_iff]
  have h1 : MvPolynomial.aeval v p = ψ (MvPolynomial.aeval ua p) := by
    change MvPolynomial.aeval (fun j ↦ ψ (ua j)) p = _
    rw [MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply]
  have h2 : MvPolynomial.aeval u p = E'.val (MvPolynomial.aeval ua p) := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply]
    rfl
  rw [h1, h2]
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hp : ψ (MvPolynomial.aeval ua p) = ψ 0 := by
      rw [map_zero]
      exact hz
    rw [ψ.injective hp, map_zero]
  · intro hz
    have hp : E'.val (MvPolynomial.aeval ua p) = E'.val 0 := by
      rw [map_zero]
      exact hz
    rw [E'.val.injective hp, map_zero]

name: AclGeom.exists_snoc_relocation_fixing
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let E := adjoin k (Set.range t)
  let L := adjoin k (Set.range (Fin.snoc t u))
  have hle : E ≤ L := by
    apply adjoin.mono
    rw [Fin.range_snoc]
    exact Set.subset_insert u _
  have halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (↥E) (↥(extendScalars hle)) := by
    apply isAlgebraic_extendScalars_adjoin hle
    intro x hx
    rw [Fin.range_snoc] at hx
    rcases hx with rfl | hx
    · exact (mem_racl_iff k).1 hu
    · have hxE : x ∈ E := subset_adjoin k _ hx
      exact isAlgebraic_algebraMap (R := ↥E) (A := Ω) ⟨x, hxE⟩
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := exists_extension_of_isAlgebraic
    (halg := halg) hle (adjoinTranscendentalAlgHom ht hs)
  have htaMem (j : Fin n.succ) :
      (Fin.snoc t u : Fin n.succ → Ω) j ∈
        (adjoin k (Set.range (Fin.snoc t u : Fin n.succ → Ω)) :
          IntermediateField k Ω) :=
    subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self j)
  let ta : Fin n.succ → ↥L :=
    fun j ↦ ⟨(Fin.snoc t u : Fin n.succ → Ω) j, htaMem j⟩
  let v : Ω := ψ (ta (Fin.last n))
  have hprefix (i : Fin n) : ψ (ta i.castSucc) = s i := by
    have hmem : t i ∈ E := subset_adjoin k _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    have hta : ta i.castSucc = ⟨t i, hle hmem⟩ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp [ta]
    rw [hta, hψ ⟨t i, hmem⟩]
    exact adjoinTranscendentalAlgHom_apply ht hs i
  have htuple : Fin.snoc s v = fun j ↦ ψ (ta j) := by
    funext j
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i ↦ ?_) j
    · simp [v]
    · simpa using (hprefix i).symm
  refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
  rw [htuple]
  ext f
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, mem_idealOf_iff]
  have h1 : MvPolynomial.aeval (fun j ↦ ψ (ta j)) f =
      ψ (MvPolynomial.aeval ta f) := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply]
  have h2 : MvPolynomial.aeval (Fin.snoc t u) f =
      L.val (MvPolynomial.aeval ta f) := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply]
    rfl
  rw [h1, h2]
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have ha : ψ (MvPolynomial.aeval ta f) = ψ 0 := by
      rw [map_zero]
      exact hz
    rw [ψ.injective ha, map_zero]
  · intro hz
    have ha : L.val (MvPolynomial.aeval ta f) = L.val 0 := by
      rw [map_zero]
      exact hz
    rw [L.val.injective ha, map_zero]

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondenceMultiplication.IsRealization.output_mem_left_right
statement: theorem output_mem_left_right : c ∈ racl k ({a, b} : Set Ω)
proof:
:= by
  have hfull : idealOf k M.tuple = idealOf k ![a, b, c] := by
    simpa [IsRealization, ideal] using h.symm
  have himageM : M.tuple '' ({0, 1} : Set (Fin 3)) =
      ({M.left, M.right} : Set Ω) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      fin_cases i <;> simp [tuple] at hi ⊢
    · rintro (rfl | rfl)
      · exact ⟨0, by simp, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨1, by simp, rfl⟩
  have ho : M.tuple 2 ∈
      racl k (M.tuple '' ({0, 1} : Set (Fin 3))) := by
    rw [himageM]
    exact M.output_mem_left_right
  have ht := mem_racl_image_of_idealOf_eq k hfull ho
  have himage : (![a, b, c] : Fin 3 → Ω) '' ({0, 1} : Set (Fin 3)) =
      ({a, b} : Set Ω) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      fin_cases i <;> simp at hi ⊢
    · rintro (rfl | rfl)
      · exact ⟨0, by simp, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨1, by simp, rfl⟩
  rwa [himage] at ht

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondenceMultiplication.IsRealization.right_mem_left_output
statement: theorem right_mem_left_output : b ∈ racl k ({a, c} : Set Ω)
proof:
:= by
  have hfull : idealOf k M.tuple = idealOf k ![a, b, c] := by
    simpa [IsRealization, ideal] using h.symm
  have himageM : M.tuple '' ({0, 2} : Set (Fin 3)) =
      ({M.left, M.output} : Set Ω) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      fin_cases i <;> simp [tuple] at hi ⊢
    · rintro (rfl | rfl)
      · exact ⟨0, by simp, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨2, by simp, rfl⟩
  have ho : M.tuple 1 ∈
      racl k (M.tuple '' ({0, 2} : Set (Fin 3))) := by
    rw [himageM]
    exact M.right_mem_left_output
  have ht := mem_racl_image_of_idealOf_eq k hfull ho
  have himage : (![a, b, c] : Fin 3 → Ω) '' ({0, 2} : Set (Fin 3)) =
      ({a, c} : Set Ω) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      fin_cases i <;> simp at hi ⊢
    · rintro (rfl | rfl)
      · exact ⟨0, by simp, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨2, by simp, rfl⟩
  rwa [himage] at ht

proof:
:= by

  have ho : M.tuple 0 ∈

  have ht := mem_racl_image_of_idealOf_eq k hfull ho
  have himage : (![a, b, c] : Fin 3 → Ω) '' ({1, 2} : Set (Fin 3)) =
      ({b, c} : Set Ω) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondenceMultiplication.exists_output
proof:
:= by

      ({M.left, M.right} : Set Ω) := by
    ext z
    simp
    tauto
  have hmem : M.output ∈
      racl k (Set.range (![M.left, M.right] : Fin 2 → Ω)) := by
    rw [hrange]
    exact M.output_mem_left_right
  simpa [ideal, tuple] using
    exists_snoc_relocation_fixing M.leftRight_independent hab hmem

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondenceMultiplication.exists_right
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : Fin 2 → Fin 3 := ![0, 2]
  have he (i : Fin 2) : M.tuple (e i) = (![M.left, M.output] : Fin 2 → Ω) i := by
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hmem (j : Fin 3) :
      M.tuple j ∈ racl k (Set.range (![M.left, M.output] : Fin 2 → Ω)) := by
    have hrange : Set.range (![M.left, M.output] : Fin 2 → Ω) =
        ({M.left, M.output} : Set Ω) := by
      ext z
      simp
      tauto
    rw [hrange]
    fin_cases j
    · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp [tuple])
    · exact M.right_mem_left_output
    · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp [tuple])
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hfix⟩ := exists_tuple_relocation_fixing
    M.leftOutput_independent hac he hmem
  refine ⟨v 1, ?_⟩
  have hvtuple : v = ![a, v 1, c] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · exact hfix 0
    · rfl
    · exact hfix 1
  change idealOf k ![a, v 1, c] = idealOf k M.tuple
  rw [← hvtuple]
  exact hv

  obtain ⟨v, hv, hfix⟩ := exists_tuple_relocation_fixing

  exact hv

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondenceMultiplication.exists_fourArrowDifferenceDiagram
statement:
theorem exists_fourArrowDifferenceDiagram [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    {s e a b : Ω} (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![s, e, a, b]) :
    Nonempty (M.FourArrowDifferenceDiagram s a b e)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let q : Fin 4 → Ω := ![s, e, a, b]
  have hq : AlgebraicIndependent k q := hind
  have hq01 : q '' ({0, 1} : Set (Fin 4)) = ({s, e} : Set Ω) := by
    ext z
    simp [q]
  have hq012 : q '' ({0, 1, 2} : Set (Fin 4)) =
      ({s, e, a} : Set Ω) := by
    ext z
    simp [q]
  have hq02 : q '' ({0, 2} : Set (Fin 4)) = ({s, a} : Set Ω) := by
    ext z
    simp [q]
  have ha_se : a ∉ racl k ({s, e} : Set Ω) := by
    have hnot := AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_image hq
      (S := ({0, 1} : Set (Fin 4))) (i := 2) (by simp)
    rw [hq01] at hnot
    simpa [q] using hnot
  have hb_sea : b ∉ racl k ({s, e, a} : Set Ω) := by
    have hnot := AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_image hq
      (S := ({0, 1, 2} : Set (Fin 4))) (i := 3) (by simp)
    rw [hq012] at hnot
    simpa [q] using hnot
  have he_sa : e ∉ racl k ({s, a} : Set Ω) := by
    have hnot := AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_image hq
      (S := ({0, 2} : Set (Fin 4))) (i := 1) (by simp)
    rw [hq02] at hnot
    simpa [q] using hnot
  have hb_se : b ∉ racl k ({s, e} : Set Ω) := by
    intro hmem
    exact hb_sea (racl_mono (by intro z hz; simp at hz ⊢; tauto) hmem)
  have hb_s : b ∉ racl k ({s} : Set Ω) := by
    intro hmem
    exact hb_se (racl_mono (by intro z hz; simp at hz ⊢; tauto) hmem)
  have he_s : e ∉ racl k ({s} : Set Ω) := by
    intro hmem
    exact he_sa (racl_mono (by intro z hz; simp at hz ⊢; tauto) hmem)
  have hse : AlgebraicIndependent k ![s, e] := by
    have hp := AlgebraicIndependent.comp_pair hq
      (i := 0) (j := 1) (by decide)
    simpa [q] using hp
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := M.exists_output hse
  have hRu : M.IsRealization s e u := hu
  have hau : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, u] := by
    refine algebraicIndependent_pair ?_ ?_
    · intro ha_u
      apply ha_se
      refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ ha_u
      rintro z rfl
      exact hRu.output_mem_left_right
    · intro hu_a
      have hu_as : u ∈ racl k (insert a ({s} : Set Ω)) :=
        racl_mono (by intro z hz; simp at hz ⊢; tauto) hu_a
      have hu_es : u ∈ racl k (insert e ({s} : Set Ω)) := by
        have hset : insert e ({s} : Set Ω) = ({s, e} : Set Ω) := by
          ext z
          simp
          tauto
        rw [hset]
        exact hRu.output_mem_left_right
      have ha_es : a ∉ racl k (insert e ({s} : Set Ω)) := by
        have hset : insert e ({s} : Set Ω) = ({s, e} : Set Ω) := by
          ext z
          simp
          tauto
        rwa [hset]
      have hu_s : u ∈ racl k ({s} : Set Ω) :=
        mem_racl_of_mem_racl_insert hu_es hu_as ha_es
      have he_s' : e ∈ racl k ({s} : Set Ω) := by
        refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ hRu.right_mem_left_output
        rintro z (rfl | rfl)
        · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
        · exact hu_s
      exact he_s he_s'
  obtain ⟨sA, hsA⟩ := M.exists_left hau
  have hRsA : M.IsRealization sA a u := hsA
  have hsb : AlgebraicIndependent k ![s, b] := by
    have hp := AlgebraicIndependent.comp_pair hq
      (i := 0) (j := 3) (by decide)
    simpa [q] using hp
  obtain ⟨uB, huB⟩ := M.exists_output hsb
  have hRuB : M.IsRealization s b uB := huB
  have hsa_sea : sA ∈ racl k ({s, e, a} : Set Ω) := by
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ hRsA.left_mem_right_output
    rintro z (rfl | rfl)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
    · exact racl_mono (by intro z hz; simp at hz ⊢; tauto)
        hRu.output_mem_left_right
  have huB_sb : uB ∈ racl k ({s, b} : Set Ω) :=
    hRuB.output_mem_left_right
  have hinsert_a_se : insert a ({s, e} : Set Ω) =
      ({s, e, a} : Set Ω) := by
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor <;> rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl) <;> simp
  have hinsert_e_s : insert e ({s} : Set Ω) = ({s, e} : Set Ω) := by
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor <;> rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> simp
  have hinsert_b_s : insert b ({s} : Set Ω) = ({s, b} : Set Ω) := by
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    constructor <;> rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> simp
  have hintersection {w : Ω}
      (hw_sea : w ∈ racl k ({s, e, a} : Set Ω))
      (hw_sb : w ∈ racl k ({s, b} : Set Ω)) :
      w ∈ racl k ({s} : Set Ω) := by
    have hw_a_se : w ∈ racl k (insert a ({s, e} : Set Ω)) := by
      rwa [hinsert_a_se]
    have hw_b_se : w ∈ racl k (insert b ({s, e} : Set Ω)) :=
      racl_mono (by
        rintro z (rfl | rfl)
        · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (by simp)
        · exact Set.mem_insert _ _) hw_sb
    have hb_a_se : b ∉ racl k (insert a ({s, e} : Set Ω)) := by
      rwa [hinsert_a_se]
    have hw_se : w ∈ racl k ({s, e} : Set Ω) :=
      mem_racl_of_mem_racl_insert hw_a_se hw_b_se hb_a_se
    have hw_e_s : w ∈ racl k (insert e ({s} : Set Ω)) := by
      rwa [hinsert_e_s]
    have hw_b_s : w ∈ racl k (insert b ({s} : Set Ω)) := by
      rwa [hinsert_b_s]
    have hb_e_s : b ∉ racl k (insert e ({s} : Set Ω)) := by
      rwa [hinsert_e_s]
    exact mem_racl_of_mem_racl_insert hw_e_s hw_b_s hb_e_s
  have hsa_uB : AlgebraicIndependent k ![sA, uB] := by
    refine algebraicIndependent_pair ?_ ?_
    · intro hsa_uB
      have hsa_sb : sA ∈ racl k ({s, b} : Set Ω) := by
        refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ hsa_uB
        rintro z rfl
        exact huB_sb
      have hsa_s := hintersection hsa_sea hsa_sb
      have hu_sa : u ∈ racl k ({s, a} : Set Ω) := by
        refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ hRsA.output_mem_left_right
        rintro z (rfl | rfl)
        · exact racl_mono (by simp) hsa_s
        · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
      have he_sa' : e ∈ racl k ({s, a} : Set Ω) := by
        refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ hRu.right_mem_left_output
        rintro z (rfl | rfl)
        · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
        · exact hu_sa
      exact he_sa he_sa'
    · intro huB_sa
      have huB_sea : uB ∈ racl k ({s, e, a} : Set Ω) := by
        refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ huB_sa
        rintro z rfl
        exact hsa_sea
      have huB_s := hintersection huB_sea huB_sb
      have hb_s' : b ∈ racl k ({s} : Set Ω) := by
        refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ hRuB.right_mem_left_output
        rintro z (rfl | rfl)
        · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
        · exact huB_s
      exact hb_s hb_s'
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := M.exists_right hsa_uB
  exact ⟨{
    u := u
    sA := sA
    uB := uB
    c := c
    se_u := hRu
    sA_a_u := hRsA
    s_b_uB := hRuB
    sA_c_uB := hc }⟩

name: AclGeom.RankTwoFiniteCorrespondenceMultiplication.FourArrowDifferenceDiagram.exists_relocation
statement:
theorem exists_relocation [IsAlgClosed K]
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b))
    {s' e' a' b' : Fin 2 → K}
    (hind' : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s' e' a' b')) :
    ∃ D' : M.FourArrowDifferenceDiagram s' a' b' e',
      idealOf k D'.totalTuple = idealOf k D.totalTuple
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hfix⟩ := exists_tuple_relocation_fixing
    (t := rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)
    (s := rankTwoFourTuple s' e' a' b')
    (u := D.totalTuple) (e := inputIndex)
    hind hind' (fun i ↦ congrFun D.totalTuple_comp_inputIndex i)
    D.totalTuple_mem_input_racl
  let u' : Fin 2 → K := ![v 8, v 9]
  let sA' : Fin 2 → K := ![v 10, v 11]
  let uB' : Fin 2 → K := ![v 12, v 13]
  let c' : Fin 2 → K := ![v 14, v 15]
  have hinput (i : Fin 8) : v (inputIndex i) =
      rankTwoFourTuple s' e' a' b' i := hfix i
  have hse : M.IsRealization s' e' u' := by
    have h := idealOf_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq hv seIndex
    change idealOf k (rankTwoTripleTuple s' e' u') = M.ideal
    calc
      idealOf k (rankTwoTripleTuple s' e' u') =
          idealOf k (v ∘ seIndex) := by
        congr 1
        funext i
        fin_cases i
        · exact (hinput 0).symm
        · exact (hinput 1).symm
        · exact (hinput 2).symm
        · exact (hinput 3).symm
        · rfl
        · rfl
      _ = idealOf k (D.totalTuple ∘ seIndex) := h
      _ = M.ideal := by
        simpa [RankTwoFiniteCorrespondenceMultiplication.IsRealization]
          using D.se_u
  have hsAa : M.IsRealization sA' a' u' := by
    have h := idealOf_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq hv sAaIndex
    change idealOf k (rankTwoTripleTuple sA' a' u') = M.ideal
    calc
      idealOf k (rankTwoTripleTuple sA' a' u') =
          idealOf k (v ∘ sAaIndex) := by
        congr 1
        funext i
        fin_cases i
        · rfl
        · rfl
        · exact (hinput 4).symm
        · exact (hinput 5).symm
        · rfl
        · rfl
      _ = idealOf k (D.totalTuple ∘ sAaIndex) := h
      _ = M.ideal := by
        simpa [RankTwoFiniteCorrespondenceMultiplication.IsRealization]
          using D.sA_a_u
  have hsb : M.IsRealization s' b' uB' := by
    have h := idealOf_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq hv sbIndex
    change idealOf k (rankTwoTripleTuple s' b' uB') = M.ideal
    calc
      idealOf k (rankTwoTripleTuple s' b' uB') =
          idealOf k (v ∘ sbIndex) := by
        congr 1
        funext i
        fin_cases i
        · exact (hinput 0).symm
        · exact (hinput 1).symm
        · exact (hinput 6).symm
        · exact (hinput 7).symm
        · rfl
        · rfl
      _ = idealOf k (D.totalTuple ∘ sbIndex) := h
      _ = M.ideal := by
        simpa [RankTwoFiniteCorrespondenceMultiplication.IsRealization]
          using D.s_b_uB
  have hsAc : M.IsRealization sA' c' uB' := by
    have h := idealOf_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq hv sAcIndex
    change idealOf k (rankTwoTripleTuple sA' c' uB') = M.ideal
    calc
      idealOf k (rankTwoTripleTuple sA' c' uB') =
          idealOf k (v ∘ sAcIndex) := by
        congr 1
        funext i
        fin_cases i <;> rfl
      _ = idealOf k (D.totalTuple ∘ sAcIndex) := h
      _ = M.ideal := by
        simpa [RankTwoFiniteCorrespondenceMultiplication.IsRealization]
          using D.sA_c_uB
  let D' : M.FourArrowDifferenceDiagram s' a' b' e' :=
    { u := u'
      sA := sA'
      uB := uB'
      c := c'
      se_u := hse
      sA_a_u := hsAa
      s_b_uB := hsb
      sA_c_uB := hsAc }
  refine ⟨D', ?_⟩
  calc
    idealOf k D'.totalTuple = idealOf k v := by
      congr 1
      funext i
      fin_cases i
      · exact (hinput 0).symm
      · exact (hinput 1).symm
      · exact (hinput 2).symm
      · exact (hinput 3).symm
      · exact (hinput 4).symm
      · exact (hinput 5).symm
      · exact (hinput 6).symm
      · exact (hinput 7).symm
      · rfl
      · rfl
      · rfl
      · rfl
      · rfl
      · rfl
      · rfl
      · rfl
    _ = idealOf k D.totalTuple := hv

statement:
theorem totalOverInput_finiteDimensional :
    FiniteDimensional (↥D.inputField) (↥D.totalOverInput)
proof:
:= by
  have key : D.totalOverInput =
      adjoin (↥D.inputField) (Set.range D.totalTuple) := by
    refine restrictScalars_injective k ?_
    unfold totalOverInput
    rw [extendScalars_restrictScalars]
    unfold inputField totalField
    rw [adjoin_adjoin_left, adjoin_union]
    exact (sup_eq_right.2 D.inputField_le_totalField).symm
  rw [key]
  letI : Fintype (Set.range D.totalTuple) :=
    Set.Finite.fintype (Set.finite_range D.totalTuple)
  exact finiteDimensional_adjoin fun x hx ↦ by
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact ((mem_racl_iff k).1 (D.totalTuple_mem_input_racl i)).isIntegral

name: AclGeom.RankTwoFiniteCorrespondenceMultiplication.FourArrowDifferenceDiagram.normalCoverEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalCoverEquiv_algebraMap [IsAlgClosed K]
    {s' a' b' e' : Fin 2 → K}
    (V : M.FourArrowDifferenceDiagram s' a' b' e')
    (h : idealOf k D.totalTuple = idealOf k V.totalTuple)
    (x : D.inputField) :
    D.normalCoverEquiv V h (algebraMap (↥D.inputField) (↥D.normalCover) x) =
      algebraMap (↥V.inputField) (↥V.normalCover) (D.inputEquiv V h x)
proof:
:= by
  letI : FiniteDimensional (↥D.inputField)
      (↥(extendScalars D.inputField_le_totalField)) := by
    change FiniteDimensional (↥D.inputField) (↥D.totalOverInput)
    exact D.totalOverInput_finiteDimensional
  letI : FiniteDimensional (↥V.inputField)
      (↥(extendScalars V.inputField_le_totalField)) := by
    change FiniteDimensional (↥V.inputField) (↥V.totalOverInput)
    exact V.totalOverInput_finiteDimensional
  let cD := FiniteCover.normalClosureOverEquivCanonical
    D.inputField_le_totalField (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_finite _ _)
  let cV := FiniteCover.normalClosureOverEquivCanonical
    V.inputField_le_totalField (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_finite _ _)
  let n := (D.extensionEquiv V h).normalLift
  change cV.symm.toRingEquiv
      (n.normalEquiv
        (cD.toRingEquiv
          (algebraMap (↥D.inputField) (↥D.normalCover) x))) =
    algebraMap (↥V.inputField) (↥V.normalCover) (D.inputEquiv V h x)
  rw [show cD.toRingEquiv
      (algebraMap (↥D.inputField) (↥D.normalCover) x) =
        algebraMap (↥D.inputField)
          (↥(FiniteCover.canonicalNormalClosure D.inputField_le_totalField)) x
    from cD.commutes x]
  rw [n.normal_commutes_apply]
  exact cV.symm.commutes (D.inputEquiv V h x)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondenceGerm.composes_ofPair_carriers_eq
statement:
theorem composes_ofPair_carriers_eq [IsAlgClosed Ω] (h : P.target = Q.source) :
    {I | ∃ E : FiniteCorrespondenceGerm k Ω, Composes (ofPair P) (ofPair Q) E ∧ E.carrier = I} =
      {I | ∃ Z ∈ irreducibleComponents
          (PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial ((Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin 1) k ⧸ ℐ)),
        closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.quotientMapₐ ℐ (rename (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr))
          (idealOf_le_comap_rename_comp
            (a := Sum.elim (Function.const (Fin 1) P.source) (Function.const (Fin 1) P.target))
            (b := Function.const (Fin 1) P.target) (g := Sum.inr) (e := Sum.inl) rfl
            le_sup_left)).toRingHom '' Z) = Set.univ ∧
        I = (((PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal Z).comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ)).comap
          (rename (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl) Sum.inr : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1 → (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) ⊕ Fin 1) :
            MvPolynomial (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) k →ₐ[k] _)).comap
          (rename (![Sum.inl 0, Sum.inr 0] : Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1) :
            MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →ₐ[k] _)}
proof:
:= by
  
  let e : Fin 2 → Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1 := ![Sum.inl 0, Sum.inr 0]
  let e' : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 1 → Fin 2 := Sum.elim (fun _ ↦ 0) (fun _ ↦ 1)
  have hre (a b : Fin 1 → Ω) :
      idealOf k ![a 0, b 0] = (idealOf k (Sum.elim a b)).comap (rename (R := k) e) :=
    idealOf_eq_comap_rename (funext fun i ↦ by fin_cases i <;> rfl)
  have hre' (a b : Fin 1 → Ω) :
      idealOf k (Sum.elim a b) = (idealOf k ![a 0, b 0]).comap (rename (R := k) e') :=
    idealOf_eq_comap_rename (funext fun i ↦ by rcases i with i | i <;> fin_cases i <;> rfl)
  have ht := TupleCorrespondenceGerm.composes_ofPair_carriers_eq (toTuple P) (toTuple Q)
    (congrArg (Function.const (Fin 1)) h)
  ext I
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨E, ⟨P₁, Q₁, h₁, hP, hQ, hE⟩, rfl⟩
    have htP : (toTuple P).ideal = (toTuple P₁).ideal :=
      (hre' (Function.const (Fin 1) P.source) (Function.const (Fin 1) P.target)).trans
        ((congrArg (Ideal.comap (rename (R := k) e')) hP).trans
          (hre' (Function.const (Fin 1) P₁.source) (Function.const (Fin 1) P₁.target)).symm)
    have htQ : (toTuple Q).ideal = (toTuple Q₁).ideal :=
      (hre' (Function.const (Fin 1) Q.source) (Function.const (Fin 1) Q.target)).trans
        ((congrArg (Ideal.comap (rename (R := k) e')) hQ).trans
          (hre' (Function.const (Fin 1) Q₁.source) (Function.const (Fin 1) Q₁.target)).symm)
    obtain ⟨Z, hZ, hdense, hJ⟩ := (Set.ext_iff.1 ht _).1
      ⟨TupleCorrespondenceGerm.ofPair ((toTuple P₁).comp (toTuple Q₁)
        (congrArg (Function.const (Fin 1)) h₁)),
        ⟨toTuple P₁, toTuple Q₁, congrArg (Function.const (Fin 1)) h₁, htP, htQ, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨Z, hZ, hdense, hE.trans ((hre (Function.const (Fin 1) P₁.source)
      (Function.const (Fin 1) Q₁.target)).trans (congrArg (Ideal.comap (rename (R := k) e)) hJ))⟩
  · rintro ⟨Z, hZ, hdense, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨E, ⟨P₁, Q₁, h₁, hP, hQ, hE⟩, hEZ⟩ := (Set.ext_iff.1 ht _).2 ⟨Z, hZ, hdense, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨ofPair ((ofTuple P₁).comp (ofTuple Q₁) (congrFun h₁ 0)),
      ⟨ofTuple P₁, ofTuple Q₁, congrFun h₁ 0, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    · exact (hre (Function.const (Fin 1) P.source) (Function.const (Fin 1) P.target)).trans
        ((congrArg (Ideal.comap (rename (R := k) e)) hP).trans (hre P₁.source P₁.target).symm)
    · exact (hre (Function.const (Fin 1) Q.source) (Function.const (Fin 1) Q.target)).trans
        ((congrArg (Ideal.comap (rename (R := k) e)) hQ).trans (hre Q₁.source Q₁.target).symm)
    · exact (hre P₁.source Q₁.target).trans
        (congrArg (Ideal.comap (rename (R := k) e)) (hE.symm.trans hEZ))

name: AclGeom.exists_tensorProduct_quotient_algEquiv
statement:
private theorem exists_tensorProduct_quotient_algEquiv [Algebra 𝒜 ℬ] [Algebra 𝒜 𝒞]
    [IsScalarTower k 𝒜 ℬ]
    (h₁ : ∀ p, algebraMap 𝒜 ℬ (Ideal.Quotient.mk I₀ p) = Ideal.Quotient.mk I (rename Sum.inr p))
    (h₂ : ∀ p, algebraMap 𝒜 𝒞 (Ideal.Quotient.mk I₀ p) = Ideal.Quotient.mk I' (rename Sum.inl p)) :
    ∃ Φ : ℬ ⊗[𝒜] 𝒞 ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial ((σ ⊕ τ) ⊕ ρ) k ⧸ 𝒥,
      (∀ p q, Φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk I p ⊗ₜ Ideal.Quotient.mk I' q) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝒥 (rename Sum.inl p * rename ι₂ q)) ∧
      ∀ p, Φ (algebraMap 𝒜 (ℬ ⊗[𝒜] 𝒞) (Ideal.Quotient.mk I₀ p)) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝒥 (rename (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) p)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hI (p : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) k) (hp : p ∈ I) :
      ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k 𝒥).comp (rename Sum.inl)) p = 0 := by
    rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    exact Ideal.mem_sup_left (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hp)
  have hI' (q : MvPolynomial (τ ⊕ ρ) k) (hq : q ∈ I') :
      ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k 𝒥).comp (rename ι₂)) q = 0 := by
    rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    exact Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hq)
  let fk := Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ I ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k 𝒥).comp (rename Sum.inl)) hI
  let gk := Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ I' ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k 𝒥).comp (rename ι₂)) hI'
  have hf (p : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) k) :
      fk (Ideal.Quotient.mk I p) = Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝒥 (rename Sum.inl p) := rfl
  have hg (q : MvPolynomial (τ ⊕ ρ) k) :
      gk (Ideal.Quotient.mk I' q) = Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝒥 (rename ι₂ q) := rfl
  
  have hmid (r : 𝒜) : gk (algebraMap 𝒜 𝒞 r) = fk (algebraMap 𝒜 ℬ r) := by
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective r
    rw [h₁, h₂, hf, hg, rename_rename, rename_rename, Sum.elim_comp_inl]
  let _ : Algebra 𝒜 (MvPolynomial ((σ ⊕ τ) ⊕ ρ) k ⧸ 𝒥) :=
    (fk.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap 𝒜 ℬ)).toAlgebra
  let fQ : ℬ →ₐ[𝒜] MvPolynomial ((σ ⊕ τ) ⊕ ρ) k ⧸ 𝒥 :=
    { fk.toRingHom with commutes' := fun _ ↦ rfl }
  let gQ : 𝒞 →ₐ[𝒜] MvPolynomial ((σ ⊕ τ) ⊕ ρ) k ⧸ 𝒥 :=
    { gk.toRingHom with commutes' := hmid }
  let F := Algebra.TensorProduct.lift fQ gQ fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _
  have hF (a : ℬ) (b : 𝒞) : F (a ⊗ₜ b) = fk a * gk b := Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul _ _ _ a b
  let Fk : ℬ ⊗[𝒜] 𝒞 →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial ((σ ⊕ τ) ⊕ ρ) k ⧸ 𝒥 :=
    { F.toRingHom with
      commutes' := fun c ↦ by
        change F (algebraMap k ℬ c ⊗ₜ[𝒜] (1 : 𝒞)) = _
        rw [hF, map_one, mul_one, AlgHom.commutes] }
  
  have hswap (s : 𝒜) : algebraMap 𝒜 ℬ s ⊗ₜ[𝒜] (1 : 𝒞) = (1 : ℬ) ⊗ₜ[𝒜] algebraMap 𝒜 𝒞 s :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply s).symm.trans
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply' s)
  let G₀ : MvPolynomial ((σ ⊕ τ) ⊕ ρ) k →ₐ[k] ℬ ⊗[𝒜] 𝒞 :=
    aeval (Sum.elim (fun i ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk I (X i) ⊗ₜ (1 : 𝒞))
      (fun c ↦ (1 : ℬ) ⊗ₜ Ideal.Quotient.mk I' (X (Sum.inr c))))
  have hG₀X (i : (σ ⊕ τ) ⊕ ρ) : G₀ (X i) = Sum.elim (fun i ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk I (X i) ⊗ₜ (1 : 𝒞))
      (fun c ↦ (1 : ℬ) ⊗ₜ Ideal.Quotient.mk I' (X (Sum.inr c))) i := aeval_X _ i
  have hG₀C (r : k) : G₀ (C r) = algebraMap k (ℬ ⊗[𝒜] 𝒞) r := aeval_C _ r
  have H1 (p : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) k) :
      G₀ (rename Sum.inl p) = Ideal.Quotient.mk I p ⊗ₜ (1 : 𝒞) := by
    have : G₀.comp (rename Sum.inl) =
        Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k I) :=
      MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun i ↦ by
        simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, rename_X, hG₀X, Sum.elim_inl,
          Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_apply, Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk]
    exact AlgHom.congr_fun this p
  have H2 (q : MvPolynomial (τ ⊕ ρ) k) :
      G₀ (rename ι₂ q) = (1 : ℬ) ⊗ₜ Ideal.Quotient.mk I' q := by
    have : (G₀ : MvPolynomial ((σ ⊕ τ) ⊕ ρ) k →+* ℬ ⊗[𝒜] 𝒞).comp
        (rename ι₂ : MvPolynomial (τ ⊕ ρ) k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial ((σ ⊕ τ) ⊕ ρ) k).toRingHom =
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : 𝒞 →ₐ[𝒜] ℬ ⊗[𝒜] 𝒞) : 𝒞 →+* ℬ ⊗[𝒜] 𝒞).comp
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk I') := by
      refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun r ↦ ?_) (fun i ↦ ?_)
      · have hB : algebraMap 𝒜 ℬ (Ideal.Quotient.mk I₀ (C r)) = algebraMap k ℬ r :=
          (h₁ (C r)).trans (congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) (rename_C _ r))
        change G₀ (rename ι₂ (C r)) = (1 : ℬ) ⊗ₜ Ideal.Quotient.mk I' (C r)
        rw [rename_C, hG₀C, Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply, ← hB, hswap, h₂, rename_C]
      · rcases i with b | c
        · change G₀ (rename ι₂ (X (Sum.inl b))) =
            (1 : ℬ) ⊗ₜ Ideal.Quotient.mk I' (X (Sum.inl b))
          rw [rename_X, hG₀X]
          change Ideal.Quotient.mk I (X (Sum.inr b)) ⊗ₜ (1 : 𝒞) = _
          rw [← rename_X Sum.inr b, ← h₁, hswap, h₂, rename_X]
        · change G₀ (rename ι₂ (X (Sum.inr c))) =
            (1 : ℬ) ⊗ₜ Ideal.Quotient.mk I' (X (Sum.inr c))
          rw [rename_X, hG₀X]
          rfl
    exact RingHom.congr_fun this q
  have hG (a : MvPolynomial ((σ ⊕ τ) ⊕ ρ) k) (ha : a ∈ 𝒥) : G₀ a = 0 := by
    have hle : 𝒥 ≤ RingHom.ker G₀ := by
      refine sup_le ?_ ?_
      · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
        intro p hp
        rw [Ideal.mem_comap, RingHom.mem_ker, H1, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.2 hp,
          TensorProduct.zero_tmul]
      · rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
        intro q hq
        rw [Ideal.mem_comap, RingHom.mem_ker, H2, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.2 hq,
          TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
    exact hle ha
  let G := Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ 𝒥 G₀ hG
  have hGmk (a : MvPolynomial ((σ ⊕ τ) ⊕ ρ) k) : G (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝒥 a) = G₀ a := rfl
  have hFG : Fk.comp G = AlgHom.id k _ := by
    refine Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext k (MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun i ↦ ?_)
    rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.comp_apply, Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk,
      AlgHom.id_apply, hGmk, hG₀X]
    rcases i with i | c
    · change F (Ideal.Quotient.mk I (X i) ⊗ₜ (1 : 𝒞)) = _
      rw [hF, map_one, mul_one, hf, rename_X]
    · change F ((1 : ℬ) ⊗ₜ Ideal.Quotient.mk I' (X (Sum.inr c))) = _
      rw [hF, map_one, one_mul, hg, rename_X]
      rfl
  have hGF : G.comp Fk = AlgHom.id k _ := by
    refine AlgHom.ext fun w ↦ ?_
    induction w using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul a b =>
      obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a
      obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective b
      change G (F (Ideal.Quotient.mk I p ⊗ₜ Ideal.Quotient.mk I' q)) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk I p ⊗ₜ Ideal.Quotient.mk I' q
      rw [hF, hf, hg, map_mul, hGmk, hGmk, H1, H2, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one,
        one_mul]
    | add w₁ w₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [map_add, map_add, h₁, h₂]
  refine ⟨AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom Fk G hFG hGF, fun p q ↦ ?_, fun p ↦ ?_⟩
  · change F (Ideal.Quotient.mk I p ⊗ₜ Ideal.Quotient.mk I' q) = _
    rw [hF, hf, hg, map_mul]
  · change F (algebraMap 𝒜 ℬ (Ideal.Quotient.mk I₀ p) ⊗ₜ[𝒜] (1 : 𝒞)) = _
    rw [hF, map_one, mul_one, h₁, hf, rename_rename]

name: AclGeom.idealOf_le_comap_rename_comp
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, ← rename_rename]
  exact hJ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (Ideal.mem_comap.1 ((idealOf_eq_comap_rename h).le hp)))

name: AclGeom.exists_locusIncidence_algEquiv
statement:
theorem exists_locusIncidence_algEquiv :
    letI : Algebra 𝒜 ℬ
proof:
:= (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim x y)) (rename Sum.inr)
      (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim x y) (b := y) (g := Sum.inr)
        rfl).le).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra 𝒜 𝒞 := (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim y z)) (rename Sum.inl)
      (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim y z) (b := y) (g := Sum.inl)
        rfl).le).toAlgebra
    haveI : IsScalarTower k 𝒜 ℬ := .of_algHom _
    ∃ Φ : ℬ ⊗[𝒜] 𝒞 ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k ⧸
        (Ideal.map (rename (Sum.inl : α ⊕ β → (α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ)) (idealOf k (Sum.elim x y)) ⊔
          Ideal.map (rename (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) Sum.inr : β ⊕ γ → (α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ))
            (idealOf k (Sum.elim y z))),
      (∀ (p : MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) k) (q : MvPolynomial (β ⊕ γ) k),
        Φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p ⊗ₜ Ideal.Quotient.mk _ q) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _
          (rename Sum.inl p * rename (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) Sum.inr) q)) ∧
      ∀ p : MvPolynomial β k, Φ (algebraMap 𝒜 (ℬ ⊗[𝒜] 𝒞) (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p)) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (rename (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) p) := by
  
  let _ : Algebra 𝒜 ℬ := (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim x y)) (rename Sum.inr)
    (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim x y) (b := y) (g := Sum.inr)
      rfl).le).toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝒜 𝒞 := (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim y z)) (rename Sum.inl)
    (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim y z) (b := y) (g := Sum.inl)
      rfl).le).toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower k 𝒜 ℬ := .of_algHom _
  exact exists_tensorProduct_quotient_algEquiv (idealOf k (Sum.elim x y))
    (idealOf k (Sum.elim y z)) (idealOf k y) (fun _ ↦ rfl) (fun _ ↦ rfl)

name: AclGeom.AffineTransformation.translations_mem_of_normal_ne_bot
statement:
theorem translations_mem_of_normal_ne_bot (S : Subgroup (AffineTransformation k))
    [S.Normal] (hS : S ≠ ⊥) (b : k) : translation b ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨g, hg⟩, hg1⟩ := Subgroup.ne_bot_iff_exists_ne_one.mp hS
  have hg1 : g ≠ 1 := fun h ↦ hg1 (Subtype.ext h)
  by_cases ha : (g.multiplier : k) = 1
  · have hge : g = translation g.shift := by
      apply AffineTransformation.ext
      · exact Units.ext ha
      · rfl
    have hgshift : g.shift ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      apply hg1
      rw [hge]
      ext <;> simp [translation, hz]
    by_cases hb : b = 0
    · subst b
      convert S.one_mem using 1
      ext <;> simp [translation]
    · let a : kˣ := Units.mk0 (b / g.shift) (div_ne_zero hb hgshift)
      have hm := (inferInstance : S.Normal).conj_mem g hg (scaling a)
      rw [hge, mul_translation_mul_inv] at hm
      change translation ((b / g.shift) * g.shift) ∈ S at hm
      rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hgshift] at hm
  · let c := b / ((g.multiplier : k) - 1)
    have hm := S.mul_mem hg
      ((inferInstance : S.Normal).conj_mem g⁻¹ (S.inv_mem hg) (translation c))
    have he : g * (translation c * g⁻¹ * (translation c)⁻¹) =
        translation (((g.multiplier : k) - 1) * c) := by
      calc
        _ = (g * translation c * g⁻¹) * (translation c)⁻¹ := by
          rw [← _root_.mul_assoc, ← _root_.mul_assoc]
        _ = translation ((g.multiplier : k) * c) * translation (-c) := by
          rw [mul_translation_mul_inv, translation_inv]
        _ = _ := by rw [translation_mul_translation]; congr 1; ring
    rw [he] at hm
    change translation (((g.multiplier : k) - 1) *
      (b / ((g.multiplier : k) - 1))) ∈ S at hm
    rwa [mul_div_cancel₀ _ (sub_ne_zero.mpr ha)] at hm

name: AclGeom.AffineGroupScheme.exists_finite_chart
statement:
theorem exists_finite_chart (G : AlgebraicGroup k)
    (f : G.Hom (algebraicGroup k))
    (Φ : (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) →* AffineTransformation k)
    (hΦinj : Function.Injective Φ)
    (hpoint : ∀ q, pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom) = Φ q)
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A]
    (g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X)
    [IsOpenImmersion g.left] (d a b : A) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (hab : AlgebraicIndependent k
      (![algebraMap A (FractionRing A) a / algebraMap A (FractionRing A) d,
        algebraMap A (FractionRing A) b / algebraMap A (FractionRing A) d] :
          Fin 2 → FractionRing A))
    (hraw : ∀ (φ : A →ₐ[k] k), φ d ≠ 0 →
      ((Φ ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
        (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)).multiplier : k) =
          φ a / φ d ∧
      (Φ ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
        (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)).shift = φ b / φ d) :
    ∃ (U T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (jU : U ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X)
      (jT : T ⟶ (algebraicGroup k).toGroupScheme.X) (π : U ⟶ T),
      IsOpenImmersion jU.left ∧ IsOpenImmersion jT.left ∧
      Nonempty U.left ∧ Nonempty T.left ∧ IsFinite π.left ∧ Surjective π.left ∧
      jU ≫ f.hom.hom = π ≫ jT
proof:
:= by
  have : Mono g := Over.mono_of_mono_left g
  obtain ⟨ψ, hm, hvalues⟩ := exists_chart_coordinates G f Φ hpoint g
  let C := FractionRing A
  let evC : A →ₐ[k] C := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A C
  have hevCinj : Function.Injective evC := IsFractionRing.injective A C
  have hdC : evC d ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hd
    apply hevCinj
    simpa only [map_zero] using h
  have hclear (s c : A) (hc : ∀ (φ : A →ₐ[k] k), φ d ≠ 0 → φ s = φ c / φ d) :
      d * s = c := by
    apply sub_eq_zero.mp
    have hz : d * (d * s - c) = 0 := IsNilpotent.eq_zero
      (isNilpotent_of_forall_algHom_eq_zero (k := k) (fun φ ↦ by
        by_cases hφ : φ d = 0
        · rw [map_mul, hφ, zero_mul]
        · have he : φ d * φ s = φ c := by
            rw [mul_comm, hc φ hφ]
            exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ hφ
          simp only [map_mul, map_sub, he, sub_self, mul_zero]))
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left hd
  have haA : d * ψ (dilationUnit k) = a :=
    hclear _ _ (fun φ hφ ↦ (hvalues φ).1.trans (hraw φ hφ).1)
  have hbA : d * ψ (translation k) = b :=
    hclear _ _ (fun φ hφ ↦ (hvalues φ).2.trans (hraw φ hφ).2)
  have haC : evC (ψ (dilationUnit k)) = evC a / evC d := by
    apply (eq_div_iff hdC).mpr
    exact (mul_comm _ _).trans ((map_mul evC _ _).symm.trans (congrArg evC haA))
  have hbC : evC (ψ (translation k)) = evC b / evC d := by
    apply (eq_div_iff hdC).mpr
    exact (mul_comm _ _).trans ((map_mul evC _ _).symm.trans (congrArg evC hbA))
  let ρ : CoordinateRing k →ₐ[k] C := evC.comp ψ
  let au : Cˣ := Units.map ρ.toMonoidHom (dilationUnit k)
  let bz : C := ρ (translation k)
  have hρ : eval k au bz = ρ := (homCoordinates k C).left_inv ρ
  have hAI : AlgebraicIndependent k (![(au : C), bz] : Fin 2 → C) := by
    change AlgebraicIndependent k
      (![evC (ψ (dilationUnit k)), evC (ψ (translation k))] : Fin 2 → C)
    rw [haC, hbC]
    exact hab
  have hρinj : Function.Injective ρ := by
    rw [← hρ]
    exact eval_injective_of_algebraicIndependent au bz hAI
  have hψinj : Function.Injective ψ := fun _ _ h ↦ hρinj (congrArg evC h)
  have hpoints : Function.Injective (fun φ : A →ₐ[k] k ↦ φ.comp ψ) := by
    intro φ χ heq
    let sp (θ : A →ₐ[k] k) : (Spec (.of k)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶
        (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) :=
      (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom θ).op
    let q (θ : A →ₐ[k] k) := (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ sp θ ≫ g
    have ha : ((Φ (q φ)).multiplier : k) = ((Φ (q χ)).multiplier : k) :=
      (hvalues φ).1.symm.trans
        ((AlgHom.congr_fun heq (dilationUnit k)).trans (hvalues χ).1)
    have hb : (Φ (q φ)).shift = (Φ (q χ)).shift :=
      (hvalues φ).2.symm.trans
        ((AlgHom.congr_fun heq (translation k)).trans (hvalues χ).2)
    have hq : q φ = q χ := hΦinj (AffineTransformation.ext (Units.ext ha) hb)
    have hmap : sp φ = sp χ := by
      apply (cancel_epi (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom).mp
      apply (cancel_mono g).mp
      exact (Category.assoc (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom (sp φ) g).trans
        (hq.trans (Category.assoc (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom (sp χ) g).symm)
    have hleft := congrArg
      (fun z : (Spec (.of k)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶
        (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ↦ z.left) hmap
    change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom χ.toRingHom) at hleft
    ext z
    exact congrArg (fun h : CommRingCat.of A ⟶ CommRingCat.of k ↦ h.hom z)
      (Spec.map_injective hleft)
