  exact GenericFiniteCover.exists_finite_open_square ψ hψinj hpoints
    G.toGroupScheme.X g f.hom.hom hm

name: AclGeom.idealOf_aeval_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq
proof:
:= by
  ext F
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, mem_idealOf_iff]
  have ha : aeval (fun j ↦ aeval a (g j)) F = aeval a (bind₁ g F) := (aeval_bind₁ a g F).symm
  have hb : aeval (fun j ↦ aeval b (g j)) F = aeval b (bind₁ g F) := (aeval_bind₁ b g F).symm
  rw [ha, hb]
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hm : bind₁ g F ∈ idealOf k a := (mem_idealOf_iff k).2 hz
    exact (mem_idealOf_iff k).1 (h ▸ hm)
  · intro hz
    have hm : bind₁ g F ∈ idealOf k b := (mem_idealOf_iff k).2 hz
    exact (mem_idealOf_iff k).1 (h.symm ▸ hm)

name: AclGeom.affine_multiplier_curve_of_joint_ideal
statement:
theorem affine_multiplier_curve_of_joint_ideal {a b x c p δ f a' b' x' : K}
    (hJ : idealOf k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a', b', x']) =
      idealOf k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a, b, x]))
    (hfm : f ∈ racl k ({a * c, x} : Set K)) (hfu : f ∉ racl k ({a * c} : Set K)) :
    idealOf k ![f, a' * c, x'] = idealOf k ![f, a * c, x] ∧
      f ∈ racl k ({a' * c, x'} : Set K) ∧ f ∉ racl k ({a' * c} : Set K) ∧
      x' ∈ racl k ({a' * c, f} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hI := idealOf_aeval_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq hJ
    (![X (Sum.inl 4), X (Sum.inr 0) * X (Sum.inl 3), X (Sum.inr 2)] :
      Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 3) k)
  have hnew : (fun j ↦ aeval (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a', b', x'])
      ((![X (Sum.inl 4), X (Sum.inr 0) * X (Sum.inl 3), X (Sum.inr 2)] :
        Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 3) k) j)) = ![f, a' * c, x'] := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp
  have hold : (fun j ↦ aeval (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a, b, x])
      ((![X (Sum.inl 4), X (Sum.inr 0) * X (Sum.inl 3), X (Sum.inr 2)] :
        Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 3) k) j)) = ![f, a * c, x] := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp
  rw [hnew, hold] at hI
  
  have hm' : f ∈ racl k ({a' * c, x'} : Set K) := by
    have h : (![f, a * c, x] : Fin 3 → K) 0 ∈
        racl k ((![f, a * c, x] : Fin 3 → K) '' {1, 2}) := by
      simpa [Set.image_insert_eq] using hfm
    have h' := mem_racl_image_of_idealOf_eq k hI.symm h
    simpa [Set.image_insert_eq] using h'
  have hu' : f ∉ racl k ({a' * c} : Set K) := by
    have h : (![f, a * c, x] : Fin 3 → K) 0 ∉ racl k ((![f, a * c, x] : Fin 3 → K) '' {1}) := by
      simpa using hfu
    have h' := notMem_racl_image_of_idealOf_eq k hI.symm h
    simpa using h'
  
  have hx' : x' ∈ racl k ({a' * c, f} : Set K) := by
    have h : f ∈ racl k (insert x' ({a' * c} : Set K)) := by
      rwa [Set.pair_comm] at hm'
    have h' := racl_exchange h hu'
    rwa [Set.pair_comm] at h'
  exact ⟨hI, hm', hu', hx'⟩

name: AclGeom.multiplier_projection_genericity
statement:
theorem multiplier_projection_genericity {A B M X f : K}
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![A, B, M, X])
    (hf : f ∈ racl k ({M, X} : Set K)) (hfM : f ∉ racl k ({M} : Set K)) :
    X ∈ racl k ({M, f} : Set K) ∧ M ∉ racl k ({A, B, f} : Set K) ∧
      f ∉ racl k ({A, B} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hX3 : X ∉ racl k ({A, B, M} : Set K) := by
    have h := AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_image hind (S := {0, 1, 2}) (i := 3) (by decide)
    simpa [Set.image_insert_eq] using h
  have hX2 : X ∉ racl k ({A, M} : Set K) := by
    have h := AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_image hind (S := {0, 2}) (i := 3) (by decide)
    simpa [Set.image_insert_eq] using h
  have hM2 : M ∉ racl k ({A, B} : Set K) := by
    have h := AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_image hind (S := {0, 1}) (i := 2) (by decide)
    simpa [Set.image_insert_eq] using h
  
  have key : f ∈ racl k ({A, B, M} : Set K) → f ∈ racl k ({M} : Set K) := by
    intro h
    have hsub1 : ({A, B, M} : Set K) ⊆ racl k (insert B ({A, M} : Set K)) :=
      Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨subset_racl k _ (by simp), Set.insert_subset_iff.2
        ⟨subset_racl k _ (by simp), Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (subset_racl k _ (by simp))⟩⟩
    have hsub2 : ({M, X} : Set K) ⊆ racl k (insert X ({A, M} : Set K)) :=
      Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨subset_racl k _ (by simp),
        Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (subset_racl k _ (by simp))⟩
    have hsub3 : insert B ({A, M} : Set K) ⊆ racl k ({A, B, M} : Set K) :=
      Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨subset_racl k _ (by simp), Set.insert_subset_iff.2
        ⟨subset_racl k _ (by simp), Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (subset_racl k _ (by simp))⟩⟩
    have hAM : f ∈ racl k ({A, M} : Set K) :=
      mem_racl_of_mem_racl_insert (racl_le_of_subset_racl hsub1 h)
        (racl_le_of_subset_racl hsub2 hf) fun hx ↦ hX3 (racl_le_of_subset_racl hsub3 hx)
    have hsub4 : ({M, X} : Set K) ⊆ racl k (insert X ({M} : Set K)) :=
      Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨subset_racl k _ (by simp),
        Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (subset_racl k _ (by simp))⟩
    exact mem_racl_of_mem_racl_insert hAM (racl_le_of_subset_racl hsub4 hf) hX2
  
  have hXf : X ∈ racl k ({M, f} : Set K) := by
    have h : f ∈ racl k (insert X ({M} : Set K)) := by
      rwa [Set.pair_comm] at hf
    have h' := racl_exchange h hfM
    rwa [Set.pair_comm] at h'
  refine ⟨hXf, fun hM ↦ ?_, fun hfAB ↦ hfM (key (racl_mono ?_ hfAB))⟩
  · 
    have hsub5 : ({A, B, f} : Set K) ⊆ racl k (insert f ({A, B} : Set K)) :=
      Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨subset_racl k _ (by simp), Set.insert_subset_iff.2
        ⟨subset_racl k _ (by simp), Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (subset_racl k _ (by simp))⟩⟩
    have hfABM := racl_exchange (racl_le_of_subset_racl hsub5 hM) hM2
    have hsub6 : insert M ({A, B} : Set K) ⊆ racl k ({A, B, M} : Set K) :=
      Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨subset_racl k _ (by simp), Set.insert_subset_iff.2
        ⟨subset_racl k _ (by simp), Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (subset_racl k _ (by simp))⟩⟩
    exact hfM (key (racl_le_of_subset_racl hsub6 hfABM))
  · exact Set.insert_subset_insert (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (by simp))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.PartialMap.fromFunctionField_eq_functionFieldMorphismOfHom
statement:
lemma PartialMap.fromFunctionField_eq_functionFieldMorphismOfHom [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y]
    (f : X.PartialMap Y) [IsDominant f.hom] :
    f.fromFunctionField = functionFieldMorphismOfHom f.functionFieldMap
proof:
:=
  functionFieldMorphism_eq_of_functionFieldMapOfMorphism_eq f.fromFunctionField_closedPoint
    (functionFieldMorphismOfHom_closedPoint _)
    (functionFieldMap_functionFieldMorphismOfHom f.functionFieldMap).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.fromFunctionField_toPartialMap
statement:
lemma Hom.fromFunctionField_toPartialMap [IrreducibleSpace X] (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    f.toPartialMap.fromFunctionField = X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X) ≫ f
proof:
:=
  PartialMap.fromSpecStalkOfMem_toPartialMap f _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap_congr
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap_comp
statement:
lemma Hom.functionFieldMap_comp [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y] [IsIntegral Z] (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (g : Y ⟶ Z) [IsDominant f] [IsDominant g] :
    (f ≫ g).toPartialMap.functionFieldMap =
      g.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap ≫ f.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap
proof:
:= by
  apply PartialMap.functionFieldMap_eq_of_fromFunctionField_eq_hom
  have hf := PartialMap.fromFunctionField_eq_functionFieldMorphismOfHom f.toPartialMap
  have hg := PartialMap.fromFunctionField_eq_functionFieldMorphismOfHom g.toPartialMap
  rw [Hom.fromFunctionField_toPartialMap] at hf hg ⊢
  change _ = Spec.map _ ≫ Z.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Z)
  change _ = Spec.map _ ≫ Y.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Y) at hf
  change _ = Spec.map _ ≫ Z.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Z) at hg
  rw [← Category.assoc, hf, Category.assoc, hg, Spec.map_comp, Category.assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap_id
statement:
lemma Hom.functionFieldMap_id [IsIntegral X] :
    (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X).toPartialMap.functionFieldMap = 𝟙 X.functionField
proof:
:= by
  apply PartialMap.functionFieldMap_eq_of_fromFunctionField_eq_hom
  rw [Hom.fromFunctionField_toPartialMap]
  change _ = Spec.map (𝟙 _) ≫ _
  rw [Spec.map_id, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.isDominant_fromSpecStalk_genericPoint
statement:
lemma isDominant_fromSpecStalk_genericPoint [IrreducibleSpace X] :
    IsDominant (X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X))
proof:
:=
  ⟨by
    rw [denseRange_iff_closure_range, ← Set.univ_subset_iff, ← genericPoint_closure X]
    exact closure_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 ⟨_, fromSpecStalk_closedPoint⟩)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CategoryTheory.ModObj.pointAct_one
statement: lemma pointAct_one : pointAct X (1 : 𝟙_ C ⟶ M) = 𝟙 X
proof:
:= by
  change (toUnit X ≫ (1 : 𝟙_ C ⟶ M)) • 𝟙 X = 𝟙 X
  rw [MonObj.comp_one, _root_.one_smul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.CategoryTheory.ModObj.pointAct_mul
statement:
lemma pointAct_mul (g h : 𝟙_ C ⟶ M) :
    pointAct X (g * h) = pointAct X h ≫ pointAct X g
proof:
:= by
  change (toUnit X ≫ (g * h)) • 𝟙 X = ((toUnit X ≫ h) • 𝟙 X) ≫ ((toUnit X ≫ g) • 𝟙 X)
  rw [MonObj.comp_mul, ← smul_smul, ModObj.comp_smul, ← Category.assoc, comp_toUnit,
    Category.comp_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AclGeom.ActionFunctionField.isDominant_hom
statement: lemma isDominant_hom (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [Nonempty V.left] : IsDominant V.hom
proof:
:=
  have : Surjective V.hom := ⟨fun _ ↦ ⟨Classical.arbitrary V.left, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩⟩
  inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AclGeom.ActionFunctionField.isIso_hom_left
statement: lemma isIso_hom_left {V W : Over (Spec (.of k))} (e : V ≅ W) : IsIso e.hom.left
proof:
:=
  inferInstanceAs (IsIso ((Over.forget _).map e.hom))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AclGeom.ActionFunctionField.isIso_inv_left
statement: lemma isIso_inv_left {V W : Over (Spec (.of k))} (e : V ≅ W) : IsIso e.inv.left
proof:
:=
  inferInstanceAs (IsIso ((Over.forget _).map e.inv))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AclGeom.ActionFunctionField.functionFieldMap_algebraMap
statement:
lemma functionFieldMap_algebraMap {V W : Over (Spec (.of k))} [IsIntegral V.left]
    [IsIntegral W.left] (f : V ⟶ W) [IsDominant f.left] (c : k) :
    f.left.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap.hom (algebraMap k W.left.functionField c) =
      algebraMap k V.left.functionField c
proof:
:= by
  have := isDominant_hom V
  have := isDominant_hom W
  change (W.hom.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap ≫ f.left.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap).hom
      (algebraMap k (Spec (.of k)).functionField c) =
    V.hom.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap.hom (algebraMap k (Spec (.of k)).functionField c)
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap_comp, Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap_congr (Over.w f)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AclGeom.ActionFunctionField.algEquivOfIso_apply
statement:
theorem algEquivOfIso_apply {V : Over (Spec (.of k))} [IsIntegral V.left] (e : V ≅ V)
    (x : V.left.functionField) :
    algEquivOfIso e x = e.hom.left.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap.hom x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AclGeom.ActionFunctionField.algEquivOfIso_refl
statement:
lemma algEquivOfIso_refl {V : Over (Spec (.of k))} [IsIntegral V.left] :
    algEquivOfIso (Iso.refl V) = 1
proof:
:=
  AlgEquiv.ext fun x ↦
    congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.hom x) (Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap_id (X := V.left))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AclGeom.ActionFunctionField.algEquivOfIso_trans
statement:
lemma algEquivOfIso_trans {V : Over (Spec (.of k))} [IsIntegral V.left] (e e' : V ≅ V) :
    algEquivOfIso (e ≪≫ e') = algEquivOfIso e * algEquivOfIso e'
proof:
:=
  AlgEquiv.ext fun x ↦
    congrArg (fun φ ↦ φ.hom x) (Scheme.Hom.functionFieldMap_comp e.hom.left e'.hom.left)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AclGeom.ActionFunctionField.eq_refl_of_algEquivOfIso_eq_one
statement:
lemma eq_refl_of_algEquivOfIso_eq_one {V : Over (Spec (.of k))} [IsIntegral V.left]
    [IsSeparated V.hom] (e : V ≅ V) (he : algEquivOfIso e = 1) : e = Iso.refl V
proof:
:= by
  have hK : e.hom.left.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap = 𝟙 V.left.functionField := by
    ext x
    exact congrArg (fun σ : V.left.functionField ≃ₐ[k] V.left.functionField ↦ σ x) he
  have h1 := Scheme.PartialMap.fromFunctionField_eq_functionFieldMorphismOfHom
    e.hom.left.toPartialMap
  rw [Scheme.Hom.fromFunctionField_toPartialMap, hK] at h1
  change _ = Spec.map (𝟙 _) ≫ _ at h1
  rw [Spec.map_id, Category.id_comp] at h1
  have := Scheme.isDominant_fromSpecStalk_genericPoint (X := V.left)
  have he' : e.hom.left = 𝟙 V.left :=
    ext_of_isDominant_of_isSeparated V.hom ((Over.w e.hom).trans (Category.id_comp _).symm)
      (V.left.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint V.left)) (h1.trans (Category.comp_id _).symm)
  exact Iso.ext (Over.OverMorphism.ext he')

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AclGeom.ActionFunctionField.autFunctionField_injective
statement:
theorem autFunctionField_injective (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left]
    [IsSeparated V.hom] : Function.Injective (autFunctionField V)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_one]
  intro e he
  exact eq_refl_of_algEquivOfIso_eq_one e (MulOpposite.op_injective he)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AclGeom.ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction_injective
statement:
theorem functionFieldAction_injective (G : AlgebraicGroup k) (V : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [IsIntegral V.left] [IsSeparated V.hom] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (hker : ∀ g : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X, ModObj.pointAct V g = 𝟙 V →
      g = 1) :
    Function.Injective (functionFieldAction G V)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : Function.Injective
      (ModObj.pointAut V : (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) →* Aut V) := by
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_one]
    intro g hg
    exact hker g (congrArg Iso.hom hg)
  exact (autFunctionField_injective V).comp h2

name: AclGeom.prime_translate_iff
statement:
theorem prime_translate_iff {σ : Type*} (c : σ → k) {G : MvPolynomial σ k} :
    Prime (translate c G) ↔ Prime G
proof:
:= by
  let T : MvPolynomial σ k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k :=
    AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom (translate c) (translate (-c))
      (AlgHom.ext fun g ↦ by
        rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply]
        exact translate_translate_neg c g)
      (AlgHom.ext fun g ↦ by
        rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply]
        exact translate_neg_translate c g)
  exact MulEquiv.prime_iff T

name: AclGeom.mem_span_rename_inl_of_forall_aevalFst_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcoeff : ∀ m, (toVUPoly (k := k) f).coeff m ∈ Ideal.span {G} := by
    intro m
    refine hker _ fun c hc ↦ ?_
    have h := congrArg (fun p ↦ p.coeff m) (hf c hc)
    simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero] at h
    rwa [coeff_aevalFst] at h
  have hspan : toVUPoly (k := k) f ∈
      Ideal.span {(C G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k))} :=
    mem_span_C_iff.2 hcoeff
  rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hspan
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hspan
  rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
  refine ⟨fromVUPoly (k := k) q, ?_⟩
  have h1 := congrArg (fromVUPoly (k := k)) hq
  rw [map_mul, fromVUPoly_toVUPoly] at h1
  rw [← h1]
  congr 1
  simp [fromVUPoly]

name: AclGeom.addSubst_eq_of_mem_span_rename_inl
statement:
private theorem addSubst_eq_of_mem_span_rename_inl {G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k}
    (hGp : Prime G) (hG0 : constantCoeff G = 0)
    (hmeml : addSubst (k := k) G - rename Sum.inl G - rename Sum.inr G ∈
      Ideal.span {rename (Sum.inl : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) G}) :
    addSubst (k := k) G = rename Sum.inl G + rename Sum.inr G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hswapAdd : rename Sum.swap (addSubst (k := k) G) =
      addSubst (k := k) G := by
    have hcomp : ((rename
        (Sum.swap : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2)).toRingHom.comp
        (addSubst (k := k)).toRingHom) = (addSubst (k := k)).toRingHom := by
      refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) (fun j ↦ ?_)
      · simp [addSubst, MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
      · simp [addSubst, add_comm]
    exact congrArg (fun (F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →+* _) ↦ F G) hcomp
  have hswapl : rename Sum.swap
      (rename (Sum.inl : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) G) = rename Sum.inr G := by
    rw [rename_rename]
    congr 1
  have hswapr : rename Sum.swap
      (rename (Sum.inr : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) G) = rename Sum.inl G := by
    rw [rename_rename]
    congr 1
  have hswapD : rename Sum.swap
      (addSubst (k := k) G - rename Sum.inl G - rename Sum.inr G) =
      addSubst (k := k) G - rename Sum.inl G - rename Sum.inr G := by
    rw [map_sub, map_sub, hswapAdd, hswapl, hswapr]
    ring
  have hmemr : (addSubst (k := k) G - rename Sum.inl G - rename Sum.inr G) ∈
      Ideal.span {rename (Sum.inr : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) G} := by
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hmeml ⊢
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hmeml
    refine ⟨rename Sum.swap R, ?_⟩
    have h := congrArg
      (rename (Sum.swap : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2)) hR
    rwa [map_mul, hswapl, hswapD] at h
  have hpl := prime_rename_inl (k := k) hGp
  have hpr := prime_rename_inr (k := k) hGp
  have hndvd : ¬ rename (Sum.inl : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) G ∣
      rename Sum.inr G := by
    intro hdvd
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hdvd
    have h := congrArg
      (aeval (Sum.elim (fun _ ↦ (0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)) X)) hu
    rw [map_mul] at h
    have h1 : aeval (Sum.elim (fun _ ↦ (0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)) X)
        (rename (Sum.inr : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) G) = G := by
      rw [aeval_rename]
      have hcompr : ((Sum.elim (fun _ ↦ (0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)) X :
          Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2 → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) ∘ Sum.inr) = X := by
        funext j
        rfl
      rw [hcompr, aeval_X_left_apply]
    have h2 : aeval (Sum.elim (fun _ ↦ (0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)) X)
        (rename (Sum.inl : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) G) = 0 := by
      rw [aeval_rename]
      have hcompl : ((Sum.elim (fun _ ↦ (0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)) X :
          Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2 → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) ∘ Sum.inl) =
          (0 : Fin 2 → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) := by
        funext j
        rfl
      rw [hcompl, MvPolynomial.aeval_zero, hG0, map_zero]
    rw [h1, h2, zero_mul] at h
    exact hGp.ne_zero h
  by_contra hne
  have hDne : addSubst (k := k) G - rename Sum.inl G - rename Sum.inr G ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [sub_sub, sub_eq_zero] at h0
    exact hne h0
  have hdvdl : rename (Sum.inl : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) G ∣
      (addSubst (k := k) G - rename Sum.inl G - rename Sum.inr G) :=
    Ideal.mem_span_singleton.1 hmeml
  have hdvdr : rename (Sum.inr : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) G ∣
      (addSubst (k := k) G - rename Sum.inl G - rename Sum.inr G) :=
    Ideal.mem_span_singleton.1 hmemr
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hdvdr
  have hpm : rename (Sum.inl : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) G ∣ m := by
    rcases hpl.dvd_or_dvd (hm ▸ hdvdl) with h | h
    · exact absurd h hndvd
    · exact h
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hpm
  have hDfact : addSubst (k := k) G - rename Sum.inl G - rename Sum.inr G =
      rename Sum.inr G * rename Sum.inl G * t := by
    rw [hm, ht, mul_assoc]
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, mul_zero] at hDfact
    exact hDne hDfact
  have hpos : 0 < G.totalDegree := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos G.totalDegree with h0 | h
    · exfalso
      have hC := totalDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C.1 h0
      have ha : G.coeff 0 ≠ 0 := fun h00 ↦
        hGp.ne_zero (by rw [hC, h00, map_zero])
      exact hGp.not_isUnit
        (by rw [hC]; exact (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.2 ha).map C)
    · exact h
  have htotl : (rename (Sum.inl : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) G).totalDegree =
      G.totalDegree := totalDegree_rename_of_injective Sum.inl_injective G
  have htotr : (rename (Sum.inr : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) G).totalDegree =
      G.totalDegree := totalDegree_rename_of_injective Sum.inr_injective G
  have hDdeg : (addSubst (k := k) G - rename Sum.inl G -
      rename Sum.inr G).totalDegree ≤ G.totalDegree := by
    refine le_trans (totalDegree_sub _ _) (max_le ?_ (le_of_eq htotr))
    refine le_trans (totalDegree_sub _ _) (max_le ?_ (le_of_eq htotl))
    exact totalDegree_addSubst_le G
  have hmul1 := totalDegree_mul_of_isDomain
    (mul_ne_zero hpr.ne_zero hpl.ne_zero) ht0
  have hmul2 := totalDegree_mul_of_isDomain hpr.ne_zero hpl.ne_zero
  rw [hDfact, hmul1, hmul2, htotl, htotr] at hDdeg
  omega

name: AclGeom.coord_eq_zero_of_prime_aeval
proof:
:= by
  
  have hback : ∀ p : Polynomial k,
      (aeval (fun j ↦ if j = i then Polynomial.X else (0 : Polynomial k)) :
        MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →ₐ[k] Polynomial k) (Polynomial.aeval (X i) p) = p := fun p ↦ by
    rw [← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, aeval_X]
    simp
  have hirr : Irreducible R := by
    refine ⟨fun hu ↦ hp.not_isUnit (hu.map (Polynomial.aeval (X i))), fun a b hab ↦ ?_⟩
    have h := hp.irreducible.isUnit_or_isUnit (show Polynomial.aeval (X i) R =
      Polynomial.aeval (X i) a * Polynomial.aeval (X i) b by rw [hab, map_mul])
    rcases h with h | h
    · left
      have h' := h.map (aeval (fun j ↦ if j = i then Polynomial.X else (0 : Polynomial k)) :
        MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →ₐ[k] Polynomial k)
      rwa [hback] at h'
    · right
      have h' := h.map (aeval (fun j ↦ if j = i then Polynomial.X else (0 : Polynomial k)) :
        MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →ₐ[k] Polynomial k)
      rwa [hback] at h'
  have hdeg := IsAlgClosed.degree_eq_one_of_irreducible (k := k) hirr
  have hR := Polynomial.eq_X_add_C_of_degree_eq_one hdeg
  have hlc : R.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 := Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.2 hirr.ne_zero
  rw [hR, hR0, map_zero, add_zero, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Polynomial.eval_X] at ha
  exact (mul_eq_zero.1 ha).resolve_left hlc

name: AclGeom.addSubgroup_classification
statement:
theorem addSubgroup_classification [IsAlgClosed k] (H : AddSubgroup (Fin 2 → k))
    (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)) [hI : I.IsPrime]
    (hH : (H : Set (Fin 2 → k)) = zeroLocus k I)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k ⧸ I) = 1)
    (hproj₀ : ∃ u ∈ H, ∃ v ∈ H, u 0 ≠ v 0) (hproj₁ : ∃ u ∈ H, ∃ v ∈ H, u 1 ≠ v 1) :
    ∃ P Q : Polynomial k, IsAdditive P ∧ IsAdditive Q ∧ P ≠ 0 ∧ Q ≠ 0 ∧
      I = Ideal.span {Polynomial.aeval (X 0) P - Polynomial.aeval (X 1) Q} ∧
      (H : Set (Fin 2 → k)) = {u | P.eval (u 0) = Q.eval (u 1)}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hdim2 : ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) = 2 := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.ringKrullDim_of_isNoetherianRing, ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_field]
    simp
  have hbot : I ≠ ⊥ := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (RingEquiv.quotientBot (R := MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)),
      hdim2] at hdim
    norm_num at hdim
  have hlt : ∃ M : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k), M.IsMaximal ∧ I < M := by
    obtain ⟨M, hMmax, hIM⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal I hI.ne_top
    refine ⟨M, hMmax, lt_of_le_of_ne hIM fun hIM' ↦ ?_⟩
    have : I.IsMaximal := hIM' ▸ hMmax
    let := Ideal.Quotient.field I
    rw [ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_field] at hdim
    norm_num at hdim
  obtain ⟨M, hMmax, hIM⟩ := hlt
  have hheight : I.height = 1 := by
    have hM2 : (M.height : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ 2 := by
      rw [← hdim2]
      exact Ideal.height_le_ringKrullDim_of_ne_top hMmax.ne_top
    have hstep : I.height + 1 ≤ M.height := Ideal.height_add_one_le_of_lt_of_isPrime hIM
    have hle : I.height + 1 ≤ 2 := by
      exact_mod_cast hstep.trans (WithBot.coe_le_coe.1 hM2)
    have hne : I.height ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hbot (Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot.1 h)
    set h := I.height with hh
    have htop : h ≠ ⊤ := by
      intro ht
      rw [ht, top_add] at hle
      simp at hle
    lift h to ℕ using htop with n hn
    have h1 : n + 1 ≤ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hle
    have h2 : n ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hne
    have h3 : n = 1 := by omega
    exact_mod_cast congrArg (Nat.cast : ℕ → ℕ∞) h3
  obtain ⟨F, hFI, hFp⟩ := hI.exists_mem_prime_of_ne_bot hbot
  have hIF : I = Ideal.span {F} := Ideal.eq_span_singleton_of_height_eq_one hheight hFI hFp
  
  have hHz : ∀ c ∈ H, ∀ p ∈ I, aeval c p = 0 := fun c hc p hp ↦ by
    have hc' : c ∈ zeroLocus k I := by
      rw [← hH]
      exact hc
    exact hc' p hp
  have hvan : ∀ g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k, (∀ c ∈ H, aeval c g = 0) → g ∈ I := fun g hg ↦ by
    have hmem : g ∈ vanishingIdeal k (zeroLocus k I) := by
      rw [mem_vanishingIdeal_iff]
      intro c hc
      exact hg c (by rw [← hH] at hc; exact hc)
    rwa [vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical, hI.radical] at hmem
  
  have htrans : ∀ c ∈ H, translate c F = F := fun c hc ↦ by
    have hmem : translate c F ∈ I := hvan _ fun u hu ↦ by
      rw [aeval_translate]
      have hfun : (fun j ↦ u j + algebraMap k k (c j)) = u + c := by
        funext j
        simp
      rw [hfun]
      exact hHz _ (H.add_mem hu hc) F hFI
    rw [hIF, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hmem
    have hassoc := Prime.associated_of_dvd hFp ((prime_translate_iff c).2 hFp) hmem
    exact translate_eq_self_of_span_eq hFp.ne_zero
      (Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton.2 hassoc.symm)
  
  have hG0 : constantCoeff F = 0 := by
    have h := hHz 0 H.zero_mem F hFI
    rwa [MvPolynomial.aeval_zero, Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply] at h
  have hD : ∀ c ∈ H, aevalFst (k := k) c
      (addSubst (k := k) F - rename Sum.inl F - rename Sum.inr F) = 0 := fun c hc ↦ by
    rw [map_sub, map_sub, aevalFst_addSubst, aevalFst_rename_inl, aevalFst_rename_inr,
      Algebra.algebraMap_self, MvPolynomial.map_id, htrans c hc, hHz c hc F hFI, map_zero,
      sub_zero, sub_self]
  have hadd := addSubst_eq_of_mem_span_rename_inl hFp hG0
    (mem_span_rename_inl_of_forall_aevalFst_eq_zero (H := (H : Set (Fin 2 → k)))
      (fun g hg ↦ hIF ▸ hvan g hg) hD)
  have hFadd : ∀ u v : Fin 2 → k, aeval (u + v) F = aeval u F + aeval v F := fun u v ↦ by
    have h := congrArg (aeval (Sum.elim u v)) hadd
    rwa [aeval_addSubst, map_add, aeval_rename, aeval_rename, Sum.elim_comp_inl,
      Sum.elim_comp_inr] at h
  
  set P : Polynomial k := aeval ![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial k)] F with hPdef
  set R : Polynomial k := aeval ![(0 : Polynomial k), Polynomial.X] F with hRdef
  have hP : ∀ a : k, P.eval a = aeval ![a, 0] F := fun a ↦ by
    rw [← Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval]
    exact AddCorrSetup.polynomial_aeval_fst F a
  have hR : ∀ b : k, R.eval b = aeval ![0, b] F := fun b ↦ by
    rw [← Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval]
    exact AddCorrSetup.polynomial_aeval_snd F b
  have hsplit : ∀ x : Fin 2 → k, aeval x F = P.eval (x 0) + R.eval (x 1) := fun x ↦ by
    have hx : x = ![x 0, 0] + ![0, x 1] := by
      funext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp
    rw [hP, hR, ← hFadd, ← hx]
  have hFsplit : F = Polynomial.aeval (X 0) P + Polynomial.aeval (X 1) R := by
    refine MvPolynomial.funext fun x ↦ ?_
    change aeval x F = aeval x (Polynomial.aeval (X 0) P + Polynomial.aeval (X 1) R)
    rw [map_add, ← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, ← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, aeval_X,
      aeval_X, hsplit]
    rfl
  have hPa : IsAdditive P := fun a b ↦ by
    have hab : (![a + b, 0] : Fin 2 → k) = ![a, 0] + ![b, 0] := by
      funext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp
    rw [hP, hP, hP, ← hFadd, ← hab]
  have hRa : IsAdditive R := fun a b ↦ by
    have hab : (![0, a + b] : Fin 2 → k) = ![0, a] + ![0, b] := by
      funext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp
    rw [hR, hR, hR, ← hFadd, ← hab]
  have h00 : (![0, 0] : Fin 2 → k) = 0 := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> rfl
  have hP00 : P.coeff 0 = 0 := by
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, hP, h00]
    exact hHz 0 H.zero_mem F hFI
  have hR00 : R.coeff 0 = 0 := by
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, hR, h00]
    exact hHz 0 H.zero_mem F hFI
  
  
  have hPne : P ≠ 0 := by
    intro hP0
    have hFR : F = Polynomial.aeval (X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) R := by
      rw [hFsplit, hP0, map_zero, zero_add]
    have hzero : ∀ u ∈ H, u 1 = 0 := fun u hu ↦ by
      refine coord_eq_zero_of_prime_aeval (i := 1) (hFR ▸ hFp) hR00 ?_
      have h := hsplit u
      rw [hHz u hu F hFI, hP0, Polynomial.eval_zero, zero_add] at h
      exact h.symm
    obtain ⟨u, hu, v, hv, huv⟩ := hproj₁
    exact huv ((hzero u hu).trans (hzero v hv).symm)
  have hRne : R ≠ 0 := by
    intro hR0
    have hFP : F = Polynomial.aeval (X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) P := by
      rw [hFsplit, hR0, map_zero, add_zero]
    have hzero : ∀ u ∈ H, u 0 = 0 := fun u hu ↦ by
      refine coord_eq_zero_of_prime_aeval (i := 0) (hFP ▸ hFp) hP00 ?_
      have h := hsplit u
      rw [hHz u hu F hFI, hR0, Polynomial.eval_zero, add_zero] at h
      exact h.symm
    obtain ⟨u, hu, v, hv, huv⟩ := hproj₀
    exact huv ((hzero u hu).trans (hzero v hv).symm)
  refine ⟨P, -R, hPa, fun a b ↦ ?_, hPne, neg_ne_zero.2 hRne, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Polynomial.eval_neg, Polynomial.eval_neg, Polynomial.eval_neg, hRa a b, neg_add]
  · rw [hIF, map_neg, sub_neg_eq_add, ← hFsplit]
  · ext u
    rw [hH, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Polynomial.eval_neg, hIF]
    constructor
    · intro hu
      have h := hsplit u
      rw [(mem_zeroLocus_iff.1 hu) F (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self F)] at h
      linear_combination -h
    · intro hu
      rw [mem_zeroLocus_iff]
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.1 hp
      rw [map_mul, hsplit, hu, neg_add_cancel, mul_zero]

name: AclGeom.RegularGroupMorphism.exists_local_model
statement:
theorem exists_local_model (G : AlgebraicGroup k)
    {F : Type v} [Field F] [Algebra k F] {t : F} (ht : Transcendental k t)
    (Φ : (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) →* AffineTransformation k)
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A]
    (g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X)
    [IsOpenImmersion g.left] (d a b : A) (hd : d ≠ 0) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hfield : ∀ (φ : A →ₐ[k] k), φ d ≠ 0 →
      algebraMap k F ((Φ ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
        (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)).multiplier : k) * t +
      algebraMap k F (Φ ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
        (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)).shift =
        algebraMap k F (φ a / φ d) * t + algebraMap k F (φ b / φ d)) :
    ∃ (U : Over (Spec (.of k))) (j : U ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X)
      (_ : IsOpenImmersion j.left) (_p0 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ U)
      (fU : U ⟶ (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k).toGroupScheme.X),
      ∀ p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ U,
        p ≫ fU = (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k).symm (Φ (p ≫ j))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S := Localization.Away (a * d)
  have : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S (mul_ne_zero ha hd)
  have : Algebra.FiniteType k S := inferInstance
  let κ : A →ₐ[k] S := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A S
  have hunit : IsUnit (κ a) ∧ IsUnit (κ d) := by
    have hh : IsUnit (κ a * κ d) := by
      rw [← map_mul]
      exact IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (S := S) (a * d)
    exact ⟨isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left hh, isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_right hh⟩
  let au : Sˣ := hunit.1.unit * hunit.2.unit⁻¹
  let bz : S := κ b * (hunit.2.unit⁻¹ : Sˣ)
  let U := (Spec (.of S)).asOver (Spec (.of k))
  let i : U ⟶ (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) :=
    (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom κ).op
  have : IsOpenImmersion i.left := by
    change IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A S)))
    infer_instance
  let j : U ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X := i ≫ g
  have : IsOpenImmersion j.left := by
    change IsOpenImmersion (i.left ≫ g.left)
    infer_instance
  let fU : U ⟶ (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k).toGroupScheme.X :=
    AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k au bz
  have hex : Nonempty (S →ₐ[k] k) := by
    by_contra hn
    have hh : IsNilpotent (1 : S) := isNilpotent_of_forall_algHom_eq_zero
      (fun φ ↦ False.elim (hn ⟨φ⟩))
    exact not_isNilpotent_one hh
  let φ0 : S →ₐ[k] k := Classical.choice hex
  let p0 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ U := (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
    (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ0).op
  refine ⟨U, j, inferInstance, p0, fU, ?_⟩
  intro p
  let p' : (algSpec (.of k)).obj (.op (CommAlgCat.of k k)) ⟶
      (algSpec (.of k)).obj (.op (CommAlgCat.of k S)) :=
    (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).inv ≫ p
  have : (algSpec (.of k)).Full := algSpec.instFull
  let φ : S →ₐ[k] k := ((algSpec (.of k)).preimage p').unop.hom
  have hφ : (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op = p' :=
    (algSpec (.of k)).map_preimage p'
  have hp : p = (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
      (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op := by
    rw [hφ]
    exact (Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc (unitIsoSpecAsOver k) p).symm
  have hpLeft : p.left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) := by
    rw [hp]
    change 𝟙 _ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) = _
    rw [Category.id_comp]
  let ψ : A →ₐ[k] k := φ.comp κ
  have hdψ : ψ d ≠ 0 := (hunit.2.map φ).ne_zero
  have hcomp : (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom ψ).op =
      (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ i :=
    (algSpec (.of k)).map_comp (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op (CommAlgCat.ofHom κ).op
  have hpj : p ≫ j = (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
      (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom ψ).op ≫ g := by
    rw [hcomp, hp]
    rfl
  let T : AffineTransformation k := ⟨Units.map φ.toMonoidHom au, φ bz⟩
  have hvalues : (T.multiplier : k) = ψ a / ψ d ∧ T.shift = ψ b / ψ d := by
    have hinv : φ (hunit.2.unit⁻¹ : Sˣ) = (φ (κ d))⁻¹ := by
      have he := Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val (Units.map φ.toMonoidHom hunit.2.unit)
      change φ (hunit.2.unit⁻¹ : Sˣ) = (φ (hunit.2.unit : S))⁻¹ at he
      simpa only [hunit.2.unit_spec] using he
    constructor
    · change φ ((hunit.1.unit * hunit.2.unit⁻¹ : Sˣ) : S) = _
      rw [Units.val_mul, map_mul, hunit.1.unit_spec, hinv, div_eq_mul_inv]
      rfl
    · change φ (κ b * (hunit.2.unit⁻¹ : Sˣ)) = _
      rw [map_mul, hinv, div_eq_mul_inv]
      rfl
  have hT : T = Φ (p ≫ j) := by
    apply AffineTransformation.eval_injective ht
    change algebraMap k F (T.multiplier : k) * t + algebraMap k F T.shift =
      algebraMap k F ((Φ (p ≫ j)).multiplier : k) * t + algebraMap k F (Φ (p ≫ j)).shift
    rw [hvalues.1, hvalues.2, hpj]
    exact (hfield ψ hdψ).symm
  have heval : φ.comp (AffineGroupScheme.eval k au bz) =
      AffineGroupScheme.eval k T.multiplier T.shift := by
    apply AffineGroupScheme.hom_ext
    · rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AffineGroupScheme.eval_dilation,
        AffineGroupScheme.eval_dilation]
      rfl
    · rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AffineGroupScheme.eval_translation,
        AffineGroupScheme.eval_translation]
  have hpT : p ≫ fU = (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k).symm T := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    have hspec1 : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineGroupScheme.eval k au bz).toRingHom) =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (φ.comp (AffineGroupScheme.eval k au bz)).toRingHom) :=
      (Spec.map_comp (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineGroupScheme.eval k au bz).toRingHom)
        (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)).symm
    have hspec2 := congrArg (fun f : AffineGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k →ₐ[k] k ↦
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom)) heval
    have hleft : p.left ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (AffineGroupScheme.eval k au bz).toRingHom) =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (AffineGroupScheme.eval k T.multiplier T.shift).toRingHom) :=
      (congrArg (fun q : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Spec (.of S) ↦
        q ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineGroupScheme.eval k au bz).toRingHom))
          hpLeft).trans (hspec1.trans hspec2)
    exact hleft.trans (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_left k T).symm
  rw [hT] at hpT
  exact hpT

name: AclGeom.AffineTransformation.multiplier_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem multiplier_mul (g h : AffineTransformation k) :
    (g * h).multiplier = g.multiplier * h.multiplier
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.AffineTransformation.shift_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem shift_mul (g h : AffineTransformation k) :
    (g * h).shift = (g.multiplier : k) * h.shift + g.shift
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.AffineTransformation.multiplier_one
statement: @[simp] theorem multiplier_one : (1 : AffineTransformation k).multiplier = 1
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.AffineTransformation.shift_one
statement: @[simp] theorem shift_one : (1 : AffineTransformation k).shift = 0
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.AffineTransformation.multiplier_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem multiplier_inv (g : AffineTransformation k) :
    g⁻¹.multiplier = g.multiplier⁻¹
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.AffineTransformation.shift_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem shift_inv (g : AffineTransformation k) :
    g⁻¹.shift = -(g.multiplier⁻¹ : k) * g.shift
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.AffineTransformation.smul_def
statement:
@[simp] theorem smul_def (g : AffineTransformation k) (x : k) :
    g • x = (g.multiplier : k) * x + g.shift
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.AffineTransformation.one_smul
statement: @[simp] theorem one_smul (x : k) : (1 : AffineTransformation k) • x = x
proof:
:= by
  simp [smul_def]

name: AclGeom.AffineTransformation.mul_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem mul_smul (g h : AffineTransformation k) (x : k) :
    (g * h) • x = g • h • x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [smul_def, multiplier_mul, shift_mul, Units.val_mul]
  ring

name: AclGeom.AffineTransformation.translation_multiplier
statement:
@[simp] theorem translation_multiplier (b : k) :
    (translation b).multiplier = 1
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.AffineTransformation.translation_shift
statement: @[simp] theorem translation_shift (b : k) : (translation b).shift = b
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.AffineTransformation.translation_smul
statement: @[simp] theorem translation_smul (b x : k) : translation b • x = x + b
proof:
:= by
  simp [smul_def, translation]

name: AclGeom.AffineTransformation.translation_mul_translation
statement:
@[simp] theorem translation_mul_translation (b d : k) :
    translation b * translation d = translation (b + d)
proof:
:= by
  ext <;> simp [translation, add_comm]

name: AclGeom.AffineTransformation.translation_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem translation_inv (b : k) :
    (translation b)⁻¹ = translation (-b)
proof:
:= by
  ext <;> simp [translation]

name: AclGeom.AffineTransformation.mul_translation_mul_inv
statement:
theorem mul_translation_mul_inv (g : AffineTransformation k) (b : k) :
    g * translation b * g⁻¹ = translation ((g.multiplier : k) * b)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · simp [translation]
  · simp only [shift_mul, multiplier_mul, translation_shift, translation_multiplier,
      shift_inv, Units.val_mul, Units.val_one]
    have ha : (g.multiplier : k) ≠ 0 := Units.ne_zero g.multiplier
    field_simp
    ring

name: AclGeom.AffineTransformation.smul_eq_iff
statement:
theorem smul_eq_iff (g : AffineTransformation k) (x : k) :
    g • x = x ↔ (1 - (g.multiplier : k)) * x = g.shift
proof:
:= by
  change (g.multiplier : k) * x + g.shift = x ↔ _
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [sub_mul, one_mul]
    exact (eq_sub_of_add_eq' h).symm
  · intro h
    rw [sub_mul, one_mul] at h
    have hb : g.shift + (g.multiplier : k) * x = x :=
      (eq_sub_iff_add_eq).1 h.symm
    simpa [add_comm] using hb

name: AclGeom.AffineTransformation.smul_fixedPoint
statement:
theorem smul_fixedPoint (g : AffineTransformation k)
    (ha : (g.multiplier : k) ≠ 1) : g • g.fixedPoint = g.fixedPoint
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_eq_iff]
  exact mul_div_cancel₀ g.shift (sub_ne_zero.mpr ha.symm)

name: AclGeom.AffineTransformation.eq_fixedPoint_of_smul_eq
statement:
theorem eq_fixedPoint_of_smul_eq (g : AffineTransformation k) {x : k}
    (ha : (g.multiplier : k) ≠ 1) (hx : g • x = x) : x = g.fixedPoint
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_eq_iff] at hx
  rw [fixedPoint, eq_div_iff (sub_ne_zero.mpr ha.symm)]
  simpa [mul_comm] using hx

name: AclGeom.AffineTransformation.translation_smul_eq_iff
statement: theorem translation_smul_eq_iff {b x : k} : translation b • x = x ↔ b = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: AclGeom.AffineTransformation.translation_fixedPoint_free
statement:
theorem translation_fixedPoint_free {b : k} (hb : b ≠ 0) (x : k) :
    translation b • x ≠ x
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ hb (translation_smul_eq_iff.1 h)

name: AclGeom.AffineTransformation.eq_one_of_smul_eq_of_smul_eq
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_smul_eq_of_smul_eq (g : AffineTransformation k) {x y : k}
    (hx : g • x = x) (hy : g • y = y) (hxy : x ≠ y) : g = 1
proof:
:= by
  have ha : (g.multiplier : k) = 1 := by
    by_contra hne
    exact hxy ((g.eq_fixedPoint_of_smul_eq hne hx).trans
      (g.eq_fixedPoint_of_smul_eq hne hy).symm)
  apply AffineTransformation.ext
  · exact Units.ext ha
  · rw [smul_eq_iff, ha, sub_self, zero_mul] at hx
    simpa using hx.symm

name: AclGeom.AclGeom.AffineTransformation.eval_injective
statement:
theorem eval_injective {t : F} (ht : Transcendental k t) :
    Function.Injective (fun A : AffineTransformation k ↦
      algebraMap k F (A.multiplier : k) * t + algebraMap k F A.shift)
proof:
:= by
  intro A B h
  change algebraMap k F (A.multiplier : k) * t + algebraMap k F A.shift =
    algebraMap k F (B.multiplier : k) * t + algebraMap k F B.shift at h
  by_cases ha : (A.multiplier : k) = (B.multiplier : k)
  · have hb : A.shift = B.shift := by
      apply (algebraMap k F).injective
      rw [ha] at h
      exact add_left_cancel h
    exact AffineTransformation.ext (Units.ext ha) hb
  · have hd : algebraMap k F ((A.multiplier : k) - (B.multiplier : k)) ≠ 0 :=
      (map_ne_zero _).2 (sub_ne_zero.mpr ha)
    have he : t = algebraMap k F
        ((B.shift - A.shift) / ((A.multiplier : k) - (B.multiplier : k))) := by
      rw [map_div₀]
      apply (eq_div_iff hd).2
      rw [map_sub, map_sub]
      linear_combination h
    exfalso
    apply ht
    rw [he]
    exact isAlgebraic_algebraMap _

name: AclGeom.curveCoset_of_genericProduct
statement:
theorem curveCoset_of_genericProduct {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (G : AlgebraicGroup k) {A B D : Set G.carrier}
    (hA : IsClosed A) (hAi : IsIrreducible A) (hAd : topologicalKrullDim A = 1)
    (hB : IsClosed B) (hBi : IsIrreducible B) (hBd : topologicalKrullDim B = 1)
    (hD : IsClosed D) (hDi : IsIrreducible D) (hDd : topologicalKrullDim D = 1)
    (hgen : ∃ ξ : (reducedOver G.toGroupScheme.X ⟨A, hA⟩ ⊗
        reducedOver G.toGroupScheme.X ⟨B, hB⟩).left,
      closure {ξ} = Set.univ ∧
        ((reducedOverι G.toGroupScheme.X ⟨A, hA⟩ ⊗ₘ
          reducedOverι G.toGroupScheme.X ⟨B, hB⟩) ≫ μ[G.toGroupScheme.X]).left ξ ∈ D) :
    ∃ (H : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k) (inclusion : H.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom G)
        (g₁ g₂ : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X),
      IsClosedImmersion inclusion.schemeHom ∧ topologicalKrullDim H.toAlgebraicGroup.carrier = 1 ∧
      A = leftMulHomeo g₁ '' Set.range inclusion.schemeHom ∧
      B = rightMulHomeo g₂ '' Set.range inclusion.schemeHom ∧
      D = leftMulHomeo g₁ '' (rightMulHomeo g₂ '' Set.range inclusion.schemeHom)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Z, g₁, g₂, hZc, hZi, hZd, hZ1, hZdiv, hAZ, hBZ, hDZ⟩ :=
    curveCoset_of_exists_genericPoint hA hAi hAd hB hBi hBd hD hDi hDd hgen
  have hone : (1 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X).left
      (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) ∈ Z := hZ1
  have hdiv : ∀ a b : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
      a.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) ∈ Z → b.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) ∈ Z →
        (a * b⁻¹).left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) ∈ Z := hZdiv
  obtain ⟨H, inclusion, hclosed, hrange, hdim⟩ :=
    exists_connectedClosedSubgroup_of_points G ⟨Z, hZc⟩ hZi hone hdiv
  refine ⟨H, inclusion, g₁, g₂, hclosed, hdim.trans hZd, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hrange]
    exact hAZ
  · rw [hrange]
    exact hBZ
  · rw [hrange]
    exact hDZ

name: AclGeom.ProperCurve.hom_eq_of_toRationalMap_eq
statement:
theorem hom_eq_of_toRationalMap_eq
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsReduced X] [Y.IsSeparated]
    (f g : X ⟶ Y) (h : f.toRationalMap = g.toRationalMap) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi X.topIso.hom).mp
  exact (Scheme.PartialMap.equiv_toPartialMap_iff_of_isSeparated
    (S := ⊤_ Scheme)).mp (Scheme.PartialMap.toRationalMap_eq_iff.mp h)

name: AclGeom.ProperCurve.domain_eq_top
statement:
theorem domain_eq_top
    {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ 1)
    (hnormal : ∀ x : X, IsIntegrallyClosed (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (sX : X ⟶ S) (sY : Y ⟶ S) [IsProper sY]
    (f : X.RationalMap Y) (hf : f.compHom sY = sX.toRationalMap) :
    f.domain = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  intro x _
  have := hnormal x
  have hD : IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x) := inferInstance
  have hV : ValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk x) := stalk_valuationRing X hdim x
  have hstalk : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField)) ≫ X.fromSpecStalk x =
      X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X) :=
    Scheme.SpecMap_stalkSpecializes_fromSpecStalk (genericPoint_specializes x)
  have hgeneric : f.fromFunctionField ≫ sY =
      X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X) ≫ sX :=
    ((Scheme.RationalMap.equivFunctionField sX sY).symm ⟨f, hf⟩).property
  let sq : ValuativeCommSq sY :=
    { R := X.presheaf.stalk x
      domain := hD
      valuationRing := hV
      K := X.functionField
      i₁ := f.fromFunctionField
      i₂ := X.fromSpecStalk x ≫ sX
      commSq := ⟨hgeneric.trans ((congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ sX) hstalk).symm.trans
        (Category.assoc _ _ _))⟩ }
  have hproper : IsProper sY := inferInstance
  rw [IsProper.eq_valuativeCriterion] at hproper
  obtain ⟨l, hl₁, hl₂⟩ := (hproper.1.1.1.existence sq).exists_lift
  dsimp only [sq] at hl₁ hl₂
  let g := Scheme.PartialMap.ofFromSpecStalk sX sY l hl₂
  have hx : x ∈ g.domain :=
    Scheme.PartialMap.mem_domain_ofFromSpecStalk sX sY l hl₂
  have hgx : g.fromSpecStalkOfMem hx = l :=
    Scheme.PartialMap.fromSpecStalkOfMem_ofFromSpecStalk sX sY l hl₂
  have hη : genericPoint X ∈ g.domain :=
    (genericPoint_specializes x).mem_open g.domain.2 hx
  have hfac : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField)) ≫
      g.domain.fromSpecStalkOfMem x hx =
      g.domain.fromSpecStalkOfMem (genericPoint X) hη := by
    apply (cancel_mono g.domain.ι).mp
    rw [Category.assoc, Scheme.Opens.fromSpecStalkOfMem_ι,
      Scheme.Opens.fromSpecStalkOfMem_ι]
    exact Scheme.SpecMap_stalkSpecializes_fromSpecStalk (genericPoint_specializes x)
  have hg : g.toRationalMap = f := by
    apply Scheme.RationalMap.eq_of_fromFunctionField_eq
    rw [Scheme.RationalMap.fromFunctionField_toRationalMap]
    change g.domain.fromSpecStalkOfMem (genericPoint X) hη ≫ g.hom = _
    rw [← hfac, Category.assoc]
    change _ ≫ g.fromSpecStalkOfMem hx = _
    rw [hgx]
    exact hl₁
  exact Scheme.RationalMap.mem_domain.mpr ⟨g, hx, hg⟩

name: AclGeom.ProperCurve.existsUnique_extension
statement:
theorem existsUnique_extension
    {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [S.IsSeparated]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ 1)
    (hnormal : ∀ x : X, IsIntegrallyClosed (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (sX : X ⟶ S) (sY : Y ⟶ S) [IsProper sY]
    (f : X.RationalMap Y) (hf : f.compHom sY = sX.toRationalMap) :
    ∃! g : X ⟶ Y, g.toRationalMap = f ∧ g ≫ sY = sX
proof:
:= by
  have : Y.IsSeparated := by
    constructor
    rw [← Limits.terminal.comp_from sY]
    infer_instance
  let p := f.toPartialMap
  have hp : p.domain = ⊤ := domain_eq_top hdim hnormal sX sY f hf
  let j : X ⟶ p.domain.toScheme := X.topIso.inv ≫ (X.isoOfEq hp).inv
  have hj : j ≫ p.domain.ι = 𝟙 X := by
    dsimp only [j]
    rw [Category.assoc, Scheme.isoOfEq_inv_ι, Scheme.toIso_inv_ι]
  have hij : p.domain.ι ≫ j = 𝟙 _ := by
    apply (cancel_mono p.domain.ι).mp
    rw [Category.assoc, hj, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
  let g := j ≫ p.hom
  have hpg : p.hom = p.domain.ι ≫ g := by
    dsimp only [g]
    rw [← Category.assoc, hij, Category.id_comp]
  have hg : g.toRationalMap = f := by
    rw [← f.toRationalMap_toPartialMap]
    exact (Scheme.PartialMap.toRationalMap_eq_iff.mpr
      ((Scheme.PartialMap.equiv_toPartialMap_iff_of_isSeparated
        (S := ⊤_ Scheme)).mpr hpg)).symm
  refine ⟨g, ⟨hg, ?_⟩, fun q hq ↦ hom_eq_of_toRationalMap_eq q g (hq.1.trans hg.symm)⟩
  apply hom_eq_of_toRationalMap_eq
  change (g ≫ sY).toPartialMap.toRationalMap = _
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.toPartialMap_compHom,
    Scheme.RationalMap.compHom_toRationalMap]
  change g.toRationalMap.compHom sY = sX.toRationalMap
  rw [hg]
  exact hf

name: AclGeom.GroupScheme.leftMul_comp_rightMul
statement:
theorem leftMul_comp_rightMul (a b : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G) :
    leftMul G a ≫ rightMul G b = rightMul G b ≫ leftMul G a
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_rightMul, comp_leftMul]
  change (toUnit G ≫ a) * 𝟙 G * (toUnit G ≫ b) = (toUnit G ≫ a) * (𝟙 G * (toUnit G ≫ b))
  rw [_root_.mul_assoc]

name: AclGeom.GroupScheme.curveCoset_of_closedPoints
statement:
theorem curveCoset_of_closedPoints {A B D : Set G.left}
    (hA : IsClosed A) (hAi : IsIrreducible A) (hAd : topologicalKrullDim A = 1)
    (hB : IsClosed B) (hBi : IsIrreducible B) (hBd : topologicalKrullDim B = 1)
    (hD : IsClosed D) (hDi : IsIrreducible D) (hDd : topologicalKrullDim D = 1)
    (hAB : ∀ a b : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G,
      (pointsEquivClosedPoints a : G.left) ∈ A → (pointsEquivClosedPoints b : G.left) ∈ B →
        (pointsEquivClosedPoints (a * b) : G.left) ∈ D) :
    ∃ (H : Set G.left) (g₁ g₂ : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G),
      IsClosed H ∧ IsIrreducible H ∧ topologicalKrullDim H = 1 ∧
      (pointsEquivClosedPoints (1 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G) : G.left) ∈ H ∧
      (∀ h₁ h₂ : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G,
        (pointsEquivClosedPoints h₁ : G.left) ∈ H → (pointsEquivClosedPoints h₂ : G.left) ∈ H →
          (pointsEquivClosedPoints (h₁ * h₂⁻¹) : G.left) ∈ H) ∧
      A = leftMulHomeo g₁ '' H ∧ B = rightMulHomeo g₂ '' H ∧
      D = leftMulHomeo g₁ '' (rightMulHomeo g₂ '' H)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : JacobsonSpace G.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.jacobsonSpace G.hom
  
  have subset_of_points : ∀ {Z W : Set G.left}, IsClosed Z → IsClosed W →
      (∀ p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G,
        (pointsEquivClosedPoints p : G.left) ∈ Z → (pointsEquivClosedPoints p : G.left) ∈ W) →
      Z ⊆ W := by
    intro Z W hZ hW h
    rw [← hZ.closure_eq, ← JacobsonSpace.closure_inter_closedPoints_eq_closure hZ.isLocallyClosed]
    refine closure_minimal ?_ hW
    rintro x ⟨hxZ, hxc⟩
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := pointsEquivClosedPoints.surjective (⟨x, hxc⟩ : closedPoints G.left)
    have hx : (pointsEquivClosedPoints p : G.left) = x := congrArg Subtype.val hp
    rw [← hx] at hxZ ⊢
    exact h p hxZ
  have exists_point : ∀ {Z : Set G.left}, IsClosed Z → Z.Nonempty →
      ∃ p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G, (pointsEquivClosedPoints p : G.left) ∈ Z := by
    intro Z hZ hne
    obtain ⟨x, hxZ, hxc⟩ := nonempty_inter_closedPoints hne hZ.isLocallyClosed
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := pointsEquivClosedPoints.surjective (⟨x, hxc⟩ : closedPoints G.left)
    have hx : (pointsEquivClosedPoints p : G.left) = x := congrArg Subtype.val hp
    exact ⟨p, hx ▸ hxZ⟩
  
  have image_curve : ∀ (e : G.left ≃ₜ G.left) {Z : Set G.left}, IsClosed Z → IsIrreducible Z →
      topologicalKrullDim Z = 1 →
      IsClosed (e '' Z) ∧ IsIrreducible (e '' Z) ∧ topologicalKrullDim (e '' Z) = 1 := by
    intro e Z hZ hZi hZd
    refine ⟨e.isClosed_image.2 hZ, hZi.image e e.continuous.continuousOn, ?_⟩
    rw [← IsHomeomorph.topologicalKrullDim_eq _ (e.image Z).isHomeomorph]
    exact hZd
  
  have hRpt : ∀ b p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G,
      rightMulHomeo b (pointsEquivClosedPoints p : G.left) = pointsEquivClosedPoints (p * b) :=
    fun b p ↦ (rightMulHomeo_apply b _).trans (rightMul_left_pointsEquivClosedPoints p b)
  have hLpt : ∀ a p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G,
      leftMulHomeo a (pointsEquivClosedPoints p : G.left) = pointsEquivClosedPoints (a * p) :=
    fun a p ↦ (leftMulHomeo_apply a _).trans (leftMul_left_pointsEquivClosedPoints p a)
  
  have hRR : ∀ (b b' : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G) (Z : Set G.left),
      rightMulHomeo b' '' (rightMulHomeo b '' Z) = rightMulHomeo (b * b') '' Z := by
    intro b b' Z
    rw [Set.image_image]
    refine Set.image_congr fun x _ ↦ ?_
    rw [rightMulHomeo_apply, rightMulHomeo_apply, rightMulHomeo_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply,
      ← Over.comp_left, rightMul_comp_rightMul]
  have hLL : ∀ (a a' : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G) (Z : Set G.left),
      leftMulHomeo a' '' (leftMulHomeo a '' Z) = leftMulHomeo (a' * a) '' Z := by
    intro a a' Z
    rw [Set.image_image]
    refine Set.image_congr fun x _ ↦ ?_
    rw [leftMulHomeo_apply, leftMulHomeo_apply, leftMulHomeo_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply,
      ← Over.comp_left, leftMul_comp_leftMul]
  have hLR : ∀ (a b : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G) (Z : Set G.left),
      leftMulHomeo a '' (rightMulHomeo b '' Z) = rightMulHomeo b '' (leftMulHomeo a '' Z) := by
    intro a b Z
    rw [Set.image_image, Set.image_image]
    refine Set.image_congr fun x _ ↦ ?_
    rw [leftMulHomeo_apply, leftMulHomeo_apply, rightMulHomeo_apply, rightMulHomeo_apply,
      ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← Over.comp_left, ← Over.comp_left,
      leftMul_comp_rightMul]
  have hR1 : ∀ Z : Set G.left, rightMulHomeo (1 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G) '' Z = Z := by
    intro Z
    refine Set.EqOn.image_eq_self fun x _ ↦ ?_
    rw [rightMulHomeo_apply, rightMul_one]
    rfl
  have hL1 : ∀ Z : Set G.left, leftMulHomeo (1 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G) '' Z = Z := by
    intro Z
    refine Set.EqOn.image_eq_self fun x _ ↦ ?_
    rw [leftMulHomeo_apply, leftMul_one]
    rfl
  
  have hRinv : ∀ {b p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G} {x : G.left},
      rightMulHomeo b x = pointsEquivClosedPoints p → x = pointsEquivClosedPoints (p * b⁻¹) := by
    intro b p x hx
    rw [← (rightMulHomeo b).symm_apply_apply x, hx]
    exact rightMul_left_pointsEquivClosedPoints p b⁻¹
  
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ := exists_point hA hAi.nonempty
  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀⟩ := exists_point hB hBi.nonempty
  
  have hAb : ∀ b : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G, (pointsEquivClosedPoints b : G.left) ∈ B →
      rightMulHomeo b '' A = D := by
    intro b hb
    obtain ⟨hc, -, hd⟩ := image_curve (rightMulHomeo b) hA hAi hAd
    refine eq_of_subset_of_finite_topologicalKrullDim hc hDi ?_ 1
      (hDd.trans Nat.cast_one.symm) (hd.trans Nat.cast_one.symm)
    refine subset_of_points hc hD fun p hp ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨x, hxA, hx⟩ := hp
    have hx' := hRinv hx
    rw [hx'] at hxA
    have h := hAB _ _ hxA hb
    rwa [_root_.inv_mul_cancel_right] at h
  
  have stab_of_B : ∀ b : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G, (pointsEquivClosedPoints b : G.left) ∈ B →
      rightMulHomeo (b * b₀⁻¹) '' A = A := by
    intro b hb
    rw [← hRR, hAb b hb, ← hAb b₀ hb₀, hRR, _root_.mul_inv_cancel, hR1]
  let H : Set G.left := leftMulHomeo a₀⁻¹ '' A
  obtain ⟨hHc, hHi, hHd⟩ := image_curve (leftMulHomeo a₀⁻¹) hA hAi hAd
  have mem_of_stab : ∀ h : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G, rightMulHomeo h '' A = A →
      (pointsEquivClosedPoints h : G.left) ∈ H := by
    intro h hh
    have h1 : (pointsEquivClosedPoints (a₀ * h) : G.left) ∈ A := by
      rw [← hh, ← hRpt]
      exact Set.mem_image_of_mem _ ha₀
    refine ⟨_, h1, ?_⟩
    rw [hLpt, _root_.inv_mul_cancel_left]
  
  obtain ⟨hBc', -, hBd'⟩ := image_curve (rightMulHomeo b₀⁻¹) hB hBi hBd
  have hBH : rightMulHomeo b₀⁻¹ '' B = H := by
    refine eq_of_subset_of_finite_topologicalKrullDim hBc' hHi ?_ 1
      (hHd.trans Nat.cast_one.symm) (hBd'.trans Nat.cast_one.symm)
    refine subset_of_points hBc' hHc fun p hp ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨y, hyB, hy⟩ := hp
    have hy' := hRinv hy
    rw [hy'] at hyB
    have h := mem_of_stab _ (stab_of_B _ hyB)
    rwa [_root_.inv_inv, _root_.mul_inv_cancel_right] at h
  have stab_of_mem : ∀ h : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G, (pointsEquivClosedPoints h : G.left) ∈ H →
      rightMulHomeo h '' A = A := by
    intro h hh
    rw [← hBH] at hh
    obtain ⟨y, hyB, hy⟩ := hh
    have hy' := hRinv hy
    rw [hy'] at hyB
    have h' := stab_of_B _ hyB
    rwa [_root_.inv_inv, _root_.mul_inv_cancel_right] at h'
  refine ⟨H, a₀, b₀, hHc, hHi, hHd, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact mem_of_stab 1 (hR1 A)
  · intro h₁ h₂ hh₁ hh₂
    refine mem_of_stab _ ?_
    have hs₂ := stab_of_mem h₂ hh₂
    rw [← hRR, stab_of_mem h₁ hh₁]
    calc rightMulHomeo h₂⁻¹ '' A = rightMulHomeo h₂⁻¹ '' (rightMulHomeo h₂ '' A) := by rw [hs₂]
      _ = A := by rw [hRR, _root_.mul_inv_cancel, hR1]
  · change A = leftMulHomeo a₀ '' (leftMulHomeo a₀⁻¹ '' A)
    rw [hLL, _root_.mul_inv_cancel, hL1]
  · rw [← hBH, hRR, _root_.inv_mul_cancel, hR1]
  · rw [hLR]
    change D = rightMulHomeo b₀ '' (leftMulHomeo a₀ '' (leftMulHomeo a₀⁻¹ '' A))
    rw [hLL, _root_.mul_inv_cancel, hL1, hAb b₀ hb₀]

name: AclGeom.trdeg_eq_of_le_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
private theorem trdeg_eq_of_le_of_isAlgebraic {E G : IntermediateField k Ω} (h : E ≤ G)
    (halg : ∀ x ∈ G, IsAlgebraic E x) : Algebra.trdeg k E = Algebra.trdeg k G
proof:
:= by
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic E (extendScalars h) :=
    ⟨fun x ↦ (isAlgebraic_algHom_iff (IntermediateField.val (extendScalars h))
      Subtype.val_injective).1 (halg x x.2)⟩
  let e : extendScalars h ≃ₐ[k] G :=
    { toFun := fun x ↦ ⟨x, x.2⟩
      invFun := fun x ↦ ⟨x, x.2⟩
      left_inv := fun _ ↦ rfl
      right_inv := fun _ ↦ rfl
      map_mul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
      commutes' := fun _ ↦ rfl }
  have hadd := trdeg_add_eq k E (A := extendScalars h)
  rw [trdeg_eq_zero (R := E) (A := extendScalars h), add_zero] at hadd
  exact hadd.trans e.trdeg_eq

name: AclGeom.TupleCorrespondencePair.target_rank
statement:
theorem TupleCorrespondencePair.target_rank {α β : Type*} (P : TupleCorrespondencePair k Ω α β) :
    Algebra.trdeg k (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range P.target)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hs : adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim P.source P.target)) ≤ racl k (Set.range P.source) := by
    rw [adjoin_le_iff, Set.Sum.elim_range]
    exact Set.union_subset (subset_racl k _) (Set.range_subset_iff.2 P.target_mem_source)
  have ht : adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim P.source P.target)) ≤ racl k (Set.range P.target) := by
    rw [adjoin_le_iff, Set.Sum.elim_range]
    exact Set.union_subset (Set.range_subset_iff.2 P.source_mem_target) (subset_racl k _)
  have hs' := trdeg_eq_of_le_of_isAlgebraic
    (adjoin.mono k _ _ (Set.Sum.elim_range P.source P.target ▸ Set.subset_union_left))
    fun x hx ↦ (mem_racl_iff k).1 (hs hx)
  have ht' := trdeg_eq_of_le_of_isAlgebraic
    (adjoin.mono k _ _ (Set.Sum.elim_range P.source P.target ▸ Set.subset_union_right))
    fun x hx ↦ (mem_racl_iff k).1 (ht hx)
  exact ht'.trans (hs'.symm.trans P.source_rank)

name: AclGeom.pairField_finiteDimensional_iff
statement:
theorem pairField_finiteDimensional_iff {α β : Type*} [Finite α] [Finite β] (v : α → Ω)
    (w : β → Ω) :
    (FiniteDimensional (adjoin k (Set.range v))
        (extendScalars (adjoin.mono k (Set.range v) (Set.range (Sum.elim v w))
          (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun i ↦ ⟨Sum.inl i, rfl⟩))) ∧
      FiniteDimensional (adjoin k (Set.range w))
        (extendScalars (adjoin.mono k (Set.range w) (Set.range (Sum.elim v w))
          (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun j ↦ ⟨Sum.inr j, rfl⟩)))) ↔
      (∀ j, w j ∈ racl k (Set.range v)) ∧ ∀ i, v i ∈ racl k (Set.range w)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hv, hw⟩
    
    have key (E : IntermediateField k Ω) (h : E ≤ adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim v w)))
        (_ : FiniteDimensional E (extendScalars h)) (u : Ω)
        (hu : u ∈ adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim v w))) : IsAlgebraic E u :=
      (isAlgebraic_algHom_iff (IntermediateField.val (extendScalars h))
        Subtype.val_injective).2 (IsAlgebraic.of_finite E (⟨u, hu⟩ : extendScalars h))
    exact ⟨fun j ↦ (mem_racl_iff k).2 (key _ _ hv (w j) (subset_adjoin k _ ⟨Sum.inr j, rfl⟩)),
      fun i ↦ (mem_racl_iff k).2 (key _ _ hw (v i) (subset_adjoin k _ ⟨Sum.inl i, rfl⟩))⟩
  · rintro ⟨hwv, hvw⟩
    constructor
    · have heq : extendScalars (adjoin.mono k (Set.range v) (Set.range (Sum.elim v w))
            (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun i ↦ ⟨Sum.inl i, rfl⟩)) =
          adjoin (adjoin k (Set.range v)) (Set.range w) := by
        apply restrictScalars_injective k
        rw [extendScalars_restrictScalars, restrictScalars_adjoin_eq_sup, ← adjoin_union,
          Set.Sum.elim_range]
      rw [heq]
      exact finiteDimensional_adjoin
        (Set.forall_mem_range.2 fun j ↦ ((mem_racl_iff k).1 (hwv j)).isIntegral)
    · have heq : extendScalars (adjoin.mono k (Set.range w) (Set.range (Sum.elim v w))
            (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun j ↦ ⟨Sum.inr j, rfl⟩)) =
          adjoin (adjoin k (Set.range w)) (Set.range v) := by
        apply restrictScalars_injective k
        rw [extendScalars_restrictScalars, restrictScalars_adjoin_eq_sup, ← adjoin_union,
          Set.Sum.elim_range, Set.union_comm]
      rw [heq]
      exact finiteDimensional_adjoin
        (Set.forall_mem_range.2 fun i ↦ ((mem_racl_iff k).1 (hvw i)).isIntegral)

name: AclGeom.pairLocus_finiteCorrespondence_iff
statement:
theorem pairLocus_finiteCorrespondence_iff {α β : Type*} [Finite α] [Finite β] (v : α → Ω)
    (w : β → Ω) :
    letI : Algebra (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range v))
        (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim v w)))
proof:
:=
      (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono (s := Set.range v)
        (t := Set.range (Sum.elim v w))
        (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun i ↦ ⟨Sum.inl i, rfl⟩))).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range w))
        (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim w v))) :=
      (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono (s := Set.range w)
        (t := Set.range (Sum.elim w v))
        (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun i ↦ ⟨Sum.inl i, rfl⟩))).toAlgebra
    DenseRange (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim v w))
        (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inl : MvPolynomial α k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) k)
        (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (k := k) (Sum.elim_comp_inl v w)).le).toRingHom) ∧
      DenseRange (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim v w))
        (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inr : MvPolynomial β k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) k)
        (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (k := k) (Sum.elim_comp_inr v w)).le).toRingHom) ∧
      ((ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) k ⧸ idealOf k (Sum.elim v w)) = 1 ∧
          AlgebraicGeometry.IsFinite (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (algebraMap (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range v))
              (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range v) ⊗[Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range v)]
                Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim v w)))))) ∧
          AlgebraicGeometry.IsFinite (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (algebraMap (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range w))
              (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range w) ⊗[Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range w)]
                Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim w v))))))) ↔
        (∀ j, w j ∈ racl k (Set.range v)) ∧ (∀ i, v i ∈ racl k (Set.range w)) ∧
          Algebra.trdeg k (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range v)) = 1 ∧
          Algebra.trdeg k (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range w)) = 1) := by
  
  have hdv : Function.Injective (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim v w))
      (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inl : MvPolynomial α k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) k)
      (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (k := k) (Sum.elim_comp_inl v w)).le) := by
    have h := locusCoordinateRingEquiv_comp_quotientMapₐ (k := k) (Sum.elim_comp_inl v w)
    have hi := Subalgebra.inclusion_injective (Algebra.adjoin_mono (R := k) (s := Set.range v)
      (t := Set.range (Sum.elim v w)) (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun i ↦ ⟨Sum.inl i, rfl⟩))
    intro p q hpq
    exact (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (k := k) v).injective (hi ((DFunLike.congr_fun h p).symm.trans
      ((congrArg (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (k := k) (Sum.elim v w)) hpq).trans
        (DFunLike.congr_fun h q))))
  have hdw : Function.Injective (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim v w))
      (MvPolynomial.rename Sum.inr : MvPolynomial β k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) k)
      (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (k := k) (Sum.elim_comp_inr v w)).le) := by
    have h := locusCoordinateRingEquiv_comp_quotientMapₐ (k := k) (Sum.elim_comp_inr v w)
    have hi := Subalgebra.inclusion_injective (Algebra.adjoin_mono (R := k) (s := Set.range w)
      (t := Set.range (Sum.elim v w)) (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun j ↦ ⟨Sum.inr j, rfl⟩))
    intro p q hpq
    exact (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (k := k) w).injective (hi ((DFunLike.congr_fun h p).symm.trans
      ((congrArg (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (k := k) (Sum.elim v w)) hpq).trans
        (DFunLike.congr_fun h q))))
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hfinv⟩ := exists_pairGenericFiber_algEquiv (k := k) v w
  obtain ⟨-, -, -, hfinw⟩ := exists_pairGenericFiber_algEquiv (k := k) w v
  obtain ⟨n, hdim, htr⟩ := exists_locusCoordinateRing_dimension (k := k) (Sum.elim v w)
  
  have hjv (hw : ∀ j, w j ∈ racl k (Set.range v)) :
      Algebra.trdeg k (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range v)) = n := by
    have hle : IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim v w)) ≤ racl k (Set.range v) := by
      rw [adjoin_le_iff, Set.Sum.elim_range]
      exact Set.union_subset (subset_racl k _) (Set.range_subset_iff.2 hw)
    exact (trdeg_eq_of_le_of_isAlgebraic
      (adjoin.mono k _ _ (Set.Sum.elim_range v w ▸ Set.subset_union_left))
      fun x hx ↦ (mem_racl_iff k).1 (hle hx)).trans htr
  have hjw (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ racl k (Set.range w)) :
      Algebra.trdeg k (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range w)) = n := by
    have hle : IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim v w)) ≤ racl k (Set.range w) := by
      rw [adjoin_le_iff, Set.Sum.elim_range]
      exact Set.union_subset (Set.range_subset_iff.2 hv) (subset_racl k _)
    exact (trdeg_eq_of_le_of_isAlgebraic
      (adjoin.mono k _ _ (Set.Sum.elim_range v w ▸ Set.subset_union_right))
      fun x hx ↦ (mem_racl_iff k).1 (hle hx)).trans htr
  refine ⟨(PrimeSpectrum.denseRange_comap_iff_ker_le_nilRadical _).2 fun p hp ↦ ?_,
    (PrimeSpectrum.denseRange_comap_iff_ker_le_nilRadical _).2 fun p hp ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hdv ((RingHom.mem_ker.1 hp).trans (map_zero _).symm)]
    exact zero_mem _
  · rw [hdw ((RingHom.mem_ker.1 hp).trans (map_zero _).symm)]
    exact zero_mem _
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hd, hfv, hfw⟩
    have hw := hfinv.1 hfv
    have hv := hfinw.1 hfw
    have hn : n = 1 := Nat.cast_eq_one.1 (hdim.symm.trans hd)
    refine ⟨hw, hv, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hjv hw, hn, Nat.cast_one]
    · rw [hjw hv, hn, Nat.cast_one]
  · rintro ⟨hw, hv, hrv, -⟩
    have hn : n = 1 := by exact_mod_cast (hjv hw).symm.trans hrv
    exact ⟨hdim.trans (by rw [hn, Nat.cast_one]), hfinv.2 hw, hfinw.2 hv⟩

name: AclGeom.endpointField_le_jointField
statement:
theorem endpointField_le_jointField :
    adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim x z)) ≤ adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z))
proof:
:=
  adjoin.mono k _ _ (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun i ↦ by
    rcases i with a | c
    exacts [⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inl a), rfl⟩, ⟨Sum.inr c, rfl⟩])

name: AclGeom.jointField_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem jointField_finiteDimensional [Finite β]
    (hy : ∀ j, y j ∈ racl k (Set.range (Sum.elim x z))) :
    FiniteDimensional (adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim x z)))
      (extendScalars (endpointField_le_jointField (k := k) x y z))
proof:
:= by
  have heq : extendScalars (endpointField_le_jointField (k := k) x y z) =
      adjoin (adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim x z))) (Set.range y) := by
    apply restrictScalars_injective k
    rw [extendScalars_restrictScalars, restrictScalars_adjoin_eq_sup, ← adjoin_union,
      Set.Sum.elim_range, Set.Sum.elim_range, Set.Sum.elim_range, Set.union_right_comm]
  rw [heq]
  exact finiteDimensional_adjoin
    (Set.forall_mem_range.2 fun j ↦ ((mem_racl_iff k).1 (hy j)).isIntegral)

name: AclGeom.jointField_finiteDimensional_over_ends
statement:
theorem jointField_finiteDimensional_over_ends [Finite α] [Finite β] [Finite γ]
    (hyx : ∀ j, y j ∈ racl k (Set.range x)) (hxy : ∀ i, x i ∈ racl k (Set.range y))
    (hzy : ∀ l, z l ∈ racl k (Set.range y)) (hyz : ∀ j, y j ∈ racl k (Set.range z)) :
    FiniteDimensional (adjoin k (Set.range x))
        (extendScalars (adjoin.mono k (Set.range x) (Set.range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z))
          (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun i ↦ ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inl i), rfl⟩))) ∧
      FiniteDimensional (adjoin k (Set.range z))
        (extendScalars (adjoin.mono k (Set.range z) (Set.range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z))
          (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun l ↦ ⟨Sum.inr l, rfl⟩)))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have heq : extendScalars (adjoin.mono k (Set.range x)
          (Set.range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z))
          (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun i ↦ ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inl i), rfl⟩)) =
        adjoin (adjoin k (Set.range x)) (Set.range (Sum.elim y z)) := by
      apply restrictScalars_injective k
      rw [extendScalars_restrictScalars, restrictScalars_adjoin_eq_sup, ← adjoin_union,
        Set.Sum.elim_range (Sum.elim x y) z, Set.Sum.elim_range x y, Set.Sum.elim_range y z,
        Set.union_assoc]
    rw [heq]
    refine finiteDimensional_adjoin (Set.forall_mem_range.2 fun i ↦ ?_)
    rcases i with j | l
    · exact ((mem_racl_iff k).1 (hyx j)).isIntegral
    · exact ((mem_racl_iff k).1
        (racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.range_subset_iff.2 hyx) (hzy l))).isIntegral
  · have heq : extendScalars (adjoin.mono k (Set.range z)
          (Set.range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z))
          (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun l ↦ ⟨Sum.inr l, rfl⟩)) =
        adjoin (adjoin k (Set.range z)) (Set.range (Sum.elim x y)) := by
      apply restrictScalars_injective k
      rw [extendScalars_restrictScalars, restrictScalars_adjoin_eq_sup, ← adjoin_union,
        Set.Sum.elim_range (Sum.elim x y) z, Set.union_comm]
    rw [heq]
    refine finiteDimensional_adjoin (Set.forall_mem_range.2 fun i ↦ ?_)
    rcases i with i | j
    · exact ((mem_racl_iff k).1
        (racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.range_subset_iff.2 hyz) (hxy i))).isIntegral
    · exact ((mem_racl_iff k).1 (hyz j)).isIntegral

name: AclGeom.AdditiveRigidity.unitPoint_one
statement:
theorem unitPoint_one {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C] :
    unitPoint k (1 : Cˣ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change Spec.mapMulEquiv (R := k) (S := AddMonoidAlgebra k ℤ) (T := C)
    ((unitsMulEquivConv k C).symm 1) = 1
  rw [map_one, map_one]

name: AclGeom.AdditiveRigidity.unitPoint_mul
statement:
theorem unitPoint_mul {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C] (a b : Cˣ) :
    unitPoint k (a * b) = unitPoint k a * unitPoint k b
proof:
:= by
  change Spec.mapMulEquiv (R := k) (S := AddMonoidAlgebra k ℤ) (T := C)
    ((unitsMulEquivConv k C).symm (a * b)) =
      Spec.mapMulEquiv ((unitsMulEquivConv k C).symm a) *
        Spec.mapMulEquiv ((unitsMulEquivConv k C).symm b)
  rw [map_mul, map_mul]

name: AclGeom.AdditiveRigidity.AclGeom.AffineDilation.groupPoint_comp_projection
statement:
theorem groupPoint_comp_projection {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
    (a : Cˣ) (b : C) :
    AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k a b ≫ projection k = AdditiveRigidity.unitPoint k a
proof:
:= by
  let φ : AddMonoidAlgebra k ℤ →ₐ[k] AffineGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k :=
    ((unitsMulEquivConv k (AffineGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k)).symm
      (AffineGroupScheme.dilationUnit k)).ofConv
  have hφ : (AffineGroupScheme.eval k a b).comp φ =
      ((unitsMulEquivConv k C).symm a).ofConv := by
    have hh : WithConv.toConv ((AffineGroupScheme.eval k a b).comp φ) =
        (unitsMulEquivConv k C).symm a := by
      apply (unitsMulEquivConv k C).injective
      apply Units.ext
      rw [MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply, unitsMulEquivConv_apply_val]
      change ((AffineGroupScheme.eval k a b).comp φ)
        (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (1 : ℤ) (1 : k)) = (a : C)
      rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, unitsMulEquivConv_symm_apply_single,
        AffineGroupScheme.eval_dilation]
    exact congrArg WithConv.ofConv hh
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineGroupScheme.eval k a b).toRingHom) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((unitsMulEquivConv k C).symm a).ofConv.toRingHom)
  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
  apply congrArg Spec.map
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  exact congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom hφ

name: AclGeom.AdditiveRigidity.AclGeom.AffineDilation.scalingSection_comp_projection
statement: theorem scalingSection_comp_projection : scalingSection k ≫ projection k = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  let u := unitsMulEquivConv k (AddMonoidAlgebra k ℤ)
    (WithConv.toConv (AlgHom.id k (AddMonoidAlgebra k ℤ)))
  have he : scalingSection k ≫ projection k = AdditiveRigidity.unitPoint k u :=
    groupPoint_comp_projection k u 0
  refine he.trans ?_
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    ((unitsMulEquivConv k (AddMonoidAlgebra k ℤ)).symm u).ofConv.toRingHom) = 𝟙 _
  rw [MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  exact Spec.map_id _

name: AclGeom.AdditiveRigidity.AclGeom.AffineDilation.projection_surjective
statement: theorem projection_surjective : Surjective (projection k).left
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro x
  exact ⟨(scalingSection k).left x,
    congrArg (fun q : (multiplicativeGroup k).toGroupScheme.X ⟶
      (multiplicativeGroup k).toGroupScheme.X ↦ q.left x) (scalingSection_comp_projection k)⟩

name: AclGeom.AdditiveRigidity.AclGeom.AffineDilation.point_comp_projection
statement:
theorem point_comp_projection
    (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k).toGroupScheme.X) :
    q ≫ projection k = (multiplicativeGroup.pointsMulEquiv k).symm
      (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k q).multiplier
proof:
:= by
  let a := AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k q
  have hq : q = (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
      AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k a.multiplier a.shift := by
    calc
      _ = (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k).symm a :=
        ((AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k).symm_apply_apply q).symm
      _ = _ := by
        apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
        exact (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_left k a).trans
          (Category.id_comp _).symm
  calc
    _ = ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
        AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k a.multiplier a.shift) ≫ projection k :=
      congrArg (fun g ↦ g ≫ projection k) hq
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Category.assoc, groupPoint_comp_projection, AdditiveRigidity.unitPoint_eq_points]

name: AclGeom.SchemeAffinePointAction.exists_faithful_affine_coordinates
statement:
theorem exists_faithful_affine_coordinates
    (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (hker : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
      ModObj.pointAct V q = 𝟙 V → q = 1)
    (hdimG : (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDim G.toAlgebraicGroup.carrier)
    (hdimV : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1) :
    letI
proof:
:= ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAlgebra V
    ∃ t : V.left.functionField, Transcendental k t ∧
      IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set V.left.functionField) = ⊤ ∧
      ∃ Φ : (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) →*
          AffineTransformation k, Function.Injective Φ ∧
        ∀ g, (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V g).unop t =
          algebraMap k V.left.functionField ((Φ g).multiplier : k) * t +
            algebraMap k V.left.functionField (Φ g).shift := by
  let := ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAlgebra V
  have : IsFunctionFieldOneVar k V.left.functionField :=
    scheme_functionField_isFunctionFieldOneVar k V hdimV
  have hg : genus k V.left.functionField = 0 :=
    SchemeCurveGenus.genus_eq_zero G.toGroupScheme.X V hker hdimG hdimV
  obtain ⟨P, _, hP⟩ := SchemePlaceAction.exists_fixed_boundary_place G V hdimV
  exact FixedPlaceAffine.exists_faithful_affine_representation
    (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V)
    (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction_injective G.toAlgebraicGroup V hker)
    P (fun g ↦ (SchemePlaceAction.placeAction_apply G.toAlgebraicGroup V g P).symm.trans
      (hP g)) hg

name: AclGeom.AffineCoefficients.localized_coefficients_points_injective
statement:
theorem localized_coefficients_points_injective (G : AlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (hker : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
      ModObj.pointAct V q = 𝟙 V → q = 1)
    {t : V.left.functionField}
    (htop : IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set V.left.functionField) = ⊤)
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) [Mono g]
    (d a b : A)
    (hformula : ∀ (φ : A →ₐ[k] k), φ d ≠ 0 →
      (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G V ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
        (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)).unop t =
          algebraMap k V.left.functionField (φ a / φ d) * t +
            algebraMap k V.left.functionField (φ b / φ d)) :
    let S
proof:
:= Localization.Away d
    let a0 : S := algebraMap A S a * IsLocalization.Away.invSelf d
    let b0 : S := algebraMap A S b * IsLocalization.Away.invSelf d
    let B := Algebra.adjoin k ({a0, b0} : Set S)
    Function.Injective (fun φ : S →ₐ[k] k ↦ φ.comp B.val) := by
  let S := Localization.Away d
  let a0 : S := algebraMap A S a * IsLocalization.Away.invSelf d
  let b0 : S := algebraMap A S b * IsLocalization.Away.invSelf d
  let B := Algebra.adjoin k ({a0, b0} : Set S)
  let restrict (φ : S →ₐ[k] k) : A →ₐ[k] k :=
    φ.comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A S)
  have hd (φ : S →ₐ[k] k) : restrict φ d ≠ 0 :=
    ((IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (S := S) d).map φ).ne_zero
  have hinv (φ : S →ₐ[k] k) : φ (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf d : S) =
      (restrict φ d)⁻¹ := by
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ (hd φ)
    rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ (hd φ)]
    calc
      _ = φ ((IsLocalization.Away.invSelf d : S) * algebraMap A S d) :=
        (map_mul φ _ _).symm
      _ = 1 := by rw [mul_comm, IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf, map_one]
  have hvalue (φ : S →ₐ[k] k) (n : A) :
      φ (algebraMap A S n * IsLocalization.Away.invSelf d) =
        restrict φ n / restrict φ d := by
    rw [map_mul, hinv, div_eq_mul_inv]
    rfl
  change Function.Injective (fun φ : S →ₐ[k] k ↦ φ.comp B.val)
  intro φ ψ heq
  have ha : φ a0 = ψ a0 := by
    let x : B := ⟨a0, Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_insert _ _)⟩
    exact AlgHom.congr_fun heq x
  have hb : φ b0 = ψ b0 := by
    let x : B := ⟨b0, Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_singleton _))⟩
    exact AlgHom.congr_fun heq x
  let sp (φ : S →ₐ[k] k) : (Spec (.of k)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶
      (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) :=
    (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom (restrict φ)).op
  let q (φ : S →ₐ[k] k) := (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ sp φ ≫ g
  have ht : (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G V (q φ)).unop t =
      (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G V (q ψ)).unop t := by
    have hφ : (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G V (q φ)).unop t =
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField (restrict φ a / restrict φ d) * t +
          algebraMap k V.left.functionField (restrict φ b / restrict φ d) :=
      hformula (restrict φ) (hd φ)
    have hψ : (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G V (q ψ)).unop t =
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField (restrict ψ a / restrict ψ d) * t +
          algebraMap k V.left.functionField (restrict ψ b / restrict ψ d) :=
      hformula (restrict ψ) (hd ψ)
    rw [hφ, hψ]
    change algebraMap k V.left.functionField (restrict φ a / restrict φ d) * t +
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField (restrict φ b / restrict φ d) = _
    rw [← hvalue φ a, ← hvalue φ b, ← hvalue ψ a, ← hvalue ψ b]
    rw [ha, hb]
  have hq : q φ = q ψ := by
    apply ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction_injective G V hker
    apply MulOpposite.unop_injective
    let P := IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set V.left.functionField)
    let incl : P →ₐ[k] V.left.functionField := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P V.left.functionField
    have he : (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G V (q φ)).unop.toAlgHom.comp incl =
        (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G V (q ψ)).unop.toAlgHom.comp incl := by
      apply IntermediateField.adjoin_algHom_ext k
      intro z hz
      have hzt : z = t := Set.mem_singleton_iff.1 hz
      subst z
      exact ht
    apply AlgEquiv.ext
    intro x
    have hx : x ∈ P := by
