      change x ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set V.left.functionField)
      rw [htop]
      trivial
    exact congrArg (fun f : P →ₐ[k] V.left.functionField ↦ f ⟨x, hx⟩) he
  have hmap : sp φ = sp ψ := by
    apply (cancel_epi (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom).mp
    apply (cancel_mono g).mp
    rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc]
    exact hq
  have hleft := congrArg (fun f : (Spec (.of k)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶
    (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ↦ f.left) hmap
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (restrict φ).toRingHom) =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (restrict ψ).toRingHom) at hleft
  have hrestrict : restrict φ = restrict ψ := AlgHom.ext fun n ↦
    congrArg (fun f : CommRingCat.of A ⟶ CommRingCat.of k ↦ f.hom n)
      (Spec.map_injective hleft)
  have hr : φ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap A S) = ψ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap A S) :=
    congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom hrestrict
  have hfull := IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers d) hr
  exact AlgHom.ext fun x ↦ RingHom.congr_fun hfull x

name: AclGeom.AffineCoefficients.AclGeom.AffineCoefficients.isAlgebraic_of_affine_specializations
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_of_affine_specializations (G : AlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (hker : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
      ModObj.pointAct V q = 𝟙 V → q = 1)
    {t : V.left.functionField}
    (htop : IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set V.left.functionField) = ⊤)
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A]
    (g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) [Mono g]
    (d a b : A) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (hformula : ∀ (φ : A →ₐ[k] k), φ d ≠ 0 →
      (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G V ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
        (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)).unop t =
          algebraMap k V.left.functionField (φ a / φ d) * t +
            algebraMap k V.left.functionField (φ b / φ d)) :
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic (IntermediateField.adjoin k
      ({algebraMap A (FractionRing A) a / algebraMap A (FractionRing A) d,
        algebraMap A (FractionRing A) b / algebraMap A (FractionRing A) d} :
          Set (FractionRing A))) (FractionRing A)
proof:
:= by
  let C := FractionRing A
  let S := Localization.Away d
  let evC : A →ₐ[k] C := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A C
  have hinj : Function.Injective evC := IsFractionRing.injective A C
  have hdC : evC d ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hd
    apply hinj
    simpa only [map_zero] using h
  let locMap : S →ₐ[k] C := IsLocalization.Away.liftAlgHom d (f := evC)
    (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdC)
  have hlocMap (n : A) : locMap (algebraMap A S n) = evC n :=
    IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq d (g := evC.toRingHom) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdC) n
  let : Algebra S C := locMap.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower A S C := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun n ↦ (hlocMap n).symm)
  have : IsScalarTower k S C := IsScalarTower.of_algHom locMap
  have : IsFractionRing S C :=
    IsFractionRing.isFractionRing_of_isDomain_of_isLocalization (Submonoid.powers d) S C
  have : IsDomain S := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain S hd
  have : Algebra.FiniteType k S := inferInstance
  let a0 : S := algebraMap A S a * IsLocalization.Away.invSelf d
  let b0 : S := algebraMap A S b * IsLocalization.Away.invSelf d
  let B := Algebra.adjoin k ({a0, b0} : Set S)
  let C0 := IntermediateField.adjoin k ({evC a / evC d, evC b / evC d} : Set C)
  have hinv : locMap (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf d : S) = (evC d)⁻¹ := by
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ hdC
    rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hdC]
    calc
      _ = locMap ((IsLocalization.Away.invSelf d : S) * algebraMap A S d) := by
        rw [map_mul, hlocMap]
      _ = 1 := by rw [mul_comm, IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf, map_one]
  have hvalue (n : A) : locMap (algebraMap A S n * IsLocalization.Away.invSelf d) =
      evC n / evC d := by
    rw [map_mul, hlocMap, hinv, div_eq_mul_inv]
  have hle : B ≤ C0.toSubalgebra.comap locMap := by
    apply Algebra.adjoin_le
    intro z hz
    rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hz with rfl | hz
    · change locMap a0 ∈ C0
      rw [hvalue]
      exact IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
    · have hz' : z = b0 := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz
      subst z
      change locMap b0 ∈ C0
      rw [hvalue]
      exact IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _
        (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_singleton _))
  let f : B →ₐ[k] C0 := (locMap.comp B.val).codRestrict C0.toSubalgebra (fun z ↦ hle z.property)
  let : Algebra B C0 := f.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower B C0 C := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun _ ↦ rfl)
  apply isAlgebraic_fractionRing_of_injective_points (k := k) (B := B) (A := S)
    (C := C0) (E := C)
  exact localized_coefficients_points_injective G V hker htop g d a b hformula

name: AclGeom.card_factors_le_totalDegree
statement:
private theorem card_factors_le_totalDegree {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hF : F ≠ 0) :
    Multiset.card (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.factors F) ≤ F.totalDegree
proof:
:= by
  
  have hfac : ∀ q ∈ UniqueFactorizationMonoid.factors F, q ≠ 0 ∧ 1 ≤ q.totalDegree := by
    intro q hq
    have hirr : Irreducible q := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.irreducible_of_factor q hq
    refine ⟨hirr.ne_zero, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 fun h0 ↦ ?_⟩
    have hC : q = C (q.coeff 0) := totalDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C.1 h0
    have hc : q.coeff 0 ≠ 0 := fun hc0 ↦ hirr.ne_zero (by rw [hC, hc0, map_zero])
    exact hirr.not_isUnit (by rw [hC]; exact (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.2 hc).map C)
  
  have key : ∀ s : Multiset (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k),
      (∀ q ∈ s, q ≠ 0 ∧ 1 ≤ q.totalDegree) →
        Multiset.card s ≤ s.prod.totalDegree ∧ s.prod ≠ 0 := by
    intro s
    induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
    | empty => exact fun _ ↦ ⟨by simp, by simp⟩
    | cons a s ih =>
      intro h
      obtain ⟨ha0, ha1⟩ := h a (Multiset.mem_cons_self a s)
      obtain ⟨hcard, hprod⟩ := ih fun q hq ↦ h q (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hq)
      rw [Multiset.card_cons, Multiset.prod_cons, totalDegree_mul_of_isDomain ha0 hprod]
      exact ⟨by omega, mul_ne_zero ha0 hprod⟩
  exact (key _ hfac).1.trans
    (totalDegree_le_of_dvd_of_isDomain (UniqueFactorizationMonoid.factors_prod hF).dvd hF)

name: AclGeom.exists_curve_ideal_colors
statement:
theorem exists_curve_ideal_colors (F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (hF : F ≠ 0) :
    ∃ S : Finset (Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)), S.card ≤ F.totalDegree ∧
      ∀ u v : K, Transcendental k u → v ∈ racl k {u} → aeval ![u, v] F = 0 →
        idealOf k ![u, v] ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨(UniqueFactorizationMonoid.factors F).toFinset.image
      (fun q ↦ Ideal.span ({q} : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k))),
    (Finset.card_image_le.trans (Multiset.toFinset_card_le _)).trans
      (card_factors_le_totalDegree k hF), ?_⟩
  intro u v hu hv hz
  obtain ⟨G, hG, hI⟩ := exists_prime_span_idealOf k hu hv
  have hmem : F ∈ Ideal.span {G} := by
    rw [← hI]
    exact (mem_idealOf_iff k).2 hz
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hGq⟩ := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.exists_mem_factors_of_dvd hF hG.irreducible
    (Ideal.mem_span_singleton.1 hmem)
  exact Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨q, by simpa using hq,
    (hI.trans (Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton.2 hGq)).symm⟩

name: AclGeom.finite_curve_ideals_of_relation
statement:
theorem finite_curve_ideals_of_relation (F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (hF : F ≠ 0) :
    Set.Finite {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) |
      ∃ u v : K, Transcendental k u ∧ v ∈ racl k {u} ∧
        aeval ![u, v] F = 0 ∧ idealOf k ![u, v] = I}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, -, hS⟩ := exists_curve_ideal_colors k K F hF
  refine S.finite_toSet.subset ?_
  rintro I ⟨u, v, hu, hv, hz, rfl⟩
  exact hS u v hu hv hz

name: AclGeom.kernel_fraction_tuple
proof:
:= MvPolynomial ι E ⧸ I
    let F := FractionRing A
    let a : ι → F := fun i ↦ algebraMap A F (Ideal.Quotient.mk I (MvPolynomial.X i))
    AclGeom.idealOf E a = I := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  ext p
  rw [AclGeom.mem_idealOf_iff]
  have h : MvPolynomial.aeval
      (fun i ↦ algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι E ⧸ I) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ι E ⧸ I))
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk I (MvPolynomial.X i))) p =
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι E ⧸ I) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ι E ⧸ I))
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk I p) := by
    let φ : (MvPolynomial ι E ⧸ I) →ₐ[E] FractionRing (MvPolynomial ι E ⧸ I) :=
      IsScalarTower.toAlgHom E (MvPolynomial ι E ⧸ I) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ι E ⧸ I))
    have hc : MvPolynomial.aeval
        (fun i ↦ algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι E ⧸ I) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ι E ⧸ I))
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk I (MvPolynomial.X i))) = φ.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ E I) := by
      ext i
      simp [φ]
    exact congrArg (fun g ↦ g p) hc
  rw [h, map_eq_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective _ _), Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]

name: AclGeom.comap_map_mvPolynomial_eq_self
statement:
theorem comap_map_mvPolynomial_eq_self {k E : Type*} [Field k] [Field E] [Algebra k E]
    {ι : Type*} (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι k)) :
    (I.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E))).comap
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E)) = I
proof:
:= by
  let e := MvPolynomial.algebraTensorAlgEquiv k E (σ := ι)
  let J := I.map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (A := E) (R := k)).toRingHom
  let q : E ⊗[k] (MvPolynomial ι k ⧸ I) ≃ₐ[E] ((E ⊗[k] MvPolynomial ι k) ⧸ J) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.tensorQuotientEquiv (R := k) E (MvPolynomial ι k) E I
  have he : e.toRingHom.comp
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (A := E) (R := k)).toRingHom =
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E) := by
    ext i <;> simp [e]
  have hi : I.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E)) = J.map e.toRingHom := by
    change I.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E)) =
      (I.map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (A := E) (R := k)).toRingHom).map e.toRingHom
    rw [Ideal.map_map, he]
  ext p
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, hi]
  change MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E) p ∈ J.map e.toRingEquiv.toRingHom ↔ p ∈ I
  have hm : J.map e.toRingHom = J.comap e.symm.toRingHom :=
    Ideal.map_comap_of_equiv e.toRingEquiv
  rw [hm, Ideal.mem_comap]
  change e.symm (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E) p) ∈ J ↔ p ∈ I
  rw [MvPolynomial.algebraTensorAlgEquiv_symm_map, ← Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
  have hz : q.symm (Ideal.Quotient.mk J ((1 : E) ⊗ₜ[k] p)) = 0 ↔
      Ideal.Quotient.mk J ((1 : E) ⊗ₜ[k] p) = 0 :=
    map_eq_zero_iff q.symm q.symm.injective
  rw [← hz]
  change (1 : E) ⊗ₜ[k] Ideal.Quotient.mk I p = 0 ↔ p ∈ I
  rw [Module.FaithfullyFlat.one_tmul_eq_zero_iff, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]

name: AclGeom.independent_tensor
statement:
private theorem independent_tensor {k E A : Type*} [Field k] [CommRing E]
    [CommRing A] [Algebra k E] [Algebra k A] {ι : Type*} (x : ι → A)
    (hx : AlgebraicIndependent k x) :
    AlgebraicIndependent E (fun i ↦ (1 : E) ⊗ₜ[k] x i)
proof:
:= by
  let e := MvPolynomial.algebraTensorAlgEquiv k E (σ := ι)
  let f : E ⊗[k] MvPolynomial ι k →ₐ[E] E ⊗[k] A :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id E E) (MvPolynomial.aeval x)
  have hf : Function.Injective f :=
    Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap (M := E)
      (MvPolynomial.aeval x).toLinearMap hx
  have h : MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i ↦ (1 : E) ⊗ₜ[k] x i) =
      f.comp e.symm.toAlgHom := by
    ext i
    simp [f, e]
  rw [AlgebraicIndependent, h]
  exact hf.comp e.symm.injective

name: AclGeom.exists_genericPoint_baseChange
statement:
theorem exists_genericPoint_baseChange {k : Type u} {E : Type v} {F : Type w}
    [Field k] [Field E] [Field F] [Algebra k E] [Algebra k F] [IsAlgClosed k]
    {ι : Type z} (a : ι → F) :
    ∃ (K : Type (max v z)) (_ : Field K) (_ : Algebra E K) (_ : Algebra k K)
      (_ : IsScalarTower k E K) (b : ι → K),
      idealOf E b = (idealOf k a).map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E)) ∧
      idealOf k b = idealOf k a ∧
      ∀ S : Set ι, AlgebraicIndependent k (fun j : S ↦ a j) →
        AlgebraicIndependent E (fun j : S ↦ b j)
proof:
:= by
  let I := idealOf k a
  let J := I.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E))
  have : J.IsPrime := isPrime_map_of_isAlgClosed I
  let A := MvPolynomial ι E ⧸ J
  let K := FractionRing A
  let b : ι → K := fun i ↦ algebraMap A K (Ideal.Quotient.mk J (MvPolynomial.X i))
  have hE : idealOf E b = J := kernel_fraction_tuple J
  have hk : idealOf k b = I := by
    have hbase : idealOf k b = (idealOf E b).comap
        (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E)) := by
      ext p
      rw [mem_idealOf_iff, Ideal.mem_comap, mem_idealOf_iff,
        MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap]
    rw [hbase, hE]
    exact comap_map_mvPolynomial_eq_self I
  refine ⟨K, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, b, hE, hk, ?_⟩
  intro S hS
  let C := MvPolynomial ι k ⧸ I
  let c : ι → C := fun i ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk I (MvPolynomial.X i)
  have hc : AlgebraicIndependent k (fun j : S ↦ c j) := by
    apply AlgebraicIndependent.of_comp
      (Ideal.kerLiftAlg (MvPolynomial.aeval a : MvPolynomial ι k →ₐ[k] F))
    have hfun : (Ideal.kerLiftAlg (MvPolynomial.aeval a : MvPolynomial ι k →ₐ[k] F)) ∘
        (fun j : S ↦ c j) = fun j : S ↦ a j := by
      funext j
      exact (Ideal.kerLiftAlg_mk
        (MvPolynomial.aeval a : MvPolynomial ι k →ₐ[k] F) (MvPolynomial.X (j : ι))).trans
        (MvPolynomial.aeval_X (R := k) a (j : ι))
    rw [hfun]
    exact hS
  have ht := independent_tensor (E := E) (fun j : S ↦ c j) hc
  let e := MvPolynomial.algebraTensorAlgEquiv k E (σ := ι)
  let D := I.map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (A := E) (R := k)).toRingHom
  have he : e.toRingHom.comp
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (A := E) (R := k)).toRingHom =
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E) := by
    ext i <;> simp [e]
  have hi : J = D.map (e : E ⊗[k] MvPolynomial ι k →+* MvPolynomial ι E) := by
    change I.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E)) =
      (I.map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (A := E) (R := k)).toRingHom).map e.toRingHom
    rw [Ideal.map_map, he]
  let q : E ⊗[k] C ≃ₐ[E] A :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.tensorQuotientEquiv (R := k) E (MvPolynomial ι k) E I).trans
      (Ideal.quotientEquivAlg D J e hi)
  let φ : A →ₐ[E] K := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom E A K
  have hb := ht.map' (f := φ.comp q.toAlgHom)
    ((IsFractionRing.injective A K).comp q.injective)
  have hq (i : ι) : q ((1 : E) ⊗ₜ[k] c i) = Ideal.Quotient.mk J (MvPolynomial.X i) := by
    change Ideal.quotientEquivAlg D J e hi
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.tensorQuotientEquiv (R := k) E (MvPolynomial ι k) E I
        ((1 : E) ⊗ₜ[k] Ideal.Quotient.mk I (MvPolynomial.X i))) = _
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tensorQuotientEquiv_apply_tmul]
    change Ideal.quotientEquivAlg D J e hi
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk D ((1 : E) ⊗ₜ[k] MvPolynomial.X i)) = _
    rw [Ideal.quotientEquivAlg_mk]
    simp [e]
  have hfun : (φ.comp q.toAlgHom) ∘ (fun j : S ↦ (1 : E) ⊗ₜ[k] c j) =
      fun j : S ↦ b j := by
    funext j
    change φ (q ((1 : E) ⊗ₜ[k] c j)) = b j
    rw [hq]
    rfl
  rw [hfun] at hb
  exact hb

name: AclGeom.subalgebra_disjoint_of_generic
proof:
:= by
  let C := MvPolynomial ι k ⧸ I
  let J := I.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E))
  let e := MvPolynomial.algebraTensorAlgEquiv k E (σ := ι)
  let D := I.map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (A := E) (R := k)).toRingHom
  have he : e.toRingHom.comp
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (A := E) (R := k)).toRingHom =
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E) := by
    ext j <;> simp [e]
  have hJ : J = D.map (e : E ⊗[k] MvPolynomial ι k →+* MvPolynomial ι E) := by
    change I.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E)) =
      (I.map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (A := E) (R := k)).toRingHom).map e.toRingHom
    rw [Ideal.map_map, he]
  let q : E ⊗[k] C ≃ₐ[E] (MvPolynomial ι E ⧸ idealOf E b) :=
    ((Algebra.TensorProduct.tensorQuotientEquiv (R := k) E (MvPolynomial ι k) E I).trans
      (Ideal.quotientEquivAlg D J e hJ)).trans
      (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq E hgen.symm)
  let φ := Ideal.kerLiftAlg (MvPolynomial.aeval b : MvPolynomial ι E →ₐ[E] Ω)
  let i : E ⊗[k] C →ₐ[k] Ω := (φ.comp q.toAlgHom).restrictScalars k
  have hi : Function.Injective i :=
    (Ideal.kerLiftAlg_injective (MvPolynomial.aeval b : MvPolynomial ι E →ₐ[E] Ω)).comp
      q.injective
  have hq (x : E) (p : MvPolynomial ι k) :
      q (x ⊗ₜ[k] Ideal.Quotient.mk I p) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealOf E b) (e (x ⊗ₜ[k] p)) := by
    change Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq E hgen.symm
      (Ideal.quotientEquivAlg D J e hJ
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.tensorQuotientEquiv (R := k) E (MvPolynomial ι k) E I
          (x ⊗ₜ[k] Ideal.Quotient.mk I p))) = _
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tensorQuotientEquiv_apply_tmul]
    change Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq E hgen.symm
      (Ideal.quotientEquivAlg D J e hJ
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk D (x ⊗ₜ[k] p))) = _
    rw [Ideal.quotientEquivAlg_mk, Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq_mk]
  have hit (x : E) (p : MvPolynomial ι k) :
      i (x ⊗ₜ[k] Ideal.Quotient.mk I p) = algebraMap E Ω x * MvPolynomial.aeval b p := by
    change φ (q (x ⊗ₜ[k] Ideal.Quotient.mk I p)) = _
    rw [hq]
    change Ideal.kerLiftAlg (MvPolynomial.aeval b : MvPolynomial ι E →ₐ[E] Ω)
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (RingHom.ker (MvPolynomial.aeval b : MvPolynomial ι E →ₐ[E] Ω))
        (e (x ⊗ₜ[k] p))) = _
    rw [Ideal.kerLiftAlg_mk]
    change MvPolynomial.aeval b (MvPolynomial.algebraTensorAlgEquiv k E (x ⊗ₜ[k] p)) = _
    rw [MvPolynomial.algebraTensorAlgEquiv_tmul]
    rw [map_smul, MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap, Algebra.smul_def]
  have hleft : i.comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : E →ₐ[k] E ⊗[k] C) =
      IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k E Ω := by
    ext x
    change i (x ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : C)) = algebraMap E Ω x
    simpa using hit x 1
  have hright : (i.comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : C →ₐ[k] E ⊗[k] C)).comp
      (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k I) = MvPolynomial.aeval b := by
    ext j
    simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply, MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
    change i ((1 : E) ⊗ₜ[k] Ideal.Quotient.mk I (MvPolynomial.X j)) = b j
    simpa using hit 1 (MvPolynomial.X j)
  have hR : (i.comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : C →ₐ[k] E ⊗[k] C)).range =
      (MvPolynomial.aeval b : MvPolynomial ι k →ₐ[k] Ω).range := by
    have hm : (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k I).range = ⊤ :=
      (AlgHom.range_eq_top _).2 Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    calc
      _ = ((i.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight).comp (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k I)).range := by
        rw [AlgHom.range_comp (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k I)
          (i.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight), hm, Algebra.map_top]
      _ = _ := congrArg AlgHom.range hright
  have H := (Subalgebra.LinearDisjoint.include_range k E C).map i hi
  rw [← AlgHom.range_comp, ← AlgHom.range_comp, hleft, hR,
    ← Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_aeval] at H
  exact H

name: AclGeom.isGeneric_baseChange
statement:
theorem isGeneric_baseChange {k E Ω : Type*}
    [Field k] [Field E] [Field Ω] [Algebra k E] [Algebra k Ω] [Algebra E Ω]
    [IsScalarTower k E Ω] {ι : Type*} {b : ι → Ω} {I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι k)}
    (hgen : idealOf E b = I.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E))) :
    idealOf k b = I ∧
      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k E Ω).fieldRange.LinearDisjoint
        (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range b))
proof:
:= by
  have hk : idealOf k b = I := by
    have hbase : idealOf k b = (idealOf E b).comap
        (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E)) := by
      ext p
      rw [mem_idealOf_iff, Ideal.mem_comap, mem_idealOf_iff,
        MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap]
    rw [hbase, hgen]
    exact comap_map_mvPolynomial_eq_self I
  refine ⟨hk, ?_⟩
  let A := (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k E Ω).fieldRange
  let a := Module.Free.chooseBasis k A
  have H : A.toSubalgebra.LinearDisjoint (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range b)) :=
    subalgebra_disjoint_of_generic hgen
  have hring : LinearIndependent (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range b)) (A.val ∘ a) :=
    H.linearIndependent_left_of_flat a.linearIndependent
  have hfield : LinearIndependent (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range b)) (A.val ∘ a) :=
    (LinearIndependent.iff_fractionRing (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range b))
      (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range b))).mp hring
  exact IntermediateField.LinearDisjoint.of_basis_left a hfield

name: AclGeom.trdeg_adjoin_of_isGeneric
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F := IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range b)
  let G := IntermediateField.adjoin E (Set.range b)
  have H := ((isGeneric_baseChange hgen).2).symm'
  have hf : IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k F Ω = F.val := by
    ext z
    rfl
  rw [hf, IntermediateField.fieldRange_val] at H
  obtain ⟨α, t, ht⟩ := exists_isTranscendenceBasis' k F
  let x : α → Ω := F.val ∘ t
  have hmono : LinearIndependent k
      ((MvPolynomial.aeval t).toLinearMap ∘ MvPolynomial.basisMonomials α k) :=
    (MvPolynomial.basisMonomials α k).linearIndependent.map'
      (MvPolynomial.aeval t).toLinearMap (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr ht.1)
  have hmonoE := H.linearIndependent_left hmono
  have hx : AlgebraicIndependent E x := by
    change Function.Injective (MvPolynomial.aeval x : MvPolynomial α E →ₐ[E] Ω).toLinearMap
    apply LinearMap.injective_of_linearIndependent (MvPolynomial.basisMonomials α E).span_eq
    convert hmonoE using 1
    ext d
    simp [x, Function.comp_def, MvPolynomial.aeval_monomial, Finsupp.prod]
  have hbase (S : Set Ω) : (IntermediateField.adjoin k S : Set Ω) ⊆
      IntermediateField.adjoin E S := by
    apply (IntermediateField.adjoin_subset_adjoin_iff k).mpr
    constructor
    · rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k E Ω]
      exact IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ _
    · exact IntermediateField.subset_adjoin E S
  have hFG : (F : Set Ω) ⊆ G := hbase (Set.range b)
  let y : α → G := fun i ↦ ⟨x i, hFG (t i).2⟩
  have hy : AlgebraicIndependent E y := AlgebraicIndependent.of_comp G.val hx
  have himage : G.val '' Set.range y = Set.range x := by
    rw [← Set.range_comp]
    rfl
  have hspan : G ≤ racl E (Set.range x) := by
    apply IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    have hz : (⟨b i, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩ : F) ∈
        racl k (Set.range t) :=
      (mem_racl_iff_isAlgebraic_adjoin k).mpr (ht.isAlgebraic.isAlgebraic _)
    have hz' := (algHom_mem_racl_image_iff F.val).mpr hz
    rw [← Set.range_comp] at hz'
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hzero, hcoeff⟩ := mem_racl_iff_exists_poly.mp hz'
    exact mem_racl_iff_exists_poly.mpr ⟨p, hp, hzero, fun n ↦ hbase _ (hcoeff n)⟩
  have halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (Algebra.adjoin E (Set.range y)) G := by
    constructor
    intro z
    apply (mem_racl_iff_isAlgebraic_adjoin E).mp
    apply (algHom_mem_racl_image_iff G.val).mp
    rw [himage]
    exact hspan z.2
  have hty : IsTranscendenceBasis E y := hy.isTranscendenceBasis_iff_isAlgebraic.mpr halg
  exact hty.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg.symm.trans ht.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg

name: AclGeom.linearDisjoint_adjoin_simple_of_transcendental
statement:
theorem linearDisjoint_adjoin_simple_of_transcendental {F Ω : Type*} [Field F] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra F Ω] (N : IntermediateField F Ω) {s : Ω} (hs : Transcendental N s) :
    N.LinearDisjoint (IntermediateField.adjoin F {s})
proof:
:= by
  have hgen : idealOf N ![s] =
      (⊥ : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin 1) F)).map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap F N)) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_bot]
    exact algebraicIndependent_iff_ker_eq_bot.1 (algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff.2 hs)
  have H := (isGeneric_baseChange hgen).2
  have hf : IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F N Ω = N.val := by
    ext z
    rfl
  rw [hf, IntermediateField.fieldRange_val, Set.range_unique] at H
  exact H

name: AclGeom.BirationalGluing.partialIsoOfMutualInversePartialMaps_toRationalMap
statement:
theorem partialIsoOfMutualInversePartialMaps_toRationalMap
    (f : X.PartialMap Y) [IsDominant f.hom]
    (g : Y.PartialMap X) [IsDominant g.hom]
    (hfg : (f.comp g).hom = (f.comp g).domain.ι)
    (hgf : (g.comp f).hom = (g.comp f).domain.ι) :
    (partialIsoOfMutualInversePartialMaps f g hfg hgf).toRationalMap = f.toRationalMap
proof:
:= by
  let fPre := f.hom ⁻¹ᵁ g.domain
  let gPre := g.hom ⁻¹ᵁ f.domain
  let U := f.domain.ι ''ᵁ fPre
  let V := g.domain.ι ''ᵁ gPre
  let uToF : U.toScheme ⟶ f.domain.toScheme :=
    (f.domain.ι.isoImage fPre).inv ≫ fPre.ι
  let fToG : U.toScheme ⟶ g.domain.toScheme :=
    (f.domain.ι.isoImage fPre).inv ≫ f.hom ∣_ g.domain
  have hu : uToF ≫ f.domain.ι = U.ι := f.domain.ι.isoImage_inv_ι fPre
  have hfg' : fToG ≫ g.hom = U.ι := by
    have h := hfg
    dsimp [Scheme.PartialMap.comp, fToG, U, fPre] at h ⊢
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using h
  have hsq : uToF ≫ f.domain.ι = fToG ≫ g.hom := hu.trans hfg'.symm
  let F : U.toScheme ⟶ V.toScheme :=
    (isPullback_morphismRestrict g.hom f.domain).lift uToF fToG hsq ≫
      (g.domain.ι.isoImage gPre).hom
  have hle : U ≤ f.domain := f.comp_domain_le g
  apply Scheme.PartialMap.toRationalMap_eq_iff.mpr
  refine ⟨U, (f.comp g).dense_domain, le_rfl, hle, ?_⟩
  change X.homOfLE (show U ≤ U from le_rfl) ≫ (F ≫ V.ι) = X.homOfLE hle ≫ f.hom
  rw [Scheme.homOfLE_rfl, Category.id_comp]
  dsimp only [F]
  rw [Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.isoImage_hom_ι, ← Category.assoc,
    (isPullback_morphismRestrict g.hom f.domain).lift_snd]
  change ((f.domain.ι.isoImage fPre).inv ≫ f.hom ∣_ g.domain) ≫ g.domain.ι = _
  rw [Category.assoc, morphismRestrict_ι, ← Category.assoc]
  apply congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ f.hom)
  apply (cancel_mono f.domain.ι).mp
  rw [Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.isoImage_inv_ι, Scheme.homOfLE_ι]

name: AclGeom.BirationalGluing.AclGeom.BirationalGluing.partialIsoOfMutualInverseRationalMaps_toRationalMap
statement:
theorem partialIsoOfMutualInverseRationalMaps_toRationalMap
    [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y] [X.IsSeparated] [Y.IsSeparated]
    (f : X ⤏ Y) [f.IsDominant] (g : Y ⤏ X) [g.IsDominant]
    (hfg : f.comp g = Scheme.RationalMap.id X)
    (hgf : g.comp f = Scheme.RationalMap.id Y) :
    (partialIsoOfMutualInverseRationalMaps f g hfg hgf).toRationalMap = f
proof:
:= by
  unfold partialIsoOfMutualInverseRationalMaps
  rw [partialIsoOfMutualInversePartialMaps_toRationalMap]
  exact f.toRationalMap_toPartialMap

name: AclGeom.BirationalGluing.AclGeom.BirationalGluing.AclGeom.CurveCoordinateCover.exists_openIso_of_isIso_functionFieldMap
statement:
theorem exists_openIso_of_isIso_functionFieldMap
    (X Y : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left] [IsIntegral Y.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom]
    [X.left.IsSeparated] [Y.left.IsSeparated]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsDominant f.left] [IsIso f.left.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap] :
    ∃ (U T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (jU : U ⟶ X) (jT : T ⟶ Y) (e : U ≅ T),
      IsOpenImmersion jU.left ∧ IsOpenImmersion jT.left ∧
      Nonempty U.left ∧ Nonempty T.left ∧ jU ≫ f = e.hom ≫ jT
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Fmap := f.left.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap
  let A : Y.left.functionField ≃ₐ[k] X.left.functionField :=
    AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := (asIso Fmap).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv)
      (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldMap_algebraMap f)
  let E := A.symm
  have hF : Fmap = CommRingCat.ofHom E.symm.toRingHom := by
    ext z
    rfl
  have hf : f.left.toRationalMap.fromFunctionField =
      Scheme.functionFieldMorphism E.toRingEquiv :=
    Scheme.PartialMap.fromFunctionField_eq_of_functionFieldMap_eq f.left.toPartialMap
      E.toRingEquiv hF
  let ψ : (Spec Y.left.functionField).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ X :=
    (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom E.toAlgHom).op ≫
      SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter X
  have hψ : ψ.left = Scheme.functionFieldMorphism E.symm.toRingEquiv := by rfl
  have hbase : ψ.left ≫ X.hom =
      Y.left.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Y.left) ≫ Y.hom :=
    (Over.w ψ).trans (Over.w (SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter Y)).symm
  let g := Scheme.RationalMap.ofFunctionField Y.hom X.hom ψ.left hbase
  have hg : g.fromFunctionField = Scheme.functionFieldMorphism E.symm.toRingEquiv :=
    (Scheme.RationalMap.fromFunctionField_ofFunctionField _ _ _ _).trans hψ
  have : g.IsDominant := by
    apply Scheme.RationalMap.isDominant_of_fromFunctionField_closedPoint
    rw [hg]
    exact Scheme.functionFieldMorphism_closedPoint _
  have hfg : f.left.toRationalMap.comp g = Scheme.RationalMap.id X.left :=
    Scheme.RationalMap.comp_eq_id_of_fromFunctionField_eq _ _ E.toRingEquiv hf hg
  have hgf : g.comp f.left.toRationalMap = Scheme.RationalMap.id Y.left :=
    Scheme.RationalMap.comp_eq_id_of_fromFunctionField_eq _ _ E.symm.toRingEquiv hg hf
  let e := BirationalGluing.partialIsoOfMutualInverseRationalMaps
    f.left.toRationalMap g hfg hgf
  have he : e.toRationalMap = f.left.toRationalMap :=
    BirationalGluing.partialIsoOfMutualInverseRationalMaps_toRationalMap _ _ hfg hgf
  have hsquare : e.iso.hom ≫ e.target.ι = e.source.ι ≫ f.left :=
    (Scheme.PartialMap.equiv_toPartialMap_iff_of_isSeparated (S := ⊤_ Scheme)).mp
      (Scheme.PartialMap.toRationalMap_eq_iff.mp he)
  have hfbase : f.left.toRationalMap.compHom Y.hom = X.hom.toRationalMap := by
    rw [← Scheme.RationalMap.compHom_toRationalMap,
      Scheme.Hom.toPartialMap_compHom, Over.w f]
  have heover : e.IsOver X.hom Y.hom :=
    BirationalGluing.partialIsoOfMutualInverseRationalMaps_isOver _ _ _ _ hfg hgf hfbase
  let U : Over (Spec (.of k)) := Over.mk (e.source.ι ≫ X.hom)
  let T : Over (Spec (.of k)) := Over.mk (e.target.ι ≫ Y.hom)
  let jU : U ⟶ X := Over.homMk e.source.ι
  let jT : T ⟶ Y := Over.homMk e.target.ι
  let eU : U ≅ T := Over.isoMk e.iso heover
  refine ⟨U, T, jU, jT, eU, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change IsOpenImmersion e.source.ι
    infer_instance
  · change IsOpenImmersion e.target.ι
    infer_instance
  · exact e.dense_source.nonempty.to_subtype
  · exact e.dense_target.nonempty.to_subtype
  · exact Over.OverMorphism.ext hsquare.symm

name: AclGeom.isFunctionFieldOneVar_of_trdeg_eq_one
statement:
theorem isFunctionFieldOneVar_of_trdeg_eq_one (k F : Type*) [Field k] [Field F]
    [Algebra k F] [Algebra.EssFiniteType k F] (htr : Algebra.trdeg k F = 1) :
    IsFunctionFieldOneVar k F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_finset_isTranscendenceBasis k F
  have hcard : s.card = 1 := by
    have h := hs.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg
    rw [Cardinal.mk_coe_finset, htr] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.1 hcard
  have halg := hs.isAlgebraic_field
  have hr : Set.range ((↑) : ({t} : Finset F) → F) = {t} := by
    ext x
    simp
  rw [hr] at halg
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F :=
    Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_comp k _ _
  exact ⟨⟨t, hs.1.transcendental ⟨t, Finset.mem_singleton_self t⟩,
    Algebra.finite_of_essFiniteType_of_isAlgebraic⟩⟩

name: AclGeom.exists_isAffineOpen_dimension_one
statement:
theorem exists_isAffineOpen_dimension_one (X : Scheme)
    (hX : topologicalKrullDim X = 1) :
    ∃ U : X.Opens, IsAffineOpen U ∧ Nonempty U ∧ topologicalKrullDim U = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, D, hCD⟩ := Order.one_le_krullDim_iff.1 hX.ge
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := C.isIrreducible.nonempty
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hxU, _⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset
    (show x ∈ (⊤ : X.Opens) from trivial)
  let e := IrreducibleCloseds.orderIsoOfIsOpenEmbedding
    (Subtype.val : U → X) U.isOpenEmbedding
  let c : {Z : IrreducibleCloseds X | ((Subtype.val : U → X) ⁻¹' Z).Nonempty} :=
    ⟨C, ⟨⟨x, hxU⟩, hx⟩⟩
  let d : {Z : IrreducibleCloseds X | ((Subtype.val : U → X) ⁻¹' Z).Nonempty} :=
    ⟨D, ⟨⟨x, hxU⟩, hCD.le hx⟩⟩
  have hcd : c < d := hCD
  have hlo : (1 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDim U :=
    Order.one_le_krullDim_iff.2 ⟨e.symm c, e.symm d, e.symm.strictMono hcd⟩
  refine ⟨U, hU, ⟨⟨x, hxU⟩⟩, le_antisymm ?_ hlo⟩
  exact (topologicalKrullDim_subspace_le X (U : Set X)).trans hX.le

name: AclGeom.SchemeActionSections.top_le_preimage
statement:
theorem top_le_preimage {X : Over (Spec (.of k))} (g : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ X)
    {U : X.left.Opens} (hg : g.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) ∈ U) : ⊤ ≤ g.left ⁻¹ᵁ U
proof:
:=
  fun y _ ↦ by
    obtain rfl : y = IsLocalRing.closedPoint k := Subsingleton.elim (α := PrimeSpectrum k) _ _
    exact hg

name: AclGeom.SchemeActionSections.pointEval_appLE
statement:
theorem pointEval_appLE {X : Over (Spec (.of k))} (g : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ X)
    (U : X.left.Opens) (hg : g.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) ∈ U) (c : k) :
    pointEval g U hg (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ X.hom.appLE ⊤ U le_top).hom c) = c
proof:
:= by
  have hid : ∀ (f : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (h : ⊤ ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤), f = 𝟙 _ →
      f.appLE ⊤ ⊤ h = 𝟙 _ := by
    rintro f h rfl
    exact Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app (𝟙 _)
  have key := (Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE (X := Spec (.of k)) g.left X.hom ⊤ U ⊤ le_top
    (top_le_preimage g hg)).trans (hid _ _ (by exact Over.w g))
  exact congrArg (fun φ : CommRingCat.of k ⟶ CommRingCat.of k ↦ φ.hom c)
    (show (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X.hom.appLE ⊤ U le_top ≫
        Scheme.Hom.appLE (X := Spec (.of k)) g.left U ⊤ (top_le_preimage g hg)) ≫
          (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).hom = 𝟙 _ by
      rw [key, Category.id_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id])

name: AclGeom.SchemeActionSections.pointEval_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem pointEval_eq_zero_iff {X : Over (Spec (.of k))} (g : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ X)
    {U : X.left.Opens} (hg : g.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) ∈ U) (c : Γ(X.left, U)) :
    pointEval g U hg c = 0 ↔ g.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) ∉ X.left.basicOpen c
proof:
:= by
  have hpt : ∀ t : Γ(Spec (.of k), ⊤),
      IsLocalRing.closedPoint k ∈ (Spec (.of k)).basicOpen t ↔ t ≠ 0 := by
    intro t
    constructor
    · rintro hx rfl
      rw [Scheme.basicOpen_zero] at hx
      exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_bot.1 hx
    · intro ht
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (TopologicalSpace.Opens.ne_bot_iff_nonempty _).1
        (mt (basicOpen_eq_bot_iff t).1 ht)
      obtain rfl : y = IsLocalRing.closedPoint k := Subsingleton.elim (α := PrimeSpectrum k) _ _
      exact hy
  have key : ∀ (p : Spec (.of k) ⟶ X.left) (h : ⊤ ≤ p ⁻¹ᵁ U),
      p.appLE U ⊤ h c = 0 ↔ p (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) ∉ X.left.basicOpen c := by
    intro p h
    have hmem : p (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) ∈ X.left.basicOpen c ↔
        IsLocalRing.closedPoint k ∈ (Spec (.of k)).basicOpen (p.appLE U ⊤ h c) := by
      change _ ↔ IsLocalRing.closedPoint k ∈ (Spec (.of k)).basicOpen
        ((Spec (.of k)).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (p.app U c))
      rw [Scheme.basicOpen_res, ← Scheme.preimage_basicOpen]
      exact ⟨fun hx ↦ TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_inf.2 ⟨trivial, hx⟩,
        fun hx ↦ (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_inf.1 hx).2⟩
    rw [hmem, hpt]
    exact not_not.symm
  have hinj : Function.Injective (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).hom.hom :=
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).hom).1
  exact (map_eq_zero_iff _ hinj).trans (key g.left (top_le_preimage g hg))

name: AclGeom.SchemeActionSections.exists_pointAut_appTop_eq_sum
statement:
theorem exists_pointAut_appTop_eq_sum (G : AlgebraicGroup k) (V : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [IsAffine V.left] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V] {U : G.carrier.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (r : Γ(V.left, ⊤)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (c : Fin n → Γ(G.carrier, U)) (s : Fin n → Γ(V.left, ⊤)),
      ∀ (g : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X)
        (hg : g.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) ∈ U),
        (ModObj.pointAut V g).hom.left.appTop r =
          ∑ i, ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ V.hom.appTop).hom (pointEval g U hg (c i)) *
            s i
proof:
:= by
  
  let algU : CommRingCat.of k ⟶ Γ(G.carrier, U) :=
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ G.structureMap.appLE ⊤ U le_top
  let algV : CommRingCat.of k ⟶ Γ(V.left, ⊤) := (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ V.hom.appTop
  let _ : Algebra k Γ(G.carrier, U) := algU.hom.toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra k Γ(V.left, ⊤) := algV.hom.toAlgebra
  have hu : hU.fromSpec ≫ G.structureMap = Spec.map algU := by
    change _ = Spec.map ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ G.structureMap.appLE ⊤ U le_top)
    rw [Spec.map_comp, ← Scheme.isoSpec_Spec_inv, ← IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_top]
    exact (IsAffineOpen.SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec G.structureMap (isAffineOpen_top _) hU _).symm
  have hv : V.left.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map algV = V.hom := by
    change V.left.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ V.hom.appTop) = V.hom
    rw [Spec.map_comp, ← Category.assoc, Scheme.isoSpec_hom_naturality, Category.assoc,
      Scheme.isoSpec_Spec_hom, ← Spec.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, Spec.map_id, Category.comp_id]
  
  let u : (Spec (.of Γ(G.carrier, U))).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X :=
    Over.homMk hU.fromSpec hu
  let vIso : V ≅ (Spec (.of Γ(V.left, ⊤))).asOver (Spec (.of k)) :=
    Over.isoMk V.left.isoSpec hv
  
  let Φ : (Spec (.of Γ(G.carrier, U))).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⊗
      (Spec (.of Γ(V.left, ⊤))).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ V :=
    (fst ((Spec (.of Γ(G.carrier, U))).asOver (Spec (.of k)))
        ((Spec (.of Γ(V.left, ⊤))).asOver (Spec (.of k))) ≫ u) •
      (snd ((Spec (.of Γ(G.carrier, U))).asOver (Spec (.of k)))
        ((Spec (.of Γ(V.left, ⊤))).asOver (Spec (.of k))) ≫ vIso.inv)
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ : ∃ ψ : CommRingCat.of Γ(V.left, ⊤) ⟶
      CommRingCat.of (Γ(G.carrier, U) ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)),
      Spec.map ψ =
        ((AffineSchemeAction.tensorSpecIso k Γ(G.carrier, U) Γ(V.left, ⊤)).inv ≫ Φ ≫
          vIso.hom).left :=
    ⟨Spec.preimage _, Spec.map_preimage _⟩
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ :=
    TensorProduct.exists_finset (ψ.hom r : Γ(G.carrier, U) ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤))
  have hsum : ψ.hom r = ∑ i : Fin S.card,
      (S.equivFin.symm i : Γ(G.carrier, U) × Γ(V.left, ⊤)).1 ⊗ₜ[k]
        (S.equivFin.symm i : Γ(G.carrier, U) × Γ(V.left, ⊤)).2 := by
    rw [hS, ← Finset.sum_coe_sort S]
    exact (Equiv.sum_comp S.equivFin.symm
      (fun p : S ↦ (p : Γ(G.carrier, U) × Γ(V.left, ⊤)).1 ⊗ₜ[k]
        (p : Γ(G.carrier, U) × Γ(V.left, ⊤)).2)).symm
  refine ⟨S.card, fun i ↦ (S.equivFin.symm i : Γ(G.carrier, U) × Γ(V.left, ⊤)).1,
    fun i ↦ (S.equivFin.symm i : Γ(G.carrier, U) × Γ(V.left, ⊤)).2, fun g hg ↦ ?_⟩
  
  have hle := top_le_preimage g hg
  have hpt : g.left = Spec.map (Scheme.Hom.appLE (X := Spec (.of k)) g.left U ⊤ hle ≫
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).hom) ≫ hU.fromSpec := by
    have h := IsAffineOpen.SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec (X := Spec (.of k)) g.left hU
      (isAffineOpen_top _) hle
    rw [IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_top, Scheme.isoSpec_Spec_inv] at h
    rw [Spec.map_comp, Category.assoc, h, ← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id,
      Spec.map_id, Category.id_comp]
  
  obtain ⟨ev, hev⟩ : ∃ ev : Γ(G.carrier, U) →ₐ[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤),
      ∀ a, ev a = algebraMap k Γ(V.left, ⊤) (pointEval g U hg a) :=
    ⟨⟨(algebraMap k Γ(V.left, ⊤)).comp (pointEval g U hg), fun c ↦
      congrArg (algebraMap k Γ(V.left, ⊤)) (pointEval_appLE g U hg c)⟩, fun _ ↦ rfl⟩
  have hevH : CommRingCat.ofHom ev.toRingHom =
      (Scheme.Hom.appLE (X := Spec (.of k)) g.left U ⊤ hle ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).hom) ≫
        algV := by
    ext a
    exact hev a
  have ha : vIso.hom ≫ (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ev.toRingHom)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ≫ u =
      toUnit V ≫ g := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    change V.left.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ev.toRingHom) ≫ hU.fromSpec =
      V.hom ≫ g.left
    rw [hevH, Spec.map_comp, Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc V.left.isoSpec.hom, hv, ← hpt]
  have hb : vIso.hom ≫ (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AlgHom.id k Γ(V.left, ⊤)).toRingHom)).asOver
      (Spec (.of k)) ≫ vIso.inv = 𝟙 V := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    change V.left.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map (𝟙 _) ≫ V.left.isoSpec.inv = 𝟙 V.left
    rw [Spec.map_id, Category.id_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id]
  
  have hleft : (ModObj.pointAct V g).left = V.left.isoSpec.hom ≫
      Spec.map (ψ ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift ev
        (AlgHom.id k Γ(V.left, ⊤)) fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _).toRingHom) ≫
      V.left.isoSpec.inv := by
    have e : ModObj.pointAct V g = vIso.hom ≫
        (lift ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ev.toRingHom)).asOver (Spec (.of k)))
          ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AlgHom.id k Γ(V.left, ⊤)).toRingHom)).asOver
            (Spec (.of k))) ≫
          (AffineSchemeAction.tensorSpecIso k Γ(G.carrier, U) Γ(V.left, ⊤)).hom) ≫
        ((AffineSchemeAction.tensorSpecIso k Γ(G.carrier, U) Γ(V.left, ⊤)).inv ≫ Φ ≫
          vIso.hom) ≫ vIso.inv := by
      simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
      change (toUnit V ≫ g) • 𝟙 V = vIso.hom ≫ _ ≫
        ((fst ((Spec (.of Γ(G.carrier, U))).asOver (Spec (.of k)))
            ((Spec (.of Γ(V.left, ⊤))).asOver (Spec (.of k))) ≫ u) •
          (snd ((Spec (.of Γ(G.carrier, U))).asOver (Spec (.of k)))
            ((Spec (.of Γ(V.left, ⊤))).asOver (Spec (.of k))) ≫ vIso.inv))
      rw [ModObj.comp_smul, ModObj.comp_smul, lift_fst_assoc, lift_snd_assoc, ha, hb]
    rw [e, AffineSchemeAction.lift_tensorSpecIso_hom, Spec.map_comp ψ, hψ]
    simp only [Over.comp_left, Category.assoc]
    rfl
  have happ : (ModObj.pointAct V g).left.appTop = ψ ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift ev (AlgHom.id k Γ(V.left, ⊤)) fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _).toRingHom
      := by
    apply Spec.map_injective
    rw [← cancel_mono V.left.isoSpec.inv, Scheme.isoSpec_inv_naturality, hleft,
      Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  change ((ModObj.pointAct V g).left.appTop).hom r = _
  rw [happ]
  change (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift ev (AlgHom.id k Γ(V.left, ⊤)) fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _)
    (ψ.hom r) = _
  rw [hsum, map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul _ _ _ _ _).trans (congrArg (· * _) (hev _))

name: AclGeom.AdditiveRigidity.exists_multiplicative_lift
statement:
theorem exists_multiplicative_lift (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom]
    (f : X ⟶ (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X)
    (hpoint : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ X, ∃ a : kˣ,
      q ≫ f = (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (a : k)) :
    ∃ χ : X ⟶ (multiplicativeGroup k).toGroupScheme.X, χ ≫ multiplicativeValue k = f
proof:
:= by
  let R := AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hrec⟩ := exists_spec_pullback X R f
  let f₀ : X.left ⟶ Spec (.of R) := f.left
  have hφ₀ : CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫ f₀.appTop := by
    apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
    exact hφ
  let s := φ (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k)
  have hunit : IsUnit s := by
    apply isUnit_section_of_point_values X s
    intro q
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hpoint q
    let q₀ : Spec (.of k) ⟶ X.left := q.left
    have hspec : q₀ ≫ f₀ =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (a : k)).toRingHom) := by
      have hh := congrArg Over.Hom.left ha
      change q₀ ≫ f₀ = 𝟙 _ ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (a : k)).toRingHom) at hh
      simpa only [Category.id_comp] using hh
    have hΓ : CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom ≫ q₀.appTop ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).hom =
        CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (a : k)).toRingHom := by
      calc
        _ = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫ (q₀ ≫ f₀).appTop ≫
            (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).hom := by
          simp only [hφ₀, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, Category.assoc]
        _ = (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (a : k)).toRingHom)).appTop ≫
            (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).hom := by rw [hspec]
        _ = CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (a : k)).toRingHom ≫
            (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).hom :=
          (Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality_assoc _ _).symm
        _ = _ := by rw [Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
    have hvalue := congrArg (fun h : CommRingCat.of R ⟶ CommRingCat.of k ↦
      h (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k)) hΓ
    change (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).hom (q₀.appTop s) =
      (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (a : k)) (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k) at hvalue
    rw [AffineSchemeAction.lineEval_lineCoordinate] at hvalue
    have hu : IsUnit ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).hom (q₀.appTop s)) := by
      rw [hvalue]
      exact a.isUnit
    have hv := hu.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv.hom
    have hz : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).hom (q₀.appTop s)) =
        q₀.appTop s := by
      have hh := congrArg (fun h : Γ(Spec (.of k), ⊤) ⟶ Γ(Spec (.of k), ⊤) ↦
        h (q₀.appTop s)) (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).hom_inv_id
      exact hh
    rwa [hz] at hv
  let evalUnit : AddMonoidAlgebra k ℤ →ₐ[k] Γ(X.left, ⊤) :=
    ((unitsMulEquivConv k Γ(X.left, ⊤)).symm hunit.unit).ofConv
  have hevalUnit : evalUnit (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (1 : ℤ) (1 : k)) = s :=
    (unitsMulEquivConv_symm_apply_single k Γ(X.left, ⊤) hunit.unit).trans hunit.unit_spec
  let χ : X ⟶ (multiplicativeGroup k).toGroupScheme.X := fromGlobal X _ evalUnit
  refine ⟨χ, ?_⟩
  have hcomp : evalUnit.comp (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval
      (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (1 : ℤ) (1 : k))) = φ := by
    apply AffineSchemeAction.lineHom_ext
    rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AffineSchemeAction.lineEval_lineCoordinate, hevalUnit]
  have hring : CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval
      (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (1 : ℤ) (1 : k))).toRingHom ≫
      CommRingCat.ofHom evalUnit.toRingHom = CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom := by
    apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
    change (evalUnit.comp (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval
      (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (1 : ℤ) (1 : k)))).toRingHom = φ.toRingHom
    exact congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom hcomp
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  change (X.left.toSpecΓ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom evalUnit.toRingHom)) ≫
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval
      (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (1 : ℤ) (1 : k))).toRingHom) = f₀
  rw [Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, hring]
  exact hrec

name: AclGeom.exists_basicOpen_in_comap_range
statement:
private theorem exists_basicOpen_in_comap_range
    {A B : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [CommRing B] [IsDomain B]
    (f : A →+* B) (hf : Function.Injective f) (hfp : f.FinitePresentation) :
    ∃ g : A, g ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A,
      g ∉ p.asIdeal → p ∈ Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let z : PrimeSpectrum A := ⟨⊥, inferInstance⟩
  have hz : z ∈ Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap f) := by
    refine ⟨⟨⊥, inferInstance⟩, ?_⟩
    apply PrimeSpectrum.ext
    exact ((RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot f).mp hf)
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := exists_constructibleSetData_iff.mpr
    (isConstructible_range_comap hfp)
  rw [← hS] at hz
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hzC⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hz
  have hg : ∀ i, C.g i = 0 := by
    intro i
    exact Ideal.mem_bot.mp ((mem_zeroLocus z _).mp hzC.1 ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  have hfn : C.f ≠ 0 := by
    intro he
    apply hzC.2
    rw [mem_zeroLocus, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    change C.f ∈ (⊥ : Ideal A)
    simp [he]
  refine ⟨C.f, hfn, fun p hp ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [← hS]
  apply Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨C, hC, ?_⟩
  constructor
  · rw [mem_zeroLocus]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [hg]
    exact p.asIdeal.zero_mem
  · simpa only [mem_zeroLocus, Set.singleton_subset_iff, SetLike.mem_coe] using hp

name: AclGeom.exists_subfield_eval_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem exists_subfield_eval_ne_zero
    {k F : Type*} [Field k] [Infinite k] [Field F] [Algebra k F]
    (p : F[X]) (hp : p ≠ 0) : ∃ c : k, p.eval (algebraMap k F c) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra! h
  exact (Set.infinite_of_injective_forall_mem (algebraMap k F).injective h)
    (Polynomial.finite_setOfPred_isRoot hp)

name: AclGeom.exists_algHom_of_evaluation_in_comap_range
statement:
private theorem exists_algHom_of_evaluation_in_comap_range
    {F R : Type*} [Field F] [IsAlgClosed F] [CommRing R] [Algebra F R]
    [Algebra.FiniteType F R] (f : F[X] →ₐ[F] R) (c : F)
    (hc : PrimeSpectrum.comap (Polynomial.evalRingHom c)
      ⟨⊥, inferInstance⟩ ∈ Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap f.toRingHom)) :
    ∃ φ : R →ₐ[F] F, φ (f X) = c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hc
  obtain ⟨M, hM, hQM⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal Q.asIdeal Q.isPrime.ne_top
  let : M.IsMaximal := hM
  let : Field (R ⧸ M) := Ideal.Quotient.field M
  let : Module.Finite F (R ⧸ M) := finite_of_finite_type_of_isJacobsonRing F (R ⧸ M)
  let φ : R →ₐ[F] F := (IsAlgClosed.lift : (R ⧸ M) →ₐ[F] F).comp
    (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ F M)
  have hmem : f (X - C c) ∈ Q.asIdeal := by
    change X - C c ∈ (PrimeSpectrum.comap f.toRingHom Q).asIdeal
    rw [hQ]
    change (X - C c).eval c ∈ (⊥ : Ideal F)
    simp
  have hz : φ (f (X - C c)) = 0 := by
    change IsAlgClosed.lift (Ideal.Quotient.mk M (f (X - C c))) = 0
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (hQM hmem), map_zero]
  refine ⟨φ, ?_⟩
  have hfc : f (C c) = algebraMap F R c := f.commutes c
  rw [map_sub, map_sub, hfc, φ.commutes, Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply] at hz
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz

name: AclGeom.exists_algHom_specializing_into_subfield
statement:
private theorem exists_algHom_specializing_into_subfield
    {k F R : Type*} [Field k] [Infinite k] [Field F] [IsAlgClosed F]
    [Algebra k F] [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Algebra F R]
    [Algebra.FiniteType F R] (f : F[X] →ₐ[F] R) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    ∃ (c : k) (φ : R →ₐ[F] F), φ (f X) = algebraMap k F c
proof:
:= by
  have hft : f.toRingHom.FiniteType := by
    apply RingHom.FiniteType.of_comp_finiteType (f := algebraMap F F[X])
    have hcomp : f.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap F F[X]) = algebraMap F R := by
      ext c
      exact f.commutes c
    rw [hcomp]
    exact RingHom.finiteType_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hrange⟩ := exists_basicOpen_in_comap_range f.toRingHom hf
    (RingHom.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType.mp hft)
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_subfield_eval_ne_zero (k := k) g hg
  have hm : PrimeSpectrum.comap (Polynomial.evalRingHom (algebraMap k F c))
      ⟨⊥, inferInstance⟩ ∈ Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap f.toRingHom) := by
    apply hrange
    change g.eval (algebraMap k F c) ∉ (⊥ : Ideal F)
    simpa only [Ideal.mem_bot] using hc
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := exists_algHom_of_evaluation_in_comap_range f _ hm
  exact ⟨c, φ, hφ⟩

name: AclGeom.finite_zero_specializations
proof:
:= by
  have hp : MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv k n P ≠ 0 :=
    (map_ne_zero_iff _ (MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv k n).injective).mpr hP
  exact Set.Finite.preimage (MvPolynomial.C_injective (σ := Fin n) (R := k)).injOn
    (Polynomial.finite_setOfPred_isRoot hp)

name: AclGeom.exists_finite_specialization
statement:
private theorem exists_finite_specialization
    {k F K : Type*} [Field k] [Infinite k] [Field F] [IsAlgClosed F]
    [Field K] [Algebra k F] [Algebra F K] [Algebra k K] [IsScalarTower k F K]
    {t : K} (ht : Transcendental F t) (s : Finset K) (bad : Finset k) :
    ∃ (R : Subalgebra F K) (htR : t ∈ R), (↑s : Set K) ⊆ R ∧
      ∃ (c : k) (φ : R →ₐ[F] F), c ∉ bad ∧ φ ⟨t, htR⟩ = algebraMap k F c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let d : K := ∏ c ∈ bad, (t - algebraMap k K c)
  have hd : d ≠ 0 := by
    apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
    intro c _
    apply sub_ne_zero.mpr
    intro he
    apply ht
    rw [he, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k F K]
    exact isAlgebraic_algebraMap (algebraMap k F c)
  let R := Algebra.adjoin F (↑(insert t (insert d⁻¹ s)) : Set K)
  have htR : t ∈ R := Algebra.subset_adjoin (by simp)
  have hsR : (↑s : Set K) ⊆ R := by
    intro z hz
    exact Algebra.subset_adjoin (by simp [hz])
  have hiR : d⁻¹ ∈ R := Algebra.subset_adjoin (by simp)
  let : Algebra.FiniteType F R := Algebra.FiniteType.adjoin_of_finite (Finset.finite_toSet _)
  let tR : R := ⟨t, htR⟩
  have htr : Transcendental F tR := by
    intro h
    exact ht (by simpa only [tR, Subalgebra.val_apply] using h.isIntegral.map R.val |>.isAlgebraic)
  obtain ⟨c, φ, hφ⟩ := exists_algHom_specializing_into_subfield (k := k)
    (Polynomial.aeval tR) (transcendental_iff_injective.mp htr)
  have hφt : φ tR = algebraMap k F c := by simpa only [Polynomial.aeval_X] using hφ
  refine ⟨R, htR, hsR, c, φ, ?_, hφt⟩
  intro hc
  let dR : R := ∏ b ∈ bad, (tR - algebraMap F R (algebraMap k F b))
  have hdR : (dR : K) = d := by
    simp [dR, d, tR, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k F K]
  have hunit : dR * (⟨d⁻¹, hiR⟩ : R) = 1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (dR : K) * d⁻¹ = 1
    rw [hdR, mul_inv_cancel₀ hd]
  have hz : φ dR = 0 := by
    simp only [dR, map_prod, map_sub, φ.commutes, hφt, Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply]
    apply Finset.prod_eq_zero hc
    exact sub_self _
  have hh := congrArg φ hunit
  rw [map_mul, hz, zero_mul, map_one] at hh
  exact zero_ne_one hh

name: AclGeom.aeval_specialize_first
statement:
theorem aeval_specialize_first {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {n : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k) (c : k) (v : Fin n → K) :
    MvPolynomial.aeval v ((MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv k n P).eval (MvPolynomial.C c)) =
      MvPolynomial.aeval (Fin.cons (algebraMap k K c) v) P
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (MvPolynomial.aeval v).toRingHom.comp
      ((Polynomial.evalRingHom (MvPolynomial.C c)).comp
        (MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv k n).toRingEquiv.toRingHom) =
      (MvPolynomial.aeval (Fin.cons (algebraMap k K c) v)).toRingHom := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro r
      simp [MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv_apply]
    · intro i
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j ↦ ?_) i
      · simp [MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv_X_zero]
      · simp [MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv_X_succ]
  exact congrArg (fun f : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k →+* K ↦ f P) heq

name: AclGeom.exists_finite_specialization_preserving_polynomials
statement:
theorem exists_finite_specialization_preserving_polynomials
    {k F K : Type*} [Field k] [Infinite k] [Field F] [IsAlgClosed F]
    [Field K] [Algebra k F] [Algebra F K] [Algebra k K] [IsScalarTower k F K]
    {t : K} (ht : Transcendental F t) (s : Finset K) {n : ℕ}
    (ps : Finset (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k)) (hps : ∀ P ∈ ps, P ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (R : Subalgebra F K) (htR : t ∈ R), (↑s : Set K) ⊆ R ∧
      ∃ (c : k) (φ : R →ₐ[F] F), φ ⟨t, htR⟩ = algebraMap k F c ∧
        ∀ P ∈ ps, (MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv k n P).eval (MvPolynomial.C c) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let bad := ⋃ P ∈ (↑ps : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k)),
    {c : k | (MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv k n P).eval (MvPolynomial.C c) = 0}
  have hbad : bad.Finite := ps.finite_toSet.biUnion
    (fun P hP ↦ finite_zero_specializations P (hps P hP))
  obtain ⟨R, htR, hsR, c, φ, hc, hφ⟩ := exists_finite_specialization ht s hbad.toFinset
  refine ⟨R, htR, hsR, c, φ, hφ, fun P hP hzero ↦ hc ?_⟩
  apply hbad.mem_toFinset.mpr
  exact Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr ⟨P, hP, hzero⟩

name: AclGeom.mulcorr
statement:
theorem mulcorr [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed Ω] {x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ : Ω}
    (hx : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x₁, x₂]) (hy₁ : y₁ ≠ 0) (hy₂ : y₂ ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : point k x₁ = point k y₁) (h₂ : point k x₂ = point k y₂)
    (h₁₂ : point k (x₁ * x₂) = point k (y₁ * y₂)) :
    ∃ m n : ℤ, m ≠ 0 ∧ n ≠ 0 ∧ ∃ c₁ c₂ : k, c₁ ≠ 0 ∧ c₂ ≠ 0 ∧
      y₁ ^ n = algebraMap k Ω c₁ * x₁ ^ m ∧ y₂ ^ n = algebraMap k Ω c₂ * x₂ ^ m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  let ι : Ω →ₐ[k] FreshAmbient Ω := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k Ω (FreshAmbient Ω)
  have hι : Function.Injective ι := ι.toRingHom.injective
  have hpt : ∀ {u v : Ω}, point k u = point k v → racl k {ι u} = racl k {ι v} :=
    fun {u v} h ↦ by
      simpa [Set.image_singleton] using
        algHom_racl_image_eq_of_racl_eq ι (congrArg Subtype.val h : racl k {u} = racl k {v})
  have mem : ∀ {u v : FreshAmbient Ω}, racl k {u} = racl k {v} → v ∈ racl k {u} := fun h ↦ by
    rw [h]
    exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_singleton _)
  have h₁' := hpt h₁
  have h₂' := hpt h₂
  have h₁₂' : racl k {ι x₁ * ι x₂} = racl k {ι y₁ * ι y₂} := by
    simpa only [map_mul] using hpt h₁₂
  let S : MulCorrSetup k (FreshAmbient Ω) :=
    { x₁ := ι x₁, y₁ := ι y₁, x₂ := ι x₂, y₂ := ι y₂
      indep := by
        convert hx.map' hι using 1
        funext i
        fin_cases i <;> rfl
      y₁_ne := (map_ne_zero ι).2 hy₁, y₂_ne := (map_ne_zero ι).2 hy₂
      y₁_mem := mem h₁', x₁_mem := mem h₁'.symm, y₂_mem := mem h₂', x₂_mem := mem h₂'.symm
      mul_mem := mem h₁₂', mul_mem' := mem h₁₂'.symm }
  
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_notMem_racl_of_card_lt_trdeg (n := 2)
    (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (four_le_trdeg_freshAmbient k Ω)) {ι x₁, ι x₂}
    Finset.card_le_two
  have hs' : s ∉ racl k ({ι x₁, ι x₂} : Set (FreshAmbient Ω)) := by simpa using hs
  obtain ⟨a, b, c₁, c₂, ha, hb, hc₁, hc₂, he₁, he₂⟩ := S.exists_coset_equations hs'
  have he₁' : ι x₁ ^ a * ι y₁ ^ b = algebraMap k (FreshAmbient Ω) c₁ := he₁
  have he₂' : ι x₂ ^ a * ι y₂ ^ b = algebraMap k (FreshAmbient Ω) c₂ := he₂
  
  have pull : ∀ {u v : Ω} {c : k}, u ≠ 0 →
      ι u ^ a * ι v ^ b = algebraMap k (FreshAmbient Ω) c →
      v ^ b = algebraMap k Ω c * u ^ (-a) := fun {u v c} hu h ↦ by
    have h' : u ^ a * v ^ b = algebraMap k Ω c := hι (by
      rw [map_mul, map_zpow₀, map_zpow₀, AlgHom.commutes]
      exact h)
    rw [zpow_neg, ← h', mul_comm (u ^ a), mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (zpow_ne_zero a hu),
      mul_one]
  have hx₁ : x₁ ≠ 0 := AlgebraicIndependent.ne_zero hx 0
  have hx₂ : x₂ ≠ 0 := AlgebraicIndependent.ne_zero hx 1
  exact ⟨-a, b, neg_ne_zero.2 ha, hb, c₁, c₂, hc₁, hc₂, pull hx₁ he₁', pull hx₂ he₂'⟩

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.EmbeddingClosureEquiv.pullbackEquiv_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem pullbackEquiv_val
