name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.EmbeddingClosureEquiv.pullbackField_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem pullbackField_finiteDimensional
    [Algebra E E'] (hf : algebraMap E E' = f)
    [FiniteDimensional E E']
    (T : IntermediateField E' (AlgebraicClosure E'))
    [FiniteDimensional E' (↥T)] :
    FiniteDimensional E (↥(C.pullbackField T))
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsScalarTower E E' (↥T) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  letI : FiniteDimensional E (↥T) :=
    FiniteDimensional.trans E E' (↥T)
  apply Module.Finite.of_equiv_equiv (RingEquiv.refl E)
    (C.pullbackEquiv T).symm
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro x
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingEquiv.refl_apply,
    RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom]
  apply (C.pullbackEquiv T).injective
  rw [C.pullbackEquiv_algebraMap, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply E E' (↥T), hf]

name: AclGeom.AffineCoefficients.exists_cleared_action_coefficients
statement:
theorem exists_cleared_action_coefficients (G : AlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V] {t : V.left.functionField} (ht : Transcendental k t)
    (hpoint : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X, ∃ a b : k,
      (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G V q).unop t =
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField a * t + algebraMap k V.left.functionField b)
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A]
    (g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) :
    let f
proof:
:= (sectionsFunctionFieldEquiv V).toAlgHom.comp
      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k Γ(V.left, ⊤) (FractionRing Γ(V.left, ⊤)))
    let act (r : Γ(V.left, ⊤)) := Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id k A) f
      (sectionsTensorAut V g (1 ⊗ₜ[k] r))
    ∃ r s : Γ(V.left, ⊤), f s ≠ 0 ∧ t * f s = f r ∧
      ∃ d a b : A, d ≠ 0 ∧ a ≠ 0 ∧
        d • act r = a • ((1 ⊗ₜ[k] t) * act s) + b • act s ∧
        ∀ (φ : A →ₐ[k] k), φ d ≠ 0 →
          (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G V ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
            (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)).unop t =
              algebraMap k V.left.functionField (φ a / φ d) * t +
                algebraMap k V.left.functionField (φ b / φ d) := by
  classical
  let R : Type u := Γ(V.left, ⊤)
  let F : Type u := V.left.functionField
  let e := sectionsFunctionFieldEquiv V
  let f : R →ₐ[k] F := e.toAlgHom.comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k R (FractionRing R))
  let act (r : R) := Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id k A) f
    (sectionsTensorAut V g (1 ⊗ₜ[k] r))
  have : Nonempty (⊤ : V.left.Opens) := ⟨⟨genericPoint _, trivial⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨r, s, hs, hrs⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective R (e.symm t)
  have hsF : f s ≠ 0 := by
    change e (algebraMap R (FractionRing R) s) ≠ 0
    exact (map_ne_zero e).2 (IsFractionRing.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors hs)
  have hrel : t * f s = f r := by
    change t * e (algebraMap R (FractionRing R) s) = e (algebraMap R (FractionRing R) r)
    rw [← e.apply_symm_apply t, ← map_mul]
    exact congrArg e ((eq_div_iff
      (IsFractionRing.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors hs)).1 hrs.symm)
  have hact (φ : A →ₐ[k] k) (r : R) : tensorPointEval φ (act r) =
      (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G V ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
        (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)).unop (f r) := by
    have hf : f r = V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤ (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint _, trivial⟩⟩) r :=
      sectionsFunctionFieldEquiv_algebraMap V r
    rw [hf]
    exact (sectionsTensorAut_point_germ G V g φ r).symm
  have hS (φ : A →ₐ[k] k) : tensorPointEval φ (act s) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hact]
    exact (map_ne_zero _).2 hsF
  have hU (φ : A →ₐ[k] k) : ∃ a b : k, tensorPointEval φ (act r) =
      (algebraMap k F a * t + algebraMap k F b) * tensorPointEval φ (act s) := by
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := hpoint ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
      (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)
    refine ⟨a, b, ?_⟩
    rw [hact, hact, ← hrel, map_mul, hab]
  obtain ⟨d, a, b, hd, hclear⟩ := exists_cleared_coefficients ht (act r) (act s) hS hU
  have hformula (φ : A →ₐ[k] k) (hdφ : φ d ≠ 0) :
      (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G V ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
        (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)).unop t =
          algebraMap k F (φ a / φ d) * t + algebraMap k F (φ b / φ d) := by
    let q := (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g
    let σ := (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G V q).unop
    have hV : tensorPointEval φ ((1 ⊗ₜ[k] t) * act s) = t * tensorPointEval φ (act s) := by
      rw [map_mul]
      have h_eval : tensorPointEval φ (1 ⊗ₜ[k] t) = t := by
        change algebraMap k F (φ 1) * t = t
        rw [map_one, map_one, _root_.one_mul]
      rw [h_eval]
    have hh := congrArg (tensorPointEval φ) hclear
    rw [map_add, tensorPointEval_smul, tensorPointEval_smul, tensorPointEval_smul,
      hV, hact, hact] at hh
    change algebraMap k F (φ d) * σ (f r) =
      algebraMap k F (φ a) * (t * σ (f s)) + algebraMap k F (φ b) * σ (f s) at hh
    rw [← hrel, map_mul] at hh
    have hσs : σ (f s) ≠ 0 := (map_ne_zero σ).2 hsF
    have hlin : σ t * algebraMap k F (φ d) =
        algebraMap k F (φ a) * t + algebraMap k F (φ b) := by
      apply mul_right_cancel₀ hσs
      calc
        _ = algebraMap k F (φ d) * (σ t * σ (f s)) := by ring
        _ = _ := hh
        _ = _ := by ring
    change σ t = _
    rw [map_div₀, map_div₀, div_mul_eq_mul_div, ← add_div]
    exact (eq_div_iff ((map_ne_zero _).2 hdφ)).2 hlin
  have ha : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro ha
    have hex : ∃ φ : A →ₐ[k] k, φ d ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra! hh
      exact hd (IsNilpotent.eq_zero (isNilpotent_of_forall_algHom_eq_zero hh))
    obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := hex
    let q := (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g
    let σ := (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G V q).unop
    have hh := hformula φ hφ
    rw [ha, map_zero, zero_div, map_zero, zero_mul, zero_add] at hh
    have he := congrArg σ.symm hh
    change σ.symm (σ t) = σ.symm (algebraMap k F (φ b / φ d)) at he
    rw [σ.symm_apply_apply, σ.symm.commutes] at he
    exact ht (he ▸ isAlgebraic_algebraMap _)
  exact ⟨r, s, hsF, hrel, d, a, b, hd, ha, hclear, hformula⟩

name: AclGeom.AffineCoefficients.AclGeom.AffineCoefficients.exists_generic_family_coefficients
statement:
theorem exists_generic_family_coefficients (G : AlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V] {t : V.left.functionField} (ht : Transcendental k t)
    (hpoint : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X, ∃ a b : k,
      (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G V q).unop t =
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField a * t + algebraMap k V.left.functionField b)
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A]
    (g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) :
    let C
proof:
:= FractionRing A
    let F := V.left.functionField
    let E := FractionRing (C ⊗[k] F)
    let evC : A →ₐ[k] C := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A C
    let τ := sectionsTensorAut V ((algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom evC).op ≫ g)
    let T := algebraMap (C ⊗[k] F) E (1 ⊗ₜ[k] t)
    ∃ d a b : A, d ≠ 0 ∧ a ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ (φ : A →ₐ[k] k), φ d ≠ 0 →
        (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G V ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
          (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)).unop t =
            algebraMap k F (φ a / φ d) * t + algebraMap k F (φ b / φ d)) ∧
      ∃ hCF : IsDomain (C ⊗[k] F),
        letI := hCF
        ∃ hCR : IsDomain (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)),
          letI := hCR
          ∃ (σ : E ≃ₐ[C] E) (e : E ≃ₐ[C] FractionRing (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤))),
            (∀ (c : C) (r : Γ(V.left, ⊤)),
              e (algebraMap (C ⊗[k] F) E
                (c ⊗ₜ[k] V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤ (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint _, trivial⟩⟩) r)) =
                  algebraMap (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)) _ (c ⊗ₜ[k] r)) ∧
            (∀ x, e (σ x) = IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv τ (e x)) ∧
            σ T = algebraMap C E (evC a / evC d) * T + algebraMap C E (evC b / evC d) := by
  classical
  let R : Type u := Γ(V.left, ⊤)
  let F : Type u := V.left.functionField
  let C := FractionRing A
  let T0 := C ⊗[k] F
  let E := FractionRing T0
  let evC : A →ₐ[k] C := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A C
  let gGeneric := (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom evC).op ≫ g
  let τ := sectionsTensorAut V gGeneric
  let f : R →ₐ[k] F := (sectionsFunctionFieldEquiv V).toAlgHom.comp
    (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k R (FractionRing R))
  let act (r : R) := Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id k A) f
    (sectionsTensorAut V g (1 ⊗ₜ[k] r))
  obtain ⟨r, s, hs, hrs, d, a, b, hd, ha, hclear, hformula⟩ :=
    exists_cleared_action_coefficients G V ht hpoint g
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_tensorSections_functionFieldEquiv C V
  let σ : E ≃ₐ[C] E := e.trans ((IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv τ).trans e.symm)
  let jF : F →ₐ[k] E := (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k T0 E).comp
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : F →ₐ[k] T0)
  let m : A ⊗[k] F →ₐ[k] E := (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k T0 E).comp
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map evC (AlgHom.id k F))
  have hf (r : R) : f r =
      V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤ (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint _, trivial⟩⟩) r :=
    sectionsFunctionFieldEquiv_algebraMap V r
  have he' (c : C) (r : R) : e (algebraMap T0 E (c ⊗ₜ[k] f r)) =
      algebraMap (C ⊗[k] R) (FractionRing (C ⊗[k] R)) (c ⊗ₜ[k] r) := by
    rw [hf]
    exact he c r
  have hσ (x : E) : e (σ x) = IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv τ (e x) := by
    change e (e.symm (IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv τ (e x))) = _
    exact e.apply_symm_apply _
  have hcomp (z : A ⊗[k] R) :
      e (m (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id k A) f z)) =
        algebraMap (C ⊗[k] R) (FractionRing (C ⊗[k] R))
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map evC (AlgHom.id k R) z) := by
    induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul a r =>
      change e (algebraMap T0 E (Algebra.TensorProduct.map evC (AlgHom.id k F)
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id k A) f (a ⊗ₜ[k] r)))) = _
      simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, AlgHom.id_apply]
      exact he' (evC a) r
    | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  have hbase (r : R) : Algebra.TensorProduct.map evC (AlgHom.id k R)
      (sectionsTensorAut V g (1 ⊗ₜ[k] r)) = τ (1 ⊗ₜ[k] r) := by
    have hb := sectionsTensorAut_baseChange V evC g (1 ⊗ₜ[k] r)
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, AlgHom.id_apply, map_one] at hb
    change Algebra.TensorProduct.map evC (AlgHom.id k R)
      (sectionsTensorAut V g (1 ⊗ₜ[k] r)) = τ (1 ⊗ₜ[k] r) at hb
    exact hb
  have hσf (r : R) : σ (jF (f r)) = m (act r) := by
    apply e.injective
    change e (σ (algebraMap T0 E (1 ⊗ₜ[k] f r))) =
      e (m (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id k A) f
        (sectionsTensorAut V g (1 ⊗ₜ[k] r))))
    rw [hσ, he', IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv_algebraMap, hcomp, hbase]
  have hscalar (c : A) (z : A ⊗[k] F) :
      m (c • z) = algebraMap C E (evC c) * m z := by
    rw [Algebra.smul_def, Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply]
    change m ((c ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : F)) * z) = _
    rw [map_mul]
    have hm : m (c ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : F)) = algebraMap C E (evC c) := by
      change algebraMap T0 E (evC c ⊗ₜ[k] (1 : F)) = _
      exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply C T0 E (evC c)
    rw [hm]
  have hmt : m (1 ⊗ₜ[k] t) = jF t := by
    change algebraMap T0 E (evC 1 ⊗ₜ[k] t) = _
    rw [map_one]
    rfl
  have hh := congrArg m hclear
  rw [map_add, hscalar, hscalar, hscalar, map_mul, hmt, ← hσf, ← hσf] at hh
  change algebraMap C E (evC d) * σ (jF (f r)) =
    algebraMap C E (evC a) * (jF t * σ (jF (f s))) +
      algebraMap C E (evC b) * σ (jF (f s)) at hh
  have hrel : σ (jF (f r)) = σ (jF t) * σ (jF (f s)) := by
    rw [← hrs, map_mul, map_mul]
  rw [hrel] at hh
  have hsn : σ (jF (f s)) ≠ 0 := (map_ne_zero σ).2 ((map_ne_zero jF).2 hs)
  have hlin : σ (jF t) * algebraMap C E (evC d) =
      algebraMap C E (evC a) * jF t + algebraMap C E (evC b) := by
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ hsn
    calc
      _ = algebraMap C E (evC d) * (σ (jF t) * σ (jF (f s))) := by ring
      _ = _ := hh
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hevC : Function.Injective evC := IsFractionRing.injective A C
  have hdC : evC d ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hd
    apply hevC
    simpa only [map_zero] using h
  refine ⟨d, a, b, hd, ha, hformula, inferInstance,
    isDomain_tensor_sections C V, σ, e, he, hσ, ?_⟩
  change σ (jF t) = _
  rw [map_div₀, map_div₀, div_mul_eq_mul_div, ← add_div]
  exact (eq_div_iff ((map_ne_zero _).2 hdC)).2 hlin

name: AclGeom.ProperCurve.stalk_valuationRing
statement:
theorem stalk_valuationRing
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ 1) (x : X)
    [IsIntegrallyClosed (X.presheaf.stalk x)] :
    ValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)
proof:
:= by
  have he : Order.krullDim X = topologicalKrullDim X :=
    (Order.krullDim_eq_of_orderIso
      (irreducibleSetEquivPoints (α := X))).symm
  have hco : (Order.coheight x : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ 1 :=
    (Order.coheight_le_krullDim x).trans (he.trans_le hdim)
  have : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    krullDimLE_of_coheight_le (by exact_mod_cast hco)
  have : Ring.DimensionLEOne (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    ⟨fun hI hP ↦ Ring.krullDimLE_one_iff_of_noZeroDivisors.mp inferInstance _ hI hP⟩
  have : IsDedekindDomain (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    (isDedekindDomain_iff _ (FractionRing (X.presheaf.stalk x))).2
      ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
        fun hz ↦ (isIntegrallyClosed_iff _).1 inferInstance hz⟩
  infer_instance

name: AclGeom.tensorProduct_map_val_injective
statement:
theorem tensorProduct_map_val_injective (E' : IntermediateField k E) :
    Function.Injective
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map E'.val (AlgHom.id k F))
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (E'.val.toLinearMap) := Subtype.val_injective
  have h := Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap
    (M := F) E'.val.toLinearMap hinj
  exact h

name: AclGeom.isDomain_tensorProduct_of_fg
statement:
theorem isDomain_tensorProduct_of_fg
    (h : ∀ E' : IntermediateField k E, E'.FG → IsDomain (E' ⊗[k] F)) :
    IsDomain (E ⊗[k] F)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI : Nontrivial (E ⊗[k] F) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.nontrivial_of_algebraMap_injective_of_isDomain k E F
      (algebraMap k E).injective (algebraMap k F).injective
  
  haveI : NoZeroDivisors (E ⊗[k] F) := by
    refine ⟨fun {x y} hxy ↦ ?_⟩
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    obtain ⟨hx0, hy0⟩ := hcon
    
    obtain ⟨sx, hsx⟩ := TensorProduct.exists_finset x
    obtain ⟨sy, hsy⟩ := TensorProduct.exists_finset y
    
    set T : Finset E := sx.image Prod.fst ∪ sy.image Prod.fst with hT
    set E' : IntermediateField k E := adjoin k (T : Set E) with hE'
    haveI hdom : IsDomain (E' ⊗[k] F) := h E' ⟨T, rfl⟩
    set φ := Algebra.TensorProduct.map E'.val (AlgHom.id k F) with hφ
    have hφinj : Function.Injective φ := tensorProduct_map_val_injective E'
    
    have hmem : ∀ (s : Finset (E × F)), (↑(s.image Prod.fst) : Set E) ⊆ T →
        ∃ z : E' ⊗[k] F, φ z = ∑ p ∈ s, p.1 ⊗ₜ[k] p.2 := by
      intro s hs
      refine ⟨∑ p ∈ s.attach, (⟨p.1.1, subset_adjoin k _ (hs (by
        simpa using Finset.mem_image_of_mem Prod.fst p.2))⟩ : E') ⊗ₜ[k] p.1.2, ?_⟩
      rw [map_sum, ← Finset.sum_attach s fun p ↦ p.1 ⊗ₜ[k] p.2]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ rfl
    obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := hmem sx (by intro e he; simp only [hT, Finset.coe_union]; left; exact he)
    obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hmem sy (by intro e he; simp only [hT, Finset.coe_union]; right; exact he)
    rw [← hsx] at hx'
    rw [← hsy] at hy'
    
    have hxy' : x' * y' = 0 := by
      refine hφinj ?_
      rw [map_mul, hx', hy', hxy, map_zero]
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 hxy' with h0 | h0
    · exact hx0 (by rw [← hx', h0, map_zero])
    · exact hy0 (by rw [← hy', h0, map_zero])
  exact NoZeroDivisors.to_isDomain _

name: AclGeom.isDomain_tensorProduct_of_fg_right
statement:
theorem isDomain_tensorProduct_of_fg_right
    (h : ∀ F' : IntermediateField k F, F'.FG → IsDomain (E ⊗[k] F')) :
    IsDomain (E ⊗[k] F)
proof:
:= by
  have h' : ∀ F' : IntermediateField k F, F'.FG → IsDomain (F' ⊗[k] E) := by
    intro F' hF'
    haveI := h F' hF'
    exact MulEquiv.isDomain (E ⊗[k] F')
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm k F' E).toMulEquiv
  haveI : IsDomain (F ⊗[k] E) := isDomain_tensorProduct_of_fg h'
  exact MulEquiv.isDomain (F ⊗[k] E) (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm k E F).toMulEquiv

name: AclGeom.isDomain_tensorProduct_of_fg_fg
statement:
theorem isDomain_tensorProduct_of_fg_fg
    (h : ∀ (E' : IntermediateField k E) (F' : IntermediateField k F),
      E'.FG → F'.FG → IsDomain (E' ⊗[k] F')) :
    IsDomain (E ⊗[k] F)
proof:
:=
  isDomain_tensorProduct_of_fg fun E' hE' ↦
    isDomain_tensorProduct_of_fg_right fun F' hF' ↦ h E' F' hE' hF'

name: AclGeom.RegularAux.algebraMap_eq
statement:
theorem algebraMap_eq :
    algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ k) (MvPolynomial σ F) =
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k F)
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.RegularAux.fwd_tmul
statement:
theorem fwd_tmul (p : MvPolynomial σ k) (f : F) :
    fwd (k := k) (F := F) σ (p ⊗ₜ[k] f) =
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k F) p * MvPolynomial.C f
proof:
:= by
  simp [fwd, Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul, Algebra.ofId_apply, algebraMap_eq,
    IsScalarTower.coe_toAlgHom', MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]

name: AclGeom.RegularAux.fwd_bijective
statement: theorem fwd_bijective : Function.Bijective (fwd (k := k) (F := F) σ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let bF := Module.Basis.ofVectorSpace k F
  let bRF := (MvPolynomial.basisMonomials σ k).tensorProduct bF
  let bT := bF.smulTower (MvPolynomial.basisMonomials σ F)
  let eLin : ((MvPolynomial σ k) ⊗[k] F) ≃ₗ[k] MvPolynomial σ F :=
    bRF.equiv bT (Equiv.prodComm _ _)
  have heq : LinearMap.restrictScalars k (fwd (k := k) (F := F) σ).toLinearMap
      = (eLin : ((MvPolynomial σ k) ⊗[k] F) →ₗ[k] MvPolynomial σ F) := by
    refine bRF.ext fun p ↦ ?_
    rcases p with ⟨d, β⟩
    have h1 : bRF (d, β) = (MvPolynomial.monomial d 1) ⊗ₜ[k] bF β := by
      simp [bRF, Module.Basis.tensorProduct_apply, MvPolynomial.coe_basisMonomials]
    have h2 : eLin (bRF (d, β)) = MvPolynomial.monomial d (bF β) := by
      simp only [eLin, Module.Basis.equiv_apply, Equiv.prodComm_apply, Prod.swap_prod_mk]
      simp [bT, Module.Basis.smulTower_apply, MvPolynomial.coe_basisMonomials,
        MvPolynomial.smul_monomial]
    change fwd (k := k) (F := F) σ (bRF (d, β)) = eLin (bRF (d, β))
    rw [h2, h1, fwd_tmul, MvPolynomial.map_monomial, map_one, mul_comm,
      MvPolynomial.C_mul_monomial, mul_one]
  have hfun : ∀ z, fwd (k := k) (F := F) σ z = eLin z := fun z ↦ by
    have h3 := congrArg (fun (f : ((MvPolynomial σ k) ⊗[k] F) →ₗ[k] MvPolynomial σ F) ↦ f z) heq
    simpa using h3
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    exact eLin.injective ((hfun x).symm.trans (hxy.trans (hfun y)))
  · intro p
    exact ⟨eLin.symm p, (hfun _).trans (eLin.apply_symm_apply p)⟩

name: AclGeom.isDomain_fractionRing_mvPolynomial_tensor
statement:
theorem isDomain_fractionRing_mvPolynomial_tensor
    {k F : Type*} [Field k] [Field F] [Algebra k F] (σ : Type*) :
    IsDomain (FractionRing (MvPolynomial σ k) ⊗[k] F)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set R := MvPolynomial σ k
  set T := MvPolynomial σ F
  set L := FractionRing R
  
  letI : Algebra T (L ⊗[R] T) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  haveI hloc : IsLocalization
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid T (nonZeroDivisors R)) (L ⊗[R] T) :=
    (Algebra.isLocalization_iff_isPushout (R := R) (S := nonZeroDivisors R)
      (A := L) (T := T) (B := L ⊗[R] T)).2 inferInstance
  haveI hdom : IsDomain (L ⊗[R] T) := by
    refine IsLocalization.isDomain_of_le_nonZeroDivisors
      (M := Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid T (nonZeroDivisors R)) (L ⊗[R] T) ?_
    rintro - ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
    refine mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero ?_
    have hrne : r ≠ 0 := nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hr
    rw [RegularAux.algebraMap_eq]
    exact fun h0 ↦ hrne (MvPolynomial.map_injective _
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective k F) (by rwa [map_zero]))
  
  have iso : (L ⊗[R] T) ≃ₐ[L] (L ⊗[k] F) :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr (AlgEquiv.refl (A₁ := L) (R := L))
      (RegularAux.tensorEquiv (k := k) (F := F) σ).symm).trans
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange k R L L F)
  exact MulEquiv.isDomain (L ⊗[R] T) iso.symm.toMulEquiv

name: AclGeom.domain_baseChange
statement:
private theorem domain_baseChange [IsAlgClosed k] (A : Type*) [CommRing A]
    [IsDomain A] [Algebra k A] : IsDomain (E ⊗[k] A)
proof:
:= by
  let F := FractionRing A
  have : IsDomain (E ⊗[k] F) := AclGeom.isDomain_tensorProduct_of_isAlgClosed
  let f : A →ₐ[k] F := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A F
  let g : E ⊗[k] A →ₐ[k] E ⊗[k] F :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id k E) f
  have hg : Function.Injective g :=
    Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap (M := E) f.toLinearMap
      (IsFractionRing.injective A F)
  exact Function.Injective.isDomain g hg

name: AclGeom.isPrime_map_of_isAlgClosed
proof:
:= by
  have : IsDomain (E ⊗[k] (MvPolynomial ι k ⧸ I)) :=
    domain_baseChange (MvPolynomial ι k ⧸ I)
  let e := MvPolynomial.algebraTensorAlgEquiv k E (σ := ι)
  let J := I.map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (A := E) (R := k)).toRingHom
  have : IsDomain ((E ⊗[k] MvPolynomial ι k) ⧸ J) :=
    MulEquiv.isDomain _
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.tensorQuotientEquiv
        (R := k) E (MvPolynomial ι k) E I).symm.toMulEquiv
  have : J.IsPrime := (Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime J).mp inferInstance
  have h : (J.map e.toRingHom).IsPrime := Ideal.map_isPrime_of_equiv e
  have he : e.toRingHom.comp
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (A := E) (R := k)).toRingHom =
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E) := by
    ext i <;> simp [e]
  change (I.map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (A := E) (R := k)).toRingHom
    |>.map e.toRingHom).IsPrime at h
  rw [Ideal.map_map, he] at h
  exact h

name: AclGeom.transportPair_ideal
statement:
private theorem transportPair_ideal (σ : Ω ≃ₐ[k] Ω) (P : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) :
    (transportPair σ P).ideal = P.ideal
proof:
:= by
  have h : (![σ P.source, σ P.target] : Fin 2 → Ω) = σ ∘ ![P.source, P.target] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  change idealOf k ![σ P.source, σ P.target] = idealOf k ![P.source, P.target]
  rw [h]
  exact idealOf_comp_algHom k σ.toAlgHom _

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondenceGerm.composes_assoc
statement:
theorem FiniteCorrespondenceGerm.composes_assoc [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (A B C D : FiniteCorrespondenceGerm k Ω) :
    (∃ E, Composes A B E ∧ Composes E C D) ↔
      ∃ F, Composes B C F ∧ Composes A F D
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨E, ⟨P, Q, hPQ, hA, hB, hE⟩, ⟨R, S, hRS, hE', hC, hD⟩⟩
    have hI : idealOf k ![P.source, Q.target] = idealOf k ![R.source, R.target] :=
      hE.symm.trans hE'
    obtain ⟨σ, -, hσ⟩ := exists_ambientAutomorphism_of_idealOf_eq hI
    have hσx : σ P.source = R.source := hσ 0
    have hσz : σ Q.target = R.target := hσ 1
    let P' := transportPair σ P
    let Q' := transportPair σ Q
    have hPQ' : P'.target = Q'.source := congrArg σ hPQ
    have hQS : Q'.target = S.source := hσz.trans hRS
    refine ⟨ofPair (Q'.comp S hQS), ⟨Q', S, hQS, ?_, hC, rfl⟩,
      ⟨P', Q'.comp S hQS, hPQ', ?_, rfl, ?_⟩⟩
    · exact hB.trans (transportPair_ideal σ Q).symm
    · exact hA.trans (transportPair_ideal σ P).symm
    · rw [hD]
      change idealOf k ![R.source, S.target] = idealOf k ![σ P.source, S.target]
      rw [hσx]
  · rintro ⟨F, ⟨P, Q, hPQ, hB, hC, hF⟩, ⟨R, S, hRS, hA, hF', hD⟩⟩
    have hI : idealOf k ![P.source, Q.target] = idealOf k ![S.source, S.target] :=
      hF.symm.trans hF'
    obtain ⟨σ, -, hσ⟩ := exists_ambientAutomorphism_of_idealOf_eq hI
    have hσy : σ P.source = S.source := hσ 0
    have hσw : σ Q.target = S.target := hσ 1
    let P' := transportPair σ P
    let Q' := transportPair σ Q
    have hRP : R.target = P'.source := hRS.trans hσy.symm
    have hPQ' : P'.target = Q'.source := congrArg σ hPQ
    refine ⟨ofPair (R.comp P' hRP), ⟨R, P', hRP, hA, ?_, rfl⟩,
      ⟨R.comp P' hRP, Q', hPQ', rfl, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · exact hB.trans (transportPair_ideal σ P).symm
    · exact hC.trans (transportPair_ideal σ Q).symm
    · rw [hD]
      change idealOf k ![R.source, S.target] = idealOf k ![R.source, σ Q.target]
      rw [hσw]

name: AclGeom.aevalSnd_eq_map_toUVPoly
statement:
theorem aevalSnd_eq_map_toUVPoly (c : Fin 2 → K)
    (g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) k) :
    aevalSnd (k := k) c g =
      MvPolynomial.map ((aeval c : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →ₐ[k] K) :
        MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →+* K) (toUVPoly (k := k) g)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : (aevalSnd (k := k) c).toRingHom =
      ((MvPolynomial.map ((aeval c : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →ₐ[k] K) :
        MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →+* K)).comp (toUVPoly (k := k)).toRingHom) := by
    refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) (fun i ↦ ?_)
    · simp [aevalSnd, toUVPoly, MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
    · rcases i with j | j
      · simp [aevalSnd, toUVPoly]
      · simp [aevalSnd, toUVPoly]
  exact congrArg (fun (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) k →+* _) ↦ f g) hcomp

name: AclGeom.coeff_aevalSnd
statement:
theorem coeff_aevalSnd (c : Fin 2 → K) (g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) k)
    (m : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) :
    (aevalSnd (k := k) c g).coeff m =
      aeval c ((toUVPoly (k := k) g).coeff m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [aevalSnd_eq_map_toUVPoly, MvPolynomial.coeff_map]
  rfl

name: AclGeom.aevalSnd_addSubst
statement:
theorem aevalSnd_addSubst (c : Fin 2 → K) (F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) :
    aevalSnd (k := k) c (addSubst (k := k) F) =
      translate c (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) F)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ((aevalSnd (k := k) c).toRingHom.comp
      (addSubst (k := k)).toRingHom) =
      ((translate c).toRingHom.comp
        (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) :
          MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →+* MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K)) := by
    refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) (fun j ↦ ?_)
    · simp [aevalSnd, addSubst, translate, MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
    · simp [aevalSnd, addSubst, translate]
  exact congrArg (fun (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →+* _) ↦ f F) hcomp

name: AclGeom.aevalSnd_rename_inl
statement:
theorem aevalSnd_rename_inl (c : Fin 2 → K) (F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) :
    aevalSnd (k := k) c (rename Sum.inl F) =
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) F
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ((aevalSnd (k := k) c).toRingHom.comp
      (rename (Sum.inl : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2)).toRingHom) =
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) :
        MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →+* MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) := by
    refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) (fun j ↦ ?_)
    · simp [aevalSnd, MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
    · simp [aevalSnd]
  exact congrArg (fun (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →+* _) ↦ f F) hcomp

name: AclGeom.aeval_aevalFst
statement:
theorem aeval_aevalFst (c : Fin 2 → K) (v : Fin 2 → Ω)
    (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) k) :
    aeval v (aevalFst (k := k) c f) =
      aeval (Sum.elim (fun j ↦ algebraMap K Ω (c j)) v) f
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ((aeval v : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K →ₐ[K] Ω) :
      MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K →+* Ω).comp (aevalFst (k := k) c).toRingHom =
      ((aeval (Sum.elim (fun j ↦ algebraMap K Ω (c j)) v) :
        MvPolynomial (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) k →ₐ[k] Ω) :
        MvPolynomial (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) k →+* Ω) := by
    refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) (fun i ↦ ?_)
    · simp [aevalFst, MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq,
        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
    · rcases i with j | j
      · simp [aevalFst]
      · simp [aevalFst]
  exact congrArg (fun (g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) k →+* Ω) ↦ g f) hcomp

name: AclGeom.joint_aeval_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hfK : aevalFst (k := k) c f ∈ idealOf K q := by
    rw [mem_idealOf_iff, aeval_aevalFst]
    exact hf
  rw [hspan, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hfK
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := hfK
  rw [← aeval_aevalFst, ← hh, map_mul]
  have hGw : aeval w (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) G) = (0 : Ω) := by
    rw [aeval_map_algebraMap]
    exact hw
  rw [hGw, mul_zero]

name: AclGeom.aevalFst_addSubst
statement:
theorem aevalFst_addSubst (c : Fin 2 → K) (F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) :
    aevalFst (k := k) c (addSubst (k := k) F) =
      translate c (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) F)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ((aevalFst (k := k) c).toRingHom.comp
      (addSubst (k := k)).toRingHom) =
      ((translate c).toRingHom.comp
        (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) :
          MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →+* MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K)) := by
    refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) (fun j ↦ ?_)
    · simp [aevalFst, addSubst, translate, MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
    · simp [aevalFst, addSubst, translate, add_comm]
  exact congrArg (fun (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →+* _) ↦ f F) hcomp

name: AclGeom.aevalFst_rename_inl
statement:
theorem aevalFst_rename_inl (c : Fin 2 → K) (F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) :
    aevalFst (k := k) c (rename Sum.inl F) = C (aeval c F)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ((aevalFst (k := k) c).toRingHom.comp
      (rename (Sum.inl : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2)).toRingHom) =
      ((C : K →+* MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K).comp
        ((aeval c : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →ₐ[k] K) :
          MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →+* K)) := by
    refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) (fun j ↦ ?_)
    · simp [aevalFst, MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
    · simp [aevalFst]
  exact congrArg (fun (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →+* _) ↦ f F) hcomp

name: AclGeom.aevalFst_rename_inr
statement:
theorem aevalFst_rename_inr (c : Fin 2 → K) (F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) :
    aevalFst (k := k) c (rename Sum.inr F) =
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) F
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ((aevalFst (k := k) c).toRingHom.comp
      (rename (Sum.inr : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2)).toRingHom) =
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) :
        MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →+* MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) := by
    refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) (fun j ↦ ?_)
    · simp [aevalFst, MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
    · simp [aevalFst]
  exact congrArg (fun (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →+* _) ↦ f F) hcomp

name: AclGeom.joint_aeval_eq_zero'
proof:
:= by
  subst hp
  exact joint_aeval_eq_zero hspan hw hf

name: AclGeom.joint_idealOf_eq
statement:
theorem joint_idealOf_eq {c : Fin 2 → K} {q q' : Fin 2 → Ω}
    {G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k}
    (hspan : idealOf K q = Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) G})
    (hspan' : idealOf K q' =
      Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) G}) :
    idealOf k (Sum.elim (fun j ↦ algebraMap K Ω (c j)) q) =
      idealOf k (Sum.elim (fun j ↦ algebraMap K Ω (c j)) q')
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : ∀ {r : Fin 2 → Ω}, idealOf K r =
      Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) G} → aeval r G = 0 := by
    intro r hr
    have hmem : MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) G ∈ idealOf K r := by
      rw [hr]
      exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
    have h := (mem_idealOf_iff K).1 hmem
    rwa [aeval_map_algebraMap] at h
  refine idealOf_eq_of_aeval_iff k fun f ↦ ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · exact joint_aeval_eq_zero hspan (hzero hspan') h
  · exact joint_aeval_eq_zero hspan' (hzero hspan) h

name: AclGeom.map_translate
statement:
theorem map_translate {L : Type*} [Field L] (f : K →+* L) (c : Fin 2 → K)
    (g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) :
    MvPolynomial.map f (translate c g) =
      translate (fun j ↦ f (c j)) (MvPolynomial.map f g)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ((MvPolynomial.map f).comp (translate c).toRingHom :
      MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K →+* MvPolynomial (Fin 2) L) =
      ((translate fun j ↦ f (c j)).toRingHom.comp (MvPolynomial.map f)) := by
    refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) (fun j ↦ ?_)
    · simp [translate, MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
    · simp [translate]
  exact congrArg (fun (F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K →+* _) ↦ F g) hcomp

name: AclGeom.aevalFst_eq_map_toVUPoly
statement:
theorem aevalFst_eq_map_toVUPoly (c : Fin 2 → K)
    (g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) k) :
    aevalFst (k := k) c g =
      MvPolynomial.map ((aeval c : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →ₐ[k] K) :
        MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →+* K) (toVUPoly (k := k) g)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : (aevalFst (k := k) c).toRingHom =
      ((MvPolynomial.map ((aeval c : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →ₐ[k] K) :
        MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →+* K)).comp (toVUPoly (k := k)).toRingHom) := by
    refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) (fun i ↦ ?_)
    · simp [aevalFst, toVUPoly, MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
    · rcases i with j | j
      · simp [aevalFst, toVUPoly]
      · simp [aevalFst, toVUPoly]
  exact congrArg (fun (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) k →+* _) ↦ f g) hcomp

name: AclGeom.coeff_aevalFst
statement:
theorem coeff_aevalFst (c : Fin 2 → K) (g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) k)
    (m : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) :
    (aevalFst (k := k) c g).coeff m =
      aeval c ((toVUPoly (k := k) g).coeff m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [aevalFst_eq_map_toVUPoly, MvPolynomial.coeff_map]
  rfl

name: AclGeom.fromVUPoly_toVUPoly
statement:
theorem fromVUPoly_toVUPoly (g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) k) :
    fromVUPoly (k := k) (toVUPoly (k := k) g) = g
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ((fromVUPoly (k := k)).comp (toVUPoly (k := k)).toRingHom) =
      RingHom.id (MvPolynomial (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) k) := by
    refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) (fun i ↦ ?_)
    · simp [fromVUPoly, toVUPoly, MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
    · rcases i with j | j
      · simp [fromVUPoly, toVUPoly]
      · simp [fromVUPoly, toVUPoly]
  exact congrArg (fun (F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) k →+* _) ↦ F g) hcomp

name: AclGeom.mem_span_C_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp m
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hp
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hp
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    exact ⟨q.coeff m, by rw [← hq, mul_comm q (C g), coeff_C_mul]⟩
  · intro h
    classical
    choose r hr using fun m ↦ Ideal.mem_span_singleton.1 (h m)
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
    refine ⟨∑ m ∈ p.support, monomial m (r m), ?_⟩
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    conv_rhs => rw [p.as_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m hm ↦ ?_
    rw [mul_comm, C_mul_monomial, ← hr m]

name: AclGeom.mem_span_rename_inl_of_aevalFst_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcoeff : ∀ m, (toVUPoly (k := k) f).coeff m ∈ Ideal.span {G} := by
    intro m
    refine hker _ ?_
    have h := congrArg (fun p ↦ p.coeff m) hf
    simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero] at h
    rwa [coeff_aevalFst] at h
  have hspan : toVUPoly (k := k) f ∈
      Ideal.span {(C G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k))} :=
    mem_span_C_iff.2 hcoeff
  rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hspan
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hspan
  rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
  refine ⟨fromVUPoly (k := k) q, ?_⟩
  have h1 := congrArg (fromVUPoly (k := k)) hq
  rw [map_mul, fromVUPoly_toVUPoly] at h1
  rw [← h1]
  congr 1
  simp [fromVUPoly]

name: AclGeom.totalDegree_rename_of_injective
statement:
theorem totalDegree_rename_of_injective {σ τ : Type*} [DecidableEq τ]
    {f : σ → τ} (hf : Function.Injective f) (p : MvPolynomial σ k) :
    (rename f p).totalDegree = p.totalDegree
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [MvPolynomial.totalDegree, MvPolynomial.totalDegree,
    support_rename_of_injective hf, Finset.sup_image]
  refine Finset.sup_congr rfl fun m _ ↦ ?_
  exact Finsupp.sum_mapDomain_index (h := fun _ e ↦ e) (fun _ ↦ rfl)
    fun _ _ _ ↦ rfl

name: AclGeom.totalDegree_addSubst_le
statement:
theorem totalDegree_addSubst_le (g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) :
    (addSubst (k := k) g).totalDegree ≤ g.totalDegree
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [show addSubst (k := k) g =
    eval₂ (algebraMap k (MvPolynomial (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) k))
      (fun j ↦ X (Sum.inl j) + X (Sum.inr j)) g from rfl, eval₂_eq]
  refine le_trans (totalDegree_finsetSum _ _) ?_
  refine Finset.sup_le fun d hd ↦ ?_
  refine le_trans (totalDegree_mul _ _) ?_
  have hC : (algebraMap k (MvPolynomial (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) k)
      (g.coeff d)).totalDegree = 0 := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq, totalDegree_C]
  rw [hC, zero_add]
  refine le_trans (totalDegree_finsetProd _ _) ?_
  refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ ↦ ?_)
    (by rw [← Finsupp.sum]; exact le_totalDegree hd)
  refine le_trans (totalDegree_pow _ _) ?_
  have hXX : (X (Sum.inl i) + X (Sum.inr i) :
      MvPolynomial (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) k).totalDegree ≤ 1 :=
    le_trans (totalDegree_add _ _)
      (max_le (le_of_eq (totalDegree_X _)) (le_of_eq (totalDegree_X _)))
  calc d i * (X (Sum.inl i) + X (Sum.inr i) :
      MvPolynomial (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) k).totalDegree
      ≤ d i * 1 := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hXX
    _ = d i := mul_one _

name: AclGeom.prime_rename_inl
statement:
theorem prime_rename_inl {G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hG : Prime G) :
    Prime (rename (Sum.inl : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) G)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have heq : (Sum.inl : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) =
      ((↑) : Set.range (Sum.inl : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) ∘
        (Equiv.ofInjective _ Sum.inl_injective) := by
    funext j
    simp
  have h2 : Prime (rename (⇑(Equiv.ofInjective
      (Sum.inl : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) Sum.inl_injective)) G) := by
    have h := (MulEquiv.prime_iff (renameEquiv k (Equiv.ofInjective
      (Sum.inl : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) Sum.inl_injective))).2 hG
    simpa [renameEquiv] using h
  have h3 := (prime_rename_iff
    (Set.range (Sum.inl : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2))).2 h2
  rwa [rename_rename, ← heq] at h3

name: AclGeom.prime_rename_inr
statement:
theorem prime_rename_inr {G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hG : Prime G) :
    Prime (rename (Sum.inr : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) G)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have heq : (Sum.inr : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) =
      ((↑) : Set.range (Sum.inr : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) ∘
        (Equiv.ofInjective _ Sum.inr_injective) := by
    funext j
    simp
  have h2 : Prime (rename (⇑(Equiv.ofInjective
      (Sum.inr : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) Sum.inr_injective)) G) := by
    have h := (MulEquiv.prime_iff (renameEquiv k (Equiv.ofInjective
      (Sum.inr : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) Sum.inr_injective))).2 hG
    simpa [renameEquiv] using h
  have h3 := (prime_rename_iff
    (Set.range (Sum.inr : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2))).2 h2
  rwa [rename_rename, ← heq] at h3

name: AclGeom.translate_eq_of_idealOf_le
statement:
theorem translate_eq_of_idealOf_le
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra k K] [Algebra k L]
    {c : Fin 2 → K} {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k}
    (hid : translate c (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) F) =
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) F)
    {w : Fin 2 → L} (hle : idealOf k c ≤ idealOf k w) :
    translate w (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k L) F) =
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k L) F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set D := addSubst (k := k) F - rename Sum.inl F with hD
  have hDc : aevalSnd (k := k) c D = 0 := by
    rw [hD, map_sub, aevalSnd_addSubst, aevalSnd_rename_inl, hid, sub_self]
  have hQ : ∀ m : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ,
      (toUVPoly (k := k) D).coeff m ∈ idealOf k c := by
    intro m
    rw [mem_idealOf_iff]
    have h := congrArg (fun g ↦ g.coeff m) hDc
    simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero] at h
    rw [coeff_aevalSnd] at h
    exact h
  have hDw : aevalSnd (k := k) w D = 0 := by
    ext m
    rw [coeff_aevalSnd, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero]
    exact (mem_idealOf_iff k).1 (hle (hQ m))
  rw [hD, map_sub, aevalSnd_addSubst, aevalSnd_rename_inl, sub_eq_zero] at hDw
  exact hDw

name: AclGeom.not_algebraicIndependent_of_translate_eq
statement:
theorem not_algebraicIndependent_of_translate_eq
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {c : Fin 2 → K} {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hFp : Prime F)
    (hid : translate c (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) F) =
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) F)
    (hc : AlgebraicIndependent k c) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h0 := congrArg (aeval (fun _ : Fin 2 ↦ (0 : K))) hid
  rw [aeval_translate] at h0
  have hzero : (fun j ↦ (0 : K) + algebraMap K K (c j)) = c := by
    funext j
    simp
  rw [hzero] at h0
  
  rw [MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap, MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap] at h0
  
  have hsq : (aeval c) (C (aeval (fun _ : Fin 2 ↦ (0 : k)) F) :
      MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) = aeval (fun _ : Fin 2 ↦ (0 : K)) F := by
    rw [aeval_C]
    have hcomp2 : ((algebraMap k K).comp
        ((aeval (fun _ : Fin 2 ↦ (0 : k))).toRingHom :
          MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →+* k)) =
        ((aeval (fun _ : Fin 2 ↦ (0 : K))).toRingHom :
          MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →+* K) := by
      refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) (fun i ↦ ?_) <;> simp
    exact congrArg (fun (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →+* K) ↦ f F) hcomp2
  have hmem : F - C (aeval (fun _ : Fin 2 ↦ (0 : k)) F) ∈ idealOf k c := by
    rw [mem_idealOf_iff, map_sub, hsq, h0, sub_self]
  rw [(idealOf_eq_bot_iff k).2 hc, Ideal.mem_bot, sub_eq_zero] at hmem
  
  rcases eq_or_ne (aeval (fun _ : Fin 2 ↦ (0 : k)) F) 0 with hc0 | hc0
  · rw [hc0, map_zero] at hmem
    exact hFp.ne_zero hmem
  · exact hFp.not_isUnit (hmem ▸ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.2 hc0).map
      (C : k →+* MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k))

name: AclGeom.dimension_eq_of_integral_faithful
statement:
private theorem dimension_eq_of_integral_faithful (R S : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra.IsIntegral R S] [FaithfulSMul R S] :
    ringKrullDim S = ringKrullDim R
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact Order.krullDim_le_of_strictMono (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S))
      (fun p q hpq ↦ Ideal.IsIntegral.under_lt_under hpq)
  · apply iSup_le
    intro l
    obtain ⟨P⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (Ideal.primesOver l.head.asIdeal S))
    obtain ⟨L, hlen, _, _⟩ := Ideal.exists_ltSeries_of_hasGoingUp l P.val
    change (l.length : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ _
    rw [← hlen]
    exact le_iSup (fun p : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum S) ↦ (p.length : WithBot ℕ∞)) L

name: AclGeom.exists_dimension_trdeg_eq
statement:
private theorem exists_dimension_trdeg_eq (k A F : Type*) [Field k] [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [Field F] [Algebra k A] [Algebra A F] [IsFractionRing A F] [Algebra k F]
    [IsScalarTower k A F] [Algebra.FiniteType k A] :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ringKrullDim A = n ∧ Algebra.trdeg k F = n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, g, hg, hgintegral⟩ := exists_integral_inj_algHom_of_fg k A
  let _ : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) A := g.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) A := .of_algHom g
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) A := ⟨hgintegral⟩
  have : FaithfulSMul (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) A :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective _ _).mpr hg
  have hdim : ringKrullDim A = n := by
    rw [dimension_eq_of_integral_faithful (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) A]
    simp only [MvPolynomial.ringKrullDim_of_isNoetherianRing_of_finite,
      ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_field, Nat.card_fin, zero_add]
  have hA := (IsTranscendenceBasis.mvPolynomial (Fin n) k).algebraMap_comp (A := A)
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic A F := IsLocalization.isAlgebraic F (nonZeroDivisors A)
  have hF := hA.algebraMap_comp (A := F)
  have hcard := hF.lift_cardinalMk_eq_trdeg
  have htr : Algebra.trdeg k F = n := by
    simpa only [Cardinal.lift_mk_fin, Cardinal.lift_eq_nat_iff] using hcard.symm
  exact ⟨n, hdim, htr⟩

name: AclGeom.exists_ringKrullDim_trdeg_eq_of_finiteType
statement:
theorem exists_ringKrullDim_trdeg_eq_of_finiteType (k A F : Type*) [Field k]
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Field F] [Algebra k A] [Algebra A F]
    [IsFractionRing A F] [Algebra k F] [IsScalarTower k A F] [Algebra.FiniteType k A] :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ringKrullDim A = n ∧ Algebra.trdeg k F = n
proof:
:=
  exists_dimension_trdeg_eq k A F

name: AclGeom.exists_locusCoordinateRing_dimension
statement:
theorem exists_locusCoordinateRing_dimension {k Ω ι : Type*} [Field k] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω]
    [Finite ι] (a : ι → Ω) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial ι k ⧸ idealOf k a) = n ∧
      Algebra.trdeg k (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range a)) = n
proof:
:= by
  let A := Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range a)
  let F := IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range a)
  have : Algebra.FiniteType k A := Algebra.FiniteType.adjoin_of_finite (Set.finite_range a)
  obtain ⟨n, hdim, htr⟩ := exists_dimension_trdeg_eq k A F
  exact ⟨n, (ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (locusCoordinateRingEquiv a).toRingEquiv).trans hdim,
    htr⟩

name: AclGeom.nonempty_algHom_of_trdeg_le
statement:
private theorem nonempty_algHom_of_trdeg_le {k : Type u} {K : Type v} {Ω : Type w}
    [Field k] [Field K] [Field Ω] [Algebra k K]
    [Algebra k Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] {n : ℕ} (hK : Algebra.trdeg k K = n)
    (hΩ : (n : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k Ω) : Nonempty (K →ₐ[k] Ω)
proof:
:= by
  have : FinTrdeg k K := FinTrdeg.of_trdeg (hK ▸ Cardinal.natCast_lt_aleph0)
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_finset_isTranscendenceBasis k K
  have : FaithfulSMul k Ω := (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective k Ω).2
    (algebraMap k Ω).injective
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := exists_isTranscendenceBasis k Ω
  have hsn : Cardinal.mk s = n := hs.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg.trans hK
  obtain ⟨e⟩ : Nonempty (s ↪ B) := by
    refine Cardinal.lift_mk_le'.1 ?_
    calc Cardinal.lift.{w} (Cardinal.mk s) = (n : Cardinal.{max v w}) := by
          rw [hsn, Cardinal.lift_natCast]
      _ = Cardinal.lift.{v} (n : Cardinal.{w}) := (Cardinal.lift_natCast n).symm
      _ ≤ Cardinal.lift.{v} (Cardinal.mk B) := by
          rw [hB.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg]
          exact Cardinal.lift_le.2 hΩ
  let u : s → Ω := fun i ↦ (e i : Ω)
  have hu : AlgebraicIndependent k u := hB.1.comp e e.injective
  let K₀ := IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range ((↑) : s → K))
  let ψ : K₀ →ₐ[k] Ω := (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range u)).val.comp
    (hs.1.aevalEquivField.symm.trans hu.aevalEquivField).toAlgHom
  let _ : Algebra K₀ Ω := ψ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower k K₀ Ω := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun c ↦ (ψ.commutes c).symm
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic K₀ K := hs.isAlgebraic_field
  exact ⟨(IsAlgClosed.lift : K →ₐ[K₀] Ω).restrictScalars k⟩

name: AclGeom.exists_idealOf_eq_iff
statement:
theorem exists_idealOf_eq_iff {k Ω ι : Type*} [Field k] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    [Finite ι] (P : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι k)) [P.IsPrime] :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial ι k ⧸ P) = n ∧
      ((∃ a : ι → Ω, idealOf k a = P) ↔ (n : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k Ω)
proof:
:= by
  let A := MvPolynomial ι k ⧸ P
  let K := FractionRing A
  have : Algebra.FiniteType k A :=
    .of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k P) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  obtain ⟨n, hdim, htr⟩ := exists_dimension_trdeg_eq k A K
  refine ⟨n, hdim, ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun hΩ ↦ ?_⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h
    obtain ⟨m, hm, htm⟩ := exists_locusCoordinateRing_dimension (k := k) a
    rw [ha] at hm
    have hmn : m = n := by exact_mod_cast hm.symm.trans hdim
    let F := IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range a)
    have : FaithfulSMul k F := (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective k F).2
      (algebraMap k F).injective
    obtain ⟨_, x, hx⟩ := exists_isTranscendenceBasis' k F
    rw [← hmn, ← htm, ← hx.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg]
    exact (hx.1.map' (f := F.val) Subtype.val_injective).cardinalMk_le_trdeg
  · obtain ⟨φ⟩ := nonempty_algHom_of_trdeg_le htr hΩ
    refine ⟨fun i ↦ φ (algebraMap A K (Ideal.Quotient.mk P (MvPolynomial.X i))), ?_⟩
    have hφ : (MvPolynomial.aeval fun i ↦ φ (algebraMap A K (Ideal.Quotient.mk P
        (MvPolynomial.X i))) : MvPolynomial ι k →ₐ[k] Ω) =
        (φ.comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A K)).comp (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k P) :=
      MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun i ↦ by
        rw [MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
        rfl
    ext p
    rw [mem_idealOf_iff, hφ, AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.comp_apply,
      map_eq_zero_iff φ φ.toRingHom.injective, IsScalarTower.coe_toAlgHom',
      map_eq_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective A K), Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk,
      Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]

name: AclGeom.ker_eq_vanishingIdeal_of_isReduced
statement:
theorem ker_eq_vanishingIdeal_of_isReduced {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsReduced X] :
    f.ker = Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal (Closeds.closure (Set.range f))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.map_bot, ← Scheme.nilradical_eq_bot,
    ← Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal_top, Scheme.IdealSheafData.map_vanishingIdeal,
    Closeds.coe_top, Set.image_univ]

name: AclGeom.isIntegral_subscheme_vanishingIdeal
statement:
theorem isIntegral_subscheme_vanishingIdeal {X : Scheme.{u}} (Z : Closeds X)
    (hZ : IsIrreducible (Z : Set X)) :
    IsIntegral (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal Z).subscheme
proof:
:= by
  have hemb := (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal Z).subschemeι.isClosedEmbedding.isEmbedding
  have hrange : Set.range (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal Z).subschemeι = Z := by
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.range_subschemeι, Scheme.IdealSheafData.coe_support_vanishingIdeal]
  have hirr : IsIrreducible (Set.range (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal Z).subschemeι) := by
    rw [hrange]
    exact hZ
  have : IrreducibleSpace (Set.range (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal Z).subschemeι) :=
    Subtype.irreducibleSpace hirr
  have : IrreducibleSpace (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal Z).subscheme :=
    hemb.toHomeomorph.irreducibleSpace_iff.2 this
  exact isIntegral_of_irreducibleSpace_of_isReduced _

name: AclGeom.liftToReducedSubscheme_subschemeι
statement:
theorem liftToReducedSubscheme_subschemeι {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (Z : Closeds X) (f : Y ⟶ X)
    [IsReduced Y] (hf : Set.range f ⊆ Z) :

proof:
:=
  IsClosedImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _

name: AclGeom.CurvePointsPlaces.functionFieldMap_stalkMap
statement:
theorem functionFieldMap_stalkMap
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsDominant f] (x : X) :
    CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) Y.functionField) ≫
        f.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap =
      f.stalkMap x ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField)
proof:
:= by
  let q := f.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap
  let u := f.stalkMap x
  let sx := CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField)
  let sy := CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) Y.functionField)
  let tx := X.fromSpecStalk x
  let ty := Y.fromSpecStalk (f x)
  have hx : Spec.map sx ≫ tx = X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X) :=
    Scheme.SpecMap_stalkSpecializes_fromSpecStalk (genericPoint_specializes x)
  have hy : Spec.map sy ≫ ty = Y.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Y) :=
    Scheme.SpecMap_stalkSpecializes_fromSpecStalk (genericPoint_specializes (f x))
  have hstalk : Spec.map u ≫ ty = tx ≫ f :=
    Scheme.SpecMap_stalkMap_fromSpecStalk f
  have hg : X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X) ≫ f =
      Spec.map q ≫ Y.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Y) :=
    (Scheme.Hom.fromFunctionField_toPartialMap f).symm.trans
      (Scheme.PartialMap.fromFunctionField_eq_functionFieldMorphismOfHom f.toPartialMap)
  apply Spec.map_injective
  apply (cancel_mono ty).mp
  calc
    _ = Spec.map q ≫ (Spec.map sy ≫ ty) :=
      (congrArg (fun h ↦ h ≫ ty) (Spec.map_comp sy q)).trans (Category.assoc _ _ _)
    _ = Spec.map q ≫ Y.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Y) := congrArg _ hy
    _ = X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X) ≫ f := hg.symm
    _ = (Spec.map sx ≫ tx) ≫ f := congrArg (fun h ↦ h ≫ f) hx.symm
    _ = Spec.map sx ≫ (tx ≫ f) := Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = Spec.map sx ≫ (Spec.map u ≫ ty) := congrArg _ hstalk.symm
    _ = Spec.map (u ≫ sx) ≫ ty :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
        (congrArg (fun h ↦ h ≫ ty) (Spec.map_comp u sx).symm)

proof:

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.exists_pair_relocation
statement:
theorem exists_pair_relocation [IsAlgClosed Ω] {s : Ω}
    (hs : Transcendental ↥S.base s) :
    ∃ c₂' : Fin 2 → Ω, S.JointRel c₂' ∧
      ∀ j, IsAlgebraic ↥(adjoin ↥S.base ({s} : Set Ω)) (c₂' j)
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : S.base = adjoin k (Set.range ![S.x₁, S.y₁]) :=
    congrArg (adjoin k) (Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty S.x₁ S.y₁ ![]).symm
  have hx₂ : Transcendental ↥S.base S.x₂ := S.transcendental_x₂
  have hy₂ : S.y₂ ∈ racl ↥S.base {S.x₂} := S.y₂_mem_baseRacl
  rw [hbase] at hs hx₂ hy₂ ⊢
  
  have ht : AlgebraicIndependent ↥(adjoin k (Set.range ![S.x₁, S.y₁]))
      ![S.x₂] := algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff.2 hx₂
  have hs' : AlgebraicIndependent ↥(adjoin k (Set.range ![S.x₁, S.y₁]))
      ![s] := algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff.2 hs
  have hsub : (Set.range ![S.x₂] : Set Ω) ⊆ Set.range ![S.x₂, S.y₂] := by
    rw [Matrix.range_cons_empty, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty]
    exact Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  have hle : adjoin ↥(adjoin k (Set.range ![S.x₁, S.y₁])) (Set.range ![S.x₂]) ≤
      adjoin ↥(adjoin k (Set.range ![S.x₁, S.y₁])) (Set.range ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) :=
    adjoin.mono _ _ _ hsub
  
  have hgen : ∀ x ∈ Set.range ![S.x₂, S.y₂], IsAlgebraic
      ↥(adjoin ↥(adjoin k (Set.range ![S.x₁, S.y₁])) (Set.range ![S.x₂])) x := by
    rw [Matrix.range_cons_empty, Matrix.range_cons_cons_empty]
    rintro x (rfl | rfl)
    · exact isAlgebraic_algebraMap
        (⟨S.x₂, subset_adjoin _ _ rfl⟩ :
          ↥(adjoin ↥(adjoin k (Set.range ![S.x₁, S.y₁])) {S.x₂}))
    · exact (mem_racl_iff _).1 hy₂
  obtain ⟨c₂', hrel, halg⟩ := exists_joint_relocation ![S.x₁, S.y₁] ht hle
    (isAlgebraic_extendScalars_adjoin hle hgen) hs'
  refine ⟨c₂', hrel, fun j ↦ ?_⟩
  have h := halg j
  rwa [Matrix.range_cons_empty] at h

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.idealOf_eq

theorem JointRel.idealOf_eq (hrel : S.JointRel c₂') :

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.snd_mem
statement: theorem JointRel.snd_mem (hrel : S.JointRel c₂') : c₂' 1 ∈ racl k {c₂' 0}
proof:
:= by
  have hv : Sum.elim ![S.x₁, S.y₁] ![S.x₂, S.y₂] (Sum.inr 1) ∈ racl k
      (Sum.elim ![S.x₁, S.y₁] ![S.x₂, S.y₂] '' {Sum.inr 0}) := by
    simpa [Set.image_singleton] using S.y₂_mem
  have h := mem_racl_image_of_idealOf_eq k hrel.idealOf_eq.symm hv

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.fst_mem
statement: theorem JointRel.fst_mem (hrel : S.JointRel c₂') : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {c₂' 1}
proof:
:= by

      (Sum.elim ![S.x₁, S.y₁] ![S.x₂, S.y₂] '' {Sum.inr 1}) := by
    simpa [Set.image_singleton] using S.x₂_mem
  have h := mem_racl_image_of_idealOf_eq k hrel.idealOf_eq.symm hv
  simpa [Set.image_singleton] using h

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.fst_notMem_base
statement:
theorem JointRel.fst_notMem_base (hrel : S.JointRel c₂') :

proof:
:= by
  have hv : Sum.elim ![S.x₁, S.y₁] ![S.x₂, S.y₂] (Sum.inr 0) ∉ racl k
      (Sum.elim ![S.x₁, S.y₁] ![S.x₂, S.y₂] '' {Sum.inl 0, Sum.inl 1}) := by
    simpa [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton] using S.x₂_notMem_base
  have h := notMem_racl_image_of_idealOf_eq k hrel.idealOf_eq.symm hv
  simpa [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton] using h

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.sum_snd_mem
statement:
theorem JointRel.sum_snd_mem (hrel : S.JointRel c₂') :
    S.y₁ + c₂' 1 ∈ racl k {S.x₁ + c₂' 0}
proof:
:= by
  have hv : (![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) 1 ∈ racl k
      ((![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) '' {(0 : Fin 2)}) := by
    simpa [Set.image_singleton] using S.sum_mem
  have h := mem_racl_image_of_idealOf_eq k hrel.sum_idealOf_eq.symm hv

      ((![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) '' {(1 : Fin 2)}) := by
    simpa [Set.image_singleton] using S.sum_mem'
  have h := mem_racl_image_of_idealOf_eq k hrel.sum_idealOf_eq.symm hv
  simpa [Set.image_singleton] using h

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.sum_fst_transcendental
statement:
theorem JointRel.sum_fst_transcendental (hrel : S.JointRel c₂') :
    Transcendental k (S.x₁ + c₂' 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hv : Transcendental k ((![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) 0) := by
    simpa using S.sum_fst_transcendental
  have h := transcendental_of_idealOf_eq k hrel.sum_idealOf_eq.symm hv
  simpa using h

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.racl_pair_of_relocation
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : z ∈ racl k (insert s {S.x₁, S.y₁}) := mem_racl_insert_iff.2 halg
  have hy₁ : S.y₁ ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s} :=
    racl_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (Set.mem_insert _ _)) S.y₁_mem
  have hins : (insert s {S.x₁, S.y₁} : Set Ω) = insert S.y₁ {S.x₁, s} := by
    rw [Set.insert_comm s S.x₁, Set.pair_comm s S.y₁, Set.insert_comm S.x₁ S.y₁]
  rw [hins, racl_insert_of_mem hy₁] at h1
  exact h1

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.fst_notMem_pair
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have h0 : c₂' 0 ∉ racl k {S.x₁} := fun h ↦ hrel.fst_notMem_base
    (racl_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (Set.mem_insert _ _)) h)
  have hexch : s ∈ racl k (insert (c₂' 0) {S.x₁}) := by
    refine racl_exchange ?_ h0
    rwa [Set.pair_comm S.x₁ s] at halg
  have hsub : (insert (c₂' 0) {S.x₁} : Set Ω) ⊆ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂} := by
    rintro z (rfl | rfl)
    · exact hmem
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  exact hs (racl_le_of_subset_racl hsub hexch)

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.x₂_notMem_fresh
statement:
theorem x₂_notMem_fresh (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) :
    S.x₂ ∉ racl k {S.x₁, s}
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hexch : s ∈ racl k (insert S.x₂ {S.x₁}) := by
    refine racl_exchange ?_ S.x₂_notMem
    rwa [Set.pair_comm S.x₁ s] at hmem
  refine hs ?_
  rwa [Set.pair_comm S.x₂ S.x₁] at hexch

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.delta_fst_transcendental
statement:
theorem delta_fst_transcendental (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂})
    {c₂'' : Fin 2 → Ω} (halg : c₂'' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s}) :
    Transcendental k (S.x₂ - c₂'' 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hδ : S.x₂ - c₂'' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s} :=
    (mem_racl_iff k).2 (h.tower_top _)
  have hx₂ : S.x₂ ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s} := by
    have := add_mem hδ halg
    simpa using this
  exact x₂_notMem_fresh hs hx₂

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.x₁_notMem_pair
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hexch : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k (insert S.x₁ {S.x₂}) := by
    refine racl_exchange ?_ S.x₁_notMem
    rwa [Set.pair_comm S.x₂ (c₂' 0)] at hmem
  exact hrel.fst_notMem_pair hs halg hexch

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.sum_fst_notMem_delta
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  
  have hx₂'mem : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₂, c₂' 0} :=
    subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_iff.2 (Or.inr rfl))
  have hy₂'mem : c₂' 1 ∈ racl k {S.x₂, c₂' 0} := by
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ hrel.snd_mem
    rintro z rfl
    exact hx₂'mem
  have hy₂mem : S.y₂ ∈ racl k {S.x₂, c₂' 0} := by
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ S.y₂_mem
    rintro z rfl
    exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  have hδsub : ({S.x₂ - c₂' 0, S.y₂ - c₂' 1} : Set Ω) ⊆ racl k {S.x₂, c₂' 0} := by
    rintro z (rfl | rfl)
    · exact sub_mem (subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)) hx₂'mem
    · exact sub_mem hy₂mem hy₂'mem
  
  have hsum : S.x₁ + c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₂, c₂' 0} :=
    racl_le_of_subset_racl hδsub hmem
  have hx₁ : S.x₁ ∈ racl k {S.x₂, c₂' 0} := by
    have := sub_mem hsum hx₂'mem
    simpa using this
  exact hrel.x₁_notMem_pair hs halg hx₁

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.sum_fst_notMem_delta'
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hδ₁ : S.x₂ - c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₂ - c₂' 0, S.y₂ - c₂' 1} :=
    subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  have h2 : S.x₁ + c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₂ - c₂' 0, S.y₂ - c₂' 1} := by
    have h3 := sub_mem hmem hδ₁
    have h4 : S.x₁ + S.x₂ - (S.x₂ - c₂' 0) = S.x₁ + c₂' 0 := by ring
    rwa [h4] at h3
  exact hrel.sum_fst_notMem_delta hs halg h2

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.exists_prime_span_sum
proof:
:= by
  have hconv : ![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂] = ![S.x₁ + S.x₂, S.y₁ + S.y₂] := by
    rw [Matrix.cons_add_cons, Matrix.cons_add_cons, Matrix.empty_add_empty]
  rw [hconv]
  exact exists_prime_span_idealOf k S.sum_fst_transcendental S.sum_mem

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.subSubst_mem
statement:
theorem JointRel.subSubst_mem (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k}
    (hF : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F}) :
    subSubst (k := k) F ∈ idealOf k
      (Sum.elim (![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂'))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, aeval_subSubst]
  have harith : ![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂] - (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') =
      ![S.x₁, S.y₁] + c₂' := by
    abel
  rw [harith]
  have hmem : F ∈ idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] + c₂') := by
    rw [hrel.sum_idealOf_eq, hF]
    exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
  exact (mem_idealOf_iff _).1 hmem

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.translate_deltaVec_eq
statement:
theorem JointRel.translate_deltaVec_eq [IsAlgClosed k]
    (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hF0 : F ≠ 0)
    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F}) :
    translate (deltaVec S c₂')
        (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')) F) =
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')) F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set FK := MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')) F with hFK
  
  have hu : Transcendental ↥(deltaField S c₂') (S.x₁ + S.x₂) := fun h ↦
    hrel.sum_fst_notMem_delta' hs halg ((mem_racl_iff k).2 h)
  have hv' : Transcendental ↥(deltaField S c₂') (S.y₁ + S.y₂) := fun h ↦
    hrel.sum_snd_notMem_delta' hs halg ((mem_racl_iff k).2 h)
  
  have hconv : ![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂] = ![S.x₁ + S.x₂, S.y₁ + S.y₂] := by
    rw [Matrix.cons_add_cons, Matrix.cons_add_cons, Matrix.empty_add_empty]
  rw [hconv] at hFspan
  have hspan_d : idealOf ↥(deltaField S c₂') ![S.x₁ + S.x₂, S.y₁ + S.y₂] =
      Ideal.span {FK} :=
    idealOf_map_eq_span hu S.sum_mem hv' S.sum_mem' hF0 hFspan
  
  have hud' : Transcendental ↥(deltaField S c₂') (S.x₁ + c₂' 0) := fun h ↦
    hrel.sum_fst_notMem_delta hs halg ((mem_racl_iff k).2 h)
  have hvd'' : Transcendental ↥(deltaField S c₂') (S.y₁ + c₂' 1) := fun h ↦
    hrel.sum_snd_notMem_delta hs halg ((mem_racl_iff k).2 h)
  have hFspan_d' : idealOf k ![S.x₁ + c₂' 0, S.y₁ + c₂' 1] = Ideal.span {F} := by
    have h1 := hrel.sum_idealOf_eq
    have hconv' : ![S.x₁, S.y₁] + c₂' = ![S.x₁ + c₂' 0, S.y₁ + c₂' 1] := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp
    rw [hconv', hconv] at h1
    rw [h1, hFspan]
  have hspan_d' : idealOf ↥(deltaField S c₂') ![S.x₁ + c₂' 0, S.y₁ + c₂' 1] =
      Ideal.span {FK} :=
    idealOf_map_eq_span hud' hrel.sum_snd_mem hvd'' hrel.sum_fst_mem hF0 hFspan_d'
  
  
  have htrans := idealOf_translate_span (c := deltaVec S c₂') hspan_d
  have htuple : (fun j ↦ (![S.x₁ + S.x₂, S.y₁ + S.y₂] : Fin 2 → Ω) j -
      algebraMap ↥(deltaField S c₂') Ω (deltaVec S c₂' j)) =
      ![S.x₁ + c₂' 0, S.y₁ + c₂' 1] := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j
    · show (S.x₁ + S.x₂) - (S.x₂ - c₂' 0) = S.x₁ + c₂' 0
      ring
    · show (S.y₁ + S.y₂) - (S.y₂ - c₂' 1) = S.y₁ + c₂' 1
      ring
  rw [htuple, hspan_d'] at htrans
  have hFK0 : FK ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hF0 (MvPolynomial.map_injective _
    (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')).injective (by rw [map_zero]; exact h))
  exact translate_eq_self_of_span_eq hFK0 htrans.symm

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.delta_snd_mem
statement:
theorem JointRel.delta_snd_mem [IsAlgClosed k] (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hFp : Prime F)
    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F}) :
    S.y₂ - c₂' 1 ∈ racl k {S.x₂ - c₂' 0}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hid := hrel.translate_deltaVec_eq hs halg hFp.ne_zero hFspan
  have hnindK : ¬AlgebraicIndependent k (deltaVec S c₂') := fun h ↦
    not_algebraicIndependent_of_translate_eq hFp hid h
  have hnind : ¬AlgebraicIndependent k ![S.x₂ - c₂' 0, S.y₂ - c₂' 1] := by
    intro h
    refine hnindK (AlgebraicIndependent.of_comp (deltaField S c₂').val ?_)
    have hcomp : (⇑(deltaField S c₂').val ∘ deltaVec S c₂') =
        ![S.x₂ - c₂' 0, S.y₂ - c₂' 1] := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl
    rwa [hcomp]
  rw [algebraicIndependent_iff_forall_notMem_racl] at hnind
  push Not at hnind
  rw [Fin.exists_fin_two] at hnind
  rcases hnind with hi | hi
  · have himg : (![S.x₂ - c₂' 0, S.y₂ - c₂' 1] ''
        ({(0 : Fin 2)}ᶜ : Set (Fin 2))) = {S.y₂ - c₂' 1} := by
      have hcompl : ({(0 : Fin 2)}ᶜ : Set (Fin 2)) = {1} := by
        ext i
        fin_cases i <;> simp
      rw [hcompl, Set.image_singleton]
      simp
    rw [himg] at hi
    have hδ₁ : S.x₂ - c₂' 0 ∉ racl k (∅ : Set Ω) :=
      notMem_racl_empty_of_transcendental (delta_fst_transcendental hs halg)
    have hxy : S.x₂ - c₂' 0 ∈
        racl k (insert (S.y₂ - c₂' 1) (∅ : Set Ω)) := by
      simpa using hi
    have hexch := racl_exchange hxy hδ₁
    simpa using hexch
  · have himg : (![S.x₂ - c₂' 0, S.y₂ - c₂' 1] ''
        ({(1 : Fin 2)}ᶜ : Set (Fin 2))) = {S.x₂ - c₂' 0} := by
      have hcompl : ({(1 : Fin 2)}ᶜ : Set (Fin 2)) = {0} := by
        ext i
        fin_cases i <;> simp
      rw [hcompl, Set.image_singleton]
      simp
    rw [himg] at hi
    exact hi

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.exists_prime_span_delta
statement:
theorem JointRel.exists_prime_span_delta [IsAlgClosed k]
    (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hFp : Prime F)
    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F}) :
    ∃ G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k, Prime G ∧
      idealOf k ![S.x₂ - c₂' 0, S.y₂ - c₂' 1] = Ideal.span {G}
proof:
:=
  exists_prime_span_idealOf k (delta_fst_transcendental hs halg)
    (hrel.delta_snd_mem hs halg hFp hFspan)

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.pair_idealOf_eq
statement:
theorem JointRel.pair_idealOf_eq (hrel : S.JointRel c₂') :
    idealOf k c₂' = idealOf k ![S.x₂, S.y₂]
proof:
:= by
  refine idealOf_eq_of_aeval_iff k fun g ↦ ?_
  have hcomp₁ : (Sum.elim ![S.x₁, S.y₁] c₂' ∘ Sum.inr : Fin 2 → Ω) = c₂' := by
    funext j
    rfl
  have hcomp₂ : (Sum.elim ![S.x₁, S.y₁] ![S.x₂, S.y₂] ∘ Sum.inr :
      Fin 2 → Ω) = ![S.x₂, S.y₂] := by
    funext j
    rfl
  have h1 : aeval (Sum.elim ![S.x₁, S.y₁] c₂') (rename Sum.inr g) =
      aeval c₂' g := by
    rw [aeval_rename, hcomp₁]
  have h2 : aeval (Sum.elim ![S.x₁, S.y₁] ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) (rename Sum.inr g) =
      aeval ![S.x₂, S.y₂] g := by
    rw [aeval_rename, hcomp₂]
  rw [← h1, ← h2]
  exact hrel (rename Sum.inr g)

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.pair_fst_notMem_delta
statement:
theorem JointRel.pair_fst_notMem_delta [IsAlgClosed k] (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hFp : Prime F)
    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F}) :
    S.x₂ ∉ racl k {S.x₂ - c₂' 0, S.y₂ - c₂' 1}
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  
  have hδ₁ : S.y₂ - c₂' 1 ∈ racl k {S.x₂ - c₂' 0} :=
    hrel.delta_snd_mem hs halg hFp hFspan
  have hD : racl k ({S.x₂ - c₂' 0, S.y₂ - c₂' 1} : Set Ω) ≤
      racl k {S.x₂ - c₂' 0} := by
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_
    rintro z (rfl | rfl)
    · exact subset_racl k _ rfl
    · exact hδ₁
  have hx₂δ : S.x₂ ∈ racl k {S.x₂ - c₂' 0} := hD hmem
  
  have hx₂e : S.x₂ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set Ω) := fun h ↦
    S.x₂_notMem (racl_mono (Set.empty_subset _) h)
  have hins₀ : (insert (S.x₂ - c₂' 0) (∅ : Set Ω)) = {S.x₂ - c₂' 0} := by
    simp
  have hins₂ : (insert S.x₂ (∅ : Set Ω)) = {S.x₂} := by simp
  have hexch : S.x₂ - c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₂} := by
    have h1 : S.x₂ ∈ racl k (insert (S.x₂ - c₂' 0) (∅ : Set Ω)) := by
      rw [hins₀]
      exact hx₂δ
    have h2 := racl_exchange h1 hx₂e
    rwa [hins₂] at h2
  have hc₂'0 : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₂} := by
    have hx₂self : S.x₂ ∈ racl k {S.x₂} := subset_racl k _ rfl
    have hsub := sub_mem hx₂self hexch
    have hcancel : S.x₂ - (S.x₂ - c₂' 0) = c₂' 0 := by ring
    rwa [hcancel] at hsub
  refine hrel.fst_notMem_pair hs halg ?_
  exact racl_mono (Set.subset_insert _ _) hc₂'0

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.pair_snd_notMem_delta
statement:
theorem JointRel.pair_snd_notMem_delta [IsAlgClosed k] (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})

    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F}) :

proof:
:= fun hmem ↦

    (racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hmem) S.x₂_mem)

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.reloc_fst_notMem_delta
statement:
theorem JointRel.reloc_fst_notMem_delta [IsAlgClosed k]
    (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hFp : Prime F)
    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F}) :
    c₂' 0 ∉ racl k {S.x₂ - c₂' 0, S.y₂ - c₂' 1}
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hδ₀m : S.x₂ - c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₂ - c₂' 0, S.y₂ - c₂' 1} :=
    subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  have hx₂m := add_mem hδ₀m hmem
  have hcancel : S.x₂ - c₂' 0 + c₂' 0 = S.x₂ := by ring
  rw [hcancel] at hx₂m
  exact hrel.pair_fst_notMem_delta hs halg hFp hFspan hx₂m

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.reloc_snd_notMem_delta
statement:
theorem JointRel.reloc_snd_notMem_delta [IsAlgClosed k]

    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F}) :

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.translate_pair_eq
statement:
theorem JointRel.translate_pair_eq [IsAlgClosed k] (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hFp : Prime F)
    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F})
    {G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hG0 : G ≠ 0)
    (hGspan : idealOf k ![S.x₂, S.y₂] = Ideal.span {G}) :
    translate (deltaVec S c₂')
        (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')) G) =
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')) G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set GK := MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')) G with hGK
  
  have hu : Transcendental ↥(deltaField S c₂') S.x₂ := fun h ↦
    hrel.pair_fst_notMem_delta hs halg hFp hFspan ((mem_racl_iff k).2 h)
  have hv' : Transcendental ↥(deltaField S c₂') S.y₂ := fun h ↦
    hrel.pair_snd_notMem_delta hs halg hFp hFspan ((mem_racl_iff k).2 h)
  have hspan_d : idealOf ↥(deltaField S c₂') ![S.x₂, S.y₂] =
      Ideal.span {GK} :=
    idealOf_map_eq_span hu S.y₂_mem hv' S.x₂_mem hG0 hGspan
  
  have hud' : Transcendental ↥(deltaField S c₂') (c₂' 0) := fun h ↦
    hrel.reloc_fst_notMem_delta hs halg hFp hFspan ((mem_racl_iff k).2 h)
  have hvd'' : Transcendental ↥(deltaField S c₂') (c₂' 1) := fun h ↦
    hrel.reloc_snd_notMem_delta hs halg hFp hFspan ((mem_racl_iff k).2 h)
  have hpair : c₂' = ![c₂' 0, c₂' 1] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hGspan_d' : idealOf k ![c₂' 0, c₂' 1] = Ideal.span {G} := by
    rw [← hpair, hrel.pair_idealOf_eq, hGspan]
  have hspan_d' : idealOf ↥(deltaField S c₂') ![c₂' 0, c₂' 1] =
      Ideal.span {GK} :=
    idealOf_map_eq_span hud' hrel.snd_mem hvd'' hrel.fst_mem hG0 hGspan_d'
  
  have htrans := idealOf_translate_span (c := deltaVec S c₂') hspan_d
  have htuple : (fun j ↦ (![S.x₂, S.y₂] : Fin 2 → Ω) j -
      algebraMap ↥(deltaField S c₂') Ω (deltaVec S c₂' j)) =
      ![c₂' 0, c₂' 1] := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j
    · show S.x₂ - (S.x₂ - c₂' 0) = c₂' 0
      ring
    · show S.y₂ - (S.y₂ - c₂' 1) = c₂' 1
      ring
  rw [htuple, hspan_d'] at htrans
  have hGK0 : GK ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hG0 (MvPolynomial.map_injective _
    (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')).injective (by rw [map_zero]; exact h))
  exact translate_eq_self_of_span_eq hGK0 htrans.symm

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.fst_notMem_pairRacl
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hD : racl k ({S.x₂, S.y₂} : Set Ω) ≤ racl k {S.x₂} := by
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_
    rintro z (rfl | rfl)
    · exact subset_racl k _ rfl
    · exact S.y₂_mem
  refine hrel.fst_notMem_pair hs halg ?_
  exact racl_mono (Set.subset_insert _ _) (hD hmem)

    (racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hmem) hrel.fst_mem)

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.reloc_span_pairField
statement:
theorem JointRel.reloc_span_pairField [IsAlgClosed k] (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    {G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hG0 : G ≠ 0)
    (hGspan : idealOf k ![S.x₂, S.y₂] = Ideal.span {G}) :
    idealOf ↥(adjoin k ({S.x₂, S.y₂} : Set Ω)) c₂' =
      Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.map
        (algebraMap k ↥(adjoin k ({S.x₂, S.y₂} : Set Ω))) G}
proof:
:= by
  have hu : Transcendental ↥(adjoin k ({S.x₂, S.y₂} : Set Ω)) (c₂' 0) :=
    fun h ↦ hrel.fst_notMem_pairRacl hs halg ((mem_racl_iff k).2 h)
  have hv' : Transcendental ↥(adjoin k ({S.x₂, S.y₂} : Set Ω)) (c₂' 1) :=
    fun h ↦ hrel.snd_notMem_pairRacl hs halg ((mem_racl_iff k).2 h)
  have hpair : c₂' = ![c₂' 0, c₂' 1] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hGspan' : idealOf k ![c₂' 0, c₂' 1] = Ideal.span {G} := by
    rw [← hpair, hrel.pair_idealOf_eq, hGspan]
  have h := idealOf_map_eq_span hu hrel.snd_mem hv' hrel.fst_mem hG0 hGspan'
  rwa [← hpair] at h

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.joint_idealOf_eq_of_two_relocations
statement:
theorem joint_idealOf_eq_of_two_relocations [IsAlgClosed k]
    (hrel : S.JointRel c₂') (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂})
    (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    (hrel' : S.JointRel c₂'') (hs' : s' ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂})
    (halg' : c₂'' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s'})
    {G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hG0 : G ≠ 0)
    (hGspan : idealOf k ![S.x₂, S.y₂] = Ideal.span {G}) :
    idealOf k (Sum.elim ![S.x₂, S.y₂] c₂') =
      idealOf k (Sum.elim ![S.x₂, S.y₂] c₂'')
proof:
:= by
  have hx₂K : S.x₂ ∈ adjoin k ({S.x₂, S.y₂} : Set Ω) :=
    subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  have hy₂K : S.y₂ ∈ adjoin k ({S.x₂, S.y₂} : Set Ω) :=
    subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
  have h := joint_idealOf_eq
    (c := (![⟨S.x₂, hx₂K⟩, ⟨S.y₂, hy₂K⟩] :
      Fin 2 → ↥(adjoin k ({S.x₂, S.y₂} : Set Ω))))
    (hrel.reloc_span_pairField hs halg hG0 hGspan)
    (hrel'.reloc_span_pairField hs' halg' hG0 hGspan)
  have hcoe : (fun j ↦ algebraMap ↥(adjoin k ({S.x₂, S.y₂} : Set Ω)) Ω
      ((![⟨S.x₂, hx₂K⟩, ⟨S.y₂, hy₂K⟩] :
        Fin 2 → ↥(adjoin k ({S.x₂, S.y₂} : Set Ω))) j)) = ![S.x₂, S.y₂] := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> rfl
  rwa [hcoe] at h

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.delta_idealOf_eq_of_two_relocations
statement:
theorem delta_idealOf_eq_of_two_relocations [IsAlgClosed k]
    (hrel : S.JointRel c₂') (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂})
    (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    (hrel' : S.JointRel c₂'') (hs' : s' ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂})
    (halg' : c₂'' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s'})
    {G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hG0 : G ≠ 0)
    (hGspan : idealOf k ![S.x₂, S.y₂] = Ideal.span {G}) :
    idealOf k (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') = idealOf k (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂'')
proof:
:= by
  have h := joint_idealOf_eq_of_two_relocations hrel hs halg hrel' hs' halg'
    hG0 hGspan
  refine idealOf_sub_eq_of_joint fun f ↦ ⟨fun h0 ↦ ?_, fun h0 ↦ ?_⟩
  · have h1 := aeval_eq_aeval_of_idealOf_eq k h (f := f) (g := 0)
      (by simpa using h0)
    simpa using h1
  · have h1 := aeval_eq_aeval_of_idealOf_eq k h.symm (f := f) (g := 0)
      (by simpa using h0)
    simpa using h1

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.pair_fst_notMem_relocRacl
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hD : racl k ({c₂' 0, c₂' 1} : Set Ω) ≤ racl k {S.x₁, s} := by
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_
    rintro z (rfl | rfl)
    · exact halg
    · exact racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 halg)
        hrel.snd_mem
  exact S.x₂_notMem_fresh hs (hD hmem)

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.pair_snd_notMem_relocRacl
proof:
:= fun hmem ↦
  hrel.pair_fst_notMem_relocRacl hs halg
    (racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hmem) S.x₂_mem)

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.pair_span_relocField
statement:
theorem JointRel.pair_span_relocField [IsAlgClosed k] (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    {G₂ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hG₂0 : G₂ ≠ 0)
    (hG₂span : idealOf k ![S.x₂, S.y₂] = Ideal.span {G₂}) :
    idealOf ↥(adjoin k ({c₂' 0, c₂' 1} : Set Ω)) ![S.x₂, S.y₂] =
      Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.map
        (algebraMap k ↥(adjoin k ({c₂' 0, c₂' 1} : Set Ω))) G₂}
proof:
:= by
  have hu : Transcendental ↥(adjoin k ({c₂' 0, c₂' 1} : Set Ω)) S.x₂ :=
    fun h ↦ hrel.pair_fst_notMem_relocRacl hs halg ((mem_racl_iff k).2 h)
  have hv' : Transcendental ↥(adjoin k ({c₂' 0, c₂' 1} : Set Ω)) S.y₂ :=
    fun h ↦ hrel.pair_snd_notMem_relocRacl hs halg ((mem_racl_iff k).2 h)
  exact idealOf_map_eq_span hu S.y₂_mem hv' S.x₂_mem hG₂0 hG₂span

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.joint_transfer_pairField
statement:
theorem JointRel.joint_transfer_pairField [IsAlgClosed k]
    (hrel : S.JointRel c₂') (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂})
    (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    {G₂ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hG₂0 : G₂ ≠ 0)
    (hG₂span : idealOf k ![S.x₂, S.y₂] = Ideal.span {G₂})
    {w : Fin 2 → Ω} (hw : aeval w G₂ = 0)
    {f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) k}
    (hf : aeval (Sum.elim ![S.x₂, S.y₂] c₂') f = 0) :
    aeval (Sum.elim ![S.x₂, S.y₂] w) f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hx₂K : S.x₂ ∈ adjoin k ({S.x₂, S.y₂} : Set Ω) :=
    subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  have hy₂K : S.y₂ ∈ adjoin k ({S.x₂, S.y₂} : Set Ω) :=
    subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
  have hcoe : (fun j ↦ algebraMap ↥(adjoin k ({S.x₂, S.y₂} : Set Ω)) Ω
      ((![⟨S.x₂, hx₂K⟩, ⟨S.y₂, hy₂K⟩] : Fin 2 →
        ↥(adjoin k ({S.x₂, S.y₂} : Set Ω))) j)) = ![S.x₂, S.y₂] := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> rfl
  exact joint_aeval_eq_zero' (c := ![⟨S.x₂, hx₂K⟩, ⟨S.y₂, hy₂K⟩]) hcoe
    (hrel.reloc_span_pairField hs halg hG₂0 hG₂span) hw hf

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.joint_transfer_relocField
statement:
theorem JointRel.joint_transfer_relocField [IsAlgClosed k]
    (hrel : S.JointRel c₂') (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂})
    (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    {G₂ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hG₂0 : G₂ ≠ 0)
    (hG₂span : idealOf k ![S.x₂, S.y₂] = Ideal.span {G₂})
    {w : Fin 2 → Ω} (hw : aeval w G₂ = 0)
    {f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) k}
    (hf : aeval (Sum.elim c₂' ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) f = 0) :
    aeval (Sum.elim c₂' w) f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h0K : c₂' 0 ∈ adjoin k ({c₂' 0, c₂' 1} : Set Ω) :=
    subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  have h1K : c₂' 1 ∈ adjoin k ({c₂' 0, c₂' 1} : Set Ω) :=
    subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl)
  have hcoe : (fun j ↦ algebraMap ↥(adjoin k ({c₂' 0, c₂' 1} : Set Ω)) Ω
      ((![⟨c₂' 0, h0K⟩, ⟨c₂' 1, h1K⟩] : Fin 2 →
        ↥(adjoin k ({c₂' 0, c₂' 1} : Set Ω))) j)) = c₂' := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> rfl
  exact joint_aeval_eq_zero' (c := ![⟨c₂' 0, h0K⟩, ⟨c₂' 1, h1K⟩]) hcoe
    (hrel.pair_span_relocField hs halg hG₂0 hG₂span) hw hf

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.constantCoeff_delta_gen
statement:
theorem JointRel.constantCoeff_delta_gen [IsAlgClosed k]
    (hrel : S.JointRel c₂') (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂})
    (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    {G₂ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hG₂0 : G₂ ≠ 0)
    (hG₂span : idealOf k ![S.x₂, S.y₂] = Ideal.span {G₂})
    {G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k}
    (hGspan : idealOf k (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') = Ideal.span {G}) :
    constantCoeff G = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpair : c₂' = ![c₂' 0, c₂' 1] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  
  have hswap : ((Sum.elim c₂' ![S.x₂, S.y₂] : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2 → Ω) ∘
      Sum.swap) = Sum.elim ![S.x₂, S.y₂] c₂' := by
    funext i
    rcases i with j | j <;> rfl
  have hf : aeval (Sum.elim c₂' ![S.x₂, S.y₂])
      (rename Sum.swap (subSubst (k := k) G)) = 0 := by
    rw [aeval_rename, hswap, aeval_subSubst]
    have hmem : G ∈ idealOf k (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') := by
      rw [hGspan]
      exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
    exact (mem_idealOf_iff _).1 hmem
  
  have hw : aeval ![c₂' 0, c₂' 1] G₂ = 0 := by
    rw [← hpair]
    have hmem : G₂ ∈ idealOf k c₂' := by
      rw [hrel.pair_idealOf_eq, hG₂span]
      exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
    exact (mem_idealOf_iff _).1 hmem
  
  have h := hrel.joint_transfer_relocField hs halg hG₂0 hG₂span hw hf
  have hswap2 : ((Sum.elim c₂' ![c₂' 0, c₂' 1] : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2 → Ω) ∘
      Sum.swap) = Sum.elim ![c₂' 0, c₂' 1] c₂' := by
    funext i
    rcases i with j | j <;> rfl
