  rw [aeval_rename, hswap2, aeval_subSubst] at h
  have hzero : (![c₂' 0, c₂' 1] - c₂' : Fin 2 → Ω) = 0 := by
    rw [← hpair]
    exact sub_self _
  rw [hzero, MvPolynomial.aeval_zero] at h
  exact (map_eq_zero _).1 h

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.cpoint_aeval_zero
statement:
theorem cpoint_aeval_zero [IsAlgClosed k]
    (hrel : S.JointRel c₂') (hrel' : S.JointRel c₂'')
    (hs' : s' ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg' : c₂'' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s'})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hFp : Prime F)
    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F})
    {G₂ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hG₂0 : G₂ ≠ 0)
    (hG₂span : idealOf k ![S.x₂, S.y₂] = Ideal.span {G₂}) :
    aeval (c₂' + c₂'' - ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) G₂ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hid := hrel'.translate_pair_eq hs' halg' hFp hFspan hG₂0 hG₂span
  have h := congrArg
    (fun g ↦ aeval (c₂' + c₂'' - ![S.x₂, S.y₂] : Fin 2 → Ω) g) hid
  rw [aeval_translate] at h
  have hpt : (fun j ↦ (c₂' + c₂'' - ![S.x₂, S.y₂] : Fin 2 → Ω) j +
      algebraMap ↥(deltaField S c₂'') Ω (deltaVec S c₂'' j)) = c₂' := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j
    · show c₂' 0 + c₂'' 0 - S.x₂ + (S.x₂ - c₂'' 0) = c₂' 0
      ring
    · show c₂' 1 + c₂'' 1 - S.y₂ + (S.y₂ - c₂'' 1) = c₂' 1
      ring
  rw [hpt] at h
  have hc₂' : aeval c₂' (MvPolynomial.map
      (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂'')) G₂) = 0 := by
    rw [aeval_map_algebraMap]
    have hmem : G₂ ∈ idealOf k c₂' := by
      rw [hrel.pair_idealOf_eq, hG₂span]
      exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
    exact (mem_idealOf_iff _).1 hmem
  rw [hc₂', aeval_map_algebraMap] at h
  exact h.symm

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.chunk_add
statement:
theorem JointRel.chunk_add [IsAlgClosed k]
    (hrel : S.JointRel c₂') (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂})
    (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    (hrel' : S.JointRel c₂'') (hs' : s' ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂})
    (halg' : c₂'' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s'})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hFp : Prime F)
    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F})
    {G₂ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hG₂0 : G₂ ≠ 0)
    (hG₂span : idealOf k ![S.x₂, S.y₂] = Ideal.span {G₂})
    {G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k}
    (hGspan : idealOf k (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') = Ideal.span {G}) :
    aeval ((![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') + (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂'')) G = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hf : aeval (Sum.elim ![S.x₂, S.y₂] c₂') (subSubst (k := k) G) = 0 := by
    rw [aeval_subSubst]
    have hmem : G ∈ idealOf k (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') := by
      rw [hGspan]
      exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
    exact (mem_idealOf_iff _).1 hmem
  have hc := S.cpoint_aeval_zero hrel hrel' hs' halg' hFp hFspan hG₂0 hG₂span
  have h := hrel.joint_transfer_pairField hs halg hG₂0 hG₂span hc hf
  rw [aeval_subSubst] at h
  have harith : (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - (c₂' + c₂'' - ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) :
      Fin 2 → Ω) = (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') + (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂'') := by
    abel
  rwa [harith] at h

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.delta_snd_transcendental
statement:
theorem JointRel.delta_snd_transcendental (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s}) :
    Transcendental k (S.y₂ - c₂' 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hδ₁ : S.y₂ - c₂' 1 ∈ racl k (∅ : Set Ω) :=
    (mem_racl_iff k).2 (h.tower_top _)
  have hc₂'1 : c₂' 1 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s} :=
    racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 halg) hrel.snd_mem
  have hy₂ : S.y₂ ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s} := by
    have h2 := add_mem (racl_mono (Set.empty_subset _) hδ₁) hc₂'1
    have hcancel : S.y₂ - c₂' 1 + c₂' 1 = S.y₂ := by ring
    rwa [hcancel] at h2
  have hx₂ : S.x₂ ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s} :=
    racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hy₂) S.x₂_mem
  exact S.x₂_notMem_fresh hs hx₂

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.delta_fst_mem
statement:
theorem JointRel.delta_fst_mem [IsAlgClosed k] (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hFp : Prime F)
    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F}) :
    S.x₂ - c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.y₂ - c₂' 1}
proof:
:= by
  have hδ₁tr : S.y₂ - c₂' 1 ∉ racl k (∅ : Set Ω) :=
    notMem_racl_empty_of_transcendental
      (hrel.delta_snd_transcendental hs halg)
  have hins : (insert (S.x₂ - c₂' 0) (∅ : Set Ω)) = {S.x₂ - c₂' 0} := by simp
  have h1 : S.y₂ - c₂' 1 ∈ racl k (insert (S.x₂ - c₂' 0) (∅ : Set Ω)) := by
    rw [hins]
    exact hrel.delta_snd_mem hs halg hFp hFspan
  have h2 := racl_exchange h1 hδ₁tr
  have hins2 : (insert (S.y₂ - c₂' 1) (∅ : Set Ω)) = {S.y₂ - c₂' 1} := by simp
  rwa [hins2] at h2

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.deltaStar_fst_notMem_delta
statement:
theorem JointRel.deltaStar_fst_notMem_delta (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    (hrel' : S.JointRel c₂'')
    (hss' : s' ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂, s})
    (halg' : c₂'' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s'}) :
    S.x₂ - c₂'' 0 ∉ racl k {S.x₂ - c₂' 0, S.y₂ - c₂' 1}
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  
  have hx₁T : S.x₁ ∈ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂, s} :=
    subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  have hx₂T : S.x₂ ∈ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂, s} :=
    subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert _ _))
  have hsT : s ∈ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂, s} :=
    subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl))
  have hc₂'0T : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂, s} := by
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ halg
    rintro z (rfl | rfl)
    · exact hx₁T
    · exact hsT
  have hy₂T : S.y₂ ∈ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂, s} :=
    racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hx₂T) S.y₂_mem
  have hc₂'1T : c₂' 1 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂, s} :=
    racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hc₂'0T) hrel.snd_mem
  have hT : racl k ({S.x₂ - c₂' 0, S.y₂ - c₂' 1} : Set Ω) ≤
      racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂, s} := by
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_
    rintro z (rfl | rfl)
    · exact sub_mem hx₂T hc₂'0T
    · exact sub_mem hy₂T hc₂'1T
  have hδT : S.x₂ - c₂'' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂, s} := hT hmem
  have hc₂''0T : c₂'' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂, s} := by
    have h1 := sub_mem hx₂T hδT
    have hcancel : S.x₂ - (S.x₂ - c₂'' 0) = c₂'' 0 := by ring
    rwa [hcancel] at h1
  
  have hc₂''0base : c₂'' 0 ∉ racl k {S.x₁} := fun h ↦
    hrel'.fst_notMem_base (racl_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2
      (Set.mem_insert _ _)) h)
  have hs'exch : s' ∈ racl k {c₂'' 0, S.x₁} := by
    refine racl_exchange ?_ hc₂''0base
    rwa [Set.pair_comm S.x₁ s'] at halg'
  have hs'T : s' ∈ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂, s} := by
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ hs'exch
    rintro z (rfl | rfl)
    · exact hc₂''0T
    · exact hx₁T
  exact hss' hs'T

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.deltaStar_snd_notMem_delta
statement:
theorem JointRel.deltaStar_snd_notMem_delta [IsAlgClosed k]
    (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    (hrel' : S.JointRel c₂'')
    (hss' : s' ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂, s})
    (halg' : c₂'' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s'})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hFp : Prime F)
    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F}) :
    S.y₂ - c₂'' 1 ∉ racl k {S.x₂ - c₂' 0, S.y₂ - c₂' 1}
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hs'₂ : s' ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂} := fun h ↦
    hss' (racl_mono (Set.insert_subset_insert
      (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (Set.mem_insert _ _))) h)
  have hfst : S.x₂ - c₂'' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₂ - c₂' 0, S.y₂ - c₂' 1} :=
    racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hmem)
      (hrel'.delta_fst_mem hs'₂ halg' hFp hFspan)
  exact hrel.deltaStar_fst_notMem_delta hs halg hrel' hss' halg' hfst

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.deltaStar_span
statement:
theorem JointRel.deltaStar_span [IsAlgClosed k] (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    (hrel' : S.JointRel c₂'')
    (hss' : s' ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂, s})
    (halg' : c₂'' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s'})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hFp : Prime F)
    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F})
    {G₂ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hG₂0 : G₂ ≠ 0)
    (hG₂span : idealOf k ![S.x₂, S.y₂] = Ideal.span {G₂})
    {G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hGp : Prime G)
    (hGspan : idealOf k (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') = Ideal.span {G}) :
    idealOf ↥(deltaField S c₂') (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂'') =
      Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')) G}
proof:
:= by
  have hs'₂ : s' ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂} := fun h ↦
    hss' (racl_mono (Set.insert_subset_insert
      (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (Set.mem_insert _ _))) h)
  have htuple : (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂'' : Fin 2 → Ω) =
      ![S.x₂ - c₂'' 0, S.y₂ - c₂'' 1] := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> rfl
  have hGspan' : idealOf k ![S.x₂ - c₂'' 0, S.y₂ - c₂'' 1] =
      Ideal.span {G} := by
    rw [← htuple, ← delta_idealOf_eq_of_two_relocations hrel hs halg hrel'
      hs'₂ halg' hG₂0 hG₂span, hGspan]
  have hu : Transcendental ↥(deltaField S c₂') (S.x₂ - c₂'' 0) := fun h ↦
    hrel.deltaStar_fst_notMem_delta hs halg hrel' hss' halg'
      ((mem_racl_iff k).2 h)
  have hv' : Transcendental ↥(deltaField S c₂') (S.y₂ - c₂'' 1) := fun h ↦
    hrel.deltaStar_snd_notMem_delta hs halg hrel' hss' halg' hFp hFspan
      ((mem_racl_iff k).2 h)
  have h := idealOf_map_eq_span hu
    (hrel'.delta_snd_mem hs'₂ halg' hFp hFspan) hv'
    (hrel'.delta_fst_mem hs'₂ halg' hFp hFspan) hGp.ne_zero hGspan'
  rwa [← htuple] at h

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.translate_delta_self_eq
statement:
theorem JointRel.translate_delta_self_eq [IsAlgClosed k]
    (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    (hrel' : S.JointRel c₂'')
    (hss' : s' ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂, s})
    (halg' : c₂'' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s'})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hFp : Prime F)
    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F})
    {G₂ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hG₂0 : G₂ ≠ 0)
    (hG₂span : idealOf k ![S.x₂, S.y₂] = Ideal.span {G₂})
    {G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hGp : Prime G)
    (hGspan : idealOf k (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') = Ideal.span {G}) :
    translate (deltaVec S c₂')
        (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')) G) =
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')) G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs'₂ : s' ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂} := fun h ↦
    hss' (racl_mono (Set.insert_subset_insert
      (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (Set.mem_insert _ _))) h)
  
  have hδG : aeval (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') G = 0 := by
    have hmem : G ∈ idealOf k (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') := by
      rw [hGspan]
      exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
    exact (mem_idealOf_iff _).1 hmem
  have hδsG : aeval (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂'') G = 0 := by
    have hmem : G ∈ idealOf k (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂'') := by
      rw [← delta_idealOf_eq_of_two_relocations hrel hs halg hrel' hs'₂
        halg' hG₂0 hG₂span, hGspan]
      exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
    exact (mem_idealOf_iff _).1 hmem
  have hsumG := hrel.chunk_add hs halg hrel' hs'₂ halg' hFp hFspan hG₂0
    hG₂span hGspan
  
  have hD : aeval (Sum.elim (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂''))
      (addSubst (k := k) G - rename Sum.inl G - rename Sum.inr G) = 0 := by
    have hinl : ((Sum.elim (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂'') ∘
        Sum.inl : Fin 2 → Ω)) = ![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂' := by
      funext j
      rfl
    have hinr : ((Sum.elim (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂'') ∘
        Sum.inr : Fin 2 → Ω)) = ![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂'' := by
      funext j
      rfl
    rw [map_sub, map_sub, aeval_addSubst, aeval_rename, aeval_rename, hinl,
      hinr, hsumG, hδG, hδsG, sub_zero, sub_zero]
  
  have hcoe : (fun j ↦ algebraMap ↥(deltaField S c₂') Ω
      (deltaVec S c₂' j)) = ![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂' := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> rfl
  have hmemK : aevalFst (k := k) (deltaVec S c₂')
      (addSubst (k := k) G - rename Sum.inl G - rename Sum.inr G) ∈
      idealOf ↥(deltaField S c₂') (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂'') := by
    rw [mem_idealOf_iff, aeval_aevalFst, hcoe]
    exact hD
  rw [hrel.deltaStar_span hs halg hrel' hss' halg' hFp hFspan hG₂0 hG₂span
    hGp hGspan, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hmemK
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hmemK
  
  have hzeroK : aeval (deltaVec S c₂') G = (0 : ↥(deltaField S c₂')) := by
    apply (algebraMap ↥(deltaField S c₂') Ω).injective
    rw [map_zero, ← aeval_algebraMap_apply]
    have hcomp : (algebraMap ↥(deltaField S c₂') Ω ∘ deltaVec S c₂') =
        ![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂' := by
      funext j
      fin_cases j <;> rfl
    rw [hcomp]
    exact hδG
  have hDsplit : aevalFst (k := k) (deltaVec S c₂')
      (addSubst (k := k) G - rename Sum.inl G - rename Sum.inr G) =
      translate (deltaVec S c₂')
          (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')) G) -
        MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')) G := by
    rw [map_sub, map_sub, aevalFst_addSubst, aevalFst_rename_inl,
      aevalFst_rename_inr, hzeroK, map_zero, sub_zero]
  have hqid : q * MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')) G =
      translate (deltaVec S c₂')
          (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')) G) -
        MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')) G :=
    hq.trans hDsplit
  
  have hGK0 : MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')) G ≠ 0 :=
    fun h ↦ hGp.ne_zero (MvPolynomial.map_injective _
      (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')).injective
      (by rw [map_zero]; exact h))
  have hpos : 0 < G.totalDegree := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos G.totalDegree with h0 | h
    · exfalso
      have hC := totalDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C.1 h0
      have ha : G.coeff 0 ≠ 0 := fun h00 ↦
        hGp.ne_zero (by rw [hC, h00, map_zero])
      exact hGp.not_isUnit
        (by rw [hC]; exact (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.2 ha).map C)
    · exact h
  have hposK : 0 < (MvPolynomial.map
      (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')) G).totalDegree := by
    have hdegeq : (MvPolynomial.map
        (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')) G).totalDegree =
        G.totalDegree := by
      rw [MvPolynomial.totalDegree, MvPolynomial.totalDegree,
        support_map_of_injective G
          (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')).injective]
    rwa [hdegeq]
  rcases eq_or_ne (translate (deltaVec S c₂')
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')) G))
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')) G) with heq | hne
  · exact heq
  exfalso
  have hsubne : translate (deltaVec S c₂')
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')) G) -
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')) G ≠ 0 :=
    sub_ne_zero.2 hne
  have hq0 : q ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, zero_mul] at hqid
    exact hsubne hqid.symm
  have hdeg1 := totalDegree_mul_of_isDomain hq0 hGK0
  have hdeg2 : (translate (deltaVec S c₂')
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')) G) -
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')) G).totalDegree <
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')) G).totalDegree :=
    totalDegree_translate_sub_lt _ hposK
  rw [← hqid, hdeg1] at hdeg2
  omega

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.addSubst_delta_gen_eq
statement:
theorem JointRel.addSubst_delta_gen_eq [IsAlgClosed k]
    (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    (hrel' : S.JointRel c₂'')
    (hss' : s' ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂, s})
    (halg' : c₂'' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s'})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hFp : Prime F)
    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F})
    {G₂ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hG₂0 : G₂ ≠ 0)
    (hG₂span : idealOf k ![S.x₂, S.y₂] = Ideal.span {G₂})
    {G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hGp : Prime G)
    (hGspan : idealOf k (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') = Ideal.span {G}) :
    addSubst (k := k) G = rename Sum.inl G + rename Sum.inr G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hself := hrel.translate_delta_self_eq hs halg hrel' hss' halg' hFp
    hFspan hG₂0 hG₂span hGp hGspan
  have hcoe : (fun j ↦ algebraMap ↥(deltaField S c₂') Ω
      (deltaVec S c₂' j)) = ![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂' := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> rfl
  have hmapmap : MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap ↥(deltaField S c₂') Ω)
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(deltaField S c₂')) G) =
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k Ω) G := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.map_map, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq]
  have hselfΩ : translate (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂' : Fin 2 → Ω)
      (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k Ω) G) =
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k Ω) G := by
    have h := congrArg (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap ↥(deltaField S c₂') Ω))
      hself
    rwa [map_translate, hmapmap, hcoe] at h
  
  have hδG : aeval (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') G = 0 := by
    have hmem : G ∈ idealOf k (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') := by
      rw [hGspan]
      exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
    exact (mem_idealOf_iff _).1 hmem
  have hf : aevalFst (k := k) (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂' : Fin 2 → Ω)
      (addSubst (k := k) G - rename Sum.inl G - rename Sum.inr G) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, map_sub, aevalFst_addSubst, aevalFst_rename_inl,
      aevalFst_rename_inr, hselfΩ, hδG, map_zero, sub_zero, sub_self]
  
  have hker : ∀ h : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k,
      aeval (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂' : Fin 2 → Ω) h = 0 →
      h ∈ Ideal.span {G} := by
    intro h hh
    rw [← hGspan]
    exact (mem_idealOf_iff _).2 hh
  have hmeml := mem_span_rename_inl_of_aevalFst_eq_zero hker hf
  
  have hswapAdd : rename Sum.swap (addSubst (k := k) G) =
      addSubst (k := k) G := by
    have hcomp : ((rename
        (Sum.swap : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2)).toRingHom.comp
        (addSubst (k := k)).toRingHom) = (addSubst (k := k)).toRingHom := by
      refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun a ↦ ?_) (fun j ↦ ?_)
      · simp [addSubst, MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
      · simp [addSubst, add_comm]
    exact congrArg (fun (F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →+* _) ↦ F G) hcomp
  have hswapl : rename Sum.swap
      (rename (Sum.inl : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) G) = rename Sum.inr G := by
    rw [rename_rename]
    congr 1
  have hswapr : rename Sum.swap
      (rename (Sum.inr : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) G) = rename Sum.inl G := by
    rw [rename_rename]
    congr 1
  have hswapD : rename Sum.swap
      (addSubst (k := k) G - rename Sum.inl G - rename Sum.inr G) =
      addSubst (k := k) G - rename Sum.inl G - rename Sum.inr G := by
    rw [map_sub, map_sub, hswapAdd, hswapl, hswapr]
    ring
  
  have hmemr : (addSubst (k := k) G - rename Sum.inl G - rename Sum.inr G) ∈
      Ideal.span {rename (Sum.inr : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) G} := by
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at hmeml ⊢
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hmeml
    refine ⟨rename Sum.swap R, ?_⟩
    have h := congrArg
      (rename (Sum.swap : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2)) hR
    rwa [map_mul, hswapl, hswapD] at h
  
  have hpl := prime_rename_inl (k := k) hGp
  have hpr := prime_rename_inr (k := k) hGp
  have hndvd : ¬ rename (Sum.inl : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) G ∣
      rename Sum.inr G := by
    intro hdvd
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hdvd
    have h := congrArg
      (aeval (Sum.elim (fun _ ↦ (0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)) X)) hu
    rw [map_mul] at h
    have h1 : aeval (Sum.elim (fun _ ↦ (0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)) X)
        (rename (Sum.inr : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) G) = G := by
      rw [aeval_rename]
      have hcompr : ((Sum.elim (fun _ ↦ (0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)) X :
          Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2 → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) ∘ Sum.inr) = X := by
        funext j
        rfl
      rw [hcompr, aeval_X_left_apply]
    have h2 : aeval (Sum.elim (fun _ ↦ (0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)) X)
        (rename (Sum.inl : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) G) = 0 := by
      rw [aeval_rename]
      have hcompl : ((Sum.elim (fun _ ↦ (0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)) X :
          Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2 → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) ∘ Sum.inl) =
          (0 : Fin 2 → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) := by
        funext j
        rfl
      rw [hcompl, MvPolynomial.aeval_zero,
        hrel.constantCoeff_delta_gen hs halg hG₂0 hG₂span hGspan, map_zero]
    rw [h1, h2, zero_mul] at h
    exact hGp.ne_zero h
  
  by_contra hne
  have hDne : addSubst (k := k) G - rename Sum.inl G - rename Sum.inr G
      ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [sub_sub, sub_eq_zero] at h0
    exact hne h0
  have hdvdl : rename (Sum.inl : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) G ∣
      (addSubst (k := k) G - rename Sum.inl G - rename Sum.inr G) :=
    Ideal.mem_span_singleton.1 hmeml
  have hdvdr : rename (Sum.inr : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) G ∣
      (addSubst (k := k) G - rename Sum.inl G - rename Sum.inr G) :=
    Ideal.mem_span_singleton.1 hmemr
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hdvdr
  have hpm : rename (Sum.inl : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) G ∣ m := by
    rcases hpl.dvd_or_dvd (hm ▸ hdvdl) with h | h
    · exact absurd h hndvd
    · exact h
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hpm
  have hDfact : addSubst (k := k) G - rename Sum.inl G - rename Sum.inr G =
      rename Sum.inr G * rename Sum.inl G * t := by
    rw [hm, ht, mul_assoc]
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, mul_zero] at hDfact
    exact hDne hDfact
  have hpos : 0 < G.totalDegree := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos G.totalDegree with h0 | h
    · exfalso
      have hC := totalDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C.1 h0
      have ha : G.coeff 0 ≠ 0 := fun h00 ↦
        hGp.ne_zero (by rw [hC, h00, map_zero])
      exact hGp.not_isUnit
        (by rw [hC]; exact (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.2 ha).map C)
    · exact h
  have htotl : (rename (Sum.inl : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) G).totalDegree =
      G.totalDegree := totalDegree_rename_of_injective Sum.inl_injective G
  have htotr : (rename (Sum.inr : Fin 2 → Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) G).totalDegree =
      G.totalDegree := totalDegree_rename_of_injective Sum.inr_injective G
  have hDdeg : (addSubst (k := k) G - rename Sum.inl G -
      rename Sum.inr G).totalDegree ≤ G.totalDegree := by
    refine le_trans (totalDegree_sub _ _) (max_le ?_ (le_of_eq htotr))
    refine le_trans (totalDegree_sub _ _) (max_le ?_ (le_of_eq htotl))
    exact totalDegree_addSubst_le G
  have hmul1 := totalDegree_mul_of_isDomain
    (mul_ne_zero hpr.ne_zero hpl.ne_zero) ht0
  have hmul2 := totalDegree_mul_of_isDomain hpr.ne_zero hpl.ne_zero
  rw [hDfact, hmul1, hmul2, htotl, htotr] at hDdeg
  omega

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.aeval_delta_gen_add
statement:
theorem JointRel.aeval_delta_gen_add [IsAlgClosed k]
    (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    (hrel' : S.JointRel c₂'')
    (hss' : s' ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂, s})
    (halg' : c₂'' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s'})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hFp : Prime F)
    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F})
    {G₂ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hG₂0 : G₂ ≠ 0)
    (hG₂span : idealOf k ![S.x₂, S.y₂] = Ideal.span {G₂})
    {G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hGp : Prime G)
    (hGspan : idealOf k (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') = Ideal.span {G})
    (u v : Fin 2 → Ω) :
    aeval (u + v) G = aeval u G + aeval v G
proof:
:= by
  have hadd := hrel.addSubst_delta_gen_eq hs halg hrel' hss' halg' hFp
    hFspan hG₂0 hG₂span hGp hGspan
  have h := congrArg (aeval (Sum.elim u v) :
    MvPolynomial (Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2) k →ₐ[k] Ω) hadd
  have hinl : ((Sum.elim u v : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2 → Ω) ∘ Sum.inl) = u := by
    funext j
    rfl
  have hinr : ((Sum.elim u v : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2 → Ω) ∘ Sum.inr) = v := by
    funext j
    rfl
  rwa [aeval_addSubst, map_add, aeval_rename, aeval_rename, hinl, hinr] at h

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.exists_coset_constants
statement:
theorem JointRel.exists_coset_constants [IsAlgClosed k]
    (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    (hrel' : S.JointRel c₂'')
    (hss' : s' ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂, s})
    (halg' : c₂'' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s'})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hFp : Prime F)
    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F})
    {G₂ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hG₂0 : G₂ ≠ 0)
    (hG₂span : idealOf k ![S.x₂, S.y₂] = Ideal.span {G₂})
    {G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hGp : Prime G)
    (hGspan : idealOf k (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') = Ideal.span {G}) :
    ∃ d₁ d₂ : k, aeval ![S.x₁, S.y₁] G = algebraMap k Ω d₁ ∧
      aeval ![S.x₂, S.y₂] G = algebraMap k Ω d₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hν := hrel.aeval_delta_gen_add hs halg hrel' hss' halg' hFp hFspan
    hG₂0 hG₂span hGp hGspan
  have hδG : aeval (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') G = 0 := by
    have hmem : G ∈ idealOf k (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') := by
      rw [hGspan]
      exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
    exact (mem_idealOf_iff _).1 hmem
  
  
  have hmemT : ∀ (T : IntermediateField k Ω) (a : Fin 2 → Ω),
      (∀ j, a j ∈ T) → aeval a G ∈ T := by
    intro T a ha
    have hcomp : (algebraMap ↥T Ω ∘ fun j ↦ (⟨a j, ha j⟩ : ↥T)) = a := by
      funext j
      rfl
    have h := aeval_algebraMap_apply Ω (fun j ↦ (⟨a j, ha j⟩ : ↥T)) G
    rw [hcomp] at h
    rw [h]
    exact (aeval (fun j ↦ (⟨a j, ha j⟩ : ↥T)) G).2
  
  have hpair : c₂' = ![c₂' 0, c₂' 1] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hinv₂ : aeval ![S.x₂, S.y₂] G = aeval c₂' G := by
    have harith : (![S.x₂, S.y₂] : Fin 2 → Ω) =
        c₂' + (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') := by
      abel
    rw [harith, hν, hδG, add_zero]
  
  have hw₂x₂ : aeval ![S.x₂, S.y₂] G ∈ racl k {S.x₂} := by
    refine hmemT _ _ ?_
    intro j
    fin_cases j
    · exact subset_racl k _ rfl
    · exact S.y₂_mem
  have hw₂x₁s : aeval ![S.x₂, S.y₂] G ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s} := by
    rw [hinv₂]
    refine hmemT _ _ ?_
    intro j
    fin_cases j
    · exact halg
    · exact racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 halg)
        hrel.snd_mem
  have hw₂x₁ : aeval ![S.x₂, S.y₂] G ∈ racl k {S.x₁} := by
    refine mem_racl_of_mem_racl_insert (a := S.x₂) (b := s) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · exact racl_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (Set.mem_insert _ _)) hw₂x₂
    · rwa [Set.pair_comm S.x₁ s] at hw₂x₁s
    · rwa [Set.pair_comm S.x₁ S.x₂] at hs
  have hins₁ : (insert S.x₁ (∅ : Set Ω)) = {S.x₁} := by simp
  have hins₂ : (insert S.x₂ (∅ : Set Ω)) = {S.x₂} := by simp
  have hw₂empty : aeval ![S.x₂, S.y₂] G ∈ racl k (∅ : Set Ω) := by
    refine mem_racl_of_mem_racl_insert (a := S.x₁) (b := S.x₂) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · rw [hins₁]
      exact hw₂x₁
    · rw [hins₂]
      exact hw₂x₂
    · rw [hins₁]
      exact S.x₂_notMem
  obtain ⟨d₂, hd₂⟩ := mem_range_algebraMap_of_isAlgebraic
    (isAlgebraic_of_mem_racl_empty hw₂empty)
  
  have hinvD : aeval ![S.x₁ + S.x₂, S.y₁ + S.y₂] G =
      aeval ![S.x₁ + c₂' 0, S.y₁ + c₂' 1] G := by
    have harith : (![S.x₁ + S.x₂, S.y₁ + S.y₂] : Fin 2 → Ω) =
        ![S.x₁ + c₂' 0, S.y₁ + c₂' 1] + (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') := by
      funext j
      fin_cases j
      · show S.x₁ + S.x₂ = S.x₁ + c₂' 0 + (S.x₂ - c₂' 0)
        ring
      · show S.y₁ + S.y₂ = S.y₁ + c₂' 1 + (S.y₂ - c₂' 1)
        ring
    rw [harith, hν, hδG, add_zero]
  have hwDsum : aeval ![S.x₁ + S.x₂, S.y₁ + S.y₂] G ∈
      racl k {S.x₁ + S.x₂} := by
    refine hmemT _ _ ?_
    intro j
    fin_cases j
    · exact subset_racl k _ rfl
    · exact S.sum_mem
  have hwDx₁s : aeval ![S.x₁ + S.x₂, S.y₁ + S.y₂] G ∈
      racl k {S.x₁, s} := by
    rw [hinvD]
    have hx₁m : S.x₁ ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s} := subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
    refine hmemT _ _ ?_
    intro j
    fin_cases j
    · exact add_mem hx₁m halg
    · refine add_mem ?_ ?_
      · exact racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hx₁m)
          S.y₁_mem
      · exact racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 halg)
          hrel.snd_mem
  have hwDx₁x₂ : aeval ![S.x₁ + S.x₂, S.y₁ + S.y₂] G ∈
      racl k {S.x₂, S.x₁} := by
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 ?_) hwDsum
    exact add_mem (subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl))
      (subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _))
  have hwDx₁ : aeval ![S.x₁ + S.x₂, S.y₁ + S.y₂] G ∈ racl k {S.x₁} := by
    refine mem_racl_of_mem_racl_insert (a := S.x₂) (b := s) hwDx₁x₂ ?_ ?_
    · rwa [Set.pair_comm S.x₁ s] at hwDx₁s
    · rwa [Set.pair_comm S.x₁ S.x₂] at hs
  have hwDempty : aeval ![S.x₁ + S.x₂, S.y₁ + S.y₂] G ∈
      racl k (∅ : Set Ω) := by
    have hinsD : (insert (S.x₁ + S.x₂) (∅ : Set Ω)) = {S.x₁ + S.x₂} := by
      simp
    refine mem_racl_of_mem_racl_insert (a := S.x₁) (b := S.x₁ + S.x₂)
      ?_ ?_ ?_
    · rw [hins₁]
      exact hwDx₁
    · rw [hinsD]
      exact hwDsum
    · rw [hins₁]
      intro hmem
      have hx₁m : S.x₁ ∈ racl k {S.x₁} := subset_racl k _ rfl
      have h1 := sub_mem hmem hx₁m
      have hcancel : S.x₁ + S.x₂ - S.x₁ = S.x₂ := by ring
      rw [hcancel] at h1
      exact S.x₂_notMem h1
  obtain ⟨dD, hdD⟩ := mem_range_algebraMap_of_isAlgebraic
    (isAlgebraic_of_mem_racl_empty hwDempty)
  
  have hsplit : aeval ![S.x₁ + S.x₂, S.y₁ + S.y₂] G =
      aeval ![S.x₁, S.y₁] G + aeval ![S.x₂, S.y₂] G := by
    have hconv : (![S.x₁ + S.x₂, S.y₁ + S.y₂] : Fin 2 → Ω) =
        ![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂] := by
      rw [Matrix.cons_add_cons, Matrix.cons_add_cons, Matrix.empty_add_empty]
    rw [hconv, hν]
  refine ⟨dD - d₂, d₂, ?_, hd₂.symm⟩
  rw [map_sub, hdD, hd₂, hsplit]
  ring

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.polynomial_aeval_fst
statement:
theorem polynomial_aeval_fst (g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (u : Ω) :
    Polynomial.aeval u (aeval ![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial k)] g) =
      aeval ![u, 0] g
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : (Polynomial.aeval u).comp
      (aeval ![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial k)] :
        MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →ₐ[k] Polynomial k) =
      aeval ![u, (0 : Ω)] := by
    refine MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun i ↦ ?_
    fin_cases i <;> simp
  exact congrArg (fun (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →ₐ[k] Ω) ↦ φ g) hcomp

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.polynomial_aeval_snd
statement:
theorem polynomial_aeval_snd (g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (v : Ω) :
    Polynomial.aeval v (aeval ![(0 : Polynomial k), Polynomial.X] g) =
      aeval ![0, v] g
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : (Polynomial.aeval v).comp
      (aeval ![(0 : Polynomial k), Polynomial.X] :
        MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →ₐ[k] Polynomial k) =
      aeval ![(0 : Ω), v] := by
    refine MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun i ↦ ?_
    fin_cases i <;> simp
  exact congrArg (fun (φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →ₐ[k] Ω) ↦ φ g) hcomp

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.aeval_delta_gen_split
statement:
theorem JointRel.aeval_delta_gen_split [IsAlgClosed k]
    (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    (hrel' : S.JointRel c₂'')
    (hss' : s' ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂, s})
    (halg' : c₂'' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s'})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hFp : Prime F)
    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F})
    {G₂ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hG₂0 : G₂ ≠ 0)
    (hG₂span : idealOf k ![S.x₂, S.y₂] = Ideal.span {G₂})
    {G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hGp : Prime G)
    (hGspan : idealOf k (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') = Ideal.span {G})
    (u v : Ω) :
    aeval ![u, v] G =
      Polynomial.aeval u (aeval ![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial k)] G) +
      Polynomial.aeval v (aeval ![(0 : Polynomial k), Polynomial.X] G)
proof:
:= by
  have htuple : (![u, v] : Fin 2 → Ω) = ![u, 0] + ![0, v] := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j
    · show u = u + 0
      ring
    · show v = 0 + v
      ring
  rw [polynomial_aeval_fst, polynomial_aeval_snd, htuple]
  exact hrel.aeval_delta_gen_add hs halg hrel' hss' halg' hFp hFspan hG₂0
    hG₂span hGp hGspan _ _

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.delta_gen_eq_split
statement:
theorem JointRel.delta_gen_eq_split [IsAlgClosed k]
    (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    (hrel' : S.JointRel c₂'')
    (hss' : s' ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂, s})
    (halg' : c₂'' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s'})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hFp : Prime F)
    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F})
    {G₂ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hG₂0 : G₂ ≠ 0)
    (hG₂span : idealOf k ![S.x₂, S.y₂] = Ideal.span {G₂})
    {G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hGp : Prime G)
    (hGspan : idealOf k (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') = Ideal.span {G}) :
    G = Polynomial.aeval (X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)
        (aeval ![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial k)] G) +
      Polynomial.aeval (X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)
        (aeval ![(0 : Polynomial k), Polynomial.X] G)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsplit := hrel.aeval_delta_gen_split hs halg hrel' hss' halg' hFp
    hFspan hG₂0 hG₂span hGp hGspan
  haveI : Infinite Ω := Infinite.of_injective (algebraMap k Ω)
    (algebraMap k Ω).injective
  apply MvPolynomial.map_injective (algebraMap k Ω)
    (algebraMap k Ω).injective
  apply MvPolynomial.funext
  intro x
  rw [MvPolynomial.eval_map, MvPolynomial.eval_map, ← MvPolynomial.aeval_def,
    ← MvPolynomial.aeval_def]
  have hx : x = ![x 0, x 1] := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> rfl
  rw [map_add]
  have h1 : aeval x (Polynomial.aeval (X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)
      (aeval ![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial k)] G)) =
      Polynomial.aeval (x 0) (aeval ![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial k)] G) := by
    rw [← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, aeval_X]
  have h2 : aeval x (Polynomial.aeval (X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)
      (aeval ![(0 : Polynomial k), Polynomial.X] G)) =
      Polynomial.aeval (x 1) (aeval ![(0 : Polynomial k), Polynomial.X] G) := by
    rw [← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, aeval_X]
  rw [h1, h2]
  have hs2 := hsplit (x 0) (x 1)
  rw [show (![x 0, x 1] : Fin 2 → Ω) = x from hx.symm] at hs2
  exact hs2

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.isAdditive_delta_gen_fst
statement:
theorem JointRel.isAdditive_delta_gen_fst [IsAlgClosed k]
    (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    (hrel' : S.JointRel c₂'')
    (hss' : s' ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂, s})
    (halg' : c₂'' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s'})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hFp : Prime F)
    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F})
    {G₂ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hG₂0 : G₂ ≠ 0)
    (hG₂span : idealOf k ![S.x₂, S.y₂] = Ideal.span {G₂})
    {G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hGp : Prime G)
    (hGspan : idealOf k (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') = Ideal.span {G}) :
    IsAdditive (aeval ![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial k)] G)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y
  apply (algebraMap k Ω).injective
  rw [map_add, ← Polynomial.aeval_algebraMap_apply_eq_algebraMap_eval,
    ← Polynomial.aeval_algebraMap_apply_eq_algebraMap_eval,
    ← Polynomial.aeval_algebraMap_apply_eq_algebraMap_eval,
    map_add, polynomial_aeval_fst, polynomial_aeval_fst, polynomial_aeval_fst]
  have htuple : (![algebraMap k Ω x + algebraMap k Ω y, 0] : Fin 2 → Ω) =
      ![algebraMap k Ω x, 0] + ![algebraMap k Ω y, 0] := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j
    · show algebraMap k Ω x + algebraMap k Ω y = _ + _
      rfl
    · show (0 : Ω) = 0 + 0
      ring
  rw [htuple]
  exact hrel.aeval_delta_gen_add hs halg hrel' hss' halg' hFp hFspan hG₂0
    hG₂span hGp hGspan _ _

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.JointRel.isAdditive_delta_gen_snd
statement:
theorem JointRel.isAdditive_delta_gen_snd [IsAlgClosed k]
    (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    (hrel' : S.JointRel c₂'')
    (hss' : s' ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂, s})
    (halg' : c₂'' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s'})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hFp : Prime F)
    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] + ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F})
    {G₂ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hG₂0 : G₂ ≠ 0)
    (hG₂span : idealOf k ![S.x₂, S.y₂] = Ideal.span {G₂})
    {G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hGp : Prime G)
    (hGspan : idealOf k (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') = Ideal.span {G}) :
    IsAdditive (aeval ![(0 : Polynomial k), Polynomial.X] G)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y
  apply (algebraMap k Ω).injective
  rw [map_add, ← Polynomial.aeval_algebraMap_apply_eq_algebraMap_eval,
    ← Polynomial.aeval_algebraMap_apply_eq_algebraMap_eval,
    ← Polynomial.aeval_algebraMap_apply_eq_algebraMap_eval,
    map_add, polynomial_aeval_snd, polynomial_aeval_snd, polynomial_aeval_snd]
  have htuple : (![(0 : Ω), algebraMap k Ω x + algebraMap k Ω y] :
      Fin 2 → Ω) = ![0, algebraMap k Ω x] + ![0, algebraMap k Ω y] := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j
    · show (0 : Ω) = 0 + 0
      ring
    · show algebraMap k Ω x + algebraMap k Ω y = _ + _
      rfl
  rw [htuple]
  exact hrel.aeval_delta_gen_add hs halg hrel' hss' halg' hFp hFspan hG₂0
    hG₂span hGp hGspan _ _

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.exists_delta_gen_data
statement:
theorem exists_delta_gen_data [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed Ω] {s s' : Ω}
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (hss' : s' ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂, s}) :
    ∃ (G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (P Q : Polynomial k),
      Prime G ∧
      G = Polynomial.aeval (X 0) P + Polynomial.aeval (X 1) Q ∧
      P.coeff 0 = 0 ∧ Q.coeff 0 = 0 ∧ P ≠ 0 ∧ Q ≠ 0 ∧
      IsAdditive P ∧ IsAdditive Q ∧
      ∃ d₁ d₂ : k,
        aeval ![S.x₁, S.y₁] G = algebraMap k Ω d₁ ∧
        aeval ![S.x₂, S.y₂] G = algebraMap k Ω d₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hbaseLe : racl k ({S.x₁, S.y₁} : Set Ω) ≤ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂} := by
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_
    rintro z (rfl | rfl)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
    · exact racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2
        (subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _))) S.y₁_mem
  have hbaseLe' : racl k ({S.x₁, S.y₁} : Set Ω) ≤
      racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂, s} := by
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_
    rintro z (rfl | rfl)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
    · exact racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2
        (subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _))) S.y₁_mem
  have hstr : Transcendental ↥S.base s := fun halg ↦
    hs (hbaseLe ((mem_racl_iff k).2 halg))
  have hstr' : Transcendental ↥S.base s' := fun halg ↦
    hss' (hbaseLe' ((mem_racl_iff k).2 halg))
  obtain ⟨c₂', hrel, halgraw⟩ := S.exists_pair_relocation hstr
  obtain ⟨c₂'', hrel', halgraw'⟩ := S.exists_pair_relocation hstr'
  have halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s} :=
    S.racl_pair_of_relocation (halgraw 0)
  have halg' : c₂'' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s'} :=
    S.racl_pair_of_relocation (halgraw' 0)
  
  obtain ⟨F, hFp, hFspan⟩ := S.exists_prime_span_sum
  have hx₂tr : Transcendental k S.x₂ := fun h ↦
    S.x₂_notMem (racl_mono (Set.empty_subset _)
      ((mem_racl_iff k).2 (h.tower_top _)))
  obtain ⟨G₂, hG₂p, hG₂span⟩ := exists_prime_span_idealOf k hx₂tr S.y₂_mem
  obtain ⟨G, hGp, hGspan₀⟩ := hrel.exists_prime_span_delta hs halg hFp hFspan
  have htuple : (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂' : Fin 2 → Ω) =
      ![S.x₂ - c₂' 0, S.y₂ - c₂' 1] := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> rfl
  have hGspan : idealOf k (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') = Ideal.span {G} := by
    rw [htuple, hGspan₀]
  
  obtain ⟨d₁, d₂, hd₁, hd₂⟩ := hrel.exists_coset_constants hs halg hrel'
    hss' halg' hFp hFspan hG₂p.ne_zero hG₂span hGp hGspan
  have hsplit := hrel.aeval_delta_gen_split hs halg hrel' hss' halg' hFp
    hFspan hG₂p.ne_zero hG₂span hGp hGspan
  have hsplitpoly := hrel.delta_gen_eq_split hs halg hrel' hss' halg' hFp
    hFspan hG₂p.ne_zero hG₂span hGp hGspan
  have hpadd := hrel.isAdditive_delta_gen_fst hs halg hrel' hss' halg' hFp
    hFspan hG₂p.ne_zero hG₂span hGp hGspan
  have hqadd := hrel.isAdditive_delta_gen_snd hs halg hrel' hss' halg' hFp
    hFspan hG₂p.ne_zero hG₂span hGp hGspan
  
  have h00 : (![(0 : Ω), 0] : Fin 2 → Ω) = 0 := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> rfl
  have hG00 : aeval (![(0 : Ω), 0] : Fin 2 → Ω) G = 0 := by
    rw [h00, MvPolynomial.aeval_zero,
      hrel.constantCoeff_delta_gen hs halg hG₂p.ne_zero hG₂span hGspan,
      map_zero]
  have hcoeff0 : ∀ r : Polynomial k,
      Polynomial.aeval (0 : Ω) r = 0 → r.coeff 0 = 0 := by
    intro r hr
    have h := Polynomial.aeval_algebraMap_apply_eq_algebraMap_eval
      (0 : k) r (A := Ω)
    rw [map_zero, hr] at h
    have h2 : Polynomial.eval 0 r = 0 :=
      (algebraMap k Ω).injective (by rw [map_zero, ← h])
    rwa [Polynomial.coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero]
  have hP0 : (aeval ![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial k)] G).coeff 0 = 0 := by
    refine hcoeff0 _ ?_
    rw [polynomial_aeval_fst]
    have ht : (![(0 : Ω), 0] : Fin 2 → Ω) = ![0, 0] := rfl
    rw [← ht]
    exact hG00
  have hQ0 : (aeval ![(0 : Polynomial k), Polynomial.X] G).coeff 0 = 0 := by
    refine hcoeff0 _ ?_
    rw [polynomial_aeval_snd]
    exact hG00
  
  have hδG : aeval (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') G = 0 := by
    have hmem : G ∈ idealOf k (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') := by
      rw [hGspan]
      exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
    exact (mem_idealOf_iff _).1 hmem
  have hδsplit : Polynomial.aeval (S.x₂ - c₂' 0)
      (aeval ![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial k)] G) +
      Polynomial.aeval (S.y₂ - c₂' 1)
        (aeval ![(0 : Polynomial k), Polynomial.X] G) = 0 := by
    rw [← hsplit (S.x₂ - c₂' 0) (S.y₂ - c₂' 1), ← htuple]
    exact hδG
  haveI : Infinite Ω := Infinite.of_injective (algebraMap k Ω)
    (algebraMap k Ω).injective
  have hG0_of : aeval ![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial k)] G = 0 →
      aeval ![(0 : Polynomial k), Polynomial.X] G = 0 → False := by
    intro hp0 hq0
    refine hGp.ne_zero ?_
    have hmapG : MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k Ω) G = 0 := by
      apply MvPolynomial.funext
      intro x
      have hx : x = ![x 0, x 1] := by
        funext j
        fin_cases j <;> rfl
      rw [MvPolynomial.eval_map, ← MvPolynomial.aeval_def, map_zero, hx,
        hsplit (x 0) (x 1), hp0, hq0, map_zero, map_zero, add_zero]
    exact MvPolynomial.map_injective _ (algebraMap k Ω).injective
      (by rw [hmapG, map_zero])
  have hq0 : aeval ![(0 : Polynomial k), Polynomial.X] G ≠ 0 := by
    intro hq
    rcases eq_or_ne (aeval ![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial k)] G) 0 with
      hp | hp
    · exact hG0_of hp hq
    · have hroot : Polynomial.aeval (S.x₂ - c₂' 0)
          (aeval ![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial k)] G) = 0 := by
        have h := hδsplit
        rwa [hq, map_zero, add_zero] at h
      exact delta_fst_transcendental hs halg ⟨_, hp, hroot⟩
  have hp0 : aeval ![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial k)] G ≠ 0 := by
    intro hp
    have hroot : Polynomial.aeval (S.y₂ - c₂' 1)
        (aeval ![(0 : Polynomial k), Polynomial.X] G) = 0 := by
      have h := hδsplit
      rwa [hp, map_zero, zero_add] at h
    exact hrel.delta_snd_transcendental hs halg ⟨_, hq0, hroot⟩
  exact ⟨G, aeval ![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial k)] G,
    aeval ![(0 : Polynomial k), Polynomial.X] G, hGp, hsplitpoly, hP0, hQ0,
    hp0, hq0, hpadd, hqadd, d₁, d₂, hd₁, hd₂⟩

name: AclGeom.AddCorrSetup.exists_coset_equations
statement:
theorem exists_coset_equations [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed Ω] {s s' : Ω}
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (hss' : s' ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂, s}) :
    ∃ P Q : Polynomial k, IsAdditive P ∧ IsAdditive Q ∧ P ≠ 0 ∧ Q ≠ 0 ∧
      ∃ d₁ d₂ : k,
        Polynomial.aeval S.y₁ Q =
          Polynomial.aeval S.x₁ P + algebraMap k Ω d₁ ∧
        Polynomial.aeval S.y₂ Q =
          Polynomial.aeval S.x₂ P + algebraMap k Ω d₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hbaseLe : racl k ({S.x₁, S.y₁} : Set Ω) ≤ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂} := by
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_
    rintro z (rfl | rfl)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
    · exact racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2
        (subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _))) S.y₁_mem
  have hbaseLe' : racl k ({S.x₁, S.y₁} : Set Ω) ≤
      racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂, s} := by
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_
    rintro z (rfl | rfl)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
    · exact racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2
        (subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _))) S.y₁_mem
  have hstr : Transcendental ↥S.base s := fun halg ↦
    hs (hbaseLe ((mem_racl_iff k).2 halg))
  have hstr' : Transcendental ↥S.base s' := fun halg ↦
    hss' (hbaseLe' ((mem_racl_iff k).2 halg))
  obtain ⟨c₂', hrel, halgraw⟩ := S.exists_pair_relocation hstr
  obtain ⟨c₂'', hrel', halgraw'⟩ := S.exists_pair_relocation hstr'
  have halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s} :=
    S.racl_pair_of_relocation (halgraw 0)
  have halg' : c₂'' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s'} :=
    S.racl_pair_of_relocation (halgraw' 0)
  
  obtain ⟨F, hFp, hFspan⟩ := S.exists_prime_span_sum
  have hx₂tr : Transcendental k S.x₂ := fun h ↦
    S.x₂_notMem (racl_mono (Set.empty_subset _)
      ((mem_racl_iff k).2 (h.tower_top _)))
  obtain ⟨G₂, hG₂p, hG₂span⟩ := exists_prime_span_idealOf k hx₂tr S.y₂_mem
  obtain ⟨G, hGp, hGspan₀⟩ := hrel.exists_prime_span_delta hs halg hFp hFspan
  have htuple : (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂' : Fin 2 → Ω) =
      ![S.x₂ - c₂' 0, S.y₂ - c₂' 1] := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> rfl
  have hGspan : idealOf k (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') = Ideal.span {G} := by
    rw [htuple, hGspan₀]
  
  obtain ⟨d₁, d₂, hd₁, hd₂⟩ := hrel.exists_coset_constants hs halg hrel'
    hss' halg' hFp hFspan hG₂p.ne_zero hG₂span hGp hGspan
  have hsplit := hrel.aeval_delta_gen_split hs halg hrel' hss' halg' hFp
    hFspan hG₂p.ne_zero hG₂span hGp hGspan
  have hpadd := hrel.isAdditive_delta_gen_fst hs halg hrel' hss' halg' hFp
    hFspan hG₂p.ne_zero hG₂span hGp hGspan
  have hqadd := hrel.isAdditive_delta_gen_snd hs halg hrel' hss' halg' hFp
    hFspan hG₂p.ne_zero hG₂span hGp hGspan
  
  have hδG : aeval (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') G = 0 := by
    have hmem : G ∈ idealOf k (![S.x₂, S.y₂] - c₂') := by
      rw [hGspan]
      exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
    exact (mem_idealOf_iff _).1 hmem
  have hδsplit : Polynomial.aeval (S.x₂ - c₂' 0)
      (aeval ![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial k)] G) +
      Polynomial.aeval (S.y₂ - c₂' 1)
        (aeval ![(0 : Polynomial k), Polynomial.X] G) = 0 := by
    rw [← hsplit (S.x₂ - c₂' 0) (S.y₂ - c₂' 1), ← htuple]
    exact hδG
  haveI : Infinite Ω := Infinite.of_injective (algebraMap k Ω)
    (algebraMap k Ω).injective
  have hG0_of : aeval ![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial k)] G = 0 →
      aeval ![(0 : Polynomial k), Polynomial.X] G = 0 → False := by
    intro hp0 hq0
    refine hGp.ne_zero ?_
    have hmapG : MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k Ω) G = 0 := by
      apply MvPolynomial.funext
      intro x
      have hx : x = ![x 0, x 1] := by
        funext j
        fin_cases j <;> rfl
      rw [MvPolynomial.eval_map, ← MvPolynomial.aeval_def, map_zero, hx,
        hsplit (x 0) (x 1), hp0, hq0, map_zero, map_zero, add_zero]
    exact MvPolynomial.map_injective _ (algebraMap k Ω).injective
      (by rw [hmapG, map_zero])
  have hq0 : aeval ![(0 : Polynomial k), Polynomial.X] G ≠ 0 := by
    intro hq
    rcases eq_or_ne (aeval ![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial k)] G) 0 with
      hp | hp
    · exact hG0_of hp hq
    · have hroot : Polynomial.aeval (S.x₂ - c₂' 0)
          (aeval ![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial k)] G) = 0 := by
        have h := hδsplit
        rwa [hq, map_zero, add_zero] at h
      exact delta_fst_transcendental hs halg ⟨_, hp, hroot⟩
  have hp0 : aeval ![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial k)] G ≠ 0 := by
    intro hp
    have hroot : Polynomial.aeval (S.y₂ - c₂' 1)
        (aeval ![(0 : Polynomial k), Polynomial.X] G) = 0 := by
      have h := hδsplit
      rwa [hp, map_zero, zero_add] at h
    exact hrel.delta_snd_transcendental hs halg ⟨_, hq0, hroot⟩
  
  refine ⟨-(aeval ![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial k)] G),
    aeval ![(0 : Polynomial k), Polynomial.X] G, ?_, hqadd,
    neg_ne_zero.2 hp0, hq0, d₁, d₂, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_neg]
    rw [hpadd x y]
    ring
  · have h₁ : Polynomial.aeval S.x₁
        (aeval ![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial k)] G) +
        Polynomial.aeval S.y₁
          (aeval ![(0 : Polynomial k), Polynomial.X] G) =
        algebraMap k Ω d₁ := by
      rw [← hsplit S.x₁ S.y₁]
      exact hd₁
    rw [map_neg]
    linear_combination h₁
  · have h₂ : Polynomial.aeval S.x₂
        (aeval ![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial k)] G) +
        Polynomial.aeval S.y₂
          (aeval ![(0 : Polynomial k), Polynomial.X] G) =
        algebraMap k Ω d₂ := by
      rw [← hsplit S.x₂ S.y₂]
      exact hd₂
    rw [map_neg]
    linear_combination h₂

name: AclGeom.injective_productLeftAlgHom
statement:
private theorem injective_productLeftAlgHom {A K B Ω : Type*} [CommRing A] [Field K] [CommRing B]
    [Field Ω] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K] [Algebra A B] [Algebra K Ω] [Algebra A Ω]
    [IsScalarTower A K Ω] (g : B →ₐ[A] Ω) (hg : Function.Injective g) :
    Function.Injective (Algebra.TensorProduct.productLeftAlgHom (Algebra.ofId K Ω) g)
proof:
:= by
  have : Module.Flat A K := IsLocalization.flat K (nonZeroDivisors A)
  have h₁ := Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap (M := K) g.toLinearMap hg
  have h₂ := (IsLocalization.algebraLid (nonZeroDivisors A) K Ω).injective
  
  have heq (t : K ⊗[A] B) : Algebra.TensorProduct.productLeftAlgHom (Algebra.ofId K Ω) g t =
      IsLocalization.algebraLid (nonZeroDivisors A) K Ω (g.toLinearMap.lTensor K t) := by
    induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul a b =>
      change algebraMap K Ω a * g b = a • g b
      rw [Algebra.smul_def]
    | add s t hs ht => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hs, ht]
  intro s t hst
  exact h₁ (h₂ ((heq s).symm.trans (hst.trans (heq t))))

name: AclGeom.exists_pairGenericFiber_algEquiv
statement:
theorem exists_pairGenericFiber_algEquiv [Finite β] :
    letI : Algebra 𝔄 𝔅
proof:
:= (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono (s := Set.range v)
      (t := Set.range (Sum.elim v w)) (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun i ↦ ⟨Sum.inl i, rfl⟩))).toAlgebra
    ∃ e : 𝔎 ⊗[𝔄] 𝔅 ≃ₐ[𝔎] Algebra.adjoin 𝔎 (Set.range w),
      (∀ (a : 𝔎) (b : 𝔅), (e (a ⊗ₜ b) : Ω) = (a : Ω) * (b : Ω)) ∧
      (FiniteDimensional 𝔎 (𝔎 ⊗[𝔄] 𝔅) ↔ ∀ j, w j ∈ racl k (Set.range v)) ∧
      (IsFinite (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap 𝔎 (𝔎 ⊗[𝔄] 𝔅)))) ↔
        ∀ j, w j ∈ racl k (Set.range v)) := by
  
  let _ : Algebra 𝔄 𝔅 := (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono (s := Set.range v)
    (t := Set.range (Sum.elim v w)) (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun i ↦ ⟨Sum.inl i, rfl⟩))).toAlgebra
  let g : 𝔅 →ₐ[𝔄] Ω := { (Subalgebra.val 𝔅).toRingHom with commutes' := fun _ ↦ rfl }
  let φ := Algebra.TensorProduct.productLeftAlgHom (Algebra.ofId 𝔎 Ω) g
  have hB : 𝔅 ≤ (Algebra.adjoin 𝔎 (Set.range w)).restrictScalars k := by
    refine Algebra.adjoin_le (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun i ↦ ?_)
    rcases i with a | j
    · exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem (Algebra.adjoin 𝔎 (Set.range w))
        (⟨v a, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨a, rfl⟩⟩ : 𝔎)
    · exact (Algebra.subset_adjoin (R := 𝔎) (s := Set.range w) ⟨j, rfl⟩ :
        w j ∈ Algebra.adjoin 𝔎 (Set.range w))
  have hrange : φ.range = Algebra.adjoin 𝔎 (Set.range w) := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
      induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
      | tmul a b =>
        change (a : Ω) * (b : Ω) ∈ Algebra.adjoin 𝔎 (Set.range w)
        exact Subalgebra.mul_mem _ (Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ a) (hB b.2)
      | add s t hs ht => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hs ht
    · refine Algebra.adjoin_le (Set.range_subset_iff.2 fun j ↦
        ⟨1 ⊗ₜ ⟨w j, Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨Sum.inr j, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩)
      change (1 : Ω) * w j = w j
      exact one_mul _
  let e := (AlgEquiv.ofInjective φ (injective_productLeftAlgHom g Subtype.val_injective)).trans
    (Subalgebra.equivOfEq _ _ hrange)
  have hfd : FiniteDimensional 𝔎 (Algebra.adjoin 𝔎 (Set.range w)) ↔
      ∀ j, w j ∈ racl k (Set.range v) := by
    constructor
    · intro _ j
      exact (mem_racl_iff k).2 ((isAlgebraic_algHom_iff (Algebra.adjoin 𝔎 (Set.range w)).val
        Subtype.val_injective).2 (IsAlgebraic.of_finite 𝔎
          (⟨w j, Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨j, rfl⟩⟩ : Algebra.adjoin 𝔎 (Set.range w))))
    · intro h
      exact Algebra.finite_adjoin_of_finite_of_isIntegral (Set.finite_range w)
        (Set.forall_mem_range.2 fun j ↦ ((mem_racl_iff k).1 (h j)).isIntegral)
  have hT : FiniteDimensional 𝔎 (𝔎 ⊗[𝔄] 𝔅) ↔
      FiniteDimensional 𝔎 (Algebra.adjoin 𝔎 (Set.range w)) :=
    ⟨fun _ ↦ e.toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional, fun _ ↦ e.symm.toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional⟩
  refine ⟨e, fun _ _ ↦ rfl, hT.trans hfd, ?_⟩
  rw [IsFinite.SpecMap_iff, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom, RingHom.finite_algebraMap]
  exact hT.trans hfd

name: AclGeom.CurvePointsPlaces.existsUnique_placeModelMap
statement:
theorem existsUnique_placeModelMap
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left] [IsProper X.hom]
    (P : Place k X.left.functionField) :
    ∃! m : Spec (.of P.val) ⟶ X.left,
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom P.val.subtype) ≫ m =
        X.left.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X.left)
proof:
:= by
  let j := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom P.val.subtype)
  let b : k →+* P.val := (algebraMap k X.left.functionField).codRestrict
    P.val (fun c ↦ P.algebraMap_mem c)
  have hD : IsDomain P.val := inferInstance
  have hV : ValuationRing P.val := inferInstance
  have hFrac : IsFractionRing P.val X.left.functionField := inferInstance
  have hb : X.left.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X.left) ≫ X.hom =
      j ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom b) := by
    refine (Over.w (SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter X)).trans ?_
    exact Spec.map_comp (CommRingCat.ofHom b) (CommRingCat.ofHom P.val.subtype)
  let sq : ValuativeCommSq X.hom :=
    { R := P.val
      domain := hD
      valuationRing := hV
      K := X.left.functionField
      isFractionRing := hFrac
      i₁ := X.left.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X.left)
      i₂ := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom b)
      commSq := ⟨hb⟩ }
  have hproper : IsProper X.hom := inferInstance
  rw [IsProper.eq_valuativeCriterion] at hproper
  obtain ⟨m, hm, _⟩ := (hproper.1.1.1.existence sq).exists_lift
  have hgen : j ≫ m = X.left.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X.left) := hm
  have : X.left.IsSeparated := by
    constructor
    rw [← Limits.terminal.comp_from X.hom]
    infer_instance
  have : IsDominant j := by
    rw [isDominant_iff]
    change DenseRange (PrimeSpectrum.comap P.val.subtype)
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.denseRange_comap_iff_ker_le_nilRadical]
    intro z hz
    have hz0 : z = 0 := Subtype.ext hz
    simpa only [hz0] using Ideal.zero_mem (nilradical P.val)
  refine ⟨m, hgen, ?_⟩
  intro q hq
  exact ext_of_isDominant j (hq.trans hgen.symm)

name: AclGeom.CurvePointsPlaces.placeModelMap_generic
statement:
theorem placeModelMap_generic
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left] [IsProper X.hom]
    (P : Place k X.left.functionField) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom P.val.subtype) ≫ placeModelMap X P =
      X.left.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X.left)
proof:
:=
  (existsUnique_placeModelMap X P).choose_spec.1

name: AclGeom.NormalTranslation.exists_finite_isogeny
statement:
theorem exists_finite_isogeny
    (G : AlgebraicGroup k) (N : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (i : N.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom G) [IsMonHom.Normal i.hom.hom]
    [IsClosedImmersion i.hom.hom.left]
    (hdimN : topologicalKrullDim N.toAlgebraicGroup.carrier = 1)
    (f : G.Hom (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k))
    [IsFinite f.hom.hom.left] [Surjective f.hom.hom.left]
    (hinj : Function.Injective
      (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X ↦ q ≫ f.hom.hom)) :
    ∃ β : N.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1),
      IsFinite β.hom.hom.left ∧ Surjective β.hom.hom.left ∧
      Function.Injective (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ N.toGroupScheme.X ↦
        q ≫ β.hom.hom) ∧
      β.hom.hom ≫ AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k = i.hom.hom ≫ f.hom.hom
proof:
:= by
  let NX := N.toGroupScheme.X
  let AX := (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k).toGroupScheme.X
  let L := (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X
  let v : NX ⟶ AX := i.hom.hom ≫ f.hom.hom
  let βraw : NX ⟶ L := v ≫ AdditiveTranslation.shift k
  have hrange := image_eq_translations G N i hdimN f hinj
  have hfactor : βraw ≫ AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k = v := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    have : LocallyOfFiniteType ((βraw ≫ AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k).left ≫ AX.hom) := by
      rw [Over.w]
      infer_instance
    refine AlgebraicGeometry.ext_of_apply_eq AX.hom Set.univ isClosed_univ.isLocallyClosed
      dense_univ ?_ ((Over.w (βraw ≫ AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k)).trans (Over.w v).symm)
    intro x _ _
    have hx : v.left x ∈ Set.range (AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k).left := by
      rw [← hrange]
      exact Set.mem_range_self x
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hx
    change (AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k).left
      ((AdditiveTranslation.shift k).left (v.left x)) = v.left x
    rw [← hz]
    have he := congrArg (fun q : L ⟶ L ↦ q.left z)
      (AdditiveTranslation.inclusion_comp_shift k)
    exact congrArg (AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k).left he
  have : IsMonHom βraw := by
    constructor
    · apply (cancel_mono (AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k)).mp
      simp only [Category.assoc, hfactor, IsMonHom.one_hom]
    · apply (cancel_mono (AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k)).mp
      calc
        (μ[NX] ≫ βraw) ≫ AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k = μ[NX] ≫ v := by
          rw [Category.assoc, hfactor]
        _ = (v ⊗ₘ v) ≫ μ[AX] := IsMonHom.mul_hom _
        _ = ((βraw ≫ AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k) ⊗ₘ
            (βraw ≫ AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k)) ≫ μ[AX] := by rw [hfactor]
        _ = (βraw ⊗ₘ βraw) ≫ (AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k ⊗ₘ
            AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k) ≫ μ[AX] := by
          rw [← MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_comp_tensorHom, Category.assoc]
        _ = ((βraw ⊗ₘ βraw) ≫ μ[L]) ≫ AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k := by
          rw [Category.assoc, IsMonHom.mul_hom]
  let β : N.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1) := Grp.homMk βraw
  have : IsClosedImmersion (AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k).left :=
    translation_isClosedImmersion
  have : IsFinite (βraw.left ≫ (AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k).left) := by
    have he : βraw.left ≫ (AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k).left = v.left :=
      congrArg (fun q : NX ⟶ AX ↦ q.left) hfactor
    rw [he]
    change IsFinite (i.hom.hom.left ≫ f.hom.hom.left)
    infer_instance
  have hfinite : IsFinite βraw.left := IsFinite.of_comp _ (AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k).left
  have hsurj : Surjective βraw.left := by
    constructor
    intro z
    have hz : (AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k).left z ∈ Set.range v.left := by
      rw [hrange]
      exact Set.mem_range_self z
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hz
    refine ⟨x, (AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k).left.injective ?_⟩
    exact (congrArg (fun q : NX ⟶ AX ↦ q.left x) hfactor).trans hx
  have hβinj : Function.Injective
      (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ NX ↦ q ≫ βraw) := by
    intro q r hqr
    change q ≫ βraw = r ≫ βraw at hqr
    have he : q ≫ v = r ≫ v := by
      calc
        _ = (q ≫ βraw) ≫ AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k := by rw [Category.assoc, hfactor]
        _ = (r ≫ βraw) ≫ AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k := by rw [hqr]
        _ = _ := by rw [Category.assoc, hfactor]
    apply (cancel_mono i.hom.hom).mp
    apply hinj
    exact (Category.assoc q i.hom.hom f.hom.hom).trans
      (he.trans (Category.assoc r i.hom.hom f.hom.hom).symm)
  exact ⟨β, hfinite, hsurj, hβinj, hfactor⟩

name: AclGeom.AdditiveRigidity.normal_additiveGroup_conj
statement:
theorem normal_additiveGroup_conj
    (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (i : (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).Hom G.toAlgebraicGroup)
    [IsMonHom.Normal i.hom.hom] :
    ∃ χ : G.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom (multiplicativeGroup k),
      G.toGroupScheme.X ◁ i.hom.hom ≫ conj G.toGroupScheme.X =
        lift (fst G.toGroupScheme.X (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X ≫
          χ.hom.hom) (snd G.toGroupScheme.X
            (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X) ≫
          scalarMul k ≫ i.hom.hom
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let GX := G.toGroupScheme.X
  let N := (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X
  let i₀ : N ⟶ GX := i.hom.hom
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := IsMonHom.Normal.exists_comp_eq_conj i₀
  let c (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) : N ⟶ N :=
    lift (toUnit N ≫ q) (𝟙 N) ≫ ψ
  have hauto (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) :
      ∃ a : kˣ, c q = scale k (a : k) := by
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := NormalConjugation.exists_groupIso_conjugation_lift i₀ ψ hψ q
    simpa only [he] using groupIso_eq_scale k e
  let a (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) : kˣ := (hauto q).choose
  have ha (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) : c q = scale k (a q : k) :=
    (hauto q).choose_spec
  have hc₁ : c 1 = 𝟙 N := by
    apply (cancel_mono i₀).mp
    simp [c, hψ, lift_whiskerLeft_assoc]
  have hcomp (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX)
      (p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ N) : p ≫ c q = lift q p ≫ ψ := by
    simp only [c, comp_lift_assoc, Category.comp_id]
    simp only [← Category.assoc, comp_toUnit, toUnit_unit, Category.id_comp]
  have hc (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (p : T ⟶ N) :
      (p ≫ c q) ≫ i₀ = (toUnit T ≫ q) * (p ≫ i₀) * (toUnit T ≫ q)⁻¹ := by
    simp only [c, Category.assoc, hψ, comp_lift_assoc,
      Category.comp_id, lift_whiskerLeft_assoc, lift_conj_eq_mul_mul_inv]
    simp only [← Category.assoc, comp_toUnit]
  have hcmul (q r : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) : c (q * r) = c r ≫ c q := by
    apply (cancel_mono i₀).mp
    have hleft := hc (q * r) (𝟙 N)
    have hright := hc q (c r)
    have hr := hc r (𝟙 N)
    simp only [Category.id_comp] at hleft hr
    rw [hleft, hright, hr, comp_mul, _root_.mul_inv_rev]
    simp only [_root_.mul_assoc]
  let P (x : k) : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ N :=
    (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k x
  have hPinj : Function.Injective P := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply AffineSchemeAction.linePoint_injective k
    exact (cancel_epi (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom).mp hxy
  have hPscale (x b : k) : P x ≫ scale k b = P (b * x) := by
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
      (congrArg (fun f ↦ (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ f) (linePoint_comp_scale k b x))
  have ha₁ : a 1 = 1 := by
    apply Units.ext
    apply hPinj
    have hh := congrArg (fun f : N ⟶ N ↦ P 1 ≫ f) (ha 1).symm
    rw [hc₁, Category.comp_id, hPscale, _root_.mul_one] at hh
    exact hh
  have hamul (q r : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) : a (q * r) = a q * a r := by
    apply Units.ext
    apply hPinj
    have hh := congrArg (fun f : N ⟶ N ↦ P 1 ≫ f) (hcmul q r)
    rw [ha, ha, ha, ← Category.assoc, hPscale, hPscale, hPscale,
      _root_.mul_one, _root_.mul_one] at hh
    exact hh
  let O : GX ⟶ N := lift (𝟙 GX) (toUnit GX ≫ P 1) ≫ ψ
  have hOcomp (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) : q ≫ O = P 1 ≫ c q := by
    rw [hcomp]
    simp only [O, comp_lift_assoc, Category.comp_id]
    simp only [← Category.assoc, comp_toUnit, toUnit_unit, Category.id_comp]
  obtain ⟨χ, hχ⟩ := exists_multiplicative_lift GX O (fun q ↦
    ⟨a q, by rw [hOcomp, ha, hPscale, _root_.mul_one]⟩)
  let E := multiplicativeGroup.pointsMulEquiv k
  have hχpoint (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) : q ≫ χ = E.symm (a q) := by
    let b := E (q ≫ χ)
    have hb : q ≫ χ = (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ unitPoint k b := by
      rw [unitPoint_eq_points]
      exact (E.symm_apply_apply (q ≫ χ)).symm
    have hvalue := congrArg (fun f : GX ⟶ N ↦ q ≫ f) hχ
    rw [← Category.assoc, hb, Category.assoc, unitPoint_comp_multiplicativeValue,
      hOcomp, ha, hPscale, _root_.mul_one] at hvalue
    have hba : b = a q := Units.ext (hPinj hvalue)
    rw [hb, unitPoint_eq_points, hba]
  have hχone : (1 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) ≫ χ = 1 := by
    rw [hχpoint, ha₁, map_one]
  have hχmul (q r : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) :
      (q * r) ≫ χ = (q ≫ χ) * (r ≫ χ) := by
    rw [hχpoint, hχpoint, hχpoint, hamul, map_mul]
  have : IsIntegral (GX ⊗ GX).left := isIntegral_pullback_of_isAlgClosed GX.hom GX.hom
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType (GX ⊗ GX).hom := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (Limits.pullback.fst GX.hom GX.hom ≫ GX.hom)
    infer_instance
  have : IsMonHom χ := by
    constructor
    · simpa only [one_eq_one] using hχone
    · have heq : μ[GX] ≫ χ = (χ ⊗ₘ χ) ≫ μ[(multiplicativeGroup k).toGroupScheme.X] := by
        apply over_hom_ext_of_points
        intro p
        have hp : lift (p ≫ fst GX GX) (p ≫ snd GX GX) = p := by simp
        have hh := hχmul (p ≫ fst GX GX) (p ≫ snd GX GX)
        simp only [Hom.mul_def] at hh
        rw [← lift_map_assoc (p ≫ fst GX GX) (p ≫ snd GX GX) χ χ, hp] at hh
        simpa only [Category.assoc] using hh
      simpa only [tensorHom_def, Category.assoc] using heq
  let χG : G.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom (multiplicativeGroup k) := Grp.homMk χ
  have : IsIntegral N.left := by
    change IsIntegral (Spec (.of (AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1)))
    infer_instance
  have : IsIntegral (GX ⊗ N).left := isIntegral_pullback_of_isAlgClosed GX.hom N.hom
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType (GX ⊗ N).hom := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (Limits.pullback.fst GX.hom N.hom ≫ GX.hom)
    infer_instance
  have hψeq : ψ = lift (fst GX N ≫ χ) (snd GX N) ≫ scalarMul k := by
    apply over_hom_ext_of_points
    intro p
    let qg := p ≫ fst GX N
    let qn := p ≫ snd GX N
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := AffineSchemeAction.exists_linePoint k ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).inv ≫ qn)
    have hqn : qn = P x := by
      change qn = (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k x
      rw [hx, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
    have hp : lift qg qn = p := by simp [qg, qn]
    calc
      p ≫ ψ = qn ≫ c qg := by rw [hcomp, hp]
      _ = P ((a qg : k) * x) := by rw [ha, hqn, hPscale]
      _ = lift (E.symm (a qg)) qn ≫ scalarMul k := by
        rw [hqn, ← unitPoint_eq_points]
        change (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k _ =
          lift ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ unitPoint k (a qg))
            ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k x) ≫ scalarMul k
        rw [← comp_lift_assoc, unitPoint_linePoint_scalarMul]
      _ = _ := by rw [← hχpoint]; simp [qg, qn, comp_lift_assoc]
  refine ⟨χG, ?_⟩
  change GX ◁ i₀ ≫ conj GX = lift (fst GX N ≫ χ) (snd GX N) ≫ scalarMul k ≫ i₀
  rw [← hψ, hψeq, Category.assoc]

name: AclGeom.RationalGroupChunk.reindex_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem reindex_mul {W : Type*} (D : RationalGroupChunk W)
    (e : V ≃ W) (a b : V) :
    (D.reindex e).mul a b = e.symm (D.mul (e a) (e b))
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.RationalGroupChunk.reindex_inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem reindex_inv {W : Type*} (D : RationalGroupChunk W)
    (e : V ≃ W) (a : V) :
    (D.reindex e).inv a = e.symm (D.inv (e a))
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.RationalGroupChunk.leftUnit_mul
statement: theorem leftUnit_mul (a b : V) : C.mul (C.leftUnit a) b = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftUnit, C.mul_assoc]
  exact C.inv_mul_mul a b

name: AclGeom.RationalGroupChunk.mul_rightUnit
statement: theorem mul_rightUnit (a b : V) : C.mul b (C.rightUnit a) = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [rightUnit, ← C.mul_assoc]
  exact C.mul_mul_inv a b

name: AclGeom.RationalGroupChunk.leftUnit_eq_rightUnit
statement: theorem leftUnit_eq_rightUnit (a b : V) : C.leftUnit a = C.rightUnit b
proof:
:= by
  calc
    C.leftUnit a = C.mul (C.leftUnit a) (C.rightUnit b) :=
      (C.mul_rightUnit b (C.leftUnit a)).symm
    _ = C.rightUnit b := C.leftUnit_mul a (C.rightUnit b)

name: AclGeom.RationalGroupChunk.leftUnit_eq_leftUnit
statement: theorem leftUnit_eq_leftUnit (a b : V) : C.leftUnit a = C.leftUnit b
proof:
:=
  (C.leftUnit_eq_rightUnit a b).trans (C.leftUnit_eq_rightUnit b b).symm

name: AclGeom.RationalGroupChunk.rightUnit_eq_rightUnit
statement: theorem rightUnit_eq_rightUnit (a b : V) : C.rightUnit a = C.rightUnit b
proof:
:=
  (C.leftUnit_eq_rightUnit a a).symm.trans (C.leftUnit_eq_rightUnit a b)

name: AclGeom.TranslationGroupChunk.reindex_translation
statement:
@[simp] theorem reindex_translation
    (C : TranslationGroupChunk k F W) (e : V ≃ W) (a : V) :
    (C.reindex e).translation a = C.translation (e a)
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.TranslationGroupChunk.translationHom_injective
statement: theorem translationHom_injective : Function.Injective (translationHom C)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h ↦ C.translation_injective h

name: AclGeom.TranslationGroupChunk.translation_eq_iff
statement: theorem translation_eq_iff {a b : V} : C.translation a = C.translation b ↔ a = b
proof:
:=
  C.translation_injective.eq_iff

name: AclGeom.finite_tensor_component
statement:
private theorem finite_tensor_component
    {E Ω : Type*} [Field E] [Field Ω] [Algebra E Ω]
    (F G : IntermediateField E Ω) [FiniteDimensional E F] [FiniteDimensional E G] :
    let φ
proof:
:= Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap F.val G.val
    RingHom.ker φ ∈ (⊥ : Ideal (F ⊗[E] G)).minimalPrimes ∧
      Nonempty (((F ⊗[E] G) ⧸ RingHom.ker φ) ≃ₐ[E] ↥(F ⊔ G)) := by
  let φ := Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap F.val G.val
  let : IsArtinianRing (F ⊗[E] G) := IsArtinianRing.of_finite E _
  have : (RingHom.ker φ).IsPrime := RingHom.ker_isPrime φ
  refine ⟨IsArtinianRing.mem_minimalPrimes bot_le, ?_⟩
  have hr : φ.range = (F ⊔ G).toSubalgebra := by
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap_range, F.range_val, G.range_val,
      sup_toSubalgebra_of_left]
  exact ⟨(Ideal.quotientKerEquivRange φ).trans (Subalgebra.equivOfEq _ _ hr)⟩

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.tensor_compositum_eq_chainField
statement:
theorem FiniteCorrespondencePair.tensor_compositum_eq_chainField
    {k Ω : Type*} [Field k] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω]
    (P Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) :
    ((adjoin (↥P.targetField) {P.source}) ⊔
      (adjoin (↥P.targetField) {Q.target})).restrictScalars k = P.chainField Q
proof:
:= by
  rw [← restrictScalars_sup]
  change (adjoin (↥(adjoin k {P.target})) {P.source}).restrictScalars k ⊔
    (adjoin (↥(adjoin k {P.target})) {Q.target}).restrictScalars k =
      adjoin k {P.source, P.target, Q.target}
  rw [adjoin_adjoin_left, adjoin_adjoin_left, ← adjoin_union]
  congr 1
  ext z
  simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  tauto

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.tensor_ker_mem_minimalPrimes
statement:
theorem FiniteCorrespondencePair.tensor_ker_mem_minimalPrimes
    {k Ω : Type*} [Field k] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω]
    (P Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) (h : P.target = Q.source) :
    let E
proof:
:= P.targetField
    let F := adjoin (↥E) {P.source}
    let G := adjoin (↥E) {Q.target}
    let φ := Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap F.val G.val
    RingHom.ker φ ∈ (⊥ : Ideal (F ⊗[↥E] G)).minimalPrimes := by
  intro E F G φ
  let : FiniteDimensional (↥E) F :=
    IntermediateField.adjoin.finiteDimensional
      ((mem_racl_iff k).mp P.source_mem_target).isIntegral
  have hz : IsAlgebraic (↥E) Q.target := by
    change IsAlgebraic (adjoin k {P.target}) Q.target
    rw [h]
    exact (mem_racl_iff k).mp Q.target_mem_source
  let : FiniteDimensional (↥E) G :=
    IntermediateField.adjoin.finiteDimensional hz.isIntegral
  exact (finite_tensor_component F G).1

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.tensor_quotient_equiv_compositum
statement:
theorem FiniteCorrespondencePair.tensor_quotient_equiv_compositum
    {k Ω : Type*} [Field k] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω]
    (P Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) (h : P.target = Q.source) :
    let E
proof:
:= P.targetField
    let F := adjoin (↥E) {P.source}
    let G := adjoin (↥E) {Q.target}
    let φ := Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap F.val G.val
    let : Algebra (↥E) ((F ⊗[↥E] G) ⧸ RingHom.ker φ) := Ideal.Quotient.algebra _
    Nonempty (((F ⊗[↥E] G) ⧸ RingHom.ker φ) ≃ₐ[↥E] ↥(F ⊔ G)) := by
  intro E F G φ quotientAlgebra
  let : FiniteDimensional (↥E) F :=
    IntermediateField.adjoin.finiteDimensional
      ((mem_racl_iff k).mp P.source_mem_target).isIntegral
  have hz : IsAlgebraic (↥E) Q.target := by
    change IsAlgebraic (adjoin k {P.target}) Q.target
    rw [h]
    exact (mem_racl_iff k).mp Q.target_mem_source
  let : FiniteDimensional (↥E) G :=
    IntermediateField.adjoin.finiteDimensional hz.isIntegral
  exact (finite_tensor_component F G).2

name: AclGeom.exists_algHom_ne_zero_of_finiteType
statement:
private theorem exists_algHom_ne_zero_of_finiteType [IsAlgClosed k] {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    [IsDomain A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A] {a : A} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ φ : A →ₐ[k] k, φ a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : IsJacobsonRing A := isJacobsonRing_of_finiteType (A := k) (B := A)
  by_contra h
  have ha' : a ∈ (⊥ : Ideal A).jacobson := by
    rw [Ideal.jacobson, Ideal.mem_sInf]
    intro M hM
    let : M.IsMaximal := hM.2
    let : Field (A ⧸ M) := Ideal.Quotient.field M
    let : Module.Finite k (A ⧸ M) := finite_of_finite_type_of_isJacobsonRing k (A ⧸ M)
    let φ : (A ⧸ M) →ₐ[k] k := IsAlgClosed.lift
    by_contra ham
    apply h
    refine ⟨φ.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k M), ?_⟩
    intro hz
    apply ham
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
    apply φ.injective
    simpa using hz
  have hj : (⊥ : Ideal A).jacobson = ⊥ :=
    IsJacobsonRing.out inferInstance (inferInstance : (⊥ : Ideal A).IsPrime).isRadical
  exact ha (by simpa only [hj, Ideal.mem_bot] using ha')

name: AclGeom.repr_specialize
statement:
private theorem repr_specialize {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] {ι : Type*}
    [DecidableEq ι] (b : Module.Basis ι k F) (φ : A →ₐ[k] k) (z : A ⊗[k] F) (i : ι) :
    b.repr ((Algebra.TensorProduct.lid k F)
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map φ (AlgHom.id k F) z)) i =
      φ (TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisRight b z i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine TensorProduct.inductionOn z ?_ ?_
  · intro a f
    simp [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, Algebra.TensorProduct.lid_tmul,
      mul_comm]
  · intro x y hx hy
    simp only [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hx, hy]

name: AclGeom.mul_ne_zero_of_finiteType
statement:
private theorem mul_ne_zero_of_finiteType [IsAlgClosed k] {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    [IsDomain A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A] {x y : A ⊗[k] F} (hx : x ≠ 0)
    (hy : y ≠ 0) : x * y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b := Module.Basis.ofVectorSpace k F
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisRight b x i ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    apply hx
    apply (TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisRight b).injective
    ext i
    rw [h i, map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisRight b y j ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    apply hy
    apply (TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisRight b).injective
    ext j
    rw [h j, map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := exists_algHom_ne_zero_of_finiteType (k := k) (mul_ne_zero hi hj)
  rw [map_mul] at hφ
  let ψ : A ⊗[k] F →ₐ[k] F :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.lid k F).toAlgHom.comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.map φ (AlgHom.id k F))
  have hψx : ψ x ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply left_ne_zero_of_mul hφ
    rw [← repr_specialize b φ x i]
    change b.repr (ψ x) i = 0
    rw [h0, map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]
  have hψy : ψ y ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply right_ne_zero_of_mul hφ
    rw [← repr_specialize b φ y j]
    change b.repr (ψ y) j = 0
    rw [h0, map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply]
  intro hxy
  apply mul_ne_zero hψx hψy
  rw [← map_mul ψ x y, hxy, map_zero]

name: AclGeom.isDomain_tensorProduct_of_isAlgClosed
statement: theorem isDomain_tensorProduct_of_isAlgClosed [IsAlgClosed k] : IsDomain (E ⊗[k] F)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : Nontrivial (E ⊗[k] F) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.nontrivial_of_algebraMap_injective_of_isDomain k E F
      (algebraMap k E).injective (algebraMap k F).injective
  
  have : NoZeroDivisors (E ⊗[k] F) := by
    refine ⟨fun {x y} hxy ↦ ?_⟩
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    obtain ⟨hx0, hy0⟩ := hcon
    obtain ⟨sx, hsx⟩ := TensorProduct.exists_finset x
    obtain ⟨sy, hsy⟩ := TensorProduct.exists_finset y
    set T : Finset E := sx.image Prod.fst ∪ sy.image Prod.fst with hT
    set A : Subalgebra k E := Algebra.adjoin k (T : Set E)
    have : Algebra.FiniteType k A := Algebra.FiniteType.adjoin_of_finite T.finite_toSet
    set φ := Algebra.TensorProduct.map A.val (AlgHom.id k F)
    have hφinj : Function.Injective φ := by
      have hinj : Function.Injective A.val.toLinearMap := Subtype.val_injective
      exact Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap (M := F) A.val.toLinearMap hinj
    
    have hmem : ∀ (s : Finset (E × F)), (↑(s.image Prod.fst) : Set E) ⊆ T →
        ∃ z : A ⊗[k] F, φ z = ∑ p ∈ s, p.1 ⊗ₜ[k] p.2 := by
      intro s hs
      refine ⟨∑ p ∈ s.attach, (⟨p.1.1, Algebra.subset_adjoin (hs (by
        simpa using Finset.mem_image_of_mem Prod.fst p.2))⟩ : A) ⊗ₜ[k] p.1.2, ?_⟩
      rw [map_sum, ← Finset.sum_attach s fun p ↦ p.1 ⊗ₜ[k] p.2]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ rfl
    obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := hmem sx (by intro e he; simp only [hT, Finset.coe_union]; left; exact he)
    obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hmem sy (by intro e he; simp only [hT, Finset.coe_union]; right; exact he)
    rw [← hsx] at hx'
    rw [← hsy] at hy'
    have hx'0 : x' ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hx0 (by rw [← hx', h0, map_zero])
    have hy'0 : y' ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ hy0 (by rw [← hy', h0, map_zero])
    apply mul_ne_zero_of_finiteType hx'0 hy'0
    refine hφinj ?_
    rw [map_mul, hx', hy', hxy, map_zero]
  exact NoZeroDivisors.to_isDomain _

name: AclGeom.binomial_mem_idealOf
statement:
theorem binomial_mem_idealOf {x y : Ω} {c : k} {m n : ℕ}
    (h : x ^ m = algebraMap k Ω c * y ^ n) :
    ((X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) ^ m - C c * X 1 ^ n) ∈
      idealOf k ![x, y]
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow, aeval_X, aeval_X,
    aeval_C]
  have h0 : (![x, y] : Fin 2 → Ω) 0 = x := rfl
  have h1 : (![x, y] : Fin 2 → Ω) 1 = y := rfl
  rw [h0, h1, h, sub_self]

name: AclGeom.mixed_binomial_mem_idealOf
statement:
theorem mixed_binomial_mem_idealOf {x y : Ω} {c : k} {m n : ℕ}
    (h : x ^ m * y ^ n = algebraMap k Ω c) :
    ((X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) ^ m * X 1 ^ n - C c) ∈
      idealOf k ![x, y]
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow, aeval_X, aeval_X,
    aeval_C]
  have h0 : (![x, y] : Fin 2 → Ω) 0 = x := rfl
  have h1 : (![x, y] : Fin 2 → Ω) 1 = y := rfl
  rw [h0, h1, h, sub_self]

name: AclGeom.shifted_gen_mem_idealOf
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, map_sub, aeval_C, h, sub_self]

name: AclGeom.zpow_natAbs_of_pos
statement:
theorem zpow_natAbs_of_pos {x : Ω} {a : ℤ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    x ^ a = x ^ a.natAbs
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zpow_natCast, Int.natAbs_of_nonneg ha.le]

name: AclGeom.zpow_natAbs_of_neg
statement:
theorem zpow_natAbs_of_neg {x : Ω} {a : ℤ} (ha : a < 0) :
    x ^ a = (x ^ a.natAbs)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_neg, Int.ofNat_natAbs_of_nonpos ha.le,
    neg_neg]

name: AclGeom.sign_cases_of_zpow_relation
statement:
theorem sign_cases_of_zpow_relation {x y : Ω} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0)
    {a b : ℤ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) {c : k}
    (h : x ^ a * y ^ b = algebraMap k Ω c) :
    (0 < a ∧ b < 0 ∧ x ^ a.natAbs = algebraMap k Ω c * y ^ b.natAbs) ∨
    (a < 0 ∧ 0 < b ∧ y ^ b.natAbs = algebraMap k Ω c * x ^ a.natAbs) ∨
    (0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ x ^ a.natAbs * y ^ b.natAbs = algebraMap k Ω c) ∨
    (a < 0 ∧ b < 0 ∧ x ^ a.natAbs * y ^ b.natAbs = algebraMap k Ω c⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy a 0 with haneg | hzero | hapos
  · rcases lt_trichotomy b 0 with hbneg | hzero' | hbpos
    · 
      refine Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨haneg, hbneg, ?_⟩))
      rw [zpow_natAbs_of_neg haneg, zpow_natAbs_of_neg hbneg,
        ← mul_inv] at h
      rw [map_inv₀, ← h, inv_inv]
    · exact absurd hzero' hb
    · 
      refine Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨haneg, hbpos, ?_⟩)
      rw [zpow_natAbs_of_neg haneg, zpow_natAbs_of_pos hbpos, mul_comm,
        ← div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_iff (pow_ne_zero _ hx)] at h
      exact h
  · exact absurd hzero ha
  · rcases lt_trichotomy b 0 with hbneg | hzero' | hbpos
    · 
      refine Or.inl ⟨hapos, hbneg, ?_⟩
      rw [zpow_natAbs_of_pos hapos, zpow_natAbs_of_neg hbneg,
        ← div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_iff (pow_ne_zero _ hy)] at h
      exact h
    · exact absurd hzero' hb
    · 
      refine Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hapos, hbpos, ?_⟩))
      rw [zpow_natAbs_of_pos hapos, zpow_natAbs_of_pos hbpos] at h
      exact h

name: AclGeom.dvd_of_both_mem_span
statement:
theorem dvd_of_both_mem_span {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    {g b a : R} (hg : Prime g) (hb : Prime b)
    (hbmem : b ∈ Ideal.span {g}) (hamem : a ∈ Ideal.span {g}) :
    b ∣ a
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : g ∣ b := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.1 hbmem
  have h2 : g ∣ a := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.1 hamem
  exact (hg.associated_of_dvd hb h1).symm.dvd.trans h2

name: AclGeom.simultaneous_coset_at_curve
statement:
