name: AclGeom.MulCorrSetup.JointRel.fst_notMem_base
statement:
theorem JointRel.fst_notMem_base (hrel : S.JointRel c₂') :
    c₂' 0 ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.y₁}
proof:
:= by
  have hv : Sum.elim ![S.x₁, S.y₁] ![S.x₂, S.y₂] (Sum.inr 0) ∉ racl k
      (Sum.elim ![S.x₁, S.y₁] ![S.x₂, S.y₂] '' {Sum.inl 0, Sum.inl 1}) := by
    simpa [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton] using S.x₂_notMem_base
  have h := notMem_racl_image_of_idealOf_eq k hrel.idealOf_eq.symm hv
  simpa [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton] using h

name: AclGeom.MulCorrSetup.racl_pair_of_relocation
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : z ∈ racl k (insert s {S.x₁, S.y₁}) := mem_racl_insert_iff.2 halg
  have hy₁ : S.y₁ ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s} :=
    racl_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (Set.mem_insert _ _)) S.y₁_mem
  have hins : (insert s {S.x₁, S.y₁} : Set Ω) = insert S.y₁ {S.x₁, s} := by
    rw [Set.insert_comm s S.x₁, Set.pair_comm s S.y₁, Set.insert_comm S.x₁ S.y₁]
  rw [hins, racl_insert_of_mem hy₁] at h1
  exact h1

name: AclGeom.MulCorrSetup.x₂_notMem_fresh
statement:
theorem x₂_notMem_fresh (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) :
    S.x₂ ∉ racl k {S.x₁, s}
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hexch : s ∈ racl k (insert S.x₂ {S.x₁}) := by
    refine racl_exchange ?_ S.x₂_notMem
    rwa [Set.pair_comm S.x₁ s] at hmem
  refine hs ?_
  rwa [Set.pair_comm S.x₂ S.x₁] at hexch

name: AclGeom.MulCorrSetup.JointRel.fst_notMem_pair
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have h0 : c₂' 0 ∉ racl k {S.x₁} := fun h ↦ hrel.fst_notMem_base
    (racl_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (Set.mem_insert _ _)) h)
  have hexch : s ∈ racl k (insert (c₂' 0) {S.x₁}) := by
    refine racl_exchange ?_ h0
    rwa [Set.pair_comm S.x₁ s] at halg
  have hsub : (insert (c₂' 0) {S.x₁} : Set Ω) ⊆ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂} := by
    rintro z (rfl | rfl)
    · exact hmem
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  exact hs (racl_le_of_subset_racl hsub hexch)

name: AclGeom.MulCorrSetup.JointRel.x₁_notMem_pair
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hexch : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k (insert S.x₁ {S.x₂}) := by
    refine racl_exchange ?_ S.x₁_notMem
    rwa [Set.pair_comm S.x₂ (c₂' 0)] at hmem
  exact hrel.fst_notMem_pair hs halg hexch

name: AclGeom.MulCorrSetup.JointRel.mul_fst_notMem_rho
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hx₂'mem : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₂, c₂' 0} :=
    subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_iff.2 (Or.inr rfl))
  have hy₂'mem : c₂' 1 ∈ racl k {S.x₂, c₂' 0} := by
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ hrel.snd_mem
    rintro z rfl
    exact hx₂'mem
  have hy₂mem : S.y₂ ∈ racl k {S.x₂, c₂' 0} := by
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ S.y₂_mem
    rintro z rfl
    exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  have hρsub : ({S.x₂ / c₂' 0, S.y₂ / c₂' 1} : Set Ω) ⊆
      racl k {S.x₂, c₂' 0} := by
    rintro z (rfl | rfl)
    · exact div_mem (subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)) hx₂'mem
    · exact div_mem hy₂mem hy₂'mem
  have hmul : S.x₁ * c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₂, c₂' 0} :=
    racl_le_of_subset_racl hρsub hmem
  have hx₁ : S.x₁ ∈ racl k {S.x₂, c₂' 0} := by
    have hdiv := div_mem hmul hx₂'mem
    have hcancel : S.x₁ * c₂' 0 / c₂' 0 = S.x₁ := by
      rw [mul_div_assoc, div_self hrel.fst_ne, mul_one]
    rwa [hcancel] at hdiv
  exact hrel.x₁_notMem_pair hs halg hx₁

name: AclGeom.MulCorrSetup.exists_prime_span_mul
proof:
:= by
  have hconv : ![S.x₁, S.y₁] * ![S.x₂, S.y₂] = ![S.x₁ * S.x₂, S.y₁ * S.y₂] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  rw [hconv]
  exact exists_prime_span_idealOf k S.mul_fst_transcendental S.mul_mem

name: AclGeom.MulCorrSetup.JointRel.mulSubst_mem
statement:
theorem JointRel.mulSubst_mem (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k}
    (hF : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] * ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F}) :
    mulSubst (k := k) F ∈ idealOf k
      (Sum.elim (![S.x₁, S.y₁] * c₂') (![S.x₂, S.y₂] / c₂'))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, aeval_mulSubst]
  have hne : ∀ i, c₂' i ≠ 0 := Fin.forall_fin_two.2 ⟨hrel.fst_ne, hrel.snd_ne⟩
  have harith : ![S.x₁, S.y₁] * c₂' * (![S.x₂, S.y₂] / c₂') =
      ![S.x₁, S.y₁] * ![S.x₂, S.y₂] := by
    funext i
    simp only [Pi.mul_apply, Pi.div_apply]
    rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm (c₂' i), div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hne i)]
  rw [harith]
  have hmem : F ∈ idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] * ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) := by
    rw [hF]
    exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
  exact (mem_idealOf_iff _).1 hmem

name: AclGeom.MulCorrSetup.JointRel.mul_fst_notMem_rho'
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hρ₁ : S.x₂ / c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₂ / c₂' 0, S.y₂ / c₂' 1} :=
    subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
  have h2 : S.x₁ * c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₂ / c₂' 0, S.y₂ / c₂' 1} := by
    have h3 := div_mem hmem hρ₁
    have h4 : S.x₁ * S.x₂ / (S.x₂ / c₂' 0) = S.x₁ * c₂' 0 := by
      rw [div_div_eq_mul_div, mul_right_comm, mul_div_assoc, div_self S.x₂_ne,
        mul_one]
    rwa [h4] at h3
  exact hrel.mul_fst_notMem_rho hs halg h2

name: AclGeom.MulCorrSetup.JointRel.mul_snd_notMem_rho'
proof:
:= fun hmem ↦
  hrel.mul_fst_notMem_rho' hs halg
    (racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hmem) S.mul_mem')

name: AclGeom.MulCorrSetup.JointRel.mul_snd_notMem_rho
proof:
:= fun hmem ↦
  hrel.mul_fst_notMem_rho hs halg
    (racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hmem) hrel.mul_fst_mem)

name: AclGeom.MulCorrSetup.JointRel.monomial_prod_rhoVec_eq
statement:
theorem JointRel.monomial_prod_rhoVec_eq [IsAlgClosed k]
    (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hF0 : F ≠ 0)
    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] * ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F}) :
    ∀ m ∈ (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(rhoField S c₂')) F).support,
      ∀ m' ∈ (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(rhoField S c₂')) F).support,
        (m.prod fun j e ↦ rhoVec S c₂' j ^ e) =
          (m'.prod fun j e ↦ rhoVec S c₂' j ^ e)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set FK := MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(rhoField S c₂')) F with hFK
  
  have hu : Transcendental ↥(rhoField S c₂') (S.x₁ * S.x₂) := fun h ↦
    hrel.mul_fst_notMem_rho' hs halg ((mem_racl_iff k).2 h)
  have hv' : Transcendental ↥(rhoField S c₂') (S.y₁ * S.y₂) := fun h ↦
    hrel.mul_snd_notMem_rho' hs halg ((mem_racl_iff k).2 h)
  
  have hconv : ![S.x₁, S.y₁] * ![S.x₂, S.y₂] = ![S.x₁ * S.x₂, S.y₁ * S.y₂] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  rw [hconv] at hFspan
  have hspan_d : idealOf ↥(rhoField S c₂') ![S.x₁ * S.x₂, S.y₁ * S.y₂] =
      Ideal.span {FK} :=
    idealOf_map_eq_span hu S.mul_mem hv' S.mul_mem' hF0 hFspan
  
  have hud' : Transcendental ↥(rhoField S c₂') (S.x₁ * c₂' 0) := fun h ↦
    hrel.mul_fst_notMem_rho hs halg ((mem_racl_iff k).2 h)
  have hvd'' : Transcendental ↥(rhoField S c₂') (S.y₁ * c₂' 1) := fun h ↦
    hrel.mul_snd_notMem_rho hs halg ((mem_racl_iff k).2 h)
  have hFspan_d' : idealOf k ![S.x₁ * c₂' 0, S.y₁ * c₂' 1] = Ideal.span {F} := by
    have h1 := hrel.mul_idealOf_eq
    have hconv' : ![S.x₁, S.y₁] * c₂' = ![S.x₁ * c₂' 0, S.y₁ * c₂' 1] := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp
    rw [hconv', hconv] at h1
    rw [h1, hFspan]
  have hspan_d' : idealOf ↥(rhoField S c₂') ![S.x₁ * c₂' 0, S.y₁ * c₂' 1] =
      Ideal.span {FK} :=
    idealOf_map_eq_span hud' hrel.mul_snd_mem hvd'' hrel.mul_fst_mem hF0
      hFspan_d'
  
  have hρne : ∀ j, rhoVec S c₂' j ≠ 0 := by
    intro j
    fin_cases j
    · exact fun h0 ↦
        div_ne_zero S.x₂_ne hrel.fst_ne (congrArg Subtype.val h0)
    · exact fun h0 ↦
        div_ne_zero S.y₂_ne hrel.snd_ne (congrArg Subtype.val h0)
  have htrans := idealOf_scale_span (c := rhoVec S c₂') hρne hspan_d
  have htuple : (fun j ↦ (![S.x₁ * S.x₂, S.y₁ * S.y₂] : Fin 2 → Ω) j /
      algebraMap ↥(rhoField S c₂') Ω (rhoVec S c₂' j)) =
      ![S.x₁ * c₂' 0, S.y₁ * c₂' 1] := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j
    · show S.x₁ * S.x₂ / (S.x₂ / c₂' 0) = S.x₁ * c₂' 0
      rw [div_div_eq_mul_div, mul_right_comm, mul_div_assoc, div_self S.x₂_ne,
        mul_one]
    · show S.y₁ * S.y₂ / (S.y₂ / c₂' 1) = S.y₁ * c₂' 1
      rw [div_div_eq_mul_div, mul_right_comm, mul_div_assoc, div_self S.y₂_ne,
        mul_one]
  rw [htuple, hspan_d'] at htrans
  have hFK0 : FK ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hF0 (MvPolynomial.map_injective _
    (algebraMap k ↥(rhoField S c₂')).injective (by rw [map_zero]; exact h))
  exact monomial_prod_eq_of_span_scale_eq hρne hFK0 htrans.symm

name: AclGeom.MulCorrSetup.rho_fst_transcendental
statement:
theorem rho_fst_transcendental (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂})
    {c₂'' : Fin 2 → Ω} (hne : c₂'' 0 ≠ 0) (halg : c₂'' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s}) :
    Transcendental k (S.x₂ / c₂'' 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hρ : S.x₂ / c₂'' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s} :=
    (mem_racl_iff k).2 (h.tower_top _)
  have hx₂ : S.x₂ ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s} := by
    have hmul := MulMemClass.mul_mem hρ halg
    rwa [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hne] at hmul
  exact S.x₂_notMem_fresh hs hx₂

name: AclGeom.MulCorrSetup.JointRel.rho_snd_mem
statement:
theorem JointRel.rho_snd_mem [IsAlgClosed k] (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hFp : Prime F)
    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] * ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F}) :
    S.y₂ / c₂' 1 ∈ racl k {S.x₂ / c₂' 0}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hFmem : F ∈ idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] * ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) := by
    rw [hFspan]
    exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
  have hv0 : ∀ j, (![S.x₁, S.y₁] * ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) j ≠ 0 := by
    intro j
    fin_cases j
    · exact S.mul_fst_ne
    · exact S.mul_snd_ne
  obtain ⟨m, hm, m', hm', hmne⟩ := exists_support_pair_of_aeval_eq_zero hv0
    hFp.ne_zero ((mem_idealOf_iff _).1 hFmem)
  
  have hsupmap : (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(rhoField S c₂')) F).support
      = F.support :=
    support_map_of_injective F (algebraMap k ↥(rhoField S c₂')).injective
  have hrelmon := hrel.monomial_prod_rhoVec_eq hs halg hFp.ne_zero hFspan m
    (hsupmap ▸ hm) m' (hsupmap ▸ hm')
  
  have hP0 : (monomial m 1 - monomial m' (1 : k)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hc := congrArg (fun p ↦ p.coeff m) h0
    rw [coeff_sub, coeff_monomial, coeff_monomial, ite_eq_left rfl,
      ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hmne), AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_zero] at hc
    simp at hc
  have hnindK : ¬AlgebraicIndependent k (rhoVec S c₂') := by
    intro hind
    have h0 : aeval (rhoVec S c₂') (monomial m 1 - monomial m' (1 : k)) = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, aeval_monomial, aeval_monomial, map_one, one_mul, one_mul,
        hrelmon, sub_self]
    exact hP0 (algebraicIndependent_iff.1 hind _ h0)
  have hnind : ¬AlgebraicIndependent k ![S.x₂ / c₂' 0, S.y₂ / c₂' 1] := by
    intro h
    refine hnindK (AlgebraicIndependent.of_comp (rhoField S c₂').val ?_)
    have hcomp : (⇑(rhoField S c₂').val ∘ rhoVec S c₂') =
        ![S.x₂ / c₂' 0, S.y₂ / c₂' 1] := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl
    rwa [hcomp]
  
  rw [algebraicIndependent_iff_forall_notMem_racl] at hnind
  push Not at hnind
  rw [Fin.exists_fin_two] at hnind
  rcases hnind with hi | hi
  · have himg : (![S.x₂ / c₂' 0, S.y₂ / c₂' 1] ''
        ({(0 : Fin 2)}ᶜ : Set (Fin 2))) = {S.y₂ / c₂' 1} := by
      have hcompl : ({(0 : Fin 2)}ᶜ : Set (Fin 2)) = {1} := by
        ext i
        fin_cases i <;> simp
      rw [hcompl, Set.image_singleton]
      simp
    rw [himg] at hi
    have hρ₁ : S.x₂ / c₂' 0 ∉ racl k (∅ : Set Ω) :=
      notMem_racl_empty_of_transcendental
        (rho_fst_transcendental hs hrel.fst_ne halg)
    have hxy : S.x₂ / c₂' 0 ∈
        racl k (insert (S.y₂ / c₂' 1) (∅ : Set Ω)) := by
      simpa using hi
    have hexch := racl_exchange hxy hρ₁
    simpa using hexch
  · have himg : (![S.x₂ / c₂' 0, S.y₂ / c₂' 1] ''
        ({(1 : Fin 2)}ᶜ : Set (Fin 2))) = {S.x₂ / c₂' 0} := by
      have hcompl : ({(1 : Fin 2)}ᶜ : Set (Fin 2)) = {0} := by
        ext i
        fin_cases i <;> simp
      rw [hcompl, Set.image_singleton]
      simp
    rw [himg] at hi
    exact hi

name: AclGeom.MulCorrSetup.JointRel.rho_pow_support_eq
statement:
theorem JointRel.rho_pow_support_eq [IsAlgClosed k] (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hF0 : F ≠ 0)
    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] * ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F})
    {m m' : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ} (hm : m ∈ F.support) (hm' : m' ∈ F.support) :
    (S.x₂ / c₂' 0) ^ m 0 * (S.y₂ / c₂' 1) ^ m 1 =
      (S.x₂ / c₂' 0) ^ m' 0 * (S.y₂ / c₂' 1) ^ m' 1
proof:
:= by
  have hsupmap : (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥(rhoField S c₂')) F).support
      = F.support :=
    support_map_of_injective F (algebraMap k ↥(rhoField S c₂')).injective
  have hrelmon := hrel.monomial_prod_rhoVec_eq hs halg hF0 hFspan m
    (hsupmap ▸ hm) m' (hsupmap ▸ hm')
  have hval := congrArg (rhoField S c₂').val hrelmon
  have hconv : ∀ mm : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ,
      (rhoField S c₂').val (mm.prod fun j e ↦ rhoVec S c₂' j ^ e) =
        (S.x₂ / c₂' 0) ^ mm 0 * (S.y₂ / c₂' 1) ^ mm 1 := by
    intro mm
    rw [Finsupp.prod_fintype _ _ fun j ↦ pow_zero _, Fin.prod_univ_two,
      map_mul, map_pow, map_pow]
    rfl
  rwa [hconv, hconv] at hval

name: AclGeom.MulCorrSetup.JointRel.zpow_rho_support_eq_one
statement:
theorem JointRel.zpow_rho_support_eq_one [IsAlgClosed k]
    (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hF0 : F ≠ 0)
    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] * ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F})
    {m m' : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ} (hm : m ∈ F.support) (hm' : m' ∈ F.support) :
    (S.x₂ / c₂' 0) ^ ((m 0 : ℤ) - m' 0) *
      (S.y₂ / c₂' 1) ^ ((m 1 : ℤ) - m' 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hρ₀ : S.x₂ / c₂' 0 ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero S.x₂_ne hrel.fst_ne
  have hρ₁ : S.y₂ / c₂' 1 ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero S.y₂_ne hrel.snd_ne
  have h := hrel.rho_pow_support_eq hs halg hF0 hFspan hm hm'
  rw [zpow_sub₀ hρ₀, zpow_sub₀ hρ₁, zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast,
    zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast, div_mul_div_comm, h, div_self]
  exact mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ hρ₀) (pow_ne_zero _ hρ₁)

name: AclGeom.MulCorrSetup.zpow_mem_racl
statement:
theorem zpow_mem_racl {A : Set Ω} {x : Ω} (hx : x ∈ racl k A)
    (n : ℤ) : x ^ n ∈ racl k A
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with n | n
  · rw [Int.ofNat_eq_natCast, zpow_natCast]
    exact pow_mem hx n
  · rw [zpow_negSucc]
    exact inv_mem (pow_mem hx (n + 1))

name: AclGeom.MulCorrSetup.JointRel.exists_algebraMap_eq_zpow_mul
statement:
theorem JointRel.exists_algebraMap_eq_zpow_mul [IsAlgClosed k]
    (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hF0 : F ≠ 0)
    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] * ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F})
    {m m' : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ} (hm : m ∈ F.support) (hm' : m' ∈ F.support) :
    ∃ c : k, c ≠ 0 ∧
      (S.x₁ * S.x₂) ^ ((m 0 : ℤ) - m' 0) *
        (S.y₁ * S.y₂) ^ ((m 1 : ℤ) - m' 1) = algebraMap k Ω c
proof:
:= by
  set a : ℤ := (m 0 : ℤ) - m' 0 with ha
  set b : ℤ := (m 1 : ℤ) - m' 1 with hb
  set μ : Ω := (S.x₁ * S.x₂) ^ a * (S.y₁ * S.y₂) ^ b with hμ
  
  have hx₂' : c₂' 0 ≠ 0 := hrel.fst_ne
  have hy₂' : c₂' 1 ≠ 0 := hrel.snd_ne
  have hμ0 : μ ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (zpow_ne_zero _ S.mul_fst_ne)
    (zpow_ne_zero _ S.mul_snd_ne)
  
  have hxconv : S.x₁ * c₂' 0 * (S.x₂ / c₂' 0) = S.x₁ * S.x₂ := by
    rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm (c₂' 0), div_mul_cancel₀ _ hx₂']
  have hyconv : S.y₁ * c₂' 1 * (S.y₂ / c₂' 1) = S.y₁ * S.y₂ := by
    rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm (c₂' 1), div_mul_cancel₀ _ hy₂']
  have hsplit : μ = ((S.x₁ * c₂' 0) ^ a * (S.y₁ * c₂' 1) ^ b) *
      ((S.x₂ / c₂' 0) ^ a * (S.y₂ / c₂' 1) ^ b) := by
    rw [hμ, mul_mul_mul_comm ((S.x₁ * c₂' 0) ^ a), ← mul_zpow, ← mul_zpow,
      hxconv, hyconv]
  have hinv : μ = (S.x₁ * c₂' 0) ^ a * (S.y₁ * c₂' 1) ^ b := by
    rw [hsplit, hrel.zpow_rho_support_eq_one hs halg hF0 hFspan hm hm',
      mul_one]
  
  have hmem₁ : μ ∈ racl k {S.x₂, S.x₁} := by
    have hx₁m : S.x₁ ∈ racl k {S.x₂, S.x₁} :=
      subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_iff.2 (Or.inr rfl))
    have hx₂m : S.x₂ ∈ racl k {S.x₂, S.x₁} :=
      subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
    have hx : S.x₁ * S.x₂ ∈ racl k {S.x₂, S.x₁} :=
      MulMemClass.mul_mem hx₁m hx₂m
    have hy : S.y₁ * S.y₂ ∈ racl k {S.x₂, S.x₁} := by
      refine MulMemClass.mul_mem ?_ ?_
      · exact racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hx₁m) S.y₁_mem
      · exact racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hx₂m) S.y₂_mem
    exact MulMemClass.mul_mem (zpow_mem_racl hx a) (zpow_mem_racl hy b)
  have hmem₂ : μ ∈ racl k {s, S.x₁} := by
    have hx₂'r : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {s, S.x₁} := by
      rwa [Set.pair_comm s S.x₁]
    have hy₂'r : c₂' 1 ∈ racl k {s, S.x₁} :=
      racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hx₂'r) hrel.snd_mem
    have hx₁r : S.x₁ ∈ racl k {s, S.x₁} :=
      subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_iff.2 (Or.inr rfl))
    have hy₁r : S.y₁ ∈ racl k {s, S.x₁} :=
      racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hx₁r) S.y₁_mem
    rw [hinv]
    exact MulMemClass.mul_mem
      (zpow_mem_racl (MulMemClass.mul_mem hx₁r hx₂'r) a)
      (zpow_mem_racl (MulMemClass.mul_mem hy₁r hy₂'r) b)
  
  have hmemx₁ : μ ∈ racl k {S.x₁} := by
    refine mem_racl_of_mem_racl_insert (a := S.x₂) (b := s) hmem₁ hmem₂ ?_
    rwa [Set.pair_comm S.x₁ S.x₂] at hs
  have hins₁ : (insert S.x₁ (∅ : Set Ω)) = {S.x₁} := by simp
  have hins₂ : (insert (S.x₁ * S.x₂) (∅ : Set Ω)) = {S.x₁ * S.x₂} := by simp
  have hmemempty : μ ∈ racl k (∅ : Set Ω) := by
    
    have hx₁x₂ : S.x₁ * S.x₂ ∉ racl k (insert S.x₁ (∅ : Set Ω)) := by
      rw [hins₁]
      intro hmem
      have hx₁m : S.x₁ ∈ racl k {S.x₁} := subset_racl k _ rfl
      have hdiv := div_mem hmem hx₁m
      rw [mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ S.x₁_ne] at hdiv
      exact S.x₂_notMem hdiv
    
    have hμx₂ : μ ∈ racl k (insert (S.x₁ * S.x₂) (∅ : Set Ω)) := by
      rw [hins₂]
      have hxm : S.x₁ * S.x₂ ∈ racl k {S.x₁ * S.x₂} := subset_racl k _ rfl
      have hym : S.y₁ * S.y₂ ∈ racl k {S.x₁ * S.x₂} :=
        racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hxm) S.mul_mem
      exact MulMemClass.mul_mem (zpow_mem_racl hxm a) (zpow_mem_racl hym b)
    
    have hx₁empty : S.x₁ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set Ω) := fun h ↦
      S.x₁_notMem (racl_mono (Set.empty_subset _) h)
    refine mem_racl_of_mem_racl_insert (a := S.x₁ * S.x₂) (b := S.x₁)
      hμx₂ ?_ ?_
    · rw [hins₁]
      exact hmemx₁
    · intro hmem
      exact hx₁x₂ (racl_exchange hmem hx₁empty)
  have halgμ : IsAlgebraic k μ := isAlgebraic_of_mem_racl_empty hmemempty
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := mem_range_algebraMap_of_isAlgebraic halgμ
  refine ⟨c, fun h0 ↦ ?_, hc.symm⟩
  rw [h0, map_zero] at hc
  exact hμ0 hc.symm

name: AclGeom.MulCorrSetup.JointRel.exists_prime_span_rho
statement:
theorem JointRel.exists_prime_span_rho [IsAlgClosed k]
    (hrel : S.JointRel c₂')
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) (halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hFp : Prime F)
    (hFspan : idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] * ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) = Ideal.span {F}) :
    ∃ G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k, Prime G ∧
      idealOf k ![S.x₂ / c₂' 0, S.y₂ / c₂' 1] = Ideal.span {G}
proof:
:=
  exists_prime_span_idealOf k (rho_fst_transcendental hs hrel.fst_ne halg)
    (hrel.rho_snd_mem hs halg hFp hFspan)

name: AclGeom.MulCorrSetup.exists_coset_equations
statement:
theorem exists_coset_equations [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed Ω] {s : Ω}
    (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) :
    ∃ (a b : ℤ) (c₁ c₂ : k), a ≠ 0 ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧ c₁ ≠ 0 ∧ c₂ ≠ 0 ∧
      S.x₁ ^ a * S.y₁ ^ b = algebraMap k Ω c₁ ∧
      S.x₂ ^ a * S.y₂ ^ b = algebraMap k Ω c₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hsbase : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.y₁} := by
    intro hmem
    refine hs (racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ hmem)
    rintro z (rfl | rfl)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
    · exact racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2
        (subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _))) S.y₁_mem
  have hstr : Transcendental ↥S.base s := fun halg ↦
    hsbase ((mem_racl_iff k).2 halg)
  
  obtain ⟨c₂', hrel, halgrel⟩ := S.exists_pair_relocation hstr
  have halg : c₂' 0 ∈ racl k {S.x₁, s} :=
    S.racl_pair_of_relocation (halgrel 0)
  obtain ⟨F, hFp, hFspan⟩ := S.exists_prime_span_mul
  
  have hFmem : F ∈ idealOf k (![S.x₁, S.y₁] * ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) := by
    rw [hFspan]
    exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
  have hv0 : ∀ j, (![S.x₁, S.y₁] * ![S.x₂, S.y₂]) j ≠ 0 := by
    intro j
    fin_cases j
    · exact S.mul_fst_ne
    · exact S.mul_snd_ne
  obtain ⟨m, hm, m', hm', hmne⟩ := exists_support_pair_of_aeval_eq_zero hv0
    hFp.ne_zero ((mem_idealOf_iff _).1 hFmem)
  set a : ℤ := (m 0 : ℤ) - m' 0 with ha
  set b : ℤ := (m 1 : ℤ) - m' 1 with hb
  have hab : ¬(a = 0 ∧ b = 0) := by
    rintro ⟨ha0, hb0⟩
    rw [ha, sub_eq_zero] at ha0
    rw [hb, sub_eq_zero] at hb0
    exact hmne (Finsupp.ext (Fin.forall_fin_two.2
      ⟨by exact_mod_cast ha0, by exact_mod_cast hb0⟩))
  
  obtain ⟨c, hc0, hc⟩ := hrel.exists_algebraMap_eq_zpow_mul hs halg
    hFp.ne_zero hFspan hm hm'
  
  have hμν : (S.x₁ * S.x₂) ^ a * (S.y₁ * S.y₂) ^ b =
      (S.x₁ ^ a * S.y₁ ^ b) * (S.x₂ ^ a * S.y₂ ^ b) := by
    rw [mul_zpow, mul_zpow, mul_mul_mul_comm]
  have hν₁ne : S.x₁ ^ a * S.y₁ ^ b ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (zpow_ne_zero _ S.x₁_ne) (zpow_ne_zero _ S.y₁_ne)
  have hν₂ne : S.x₂ ^ a * S.y₂ ^ b ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (zpow_ne_zero _ S.x₂_ne) (zpow_ne_zero _ S.y₂_ne)
  have hx₁self : S.x₁ ∈ racl k {S.x₁} := subset_racl k _ rfl
  have hx₂self : S.x₂ ∈ racl k {S.x₂} := subset_racl k _ rfl
  have hν₁mem₁ : S.x₁ ^ a * S.y₁ ^ b ∈ racl k {S.x₁} :=
    MulMemClass.mul_mem (zpow_mem_racl hx₁self a) (zpow_mem_racl S.y₁_mem b)
  have hν₁eq : S.x₁ ^ a * S.y₁ ^ b =
      algebraMap k Ω c / (S.x₂ ^ a * S.y₂ ^ b) := by
    rw [eq_div_iff hν₂ne, ← hμν]
    exact hc
  have hν₁mem₂ : S.x₁ ^ a * S.y₁ ^ b ∈ racl k {S.x₂} := by
    rw [hν₁eq]
    refine div_mem (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ c) ?_
    exact MulMemClass.mul_mem (zpow_mem_racl hx₂self a)
      (zpow_mem_racl S.y₂_mem b)
  
  have hins₁ : (insert S.x₁ (∅ : Set Ω)) = {S.x₁} := by simp
  have hins₂ : (insert S.x₂ (∅ : Set Ω)) = {S.x₂} := by simp
  have hν₁empty : S.x₁ ^ a * S.y₁ ^ b ∈ racl k (∅ : Set Ω) := by
    refine mem_racl_of_mem_racl_insert (a := S.x₁) (b := S.x₂) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · rw [hins₁]
      exact hν₁mem₁
    · rw [hins₂]
      exact hν₁mem₂
    · rw [hins₁]
      exact S.x₂_notMem
  obtain ⟨c₁, hc₁eq⟩ := mem_range_algebraMap_of_isAlgebraic
    (isAlgebraic_of_mem_racl_empty hν₁empty)
  have hc₁0 : c₁ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, map_zero] at hc₁eq
    exact hν₁ne hc₁eq.symm
  
  have hν₂eq : S.x₂ ^ a * S.y₂ ^ b = algebraMap k Ω (c / c₁) := by
    rw [map_div₀, hc₁eq, eq_div_iff hν₁ne, mul_comm, ← hμν]
    exact hc
  
  
  have hx₁tr : S.x₁ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set Ω) := fun h ↦
    S.x₁_notMem (racl_mono (Set.empty_subset _) h)
  have hy₁tr : S.y₁ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set Ω) := by
    intro h
    have hy₁racl : racl k ({S.y₁} : Set Ω) = racl k (∅ : Set Ω) := by
      have h2 := racl_insert_of_mem (S := (∅ : Set Ω)) h
      simpa using h2
    have hx₁m := S.x₁_mem
    rw [hy₁racl] at hx₁m
    exact hx₁tr hx₁m
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := fun hb' ↦ hab ⟨h0, hb'⟩
    have hyb : S.y₁ ^ b ∈ racl k (∅ : Set Ω) := by
      have h1 := hν₁empty
      rwa [h0, zpow_zero, one_mul] at h1
    exact hy₁tr (mem_racl_empty_of_zpow hb0 hyb)
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have ha0' : a ≠ 0 := fun ha' ↦ hab ⟨ha', h0⟩
    have hxa : S.x₁ ^ a ∈ racl k (∅ : Set Ω) := by
      have h1 := hν₁empty
      rwa [h0, zpow_zero, mul_one] at h1
    exact hx₁tr (mem_racl_empty_of_zpow ha0' hxa)
  exact ⟨a, b, c₁, c / c₁, ha0, hb0, hc₁0, div_ne_zero hc0 hc₁0,
    hc₁eq.symm, hν₂eq⟩

name: AclGeom.MulCorrSetup.exists_coset_equations_coprime
statement:
theorem exists_coset_equations_coprime [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    {s : Ω} (hs : s ∉ racl k {S.x₁, S.x₂}) :
    ∃ (a b : ℤ) (c₁ c₂ : k), a ≠ 0 ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧ Int.gcd a b = 1 ∧
      c₁ ≠ 0 ∧ c₂ ≠ 0 ∧
      S.x₁ ^ a * S.y₁ ^ b = algebraMap k Ω c₁ ∧
      S.x₂ ^ a * S.y₂ ^ b = algebraMap k Ω c₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, b, c₁, c₂, ha, hb, hc₁, hc₂, h₁, h₂⟩ :=
    S.exists_coset_equations hs
  have hdpos : 0 < Int.gcd a b := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (Int.gcd a b) with h0 | h
    · exact absurd (Int.gcd_eq_zero_iff.1 h0).1 ha
    · exact h
  obtain ⟨a', b', hcop, ha', hb'⟩ := Int.exists_gcd_one hdpos
  have ha'0 : a' ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, zero_mul] at ha'
    exact ha ha'
  have hb'0 : b' ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, zero_mul] at hb'
    exact hb hb'
  
  have hkey : ∀ (x y : Ω) (c : k), x ≠ 0 → y ≠ 0 →
      x ^ a * y ^ b = algebraMap k Ω c →
      ∃ c' : k, c' ≠ 0 ∧ x ^ a' * y ^ b' = algebraMap k Ω c' := by
    intro x y c hx hy h
    have hzd : (x ^ a' * y ^ b') ^ ((Int.gcd a b : ℤ)) =
        algebraMap k Ω c := by
      rw [mul_zpow, ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_mul, ← ha', ← hb']
      exact h
    have hzne : x ^ a' * y ^ b' ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero (zpow_ne_zero _ hx) (zpow_ne_zero _ hy)
    have hzmem : (x ^ a' * y ^ b') ^ ((Int.gcd a b : ℤ)) ∈
        racl k (∅ : Set Ω) := by
      rw [hzd]
      exact IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ _
    have hz : x ^ a' * y ^ b' ∈ racl k (∅ : Set Ω) := by
      refine mem_racl_empty_of_zpow ?_ hzmem
      exact_mod_cast hdpos.ne'
    obtain ⟨c', hc'⟩ := mem_range_algebraMap_of_isAlgebraic
      (isAlgebraic_of_mem_racl_empty hz)
    refine ⟨c', fun h0 ↦ hzne ?_, hc'.symm⟩
    rw [← hc', h0, map_zero]
  obtain ⟨c₁', hc₁'0, h₁'⟩ := hkey S.x₁ S.y₁ c₁ S.x₁_ne S.y₁_ne h₁
  obtain ⟨c₂', hc₂'0, h₂'⟩ := hkey S.x₂ S.y₂ c₂ S.x₂_ne S.y₂_ne h₂
  exact ⟨a', b', c₁', c₂', ha'0, hb'0, hcop, hc₁'0, hc₂'0, h₁', h₂'⟩

name: AclGeom.SchemeGenericTranslate.parameterAct_injective_of_point_kernel
statement:
private theorem parameterAct_injective_of_point_kernel
    {C : Type*} [Category C] [CartesianMonoidalCategory C]
    {G : C} [GrpObj G] (X : C) [ModObj G X] {T : C}
    (e : 𝟙_ C ≅ T)
    (hker : ∀ q : 𝟙_ C ⟶ G, ModObj.pointAct X q = 𝟙 X → q = 1) :
    Function.Injective (ModObj.parameterAct X : (T ⟶ G) → (T ⊗ X ⟶ T ⊗ X))
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      (ModObj.pointAut X : (𝟙_ C ⟶ G) →* Aut X) := by
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_one]
    intro q hq
    exact hker q (congrArg Iso.hom hq)
  have hq (q : T ⟶ G) :
      (λ_ X).inv ≫ (e.hom ⊗ₘ 𝟙 X) ≫ ModObj.parameterAct X q ≫ snd T X =
        ModObj.pointAct X (e.hom ≫ q) := by
    change (λ_ X).inv ≫ (e.hom ⊗ₘ 𝟙 X) ≫ ModObj.parameterAct X q ≫ snd T X =
      (toUnit X ≫ e.hom ≫ q) • 𝟙 X
    rw [ModObj.parameterAct_snd, ModObj.comp_smul, ModObj.comp_smul]
    simp only [tensorHom_fst_assoc, tensorHom_snd, Category.comp_id,
      leftUnitor_inv_fst_assoc, leftUnitor_inv_snd]
  intro a b hab
  apply (cancel_epi e.hom).mp
  apply hinj
  apply Iso.ext
  change ModObj.pointAct X (e.hom ≫ a) = ModObj.pointAct X (e.hom ≫ b)
  rw [← hq a, ← hq b, hab]

name: AclGeom.SchemeGenericTranslate.sectionsTensorAut_injective_of_point_kernel
statement:
private theorem sectionsTensorAut_injective_of_point_kernel
    {G : Over (Spec (.of k))} [GrpObj G]
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsAffine V.left] [ModObj G V]
    (hker : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G,
      ModObj.pointAct V q = 𝟙 V → q = 1) :
    Function.Injective (sectionsTensorAut V :
      ((Spec (.of k)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G) →
        (k ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤) ≃ₐ[k] k ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)))
proof:
:= by
  let W := (Spec (.of Γ(V.left, ⊤))).asOver (Spec (.of k))
  let e := sectionsSpecIso V
  have : IsMonHom (Iso.refl G).hom := inferInstanceAs (IsMonHom (𝟙 G))
  let : ModObj G W := ModObj.ofIso (Iso.refl G) e
  have : IsModHom G e.hom := by
    constructor
    change γ[G, V] ≫ e.hom =
      (𝟙 G ⊗ₘ e.hom) ≫ (𝟙 G ⊗ₘ e.inv) ≫ γ[G, V] ≫ e.hom
    rw [← Category.assoc, tensorHom_comp_tensorHom]
    simp only [Category.id_comp, e.hom_inv_id, tensorHom_id, id_whiskerRight]
  have hkerW (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G)
      (hq : ModObj.pointAct W q = 𝟙 W) : q = 1 := by
    apply hker q
    apply (cancel_mono e.hom).mp
    have he : ModObj.pointAct V q ≫ e.hom = e.hom ≫ ModObj.pointAct W q := by
      change (((toUnit V) ≫ q) • 𝟙 V) ≫ e.hom =
        e.hom ≫ (((toUnit W) ≫ q) • 𝟙 W)
      rw [IsModHom.map_smul, ModObj.comp_smul, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id,
        ← Category.assoc, comp_toUnit]
    rw [he, hq, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
  intro a b hab
  apply parameterAct_injective_of_point_kernel W (unitIsoSpecAsOver k) hkerW
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  have hmap := congrArg (fun τ : k ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤) ≃ₐ[k]
      k ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤) ↦ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom τ.toRingHom)) hab
  change SchemeParameterAction.tensorAut a = SchemeParameterAction.tensorAut b at hab
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (SchemeParameterAction.tensorAut a).toRingHom) =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (SchemeParameterAction.tensorAut b).toRingHom) at hmap
  rw [SchemeParameterAction.spec_map_tensorAut,
    SchemeParameterAction.spec_map_tensorAut] at hmap
  apply (cancel_epi (pullbackSpecIso k k Γ(V.left, ⊤)).inv).mp
  apply (cancel_mono (pullbackSpecIso k k Γ(V.left, ⊤)).hom).mp
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (hmap.trans (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm)

name: AclGeom.SchemeGenericTranslate.coefficient_points_injective
statement:
theorem coefficient_points_injective
    {G : Over (Spec (.of k))} [GrpObj G]
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsAffine V.left] [ModObj G V]
    (hker : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G,
      ModObj.pointAct V q = 𝟙 V → q = 1)
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G) [Mono g]
    (s : Finset Γ(V.left, ⊤)) (hs : Algebra.adjoin k (s : Set Γ(V.left, ⊤)) = ⊤)
    {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → Γ(V.left, ⊤)) (cA : Bool → s → Fin n → A)
    (hc : ∀ (φ : A →ₐ[k] k) (i : s),
      sectionsTensorAut V ((algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)
        (1 ⊗ₜ[k] (i : Γ(V.left, ⊤))) = ∑ j, φ (cA true i j) ⊗ₜ[k] v j) :
    let B
proof:
:= Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range fun p : Bool × s × Fin n ↦ cA p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)
    Function.Injective (fun φ : A →ₐ[k] k ↦ φ.comp B.val) := by
  classical
  let B := Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range fun p : Bool × s × Fin n ↦ cA p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)
  change Function.Injective (fun φ : A →ₐ[k] k ↦ φ.comp B.val)
  intro φ ψ h
  have he (e : Bool) (i : s) (j : Fin n) : φ (cA e i j) = ψ (cA e i j) := by
    let b : B := ⟨cA e i j, Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨(e, i, j), rfl⟩⟩
    exact AlgHom.congr_fun h b
  let a : (Spec (.of k)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G :=
    (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g
  let b : (Spec (.of k)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G :=
    (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom ψ).op ≫ g
  have haut : sectionsTensorAut V a = sectionsTensorAut V b := by
    have hright : (sectionsTensorAut V a).toAlgHom.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight =
        (sectionsTensorAut V b).toAlgHom.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight := by
      apply AlgHom.ext_of_adjoin_eq_top hs
      intro r hr
      change sectionsTensorAut V a (1 ⊗ₜ[k] r) = sectionsTensorAut V b (1 ⊗ₜ[k] r)
      rw [hc φ ⟨r, hr⟩, hc ψ ⟨r, hr⟩]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      rw [he true ⟨r, hr⟩ j]
    apply AlgEquiv.ext
    intro x
    induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
    | tmul c r =>
      have hr := AlgHom.congr_fun hright r
      change sectionsTensorAut V a (1 ⊗ₜ[k] r) =
        sectionsTensorAut V b (1 ⊗ₜ[k] r) at hr
      have hfactor : c ⊗ₜ[k] r = c • (1 ⊗ₜ[k] r : k ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)) := by
        change c ⊗ₜ[k] r = (c • (1 : k)) ⊗ₜ[k] r
        simp only [smul_eq_mul, _root_.mul_one]
      rw [hfactor, map_smul, map_smul, hr]
  have hab := sectionsTensorAut_injective_of_point_kernel V hker haut
  have hf := (cancel_mono g).mp hab
  have hspec := congrArg Over.Hom.left hf
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ.toRingHom) at hspec
  have hf' := Spec.map_injective hspec
  ext z
  exact congrArg (fun f : CommRingCat.of A ⟶ CommRingCat.of k ↦ f.hom z) hf'

name: AclGeom.SchemePlaceAction.boundary_nonempty
statement:
theorem boundary_nonempty {k : Type u} [Field k] (V : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1) :
    (Place.boundary (globalSections V)).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty (⊤ : V.left.Opens) := ⟨⟨genericPoint V.left, trivial⟩⟩
  have : IsFractionRing Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen V.left ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top V.left)
  have : IsFunctionFieldOneVar k V.left.functionField :=
    scheme_functionField_isFunctionFieldOneVar k V hdim
  obtain ⟨t, ht, -⟩ :=
    IsFunctionFieldOneVar.exists_transcendental_finite (k := k) (F := V.left.functionField)
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a : Γ(V.left, ⊤),
      Transcendental k (algebraMap Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField a) := by
    obtain ⟨a, b, -, hab⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective Γ(V.left, ⊤) t
    by_cases ha : IsAlgebraic k (algebraMap Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField a)
    · refine ⟨b, fun hb ↦ ht ?_⟩
      rw [← hab, div_eq_mul_inv]
      exact ha.mul hb.inv
    · exact ⟨a, ha⟩
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := exists_place_one_lt_valuation ha
  refine ⟨P, ?_⟩
  change ¬ (globalSections V : Set V.left.functionField) ⊆ P.val
  intro h
  exact (not_le_of_gt hP) ((P.val.valuation_le_one_iff _).2 (h ⟨a, rfl⟩))

name: AclGeom.TupleCorrespondencePair.idealOf_comp_elim
statement:
private theorem idealOf_comp_elim (σ : Ω ≃ₐ[k] Ω) (a : α → Ω) (b : β → Ω) :
    idealOf k (Sum.elim (⇑σ ∘ a) (⇑σ ∘ b)) = idealOf k (Sum.elim a b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Sum.comp_elim]
  exact idealOf_comp_algHom k (σ : Ω →ₐ[k] Ω) _

name: AclGeom.TupleCorrespondencePair.idealOf_target_eq
statement:
private theorem idealOf_target_eq (P : TupleCorrespondencePair k Ω α β) :
    idealOf k P.target = P.ideal.comap (rename Sum.inr : MvPolynomial β k →ₐ[k] _)
proof:
:=
  idealOf_eq_comap_rename (Sum.elim_comp_inr P.source P.target)

name: AclGeom.TupleCorrespondenceGerm.composes_assoc
statement:
theorem composes_assoc [Finite α] [Finite β] [Finite γ] [Finite δ] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (A : TupleCorrespondenceGerm k Ω α β) (B : TupleCorrespondenceGerm k Ω β γ)
    (C : TupleCorrespondenceGerm k Ω γ δ) (D : TupleCorrespondenceGerm k Ω α δ) :
    (∃ E, Composes A B E ∧ Composes E C D) ↔ ∃ F, Composes B C F ∧ Composes A F D
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨E, ⟨P, Q, hPQ, hA, hB, hE⟩, ⟨R, S, hRS, hE', hC, hD⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨σ, -, hσ⟩ := exists_ambientAutomorphism_of_idealOf_eq
      (a := Sum.elim P.source Q.target) (b := Sum.elim R.source R.target) (hE.symm.trans hE')
    have hσx : ⇑σ ∘ P.source = R.source := funext fun a ↦ hσ (Sum.inl a)
    have hσz : ⇑σ ∘ Q.target = R.target := funext fun c ↦ hσ (Sum.inr c)
    let P' := transport σ P
    let Q' := transport σ Q
    have hPQ' : P'.target = Q'.source := congrArg (fun t ↦ ⇑σ ∘ t) hPQ
    have hQS : Q'.target = S.source := hσz.trans hRS
    refine ⟨ofPair (Q'.comp S hQS),
      ⟨Q', S, hQS, hB.trans (idealOf_comp_elim σ Q.source Q.target).symm, hC, rfl⟩,
      ⟨P', Q'.comp S hQS, hPQ', hA.trans (idealOf_comp_elim σ P.source P.target).symm, rfl, ?_⟩⟩
    rw [hD]
    change idealOf k (Sum.elim R.source S.target) =
      idealOf k (Sum.elim (⇑σ ∘ P.source) S.target)
    rw [hσx]
  · rintro ⟨F, ⟨P, Q, hPQ, hB, hC, hF⟩, ⟨R, S, hRS, hA, hF', hD⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨σ, -, hσ⟩ := exists_ambientAutomorphism_of_idealOf_eq
      (a := Sum.elim P.source Q.target) (b := Sum.elim S.source S.target) (hF.symm.trans hF')
    have hσy : ⇑σ ∘ P.source = S.source := funext fun b ↦ hσ (Sum.inl b)
    have hσw : ⇑σ ∘ Q.target = S.target := funext fun d ↦ hσ (Sum.inr d)
    let P' := transport σ P
    let Q' := transport σ Q
    have hRP : R.target = P'.source := hRS.trans hσy.symm
    have hPQ' : P'.target = Q'.source := congrArg (fun t ↦ ⇑σ ∘ t) hPQ
    refine ⟨ofPair (R.comp P' hRP),
      ⟨R, P', hRP, hA, hB.trans (idealOf_comp_elim σ P.source P.target).symm, rfl⟩,
      ⟨R.comp P' hRP, Q', hPQ', rfl, hC.trans (idealOf_comp_elim σ Q.source Q.target).symm, ?_⟩⟩
    rw [hD]
    change idealOf k (Sum.elim R.source S.target) =
      idealOf k (Sum.elim R.source (⇑σ ∘ Q.target))
    rw [hσw]

name: AclGeom.TupleCorrespondenceGerm.exists_composes_of_middle_ideal_eq
statement:
theorem exists_composes_of_middle_ideal_eq [Finite β] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (C : TupleCorrespondenceGerm k Ω α β) (D : TupleCorrespondenceGerm k Ω β γ)
    (hmid : C.carrier.comap (rename Sum.inr : MvPolynomial β k →ₐ[k] _) =
      D.carrier.comap (rename Sum.inl : MvPolynomial β k →ₐ[k] _)) :
    ∃ E, Composes C D E
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := C.presentation
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := D.presentation
  have hy : idealOf k Q.source = idealOf k P.target := by
    rw [idealOf_target_eq P, ← hP, hmid, hQ]
    exact idealOf_eq_comap_rename (Sum.elim_comp_inl Q.source Q.target)
  obtain ⟨σ, -, hσ⟩ := exists_ambientAutomorphism_of_idealOf_eq hy
  let Q' := transport σ Q
  have h : P.target = Q'.source := (funext hσ).symm
  exact ⟨ofPair (P.comp Q' h), P, Q', h, hP,
    hQ.trans (idealOf_comp_elim σ Q.source Q.target).symm, rfl⟩

name: AclGeom.TupleCorrespondenceGerm.composes_threefold_carriers_eq
statement:
theorem composes_threefold_carriers_eq [Finite α] [Finite β] [Finite γ] [Finite δ]
    [IsAlgClosed Ω] (P : TupleCorrespondencePair k Ω α β) (Q : TupleCorrespondencePair k Ω β γ)
    (S : TupleCorrespondencePair k Ω γ δ) (hPQ : P.target = Q.source)
    (hQS : Q.target = S.source) :
    {I | ∃ (E : TupleCorrespondenceGerm k Ω α γ) (F : TupleCorrespondenceGerm k Ω α δ),
        Composes (ofPair P) (ofPair Q) E ∧ Composes E (ofPair S) F ∧ F.carrier = I} =
      {I | ∃ (x' : α → Ω) (w' : δ → Ω),
        idealOf k (Sum.elim x' P.target) = idealOf k (Sum.elim P.source P.target) ∧
        idealOf k (Sum.elim Q.target w') = idealOf k (Sum.elim Q.target S.target) ∧
        I = idealOf k (Sum.elim x' w')} ∧
    {I | ∃ (E : TupleCorrespondenceGerm k Ω β δ) (F : TupleCorrespondenceGerm k Ω α δ),
        Composes (ofPair Q) (ofPair S) E ∧ Composes (ofPair P) E F ∧ F.carrier = I} =
      {I | ∃ (x' : α → Ω) (w' : δ → Ω),
        idealOf k (Sum.elim x' P.target) = idealOf k (Sum.elim P.source P.target) ∧
        idealOf k (Sum.elim Q.target w') = idealOf k (Sum.elim Q.target S.target) ∧
        I = idealOf k (Sum.elim x' w')}
proof:
:= by
  have hS : S.ideal = idealOf k (Sum.elim Q.target S.target) := by
    change idealOf k (Sum.elim S.source S.target) = _
    rw [hQS]
  
  have hQ : Q.ideal = idealOf k (Sum.elim P.target Q.target) := by
    change idealOf k (Sum.elim Q.source Q.target) = _
    rw [hPQ]
  
  have hassoc : {I | ∃ (E : TupleCorrespondenceGerm k Ω β δ) (F : TupleCorrespondenceGerm k Ω α δ),
        Composes (ofPair Q) (ofPair S) E ∧ Composes (ofPair P) E F ∧ F.carrier = I} =
      {I | ∃ (E : TupleCorrespondenceGerm k Ω α γ) (F : TupleCorrespondenceGerm k Ω α δ),
        Composes (ofPair P) (ofPair Q) E ∧ Composes E (ofPair S) F ∧ F.carrier = I} := by
    ext I
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨E, F, hE, hF, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨E', h₁, h₂⟩ := (composes_assoc (ofPair P) (ofPair Q) (ofPair S) F).2 ⟨E, hE, hF⟩
      exact ⟨E', F, h₁, h₂, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨E, F, hE, hF, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨E', h₁, h₂⟩ := (composes_assoc (ofPair P) (ofPair Q) (ofPair S) F).1 ⟨E, hE, hF⟩
      exact ⟨E', F, h₁, h₂, rfl⟩
  rw [hassoc, and_self]
  ext I
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨E, F, ⟨P₁, Q₁, h₁, hP₁, hQ₁, hE⟩, ⟨R₁, S₁, h₂, hR₁, hS₁, hF⟩, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨σ, -, hσ⟩ := exists_ambientAutomorphism_of_idealOf_eq
      (a := Sum.elim P₁.source Q₁.target) (b := Sum.elim R₁.source R₁.target)
      (hE.symm.trans hR₁)
    have hσx : ⇑σ ∘ P₁.source = R₁.source := funext fun a ↦ hσ (Sum.inl a)
    have hσz : ⇑σ ∘ Q₁.target = R₁.target := funext fun c ↦ hσ (Sum.inr c)
    have hmid : idealOf k (Sum.elim (⇑σ ∘ P₁.target) (⇑σ ∘ Q₁.target)) =
        idealOf k (Sum.elim P.target Q.target) := by
      rw [idealOf_comp_elim, h₁]
      exact hQ₁.symm.trans hQ
    obtain ⟨τ, -, hτ⟩ := exists_ambientAutomorphism_of_idealOf_eq hmid
    have hτy : ⇑τ ∘ (⇑σ ∘ P₁.target) = P.target := funext fun b ↦ hτ (Sum.inl b)
    have hτz : ⇑τ ∘ (⇑σ ∘ Q₁.target) = Q.target := funext fun c ↦ hτ (Sum.inr c)
    have hx : idealOf k (Sum.elim (⇑τ ∘ R₁.source) P.target) = P.ideal := by
      rw [← hτy, ← hσx, idealOf_comp_elim, idealOf_comp_elim]
      exact hP₁.symm
    have hw : idealOf k (Sum.elim Q.target (⇑τ ∘ S₁.target)) = S.ideal := by
      rw [← hτz, hσz, h₂, idealOf_comp_elim]
      exact hS₁.symm
    exact ⟨⇑τ ∘ R₁.source, ⇑τ ∘ S₁.target, hx, hw.trans hS,
      hF.trans (idealOf_comp_elim τ R₁.source S₁.target).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨x', w', hx', hw', rfl⟩
    let P' := ofIdealEq P x' P.target hx'
    let S' := ofIdealEq S Q.target w' (hw'.trans hS.symm)
    exact ⟨ofPair (P'.comp Q hPQ), ofPair ((P'.comp Q hPQ).comp S' rfl),
      ⟨P', Q, hPQ, hx'.symm, rfl, rfl⟩,
      ⟨P'.comp Q hPQ, S', rfl, rfl, (hw'.trans hS.symm).symm, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: AclGeom.TupleCorrespondenceGerm.composes_ofPair_carriers_eq
statement:
theorem composes_ofPair_carriers_eq [Finite α] [Finite β] [Finite γ] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (h : P.target = Q.source) :
    {I | ∃ E : TupleCorrespondenceGerm k Ω α γ, Composes (ofPair P) (ofPair Q) E ∧
        E.carrier = I} =
      {I | ∃ Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k ⧸ ℐ)),
        closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.quotientMapₐ ℐ (rename (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr))
          (idealOf_le_comap_rename_comp (a := Sum.elim P.source P.target) (b := P.target)
            (g := Sum.inr) (e := Sum.inl) rfl le_sup_left)).toRingHom '' Z) = Set.univ ∧
        I = ((PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal Z).comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ)).comap
          (rename (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl) Sum.inr :
            α ⊕ γ → (α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) : MvPolynomial (α ⊕ γ) k →ₐ[k] _)}
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : idealOf k (Sum.elim P.target Q.target) = idealOf k (Sum.elim Q.source Q.target) := by
    rw [h]
  have hset := locusIncidence_dominatingComponents_eq_jointLoci (k := k) P.source P.target
    Q.target P.source_mem_target (by rw [h]; exact Q.target_mem_source)
  
  have hcontr (x' : α → Ω) (z' : γ → Ω)
      (hx' : idealOf k (Sum.elim x' P.target) = idealOf k (Sum.elim P.source P.target))
      (hz' : idealOf k (Sum.elim P.target z') = idealOf k (Sum.elim P.target Q.target)) :
      ((PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ)
          (idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' P.target) z')) :
            Set (MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k ⧸ ℐ)))).comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ)).comap
        (rename (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl) Sum.inr : α ⊕ γ → (α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) :
          MvPolynomial (α ⊕ γ) k →ₐ[k] _) = idealOf k (Sum.elim x' z') := by
    have hle := locusIncidence_le_idealOf (k := k) x' P.target z'
    rw [hx', hz'] at hle
    have : (Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ)
        (idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' P.target) z'))).IsPrime :=
      Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
        (by rwa [Ideal.mk_ker])
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical, this.radical,
      Ideal.comap_map_mk hle]
    exact (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (k := k) (a := Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' P.target) z')
      (b := Sum.elim x' z') (g := Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl) Sum.inr)
      (funext fun i ↦ by rcases i with a | c <;> rfl)).symm
  ext I
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨E, ⟨P₁, Q₁, h₁, hP₁, hQ₁, hE⟩, rfl⟩
    have hy : idealOf k P₁.target = idealOf k P.target :=
      (idealOf_target_eq P₁).trans ((congrArg
        (Ideal.comap (rename Sum.inr : MvPolynomial β k →ₐ[k] _)) hP₁.symm).trans
          (idealOf_target_eq P).symm)
    obtain ⟨σ, -, hσ⟩ := exists_ambientAutomorphism_of_idealOf_eq hy
    have hσy : ⇑σ ∘ P₁.target = P.target := funext hσ
    have hx : idealOf k (Sum.elim (⇑σ ∘ P₁.source) P.target) = P.ideal := by
      rw [← hσy, idealOf_comp_elim]
      exact hP₁.symm
    have hz : idealOf k (Sum.elim P.target (⇑σ ∘ Q₁.target)) = Q.ideal := by
      rw [← hσy, h₁, idealOf_comp_elim]
      exact hQ₁.symm
    obtain ⟨hZ, hdense⟩ := (Set.ext_iff.1 hset _).2
      ⟨⇑σ ∘ P₁.source, ⇑σ ∘ Q₁.target, hx, hz.trans hQ.symm, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, hZ, hdense, hE.trans ((hcontr (⇑σ ∘ P₁.source) (⇑σ ∘ Q₁.target) hx
      (hz.trans hQ.symm)).trans (idealOf_comp_elim σ P₁.source Q₁.target)).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨Z, hZ, hdense, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨x', z', hx', hz', rfl⟩ := (Set.ext_iff.1 hset Z).1 ⟨hZ, hdense⟩
    let P₂ := ofIdealEq P x' P.target hx'
    let Q₂ := ofIdealEq Q P.target z' (hz'.trans hQ)
    exact ⟨ofPair (P₂.comp Q₂ rfl), ⟨P₂, Q₂, rfl, hx'.symm, (hz'.trans hQ).symm, rfl⟩,
      (hcontr x' z' hx' hz').symm⟩

name: AclGeom.GroupScheme.irreducibleSpace_reducedOver_tensor
proof:
:= by
  have : IsIntegral (reducedOver G A).left := isIntegral_subscheme_vanishingIdeal A hA
  have : IsIntegral (reducedOver G B).left := isIntegral_subscheme_vanishingIdeal B hB
  exact @irreducibleSpace_of_isIntegral _
    (isIntegral_pullback_of_isAlgClosed (reducedOver G A).hom (reducedOver G B).hom)

name: AclGeom.GroupScheme.curveCoset_of_genericPoints
statement:
theorem curveCoset_of_genericPoints {A B D : Set G.left}
    (hA : IsClosed A) (hAi : IsIrreducible A) (hAd : topologicalKrullDim A = 1)
    (hB : IsClosed B) (hBi : IsIrreducible B) (hBd : topologicalKrullDim B = 1)
    (hD : IsClosed D) (hDi : IsIrreducible D) (hDd : topologicalKrullDim D = 1)
    (hgen : ∀ ξ : (reducedOver G ⟨A, hA⟩ ⊗ reducedOver G ⟨B, hB⟩).left,
      closure {ξ} = Set.univ →
        ((reducedOverι G ⟨A, hA⟩ ⊗ₘ reducedOverι G ⟨B, hB⟩) ≫ μ[G]).left ξ ∈ D) :
    ∃ (H : Set G.left) (g₁ g₂ : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G),
      IsClosed H ∧ IsIrreducible H ∧ topologicalKrullDim H = 1 ∧
      (pointsEquivClosedPoints (1 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G) : G.left) ∈ H ∧
      (∀ h₁ h₂ : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G,
        (pointsEquivClosedPoints h₁ : G.left) ∈ H → (pointsEquivClosedPoints h₂ : G.left) ∈ H →
          (pointsEquivClosedPoints (h₁ * h₂⁻¹) : G.left) ∈ H) ∧
      A = leftMulHomeo g₁ '' H ∧ B = rightMulHomeo g₂ '' H ∧
      D = leftMulHomeo g₁ '' (rightMulHomeo g₂ '' H)
proof:
:= by
  have := irreducibleSpace_reducedOver_tensor (G := G) (A := ⟨A, hA⟩) (B := ⟨B, hB⟩) hAi hBi
  have hmem := hgen _ (genericPoint_closure _)
  refine curveCoset_of_closedPoints hA hAi hAd hB hBi hBd hD hDi hDd fun a b ha hb ↦ ?_
  rw [pointsEquivClosedPoints_apply] at ha hb ⊢
  exact mul_mem_of_genericPoint_mem hD hmem a b ha hb

name: AclGeom.GroupScheme.curveCoset_of_exists_genericPoint
statement:
theorem curveCoset_of_exists_genericPoint {A B D : Set G.left}
    (hA : IsClosed A) (hAi : IsIrreducible A) (hAd : topologicalKrullDim A = 1)
    (hB : IsClosed B) (hBi : IsIrreducible B) (hBd : topologicalKrullDim B = 1)
    (hD : IsClosed D) (hDi : IsIrreducible D) (hDd : topologicalKrullDim D = 1)
    (hgen : ∃ ξ : (reducedOver G ⟨A, hA⟩ ⊗ reducedOver G ⟨B, hB⟩).left,
      closure {ξ} = Set.univ ∧
        ((reducedOverι G ⟨A, hA⟩ ⊗ₘ reducedOverι G ⟨B, hB⟩) ≫ μ[G]).left ξ ∈ D) :
    ∃ (H : Set G.left) (g₁ g₂ : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G),
      IsClosed H ∧ IsIrreducible H ∧ topologicalKrullDim H = 1 ∧
      (pointsEquivClosedPoints (1 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G) : G.left) ∈ H ∧
      (∀ h₁ h₂ : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G,
        (pointsEquivClosedPoints h₁ : G.left) ∈ H → (pointsEquivClosedPoints h₂ : G.left) ∈ H →
          (pointsEquivClosedPoints (h₁ * h₂⁻¹) : G.left) ∈ H) ∧
      A = leftMulHomeo g₁ '' H ∧ B = rightMulHomeo g₂ '' H ∧
      D = leftMulHomeo g₁ '' (rightMulHomeo g₂ '' H)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ξ, hξ, hmem⟩ := hgen
  refine curveCoset_of_genericPoints hA hAi hAd hB hBi hBd hD hDi hDd fun ξ' hξ' ↦ ?_
  have heq : ξ' = ξ :=
    (show IsGenericPoint ξ' Set.univ from hξ').eq (show IsGenericPoint ξ Set.univ from hξ)
  rw [heq]
  exact hmem

name: AclGeom.NormalBranchEmbedding.reparametrize_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem reparametrize_apply
    (g : NormalBranchEmbedding E M' N) (e : M ≃ₐ[E] M') (x : M) :
    (g.reparametrize e).toAlgHom x = g.toAlgHom (e x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AclGeom.NormalBranchEmbedding.mapOfEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapOfEquiv_apply
    (eE : E ≃+* E') (eM : M ≃+* M') (eN : N ≃+* N')
    (hM : eM.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap E M) =
      (algebraMap E' M').comp eE.toRingHom)
    (hN : eN.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap E N) =
      (algebraMap E' N').comp eE.toRingHom)
    (f : NormalBranchEmbedding E M N) (x : M') :
    (mapOfEquiv eE eM eN hM hN f).toAlgHom x =
      eN (f.toAlgHom (eM.symm x))
proof:
:= by
  change eN (f.toAlgHom (eM.symm x)) = _
  rfl

name: AclGeom.NormalBranchEmbedding.deckMapOfEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem deckMapOfEquiv_apply
    (eE : E ≃+* E') (eN : N ≃+* N')
    (hN : eN.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap E N) =
      (algebraMap E' N').comp eE.toRingHom)
    (σ : N ≃ₐ[E] N) (x : N') :
    deckMapOfEquiv eE eN hN σ x = eN (σ (eN.symm x))
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: AclGeom.NormalBranchEmbedding.smul_toAlgHom
statement:
@[simp] theorem smul_toAlgHom (σ : N ≃ₐ[E] N)
    (f : NormalBranchEmbedding E M N) :
    (σ • f).toAlgHom = σ.toAlgHom.comp f.toAlgHom
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.NormalBranchEmbedding.mapOfEquiv_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapOfEquiv_smul
    (eE : E ≃+* E') (eM : M ≃+* M') (eN : N ≃+* N')
    (hM : eM.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap E M) =
      (algebraMap E' M').comp eE.toRingHom)
    (hN : eN.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap E N) =
      (algebraMap E' N').comp eE.toRingHom)
    (σ : N ≃ₐ[E] N) (f : NormalBranchEmbedding E M N) :
    mapOfEquiv eE eM eN hM hN (σ • f) =
      deckMapOfEquiv eE eN hN σ •
        mapOfEquiv eE eM eN hM hN f
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp

name: AclGeom.NormalBranchEmbedding.canonical_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem canonical_apply (x : M) :
    (canonical (E := E) (M := M) (N := N)).toAlgHom x =
      algebraMap M N x
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.NormalBranchEmbedding.extendToAut_smul_canonical
statement:
theorem extendToAut_smul_canonical [Normal E N]
    (f : NormalBranchEmbedding E M N) :
    f.extendToAut • canonical (E := E) (M := M) (N := N) = f
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact f.toAlgHom.liftNormal_commutes N x

name: AclGeom.NormalBranchEmbedding.alignmentAut_smul
statement:
theorem alignmentAut_smul [Normal E N]
    (f g : NormalBranchEmbedding E M N) :
    alignmentAut f g • f = g
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra M N := f.toAlgHom.toAlgebra
  letI : IsScalarTower E M N :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦ f.toAlgHom.commutes x |>.symm
  exact g.extendToAut_smul_canonical

name: AclGeom.NormalBranchEmbedding.extendAlong_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem extendAlong_apply [Normal E N]
    (f : M →ₐ[E] N) (e : M ≃ₐ[E] M) (x : M) :
    extendAlong f e (f x) = f (e x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun b : NormalBranchEmbedding E M N ↦ b.toAlgHom x)
    (alignmentAut_smul (⟨f⟩ : NormalBranchEmbedding E M N)
      ⟨f.comp e.toAlgHom⟩)
  exact h

name: AclGeom.NormalBranchEmbedding.alignmentAut_smul_reparametrize
statement:
theorem alignmentAut_smul_reparametrize [Normal E N]
    {M' : Type*} [Field M'] [Algebra E M']
    (f : NormalBranchEmbedding E M N)
    (g : NormalBranchEmbedding E M' N) (e : M ≃ₐ[E] M') :
    alignmentAut f (g.reparametrize e) • f = g.reparametrize e
proof:
:=
  alignmentAut_smul f (g.reparametrize e)

name: AclGeom.NormalBranchEmbedding.exists_smul_eq
statement:
theorem exists_smul_eq [Normal E N]
    (f g : NormalBranchEmbedding E M N) :
    ∃ σ : N ≃ₐ[E] N, σ • f = g
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨alignmentAut f g, alignmentAut_smul f g⟩

name: AclGeom.mulActionEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem mulActionEquiv_apply (g : G) (x : X) :
    mulActionEquiv g x = g • x
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.actionCategory_groupoidInv_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem actionCategory_groupoidInv_val
    {x y : ActionCategory G X} (f : x ⟶ y) :
    (CategoryTheory.Groupoid.inv f).hom = f.hom⁻¹
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.actionCategoryLabel_injective
statement:
theorem actionCategoryLabel_injective {x y : ActionCategory G X} :
    Function.Injective (actionCategoryLabel : (x ⟶ y) → G)
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h

name: AclGeom.actionCategoryLabel_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem actionCategoryLabel_comp

name: AclGeom.actionCategoryLabel_arrowInv

@[simp] theorem actionCategoryLabel_arrowInv

name: AclGeom.actionCategoryLabel_arrowProduct
statement:
@[simp] theorem actionCategoryLabel_arrowProduct
    {x y : ActionCategory G X} (e a b : x ⟶ y) :
    actionCategoryLabel (actionCategoryArrowProduct e a b) =
      actionCategoryLabel b *
        ((actionCategoryLabel e)⁻¹ * actionCategoryLabel a)
proof:
:= by

name: AclGeom.actionCategoryLabel_arrowInverse
statement:
@[simp] theorem actionCategoryLabel_arrowInverse
    {x y : ActionCategory G X} (e a : x ⟶ y) :
    actionCategoryLabel (actionCategoryArrowInverse e a) =
      actionCategoryLabel e *
        ((actionCategoryLabel a)⁻¹ * actionCategoryLabel e)

name: AclGeom.actionCategoryTranslationChunk_translation

name: AclGeom.normalBranchGroupoid.isConnected
statement:

name: AclGeom.finiteCoverBranchEquivOfExtensionEquiv_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteCoverBranchEquivOfExtensionEquiv_smul
    {E' L' : IntermediateField k Ω} (h : E ≤ L) (h' : E' ≤ L')
    (e : FiniteCover.ExtensionEquiv h h')
    (n : (↥(FiniteCover.normalClosureOver h)) ≃+*
      (↥(FiniteCover.normalClosureOver h')))
    (hn : n.toRingHom.comp
        (algebraMap (↥E) (↥(FiniteCover.normalClosureOver h))) =
      (algebraMap (↥E') (↥(FiniteCover.normalClosureOver h'))).comp
        e.baseEquiv.toRingEquiv.toRingHom)
    (σ : FiniteCoverDeck h) (b : FiniteCoverBranch h) :
    finiteCoverBranchEquivOfExtensionEquiv h h' e n hn (σ • b) =
      finiteCoverDeckEquivOfExtensionEquiv h h' e n hn σ •
        finiteCoverBranchEquivOfExtensionEquiv h h' e n hn b
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteCoverBranchEquivOfExtensionEquiv
    finiteCoverDeckEquivOfExtensionEquiv
    NormalBranchEmbedding.equivOfEquiv
    NormalBranchEmbedding.deckEquivOfEquiv
  ext x
  simp
  change n ((σ • b).toAlgHom (e.totalEquiv.toRingEquiv.symm x)) =
    n (σ (n.symm (n (b.toAlgHom (e.totalEquiv.toRingEquiv.symm x)))))
  rw [n.symm_apply_apply]
  rfl

name: AclGeom.finiteCoverCanonicalSelectedBranchIn_apply
statement:
theorem finiteCoverCanonicalSelectedBranchIn_apply
    [IsAlgClosed Ω] (h : E ≤ L)

    (hle : FiniteCover.canonicalNormalClosure h ≤ N)
    (x : extendScalars h) :
    (finiteCoverCanonicalSelectedBranchIn h halg N hle).toAlgHom x =
      IntermediateField.inclusion hle
        (FiniteCover.canonicalSelectedEmbedding h halg x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AclGeom.finite_coverBranches
statement:
theorem finite_coverBranches (h : E ≤ L)
    (hfin : FiniteDimensional (↥E) (↥(extendScalars h))) :
    Finite (FiniteCoverBranch h)
proof:
:= by

    fun f g hfg ↦ NormalBranchEmbedding.ext hfg

name: AclGeom.finiteCoverBranch_exists_smul_eq
statement:
theorem finiteCoverBranch_exists_smul_eq [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (h : E ≤ L)
    (hfin : FiniteDimensional (↥E) (↥(extendScalars h)))
    (f g : FiniteCoverBranch h) :
    ∃ σ : FiniteCoverDeck h, σ • f = g
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra (↥(extendScalars h))
      (↥(FiniteCover.normalClosureOver h)) :=
    (FiniteCover.selectedEmbedding h).toAlgebra
  letI : IsScalarTower (↥E) (↥(extendScalars h))
      (↥(FiniteCover.normalClosureOver h)) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦
      (FiniteCover.selectedEmbedding h).commutes x |>.symm
  letI : FiniteDimensional (↥E) (↥(extendScalars h)) := hfin
  letI : Normal (↥E) (↥(FiniteCover.normalClosureOver h)) :=
    FiniteCover.normalClosureOver_normal h
      (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_finite (↥E) (↥(extendScalars h)))
  exact NormalBranchEmbedding.exists_smul_eq f g

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoverBasedBranchEquiv.symm_trans_self

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoverBasedBranchEquiv.symm_trans_trans_symm_trans

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoverBasedBranchEquiv.groupoidEquivalence_obj_back
statement:
@[simp] theorem groupoidEquivalence_obj_back
    (T : FiniteCoverBasedBranchEquiv h h')
    (b : finiteCoverBranchGroupoid h) :
    (T.groupoidEquivalence.functor.obj b).back = T.branchEquiv b.back
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoverBasedBranchEquiv.groupoidEquivalence_obj_selected
statement:
theorem groupoidEquivalence_obj_selected
    (T : FiniteCoverBasedBranchEquiv h h') :
    T.groupoidEquivalence.functor.obj (finiteCoverSelectedObject h) =
      finiteCoverSelectedObject h'
proof:
:= by

      (x := T.groupoidEquivalence.functor.obj
        (finiteCoverSelectedObject h)),
    ← ActionCategory.back_coe (x := finiteCoverSelectedObject h')]

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoverBasedBranchEquiv.arrowEquiv_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem arrowEquiv_val (T : FiniteCoverBasedBranchEquiv h h')
    (b : finiteCoverBranchGroupoid h)
    (a : finiteCoverSelectedObject h ⟶ b) :
    (T.arrowEquiv b a).hom = T.deckEquiv a.hom
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoverBasedBranchEquiv.arrowEquiv_differenceProduct
statement:
theorem arrowEquiv_differenceProduct
    (T : FiniteCoverBasedBranchEquiv h h')
    (b : finiteCoverBranchGroupoid h)
    (e a c : finiteCoverSelectedObject h ⟶ b) :
    T.arrowEquiv b (groupoidDifferenceProduct e a c) =
      groupoidDifferenceProduct
        (T.arrowEquiv b e) (T.arrowEquiv b a) (T.arrowEquiv b c)
proof:
:= by
  let ε : FiniteCoverDeck h := e.hom
  let α : FiniteCoverDeck h := a.hom
  let γ : FiniteCoverDeck h := c.hom
  have hsrc : (a ≫ CategoryTheory.Groupoid.inv e ≫ c).hom =
      γ * ε⁻¹ * α := rfl
  have htgt : (T.arrowEquiv b a ≫
      CategoryTheory.Groupoid.inv (T.arrowEquiv b e) ≫
        T.arrowEquiv b c).hom =
      T.deckEquiv γ * (T.deckEquiv ε)⁻¹ * T.deckEquiv α := rfl
  apply Functor.Elements.hom_ext
  refine (arrowEquiv_val T b _).trans ?_
  unfold groupoidDifferenceProduct
  rw [← CategoryTheory.Groupoid.inv_eq_inv e,
    ← CategoryTheory.Groupoid.inv_eq_inv (T.arrowEquiv b e)]
  calc
    T.deckEquiv (a ≫ CategoryTheory.Groupoid.inv e ≫ c).hom =
        T.deckEquiv (γ * ε⁻¹ * α) := congrArg T.deckEquiv hsrc
    _ = T.deckEquiv γ * (T.deckEquiv ε)⁻¹ * T.deckEquiv α := by simp
    _ = (T.arrowEquiv b a ≫
        CategoryTheory.Groupoid.inv (T.arrowEquiv b e) ≫
          T.arrowEquiv b c).hom := htgt.symm

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoverBasedBranchEquiv.arrowEquiv_differenceInverse
statement:
theorem arrowEquiv_differenceInverse
    (T : FiniteCoverBasedBranchEquiv h h')
    (b : finiteCoverBranchGroupoid h)
    (e a : finiteCoverSelectedObject h ⟶ b) :
    T.arrowEquiv b (groupoidDifferenceInverse e a) =
      groupoidDifferenceInverse (T.arrowEquiv b e) (T.arrowEquiv b a)
proof:
:= by
  let ε : FiniteCoverDeck h := e.hom
  let α : FiniteCoverDeck h := a.hom
  have hsrc : (e ≫ CategoryTheory.Groupoid.inv a ≫ e).hom =
      ε * α⁻¹ * ε := rfl
  have htgt : (T.arrowEquiv b e ≫
      CategoryTheory.Groupoid.inv (T.arrowEquiv b a) ≫
        T.arrowEquiv b e).hom =
      T.deckEquiv ε * (T.deckEquiv α)⁻¹ * T.deckEquiv ε := rfl
  apply Functor.Elements.hom_ext
  refine (arrowEquiv_val T b _).trans ?_
  unfold groupoidDifferenceInverse
  rw [← CategoryTheory.Groupoid.inv_eq_inv a,
    ← CategoryTheory.Groupoid.inv_eq_inv (T.arrowEquiv b a)]
  calc
    T.deckEquiv (e ≫ CategoryTheory.Groupoid.inv a ≫ e).hom =
        T.deckEquiv (ε * α⁻¹ * ε) := congrArg T.deckEquiv hsrc
    _ = T.deckEquiv ε * (T.deckEquiv α)⁻¹ * T.deckEquiv ε := by simp
    _ = (T.arrowEquiv b e ≫
        CategoryTheory.Groupoid.inv (T.arrowEquiv b a) ≫
          T.arrowEquiv b e).hom := htgt.symm

name: AclGeom.finiteCoverBranchGroupoid_isConnected
statement:
theorem finiteCoverBranchGroupoid_isConnected [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (h : E ≤ L)
    (hfin : FiniteDimensional (↥E) (↥(extendScalars h))) :
    IsConnected (finiteCoverBranchGroupoid h)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Nonempty (FiniteCoverBranch h) :=
    ⟨finiteCoverSelectedBranch h⟩
  letI : MulAction.IsPretransitive (FiniteCoverDeck h)
      (FiniteCoverBranch h) :=
    MulAction.IsPretransitive.mk
      (finiteCoverBranch_exists_smul_eq h hfin)
  infer_instance

name: AclGeom.exists_relation_of_mem_racl_pair
proof:
:= by
  have hn : ¬AlgebraicIndependent k ![t, u, v] := by
    intro hi
    have hm := AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_image hi
      (S := ({0, 1} : Set (Fin 3))) (i := 2) (by decide)
    apply hm
    simpa [Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton] using hv
  rw [algebraicIndependent_iff] at hn
  push Not at hn
  obtain ⟨P, hzero, hne⟩ := hn
  exact ⟨P, hne, hzero⟩

name: AclGeom.mem_racl_of_relation
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hv
  have hi : AlgebraicIndependent k ![u, v] := by
    have hsingle : AlgebraicIndependent k ![u] := algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff.mpr hu
    have hn : v ∉ racl k (Set.range (![u] : Fin 1 → K)) := by simpa using hv
    convert algebraicIndependent_snoc hsingle hn using 1
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  exact hP (hi.eq_zero_of_aeval_eq_zero P hz)

name: AclGeom.specialize_relation
statement:
private theorem specialize_relation {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
    (ι : R →ₐ[k] K) (hι : Function.Injective ι) (φ : R →ₐ[k] K)
    {n : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k) (t : R) (v : Fin n → R)
    (c : k) (hc : φ t = algebraMap k K c)
    (hz : aeval (Fin.cons (ι t) (fun i ↦ ι (v i))) P = 0) :
    aeval (fun i ↦ φ (v i)) ((finSuccEquiv k n P).eval (C c)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : aeval (Fin.cons t v) P = 0 := by
    apply hι
    rw [map_zero, MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply]
    have heq : (fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦ ι ((Fin.cons t v : Fin (n + 1) → R) i)) =
        Fin.cons (ι t) (fun i ↦ ι (v i)) := by
      funext i
      exact Fin.cases rfl (fun _ ↦ rfl) i
    rw [heq]
    exact hz
  rw [aeval_specialize_first]
  have heq : Fin.cons (algebraMap k K c) (fun i ↦ φ (v i)) =
      fun i : Fin (n + 1) ↦ φ ((Fin.cons t v : Fin (n + 1) → R) i) := by
    ext i
    exact Fin.cases hc.symm (fun _ ↦ rfl) i
  rw [heq, ← MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply, hzero, map_zero]

name: AclGeom.transcendental_mul_of_mem_racl
proof:
:= by
  intro halg
  have hm : β * x ∈ racl k {a} :=
    racl_mono (Set.empty_subset _) (mem_racl_empty_of_isAlgebraic halg)
  have hd := div_mem hm hβ
  rw [mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hβ0] at hd
  exact hx hd

name: AclGeom.exists_multiplier_descent
statement:
theorem exists_multiplier_descent
    {F : Type*} [Field F] [IsAlgClosed F] [Infinite k]
    [Algebra k F] [Algebra F K] [IsScalarTower k F K]
    (a b c x y : F) {t α : K} (ht : Transcendental F t)
    (hi : AlgebraicIndependent k
      ![algebraMap F K a, algebraMap F K x, algebraMap F K y])
    (hα0 : α ≠ 0) (hα : α ∈ racl k {t, algebraMap F K a})
    (hb : algebraMap F K b ∈ racl k {t, α * algebraMap F K x})
    (hc : algebraMap F K c ∈ racl k {t, α * algebraMap F K y}) :
    ∃ β : K, β ≠ 0 ∧ β ∈ racl k {algebraMap F K a} ∧
      algebraMap F K b ∈ racl k {β * algebraMap F K x} ∧
      algebraMap F K c ∈ racl k {β * algebraMap F K y}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQzero⟩ := exists_relation_of_mem_racl_pair hα
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hPzero⟩ := exists_relation_of_mem_racl_pair hb
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hTzero⟩ := exists_relation_of_mem_racl_pair hc
  obtain ⟨R, htR, hsR, ℓ, φ, hφ, hgood⟩ :=
    exists_finite_specialization_preserving_polynomials ht {α, α⁻¹} {Q, P, T} (by
      intro W hW
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hW
      rcases hW with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> assumption)
  let tR : R := ⟨t, htR⟩
  let αR : R := ⟨α, hsR (by simp)⟩
  let αinvR : R := ⟨α⁻¹, hsR (by simp)⟩
  let ι : R →ₐ[k] K := R.val.restrictScalars k
  let ψ : R →ₐ[k] K := (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k F K).comp (φ.restrictScalars k)
  have hι : Function.Injective ι := Subtype.val_injective
  have hψ : ψ tR = algebraMap k K ℓ := by
    change algebraMap F K (φ ⟨t, htR⟩) = _
    rw [hφ, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k F K]
  have hfix (z : F) : ψ (algebraMap F R z) = algebraMap F K z := by
    change algebraMap F K (φ (algebraMap F R z)) = _
    rw [φ.commutes, Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply]
  let β := ψ αR
  have hβ0 : β ≠ 0 := by
    have hunit : αR * αinvR = 1 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact mul_inv_cancel₀ hα0
    have heq := congrArg ψ hunit
    rw [map_mul, map_one] at heq
    exact left_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one heq
  have hmap (f : R → K) (u v : R) : (fun i ↦ f (![u, v] i)) = ![f u, f v] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hQ' := specialize_relation ι hι ψ Q tR ![algebraMap F R a, αR] ℓ hψ
    (by simpa [hmap, ι, tR, αR] using hQzero)
  have hP' := specialize_relation ι hι ψ P tR ![αR * algebraMap F R x, algebraMap F R b]
    ℓ hψ (by simpa [hmap, ι, tR, αR] using hPzero)
  have hT' := specialize_relation ι hι ψ T tR ![αR * algebraMap F R y, algebraMap F R c]
    ℓ hψ (by simpa [hmap, ι, tR, αR] using hTzero)
  have hQspec : aeval ![algebraMap F K a, β]
      ((finSuccEquiv k 2 Q).eval (C ℓ)) = 0 := by
    simpa only [hmap, hfix] using hQ'
  have hPspec : aeval ![β * algebraMap F K x, algebraMap F K b]
      ((finSuccEquiv k 2 P).eval (C ℓ)) = 0 := by
    simpa only [hmap, map_mul, hfix] using hP'
  have hTspec : aeval ![β * algebraMap F K y, algebraMap F K c]
      ((finSuccEquiv k 2 T).eval (C ℓ)) = 0 := by
    simpa only [hmap, map_mul, hfix] using hT'
  have hβ : β ∈ racl k {algebraMap F K a} :=
    mem_racl_of_relation (hi.transcendental 0) (hgood Q (by simp)) hQspec
  have hx : algebraMap F K x ∉ racl k {algebraMap F K a} :=
    AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_pair
      (AlgebraicIndependent.comp_pair hi (i := 0) (j := 1) (by decide))
  have hy : algebraMap F K y ∉ racl k {algebraMap F K a} :=
    AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_pair
      (AlgebraicIndependent.comp_pair hi (i := 0) (j := 2) (by decide))
  exact ⟨β, hβ0, hβ,
    mem_racl_of_relation (transcendental_mul_of_mem_racl hx hβ hβ0) (hgood P (by simp)) hPspec,
    mem_racl_of_relation (transcendental_mul_of_mem_racl hy hβ hβ0) (hgood T (by simp)) hTspec⟩

name: AclGeom.weight_two_one
statement: theorem weight_two_one (m : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) : Finsupp.weight ![2, 1] m = 2 * m 0 + m 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.weight_apply, Finsupp.sum_fintype _ _ (by simp)]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: AclGeom.isWeightedHomogeneous_of_support_pairs
statement:
theorem isWeightedHomogeneous_of_support_pairs {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) M} (hF0 : F ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ m₁ ∈ F.support, ∀ m₂ ∈ F.support,
      2 * ((m₁ 0 : ℤ) - m₂ 0) + ((m₁ 1 : ℤ) - m₂ 1) = 0) :
    ∃ W : ℕ, F.IsWeightedHomogeneous ![2, 1] W
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 fun he ↦ hF0 (support_eq_empty.1 he)
  refine ⟨2 * m 0 + m 1, fun ⦃d⦄ hd ↦ ?_⟩
  have := h d (mem_support_iff.2 hd) m hm
  rw [weight_two_one]
  omega

name: AclGeom.isAlgebraic_div_sq_of_isWeightedHomogeneous
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hw : ∀ m ∈ F.support, 2 * m 0 + m 1 = W := fun m hm ↦ by
    rw [← weight_two_one]
    exact hF (mem_support_iff.1 hm)
  
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : Polynomial M,
      P = ∑ m ∈ F.support, Polynomial.monomial (m 0) (F.coeff m) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  
  have heval : MvPolynomial.aeval ![s, u] F = u ^ W * Polynomial.aeval (s / u ^ 2) P := by
    rw [hP, MvPolynomial.aeval_def, MvPolynomial.eval₂_eq', map_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m hm ↦ ?_
    rw [Polynomial.aeval_monomial, Fin.prod_univ_two]
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
    have hW : u ^ W = u ^ (2 * m 0) * u ^ m 1 := by
      rw [← pow_add, hw m hm]
    rw [hW, div_pow, ← pow_mul, mul_div_assoc', mul_div_assoc', eq_div_iff (pow_ne_zero _ hu)]
    ring
  
  
  obtain ⟨m', hm'⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 fun he ↦ hF0 (support_eq_empty.1 he)
  have hcoeff : P.coeff (m' 0) = F.coeff m' := by
    rw [hP, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_monomial]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single m']
    · simp
    · intro m hm hne
      refine ite_eq_right_iff.2 fun h0 ↦ absurd ?_ hne
      ext j
      fin_cases j
      · exact h0
      · change m 1 = m' 1
        have h1 := hw m hm
        have h2 := hw m' hm'
        omega
    · intro hnot
      exact absurd hm' hnot
  have hP0 : P ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦ (mem_support_iff.1 hm') (by
    rw [← hcoeff, h0, Polynomial.coeff_zero])
  refine ⟨P, hP0, ?_⟩
  have h0 : u ^ W * Polynomial.aeval (s / u ^ 2) P = 0 := by
    rw [← heval]
    exact hsu
  exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h0).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero _ hu)

name: AclGeom.CurvePointsPlaces.algebraMap_mem_stalkValuationSubring
statement:
theorem algebraMap_mem_stalkValuationSubring
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left] [IsLocallyNoetherian X.left]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left ≤ 1)
    (hnormal : ∀ x : X.left, IsIntegrallyClosed (X.left.presheaf.stalk x))
    (x : X.left) (c : k) :
    algebraMap k X.left.functionField c ∈ stalkValuationSubring X.left hdim hnormal x
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty (⊤ : X.left.Opens) := ⟨⟨genericPoint X.left, trivial⟩⟩
  let r : Γ(X.left, ⊤) := ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ X.hom.appTop).hom c
  apply (mem_stalkValuationSubring X.left hdim hnormal x _).mpr
  have hxTop : x ∈ (⊤ : X.left.Opens) := by trivial
  refine ⟨X.left.presheaf.germ ⊤ x hxTop r, ?_⟩
  refine (Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField X.left hxTop r).trans ?_
  rw [ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAlgebra_eq_germ X]
  rfl

name: AclGeom.CurvePointsPlaces.mem_closedPointPlace
statement:
theorem mem_closedPointPlace
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left] [IsProper X.hom]

      ∃ r : X.left.presheaf.stalk x.val,

proof:
