name: AclGeom.ProperCurve.existsUnique_iso_of_functionFieldEquiv
statement:
theorem existsUnique_iso_of_functionFieldEquiv
    (X Y : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left] [IsIntegral Y.left]
    (hdimX : topologicalKrullDim X.left ≤ 1)
    (hdimY : topologicalKrullDim Y.left ≤ 1)
    (hnormalX : ∀ x : X.left, IsIntegrallyClosed (X.left.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hnormalY : ∀ y : Y.left, IsIntegrallyClosed (Y.left.presheaf.stalk y))
    [IsProper X.hom] [IsProper Y.hom]
    (E : X.left.functionField ≃ₐ[k] Y.left.functionField) :
    ∃! e : X ≅ Y, e.hom.left.toRationalMap.fromFunctionField =
      Scheme.functionFieldMorphism E.toRingEquiv
proof:
:= by
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian X.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian X.hom
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian Y.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian Y.hom
  have : X.left.IsSeparated := by
    constructor
    rw [← Limits.terminal.comp_from X.hom]
    infer_instance
  have : Y.left.IsSeparated := by
    constructor
    rw [← Limits.terminal.comp_from Y.hom]
    infer_instance
  let φ : (Spec X.left.functionField).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ Y :=
    (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom E.symm.toAlgHom).op ≫
      SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter Y
  let ψ : (Spec Y.left.functionField).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ X :=
    (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom E.toAlgHom).op ≫
      SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter X
  have hφ : φ.left = Scheme.functionFieldMorphism E.toRingEquiv := rfl
  have hψ : ψ.left = Scheme.functionFieldMorphism E.symm.toRingEquiv := rfl
  have hφbase : φ.left ≫ Y.hom =
      X.left.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X.left) ≫ X.hom :=
    (Over.w φ).trans (Over.w (SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter X)).symm
  have hψbase : ψ.left ≫ X.hom =
      Y.left.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Y.left) ≫ Y.hom :=
    (Over.w ψ).trans (Over.w (SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter Y)).symm
  let f := Scheme.RationalMap.ofFunctionField X.hom Y.hom φ.left hφbase
  let g := Scheme.RationalMap.ofFunctionField Y.hom X.hom ψ.left hψbase
  have hf : f.fromFunctionField = Scheme.functionFieldMorphism E.toRingEquiv :=
    (Scheme.RationalMap.fromFunctionField_ofFunctionField _ _ _ _).trans hφ
  have hg : g.fromFunctionField = Scheme.functionFieldMorphism E.symm.toRingEquiv :=
    (Scheme.RationalMap.fromFunctionField_ofFunctionField _ _ _ _).trans hψ
  have hfbase : f.compHom Y.hom = X.hom.toRationalMap :=
    ((Scheme.RationalMap.equivFunctionField X.hom Y.hom) ⟨φ.left, hφbase⟩).property
  have hgbase : g.compHom X.hom = Y.hom.toRationalMap :=
    ((Scheme.RationalMap.equivFunctionField Y.hom X.hom) ⟨ψ.left, hψbase⟩).property
  have : f.IsDominant := by
    apply Scheme.RationalMap.isDominant_of_fromFunctionField_closedPoint
    rw [hf]
    exact Scheme.functionFieldMorphism_closedPoint _
  have : g.IsDominant := by
    apply Scheme.RationalMap.isDominant_of_fromFunctionField_closedPoint
    rw [hg]
    exact Scheme.functionFieldMorphism_closedPoint _
  have hfg := Scheme.RationalMap.comp_eq_id_of_fromFunctionField_eq
    f g E.toRingEquiv hf hg
  have hgf := Scheme.RationalMap.comp_eq_id_of_fromFunctionField_eq
    g f E.symm.toRingEquiv hg hf
  obtain ⟨F, ⟨hF, hFbase⟩, _⟩ :=
    existsUnique_extension hdimX hnormalX X.hom Y.hom f hfbase
  obtain ⟨H, ⟨hH, hHbase⟩, _⟩ :=
    existsUnique_extension hdimY hnormalY Y.hom X.hom g hgbase
  have hFH : F ≫ H = 𝟙 X.left := by
    apply hom_eq_of_toRationalMap_eq
    change (F ≫ H).toPartialMap.toRationalMap = _
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.toPartialMap_compHom,
      Scheme.RationalMap.compHom_toRationalMap]
    change F.toRationalMap.compHom H = _
    rw [hF, ← Scheme.RationalMap.comp_toRationalMap, hH]
    exact hfg
  have hHF : H ≫ F = 𝟙 Y.left := by
    apply hom_eq_of_toRationalMap_eq
    change (H ≫ F).toPartialMap.toRationalMap = _
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.toPartialMap_compHom,
      Scheme.RationalMap.compHom_toRationalMap]
    change H.toRationalMap.compHom F = _
    rw [hH, ← Scheme.RationalMap.comp_toRationalMap, hF]
    exact hgf
  let e : X ≅ Y := Over.isoMk
    { hom := F, inv := H, hom_inv_id := hFH, inv_hom_id := hHF } hFbase
  have he : e.hom.left.toRationalMap.fromFunctionField =
      Scheme.functionFieldMorphism E.toRingEquiv :=
    (congrArg Scheme.RationalMap.fromFunctionField hF).trans hf
  refine ⟨e, he, ?_⟩
  intro d hd
  apply Iso.ext
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  apply hom_eq_of_toRationalMap_eq
  apply Scheme.RationalMap.eq_of_fromFunctionField_eq
  exact hd.trans he.symm

name: AclGeom.ProperCurve.isIso_of_isIso_functionFieldMap
statement:
theorem isIso_of_isIso_functionFieldMap
    (X Y : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left] [IsIntegral Y.left]
    (hdimX : topologicalKrullDim X.left ≤ 1)
    (hdimY : topologicalKrullDim Y.left ≤ 1)
    (hnormalX : ∀ x : X.left, IsIntegrallyClosed (X.left.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hnormalY : ∀ y : Y.left, IsIntegrallyClosed (Y.left.presheaf.stalk y))
    [IsProper X.hom] [IsProper Y.hom]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsDominant f.left] [IsIso f.left.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap] :
    IsIso f
proof:
:= by
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian X.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian X.hom
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian Y.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian Y.hom
  have : Y.left.IsSeparated := by
    constructor
    rw [← Limits.terminal.comp_from Y.hom]
    infer_instance
  let A : Y.left.functionField ≃ₐ[k] X.left.functionField :=
    AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv
      (f := (asIso f.left.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv)
      (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldMap_algebraMap f)
  let E := A.symm
  have hmap : f.left.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap =
      CommRingCat.ofHom E.symm.toRingHom := by
    ext z
    rfl
  have hgeneric : f.left.toRationalMap.fromFunctionField =
      Scheme.functionFieldMorphism E.toRingEquiv :=
    Scheme.PartialMap.fromFunctionField_eq_of_functionFieldMap_eq
      f.left.toPartialMap E.toRingEquiv hmap
  obtain ⟨e, he, _⟩ := existsUnique_iso_of_functionFieldEquiv
    X Y hdimX hdimY hnormalX hnormalY E
  have hfe : f = e.hom := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    apply hom_eq_of_toRationalMap_eq
    apply Scheme.RationalMap.eq_of_fromFunctionField_eq
    exact hgeneric.trans he.symm
  rw [hfe]
  infer_instance

name: AclGeom.SchemeAffineMorphism.exists_affine_morphism
statement:
theorem exists_affine_morphism
    (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (hker : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
      ModObj.pointAct V q = 𝟙 V → q = 1)
    (hdimG : (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDim G.toAlgebraicGroup.carrier)
    (hdimV : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1) :
    ∃ t : V.left.functionField, Transcendental k t ∧
      IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set V.left.functionField) = ⊤ ∧
      ∃ Φ : (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) →* AffineTransformation k,
        Function.Injective Φ ∧
        (∀ q, (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V q).unop t =
          algebraMap k V.left.functionField ((Φ q).multiplier : k) * t +
            algebraMap k V.left.functionField (Φ q).shift) ∧
      ∃ f : G.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k),
        Function.Injective (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X ↦
          q ≫ f.hom.hom) ∧
        (∀ q, AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom) = Φ q) ∧
          ∃ (W : Over (Spec (.of k))) (hI : IsIntegral W.left) (hA : IsAffine W.left)
            (j : W ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) (_ : IsOpenImmersion j.left),
            letI
proof:
:= hI
            letI := hA
            letI := sectionsAlgebra W
            let A : Type u := Γ(W.left, ⊤)
            let C := FractionRing A
            let F : Type u := V.left.functionField
            let E := FractionRing (C ⊗[k] F)
            let g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X :=
              (sectionsSpecIso W).inv ≫ j
            let evC : A →ₐ[k] C := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A C
            let τ := sectionsTensorAut V ((algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom evC).op ≫ g)
            let T := algebraMap (C ⊗[k] F) E (1 ⊗ₜ[k] t)
            Algebra.FiniteType k A ∧
              ∃ d a b : A, d ≠ 0 ∧ a ≠ 0 ∧
                FiniteDimensional
                  (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({evC a / evC d, evC b / evC d} : Set C)) C ∧
                IsTranscendenceBasis k (![evC a / evC d, evC b / evC d] : Fin 2 → C) ∧
                (∀ (φ : A →ₐ[k] k), φ d ≠ 0 →
                  (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V
                    ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
                      (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)).unop t =
                        algebraMap k F (φ a / φ d) * t + algebraMap k F (φ b / φ d)) ∧
                ∃ hCF : IsDomain (C ⊗[k] F),
                  letI := hCF
                  ∃ hCR : IsDomain (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)),
                    letI := hCR
                    ∃ (σ : E ≃ₐ[C] E) (e : E ≃ₐ[C] FractionRing (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤))),
                      (∀ (c : C) (r : Γ(V.left, ⊤)),
                        e (algebraMap (C ⊗[k] F) E
                          (c ⊗ₜ[k] V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤
                            (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint _, trivial⟩⟩) r)) =
                              algebraMap (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)) _ (c ⊗ₜ[k] r)) ∧
                      (∀ x, e (σ x) = IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv τ (e x)) ∧
                      σ T = algebraMap C E (evC a / evC d) * T +
                        algebraMap C E (evC b / evC d) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htop, Φ, hΦinj, hΦ, W, hI, hA, j, hOpen, hft,
    d, a, b, hd, ha, hfinite, hbasis, hformula, hCF, hCR, σ, e, he, hcompare, hgeneric⟩ :=
    SchemeAffineParameters.exists_affine_parameters G V hker hdimG hdimV
  have := hI
  have := hA
  have := hOpen
  let A : Type u := Γ(W.left, ⊤)
  let : Algebra k A := sectionsAlgebra W
  have : Algebra.FiniteType k A := hft
  let g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X :=
    (sectionsSpecIso W).inv ≫ j
  have : IsIso (sectionsSpecIso W).inv.left :=
    ActionFunctionField.isIso_inv_left (sectionsSpecIso W)
  have : IsOpenImmersion g.left := by
    change IsOpenImmersion ((sectionsSpecIso W).inv.left ≫ j.left)
    infer_instance
  have hfield (φ : A →ₐ[k] k) (hdφ : φ d ≠ 0) :
      algebraMap k V.left.functionField ((Φ ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
        (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)).multiplier : k) * t +
      algebraMap k V.left.functionField (Φ ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
        (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)).shift =
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField (φ a / φ d) * t +
          algebraMap k V.left.functionField (φ b / φ d) :=
    (hΦ _).symm.trans (hformula φ hdφ)
  obtain ⟨U, jU, hJU, p0, fU, hU⟩ :=
    exists_local_model G.toAlgebraicGroup ht Φ g d a b hd ha hfield
  have := hJU
  let Ψ := (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k).symm.toMonoidHom.comp Φ
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_extension G (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k) U jU p0 Ψ fU hU
  have hpoint (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) :
      AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom) = Φ q := by
    rw [hf]
    exact (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k).apply_symm_apply (Φ q)
  have hfinj : Function.Injective
      (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X ↦ q ≫ f.hom.hom) := by
    intro q r hqr
    change q ≫ f.hom.hom = r ≫ f.hom.hom at hqr
    apply hΦinj
    exact (hpoint q).symm.trans
      ((congrArg (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k) hqr).trans (hpoint r))
  exact ⟨t, ht, htop, Φ, hΦinj, hΦ, f, hfinj, hpoint,
    W, hI, hA, j, hOpen, hft, d, a, b, hd, ha, hfinite, hbasis, hformula,
    hCF, hCR, σ, e, he, hcompare, hgeneric⟩

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionChart.adjoin_liftedCoordinates_eq_top

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionChart.adjoin_generators_eq_top
statement:
theorem adjoin_generators_eq_top (a : ι → K)
    (ha : adjoin k (Set.range a) = ⊤) :
    adjoin k (Set.range (generators (K := K) (L := L) a)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let b := Module.finBasis K L
  let e : K →ₐ[k] L := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k K L
  let F := adjoin k (Set.range (generators (K := K) (L := L) a))
  have hmap : (⊤ : IntermediateField k K).map e ≤ F := by
    rw [← ha, adjoin_map]
    apply adjoin.mono
    rintro y ⟨x, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact Set.mem_range_self
      (Sum.inl i : ι ⊕ Fin (Module.finrank K L))
  apply top_unique
  intro z hz
  change z ∈ F
  rw [← b.sum_repr z]
  apply sum_mem
  intro i hi
  rw [Algebra.smul_def]
  apply mul_mem
  · apply hmap
    change e (b.repr z i) ∈ (⊤ : IntermediateField k K).map e
    exact ⟨b.repr z i, Set.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
  · exact subset_adjoin k
      (Set.range (generators (K := K) (L := L) a))
      (Set.mem_range_self
        (Sum.inr i : ι ⊕ Fin (Module.finrank K L)))

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionChart.adjoin_coordinateGenerators_eq_top
statement:
theorem adjoin_coordinateGenerators_eq_top (a : ι → K) :
    Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range
      (coordinateGenerators (k := k) (K := K) (L := L) a)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let C := coordinateRing (k := k) (K := K) (L := L) a
  apply Subalgebra.map_injective (f := C.val) Subtype.val_injective
  rw [AlgHom.map_adjoin, Algebra.map_top, Subalgebra.range_val]
  change Algebra.adjoin k
      (C.val '' Set.range
        (coordinateGenerators (k := k) (K := K) (L := L) a)) = C
  have hrange : C.val '' Set.range
      (coordinateGenerators (k := k) (K := K) (L := L) a) =
      Set.range (generators (K := K) (L := L) a) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨c, ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨i, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨coordinateGenerators (k := k) (K := K) (L := L) a i,
        ⟨i, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [hrange]
  rfl

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionChart.isFractionRing_extension
statement:
theorem isFractionRing_extension (a : ι → K)
    (ha : adjoin k (Set.range a) = ⊤) :
    IsFractionRing
      (coordinateRing (k := k) (K := K) (L := L) a) L
proof:
:= by
  apply IsFractionRing.of_field
  intro z
  let z' : generatedField (k := k) (K := K) (L := L) a :=
    ⟨z, by
      change z ∈ adjoin k
        (Set.range (generators (K := K) (L := L) a))
      rw [adjoin_generators_eq_top (K := K) (L := L) a ha]
      trivial⟩
  obtain ⟨x, y, hy, hxy⟩ :=
    IsFractionRing.div_surjective
      (coordinateRing (k := k) (K := K) (L := L) a) z'
  refine ⟨x, y, ?_⟩
  exact (congr_arg Subtype.val hxy).symm

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionChart.functionFieldAlgEquiv_toStalk
statement:
theorem functionFieldAlgEquiv_toStalk (a : ι → K)
    (ha : adjoin k (Set.range a) = ⊤)
    (z : coordinateRing (k := k) (K := K) (L := L) a) :
    functionFieldAlgEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (L := L) a ha
        ((StructureSheaf.toStalk
          (coordinateRing (k := k) (K := K) (L := L) a)
          (genericPoint (scheme (k := k) (K := K) (L := L) a))) z) =
      (z : L)
proof:
:= by
  unfold scheme
  let A := coordinateRing (k := k) (K := K) (L := L) a
  letI : Algebra A (Spec (.of A)).functionField :=
    RingHom.toAlgebra <| (StructureSheaf.toStalk A
      (genericPoint (Spec (.of A)))).hom
  letI : IsFractionRing A (Spec (.of A)).functionField := by
    change IsFractionRing (↑(CommRingCat.of A)) _
    exact functionField_isFractionRing_of_affine _
  letI : IsFractionRing A L := isFractionRing_extension a ha
  unfold functionFieldAlgEquiv
  dsimp only
  exact (IsLocalization.algEquiv (nonZeroDivisors A)
    (Spec (.of A)).functionField L).commutes z

name: AclGeom.RegularGroupMorphism.hom_ext_points
statement:
private theorem hom_ext_points (X Y : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsReduced X.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom] [IsSeparated Y.hom]
    (f g : X ⟶ Y)
    (h : ∀ p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ X, p ≫ f = p ≫ g) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType (f.left ≫ Y.hom) := by
    rw [Over.w f]
    infer_instance
  refine AlgebraicGeometry.ext_of_apply_eq Y.hom Set.univ isClosed_univ.isLocallyClosed
    dense_univ ?_ ((Over.w f).trans (Over.w g).symm)
  intro x _ hx
  let p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ X :=
    Over.homMk (pointOfClosedPoint X.hom x hx) (pointOfClosedPoint_comp X.hom x hx)
  have he := congrArg (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ Y ↦
    q.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) (h p)
  change f.left (pointOfClosedPoint X.hom x hx (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) =
    g.left (pointOfClosedPoint X.hom x hx (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) at he
  have hp : pointOfClosedPoint X.hom x hx (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) = x :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.pointOfClosedPoint_apply X.hom x hx _
  simpa only [hp] using he

name: AclGeom.RegularGroupMorphism.AclGeom.RegularGroupMorphism.translated_isOpenImmersion
statement:
private theorem translated_isOpenImmersion (G : AlgebraicGroup k)
    (U : Over (Spec (.of k))) (j : U ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) [IsOpenImmersion j.left]
    (g : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) :
    IsOpenImmersion (j ≫ GroupScheme.leftMul G.toGroupScheme.X g).left
proof:
:= by
  have : IsIso (GroupScheme.leftMul G.toGroupScheme.X g).left := by
    change IsIso (((Over.forget (Spec (.of k))).mapIso (GroupScheme.leftMulIso g)).hom)
    infer_instance
  change IsOpenImmersion (j.left ≫ (GroupScheme.leftMul G.toGroupScheme.X g).left)
  infer_instance

name: AclGeom.RegularGroupMorphism.AclGeom.RegularGroupMorphism.translated_covers
statement:
private theorem translated_covers (G : AlgebraicGroup k)
    (U : Over (Spec (.of k))) (j : U ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) [IsOpenImmersion j.left]
    (p0 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ U) (x : G.carrier) :
    ∃ (g : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) (y : U.left),
      (j ≫ GroupScheme.leftMul G.toGroupScheme.X g).left y = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : JacobsonSpace G.carrier := LocallyOfFiniteType.jacobsonSpace G.structureMap
  let S : Set G.carrier := ⋃ g : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
    Set.range (j ≫ GroupScheme.leftMul G.toGroupScheme.X g).left
  have hopen : IsOpen S := isOpen_iUnion fun g ↦ by
    have := translated_isOpenImmersion G U j g
    exact IsOpenImmersion.isOpen_range _
  have hclosed (z : G.carrier) (hz : IsClosed {z}) : z ∈ S := by
    let q := GroupScheme.pointsEquivClosedPoints.symm ⟨z, hz⟩
    let g := q * (p0 ≫ j)⁻¹
    have hq : q.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) = z := by
      have h := congrArg Subtype.val
        (GroupScheme.pointsEquivClosedPoints.apply_symm_apply ⟨z, hz⟩)
      exact h
    have hp : p0 ≫ (j ≫ GroupScheme.leftMul G.toGroupScheme.X g) = q := by
      rw [← Category.assoc, GroupScheme.point_comp_leftMul]
      dsimp only [g]
      rw [_root_.mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, _root_.mul_one]
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨g, p0.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k), ?_⟩
    change (p0 ≫ (j ≫ GroupScheme.leftMul G.toGroupScheme.X g)).left
      (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) = z
    rw [hp]
    exact hq
  have hzero : Sᶜ ∩ closedPoints G.carrier = ∅ := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      exact hz.1 (hclosed z hz.2)
    · intro hz
      exact hz.elim
  have hempty : Sᶜ = ∅ := by
    have h := closure_inter_closedPoints hopen.isClosed_compl
    rw [hzero, closure_empty] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hx : x ∈ S := by
    by_contra hn
    have : x ∈ Sᶜ := hn
    rw [hempty] at this
    exact this
  obtain ⟨g, y, hy⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
  exact ⟨g, y, hy⟩

name: AclGeom.RegularGroupMorphism.AclGeom.RegularGroupMorphism.AclGeom.RegularGroupMorphism.exists_extension
statement:
theorem exists_extension (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k) (H : AlgebraicGroup k)
    (U : Over (Spec (.of k))) (j : U ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) [IsOpenImmersion j.left]
    (p0 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ U)
    (Φ : (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) →*
      (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ H.toGroupScheme.X))
    (fU : U ⟶ H.toGroupScheme.X)
    (hU : ∀ p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ U, p ≫ fU = Φ (p ≫ j)) :
    ∃ f : G.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom H, ∀ q, q ≫ f.hom.hom = Φ q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let GX := G.toGroupScheme.X
  let HX := H.toGroupScheme.X
  let ig (g : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) : U ⟶ GX :=
    j ≫ GroupScheme.leftMul GX g
  let fg (g : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) : U ⟶ HX :=
    fU ≫ GroupScheme.leftMul HX (Φ g)
  let Q := translatedCover G.toAlgebraicGroup U j p0
  have : IsReduced U.left := isReduced_of_isOpenImmersion j.left
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType U.hom := by
    rw [← Over.w j]
    infer_instance
  have hlocal (g : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX)
      (p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ U) : p ≫ fg g = Φ (p ≫ ig g) := by
    dsimp only [fg, ig]
    rw [← Category.assoc, GroupScheme.point_comp_leftMul, hU, ← Φ.map_mul,
      ← GroupScheme.point_comp_leftMul, Category.assoc]
  have hcompat (g h : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) :
      pullback.fst (Q.f g) (Q.f h) ≫ (fg g).left =
        pullback.snd (Q.f g) (Q.f h) ≫ (fg h).left := by
    let W : Over (Spec (.of k)) := Over.mk (pullback.fst (Q.f g) (Q.f h) ≫ U.hom)
    have : IsOpenImmersion (Q.f g) := Q.map_prop g
    have : IsOpenImmersion (Q.f h) := Q.map_prop h
    have : IsOpenImmersion (pullback.fst (Q.f g) (Q.f h)) := inferInstance
    let π1 : W.left ⟶ U.left := pullback.fst (Q.f g) (Q.f h)
    have : IsOpenImmersion π1 := inferInstanceAs
      (IsOpenImmersion (pullback.fst (Q.f g) (Q.f h)))
    have : IsReduced W.left := isReduced_of_isOpenImmersion π1
    have : LocallyOfFiniteType π1 := inferInstance
    have : LocallyOfFiniteType W.hom := by
      change LocallyOfFiniteType (π1 ≫ U.hom)
      infer_instance
    have hg : Q.f g ≫ GX.hom = U.hom := Over.w (ig g)
    have hh : Q.f h ≫ GX.hom = U.hom := Over.w (ig h)
    let p1 : W ⟶ U := Over.homMk (pullback.fst (Q.f g) (Q.f h)) rfl
    let p2 : W ⟶ U := Over.homMk (pullback.snd (Q.f g) (Q.f h)) (by
      change pullback.snd (Q.f g) (Q.f h) ≫ U.hom =
        pullback.fst (Q.f g) (Q.f h) ≫ U.hom
      calc
        _ = pullback.snd (Q.f g) (Q.f h) ≫ Q.f h ≫ GX.hom := by rw [hh]
        _ = pullback.fst (Q.f g) (Q.f h) ≫ Q.f g ≫ GX.hom := by
          rw [← Category.assoc, ← pullback.condition, Category.assoc]
        _ = _ := by rw [hg])
    have hp : p1 ≫ ig g = p2 ≫ ig h := by
      apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
      exact pullback.condition
    have he := hom_ext_points W HX (p1 ≫ fg g) (p2 ≫ fg h) (fun p ↦ by
      calc
        _ = (p ≫ p1) ≫ fg g := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
        _ = Φ ((p ≫ p1) ≫ ig g) := hlocal g (p ≫ p1)
        _ = Φ ((p ≫ p2) ≫ ig h) := by rw [Category.assoc, hp, ← Category.assoc]
        _ = (p ≫ p2) ≫ fg h := (hlocal h (p ≫ p2)).symm
        _ = _ := Category.assoc _ _ _)
    exact congrArg (fun f : W ⟶ HX ↦ f.left) he
  let s : GX.left ⟶ HX.left := Q.glueMorphisms (fun g ↦ (fg g).left) hcompat
  have hs : s ≫ HX.hom = GX.hom := by
    apply Q.hom_ext
    intro g
    have he : Q.f g ≫ s = (fg g).left :=
      Q.ι_glueMorphisms (fun g ↦ (fg g).left) hcompat g
    have he' : (Q.f g ≫ s) ≫ HX.hom = Q.f g ≫ GX.hom :=
      (congrArg (fun t : U.left ⟶ HX.left ↦ t ≫ HX.hom) he).trans
        ((Over.w (fg g)).trans (Over.w (ig g)).symm)
    exact (Category.assoc (Q.f g) s HX.hom).symm.trans he'
  let f : GX ⟶ HX := Over.homMk s hs
  have hfac (g : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) : ig g ≫ f = fg g := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    exact Q.ι_glueMorphisms (fun g ↦ (fg g).left) hcompat g
  have hpoint (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) : q ≫ f = Φ q := by
    let g := q * (p0 ≫ j)⁻¹
    have hp : p0 ≫ ig g = q := by
      dsimp only [ig]
      rw [← Category.assoc, GroupScheme.point_comp_leftMul]
      dsimp only [g]
      rw [_root_.mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, _root_.mul_one]
    calc
      _ = (p0 ≫ ig g) ≫ f := by rw [hp]
      _ = p0 ≫ fg g := by rw [Category.assoc, hfac]
      _ = Φ (p0 ≫ ig g) := hlocal g p0
      _ = _ := by rw [hp]
  have hone : η[GX] ≫ f = η[HX] := by
    change (1 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) ≫ f = 1
    exact (hpoint 1).trans Φ.map_one
  have hmul : μ[GX] ≫ f = (f ⊗ₘ f) ≫ μ[HX] := by
    have : IsIntegral (GX ⊗ GX).left :=
      isIntegral_pullback_of_isAlgClosed GX.hom GX.hom
    have : LocallyOfFiniteType GX.hom := G.locallyOfFiniteType
    have : LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback.fst GX.hom GX.hom) := inferInstance
    have : LocallyOfFiniteType (GX ⊗ GX).hom := by
      change LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback.fst GX.hom GX.hom ≫ GX.hom)
      infer_instance
    apply hom_ext_points (GX ⊗ GX) HX
    intro p
    calc
      _ = ((p ≫ fst GX GX) * (p ≫ snd GX GX)) ≫ f := by
        rw [← Category.assoc, MonObj.mul_eq_mul, MonObj.comp_mul]
      _ = Φ ((p ≫ fst GX GX) * (p ≫ snd GX GX)) := hpoint _
      _ = Φ (p ≫ fst GX GX) * Φ (p ≫ snd GX GX) := Φ.map_mul _ _
      _ = ((p ≫ fst GX GX) ≫ f) * ((p ≫ snd GX GX) ≫ f) := by rw [hpoint, hpoint]
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [MonObj.mul_eq_mul, MonObj.comp_mul, Category.assoc,
          tensorHom_fst, tensorHom_snd]
  exact ⟨Grp.homMk'' f hone hmul, hpoint⟩

name: AclGeom.GroupScheme.diagonal_isPullback_unit
statement:
theorem diagonal_isPullback_unit (G : GroupScheme k) :
    IsPullback (lift (𝟙 G.X) (𝟙 G.X)) (toUnit G.X)
      G.difference η[G.X]
proof:
:= by
  refine
    { w := by simp [difference, GrpObj.comp_div, one_eq_one]
      isLimit' := ⟨PullbackCone.IsLimit.mk _
        (fun s ↦ s.fst ≫ fst G.X G.X)
        ?_ ?_ ?_⟩ }
  · intro s
    apply CartesianMonoidalCategory.hom_ext
    · simp
    · have h :
          s.fst ≫ fst G.X G.X / s.fst ≫ snd G.X G.X = 1 := by
        simpa [difference, GrpObj.comp_div, one_eq_one] using s.condition
      simpa using (div_eq_one.mp h)
  · intro s
    apply Subsingleton.elim
  · intro s m hm _
    simpa using hm =≫ fst G.X G.X

name: AclGeom.GroupScheme.unit_isClosedImmersion
statement:
theorem unit_isClosedImmersion (G : GroupScheme k) :

proof:
:=

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicGroup.Hom.kernelι_comp
statement:

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicGroup.Hom.kernel_isPullback_trivial
statement:
theorem kernel_isPullback_trivial (f : G.Hom H) :
    IsPullback (Limits.kernel.ι f)
      (0 : Limits.kernel f ⟶ CategoryTheory.Grp.trivial
        (Over (Spec (.of k)))) f
      (0 : CategoryTheory.Grp.trivial (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶
        H.toGroupScheme)
proof:
:= by
  refine
    { w := by simp
      isLimit' := ⟨PullbackCone.IsLimit.mk _
        (fun s ↦ Limits.kernel.lift f s.fst (by simpa using s.condition))
        (by intro s; simp)
        (by intro s; apply Subsingleton.elim)
        (by
          intro s m hm _
          exact Fork.IsLimit.hom_ext (Limits.kernelIsKernel f)
            (hm.trans (Limits.kernel.lift_ι f s.fst _).symm))⟩ }

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicGroup.Hom.kernel_isPullback_unit
statement:
theorem kernel_isPullback_unit (f : G.Hom H) :
    IsPullback f.kernelι.hom.hom (toUnit _)
      f.hom.hom η[H.toGroupScheme.X]
proof:
:= by
  let F := CategoryTheory.Grp.forget (Over (Spec (.of k)))
  let h := f.kernel_isPullback_trivial.map F
  let e₃ : F.obj (CategoryTheory.Grp.trivial
      (Over (Spec (.of k)))) ≅ 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) := Iso.refl _
  refine h.of_iso (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) e₃ (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  all_goals cat_disch
