name: AclGeom.SmoothCurveStalks.baseGerm_isIso
statement:
theorem baseGerm_isIso (y : Spec (.of k)) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫
      (Spec (.of k)).presheaf.germ ⊤ y trivial)
proof:
:= by
  have hy : y = IsLocalRing.closedPoint k := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  subst y
  rw [← ΓSpecIso_hom_stalkClosedPointIso_inv, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  infer_instance

name: AclGeom.SmoothCurveStalks.stalkAlgebra_eq_germ
statement:
theorem stalkAlgebra_eq_germ (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) (x : X.left) :
    stalkAlgebra X x =
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ X.hom.appTop ≫
        X.left.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial).hom.toAlgebra
proof:
:= by
  apply Algebra.algebra_ext
  intro c
  change (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫
      (Spec (.of k)).presheaf.germ ⊤ (X.hom x) trivial) ≫ X.hom.stalkMap x) c =
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ X.hom.appTop ≫
      X.left.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial) c
  exact congrArg (fun g ↦ g c)
    ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
      (congrArg (fun g ↦ (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ g)
        (X.hom.germ_stalkMap ⊤ x trivial)))

name: AclGeom.SmoothCurveStalks.stalk_formallySmooth
statement:
theorem stalk_formallySmooth (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [Smooth X.hom] (x : X.left) :
    letI
proof:
:= stalkAlgebra X x
    Algebra.FormallySmooth k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) := by
  let u : CommRingCat.of k ⟶ (Spec (.of k)).presheaf.stalk (X.hom x) :=
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (Spec (.of k)).presheaf.germ ⊤ (X.hom x) trivial
  have : IsIso u := baseGerm_isIso _
  have hu : u.hom.FormallySmooth :=
    RingHom.FormallySmooth.of_bijective (asIso u).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.bijective
  have hx : x ∈ X.hom.smoothLocus := by rw [X.hom.smoothLocus_eq_top]; trivial
  have hf := Scheme.Hom.mem_smoothLocus.mp hx
  exact (hu.comp hf).toAlgebra

name: AclGeom.SmoothCurveStalks.stalk_essFiniteType
statement:
theorem stalk_essFiniteType (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom]
    (x : X.left) :
    letI
proof:
:= stalkAlgebra X x
    Algebra.EssFiniteType k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) := by
  let u : CommRingCat.of k ⟶ (Spec (.of k)).presheaf.stalk (X.hom x) :=
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (Spec (.of k)).presheaf.germ ⊤ (X.hom x) trivial
  have : IsIso u := baseGerm_isIso _
  have hu : u.hom.EssFiniteType :=
    (RingHom.FiniteType.of_surjective _
      (asIso u).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.surjective).essFiniteType
  exact hu.comp (LocallyOfFiniteType.stalkMap X.hom x)

name: AclGeom.SmoothCurveStalks.stalk_functionField_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem stalk_functionField_isScalarTower
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left] (x : X.left) :
    letI
proof:
:= stalkAlgebra X x
    IsScalarTower k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField := by
  rw [stalkAlgebra_eq_germ]
  let : Algebra k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) :=
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ X.hom.appTop ≫
      X.left.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial).hom.toAlgebra
  have : Nonempty (⊤ : X.left.Opens) := ⟨⟨genericPoint X.left, trivial⟩⟩
  have hbase (c : k) : algebraMap k X.left.functionField c =
      X.left.germToFunctionField ⊤ (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ X.hom.appTop) c) := by
    rw [ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAlgebra_eq_germ X]
    rfl
  refine IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun c ↦ ?_
  rw [hbase]
  exact (Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField X.left
    (show x ∈ (⊤ : X.left.Opens) from trivial)
    (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ X.hom.appTop) c)).symm

name: AclGeom.SmoothCurveStalks.SpecMap_stalkAlgebra
statement:
theorem SpecMap_stalkAlgebra (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) (x : X.left) :
    letI
proof:
:= stalkAlgebra X x
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x))) =
      X.left.fromSpecStalk x ≫ X.hom := by
  change Spec.map (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫
    (Spec (.of k)).presheaf.germ ⊤ (X.hom x) trivial) ≫ X.hom.stalkMap x) = _
  rw [Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.fromSpecStalk_eq]
  exact Scheme.SpecMap_stalkMap_fromSpecStalk X.hom

name: AclGeom.SmoothCurveStalks.stalk_residue_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem stalk_residue_isAlgebraic [IsAlgClosed k]
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom]
    (x : X.left) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X.left)) :
    letI
proof:
:= stalkAlgebra X x
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)) := by
  let := stalkAlgebra X x
  let ρ : CommRingCat.of k ⟶ X.left.residueField x :=
    CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)))
  have hρ : ρ = CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)) ≫
      X.left.residue x := rfl
  have hspec : Spec.map ρ = X.left.fromSpecResidueField x ≫ X.hom := by
    calc
      Spec.map ρ = Spec.map (X.left.residue x) ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x))) :=
        (congrArg Spec.map hρ).trans (Spec.map_comp _ _)
      _ = Spec.map (X.left.residue x) ≫ (X.left.fromSpecStalk x ≫ X.hom) :=
        congrArg (fun g ↦ Spec.map (X.left.residue x) ≫ g) (SpecMap_stalkAlgebra X x)
      _ = X.left.fromSpecResidueField x ≫ X.hom := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
  have hmap : ρ = (residueFieldIsoBase X.hom x hx).inv :=
    Spec.map_injective (hspec.trans (SpecMap_residueFieldIsoBase_inv X.hom x hx).symm)
  have hs : Function.Surjective ρ := by
    rw [hmap]
    exact (residueFieldIsoBase X.hom x hx).symm.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.surjective
  constructor
  intro z
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hs z
  exact isAlgebraic_algebraMap c

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.CompositionTriangle.commonSourcePullbackChart_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem commonSourcePullbackChart_algebraMap
    (sourceChart : X ≃+* X')
    (commonSource : IntermediateField X' (AlgebraicClosure X'))
    (x : X) :
    commonSourcePullbackChart sourceChart commonSource
        (algebraMap X
          (↥(commonSourcePullbackField sourceChart commonSource)) x) =
      algebraMap X' (↥commonSource) (sourceChart x)
proof:
:= by
  exact
    (AlgebraicClosureTransport.EmbeddingClosureEquiv.ofRingEquiv sourceChart)
      |>.pullbackEquiv_algebraMap commonSource x

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.CompositionTriangle.commonSourcePullbackChart_comp_algebraMap_comp
statement:
theorem commonSourcePullbackChart_comp_algebraMap_comp
    {W : Type u} [Semiring W]
    (sourceChart : X ≃+* X')
    (commonSource : IntermediateField X' (AlgebraicClosure X'))
    (g : W →+* X) :
    (commonSourcePullbackChart sourceChart commonSource).toRingHom.comp
        ((algebraMap X
          (↥(commonSourcePullbackField sourceChart commonSource))).comp g) =
      (algebraMap X' (↥commonSource)).comp
        (sourceChart.toRingHom.comp g)
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro x
  exact commonSourcePullbackChart_algebraMap sourceChart commonSource (g x)

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.CompositionTriangle.sourceExtensionRightEquiv_comp_middleRingHom_comp
statement:
theorem sourceExtensionRightEquiv_comp_middleRingHom_comp
    {W : Type u} [Semiring W]
    (source : IntermediateField X (AlgebraicClosure X))
    (g : W →+* Y) :
    (T.sourceExtension source).right.toRingHom.comp
        ((T.sourceExtensionMiddleRingHom source).comp g) =
      (T.sourceExtensionTargetRingHom source).comp
        (T.right.toRingHom.comp g)
proof:
:= by
  have h := T.sourceExtensionRightEquiv_comp_middleRingHom source
  have hc := congrArg (fun f ↦ f.comp g) h
  simpa only [sourceExtension, RingHom.comp_assoc] using hc

name: AclGeom.SchemePlaceAction.fixed_of_isClosed_orders
statement:
private theorem fixed_of_isClosed_orders (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1)
    (g : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X)
    {P : Place k V.left.functionField} (hP : P ∈ Place.boundary (globalSections V)) :
    letI
proof:
:= scheme_functionField_isFunctionFieldOneVar k V hdim
    letI := GroupPointTopology.topology G.toAlgebraicGroup
    (∀ (r : Γ(V.left, ⊤)), r ≠ 0 → ∀ m : ℤ,
      IsClosed {h : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X |
        m ≤ P.ord ((functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V h).unop
          (V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤ (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint _, trivial⟩⟩) r))}) →
    placeAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V g P = P := by
  classical
  have : IsFunctionFieldOneVar k V.left.functionField :=
    scheme_functionField_isFunctionFieldOneVar k V hdim
  let : TopologicalSpace (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) :=
    GroupPointTopology.topology G.toAlgebraicGroup
  intro hclosed
  have : Nonempty (⊤ : V.left.Opens) := ⟨⟨genericPoint V.left, trivial⟩⟩
  have : IsFractionRing Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen V.left ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top V.left)
  have := GroupPointTopology.irreducibleSpace G
  let ρ := placeAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V
  let B := Place.boundary (globalSections V)
  have hB : B.Finite := boundary_finite V hdim
  have horbit : ∀ h : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X, ρ h P ∈ B :=
    fun h ↦ (placeAction_mem_boundary_iff G.toAlgebraicGroup V h P).2 hP
  obtain ⟨s, hs0, hsep⟩ := Place.exists_finset_ord_separating Γ(V.left, ⊤) hB
  have ho : ∀ (h : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) (a : Γ(V.left, ⊤)),
      (ρ h P).ord (algebraMap Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField a) =
        P.ord ((functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V h).unop
          (algebraMap Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField a)) := by
    intro h a
    change (placeAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V h P).ord _ = _
    rw [placeAction_apply, Place.ord_comap]
  have hc : ∀ a ∈ s, ∀ m : ℤ,
      IsClosed {h : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X |
        m ≤ P.ord ((functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V h).unop
          (algebraMap Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField a))} := by
    intro a ha m
    have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
      intro he
      apply hs0 a ha
      rw [he, map_zero]
    exact hclosed a ha0 m
  have hfiber : ∀ Q ∈ B, IsLocallyClosed
      {h : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X | ρ h P = Q} := by
    intro Q hQ
    have he : {h : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X | ρ h P = Q} =
        (⋂ a ∈ s, {h | Q.ord (algebraMap Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField a) ≤
          P.ord ((functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V h).unop
            (algebraMap Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField a))}) ∩
        (⋃ a ∈ s, {h | Q.ord (algebraMap Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField a) + 1 ≤
          P.ord ((functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V h).unop
            (algebraMap Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField a))})ᶜ := by
      ext h
      constructor
      · intro hPQ
        constructor
        · refine Set.mem_iInter.2 fun a ↦ Set.mem_iInter.2 fun _ha ↦ ?_
          have e := ho h a
          rw [hPQ] at e
          exact e.le
        · intro hu
          obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hu
          obtain ⟨_ha, hgt⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 ha
          rw [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hgt
          rw [← ho h a, hPQ] at hgt
          omega
      · rintro ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
        apply hsep (ρ h P) (horbit h) Q hQ
        intro a ha
        rw [ho h a]
        have h1 := Set.mem_iInter.1 (Set.mem_iInter.1 hlo a) ha
        rw [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at h1
        have h2 : ¬ Q.ord (algebraMap Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField a) + 1 ≤
            P.ord ((functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V h).unop
              (algebraMap Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField a)) :=
          fun hh ↦ hhi (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨a, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨ha, hh⟩⟩)
        omega
    rw [he]
    exact (isClosed_iInter fun a ↦ isClosed_iInter fun ha ↦ hc a ha _).isLocallyClosed.inter
      (isClosed_biUnion_finset fun a ha ↦ hc a ha _).isOpen_compl.isLocallyClosed
  exact FiniteAction.fixed_of_finite_locallyClosed_fibers ρ
    (GroupPointTopology.leftMulHomeo G.toAlgebraicGroup)
    (GroupPointTopology.leftMulHomeo_apply G.toAlgebraicGroup) P hB horbit hfiber g

name: AclGeom.SchemePlaceAction.placeAction_eq_of_mem_boundary
statement:
theorem placeAction_eq_of_mem_boundary (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1)
    (g : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X)
    {P : Place k V.left.functionField} (hP : P ∈ Place.boundary (globalSections V)) :
    placeAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V g P = P
proof:
:= by
  have : IsFunctionFieldOneVar k V.left.functionField :=
    scheme_functionField_isFunctionFieldOneVar k V hdim
  let : TopologicalSpace (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) :=
    GroupPointTopology.topology G.toAlgebraicGroup
  apply fixed_of_isClosed_orders G V hdim g hP
  intro r hr m
  have hh (h : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) :
      (GroupScheme.pointsEquivClosedPoints (G := G.toGroupScheme.X)).symm
        (GroupPointTopology.pointsHomeo G.toAlgebraicGroup h) = h :=
    Equiv.symm_apply_apply _ h
  have hc := (ActionSemicontinuity.isClosed_setOf_le_ord
    G.toAlgebraicGroup V hdim P hr m).preimage
      (GroupPointTopology.pointsHomeo G.toAlgebraicGroup).continuous
  change IsClosed {h : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X |
    m ≤ P.ord ((functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V
      ((GroupScheme.pointsEquivClosedPoints (G := G.toGroupScheme.X)).symm
        (GroupPointTopology.pointsHomeo G.toAlgebraicGroup h))).unop
          (V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤ (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint _, trivial⟩⟩) r))} at hc
  have he : {h : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X |
      m ≤ P.ord ((functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V
        ((GroupScheme.pointsEquivClosedPoints (G := G.toGroupScheme.X)).symm
          (GroupPointTopology.pointsHomeo G.toAlgebraicGroup h))).unop
            (V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤ (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint _, trivial⟩⟩) r))} =
      {h | m ≤ P.ord ((functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V h).unop
        (V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤ (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint _, trivial⟩⟩) r))} := by
    ext h
    change (m ≤ P.ord ((functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V
      ((GroupScheme.pointsEquivClosedPoints (G := G.toGroupScheme.X)).symm
        (GroupPointTopology.pointsHomeo G.toAlgebraicGroup h))).unop
          (V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤ (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint _, trivial⟩⟩) r))) ↔ _
    rw [hh]
    rfl
  rw [he] at hc
  exact hc

name: AclGeom.SchemePlaceAction.exists_fixed_boundary_place
statement:
theorem exists_fixed_boundary_place (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1) :
    ∃ P : Place k V.left.functionField, P ∈ Place.boundary (globalSections V) ∧
      ∀ g : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
        placeAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V g P = P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := boundary_nonempty V hdim
  exact ⟨P, hP, fun g ↦ placeAction_eq_of_mem_boundary G V hdim g hP⟩

name: AclGeom.MultiplicativeRigidity.hopfIso_eq_id_or_neg
statement:
theorem hopfIso_eq_id_or_neg (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (e : CommHopfAlgCat.of k (AddMonoidAlgebra k ℤ) ≅
      CommHopfAlgCat.of k (AddMonoidAlgebra k ℤ)) :
    e.hom.hom = BialgHom.id k (AddMonoidAlgebra k ℤ) ∨
      e.hom.hom = AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHom k (-AddMonoidHom.id ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  let f := AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomainOfBialgHom e.hom.hom
  let g := AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomainOfBialgHom e.inv.hom
  have hf (z : ℤ) : f z = z * f 1 := by
    simpa only [zsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, Int.cast_id] using (map_zsmul f z (1 : ℤ))
  have hg (z : ℤ) : g z = z * g 1 := by
    simpa only [zsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, Int.cast_id] using (map_zsmul g z (1 : ℤ))
  have hcomp : g.comp f = AddMonoidHom.id ℤ := by
    dsimp only [f, g]
    rw [← AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomainOfBialgHom_comp]
    have h : e.inv.hom.comp e.hom.hom = BialgHom.id k (AddMonoidAlgebra k ℤ) :=
      congrArg CommHopfAlgCat.Hom.hom e.hom_inv_id
    rw [h, AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomainOfBialgHom_id]
  have hmul : f 1 * g 1 = 1 := by
    rw [← hg]
    exact congrArg (fun h : ℤ →+ ℤ ↦ h 1) hcomp
  rcases Int.mul_eq_one_iff_eq_one_or_neg_one.mp hmul with h | h
  · left
    apply (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHomEquiv (R := k) (G := ℤ) (H := ℤ)).symm.injective
    change f = AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomainOfBialgHom (BialgHom.id k _)
    rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomainOfBialgHom_id]
    apply AddMonoidHom.ext
    intro z
    rw [hf, h.1, mul_one]
    rfl
  · right
    apply (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHomEquiv (R := k) (G := ℤ) (H := ℤ)).symm.injective
    change f = AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomainOfBialgHom
      (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHom k (-AddMonoidHom.id ℤ))
    rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomainOfBialgHom_mapDomainBialgHom]
    apply AddMonoidHom.ext
    intro z
    rw [hf, h.1, mul_neg_one]
    rfl

name: AclGeom.MultiplicativeRigidity.AclGeom.MultiplicativeRigidity.groupIso_eq_id_or_inv
statement:
theorem groupIso_eq_id_or_inv (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (e : (multiplicativeGroup k).toGroupScheme ≅ (multiplicativeGroup k).toGroupScheme) :
    e.hom.hom.hom = 𝟙 _ ∨ e.hom.hom.hom = ι[(multiplicativeGroup k).toGroupScheme.X]
proof:
:= by
  let A : CommHopfAlgCat.{u} k := .of k (AddMonoidAlgebra k ℤ)
  let F : (CommHopfAlgCat.{u} k)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Grp (Over (Spec (.of k))) := hopfSpec (.of k)
  have : F.Full := hopfSpec.instFull
  have : F.Faithful := hopfSpec.instFaithful
  let E : A ≅ A := (F.preimageIso (X := .op A) (Y := .op A) e).unop
  have he : F.map E.hom.op = e.hom := F.map_preimage (X := .op A) (Y := .op A) e.hom
  rcases hopfIso_eq_id_or_neg k E with h | h
  · left
    have hE : E.hom = 𝟙 A := CommHopfAlgCat.hom_ext h
    rw [hE, op_id, F.map_id] at he
    exact congrArg (fun f ↦ f.hom.hom) he.symm
  · right
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    rw [← he]
    change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom E.hom.hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (HopfAlgebra.antipodeAlgHom k (AddMonoidAlgebra k ℤ)).toRingHom)
    rw [h]
    apply congrArg Spec.map
    apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
    apply congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom
    ext n : 1
    · change (AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHom k (-AddMonoidHom.id ℤ))
        (AddMonoidAlgebra.single n (1 : k)) =
          HopfAlgebra.antipode k (AddMonoidAlgebra.single n (1 : k))
      rw [AddMonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHom_single]
      simp only [AddMonoidHom.neg_apply, AddMonoidHom.id_apply,
        AddMonoidAlgebra.antipode_single, HopfAlgebra.antipode_one]
    · ext

name: AclGeom.AdditiveOrbit.exists_finite_orbit_cover_of_nontrivial_one
statement:
theorem exists_finite_orbit_cover_of_nontrivial_one
    (G : AlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (hker : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
      ModObj.pointAct V q = 𝟙 V → q = 1)
    (hdimV : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1)
    (i : (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).Hom G)
    (hi : ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (1 : k)) ≫
      i.hom.hom ≠ 1) :
    ∃ p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ V,
      IsFinite (orbitMap i.hom.hom p).left ∧ Surjective (orbitMap i.hom.hom p).left ∧
      ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (0 : k)) ≫
        orbitMap i.hom.hom p = p ∧
      μ[(AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X] ≫ orbitMap i.hom.hom p =
        lift (fst (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X
          (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X ≫ i.hom.hom)
          (snd (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X
            (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X ≫ orbitMap i.hom.hom p) ≫
              γ[G.toGroupScheme.X, V] ∧
      ∀ (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra k C] (b c : C),
        lift (AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k b ≫ i.hom.hom)
          (AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k c ≫ orbitMap i.hom.hom p) ≫ γ[G.toGroupScheme.X, V] =
            AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (b + c) ≫ orbitMap i.hom.hom p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let N := (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X
  let Q (b : k) : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ N :=
    (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k b
  have hQ₀ : Q 0 = 1 := by
    change (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (0 : k) = 1
    rw [AdditiveTranslation.linePoint_zero, comp_one]
  let g := Q 1 ≫ i.hom.hom
  have hg : g ≠ 1 := hi
  have hact : ModObj.pointAct V g ≠ 𝟙 V := fun h ↦ hg (hker g h)
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ V,
      p ≫ ModObj.pointAct V g ≠ p := by
    by_contra! h
    apply hact
    apply AdditiveRigidity.over_hom_ext_of_points
    intro p
    simpa only [Category.comp_id] using h p
  let o := orbitMap i.hom.hom p
  have h₀ : Q 0 ≫ o = p := by
    rw [point_comp_orbitMap, hQ₀, one_comp, ModObj.pointAct_one, Category.comp_id]
  have hsep : AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (0 : k) ≫ o ≠
      AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (1 : k) ≫ o := by
    intro h
    have hh : Q 0 ≫ o = Q 1 ≫ o := by
      simpa only [Q, Category.assoc] using
        congrArg (fun z ↦ (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ z) h
    rw [h₀, point_comp_orbitMap] at hh
    exact hp hh.symm
  obtain ⟨hfin, hsurj⟩ := finite_surjective_of_separates_zero_one V hdimV o hsep
  have hjoint := mul_comp_orbitMap i.hom.hom p
  refine ⟨p, hfin, hsurj, h₀, hjoint, ?_⟩
  intro C _ _ b c
  calc
    _ = lift (AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k b) (AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k c) ≫
        μ[N] ≫ o := by
      rw [hjoint]
      simp only [comp_lift_assoc, lift_fst_assoc, lift_snd_assoc]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← Category.assoc, ← Hom.mul_def, AdditiveTranslation.linePoint_mul]

name: AclGeom.AdditiveOrbit.exists_finite_orbit_cover
statement:
theorem exists_finite_orbit_cover
    (G : AlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (hker : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
      ModObj.pointAct V q = 𝟙 V → q = 1)
    (hdimV : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1)
    (i : (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).Hom G) [Mono i.hom.hom] :
    ∃ p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ V,
      IsFinite (orbitMap i.hom.hom p).left ∧ Surjective (orbitMap i.hom.hom p).left ∧
      ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (0 : k)) ≫
        orbitMap i.hom.hom p = p ∧
      μ[(AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X] ≫ orbitMap i.hom.hom p =
        lift (fst (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X
          (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X ≫ i.hom.hom)
          (snd (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X
            (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X ≫ orbitMap i.hom.hom p) ≫
              γ[G.toGroupScheme.X, V] ∧
      ∀ (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra k C] (b c : C),
        lift (AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k b ≫ i.hom.hom)
          (AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k c ≫ orbitMap i.hom.hom p) ≫ γ[G.toGroupScheme.X, V] =
            AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (b + c) ≫ orbitMap i.hom.hom p
proof:
:= by
  apply exists_finite_orbit_cover_of_nontrivial_one G V hker hdimV i
  intro h
  have h₁ : (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (1 : k) = 1 := by
    apply (cancel_mono i.hom.hom).mp
    rw [one_comp]
    exact h
  have h₀ : (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (0 : k) = 1 := by
    rw [AdditiveTranslation.linePoint_zero, comp_one]
  apply (one_ne_zero : (1 : k) ≠ 0)
  apply AffineSchemeAction.linePoint_injective k
  exact (cancel_epi (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom).mp (h₁.trans h₀.symm)

name: AclGeom.idealOf_ne_bot_of_mem_racl
statement:
theorem idealOf_ne_bot_of_mem_racl {u v : Ω} (hv : v ∈ racl k {u}) :
    idealOf k ![u, v] ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= fun h ↦
  AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_pair ((idealOf_eq_bot_iff k).1 h) hv

name: AclGeom.not_isMaximal_idealOf
statement:
theorem not_isMaximal_idealOf {u v : Ω} (hu : Transcendental k u) :
    ¬(idealOf k ![u, v]).IsMaximal
proof:
:= by
  intro hM
  letI : Field (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k ⧸ idealOf k ![u, v]) :=
    Ideal.Quotient.field _
  have hft : Algebra.FiniteType k (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k ⧸ idealOf k ![u, v]) :=
    Algebra.FiniteType.of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k _)
      (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_surjective k _)
  have hfin : Module.Finite k (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k ⧸ idealOf k ![u, v]) :=
    finite_of_finite_type_of_isJacobsonRing k _
  have hint : Algebra.IsIntegral k
      (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k ⧸ idealOf k ![u, v]) :=
    Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite k _
  
  have h0 : IsIntegral k (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealOf k ![u, v]) (X 0)) :=
    Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral _
  have hlift := h0.map (Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ (idealOf k ![u, v])
    (aeval ![u, v]) fun a ha ↦ (mem_idealOf_iff k).1 ha)
  have heval : Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ (idealOf k ![u, v]) (aeval ![u, v])
      (fun a ha ↦ (mem_idealOf_iff k).1 ha)
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealOf k ![u, v]) (X 0)) = u := by
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ_apply]
    exact (Ideal.Quotient.lift_mk _ _ _).trans (by simp)
  rw [heval] at hlift
  exact hu hlift.isAlgebraic

name: AclGeom.exists_prime_span_idealOf
proof:
:= by
  have hbot : idealOf k ![u, v] ≠ ⊥ := idealOf_ne_bot_of_mem_racl k hv
  obtain ⟨f, hfP, hf⟩ :=
    (idealOf_isPrime k ![u, v]).exists_mem_prime_of_ne_bot hbot
  refine ⟨f, hf, ?_⟩
  
  
  have hheight : (idealOf k ![u, v]).height = 1 := by
    obtain ⟨M, hMmax, hPM⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal (idealOf k ![u, v])
      (idealOf_isPrime k ![u, v]).ne_top
    have hlt : idealOf k ![u, v] < M :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne hPM fun h ↦ not_isMaximal_idealOf k hu (h ▸ hMmax)
    have hdim : ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) = 2 := by
      rw [MvPolynomial.ringKrullDim_of_isNoetherianRing,
        ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_field]
      simp
    have hM2 : (M.height : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ 2 := by
      rw [← hdim]
      exact Ideal.height_le_ringKrullDim_of_ne_top hMmax.ne_top
    have hstep : (idealOf k ![u, v]).height + 1 ≤ M.height :=
      Ideal.height_add_one_le_of_lt_of_isPrime hlt
    have hle : (idealOf k ![u, v]).height + 1 ≤ 2 := by
      exact_mod_cast hstep.trans (WithBot.coe_le_coe.1 hM2)
    have hne : (idealOf k ![u, v]).height ≠ 0 := fun h ↦
      hbot (Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot.1 h)
    
    set h := (idealOf k ![u, v]).height with hh
    have htop : h ≠ ⊤ := by
      intro ht
      rw [ht, top_add] at hle
      simp at hle
    lift h to ℕ using htop with n hn
    have h1 : n + 1 ≤ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hle
    have h2 : n ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hne
    have h3 : n = 1 := by omega
    exact_mod_cast congrArg (Nat.cast : ℕ → ℕ∞) h3
  exact Ideal.eq_span_singleton_of_height_eq_one hheight hfP hf

name: AclGeom.translate_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem translate_X (c : σ → K) (j : σ) :
    translate c (X j) = X j + C (c j)
proof:
:= by
  simp [translate]

name: AclGeom.translate_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem translate_C (c : σ → K) (a : K) : translate c (C a) = C a
proof:
:= by
  simp [translate, algebraMap_eq]

name: AclGeom.totalDegree_translate_pow_sub_lt
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact absurd hn (lt_irrefl 0)
  | succ m ih =>
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm
    · simpa [totalDegree_C] using Nat.zero_lt_one
    · have key : ((X j + C (c j)) ^ (m + 1) - X j ^ (m + 1) : MvPolynomial σ K) =
          ((X j + C (c j)) ^ m - X j ^ m) * (X j + C (c j)) + X j ^ m * C (c j) := by
        ring
      rw [key]
      refine lt_of_le_of_lt (totalDegree_add _ _) (max_lt ?_ ?_)
      · refine lt_of_le_of_lt (totalDegree_mul _ _) ?_
        have h1 := ih hm
        have h2 : (X j + C (c j) : MvPolynomial σ K).totalDegree ≤ 1 := by
          refine le_trans (totalDegree_add _ _) ?_
          simp [totalDegree_X, totalDegree_C]
        omega
      · refine lt_of_le_of_lt (totalDegree_mul _ _) ?_
        rw [totalDegree_C, totalDegree_X_pow]
        omega

name: AclGeom.finsupp_sum_id_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem finsupp_sum_id_eq_zero_iff {m : σ →₀ ℕ} :
    (m.sum fun _ e ↦ e) = 0 ↔ m = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    ext a
    rcases eq_or_ne (m a) 0 with h0 | h0
    · simp [h0]
    · exact absurd ((Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff.1 h) a (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 h0)) h0
  · intro h
    simp [h]

name: AclGeom.totalDegree_translate_monomial_sub_lt
statement:
theorem totalDegree_translate_monomial_sub_lt (c : σ → K) {m : σ →₀ ℕ}
    (hm : 0 < m.sum fun _ e ↦ e) :
    (translate c (monomial m 1) - monomial m 1).totalDegree <
      m.sum fun _ e ↦ e
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Finsupp.induction with
  | zero => simp at hm
  | single_add j n m' hjm' hn ih =>
    have hsum : ((Finsupp.single j n + m').sum fun _ e ↦ e) =
        n + m'.sum fun _ e ↦ e := by
      rw [Finsupp.sum_add_index' (fun _ ↦ rfl) fun _ _ _ ↦ rfl]
      rw [Finsupp.sum_single_index rfl]
    have hn' : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
    
    have hmono : (monomial (Finsupp.single j n + m') (1 : K)) =
        monomial (Finsupp.single j n) 1 * monomial m' 1 := by
      rw [monomial_mul_monomial, mul_one]
    have htrA : translate c (monomial (Finsupp.single j n) (1 : K)) =
        (X j + C (c j)) ^ n := by
      rw [← X_pow_eq_monomial, map_pow, translate_X]
    rcases eq_or_ne m' 0 with rfl | hm'0
    · rw [add_zero, ← X_pow_eq_monomial, map_pow, translate_X,
        Finsupp.sum_single_index rfl]
      exact totalDegree_translate_pow_sub_lt c j hn'
    · have hm'pos : 0 < m'.sum fun _ e ↦ e := by
        rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (m'.sum fun _ e ↦ e) with hz | hp
        · exact absurd (finsupp_sum_id_eq_zero_iff.1 hz) hm'0
        · exact hp
      have ihm := ih hm'pos
      have hB₀deg : (monomial m' (1 : K)).totalDegree = m'.sum fun _ e ↦ e :=
        totalDegree_monomial m' one_ne_zero
      have hBdeg : (translate c (monomial m' 1)).totalDegree ≤
          m'.sum fun _ e ↦ e := by
        have hsplit : translate c (monomial m' (1 : K)) =
            (translate c (monomial m' 1) - monomial m' 1) + monomial m' 1 := by
          ring
        rw [hsplit]
        refine le_trans (totalDegree_add _ _) (max_le (le_of_lt ?_) ?_)
        · exact hB₀deg ▸ ihm
        · exact le_of_eq hB₀deg
      
      have hkey : translate c (monomial (Finsupp.single j n + m') 1) -
          monomial (Finsupp.single j n + m') 1 =
          ((X j + C (c j)) ^ n - X j ^ n) * translate c (monomial m' 1) +
            X j ^ n * (translate c (monomial m' 1) - monomial m' 1) := by
        rw [hmono, map_mul, htrA, X_pow_eq_monomial]
        ring
      rw [hkey, hsum]
      refine lt_of_le_of_lt (totalDegree_add _ _) (max_lt ?_ ?_)
      · refine lt_of_le_of_lt (totalDegree_mul _ _) ?_
        have h1 := totalDegree_translate_pow_sub_lt c j hn' (σ := σ)
        omega
      · refine lt_of_le_of_lt (totalDegree_mul _ _) ?_
        rw [totalDegree_X_pow]
        omega

name: AclGeom.totalDegree_translate_sub_lt
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hrepr : translate c F - F = ∑ m ∈ F.support,
      C (F.coeff m) * (translate c (monomial m 1) - monomial m 1) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [F.as_sum]
    rw [map_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ ↦ ?_
    have hCm : monomial m (F.coeff m) = C (F.coeff m) * monomial m 1 := by
      rw [C_mul_monomial, mul_one]
    rw [hCm, map_mul, translate_C, mul_sub]
  rw [hrepr]
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt (totalDegree_finsetSum _ _) ?_
  rw [Finset.sup_lt_iff (by simpa using hF)]
  intro m hmF
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt (totalDegree_mul _ _) ?_
  rw [totalDegree_C, zero_add]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (m.sum fun _ e ↦ e) with hz | hp
  · have hm0 : m = 0 := finsupp_sum_id_eq_zero_iff.1 hz
    subst hm0
    have h1 : (monomial (0 : σ →₀ ℕ) (1 : K)) = 1 := by
      rw [monomial_zero']
      exact C_1
    rw [h1, map_one, sub_self]
    simpa using hF
  · exact lt_of_lt_of_le (totalDegree_translate_monomial_sub_lt c hp)
      (le_totalDegree hmF)

name: AclGeom.translate_eq_self_of_span_eq
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos F.totalDegree with h0 | hpos
  · have hFC : F = C (F.coeff 0) := totalDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C.1 h0
    rw [hFC, translate_C]
  · obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton.1 h
    have hτF : translate c F ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      rw [h0, zero_mul] at hu
      exact hF hu.symm
    have hdrop := totalDegree_translate_sub_lt c hpos
    
    have hτdeg : (translate c F).totalDegree = F.totalDegree := by
      have hle : (translate c F).totalDegree ≤ F.totalDegree := by
        have hsplit : translate c F = (translate c F - F) + F := by ring
        rw [hsplit]
        exact le_trans (totalDegree_add _ _) (max_le (le_of_lt hdrop) le_rfl)
      have hge : F.totalDegree ≤ (translate c F).totalDegree := by
        have hsplit : F = translate c F + -(translate c F - F) := by ring
        have hFle : F.totalDegree ≤ max (translate c F).totalDegree
            (translate c F - F).totalDegree := by
          calc F.totalDegree
              = (translate c F + -(translate c F - F)).totalDegree := by
                rw [← hsplit]
            _ ≤ max (translate c F).totalDegree
                (-(translate c F - F)).totalDegree := totalDegree_add _ _
            _ = max (translate c F).totalDegree
                (translate c F - F).totalDegree := by rw [totalDegree_neg]
        rcases max_cases (translate c F).totalDegree
            (translate c F - F).totalDegree with ⟨hmax, -⟩ | ⟨hmax, -⟩ <;>
          rw [hmax] at hFle <;> omega
      omega
    
    have hudeg : (u : MvPolynomial σ K).totalDegree = 0 := by
      have hprod := totalDegree_mul_of_isDomain hτF u.ne_zero
      rw [hu, hτdeg] at hprod
      omega
    set a : K := (u : MvPolynomial σ K).coeff 0 with ha_def
    have ha : (u : MvPolynomial σ K) = C a := totalDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C.1 hudeg
    
    
    obtain ⟨e, heF, hesum⟩ := F.support.exists_mem_eq_sup
      (support_nonempty.2 hF) fun m : σ →₀ ℕ ↦ Multiset.card (Finsupp.toMultiset m)
    have hesum' : F.totalDegree = ∑ i ∈ e.support, e i := by
      rw [totalDegree_eq, hesum, Finsupp.card_toMultiset]
      rfl
    have hcoeff : F.coeff e ≠ 0 := mem_support_iff.1 heF
    have htop : (translate c F).coeff e = F.coeff e := by
      have hzero : (translate c F - F).coeff e = 0 :=
        coeff_eq_zero_of_totalDegree_lt (hesum' ▸ hdrop)
      have hsplit : translate c F = (translate c F - F) + F := by ring
      rw [hsplit, AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hzero, zero_add]
    rw [mul_comm] at hu
    have hcmp : F.coeff e = a * F.coeff e := by
      nth_rewrite 1 [← hu]
      rw [ha, coeff_C_mul, htop]
    have ha1 : a = 1 :=
      mul_right_cancel₀ hcoeff (by rw [← hcmp, one_mul])
    rw [ha, ha1, C_1, one_mul] at hu
    exact hu

name: AclGeom.translate_translate
statement:
theorem translate_translate (c c' : σ → K) (g : MvPolynomial σ K) :
    translate c (translate c' g) = translate (c + c') g
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : (translate (σ := σ) c).comp (translate c') = translate (c + c') := by
    refine algHom_ext fun i ↦ ?_
    simp [translate, map_add, add_assoc]
  exact congrArg (fun (f : MvPolynomial σ K →ₐ[K] MvPolynomial σ K) ↦ f g) hcomp

name: AclGeom.translate_zero
statement:
theorem translate_zero (g : MvPolynomial σ K) :
    translate (0 : σ → K) g = g
proof:
:= by
  have hid : translate (σ := σ) (0 : σ → K) = AlgHom.id K _ := by
    refine algHom_ext fun i ↦ ?_
    simp [translate]
  rw [hid]
  rfl

name: AclGeom.translate_neg_translate
statement:
theorem translate_neg_translate (c : σ → K) (g : MvPolynomial σ K) :
    translate (-c) (translate c g) = g
proof:
:= by
  rw [translate_translate, neg_add_cancel, translate_zero]

name: AclGeom.translate_translate_neg
statement:
theorem translate_translate_neg (c : σ → K) (g : MvPolynomial σ K) :
    translate c (translate (-c) g) = g
proof:
:= by
  rw [translate_translate, add_neg_cancel, translate_zero]

name: AclGeom.aeval_translate
statement:
theorem aeval_translate {Ω : Type*} [Field Ω] [Algebra K Ω]
    (a : σ → Ω) (c : σ → K) (g : MvPolynomial σ K) :
    aeval a (translate c g) = aeval (fun j ↦ a j + algebraMap K Ω (c j)) g
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ((aeval a : MvPolynomial σ K →ₐ[K] Ω).comp (translate c)) =
      aeval fun j ↦ a j + algebraMap K Ω (c j) := by
    refine algHom_ext fun i ↦ ?_
    simp [translate, algebraMap_eq]
  exact congrArg (fun (f : MvPolynomial σ K →ₐ[K] Ω) ↦ f g) hcomp

name: AclGeom.idealOf_translate_span
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hkey : ∀ g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K,
      aeval (fun j ↦ a j - algebraMap K Ω (c j)) (translate c g) = aeval a g := by
    intro g
    have hfun : (fun j ↦ (a j - algebraMap K Ω (c j)) + algebraMap K Ω (c j)) = a := by
      funext j
      rw [sub_add_cancel]
    rw [aeval_translate, hfun]
  ext g
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  constructor
  · intro hg
    have hg' : translate (-c) g ∈ idealOf K a := by
      rw [mem_idealOf_iff, ← hkey (translate (-c) g), translate_translate_neg]
      exact hg
    rw [h, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hg'
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hg'
    refine ⟨translate c e, ?_⟩
    have hT := congrArg (translate c) he
    rw [translate_translate_neg, map_mul] at hT
    exact hT
  · rintro ⟨e, rfl⟩
    rw [map_mul]
    have hF : aeval (fun j ↦ a j - algebraMap K Ω (c j)) (translate c F) = 0 := by
      rw [hkey]
      exact (mem_idealOf_iff K).1 (h ▸ Ideal.subset_span rfl)
    rw [hF, zero_mul]

name: AclGeom.scale_X
statement:
@[simp]
theorem scale_X (c : σ → K) (j : σ) : scale c (X j) = C (c j) * X j
proof:
:= by
  simp [scale]

name: AclGeom.scale_C
statement:
@[simp]
theorem scale_C (c : σ → K) (a : K) : scale c (C a) = C a
proof:
:= by
  simp [scale, algebraMap_eq]

name: AclGeom.scale_monomial
statement:
theorem scale_monomial (c : σ → K) (m : σ →₀ ℕ) (a : K) :
    scale c (monomial m a) = monomial m ((m.prod fun j e ↦ c j ^ e) * a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [scale, aeval_monomial]
  have hprod : (m.prod fun j e ↦ (C (c j) * X j : MvPolynomial σ K) ^ e) =
      C (m.prod fun j e ↦ c j ^ e) * m.prod fun j e ↦ (X j : MvPolynomial σ K) ^ e := by
    rw [Finsupp.prod, Finsupp.prod, Finsupp.prod, map_prod,
      ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
    rw [mul_pow, C_pow]
  have hmono : (m.prod fun j e ↦ (X j : MvPolynomial σ K) ^ e) =
      monomial m (1 : K) := by
    rw [monomial_eq, C_1, one_mul]
  rw [hprod, MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq, hmono, ← mul_assoc, ← C_mul,
    C_mul_monomial, mul_one, mul_comm a (m.prod fun j e ↦ c j ^ e)]

name: AclGeom.coeff_scale
statement:
theorem coeff_scale (c : σ → K) (g : MvPolynomial σ K) (m : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    (scale c g).coeff m = (m.prod fun j e ↦ c j ^ e) * g.coeff m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  conv_lhs => rw [g.as_sum, map_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m' _ ↦ scale_monomial c m' (g.coeff m')]
  rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m' _ ↦ MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial m m' _]
  by_cases hm : m ∈ g.support
  · rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' g.support m
      fun m' ↦ (m'.prod fun j e ↦ c j ^ e) * g.coeff m', ite_eq_left hm]
  · rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' g.support m
      fun m' ↦ (m'.prod fun j e ↦ c j ^ e) * g.coeff m', ite_eq_right hm]
    rw [MvPolynomial.notMem_support_iff.1 hm, mul_zero]

name: AclGeom.scale_scale
statement:
theorem scale_scale (c c' : σ → K) (g : MvPolynomial σ K) :
    scale c (scale c' g) = scale (c * c') g
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : (scale (σ := σ) c).comp (scale c') = scale (c * c') := by
    refine algHom_ext fun i ↦ ?_
    simp [scale, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]
  exact congrArg (fun (f : MvPolynomial σ K →ₐ[K] MvPolynomial σ K) ↦ f g) hcomp

name: AclGeom.scale_one
statement: theorem scale_one (g : MvPolynomial σ K) : scale (1 : σ → K) g = g
proof:
:= by
  have hid : scale (σ := σ) (1 : σ → K) = AlgHom.id K _ := by
    refine algHom_ext fun i ↦ ?_
    simp [scale]
  rw [hid]
  rfl

name: AclGeom.aeval_scale
statement:
theorem aeval_scale {Ω : Type*} [Field Ω] [Algebra K Ω]
    (a : σ → Ω) (c : σ → K) (g : MvPolynomial σ K) :
    aeval a (scale c g) = aeval (fun j ↦ algebraMap K Ω (c j) * a j) g
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ((aeval a : MvPolynomial σ K →ₐ[K] Ω).comp (scale c)) =
      aeval fun j ↦ algebraMap K Ω (c j) * a j := by
    refine algHom_ext fun i ↦ ?_
    simp [scale, algebraMap_eq]
  exact congrArg (fun (f : MvPolynomial σ K →ₐ[K] Ω) ↦ f g) hcomp

name: AclGeom.idealOf_scale_span
statement:
theorem idealOf_scale_span {Ω : Type*} [Field Ω] [Algebra K Ω]
    {a : Fin 2 → Ω} {c : Fin 2 → K} (hc : ∀ j, c j ≠ 0)
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K} (h : idealOf K a = Ideal.span {F}) :
    idealOf K (fun j ↦ a j / algebraMap K Ω (c j)) =
      Ideal.span {scale c F}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcΩ : ∀ j, algebraMap K Ω (c j) ≠ 0 := fun j h0 ↦
    hc j ((map_eq_zero _).1 h0)
  have hkey : ∀ g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K,
      aeval (fun j ↦ a j / algebraMap K Ω (c j)) (scale c g) = aeval a g := by
    intro g
    have hfun : (fun j ↦ algebraMap K Ω (c j) * (a j / algebraMap K Ω (c j))) =
        a := by
      funext j
      rw [mul_comm, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hcΩ j)]
    rw [aeval_scale, hfun]
  have hinv : ∀ j, ((c j)⁻¹ : K) ≠ 0 := fun j ↦ inv_ne_zero (hc j)
  ext g
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  constructor
  · intro hg
    have hg' : scale (fun j ↦ (c j)⁻¹) g ∈ idealOf K a := by
      rw [mem_idealOf_iff, ← hkey (scale (fun j ↦ (c j)⁻¹) g), scale_scale]
      have hone : (c * fun j ↦ (c j)⁻¹) = (1 : Fin 2 → K) := by
        funext j
        simp [mul_inv_cancel₀ (hc j)]
      rw [hone, scale_one]
      exact hg
    rw [h, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hg'
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hg'
    refine ⟨scale c e, ?_⟩
    have hT := congrArg (scale c) he
    rw [scale_scale] at hT
    have hone : (c * fun j ↦ (c j)⁻¹) = (1 : Fin 2 → K) := by
      funext j
      simp [mul_inv_cancel₀ (hc j)]
    rw [hone, scale_one, map_mul] at hT
    exact hT
  · rintro ⟨e, rfl⟩
    rw [map_mul]
    have hF : aeval (fun j ↦ a j / algebraMap K Ω (c j)) (scale c F) = 0 := by
      rw [hkey]
      exact (mem_idealOf_iff K).1 (h ▸ Ideal.subset_span rfl)
    rw [hF, zero_mul]

name: AclGeom.support_scale
statement:
theorem support_scale {c : σ → K} (hc : ∀ j, c j ≠ 0) (g : MvPolynomial σ K) :
    (scale c g).support = g.support
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext m
  rw [MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff, MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff, coeff_scale]
  have hne : (m.prod fun j e ↦ c j ^ e) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Finsupp.prod]
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun j _ ↦ pow_ne_zero _ (hc j)
  constructor
  · intro h h0
    exact h (by rw [h0, mul_zero])
  · intro h h0
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h0 with h1 | h1
    · exact hne h1
    · exact h h1

name: AclGeom.monomial_prod_eq_of_span_scale_eq
statement:
theorem monomial_prod_eq_of_span_scale_eq {c : σ → K} (hc : ∀ j, c j ≠ 0)
    {F : MvPolynomial σ K} (hF : F ≠ 0)
    (h : Ideal.span {scale c F} = Ideal.span {F}) :
    ∀ m ∈ F.support, ∀ m' ∈ F.support,
      (m.prod fun j e ↦ c j ^ e) = m'.prod fun j e ↦ c j ^ e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton.1 h
  have hsF : scale c F ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, zero_mul] at hu
    exact hF hu.symm
  have hudeg : (u : MvPolynomial σ K).totalDegree = 0 := by
    have hprod := totalDegree_mul_of_isDomain hsF u.ne_zero
    rw [hu] at hprod
    have hdeq : (scale c F).totalDegree = F.totalDegree := by
      rw [totalDegree_eq, totalDegree_eq, support_scale hc]
    omega
  set lam : K := (u : MvPolynomial σ K).coeff 0 with hlam
  have hCl : (u : MvPolynomial σ K) = C lam :=
    totalDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C.1 hudeg
  have key : ∀ m₀ ∈ F.support, lam * (m₀.prod fun j e ↦ c j ^ e) = 1 := by
    intro m₀ hm₀
    have h1 : (scale c F * (u : MvPolynomial σ K)).coeff m₀ = F.coeff m₀ :=
      congrArg (fun g ↦ g.coeff m₀) hu
    rw [hCl, mul_comm (scale c F), coeff_C_mul, coeff_scale] at h1
    have hm₀0 : F.coeff m₀ ≠ 0 := MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.1 hm₀
    have h2 : (lam * (m₀.prod fun j e ↦ c j ^ e)) * F.coeff m₀ =
        1 * F.coeff m₀ := by
      rw [one_mul, mul_assoc]
      exact h1
    exact mul_right_cancel₀ hm₀0 h2
  intro m hm m' hm'
  have hlam0 : lam ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hk := key m hm
    rw [h0, zero_mul] at hk
    exact one_ne_zero hk.symm
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hlam0 ((key m hm).trans (key m' hm').symm)

name: AclGeom.exists_support_pair_of_aeval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_support_pair_of_aeval_eq_zero [Fintype σ]
    {Ω : Type*} [Field Ω] [Algebra K Ω] {v : σ → Ω} (hv : ∀ j, v j ≠ 0)
    {F : MvPolynomial σ K} (hF0 : F ≠ 0) (hF : aeval v F = 0) :
    ∃ m ∈ F.support, ∃ m' ∈ F.support, m ≠ m'
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ :=
    Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 fun h ↦ hF0 (support_eq_empty.1 h)
  by_contra hcon
  push Not at hcon
  have hsup : F.support = {m₀} :=
    Finset.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.2 ⟨hm₀, fun m hm ↦ hcon m hm m₀ hm₀⟩
  rw [aeval_def, eval₂_eq, hsup, Finset.sum_singleton] at hF
  rcases mul_eq_zero.1 hF with h | h
  · exact mem_support_iff.1 hm₀ ((map_eq_zero _).1 h)
  · obtain ⟨j, _, hj⟩ := Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff.1 h
    exact hv j (pow_eq_zero_iff'.1 hj).1

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.sourceToMiddleTransport_baseEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourceToMiddleTransport_baseEquiv_algebraMap (c : E) :
    (sourceToMiddleTransport P Q h).baseEquiv
        (algebraMap E (↥P.sourceField) c) =
      algebraMap E (↥Q.sourceField) c
proof:
:= by
  exact AlgebraicClosureTransport.trans_baseEquiv_algebraMap
    P.coordinateClosureTransport (P.middleClosureTransport Q h)
    P.coordinateClosureTransport_baseEquiv_algebraMap
    (P.middleClosureTransport_baseEquiv_algebraMap Q h) c

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.chainCoordinateClosureTransport_baseEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem chainCoordinateClosureTransport_baseEquiv_algebraMap
    (c : E) :
    (P.chainCoordinateClosureTransport Q h).baseEquiv
        (algebraMap E (↥P.sourceField) c) =
      algebraMap E (↥Q.targetField) c
proof:
:= by
  exact AlgebraicClosureTransport.trans_baseEquiv_algebraMap
    P.coordinateClosureTransport
    ((P.middleClosureTransport Q h).trans Q.coordinateClosureTransport)
    P.coordinateClosureTransport_baseEquiv_algebraMap
    (fun c ↦ AlgebraicClosureTransport.trans_baseEquiv_algebraMap
      (P.middleClosureTransport Q h) Q.coordinateClosureTransport
      (P.middleClosureTransport_baseEquiv_algebraMap Q h)
      Q.coordinateClosureTransport_baseEquiv_algebraMap c) c

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.directCompositeClosureTransport_baseEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem directCompositeClosureTransport_baseEquiv_algebraMap
    (c : E) :
    (P.directCompositeClosureTransport Q h).baseEquiv
        (algebraMap E (↥P.sourceField) c) =
      algebraMap E (↥Q.targetField) c
proof:
:= by
  change (P.chainCoordinateClosureTransport Q h).baseEquiv
      (algebraMap E (↥P.sourceField) c) = _
  exact chainCoordinateClosureTransport_baseEquiv_algebraMap P Q h c

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.leftSourceFiniteNormalCover_le_sourceCover
statement:
theorem leftSourceFiniteNormalCover_le_sourceCover :
    P.sourceFiniteNormalCover.field ≤ (sourceCover P Q h).field
proof:
:= by
  change P.sourceFiniteNormalCover.field ≤
    (P.sourceFiniteNormalCover.field ⊔
      (Q.sourceFiniteNormalCover.map
        (sourceToMiddleTransport P Q h).symm).field) ⊔
      (P.comp Q h).sourceFiniteNormalCover.field
  exact le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.pulledRightSourceFiniteNormalCover_le_sourceCover
statement:
theorem pulledRightSourceFiniteNormalCover_le_sourceCover :
    (Q.sourceFiniteNormalCover.map
      (sourceToMiddleTransport P Q h).symm).field ≤
        (sourceCover P Q h).field
proof:
:= by
  change (Q.sourceFiniteNormalCover.map
      (sourceToMiddleTransport P Q h).symm).field ≤
    (P.sourceFiniteNormalCover.field ⊔
      (Q.sourceFiniteNormalCover.map
        (sourceToMiddleTransport P Q h).symm).field) ⊔
      (P.comp Q h).sourceFiniteNormalCover.field
  exact le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.directSourceFiniteNormalCover_le_sourceCover
statement:
theorem directSourceFiniteNormalCover_le_sourceCover :
    (P.comp Q h).sourceFiniteNormalCover.field ≤
      (sourceCover P Q h).field
proof:
:= by
  change (P.comp Q h).sourceFiniteNormalCover.field ≤
    (P.sourceFiniteNormalCover.field ⊔
      (Q.sourceFiniteNormalCover.map
        (sourceToMiddleTransport P Q h).symm).field) ⊔
      (P.comp Q h).sourceFiniteNormalCover.field
  exact le_sup_right

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.rightSourceFiniteNormalCover_le_middleCover
statement:
theorem rightSourceFiniteNormalCover_le_middleCover
    (N : AlgebraicClosureTransport.FiniteNormalCover (↥P.sourceField))
    (hle : (sourceCover P Q h).field ≤ N.field) :
    Q.sourceFiniteNormalCover.field ≤
      (N.map (sourceToMiddleTransport P Q h)).field
proof:
:= by
  let T := sourceToMiddleTransport P Q h
  have hpre : (Q.sourceFiniteNormalCover.map T.symm).field ≤ N.field :=
    (pulledRightSourceFiniteNormalCover_le_sourceCover P Q h).trans hle
  have hmap := T.mapField_mono hpre
  simpa [T] using hmap

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.selectedRightBranchInMiddle_curveEquation
statement:
theorem selectedRightBranchInMiddle_curveEquation
    [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (N : AlgebraicClosureTransport.FiniteNormalCover (↥P.sourceField))
    (hle : (sourceCover P Q h).field ≤ N.field)
    {L : Type*} [Field L] [Algebra E L]
    (chart :
      (↥(N.map (sourceToMiddleTransport P Q h)).field) ≃+* L)
    (hchart : ∀ c : E,
      chart (algebraMap E
        (↥(N.map (sourceToMiddleTransport P Q h)).field) c) =
        algebraMap E L c) :
    MvPolynomial.aeval
        ![chart ((selectedRightBranchInMiddle P Q h N hle).toAlgHom
            Q.sourceInBranchOverSource),
          chart ((selectedRightBranchInMiddle P Q h N hle).toAlgHom
            Q.targetInBranchOverSource)]
        Q.curveEquation = 0
proof:
:= by
  let : IsScalarTower E (↥Q.sourceField)
      (↥(N.map (sourceToMiddleTransport P Q h)).field) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let branch : (↥Q.branchOverSource) →ₐ[E]
      (↥(N.map (sourceToMiddleTransport P Q h)).field) :=
    (selectedRightBranchInMiddle P Q h N hle).toAlgHom.restrictScalars E
  let e : (↥(N.map (sourceToMiddleTransport P Q h)).field) ≃ₐ[E] L :=
    AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv hchart
  exact Q.aeval_curveEquation_map (e.toAlgHom.comp branch)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.rightMap_field
statement:
theorem rightMap_field :
    ((middleCover P Q h).map Q.coordinateClosureTransport).field =
      (targetCover P Q h).field
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp [targetCover, middleCover, sourceToMiddleTransport,
    FiniteCorrespondencePair.chainCoordinateClosureTransport]

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.leftEquiv_trans_rightEquiv
statement:
theorem leftEquiv_trans_rightEquiv :
    (leftEquiv P Q h).trans (rightEquiv P Q h) =
      compositeEquiv P Q h
proof:
:= by
  apply RingEquiv.ext
  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  rfl

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.directMap_field
statement:
theorem directMap_field :
    ((sourceCover P Q h).map
      (P.directCompositeClosureTransport Q h)).field =
        (targetCover P Q h).field
proof:
:= by
  exact (sourceCover P Q h).correctedMap_field
    (P.chainCoordinateClosureTransport Q h)
    (P.directCompositeClosureTransport Q h)
    (P.compositionDefect Q h)
    (P.chainCoordinateClosureTransport_trans_compositionDefect Q h)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.compositeEquiv_trans_defectEquiv
statement:
theorem compositeEquiv_trans_defectEquiv :
    (compositeEquiv P Q h).trans (defectEquiv P Q h).toRingEquiv =
      directEquiv P Q h
proof:
:=
  (sourceCover P Q h).mapEquiv_trans_restrictAlgEquiv
    (P.chainCoordinateClosureTransport Q h)
    (P.directCompositeClosureTransport Q h)
    (P.compositionDefect Q h)
    (P.chainCoordinateClosureTransport_trans_compositionDefect Q h)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.strictComposition
statement:
theorem strictComposition :
    (leftEquiv P Q h).trans (rightEquiv P Q h) =
      strictDirectEquiv P Q h
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftEquiv_trans_rightEquiv]
  exact FieldEquiv.eq_trans_symm_of_trans_eq
    (compositeEquiv P Q h) (directEquiv P Q h)
    (defectEquiv P Q h).toRingEquiv
    (compositeEquiv_trans_defectEquiv P Q h)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.OnSourceCover.rightMap_field
statement:
theorem rightMap_field :
    ((middleCover P Q h N).map Q.coordinateClosureTransport).field =
      (targetCover P Q h N).field
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp [targetCover, middleCover, sourceToMiddleTransport,
    FiniteCorrespondencePair.chainCoordinateClosureTransport]

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.OnSourceCover.leftEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftEquiv_algebraMap (c : E) :
    leftEquiv P Q h N (algebraMap E (↥N.field) c) =
      algebraMap E (↥(middleCover P Q h N).field) c
proof:
:= by
  exact N.mapEquiv_coefficient_algebraMap
    (sourceToMiddleTransport P Q h)
    (sourceToMiddleTransport_baseEquiv_algebraMap P Q h) c

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.OnSourceCover.rightEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightEquiv_algebraMap (c : E) :
    rightEquiv P Q h N
        (algebraMap E (↥(middleCover P Q h N).field) c) =
      algebraMap E (↥(targetCover P Q h N).field) c
proof:
:= by
  unfold rightEquiv
  rw [RingEquiv.trans_apply]
  rw [(middleCover P Q h N).mapEquiv_coefficient_algebraMap
    Q.coordinateClosureTransport
      Q.coordinateClosureTransport_baseEquiv_algebraMap]
  apply Subtype.ext
  rfl

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.OnSourceCover.compositeEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem compositeEquiv_algebraMap (c : E) :
    compositeEquiv P Q h N (algebraMap E (↥N.field) c) =
      algebraMap E (↥(targetCover P Q h N).field) c
proof:
:= by
  exact N.mapEquiv_coefficient_algebraMap
    (P.chainCoordinateClosureTransport Q h)
    (chainCoordinateClosureTransport_baseEquiv_algebraMap P Q h) c

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.OnSourceCover.leftEquiv_trans_rightEquiv
statement:
theorem leftEquiv_trans_rightEquiv :

proof:
:= by

  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  rfl

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.OnSourceCover.compositeEquiv_trans_defectEquiv
statement:
theorem compositeEquiv_trans_defectEquiv :
    (compositeEquiv P Q h N).trans
        (defectEquiv P Q h N).toRingEquiv =
      directEquiv P Q h N
proof:
:=
  N.mapEquiv_trans_restrictAlgEquiv
    (P.chainCoordinateClosureTransport Q h)
    (P.directCompositeClosureTransport Q h)
    (P.compositionDefect Q h)
    (P.chainCoordinateClosureTransport_trans_compositionDefect Q h)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.OnSourceCover.strictComposition
statement:
theorem strictComposition :
    (leftEquiv P Q h N).trans (rightEquiv P Q h N) =
      strictDirectEquiv P Q h N
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftEquiv_trans_rightEquiv]
  exact FieldEquiv.eq_trans_symm_of_trans_eq
    (compositeEquiv P Q h N) (directEquiv P Q h N)
    (defectEquiv P Q h N).toRingEquiv
    (compositeEquiv_trans_defectEquiv P Q h N)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.FiniteCoverTriangle.OnSourceCover.strictDirectEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem strictDirectEquiv_algebraMap (c : E) :
    strictDirectEquiv P Q h N (algebraMap E (↥N.field) c) =
      algebraMap E (↥(targetCover P Q h N).field) c
proof:
:= by
  have heq : strictDirectEquiv P Q h N = compositeEquiv P Q h N :=
    (strictComposition P Q h N).symm.trans
      (leftEquiv_trans_rightEquiv P Q h N)
  rw [heq, compositeEquiv_algebraMap]

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.source_transcendental'

:= by

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.rawCurveEquation_prime
statement: private theorem rawCurveEquation_prime : Prime P.rawCurveEquation
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec
    (exists_prime_span_idealOf k P.source_transcendental' P.target_mem_source)).1

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.ideal_eq_span_rawCurveEquation
statement:

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.leadingCoeff_rawCurveEquation_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem leadingCoeff_rawCurveEquation_ne_zero :
    MonomialOrder.lex.leadingCoeff P.rawCurveEquation ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  MonomialOrder.leadingCoeff_ne_zero_iff.mpr P.rawCurveEquation_prime.ne_zero

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.curveEquation_monic
statement: theorem curveEquation_monic : MonomialOrder.lex.Monic P.curveEquation
proof:
:= by
  rw [MonomialOrder.Monic, curveEquation, MonomialOrder.leadingCoeff_mul,
    MonomialOrder.leadingCoeff_C]
  exact inv_mul_cancel₀ P.leadingCoeff_rawCurveEquation_ne_zero

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.curveEquation_associated_raw
statement:
private theorem curveEquation_associated_raw :
    Associated P.curveEquation P.rawCurveEquation
proof:
:= by
  apply associated_unit_mul_left
  exact IsUnit.map MvPolynomial.C
    (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (inv_ne_zero P.leadingCoeff_rawCurveEquation_ne_zero))

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.curveEquation_prime
statement: theorem curveEquation_prime : Prime P.curveEquation
proof:
:=
  P.curveEquation_associated_raw.symm.prime P.rawCurveEquation_prime

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.ideal_eq_span_curveEquation
statement:
theorem ideal_eq_span_curveEquation :
    P.ideal = Ideal.span {P.curveEquation}
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.ideal_eq_span_rawCurveEquation]
  exact Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton.mpr
    P.curveEquation_associated_raw.symm

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.aeval_curveEquation
statement:
theorem aeval_curveEquation :
    aeval ![P.source, P.target] P.curveEquation = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_idealOf_iff k]
  change P.curveEquation ∈ P.ideal
  rw [P.ideal_eq_span_curveEquation]
  exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton P.curveEquation)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.eq_of_monic_of_associated
statement:
theorem eq_of_monic_of_associated
    {f g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k}
    (hf : MonomialOrder.lex.Monic f) (hg : MonomialOrder.lex.Monic g)
    (hfg : Associated f g) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hfg
  obtain ⟨c, hcunit, huc⟩ :=
    MvPolynomial.isUnit_iff_eq_C_of_isReduced.mp u.isUnit
  have hlc : MonomialOrder.lex.leadingCoeff (f * (u : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)) = c := by
    rw [huc, MonomialOrder.leadingCoeff_mul, MonomialOrder.leadingCoeff_C,
      hf.leadingCoeff_eq_one, one_mul]
  have hc : c = 1 := by
    rw [hu, hg.leadingCoeff_eq_one] at hlc
    exact hlc.symm
  rw [← hu, huc, hc, map_one, mul_one]

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.curveEquation_eq_of_ideal_eq
statement:
theorem curveEquation_eq_of_ideal_eq
    (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) (h : P.ideal = Q.ideal) :
    P.curveEquation = Q.curveEquation
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_of_monic_of_associated P.curveEquation_monic Q.curveEquation_monic
  rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton]
  rw [← P.ideal_eq_span_curveEquation, ← Q.ideal_eq_span_curveEquation, h]

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.curveCoefficientSet_finite
statement: theorem curveCoefficientSet_finite : (P.curveCoefficientSet k E).Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let c : (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) → Ω :=
    fun d ↦ ((P.curveEquation.coeff d : E) : Ω)
  have hs : ((P.curveEquation.support : Set (Fin 2 →₀ ℕ)).image c).Finite :=
    P.curveEquation.support.finite_toSet.image c
  refine (hs.insert 0).subset ?_
  rintro z ⟨d, rfl⟩
  by_cases hd : d ∈ P.curveEquation.support
  · exact Set.mem_insert_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩)
  · have hcoeff : P.curveEquation.coeff d = 0 := by
      simpa only [MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff, not_ne_iff] using hd
    exact Set.mem_insert_iff.mpr (Or.inl (by simp [hcoeff]))

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.adjoin_curveCoefficientCoordinates_eq_top
statement:
theorem adjoin_curveCoefficientCoordinates_eq_top :
    IntermediateField.adjoin k
      (Set.range (P.curveCoefficientCoordinates k E)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let F := P.curveCoefficientField k E
  apply F.lift_injective
  rw [F.lift_adjoin, F.lift_top]
  change IntermediateField.adjoin k
      (Subtype.val '' Set.range (P.curveCoefficientCoordinates k E)) = F
  have hrange : Subtype.val ''
      Set.range (P.curveCoefficientCoordinates k E) =
      P.curveCoefficientSet k E := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨c, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact c.2
    · intro hz
      let c : P.curveCoefficientSet k E := ⟨z, hz⟩
      exact ⟨P.curveCoefficientCoordinates k E c, ⟨c, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [hrange]
  rfl

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.coeff_mem_curveCoefficientField
statement:
theorem coeff_mem_curveCoefficientField (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) :
    ((P.curveEquation.coeff d : E) : Ω) ∈ P.curveCoefficientField k E
proof:
:=
  IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨d, rfl⟩

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.curveCoefficientField_le
statement: theorem curveCoefficientField_le : P.curveCoefficientField k E ≤ E
proof:
:= by
  rw [curveCoefficientField]
  refine IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff.mpr ?_
  rintro z ⟨d, rfl⟩
  exact (P.curveEquation.coeff d).2

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.map_curveEquationOverCoefficientField
statement:
theorem map_curveEquationOverCoefficientField :
    MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (P.curveCoefficientField k E) Ω)
        (P.curveEquationOverCoefficientField k E) =
      MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap E Ω) P.curveEquation
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [curveEquationOverCoefficientField, map_sum]
  conv_rhs => rw [P.curveEquation.as_sum, map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d hd
  simp

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.curveEquationOverCoefficientField_ne_zero
statement:
theorem curveEquationOverCoefficientField_ne_zero :
    P.curveEquationOverCoefficientField k E ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hm := congrArg
    (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (P.curveCoefficientField k E) Ω)) h
  rw [P.map_curveEquationOverCoefficientField k E, map_zero] at hm
  exact P.curveEquation_prime.ne_zero
    ((MvPolynomial.map_injective (algebraMap E Ω) (algebraMap E Ω).injective) hm)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.aeval_curveEquationOverCoefficientField
statement:
theorem aeval_curveEquationOverCoefficientField :
    aeval ![P.source, P.target] (P.curveEquationOverCoefficientField k E) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hm := congrArg (aeval ![P.source, P.target])
    (P.map_curveEquationOverCoefficientField k E)
  rw [MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap,
    MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap, P.aeval_curveEquation] at hm
  exact hm

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.source_transcendental_curveCoefficientField
statement:
theorem source_transcendental_curveCoefficientField :
    Transcendental (P.curveCoefficientField k E) P.source
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact P.source_transcendental'
    (isAlgebraic_of_le (P.curveCoefficientField_le k E) h)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.target_mem_racl_curveCoefficientField_source
statement:
theorem target_mem_racl_curveCoefficientField_source :
    P.target ∈ racl (P.curveCoefficientField k E) {P.source}
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_racl_iff]
  refine ⟨evalFst (K := P.curveCoefficientField k E) P.source
      (P.curveEquationOverCoefficientField k E), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    exact P.curveEquationOverCoefficientField_ne_zero k E
      ((evalFst_injective P.source_transcendental_curveCoefficientField)
        (by rw [h, map_zero]))
  · rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, eval₂_evalFst]
    exact P.aeval_curveEquationOverCoefficientField k E

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.curveCoefficientSet_eq_of_ideal_eq
statement:
theorem curveCoefficientSet_eq_of_ideal_eq
    (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair E Ω) (h : P.ideal = Q.ideal) :

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.curveCoefficientField_eq_of_ideal_eq
statement:
theorem curveCoefficientField_eq_of_ideal_eq
    (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair E Ω) (h : P.ideal = Q.ideal) :
    P.curveCoefficientField k E = Q.curveCoefficientField k E
proof:
