    P.curveCoefficientSet_eq_of_ideal_eq k E Q h]

name: AclGeom.CurvePointsPlaces.placeModelMap_stalk_comp_subtype
statement:
theorem placeModelMap_stalk_comp_subtype
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left] [IsProper X.hom]
    (P : Place k X.left.functionField) :
    Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo (placeModelMap X P) ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom P.val.subtype =
      CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk (placeCenter X P)) X.left.functionField)
proof:
:= by
  let m := placeModelMap X P
  let u := Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo m
  let v := CommRingCat.ofHom P.val.subtype
  let t := X.left.fromSpecStalk (placeCenter X P)
  have hlocal : Spec.map u ≫ t = m :=
    Scheme.Spec_stalkClosedPointTo_fromSpecStalk m
  have hgeneric : Spec.map v ≫ m =
      X.left.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X.left) := placeModelMap_generic X P
  have hcanonical : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk (placeCenter X P)) X.left.functionField)) ≫ t =
      X.left.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X.left) :=
    Scheme.SpecMap_stalkSpecializes_fromSpecStalk (genericPoint_specializes (placeCenter X P))
  apply Spec.map_injective
  apply (cancel_mono t).mp
  exact ((congrArg (fun f ↦ f ≫ t) (Spec.map_comp u v)).trans
    ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans ((congrArg (fun f ↦ Spec.map v ≫ f) hlocal).trans
      hgeneric))).trans hcanonical.symm

name: AclGeom.CurvePointsPlaces.stalkValuationSubring_placeCenter
statement:
theorem stalkValuationSubring_placeCenter
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left] [IsProper X.hom]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X.left] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1)
    (hnormal : ∀ x : X.left, IsIntegrallyClosed (X.left.presheaf.stalk x))
    (P : Place k X.left.functionField) :
    stalkValuationSubring X.left hdim.le hnormal (placeCenter X P) = P.val
proof:
:= by
  have hle : stalkValuationSubring X.left hdim.le hnormal (placeCenter X P) ≤ P.val := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ :=
      (mem_stalkValuationSubring X.left hdim.le hnormal (placeCenter X P) z).mp hz
    have hval : ((Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo (placeModelMap X P)).hom r :
        X.left.functionField) = z :=
      (congrArg (fun f ↦ f.hom r) (placeModelMap_stalk_comp_subtype X P)).trans hr
    rw [← hval]
    exact ((Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo (placeModelMap X P)).hom r).property
  have : Ring.KrullDimLE 1
      (stalkValuationSubring X.left hdim.le hnormal (placeCenter X P)) :=
    stalkValuationSubring_krullDimLE X.left hdim.le hnormal (placeCenter X P)
  exact ValuationSubring.eq_of_le_of_ne_top
    (stalkValuationSubring X.left hdim.le hnormal (placeCenter X P)) hle P.ne_top

name: AclGeom.CurvePointsPlaces.placeCenter_isClosed
statement:
theorem placeCenter_isClosed
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left] [IsProper X.hom]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1)
    (hnormal : ∀ x : X.left, IsIntegrallyClosed (X.left.presheaf.stalk x))
    (P : Place k X.left.functionField) : IsClosed ({placeCenter X P} : Set X.left)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian X.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian X.hom
  apply (isClosed_singleton_iff_ne_genericPoint X.left hdim (placeCenter X P)).mpr
  intro h
  apply P.ne_top
  exact (stalkValuationSubring_placeCenter X hdim hnormal P).symm.trans
    ((stalkValuationSubring_eq_top_iff X.left hdim.le hnormal (placeCenter X P)).mpr h)

name: AclGeom.exists_ambientAutomorphism_of_idealOf_eq
statement:
theorem exists_ambientAutomorphism_of_idealOf_eq
    {k Ω : Type*} [Field k] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] {a b : ι → Ω} (h : idealOf k a = idealOf k b) :
    ∃ σ : Ω ≃ₐ[k] Ω,
      (∀ z : ↥(adjoin k (Set.range a)),
        σ (z : Ω) = (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq h z : Ω)) ∧
      ∀ i, σ (a i) = b i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F : IntermediateField k Ω := adjoin k (Set.range a)
  let G : IntermediateField k Ω := adjoin k (Set.range b)
  let φ : F ≃ₐ[k] G := locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq h
  let : Algebra.EssFiniteType k F :=
    essFiniteType_iff.mpr (fg_adjoin_of_finite (Set.finite_range a))
  have hf : Algebra.trdeg k F < Cardinal.aleph0 := trdeg_lt_aleph0 k F
  have hfg : Algebra.trdeg k F = Algebra.trdeg k G := φ.trdeg_eq
  have hc : Algebra.trdeg F Ω = Algebra.trdeg G Ω := by
    have ht := (trdeg_add_eq k F (A := Ω)).trans (trdeg_add_eq k G (A := Ω)).symm
    rw [← hfg] at ht
    apply (Cardinal.add_right_inj_of_lt_aleph0 hf).1
    simpa only [add_comm] using ht
  obtain ⟨α, x, hx⟩ := exists_isTranscendenceBasis' F Ω
  obtain ⟨β, y, hy⟩ := exists_isTranscendenceBasis' G Ω
  let e : α ≃ β :=
    (Cardinal.eq.1 (hx.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg.trans
      (hc.trans hy.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg.symm))).some
  have hy' : IsTranscendenceBasis G (y ∘ e) := hy.comp_equiv e
  let S : IntermediateField F Ω := adjoin F (Set.range x)
  let T : IntermediateField G Ω := adjoin G (Set.range (y ∘ e))
  let ψ : S ≃ₐ[k] T := adjoinIndependentEquivOfEquiv φ hx.1 hy'.1
  let : IsAlgClosure S Ω := ⟨inferInstance, hx.isAlgebraic_field⟩
  let : IsAlgClosure T Ω := ⟨inferInstance, hy'.isAlgebraic_field⟩
  let σ₀ : Ω ≃+* Ω := IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv Ω Ω ψ.toRingEquiv
  have hσ (z : F) : σ₀ (z : Ω) = (φ z : Ω) := by
    calc
      σ₀ (z : Ω) = algebraMap T Ω (ψ (algebraMap F S z)) :=
        IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv_algebraMap Ω Ω ψ.toRingEquiv (algebraMap F S z)
      _ = (φ z : Ω) := by
        change algebraMap T Ω
          (adjoinIndependentEquivOfEquiv φ hx.1 hy'.1 (algebraMap F S z)) = _
        rw [adjoinIndependentEquivOfEquiv_algebraMap]
        rfl
  let σ : Ω ≃ₐ[k] Ω :=
    { σ₀ with
      commutes' := fun c ↦ by
        change σ₀ ((algebraMap k F c : F) : Ω) = algebraMap k Ω c
        rw [hσ, φ.commutes]
        rfl }
  refine ⟨σ, hσ, ?_⟩
  intro i
  calc
    σ (a i) = (φ ⟨a i, subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩ : Ω) :=
      hσ ⟨a i, subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩
    _ = b i := congrArg Subtype.val (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_apply h i)

name: AclGeom.GroupPointTopology.irreducibleSpace
statement:
theorem irreducibleSpace (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k) :
    letI
proof:
:= topology G.toAlgebraicGroup
    IrreducibleSpace (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) := by
  let : TopologicalSpace (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) :=
    topology G.toAlgebraicGroup
  have : JacobsonSpace G.toAlgebraicGroup.carrier :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.jacobsonSpace G.toGroupScheme.X.hom
  have hc : IsIrreducible (closedPoints G.toAlgebraicGroup.carrier) := by
    rw [← isIrreducible_iff_closure, closure_closedPoints]
    exact IrreducibleSpace.isIrreducible_univ _
  have := Subtype.irreducibleSpace hc
  exact (pointsHomeo G.toAlgebraicGroup).irreducibleSpace_iff.mpr inferInstance

name: AclGeom.GroupPointTopology.leftMulHomeo_apply
statement:
theorem leftMulHomeo_apply (G : AlgebraicGroup k)
    (g p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) :
    letI
proof:
:= topology G
    leftMulHomeo G g p = g * p := by
  let : TopologicalSpace (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) := topology G
  apply (pointsHomeo G).injective
  change (pointsHomeo G) ((pointsHomeo G).symm _) = _
  rw [Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply]
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact GroupScheme.leftMul_left_pointsEquivClosedPoints p g

name: AclGeom.scheme_functionField_isFunctionFieldOneVar
statement:
theorem scheme_functionField_isFunctionFieldOneVar (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1) :
    letI
proof:
:= ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAlgebra V
    IsFunctionFieldOneVar k V.left.functionField := by
  rw [ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAlgebra_eq_germ]
  have : Nonempty (⊤ : V.left.Opens) := ⟨⟨genericPoint V.left, trivial⟩⟩
  let : Algebra k V.left.functionField :=
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ V.hom.appTop ≫
      V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤).hom.toAlgebra
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hne, hUdim⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_dimension_one V.left hdim
  have : Nonempty U := hne
  let A := Γ(V.left, U)
  let f : CommRingCat.of k ⟶ CommRingCat.of A :=
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ V.hom.appLE ⊤ U (by simp)
  let : Algebra k A := f.hom.toAlgebra
  have : Algebra.FiniteType k A :=
    (V.hom.finiteType_appLE (isAffineOpen_top _) hU (by simp)).comp
      (RingHom.FiniteType.of_surjective _
        (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv).2)
  have hres : V.hom.appLE ⊤ U (by simp) ≫ V.left.germToFunctionField U =
      V.hom.appTop ≫ V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤ := by
    change (V.hom.appTop ≫
      V.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show U ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op) ≫
        V.left.germToFunctionField U = V.hom.appTop ≫ V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg
      (fun q : Γ(V.left, ⊤) ⟶ V.left.functionField ↦ V.hom.appTop ≫ q)
      (V.left.presheaf.germ_res (homOfLE (show U ≤ ⊤ from le_top)) (genericPoint V.left)
        (((genericPoint_spec V.left).mem_open_set_iff U.isOpen).2 (by simpa using hne))))
  have : IsScalarTower k A V.left.functionField :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun r ↦ by
      change ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ V.hom.appTop ≫
        V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤) r =
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ V.hom.appLE ⊤ U (by simp) ≫
            V.left.germToFunctionField U) r
      rw [hres]
  have : IsFractionRing A V.left.functionField :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen V.left U hU
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType A V.left.functionField :=
    Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_isLocalization V.left.functionField (nonZeroDivisors A)
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType k V.left.functionField :=
    Algebra.EssFiniteType.comp k A V.left.functionField
  have hAdim : ringKrullDim A = 1 := by
    have he := IsHomeomorph.topologicalKrullDim_eq _ hU.isoSpec.hom.homeomorph.isHomeomorph
    change topologicalKrullDim U = topologicalKrullDim (PrimeSpectrum A) at he
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.topologicalKrullDim_eq_ringKrullDim] at he
    exact he.symm.trans hUdim
  obtain ⟨n, hn, ht⟩ := exists_ringKrullDim_trdeg_eq_of_finiteType k A V.left.functionField
  have hn1 : n = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hn.symm.trans hAdim
  apply isFunctionFieldOneVar_of_trdeg_eq_one k V.left.functionField
  simpa only [hn1, Nat.cast_one] using ht

name: AclGeom.FiniteGaCover.linePoint_comp_relativeFrobenius
statement:
theorem linePoint_comp_relativeFrobenius {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
    (c : C) : AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k c ≫ relativeFrobenius k p n =
      AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (c ^ p ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  change AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k c ≫
      AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k ^ p ^ n) = _
  rw [AdditiveTranslation.linePoint_comp_linePoint, map_pow,
    AffineSchemeAction.lineEval_lineCoordinate]

name: AclGeom.AffineSchemeAction.coaction_lineCoordinate
statement:
theorem coaction_lineCoordinate :
    coaction k (lineCoordinate k) =
      (AffineGroupScheme.dilationUnit k : AffineGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k) ⊗ₜ lineCoordinate k +
        AffineGroupScheme.translation k ⊗ₜ 1
proof:
:=
  AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraCoordinates_symm_apply_ι _ 0

name: AclGeom.AffineSchemeAction.lineEval_lineCoordinate
statement:
theorem lineEval_lineCoordinate {C : Type v} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C] (x : C) :
    lineEval x (lineCoordinate k) = x
proof:
:=
  AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraCoordinates_symm_apply_ι _ 0

name: AclGeom.AffineSchemeAction.lineHom_ext
proof:
:= by
  apply (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraCoordinates k 1 C).injective
  funext i
  rw [AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraCoordinates_apply, AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraCoordinates_apply,
    Subsingleton.elim i 0]
  exact h

name: AclGeom.AffineSchemeAction.coactionEval
statement:
theorem coactionEval {C : Type v} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C] (a : Cˣ) (b x : C) :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (AffineGroupScheme.eval k a b) (lineEval x)
        (fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _)).comp (coaction k) = lineEval (a * x + b)
proof:
:= by
  apply lineHom_ext
  rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, coaction_lineCoordinate, lineEval_lineCoordinate, map_add,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul, Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul,
    AffineGroupScheme.eval_dilation, AffineGroupScheme.eval_translation, lineEval_lineCoordinate,
    map_one, _root_.mul_one]

name: AclGeom.AffineSchemeAction.lift_tensorSpecIso_hom
statement:
theorem lift_tensorSpecIso_hom {S T C : Type u} [CommRing S] [CommRing T] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra k S] [Algebra k T] [Algebra k C] (f : S →ₐ[k] C) (g : T →ₐ[k] C) :
    lift ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom)).asOver (Spec (.of k)))
        ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g.toRingHom)).asOver (Spec (.of k))) ≫
        (tensorSpecIso k S T).hom =
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift f g fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _).toRingHom)).asOver
          (Spec (.of k))
proof:
:= by
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  have w : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k S)) =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g.toRingHom) ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k T)) := by
    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    congr 2
    ext r
    simp
  change Limits.pullback.lift (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom g.toRingHom)) w ≫ (pullbackSpecIso k S T).hom =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift f g fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _).toRingHom)
  rw [← Iso.eq_comp_inv]
  apply Limits.pullback.hom_ext
  · rw [Limits.pullback.lift_fst, Category.assoc, pullbackSpecIso_inv_fst, ← Spec.map_comp,
      ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    congr 2
    ext s
    simp
  · rw [Limits.pullback.lift_snd, Category.assoc, pullbackSpecIso_inv_snd, ← Spec.map_comp,
      ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
    congr 2
    ext t
    simp

name: AclGeom.AffineSchemeAction.exists_groupPoint
statement:
theorem exists_groupPoint {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
    (g : (Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶
      (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k).toGroupScheme.X) :
    ∃ (a : Cˣ) (b : C), groupPoint k a b = g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, rfl⟩ := (Spec.mapMulEquiv (R := k) (S := AffineGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k)
    (T := C)).surjective g
  refine ⟨(AffineGroupScheme.homCoordinates k C φ.ofConv).1,
    (AffineGroupScheme.homCoordinates k C φ.ofConv).2, ?_⟩
  exact congrArg (fun f ↦ Spec.mapMulEquiv (WithConv.toConv f))
    ((AffineGroupScheme.homCoordinates k C).symm_apply_apply φ.ofConv)

name: AclGeom.AffineSchemeAction.exists_linePoint
statement:
theorem exists_linePoint {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
    (y : (Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶
      (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X) :
    ∃ x : C, linePoint k x = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, rfl⟩ := (Spec.mapMulEquiv (R := k) (S := AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1)
    (T := C)).surjective y
  exact ⟨φ.ofConv (lineCoordinate k), congrArg (fun f ↦ Spec.mapMulEquiv (WithConv.toConv f))
    (lineHom_ext (lineEval_lineCoordinate _))⟩

name: AclGeom.AffineSchemeAction.linePoint_injective
statement:
theorem linePoint_injective {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C] :
    Function.Injective (linePoint k : C → _)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  have h := (Spec.mapMulEquiv (R := k) (S := AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1)
    (T := C)).injective hxy
  calc x = lineEval x (lineCoordinate k) := (lineEval_lineCoordinate x).symm
    _ = lineEval y (lineCoordinate k) :=
      congrArg (fun f : WithConv (AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1 →ₐ[k] C) ↦
        f.ofConv (lineCoordinate k)) h
    _ = y := lineEval_lineCoordinate y

name: AclGeom.AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint_mul
statement:
theorem groupPoint_mul {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C] (a c : Cˣ) (b d : C) :
    groupPoint k a b * groupPoint k c d = groupPoint k (a * c) (a * d + b)
proof:
:= by
  have h : WithConv.toConv (AffineGroupScheme.eval k a b) *
      WithConv.toConv (AffineGroupScheme.eval k c d) =
        WithConv.toConv (AffineGroupScheme.eval k (a * c) (a * d + b)) := by
    apply WithConv.ofConv_injective
    apply AffineGroupScheme.hom_ext
    · rw [AlgHom.convMul_apply, AffineGroupScheme.coalgebra_comul,
        AffineGroupScheme.comul_dilation]
      simp
    · rw [AlgHom.convMul_apply, AffineGroupScheme.coalgebra_comul,
        AffineGroupScheme.comul_translation]
      simp
  have h' := congrArg (Spec.mapMulEquiv (R := k) (S := AffineGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k)
    (T := C)) h
  rw [map_mul] at h'
  exact h'

name: AclGeom.AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint_one
statement:
theorem groupPoint_one {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C] :
    groupPoint k (1 : Cˣ) 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : WithConv.toConv (AffineGroupScheme.eval k (1 : Cˣ) 0) = 1 := by
    apply WithConv.ofConv_injective
    apply AffineGroupScheme.hom_ext <;> simp
  exact (congrArg (Spec.mapMulEquiv (R := k) (S := AffineGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k)
    (T := C)) h).trans (map_one _)

name: AclGeom.AffineSchemeAction.lift_groupPoint_linePoint_smul
statement:
theorem lift_groupPoint_linePoint_smul {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C] (a : Cˣ)
    (b x : C) : lift (groupPoint k a b) (linePoint k x) ≫ smul k = linePoint k (a * x + b)
proof:
:= by
  change lift ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineGroupScheme.eval k a b).toRingHom)).asOver
      (Spec (.of k))) ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (lineEval x).toRingHom)).asOver
        (Spec (.of k))) ≫ (tensorSpecIso k _ _).hom ≫
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (coaction k).toRingHom)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) =
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (lineEval (a * x + b)).toRingHom)).asOver (Spec (.of k))
  rw [← Category.assoc, lift_tensorSpecIso_hom, ← coactionEval a b x]
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  change Spec.map _ ≫ Spec.map _ = Spec.map _
  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
  rfl

name: AclGeom.AffineSchemeAction.eq_one_of_lift_smul_eq
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_lift_smul_eq {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
    (g : (Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶
      (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k).toGroupScheme.X)
    (h : ∀ x : (Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶
      (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X, lift g x ≫ smul k = x) :
    g = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ := exists_groupPoint k g
  have h0 := h (linePoint k 0)
  have h1 := h (linePoint k 1)
  rw [lift_groupPoint_linePoint_smul] at h0 h1
  have hb : b = 0 := by
    have := linePoint_injective k h0
    rwa [mul_zero, zero_add] at this
  have ha : a = 1 := by
    have := linePoint_injective k h1
    rw [_root_.mul_one, hb, add_zero] at this
    exact Units.ext this
  subst ha hb
  exact groupPoint_one k

name: AclGeom.SchemeNormalTranslations.exists_normal_subgroup_translation_isogeny
statement:
theorem exists_normal_subgroup_translation_isogeny
    (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (hker : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
      ModObj.pointAct V q = 𝟙 V → q = 1)
    (hdimG : (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDim G.toAlgebraicGroup.carrier)
    (hdimV : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1)
    (N : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (i : N.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom G.toAlgebraicGroup)
    [IsMonHom.Normal i.hom.hom] [IsClosedImmersion i.hom.hom.left]
    (hdimN : topologicalKrullDim N.toAlgebraicGroup.carrier = 1) :
    ∃ t : V.left.functionField, Transcendental k t ∧
      IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set V.left.functionField) = ⊤ ∧
    ∃ f : G.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k),
      Function.Injective (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X ↦
        q ≫ f.hom.hom) ∧
      IsFinite f.hom.hom.left ∧ Surjective f.hom.hom.left ∧
      (∀ q, (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V q).unop t =
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField
          ((AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom)).multiplier : k) * t +
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField
          (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom)).shift) ∧
    ∃ β : N.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1),
      IsFinite β.hom.hom.left ∧ Surjective β.hom.hom.left ∧
      Function.Injective (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ N.toGroupScheme.X ↦
        q ≫ β.hom.hom) ∧
      β.hom.hom ≫ AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k = i.hom.hom ≫ f.hom.hom ∧
      ∀ (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ N.toGroupScheme.X) (b : k),
        q ≫ β.hom.hom = (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k b →
        (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V (q ≫ i.hom.hom)).unop t =
          t + algebraMap k V.left.functionField b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htop, Φ, _, hΦ, f, hfinj, hpoint, hfinite, hsurj⟩ :=
    SchemeAffineFinite.exists_finite_surjective_morphism G V hker hdimG hdimV
  have := hfinite
  have := hsurj
  obtain ⟨β, hβfinite, hβsurj, hβinj, hβfactor⟩ :=
    NormalTranslation.exists_finite_isogeny G.toAlgebraicGroup N i hdimN f hfinj
  have hf (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) :
      (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V q).unop t =
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField
          ((AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom)).multiplier : k) * t +
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField
          (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom)).shift := by
    rw [hpoint]
    exact hΦ q
  refine ⟨t, ht, htop, f, hfinj, hfinite, hsurj, hf,
    β, hβfinite, hβsurj, hβinj, hβfactor, ?_⟩
  intro q b hqb
  have hqf : (q ≫ i.hom.hom) ≫ f.hom.hom =
      (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k).symm (AffineTransformation.translation b) := by
    calc
      _ = q ≫ (β.hom.hom ≫ AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k) := by
        rw [Category.assoc, hβfactor]
      _ = (q ≫ β.hom.hom) ≫ AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = _ := by rw [hqb, NormalTranslation.point_inclusion]
  rw [hf, hqf, MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  simp only [AffineTransformation.translation_multiplier, Units.val_one, map_one,
    _root_.one_mul, AffineTransformation.translation_shift]

name: AclGeom.CurveBoundary.pointAct_naturality
statement:
theorem pointAct_naturality
    {G U V : Over (Spec (.of k))} [GrpObj G] [ModObj G U] [ModObj G V]
    (j : U ⟶ V) [IsModHom G j] (g : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G) :
    ModObj.pointAct U g ≫ j = j ≫ ModObj.pointAct V g
proof:
:= by
  change ((toUnit U ≫ g) • 𝟙 U) ≫ j = j ≫ ((toUnit V ≫ g) • 𝟙 V)
  rw [IsModHom.map_smul, ModObj.comp_smul]
  simp only [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id, comp_toUnit_assoc]

name: AclGeom.CurveBoundary.pointAct_mem_complement
statement:
theorem pointAct_mem_complement
    {G U V : Over (Spec (.of k))} [GrpObj G] [ModObj G U] [ModObj G V]
    (j : U ⟶ V) [IsModHom G j] (g : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G)
    (x : V.left) (hx : x ∉ Set.range j.left) :
    (ModObj.pointAct V g).left x ∉ Set.range j.left
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
  apply hx
  refine ⟨(ModObj.pointAct U g⁻¹).left y, ?_⟩
  have hn := congrArg (fun f : U ⟶ V ↦ f.left y) (pointAct_naturality j g⁻¹)
  have hi := congrArg (fun f : V ⟶ V ↦ f.left x) (ModObj.pointAut V g).hom_inv_id
  exact hn.trans ((congrArg (ModObj.pointAct V g⁻¹).left hy).trans hi)

name: AclGeom.CurveBoundary.orbitMap_point
statement:
theorem orbitMap_point
    (G : AlgebraicGroup k) (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ V)
    (g : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) :
    g ≫ orbitMap G V p = p ≫ ModObj.pointAct V g
proof:
:= by
  change g ≫ lift (𝟙 _) (toUnit G.toGroupScheme.X ≫ p) ≫ _ =
    p ≫ ((toUnit V ≫ g) • 𝟙 V)
  rw [comp_lift_assoc, ModObj.comp_smul]
  simp only [Category.comp_id, comp_toUnit_assoc, toUnit_unit, Category.id_comp,
    Hom.smul_def]

name: IntermediateField.ringEquivOfCarrierEq_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem ringEquivOfCarrierEq_val
    {F F' Ω : Type*} [Field F] [Field F'] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra F Ω] [Algebra F' Ω]
    (S : IntermediateField F Ω) (T : IntermediateField F' Ω)
    (h : (S : Set Ω) = (T : Set Ω)) (x : S) :
    ((ringEquivOfCarrierEq S T h x : T) : Ω) = x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: IntermediateField.le_of_carrier_eq_pair
statement:
theorem le_of_carrier_eq_pair
    {F F' Ω : Type*} [Field F] [Field F'] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra F Ω] [Algebra F' Ω]
    {S U : IntermediateField F Ω} {T V : IntermediateField F' Ω}
    (hST : (S : Set Ω) = (T : Set Ω))
    (hUV : (U : Set Ω) = (V : Set Ω)) (hTV : T ≤ V) : S ≤ U
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have hzT : z ∈ T := (Set.ext_iff.mp hST z).mp hz
  have hzV : z ∈ V := hTV hzT
  exact (Set.ext_iff.mp hUV z).mpr hzV

name: IntermediateField.adjoin_singleton_carrier_eq_of_carrier_eq
statement:
theorem adjoin_singleton_carrier_eq_of_carrier_eq
    {F F' Ω : Type*} [Field F] [Field F'] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra F Ω] [Algebra F' Ω]
    (S : IntermediateField F Ω) (T : IntermediateField F' Ω)
    (hbase : (S : Set Ω) = (T : Set Ω))
    {x y : Ω} (hxy : x = y) :
    ((adjoin (↥S) {x}) : Set Ω) =
      ((adjoin (↥T) {y}) : Set Ω)
proof:
:= by
  have hrange : Set.range (algebraMap (↥S) Ω) =
      Set.range (algebraMap (↥T) Ω) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨⟨a, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
      change (a : Ω) ∈ (T : Set Ω)
      rw [← hbase]
      exact a.2
    · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨⟨a, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
      change (a : Ω) ∈ (S : Set Ω)
      rw [hbase]
      exact a.2
  have hfield : (adjoin (↥S) {x}).toSubfield =
      (adjoin (↥T) {y}).toSubfield := by
    rw [adjoin_toSubfield, adjoin_toSubfield, hrange, hxy]
  exact congrArg (fun U : Subfield Ω ↦ U.carrier) hfield

name: IntermediateField.equivImageUnderAutomorphism_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem equivImageUnderAutomorphism_apply
    {k E L : Type*} [Field k] [Field E] [Field L]
    [Algebra k E] [Algebra k L]
    (i : E →ₐ[k] L) (sigma : L ≃ₐ[k] L) (x : E) :
    ((equivImageUnderAutomorphism i sigma x :
      imageUnderAutomorphism i sigma) : L) = sigma (i x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: IntermediateField.equivImageUnderAutomorphism_eq_of_eq_algebraMap
statement:
theorem equivImageUnderAutomorphism_eq_of_eq_algebraMap
    {k F E L : Type*} [Field k] [Field F] [Field E] [Field L]
    [Algebra k F] [Algebra k E] [Algebra k L] [Algebra F L]
    [IsScalarTower k F L]
    (i : E →ₐ[k] L) (sigma : L ≃ₐ[F] L) (x : E) (y : F)
    (hxy : i x = algebraMap F L y) :
    ((equivImageUnderAutomorphism i (sigma.restrictScalars k) x :
      imageUnderAutomorphism i (sigma.restrictScalars k)) : L) = i x
proof:
:= by
  rw [equivImageUnderAutomorphism_apply, hxy]
  change sigma (algebraMap F L y) = algebraMap F L y
  exact sigma.commutes y

name: IntermediateField.ambientImageUnderAutomorphism_le
statement:
theorem ambientImageUnderAutomorphism_le
    {k F Ω : Type*} [Field k] [Field F] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra k F] [Algebra k Ω] [Algebra F Ω] [IsScalarTower k F Ω]
    (E : IntermediateField k Ω) (N : IntermediateField F Ω)
    (h : E ≤ N.restrictScalars k) (sigma : (↥N) ≃ₐ[k] (↥N)) :
    ambientImageUnderAutomorphism E N h sigma ≤ N.restrictScalars k
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨x, _, rfl⟩ := (IntermediateField.mem_map _).1 hz
  change ((x : ↥N) : Ω) ∈ N
  exact (x : ↥N).2

name: IntermediateField.ambientImageUnderAutomorphism_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem ambientImageUnderAutomorphism_finiteDimensional
    {k F Ω : Type*} [Field k] [Field F] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra k F] [Algebra k Ω] [Algebra F Ω] [IsScalarTower k F Ω]
    (E : IntermediateField k Ω) (N : IntermediateField F Ω)
    (h : E ≤ N.restrictScalars k) (sigma : (↥N) ≃ₐ[k] (↥N))
    (hfin : FiniteDimensional (↥E) (↥(extendScalars h))) :
    FiniteDimensional
      (↥(ambientImageUnderAutomorphism E N h sigma))
      (↥(extendScalars (ambientImageUnderAutomorphism_le E N h sigma)))
proof:
:= by
  let h' := ambientImageUnderAutomorphism_le E N h sigma
  let e := extensionEquivUnderAutomorphism E N h sigma
  let : Algebra (↥E) (↥(N.restrictScalars k)) :=
    (inclusion h).toAlgebra
  let : Algebra (↥(ambientImageUnderAutomorphism E N h sigma))
      (↥(N.restrictScalars k)) := (inclusion h').toAlgebra
  let : FiniteDimensional (↥E) (↥(N.restrictScalars k)) := by
    change FiniteDimensional (↥E) (↥(extendScalars h))
    exact hfin
  apply Module.Finite.of_equiv_equiv e.baseEquiv.toRingEquiv
    e.totalEquiv.toRingEquiv
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro x
  exact (e.commutes_apply x).symm

name: AclGeom.FiniteCover.finiteDimensional_of_carrier_eq
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_of_carrier_eq
    {k₁ k₂ Ω : Type*} [Field k₁] [Field k₂] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra k₁ Ω] [Algebra k₂ Ω]
    {E L : IntermediateField k₁ Ω} {E' L' : IntermediateField k₂ Ω}
    (h : E ≤ L) (h' : E' ≤ L')
    (hE : (E : Set Ω) = (E' : Set Ω))
    (hL : (L : Set Ω) = (L' : Set Ω))
    (hfin : FiniteDimensional (↥E) (↥(extendScalars h))) :
    FiniteDimensional (↥E') (↥(extendScalars h'))
proof:
:= by
  have := hfin
  apply Module.Finite.of_equiv_equiv
    (IntermediateField.ringEquivOfCarrierEq E E' hE)
    (IntermediateField.ringEquivOfCarrierEq (extendScalars h) (extendScalars h') hL)
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  rfl

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.branchOverSourceToIntermediateFieldRingHom_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem FiniteCorrespondencePair.branchOverSourceToIntermediateFieldRingHom_val
    {F E Ω : Type*} [Field F] [Field E] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra F Ω] [Algebra E Ω]
    (P : FiniteCorrespondencePair F Ω) (N : IntermediateField E Ω)
    (h : ∀ z : Ω, z ∈ P.branchField → z ∈ N) (x : P.branchOverSource) :
    ((P.branchOverSourceToIntermediateFieldRingHom N h x : N) : Ω) = x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.branchOverSourceToIntermediateFieldRingHom_trans
statement:
theorem FiniteCorrespondencePair.branchOverSourceToIntermediateFieldRingHom_trans
    {F E Ω : Type*} [Field F] [Field E] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra F Ω] [Algebra E Ω]
    (P : FiniteCorrespondencePair F Ω)
    (M N : IntermediateField E Ω) (hMN : M ≤ N)
    (hM : ∀ z : Ω, z ∈ P.branchField → z ∈ M)
    (hN : ∀ z : Ω, z ∈ P.branchField → z ∈ N) :
    P.branchOverSourceToIntermediateFieldRingHom N hN =
      (IntermediateField.inclusion hMN).toRingHom.comp
        (P.branchOverSourceToIntermediateFieldRingHom M hM)
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  rfl

name: AclGeom.FiniteCover.normalCoverEquivUnderAutomorphism_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalCoverEquivUnderAutomorphism_algebraMap
    [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (E : IntermediateField k Ω) (N : IntermediateField F Ω)
    (h : E ≤ N.restrictScalars k) (sigma : (↥N) ≃ₐ[k] (↥N))
    (hfin : FiniteDimensional (↥E) (↥(extendScalars h))) (x : E) :
    normalCoverEquivUnderAutomorphism E N h sigma hfin
        (algebraMap (↥E) (↥(normalClosureOver h)) x) =
      algebraMap
        (↥(IntermediateField.ambientImageUnderAutomorphism E N h sigma))
        (↥(normalClosureOver
          (IntermediateField.ambientImageUnderAutomorphism_le E N h sigma)))
        (IntermediateField.equivAmbientImageUnderAutomorphism E N h sigma x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [normalCoverEquivUnderAutomorphism,
    IntermediateField.extensionEquivUnderAutomorphism]

name: AclGeom.FiniteCover.basedBranchEquivUnderAutomorphism_selected
statement:
@[simp] theorem basedBranchEquivUnderAutomorphism_selected
    [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (E : IntermediateField k Ω) (N : IntermediateField F Ω)
    (h : E ≤ N.restrictScalars k) (sigma : (↥N) ≃ₐ[k] (↥N))
    (hfin : FiniteDimensional (↥E) (↥(extendScalars h))) :
    (basedBranchEquivUnderAutomorphism E N h sigma hfin).branchEquiv
        (finiteCoverSelectedBranch h) =
      finiteCoverSelectedBranch
        (IntermediateField.ambientImageUnderAutomorphism_le E N h sigma)
proof:
:=
  (basedBranchEquivUnderAutomorphism E N h sigma hfin).map_selected

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionCompositum.basisValues_isIntegral_of_le
statement:
theorem basisValues_isIntegral_of_le (hFE : F ≤ E)
    (i : Fin (Module.finrank (↥F) (↥N))) :
    IsIntegral (↥E) (basisValues F N i)
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra (↥F) (↥E) := (IntermediateField.inclusion hFE).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower (↥F) (↥E) K :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let b := Module.finBasis (↥F) (↥N)
  have hiN : IsIntegral (↥F) (b i) :=
    (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_finite (↥F) (↥N)).isAlgebraic (b i) |>.isIntegral
  have hiK : IsIntegral (↥F) (b i : K) := hiN.map N.val
  exact hiK.tower_top

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionCompositum.restrictScalars_le_of_basisValues_subset
statement:
theorem restrictScalars_le_of_basisValues_subset
    {G : IntermediateField k K} (hFG : F ≤ G)
    (hbasis : Set.range (basisValues F N) ⊆ G) :
    N.restrictScalars k ≤ G
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  let b := Module.finBasis (↥F) (↥N)
  let zN : N := ⟨z, hz⟩
  have hF (r : F) : (r : K) ∈ G := hFG r.2
  have hb (i : Fin (Module.finrank (↥F) (↥N))) : (b i : K) ∈ G := by
    apply hbasis
    exact Set.mem_range_self i
  have hsum : ∑ i, ((b.repr zN i : F) : K) * (b i : K) ∈ G := by
    exact Subring.sum_mem G.toSubring fun i _ ↦ G.mul_mem (hF _) (hb i)
  have hzsum := congrArg (fun y : N ↦ (y : K)) (b.sum_repr zN)
  have hzsum' : ∑ i, ((b.repr zN i : F) : K) * (b i : K) = z := by
    simpa [Algebra.smul_def] using hzsum
  exact hzsum' ▸ hsum

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionCompositum.le_field
statement: theorem le_field : E ≤ field F E N
proof: := le_sup_left

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionCompositum.normal_le_field
statement:
theorem normal_le_field (hFE : F ≤ E) :
    N.restrictScalars k ≤ field F E N
proof:
:= by
  apply restrictScalars_le_of_basisValues_subset F N (hFE.trans le_sup_left)
  intro _ hx
  exact (le_sup_right : adjoin k (Set.range (basisValues F N)) ≤
      field F E N) (subset_adjoin k _ hx)

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionCompositum.field_le_of_le
proof:
:= by
  apply sup_le hEG
  apply adjoin_le_iff.2
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hz
  apply hNG
  exact (Module.finBasis (↥F) (↥N) i).2

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionCompositum.over_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem over_finiteDimensional (hFE : F ≤ E) :
    FiniteDimensional (↥E) (↥(over F E N))
proof:
:= by
  have key : over F E N = adjoin (↥E) (Set.range (basisValues F N)) := by
    refine restrictScalars_injective k ?_
    unfold over field
    refine (extendScalars_restrictScalars _).trans ?_
    rw [restrictScalars_adjoin, adjoin_union, adjoin_self]
  rw [key]
  exact finiteDimensional_adjoin fun x hx ↦ by
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact basisValues_isIntegral_of_le F E N hFE i

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionCompositum.over_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem over_isAlgebraic (hFE : F ≤ E) :
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic (↥E) (↥(over F E N))
proof:
:= by
  let : FiniteDimensional (↥E) (↥(over F E N)) :=
    over_finiteDimensional F E N hFE
  exact Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_finite _ _

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionCompositum.normalField_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem normalField_finiteDimensional (hFE : F ≤ E) :
    FiniteDimensional (↥E) (↥(normalField F E N hFE))
proof:
:=
  FiniteCover.normalClosureOver_finiteDimensional
    (le_field F E N) (over_finiteDimensional F E N hFE)

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionCompositum.normalField_normal
statement:
theorem normalField_normal [IsAlgClosed K] (hFE : F ≤ E) :
    Normal (↥E) (↥(normalField F E N hFE))
proof:
:= by
  exact FiniteCover.normalClosureOver_normal
    (le_field F E N) (over_isAlgebraic F E N hFE)

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionCompositum.normal_le_normalField_restrictScalars
statement:
theorem normal_le_normalField_restrictScalars (hFE : F ≤ E) :
    N.restrictScalars k ≤
      (normalField F E N hFE).restrictScalars k
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  apply FiniteCover.extendScalars_le_normalClosureOver
    (le_field F E N)
  exact normal_le_field F E N hFE hz

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionCompositum.originalToCompositumRingHom_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem originalToCompositumRingHom_val (hFE : F ≤ E) (z : N) :
    ((originalToCompositumRingHom F E N hFE z : over F E N) : K) = z
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionCompositum.originalToCanonicalRingHom_apply
statement:
theorem originalToCanonicalRingHom_apply [IsAlgClosed K]
    (hFE : F ≤ E) (z : N) :
    originalToCanonicalRingHom F E N hFE z =
      FiniteCover.canonicalSelectedEmbedding
        (le_field F E N) (over_isAlgebraic F E N hFE)
        (originalToCompositumRingHom F E N hFE z)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionCompositum.extendScalars_trans_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem extendScalars_trans_finiteDimensional
    {E₀ E₁ E₂ : IntermediateField k K}
    (h01 : E₀ ≤ E₁) (h12 : E₁ ≤ E₂)
    (hfin01 : FiniteDimensional (↥E₀) (↥(extendScalars h01)))
    (hfin12 : FiniteDimensional (↥E₁) (↥(extendScalars h12))) :
    FiniteDimensional (↥E₀) (↥(extendScalars (h01.trans h12)))
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra (↥E₀) (↥E₁) :=
    (IntermediateField.inclusion h01).toAlgebra
  let : Algebra (↥E₁) (↥E₂) :=
    (IntermediateField.inclusion h12).toAlgebra
  let : Algebra (↥E₀) (↥E₂) :=
    (IntermediateField.inclusion (h01.trans h12)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower (↥E₀) (↥E₁) (↥E₂) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : FiniteDimensional (↥E₀) (↥E₁) := by
    change FiniteDimensional (↥E₀) (↥(extendScalars h01))
    exact hfin01
  let : FiniteDimensional (↥E₁) (↥E₂) := by
    change FiniteDimensional (↥E₁) (↥(extendScalars h12))
    exact hfin12
  change FiniteDimensional (↥E₀) (↥E₂)
  exact FiniteDimensional.trans (↥E₀) (↥E₁) (↥E₂)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.coefficientField_le_sourceField
statement:
theorem coefficientField_le_sourceField :
    F ≤ sourceField F P
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  change z ∈ P.sourceField
  exact P.sourceField.algebraMap_mem ⟨z, hz⟩

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.sourceField_le_coefficientSourceField
statement:
theorem sourceField_le_coefficientSourceField :
    sourceField F P ≤ coefficientSourceField F P C
proof:
:=
  FiniteExtensionCompositum.le_field F (sourceField F P) C

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.coefficientExtension_le_coefficientSourceField
statement:
theorem coefficientExtension_le_coefficientSourceField :
    C.restrictScalars k ≤ coefficientSourceField F P C
proof:
:=
  FiniteExtensionCompositum.normal_le_field F (sourceField F P) C
    (coefficientField_le_sourceField F P)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.coefficientSourceField_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem coefficientSourceField_finiteDimensional :
    FiniteDimensional (↥(sourceField F P))
      (↥(extendScalars
        (sourceField_le_coefficientSourceField F P C)))
proof:
:=
  FiniteExtensionCompositum.over_finiteDimensional
    F (sourceField F P) C (coefficientField_le_sourceField F P)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.firstBranchOverSource_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem firstBranchOverSource_finiteDimensional :
    FiniteDimensional (↥(sourceField F P))
      (↥(firstBranchOverSource F P))
proof:
:= by
  change FiniteDimensional (↥P.sourceField) (↥P.branchOverSource)
  exact P.branchOverSource_finiteDimensional

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.coefficientSourceField_le_withFirstBranch
statement:
theorem coefficientSourceField_le_withFirstBranch :
    coefficientSourceField F P C ≤ withFirstBranch F P C
proof:
:= by
  let := firstBranchOverSource_finiteDimensional F P
  exact FiniteExtensionCompositum.le_field
    (sourceField F P) (coefficientSourceField F P C)
      (firstBranchOverSource F P)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.firstBranch_le_withFirstBranch
statement:
theorem firstBranch_le_withFirstBranch :
    (firstBranchOverSource F P).restrictScalars k ≤
      withFirstBranch F P C
proof:
:= by
  let := firstBranchOverSource_finiteDimensional F P
  exact FiniteExtensionCompositum.normal_le_field
    (sourceField F P) (coefficientSourceField F P C)
      (firstBranchOverSource F P)
      (sourceField_le_coefficientSourceField F P C)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.withFirstBranch_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem withFirstBranch_finiteDimensional :
    FiniteDimensional (↥(coefficientSourceField F P C))
      (↥(extendScalars
        (coefficientSourceField_le_withFirstBranch F P C)))
proof:
:= by
  let := firstBranchOverSource_finiteDimensional F P
  exact FiniteExtensionCompositum.over_finiteDimensional
    (sourceField F P) (coefficientSourceField F P C)
      (firstBranchOverSource F P)
      (sourceField_le_coefficientSourceField F P C)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.sourceField_le_secondBranchField
statement:
theorem sourceField_le_secondBranchField
    (hsource : P.source = Q.source) :
    P.sourceField ≤ Q.branchField
proof:
:= by
  unfold FiniteCorrespondencePair.sourceField
    FiniteCorrespondencePair.branchField
  apply adjoin.mono
  simp [hsource]

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.secondBranchOverSource_eq_adjoin_target
proof:
:= by
  change extendScalars (sourceField_le_secondBranchField F P Q hsource) =
    adjoin (↥P.sourceField) {Q.target}
  unfold FiniteCorrespondencePair.branchField
  refine (extendScalars_adjoin _).trans ?_
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply adjoin_le_iff.2
    intro z hz
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    rcases hz with rfl | rfl
    · rw [← hsource]
      exact (adjoin P.sourceField {Q.target}).algebraMap_mem
        ⟨P.source, subset_adjoin (↥F) _ (by simp)⟩
    · exact subset_adjoin P.sourceField _ (by simp)
  · apply adjoin_le_iff.2
    intro z hz
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    subst z
    exact subset_adjoin P.sourceField _ (by simp)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.secondBranchOverSource_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem secondBranchOverSource_finiteDimensional :
    FiniteDimensional (↥(sourceField F P))
      (↥(secondBranchOverSource F P Q hsource))
proof:
:= by
  rw [secondBranchOverSource_eq_adjoin_target F P Q hsource]
  exact finiteDimensional_adjoin fun z hz ↦ by
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    subst z
    have hAlg := (mem_racl_iff (↥F)).1 Q.target_mem_source
    have hAlg' : IsAlgebraic (↥P.sourceField) Q.target := by
      have hsourceField : P.sourceField = Q.sourceField := by
        unfold FiniteCorrespondencePair.sourceField
        rw [hsource]
      rw [hsourceField]
      exact hAlg
    exact hAlg'.isIntegral

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.extensionEquiv_base_coe_eq_of_source_eq
statement:
theorem extensionEquiv_base_coe_eq_of_source_eq
    (hideal : P.ideal = Q.ideal) (z : sourceField F P) :
    ((((P.extensionEquivOfIdealEq Q hideal).baseEquiv
        (⟨z, z.2⟩ : P.sourceField) : Q.sourceField) : Ω)) = z
proof:
:= by
  let e := P.extensionEquivOfIdealEq Q hideal
  let f : P.sourceField →ₐ[↥F] Ω :=
    Q.sourceField.val.comp e.baseEquiv.toAlgHom
  have hfg : f = P.sourceField.val := by
    apply adjoin_algHom_ext (↥F)
    rintro _ hz
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    subst hz
    change (((e.baseEquiv ⟨P.source, _⟩ : Q.sourceField) : Ω)) =
      P.source
    simpa [e, hsource] using congrArg Subtype.val
      (P.extensionEquivOfIdealEq_base_source Q hideal)
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hfg (⟨z, z.2⟩ : P.sourceField)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.branchEquivOfIdealEq_target
statement:
@[simp] theorem branchEquivOfIdealEq_target
    (hideal : P.ideal = Q.ideal) :
    branchEquivOfIdealEq F P Q hsource hideal
        ⟨P.target, by
          change P.target ∈ P.branchField
          exact subset_adjoin (↥F) _ (by simp)⟩ =
      ⟨Q.target, by
        change Q.target ∈ Q.branchField
        exact subset_adjoin (↥F) _ (by simp)⟩
proof:
:= by
  exact P.extensionEquivOfIdealEq_total_target Q hideal

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.withFirstBranch_le_field
statement:
theorem withFirstBranch_le_field :
    withFirstBranch F P C ≤ field F P Q hsource C
proof:
:= by
  let := secondBranchOverSource_finiteDimensional F P Q hsource
  exact FiniteExtensionCompositum.le_field
    (sourceField F P) (withFirstBranch F P C)
      (secondBranchOverSource F P Q hsource)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.secondBranch_le_field
statement:
theorem secondBranch_le_field :
    (secondBranchOverSource F P Q hsource).restrictScalars k ≤
      field F P Q hsource C
proof:
:= by
  let := secondBranchOverSource_finiteDimensional F P Q hsource
  exact FiniteExtensionCompositum.normal_le_field
    (sourceField F P) (withFirstBranch F P C)
      (secondBranchOverSource F P Q hsource)
      ((sourceField_le_coefficientSourceField F P C).trans
        (coefficientSourceField_le_withFirstBranch F P C))

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.field_over_withFirstBranch_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem field_over_withFirstBranch_finiteDimensional :
    FiniteDimensional (↥(withFirstBranch F P C))
      (↥(extendScalars (withFirstBranch_le_field F P Q hsource C)))
proof:
:= by
  let := secondBranchOverSource_finiteDimensional F P Q hsource
  exact FiniteExtensionCompositum.over_finiteDimensional
    (sourceField F P) (withFirstBranch F P C)
      (secondBranchOverSource F P Q hsource)
      ((sourceField_le_coefficientSourceField F P C).trans
        (coefficientSourceField_le_withFirstBranch F P C))

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.sourceField_le_field
statement:
theorem sourceField_le_field :
    sourceField F P ≤ field F P Q hsource C
proof:
:=
  (sourceField_le_coefficientSourceField F P C).trans
    ((coefficientSourceField_le_withFirstBranch F P C).trans
      (withFirstBranch_le_field F P Q hsource C))

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.field_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem field_finiteDimensional :
    FiniteDimensional (↥(sourceField F P))
      (↥(extendScalars (sourceField_le_field F P Q hsource C)))
proof:
:= by
  have hfinFirst : FiniteDimensional (↥(sourceField F P))
      (↥(extendScalars
        ((sourceField_le_coefficientSourceField F P C).trans
          (coefficientSourceField_le_withFirstBranch F P C)))) :=
    FiniteExtensionCompositum.extendScalars_trans_finiteDimensional
      (sourceField_le_coefficientSourceField F P C)
      (coefficientSourceField_le_withFirstBranch F P C)
      (coefficientSourceField_finiteDimensional F P C)
      (withFirstBranch_finiteDimensional F P C)
  exact FiniteExtensionCompositum.extendScalars_trans_finiteDimensional
    ((sourceField_le_coefficientSourceField F P C).trans
      (coefficientSourceField_le_withFirstBranch F P C))
    (withFirstBranch_le_field F P Q hsource C)
    hfinFirst
    (field_over_withFirstBranch_finiteDimensional F P Q hsource C)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.field_le_normalField
statement:
theorem field_le_normalField :
    extendScalars (sourceField_le_field F P Q hsource C) ≤
      normalField F P Q hsource C
proof:
:=
  FiniteCover.extendScalars_le_normalClosureOver
    (sourceField_le_field F P Q hsource C)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.field_le_normalField_restrictScalars
statement:
theorem field_le_normalField_restrictScalars :
    field F P Q hsource C ≤
      (normalField F P Q hsource C).restrictScalars k
proof:
:= by
  change extendScalars (sourceField_le_field F P Q hsource C) ≤
    normalField F P Q hsource C
  exact field_le_normalField F P Q hsource C

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.coefficientExtension_le_normalField
statement:
theorem coefficientExtension_le_normalField :
    C.restrictScalars k ≤
      (normalField F P Q hsource C).restrictScalars k
proof:
:=
  (coefficientExtension_le_coefficientSourceField F P C).trans
    ((coefficientSourceField_le_withFirstBranch F P C).trans
      ((withFirstBranch_le_field F P Q hsource C).trans
        (field_le_normalField_restrictScalars F P Q hsource C)))

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.firstBranch_le_normalField
statement:
theorem firstBranch_le_normalField :
    (firstBranchOverSource F P).restrictScalars k ≤
      (normalField F P Q hsource C).restrictScalars k
proof:
:=
  (firstBranch_le_withFirstBranch F P C).trans
    ((withFirstBranch_le_field F P Q hsource C).trans
      (field_le_normalField_restrictScalars F P Q hsource C))

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.coefficientSourceAdjoin_le_normalField
statement:
theorem coefficientSourceAdjoin_le_normalField
    (E : IntermediateField k Ω) (hEC : E ≤ C.restrictScalars k) :
    (adjoin E {P.source}).restrictScalars k ≤
      (normalField F P Q hsource C).restrictScalars k
proof:
:= by
  rw [restrictScalars_adjoin_eq_sup]
  apply sup_le
  · exact hEC.trans
      (coefficientExtension_le_normalField F P Q hsource C)
  · apply adjoin_le_iff.2
    intro z hz
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    subst z
    apply firstBranch_le_normalField F P Q hsource C
    change P.source ∈ P.branchField
    exact subset_adjoin (↥F) _ (by simp)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.firstBranch_le_normalField_overSource
statement:
theorem firstBranch_le_normalField_overSource :
    firstBranchOverSource F P ≤ normalField F P Q hsource C
proof:
:= by
  change (firstBranchOverSource F P).restrictScalars k ≤
    (normalField F P Q hsource C).restrictScalars k
  exact firstBranch_le_normalField F P Q hsource C

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.secondBranch_le_normalField
statement:
theorem secondBranch_le_normalField :
    (secondBranchOverSource F P Q hsource).restrictScalars k ≤
      (normalField F P Q hsource C).restrictScalars k
proof:
:=
  (secondBranch_le_field F P Q hsource C).trans
    (field_le_normalField_restrictScalars F P Q hsource C)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.secondBranch_le_normalField_overSource
statement:
theorem secondBranch_le_normalField_overSource :
    secondBranchOverSource F P Q hsource ≤
      normalField F P Q hsource C
proof:
:= by
  change (secondBranchOverSource F P Q hsource).restrictScalars k ≤
    (normalField F P Q hsource C).restrictScalars k
  exact secondBranch_le_normalField F P Q hsource C

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.normalField_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem normalField_finiteDimensional :
    FiniteDimensional (↥(sourceField F P))
      (↥(normalField F P Q hsource C))
proof:
:=
  FiniteCover.normalClosureOver_finiteDimensional
    (sourceField_le_field F P Q hsource C)
    (field_finiteDimensional F P Q hsource C)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.normalField_finiteDimensional_over_coefficientSource
statement:
theorem normalField_finiteDimensional_over_coefficientSource
    (E : IntermediateField k Ω) (hEC : E ≤ C.restrictScalars k)
    (hfinEC : FiniteDimensional (↥E) (↥(extendScalars hEC))) :
    FiniteDimensional
      (↥((adjoin E {P.source}).restrictScalars k))
      (↥(extendScalars
        (coefficientSourceAdjoin_le_normalField
          F P Q hsource C E hEC)))
proof:
:= by
  let B : IntermediateField k Ω :=
    (adjoin E {P.source}).restrictScalars k
  let CE : IntermediateField (↥E) Ω := extendScalars hEC
  let D : IntermediateField k Ω :=
    FiniteExtensionCompositum.field E B CE
  have hEB : E ≤ B := by
    change E ≤ (adjoin E {P.source}).restrictScalars k
    rw [restrictScalars_adjoin_eq_sup]
    exact le_sup_left
  let : FiniteDimensional (↥E) (↥CE) := hfinEC
  have hBD : B ≤ D :=
    FiniteExtensionCompositum.le_field E B CE
  have hCD : C.restrictScalars k ≤ D := by
    change CE.restrictScalars k ≤ D
    exact FiniteExtensionCompositum.normal_le_field E B CE hEB
  have hBN : B ≤
      (normalField F P Q hsource C).restrictScalars k :=
    coefficientSourceAdjoin_le_normalField F P Q hsource C E hEC
  have hDN : D ≤
      (normalField F P Q hsource C).restrictScalars k := by
    exact FiniteExtensionCompositum.field_le_of_le E B CE hBN
      (coefficientExtension_le_normalField F P Q hsource C)
  have hSD : sourceField F P ≤ D := by
    change (adjoin F {P.source}).restrictScalars k ≤ D
    rw [restrictScalars_adjoin_eq_sup]
    apply sup_le
    · exact (show F ≤ C.restrictScalars k from fun z hz ↦
        C.algebraMap_mem ⟨z, hz⟩) |>.trans hCD
    · apply adjoin_le_iff.2
      intro z hz
      rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
      subst z
      apply hBD
      change P.source ∈ (adjoin E {P.source}).restrictScalars k
      rw [restrictScalars_adjoin_eq_sup]
      exact (le_sup_right : adjoin k {P.source} ≤
        E ⊔ adjoin k {P.source}) (subset_adjoin k _ (by simp))
  have hfinBD : FiniteDimensional (↥B) (↥(extendScalars hBD)) :=
    FiniteExtensionCompositum.over_finiteDimensional E B CE hEB
  have hfinSN : FiniteDimensional (↥(sourceField F P))
      (↥(normalField F P Q hsource C)) :=
    normalField_finiteDimensional F P Q hsource C
  have hfinDN : FiniteDimensional (↥D) (↥(extendScalars hDN)) := by
    let : Algebra (↥(sourceField F P)) (↥D) :=
      (IntermediateField.inclusion hSD).toAlgebra
    let : Algebra (↥D) (↥(normalField F P Q hsource C)) :=
      (IntermediateField.inclusion hDN).toAlgebra
    let : Algebra (↥(sourceField F P))
        (↥(normalField F P Q hsource C)) :=
      (IntermediateField.inclusion (hSD.trans hDN)).toAlgebra
    let : IsScalarTower (↥(sourceField F P)) (↥D)
        (↥(normalField F P Q hsource C)) :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
    let : FiniteDimensional (↥(sourceField F P))
        (↥(normalField F P Q hsource C)) := hfinSN
    change FiniteDimensional (↥D)
      (↥(normalField F P Q hsource C))
    exact FiniteDimensional.right (↥(sourceField F P)) (↥D)
      (↥(normalField F P Q hsource C))
  change FiniteDimensional (↥B) (↥(extendScalars hBN))
  exact FiniteExtensionCompositum.extendScalars_trans_finiteDimensional
    hBD hDN hfinBD hfinDN

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.normalField_normal
statement:
theorem normalField_normal [IsAlgClosed Ω] :
    Normal (↥(sourceField F P))
      (↥(normalField F P Q hsource C))
proof:
:= by
  let := field_finiteDimensional F P Q hsource C
  exact FiniteCover.normalClosureOver_normal
    (sourceField_le_field F P Q hsource C)
    (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_finite _ _)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.rebasedNormalField_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem rebasedNormalField_finiteDimensional
    (E : IntermediateField k Ω) (hEC : E ≤ C.restrictScalars k)
    (hfinEC : FiniteDimensional (↥E) (↥(extendScalars hEC))) :
    FiniteDimensional
      (↥((adjoin E {P.source}).restrictScalars k))
      (↥(rebasedNormalField F P Q hsource C E hEC))
proof:
:=
  FiniteCover.normalClosureOver_finiteDimensional
    (coefficientSourceAdjoin_le_normalField F P Q hsource C E hEC)
    (normalField_finiteDimensional_over_coefficientSource
      F P Q hsource C E hEC hfinEC)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.rebasedNormalField_normal
statement:
theorem rebasedNormalField_normal [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (E : IntermediateField k Ω) (hEC : E ≤ C.restrictScalars k)
    (hfinEC : FiniteDimensional (↥E) (↥(extendScalars hEC))) :
    Normal
      (↥((adjoin E {P.source}).restrictScalars k))
      (↥(rebasedNormalField F P Q hsource C E hEC))
proof:
:= by
  let := normalField_finiteDimensional_over_coefficientSource
    F P Q hsource C E hEC hfinEC
  exact FiniteCover.normalClosureOver_normal
    (coefficientSourceAdjoin_le_normalField F P Q hsource C E hEC)
    (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_finite _ _)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.normalField_le_rebasedNormalField
statement:
theorem normalField_le_rebasedNormalField
    (E : IntermediateField k Ω) (hEC : E ≤ C.restrictScalars k) :
    (normalField F P Q hsource C).restrictScalars k ≤
      (rebasedNormalField F P Q hsource C E hEC).restrictScalars k
proof:
:= by
  change extendScalars
      (coefficientSourceAdjoin_le_normalField F P Q hsource C E hEC) ≤
    rebasedNormalField F P Q hsource C E hEC
  exact FiniteCover.extendScalars_le_normalClosureOver
    (coefficientSourceAdjoin_le_normalField F P Q hsource C E hEC)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.firstBranchOverRebasedSource_le_normalField
statement:
theorem firstBranchOverRebasedSource_le_normalField
    (E : IntermediateField k Ω) (hEC : E ≤ C.restrictScalars k) :
    firstBranchOverRebasedSource F P E ≤
      extendScalars
        (coefficientSourceAdjoin_le_normalField F P Q hsource C E hEC)
proof:
:= by
  apply adjoin_le_iff.2
  intro z hz
  rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
  subst z
  change P.target ∈ normalField F P Q hsource C
  exact firstBranch_le_normalField F P Q hsource C
    (subset_adjoin (↥F) _ (by simp))

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.secondBranchOverRebasedSource_le_normalField
statement:
theorem secondBranchOverRebasedSource_le_normalField
    (E : IntermediateField k Ω) (hEC : E ≤ C.restrictScalars k) :
    secondBranchOverRebasedSource F P Q E ≤
      extendScalars
        (coefficientSourceAdjoin_le_normalField F P Q hsource C E hEC)
proof:
:= by
  apply adjoin_le_iff.2
  intro z hz
  rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
  subst z
  change Q.target ∈ normalField F P Q hsource C
  exact secondBranch_le_normalField F P Q hsource C
    (subset_adjoin (↥F) _ (by simp))

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.firstBranchOverRebasedSource_le_rebasedNormalField
statement:
theorem firstBranchOverRebasedSource_le_rebasedNormalField
    (E : IntermediateField k Ω) (hEC : E ≤ C.restrictScalars k) :
    firstBranchOverRebasedSource F P E ≤
      rebasedNormalField F P Q hsource C E hEC
proof:
:= by
  apply adjoin_le_iff.2
  intro z hz
  rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
  subst z
  apply normalField_le_rebasedNormalField F P Q hsource C E hEC
  apply firstBranch_le_normalField F P Q hsource C
  change P.target ∈ P.branchField
  exact subset_adjoin (↥F) _ (by simp)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.secondBranchOverRebasedSource_le_rebasedNormalField
statement:
theorem secondBranchOverRebasedSource_le_rebasedNormalField
    (E : IntermediateField k Ω) (hEC : E ≤ C.restrictScalars k) :
    secondBranchOverRebasedSource F P Q E ≤
      rebasedNormalField F P Q hsource C E hEC
proof:
:= by
  apply adjoin_le_iff.2
  intro z hz
  rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
  subst z
  apply normalField_le_rebasedNormalField F P Q hsource C E hEC
  apply secondBranch_le_normalField F P Q hsource C
  change Q.target ∈ Q.branchField
  exact subset_adjoin (↥F) _ (by simp)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.branchAutomorphismOfIdealEq_inclusion_apply
statement:
theorem branchAutomorphismOfIdealEq_inclusion_apply [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (hideal : P.ideal = Q.ideal) (x : firstBranchOverSource F P) :
    branchAutomorphismOfIdealEq F P Q hsource C hideal
        (IntermediateField.inclusion
          (firstBranch_le_normalField_overSource F P Q hsource C) x) =
      IntermediateField.inclusion
        (secondBranch_le_normalField_overSource F P Q hsource C)
        (branchEquivOfIdealEq F P Q hsource hideal x)
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra (↥(firstBranchOverSource F P))
      (↥(normalField F P Q hsource C)) :=
    (IntermediateField.inclusion
      (firstBranch_le_normalField_overSource F P Q hsource C)).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower (↥(sourceField F P))
      (↥(firstBranchOverSource F P))
      (↥(normalField F P Q hsource C)) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let : Normal (↥(sourceField F P))
      (↥(normalField F P Q hsource C)) :=
    normalField_normal F P Q hsource C
  change ((secondBranchEmbeddingOfIdealEq F P Q hsource C hideal).toAlgHom
      |>.liftNormal (↥(normalField F P Q hsource C)))
        (algebraMap (↥(firstBranchOverSource F P))
          (↥(normalField F P Q hsource C)) x) = _
  exact (secondBranchEmbeddingOfIdealEq F P Q hsource C hideal).toAlgHom
    |>.liftNormal_commutes (↥(normalField F P Q hsource C)) x

name: AclGeom.FiniteCoefficientBranchCompositum.branchAutomorphismOfIdealEq_target
statement:
@[simp] theorem branchAutomorphismOfIdealEq_target [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (hideal : P.ideal = Q.ideal) :
    branchAutomorphismOfIdealEq F P Q hsource C hideal
        (IntermediateField.inclusion
          (firstBranch_le_normalField_overSource F P Q hsource C)
          ⟨P.target, by
            change P.target ∈ P.branchField
            exact subset_adjoin (↥F) _ (by simp)⟩) =
      IntermediateField.inclusion
        (secondBranch_le_normalField_overSource F P Q hsource C)
        ⟨Q.target, by
          change Q.target ∈ Q.branchField
          exact subset_adjoin (↥F) _ (by simp)⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [branchAutomorphismOfIdealEq_inclusion_apply]
  exact congrArg
    (IntermediateField.inclusion
      (secondBranch_le_normalField_overSource F P Q hsource C))
    (branchEquivOfIdealEq_target F P Q hsource hideal)

name: AclGeom.SchemeGenericTranslate.finiteType_sections
statement:
theorem finiteType_sections (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] : Algebra.FiniteType k Γ(V.left, ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (V.hom.finiteType_appLE (isAffineOpen_top _) (isAffineOpen_top _) (by simp)).comp
    (RingHom.FiniteType.of_surjective _
      (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv).2)
  have htop : V.hom.appLE ⊤ ⊤ (by simp) = V.hom.appTop := Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app V.hom
  rw [htop] at h
  exact h

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.commutes_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem commutes_apply (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E')
    (x : E) :
    T.closureEquiv (algebraMap E (AlgebraicClosure E) x) =
      algebraMap E' (AlgebraicClosure E') (T.baseEquiv x)
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun T.commutes x

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.refl_baseEquiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem refl_baseEquiv (E : Type*) [Field E] :
    (refl E).baseEquiv = RingEquiv.refl E
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.refl_closureEquiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem refl_closureEquiv (E : Type*) [Field E] :
    (refl E).closureEquiv = RingEquiv.refl (AlgebraicClosure E)
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.symm_baseEquiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem symm_baseEquiv (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E') :
    T.symm.baseEquiv = T.baseEquiv.symm
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.symm_closureEquiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem symm_closureEquiv (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E') :
    T.symm.closureEquiv = T.closureEquiv.symm
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.trans_baseEquiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem trans_baseEquiv (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E')
    (U : AlgebraicClosureTransport E' E'') :
    (T.trans U).baseEquiv = T.baseEquiv.trans U.baseEquiv
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.trans_closureEquiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem trans_closureEquiv (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E')
    (U : AlgebraicClosureTransport E' E'') :
    (T.trans U).closureEquiv =
      T.closureEquiv.trans U.closureEquiv
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.trans_baseEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
theorem trans_baseEquiv_algebraMap
    {F : Type*} [Field F] [Algebra F E] [Algebra F E'] [Algebra F E'']
    (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E')
    (U : AlgebraicClosureTransport E' E'')
    (hT : ∀ c : F,
      T.baseEquiv (algebraMap F E c) = algebraMap F E' c)
    (hU : ∀ c : F,
      U.baseEquiv (algebraMap F E' c) = algebraMap F E'' c)
    (c : F) :
    (T.trans U).baseEquiv (algebraMap F E c) =
      algebraMap F E'' c
proof:
:= by
  rw [trans_baseEquiv, RingEquiv.trans_apply, hT, hU]

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.lift_baseEquiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem lift_baseEquiv (e : E ≃+* E') :
    (lift e).baseEquiv = e
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.source_transcendental
statement: theorem source_transcendental : Transcendental k P.source
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact P.source_generic (mem_racl_empty_of_isAlgebraic h)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.target_transcendental
statement: theorem target_transcendental : Transcendental k P.target
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact P.target_generic (mem_racl_empty_of_isAlgebraic h)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.coordinateIdealEq
proof:
:= by
  have hx : AlgebraicIndependent k (![P.source] : Fin 1 → Ω) :=
    algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff.2 P.source_transcendental
  have hy : AlgebraicIndependent k (![P.target] : Fin 1 → Ω) :=
    algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff.2 P.target_transcendental
  calc
    idealOf k (![P.source] : Fin 1 → Ω) = ⊥ :=
      (idealOf_eq_bot_iff k).2 hx
    _ = idealOf k (![P.target] : Fin 1 → Ω) :=
      ((idealOf_eq_bot_iff k).2 hy).symm

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.coordinateEquiv_source
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinateEquiv_source :
    P.coordinateEquiv
        ⟨P.source, subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩ =
      ⟨P.target, subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hsource :
      singletonRangeEquiv P.source
          ⟨P.source, subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩ =
        ⟨P.source, subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self 0)⟩ := by
    rfl
  apply Subtype.ext
  change ((locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq P.coordinateIdealEq)
      ((singletonRangeEquiv P.source)
        ⟨P.source, subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩) : Ω) = P.target
  rw [hsource]
  exact congrArg Subtype.val
    (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_apply P.coordinateIdealEq 0)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.coordinateClosureTransport_baseEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinateClosureTransport_baseEquiv_algebraMap (c : k) :
    P.coordinateClosureTransport.baseEquiv
        (algebraMap k (↥P.sourceField) c) =
      algebraMap k (↥P.targetField) c
proof:
:= by
  change P.coordinateEquiv (algebraMap k (↥P.sourceField) c) = _
  exact P.coordinateEquiv.commutes c

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.coordinateClosureTransport_source
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinateClosureTransport_source :
    P.coordinateClosureTransport.closureEquiv
        (algebraMap (↥P.sourceField) (AlgebraicClosure (↥P.sourceField))
          ⟨P.source, subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩) =
      algebraMap (↥P.targetField) (AlgebraicClosure (↥P.targetField))
        ⟨P.target, subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [AlgebraicClosureTransport.commutes_apply]
  exact congrArg
    (algebraMap (↥P.targetField) (AlgebraicClosure (↥P.targetField)))
    P.coordinateEquiv_source

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.middleFieldEquiv_target
statement:
@[simp] theorem middleFieldEquiv_target
    (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) (h : P.target = Q.source) :
    P.middleFieldEquiv Q h
        ⟨P.target, subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩ =
      ⟨Q.source, subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact h

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.middleClosureTransport_baseEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem middleClosureTransport_baseEquiv_algebraMap
    (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) (h : P.target = Q.source) (c : k) :
    (P.middleClosureTransport Q h).baseEquiv
        (algebraMap k (↥P.targetField) c) =
      algebraMap k (↥Q.sourceField) c
proof:
:= by
  change P.middleFieldEquiv Q h (algebraMap k (↥P.targetField) c) = _
  exact (P.middleFieldEquiv Q h).commutes c

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.middleClosureTransport_target
statement:
@[simp] theorem middleClosureTransport_target
    (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) (h : P.target = Q.source) :
    (P.middleClosureTransport Q h).closureEquiv
        (algebraMap (↥P.targetField)
          (AlgebraicClosure (↥P.targetField))
          ⟨P.target, subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩) =
      algebraMap (↥Q.sourceField)
        (AlgebraicClosure (↥Q.sourceField))
        ⟨Q.source, subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [AlgebraicClosureTransport.commutes_apply]
  exact congrArg
    (algebraMap (↥Q.sourceField) (AlgebraicClosure (↥Q.sourceField)))
    (P.middleFieldEquiv_target Q h)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.chainCoordinateClosureTransport_source
statement:
@[simp] theorem chainCoordinateClosureTransport_source
    (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) (h : P.target = Q.source) :
    (P.chainCoordinateClosureTransport Q h).closureEquiv
        (algebraMap (↥P.sourceField)
          (AlgebraicClosure (↥P.sourceField))
          ⟨P.source, subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩) =
      algebraMap (↥Q.targetField)
        (AlgebraicClosure (↥Q.targetField))
        ⟨Q.target, subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩
proof:
:= by
  change Q.coordinateClosureTransport.closureEquiv
      ((P.middleClosureTransport Q h).closureEquiv
        (P.coordinateClosureTransport.closureEquiv
          (algebraMap (↥P.sourceField)
            (AlgebraicClosure (↥P.sourceField))
            ⟨P.source, subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩))) = _
  rw [P.coordinateClosureTransport_source,
    P.middleClosureTransport_target, Q.coordinateClosureTransport_source]

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.compositionDefect_toRingEquiv
statement:
theorem compositionDefect_toRingEquiv
    (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) (h : P.target = Q.source) :
    (P.compositionDefect Q h).toRingEquiv =
      (P.chainCoordinateClosureTransport Q h).closureEquiv.symm.trans
        (P.directCompositeClosureTransport Q h).closureEquiv
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.chainCoordinateClosureTransport_trans_compositionDefect
statement:
theorem chainCoordinateClosureTransport_trans_compositionDefect
    (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) (h : P.target = Q.source) :
    (P.chainCoordinateClosureTransport Q h).closureEquiv.trans
        (P.compositionDefect Q h).toRingEquiv =
      (P.directCompositeClosureTransport Q h).closureEquiv
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.compositionDefect_toRingEquiv Q h]
  apply RingEquiv.ext
  intro x
  simp

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.compositionDefect_target
statement:
@[simp] theorem compositionDefect_target
    (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) (h : P.target = Q.source) :
    P.compositionDefect Q h
        (algebraMap (↥Q.targetField)
          (AlgebraicClosure (↥Q.targetField))
          ⟨Q.target, subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩) =
      algebraMap (↥Q.targetField)
        (AlgebraicClosure (↥Q.targetField))
        ⟨Q.target, subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩
proof:
:= by
  exact (P.compositionDefect Q h).commutes _

name: AclGeom.mem_racl_trans
statement:
theorem mem_racl_trans {z w u : Ω} (hzw : z ∈ racl k ({w} : Set Ω))
    (hwu : w ∈ racl k ({u} : Set Ω)) : z ∈ racl k ({u} : Set Ω)
proof:
:=
  racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hwu) hzw

name: AclGeom.comp_pair_of_shared_middle
statement:
theorem comp_pair_of_shared_middle {z w u : Ω}
    (hzw : z ∈ racl k ({w} : Set Ω)) (hwz : w ∈ racl k ({z} : Set Ω))
    (hwu : u ∈ racl k ({w} : Set Ω)) (huw : w ∈ racl k ({u} : Set Ω)) :
    u ∈ racl k ({z} : Set Ω) ∧ z ∈ racl k ({u} : Set Ω)
proof:
:=
  ⟨mem_racl_trans hwu hwz, mem_racl_trans hzw huw⟩

name: AclGeom.map_mem_idealOf_of_intermediateField_le
statement:
theorem map_mem_idealOf_of_intermediateField_le
    {E F : IntermediateField k Ω} (hEF : E ≤ F)
    {q : Fin 2 → Ω} {f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) E}
    (hf : f ∈ idealOf E q) :
    MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion hEF) f ∈
      idealOf F q
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff] at hf ⊢
  change MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap E Ω) q f = 0 at hf
  change MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap F Ω) q
    (MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion hEF) f) = 0
  rw [MvPolynomial.eval₂_map]
  have hcomp : (algebraMap F Ω).comp
      (IntermediateField.inclusion hEF).toRingHom =
      algebraMap E Ω := by
    ext x
    rfl
  change MvPolynomial.eval₂ ((algebraMap F Ω).comp
    (IntermediateField.inclusion hEF).toRingHom) q f = 0
  rw [hcomp]
  exact hf

name: AclGeom.idealOf_map_le_of_intermediateField_le
statement:
theorem idealOf_map_le_of_intermediateField_le
    {E F : IntermediateField k Ω} (hEF : E ≤ F) (q : Fin 2 → Ω) :
    Ideal.map (MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion hEF))
        (idealOf E q) ≤ idealOf F q
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro f hf
  exact map_mem_idealOf_of_intermediateField_le hEF hf

name: AclGeom.exists_pair_relocation_fixing
statement:
theorem exists_pair_relocation_fixing [IsAlgClosed Ω] {w' u w : Ω}
    (hw'0 : w' ∉ racl k (∅ : Set Ω))
    (hu : u ∈ racl k ({w'} : Set Ω))
    (hw0 : w ∉ racl k (∅ : Set Ω)) :
    ∃ u' : Ω, idealOf k ![w, u'] = idealOf k ![w', u]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hw'tr : Transcendental k w' := fun halg ↦
    hw'0 (mem_racl_empty_of_isAlgebraic halg)
  have hwtr : Transcendental k w := fun halg ↦
    hw0 (mem_racl_empty_of_isAlgebraic halg)
  have ht : AlgebraicIndependent k ![w'] :=
    algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff.2 hw'tr
  have hs : AlgebraicIndependent k ![w] :=
    algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff.2 hwtr
  have hrt : Set.range (![w'] : Fin 1 → Ω) = ({w'} : Set Ω) := by
    ext z
    simp [Matrix.range_cons, Matrix.range_empty]
  have hrs : Set.range (![w] : Fin 1 → Ω) = ({w} : Set Ω) := by
    ext z
    simp [Matrix.range_cons, Matrix.range_empty]
  have hra : Set.range (![w', u] : Fin 2 → Ω) = ({w', u} : Set Ω) := by
    ext z
    simp [Matrix.range_cons, Matrix.range_empty]
    tauto
  have hle : adjoin k (Set.range (![w'] : Fin 1 → Ω)) ≤
      adjoin k (Set.range (![w', u] : Fin 2 → Ω)) := by
    rw [hrt, hra]
    exact adjoin.mono _ _ _ (by simp)
  have halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic
      ↥(adjoin k (Set.range (![w'] : Fin 1 → Ω)))
      ↥(extendScalars hle) := by
    refine isAlgebraic_extendScalars_adjoin hle ?_
    intro x hx
    rw [hra] at hx
    rw [hrt]
    rcases hx with rfl | hx
    · have hmem : x ∈ adjoin k ({x} : Set Ω) := subset_adjoin k _ rfl
      have h := isAlgebraic_algebraMap
        (R := ↥(adjoin k ({x} : Set Ω))) (A := Ω) ⟨x, hmem⟩
      simpa using h
    · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      subst hx
      exact (mem_racl_iff k).1 hu
  
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := exists_extension_of_isAlgebraic (halg := halg) hle
    (adjoinTranscendentalAlgHom ht hs)
  set ta : Fin 2 → ↥(adjoin k (Set.range (![w', u] : Fin 2 → Ω))) :=
    fun j ↦ ⟨(![w', u] : Fin 2 → Ω) j, subset_adjoin k _ ⟨j, rfl⟩⟩
    with hta
  refine ⟨ψ (ta 1), ?_⟩
  
  have hb0 : ψ (ta 0) = w := by
    have hmem : w' ∈ adjoin k (Set.range (![w'] : Fin 1 → Ω)) := by
      rw [hrt]
      exact subset_adjoin k _ rfl
    have h1 : ta 0 = ⟨w', hle hmem⟩ := Subtype.ext rfl
    rw [h1, hψ ⟨w', hmem⟩]
    have h2 : (⟨w', hmem⟩ :
        ↥(adjoin k (Set.range (![w'] : Fin 1 → Ω)))) =
        ⟨(![w'] : Fin 1 → Ω) 0, subset_adjoin k _ ⟨0, rfl⟩⟩ := rfl
    rw [h2, adjoinTranscendentalAlgHom_apply]
    exact rfl
  have hbfun : (![w, ψ (ta 1)] : Fin 2 → Ω) = fun j ↦ ψ (ta j) := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j
    · exact hb0.symm
    · rfl
  rw [hbfun]
  
  ext f
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, mem_idealOf_iff]
  have h1 : MvPolynomial.aeval (fun j ↦ ψ (ta j)) f =
      ψ (MvPolynomial.aeval ta f) := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply]
  have h2 : MvPolynomial.aeval (![w', u] : Fin 2 → Ω) f =
      (adjoin k (Set.range (![w', u] : Fin 2 → Ω))).val
        (MvPolynomial.aeval ta f) := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply]
    rfl
  rw [h1, h2]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h4 : ψ (MvPolynomial.aeval ta f) = ψ 0 := by
      rw [map_zero]
      exact h
    rw [ψ.injective h4, map_zero]
  · intro h
    have h4 : (adjoin k (Set.range (![w', u] : Fin 2 → Ω))).val
        (MvPolynomial.aeval ta f) =
        (adjoin k (Set.range (![w', u] : Fin 2 → Ω))).val 0 := by
      rw [map_zero]
      exact h
    rw [(adjoin k (Set.range (![w', u] : Fin 2 → Ω))).val.injective h4,
      map_zero]

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.target_generic
statement: theorem target_generic : P.target ∉ racl k (∅ : Set Ω)
proof:
:= by
  intro ht
  exact P.source_generic
    (racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 ht) P.source_mem_target)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.swap_target

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.comp_source

@[simp] theorem comp_source (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω)

@[simp] theorem comp_target (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.comp_ideal_assoc
statement:
theorem comp_ideal_assoc (Q R : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω)
    (hPQ : P.target = Q.source) (hQR : Q.target = R.source) :
    ((P.comp Q hPQ).comp R (by simpa using hQR)).ideal =

    (P.comp P.swap rfl).ideal =
      (identity P.source P.source_generic).ideal

    (P.swap.comp P rfl).ideal =
      (identity P.target P.target_generic).ideal
