name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondenceGerm.composes_of_shared_middle
statement:
theorem composes_of_shared_middle (P Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω)
    (h : P.target = Q.source) :
    Composes (ofPair P) (ofPair Q) (ofPair (P.comp Q h))
proof:
:=
  ⟨P, Q, h, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondenceGerm.composes_inverse_right
statement:
theorem composes_inverse_right (P : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) :
    Composes (ofPair P) (inverseOfPair P)
      (identity P.source P.source_generic)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨P, P.swap, rfl, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  exact P.comp_swap_ideal

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondenceGerm.composes_inverse_left
statement:
theorem composes_inverse_left (P : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) :
    Composes (inverseOfPair P) (ofPair P)
      (identity P.target P.target_generic)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨P.swap, P, rfl, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  exact P.swap_comp_ideal

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondenceGerm.comp_assoc_of_shared_middles
statement:
theorem comp_assoc_of_shared_middles
    (P Q R : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω)
    (hPQ : P.target = Q.source) (hQR : Q.target = R.source) :
    ofPair ((P.comp Q hPQ).comp R (by simpa using hQR)) =
      ofPair (P.comp (Q.comp R hQR) (by simpa using hPQ))
proof:
:= by
  apply FiniteCorrespondenceGerm.ext
  exact P.comp_ideal_assoc Q R hPQ hQR

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondenceGerm.exists_composite
statement:
theorem exists_composite [IsAlgClosed Ω] (C D : FiniteCorrespondenceGerm k Ω) :
    ∃ E : FiniteCorrespondenceGerm k Ω, Composes C D E
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := C.presentation
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := D.presentation
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_pair_relocation_fixing
    Q.source_generic Q.target_mem_source P.target_generic
  have htarget : u ∈ racl k {P.target} := by
    have hv : (![Q.source, Q.target] : Fin 2 → Ω) 1 ∈ racl k
        ((![Q.source, Q.target] : Fin 2 → Ω) '' {(0 : Fin 2)}) := by
      simpa [Set.image_singleton] using Q.target_mem_source
    have h := mem_racl_image_of_idealOf_eq k hu.symm
      (J := {(0 : Fin 2)}) (i := (1 : Fin 2)) hv
    simpa [Set.image_singleton] using h
  have hsource : P.target ∈ racl k {u} := by
    have hv : (![Q.source, Q.target] : Fin 2 → Ω) 0 ∈ racl k
        ((![Q.source, Q.target] : Fin 2 → Ω) '' {(1 : Fin 2)}) := by
      simpa [Set.image_singleton] using Q.source_mem_target
    have h := mem_racl_image_of_idealOf_eq k hu.symm
      (J := {(1 : Fin 2)}) (i := (0 : Fin 2)) hv
    simpa [Set.image_singleton] using h
  let Q' : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω :=
    { source := P.target
      target := u
      source_generic := P.target_generic
      target_mem_source := htarget
      source_mem_target := hsource }
  have hQ' : D.carrier = Q'.ideal := by
    rw [hQ, FiniteCorrespondencePair.ideal]
    change idealOf k ![Q.source, Q.target] = idealOf k ![P.target, u]
    exact hu.symm
  refine ⟨ofPair (P.comp Q' rfl), P, Q', rfl, hP, hQ', rfl⟩

name: AclGeom.fiber_product_rank_count
statement:
theorem fiber_product_rank_count {p : Fin 4 → Ω} {x y z : Ω}
    (hp : AlgebraicIndependent k p)
    (hx : x ∉ racl k (Set.range p))
    (hy : y ∈ racl k (Set.range (Fin.snoc p x)))
    (hz : z ∈ racl k (Set.range (Fin.snoc p x))) :
    AlgebraicIndependent k (Fin.snoc p x) ∧
      racl k (Set.range (Fin.snoc (Fin.snoc (Fin.snoc p x) y) z)) =
        racl k (Set.range (Fin.snoc p x))
proof:
:= by
  have hpx : AlgebraicIndependent k (Fin.snoc p x) :=
    algebraicIndependent_snoc hp hx
  refine ⟨hpx, ?_⟩
  rw [Fin.range_snoc, Fin.range_snoc]
  rw [racl_insert_of_mem (racl_mono (Set.subset_insert y _) hz)]
  exact racl_insert_of_mem hy

name: AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.coordinate_points_eq
statement:
theorem coordinate_points_eq
    (G : AlgebraicGroup k) (V U : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left]
    [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (j : U ⟶ V) [IsOpenImmersion j.left]
    (x : U ⟶ (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X)
    (t : V.left.functionField)
    (g : (Spec V.left.functionField).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ U)
    (hgj : g ≫ j = SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter V)
    (hgx : g ≫ x = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k t)
    (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X)
    (A : AffineTransformation k)
    (hfield : (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G V q).unop t =
      algebraMap k V.left.functionField (A.multiplier : k) * t +
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField A.shift)
    (p r : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ U)
    (hpr : (p ≫ j) ≫ ModObj.pointAct V q = r ≫ j) :
    (p ≫ x) ≫ ModObj.pointAct (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X
      ((AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k).symm A) = r ≫ x
proof:
:= by
  let e := ModObj.pointAut V q
  have hf : ActionFunctionField.algEquivOfIso e t =
      algebraMap k V.left.functionField (A.multiplier : k) * t +
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField A.shift := hfield
  obtain ⟨_, he⟩ := CurveAffineCoordinate.equivariance_on_pullback V U j x t g hgj hgx
    e A.multiplier A.shift hf
  let l : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ pullback (j ≫ e.hom) j :=
    pullback.lift p r (by
      change p ≫ (j ≫ ModObj.pointAct V q) = r ≫ j
      exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans hpr)
  have hh := congrArg (fun z ↦ l ≫ z) he
  have hA : (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
      AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k A.multiplier A.shift =
        (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k).symm A := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    change 𝟙 _ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (AffineGroupScheme.eval k A.multiplier A.shift).toRingHom) = _
    rw [Category.id_comp]
    exact (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_left k A).symm
  rw [hA] at hh
  dsimp only [l] at hh
  simpa only [← Category.assoc, pullback.lift_fst, pullback.lift_snd] using hh.symm

name: AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.translated_coordinate_points_compatibility
statement:
theorem translated_coordinate_points_compatibility
    (G : AlgebraicGroup k) (V U : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left]
    [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (j : U ⟶ V) [IsOpenImmersion j.left]
    (x : U ⟶ (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X)
    (t : V.left.functionField)
    (gU : (Spec V.left.functionField).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ U)
    (hgj : gU ≫ j = SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter V)
    (hgx : gU ≫ x = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k t)
    (Φ : (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) →* AffineTransformation k)
    (hΦ : ∀ q, (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G V q).unop t =
      algebraMap k V.left.functionField ((Φ q).multiplier : k) * t +
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField (Φ q).shift)
    (q r : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X)
    (p z : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ U)
    (hp : p ≫ (j ≫ ModObj.pointAct V q) = z ≫ (j ≫ ModObj.pointAct V r)) :
    p ≫ (x ≫ ModObj.pointAct (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X
      ((AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k).symm (Φ q))) =
    z ≫ (x ≫ ModObj.pointAct (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X
      ((AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k).symm (Φ r)))
proof:
:= by
  let Y := (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X
  let ρ := (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k).symm.toMonoidHom.comp Φ
  have hp' : (p ≫ j) ≫ ModObj.pointAct V q = (z ≫ j) ≫ ModObj.pointAct V r := by
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using hp
  have hmove : (p ≫ j) ≫ ModObj.pointAct V (r⁻¹ * q) = z ≫ j := by
    rw [ModObj.pointAct_mul, ← Category.assoc, hp', Category.assoc,
      ← ModObj.pointAct_mul, inv_mul_cancel, ModObj.pointAct_one, Category.comp_id]
  have hc := coordinate_points_eq G V U j x t gU hgj hgx (r⁻¹ * q)
    (Φ (r⁻¹ * q)) (hΦ _) p z hmove
  change (p ≫ x) ≫ ModObj.pointAct Y (ρ (r⁻¹ * q)) = z ≫ x at hc
  change p ≫ (x ≫ ModObj.pointAct Y (ρ q)) = z ≫ (x ≫ ModObj.pointAct Y (ρ r))
  rw [← Category.assoc p, ← Category.assoc z, ← hc,
    Category.assoc (p ≫ x), ← ModObj.pointAct_mul, ← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel_left]

name: AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.pullback_eq_of_point_compatibility
statement:
theorem pullback_eq_of_point_compatibility
    (X U Y : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsReduced U.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType U.hom]
    [IsSeparated Y.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom]
    (j₁ j₂ : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j₁.left] [IsOpenImmersion j₂.left]
    (f₁ f₂ : U ⟶ Y)
    (hpoints : ∀ p q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ U,
      p ≫ j₁ = q ≫ j₂ → p ≫ f₁ = q ≫ f₂) :
    pullback.fst j₁.left j₂.left ≫ f₁.left =
      pullback.snd j₁.left j₂.left ≫ f₂.left
proof:
:= by
  let W : Over (Spec (.of k)) := Over.mk (pullback.fst j₁.left j₂.left ≫ U.hom)
  let π₁ : W.left ⟶ U.left := pullback.fst j₁.left j₂.left
  have : IsOpenImmersion π₁ := inferInstanceAs
    (IsOpenImmersion (pullback.fst j₁.left j₂.left))
  have : IsReduced W.left := isReduced_of_isOpenImmersion π₁
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType W.hom := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (π₁ ≫ U.hom)
    infer_instance
  let p₁ : W ⟶ U := Over.homMk (pullback.fst j₁.left j₂.left) rfl
  let p₂ : W ⟶ U := Over.homMk (pullback.snd j₁.left j₂.left) (by
    change pullback.snd j₁.left j₂.left ≫ U.hom = pullback.fst j₁.left j₂.left ≫ U.hom
    calc
      _ = pullback.snd j₁.left j₂.left ≫ j₂.left ≫ X.hom := by rw [Over.w j₂]
      _ = pullback.fst j₁.left j₂.left ≫ j₁.left ≫ X.hom := by
        rw [← Category.assoc, ← pullback.condition, Category.assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [Over.w j₁])
  have hp : p₁ ≫ j₁ = p₂ ≫ j₂ := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    exact pullback.condition
  have he : p₁ ≫ f₁ = p₂ ≫ f₂ := by
    apply AdditiveRigidity.over_hom_ext_of_points
    intro p
    have hh := hpoints (p ≫ p₁) (p ≫ p₂)
      (by simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg (fun z ↦ p ≫ z) hp)
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using hh
  exact congrArg Over.Hom.left he

name: AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.point_comp_pointAct
statement:
theorem point_comp_pointAct (p : 𝟙_ C ⟶ V) (q : 𝟙_ C ⟶ M) :
    p ≫ ModObj.pointAct V q = q • p
proof:
:= by
  change p ≫ ((toUnit V ≫ q) • 𝟙 V) = q • p
  rw [ModObj.comp_smul, Category.comp_id, ← Category.assoc, comp_toUnit,
    toUnit_unit, Category.id_comp]

name: AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.point_equivariance_of_chart
statement:
theorem point_equivariance_of_chart
    (j : U ⟶ V) (p0 : 𝟙_ C ⟶ U) (xU : U ⟶ Y) (x : V ⟶ Y)
    (ρ : (𝟙_ C ⟶ M) →* (𝟙_ C ⟶ H))
    (hfac : ∀ q, (j ≫ ModObj.pointAct V q) ≫ x = xU ≫ ModObj.pointAct Y (ρ q))
    (htrans : ∀ a b : 𝟙_ C ⟶ V, ∃ q : 𝟙_ C ⟶ M, a ≫ ModObj.pointAct V q = b)
    (q : 𝟙_ C ⟶ M) (p : 𝟙_ C ⟶ V) :
    p ≫ (ModObj.pointAct V q ≫ x) = p ≫ (x ≫ ModObj.pointAct Y (ρ q))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := htrans (p0 ≫ j) p
  rw [← hr]
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  have hfr (a : 𝟙_ C ⟶ M) :
      ((p0 ≫ j) ≫ ModObj.pointAct V a) ≫ x =
        (p0 ≫ xU) ≫ ModObj.pointAct Y (ρ a) := by
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg (fun z ↦ p0 ≫ z) (hfac a)
  calc
    _ = ((p0 ≫ j) ≫ ModObj.pointAct V (q * r)) ≫ x := by
      simp only [ModObj.pointAct_mul, Category.assoc]
    _ = (p0 ≫ xU) ≫ ModObj.pointAct Y (ρ (q * r)) := hfr _
    _ = ((p0 ≫ xU) ≫ ModObj.pointAct Y (ρ r)) ≫ ModObj.pointAct Y (ρ q) := by
      rw [map_mul, ModObj.pointAct_mul]
      simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [hfr r]

name: AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.exists_global_coordinate
statement:
theorem exists_global_coordinate
    (G : AlgebraicGroup k) (V U : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (j : U ⟶ V) [IsOpenImmersion j.left]
    (p0 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ U)
    (xU : U ⟶ (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X)
    (t : V.left.functionField)
    (gU : (Spec V.left.functionField).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ U)
    (hgj : gU ≫ j = SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter V)
    (hgx : gU ≫ xU = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k t)
    (Φ : (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) →* AffineTransformation k)
    (hΦ : ∀ q, (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G V q).unop t =
      algebraMap k V.left.functionField ((Φ q).multiplier : k) * t +
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField (Φ q).shift)
    (htrans : ∀ a b : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ V,
      ∃ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
        a ≫ ModObj.pointAct V q = b) :
    ∃ x : V ⟶ (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X,
      j ≫ x = xU ∧ SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter V ≫ x =
        AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k t ∧
      ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
        ModObj.pointAct V q ≫ x = x ≫
          ModObj.pointAct (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X
            ((AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k).symm (Φ q))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let GX := G.toGroupScheme.X
  let Y := (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X
  let ρ := (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k).symm.toMonoidHom.comp Φ
  let ig (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) := j ≫ ModObj.pointAct V q
  let fg (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) := xU ≫ ModObj.pointAct Y (ρ q)
  let Q := translatedCover G V U j p0 htrans
  have : IsReduced U.left := isReduced_of_isOpenImmersion j.left
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType U.hom := by rw [← Over.w j]; infer_instance
  have hcompat (q r : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) :
      pullback.fst (Q.f q) (Q.f r) ≫ (fg q).left =
        pullback.snd (Q.f q) (Q.f r) ≫ (fg r).left := by
    have : IsOpenImmersion (ig q).left := Q.map_prop q
    have : IsOpenImmersion (ig r).left := Q.map_prop r
    exact pullback_eq_of_point_compatibility V U Y (ig q) (ig r) (fg q) (fg r)
      (translated_coordinate_points_compatibility G V U j xU t gU hgj hgx Φ hΦ q r)
  let s : V.left ⟶ Y.left := Q.glueMorphisms (fun q ↦ (fg q).left) hcompat
  have hs : s ≫ Y.hom = V.hom := by
    apply Q.hom_ext
    intro q
    have he := Q.ι_glueMorphisms (fun q ↦ (fg q).left) hcompat q
    have he' : (Q.f q ≫ s) ≫ Y.hom = Q.f q ≫ V.hom :=
      (congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ Y.hom) he).trans
        ((Over.w (fg q)).trans (Over.w (ig q)).symm)
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans he'
  let x : V ⟶ Y := Over.homMk s hs
  have hfac (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) : ig q ≫ x = fg q := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    exact Q.ι_glueMorphisms (fun q ↦ (fg q).left) hcompat q
  have hjx : j ≫ x = xU := by
    have hh := hfac 1
    change (j ≫ ModObj.pointAct V 1) ≫ x = xU ≫ ModObj.pointAct Y (ρ 1) at hh
    rw [map_one, ModObj.pointAct_one, ModObj.pointAct_one, Category.comp_id,
      Category.comp_id] at hh
    exact hh
  refine ⟨x, hjx, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hgj, Category.assoc, hjx, hgx]
  · intro q
    apply AdditiveRigidity.over_hom_ext_of_points
    exact point_equivariance_of_chart j p0 xU x ρ hfac htrans q

name: AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.joint_diagram_of_point_equivariance
statement:
theorem joint_diagram_of_point_equivariance
    (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k) (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (f : G.toGroupScheme.X ⟶ (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k).toGroupScheme.X)
    (x : V ⟶ (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X)
    (heq : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
      ModObj.pointAct V q ≫ x = x ≫
        ModObj.pointAct (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X (q ≫ f)) :
    γ[G.toGroupScheme.X, V] ≫ x =
      lift (fst G.toGroupScheme.X V ≫ f) (snd G.toGroupScheme.X V ≫ x) ≫
        AffineSchemeAction.smul k
proof:
:= by
  let GX := G.toGroupScheme.X
  let Y := (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X
  have : IsIntegral (GX ⊗ V).left := isIntegral_pullback_of_isAlgClosed GX.hom V.hom
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType (GX ⊗ V).hom := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback.fst GX.hom V.hom ≫ GX.hom)
    infer_instance
  apply AdditiveRigidity.over_hom_ext_of_points
  intro p
  let q := p ≫ fst GX V
  let z := p ≫ snd GX V
  have hp : lift q z = p := by simp [q, z]
  have hh : (z ≫ ModObj.pointAct V q) ≫ x =
      (z ≫ x) ≫ ModObj.pointAct Y (q ≫ f) := by
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg (fun h ↦ z ≫ h) (heq q)
  rw [point_comp_pointAct, point_comp_pointAct] at hh
  calc
    _ = (q • z) ≫ x := by rw [← hp, ← Category.assoc]; rfl
    _ = (q ≫ f) • (z ≫ x) := hh
    _ = _ := by
      change lift (q ≫ f) (z ≫ x) ≫ AffineSchemeAction.smul k = _
      rw [← hp]
      change lift (q ≫ f) (z ≫ x) ≫ AffineSchemeAction.smul k =
        lift q z ≫ lift (fst GX V ≫ f) (snd GX V ≫ x) ≫ AffineSchemeAction.smul k
      simp only [comp_lift_assoc, lift_fst_assoc, lift_snd_assoc]

name: AclGeom.SchemeParameterAction.exists_generating_tensorCoefficients
statement:
theorem exists_generating_tensorCoefficients [Algebra.FiniteType k R]
    (g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G) :
    ∃ s : Finset R, Algebra.adjoin k (s : Set R) = ⊤ ∧
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → R) (c : Bool → s → Fin n → A),
        LinearIndependent k v ∧
        ∀ (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] (φ : A →ₐ[k] B) (e : Bool) (i : s),
          let f : (Spec (.of B)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶
              (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k))
proof:
:=
            (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op
          tensorAut (R := R) (f ≫ (if e then g else g⁻¹)) (1 ⊗ₜ[k] (i : R)) =
            ∑ j, φ (c e i j) ⊗ₜ[k] v j := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Algebra.FiniteType.out (R := k) (A := R)
  refine ⟨s, hs, ?_⟩
  let b := Module.Free.chooseBasis k R
  let d : Bool → s → Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex k R →₀ A := fun e i ↦
    TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisRight b
      (tensorAut (R := R) (if e then g else g⁻¹) (1 ⊗ₜ[k] (i : R)))
  let I : Finset (Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex k R) :=
    Finset.univ.biUnion fun p : Bool × s ↦ (d p.1 p.2).support
  refine ⟨I.card, (fun j ↦ b (I.equivFin.symm j).val),
    (fun e i j ↦ d e i (I.equivFin.symm j).val), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact b.linearIndependent.comp _
      (Subtype.val_injective.comp I.equivFin.symm.injective)
  · intro B _ _ φ e i
    have hsupp : (d e i).support ⊆ I := by
      intro a ha
      exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨(e, i), Finset.mem_univ _, ha⟩
    have hpad : (d e i).sum (fun j a ↦ a ⊗ₜ[k] b j) =
        ∑ j ∈ I, d e i j ⊗ₜ[k] b j := by
      apply Finset.sum_subset hsupp
      intro a _ ha
      rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp ha]
      change (0 : A) ⊗ₜ[k] b a = 0
      simp only [TensorProduct.zero_tmul]
    have hrepr := (TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisRight b).symm_apply_apply
      (tensorAut (R := R) (if e then g else g⁻¹) (1 ⊗ₜ[k] (i : R)))
    change (TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisRight b).symm (d e i) = _ at hrepr
    rw [TensorProduct.equivFinsuppOfBasisRight_symm_apply] at hrepr
    have hsum : tensorAut (R := R) (if e then g else g⁻¹) (1 ⊗ₜ[k] (i : R)) =
        ∑ j : Fin I.card, d e i (I.equivFin.symm j).val ⊗ₜ[k]
          b (I.equivFin.symm j).val := by
      calc
        _ = (d e i).sum (fun j a ↦ a ⊗ₜ[k] b j) := hrepr.symm
        _ = ∑ j : I, d e i j.val ⊗ₜ[k] b j.val := by
          exact hpad.trans (Finset.sum_coe_sort I
            (fun j ↦ d e i j ⊗ₜ[k] b j)).symm
        _ = _ := (Equiv.sum_comp I.equivFin.symm
          (fun j : I ↦ d e i j.val ⊗ₜ[k] b j.val)).symm
    calc
      _ = Algebra.TensorProduct.map φ (AlgHom.id k R)
          (tensorAut (R := R) (if e then g else g⁻¹) (1 ⊗ₜ[k] (i : R))) := by
        simpa only [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, map_one, AlgHom.id_apply] using
          (tensorAut_baseChange φ (if e then g else g⁻¹) (1 ⊗ₜ[k] (i : R))).symm
      _ = _ := by
        rw [hsum]
        simp only [map_sum, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, AlgHom.id_apply]

name: AclGeom.SchemeParameterAction.AclGeom.SchemeGenericTranslate.exists_generating_sectionsCoefficients
statement:
theorem exists_generating_sectionsCoefficients
    {G : Over (Spec (.of k))} [GrpObj G]
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsAffine V.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G V]
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G) :
    ∃ s : Finset Γ(V.left, ⊤), Algebra.adjoin k (s : Set Γ(V.left, ⊤)) = ⊤ ∧
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → Γ(V.left, ⊤)) (c : Bool → s → Fin n → A),
        LinearIndependent k v ∧
        ∀ (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] (φ : A →ₐ[k] B) (e : Bool) (i : s),
          let f : (Spec (.of B)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶
              (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k))
proof:
:=
            (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op
          sectionsTensorAut V (f ≫ (if e then g else g⁻¹))
              (1 ⊗ₜ[k] (i : Γ(V.left, ⊤))) =
            ∑ j, φ (c e i j) ⊗ₜ[k] v j := by
  have : Algebra.FiniteType k Γ(V.left, ⊤) := finiteType_sections V
  have : IsMonHom (Iso.refl G).hom := inferInstanceAs (IsMonHom (𝟙 G))
  let : ModObj G ((Spec (.of Γ(V.left, ⊤))).asOver (Spec (.of k))) :=
    ModObj.ofIso (Iso.refl G) (sectionsSpecIso V)
  exact SchemeParameterAction.exists_generating_tensorCoefficients (R := Γ(V.left, ⊤)) g

name: AclGeom.CurvePointsPlaces.isClosed_singleton_iff_isMin
statement:
theorem isClosed_singleton_iff_isMin (X : Scheme.{u}) (x : X) :
    IsClosed ({x} : Set X) ↔ IsMin x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx y hy
    have hsp : x ⤳ y := hy
    have hmem := hsp.mem_closure
    rw [hx.closure_eq] at hmem
    exact le_of_eq (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hmem).symm
  · intro hx
    apply closure_eq_iff_isClosed.mp
    apply Set.Subset.antisymm _ subset_closure
    intro y hy
    have hyx : y ≤ x := specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr hy
    exact Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr (le_antisymm hyx (hx hyx))

name: AclGeom.CurvePointsPlaces.isClosed_singleton_iff_ne_genericPoint
statement:
theorem isClosed_singleton_iff_ne_genericPoint (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1) (x : X) :
    IsClosed ({x} : Set X) ↔ x ≠ genericPoint X
proof:
:= by
  have he : Order.krullDim X = topologicalKrullDim X :=
    (Order.krullDim_eq_of_orderIso (irreducibleSetEquivPoints (α := X))).symm
  rw [isClosed_singleton_iff_isMin]
  constructor
  · intro hx h
    subst x
    change IsMin (⊤ : X) at hx
    have : Subsingleton X := subsingleton_of_forall_eq ⊤ fun a ↦
      le_antisymm le_top (hx le_top)
    have hz : Order.krullDim X = 0 := Order.krullDim_eq_zero
    exact (zero_ne_one : (0 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≠ 1) (hz.symm.trans (he.trans hdim))
  · intro hx
    exact (Order.krullDim_le_one_iff_forall_isMin.mp (he.trans hdim).le) x hx

name: AclGeom.CurvePointsPlaces.isField_stalk_iff_genericPoint
statement:
theorem isField_stalk_iff_genericPoint (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X] (x : X) :
    IsField (X.presheaf.stalk x) ↔ x = genericPoint X
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hc : (Order.coheight x : WithBot ℕ∞) = 0 :=
      (ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight x).symm.trans (ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_isField hx)
    have hc0 : Order.coheight x = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hc
    exact isMax_iff_eq_top.mp (Order.coheight_eq_zero.mp hc0)
  · rintro rfl
    exact (inferInstance : Field X.functionField).toIsField

name: AclGeom.eq_bilinear_of_degreeOf_le_one
statement:
theorem eq_bilinear_of_degreeOf_le_one {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k}
    (h0 : degreeOf 0 F ≤ 1) (h1 : degreeOf 1 F ≤ 1) :
    F = C (F.coeff 0) +
      C (F.coeff (Finsupp.single 0 1)) * X 0 +
      C (F.coeff (Finsupp.single 1 1)) * X 1 +
      C (F.coeff (Finsupp.single 0 1 + Finsupp.single 1 1)) *
        (X 0 * X 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hX01 : (X 0 * X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) =
      monomial (Finsupp.single 0 1 + Finsupp.single 1 1) 1 := by
    rw [X, X, monomial_mul_monomial, one_mul]
  ext m
  simp only [AddMonoidAlgebra.coeff_add, Finsupp.add_apply]
  rw [hX01, X, X,
    coeff_C_mul, coeff_C_mul, coeff_C_mul,
    coeff_monomial, coeff_monomial, coeff_monomial, coeff_C]
  by_cases hbig : m 0 ≤ 1 ∧ m 1 ≤ 1
  · obtain ⟨hm0, hm1⟩ := hbig
    have hrec := finsupp_fin_two_eq m
    rcases Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.1 hm0 with h00 | h00 <;>
      rcases Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.1 hm1 with h10 | h10
    · 
      rw [h00, h10] at hrec
      simp only [Finsupp.single_zero, add_zero] at hrec
      subst hrec
      simp [exp_ne_zero_e10.symm ∘ Eq.symm, ite_eq_right, exp_ne_zero_e10,
        exp_ne_zero_e01, exp_ne_zero_e11]
    · 
      rw [h00, h10] at hrec
      simp only [Finsupp.single_zero, zero_add] at hrec
      subst hrec
      have hn1 : (Finsupp.single 0 1 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) ≠ Finsupp.single 1 1 :=
        exp_ne_e10_e01
      have hn2 : (Finsupp.single 0 1 + Finsupp.single 1 1 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) ≠
          Finsupp.single 1 1 := fun h ↦ exp_ne_e01_e11 h.symm
      have hn3 : (0 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) ≠ Finsupp.single 1 1 := fun h ↦
        exp_ne_zero_e01 h.symm
      simp [ite_eq_right hn1, ite_eq_right hn2, ite_eq_right hn3]
    · 
      rw [h00, h10] at hrec
      simp only [Finsupp.single_zero, add_zero] at hrec
      subst hrec
      have hn1 : (Finsupp.single 1 1 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) ≠ Finsupp.single 0 1 :=
        fun h ↦ exp_ne_e10_e01 h.symm
      have hn2 : (Finsupp.single 0 1 + Finsupp.single 1 1 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) ≠
          Finsupp.single 0 1 := fun h ↦ exp_ne_e10_e11 h.symm
      have hn3 : (0 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) ≠ Finsupp.single 0 1 := fun h ↦
        exp_ne_zero_e10 h.symm
      simp [ite_eq_right hn1, ite_eq_right hn2, ite_eq_right hn3]
    · 
      rw [h00, h10] at hrec
      subst hrec
      have hn1 : (Finsupp.single 0 1 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) ≠
          Finsupp.single 0 1 + Finsupp.single 1 1 := exp_ne_e10_e11
      have hn2 : (Finsupp.single 1 1 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) ≠
          Finsupp.single 0 1 + Finsupp.single 1 1 := exp_ne_e01_e11
      have hn3 : (0 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) ≠
          Finsupp.single 0 1 + Finsupp.single 1 1 := fun h ↦
        exp_ne_zero_e11 h.symm
      simp [ite_eq_right hn1, ite_eq_right hn2, ite_eq_right hn3]
  · 
    have hLHS : F.coeff m = 0 := by
      by_contra hc
      refine hbig ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · exact degreeOf_le_iff.1 h0 m (mem_support_iff.2 hc)
      · exact degreeOf_le_iff.1 h1 m (mem_support_iff.2 hc)
    have hn0 : (0 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) ≠ m := by
      intro h
      refine hbig ?_
      rw [← h]
      simp
    have hn1 : (Finsupp.single 0 1 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) ≠ m := by
      intro h
      refine hbig ?_
      rw [← h]
      simp
    have hn2 : (Finsupp.single 1 1 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) ≠ m := by
      intro h
      refine hbig ?_
      rw [← h]
      simp
    have hn3 : (Finsupp.single 0 1 + Finsupp.single 1 1 : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ) ≠
        m := by
      intro h
      refine hbig ?_
      rw [← h]
      simp
    rw [hLHS, ite_eq_right hn0, ite_eq_right hn1, ite_eq_right hn2, ite_eq_right hn3]
    ring

name: AclGeom.exists_moebius_of_bidegree_le_one
statement:
theorem exists_moebius_of_bidegree_le_one {z w : Ω}
    (hz : z ∉ racl k (∅ : Set Ω))
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hF0 : F ≠ 0)
    (h0 : degreeOf 0 F ≤ 1) (h1 : degreeOf 1 F ≤ 1)
    (hvan : aeval ![z, w] F = 0) :
    ∃ a b c d : k,
      algebraMap k Ω c * z + algebraMap k Ω d ≠ 0 ∧
      w * (algebraMap k Ω c * z + algebraMap k Ω d) =
        algebraMap k Ω a * z + algebraMap k Ω b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set c₀₀ := F.coeff 0 with hc00
  set c₁₀ := F.coeff (Finsupp.single 0 1) with hc10
  set c₀₁ := F.coeff (Finsupp.single 1 1) with hc01
  set c₁₁ := F.coeff (Finsupp.single 0 1 + Finsupp.single 1 1) with hc11
  have hform := eq_bilinear_of_degreeOf_le_one h0 h1
  rw [← hc00, ← hc10, ← hc01, ← hc11] at hform
  
  have hexp : algebraMap k Ω c₀₀ + algebraMap k Ω c₁₀ * z +
      algebraMap k Ω c₀₁ * w + algebraMap k Ω c₁₁ * (z * w) = 0 := by
    have h := hvan
    rw [hform] at h
    simpa [map_add, map_mul, MvPolynomial.aeval_C] using h
  
  have hlin : ∀ p q : k, algebraMap k Ω p * z + algebraMap k Ω q = 0 →
      p = 0 ∧ q = 0 := by
    intro p q hpq
    by_cases hp : p = 0
    · refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
      rw [hp, map_zero, zero_mul, zero_add] at hpq
      have := (algebraMap k Ω).injective (hpq.trans (map_zero _).symm)
      exact this
    · exfalso
      refine hz ?_
      have hmap : algebraMap k Ω p ≠ 0 := fun h ↦
        hp ((algebraMap k Ω).injective (by rw [h, map_zero]))
      have h2 : algebraMap k Ω p * z = -(algebraMap k Ω q) := by
        have := congrArg (fun t ↦ t - algebraMap k Ω q) hpq
        simpa [add_sub_cancel_right] using this
      have hzval : z = algebraMap k Ω (-(q / p)) := by
        have h3 : z = (algebraMap k Ω p)⁻¹ * (algebraMap k Ω p * z) := by
          rw [inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hmap]
        rw [h3, h2, map_neg, map_div₀, mul_neg, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
      rw [hzval]
      exact IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ _
  refine ⟨-c₁₀, -c₀₀, c₁₁, c₀₁, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro hden
    obtain ⟨hc, hd⟩ := hlin c₁₁ c₀₁ hden
    rw [hc, hd] at hexp
    simp only [map_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, mul_zero] at hexp
    obtain ⟨hp, hq⟩ := hlin c₁₀ c₀₀ (by
      rw [add_comm] at hexp
      exact hexp)
    refine hF0 ?_
    rw [hform, hp, hq, hc, hd]
    simp
  · 
    rw [map_neg, map_neg]
    calc w * (algebraMap k Ω c₁₁ * z + algebraMap k Ω c₀₁) =
          (algebraMap k Ω c₀₀ + algebraMap k Ω c₁₀ * z +
            algebraMap k Ω c₀₁ * w + algebraMap k Ω c₁₁ * (z * w)) -
          (algebraMap k Ω c₀₀ + algebraMap k Ω c₁₀ * z) := by
            ring
      _ = 0 - (algebraMap k Ω c₀₀ + algebraMap k Ω c₁₀ * z) := by
            rw [hexp]
      _ = -(algebraMap k Ω c₁₀) * z + -(algebraMap k Ω c₀₀) := by
            ring

name: AclGeom.exists_moebius_of_minpoly_natDegree_one
statement:
theorem exists_moebius_of_minpoly_natDegree_one {z w : Ω}
    (hz : z ∉ racl k (∅ : Set Ω)) (hw : w ∉ racl k (∅ : Set Ω))
    (hwz : w ∈ racl k ({z} : Set Ω)) (hzw : z ∈ racl k ({w} : Set Ω))
    (h1 : (minpoly ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k ({z} : Set Ω)) w).natDegree
      = 1)
    (h2 : (minpoly ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k ({w} : Set Ω)) z).natDegree
      = 1) :
    ∃ a b c d : k,
      algebraMap k Ω c * z + algebraMap k Ω d ≠ 0 ∧
      w * (algebraMap k Ω c * z + algebraMap k Ω d) =
        algebraMap k Ω a * z + algebraMap k Ω b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hztr : Transcendental k z := fun halg ↦
    hz (mem_racl_empty_of_isAlgebraic halg)
  have hwtr : Transcendental k w := fun halg ↦
    hw (mem_racl_empty_of_isAlgebraic halg)
  obtain ⟨F, hFp, hFspan⟩ := exists_prime_span_idealOf k hztr hwz
  have hF0 : F ≠ 0 := hFp.ne_zero
  have hvalg : IsAlgebraic ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k ({z} : Set Ω)) w :=
    (mem_racl_iff k).1 hwz
  have hd1 : degreeOf 1 F = 1 := by
    rw [← natDegree_minpoly_adjoin hztr hF0 hFspan hvalg]
    exact h1
  have hswap := idealOf_swap_span hFspan
  have hswap0 : rename (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1) F ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    refine hF0 (rename_injective (⇑(Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1))
      (Equiv.injective (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1)) ?_)
    rw [h, map_zero]
  have hzalg : IsAlgebraic ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k ({w} : Set Ω)) z :=
    (mem_racl_iff k).1 hzw
  have hd0' : degreeOf 1 (rename (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1) F) = 1 := by
    rw [← natDegree_minpoly_adjoin hwtr hswap0 hswap hzalg]
    exact h2
  have hd0 : degreeOf 0 F = 1 := by
    have h := degreeOf_rename_of_injective
      (Equiv.injective (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1)) (0 : Fin 2) (p := F)
    rw [show (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1) 0 = 1 from Equiv.swap_apply_left 0 1]
      at h
    rw [← h]
    exact hd0'
  have hvan : aeval ![z, w] F = 0 :=
    (mem_idealOf_iff _).1 (hFspan ▸ Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  exact exists_moebius_of_bidegree_le_one hz hF0 hd0.le hd1.le hvan

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.ideal_mem_minimalPrimes_baseChange
statement:
theorem FiniteCorrespondencePair.ideal_mem_minimalPrimes_baseChange
    {E F : IntermediateField k Ω} (hEF : E ≤ F)
    (P : FiniteCorrespondencePair E Ω) (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair F Ω)
    (hs : P.source = Q.source) (ht : P.target = Q.target) :
    Q.ideal ∈ (P.ideal.map
      (MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion hEF : E →+* F))).minimalPrimes
proof:
:= by
  have hle :
      P.ideal.map (MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion hEF : E →+* F)) ≤ Q.ideal := by
    simpa only [FiniteCorrespondencePair.ideal, hs, ht] using
      idealOf_map_le_of_intermediateField_le hEF ![Q.source, Q.target]
  have hnonzero :
      MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion hEF : E →+* F) P.curveEquation ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact P.curveEquation_prime.ne_zero
      ((MvPolynomial.map_injective _ (IntermediateField.inclusion hEF).injective)
        (h.trans (map_zero _).symm))
  have hsmall : Q.ideal.height ≤ 1 := by
    rw [Q.ideal_eq_span_curveEquation]
    exact Ideal.height_span_singleton_le_one Q.curveEquation_prime.not_isUnit
  have hlarge :
      1 ≤ (P.ideal.map (MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion hEF : E →+* F))).height := by
    rw [P.ideal_eq_span_curveEquation, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
    exact Ideal.one_le_height_span_singleton_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors
      (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hnonzero)
  have : Q.ideal.IsPrime := by
    change (idealOf F ![Q.source, Q.target]).IsPrime
    infer_instance
  exact Ideal.mem_minimalPrimes_of_height_le hle (hsmall.trans hlarge)

name: AclGeom.mem_racl_of_le
statement:
private theorem mem_racl_of_le {E F : IntermediateField k Ω} (hEF : E ≤ F) {S : Set Ω} {x : Ω}
    (hx : x ∈ racl E S) : x ∈ racl F S
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_racl_iff] at hx ⊢
  have hle : (IntermediateField.adjoin E S).restrictScalars k ≤
      (IntermediateField.adjoin F S).restrictScalars k := by
    rw [IntermediateField.restrictScalars_adjoin_eq_sup,
      IntermediateField.restrictScalars_adjoin_eq_sup]
    exact sup_le_sup_right hEF _
  have hx' : IsAlgebraic ((IntermediateField.adjoin E S).restrictScalars k) x := hx
  exact isAlgebraic_of_le hle hx'

name: AclGeom.height_eq_two_of_isMaximal
statement:
private theorem height_eq_two_of_isMaximal {F : Type*} [Field F]
    (J : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) F)) [J.IsMaximal] : J.height = 2
proof:
:= by
  let e₁ : MvPolynomial (Fin 1) F ≃+* Polynomial F :=
    ((MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv F 0).trans
      (Polynomial.mapAlgEquiv (MvPolynomial.isEmptyAlgEquiv F (Fin 0)))).toRingEquiv
  let e : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) F ≃+* Polynomial (Polynomial F) :=
    (MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv F 1).toRingEquiv.trans (Polynomial.mapEquiv e₁)
  rw [← e.height_map J]
  have : ((J.map e).under (Polynomial F)).IsMaximal :=
    Polynomial.isMaximal_comap_C_of_isJacobsonRing _
  rw [Polynomial.height_eq_height_add_one ((J.map e).under (Polynomial F)) (J.map e),
    IsPrincipalIdealRing.height_eq_one_of_isMaximal _ (Polynomial.not_isField F)]
  exact one_add_one_eq_two

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.exists_conjugate_of_mem_minimalPrimes_baseChange
statement:
theorem FiniteCorrespondencePair.exists_conjugate_of_mem_minimalPrimes_baseChange
    [IsAlgClosed Ω] {E F : IntermediateField k Ω} (hEF : E ≤ F)
    (P : FiniteCorrespondencePair E Ω) {z : Ω} (hz : z ∉ racl F (∅ : Set Ω))
    {J : Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) F)}
    (hJ : J ∈ (P.ideal.map
      (MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion hEF : E →+* F))).minimalPrimes) :
    ∃ (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair F Ω) (σ : Ω ≃ₐ[E] Ω),
      Q.ideal = J ∧ Q.source = σ P.source ∧ Q.target = σ P.target
proof:
:= by
  have : J.IsPrime := hJ.1.1
  let g := MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion hEF : E →+* F) P.curveEquation
  have hg0 : g ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact P.curveEquation_prime.ne_zero
      ((MvPolynomial.map_injective _ (IntermediateField.inclusion hEF).injective)
        (h.trans (map_zero _).symm))
  have hspan : P.ideal.map (MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion hEF : E →+* F)) =
      Ideal.span {g} := by
    rw [P.ideal_eq_span_curveEquation, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
  have hgJ : Ideal.span {g} ≤ J := hspan ▸ hJ.1.2
  
  have hht : J.height ≤ 1 := by
    have : (Ideal.span {g}).IsPrincipal := ⟨⟨g, rfl⟩⟩
    exact Ideal.height_le_one_of_isPrincipal_of_mem_minimalPrimes _ J (hspan ▸ hJ)
  
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hiff⟩ := exists_idealOf_eq_iff (k := F) (Ω := Ω) J
  have hn1 : n ≤ 1 := by
    have hdim : ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) F) = 2 := by
      rw [MvPolynomial.ringKrullDim_of_isNoetherianRing, ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_field]
      simp
    have hle : ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) F ⧸ J) + 1 ≤ 2 :=
      (add_le_add (ringKrullDim_le_of_surjective _ (Ideal.Quotient.factor_surjective hgJ))
        le_rfl).trans ((ringKrullDim_quotient_succ_le_of_nonZeroDivisor
          (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hg0)).trans_eq hdim)
    rw [hn] at hle
    have h2 : n + 1 ≤ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hle
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ h2
  have htr : (1 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg F Ω := by
    have hind : AlgebraicIndependent F (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ z) :=
      algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff.2 fun h ↦ hz (mem_racl_empty_of_isAlgebraic h)
    simpa using hind.lift_cardinalMk_le_trdeg
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hiff.2 ((Nat.cast_le.2 hn1).trans (by simpa using htr))
  
  have hPw : P.ideal ≤ idealOf E w := by
    intro p hp
    have hmap : MvPolynomial.map (IntermediateField.inclusion hEF : E →+* F) p ∈ idealOf F w :=
      hw ▸ hJ.1.2 (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hp)
    rw [mem_idealOf_iff] at hmap ⊢
    change MvPolynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap F Ω) w (MvPolynomial.map _ p) = 0 at hmap
    rw [MvPolynomial.eval₂_map] at hmap
    exact hmap
  
  have hnalg : ∃ i, w i ∉ racl F (∅ : Set Ω) := by
    by_contra! hall
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hmtr⟩ := exists_locusCoordinateRing_dimension (k := F) w
    have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic F (IntermediateField.adjoin F (Set.range w)) :=
      IntermediateField.isAlgebraic_adjoin
        (Set.forall_mem_range.2 fun i ↦ (isAlgebraic_of_mem_racl_empty (hall i)).isIntegral)
    have hm0 : m = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hmtr.symm.trans trdeg_eq_zero
    rw [hm0, hw] at hm
    have : Ring.KrullDimLE 0 (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) F ⧸ J) := Ring.krullDimLE_iff.2 hm.le
    have : J.IsMaximal := Ideal.Quotient.maximal_of_isField J Ring.KrullDimLE.isField_of_isDomain
    rw [height_eq_two_of_isMaximal J] at hht
    exact absurd (by exact_mod_cast hht : (2 : ℕ) ≤ 1) (by norm_num)
  
  have hEq : P.ideal = idealOf E w := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := id hnalg
    have hiE : w i ∉ racl E (∅ : Set Ω) := fun h ↦ hi (mem_racl_of_le hEF h)
    have hbot (c : Ω) (hc : c ∉ racl E (∅ : Set Ω)) : idealOf E (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ c) = ⊥ :=
      algebraicIndependent_iff_ker_eq_bot.1
        (algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff.2 fun h ↦ hc (mem_racl_empty_of_isAlgebraic h))
    refine (idealOf_eq_of_le_of_comap_eq (k := E) ![P.source, P.target] (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ i)
      ?_ hPw ?_).symm
    · have hr : Set.range (![P.source, P.target] ∘ fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ i) =
          {![P.source, P.target] i} := Set.range_const
      intro j
      rw [hr]
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
      · exact subset_racl E _ (Set.mem_singleton _)
      · exact P.target_mem_source
      · exact P.source_mem_target
      · exact subset_racl E _ (Set.mem_singleton _)
    · rw [← idealOf_eq_comap_rename (k := E) (a := w) (b := w ∘ fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ i)
        (g := fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ i) rfl]
      change idealOf E (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ w i) = idealOf E (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ ![P.source, P.target] i)
      rw [hbot _ hiE, hbot]
      fin_cases i
      · exact P.source_generic
      · exact P.target_generic
  
  obtain ⟨σ, -, hσ⟩ := exists_ambientAutomorphism_of_idealOf_eq (k := E)
    (a := ![P.source, P.target]) (b := w) hEq
  have hσ0 : σ P.source = w 0 := hσ 0
  have hσ1 : σ P.target = w 1 := hσ 1
  have hy : w 1 ∈ racl E {w 0} := by
    have h := (algHom_mem_racl_image_iff (σ : Ω →ₐ[E] Ω) (S := {P.source})).2 P.target_mem_source
    simpa [Set.image_singleton, hσ0, hσ1] using h
  have hx : w 0 ∈ racl E {w 1} := by
    have h := (algHom_mem_racl_image_iff (σ : Ω →ₐ[E] Ω) (S := {P.target})).2 P.source_mem_target
    simpa [Set.image_singleton, hσ0, hσ1] using h
  
  have h0 : w 0 ∉ racl F (∅ : Set Ω) := by
    intro h0
    have h1 : w 1 ∈ racl F (∅ : Set Ω) :=
      racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 h0) (mem_racl_of_le hEF hy)
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hnalg
    fin_cases i
    · exact hi h0
    · exact hi h1
  refine ⟨⟨w 0, w 1, h0, mem_racl_of_le hEF hy, mem_racl_of_le hEF hx⟩, σ, ?_, hσ0.symm,
    hσ1.symm⟩
  change idealOf F ![w 0, w 1] = J
  rw [← hw]
  congr 1
  funext j
  fin_cases j <;> rfl

name: AclGeom.NormalCoordinateConjugation.factor_conjugation
statement:
theorem factor_conjugation
    {C : Type*} [Category* C] [CartesianMonoidalCategory C]
    {G H N M : C} [GrpObj G] [GrpObj H]
    (i : N ⟶ G) (j : M ⟶ H) (f : G ⟶ H) [IsMonHom f]
    (β : N ⟶ M) (ψ : G ⊗ N ⟶ N)
    (hfactor : β ≫ j = i ≫ f) (hψ : ψ ≫ i = G ◁ i ≫ conj G) :
    (ψ ≫ β) ≫ j = (f ⊗ₘ β) ≫ H ◁ j ≫ conj H
proof:
:= by
  have hconj : conj G ≫ f = (f ⊗ₘ f) ≫ conj H := by
    change (fst G G * snd G G * (fst G G)⁻¹) ≫ f =
      (f ⊗ₘ f) ≫ (fst H H * snd H H * (fst H H)⁻¹)
    simp only [mul_comp, inv_comp, comp_mul, comp_inv, tensorHom_fst, tensorHom_snd]
  have hsq : G ◁ i ≫ (f ⊗ₘ f) = (f ⊗ₘ β) ≫ H ◁ j := by
    apply CartesianMonoidalCategory.hom_ext
    · simp only [Category.assoc, tensorHom_fst, whiskerLeft_fst_assoc, whiskerLeft_fst]
    · simp only [Category.assoc, tensorHom_snd, whiskerLeft_snd_assoc, whiskerLeft_snd,
        tensorHom_snd_assoc, hfactor]
  calc
    _ = (ψ ≫ i) ≫ f := by rw [Category.assoc, hfactor, ← Category.assoc]
    _ = (G ◁ i ≫ conj G) ≫ f := by rw [hψ]
    _ = (G ◁ i ≫ (f ⊗ₘ f)) ≫ conj H := by
      rw [Category.assoc, hconj, ← Category.assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [hsq, Category.assoc]

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.FiniteNormalCover.map_trans_self_field
statement:
theorem map_trans_self_field (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E)
    (hbase : T.baseEquiv.trans T.baseEquiv = RingEquiv.refl E) :
    (N.map (T.trans T)).field = N.field
proof:
:= by
  let σ := T.squareAlgEquiv hbase
  calc
    (N.map (T.trans T)).field =
        (N.map (ofAlgEquiv σ)).field :=
      mapField_eq_of_closureEquiv_eq
        (T.trans T) (ofAlgEquiv σ) rfl N.field
    _ = N.field := N.map_ofAlgEquiv_field σ

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.FiniteNormalCover.twoOrbitCover_map_field
statement:
theorem twoOrbitCover_map_field (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E)
    (hbase : T.baseEquiv.trans T.baseEquiv = RingEquiv.refl E) :
    ((N.twoOrbitCover T).map T).field = (N.twoOrbitCover T).field
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ((N.twoOrbitCover T).map T).field =
        ((N.map T).sup ((N.map T).map T)).field :=
      N.map_sup_field (N.map T) T
    _ = (N.map T).field ⊔ ((N.map T).map T).field := rfl
    _ = (N.map T).field ⊔ (N.map (T.trans T)).field := by
      rw [N.map_trans_field T T]
    _ = (N.map T).field ⊔ N.field := by
      rw [N.map_trans_self_field T hbase]
    _ = N.field ⊔ (N.map T).field := by rw [sup_comm]
    _ = (N.twoOrbitCover T).field := rfl

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.FiniteNormalCover.twoOrbitEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem twoOrbitEquiv_algebraMap
    (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E)
    (hbase : T.baseEquiv.trans T.baseEquiv = RingEquiv.refl E)
    (x : E) :
    N.twoOrbitEquiv T hbase
        (algebraMap E (↥(N.twoOrbitCover T).field) x) =
      algebraMap E (↥(N.twoOrbitCover T).field) (T.baseEquiv x)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [N.coe_twoOrbitEquiv_apply]
  exact T.commutes_apply x

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.FiniteNormalCover.twoOrbitEquiv_commutes
statement:
theorem twoOrbitEquiv_commutes
    (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E)
    (hbase : T.baseEquiv.trans T.baseEquiv = RingEquiv.refl E) :
    (N.twoOrbitEquiv T hbase).toRingHom.comp
        (algebraMap E (↥(N.twoOrbitCover T).field)) =
      (algebraMap E (↥(N.twoOrbitCover T).field)).comp
        T.baseEquiv.toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro x
  exact N.twoOrbitEquiv_algebraMap T hbase x

:=

name: AclGeom.GroupScheme.mul_mem_of_genericPoint_mem
statement:
theorem mul_mem_of_genericPoint_mem {A B : Closeds G.left} {D : Set G.left} (hD : IsClosed D)
    [IrreducibleSpace (reducedOver G A ⊗ reducedOver G B).left]
    (hgen : ((reducedOverι G A ⊗ₘ reducedOverι G B) ≫ μ[G]).left
      (genericPoint (reducedOver G A ⊗ reducedOver G B).left) ∈ D)
    (a b : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G) (ha : a.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) ∈ A)
    (hb : b.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) ∈ B) :
    (a * b).left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) ∈ D
proof:
:= by
  
  have hall : ∀ x, ((reducedOverι G A ⊗ₘ reducedOverι G B) ≫ μ[G]).left x ∈ D := by
    intro x
    have hcl := hD.preimage ((reducedOverι G A ⊗ₘ reducedOverι G B) ≫ μ[G]).left.continuous
    have hmem : genericPoint (reducedOver G A ⊗ reducedOver G B).left ∈
        ((reducedOverι G A ⊗ₘ reducedOverι G B) ≫ μ[G]).left ⁻¹' D := hgen
    have hsub := closure_minimal (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hmem) hcl
    rw [genericPoint_closure] at hsub
    exact hsub (Set.mem_univ x)
  
  have hpair : lift (liftPoint A a ha) (liftPoint B b hb) ≫
      (reducedOverι G A ⊗ₘ reducedOverι G B) ≫ μ[G] = a * b := by
    rw [lift_map_assoc, liftPoint_comp_reducedOverι, liftPoint_comp_reducedOverι, Hom.mul_def]
  rw [← hpair]
  exact hall ((lift (liftPoint A a ha) (liftPoint B b hb)).left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k))

name: AclGeom.SchemeGenericTranslate.exists_affine_parameter
statement:
theorem exists_affine_parameter (G : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral G.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType G.hom] (n : ℕ)
    (hdim : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDim G.left) :
    ∃ (W : Over (Spec (.of k))) (hI : IsIntegral W.left) (hA : IsAffine W.left)
      (j : W ⟶ G) (_ : IsOpenImmersion j.left),
      letI
proof:
:= hI
      letI := hA
      letI := sectionsAlgebra W
      Algebra.FiniteType k Γ(W.left, ⊤) ∧
        (n : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k (FractionRing Γ(W.left, ⊤)) := by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hne, hd⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_dimension_ge G.left n hdim
  let W : Over (Spec (.of k)) := Over.mk (U.ι ≫ G.hom)
  have : Nonempty W.left := hne
  have : IsAffine W.left := hU
  have : IsIntegral W.left := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion U.ι
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType W.hom := inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType (U.ι ≫ G.hom))
  let j : W ⟶ G := Over.homMk U.ι rfl
  have : IsOpenImmersion j.left := inferInstanceAs (IsOpenImmersion U.ι)
  have hft := finiteType_sections W
  refine ⟨W, inferInstance, inferInstance, j, inferInstance, hft, ?_⟩
  have := hft
  let A := Γ(W.left, ⊤)
  have he := IsHomeomorph.topologicalKrullDim_eq _ W.left.isoSpec.hom.homeomorph.isHomeomorph
  change topologicalKrullDim W.left = topologicalKrullDim (PrimeSpectrum A) at he
  rw [PrimeSpectrum.topologicalKrullDim_eq_ringKrullDim] at he
  obtain ⟨m, hm, ht⟩ := exists_ringKrullDim_trdeg_eq_of_finiteType k A (FractionRing A)
  have hnm : n ≤ m := by
    have h : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ m := hd.trans_eq (he.trans hm)
    exact_mod_cast h
  rw [ht]
  exact_mod_cast hnm

name: AclGeom.SchemeAffineParameters.exists_affine_parameters
statement:
theorem exists_affine_parameters
    (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (hker : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
      ModObj.pointAct V q = 𝟙 V → q = 1)
    (hdimG : (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDim G.toAlgebraicGroup.carrier)
    (hdimV : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1) :
    ∃ t : V.left.functionField, Transcendental k t ∧
      IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set V.left.functionField) = ⊤ ∧
      ∃ Φ : (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) →* AffineTransformation k,
        Function.Injective Φ ∧
        (∀ q, (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V q).unop t =
          algebraMap k V.left.functionField ((Φ q).multiplier : k) * t +
            algebraMap k V.left.functionField (Φ q).shift) ∧
      ∃ (W : Over (Spec (.of k))) (hI : IsIntegral W.left) (hA : IsAffine W.left)
        (j : W ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) (_ : IsOpenImmersion j.left),
        letI
proof:
:= hI
        letI := hA
        letI := sectionsAlgebra W
        let A : Type u := Γ(W.left, ⊤)
        let C := FractionRing A
        let F : Type u := V.left.functionField
        let E := FractionRing (C ⊗[k] F)
        let g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X :=
          (sectionsSpecIso W).inv ≫ j
        let evC : A →ₐ[k] C := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A C
        let τ := sectionsTensorAut V ((algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom evC).op ≫ g)
        let T := algebraMap (C ⊗[k] F) E (1 ⊗ₜ[k] t)
        Algebra.FiniteType k A ∧
          ∃ d a b : A, d ≠ 0 ∧ a ≠ 0 ∧
            FiniteDimensional
              (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({evC a / evC d, evC b / evC d} : Set C)) C ∧
            IsTranscendenceBasis k (![evC a / evC d, evC b / evC d] : Fin 2 → C) ∧
            (∀ (φ : A →ₐ[k] k), φ d ≠ 0 →
              (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V
                ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
                  (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)).unop t =
                    algebraMap k F (φ a / φ d) * t + algebraMap k F (φ b / φ d)) ∧
            ∃ hCF : IsDomain (C ⊗[k] F),
              letI := hCF
              ∃ hCR : IsDomain (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)),
                letI := hCR
                ∃ (σ : E ≃ₐ[C] E) (e : E ≃ₐ[C] FractionRing (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤))),
                  (∀ (c : C) (r : Γ(V.left, ⊤)),
                    e (algebraMap (C ⊗[k] F) E
                      (c ⊗ₜ[k] V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤
                        (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint _, trivial⟩⟩) r)) =
                          algebraMap (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)) _ (c ⊗ₜ[k] r)) ∧
                  (∀ x, e (σ x) = IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv τ (e x)) ∧
                  σ T = algebraMap C E (evC a / evC d) * T +
                    algebraMap C E (evC b / evC d) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htop, Φ, hΦinj, hΦ⟩ :=
    SchemeAffinePointAction.exists_faithful_affine_coordinates G V hker hdimG hdimV
  have hpoint (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) : ∃ a b : k,
      (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V q).unop t =
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField a * t + algebraMap k V.left.functionField b :=
    ⟨((Φ q).multiplier : k), (Φ q).shift, hΦ q⟩
  obtain ⟨W, hI, hA, j, hOpen, hft, hrank⟩ :=
    exists_affine_parameter G.toGroupScheme.X 2 hdimG
  have := hI
  have := hA
  have := hOpen
  let A : Type u := Γ(W.left, ⊤)
  let : Algebra k A := sectionsAlgebra W
  have : Algebra.FiniteType k A := hft
  let C := FractionRing A
  let g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X :=
    (sectionsSpecIso W).inv ≫ j
  have : Mono j := Over.mono_of_mono_left j
  have : Mono g := inferInstance
  obtain ⟨d, a, b, hd, ha, hformula, hCF, hCR, σ, e, he, hcompare, hgeneric⟩ :=
    exists_generic_family_coefficients G.toAlgebraicGroup V ht hpoint g
  let aa := algebraMap A C a / algebraMap A C d
  let bb := algebraMap A C b / algebraMap A C d
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({aa, bb} : Set C)) C :=
    isAlgebraic_of_affine_specializations G.toAlgebraicGroup V hker htop g d a b hd hformula
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType A C :=
    Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_isLocalization C (nonZeroDivisors A)
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType k C := Algebra.EssFiniteType.comp k A C
  obtain ⟨hfinite, hbasis⟩ := finite_pair_parameters aa bb hrank
  exact ⟨t, ht, htop, Φ, hΦinj, hΦ, W, hI, hA, j, hOpen, hft, d, a, b, hd, ha,
    hfinite, hbasis, hformula, hCF, hCR, σ, e, he, hcompare, hgeneric⟩

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionTransition.transitionAlgHom_injective
statement:
theorem transitionAlgHom_injective (a₂ : ι₂ → K₂) (e : L₁ ≃ₐ[k] L₂) :
    Function.Injective (transitionAlgHom (k := k) a₂ e)
proof:
:=
  e.symm.injective.comp Subtype.val_injective

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionTransition.partialMap_fromFunctionField
statement:
theorem partialMap_fromFunctionField [Fintype ι₂]
    (a₁ : ι₁ → K₁) (a₂ : ι₂ → K₂)
    (ha₁ : adjoin k (Set.range a₁) = ⊤)
    (ha₂ : adjoin k (Set.range a₂) = ⊤)
    (e : L₁ ≃ₐ[k] L₂) :
    (partialMap (k := k) a₁ a₂ ha₁ e).fromFunctionField =
      Scheme.functionFieldMorphism
        (functionFieldAlgEquiv a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e).toRingEquiv
proof:
:= by
  let A₁ := FiniteExtensionChart.coordinateRing
    (k := k) (K := K₁) (L := L₁) a₁
  let A₂ := FiniteExtensionChart.coordinateRing
    (k := k) (K := K₂) (L := L₂) a₂
  letI : IsFractionRing A₁ L₁ :=
    FiniteExtensionChart.isFractionRing_extension a₁ ha₁
  let b₂ := FiniteExtensionChart.coordinateGenerators
    (k := k) (K := K₂) (L := L₂) a₂
  let φ := transitionAlgHom (k := k) a₂ e
  let x : (ι₂ ⊕ Fin (Module.finrank K₂ L₂)) → L₁ := fun i ↦ φ (b₂ i)
  let d : A₁ := PrincipalLocalization.CommonDenominator.common (R := A₁) x
  have hd : d ≠ 0 :=
    PrincipalLocalization.CommonDenominator.common_ne_zero (R := A₁) x
  let ψ : A₂ →ₐ[k] Localization.Away d :=
    PrincipalLocalization.awayAlgHomOfGenerators (A := A₁) b₂
      (FiniteExtensionChart.adjoin_coordinateGenerators_eq_top
        (k := k) (K := K₂) (L := L₂) a₂) φ
  let q : Localization.Away d →+*
      (FiniteExtensionChart.scheme
        (k := k) (K := K₁) (L := L₁) a₁).functionField :=
    PrincipalLocalization.genericAwayMap d hd
  have hleft :
      (partialMap (k := k) a₁ a₂ ha₁ e).fromFunctionField =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (q.comp ψ.toRingHom)) := by
    change (PrincipalLocalization.partialMapOfGenerators b₂
      (FiniteExtensionChart.adjoin_coordinateGenerators_eq_top
        (k := k) (K := K₂) (L := L₂) a₂)
      φ (transitionAlgHom_injective (k := k) a₂ e)).fromFunctionField = _
    exact PrincipalLocalization.partialMap_fromFunctionField_eq _ _ _ _
  let E := functionFieldAlgEquiv a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e
  have hring : CommRingCat.ofHom (q.comp ψ.toRingHom) =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (StructureSheaf.toStalk A₂
          (genericPoint (FiniteExtensionChart.scheme
            (k := k) (K := K₂) (L := L₂) a₂))).hom ≫
        CommRingCat.ofHom E.toRingEquiv.symm.toRingHom := by
    ext z
    simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
    change q (ψ z) = _
    apply (FiniteExtensionChart.functionFieldAlgEquiv a₁ ha₁).injective
    have hq :
        (FiniteExtensionChart.functionFieldAlgEquiv a₁ ha₁).toRingHom.comp q =
          (Localization.mapToFractionRing L₁ (Submonoid.powers d)
            (Localization.Away d)
            (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors hd)).toRingHom := by
      apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers d)
      apply RingHom.ext
      intro t
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
      change (FiniteExtensionChart.functionFieldAlgEquiv
          (k := k) (K := K₁) (L := L₁) a₁ ha₁).toRingEquiv.toRingHom
          ((q.comp (algebraMap A₁ (Localization.Away d))) t) = _
      rw [PrincipalLocalization.genericAwayMap_comp_algebraMap]
      exact (FiniteExtensionChart.functionFieldAlgEquiv_toStalk
        (k := k) (K := K₁) (L := L₁) a₁ ha₁ t).trans <|
          ((Localization.mapToFractionRing L₁ (Submonoid.powers d)
            (Localization.Away d)
            (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors hd))).commutes t |>.symm
    have hz : (FiniteExtensionChart.functionFieldAlgEquiv
        (k := k) (K := K₁) (L := L₁) a₁ ha₁)
        (q (ψ z)) =
        (Localization.mapToFractionRing L₁ (Submonoid.powers d)
          (Localization.Away d)
          (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors hd)) (ψ z) := by
      exact RingHom.congr_fun hq (ψ z)
    rw [hz]
    rw [PrincipalLocalization.awayAlgHomOfGenerators_mapToFractionRing]
    change e.symm (z : L₂) = _
    have hz₂ := FiniteExtensionChart.functionFieldAlgEquiv_toStalk
      (k := k) (K := K₂) (L := L₂) a₂ ha₂ z
    change e.symm (z : L₂) =
      (FiniteExtensionChart.functionFieldAlgEquiv
        (k := k) (K := K₁) (L := L₁) a₁ ha₁)
        ((FiniteExtensionChart.functionFieldAlgEquiv
          (k := k) (K := K₁) (L := L₁) a₁ ha₁).symm
          (e.symm ((FiniteExtensionChart.functionFieldAlgEquiv
            (k := k) (K := K₂) (L := L₂) a₂ ha₂)
            ((StructureSheaf.toStalk A₂
              (genericPoint (FiniteExtensionChart.scheme a₂))) z))))
    rw [(FiniteExtensionChart.functionFieldAlgEquiv
      (k := k) (K := K₁) (L := L₁) a₁ ha₁).apply_symm_apply, hz₂]
  rw [hleft]
  unfold Scheme.functionFieldMorphism
  rw [Spec.fromSpecStalk_eq']
  exact (congrArg Spec.map hring).trans (Spec.map_comp _ _)

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionTransition.functionFieldMorphism_comp_structureMap
statement:
theorem functionFieldMorphism_comp_structureMap
    (a₁ : ι₁ → K₁) (a₂ : ι₂ → K₂)
    (ha₁ : adjoin k (Set.range a₁) = ⊤)
    (ha₂ : adjoin k (Set.range a₂) = ⊤)
    (e : L₁ ≃ₐ[k] L₂) :
    let E
proof:
:= functionFieldAlgEquiv a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e
    Scheme.functionFieldMorphism E.toRingEquiv ≫
        FiniteExtensionChart.structureMap a₂ =
      (FiniteExtensionChart.scheme a₁).fromSpecStalk
          (genericPoint (FiniteExtensionChart.scheme a₁)) ≫
        FiniteExtensionChart.structureMap a₁ := by
  let E := functionFieldAlgEquiv a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e
  change Scheme.functionFieldMorphism E.toRingEquiv ≫
      FiniteExtensionChart.structureMap a₂ =
    (FiniteExtensionChart.scheme a₁).fromSpecStalk
        (genericPoint (FiniteExtensionChart.scheme a₁)) ≫
      FiniteExtensionChart.structureMap a₁
  unfold Scheme.functionFieldMorphism FiniteExtensionChart.structureMap
    FiniteExtensionChart.scheme
  rw [Category.assoc]
  rw [Spec.fromSpecStalk_eq, Spec.fromSpecStalk_eq]
  simp only [← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1
  ext z
  exact E.symm.commutes z

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionTransition.rationalMap_comp_structureMap
statement:
theorem rationalMap_comp_structureMap [Finite ι₂]
    (a₁ : ι₁ → K₁) (a₂ : ι₂ → K₂)
    (ha₁ : adjoin k (Set.range a₁) = ⊤)
    (ha₂ : adjoin k (Set.range a₂) = ⊤)
    (e : L₁ ≃ₐ[k] L₂) :
    (rationalMap a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e).compHom
        (FiniteExtensionChart.structureMap a₂) =
      (FiniteExtensionChart.structureMap a₁).toRationalMap
proof:
:= by
  let X := FiniteExtensionChart.scheme
    (k := k) (K := K₁) (L := L₁) a₁
  let Y := FiniteExtensionChart.scheme
    (k := k) (K := K₂) (L := L₂) a₂
  let S := Spec (.of k)
  let sX : X ⟶ S := FiniteExtensionChart.structureMap a₁
  let sY : Y ⟶ S := FiniteExtensionChart.structureMap a₂
  let φ := Scheme.functionFieldMorphism
    (functionFieldAlgEquiv a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e).toRingEquiv
  let hφ := functionFieldMorphism_comp_structureMap a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e
  letI : X.Over S := ⟨sX⟩
  letI : Y.Over S := ⟨sY⟩
  have hOver : (rationalMap a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e).IsOver S := by
    change (Scheme.RationalMap.ofFunctionField sX sY φ hφ).IsOver S
    unfold Scheme.RationalMap.ofFunctionField
    letI : (Scheme.PartialMap.ofFromSpecStalk sX sY φ hφ).IsOver S :=
      ⟨Scheme.PartialMap.ofFromSpecStalk_comp sX sY φ hφ⟩
    infer_instance
  exact Scheme.RationalMap.isOver_iff.mp hOver

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionTransition.rationalMap_fromFunctionField
statement:
theorem rationalMap_fromFunctionField [Finite ι₂]
    (a₁ : ι₁ → K₁) (a₂ : ι₂ → K₂)
    (ha₁ : adjoin k (Set.range a₁) = ⊤)
    (ha₂ : adjoin k (Set.range a₂) = ⊤)
    (e : L₁ ≃ₐ[k] L₂) :
    (rationalMap a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e).fromFunctionField =
      Scheme.functionFieldMorphism
        (functionFieldAlgEquiv a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e).toRingEquiv
proof:
:= by
  unfold rationalMap
  exact Scheme.RationalMap.fromFunctionField_ofFunctionField _ _ _ _

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionTransition.partialMap_toRationalMap
statement:
theorem partialMap_toRationalMap [Fintype ι₂]
    (a₁ : ι₁ → K₁) (a₂ : ι₂ → K₂)
    (ha₁ : adjoin k (Set.range a₁) = ⊤)
    (ha₂ : adjoin k (Set.range a₂) = ⊤)
    (e : L₁ ≃ₐ[k] L₂) :
    (partialMap (k := k) a₁ a₂ ha₁ e).toRationalMap =
      rationalMap a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.RationalMap.eq_of_fromFunctionField_eq
  rw [Scheme.RationalMap.fromFunctionField_toRationalMap]
  rw [partialMap_fromFunctionField, rationalMap_fromFunctionField]

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionTransition.functionFieldAlgEquiv_symm
statement:
theorem functionFieldAlgEquiv_symm
    (a₁ : ι₁ → K₁) (a₂ : ι₂ → K₂)
    (ha₁ : adjoin k (Set.range a₁) = ⊤)
    (ha₂ : adjoin k (Set.range a₂) = ⊤)
    (e : L₁ ≃ₐ[k] L₂) :
    functionFieldAlgEquiv a₂ a₁ ha₂ ha₁ e.symm =
      (functionFieldAlgEquiv a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e).symm
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp [functionFieldAlgEquiv]

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionTransition.functionFieldAlgEquiv_trans
statement:
theorem functionFieldAlgEquiv_trans
    (a₁ : ι₁ → K₁) (a₂ : ι₂ → K₂) (a₃ : ι₃ → K₃)
    (ha₁ : adjoin k (Set.range a₁) = ⊤)
    (ha₂ : adjoin k (Set.range a₂) = ⊤)
    (ha₃ : adjoin k (Set.range a₃) = ⊤)
    (e₁₂ : L₁ ≃ₐ[k] L₂) (e₂₃ : L₂ ≃ₐ[k] L₃) :
    (functionFieldAlgEquiv a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e₁₂).trans
        (functionFieldAlgEquiv a₂ a₃ ha₂ ha₃ e₂₃) =
      functionFieldAlgEquiv a₁ a₃ ha₁ ha₃ (e₁₂.trans e₂₃)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp [functionFieldAlgEquiv]

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionTransition.rationalMap_comp
statement:
theorem rationalMap_comp [Finite ι₁] [Finite ι₂] [Finite ι₃]
    (a₁ : ι₁ → K₁) (a₂ : ι₂ → K₂) (a₃ : ι₃ → K₃)
    (ha₁ : adjoin k (Set.range a₁) = ⊤)
    (ha₂ : adjoin k (Set.range a₂) = ⊤)
    (ha₃ : adjoin k (Set.range a₃) = ⊤)
    (e₁₂ : L₁ ≃ₐ[k] L₂) (e₂₃ : L₂ ≃ₐ[k] L₃) :
    (rationalMap a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e₁₂).comp
        (rationalMap a₂ a₃ ha₂ ha₃ e₂₃) =
      rationalMap a₁ a₃ ha₁ ha₃ (e₁₂.trans e₂₃)
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.RationalMap.eq_of_fromFunctionField_eq
  rw [Scheme.RationalMap.comp_fromFunctionField_eq_trans
    _ _
    (functionFieldAlgEquiv a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e₁₂).toRingEquiv
    (functionFieldAlgEquiv a₂ a₃ ha₂ ha₃ e₂₃).toRingEquiv
    (rationalMap_fromFunctionField a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e₁₂)
    (rationalMap_fromFunctionField a₂ a₃ ha₂ ha₃ e₂₃)]
  rw [rationalMap_fromFunctionField]
  congr 1
  exact congrArg AlgEquiv.toRingEquiv
    (functionFieldAlgEquiv_trans a₁ a₂ a₃ ha₁ ha₂ ha₃ e₁₂ e₂₃)

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionTransition.rationalMap_comp_symm
statement:
theorem rationalMap_comp_symm [Finite ι₁] [Finite ι₂]
    (a₁ : ι₁ → K₁) (a₂ : ι₂ → K₂)
    (ha₁ : adjoin k (Set.range a₁) = ⊤)
    (ha₂ : adjoin k (Set.range a₂) = ⊤)
    (e : L₁ ≃ₐ[k] L₂) :
    (rationalMap a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e).comp
        (rationalMap a₂ a₁ ha₂ ha₁ e.symm) =
      Scheme.RationalMap.id (FiniteExtensionChart.scheme
        (k := k) (K := K₁) (L := L₁) a₁)
proof:
:= by
  let E := functionFieldAlgEquiv a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e
  apply Scheme.RationalMap.comp_eq_id_of_fromFunctionField_eq
    _ _ E.toRingEquiv
  · exact rationalMap_fromFunctionField a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e
  · rw [rationalMap_fromFunctionField, functionFieldAlgEquiv_symm]
    rfl

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionTransition.rationalMap_symm_comp
statement:
theorem rationalMap_symm_comp [Finite ι₁] [Finite ι₂]
    (a₁ : ι₁ → K₁) (a₂ : ι₂ → K₂)
    (ha₁ : adjoin k (Set.range a₁) = ⊤)
    (ha₂ : adjoin k (Set.range a₂) = ⊤)
    (e : L₁ ≃ₐ[k] L₂) :
    (rationalMap a₂ a₁ ha₂ ha₁ e.symm).comp
        (rationalMap a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e) =
      Scheme.RationalMap.id (FiniteExtensionChart.scheme
        (k := k) (K := K₂) (L := L₂) a₂)
proof:
:= by
  exact rationalMap_comp_symm a₂ a₁ ha₂ ha₁ e.symm

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionTransition.partialIso_isOver
statement:
theorem partialIso_isOver [Finite ι₁] [Finite ι₂]
    (a₁ : ι₁ → K₁) (a₂ : ι₂ → K₂)
    (ha₁ : adjoin k (Set.range a₁) = ⊤)
    (ha₂ : adjoin k (Set.range a₂) = ⊤)
    (e : L₁ ≃ₐ[k] L₂) :
    (partialIso a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e).IsOver
      (FiniteExtensionChart.structureMap a₁)
      (FiniteExtensionChart.structureMap a₂)
proof:
:= by
  apply BirationalGluing.partialIsoOfMutualInverseRationalMaps_isOver
  exact rationalMap_comp_structureMap a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e

name: AclGeom.aleph0_le_trdeg_ref
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom E (MvPolynomial ℕ E)
      (AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ℕ E)))) := by
    change Function.Injective (algebraMap (MvPolynomial ℕ E)
      (AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ℕ E))))
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq (MvPolynomial ℕ E) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ℕ E))
      (AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ℕ E)))]
    exact (algebraMap (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ℕ E)) _).injective.comp
      (IsFractionRing.injective _ _)
  have hX := (MvPolynomial.algebraicIndependent_X ℕ E).map' hinj
  simpa using hX.lift_cardinalMk_le_trdeg

name: AclGeom.exists_basis_coords
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := (Set.toFinite {S : Set ι | AlgebraicIndepOn E v S}).exists_maximal
    ⟨∅, algebraicIndependent_empty_type_iff.2 (algebraMap E Ω).injective⟩
  refine ⟨S, hS.1, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  by_cases hi : i ∈ S
  · exact subset_racl E _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
  · rw [mem_racl_iff_isAlgebraic_adjoin]
    by_contra htr
    exact hi (hS.2 ((AlgebraicIndepOn.insert_iff hi).2 ⟨hS.1, htr⟩) (Set.subset_insert _ _)
      (Set.mem_insert _ _))

name: AclGeom.idealOf_eq_of_le_of_trdeg_eq
statement:
private theorem idealOf_eq_of_le_of_trdeg_eq {E K Ω : Type*} [Field E] [Field K] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra E K] [Algebra E Ω] {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (t : ι → K) (v : ι → Ω) {n : ℕ}
    (hle : idealOf E t ≤ idealOf E v)
    (ht : Algebra.trdeg E (IntermediateField.adjoin E (Set.range t)) = n)
    (hv : Algebra.trdeg E (IntermediateField.adjoin E (Set.range v)) = n) :
    idealOf E v = idealOf E t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hSind, hSspan⟩ := exists_basis_coords (E := E) v
  let g : S → ι := Subtype.val
  have hvS : idealOf E (v ∘ g) = ⊥ := algebraicIndependent_iff_ker_eq_bot.1 hSind
  have hcomapv : (idealOf E v).comap (rename g : MvPolynomial S E →ₐ[E] MvPolynomial ι E) = ⊥ :=
    (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (k := E) (a := v) (b := v ∘ g) (g := g) rfl).symm.trans hvS
  
  let F := IntermediateField.adjoin E (Set.range v)
  let w : S → F := fun i ↦ ⟨v i, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin E _ ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩
  have hwind : AlgebraicIndependent E w := AlgebraicIndependent.of_comp F.val hSind
  have hwb : IsTranscendenceBasis E w := by
    refine hwind.isTranscendenceBasis_iff_isAlgebraic.2 ⟨fun z ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [← mem_racl_iff_isAlgebraic_adjoin, ← coe_mem_racl_image_iff, ← Set.range_comp]
    have hz : (z : Ω) ∈ racl E (v '' S) :=
      (IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff.2 (Set.range_subset_iff.2 hSspan) :
        F ≤ racl E (v '' S)) z.2
    rwa [Set.image_eq_range] at hz
  have hS : Cardinal.mk S = n := by
    have h := hwb.lift_cardinalMk_eq_trdeg
    rw [hv, Cardinal.lift_natCast] at h
    exact Cardinal.lift_eq_nat_iff.1 h
  
  have htS : idealOf E (t ∘ g) = ⊥ := by
    refine le_bot_iff.1 ?_
    rw [idealOf_eq_comap_rename (k := E) (a := t) (b := t ∘ g) (g := g) rfl]
    exact (Ideal.comap_mono hle).trans hcomapv.le
  let G := IntermediateField.adjoin E (Set.range t)
  let w' : S → G := fun i ↦ ⟨t i, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin E _ ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩
  have hw'ind : AlgebraicIndependent E w' :=
    AlgebraicIndependent.of_comp G.val (algebraicIndependent_iff_ker_eq_bot.2 htS)
  have hw'b : IsTranscendenceBasis E w' := by
    refine hw'ind.isTranscendenceBasis_of_lift_trdeg_le_of_finite ?_
    rw [ht, hS, Cardinal.lift_natCast, Cardinal.lift_natCast]
  have halg : ∀ i, t i ∈ racl E (Set.range (t ∘ g)) := fun i ↦ by
    have hx : (⟨t i, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin E _ ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩ : G) ∈
        racl E (Set.range w') :=
      (mem_racl_iff_isAlgebraic_adjoin E).2 (hw'b.isAlgebraic.isAlgebraic _)
    rw [← coe_mem_racl_image_iff, ← Set.range_comp] at hx
    exact hx
  exact idealOf_eq_of_le_of_comap_eq (k := E) t g halg hle (hcomapv.trans htS.symm)

name: AclGeom.genericExtension_genericPoint
statement:
theorem genericExtension_genericPoint {k : Type u} {E : Type v} {Ω : Type w} {ι : Type z}
    [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [Field E] [Algebra k E] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω] [Algebra E Ω]
    [IsScalarTower k E Ω] [Finite ι] (P : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι k)) [P.IsPrime] :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial ι k ⧸ P) = n ∧
      ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial ι E ⧸ P.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E))) = n ∧
      (∀ v : ι → Ω, P ≤ idealOf k v →
          Algebra.trdeg E (IntermediateField.adjoin E (Set.range v)) = n →
          idealOf E v = P.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E)) ∧ idealOf k v = P ∧
            (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k E Ω).fieldRange.LinearDisjoint
              (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range v))) ∧
      (IsAlgClosed Ω → ((∃ v : ι → Ω, idealOf E v = P.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E))) ↔
          (n : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg E Ω))
proof:
:= by
  have hPe : (P.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E))).IsPrime :=
    isPrime_map_of_isAlgClosed (E := E) P
  
  let R := AlgebraicClosure (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ℕ E))
  obtain ⟨nE, hnE, hiffR⟩ := exists_idealOf_eq_iff (k := E) (Ω := R)
    (P.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E)))
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hiffR.2 (Cardinal.natCast_lt_aleph0.le.trans (aleph0_le_trdeg_ref E))
  have htk : idealOf k t = P := (isGeneric_baseChange (k := k) (E := E) (Ω := R) ht).1
  have htr := trdeg_adjoin_of_isGeneric (k := k) (E := E) (Ω := R) ht
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hntr⟩ := exists_locusCoordinateRing_dimension (k := k) t
  obtain ⟨n', hn', hn'tr⟩ := exists_locusCoordinateRing_dimension (k := E) t
  have hnn : n' = n := by exact_mod_cast hn'tr.symm.trans (htr.trans hntr)
  have hdimE : ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial ι E ⧸ P.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E))) = n := by
    rw [← ht, hn', hnn]
  refine ⟨n, by rw [← htk]; exact hn, hdimE, fun v hv hrank ↦ ?_, fun hΩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · 
    have hle : P.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E)) ≤ idealOf E v := by
      rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
      intro p hp
      rw [Ideal.mem_comap, mem_idealOf_iff, MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap]
      exact (mem_idealOf_iff k).1 (hv hp)
    have hEv : idealOf E v = P.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E)) :=
      (idealOf_eq_of_le_of_trdeg_eq t v (ht ▸ hle) (hn'tr.trans (congrArg _ hnn)) hrank).trans ht
    have hgenv := isGeneric_baseChange (k := k) (E := E) (Ω := Ω) hEv
    exact ⟨hEv, hgenv.1, hgenv.2⟩
  · have : IsAlgClosed Ω := hΩ
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hiffΩ⟩ := exists_idealOf_eq_iff (k := E) (Ω := Ω)
      (P.map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k E)))
    have hmn : m = n := by exact_mod_cast hm.symm.trans hdimE
    exact hmn ▸ hiffΩ

name: AclGeom.ProperCurve.existsUnique_morphism_extension_from_open
statement:
theorem existsUnique_morphism_extension_from_open
    (X Y U : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left] [IsLocallyNoetherian X.left]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left ≤ 1)
    (hnormal : ∀ x : X.left, IsIntegrallyClosed (X.left.presheaf.stalk x))
    [IsProper Y.hom] [Nonempty U.left]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j.left] (a : U ⟶ Y) :
    ∃! F : X ⟶ Y, j ≫ F = a
proof:
:= by
  have : Y.left.IsSeparated := by
    constructor
    rw [← Limits.terminal.comp_from Y.hom]
    infer_instance
  have hdense : Dense (j.left.opensRange : Set X.left) :=
    j.left.opensRange.2.dense (Set.range_nonempty j.left)
  have : IsDominant j.left := ⟨hdense⟩
  let p : X.left.PartialMap Y.left :=
    { domain := j.left.opensRange
      dense_domain := hdense
      hom := j.left.isoOpensRange.inv ≫ a.left }
  have hpbase : p.hom ≫ Y.hom = p.domain.ι ≫ X.hom := by
    dsimp only [p]
    rw [Category.assoc, Over.w a, ← Over.w j, ← Category.assoc,
      Scheme.Hom.isoOpensRange_inv_comp]
  have hpfield : p.fromFunctionField ≫ Y.hom =
      X.left.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X.left) ≫ X.hom := by
    dsimp only [Scheme.PartialMap.fromFunctionField,
      Scheme.PartialMap.fromSpecStalkOfMem]
    rw [Category.assoc, hpbase, ← Category.assoc,
      Scheme.Opens.fromSpecStalkOfMem_ι]
  let r := Scheme.RationalMap.ofFunctionField X.hom Y.hom p.fromFunctionField hpfield
  have hr : r = p.toRationalMap := by
    apply Scheme.RationalMap.eq_of_fromFunctionField_eq
    exact Scheme.RationalMap.fromFunctionField_ofFunctionField _ _ _ _
  have hrbase : r.compHom Y.hom = X.hom.toRationalMap :=
    ((Scheme.RationalMap.equivFunctionField X.hom Y.hom)
      ⟨p.fromFunctionField, hpfield⟩).property
  obtain ⟨F, ⟨hFr, hFbase⟩, _⟩ :=
    existsUnique_extension hdim hnormal X.hom Y.hom r hrbase
  have hF : F.toRationalMap = p.toRationalMap := hFr.trans hr
  have hpF : p.hom = p.domain.ι ≫ F :=
    (Scheme.PartialMap.equiv_toPartialMap_iff_of_isSeparated (S := ⊤_ Scheme)).mp
      (Scheme.PartialMap.toRationalMap_eq_iff.mp hF.symm)
  let F' : X ⟶ Y := Over.homMk F hFbase
  have hjF : j ≫ F' = a := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    change j.left ≫ F = a.left
    rw [← j.left.isoOpensRange_hom_ι, Category.assoc, ← hpF]
    dsimp only [p]
    rw [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  refine ⟨F', hjF, ?_⟩
  intro q hq
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  apply ext_of_isDominant j.left
  exact congrArg Over.Hom.left (hq.trans hjF.symm)

name: AclGeom.ProperCurve.existsUnique_iso_extension
statement:
theorem existsUnique_iso_extension
    (X U : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left ≤ 1)
    (hnormal : ∀ x : X.left, IsIntegrallyClosed (X.left.presheaf.stalk x))
    [IsProper X.hom] [Nonempty U.left]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j.left] (a : U ≅ U) :
    ∃! F : X ≅ X, j ≫ F.hom = a.hom ≫ j
proof:
:= by
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian X.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian X.hom
  have : X.left.IsSeparated := by
    constructor
    rw [← Limits.terminal.comp_from X.hom]
    infer_instance
  have hdense : Dense (j.left.opensRange : Set X.left) :=
    j.left.opensRange.2.dense (Set.range_nonempty j.left)
  have : IsDominant j.left := ⟨hdense⟩
  obtain ⟨F, hF, _⟩ :=
    existsUnique_morphism_extension_from_open X X U hdim hnormal j (a.hom ≫ j)
  obtain ⟨H, hH, _⟩ :=
    existsUnique_morphism_extension_from_open X X U hdim hnormal j (a.inv ≫ j)
  have hFH : F ≫ H = 𝟙 X := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    apply ext_of_isDominant j.left
    have h : j ≫ F ≫ H = j := by
      rw [← Category.assoc, hF, Category.assoc, hH, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
    simpa only [Over.comp_left, Over.id_left, Category.comp_id] using
      congrArg Over.Hom.left h
  have hHF : H ≫ F = 𝟙 X := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    apply ext_of_isDominant j.left
    have h : j ≫ H ≫ F = j := by
      rw [← Category.assoc, hH, Category.assoc, hF, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    simpa only [Over.comp_left, Over.id_left, Category.comp_id] using
      congrArg Over.Hom.left h
  let e : X ≅ X := { hom := F, inv := H, hom_inv_id := hFH, inv_hom_id := hHF }
  refine ⟨e, hF, ?_⟩
  intro d hd
  apply Iso.ext
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  apply ext_of_isDominant j.left
  exact congrArg Over.Hom.left (hd.trans hF.symm)

name: AclGeom.SmoothCurveStalks.finrank_cotangent_le_one
statement:
theorem finrank_cotangent_le_one (htr : Algebra.trdeg k F = 1) :
    Module.finrank (ResidueField R) (CotangentSpace R) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  let S := ResidueField R
  let ρ : S →ₐ[k] k := IsAlgClosed.lift
  let σ : S →ₐ[k] R := (Algebra.ofId k R).comp ρ
  have hσ : (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k R S).comp σ = AlgHom.id k S := by
    ext x
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := (IsAlgClosed.algebraMap_bijective_of_isIntegral (k := k) (K := S)).2 x
    simp only [AlgHom.commutes]
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (algebraMap R S) := residue_surjective
  have hinj := kerCotangentToTensor_injective_of_section hsurj σ hσ
  have hker : maximalIdeal R = RingHom.ker (algebraMap R S) := (ker_residue).symm
  let e := Ideal.Cotangent.equivOfEq (maximalIdeal R)
    (RingHom.ker (algebraMap R S)) hker
  let f := (KaehlerDifferential.kerCotangentToTensor k R S).comp e.toLinearMap
  let fS : CotangentSpace R →ₗ[S] S ⊗[R] KaehlerDifferential k R :=
    { toFun := f
      map_add' := f.map_add
      map_smul' := fun c x ↦ by
        obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hsurj c
        change f ((algebraMap R S r) • x) = (algebraMap R S r) • f x
        rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul]
        exact f.map_smul r x }
  have hfS : Function.Injective fS := hinj.comp e.injective
  have : Module.Free R (KaehlerDifferential k R) := Module.free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType R F :=
    Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_isLocalization F (nonZeroDivisors R)
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType k F := Algebra.EssFiniteType.comp k R F
  have : Algebra.FormallyEtale R F :=
    Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isLocalization (nonZeroDivisors R)
  have hdim : Module.finrank R (KaehlerDifferential k R) = 1 := by
    have h := (KaehlerDifferential.tensorKaehlerEquivOfFormallyEtale k R F).finrank_eq
    rw [Module.finrank_baseChange] at h
    exact h.trans (finrank_differential_eq_one htr)
  have hle := LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective hfS
  simpa only [Module.finrank_baseChange, hdim] using hle

name: AclGeom.SmoothCurveStalks.isIntegrallyClosed_of_smooth
statement: theorem isIntegrallyClosed_of_smooth (htr : Algebra.trdeg k F = 1) : IsIntegrallyClosed R
proof:
:= by
  have hm : (maximalIdeal R).IsPrincipal :=
    finrank_cotangentSpace_le_one_iff.mp (finrank_cotangent_le_one htr)
  have : IsDedekindDomain R :=
    (tfae_of_isNoetherianRing_of_isLocalRing_of_isDomain R).out 5 3 |>.mp hm
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.map_genericPoint_of_isDominant
statement:
lemma map_genericPoint_of_isDominant (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IrreducibleSpace X] [IrreducibleSpace Y] [IsDominant f] :
    f (genericPoint X) = genericPoint Y
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply (genericPoint_spec Y).eq
  rw [← f.denseRange.closure_range]
  simpa only [Set.image_univ] using (genericPoint_spec X).image f.continuous

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.PartialMap.fromFunctionField_closedPoint
statement:
lemma PartialMap.fromFunctionField_closedPoint (f : X.PartialMap Y)
    [IrreducibleSpace X] [IrreducibleSpace Y] [IsDominant f.hom] :
    f.fromFunctionField (closedPoint X.functionField) = genericPoint Y
proof:
:= by
  letI : Nonempty f.domain := f.dense_domain.nonempty.to_subtype
  letI : IrreducibleSpace f.domain :=
    f.domain.ι.isOpenEmbedding.irreducibleSpace
  rw [PartialMap.fromFunctionField, PartialMap.fromSpecStalkOfMem,
    Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
  rw [← map_genericPoint_of_isDominant f.hom]
  congr 1
  apply f.domain.ι.isOpenEmbedding.injective
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Scheme.Opens.fromSpecStalkOfMem_ι,
    Scheme.fromSpecStalk_closedPoint,
    genericPoint_eq_of_isOpenImmersion f.domain.ι]

lemma PartialMap.genericLift_hom (f : X.PartialMap Y)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.PartialMap.genericLift_ι

@[reassoc]
lemma PartialMap.genericLift_ι (f : X.PartialMap Y)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.PartialMap.compLift_hom
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma PartialMap.compLift_hom (f : X.PartialMap Y)
    [PreirreducibleSpace X] [Nonempty Y] [IsDominant f.hom]
    (g : Y.PartialMap Z) :
    f.compLift g ≫ g.hom = (f.comp g).hom

:= by
