name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.PartialMap.comp_domain_le
statement:
lemma PartialMap.comp_domain_le (f : X.PartialMap Y)
    [PreirreducibleSpace X] [Nonempty Y] [IsDominant f.hom]
    (g : Y.PartialMap Z) : (f.comp g).domain ≤ f.domain
proof:
:= by
  change f.domain.ι ''ᵁ (f.hom ⁻¹ᵁ g.domain) ≤ f.domain
  exact (Set.image_subset_range _ _).trans_eq Subtype.range_val

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.PartialMap.compToDomain_eq_homOfLE
statement:
lemma PartialMap.compToDomain_eq_homOfLE (f : X.PartialMap Y)
    [PreirreducibleSpace X] [Nonempty Y] [IsDominant f.hom]
    (g : Y.PartialMap Z) :
    f.compToDomain g = X.homOfLE (f.comp_domain_le g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono f.domain.ι]
  change
    (f.domain.ι.isoImage (f.hom ⁻¹ᵁ g.domain)).inv ≫
        (f.hom ⁻¹ᵁ g.domain).ι ≫ f.domain.ι =
      X.homOfLE (f.comp_domain_le g) ≫ f.domain.ι
  simp only [Hom.isoImage_inv_ι, homOfLE_ι]
  change (f.comp g).domain.ι = (f.comp g).domain.ι
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.PartialMap.compLift_ι
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma PartialMap.compLift_ι (f : X.PartialMap Y)
    [PreirreducibleSpace X] [Nonempty Y] [IsDominant f.hom]
    (g : Y.PartialMap Z) :
    f.compLift g ≫ g.domain.ι =
      f.compToDomain g ≫ f.hom
proof:
:= by
  change
    (f.domain.ι.isoImage (f.hom ⁻¹ᵁ g.domain)).inv ≫
        f.hom ∣_ g.domain ≫ g.domain.ι =
      (f.domain.ι.isoImage (f.hom ⁻¹ᵁ g.domain)).inv ≫
        (f.hom ⁻¹ᵁ g.domain).ι ≫ f.hom
  let a := (f.domain.ι.isoImage (f.hom ⁻¹ᵁ g.domain)).inv
  exact congrArg (fun q ↦ a ≫ q) (morphismRestrict_ι f.hom g.domain)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.PartialMap.genericLift_compToDomain_hom
statement:
lemma PartialMap.genericLift_compToDomain_hom (f : X.PartialMap Y)
    [IrreducibleSpace X] [Nonempty Y] [IsDominant f.hom]
    (g : Y.PartialMap Z) :
    (f.comp g).genericLift ≫ f.compToDomain g ≫ f.hom =
      f.fromFunctionField
proof:
:= by
  rw [f.compToDomain_eq_homOfLE g]
  exact f.fromFunctionField_restrict (f.comp g).dense_domain
    (f.comp_domain_le g)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.PartialMap.fromFunctionField_comp
statement:
lemma PartialMap.fromFunctionField_comp (f : X.PartialMap Y)
    [IrreducibleSpace X] [IrreducibleSpace Y] [IsDominant f.hom]
    (g : Y.PartialMap Z) :
    (f.comp g).fromFunctionField =
      Spec.map f.functionFieldMap ≫
        g.fromFunctionField
proof:
:= by
  have hfgeneric :
      f.fromFunctionField (closedPoint X.functionField) = genericPoint Y :=
    f.fromFunctionField_closedPoint
  rw [← (f.comp g).genericLift_hom]
  rw [← f.compLift_hom g]
  rw [← g.genericLift_hom]
  suffices h : (f.comp g).genericLift ≫ f.compLift g =
      Spec.map f.functionFieldMap ≫ g.genericLift by
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using
      congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ g.hom) h
  apply (cancel_mono g.domain.ι).mp
  rw [Category.assoc, f.compLift_ι g]
  rw [f.genericLift_compToDomain_hom g]
  dsimp only [PartialMap.functionFieldMap]
  rw [Category.assoc, g.genericLift_ι]
  rw [Spec.map_comp_assoc]
  have ht :
      Spec.map
          (Y.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hfgeneric.symm)).hom ≫
          Y.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Y) =
        Y.fromSpecStalk
          (f.fromFunctionField (closedPoint X.functionField)) := by
    exact Scheme.SpecMap_stalkSpecializes_fromSpecStalk
      (Inseparable.of_eq hfgeneric).specializes
  rw [ht]
  rw [Scheme.Spec_stalkClosedPointTo_fromSpecStalk]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.functionFieldMorphism_closedPoint
statement:
lemma functionFieldMorphism_closedPoint
    [IrreducibleSpace X] [IrreducibleSpace Y]
    (E : X.functionField ≃+* Y.functionField) :
    functionFieldMorphism E (closedPoint X.functionField) = genericPoint Y
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsLocalHom E.symm.toRingHom :=
    .of_surjective _ E.symm.surjective
  rw [functionFieldMorphism, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Spec_closedPoint]
  exact Scheme.fromSpecStalk_closedPoint

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.functionFieldMapOfMorphism_congr
statement:
lemma functionFieldMapOfMorphism_congr
    [IrreducibleSpace X] [IrreducibleSpace Y]
    {F G : Spec X.functionField ⟶ Y}
    (hFG : F = G)
    (hF : F (closedPoint X.functionField) = genericPoint Y)
    (hG : G (closedPoint X.functionField) = genericPoint Y) :
    functionFieldMapOfMorphism F hF = functionFieldMapOfMorphism G hG
proof:
:= by
  subst G
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.functionFieldMap_functionFieldMorphism
statement:
lemma functionFieldMap_functionFieldMorphism
    [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y]
    (E : X.functionField ≃+* Y.functionField) :
    functionFieldMapOfMorphism (functionFieldMorphism E)
      (functionFieldMorphism_closedPoint E) =
        CommRingCat.ofHom E.symm.toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  let q : Y.functionField ⟶ X.functionField :=
    CommRingCat.ofHom E.symm.toRingHom
  let xq : Σ y, { q : Y.presheaf.stalk y ⟶ X.functionField //
      IsLocalHom q.hom } := ⟨genericPoint Y, q, inferInstance⟩
  have hr := (SpecToEquivOfLocalRing Y X.functionField).apply_symm_apply xq
  obtain ⟨hpoint, hmap⟩ := SpecToEquivOfLocalRing_eq_iff.mp hr
  dsimp [SpecToEquivOfLocalRing, xq, q] at hpoint hmap
  change Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo
      (Spec.map q ≫ Y.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Y)) = _ ≫ q at hmap
  change _ ≫ Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo
      (Spec.map q ≫ Y.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Y)) = q
  let hF := functionFieldMorphism_closedPoint E
  have hmap' : Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo
      (Spec.map q ≫ Y.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Y)) =
        (Y.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hF)).hom ≫ q := by
    exact hmap
  rw [hmap']
  change (Y.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hF)).inv ≫
    (Y.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hF)).hom ≫ q = q
  exact Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc _ q

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.functionFieldMorphismOfHom_closedPoint
statement:
lemma functionFieldMorphismOfHom_closedPoint
    [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y]
    (q : Y.functionField ⟶ X.functionField) :
    functionFieldMorphismOfHom q (closedPoint X.functionField) =
      genericPoint Y
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsLocalHom q.hom := by
    refine ⟨fun a ha ↦ ?_⟩
    apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    intro hz
    exact (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mp ha) (by rw [hz, map_zero])
  rw [functionFieldMorphismOfHom, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Spec_closedPoint,
    Scheme.fromSpecStalk_closedPoint]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.functionFieldMap_functionFieldMorphismOfHom
statement:
lemma functionFieldMap_functionFieldMorphismOfHom
    [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y]
    (q : Y.functionField ⟶ X.functionField) :
    functionFieldMapOfMorphism (functionFieldMorphismOfHom q)
      (functionFieldMorphismOfHom_closedPoint q) = q
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsLocalHom q.hom := by
    refine ⟨fun a ha ↦ ?_⟩
    apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    intro hz
    exact (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mp ha) (by rw [hz, map_zero])
  let xq : Σ y, { q : Y.presheaf.stalk y ⟶ X.functionField //
      IsLocalHom q.hom } := ⟨genericPoint Y, q, inferInstance⟩
  have hr := (SpecToEquivOfLocalRing Y X.functionField).apply_symm_apply xq
  obtain ⟨hpoint, hmap⟩ := SpecToEquivOfLocalRing_eq_iff.mp hr
  dsimp [SpecToEquivOfLocalRing, xq] at hpoint hmap
  change Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo
      (Spec.map q ≫ Y.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Y)) = _ ≫ q at hmap
  change _ ≫ Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo
      (Spec.map q ≫ Y.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Y)) = q
  let hF := functionFieldMorphismOfHom_closedPoint q
  have hmap' : Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo
      (Spec.map q ≫ Y.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Y)) =
        (Y.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hF)).hom ≫ q := by
    exact hmap
  rw [hmap']
  change (Y.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hF)).inv ≫
    (Y.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hF)).hom ≫ q = q
  exact Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc _ q

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.PartialMap.functionFieldMap_eq_of_fromFunctionField_eq_hom
statement:
lemma PartialMap.functionFieldMap_eq_of_fromFunctionField_eq_hom
    [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y]
    (f : X.PartialMap Y) [IsDominant f.hom]
    (q : Y.functionField ⟶ X.functionField)
    (h : f.fromFunctionField = functionFieldMorphismOfHom q) :
    f.functionFieldMap = q
proof:
:= by
  change functionFieldMapOfMorphism f.fromFunctionField
      f.fromFunctionField_closedPoint = q
  exact (functionFieldMapOfMorphism_congr h
    f.fromFunctionField_closedPoint
    (functionFieldMorphismOfHom_closedPoint q)).trans
      (functionFieldMap_functionFieldMorphismOfHom q)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.functionFieldMorphism_eq_of_functionFieldMapOfMorphism_eq
statement:
lemma functionFieldMorphism_eq_of_functionFieldMapOfMorphism_eq
    [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y]
    {F G : Spec X.functionField ⟶ Y}
    (hF : F (closedPoint X.functionField) = genericPoint Y)
    (hG : G (closedPoint X.functionField) = genericPoint Y)
    (hmap : functionFieldMapOfMorphism F hF =
      functionFieldMapOfMorphism G hG) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  apply (SpecToEquivOfLocalRing Y X.functionField).injective
  apply SpecToEquivOfLocalRing_eq_iff.mpr
  refine ⟨hF.trans hG.symm, ?_⟩
  unfold functionFieldMapOfMorphism at hmap
  let eF := Y.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hF.symm)
  let eG := Y.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hG.symm)
  have hm := congrArg (fun q ↦ eF.inv ≫ q) hmap
  change stalkClosedPointTo F =
    (Y.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (hF.trans hG.symm))).hom ≫
      stalkClosedPointTo G
  simpa [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, eF, eG,
    TopCat.Presheaf.stalkCongr, TopCat.Presheaf.stalkSpecializes_comp,
    TopCat.Presheaf.stalkSpecializes_comp_assoc] using hm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.PartialMap.fromFunctionField_eq_of_functionFieldMap_eq
statement:
lemma PartialMap.fromFunctionField_eq_of_functionFieldMap_eq
    [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y]
    (f : X.PartialMap Y) [IsDominant f.hom]
    (E : X.functionField ≃+* Y.functionField)
    (h : f.functionFieldMap = CommRingCat.ofHom E.symm.toRingHom) :
    f.fromFunctionField = functionFieldMorphism E
proof:
:= by
  apply functionFieldMorphism_eq_of_functionFieldMapOfMorphism_eq
    f.fromFunctionField_closedPoint (functionFieldMorphism_closedPoint E)
  change f.functionFieldMap = _
  rw [h]
  exact (functionFieldMap_functionFieldMorphism E).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.PartialMap.isDominant_of_fromFunctionField_closedPoint
statement:
lemma PartialMap.isDominant_of_fromFunctionField_closedPoint
    [IrreducibleSpace X] [IrreducibleSpace Y]
    (f : X.PartialMap Y)
    (h : f.fromFunctionField (closedPoint X.functionField) = genericPoint Y) :
    IsDominant f.hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [isDominant_iff]
  apply DenseRange.of_comp (g := f.genericLift)
  have hdense : DenseRange f.fromFunctionField := by
    apply (dense_iff_closure_eq.mpr (genericPoint_spec Y)).mono
    rintro y (rfl : y = genericPoint Y)
    exact ⟨closedPoint X.functionField, h⟩
  simpa only [← f.genericLift_hom, Scheme.Hom.comp_base,
    TopCat.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply] using hdense

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.RationalMap.isDominant_of_fromFunctionField_closedPoint
statement:
lemma RationalMap.isDominant_of_fromFunctionField_closedPoint
    [IrreducibleSpace X] [IrreducibleSpace Y]
    (f : Scheme.RationalMap X Y)
    (h : f.fromFunctionField (closedPoint X.functionField) = genericPoint Y) :
    f.IsDominant
proof:
:= by
  let F := f.representative
  have hF : F.fromFunctionField (closedPoint X.functionField) = genericPoint Y := by
    have hrep : F.fromFunctionField = f.fromFunctionField := by
      change f.representative.fromFunctionField = f.fromFunctionField
      rw [← RationalMap.fromFunctionField_toRationalMap]
      rw [f.toRationalMap_representative]
    rw [hrep]
    exact h
  haveI : IsDominant F.hom := F.isDominant_of_fromFunctionField_closedPoint hF
  rw [← f.toRationalMap_representative]
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.RationalMap.fromFunctionField_representative
statement:
lemma RationalMap.fromFunctionField_representative
    [IrreducibleSpace X]
    (f : Scheme.RationalMap X Y) :
    f.representative.fromFunctionField = f.fromFunctionField
proof:
:= by
  rw [← RationalMap.fromFunctionField_toRationalMap]
  rw [f.toRationalMap_representative]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.RationalMap.fromFunctionField_comp
statement:
lemma RationalMap.fromFunctionField_comp
    [IrreducibleSpace X] [IrreducibleSpace Y]
    (f : Scheme.RationalMap X Y) [f.IsDominant]
    (g : Scheme.RationalMap Y Z) :
    (f.comp g).fromFunctionField =
      Spec.map f.representative.functionFieldMap ≫ g.fromFunctionField
proof:
:= by
  rw [← g.toRationalMap_representative]
  rw [RationalMap.comp_def]
  rw [RationalMap.fromFunctionField_toRationalMap]
  rw [PartialMap.fromFunctionField_comp]
  rw [RationalMap.fromFunctionField_representative]
  rw [g.toRationalMap_representative]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.RationalMap.functionFieldMap_representative_eq_of_fromFunctionField_eq_hom
statement:
lemma RationalMap.functionFieldMap_representative_eq_of_fromFunctionField_eq_hom
    [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y]
    (f : Scheme.RationalMap X Y) [f.IsDominant]
    (q : Y.functionField ⟶ X.functionField)
    (h : f.fromFunctionField = functionFieldMorphismOfHom q) :
    f.representative.functionFieldMap = q
proof:
:= by
  apply PartialMap.functionFieldMap_eq_of_fromFunctionField_eq_hom
  rw [RationalMap.fromFunctionField_representative]
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.RationalMap.comp_fromFunctionField_eq_hom
statement:
theorem RationalMap.comp_fromFunctionField_eq_hom
    [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y] [IsIntegral Z]
    (f : Scheme.RationalMap X Y) [f.IsDominant]
    (g : Scheme.RationalMap Y Z)
    (qf : Y.functionField ⟶ X.functionField)
    (qg : Z.functionField ⟶ Y.functionField)
    (hf : f.fromFunctionField = functionFieldMorphismOfHom qf)
    (hg : g.fromFunctionField = functionFieldMorphismOfHom qg) :
    (f.comp g).fromFunctionField =
      functionFieldMorphismOfHom (qg ≫ qf)
proof:
:= by
  rw [RationalMap.fromFunctionField_comp]
  rw [f.functionFieldMap_representative_eq_of_fromFunctionField_eq_hom qf hf]
  rw [hg]
  unfold functionFieldMorphismOfHom
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  exact congrArg (fun t ↦ t ≫ Z.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Z))
    (Spec.map_comp qg qf).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.RationalMap.fromFunctionField_id
statement:
lemma RationalMap.fromFunctionField_id [IrreducibleSpace X] :
    (RationalMap.id X).fromFunctionField =
      X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [RationalMap.fromFunctionField_toRationalMap]
  change (𝟙 X : X ⟶ X).toPartialMap.fromSpecStalkOfMem _ = _
  simpa only [Category.comp_id] using PartialMap.fromSpecStalkOfMem_toPartialMap
    (𝟙 X) (genericPoint X)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.PartialMap.functionFieldMap_eq_of_fromFunctionField_eq
statement:
lemma PartialMap.functionFieldMap_eq_of_fromFunctionField_eq
    [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y]
    (f : X.PartialMap Y) [IsDominant f.hom]
    (E : X.functionField ≃+* Y.functionField)
    (h : f.fromFunctionField = functionFieldMorphism E) :
    f.functionFieldMap = CommRingCat.ofHom E.symm.toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  change functionFieldMapOfMorphism f.fromFunctionField
      f.fromFunctionField_closedPoint = _
  rw [functionFieldMapOfMorphism_congr h]
  exact functionFieldMap_functionFieldMorphism E

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.RationalMap.functionFieldMap_representative_eq
statement:
lemma RationalMap.functionFieldMap_representative_eq
    [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y]
    (f : Scheme.RationalMap X Y) [f.IsDominant]
    (E : X.functionField ≃+* Y.functionField)
    (h : f.fromFunctionField = functionFieldMorphism E) :
    f.representative.functionFieldMap =
      CommRingCat.ofHom E.symm.toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  apply PartialMap.functionFieldMap_eq_of_fromFunctionField_eq _ E
  rw [RationalMap.fromFunctionField_representative]
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.RationalMap.comp_eq_id_of_fromFunctionField_eq
statement:
theorem RationalMap.comp_eq_id_of_fromFunctionField_eq
    [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y]
    (f : Scheme.RationalMap X Y) [f.IsDominant]
    (g : Scheme.RationalMap Y X) [g.IsDominant]
    (E : X.functionField ≃+* Y.functionField)
    (hf : f.fromFunctionField = functionFieldMorphism E)
    (hg : g.fromFunctionField = functionFieldMorphism E.symm) :
    f.comp g = RationalMap.id X
proof:
:= by
  apply RationalMap.eq_of_fromFunctionField_eq
  rw [RationalMap.fromFunctionField_comp]
  rw [f.functionFieldMap_representative_eq E hf]
  rw [hg]
  unfold functionFieldMorphism
  rw [RationalMap.fromFunctionField_id]
  simp only [RingEquiv.symm_symm]
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  let p : X.functionField ⟶ Y.functionField :=
    CommRingCat.ofHom E.toRingHom
  let q : Y.functionField ⟶ X.functionField :=
    CommRingCat.ofHom E.symm.toRingHom
  have hpq : p ≫ q = 𝟙 _ := by
    ext z
    exact E.symm_apply_apply z
  have hspec : Spec.map q ≫ Spec.map p = 𝟙 _ := by
    calc
      Spec.map q ≫ Spec.map p = Spec.map (p ≫ q) :=
        (Spec.map_comp p q).symm
      _ = Spec.map (𝟙 _) := congrArg Spec.map hpq
      _ = 𝟙 _ := Spec.map_id _
  change (Spec.map q ≫ Spec.map p) ≫
    X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X) = _
  rw [hspec, Category.id_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.RationalMap.comp_fromFunctionField_eq_trans
statement:
theorem RationalMap.comp_fromFunctionField_eq_trans
    [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y] [IsIntegral Z]
    (f : Scheme.RationalMap X Y) [f.IsDominant]
    (g : Scheme.RationalMap Y Z) [g.IsDominant]
    (E : X.functionField ≃+* Y.functionField)
    (F : Y.functionField ≃+* Z.functionField)
    (hf : f.fromFunctionField = functionFieldMorphism E)
    (hg : g.fromFunctionField = functionFieldMorphism F) :
    (f.comp g).fromFunctionField = functionFieldMorphism (E.trans F)
proof:
:= by
  rw [RationalMap.fromFunctionField_comp]
  rw [f.functionFieldMap_representative_eq E hf]
  rw [hg]
  unfold functionFieldMorphism
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
  rfl

name: CategoryTheory.ModObj.parameterAct_natural
statement:
theorem parameterAct_natural (f : S ⟶ T) (g : T ⟶ G) :
    (f ⊗ₘ 𝟙 X) ≫ parameterAct X g = parameterAct X (f ≫ g) ≫ (f ⊗ₘ 𝟙 X)
proof:
:= by
  apply CartesianMonoidalCategory.hom_ext
  · simp only [Category.assoc, parameterAct_fst, tensorHom_fst]
    rw [← Category.assoc, parameterAct_fst]
  · simp only [Category.assoc, parameterAct_snd, tensorHom_snd, Category.comp_id,
      comp_smul, tensorHom_fst_assoc]

name: AclGeom.WeilGluing.ι_desc
statement:
@[simp, reassoc]
theorem ι_desc {X : Scheme.{u}} (g : ∀ i, D.U i ⟶ X)
    (hg : CompatibleMaps D g) (i : D.J) :
    D.ι i ≫ desc D g hg = g i
proof:
:=
  Multicoequalizer.π_desc _ _ _ _ _

name: AclGeom.WeilGluing.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext {X : Scheme.{u}} (f g : D.glued ⟶ X)
    (h : ∀ i, D.ι i ≫ f = D.ι i ≫ g) : f = g

name: AclGeom.WeilGluing.commonOverlap_compatible
statement:
theorem commonOverlap_compatible {S : Scheme.{u}}
    (s : ∀ i, U i ⟶ S) (w : W ⟶ S)
    (h : ∀ i, f i ≫ s i = w) :
    CompatibleMaps (commonOverlapGlueData U W f) s
proof:
:= by
  unfold CompatibleMaps
  change ∀ i j : J,
    (commonOverlapGlueData U W f).f i j ≫ s i =
      (commonOverlapGlueData U W f).t i j ≫
        (commonOverlapGlueData U W f).f j i ≫ s j
  intro i j
  classical
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simp [commonOverlapGlueData, CategoryTheory.GlueData.ofGlueData',
      CategoryTheory.GlueData'.f', commonOverlapGlueData']
  · simp [commonOverlapGlueData, CategoryTheory.GlueData.ofGlueData',
      CategoryTheory.GlueData'.f', hij, Ne.symm hij, commonOverlapGlueData', h]

name: AclGeom.WeilGluing.commonOverlap_ι_toBase
statement:
@[simp, reassoc]
theorem commonOverlap_ι_toBase {S : Scheme.{u}}
    (s : ∀ i, U i ⟶ S) (w : W ⟶ S)
    (h : ∀ i, f i ≫ s i = w) (i : J) :
    (commonOverlapGlueData U W f).ι i ≫
      commonOverlapToBase U W f s w h = s i
proof:
:= by
  unfold commonOverlapToBase
  apply ι_desc

name: AclGeom.aeval_translate_eq
statement:
private theorem aeval_translate_eq (u c : Fin 2 → k) (g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) :
    aeval u (translate c g) = aeval (u + c) g
proof:
:= by
  rw [aeval_translate]
  have hfun : (fun j ↦ u j + algebraMap k k (c j)) = u + c := by
    funext j
    simp
  rw [hfun]

name: AclGeom.addSubgroup_classification_of_connected
statement:
theorem addSubgroup_classification_of_connected (H : AddSubgroup (Fin 2 → k))
    (hclosed : zeroLocus k (vanishingIdeal k (H : Set (Fin 2 → k))) = H)
    [ConnectedSpace
      (PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k ⧸ vanishingIdeal k (H : Set (Fin 2 → k))))]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k ⧸ vanishingIdeal k (H : Set (Fin 2 → k))) = 1)
    (hproj₀ : ∃ u ∈ H, ∃ v ∈ H, u 0 ≠ v 0) (hproj₁ : ∃ u ∈ H, ∃ v ∈ H, u 1 ≠ v 1) :
    ∃ P Q : Polynomial k, IsAdditive P ∧ IsAdditive Q ∧ P ≠ 0 ∧ Q ≠ 0 ∧
      vanishingIdeal k (H : Set (Fin 2 → k)) =
        Ideal.span {Polynomial.aeval (X 0) P - Polynomial.aeval (X 1) Q} ∧
      (H : Set (Fin 2 → k)) = {u | P.eval (u 0) = Q.eval (u 1)}
proof:
:= by
  have := isPrime_vanishingIdeal_of_connected (H : Set (Fin 2 → k)) hclosed ⟨0, H.zero_mem⟩
    (fun c u v ↦ u + v - c) (fun c hc u hu v hv ↦ H.sub_mem (H.add_mem hu hv) hc)
    (fun c _ u ↦ add_sub_cancel_right u c) (fun c _ v ↦ add_sub_cancel_left c v)
    (fun c v ↦ translate (v - c))
    (fun c v u g ↦ by rw [aeval_translate_eq, ← add_sub_assoc])
    (fun c u ↦ translate (u - c))
    (fun c u v g ↦ by rw [aeval_translate_eq, add_sub_left_comm, ← add_sub_assoc])
  exact addSubgroup_classification H _ hclosed.symm hdim hproj₀ hproj₁

name: AclGeom.AdditiveTranslation.exists_finite_coordinate
statement:
theorem exists_finite_coordinate
    (β : (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).Hom (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1))
    (hne : ∃ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶
      (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X, q ≫ β.hom.hom ≠ 1) :
    ∃ p : Polynomial k, Polynomial.eval 0 p = 0 ∧ p.natDegree ≠ 0 ∧
      IsFinite β.hom.hom.left ∧ Surjective β.hom.hom.left ∧
      (∀ (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra k C] (x : C),
        AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k x ≫ β.hom.hom =
          AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (Polynomial.aeval x p)) ∧
      ∀ (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra k C] (x y : C),
        Polynomial.aeval (x + y) p = Polynomial.aeval x p + Polynomial.aeval y p
proof:
:= by
  let R := AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1
  let P := polynomialCoordinates k
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := AffineSchemeAction.exists_linePoint k (C := R) β.hom.hom
  let p := P z
  have hz₀ : AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) (0 : k) z = 0 := by
    apply AffineSchemeAction.linePoint_injective k
    rw [← linePoint_comp_linePoint, hz, linePoint_zero, one_comp]
  have hp₀ : Polynomial.eval 0 p = 0 :=
    (lineEval_polynomialCoordinates k 0 z).symm.trans hz₀
  have hp : p.natDegree ≠ 0 := by
    intro hp
    have hconst : p = 0 := by
      rw [Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hp]
      have hc : p.coeff 0 = 0 := by
        have hh := hp₀
        rw [Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hp, Polynomial.eval_C] at hh
        exact hh
      rw [hc, Polynomial.C_0]
    have hz₀' : z = 0 := by
      apply P.injective
      change p = P 0
      rw [hconst, map_zero]
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hne
    apply hq
    rw [← hz, hz₀', linePoint_zero]
    change q ≫ (1 : (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X ⟶
      (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X) = 1
    exact comp_one q
  refine ⟨p, hp₀, hp, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hz]
    exact isFinite_linePoint k z hp
  · rw [← hz]
    exact surjective_linePoint k z hp
  · intro C _ _ x
    rw [← hz, linePoint_comp_linePoint, lineEval_polynomialCoordinates]
  · intro C _ _ x y
    have hformula (w : C) : AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k w ≫ β.hom.hom =
        AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (Polynomial.aeval w p) := by
      rw [← hz, linePoint_comp_linePoint, lineEval_polynomialCoordinates]
    apply AffineSchemeAction.linePoint_injective k
    calc
      AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (Polynomial.aeval (x + y) p) =
          AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (x + y) ≫ β.hom.hom := (hformula _).symm
      _ = (AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k x * AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k y) ≫
          β.hom.hom := by rw [linePoint_mul]
      _ = (AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k x ≫ β.hom.hom) *
          (AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k y ≫ β.hom.hom) := mul_comp _ _ _
      _ = _ := by rw [hformula, hformula, linePoint_mul]

name: AclGeom.interalgebraic_div_of_coset_equations
proof:
:= by
  have hX : (x₁ / x₂) ^ a ≠ 0 := zpow_ne_zero a (div_ne_zero hx₁ hx₂)
  have hY : (y₁ / y₂) ^ b ≠ 0 := zpow_ne_zero b (div_ne_zero hy₁ hy₂)
  have hq : (x₁ / x₂) ^ a * (y₁ / y₂) ^ b = algebraMap k Ω (c₁ / c₂) := by
    rw [div_zpow, div_zpow, div_mul_div_comm, h₁, h₂, map_div₀]
  
  have hYb : (y₁ / y₂) ^ b ∈ racl k {x₁ / x₂} := by
    have h : (y₁ / y₂) ^ b = algebraMap k Ω (c₁ / c₂) / (x₁ / x₂) ^ a :=
      (eq_div_iff hX).2 (by rw [mul_comm]; exact hq)
    rw [h]
    exact div_mem (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ _)
      (MulCorrSetup.zpow_mem_racl (subset_racl k {x₁ / x₂} rfl) a)
  have hXa : (x₁ / x₂) ^ a ∈ racl k {y₁ / y₂} := by
    have h : (x₁ / x₂) ^ a = algebraMap k Ω (c₁ / c₂) / (y₁ / y₂) ^ b := (eq_div_iff hY).2 hq
    rw [h]
    exact div_mem (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem _ _)
      (MulCorrSetup.zpow_mem_racl (subset_racl k {y₁ / y₂} rfl) b)
  constructor
  · exact racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hYb) (mem_racl_singleton_zpow hb)
  · exact racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hXa) (mem_racl_singleton_zpow ha)

name: AclGeom.MulCorrSetup.interalgebraic_div
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, c₁, c₂, ha, hb, -, -, h₁, h₂⟩ := S.exists_coset_equations hs
  exact interalgebraic_div_of_coset_equations ha hb S.x₁_ne S.x₂_ne S.y₁_ne S.y₂_ne h₁ h₂

name: AclGeom.FiniteAction.exists_open_of_finite_locallyClosed_cover
statement:
private theorem exists_open_of_finite_locallyClosed_cover {X ι : Type*}
    [TopologicalSpace X] [IrreducibleSpace X] (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → Set X)
    (hF : ∀ i ∈ s, IsLocallyClosed (F i)) (hcover : ∀ x, ∃ i ∈ s, x ∈ F i) :
    ∃ i ∈ s, IsOpen (F i) ∧ (F i).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let C := s.image fun i ↦ closure (F i)
  have hc : ∀ Z ∈ C, IsClosed Z := by
    intro Z hZ
    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hZ
    exact isClosed_closure
  have hcov : Set.univ ⊆ ⋃₀ (C : Set (Set X)) := by
    intro x _
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := hcover x
    exact Set.mem_sUnion_of_mem (subset_closure hxi)
      (Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩)
  obtain ⟨Z, hZ, hall⟩ := isIrreducible_iff_sUnion_isClosed.1
    (IrreducibleSpace.isIrreducible_univ X) C hc hcov
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hZ
  have hcl : closure (F i) = Set.univ := Set.univ_subset_iff.1 hall
  obtain ⟨U, Z, hU, hZ, he⟩ := hF i hi
  have hZu : Z = Set.univ := by
    apply Set.univ_subset_iff.1
    rw [← hcl]
    apply closure_minimal _ hZ
    rw [he]
    exact Set.inter_subset_right
  refine ⟨i, hi, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [he, hZu, Set.inter_univ] using hU
  · rw [← closure_nonempty_iff, hcl]
    exact Set.univ_nonempty

name: AclGeom.FiniteAction.fixed_of_finite_locallyClosed_fibers
statement:
theorem fixed_of_finite_locallyClosed_fibers {Γ α : Type*} [Group Γ] [TopologicalSpace Γ]
    [IrreducibleSpace Γ] (ρ : Γ →* Equiv.Perm α) (L : Γ → Γ ≃ₜ Γ)
    (hL : ∀ g h, L g h = g * h) (P : α) {B : Set α} (hB : B.Finite)
    (horbit : ∀ g, ρ g P ∈ B) (hfiber : ∀ Q ∈ B, IsLocallyClosed {g : Γ | ρ g P = Q})
    (g : Γ) : ρ g P = P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨Q, _, hQopen, h, hh⟩ := exists_open_of_finite_locallyClosed_cover hB.toFinset
    (fun Q ↦ {x : Γ | ρ x P = Q})
    (fun Q hQ ↦ hfiber Q (hB.mem_toFinset.1 hQ))
    (fun x ↦ ⟨ρ x P, hB.mem_toFinset.2 (horbit x), rfl⟩)
  have hPopen : IsOpen {x : Γ | ρ x P = P} := by
    have he : (L h) ⁻¹' {x : Γ | ρ x P = Q} = {x : Γ | ρ x P = P} := by
      ext x
      change ρ (L h x) P = Q ↔ ρ x P = P
      rw [hL, ← hh, map_mul]
      change ρ h (ρ x P) = ρ h P ↔ ρ x P = P
      exact (ρ h).injective.eq_iff
    rw [← he]
    exact hQopen.preimage (L h).continuous
  have hpre : IsOpen ((L g) ⁻¹' {x : Γ | ρ x P = P}) :=
    hPopen.preimage (L g).continuous
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hgx⟩ := nonempty_preirreducible_inter hPopen hpre
    ⟨1, by simp⟩ ⟨g⁻¹, by simp [hL]⟩
  change ρ (L g x) P = P at hgx
  rw [hL, map_mul] at hgx
  change ρ g (ρ x P) = P at hgx
  rw [hx] at hgx
  exact hgx

name: CategoryTheory.ModObj.parameterAct_fst
statement: lemma parameterAct_fst (g : T ⟶ G) : parameterAct X g ≫ fst T X = fst T X
proof:
:=
  lift_fst _ _

name: CategoryTheory.ModObj.parameterAct_snd
statement:
lemma parameterAct_snd (g : T ⟶ G) :
    parameterAct X g ≫ snd T X = ((fst T X) ≫ g) • snd T X
proof:
:=
  lift_snd _ _

name: CategoryTheory.ModObj.parameterAct_one
statement: lemma parameterAct_one : parameterAct X (1 : T ⟶ G) = 𝟙 (T ⊗ X)
proof:
:= by
  change lift (fst T X) (((fst T X) ≫ (1 : T ⟶ G)) • snd T X) = 𝟙 (T ⊗ X)
  rw [MonObj.comp_one, _root_.one_smul, lift_fst_snd]

name: CategoryTheory.ModObj.parameterAct_mul
statement:
lemma parameterAct_mul (g h : T ⟶ G) :
    parameterAct X (g * h) = parameterAct X h ≫ parameterAct X g
proof:
:= by
  apply CartesianMonoidalCategory.hom_ext
  · simp only [Category.assoc, parameterAct_fst]
  · rw [Category.assoc, parameterAct_snd, parameterAct_snd, comp_smul,
      ← Category.assoc, parameterAct_fst, parameterAct_snd, MonObj.comp_mul, smul_smul]

name: AclGeom.IsAdditive.aeval_add
statement:
theorem IsAdditive.aeval_add [Infinite k] {P : Polynomial k} (hP : IsAdditive P)
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] (x y : A) :
    Polynomial.aeval (x + y) P = Polynomial.aeval x P + Polynomial.aeval y P
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Polynomial.aeval (X 0 + X 1) P : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) =
      Polynomial.aeval (X 0) P + Polynomial.aeval (X 1) P := by
    refine MvPolynomial.funext fun v ↦ ?_
    change MvPolynomial.aeval v _ = MvPolynomial.aeval v _
    simp only [map_add, ← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
    exact hP (v 0) (v 1)
  have h' := congrArg (MvPolynomial.aeval ![x, y]) h
  simpa only [map_add, ← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, MvPolynomial.aeval_X,
    Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.head_cons] using h'

name: AclGeom.prime_sub_C_of_split
statement:
private theorem prime_sub_C_of_split [IsAlgClosed k] {G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k}
    {P Q : Polynomial k} (hGp : Prime G)
    (hG : G = Polynomial.aeval (X 0) P + Polynomial.aeval (X 1) Q)
    (hP0 : P.coeff 0 = 0) (hP : P ≠ 0) (hPa : IsAdditive P) (e : k) :
    Prime (G - C e)
proof:
:= by
  have hdeg : 0 < P.degree := by
    by_contra h
    exact hP ((Polynomial.eq_C_of_degree_le_zero (not_lt.1 h)).trans (by rw [hP0, map_zero]))
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_root (P - Polynomial.C e)
    (by rw [Polynomial.degree_sub_C hdeg]; exact hdeg.ne')
  have hPa' : P.eval a = e := by
    rwa [Polynomial.IsRoot.def, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_C, sub_eq_zero] at ha
  have hneg : P.eval (-a) = -e := by
    have h := hPa a (-a)
    rw [add_neg_cancel, hPa.eval_zero, hPa'] at h
    linear_combination -h
  have htrans : translate ![-a, 0] G = G - C e := by
    rw [hG, map_add, ← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, ← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply,
      translate_X, translate_X]
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, map_zero, add_zero]
    rw [hPa.aeval_add, ← MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq,
      Polynomial.aeval_algebraMap_apply_eq_algebraMap_eval, hneg, map_neg,
      MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
    ring
  let T : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k :=
    AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom (translate ![-a, 0]) (translate (-![-a, 0]))
      (AlgHom.ext fun g ↦ by
        rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply]
        exact translate_translate_neg ![-a, 0] g)
      (AlgHom.ext fun g ↦ by
        rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply]
        exact translate_neg_translate ![-a, 0] g)
  rw [← htrans]
  exact (MulEquiv.prime_iff T).2 hGp

name: AclGeom.addcorr_of_four_le_trdeg
statement:
private theorem addcorr_of_four_le_trdeg [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (htr : (4 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k Ω) {x₁ x₂ x₃ y₁ y₂ y₃ : Ω}
    (hx : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x₁, x₂, x₃])
    (h₁ : racl k {x₁} = racl k {y₁}) (h₂ : racl k {x₂} = racl k {y₂})
    (h₃ : racl k {x₃} = racl k {y₃})
    (h₁₂ : racl k {x₁ + x₂} = racl k {y₁ + y₂}) (h₁₃ : racl k {x₁ + x₃} = racl k {y₁ + y₃}) :
    ∃ P Q : Polynomial k, IsAdditive P ∧ IsAdditive Q ∧ P ≠ 0 ∧ Q ≠ 0 ∧
      ∃ e₁ e₂ e₃ : k,
        Polynomial.aeval x₁ P + Polynomial.aeval y₁ Q = algebraMap k Ω e₁ ∧
        Polynomial.aeval x₂ P + Polynomial.aeval y₂ Q = algebraMap k Ω e₂ ∧
        Polynomial.aeval x₃ P + Polynomial.aeval y₃ Q = algebraMap k Ω e₃
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have mem : ∀ {u v : Ω}, racl k {u} = racl k {v} → v ∈ racl k {u} := fun h ↦ by
    rw [h]
    exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_singleton _)
  have fresh : ∀ S : Finset Ω, S.card ≤ 3 → ∃ z : Ω, z ∉ racl k (S : Set Ω) :=
    exists_notMem_racl_of_card_lt_trdeg (n := 3) (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) htr)
  
  let S₂ : AddCorrSetup k Ω :=
    { x₁ := x₁, y₁ := y₁, x₂ := x₂, y₂ := y₂
      indep := AlgebraicIndependent.pair_of_triple hx (i := 0) (j := 1) (by decide)
      y₁_mem := mem h₁, x₁_mem := mem h₁.symm, y₂_mem := mem h₂, x₂_mem := mem h₂.symm
      sum_mem := mem h₁₂, sum_mem' := mem h₁₂.symm }
  let S₃ : AddCorrSetup k Ω :=
    { x₁ := x₁, y₁ := y₁, x₂ := x₃, y₂ := y₃
      indep := AlgebraicIndependent.pair_zero_two hx
      y₁_mem := mem h₁, x₁_mem := mem h₁.symm, y₂_mem := mem h₃, x₂_mem := mem h₃.symm
      sum_mem := mem h₁₃, sum_mem' := mem h₁₃.symm }
  obtain ⟨s₂, hs₂⟩ := fresh {x₁, x₂} (Finset.card_le_two.trans (by norm_num))
  obtain ⟨t₂, ht₂⟩ := fresh {x₁, x₂, s₂} Finset.card_le_three
  obtain ⟨s₃, hs₃⟩ := fresh {x₁, x₃} (Finset.card_le_two.trans (by norm_num))
  obtain ⟨t₃, ht₃⟩ := fresh {x₁, x₃, s₃} Finset.card_le_three
  have hs₂' : s₂ ∉ racl k ({x₁, x₂} : Set Ω) := by simpa using hs₂
  have ht₂' : t₂ ∉ racl k ({x₁, x₂, s₂} : Set Ω) := by simpa using ht₂
  have hs₃' : s₃ ∉ racl k ({x₁, x₃} : Set Ω) := by simpa using hs₃
  have ht₃' : t₃ ∉ racl k ({x₁, x₃, s₃} : Set Ω) := by simpa using ht₃
  obtain ⟨G, P, Q, hGp, hG, hP0, -, hP, hQ, hPa, hQa, e₁, e₂, he₁, he₂⟩ :=
    S₂.exists_delta_gen_data (s := s₂) (s' := t₂) hs₂' ht₂'
  obtain ⟨G', P', Q', hGp', hG', hP0', -, hP', -, hPa', -, e₁', e₃, he₁', he₃⟩ :=
    S₃.exists_delta_gen_data (s := s₃) (s' := t₃) hs₃' ht₃'
  
  have hx₁ : Transcendental k x₁ := hx.transcendental 0
  obtain ⟨F, hFp, hF⟩ := exists_prime_span_idealOf k hx₁ (mem h₁)
  have assoc : ∀ (H : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (R S : Polynomial k) (e : k), Prime H →
      H = Polynomial.aeval (X 0) R + Polynomial.aeval (X 1) S → R.coeff 0 = 0 → R ≠ 0 →
      IsAdditive R → aeval ![x₁, y₁] H = algebraMap k Ω e → Associated F (H - C e) :=
    fun H R S e hHp hH hR0 hR hRa he ↦ by
      refine Prime.associated_of_dvd hFp (prime_sub_C_of_split hHp hH hR0 hR hRa e) ?_
      have hmem : H - C e ∈ idealOf k ![x₁, y₁] := by
        rw [mem_idealOf_iff, map_sub, he, aeval_C, sub_self]
      rw [hF, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hmem
      exact hmem
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := (assoc G P Q e₁ hGp hG hP0 hP hPa he₁).symm.trans
    (assoc G' P' Q' e₁' hGp' hG' hP0' hP' hPa' he₁')
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hur⟩ := MvPolynomial.isUnit_iff_eq_C_of_isReduced.1 u.isUnit
  
  have h3 := congrArg (aeval ![x₃, y₃]) hu
  rw [hur, map_mul, map_sub, map_sub, aeval_C, aeval_C, aeval_C,
    show aeval ![x₃, y₃] G' = algebraMap k Ω e₃ from he₃] at h3
  have hr0 : algebraMap k Ω r ≠ 0 := (map_ne_zero _).2 hr.ne_zero
  have he₃' : aeval ![x₃, y₃] G = algebraMap k Ω (e₁ + (e₃ - e₁') / r) := by
    rw [map_add, map_div₀, map_sub]
    field_simp
    linear_combination h3
  have split : ∀ {v w : Ω} {e : k}, aeval ![v, w] G = algebraMap k Ω e →
      Polynomial.aeval v P + Polynomial.aeval w Q = algebraMap k Ω e := fun h ↦ by
    rw [hG, map_add, ← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, ← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply,
      aeval_X, aeval_X] at h
    simpa using h
  exact ⟨P, Q, hPa, hQa, hP, hQ, e₁, e₂, _, split he₁, split he₂, split he₃'⟩

name: AclGeom.addcorr
statement:
theorem addcorr [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed Ω] {x₁ x₂ x₃ y₁ y₂ y₃ : Ω}
    (hx : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x₁, x₂, x₃])
    (h₁ : point k x₁ = point k y₁) (h₂ : point k x₂ = point k y₂)
    (h₃ : point k x₃ = point k y₃)
    (h₁₂ : point k (x₁ + x₂) = point k (y₁ + y₂))
    (h₁₃ : point k (x₁ + x₃) = point k (y₁ + y₃)) :
    ∃ P Q : Polynomial k, IsAdditive P ∧ IsAdditive Q ∧ P ≠ 0 ∧ Q ≠ 0 ∧
      ∃ d₁ d₂ d₃ : k,
        Polynomial.aeval y₁ Q = Polynomial.aeval x₁ P + algebraMap k Ω d₁ ∧
        Polynomial.aeval y₂ Q = Polynomial.aeval x₂ P + algebraMap k Ω d₂ ∧
        Polynomial.aeval y₃ Q = Polynomial.aeval x₃ P + algebraMap k Ω d₃ ∧
        Polynomial.aeval (y₁ + y₂) Q =
          Polynomial.aeval (x₁ + x₂) P + algebraMap k Ω (d₁ + d₂) ∧
        Polynomial.aeval (y₁ + y₃) Q =
          Polynomial.aeval (x₁ + x₃) P + algebraMap k Ω (d₁ + d₃)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  let ι : Ω →ₐ[k] FreshAmbient Ω := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k Ω (FreshAmbient Ω)
  have hι : Function.Injective ι := ι.toRingHom.injective
  have htr := four_le_trdeg_freshAmbient k Ω
  
  have hpt : ∀ {u v : Ω}, point k u = point k v → racl k {ι u} = racl k {ι v} :=
    fun {u v} h ↦ by
      simpa [Set.image_singleton] using
        algHom_racl_image_eq_of_racl_eq ι (congrArg Subtype.val h : racl k {u} = racl k {v})
  have hsum : ∀ {u v w z : Ω}, point k (u + v) = point k (w + z) →
      racl k {ι u + ι v} = racl k {ι w + ι z} := fun {u v w z} h ↦ by
    simpa only [map_add] using hpt h
  obtain ⟨P, Q, hPa, hQa, hP, hQ, e₁, e₂, e₃, he₁, he₂, he₃⟩ :=
    addcorr_of_four_le_trdeg htr (x₁ := ι x₁) (x₂ := ι x₂) (x₃ := ι x₃)
      (by
        convert hx.map' hι using 1
        funext i
        fin_cases i <;> rfl)
      (hpt h₁) (hpt h₂) (hpt h₃) (hsum h₁₂) (hsum h₁₃)
  
  have pull : ∀ {u v : Ω} {e : k},
      Polynomial.aeval (ι u) P + Polynomial.aeval (ι v) Q = algebraMap k (FreshAmbient Ω) e →
      Polynomial.aeval u P + Polynomial.aeval v Q = algebraMap k Ω e := fun h ↦ hι (by
    rw [map_add, ← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, ← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply,
      AlgHom.commutes]
    exact h)
  have he₁' := pull he₁
  have he₂' := pull he₂
  have he₃' := pull he₃
  refine ⟨-P, Q, fun a b ↦ ?_, hQa, neg_ne_zero.2 hP, hQ, e₁, e₂, e₃, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Polynomial.eval_neg, Polynomial.eval_neg, Polynomial.eval_neg, hPa a b, neg_add]
  · rw [map_neg]
    linear_combination he₁'
  · rw [map_neg]
    linear_combination he₂'
  · rw [map_neg]
    linear_combination he₃'
  · rw [hQa.aeval_add, map_neg, hPa.aeval_add, map_add]
    linear_combination he₁' + he₂'
  · rw [hQa.aeval_add, map_neg, hPa.aeval_add, map_add]
    linear_combination he₁' + he₃'

name: AclGeom.FiniteGaCover.exists_group_cover
statement:
theorem exists_group_cover
    (N : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim N.toAlgebraicGroup.carrier = 1)
    (β : N.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1))
    [IsFinite β.hom.hom.left] [Surjective β.hom.hom.left]
    (hinj : Function.Injective (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ N.toGroupScheme.X ↦
      q ≫ β.hom.hom))
    (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (α : (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).Hom N.toAlgebraicGroup),
      IsFinite α.hom.hom.left ∧ Surjective α.hom.hom.left ∧
      α.hom.hom ≫ β.hom.hom = relativeFrobenius k p n ∧
      ∀ (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra k C] (c : C),
        AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k c ≫ α.hom.hom ≫ β.hom.hom =
          AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (c ^ p ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  let L := (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X
  let NX := N.toGroupScheme.X
  have : IsAffineHom β.hom.hom.left := inferInstance
  have hLaff : IsAffine L.left := by
    change IsAffine (Spec (.of (AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1)))
    infer_instance
  have : IsAffine NX.left :=
    @isAffine_of_isAffineHom _ _ β.hom.hom.left inferInstance hLaff
  obtain ⟨n, a, hfinite, hsurj, hcomp, hformula⟩ :=
    exists_line_cover NX hdim β.hom.hom hinj p
  have hF : a ≫ β.hom.hom = relativeFrobenius k p n := hcomp
  have : IsIntegral L.left := by
    change IsIntegral (Spec (.of (AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1)))
    infer_instance
  have : IsIntegral (L ⊗ L).left := isIntegral_pullback_of_isAlgClosed L.hom L.hom
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType (L ⊗ L).hom := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (Limits.pullback.fst L.hom L.hom ≫ L.hom)
    infer_instance
  have ha : IsMonHom a := by
    constructor
    · apply hinj
      change (η[L] ≫ a) ≫ β.hom.hom = η[NX] ≫ β.hom.hom
      rw [Category.assoc, hF, IsMonHom.one_hom, IsMonHom.one_hom]
    · have he : (μ[L] ≫ a) ≫ β.hom.hom =
          ((a ⊗ₘ a) ≫ μ[NX]) ≫ β.hom.hom := by
        calc
          _ = μ[L] ≫ relativeFrobenius k p n := by rw [Category.assoc, hF]
          _ = (relativeFrobenius k p n ⊗ₘ relativeFrobenius k p n) ≫ μ[L] :=
            IsMonHom.mul_hom _
          _ = ((a ≫ β.hom.hom) ⊗ₘ (a ≫ β.hom.hom)) ≫ μ[L] := by rw [hF]
          _ = (a ⊗ₘ a) ≫ (β.hom.hom ⊗ₘ β.hom.hom) ≫ μ[L] := by
            rw [← MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_comp_tensorHom, Category.assoc]
          _ = _ := by rw [Category.assoc, IsMonHom.mul_hom]
      apply AdditiveRigidity.over_hom_ext_of_points
      intro q
      apply hinj
      change (q ≫ (μ[L] ≫ a)) ≫ β.hom.hom =
        (q ≫ ((a ⊗ₘ a) ≫ μ[NX])) ≫ β.hom.hom
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg (fun z ↦ q ≫ z) he
  let α : (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).Hom N.toAlgebraicGroup := Grp.homMk a
  exact ⟨n, α, hfinite, hsurj, hF, hformula⟩

name: AclGeom.SchemeAffineCurveCover.exists_curve_coordinate_cover
statement:
theorem exists_curve_coordinate_cover
    (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (hker : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
      ModObj.pointAct V q = 𝟙 V → q = 1)
    (hdimG : (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDim G.toAlgebraicGroup.carrier)
    (hdimV : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1) :
    ∃ t : V.left.functionField, Transcendental k t ∧
      IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set V.left.functionField) = ⊤ ∧
      ∃ Φ : (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) →* AffineTransformation k,
        Function.Injective Φ ∧
        (∀ q, (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V q).unop t =
          algebraMap k V.left.functionField ((Φ q).multiplier : k) * t +
            algebraMap k V.left.functionField (Φ q).shift) ∧
      ∃ f : G.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k),
        Function.Injective (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X ↦
          q ≫ f.hom.hom) ∧
        (∀ q, AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom) = Φ q) ∧
      ∃ (V₀ : Over (Spec (.of k))) (jV : V₀ ⟶ V)
        (x : V₀ ⟶ (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X)
        (gV : (Spec V.left.functionField).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ V₀),
        IsOpenImmersion jV.left ∧ Nonempty V₀.left ∧
        gV ≫ jV = SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter V ∧
        gV ≫ x = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k t ∧
      ∃ (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (i : D ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X ⊗ V)
        (s z : D ⟶ V₀), IsOpenImmersion i.left ∧ Nonempty D.left ∧
        s ≫ jV = i ≫ snd G.toGroupScheme.X V ∧
        z ≫ jV = i ≫ γ[G.toGroupScheme.X, V] ∧
        z ≫ x = lift (i ≫ fst G.toGroupScheme.X V ≫ f.hom.hom) (s ≫ x) ≫
          AffineSchemeAction.smul k ∧
      ∃ (V₁ T₁ : Over (Spec (.of k))) (j₁ : V₁ ⟶ V₀)
        (jLine : T₁ ⟶ (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X)
        (eV : V₁ ≅ T₁) (g₁ : (Spec V.left.functionField).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ V₁),
        IsOpenImmersion j₁.left ∧ IsOpenImmersion jLine.left ∧
        Nonempty V₁.left ∧ Nonempty T₁.left ∧
        IsFinite eV.hom.left ∧ Surjective eV.hom.left ∧
        j₁ ≫ x = eV.hom ≫ jLine ∧ g₁ ≫ j₁ = gV ∧
      ∃ (D₁ : Over (Spec (.of k))) (i₁ : D₁ ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X ⊗ V)
        (s₁ z₁ : D₁ ⟶ V₁), IsOpenImmersion i₁.left ∧ Nonempty D₁.left ∧
        s₁ ≫ j₁ ≫ jV = i₁ ≫ snd G.toGroupScheme.X V ∧
        z₁ ≫ j₁ ≫ jV = i₁ ≫ γ[G.toGroupScheme.X, V] ∧
        z₁ ≫ j₁ ≫ x = lift (i₁ ≫ fst G.toGroupScheme.X V ≫ f.hom.hom)
          (s₁ ≫ j₁ ≫ x) ≫ AffineSchemeAction.smul k ∧
      ∃ (U T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (jU : U ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X)
        (jT : T ⟶ (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k).toGroupScheme.X) (π : U ⟶ T),
        IsOpenImmersion jU.left ∧ IsOpenImmersion jT.left ∧
        Nonempty U.left ∧ Nonempty T.left ∧ IsFinite π.left ∧ Surjective π.left ∧
        jU ≫ f.hom.hom = π ≫ jT ∧
          ∃ (W : Over (Spec (.of k))) (hI : IsIntegral W.left) (hA : IsAffine W.left)
            (j : W ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) (_ : IsOpenImmersion j.left),
            letI
proof:
:= hI
            letI := hA
            letI := sectionsAlgebra W
            let A : Type u := Γ(W.left, ⊤)
            let C := FractionRing A
            let F : Type u := V.left.functionField
            let E := FractionRing (C ⊗[k] F)
            let g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X :=
              (sectionsSpecIso W).inv ≫ j
            let evC : A →ₐ[k] C := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A C
            let τ := sectionsTensorAut V ((algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom evC).op ≫ g)
            let T := algebraMap (C ⊗[k] F) E (1 ⊗ₜ[k] t)
            Algebra.FiniteType k A ∧
              ∃ d a b : A, d ≠ 0 ∧ a ≠ 0 ∧
                FiniteDimensional
                  (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({evC a / evC d, evC b / evC d} : Set C)) C ∧
                IsTranscendenceBasis k (![evC a / evC d, evC b / evC d] : Fin 2 → C) ∧
                (∀ (φ : A →ₐ[k] k), φ d ≠ 0 →
                  (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V
                    ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
                      (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)).unop t =
                        algebraMap k F (φ a / φ d) * t + algebraMap k F (φ b / φ d)) ∧
                ∃ hCF : IsDomain (C ⊗[k] F),
                  letI := hCF
                  ∃ hCR : IsDomain (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)),
                    letI := hCR
                    ∃ (σ : E ≃ₐ[C] E) (e : E ≃ₐ[C] FractionRing (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤))),
                      (∀ (c : C) (r : Γ(V.left, ⊤)),
                        e (algebraMap (C ⊗[k] F) E
                          (c ⊗ₜ[k] V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤
                            (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint _, trivial⟩⟩) r)) =
                              algebraMap (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)) _ (c ⊗ₜ[k] r)) ∧
                      (∀ x, e (σ x) = IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv τ (e x)) ∧
                      σ T = algebraMap C E (evC a / evC d) * T +
                        algebraMap C E (evC b / evC d) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htop, Φ, hΦinj, hΦ, f, hfinj, hpoint,
    V₀, jV, x, gV, hjV, hV₀, hgjV, hgx, D, i, s, z, hi, hD, hsj, hzj, hdiagram,
    U, T, jU, jT, π, hjU, hjT, hU, hT, hπfin, hπsurj, hπ,
    W, hI, hA, j, hOpen, hft, d, a, b, hd, ha, hfinite, hbasis,
    hformula, hCF, hCR, σ, e, he, hcompare, hgeneric⟩ :=
    SchemeAffineCurveDiagram.exists_curve_action_diagram G V hker hdimG hdimV
  have := hjV
  obtain ⟨V₁, T₁, j₁, jLine, eV, g₁, hj₁, hjLine, hV₁, hT₁, hsq, hg₁⟩ :=
    CurveCoordinateCover.exists_coordinate_restriction_iso V V₀ jV x t ht htop gV hgjV hgx
  have := hj₁
  have : IsOpenImmersion (j₁ ≫ jV).left := by
    change IsOpenImmersion (j₁.left ≫ jV.left)
    infer_instance
  have hgj₁ : g₁ ≫ (j₁ ≫ jV) = SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter V := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, hg₁, hgjV]
  have hgx₁ : g₁ ≫ (j₁ ≫ x) = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k t := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, hg₁, hgx]
  obtain ⟨D₁, i₁, s₁, z₁, hi₁, hD₁, hsj₁, hzj₁, hdiagram₁⟩ :=
    CurveAffineCoordinate.exists_joint_diagram_on_coordinate G V t V₁ (j₁ ≫ jV)
      (j₁ ≫ x) g₁ hgj₁ hgx₁ f.hom.hom (fun q ↦ by simpa only [hpoint] using hΦ q)
  have : IsIso eV.hom.left := ActionFunctionField.isIso_hom_left eV
  have hfinV : IsFinite eV.hom.left := inferInstance
  have hsurjV : Surjective eV.hom.left := inferInstance
  exact ⟨t, ht, htop, Φ, hΦinj, hΦ, f, hfinj, hpoint,
    V₀, jV, x, gV, hjV, hV₀, hgjV, hgx, D, i, s, z, hi, hD, hsj, hzj, hdiagram,
    V₁, T₁, j₁, jLine, eV, g₁, hj₁, hjLine, hV₁, hT₁, hfinV, hsurjV, hsq, hg₁,
    D₁, i₁, s₁, z₁, hi₁, hD₁, hsj₁, hzj₁, hdiagram₁,
    U, T, jU, jT, π, hjU, hjT, hU, hT, hπfin, hπsurj, hπ,
    W, hI, hA, j, hOpen, hft, d, a, b, hd, ha, hfinite, hbasis, hformula,
    hCF, hCR, σ, e, he, hcompare, hgeneric⟩

name: AclGeom.GroupFinite.universallyInjective_of_point_injective
statement:
theorem universallyInjective_of_point_injective
    {X Y : Over (Spec (.of k))} [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f.left]
    (hinj : Function.Injective
      (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ X ↦ q ≫ f)) :
    UniversallyInjective f.left
proof:
:= by
  let W : Over (Spec (.of k)) := Over.mk (pullback.fst f.left f.left ≫ X.hom)
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType W.hom := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback.fst f.left f.left ≫ X.hom)
    infer_instance
  have : JacobsonSpace W.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.jacobsonSpace W.hom
  let p1 : W ⟶ X := Over.homMk (pullback.fst f.left f.left) rfl
  let p2 : W ⟶ X := Over.homMk (pullback.snd f.left f.left) (by
    calc
      _ = pullback.snd f.left f.left ≫ f.left ≫ Y.hom := by rw [Over.w f]
      _ = pullback.fst f.left f.left ≫ f.left ≫ Y.hom := by
        rw [← Category.assoc, ← pullback.condition, Category.assoc]
      _ = pullback.fst f.left f.left ≫ X.hom := by rw [Over.w f]
      _ = _ := rfl)
  have hfac : p1 ≫ f = p2 ≫ f := Over.OverMorphism.ext pullback.condition
  have hclosed (w : W.left) (hw : IsClosed {w}) :
      w ∈ Set.range (pullback.diagonal f.left) := by
    let p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ W :=
      Over.homMk (pointOfClosedPoint W.hom w hw) (pointOfClosedPoint_comp W.hom w hw)
    have heq : p ≫ p1 = p ≫ p2 := hinj (by
      change (p ≫ p1) ≫ f = (p ≫ p2) ≫ f
      rw [Category.assoc, hfac, ← Category.assoc])
    have hdiag : (p ≫ p1).left ≫ pullback.diagonal f.left = p.left := by
      apply pullback.hom_ext
      · rw [Category.assoc, pullback.diagonal_fst, Category.comp_id]
        rfl
      · rw [Category.assoc, pullback.diagonal_snd, Category.comp_id]
        exact congrArg (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ X ↦ q.left) heq
    refine ⟨(p ≫ p1).left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k), ?_⟩
    have hh := congrArg (fun q ↦ q (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) hdiag
    exact hh.trans (pointOfClosedPoint_apply W.hom w hw _)
  have hc : closure (closedPoints W.left) ⊆ Set.range (pullback.diagonal f.left) :=
    closure_minimal (fun w hw ↦ hclosed w hw)
      (pullback.diagonal f.left).isClosedMap.isClosed_range
  have hd : closure (closedPoints W.left) = Set.univ := by
    simpa only [Set.univ_inter, closure_univ] using
      closure_inter_closedPoints (isClosed_univ : IsClosed (Set.univ : Set W.left))
  rw [hd] at hc
  apply (UniversallyInjective.iff_diagonal f.left).mpr
  exact ⟨fun w ↦ hc (Set.mem_univ w)⟩

name: AclGeom.GroupFinite.isHomeomorph_of_finite_surjective_point_injective
statement:
theorem isHomeomorph_of_finite_surjective_point_injective
    {X Y : Over (Spec (.of k))} [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f.left] [Surjective f.left]
    (hinj : Function.Injective
      (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ X ↦ q ≫ f)) :
    IsHomeomorph f.left
proof:
:= by
  have := universallyInjective_of_point_injective f hinj
  exact isHomeomorph_iff_continuous_isClosedMap_bijective.mpr
    ⟨f.left.continuous, f.left.isClosedMap, f.left.injective, f.left.surjective⟩

name: AclGeom.PresentedFamilyGroupoidOf.fourArrow_right_cancellation
statement:
theorem fourArrow_right_cancellation
    {s e a b u sA uB c : P}
    (hse : R s e u) (hsa : R sA a u)
    (hsb : R s b uB) (hsc : R sA c uB) :
    PresentedFamilyGroupoidOf.s R c =
      groupoidDifferenceProduct
        (PresentedFamilyGroupoidOf.s R e)
        (PresentedFamilyGroupoidOf.s R a)
        (PresentedFamilyGroupoidOf.s R b)
proof:
:= by
  let ts := PresentedFamilyGroupoidOf.t R s
  let tsA := PresentedFamilyGroupoidOf.t R sA
  let se := PresentedFamilyGroupoidOf.s R e
  let sa := PresentedFamilyGroupoidOf.s R a
  let sb := PresentedFamilyGroupoidOf.s R b
  let sc := PresentedFamilyGroupoidOf.s R c
  let uu := PresentedFamilyGroupoidOf.u R u
  let uuB := PresentedFamilyGroupoidOf.u R uB
  have hse' : ts ≫ se = uu := t_comp_s_eq_u R hse
  have hsa' : tsA ≫ sa = uu := t_comp_s_eq_u R hsa
  have hsb' : ts ≫ sb = uuB := t_comp_s_eq_u R hsb
  have hsc' : tsA ≫ sc = uuB := t_comp_s_eq_u R hsc
  change sc = sa ≫ inv se ≫ sb
  apply (cancel_epi tsA).1
  rw [hsc', ← Category.assoc, hsa', ← hse']
  simpa [Category.assoc] using hsb'.symm

name: AclGeom.PresentedFamilyGroupoid.fourArrow_cancellation
statement:
theorem fourArrow_cancellation {s a b e : Ω}
    (D : M.FourArrowDifferenceDiagram s a b e) :
    PresentedFamilyGroupoid.t M D.c =
      groupoidDifferenceProduct
        (PresentedFamilyGroupoid.t M e)
        (PresentedFamilyGroupoid.t M b)
        (PresentedFamilyGroupoid.t M a)
proof:
:= by
  let te := PresentedFamilyGroupoid.t M e
  let ta := PresentedFamilyGroupoid.t M a
  let tb := PresentedFamilyGroupoid.t M b
  let tc := PresentedFamilyGroupoid.t M D.c
  let ss := PresentedFamilyGroupoid.s M s
  let ssA := PresentedFamilyGroupoid.s M D.sA
  let uu := PresentedFamilyGroupoid.u M D.u
  let uuB := PresentedFamilyGroupoid.u M D.uB
  have hse : te ≫ ss = uu := t_comp_s_eq_u M D.se_u
  have hsa : ta ≫ ssA = uu := t_comp_s_eq_u M D.sA_a_u
  have hsb : tb ≫ ss = uuB := t_comp_s_eq_u M D.s_b_uB
  have hsc : tc ≫ ssA = uuB := t_comp_s_eq_u M D.sA_c_uB
  apply (cancel_mono ssA).1
  simp only [groupoidDifferenceProduct, Category.assoc]
  rw [hsc, hsa, ← hse]
  change uuB = tb ≫ inv te ≫ te ≫ ss
  simpa using hsb.symm

name: AclGeom.PresentedFamilyGroupoid.fourArrow_cancellation_swapped
statement:
theorem fourArrow_cancellation_swapped {s a b e : Ω}
    (D : M.FourArrowDifferenceDiagram s b a e) :
    PresentedFamilyGroupoid.t M D.c =
      groupoidDifferenceProduct
        (PresentedFamilyGroupoid.t M e)
        (PresentedFamilyGroupoid.t M a)
        (PresentedFamilyGroupoid.t M b)
proof:
:=
  fourArrow_cancellation M D

name: AclGeom.GroupScheme.comp_leftMul
statement:
theorem comp_leftMul {X : Over (Spec (.of k))} (p : X ⟶ G)
    (g : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G) : p ≫ leftMul G g = (toUnit X ≫ g) * p
proof:
:= by
  change p ≫ ((toUnit G ≫ g) * 𝟙 G) = _
  rw [MonObj.comp_mul, ← Category.assoc, comp_toUnit, Category.comp_id]

name: AclGeom.GroupScheme.comp_rightMul

proof:

  change p ≫ (𝟙 G * (toUnit G ≫ g)) = _

name: AclGeom.GroupScheme.point_comp_rightMul

name: AclGeom.GroupScheme.leftMul_comp_leftMul
statement:
theorem leftMul_comp_leftMul (g h : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G) :
    leftMul G g ≫ leftMul G h = leftMul G (h * g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_leftMul]
  change (toUnit G ≫ h) * ((toUnit G ≫ g) * 𝟙 G) = (toUnit G ≫ (h * g)) * 𝟙 G
  rw [← _root_.mul_assoc, MonObj.comp_mul]

name: AclGeom.GroupScheme.rightMul_comp_rightMul
statement:
theorem rightMul_comp_rightMul (g h : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G) :
    rightMul G g ≫ rightMul G h = rightMul G (g * h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_rightMul]
  change (𝟙 G * (toUnit G ≫ g)) * (toUnit G ≫ h) = 𝟙 G * (toUnit G ≫ (g * h))
  rw [_root_.mul_assoc, MonObj.comp_mul]

name: AclGeom.GroupScheme.rightMul_one

name: AclGeom.SchemeGenericTranslate.exists_effective_sectionsTensorAut
statement:
theorem exists_effective_sectionsTensorAut
    {G : Over (Spec (.of k))} [GrpObj G]
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsAffine V.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G V]
    {A C : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [Field C] [Algebra k C]
    (g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G) (φ : A →ₐ[k] C) :
    ∃ s : Finset Γ(V.left, ⊤), Algebra.adjoin k (s : Set Γ(V.left, ⊤)) = ⊤ ∧
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → Γ(V.left, ⊤)) (cA : Bool → s → Fin n → A),
        LinearIndependent k v ∧
        (∀ (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] (ψ : A →ₐ[k] B) (e : Bool) (i : s),
          let f : (Spec (.of B)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶
              (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) :=
            (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom ψ).op
          sectionsTensorAut V (f ≫ (if e then g else g⁻¹))
              (1 ⊗ₜ[k] (i : Γ(V.left, ⊤))) = ∑ j, ψ (cA e i j) ⊗ₜ[k] v j) ∧
        ∃ (C0 : IntermediateField k C) (c0 : Bool → s → Fin n → C0),
          C0 = IntermediateField.adjoin k
            (Set.range fun p : Bool × s × Fin n ↦ φ (cA p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)) ∧
          Algebra.EssFiniteType k C0 ∧
          IntermediateField.adjoin k
            (Set.range fun p : Bool × s × Fin n ↦ c0 p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) = ⊤ ∧
          (∀ e i j, (c0 e i j : C) = φ (cA e i j)) ∧
          ∃ τ : C0 ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤) ≃ₐ[C0] C0 ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤),
            (∀ x, Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId C0 C)
                (AlgHom.id k Γ(V.left, ⊤)) (τ x) =
              sectionsTensorAut V ((algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)
                (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId C0 C)
                  (AlgHom.id k Γ(V.left, ⊤)) x)) ∧
            ∀ (e : Bool) (i : s),
              (if e then τ else τ.symm) (1 ⊗ₜ[k] (i : Γ(V.left, ⊤))) =
                ∑ j, c0 e i j ⊗ₜ[k] v j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, n, v, cA, hv, hc⟩ := exists_generating_sectionsCoefficients V g
  refine ⟨s, hs, n, v, cA, hv, hc, ?_⟩
  let f : (Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶
      (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) :=
    (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op
  let σ : C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤) ≃ₐ[C] C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤) :=
    sectionsTensorAut V (f ≫ g)
  apply TensorCoefficientDescent.exists_effective_tensorAut σ s hs v (fun e i j ↦ φ (cA e i j))
  intro e i
  have h := hc C φ e i
  cases e with
  | false =>
    change sectionsTensorAut V (f ≫ g⁻¹) (1 ⊗ₜ[k] (i : Γ(V.left, ⊤))) = _ at h
    rw [GrpObj.comp_inv] at h
    have hinv : sectionsTensorAut V (f ≫ g)⁻¹ = σ.symm := by
      ext x
      rfl
    rw [hinv] at h
    exact h
  | true => exact h

name: AclGeom.SchemeGenericTranslate.exists_effective_functionFieldAut
statement:
theorem exists_effective_functionFieldAut [IsAlgClosed k]
    {G : Over (Spec (.of k))} [GrpObj G]
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G V]
    {A C : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [Field C] [Algebra k C]
    (g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G) (φ : A →ₐ[k] C) :
    let f_eval : (Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶
        (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k))
proof:
:=
      (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op
    let σC : C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤) ≃ₐ[C] C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤) :=
      sectionsTensorAut V (f_eval ≫ g)
    ∃ s : Finset Γ(V.left, ⊤), Algebra.adjoin k (s : Set Γ(V.left, ⊤)) = ⊤ ∧
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → Γ(V.left, ⊤)) (cA : Bool → s → Fin n → A),
        LinearIndependent k v ∧
        (∀ (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] (ψ : A →ₐ[k] B) (e : Bool) (i : s),
          let f : (Spec (.of B)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶
              (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) :=
            (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom ψ).op
          sectionsTensorAut V (f ≫ (if e then g else g⁻¹))
              (1 ⊗ₜ[k] (i : Γ(V.left, ⊤))) = ∑ j, ψ (cA e i j) ⊗ₜ[k] v j) ∧
        ∃ (C0 : IntermediateField k C) (c0 : Bool → s → Fin n → C0),
          C0 = IntermediateField.adjoin k
            (Set.range fun p : Bool × s × Fin n ↦ φ (cA p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)) ∧
          Algebra.EssFiniteType k C0 ∧
          IntermediateField.adjoin k
            (Set.range fun p : Bool × s × Fin n ↦ c0 p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) = ⊤ ∧
          (∀ e i j, (c0 e i j : C) = φ (cA e i j)) ∧
          ∃ τ : C0 ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤) ≃ₐ[C0] C0 ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤),
            (∀ x, Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId C0 C)
                (AlgHom.id k Γ(V.left, ⊤)) (τ x) =
              σC
                (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId C0 C)
                  (AlgHom.id k Γ(V.left, ⊤)) x)) ∧
            (∀ (e : Bool) (i : s),
              (if e then τ else τ.symm) (1 ⊗ₜ[k] (i : Γ(V.left, ⊤))) =
                ∑ j, c0 e i j ⊗ₜ[k] v j) ∧
            ∃ (h0 : IsDomain (C0 ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)))
              (hC : IsDomain (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)))
              (hF : IsDomain (C0 ⊗[k] V.left.functionField)),
            letI := h0
            letI := hC
            letI := hF
            ∃ (τF : FractionRing (C0 ⊗[k] V.left.functionField) ≃ₐ[C0]
                FractionRing (C0 ⊗[k] V.left.functionField))
              (e0 : FractionRing (C0 ⊗[k] V.left.functionField) ≃ₐ[C0]
                FractionRing (C0 ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)))
              (J : FractionRing (C0 ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)) →ₐ[C0]
                FractionRing (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤))),
              Function.Injective (coefficientVariationLinear (k := k) τF) ∧
              Function.Injective J ∧
              (∀ (c : C0) (r : Γ(V.left, ⊤)),
                e0 (algebraMap (C0 ⊗[k] V.left.functionField) _
                  (c ⊗ₜ[k] V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤
                    (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint V.left, trivial⟩⟩) r)) =
                  algebraMap (C0 ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)) _ (c ⊗ₜ[k] r)) ∧
              (∀ x, J (algebraMap (C0 ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)) _ x) =
                algebraMap (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)) _
                  (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId C0 C)
                    (AlgHom.id k Γ(V.left, ⊤)) x)) ∧
              (∀ x, J (e0 (τF x)) =
                (IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv σC :
                    FractionRing (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)) ≃ₐ[C]
                      FractionRing (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤))) (J (e0 x))) ∧
              ∀ (e : Bool) (i : s),
                (if e then τF else τF.symm)
                    (algebraMap (C0 ⊗[k] V.left.functionField) _
                      (1 ⊗ₜ[k] V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤
                        (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint V.left, trivial⟩⟩) (i : Γ(V.left, ⊤)))) =
                  ∑ j, algebraMap (C0 ⊗[k] V.left.functionField) _
                    (c0 e i j ⊗ₜ[k] V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤
                      (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint V.left, trivial⟩⟩) (v j)) := by
  dsimp only
  obtain ⟨s, hs, n, v, cA, hv, hcA, C0, c0, hC0, hfg, hgen, hcoe, τ, hτ, hmat⟩ :=
    exists_effective_sectionsTensorAut V g φ
  refine ⟨s, hs, n, v, cA, hv, hcA, C0, c0, hC0, hfg, hgen, hcoe, τ, hτ, hmat, ?_⟩
  have : IsDomain (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)) := isDomain_tensor_sections C V
  let f : (Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶
      (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) :=
    (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op
  let σ : C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤) ≃ₐ[C] C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤) :=
    sectionsTensorAut V (f ≫ g)
  obtain ⟨h0, J, τR, hJinj, hJ, hτR, hcomm⟩ :=
    TensorCoefficientDescent.exists_fractionTensorAut_comparison C0 τ σ hτ
  have := h0
  obtain ⟨e0, he0⟩ := exists_tensorSections_functionFieldEquiv C0 V
  let τF := e0.trans (τR.trans e0.symm)
  have hconj (e : Bool) (x : FractionRing (C0 ⊗[k] V.left.functionField)) :
      e0 ((if e then τF else τF.symm) x) = (if e then τR else τR.symm) (e0 x) := by
    cases e with
    | false =>
      change e0 (e0.symm (τR.symm (e0 x))) = _
      exact e0.apply_symm_apply _
    | true =>
      change e0 (e0.symm (τR (e0 x))) = _
      exact e0.apply_symm_apply _
  have hτRinv (x : C0 ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)) :
      τR.symm (algebraMap (C0 ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)) _ x) =
        algebraMap (C0 ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)) _ (τ.symm x) := by
    apply τR.injective
    rw [τR.apply_symm_apply, hτR, τ.apply_symm_apply]
  have hmatF : ∀ (e : Bool) (i : s),
      (if e then τF else τF.symm)
          (algebraMap (C0 ⊗[k] V.left.functionField) _
            (1 ⊗ₜ[k] V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤
              (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint V.left, trivial⟩⟩) (i : Γ(V.left, ⊤)))) =
        ∑ j, algebraMap (C0 ⊗[k] V.left.functionField) _
          (c0 e i j ⊗ₜ[k] V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤
            (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint V.left, trivial⟩⟩) (v j)) := by
    intro e i
    apply e0.injective
    rw [hconj, he0]
    simp only [map_sum, he0]
    cases e with
    | false =>
      change τR.symm (algebraMap (C0 ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)) _
        (1 ⊗ₜ[k] (i : Γ(V.left, ⊤)))) = _
      rw [hτRinv]
      simpa only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, map_sum] using
        congrArg (algebraMap (C0 ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤))
          (FractionRing (C0 ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)))) (hmat false i)
    | true =>
      change τR (algebraMap (C0 ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)) _
        (1 ⊗ₜ[k] (i : Γ(V.left, ⊤)))) = _
      rw [hτR]
      simpa only [↓reduceIte, map_sum] using
        congrArg (algebraMap (C0 ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤))
          (FractionRing (C0 ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)))) (hmat true i)
  have : Nonempty (⊤ : V.left.Opens) := ⟨⟨genericPoint V.left, trivial⟩⟩
  have : IsFractionRing Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen V.left ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top V.left)
  have : IsScalarTower k Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField :=
    sections_functionField_isScalarTower V
  let fV : Γ(V.left, ⊤) →ₐ[k] V.left.functionField :=
    IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField
  have hvF : LinearIndependent k (fun j ↦
      V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤ (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint V.left, trivial⟩⟩) (v j)) :=
    hv.map' fV.toLinearMap (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr
      (IsFractionRing.injective Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField))
  have hF : IsDomain (C0 ⊗[k] V.left.functionField) :=
    isDomain_tensorProduct_of_isAlgClosed
  have hfaithful : Function.Injective (coefficientVariationLinear (k := k) τF) := by
    exact coefficientVariationLinear_injective_of_generating_coefficients τF
      (fun i : s ↦ V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤
        (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint V.left, trivial⟩⟩) (i : Γ(V.left, ⊤)))
      (fun j ↦ V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤
        (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint V.left, trivial⟩⟩) (v j)) hvF c0 hgen hmatF
  refine ⟨h0, inferInstance, hF, τF, e0, J, hfaithful, hJinj, he0, hJ, ?_, hmatF⟩
  intro x
  rw [show e0 (τF x) = τR (e0 x) from hconj true x]
  exact hcomm (e0 x)

name: AclGeom.CurvePointsPlaces.closedPointEquivPlace_action
statement:
theorem closedPointEquivPlace_action
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left] [IsProper X.hom]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1)
    (hnormal : ∀ x : X.left, IsIntegrallyClosed (X.left.presheaf.stalk x))
    (G : AlgebraicGroup k) [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X X]
    (g : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X)
    (x : {x : X.left // IsClosed ({x} : Set X.left)}) :
    closedPointEquivPlace X hdim hnormal (mapClosedPoint (ModObj.pointAut X g) x) =
      SchemePlaceAction.placeAction G X g (closedPointEquivPlace X hdim hnormal x)
proof:
:= by
  exact (closedPointPlace_comap X hdim hnormal (ModObj.pointAut X g) x).symm.trans
    (SchemePlaceAction.placeAction_apply G X g (closedPointPlace X hdim hnormal x)).symm

name: AclGeom.CurvePointsPlaces.exists_point_place_model
statement:
theorem exists_point_place_model
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left] [IsProper X.hom]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1)
    (hnormal : ∀ x : X.left, IsIntegrallyClosed (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    IsFunctionFieldOneVar k X.left.functionField ∧
    ∃ e : {x : X.left // IsClosed ({x} : Set X.left)} ≃ Place k X.left.functionField,
      (∀ (x : {x : X.left // IsClosed ({x} : Set X.left)}) (z : X.left.functionField),
        z ∈ (e x).val ↔ ∃ r : X.left.presheaf.stalk x.val,
          algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x.val) X.left.functionField r = z) ∧
      (∀ x : {x : X.left // IsClosed ({x} : Set X.left)},
        ∃ L : (X.left.presheaf.stalk x.val) ≃+* (e x).val,
          ∀ r : X.left.presheaf.stalk x.val,
            (L r : X.left.functionField) =
              algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x.val) X.left.functionField r) ∧
      (∀ P : Place k X.left.functionField, (e.symm P).val = placeCenter X P) ∧
      (∀ (a : X ≅ X) (x : {x : X.left // IsClosed ({x} : Set X.left)}),
        e (mapClosedPoint a x) = (e x).comap (ActionFunctionField.algEquivOfIso a)) ∧
      ∀ (G : AlgebraicGroup k) [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X X]
        (g : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X)
        (x : {x : X.left // IsClosed ({x} : Set X.left)}),
        e (mapClosedPoint (ModObj.pointAut X g) x) = SchemePlaceAction.placeAction G X g (e x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨scheme_functionField_isFunctionFieldOneVar k X hdim,
    closedPointEquivPlace X hdim hnormal, mem_closedPointEquivPlace X hdim hnormal,
    ?_, closedPointEquivPlace_symm_val X hdim hnormal, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    exact ⟨closedPointStalkEquiv X hdim hnormal x, coe_closedPointStalkEquiv X hdim hnormal x⟩
  · intro a x
    exact (closedPointPlace_comap X hdim hnormal a x).symm
  · intro G _ g x
    exact closedPointEquivPlace_action X hdim hnormal G g x

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.CompositionTriangle.sourceExtension_left_trans_right
statement:
theorem sourceExtension_left_trans_right
    (L : IntermediateField X (AlgebraicClosure X)) :
    (T.sourceExtensionLeftEquiv L).trans
        (T.sourceExtensionRightEquiv L) =
      T.sourceExtensionDirectEquiv L
proof:
:= by
  apply RingEquiv.ext
  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  rfl

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.CompositionTriangle.sourceExtensionLeftEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourceExtensionLeftEquiv_algebraMap
    (L : IntermediateField X (AlgebraicClosure X)) (x : X) :
    T.sourceExtensionLeftEquiv L (algebraMap X (↥L) x) =
      algebraMap Y (↥(T.sourceExtensionMiddleField L)) (T.left x)
proof:
:= by
  exact (DFunLike.congr_fun
    (T.sourceExtensionLeftTransport.mapFieldEquiv_commutes L) x).symm

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.CompositionTriangle.sourceExtension_left_comp_of_left_comp
statement:
theorem sourceExtension_left_comp_of_left_comp
    {W : Type u} [Semiring W]
    (L : IntermediateField X (AlgebraicClosure X))
    (source : W →+* X) (middle : W →+* Y)
    (h : T.left.toRingHom.comp source = middle) :
    (T.sourceExtension L).left.toRingHom.comp
        ((algebraMap X (↥L)).comp source) =
      (T.sourceExtensionMiddleRingHom L).comp middle
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro x
  change T.sourceExtensionLeftEquiv L
      (algebraMap X (↥L) (source x)) =
    algebraMap Y (↥(T.sourceExtensionMiddleField L)) (middle x)
  rw [T.sourceExtensionLeftEquiv_algebraMap]
  exact congrArg (algebraMap Y (↥(T.sourceExtensionMiddleField L)))
    (DFunLike.congr_fun h x)

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.CompositionTriangle.sourceExtensionRightEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourceExtensionRightEquiv_algebraMap
    (L : IntermediateField X (AlgebraicClosure X)) (y : Y) :
    T.sourceExtensionRightEquiv L
        (algebraMap Y (↥(T.sourceExtensionMiddleField L)) y) =
      algebraMap Z (↥(T.sourceExtensionTargetField L)) (T.right y)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change T.sourceExtensionRightTransport.closureEquiv
      (algebraMap Y (AlgebraicClosure Y) y) =
    algebraMap Z (AlgebraicClosure Z) (T.right y)
  exact T.sourceExtensionRightTransport.commutes_apply y

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.CompositionTriangle.sourceExtensionRightEquiv_comp_middleRingHom
statement:
theorem sourceExtensionRightEquiv_comp_middleRingHom
    (L : IntermediateField X (AlgebraicClosure X)) :
    (T.sourceExtensionRightEquiv L).toRingHom.comp
        (T.sourceExtensionMiddleRingHom L) =
      (T.sourceExtensionTargetRingHom L).comp T.right.toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  exact congrArg Subtype.val
    (T.sourceExtensionRightEquiv_algebraMap L y)

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.CompositionTriangle.sourceExtensionDirectEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourceExtensionDirectEquiv_algebraMap
    (L : IntermediateField X (AlgebraicClosure X)) (x : X) :
    T.sourceExtensionDirectEquiv L (algebraMap X (↥L) x) =
      algebraMap Z (↥(T.sourceExtensionTargetField L)) (T.direct x)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change ((T.sourceExtensionLeftTransport).trans
      T.sourceExtensionRightTransport).closureEquiv
        (algebraMap X (AlgebraicClosure X) x) =
    algebraMap Z (AlgebraicClosure Z) (T.direct x)
  rw [← DFunLike.congr_fun T.composition x]
  exact ((T.sourceExtensionLeftTransport).trans
    T.sourceExtensionRightTransport).commutes_apply x

name: AclGeom.AffineGroupScheme.comul_dilation
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comul_dilation : comul k (dilationUnit k) =
    (dilationUnit k : CoordinateRing k) ⊗ₜ[k] (dilationUnit k : CoordinateRing k)
proof:
:= by
  change eval k _ _ (dilationUnit k) = _
  rw [eval_dilation]
  simp

name: AclGeom.AffineGroupScheme.comul_translation
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comul_translation : comul k (translation k) =
    (dilationUnit k : CoordinateRing k) ⊗ₜ[k] translation k + translation k ⊗ₜ[k] 1
proof:
:=
  eval_translation _ _

name: AclGeom.AffineGroupScheme.counit_dilation
statement:
@[simp]
theorem counit_dilation : counit k (dilationUnit k) = 1
proof: := eval_dilation _ _

name: AclGeom.AffineGroupScheme.counit_translation
statement:
@[simp]
theorem counit_translation : counit k (translation k) = 0
proof: := eval_translation _ _

name: AclGeom.AffineGroupScheme.inverse_dilation
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inverse_dilation :
    inverse k (dilationUnit k) = (↑((dilationUnit k)⁻¹) : CoordinateRing k)
proof:
:=
  eval_dilation _ _

name: AclGeom.AffineGroupScheme.inverse_translation
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inverse_translation : inverse k (translation k) =
    -(↑((dilationUnit k)⁻¹) : CoordinateRing k) * translation k
proof:
:=
  eval_translation _ _

name: AclGeom.AffineGroupScheme.coalgebra_comul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coalgebra_comul (f : CoordinateRing k) : Coalgebra.comul (R := k) f = comul k f

name: AclGeom.AffineGroupScheme.coalgebra_counit
statement:

theorem coalgebra_counit (f : CoordinateRing k) : Coalgebra.counit (R := k) f = counit k f

name: AclGeom.AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_left
statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_left (g : AffineTransformation k) :
    ((pointsMulEquiv k).symm g).left =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (eval k g.multiplier g.shift).toRingHom)
proof:
:= by

    (WithConv.toConv (eval k g.multiplier g.shift))).left = _

name: AclGeom.CurvePointsPlaces.mem_closedPointEquivPlace
statement:
theorem mem_closedPointEquivPlace
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left] [IsProper X.hom]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1)
    (hnormal : ∀ x : X.left, IsIntegrallyClosed (X.left.presheaf.stalk x))
    (x : {x : X.left // IsClosed ({x} : Set X.left)}) (z : X.left.functionField) :
    z ∈ (closedPointEquivPlace X hdim hnormal x).val ↔
      ∃ r : X.left.presheaf.stalk x.val,
        algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x.val) X.left.functionField r = z
proof:
:=
  mem_closedPointPlace X hdim hnormal x z

name: AclGeom.CurvePointsPlaces.closedPointEquivPlace_symm_val
statement:
theorem closedPointEquivPlace_symm_val
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left] [IsProper X.hom]

    (hnormal : ∀ x : X.left, IsIntegrallyClosed (X.left.presheaf.stalk x))
    (P : Place k X.left.functionField) :
    ((closedPointEquivPlace X hdim hnormal).symm P).val = placeCenter X P
