name: AclGeom.AdditiveOrbit.finite_of_nonconstant_polynomial_image
statement:
theorem finite_of_nonconstant_polynomial_image [Algebra k A] (φ : A →ₐ[k] k[X]) (a : A)
    (ha : (φ a).natDegree ≠ 0) : φ.toRingHom.Finite
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : φ.toRingHom.comp (aeval (R := k) a).toRingHom =
      (aeval (R := k) (φ a)).toRingHom :=
    congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom (Polynomial.aeval_algHom φ a).symm
  apply RingHom.Finite.of_comp_finite (f := (aeval (R := k) a).toRingHom)
  rw [hcomp]
  exact AdditiveTranslation.polynomial_aeval_finite (φ a) ha

name: AclGeom.AdditiveOrbit.injective_finite_to_polynomial
statement:
theorem injective_finite_to_polynomial [IsDomain A] [Ring.KrullDimLE 1 A]
    (φ : A →+* k[X]) (hφ : φ.Finite) : Function.Injective φ
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hinj
  have hker : RingHom.ker φ ≠ ⊥ := fun h ↦ hinj ((RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot φ).mpr h)
  have : (RingHom.ker φ).IsPrime := RingHom.ker_isPrime φ
  have hm : (RingHom.ker φ).IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.isMaximal_of_isPrime_of_ne_bot _ hker
  have hbot : (⊥ : Ideal k[X]).IsMaximal :=
    Ideal.isMaximal_of_isIntegral_of_isMaximal_comap φ hφ.to_isIntegral ⊥ (by
      rw [← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot]
      exact hm)
  exact Polynomial.not_isField k (Ring.isField_iff_maximal_bot.mpr hbot)

name: AclGeom.AdditiveOrbit.AclGeom.AdditiveOrbit.exists_algHom_of_spec_hom
statement:
theorem exists_algHom_of_spec_hom (A B : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra k A] [Algebra k B]
    (f : (Spec (.of B)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k))) :
    ∃ φ : A →ₐ[k] B, (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op = f
proof:
:= by
  let f₀ : Spec (.of B) ⟶ Spec (.of A) := f.left
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := Spec.map_surjective f₀
  have hcomp : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A) ≫ φ =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k B) := by
    apply Spec.map_injective
    rw [Spec.map_comp, hφ]
    exact Over.w f
  let ψ : A →ₐ[k] B :=
    { φ.hom with
      commutes' := fun a ↦ congrArg (fun h : CommRingCat.of k ⟶ CommRingCat.of B ↦ h a) hcomp }
  refine ⟨ψ, ?_⟩
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  change Spec.map φ = f₀
  exact hφ

name: AclGeom.AdditiveOrbit.AclGeom.AdditiveOrbit.AclGeom.AdditiveOrbit.finite_surjective_of_separates_zero_one
statement:
theorem finite_surjective_of_separates_zero_one
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1)
    (f : (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X ⟶ V)
    (hne : AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (0 : k) ≫ f ≠
      AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (1 : k) ≫ f) :
    IsFinite f.left ∧ Surjective f.left
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A : Type u := Γ(V.left, ⊤)
  let R := AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1
  let e : V ≅ (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) :=
    SchemeGenericTranslate.sectionsSpecIso V
  let e₀ : V.left ≅ Spec (.of A) := (Over.forget (Spec (.of k))).mapIso e
  let f₁ : Spec (.of R) ⟶ V.left := f.left
  let f₀ : (Spec (.of R)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶
      (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) := f ≫ e.hom
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_algHom_of_spec_hom A R f₀
  have hσleft := congrArg Over.Hom.left hσ
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom σ.toRingHom) = f₁ ≫ e₀.hom at hσleft
  let P := AdditiveTranslation.polynomialCoordinates k
  let η₀ : A →ₐ[k] Polynomial k := P.toAlgHom.comp σ
  have hex : ∃ a : A, (η₀ a).natDegree ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra! h
    have hcompare : (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) (0 : k)).comp σ =
        (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) (1 : k)).comp σ := by
      apply AlgHom.ext
      intro a
      simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AdditiveTranslation.lineEval_polynomialCoordinates]
      have ha : P (σ a) = Polynomial.C ((P (σ a)).coeff 0) :=
        Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero (h a)
      rw [ha, Polynomial.aeval_C, Polynomial.aeval_C]
    apply hne
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    apply (cancel_mono e₀.hom).mp
    change (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) (0 : k)).toRingHom) ≫ f₁) ≫ e₀.hom =
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) (1 : k)).toRingHom) ≫ f₁) ≫ e₀.hom
    rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ← hσleft]
    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
    apply congrArg Spec.map
    apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
    change ((AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) (0 : k)).comp σ).toRingHom =
      ((AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) (1 : k)).comp σ).toRingHom
    exact congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom hcompare
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hex
  have hη : η₀.toRingHom.Finite := finite_of_nonconstant_polynomial_image η₀ a ha
  have hdimA : ringKrullDim A = 1 := by
    have he := IsHomeomorph.topologicalKrullDim_eq _
      e₀.hom.homeomorph.isHomeomorph
    change topologicalKrullDim V.left = topologicalKrullDim (PrimeSpectrum A) at he
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.topologicalKrullDim_eq_ringKrullDim] at he
    exact he.symm.trans hdim
  have : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 A := Ring.krullDimLE_iff.mpr hdimA.le
  have hinjη : Function.Injective η₀ := injective_finite_to_polynomial η₀.toRingHom hη
  have hinjσ : Function.Injective σ := fun x y h ↦ hinjη (congrArg P h)
  have hσeq : P.symm.toRingHom.comp η₀.toRingHom = σ.toRingHom := by
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro a
    exact P.symm_apply_apply (σ a)
  have hσfin : σ.toRingHom.Finite := by
    rw [← hσeq]
    exact P.symm.toRingEquiv.finite.comp hη
  have hf : f₁ = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom σ.toRingHom) ≫ e₀.inv := by
    apply (cancel_mono e₀.hom).mp
    rw [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
    exact hσleft.symm
  have : IsFinite (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom σ.toRingHom)) :=
    (IsFinite.SpecMap_iff _).mpr hσfin
  have : Surjective (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom σ.toRingHom)) := by
    constructor
    exact hσfin.to_isIntegral.comap_surjective hinjσ
  have : IsFinite e₀.inv := inferInstance
  have : Surjective e₀.inv := inferInstance
  change IsFinite f₁ ∧ Surjective f₁
  rw [hf]
  exact ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

name: AclGeom.map_groupoidDifferenceChart
statement:
theorem map_groupoidDifferenceChart
    {D : Type*} [CategoryTheory.Groupoid D] (F : C ⥤ D)
    (e a : X ⟶ Y) :
    F.map (groupoidDifferenceChart e a) =
      groupoidDifferenceChart (F.map e) (F.map a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [groupoidDifferenceChart, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_inv]

name: AclGeom.groupoidDifferenceChart_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem groupoidDifferenceChart_eq_one_iff (e a : X ⟶ Y) :
    groupoidDifferenceChart e a = 1 ↔ a = e
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply (cancel_mono (inv e)).1
    simpa [groupoidDifferenceChart] using h
  · rintro rfl
    simp [groupoidDifferenceChart]

name: AclGeom.map_groupoidDifferenceProduct
statement:
theorem map_groupoidDifferenceProduct
    {D : Type*} [CategoryTheory.Groupoid D] (F : C ⥤ D)
    (e a b : X ⟶ Y) :
    F.map (groupoidDifferenceProduct e a b) =
      groupoidDifferenceProduct (F.map e) (F.map a) (F.map b)
proof:
:= by
  simp [groupoidDifferenceProduct, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_inv]

name: AclGeom.groupoidDifferenceProduct_inv
statement:
theorem groupoidDifferenceProduct_inv (e a b : X ⟶ Y) :
    groupoidDifferenceProduct (inv e) (inv a) (inv b) =
      inv (groupoidDifferenceProduct e b a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [groupoidDifferenceProduct, Category.assoc, IsIso.inv_comp]

name: AclGeom.groupoidDifferenceChart_mul
statement:
theorem groupoidDifferenceChart_mul (e a b : X ⟶ Y) :
    groupoidDifferenceChart e a * groupoidDifferenceChart e b =
      groupoidDifferenceChart e (groupoidDifferenceProduct e a b)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [groupoidDifferenceChart, groupoidDifferenceProduct,
    CategoryTheory.Groupoid.vertexGroup_mul, Category.assoc]

name: AclGeom.groupoidDifferenceChart_inv
statement:
theorem groupoidDifferenceChart_inv (e a : X ⟶ Y) :
    (groupoidDifferenceChart e a)⁻¹ =
      groupoidDifferenceChart e (groupoidDifferenceInverse e a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [groupoidDifferenceChart, groupoidDifferenceInverse,
    CategoryTheory.Groupoid.vertexGroup_inv, Category.assoc]

name: AclGeom.groupoidFourArrowComposite
statement:
theorem groupoidFourArrowComposite (e a b : X ⟶ Y) (s : Y ⟶ Z) :
    (a ≫ s) ≫ inv (inv b ≫ e ≫ s) =
      groupoidDifferenceProduct e a b
proof:
:= by
  simp [groupoidDifferenceProduct, Category.assoc]

name: AclGeom.groupoidFourArrowComposite_chart
statement:
theorem groupoidFourArrowComposite_chart (e a b : X ⟶ Y) (s : Y ⟶ Z) :
    groupoidDifferenceChart e a * groupoidDifferenceChart e b =
      groupoidDifferenceChart e ((a ≫ s) ≫ inv (inv b ≫ e ≫ s))
proof:
:= by
  rw [groupoidFourArrowComposite]
  exact groupoidDifferenceChart_mul e a b

name: AclGeom.groupoidDifferenceEquiv_mul
statement:
theorem groupoidDifferenceEquiv_mul (e a b : X ⟶ Y) :
    groupoidDifferenceEquiv e ((groupoidArrowChunk e).mul a b) =
      groupoidDifferenceEquiv e a * groupoidDifferenceEquiv e b
proof:
:= by
  exact (groupoidDifferenceChart_mul e a b).symm

name: AclGeom.groupoidDifferenceEquiv_inv
statement:
theorem groupoidDifferenceEquiv_inv (e a : X ⟶ Y) :
    groupoidDifferenceEquiv e ((groupoidArrowChunk e).inv a) =
      (groupoidDifferenceEquiv e a)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  exact (groupoidDifferenceChart_inv e a).symm

name: AclGeom.differenceChart_mul
statement:
theorem differenceChart_mul (e a b : G) :
    differenceChart e a * differenceChart e b =
      differenceChart e (differenceProduct e a b)
proof:
:= by
  simp [differenceChart, differenceProduct, mul_assoc]

name: AclGeom.differenceChart_inv
statement:
theorem differenceChart_inv (e a : G) :
    (differenceChart e a)⁻¹ = differenceChart e (differenceInverse e a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [differenceChart, differenceInverse, mul_assoc]

name: AclGeom.groupoidComposite_eq
statement:
theorem groupoidComposite_eq (s e a b : G) :
    (((s * e) * a⁻¹)⁻¹) * (s * b) = differenceProduct e a b
proof:
:= by
  simp [differenceProduct, mul_assoc]

name: AclGeom.groupoidComposite_chart
statement:
theorem groupoidComposite_chart (s e a b : G) :
    differenceChart e a * differenceChart e b =
      differenceChart e ((((s * e) * a⁻¹)⁻¹) * (s * b))
proof:
:= by
  rw [groupoidComposite_eq]
  exact differenceChart_mul e a b

name: AclGeom.sixPointGroupTuple_zero

name: AclGeom.sixPointGroupTuple_relations
statement:
theorem sixPointGroupTuple_relations (α γ ε : G) :
    sixPointGroupTuple α γ ε 2 =
        sixPointGroupTuple α γ ε 0 * sixPointGroupTuple α γ ε 1 ∧
    sixPointGroupTuple α γ ε 4 =
        sixPointGroupTuple α γ ε 0 * sixPointGroupTuple α γ ε 5 ∧
