:= by
  simp [mul_assoc]

name: AclGeom.ker_productMap_mem_minimalPrimes
statement:
private theorem ker_productMap_mem_minimalPrimes {E F G S : Type*} [Field E] [Field F] [Field G]
    [CommRing S] [IsDomain S] [Algebra E F] [Algebra E G] [Algebra E S] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic E G]
    (f : F →ₐ[E] S) (g : G →ₐ[E] S) :
    RingHom.ker (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap f g) ∈ minimalPrimes (F ⊗[E] G)
proof:
:= by
  have : (RingHom.ker (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap f g)).IsPrime := RingHom.ker_isPrime _
  have hunder : (RingHom.ker (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap f g)).under F = ⊥ := by
    refine eq_bot_iff.2 fun a ha ↦ ?_
    rw [Ideal.mem_bot]
    have ha' : algebraMap F (F ⊗[E] G) a ∈ RingHom.ker (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap f g) :=
      ha
    have h0 : f a = 0 :=
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap_left_apply f g a).symm.trans (RingHom.mem_ker.1 ha')
    exact (RingHom.injective f.toRingHom) (h0.trans (map_zero f).symm)
  have hmin := Ideal.IsIntegral.mem_minimalPrimes_map_under (R := F)
    (RingHom.ker (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap f g))
  rw [hunder, Ideal.map_bot] at hmin
  exact hmin

name: AclGeom.ker_productMap_mem_minimalPrimes_of_injective
statement:
private theorem ker_productMap_mem_minimalPrimes_of_injective {E F G Ω : Type*} [Field E] [Field F]
    [Field G] [Field Ω] [Algebra E F] [Algebra E G] [Algebra E Ω]
    (f : F →ₐ[E] Ω) (g : G →ₐ[E] Ω) {ι : Type*} (u : ι → F)
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic (IntermediateField.adjoin E (Set.range u)) F]
    (hind : Function.Injective (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (g : G →+* Ω) (⇑f ∘ u))) :
    RingHom.ker (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap f g) ∈ minimalPrimes (F ⊗[E] G)
proof:
:= by
  let K := IntermediateField.adjoin E (Set.range u)
  let φ : K →ₐ[E] Ω := f.comp K.val
  
  let N := g.fieldRange
  let e : G ≃ₐ[E] N := AlgEquiv.ofInjectiveField g
  have haeval : Function.Injective (MvPolynomial.aeval (R := N) (⇑f ∘ u)) := by
    have key : ∀ r : MvPolynomial ι N, MvPolynomial.aeval (⇑f ∘ u) r =
        MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (g : G →+* Ω) (⇑f ∘ u)
          (MvPolynomial.map (e.symm : N →+* G) r) := fun r ↦ by
      rw [MvPolynomial.coe_eval₂Hom, MvPolynomial.eval₂_map, MvPolynomial.aeval_def]
      congr 1
      exact RingHom.ext fun n ↦ (congrArg Subtype.val (e.apply_symm_apply n)).symm
    intro p q h
    exact MvPolynomial.map_injective _ e.symm.injective
      (hind ((key p).symm.trans (h.trans (key q))))
  have hgen : idealOf N (⇑f ∘ u) =
      (⊥ : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι E)).map (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap E N)) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_bot]
    exact (RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot _).1 haeval
  have H := (isGeneric_baseChange hgen).2
  have hN : IsScalarTower.toAlgHom E N Ω = N.val := by
    ext z
    rfl
  rw [hN, IntermediateField.fieldRange_val] at H
  have hφ : φ.fieldRange = IntermediateField.adjoin E (Set.range (⇑f ∘ u)) := by
    rw [IntermediateField.fieldRange_comp_val, IntermediateField.adjoin_map, Set.range_comp]
  have H' : φ.fieldRange.LinearDisjoint g.fieldRange := by
    rw [hφ]
    exact H.symm
  rw [IntermediateField.linearDisjoint_iff', AlgHom.fieldRange_toSubalgebra,
    AlgHom.fieldRange_toSubalgebra, Subalgebra.linearDisjoint_iff_injective] at H'
  have hprod : Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap φ g = (φ.range.mulMap g.range).comp
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.congr (AlgEquiv.ofInjective φ φ.injective)
        (AlgEquiv.ofInjective g g.injective)).toAlgHom := by
    ext <;> rfl
  have hinjK : Function.Injective (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap φ g) := by
    rw [hprod, AlgHom.coe_comp]
    exact H'.comp (AlgEquiv.injective _)
  
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral K F := inferInstance
  let Φ : (K ⊗[E] G) ⊗[K] F ≃ₐ[K] F ⊗[E] G :=
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm K (K ⊗[E] G) F).trans
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange E K K F G)
  let P := RingHom.ker (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap f g)
  let P' : Ideal ((K ⊗[E] G) ⊗[K] F) := P.comap (Φ : (K ⊗[E] G) ⊗[K] F →+* F ⊗[E] G)
  have hcomp : ((Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap f g : F ⊗[E] G →+* Ω).comp
      ((Φ : (K ⊗[E] G) ⊗[K] F →+* F ⊗[E] G).comp
        (algebraMap (K ⊗[E] G) ((K ⊗[E] G) ⊗[K] F)))) =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap φ g : K ⊗[E] G →+* Ω) := by
    refine RingHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
    induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul s y =>
      change Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap f g
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange E K K F G (1 ⊗ₜ (s ⊗ₜ y))) = φ s * g y
      rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange_tmul, Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap_apply_tmul,
        Algebra.smul_def, mul_one]
      rfl
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  have hunder : P'.under (K ⊗[E] G) = ⊥ := by
    refine eq_bot_iff.2 fun x hx ↦ ?_
    have hx' : Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap f g
        (Φ (algebraMap (K ⊗[E] G) ((K ⊗[E] G) ⊗[K] F) x)) = 0 := hx
    rw [Ideal.mem_bot]
    apply hinjK
    rw [map_zero]
    exact (RingHom.congr_fun hcomp x).symm.trans hx'
  have : P.IsPrime := RingHom.ker_isPrime _
  have hmin := Ideal.IsIntegral.mem_minimalPrimes_map_under (R := K ⊗[E] G) P'
  rw [hunder, Ideal.map_bot] at hmin
  have htr := Ideal.minimalPrimes_comap_of_surjective
    (f := (Φ.symm : F ⊗[E] G →+* (K ⊗[E] G) ⊗[K] F)) Φ.symm.surjective hmin
  rw [Ideal.comap_bot_of_injective (f := (Φ.symm : F ⊗[E] G →+* (K ⊗[E] G) ⊗[K] F))
    Φ.symm.injective, Ideal.comap_comap] at htr
  have hid : (Φ : (K ⊗[E] G) ⊗[K] F →+* F ⊗[E] G).comp
      (Φ.symm : F ⊗[E] G →+* (K ⊗[E] G) ⊗[K] F) = RingHom.id _ :=
    RingHom.ext fun z ↦ Φ.apply_symm_apply z
  rw [hid, Ideal.comap_id] at htr
  exact htr

name: AclGeom.ker_mem_minimalPrimes_of_productMap_comp
statement:
private theorem ker_mem_minimalPrimes_of_productMap_comp {A Q E F G S : Type*} [CommRing A]
    [CommRing Q] [Field E] [Field F] [Field G] [CommRing S] [IsDomain S] [Algebra E F]
    [Algebra E G] [Algebra E S] (f : F →ₐ[E] S) (g : G →ₐ[E] S)
    (hmin : RingHom.ker (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap f g) ∈ minimalPrimes (F ⊗[E] G))
    (ψ : Q →+* F ⊗[E] G) (ev : Q →+* S)
    (hcomp : (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap f g : F ⊗[E] G →+* S).comp ψ = ev) (fY : A →+* Q)
    (hset : {Z | Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum Q) ∧
        closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap fY '' Z) = Set.univ} =
      (fun P : Ideal (F ⊗[E] G) ↦ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.comap ψ P : Set Q)) ''
        minimalPrimes (F ⊗[E] G)) :
    RingHom.ker ev ∈ minimalPrimes Q ∧
      closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap fY '' PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (RingHom.ker ev : Set Q)) =
        Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  have hker : Ideal.comap ψ (RingHom.ker (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap f g)) =
      RingHom.ker ev :=
    (RingHom.comap_ker _ ψ).trans (congrArg RingHom.ker hcomp)
  have hmem := (Set.ext_iff.1 hset _).2 ⟨_, hmin,
    congrArg (fun P : Ideal Q ↦ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (P : Set Q)) hker⟩
  have hprime : (RingHom.ker ev).IsPrime := RingHom.ker_isPrime _
  have hmin := PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_ideal_mem_irreducibleComponents.1 hmem.1
  rw [hprime.radical] at hmin
  exact ⟨hmin, hmem.2⟩

name: AclGeom.dominatingComponents_eq_productMap_kers
statement:
private theorem dominatingComponents_eq_productMap_kers {A Q E F G S : Type*} [CommRing A]
    [CommRing Q] [Field E] [Field F] [Field G] [Field S] [IsAlgClosed S] [Algebra E F]
    [Algebra E G] [Algebra E S] [FiniteDimensional E F] [FiniteDimensional E G]
    (ψ : Q →+* F ⊗[E] G) (fY : A →+* Q)
    (hset : {Z | Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum Q) ∧
        closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap fY '' Z) = Set.univ} =
      (fun P : Ideal (F ⊗[E] G) ↦ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.comap ψ P : Set Q)) ''
        minimalPrimes (F ⊗[E] G)) :
    {Z | Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum Q) ∧
        closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap fY '' Z) = Set.univ} =
      {C | ∃ (f : F →ₐ[E] S) (g : G →ₐ[E] S), C = PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus
        (Ideal.comap ψ (RingHom.ker (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap f g)) : Set Q)}
proof:
:= by
  refine hset.trans ?_
  ext C
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨P, hP, rfl⟩
    have : P.IsPrime := Ideal.IsMinimalPrime.isPrime hP
    obtain ⟨f, g, hfg⟩ := exists_productMap_ker_of_isPrime (Ω := S) P
    exact ⟨f, g, by rw [hfg]⟩
  · rintro ⟨f, g, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, ker_productMap_mem_minimalPrimes f g, rfl⟩

name: AclGeom.locusIncidence_le_idealOf
statement: theorem locusIncidence_le_idealOf : ℐ ≤ idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z)
proof:
:=
  sup_le
    (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z)
      (b := Sum.elim x y) (g := Sum.inl) rfl).le)
    (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z)
      (b := Sum.elim y z) (g := Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) Sum.inr)
      (funext fun i ↦ by rcases i with b | c <;> rfl)).le)

name: AclGeom.isAlgebraic_locusField
statement:
private theorem isAlgebraic_locusField (hzy : ∀ i, z i ∈ racl k (Set.range y)) :
    letI : Algebra 𝔎 𝔐
proof:
:= (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
      (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic 𝔎 𝔐 := by
  
  
  have hle : 𝔐 ≤ (algebraicClosure 𝔎 Ω).restrictScalars k := by
    rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rcases i with j | i
    · exact mem_algebraicClosure_iff.2 (isAlgebraic_algebraMap
        (⟨y j, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨j, rfl⟩⟩ : 𝔎))
    · exact mem_algebraicClosure_iff.2 ((mem_racl_iff k).1 (hzy i))
  let _ : Algebra 𝔎 𝔐 := (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
    (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let g : 𝔐 →ₐ[𝔎] Ω := { (IntermediateField.val 𝔐).toRingHom with commutes' := fun _ ↦ rfl }
  exact ⟨fun m ↦ (isAlgebraic_algHom_iff g Subtype.val_injective).1
    (mem_algebraicClosure_iff.1 (hle m.2))⟩

name: AclGeom.finiteDimensional_of_mem_iff
statement:
private theorem finiteDimensional_of_mem_iff {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (w : ι → Ω)
    (hw : ∀ i, w i ∈ racl k (Set.range y)) (T : IntermediateField k Ω) (hyT : 𝔎 ≤ T)
    (hT : ∀ v, v ∈ T ↔ v ∈ IntermediateField.adjoin 𝔎 (Set.range w)) :
    letI : Algebra 𝔎 T
proof:
:= (IntermediateField.inclusion hyT).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    FiniteDimensional 𝔎 T := by
  have : FiniteDimensional 𝔎 (IntermediateField.adjoin 𝔎 (Set.range w)) :=
    IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_adjoin fun _ ⟨i, hi⟩ ↦
      hi ▸ ((mem_racl_iff k).1 (hw i)).isIntegral
  let _ : Algebra 𝔎 T := (IntermediateField.inclusion hyT).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let φ : IntermediateField.adjoin 𝔎 (Set.range w) →ₐ[𝔎] T :=
    { toFun := fun m ↦ ⟨m, (hT _).2 m.2⟩
      map_one' := rfl
      map_mul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
      map_zero' := rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
      commutes' := fun _ ↦ rfl }
  exact Module.Finite.of_surjective φ.toLinearMap fun t ↦ ⟨⟨t, (hT _).1 t.2⟩, rfl⟩

name: AclGeom.idealOf_algHom_comp_eq
proof:
:= (IntermediateField.inclusion hyT).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    ∀ f : T →ₐ[𝔎] Ω, idealOf k (fun i ↦ f ⟨w i, hw i⟩) = idealOf k w := by
  let _ : Algebra 𝔎 T := (IntermediateField.inclusion hyT).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  intro f
  let fk : T →ₐ[k] Ω := { f.toRingHom with commutes' := fun c ↦ f.commutes (algebraMap k 𝔎 c) }
  exact (idealOf_comp_algHom k fk (fun i ↦ (⟨w i, hw i⟩ : T))).trans
    (idealOf_comp_algHom k T.val (fun i ↦ (⟨w i, hw i⟩ : T))).symm

name: AclGeom.exists_algHom_of_idealOf_eq
statement:
private theorem exists_algHom_of_idealOf_eq {ι : Type*} {a b : ι → Ω}
    (h : idealOf k a = idealOf k b) {j : β → ι} (ha : a ∘ j = y) (hb : b ∘ j = y)
    (hyT : 𝔎 ≤ IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range a)) :
    letI : Algebra 𝔎 (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range a))
proof:
:=
      (IntermediateField.inclusion hyT).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    ∃ f : IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range a) →ₐ[𝔎] Ω,
      ∀ i, f ⟨a i, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩ = b i := by
  let φ : IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range a) →ₐ[k] Ω :=
    (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range b)).val.comp
      (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq h).toAlgHom
  have hφ (i : ι) : φ ⟨a i, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩ = b i :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_apply h i)
  have hext : φ.comp (IntermediateField.inclusion hyT) = IntermediateField.val 𝔎 := by
    apply IntermediateField.adjoin_algHom_ext k
    rintro _ ⟨m, rfl⟩
    have hm : (⟨y m, hyT (IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨m, rfl⟩)⟩ :
        IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range a)) =
        ⟨a (j m), IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨j m, rfl⟩⟩ :=
      Subtype.ext (congrFun ha m).symm
    change φ ⟨y m, hyT (IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨m, rfl⟩)⟩ = y m
    rw [hm, hφ]
    exact congrFun hb m
  let _ : Algebra 𝔎 (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range a)) :=
    (IntermediateField.inclusion hyT).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  exact ⟨{ φ.toRingHom with commutes' := fun c ↦ DFunLike.congr_fun hext c }, hφ⟩

name: AclGeom.productMap_comp_mk_eq_aeval
statement:
private theorem productMap_comp_mk_eq_aeval :
    letI : Algebra 𝔎 𝔏
proof:
:= (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
      (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra 𝔎 𝔐 := (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
      (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    ∀ (f : 𝔏 →ₐ[𝔎] Ω) (g : 𝔐 →ₐ[𝔎] Ω) (ψ : MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k ⧸ ℐ →+* 𝔏 ⊗[𝔎] 𝔐),
      (∀ (p : MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) k) (q : MvPolynomial (β ⊕ γ) k),
        ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ
            (rename Sum.inl p * rename (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) Sum.inr) q)) =
          algebraMap 𝔅 𝔏 (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (Sum.elim x y) (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p)) ⊗ₜ
            algebraMap ℭ 𝔐 (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (Sum.elim y z) (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ q))) →
      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap f g : 𝔏 ⊗[𝔎] 𝔐 →+* Ω).comp ψ).comp
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ) =
        (aeval (Sum.elim (Sum.elim
          (fun a ↦ f ⟨x a, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨Sum.inl a, rfl⟩⟩) y)
          (fun c ↦ g ⟨z c, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨Sum.inr c, rfl⟩⟩)) :
          MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k →ₐ[k] Ω).toRingHom := by
  let _ : Algebra 𝔎 𝔏 := (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
    (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝔎 𝔐 := (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
    (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  intro f g ψ hψ
  refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun r ↦ ?_) (fun i ↦ ?_)
  · have h := hψ (C r) 1
    simp only [map_one, mul_one, rename_C] at h
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom]
    rw [h]
    simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap_apply_tmul, map_one, mul_one,
      locusCoordinateRingEquiv_mk, aeval_C]
    exact f.commutes (algebraMap k 𝔎 r)
  · rcases i with (a | b) | c
    · have h := hψ (X (Sum.inl a)) 1
      simp only [map_one, mul_one, rename_X] at h
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom]
      rw [h]
      simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap_apply_tmul, map_one, mul_one,
        locusCoordinateRingEquiv_mk, aeval_X, Sum.elim_inl]
      rfl
    · have h := hψ (X (Sum.inr b)) 1
      simp only [map_one, mul_one, rename_X] at h
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom]
      rw [h]
      simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap_apply_tmul, map_one, mul_one,
        locusCoordinateRingEquiv_mk, aeval_X, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]
      exact f.commutes ⟨y b, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨b, rfl⟩⟩
    · have h := hψ 1 (X (Sum.inr c))
      simp only [map_one, one_mul, rename_X, Sum.elim_inr] at h
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom]
      rw [h]
      simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap_apply_tmul, map_one, one_mul,
        locusCoordinateRingEquiv_mk, aeval_X, Sum.elim_inr]
      rfl

name: AclGeom.locusIncidence_jointPrime_dominating
statement:
theorem locusIncidence_jointPrime_dominating (hzy : ∀ i, z i ∈ racl k (Set.range y)) :
    RingHom.ker 𝔈 ∈ minimalPrimes (MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k ⧸ ℐ) ∧
      closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.quotientMapₐ ℐ (rename (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr))
          (idealOf_le_comap_rename_comp (a := Sum.elim x y) (b := y) (g := Sum.inr)
            (e := Sum.inl) rfl le_sup_left)).toRingHom ''
        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus
          (RingHom.ker 𝔈 : Set (MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k ⧸ ℐ))) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Algebra 𝔎 𝔏 := (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
    (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝔎 𝔐 := (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
    (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic 𝔎 𝔐 := isAlgebraic_locusField y z hzy
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, hset⟩ := exists_locusIncidence_dominatingComponents (k := k) x y z
  let f : 𝔏 →ₐ[𝔎] Ω := { (IntermediateField.val 𝔏).toRingHom with commutes' := fun _ ↦ rfl }
  let g : 𝔐 →ₐ[𝔎] Ω := { (IntermediateField.val 𝔐).toRingHom with commutes' := fun _ ↦ rfl }
  exact ker_mem_minimalPrimes_of_productMap_comp f g (ker_productMap_mem_minimalPrimes f g) ψ
    (𝔈 : MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k ⧸ ℐ →+* Ω)
    (Ideal.Quotient.ringHom_ext ((productMap_comp_mk_eq_aeval x y z f g ψ hψ).trans
      (RingHom.ext fun _ ↦ rfl))) _ hset

name: AclGeom.exists_basis_of_rank
statement:
private theorem exists_basis_of_rank [Finite α] [Finite β] [Finite γ]
    (hrank : Algebra.trdeg k ℌ + Algebra.trdeg k 𝔎 = Algebra.trdeg k 𝔏 + Algebra.trdeg k 𝔐) :
    letI : Algebra 𝔎 𝔏
proof:
:= (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
      (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    ∃ (U : Set Ω) (u : U → 𝔏), (∀ i, (u i : Ω) = i) ∧
      Algebra.IsAlgebraic (IntermediateField.adjoin 𝔎 (Set.range u)) 𝔏 ∧
      AlgebraicIndependent 𝔐 (fun i : U ↦ (i : Ω)) := by
  let _ : Algebra 𝔎 𝔏 := (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
    (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have hfinK : Algebra.trdeg k 𝔎 < Cardinal.aleph0 := by
    have : Algebra.EssFiniteType k 𝔎 :=
      essFiniteType_iff.mpr (fg_adjoin_of_finite (Set.finite_range y))
    exact trdeg_lt_aleph0 k 𝔎
  have hfinM : Algebra.trdeg k 𝔐 < Cardinal.aleph0 := by
    have : Algebra.EssFiniteType k 𝔐 :=
      essFiniteType_iff.mpr (fg_adjoin_of_finite (Set.finite_range (Sum.elim y z)))
    exact trdeg_lt_aleph0 k 𝔐
  
  obtain ⟨U, -, hU⟩ := exists_maximal_algebraicIndependent (R := 𝔎) (A := Ω) ∅ (Set.range x)
    (Set.empty_subset _) ((algebraicIndependent_empty_iff _ _).2 (algebraMap 𝔎 Ω).injective)
  have hUind : AlgebraicIndepOn 𝔎 id U := hU.1.1
  have hUx : U ⊆ Set.range x := hU.1.2
  have : Finite U := (Set.finite_range x).subset hUx
  have hxU : ∀ a, x a ∈ racl 𝔎 U := by
    intro a
    by_cases ha : x a ∈ U
    · exact subset_racl 𝔎 U ha
    · rw [mem_racl_iff_isAlgebraic_adjoin]
      by_contra htr
      have hins : AlgebraicIndepOn 𝔎 id (insert (x a) U) :=
        (AlgebraicIndepOn.insert_iff ha).2 ⟨hUind, by rwa [Set.image_id]⟩
      exact ha (hU.2 ⟨hins, Set.insert_subset ⟨a, rfl⟩ hUx⟩ (Set.subset_insert _ _)
        (Set.mem_insert _ _))
  have hU𝔏 : ∀ i : U, (i : Ω) ∈ 𝔏 := fun i ↦ by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hUx i.2
    exact ha ▸ subset_adjoin k _ ⟨Sum.inl a, rfl⟩
  have hUℌ : ∀ i : U, (i : Ω) ∈ ℌ := fun i ↦ by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hUx i.2
    exact ha ▸ subset_adjoin k _ ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inl a), rfl⟩
  
  have hLsub : ∀ w ∈ 𝔏, w ∈ racl 𝔎 U := by
    intro w hw
    rw [mem_racl_adjoin_base_iff]
    refine (adjoin_le_iff.2 ?_ : 𝔏 ≤ racl k (Set.range y ∪ U)) hw
    rintro _ ⟨i | b, rfl⟩
    · exact mem_racl_adjoin_base_iff.1 (hxU i)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Or.inl ⟨b, rfl⟩)
  
  have hHsub : ∀ w ∈ ℌ, w ∈ racl 𝔐 U := by
    intro w hw
    rw [mem_racl_adjoin_base_iff]
    refine (adjoin_le_iff.2 ?_ : ℌ ≤ racl k (Set.range (Sum.elim y z) ∪ U)) hw
    rintro _ ⟨(a | b) | c, rfl⟩
    · exact racl_mono (Set.union_subset_union_left U
        (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left)) (mem_racl_adjoin_base_iff.1 (hxU a))
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Or.inl ⟨Sum.inl b, rfl⟩)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Or.inl ⟨Sum.inr c, rfl⟩)
  
  have h𝔎𝔏 : 𝔎 ≤ 𝔏 :=
    IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _ (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right)
  let L := extendScalars h𝔎𝔏
  have : FaithfulSMul 𝔎 L := (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective 𝔎 L).2
    (algebraMap 𝔎 L).injective
  let v : U → L := fun i ↦ ⟨i, hU𝔏 i⟩
  have hvind : AlgebraicIndependent 𝔎 v := AlgebraicIndependent.of_comp L.val hUind
  have hvb : IsTranscendenceBasis 𝔎 v := by
    refine hvind.isTranscendenceBasis_iff_isAlgebraic.2 ⟨fun w ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [← mem_racl_iff_isAlgebraic_adjoin, ← coe_mem_racl_image_iff, ← Set.range_comp,
      show Set.range (Subtype.val ∘ v) = U from Subtype.range_coe]
    exact hLsub w w.2
  let e₁ : L ≃ₐ[k] 𝔏 :=
    { toFun := fun w ↦ ⟨w, w.2⟩
      invFun := fun w ↦ ⟨w, w.2⟩
      left_inv := fun _ ↦ rfl
      right_inv := fun _ ↦ rfl
      map_mul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
      commutes' := fun _ ↦ rfl }
  have hL : Algebra.trdeg k 𝔎 + Cardinal.mk U = Algebra.trdeg k 𝔏 := by
    rw [hvb.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg, trdeg_add_eq k 𝔎 (A := L), e₁.trdeg_eq]
  
  have h𝔐ℌ : 𝔐 ≤ ℌ := IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _ (by
    rintro _ ⟨b | c, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inr b), rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨Sum.inr c, rfl⟩)
  let M := extendScalars h𝔐ℌ
  have : FaithfulSMul 𝔐 M := (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective 𝔐 M).2
    (algebraMap 𝔐 M).injective
  let v' : U → M := fun i ↦ ⟨i, hUℌ i⟩
  let e₂ : M ≃ₐ[k] ℌ :=
    { toFun := fun w ↦ ⟨w, w.2⟩
      invFun := fun w ↦ ⟨w, w.2⟩
      left_inv := fun _ ↦ rfl
      right_inv := fun _ ↦ rfl
      map_mul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
      commutes' := fun _ ↦ rfl }
  have hM : Algebra.trdeg k 𝔐 + Algebra.trdeg 𝔐 M = Algebra.trdeg k ℌ := by
    rw [trdeg_add_eq k 𝔐 (A := M), e₂.trdeg_eq]
  have hcard : Algebra.trdeg 𝔐 M = Cardinal.mk U := by
    rw [← hM, ← hL] at hrank
    have h : Algebra.trdeg 𝔐 M + (Algebra.trdeg k 𝔐 + Algebra.trdeg k 𝔎) =
        Cardinal.mk U + (Algebra.trdeg k 𝔐 + Algebra.trdeg k 𝔎) := by
      calc _ = Algebra.trdeg k 𝔐 + Algebra.trdeg 𝔐 M + Algebra.trdeg k 𝔎 := by ac_rfl
        _ = Algebra.trdeg k 𝔎 + Cardinal.mk U + Algebra.trdeg k 𝔐 := hrank
        _ = _ := by ac_rfl
    exact (Cardinal.add_right_inj_of_lt_aleph0 (Cardinal.add_lt_aleph0 hfinM hfinK)).1 h
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (Algebra.adjoin 𝔐 (Set.range v')) M := ⟨fun w ↦ by
    rw [← mem_racl_iff_isAlgebraic_adjoin, ← coe_mem_racl_image_iff, ← Set.range_comp,
      show Set.range (Subtype.val ∘ v') = U from Subtype.range_coe]
    exact hHsub w w.2⟩
  have hv'b : IsTranscendenceBasis 𝔐 v' :=
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isTranscendenceBasis_of_le_trdeg_of_finite 𝔐 v' hcard.ge
  
  let f : 𝔏 →ₐ[𝔎] Ω := { (IntermediateField.val 𝔏).toRingHom with commutes' := fun _ ↦ rfl }
  refine ⟨U, fun i ↦ ⟨i, hU𝔏 i⟩, fun _ ↦ rfl, ⟨fun w ↦ ?_⟩,
    hv'b.1.map' (f := M.val) Subtype.val_injective⟩
  rw [← mem_racl_iff, ← algHom_mem_racl_image_iff f, ← Set.range_comp,
    show Set.range (⇑f ∘ fun i : U ↦ (⟨i, hU𝔏 i⟩ : 𝔏)) = U from Subtype.range_coe]
  exact hLsub w w.2

name: AclGeom.locusIncidence_jointPrime_dominating_of_rank
statement:
theorem locusIncidence_jointPrime_dominating_of_rank [Finite α] [Finite β] [Finite γ]
    (hrank : Algebra.trdeg k ℌ + Algebra.trdeg k 𝔎 = Algebra.trdeg k 𝔏 + Algebra.trdeg k 𝔐) :
    RingHom.ker 𝔈 ∈ minimalPrimes (MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k ⧸ ℐ) ∧
      closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.quotientMapₐ ℐ (rename (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr))
          (idealOf_le_comap_rename_comp (a := Sum.elim x y) (b := y) (g := Sum.inr)
            (e := Sum.inl) rfl le_sup_left)).toRingHom ''
        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus
          (RingHom.ker 𝔈 : Set (MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k ⧸ ℐ))) = Set.univ ∧
      ((RingHom.ker 𝔈).comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ)).comap
          (rename (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl) Sum.inr : α ⊕ γ → (α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) :
            MvPolynomial (α ⊕ γ) k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k) =
        idealOf k (Sum.elim x z) ∧
      ∃ n : ℕ, ringKrullDim ((MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k ⧸ ℐ) ⧸ RingHom.ker 𝔈) = n ∧
        Algebra.trdeg k ℌ = n
proof:
:= by
  have hker : (RingHom.ker 𝔈).comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ) =
      idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z) := by
    ext p
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, RingHom.mem_ker, mem_idealOf_iff]
    rfl
  have hrange : (𝔈 : MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k ⧸ ℐ →ₐ[k] Ω).range =
      (aeval (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z) : MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k →ₐ[k] Ω).range := by
    ext w
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective q
      exact ⟨p, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ p, rfl⟩
  refine and_assoc.1 ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · let _ : Algebra 𝔎 𝔏 := (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
      (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    let _ : Algebra 𝔎 𝔐 := (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
      (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    obtain ⟨U, u, hu, halg, hind⟩ := exists_basis_of_rank x y z hrank
    obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, hset⟩ := exists_locusIncidence_dominatingComponents (k := k) x y z
    let f : 𝔏 →ₐ[𝔎] Ω := { (IntermediateField.val 𝔏).toRingHom with commutes' := fun _ ↦ rfl }
    let g : 𝔐 →ₐ[𝔎] Ω := { (IntermediateField.val 𝔐).toRingHom with commutes' := fun _ ↦ rfl }
    have hfu : ⇑f ∘ u = fun i : U ↦ (i : Ω) := funext hu
    have hmin := ker_productMap_mem_minimalPrimes_of_injective f g u (by rw [hfu]; exact hind)
    exact ker_mem_minimalPrimes_of_productMap_comp f g hmin ψ
      (𝔈 : MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k ⧸ ℐ →+* Ω)
      (Ideal.Quotient.ringHom_ext ((productMap_comp_mk_eq_aeval x y z f g ψ hψ).trans
        (RingHom.ext fun _ ↦ rfl))) _ hset
  · rw [hker]
    exact (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z) (b := Sum.elim x z)
      (g := Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl) Sum.inr)
      (funext fun i ↦ by rcases i with a | c <;> rfl)).symm
  · obtain ⟨n, hn, htr⟩ := exists_locusCoordinateRing_dimension (k := k)
      (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z)
    refine ⟨n, (ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv ((Ideal.quotientKerEquivRange 𝔈).trans
      ((Subalgebra.equivOfEq _ _ hrange).trans
        (Ideal.quotientKerEquivRange (aeval (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x y) z) :
          MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k →ₐ[k] Ω)).symm)).toRingEquiv).trans hn, htr⟩

name: AclGeom.locusIncidence_dominatingComponents_eq_jointLoci
statement:
theorem locusIncidence_dominatingComponents_eq_jointLoci [Finite α] [Finite γ] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (hxy : ∀ i, x i ∈ racl k (Set.range y)) (hzy : ∀ i, z i ∈ racl k (Set.range y)) :
    {Z : Set (PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k ⧸ ℐ)) | Z ∈ irreducibleComponents _ ∧
        closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.quotientMapₐ ℐ (rename (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr))
          (idealOf_le_comap_rename_comp (a := Sum.elim x y) (b := y) (g := Sum.inr)
            (e := Sum.inl) rfl le_sup_left)).toRingHom '' Z) = Set.univ} =
      {C | ∃ (x' : α → Ω) (z' : γ → Ω), idealOf k (Sum.elim x' y) = idealOf k (Sum.elim x y) ∧
        idealOf k (Sum.elim y z') = idealOf k (Sum.elim y z) ∧
        C = PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ)
          (idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z')) :
            Set (MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k ⧸ ℐ))}
proof:
:= by
  
  have hL : 𝔏 = (IntermediateField.adjoin 𝔎 (Set.range x)).restrictScalars k := by
    rw [IntermediateField.restrictScalars_adjoin_eq_sup, Set.Sum.elim_range,
      IntermediateField.adjoin_union, sup_comm]
  have hM : 𝔐 = (IntermediateField.adjoin 𝔎 (Set.range z)).restrictScalars k := by
    rw [IntermediateField.restrictScalars_adjoin_eq_sup, Set.Sum.elim_range,
      IntermediateField.adjoin_union]
  have hFL := finiteDimensional_of_mem_iff y x hxy 𝔏 (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
    (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right)) fun v ↦ by rw [hL]; exact Iff.rfl
  have hFM := finiteDimensional_of_mem_iff y z hzy 𝔐 (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
    (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left)) fun v ↦ by rw [hM]; exact Iff.rfl
  let _ : Algebra 𝔎 𝔏 := (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
    (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝔎 𝔐 := (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
    (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have : FiniteDimensional 𝔎 𝔏 := hFL
  have : FiniteDimensional 𝔎 𝔐 := hFM
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, hset⟩ := exists_locusIncidence_dominatingComponents (k := k) x y z
  
  have hkey (f : 𝔏 →ₐ[𝔎] Ω) (g : 𝔐 →ₐ[𝔎] Ω) :
      Ideal.comap ψ (RingHom.ker (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap f g)) =
        Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ) (idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim
          (fun a ↦ f ⟨x a, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨Sum.inl a, rfl⟩⟩) y)
          (fun c ↦ g ⟨z c, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨Sum.inr c, rfl⟩⟩))) := by
    have h2 : idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim
          (fun a ↦ f ⟨x a, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨Sum.inl a, rfl⟩⟩) y)
          (fun c ↦ g ⟨z c, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨Sum.inr c, rfl⟩⟩)) =
        Ideal.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ) (RingHom.ker
          ((Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap f g : 𝔏 ⊗[𝔎] 𝔐 →+* Ω).comp ψ)) := by
      rw [RingHom.comap_ker, productMap_comp_mk_eq_aeval x y z f g ψ hψ]
      rfl
    rw [h2, Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective (f := Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ)
      (hf := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective)]
    exact RingHom.comap_ker _ ψ
  refine (dominatingComponents_eq_productMap_kers (S := Ω) ψ _ hset).trans ?_
  ext C
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, g, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨fun a ↦ f ⟨x a, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨Sum.inl a, rfl⟩⟩,
      fun c ↦ g ⟨z c, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨Sum.inr c, rfl⟩⟩, ?_, ?_,
      by rw [hkey]⟩
    · refine (congrArg (idealOf k) (funext fun i ↦ ?_)).trans (idealOf_algHom_comp_eq y 𝔏
        (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _ (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right))
        (Sum.elim x y) (fun i ↦ IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨i, rfl⟩) f)
      rcases i with a | b
      · rfl
      · exact (f.commutes ⟨y b, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨b, rfl⟩⟩).symm
    · refine (congrArg (idealOf k) (funext fun i ↦ ?_)).trans (idealOf_algHom_comp_eq y 𝔐
        (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _ (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left))
        (Sum.elim y z) (fun i ↦ IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨i, rfl⟩) g)
      rcases i with b | c
      · exact (g.commutes ⟨y b, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨b, rfl⟩⟩).symm
      · rfl
  · rintro ⟨x', z', hx', hz', rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_algHom_of_idealOf_eq y hx'.symm (j := Sum.inr) rfl rfl
      (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _ (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right))
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := exists_algHom_of_idealOf_eq y hz'.symm (j := Sum.inl) rfl rfl
      (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _ (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left))
    have htuple : Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z' = Sum.elim (Sum.elim
        (fun a ↦ f ⟨x a, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨Sum.inl a, rfl⟩⟩) y)
        (fun c ↦ g ⟨z c, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ ⟨Sum.inr c, rfl⟩⟩) := by
      funext i
      rcases i with (a | b) | c
      · exact (hf (Sum.inl a)).symm
      · rfl
      · exact (hg (Sum.inr c)).symm
    refine ⟨f, g, ?_⟩
    rw [hkey, htuple]

name: AclGeom.FiniteGaCover.exists_line_cover
statement:
theorem exists_line_cover
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1)
    (β : V ⟶ (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X)
    [IsFinite β.left] [Surjective β.left]
    (hinj : Function.Injective (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ V ↦ q ≫ β))
    (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (a : (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X ⟶ V),
      IsFinite a.left ∧ Surjective a.left ∧
      a ≫ β = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k ^ p ^ n) ∧
      ∀ (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra k C] (c : C),
        AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k c ≫ a ≫ β =
          AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (c ^ p ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A : Type u := Γ(V.left, ⊤)
  let R := AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1
  let P := AdditiveTranslation.polynomialCoordinates k
  let e : V ≅ (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) :=
    SchemeGenericTranslate.sectionsSpecIso V
  let e₀ : V.left ≅ Spec (.of A) := (Over.forget (Spec (.of k))).mapIso e
  let βraw : V.left ⟶ Spec (.of R) := β.left
  have : IsFinite βraw := ‹IsFinite β.left›
  have : Surjective βraw := ‹Surjective β.left›
  have : IsDomain A := inferInstance
  obtain ⟨β₀, hβ₀⟩ := AdditiveOrbit.exists_algHom_of_spec_hom R A (e.inv ≫ β)
  have hβleft := congrArg Over.Hom.left hβ₀
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom β₀.toRingHom) = e₀.inv ≫ βraw at hβleft
  have : IsFinite e₀.inv := inferInstance
  have : IsFinite (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom β₀.toRingHom)) := by
    rw [hβleft]
    exact CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderComposition.comp_mem
      e₀.inv βraw inferInstance inferInstance
  have hβfin : β₀.toRingHom.Finite :=
    (IsFinite.SpecMap_iff (CommRingCat.ofHom β₀.toRingHom)).mp inferInstance
  have hβsurj : Surjective (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom β₀.toRingHom)) := by
    rw [hβleft]
    exact ⟨βraw.surjective.comp e₀.inv.surjective⟩
  have hβinj : Function.Injective β₀ := by
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hβsurj.1 (⟨⊥, inferInstance⟩ : PrimeSpectrum R)
    have hcomap : Ideal.comap β₀.toRingHom Q.asIdeal = ⊥ := congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hQ
    apply (RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot β₀.toRingHom).mpr
    apply le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
    intro r hr
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker] at hr
    change β₀ r = 0 at hr
    rw [← hcomap]
    change β₀ r ∈ Q.asIdeal
    rw [hr]
    exact Q.asIdeal.zero_mem
  have hβuniv : UniversallyInjective β.left :=
    GroupFinite.universallyInjective_of_point_injective β hinj
  have : UniversallyInjective βraw := hβuniv
  have : UniversallyInjective (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom β₀.toRingHom)) := by
    rw [hβleft]
    exact CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderComposition.comp_mem
      e₀.inv βraw inferInstance inferInstance
  let δ : Polynomial k →ₐ[k] A := β₀.comp P.symm.toAlgHom
  have hδinj : Function.Injective δ := hβinj.comp P.symm.injective
  have hδfin : δ.toRingHom.Finite := hβfin.comp P.symm.toRingEquiv.finite
  have hδleft : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom δ.toRingHom) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom β₀.toRingHom) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom P.symm.toRingHom) := by
    rw [← Spec.map_comp]
    rfl
  have : IsIso (CommRingCat.ofHom P.symm.toRingHom) :=
    P.symm.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.isIso_hom
  have : IsIso (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom P.symm.toRingHom)) := inferInstance
  have : UniversallyInjective (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom P.symm.toRingHom)) := inferInstance
  have : UniversallyInjective (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom δ.toRingHom)) := by
    rw [hδleft]
    exact CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderComposition.comp_mem
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom β₀.toRingHom))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom P.symm.toRingHom)) inferInstance inferInstance
  obtain ⟨n, θ, _, hθ⟩ := exists_polynomial_frobenius_factor p δ hδinj hδfin
  let σ : A →ₐ[k] R := P.symm.toAlgHom.comp θ
  let a : (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X ⟶ V :=
    (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom σ).op ≫ e.inv
  have hθX : θ (δ Polynomial.X) = Polynomial.X ^ p ^ n := by
    have h := AlgHom.congr_fun hθ Polynomial.X
    simpa only [AlgHom.comp_apply, Polynomial.aeval_X] using h
  have hcompAlg : σ.comp β₀ = AffineSchemeAction.lineEval
      (k := k) (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k ^ p ^ n) := by
    apply AffineSchemeAction.lineHom_ext
    rw [AffineSchemeAction.lineEval_lineCoordinate]
    change P.symm (θ (β₀ (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k))) = _
    have hx : δ Polynomial.X = β₀ (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k) := by
      change β₀ (P.symm Polynomial.X) = _
      rw [← AdditiveTranslation.polynomialCoordinates_coordinate k, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rw [← hx, hθX, map_pow]
    rw [← AdditiveTranslation.polynomialCoordinates_coordinate k, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hcomp : a ≫ β = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k
      (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k ^ p ^ n) := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    change (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom σ.toRingHom) ≫ e₀.inv) ≫ βraw =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval
        (k := k) (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k ^ p ^ n)).toRingHom)
    rw [Category.assoc, ← hβleft, ← Spec.map_comp]
    exact congrArg Spec.map (congrArg (fun f : R →ₐ[k] R ↦
      CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom) hcompAlg)
  have hformula (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra k C] (c : C) :
      AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k c ≫ a ≫ β =
        AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (c ^ p ^ n) := by
    rw [hcomp, AdditiveTranslation.linePoint_comp_linePoint, map_pow,
      AffineSchemeAction.lineEval_lineCoordinate]
  have hne : AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (0 : k) ≫ a ≠
      AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (1 : k) ≫ a := by
    intro h
    have hh := congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ β) h
    rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hformula, hformula,
      zero_pow (Nat.ne_of_gt (expChar_pow_pos k p n)), one_pow] at hh
    exact zero_ne_one (AffineSchemeAction.linePoint_injective k hh)
  have hcover := AdditiveOrbit.finite_surjective_of_separates_zero_one V hdim a hne
  exact ⟨n, a, hcover.1, hcover.2, hcomp, hformula⟩

name: AclGeom.GroupFinite.exists_point_of_nonempty
statement:
theorem exists_point_of_nonempty (X : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [Nonempty X.left] :
    Nonempty (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ X)
proof:
:= by
  have : JacobsonSpace X.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.jacobsonSpace X.hom
  obtain ⟨z, _, hzc⟩ := nonempty_inter_closedPoints
    (Set.univ_nonempty : (Set.univ : Set X.left).Nonempty) isClosed_univ.isLocallyClosed
  have hz : IsClosed ({z} : Set X.left) := hzc
  exact ⟨Over.homMk (pointOfClosedPoint X.hom z hz) (pointOfClosedPoint_comp X.hom z hz)⟩

name: AclGeom.GroupFinite.exists_point_lift
statement:
theorem exists_point_lift {X Y : Over (Spec (.of k))} (j : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion j.left] (p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ Y)
    (hp : p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) ∈ Set.range j.left) :
    ∃ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ X, q ≫ j = p
proof:
:= by
  have hr : Set.range p.left ⊆ Set.range j.left := by
    rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
    have hz : z = IsLocalRing.closedPoint k := by
      apply Subsingleton.elim (α := PrimeSpectrum k)
    simpa only [hz] using hp
  let q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ X :=
    Over.homMk (IsOpenImmersion.lift j.left p.left hr) (by
      rw [← Over.w j, ← Category.assoc, IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac]
      exact Over.w p)
  exact ⟨q, Over.OverMorphism.ext (IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac j.left p.left hr)⟩

name: AclGeom.GroupFinite.translated_open
statement:
theorem translated_open (G : AlgebraicGroup k) (U : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    (j : U ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) [IsOpenImmersion j.left]
    (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) :
    IsOpenImmersion (j ≫ GroupScheme.leftMul G.toGroupScheme.X q).left
proof:
:= by
  have : IsIso (GroupScheme.leftMul G.toGroupScheme.X q).left := by
    change IsIso (((Over.forget (Spec (.of k))).mapIso (GroupScheme.leftMulIso q)).hom)
    infer_instance
  change IsOpenImmersion (j.left ≫ (GroupScheme.leftMul G.toGroupScheme.X q).left)
  infer_instance

name: AclGeom.GroupFinite.surjective_points
statement:
theorem surjective_points (G : AlgebraicGroup k) (H : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (f : G.Hom H.toAlgebraicGroup)
    (U T : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    (jU : U ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) (jT : T ⟶ H.toGroupScheme.X)
    (π : U ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion jU.left] [IsOpenImmersion jT.left]
    [Nonempty T.left] [Surjective π.left]
    (hsq : jU ≫ f.hom.hom = π ≫ jT) :
    Function.Surjective (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X ↦
      q ≫ f.hom.hom)
proof:
:= by
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType U.hom := by rw [← Over.w jU]; infer_instance
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType T.hom := by rw [← Over.w jT]; infer_instance
  have : JacobsonSpace H.carrier := LocallyOfFiniteType.jacobsonSpace H.structureMap
  intro h
  let jh := jT ≫ GroupScheme.leftMul H.toGroupScheme.X h
  have : IsOpenImmersion jh.left := translated_open H.toAlgebraicGroup T jT h
  have hne : (Set.range jT.left ∩ Set.range jh.left).Nonempty :=
    nonempty_preirreducible_inter (IsOpenImmersion.isOpen_range jT.left)
      (IsOpenImmersion.isOpen_range jh.left) (Set.range_nonempty _) (Set.range_nonempty _)
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzc⟩ := nonempty_inter_closedPoints hne
    ((IsOpenImmersion.isOpen_range jT.left).inter
      (IsOpenImmersion.isOpen_range jh.left)).isLocallyClosed
  have hzclosed : IsClosed ({z} : Set H.carrier) := hzc
  let w : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ H.toGroupScheme.X :=
    Over.homMk (pointOfClosedPoint H.structureMap z hzclosed)
      (pointOfClosedPoint_comp H.structureMap z hzclosed)
  have hw : w.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) = z := pointOfClosedPoint_apply _ _ _ _
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_point_lift jT w (by rw [hw]; exact hz.1)
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_point_lift jh w (by rw [hw]; exact hz.2)
  obtain ⟨aU, haU⟩ := CurveGlobalCoordinate.surjective_points_of_surjective π a
  obtain ⟨bU, hbU⟩ := CurveGlobalCoordinate.surjective_points_of_surjective π b
  change aU ≫ π = a at haU
  change bU ≫ π = b at hbU
  have haG : (aU ≫ jU) ≫ f.hom.hom = a ≫ jT := by
    rw [Category.assoc, hsq, ← Category.assoc, haU]
  have hbG : (bU ≫ jU) ≫ f.hom.hom = b ≫ jT := by
    rw [Category.assoc, hsq, ← Category.assoc, hbU]
  have hrel : h * (b ≫ jT) = a ≫ jT := by
    rw [← GroupScheme.point_comp_leftMul, Category.assoc]
    exact hb.trans ha.symm
  refine ⟨(aU ≫ jU) * (bU ≫ jU)⁻¹, ?_⟩
  change ((aU ≫ jU) * (bU ≫ jU)⁻¹) ≫ f.hom.hom = h
  rw [MonObj.mul_comp, GrpObj.inv_comp, haG, hbG, ← hrel,
    _root_.mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, _root_.mul_one]

name: AclGeom.GroupFinite.preimage_open_eq
statement:
theorem preimage_open_eq {X Y U T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hinj : Function.Injective
      (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ X ↦ q ≫ f))
    (jU : U ⟶ X) (jT : T ⟶ Y) (π : U ⟶ T)
    [IsOpenImmersion jU.left] [IsOpenImmersion jT.left] [Surjective π.left]
    (hsq : jU ≫ f = π ≫ jT) :
    f.left ⁻¹' Set.range jT.left = Set.range jU.left
proof:
:= by
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType U.hom := by rw [← Over.w jU]; infer_instance
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType T.hom := by rw [← Over.w jT]; infer_instance
  have : JacobsonSpace X.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.jacobsonSpace X.hom
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · intro z hz
    by_contra hn
    have hne : ((f.left ⁻¹' Set.range jT.left) ∩ (Set.range jU.left)ᶜ).Nonempty :=
      ⟨z, hz, hn⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hwclosed⟩ := nonempty_inter_closedPoints hne
      (((IsOpenImmersion.isOpen_range jT.left).preimage f.left.continuous).isLocallyClosed.inter
        (IsOpenImmersion.isOpen_range jU.left).isClosed_compl.isLocallyClosed)
    have hwc : IsClosed ({w} : Set X.left) := hwclosed
    let p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ X :=
      Over.homMk (pointOfClosedPoint X.hom w hwc) (pointOfClosedPoint_comp X.hom w hwc)
    have hp : p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) = w := pointOfClosedPoint_apply _ _ _ _
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_point_lift jT (p ≫ f) (by
      change f.left (p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) ∈ Set.range jT.left
      rw [hp]
      exact hw.1)
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := CurveGlobalCoordinate.surjective_points_of_surjective π a
    change r ≫ π = a at hr
    have he : (r ≫ jU) ≫ f = p ≫ f := by
      rw [Category.assoc, hsq, ← Category.assoc, hr, ha]
    have heq := congrArg (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ X ↦
      q.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) (hinj he)
    exact hw.2 ⟨r.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k), heq.trans hp⟩
  · rintro z ⟨w, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨π.left w, ?_⟩
    exact (congrArg (fun q : U ⟶ Y ↦ q.left w) hsq).symm

name: AclGeom.GroupFinite.finite_surjective_pullback
statement:
theorem finite_surjective_pullback {X Y U T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hinj : Function.Injective
      (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ X ↦ q ≫ f))
    (jU : U ⟶ X) (jT : T ⟶ Y) (π : U ⟶ T)
    [IsOpenImmersion jU.left] [IsOpenImmersion jT.left]
    [IsFinite π.left] [Surjective π.left]
    (hsq : jU ≫ f = π ≫ jT) :
    IsFinite (pullback.snd f.left jT.left) ∧ Surjective (pullback.snd f.left jT.left)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : Set.range jU.left = Set.range (pullback.fst f.left jT.left) := by
    rw [IsOpenImmersion.range_pullbackFst]
    exact (preimage_open_eq f hinj jU jT π hsq).symm
  let e := IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq jU.left (pullback.fst f.left jT.left) hr
  have he : e.hom ≫ pullback.snd f.left jT.left = π.left := by
    apply (cancel_mono jT.left).mp
    rw [Category.assoc, ← pullback.condition, ← Category.assoc,
      IsOpenImmersion.isoOfRangeEq_hom_fac]
    exact congrArg (fun q : U ⟶ Y ↦ q.left) hsq
  have hres : pullback.snd f.left jT.left = e.inv ≫ π.left := by
    rw [← he, ← Category.assoc, e.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]
  rw [hres]
  exact ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

name: AclGeom.GroupFinite.leftMul_hom
statement:
theorem leftMul_hom (G H : AlgebraicGroup k) (f : G.Hom H)
    (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) :
    GroupScheme.leftMul G.toGroupScheme.X q ≫ f.hom.hom =
      f.hom.hom ≫ GroupScheme.leftMul H.toGroupScheme.X (q ≫ f.hom.hom)
proof:
:= by
  change ((toUnit G.toGroupScheme.X ≫ q) * 𝟙 G.toGroupScheme.X) ≫ f.hom.hom = _
  rw [MonObj.mul_comp, Category.id_comp, GroupScheme.comp_leftMul, Category.assoc]

name: AclGeom.GroupFinite.finite_surjective
statement:
theorem finite_surjective (G : AlgebraicGroup k) (H : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (f : G.Hom H.toAlgebraicGroup)
    (hinj : Function.Injective
      (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X ↦ q ≫ f.hom.hom))
    (U T : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    (jU : U ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) (jT : T ⟶ H.toGroupScheme.X) (π : U ⟶ T)
    [IsOpenImmersion jU.left] [IsOpenImmersion jT.left]
    [Nonempty T.left] [IsFinite π.left] [Surjective π.left]
    (hsq : jU ≫ f.hom.hom = π ≫ jT) :
    IsFinite f.hom.hom.left ∧ Surjective f.hom.hom.left
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsurj := surjective_points G H f U T jU jT π hsq
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType T.hom := by rw [← Over.w jT]; infer_instance
  let p0 := (exists_point_of_nonempty T).some
  let : ModObj H.toGroupScheme.X H.toGroupScheme.X := ModObj.regular _
  have htrans (a b : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ H.toGroupScheme.X) :
      ∃ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ H.toGroupScheme.X,
        a ≫ ModObj.pointAct H.toGroupScheme.X q = b := by
    refine ⟨b * a⁻¹, ?_⟩
    change a ≫ GroupScheme.leftMul H.toGroupScheme.X (b * a⁻¹) = b
    rw [GroupScheme.point_comp_leftMul, _root_.mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, _root_.mul_one]
  let Q := CurveGlobalCoordinate.translatedCover H.toAlgebraicGroup
    H.toGroupScheme.X T jT p0 htrans
  have hlocal (h : Q.I₀) :
      IsFinite (Q.pullbackHom f.hom.hom.left h) ∧
        Surjective (Q.pullbackHom f.hom.hom.left h) := by
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hsurj h
    change q ≫ f.hom.hom = h at hq
    let jU' := jU ≫ GroupScheme.leftMul G.toGroupScheme.X q
    let jT' := jT ≫ GroupScheme.leftMul H.toGroupScheme.X h
    have : IsOpenImmersion jU'.left := translated_open G U jU q
    have : IsOpenImmersion jT'.left := translated_open H.toAlgebraicGroup T jT h
    have hsq' : jU' ≫ f.hom.hom = π ≫ jT' := by
      dsimp only [jU', jT']
      rw [Category.assoc, leftMul_hom, hq, ← Category.assoc, hsq, Category.assoc]
    exact finite_surjective_pullback f.hom.hom hinj jU' jT' π hsq'
  have : IsZariskiLocalAtTarget (@IsFinite.{u}) := by
    
    set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in infer_instance
  exact ⟨IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_openCover (P := @IsFinite) Q (fun h ↦ (hlocal h).1),
    IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_openCover (P := @Surjective) Q (fun h ↦ (hlocal h).2)⟩

name: AclGeom.generic_multiplier_pair
statement:
private theorem generic_multiplier_pair (S : Set K) {a c x f : K}
    (ha : a ∈ racl k S) (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (hf : f ∈ racl k S)
    (hc : c ∉ racl k S) (hx : x ∈ racl k ({a * c, f} : Set K)) :
    Transcendental ↥(racl k S) (a * c) ∧ x ∈ racl ↥(racl k S) ({a * c} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Transcendental ↥(racl k S) (a * c) := by
    intro halg
    have hmem : a * c ∈ racl k (racl k S : Set K) := by
      rw [mem_racl_iff, adjoin_self]
      exact halg
    rw [racl_racl] at hmem
    have h := mul_mem hmem (inv_mem ha)
    have heq : (a * c) * a⁻¹ = c := by
      rw [mul_comm a c, mul_inv_cancel_right₀ ha0]
    rw [heq] at h
    exact hc h
  have hf' : f ∈ racl ↥(racl k S) ({a * c} : Set K) :=
    (racl ↥(racl k S) ({a * c} : Set K)).algebraMap_mem ⟨f, hf⟩
  have hx' := racl_subset_racl_base (racl k S) ({a * c, f} : Set K) hx
  refine ⟨hm, racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ hx'⟩
  exact Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨subset_racl _ _ rfl, Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hf'⟩

name: AclGeom.colors_of_fresh_literal_relocations
statement:
private theorem colors_of_fresh_literal_relocations {a b x c p δ f : K}
    (F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ↥(adjoin k ({f} : Set K))) (hF : Prime F)
    (hspan : idealOf ↥(adjoin k ({f} : Set K)) ![a * c, x] = Ideal.span {F})
    (a' b' x' : ℕ → K) (n : ℕ)
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b, x, c])
    (hfm : f ∈ racl k ({a * c, x} : Set K)) (hfu : f ∉ racl k ({a * c} : Set K))
    (hfresh : ∀ i < n, a' i ∉ racl k ({a, b, x, c} ∪ a' '' Set.Iio i))
    (hJ : ∀ i < n, idealOf k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a' i, b' i, x' i]) =
      idealOf k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a, b, x])) :
    let L
proof:
:= racl k ({a, f} ∪ a' '' Set.Iio n)
    ∃ S : Finset (Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ↥L)), S.card ≤ F.totalDegree ∧
      ∀ i < n, idealOf ↥L ![a' i * c, x' i] ∈ S := by
  let T : Set K := {a, f} ∪ a' '' Set.Iio n
  let L := racl k T
  let E := adjoin k ({f} : Set K)
  change ∃ S : Finset (Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ↥L)), S.card ≤ F.totalDegree ∧
    ∀ i < n, idealOf ↥L ![a' i * c, x' i] ∈ S
  have hc : c ∉ L := scale_notMem_racl_of_fresh_multipliers hind hfm hfu hfresh
  have hfL : f ∈ L := subset_racl k T (by simp [T])
  have hEL : E ≤ L := adjoin_le_iff.2 (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hfL)
  let : Algebra ↥E ↥L := (IntermediateField.inclusion hEL).toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower ↥E ↥L K := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ↥L := MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap ↥E ↥L) F
  have hG : G ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hF.ne_zero ((MvPolynomial.map_injective _ (algebraMap ↥E ↥L).injective)
      (h.trans (map_zero _).symm))
  have hdeg : G.totalDegree = F.totalDegree := by
    classical
    simp only [G, MvPolynomial.totalDegree,
      MvPolynomial.support_map_of_injective F (algebraMap ↥E ↥L).injective]
  obtain ⟨S, hcard, hS⟩ := exists_curve_ideal_colors ↥L K G hG
  refine ⟨S, hdeg ▸ hcard, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  have haL : a' i ∈ L := subset_racl k T (Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩)
  have ha0 : a' i ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hfresh i hi
    rw [h]
    exact zero_mem _
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, hxi⟩ := affine_multiplier_curve_of_joint_ideal (hJ i hi) hfm hfu
  obtain ⟨hm, hx⟩ := generic_multiplier_pair T haL ha0 hfL hc hxi
  have hzero : MvPolynomial.aeval ![a' i * c, x' i] G = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨Fi, _, hold, hnew⟩ := exists_prime_multiplier_curve_of_joint_ideal
      hind (hJ i hi) hfm hfu
    have hmem : F ∈ idealOf ↥E ![a' i * c, x' i] := by
      rw [hnew.trans hold.symm, hspan]
      exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
    have heval := (mem_idealOf_iff ↥E).1 hmem
    simpa only [G, MvPolynomial.aeval_def, MvPolynomial.eval₂_map,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq] using heval
  exact hS _ _ hm hx hzero

name: AclGeom.constructed_fresh_literal_relocations
statement:
private theorem constructed_fresh_literal_relocations [IsAlgClosed K] {a b x c p δ f : K}
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b, x, c])
    (hp : p ∈ racl k ({a, b} : Set K)) (hpa : p ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K))
    (hδx : δ ∈ racl k ({a, x} : Set K)) (hδy : δ ∈ racl k ({p, a * x + b} : Set K))
    (hf : f ∈ racl k ({c, δ} : Set K)) (t : ℕ → K) (n : ℕ)
    (ht : ∀ i < n, t i ∉ racl k ({a, b, x, c} ∪ t '' Set.Iio i)) :
    ∃ a' b' x' : ℕ → K,
      (∀ i < n, a' i ∉ racl k ({a, b, x, c} ∪ a' '' Set.Iio i)) ∧
      ∀ i < n,
        idealOf k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a' i, b' i, x' i]) =
          idealOf k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a, b, x]) ∧
        a' i ∈ racl k ({p, a * x + b, c, t i} : Set K) ∧
        p ∈ racl k ({a' i, b' i} : Set K) ∧ δ ∈ racl k ({a' i, x' i} : Set K) ∧
        a' i * x' i + b' i = a * x + b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpyc : ({p, a * x + b, c} : Set K) ⊆ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) := by
    have ha : a ∈ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
    have hb : b ∈ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
    have hx : x ∈ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
    have hc : c ∈ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
    have hp4 : p ∈ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) :=
      racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨ha, Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hb⟩) hp
    exact Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨hp4, Set.insert_subset_iff.2
      ⟨add_mem (mul_mem ha hx) hb, Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hc⟩⟩
  have H : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ a' b' x' : K, i < n →
      idealOf k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a', b', x']) =
        idealOf k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a, b, x]) ∧
      a' ∈ racl k ({p, a * x + b, c, t i} : Set K) ∧
      a' ∉ racl k ({a, b, x, c} ∪ t '' Set.Iio i) ∧
      p ∈ racl k ({a', b'} : Set K) ∧ δ ∈ racl k ({a', x'} : Set K) ∧
      a' * x' + b' = a * x + b := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i < n
    · obtain ⟨a', b', x', h⟩ := exists_affine_relocation_fresh_over
        (t '' Set.Iio i) hind hp hpa hδx hδy hf (ht i hi)
      exact ⟨a', b', x', fun _ ↦ h⟩
    · exact ⟨0, 0, 0, fun h ↦ (hi h).elim⟩
  choose a' b' x' H using H
  refine ⟨a', b', x', ?_, fun i hi ↦ ?_⟩
  · intro i hi hbad
    refine (H i hi).2.2.1 (racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ hbad)
    refine Set.union_subset (fun z hz ↦ subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_union_left _ hz)) ?_
    rintro _ ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    have hpyci : ({p, a * x + b, c} : Set K) ⊆
        racl k ({a, b, x, c} ∪ t '' Set.Iio i) :=
      fun z hz ↦ racl_mono Set.subset_union_left (hpyc hz)
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ (H j (lt_trans hj hi)).2.1
    exact Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨hpyci (by simp), Set.insert_subset_iff.2
      ⟨hpyci (by simp), Set.insert_subset_iff.2
        ⟨hpyci (by simp), Set.singleton_subset_iff.2
          (subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩))⟩⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨(H i hi).1, (H i hi).2.1, (H i hi).2.2.2⟩

name: AclGeom.constructed_fresh_literal_colored_family
statement:
private theorem constructed_fresh_literal_colored_family [IsAlgClosed K] {a b x c p δ f : K}
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b, x, c])
    (hp : p ∈ racl k ({a, b} : Set K)) (hpa : p ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K))
    (hδx : δ ∈ racl k ({a, x} : Set K)) (hδa : δ ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K))
    (hδy : δ ∈ racl k ({p, a * x + b} : Set K)) (hf : f ∈ racl k ({c, δ} : Set K))
    (hfm : f ∈ racl k ({a * c, x} : Set K)) (hfu : f ∉ racl k ({a * c} : Set K)) :
    ∃ F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ↥(adjoin k ({f} : Set K)), Prime F ∧
      idealOf ↥(adjoin k ({f} : Set K)) ![a * c, x] = Ideal.span {F} ∧
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℕ → K),
        (∀ i < n, t i ∉ racl k ({a, b, x, c} ∪ t '' Set.Iio i)) →
        ∃ a' b' x' : ℕ → K,
          (∀ i < n, a' i ∉ racl k ({a, b, x, c} ∪ a' '' Set.Iio i)) ∧
          (∀ i < n, idealOf k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a' i, b' i, x' i]) =
            idealOf k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a, b, x])) ∧
          (∀ i < n, p ∈ racl k ({a' i, b' i} : Set K)) ∧
          (∀ i < n, δ ∈ racl k ({a' i, x' i} : Set K)) ∧
          (∀ i < n, a' i * x' i + b' i = a * x + b) ∧
          let L
proof:
:= racl k ({a, f} ∪ a' '' Set.Iio n)
          (∀ i < n, b - b' i ∈ L) ∧
          ∃ S : Finset (Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ↥L)), S.card ≤ F.totalDegree ∧
            ∀ i < n, idealOf ↥L ![a' i * c, x' i] ∈ S := by
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hspan, _⟩ := exists_prime_multiplier_curve_of_joint_ideal
    (p := p) (δ := δ) (a' := a) (b' := b) (x' := x) hind rfl hfm hfu
  refine ⟨F, hF, hspan, fun n t ht ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨a', b', x', hfresh, H⟩ := constructed_fresh_literal_relocations
    hind hp hpa hδx hδy hf t n ht
  have hJ : ∀ i < n, idealOf k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a' i, b' i, x' i]) =
      idealOf k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a, b, x]) := fun i hi ↦ (H i hi).1
  refine ⟨a', b', x', hfresh, hJ, (fun i hi ↦ (H i hi).2.2.1),
    (fun i hi ↦ (H i hi).2.2.2.1), (fun i hi ↦ (H i hi).2.2.2.2), ?_,
    colors_of_fresh_literal_relocations F hF hspan a' b' x' n hind hfm hfu hfresh hJ⟩
  have h3 : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b, x] := by
    have heq : (fun i : Fin 3 ↦ (![a, b, x, c] : Fin 4 → K) i.castSucc) =
        ![a, b, x] := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl
    exact heq ▸ hind.comp (fun i : Fin 3 ↦ i.castSucc) (Fin.castSucc_injective 3)
  intro i hi
  have ha3 : a' i ∉ racl k ({a, b, x} : Set K) := by
    intro h
    exact hfresh i hi (racl_mono (by
      intro z hz
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_union] at hz ⊢
      tauto) h)
  have hdiff := sub_mem_racl_of_affine_value_eq h3 ha3 hp hpa hδx hδa
    (H i hi).2.2.1 (H i hi).2.2.2.1 (H i hi).2.2.2.2
  have hsub : ({a, a' i} : Set K) ⊆ ({a, f} ∪ a' '' Set.Iio n) :=
    Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨Set.mem_union_left _ (by simp),
      Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩)⟩
  exact racl_mono hsub hdiff

name: AclGeom.ratio_transcendental_of_fresh_family
proof:
:= by
  have hi : i < n := lt_trans hij hj
  have hai0 : a' i ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hfresh i hi
    rw [h]
    exact zero_mem _
  intro halg
  have hratio : a' j / a' i ∈ racl k (T ∪ a' '' Set.Iio j) :=
    racl_mono (Set.empty_subset _) (mem_racl_empty_of_isAlgebraic halg)
  have hai : a' i ∈ racl k (T ∪ a' '' Set.Iio j) :=
    subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨i, hij, rfl⟩)
  have hprod := mul_mem hratio hai
  rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hai0] at hprod
  exact hfresh j hj hprod

name: AclGeom.relocation_map_preserves
statement:
private theorem relocation_map_preserves {L : IntermediateField k K} {ai aj bi bj xi xj c : K}
    (hai : ai ≠ 0) (haj : aj ≠ 0) (hval : aj * xj + bj = ai * xi + bi)
    (hcolor : idealOf ↥L ![aj * c, xj] = idealOf ↥L ![ai * c, xi]) :
    idealOf ↥L ![(aj / ai) * (ai * c), xi / (aj / ai) + (bi - bj) / aj] =
      idealOf ↥L ![ai * c, xi]
proof:
:= by
  have hcoords : ![(aj / ai) * (ai * c), xi / (aj / ai) + (bi - bj) / aj] =
      (![aj * c, xj] : Fin 2 → K) := by
    funext q
    fin_cases q
    · change (aj / ai) * (ai * c) = aj * c
      rw [← mul_assoc, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hai]
    · change xi / (aj / ai) + (bi - bj) / aj = xj
      field_simp [haj]
      linear_combination hval.symm
  rw [hcoords]
  exact hcolor

name: AclGeom.same_color_common_center
statement:
private theorem same_color_common_center (T : Set K) {a' b' x' : ℕ → K} {n i j r : ℕ} {b c : K}
    {L : IntermediateField k K}
    (hfresh : ∀ q < n, a' q ∉ racl k (T ∪ a' '' Set.Iio q))
    (hij : i < j) (hir : i < r) (hj : j < n) (hr : r < n)
    (ha : ∀ q < n, a' q ∈ L) (hd : ∀ q < n, b - b' q ∈ L)
    (hvj : a' j * x' j + b' j = a' i * x' i + b' i)
    (hvr : a' r * x' r + b' r = a' i * x' i + b' i)
    (hx : x' i ∈ racl ↥L ({a' i * c} : Set K))
    (hcj : idealOf ↥L ![a' j * c, x' j] = idealOf ↥L ![a' i * c, x' i])
    (hcr : idealOf ↥L ![a' r * c, x' r] = idealOf ↥L ![a' i * c, x' i]) :
    (b' i - b' j) / (a' j - a' i) = (b' i - b' r) / (a' r - a' i)
proof:
:= by
  have hi : i < n := lt_trans hij hj
  have h0 : ∀ q < n, a' q ≠ 0 := by
    intro q hq he
    apply hfresh q hq
    rw [he]
    exact zero_mem _
  have hdiff : ∀ q < n, b' i - b' q ∈ L := by
    intro q hq
    have h := sub_mem (hd q hq) (hd i hi)
    have he : (b - b' q) - (b - b' i) = b' i - b' q := by ring
    rwa [he] at h
  let lam : ↥L := ⟨a' j / a' i, div_mem (ha j hj) (ha i hi)⟩
  let rho : ↥L := ⟨a' r / a' i, div_mem (ha r hr) (ha i hi)⟩
  let nu : ↥L := ⟨(b' i - b' j) / a' j, div_mem (hdiff j hj) (ha j hj)⟩
  let om : ↥L := ⟨(b' i - b' r) / a' r, div_mem (hdiff r hr) (ha r hr)⟩
  have hLam : Transcendental k (lam : K) :=
    ratio_transcendental_of_fresh_family T hfresh hij hj
  have hrho : rho ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have he : a' r / a' i = 0 := congrArg Subtype.val h
    exact (div_ne_zero (h0 r hr) (h0 i hi)) he
  have hA : idealOf ↥L ![(lam : K) * (a' i * c), x' i / (lam : K) + (nu : K)] =
      idealOf ↥L ![a' i * c, x' i] :=
    relocation_map_preserves (h0 i hi) (h0 j hj) hvj hcj
  have hB : idealOf ↥L ![(rho : K) * (a' i * c), x' i / (rho : K) + (om : K)] =
      idealOf ↥L ![a' i * c, x' i] :=
    relocation_map_preserves (h0 i hi) (h0 r hr) hvr hcr
  have h := congrArg Subtype.val
    (affine_locus_commutation_balance hx lam nu rho om hLam hrho hA hB)
  change (a' j / a' i) * (a' r / a' i - 1) * ((b' i - b' j) / a' j) =
    (a' r / a' i) * (a' j / a' i - 1) * ((b' i - b' r) / a' r) at h
  have hne : ∀ q < n, i < q → a' q - a' i ≠ 0 := by
    intro q hq hiq he
    apply hfresh q hq
    rw [sub_eq_zero.1 he]
    exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨i, hiq, rfl⟩)
  apply (div_eq_div_iff (hne j hj hij) (hne r hr hir)).2
  field_simp [h0 i hi, h0 j hj, h0 r hr] at h
  linear_combination h

name: AclGeom.same_color_triple
statement:
private theorem same_color_triple {C : Type*} (color : ℕ → C)
    (S : Finset C) {D n : ℕ} (hD : S.card ≤ D) (hn : 2 * D < n)
    (hc : ∀ i < n, color i ∈ S) :
    ∃ i j r : ℕ, i < j ∧ i < r ∧ j ≠ r ∧ r < n ∧ j < n ∧
      color j = color i ∧ color r = color i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcard : S.card * 2 < (Finset.range n).card := by
    rw [Finset.card_range]
    omega
  obtain ⟨y, _, hF⟩ := Finset.exists_lt_card_fiber_of_mul_lt_card_of_maps_to
    (s := Finset.range n) (t := S) (f := color)
    (fun a ha ↦ hc a (Finset.mem_range.1 ha)) hcard
  let F := (Finset.range n).filter fun a ↦ color a = y
  have hFcard : 2 < F.card := hF
  have hne : F.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.1 (by omega)
  let i := F.min' hne
  have hi : i ∈ F := Finset.min'_mem _ _
  have he : 1 < (F.erase i).card := by
    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hi]
    omega
  obtain ⟨j, hj, r, hr, hjr⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.1 he
  obtain ⟨hji, hjF⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.1 hj
  obtain ⟨hri, hrF⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.1 hr
  have hij : i < j := lt_of_le_of_ne (Finset.min'_le F j hjF) hji.symm
  have hir : i < r := lt_of_le_of_ne (Finset.min'_le F r hrF) hri.symm
  have hii := Finset.mem_filter.1 hi
  have hjj := Finset.mem_filter.1 hjF
  have hrr := Finset.mem_filter.1 hrF
  exact ⟨i, j, r, hij, hir, hjr, Finset.mem_range.1 hrr.1,
    Finset.mem_range.1 hjj.1, hjj.2.trans hii.2.symm, hrr.2.trans hii.2.symm⟩

name: AclGeom.common_center_mem_racl_empty
statement:
private theorem common_center_mem_racl_empty {ai aj ar bi bj br : K}
    (hj : aj ∉ racl k ({ai} : Set K)) (hr : ar ∉ racl k ({ai, aj} : Set K))
    (hdij : bi - bj ∈ racl k ({ai, aj} : Set K))
    (hdir : bi - br ∈ racl k ({ai, ar} : Set K))
    (hdjr : bj - br ∈ racl k ({aj, ar} : Set K))
    (hcenter : (bi - bj) / (aj - ai) = (bi - br) / (ar - ai)) :
    (bi - bj) / (aj - ai) ∈ racl k (∅ : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  let t := (bi - bj) / (aj - ai)
  have h0j : aj - ai ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hj
    rw [sub_eq_zero.1 h]
    exact subset_racl k _ rfl
  have h0r : ar - ai ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hr
    rw [sub_eq_zero.1 h]
    exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
  have h0jr : ar - aj ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hr
    rw [sub_eq_zero.1 h]
    exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
  have hjval : t * (aj - ai) = bi - bj := div_mul_cancel₀ _ h0j
  have hrval : t * (ar - ai) = bi - br := by
    change ((bi - bj) / (aj - ai)) * (ar - ai) = bi - br
    rw [hcenter, div_mul_cancel₀ _ h0r]
  have hthird : t = (bj - br) / (ar - aj) := (eq_div_iff h0jr).2 (by
    linear_combination hrval - hjval)
  have pair_mem (u v B C : K) (h : B - C ∈ racl k ({u, v} : Set K)) :
      (B - C) / (v - u) ∈ racl k ({u, v} : Set K) :=
    div_mem h (sub_mem (subset_racl k _ (by simp)) (subset_racl k _ (by simp)))
  have htij : t ∈ racl k ({ai, aj} : Set K) := pair_mem ai aj bi bj hdij
  have htir : t ∈ racl k ({ai, ar} : Set K) := by
    change (bi - bj) / (aj - ai) ∈ racl k ({ai, ar} : Set K)
    rw [hcenter]
    exact pair_mem ai ar bi br hdir
  have htjr : t ∈ racl k ({aj, ar} : Set K) := by
    rw [hthird]
    exact pair_mem aj ar bj br hdjr
  have hti : t ∈ racl k ({ai} : Set K) :=
    mem_racl_of_mem_racl_insert (A := {ai}) (a := aj) (b := ar)
      (by simpa only [Set.pair_comm] using htij)
      (by simpa only [Set.pair_comm] using htir)
      (by simpa only [Set.pair_comm] using hr)
  have htj : t ∈ racl k ({aj} : Set K) :=
    mem_racl_of_mem_racl_insert (A := {aj}) (a := ai) (b := ar) htij
      (by simpa only [Set.pair_comm] using htjr) hr
  exact mem_racl_of_mem_racl_insert (A := ∅) (a := ai) (b := aj)
    (by simpa using hti) (by simpa using htj) (by simpa using hj)

name: AclGeom.pairwise_cocycles_of_fresh_family
statement:
private theorem pairwise_cocycles_of_fresh_family {a b x c p δ f : K} {n : ℕ}
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b, x])
    (hp : p ∈ racl k ({a, b} : Set K)) (hpa : p ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K))
    (hδ : δ ∈ racl k ({a, x} : Set K)) (hδa : δ ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K))
    (a' b' x' : ℕ → K)
    (hfresh : ∀ q < n, a' q ∉ racl k ({a, b, x, c} ∪ a' '' Set.Iio q))
    (hJ : ∀ q < n, idealOf k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a' q, b' q, x' q]) =
      idealOf k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a, b, x]))
    (hpi : ∀ q < n, p ∈ racl k ({a' q, b' q} : Set K))
    (hδi : ∀ q < n, δ ∈ racl k ({a' q, x' q} : Set K))
    (hval : ∀ q < n, a' q * x' q + b' q = a * x + b) :
    ∀ u v : ℕ, u < v → v < n → b' u - b' v ∈ racl k ({a' u, a' v} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  intro u v huv hv
  have hu : u < n := lt_trans huv hv
  have hsub : (({a, b, x} : Set K) ∪ {a' u}) ⊆ ({a, b, x, c} ∪ a' '' Set.Iio v) := by
    intro z hz
    rcases hz with hz | hz
    · exact Set.mem_union_left _ (by
        simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz ⊢
        tauto)
    · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
      rw [hz]
      exact Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨u, huv, rfl⟩
  have hvfresh : a' v ∉ racl k (({a, b, x} : Set K) ∪ {a' u}) :=
    fun h ↦ hfresh v hv (racl_mono hsub h)
  exact sub_mem_racl_of_two_relocations hind hp hpa hδ hδa (hJ u hu)
    (hpi u hu) (hδi u hu) (hval u hu) (hpi v hv) (hδi v hv) (hval v hv) hvfresh

name: AclGeom.original_p_of_shifted_joint_ideal
statement:
private theorem original_p_of_shifted_joint_ideal {a b x c p δ f ai bi xi : K}
    (hJ : idealOf k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![ai, bi, xi]) =
      idealOf k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a, b, x]))
    (κ : k)
    (hP : racl k ({p} : Set K) =
      racl k ({bi + (ai - 1) * algebraMap k K κ} : Set K)) :
    racl k ({p} : Set K) =
      racl k ({b + (a - 1) * algebraMap k K κ} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  let u : Fin 2 → MvPolynomial (Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 3) k :=
    ![X (Sum.inl 0), X (Sum.inr 1) + (X (Sum.inr 0) - 1) * C κ]
  have hI := idealOf_aeval_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq hJ u
  have hi : (fun q ↦ aeval (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![ai, bi, xi]) (u q)) =
      ![p, bi + (ai - 1) * algebraMap k K κ] := by
    funext q
    fin_cases q <;> simp [u]
  have ho : (fun q ↦ aeval (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a, b, x]) (u q)) =
      ![p, b + (a - 1) * algebraMap k K κ] := by
    funext q
    fin_cases q <;> simp [u]
  rw [hi, ho] at hI
  have hpm : p ∈ racl k ({bi + (ai - 1) * algebraMap k K κ} : Set K) := by
    rw [← hP]
    exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
  have hwm : bi + (ai - 1) * algebraMap k K κ ∈ racl k ({p} : Set K) := by
    rw [hP]
    exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
  have hpold : p ∈ racl k ({b + (a - 1) * algebraMap k K κ} : Set K) := by
    have h : (![p, bi + (ai - 1) * algebraMap k K κ] : Fin 2 → K) 0 ∈
        racl k ((![p, bi + (ai - 1) * algebraMap k K κ] : Fin 2 → K) '' {1}) := by
      simpa using hpm
    have h' := mem_racl_image_of_idealOf_eq k hI h
    simpa using h'
  have hwold : b + (a - 1) * algebraMap k K κ ∈ racl k ({p} : Set K) := by
    have h : (![p, bi + (ai - 1) * algebraMap k K κ] : Fin 2 → K) 1 ∈
        racl k ((![p, bi + (ai - 1) * algebraMap k K κ] : Fin 2 → K) '' {0}) := by
      simpa using hwm
    have h' := mem_racl_image_of_idealOf_eq k hI h
    simpa using h'
  exact racl_singleton_congr hpold hwold

name: AclGeom.racl_normalized_P_of_supplied_fresh_inputs
statement:
theorem racl_normalized_P_of_supplied_fresh_inputs [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K]
    {a b x c p δ f : K}
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b, x, c])
    (hp : p ∈ racl k ({a, b} : Set K)) (hpa : p ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K))
    (hδx : δ ∈ racl k ({a, x} : Set K)) (hδa : δ ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K))
    (hδy : δ ∈ racl k ({p, a * x + b} : Set K)) (hf : f ∈ racl k ({c, δ} : Set K))
    (hfm : f ∈ racl k ({a * c, x} : Set K)) (hfu : f ∉ racl k ({a * c} : Set K)) :
    ∃ F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ↥(adjoin k ({f} : Set K)), Prime F ∧
      idealOf ↥(adjoin k ({f} : Set K)) ![a * c, x] = Ideal.span {F} ∧
      ∀ (t : ℕ → K),
        (∀ q < 2 * F.totalDegree + 1,
          t q ∉ racl k ({a, b, x, c} ∪ t '' Set.Iio q)) →
        ∃ κ : k, racl k ({p} : Set K) =
          racl k ({b + (a - 1) * algebraMap k K κ} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hspan, H⟩ := constructed_fresh_literal_colored_family
    hind hp hpa hδx hδa hδy hf hfm hfu
  refine ⟨F, hF, hspan, fun t ht ↦ ?_⟩
  let n := 2 * F.totalDegree + 1
  obtain ⟨a', b', x', hfresh, hJ, hpi, hδi, hval, hdiff, S, hD, hcolor⟩ := H n t ht
  let L := racl k ({a, f} ∪ a' '' Set.Iio n)
  let color : ℕ → Ideal (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ↥L) :=
    fun q ↦ idealOf ↥L ![a' q * c, x' q]
  obtain ⟨i, j, r, hij, hir, hjr, hr, hj, hcj, hcr⟩ :=
    same_color_triple color S hD (by dsimp [n]; omega) hcolor
  have hi : i < n := lt_trans hij hj
  have hcenter : (b' i - b' j) / (a' j - a' i) =
      (b' i - b' r) / (a' r - a' i) := by
    have ha : ∀ q < n, a' q ∈ L :=
      fun q hq ↦ subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩)
    have hai0 : a' i ≠ 0 := by
      intro he
      apply hfresh i hi
      rw [he]
      exact zero_mem _
    have hfL : f ∈ L := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
    have hc : c ∉ L := scale_notMem_racl_of_fresh_multipliers hind hfm hfu hfresh
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, hxi⟩ := affine_multiplier_curve_of_joint_ideal (hJ i hi) hfm hfu
    obtain ⟨_, hxL⟩ := generic_multiplier_pair ({a, f} ∪ a' '' Set.Iio n)
      (ha i hi) hai0 hfL hc hxi
    exact same_color_common_center ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) hfresh hij hir hj hr ha hdiff
      ((hval j hj).trans (hval i hi).symm) ((hval r hr).trans (hval i hi).symm) hxL hcj hcr
  have h3 : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b, x] := by
    have heq : (fun q : Fin 3 ↦ (![a, b, x, c] : Fin 4 → K) q.castSucc) =
        ![a, b, x] := by
      funext q
      fin_cases q <;> rfl
    exact heq ▸ hind.comp (fun q : Fin 3 ↦ q.castSucc) (Fin.castSucc_injective 3)
  have hpair := pairwise_cocycles_of_fresh_family h3 hp hpa hδx hδa
    a' b' x' hfresh hJ hpi hδi hval
  have hNF2 (u v w : ℕ) (huw : u < w) (hvw : v < w) (hw : w < n) :
      a' w ∉ racl k ({a' u, a' v} : Set K) := by
    have hsub : ({a' u, a' v} : Set K) ⊆ ({a, b, x, c} ∪ a' '' Set.Iio w) :=
      Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨u, huw, rfl⟩,
        Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨v, hvw, rfl⟩)⟩
    exact fun h ↦ hfresh w hw (racl_mono hsub h)
  have hNF1 (u v : ℕ) (huv : u < v) (hv : v < n) :
      a' v ∉ racl k ({a' u} : Set K) := by
    simpa using hNF2 u u v huv huv hv
  have htcenter : (b' i - b' j) / (a' j - a' i) ∈ racl k (∅ : Set K) := by
    by_cases hjlt : j < r
    · exact common_center_mem_racl_empty (hNF1 i j hij hj) (hNF2 i j r hir hjlt hr)
        (hpair i j hij hj) (hpair i r hir hr) (hpair j r hjlt hr) hcenter
    · have hrlt : r < j := by omega
      rw [hcenter]
      exact common_center_mem_racl_empty (hNF1 i r hir hr) (hNF2 i r j hij hrlt hj)
        (hpair i r hir hr) (hpair i j hij hj) (hpair r j hrlt hj) hcenter.symm
  let θ := (b' i - b' j) / (a' j - a' i)
  have hpai : p ∉ racl k ({a' i} : Set K) := by
    have h : (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a, b, x])
        (Sum.inl (0 : Fin 5)) ∉
        racl k ((Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a, b, x]) ''
          {Sum.inr (0 : Fin 3)}) := by
      simpa using hpa
    have h' := notMem_racl_image_of_idealOf_eq k (hJ i hi).symm h
    simpa using h'
  have hpS : p ∈ racl k ({a, b, x, c} ∪ a' '' Set.Iio j) :=
    racl_mono (by
      intro z hz
      apply Set.mem_union_left
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz ⊢
      tauto) hp
  have hNFjaip : a' j ∉ racl k ({a' i, p} : Set K) := by
    have hsub : ({a' i, p} : Set K) ⊆
        racl k ({a, b, x, c} ∪ a' '' Set.Iio j) :=
      Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨i, hij, rfl⟩),
        Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hpS⟩
    exact fun h ↦ hfresh j hj (racl_le_of_subset_racl hsub h)
  have h0j : a' j - a' i ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hNF1 i j hij hj
    rw [sub_eq_zero.1 h]
    exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
  have hconc : b' i + (a' i - 1) * θ = b' j + (a' j - 1) * θ := by
    have hD : θ * (a' j - a' i) = b' i - b' j := div_mul_cancel₀ _ h0j
    linear_combination -hD
  have hP := racl_singleton_eq_of_concurrent htcenter
    (hpi i hi) hpai (hpi j hj) hNFjaip hconc
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ⟩ := mem_range_algebraMap_of_isAlgebraic
    (isAlgebraic_of_mem_racl_empty htcenter)
  have hOriginal : racl k ({p} : Set K) =
      racl k ({b + (a - 1) * algebraMap k K κ} : Set K) :=
    original_p_of_shifted_joint_ideal (hJ i hi) κ (by simpa only [hκ] using hP)
  exact ⟨κ, hOriginal⟩

name: AclGeom.unitsMulEquivConv_apply_val
statement:
theorem unitsMulEquivConv_apply_val (C : Type*) [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
    (f : WithConv (AddMonoidAlgebra k ℤ →ₐ[k] C)) :
    ((unitsMulEquivConv k C f : Cˣ) : C) = f (AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 1)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AclGeom.unitsMulEquivConv_symm_apply_single

theorem unitsMulEquivConv_symm_apply_single (C : Type*) [CommRing C] [Algebra k C] (u : Cˣ) :
