name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.germToFunctionField_top_comp
statement:
theorem Hom.germToFunctionField_top_comp {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsDominant f] :
    Y.germToFunctionField ⊤ (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint Y, trivial⟩⟩) ≫
        f.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap =
      f.appTop ≫ X.germToFunctionField ⊤ (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint X, trivial⟩⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have h := PartialMap.fromFunctionField_eq_functionFieldMorphismOfHom f.toPartialMap
  rw [Hom.fromFunctionField_toPartialMap] at h
  change X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X) ≫ f =
    Spec.map f.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap ≫ Y.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Y) at h
  apply Spec.map_injective
  change Spec.map (Y.presheaf.germ ⊤ (genericPoint Y) trivial ≫
      f.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap) =
    Spec.map (f.appTop ≫ X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (genericPoint X) trivial)
  calc
    _ = Spec.map f.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap ≫
        Y.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Y) ≫ Y.toSpecΓ := by
      rw [Spec.map_comp, fromSpecStalk_toSpecΓ]
    _ = (X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X) ≫ f) ≫ Y.toSpecΓ := by
      rw [← Category.assoc, ← h]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Category.assoc, Scheme.toSpecΓ_naturality, ← Category.assoc,
        fromSpecStalk_toSpecΓ, ← Spec.map_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AclGeom.ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAlgebra_eq_germ
statement:
theorem functionFieldAlgebra_eq_germ {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] :
    functionFieldAlgebra V =
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ V.hom.appTop ≫
        V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤ (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint V.left, trivial⟩⟩)).hom.toAlgebra
proof:
:= by
  have := isDominant_hom V
  apply Algebra.algebra_ext
  intro c
  change (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap (CommRingCat.of k) (Spec (.of k)).functionField) ≫
      V.hom.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap) c = _
  have hbase : CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap (CommRingCat.of k) (Spec (.of k)).functionField) =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫
        (Spec (.of k)).germToFunctionField ⊤ (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint _, trivial⟩⟩) := by
    rw [Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv]
    rfl
  rw [hbase, Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.germToFunctionField_top_comp]
  rfl

name: AclGeom.SchemeAffineParameterCover.exists_finite_parameter_cover
statement:
theorem exists_finite_parameter_cover
    (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (hker : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
      ModObj.pointAct V q = 𝟙 V → q = 1)
    (hdimG : (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDim G.toAlgebraicGroup.carrier)
    (hdimV : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1) :
    ∃ t : V.left.functionField, Transcendental k t ∧
      IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set V.left.functionField) = ⊤ ∧
      ∃ Φ : (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) →* AffineTransformation k,
        Function.Injective Φ ∧
        (∀ q, (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V q).unop t =
          algebraMap k V.left.functionField ((Φ q).multiplier : k) * t +
            algebraMap k V.left.functionField (Φ q).shift) ∧
      ∃ f : G.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k),
        Function.Injective (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X ↦
          q ≫ f.hom.hom) ∧
        (∀ q, AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom) = Φ q) ∧
      ∃ (U T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (jU : U ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X)
        (jT : T ⟶ (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k).toGroupScheme.X) (π : U ⟶ T),
        IsOpenImmersion jU.left ∧ IsOpenImmersion jT.left ∧
        Nonempty U.left ∧ Nonempty T.left ∧ IsFinite π.left ∧ Surjective π.left ∧
        jU ≫ f.hom.hom = π ≫ jT ∧
          ∃ (W : Over (Spec (.of k))) (hI : IsIntegral W.left) (hA : IsAffine W.left)
            (j : W ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) (_ : IsOpenImmersion j.left),
            letI
proof:
:= hI
            letI := hA
            letI := sectionsAlgebra W
            let A : Type u := Γ(W.left, ⊤)
            let C := FractionRing A
            let F : Type u := V.left.functionField
            let E := FractionRing (C ⊗[k] F)
            let g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X :=
              (sectionsSpecIso W).inv ≫ j
            let evC : A →ₐ[k] C := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A C
            let τ := sectionsTensorAut V ((algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom evC).op ≫ g)
            let T := algebraMap (C ⊗[k] F) E (1 ⊗ₜ[k] t)
            Algebra.FiniteType k A ∧
              ∃ d a b : A, d ≠ 0 ∧ a ≠ 0 ∧
                FiniteDimensional
                  (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({evC a / evC d, evC b / evC d} : Set C)) C ∧
                IsTranscendenceBasis k (![evC a / evC d, evC b / evC d] : Fin 2 → C) ∧
                (∀ (φ : A →ₐ[k] k), φ d ≠ 0 →
                  (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V
                    ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
                      (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)).unop t =
                        algebraMap k F (φ a / φ d) * t + algebraMap k F (φ b / φ d)) ∧
                ∃ hCF : IsDomain (C ⊗[k] F),
                  letI := hCF
                  ∃ hCR : IsDomain (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)),
                    letI := hCR
                    ∃ (σ : E ≃ₐ[C] E) (e : E ≃ₐ[C] FractionRing (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤))),
                      (∀ (c : C) (r : Γ(V.left, ⊤)),
                        e (algebraMap (C ⊗[k] F) E
                          (c ⊗ₜ[k] V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤
                            (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint _, trivial⟩⟩) r)) =
                              algebraMap (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)) _ (c ⊗ₜ[k] r)) ∧
                      (∀ x, e (σ x) = IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv τ (e x)) ∧
                      σ T = algebraMap C E (evC a / evC d) * T +
                        algebraMap C E (evC b / evC d) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htop, Φ, hΦinj, hΦ, f, hfinj, hpoint,
    W, hI, hA, j, hOpen, hft, d, a, b, hd, ha, hfinite, hbasis,
    hformula, hCF, hCR, σ, e, he, hcompare, hgeneric⟩ :=
    SchemeAffineMorphism.exists_affine_morphism G V hker hdimG hdimV
  have := hI
  have := hA
  have := hOpen
  let A : Type u := Γ(W.left, ⊤)
  let : Algebra k A := sectionsAlgebra W
  have : Algebra.FiniteType k A := hft
  let g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X :=
    (sectionsSpecIso W).inv ≫ j
  have : IsIso (sectionsSpecIso W).inv.left :=
    ActionFunctionField.isIso_inv_left (sectionsSpecIso W)
  have : IsOpenImmersion g.left := by
    change IsOpenImmersion ((sectionsSpecIso W).inv.left ≫ j.left)
    infer_instance
  have hraw (φ : A →ₐ[k] k) (hdφ : φ d ≠ 0) :
      ((Φ ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
        (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)).multiplier : k) =
          φ a / φ d ∧
      (Φ ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
        (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)).shift = φ b / φ d := by
    let q := (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
      (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g
    have hp : algebraMap k V.left.functionField ((Φ q).multiplier : k) * t +
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField (Φ q).shift =
      algebraMap k V.left.functionField (φ a / φ d) * t +
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField (φ b / φ d) :=
      (hΦ q).symm.trans (hformula φ hdφ)
    have hpoly : Polynomial.C ((Φ q).multiplier : k) * Polynomial.X +
        Polynomial.C (Φ q).shift =
      Polynomial.C (φ a / φ d) * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C (φ b / φ d) := by
      apply transcendental_iff_injective.mp ht
      simpa only [map_add, map_mul, Polynomial.aeval_C, Polynomial.aeval_X] using hp
    constructor
    · simpa using congrArg (fun p : Polynomial k ↦ p.coeff 1) hpoly
    · simpa using congrArg (fun p : Polynomial k ↦ p.coeff 0) hpoly
  obtain ⟨U, T, jU, jT, π, hjU, hjT, hU, hT, hπfin, hπsurj, hπ⟩ :=
    AffineGroupScheme.exists_finite_chart G.toAlgebraicGroup f Φ hΦinj hpoint
      g d a b hd hbasis.1 hraw
  exact ⟨t, ht, htop, Φ, hΦinj, hΦ, f, hfinj, hpoint,
    U, T, jU, jT, π, hjU, hjT, hU, hT, hπfin, hπsurj, hπ,
    W, hI, hA, j, hOpen, hft, d, a, b, hd, ha, hfinite, hbasis, hformula,
    hCF, hCR, σ, e, he, hcompare, hgeneric⟩

name: AclGeom.curveCoset_additive_of_finiteCorrespondence
statement:
theorem curveCoset_additive_of_finiteCorrespondence [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    {x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ : Ω} (hx : AlgebraicIndependent k ![x₁, x₂])
    (h₁ : point k x₁ = point k y₁) (h₂ : point k x₂ = point k y₂)
    (h₁₂ : point k (x₁ + x₂) = point k (y₁ + y₂)) :
    ∃ (H : AddSubgroup (Fin 2 → k)) (F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (g₁ g₂ : Fin 2 → k),
      Prime F ∧ vanishingIdeal k (H : Set (Fin 2 → k)) = Ideal.span {F} ∧
      zeroLocus k (vanishingIdeal k (H : Set (Fin 2 → k))) = H ∧
      ConnectedSpace
        (PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k ⧸ vanishingIdeal k (H : Set (Fin 2 → k)))) ∧
      ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k ⧸ vanishingIdeal k (H : Set (Fin 2 → k))) = 1 ∧
      (∃ u ∈ H, ∃ v ∈ H, u 0 ≠ v 0) ∧ (∃ u ∈ H, ∃ v ∈ H, u 1 ≠ v 1) ∧
      idealOf k ![x₁, y₁] = Ideal.span {translate (-g₁) F} ∧
      idealOf k ![x₂, y₂] = Ideal.span {translate (-g₂) F} ∧
      idealOf k ![x₁ + x₂, y₁ + y₂] = Ideal.span {translate (-(g₁ + g₂)) F} ∧
      zeroLocus k (idealOf k ![x₁, y₁]) = g₁ +ᵥ (H : Set (Fin 2 → k)) ∧
      zeroLocus k (idealOf k ![x₂, y₂]) = g₂ +ᵥ (H : Set (Fin 2 → k)) ∧
      zeroLocus k (idealOf k ![x₁ + x₂, y₁ + y₂]) = (g₁ + g₂) +ᵥ (H : Set (Fin 2 → k))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨G, P, Q, hG, hGPQ, hP0, hQ0, hP, hQ, hPa, hQa, d₁, d₂, hd₁, hd₂⟩ :
      ∃ (G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (P Q : Polynomial k), Prime G ∧
        G = Polynomial.aeval (X 0) P + Polynomial.aeval (X 1) Q ∧
        P.coeff 0 = 0 ∧ Q.coeff 0 = 0 ∧ P ≠ 0 ∧ Q ≠ 0 ∧ IsAdditive P ∧ IsAdditive Q ∧
        ∃ d₁ d₂ : k, aeval ![x₁, y₁] G = algebraMap k Ω d₁ ∧
          aeval ![x₂, y₂] G = algebraMap k Ω d₂ := by
    let ι : Ω →ₐ[k] FreshAmbient Ω := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k Ω (FreshAmbient Ω)
    have hι : Function.Injective ι := ι.toRingHom.injective
    have htr := four_le_trdeg_freshAmbient k Ω
    have hpt : ∀ {u v : Ω}, point k u = point k v → racl k {ι u} = racl k {ι v} :=
      fun {u v} h ↦ by
        simpa [Set.image_singleton] using
          algHom_racl_image_eq_of_racl_eq ι (congrArg Subtype.val h : racl k {u} = racl k {v})
    have mem : ∀ {u v : FreshAmbient Ω}, racl k {u} = racl k {v} → v ∈ racl k {u} :=
      fun h ↦ by
        rw [h]
        exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_singleton _)
    have h₁' := hpt h₁
    have h₂' := hpt h₂
    have h₁₂' : racl k {ι x₁ + ι x₂} = racl k {ι y₁ + ι y₂} := by
      simpa only [map_add] using hpt h₁₂
    let S : AddCorrSetup k (FreshAmbient Ω) :=
      { x₁ := ι x₁, y₁ := ι y₁, x₂ := ι x₂, y₂ := ι y₂
        indep := by
          convert hx.map' hι using 1
          funext i
          fin_cases i <;> rfl
        y₁_mem := mem h₁', x₁_mem := mem h₁'.symm, y₂_mem := mem h₂', x₂_mem := mem h₂'.symm
        sum_mem := mem h₁₂', sum_mem' := mem h₁₂'.symm }
    have fresh : ∀ T : Finset (FreshAmbient Ω), T.card ≤ 3 →
        ∃ z : FreshAmbient Ω, z ∉ racl k (T : Set (FreshAmbient Ω)) :=
      exists_notMem_racl_of_card_lt_trdeg (n := 3) (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) htr)
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := fresh {ι x₁, ι x₂} (Finset.card_le_two.trans (by decide))
    obtain ⟨s', hs'⟩ := fresh {ι x₁, ι x₂, s} Finset.card_le_three
    have hs₀ : s ∉ racl k ({ι x₁, ι x₂} : Set (FreshAmbient Ω)) := by simpa using hs
    have hs₁ : s' ∉ racl k ({ι x₁, ι x₂, s} : Set (FreshAmbient Ω)) := by simpa using hs'
    obtain ⟨G, P, Q, hG, hGPQ, hP0, hQ0, hP, hQ, hPa, hQa, d₁, d₂, hd₁, hd₂⟩ :=
      S.exists_delta_gen_data (s := s) (s' := s') hs₀ hs₁
    have pull : ∀ {u v : Ω} {d : k},
        aeval ![ι u, ι v] G = algebraMap k (FreshAmbient Ω) d →
        aeval ![u, v] G = algebraMap k Ω d := fun {u v d} h ↦ hι (by
      have e : (fun i ↦ ι (![u, v] i)) = ![ι u, ι v] := by
        funext i
        fin_cases i <;> rfl
      rw [AlgHom.commutes, MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply, e]
      exact h)
    exact ⟨G, P, Q, hG, hGPQ, hP0, hQ0, hP, hQ, hPa, hQa, d₁, d₂,
      pull (u := x₁) (v := y₁) hd₁, pull (u := x₂) (v := y₂) hd₂⟩
  
  have evalΩ : ∀ p : Fin 2 → Ω,
      aeval p G = Polynomial.aeval (p 0) P + Polynomial.aeval (p 1) Q := fun p ↦ by
    rw [hGPQ, map_add, ← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply (aeval p) (X 0) P,
      ← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply (aeval p) (X 1) Q, MvPolynomial.aeval_X,
      MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
  have evalk : ∀ p : Fin 2 → k, aeval p G = P.eval (p 0) + Q.eval (p 1) := fun p ↦ by
    rw [hGPQ, map_add, ← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply (aeval p) (X 0) P,
      ← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply (aeval p) (X 1) Q, MvPolynomial.aeval_X,
      MvPolynomial.aeval_X, Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval, Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval]
  have hneg : ∀ {R : Polynomial k}, IsAdditive R → ∀ a : k, R.eval (-a) = -R.eval a :=
    fun {R} hR a ↦ by
      have h := hR a (-a)
      rw [add_neg_cancel, hR.eval_zero] at h
      linear_combination -h
  
  have root : ∀ {R : Polynomial k}, R ≠ 0 → R.coeff 0 = 0 → ∀ d : k, ∃ a : k, R.eval a = d :=
    fun {R} hR hR0 d ↦ by
      have hdeg : 0 < R.degree := by
        by_contra h
        exact hR ((Polynomial.eq_C_of_degree_le_zero (not_lt.1 h)).trans (by rw [hR0, map_zero]))
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_root (R - Polynomial.C d)
        (by rw [Polynomial.degree_sub_C hdeg]; exact hdeg.ne')
      refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
      have h0 := ha.eq_zero
      rw [Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_C, sub_eq_zero] at h0
      exact h0
  
  have memShift : ∀ {u v : Ω} {d a : k}, aeval ![u, v] G = algebraMap k Ω d → P.eval a = d →
      translate (-![a, 0]) G ∈ idealOf k ![u, v] := by
    intro u v d a hd ha
    rw [mem_idealOf_iff, aeval_translate, evalΩ]
    change Polynomial.aeval (u + algebraMap k Ω (-a)) P +
      Polynomial.aeval (v + algebraMap k Ω (-0)) Q = 0
    rw [neg_zero, map_zero, add_zero, hPa.aeval_add,
      Polynomial.aeval_algebraMap_apply_eq_algebraMap_eval, hneg hPa, ha]
    have hd' := hd
    rw [evalΩ] at hd'
    change Polynomial.aeval u P + Polynomial.aeval v Q = algebraMap k Ω d at hd'
    rw [map_neg]
    linear_combination hd'
  
  have idealEq : ∀ {u v : Ω} {d a : k}, Transcendental k u → v ∈ racl k {u} →
      aeval ![u, v] G = algebraMap k Ω d → P.eval a = d →
      idealOf k ![u, v] = Ideal.span {translate (-![a, 0]) G} := by
    intro u v d a hu hv hd ha
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfI⟩ := exists_prime_span_idealOf k hu hv
    have hmem := memShift hd ha
    rw [hfI, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hmem
    rw [hfI]
    exact Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton.2
      (Prime.associated_of_dvd hf ((prime_translate_iff _).2 hG) hmem)
  
  have memΩ : ∀ {u v : Ω}, point k u = point k v → v ∈ racl k {u} := fun {u v} h ↦ by
    have hr : racl k {u} = racl k {v} := congrArg Subtype.val h
    rw [hr]
    exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_singleton _)
  let S₀ : AddCorrSetup k Ω :=
    { x₁ := x₁, y₁ := y₁, x₂ := x₂, y₂ := y₂, indep := hx
      y₁_mem := memΩ h₁, x₁_mem := memΩ h₁.symm, y₂_mem := memΩ h₂, x₂_mem := memΩ h₂.symm
      sum_mem := memΩ h₁₂, sum_mem' := memΩ h₁₂.symm }
  have hx₁t : Transcendental k x₁ := hx.transcendental 0
  have hx₂t : Transcendental k x₂ := hx.transcendental 1
  have hx₁₂t : Transcendental k (x₁ + x₂) := S₀.sum_fst_transcendental
  obtain ⟨a₁, ha₁⟩ := root hP hP0 d₁
  obtain ⟨a₂, ha₂⟩ := root hP hP0 d₂
  have ha₁₂ : P.eval (a₁ + a₂) = d₁ + d₂ := by rw [hPa, ha₁, ha₂]
  have hd₁₂ : aeval ![x₁ + x₂, y₁ + y₂] G = algebraMap k Ω (d₁ + d₂) := by
    have e₁ := hd₁
    have e₂ := hd₂
    rw [evalΩ] at e₁ e₂ ⊢
    change Polynomial.aeval x₁ P + Polynomial.aeval y₁ Q = algebraMap k Ω d₁ at e₁
    change Polynomial.aeval x₂ P + Polynomial.aeval y₂ Q = algebraMap k Ω d₂ at e₂
    change Polynomial.aeval (x₁ + x₂) P + Polynomial.aeval (y₁ + y₂) Q = _
    rw [hPa.aeval_add, hQa.aeval_add, map_add]
    linear_combination e₁ + e₂
  have hI₁ := idealEq hx₁t (memΩ h₁) hd₁ ha₁
  have hI₂ := idealEq hx₂t (memΩ h₂) hd₂ ha₂
  have hI₁₂ := idealEq hx₁₂t (memΩ h₁₂) hd₁₂ ha₁₂
  have hg : (![a₁, 0] : Fin 2 → k) + ![a₂, 0] = ![a₁ + a₂, 0] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp
  
  let H : AddSubgroup (Fin 2 → k) :=
    { carrier := {u | aeval u G = 0}
      add_mem' := fun {u v} hu hv ↦ by
        change aeval u G = 0 at hu
        change aeval v G = 0 at hv
        change aeval (u + v) G = 0
        rw [evalk] at hu hv ⊢
        rw [Pi.add_apply, Pi.add_apply, hPa, hQa]
        linear_combination hu + hv
      zero_mem' := by
        change aeval 0 G = 0
        rw [evalk, Pi.zero_apply, Pi.zero_apply, hPa.eval_zero, hQa.eval_zero, add_zero]
      neg_mem' := fun {u} hu ↦ by
        change aeval u G = 0 at hu
        change aeval (-u) G = 0
        rw [evalk] at hu ⊢
        rw [Pi.neg_apply, Pi.neg_apply, hneg hPa, hneg hQa]
        linear_combination -hu }
  have hHset : (H : Set (Fin 2 → k)) = zeroLocus k (Ideal.span {G}) := by
    rw [zeroLocus_span]
    ext u
    change aeval u G = 0 ↔ ∀ f ∈ ({G} : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)), aeval u f = 0
    exact ⟨fun h f hf ↦ by rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.1 hf]; exact h,
      fun h ↦ h G (Set.mem_singleton G)⟩
  have hGspan : (Ideal.span {G}).IsPrime := (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hG.ne_zero).2 hG
  have hvan : vanishingIdeal k (H : Set (Fin 2 → k)) = Ideal.span {G} := by
    rw [hHset, vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical, hGspan.radical]
  have hclosed : zeroLocus k (vanishingIdeal k (H : Set (Fin 2 → k))) = H := by
    rw [hvan, ← hHset]
  
  have hdim1 : ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k ⧸ Ideal.span {G}) = 1 := by
    have hdim : ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) = 2 := by
      rw [MvPolynomial.ringKrullDim_of_isNoetherianRing, ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_field]
      simp
    obtain ⟨M, hMmax, hIM⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal (idealOf k ![x₁, y₁])
      (idealOf_isPrime k ![x₁, y₁]).ne_top
    have : M.IsPrime := hMmax.isPrime
    have hlt : idealOf k ![x₁, y₁] < M :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne hIM fun h ↦ not_isMaximal_idealOf k hx₁t (h ▸ hMmax)
    have hne : (idealOf k ![x₁, y₁]).height ≠ 0 := fun h ↦
      idealOf_ne_bot_of_mem_racl k (memΩ h₁) (Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot.1 h)
    have hM2 : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ M.height :=
      calc (2 : ℕ∞) = 1 + 1 := one_add_one_eq_two.symm
        _ ≤ (idealOf k ![x₁, y₁]).height + 1 := by
          gcongr
          exact Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hne
        _ ≤ M.height := Ideal.height_add_one_le_of_lt_of_isPrime hlt
    have hMh : (M.height : WithBot ℕ∞) = ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) := by
      refine le_antisymm (Ideal.height_le_ringKrullDim_of_ne_top hMmax.ne_top) ?_
      rw [hdim]
      exact WithBot.coe_le_coe.2 hM2
    have hT := (prime_translate_iff (-![a₁, 0])).2 hG
    have hrM : translate (-![a₁, 0]) G ∈ M := hIM (by
      rw [hI₁]
      exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _))
    have key : ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k ⧸ Ideal.span {translate (-![a₁, 0]) G}) + 1 =
        ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) := by
      refine le_antisymm (ringKrullDim_quotient_succ_le_of_nonZeroDivisor
        (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hT.ne_zero)) ?_
      rw [← hMh]
      exact Ideal.height_le_ringKrullDim_quotient_add_one hrM
    let T : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k :=
      AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom (translate (-![a₁, 0])) (translate ![a₁, 0])
        (AlgHom.ext fun g ↦ by
          rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply]
          exact translate_neg_translate _ g)
        (AlgHom.ext fun g ↦ by
          rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply]
          exact translate_translate_neg _ g)
    have hmap : Ideal.span {translate (-![a₁, 0]) G} = (Ideal.span {G}).map
        (T.toRingEquiv : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →+* MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) := by
      rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
      rfl
    rw [← ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (Ideal.quotientEquiv _ _ T.toRingEquiv hmap), hdim,
      ← one_add_one_eq_two (R := WithBot ℕ∞), ENat.WithBot.add_one_cancel] at key
    exact key
  
  have cosetSet : ∀ g : Fin 2 → k,
      zeroLocus k (Ideal.span {translate (-g) G}) = g +ᵥ (H : Set (Fin 2 → k)) := by
    intro g
    ext u
    rw [zeroLocus_span, Set.mem_vadd_set_iff_neg_vadd_mem]
    change (∀ f ∈ ({translate (-g) G} : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)), aeval u f = 0) ↔
      aeval (-g + u) G = 0
    have hfun : (fun j ↦ u j + algebraMap k k ((-g) j)) = -g + u := by
      funext j
      simp [add_comm]
    have hu : aeval u (translate (-g) G) = aeval (-g + u) G := by
      rw [aeval_translate, hfun]
    exact ⟨fun h ↦ hu.symm.trans (h _ (Set.mem_singleton _)),
      fun h f hf ↦ by rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.1 hf, hu]; exact h⟩
  
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := root hQ hQ0 (-P.eval 1)
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := root hP hP0 (-Q.eval 1)
  have hproj₀ : ∃ u ∈ H, ∃ v ∈ H, u 0 ≠ v 0 := by
    refine ⟨0, H.zero_mem, ![1, b], ?_, by simp⟩
    change aeval ![1, b] G = 0
    rw [evalk]
    change P.eval 1 + Q.eval b = 0
    rw [hb, add_neg_cancel]
  have hproj₁ : ∃ u ∈ H, ∃ v ∈ H, u 1 ≠ v 1 := by
    refine ⟨0, H.zero_mem, ![c, 1], ?_, by simp⟩
    change aeval ![c, 1] G = 0
    rw [evalk]
    change P.eval c + Q.eval 1 = 0
    rw [hc, neg_add_cancel]
  refine ⟨H, G, ![a₁, 0], ![a₂, 0], hG, hvan, hclosed, ?_, ?_, hproj₀, hproj₁, hI₁, hI₂, ?_,
    ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hvan]
    infer_instance
  · rw [hvan]
    exact hdim1
  · rw [hg]
    exact hI₁₂
  · rw [hI₁]
    exact cosetSet _
  · rw [hI₂]
    exact cosetSet _
  · rw [hI₁₂, hg]
    exact cosetSet _

name: AclGeom.isNilpotent_of_forall_algHom_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  let : IsJacobsonRing S := isJacobsonRing_of_finiteType (A := k) (B := S)
  have hrad : z ∈ (⊥ : Ideal S).radical := by
    rw [Ideal.radical_eq_jacobson, Ideal.jacobson, Ideal.mem_sInf]
    intro M hM
    let : M.IsMaximal := hM.2
    let : Field (S ⧸ M) := Ideal.Quotient.field M
    let : Module.Finite k (S ⧸ M) := finite_of_finite_type_of_isJacobsonRing k (S ⧸ M)
    let φ : (S ⧸ M) →ₐ[k] k := IsAlgClosed.lift
    apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
    apply φ.injective
    change (φ.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k M)) z = φ 0
    rw [map_zero]
    exact hz _
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Ideal.mem_radical_iff.mp hrad
  exact ⟨n, Ideal.mem_bot.mp hn⟩

name: AclGeom.transcendental_one_tmul
statement:
theorem transcendental_one_tmul {L C E : Type*} [Field L] [Field C] [Field E]
    [Algebra L C] [Algebra L E] {r : E} (hr : Transcendental L r) :
    Transcendental C ((1 : C) ⊗ₜ[L] r : C ⊗[L] E)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : LinearIndependent L (fun n : ℕ ↦ r ^ n) := by
    have h := (Polynomial.basisMonomials L).linearIndependent.map'
      (Polynomial.aeval r).toLinearMap
      (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr (transcendental_iff_injective.mp hr))
    have he : (Polynomial.aeval r).toLinearMap ∘ Polynomial.basisMonomials L =
        fun n : ℕ ↦ r ^ n := by
      funext n
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, Polynomial.coe_basisMonomials,
        Polynomial.aeval_monomial, map_one, one_mul]
    rw [he] at h
    exact h
  have ht := Module.Flat.linearIndependent_one_tmul (S := C) hp
  have he : (Polynomial.aeval ((1 : C) ⊗ₜ[L] r : C ⊗[L] E)).toLinearMap ∘
      Polynomial.basisMonomials C = fun n : ℕ ↦ (1 : C) ⊗ₜ[L] (r ^ n) := by
    funext n
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, Polynomial.coe_basisMonomials,
      Polynomial.aeval_monomial, map_one, one_mul, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_pow, one_pow]
  apply transcendental_iff_injective.mpr
  apply LinearMap.injective_of_linearIndependent
    (f := (Polynomial.aeval ((1 : C) ⊗ₜ[L] r : C ⊗[L] E)).toLinearMap)
    (Polynomial.basisMonomials C).span_eq
  rw [he]
  exact ht

name: AclGeom.not_isNilpotent_tensor_diagonal
statement:
theorem not_isNilpotent_tensor_diagonal {L E : Type*} [Field L] [Field E] [Algebra L E]
    {r : E} (hr : Transcendental L r) :
    ¬ IsNilpotent (r ⊗ₜ[L] (1 : E) - (1 : E) ⊗ₜ[L] r)
proof:
:= by
  have : Nontrivial (E ⊗[L] E) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.nontrivial_of_algebraMap_injective_of_isDomain L E E
      (algebraMap L E).injective (algebraMap L E).injective
  intro hnil
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hnil
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    subst n
    simp only [pow_zero, one_ne_zero] at hn
  have hal : IsAlgebraic E (r ⊗ₜ[L] (1 : E) - (1 : E) ⊗ₜ[L] r) :=
    IsAlgebraic.of_pow (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn0) (by rw [hn]; exact isAlgebraic_zero)
  have hc : IsAlgebraic E (r ⊗ₜ[L] (1 : E)) := by
    change IsAlgebraic E (algebraMap E (E ⊗[L] E) r)
    exact isAlgebraic_algebraMap r
  apply transcendental_one_tmul (C := E) hr
  have he : -(r ⊗ₜ[L] (1 : E) - (1 : E) ⊗ₜ[L] r) + r ⊗ₜ[L] (1 : E) =
      (1 : E) ⊗ₜ[L] r := by rw [neg_sub, sub_add_cancel]
  rw [← he]
  exact hal.neg.add hc

name: AclGeom.tensor_diagonal_isNilpotent_of_injective_points
statement:
theorem tensor_diagonal_isNilpotent_of_injective_points
    {k B A : Type*} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CommRing B] [CommRing A]
    [Algebra k B] [Algebra k A] [Algebra B A] [IsScalarTower k B A]
    [Algebra.FiniteType k A]
    (hpoints : Function.Injective
      (fun φ : A →ₐ[k] k ↦ φ.comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k B A))) (a : A) :
    IsNilpotent (a ⊗ₜ[B] (1 : A) - (1 : A) ⊗ₜ[B] a)
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra.FiniteType B A := Algebra.FiniteType.of_restrictScalars_finiteType k B A
  have : Algebra.FiniteType k (A ⊗[B] A) :=
    Algebra.FiniteType.trans (S := A) inferInstance inferInstance
  apply isNilpotent_of_forall_algHom_eq_zero (k := k)
  intro φ
  let f : A →ₐ[k] k := φ.comp
    ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : A →ₐ[B] A ⊗[B] A).restrictScalars k)
  let g : A →ₐ[k] k := φ.comp
    ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[B] A ⊗[B] A).restrictScalars k)
  have he : f.comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k B A) =
      g.comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k B A) := by
    ext b
    change φ ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : A →ₐ[B] A ⊗[B] A)
        (algebraMap B A b)) =
      φ ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[B] A ⊗[B] A) (algebraMap B A b))
    rw [AlgHom.commutes, AlgHom.commutes]
  have hf := hpoints he
  rw [map_sub]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mpr (AlgHom.congr_fun hf a)

name: AclGeom.isAlgebraic_fractionRing_of_injective_points
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_fractionRing_of_injective_points
    {k B A C E : Type*} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CommRing B]
    [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Algebra k B] [Algebra k A] [Algebra B A]
    [IsScalarTower k B A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A]
    [Field C] [Field E] [Algebra B C]
    [Algebra A E] [IsFractionRing A E] [Algebra B E] [IsScalarTower B A E]
    [Algebra C E] [IsScalarTower B C E]
    (hpoints : Function.Injective
      (fun φ : A →ₐ[k] k ↦ φ.comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k B A))) :
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic C E
proof:
:= by
  have ha (a : A) : IsAlgebraic C (algebraMap A E a) := by
    by_contra h
    have htr : Transcendental C (algebraMap A E a) := h
    have hd := tensor_diagonal_isNilpotent_of_injective_points hpoints a
    let f : A →ₐ[B] E ⊗[C] E :=
      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft : E →ₐ[C] E ⊗[C] E).restrictScalars B).comp
        (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom B A E)
    let g : A →ₐ[B] E ⊗[C] E :=
      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : E →ₐ[C] E ⊗[C] E).restrictScalars B).comp
        (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom B A E)
    let ψ : A ⊗[B] A →ₐ[B] E ⊗[C] E :=
      Algebra.TensorProduct.lift f g (fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _)
    have hd' : IsNilpotent ((algebraMap A E a) ⊗ₜ[C] (1 : E) -
        (1 : E) ⊗ₜ[C] (algebraMap A E a)) := by
      have hm := hd.map ψ
      change IsNilpotent (ψ (a ⊗ₜ[B] (1 : A) - (1 : A) ⊗ₜ[B] a)) at hm
      rw [map_sub, Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul, Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul] at hm
      simp only [map_one, mul_one, one_mul] at hm
      exact hm
    exact not_isNilpotent_tensor_diagonal htr hd'
  constructor
  intro x
  obtain ⟨a, b, _, rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective A x
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact (ha a).mul (IsAlgebraic.inv (ha b))

name: AclGeom.AdditiveRigidity.unitPoint_linePoint_scalarMul
statement:
theorem unitPoint_linePoint_scalarMul {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C] (a : Cˣ) (x : C) :
    lift (unitPoint k a) (AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k x) ≫ scalarMul k =
      AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k ((a : C) * x)
proof:
:= by
  let evalUnit : AddMonoidAlgebra k ℤ →ₐ[k] C := ((unitsMulEquivConv k C).symm a).ofConv
  let θ : AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1 →ₐ[k]
      AddMonoidAlgebra k ℤ ⊗[k] AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1 :=
    AffineSchemeAction.lineEval
    (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (1 : ℤ) (1 : k) ⊗ₜ[k] AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k)
  have hevalUnit : evalUnit (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (1 : ℤ) (1 : k)) = (a : C) :=
    unitsMulEquivConv_symm_apply_single k C a
  have hco : (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift evalUnit (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval x)
      (fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _)).comp θ = AffineSchemeAction.lineEval ((a : C) * x) := by
    apply AffineSchemeAction.lineHom_ext
    rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AffineSchemeAction.lineEval_lineCoordinate,
      AffineSchemeAction.lineEval_lineCoordinate, Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul,
      hevalUnit, AffineSchemeAction.lineEval_lineCoordinate]
  change lift ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom evalUnit.toRingHom)).asOver (Spec (.of k)))
      ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval x).toRingHom)).asOver
        (Spec (.of k))) ≫ (AffineSchemeAction.tensorSpecIso k _ _).hom ≫
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom θ.toRingHom)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) =
    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval ((a : C) * x)).toRingHom)).asOver (Spec (.of k))
  rw [← Category.assoc, AffineSchemeAction.lift_tensorSpecIso_hom, ← hco]
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  change Spec.map _ ≫ Spec.map _ = Spec.map _
  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
  rfl

name: AclGeom.SmoothCurveStalks.kerCotangentToTensor_injective_of_section
statement:
theorem kerCotangentToTensor_injective_of_section
    {k : Type u} {R : Type v} {S : Type w}
    [CommRing k] [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra k R] [Algebra k S] [Algebra R S] [IsScalarTower k R S]
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (algebraMap R S))
    (σ : S →ₐ[k] R) (hσ : (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k R S).comp σ = AlgHom.id k S) :
    Function.Injective (KaehlerDifferential.kerCotangentToTensor k R S)
proof:
:= by
  let f := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k R S
  let g : S →ₐ[k] R ⧸ (RingHom.ker (algebraMap R S)) ^ 2 :=
    (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k _).comp σ
  have hg : f.kerSquareLift.comp g = AlgHom.id k S := by
    ext x
    change f.kerSquareLift (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (σ x)) = x
    rw [AlgHom.kerSquareLift_mk]
    exact AlgHom.congr_fun hσ x
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ :=
    (retractionKerCotangentToTensorEquivSection (R := k) (P := R) (S := S) hsurj).symm ⟨g, hg⟩
  exact (show Function.LeftInverse l (KaehlerDifferential.kerCotangentToTensor k R S) from
    fun x ↦ LinearMap.congr_fun hl x).injective

name: AclGeom.SchemeAffineCurveDiagram.exists_curve_action_diagram
statement:
theorem exists_curve_action_diagram
    (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (hker : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
      ModObj.pointAct V q = 𝟙 V → q = 1)
    (hdimG : (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDim G.toAlgebraicGroup.carrier)
    (hdimV : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1) :
    ∃ t : V.left.functionField, Transcendental k t ∧
      IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set V.left.functionField) = ⊤ ∧
      ∃ Φ : (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) →* AffineTransformation k,
        Function.Injective Φ ∧
        (∀ q, (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V q).unop t =
          algebraMap k V.left.functionField ((Φ q).multiplier : k) * t +
            algebraMap k V.left.functionField (Φ q).shift) ∧
      ∃ f : G.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k),
        Function.Injective (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X ↦
          q ≫ f.hom.hom) ∧
        (∀ q, AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom) = Φ q) ∧
      ∃ (V₀ : Over (Spec (.of k))) (jV : V₀ ⟶ V)
        (x : V₀ ⟶ (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X)
        (gV : (Spec V.left.functionField).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ V₀),
        IsOpenImmersion jV.left ∧ Nonempty V₀.left ∧
        gV ≫ jV = SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter V ∧
        gV ≫ x = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k t ∧
      ∃ (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (i : D ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X ⊗ V)
        (s z : D ⟶ V₀), IsOpenImmersion i.left ∧ Nonempty D.left ∧
        s ≫ jV = i ≫ snd G.toGroupScheme.X V ∧
        z ≫ jV = i ≫ γ[G.toGroupScheme.X, V] ∧
        z ≫ x = lift (i ≫ fst G.toGroupScheme.X V ≫ f.hom.hom) (s ≫ x) ≫
          AffineSchemeAction.smul k ∧
      ∃ (U T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (jU : U ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X)
        (jT : T ⟶ (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k).toGroupScheme.X) (π : U ⟶ T),
        IsOpenImmersion jU.left ∧ IsOpenImmersion jT.left ∧
        Nonempty U.left ∧ Nonempty T.left ∧ IsFinite π.left ∧ Surjective π.left ∧
        jU ≫ f.hom.hom = π ≫ jT ∧
          ∃ (W : Over (Spec (.of k))) (hI : IsIntegral W.left) (hA : IsAffine W.left)
            (j : W ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) (_ : IsOpenImmersion j.left),
            letI
proof:
:= hI
            letI := hA
            letI := sectionsAlgebra W
            let A : Type u := Γ(W.left, ⊤)
            let C := FractionRing A
            let F : Type u := V.left.functionField
            let E := FractionRing (C ⊗[k] F)
            let g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X :=
              (sectionsSpecIso W).inv ≫ j
            let evC : A →ₐ[k] C := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A C
            let τ := sectionsTensorAut V ((algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom evC).op ≫ g)
            let T := algebraMap (C ⊗[k] F) E (1 ⊗ₜ[k] t)
            Algebra.FiniteType k A ∧
              ∃ d a b : A, d ≠ 0 ∧ a ≠ 0 ∧
                FiniteDimensional
                  (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({evC a / evC d, evC b / evC d} : Set C)) C ∧
                IsTranscendenceBasis k (![evC a / evC d, evC b / evC d] : Fin 2 → C) ∧
                (∀ (φ : A →ₐ[k] k), φ d ≠ 0 →
                  (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V
                    ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
                      (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)).unop t =
                        algebraMap k F (φ a / φ d) * t + algebraMap k F (φ b / φ d)) ∧
                ∃ hCF : IsDomain (C ⊗[k] F),
                  letI := hCF
                  ∃ hCR : IsDomain (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)),
                    letI := hCR
                    ∃ (σ : E ≃ₐ[C] E) (e : E ≃ₐ[C] FractionRing (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤))),
                      (∀ (c : C) (r : Γ(V.left, ⊤)),
                        e (algebraMap (C ⊗[k] F) E
                          (c ⊗ₜ[k] V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤
                            (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint _, trivial⟩⟩) r)) =
                              algebraMap (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)) _ (c ⊗ₜ[k] r)) ∧
                      (∀ x, e (σ x) = IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv τ (e x)) ∧
                      σ T = algebraMap C E (evC a / evC d) * T +
                        algebraMap C E (evC b / evC d) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htop, Φ, hΦinj, hΦ, f, hfinj, hpoint,
    U, T, jU, jT, π, hjU, hjT, hU, hT, hπfin, hπsurj, hπ,
    W, hI, hA, j, hOpen, hft, d, a, b, hd, ha, hfinite, hbasis,
    hformula, hCF, hCR, σ, e, he, hcompare, hgeneric⟩ :=
    SchemeAffineParameterCover.exists_finite_parameter_cover G V hker hdimG hdimV
  obtain ⟨V₀, jV, x, gV, hjV, hV₀, hgjV, hgx, D, i, s, z, hi, hD, hsj, hzj, hdiagram⟩ :=
    CurveAffineCoordinate.exists_joint_diagram G V t f.hom.hom (fun q ↦ by
      simpa only [hpoint] using hΦ q)
  exact ⟨t, ht, htop, Φ, hΦinj, hΦ, f, hfinj, hpoint,
    V₀, jV, x, gV, hjV, hV₀, hgjV, hgx, D, i, s, z, hi, hD, hsj, hzj, hdiagram,
    U, T, jU, jT, π, hjU, hjT, hU, hT, hπfin, hπsurj, hπ,
    W, hI, hA, j, hOpen, hft, d, a, b, hd, ha, hfinite, hbasis, hformula,
    hCF, hCR, σ, e, he, hcompare, hgeneric⟩

name: AclGeom.CurveAffineCoordinate.exists_joint_diagram_on_coordinate
statement:
theorem exists_joint_diagram_on_coordinate
    (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom]
    [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (t : V.left.functionField)
    (U : Over (Spec (.of k))) (j : U ⟶ V) [IsOpenImmersion j.left]
    (x : U ⟶ (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X)
    (g : (Spec V.left.functionField).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ U)
    (hgj : g ≫ j = SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter V)
    (hgx : g ≫ x = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k t)
    (f : G.toGroupScheme.X ⟶ (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k).toGroupScheme.X)
    (hfield : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
      (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V q).unop t =
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField
          ((AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f)).multiplier : k) * t +
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f)).shift) :
    ∃ (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (i : D ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X ⊗ V)
        (s z : D ⟶ U), IsOpenImmersion i.left ∧ Nonempty D.left ∧
        s ≫ j = i ≫ snd G.toGroupScheme.X V ∧
        z ≫ j = i ≫ γ[G.toGroupScheme.X, V] ∧
        z ≫ x = lift (i ≫ fst G.toGroupScheme.X V ≫ f) (s ≫ x) ≫ AffineSchemeAction.smul k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let GX := G.toGroupScheme.X
  let L := (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X
  have hU : Nonempty U.left := ⟨g.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint V.left.functionField)⟩
  have : IsIntegral U.left := isIntegral_of_isOpenImmersion j.left
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType U.hom := by rw [← Over.w j]; infer_instance
  have : IsIntegral (GX ⊗ U).left := isIntegral_pullback_of_isAlgClosed GX.hom U.hom
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType (GX ⊗ U).hom := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback.fst GX.hom U.hom ≫ GX.hom)
    infer_instance
  let m : GX ⊗ U ⟶ V := GX ◁ j ≫ γ[GX, V]
  let D := pullback m j
  let i : D ⟶ GX ⊗ V := pullback.fst m j ≫ GX ◁ j
  let s : D ⟶ U := pullback.fst m j ≫ snd GX U
  let z : D ⟶ U := pullback.snd m j
  have hpb := (IsPullback.of_hasPullback m j).map (Over.forget _)
  have hfst : IsOpenImmersion (pullback.fst m j).left :=
    MorphismProperty.of_isPullback hpb.flip (inferInstance : IsOpenImmersion j.left)
  have hwhisker : IsOpenImmersion (GX ◁ j).left := by
    rw [Over.whiskerLeft_left]
    infer_instance
  have hi : IsOpenImmersion i.left := by
    change IsOpenImmersion ((pullback.fst m j).left ≫ (GX ◁ j).left)
    infer_instance
  have hsj : s ≫ j = i ≫ snd GX V := by simp [s, i]
  have hzj : z ≫ j = i ≫ γ[GX, V] := (pullback.condition (f := m) (g := j)).symm
  let pg : (Spec V.left.functionField).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ GX ⊗ U := lift 1 g
  have hpg : pg ≫ m = g ≫ j := by
    dsimp only [pg, m]
    rw [lift_whiskerLeft_assoc]
    change (1 : (Spec V.left.functionField).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ GX) • (g ≫ j) = _
    exact _root_.one_smul _ _
  let pd : (Spec V.left.functionField).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ D := pullback.lift pg g hpg
  have hD : Nonempty D.left := ⟨pd.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint V.left.functionField)⟩
  have : IsReduced D.left := isReduced_of_isOpenImmersion (pullback.fst m j).left
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType D.hom := by
    rw [← Over.w (pullback.fst m j)]
    infer_instance
  refine ⟨D, i, s, z, hi, hD, hsj, hzj, ?_⟩
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType ((z ≫ x).left ≫ L.hom) := by
    rw [Over.w (z ≫ x)]
    infer_instance
  refine AlgebraicGeometry.ext_of_apply_eq L.hom Set.univ isClosed_univ.isLocallyClosed
    dense_univ ?_ ((Over.w _).trans (Over.w _).symm)
  intro y _ hy
  let p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ D :=
    Over.homMk (pointOfClosedPoint D.hom y hy) (pointOfClosedPoint_comp D.hom y hy)
  let q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX := p ≫ i ≫ fst GX V
  let u : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ U := p ≫ s
  let v : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ U := p ≫ z
  let φ := AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f)
  have hqf : q ≫ f = (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
      AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k φ.multiplier φ.shift := by
    calc
      q ≫ f = (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k).symm φ :=
        ((AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k).symm_apply_apply _).symm
      _ = _ := by
        apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
        exact (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_left k φ).trans (Category.id_comp _).symm
  have huv : u ≫ (j ≫ (ModObj.pointAut V q).hom) = v ≫ j := by
    have hqu : q • (u ≫ j) = v ≫ j := by
      change lift q (u ≫ j) ≫ γ[GX, V] = _
      have hl : lift q (u ≫ j) = p ≫ i := by
        apply CartesianMonoidalCategory.hom_ext
        · simp [q]
        · simp only [lift_snd]
          dsimp only [u]
          rw [Category.assoc, hsj]
          exact (Category.assoc p i (snd GX V)).symm
      rw [hl, Category.assoc, ← hzj]
      exact (Category.assoc p z j).symm
    change u ≫ (j ≫ ((toUnit V ≫ q) • 𝟙 V)) = _
    rw [← Category.assoc, ModObj.comp_smul, ← Category.assoc,
      comp_toUnit, toUnit_unit, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
    exact hqu
  obtain ⟨_, heq⟩ := equivariance_on_pullback V U j x t g hgj hgx
    (ModObj.pointAut V q) φ.multiplier φ.shift (hfield q)
  let pq := pullback.lift u v huv
  have hpcoord : v ≫ x = u ≫ x ≫ ModObj.pointAct L (q ≫ f) := by
    have h := congrArg (fun h ↦ pq ≫ h) heq
    dsimp only [pq] at h
    simpa only [pullback.lift_snd_assoc, pullback.lift_fst_assoc, hqf] using h
  have hp : p ≫ (z ≫ x) =
      p ≫ (lift (i ≫ fst GX V ≫ f) (s ≫ x) ≫ AffineSchemeAction.smul k) := by
    change v ≫ x = _
    rw [hpcoord]
    change (u ≫ x) ≫ ((toUnit L ≫ (q ≫ f)) • 𝟙 L) = _
    rw [ModObj.comp_smul, ← Category.assoc, comp_toUnit, toUnit_unit,
      Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id, Hom.smul_def, comp_lift_assoc]
    rfl
  have he := congrArg (fun h : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ L ↦
    h.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) hp
  have hpy : p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) = y := pointOfClosedPoint_apply D.hom y hy _
  change (z ≫ x).left (p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) =
    (lift (i ≫ fst GX V ≫ f) (s ≫ x) ≫ AffineSchemeAction.smul k).left
      (p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) at he
  rw [hpy] at he
  exact he

name: AclGeom.CurveAffineCoordinate.AclGeom.CurveAffineCoordinate.exists_joint_diagram
statement:
theorem exists_joint_diagram
    (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom]
    [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (t : V.left.functionField)
    (f : G.toGroupScheme.X ⟶ (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k).toGroupScheme.X)
    (hfield : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
      (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V q).unop t =
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField
          ((AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f)).multiplier : k) * t +
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f)).shift) :
    ∃ (U : Over (Spec (.of k))) (j : U ⟶ V)
      (x : U ⟶ (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X)
      (g : (Spec V.left.functionField).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ U),
      IsOpenImmersion j.left ∧ Nonempty U.left ∧
      g ≫ j = SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter V ∧
      g ≫ x = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k t ∧
      ∃ (D : Over (Spec (.of k))) (i : D ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X ⊗ V)
        (s z : D ⟶ U), IsOpenImmersion i.left ∧ Nonempty D.left ∧
        s ≫ j = i ≫ snd G.toGroupScheme.X V ∧
        z ≫ j = i ≫ γ[G.toGroupScheme.X, V] ∧
        z ≫ x = lift (i ≫ fst G.toGroupScheme.X V ≫ f) (s ≫ x) ≫ AffineSchemeAction.smul k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let GX := G.toGroupScheme.X
  let L := (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X
  obtain ⟨P, hPbase, hPgen⟩ := exists_partial_coordinate V t
  let U : Over (Spec (.of k)) := Over.mk (P.domain.ι ≫ V.hom)
  let j : U ⟶ V := Over.homMk P.domain.ι
  let x : U ⟶ L := Over.homMk P.hom hPbase
  let g : (Spec V.left.functionField).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ U :=
    Over.homMk P.genericLift (by
      change P.genericLift ≫ (P.domain.ι ≫ V.hom) = _
      rw [← Category.assoc, P.genericLift_ι]
      exact Over.w (SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter V))
  have hgj : g ≫ j = SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter V :=
    Over.OverMorphism.ext P.genericLift_ι
  have hgx : g ≫ x = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k t := Over.OverMorphism.ext hPgen
  have hU : Nonempty U.left := ⟨g.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint V.left.functionField)⟩
  have hj : IsOpenImmersion j.left := by
    change IsOpenImmersion P.domain.ι
    infer_instance
  obtain ⟨D, i, s, z, hi, hD, hsj, hzj, hdiagram⟩ :=
    exists_joint_diagram_on_coordinate G V t U j x g hgj hgx f hfield
  exact ⟨U, j, x, g, hj, hU, hgj, hgx, D, i, s, z, hi, hD, hsj, hzj, hdiagram⟩

name: AclGeom.SchemeParameterAction.spec_map_tensorMap
statement:
private theorem spec_map_tensorMap (φ : A →ₐ[k] B) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map φ (AlgHom.id k R)).toRingHom) ≫
      (pullbackSpecIso k A R).inv =
    (pullbackSpecIso k B R).inv ≫
      (((algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op) ⊗ₘ
        𝟙 ((Spec (.of R)).asOver (Spec (.of k)))).left
proof:
:= by
  have h := prodComparison_natural (algSpec (.of k)) (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op
    (𝟙 (op (CommAlgCat.of k R)))
  rw [(algSpec (.of k)).map_id] at h
  have h' := congrArg (fun f :
      (algSpec (.of k)).obj (op (CommAlgCat.of k (B ⊗[k] R))) ⟶
        (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⊗
          (Spec (.of R)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ↦ f.left) h
  exact h'

name: AclGeom.SchemeParameterAction.tensorAut_baseChange
statement:
theorem tensorAut_baseChange (φ : A →ₐ[k] B)
    (g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G) (x : A ⊗[k] R) :
    let f : (Spec (.of B)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶
        (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k))
proof:
:=
      (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map φ (AlgHom.id k R) (tensorAut g x) =
      tensorAut (f ≫ g) (Algebra.TensorProduct.map φ (AlgHom.id k R) x) := by
  let f : (Spec (.of B)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶
      (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) :=
    (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op
  let t := Algebra.TensorProduct.map φ (AlgHom.id k R)
  let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom t.toRingHom)
  let iA := pullbackSpecIso k A R
  let iB := pullbackSpecIso k B R
  let a : Limits.pullback (Spec.algebraMap k B) (Spec.algebraMap k R) ⟶
      Limits.pullback (Spec.algebraMap k A) (Spec.algebraMap k R) :=
    (f ⊗ₘ 𝟙 ((Spec (.of R)).asOver (Spec (.of k)))).left
  let pA : Limits.pullback (Spec.algebraMap k A) (Spec.algebraMap k R) ⟶
      Limits.pullback (Spec.algebraMap k A) (Spec.algebraMap k R) :=
    (ModObj.parameterAct ((Spec (.of R)).asOver (Spec (.of k))) g).left
  let pB : Limits.pullback (Spec.algebraMap k B) (Spec.algebraMap k R) ⟶
      Limits.pullback (Spec.algebraMap k B) (Spec.algebraMap k R) :=
    (ModObj.parameterAct ((Spec (.of R)).asOver (Spec (.of k))) (f ≫ g)).left
  have hn := congrArg (fun m :
      (Spec (.of B)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⊗ (Spec (.of R)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶
        (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⊗ (Spec (.of R)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ↦
      m.left) (ModObj.parameterAct_natural ((Spec (.of R)).asOver (Spec (.of k))) f g)
  change a ≫ pA = pB ≫ a at hn
  have hq := spec_map_tensorMap (R := R) φ
  change q ≫ iA.inv = iB.inv ≫ a at hq
  have hq' : q = iB.inv ≫ a ≫ iA.hom := by
    simpa only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id] using
      congrArg (fun m ↦ m ≫ iA.hom) hq
  have hs : CommRingCat.ofHom (tensorAut (R := R) g).toRingHom ≫
        CommRingCat.ofHom t.toRingHom =
      CommRingCat.ofHom t.toRingHom ≫
        CommRingCat.ofHom (tensorAut (R := R) (f ≫ g)).toRingHom := by
    apply Spec.map_injective
    simp only [Spec.map_comp]
    change q ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (tensorAut (R := R) g).toRingHom) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (tensorAut (R := R) (f ≫ g)).toRingHom) ≫ q
    rw [spec_map_tensorAut, spec_map_tensorAut]
    change q ≫ iA.inv ≫ pA ≫ iA.hom = iB.inv ≫ pB ≫ iB.hom ≫ q
    rw [hq']
    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg (fun m ↦ iB.inv ≫ m ≫ iA.hom) hn
  exact congrArg (fun m : CommRingCat.of (A ⊗[k] R) ⟶ CommRingCat.of (B ⊗[k] R) ↦
    m.hom x) hs

name: AclGeom.eq_pow_of_forall_dvd_choose
statement:
theorem eq_pow_of_forall_dvd_choose (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → (∀ j, 0 < j → j < i → p ∣ i.choose j) → ∃ r, i = p ^ r
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  intro i
  induction i using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ i ih =>
    intro hi h
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hi with h1 | h2
    · exact ⟨0, h1.symm⟩
    
    rcases lt_or_ge i p with hip | hpi
    · 
      exfalso
      have hdvd := h 1 one_pos h2
      rw [Nat.choose_one_right] at hdvd
      exact absurd (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdvd) (by omega)
    
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (i % p) with hd | hd
    · 
      have hpm : p * (i / p) = i := Nat.mul_div_cancel' (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero hd)
      have hm1 : 1 ≤ i / p := (Nat.one_le_div_iff hp.pos).2 hpi
      have hmlt : i / p < i := Nat.div_lt_self (by omega) hp.one_lt
      have hdesc : ∀ j, 0 < j → j < i / p → p ∣ (i / p).choose j := by
        intro j hj0 hjm
        have hlt : p * j < i := by
          calc p * j < p * (i / p) := (Nat.mul_lt_mul_left hp.pos).2 hjm
          _ = i := hpm
        have key := h (p * j) (Nat.mul_pos hp.pos hj0) hlt
        have hluc := Choose.choose_modEq_choose_mod_mul_choose_div_nat
          (n := i) (k := p * j) (p := p)
        rw [Nat.mul_mod_right, hd, Nat.choose_self, one_mul,
          Nat.mul_div_cancel_left j hp.pos] at hluc
        
        exact (Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd).1
          (hluc.symm.trans ((Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd).2 key))
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := ih (i / p) hmlt hm1 hdesc
      exact ⟨r + 1, by rw [pow_succ, ← hr, Nat.mul_comm]; exact hpm.symm⟩
    · 
      exfalso
      have key := h (i % p) hd (lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.mod_lt i hp.pos) hpi)
      have hluc := Choose.choose_modEq_choose_mod_mul_choose_div_nat
        (n := i) (k := i % p) (p := p)
      rw [Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ dvd_rfl, Nat.choose_self,
        Nat.div_eq_of_lt (Nat.mod_lt i hp.pos), Nat.choose_zero_right, mul_one] at hluc
      
      have h1 : (0 : ℕ) ≡ 1 [MOD p] :=
        ((Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd).2 key).symm.trans hluc
      have := (Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd).1 h1.symm
      exact absurd (Nat.le_of_dvd one_pos this) (by have := hp.two_le; omega)

statement: theorem isAdditive_zero : IsAdditive (0 : Polynomial K)

name: AclGeom.IsAdditive.eval_zero
statement:
theorem IsAdditive.eval_zero {P : Polynomial K} (hP : IsAdditive P) :
    P.eval 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := hP 0 0
  rw [add_zero] at h
  have h2 : P.eval 0 + P.eval 0 = P.eval 0 + 0 := by
    rw [add_zero]
    exact h.symm
  exact add_left_cancel h2

name: AclGeom.IsAdditive.coeff_zero
statement:
theorem IsAdditive.coeff_zero {P : Polynomial K} (hP : IsAdditive P) :
    P.coeff 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero]
  exact hP.eval_zero

name: AclGeom.IsAdditive.natCast_choose_mul_coeff
proof:
:= by
  
  have h1 : ∀ c : K, taylor c P = P + C (P.eval c) := by
    intro c
    refine Polynomial.funext fun x ↦ ?_
    rw [taylor_eval]
    simp [hP x c]
  
  have h2 : hasseDeriv j P = C (P.coeff j) := by
    refine Polynomial.funext fun c ↦ ?_
    have h3 := congrArg (fun Q ↦ Polynomial.coeff Q j) (h1 c)
    simp only [taylor_coeff, coeff_add, coeff_C, if_neg hj0, add_zero] at h3
    rw [h3, eval_C]
  
  have h4 := congrArg (fun Q ↦ Polynomial.coeff Q (i - j)) h2
  simp only [hasseDeriv_coeff, coeff_C, if_neg (Nat.sub_ne_zero_of_lt hji)] at h4
  rwa [Nat.sub_add_cancel hji.le] at h4

name: AclGeom.IsAdditive.eq_C_mul_X
statement:
theorem IsAdditive.eq_C_mul_X [CharZero K] {P : Polynomial K}
    (hP : IsAdditive P) : P = C (P.coeff 1) * X
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Infinite K := Infinite.of_injective _ (Nat.cast_injective (R := K))
  ext i
  rcases i with - | i
  · simpa using hP.coeff_zero
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos i with rfl | hi
  · simp
  · 
    have h := hP.natCast_choose_mul_coeff (i := i + 1) (j := 1) one_ne_zero (by omega)
    rw [Nat.choose_one_right] at h
    have hne : ((i + 1 : ℕ) : K) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 (by omega)
    have : P.coeff (i + 1) = 0 := by
      rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h with h' | h'
      · exact absurd h' hne
      · exact h'
    rw [this, coeff_C_mul, coeff_X]
    rw [if_neg (by omega : ¬(1 = i + 1)), mul_zero]

name: AclGeom.IsAdditive.coeff_eq_zero_of_ne_pow
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos i with rfl | hi0
  · exact hP.coeff_zero
  by_contra hne
  
  have hdvd : ∀ j, 0 < j → j < i → p ∣ i.choose j := by
    intro j hj0 hji
    have h := hP.natCast_choose_mul_coeff (i := i) (j := j) hj0.ne' hji
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h with h' | h'
    · exact (CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff K p _).1 h'
    · exact absurd h' hne
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := eq_pow_of_forall_dvd_choose p hp i hi0 hdvd
  exact hi r hr

name: AclGeom.eq_monomial_of_eq_smul_binomial
statement:
theorem eq_monomial_of_eq_smul_binomial {P Q : Polynomial K} {e c l : K}
    {m n : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) (hn : n ≠ 0) (hP0 : P.coeff 0 = 0) (hQ0 : Q.coeff 0 = 0)
    (h : C P - Q.map (C : K →+* Polynomial K) - C (C e) =
      l • (C ((X : Polynomial K) ^ m) -
        C (Polynomial.C c) * (X : Polynomial (Polynomial K)) ^ n)) :
    e = 0 ∧ P = C l * X ^ m ∧ Q = C (l * c) * X ^ n
proof:
:= by
  
  have h0 : P - C e = C l * X ^ m := by
    have h0' := congrArg (fun F ↦ Polynomial.coeff F 0) h
    simp only [coeff_sub, coeff_smul, coeff_map, coeff_C_zero, coeff_C_mul,
      coeff_X_pow, if_neg (fun hh : (0 : ℕ) = n ↦ hn hh.symm), mul_zero, sub_zero, hQ0,
      map_zero, smul_eq_C_mul] at h0'
    rw [← h0']
  
  have he : e = 0 := by
    have hc := congrArg (fun F ↦ Polynomial.coeff F 0) h0
    simp only [coeff_sub, coeff_C_zero, coeff_C_mul, coeff_X_pow,
      if_neg (fun hh : (0 : ℕ) = m ↦ hm hh.symm), mul_zero, hP0, zero_sub] at hc
    exact neg_eq_zero.1 hc
  refine ⟨he, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← h0, he, map_zero, sub_zero]
  
  · ext j
    rcases eq_or_ne j 0 with rfl | hj0
    · simp [hQ0, Ne.symm hn]
    have hj := congrArg (fun F ↦ Polynomial.coeff F j) h
    simp only [coeff_sub, coeff_smul, coeff_map, coeff_C, if_neg hj0,
      coeff_C_mul, coeff_X_pow, zero_sub, sub_zero, zero_sub] at hj
    rcases eq_or_ne j n with rfl | hjn
    · rw [if_pos rfl, mul_one, smul_neg] at hj
      
      have := neg_injective hj
      rw [smul_eq_C_mul, ← map_mul] at this
      rw [coeff_C_mul, coeff_X_pow, if_pos rfl, mul_one]
      exact C_injective this
    · rw [if_neg hjn, mul_zero, neg_zero, smul_zero, neg_eq_zero] at hj
      rw [coeff_C_mul, coeff_X_pow, if_neg hjn, mul_zero]
      exact C_injective (by rw [hj, map_zero])

name: AclGeom.IsAdditive.pow_exponent_of_monomial
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hz := hP.coeff_eq_zero_of_ne_pow p hp (i := m) hcon
  rw [hPm, coeff_C_mul, coeff_X_pow, if_pos rfl, mul_one] at hz
  exact hl hz

name: AclGeom.exists_connectedClosedSubgroup_of_points
statement:
theorem exists_connectedClosedSubgroup_of_points {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (G : AlgebraicGroup k) (Z : Closeds G.carrier) (hZi : IsIrreducible (Z : Set G.carrier))
    (h1 : (1 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X).left
      (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) ∈ Z)
    (hdiv : ∀ a b : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
      a.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) ∈ Z → b.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) ∈ Z →
        (a * b⁻¹).left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) ∈ Z) :
    ∃ (H : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k) (inclusion : H.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom G),
      IsClosedImmersion inclusion.schemeHom ∧ Set.range inclusion.schemeHom = Z ∧
      topologicalKrullDim H.toAlgebraicGroup.carrier = topologicalKrullDim Z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let G₀ := G.toGroupScheme.X
  let H₀ := reducedOver G₀ Z
  let i : H₀ ⟶ G₀ := reducedOverι G₀ Z
  have : IsIntegral H₀.left := isIntegral_subscheme_vanishingIdeal Z hZi
  have : IsClosedImmersion i.left := by
    change IsClosedImmersion (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal Z).subschemeι
    infer_instance
  have : Mono i.left := inferInstance
  have : Mono i := Over.mono_of_mono_left i
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType H₀.hom := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (i.left ≫ G₀.hom)
    infer_instance
  have : QuasiCompact H₀.hom := by
    change QuasiCompact (i.left ≫ G₀.hom)
    infer_instance
  have hirange : Set.range i.left = (Z : Set G.carrier) := by
    change Set.range (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal Z).subschemeι = Z
    rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.range_subschemeι, Scheme.IdealSheafData.coe_support_vanishingIdeal]
  have hi (x : H₀.left) : i.left x ∈ Z := by
    change i.left x ∈ (Z : Set G.carrier)
    rw [← hirange]
    exact Set.mem_range_self x
  let S : Subgroup (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G₀) :=
    Subgroup.ofDiv {p | p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) ∈ Z} ⟨1, h1⟩
      (fun a ha b hb ↦ hdiv a b ha hb)
  
  have range_of_points : ∀ {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} [LocallyOfFiniteType T.hom]
      (v : T ⟶ G₀),
      (∀ p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ T,
        (p ≫ v).left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) ∈ Z) → Set.range v.left ⊆ Z := by
    intro T _ v hv
    have : JacobsonSpace T.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.jacobsonSpace T.hom
    have hclosed := Z.isClosed.preimage v.left.continuous
    have hsub : closure (closedPoints T.left) ⊆ v.left ⁻¹' (Z : Set G.carrier) := by
      refine closure_minimal ?_ hclosed
      intro x hxc
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := (pointsEquivClosedPoints (G := T)).surjective
        (⟨x, hxc⟩ : closedPoints T.left)
      have he : p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) = x := congrArg Subtype.val hp
      have hz := hv p
      change v.left (p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) ∈ Z at hz
      rwa [he] at hz
    have hden : closure (closedPoints T.left) = Set.univ := by
      simpa only [Set.univ_inter, closure_univ] using
        JacobsonSpace.closure_inter_closedPoints_eq_closure
          (isClosed_univ : IsClosed (Set.univ : Set T.left)).isLocallyClosed
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact hsub (hden.symm ▸ Set.mem_univ x)
  have lift_of_points : ∀ {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} [IsReduced T.left]
      [LocallyOfFiniteType T.hom] (v : T ⟶ G₀),
      (∀ p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ T,
        (p ≫ v).left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) ∈ Z) → ∃ w : T ⟶ H₀, w ≫ i = v := by
    intro T _ _ v hv
    let w₀ := liftToReducedSubscheme Z v.left (range_of_points v hv)
    let w : T ⟶ H₀ := Over.homMk w₀ (by
      change w₀ ≫ (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal Z).subschemeι ≫ G₀.hom = T.hom
      rw [← Category.assoc, liftToReducedSubscheme_subschemeι]
      exact Over.w v)
    exact ⟨w, Over.OverMorphism.ext (liftToReducedSubscheme_subschemeι Z v.left
      (range_of_points v hv))⟩
  
  let e : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ H₀ := liftPoint Z 1 h1
  have he : e ≫ i = η[G₀] := by
    change liftPoint Z 1 h1 ≫ reducedOverι G₀ Z = η[G₀]
    rw [liftPoint_comp_reducedOverι, Hom.one_def, toUnit_unit, Category.id_comp]
  
  have : IsIntegral (H₀ ⊗ H₀).left :=
    isIntegral_pullback_of_isAlgClosed H₀.hom H₀.hom
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType (H₀ ⊗ H₀).hom := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback.fst H₀.hom H₀.hom ≫ H₀.hom)
    infer_instance
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := lift_of_points ((i ⊗ₘ i) ≫ μ[G₀]) (by
    intro p
    have ha : p ≫ fst H₀ H₀ ≫ i ∈ S := by
      change i.left ((p ≫ fst H₀ H₀).left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) ∈ Z
      exact hi _
    have hb : p ≫ snd H₀ H₀ ≫ i ∈ S := by
      change i.left ((p ≫ snd H₀ H₀).left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) ∈ Z
      exact hi _
    have hp : p ≫ (i ⊗ₘ i) ≫ μ[G₀] =
        (p ≫ fst H₀ H₀ ≫ i) * (p ≫ snd H₀ H₀ ≫ i) := by
      rw [← lift_fst_comp_snd_comp i i, ← Hom.mul_def, MonObj.comp_mul]
    rw [hp]
    exact S.mul_mem ha hb)
  
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := lift_of_points (i ≫ ι[G₀]) (by
    intro p
    have hp : p ≫ i ∈ S := by
      change i.left (p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) ∈ Z
      exact hi _
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← Hom.inv_def]
    exact S.inv_mem hp)
  
  let : GrpObj H₀ := groupObjectOfMono i e m j he hm hj
  let Hs : GroupScheme k := Grp.mk H₀
  let Ha : AlgebraicGroup k := AlgebraicGroup.ofGroupScheme Hs
  let Hc : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k :=
    { Ha with geometricallyIntegral := geometricallyIntegral_of_isAlgClosed H₀.hom }
  let inclusion : Hc.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom G := Grp.homMk'' i he hm
  let eh : H₀.left ≃ₜ Z :=
    i.left.isClosedEmbedding.isEmbedding.toHomeomorph.trans (Homeomorph.setCongr hirange)
  refine ⟨Hc, inclusion, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change IsClosedImmersion i.left
    infer_instance
  · exact hirange
  · exact IsHomeomorph.topologicalKrullDim_eq _ eh.isHomeomorph

name: AclGeom.MultiplicativeRigidity.normal_multiplicativeGroup_conj
statement:
theorem normal_multiplicativeGroup_conj
    (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (i : (multiplicativeGroup k).Hom G.toAlgebraicGroup)
    [IsMonHom.Normal i.hom.hom] :
    G.toGroupScheme.X ◁ i.hom.hom ≫ conj G.toGroupScheme.X =
      snd G.toGroupScheme.X (multiplicativeGroup k).toGroupScheme.X ≫ i.hom.hom
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let GX := G.toGroupScheme.X
  let N := (multiplicativeGroup k).toGroupScheme.X
  let i₀ : N ⟶ GX := i.hom.hom
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := IsMonHom.Normal.exists_comp_eq_conj i₀
  let c (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) : N ⟶ N :=
    lift (toUnit N ≫ q) (𝟙 N) ≫ ψ
  have hauto (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) : c q = 𝟙 N ∨ c q = ι[N] := by
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := NormalConjugation.exists_groupIso_conjugation_lift i₀ ψ hψ q
    simpa only [he] using groupIso_eq_id_or_inv k e
  have hc₁ : c 1 = 𝟙 N := by
    apply (cancel_mono i₀).mp
    simp [c, hψ, lift_whiskerLeft_assoc]
  have hcomp (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX)
      (p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ N) : p ≫ c q = lift q p ≫ ψ := by
    simp only [c, comp_lift_assoc, Category.comp_id]
    simp only [← Category.assoc, comp_toUnit, toUnit_unit, Category.id_comp]
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u : kˣ, u ≠ u⁻¹ := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Finset.exists_notMem ({0, 1, -1} : Finset k)
    have ha₀ : a ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ ha (by simp [h])
    have ha₁ : a ≠ 1 := fun h ↦ ha (by simp [h])
    have ha_neg_one : a ≠ -1 := fun h ↦ ha (by simp [h])
    let u := Units.mk0 a ha₀
    refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
    intro h
    have hm := congrArg (fun v : kˣ ↦ v * u) h
    rw [_root_.inv_mul_cancel] at hm
    have hm' := congrArg Units.val hm
    change a * a = 1 at hm'
    rcases mul_self_eq_one_iff.mp hm' with h | h
    · exact ha₁ h
    · exact ha_neg_one h
  let p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ N := (multiplicativeGroup.pointsMulEquiv k).symm u
  have hp : p ≠ p⁻¹ := by
    intro h
    apply hu
    simpa only [p, map_inv, MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using
      congrArg (multiplicativeGroup.pointsMulEquiv k) h
  have hpval : p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) ≠ (p⁻¹).left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) := by
    intro h
    exact hp (GroupScheme.pointsEquivClosedPoints.injective (Subtype.ext h))
  let O : GX ⟶ N := lift (𝟙 GX) (toUnit GX ≫ p) ≫ ψ
  have hOcomp (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) : q ≫ O = p ≫ c q := by
    rw [hcomp]
    simp only [O, comp_lift_assoc, Category.comp_id]
    simp only [← Category.assoc, comp_toUnit, toUnit_unit, Category.id_comp]
  have hO₁ : (1 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) ≫ O = p := by
    rw [hOcomp, hc₁, Category.comp_id]
  have hvals (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) : q ≫ O = p ∨ q ≫ O = p⁻¹ := by
    rw [hOcomp]
    rcases hauto q with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (by rw [h, Category.comp_id])
    · exact Or.inr (by rw [h]; rfl)
  have hpclosed : IsClosed ({p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)} : Set N.left) :=
    (GroupScheme.pointsEquivClosedPoints p).property
  have hpinvclosed : IsClosed ({(p⁻¹).left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)} : Set N.left) :=
    (GroupScheme.pointsEquivClosedPoints p⁻¹).property
  let Z₀ := O.left ⁻¹' {p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)}
  let Z₁ := O.left ⁻¹' {(p⁻¹).left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)}
  have hZ₀ : IsClosed Z₀ := hpclosed.preimage O.left.continuous
  have hZ₁ : IsClosed Z₁ := hpinvclosed.preimage O.left.continuous
  have hclosed : IsClosed (Z₀ ∪ Z₁) := hZ₀.union hZ₁
  have hsub : closedPoints GX.left ⊆ Z₀ ∪ Z₁ := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := GroupScheme.pointsEquivClosedPoints.surjective
      (⟨y, hy⟩ : closedPoints GX.left)
    have hqy : q.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) = y := congrArg Subtype.val hq
    rcases hvals q with h | h
    · left
      change O.left y = p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)
      rw [← hqy]
      exact congrArg (fun f ↦ f.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) h
    · right
      change O.left y = (p⁻¹).left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)
      rw [← hqy]
      exact congrArg (fun f ↦ f.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) h
  have : JacobsonSpace GX.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.jacobsonSpace GX.hom
  have hden : closure (closedPoints GX.left) = Set.univ := by
    simpa only [Set.univ_inter, closure_univ] using
      JacobsonSpace.closure_inter_closedPoints_eq_closure
        (isClosed_univ : IsClosed (Set.univ : Set GX.left)).isLocallyClosed
  have hcover : Set.univ ⊆ Z₀ ∪ Z₁ := by
    rw [← hden]
    exact closure_minimal hsub hclosed
  have hconst (y : GX.left) : O.left y = p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) := by
    rcases isPreirreducible_iff_isClosed_union_isClosed.mp
      (IrreducibleSpace.isIrreducible_univ GX.left).isPreirreducible Z₀ Z₁ hZ₀ hZ₁ hcover with h | h
    · exact h (Set.mem_univ y)
    · have he : O.left ((1 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX).left
          (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) = (p⁻¹).left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) :=
        h (Set.mem_univ _)
      have hu := congrArg (fun f ↦ f.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) hO₁
      exact False.elim (hpval (hu.symm.trans he))
  have hfix (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) : p ≫ c q = p := by
    rw [← hOcomp]
    apply GroupScheme.pointsEquivClosedPoints.injective
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hconst (q.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k))
  have hcall (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) : c q = 𝟙 N := by
    rcases hauto q with h | h
    · exact h
    · have hf := hfix q
      rw [h] at hf
      change p⁻¹ = p at hf
      exact False.elim (hp hf.symm)
  have : IsIntegral N.left :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsIntegral (Spec (.of (AddMonoidAlgebra k ℤ))))
  have : IsIntegral (GX ⊗ N).left := isIntegral_pullback_of_isAlgClosed GX.hom N.hom
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType (GX ⊗ N).hom := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (Limits.pullback.fst GX.hom N.hom ≫ GX.hom)
    infer_instance
  have hψeq : ψ = snd GX N := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    have : LocallyOfFiniteType (ψ.left ≫ N.hom) := by rw [Over.w ψ]; infer_instance
    refine AlgebraicGeometry.ext_of_apply_eq N.hom Set.univ isClosed_univ.isLocallyClosed
      dense_univ ?_ ((Over.w ψ).trans (Over.w (snd GX N)).symm)
    intro y _ hy
    let q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX ⊗ N :=
      Over.homMk (pointOfClosedPoint (GX ⊗ N).hom y hy)
        (pointOfClosedPoint_comp (GX ⊗ N).hom y hy)
    have hq : lift (q ≫ fst GX N) (q ≫ snd GX N) = q := by simp
    have hpoint : q ≫ ψ = q ≫ snd GX N := by
      rw [← hq, ← hcomp, hcall, Category.comp_id, lift_snd]
    have he := congrArg (fun f ↦ f.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) hpoint
    have hqy : q.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) = y :=
      pointOfClosedPoint_apply (GX ⊗ N).hom y hy _
    change ψ.left (q.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) =
      (snd GX N).left (q.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) at he
    rwa [hqy] at he
  change GX ◁ i₀ ≫ conj GX = snd GX N ≫ i₀
  rw [← hψ, hψeq]

name: AclGeom.AdditiveRigidity.isUnit_section_of_point_values
statement:
theorem isUnit_section_of_point_values (X : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] (s : Γ(X.left, ⊤))
    (h : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ X, IsUnit (q.left.appTop s)) : IsUnit s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hclosed (y : X.left) (hy : IsClosed ({y} : Set X.left)) : y ∈ X.left.basicOpen s := by
    let q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ X :=
      Over.homMk (pointOfClosedPoint X.hom y hy) (pointOfClosedPoint_comp X.hom y hy)
    let q₀ : Spec (.of k) ⟶ X.left := q.left
    have hu : IsUnit (q₀.appTop s) := h q
    have hb := (Spec (.of k)).basicOpen_of_isUnit hu
    rw [← Scheme.preimage_basicOpen_top q₀] at hb
    have hq : q₀ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) ∈ X.left.basicOpen s := by
      change IsLocalRing.closedPoint k ∈ q₀ ⁻¹ᵁ X.left.basicOpen s
      rw [hb]
      trivial
    rwa [show q₀ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) = y from
      pointOfClosedPoint_apply X.hom y hy _] at hq
  have : JacobsonSpace X.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.jacobsonSpace X.hom
  let Z : Set X.left := (X.left.basicOpen s : Set X.left)ᶜ
  have hZ : IsClosed Z := (X.left.basicOpen s).isOpen.isClosed_compl
  have hinter : Z ∩ closedPoints X.left = ∅ := by
    apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
    rintro y ⟨hy, hyc⟩
    exact hy (hclosed y hyc)
  have hZempty : Z = ∅ := by
    have hd := JacobsonSpace.closure_inter_closedPoints_eq_closure hZ.isLocallyClosed
    simpa only [hinter, closure_empty, hZ.closure_eq] using hd.symm
  apply X.left.toRingedSpace.isUnit_of_isUnit_germ ⊤ s
  intro y hy
  apply (Scheme.mem_basicOpen X.left s y hy).mp
  by_contra hn
  have hz : y ∈ Z := hn
  rw [hZempty] at hz
  exact hz

name: AclGeom.SmoothCurveStalks.finrank_differential_eq_one
statement:
theorem finrank_differential_eq_one [PerfectField k] [Algebra.EssFiniteType k F]
    (htr : Algebra.trdeg k F = 1) :
    Module.finrank F (KaehlerDifferential k F) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsep⟩ := exists_isTranscendenceBasis_and_isSeparable_of_perfectField k F
  have hcard : s.card = 1 := by
    have h := hs.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg
    rw [Cardinal.mk_coe_finset, htr] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  have hr : Set.range ((↑) : s → F) = (s : Set F) := by ext; simp
  let P := MvPolynomial s k
  let A := Algebra.adjoin k (s : Set F)
  let K := IntermediateField.adjoin k (s : Set F)
  let e : P ≃ₐ[k] A := hs.1.aevalEquiv.trans
    (Subalgebra.equivOfEq _ _ (congrArg (Algebra.adjoin k) hr))
  let : Algebra P K := ((algebraMap A K).comp e.toRingHom).toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower k P K := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun c ↦ by
    symm
    change algebraMap A K (e (algebraMap k P c)) = algebraMap k K c
    rw [e.commutes, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k A K]
  have : IsFractionRing P K :=
    IsFractionRing.of_ringEquiv_left e.toRingEquiv (fun _ ↦ rfl)
  let : Algebra P F := ((algebraMap K F).comp (algebraMap P K)).toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower P K F := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have : IsScalarTower k P F := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun c ↦ by
    symm
    change algebraMap K F (algebraMap P K (algebraMap k P c)) = algebraMap k F c
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k P K, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k K F]
  have : Algebra.IsSeparable K F := hsep
  have : Algebra.FormallyEtale P K :=
    Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isLocalization (nonZeroDivisors P)
  have : Algebra.FormallyEtale K F := Algebra.FormallyEtale.of_isSeparable K F
  have : Algebra.FormallyEtale P F := Algebra.FormallyEtale.comp P K F
  let b := ((KaehlerDifferential.mvPolynomialBasis k s).baseChange F).map
    (KaehlerDifferential.tensorKaehlerEquivOfFormallyEtale k P F)
  simpa only [Fintype.card_coe, hcard] using Module.finrank_eq_card_basis b

name: AclGeom.SmoothCurveStalks.trdeg_eq_one_of_oneVar
statement: theorem trdeg_eq_one_of_oneVar [IsFunctionFieldOneVar k F] : Algebra.trdeg k F = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hfin⟩ := IsFunctionFieldOneVar.exists_transcendental_finite (k := k) (F := F)
  have := hfin
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (Algebra.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F :=
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic.trans (Algebra.adjoin k ({t} : Set F))
      (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F
  apply le_antisymm
  · simpa only [Cardinal.mk_singleton] using
      Algebra.IsAlgebraic.trdeg_le_cardinalMk k ({t} : Set F)
  · apply Cardinal.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    intro hz
    have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic k F := (trdeg_eq_zero_iff).mp hz
    exact ht (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic t)

name: AclGeom.denseImage_iff_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem denseImage_iff_of_isAlgebraic
    {A B T : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [CommRing B] [IsDomain B]
    [CommRing T] [Algebra A B] [Algebra B T] [Algebra A T] [IsScalarTower A B T]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic A B] (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A B))
    (Z : Set (PrimeSpectrum T)) :
    closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A T) '' Z) = Set.univ ↔
      closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap B T) '' Z) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let P := PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal Z
  rw [← closure_image_closure (PrimeSpectrum.continuous_comap (algebraMap A T)),
    ← closure_image_closure (PrimeSpectrum.continuous_comap (algebraMap B T))]
  have hZ := PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_eq_closure Z
  simp only [← hZ]
  simp only [PrimeSpectrum.closure_image_comap_zeroLocus,
    PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_eq_univ_iff, nilradical_eq_zero]
  change P.under A ≤ ⊥ ↔ P.under B ≤ ⊥
  simp only [le_bot_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
    intro b hb
    by_cases hb0 : b = 0
    · exact hb0.symm ▸ Ideal.zero_mem ⊥
    · exact False.elim ((Ideal.under_ne_bot_of_algebraic_mem
        (I := P.under B) hb0 hb (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic b)) (by
          rw [Ideal.under_under (A := A) (B := B) P]
          exact h))
  · intro h
    rw [← Ideal.under_under (A := A) (B := B) P, h]
    exact Ideal.comap_bot_of_injective (f := algebraMap A B) hinj

name: AclGeom.isAlgebraic_adjoin_of_subset_racl
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_adjoin_of_subset_racl
    {k Ω : Type*} [Field k] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω]
    (S T : Set Ω) (hST : S ⊆ T) (hT : T ⊆ racl k S) :
    let A
proof:
:= Algebra.adjoin k S
    let B := Algebra.adjoin k T
    letI : Algebra A B := (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono hST)).toAlgebra
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic A B := by
  let A := Algebra.adjoin k S
  let B := Algebra.adjoin k T
  let K := IntermediateField.adjoin k S
  let _ : Algebra A B := (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono hST)).toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower A B Ω := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  have hB : B ≤ (Subalgebra.algebraicClosure A Ω).restrictScalars k := by
    refine Algebra.adjoin_le_iff.mpr ?_
    intro t ht
    change IsAlgebraic A t
    exact (IsFractionRing.isAlgebraic_iff A K Ω).mpr ((mem_racl_iff k).mp (hT ht))
  refine ⟨fun b ↦ ?_⟩
  exact (isAlgebraic_algHom_iff (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B Ω) Subtype.val_injective).mp
    (hB b.property)

name: AclGeom.dense_comp_iff_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
private theorem dense_comp_iff_of_isAlgebraic {A X B : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [CommRing X] [IsDomain X] [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [Algebra A B] [Algebra X B]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic A B] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic X B]
    (hA : Function.Injective (algebraMap A B)) (hX : Function.Injective (algebraMap X B))
    {P : Scheme.{u}} (p : P ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of B)) (Z : Set P) :
    closure ((p ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))).base '' Z) = Set.univ ↔
      closure ((p ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap X B))).base '' Z) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  have himg : ∀ (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra R B],
      (p ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B))).base '' Z =
        PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R B) '' (p.base '' Z) := fun R _ _ ↦
    (Set.image_image (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R B)) (p.base : P → PrimeSpectrum B) Z).symm
  rw [himg A, himg X]
  exact (denseImage_iff_of_isAlgebraic hA (p.base '' Z)).trans
    (denseImage_iff_of_isAlgebraic hX (p.base '' Z)).symm

name: AclGeom.locusPullback_endDominance
statement:
theorem locusPullback_endDominance (hxy : ∀ i, x i ∈ racl k (Set.range y))
    (hyx : ∀ j, y j ∈ racl k (Set.range x)) (hzy : ∀ i, z i ∈ racl k (Set.range y))
    (hyz : ∀ j, y j ∈ racl k (Set.range z)) :
    letI : Algebra 𝔜 𝔅
proof:
:= (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono
      (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right))).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra 𝔜 ℭ := (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono
      (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left))).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra 𝔛 𝔅 := (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono
      (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_left))).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra ℨ ℭ := (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono
      (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_right))).toAlgebra
    ∀ Z : Set ↥(pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap 𝔜 𝔅)))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap 𝔜 ℭ)))),
      (closure ((pullback.fst _ _ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap 𝔜 𝔅))).base '' Z) =
          Set.univ ↔
        closure ((pullback.fst _ _ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap 𝔛 𝔅))).base '' Z) =
          Set.univ) ∧
      (closure ((pullback.fst _ _ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap 𝔜 𝔅))).base '' Z) =
          Set.univ ↔
        closure ((pullback.snd _ _ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap ℨ ℭ))).base '' Z) =
          Set.univ) := by
  
  let _ : Algebra 𝔜 𝔅 := (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono
    (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right))).toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝔜 ℭ := (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono
    (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left))).toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝔛 𝔅 := (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono
    (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_left))).toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra ℨ ℭ := (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono
    (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_right))).toAlgebra
  
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic 𝔜 𝔅 := isAlgebraic_adjoin_of_subset_racl (k := k) _ _
    (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right) (by
      rw [Set.Sum.elim_range]
      exact Set.union_subset (Set.range_subset_iff.2 hxy) (subset_racl k _))
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic 𝔛 𝔅 := isAlgebraic_adjoin_of_subset_racl (k := k) _ _
    (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_left) (by
      rw [Set.Sum.elim_range]
      exact Set.union_subset (subset_racl k _) (Set.range_subset_iff.2 hyx))
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic 𝔜 ℭ := isAlgebraic_adjoin_of_subset_racl (k := k) _ _
    (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left) (by
      rw [Set.Sum.elim_range]
      exact Set.union_subset (subset_racl k _) (Set.range_subset_iff.2 hzy))
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℨ ℭ := isAlgebraic_adjoin_of_subset_racl (k := k) _ _
    (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_right) (by
      rw [Set.Sum.elim_range]
      exact Set.union_subset (Set.range_subset_iff.2 hyz) (subset_racl k _))
  intro Z
  refine ⟨dense_comp_iff_of_isAlgebraic (Subalgebra.inclusion_injective _)
    (Subalgebra.inclusion_injective _) (pullback.fst _ _) Z, ?_⟩
  rw [pullback.condition]
  exact dense_comp_iff_of_isAlgebraic (Subalgebra.inclusion_injective _)
    (Subalgebra.inclusion_injective _) (pullback.snd _ _) Z

statement:
theorem coe_closedPointStalkEquiv
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left] [IsProper X.hom]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1)
    (hnormal : ∀ x : X.left, IsIntegrallyClosed (X.left.presheaf.stalk x))
    (x : {x : X.left // IsClosed ({x} : Set X.left)}) (r : X.left.presheaf.stalk x.val) :
