name: AclGeom.CurvePointsPlaces.placeCenter_closedPointPlace
statement:
theorem placeCenter_closedPointPlace
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left] [IsProper X.hom]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1)
    (hnormal : ∀ x : X.left, IsIntegrallyClosed (X.left.presheaf.stalk x))
    (x : {x : X.left // IsClosed ({x} : Set X.left)}) :
    placeCenter X (closedPointPlace X hdim hnormal x) = x.val
proof:
:= by
  let P := closedPointPlace X hdim hnormal x
  let E := closedPointStalkEquiv X hdim hnormal x
  let u := CommRingCat.ofHom E.toRingHom
  let v := CommRingCat.ofHom P.val.subtype
  let t := X.left.fromSpecStalk x.val
  let m := Spec.map u ≫ t
  have huv : u ≫ v = CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x.val) X.left.functionField) := by
    ext r
    exact coe_closedPointStalkEquiv X hdim hnormal x r
  have hcanonical : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x.val) X.left.functionField)) ≫ t =
      X.left.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X.left) :=
    Scheme.SpecMap_stalkSpecializes_fromSpecStalk (genericPoint_specializes x.val)
  have hmgen : Spec.map v ≫ m = X.left.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X.left) := by
    calc
      _ = (Spec.map v ≫ Spec.map u) ≫ t := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = Spec.map (u ≫ v) ≫ t :=
        congrArg (fun f ↦ f ≫ t) (Spec.map_comp u v).symm
      _ = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x.val) X.left.functionField)) ≫ t :=
        congrArg (fun f ↦ Spec.map f ≫ t) huv
      _ = _ := hcanonical
  have : IsLocalHom u.hom := IsLocalHom.of_surjective _ E.surjective
  have hp : Spec.map u (IsLocalRing.closedPoint P.val) =
      IsLocalRing.closedPoint (X.left.presheaf.stalk x.val) := Spec_closedPoint
  have ht : t (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (X.left.presheaf.stalk x.val)) = x.val :=
    Scheme.fromSpecStalk_closedPoint
  have hmPoint : m (IsLocalRing.closedPoint P.val) = x.val :=
    (Scheme.Hom.comp_apply _ _ _).trans ((congrArg (fun q ↦ t q) hp).trans ht)
  have hmEq : m = placeModelMap X P :=
    (existsUnique_placeModelMap X P).choose_spec.2 m hmgen
  change placeModelMap X P (IsLocalRing.closedPoint P.val) = x.val
  exact (congrArg (fun f ↦ f (IsLocalRing.closedPoint P.val)) hmEq).symm.trans hmPoint

name: AclGeom.racl_union_congr_left
proof:
:= by

name: AclGeom.RankTwoFiniteCorrespondenceMultiplication.exists_output
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : Fin 4 → Fin 6 := ![0, 1, 2, 3]
  have he (i : Fin 4) :
      M.tuple (e i) = rankTwoPairTuple M.left M.right i := by
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hmem (j : Fin 6) :
      M.tuple j ∈
        racl k (Set.range (rankTwoPairTuple M.left M.right)) := by
    fin_cases j
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_range_self 0)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_range_self 1)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_range_self 2)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_range_self 3)
    · exact M.output_mem_left_right 0
    · exact M.output_mem_left_right 1
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hfix⟩ := exists_tuple_relocation_fixing
    M.leftRight_independent hab he hmem
  let c : Fin 2 → Ω := ![v 4, v 5]
  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
  have hvtuple : v = rankTwoTripleTuple a b c := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · simpa [e, rankTwoPairTuple, rankTwoTripleTuple] using hfix (0 : Fin 4)
    · simpa [e, rankTwoPairTuple, rankTwoTripleTuple] using hfix (1 : Fin 4)
    · simpa [e, rankTwoPairTuple, rankTwoTripleTuple] using hfix (2 : Fin 4)
    · simpa [e, rankTwoPairTuple, rankTwoTripleTuple] using hfix (3 : Fin 4)
    · rfl
    · rfl
  change idealOf k (rankTwoTripleTuple a b c) = idealOf k M.tuple
  rw [← hvtuple]
  exact hv

name: AclGeom.RankTwoFiniteCorrespondenceMultiplication.exists_right
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : Fin 4 → Fin 6 := ![0, 1, 4, 5]
  have he (i : Fin 4) :
      M.tuple (e i) = rankTwoPairTuple M.left M.output i := by
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hmem (j : Fin 6) :
      M.tuple j ∈
        racl k (Set.range (rankTwoPairTuple M.left M.output)) := by
    fin_cases j
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_range_self 0)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_range_self 1)
    · exact M.right_mem_left_output 0
    · exact M.right_mem_left_output 1
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_range_self 2)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_range_self 3)
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hfix⟩ := exists_tuple_relocation_fixing
    M.leftOutput_independent hac he hmem
  let b : Fin 2 → Ω := ![v 2, v 3]
  refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
  have hvtuple : v = rankTwoTripleTuple a b c := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · simpa [e, rankTwoPairTuple, rankTwoTripleTuple] using hfix (0 : Fin 4)
    · simpa [e, rankTwoPairTuple, rankTwoTripleTuple] using hfix (1 : Fin 4)
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · simpa [e, rankTwoPairTuple, rankTwoTripleTuple] using hfix (2 : Fin 4)
    · simpa [e, rankTwoPairTuple, rankTwoTripleTuple] using hfix (3 : Fin 4)
  change idealOf k (rankTwoTripleTuple a b c) = idealOf k M.tuple
  rw [← hvtuple]
  exact hv

name: AclGeom.RankTwoFiniteCorrespondenceMultiplication.exists_left
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : Fin 4 → Fin 6 := ![2, 3, 4, 5]
  have he (i : Fin 4) :
      M.tuple (e i) = rankTwoPairTuple M.right M.output i := by
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hmem (j : Fin 6) :
      M.tuple j ∈
        racl k (Set.range (rankTwoPairTuple M.right M.output)) := by
    fin_cases j
    · exact M.left_mem_right_output 0
    · exact M.left_mem_right_output 1
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_range_self 0)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_range_self 1)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_range_self 2)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_range_self 3)
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hfix⟩ := exists_tuple_relocation_fixing
    M.rightOutput_independent hbc he hmem
  let a : Fin 2 → Ω := ![v 0, v 1]
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  have hvtuple : v = rankTwoTripleTuple a b c := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · simpa [e, rankTwoPairTuple, rankTwoTripleTuple] using hfix (0 : Fin 4)
    · simpa [e, rankTwoPairTuple, rankTwoTripleTuple] using hfix (1 : Fin 4)
    · simpa [e, rankTwoPairTuple, rankTwoTripleTuple] using hfix (2 : Fin 4)
    · simpa [e, rankTwoPairTuple, rankTwoTripleTuple] using hfix (3 : Fin 4)
  change idealOf k (rankTwoTripleTuple a b c) = idealOf k M.tuple
  rw [← hvtuple]
  exact hv

name: AclGeom.RankTwoFiniteCorrespondenceMultiplication.exists_fourArrowDifferenceDiagram
statement:
theorem exists_fourArrowDifferenceDiagram [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    {s e a b : Fin 2 → Ω}
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s e a b)) :
    Nonempty (M.FourArrowDifferenceDiagram s a b e)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hse : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoPairTuple s e) := by
    let f : Fin 4 → Fin 8 := ![0, 1, 2, 3]
    have ht := AlgebraicIndependent.comp hind f (by decide)
    convert ht using 1
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := M.exists_output hse
  have hRu : M.IsRealization s e u := hu
  have hq1 : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s u a b) :=
    algebraicIndependent_of_racl_range_eq hind
      (hRu.racl_four_leftRight_eq_leftOutput a b)
  have hau : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoPairTuple a u) := by
    let f : Fin 4 → Fin 8 := ![4, 5, 2, 3]
    have ht := AlgebraicIndependent.comp hq1 f (by decide)
    convert ht using 1
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  obtain ⟨sA, hsA⟩ := M.exists_left hau
  have hRsA : M.IsRealization sA a u := hsA
  have hq2 : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s sA a b) :=
    algebraicIndependent_of_racl_range_eq hq1
      (hRsA.racl_four_outputRight_eq_leftRight s b)
  have hsb : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoPairTuple s b) := by
    let f : Fin 4 → Fin 8 := ![0, 1, 6, 7]
    have ht := AlgebraicIndependent.comp hq2 f (by decide)
    convert ht using 1
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  obtain ⟨uB, huB⟩ := M.exists_output hsb
  have hRuB : M.IsRealization s b uB := huB
  have hq3 : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoFourTuple s sA a uB) :=
    algebraicIndependent_of_racl_range_eq hq2
      (hRuB.racl_four_firstRight_eq_firstOutput sA a)
  have hsa_uB : AlgebraicIndependent k (rankTwoPairTuple sA uB) := by
    let f : Fin 4 → Fin 8 := ![2, 3, 6, 7]
    have ht := AlgebraicIndependent.comp hq3 f (by decide)
    convert ht using 1
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := M.exists_right hsa_uB
  exact ⟨{
    u := u
    sA := sA
    uB := uB
    c := c
    se_u := hRu
    sA_a_u := hRsA
    s_b_uB := hRuB
    sA_c_uB := hc }⟩

name: AclGeom.FiniteCover.ExtensionEquiv.ext

name: AclGeom.FiniteCover.ExtensionEquiv.commutes_apply

@[simp] theorem commutes_apply (e : ExtensionEquiv h h') (x : E) :

name: AclGeom.FiniteCover.ExtensionEquiv.ofEq_baseEquiv

proof:

name: AclGeom.FiniteCover.finiteDimensional_of_eq
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_of_eq
    {E L E' L' : IntermediateField k Ω}
    (h : E ≤ L) (h' : E' ≤ L') (hE : E = E') (hL : L = L')
    (hfin : FiniteDimensional (↥E') (↥(extendScalars h'))) :
    FiniteDimensional (↥E) (↥(extendScalars h))
proof:
:= by
  subst E'
  subst L'
  exact hfin

name: AclGeom.FiniteCover.map_normalClosure_eq_of_equiv
statement:
theorem map_normalClosure_eq_of_equiv
    {F K K' A A' : Type*}
    [Field F] [Field K] [Field K'] [Field A] [Field A']
    [Algebra F K] [Algebra F K'] [Algebra F A] [Algebra F A']
    (eK : K ≃ₐ[F] K') (eA : A ≃ₐ[F] A') :
    (normalClosure F K A).map eA.toAlgHom =
      normalClosure F K' A'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [normalClosure_def]
  rw [IntermediateField.map_iSup]
  simp_rw [AlgHom.map_fieldRange]
  rw [← (AlgEquiv.arrowCongr eK eA).iSup_comp]
  apply iSup_congr
  intro f
  ext x
  change (∃ y, eA (f y) = x) ↔
    ∃ y, eA (f (eK.symm y)) = x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨eK y, by simp⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨eK.symm y, rfl⟩

name: AclGeom.FiniteCover.normalClosure_restrictScalars_of_surjective
statement:
theorem normalClosure_restrictScalars_of_surjective
    {F F' K A : Type*}
    [Field F] [Field F'] [Field K] [Field A]
    [Algebra F F'] [Algebra F K] [Algebra F A]
    [Algebra F' K] [Algebra F' A]
    [IsScalarTower F F' K] [IsScalarTower F F' A]
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (algebraMap F F')) :
    normalClosure F K A =
      (normalClosure F' K A).restrictScalars F
proof:
:= by
  let upgrade (g : K →ₐ[F] A) : K →ₐ[F'] A :=
    { g.toRingHom with
      commutes' := fun x ↦ by
        obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hsurj x
        simp only [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply]
        exact g.commutes y }
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [normalClosure_le_iff]
    intro g
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact (AlgHom.fieldRange_le_normalClosure (upgrade g)) ⟨x, rfl⟩
  · let N : IntermediateField F A := normalClosure F K A
    let N' : IntermediateField F' A :=
      { N.toSubfield with
        algebraMap_mem' := fun x ↦ by
          obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hsurj x
          rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F F' A]
          exact N.algebraMap_mem y }
    change normalClosure F' K A ≤ N'
    rw [normalClosure_le_iff]
    intro g
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact (AlgHom.fieldRange_le_normalClosure
      (g.restrictScalars F)) ⟨x, rfl⟩

statement:

name: AclGeom.FiniteCover.canonicalNormalClosure_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem canonicalNormalClosure_finiteDimensional (h : E ≤ L)

    FiniteDimensional (↥E) (↥(canonicalNormalClosure h))
proof:
:= by
  letI := hfin
  exact normalClosure.is_finiteDimensional
    (↥E) (↥(extendScalars h)) (AlgebraicClosure (↥E))

name: AclGeom.FiniteCover.canonicalNormalClosure_normal
statement:
theorem canonicalNormalClosure_normal (h : E ≤ L)
    (halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (↥E) (↥(extendScalars h))) :
    Normal (↥E) (↥(canonicalNormalClosure h))
proof:
:= by
  letI := halg
  exact
    (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isNormalClosure_normalClosure
      (F := ↥E) (K := ↥(extendScalars h))
      (L := AlgebraicClosure (↥E))
      (fun _ ↦ IsAlgClosed.splits _)).normal

name: AclGeom.FiniteCover.normalClosureOverEquivCanonical_symm_comp_selectedEmbedding
statement:
theorem normalClosureOverEquivCanonical_symm_comp_selectedEmbedding
    [IsAlgClosed Ω] (h : E ≤ L)
    (halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (↥E) (↥(extendScalars h))) :
    (normalClosureOverEquivCanonical h halg).symm.toAlgHom.comp
        (canonicalSelectedEmbedding h halg) =
      IntermediateField.inclusion (extendScalars_le_normalClosureOver h)
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgHom.ext
  intro x
  simp [canonicalSelectedEmbedding]

name: AclGeom.FiniteCover.NormalExtensionEquiv.normal_commutes_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem normal_commutes_apply (e : NormalExtensionEquiv h h')

        (algebraMap (↥E) (↥(canonicalNormalClosure h)) x) =
      algebraMap (↥E') (↥(canonicalNormalClosure h'))
        (e.baseEquiv x)
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun e.normal_commutes x

name: AclGeom.FiniteCover.normalClosure_val_comp_liftEmbedding

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.branchOverSource_eq_adjoin_target
statement:
theorem branchOverSource_eq_adjoin_target :
    P.branchOverSource = adjoin (↥P.sourceField) {P.target}
proof:
:= by
  refine restrictScalars_injective k ?_
  unfold branchOverSource
  rw [extendScalars_restrictScalars]
  unfold sourceField branchField
  rw [adjoin_adjoin_left]
  simp only [Set.union_singleton, Set.pair_comm]

proof:
:= by

  exact finiteDimensional_adjoin fun x hx ↦ by
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    subst x
    exact ((mem_racl_iff k).1 P.target_mem_source).isIntegral

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.branchField_le_chainField
statement:

  intro x hx
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx ⊢
  rcases hx with rfl | rfl
  · exact Or.inl rfl

  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_union]
  tauto

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.chainOverLeft_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem chainOverLeft_finiteDimensional
    (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) (h : P.target = Q.source) :
    FiniteDimensional (↥P.branchField) (↥(P.chainOverLeft Q))
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.chainOverLeft_eq_adjoin_target Q]
  exact finiteDimensional_adjoin fun x hx ↦ by
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    subst x
    exact (isAlgebraic_of_le P.targetField_le_branchField
      (by
        unfold targetField
        rw [h]
        exact (mem_racl_iff k).1 Q.target_mem_source)).isIntegral

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.chainOverRight_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem chainOverRight_finiteDimensional
    (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) (h : P.target = Q.source) :
    FiniteDimensional (↥Q.branchField) (↥(P.chainOverRight Q h))
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.chainOverRight_eq_adjoin_source Q h]
  exact finiteDimensional_adjoin fun x hx ↦ by
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    subst x
    exact (isAlgebraic_of_le Q.sourceField_le_branchField
      (by
        unfold sourceField
        rw [← h]
        exact (mem_racl_iff k).1 P.source_mem_target)).isIntegral

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.chainOverComposite_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem chainOverComposite_finiteDimensional
    (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) (h : P.target = Q.source) :
    FiniteDimensional (↥(P.comp Q h).branchField)
      (↥(P.chainOverComposite Q h))
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.chainOverComposite_eq_adjoin_middle Q h]
  exact finiteDimensional_adjoin fun x hx ↦ by
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    subst x
    exact (isAlgebraic_of_le
      (P.comp Q h).sourceField_le_branchField
      ((mem_racl_iff k).1 P.target_mem_source)).isIntegral

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.chainOverComposite_le_normal
statement:
theorem chainOverComposite_le_normal
    (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) (h : P.target = Q.source) :
    P.chainOverComposite Q h ≤ P.chainNormalOverComposite Q h
proof:
:=
  FiniteCover.extendScalars_le_normalClosureOver
    (P.compositeBranchField_le_chainField Q h)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.chainNormalOverComposite_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem chainNormalOverComposite_finiteDimensional
    (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) (h : P.target = Q.source) :
    FiniteDimensional (↥(P.comp Q h).branchField)
      (↥(P.chainNormalOverComposite Q h))
proof:
:=
  FiniteCover.normalClosureOver_finiteDimensional
    (P.compositeBranchField_le_chainField Q h)
    (P.chainOverComposite_finiteDimensional Q h)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.chainNormalOverComposite_normal
statement:
theorem chainNormalOverComposite_normal [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) (h : P.target = Q.source) :
    Normal (↥(P.comp Q h).branchField)
      (↥(P.chainNormalOverComposite Q h))
proof:
:= by
  letI := P.chainOverComposite_finiteDimensional Q h
  exact FiniteCover.normalClosureOver_normal
    (P.compositeBranchField_le_chainField Q h)
    (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_finite
      (↥(P.comp Q h).branchField) (↥(P.chainOverComposite Q h)))

name: AclGeom.AdditiveRigidity.unitPoint_comp_multiplicativeValue
statement:
theorem unitPoint_comp_multiplicativeValue {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C] (a : Cˣ) :
    unitPoint k a ≫ multiplicativeValue k = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (a : C)
proof:
:= by
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((unitsMulEquivConv k C).symm a).ofConv.toRingHom) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval
        (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (1 : ℤ) (1 : k))).toRingHom) =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (a : C)).toRingHom)
  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
  apply congrArg Spec.map
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  change (((unitsMulEquivConv k C).symm a).ofConv.comp (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval
    (AddMonoidAlgebra.single (1 : ℤ) (1 : k)))).toRingHom = _
  apply congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom
  apply AffineSchemeAction.lineHom_ext
  rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AffineSchemeAction.lineEval_lineCoordinate,
    AffineSchemeAction.lineEval_lineCoordinate]
  exact unitsMulEquivConv_symm_apply_single k C a

name: AclGeom.AdditiveRigidity.unitPoint_eq_points
statement:
theorem unitPoint_eq_points (a : kˣ) :
    (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ unitPoint k a = (multiplicativeGroup.pointsMulEquiv k).symm a
proof:
:= by
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  change 𝟙 _ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((unitsMulEquivConv k k).symm a).ofConv.toRingHom) =
    ((hopfPointsMulEquiv k (AddMonoidAlgebra k ℤ)).symm ((unitsMulEquivConv k k).symm a)).left
  rw [Category.id_comp]
  exact (hopfPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_left k (AddMonoidAlgebra k ℤ)
    ((unitsMulEquivConv k k).symm a).ofConv).symm

name: AclGeom.exists_affine_relocation
statement:
theorem exists_affine_relocation [IsAlgClosed K] {a b x c p δ f a₀ : K}
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b, x, c])
    (hp : p ∈ racl k ({a, b} : Set K)) (hpa : p ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K))
    (hδx : δ ∈ racl k ({a, x} : Set K)) (hδy : δ ∈ racl k ({p, a * x + b} : Set K))
    (hf : f ∈ racl k ({c, δ} : Set K)) (ha₀ : a₀ ∉ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K)) :
    ∃ a' b' x' : K,
      idealOf k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a', b', x']) =
        idealOf k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a, b, x]) ∧
      a' ∈ racl k ({p, a * x + b, c, a₀} : Set K) ∧ a' ∉ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) ∧
      p ∈ racl k ({a', b'} : Set K) ∧ δ ∈ racl k ({a', x'} : Set K) ∧
      a' * x' + b' = a * x + b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := hind.ne_zero 0
  
  have hb : b ∈ racl k ({a, p} : Set K) := by
    have h : p ∈ racl k (insert b ({a} : Set K)) := by
      rwa [Set.pair_comm] at hp
    have h' := racl_exchange h hpa
    rwa [Set.pair_comm] at h'
  have hxeq : (a * x + b - b) * a⁻¹ = x := by
    rw [add_sub_cancel_right, mul_comm a x, mul_inv_cancel_right₀ ha0]
  
  have hP3 : p ∈ racl k ({p, a * x + b, c} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
  have hY3 : a * x + b ∈ racl k ({p, a * x + b, c} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
  have hC3 : c ∈ racl k ({p, a * x + b, c} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
  have hD3 : δ ∈ racl k ({p, a * x + b, c} : Set K) :=
    racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨hP3, Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hY3⟩) hδy
  have hF3 : f ∈ racl k ({p, a * x + b, c} : Set K) :=
    racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨hC3, Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hD3⟩) hf
  have hpyc : Set.range ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ⊆ racl k ({p, a * x + b, c} : Set K) := by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    fin_cases i
    · exact hP3
    · exact hY3
    · exact hD3
    · exact hC3
    · exact hF3
  have hA4 : a ∈ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
  have hB4 : b ∈ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
  have hX4 : x ∈ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
  have hC4 : c ∈ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
  have hP4 : p ∈ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) :=
    racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨hA4, Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hB4⟩) hp
  have hY4 : a * x + b ∈ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) := add_mem (mul_mem hA4 hX4) hB4
  have hD4 : δ ∈ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) :=
    racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨hA4, Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hX4⟩) hδx
  have hF4 : f ∈ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) :=
    racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨hC4, Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hD4⟩) hf
  have habxc : Set.range ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ⊆ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) := by
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    fin_cases i
    · exact hP4
    · exact hY4
    · exact hD4
    · exact hC4
    · exact hF4
  
  have hind' : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, p, a * x + b, c] := by
    refine AlgebraicIndependent.of_racl_range_eq hind (racl_range_eq_of_mem ?_ ?_)
    · have hAv : a ∈ racl k (Set.range ![a, b, x, c]) := subset_racl k _ ⟨0, rfl⟩
      have hBv : b ∈ racl k (Set.range ![a, b, x, c]) := subset_racl k _ ⟨1, rfl⟩
      have hXv : x ∈ racl k (Set.range ![a, b, x, c]) := subset_racl k _ ⟨2, rfl⟩
      have hCv : c ∈ racl k (Set.range ![a, b, x, c]) := subset_racl k _ ⟨3, rfl⟩
      have hPv : p ∈ racl k (Set.range ![a, b, x, c]) :=
        racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨hAv, Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hBv⟩) hp
      intro j
      fin_cases j
      · exact hAv
      · exact hPv
      · exact add_mem (mul_mem hAv hXv) hBv
      · exact hCv
    · have hAw : a ∈ racl k (Set.range ![a, p, a * x + b, c]) := subset_racl k _ ⟨0, rfl⟩
      have hPw : p ∈ racl k (Set.range ![a, p, a * x + b, c]) := subset_racl k _ ⟨1, rfl⟩
      have hYw : a * x + b ∈ racl k (Set.range ![a, p, a * x + b, c]) :=
        subset_racl k _ ⟨2, rfl⟩
      have hCw : c ∈ racl k (Set.range ![a, p, a * x + b, c]) := subset_racl k _ ⟨3, rfl⟩
      have hBw : b ∈ racl k (Set.range ![a, p, a * x + b, c]) :=
        racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨hAw, Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hPw⟩) hb
      have hXw : x ∈ racl k (Set.range ![a, p, a * x + b, c]) := by
        have h := mul_mem (sub_mem hYw hBw) (inv_mem hAw)
        rw [hxeq] at h
        exact h
      intro i
      fin_cases i
      · exact hAw
      · exact hBw
      · exact hXw
      · exact hCw
  have ha_pyc : a ∉ racl k ({p, a * x + b, c} : Set K) := by
    have h := AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_image hind' (S := {1, 2, 3}) (i := 0) (by decide)
    simpa [Set.image_insert_eq] using h
  
  have ht : AlgebraicIndependent ↥(adjoin k (Set.range ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f])) ![a] :=
    algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff.2 fun hal ↦
      ha_pyc (racl_le_of_subset_racl hpyc ((mem_racl_iff k).2 hal))
  have hs : AlgebraicIndependent ↥(adjoin k (Set.range ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f])) ![a₀] :=
    algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff.2 fun hal ↦
      ha₀ (racl_le_of_subset_racl habxc ((mem_racl_iff k).2 hal))
  have hsub : Set.range ![a] ⊆ Set.range ![a, b, x] := by
    rw [Matrix.range_cons_empty]
    exact Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 ⟨0, rfl⟩
  have hle : adjoin ↥(adjoin k (Set.range ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f])) (Set.range ![a]) ≤
      adjoin ↥(adjoin k (Set.range ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f])) (Set.range ![a, b, x]) :=
    adjoin.mono _ _ _ hsub
  have hgen : ∀ z ∈ Set.range ![a, b, x], IsAlgebraic
      ↥(adjoin ↥(adjoin k (Set.range ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f])) (Set.range ![a])) z := by
    have hA : a ∈ racl k (insert a (Set.range ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f])) :=
      subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _)
    have hP : p ∈ racl k (insert a (Set.range ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f])) :=
      subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ ⟨0, rfl⟩)
    have hY : a * x + b ∈ racl k (insert a (Set.range ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f])) :=
      subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ ⟨1, rfl⟩)
    have hB : b ∈ racl k (insert a (Set.range ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f])) :=
      racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨hA, Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hP⟩) hb
    have hX : x ∈ racl k (insert a (Set.range ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f])) := by
      have h := mul_mem (sub_mem hY hB) (inv_mem hA)
      rw [hxeq] at h
      exact h
    rw [Matrix.range_cons_empty]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    refine mem_racl_insert_iff.1 ?_
    fin_cases i
    · exact hA
    · exact hB
    · exact hX
  
  obtain ⟨v, hrel, hvalg⟩ := exists_joint_relocation ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ht hle
    (isAlgebraic_extendScalars_adjoin hle hgen) hs
  have hideal := idealOf_eq_of_aeval_iff k hrel
  have hv : ![v 0, v 1, v 2] = v := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  
  have hv0 : v 0 ∈ racl k (insert a₀ ({p, a * x + b, c} : Set K)) := by
    have h := hvalg 0
    rw [Matrix.range_cons_empty] at h
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ (mem_racl_insert_iff.2 h)
    exact Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_insert _ _),
      fun z hz ↦ racl_mono (Set.subset_insert _ _) (hpyc hz)⟩
  have hv0pyc : v 0 ∉ racl k ({p, a * x + b, c} : Set K) := by
    have h : Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a, b, x] (Sum.inr 0) ∉
        racl k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a, b, x] ''
          {Sum.inl 0, Sum.inl 1, Sum.inl 3}) := by
      simpa [Set.image_insert_eq] using ha_pyc
    have h' := notMem_racl_image_of_idealOf_eq k hideal.symm h
    simpa [Set.image_insert_eq] using h'
  have hfresh : v 0 ∉ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) := by
    intro hv4
    have hex := racl_exchange hv0 hv0pyc
    refine ha₀ (racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ hex)
    exact Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨hv4, Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨hP4,
      Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨hY4, Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hC4⟩⟩⟩
  have hv0' : v 0 ∈ racl k ({p, a * x + b, c, a₀} : Set K) := by
    rwa [Set.insert_comm a₀ p, Set.insert_comm a₀ (a * x + b), Set.pair_comm a₀ c] at hv0
  
  have hp' : p ∈ racl k ({v 0, v 1} : Set K) := by
    have h : Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a, b, x] (Sum.inl 0) ∈
        racl k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a, b, x] '' {Sum.inr 0, Sum.inr 1}) := by
      simpa [Set.image_insert_eq] using hp
    have h' := mem_racl_image_of_idealOf_eq k hideal.symm h
    simpa [Set.image_insert_eq] using h'
  have hδ' : δ ∈ racl k ({v 0, v 2} : Set K) := by
    have h : Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a, b, x] (Sum.inl 2) ∈
        racl k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a, b, x] '' {Sum.inr 0, Sum.inr 2}) := by
      simpa [Set.image_insert_eq] using hδx
    have h' := mem_racl_image_of_idealOf_eq k hideal.symm h
    simpa [Set.image_insert_eq] using h'
  have hval : v 0 * v 2 + v 1 = a * x + b := by
    have h := aeval_eq_aeval_of_idealOf_eq k hideal.symm
      (f := X (Sum.inr 0) * X (Sum.inr 2) + X (Sum.inr 1)) (g := X (Sum.inl 1)) (by simp)
    simpa using h
  refine ⟨v 0, v 1, v 2, ?_, hv0', hfresh, hp', hδ', hval⟩
  rw [hv]
  exact hideal

name: AclGeom.exists_affine_relocation_fresh_over
statement:
theorem exists_affine_relocation_fresh_over [IsAlgClosed K] {a b x c p δ f a₀ : K} (T : Set K)
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b, x, c])
    (hp : p ∈ racl k ({a, b} : Set K)) (hpa : p ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K))
    (hδx : δ ∈ racl k ({a, x} : Set K)) (hδy : δ ∈ racl k ({p, a * x + b} : Set K))
    (hf : f ∈ racl k ({c, δ} : Set K)) (ha₀ : a₀ ∉ racl k ({a, b, x, c} ∪ T)) :
    ∃ a' b' x' : K,
      idealOf k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a', b', x']) =
        idealOf k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a, b, x]) ∧
      a' ∈ racl k ({p, a * x + b, c, a₀} : Set K) ∧ a' ∉ racl k ({a, b, x, c} ∪ T) ∧
      p ∈ racl k ({a', b'} : Set K) ∧ δ ∈ racl k ({a', x'} : Set K) ∧
      a' * x' + b' = a * x + b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a', b', x', hJ, halg, hnew, hp', hδ', hval⟩ :=
    exists_affine_relocation (a₀ := a₀) hind hp hpa hδx hδy hf
      fun h ↦ ha₀ (racl_mono Set.subset_union_left h)
  refine ⟨a', b', x', hJ, halg, ?_, hp', hδ', hval⟩
  
  have hA : a ∈ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
  have hB : b ∈ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
  have hX : x ∈ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
  have hC : c ∈ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
  have hP : p ∈ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) :=
    racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨hA, Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hB⟩) hp
  have hpyc : ({p, a * x + b, c} : Set K) ⊆ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) :=
    Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨hP, Set.insert_subset_iff.2
      ⟨add_mem (mul_mem hA hX) hB, Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hC⟩⟩
  have hnew' : a' ∉ racl k ({p, a * x + b, c} : Set K) :=
    fun h ↦ hnew (racl_le_of_subset_racl hpyc h)
  
  have halg' : a' ∈ racl k (insert a₀ ({p, a * x + b, c} : Set K)) := by
    rwa [Set.insert_comm a₀ p, Set.insert_comm a₀ (a * x + b), Set.pair_comm a₀ c]
  intro hT
  refine ha₀ (racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ (racl_exchange halg' hnew'))
  exact Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨hT, fun z hz ↦ racl_mono Set.subset_union_left (hpyc hz)⟩

name: AclGeom.sub_mem_racl_of_two_relocations
statement:
theorem sub_mem_racl_of_two_relocations {a b x c p δ f ai bi xi aj bj xj : K}
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b, x])
    (hp : p ∈ racl k ({a, b} : Set K)) (hpa : p ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K))
    (hδx : δ ∈ racl k ({a, x} : Set K)) (hδa : δ ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K))
    (hJi : idealOf k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![ai, bi, xi]) =
      idealOf k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a, b, x]))
    (hpi : p ∈ racl k ({ai, bi} : Set K)) (hδi : δ ∈ racl k ({ai, xi} : Set K))
    (hvi : ai * xi + bi = a * x + b)
    (hpj : p ∈ racl k ({aj, bj} : Set K)) (hδj : δ ∈ racl k ({aj, xj} : Set K))
    (hvj : aj * xj + bj = a * x + b)
    (hfresh : aj ∉ racl k (({a, b, x} : Set K) ∪ {ai})) :
    bi - bj ∈ racl k ({ai, aj} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hJ3 := idealOf_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq hJi Sum.inr
  rw [Sum.elim_comp_inr, Sum.elim_comp_inr] at hJ3
  have hindi : AlgebraicIndependent k ![ai, bi, xi] :=
    (idealOf_eq_bot_iff k).1 (hJ3.trans ((idealOf_eq_bot_iff k).2 hind))
  
  have hpai : p ∉ racl k ({ai} : Set K) := by
    have h : Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a, b, x] (Sum.inl 0) ∉
        racl k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a, b, x] '' {Sum.inr 0}) := by
      simpa using hpa
    have h' := notMem_racl_image_of_idealOf_eq k hJi.symm h
    simpa using h'
  have hδai : δ ∉ racl k ({ai} : Set K) := by
    have h : Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a, b, x] (Sum.inl 2) ∉
        racl k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a, b, x] '' {Sum.inr 0}) := by
      simpa using hδa
    have h' := notMem_racl_image_of_idealOf_eq k hJi.symm h
    simpa using h'
  
  have hbi : bi ∈ racl k ({ai, p} : Set K) := by
    have h : p ∈ racl k (insert bi ({ai} : Set K)) := by
      rwa [Set.pair_comm] at hpi
    have h' := racl_exchange h hpai
    rwa [Set.pair_comm] at h'
  have hxi : xi ∈ racl k ({ai, δ} : Set K) := by
    have h : δ ∈ racl k (insert xi ({ai} : Set K)) := by
      rwa [Set.pair_comm] at hδi
    have h' := racl_exchange h hδai
    rwa [Set.pair_comm] at h'
  have hai : ai ∈ racl k (({a, b, x} : Set K) ∪ {ai}) :=
    subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_union_right _ rfl)
  have hP : p ∈ racl k (({a, b, x} : Set K) ∪ {ai}) :=
    racl_mono (Set.subset_union_of_subset_left
      (Set.insert_subset_insert (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (by simp))) _) hp
  have hD : δ ∈ racl k (({a, b, x} : Set K) ∪ {ai}) :=
    racl_mono (Set.subset_union_of_subset_left
      (Set.insert_subset_insert (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (by simp))) _) hδx
  have hsub : ({ai, bi, xi} : Set K) ⊆ racl k (({a, b, x} : Set K) ∪ {ai}) := by
    refine Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨hai, Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · exact racl_le_of_subset_racl
        (Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨hai, Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hP⟩) hbi
    · exact Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (racl_le_of_subset_racl
        (Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨hai, Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hD⟩) hxi)
  have haj : aj ∉ racl k ({ai, bi, xi} : Set K) :=
    fun h ↦ hfresh (racl_le_of_subset_racl hsub h)
  exact sub_mem_racl_of_affine_value_eq hindi haj hpi hpai hδi hδai hpj hδj (hvj.trans hvi.symm)

name: AclGeom.pairIdeal_eq_over_commonParameter_of_familyIdeal_eq
statement:
theorem pairIdeal_eq_over_commonParameter_of_familyIdeal_eq
    {d : ℕ} {p : Fin d → Ω} {x y x' y' : Ω}
    (h : idealOf k (Fin.snoc (Fin.snoc p x) y) =
      idealOf k (Fin.snoc (Fin.snoc p x') y')) :
    idealOf (↥(adjoin k (Set.range p))) ![x, y] =
      idealOf (↥(adjoin k (Set.range p))) ![x', y']
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let E : IntermediateField k Ω := adjoin k (Set.range p)
  change idealOf (↥E) ![x, y] = idealOf (↥E) ![x', y']
  let t : Fin (d + 2) → Ω := Fin.snoc (Fin.snoc p x) y
  let t' : Fin (d + 2) → Ω := Fin.snoc (Fin.snoc p x') y'
  let L : IntermediateField k Ω := adjoin k (Set.range t)
  let L' : IntermediateField k Ω := adjoin k (Set.range t')
  have hEL : E ≤ L := by
    apply adjoin.mono
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨i.castSucc.castSucc, by simp [t]⟩
  have hEL' : E ≤ L' := by
    apply adjoin.mono
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨i.castSucc.castSucc, by simp [t']⟩
  letI : Algebra E L := (IntermediateField.inclusion hEL).toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra E L' := (IntermediateField.inclusion hEL').toAlgebra
  let e₀ : L ≃ₐ[k] L' := locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq h
  have he₀ : e₀.toAlgHom.comp (IntermediateField.inclusion hEL) =
      IntermediateField.inclusion hEL' := by
    apply adjoin_algHom_ext k
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    change e₀ ⟨p i, _⟩ = ⟨p i, _⟩
    simpa [e₀, t, t'] using
      (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_apply h i.castSucc.castSucc)
  let e : L ≃ₐ[E] L' :=
    { e₀.toRingEquiv with
      commutes' := fun z ↦ DFunLike.congr_fun he₀ z }
  let q : Fin 2 → L :=
    ![⟨x, subset_adjoin k _ ⟨(Fin.last d).castSucc, by simp [t]⟩⟩,
      ⟨y, subset_adjoin k _ ⟨Fin.last (d + 1), by simp [t]⟩⟩]
  let q' : Fin 2 → L' :=
    ![⟨x', subset_adjoin k _ ⟨(Fin.last d).castSucc, by simp [t']⟩⟩,
      ⟨y', subset_adjoin k _ ⟨Fin.last (d + 1), by simp [t']⟩⟩]
  have heq (i : Fin 2) : e (q i) = q' i := by
    fin_cases i
    · simpa [e, e₀, q, q', t, t'] using
        (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_apply h (Fin.last d).castSucc)
    · simpa [e, e₀, q, q', t, t'] using
        (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_apply h (Fin.last (d + 1)))
  let vL : L →ₐ[E] Ω :=
    { L.val.toRingHom with commutes' := fun _ ↦ rfl }
  let vL' : L' →ₐ[E] Ω :=
    { L'.val.toRingHom with commutes' := fun _ ↦ rfl }
  ext f
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, mem_idealOf_iff]
  have hval : MvPolynomial.aeval ![x, y] f =
      L.val (MvPolynomial.aeval q f) := by
    have hqval : (fun i ↦ vL (q i)) = (![x, y] : Fin 2 → Ω) := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl
    calc
      MvPolynomial.aeval ![x, y] f =
          MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i ↦ vL (q i)) f := by
        exact congrArg (fun g ↦ MvPolynomial.aeval g f) hqval.symm
      _ = vL (MvPolynomial.aeval q f) := by
        exact (MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply (f := q) vL f).symm
      _ = L.val (MvPolynomial.aeval q f) := rfl
  have hval' : MvPolynomial.aeval ![x', y'] f =
      L'.val (MvPolynomial.aeval q' f) := by
    have hqval : (fun i ↦ vL' (q' i)) = (![x', y'] : Fin 2 → Ω) := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl
    calc
      MvPolynomial.aeval ![x', y'] f =
          MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i ↦ vL' (q' i)) f := by
        exact congrArg (fun g ↦ MvPolynomial.aeval g f) hqval.symm
      _ = vL' (MvPolynomial.aeval q' f) := by
        exact (MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply (f := q') vL' f).symm
      _ = L'.val (MvPolynomial.aeval q' f) := rfl
  have heval : MvPolynomial.aeval q' f =
      e (MvPolynomial.aeval q f) := by
    have hqeval : (fun i ↦ e.toAlgHom (q i)) = q' := by
      funext i
      exact heq i
    calc
      MvPolynomial.aeval q' f =
          MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i ↦ e.toAlgHom (q i)) f := by
        exact congrArg (fun g ↦ MvPolynomial.aeval g f) hqeval.symm
      _ = e (MvPolynomial.aeval q f) := by
        exact (MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply (f := q) e.toAlgHom f).symm
  rw [hval, hval', heval]
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hzero : MvPolynomial.aeval q f = 0 := by
      exact L.val.injective hz
    rw [hzero, map_zero]
    rfl
  · intro hz
    have hzero : e (MvPolynomial.aeval q f) = 0 := by
      apply L'.val.injective
      simpa using hz
    have := e.injective (hzero.trans (map_zero e).symm)
    simpa using congrArg L.val this

name: AclGeom.auxiliary_independent_over_parameterPairField
statement:
theorem auxiliary_independent_over_parameterPairField
    {d n : ℕ} {p : Fin d → Ω} {r : Fin n → Ω} {x y : Ω}
    (hprx : AlgebraicIndependent k
      (Sum.elim r (Fin.snoc p x) : Fin n ⊕ Fin (d + 1) → Ω))
    (hy : y ∈ racl k (insert x (Set.range p))) :
    AlgebraicIndependent
      (↥(adjoin (↥(adjoin k (Set.range p)))
        (Set.range (![x, y] : Fin 2 → Ω)))) r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let base : Fin (d + 1) → Ω := Fin.snoc p x
  let B : IntermediateField k Ω := adjoin k (Set.range base)
  let E : IntermediateField k Ω := adjoin k (Set.range p)
  let L : IntermediateField (↥E) Ω :=
    adjoin (↥E) (Set.range (![x, y] : Fin 2 → Ω))
  have hrB : AlgebraicIndependent (↥B) r := by
    change AlgebraicIndependent
      (↥(adjoin k (Set.range (Fin.snoc p x)))) r
    rw [IntermediateField.algebraicIndependent_adjoin_iff]
    exact (AlgebraicIndependent.sumElim_iff.1 hprx).2
  have hEB : E ≤ B := by
    apply adjoin.mono
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨i.castSucc, by simp [base]⟩
  have hBL : B ≤ L.restrictScalars k := by
    apply adjoin_le_iff.2
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j ↦ ?_) i
    · simpa [L, base] using
        (subset_adjoin (↥E)
          (Set.range (![x, y] : Fin 2 → Ω))
          (Set.mem_range_self (0 : Fin 2)))
    · simpa [L, base] using
        (IntermediateField.algebraMap_mem L
          ⟨p j, subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self j)⟩)
  letI : Algebra B L := (IntermediateField.inclusion hBL).toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower B L Ω := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have hLB : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (↥B) (↥L) := by
    constructor
    rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
    rw [← isAlgebraic_algHom_iff
      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom (↥B) (↥L) Ω) Subtype.val_injective]
    change IsAlgebraic (↥B) z
    apply adjoin_induction (F := ↥E) (s := Set.range (![x, y] : Fin 2 → Ω))
        (p := fun z _ ↦ IsAlgebraic (↥B) z)
    · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      fin_cases i
      · exact isAlgebraic_algebraMap (R := ↥B) (A := Ω)
          ⟨x, subset_adjoin k _ ⟨Fin.last d, by simp [base]⟩⟩
      · have hy' : IsAlgebraic (↥B) y := by
          change IsAlgebraic
            (↥(adjoin k (Set.range (Fin.snoc p x)))) y
          rw [Fin.range_snoc]
          exact (mem_racl_iff k).1 hy
        exact hy'
    · intro z
      exact isAlgebraic_algebraMap (R := ↥B) (A := Ω)
        ⟨z, hEB z.2⟩
    · exact fun _ _ _ _ hx hy ↦ hx.add hy
    · exact fun _ _ hx ↦ hx.inv
    · exact fun _ _ _ _ hx hy ↦ hx.mul hy
    · exact hz
  exact hrB.extendScalars L

name: AclGeom.source_notMem_racl_independentExtension
statement:
theorem source_notMem_racl_independentExtension
    {d n : ℕ} {p : Fin d → Ω} {r : Fin n → Ω} {x : Ω}
    (hprx : AlgebraicIndependent k
      (Sum.elim r (Fin.snoc p x) : Fin n ⊕ Fin (d + 1) → Ω)) :
    x ∉ racl (↥(adjoin k (Set.range p ∪ Set.range r)))
      (∅ : Set Ω)
proof:
:= by
  let B : IntermediateField k Ω := adjoin k (Set.range r)
  have hswap : AlgebraicIndependent k
      (Sum.elim (Fin.snoc p x) r : Fin (d + 1) ⊕ Fin n → Ω) := by
    have h := AlgebraicIndependent.comp hprx
      (Equiv.sumComm (Fin (d + 1)) (Fin n))
      (Equiv.sumComm (Fin (d + 1)) (Fin n)).injective
    convert h using 1
    funext i
    rcases i with i | i <;> rfl
  have hpx : AlgebraicIndependent (↥B) (Fin.snoc p x) := by
    change AlgebraicIndependent
      (↥(adjoin k (Set.range r))) (Fin.snoc p x)
    rw [IntermediateField.algebraicIndependent_adjoin_iff]
    exact (AlgebraicIndependent.sumElim_iff.1 hswap).2
  let S : Set (Fin (d + 1)) := Set.range Fin.castSucc
  have hlast : Fin.last d ∉ S := by
    rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact Fin.castSucc_ne_last i hi
  have hx := AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_image hpx hlast
  have himage : Fin.snoc p x '' S = Set.range p := by
    rw [← Set.range_comp]
    congr 1
    funext i
    simp
  rw [himage] at hx
  rw [mem_racl_adjoin_base_iff, Set.union_empty]
  rw [mem_racl_adjoin_base_iff] at hx
  simpa only [B, Fin.snoc_last, Set.union_comm] using hx

name: AclGeom.pairIdeal_eq_over_independentExtension_of_pairIdeal_eq
statement:
theorem pairIdeal_eq_over_independentExtension_of_pairIdeal_eq
    {E : IntermediateField k Ω} {ι : Type*} {r : ι → Ω}
    {x y x' y' : Ω}
    (h : idealOf (↥E) ![x, y] = idealOf (↥E) ![x', y'])
    (hr : AlgebraicIndependent
      (↥(adjoin (↥E) (Set.range (![x, y] : Fin 2 → Ω)))) r)
    (hr' : AlgebraicIndependent
      (↥(adjoin (↥E) (Set.range (![x', y'] : Fin 2 → Ω)))) r) :
    idealOf
        (↥((adjoin (↥E) (Set.range r)).restrictScalars k)) ![x, y] =
      idealOf
        (↥((adjoin (↥E) (Set.range r)).restrictScalars k)) ![x', y']
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L : IntermediateField (↥E) Ω :=
    adjoin (↥E) (Set.range (![x, y] : Fin 2 → Ω))
  let L' : IntermediateField (↥E) Ω :=
    adjoin (↥E) (Set.range (![x', y'] : Fin 2 → Ω))
  let C : IntermediateField (↥E) Ω := adjoin (↥E) (Set.range r)
  let Ck : IntermediateField k Ω := C.restrictScalars k
  let M : IntermediateField (↥L) Ω := adjoin (↥L) (Set.range r)
  let M' : IntermediateField (↥L') Ω := adjoin (↥L') (Set.range r)
  let e₀ : L ≃ₐ[E] L' := locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq h
  let ex : M ≃ₐ[E] M' :=
    adjoinIndependentEquivOfEquiv e₀ hr hr'
  have hCM : C ≤ M.restrictScalars (↥E) := by
    apply adjoin_le_iff.2
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact subset_adjoin (↥L) _ (Set.mem_range_self i)
  have hCM' : C ≤ M'.restrictScalars (↥E) := by
    apply adjoin_le_iff.2
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact subset_adjoin (↥L') _ (Set.mem_range_self i)
  let iCkM : Ck →+* M :=
    { toFun := fun z ↦ ⟨z, hCM z.2⟩
      map_one' := rfl
      map_mul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
      map_zero' := rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
  let iCkM' : Ck →+* M' :=
    { toFun := fun z ↦ ⟨z, hCM' z.2⟩
      map_one' := rfl
      map_mul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl
      map_zero' := rfl
      map_add' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
  letI : Algebra Ck M := iCkM.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra Ck M' := iCkM'.toAlgebra
  have hexC : ex.toAlgHom.comp (IntermediateField.inclusion hCM) =
      IntermediateField.inclusion hCM' := by
    apply adjoin_algHom_ext (↥E)
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    change ex ⟨r i, _⟩ = ⟨r i, _⟩
    simpa [ex, M, M'] using
      (adjoinIndependentEquivOfEquiv_generator e₀ hr hr' i)
  let e : M ≃ₐ[Ck] M' :=
    { ex.toRingEquiv with
      commutes' := fun z ↦ by
        change ex ⟨z, hCM z.2⟩ = ⟨z, hCM' z.2⟩
        exact DFunLike.congr_fun hexC (⟨z, z.2⟩ : C) }
  let q : Fin 2 → M :=
    ![algebraMap L M
        ⟨x, subset_adjoin (↥E) _ (Set.mem_range_self 0)⟩,
      algebraMap L M
        ⟨y, subset_adjoin (↥E) _ (Set.mem_range_self 1)⟩]
  let q' : Fin 2 → M' :=
    ![algebraMap L' M'
        ⟨x', subset_adjoin (↥E) _ (Set.mem_range_self 0)⟩,
      algebraMap L' M'
        ⟨y', subset_adjoin (↥E) _ (Set.mem_range_self 1)⟩]
  have heq (i : Fin 2) : e (q i) = q' i := by
    fin_cases i
    · change ex (algebraMap L M ⟨x, _⟩) = algebraMap L' M' ⟨x', _⟩
      rw [adjoinIndependentEquivOfEquiv_algebraMap]
      exact congrArg (algebraMap L' M')
        (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_apply h 0)
    · change ex (algebraMap L M ⟨y, _⟩) = algebraMap L' M' ⟨y', _⟩
      rw [adjoinIndependentEquivOfEquiv_algebraMap]
      exact congrArg (algebraMap L' M')
        (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_apply h 1)
  let vM : M →ₐ[Ck] Ω :=
    { M.val.toRingHom with commutes' := fun _ ↦ rfl }
  let vM' : M' →ₐ[Ck] Ω :=
    { M'.val.toRingHom with commutes' := fun _ ↦ rfl }
  change idealOf (↥Ck) ![x, y] = idealOf (↥Ck) ![x', y']
  ext f
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, mem_idealOf_iff]
  have hval : MvPolynomial.aeval ![x, y] f =
      M.val (MvPolynomial.aeval q f) := by
    have hqval : (fun i ↦ vM (q i)) = (![x, y] : Fin 2 → Ω) := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl
    calc
      MvPolynomial.aeval ![x, y] f =
          MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i ↦ vM (q i)) f := by
        exact congrArg (fun g ↦ MvPolynomial.aeval g f) hqval.symm
      _ = vM (MvPolynomial.aeval q f) := by
        exact (MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply (f := q) vM f).symm
      _ = M.val (MvPolynomial.aeval q f) := rfl
  have hval' : MvPolynomial.aeval ![x', y'] f =
      M'.val (MvPolynomial.aeval q' f) := by
    have hqval : (fun i ↦ vM' (q' i)) = (![x', y'] : Fin 2 → Ω) := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl
    calc
      MvPolynomial.aeval ![x', y'] f =
          MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i ↦ vM' (q' i)) f := by
        exact congrArg (fun g ↦ MvPolynomial.aeval g f) hqval.symm
      _ = vM' (MvPolynomial.aeval q' f) := by
        exact (MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply (f := q') vM' f).symm
      _ = M'.val (MvPolynomial.aeval q' f) := rfl
  have heval : MvPolynomial.aeval q' f =
      e (MvPolynomial.aeval q f) := by
    have hqeval : (fun i ↦ e.toAlgHom (q i)) = q' := by
      funext i
      exact heq i
    calc
      MvPolynomial.aeval q' f =
          MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i ↦ e.toAlgHom (q i)) f := by
        exact congrArg (fun g ↦ MvPolynomial.aeval g f) hqeval.symm
      _ = e (MvPolynomial.aeval q f) := by
        exact (MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply (f := q) e.toAlgHom f).symm
  rw [hval, hval', heval]
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hzero : MvPolynomial.aeval q f = 0 := M.val.injective hz
    rw [hzero, map_zero]
    rfl
  · intro hz
    have hzero : e (MvPolynomial.aeval q f) = 0 := by
      apply M'.val.injective
      simpa using hz
    have := e.injective (hzero.trans (map_zero e).symm)
    simpa using congrArg M.val this

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.coe_equivOfEq
statement:
@[simp] private theorem coe_equivOfEq
    {E E' : IntermediateField k Ω} (h : E = E') (x : E) :
    (((IntermediateField.equivOfEq h) x : E') : Ω) = x
proof:
:= by
  subst E'
  rfl

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.sourceIdeal_eq_of_ideal_eq
statement:
theorem sourceIdeal_eq_of_ideal_eq
    (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) (h : P.ideal = Q.ideal) :
    idealOf k (![P.source] : Fin 1 → Ω) =
      idealOf k (![Q.source] : Fin 1 → Ω)
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin 1 → Fin 2 := Fin.castSucc
  have h' := idealOf_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq h e
  convert h' using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.extensionEquivOfIdealEq_base_source
statement:
@[simp] theorem extensionEquivOfIdealEq_base_source
    (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) (h : P.ideal = Q.ideal) :
    (P.extensionEquivOfIdealEq Q h).baseEquiv
        ⟨P.source, subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩ =
      ⟨Q.source, subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩
proof:
:= by
  let hsource := P.sourceIdeal_eq_of_ideal_eq Q h
  let pSourceRange : P.sourceField =
      adjoin k (Set.range (![P.source] : Fin 1 → Ω)) := by
    ext z
    simp [FiniteCorrespondencePair.sourceField,
      Matrix.range_cons, Matrix.range_empty]
  let qSourceRange : Q.sourceField =
      adjoin k (Set.range (![Q.source] : Fin 1 → Ω)) := by
    ext z
    simp [FiniteCorrespondencePair.sourceField,
      Matrix.range_cons, Matrix.range_empty]
  let eBase : (↥P.sourceField) ≃ₐ[k] (↥Q.sourceField) :=
    (IntermediateField.equivOfEq pSourceRange).trans
      ((locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq hsource).trans
        (IntermediateField.equivOfEq qSourceRange.symm))
  change eBase ⟨P.source, subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩ =
    ⟨Q.source, subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hpBase :
      IntermediateField.equivOfEq pSourceRange
          ⟨P.source, subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩ =
        ⟨(![P.source] : Fin 1 → Ω) 0,
          subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self 0)⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  have hbase := congrArg Subtype.val
    (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_apply hsource 0)
  dsimp only [eBase]
  simp only [AlgEquiv.trans_apply]
  rw [hpBase]
  simpa only [coe_equivOfEq, Matrix.cons_val_zero] using hbase

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.extensionEquivOfIdealEq_total_target
statement:
@[simp] theorem extensionEquivOfIdealEq_total_target
    (Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) (h : P.ideal = Q.ideal) :
    (P.extensionEquivOfIdealEq Q h).totalEquiv
        ⟨P.target, subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩ =
      ⟨Q.target, subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩
proof:
:= by
  let pBranchRange : P.branchField =
      adjoin k (Set.range (![P.source, P.target] : Fin 2 → Ω)) := by
    change adjoin k {P.source, P.target} = _
    rw [show Set.range (![P.source, P.target] : Fin 2 → Ω) =
      {P.target, P.source} by
        simp [Matrix.range_cons, Matrix.range_empty]]
    exact congrArg (adjoin k) (Set.pair_comm _ _)
  let qBranchRange : Q.branchField =
      adjoin k (Set.range (![Q.source, Q.target] : Fin 2 → Ω)) := by
    change adjoin k {Q.source, Q.target} = _
    rw [show Set.range (![Q.source, Q.target] : Fin 2 → Ω) =
      {Q.target, Q.source} by
        simp [Matrix.range_cons, Matrix.range_empty]]
    exact congrArg (adjoin k) (Set.pair_comm _ _)
  let eTotal : (↥P.branchField) ≃ₐ[k] (↥Q.branchField) :=
    (IntermediateField.equivOfEq pBranchRange).trans
      ((locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq h).trans
        (IntermediateField.equivOfEq qBranchRange.symm))
  change eTotal ⟨P.target, subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩ =
    ⟨Q.target, subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hpTotal :
      IntermediateField.equivOfEq pBranchRange
          ⟨P.target, subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)⟩ =
        ⟨(![P.source, P.target] : Fin 2 → Ω) 1,
          subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self 1)⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  have htotal := congrArg Subtype.val
    (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_apply h 1)
  dsimp only [eTotal]
  simp only [AlgEquiv.trans_apply]
  rw [hpTotal]
  simpa only [coe_equivOfEq, Matrix.cons_val_one,
    Matrix.cons_val_zero] using htotal

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember.extensionEquivOfIdealEq_base_parameter
statement:
theorem extensionEquivOfIdealEq_base_parameter
    (G : FiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember (k := k) (Ω := Ω) d)
    (h : F.ideal = G.ideal) (z : F.parameterField) :
    (F.extensionEquivOfIdealEq G h).baseEquiv
        (IntermediateField.inclusion
          F.parameterField_le_parameterSourceField z) =
      IntermediateField.inclusion G.parameterField_le_parameterSourceField
        (F.parameterEquivOfIdealEq G h z)
proof:
:= by
  let f : F.parameterField →ₐ[k] G.parameterSourceField :=
    (F.extensionEquivOfIdealEq G h).baseEquiv.toAlgHom.comp
      (IntermediateField.inclusion
        F.parameterField_le_parameterSourceField)
  let g : F.parameterField →ₐ[k] G.parameterSourceField :=
    (IntermediateField.inclusion
      G.parameterField_le_parameterSourceField).comp
        (F.parameterEquivOfIdealEq G h).toAlgHom
  change f z = g z
  apply adjoin_induction (F := k) (s := Set.range F.parameter)
      (p := fun x hx ↦ f ⟨x, hx⟩ = g ⟨x, hx⟩)
  · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    unfold f g
    simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply]
    have hin : IntermediateField.inclusion
          F.parameterField_le_parameterSourceField
          ⟨F.parameter i, subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩ =
        ⟨F.parameterSource i.castSucc,
          subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i.castSucc)⟩ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp [parameterSource]
    have hout : IntermediateField.inclusion
          G.parameterField_le_parameterSourceField
          (F.parameterEquivOfIdealEq G h
            ⟨F.parameter i, subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩) =
        ⟨G.parameterSource i.castSucc,
          subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i.castSucc)⟩ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change ↑(F.parameterEquivOfIdealEq G h
        ⟨F.parameter i, subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩) =
          G.parameterSource i.castSucc
      rw [F.parameterEquivOfIdealEq_apply G h i]
      simp [parameterSource]
    rw [hin]
    exact (F.extensionEquivOfIdealEq_base_apply G h i.castSucc).trans
      hout.symm
  · intro x
    exact (f.commutes x).trans (g.commutes x).symm
  · intro x y hx hy hfx hfy
    change f (⟨x, hx⟩ + ⟨y, hy⟩) = g (⟨x, hx⟩ + ⟨y, hy⟩)
    rw [map_add, map_add, hfx, hfy]
  · intro x hx hfx
    change f (⟨x, hx⟩⁻¹) = g (⟨x, hx⟩⁻¹)
    rw [map_inv₀, map_inv₀, hfx]
  · intro x y hx hy hfx hfy
    change f (⟨x, hx⟩ * ⟨y, hy⟩) = g (⟨x, hx⟩ * ⟨y, hy⟩)
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, hfx, hfy]

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember.completeBranchRingEquivOfIdealEq_algebraMap
statement:
theorem completeBranchRingEquivOfIdealEq_algebraMap
    (G : FiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember (k := k) (Ω := Ω) d)
    (h : F.ideal = G.ideal) (z : F.parameterField) :
    F.completeBranchRingEquivOfIdealEq G h
        (algebraMap (↥F.parameterField) (↥F.toPair.branchOverSource) z) =
      algebraMap (↥G.parameterField) (↥G.toPair.branchOverSource)
        (F.parameterEquivOfIdealEq G h z)
proof:
:= by
  have hb := F.extensionEquivOfIdealEq_base_parameter G h z
  have ht := (F.extensionEquivOfIdealEq G h).commutes_apply
    (IntermediateField.inclusion
      F.parameterField_le_parameterSourceField z)
  have htotal := ht.trans (congrArg
    (IntermediateField.inclusion G.parameterSourceField_le_familyField) hb)
  have hin : F.familyFieldEquivPairBranch.symm
        (algebraMap (↥F.parameterField) (↥F.toPair.branchOverSource) z) =
      IntermediateField.inclusion F.parameterSourceField_le_familyField
        (IntermediateField.inclusion
          F.parameterField_le_parameterSourceField z) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  have hout : G.familyFieldEquivPairBranch
        (IntermediateField.inclusion G.parameterSourceField_le_familyField
          (IntermediateField.inclusion
            G.parameterField_le_parameterSourceField
            (F.parameterEquivOfIdealEq G h z))) =
      algebraMap (↥G.parameterField) (↥G.toPair.branchOverSource)
        (F.parameterEquivOfIdealEq G h z) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  unfold completeBranchRingEquivOfIdealEq
  simp only [RingEquiv.trans_apply]
  rw [hin]
  change (F.extensionEquivOfIdealEq G h).totalEquiv.toRingEquiv
      (IntermediateField.inclusion F.parameterSourceField_le_familyField
        (IntermediateField.inclusion
          F.parameterField_le_parameterSourceField z)) = _ at htotal
  rw [htotal]
  exact hout

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember.basedNormalEquivOfIdealEq_completeBranch
statement:
theorem basedNormalEquivOfIdealEq_completeBranch [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (G : FiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember (k := k) (Ω := Ω) d)
    (h : F.ideal = G.ideal) :
    (F.basedNormalEquivOfIdealEq G h).toRingEquiv.toRingHom.comp
        F.completeBranchToNormalCoverRingHom =
      G.completeBranchToNormalCoverRingHom.comp
        (F.completeBranchRingEquivOfIdealEq G h).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro z
  let zF : F.familyField := F.familyFieldEquivPairBranch.symm z
  let z' : extendScalars F.parameterSourceField_le_familyField :=
    ⟨zF.1, zF.2⟩
  have hz := (F.basedNormalEquivOfIdealEq G h).map_selected_apply z'
  calc
    ((F.basedNormalEquivOfIdealEq G h).toRingEquiv.toRingHom.comp
        F.completeBranchToNormalCoverRingHom) z =
      (F.basedNormalEquivOfIdealEq G h).toRingEquiv
        (FiniteCover.selectedEmbedding
          F.parameterSourceField_le_familyField z') := by rfl
    _ = FiniteCover.selectedEmbedding
        G.parameterSourceField_le_familyField
        ((F.extensionEquivOfIdealEq G h).totalEquiv z') := hz
    _ = (G.completeBranchToNormalCoverRingHom.comp
        (F.completeBranchRingEquivOfIdealEq G h).toRingHom) z := by
      apply congrArg (FiniteCover.selectedEmbedding
        G.parameterSourceField_le_familyField)
      apply Subtype.ext
      rfl

name: AclGeom.CurvePointsPlaces.closedPointPlace_comap
statement:
theorem closedPointPlace_comap
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left] [IsProper X.hom]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1)
    (hnormal : ∀ x : X.left, IsIntegrallyClosed (X.left.presheaf.stalk x))
    (a : X ≅ X) (x : {x : X.left // IsClosed ({x} : Set X.left)}) :
    (closedPointPlace X hdim hnormal x).comap (ActionFunctionField.algEquivOfIso a) =
      closedPointPlace X hdim hnormal (mapClosedPoint a x)
proof:
:= by
  let σ := ActionFunctionField.algEquivOfIso a
  let u := a.hom.left.stalkMap x.val
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective u.hom :=
    (asIso u).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.surjective
  have hfield (r : X.left.presheaf.stalk (a.hom.left x.val)) :
      σ (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk (a.hom.left x.val)) X.left.functionField r) =
        algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x.val) X.left.functionField (u.hom r) :=
    congrArg (fun f ↦ f.hom r) (functionFieldMap_stalkMap a.hom.left x.val)
  apply Place.ext_val
  apply ValuationSubring.ext
  intro z
  change σ z ∈ (closedPointPlace X hdim hnormal x).val ↔
    z ∈ (closedPointPlace X hdim hnormal (mapClosedPoint a x)).val
  rw [mem_closedPointPlace, mem_closedPointPlace]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hsurj r
    refine ⟨s, σ.injective ?_⟩
    exact (hfield s).trans
      ((congrArg (algebraMap (X.left.presheaf.stalk x.val) X.left.functionField) hs).trans hr)
  · rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
    refine ⟨u.hom r, ?_⟩
    exact (hfield r).symm.trans (congrArg σ hr)

name: AclGeom.AdditiveRigidity.over_hom_ext_of_points
proof:
:= by
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType (f.left ≫ Y.hom) := by rw [Over.w f]; infer_instance
  refine AlgebraicGeometry.ext_of_apply_eq Y.hom Set.univ isClosed_univ.isLocallyClosed
    dense_univ ?_ ((Over.w f).trans (Over.w g).symm)
  intro y _ hy
  let p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ X :=
    Over.homMk (pointOfClosedPoint X.hom y hy) (pointOfClosedPoint_comp X.hom y hy)
  have he := congrArg (fun f ↦ f.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) (h p)
  have hpy : p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) = y := pointOfClosedPoint_apply X.hom y hy _
  change f.left (p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) =
    g.left (p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) at he
  rwa [hpy] at he

name: AclGeom.GenericFiniteCover.exists_finite_away
statement:
theorem exists_finite_away {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [CommRing S] [IsDomain S] [Algebra R S] [Algebra.FiniteType R S]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic R S] (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap R S)) :
    ∃ r : R, r ≠ 0 ∧
      (IsLocalization.Away.map (Localization.Away r)
        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R S r)) (algebraMap R S) r).Finite ∧
      Function.Injective (IsLocalization.Away.map (Localization.Away r)
        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R S r)) (algebraMap R S) r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Algebra.FiniteType.out (R := R) (A := S)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hint⟩ := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.exists_integral_multiples R s
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
  let Rr := Localization.Away r
  let Sr := Localization.Away (algebraMap R S r)
  let f : Rr →+* Sr := IsLocalization.Away.map Rr Sr (algebraMap R S) r
  let : Algebra Rr Sr := f.toAlgebra
  have hf (a : R) : f (algebraMap R Rr a) = algebraMap S Sr (algebraMap R S a) :=
    IsLocalization.map_eq _ a
  have : IsScalarTower R Rr Sr := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun a ↦ (hf a).symm
  have hg (x : S) (hx : x ∈ s) : IsIntegral Rr (algebraMap S Sr x) := by
    have hh : IsIntegral Rr (algebraMap S Sr (r • x)) :=
      ((hint x hx).algebraMap (B := Sr)).tower_top
    apply IsIntegral.of_mul_unit
      (r := IsLocalization.Away.invSelf r)
      (y := algebraMap Rr Sr (algebraMap R Rr r))
    · rw [← map_mul, mul_comm, IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf, map_one]
    · simpa only [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul,
        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R Rr Sr,
        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R S Sr, mul_comm] using hh
  have hS (x : S) : IsIntegral Rr (algebraMap S Sr x) := by
    have hx : x ∈ Algebra.adjoin R (s : Set S) := by rw [hs]; trivial
    induction hx using Algebra.adjoin_induction with
    | mem x hx => exact hg x hx
    | algebraMap a =>
      rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R S Sr,
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R Rr Sr]
      exact isIntegral_algebraMap
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => simpa only [map_add] using hx.add hy
    | mul x y _ _ hx hy => simpa only [map_mul] using hx.mul hy
  have : Algebra.IsIntegral Rr Sr := by
    constructor
    intro x
    obtain ⟨a, ⟨_, n, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ :=
      IsLocalization.exists_mk'_eq (Submonoid.powers (algebraMap R S r)) x
    have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap R Rr (r ^ n)) := by
      rw [map_pow]
      exact (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit r).pow n
    apply IsIntegral.of_mul_unit
      (r := ((hu.unit⁻¹ : Rrˣ) : Rr))
      (y := algebraMap Rr Sr (algebraMap R Rr (r ^ n)))
    · rw [← map_mul]
      have hh : ((hu.unit⁻¹ : Rrˣ) : Rr) * algebraMap R Rr (r ^ n) = 1 := by
        simpa only [hu.unit_spec] using Units.inv_mul hu.unit
      exact (congrArg (algebraMap Rr Sr) hh).trans (map_one _)
    · have he : algebraMap Rr Sr (algebraMap R Rr (r ^ n)) =
          algebraMap S Sr ((algebraMap R S r) ^ n) := by
        rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R Rr Sr,
          IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R S Sr, map_pow]
      rw [he, IsLocalization.mk'_spec]
      exact hS a
  have : Algebra.FiniteType R Sr := Algebra.FiniteType.trans
    (inferInstance : Algebra.FiniteType R S) inferInstance
  have : Algebra.FiniteType Rr Sr := Algebra.FiniteType.of_restrictScalars_finiteType R Rr Sr
  refine ⟨Algebra.IsIntegral.finite, ?_⟩
  apply (IsLocalization.Away.map_injective_iff Sr (algebraMap R S) r).mpr
  intro a ha
  have hz : a = 0 := hinj (ha.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  exact ⟨0, by rw [hz]; simp⟩

name: AclGeom.GenericFiniteCover.AclGeom.GenericFiniteCover.exists_finite_away_of_injective_points
statement:
theorem exists_finite_away_of_injective_points {k B A : Type*} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [Algebra k B] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A]
    (ψ : B →ₐ[k] A) (hinj : Function.Injective ψ)
    (hpoints : Function.Injective (fun φ : A →ₐ[k] k ↦ φ.comp ψ)) :
    ∃ r : B, r ≠ 0 ∧
      (IsLocalization.Away.map (Localization.Away r)
        (Localization.Away (ψ r)) ψ.toRingHom r).Finite ∧
      Function.Injective (IsLocalization.Away.map (Localization.Away r)
        (Localization.Away (ψ r)) ψ.toRingHom r)
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra B A := ψ.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower k B A := IsScalarTower.of_algHom ψ
  let E := FractionRing A
  let F := FractionRing B
  let ι : B →ₐ[k] E := (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A E).comp ψ
  have hι : Function.Injective ι := (IsFractionRing.injective A E).comp hinj
  have : IsScalarTower B A E := inferInstance
  let η : F →ₐ[k] E := IsFractionRing.liftAlgHom hι
  let : Algebra F E := η.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower B F E := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦ by
    exact (IsFractionRing.lift_algebraMap hι x).symm
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic F E :=
    isAlgebraic_fractionRing_of_injective_points (B := B) (A := A)
      (C := F) (E := E) hpoints
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic B E :=
    (IsFractionRing.comap_isAlgebraic_iff (A := B) (K := F) (C := E)).mpr inferInstance
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic B A := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_injective
    (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom B A E) (IsFractionRing.injective A E)
  have : Algebra.FiniteType B A := Algebra.FiniteType.of_restrictScalars_finiteType k B A
  exact exists_finite_away hinj

name: AclGeom.GenericFiniteCover.AclGeom.GenericFiniteCover.AclGeom.GenericFiniteCover.exists_finite_open_square
statement:
theorem exists_finite_open_square {k B A : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [Algebra k B] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A]
    (ψ : B →ₐ[k] A) (hinj : Function.Injective ψ)
    (hpoints : Function.Injective (fun φ : A →ₐ[k] k ↦ φ.comp ψ))
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    (g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion g.left]
    (f : X ⟶ (Spec (.of B)).asOver (Spec (.of k)))
    (hψ : (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom ψ).op = g ≫ f) :
    ∃ (U T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (jU : U ⟶ X)
      (jT : T ⟶ (Spec (.of B)).asOver (Spec (.of k))) (π : U ⟶ T),
      IsOpenImmersion jU.left ∧ IsOpenImmersion jT.left ∧
      Nonempty U.left ∧ Nonempty T.left ∧ IsFinite π.left ∧ Surjective π.left ∧
      jU ≫ f = π ≫ jT
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hfinite, hinjloc⟩ := exists_finite_away_of_injective_points ψ hinj hpoints
  let Rr := Localization.Away r
  let Sr := Localization.Away (ψ r)
  have : IsDomain Rr := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain Rr hr
  have hψr : ψ r ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hr (hinj (h.trans (map_zero _).symm))
  have : IsDomain Sr := IsLocalization.Away.isDomain Sr hψr
  let U := (Spec (.of Sr)).asOver (Spec (.of k))
  let T := (Spec (.of Rr)).asOver (Spec (.of k))
  let iA : U ⟶ (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) :=
    (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A Sr)).op
  let iB : T ⟶ (Spec (.of B)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) :=
    (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k B Rr)).op
  let φ : Rr →ₐ[k] Sr := IsLocalization.Away.mapₐ Rr Sr ψ r
  let π : U ⟶ T := (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op
  have hiA : IsOpenImmersion iA.left := by
    change IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A Sr)))
    infer_instance
  have hiB : IsOpenImmersion iB.left := by
    change IsOpenImmersion (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B Rr)))
    infer_instance
  have hπfinite : IsFinite π.left := by
    change IsFinite (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom))
    exact (IsFinite.SpecMap_iff _).mpr hfinite
  have hπsurj : Surjective π.left := by
    constructor
    change Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap φ.toRingHom)
    exact hfinite.to_isIntegral.comap_surjective hinjloc
  have hcomm : iA ≫ (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom ψ).op = π ≫ iB := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A Sr)) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ.toRingHom) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B Rr))
    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
    apply congrArg Spec.map
    ext b
    change algebraMap A Sr (ψ b) = φ (algebraMap B Rr b)
    have hy : Submonoid.powers r ≤ (Submonoid.powers (ψ r)).comap ψ.toRingHom := by
      rintro z ⟨n, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨n, (map_pow ψ r n).symm⟩
    exact (IsLocalization.map_eq (M := Submonoid.powers r)
      (T := Submonoid.powers (ψ r)) (S := Rr) (Q := Sr) (g := ψ.toRingHom) hy b).symm
  have hU : Nonempty U.left := by
    change Nonempty (PrimeSpectrum Sr)
    exact ⟨⟨⊥, inferInstance⟩⟩
  have hT : Nonempty T.left := by
    change Nonempty (PrimeSpectrum Rr)
    exact ⟨⟨⊥, inferInstance⟩⟩
  refine ⟨U, T, iA ≫ g, iB, π, ?_, hiB, hU, hT, hπfinite, hπsurj, ?_⟩
  · change IsOpenImmersion (iA.left ≫ g.left)
    infer_instance
  · have hh : iA ≫ (g ≫ f) =
        iA ≫ (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom ψ).op :=
      congrArg (fun m : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶
        (Spec (.of B)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ↦ iA ≫ m) hψ.symm
    exact (Category.assoc iA g f).trans (hh.trans hcomm)

name: AclGeom.isIntegral_pullback_of_isAlgClosed
statement:
theorem isIntegral_pullback_of_isAlgClosed {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) : IsIntegral (pullback f g)
proof:
:= by
  let E := X.residueField (genericPoint X)
  let F := Y.residueField (genericPoint Y)
  let a : Spec E ⟶ X := X.fromSpecResidueField (genericPoint X)
  let b : Spec F ⟶ Y := Y.fromSpecResidueField (genericPoint Y)
  have : IsDominant a := ⟨by
    rw [denseRange_iff_closure_range]
    change closure (Set.range (X.fromSpecResidueField (genericPoint X))) = Set.univ
    rw [Scheme.range_fromSpecResidueField]
    exact genericPoint_closure X⟩
  have : IsDominant b := ⟨by
    rw [denseRange_iff_closure_range]
    change closure (Set.range (Y.fromSpecResidueField (genericPoint Y))) = Set.univ
    rw [Scheme.range_fromSpecResidueField]
    exact genericPoint_closure Y⟩
  have : IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant a := .of_isDominant a
  have : IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant b := .of_isDominant b
  have : QuasiCompact a := inferInstance
  have : QuasiCompact b := inferInstance
  let : Algebra k E := (Spec.preimage (a ≫ f)).hom.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra k F := (Spec.preimage (b ≫ g)).hom.toAlgebra
  have ea : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k E)) = a ≫ f :=
    Spec.map_preimage (a ≫ f)
  have eb : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k F)) = b ≫ g :=
    Spec.map_preimage (b ≫ g)
  let Q : Scheme := pullback (a ≫ f) (b ≫ g)
  let M : Scheme := pullback f (b ≫ g)
  let P : Scheme := pullback f g
  have : IsIntegral Q := by
    have : IsDomain (E ⊗[k] F) := isDomain_tensorProduct_of_isAlgClosed
    let e : Q ≅ Spec (.of (E ⊗[k] F)) :=
      pullback.congrHom ea.symm eb.symm ≪≫ pullbackSpecIso k E F
    exact IsIntegral.of_isIso e.inv
  have m : IsPullback (pullback.fst f (b ≫ g)) (pullback.snd f (b ≫ g)) f (b ≫ g) :=
    .of_hasPullback _ _
  let q : Q ⟶ M := m.lift (pullback.fst (a ≫ f) (b ≫ g) ≫ a)
    (pullback.snd (a ≫ f) (b ≫ g)) (by rw [Category.assoc]; exact pullback.condition)
  have hq : IsPullback (pullback.fst (a ≫ f) (b ≫ g)) q a
      (pullback.fst f (b ≫ g)) :=
    IsPullback.of_bot' (IsPullback.of_hasPullback (a ≫ f) (b ≫ g)) m
  have : Flat (pullback.fst f (b ≫ g)) := inferInstance
  have : QuasiCompact q := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback hq (inferInstance : QuasiCompact a)
  have : IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant q := .of_isPullback hq
  have p : IsPullback (pullback.snd f g) (pullback.fst f g) g f :=
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f g).flip
  let r : M ⟶ P := p.lift (pullback.snd f (b ≫ g) ≫ b) (pullback.fst f (b ≫ g))
    (by rw [Category.assoc]; exact pullback.condition.symm)
  have hr : IsPullback (pullback.snd f (b ≫ g)) r b (pullback.snd f g) :=
    IsPullback.of_bot' (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f (b ≫ g)).flip p
  have : Flat (pullback.snd f g) := inferInstance
  have : QuasiCompact r := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback hr (inferInstance : QuasiCompact b)
  have : IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant r := .of_isPullback hr
  have : IsReduced P := IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant.isReduced (q ≫ r)
  have : IrreducibleSpace P := by
    apply (irreducibleSpace_def P).2
    change IsIrreducible (Set.univ : Set P)
    rw [← (q ≫ r).denseRange.closure_eq, ← Set.image_univ]
    exact ((IrreducibleSpace.isIrreducible_univ Q).image (q ≫ r)
      (q ≫ r).continuous.continuousOn).closure
  exact isIntegral_of_irreducibleSpace_of_isReduced P

name: AclGeom.geometricallyIntegral_of_isAlgClosed
statement:
theorem geometricallyIntegral_of_isAlgClosed {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) : GeometricallyIntegral f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro K _ y Z fst snd h
  have : IsIntegral (pullback f y) := isIntegral_pullback_of_isAlgClosed f y
  exact IsIntegral.of_isIso h.isoPullback.inv

name: AclGeom.SchemeAffineFinite.exists_finite_surjective_morphism
statement:
theorem exists_finite_surjective_morphism
    (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (hker : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
      ModObj.pointAct V q = 𝟙 V → q = 1)
    (hdimG : (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDim G.toAlgebraicGroup.carrier)
    (hdimV : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1) :
    ∃ t : V.left.functionField, Transcendental k t ∧
      IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set V.left.functionField) = ⊤ ∧
    ∃ Φ : (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) →* AffineTransformation k,
      Function.Injective Φ ∧
      (∀ q, (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V q).unop t =
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField ((Φ q).multiplier : k) * t +
          algebraMap k V.left.functionField (Φ q).shift) ∧
    ∃ f : G.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k),
      Function.Injective (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X ↦
        q ≫ f.hom.hom) ∧
      (∀ q, AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom) = Φ q) ∧
      IsFinite f.hom.hom.left ∧ Surjective f.hom.hom.left
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htop, Φ, hΦinj, hΦ, f, hfinj, hpoint,
    U, T, jU, jT, π, hjU, hjT, _, hT, hfinite, hsurj, hsq, _⟩ :=
    SchemeAffineParameterCover.exists_finite_parameter_cover G V hker hdimG hdimV
  have hglobal := @GroupFinite.finite_surjective k _ _ G.toAlgebraicGroup
    (AffineGroupScheme.connectedAlgebraicGroup k) f hfinj U T jU jT π
      hjU hjT hT hfinite hsurj hsq
  exact ⟨t, ht, htop, Φ, hΦinj, hΦ, f, hfinj, hpoint, hglobal⟩

name: AclGeom.SchemeAffineFinite.exists_finite_morphism_whole_curve
statement:
theorem exists_finite_morphism_whole_curve
    (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (hker : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
      ModObj.pointAct V q = 𝟙 V → q = 1)
    (hdimG : (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDim G.toAlgebraicGroup.carrier)
    (hdimV : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1)
    (i : (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).Hom G.toAlgebraicGroup)
    [Mono i.hom.hom] :
    ∃ t : V.left.functionField, Transcendental k t ∧
      IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set V.left.functionField) = ⊤ ∧
    ∃ f : G.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k),
      Function.Injective (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X ↦
        q ≫ f.hom.hom) ∧
      IsFinite f.hom.hom.left ∧ Surjective f.hom.hom.left ∧
      (∀ q, (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V q).unop t =
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField
          ((AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom)).multiplier : k) * t +
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField
          (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom)).shift) ∧
    ∃ e : V ≅ (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X,
      SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter V ≫ e.hom = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k t ∧
      γ[G.toGroupScheme.X, V] ≫ e.hom =
        lift (fst G.toGroupScheme.X V ≫ f.hom.hom)
          (snd G.toGroupScheme.X V ≫ e.hom) ≫ AffineSchemeAction.smul k ∧
      ∀ (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
        (q : (Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X)
        (z : (Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ V) (a : Cˣ) (b c : C),
        q ≫ f.hom.hom = AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k a b →
        z ≫ e.hom = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k c →
        (lift q z ≫ γ[G.toGroupScheme.X, V]) ≫ e.hom =
          AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k ((a : C) * c + b)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htop, Φ, _, hΦ, f, hfinj, hpoint, hfinite, hsurj⟩ :=
    exists_finite_surjective_morphism G V hker hdimG hdimV
  have hf (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) :
      (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V q).unop t =
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField
          ((AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom)).multiplier : k) * t +
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField
          (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom)).shift := by
    rw [hpoint]
    exact hΦ q
  exact ⟨t, ht, htop, f, hfinj, hfinite, hsurj, hf,
    CurveGlobalCoordinate.whole_curve_coordinate_of_affine_data
      G V hker hdimV i t ht htop Φ hΦ f hpoint⟩

name: AclGeom.RecoverableFiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember.endpointField_le_familyField
statement: theorem endpointField_le_familyField : F.endpointField ≤ F.familyField
proof:
:= by
  apply adjoin.mono
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  fin_cases i
  · exact ⟨1, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨2, rfl⟩

name: AclGeom.RecoverableFiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember.tuple_isAlgebraic_endpointField
statement:
theorem tuple_isAlgebraic_endpointField (i : Fin 3) :
    IsAlgebraic (↥F.endpointField)
      (F.toFiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember.tuple i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [endpointField]
  apply (mem_racl_iff k).1
  fin_cases i
  · simpa [endpointTuple, FiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember.tuple,
      FiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember.parameterSource, Matrix.range_cons,
      Matrix.range_empty, Set.pair_comm] using F.parameter_mem_endpoints
  · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨0, rfl⟩
  · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨1, rfl⟩

name: AclGeom.RecoverableFiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember.familyOverEndpoints_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem familyOverEndpoints_finiteDimensional :
    FiniteDimensional (↥F.endpointField) (↥F.familyOverEndpoints)
proof:
:= by
  have key : F.familyOverEndpoints =
      adjoin (↥F.endpointField)
        (Set.range F.toFiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember.tuple) := by
    refine restrictScalars_injective k ?_
    unfold familyOverEndpoints
    rw [extendScalars_restrictScalars]
    unfold endpointField familyField
    rw [adjoin_adjoin_left, adjoin_union]
    exact (sup_eq_right.2 F.endpointField_le_familyField).symm
  rw [key]
  letI : Fintype
      (Set.range F.toFiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember.tuple) :=
    Set.Finite.fintype
      (Set.finite_range F.toFiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember.tuple)
  exact finiteDimensional_adjoin fun _ hx ↦ by
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact (F.tuple_isAlgebraic_endpointField i).isIntegral

name: AclGeom.RecoverableFiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember.familyOverEndpoints_le_normal
statement:
theorem familyOverEndpoints_le_normal :
    F.familyOverEndpoints ≤ F.normalFamilyOverEndpoints
proof:
:=
  FiniteCover.extendScalars_le_normalClosureOver
    F.endpointField_le_familyField

name: AclGeom.RecoverableFiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember.normalFamilyOverEndpoints_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem normalFamilyOverEndpoints_finiteDimensional :
    FiniteDimensional (↥F.endpointField)
      (↥F.normalFamilyOverEndpoints)
proof:
:=
  FiniteCover.normalClosureOver_finiteDimensional
    F.endpointField_le_familyField
    F.familyOverEndpoints_finiteDimensional

name: AclGeom.RecoverableFiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember.normalFamilyOverEndpoints_normal
statement:
theorem normalFamilyOverEndpoints_normal [IsAlgClosed Ω] :
    Normal (↥F.endpointField) (↥F.normalFamilyOverEndpoints)
proof:
:= by
  letI := F.familyOverEndpoints_finiteDimensional
  exact FiniteCover.normalClosureOver_normal
    F.endpointField_le_familyField
    (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_finite
      (↥F.endpointField) (↥F.familyOverEndpoints))

name: AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.bijective_of_polynomial_cover
statement:
theorem bijective_of_polynomial_cover
    (α : k[X] →ₐ[k] A) (σ : A →ₐ[k] k[X]) (hσ : Function.Injective σ)
    (j : A →ₐ[k] F) (hj : Function.Injective j)
    (hja : j.comp α = IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k k[X] F) : Function.Bijective α
proof:
:= by
  have hα : Function.Injective α := by
    intro a b h
    apply IsFractionRing.injective k[X] F
    have hh := congrArg j h
    change (j.comp α) a = (j.comp α) b at hh
    rw [hja] at hh
    exact hh
  let ψ := σ.comp α
  have hψ : Function.Injective ψ := hσ.comp hα
  have hq : (ψ X).natDegree ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hc : ψ X = ψ (C ((ψ X).coeff 0)) :=
      (Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero h).trans (ψ.commutes _).symm
    exact X_ne_C _ (hψ hc)
  have hfin : ψ.toRingHom.Finite :=
    AdditiveOrbit.finite_of_nonconstant_polynomial_image ψ X hq
  refine ⟨hα, ?_⟩
  intro a
  have ha : α.toRingHom.IsIntegralElem a :=
