    RingHom.IsIntegralElem.of_map hσ (hfin.to_isIntegral (σ a))
  have hjint : IsIntegral k[X] (j a) := by
    have hh := ha.map j.toRingHom
    have he : j.toRingHom.comp α.toRingHom = algebraMap k[X] F :=
      congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom hja
    rw [he] at hh
    exact hh
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := IsIntegrallyClosed.algebraMap_eq_of_integral hjint
  refine ⟨r, hj ?_⟩
  change (j.comp α) r = j a
  rw [hja]
  exact hr

name: AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.fractionRing_of_generator
statement:
theorem fractionRing_of_generator {k F : Type u} [Field k] [Field F] [Algebra k F]
    (t : F) (ht : Transcendental k t)
    (htop : IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F) = ⊤) :
    let : Algebra k[X] F
proof:
:= (aeval t).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    IsFractionRing k[X] F := by
  let : Algebra k[X] F := (aeval t).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have : FaithfulSMul k[X] F := (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective k[X] F).mpr
    (transcendental_iff_injective.mp ht)
  apply IsFractionRing.of_field
  intro z
  apply (IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_iff k z).mp
  rw [htop]
  trivial

name: AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.isIso_of_surjective_line_cover
statement:
theorem isIso_of_surjective_line_cover
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    (x : V ⟶ (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X)
    (t : V.left.functionField) (ht : Transcendental k t)
    (htop : IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set V.left.functionField) = ⊤)
    (hgen : SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter V ≫ x = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k t)
    (o : (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X ⟶ V)
    [Surjective o.left] : IsIso x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A : Type u := Γ(V.left, ⊤)
  let R := AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1
  let F : Type u := V.left.functionField
  let e : V ≅ (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) :=
    SchemeGenericTranslate.sectionsSpecIso V
  let e₀ : V.left ≅ Spec (.of A) := (Over.forget (Spec (.of k))).mapIso e
  let x₀ : V.left ⟶ Spec (.of R) := x.left
  let o₀ : Spec (.of R) ⟶ V.left := o.left
  let g₀ : Spec (.of F) ⟶ V.left := (SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter V).left
  let ν : R →ₐ[k] F := AffineSchemeAction.lineEval t
  have hgen₀ : g₀ ≫ x₀ = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ν.toRingHom) :=
    congrArg Over.Hom.left hgen
  have : Nonempty (⊤ : V.left.Opens) := ⟨⟨genericPoint V.left, trivial⟩⟩
  have : IsScalarTower k A F := SchemeGenericTranslate.sections_functionField_isScalarTower V
  let j : A →ₐ[k] F := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A F
  have hj : Function.Injective j := V.left.germToFunctionField_injective ⊤
  obtain ⟨α₀, hα₀⟩ := AdditiveOrbit.exists_algHom_of_spec_hom R A (e.inv ≫ x)
  obtain ⟨σ₀, hσ₀⟩ := AdditiveOrbit.exists_algHom_of_spec_hom A R (o ≫ e.hom)
  have hαleft := congrArg Over.Hom.left hα₀
  have hσleft := congrArg Over.Hom.left hσ₀
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α₀.toRingHom) = e₀.inv ≫ x₀ at hαleft
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom σ₀.toRingHom) = o₀ ≫ e₀.hom at hσleft
  have hgenj : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom j.toRingHom) =
      g₀ ≫ e₀.hom := by
    change Spec.map (V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤) =
      V.left.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint V.left) ≫ V.left.toSpecΓ
    exact (Scheme.fromSpecStalk_toSpecΓ _ _).symm
  have hja₀ : j.comp α₀ = ν := by
    have hh : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (j.comp α₀).toRingHom) =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ν.toRingHom) := by
      change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α₀.toRingHom ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom j.toRingHom) = _
      rw [Spec.map_comp, hgenj, hαleft, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
      exact hgen₀
    have hh' := congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (Spec.map_injective hh)
    exact AlgHom.ext fun a ↦ congrArg (fun f : R →+* F ↦ f a) hh'
  have : Surjective o₀ := inferInstanceAs (Surjective o.left)
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap σ₀.toRingHom) := by
    have : Surjective (o₀ ≫ e₀.hom) := inferInstance
    have hh : Surjective (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom σ₀.toRingHom)) := by
      rw [hσleft]
      infer_instance
    exact hh.1
  have hσinj : Function.Injective σ₀ := by
    obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := hsurj (⟨⊥, inferInstance⟩ : PrimeSpectrum A)
    have hcomap : Ideal.comap σ₀.toRingHom P.asIdeal = ⊥ := congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hP
    apply (RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot σ₀.toRingHom).mpr
    apply le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
    intro a ha
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker] at ha
    change σ₀ a = 0 at ha
    rw [← hcomap]
    change σ₀ a ∈ P.asIdeal
    rw [ha]
    exact P.asIdeal.zero_mem
  let P := AdditiveTranslation.polynomialCoordinates k
  let α : Polynomial k →ₐ[k] A := α₀.comp P.symm.toAlgHom
  let σ : A →ₐ[k] Polynomial k := P.toAlgHom.comp σ₀
  have hσ : Function.Injective σ := P.injective.comp hσinj
  let : Algebra (Polynomial k) F := (Polynomial.aeval t).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower k (Polynomial k) F := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun c ↦
    ((Polynomial.aeval t).commutes c).symm
  have : IsFractionRing (Polynomial k) F := fractionRing_of_generator t ht htop
  have hja : j.comp α = IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k (Polynomial k) F := by
    apply AlgHom.ext
    intro p
    change (j.comp α₀) (P.symm p) = Polynomial.aeval t p
    rw [hja₀]
    change AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) t (P.symm p) = Polynomial.aeval t p
    rw [AdditiveTranslation.lineEval_polynomialCoordinates]
    rw [P.apply_symm_apply]
  have hbij : Function.Bijective α := bijective_of_polynomial_cover α σ hσ j hj hja
  have hα₀bij : Function.Bijective α₀ := by
    have heq : α₀ = α.comp P.toAlgHom := by
      apply AlgHom.ext
      intro r
      exact (congrArg α₀ (P.symm_apply_apply r)).symm
    rw [heq]
    exact hbij.comp P.bijective
  have : IsIso (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α₀.toRingHom)) :=
    (isIso_SpecMap_iff).mpr hα₀bij
  have : IsIso (e₀.inv ≫ x₀) := by rw [← hαleft]; infer_instance
  have : IsIso x₀ := IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left e₀.inv x₀
  have : IsIso x.left := this
  have : IsIso ((Over.forget (Spec (.of k))).map x) := inferInstanceAs (IsIso x.left)
  exact isIso_of_reflects_iso x (Over.forget (Spec (.of k)))

name: AclGeom.RegularAffineModel.exists_whole_curve_model
statement:
theorem exists_whole_curve_model
    (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (hker : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
      ModObj.pointAct V q = 𝟙 V → q = 1)
    (hdimG : (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDim G.toAlgebraicGroup.carrier)
    (hdimV : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1)
    (N : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k) (i : N.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom G.toAlgebraicGroup)
    [IsMonHom.Normal i.hom.hom] [IsClosedImmersion i.hom.hom.left]
    (hdimN : topologicalKrullDim N.toAlgebraicGroup.carrier = 1) :
    ∃ t : V.left.functionField, Transcendental k t ∧
      IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set V.left.functionField) = ⊤ ∧
    ∃ f : G.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k),
      Function.Injective (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X ↦
        q ≫ f.hom.hom) ∧ IsFinite f.hom.hom.left ∧ Surjective f.hom.hom.left ∧
      (∀ q, (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V q).unop t =
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField
          ((AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom)).multiplier : k) * t +
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField
          (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom)).shift) ∧
      (∀ (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
        (q r : (Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X)
        (c a : Cˣ) (d b : C),
        q ≫ f.hom.hom = AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k c d →
        r ≫ f.hom.hom = AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k a b →
        (q * r) ≫ f.hom.hom =
          AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k (c * a) ((c : C) * b + d)) ∧
    ∃ (χ : G.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom (multiplicativeGroup k))
      (β : N.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1)),
      Surjective χ.hom.hom.left ∧
      χ.hom.hom = f.hom.hom ≫ AffineDilation.projection k ∧
      IsFinite β.hom.hom.left ∧ Surjective β.hom.hom.left ∧
      Function.Injective (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ N.toGroupScheme.X ↦
        q ≫ β.hom.hom) ∧
      β.hom.hom ≫ AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k = i.hom.hom ≫ f.hom.hom ∧
    ∃ ψ : G.toGroupScheme.X ⊗ N.toGroupScheme.X ⟶ N.toGroupScheme.X,
      ψ ≫ i.hom.hom = G.toGroupScheme.X ◁ i.hom.hom ≫ conj G.toGroupScheme.X ∧
      ψ ≫ β.hom.hom = lift
        (fst G.toGroupScheme.X N.toGroupScheme.X ≫ χ.hom.hom)
        (snd G.toGroupScheme.X N.toGroupScheme.X ≫ β.hom.hom) ≫
          AdditiveRigidity.scalarMul k ∧
      (∀ (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
        (q : (Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X)
        (n : (Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ N.toGroupScheme.X)
        (a : Cˣ) (b : C),
        q ≫ χ.hom.hom = AdditiveRigidity.unitPoint k a →
        n ≫ β.hom.hom = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k b →
        (lift q n ≫ ψ) ≫ β.hom.hom =
          AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k ((a : C) * b)) ∧
    ∃ p : ℕ, ExpChar k p ∧
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (α : (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).Hom N.toAlgebraicGroup),
      IsFinite α.hom.hom.left ∧ Surjective α.hom.hom.left ∧
      α.hom.hom ≫ β.hom.hom = FiniteGaCover.relativeFrobenius k p n ∧
      (∀ (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra k C] (c : C),
        AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k c ≫ α.hom.hom ≫ β.hom.hom =
          AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (c ^ p ^ n)) ∧
    ∃ e : V ≅ (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X,
      SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter V ≫ e.hom = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k t ∧
      γ[G.toGroupScheme.X, V] ≫ e.hom =
        lift (fst G.toGroupScheme.X V ≫ f.hom.hom)
          (snd G.toGroupScheme.X V ≫ e.hom) ≫ AffineSchemeAction.smul k ∧
      ∀ (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
        (q : (Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X)
        (z : (Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ V) (a : Cˣ) (b c : C),
        q ≫ f.hom.hom = AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k a b →
        z ≫ e.hom = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k c →
        (lift q z ≫ γ[G.toGroupScheme.X, V]) ≫ e.hom =
          AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k ((a : C) * c + b)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htop, f, hfinj, hfinite, hsurj, hfield, hmul,
    χ, β, hχsurj, hχ, hβfin, hβsurj, hβinj, hβfactor, ψ, hψ, hβconj, hconjC, _⟩ :=
    exists_model G V hker hdimG hdimV N i hdimN
  have : IsFinite β.hom.hom.left := hβfin
  have : Surjective β.hom.hom.left := hβsurj
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ExpChar.exists k
  have := hp
  obtain ⟨n, α, hαfin, hαsurj, hαβ, hαC⟩ :=
    FiniteGaCover.exists_group_cover N hdimN β hβinj p
  let jGa : (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).Hom G.toAlgebraicGroup := α ≫ i
  let Q (c : k) : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶
      (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X :=
    (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k c
  have hQ₀ : Q 0 = 1 := by
    change (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (0 : k) = 1
    rw [AdditiveTranslation.linePoint_zero, comp_one]
  have hjGa : Q 1 ≫ jGa.hom.hom ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have hα : Q 1 ≫ α.hom.hom = 1 := by
      apply (cancel_mono i.hom.hom).mp
      rw [one_comp]
      exact (Category.assoc (Q 1) α.hom.hom i.hom.hom).trans h
    have hh := congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ β.hom.hom) hα
    rw [Category.assoc, one_comp] at hh
    have hQ₁ : Q 1 ≫ α.hom.hom ≫ β.hom.hom = Q 1 := by
      dsimp only [Q]
      rw [Category.assoc, hαC, one_pow]
    apply (one_ne_zero : (1 : k) ≠ 0)
    apply AffineSchemeAction.linePoint_injective k
    apply (cancel_epi (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom).mp
    exact (hQ₁.symm.trans hh).trans hQ₀.symm
  let Φ := (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k).toMonoidHom.comp
    (IsMonHom.monoidHom f.hom.hom (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k)))))
  have hΦ (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) :
      (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V q).unop t =
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField ((Φ q).multiplier : k) * t +
          algebraMap k V.left.functionField (Φ q).shift := hfield q
  have hpoint (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) :
      AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom) = Φ q := rfl
  obtain ⟨e, hgen, haction, hactionC⟩ :=
    CurveGlobalCoordinate.whole_curve_coordinate_of_affine_data_of_nontrivial_ga G V
      hker hdimV jGa hjGa t ht htop Φ hΦ f hpoint
  exact ⟨t, ht, htop, f, hfinj, hfinite, hsurj, hfield, hmul,
    χ, β, hχsurj, hχ, hβfin, hβsurj, hβinj, hβfactor, ψ, hψ, hβconj, hconjC,
    p, hp, n, α, hαfin, hαsurj, hαβ, hαC, e, hgen, haction, hactionC⟩

name: AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.whole_curve_coordinate_of_affine_data_of_nontrivial_ga
statement:
theorem whole_curve_coordinate_of_affine_data_of_nontrivial_ga
    (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (hker : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
      ModObj.pointAct V q = 𝟙 V → q = 1)
    (hdimV : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1)
    (i : (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).Hom G.toAlgebraicGroup)
    (hi : ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (1 : k)) ≫
      i.hom.hom ≠ 1)
    (t : V.left.functionField) (ht : Transcendental k t)
    (htop : IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set V.left.functionField) = ⊤)
    (Φ : (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) →* AffineTransformation k)
    (hΦ : ∀ q, (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V q).unop t =
      algebraMap k V.left.functionField ((Φ q).multiplier : k) * t +
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField (Φ q).shift)
    (f : G.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k))
    (hpoint : ∀ q, AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom) = Φ q) :
    ∃ e : V ≅ (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X,
      SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter V ≫ e.hom = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k t ∧
      γ[G.toGroupScheme.X, V] ≫ e.hom =
        lift (fst G.toGroupScheme.X V ≫ f.hom.hom)
          (snd G.toGroupScheme.X V ≫ e.hom) ≫ AffineSchemeAction.smul k ∧
      ∀ (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
        (q : (Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X)
        (z : (Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ V) (a : Cˣ) (b c : C),
        q ≫ f.hom.hom = AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k a b →
        z ≫ e.hom = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k c →
        (lift q z ≫ γ[G.toGroupScheme.X, V]) ≫ e.hom =
          AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k ((a : C) * c + b)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hf (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) :
      (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V q).unop t =
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField
          ((AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom)).multiplier : k) * t +
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField
          (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom)).shift := by
    rw [hpoint]
    exact hΦ q
  obtain ⟨U, j, xU, gU, hj, hU, hgj, hgx, _⟩ :=
    CurveAffineCoordinate.exists_joint_diagram G V t f.hom.hom hf
  have := hj
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType U.hom := by rw [← Over.w j]; infer_instance
  have : JacobsonSpace U.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.jacobsonSpace U.hom
  have : Nonempty U.left := hU
  obtain ⟨z, _, hzc⟩ := nonempty_inter_closedPoints
    (Set.univ_nonempty : (Set.univ : Set U.left).Nonempty) isClosed_univ.isLocallyClosed
  have hzc₀ : IsClosed ({z} : Set U.left) := hzc
  let p0 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ U :=
    Over.homMk (pointOfClosedPoint U.hom z hzc₀) (pointOfClosedPoint_comp U.hom z hzc₀)
  obtain ⟨p, _, hsurj, _⟩ :=
    AdditiveOrbit.exists_finite_orbit_cover_of_nontrivial_one G.toAlgebraicGroup V
      hker hdimV i hi
  have : Surjective (AdditiveOrbit.orbitMap i.hom.hom p).left := hsurj
  have htrans := transitive_points_of_surjective_orbit G.toAlgebraicGroup
    (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X V i.hom.hom p
  obtain ⟨x, _, hgen, heq⟩ := exists_global_coordinate G.toAlgebraicGroup V U j p0 xU t
    gU hgj hgx Φ hΦ htrans
  have : IsIso x := isIso_of_surjective_line_cover V x t ht htop hgen
    (AdditiveOrbit.orbitMap i.hom.hom p)
  let e := asIso x
  have haction (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) :
      ModObj.pointAct V q ≫ x = x ≫
        ModObj.pointAct (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X
          (q ≫ f.hom.hom) := by
    have hq : q ≫ f.hom.hom = (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k).symm (Φ q) := by
      apply (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k).injective
      rw [MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      exact hpoint q
    rw [hq]
    exact heq q
  have hjoint := joint_diagram_of_point_equivariance G V f.hom.hom x haction
  refine ⟨e, hgen, hjoint, ?_⟩
  intro C _ _ q z a b c hq hz
  change z ≫ x = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k c at hz
  have hh := congrArg (fun h ↦ lift q z ≫ h) hjoint
  simp only [comp_lift_assoc, lift_fst_assoc, lift_snd_assoc] at hh
  rw [hq, hz] at hh
  exact hh.trans (AffineSchemeAction.lift_groupPoint_linePoint_smul k a b c)

name: AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.whole_curve_coordinate_of_affine_data
statement:
theorem whole_curve_coordinate_of_affine_data
    (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (hker : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
      ModObj.pointAct V q = 𝟙 V → q = 1)
    (hdimV : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1)
    (i : (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).Hom G.toAlgebraicGroup)
    [Mono i.hom.hom]
    (t : V.left.functionField) (ht : Transcendental k t)
    (htop : IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set V.left.functionField) = ⊤)
    (Φ : (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) →* AffineTransformation k)
    (hΦ : ∀ q, (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V q).unop t =
      algebraMap k V.left.functionField ((Φ q).multiplier : k) * t +
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField (Φ q).shift)
    (f : G.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k))
    (hpoint : ∀ q, AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom) = Φ q) :
    ∃ e : V ≅ (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X,
      SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter V ≫ e.hom = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k t ∧
      γ[G.toGroupScheme.X, V] ≫ e.hom =
        lift (fst G.toGroupScheme.X V ≫ f.hom.hom)
          (snd G.toGroupScheme.X V ≫ e.hom) ≫ AffineSchemeAction.smul k ∧
      ∀ (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
        (q : (Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X)
        (z : (Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ V) (a : Cˣ) (b c : C),
        q ≫ f.hom.hom = AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k a b →
        z ≫ e.hom = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k c →
        (lift q z ≫ γ[G.toGroupScheme.X, V]) ≫ e.hom =
          AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k ((a : C) * c + b)
proof:
:= by
  refine whole_curve_coordinate_of_affine_data_of_nontrivial_ga G V hker hdimV i
    ?_ t ht htop Φ hΦ f hpoint
  intro h
  have h₁ : (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (1 : k) = 1 := by
    apply (cancel_mono i.hom.hom).mp
    rw [one_comp]
    exact h
  have h₀ : (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (0 : k) = 1 := by
    rw [AdditiveTranslation.linePoint_zero, comp_one]
  apply (one_ne_zero : (1 : k) ≠ 0)
  apply AffineSchemeAction.linePoint_injective k
  exact (cancel_epi (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom).mp (h₁.trans h₀.symm)

name: AclGeom.comap_minimalPrimes_eq
statement:
private theorem comap_minimalPrimes_eq {R T : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing T] [Algebra R T]
    (U : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization U T] :
    Ideal.comap (algebraMap R T) '' minimalPrimes T =
      {P | P ∈ minimalPrimes R ∧ Disjoint (U : Set R) P}
proof:
:= by
  have hker : ∀ P : Ideal R, P.IsPrime → Disjoint (U : Set R) P →
      Ideal.comap (algebraMap R T) ⊥ ≤ P := by
    intro P hP hd r hr
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.mem_bot, IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff U T] at hr
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hr
    exact (hP.mem_or_mem (hm ▸ P.zero_mem)).resolve_left (Set.disjoint_left.1 hd m.2)
  have key := IsLocalization.minimalPrimes_comap U T (⊥ : Ideal T)
  change Ideal.comap (algebraMap R T) '' (⊥ : Ideal T).minimalPrimes = _
  rw [← key]
  ext P
  constructor
  · intro hP
    have hd : Disjoint (U : Set R) P := by
      obtain ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩ := key ▸ hP
      refine Set.disjoint_left.2 fun u hu huQ ↦ hQ.1.1.ne_top ?_
      exact Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ huQ (IsLocalization.map_units T ⟨u, hu⟩)
    exact ⟨⟨⟨hP.1.1, bot_le⟩, fun Q hQ hQP ↦ hP.2 ⟨hQ.1, hker Q hQ.1 (hd.mono_right hQP)⟩ hQP⟩,
      hd⟩
  · rintro ⟨hP, hd⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hP.1.1, hker P hP.1.1 hd⟩, fun Q hQ hQP ↦ hP.2 ⟨hQ.1, bot_le⟩ hQP⟩

name: AclGeom.tmul_one_mem_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
private theorem tmul_one_mem_nonZeroDivisors {A B X : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [IsDomain B]
    [Algebra A B] [CommRing X] [Algebra A X] [Module.Flat A X] {b : B} (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    b ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : X) ∈ nonZeroDivisors (B ⊗[A] X)
proof:
:= by
  have hmul : ∀ x : B ⊗[A] X, x * (b ⊗ₜ 1) = LinearMap.rTensor X (LinearMap.mulRight A b) x := by
    intro x
    induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul y z => simp
    | add x y hx hy => rw [add_mul, hx, hy, map_add]
  have hinj : Function.Injective (LinearMap.rTensor X (LinearMap.mulRight A b)) :=
    Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap _ (mul_left_injective₀ hb)
  refine mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right.2 fun x hx ↦ hinj ?_
  rw [← hmul, hx, map_zero]

name: AclGeom.one_tmul_mem_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
private theorem one_tmul_mem_nonZeroDivisors {A X C : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing C] [IsDomain C]
    [Algebra A C] [CommRing X] [Algebra A X] [Module.Flat A X] {c : C} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (1 : X) ⊗ₜ[A] c ∈ nonZeroDivisors (X ⊗[A] C)
proof:
:= by
  have hmul : ∀ x : X ⊗[A] C, x * (1 ⊗ₜ c) = LinearMap.lTensor X (LinearMap.mulRight A c) x := by
    intro x
    induction x using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul y z => simp
    | add x y hx hy => rw [add_mul, hx, hy, map_add]
  have hinj : Function.Injective (LinearMap.lTensor X (LinearMap.mulRight A c)) :=
    Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap _ (mul_left_injective₀ hc)
  refine mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right.2 fun x hx ↦ hinj ?_
  rw [← hmul, hx, map_zero]

name: AclGeom.minimalPrimes_tensorProduct_fractionRing
statement:
theorem minimalPrimes_tensorProduct_fractionRing
    {A B C K L M : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [CommRing B] [IsDomain B]
    [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] [Field K] [Field L] [Field M]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra A C] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra B L] [IsFractionRing B L] [Algebra C M] [IsFractionRing C M]
    [Algebra A L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower A B L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [Algebra A M] [Algebra K M] [IsScalarTower A C M] [IsScalarTower A K M] :
    Ideal.comap ((IsLocalization.algebraTensorEquiv (nonZeroDivisors A) K L M).symm.toRingHom.comp
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B L)
          (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A C M)).toRingHom) '' minimalPrimes (L ⊗[K] M) =
      {P | P ∈ minimalPrimes (B ⊗[A] C) ∧ ∀ a : A, a ≠ 0 → algebraMap A (B ⊗[A] C) a ∉ P}
proof:
:= by
  have hAK : Module.Flat A K := IsLocalization.flat K (nonZeroDivisors A)
  have hAL : Module.Flat A L := Module.Flat.trans A K L
  have hinjB : Function.Injective (algebraMap A B) := by
    have h : Function.Injective (algebraMap A L) := by
      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A K L]
      exact (algebraMap K L).injective.comp (IsFractionRing.injective A K)
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq A B L, RingHom.coe_comp] at h
    exact h.of_comp
  let f := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B L
  let g := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A C M
  let φ1 : B ⊗[A] C →ₐ[A] L ⊗[A] C := Algebra.TensorProduct.map f (AlgHom.id A C)
  let φ2 : L ⊗[A] C →ₐ[A] L ⊗[A] M := Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id A L) g
  let _ : Algebra (B ⊗[A] C) (L ⊗[A] C) := φ1.toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra (L ⊗[A] C) (L ⊗[A] M) := φ2.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower B (B ⊗[A] C) (L ⊗[A] C) := .of_algebraMap_eq fun b ↦ by
    simp [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, φ1, f, Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply]
  have : IsScalarTower L (L ⊗[A] C) (L ⊗[A] M) := .of_algebraMap_eq fun l ↦ by
    simp [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, φ2, Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply]
  have h1 : IsLocalization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid (B ⊗[A] C) (nonZeroDivisors B))
      (L ⊗[A] C) :=
    IsLocalization.tensorProduct_tensorProduct A C (nonZeroDivisors B) L (by
      ext c; simp [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, φ1])
  have h2 : IsLocalization ((nonZeroDivisors C).map
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := A) (A := L))) (L ⊗[A] M) :=
    IsLocalization.tensorProduct_tensorProduct_right A L (nonZeroDivisors C) M (by
      ext c; simp [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, φ2, g])
  
  let X := C ⊗[A] K
  have hAX : Module.Flat A X := by
    have : Module.Flat A (K ⊗[A] C) := Module.Flat.trans A K (K ⊗[A] C)
    exact Module.Flat.of_linearEquiv (TensorProduct.comm A C K)
  let ψ : B ⊗[A] C →ₐ[A] B ⊗[A] X :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id A B) (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A C X)
  let _ : Algebra (B ⊗[A] C) (B ⊗[A] X) := ψ.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower B (B ⊗[A] C) (B ⊗[A] X) := .of_algebraMap_eq fun b ↦ by
    simp [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, ψ, Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply]
    rfl
  have h3 : IsLocalization ((Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid C (nonZeroDivisors A)).map
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := A) (A := B))) (B ⊗[A] X) :=
    IsLocalization.tensorProduct_tensorProduct_right A B
      (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid C (nonZeroDivisors A)) X (by
        ext c; simp [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, ψ])
  
  have hP2 : ∀ P ∈ minimalPrimes (B ⊗[A] C),
      (∀ a : A, a ≠ 0 → algebraMap A (B ⊗[A] C) a ∉ P) →
        ∀ b : B, b ≠ 0 → algebraMap B (B ⊗[A] C) b ∉ P := by
    intro P hP ha b hb hbP
    have hd : Disjoint (((Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid C (nonZeroDivisors A)).map
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := A) (A := B)) : Submonoid (B ⊗[A] C)) :
          Set (B ⊗[A] C)) P := by
      refine Set.disjoint_left.2 ?_
      rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨a, ha0, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      have : algebraMap A (B ⊗[A] C) a =
          Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := A) (A := B) (algebraMap A C a) := by
        simp
      rw [← this]
      exact ha a (nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero ha0)
    have hset := comap_minimalPrimes_eq (T := B ⊗[A] X)
      ((Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid C (nonZeroDivisors A)).map
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := A) (A := B)))
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩ :
        P ∈ Ideal.comap (algebraMap (B ⊗[A] C) (B ⊗[A] X)) '' minimalPrimes _ := by
      rw [hset]
      exact ⟨hP, hd⟩
    have hmem : (b ⊗ₜ[A] (1 : X)) ∈ Q := by
      have := Ideal.mem_comap.1 hbP
      simpa [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, ψ, Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply] using this
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 (Ideal.disjoint_nonZeroDivisors_of_mem_minimalPrimes hQ) hmem
      (tmul_one_mem_nonZeroDivisors hb)
  
  have hφ : (Algebra.TensorProduct.map f g).toRingHom = φ2.toRingHom.comp φ1.toRingHom := by
    have h := Algebra.TensorProduct.map_comp (AlgHom.id A L) f g (AlgHom.id A C)
    rw [AlgHom.id_comp, AlgHom.comp_id] at h
    exact congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom h
  let e := (IsLocalization.algebraTensorEquiv (nonZeroDivisors A) K L M).symm
  have he : Ideal.comap e.toRingHom '' minimalPrimes (L ⊗[K] M) = minimalPrimes (L ⊗[A] M) := by
    have h := Ideal.comap_minimalPrimes_eq_of_surjective (f := e.toRingHom) e.surjective ⊥
    rw [Ideal.comap_bot_of_injective (f := e.toRingHom) e.injective] at h
    exact h.symm
  
  have hstep2 : Ideal.comap φ2.toRingHom '' minimalPrimes (L ⊗[A] M) =
      minimalPrimes (L ⊗[A] C) := by
    rw [show φ2.toRingHom = algebraMap (L ⊗[A] C) (L ⊗[A] M) from rfl,
      comap_minimalPrimes_eq ((nonZeroDivisors C).map
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := A) (A := L)))]
    ext Q
    refine ⟨fun h ↦ h.1, fun hQ ↦ ⟨hQ, Set.disjoint_left.2 ?_⟩⟩
    rintro _ ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ hcQ
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 (Ideal.disjoint_nonZeroDivisors_of_mem_minimalPrimes hQ) hcQ
      (one_tmul_mem_nonZeroDivisors (X := L) (nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hc))
  have hstep1 : Ideal.comap φ1.toRingHom '' minimalPrimes (L ⊗[A] C) =
      {P | P ∈ minimalPrimes (B ⊗[A] C) ∧ Disjoint
        ((Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid (B ⊗[A] C) (nonZeroDivisors B) : Submonoid _) :
          Set (B ⊗[A] C)) P} :=
    comap_minimalPrimes_eq (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid (B ⊗[A] C) (nonZeroDivisors B))
  rw [hφ]
  have himg : Ideal.comap (e.toRingHom.comp (φ2.toRingHom.comp φ1.toRingHom)) ''
      minimalPrimes (L ⊗[K] M) = Ideal.comap φ1.toRingHom '' (Ideal.comap φ2.toRingHom ''
        (Ideal.comap e.toRingHom '' minimalPrimes (L ⊗[K] M))) := by
    simp only [Set.image_image, Ideal.comap_comap, RingHom.comp_assoc]
  rw [himg, he, hstep2, hstep1]
  ext P
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hP, hd⟩
    refine ⟨hP, fun a ha haP ↦ Set.disjoint_left.1 hd ⟨algebraMap A B a,
      mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero ((map_ne_zero_iff _ hinjB).2 ha), ?_⟩ haP⟩
    exact (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply A B (B ⊗[A] C) a).symm
  · rintro ⟨hP, ha⟩
    refine ⟨hP, Set.disjoint_left.2 ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    exact hP2 P hP ha b (nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hb)

name: AclGeom.algEquiv_coefficient_algebraMap
statement:
theorem algEquiv_coefficient_algebraMap
    {F E L : Type*} [Field F] [Field E] [Field L]
    [Algebra F E] [Algebra E L] [Algebra F L]
    [IsScalarTower F E L]
    (σ : L ≃ₐ[E] L) (c : F) :
    σ (algebraMap F L c) = algebraMap F L c
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F E L, σ.commutes]

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.algebraicExtensionClosureRingEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem algebraicExtensionClosureRingEquiv_algebraMap
    [Algebra E E'] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic E E'] (x : E) :
    algebraicExtensionClosureRingEquiv (E := E) (E' := E')
        (algebraMap E (AlgebraicClosure E) x) =
      algebraMap E' (AlgebraicClosure E') (algebraMap E E' x)
proof:
:= by
  let phi := IsAlgClosure.equivOfAlgebraic E E'
    (AlgebraicClosure E') (AlgebraicClosure E)
  change phi.symm (algebraMap E (AlgebraicClosure E) x) = _
  apply phi.injective
  rw [phi.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply E E' (AlgebraicClosure E')]
  exact (phi.commutes x).symm

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.finiteExtensionClosureRingEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteExtensionClosureRingEquiv_algebraMap
    [Algebra E E'] [FiniteDimensional E E'] (x : E) :
    finiteExtensionClosureRingEquiv (E := E) (E' := E')
        (algebraMap E (AlgebraicClosure E) x) =
      algebraMap E' (AlgebraicClosure E') (algebraMap E E' x)
proof:
:= by
  exact algebraicExtensionClosureRingEquiv_algebraMap x

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.equivOfEq_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem equivOfEq_val
    {L : Type*} [Field L] [Algebra E L]
    {S T : IntermediateField E L} (h : S = T) (x : S) :
    (((IntermediateField.equivOfEq h).toRingEquiv x : T) : L) = x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.mem_mapField_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_mapField_iff
    (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E')
    (L : IntermediateField E (AlgebraicClosure E))
    (y : AlgebraicClosure E') :
    y ∈ T.mapField L ↔ T.closureEquiv.symm y ∈ L
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    simpa using hx
  · intro hy
    exact ⟨T.closureEquiv.symm y, hy, by simp⟩

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.mapField_toSubfield
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapField_toSubfield
    (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E')
    (L : IntermediateField E (AlgebraicClosure E)) :
    (T.mapField L).toSubfield =
      L.toSubfield.map T.closureEquiv.toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  rfl

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.mapFieldEquiv_commutes
statement:
theorem mapFieldEquiv_commutes
    (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E')
    (L : IntermediateField E (AlgebraicClosure E)) :
    (algebraMap E' (↥(T.mapField L))).comp T.baseEquiv.toRingHom =
      (T.mapFieldEquiv L).toRingHom.comp (algebraMap E (↥L))
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  change algebraMap E' (AlgebraicClosure E') (T.baseEquiv x) =
    T.closureEquiv (algebraMap E (AlgebraicClosure E) x)
  exact (T.commutes_apply x).symm

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.mapField_trans
statement:
theorem mapField_trans (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E')
    (U : AlgebraicClosureTransport E' E'')
    (L : IntermediateField E (AlgebraicClosure E)) :
    (T.trans U).mapField L = U.mapField (T.mapField L)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.mapField_sup
statement:
theorem mapField_sup (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E')
    (L M : IntermediateField E (AlgebraicClosure E)) :
    T.mapField (L ⊔ M) = T.mapField L ⊔ T.mapField M
proof:
:= by
  apply IntermediateField.toSubfield_injective
  rw [T.mapField_toSubfield,
    IntermediateField.sup_toSubfield L M]
  rw [IntermediateField.sup_toSubfield (T.mapField L) (T.mapField M),
    T.mapField_toSubfield, T.mapField_toSubfield, Subfield.map_sup]

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.mapField_symm_mapField
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapField_symm_mapField
    (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E')
    (L : IntermediateField E (AlgebraicClosure E)) :
    T.symm.mapField (T.mapField L) = L
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.mapField_mapField_symm
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapField_mapField_symm
    (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E')
    (L : IntermediateField E' (AlgebraicClosure E')) :
    T.mapField (T.symm.mapField L) = L
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.mapField_eq_of_closureEquiv_eq
statement:
theorem mapField_eq_of_closureEquiv_eq
    (T U : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E')
    (h : T.closureEquiv = U.closureEquiv)
    (L : IntermediateField E (AlgebraicClosure E)) :
    T.mapField L = U.mapField L
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  change z ∈ T.closureEquiv '' L ↔ z ∈ U.closureEquiv '' L
  rw [h]

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.mapField_mono
statement:
theorem mapField_mono (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E')
    {L M : IntermediateField E (AlgebraicClosure E)} (h : L ≤ M) :
    T.mapField L ≤ T.mapField M
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  rw [T.mem_mapField_iff] at hz ⊢
  exact h hz

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.mapField_refl
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapField_refl
    (L : IntermediateField E (AlgebraicClosure E)) :
    (refl E).mapField L = L
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.FiniteNormalCover.sup_field
statement:
@[simp] theorem sup_field (M : FiniteNormalCover E) :
    (N.sup M).field = N.field ⊔ M.field
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.FiniteNormalCover.map_field
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_field (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E') :
    (N.map T).field = T.mapField N.field
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.FiniteNormalCover.mapEquiv_commutes
statement:
theorem mapEquiv_commutes (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E') :
    (algebraMap E' (↥(N.map T).field)).comp T.baseEquiv.toRingHom =
      (N.mapEquiv T).toRingHom.comp (algebraMap E (↥N.field))
proof:
:=
  T.mapFieldEquiv_commutes N.field

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.FiniteNormalCover.mapEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapEquiv_algebraMap (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E')
    (x : E) :
    N.mapEquiv T (algebraMap E (↥N.field) x) =
      algebraMap E' (↥(N.map T).field) (T.baseEquiv x)
proof:
:= by
  exact (DFunLike.congr_fun (N.mapEquiv_commutes T) x).symm

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.FiniteNormalCover.mapEquiv_coefficient_algebraMap
statement:
theorem mapEquiv_coefficient_algebraMap
    {F : Type*} [Field F] [Algebra F E] [Algebra F E']
    (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E')
    [Algebra F (↥N.field)] [Algebra F (↥(N.map T).field)]
    [IsScalarTower F E (↥N.field)]
    [IsScalarTower F E' (↥(N.map T).field)]
    (hbase : ∀ c : F,
      T.baseEquiv (algebraMap F E c) = algebraMap F E' c)
    (c : F) :
    N.mapEquiv T (algebraMap F (↥N.field) c) =
      algebraMap F (↥(N.map T).field) c
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F E (↥N.field),
    N.mapEquiv_algebraMap, hbase,
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply F E' (↥(N.map T).field)]

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.FiniteNormalCover.map_trans_field
statement:
theorem map_trans_field (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E')
    (U : AlgebraicClosureTransport E' E'') :
    (N.map (T.trans U)).field = ((N.map T).map U).field
proof:
:=
  T.mapField_trans U N.field

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.FiniteNormalCover.map_sup_field
statement:
theorem map_sup_field (M : FiniteNormalCover E)
    (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E') :
    ((N.sup M).map T).field = ((N.map T).sup (M.map T)).field
proof:
:=
  T.mapField_sup N.field M.field

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.FiniteNormalCover.map_symm_map_field
statement:
theorem map_symm_map_field (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E') :
    ((N.map T).map T.symm).field = N.field
proof:
:=
  T.mapField_symm_mapField N.field

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.FiniteNormalCover.map_ofAlgEquiv_field
statement:
theorem map_ofAlgEquiv_field
    (σ : AlgebraicClosure E ≃ₐ[E] AlgebraicClosure E) :
    (N.map (ofAlgEquiv σ)).field = N.field
proof:
:= by
  letI := N.normal
  have hmap : N.field.map σ.toAlgHom = N.field :=
    (normal_iff_forall_map_eq'.1 N.normal) σ
  have himage : (N.map (ofAlgEquiv σ)).field =
      N.field.map σ.toAlgHom := by
    ext z
    rfl
  exact himage.trans hmap

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.FiniteNormalCover.map_trans_ofAlgEquiv_field
statement:
theorem map_trans_ofAlgEquiv_field
    (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E')
    (σ : AlgebraicClosure E' ≃ₐ[E'] AlgebraicClosure E') :
    (N.map (T.trans (ofAlgEquiv σ))).field = (N.map T).field
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (N.map (T.trans (ofAlgEquiv σ))).field =
        ((N.map T).map (ofAlgEquiv σ)).field :=
      N.map_trans_field T (ofAlgEquiv σ)
    _ = (N.map T).field := (N.map T).map_ofAlgEquiv_field σ

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.FiniteNormalCover.correctedMap_field
statement:
theorem correctedMap_field
    (T U : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E')
    (σ : AlgebraicClosure E' ≃ₐ[E'] AlgebraicClosure E')
    (h : T.closureEquiv.trans σ.toRingEquiv = U.closureEquiv) :
    (N.map U).field = (N.map T).field
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (N.map U).field =
        (N.map (T.trans (ofAlgEquiv σ))).field :=
      mapField_eq_of_closureEquiv_eq U (T.trans (ofAlgEquiv σ))
        h.symm N.field
    _ = (N.map T).field := N.map_trans_ofAlgEquiv_field T σ

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.FiniteNormalCover.coe_restrictAlgEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_restrictAlgEquiv_apply
    (σ : AlgebraicClosure E ≃ₐ[E] AlgebraicClosure E) (x : N.field) :
    ((N.restrictAlgEquiv σ x : N.field) : AlgebraicClosure E) = σ x
proof:
:=
  by
    letI := N.normal
    exact AlgEquiv.restrictNormal_commutes σ N.field x

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.FiniteNormalCover.coe_restrictAlgEquiv_toRingEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_restrictAlgEquiv_toRingEquiv_apply
    (σ : AlgebraicClosure E ≃ₐ[E] AlgebraicClosure E) (x : N.field) :
    (((N.restrictAlgEquiv σ).toRingEquiv x : N.field) :
      AlgebraicClosure E) = σ x
proof:
:= by
    exact N.coe_restrictAlgEquiv_apply σ x

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.FiniteNormalCover.mapEquiv_trans_restrictAlgEquiv
statement:
theorem mapEquiv_trans_restrictAlgEquiv
    (T U : AlgebraicClosureTransport E E')
    (σ : AlgebraicClosure E' ≃ₐ[E'] AlgebraicClosure E')
    (h : T.closureEquiv.trans σ.toRingEquiv = U.closureEquiv) :
    (N.mapEquiv T).trans ((N.map T).restrictAlgEquiv σ).toRingEquiv =
      N.correctedMapEquiv T U σ h
proof:
:= by
  apply RingEquiv.ext
  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [correctedMapEquiv, RingEquiv.trans_apply, mapEquiv,
    mapFieldEquiv, coe_restrictAlgEquiv_toRingEquiv_apply,
    AlgebraicClosureTransport.equivOfEq_val]
  exact congrArg
    (fun e : AlgebraicClosure E ≃+* AlgebraicClosure E' ↦
      e (x : AlgebraicClosure E)) h

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.FiniteNormalCover.rebaseField_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem rebaseField_finiteDimensional
    (sigma : AlgebraicClosure E ≃+* AlgebraicClosure E') :
    FiniteDimensional E' (↥(N.rebaseField sigma))
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fintype (Set.range (N.rebaseBasisValues sigma)) :=
    Set.Finite.fintype (Set.finite_range (N.rebaseBasisValues sigma))
  exact finiteDimensional_adjoin fun z _ ↦
    (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic z).isIntegral

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.FiniteNormalCover.closureEquiv_mem_rebaseField
statement:
theorem closureEquiv_mem_rebaseField
    (sigma : AlgebraicClosure E ≃+* AlgebraicClosure E')
    (hsigma : ∀ x : E,
      sigma (algebraMap E (AlgebraicClosure E) x) =
        algebraMap E' (AlgebraicClosure E') (algebraMap E E' x))
    (x : N.field) :
    sigma (x : AlgebraicClosure E) ∈ N.rebaseField sigma
proof:
:= by
  letI := N.finiteDimensional
  let basis := Module.finBasis E (↥N.field)
  have hsum :
      (∑ i,
        algebraMap E' (AlgebraicClosure E')
            (algebraMap E E' (basis.repr x i)) *
          sigma (basis i : AlgebraicClosure E)) ∈ N.rebaseField sigma := by
    apply Subring.sum_mem
    intro i _
    apply (N.rebaseField sigma).mul_mem
    · exact (N.rebaseField sigma).algebraMap_mem _
    · exact subset_adjoin E'
        (Set.range (N.rebaseBasisValues sigma)) (Set.mem_range_self i)
  have hx := congrArg
    (fun y : N.field ↦ sigma (y : AlgebraicClosure E))
    (basis.sum_repr x)
  have heq :
      (∑ i,
        algebraMap E' (AlgebraicClosure E')
            (algebraMap E E' (basis.repr x i)) *
          sigma (basis i : AlgebraicClosure E)) =
        sigma (x : AlgebraicClosure E) := by
    simpa [Algebra.smul_def, hsigma] using hx
  exact heq ▸ hsum

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.FiniteNormalCover.closureEquiv_mem_rebaseCover
statement:
theorem closureEquiv_mem_rebaseCover
    (sigma : AlgebraicClosure E ≃+* AlgebraicClosure E')
    (hsigma : ∀ x : E,
      sigma (algebraMap E (AlgebraicClosure E) x) =
        algebraMap E' (AlgebraicClosure E') (algebraMap E E' x))
    (x : N.field) :
    sigma (x : AlgebraicClosure E) ∈ (N.rebaseCover sigma).field
proof:
:=
  le_normalClosure _ (N.closureEquiv_mem_rebaseField sigma hsigma x)

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.FiniteNormalCover.rebaseRingHom_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem rebaseRingHom_val
    (sigma : AlgebraicClosure E ≃+* AlgebraicClosure E')
    (hsigma : ∀ x : E,
      sigma (algebraMap E (AlgebraicClosure E) x) =
        algebraMap E' (AlgebraicClosure E') (algebraMap E E' x))
    (x : N.field) :
    ((N.rebaseRingHom sigma hsigma x : (N.rebaseCover sigma).field) :
      AlgebraicClosure E') = sigma x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AclGeom.AlgebraicClosureTransport.FiniteNormalCover.rebaseRingHom_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem rebaseRingHom_algebraMap
    (sigma : AlgebraicClosure E ≃+* AlgebraicClosure E')
    (hsigma : ∀ x : E,
      sigma (algebraMap E (AlgebraicClosure E) x) =
        algebraMap E' (AlgebraicClosure E') (algebraMap E E' x))
    (x : E) :
    N.rebaseRingHom sigma hsigma (algebraMap E (↥N.field) x) =
      algebraMap E' (↥(N.rebaseCover sigma).field) (algebraMap E E' x)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact hsigma x

name: AclGeom.FiniteCover.NormalExtensionEquiv.mappedNormalEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem mappedNormalEquiv_algebraMap
    (e : FiniteCover.NormalExtensionEquiv h h')
    (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport (↥E') E'') (x : E) :
    mappedNormalEquiv e T
        (algebraMap (↥E) (↥(FiniteCover.canonicalNormalClosure h)) x) =
      algebraMap E''
        (↥(T.mapField (FiniteCover.canonicalNormalClosure h')))
        (T.baseEquiv (e.baseEquiv x))
proof:
:= by
  change T.mapFieldEquiv (FiniteCover.canonicalNormalClosure h')
      (e.normalEquiv
        (algebraMap (↥E) (↥(FiniteCover.canonicalNormalClosure h)) x)) = _
  rw [FiniteCover.NormalExtensionEquiv.normal_commutes_apply]
  exact (DFunLike.congr_fun
    (T.mapFieldEquiv_commutes (FiniteCover.canonicalNormalClosure h'))
    (e.baseEquiv x)).symm

name: AclGeom.FiniteCover.ExtensionEquiv.mappedCanonicalSelectedEmbedding_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem mappedCanonicalSelectedEmbedding_algebraMap [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (e : FiniteCover.ExtensionEquiv h h')
    (T : AlgebraicClosureTransport (↥E') (↥E))
    (hbase : ∀ x : E, T.baseEquiv (e.baseEquiv x) = x)
    (halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (↥E) (↥(extendScalars h))) (x : E) :
    e.mappedCanonicalSelectedEmbedding T hbase halg
        (algebraMap (↥E) (↥(extendScalars h)) x) =
      algebraMap (↥E)
        (↥(T.mapField (FiniteCover.canonicalNormalClosure h'))) x
proof:
:= by
  simp [mappedCanonicalSelectedEmbedding]

name: AclGeom.eq_cochar_of_mul_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  have hv : v ^ b = (u ^ a)⁻¹ := eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right h
  have hu : u ^ a = (v ^ b)⁻¹ := eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left h
  constructor
  · calc (u ^ q * v ^ (-p)) ^ b = u ^ (q * b) * (v ^ b) ^ (-p) := by
          rw [mul_zpow, ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_mul]
          ring_nf
      _ = u ^ (a * p + b * q) := by
          rw [hv, inv_zpow', neg_neg, ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_add]
          ring_nf
      _ = u := by rw [hab, zpow_one]
  · calc (u ^ q * v ^ (-p)) ^ (-a) = (u ^ a) ^ (-q) * v ^ (p * a) := by
          rw [mul_zpow, ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_mul]
          ring_nf
      _ = v ^ (a * p + b * q) := by
          rw [hu, inv_zpow', neg_neg, ← zpow_mul, ← zpow_add]
          ring_nf
      _ = v := by rw [hab, zpow_one]

name: AclGeom.mulSubgroup_classification_of_connected
statement:
theorem mulSubgroup_classification_of_connected (H : Subgroup (kˣ × kˣ))
    (hclosed : zeroLocus k (vanishingIdeal k (torusEmb '' (H : Set (kˣ × kˣ)))) =
      torusEmb '' (H : Set (kˣ × kˣ)))
    [ConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum
      (MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k ⧸ vanishingIdeal k (torusEmb '' (H : Set (kˣ × kˣ)))))]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim
      (MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k ⧸ vanishingIdeal k (torusEmb '' (H : Set (kˣ × kˣ)))) = 1)
    (hproj₁ : ∃ g ∈ H, ∃ h ∈ H, g.1 ≠ h.1) (hproj₂ : ∃ g ∈ H, ∃ h ∈ H, g.2 ≠ h.2) :
    ∃ m n : ℤ, m ≠ 0 ∧ n ≠ 0 ∧ (H : Set (kˣ × kˣ)) = {g | g.1 ^ m = g.2 ^ n} ∧
      ∀ g : kˣ × kˣ, g • (H : Set (kˣ × kˣ)) =
        {x | x.1 ^ m = g.1 ^ m * (g.2 ^ n)⁻¹ * x.2 ^ n}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set S : Set (Fin 4 → k) := torusEmb '' (H : Set (kˣ × kˣ)) with hS
  set J := vanishingIdeal k S with hJdef
  have hJmem : ∀ f, f ∈ J ↔ ∀ h ∈ H, aeval (torusEmb h) f = 0 := fun f ↦ by
    rw [mem_vanishingIdeal_iff]
    constructor
    · intro hf h hh
      exact hf _ ⟨h, hh, rfl⟩
    · rintro hf _ ⟨h, hh, rfl⟩
      exact hf h hh
  have hSne : ∀ c ∈ S, ∀ j, c j ≠ 0 := by
    rintro _ ⟨h, -, rfl⟩ j
    exact torusEmb_ne_zero h j
  
  have hJ : J.IsPrime := by
    refine isPrime_vanishingIdeal_of_connected S hclosed ⟨torusEmb 1, 1, H.one_mem, rfl⟩
      (fun c u v ↦ u * v * c⁻¹) ?_ ?_ ?_ (fun c v ↦ scale (v * c⁻¹)) ?_
      (fun c u ↦ scale (u * c⁻¹)) ?_
    · rintro _ ⟨γ, hγ, rfl⟩ _ ⟨α, hα, rfl⟩ _ ⟨β, hβ, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨α * β * γ⁻¹, H.mul_mem (H.mul_mem hα hβ) (H.inv_mem hγ), by
        rw [torusEmb_mul, torusEmb_mul, torusEmb_inv]⟩
    · intro c hc u
      funext j
      simp only [Pi.mul_apply, Pi.inv_apply]
      exact mul_inv_cancel_right₀ (hSne c hc j) (u j)
    · intro c hc v
      funext j
      simp only [Pi.mul_apply, Pi.inv_apply]
      rw [mul_comm (c j), mul_inv_cancel_right₀ (hSne c hc j)]
    · intro c v u g
      have hfun : (fun j ↦ algebraMap k k ((v * c⁻¹) j) * u j) = u * v * c⁻¹ := by
        funext j
        simp only [Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.inv_apply]
        ring
      rw [aeval_scale, hfun]
    · intro c u v g
      have hfun : (fun j ↦ algebraMap k k ((u * c⁻¹) j) * v j) = u * v * c⁻¹ := by
        funext j
        simp only [Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.inv_apply]
        ring
      rw [aeval_scale, hfun]
  
  have hconst : ∀ (M : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k) {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 →
      (∀ h ∈ H, aeval (torusEmb h) M ^ n = 1) → ∃ ζ : k, ∀ h ∈ H, aeval (torusEmb h) M = ζ := by
    intro M n hn hM
    have hmem : M ^ n - 1 ∈ J := (hJmem _).2 fun h hh ↦ by
      rw [map_sub, map_pow, map_one, hM h hh, sub_self]
    obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := exists_sub_C_mem_of_pow_sub_one_mem hJ M hn hmem
    refine ⟨ζ, fun h hh ↦ ?_⟩
    have := (hJmem _).1 hζ h hh
    rwa [map_sub, aeval_C, Algebra.algebraMap_self, RingHom.id_apply, sub_eq_zero] at this
  
  have hfst : ∀ {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → ¬ ∀ h ∈ H, h.1 ^ n = 1 := by
    intro n hn hall
    obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := hconst (X 0) hn fun h hh ↦ by
      rw [aeval_X, torusEmb_apply_zero, ← Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, hall h hh, Units.val_one]
    obtain ⟨g, hg, h, hh, hgh⟩ := hproj₁
    refine hgh (Units.ext ?_)
    have h1 := hζ g hg
    have h2 := hζ h hh
    rw [aeval_X, torusEmb_apply_zero] at h1 h2
    rw [h1, h2]
  have hsnd : ∀ {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → ¬ ∀ h ∈ H, h.2 ^ n = 1 := by
    intro n hn hall
    obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := hconst (X 1) hn fun h hh ↦ by
      rw [aeval_X, torusEmb_apply_one, ← Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, hall h hh, Units.val_one]
    obtain ⟨g, hg, h, hh, hgh⟩ := hproj₂
    refine hgh (Units.ext ?_)
    have h1 := hζ g hg
    have h2 := hζ h hh
    rw [aeval_X, torusEmb_apply_one] at h1 h2
    rw [h1, h2]
  
  have hinfinite : (H : Set (kˣ × kˣ)).Infinite := by
    intro hfin
    have : Finite H := hfin.to_subtype
    refine hfst (n := Nat.card H) Nat.card_pos.ne' fun h hh ↦ ?_
    have hpow : (⟨h, hh⟩ : H) ^ Nat.card H = 1 := pow_card_eq_one'
    have h2 := congrArg Subtype.val hpow
    rw [SubgroupClass.coe_pow, OneMemClass.coe_one] at h2
    rw [← Prod.pow_fst]
    exact (congrArg Prod.fst h2).trans Prod.fst_one
  
  let ρ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k := aeval ![X 0, X 1]
  have hρ : ∀ (h : kˣ × kˣ) (q : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k),
      aeval (torusEmb h) (ρ q) = aeval ![(h.1 : k), (h.2 : k)] q := fun h q ↦ by
    have hcomp : (aeval (torusEmb h)).comp ρ = aeval ![(h.1 : k), (h.2 : k)] := by
      refine MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun i ↦ ?_
      fin_cases i <;> simp [ρ]
    exact congrArg (fun φ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k →ₐ[k] k ↦ φ q) hcomp
  set I₂ := J.comap ρ with hI₂def
  have hI₂prime : I₂.IsPrime := Ideal.comap_isPrime ρ J
  have hI₂mem : ∀ q, q ∈ I₂ ↔ ∀ h ∈ H, aeval ![(h.1 : k), (h.2 : k)] q = 0 := fun q ↦ by
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap, hJmem]
    simp only [hρ]
  
  have hnmax : ¬ I₂.IsMaximal := fun hmax ↦ by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := isMaximal_iff_eq_vanishingIdeal_singleton.1 hmax
    have hpt : ∀ h ∈ H, (h.1 : k) = x 0 := fun h hh ↦ by
      have hmem : X 0 - C (x 0) ∈ I₂ := by
        rw [hx, mem_vanishingIdeal_iff]
        intro y hy
        rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
        subst hy
        simp
      have := (hI₂mem _).1 hmem h hh
      simpa [sub_eq_zero] using this
    obtain ⟨g, hg, h, hh, hgh⟩ := hproj₁
    exact hgh (Units.ext ((hpt g hg).trans (hpt h hh).symm))
  
  have hbot : I₂ ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hI₂bot
    have hall : ∀ g : kˣ × kˣ, g ∈ H := fun g ↦ by
      have hg : torusEmb g ∈ zeroLocus k J := by
        intro f hf
        obtain ⟨N, q, hq⟩ := exists_plane_clear f
        have hq0 : q ∈ I₂ := (hI₂mem q).2 fun h hh ↦ by
          rw [hq h, (hJmem f).1 hf h hh, mul_zero]
        rw [hI₂bot, Ideal.mem_bot] at hq0
        have h0 := hq g
        rw [hq0, map_zero] at h0
        have hne : ((g.1 : k) * g.2) ^ N ≠ 0 :=
          pow_ne_zero _ (mul_ne_zero g.1.ne_zero g.2.ne_zero)
        exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h0.symm).resolve_left hne
      rw [hclosed] at hg
      obtain ⟨h, hh, hgh⟩ := hg
      exact torusEmb_injective hgh ▸ hh
    
    let e : Fin 4 → ℤ := ![0, 1, 0, -1]
    have hcurve : ∀ t : kˣ, torusEmb ((1 : kˣ), t) = fun j ↦ ((t ^ e j : kˣ) : k) := by
      intro t
      funext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp [e]
    let p₁ := vanishingIdeal k (Set.range fun t : kˣ ↦ torusEmb ((1 : kˣ), t))
    let p₂ := vanishingIdeal k ({torusEmb (1 : kˣ × kˣ)} : Set (Fin 4 → k))
    have hp₁mem : ∀ f, f ∈ p₁ ↔ ∀ t : kˣ, aeval (torusEmb ((1 : kˣ), t)) f = 0 := fun f ↦ by
      simp only [p₁, mem_vanishingIdeal_iff, Set.forall_mem_range]
    have hp₁ : p₁.IsPrime := by
      refine ⟨fun htop ↦ ?_, fun {f g} hfg ↦ ?_⟩
      · have := (hp₁mem 1).1 (htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top) 1
        simp at this
      · obtain ⟨N, φ, hφ⟩ := exists_curve_clear e f
        obtain ⟨M, ψ, hψ⟩ := exists_curve_clear e g
        have hprod : φ * ψ = 0 := by
          apply Polynomial.eq_zero_of_infinite_isRoot
          have hinf : {x : k | x ≠ 0}.Infinite := by
            convert (Set.infinite_univ (α := k)).sdiff (Set.finite_singleton (0 : k)) using 1
            ext x
            simp
          refine Set.Infinite.mono (s := {x : k | x ≠ 0}) ?_ hinf
          intro x hx
          let t : kˣ := Units.mk0 x hx
          have hfgt := (hp₁mem (f * g)).1 hfg t
          rw [map_mul, hcurve] at hfgt
          simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Polynomial.IsRoot.def, Polynomial.eval_mul]
          have hx' : x = (t : k) := rfl
          rw [hx', hφ, hψ]
          calc (t : k) ^ N * aeval (fun j ↦ ((t ^ e j : kˣ) : k)) f *
                ((t : k) ^ M * aeval (fun j ↦ ((t ^ e j : kˣ) : k)) g)
              = (t : k) ^ N * (t : k) ^ M * (aeval (fun j ↦ ((t ^ e j : kˣ) : k)) f *
                  aeval (fun j ↦ ((t ^ e j : kˣ) : k)) g) := by ring
            _ = 0 := by rw [hfgt, mul_zero]
        rcases mul_eq_zero.1 hprod with h0 | h0
        · left
          rw [hp₁mem]
          intro t
          have := hφ t
          rw [h0, Polynomial.eval_zero] at this
          rw [hcurve]
          exact (mul_eq_zero.1 this.symm).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero _ t.ne_zero)
        · right
          rw [hp₁mem]
          intro t
          have := hψ t
          rw [h0, Polynomial.eval_zero] at this
          rw [hcurve]
          exact (mul_eq_zero.1 this.symm).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero _ t.ne_zero)
    have hp₂ : p₂.IsPrime := (isMaximal_iff_eq_vanishingIdeal_singleton.2 ⟨_, rfl⟩).isPrime
    obtain ⟨g₀, hg₀, h₀, hh₀, hgh₀⟩ := hproj₁
    obtain ⟨g₁, hg₁, h₁, hh₁, hgh₁⟩ := hproj₂
    have hJp₁ : J < p₁ := by
      refine lt_of_le_of_ne (fun f hf ↦ (hp₁mem f).2 fun t ↦ (hJmem f).1 hf _ (hall _))
        fun heq ↦ ?_
      have hmem : X 0 - C 1 ∈ p₁ := (hp₁mem _).2 fun t ↦ by simp
      rw [← heq] at hmem
      have hu : ∃ u : kˣ, u ≠ 1 := by
        by_contra hcon
        push Not at hcon
        exact hgh₀ ((hcon _).trans (hcon _).symm)
      obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hu
      have := (hJmem _).1 hmem (u, 1) (hall _)
      simp only [map_sub, aeval_X, aeval_C, torusEmb_apply_zero, Algebra.algebraMap_self,
        RingHom.id_apply, sub_eq_zero] at this
      exact hu (Units.ext this)
    have hp₁p₂ : p₁ < p₂ := by
      refine lt_of_le_of_ne (fun f hf ↦ ?_) fun heq ↦ ?_
      · rw [mem_vanishingIdeal_iff]
        intro y hy
        rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
        subst hy
        exact (hp₁mem f).1 hf 1
      · have hmem : X 1 - C 1 ∈ p₂ := by
          rw [mem_vanishingIdeal_iff]
          intro y hy
          rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
          subst hy
          simp
        rw [← heq] at hmem
        have hv : ∃ v : kˣ, v ≠ 1 := by
          by_contra hcon
          push Not at hcon
          exact hgh₁ ((hcon _).trans (hcon _).symm)
        obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hv
        have := (hp₁mem _).1 hmem v
        simp only [map_sub, aeval_X, aeval_C, torusEmb_apply_one, Algebra.algebraMap_self,
          RingHom.id_apply, sub_eq_zero] at this
        exact hv (Units.ext this)
    have := two_le_ringKrullDim_quotient (P := J) hJp₁ hp₁p₂
    rw [hdim] at this
    norm_num at this
  
  have hdim2 : ringKrullDim (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) = 2 := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.ringKrullDim_of_isNoetherianRing, ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_field]
    simp
  obtain ⟨Mx, hMmax, hIM⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal I₂ hI₂prime.ne_top
  have hIMlt : I₂ < Mx := lt_of_le_of_ne hIM fun h ↦ hnmax (h ▸ hMmax)
  have hheight : I₂.height = 1 := by
    have hM2 : (Mx.height : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ 2 := by
      rw [← hdim2]
      exact Ideal.height_le_ringKrullDim_of_ne_top hMmax.ne_top
    have hstep : I₂.height + 1 ≤ Mx.height := Ideal.height_add_one_le_of_lt_of_isPrime hIMlt
    have hle : I₂.height + 1 ≤ 2 := by
      exact_mod_cast hstep.trans (WithBot.coe_le_coe.1 hM2)
    have hne : I₂.height ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hbot (Ideal.height_eq_zero_iff_eq_bot.1 h)
    set ht := I₂.height with hht
    have htop : ht ≠ ⊤ := by
      intro h
      rw [h, top_add] at hle
      simp at hle
    lift ht to ℕ using htop with n hn
    have h1 : n + 1 ≤ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hle
    have h2 : n ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hne
    have h3 : n = 1 := by omega
    exact_mod_cast congrArg (Nat.cast : ℕ → ℕ∞) h3
  obtain ⟨F, hFI, hFp⟩ := hI₂prime.exists_mem_prime_of_ne_bot hbot
  have hIF : I₂ = Ideal.span {F} := Ideal.eq_span_singleton_of_height_eq_one hheight hFI hFp
  
  have hscale : ∀ h ∈ H,
      Ideal.span {scale ![(h.1 : k), (h.2 : k)] F} = Ideal.span {F} := fun h hh ↦ by
    set c : Fin 2 → k := ![(h.1 : k), (h.2 : k)] with hc
    have hc0 : ∀ j, c j ≠ 0 := by
      intro j
      fin_cases j <;> simp [c]
    have hmem : scale c F ∈ I₂ := (hI₂mem _).2 fun h' hh' ↦ by
      have hfun : (fun j ↦ algebraMap k k (c j) * ![(h'.1 : k), (h'.2 : k)] j) =
          ![((h' * h).1 : k), ((h' * h).2 : k)] := by
        funext j
        fin_cases j <;> simp [c, mul_comm]
      rw [aeval_scale, hfun]
      exact (hI₂mem F).1 hFI _ (H.mul_mem hh' hh)
    have hcc : c * c⁻¹ = 1 := by
      funext j
      simp [hc0 j]
    have hcc' : c⁻¹ * c = 1 := by
      rw [mul_comm, hcc]
    let T : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k :=
      AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom (scale c) (scale c⁻¹)
        (AlgHom.ext fun g ↦ by rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply, scale_scale, hcc,
          scale_one])
        (AlgHom.ext fun g ↦ by rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply, scale_scale, hcc',
          scale_one])
    have hprime : Prime (scale c F) := (MulEquiv.prime_iff T).2 hFp
    rw [hIF, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hmem
    exact Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton.2 (Prime.associated_of_dvd hFp hprime hmem).symm
  
  have hsupp : ∃ m ∈ F.support, ∃ m' ∈ F.support, m ≠ m' := by
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 fun h ↦
      hFp.ne_zero (MvPolynomial.support_eq_empty.1 h)
    have hsing : F.support = {m₀} :=
      Finset.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.2 ⟨hm₀, fun m hm ↦ hcon m hm m₀ hm₀⟩
    have h1 := (hI₂mem F).1 hFI 1 H.one_mem
    have h11 : ![((1 : kˣ × kˣ).1 : k), ((1 : kˣ × kˣ).2 : k)] = fun _ ↦ (1 : k) := by
      funext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp
    rw [h11] at h1
    change MvPolynomial.eval (fun _ ↦ (1 : k)) F = 0 at h1
    rw [MvPolynomial.eval_eq, hsing, Finset.sum_singleton] at h1
    simp only [one_pow, Finset.prod_const_one, mul_one] at h1
    exact (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.1 hm₀) h1
  obtain ⟨m, hm, m', hm', hmm'⟩ := hsupp
  
  set d₁ : ℤ := (m 0 : ℤ) - m' 0 with hd₁
  set d₂ : ℤ := (m 1 : ℤ) - m' 1 with hd₂
  have hrel : ∀ h ∈ H, h.1 ^ d₁ * h.2 ^ d₂ = 1 := fun h hh ↦ by
    have hc0 : ∀ j, (![(h.1 : k), (h.2 : k)] : Fin 2 → k) j ≠ 0 := by
      intro j
      fin_cases j <;> simp
    have hk := monomial_prod_eq_of_span_scale_eq hc0 hFp.ne_zero (hscale h hh) m hm m' hm'
    rw [Finsupp.prod_fintype _ _ (fun i ↦ pow_zero _),
      Finsupp.prod_fintype _ _ (fun i ↦ pow_zero _), Fin.prod_univ_two, Fin.prod_univ_two]
      at hk
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one] at hk
    have hu : h.1 ^ (m 0) * h.2 ^ (m 1) = h.1 ^ (m' 0) * h.2 ^ (m' 1) :=
      Units.ext (by push_cast; exact hk)
    rw [hd₁, hd₂, zpow_sub, zpow_sub, zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast,
      mul_mul_mul_comm, ← mul_inv, hu, mul_inv_cancel]
  have hd : d₁ ≠ 0 ∨ d₂ ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    apply hmm'
    ext j
    fin_cases j
    · have := hcon.1
      simp only [hd₁, sub_eq_zero] at this
      exact_mod_cast this
    · have := hcon.2
      simp only [hd₂, sub_eq_zero] at this
      exact_mod_cast this
  
  have hnat : ∀ {x : kˣ} {z : ℤ}, x ^ z = 1 → x ^ z.natAbs = 1 := by
    intro x z hz
    rcases Int.natAbs_eq z with h | h
    · rw [h, zpow_natCast] at hz
      exact hz
    · rw [h, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, inv_eq_one] at hz
      exact hz
  have hd₁0 : d₁ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hd₂0 : d₂ ≠ 0 := hd.resolve_left (not_not.2 h0)
    refine hsnd (Int.natAbs_ne_zero.2 hd₂0) fun h hh ↦ hnat ?_
    simpa [h0] using hrel h hh
  have hd₂0 : d₂ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    refine hfst (Int.natAbs_ne_zero.2 hd₁0) fun h hh ↦ hnat ?_
    simpa [h0] using hrel h hh
  
  set g := Int.gcd d₁ d₂ with hgdef
  have hgpos : 0 < g := Int.gcd_pos_of_ne_zero_left _ hd₁0
  set a : ℤ := d₁ / g with ha
  set b : ℤ := d₂ / g with hb
  have hcop : Int.gcd a b = 1 := Int.gcd_div_gcd_div_gcd hgpos
  have hd₁a : d₁ = a * g := (Int.ediv_mul_cancel (Int.gcd_dvd_left d₁ d₂)).symm
  have hd₂b : d₂ = b * g := (Int.ediv_mul_cancel (Int.gcd_dvd_right d₁ d₂)).symm
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, zero_mul] at hd₁a
    exact hd₁0 hd₁a
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, zero_mul] at hd₂b
    exact hd₂0 hd₂b
  have hchar : ∀ h ∈ H, h.1 ^ a * h.2 ^ b = 1 := by
    obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := hconst (charMono a b) hgpos.ne' fun h hh ↦ by
      rw [aeval_charMono, ← Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, ← zpow_natCast, mul_zpow, ← zpow_mul,
        ← zpow_mul, ← hd₁a, ← hd₂b, hrel h hh, Units.val_one]
    have h1 := hζ 1 H.one_mem
    rw [aeval_charMono] at h1
    simp only [Prod.fst_one, Prod.snd_one, one_zpow, mul_one, Units.val_one] at h1
    intro h hh
    have := hζ h hh
    rw [aeval_charMono, ← h1] at this
    exact Units.ext this
  
  obtain ⟨p, q, hpq⟩ : ∃ p q : ℤ, a * p + b * q = 1 :=
    ⟨Int.gcdA a b, Int.gcdB a b, by rw [← Int.gcd_eq_gcd_ab, hcop, Nat.cast_one]⟩
  let lam : kˣ →* kˣ × kˣ := (zpowGroupHom b).prod (zpowGroupHom (-a))
  have hlam : ∀ t : kˣ, lam t = (t ^ b, t ^ (-a)) := fun t ↦ rfl
  have hker : ∀ x : kˣ × kˣ, x.1 ^ a * x.2 ^ b = 1 → x = lam (x.1 ^ q * x.2 ^ (-p)) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := eq_cochar_of_mul_eq_one hpq hx
    rw [hlam]
    exact Prod.ext h1.symm h2.symm
  let L := H.comap lam
  have hL : ∀ t : kˣ, t ∈ L := by
    by_contra hcon
    push Not at hcon
    obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀⟩ := hcon
    have hnot : torusEmb (lam t₀) ∉ zeroLocus k J := by
      rw [hclosed]
      rintro ⟨h, hh, hht⟩
      apply ht₀
      change lam t₀ ∈ H
      rw [← torusEmb_injective hht]
      exact hh
    rw [mem_zeroLocus_iff] at hnot
    push Not at hnot
    obtain ⟨f, hfJ, hf0⟩ := hnot
    let e : Fin 4 → ℤ := ![b, -a, -b, a]
    have hcurve : ∀ t : kˣ, torusEmb (lam t) = fun j ↦ ((t ^ e j : kˣ) : k) := by
      intro t
      funext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp [e, hlam, zpow_neg]
    obtain ⟨N, φ, hφ⟩ := exists_curve_clear e f
    have hφ0 : φ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have := hφ t₀
      rw [h0, Polynomial.eval_zero, ← hcurve] at this
      exact hf0 ((mul_eq_zero.1 this.symm).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero _ t₀.ne_zero))
    have hfinL : (L : Set kˣ).Finite := by
      refine ((Polynomial.finite_setOfPred_isRoot hφ0).preimage
        Units.val_injective.injOn).subset fun t ht ↦ ?_
      simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Polynomial.IsRoot.def]
      rw [hφ, ← hcurve, (hJmem f).1 hfJ _ ht, mul_zero]
    apply hinfinite
    refine (hfinL.image lam).subset fun h hh ↦ ?_
    refine ⟨h.1 ^ q * h.2 ^ (-p), ?_, (hker h (hchar h hh)).symm⟩
    change lam (h.1 ^ q * h.2 ^ (-p)) ∈ H
    rw [← hker h (hchar h hh)]
    exact hh
  
  have hH : (H : Set (kˣ × kˣ)) = {x | x.1 ^ a * x.2 ^ b = 1} := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · exact hchar x
    · intro hx
      rw [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hx
      rw [SetLike.mem_coe, hker x hx]
      exact hL _
  have hH' : (H : Set (kˣ × kˣ)) = {x | x.1 ^ a = x.2 ^ (-b)} := by
    rw [hH]
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, zpow_neg]
    exact mul_eq_one_iff_eq_inv
  refine ⟨a, -b, ha0, neg_ne_zero.2 hb0, hH', fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  ext y
  rw [Set.mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem, smul_eq_mul, hH']
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Prod.fst_mul, Prod.snd_mul, Prod.fst_inv, Prod.snd_inv,
    mul_zpow, inv_zpow]
  rw [inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul, mul_assoc]

name: AclGeom.exists_poly_of_mem_racl
statement:
theorem exists_poly_of_mem_racl {ι κ : Type*} (t : ι → Ω) (g : κ → ι) (f : MvPolynomial ι k)
    (hf : aeval t f ∈ racl k (Set.range (t ∘ g))) :
    ∃ p : Polynomial (MvPolynomial κ k), (∃ j, p.coeff j ∉ idealOf k (t ∘ g)) ∧
      p.eval₂ (rename g : MvPolynomial κ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial ι k).toRingHom f ∈
        idealOf k t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp0, hpz⟩ : IsAlgebraic (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (t ∘ g))) (aeval t f) :=
    (IsFractionRing.isAlgebraic_iff (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (t ∘ g)))
      (IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range (t ∘ g))) Ω).2 ((mem_racl_iff k).1 hf)
  let ψ : MvPolynomial κ k →+* Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (t ∘ g)) :=
    (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (k := k) (t ∘ g)).toRingEquiv.toRingHom.comp
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealOf k (t ∘ g)))
  have hψ : Function.Surjective ψ :=
    (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (k := k) (t ∘ g)).surjective.comp Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  have hcomp : (aeval t).toRingHom.comp
      (rename g : MvPolynomial κ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial ι k).toRingHom =
      (algebraMap (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (t ∘ g))) Ω).comp ψ :=
    RingHom.ext fun c ↦ (aeval_rename g t c).trans
      (congrArg Subtype.val (locusCoordinateRingEquiv_mk (k := k) (t ∘ g) c)).symm
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := Polynomial.map_surjective ψ hψ p
  refine ⟨P, ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, p.coeff j ≠ 0 := ⟨p.natDegree, Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.2 hp0⟩
    refine ⟨j, fun hmem ↦ hj ?_⟩
    rw [← hP, Polynomial.coeff_map]
    exact Subtype.ext ((congrArg Subtype.val (locusCoordinateRingEquiv_mk (k := k) (t ∘ g) _)).trans
      ((mem_idealOf_iff k).1 hmem))
  · rw [mem_idealOf_iff]
    change (aeval t).toRingHom (P.eval₂ (rename g).toRingHom f) = 0
    rw [Polynomial.hom_eval₂, hcomp, ← Polynomial.eval₂_map, hP, ← Polynomial.aeval_def]
    exact hpz

name: AclGeom.idealOf_eq_of_le_of_comap_eq
statement:
theorem idealOf_eq_of_le_of_comap_eq {ι κ : Type*} (t : ι → Ω) (g : κ → ι)
    (halg : ∀ i, t i ∈ racl k (Set.range (t ∘ g))) {J : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι k)}
    (hle : idealOf k t ≤ J)
    (hcomap : J.comap (rename g : MvPolynomial κ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial ι k) = idealOf k (t ∘ g)) :
    J = idealOf k t
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun f hf ↦ ?_) hle
  by_contra hft
  have hracl : aeval t f ∈ racl k (Set.range (t ∘ g)) := by
    have hle' : IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range t) ≤ racl k (Set.range (t ∘ g)) :=
      IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff.2 (Set.range_subset_iff.2 halg)
    refine hle' (IntermediateField.algebra_adjoin_le_adjoin k _ ?_)
    rw [Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_aeval]
    exact AlgHom.mem_range_self _ f
  obtain ⟨p, ⟨j, hj⟩, hp⟩ := exists_poly_of_mem_racl t g f hracl
  have hI : (idealOf k t).comap (rename g : MvPolynomial κ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial ι k).toRingHom =
      idealOf k (t ∘ g) := (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (k := k) rfl).symm
  have hne : p.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((idealOf k t).comap
      (rename g : MvPolynomial κ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial ι k).toRingHom)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hj
    rw [← hI]
    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.1
      (by rw [← Polynomial.coeff_map, h, Polynomial.coeff_zero])
  have hlt := Ideal.comap_lt_comap_of_root_mem_sdiff
    (f := (rename g : MvPolynomial κ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial ι k).toRingHom) hle ⟨hf, hft⟩ hne hp
  rw [hI] at hlt
  exact lt_irrefl _ (hlt.trans_eq hcomap)

name: AclGeom.algebraicIndependent_rep_pair_of_ne
statement:
theorem algebraicIndependent_rep_pair_of_ne
    {P Q : Point k K} (hPQ : P ≠ Q) :
    AlgebraicIndependent k ![P.rep, Q.rep]
proof:
:= by
  have hP : P.rep ∉ racl k ({Q.rep} : Set K) := by
    intro hmem
    have hle : P.1 ≤ Q.1 := by
      rw [← P.point_rep, ← Q.point_rep]
      exact ClosedIF.point_le_iff.2 hmem
    have heq : P.1 = Q.1 := (Q.2.le_iff_eq P.2.1).1 hle
    exact hPQ (Subtype.ext heq)
  have hQ : Q.rep ∉ racl k ({P.rep} : Set K) := by
    intro hmem
    have hle : Q.1 ≤ P.1 := by
      rw [← Q.point_rep, ← P.point_rep]
      exact ClosedIF.point_le_iff.2 hmem
    have heq : Q.1 = P.1 := (P.2.le_iff_eq Q.2.1).1 hle
    exact hPQ (Subtype.ext heq.symm)
  exact algebraicIndependent_pair hP hQ

name: AclGeom.point_rep_notMem_racl_rep_of_ne
statement:
theorem point_rep_notMem_racl_rep_of_ne
    {P Q : Point k K} (hPQ : P ≠ Q) :
    P.rep ∉ racl k ({Q.rep} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hle : P.1 ≤ Q.1 := by
    rw [← P.point_rep, ← Q.point_rep]
    exact ClosedIF.point_le_iff.2 hmem
  have heq : P.1 = Q.1 := (Q.2.le_iff_eq P.2.1).1 hle
  exact hPQ (Subtype.ext heq)

name: AclGeom.point_rep_singleton_independent
statement:
theorem point_rep_singleton_independent (P : Point k K) :
    AlgebraicIndependent k ![P.rep]
proof:
:= by
  rw [algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff]
  intro halg
  exact P.rep_notMem_bot (ClosedIF.mem_bot_iff.2 halg)

name: AclGeom.sup_eq_iSup_three
statement:
theorem sup_eq_iSup_three {α : Type*} [CompleteLattice α] (a b c : α) :
    a ⊔ (b ⊔ c) = ⨆ i, (![a, b, c] : Fin 3 → α) i
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (sup_le ?_ (sup_le ?_ ?_)) (iSup_le fun i ↦ ?_)
  · exact le_iSup_of_le 0 (by simp)
  · exact le_iSup_of_le 1 (by simp)
  · exact le_iSup_of_le 2 (by simp)
  · fin_cases i
    · exact le_sup_left
    · exact le_sup_of_le_right le_sup_left
    · exact le_sup_of_le_right le_sup_right

name: AclGeom.pair_sup_eq_triple_of_rankEq_two
statement:
theorem pair_sup_eq_triple_of_rankEq_two
    {P Q R : Point k K} (hPQ : P ≠ Q)
    (h : RankEq 2 (P.1 ⊔ (Q.1 ⊔ R.1))) :
    P.1 ⊔ Q.1 = P.1 ⊔ (Q.1 ⊔ R.1)
proof:
:= by
  apply RankEq.eq_of_le _ (rankEq_two_sup_of_ne hPQ) h
  exact sup_le le_sup_left (le_sup_of_le_right le_sup_left)

name: AclGeom.third_rep_mem_racl_pair_of_rankEq_two
statement:
theorem third_rep_mem_racl_pair_of_rankEq_two
    {P Q R : Point k K} (hPQ : P ≠ Q)
    (h : RankEq 2 (P.1 ⊔ (Q.1 ⊔ R.1))) :
    R.rep ∈ racl k ({P.rep, Q.rep} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have heq := pair_sup_eq_triple_of_rankEq_two hPQ h
  have hle : R.1 ≤ P.1 ⊔ Q.1 := by
    rw [heq]
    exact le_sup_of_le_right le_sup_right
  have hmem : R.rep ∈ (P.1 ⊔ Q.1).1 := hle R.mem_rep
  rw [← P.point_rep, ← Q.point_rep, coe_sup_point₂] at hmem
  exact hmem

name: AclGeom.algebraicIndependent_rep_triple_of_rankEq_three
statement:
theorem algebraicIndependent_rep_triple_of_rankEq_three
    {P Q R : Point k K}
    (h : RankEq 3 (P.1 ⊔ (Q.1 ⊔ R.1))) :
    AlgebraicIndependent k ![P.rep, Q.rep, R.rep]
proof:
:= by
  apply algebraicIndependent_of_rankEq_iSup_point
  apply h.congr
  rw [← P.point_rep, ← Q.point_rep, ← R.point_rep,
    sup_eq_iSup_three]
  exact iSup_congr fun i ↦ by fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: AclGeom.rep_notMem_racl_dependent_triple
statement:
theorem rep_notMem_racl_dependent_triple
    {P Q R X : Point k K} (hPQ : P ≠ Q)
    (hdep : RankEq 2 (P.1 ⊔ (Q.1 ⊔ R.1)))
    (hfree : RankEq 3 (P.1 ⊔ (Q.1 ⊔ X.1))) :
    X.rep ∉ racl k ({P.rep, Q.rep, R.rep} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have hfreeAI := algebraicIndependent_rep_triple_of_rankEq_three hfree
  have hnot := AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_image hfreeAI
    (S := ({0, 1} : Set (Fin 3))) (i := 2) (by decide)
  have hnotPair : X.rep ∉ racl k ({P.rep, Q.rep} : Set K) := by
    simpa [Set.image_insert_eq] using hnot
  intro hx
  have htriple : X.rep ∈ (P.1 ⊔ (Q.1 ⊔ R.1)).1 := by
    rw [← P.point_rep, ← Q.point_rep, ← R.point_rep,
      coe_sup_point₃]
    exact hx
  have heq := pair_sup_eq_triple_of_rankEq_two hPQ hdep
  have hpair : X.rep ∈ (P.1 ⊔ Q.1).1 := by
    rw [heq]
    exact htriple
  rw [← P.point_rep, ← Q.point_rep, coe_sup_point₂] at hpair
  exact hnotPair hpair

      groupoidDifferenceProduct (parameterTArrow h e)

name: AclGeom.IsPartialQuadrangle.exists_parameter_groupoidDifferenceProduct
statement:
theorem exists_parameter_groupoidDifferenceProduct [IsAlgClosed K]
    (h : IsPartialQuadrangle f) {s e a b : K}
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![s, e, a, b]) :
    ∃ D : ParameterFourArrowDifferenceDiagram h s b a e,
      parameterTArrow h D.c =
        groupoidDifferenceProduct (parameterTArrow h e)
          (parameterTArrow h a) (parameterTArrow h b)
proof:
:= by
  let p : Fin 4 → Fin 4 := ![0, 1, 3, 2]
  have hp : Function.Injective p := by
    intro i j hij
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [p] at hij ⊢
  have hswap := AlgebraicIndependent.comp hind p hp
  have heq : (![s, e, a, b] : Fin 4 → K) ∘ p = ![s, e, b, a] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  rw [heq] at hswap
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := h.exists_parameter_fourArrowDifferenceDiagram hswap
  exact ⟨D, PresentedFamilyGroupoid.fourArrow_cancellation_swapped
    (parameterMultiplication h) D⟩

name: AclGeom.IsPartialQuadrangle.configurationReps_mem_racl_groupReps
statement:
theorem configurationReps_mem_racl_groupReps
    (h : IsPartialQuadrangle f) (i : Fin 6) :
    configurationReps f i ∈ racl k (Set.range (groupReps f))
proof:
:= by
  rw [groupReps_range]
  fin_cases i
  · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp [configurationReps])
  · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp [configurationReps])
  · apply racl_mono (k := k)
      (S := {(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep})
      (T := {(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep, (f 3).rep})
      (by rintro x (rfl | rfl) <;> simp)
    exact third_rep_mem_racl_pair_of_rankEq_two
      ((IsPartialQuadrangle.injective h).ne (by decide))
      (IsPartialQuadrangle.rank_STU h)
  · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp [configurationReps])
  · have hmem : (f 4).rep ∈ racl k ({(f 2).rep, (f 3).rep} : Set K) :=
      third_rep_mem_racl_pair_of_rankEq_two
        ((IsPartialQuadrangle.injective h).ne (by decide))
        (IsPartialQuadrangle.rank_S'T'U h)
    apply racl_le_of_subset_racl (k := k) _ hmem
    rintro x (rfl | rfl)
    · apply racl_mono (k := k)
        (S := {(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep})
        (T := {(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep, (f 3).rep})
        (by rintro y (rfl | rfl) <;> simp)
      exact third_rep_mem_racl_pair_of_rankEq_two
        ((IsPartialQuadrangle.injective h).ne (by decide))
        (IsPartialQuadrangle.rank_STU h)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
  · apply racl_mono (k := k)
      (S := {(f 1).rep, (f 3).rep})
      (T := {(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep, (f 3).rep})
      (by rintro x (rfl | rfl) <;> simp)
    exact third_rep_mem_racl_pair_of_rankEq_two
      ((IsPartialQuadrangle.injective h).ne (by decide))
      (IsPartialQuadrangle.rank_S'TU' h)

name: AclGeom.IsPartialQuadrangle.exists_configuration_relocation
statement:
theorem exists_configuration_relocation [IsAlgClosed K]
    (h : IsPartialQuadrangle f) {g : Fin 3 → K}
    (hg : AlgebraicIndependent k g) :
    ∃ v : Fin 6 → K,
      idealOf k v = idealOf k (configurationReps f) ∧
        v ∘ groupCoordinateIndex = g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hfix⟩ := exists_tuple_relocation_fixing
    (groupReps_independent h) hg
    (u := configurationReps f) (e := groupCoordinateIndex)
    (fun i ↦ congrFun configurationReps_comp_groupCoordinateIndex i)
    (configurationReps_mem_racl_groupReps h)
  exact ⟨v, hv, funext hfix⟩

name: AclGeom.IsPartialQuadrangle.exists_configuration_relocation_fixing_parameter_realization
statement:
theorem exists_configuration_relocation_fixing_parameter_realization
    [IsAlgClosed K] (h : IsPartialQuadrangle f) {s t u x : K}
    (hstu : idealOf k ![s, t, u] = (parameterMultiplication h).ideal)
    (hx : x ∉ racl k ({s, t, u} : Set K)) :
    ∃ v : Fin 6 → K,
      idealOf k v = idealOf k (configurationReps f) ∧
        v ∘ parameterSourceCoordinateIndex = ![s, t, u, x]
proof:
:= by
  have hparameter : idealOf k ![s, t, u] =
      idealOf k ![(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep, (f 2).rep] := by
    simpa [FiniteCorrespondenceMultiplication.ideal,
      FiniteCorrespondenceMultiplication.tuple, parameterMultiplication]
      using hstu
  have hx' : x ∉ racl k (Set.range (![s, t, u] : Fin 3 → K)) := by
    have hrange : Set.range (![s, t, u] : Fin 3 → K) =
        ({s, t, u} : Set K) := by
      ext z
      simp
      tauto
    rw [hrange]
    exact hx
  have hsource : (f 3).rep ∉ racl k
      (Set.range (![(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep, (f 2).rep] : Fin 3 → K)) := by
    have hrange :
        Set.range (![(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep, (f 2).rep] : Fin 3 → K) =
          ({(f 0).rep, (f 1).rep, (f 2).rep} : Set K) := by
      ext z
      simp
      tauto
    rw [hrange]
    exact S'_rep_generic_over_parameters h
  have hquad : idealOf k ![s, t, u, x] =
      idealOf k (parameterSourceReps f) := by
    simpa [parameterSourceReps] using
      idealOf_snoc_eq_of_idealOf_eq_of_generic hparameter hx' hsource
  have hmem (j : Fin 6) : configurationReps f j ∈
      racl k (Set.range (parameterSourceReps f)) := by
    apply racl_mono (k := k)
      (S := Set.range (groupReps f))
      (T := Set.range (parameterSourceReps f))
      (fun z hz ↦ ?_)
      (configurationReps_mem_racl_groupReps h j)
    rcases hz with ⟨i, rfl⟩
    fin_cases i
    · exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨1, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨3, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hfix⟩ := exists_tuple_relocation_fixing_locus
    hquad
    (u := configurationReps f) (e := parameterSourceCoordinateIndex)
    (fun i ↦ congrFun configurationReps_comp_parameterSourceCoordinateIndex i)
    hmem
  exact ⟨v, hv, funext hfix⟩

name: AclGeom.IsPartialQuadrangle.configurationOverGroupCoordinates_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem configurationOverGroupCoordinates_finiteDimensional
    (h : IsPartialQuadrangle f) :
    FiniteDimensional (↥(groupCoordinateField f))
      (↥(configurationOverGroupCoordinates f))
proof:
:= by
  have key : configurationOverGroupCoordinates f =
      adjoin (↥(groupCoordinateField f))
        (Set.range (configurationReps f)) := by
    refine restrictScalars_injective k ?_
    unfold configurationOverGroupCoordinates groupCoordinateField
      configurationField
    rw [adjoin_adjoin_left]
    refine (extendScalars_restrictScalars _).trans ?_
    rw [adjoin_union]
    exact (sup_eq_right.2 groupCoordinateField_le_configurationField).symm
  rw [key]
  letI : Fintype (Set.range (configurationReps f)) :=
    Set.Finite.fintype (Set.finite_range (configurationReps f))
  exact finiteDimensional_adjoin fun x hx ↦ by
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [groupCoordinateField]
    exact ((mem_racl_iff k).1
      (configurationReps_mem_racl_groupReps h i)).isIntegral
