name: AclGeom.IsPartialQuadrangle.exists_compatible_family_relocation
statement:
theorem exists_compatible_family_relocation [IsAlgClosed K]
    (h : IsPartialQuadrangle f) {g : Fin 3 → K}
    (hg : AlgebraicIndependent k g) :
    ∃ v : Fin 6 → K,
      idealOf k v = idealOf k (configurationReps f) ∧
        v ∘ groupCoordinateIndex = g ∧
        idealOf k (v ∘ tFamilyIndex) = (tFamilyMember h).ideal ∧
        idealOf k (v ∘ sFamilyIndex) = (sFamilyMember h).ideal ∧
        idealOf k (v ∘ uFamilyIndex) = (uFamilyMember h).ideal
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hfix⟩ := exists_configuration_relocation h hg
  have ht := idealOf_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq hv tFamilyIndex
  have hs := idealOf_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq hv sFamilyIndex
  have hu := idealOf_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq hv uFamilyIndex
  rw [configurationReps_comp_tFamilyIndex h] at ht
  rw [configurationReps_comp_sFamilyIndex h] at hs
  rw [configurationReps_comp_uFamilyIndex h] at hu
  exact ⟨v, hv, hfix, ht, hs, hu⟩

name: AclGeom.IsPartialQuadrangle.exists_family_composition_of_parameter_product
statement:
theorem exists_family_composition_of_parameter_product [IsAlgClosed K]
    (h : IsPartialQuadrangle f) {s t u x : K}
    (hstu : idealOf k ![s, t, u] = (parameterMultiplication h).ideal)
    (hx : x ∉ racl k ({s, t, u} : Set K)) :
    ∃ y z : K,
      idealOf k ![t, x, y] = (tFamilyMember h).ideal ∧
        idealOf k ![s, y, z] = (sFamilyMember h).ideal ∧
        idealOf k ![u, x, z] = (uFamilyMember h).ideal
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hfix⟩ :=
    exists_configuration_relocation_fixing_parameter_realization h hstu hx
  have h0 : v 0 = s := by
    simpa [parameterSourceCoordinateIndex] using congrFun hfix 0
  have h1 : v 1 = t := by
    simpa [parameterSourceCoordinateIndex] using congrFun hfix 1
  have h2 : v 2 = u := by
    simpa [parameterSourceCoordinateIndex] using congrFun hfix 2
  have h3 : v 3 = x := by
    simpa [parameterSourceCoordinateIndex] using congrFun hfix 3
  have ht := idealOf_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq hv tFamilyIndex
  have hs := idealOf_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq hv sFamilyIndex
  have hu := idealOf_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq hv uFamilyIndex
  rw [configurationReps_comp_tFamilyIndex h] at ht
  rw [configurationReps_comp_sFamilyIndex h] at hs
  rw [configurationReps_comp_uFamilyIndex h] at hu
  have htTuple : v ∘ tFamilyIndex = ![t, x, v 5] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · exact h1
    · exact h3
    · rfl
  have hsTuple : v ∘ sFamilyIndex = ![s, v 5, v 4] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · exact h0
    · rfl
    · rfl
  have huTuple : v ∘ uFamilyIndex = ![u, x, v 4] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · exact h2
    · exact h3
    · rfl
  rw [htTuple] at ht
  rw [hsTuple] at hs
  rw [huTuple] at hu
  exact ⟨v 5, v 4, ht, hs, hu⟩

      groupoidDifferenceProduct (parameterTArrow h e)
        (parameterTArrow h b) (parameterTArrow h a)
proof:
:=

name: AclGeom.IsPartialQuadrangle.exists_parameterFourArrowFamilyLifts
statement:
theorem exists_parameterFourArrowFamilyLifts [IsAlgClosed K]
    (h : IsPartialQuadrangle f) {s a b e x : K}
    (D : ParameterFourArrowDifferenceDiagram h s a b e)
    (hx : x ∉ racl k ({s, e, a, b} : Set K)) :
    Nonempty (ParameterFourArrowFamilyLifts h D x)
proof:
:= by
  have hx_seu : x ∉ racl k ({s, e, D.u} : Set K) := by
    intro hmem
    apply hx
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ hmem
    rintro z (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
    · exact D.u_mem_inputs
  have hx_sAau : x ∉ racl k ({D.sA, a, D.u} : Set K) := by
    intro hmem
    apply hx
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ hmem
    rintro z (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    · exact D.sA_mem_inputs
    · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
    · exact D.u_mem_inputs
  have hx_sbuB : x ∉ racl k ({s, b, D.uB} : Set K) := by
    intro hmem
    apply hx
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ hmem
    rintro z (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
    · exact subset_racl k _ (by simp)
    · exact D.uB_mem_inputs
  have hx_sAcuB : x ∉ racl k ({D.sA, D.c, D.uB} : Set K) := by
    intro hmem
    apply hx
    refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ hmem
    rintro z (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    · exact D.sA_mem_inputs
    · exact D.c_mem_inputs
    · exact D.uB_mem_inputs
  obtain ⟨Lse⟩ := exists_parameterProductFamilyLift h D.se_u hx_seu
  obtain ⟨LsA_a⟩ := exists_parameterProductFamilyLift h D.sA_a_u hx_sAau
  obtain ⟨Ls_b⟩ := exists_parameterProductFamilyLift h D.s_b_uB hx_sbuB
  obtain ⟨LsA_c⟩ := exists_parameterProductFamilyLift h D.sA_c_uB hx_sAcuB
  exact ⟨⟨Lse, LsA_a, Ls_b, LsA_c⟩⟩

name: AclGeom.IsPartialQuadrangle.exists_parameterFourArrowDiagramWithFamilyLifts
statement:
theorem exists_parameterFourArrowDiagramWithFamilyLifts [IsAlgClosed K]
    (h : IsPartialQuadrangle f) {s e a b x : K}
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![s, e, a, b, x]) :
    ∃ D : ParameterFourArrowDifferenceDiagram h s a b e,
      Nonempty (ParameterFourArrowFamilyLifts h D x)
proof:
:= by
  let q : Fin 5 → K := ![s, e, a, b, x]
  let firstFour : Fin 4 → Fin 5 := ![0, 1, 2, 3]
  have hfour : AlgebraicIndependent k ![s, e, a, b] := by
    have hcomp := AlgebraicIndependent.comp hind firstFour (by decide)
    convert hcomp using 1
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hq : AlgebraicIndependent k q := hind
  have hx : x ∉ racl k ({s, e, a, b} : Set K) := by
    have hnot := AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_image hq
      (S := ({0, 1, 2, 3} : Set (Fin 5))) (i := 4) (by simp)
    have himage : q '' ({0, 1, 2, 3} : Set (Fin 5)) =
        ({s, e, a, b} : Set K) := by
      ext z
      simp [q]
    rw [himage] at hnot
    simpa [q] using hnot
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := exists_parameter_fourArrowDifferenceDiagram h hfour
  exact ⟨D, exists_parameterFourArrowFamilyLifts h D hx⟩

name: AclGeom.IsPartialQuadrangle.relocatedCompositeEquiv_symm

    (relocatedCompositeEquiv hv hw).symm =
      relocatedCompositeEquiv hw hv
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom_injective
  apply adjoin_algHom_ext k
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  calc
    (relocatedCompositeEquiv hv hw).symm
        ⟨w (compositeBranchIndex i),
          subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩ =
        ⟨v (compositeBranchIndex i),
          subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩ :=
      (relocatedCompositeEquiv hv hw).symm_apply_eq.mpr
        (relocatedCompositeEquiv_apply hv hw i).symm
    _ = relocatedCompositeEquiv hw hv
        ⟨w (compositeBranchIndex i),
          subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩ :=
      (relocatedCompositeEquiv_apply hw hv i).symm

name: AclGeom.IsPartialQuadrangle.relocatedCompositeEquiv_trans
statement:
@[simp] theorem relocatedCompositeEquiv_trans {u v w : Fin 6 → K}
    (hu : idealOf k u = idealOf k (configurationReps f))
    (hv : idealOf k v = idealOf k (configurationReps f))
    (hw : idealOf k w = idealOf k (configurationReps f)) :
    (relocatedCompositeEquiv hu hv).trans
        (relocatedCompositeEquiv hv hw) =
      relocatedCompositeEquiv hu hw
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom_injective
  apply adjoin_algHom_ext k
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  calc
    ((relocatedCompositeEquiv hu hv).trans
        (relocatedCompositeEquiv hv hw))
        ⟨u (compositeBranchIndex i),
          subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩ =
        relocatedCompositeEquiv hv hw
          (relocatedCompositeEquiv hu hv
            ⟨u (compositeBranchIndex i),
              subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩) := rfl
    _ = relocatedCompositeEquiv hv hw
        ⟨v (compositeBranchIndex i),
          subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩ := by
      rw [relocatedCompositeEquiv_apply]
    _ = ⟨w (compositeBranchIndex i),
        subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩ :=
      relocatedCompositeEquiv_apply hv hw i
    _ = relocatedCompositeEquiv hu hw
        ⟨u (compositeBranchIndex i),
          subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩ :=
      (relocatedCompositeEquiv_apply hu hw i).symm

name: AclGeom.IsPartialQuadrangle.relocatedCompositeBranchField_restrictScalars_eq
statement:
theorem relocatedCompositeBranchField_restrictScalars_eq
    (h : IsPartialQuadrangle f) (v : Fin 6 → K)
    (hv : idealOf k v = idealOf k (configurationReps f)) :
    relocatedCompositeBranchField h v hv =
      tupleCompositeField (k := k) v
proof:
:= by
  change (((tPairOfIdealEq h v hv).comp
      (sPairOfIdealEq h v hv) rfl).branchField).restrictScalars k = _
  rw [FiniteCorrespondencePair.branchField, restrictScalars_adjoin]
  change adjoin k
      ((tupleParameterField (k := k) v : Set K) ∪ {v 3, v 4}) =
    adjoin k (Set.range (v ∘ compositeBranchIndex))
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply adjoin_le_iff.mpr
    rintro x (hx | hx)
    · have hparam : tupleParameterField (k := k) v ≤
          tupleCompositeField (k := k) v := by
        rw [tupleParameterField, tupleCompositeField]
        apply adjoin.mono
        intro z hz
        simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
        rcases hz with rfl | rfl | rfl
        · exact Set.mem_range_self 0
        · exact Set.mem_range_self 1
        · exact Set.mem_range_self 2
      exact hparam hx
    · apply subset_adjoin k _
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl
      · exact Set.mem_range_self 3
      · exact Set.mem_range_self 4
  · apply adjoin_le_iff.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    fin_cases i
    · apply subset_adjoin k _
      left
      exact subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)
    · apply subset_adjoin k _
      left
      exact subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)
    · apply subset_adjoin k _
      left
      exact subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)
    · exact subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)
    · exact subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)

name: AclGeom.IsPartialQuadrangle.relocatedChainField_restrictScalars_eq
statement:
theorem relocatedChainField_restrictScalars_eq
    (h : IsPartialQuadrangle f) (v : Fin 6 → K)
    (hv : idealOf k v = idealOf k (configurationReps f)) :
    relocatedChainField h v hv =
      tupleConfigurationField (k := k) v
proof:
:= by
  change ((tPairOfIdealEq h v hv).chainField
      (sPairOfIdealEq h v hv)).restrictScalars k = _
  rw [FiniteCorrespondencePair.chainField, restrictScalars_adjoin]
  change adjoin k
      ((tupleParameterField (k := k) v : Set K) ∪ {v 3, v 5, v 4}) =
    adjoin k (Set.range v)
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply adjoin_le_iff.mpr
    rintro x (hx | hx)
    · have hparam : tupleParameterField (k := k) v ≤
          adjoin k (Set.range v) := by
        rw [tupleParameterField]
        apply adjoin.mono
        intro z hz
        simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
        rcases hz with rfl | rfl | rfl
        · exact Set.mem_range_self 0
        · exact Set.mem_range_self 1
        · exact Set.mem_range_self 2
      exact hparam hx
    · apply subset_adjoin k _
      simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact Set.mem_range_self 3
      · exact Set.mem_range_self 5
      · exact Set.mem_range_self 4
  · apply adjoin_le_iff.mpr
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    fin_cases i
    · apply subset_adjoin k _
      left
      exact subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)
    · apply subset_adjoin k _
      left
      exact subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)
    · apply subset_adjoin k _
      left
      exact subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)
    · exact subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)
    · exact subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)
    · exact subset_adjoin k _ (by simp)

  dsimp only

name: AclGeom.AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraCoordinates_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem algebraCoordinates_apply {k : Type u} {C : Type v} [Field k] [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
    {n : ℕ} (f : CoordinateRing k n →ₐ[k] C) (i : Fin n) :
    algebraCoordinates k n C f i =
      f (SymmetricAlgebra.ι k (Fin n → k) (Pi.basisFun k (Fin n) i))
proof:
:= by
  change (SymmetricAlgebra.lift.symm f) (Pi.basisFun k (Fin n) i) = _
  have h := SymmetricAlgebra.lift_comp_ι (SymmetricAlgebra.lift.symm f)
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
  exact (LinearMap.congr_fun h (Pi.basisFun k (Fin n) i)).symm

theorem algebraCoordinates_symm_apply_ι {k : Type u} {C : Type v} [Field k] [CommRing C]
    [Algebra k C] {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → C) (i : Fin n) :
    (algebraCoordinates k n C).symm v
      (SymmetricAlgebra.ι k (Fin n → k) (Pi.basisFun k (Fin n) i)) = v i
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrFun ((algebraCoordinates k n C).apply_symm_apply v) i
  rw [algebraCoordinates_apply] at h
  exact h

    ((pointsMulEquiv k n).symm (Multiplicative.ofAdd v)).left =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((algebraCoordinates k n k).symm v).toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  change ((hopfPointsMulEquiv k (CoordinateRing k n)).symm
    (WithConv.toConv ((algebraCoordinates k n k).symm v))).left = _
  exact hopfPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_left k (CoordinateRing k n) _

name: AclGeom.GroupScheme.rightMul_eq_leftMul
statement:
theorem rightMul_eq_leftMul {k : Type u} [Field k] {G : Over (Spec (.of k))} [GrpObj G]
    [IsCommMonObj G] (g : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G) : rightMul G g = leftMul G g
proof:
:= by
  change 𝟙 G * (toUnit G ≫ g) = (toUnit G ≫ g) * 𝟙 G
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: AclGeom.curveCoset_of_genericProduct_commutative
statement:
theorem curveCoset_of_genericProduct_commutative {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (G : AlgebraicGroup k) [IsCommMonObj G.toGroupScheme.X] {A B D : Set G.carrier}
    (hA : IsClosed A) (hAi : IsIrreducible A) (hAd : topologicalKrullDim A = 1)
    (hB : IsClosed B) (hBi : IsIrreducible B) (hBd : topologicalKrullDim B = 1)
    (hD : IsClosed D) (hDi : IsIrreducible D) (hDd : topologicalKrullDim D = 1)
    (hgen : ∃ ξ : (reducedOver G.toGroupScheme.X ⟨A, hA⟩ ⊗
        reducedOver G.toGroupScheme.X ⟨B, hB⟩).left,
      closure {ξ} = Set.univ ∧
        ((reducedOverι G.toGroupScheme.X ⟨A, hA⟩ ⊗ₘ
          reducedOverι G.toGroupScheme.X ⟨B, hB⟩) ≫ μ[G.toGroupScheme.X]).left ξ ∈ D) :
    ∃ (H : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k) (inclusion : H.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom G)
        (g₁ g₂ : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X),
      IsClosedImmersion inclusion.schemeHom ∧ topologicalKrullDim H.toAlgebraicGroup.carrier = 1 ∧
      A = leftMulHomeo g₁ '' Set.range inclusion.schemeHom ∧
      B = leftMulHomeo g₂ '' Set.range inclusion.schemeHom ∧
      D = leftMulHomeo (g₁ * g₂) '' Set.range inclusion.schemeHom
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨H, inclusion, g₁, g₂, hclosed, hdim, hAH, hBH, hDH⟩ :=
    curveCoset_of_genericProduct G hA hAi hAd hB hBi hBd hD hDi hDd hgen
  have hRL : ∀ x, rightMulHomeo g₂ x = leftMulHomeo g₂ x := fun x ↦ by
    rw [rightMulHomeo_apply, leftMulHomeo_apply, rightMul_eq_leftMul]
  have hR : ∀ Z : Set G.carrier, rightMulHomeo g₂ '' Z = leftMulHomeo g₂ '' Z := fun Z ↦
    Set.image_congr fun x _ ↦ hRL x
  have hLL : ∀ Z : Set G.carrier,
      leftMulHomeo g₁ '' (leftMulHomeo g₂ '' Z) = leftMulHomeo (g₁ * g₂) '' Z := fun Z ↦ by
    rw [Set.image_image]
    refine Set.image_congr fun x _ ↦ ?_
    rw [leftMulHomeo_apply, leftMulHomeo_apply, leftMulHomeo_apply, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply,
      ← Over.comp_left, leftMul_comp_leftMul]
  refine ⟨H, inclusion, g₁, g₂, hclosed, hdim, hAH, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hBH, hR]
  · rw [hDH, hR, hLL]

name: AclGeom.AffineGroupScheme.eval_injective_of_algebraicIndependent
statement:
theorem eval_injective_of_algebraicIndependent {k C : Type*} [Field k] [Field C]
    [Algebra k C] (a : Cˣ) (b : C)
    (hab : AlgebraicIndependent k (![(a : C), b] : Fin 2 → C)) :
    Function.Injective (eval k a b)
proof:
:= by
  let P := MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k
  let x : P := MvPolynomial.X 0
  let y : P := MvPolynomial.X 1
  let Q := Localization.Away x
  let γ : P →ₐ[k] CoordinateRing k :=
    MvPolynomial.aeval (![(dilationUnit k : CoordinateRing k), translation k])
  have hxQ : IsUnit (algebraMap P Q x) := IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit x
  let xu : Qˣ := hxQ.unit
  let δ : CoordinateRing k →ₐ[k] Q := eval k xu (algebraMap P Q y)
  have hxγ : IsUnit (γ x) := by
    simpa only [γ, x, P, MvPolynomial.aeval_X, Matrix.cons_val_zero] using (dilationUnit k).isUnit
  let η : Q →ₐ[k] CoordinateRing k := IsLocalization.Away.liftAlgHom x (f := γ) hxγ
  have hη (z : P) : η (algebraMap P Q z) = γ z :=
    IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq x (g := γ.toRingHom) hxγ z
  have hleft : η.comp δ = AlgHom.id k (CoordinateRing k) := by
    apply hom_ext
    · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, δ, eval_dilation, xu, hxQ.unit_spec,
        hη, γ, x, P, MvPolynomial.aeval_X, Matrix.cons_val_zero, AlgHom.id_apply]
    · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, δ, eval_translation, hη, γ, y, P,
        MvPolynomial.aeval_X, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero, AlgHom.id_apply]
  let ψ : P →ₐ[k] C := MvPolynomial.aeval (![(a : C), b])
  have hψ : Function.Injective ψ := algebraicIndependent_iff_injective_aeval.mp hab
  have hxψ : IsUnit (ψ x) := by
    simpa only [ψ, x, P, MvPolynomial.aeval_X, Matrix.cons_val_zero] using a.isUnit
  let μ : Q →ₐ[k] C := IsLocalization.Away.liftAlgHom x (f := ψ) hxψ
  have hμ (z : P) : μ (algebraMap P Q z) = ψ z :=
    IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq x (g := ψ.toRingHom) hxψ z
  have hμinj : Function.Injective μ := by
    apply (IsLocalization.injective_iff_map_algebraMap_eq (Submonoid.powers x) μ.toRingHom).mpr
    intro z w
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact congrArg μ h
    · intro h
      exact congrArg (algebraMap P Q) (hψ ((hμ z).symm.trans (h.trans (hμ w))))
  have hμδ : μ.comp δ = eval k a b := by
    apply hom_ext
    · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, δ, eval_dilation, xu, hxQ.unit_spec,
        hμ, ψ, x, P, MvPolynomial.aeval_X, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
    · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, δ, eval_translation, hμ, ψ, y, P,
        MvPolynomial.aeval_X, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
  intro v w hvw
  have hd : δ v = δ w := hμinj (by
    change (μ.comp δ) v = (μ.comp δ) w
    rw [hμδ]
    exact hvw)
  have hv := AlgHom.congr_fun hleft v
  have hw := AlgHom.congr_fun hleft w
  exact hv.symm.trans ((congrArg η hd).trans hw)

name: AclGeom.AffineGroupScheme.AclGeom.AffineGroupScheme.exists_chart_coordinates
statement:
theorem exists_chart_coordinates (G : AlgebraicGroup k)
    (f : G.Hom (algebraicGroup k))
    (Φ : (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) →* AffineTransformation k)
    (hpoint : ∀ q, pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom) = Φ q)
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) :
    ∃ ψ : CoordinateRing k →ₐ[k] A,
      (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom ψ).op = g ≫ f.hom.hom ∧
      ∀ φ : A →ₐ[k] k,
        φ (ψ (dilationUnit k)) =
          ((Φ ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
            (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)).multiplier : k) ∧
        φ (ψ (translation k)) =
          (Φ ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
            (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)).shift
proof:
:= by
  have : (algSpec (.of k)).Full := algSpec.instFull
  let m : (algSpec (.of k)).obj (.op (CommAlgCat.of k A)) ⟶
      (algSpec (.of k)).obj (.op (CommAlgCat.of k (CoordinateRing k))) := g ≫ f.hom.hom
  let ψ : CoordinateRing k →ₐ[k] A := ((algSpec (.of k)).preimage m).unop.hom
  have hm : (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom ψ).op = m :=
    (algSpec (.of k)).map_preimage m
  refine ⟨ψ, hm, ?_⟩
  intro φ
  let p := (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
    (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op
  let q := p ≫ g
  have hp : p ≫ m = (pointsMulEquiv k).symm (Φ q) := by
    apply (pointsMulEquiv k).injective
    have hpa : q ≫ f.hom.hom = p ≫ m := Category.assoc p g f.hom.hom
    exact (congrArg (pointsMulEquiv k) hpa.symm).trans
      ((hpoint q).trans ((pointsMulEquiv k).apply_symm_apply (Φ q)).symm)
  have hleft : (p ≫ m).left =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ.toRingHom) := by
    rw [← hm]
    change (𝟙 _ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)) ≫ _ = _
    rw [Category.id_comp]
    rfl
  have hs : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (φ.comp ψ).toRingHom) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (eval k (Φ q).multiplier (Φ q).shift).toRingHom) := by
    have hcomp : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (φ.comp ψ).toRingHom) =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ.toRingHom) :=
      Spec.map_comp (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ.toRingHom) (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)
    have he := congrArg
      (fun r : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ (algebraicGroup k).toGroupScheme.X ↦ r.left) hp
    exact hcomp.trans (hleft.symm.trans (he.trans (pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_left k (Φ q))))
  have he : φ.comp ψ = eval k (Φ q).multiplier (Φ q).shift := by
    apply AlgHom.coe_ringHom_injective
    exact congrArg (fun r : CommRingCat.of (CoordinateRing k) ⟶ CommRingCat.of k ↦ r.hom)
      (Spec.map_injective hs)
  constructor
  · change (φ.comp ψ) (dilationUnit k) = _
    rw [he, eval_dilation]
    exact congrArg (fun z ↦ ((Φ z).multiplier : k))
      (Category.assoc (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom
        ((algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op) g)
  · change (φ.comp ψ) (translation k) = _
    rw [he, eval_translation]
    exact congrArg (fun z ↦ (Φ z).shift)
      (Category.assoc (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom
        ((algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op) g)

name: AclGeom.PrincipalLocalization.genericPoint_mem_awayOpen
statement:
theorem genericPoint_mem_awayOpen (d : A) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    genericPoint (Spec (.of A)) ∈ awayOpen d
proof:
:= by
  apply ((genericPoint_spec (Spec (.of A))).mem_open_set_iff
    (awayOpen d).2).mpr
  rw [Set.univ_inter]
  refine ⟨(⊥ : PrimeSpectrum A), ?_⟩
  change d ∉ (⊥ : Ideal A)
  simpa using hd

name: AclGeom.PrincipalLocalization.genericAwayMap_comp_algebraMap
statement:
theorem genericAwayMap_comp_algebraMap (d : A) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    (genericAwayMap d hd).comp
        (algebraMap A (Localization.Away d)) =
      (StructureSheaf.toStalk A
        (genericPoint (Spec (.of A)))).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hscheme :
      ((awayOpen d).fromSpecStalkOfMem _
          (genericPoint_mem_awayOpen d hd) ≫
          (awayOpenIso d).hom) ≫
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
            (algebraMap A (Localization.Away d))) =
        (Spec (.of A)).fromSpecStalk
          (genericPoint (Spec (.of A))) := by
    rw [Category.assoc]
    rw [show (awayOpenIso d).hom ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap A (Localization.Away d))) =
        (awayOpen d).ι by
      exact basicOpenIsoSpecAway_hom_SpecMap (R := CommRingCat.of A) d]
    exact (awayOpen d).fromSpecStalkOfMem_ι _ _
  have hp := congrArg Spec.preimage hscheme
  rw [Spec.fromSpecStalk_eq'] at hp
  simp only [Spec.preimage_comp] at hp
  have hpre : Spec.preimage (Spec.map
      (StructureSheaf.toStalk A
        (genericPoint (Spec (.of A))))) =
      StructureSheaf.toStalk A
        (genericPoint (Spec (.of A))) :=
    Spec.preimage_map _
  have hp2 := hp.trans hpre
  have hpreAlg : Spec.preimage (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap A (Localization.Away d)))) =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (Localization.Away d)) :=
    Spec.preimage_map _
  have hp3 := (congrArg (fun q ↦ q ≫ Spec.preimage
      ((awayOpen d).fromSpecStalkOfMem _
        (genericPoint_mem_awayOpen d hd) ≫ (awayOpenIso d).hom))
      hpreAlg.symm).trans hp2
  have hp' := congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom hp3
  simp only [CommRingCat.hom_comp, CommRingCat.hom_ofHom] at hp'
  unfold genericAwayMap
  exact hp'

name: AclGeom.PrincipalLocalization.genericAwayMap_eq_mapToFractionRing
statement:
theorem genericAwayMap_eq_mapToFractionRing (d : A) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    letI : Algebra A (Spec (.of A)).functionField
proof:
:=
      AlgebraicGeometry.instAlgebraCarrierFunctionFieldSpec (.of A)
    letI : IsFractionRing A (Spec (.of A)).functionField :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.functionField_isFractionRing_of_affine (.of A)
    genericAwayMap d hd =
      (Localization.mapToFractionRing ((Spec (.of A)).functionField)
        (Submonoid.powers d) (Localization.Away d)
        (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors hd)).toRingHom := by
  letI : Algebra A (Spec (.of A)).functionField :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.instAlgebraCarrierFunctionFieldSpec (.of A)
  letI : IsFractionRing A (Spec (.of A)).functionField :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.functionField_isFractionRing_of_affine (.of A)
  apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers d)
  rw [genericAwayMap_comp_algebraMap]
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro z
  change algebraMap A (Spec (.of A)).functionField z = _
  exact ((Localization.mapToFractionRing ((Spec (.of A)).functionField)
    (Submonoid.powers d) (Localization.Away d)
    (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors hd))).commutes z |>.symm

name: AclGeom.PrincipalLocalization.partialMap_fromFunctionField_eq
statement:
theorem partialMap_fromFunctionField_eq (d : A) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (φ : B →+* Localization.Away d) (hφ : Function.Injective φ) :
    (partialMap d hd φ hφ).fromFunctionField =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ((genericAwayMap d hd).comp φ))
proof:
:= by
  unfold Scheme.PartialMap.fromFunctionField
    Scheme.PartialMap.fromSpecStalkOfMem partialMap
  change (awayOpen d).fromSpecStalkOfMem _ _ ≫
      ((awayOpenIso d).hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) = _
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  rw [← Spec.map_preimage ((awayOpen d).fromSpecStalkOfMem _ _ ≫
    (awayOpenIso d).hom)]
  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: AclGeom.PrincipalLocalization.CommonDenominator.denominator_mem
statement: theorem denominator_mem (x : K) : denominator (R := R) x ∈ R⁰
proof:
:=
  (IsFractionRing.div_surjective R x).choose_spec.choose_spec.1

name: AclGeom.PrincipalLocalization.CommonDenominator.fraction_eq
statement:
theorem fraction_eq (x : K) :
    algebraMap R K (numerator (R := R) x) /
      algebraMap R K (denominator (R := R) x) = x
proof:
:=
  (IsFractionRing.div_surjective R x).choose_spec.choose_spec.2

name: AclGeom.PrincipalLocalization.CommonDenominator.common_ne_zero
statement: theorem common_ne_zero (x : ι → K) : common (R := R) x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro i hi
  exact mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mp (denominator_mem (R := R) (x i))

name: AclGeom.PrincipalLocalization.CommonDenominator.mem_localization
statement:
theorem mem_localization (x : ι → K) (i : ι) :
    x i ∈ Localization.subalgebra.ofField K
      (Submonoid.powers (common (R := R) x))
      (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors
        (common_ne_zero (R := R) x))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let q : R := ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, denominator (R := R) (x j)
  let d := common (R := R) x
  let n := numerator (R := R) (x i)
  let s := denominator (R := R) (x i)
  have hs : s ≠ 0 :=
    mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mp (denominator_mem (R := R) (x i))
  have hq : q ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [q]
    apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
    intro j hj
    exact mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mp (denominator_mem (R := R) (x j))
  have hd : d = s * q := by
    dsimp [d, s, q, common]
    symm
    exact Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ
      (fun j ↦ denominator (R := R) (x j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  change ∃ (a t : R) (_ : t ∈ Submonoid.powers d),
    x i = algebraMap R K a * (algebraMap R K t)⁻¹
  refine ⟨n * q, d, Submonoid.mem_powers d, ?_⟩
  rw [← fraction_eq (R := R) (x i)]
  dsimp [n, s]
  rw [map_mul, hd, map_mul]
  have hsK : algebraMap R K s ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hs
    exact IsFractionRing.injective R K (by simpa using h)
  have hqK : algebraMap R K q ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hq
    exact IsFractionRing.injective R K (by simpa using h)
  field_simp [hsK, hqK]
  simp [s, hsK]

name: AclGeom.PrincipalLocalization.awayAlgHomOfGenerators_mapToFractionRing
statement:
theorem awayAlgHomOfGenerators_mapToFractionRing
    (b : ι → B) (hb : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range b) = ⊤)
    (φ : B →ₐ[k] K) (z : B) :
    let x : ι → K
proof:
:= fun i ↦ φ (b i)
    let d : A := CommonDenominator.common (R := A) x
    let hd : d ≠ 0 := CommonDenominator.common_ne_zero (R := A) x
    Localization.mapToFractionRing K (Submonoid.powers d)
      (Localization.Away d)
      (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors hd)
      (awayAlgHomOfGenerators (A := A) b hb φ z) = φ z := by
  let x : ι → K := fun i ↦ φ (b i)
  let d : A := CommonDenominator.common (R := A) x
  let hd : d ≠ 0 := CommonDenominator.common_ne_zero (R := A) x
  let hS : Submonoid.powers d ≤ A⁰ :=
    powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors hd
  let S : Subalgebra A K :=
    Localization.subalgebra.ofField K (Submonoid.powers d) hS
  let Sk : Subalgebra k K := S.restrictScalars k
  have hall (z : B) : φ z ∈ Sk := by
    have hgen (i : ι) : φ (b i) ∈ Sk := by
      exact CommonDenominator.mem_localization (R := A) x i
    have hle : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range b) ≤ Sk.comap φ := by
      apply Algebra.adjoin_le
      rintro z ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact hgen i
    rw [hb] at hle
    exact hle (Set.mem_univ z)
  let ψS : B →ₐ[k] Sk := φ.codRestrict Sk hall
  let eA : Localization.Away d ≃ₐ[A] S :=
    IsLocalization.algEquiv (Submonoid.powers d) _ _
  let e : Localization.Away d ≃ₐ[k] Sk := eA.restrictScalars k
  change Localization.mapToFractionRing K (Submonoid.powers d)
      (Localization.Away d) hS (e.symm (ψS z)) = φ z
  have hmaps :
      Localization.mapToFractionRing K (Submonoid.powers d)
          (Localization.Away d) hS =
        (Subalgebra.val S).comp eA.toAlgHom :=
    (IsLocalization.algHom_subsingleton (Submonoid.powers d)).elim _ _
  rw [AlgHom.congr_fun hmaps]
  change ((e (e.symm (ψS z)) : Sk) : K) = φ z
  rw [e.apply_symm_apply]
  rfl

name: AclGeom.PrincipalLocalization.awayAlgHomOfGenerators_injective
statement:
theorem awayAlgHomOfGenerators_injective
    (b : ι → B) (hb : Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range b) = ⊤)
    (φ : B →ₐ[k] K) (hφ : Function.Injective φ) :
    Function.Injective (awayAlgHomOfGenerators (A := A) b hb φ)
proof:
:= by
  intro z w hzw
  apply hφ
  let x : ι → K := fun i ↦ φ (b i)
  let d : A := CommonDenominator.common (R := A) x
  let hd : d ≠ 0 := CommonDenominator.common_ne_zero (R := A) x
  let F := Localization.mapToFractionRing K (Submonoid.powers d)
    (Localization.Away d)
    (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors hd)
  have h := congr_arg F hzw
  calc
    φ z = F (awayAlgHomOfGenerators (A := A) b hb φ z) := by
      exact (awayAlgHomOfGenerators_mapToFractionRing
        (A := A) b hb φ z).symm
    _ = F (awayAlgHomOfGenerators (A := A) b hb φ w) := h
    _ = φ w := by
      exact awayAlgHomOfGenerators_mapToFractionRing
        (A := A) b hb φ w

name: AclGeom.SchemeAffineTranslations.exists_subgroup_translation_coordinate
statement:
theorem exists_subgroup_translation_coordinate
    (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (hker : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
      ModObj.pointAct V q = 𝟙 V → q = 1)
    (hdimG : (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDim G.toAlgebraicGroup.carrier)
    (hdimV : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1)
    (i : (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).Hom G.toAlgebraicGroup)
    [Mono i.hom.hom] :
    ∃ t : V.left.functionField, Transcendental k t ∧
      IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set V.left.functionField) = ⊤ ∧
      ∃ Φ : (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) →* AffineTransformation k,
        Function.Injective Φ ∧
        (∀ q, (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V q).unop t =
          algebraMap k V.left.functionField ((Φ q).multiplier : k) * t +
            algebraMap k V.left.functionField (Φ q).shift) ∧
      ∃ f : G.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k),
        Function.Injective (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X ↦
          q ≫ f.hom.hom) ∧
        (∀ q, AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom) = Φ q) ∧
      ∃ β : (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).Hom (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1),
        β.hom.hom ≫ (groupInclusion k).hom.hom = i.hom.hom ≫ f.hom.hom ∧
        Function.Injective (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶
          (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X ↦ q ≫ β.hom.hom) ∧
        IsFinite β.hom.hom.left ∧ Surjective β.hom.hom.left ∧
      ∃ p : Polynomial k, Polynomial.eval 0 p = 0 ∧ p.natDegree ≠ 0 ∧
        (∀ (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra k C] (b : C),
          AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k b ≫ β.hom.hom =
            AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (Polynomial.aeval b p)) ∧
        (∀ (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra k C] (x y : C),
          Polynomial.aeval (x + y) p = Polynomial.aeval x p + Polynomial.aeval y p) ∧
        ∀ b : k,
          (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V
            ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k b ≫ i.hom.hom)).unop t =
              t + algebraMap k V.left.functionField (Polynomial.eval b p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htop, Φ, hΦinj, hΦ, f, hfinj, hpoint, _⟩ :=
    SchemeAffineMorphism.exists_affine_morphism G V hker hdimG hdimV
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := exists_group_factor k (i ≫ f)
  change β.hom.hom ≫ inclusion k = i.hom.hom ≫ f.hom.hom at hβ
  have hβinj : Function.Injective (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶
      (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X ↦ q ≫ β.hom.hom) := by
    intro q r hqr
    change q ≫ β.hom.hom = r ≫ β.hom.hom at hqr
    apply (cancel_mono i.hom.hom).mp
    apply hfinj
    change (q ≫ i.hom.hom) ≫ f.hom.hom = (r ≫ i.hom.hom) ≫ f.hom.hom
    rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ← hβ, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, hqr]
  have hq₁ : (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (1 : k) ≠
      (1 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶
        (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X) := by
    intro h
    have hz : (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (0 : k) = 1 := by
      rw [linePoint_zero, comp_one]
    exact one_ne_zero (AffineSchemeAction.linePoint_injective k
      ((cancel_epi (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom).mp (h.trans hz.symm)))
  obtain ⟨p, hp₀, hp, hβfin, hβsurj, hpoly, hadd⟩ := exists_finite_coordinate k β
    ⟨(unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (1 : k), fun h ↦ by
      apply hq₁
      apply hβinj
      change ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (1 : k)) ≫
        β.hom.hom = (1 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶
          (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X) ≫ β.hom.hom
      rw [h, one_comp]⟩
  have htranslation (c : k) : (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k 1 c =
      (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k).symm (AffineTransformation.translation c) := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    change 𝟙 _ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineGroupScheme.eval k 1 c).toRingHom) = _
    rw [Category.id_comp]
    exact (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_left k
      (AffineTransformation.translation c)).symm
  refine ⟨t, ht, htop, Φ, hΦinj, hΦ, f, hfinj, hpoint, β, hβ, hβinj,
    hβfin, hβsurj, p, hp₀, hp, hpoly, hadd, ?_⟩
  intro b
  let q := (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k b
  have himage : (q ≫ i.hom.hom) ≫ f.hom.hom =
      (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k 1 (Polynomial.eval b p) := by
    rw [Category.assoc, ← hβ, ← Category.assoc]
    change ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k b) ≫
      β.hom.hom ≫ inclusion k = _
    rw [Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc _ β.hom.hom, hpoly k b,
      linePoint_comp_inclusion]
    simp only [Polynomial.aeval_def, Algebra.algebraMap_self, Polynomial.eval₂_id]
  have hΦq : Φ (q ≫ i.hom.hom) = AffineTransformation.translation (Polynomial.eval b p) := by
    apply (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k).symm.injective
    rw [← hpoint, MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply, himage, htranslation]
  change (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V
    (q ≫ i.hom.hom)).unop t = _
  rw [hΦ, hΦq, AffineTransformation.translation_multiplier,
    AffineTransformation.translation_shift, Units.val_one, map_one, _root_.one_mul]

name: AclGeom.isPrincipalIdealRing_of_isLocalization
statement:
theorem isPrincipalIdealRing_of_isLocalization {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra R S] (M : Submonoid R) [IsLocalization M S] [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] :
    IsPrincipalIdealRing S where
  principal I
proof:
:= by
    refine ⟨⟨algebraMap R S (Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator (I.under R)), ?_⟩⟩
    calc
      I = Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) (I.under R) := (IsLocalization.map_under M S I).symm
      _ = Ideal.map (algebraMap R S)
          (Ideal.span {Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator (I.under R)}) := by
        rw [Ideal.span_singleton_generator]
      _ = Ideal.span {algebraMap R S (Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator (I.under R))} := by
        rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]

name: AclGeom.multiplicativeCoordinate_isPrincipal
statement:
theorem multiplicativeCoordinate_isPrincipal (k : Type u) [Field k] :
    IsPrincipalIdealRing (AddMonoidAlgebra k ℤ)
proof:
:=
  isPrincipalIdealRing_of_isLocalization
    (S := LaurentPolynomial k) (Submonoid.powers (Polynomial.X : Polynomial k))

name: AclGeom.multiplicativeCoordinate_not_isField
statement:
theorem multiplicativeCoordinate_not_isField (k : Type u) [Field k] :
    ¬ IsField (AddMonoidAlgebra k ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  let := h.toField
  let f := ((unitsMulEquivConv k k).symm (1 : kˣ)).ofConv
  have heq : f (AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 1) = f 1 := by
    rw [unitsMulEquivConv_symm_apply_single, map_one]
    rfl
  have hbad := f.toRingHom.injective heq
  have hcoeff := congrArg (fun p : AddMonoidAlgebra k ℤ ↦ p.coeff (1 : ℤ)) hbad
  change (Finsupp.single (1 : ℤ) (1 : k)) 1 = (Finsupp.single (0 : ℤ) (1 : k)) 1 at hcoeff
  norm_num [Finsupp.single_apply] at hcoeff

name: AclGeom.multiplicativeCoordinate_dimension
statement:
theorem multiplicativeCoordinate_dimension (k : Type u) [Field k] :
    ringKrullDim (AddMonoidAlgebra k ℤ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have := multiplicativeCoordinate_isPrincipal k
  exact IsPrincipalIdealRing.ringKrullDim_eq_one _ (multiplicativeCoordinate_not_isField k)

name: AclGeom.additiveGroup_dimension
statement:
theorem additiveGroup_dimension (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
    topologicalKrullDim (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k n).carrier = n
proof:
:= by
  change topologicalKrullDim (PrimeSpectrum (AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k n)) = _
  rw [PrimeSpectrum.topologicalKrullDim_eq_ringKrullDim,
    ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv
      (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial (Pi.basisFun k (Fin n))).toRingEquiv,
    MvPolynomial.ringKrullDim_of_isNoetherianRing, ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_field]
  simp

name: AclGeom.multiplicativeGroup_dimension
statement:
theorem multiplicativeGroup_dimension (k : Type u) [Field k] :
    topologicalKrullDim (multiplicativeGroup k).carrier = 1
proof:
:= by
  change topologicalKrullDim (PrimeSpectrum (AddMonoidAlgebra k ℤ)) = 1
  rw [PrimeSpectrum.topologicalKrullDim_eq_ringKrullDim]
  exact multiplicativeCoordinate_dimension k

name: AclGeom.AffineGroupScheme.dimension
statement:
theorem dimension (k : Type u) [Field k] :
    topologicalKrullDim (algebraicGroup k).carrier = 2
proof:
:= by
  have := multiplicativeCoordinate_isPrincipal k
  change topologicalKrullDim (PrimeSpectrum (CoordinateRing k)) = 2
  rw [PrimeSpectrum.topologicalKrullDim_eq_ringKrullDim,
    ringKrullDim_eq_of_ringEquiv (polynomialEquiv k).toRingEquiv,
    MvPolynomial.ringKrullDim_of_isNoetherianRing, multiplicativeCoordinate_dimension]
  norm_num

name: AclGeom.AdditiveOrbit.point_comp_orbitMap
statement:
theorem point_comp_orbitMap (i : N ⟶ M) (p : 𝟙_ C ⟶ X) (q : 𝟙_ C ⟶ N) :
    q ≫ orbitMap i p = p ≫ ModObj.pointAct X (q ≫ i)
proof:
:= by
  change q ≫ (i • (toUnit N ≫ p)) = p ≫ ((toUnit X ≫ (q ≫ i)) • 𝟙 X)
  simp only [ModObj.comp_smul, Category.comp_id]
  simp only [← Category.assoc, comp_toUnit, toUnit_unit, Category.id_comp]

name: AclGeom.AdditiveOrbit.mul_comp_orbitMap
statement:
theorem mul_comp_orbitMap [MonObj N] (i : N ⟶ M) [IsMonHom i] (p : 𝟙_ C ⟶ X) :
    μ[N] ≫ orbitMap i p =
      lift (fst N N ≫ i) (snd N N ≫ orbitMap i p) ≫ γ[M, X]
proof:
:= by
  have hmul : μ[N] ≫ i = (fst N N ≫ i) * (snd N N ≫ i) := by
    rw [IsMonHom.mul_hom, Hom.mul_def, lift_fst_comp_snd_comp]
  change μ[N] ≫ (i • (toUnit N ≫ p)) =
    (fst N N ≫ i) • (snd N N ≫ (i • (toUnit N ≫ p)))
  rw [ModObj.comp_smul, ModObj.comp_smul, hmul]
  simp only [← Category.assoc, comp_toUnit]
  exact mul_smul _ _ _

name: AclGeom.hopfPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_left
statement:
theorem hopfPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_left (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [HopfAlgebra R S]
    (f : S →ₐ[R] R) :
    ((hopfPointsMulEquiv R S).symm (WithConv.toConv f)).left =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  change 𝟙 _ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom) = _
  rw [Category.id_comp]

name: AclGeom.AdditiveTranslation.exists_group_factor
statement:
theorem exists_group_factor
    (h : (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).Hom (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k)) :
    ∃ β : (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).Hom (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1),
      β.hom.hom ≫ inclusion k = h.hom.hom
proof:
:= by
  let R := AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1
  let N := (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X
  let A := (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k).toGroupScheme.X
  let P := polynomialCoordinates k
  obtain ⟨u, z, huz⟩ := AffineSchemeAction.exists_groupPoint k h.hom.hom
  have hp₀ : AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (0 : k) ≫
      AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k u z = AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k 1 (0 : k) := by
    rw [huz, linePoint_zero, one_comp, AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint_one]
  rw [linePoint_comp_groupPoint] at hp₀
  have hmaps := (Spec.mapMulEquiv (R := k) (S := AffineGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k)
    (T := k)).injective hp₀
  have hvalue := congrArg (fun f : WithConv (AffineGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k →ₐ[k] k) ↦
    f.ofConv (AffineGroupScheme.dilationUnit k)) hmaps
  simp only [AffineGroupScheme.eval_dilation, Units.coe_map, Units.val_one] at hvalue
  have hu : IsUnit (P (u : R)) := u.isUnit.map P.toRingHom
  obtain ⟨a, _, ha⟩ := Polynomial.isUnit_iff.mp hu
  have ha₁ : a = 1 := by
    have hh := congrArg (Polynomial.aeval (0 : k)) ha
    rw [Polynomial.aeval_C] at hh
    exact hh.trans ((lineEval_polynomialCoordinates k 0 (u : R)).symm.trans hvalue)
  have hu₁ : u = 1 := by
    apply Units.ext
    apply P.injective
    rw [← ha, ha₁, Polynomial.C_1, Units.val_one, map_one]
  rw [hu₁] at huz
  let β : N ⟶ N := AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k z
  have hfactor : β ≫ inclusion k = h.hom.hom :=
    (linePoint_comp_inclusion k z).trans huz
  have : IsMonHom β := by
    constructor
    · apply (cancel_mono (inclusion k)).mp
      simp only [Category.assoc, hfactor, IsMonHom.one_hom]
    · apply (cancel_mono (inclusion k)).mp
      calc
        (μ[N] ≫ β) ≫ inclusion k = μ[N] ≫ h.hom.hom := by
          rw [Category.assoc, hfactor]
        _ = (h.hom.hom ⊗ₘ h.hom.hom) ≫ μ[A] := IsMonHom.mul_hom _
        _ = ((β ≫ inclusion k) ⊗ₘ (β ≫ inclusion k)) ≫ μ[A] := by rw [hfactor]
        _ = (β ⊗ₘ β) ≫ (inclusion k ⊗ₘ inclusion k) ≫ μ[A] := by
          rw [← MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_comp_tensorHom, Category.assoc]
        _ = ((β ⊗ₘ β) ≫ μ[N]) ≫ inclusion k := by
          rw [Category.assoc, IsMonHom.mul_hom]
  exact ⟨Grp.homMk β, hfactor⟩

name: AclGeom.exists_isAffineOpen_dimension_ge
statement:
theorem exists_isAffineOpen_dimension_ge (X : Scheme) (n : ℕ)
    (hX : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDim X) :
    ∃ U : X.Opens, IsAffineOpen U ∧ Nonempty U ∧
      (n : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDim U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Order.le_krullDim_iff.mp hX
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := p.head.isIrreducible.nonempty
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hxU, _⟩ := exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset
    (show x ∈ (⊤ : X.Opens) from trivial)
  let e := IrreducibleCloseds.orderIsoOfIsOpenEmbedding
    (Subtype.val : U → X) U.isOpenEmbedding
  let q : Fin (p.length + 1) →
      {Z : IrreducibleCloseds X | ((Subtype.val : U → X) ⁻¹' Z).Nonempty} :=
    fun i ↦ ⟨p i, ⟨⟨x, hxU⟩, (p.head_le i) hx⟩⟩
  have hq : StrictMono q := fun _ _ hij ↦ p.strictMono hij
  let r : LTSeries (IrreducibleCloseds U) :=
    LTSeries.mk p.length (fun i ↦ e.symm (q i)) (e.symm.strictMono.comp hq)
  refine ⟨U, hU, ⟨⟨x, hxU⟩⟩, ?_⟩
  change (n : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ Order.krullDim (IrreducibleCloseds U)
  calc
    (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = r.length := by
      change (n : WithBot ℕ∞) = (p.length : WithBot ℕ∞)
      rw [hp]
    _ ≤ _ := Order.LTSeries.length_le_krullDim r

name: AclGeom.SchemeGenericTranslate.isAlgebraic_of_faithful_coefficients
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_of_faithful_coefficients
    {G : Over (Spec (.of k))} [GrpObj G]
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsAffine V.left] [ModObj G V]
    (hker : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G,
      ModObj.pointAct V q = 𝟙 V → q = 1)
    {A C : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A]
    [Field C] [Algebra k C] [Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower k A C] [IsFractionRing A C]
    (g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G) [Mono g]
    (s : Finset Γ(V.left, ⊤)) (hs : Algebra.adjoin k (s : Set Γ(V.left, ⊤)) = ⊤)
    {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → Γ(V.left, ⊤)) (cA : Bool → s → Fin n → A)
    (hc : ∀ (φ : A →ₐ[k] k) (i : s),
      sectionsTensorAut V ((algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)
        (1 ⊗ₜ[k] (i : Γ(V.left, ⊤))) = ∑ j, φ (cA true i j) ⊗ₜ[k] v j)
    (C0 : IntermediateField k C)
    (hmem : ∀ (e : Bool) (i : s) (j : Fin n), algebraMap A C (cA e i j) ∈ C0) :
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic C0 C
proof:
:= by
  let B := Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range fun p : Bool × s × Fin n ↦ cA p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)
  let φ : A →ₐ[k] C := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A C
  have hle : B ≤ C0.toSubalgebra.comap φ := by
    apply Algebra.adjoin_le
    rintro a ⟨p, rfl⟩
    exact hmem p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2
  let f : B →ₐ[k] C0 :=
    (φ.comp B.val).codRestrict C0.toSubalgebra (fun b ↦ hle b.property)
  let : Algebra B C0 := f.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower B C0 C := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun _ ↦ rfl)
  exact isAlgebraic_fractionRing_of_injective_points
    (coefficient_points_injective V hker g s hs v cA hc)

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.aeval_curveEquationOverSourceField
statement:
theorem aeval_curveEquationOverSourceField :
    MvPolynomial.aeval
        ![P.sourceInBranchOverSource, P.targetInBranchOverSource]
        P.curveEquationOverSourceField = 0
proof:
:= by
  let q : Fin 2 → P.branchOverSource :=
    ![P.sourceInBranchOverSource, P.targetInBranchOverSource]
  let v := P.branchOverSource.val
  have hq : (fun i ↦ v (q i)) = (![P.source, P.target] : Fin 2 → Ω) := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  apply v.injective
  change v (MvPolynomial.aeval q P.curveEquationOverSourceField) = v 0
  calc
    v (MvPolynomial.aeval q P.curveEquationOverSourceField) =
        MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i ↦ v (q i))
          P.curveEquationOverSourceField :=
      MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply (f := q) v
        P.curveEquationOverSourceField
    _ = MvPolynomial.aeval ![P.source, P.target]
        P.curveEquationOverSourceField := by rw [hq]
    _ = 0 := by
      rw [curveEquationOverSourceField,
        MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap, P.aeval_curveEquation]
    _ = v 0 := by rw [map_zero]

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.aeval_curveEquation_inBranchOverSource
statement:
theorem aeval_curveEquation_inBranchOverSource :

    MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap] at h
  exact h

    funext i

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.aeval_curveEquationOverSourceField_map_aut

statement:

theorem parameterField_map {Ω' : Type*} [Field Ω'] [Algebra k Ω']

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember.coe_parameterMapEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_parameterMapEquiv_apply
    {Ω' : Type*} [Field Ω'] [Algebra k Ω'] (σ : Ω →ₐ[k] Ω')

@[simp] theorem parameterMapEquiv_apply

          IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _ (Set.mem_range_self i)⟩ =

proof:
:= by
