name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember.toPair_ideal_map_parameterMapEquiv
statement:
theorem toPair_ideal_map_parameterMapEquiv
    {Ω' : Type*} [Field Ω'] [Algebra k Ω'] (σ : Ω →ₐ[k] Ω') :
    Ideal.map
        (MvPolynomial.mapAlgEquiv (Fin 2)
          (F.parameterMapEquiv σ)).toRingEquiv
        F.toPair.ideal =
      (F.map σ).toPair.ideal
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let ep := F.parameterMapEquiv σ
  have heval (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) F.parameterField) :
      σ (MvPolynomial.aeval ![F.source, F.target] f) =
        MvPolynomial.aeval ![σ F.source, σ F.target]
          (MvPolynomial.map ep.toRingHom f) := by
    induction f using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
    | C z =>
        simp only [MvPolynomial.map_C, MvPolynomial.aeval_C]
        rfl
    | add f g hf hg => simp only [map_add, hf, hg]
    | mul_X f i hf =>
        simp only [map_mul, MvPolynomial.map_X, MvPolynomial.aeval_X, hf]
        fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hmem (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) F.parameterField) :
      MvPolynomial.map ep.toRingHom f ∈ (F.map σ).toPair.ideal ↔
        f ∈ F.toPair.ideal := by
    change MvPolynomial.map ep.toRingHom f ∈
        idealOf (↥(F.map σ).parameterField)
          ![σ F.source, σ F.target] ↔
      f ∈ idealOf (↥F.parameterField) ![F.source, F.target]
    rw [mem_idealOf_iff, mem_idealOf_iff, ← heval]
    constructor
    · intro hz
      exact σ.injective (hz.trans (map_zero σ).symm)
    · intro hz
      rw [hz, map_zero]
  let em : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) F.parameterField ≃+*
      MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (F.map σ).parameterField :=
    (MvPolynomial.mapAlgEquiv (Fin 2) ep).toRingEquiv
  ext g
  constructor
  · intro hg
    obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := (Ideal.mem_map_of_equiv em g).mp hg
    exact (hmem f).2 hf
  · intro hg
    refine (Ideal.mem_map_of_equiv em g).2
      ⟨em.symm g, ?_, em.apply_symm_apply g⟩
    have hm : MvPolynomial.map ep.toRingHom (em.symm g) = g :=
      em.apply_symm_apply g
    rw [← hm] at hg
    exact (hmem (em.symm g)).1 hg

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember.curveEquation_map_parameterMapEquiv
statement:
theorem curveEquation_map_parameterMapEquiv
    {Ω' : Type*} [Field Ω'] [Algebra k Ω'] (σ : Ω →ₐ[k] Ω') :
    MvPolynomial.map (F.parameterMapEquiv σ).toRingHom
        F.toPair.curveEquation =
      (F.map σ).toPair.curveEquation
proof:
:= by
  let ep := F.parameterMapEquiv σ
  change MvPolynomial.map ep.toRingHom F.toPair.curveEquation =
    (F.map σ).toPair.curveEquation
  have hmonic : MonomialOrder.lex.Monic
      (MvPolynomial.map ep.toRingHom F.toPair.curveEquation) := by
    have hs :
        (MvPolynomial.map ep.toRingHom F.toPair.curveEquation).support =
          F.toPair.curveEquation.support :=
      MvPolynomial.support_map_of_injective _ ep.injective
    rw [MonomialOrder.Monic, MonomialOrder.leadingCoeff,
      MonomialOrder.degree, hs, MvPolynomial.coeff_map]
    change ep.toRingHom
        (MonomialOrder.lex.leadingCoeff F.toPair.curveEquation) = 1
    rw [F.toPair.curveEquation_monic.leadingCoeff_eq_one, map_one]
  apply FiniteCorrespondencePair.eq_of_monic_of_associated
    hmonic (F.map σ).toPair.curveEquation_monic
  rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton]
  calc
    Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.map ep.toRingHom
        F.toPair.curveEquation} =
        Ideal.map
          (MvPolynomial.mapAlgEquiv (Fin 2) ep).toRingEquiv
          (Ideal.span {F.toPair.curveEquation}) := by
      rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
      rfl
    _ = Ideal.map
        (MvPolynomial.mapAlgEquiv (Fin 2) ep).toRingEquiv
        F.toPair.ideal := by
      rw [F.toPair.ideal_eq_span_curveEquation]
    _ = (F.map σ).toPair.ideal := by
      exact F.toPair_ideal_map_parameterMapEquiv σ
    _ = Ideal.span {(F.map σ).toPair.curveEquation} :=
      (F.map σ).toPair.ideal_eq_span_curveEquation

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember.toPair_ideal_map_parameterEquivOfIdealEq
statement:
theorem toPair_ideal_map_parameterEquivOfIdealEq
    (G : FiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember (k := k) (Ω := Ω) d)
    (h : F.ideal = G.ideal) :
    Ideal.map
        (MvPolynomial.mapAlgEquiv (Fin 2)
          (F.parameterEquivOfIdealEq G h)).toRingEquiv
        F.toPair.ideal =
      G.toPair.ideal
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let E := F.parameterField
  let E' := G.parameterField
  let L := F.familyField
  let L' := G.familyField
  let ep : E ≃ₐ[k] E' := F.parameterEquivOfIdealEq G h
  let et : L ≃ₐ[k] L' := locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq h
  have hEL : E ≤ L := by
    apply IntermediateField.adjoin.mono
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨i.castSucc.castSucc, by simp [tuple, parameterSource]⟩
  have hEL' : E' ≤ L' := by
    apply IntermediateField.adjoin.mono
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨i.castSucc.castSucc, by simp [tuple, parameterSource]⟩
  let iEL : E →ₐ[k] L := IntermediateField.inclusion hEL
  let iEL' : E' →ₐ[k] L' := IntermediateField.inclusion hEL'
  letI : Algebra E L := iEL.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra E' L' := iEL'.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have het_parameter : et.toAlgHom.comp iEL = iEL'.comp ep.toAlgHom := by
    apply IntermediateField.adjoin_algHom_ext k
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    change et ⟨F.parameter i, _⟩ =
      iEL' (ep ⟨F.parameter i, _⟩)
    rw [F.parameterEquivOfIdealEq_apply G h i]
    change et ⟨F.parameter i, _⟩ = ⟨G.parameter i, _⟩
    have hin :
        (⟨F.parameter i,
          hEL (IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _
            (Set.mem_range_self i))⟩ : L) =
        ⟨F.tuple i.castSucc.castSucc,
          IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _
            (Set.mem_range_self i.castSucc.castSucc)⟩ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp [tuple, parameterSource]
    rw [hin]
    apply Subtype.ext
    change ((et ⟨F.tuple i.castSucc.castSucc, _⟩ : L') : Ω) =
      G.parameter i
    dsimp only [et, L, L', familyField]
    convert congrArg Subtype.val
      (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_apply h
        i.castSucc.castSucc) using 1
    simp [tuple, parameterSource]
  let q : Fin 2 → L :=
    ![⟨F.source, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _
        ⟨(Fin.last d).castSucc, by simp [tuple, parameterSource]⟩⟩,
      ⟨F.target, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _
        ⟨Fin.last (d + 1), by simp [tuple]⟩⟩]
  let q' : Fin 2 → L' :=
    ![⟨G.source, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _
        ⟨(Fin.last d).castSucc, by simp [tuple, parameterSource]⟩⟩,
      ⟨G.target, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _
        ⟨Fin.last (d + 1), by simp [tuple]⟩⟩]
  have het_q (i : Fin 2) : et (q i) = q' i := by
    fin_cases i
    · change et ⟨F.source, _⟩ = ⟨G.source, _⟩
      have hin :
          (⟨F.source, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _
            ⟨(Fin.last d).castSucc,
              by simp [tuple, parameterSource]⟩⟩ : L) =
          ⟨F.tuple (Fin.last d).castSucc,
            IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _
              (Set.mem_range_self (Fin.last d).castSucc)⟩ := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        simp [tuple, parameterSource]
      rw [hin]
      apply Subtype.ext
      change ((et ⟨F.tuple (Fin.last d).castSucc, _⟩ : L') : Ω) =
        G.source
      dsimp only [et, L, L', familyField]
      convert congrArg Subtype.val
        (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_apply h
          (Fin.last d).castSucc) using 1
      simp [tuple, parameterSource]
    · change et ⟨F.target, _⟩ = ⟨G.target, _⟩
      have hin :
          (⟨F.target, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _
            ⟨Fin.last (d + 1), by simp [tuple]⟩⟩ : L) =
          ⟨F.tuple (Fin.last (d + 1)),
            IntermediateField.subset_adjoin k _
              (Set.mem_range_self (Fin.last (d + 1)))⟩ := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        simp [tuple]
      rw [hin]
      apply Subtype.ext
      change ((et ⟨F.tuple (Fin.last (d + 1)), _⟩ : L') : Ω) =
        G.target
      dsimp only [et, L, L', familyField]
      convert congrArg Subtype.val
        (locusFunctionFieldEquivOfIdealEq_apply h
          (Fin.last (d + 1))) using 1
      simp [tuple]
  have het_eval (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) E) :
      et (MvPolynomial.aeval q f) =
        MvPolynomial.aeval q' (MvPolynomial.map ep.toRingHom f) := by
    induction f using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
    | C z =>
        simp only [MvPolynomial.map_C, MvPolynomial.aeval_C]
        change et (iEL z) = iEL' (ep z)
        exact DFunLike.congr_fun het_parameter z
    | add f g hf hg => simp only [map_add, hf, hg]
    | mul_X f i hf =>
        simp only [map_mul, MvPolynomial.map_X, hf,
          MvPolynomial.aeval_X, het_q]
  have hval (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) E) :
      MvPolynomial.aeval ![F.source, F.target] f =
        L.val (MvPolynomial.aeval q f) := by
    let vL : L →ₐ[E] Ω :=
      { L.val.toRingHom with commutes' := fun _ => rfl }
    have hqval : (fun i => vL (q i)) =
        (![F.source, F.target] : Fin 2 → Ω) := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl
    calc
      MvPolynomial.aeval ![F.source, F.target] f =
          MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i => vL (q i)) f := by rw [hqval]
      _ = vL (MvPolynomial.aeval q f) :=
        (MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply (f := q) vL f).symm
      _ = L.val (MvPolynomial.aeval q f) := rfl
  have hval' (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) E') :
      MvPolynomial.aeval ![G.source, G.target] f =
        L'.val (MvPolynomial.aeval q' f) := by
    let vL' : L' →ₐ[E'] Ω :=
      { L'.val.toRingHom with commutes' := fun _ => rfl }
    have hqval : (fun i => vL' (q' i)) =
        (![G.source, G.target] : Fin 2 → Ω) := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl
    calc
      MvPolynomial.aeval ![G.source, G.target] f =
          MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i => vL' (q' i)) f := by rw [hqval]
      _ = vL' (MvPolynomial.aeval q' f) :=
        (MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply (f := q') vL' f).symm
      _ = L'.val (MvPolynomial.aeval q' f) := rfl
  have hmem (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) E) :
      MvPolynomial.map ep.toRingHom f ∈ G.toPair.ideal ↔
        f ∈ F.toPair.ideal := by
    change MvPolynomial.map ep.toRingHom f ∈
        idealOf (↥E') ![G.source, G.target] ↔
      f ∈ idealOf (↥E) ![F.source, F.target]
    rw [mem_idealOf_iff, mem_idealOf_iff, hval, hval', ← het_eval]
    constructor
    · intro hz
      have hzero : et (MvPolynomial.aeval q f) = 0 :=
        L'.val.injective hz
      have hzero' : MvPolynomial.aeval q f = 0 :=
        et.injective (by simpa using hzero)
      simpa using congrArg L.val hzero'
    · intro hz
      have hzero : MvPolynomial.aeval q f = 0 := L.val.injective hz
      rw [hzero, map_zero]
      rfl
  let em : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) E ≃+*
      MvPolynomial (Fin 2) E' :=
    (MvPolynomial.mapAlgEquiv (Fin 2) ep).toRingEquiv
  ext g
  constructor
  · intro hg
    obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := (Ideal.mem_map_of_equiv em g).mp hg
    exact (hmem f).2 hf
  · intro hg
    refine (Ideal.mem_map_of_equiv em g).2
      ⟨em.symm g, ?_, em.apply_symm_apply g⟩
    have hm : MvPolynomial.map ep.toRingHom (em.symm g) = g :=
      em.apply_symm_apply g
    rw [← hm] at hg
    exact (hmem (em.symm g)).1 hg

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember.curveEquation_map_parameterEquivOfIdealEq
statement:
theorem curveEquation_map_parameterEquivOfIdealEq
    (G : FiniteCorrespondenceFamilyMember (k := k) (Ω := Ω) d)
    (h : F.ideal = G.ideal) :
    MvPolynomial.map (F.parameterEquivOfIdealEq G h).toRingHom
        F.toPair.curveEquation =
      G.toPair.curveEquation
proof:
:= by
  let ep := F.parameterEquivOfIdealEq G h
  change MvPolynomial.map ep.toRingHom F.toPair.curveEquation =
    G.toPair.curveEquation
  have hmonic : MonomialOrder.lex.Monic
      (MvPolynomial.map ep.toRingHom F.toPair.curveEquation) := by
    have hs :
        (MvPolynomial.map ep.toRingHom F.toPair.curveEquation).support =
          F.toPair.curveEquation.support :=
      MvPolynomial.support_map_of_injective _ ep.injective
    rw [MonomialOrder.Monic, MonomialOrder.leadingCoeff,
      MonomialOrder.degree, hs, MvPolynomial.coeff_map]
    change ep.toRingHom
        (MonomialOrder.lex.leadingCoeff F.toPair.curveEquation) = 1
    rw [F.toPair.curveEquation_monic.leadingCoeff_eq_one, map_one]
  apply FiniteCorrespondencePair.eq_of_monic_of_associated
    hmonic G.toPair.curveEquation_monic
  rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton]
  calc
    Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.map ep.toRingHom
        F.toPair.curveEquation} =
        Ideal.map
          (MvPolynomial.mapAlgEquiv (Fin 2) ep).toRingEquiv
          (Ideal.span {F.toPair.curveEquation}) := by
      rw [Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]
      rfl
    _ = Ideal.map
        (MvPolynomial.mapAlgEquiv (Fin 2) ep).toRingEquiv
        F.toPair.ideal := by
      rw [F.toPair.ideal_eq_span_curveEquation]
    _ = G.toPair.ideal := by
      exact F.toPair_ideal_map_parameterEquivOfIdealEq G h
    _ = Ideal.span {G.toPair.curveEquation} :=
      G.toPair.ideal_eq_span_curveEquation

name: AclGeom.SchemeGenericTranslate.exists_separating_parameter
statement:
private theorem exists_separating_parameter {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra k F]
    [PerfectField k] [Algebra.EssFiniteType k F] (htr : Algebra.trdeg k F = 1) :
    ∃ t : F, Transcendental k t ∧
      FiniteDimensional (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F ∧
      Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsep⟩ := exists_isTranscendenceBasis_and_isSeparable_of_perfectField k F
  have hcard : s.card = 1 := by
    have h := hs.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg
    rw [Cardinal.mk_coe_finset, htr] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.1 hcard
  have halg := hs.isAlgebraic_field
  have hr : Set.range ((↑) : ({t} : Finset F) → F) = {t} := by
    ext
    simp
  rw [hr] at halg
  rw [Finset.coe_singleton] at hsep
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F :=
    Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_comp k _ _
  exact ⟨t, hs.1.transcendental ⟨t, Finset.mem_singleton_self t⟩,
    Algebra.finite_of_essFiniteType_of_isAlgebraic, hsep⟩

name: AclGeom.SchemeGenericTranslate.exists_separating_function
statement:
private theorem exists_separating_function [PerfectField k]
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1) :
    ∃ t : V.left.functionField, Transcendental k t ∧
      FiniteDimensional (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set V.left.functionField))
        V.left.functionField ∧
      Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set V.left.functionField))
        V.left.functionField
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty (⊤ : V.left.Opens) := ⟨⟨genericPoint V.left, trivial⟩⟩
  have : IsFractionRing Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen V.left ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top V.left)
  have : IsScalarTower k Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField :=
    sections_functionField_isScalarTower V
  have := finiteType_sections V
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField :=
    Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_isLocalization V.left.functionField (nonZeroDivisors Γ(V.left, ⊤))
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType k V.left.functionField :=
    Algebra.EssFiniteType.comp k Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField
  have he := IsHomeomorph.topologicalKrullDim_eq _ V.left.isoSpec.hom.homeomorph.isHomeomorph
  change topologicalKrullDim V.left = topologicalKrullDim (PrimeSpectrum Γ(V.left, ⊤)) at he
  rw [PrimeSpectrum.topologicalKrullDim_eq_ringKrullDim] at he
  obtain ⟨m, hm, ht⟩ :=
    exists_ringKrullDim_trdeg_eq_of_finiteType k Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField
  have hm1 : m = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hm.symm.trans (he.symm.trans hdim)
  apply exists_separating_parameter
  simpa only [hm1, Nat.cast_one] using ht

name: AclGeom.SchemeGenericTranslate.exists_constantExtension_genus_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_constantExtension_genus_eq_zero [IsAlgClosed k]
    (G : Over (Spec (.of k))) [GrpObj G] [IsIntegral G.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType G.hom]
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G V]
    (hker : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G,
      ModObj.pointAct V q = 𝟙 V → q = 1)
    (hdimG : (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDim G.left)
    (hdimV : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1) :
    letI
proof:
:= ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAlgebra V
    ∃ (K : Type u) (hK : Field K),
      letI := hK
      ∃ hAlg : Algebra k K,
      letI := hAlg
      ∃ (hACF : IsAlgClosed K) (hDom : IsDomain (K ⊗[k] V.left.functionField)),
      letI := hACF
      letI := hDom
      ∃ hOne : IsFunctionFieldOneVar K (FractionRing (K ⊗[k] V.left.functionField)),
      letI := hOne
      genus K (FractionRing (K ⊗[k] V.left.functionField)) = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨W, hI, hA, j, hOpen, hft, hrank⟩ := exists_affine_parameter G 2 hdimG
  have := hI
  have := hA
  have := hOpen
  let A := Γ(W.left, ⊤)
  let : Algebra k A := sectionsAlgebra W
  have : Algebra.FiniteType k A := hft
  let C := FractionRing A
  let g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G := (sectionsSpecIso W).inv ≫ j
  have : Mono j := Over.mono_of_mono_left j
  have : Mono g := inferInstance
  let φ : A →ₐ[k] C := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A C
  obtain ⟨s, hs, n, v, cA, hv, hcA, C0, c0, hC0, hfg, hgen, hcoe,
      τ, hτ, hmat, h0, hC, hF, rest⟩ := exists_effective_functionFieldAut V g φ
  have := h0
  have := hC
  have := hF
  obtain ⟨τF, _, _, hfaith, _⟩ := rest
  have hmem (e : Bool) (i : s) (j : Fin n) : algebraMap A C (cA e i j) ∈ C0 := by
    change φ (cA e i j) ∈ C0
    rw [← hcoe e i j]
    exact (c0 e i j).property
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic C0 C :=
    isAlgebraic_of_faithful_coefficients V hker g s hs v cA
      (fun ψ i ↦ hcA k ψ true i) C0 hmem
  have : FaithfulSMul k C0 :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective k C0).2 (algebraMap k C0).injective
  have : FaithfulSMul C0 C :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective C0 C).2 (algebraMap C0 C).injective
  have htr := trdeg_add_eq k C0 (A := C)
  rw [trdeg_eq_zero (R := C0) (A := C), add_zero] at htr
  have htr0 : (2 : Cardinal) ≤ Algebra.trdeg k C0 := hrank.trans_eq htr.symm
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType k C0 := hfg
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := exists_linearIndependent_derivations htr0
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hfin, hsep⟩ := exists_separating_function V hdimV
  have : IsFunctionFieldOneVar k V.left.functionField := ⟨⟨t, ht, hfin⟩⟩
  have := hsep
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hreg⟩ := exists_independent_regular_variations ht τF hfaith D hD
  let K := AlgebraicClosure C0
  have : IsScalarTower k C0 K := inferInstance
  obtain ⟨δ', hδ', _, hreg'⟩ :=
    exists_regular_derivations_baseChange (K := K) ht δ hδ hreg
  have hDom : IsDomain (K ⊗[k] V.left.functionField) := isDomain_tensorProduct_of_isAlgClosed
  let T := algebraMap (K ⊗[k] V.left.functionField)
    (FractionRing (K ⊗[k] V.left.functionField)) ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[k] t)
  have hT : Transcendental K T := by
    intro hbad
    apply transcendental_one_tmul (C := K) ht
    exact (isAlgebraic_algHom_iff
      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K (K ⊗[k] V.left.functionField)
        (FractionRing (K ⊗[k] V.left.functionField)))
      (IsFractionRing.injective (K ⊗[k] V.left.functionField)
        (FractionRing (K ⊗[k] V.left.functionField)))).mp hbad
  have hOne : IsFunctionFieldOneVar K (FractionRing (K ⊗[k] V.left.functionField)) :=
    ⟨⟨T, hT, (finiteDimensional_isSeparable_adjoin (L := K) ht).1⟩⟩
  refine ⟨K, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, hDom, hOne, ?_⟩
  have := hOne
  exact genus_eq_zero_of_linearIndependent_regular δ' hδ' hreg'

name: AclGeom.SchemeCurveGenus.genus_eq_zero
statement:
theorem genus_eq_zero
    (G : Over (Spec (.of k))) [GrpObj G] [IsIntegral G.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType G.hom]
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G V]
    (hker : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G,
      ModObj.pointAct V q = 𝟙 V → q = 1)
    (hdimG : (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDim G.left)
    (hdimV : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1) :
    letI
proof:
:= ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAlgebra V
    letI := scheme_functionField_isFunctionFieldOneVar k V hdimV
    genus k V.left.functionField = 0 := by
  let := ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAlgebra V
  have : IsFunctionFieldOneVar k V.left.functionField :=
    scheme_functionField_isFunctionFieldOneVar k V hdimV
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hAlg, hACF, hDom, hOne, hg⟩ :=
    SchemeGenericTranslate.exists_constantExtension_genus_eq_zero G V hker hdimG hdimV
  let := hK
  let := hAlg
  have := hACF
  have := hDom
  have := hOne
  exact RationalityDescent.genus_eq_zero_of_tensor hg

name: AclGeom.SchemeCurveGenus.exists_generator
statement:
theorem exists_generator
    (G : Over (Spec (.of k))) [GrpObj G] [IsIntegral G.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType G.hom]
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G V]
    (hker : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G,
      ModObj.pointAct V q = 𝟙 V → q = 1)
    (hdimG : (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDim G.left)
    (hdimV : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1) :
    letI
proof:
:= ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAlgebra V
    ∃ t : V.left.functionField, Transcendental k t ∧
      IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set V.left.functionField) = ⊤ := by
  let := ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAlgebra V
  have : IsFunctionFieldOneVar k V.left.functionField :=
    scheme_functionField_isFunctionFieldOneVar k V hdimV
  exact genus_eq_zero_iff_exists_generator.1 (genus_eq_zero G V hker hdimG hdimV)

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionProjection.projectionAlgHom_injective
statement:
theorem projectionAlgHom_injective (a₂ : ι₂ → K₂) (e : L₂ →ₐ[k] L₁) :
    Function.Injective (projectionAlgHom (k := k) a₂ e)
proof:
:=
  e.injective.comp Subtype.val_injective

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionProjection.functionFieldAlgHom_commutes
statement:
@[simp] theorem functionFieldAlgHom_commutes
    (a₁ : ι₁ → K₁) (a₂ : ι₂ → K₂)
    (ha₁ : adjoin k (Set.range a₁) = ⊤)
    (ha₂ : adjoin k (Set.range a₂) = ⊤)
    (e : L₂ →ₐ[k] L₁)
    (z : (FiniteExtensionChart.scheme
      (k := k) (K := K₂) (L := L₂) a₂).functionField) :
    FiniteExtensionChart.functionFieldAlgEquiv
        (k := k) (K := K₁) (L := L₁) a₁ ha₁
        (functionFieldAlgHom a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e z) =
      e (FiniteExtensionChart.functionFieldAlgEquiv
        (k := k) (K := K₂) (L := L₂) a₂ ha₂ z)
proof:
:= by
  simp [functionFieldAlgHom]

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionProjection.partialMap_fromFunctionField
statement:
theorem partialMap_fromFunctionField [Fintype ι₂]
    (a₁ : ι₁ → K₁) (a₂ : ι₂ → K₂)
    (ha₁ : adjoin k (Set.range a₁) = ⊤)
    (ha₂ : adjoin k (Set.range a₂) = ⊤)
    (e : L₂ →ₐ[k] L₁) :
    (partialMap (k := k) a₁ a₂ ha₁ e).fromFunctionField =
      Scheme.functionFieldMorphismOfHom
        (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (functionFieldAlgHom a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e).toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  let A₁ := FiniteExtensionChart.coordinateRing
    (k := k) (K := K₁) (L := L₁) a₁
  let A₂ := FiniteExtensionChart.coordinateRing
    (k := k) (K := K₂) (L := L₂) a₂
  letI : IsFractionRing A₁ L₁ :=
    FiniteExtensionChart.isFractionRing_extension a₁ ha₁
  let b₂ := FiniteExtensionChart.coordinateGenerators
    (k := k) (K := K₂) (L := L₂) a₂
  let φ := projectionAlgHom (k := k) a₂ e
  let x : (ι₂ ⊕ Fin (Module.finrank K₂ L₂)) → L₁ := fun i ↦ φ (b₂ i)
  let d : A₁ := PrincipalLocalization.CommonDenominator.common (R := A₁) x
  have hd : d ≠ 0 :=
    PrincipalLocalization.CommonDenominator.common_ne_zero (R := A₁) x
  let ψ : A₂ →ₐ[k] Localization.Away d :=
    PrincipalLocalization.awayAlgHomOfGenerators (A := A₁) b₂
      (FiniteExtensionChart.adjoin_coordinateGenerators_eq_top
        (k := k) (K := K₂) (L := L₂) a₂) φ
  let q : Localization.Away d →+*
      (FiniteExtensionChart.scheme
        (k := k) (K := K₁) (L := L₁) a₁).functionField :=
    PrincipalLocalization.genericAwayMap d hd
  have hleft :
      (partialMap (k := k) a₁ a₂ ha₁ e).fromFunctionField =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (q.comp ψ.toRingHom)) := by
    change (PrincipalLocalization.partialMapOfGenerators b₂
      (FiniteExtensionChart.adjoin_coordinateGenerators_eq_top
        (k := k) (K := K₂) (L := L₂) a₂)
      φ (projectionAlgHom_injective (k := k) a₂ e)).fromFunctionField = _
    exact PrincipalLocalization.partialMap_fromFunctionField_eq _ _ _ _
  let H := functionFieldAlgHom a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e
  have hring : CommRingCat.ofHom (q.comp ψ.toRingHom) =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (StructureSheaf.toStalk A₂
          (genericPoint (FiniteExtensionChart.scheme
            (k := k) (K := K₂) (L := L₂) a₂))).hom ≫
        CommRingCat.ofHom H.toRingHom := by
    ext z
    simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]
    change q (ψ z) = _
    apply (FiniteExtensionChart.functionFieldAlgEquiv a₁ ha₁).injective
    have hq :
        (FiniteExtensionChart.functionFieldAlgEquiv a₁ ha₁).toRingHom.comp q =
          (Localization.mapToFractionRing L₁ (Submonoid.powers d)
            (Localization.Away d)
            (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors hd)).toRingHom := by
      apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers d)
      apply RingHom.ext
      intro t
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
      change (FiniteExtensionChart.functionFieldAlgEquiv
          (k := k) (K := K₁) (L := L₁) a₁ ha₁).toRingEquiv.toRingHom
          ((q.comp (algebraMap A₁ (Localization.Away d))) t) = _
      rw [PrincipalLocalization.genericAwayMap_comp_algebraMap]
      exact (FiniteExtensionChart.functionFieldAlgEquiv_toStalk
        (k := k) (K := K₁) (L := L₁) a₁ ha₁ t).trans <|
          ((Localization.mapToFractionRing L₁ (Submonoid.powers d)
            (Localization.Away d)
            (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors hd))).commutes t |>.symm
    have hz : (FiniteExtensionChart.functionFieldAlgEquiv
        (k := k) (K := K₁) (L := L₁) a₁ ha₁)
        (q (ψ z)) =
        (Localization.mapToFractionRing L₁ (Submonoid.powers d)
          (Localization.Away d)
          (powers_le_nonZeroDivisors_of_noZeroDivisors hd)) (ψ z) := by
      exact RingHom.congr_fun hq (ψ z)
    rw [hz]
    rw [PrincipalLocalization.awayAlgHomOfGenerators_mapToFractionRing]
    change e (z : L₂) = _
    have hz₂ := FiniteExtensionChart.functionFieldAlgEquiv_toStalk
      (k := k) (K := K₂) (L := L₂) a₂ ha₂ z
    change e (z : L₂) =
      (FiniteExtensionChart.functionFieldAlgEquiv
        (k := k) (K := K₁) (L := L₁) a₁ ha₁)
        ((FiniteExtensionChart.functionFieldAlgEquiv
          (k := k) (K := K₁) (L := L₁) a₁ ha₁).symm
          (e ((FiniteExtensionChart.functionFieldAlgEquiv
            (k := k) (K := K₂) (L := L₂) a₂ ha₂)
            ((StructureSheaf.toStalk A₂
              (genericPoint (FiniteExtensionChart.scheme a₂))) z))))
    rw [(FiniteExtensionChart.functionFieldAlgEquiv
      (k := k) (K := K₁) (L := L₁) a₁ ha₁).apply_symm_apply, hz₂]
  rw [hleft]
  unfold Scheme.functionFieldMorphismOfHom
  rw [Spec.fromSpecStalk_eq']
  exact (congrArg Spec.map hring).trans (Spec.map_comp _ _)

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionProjection.rationalMap_fromFunctionField
statement:
theorem rationalMap_fromFunctionField [Fintype ι₂]
    (a₁ : ι₁ → K₁) (a₂ : ι₂ → K₂)
    (ha₁ : adjoin k (Set.range a₁) = ⊤)
    (ha₂ : adjoin k (Set.range a₂) = ⊤)
    (e : L₂ →ₐ[k] L₁) :
    (rationalMap (k := k) a₁ a₂ ha₁ e).fromFunctionField =
      Scheme.functionFieldMorphismOfHom
        (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (functionFieldAlgHom a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e).toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  unfold rationalMap
  rw [Scheme.RationalMap.fromFunctionField_toRationalMap]
  exact partialMap_fromFunctionField a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e

name: AclGeom.FiniteExtensionProjection.rationalMap_functionFieldMap
statement:
theorem rationalMap_functionFieldMap [Fintype ι₂]
    (a₁ : ι₁ → K₁) (a₂ : ι₂ → K₂)
    (ha₁ : adjoin k (Set.range a₁) = ⊤)
    (ha₂ : adjoin k (Set.range a₂) = ⊤)
    (e : L₂ →ₐ[k] L₁) :
    (rationalMap (k := k) a₁ a₂ ha₁ e).representative.functionFieldMap =
      CommRingCat.ofHom
        (functionFieldAlgHom a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  apply Scheme.RationalMap.functionFieldMap_representative_eq_of_fromFunctionField_eq_hom
  exact rationalMap_fromFunctionField a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ e

name: AclGeom.SchemeGenericTranslate.sections_functionField_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem sections_functionField_isScalarTower (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] :
    letI : Nonempty (⊤ : V.left.Opens)
proof:
:= ⟨⟨genericPoint V.left, trivial⟩⟩
    IsScalarTower k Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField := by
  have : Nonempty (⊤ : V.left.Opens) := ⟨⟨genericPoint V.left, trivial⟩⟩
  rw [ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAlgebra_eq_germ V]
  let : Algebra k V.left.functionField :=
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ V.hom.appTop ≫
      V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤).hom.toAlgebra
  exact IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (R := k) (S := Γ(V.left, ⊤))
    (A := V.left.functionField) (fun _ ↦ rfl)

name: AclGeom.SchemeGenericTranslate.sectionsFunctionFieldEquiv_algebraMap
statement:
theorem sectionsFunctionFieldEquiv_algebraMap (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left]
    [IsAffine V.left] (r : Γ(V.left, ⊤)) :
    sectionsFunctionFieldEquiv V (algebraMap Γ(V.left, ⊤) (FractionRing Γ(V.left, ⊤)) r) =
      V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤ (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint V.left, trivial⟩⟩) r
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty (⊤ : V.left.Opens) := ⟨⟨genericPoint V.left, trivial⟩⟩
  have : IsFractionRing Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen V.left ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top V.left)
  have : IsScalarTower k Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField :=
    sections_functionField_isScalarTower V
  change (IsLocalization.algEquiv (nonZeroDivisors Γ(V.left, ⊤))
      (FractionRing Γ(V.left, ⊤)) V.left.functionField)
        (algebraMap Γ(V.left, ⊤) (FractionRing Γ(V.left, ⊤)) r) =
    algebraMap Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField r
  exact AlgEquiv.commutes _ r

name: AclGeom.SchemeGenericTranslate.isDomain_tensor_sections
statement:
theorem isDomain_tensor_sections [IsAlgClosed k] (C : Type u) [Field C] [Algebra k C]
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left] :
    IsDomain (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤))
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty (⊤ : V.left.Opens) := ⟨⟨genericPoint V.left, trivial⟩⟩
  have : IsFractionRing Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField :=
    functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen V.left ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top V.left)
  have : IsScalarTower k Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField :=
    sections_functionField_isScalarTower V
  have : IsDomain (C ⊗[k] V.left.functionField) := isDomain_tensorProduct_of_isAlgClosed
  let f : Γ(V.left, ⊤) →ₐ[k] V.left.functionField :=
    IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField
  let g : C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤) →ₐ[k] C ⊗[k] V.left.functionField :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id k C) f
  have hg : Function.Injective g := Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap
    (M := C) f.toLinearMap (IsFractionRing.injective Γ(V.left, ⊤) V.left.functionField)
  exact Function.Injective.isDomain g hg

name: AclGeom.SchemeGenericTranslate.exists_tensorSections_functionFieldEquiv
statement:
theorem exists_tensorSections_functionFieldEquiv [IsAlgClosed k]
    (C : Type u) [Field C] [Algebra k C]
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left] :
    ∃ e : FractionRing (C ⊗[k] V.left.functionField) ≃ₐ[C]
        FractionRing (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)),
      ∀ (c : C) (r : Γ(V.left, ⊤)),
        e (algebraMap (C ⊗[k] V.left.functionField) _
          (c ⊗ₜ[k] V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤
            (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint V.left, trivial⟩⟩) r)) =
          algebraMap (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)) _ (c ⊗ₜ[k] r)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsDomain (C ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)) := isDomain_tensor_sections C V
  obtain ⟨_, e₂, he₂⟩ := isDomain_and_exists_tensorFractionEquiv
    (k := k) (C := C) (A := Γ(V.left, ⊤))
  let et : C ⊗[k] V.left.functionField ≃ₐ[C] C ⊗[k] FractionRing Γ(V.left, ⊤) :=
    Algebra.TensorProduct.congr (AlgEquiv.refl : C ≃ₐ[C] C) (sectionsFunctionFieldEquiv V).symm
  let el : FractionRing (C ⊗[k] V.left.functionField) ≃ₐ[C]
      FractionRing (C ⊗[k] FractionRing Γ(V.left, ⊤)) :=
    IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv et
  refine ⟨el.trans e₂, fun c r ↦ ?_⟩
  have hh : (sectionsFunctionFieldEquiv V).symm
      (V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤ (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint V.left, trivial⟩⟩) r) =
        algebraMap Γ(V.left, ⊤) (FractionRing Γ(V.left, ⊤)) r := by
    rw [← sectionsFunctionFieldEquiv_algebraMap V r, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  change e₂ (IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv et
    (algebraMap (C ⊗[k] V.left.functionField) _ _)) = _
  rw [IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv_algebraMap]
  change e₂ (algebraMap (C ⊗[k] FractionRing Γ(V.left, ⊤)) _
    (c ⊗ₜ[k] (sectionsFunctionFieldEquiv V).symm
      (V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤ (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint V.left, trivial⟩⟩) r))) = _
  rw [hh]
  exact he₂ c r

name: AclGeom.SchemeGenericTranslate.exists_functionField_genericTranslate
statement:
theorem exists_functionField_genericTranslate [IsAlgClosed k]
    (G : Over (Spec (.of k))) [GrpObj G] [IsIntegral G.left]
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left] [ModObj G V] :
    ∃ (σ : FractionRing (G.left.functionField ⊗[k] V.left.functionField) ≃ₐ[G.left.functionField]
          FractionRing (G.left.functionField ⊗[k] V.left.functionField))
      (e : FractionRing (G.left.functionField ⊗[k] V.left.functionField) ≃ₐ[G.left.functionField]
          FractionRing (G.left.functionField ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤))),
      (∀ (c : G.left.functionField) (r : Γ(V.left, ⊤)),
        e (algebraMap (G.left.functionField ⊗[k] V.left.functionField) _
          (c ⊗ₜ[k] V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤
            (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint V.left, trivial⟩⟩) r)) =
          algebraMap (G.left.functionField ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)) _ (c ⊗ₜ[k] r)) ∧
      ∀ x, e (σ x) = genericTranslate G V (e x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_tensorSections_functionFieldEquiv G.left.functionField V
  refine ⟨e.trans ((genericTranslate G V).trans e.symm), e, he, fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  change e (e.symm (genericTranslate G V (e x))) = _
  exact e.apply_symm_apply _

name: AclGeom.NormalConjugation.exists_groupIso_conjugation_lift
statement:
theorem exists_groupIso_conjugation_lift
    {C : Type*} [Category* C] [CartesianMonoidalCategory C]
    {G N : C} [GrpObj G] [GrpObj N]
    (i : N ⟶ G) [IsMonHom i] [Mono i]
    (ψ : G ⊗ N ⟶ N) (hψ : ψ ≫ i = G ◁ i ≫ conj G)
    (q : 𝟙_ C ⟶ G) :
    ∃ e : Grp.mk N ≅ Grp.mk N,
      e.hom.hom.hom = lift (toUnit N ≫ q) (𝟙 N) ≫ ψ
proof:
:= by
  let c (q : 𝟙_ C ⟶ G) : N ⟶ N := lift (toUnit N ≫ q) (𝟙 N) ≫ ψ
  have hc (q : 𝟙_ C ⟶ G) {T : C} (p : T ⟶ N) :
      (p ≫ c q) ≫ i = (toUnit T ≫ q) * (p ≫ i) * (toUnit T ≫ q)⁻¹ := by
    simp only [c, Category.assoc, hψ, comp_lift_assoc,
      Category.comp_id, lift_whiskerLeft_assoc, lift_conj_eq_mul_mul_inv]
    simp only [← Category.assoc, comp_toUnit]
  have hci (q : 𝟙_ C ⟶ G) :
      c q ≫ i = (toUnit N ≫ q) * i * (toUnit N ≫ q)⁻¹ := by
    simpa only [Category.id_comp] using hc q (𝟙 N)
  have hmul (q : 𝟙_ C ⟶ G) {T : C} (p r : T ⟶ N) :
      (p * r) ≫ c q = (p ≫ c q) * (r ≫ c q) := by
    apply (cancel_mono i).mp
    rw [hc, mul_comp, mul_comp, hc, hc]
    simp only [_root_.mul_assoc, _root_.inv_mul_cancel_left]
  have hone (q : 𝟙_ C ⟶ G) {T : C} : (1 : T ⟶ N) ≫ c q = 1 := by
    apply (cancel_mono i).mp
    rw [hc, one_comp]
    simp only [_root_.mul_one, _root_.mul_inv_cancel]
  have hmon (q : 𝟙_ C ⟶ G) : IsMonHom (c q) := by
    constructor
    · simpa only [one_eq_one] using (hone q (T := 𝟙_ C))
    · simpa only [Hom.mul_def, lift_fst_snd, Category.id_comp,
        lift_fst_comp_snd_comp] using hmul q (fst N N) (snd N N)
  have hinv (q : 𝟙_ C ⟶ G) : c q ≫ c q⁻¹ = 𝟙 N := by
    apply (cancel_mono i).mp
    rw [hc, hci, Category.id_comp, comp_inv]
    simp only [_root_.inv_inv, _root_.mul_assoc, _root_.inv_mul_cancel_left,
      _root_.inv_mul_cancel, _root_.mul_one]
  let e : N ≅ N := ⟨c q, c q⁻¹, hinv q, by simpa only [_root_.inv_inv] using hinv q⁻¹⟩
  have : IsMonHom e.hom := hmon q
  exact ⟨Grp.mkIso' e, rfl⟩

name: AclGeom.forall_op_or
statement:
private theorem forall_op_or {P P' : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)} (hP : P.IsPrime)
    (hP' : P'.IsPrime) (op : (σ → k) → (σ → k) → (σ → k))
    (τ : (σ → k) → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
    (hτ : ∀ v u g, aeval u (τ v g) = aeval (op u v) g)
    (τ' : (σ → k) → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
    (hτ' : ∀ u v g, aeval v (τ' u g) = aeval (op u v) g) {g h : MvPolynomial σ k}
    (hgh : ∀ u ∈ zeroLocus k P, ∀ v ∈ zeroLocus k P', aeval (op u v) (g * h) = 0) :
    (∀ u ∈ zeroLocus k P, ∀ v ∈ zeroLocus k P', aeval (op u v) g = 0) ∨
      (∀ u ∈ zeroLocus k P, ∀ v ∈ zeroLocus k P', aeval (op u v) h = 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hPv : vanishingIdeal k (zeroLocus k P) = P :=
    MvPolynomial.IsPrime.vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus P (h := hP)
  have hP'v : vanishingIdeal k (zeroLocus k P') = P' :=
    MvPolynomial.IsPrime.vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus P' (h := hP')
  
  let T : MvPolynomial σ k → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k) := fun f ↦
    Ideal.span ((fun v ↦ τ v f) '' zeroLocus k P')
  have hT : ∀ (f : MvPolynomial σ k) (u : σ → k),
      (∀ v ∈ zeroLocus k P', aeval (op u v) f = 0) →
      T f ≤ RingHom.ker (aeval u : MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] k) := by
    intro f u hf
    refine Ideal.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, RingHom.mem_ker, hτ]
    exact hf v hv
  
  have hsplit : ∀ u ∈ zeroLocus k P, (∀ v ∈ zeroLocus k P', aeval (op u v) g = 0) ∨
      (∀ v ∈ zeroLocus k P', aeval (op u v) h = 0) := by
    intro u hu
    have hmem : τ' u g * τ' u h ∈ P' := by
      rw [← map_mul, ← hP'v, mem_vanishingIdeal_iff]
      intro v hv
      rw [hτ']
      exact hgh u hu v hv
    rcases hP'.mem_or_mem hmem with hg | hh
    · left
      intro v hv
      have := mem_vanishingIdeal_iff.1 (hP'v.symm ▸ hg) v hv
      rwa [hτ'] at this
    · right
      intro v hv
      have := mem_vanishingIdeal_iff.1 (hP'v.symm ▸ hh) v hv
      rwa [hτ'] at this
  
  have hinf : T g ⊓ T h ≤ P := by
    intro f hf
    rw [← hPv, mem_vanishingIdeal_iff]
    intro u hu
    rcases hsplit u hu with hg | hh
    · exact (RingHom.mem_ker).1 (hT g u hg hf.1)
    · exact (RingHom.mem_ker).1 (hT h u hh hf.2)
  have hfin : ∀ f, T f ≤ P → ∀ u ∈ zeroLocus k P, ∀ v ∈ zeroLocus k P',
      aeval (op u v) f = 0 := by
    intro f hf u hu v hv
    have hmem : τ v f ∈ P := hf (Ideal.subset_span ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩)
    have := hu _ hmem
    rwa [hτ] at this
  rcases hP.inf_le.1 hinf with hg | hh
  · exact Or.inl (hfin g hg)
  · exact Or.inr (hfin h hh)

name: AclGeom.eq_zero_or_one_of_isIdempotentElem
statement:
private theorem eq_zero_or_one_of_isIdempotentElem {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    [ConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum A)] {y : A} (hy : IsIdempotentElem y) : y = 0 ∨ y = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hcl : IsClopen ((PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen y : TopologicalSpace.Opens (PrimeSpectrum A)) :
      Set (PrimeSpectrum A)) := PrimeSpectrum.isClopen_iff.2 ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  rcases isClopen_iff.1 hcl with h | h
  · refine Or.inl (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_injOn_isIdempotentElem hy IsIdempotentElem.zero ?_)
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_zero]
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.ext h
  · refine Or.inr (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_injOn_isIdempotentElem hy IsIdempotentElem.one ?_)
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_one]
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.ext h

name: AclGeom.isPrime_vanishingIdeal_of_connected
statement:
theorem isPrime_vanishingIdeal_of_connected (S : Set (σ → k))
    (hclosed : zeroLocus k (vanishingIdeal k S) = S) (hne : S.Nonempty)
    [ConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial σ k ⧸ vanishingIdeal k S))]
    (op : (σ → k) → (σ → k) → (σ → k) → (σ → k))
    (hmem : ∀ c ∈ S, ∀ u ∈ S, ∀ v ∈ S, op c u v ∈ S)
    (hleft : ∀ c ∈ S, ∀ u, op c u c = u) (hright : ∀ c ∈ S, ∀ v, op c c v = v)
    (τ : (σ → k) → (σ → k) → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
    (hτ : ∀ c v u g, aeval u (τ c v g) = aeval (op c u v) g)
    (τ' : (σ → k) → (σ → k) → MvPolynomial σ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial σ k)
    (hτ' : ∀ c u v g, aeval v (τ' c u g) = aeval (op c u v) g) :
    (vanishingIdeal k S).IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set J := vanishingIdeal k S with hJdef
  have hsub : ∀ {Q : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k)}, J ≤ Q → ∀ x ∈ zeroLocus k Q, x ∈ S := by
    intro Q hQ x hx
    have hx' : x ∈ zeroLocus k J := zeroLocus_anti_mono hQ hx
    rw [hclosed] at hx'
    exact hx'
  
  have heq : ∀ P ∈ J.minimalPrimes, ∀ P' ∈ J.minimalPrimes, ∀ c ∈ zeroLocus k P,
      c ∈ zeroLocus k P' → P = P' := by
    intro P hP P' hP' c hc hc'
    have hPp : P.IsPrime := hP.1.1
    have hP'p : P'.IsPrime := hP'.1.1
    have hPv : vanishingIdeal k (zeroLocus k P) = P :=
      MvPolynomial.IsPrime.vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus P (h := hPp)
    have hP'v : vanishingIdeal k (zeroLocus k P') = P' :=
      MvPolynomial.IsPrime.vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus P' (h := hP'p)
    have hcS : c ∈ S := hsub hP.1.2 c hc
    let Q := vanishingIdeal k
      {w : σ → k | ∃ u ∈ zeroLocus k P, ∃ v ∈ zeroLocus k P', w = op c u v}
    have hmemQ : ∀ g, g ∈ Q ↔
        ∀ u ∈ zeroLocus k P, ∀ v ∈ zeroLocus k P', aeval (op c u v) g = 0 := by
      intro g
      rw [mem_vanishingIdeal_iff]
      constructor
      · intro hg u hu v hv
        exact hg _ ⟨u, hu, v, hv, rfl⟩
      · rintro hg _ ⟨u, hu, v, hv, rfl⟩
        exact hg u hu v hv
    have hQP : Q ≤ P := fun g hg ↦ by
      rw [← hPv, mem_vanishingIdeal_iff]
      intro u hu
      have := (hmemQ g).1 hg u hu c hc'
      rwa [hleft c hcS] at this
    have hQP' : Q ≤ P' := fun g hg ↦ by
      rw [← hP'v, mem_vanishingIdeal_iff]
      intro v hv
      have := (hmemQ g).1 hg c hc v hv
      rwa [hright c hcS] at this
    have hJQ : J ≤ Q := fun g hg ↦ (hmemQ g).2 fun u hu v hv ↦
      mem_vanishingIdeal_iff.1 hg _ (hmem c hcS u (hsub hP.1.2 u hu) v (hsub hP'.1.2 v hv))
    have hQprime : Q.IsPrime := by
      refine ⟨fun htop ↦ hPp.ne_top (top_le_iff.1 (htop ▸ hQP)), fun {g h} hgh ↦ ?_⟩
      rcases forall_op_or hPp hP'p (op c) (τ c) (hτ c) (τ' c) (hτ' c)
          ((hmemQ (g * h)).1 hgh) with hg | hh
      · exact Or.inl ((hmemQ g).2 hg)
      · exact Or.inr ((hmemQ h).2 hh)
    obtain ⟨P'', hP'', hP''Q⟩ := Ideal.exists_minimalPrimes_le hJQ
    have h1 : P = P'' := le_antisymm (hP.2 hP''.1 (hP''Q.trans hQP)) (hP''Q.trans hQP)
    have h2 : P' = P'' := le_antisymm (hP'.2 hP''.1 (hP''Q.trans hQP')) (hP''Q.trans hQP')
    exact h1.trans h2.symm
  have hJrad : J.radical = J := by
    have h := vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical (K := k) J
    rw [hclosed] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hJtop : J ≠ ⊤ := fun h ↦ by
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hne
    have h1 : (1 : MvPolynomial σ k) ∈ J := h ▸ Submodule.mem_top
    have h2 := mem_vanishingIdeal_iff.1 h1 s hs
    simp at h2
  
  have hcop : ∀ P ∈ J.minimalPrimes, ∀ P' ∈ J.minimalPrimes, P ≠ P' → IsCoprime P P' := by
    intro P hP P' hP' hne'
    rw [Ideal.isCoprime_iff_sup_eq]
    have hempty : zeroLocus k (P ⊔ P') = ∅ := by
      ext c
      simp only [Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
      intro hc
      exact hne' (heq P hP P' hP' c (zeroLocus_anti_mono le_sup_left hc)
        (zeroLocus_anti_mono le_sup_right hc))
    have h := vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical (K := k) (P ⊔ P')
    rw [hempty, vanishingIdeal_empty] at h
    exact Ideal.radical_eq_top.1 h.symm
  
  have hfin := Ideal.finite_minimalPrimes_of_isNoetherianRing (MvPolynomial σ k) J
  have hsing : J.minimalPrimes.Subsingleton := by
    intro P hP P' hP'
    by_contra hne'
    have := hfin.to_subtype
    let f : J.minimalPrimes → Ideal (MvPolynomial σ k) := Subtype.val
    have hpair : Pairwise (Function.onFun IsCoprime f) := fun i j hij ↦
      hcop i.1 i.2 j.1 j.2 fun h ↦ hij (Subtype.ext h)
    have hinf : ⨅ i, f i = J :=
      (sInf_eq_iInf' J.minimalPrimes).symm.trans (Ideal.sInf_minimalPrimes.trans hJrad)
    let e := (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hinf.symm).trans (Ideal.quotientInfRingEquivPiQuotient f hpair)
    let i₀ : J.minimalPrimes := ⟨P, hP⟩
    let i₁ : J.minimalPrimes := ⟨P', hP'⟩
    have hi : i₁ ≠ i₀ := fun h ↦ hne' (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
    have hnt : ∀ i : J.minimalPrimes, Nontrivial (MvPolynomial σ k ⧸ f i) := fun i ↦ by
      have : (f i).IsPrime := i.2.1.1
      infer_instance
    let s : ∀ i : J.minimalPrimes, MvPolynomial σ k ⧸ f i := Pi.single i₀ 1
    have hs : IsIdempotentElem s := by
      funext i
      by_cases hii : i = i₀
      · subst hii
        simp [s]
      · simp [s, hii]
    rcases eq_zero_or_one_of_isIdempotentElem (hs.map e.symm) with h0 | h1
    · have h := congrFun (e.symm.injective (h0.trans (map_zero e.symm).symm)) i₀
      simp [s] at h
    · have h := congrFun (e.symm.injective (h1.trans (map_one e.symm).symm)) i₁
      simp [s, hi] at h
  obtain ⟨⟨P, hP⟩⟩ := Ideal.nonempty_minimalPrimes hJtop
  have hJP : J = P := by
    have hset : J.minimalPrimes = {P} := (hsing.eq_singleton_of_mem hP)
    rw [← hJrad, ← Ideal.sInf_minimalPrimes, hset, sInf_singleton]
  rw [hJP]
  exact hP.1.1

name: AclGeom.surjective_of_isClosedEmbedding_of_finite_topologicalKrullDim
statement:
theorem surjective_of_isClosedEmbedding_of_finite_topologicalKrullDim
    {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [IrreducibleSpace X]
    {f : Y → X} (hf : IsClosedEmbedding f) (n : ℕ)
    (hY : (n : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDim Y)
    (hX : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ n) : Function.Surjective f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hnot
  let F : IrreducibleCloseds Y → IrreducibleCloseds X :=
    IrreducibleCloseds.map f hf.continuous
  have hF : StrictMono F :=
    IrreducibleCloseds.map_strictMono_of_isInducing hf.isEmbedding.isInducing
  let T : IrreducibleCloseds X := ⟨univ, IrreducibleSpace.isIrreducible_univ X, isClosed_univ⟩
  have hsub (S : IrreducibleCloseds Y) : (F S : Set X) ⊆ range f := by
    change closure (f '' (S : Set Y)) ⊆ range f
    exact closure_minimal (image_subset_range _ _) hf.isClosed_range
  have hlt (S : IrreducibleCloseds Y) : F S < T := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne (fun x _ ↦ mem_univ x) ?_
    intro heq
    apply hnot
    intro x
    have hx : x ∈ (F S : Set X) := by
      rw [heq]
      exact mem_univ x
    exact hsub S hx
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := (Order.le_krullDim_iff (α := IrreducibleCloseds Y) (n := n)).1 hY
  let q : LTSeries (IrreducibleCloseds X) := (p.map F hF).snoc T (hlt _)
  have hlen : q.length = n + 1 := by
    change p.length + 1 = n + 1
    rw [hp]
  have hbad : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ n := by
    calc
      _ = (q.length : WithBot ℕ∞) := congrArg (fun m : ℕ ↦ (m : WithBot ℕ∞)) hlen.symm
      _ ≤ topologicalKrullDim X := Order.LTSeries.length_le_krullDim q
      _ ≤ n := hX
  exact (not_le_of_gt (show (n : WithBot ℕ∞) < ((n + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self n)) hbad

name: AclGeom.eq_of_subset_of_finite_topologicalKrullDim
statement:
theorem eq_of_subset_of_finite_topologicalKrullDim
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {A D : Set X}
    (hA : IsClosed A) (hDi : IsIrreducible D) (hAD : A ⊆ D) (n : ℕ)
    (hD : topologicalKrullDim D = n) (hAn : topologicalKrullDim A = n) : A = D
proof:
:= by
  have : IrreducibleSpace D := Subtype.irreducibleSpace hDi
  have hf : IsClosedEmbedding (Set.inclusion hAD) :=
    IsClosedEmbedding.inclusion hAD (hA.preimage continuous_subtype_val)
  have hs := surjective_of_isClosedEmbedding_of_finite_topologicalKrullDim hf n
    hAn.symm.le hD.le
  refine Set.Subset.antisymm hAD ?_
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hs ⟨x, hx⟩
  have he : (a : X) = x := congrArg Subtype.val ha
  rw [← he]
  exact a.property

name: AclGeom.mem_idealOf_iff
statement:
theorem mem_idealOf_iff {a : ι → Ω} {f : MvPolynomial ι k} :
    f ∈ idealOf k a ↔ aeval a f = 0
proof:
:=
  RingHom.mem_ker

name: AclGeom.idealOf_eq_bot_iff
statement:
theorem idealOf_eq_bot_iff {a : ι → Ω} :
    idealOf k a = ⊥ ↔ AlgebraicIndependent k a
proof:
:= by
  rw [AlgebraicIndependent, idealOf, ← RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot]
  exact Iff.rfl

name: AclGeom.idealOf_comp_algHom
statement:
theorem idealOf_comp_algHom {Ω' : Type*} [Field Ω'] [Algebra k Ω']
    (σ : Ω →ₐ[k] Ω') (a : ι → Ω) :
    idealOf k (⇑σ ∘ a) = idealOf k a
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, mem_idealOf_iff]
  have hcomp : aeval (⇑σ ∘ a) f = σ (aeval a f) := by
    rw [Function.comp_def, ← comp_aeval_apply]
  rw [hcomp]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ σ.injective (by rwa [map_zero]), fun h ↦ by rw [h, map_zero]⟩

name: AclGeom.idealOf_eq_of_aeval_iff
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, mem_idealOf_iff]
  exact H f

name: AclGeom.aeval_eq_aeval_of_idealOf_eq
proof:
:= by
  have : f - g ∈ idealOf k a := by
    rw [mem_idealOf_iff, map_sub, sub_eq_zero]
    exact hfg
  rw [h, mem_idealOf_iff, map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at this
  exact this

name: AclGeom.mem_racl_image_of_idealOf_eq
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [mem_racl_iff] at ha ⊢
  
  
  obtain ⟨p, hp0, hpz⟩ : IsAlgebraic (Algebra.adjoin k (a '' J)) (a i) :=
    (IsFractionRing.isAlgebraic_iff (Algebra.adjoin k (a '' J))
      (adjoin k (a '' J)) Ω).2 ha
  have hadj : ∀ c : ι → Ω,
      Algebra.adjoin k (c '' J) = (aeval (fun j : J ↦ c j)).range := fun c ↦ by
    rw [Set.image_eq_range, Algebra.adjoin_range_eq_range_aeval]
  have hrepr : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ g : MvPolynomial J k,
      aeval (fun j : J ↦ a j) g = (p.coeff m : Ω) := fun m ↦
    (AlgHom.mem_range _).1 ((hadj a).le (p.coeff m).2)
  choose q hq using hrepr
  
  have hren : ∀ (c : ι → Ω) (m : ℕ),
      aeval c (rename (Subtype.val : J → ι) (q m)) =
        aeval (fun j : J ↦ c j) (q m) := by
    intro c m
    rw [aeval_rename]
    rfl
  set G : MvPolynomial ι k :=
    ∑ m ∈ p.support, rename (Subtype.val : J → ι) (q m) * X i ^ m with hG
  have hkey : ∀ c : ι → Ω, aeval c G =
      ∑ m ∈ p.support, aeval (fun j : J ↦ c j) (q m) * c i ^ m := by
    intro c
    rw [hG, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ ↦ ?_
    rw [map_mul, map_pow, aeval_X, hren]
  have hpa : ∑ m ∈ p.support, aeval (fun j : J ↦ a j) (q m) * a i ^ m = 0 := by
    have h0 := hpz
    rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, Polynomial.eval₂_eq_sum, Polynomial.sum_def] at h0
    calc ∑ m ∈ p.support, aeval (fun j : J ↦ a j) (q m) * a i ^ m
        = ∑ m ∈ p.support,
            algebraMap (↥(Algebra.adjoin k (a '' J))) Ω (p.coeff m) * a i ^ m :=
          Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ ↦ by rw [hq m]; rfl
      _ = 0 := h0
  
  have hGb : aeval b G = 0 := by
    have hmem : G ∈ idealOf k b := h ▸ (mem_idealOf_iff _).2 ((hkey a).trans hpa)
    exact (mem_idealOf_iff _).1 hmem
  obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀s⟩ := Polynomial.support_nonempty.2 hp0
  have hm₀ : p.coeff m₀ ≠ 0 := Polynomial.mem_support_iff.1 hm₀s
  have hqb0 : aeval (fun j : J ↦ b j) (q m₀) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hb : rename (Subtype.val : J → ι) (q m₀) ∈ idealOf k b := by
      rw [mem_idealOf_iff, hren]
      exact h0
    rw [← h, mem_idealOf_iff, hren, hq m₀] at hb
    exact hm₀ (by exact_mod_cast hb)
  
  refine isAlgebraic_of_coeff_mem (p := ∑ m ∈ p.support,
      Polynomial.C (aeval (fun j : J ↦ b j) (q m)) * Polynomial.X ^ m) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro h0
    have hc : (∑ m ∈ p.support,
        Polynomial.C (aeval (fun j : J ↦ b j) (q m)) * Polynomial.X ^ m).coeff m₀ =
        aeval (fun j : J ↦ b j) (q m₀) := by
      rw [Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ ↦
        Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow (aeval (fun j : J ↦ b j) (q m)) m m₀]
      rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq p.support m₀ fun m ↦ aeval (fun j : J ↦ b j) (q m)]
      exact if_pos hm₀s
    rw [h0, Polynomial.coeff_zero] at hc
    exact hqb0 hc.symm
  · calc (∑ m ∈ p.support,
          Polynomial.C (aeval (fun j : J ↦ b j) (q m)) * Polynomial.X ^ m).eval (b i)
        = ∑ m ∈ p.support, aeval (fun j : J ↦ b j) (q m) * b i ^ m := by
          rw [Polynomial.eval_finsetSum]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ ↦ by
            rw [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_pow,
              Polynomial.eval_X]
      _ = aeval b G := (hkey b).symm
      _ = 0 := hGb
  · intro m
    rw [Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
    refine sum_mem fun mm _ ↦ ?_
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow]
    split
    · have hmem : aeval (fun j : J ↦ b j) (q mm) ∈ Algebra.adjoin k (b '' J) :=
        (hadj b).ge ((AlgHom.mem_range _).2 ⟨q mm, rfl⟩)
      exact algebra_adjoin_le_adjoin k _ hmem
    · exact zero_mem _

name: AclGeom.notMem_racl_image_of_idealOf_eq
proof:
:=
  fun hb ↦ ha (mem_racl_image_of_idealOf_eq k h.symm hb)

name: AclGeom.transcendental_of_idealOf_eq
proof:
:= by
  intro hb
  obtain ⟨p, hp0, hpz⟩ := hb
  
  set f : MvPolynomial ι k := Polynomial.aeval (X j : MvPolynomial ι k) p
    with hf
  have key : ∀ c : ι → Ω, aeval c f = Polynomial.aeval (c j) p := by
    intro c
    rw [hf]
    have hcomp : ((aeval c : MvPolynomial ι k →ₐ[k] Ω).comp
        (Polynomial.aeval (X j : MvPolynomial ι k) : Polynomial k →ₐ[k] _)) =
        Polynomial.aeval (c j) := by
      refine Polynomial.algHom_ext ?_
      simp
    exact congrArg (fun (g : Polynomial k →ₐ[k] Ω) ↦ g p) hcomp
  have hfb : f ∈ idealOf k b := by
    rw [mem_idealOf_iff, key, hpz]
  rw [← h, mem_idealOf_iff, key] at hfb
  exact ha ⟨p, hp0, hfb⟩

name: AclGeom.AdditiveRigidity.polynomialAlgEquiv_fix_zero
statement:
theorem polynomialAlgEquiv_fix_zero {k : Type*} [Field k]
    (e : Polynomial k ≃ₐ[k] Polynomial k)
    (hzero : Polynomial.eval 0 (e Polynomial.X) = 0) :
    ∃ a : kˣ, e Polynomial.X = Polynomial.C (a : k) * Polynomial.X
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : (e Polynomial.X).comp (e.symm Polynomial.X) = Polynomial.X := by
    rw [Polynomial.comp_eq_aeval, Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply,
      Polynomial.aeval_X_left_apply, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hdeg := congrArg Polynomial.natDegree hcomp
  rw [Polynomial.natDegree_comp, Polynomial.natDegree_X] at hdeg
  have hdeg₁ : (e Polynomial.X).natDegree = 1 :=
    Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_one ⟨(e.symm Polynomial.X).natDegree, hdeg.symm⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hab⟩ := Polynomial.natDegree_eq_one.mp hdeg₁
  have hb : b = 0 := by
    rw [← hab] at hzero
    simpa using hzero
  exact ⟨Units.mk0 a ha, by simpa only [hb, Polynomial.C_0, add_zero, Units.val_mk0] using hab.symm⟩

name: AclGeom.AdditiveRigidity.AclGeom.AdditiveRigidity.groupIso_eq_scale
statement:
theorem groupIso_eq_scale (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (e : (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme ≅
      (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme) :
    ∃ a : kˣ, e.hom.hom.hom = scale k (a : k)
proof:
:= by
  let R := AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1
  let A : CommHopfAlgCat.{u} k := .of k R
  let F : (CommHopfAlgCat.{u} k)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Grp (Over (Spec (.of k))) := hopfSpec (.of k)
  have : F.Full := hopfSpec.instFull
  have : F.Faithful := hopfSpec.instFaithful
  let E : A ≅ A := (F.preimageIso (X := .op A) (Y := .op A) e).unop
  have he : F.map E.hom.op = e.hom := F.map_preimage (X := .op A) (Y := .op A) e.hom
  let B : R ≃ₐ[k] R := AlgEquiv.ofAlgHom E.hom.hom.toAlgHom E.inv.hom.toAlgHom
    (by apply AlgHom.ext; intro z; exact CommHopfAlgCat.hom_inv_apply E z)
    (by apply AlgHom.ext; intro z; exact CommHopfAlgCat.inv_hom_apply E z)
  let P : R ≃ₐ[k] Polynomial k :=
    (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial (Pi.basisFun k (Fin 1))).trans
      (MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv k (Fin 1))
  have hPX : P (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k) = Polynomial.X := by
    change (MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv k (Fin 1))
      ((SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial (Pi.basisFun k (Fin 1)))
        (SymmetricAlgebra.ι k (Fin 1 → k) (Pi.basisFun k (Fin 1) 0))) = Polynomial.X
    rw [SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial_ι_apply]
    rw [MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv_apply, MvPolynomial.eval₂_X]
  have hPX' : P.symm Polynomial.X = AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k := by
    rw [← hPX, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have hP₀ : (Polynomial.aeval (0 : k)).comp P.toAlgHom = Bialgebra.counitAlgHom k R := by
    apply AffineSchemeAction.lineHom_ext
    rw [AlgHom.comp_apply]
    change Polynomial.aeval (0 : k) (P (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k)) = _
    rw [hPX, Polynomial.aeval_X]
    change 0 = (Bialgebra.counitAlgHom k (SymmetricAlgebra k (Fin 1 → k)))
      (SymmetricAlgebra.ι k (Fin 1 → k) (Pi.basisFun k (Fin 1) 0))
    simp only [SymmetricAlgebra.counitAlgHom_eq, SymmetricAlgebra.algebraMapInv_ι]
  have hPeval (z : R) : Polynomial.eval 0 (P z) = Bialgebra.counitAlgHom k R z :=
    AlgHom.congr_fun hP₀ z
  let BP : Polynomial k ≃ₐ[k] Polynomial k := P.symm.trans (B.trans P)
  have hzero : Polynomial.eval 0 (BP Polynomial.X) = 0 := by
    change Polynomial.eval 0 (P (B (P.symm Polynomial.X))) = 0
    rw [hPX', hPeval]
    have hc := AlgHom.congr_fun (BialgHom.counitAlgHom_comp E.hom.hom)
      (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k)
    change Bialgebra.counitAlgHom k R (B (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k)) =
      Bialgebra.counitAlgHom k R (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k) at hc
    rw [hc]
    change (Bialgebra.counitAlgHom k (SymmetricAlgebra k (Fin 1 → k)))
      (SymmetricAlgebra.ι k (Fin 1 → k) (Pi.basisFun k (Fin 1) 0)) = 0
    simp only [SymmetricAlgebra.counitAlgHom_eq, SymmetricAlgebra.algebraMapInv_ι]
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := polynomialAlgEquiv_fix_zero BP hzero
  change P (B (P.symm Polynomial.X)) = Polynomial.C (a : k) * Polynomial.X at ha
  rw [hPX'] at ha
  have hφ : E.hom.hom (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k) =
      algebraMap k R (a : k) * AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k := by
    apply P.injective
    change P (B (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k)) = _
    rw [map_mul, P.commutes, hPX]
    exact ha
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  rw [← he]
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom E.hom.hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom) =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval
      (algebraMap k R (a : k) * AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k)).toRingHom)
  apply congrArg Spec.map
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  apply congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom
  apply AffineSchemeAction.lineHom_ext
  rw [AffineSchemeAction.lineEval_lineCoordinate]
  exact hφ

name: AclGeom.exists_plane_clear
statement:
theorem exists_plane_clear (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (q : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k), ∀ g : kˣ × kˣ,
      aeval ![(g.1 : k), (g.2 : k)] q = ((g.1 : k) * g.2) ^ N * aeval (torusEmb g) f
proof:
:= by
  induction f using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a => exact ⟨0, C a, fun g ↦ by simp⟩
  | add p q hp hq =>
    obtain ⟨N, P, hP⟩ := hp
    obtain ⟨M, Q, hQ⟩ := hq
    refine ⟨N + M, P * (X 0 * X 1) ^ M + Q * (X 0 * X 1) ^ N, fun g ↦ ?_⟩
    simp only [map_add, map_mul, map_pow, aeval_X, hP, hQ]
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
    ring
  | mul_X p n hp =>
    obtain ⟨N, P, hP⟩ := hp
    fin_cases n
    · refine ⟨N, P * X 0, fun g ↦ ?_⟩
      simp only [map_mul, aeval_X, hP]
      simp
      ring
    · refine ⟨N, P * X 1, fun g ↦ ?_⟩
      simp only [map_mul, aeval_X, hP]
      simp
      ring
    · refine ⟨N + 1, P * X 1, fun g ↦ ?_⟩
      have h1 : (g.1 : k) ≠ 0 := g.1.ne_zero
      simp only [map_mul, aeval_X, hP]
      simp
      field_simp
      ring
    · refine ⟨N + 1, P * X 0, fun g ↦ ?_⟩
      have h2 : (g.2 : k) ≠ 0 := g.2.ne_zero
      simp only [map_mul, aeval_X, hP]
      simp
      field_simp
      ring

name: AclGeom.exists_curve_clear
statement:
theorem exists_curve_clear (e : Fin 4 → ℤ) (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) k) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (φ : Polynomial k), ∀ t : kˣ,
      φ.eval (t : k) = (t : k) ^ N * aeval (fun j ↦ ((t ^ e j : kˣ) : k)) f
proof:
:= by
  induction f using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a => exact ⟨0, Polynomial.C a, fun t ↦ by simp⟩
  | add p q hp hq =>
    obtain ⟨N, φ, hφ⟩ := hp
    obtain ⟨M, ψ, hψ⟩ := hq
    refine ⟨N + M, φ * Polynomial.X ^ M + ψ * Polynomial.X ^ N, fun t ↦ ?_⟩
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_pow,
      Polynomial.eval_X, hφ, hψ, map_add]
    ring
  | mul_X p j hp =>
    obtain ⟨N, φ, hφ⟩ := hp
    refine ⟨N + (-(e j)).toNat, φ * Polynomial.X ^ (e j).toNat, fun t ↦ ?_⟩
    have hz : ((t ^ e j : kˣ) : k) * (t : k) ^ (-(e j)).toNat = (t : k) ^ (e j).toNat := by
      rw [Units.val_zpow_eq_zpow_val, zpow_eq_pow_toNat_mul_inv_pow, mul_assoc, ← mul_pow,
        inv_mul_cancel₀ t.ne_zero, one_pow, mul_one]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X, hφ, map_mul,
      aeval_X]
    rw [← hz]
    ring

name: AclGeom.exists_sub_C_mem_of_pow_sub_one_mem
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set q : Polynomial k := Polynomial.X ^ n - Polynomial.C 1 with hqdef
  have hmonic : q.Monic := Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C 1 hn
  have hq : q = (q.roots.map fun ζ ↦ Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ζ).prod :=
    (IsAlgClosed.splits q).eq_prod_roots_of_monic hmonic
  have himg : Polynomial.aeval M q = M ^ n - 1 := by
    simp [q]
  rw [← himg, hq, map_multiset_prod, Multiset.map_map] at hM
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyJ⟩ := (hJ.multiset_prod_mem_iff_exists_mem _).1 hM
  obtain ⟨ζ, -, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.1 hy
  refine ⟨ζ, ?_⟩
  simpa [Function.comp, MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq] using hyJ

name: AclGeom.two_le_ringKrullDim_quotient
proof:
:= by
  rw [ringKrullDim_quotient]
  let a : PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (R := R) (P : Set R) := ⟨⟨P, inferInstance⟩, fun _ h ↦ h⟩
  let b : PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (R := R) (P : Set R) :=
    ⟨⟨p₁, inferInstance⟩, fun _ h ↦ h₁.le h⟩
  let c : PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (R := R) (P : Set R) :=
    ⟨⟨p₂, inferInstance⟩, fun _ h ↦ (h₁.trans h₂).le h⟩
  have hab : a < b := h₁
  have hbc : b < c := h₂
  let s : LTSeries (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (R := R) (P : Set R)) :=
    ⟨2, ![a, b, c], fun i ↦ by fin_cases i <;> simp [hab, hbc]⟩
  have := Order.LTSeries.length_le_krullDim s
  exact_mod_cast this

name: AclGeom.pullbackSpec_dominatingComponents
statement:
private theorem pullbackSpec_dominatingComponents
    {A B C K L M : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [CommRing B] [IsDomain B]
    [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] [Field K] [Field L] [Field M]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra A C] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra B L] [IsFractionRing B L] [Algebra C M] [IsFractionRing C M]
    [Algebra A L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower A B L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [Algebra A M] [Algebra K M] [IsScalarTower A C M] [IsScalarTower A K M] :
    {Z : Set ↥(pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A C)))) |
      Z ∈ irreducibleComponents _ ∧
        closure ((pullback.fst _ _ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))).base '' Z) =
          Set.univ} =
      (fun Q : Ideal (L ⊗[K] M) ↦ Scheme.homeoOfIso (pullbackSpecIso A B C).symm ''
        (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.comap
          ((IsLocalization.algebraTensorEquiv (nonZeroDivisors A) K L M).symm.toRingHom.comp
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B L)
              (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A C M)).toRingHom) Q : Set (B ⊗[A] C)) :
          Set (Spec (CommRingCat.of (B ⊗[A] C))))) '' minimalPrimes (L ⊗[K] M)
proof:
:= by
  have hG : (fun Q : Ideal (L ⊗[K] M) ↦ (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.comap
        ((IsLocalization.algebraTensorEquiv (nonZeroDivisors A) K L M).symm.toRingHom.comp
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B L)
            (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A C M)).toRingHom) Q : Set (B ⊗[A] C)) :
          Set (Spec (CommRingCat.of (B ⊗[A] C))))) '' minimalPrimes (L ⊗[K] M) =
      {Z : Set (Spec (CommRingCat.of (B ⊗[A] C))) | Z ∈ irreducibleComponents _ ∧
        closure ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (B ⊗[A] C)))).base '' Z) =
          Set.univ} :=
    dominatingComponents_tensorProduct_fractionRing
  set e := pullbackSpecIso A B C
  set h := Scheme.homeoOfIso e.symm
  
  have hπ : e.inv ≫ pullback.fst _ _ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (B ⊗[A] C))) := by
    rw [pullbackSpecIso_inv_fst'_assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp,
      ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq]
  have hπp : ∀ p, (pullback.fst _ _ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))).base (h p) =
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (B ⊗[A] C)))).base p := fun p ↦ by
    rw [← hπ, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply]
    rfl
  ext Z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hZ, hd⟩
    have hZ' : h ⁻¹' Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (Spec (CommRingCat.of (B ⊗[A] C))) :=
      preimage_mem_irreducibleComponents hZ h.isOpenEmbedding
        (let ⟨p, hp⟩ := hZ.1.nonempty; ⟨p, hp, h.surjective p⟩)
    have himg : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (B ⊗[A] C)))).base '' (h ⁻¹' Z) =
        (pullback.fst _ _ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B))).base '' Z := by
      conv_rhs => rw [← h.image_preimage Z, Set.image_image]
      exact Set.image_congr fun p _ ↦ (hπp p).symm
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQZ⟩ := (Set.ext_iff.1 hG (h ⁻¹' Z)).2 ⟨hZ', himg ▸ hd⟩
    exact ⟨Q, hQ, (congrArg (h '' ·) hQZ).trans (h.image_preimage Z)⟩
  · rintro ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩
    have hmem := (Set.ext_iff.1 hG _).1 ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(congrArg (· ∈ irreducibleComponents _) (h.image_eq_preimage_symm _)).mpr
      (preimage_mem_irreducibleComponents hmem.1 h.symm.isOpenEmbedding
        (let ⟨p, hp⟩ := hmem.1.1.nonempty; ⟨p, hp, h.symm.surjective p⟩)), ?_⟩
    exact (congrArg closure ((Set.image_image _ _ _).trans
      (Set.image_congr fun p _ ↦ hπp p))).trans hmem.2

name: AclGeom.locusPullback_dominatingComponents
statement:
theorem locusPullback_dominatingComponents :
    letI : Algebra 𝔄 𝔅
proof:
:= (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono
      (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right))).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra 𝔄 ℭ := (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono
      (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left))).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra 𝔎 𝔏 := (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
      (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra 𝔎 𝔐 := (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
      (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra 𝔄 𝔏 := ((algebraMap 𝔎 𝔏).comp (algebraMap 𝔄 𝔎)).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra 𝔄 𝔐 := ((algebraMap 𝔎 𝔐).comp (algebraMap 𝔄 𝔎)).toAlgebra
    haveI : IsScalarTower 𝔄 𝔎 𝔏 := .of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
    haveI : IsScalarTower 𝔄 𝔎 𝔐 := .of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
    haveI : IsScalarTower 𝔄 𝔅 𝔏 := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
    haveI : IsScalarTower 𝔄 ℭ 𝔐 := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
    {Z : Set ↥(pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap 𝔄 𝔅)))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap 𝔄 ℭ)))) |
      Z ∈ irreducibleComponents _ ∧
        closure ((pullback.fst _ _ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap 𝔄 𝔅))).base '' Z) =
          Set.univ} =
      (fun Q : Ideal (𝔏 ⊗[𝔎] 𝔐) ↦ Scheme.homeoOfIso (pullbackSpecIso 𝔄 𝔅 ℭ).symm ''
        (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.comap
          ((IsLocalization.algebraTensorEquiv (nonZeroDivisors 𝔄) 𝔎 𝔏 𝔐).symm.toRingHom.comp
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom 𝔄 𝔅 𝔏)
              (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom 𝔄 ℭ 𝔐)).toRingHom) Q : Set (𝔅 ⊗[𝔄] ℭ)) :
          Set (Spec (CommRingCat.of (𝔅 ⊗[𝔄] ℭ))))) '' minimalPrimes (𝔏 ⊗[𝔎] 𝔐) := by
  
  let _ : Algebra 𝔄 𝔅 := (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono
    (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right))).toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝔄 ℭ := (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono
    (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left))).toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝔎 𝔏 := (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
    (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝔎 𝔐 := (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
    (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝔄 𝔏 := ((algebraMap 𝔎 𝔏).comp (algebraMap 𝔄 𝔎)).toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝔄 𝔐 := ((algebraMap 𝔎 𝔐).comp (algebraMap 𝔄 𝔎)).toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower 𝔄 𝔎 𝔏 := .of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have : IsScalarTower 𝔄 𝔎 𝔐 := .of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have : IsScalarTower 𝔄 𝔅 𝔏 := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  have : IsScalarTower 𝔄 ℭ 𝔐 := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  exact pullbackSpec_dominatingComponents

name: AclGeom.AdditiveRigidity.exists_spec_pullback
statement:
theorem exists_spec_pullback (X : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
    (f : X ⟶ (Spec (.of R)).asOver (Spec (.of k))) :
    ∃ φ : R →ₐ[k] Γ(X.left, ⊤),
      φ.toRingHom = ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫ f.left.appTop).hom ∧
      X.left.toSpecΓ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) = f.left
proof:
:= by
  let f₀ : X.left ⟶ Spec (.of R) := f.left
  let b : Γ(Spec (.of R), ⊤) ⟶ Γ(X.left, ⊤) := f₀.appTop
  let β : R →+* Γ(X.left, ⊤) := ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫ b).hom
  have hOver : f₀ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k R)) = X.hom := Over.w f
  have happ : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k R))).appTop ≫ b = X.hom.appTop := by
    dsimp only [b]
    rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop, hOver]
  have hbase : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k R) ≫
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫ b =
      (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ X.hom.appTop := by
    rw [Scheme.ΓSpecIso_inv_naturality_assoc, happ]
  let φ : R →ₐ[k] Γ(X.left, ⊤) :=
    { β with
      commutes' := fun a ↦ congrArg (fun h : CommRingCat.of k ⟶ Γ(X.left, ⊤) ↦ h a) hbase }
  refine ⟨φ, rfl, ?_⟩
  change X.left.toSpecΓ ≫ Spec.map ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫ b) = f₀
  calc
    _ = (X.left.toSpecΓ ≫ Spec.map b) ≫ Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv := by
      rw [Spec.map_comp, Category.assoc]
    _ = (f₀ ≫ (Spec (.of R)).toSpecΓ) ≫ Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv :=
      congrArg (fun h ↦ h ≫ Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv)
        (Scheme.toSpecΓ_naturality f₀).symm
    _ = f₀ := by
      change (f₀ ≫ (Spec (.of R)).isoSpec.hom) ≫
        Spec.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv = f₀
      rw [Scheme.isoSpec_Spec_hom, Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp,
        Iso.inv_hom_id, Spec.map_id, Category.comp_id]

name: AclGeom.closure_image_comap_eq_univ_iff_of_ringEquiv
statement:
private theorem closure_image_comap_eq_univ_iff_of_ringEquiv {A A' T T' : Type*} [CommRing A]
    [CommRing A'] [CommRing T] [CommRing T'] (Φ : T ≃+* T') (e : A ≃+* A') (f : A →+* T)
    (f' : A' →+* T') (hf : ∀ a, Φ (f a) = f' (e a)) (Z : Set (PrimeSpectrum T)) :
    closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap f '' Z) = Set.univ ↔
      closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap f' '' (PrimeSpectrum.homeomorphOfRingEquiv Φ '' Z)) =
        Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : (Φ.symm : T' →+* T).comp f' = f.comp (e.symm : A' →+* A) := by
    ext a
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom]
    rw [Φ.symm_apply_eq, hf, e.apply_symm_apply]
  have himg : PrimeSpectrum.comap f' '' (PrimeSpectrum.homeomorphOfRingEquiv Φ '' Z) =
      PrimeSpectrum.homeomorphOfRingEquiv e '' (PrimeSpectrum.comap f '' Z) := by
    rw [Set.image_image, Set.image_image]
    refine Set.image_congr fun p _ ↦ ?_
    change PrimeSpectrum.comap f' (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Φ.symm : T' →+* T) p) =
      PrimeSpectrum.comap (e.symm : A' →+* A) (PrimeSpectrum.comap f p)
    rw [← PrimeSpectrum.comap_comp_apply, ← PrimeSpectrum.comap_comp_apply, hcomp]
  rw [himg, ← Homeomorph.image_closure]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [h, Set.image_univ_of_surjective (Homeomorph.surjective _)]
  · intro h
    apply (Homeomorph.injective (PrimeSpectrum.homeomorphOfRingEquiv e)).image_injective
    rw [h, Set.image_univ_of_surjective (Homeomorph.surjective _)]

name: AclGeom.dominatingComponents_of_ringEquiv
statement:
private theorem dominatingComponents_of_ringEquiv {A A' T T' L : Type*} [CommRing A]
    [CommRing A'] [CommRing T] [CommRing T'] [CommRing L] (Φ : T ≃+* T') (e : A ≃+* A')
    (f : A →+* T) (f' : A' →+* T') (hf : ∀ a, Φ (f a) = f' (e a)) (φ : T' →+* L)
    (hφ : (fun Q : Ideal L ↦ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.comap φ Q : Set T')) ''
        minimalPrimes L =
      {W | W ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum T') ∧
        closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap f' '' W) = Set.univ}) :
    {Z | Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum T) ∧
        closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap f '' Z) = Set.univ} =
      (fun Q : Ideal L ↦ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus
        (Ideal.comap (φ.comp (Φ : T →+* T')) Q : Set T)) '' minimalPrimes L
proof:
:= by
  let h := PrimeSpectrum.homeomorphOfRingEquiv Φ
  have hd (Z : Set (PrimeSpectrum T)) : closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap f '' Z) = Set.univ ↔
      closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap f' '' (h '' Z)) = Set.univ :=
    closure_image_comap_eq_univ_iff_of_ringEquiv Φ e f f' hf Z
  have hzero (Q : Ideal L) : h ⁻¹' PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.comap φ Q : Set T') =
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.comap (φ.comp (Φ : T →+* T')) Q : Set T) := by
    change PrimeSpectrum.comap (Φ.symm : T' →+* T) ⁻¹' _ = _
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.preimage_comap_zeroLocus]
    congr 1
    ext t
    simp only [Set.mem_image, SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.mem_comap, RingHom.comp_apply,
      RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
      rwa [Φ.apply_symm_apply]
    · exact fun ht ↦ ⟨Φ t, ht, Φ.symm_apply_apply t⟩
  ext Z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hZ, hdZ⟩
    have hW : h '' Z ∈ {W | W ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum T') ∧
        closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap f' '' W) = Set.univ} := by
      refine ⟨?_, (hd Z).1 hdZ⟩
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hZ.1.nonempty
      rw [h.image_eq_preimage_symm]
      exact preimage_mem_irreducibleComponents hZ h.symm.isOpenEmbedding
        ⟨z, hz, h.symm.surjective z⟩
    rw [← hφ] at hW
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQZ⟩ := hW
    refine ⟨Q, hQ, ?_⟩
    change PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.comap (φ.comp (Φ : T →+* T')) Q : Set T) = Z
    change PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.comap φ Q : Set T') = h '' Z at hQZ
    rw [← hzero, hQZ, h.preimage_image]
  · rintro ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨hirr, hdense⟩ := hφ ▸ Set.mem_image_of_mem
      (fun Q : Ideal L ↦ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.comap φ Q : Set T')) hQ
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · change PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.comap (φ.comp (Φ : T →+* T')) Q : Set T) ∈
        irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum T)
      rw [← hzero]
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hirr.1.nonempty
      exact preimage_mem_irreducibleComponents hirr h.isOpenEmbedding ⟨w, hw, h.surjective w⟩
    · change closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap f ''
        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.comap (φ.comp (Φ : T →+* T')) Q : Set T)) = Set.univ
      rw [hd, ← hzero, h.image_preimage]
      exact hdense

name: AclGeom.exists_dominatingComponents_of_ringEquiv
statement:
private theorem exists_dominatingComponents_of_ringEquiv {A B C A' B' C' K L M : Type*}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C] [Algebra A B] [Algebra A C]
    [CommRing A'] [IsDomain A'] [CommRing B'] [IsDomain B'] [CommRing C'] [IsDomain C']
    [Field K] [Field L] [Field M] [Algebra A' B'] [Algebra A' C'] [Algebra A' K]
    [IsFractionRing A' K] [Algebra B' L] [IsFractionRing B' L] [Algebra C' M] [IsFractionRing C' M]
    [Algebra A' L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower A' B' L] [IsScalarTower A' K L]
    [Algebra A' M] [Algebra K M] [IsScalarTower A' C' M] [IsScalarTower A' K M]
    (Φ : B ⊗[A] C ≃+* B' ⊗[A'] C') (eA : A ≃+* A') (eB : B ≃+* B') (eC : C ≃+* C')
    (htmul : ∀ b c, Φ (b ⊗ₜ c) = eB b ⊗ₜ eC c)
    (hbase : ∀ a, Φ (algebraMap A (B ⊗[A] C) a) = algebraMap A' (B' ⊗[A'] C') (eA a)) :
    ∃ ψ : B ⊗[A] C →+* L ⊗[K] M,
      (∀ b c, ψ (b ⊗ₜ c) = algebraMap B' L (eB b) ⊗ₜ algebraMap C' M (eC c)) ∧
      {Z | Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum (B ⊗[A] C)) ∧
          closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (B ⊗[A] C)) '' Z) = Set.univ} =
        (fun Q : Ideal (L ⊗[K] M) ↦ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.comap ψ Q : Set (B ⊗[A] C))) ''
          minimalPrimes (L ⊗[K] M)
proof:
:= by
  let φ : B' ⊗[A'] C' →+* L ⊗[K] M :=
    (IsLocalization.algebraTensorEquiv (nonZeroDivisors A') K L M).symm.toRingHom.comp
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A' B' L)
        (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A' C' M)).toRingHom
  have hφ : (fun Q : Ideal (L ⊗[K] M) ↦
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.comap φ Q : Set (B' ⊗[A'] C'))) '' minimalPrimes (L ⊗[K] M) =
      {W | W ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum (B' ⊗[A'] C')) ∧
        closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A' (B' ⊗[A'] C')) '' W) = Set.univ} :=
    dominatingComponents_tensorProduct_fractionRing
  exact ⟨φ.comp (Φ : B ⊗[A] C →+* B' ⊗[A'] C'), fun b c ↦ (congrArg φ (htmul b c)).trans rfl,
    dominatingComponents_of_ringEquiv Φ eA (algebraMap A (B ⊗[A] C))
      (algebraMap A' (B' ⊗[A'] C')) hbase φ hφ⟩

name: AclGeom.exists_dominatingComponents_of_algEquiv
statement:
private theorem exists_dominatingComponents_of_algEquiv {R A T Q L : Type*} [CommRing R]
    [CommRing A] [CommRing T] [CommRing Q] [CommRing L] [Algebra R T] [Algebra R Q]
    (Φ : T ≃ₐ[R] Q) (f : A →+* T) (fQ : A →+* Q) (hf : ∀ a, Φ (f a) = fQ a) (ψ : T →+* L)
    (hψ : {Z | Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum T) ∧
        closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap f '' Z) = Set.univ} =
      (fun P : Ideal L ↦ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.comap ψ P : Set T)) '' minimalPrimes L) :
    ∃ ψ' : Q →+* L, (∀ t, ψ' (Φ t) = ψ t) ∧
      {Z | Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum Q) ∧
          closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap fQ '' Z) = Set.univ} =
        (fun P : Ideal L ↦ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.comap ψ' P : Set Q)) '' minimalPrimes L
proof:
:=
  ⟨ψ.comp (Φ.symm.toRingEquiv : Q →+* T), fun t ↦ congrArg ψ (Φ.symm_apply_apply t),
    dominatingComponents_of_ringEquiv Φ.symm.toRingEquiv (RingEquiv.refl A) fQ f
      (fun a ↦ Φ.symm_apply_eq.2 (hf a).symm) ψ hψ.symm⟩

name: AclGeom.endDominance_of_ringEquiv
statement:
private theorem endDominance_of_ringEquiv {A B C X Z A' B' C' X' Z' : Type*}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C] [CommRing X] [CommRing Z] [Algebra A B] [Algebra A C]
    [CommRing A'] [CommRing B'] [CommRing C'] [CommRing X'] [CommRing Z']
    [IsDomain A'] [IsDomain B'] [IsDomain C'] [IsDomain X'] [IsDomain Z']
    [Algebra A' B'] [Algebra A' C'] [Algebra X' B'] [Algebra Z' C']
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic A' B'] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic X' B'] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic A' C']
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic Z' C']
    (hAB : Function.Injective (algebraMap A' B')) (hXB : Function.Injective (algebraMap X' B'))
    (hAC : Function.Injective (algebraMap A' C')) (hZC : Function.Injective (algebraMap Z' C'))
    (Φ : B ⊗[A] C ≃+* B' ⊗[A'] C') (eA : A ≃+* A') (eB : B ≃+* B') (eC : C ≃+* C')
    (eX : X ≃+* X') (eZ : Z ≃+* Z') (fX : X →+* B) (fZ : Z →+* C)
    (htmul : ∀ b c, Φ (b ⊗ₜ c) = eB b ⊗ₜ eC c)
    (hbase : ∀ a, Φ (algebraMap A (B ⊗[A] C) a) = algebraMap A' (B' ⊗[A'] C') (eA a))
    (hX : ∀ u, eB (fX u) = algebraMap X' B' (eX u)) (hZ : ∀ u, eC (fZ u) = algebraMap Z' C' (eZ u))
    (W : Set (PrimeSpectrum (B ⊗[A] C))) :
    (closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (B ⊗[A] C)) '' W) = Set.univ ↔
      closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom.comp fX) '' W) =
        Set.univ) ∧
    (closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (B ⊗[A] C)) '' W) = Set.univ ↔
      closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : C →ₐ[A] B ⊗[A] C).toRingHom.comp fZ) '' W) =
        Set.univ)
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have : IsScalarTower A' B' (B' ⊗[A'] C') := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  let _ : Algebra C' (B' ⊗[A'] C') := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra Z' (B' ⊗[A'] C') :=
    ((algebraMap C' (B' ⊗[A'] C')).comp (algebraMap Z' C')).toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower Z' C' (B' ⊗[A'] C') := .of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have hY := closure_image_comap_eq_univ_iff_of_ringEquiv Φ eA (algebraMap A (B ⊗[A] C))
    (algebraMap A' (B' ⊗[A'] C')) hbase W
  have hXd := closure_image_comap_eq_univ_iff_of_ringEquiv Φ eX
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom.comp fX) (algebraMap X' (B' ⊗[A'] C'))
    (fun u ↦ by
      change Φ (fX u ⊗ₜ[A] 1) = algebraMap X' B' (eX u) ⊗ₜ[A'] 1
      rw [htmul, hX, map_one]) W
  have hZd := closure_image_comap_eq_univ_iff_of_ringEquiv Φ eZ
    ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : C →ₐ[A] B ⊗[A] C).toRingHom.comp fZ)
    (algebraMap Z' (B' ⊗[A'] C'))
    (fun u ↦ by
      change Φ (1 ⊗ₜ[A] fZ u) = 1 ⊗ₜ[A'] algebraMap Z' C' (eZ u)
      rw [htmul, map_one, hZ]) W
