  exact ⟨hY.trans (((denseImage_iff_of_isAlgebraic hAB _).trans
      (denseImage_iff_of_isAlgebraic hXB _).symm).trans hXd.symm),
    hY.trans (((denseImage_iff_of_isAlgebraic hAC _).trans
      (denseImage_iff_of_isAlgebraic hZC _).symm).trans hZd.symm)⟩

name: AclGeom.exists_locusQuotient_dominatingComponents
statement:
theorem exists_locusQuotient_dominatingComponents :
    letI : Algebra 𝒜 ℬ
proof:
:= (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim x y)) (rename Sum.inr)
      (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim x y) (b := y) (g := Sum.inr)
        rfl).le).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra 𝒜 𝒞 := (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim y z)) (rename Sum.inl)
      (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim y z) (b := y) (g := Sum.inl)
        rfl).le).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra 𝔎 𝔏 := (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
      (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra 𝔎 𝔐 := (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
      (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    ∃ ψ : ℬ ⊗[𝒜] 𝒞 →+* 𝔏 ⊗[𝔎] 𝔐,
      (∀ (a : ℬ) (b : 𝒞), ψ (a ⊗ₜ b) =
        algebraMap 𝔅 𝔏 (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (Sum.elim x y) a) ⊗ₜ
          algebraMap ℭ 𝔐 (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (Sum.elim y z) b)) ∧
      {Z : Set (PrimeSpectrum (ℬ ⊗[𝒜] 𝒞)) | Z ∈ irreducibleComponents _ ∧
          closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap 𝒜 (ℬ ⊗[𝒜] 𝒞)) '' Z) = Set.univ} =
        (fun Q : Ideal (𝔏 ⊗[𝔎] 𝔐) ↦
          PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.comap ψ Q : Set (ℬ ⊗[𝒜] 𝒞))) ''
          minimalPrimes (𝔏 ⊗[𝔎] 𝔐) := by
  
  let _ : Algebra 𝒜 ℬ := (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim x y)) (rename Sum.inr)
    (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim x y) (b := y) (g := Sum.inr)
      rfl).le).toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝒜 𝒞 := (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim y z)) (rename Sum.inl)
    (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim y z) (b := y) (g := Sum.inl)
      rfl).le).toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝔎 𝔏 := (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
    (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝔎 𝔐 := (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
    (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝔄 𝔅 := (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono
    (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right))).toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝔄 ℭ := (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono
    (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left))).toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝔄 𝔏 := ((algebraMap 𝔎 𝔏).comp (algebraMap 𝔄 𝔎)).toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝔄 𝔐 := ((algebraMap 𝔎 𝔐).comp (algebraMap 𝔄 𝔎)).toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower 𝔄 𝔎 𝔏 := .of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have : IsScalarTower 𝔄 𝔎 𝔐 := .of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have : IsScalarTower 𝔄 𝔅 𝔏 := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  have : IsScalarTower 𝔄 ℭ 𝔐 := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ ↦ rfl
  obtain ⟨Φ, htmul, hbase⟩ := exists_locusQuotientTensor_algEquiv (k := k) x y z
  exact exists_dominatingComponents_of_ringEquiv Φ.toRingEquiv
    (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (k := k) y).toRingEquiv
    (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (k := k) (Sum.elim x y)).toRingEquiv
    (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (k := k) (Sum.elim y z)).toRingEquiv htmul hbase

name: AclGeom.locusQuotient_endDominance
statement:
theorem locusQuotient_endDominance (hxy : ∀ i, x i ∈ racl k (Set.range y))
    (hyx : ∀ j, y j ∈ racl k (Set.range x)) (hzy : ∀ i, z i ∈ racl k (Set.range y))
    (hyz : ∀ j, y j ∈ racl k (Set.range z)) :
    letI : Algebra 𝒜 ℬ
proof:
:= (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim x y)) (rename Sum.inr)
      (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim x y) (b := y) (g := Sum.inr)
        rfl).le).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra 𝒜 𝒞 := (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim y z)) (rename Sum.inl)
      (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim y z) (b := y) (g := Sum.inl)
        rfl).le).toAlgebra
    ∀ W : Set (PrimeSpectrum (ℬ ⊗[𝒜] 𝒞)),
      (closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap 𝒜 (ℬ ⊗[𝒜] 𝒞)) '' W) = Set.univ ↔
        closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom.comp
          (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim x y)) (rename Sum.inl)
            (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim x y) (b := x) (g := Sum.inl)
              rfl).le).toRingHom) '' W) = Set.univ) ∧
      (closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap 𝒜 (ℬ ⊗[𝒜] 𝒞)) '' W) = Set.univ ↔
        closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap
          ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : 𝒞 →ₐ[𝒜] ℬ ⊗[𝒜] 𝒞).toRingHom.comp
            (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim y z)) (rename Sum.inr)
              (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim y z) (b := z) (g := Sum.inr)
                rfl).le).toRingHom) '' W) = Set.univ) := by
  
  let _ : Algebra 𝒜 ℬ := (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim x y)) (rename Sum.inr)
    (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim x y) (b := y) (g := Sum.inr)
      rfl).le).toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝒜 𝒞 := (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim y z)) (rename Sum.inl)
    (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim y z) (b := y) (g := Sum.inl)
      rfl).le).toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝔄 𝔅 := (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono
    (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right))).toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝔄 ℭ := (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono
    (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left))).toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝔛 𝔅 := (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono
    (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_left))).toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra ℨ ℭ := (Subalgebra.inclusion (Algebra.adjoin_mono
    (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_right))).toAlgebra
  
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic 𝔄 𝔅 := isAlgebraic_adjoin_of_subset_racl (k := k) _ _
    (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right) (by
      rw [Set.Sum.elim_range]
      exact Set.union_subset (Set.range_subset_iff.2 hxy) (subset_racl k _))
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic 𝔛 𝔅 := isAlgebraic_adjoin_of_subset_racl (k := k) _ _
    (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_left) (by
      rw [Set.Sum.elim_range]
      exact Set.union_subset (subset_racl k _) (Set.range_subset_iff.2 hyx))
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic 𝔄 ℭ := isAlgebraic_adjoin_of_subset_racl (k := k) _ _
    (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left) (by
      rw [Set.Sum.elim_range]
      exact Set.union_subset (subset_racl k _) (Set.range_subset_iff.2 hzy))
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℨ ℭ := isAlgebraic_adjoin_of_subset_racl (k := k) _ _
    (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_right) (by
      rw [Set.Sum.elim_range]
      exact Set.union_subset (Set.range_subset_iff.2 hyz) (subset_racl k _))
  obtain ⟨Φ, htmul, hbase⟩ := exists_locusQuotientTensor_algEquiv (k := k) x y z
  intro W
  exact endDominance_of_ringEquiv (Subalgebra.inclusion_injective _)
    (Subalgebra.inclusion_injective _) (Subalgebra.inclusion_injective _)
    (Subalgebra.inclusion_injective _) Φ.toRingEquiv
    (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (k := k) y).toRingEquiv
    (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (k := k) (Sum.elim x y)).toRingEquiv
    (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (k := k) (Sum.elim y z)).toRingEquiv
    (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (k := k) x).toRingEquiv
    (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (k := k) z).toRingEquiv
    (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim x y)) (rename Sum.inl)
      (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim x y) (b := x) (g := Sum.inl) rfl).le).toRingHom
    (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim y z)) (rename Sum.inr)
      (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim y z) (b := z) (g := Sum.inr) rfl).le).toRingHom
    htmul hbase
    (AlgHom.congr_fun (locusCoordinateRingEquiv_comp_quotientMapₐ (k := k) (a := Sum.elim x y)
      (b := x) (g := Sum.inl) rfl))
    (AlgHom.congr_fun (locusCoordinateRingEquiv_comp_quotientMapₐ (k := k) (a := Sum.elim y z)
      (b := z) (g := Sum.inr) rfl)) W

name: AclGeom.exists_locusIncidence_dominatingComponents
statement:
theorem exists_locusIncidence_dominatingComponents :
    letI : Algebra 𝔎 𝔏
proof:
:= (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
      (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra 𝔎 𝔐 := (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
      (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
    ∃ ψ : MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k ⧸ ℐ →+* 𝔏 ⊗[𝔎] 𝔐,
      (∀ (p : MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) k) (q : MvPolynomial (β ⊕ γ) k),
        ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ
            (rename Sum.inl p * rename (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) Sum.inr) q)) =
          algebraMap 𝔅 𝔏 (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (Sum.elim x y) (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p)) ⊗ₜ
            algebraMap ℭ 𝔐 (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (Sum.elim y z) (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ q))) ∧
      {Z : Set (PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k ⧸ ℐ)) |
          Z ∈ irreducibleComponents _ ∧
          closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.quotientMapₐ ℐ (rename (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr))
            (idealOf_le_comap_rename_comp (a := Sum.elim x y) (b := y) (g := Sum.inr)
              (e := Sum.inl) rfl le_sup_left)).toRingHom '' Z) = Set.univ} =
        (fun Q : Ideal (𝔏 ⊗[𝔎] 𝔐) ↦ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus
          (Ideal.comap ψ Q : Set (MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k ⧸ ℐ))) ''
          minimalPrimes (𝔏 ⊗[𝔎] 𝔐) := by
  
  let _ : Algebra 𝒜 ℬ := (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim x y)) (rename Sum.inr)
    (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim x y) (b := y) (g := Sum.inr)
      rfl).le).toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝒜 𝒞 := (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim y z)) (rename Sum.inl)
    (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim y z) (b := y) (g := Sum.inl)
      rfl).le).toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝔎 𝔏 := (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
    (Set.Sum.elim_range x y ▸ Set.subset_union_right))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝔎 𝔐 := (IntermediateField.inclusion (IntermediateField.adjoin.mono k _ _
    (Set.Sum.elim_range y z ▸ Set.subset_union_left))).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower k 𝒜 ℬ := .of_algHom _
  obtain ⟨Φ, htmul, hbase⟩ := exists_locusIncidence_algEquiv (k := k) x y z
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, hset⟩ := exists_locusQuotient_dominatingComponents (k := k) x y z
  have hY (a : 𝒜) : Φ (algebraMap 𝒜 (ℬ ⊗[𝒜] 𝒞) a) =
      (Ideal.quotientMapₐ ℐ (rename (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr))
        (idealOf_le_comap_rename_comp (a := Sum.elim x y) (b := y) (g := Sum.inr)
          (e := Sum.inl) rfl le_sup_left)).toRingHom a := by
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a
    exact hbase p
  obtain ⟨ψ', hψ', hset'⟩ := exists_dominatingComponents_of_algEquiv Φ
    (algebraMap 𝒜 (ℬ ⊗[𝒜] 𝒞)) _ hY ψ hset
  exact ⟨ψ', fun p q ↦ (congrArg ψ' (htmul p q)).symm.trans ((hψ' _).trans (hψ _ _)), hset'⟩

name: AclGeom.locusIncidence_endDominance
statement:
theorem locusIncidence_endDominance (hxy : ∀ i, x i ∈ racl k (Set.range y))
    (hyx : ∀ j, y j ∈ racl k (Set.range x)) (hzy : ∀ i, z i ∈ racl k (Set.range y))
    (hyz : ∀ j, y j ∈ racl k (Set.range z)) :
    ∀ W : Set (PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k ⧸ ℐ)),
      (closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.quotientMapₐ ℐ (rename (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr))
          (idealOf_le_comap_rename_comp (a := Sum.elim x y) (b := y) (g := Sum.inr)
            (e := Sum.inl) rfl le_sup_left)).toRingHom '' W) = Set.univ ↔
        closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.quotientMapₐ ℐ (rename (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl))
          (idealOf_le_comap_rename_comp (a := Sum.elim x y) (b := x) (g := Sum.inl)
            (e := Sum.inl) rfl le_sup_left)).toRingHom '' W) = Set.univ) ∧
      (closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.quotientMapₐ ℐ (rename (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr))
          (idealOf_le_comap_rename_comp (a := Sum.elim x y) (b := y) (g := Sum.inr)
            (e := Sum.inl) rfl le_sup_left)).toRingHom '' W) = Set.univ ↔
        closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.quotientMapₐ ℐ (rename Sum.inr)
          (idealOf_le_comap_rename_comp (a := Sum.elim y z) (b := z) (g := Sum.inr)
            (e := Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) Sum.inr) rfl le_sup_right)).toRingHom '' W) =
          Set.univ)
proof:
:= by
  
  let _ : Algebra 𝒜 ℬ := (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim x y)) (rename Sum.inr)
    (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim x y) (b := y) (g := Sum.inr)
      rfl).le).toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra 𝒜 𝒞 := (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim y z)) (rename Sum.inl)
    (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim y z) (b := y) (g := Sum.inl)
      rfl).le).toAlgebra
  obtain ⟨Φ, htmul, hbase⟩ := exists_locusIncidence_algEquiv (k := k) x y z
  have hL2 := locusQuotient_endDominance (k := k) x y z hxy hyx hzy hyz
  have hY (a : 𝒜) : Φ.symm.toRingEquiv ((Ideal.quotientMapₐ ℐ (rename (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr))
      (idealOf_le_comap_rename_comp (a := Sum.elim x y) (b := y) (g := Sum.inr)
        (e := Sum.inl) rfl le_sup_left)).toRingHom a) =
      algebraMap 𝒜 (ℬ ⊗[𝒜] 𝒞) (RingEquiv.refl 𝒜 a) := by
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a
    exact Φ.symm_apply_eq.2 (hbase p).symm
  have hX (u : 𝒳) : Φ.symm.toRingEquiv ((Ideal.quotientMapₐ ℐ (rename (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl))
      (idealOf_le_comap_rename_comp (a := Sum.elim x y) (b := x) (g := Sum.inl)
        (e := Sum.inl) rfl le_sup_left)).toRingHom u) =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom.comp
        (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim x y)) (rename Sum.inl)
          (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim x y) (b := x) (g := Sum.inl)
            rfl).le).toRingHom) (RingEquiv.refl 𝒳 u) := by
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective u
    have h := htmul (rename Sum.inl p) 1
    rw [map_one, map_one, mul_one, rename_rename] at h
    exact Φ.symm_apply_eq.2 h.symm
  have hZ (u : 𝒵) : Φ.symm.toRingEquiv ((Ideal.quotientMapₐ ℐ (rename Sum.inr)
      (idealOf_le_comap_rename_comp (a := Sum.elim y z) (b := z) (g := Sum.inr)
        (e := Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) Sum.inr) rfl le_sup_right)).toRingHom u) =
      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : 𝒞 →ₐ[𝒜] ℬ ⊗[𝒜] 𝒞).toRingHom.comp
        (Ideal.quotientMapₐ (idealOf k (Sum.elim y z)) (rename Sum.inr)
          (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (a := Sum.elim y z) (b := z) (g := Sum.inr)
            rfl).le).toRingHom) (RingEquiv.refl 𝒵 u) := by
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective u
    have h := htmul 1 (rename Sum.inr p)
    rw [map_one, map_one, one_mul, rename_rename] at h
    exact Φ.symm_apply_eq.2 h.symm
  intro W
  have hYd := closure_image_comap_eq_univ_iff_of_ringEquiv Φ.symm.toRingEquiv
    (RingEquiv.refl 𝒜) _ _ hY W
  have hXd := closure_image_comap_eq_univ_iff_of_ringEquiv Φ.symm.toRingEquiv
    (RingEquiv.refl 𝒳) _ _ hX W
  have hZd := closure_image_comap_eq_univ_iff_of_ringEquiv Φ.symm.toRingEquiv
    (RingEquiv.refl 𝒵) _ _ hZ W
  exact ⟨hYd.trans ((hL2 _).1.trans hXd.symm), hYd.trans ((hL2 _).2.trans hZd.symm)⟩

name: AclGeom.exists_map_eq_of_eval₂_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_map_eq_of_eval₂_eq_zero [Infinite k]
    (hk : ∀ y : K, IsAlgebraic k y → y ∈ (algebraMap k K).range)
    {x : Polynomial K} {P : Polynomial (Polynomial k)} (hP : P ≠ 0)
    (hPx : Polynomial.eval₂ (mapRingHom (algebraMap k K)) x P = 0) :
    ∃ y : Polynomial k, x = y.map (algebraMap k K)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set φ := algebraMap k K with hφ
  
  obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := Polynomial.support_nonempty.2 hP
  have hc₀ : P.coeff i₀ ≠ 0 := Polynomial.mem_support_iff.1 hi₀
  set bad : Finset k := (P.coeff i₀).roots.toFinset with hbad
  
  have hval : ∀ τ : k, τ ∉ bad → ∃ c : k, x.eval (φ τ) = φ c := by
    intro τ hτ
    have hPτ : P.map (evalRingHom τ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have hcoeff := congrArg (fun q ↦ Polynomial.coeff q i₀) h0
      simp only [Polynomial.coeff_map, Polynomial.coeff_zero] at hcoeff
      exact hτ (Multiset.mem_toFinset.2 (Polynomial.mem_roots'.2 ⟨hc₀, hcoeff⟩))
    have hcomp : (evalRingHom (φ τ)).comp (mapRingHom φ) =
        φ.comp (evalRingHom τ) := by
      refine RingHom.ext fun q ↦ ?_
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, coe_mapRingHom, coe_evalRingHom]
      rw [eval_map, eval₂_at_apply]
    have hrel : Polynomial.eval₂ (φ.comp (evalRingHom τ)) (x.eval (φ τ)) P = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (evalRingHom (φ τ)) hPx
      rw [map_zero, Polynomial.hom_eval₂, hcomp] at h
      exact h
    have halg : IsAlgebraic k (x.eval (φ τ)) := by
      refine ⟨P.map (evalRingHom τ), hPτ, ?_⟩
      rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, Polynomial.eval₂_map]
      exact hrel
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := RingHom.mem_range.1 (hk _ halg)
    exact ⟨c, hc.symm⟩
  
  obtain ⟨s, hs_sub, hs_card⟩ := Set.Infinite.exists_subset_card_eq
    ((Set.infinite_univ (α := k)).sdiff bad.finite_toSet) (x.natDegree + 1)
  have hs_good : ∀ τ ∈ s, τ ∉ bad := fun τ hτ ↦ (hs_sub hτ).2
  
  set r : k → k := fun τ ↦ if h : τ ∉ bad then Classical.choose (hval τ h) else 0
    with hr
  have hrspec : ∀ τ ∈ s, x.eval (φ τ) = φ (r τ) := by
    intro τ hτ
    rw [hr]
    simp only [hs_good τ hτ]
    exact Classical.choose_spec (hval τ (hs_good τ hτ))
  set y : Polynomial k := Lagrange.interpolate s id r with hy
  refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
  
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun τ : k ↦ φ τ) s := fun a _ b _ h ↦
    (algebraMap k K).injective h
  refine Polynomial.eq_of_degrees_lt_of_eval_index_eq (v := fun τ : k ↦ φ τ)
    s hinj ?_ ?_ ?_
  · calc x.degree ≤ (x.natDegree : WithBot ℕ) := Polynomial.degree_le_natDegree
      _ < (s.card : WithBot ℕ) := by
          rw [hs_card]
          exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_succ_self _
  · calc (y.map φ).degree ≤ y.degree := Polynomial.degree_map_le
      _ < (s.card : WithBot ℕ) :=
          Lagrange.degree_interpolate_lt _ (Set.injOn_id _)
  · intro τ hτ
    have hnode := Lagrange.eval_interpolate_at_node (v := id) (r := r)
      (Set.injOn_id _) hτ
    simp only [id_eq] at hnode
    rw [eval_map, eval₂_at_apply, hy, hnode]
    exact hrspec τ hτ

name: AclGeom.mem_range_algebraMap_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem mem_range_algebraMap_of_isAlgebraic [IsAlgClosed k] {y : K}
    (hy : IsAlgebraic k y) : y ∈ (algebraMap k K).range
proof:
:= by
  have hint : IsIntegral k y := hy.isIntegral
  refine ⟨-(minpoly k y).coeff 0, ?_⟩
  have hq : (minpoly k y).leadingCoeff = 1 := minpoly.monic hint
  have h1 : (minpoly k y).degree = 1 :=
    IsAlgClosed.degree_eq_one_of_irreducible k (minpoly.irreducible hint)
  have h0 : aeval y (minpoly k y) = 0 := minpoly.aeval k y
  rw [eq_X_add_C_of_degree_eq_one h1, hq, C_1, one_mul, aeval_add, aeval_X,
    aeval_C, add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg] at h0
  exact (map_neg (algebraMap k K) ((minpoly k y).coeff 0)).symm ▸ h0.symm

name: AclGeom.exists_map_eq_of_eval₂_eq_zero_of_isAlgClosed
statement:
theorem exists_map_eq_of_eval₂_eq_zero_of_isAlgClosed [IsAlgClosed k]
    {x : Polynomial K} {P : Polynomial (Polynomial k)} (hP : P ≠ 0)
    (hPx : Polynomial.eval₂ (mapRingHom (algebraMap k K)) x P = 0) :
    ∃ y : Polynomial k, x = y.map (algebraMap k K)
proof:
:=
  exists_map_eq_of_eval₂_eq_zero (fun _ hy ↦ mem_range_algebraMap_of_isAlgebraic hy)
    hP hPx

name: AclGeom.coordPoly_coeff
statement:
theorem coordPoly_coeff (b : Module.Basis ι k K') (j : ι) (q : Polynomial K')
    (m : ℕ) : (coordPoly b j q).coeff m = b.repr (q.coeff m) j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coordPoly, Polynomial.sum_def, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦
    Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow (b.repr (q.coeff i) j) i m]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq q.support m fun i ↦ b.repr (q.coeff i) j]
  by_cases hm : m ∈ q.support
  · rw [if_pos hm]
  · rw [if_neg hm, Polynomial.notMem_support_iff.1 hm, map_zero,
      Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply]

name: AclGeom.eval_coordPoly
statement:
theorem eval_coordPoly (b : Module.Basis ι k K') (j : ι) (q : Polynomial K')
    (τ : k) :
    (coordPoly b j q).eval τ = b.repr (q.eval (algebraMap k K' τ)) j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [coordPoly, Polynomial.sum_def, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum]
  have hq : q.eval (algebraMap k K' τ) = ∑ m ∈ q.support, τ ^ m • q.coeff m := by
    rw [Polynomial.eval_eq_sum, Polynomial.sum_def]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ ↦ ?_
    rw [Algebra.smul_def, map_pow, mul_comm]
  rw [hq, map_sum, Finsupp.coe_finset_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ ↦ ?_
  rw [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_pow,
    Polynomial.eval_X, map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: AclGeom.coordPoly_mul_map
statement:
theorem coordPoly_mul_map (b : Module.Basis ι k K') (j : ι)
    (r : Polynomial K') (q : Polynomial k) :
    coordPoly b j (r * q.map (algebraMap k K')) = coordPoly b j r * q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext m
  rw [coordPoly_coeff, Polynomial.coeff_mul, Polynomial.coeff_mul, map_sum,
    Finsupp.coe_finset_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ ↦ ?_
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_map, coordPoly_coeff]
  have h1 : r.coeff x.1 * algebraMap k K' (q.coeff x.2) =
      q.coeff x.2 • r.coeff x.1 := by
    rw [Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm]
  rw [h1, map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

name: AclGeom.mem_adjoin_base_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem mem_adjoin_base_of_isAlgebraic [Infinite k]
    (hk : ∀ y : K', IsAlgebraic k y → y ∈ (algebraMap k K').range)
    {u c : Ω} (hu : Transcendental K' u)
    (hcK : c ∈ adjoin K' ({u} : Set Ω))
    (hcalg : IsAlgebraic ↥(adjoin k ({u} : Set Ω)) c) :
    c ∈ adjoin k ({u} : Set Ω)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set φ' := algebraMap k K' with hφ'
  
  obtain ⟨r, s, hc⟩ := (mem_adjoin_simple_iff K' c).1 hcK
  rcases eq_or_ne (Polynomial.aeval u s) 0 with hs0 | hs0
  · rw [hc, hs0, div_zero]
    exact zero_mem _
  have hcs : c * Polynomial.aeval u s = Polynomial.aeval u r := by
    rw [hc, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hs0]
  have hs_ne : s ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hs0 (by rw [h, map_zero])
  
  have hcalg' : IsAlgebraic ↥(Algebra.adjoin k ({u} : Set Ω)) c :=
    (IsFractionRing.isAlgebraic_iff (Algebra.adjoin k ({u} : Set Ω))
      (adjoin k ({u} : Set Ω)) Ω).2 hcalg
  obtain ⟨p, hp0, hpc⟩ := hcalg'
  have hrepr : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ P : Polynomial k,
      Polynomial.aeval u P = (p.coeff m : Ω) := by
    intro m
    have hle := (Algebra.adjoin_singleton_eq_range_aeval k u).le
    exact (AlgHom.mem_range _).1 (hle (p.coeff m).2)
  choose P hP using hrepr
  set n := p.natDegree with hn
  have hlead : Polynomial.aeval u (P n) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hP n]
    exact_mod_cast Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.2 hp0
  have hPn : P n ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hlead (by rw [h, map_zero])
  
  have huk : Transcendental k u := fun halg ↦ hu (halg.tower_top K')
  
  set E : Polynomial K' := ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
    (P m).map φ' * r ^ m * s ^ (n - m) with hE
  have hEval : Polynomial.aeval u E = 0 := by
    have hexp : Polynomial.aeval c p =
        ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (p.coeff m : Ω) * c ^ m := by
      rw [Polynomial.aeval_eq_sum_range]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ ↦ ?_
      rw [Algebra.smul_def]
      rfl
    have hzero : ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (p.coeff m : Ω) * c ^ m = 0 := by
      rw [← hexp, hpc]
    have hkey : Polynomial.aeval u E =
        (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (p.coeff m : Ω) * c ^ m) *
          (Polynomial.aeval u s) ^ n := by
      rw [hE, map_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m hm ↦ ?_
      have hmn : m ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 hm)
      rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow,
        Polynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap, hP m, ← hcs]
      have hsplit : (Polynomial.aeval u s : Ω) ^ n =
          (Polynomial.aeval u s) ^ m * (Polynomial.aeval u s) ^ (n - m) := by
        rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hmn]
      rw [hsplit]
      ring
    rw [hkey, hzero, zero_mul]
  have hE0 : E = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    exact hu ⟨E, hne, hEval⟩
  
  set b := Module.Basis.ofVectorSpace k K' with hb
  
  obtain ⟨ms, hms⟩ := Polynomial.support_nonempty.2 hs_ne
  have hms0 : s.coeff ms ≠ 0 := Polynomial.mem_support_iff.1 hms
  obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ : ∃ j, b.repr (s.coeff ms) j ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hall
    push Not at hall
    exact hms0 (b.repr.injective (by ext j; simp [hall j]))
  have hSj₀ : coordPoly b j₀ s ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ by
    have := coordPoly_coeff b j₀ s ms
    rw [h, Polynomial.coeff_zero] at this
    exact hj₀ this.symm
  
  set badP : Finset k := (P n).roots.toFinset with hbadP
  have hsroots : Set.Finite {τ : k | s.eval (φ' τ) = 0} := by
    have hsub : {τ : k | s.eval (φ' τ) = 0} ⊆
        (fun τ ↦ φ' τ) ⁻¹' {y : K' | s.eval y = 0} := fun τ hτ ↦ hτ
    refine Set.Finite.subset (Set.Finite.preimage
      (Set.injOn_of_injective (algebraMap k K').injective)
      (Polynomial.finite_setOf_isRoot hs_ne)) hsub
  
  have hgood : ∀ τ : k, τ ∉ badP → s.eval (φ' τ) ≠ 0 → ∀ j,
      (coordPoly b j r * coordPoly b j₀ s).eval τ =
      (coordPoly b j₀ r * coordPoly b j s).eval τ := by
    intro τ hτP hτs j
    
    have hspec : ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        φ' ((P m).eval τ) * r.eval (φ' τ) ^ m * s.eval (φ' τ) ^ (n - m) = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (Polynomial.eval (φ' τ)) hE0
      rw [hE, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum, Polynomial.eval_zero] at h
      rw [← h]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ ↦ ?_
      rw [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_pow,
        Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_map, Polynomial.eval₂_at_apply]
    set w : K' := r.eval (φ' τ) / s.eval (φ' τ) with hw
    have hwalg : IsAlgebraic k w := by
      refine ⟨∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        Polynomial.C ((P m).eval τ) * Polynomial.X ^ m, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro h0
        have hcoeff := congrArg (fun q ↦ Polynomial.coeff q n) h0
        simp only [Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff, Polynomial.coeff_zero] at hcoeff
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ ↦
          Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow ((P m).eval τ) m n] at hcoeff
        rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq (Finset.range (n + 1)) n fun m ↦ (P m).eval τ,
          if_pos (Finset.self_mem_range_succ n)] at hcoeff
        exact hτP (Multiset.mem_toFinset.2
          (Polynomial.mem_roots'.2 ⟨hPn, hcoeff⟩))
      · rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, Polynomial.eval₂_finsetSum]
        have hterm : ∀ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            Polynomial.eval₂ φ' w (Polynomial.C ((P m).eval τ) *
              Polynomial.X ^ m) =
            φ' ((P m).eval τ) * r.eval (φ' τ) ^ m * s.eval (φ' τ) ^ (n - m) /
              s.eval (φ' τ) ^ n := by
          intro m hm
          have hmn : m ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 hm)
          rw [Polynomial.eval₂_mul, Polynomial.eval₂_C, Polynomial.eval₂_pow,
            Polynomial.eval₂_X, hw, div_pow, ← mul_div_assoc,
            div_eq_div_iff (pow_ne_zero m hτs) (pow_ne_zero n hτs)]
          have hsplit : s.eval (φ' τ) ^ n =
              s.eval (φ' τ) ^ m * s.eval (φ' τ) ^ (n - m) := by
            rw [← pow_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hmn]
          rw [hsplit]
          ring
        rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm]
        simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
        rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hspec, zero_mul]
    obtain ⟨cτ, hcτ⟩ := RingHom.mem_range.1 (hk w hwalg)
    
    have hrs : r.eval (φ' τ) = cτ • s.eval (φ' τ) := by
      rw [Algebra.smul_def, hcτ, hw, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hτs]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul]
    rw [eval_coordPoly, eval_coordPoly, eval_coordPoly, eval_coordPoly, hrs,
      map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  
  have hD : ∀ j, coordPoly b j r * coordPoly b j₀ s =
      coordPoly b j₀ r * coordPoly b j s := by
    intro j
    have hbadfin : Set.Finite ((badP : Set k) ∪ {τ : k | s.eval (φ' τ) = 0}) :=
      Set.Finite.union badP.finite_toSet hsroots
    have hroots : {τ : k | (coordPoly b j r * coordPoly b j₀ s -
        coordPoly b j₀ r * coordPoly b j s).IsRoot τ}.Infinite := by
      refine Set.Infinite.mono ?_
        (Set.Infinite.sdiff (Set.infinite_univ (α := k)) hbadfin)
      intro τ hτ
      have hτP : τ ∉ badP := fun h ↦ hτ.2 (Or.inl h)
      have hτs : s.eval (φ' τ) ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hτ.2 (Or.inr h)
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Polynomial.IsRoot, Polynomial.eval_sub]
      rw [hgood τ hτP hτs j, sub_self]
    have := Polynomial.eq_zero_of_infinite_isRoot _ hroots
    rw [sub_eq_zero] at this
    exact this
  
  have hpoly : r * (coordPoly b j₀ s).map φ' = (coordPoly b j₀ r).map φ' * s := by
    ext m
    have hcoord : ∀ j, b.repr ((r * (coordPoly b j₀ s).map φ').coeff m) j =
        b.repr (((coordPoly b j₀ r).map φ' * s).coeff m) j := by
      intro j
      rw [← coordPoly_coeff b j, ← coordPoly_coeff b j, coordPoly_mul_map]
      have hcomm : (coordPoly b j₀ r).map φ' * s =
          s * (coordPoly b j₀ r).map φ' := mul_comm _ _
      rw [hcomm, coordPoly_mul_map, hD j]
      ring_nf
    exact b.repr.injective (Finsupp.ext fun j ↦ hcoord j)
  have hnum : Polynomial.aeval u r * Polynomial.aeval u (coordPoly b j₀ s) =
      Polynomial.aeval u (coordPoly b j₀ r) * Polynomial.aeval u s := by
    have h := congrArg (Polynomial.aeval u) hpoly
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, Polynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap,
      Polynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap] at h
    exact h
  have hSu : Polynomial.aeval u (coordPoly b j₀ s) ≠ 0 := fun h ↦
    huk ⟨coordPoly b j₀ s, hSj₀, h⟩
  
  have hcval : c = Polynomial.aeval u (coordPoly b j₀ r) /
      Polynomial.aeval u (coordPoly b j₀ s) := by
    rw [hc, div_eq_div_iff hs0 hSu, hnum]
  rw [hcval]
  have hmemP : ∀ Q : Polynomial k,
      Polynomial.aeval u Q ∈ adjoin k ({u} : Set Ω) := by
    intro Q
    have hmem : Polynomial.aeval u Q ∈ Algebra.adjoin k ({u} : Set Ω) := by
      rw [Algebra.adjoin_singleton_eq_range_aeval]
      exact (AlgHom.mem_range _).2 ⟨Q, rfl⟩
    exact algebra_adjoin_le_adjoin k _ hmem
  exact div_mem (hmemP _) (hmemP _)

name: AclGeom.minpoly_coeff_mem
statement:
theorem minpoly_coeff_mem [IsAlgClosed k] {K : IntermediateField k Ω}
    {u v : Ω} (hu : Transcendental ↥K u)
    (hv : IsAlgebraic ↥(adjoin k ({u} : Set Ω)) v) (i : ℕ) :
    ((minpoly ↥(adjoin ↥K ({u} : Set Ω)) v).coeff i : Ω) ∈
      adjoin k ({u} : Set Ω)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set L₀ : IntermediateField k Ω := adjoin k ({u} : Set Ω) with hL₀
  set L : IntermediateField ↥K Ω := adjoin ↥K ({u} : Set Ω) with hL
  
  have hle : L₀ ≤ L.restrictScalars k := by
    rw [hL₀]
    refine adjoin_le_iff.2 ?_
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with rfl
    exact subset_adjoin ↥K _ rfl
  set incl : ↥L₀ →ₐ[k] ↥(L.restrictScalars k) := IntermediateField.inclusion hle
  letI : Algebra ↥L₀ ↥L := incl.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  haveI htow : IsScalarTower ↥L₀ ↥L Ω := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  
  have hvL : IsAlgebraic ↥L v := by
    obtain ⟨p, hp0, hpv⟩ := hv
    refine ⟨p.map (algebraMap ↥L₀ ↥L), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact fun h ↦ hp0 ((Polynomial.map_eq_zero_iff
        (algebraMap ↥L₀ ↥L).injective).1 h)
    · rw [Polynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap]
      exact hpv
  set m₀ := minpoly ↥L₀ v with hm₀
  set m := minpoly ↥L v with hm
  have hm₀monic : m₀.Monic := minpoly.monic hv.isIntegral
  have hmdvd : m ∣ m₀.map (algebraMap ↥L₀ ↥L) := by
    refine minpoly.dvd ↥L v ?_
    rw [Polynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap]
    exact minpoly.aeval ↥L₀ v
  
  have hmmonic : m.Monic := minpoly.monic hvL.isIntegral
  have hlifts := integralClosure.mem_lifts_of_monic_of_dvd_map ↥L
    hm₀monic hmmonic hmdvd
  rw [Polynomial.lifts_iff_coeff_lifts] at hlifts
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hlifts i
  
  have hint : IsIntegral ↥L₀ (m.coeff i) := by
    have h2 : IsIntegral ↥L₀
        (algebraMap ↥(integralClosure ↥L₀ ↥L) ↥L w) := w.2
    exact hw ▸ h2
  have halg : IsAlgebraic ↥L₀ ((m.coeff i : ↥L) : Ω) :=
    (hint.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom ↥L₀ ↥L Ω)).isAlgebraic
  have hmem : ((m.coeff i : ↥L) : Ω) ∈ adjoin ↥K ({u} : Set Ω) := (m.coeff i).2
  exact mem_adjoin_base_of_isAlgebraic
    (fun y hy ↦ mem_range_algebraMap_of_isAlgebraic hy) hu hmem halg

name: AclGeom.natDegree_minpoly_adjoin_eq
statement:
theorem natDegree_minpoly_adjoin_eq [IsAlgClosed k] {K : IntermediateField k Ω}
    {u v : Ω} (hu : Transcendental ↥K u)
    (hv : IsAlgebraic ↥(adjoin k ({u} : Set Ω)) v) :
    (minpoly ↥(adjoin ↥K ({u} : Set Ω)) v).natDegree =
      (minpoly ↥(adjoin k ({u} : Set Ω)) v).natDegree
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set L₀ : IntermediateField k Ω := adjoin k ({u} : Set Ω) with hL₀
  set L : IntermediateField ↥K Ω := adjoin ↥K ({u} : Set Ω) with hL
  have hle : L₀ ≤ L.restrictScalars k := by
    rw [hL₀]
    refine adjoin_le_iff.2 ?_
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with rfl
    exact subset_adjoin ↥K _ rfl
  set incl : ↥L₀ →ₐ[k] ↥(L.restrictScalars k) := IntermediateField.inclusion hle
  letI : Algebra ↥L₀ ↥L := incl.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  haveI htow : IsScalarTower ↥L₀ ↥L Ω := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap ↥L₀ ↥L) := by
    intro a b hab
    have h2 : ((a : Ω)) = ((b : Ω)) := congrArg (Subtype.val : ↥L → Ω) hab
    exact Subtype.ext h2
  have hvL : IsAlgebraic ↥L v := by
    obtain ⟨p, hp0, hpv⟩ := hv
    refine ⟨p.map (algebraMap ↥L₀ ↥L), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact fun h ↦ hp0 ((Polynomial.map_eq_zero_iff hinj).1 h)
    · rw [Polynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap]
      exact hpv
  set m₀ := minpoly ↥L₀ v with hm₀def
  set m := minpoly ↥L v with hmdef
  have hm₀monic : m₀.Monic := minpoly.monic hv.isIntegral
  have hmmonic : m.Monic := minpoly.monic hvL.isIntegral
  
  set m' : Polynomial ↥L₀ := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m.natDegree + 1),
    Polynomial.C (⟨(m.coeff i : Ω), minpoly_coeff_mem hu hv i⟩ : ↥L₀) *
      Polynomial.X ^ i with hm'def
  have hm'coeff : ∀ j, ((m'.coeff j : Ω)) = (m.coeff j : Ω) := by
    intro j
    rw [hm'def, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow _ i j]
    rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq (Finset.range (m.natDegree + 1)) j
      fun i ↦ (⟨(m.coeff i : Ω), minpoly_coeff_mem hu hv i⟩ : ↥L₀)]
    by_cases hj : j ∈ Finset.range (m.natDegree + 1)
    · rw [if_pos hj]
    · rw [if_neg hj]
      have hj' : m.natDegree < j := by
        by_contra hle'
        exact hj (Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_of_not_lt hle')))
      rw [Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt hj']
      simp
  have hmap : m'.map (algebraMap ↥L₀ ↥L) = m := by
    ext j
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_map]
    have h2 : (((algebraMap ↥L₀ ↥L) (m'.coeff j) : ↥L) : Ω) =
        ((m.coeff j : ↥L) : Ω) := by
      have h3 : (((algebraMap ↥L₀ ↥L) (m'.coeff j) : ↥L) : Ω) =
          ((m'.coeff j : ↥L₀) : Ω) := rfl
      rw [h3]
      exact hm'coeff j
    exact h2
  
  have hm'v : Polynomial.aeval v m' = 0 := by
    have h := minpoly.aeval ↥L v
    rw [← hmdef, ← hmap, Polynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap] at h
    exact h
  have hdvd₀ : m₀ ∣ m' := minpoly.dvd ↥L₀ v hm'v
  have hdvd' : m' ∣ m₀ := by
    have hmdvd : m ∣ m₀.map (algebraMap ↥L₀ ↥L) := by
      refine minpoly.dvd ↥L v ?_
      rw [Polynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap]
      exact minpoly.aeval ↥L₀ v
    have hm'monic : m'.Monic := by
      have h1 : (algebraMap ↥L₀ ↥L) m'.leadingCoeff = 1 := by
        have h2 : m'.natDegree = m.natDegree := by
          rw [← hmap, Polynomial.natDegree_map_eq_of_injective hinj]
        rw [Polynomial.leadingCoeff, h2]
        refine Subtype.ext ?_
        rw [show (((algebraMap ↥L₀ ↥L) (m'.coeff m.natDegree) : ↥L) : Ω) =
          ((m'.coeff m.natDegree : ↥L₀) : Ω) from rfl, hm'coeff]
        exact congrArg Subtype.val hmmonic
      exact hinj (by rw [h1, map_one])
    have hmod : (m₀ %ₘ m').map (algebraMap ↥L₀ ↥L) = 0 := by
      rw [Polynomial.map_modByMonic _ hm'monic, hmap]
      exact (Polynomial.modByMonic_eq_zero_iff_dvd hmmonic).2 hmdvd
    have h0 : m₀ %ₘ m' = 0 := (Polynomial.map_eq_zero_iff hinj).1 hmod
    exact (Polynomial.modByMonic_eq_zero_iff_dvd hm'monic).1 h0
  have hm'monic : m'.Monic := by
    have h2 : m'.natDegree = m.natDegree := by
      rw [← hmap, Polynomial.natDegree_map_eq_of_injective hinj]
    have h1 : (algebraMap ↥L₀ ↥L) m'.leadingCoeff = 1 := by
      rw [Polynomial.leadingCoeff, h2]
      refine Subtype.ext ?_
      rw [show (((algebraMap ↥L₀ ↥L) (m'.coeff m.natDegree) : ↥L) : Ω) =
        ((m'.coeff m.natDegree : ↥L₀) : Ω) from rfl, hm'coeff]
      exact congrArg Subtype.val hmmonic
    exact hinj (by rw [h1, map_one])
  have hm'eq : m' = m₀ :=
    Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_associated hm'monic hm₀monic
      (associated_of_dvd_dvd hdvd' hdvd₀)
  calc m.natDegree = m'.natDegree := by
        rw [← hmap, Polynomial.natDegree_map_eq_of_injective hinj]
    _ = m₀.natDegree := by rw [hm'eq]

name: AclGeom.eval₂_evalFst
statement:
theorem eval₂_evalFst (u v : Ω) (g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) :
    Polynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap ↥(adjoin K ({u} : Set Ω)) Ω) v
      (evalFst (K := K) u g) = MvPolynomial.aeval ![u, v] g
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ((Polynomial.eval₂RingHom
        (algebraMap ↥(adjoin K ({u} : Set Ω)) Ω) v).comp
      (evalFst (K := K) u).toRingHom) = (MvPolynomial.aeval ![u, v]).toRingHom := by
    refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun c ↦ ?_) (fun i ↦ ?_)
    · simp [evalFst, IntermediateField.algebraMap_apply]
    · fin_cases i <;> simp [evalFst]
  exact congrArg (fun (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K →+* Ω) ↦ f g) hcomp

name: AclGeom.mem_idealOf_iff_evalFst
statement:
theorem mem_idealOf_iff_evalFst {u v : Ω} {g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K} :
    g ∈ idealOf K ![u, v] ↔
      Polynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap ↥(adjoin K ({u} : Set Ω)) Ω) v
        (evalFst (K := K) u g) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, eval₂_evalFst]

name: AclGeom.evalFst_apply_eq
statement:
theorem evalFst_apply_eq (u : Ω) (g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) :
    evalFst (K := K) u g =
      (finSuccEquiv K 1 (rename (Equiv.swap 0 1) g)).map
        (MvPolynomial.aeval
          ![(⟨u, subset_adjoin K _ rfl⟩ : ↥(adjoin K ({u} : Set Ω)))]).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : (evalFst (K := K) u (Ω := Ω)).toRingHom =
      ((Polynomial.mapRingHom (MvPolynomial.aeval
          ![(⟨u, subset_adjoin K _ rfl⟩ : ↥(adjoin K ({u} : Set Ω)))]).toRingHom).comp
        ((finSuccEquiv K 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K ≃ₐ[K] _).toRingEquiv.toRingHom.comp
          (rename (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1)).toRingHom)) := by
    have hXone : finSuccEquiv K 1 (X (1 : Fin 2)) = Polynomial.C (X 0) := by
      have h := finSuccEquiv_X_succ (R := K) (n := 1) (j := 0)
      simpa using h
    have hC : ∀ c : K, finSuccEquiv K 1 (MvPolynomial.C c) =
        Polynomial.C (MvPolynomial.C c) := fun c ↦ by
      simp [finSuccEquiv_apply, eval₂Hom_C]
    refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun c ↦ ?_) (fun i ↦ ?_)
    · simp [evalFst, hC]
    · fin_cases i
      · have h1 : (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1) 0 = 1 := by decide
        simp [evalFst, h1, hXone]
      · have h1 : (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1) 1 = 0 := by decide
        simp [evalFst, h1, finSuccEquiv_X_zero]
  exact congrArg (fun (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K →+* _) ↦ f g) hcomp

name: AclGeom.natDegree_evalFst
statement:
theorem natDegree_evalFst {u : Ω} (hu : Transcendental K u)
    (g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) :
    (evalFst (K := K) u g).natDegree = g.degreeOf 1
proof:
:= by
  have htr : Transcendental K
      (⟨u, subset_adjoin K _ rfl⟩ : ↥(adjoin K ({u} : Set Ω))) := by
    intro halg
    exact hu (by
      have := (halg.isIntegral.map
        (adjoin K ({u} : Set Ω)).val).isAlgebraic
      simpa using this)
  have hind : AlgebraicIndependent K
      ![(⟨u, subset_adjoin K _ rfl⟩ : ↥(adjoin K ({u} : Set Ω)))] :=
    algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff.2 htr
  have hinj : Function.Injective (MvPolynomial.aeval
      ![(⟨u, subset_adjoin K _ rfl⟩ : ↥(adjoin K ({u} : Set Ω)))]).toRingHom :=
    hind
  rw [evalFst_apply_eq, Polynomial.natDegree_map_eq_of_injective hinj,
    natDegree_finSuccEquiv]
  have hswap := degreeOf_rename_of_injective
    (Equiv.injective (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1)) (p := g) 1
  rw [Equiv.swap_apply_right] at hswap
  exact hswap

name: AclGeom.evalFst_injective
statement:
theorem evalFst_injective {u : Ω} (hu : Transcendental K u) :
    Function.Injective (evalFst (K := K) u)
proof:
:= by
  have htr : Transcendental K
      (⟨u, subset_adjoin K _ rfl⟩ : ↥(adjoin K ({u} : Set Ω))) := by
    intro halg
    exact hu (by
      have := (halg.isIntegral.map (adjoin K ({u} : Set Ω)).val).isAlgebraic
      simpa using this)
  have hind : AlgebraicIndependent K
      ![(⟨u, subset_adjoin K _ rfl⟩ : ↥(adjoin K ({u} : Set Ω)))] :=
    algebraicIndependent_unique_type_iff.2 htr
  intro g₁ g₂ h
  rw [evalFst_apply_eq, evalFst_apply_eq] at h
  have h2 := Polynomial.map_injective _ (hind : Function.Injective _) h
  have h3 := (finSuccEquiv K 1).injective h2
  exact (rename_injective _ (Equiv.injective (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1))) h3

name: AclGeom.evalFst_polyAevalX
statement:
theorem evalFst_polyAevalX (u : Ω) (P : Polynomial K) :
    evalFst (K := K) u (Polynomial.aeval (X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) P) =
      Polynomial.C (Polynomial.aeval
        (⟨u, subset_adjoin K _ rfl⟩ : ↥(adjoin K ({u} : Set Ω))) P)
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ((evalFst (K := K) u (Ω := Ω)).comp
      (Polynomial.aeval (X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K))) =
      ((Polynomial.C : ↥(adjoin K ({u} : Set Ω)) →+* _).comp
        (Polynomial.aeval
          (⟨u, subset_adjoin K _ rfl⟩ : ↥(adjoin K ({u} : Set Ω)))).toRingHom
        : Polynomial K →+* _) := by
    refine Polynomial.ringHom_ext (fun c ↦ ?_) ?_
    · simp [evalFst]
    · simp [evalFst]
  exact congrArg (fun (f : Polynomial K →+* _) ↦ f P) hcomp

name: AclGeom.aeval_polyAevalX
statement:
theorem aeval_polyAevalX (u v : Ω) (P : Polynomial K) :
    MvPolynomial.aeval ![u, v]
      (Polynomial.aeval (X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) P) =
      Polynomial.aeval u P
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ((MvPolynomial.aeval ![u, v]).comp
      (Polynomial.aeval (X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K))) =
      (Polynomial.aeval u : Polynomial K →ₐ[K] Ω) := by
    refine Polynomial.algHom_ext ?_
    simp
  exact congrArg (fun (f : Polynomial K →ₐ[K] Ω) ↦ f P) hcomp

name: AclGeom.exists_evalFst_eq
statement:
theorem exists_evalFst_eq {u : Ω} (hu : Transcendental K u)
    (N : Polynomial ↥(Algebra.adjoin K ({u} : Set Ω))) :
    ∃ W : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K,
      evalFst (K := K) u W = N.map (Subalgebra.inclusion
        (algebra_adjoin_le_adjoin K ({u} : Set Ω))).toRingHom ∧
      degreeOf 1 W ≤ N.natDegree
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hrepr : ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ P : Polynomial K,
      Polynomial.aeval u P = (N.coeff i : Ω) := by
    intro i
    have hle := (Algebra.adjoin_singleton_eq_range_aeval K u).le
    exact (AlgHom.mem_range _).1 (hle (N.coeff i).2)
  choose P hP using hrepr
  set W : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (N.natDegree + 1),
    Polynomial.aeval (X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) (P i) * X 1 ^ i with hW
  have heq : evalFst (K := K) u W = N.map (Subalgebra.inclusion
      (algebra_adjoin_le_adjoin K ({u} : Set Ω))).toRingHom := by
    rw [hW, map_sum]
    have hterm : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (N.natDegree + 1),
        evalFst (K := K) u
          (Polynomial.aeval (X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) (P i) * X 1 ^ i) =
        Polynomial.C ((⟨(N.coeff i : Ω), algebra_adjoin_le_adjoin K _
          (N.coeff i).2⟩ : ↥(adjoin K ({u} : Set Ω)))) * Polynomial.X ^ i := by
      intro i _
      rw [map_mul, map_pow, evalFst_polyAevalX]
      have hXone : evalFst (K := K) u (X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) =
          Polynomial.X := by
        simp [evalFst]
      rw [hXone]
      congr 2
      exact Subtype.ext ((Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply
        (adjoin K ({u} : Set Ω)).val _ _).symm.trans (hP i))
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm]
    
    ext m
    rw [Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow _ i m]
    rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq (Finset.range (N.natDegree + 1)) m
      fun i ↦ (⟨(N.coeff i : Ω), algebra_adjoin_le_adjoin K _ (N.coeff i).2⟩ :
        ↥(adjoin K ({u} : Set Ω)))]
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_map]
    by_cases hm : m ∈ Finset.range (N.natDegree + 1)
    · rw [if_pos hm]
      rfl
    · rw [if_neg hm]
      have hm' : N.natDegree < m := by
        by_contra hle
        exact hm (Finset.mem_range.2 (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_of_not_lt hle)))
      rw [Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt hm', map_zero]
  refine ⟨W, heq, ?_⟩
  rw [← natDegree_evalFst hu W, heq]
  exact Polynomial.natDegree_map_le

name: AclGeom.natDegree_minpoly_adjoin
statement:
theorem natDegree_minpoly_adjoin {u v : Ω} (hu : Transcendental k u)
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hF0 : F ≠ 0)
    (hFspan : idealOf k ![u, v] = Ideal.span {F})
    (hv : IsAlgebraic ↥(adjoin k ({u} : Set Ω)) v) :
    (minpoly ↥(adjoin k ({u} : Set Ω)) v).natDegree = degreeOf 1 F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set m₀ := minpoly ↥(adjoin k ({u} : Set Ω)) v with hm₀def
  have hm₀ne : m₀ ≠ 0 := minpoly.ne_zero hv.isIntegral
  have hf0 : evalFst (K := k) u F ≠ 0 := fun h ↦
    hF0 (evalFst_injective hu (by rw [h, map_zero]))
  
  have hFv : F ∈ idealOf k ![u, v] := hFspan ▸ Ideal.subset_span rfl
  have hdvd : m₀ ∣ evalFst (K := k) u F := by
    refine minpoly.dvd _ v ?_
    rw [Polynomial.aeval_def]
    exact mem_idealOf_iff_evalFst.1 hFv
  have hle : m₀.natDegree ≤ degreeOf 1 F := by
    rw [← natDegree_evalFst hu]
    exact Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_dvd hdvd hf0
  
  set N := IsLocalization.integerNormalization
    (nonZeroDivisors ↥(Algebra.adjoin k ({u} : Set Ω))) m₀ with hNdef
  have hNne : N ≠ 0 := fun h0 ↦
    hm₀ne ((IsLocalization.integerNormalization_eq_zero_iff le_rfl m₀).1 h0)
  obtain ⟨W, hWeq, -⟩ := exists_evalFst_eq (K := k) hu N
  have hinclinj : Function.Injective (Subalgebra.inclusion
      (algebra_adjoin_le_adjoin k ({u} : Set Ω))).toRingHom := by
    have h := Subalgebra.inclusion_injective
      (algebra_adjoin_le_adjoin k ({u} : Set Ω))
    exact h
  have hWmem : W ∈ idealOf k ![u, v] := by
    rw [mem_idealOf_iff_evalFst, hWeq, Polynomial.eval₂_map]
    have hg : ((algebraMap ↥(adjoin k ({u} : Set Ω)) Ω).comp
        (Subalgebra.inclusion (algebra_adjoin_le_adjoin k ({u} : Set Ω))).toRingHom) =
        ((algebraMap ↥(adjoin k ({u} : Set Ω)) Ω).comp
          (algebraMap ↥(Algebra.adjoin k ({u} : Set Ω))
            ↥(adjoin k ({u} : Set Ω)))) := by
      refine RingHom.ext fun x ↦ ?_
      rfl
    rw [hg, hNdef]
    refine IsLocalization.integerNormalization_eval₂_eq_zero _ _ m₀ ?_
    rw [← Polynomial.aeval_def]
    exact minpoly.aeval _ v
  rw [hFspan, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hWmem
  obtain ⟨H₂, hH₂⟩ := hWmem
  have hWne : W ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, map_zero] at hWeq
    exact hNne ((Polynomial.map_eq_zero_iff hinclinj).1 hWeq.symm)
  have hH₂ne : H₂ ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hWne (by rw [hH₂, h, mul_zero])
  have hNdeg : N.natDegree ≤ m₀.natDegree := by
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero]
    intro i hi
    have hnot : i ∉ m₀.support := fun hmem ↦
      (Polynomial.mem_support_iff.1 hmem)
        (Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt hi)
    have hnotN : i ∉ N.support := fun hmem ↦
      hnot (IsLocalization.integerNormalization_support _ _ hmem)
    exact Polynomial.notMem_support_iff.1 hnotN
  have hge : degreeOf 1 F ≤ m₀.natDegree := by
    calc degreeOf 1 F = (evalFst (K := k) u F).natDegree :=
          (natDegree_evalFst hu F).symm
      _ ≤ (evalFst (K := k) u F).natDegree +
            (evalFst (K := k) u H₂).natDegree := Nat.le_add_right _ _
      _ = (evalFst (K := k) u W).natDegree := by
          rw [hH₂, map_mul, Polynomial.natDegree_mul hf0 fun h ↦
            hH₂ne (evalFst_injective hu (by rw [h, map_zero]))]
      _ ≤ N.natDegree := by
          rw [hWeq]
          exact Polynomial.natDegree_map_le
      _ ≤ m₀.natDegree := hNdeg
  exact le_antisymm hle hge

name: AclGeom.degreeOf_map_eq
statement:
theorem degreeOf_map_eq {K : Type*} [Field K] [Algebra k K] (i : Fin 2)
    (F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) :
    degreeOf i (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) F) = degreeOf i F
proof:
:= by
  have hsupp : (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k K) F).support = F.support := by
    refine Finset.ext fun m ↦ ?_
    rw [MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff, MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff,
      MvPolynomial.coeff_map]
    exact map_ne_zero_iff _ (algebraMap k K).injective
  rw [degreeOf_eq_sup, degreeOf_eq_sup, hsupp]

name: AclGeom.idealOf_swap_span
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcomp : ∀ g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k,
      MvPolynomial.aeval (![v, u] : Fin 2 → Ω) g =
        MvPolynomial.aeval ![u, v] (rename (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1) g) := by
    intro g
    have hfun : ((![u, v] : Fin 2 → Ω) ∘ (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1)) = ![v, u] := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp
    rw [aeval_rename, hfun]
  have hswapswap : ∀ g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k,
      rename (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1) (rename (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1) g) =
        g := by
    intro g
    rw [rename_rename]
    have hid : ((Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1) ∘ (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1)) = id := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp
    rw [hid, rename_id]
    rfl
  ext g
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  constructor
  · intro hg
    have hmem : rename (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1) g ∈ idealOf k ![u, v] := by
      rw [mem_idealOf_iff, ← hcomp]
      exact hg
    rw [h, Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hmem
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hmem
    refine ⟨rename (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1) c, ?_⟩
    have := congrArg (rename (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1)) hc
    rw [hswapswap, map_mul] at this
    exact this
  · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
    rw [hcomp, map_mul, hswapswap F, map_mul]
    have hF0' : MvPolynomial.aeval (![u, v] : Fin 2 → Ω) F = 0 :=
      (mem_idealOf_iff k).1 (h ▸ Ideal.subset_span rfl)
    rw [hF0', zero_mul]

name: AclGeom.degreeOf_one_factor_eq_zero
statement:
theorem degreeOf_one_factor_eq_zero [IsAlgClosed k] {K : IntermediateField k Ω}
    {u v : Ω} (hu : Transcendental ↥K u) (hv : v ∈ racl k {u})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hF0 : F ≠ 0)
    (hFspan : idealOf k ![u, v] = Ideal.span {F})
    {G H : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ↥K}
    (hGspan : idealOf ↥K ![u, v] = Ideal.span {G})
    (hFGH : MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥K) F = G * H) :
    degreeOf 1 H = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have huk : Transcendental k u := fun h ↦ hu (h.tower_top ↥K)
  have hvalg : IsAlgebraic ↥(adjoin k ({u} : Set Ω)) v := (mem_racl_iff k).1 hv
  have hFK0 : MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥K) F ≠ 0 := fun h ↦
    hF0 (MvPolynomial.map_injective _ (algebraMap k ↥K).injective
      (by rw [h, map_zero]))
  have hG0 : G ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hFK0 (by rw [hFGH, h, zero_mul])
  have hH0 : H ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hFK0 (by rw [hFGH, h, mul_zero])
  
  have hGv : G ∈ idealOf ↥K ![u, v] := hGspan ▸ Ideal.subset_span rfl
  have hmdvd : minpoly ↥(adjoin ↥K ({u} : Set Ω)) v ∣ evalFst (K := ↥K) u G := by
    refine minpoly.dvd _ v ?_
    rw [Polynomial.aeval_def]
    exact mem_idealOf_iff_evalFst.1 hGv
  have hGne : evalFst (K := ↥K) u G ≠ 0 := fun h ↦
    hG0 (evalFst_injective hu (by rw [h, map_zero]))
  have h1 : (minpoly ↥(adjoin ↥K ({u} : Set Ω)) v).natDegree ≤ degreeOf 1 G := by
    rw [← natDegree_evalFst hu]
    exact Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_dvd hmdvd hGne
  have h2 : (minpoly ↥(adjoin ↥K ({u} : Set Ω)) v).natDegree = degreeOf 1 F := by
    rw [natDegree_minpoly_adjoin_eq hu hvalg]
    exact natDegree_minpoly_adjoin huk hF0 hFspan hvalg
  have hadd : degreeOf 1 (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥K) F) =
      degreeOf 1 G + degreeOf 1 H := by
    rw [← natDegree_evalFst hu, hFGH, map_mul,
      Polynomial.natDegree_mul hGne fun h ↦
        hH0 (evalFst_injective hu (by rw [h, map_zero])),
      natDegree_evalFst hu, natDegree_evalFst hu]
  have hFKdeg : degreeOf 1 (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥K) F) =
      degreeOf 1 F := degreeOf_map_eq 1 F
  omega

name: AclGeom.idealOf_map_eq_span
statement:
theorem idealOf_map_eq_span [IsAlgClosed k] {K : IntermediateField k Ω}
    {u v : Ω} (hu : Transcendental ↥K u) (hv : v ∈ racl k {u})
    (hv' : Transcendental ↥K v) (hu' : u ∈ racl k {v})
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k} (hF0 : F ≠ 0)
    (hFspan : idealOf k ![u, v] = Ideal.span {F}) :
    idealOf ↥K ![u, v] =
      Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥K) F}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hvK : v ∈ racl ↥K {u} := racl_subset_racl_base K {u} hv
  obtain ⟨G, hGp, hGspan⟩ := exists_prime_span_idealOf ↥K hu hvK
  have hFKmem : MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥K) F ∈ idealOf ↥K ![u, v] := by
    rw [mem_idealOf_iff, MvPolynomial.aeval_map_algebraMap]
    exact (mem_idealOf_iff k).1 (hFspan ▸ Ideal.subset_span rfl)
  obtain ⟨H, hFGH⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.1 (hGspan ▸ hFKmem)
  have hFK0 : MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥K) F ≠ 0 := fun h ↦
    hF0 (MvPolynomial.map_injective _ (algebraMap k ↥K).injective
      (by rw [h, map_zero]))
  have hH0 : H ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hFK0 (by rw [hFGH, h, mul_zero])
  
  have hcount1 : degreeOf 1 H = 0 :=
    degreeOf_one_factor_eq_zero hu hv hF0 hFspan hGspan hFGH
  
  have hcount0 : degreeOf 0 H = 0 := by
    have hswapF : idealOf k ![v, u] =
        Ideal.span {rename (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1) F} := idealOf_swap_span hFspan
    have hswapG : idealOf ↥K ![v, u] =
        Ideal.span {rename (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1) G} := idealOf_swap_span hGspan
    have hswapF0 : rename (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1) F ≠ 0 := fun h ↦
      hF0 (rename_injective _ (Equiv.injective _) (by rw [h, map_zero]))
    have hswapFGH : MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k ↥K)
        (rename (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1) F) =
        rename (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1) G *
          rename (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1) H := by
      rw [map_rename, hFGH, map_mul]
    have h1 := degreeOf_one_factor_eq_zero hv' hu' hswapF0 hswapF hswapG hswapFGH
    have h2 := degreeOf_rename_of_injective
      (Equiv.injective (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1)) (p := H) 0
    rw [Equiv.swap_apply_left] at h2
    rw [← h2]
    exact h1
  
  have htot : H.totalDegree = 0 := by
    refine Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero ?_
    rw [totalDegree_eq]
    refine Finset.sup_le fun m hm ↦ ?_
    have h0 : m 0 = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero
      ((monomial_le_degreeOf 0 hm).trans (le_of_eq hcount0))
    have h1 : m 1 = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero
      ((monomial_le_degreeOf 1 hm).trans (le_of_eq hcount1))
    have hm0 : m = 0 := by
      ext i
      fin_cases i
      · exact h0
      · exact h1
    rw [hm0]
    simp
  have hHC : H = MvPolynomial.C (H.coeff 0) :=
    totalDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C.1 htot
  have hc0 : H.coeff 0 ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hH0 (by rw [hHC, h, map_zero])
  have hHunit : IsUnit H := by
    rw [hHC]
    exact (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.2 hc0).map
      (MvPolynomial.C : ↥K →+* MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ↥K)
  rw [hGspan]
  exact Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton.2
    ⟨hHunit.unit, by rw [IsUnit.unit_spec]; exact hFGH.symm⟩

name: AclGeom.exists_locusIncidence_component_algEquiv
statement:
theorem exists_locusIncidence_component_algEquiv [Finite α] [Finite γ] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (hxy : ∀ i, x i ∈ racl k (Set.range y)) (hzy : ∀ i, z i ∈ racl k (Set.range y))
    (Z : Set (PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k ⧸ ℐ)))
    (hZ : Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k ⧸ ℐ)))
    (hdense : closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.quotientMapₐ ℐ (rename (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr))
      (idealOf_le_comap_rename_comp (a := Sum.elim x y) (b := y) (g := Sum.inr)
        (e := Sum.inl) rfl le_sup_left)).toRingHom '' Z) = Set.univ) :
    ∃ (x' : α → Ω) (z' : γ → Ω), idealOf k (Sum.elim x' y) = idealOf k (Sum.elim x y) ∧
      idealOf k (Sum.elim y z') = idealOf k (Sum.elim y z) ∧
      ∃ e : ((MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k ⧸ ℐ) ⧸ PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal Z) ≃ₐ[k]
          Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z')),
        (∀ p, (e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ p)) : Ω) =
          aeval (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z') p) ∧
        ∃ f : FractionRing ((MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k ⧸ ℐ) ⧸
            PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal Z) ≃ₐ[k]
            ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim x' y)) ⊔
              IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim y z'))),
          ∀ p, (f (algebraMap ((MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k ⧸ ℐ) ⧸
            PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal Z) _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ p))) : Ω) =
              aeval (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z') p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x', z', hx', hz', hZeq⟩ :=
    (Set.ext_iff.1 (locusIncidence_dominatingComponents_eq_jointLoci (k := k) x y z hxy hzy) Z).1
      ⟨hZ, hdense⟩
  have hle := locusIncidence_le_idealOf (k := k) x' y z'
  rw [hx', hz'] at hle
  have hprime : (Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ)
      (idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z'))).IsPrime :=
    Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (by rwa [Ideal.mk_ker])
  
  have hvan : PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal Z =
      (idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z')).map (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k ℐ) :=
    (congrArg PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal hZeq).trans
      ((PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical _).trans hprime.radical)
  let e := (Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq k hvan).trans
    ((DoubleQuot.quotQuotEquivQuotOfLEₐ k hle).trans
      (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (k := k) (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z')))
  have he (p : MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k) :
      (e (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ p)) : Ω) =
        aeval (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z') p := by
    change (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (k := k) (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z')
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p) : Ω) = _
    rw [locusCoordinateRingEquiv_mk]
  have hcomp : IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z')) =
      IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim x' y)) ⊔
        IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim y z')) := by
    rw [← IntermediateField.adjoin_union]
    congr 1
    simp only [Set.Sum.elim_range]
    ext u
    simp only [Set.mem_union]
    tauto
  let f := (IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv
    (K := FractionRing ((MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k ⧸ ℐ) ⧸ PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal Z))
    (L := IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z'))) e).trans
    (IntermediateField.equivOfEq hcomp)
  refine ⟨x', z', hx', hz', e, he, f, fun p ↦ ?_⟩
  exact (congrArg Subtype.val (IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv_algebraMap
    (K := FractionRing ((MvPolynomial ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) k ⧸ ℐ) ⧸ PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal Z))
    (L := IntermediateField.adjoin k (Set.range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z'))) e
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ p)))).trans (he p)

name: AclGeom.AdditiveRigidity.linePoint_comp_scale
statement:
theorem linePoint_comp_scale (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C] (a : k) (x : C) :
    AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k x ≫ scale k a =
      AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (algebraMap k C a * x)
proof:
:= by
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval x).toRingHom) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval
        (algebraMap k _ a * AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k)).toRingHom) =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (algebraMap k C a * x)).toRingHom)
  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
  apply congrArg Spec.map
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  change ((AffineSchemeAction.lineEval x).comp (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval
    (algebraMap k (AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1) a *
      AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k))).toRingHom =
    (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (algebraMap k C a * x)).toRingHom
  apply congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom
  apply AffineSchemeAction.lineHom_ext
  simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AffineSchemeAction.lineEval_lineCoordinate, map_mul,
    AlgHom.commutes]

name: AclGeom.CurveBoundary.finite_closed_boundary
statement:
theorem finite_closed_boundary
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom]
    [QuasiCompact V.hom] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1)
    (U : Over (Spec (.of k))) [Nonempty U.left] (j : U ⟶ V) [IsOpenImmersion j.left] :
    ((Set.range j.left)ᶜ).Finite ∧
      ∀ x ∈ (Set.range j.left)ᶜ, IsClosed ({x} : Set V.left)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian V.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian V.hom
  have : CompactSpace V.left := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace V.hom
  have : IsNoetherian V.left := ⟨⟩
  have : Nonempty j.left.opensRange :=
    ⟨⟨j.left (Classical.arbitrary U.left), Classical.arbitrary U.left, rfl⟩⟩
  simpa only [Scheme.Hom.coe_opensRange] using
    finite_closed_complement V.left hdim j.left.opensRange

name: AclGeom.CurveBoundary.orbitMap_eq_constant
statement:
theorem orbitMap_eq_constant
    (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom]
    [QuasiCompact V.hom] [IsSeparated V.hom] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1)
    (U : Over (Spec (.of k))) [Nonempty U.left] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X U]
    (j : U ⟶ V) [IsOpenImmersion j.left] [IsModHom G.toGroupScheme.X j]
    (p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ V)
    (hp : p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) ∉ Set.range j.left) :
    orbitMap G.toAlgebraicGroup V p = toUnit G.toGroupScheme.X ≫ p
proof:
:= by
  let GX := G.toGroupScheme.X
  let f := orbitMap G.toAlgebraicGroup V p
  let B : Set V.left := (Set.range j.left)ᶜ
  obtain ⟨hfinite, hclosed⟩ := finite_closed_boundary V hdim U j
  have hB : IsClosed B := j.left.opensRange.isOpen.isClosed_compl
  have : JacobsonSpace GX.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.jacobsonSpace GX.hom
  have hpoints : closedPoints GX.left ⊆ f.left ⁻¹' B := by
    intro a ha
    let q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX :=
      Over.homMk (pointOfClosedPoint GX.hom a ha) (pointOfClosedPoint_comp GX.hom a ha)
    have hq : q.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) = a :=
      pointOfClosedPoint_apply GX.hom a ha _
    have h := congrArg (fun z : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ V ↦
      z.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) (orbitMap_point G.toAlgebraicGroup V p q)
    change f.left (q.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) =
      (ModObj.pointAct V q).left (p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) at h
    rw [hq] at h
    change f.left a ∉ Set.range j.left
    rw [h]
    exact pointAct_mem_complement j q _ hp
  have hmem : ∀ a : GX.left, f.left a ∈ B := by
    have hc := closure_minimal hpoints (hB.preimage f.left.continuous)
    rw [closure_closedPoints] at hc
    exact fun a ↦ hc (Set.mem_univ a)
  have hconst := constant_of_finite_closed_range f.left f.left.continuous B
    hfinite hclosed hmem
  have hone : (1 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX) ≫ f = p := by
    rw [orbitMap_point, ModObj.pointAct_one, Category.comp_id]
  have hvalue := congrArg (fun z : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ V ↦
    z.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) hone
  change f.left ((1 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX).left
    (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) = p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) at hvalue
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType (f.left ≫ V.hom) := by rw [Over.w f]; infer_instance
  refine AlgebraicGeometry.ext_of_apply_eq V.hom Set.univ isClosed_univ.isLocallyClosed
    dense_univ ?_ ((Over.w f).trans (Over.w (toUnit GX ≫ p)).symm)
  intro a _ _
  change f.left a = p.left ((toUnit GX).left a)
  exact (hconst a ((1 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ GX).left
    (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k))).trans
      (hvalue.trans (congrArg p.left
        (Subsingleton.elim (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) ((toUnit GX).left a))))

name: AclGeom.CurveBoundary.fixed_boundary
statement:
theorem fixed_boundary
    (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom]
    [QuasiCompact V.hom] [IsSeparated V.hom] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1)
    (U : Over (Spec (.of k))) [Nonempty U.left] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X U]
    (j : U ⟶ V) [IsOpenImmersion j.left] [IsModHom G.toGroupScheme.X j] :
    ((Set.range j.left)ᶜ).Finite ∧
      (∀ x ∈ (Set.range j.left)ᶜ, IsClosed ({x} : Set V.left)) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ (Set.range j.left)ᶜ,
        ∃ p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ V,
          p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) = x ∧
          orbitMap G.toAlgebraicGroup V p = toUnit G.toGroupScheme.X ≫ p ∧
          ∀ (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (q : T ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X),
            q • (toUnit T ≫ p) = toUnit T ≫ p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hf, hc⟩ := finite_closed_boundary V hdim U j
  refine ⟨hf, hc, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  let p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ V :=
    Over.homMk (pointOfClosedPoint V.hom x (hc x hx))
      (pointOfClosedPoint_comp V.hom x (hc x hx))
  have hp : p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) = x :=
    pointOfClosedPoint_apply V.hom x (hc x hx) _
  have hfix := orbitMap_eq_constant G V hdim U j p (hp ▸ hx)
  refine ⟨p, hp, hfix, ?_⟩
  intro T q
  have h := congrArg (fun z : G.toGroupScheme.X ⟶ V ↦ q ≫ z) hfix
  change q ≫ lift (𝟙 _) (toUnit G.toGroupScheme.X ≫ p) ≫
    γ[G.toGroupScheme.X, V] = q ≫ toUnit G.toGroupScheme.X ≫ p at h
  simpa only [comp_lift_assoc, Category.comp_id, comp_toUnit_assoc, Hom.smul_def] using h

name: AclGeom.dominatingComponents_tensorProduct_fractionRing
statement:
theorem dominatingComponents_tensorProduct_fractionRing
    {A B C K L M : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [CommRing B] [IsDomain B]
    [CommRing C] [IsDomain C] [Field K] [Field L] [Field M]
    [Algebra A B] [Algebra A C] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Algebra B L] [IsFractionRing B L] [Algebra C M] [IsFractionRing C M]
    [Algebra A L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower A B L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [Algebra A M] [Algebra K M] [IsScalarTower A C M] [IsScalarTower A K M] :
    let φ
proof:
:= (IsLocalization.algebraTensorEquiv (nonZeroDivisors A) K L M).symm.toRingHom.comp
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B L)
        (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A C M)).toRingHom
    (fun Q : Ideal (L ⊗[K] M) ↦
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.comap φ Q : Set (B ⊗[A] C))) ''
        minimalPrimes (L ⊗[K] M) =
      {Z | Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum (B ⊗[A] C)) ∧
        closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (B ⊗[A] C)) '' Z) = Set.univ} := by
  classical
  intro φ
  have hG := minimalPrimes_tensorProduct_fractionRing
    (A := A) (B := B) (C := C) (K := K) (L := L) (M := M)
  have hdom (P : Ideal (B ⊗[A] C)) :
      closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (B ⊗[A] C)) ''
        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (P : Set (B ⊗[A] C))) = Set.univ ↔
      ∀ a : A, a ≠ 0 → algebraMap A (B ⊗[A] C) a ∉ P := by
    rw [PrimeSpectrum.closure_image_comap_zeroLocus,
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_eq_univ_iff, nilradical_eq_zero]
    change (∀ a : A, algebraMap A (B ⊗[A] C) a ∈ P → a = 0) ↔ _
    constructor
    · intro h a ha hmem
      exact ha (h a hmem)
    · intro h a hmem
      by_contra ha
      exact h a ha hmem
  ext Z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩
    have hP : Ideal.comap φ Q ∈ {P : Ideal (B ⊗[A] C) |
        P ∈ minimalPrimes (B ⊗[A] C) ∧
        ∀ a : A, a ≠ 0 → algebraMap A (B ⊗[A] C) a ∉ P} := by
      rw [← hG]
      exact ⟨Q, hQ, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨?_, (hdom _).2 hP.2⟩
    rw [← PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_minimalPrimes]
    exact ⟨Ideal.comap φ Q, hP.1, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨hZ, hd⟩
    rw [← PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_minimalPrimes] at hZ
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hZ⟩ := hZ
    change PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (P : Set (B ⊗[A] C)) = Z at hZ
    subst Z
    have hmem : P ∈ {P | P ∈ minimalPrimes (B ⊗[A] C) ∧
        ∀ a : A, a ≠ 0 → algebraMap A (B ⊗[A] C) a ∉ P} := ⟨hP, (hdom P).1 hd⟩
    rw [← hG] at hmem
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ, heq⟩ := hmem
    exact ⟨Q, hQ, congrArg (fun P : Ideal (B ⊗[A] C) ↦
      PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (P : Set (B ⊗[A] C))) heq⟩

name: AclGeom.compScale_apply
statement:
theorem compScale_apply (α : K) (p : Polynomial K) :
    compScale α p = p.comp (Polynomial.C α * Polynomial.X)
proof:
:=
  Polynomial.coe_compRingHom_apply p _

name: AclGeom.compScale_injective
statement:
theorem compScale_injective {α : K} (hα : α ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (compScale α)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q h
  have h2 := congrArg (compScale α⁻¹) h
  have hcomp : ∀ r : Polynomial K, compScale α⁻¹ (compScale α r) = r := by
    intro r
    rw [compScale_apply, compScale_apply, Polynomial.comp_assoc]
    have hlin : (Polynomial.C α * Polynomial.X).comp
        (Polynomial.C α⁻¹ * Polynomial.X) = Polynomial.X := by
      rw [Polynomial.mul_comp, Polynomial.C_comp, Polynomial.X_comp,
        ← mul_assoc, ← Polynomial.C_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hα,
        Polynomial.C_1, one_mul]
    rw [hlin, Polynomial.comp_X]
  rwa [hcomp, hcomp] at h2

name: AclGeom.innerParam_apply
statement:
theorem innerParam_apply (α : K) (n : ℕ) (p : Polynomial K) :
    innerParam α n p = Polynomial.expand K n (compScale α p)
proof: := rfl

name: AclGeom.innerParam_injective
statement:
theorem innerParam_injective {α : K} (hα : α ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (innerParam α n)
proof:
:=
  (Polynomial.expand_injective (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn)).comp
    (compScale_injective hα)

name: AclGeom.innerParam_coeff_eq_zero
statement:
theorem innerParam_coeff_eq_zero {α : K} {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (p : Polynomial K) {e : ℕ} (he : ¬ n ∣ e) :
    (innerParam α n p).coeff e = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [innerParam_apply, Polynomial.coeff_expand (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn),
    ite_eq_right he]

name: AclGeom.binomialParam_C
statement:
theorem binomialParam_C (α : K) (n m : ℕ) (p : Polynomial K) :
    binomialParam α n m (Polynomial.C p) = innerParam α n p
proof:
:= by
  simp [binomialParam]

name: AclGeom.binomialParam_X
statement:
theorem binomialParam_X (α : K) (n m : ℕ) :
    binomialParam α n m Polynomial.X = Polynomial.X ^ m
proof:
:= by
  simp [binomialParam]

name: AclGeom.binomialParam_cosetBinomial
statement:
theorem binomialParam_cosetBinomial {α c : K} (m₀ n₀ : ℕ)
    (hroot : α ^ m₀ = c) :
    binomialParam α n₀ m₀ (cosetBinomial c m₀ n₀) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : binomialParam α n₀ m₀
      (Polynomial.C ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial K) ^ m₀)) =
      Polynomial.C (α ^ m₀) * Polynomial.X ^ (n₀ * m₀) := by
    rw [binomialParam_C, map_pow, innerParam_apply, compScale_apply,
      Polynomial.X_comp]
    rw [map_mul, Polynomial.expand_C, Polynomial.expand_X, mul_pow,
      ← Polynomial.C_pow, ← pow_mul]
  have h2 : binomialParam α n₀ m₀
      (Polynomial.C (Polynomial.C c)) = Polynomial.C c := by
    rw [binomialParam_C, innerParam_apply, compScale_apply,
      Polynomial.C_comp, Polynomial.expand_C]
  have h3 : binomialParam α n₀ m₀
      ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial (Polynomial K)) ^ n₀) =
      Polynomial.X ^ (m₀ * n₀) := by
    rw [map_pow, binomialParam_X, ← pow_mul]
  rw [cosetBinomial, map_sub, map_mul, h1, h2, h3, hroot, mul_comm n₀ m₀,
    sub_self]

name: AclGeom.cosetBinomial_dvd_of_binomialParam_eq_zero
statement:
theorem cosetBinomial_dvd_of_binomialParam_eq_zero {α c : K} (hα : α ≠ 0)
    (hc : c ≠ 0) {m n : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hcop : Nat.gcd m n = 1) (hroot : α ^ m = c)
    {f : Polynomial (Polynomial K)} (hf : binomialParam α n m f = 0) :
    cosetBinomial c m n ∣ f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set bmon : Polynomial (Polynomial K) :=
    Polynomial.X ^ n - Polynomial.C (Polynomial.C c⁻¹ * Polynomial.X ^ m)
    with hbmon
  have hmonic : bmon.Monic := Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C _ hn
  have hbrel : cosetBinomial c m n = -Polynomial.C (Polynomial.C c) * bmon := by
    rw [hbmon, cosetBinomial]
    rw [neg_mul, mul_sub, ← Polynomial.C_mul, ← mul_assoc,
      ← Polynomial.C_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc, Polynomial.C_1, one_mul]
    ring
  
  have hbmon0 : binomialParam α n m bmon = 0 := by
    have hb0 := binomialParam_cosetBinomial (α := α) m n hroot
    rw [hbrel, map_mul, map_neg] at hb0
    have hCc : binomialParam α n m (Polynomial.C (Polynomial.C c)) =
        Polynomial.C c := by
      rw [binomialParam_C, innerParam_apply, compScale_apply,
        Polynomial.C_comp, Polynomial.expand_C]
    rw [hCc] at hb0
    have hCc0 : (Polynomial.C c : Polynomial K) ≠ 0 := by
      simpa using hc
    rcases mul_eq_zero.1 hb0 with h | h
    · exact absurd (neg_eq_zero.1 h) hCc0
    · exact h
  
  have hdiv := Polynomial.modByMonic_add_div f bmon
  have hr0 : f %ₘ bmon = 0 := by
    set r := f %ₘ bmon with hrdef
    have hψr : binomialParam α n m r = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (binomialParam α n m) hdiv
      rw [map_add, map_mul, hbmon0, zero_mul, add_zero] at h
      rw [h]
      exact hf
    rcases eq_or_ne r 0 with h0 | hrne
    · exact h0
    exfalso
    have hdeg : r.natDegree < n := by
      have h1 := Polynomial.degree_modByMonic_lt f hmonic
      have h2 : bmon.degree = n := by
        rw [hbmon]
        exact Polynomial.degree_X_pow_sub_C (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn) _
      rw [← hrdef, h2] at h1
      exact (Polynomial.natDegree_lt_iff_degree_lt hrne).2 h1
    
    have hrsum : r = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n,
        Polynomial.C (r.coeff j) * Polynomial.X ^ j := by
      conv_lhs => rw [Polynomial.as_sum_range' r n hdeg]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦
        (Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial).symm
    have hψsum : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n,
        innerParam α n (r.coeff j) * Polynomial.X ^ (m * j) = 0 := by
      have h := hψr
      rw [hrsum] at h
      rw [map_sum] at h
      have hterm : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range n,
          binomialParam α n m (Polynomial.C (r.coeff j) * Polynomial.X ^ j) =
          innerParam α n (r.coeff j) * Polynomial.X ^ (m * j) := by
        intro j _
        rw [map_mul, map_pow, binomialParam_C, binomialParam_X, ← pow_mul]
      rwa [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm] at h
    
    have hterm0 : ∀ j₀ ∈ Finset.range n,
        innerParam α n (r.coeff j₀) * Polynomial.X ^ (m * j₀) = 0 := by
      intro j₀ hj₀
      ext e
      rw [Polynomial.coeff_zero]
      by_contra hce
      
      have hle : m * j₀ ≤ e := by
        by_contra hlt
        rw [Polynomial.coeff_mul_X_pow', ite_eq_right hlt] at hce
        exact hce rfl
      have hdvd : n ∣ e - m * j₀ := by
        by_contra hnd
        rw [Polynomial.coeff_mul_X_pow', ite_eq_left hle,
          innerParam_coeff_eq_zero hn _ hnd] at hce
        exact hce rfl
      
      have hothers : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range n, j ≠ j₀ →
          (innerParam α n (r.coeff j) * Polynomial.X ^ (m * j)).coeff e
          = 0 := by
        intro j hj hne
        by_contra hcj
        have hlej : m * j ≤ e := by
          by_contra hlt
          rw [Polynomial.coeff_mul_X_pow', ite_eq_right hlt] at hcj
          exact hcj rfl
        have hdvdj : n ∣ e - m * j := by
          by_contra hnd
          rw [Polynomial.coeff_mul_X_pow', ite_eq_left hlej,
            innerParam_coeff_eq_zero hn _ hnd] at hcj
          exact hcj rfl
        have hmod : m * j ≡ m * j₀ [MOD n] := by
          have h1 : m * j₀ ≡ e [MOD n] :=
            (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' hle).2 hdvd
          have h2 : m * j ≡ e [MOD n] :=
            (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' hlej).2 hdvdj
          exact h2.trans h1.symm
        have hjj : j ≡ j₀ [MOD n] :=
          hmod.cancel_left_of_coprime ((Nat.gcd_comm n m).trans hcop)
        have : j = j₀ := by
          have h1 := hjj
          unfold Nat.ModEq at h1
          rwa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Finset.mem_range.1 hj),
            Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Finset.mem_range.1 hj₀)] at h1
        exact hne this
      have hsum := congrArg (fun p ↦ Polynomial.coeff p e) hψsum
      rw [Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff] at hsum
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j₀ hothers (fun h ↦ absurd hj₀ h)] at hsum
      exact hce hsum
    
    refine hrne ?_
    ext j
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j n with hj | hj
    · have h := hterm0 j (Finset.mem_range.2 hj)
      have hX0 : (Polynomial.X : Polynomial K) ^ (m * j) ≠ 0 :=
        pow_ne_zero _ Polynomial.X_ne_zero
      rcases mul_eq_zero.1 h with h1 | h1
      · have h2 : innerParam α n (r.coeff j) = innerParam α n 0 := by
          rw [h1, map_zero]
        have := innerParam_injective hα hn h2
        simp [this]
      · exact absurd h1 hX0
    · simp [Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt
        (lt_of_lt_of_le hdeg hj)]
  
  have hfact : f = bmon * (f /ₘ bmon) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hdiv]
    rw [hr0, zero_add]
  have hcc : (-Polynomial.C (Polynomial.C c) : Polynomial (Polynomial K)) *
      (-Polynomial.C (Polynomial.C c⁻¹)) = 1 := by
    rw [neg_mul_neg, ← Polynomial.C_mul, ← Polynomial.C_mul,
      mul_inv_cancel₀ hc, Polynomial.C_1, Polynomial.C_1]
  refine ⟨-Polynomial.C (Polynomial.C c⁻¹) * (f /ₘ bmon), ?_⟩
  rw [hbrel]
  calc f = bmon * (f /ₘ bmon) := hfact
    _ = (-Polynomial.C (Polynomial.C c) * -Polynomial.C (Polynomial.C c⁻¹)) *
        (bmon * (f /ₘ bmon)) := by rw [hcc, one_mul]
    _ = -Polynomial.C (Polynomial.C c) * bmon *
        (-Polynomial.C (Polynomial.C c⁻¹) * (f /ₘ bmon)) := by ring

name: AclGeom.cosetBinomial_prime
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq c (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm)
  have hα0 : α ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [zero_pow hm] at hα
    exact hc hα.symm
  have hker_eq : Ideal.span {cosetBinomial c m n} =
      RingHom.ker (binomialParam α n m) := by
    ext f
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton, RingHom.mem_ker]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨g, rfl⟩
      rw [map_mul, binomialParam_cosetBinomial m n hα, zero_mul]
    · exact cosetBinomial_dvd_of_binomialParam_eq_zero hα0 hc hm hn hcop hα
  have hprime_ideal : (Ideal.span {cosetBinomial c m n}).IsPrime := by
    rw [hker_eq]
    exact RingHom.ker_isPrime _
  have hb0 : cosetBinomial c m n ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hcoeff := congrArg (fun p ↦ Polynomial.coeff p n) h0
    simp only [cosetBinomial, Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_zero,
      Polynomial.coeff_C_mul, Polynomial.coeff_X_pow, ite_eq_left rfl, mul_one,
      Polynomial.coeff_C, ite_eq_right hn] at hcoeff
    rw [zero_sub, neg_eq_zero] at hcoeff
    exact hc (by simpa using hcoeff)
  exact (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hb0).1 hprime_ideal

name: AclGeom.nestEquiv_X_zero
statement:
theorem nestEquiv_X_zero :
    nestEquiv K (MvPolynomial.X 0) =
      (Polynomial.X : Polynomial (Polynomial K))
proof:
:= by
  rw [nestEquiv, AlgEquiv.trans_apply, MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv_X_zero,
    Polynomial.coe_mapAlgEquiv, Polynomial.map_X]

name: AclGeom.nestEquiv_X_one
statement:
theorem nestEquiv_X_one :
    nestEquiv K (MvPolynomial.X 1) = Polynomial.C Polynomial.X
proof:
:= by
  rw [nestEquiv, AlgEquiv.trans_apply]
  have hXone : MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv K 1 (MvPolynomial.X (1 : Fin 2)) =
      Polynomial.C (MvPolynomial.X 0) := by
    have h := MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv_X_succ (R := K) (n := 1) (j := 0)
    simpa using h
  rw [hXone, Polynomial.coe_mapAlgEquiv, Polynomial.map_C]
  congr 1
  have h2 : MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv K (Fin 1) (MvPolynomial.X 0) =
      Polynomial.X := by
    have hX : (MvPolynomial.X (0 : Fin 1) : MvPolynomial (Fin 1) K) =
        MvPolynomial.monomial (Finsupp.single 0 1) 1 := by
      rw [MvPolynomial.monomial_eq]
      simp
    rw [hX, MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv_monomial]
    simp [Polynomial.monomial_one_one_eq_X]
  exact h2

name: AclGeom.nestEquiv_C
statement:
theorem nestEquiv_C (a : K) :
    nestEquiv K (MvPolynomial.C a) = Polynomial.C (Polynomial.C a)
proof:
:= by
  have h : nestEquiv K (MvPolynomial.C a) = algebraMap K _ a :=
    (nestEquiv K).commutes a
  rw [h]
  rfl

name: AclGeom.mvBinomial_prime
statement:
theorem mvBinomial_prime [IsAlgClosed K] {c : K} (hc : c ≠ 0) {m n : ℕ}
    (hm : m ≠ 0) (hn : n ≠ 0) (hcop : Nat.gcd m n = 1) :
    Prime ((MvPolynomial.X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) ^ m -
      MvPolynomial.C c * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  have himage : nestEquiv K
      ((MvPolynomial.X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) ^ m -
        MvPolynomial.C c * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ n) =
      -Polynomial.C (Polynomial.C c) * cosetBinomial c⁻¹ n m := by
    rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow, nestEquiv_X_zero, nestEquiv_X_one,
      nestEquiv_C, cosetBinomial]
    rw [neg_mul, mul_sub, ← Polynomial.C_pow, ← Polynomial.C_mul,
      ← mul_assoc, ← Polynomial.C_mul, ← Polynomial.C_mul,
      mul_inv_cancel₀ hc, Polynomial.C_1, Polynomial.C_1, one_mul]
    ring
  have hunit : IsUnit (-Polynomial.C (Polynomial.C c) :
      Polynomial (Polynomial K)) := by
    refine IsUnit.neg ?_
    rw [Polynomial.isUnit_C, Polynomial.isUnit_C]
    exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.2 hc
  have hprime : Prime (nestEquiv K
      ((MvPolynomial.X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) ^ m -
        MvPolynomial.C c * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ n)) := by
    rw [himage]
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hunit
    have hassoc : Associated (cosetBinomial c⁻¹ n m)
        (-Polynomial.C (Polynomial.C c) * cosetBinomial c⁻¹ n m) :=
