      ⟨u, by rw [hu]; ring⟩
    exact hassoc.prime (cosetBinomial_prime (inv_ne_zero hc) hn hm
      ((Nat.gcd_comm n m).trans hcop))
  exact (MulEquiv.prime_iff (nestEquiv K)).1 hprime

name: AclGeom.mvParam_binomial
statement:
theorem mvParam_binomial {α c : K} {m n : ℕ} (hroot : α ^ m = c) :
    mvParam α n m ((MvPolynomial.X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) ^ m -
      MvPolynomial.C c * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mvParam, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, map_pow, MvPolynomial.aeval_X,
    MvPolynomial.aeval_X, MvPolynomial.aeval_C]
  have h0 : (![Polynomial.C α * Polynomial.X ^ n, Polynomial.X ^ m] :
      Fin 2 → Polynomial K) 0 = Polynomial.C α * Polynomial.X ^ n := rfl
  have h1 : (![Polynomial.C α * Polynomial.X ^ n, Polynomial.X ^ m] :
      Fin 2 → Polynomial K) 1 = Polynomial.X ^ m := rfl
  rw [h0, h1, mul_pow, ← Polynomial.C_pow, hroot, ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul,
    mul_comm n m]
  have halg : (algebraMap K (Polynomial K)) c = Polynomial.C c := rfl
  rw [halg, sub_self]

name: AclGeom.eq_smul_binomial_of_dvd_shift
statement:
theorem eq_smul_binomial_of_dvd_shift [IsAlgClosed K]
    {G : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K} (hGp : Prime G)
    {P Q : Polynomial K} (hP0 : P.coeff 0 = 0) (hQ0 : Q.coeff 0 = 0)
    (hsplit : G = Polynomial.aeval (MvPolynomial.X 0) P +
      Polynomial.aeval (MvPolynomial.X 1) Q)
    {c d : K} (hc : c ≠ 0) {m n : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (hcop : Nat.gcd m n = 1)
    (hdvd : ((MvPolynomial.X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) ^ m -
      MvPolynomial.C c * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ n) ∣ (G - MvPolynomial.C d)) :
    d = 0 ∧ ∃ l : K, l ≠ 0 ∧
      P = Polynomial.C l * Polynomial.X ^ m ∧
      Q = -(Polynomial.C (l * c)) * Polynomial.X ^ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq c (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm)
  
  have hcomp0 : ∀ p : Polynomial K,
      mvParam α n m (Polynomial.aeval (MvPolynomial.X 0) p) =
        Polynomial.aeval (Polynomial.C α * Polynomial.X ^ n) p := by
    intro p
    rw [← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, mvParam, MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
    rfl
  have hcomp1 : ∀ p : Polynomial K,
      mvParam α n m (Polynomial.aeval (MvPolynomial.X 1) p) =
        Polynomial.aeval (Polynomial.X ^ m) p := by
    intro p
    rw [← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, mvParam, MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
    rfl
  
  have hGval : mvParam α n m G = Polynomial.C d := by
    obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := hdvd
    have h := congrArg (mvParam α n m) hR
    rw [map_sub, map_mul, mvParam_binomial hα, zero_mul] at h
    rw [sub_eq_zero] at h
    rw [h]
    exact MvPolynomial.aeval_C _ _
  
  have hd0 : d = 0 := by
    have hc0 := congrArg (fun p ↦ Polynomial.coeff p 0) hGval
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_C_zero] at hc0
    rw [hsplit, map_add, hcomp0, hcomp1] at hc0
    have he0 : ∀ (s : Polynomial K), s.eval 0 = 0 →
        ∀ p : Polynomial K, p.coeff 0 = 0 →
        (Polynomial.aeval s p).coeff 0 = 0 := by
      intro s hs p hp
      have haev : Polynomial.aeval s p = p.comp s := rfl
      rw [haev, Polynomial.coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, Polynomial.eval_comp,
        hs, ← Polynomial.coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, hp]
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_add,
      he0 _ (by simp [Polynomial.eval_pow, zero_pow hn]) _ hP0,
      he0 _ (by simp [zero_pow hm]) _ hQ0, add_zero] at hc0
    exact hc0.symm
  
  subst hd0
  rw [map_zero, sub_zero] at hdvd
  have hassoc : Associated ((MvPolynomial.X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) ^ m -
      MvPolynomial.C c * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ n) G :=
    (mvBinomial_prime hc hm hn hcop).associated_of_dvd hGp hdvd
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hassoc
  
  have hudeg : ((u : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K)).totalDegree = 0 := by
    have h1 : ((u : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) *
        ((u⁻¹ : (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K)ˣ) :
          MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K)).totalDegree = 0 := by
      rw [Units.mul_inv]
      exact MvPolynomial.totalDegree_one
    rw [MvPolynomial.totalDegree_mul_of_isDomain (Units.ne_zero u)
      (Units.ne_zero u⁻¹)] at h1
    omega
  set l := (u : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K).coeff 0 with hldef
  have hCform : (u : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) = MvPolynomial.C l :=
    MvPolynomial.totalDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C.1 hudeg
  refine ⟨rfl, l, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h0
    have hne := Units.ne_zero u
    rw [hCform, h0, map_zero] at hne
    exact hne rfl
  · 
    have hΦG : MvPolynomial.aeval
        (![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial K)] : Fin 2 → Polynomial K) G =
        P := by
      rw [hsplit, map_add, ← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply,
        ← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, MvPolynomial.aeval_X,
        MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
      have h0 : (![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial K)] : Fin 2 → Polynomial K)
          0 = Polynomial.X := rfl
      have h1 : (![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial K)] : Fin 2 → Polynomial K)
          1 = 0 := rfl
      rw [h0, h1, Polynomial.aeval_X_left_apply]
      have hQ0' : Polynomial.aeval (0 : Polynomial K) Q = 0 := by
        rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, Polynomial.eval₂_at_zero, hQ0, map_zero]
      rw [hQ0', add_zero]
    have hΦB : MvPolynomial.aeval
        (![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial K)] : Fin 2 → Polynomial K)
        (((MvPolynomial.X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) ^ m -
          MvPolynomial.C c * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ n) *
          (u : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K)) =
        Polynomial.C l * Polynomial.X ^ m := by
      rw [hCform, map_mul, MvPolynomial.aeval_C, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow,
        map_pow, MvPolynomial.aeval_X, MvPolynomial.aeval_X,
        MvPolynomial.aeval_C]
      have h0 : (![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial K)] : Fin 2 → Polynomial K)
          0 = Polynomial.X := rfl
      have h1 : (![Polynomial.X, (0 : Polynomial K)] : Fin 2 → Polynomial K)
          1 = 0 := rfl
      rw [h0, h1, zero_pow hn, mul_zero, sub_zero, Polynomial.algebraMap_eq]
      ring
    rw [← hΦG, ← hu, hΦB]
  · 
    have hΦG : MvPolynomial.aeval
        (![(0 : Polynomial K), Polynomial.X] : Fin 2 → Polynomial K) G =
        Q := by
      rw [hsplit, map_add, ← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply,
        ← Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, MvPolynomial.aeval_X,
        MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
      have h0 : (![(0 : Polynomial K), Polynomial.X] : Fin 2 → Polynomial K)
          0 = 0 := rfl
      have h1 : (![(0 : Polynomial K), Polynomial.X] : Fin 2 → Polynomial K)
          1 = Polynomial.X := rfl
      rw [h0, h1, Polynomial.aeval_X_left_apply]
      have hP0' : Polynomial.aeval (0 : Polynomial K) P = 0 := by
        rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, Polynomial.eval₂_at_zero, hP0, map_zero]
      rw [hP0', zero_add]
    have hΦB : MvPolynomial.aeval
        (![(0 : Polynomial K), Polynomial.X] : Fin 2 → Polynomial K)
        (((MvPolynomial.X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K) ^ m -
          MvPolynomial.C c * MvPolynomial.X 1 ^ n) *
          (u : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K)) =
        -(Polynomial.C (l * c)) * Polynomial.X ^ n := by
      rw [hCform, map_mul, MvPolynomial.aeval_C, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow,
        map_pow, MvPolynomial.aeval_X, MvPolynomial.aeval_X,
        MvPolynomial.aeval_C]
      have h0 : (![(0 : Polynomial K), Polynomial.X] : Fin 2 → Polynomial K)
          0 = 0 := rfl
      have h1 : (![(0 : Polynomial K), Polynomial.X] : Fin 2 → Polynomial K)
          1 = Polynomial.X := rfl
      rw [h0, h1, zero_pow hm, zero_sub, Polynomial.algebraMap_eq,
        Polynomial.C_mul]
      ring
    rw [← hΦG, ← hu, hΦB]

name: AclGeom.exists_productMap_ker_of_isPrime
statement:
theorem exists_productMap_ker_of_isPrime
    {E F G Ω : Type*} [Field E] [Field F] [Field G] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra E F] [Algebra E G] [Algebra E Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    [FiniteDimensional E F] [FiniteDimensional E G]
    (I : Ideal (F ⊗[E] G)) [I.IsPrime] :
    ∃ (f : F →ₐ[E] Ω) (g : G →ₐ[E] Ω),
      RingHom.ker (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap f g) = I
proof:
:= by
  let : IsArtinianRing (F ⊗[E] G) := IsArtinianRing.of_finite E _
  let : Field ((F ⊗[E] G) ⧸ I) := Ideal.Quotient.field I
  let e : ((F ⊗[E] G) ⧸ I) →ₐ[E] Ω := IsAlgClosed.lift
  let φ := e.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ E I)
  refine ⟨φ.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft,
    φ.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight, ?_⟩
  have hφ : Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap
      (φ.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft)
      (φ.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight) = φ := by
    ext <;> simp [← Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def]
  rw [hφ]
  change RingHom.ker (e.toRingHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) = I
  rw [RingHom.ker_comp_of_injective _ e.injective, Ideal.mk_ker]

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.exists_tensor_component_embeddings
statement:
theorem FiniteCorrespondencePair.exists_tensor_component_embeddings
    {k Ω : Type*} [Field k] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (P Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) (h : P.target = Q.source) :
    let E
proof:
:= P.targetField
    let F := adjoin (↥E) {P.source}
    let G := adjoin (↥E) {Q.target}
    ∀ I : Ideal (F ⊗[↥E] G), I ∈ (⊥ : Ideal (F ⊗[↥E] G)).minimalPrimes →
      ∃ (f : F →ₐ[↥E] Ω) (g : G →ₐ[↥E] Ω),
        RingHom.ker (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap f g) = I := by
  intro E F G I hI
  let : FiniteDimensional (↥E) F :=
    IntermediateField.adjoin.finiteDimensional
      ((mem_racl_iff k).mp P.source_mem_target).isIntegral
  have hz : IsAlgebraic (↥E) Q.target := by
    change IsAlgebraic (adjoin k {P.target}) Q.target
    rw [h]
    exact (mem_racl_iff k).mp Q.target_mem_source
  let : FiniteDimensional (↥E) G :=
    IntermediateField.adjoin.finiteDimensional hz.isIntegral
  have : I.IsPrime := hI.isPrime
  exact exists_productMap_ker_of_isPrime I

name: AclGeom.realize_pair
statement:
private theorem realize_pair
    {k Ω K : Type*} [Field k] [Field Ω] [Field K] [Algebra k Ω] [Algebra k K]
    (P : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) (ι f : K →ₐ[k] Ω) (x y : K)
    (hx : ι x = P.source) (hy : ι y = P.target) :
    ∃ R : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω,
      R.source = f x ∧ R.target = f y ∧ R.ideal = P.ideal
proof:
:= by
  have hgen : x ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) := by
    intro hxalg
    apply P.source_generic
    rw [← hx]
    exact (algHom_mem_racl_empty_iff ι).mpr hxalg
  have hyx : y ∈ racl k {x} :=
    (algHom_mem_racl_singleton_iff ι).mp (by simpa [hx, hy] using P.target_mem_source)
  have hxy : x ∈ racl k {y} :=
    (algHom_mem_racl_singleton_iff ι).mp (by simpa [hx, hy] using P.source_mem_target)
  let R : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω :=
    { source := f x
      target := f y
      source_generic := (algHom_mem_racl_empty_iff f).not.mpr hgen
      target_mem_source := (algHom_mem_racl_singleton_iff f).mpr hyx
      source_mem_target := (algHom_mem_racl_singleton_iff f).mpr hxy }
  refine ⟨R, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  have tuple_comp (j : K →ₐ[k] Ω) :
      (⇑j ∘ ![x, y]) = (![j x, j y] : Fin 2 → Ω) := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have hf := idealOf_comp_algHom k f (![x, y] : Fin 2 → K)
  have hi := idealOf_comp_algHom k ι (![x, y] : Fin 2 → K)
  rw [tuple_comp] at hf
  rw [tuple_comp, hx, hy] at hi
  exact hf.trans hi.symm

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.exists_composite_of_tensor_component
statement:
theorem FiniteCorrespondencePair.exists_composite_of_tensor_component
    {k Ω : Type*} [Field k] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (P Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) (h : P.target = Q.source) :
    let E
proof:
:= P.targetField
    let F := adjoin (↥E) {P.source}
    let G := adjoin (↥E) {Q.target}
    let x : F := ⟨P.source, subset_adjoin (↥E) {P.source} rfl⟩
    let z : G := ⟨Q.target, subset_adjoin (↥E) {Q.target} rfl⟩
    ∀ I : Ideal (F ⊗[↥E] G), I ∈ (⊥ : Ideal (F ⊗[↥E] G)).minimalPrimes →
      ∃ (f : F →ₐ[↥E] Ω) (g : G →ₐ[↥E] Ω) (R : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω),
        RingHom.ker (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap f g) = I ∧
          R.source = f x ∧ R.target = g z ∧
          FiniteCorrespondenceGerm.Composes (FiniteCorrespondenceGerm.ofPair P)
            (FiniteCorrespondenceGerm.ofPair Q) (FiniteCorrespondenceGerm.ofPair R) := by
  intro E F G x z I hI
  obtain ⟨f, g, hfg⟩ := P.exists_tensor_component_embeddings Q h I hI
  let y : E := ⟨P.target, subset_adjoin k {P.target} rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨P', hx, hy, hP⟩ := realize_pair P (F.val.restrictScalars k)
    (f.restrictScalars k) x (algebraMap (↥E) F y) rfl rfl
  obtain ⟨Q', hy', hz, hQ⟩ := realize_pair Q (G.val.restrictScalars k)
    (g.restrictScalars k) (algebraMap (↥E) G y) z h rfl
  have hPmid : P'.target = P.target := hy.trans (f.commutes y)
  have hQmid : Q'.source = P.target := hy'.trans (g.commutes y)
  have hmid : P'.target = Q'.source := hPmid.trans hQmid.symm
  refine ⟨f, g, P'.comp Q' hmid, hfg, hx, hz, ?_⟩
  exact ⟨P', Q', hmid, hP.symm, hQ.symm, rfl⟩

name: AclGeom.idealOf_comp_eq_of_ker_eq
statement:
private theorem idealOf_comp_eq_of_ker_eq
    {k Ω A ι : Type*} [Field k] [Field Ω] [CommRing A]
    [Algebra k Ω] [Algebra k A] (f g : A →ₐ[k] Ω)
    (h : RingHom.ker f = RingHom.ker g) (a : ι → A) :
    idealOf k (⇑f ∘ a) = idealOf k (⇑g ∘ a)
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  have hf : MvPolynomial.aeval (⇑f ∘ a) p = f (MvPolynomial.aeval a p) := by
    rw [Function.comp_def, ← MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply]
  have hg : MvPolynomial.aeval (⇑g ∘ a) p = g (MvPolynomial.aeval a p) := by
    rw [Function.comp_def, ← MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply]
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, mem_idealOf_iff, hf, hg, ← RingHom.mem_ker,
    ← RingHom.mem_ker, h]

name: AclGeom.FiniteCorrespondencePair.tensor_component_endpoint_ideal_eq
statement:
theorem FiniteCorrespondencePair.tensor_component_endpoint_ideal_eq
    {k Ω : Type*} [Field k] [Field Ω] [Algebra k Ω]
    (P Q : FiniteCorrespondencePair k Ω) :
    let E
proof:
:= P.targetField
    let F := adjoin (↥E) {P.source}
    let G := adjoin (↥E) {Q.target}
    let x : F := ⟨P.source, subset_adjoin (↥E) {P.source} rfl⟩
    let z : G := ⟨Q.target, subset_adjoin (↥E) {Q.target} rfl⟩
    ∀ (f₁ f₂ : F →ₐ[↥E] Ω) (g₁ g₂ : G →ₐ[↥E] Ω),
      RingHom.ker (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap f₁ g₁) =
        RingHom.ker (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap f₂ g₂) →
      idealOf k ![f₁ x, g₁ z] = idealOf k ![f₂ x, g₂ z] := by
  intro E F G x z f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ h
  let a : Fin 2 → F ⊗[↥E] G := ![x ⊗ₜ[↥E] 1, 1 ⊗ₜ[↥E] z]
  have tuple_product (f : F →ₐ[↥E] Ω) (g : G →ₐ[↥E] Ω) :
      (⇑((Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap f g).restrictScalars k) ∘ a) =
        (![f x, g z] : Fin 2 → Ω) := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [a]
  have heq := idealOf_comp_eq_of_ker_eq
    ((Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap f₁ g₁).restrictScalars k)
    ((Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap f₂ g₂).restrictScalars k) h a
  rwa [tuple_product, tuple_product] at heq

name: AclGeom.CurveCoordinateCover.spec_functionField_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem spec_functionField_isScalarTower (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (A : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsDomain A] [Algebra k A] :
    let : Algebra k (Spec A).functionField
proof:
:= @ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAlgebra k _
      ((Spec A).asOver (Spec (.of k))) (inferInstanceAs (IsIntegral (Spec A)))
    IsScalarTower k A (Spec A).functionField := by
  let V := (Spec A).asOver (Spec (.of k))
  have : IsIntegral V.left := inferInstanceAs (IsIntegral (Spec A))
  let : Algebra k (Spec A).functionField := ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAlgebra V
  have : (algSpec (.of k)).Full := algSpec.instFull
  let p : (algSpec (.of k)).obj (.op (CommAlgCat.of k (Spec A).functionField)) ⟶
      (algSpec (.of k)).obj (.op (CommAlgCat.of k A)) :=
    SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter V
  let φ : A →ₐ[k] (Spec A).functionField := ((algSpec (.of k)).preimage p).unop.hom
  have hm : (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op = p :=
    (algSpec (.of k)).map_preimage p
  have hφ : φ.toRingHom = algebraMap A (Spec A).functionField := by
    have h := congrArg Over.Hom.left hm
    change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) =
      (Spec A).fromSpecStalk (genericPoint (Spec A)) at h
    rw [Spec.fromSpecStalk_eq'] at h
    exact congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (Spec.map_injective h)
  apply IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq
  intro c
  rw [← φ.commutes c]
  exact congrArg (fun f : A →+* (Spec A).functionField ↦ f (algebraMap k A c)) hφ

name: AclGeom.CurveCoordinateCover.AclGeom.CurveCoordinateCover.lineEval_injective_of_transcendental
statement:
theorem lineEval_injective_of_transcendental {k F : Type*} [Field k] [Field F]
    [Algebra k F] (t : F) (ht : Transcendental k t) :
    Function.Injective (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) t)
proof:
:= by
  let e : AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1 ≃ₐ[k] Polynomial k :=
    (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial (Pi.basisFun k (Fin 1))).trans
      (MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv k (Fin 1))
  have he : e (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k) = Polynomial.X := by
    change (MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv k (Fin 1))
      ((SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial (Pi.basisFun k (Fin 1)))
        (SymmetricAlgebra.ι k (Fin 1 → k) (Pi.basisFun k (Fin 1) 0))) = Polynomial.X
    rw [SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial_ι_apply]
    rw [MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv_apply, MvPolynomial.eval₂_X]
  have h : AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) t = (Polynomial.aeval t).comp e.toAlgHom := by
    apply AffineSchemeAction.lineHom_ext
    rw [AffineSchemeAction.lineEval_lineCoordinate, AlgHom.comp_apply]
    change t = Polynomial.aeval t (e (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k))
    rw [he, Polynomial.aeval_X]
  rw [h]
  exact (transcendental_iff_injective.mp ht).comp e.injective

name: AclGeom.CurveCoordinateCover.AclGeom.CurveCoordinateCover.AclGeom.CurveCoordinateCover.exists_line_functionField_equiv
statement:
theorem exists_line_functionField_equiv {k F : Type u} [Field k] [Field F] [Algebra k F]
    (t : F) (ht : Transcendental k t)
    (htop : IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F) = ⊤) :
    let A : CommRingCat.{u}
proof:
:= .of (AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1)
    letI : Algebra A (Spec A).functionField := instAlgebraCarrierFunctionFieldSpec A
    letI : Algebra k (Spec A).functionField := @ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAlgebra k _
      ((Spec A).asOver (Spec (.of k))) (inferInstanceAs (IsIntegral (Spec A)))
    ∃ E : (Spec A).functionField ≃ₐ[k] F,
      (∀ r : A, E (algebraMap A (Spec A).functionField r) =
        AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) t r) ∧
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom E.toRingHom) ≫
        (Spec A).fromSpecStalk (genericPoint (Spec A)) =
          (AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k t).left := by
  let A : CommRingCat.{u} := .of (AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1)
  let : Algebra A (Spec A).functionField := instAlgebraCarrierFunctionFieldSpec A
  let : IsFractionRing A (Spec A).functionField := functionField_isFractionRing_of_affine A
  let : Algebra k (Spec A).functionField := @ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAlgebra k _
    ((Spec A).asOver (Spec (.of k))) (inferInstanceAs (IsIntegral (Spec A)))
  have : IsScalarTower k A (Spec A).functionField := spec_functionField_isScalarTower k A
  let χ : A →ₐ[k] F := AffineSchemeAction.lineEval t
  have hχ : Function.Injective χ := lineEval_injective_of_transcendental t ht
  let η : (Spec A).functionField →ₐ[k] F := IsFractionRing.liftAlgHom hχ
  have hη (r : A) : η (algebraMap A (Spec A).functionField r) = χ r :=
    IsFractionRing.lift_algebraMap hχ r
  have htopη : η.fieldRange = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    rw [← htop]
    apply IntermediateField.adjoin_le_iff.mpr
    intro z hz
    have hz : z = t := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz
    subst z
    apply AlgHom.mem_fieldRange.mpr
    refine ⟨algebraMap A (Spec A).functionField (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k), ?_⟩
    exact (hη _).trans (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval_lineCoordinate t)
  let E : (Spec A).functionField ≃ₐ[k] F :=
    AlgEquiv.ofBijective η ⟨η.injective, AlgHom.fieldRange_eq_top.mp htopη⟩
  refine ⟨E, hη, ?_⟩
  let i : A ⟶ (Spec A).functionField :=
    CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (Spec A).functionField)
  let φ : (Spec A).functionField ⟶ CommRingCat.of F := CommRingCat.ofHom E.toRingHom
  have hcomp : i ≫ φ = CommRingCat.ofHom χ.toRingHom := by
    ext r
    exact hη r
  change Spec.map φ ≫ (Spec A).fromSpecStalk (genericPoint (Spec A)) = _
  calc
    _ = Spec.map φ ≫ Spec.map i := congrArg (fun q ↦ Spec.map φ ≫ q)
      (Spec.fromSpecStalk_eq' A (genericPoint (Spec A)))
    _ = Spec.map (i ≫ φ) := (Spec.map_comp i φ).symm
    _ = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom χ.toRingHom) := congrArg Spec.map hcomp
    _ = _ := rfl

name: AclGeom.CurveCoordinateCover.AclGeom.CurveCoordinateCover.AclGeom.CurveCoordinateCover.AclGeom.CurveCoordinateCover.linePoint_baseChange
statement:
theorem linePoint_baseChange {k A B : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra k A] [Algebra k B] (f : A →ₐ[k] B) (x : A) :
    (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom f).op ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k x =
      AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (f x)
proof:
:= by
  have h : f.comp (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval x) = AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (f x) := by
    apply AffineSchemeAction.lineHom_ext
    rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AffineSchemeAction.lineEval_lineCoordinate,
      AffineSchemeAction.lineEval_lineCoordinate]
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval x).toRingHom) =
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (f x)).toRingHom)
  exact (Spec.map_comp _ _).symm.trans
    (congrArg Spec.map (congrArg CommRingCat.ofHom (congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom h)))

name: AclGeom.multiplier_tuple_independent
proof:
:= by
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := hind.ne_zero 0
  refine AlgebraicIndependent.of_racl_range_eq hind (racl_range_eq_of_mem ?_ ?_)
  · have ha : a ∈ racl k (Set.range ![a, b, x, c]) := subset_racl k _ ⟨0, rfl⟩
    have hb : b ∈ racl k (Set.range ![a, b, x, c]) := subset_racl k _ ⟨1, rfl⟩
    have hx : x ∈ racl k (Set.range ![a, b, x, c]) := subset_racl k _ ⟨2, rfl⟩
    have hc : c ∈ racl k (Set.range ![a, b, x, c]) := subset_racl k _ ⟨3, rfl⟩
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact ha
    · exact hb
    · exact mul_mem ha hc
    · exact hx
  · have ha : a ∈ racl k (Set.range ![a, b, a * c, x]) := subset_racl k _ ⟨0, rfl⟩
    have hb : b ∈ racl k (Set.range ![a, b, a * c, x]) := subset_racl k _ ⟨1, rfl⟩
    have hac : a * c ∈ racl k (Set.range ![a, b, a * c, x]) := subset_racl k _ ⟨2, rfl⟩
    have hx : x ∈ racl k (Set.range ![a, b, a * c, x]) := subset_racl k _ ⟨3, rfl⟩
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact ha
    · exact hb
    · exact hx
    · have h := mul_mem hac (inv_mem ha)
      have heq : (a * c) * a⁻¹ = c := by
        rw [mul_comm a c, mul_inv_cancel_right₀ ha0]
      rw [heq] at h
      exact h

name: AclGeom.exists_prime_multiplier_curve_of_joint_ideal
statement:
theorem exists_prime_multiplier_curve_of_joint_ideal {a b x c p δ f a' b' x' : K}
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b, x, c])
    (hJ : idealOf k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a', b', x']) =
      idealOf k (Sum.elim ![p, a * x + b, δ, c, f] ![a, b, x]))
    (hfm : f ∈ racl k ({a * c, x} : Set K)) (hfu : f ∉ racl k ({a * c} : Set K)) :
    ∃ F : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ↥(adjoin k ({f} : Set K)), Prime F ∧
      idealOf ↥(adjoin k ({f} : Set K)) ![a * c, x] = Ideal.span {F} ∧
      idealOf ↥(adjoin k ({f} : Set K)) ![a' * c, x'] = Ideal.span {F}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hI, _, _, _⟩ := affine_multiplier_curve_of_joint_ideal hJ hfm hfu
  obtain ⟨hX, hM, _⟩ := multiplier_projection_genericity (multiplier_tuple_independent hind) hfm hfu
  have hm : Transcendental ↥(adjoin k ({f} : Set K)) (a * c) := by
    intro halg
    exact hM (racl_mono (by simp) ((mem_racl_iff k).2 halg))
  have hx : x ∈ racl ↥(adjoin k ({f} : Set K)) ({a * c} : Set K) := by
    apply mem_racl_adjoin_base_iff.2
    simpa [Set.pair_comm] using hX
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hspan⟩ := exists_prime_span_idealOf ↥(adjoin k ({f} : Set K)) hm hx
  have hs (u v : K) :
      (Fin.snoc (Fin.snoc (![f] : Fin 1 → K) u) v : Fin 3 → K) = ![f, u, v] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have he := pairIdeal_eq_over_commonParameter_of_familyIdeal_eq (k := k)
    (p := (![f] : Fin 1 → K)) (x := a' * c) (y := x') (x' := a * c) (y' := x)
    (by rw [hs, hs]; exact hI)
  rw [Matrix.range_cons_empty] at he
  exact ⟨F, hF, hspan, he.trans hspan⟩

name: AclGeom.scale_notMem_racl_of_fresh_multipliers
statement:
theorem scale_notMem_racl_of_fresh_multipliers {a b x c f : K} {a' : ℕ → K} {n : ℕ}
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b, x, c])
    (hfm : f ∈ racl k ({a * c, x} : Set K)) (hfu : f ∉ racl k ({a * c} : Set K))
    (hfresh : ∀ i < n, a' i ∉ racl k ({a, b, x, c} ∪ a' '' Set.Iio i)) :
    c ∉ racl k ({a, f} ∪ a' '' Set.Iio n)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hmem : ∀ z ∈ ({a, b, x, c} : Set K), z ∈ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) :=
    fun z hz ↦ subset_racl k _ hz
  have hac : a * c ∈ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) :=
    mul_mem (hmem a (by simp)) (hmem c (by simp))
  have hf : f ∈ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) := by
    have hsub : ({a * c, x} : Set K) ⊆ racl k ({a, b, x, c} : Set K) :=
      Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨hac, Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (hmem x (by simp))⟩
    exact racl_le_of_subset_racl hsub hfm
  
  have hbase : c ∉ racl k ({a, f} : Set K) := by
    obtain ⟨-, hM, -⟩ :=
      multiplier_projection_genericity (multiplier_tuple_independent hind) hfm hfu
    intro hc
    have ha : a ∈ racl k ({a, b, f} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
    have hc' : c ∈ racl k ({a, b, f} : Set K) :=
      racl_mono (Set.insert_subset_insert (Set.subset_insert _ _)) hc
    exact hM (mul_mem ha hc')
  
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have h0 : a' '' Set.Iio 0 = ∅ := by
      ext z
      simp
    rwa [h0, Set.union_empty]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro hc
    have hIio : a' '' Set.Iio (n + 1) = insert (a' n) (a' '' Set.Iio n) := by
      have h : Set.Iio (n + 1) = insert n (Set.Iio n) := by
        ext j
        simp only [Set.mem_Iio, Set.mem_insert_iff]
        constructor <;> intro h <;> omega
      rw [h, Set.image_insert_eq]
    rw [hIio, Set.union_insert] at hc
    have hex := racl_exchange hc (ih fun i hi ↦ hfresh i (by omega))
    have hTn : ∀ z ∈ ({a, b, x, c} : Set K),
        z ∈ racl k ({a, b, x, c} ∪ a' '' Set.Iio n) :=
      fun z hz ↦ racl_mono Set.subset_union_left (hmem z hz)
    have hsub : insert c ({a, f} ∪ a' '' Set.Iio n) ⊆
        racl k ({a, b, x, c} ∪ a' '' Set.Iio n) := by
      refine Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨hTn c (by simp), Set.union_subset ?_ ?_⟩
      · exact Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨hTn a (by simp),
          Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (racl_mono Set.subset_union_left hf)⟩
      · exact fun z hz ↦ subset_racl k _ (Set.mem_union_right _ hz)
    exact hfresh n (by omega) (racl_le_of_subset_racl hsub hex)

name: AclGeom.finite_same_fibre_ideals
statement:
theorem finite_same_fibre_ideals {m x : K} (hx : x ∈ racl k ({m} : Set K)) :
    {z : K | idealOf k ![m, z] = idealOf k ![m, x]}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  
  have key : ∀ (E : IntermediateField k K) (P : Polynomial ↥E) (u : K),
      aeval ![u, 0] (Polynomial.aeval (X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ↥E) P) =
        Polynomial.aeval u P := by
    intro E P u
    have h := Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply
      (aeval ![u, 0] : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ↥E →ₐ[↥E] K) (X 0) P
    rw [aeval_X] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hint : IsIntegral ↥(adjoin k ({m} : Set K)) x := ((mem_racl_iff k).1 hx).isIntegral
  refine (Polynomial.rootSet_finite (minpoly ↥(adjoin k ({m} : Set K)) x) K).subset
    fun z hz ↦ Polynomial.mem_rootSet'.2 ⟨Polynomial.map_ne_zero (minpoly.ne_zero hint), ?_⟩
  
  have hz' : idealOf k ![m, z, 0] = idealOf k ![m, x, 0] := by
    have h := idealOf_aeval_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq (hz : idealOf k ![m, z] = idealOf k ![m, x])
      (![X 0, X 1, 0] : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)
    have hl : (fun j ↦ aeval ![m, z] ((![X 0, X 1, 0] : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) j)) =
        ![m, z, 0] := by
      funext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp
    have hr : (fun j ↦ aeval ![m, x] ((![X 0, X 1, 0] : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) j)) =
        ![m, x, 0] := by
      funext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp
    rwa [hl, hr] at h
  have hs (u : K) :
      (Fin.snoc (Fin.snoc (![m] : Fin 1 → K) u) 0 : Fin 3 → K) = ![m, u, 0] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  have he := pairIdeal_eq_over_commonParameter_of_familyIdeal_eq (k := k)
    (p := (![m] : Fin 1 → K)) (x := z) (y := 0) (x' := x) (y' := 0)
    (by rw [hs, hs]; exact hz')
  rw [Matrix.range_cons_empty] at he
  
  have hmem : Polynomial.aeval (X 0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ↥(adjoin k ({m} : Set K)))
      (minpoly ↥(adjoin k ({m} : Set K)) x) ∈ idealOf ↥(adjoin k ({m} : Set K)) ![z, 0] := by
    rw [he, mem_idealOf_iff, key]
    exact minpoly.aeval _ x
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, key] at hmem
  exact hmem

name: AclGeom.BirationalGluing.dense_iInf_opens
statement:
theorem dense_iInf_opens {X : Scheme.{u}} [Finite J]
    (V : J → X.Opens) (hV : ∀ i, Dense (V i : Set X)) :
    Dense (((⨅ i, V i) : X.Opens) : Set X)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite J
  have aux (s : Finset J) : Dense (((s.inf V : X.Opens)) : Set X) := by
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp
    | @insert a s ha ih =>
        rw [Finset.inf_insert]
        exact (hV a).inter_of_isOpen_right ih (s.inf V).2
  simpa only [Finset.inf_univ_eq_iInf] using aux Finset.univ

name: AclGeom.BirationalGluing.partialIsoFamilyCommonSource_dense
statement:
theorem partialIsoFamilyCommonSource_dense :
    Dense ((partialIsoFamilyCommonSource U e : X.Opens) : Set X)

:=
  dense_iInf_opens (fun i ↦ (e i).source) (fun i ↦ (e i).dense_source)

name: AclGeom.BirationalGluing.partialIsoFamilyRestriction_isOver
statement:
theorem partialIsoFamilyRestriction_isOver {S : Scheme.{u}}
    (sX : X ⟶ S) (s : ∀ i, U i ⟶ S)
    (he : ∀ i, (e i).IsOver sX (s i)) (i : J) :
    (partialIsoFamilyRestriction U e i).IsOver sX (s i)
proof:
:=
  (he i).restrictSource (partialIsoFamilyCommonSource U e)
    (partialIsoFamilyCommonSource_dense U e) (iInf_le _ i)

name: AclGeom.BirationalGluing.partialIsoFamilyMap_comp
statement:
theorem partialIsoFamilyMap_comp {S : Scheme.{u}}
    (sX : X ⟶ S) (s : ∀ i, U i ⟶ S)
    (he : ∀ i, (e i).IsOver sX (s i)) (i : J) :
    partialIsoFamilyMap U e i ≫ s i =
      (partialIsoFamilyCommonSource U e).ι ≫ sX
proof:
:= by
  have hi := partialIsoFamilyRestriction_isOver U e sX s he i
  unfold Scheme.PartialIso.IsOver at hi
  simpa only [partialIsoFamilyMap, Category.assoc,
    partialIsoFamilyRestriction, Scheme.PartialIso.restrictSource,
    Scheme.PartialIso.restrictSource_source] using hi

name: AclGeom.BirationalGluing.partialIsoOfMutualInversePartialMaps_isOver
statement:
theorem partialIsoOfMutualInversePartialMaps_isOver
    {S : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ S) (sY : Y ⟶ S)
    (f : X.PartialMap Y) [IsDominant f.hom]
    (g : Y.PartialMap X) [IsDominant g.hom]
    (hfg : (f.comp g).hom = (f.comp g).domain.ι)
    (hgf : (g.comp f).hom = (g.comp f).domain.ι)
    (hf : f.hom ≫ sY = f.domain.ι ≫ sX) :
    (partialIsoOfMutualInversePartialMaps f g hfg hgf).IsOver sX sY
proof:
:= by
  let fPre : f.domain.toScheme.Opens := f.hom ⁻¹ᵁ g.domain
  let gPre : g.domain.toScheme.Opens := g.hom ⁻¹ᵁ f.domain
  let U : X.Opens := f.domain.ι ''ᵁ fPre
  let V : Y.Opens := g.domain.ι ''ᵁ gPre
  let uToF : U.toScheme ⟶ f.domain.toScheme :=
    (f.domain.ι.isoImage fPre).inv ≫ fPre.ι
  let fToG : U.toScheme ⟶ g.domain.toScheme :=
    (f.domain.ι.isoImage fPre).inv ≫ f.hom ∣_ g.domain
  let vToG : V.toScheme ⟶ g.domain.toScheme :=
    (g.domain.ι.isoImage gPre).inv ≫ gPre.ι
  have hu : uToF ≫ f.domain.ι = U.ι := by
    exact f.domain.ι.isoImage_inv_ι fPre
  have hv : vToG ≫ g.domain.ι = V.ι := by
    exact g.domain.ι.isoImage_inv_ι gPre
  have hfg' : fToG ≫ g.hom = U.ι := by
    have h := hfg
    dsimp [Scheme.PartialMap.comp, fToG, U, fPre] at h ⊢
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using h
  have hsqU : uToF ≫ f.domain.ι = fToG ≫ g.hom := by
    rw [hu, hfg']
  let liftU : U.toScheme ⟶ gPre.toScheme :=
    (isPullback_morphismRestrict g.hom f.domain).lift uToF fToG hsqU
  let F : U.toScheme ⟶ V.toScheme :=
    liftU ≫ (g.domain.ι.isoImage gPre).hom
  have hFv : F ≫ vToG = fToG := by
    dsimp [F, vToG, liftU]
    rw [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
    exact (isPullback_morphismRestrict g.hom f.domain).lift_snd
      uToF fToG hsqU
  have hFι : F ≫ V.ι = uToF ≫ f.hom := by
    calc
      F ≫ V.ι = (F ≫ vToG) ≫ g.domain.ι := by
        simp only [Category.assoc, hv]
      _ = fToG ≫ g.domain.ι := by rw [hFv]
      _ = uToF ≫ f.hom := by
        dsimp [fToG, uToF]
        rw [Category.assoc, morphismRestrict_ι]
        simp only [Category.assoc]
        rfl
  unfold Scheme.PartialIso.IsOver
  change F ≫ V.ι ≫ sY = U.ι ≫ sX
  rw [← Category.assoc, hFι, Category.assoc, hf, ← Category.assoc, hu]

name: AclGeom.BirationalGluing.partialIsoOfMutualInverseRationalMaps_isOver
statement:
theorem partialIsoOfMutualInverseRationalMaps_isOver
    {S : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y] [X.IsSeparated] [Y.IsSeparated]
    [S.IsSeparated]
    (sX : X ⟶ S) (sY : Y ⟶ S)
    (f : X ⤏ Y) [f.IsDominant]
    (g : Y ⤏ X) [g.IsDominant]
    (hfg : f.comp g = Scheme.RationalMap.id X)
    (hgf : g.comp f = Scheme.RationalMap.id Y)
    (hf : f.compHom sY = sX.toRationalMap) :
    (partialIsoOfMutualInverseRationalMaps f g hfg hgf).IsOver sX sY
proof:
:= by
  letI : X.Over S := ⟨sX⟩
  letI : Y.Over S := ⟨sY⟩
  haveI hfOver : f.IsOver S := Scheme.RationalMap.isOver_iff.mpr hf
  letI : IsDominant f.toPartialMap.hom := by
    rw [← f.toPartialMap.isDominant_toRationalMap_iff]
    simpa using (inferInstance : f.IsDominant)
  letI : IsDominant g.toPartialMap.hom := by
    rw [← g.toPartialMap.isDominant_toRationalMap_iff]
    simpa using (inferInstance : g.IsDominant)
  unfold partialIsoOfMutualInverseRationalMaps
  apply partialIsoOfMutualInversePartialMaps_isOver
  exact (inferInstance : f.toPartialMap.IsOver S).1

statement:
private theorem TwoChartIndex.no_three_distinct
    (i j k : TwoChartIndex)

proof:
:= by

name: AclGeom.NormalTranslation.closed_irreducible_eq_univ_of_two_points
statement:
theorem closed_irreducible_eq_univ_of_two_points
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [IrreducibleSpace X]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    (Z : Set X) (hZc : IsClosed Z) (hZi : IsIrreducible Z)
    (z w : X) (hz : z ∈ Z) (hw : w ∈ Z) (hzw : z ≠ w)
    (hzc : IsClosed ({z} : Set X)) : Z = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  let C0 : IrreducibleCloseds X := ⟨{z}, isIrreducible_singleton, hzc⟩
  let C1 : IrreducibleCloseds X := ⟨Z, hZi, hZc⟩
  let C2 : IrreducibleCloseds X :=
    ⟨Set.univ, IrreducibleSpace.isIrreducible_univ X, isClosed_univ⟩
  have h01 : C0 < C1 := by
    refine lt_iff_le_not_ge.mpr ⟨Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hz, ?_⟩
    intro h
    exact hzw (h hw).symm
  have h12 : C1 < C2 := by
    refine lt_iff_le_not_ge.mpr ⟨Set.subset_univ Z, ?_⟩
    intro h
    exact hne (Set.Subset.antisymm (Set.subset_univ Z) h)
  let p : LTSeries (IrreducibleCloseds X) :=
    RelSeries.fromListIsChain [C0, C1, C2] (List.cons_ne_nil _ _)
      (List.IsChain.cons_cons h01 (List.isChain_pair.mpr h12))
  have hh : (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDim X := by
    have hh := p.length_le_krullDim
    have hlen : p.length = 2 := rfl
    rw [hlen] at hh
    exact hh
  rw [hdim] at hh
  norm_num at hh

name: AclGeom.NormalTranslation.translation_isClosedImmersion
statement:
theorem translation_isClosedImmersion :
    IsClosedImmersion (AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k).left
proof:
:= by
  let s := AdditiveTranslation.shift k
  have hs : IsSeparated (s.left ≫
      (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X.hom) := by
    rw [Over.w s]
    infer_instance
  have : IsSeparated s.left := IsSeparated.of_comp s.left
    (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X.hom
  have : IsClosedImmersion ((AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k).left ≫ s.left) := by
    have he : (AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k).left ≫ s.left = 𝟙 _ :=
      congrArg (fun q ↦ q.left) (AdditiveTranslation.inclusion_comp_shift k)
    rw [he]
    infer_instance
  exact IsClosedImmersion.of_comp _ s.left

name: AclGeom.NormalTranslation.point_inclusion
statement:
theorem point_inclusion (b : k) :
    ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k b) ≫
      AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k =
        (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k).symm (AffineTransformation.translation b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Category.assoc, AdditiveTranslation.linePoint_comp_inclusion]
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  exact (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_left k
    (AffineTransformation.translation b)).symm

name: AclGeom.NormalTranslation.image_eq_translations
statement:
theorem image_eq_translations
    (G : AlgebraicGroup k) (N : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (i : N.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom G) [IsMonHom.Normal i.hom.hom]
    [IsClosedImmersion i.hom.hom.left]
    (hdimN : topologicalKrullDim N.toAlgebraicGroup.carrier = 1)
    (f : G.Hom (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k))
    [IsFinite f.hom.hom.left] [Surjective f.hom.hom.left]
    (hinj : Function.Injective
      (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X ↦ q ≫ f.hom.hom)) :
    Set.range (i.hom.hom ≫ f.hom.hom).left =
      Set.range (AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k).left
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let NX := N.toGroupScheme.X
  let AX := (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k).toGroupScheme.X
  let L := (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X
  let v : NX ⟶ AX := i.hom.hom ≫ f.hom.hom
  let E := AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k
  let I := IsMonHom.monoidHom i.hom.hom (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))))
  let F := E.toMonoidHom.comp (IsMonHom.monoidHom f.hom.hom (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k)))))
  let Ψ := F.comp I
  let H := Ψ.range
  have hFsurj : Function.Surjective F := by
    intro a
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := CurveGlobalCoordinate.surjective_points_of_surjective f.hom.hom (E.symm a)
    change q ≫ f.hom.hom = E.symm a at hq
    refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
    change E (q ≫ f.hom.hom) = a
    rw [hq, MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hInormal : I.range.Normal :=
    (IsMonHom.normal_iff_normal_monoidHom.mp inferInstance) _
  have : H.Normal := by
    change (F.comp I).range.Normal
    rw [MonoidHom.range_comp]
    exact hInormal.map F hFsurj
  have hfhomeo := GroupFinite.isHomeomorph_of_finite_surjective_point_injective
    f.hom.hom hinj
  have hvemb : Topology.IsClosedEmbedding v.left :=
    (hfhomeo.homeomorph f.hom.hom.left).isClosedEmbedding.comp
      i.hom.hom.left.isClosedEmbedding
  have hH : H ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hbot
    have hconst : v = toUnit NX ≫ (1 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ AX) := by
      apply AdditiveRigidity.over_hom_ext_of_points
      intro p
      have hm : Ψ p ∈ H := ⟨p, rfl⟩
      rw [hbot] at hm
      have he : E (p ≫ v) = 1 := Subgroup.mem_bot.mp hm
      have hp : p ≫ v = 1 := E.injective (he.trans E.map_one.symm)
      calc
        _ = 1 := hp
        _ = _ := by
          symm
          rw [← Category.assoc, comp_toUnit, toUnit_unit, Category.id_comp]
    have : Subsingleton NX.left := ⟨fun x y ↦ hvemb.injective (by
      have he : (toUnit NX).left x = (toUnit NX).left y :=
        Subsingleton.elim (α := PrimeSpectrum k) _ _
      calc
        _ = (1 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ AX).left ((toUnit NX).left x) :=
          congrArg (fun q : NX ⟶ AX ↦ q.left x) hconst
        _ = (1 : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ AX).left ((toUnit NX).left y) :=
          congrArg _ he
        _ = _ := (congrArg (fun q : NX ⟶ AX ↦ q.left y) hconst).symm)⟩
    have : DiscreteTopology NX.left := inferInstance
    have hd := topologicalKrullDim_zero_of_discreteTopology NX.left
    rw [hdimN] at hd
    norm_num at hd
  have : IsClosedImmersion (AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k).left :=
    translation_isClosedImmersion
  have hsub : Set.range (AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k).left ⊆ Set.range v.left := by
    have : JacobsonSpace L.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.jacobsonSpace L.hom
    have hclosed (w : L.left) (hw : IsClosed {w}) :
        (AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k).left w ∈ Set.range v.left := by
      let p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ L :=
        Over.homMk (pointOfClosedPoint L.hom w hw) (pointOfClosedPoint_comp L.hom w hw)
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := AffineSchemeAction.exists_linePoint k ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).inv ≫ p)
      have hp : (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k b = p := by
        rw [hb, ← Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.id_comp]
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := AffineTransformation.translations_mem_of_normal_ne_bot H hH b
      have hn : E (n ≫ v) = AffineTransformation.translation b := hn
      have he : n ≫ v = p ≫ AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k := by
        rw [← hp, ← Category.assoc, point_inclusion]
        apply E.injective
        rw [MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
        exact hn
      have hh := congrArg (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ AX ↦
        q.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) he
      refine ⟨n.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k), ?_⟩
      exact hh.trans (congrArg (AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k).left
        (pointOfClosedPoint_apply L.hom w hw _))
    have hc : closure (closedPoints L.left) ⊆
        (AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k).left ⁻¹' Set.range v.left :=
      closure_minimal (fun w hw ↦ hclosed w hw)
        (hvemb.isClosed_range.preimage (AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k).left.continuous)
    have hd : closure (closedPoints L.left) = Set.univ := by
      simpa only [Set.univ_inter, closure_univ] using
        closure_inter_closedPoints (isClosed_univ : IsClosed (Set.univ : Set L.left))
    rw [hd] at hc
    rintro _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
    exact hc (Set.mem_univ w)
  let S := Set.range v.left
  let e := hvemb.isEmbedding.toHomeomorph
  have : IrreducibleSpace S := e.irreducibleSpace_iff.mp inferInstance
  have hdimS : topologicalKrullDim S = 1 := by
    rw [← IsHomeomorph.topologicalKrullDim_eq e e.isHomeomorph]
    exact hdimN
  let J : L.left → S := fun w ↦ ⟨(AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k).left w, hsub ⟨w, rfl⟩⟩
  have hJ : Topology.IsClosedEmbedding J :=
    Topology.IsClosedEmbedding.of_comp .subtypeVal
      (AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k).left.isClosedEmbedding
  let P (b : k) : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ L :=
    (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k b
  let z := J ((P 0).left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k))
  let w := J ((P 1).left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k))
  have hzw : z ≠ w := by
    intro he
    have he' := hJ.injective he
    have hp : P 0 = P 1 := GroupScheme.pointsEquivClosedPoints.injective (Subtype.ext he')
    apply (zero_ne_one : (0 : k) ≠ 1)
    apply AffineSchemeAction.linePoint_injective k
    exact (cancel_epi (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom).mp hp
  have hzc : IsClosed ({z} : Set S) := by
    have h0 : IsClosed ({(P 0).left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)} : Set L.left) :=
      (GroupScheme.pointsEquivClosedPoints (P 0)).property
    simpa only [Set.image_singleton] using hJ.isClosedMap _ h0
  have : IsIntegral L.left := by
    change IsIntegral (Spec (.of (AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1)))
    infer_instance
  have hZi : IsIrreducible (Set.range J) := by
    simpa only [Set.image_univ] using
      (IrreducibleSpace.isIrreducible_univ L.left).image J hJ.continuous.continuousOn
  have hfull := closed_irreducible_eq_univ_of_two_points hdimS (Set.range J)
    hJ.isClosed_range hZi z w (Set.mem_range_self _) (Set.mem_range_self _) hzw hzc
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · intro a ha
    have hm : (⟨a, ha⟩ : S) ∈ Set.range J := by rw [hfull]; trivial
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hm
    exact ⟨b, congrArg Subtype.val hb⟩
  · exact hsub

name: AclGeom.AdditiveTranslation.polynomial_aeval_finite
statement:
theorem polynomial_aeval_finite {k : Type*} [Field k] (p : k[X]) (hp : p.natDegree ≠ 0) :
    (aeval (R := k) p).toRingHom.Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : k[X] →ₐ[k] k[X] := aeval p
  let S := f.range
  let p₀ : S := ⟨p, X, aeval_X p⟩
  let q : S[X] := p.map (algebraMap k S) - C p₀
  have hdeg : (C p₀ : S[X]).degree < (p.map (algebraMap k S)).degree := by
    rw [degree_map]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt degree_C_le (natDegree_pos_iff_degree_pos.mp (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hp))
  have hlead : q.leadingCoeff = algebraMap k S p.leadingCoeff :=
    (leadingCoeff_sub_of_degree_lt hdeg).trans
      (leadingCoeff_map_of_injective (algebraMap k S).injective p)
  have hq : aeval (X : k[X]) q = 0 := by
    simp only [q, map_sub, aeval_map_algebraMap, aeval_X_left_apply, aeval_C]
    change p - p = 0
    exact sub_self p
  have hi := isIntegral_leadingCoeff_smul q (X : k[X]) hq
  have hc : IsUnit q.leadingCoeff := by
    rw [hlead]
    exact (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr (by
      intro hz; exact hp (hz ▸ natDegree_zero)))).map (algebraMap k S)
  let v : Sˣ := hc.unit
  have hv : (v : S) = q.leadingCoeff := hc.unit_spec
  have hx : IsIntegral S (X : k[X]) := by
    have hh := hi.smul ((v⁻¹ : Sˣ) : S)
    rw [← hv] at hh
    simpa only [smul_smul, Units.inv_mul, one_smul] using hh
  have ht : Algebra.adjoin S ({X} : Set k[X]) = ⊤ := by
    have hle : Algebra.adjoin k ({X} : Set k[X]) ≤
        (Algebra.adjoin S ({X} : Set k[X])).restrictScalars k :=
      Algebra.adjoin_le (show ({X} : Set k[X]) ⊆
        (Algebra.adjoin S ({X} : Set k[X])).restrictScalars k from by
          intro z hz
          change z ∈ Algebra.adjoin S ({X} : Set k[X])
          exact Algebra.subset_adjoin hz)
    rw [Polynomial.adjoin_X] at hle
    exact top_unique (fun _ _ ↦ hle trivial)
  have hfinite : Module.Finite S k[X] := by
    apply Module.finite_def.mpr
    rw [← Algebra.top_toSubmodule, ← ht]
    exact hx.fg_adjoin_singleton
  have hval : S.val.toRingHom.Finite := by
    change (algebraMap S k[X]).Finite
    exact RingHom.finite_algebraMap.mpr hfinite
  have hrange : f.rangeRestrict.toRingHom.Finite :=
    RingHom.Finite.of_surjective _ f.rangeRestrict_surjective
  have hcomp : S.val.toRingHom.comp f.rangeRestrict.toRingHom =
      (aeval (R := k) p).toRingHom := rfl
  rw [← hcomp]
  exact RingHom.Finite.comp hval hrange

name: AclGeom.AdditiveTranslation.AclGeom.AdditiveTranslation.polynomialCoordinates_coordinate
statement:
theorem polynomialCoordinates_coordinate :
    polynomialCoordinates k (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k) = Polynomial.X
proof:
:= by
  change (MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv k (Fin 1))
    ((SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial (Pi.basisFun k (Fin 1)))
      (SymmetricAlgebra.ι k (Fin 1 → k) (Pi.basisFun k (Fin 1) 0))) = Polynomial.X
  rw [SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial_ι_apply]
  rw [MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv_apply, MvPolynomial.eval₂_X]

name: AclGeom.AdditiveTranslation.AclGeom.AdditiveTranslation.AclGeom.AdditiveTranslation.lineEval_polynomialCoordinates
statement:
theorem lineEval_polynomialCoordinates {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
    (x : C) (z : AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1) :
    AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) x z =
      Polynomial.aeval x (polynomialCoordinates k z)
proof:
:= by
  have hh : (Polynomial.aeval x).comp (polynomialCoordinates k).toAlgHom =
      AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) x := by
    apply AffineSchemeAction.lineHom_ext
    change Polynomial.aeval x
      (polynomialCoordinates k (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k)) = _
    rw [polynomialCoordinates_coordinate, Polynomial.aeval_X,
      AffineSchemeAction.lineEval_lineCoordinate]
  exact (AlgHom.congr_fun hh z).symm

name: AclGeom.AdditiveTranslation.AclGeom.AdditiveTranslation.AclGeom.AdditiveTranslation.linePoint_comp_linePoint
statement:
theorem linePoint_comp_linePoint {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
    (x : C) (z : AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1) :
    AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k x ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k z =
      AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) x z)
proof:
:= by
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) x).toRingHom) ≫
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) z).toRingHom) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval
        (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) x z)).toRingHom)
  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
  apply congrArg Spec.map
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  change ((AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) x).comp
    (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) z)).toRingHom = _
  apply congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom
  apply AffineSchemeAction.lineHom_ext
  rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AffineSchemeAction.lineEval_lineCoordinate,
    AffineSchemeAction.lineEval_lineCoordinate]

name: AclGeom.AdditiveTranslation.AclGeom.AdditiveTranslation.AclGeom.AdditiveTranslation.lineEval_ringHom_eq
statement:
theorem lineEval_ringHom_eq (z : AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1) :
    (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) z).toRingHom =
      (polynomialCoordinates k).symm.toRingHom.comp
        ((Polynomial.aeval (R := k) (polynomialCoordinates k z)).toRingHom.comp
          (polynomialCoordinates k).toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  let P := polynomialCoordinates k
  let p := P z
  change (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) z).toRingHom =
    (P.symm.toAlgHom.comp ((Polynomial.aeval (R := k) p).comp P.toAlgHom)).toRingHom
  apply congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom
  apply AffineSchemeAction.lineHom_ext
  rw [AffineSchemeAction.lineEval_lineCoordinate]
  change z = P.symm (Polynomial.aeval p (P (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k)))
  rw [polynomialCoordinates_coordinate, Polynomial.aeval_X, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: AclGeom.AdditiveTranslation.AclGeom.AdditiveTranslation.AclGeom.AdditiveTranslation.isFinite_linePoint
statement:
theorem isFinite_linePoint (z : AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1)
    (hp : (polynomialCoordinates k z).natDegree ≠ 0) :
    IsFinite (AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k z).left
proof:
:= by
  let P := polynomialCoordinates k
  let p := P z
  change IsFinite (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) z).toRingHom))
  apply (IsFinite.SpecMap_iff _).mpr
  rw [lineEval_ringHom_eq]
  exact P.symm.toRingEquiv.finite.comp ((polynomial_aeval_finite p hp).comp P.toRingEquiv.finite)

name: AclGeom.AdditiveTranslation.AclGeom.AdditiveTranslation.AclGeom.AdditiveTranslation.surjective_linePoint
statement:
theorem surjective_linePoint (z : AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1)
    (hp : (polynomialCoordinates k z).natDegree ≠ 0) :
    Surjective (AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k z).left
proof:
:= by
  let P := polynomialCoordinates k
  have hf : (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) z).toRingHom.Finite :=
    (IsFinite.SpecMap_iff _).mp (isFinite_linePoint k z hp)
  have hinj : Function.Injective (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) z).toRingHom := by
    rw [lineEval_ringHom_eq]
    have hpne : P z ≠ 0 := fun hz ↦ hp (hz ▸ Polynomial.natDegree_zero)
    have ht : Transcendental k (P z) := (P z).transcendental hp
      (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hpne))
    exact P.symm.injective.comp ((transcendental_iff_injective.mp ht).comp P.injective)
  constructor
  change Function.Surjective
    (PrimeSpectrum.comap (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) z).toRingHom)
  exact hf.to_isIntegral.comap_surjective hinj

name: AclGeom.CurveBoundary.fixed_boundary_places
statement:
theorem fixed_boundary_places
    (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsProper V.hom]
    [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1)
    (hnormal : ∀ x : V.left, IsIntegrallyClosed (V.left.presheaf.stalk x))
    (U : Over (Spec (.of k))) [Nonempty U.left] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X U]
    (j : U ⟶ V) [IsOpenImmersion j.left] [IsModHom G.toGroupScheme.X j] :
    ((Set.range j.left)ᶜ).Finite ∧
      (∀ x ∈ (Set.range j.left)ᶜ, IsClosed ({x} : Set V.left)) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ (Set.range j.left)ᶜ,
        ∃ p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ V,
          p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) = x ∧
          orbitMap G.toAlgebraicGroup V p = toUnit G.toGroupScheme.X ≫ p ∧
          ∀ (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (q : T ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X),
            q • (toUnit T ≫ p) = toUnit T ≫ p) ∧
      ∀ P : Place k V.left.functionField,
        CurvePointsPlaces.placeCenter V P ∉ Set.range j.left →
        ∀ g : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
          SchemePlaceAction.placeAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V g P = P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hf, hc, hfix⟩ := fixed_boundary G V hdim U j
  refine ⟨hf, hc, hfix, ?_⟩
  intro P hP g
  let e := CurvePointsPlaces.closedPointEquivPlace V hdim hnormal
  let x := e.symm P
  have hx : x.val ∉ Set.range j.left := by
    rw [CurvePointsPlaces.closedPointEquivPlace_symm_val]
    exact hP
  obtain ⟨p, hp, _, hT⟩ := hfix x.val hx
  have hpoint : p ≫ ModObj.pointAct V g = p := by
    change p ≫ ((toUnit V ≫ g) • 𝟙 V) = p
    rw [ModObj.comp_smul, Category.comp_id, comp_toUnit_assoc,
      toUnit_unit, Category.id_comp]
    simpa only [toUnit_unit, Category.id_comp] using hT (𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k)))) g
  have heval := congrArg (fun z : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ V ↦
    z.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) hpoint
  change (ModObj.pointAct V g).left (p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) =
    p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) at heval
  rw [hp] at heval
  have hmap : CurvePointsPlaces.mapClosedPoint (ModObj.pointAut V g) x = x :=
    Subtype.ext heval
  have hact := CurvePointsPlaces.closedPointEquivPlace_action V hdim hnormal
    G.toAlgebraicGroup g x
  have hPx : e x = P := e.apply_symm_apply P
  calc
    SchemePlaceAction.placeAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V g P =
        SchemePlaceAction.placeAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V g (e x) :=
      congrArg (SchemePlaceAction.placeAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V g) hPx.symm
    _ = e (CurvePointsPlaces.mapClosedPoint (ModObj.pointAut V g) x) := hact.symm
    _ = e x := congrArg e hmap
    _ = P := hPx

name: AclGeom.CurvePointsPlaces.mem_stalkValuationSubring
statement:
theorem mem_stalkValuationSubring
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ 1)
    (hnormal : ∀ x : X, IsIntegrallyClosed (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (x : X)
    (z : X.functionField) :
    z ∈ stalkValuationSubring X hdim hnormal x ↔
      ∃ r : X.presheaf.stalk x, algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField r = z
proof:
:= by
  have := hnormal x
  have := ProperCurve.stalk_valuationRing X hdim x
  exact ValuationRing.mem_integer_iff (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField z

name: AclGeom.CurvePointsPlaces.stalkValuationSubring_krullDimLE
statement:
theorem stalkValuationSubring_krullDimLE
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ 1)
    (hnormal : ∀ x : X, IsIntegrallyClosed (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (x : X) :
    Ring.KrullDimLE 1 (stalkValuationSubring X hdim hnormal x)
proof:
:= by
  have := hnormal x
  have := ProperCurve.stalk_valuationRing X hdim x
  let e : (X.presheaf.stalk x) ≃+* stalkValuationSubring X hdim hnormal x :=
    ValuationRing.equivInteger (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField
  have he : Order.krullDim X = topologicalKrullDim X :=
    (Order.krullDim_eq_of_orderIso (irreducibleSetEquivPoints (α := X))).symm
  rw [Ring.krullDimLE_iff, ← e.ringKrullDim, ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight]
  exact (Order.coheight_le_krullDim x).trans (he.trans_le hdim)

name: AclGeom.CurvePointsPlaces.stalkValuationSubring_eq_top_iff
statement:
theorem stalkValuationSubring_eq_top_iff
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ 1)
    (hnormal : ∀ x : X, IsIntegrallyClosed (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (x : X) :
    stalkValuationSubring X hdim hnormal x = ⊤ ↔ x = genericPoint X
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x) X.functionField) := by
      intro z
      apply (mem_stalkValuationSubring X hdim hnormal x z).mp
      rw [h]
      trivial
    exact (isField_stalk_iff_genericPoint X x).mp
      (IsFractionRing.surjective_iff_isField.mp hsurj)
  · intro h
    have hfield := (isField_stalk_iff_genericPoint X x).mpr h
    have hsurj := (IsFractionRing.surjective_iff_isField
      (R := X.presheaf.stalk x) (K := X.functionField)).mpr hfield
    apply top_unique
    intro z _
    exact (mem_stalkValuationSubring X hdim hnormal x z).mpr (hsurj z)

name: SymmetricAlgebra.antipode_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem antipode_ι (x : M) : HopfAlgebra.antipode R (ι R M x) = -ι R M x
proof:
:=
  lift_ι_apply _ x

name: AclGeom.mem_racl_pair_of_mem_racl_pair
statement:
private theorem mem_racl_pair_of_mem_racl_pair {a b w : K} (hw : w ∈ racl k ({a, b} : Set K))
    (hwa : w ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K)) : b ∈ racl k ({a, w} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  have h : w ∈ racl k (insert b ({a} : Set K)) := by
    rwa [Set.pair_comm] at hw
  have h' := racl_exchange h hwa
  rwa [Set.pair_comm] at h'

name: AclGeom.notMem_racl_singleton_of_notMem
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h' : a' ∈ racl k (insert w (∅ : Set K)) :=
    racl_exchange (by simpa using h) hw0
  have hsub : (insert w (∅ : Set K)) ⊆ racl k S :=
    Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨hwS, Set.empty_subset _⟩
  exact ha' (racl_le_of_subset_racl hsub h')

name: AclGeom.sub_mem_racl_of_affine_value_eq
statement:
theorem sub_mem_racl_of_affine_value_eq {a b x a' b' x' p δ : K}
    (hind : AlgebraicIndependent k ![a, b, x]) (ha' : a' ∉ racl k ({a, b, x} : Set K))
    (hp : p ∈ racl k ({a, b} : Set K)) (hpa : p ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K))
    (hδ : δ ∈ racl k ({a, x} : Set K)) (hδa : δ ∉ racl k ({a} : Set K))
    (hp' : p ∈ racl k ({a', b'} : Set K)) (hδ' : δ ∈ racl k ({a', x'} : Set K))
    (hy : a' * x' + b' = a * x + b) :
    b - b' ∈ racl k ({a, a'} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hpabx : p ∈ racl k ({a, b, x} : Set K) :=
    racl_mono (Set.insert_subset_insert (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (by simp))) hp
  have hδabx : δ ∈ racl k ({a, b, x} : Set K) :=
    racl_mono (Set.insert_subset_insert (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (by simp))) hδ
  have hp0 : p ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) := fun h ↦ hpa (racl_mono (Set.empty_subset _) h)
  have hδ0 : δ ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) := fun h ↦ hδa (racl_mono (Set.empty_subset _) h)
  
  have hb : b ∈ racl k ({a, p} : Set K) := mem_racl_pair_of_mem_racl_pair hp hpa
  have hx : x ∈ racl k ({a, δ} : Set K) := mem_racl_pair_of_mem_racl_pair hδ hδa
  have hb' : b' ∈ racl k ({a', p} : Set K) :=
    mem_racl_pair_of_mem_racl_pair hp' (notMem_racl_singleton_of_notMem hpabx hp0 ha')
  have hx' : x' ∈ racl k ({a', δ} : Set K) :=
    mem_racl_pair_of_mem_racl_pair hδ' (notMem_racl_singleton_of_notMem hδabx hδ0 ha')
  
  have hP : b - b' ∈ racl k (insert p ({a, a'} : Set K)) := by
    have h1 : ({a, p} : Set K) ⊆ insert p ({a, a'} : Set K) :=
      Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨by simp, Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (by simp)⟩
    have h2 : ({a', p} : Set K) ⊆ insert p ({a, a'} : Set K) :=
      Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨by simp, Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (by simp)⟩
    exact sub_mem (racl_mono h1 hb) (racl_mono h2 hb')
  
  have hD : b - b' ∈ racl k (insert δ ({a, a'} : Set K)) := by
    have hw : b - b' = a' * x' - a * x :=
      sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add.2 (by rw [hy, add_comm])
    have h1 : ({a, δ} : Set K) ⊆ insert δ ({a, a'} : Set K) :=
      Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨by simp, Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (by simp)⟩
    have h2 : ({a', δ} : Set K) ⊆ insert δ ({a, a'} : Set K) :=
      Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨by simp, Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (by simp)⟩
    have ha : a ∈ racl k (insert δ ({a, a'} : Set K)) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
    have ha₂ : a' ∈ racl k (insert δ ({a, a'} : Set K)) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
    rw [hw]
    exact sub_mem (mul_mem ha₂ (racl_mono h2 hx')) (mul_mem ha (racl_mono h1 hx))
  
  
  have hδP : δ ∉ racl k (insert p ({a, a'} : Set K)) := by
    intro h
    have hle : racl k (insert p ({a, a'} : Set K)) ≤ racl k (insert a' ({a, b} : Set K)) := by
      have hsub : insert p ({a, a'} : Set K) ⊆ racl k (insert a' ({a, b} : Set K)) :=
        Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨racl_mono (Set.subset_insert _ _) hp,
          Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨subset_racl k _ (by simp),
            Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (subset_racl k _ (by simp))⟩⟩
      exact racl_le_of_subset_racl hsub
    have hsub : ({a, δ} : Set K) ⊆ racl k (insert a' ({a, b} : Set K)) :=
      Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨subset_racl k _ (by simp), Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (hle h)⟩
    have hxab' : x ∈ racl k (insert a' ({a, b} : Set K)) := racl_le_of_subset_racl hsub hx
    have hxab : x ∉ racl k ({a, b} : Set K) := by
      have h' := AlgebraicIndependent.notMem_racl_image hind (S := {0, 1}) (i := 2) (by decide)
      simpa [Set.image_insert_eq] using h'
    have ha'x := racl_exchange hxab' hxab
    apply ha'
    rwa [Set.insert_comm x a, Set.pair_comm x b] at ha'x
  exact mem_racl_of_mem_racl_insert hP hD hδP

name: AclGeom.racl_singleton_eq_of_concurrent
statement:
theorem racl_singleton_eq_of_concurrent {ai bi aj bj p t : K}
    (ht : t ∈ racl k (∅ : Set K))
    (hpi : p ∈ racl k ({ai, bi} : Set K)) (hpa : p ∉ racl k ({ai} : Set K))
    (hpj : p ∈ racl k ({aj, bj} : Set K)) (haj : aj ∉ racl k ({ai, p} : Set K))
    (hconc : bi + (ai - 1) * t = bj + (aj - 1) * t) :
    racl k ({p} : Set K) = racl k ({bi + (ai - 1) * t} : Set K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ : ∃ w, w = bi + (ai - 1) * t := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hw]
  have hwj : w = bj + (aj - 1) * t := hw.trans hconc
  
  have hpiw : p ∈ racl k ({ai, w} : Set K) := by
    have ha : ai ∈ racl k ({ai, w} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
    have hw' : w ∈ racl k ({ai, w} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
    have hb : bi ∈ racl k ({ai, w} : Set K) := by
      have h : bi = w - (ai - 1) * t := by
        rw [hw]
        ring
      rw [h]
      exact sub_mem hw' (mul_mem (sub_mem ha (one_mem _)) (racl_mono (Set.empty_subset _) ht))
    exact racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨ha, Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hb⟩) hpi
  have hpjw : p ∈ racl k ({aj, w} : Set K) := by
    have ha : aj ∈ racl k ({aj, w} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
    have hw' : w ∈ racl k ({aj, w} : Set K) := subset_racl k _ (by simp)
    have hb : bj ∈ racl k ({aj, w} : Set K) := by
      have h : bj = w - (aj - 1) * t := by
        rw [hwj]
        ring
      rw [h]
      exact sub_mem hw' (mul_mem (sub_mem ha (one_mem _)) (racl_mono (Set.empty_subset _) ht))
    exact racl_le_of_subset_racl (Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨ha, Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hb⟩) hpj
  
  have hw2 : w ∉ racl k ({ai, aj} : Set K) := by
    intro hwa
    have hp2 : p ∈ racl k ({ai, aj} : Set K) := by
      refine racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_ hpiw
      exact Set.insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨subset_racl k _ (by simp), Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hwa⟩
    exact haj (mem_racl_pair_of_mem_racl_pair hp2 hpa)
  
  have haj1 : aj ∉ racl k ({ai} : Set K) :=
    fun h ↦ haj (racl_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (Set.mem_insert _ _)) h)
  have haw : aj ∉ racl k ({ai, w} : Set K) :=
    fun h ↦ hw2 (mem_racl_pair_of_mem_racl_pair h haj1)
  have hpw : p ∈ racl k ({w} : Set K) := mem_racl_of_mem_racl_insert hpiw hpjw haw
  
  have hp0 : p ∉ racl k (∅ : Set K) := fun h ↦ hpa (racl_mono (Set.empty_subset _) h)
  have hwp : w ∈ racl k (insert p (∅ : Set K)) := racl_exchange (by simpa using hpw) hp0
  refine le_antisymm (racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_) (racl_le_of_subset_racl ?_)
  · exact Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 hpw
  · exact Set.singleton_subset_iff.2 (by simpa using hwp)

name: AclGeom.coe_locusCoordinateRingEquiv_mk
statement:
private theorem coe_locusCoordinateRingEquiv_mk {κ : Type*} (m : κ → Ω) (c : MvPolynomial κ k) :
    ((locusCoordinateRingEquiv (k := k) m (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ c) : Ω)) = aeval m c
proof:
:= by
  rw [locusCoordinateRingEquiv_mk]

name: AclGeom.exists_idealOf_eq
statement:
private theorem exists_idealOf_eq {ι κ : Type*} [IsAlgClosed Ω] (g : κ → ι) (m : κ → Ω)
    (q : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι k)) [q.IsPrime]
    (hcomap : q.comap (rename g : MvPolynomial κ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial ι k) = idealOf k m)
    (halg : ∀ i, ∃ p : Polynomial (MvPolynomial κ k), (∃ j, p.coeff j ∉ idealOf k m) ∧
      p.eval₂ (rename g : MvPolynomial κ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial ι k).toRingHom (X i) ∈ q) :
    ∃ T : ι → Ω, T ∘ g = m ∧ idealOf k T = q
proof:
:= by
  let φ : MvPolynomial κ k ⧸ idealOf k m →+* MvPolynomial ι k ⧸ q :=
    Ideal.quotientMap q (rename g : MvPolynomial κ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial ι k).toRingHom hcomap.ge
  have hφ : Function.Injective φ := Ideal.quotientMap_injective' hcomap.le
  let ψ : MvPolynomial κ k ⧸ idealOf k m →+* Ω :=
    (Algebra.adjoin k (Set.range m)).val.toRingHom.comp
      (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (k := k) m).toRingEquiv.toRingHom
  have hψ : Function.Injective ψ :=
    Subtype.val_injective.comp (locusCoordinateRingEquiv (k := k) m).injective
  have hψmk (c : MvPolynomial κ k) : ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ c) = aeval m c :=
    coe_locusCoordinateRingEquiv_mk m c
  let _ : Algebra (MvPolynomial κ k ⧸ idealOf k m) (MvPolynomial ι k ⧸ q) := φ.toAlgebra
  let _ : Algebra (MvPolynomial κ k ⧸ idealOf k m) Ω := ψ.toAlgebra
  have : FaithfulSMul (MvPolynomial κ k ⧸ idealOf k m) (MvPolynomial ι k ⧸ q) :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective _ _).2 hφ
  have : FaithfulSMul (MvPolynomial κ k ⧸ idealOf k m) Ω :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective _ _).2 hψ
  
  have hgen (i : ι) : IsAlgebraic (MvPolynomial κ k ⧸ idealOf k m)
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk q (X i)) := by
    obtain ⟨p, ⟨j, hj⟩, hp⟩ := halg i
    refine ⟨p.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealOf k m)), fun h ↦ hj ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.1
        (by rw [← Polynomial.coeff_map, h, Polynomial.coeff_zero])
    · rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, Polynomial.eval₂_map]
      have hφmk : φ.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealOf k m)) = (Ideal.Quotient.mk q).comp
          (rename g : MvPolynomial κ k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial ι k).toRingHom :=
        Ideal.quotientMap_comp_mk hcomap.ge
      change Polynomial.eval₂ (φ.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealOf k m))) _ p = 0
      rw [hφmk, ← Polynomial.hom_eval₂]
      exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.2 hp
  have hmem (f : MvPolynomial ι k) : Ideal.Quotient.mk q f ∈ Algebra.adjoin
      (MvPolynomial κ k ⧸ idealOf k m) (Set.range fun i ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk q (X i)) := by
    induction f using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
    | C c =>
      have : Ideal.Quotient.mk q (C c) =
          algebraMap (MvPolynomial κ k ⧸ idealOf k m) _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (C c)) := by
        change _ = Ideal.Quotient.mk q (rename g (C c))
        rw [rename_C]
      rw [this]
      exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ _
    | add f₁ f₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem h₁ h₂
    | mul_X f i h =>
      rw [map_mul]
      exact mul_mem h (Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_range_self i))
  have hadj : (Algebra.adjoin (MvPolynomial κ k ⧸ idealOf k m)
      (Set.range fun i ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk q (X i))).IsAlgebraic := by
    refine Algebra.isAlgebraic_adjoin_iff.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact hgen i
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (MvPolynomial κ k ⧸ idealOf k m) (MvPolynomial ι k ⧸ q) := by
    refine ⟨fun a ↦ ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a
    exact hadj _ (hmem f)
  let L : MvPolynomial ι k ⧸ q →ₐ[MvPolynomial κ k ⧸ idealOf k m] Ω := IsAlgClosed.lift
  
  have hL : Function.Injective L := by
    refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero L).2 fun a ha ↦ ?_
    by_contra ha0
    refine Ideal.under_ne_bot_of_algebraic_mem (R := MvPolynomial κ k ⧸ idealOf k m)
      (I := RingHom.ker L) ha0 ha
      (Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic a) (eq_bot_iff.2 fun b hb ↦ ?_)
    rw [Ideal.mem_bot]
    refine hψ ?_
    rw [map_zero]
    change algebraMap _ Ω b = 0
    rw [← L.commutes]
    exact hb
  refine ⟨fun i ↦ L (Ideal.Quotient.mk q (X i)), funext fun c ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · change L (Ideal.Quotient.mk q (X (g c))) = m c
    have : Ideal.Quotient.mk q (X (g c)) =
        algebraMap (MvPolynomial κ k ⧸ idealOf k m) _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (X c)) := by
      change _ = Ideal.Quotient.mk q (rename g (X c))
      rw [rename_X]
    rw [this, L.commutes]
    exact (hψmk (X c)).trans (aeval_X m c)
  · have hev : (aeval fun i ↦ L (Ideal.Quotient.mk q (X i)) :
        MvPolynomial ι k →ₐ[k] Ω).toRingHom = L.toRingHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk q) := by
      refine MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext (fun c ↦ ?_) (fun i ↦ ?_)
      · change aeval _ (C c) = L (Ideal.Quotient.mk q (C c))
        have : Ideal.Quotient.mk q (C c) =
            algebraMap (MvPolynomial κ k ⧸ idealOf k m) _ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (C c)) := by
          change _ = Ideal.Quotient.mk q (rename g (C c))
          rw [rename_C]
        rw [aeval_C, this, L.commutes]
        exact ((hψmk (C c)).trans (aeval_C m c)).symm
      · exact aeval_X _ i
    change RingHom.ker _ = q
    rw [hev, ← RingHom.comap_ker, (RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot L.toRingHom).1 hL,
      ← RingHom.ker_eq_comap_bot, Ideal.mk_ker]

name: AclGeom.chain_relations
statement:
private theorem chain_relations (hxy : ∀ i, x i ∈ racl k (Set.range y))
    (hwz : ∀ l, w l ∈ racl k (Set.range z)) (i : ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) :
    ∃ p : Polynomial (MvPolynomial (β ⊕ γ) k), (∃ j, p.coeff j ∉ idealOf k (Sum.elim y z)) ∧
      p.eval₂ (rename 𝔢 : MvPolynomial (β ⊕ γ) k →ₐ[k] _).toRingHom (X i) ∈ ℐ₄
proof:
:= by
  have hone : (1 : MvPolynomial (β ⊕ γ) k) ∉ idealOf k (Sum.elim y z) := fun h ↦
    one_ne_zero ((map_one (aeval (R := k) (Sum.elim y z))).symm.trans ((mem_idealOf_iff k).1 h))
  rcases i with ((a | b) | c) | d
  · obtain ⟨p, ⟨j, hj⟩, hp⟩ := exists_poly_of_mem_racl (Sum.elim x y) Sum.inr
      (X (Sum.inl a) : MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) k) (by rw [aeval_X]; exact hxy a)
    refine ⟨p.map (rename (Sum.inl : β → β ⊕ γ) : MvPolynomial β k →ₐ[k] _).toRingHom,
      ⟨j, fun h ↦ hj ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [Polynomial.coeff_map, mem_idealOf_iff] at h
      rw [mem_idealOf_iff]
      rw [AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, aeval_rename] at h
      exact h
    · have hc : (rename 𝔢 : MvPolynomial (β ⊕ γ) k →ₐ[k] _).toRingHom.comp
          (rename (Sum.inl : β → β ⊕ γ) : MvPolynomial β k →ₐ[k] _).toRingHom =
          (rename (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl : α ⊕ β → ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) :
            MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) k →ₐ[k] _).toRingHom.comp
          (rename (Sum.inr : β → α ⊕ β) : MvPolynomial β k →ₐ[k] _).toRingHom :=
        RingHom.ext fun c ↦ (rename_rename _ _ c).trans
          (rename_rename (Sum.inr : β → α ⊕ β) (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl) c).symm
      rw [Polynomial.eval₂_map, hc, show (X (Sum.inl (Sum.inl (Sum.inl a))) :
        MvPolynomial (((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) k) = (rename (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl :
          α ⊕ β → ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) : MvPolynomial (α ⊕ β) k →ₐ[k] _).toRingHom
            (X (Sum.inl a)) from (rename_X (R := k) (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl :
              α ⊕ β → ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) (Sum.inl a)).symm, ← Polynomial.hom_eval₂]
      exact Ideal.mem_sup_left (Ideal.mem_sup_left (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hp))
  · refine ⟨Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (X (Sum.inl b)), ⟨1, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_X_one, Polynomial.coeff_C_of_ne_zero one_ne_zero,
        sub_zero]
      exact hone
    · rw [Polynomial.eval₂_sub, Polynomial.eval₂_X, Polynomial.eval₂_C]
      change X _ - rename _ (X (Sum.inl b)) ∈ _
      rw [rename_X, Sum.elim_inl, Function.comp_apply, Function.comp_apply, sub_self]
      exact zero_mem _
  · refine ⟨Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (X (Sum.inr c)), ⟨1, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_X_one, Polynomial.coeff_C_of_ne_zero one_ne_zero,
        sub_zero]
      exact hone
    · rw [Polynomial.eval₂_sub, Polynomial.eval₂_X, Polynomial.eval₂_C]
      change X _ - rename _ (X (Sum.inr c)) ∈ _
      rw [rename_X, Sum.elim_inr, Function.comp_apply, sub_self]
      exact zero_mem _
  · obtain ⟨p, ⟨j, hj⟩, hp⟩ := exists_poly_of_mem_racl (Sum.elim z w) Sum.inl
      (X (Sum.inr d) : MvPolynomial (γ ⊕ δ) k) (by rw [aeval_X]; exact hwz d)
    refine ⟨p.map (rename (Sum.inr : γ → β ⊕ γ) : MvPolynomial γ k →ₐ[k] _).toRingHom,
      ⟨j, fun h ↦ hj ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rw [Polynomial.coeff_map, mem_idealOf_iff] at h
      rw [mem_idealOf_iff]
      rw [AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, aeval_rename] at h
      exact h
    · have hc : (rename 𝔢 : MvPolynomial (β ⊕ γ) k →ₐ[k] _).toRingHom.comp
          (rename (Sum.inr : γ → β ⊕ γ) : MvPolynomial γ k →ₐ[k] _).toRingHom =
          (rename (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) Sum.inr : γ ⊕ δ → ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) :
            MvPolynomial (γ ⊕ δ) k →ₐ[k] _).toRingHom.comp
          (rename (Sum.inl : γ → γ ⊕ δ) : MvPolynomial γ k →ₐ[k] _).toRingHom :=
        RingHom.ext fun c ↦ (rename_rename _ _ c).trans
          (rename_rename (Sum.inl : γ → γ ⊕ δ) (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) Sum.inr) c).symm
      rw [Polynomial.eval₂_map, hc, show (X (Sum.inr d) :
        MvPolynomial (((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) k) = (rename (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) Sum.inr :
          γ ⊕ δ → ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) : MvPolynomial (γ ⊕ δ) k →ₐ[k] _).toRingHom
            (X (Sum.inr d)) from (rename_X (R := k) (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) Sum.inr :
              γ ⊕ δ → ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) (Sum.inr d)).symm, ← Polynomial.hom_eval₂]
      exact Ideal.mem_sup_right (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hp)

name: AclGeom.chain_le_idealOf
statement:
private theorem chain_le_idealOf {x' : α → Ω} {w' : δ → Ω}
    (hx' : idealOf k (Sum.elim x' y) = idealOf k (Sum.elim x y))
    (hw' : idealOf k (Sum.elim z w') = idealOf k (Sum.elim z w)) :
    ℐ₄ ≤ idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z) w')
proof:
:=
  sup_le (sup_le
    (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 (hx' ▸ (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (k := k)
      (a := Sum.elim (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z) w') (b := Sum.elim x' y)
      (g := Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl) rfl).le))
    (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (k := k)
      (a := Sum.elim (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z) w') (b := Sum.elim y z) (g := 𝔢)
      (funext fun i ↦ by rcases i with b | c <;> rfl)).le))
    (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 (hw' ▸ (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (k := k)
      (a := Sum.elim (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z) w') (b := Sum.elim z w')
      (g := Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) Sum.inr)
      (funext fun i ↦ by rcases i with c | d <;> rfl)).le))

name: AclGeom.chain_dense_iff
statement:
private theorem chain_dense_iff (𝔭 : Ideal (MvPolynomial (((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) k))
    (h𝔭 : ℐ₄ ≤ 𝔭) :
    closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (π₄).toRingHom '' PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus
        (Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ₄) 𝔭 : Set (MvPolynomial (((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) k ⧸ ℐ₄))) =
        Set.univ ↔
      𝔭.comap (rename 𝔢 : MvPolynomial (β ⊕ γ) k →ₐ[k] _) = idealOf k (Sum.elim y z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [PrimeSpectrum.closure_image_comap_zeroLocus, PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_eq_univ_iff,
    nilradical_eq_zero, Ideal.zero_eq_bot, SetLike.coe_subset_coe, le_bot_iff]
  have hge : idealOf k (Sum.elim y z) ≤ 𝔭.comap (rename 𝔢 : MvPolynomial (β ⊕ γ) k →ₐ[k] _) :=
    (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.1 (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left)).trans (Ideal.comap_mono h𝔭)
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine le_antisymm (fun c hc ↦ ?_) hge
    have hmem : Ideal.Quotient.mk (idealOf k (Sum.elim y z)) c ∈
        (Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ₄) 𝔭).comap (π₄).toRingHom := by
      rw [Ideal.mem_comap]
      exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hc
    rw [h, Ideal.mem_bot, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem] at hmem
    exact hmem
  · intro h
    refine eq_bot_iff.2 fun b hb ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective b
    rw [Ideal.mem_bot, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem, ← h, Ideal.mem_comap]
    rw [Ideal.mem_comap] at hb
    exact (Ideal.mem_quotient_iff_mem h𝔭).1 hb

name: AclGeom.chain_realization
statement:
private theorem chain_realization [IsAlgClosed Ω] (hxy : ∀ i, x i ∈ racl k (Set.range y))
    (hwz : ∀ l, w l ∈ racl k (Set.range z)) (q : Ideal (MvPolynomial (((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) k))
    [q.IsPrime] (hq : ℐ₄ ≤ q)
    (hc : q.comap (rename 𝔢 : MvPolynomial (β ⊕ γ) k →ₐ[k] _) = idealOf k (Sum.elim y z)) :
    ∃ (x'' : α → Ω) (w'' : δ → Ω),
      idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x'' y) z) w'') = q ∧
        ∀ i, Sum.elim (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x'' y) z) w'' i ∈ racl k (Set.range (Sum.elim y z))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, hTg, hT⟩ := exists_idealOf_eq 𝔢 (Sum.elim y z) q hc fun i ↦
    (chain_relations x y z w hxy hwz i).imp fun _ hp ↦ ⟨hp.1, hq hp.2⟩
  have hTJ : T = Sum.elim (Sum.elim (Sum.elim (T ∘ Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl) y) z)
      (T ∘ Sum.inr) := funext fun i ↦ by
    rcases i with ((a | b) | c) | d
    · rfl
    · exact congrFun hTg (Sum.inl b)
    · exact congrFun hTg (Sum.inr c)
    · rfl
  refine ⟨T ∘ Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl, T ∘ Sum.inr,
    (congrArg (idealOf k) hTJ).symm.trans hT, fun i ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [← hTJ]
  obtain ⟨p, ⟨j, hj⟩, hp⟩ := chain_relations x y z w hxy hwz i
  have := mem_racl_of_relation T 𝔢 (i := i) (p := p) ⟨j, by rwa [hTg]⟩ (hT.ge (hq hp))
  rwa [hTg] at this

name: AclGeom.chain_dominatingComponents
statement:
private theorem chain_dominatingComponents [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (hxy : ∀ i, x i ∈ racl k (Set.range y)) (hwz : ∀ l, w l ∈ racl k (Set.range z)) :
    {Z : Set (PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) k ⧸ ℐ₄)) |
        Z ∈ irreducibleComponents _ ∧
          closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (π₄).toRingHom '' Z) = Set.univ} =
      {C | ∃ (x' : α → Ω) (w' : δ → Ω), idealOf k (Sum.elim x' y) = idealOf k (Sum.elim x y) ∧
        idealOf k (Sum.elim z w') = idealOf k (Sum.elim z w) ∧
        C = PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ₄)
          (idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z) w')) :
            Set (MvPolynomial (((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) k ⧸ ℐ₄))}
proof:
:= by
  
  have hpair (x' : α → Ω) (w' : δ → Ω)
      (hℐ : ℐ₄ ≤ idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z) w')) :
      idealOf k (Sum.elim x' y) = idealOf k (Sum.elim x y) ∧
        idealOf k (Sum.elim z w') = idealOf k (Sum.elim z w) := by
    refine ⟨idealOf_eq_of_le_of_comap_eq (Sum.elim x y) Sum.inr (fun i ↦ ?_) ?_
      (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (k := k) (a := Sum.elim x' y) (b := y) (g := Sum.inr) rfl).symm,
      idealOf_eq_of_le_of_comap_eq (Sum.elim z w) Sum.inl (fun i ↦ ?_) ?_
      (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (k := k) (a := Sum.elim z w') (b := z) (g := Sum.inl) rfl).symm⟩
    · rcases i with a | b
      · exact hxy a
      · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨b, rfl⟩
    · exact (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.1 (le_sup_left.trans (le_sup_left.trans hℐ))).trans
        (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (k := k) (a := Sum.elim (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z) w')
          (b := Sum.elim x' y) (g := Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl) rfl).ge
    · rcases i with c | d
      · exact subset_racl k _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
      · exact hwz d
    · exact (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.1 (le_sup_right.trans hℐ)).trans
        (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (k := k) (a := Sum.elim (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z) w')
          (b := Sum.elim z w') (g := Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) Sum.inr)
          (funext fun i ↦ by rcases i with c | d <;> rfl)).ge
  ext C
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hC, hd⟩
    have : (PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal C).IsPrime :=
      PrimeSpectrum.isIrreducible_iff_vanishingIdeal_isPrime.1 hC.1
    have h𝔭 : ℐ₄ ≤ (PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal C).comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ₄) := fun f hf ↦ by
      rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.2 hf]
      exact zero_mem _
    have hC𝔭 : C = PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ₄)
        ((PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal C).comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ₄)) :
          Set (MvPolynomial (((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) k ⧸ ℐ₄)) := by
      rw [Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective,
        PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_vanishingIdeal_eq_closure,
        (isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents C hC).closure_eq]
    rw [hC𝔭] at hd
    obtain ⟨x', w', hJ, -⟩ := chain_realization x y z w hxy hwz _ h𝔭
      ((chain_dense_iff x y z w _ h𝔭).1 hd)
    obtain ⟨hx', hw'⟩ := hpair x' w' (hJ ▸ h𝔭)
    exact ⟨x', w', hx', hw', hC𝔭.trans (by rw [hJ])⟩
  · rintro ⟨x', w', hx', hw', rfl⟩
    have hℐ := chain_le_idealOf x y z w hx' hw'
    have hc : (idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z) w')).comap
        (rename 𝔢 : MvPolynomial (β ⊕ γ) k →ₐ[k] _) = idealOf k (Sum.elim y z) :=
      (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (k := k) (funext fun i ↦ by rcases i with b | c <;> rfl)).symm
    have hprime : (Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ₄)
        (idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z) w'))).IsPrime :=
      Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (by rwa [Ideal.mk_ker])
    refine ⟨?_, (chain_dense_iff x y z w _ hℐ).2 hc⟩
