    rw [PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus_ideal_mem_irreducibleComponents, hprime.radical]
    refine ⟨⟨hprime, bot_le⟩, fun Q' hQ' hle ↦ ?_⟩
    have : Q'.IsPrime := hQ'.1
    have : (Q'.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ₄)).IsPrime := Ideal.comap_isPrime _ _
    have hq : ℐ₄ ≤ Q'.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ₄) := fun f hf ↦ by
      rw [Ideal.mem_comap, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.2 hf]
      exact zero_mem _
    have hq𝔭 : Q'.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ₄) ≤
        idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z) w') :=
      (Ideal.comap_mono hle).trans (Ideal.comap_map_mk hℐ).le
    have hqc : (Q'.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ₄)).comap
        (rename 𝔢 : MvPolynomial (β ⊕ γ) k →ₐ[k] _) = idealOf k (Sum.elim y z) :=
      le_antisymm ((Ideal.comap_mono hq𝔭).trans hc.le)
        ((Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.1 (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left)).trans
          (Ideal.comap_mono hq))
    obtain ⟨x'', w'', hq'', halg⟩ := chain_realization x y z w hxy hwz _ hq hqc
    have h𝔢 : Sum.elim (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x'' y) z) w'' ∘ 𝔢 = Sum.elim y z :=
      funext fun i ↦ by rcases i with b | c <;> rfl
    have halg' : ∀ i, Sum.elim (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x'' y) z) w'' i ∈
        racl k (Set.range (Sum.elim (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x'' y) z) w'' ∘ 𝔢)) := by
      rw [h𝔢]
      exact halg
    have heq : idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z) w') =
        Q'.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ₄) :=
      (idealOf_eq_of_le_of_comap_eq (Sum.elim (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x'' y) z) w'') 𝔢 halg'
        (hq''.le.trans hq𝔭) (hc.trans (congrArg (idealOf k) h𝔢).symm)).trans hq''
    rw [heq]
    exact Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 le_rfl

name: AclGeom.chain_contraction
statement:
private theorem chain_contraction {x' : α → Ω} {w' : δ → Ω}
    (hℐ : ℐ₄ ≤ idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z) w')) :
    ((PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal (PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus (Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ₄)
        (idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z) w')) :
          Set (MvPolynomial (((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) k ⧸ ℐ₄)))).comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ₄)).comap
      (rename (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl) Sum.inr : α ⊕ δ → ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) :
        MvPolynomial (α ⊕ δ) k →ₐ[k] _) = idealOf k (Sum.elim x' w')
proof:
:= by
  have hprime : (Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk ℐ₄)
      (idealOf k (Sum.elim (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z) w'))).IsPrime :=
    Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (by rwa [Ideal.mk_ker])
  rw [PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal_zeroLocus_eq_radical, hprime.radical, Ideal.comap_map_mk hℐ]
  exact (idealOf_eq_comap_rename (k := k) (a := Sum.elim (Sum.elim (Sum.elim x' y) z) w')
    (b := Sum.elim x' w') (funext fun i ↦ by rcases i with a | d <;> rfl)).symm

name: AclGeom.normalization_generic_data
statement:
private theorem normalization_generic_data {R T : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing T]
    (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime] (f : T →+* R) :
    let A
proof:
:= R ⧸ p
    let N := integralClosure A (FractionRing A)
    IsIntegrallyClosed N ∧
      ∃ e : FractionRing N ≃ₐ[N] FractionRing A,
        (∀ a : A, e (algebraMap N (FractionRing N) (algebraMap A N a)) =
          algebraMap A (FractionRing A) a) ∧
        RingHom.ker (((algebraMap N (FractionRing N)).comp (algebraMap A N)).comp
          ((Ideal.Quotient.mk p).comp f)) = p.comap f := by
  let A := R ⧸ p
  let K := FractionRing A
  let N := integralClosure A K
  have hnorm : IsIntegrallyClosed N :=
    integralClosure.isIntegrallyClosedOfFiniteExtension K
  let _ : IsFractionRing N K := integralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension K K
  let e : FractionRing N ≃ₐ[N] K :=
    IsLocalization.algEquiv (nonZeroDivisors N) (FractionRing N) K
  refine ⟨hnorm, e, fun a ↦ e.commutes (algebraMap A N a), ?_⟩
  have hi : Function.Injective (algebraMap A N) := fun a b h ↦
    IsFractionRing.injective A K (congrArg (algebraMap N K) h)
  have hj : Function.Injective ((algebraMap N (FractionRing N)).comp (algebraMap A N)) :=
    (IsFractionRing.injective N (FractionRing N)).comp hi
  rw [RingHom.ker_comp_of_injective _ hj, ← RingHom.comap_ker, Ideal.mk_ker]

name: AclGeom.TupleCorrespondenceGerm.composes_threefold_components_eq
statement:
theorem composes_threefold_components_eq [Finite α] [Finite β] [Finite γ] [Finite δ]
    [IsAlgClosed Ω] (hPQ : P.target = Q.source) (hQS : Q.target = S.source) :
    {I | ∃ (E : TupleCorrespondenceGerm k Ω α γ) (F : TupleCorrespondenceGerm k Ω α δ),
        Composes (ofPair P) (ofPair Q) E ∧ Composes E (ofPair S) F ∧ F.carrier = I} =
      {I | ∃ Z ∈ irreducibleComponents
          (PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) k ⧸ 𝒥)),
        closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.quotientMapₐ 𝒥
          (rename (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) :
            β ⊕ γ → ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) :
            MvPolynomial (β ⊕ γ) k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) k)
          (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.1 (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left))).toRingHom '' Z) =
            Set.univ ∧
        I = ((PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal Z).comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝒥)).comap
          (rename (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl) Sum.inr : α ⊕ δ → ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) :
            MvPolynomial (α ⊕ δ) k →ₐ[k] _)} ∧
    {I | ∃ (E : TupleCorrespondenceGerm k Ω β δ) (F : TupleCorrespondenceGerm k Ω α δ),
        Composes (ofPair Q) (ofPair S) E ∧ Composes (ofPair P) E F ∧ F.carrier = I} =
      {I | ∃ Z ∈ irreducibleComponents
          (PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) k ⧸ 𝒥)),
        closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.quotientMapₐ 𝒥
          (rename (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) :
            β ⊕ γ → ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) :
            MvPolynomial (β ⊕ γ) k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) k)
          (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.1 (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left))).toRingHom '' Z) =
            Set.univ ∧
        I = ((PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal Z).comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝒥)).comap
          (rename (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl) Sum.inr : α ⊕ δ → ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) :
            MvPolynomial (α ⊕ δ) k →ₐ[k] _)} ∧
    ∀ Z ∈ irreducibleComponents (PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) k ⧸ 𝒥)),
      let p
proof:
:= (PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal Z).comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝒥)
      let A := MvPolynomial (((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) k ⧸ p
      let N := integralClosure A (FractionRing A)
      IsIntegrallyClosed N ∧
        ∃ e : FractionRing N ≃ₐ[N] FractionRing A,
          (∀ a : A, e (algebraMap N (FractionRing N) (algebraMap A N a)) =
            algebraMap A (FractionRing A) a) ∧
          RingHom.ker (((algebraMap N (FractionRing N)).comp (algebraMap A N)).comp
            ((Ideal.Quotient.mk p).comp (rename (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl) Sum.inr :
              α ⊕ δ → ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) : MvPolynomial (α ⊕ δ) k →ₐ[k] _).toRingHom)) =
            p.comap (rename (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl) Sum.inr :
              α ⊕ δ → ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) : MvPolynomial (α ⊕ δ) k →ₐ[k] _) := by
  have hwz : ∀ l, S.target l ∈ racl k (Set.range Q.target) := fun l ↦ by
    rw [hQS]
    exact S.target_mem_source l
  have hset := chain_dominatingComponents P.source P.target Q.target S.target
    P.source_mem_target hwz
  
  have hT : {I | ∃ (x' : α → Ω) (w' : δ → Ω),
      idealOf k (Sum.elim x' P.target) = idealOf k (Sum.elim P.source P.target) ∧
      idealOf k (Sum.elim Q.target w') = idealOf k (Sum.elim Q.target S.target) ∧
      I = idealOf k (Sum.elim x' w')} =
      {I | ∃ Z ∈ irreducibleComponents
          (PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) k ⧸ 𝒥)),
        closure (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.quotientMapₐ 𝒥
          (rename (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) :
            β ⊕ γ → ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) :
            MvPolynomial (β ⊕ γ) k →ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) k)
          (Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.1 (le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left))).toRingHom '' Z) =
            Set.univ ∧
        I = ((PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal Z).comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk 𝒥)).comap
          (rename (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl) Sum.inr : α ⊕ δ → ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) :
            MvPolynomial (α ⊕ δ) k →ₐ[k] _)} := by
    ext I
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x', w', hx', hw', rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨hZ, hd⟩ := (Set.ext_iff.1 hset _).2 ⟨x', w', hx', hw', rfl⟩
      exact ⟨_, hZ, hd, (chain_contraction P.source P.target Q.target S.target
        (chain_le_idealOf P.source P.target Q.target S.target hx' hw')).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨Z, hZ, hd, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨x', w', hx', hw', rfl⟩ := (Set.ext_iff.1 hset Z).1 ⟨hZ, hd⟩
      exact ⟨x', w', hx', hw', chain_contraction P.source P.target Q.target S.target
        (chain_le_idealOf P.source P.target Q.target S.target hx' hw')⟩
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := composes_threefold_carriers_eq P Q S hPQ hQS
  refine ⟨h₁.trans hT, h₂.trans hT, fun Z hZ ↦ ?_⟩
  have : (PrimeSpectrum.vanishingIdeal Z).IsPrime :=
    PrimeSpectrum.isIrreducible_iff_vanishingIdeal_isPrime.1 hZ.1
  exact normalization_generic_data _
    (rename (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl) Sum.inr : α ⊕ δ → ((α ⊕ β) ⊕ γ) ⊕ δ) :
      MvPolynomial (α ⊕ δ) k →ₐ[k] _).toRingHom

name: AclGeom.AdditiveTranslation.linePoint_comp_inclusion
statement:
theorem linePoint_comp_inclusion {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C] (x : C) :
    AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k x ≫ inclusion k = AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k 1 x
proof:
:= by
  have hh : (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) x).comp
      (AffineGroupScheme.eval k 1 (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k)) =
        AffineGroupScheme.eval k 1 x := by
    apply AffineGroupScheme.hom_ext
    · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AffineGroupScheme.eval_dilation, Units.val_one, map_one]
    · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AffineGroupScheme.eval_translation,
        AffineSchemeAction.lineEval_lineCoordinate]
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) x).toRingHom) ≫
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineGroupScheme.eval k 1
      (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k)).toRingHom) =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineGroupScheme.eval k 1 x).toRingHom)
  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
  apply congrArg Spec.map
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  change ((AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) x).comp
    (AffineGroupScheme.eval k 1 (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k))).toRingHom =
      (AffineGroupScheme.eval k 1 x).toRingHom
  exact congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom hh

name: AclGeom.AdditiveTranslation.inclusion_comp_shift
statement: theorem inclusion_comp_shift : inclusion k ≫ shift k = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  have hh : (AffineGroupScheme.eval k 1 (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k)).comp
      (AffineGroupScheme.includeTranslation k) =
        AlgHom.id k (AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1) := by
    apply AffineSchemeAction.lineHom_ext
    change (AffineGroupScheme.eval k 1 (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k))
      (AffineGroupScheme.translation k) = AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k
    exact AffineGroupScheme.eval_translation _ _
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  change Spec.map _ ≫ Spec.map _ = 𝟙 _
  rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_id]
  apply congrArg Spec.map
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  change ((AffineGroupScheme.eval k 1 (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k)).comp
    (AffineGroupScheme.includeTranslation k)).toRingHom = RingHom.id _
  exact congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom hh

name: AclGeom.AdditiveTranslation.linePoint_mul
statement:
theorem linePoint_mul {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C] (x y : C) :
    AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k x * AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k y =
      AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (x + y)
proof:
:= by
  have hh : WithConv.toConv (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) x) *
      WithConv.toConv (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) y) =
        WithConv.toConv (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) (x + y)) := by
    apply WithConv.ofConv_injective
    apply AffineSchemeAction.lineHom_ext
    rw [AlgHom.convMul_apply]
    change (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) x)
      (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) y) (fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _))
        (Coalgebra.comul (R := k) (SymmetricAlgebra.ι k (Fin 1 → k)
          (Pi.basisFun k (Fin 1) 0))) =
            (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) (x + y)) (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k)
    rw [SymmetricAlgebra.comul_ι]
    simp only [map_add, Algebra.TensorProduct.lift_tmul, map_one]
    change (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) x) (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k) * 1 +
      1 * (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) y) (AffineSchemeAction.lineCoordinate k) = _
    simp only [AffineSchemeAction.lineEval_lineCoordinate, _root_.mul_one, _root_.one_mul]
  have h := congrArg (Spec.mapMulEquiv (R := k)
    (S := AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1) (T := C)) hh
  rw [map_mul] at h
  exact h

name: AclGeom.AdditiveTranslation.linePoint_zero
statement:
theorem linePoint_zero {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C] :
    AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k (0 : C) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hh : WithConv.toConv (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) (0 : C)) = 1 := by
    apply WithConv.ofConv_injective
    apply AffineSchemeAction.lineHom_ext
    rw [AffineSchemeAction.lineEval_lineCoordinate]
    change 0 = algebraMap k C
      ((Bialgebra.counitAlgHom k (SymmetricAlgebra k (Fin 1 → k)))
        (SymmetricAlgebra.ι k (Fin 1 → k) (Pi.basisFun k (Fin 1) 0)))
    simp only [SymmetricAlgebra.counitAlgHom_eq, SymmetricAlgebra.algebraMapInv_ι, map_zero]
  exact (congrArg (Spec.mapMulEquiv (R := k)
    (S := AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1) (T := C)) hh).trans (map_one _)

name: AclGeom.AdditiveTranslation.AclGeom.AdditiveTranslation.linePoint_comp_groupPoint
statement:
theorem linePoint_comp_groupPoint {C : Type u} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
    (x : C) (a : (AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1)ˣ)
    (z : AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1) :
    AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k x ≫ AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k a z =
      AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k
        (Units.map (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) x).toMonoidHom a)
        (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) x z)
proof:
:= by
  have hh : (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) x).comp (AffineGroupScheme.eval k a z) =
      AffineGroupScheme.eval k
        (Units.map (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) x).toMonoidHom a)
        (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) x z) := by
    apply AffineGroupScheme.hom_ext
    · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AffineGroupScheme.eval_dilation, Units.coe_map]
      rfl
    · simp only [AlgHom.comp_apply, AffineGroupScheme.eval_translation]
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) x).toRingHom) ≫
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineGroupScheme.eval k a z).toRingHom) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AffineGroupScheme.eval k
        (Units.map (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) x).toMonoidHom a)
        (AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) x z)).toRingHom)
  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
  apply congrArg Spec.map
  apply CommRingCat.hom_ext
  change ((AffineSchemeAction.lineEval (k := k) x).comp
    (AffineGroupScheme.eval k a z)).toRingHom = _
  exact congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom hh

name: AclGeom.adjoinTranscendentalAlgHom_apply
statement:
theorem adjoinTranscendentalAlgHom_apply (ht : AlgebraicIndependent k t)
    (hs : AlgebraicIndependent k s) (i : ι) :
    adjoinTranscendentalAlgHom ht hs ⟨t i, subset_adjoin k _ ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩ = s i
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ht.aevalEquivField (algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι k)
      (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ι k)) (MvPolynomial.X i)) =
      ⟨t i, subset_adjoin k _ ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩ := by
    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    rw [ht.aevalEquivField_algebraMap_apply_coe]
    simp
  have h2 : ht.aevalEquivField.symm ⟨t i, subset_adjoin k _ ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩ =
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι k) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ι k))
        (MvPolynomial.X i) := by
    rw [← h1, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have h3 : hs.aevalEquivField (algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι k)
      (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ι k)) (MvPolynomial.X i)) =
      ⟨s i, subset_adjoin k _ ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩ := by
    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    rw [hs.aevalEquivField_algebraMap_apply_coe]
    simp
  change (adjoin k (Set.range s)).val
    (hs.aevalEquivField (ht.aevalEquivField.symm
      ⟨t i, subset_adjoin k _ ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩)) = s i
  rw [h2, h3]
  rfl

name: AclGeom.exists_extension_of_isAlgebraic
statement:
theorem exists_extension_of_isAlgebraic [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    {E E' : IntermediateField k Ω} (hEE' : E ≤ E')
    [halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic ↥E ↥(extendScalars hEE')]
    (φ : ↥E →ₐ[k] Ω) :
    ∃ ψ : ↥E' →ₐ[k] Ω, ∀ x : ↥E, ψ ⟨x.1, hEE' x.2⟩ = φ x
proof:
:= by
  
  
  letI : Algebra ↥E Ω := φ.toAlgebra
  let ψE : ↥(extendScalars hEE') →ₐ[↥E] Ω := IsAlgClosed.lift
  have hcomm : ∀ y : ↥E, ψE (algebraMap ↥E ↥(extendScalars hEE') y) = φ y :=
    fun y ↦ ψE.commutes y
  refine ⟨{ toRingHom := ψE.toRingHom, commutes' := fun c ↦ ?_ }, fun x ↦ ?_⟩
  · have h1 : (algebraMap k ↥E' c : ↥E') =
        algebraMap ↥E ↥(extendScalars hEE') (algebraMap k ↥E c) := rfl
    change ψE (algebraMap k ↥E' c) = algebraMap k Ω c
    rw [h1, hcomm, φ.commutes]
  · have hx : (⟨x.1, hEE' x.2⟩ : ↥(extendScalars hEE')) =
        algebraMap ↥E ↥(extendScalars hEE') x := rfl
    change ψE ⟨x.1, hEE' x.2⟩ = φ x
    rw [hx, hcomm]

name: AclGeom.adjoinTranscendentalAlgHom_mem
statement:
theorem adjoinTranscendentalAlgHom_mem {ι : Type*} {t s : ι → Ω}
    (ht : AlgebraicIndependent k t) (hs : AlgebraicIndependent k s)
    (x : ↥(adjoin k (Set.range t))) :
    adjoinTranscendentalAlgHom ht hs x ∈ adjoin k (Set.range s)
proof:
:= by
  change (adjoin k (Set.range s)).val
    (hs.aevalEquivField (ht.aevalEquivField.symm x)) ∈ adjoin k (Set.range s)
  exact SetLike.coe_mem _

name: AclGeom.exists_relocation
statement:
theorem exists_relocation [IsAlgClosed Ω] {n d : ℕ} {a : Fin n → Ω}
    {t : Fin d → Ω} (ht : AlgebraicIndependent k t)
    (hle : adjoin k (Set.range t) ≤ adjoin k (Set.range a))
    (halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic ↥(adjoin k (Set.range t)) ↥(extendScalars hle))
    {s : Fin d → Ω} (hs : AlgebraicIndependent k s) :
    ∃ b : Fin n → Ω, idealOf k b = idealOf k a ∧
      ∀ j, IsAlgebraic ↥(adjoin k (Set.range s)) (b j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := exists_extension_of_isAlgebraic (halg := halg) hle
    (adjoinTranscendentalAlgHom ht hs)
  set ta : Fin n → ↥(adjoin k (Set.range a)) :=
    fun j ↦ ⟨a j, subset_adjoin k _ ⟨j, rfl⟩⟩ with hta
  refine ⟨fun j ↦ ψ (ta j), ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    ext f
    rw [mem_idealOf_iff, mem_idealOf_iff]
    have h1 : MvPolynomial.aeval (fun j ↦ ψ (ta j)) f = ψ (MvPolynomial.aeval ta f) := by
      rw [MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply]
    have h2 : MvPolynomial.aeval a f =
        (adjoin k (Set.range a)).val (MvPolynomial.aeval ta f) := by
      rw [MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply]
      rfl
    rw [h1, h2]
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h4 : ψ (MvPolynomial.aeval ta f) = ψ 0 := by
        rw [map_zero]
        exact h
      rw [ψ.injective h4, map_zero]
    · intro h
      have h4 : (adjoin k (Set.range a)).val (MvPolynomial.aeval ta f) =
          (adjoin k (Set.range a)).val 0 := by
        rw [map_zero]
        exact h
      rw [(adjoin k (Set.range a)).val.injective h4, map_zero]
  · 
    intro j
    
    obtain ⟨p, hp0, hpz⟩ := (halg.isAlgebraic
      (⟨(ta j).1, (ta j).2⟩ : ↥(extendScalars hle)))
    
    refine isAlgebraic_of_coeff_mem (p := p.map ((adjoinTranscendentalAlgHom ht hs) :
        ↥(adjoin k (Set.range t)) →+* Ω))
      ((Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff (RingHom.injective _)).2 hp0) ?_ fun m ↦ ?_
    · 
      have hcomp : ((ψ : ↥(adjoin k (Set.range a)) →+* Ω).comp
          (algebraMap ↥(adjoin k (Set.range t)) ↥(extendScalars hle))) =
          ((adjoinTranscendentalAlgHom ht hs) : ↥(adjoin k (Set.range t)) →+* Ω) := by
        refine RingHom.ext fun y ↦ ?_
        exact hψ y
      rw [Polynomial.eval_map, ← hcomp]
      have h3 : ψ ((Polynomial.aeval (⟨(ta j).1, (ta j).2⟩ :
          ↥(extendScalars hle))) p) = 0 := by
        rw [hpz]
        exact map_zero ψ
      rw [← h3, Polynomial.aeval_def]
      exact (Polynomial.hom_eval₂ p
        (algebraMap ↥(adjoin k (Set.range t)) ↥(extendScalars hle))
        ψ.toRingHom ⟨(ta j).1, (ta j).2⟩).symm
    · rw [Polynomial.coeff_map]
      exact adjoinTranscendentalAlgHom_mem ht hs _

name: AclGeom.aeval_partialAeval
statement:
theorem aeval_partialAeval (E : IntermediateField k Ω) (c : Fin m → ↥E)
    (w : Fin n → Ω) (f : MvPolynomial (Fin m ⊕ Fin n) k) :
    aeval w (partialAeval (Ω := Ω) E c f) =
      aeval (Sum.elim (fun i ↦ (c i : Ω)) w) f
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((aeval w : MvPolynomial (Fin n) ↥E →ₐ[↥E] Ω).restrictScalars k).comp
      (partialAeval (Ω := Ω) E c) = aeval (Sum.elim (fun i ↦ (c i : Ω)) w) := by
    refine MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun i ↦ ?_
    rcases i with i | j
    · simp [partialAeval]
    · simp [partialAeval]
  exact congrArg (fun (g : MvPolynomial (Fin m ⊕ Fin n) k →ₐ[k] Ω) ↦ g f) h

name: AclGeom.isAlgebraic_extendScalars_adjoin
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_extendScalars_adjoin {F : Type*} [Field F] [Algebra F Ω]
    {S T : Set Ω} (hle : adjoin F S ≤ adjoin F T)
    (halg : ∀ x ∈ T, IsAlgebraic ↥(adjoin F S) x) :
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic ↥(adjoin F S) ↥(extendScalars hle)
proof:
:= by
  have key : extendScalars hle = adjoin ↥(adjoin F S) T := by
    refine restrictScalars_injective F ?_
    rw [adjoin_adjoin_left, extendScalars_restrictScalars, adjoin_union]
    exact (sup_eq_right.2 hle).symm
  rw [key]
  exact isAlgebraic_adjoin fun x hx ↦ (halg x hx).isIntegral

name: AclGeom.exists_joint_relocation
statement:
theorem exists_joint_relocation [IsAlgClosed Ω] {d : ℕ}
    (c₁ : Fin m → Ω) {c₂ : Fin n → Ω} {t : Fin d → Ω}
    (ht : AlgebraicIndependent ↥(adjoin k (Set.range c₁)) t)
    (hle : adjoin ↥(adjoin k (Set.range c₁)) (Set.range t) ≤
      adjoin ↥(adjoin k (Set.range c₁)) (Set.range c₂))
    (halg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic
      ↥(adjoin ↥(adjoin k (Set.range c₁)) (Set.range t)) ↥(extendScalars hle))
    {s : Fin d → Ω}
    (hs : AlgebraicIndependent ↥(adjoin k (Set.range c₁)) s) :
    ∃ c₂' : Fin n → Ω,
      (∀ f : MvPolynomial (Fin m ⊕ Fin n) k,
        aeval (Sum.elim c₁ c₂') f = 0 ↔ aeval (Sum.elim c₁ c₂) f = 0) ∧
      ∀ j, IsAlgebraic
        ↥(adjoin ↥(adjoin k (Set.range c₁)) (Set.range s)) (c₂' j)
proof:
:= by
  set K₀ := adjoin k (Set.range c₁)
  obtain ⟨c₂', hideal, halg'⟩ := exists_relocation (k := ↥K₀) ht hle halg hs
  refine ⟨c₂', fun f ↦ ?_, halg'⟩
  set tc₁ : Fin m → ↥K₀ := fun i ↦ ⟨c₁ i, subset_adjoin k _ ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩ with htc₁
  have hval : ∀ i, ((tc₁ i : ↥K₀) : Ω) = c₁ i := fun i ↦ rfl
  have h1 : aeval (Sum.elim c₁ c₂') f =
      aeval c₂' (partialAeval (Ω := Ω) K₀ tc₁ f) := by
    rw [aeval_partialAeval]
  have h2 : aeval (Sum.elim c₁ c₂) f =
      aeval c₂ (partialAeval (Ω := Ω) K₀ tc₁ f) := by
    rw [aeval_partialAeval]
  rw [h1, h2, ← mem_idealOf_iff, ← mem_idealOf_iff, hideal]

name: AclGeom.aeval_addSubst
statement:
theorem aeval_addSubst (u v : Fin n → Ω) (h : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) :
    aeval (Sum.elim u v) (addSubst (k := k) h) = aeval (u + v) h
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ((aeval (Sum.elim u v) : MvPolynomial (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) k →ₐ[k] Ω).comp
      (addSubst (k := k))) = aeval (u + v) := by
    refine MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun j ↦ ?_
    simp [addSubst]
  exact congrArg (fun (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k →ₐ[k] Ω) ↦ g h) hcomp

name: AclGeom.idealOf_add_eq_of_joint
statement:
theorem idealOf_add_eq_of_joint {c₁ c₂ c₂' : Fin n → Ω}
    (H : ∀ f : MvPolynomial (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) k,
      aeval (Sum.elim c₁ c₂') f = 0 ↔ aeval (Sum.elim c₁ c₂) f = 0) :
    idealOf k (c₁ + c₂') = idealOf k (c₁ + c₂)
proof:
:= by
  ext h
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, mem_idealOf_iff, ← aeval_addSubst, ← aeval_addSubst]
  exact H (addSubst (k := k) h)

name: AclGeom.aeval_mulSubst
statement:
theorem aeval_mulSubst (u v : Fin n → Ω) (h : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) :
    aeval (Sum.elim u v) (mulSubst (k := k) h) = aeval (u * v) h
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ((aeval (Sum.elim u v) : MvPolynomial (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) k →ₐ[k] Ω).comp
      (mulSubst (k := k))) = aeval (u * v) := by
    refine MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun j ↦ ?_
    simp [mulSubst]
  exact congrArg (fun (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k →ₐ[k] Ω) ↦ g h) hcomp

name: AclGeom.idealOf_mul_eq_of_joint
statement:
theorem idealOf_mul_eq_of_joint {c₁ c₂ c₂' : Fin n → Ω}
    (H : ∀ f : MvPolynomial (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) k,
      aeval (Sum.elim c₁ c₂') f = 0 ↔ aeval (Sum.elim c₁ c₂) f = 0) :
    idealOf k (c₁ * c₂') = idealOf k (c₁ * c₂)
proof:
:= by
  ext h
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, mem_idealOf_iff, ← aeval_mulSubst, ← aeval_mulSubst]
  exact H (mulSubst (k := k) h)

name: AclGeom.aeval_subSubst
statement:
theorem aeval_subSubst (u v : Fin n → Ω) (h : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) :
    aeval (Sum.elim u v) (subSubst (k := k) h) = aeval (u - v) h
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ((aeval (Sum.elim u v) : MvPolynomial (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) k →ₐ[k] Ω).comp
      (subSubst (k := k))) = aeval (u - v) := by
    refine MvPolynomial.algHom_ext fun j ↦ ?_
    simp [subSubst]
  exact congrArg (fun (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k →ₐ[k] Ω) ↦ g h) hcomp

name: AclGeom.idealOf_sub_eq_of_joint
statement:
theorem idealOf_sub_eq_of_joint {c₁ c₂ c₂' : Fin n → Ω}
    (H : ∀ f : MvPolynomial (Fin n ⊕ Fin n) k,
      aeval (Sum.elim c₁ c₂') f = 0 ↔ aeval (Sum.elim c₁ c₂) f = 0) :
    idealOf k (c₁ - c₂') = idealOf k (c₁ - c₂)
proof:
:= by
  ext h
  rw [mem_idealOf_iff, mem_idealOf_iff, ← aeval_subSubst, ← aeval_subSubst]
  exact H (subSubst (k := k) h)

name: AclGeom.SmoothCurveStalks.stalk_integrallyClosed
statement:
theorem stalk_integrallyClosed
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left] [Smooth X.hom]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1) (x : X.left) :
    IsIntegrallyClosed (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = genericPoint X.left
  · subst x
    exact inferInstanceAs (IsIntegrallyClosed X.left.functionField)
  have hclosed := (CurvePointsPlaces.isClosed_singleton_iff_ne_genericPoint X.left hdim x).2 hx
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian X.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian X.hom
  let := stalkAlgebra X x
  have := stalk_formallySmooth X x
  have := stalk_essFiniteType X x
  have := stalk_functionField_isScalarTower X x
  have := stalk_residue_isAlgebraic X x hclosed
  have := scheme_functionField_isFunctionFieldOneVar k X hdim
  exact isIntegrallyClosed_of_smooth (F := X.left.functionField)
    (trdeg_eq_one_of_oneVar (k := k) (F := X.left.functionField))

name: AclGeom.SmoothCurveStalks.stalk_valuationRing
statement:
theorem stalk_valuationRing
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left] [Smooth X.hom]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1) (x : X.left) :
    ValuationRing (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian X.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian X.hom
  have := stalk_integrallyClosed X hdim x
  exact ProperCurve.stalk_valuationRing X.left hdim.le x

name: AclGeom.SmoothCurveStalks.stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing
statement:
theorem stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left] [Smooth X.hom]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1) (x : X.left)
    (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X.left)) :
    IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian X.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian X.hom
  have hnotfield : ¬ IsField (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) := by
    intro hf
    exact ((CurvePointsPlaces.isClosed_singleton_iff_ne_genericPoint X.left hdim x).1 hx)
      ((CurvePointsPlaces.isField_stalk_iff_genericPoint X.left x).1 hf)
  exact ((IsDiscreteValuationRing.TFAE (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) hnotfield).out 2 1).mp
    (stalk_valuationRing X hdim x)

name: AclGeom.SmoothCurveStalks.connectedGroup_stalks
statement:
theorem connectedGroup_stalks (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim G.toGroupScheme.X.left = 1) :
    (∀ x : G.toGroupScheme.X.left, IsIntegrallyClosed (G.toGroupScheme.X.left.presheaf.stalk x)) ∧
    (∀ x : G.toGroupScheme.X.left, ValuationRing (G.toGroupScheme.X.left.presheaf.stalk x)) ∧
    (∀ x : G.toGroupScheme.X.left, IsClosed ({x} : Set G.toGroupScheme.X.left) →
      IsDiscreteValuationRing (G.toGroupScheme.X.left.presheaf.stalk x))
proof:
:= by
  have : GrpObj (Over.mk G.toGroupScheme.X.hom) := by
    change GrpObj G.toGroupScheme.X
    infer_instance
  have : Smooth G.toGroupScheme.X.hom := smooth_of_grpObj _
  exact ⟨stalk_integrallyClosed G.toGroupScheme.X hdim,
    stalk_valuationRing G.toGroupScheme.X hdim,
    stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing G.toGroupScheme.X hdim⟩

name: AclGeom.SmoothCurveStalks.properSmooth_existsUnique_iso_extension
statement:
theorem properSmooth_existsUnique_iso_extension
    (X U : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left] [Smooth X.hom] [IsProper X.hom]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1) [Nonempty U.left]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j.left] (a : U ≅ U) :
    ∃! F : X ≅ X, j ≫ F.hom = a.hom ≫ j
proof:
:= by
  exact ProperCurve.existsUnique_iso_extension X U hdim.le
    (stalk_integrallyClosed X hdim) j a

name: AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.exists_whole_curve_coordinate
statement:
theorem exists_whole_curve_coordinate
    (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    (hker : ∀ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
      ModObj.pointAct V q = 𝟙 V → q = 1)
    (hdimG : (2 : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ topologicalKrullDim G.toAlgebraicGroup.carrier)
    (hdimV : topologicalKrullDim V.left = 1)
    (i : (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).Hom G.toAlgebraicGroup)
    [Mono i.hom.hom] :
    ∃ t : V.left.functionField, Transcendental k t ∧
      IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set V.left.functionField) = ⊤ ∧
    ∃ f : G.toAlgebraicGroup.Hom (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k),
      Function.Injective (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X ↦
        q ≫ f.hom.hom) ∧
      (∀ q, (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V q).unop t =
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField
          ((AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom)).multiplier : k) * t +
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField
          (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom)).shift) ∧
    ∃ e : V ≅ (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X,
      SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter V ≫ e.hom = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k t ∧
      γ[G.toGroupScheme.X, V] ≫ e.hom =
        lift (fst G.toGroupScheme.X V ≫ f.hom.hom)
          (snd G.toGroupScheme.X V ≫ e.hom) ≫ AffineSchemeAction.smul k ∧
      ∀ (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
        (q : (Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X)
        (z : (Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ V) (a : Cˣ) (b c : C),
        q ≫ f.hom.hom = AffineSchemeAction.groupPoint k a b →
        z ≫ e.hom = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k c →
        (lift q z ≫ γ[G.toGroupScheme.X, V]) ≫ e.hom =
          AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k ((a : C) * c + b)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htop, Φ, _, hΦ, f, hfinj, hpoint, _⟩ :=
    SchemeAffineMorphism.exists_affine_morphism G V hker hdimG hdimV
  have hf (q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) :
      (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G.toAlgebraicGroup V q).unop t =
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField
          ((AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom)).multiplier : k) * t +
        algebraMap k V.left.functionField
          (AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k (q ≫ f.hom.hom)).shift := by
    rw [hpoint]
    exact hΦ q
  exact ⟨t, ht, htop, f, hfinj, hf,
    whole_curve_coordinate_of_affine_data G V hker hdimV i t ht htop Φ hΦ f hpoint⟩

name: AclGeom.FiniteGaCover.exists_polynomial_frobenius_factor
statement:
theorem exists_polynomial_frobenius_factor
    {k A : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Algebra k A]
    (p : ℕ) [ExpChar k p] [PerfectRing k p]
    (α : k[X] →ₐ[k] A) (hinj : Function.Injective α) (hfin : α.toRingHom.Finite)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.UniversallyInjective
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α.toRingHom))] :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (θ : A →ₐ[k] k[X]), Function.Injective θ ∧
      θ.comp α = aeval (X ^ p ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  let R := k[X]
  let K := FractionRing R
  let L := FractionRing A
  let : Algebra R A := α.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower k R A := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun c ↦ (α.commutes c).symm
  have : FaithfulSMul R A := (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective R A).mpr hinj
  have : Module.Finite R A := hfin
  have : IsScalarTower R A L := inferInstance
  have : FaithfulSMul R L := (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective R L).mpr
    ((IsFractionRing.injective A L).comp hinj)
  let : Algebra K L := FractionRing.liftAlgebra R L
  have : IsScalarTower R K L := FractionRing.isScalarTower_liftAlgebra R L
  have : FiniteDimensional K L := inferInstance
  have : IsPurelyInseparable K L :=
    isPurelyInseparable_of_universallyInjective (R := R) (A := A) (K := K) (L := L)
  have : IsPurelyInseparable.HasExponent K L := inferInstance
  have : ExpChar K p := expChar_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap k K).injective p
  let n := IsPurelyInseparable.exponent K L
  let f : L →+* K := IsPurelyInseparable.iterateFrobenius K L p (le_refl n)
  let π : A →+* K := f.comp (algebraMap A L)
  have hπ (a : A) : ∃ r : R, algebraMap R K r = π a := by
    apply IsIntegrallyClosed.algebraMap_eq_of_integral
    apply (isIntegral_algHom_iff (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R K L)
      (algebraMap K L).injective).mp
    change IsIntegral R (algebraMap K L (f (algebraMap A L a)))
    rw [IsPurelyInseparable.algebraMap_iterateFrobenius]
    exact ((Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral (R := R) a).algebraMap).pow _
  let e : R ≃+* (algebraMap R K).range := RingEquiv.ofLeftInverse
    (Classical.choose_spec (IsFractionRing.injective R K).hasLeftInverse)
  let πR : A →+* R := e.symm.toRingHom.comp (π.codRestrict _ hπ)
  have hπR (a : A) : algebraMap R K (πR a) = π a := by
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (e.apply_symm_apply (π.codRestrict _ hπ a))
  have hbase (r : R) : πR (α r) = r ^ p ^ n := by
    apply IsFractionRing.injective R K
    rw [hπR, map_pow]
    change f (algebraMap A L (algebraMap R A r)) = (algebraMap R K r) ^ p ^ n
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R A L, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R K L]
    exact IsPurelyInseparable.iterateFrobenius_algebraMap L p (le_refl n) _
  let σ := (iterateFrobeniusEquiv k p n).symm
  let θraw : A →+* R := (Polynomial.mapRingHom σ.toRingHom).comp πR
  have hc (c : k) : θraw (algebraMap k A c) = C c := by
    rw [← α.commutes c]
    change Polynomial.map σ.toRingHom (πR (α (C c))) = C c
    rw [hbase, Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_C]
    change C (σ c) ^ p ^ n = C c
    rw [← Polynomial.C_pow]
    apply congrArg C
    exact (iterateFrobeniusEquiv k p n).apply_symm_apply c
  let θ : A →ₐ[k] k[X] := { θraw with commutes' := hc }
  have hθinj : Function.Injective θ := by
    apply (Polynomial.map_injective σ.toRingHom σ.injective).comp
    intro a b hab
    have hh : π a = π b := (hπR a).symm.trans ((congrArg (algebraMap R K) hab).trans (hπR b))
    exact (IsFractionRing.injective A L) (f.injective hh)
  refine ⟨n, θ, hθinj, ?_⟩
  apply Polynomial.algHom_ext
  change Polynomial.map σ.toRingHom (πR (α X)) = (aeval (X ^ p ^ n)) X
  rw [hbase, Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_X, aeval_X]

name: AclGeom.AffineCoefficients.sectionsTensorAut_baseChange
statement:
theorem sectionsTensorAut_baseChange {G : Over (Spec (.of k))} [GrpObj G]
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsAffine V.left] [ModObj G V]
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra k A] [Algebra k B]
    (φ : A →ₐ[k] B) (g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G)
    (z : A ⊗[k] Γ(V.left, ⊤)) :
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map φ (AlgHom.id k Γ(V.left, ⊤)) (sectionsTensorAut V g z) =
      sectionsTensorAut V ((algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map φ (AlgHom.id k Γ(V.left, ⊤)) z)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsMonHom (Iso.refl G).hom := inferInstanceAs (IsMonHom (𝟙 G))
  let : ModObj G ((Spec (.of Γ(V.left, ⊤))).asOver (Spec (.of k))) :=
    ModObj.ofIso (Iso.refl G) (sectionsSpecIso V)
  exact SchemeParameterAction.tensorAut_baseChange φ g z

name: AclGeom.AffineCoefficients.sectionsTensorAut_point
statement:
private theorem sectionsTensorAut_point {G : Over (Spec (.of k))} [GrpObj G]
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsAffine V.left] [ModObj G V]
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G) (φ : A →ₐ[k] k)
    (r : Γ(V.left, ⊤)) :
    (ModObj.pointAct V ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
      (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)).left.appTop r =
        tensorPointEval φ (sectionsTensorAut V g (1 ⊗ₜ[k] r))
proof:
:= by
  let R : Type u := Γ(V.left, ⊤)
  let W := (Spec (.of R)).asOver (Spec (.of k))
  let e := sectionsSpecIso V
  have : IsMonHom (Iso.refl G).hom := inferInstanceAs (IsMonHom (𝟙 G))
  let : ModObj G W := ModObj.ofIso (Iso.refl G) e
  have : IsModHom G e.hom := by
    constructor
    change γ[G, V] ≫ e.hom =
      (𝟙 G ⊗ₘ e.hom) ≫ (𝟙 G ⊗ₘ e.inv) ≫ γ[G, V] ≫ e.hom
    rw [← Category.assoc, tensorHom_comp_tensorHom]
    simp only [Category.id_comp, e.hom_inv_id, tensorHom_id, id_whiskerRight]
  let T := (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k))
  let Φ : T ⊗ W ⟶ V := (fst T W ≫ g) • (snd T W ≫ e.inv)
  let ψ : R →+* A ⊗[k] R := (sectionsTensorAut V g).toRingHom.comp
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : R →ₐ[k] A ⊗[k] R).toRingHom
  have hΦ : Φ ≫ e.hom = (fst T W ≫ g) • snd T W := by
    change ((fst T W ≫ g) • (snd T W ≫ e.inv)) ≫ e.hom = _
    rw [IsModHom.map_smul, Category.assoc, e.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  have hψ : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ) =
      ((AffineSchemeAction.tensorSpecIso k A R).inv ≫ Φ ≫ e.hom).left := by
    let f : Limits.pullback (Spec.algebraMap k A) (Spec.algebraMap k R) ⟶ Spec (.of R) :=
      (Φ ≫ e.hom).left
    change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : R →ₐ[k] A ⊗[k] R).toRingHom ≫
      CommRingCat.ofHom (SchemeParameterAction.tensorAut g).toRingHom) =
        (pullbackSpecIso k A R).inv ≫ f
    let p : Limits.pullback (Spec.algebraMap k A) (Spec.algebraMap k R) ⟶
        Limits.pullback (Spec.algebraMap k A) (Spec.algebraMap k R) :=
      (ModObj.parameterAct W g).left
    have hp := SchemeParameterAction.spec_map_tensorAut (R := R) g
    change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (SchemeParameterAction.tensorAut g).toRingHom) =
      (pullbackSpecIso k A R).inv ≫ p ≫ (pullbackSpecIso k A R).hom at hp
    have hsnd := pullbackSpecIso_hom_snd k A R
    change (pullbackSpecIso k A R).hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : R →ₐ[k] A ⊗[k] R).toRingHom) =
        Limits.pullback.snd _ _ at hsnd
    rw [Spec.map_comp, hp, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hsnd]
    have h := congrArg (fun f : T ⊗ W ⟶ W ↦ f.left)
      (ModObj.parameterAct_snd W g)
    rw [← hΦ] at h
    change p ≫ Limits.pullback.snd _ _ = f at h
    exact congrArg (fun f ↦ (pullbackSpecIso k A R).inv ≫ f) h
  let q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G := (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
    (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g
  have hpt : q.left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) ≫ g.left := by
    change 𝟙 _ ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) ≫ g.left = _
    rw [Category.id_comp]
  let ev : A →ₐ[k] R := (Algebra.ofId k R).comp φ
  have hevH : CommRingCat.ofHom ev.toRingHom =
      CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k R) := rfl
  have hv : V.left.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k R)) = V.hom :=
    Over.w e.hom
  have ha : e.hom ≫ (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ev.toRingHom)).asOver
      (Spec (.of k)) ≫ g = toUnit V ≫ q := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    let g' : Spec (.of A) ⟶ G.left := g.left
    let q' : Spec (.of k) ⟶ G.left := q.left
    have hq' : q' = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) ≫ g' := hpt
    change V.left.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ev.toRingHom) ≫ g' =
      V.hom ≫ q'
    rw [hevH, Spec.map_comp]
    calc
      _ = (V.left.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k R))) ≫
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) ≫ g') := by
        simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [hv, hq']
  have hb : e.hom ≫ (Spec.map
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (AlgHom.id k R).toRingHom)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ≫ e.inv = 𝟙 V := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    change V.left.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map (𝟙 _) ≫ V.left.isoSpec.inv = 𝟙 V.left
    rw [Spec.map_id, Category.id_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id]
  have hleft : (ModObj.pointAct V q).left = V.left.isoSpec.hom ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift ev (AlgHom.id k R)
          (fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _)).toRingHom) ≫ V.left.isoSpec.inv := by
    have hh : ModObj.pointAct V q = e.hom ≫
        (lift ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ev.toRingHom)).asOver (Spec (.of k)))
          ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AlgHom.id k R).toRingHom)).asOver (Spec (.of k))) ≫
          (AffineSchemeAction.tensorSpecIso k A R).hom) ≫
        ((AffineSchemeAction.tensorSpecIso k A R).inv ≫ Φ ≫ e.hom) ≫ e.inv := by
      simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
      change (toUnit V ≫ q) • 𝟙 V = e.hom ≫ _ ≫
        ((fst T W ≫ g) • (snd T W ≫ e.inv))
      rw [ModObj.comp_smul, ModObj.comp_smul, lift_fst_assoc, lift_snd_assoc, ha, hb]
    rw [hh, AffineSchemeAction.lift_tensorSpecIso_hom, Spec.map_comp, hψ]
    rfl
  have happ : (ModObj.pointAct V q).left.appTop = CommRingCat.ofHom ψ ≫
      CommRingCat.ofHom (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift ev (AlgHom.id k R)
        (fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _)).toRingHom := by
    apply Spec.map_injective
    rw [← cancel_mono V.left.isoSpec.inv, Scheme.isoSpec_inv_naturality, hleft,
      Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  change ((ModObj.pointAct V q).left.appTop).hom r = _
  rw [happ]
  rfl

name: AclGeom.AffineCoefficients.sectionsTensorAut_point_germ
statement:
theorem sectionsTensorAut_point_germ (G : AlgebraicGroup k)
    (V : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral V.left] [IsAffine V.left]
    [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V]
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X) (φ : A →ₐ[k] k)
    (r : Γ(V.left, ⊤)) :
    (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G V ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
      (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g)).unop
        (V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤ (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint _, trivial⟩⟩) r) =
      tensorPointEval φ (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id k A)
        ((sectionsFunctionFieldEquiv V).toAlgHom.comp
          (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k Γ(V.left, ⊤) (FractionRing Γ(V.left, ⊤))))
        (sectionsTensorAut V g (1 ⊗ₜ[k] r)))
proof:
:= by
  let R : Type u := Γ(V.left, ⊤)
  let F : Type u := V.left.functionField
  let f : R →ₐ[k] F := (sectionsFunctionFieldEquiv V).toAlgHom.comp
    (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k R (FractionRing R))
  have hf (r : R) : f r =
      V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤ (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint _, trivial⟩⟩) r :=
    sectionsFunctionFieldEquiv_algebraMap V r
  have hnat (z : A ⊗[k] R) : f (tensorPointEval φ z) =
      tensorPointEval φ (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id k A) f z) := by
    induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul a r =>
      change f (algebraMap k R (φ a) * r) = algebraMap k F (φ a) * f r
      rw [map_mul, f.commutes]
    | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  let q := (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom φ).op ≫ g
  have : IsIso (ModObj.pointAut V q).hom.left :=
    ActionFunctionField.isIso_hom_left (ModObj.pointAut V q)
  have : IsDominant (ModObj.pointAut V q).hom.left := inferInstance
  have hgerm := congrArg (fun z ↦ z.hom r)
    (Scheme.Hom.germToFunctionField_top_comp (ModObj.pointAut V q).hom.left)
  change (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAction G V q).unop
      (V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤ (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint _, trivial⟩⟩) r) =
    V.left.germToFunctionField ⊤ (h := ⟨⟨genericPoint _, trivial⟩⟩)
      ((ModObj.pointAct V q).left.appTop r) at hgerm
  change _ = tensorPointEval φ (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id k A) f _)
  rw [hgerm, sectionsTensorAut_point V g φ r, ← hf]
  exact hnat _

name: AclGeom.pow_injective_of_transcendental
statement:
private theorem pow_injective_of_transcendental {lam : K} (hlam : Transcendental k lam) :
    Function.Injective fun n : ℕ ↦ lam ^ n
proof:
:= by
  intro n m h
  have he : (Polynomial.X : Polynomial k) ^ n = Polynomial.X ^ m :=
    (transcendental_iff_injective.1 hlam) (by simpa only [map_pow, Polynomial.aeval_X] using h)
  have hd := congrArg Polynomial.natDegree he
  simpa only [Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow] using hd

name: AclGeom.finite_stable_under_mul_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hμ0
  have hmem : ∀ n : ℕ, μ * lam ^ n ∈ S := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simpa only [pow_zero, mul_one] using hμ
    | succ n ih => simpa only [pow_succ, ← mul_assoc] using hstable _ ih
  have hinj : Function.Injective fun n : ℕ ↦ μ * lam ^ n := by
    intro n m h
    exact pow_injective_of_transcendental hlam (mul_left_cancel₀ hμ0 h)
  exact (Set.infinite_range_of_injective hinj) (hS.subset (Set.range_subset_iff.2 hmem))

name: AclGeom.vertical_translation_conjugation
statement:
private theorem vertical_translation_conjugation {m x : K} (lam nu mu : k) (hlam : lam ≠ 0)
    (hA : idealOf k ![algebraMap k K lam * m, x / algebraMap k K lam + algebraMap k K nu] =
      idealOf k ![m, x])
    (hT : idealOf k ![m, x + algebraMap k K mu] = idealOf k ![m, x]) :
    idealOf k ![m, x + algebraMap k K (lam * mu)] = idealOf k ![m, x]
proof:
:= by
  let l : K := algebraMap k K lam
  let n : K := algebraMap k K nu
  let u : K := algebraMap k K mu
  have hl : l ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hlam ((algebraMap k K).injective (h.trans (map_zero _).symm))
  change idealOf k ![l * m, x / l + n] = idealOf k ![m, x] at hA
  change idealOf k ![m, x + u] = idealOf k ![m, x] at hT
  let invA : Fin 2 → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k :=
    ![C lam⁻¹ * X 0, C lam * (X 1 - C nu)]
  let shift : Fin 2 → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k := ![X 0, X 1 + C mu]
  have hi (a b : K) :
      (fun j ↦ aeval ![a, b] (invA j)) = ![a / l, l * (b - n)] := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j
    · simp [invA, l, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
    · simp [invA, l, n]
  have ht (a b : K) : (fun j ↦ aeval ![a, b] (shift j)) = ![a, b + u] := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [shift, u]
  have hc : ![(l * m) / l, l * (x / l + n - n)] = (![m, x] : Fin 2 → K) := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j
    · simp [hl]
    · change l * (x / l + n - n) = x
      rw [add_sub_cancel_right, mul_comm l (x / l), div_mul_cancel₀ x hl]
  have hInv := idealOf_aeval_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq hA invA
  rw [hi, hi, hc] at hInv
  have hShift := idealOf_aeval_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq hA shift
  rw [ht, ht] at hShift
  have he := idealOf_aeval_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq (hShift.trans hT) invA
  rw [hi, hi] at he
  have hcc : ![(l * m) / l, l * (x / l + n + u - n)] =
      (![m, x + l * u] : Fin 2 → K) := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j
    · simp [hl]
    · change l * (x / l + n + u - n) = x + l * u
      have hsum : x / l + n + u - n = x / l + u := by ring
      rw [hsum, mul_add, mul_comm l (x / l), div_mul_cancel₀ x hl]
  rw [hcc] at he
  have hfinal := he.trans hInv.symm
  simpa only [map_mul] using hfinal

name: AclGeom.no_vertical_translation_of_transcendental_scaling
statement:
private theorem no_vertical_translation_of_transcendental_scaling
    {L : IntermediateField k K} {m x : K}
    (hx : x ∈ racl ↥L ({m} : Set K)) (lam nu : ↥L)
    (hLam : Transcendental k (lam : K))
    (hA : idealOf ↥L ![(lam : K) * m, x / (lam : K) + (nu : K)] =
      idealOf ↥L ![m, x]) :
    ∀ mu : ↥L, idealOf ↥L ![m, x + (mu : K)] = idealOf ↥L ![m, x] → mu = 0
proof:
:= by
  let S : Set K := {z | z ∈ L ∧ idealOf ↥L ![m, x + z] = idealOf ↥L ![m, x]}
  have hfibre : {z : K | idealOf ↥L ![m, z] = idealOf ↥L ![m, x]}.Finite :=
    finite_same_fibre_ideals hx
  have hinj : Function.Injective fun z : K ↦ x + z := fun _ _ h ↦ add_left_cancel h
  have htrans : {z : K | idealOf ↥L ![m, x + z] = idealOf ↥L ![m, x]}.Finite :=
    hfibre.preimage hinj.injOn
  have hS : S.Finite := htrans.subset fun _ hz ↦ hz.2
  have hLam0 : lam ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hLam.ne_zero (by rw [h]; rfl)
  have hstable : ∀ z ∈ S, z * (lam : K) ∈ S := by
    intro z hz
    refine ⟨mul_mem hz.1 lam.property, ?_⟩
    have h := vertical_translation_conjugation (k := ↥L) (K := K) lam nu ⟨z, hz.1⟩
      hLam0 hA hz.2
    simp only [map_mul, IntermediateField.algebraMap_apply] at h
    rwa [mul_comm (lam : K) z] at h
  intro mu hmu
  have he : (mu : K) = 0 := finite_stable_under_mul_eq_zero hS hLam hstable ⟨mu.property, hmu⟩
  exact Subtype.ext he

name: AclGeom.affine_locus_commutation_balance
statement:
theorem affine_locus_commutation_balance {L : IntermediateField k K} {m x : K}
    (hx : x ∈ racl ↥L ({m} : Set K)) (lam nu rho omega : ↥L)
    (hLam : Transcendental k (lam : K)) (hrho : rho ≠ 0)
    (hA : idealOf ↥L ![(lam : K) * m, x / (lam : K) + (nu : K)] = idealOf ↥L ![m, x])
    (hB : idealOf ↥L ![(rho : K) * m, x / (rho : K) + (omega : K)] = idealOf ↥L ![m, x]) :
    lam * (rho - 1) * nu = rho * (lam - 1) * omega
proof:
:= by
  have hA0 := hA
  let d : ↥L := nu * (1 - rho⁻¹) - omega * (1 - lam⁻¹)
  let l : K := algebraMap ↥L K lam
  let n : K := algebraMap ↥L K nu
  let r : K := algebraMap ↥L K rho
  let w : K := algebraMap ↥L K omega
  let e : K := algebraMap ↥L K d
  have hl : l ≠ 0 := hLam.ne_zero
  have hr : r ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hrho ((algebraMap ↥L K).injective (h.trans (map_zero _).symm))
  have hlam : lam ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ hl (by simp [l, h])
  change idealOf ↥L ![l * m, x / l + n] = idealOf ↥L ![m, x] at hA
  change idealOf ↥L ![r * m, x / r + w] = idealOf ↥L ![m, x] at hB
  
  let mapA : Fin 2 → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ↥L := ![C lam * X 0, C lam⁻¹ * X 1 + C nu]
  let mapB : Fin 2 → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ↥L := ![C rho * X 0, C rho⁻¹ * X 1 + C omega]
  let shift : Fin 2 → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ↥L := ![X 0, X 1 + C d]
  have hmA (a b : K) : (fun j ↦ aeval ![a, b] (mapA j)) = ![l * a, b / l + n] := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [mapA, l, n, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
  have hmB (a b : K) : (fun j ↦ aeval ![a, b] (mapB j)) = ![r * a, b / r + w] := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [mapB, r, w, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
  have hsh (a b : K) : (fun j ↦ aeval ![a, b] (shift j)) = ![a, b + e] := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [shift, e]
  
  have hAB := idealOf_aeval_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq hB mapA
  rw [hmA, hmA] at hAB
  have hBA := idealOf_aeval_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq hA mapB
  rw [hmB, hmB] at hBA
  have hcoord : ![r * (l * m), (x / l + n) / r + w + e] =
      (![l * (r * m), (x / r + w) / l + n] : Fin 2 → K) := by
    funext j
    fin_cases j
    · change r * (l * m) = l * (r * m)
      ring
    · change (x / l + n) / r + w + e = (x / r + w) / l + n
      have he : e = n * (1 - r⁻¹) - w * (1 - l⁻¹) := by
        simp [e, d, l, n, r, w]
      rw [he]
      field_simp [hl, hr]
      ring
  have hT := idealOf_aeval_comp_eq_of_idealOf_eq (hBA.trans hB) shift
  rw [hsh, hsh, hcoord] at hT
  
  have hTP : idealOf ↥L ![m, x + (d : K)] = idealOf ↥L ![m, x] := hT.symm.trans (hAB.trans hA)
  have hd : nu * (1 - rho⁻¹) - omega * (1 - lam⁻¹) = 0 :=
    no_vertical_translation_of_transcendental_scaling hx lam nu hLam hA0 d hTP
  have h1 : rho * rho⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hrho
  have h2 : lam * lam⁻¹ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hlam
  linear_combination (lam * rho) * hd + (lam * nu) * h1 - (rho * omega) * h2

name: AclGeom.SchemeParameterAction.tensorSchemeAut_hom_base
statement:
private theorem tensorSchemeAut_hom_base
    (g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G) :
    (tensorSchemeAut (R := R) g).hom ≫ Spec.algebraMap A (A ⊗[k] R) =
      Spec.algebraMap A (A ⊗[k] R)
proof:
:= by
  let a : Limits.pullback (Spec.algebraMap k A) (Spec.algebraMap k R) ⟶
      Limits.pullback (Spec.algebraMap k A) (Spec.algebraMap k R) :=
    (ModObj.parameterAct ((Spec (.of R)).asOver (Spec (.of k))) g).left
  have hfst : a ≫ Limits.pullback.fst _ _ = Limits.pullback.fst _ _ :=
    congrArg (fun f :
      (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⊗ (Spec (.of R)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶
        (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ↦ f.left)
          (ModObj.parameterAct_fst ((Spec (.of R)).asOver (Spec (.of k))) g)
  change (pullbackSpecIso k A R).inv ≫ a ≫
    (pullbackSpecIso k A R).hom ≫ Spec.algebraMap A (A ⊗[k] R) = _
  rw [pullbackSpecIso_hom_fst', hfst, pullbackSpecIso_inv_fst']

name: AclGeom.SchemeParameterAction.spec_map_tensorAut
statement:
theorem spec_map_tensorAut (g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (tensorAut (R := R) g).toRingHom) =
      (pullbackSpecIso k A R).inv ≫
        (ModObj.parameterAct ((Spec (.of R)).asOver (Spec (.of k))) g).left ≫
          (pullbackSpecIso k A R).hom
proof:
:= by
  change Spec.map (Spec.preimage (tensorSchemeAut (R := R) g).hom) = _
  exact Spec.map_preimage _

name: AclGeom.SchemeParameterAction.tensorAut_inv
statement:
theorem tensorAut_inv (g : (Spec (.of A)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G) :
    tensorAut (R := R) g⁻¹ = (tensorAut (R := R) g).symm
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rfl

name: AclGeom.CurveBoundary.finite_closed_complement
statement:
theorem finite_closed_complement
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X] [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1) (U : X.Opens) [Nonempty U] :
    ((U : Set X)ᶜ).Finite ∧ ∀ x ∈ ((U : Set X)ᶜ), IsClosed ({x} : Set X)
proof:
:= by
  have hgen : genericPoint X ∈ U :=
    ((genericPoint_spec X).mem_open_set_iff U.isOpen).mpr
      (by simpa using (inferInstance : Nonempty U))
  have hclosed (x : X) (hx : x ∈ ((U : Set X)ᶜ)) : IsClosed ({x} : Set X) :=
    (CurvePointsPlaces.isClosed_singleton_iff_ne_genericPoint X hdim x).mpr
      (fun e ↦ hx (e.symm ▸ hgen))
  have hB : IsClosed ((U : Set X)ᶜ) := U.isOpen.isClosed_compl
  have : QuasiSober ↥((U : Set X)ᶜ) := hB.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal.quasiSober
  have hproper : closure ((U : Set X)ᶜ) ≠ Set.univ := by
    rw [hB.closure_eq]
    intro h
    obtain ⟨x⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty U)
    have hx : x.val ∈ ((U : Set X)ᶜ) := h ▸ Set.mem_univ x.val
    exact hx x.property
  have hf := TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace.finite_coheight_one_of_closure_ne_univ hproper
  have he : Order.krullDim X = topologicalKrullDim X :=
    (Order.krullDim_eq_of_orderIso (irreducibleSetEquivPoints (α := X))).symm
  refine ⟨hf.subset ?_, hclosed⟩
  intro x hx
  refine ⟨hx, le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  · have h := (Order.coheight_le_krullDim x).trans (he.trans hdim).le
    exact_mod_cast h
  · apply Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    intro hz
    have : x = genericPoint X := isMax_iff_eq_top.mp (Order.coheight_eq_zero.mp hz)
    exact hx (this.symm ▸ hgen)

name: AclGeom.CurveBoundary.constant_of_finite_closed_range
statement:
theorem constant_of_finite_closed_range
    {A B : Type*} [TopologicalSpace A] [PreirreducibleSpace A] [TopologicalSpace B]
    (f : A → B) (hf : Continuous f) (S : Set B) (hS : S.Finite)
    (hclosed : ∀ x ∈ S, IsClosed ({x} : Set B)) (hmem : ∀ a, f a ∈ S) :
    ∀ a b, f a = f b
proof:
:= by
  have hr : Set.range f ⊆ S := by
    rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact hmem a
  have hd : IsDiscrete (Set.range f) :=
    (hS.isDiscrete_of_subset_closedPoints (fun x hx ↦ hclosed x hx)).mono hr
  have hi : IsPreirreducible (Set.range f) := by
    simpa only [Set.image_univ] using
      PreirreducibleSpace.isPreirreducible_univ.image f hf.continuousOn
  intro a b
  exact hd.subsingleton_of_isPreirreducible hi ⟨a, rfl⟩ ⟨b, rfl⟩

name: AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.surjective_points_of_surjective
statement:
theorem surjective_points_of_surjective
    {X Y : Over (Spec (.of k))} [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom] (f : X ⟶ Y) [Surjective f.left] :
    Function.Surjective (fun q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ X ↦ q ≫ f)
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  have : JacobsonSpace X.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.jacobsonSpace X.hom
  let y := p.left (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)
  have hy : IsClosed {y} := (GroupScheme.pointsEquivClosedPoints p).property
  have hne : (f.left ⁻¹' ({y} : Set Y.left)).Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := f.left.surjective y
    exact ⟨z, hz⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzc⟩ := nonempty_inter_closedPoints hne
    (hy.preimage f.left.continuous).isLocallyClosed
  have hzc₀ : IsClosed ({z} : Set X.left) := hzc
  let q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ X :=
    Over.homMk (pointOfClosedPoint X.hom z hzc₀) (pointOfClosedPoint_comp X.hom z hzc₀)
  refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  apply ext_of_apply_closedPoint_eq Y.hom (Over.w (q ≫ f)) (Over.w p)
  change f.left (pointOfClosedPoint X.hom z hzc₀ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)) = y
  exact (congrArg f.left
    (pointOfClosedPoint_apply X.hom z hzc₀ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k))).trans hz

name: AclGeom.CurveGlobalCoordinate.transitive_points_of_surjective_orbit
statement:
theorem transitive_points_of_surjective_orbit
    (G : AlgebraicGroup k) (N V : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType N.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom]
    [ModObj G.toGroupScheme.X V] (i : N ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X)
    (p : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ V)
    [Surjective (AdditiveOrbit.orbitMap i p).left]
    (a b : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ V) :
    ∃ q : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X,
      a ≫ ModObj.pointAct V q = b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := surjective_points_of_surjective (AdditiveOrbit.orbitMap i p) a
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := surjective_points_of_surjective (AdditiveOrbit.orbitMap i p) b
  change r ≫ AdditiveOrbit.orbitMap i p = a at hr
  change s ≫ AdditiveOrbit.orbitMap i p = b at hs
  refine ⟨(s ≫ i) * (r ≫ i)⁻¹, ?_⟩
  rw [← hr, ← hs, AdditiveOrbit.point_comp_orbitMap, AdditiveOrbit.point_comp_orbitMap,
    Category.assoc, ← ModObj.pointAct_mul]
  congr 2
  rw [_root_.mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, _root_.mul_one]

name: AclGeom.AffineDilation.standard_conjugation
statement:
theorem standard_conjugation :
    (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k).toGroupScheme.X ◁ AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k ≫
        conj (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k).toGroupScheme.X =
      (lift (fst (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k).toGroupScheme.X
          (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X ≫ projection k)
        (snd (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k).toGroupScheme.X
          (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X) ≫
          AdditiveRigidity.scalarMul k) ≫ AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k
proof:
:= by
  let A := (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k).toGroupScheme.X
  let L := (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1).toGroupScheme.X
  let EA := AffineGroupScheme.pointsMulEquiv k
  let EM := multiplicativeGroup.pointsMulEquiv k
  have : IsIntegral L.left := by
    change IsIntegral (Spec (.of (AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1)))
    infer_instance
  have : IsIntegral A.left := by
    change IsIntegral (Spec (.of (AffineGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k)))
    infer_instance
  have : IsIntegral (A ⊗ L).left := isIntegral_pullback_of_isAlgClosed A.hom L.hom
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType (A ⊗ L).hom := by
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (Limits.pullback.fst A.hom L.hom ≫ A.hom)
    infer_instance
  apply AdditiveRigidity.over_hom_ext_of_points
  intro p
  let q := p ≫ fst A L
  let n := p ≫ snd A L
  let a := EA q
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := AffineSchemeAction.exists_linePoint k ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).inv ≫ n)
  have hn : n = (unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫ AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k x := by
    rw [hx, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  have hp : lift q n = p := by
    apply CartesianMonoidalCategory.hom_ext
    · exact lift_fst q n
    · exact lift_snd q n
  have hleft : p ≫ (A ◁ AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k ≫ conj A) =
      EA.symm (AffineTransformation.translation ((a.multiplier : k) * x)) := by
    calc
      _ = lift q n ≫ A ◁ AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k ≫ conj A :=
        congrArg (fun z ↦ z ≫ (A ◁ AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k ≫ conj A)) hp.symm
      _ = q * (n ≫ AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k) * q⁻¹ := by
        rw [lift_whiskerLeft_assoc, lift_conj_eq_mul_mul_inv]
      _ = _ := by
        rw [hn, NormalTranslation.point_inclusion]
        apply EA.injective
        rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_inv, MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
          MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
        exact AffineTransformation.mul_translation_mul_inv (EA q) x
  have hright : p ≫ ((lift (fst A L ≫ projection k) (snd A L) ≫
        AdditiveRigidity.scalarMul k) ≫ AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k) =
      EA.symm (AffineTransformation.translation ((a.multiplier : k) * x)) := by
    calc
      _ = (lift (q ≫ projection k) n ≫ AdditiveRigidity.scalarMul k) ≫
          AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k := by
        simp only [q, n, Category.assoc, comp_lift_assoc]
      _ = ((unitIsoSpecAsOver k).hom ≫
          AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k ((a.multiplier : k) * x)) ≫
            AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k := by
        have hproj : q ≫ projection k = EM.symm a.multiplier := point_comp_projection k q
        rw [hproj, hn, ← AdditiveRigidity.unitPoint_eq_points,
          ← comp_lift_assoc, AdditiveRigidity.unitPoint_linePoint_scalarMul]
      _ = _ := NormalTranslation.point_inclusion ((a.multiplier : k) * x)
  exact hleft.trans hright.symm

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.conjugate_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem conjugate_apply (eX : X ≃+* X') (eY : Y ≃+* Y')
    (f : X ≃+* Y) (x : X') :
    conjugate eX eY f x = eY (f (eX.symm x))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.conjugate_refl
statement:
@[simp] theorem conjugate_refl (eX : X ≃+* X') :
    conjugate eX eX (RingEquiv.refl X) = RingEquiv.refl X'
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [conjugate]

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.conjugate_trans
statement:
theorem conjugate_trans (eX : X ≃+* X') (eY : Y ≃+* Y')
    (eZ : Z ≃+* Z') (f : X ≃+* Y) (g : Y ≃+* Z) :
    (conjugate eX eY f).trans (conjugate eY eZ g) =
      conjugate eX eZ (f.trans g)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [conjugate]

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.conjugate_symm
statement:
@[simp] theorem conjugate_symm (eX : X ≃+* X') (eY : Y ≃+* Y')
    (f : X ≃+* Y) :
    (conjugate eX eY f).symm = conjugate eY eX f.symm
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  simp [conjugate]

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.conjugate_injective
statement:
theorem conjugate_injective (eX : X ≃+* X') (eY : Y ≃+* Y') :
    Function.Injective (conjugate eX eY : (X ≃+* Y) → (X' ≃+* Y'))
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h
  ext x
  have hx := congrArg (fun F : X' ≃+* Y' ↦ eY.symm (F (eX x))) h
  simpa [conjugate] using hx

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.conjugate_eq_iff
statement:
theorem conjugate_eq_iff (eX : X ≃+* X') (eY : Y ≃+* Y')
    (f g : X ≃+* Y) :
    conjugate eX eY f = conjugate eX eY g ↔ f = g
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ conjugate_injective eX eY h,
    congrArg (conjugate eX eY)⟩

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.eq_trans_symm_of_trans_eq
statement:
theorem eq_trans_symm_of_trans_eq (f g : X ≃+* Y) (d : Y ≃+* Y)
    (h : f.trans d = g) : f = g.trans d.symm
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  have hx := congrArg (fun e : X ≃+* Y ↦ e x) h
  change d (f x) = g x at hx
  change f x = d.symm (g x)
  rw [← hx]
  simp

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.CompositionTriangle.inducedMiddleChart_left_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem inducedMiddleChart_left_apply (eX : X ≃+* X') (x : X) :
    T.inducedMiddleChart eX (T.left x) = eX x
proof:
:= by
  simp [inducedMiddleChart]

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.CompositionTriangle.inducedTargetChart_direct_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem inducedTargetChart_direct_apply (eX : X ≃+* X') (x : X) :
    T.inducedTargetChart eX (T.direct x) = eX x
proof:
:= by
  simp [inducedTargetChart]

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.CompositionTriangle.inducedMiddleChart_algebraMap
statement:
theorem inducedMiddleChart_algebraMap
    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F X] [Algebra F Y] [Algebra F X']
    (eX : X ≃+* X')
    (heX : ∀ c : F, eX (algebraMap F X c) = algebraMap F X' c)
    (hleft : ∀ c : F, T.left (algebraMap F X c) = algebraMap F Y c)
    (c : F) :
    T.inducedMiddleChart eX (algebraMap F Y c) =
      algebraMap F X' c
proof:
:= by
  have hs : T.left.symm (algebraMap F Y c) = algebraMap F X c := by
    apply T.left.injective
    rw [T.left.apply_symm_apply, hleft]
  rw [inducedMiddleChart, RingEquiv.trans_apply, hs, heX]

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.CompositionTriangle.inducedTargetChart_algebraMap
statement:
theorem inducedTargetChart_algebraMap
    {F : Type u} [Field F] [Algebra F X] [Algebra F Z] [Algebra F X']
    (eX : X ≃+* X')
    (heX : ∀ c : F, eX (algebraMap F X c) = algebraMap F X' c)
    (hdirect : ∀ c : F, T.direct (algebraMap F X c) = algebraMap F Z c)
    (c : F) :
    T.inducedTargetChart eX (algebraMap F Z c) =
      algebraMap F X' c
proof:
:= by
  have hs : T.direct.symm (algebraMap F Z c) = algebraMap F X c := by
    apply T.direct.injective
    rw [T.direct.apply_symm_apply, hdirect]
  rw [inducedTargetChart, RingEquiv.trans_apply, hs, heX]

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.CompositionTriangle.conjugate_induced_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem conjugate_induced_left (eX : X ≃+* X') :
    (T.conjugate eX (T.inducedMiddleChart eX)
      (T.inducedTargetChart eX)).left = RingEquiv.refl X'
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [conjugate, inducedMiddleChart]

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.CompositionTriangle.conjugate_induced_direct
statement:
@[simp] theorem conjugate_induced_direct (eX : X ≃+* X') :
    (T.conjugate eX (T.inducedMiddleChart eX)
      (T.inducedTargetChart eX)).direct = RingEquiv.refl X'
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [conjugate, inducedTargetChart]

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.CompositionTriangle.conjugate_induced_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem conjugate_induced_right (eX : X ≃+* X') :
    (T.conjugate eX (T.inducedMiddleChart eX)
      (T.inducedTargetChart eX)).right = RingEquiv.refl X'
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change eX (T.direct.symm (T.right (T.left (eX.symm x)))) = x
  calc
    _ = eX (T.direct.symm
        ((T.left.trans T.right) (eX.symm x))) := rfl
    _ = eX (T.direct.symm (T.direct (eX.symm x))) := by
      rw [T.composition]
    _ = x := by simp

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.CompositionTriangle.conjugate_inducedMiddle_trans_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem conjugate_inducedMiddle_trans_left
    (eX : X ≃+* X') (left' : X' ≃+* Y') (direct' : X' ≃+* Z') :
    (T.conjugate eX ((T.inducedMiddleChart eX).trans left')
      ((T.inducedTargetChart eX).trans direct')).left = left'
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [conjugate, inducedMiddleChart]

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.CompositionTriangle.conjugate_inducedTarget_trans_direct
statement:
@[simp] theorem conjugate_inducedTarget_trans_direct
    (eX : X ≃+* X') (left' : X' ≃+* Y') (direct' : X' ≃+* Z') :
    (T.conjugate eX ((T.inducedMiddleChart eX).trans left')
      ((T.inducedTargetChart eX).trans direct')).direct = direct'
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [conjugate, inducedTargetChart]

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.CompositionTriangle.conjugate_induced_trans_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem conjugate_induced_trans_right
    (eX : X ≃+* X') (left' : X' ≃+* Y') (direct' : X' ≃+* Z') :
    (T.conjugate eX ((T.inducedMiddleChart eX).trans left')
      ((T.inducedTargetChart eX).trans direct')).right =
        left'.symm.trans direct'
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  change direct' (eX (T.direct.symm
      (T.right (T.left (eX.symm (left'.symm y)))))) =
    direct' (left'.symm y)
  have hcomp := DFunLike.congr_fun T.composition
    (eX.symm (left'.symm y))
  change T.right (T.left (eX.symm (left'.symm y))) =
    T.direct (eX.symm (left'.symm y)) at hcomp
  rw [hcomp]
  simp

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.CompositionTriangle.direct_comp_of_left_right
statement:
theorem direct_comp_of_left_right
    {F : Type u} [Semiring F]
    (source : F →+* X) (middle : F →+* Y) (target : F →+* Z)
    (hleft : T.left.toRingHom.comp source = middle)
    (hright : T.right.toRingHom.comp middle = target) :
    T.direct.toRingHom.comp source = target
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro x
  have hcomp := DFunLike.congr_fun T.composition (source x)
  have hl := DFunLike.congr_fun hleft x
  have hr := DFunLike.congr_fun hright x
  change T.right (T.left (source x)) = T.direct (source x) at hcomp
  change T.left (source x) = middle x at hl
  change T.right (middle x) = target x at hr
  exact hcomp.symm.trans ((congrArg T.right hl).trans hr)

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.FourTriangleReference.ofCommonLeftDirect_toFourArrowDiagram
statement:
theorem ofCommonLeftDirect_toFourArrowDiagram
    (se : CompositionTriangle Xse Yse Zse)
    (sAa : CompositionTriangle Xsa Ysa Zsa)
    (sb : CompositionTriangle Xsb Ysb Zsb)
    (sAc : CompositionTriangle Xsc Ysc Zsc)
    (seX : Xse ≃+* X) (sAaX : Xsa ≃+* X)
    (sbX : Xsb ≃+* X) (sAcX : Xsc ≃+* X)
    (leftS leftSA : X ≃+* Y)
    (directU directUB : X ≃+* Z) :
    let A
proof:
:= ofCommonLeftDirect se sAa sb sAc
      seX sAaX sbX sAcX leftS leftSA directU directUB
    A.toFourArrowDiagram.leftS = leftS ∧
      A.toFourArrowDiagram.leftSA = leftSA ∧
      A.toFourArrowDiagram.rightE = leftS.symm.trans directU ∧
      A.toFourArrowDiagram.rightA = leftSA.symm.trans directU ∧
      A.toFourArrowDiagram.rightB = leftS.symm.trans directUB ∧
      A.toFourArrowDiagram.rightC = leftSA.symm.trans directUB ∧
      A.toFourArrowDiagram.compositeU = directU ∧
      A.toFourArrowDiagram.compositeUB = directUB := by
  dsimp only [toFourArrowDiagram]
  simp [ofCommonLeftDirect]

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.FourTriangleReference.ofSourceCharts_right_arrows_eq_refl
statement:
theorem ofSourceCharts_right_arrows_eq_refl
    (se : CompositionTriangle Xse Yse Zse)
    (sAa : CompositionTriangle Xsa Ysa Zsa)
    (sb : CompositionTriangle Xsb Ysb Zsb)
    (sAc : CompositionTriangle Xsc Ysc Zsc)
    (seX : Xse ≃+* X) (sAaX : Xsa ≃+* X)
    (sbX : Xsb ≃+* X) (sAcX : Xsc ≃+* X) :
    let A
proof:
:= FourTriangleReference.ofSourceCharts
      se sAa sb sAc seX sAaX sbX sAcX
    A.toFourArrowDiagram.rightE = RingEquiv.refl X ∧
      A.toFourArrowDiagram.rightA = RingEquiv.refl X ∧
      A.toFourArrowDiagram.rightB = RingEquiv.refl X ∧
      A.toFourArrowDiagram.rightC = RingEquiv.refl X := by
  dsimp only [toFourArrowDiagram]
  exact ⟨se.conjugate_induced_right seX,
    sAa.conjugate_induced_right sAaX,
    sb.conjugate_induced_right sbX,
    sAc.conjugate_induced_right sAcX⟩

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.FourTriangleReference.toFourArrowDiagram_rightE_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem toFourArrowDiagram_rightE_apply (y : Yse) :
    R.toFourArrowDiagram.rightE (R.seY y) =

@[simp] theorem toFourArrowDiagram_rightA_apply (y : Ysa) :
