name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.FourArrowDiagram.conjugate_rightC
statement:
@[simp] theorem conjugate_rightC
    (eX : X ≃+* X') (eY : Y ≃+* Y') (eZ : Z ≃+* Z') :
    (D.conjugate eX eY eZ).rightC =
      FieldEquiv.conjugate eY eZ D.rightC
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.FourArrowDiagram.right_cancellation
statement:
theorem right_cancellation :
    D.rightC = (D.rightA.trans D.rightE.symm).trans D.rightB
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  let x := D.leftSA.symm y
  have hsc := congrArg (fun f : X ≃+* Z ↦ f x) D.sA_c_uB
  have hsb := congrArg (fun f : X ≃+* Z ↦ f x) D.s_b_uB
  have hsa := congrArg (fun f : X ≃+* Z ↦ f x) D.sA_a_u
  have hse := congrArg (fun f : X ≃+* Z ↦ f x) D.se_u
  change D.rightC (D.leftSA x) = D.compositeUB x at hsc
  change D.rightB (D.leftS x) = D.compositeUB x at hsb
  change D.rightA (D.leftSA x) = D.compositeU x at hsa
  change D.rightE (D.leftS x) = D.compositeU x at hse
  change D.rightC y = D.rightB (D.rightE.symm (D.rightA y))
  calc
    D.rightC y = D.rightC (D.leftSA x) := by simp [x]
    _ = D.compositeUB x := hsc
    _ = D.rightB (D.leftS x) := hsb.symm
    _ = D.rightB (D.rightE.symm (D.rightE (D.leftS x))) := by simp
    _ = D.rightB (D.rightE.symm (D.compositeU x)) := by rw [hse]
    _ = D.rightB (D.rightE.symm (D.rightA (D.leftSA x))) := by rw [hsa]
    _ = D.rightB (D.rightE.symm (D.rightA y)) := by simp [x]

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.FourArrowDiagram.RightRestriction.mapC_factorization
statement:
theorem mapC_factorization :
    C.mapC = D.rightB.toRingHom.comp
      (D.rightE.symm.toRingHom.comp C.mapA)
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro z
  calc
    C.mapC z = D.rightC (C.middle z) :=
      (DFunLike.congr_fun C.rightC z).symm
    _ = D.rightB (D.rightE.symm (D.rightA (C.middle z))) :=
      DFunLike.congr_fun D.right_cancellation (C.middle z)
    _ = D.rightB (D.rightE.symm (C.mapA z)) := by
      have hz := DFunLike.congr_fun C.rightA z
      change D.rightA (C.middle z) = C.mapA z at hz
      rw [hz]

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.FourArrowDiagram.right_cancellation_apply
statement:
theorem right_cancellation_apply (y : Y) :
    D.rightC y = D.rightB (D.rightE.symm (D.rightA y))
proof:
:= by
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun D.right_cancellation y

name: AclGeom.FieldEquiv.FourArrowDiagram.conjugate_right_cancellation
statement:
theorem conjugate_right_cancellation
    (eX : X ≃+* X') (eY : Y ≃+* Y') (eZ : Z ≃+* Z') :
    (D.conjugate eX eY eZ).rightC =
      (((D.conjugate eX eY eZ).rightA.trans
        (D.conjugate eX eY eZ).rightE.symm).trans
          (D.conjugate eX eY eZ).rightB)
proof:
:=
  (D.conjugate eX eY eZ).right_cancellation

name: AclGeom.NormalCoordinateConjugation.exists_character
statement:
theorem exists_character
    (G N : AlgebraicGroup k) (i : N.Hom G) [IsMonHom.Normal i.hom.hom]
    (f : G.Hom (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k)) [Surjective f.hom.hom.left]
    (β : N.Hom (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k 1))
    (hfactor : β.hom.hom ≫ AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k = i.hom.hom ≫ f.hom.hom) :
    ∃ χ : G.Hom (multiplicativeGroup k), Surjective χ.hom.hom.left ∧
      χ.hom.hom = f.hom.hom ≫ AffineDilation.projection k ∧
      ∃ ψ : G.toGroupScheme.X ⊗ N.toGroupScheme.X ⟶ N.toGroupScheme.X,
        ψ ≫ i.hom.hom = G.toGroupScheme.X ◁ i.hom.hom ≫ conj G.toGroupScheme.X ∧
        ψ ≫ β.hom.hom = lift
          (fst G.toGroupScheme.X N.toGroupScheme.X ≫ χ.hom.hom)
          (snd G.toGroupScheme.X N.toGroupScheme.X ≫ β.hom.hom) ≫
            AdditiveRigidity.scalarMul k ∧
        ∀ (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
          (q : (Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ G.toGroupScheme.X)
          (n : (Spec (.of C)).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ N.toGroupScheme.X)
          (a : Cˣ) (b : C),
          q ≫ χ.hom.hom = AdditiveRigidity.unitPoint k a →
          n ≫ β.hom.hom = AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k b →
          (lift q n ≫ ψ) ≫ β.hom.hom =
            AffineSchemeAction.linePoint k ((a : C) * b)
proof:
:= by
  let χ : G.Hom (multiplicativeGroup k) := f ≫ AffineDilation.character k
  have hχ : χ.hom.hom = f.hom.hom ≫ AffineDilation.projection k := rfl
  have hχsurj : Surjective χ.hom.hom.left := by
    rw [hχ]
    have : Surjective (AffineDilation.projection k).left :=
      AffineDilation.projection_surjective k
    change Surjective (f.hom.hom.left ≫ (AffineDilation.projection k).left)
    infer_instance
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := IsMonHom.Normal.exists_comp_eq_conj (φ := i.hom.hom)
  have hψ' : ψ ≫ i.hom.hom = G.toGroupScheme.X ◁ i.hom.hom ≫
      conj G.toGroupScheme.X := hψ
  have hdiagram : ψ ≫ β.hom.hom = lift
      (fst G.toGroupScheme.X N.toGroupScheme.X ≫ χ.hom.hom)
      (snd G.toGroupScheme.X N.toGroupScheme.X ≫ β.hom.hom) ≫
        AdditiveRigidity.scalarMul k := by
    apply (cancel_mono (AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k)).mp
    calc
      _ = (f.hom.hom ⊗ₘ β.hom.hom) ≫
          (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k).toGroupScheme.X ◁
            AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k ≫
            conj (AffineGroupScheme.algebraicGroup k).toGroupScheme.X :=
        factor_conjugation i.hom.hom (AdditiveTranslation.inclusion k)
          f.hom.hom β.hom.hom ψ hfactor hψ'
      _ = _ := by
        rw [AffineDilation.standard_conjugation]
        simp only [Category.assoc, comp_lift_assoc, tensorHom_fst_assoc,
          tensorHom_snd, hχ]
  refine ⟨χ, hχsurj, hχ, ψ, hψ', hdiagram, ?_⟩
  intro C _ _ q n a b hqa hnb
  rw [Category.assoc, hdiagram, comp_lift_assoc, lift_fst_assoc, lift_snd_assoc,
    hqa, hnb, AdditiveRigidity.unitPoint_linePoint_scalarMul]

name: AclGeom.AffineGroupScheme.dilationUnit_val
statement:
theorem dilationUnit_val (k : Type u) [Field k] :
    (dilationUnit k : CoordinateRing k) = includeDilation k (AddMonoidAlgebra.single 1 1)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: AclGeom.AffineGroupScheme.eval_includeDilation
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_includeDilation {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Type v} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
    (a : Cˣ) (b : C) (f : AddMonoidAlgebra k ℤ) :
    eval k a b (includeDilation k f) = (unitsMulEquivConv k C).symm a f
proof:
:= by
  change (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift _ _ _) (f ⊗ₜ[k] 1) = _
  simp

name: AclGeom.AffineGroupScheme.eval_includeTranslation
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_includeTranslation {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Type v} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
    (a : Cˣ) (b : C) (f : AdditiveGroupScheme.CoordinateRing k 1) :
    eval k a b (includeTranslation k f) =
      (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraCoordinates k 1 C).symm (fun _ ↦ b) f
proof:
:= by
  change (Algebra.TensorProduct.lift _ _ _) (1 ⊗ₜ[k] f) = _
  simp

name: AclGeom.AffineGroupScheme.eval_dilation
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_dilation {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Type v} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
    (a : Cˣ) (b : C) : eval k a b (dilationUnit k) = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [dilationUnit_val, eval_includeDilation, unitsMulEquivConv_symm_apply_single]

name: AclGeom.AffineGroupScheme.eval_translation
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_translation {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Type v} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
    (a : Cˣ) (b : C) : eval k a b (translation k) = b
proof:
:= by
  change eval k a b (includeTranslation k _) = b
  rw [eval_includeTranslation]
  exact AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraCoordinates_symm_apply_ι (fun _ ↦ b) 0

name: AclGeom.AffineGroupScheme.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Type v} [CommRing C] [Algebra k C]
    {f g : CoordinateRing k →ₐ[k] C}
    (ha : f (dilationUnit k) = g (dilationUnit k))
    (hb : f (translation k) = g (translation k)) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply Algebra.TensorProduct.ext
  · apply WithConv.toConv_injective
    apply (unitsMulEquivConv k C).injective
    apply Units.ext
    change f (dilationUnit k) = g (dilationUnit k)
    exact ha
  · apply (AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraCoordinates k 1 C).injective
    ext i
    rw [AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraCoordinates_apply,
      AdditiveGroupScheme.algebraCoordinates_apply]
    have hi : i = (0 : Fin 1) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst i
    exact hb

name: AclGeom.FiniteGaCover.isPurelyInseparable_of_universallyInjective
statement:
theorem isPurelyInseparable_of_universallyInjective
    {R A K L : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Field K] [Field L]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra A L] [IsFractionRing A L]
    [Algebra R K] [Algebra R L] [Algebra K L]
    [IsScalarTower R A L] [IsScalarTower R K L]
    [UniversallyInjective (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)))] :
    IsPurelyInseparable K L
proof:
:= by
  apply (isPurelyInseparable_iff_subsingleton_emb K L).mpr
  constructor
  intro φ ψ
  let φA : A →+* AlgebraicClosure L := φ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap A L)
  let ψA : A →+* AlgebraicClosure L := ψ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap A L)
  have hR : φA.comp (algebraMap R A) = ψA.comp (algebraMap R A) := by
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro r
    change φ (algebraMap A L (algebraMap R A r)) =
      ψ (algebraMap A L (algebraMap R A r))
    rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R A L, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R K L,
      φ.commutes, ψ.commutes]
  have hp : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φA) = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψA) := by
    have hinj := ((tfae_universallyInjective
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)))).out 1 2).mp
      (inferInstance : UniversallyInjective (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))))
    apply hinj (AlgebraicClosure L)
    change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φA) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψA) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))
    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← Spec.map_comp]
    exact congrArg Spec.map (CommRingCat.hom_ext hR)
  have hA : φA = ψA := congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (Spec.map_injective hp)
  apply AlgHom.coe_ringHom_injective
  apply IsFractionRing.ringHom_ext (A := A)
  intro a
  exact congrArg (fun f : A →+* AlgebraicClosure L ↦ f a) hA

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.chart_model_maps_eq_of_fraction_field
statement:
theorem chart_model_maps_eq_of_fraction_field (t : F) (ht : t ≠ 0)
    {O K : Type u} [CommRing O] [Field K] [Algebra O K] [IsFractionRing O K]
    (b c : Bool) (q : Spec (.of O) ⟶ chart (k := k) t b)
    (r : Spec (.of O) ⟶ chart (k := k) t c)
    (h : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap O K)) ≫
        (q ≫ (atlas (k := k) t ht).ι ⟨b⟩) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap O K)) ≫
        (r ≫ (atlas (k := k) t ht).ι ⟨c⟩)) :
    q ≫ (atlas (k := k) t ht).ι ⟨b⟩ = r ≫ (atlas (k := k) t ht).ι ⟨c⟩
proof:
:= by
  let δ := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap O K))
  by_cases hbc : b = c
  · subst c
    have hqr : q = r := by
      apply affine_hom_eq_of_fraction_field (K := K)
      apply (cancel_mono ((atlas (k := k) t ht).ι ⟨b⟩)).mp
      simpa only [Category.assoc] using h
    rw [hqr]
  · have hc : c = !b := by cases b <;> cases c <;> simp_all
    subst c
    let H := overlap_isPullback (k := k) t ht b
    have he : (δ ≫ q) ≫ (atlas (k := k) t ht).ι ⟨b⟩ =
        (δ ≫ r) ≫ (atlas (k := k) t ht).ι ⟨!b⟩ := by
      simpa only [Category.assoc, δ] using h
    let z := H.lift (δ ≫ q) (δ ≫ r) he
    have hzq : z ≫ overlapToChart (k := k) t b = δ ≫ q := H.lift_fst _ _ _
    have hzr : z ≫ overlapToChart (k := k) t (!b) = δ ≫ r := H.lift_snd _ _ _
    let ρ : normalizedOverlap (k := k) t →+* K := (Spec.preimage z).hom
    let a : O := (Spec.preimage q).hom (chartParameter t b)
    let d : O := (Spec.preimage r).hom (chartParameter t (!b))
    have hqring : ρ.comp (chartToOverlap t b) =
        (algebraMap O K).comp (Spec.preimage q).hom := by
      have hx := congrArg Spec.preimage hzq
      rw [← chart_overlap_spec, Spec.preimage_comp, Spec.preimage_comp,
        Spec.preimage_map] at hx
      dsimp only [δ] at hx
      rw [Spec.preimage_map] at hx
      exact congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom hx
    have hrring : ρ.comp (chartToOverlap t (!b)) =
        (algebraMap O K).comp (Spec.preimage r).hom := by
      have hx := congrArg Spec.preimage hzr
      rw [← chart_overlap_spec, Spec.preimage_comp, Spec.preimage_comp,
        Spec.preimage_map] at hx
      dsimp only [δ] at hx
      rw [Spec.preimage_map] at hx
      exact congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom hx
    have had : a * d = 1 := by
      apply IsFractionRing.injective O K
      have hp := congrArg ρ (chart_parameters_mul (k := k) t ht b)
      rw [map_mul, map_one] at hp
      have hqa := RingHom.congr_fun hqring (chartParameter t b)
      have hrd := RingHom.congr_fun hrring (chartParameter t (!b))
      change ρ (chartToOverlap t b (chartParameter t b)) = algebraMap O K a at hqa
      change ρ (chartToOverlap t (!b) (chartParameter t (!b))) = algebraMap O K d at hrd
      rw [map_mul, map_one, ← hqa, ← hrd]
      exact hp
    obtain ⟨θ, hθ⟩ := exists_chart_overlap_lift_of_isUnit t ht b (Spec.preimage q).hom
      (IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one d had)
    let w := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom θ)
    have hwq : w ≫ overlapToChart (k := k) t b = q := by
      rw [← chart_overlap_spec]
      dsimp only [w]
      rw [← Spec.map_comp]
      change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (θ.comp (chartToOverlap t b))) = q
      rw [hθ]
      exact Spec.map_preimage q
    have hzw : δ ≫ w = z := by
      have : Mono (overlapToChart (k := k) t b) := by
        have := overlapToChart_isOpenImmersion (k := k) t ht b
        infer_instance
      apply (cancel_mono (overlapToChart (k := k) t b)).mp
      rw [Category.assoc, hwq, hzq]
    have hwr : w ≫ overlapToChart (k := k) t (!b) = r := by
      apply affine_hom_eq_of_fraction_field (K := K)
      change δ ≫ _ = δ ≫ r
      rw [← Category.assoc, hzw, hzr]
    rw [← hwq, Category.assoc, overlap_glue_condition_bool,
      ← Category.assoc, hwr]

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.modelHom_valuative_uniqueness
statement:
theorem modelHom_valuative_uniqueness (t : F) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    ValuativeCriterion.Uniqueness (modelHom (k := k) t ht)
proof:
:= by
  intro S
  refine ⟨fun f g ↦ ?_⟩
  apply CommSq.LiftStruct.ext
  obtain ⟨⟨b⟩, q, hq⟩ := exists_chart_factor t ht S.R f.l
  obtain ⟨⟨c⟩, r, hr⟩ := exists_chart_factor t ht S.R g.l
  rw [← hq, ← hr]
  apply chart_model_maps_eq_of_fraction_field (K := S.K) t ht b c
  rw [hq, hr, f.fac_left, g.fac_left]

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.separating_inverse
statement:
theorem separating_inverse (t : F) (htr : Transcendental k t)
    [FiniteDimensional (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F] :
    Transcendental k t⁻¹ ∧
      FiniteDimensional (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t⁻¹} : Set F)) F ∧
      Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t⁻¹} : Set F)) F
proof:
:= by
  have he := adjoin_inv_eq (k := k) t
  exact ⟨(fun h ↦ htr (IsAlgebraic.inv_iff.mp h)),
    (congrArg (fun E : IntermediateField k F ↦ FiniteDimensional E F) he).mpr inferInstance,
    (congrArg (fun E : IntermediateField k F ↦ Algebra.IsSeparable E F) he).mpr inferInstance⟩

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.chartBaseHom_locallyOfFiniteType
statement:
theorem chartBaseHom_locallyOfFiniteType (t : F) (htr : Transcendental k t)
    [FiniteDimensional (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F] (b : Bool) :
    LocallyOfFiniteType (chartBaseHom (k := k) t b)
proof:
:= by
  have hinv := separating_inverse t htr
  have := hinv.2.1
  have := hinv.2.2
  cases b
  · let := normalizedBaseAlgebra (k := k) t
    have : Algebra.FiniteType k (normalizedRing (k := k) t) :=
      (normalizedRing_properties t htr).2.2.2
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (Spec.map
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (normalizedRing (k := k) t))))
    rw [HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @LocallyOfFiniteType)]
    exact RingHom.finiteType_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance
  · let := normalizedBaseAlgebra (k := k) t⁻¹
    have : Algebra.FiniteType k (normalizedRing (k := k) t⁻¹) :=
      (normalizedRing_properties t⁻¹ hinv.1).2.2.2
    change LocallyOfFiniteType (Spec.map
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (normalizedRing (k := k) t⁻¹))))
    rw [HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @LocallyOfFiniteType)]
    exact RingHom.finiteType_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.modelHom_locallyOfFiniteType
statement:
theorem modelHom_locallyOfFiniteType (t : F) (ht : t ≠ 0) (htr : Transcendental k t)
    [FiniteDimensional (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F] :
    LocallyOfFiniteType (modelHom (k := k) t ht)
proof:
:= by
  let : ∀ i : ULift.{u} Bool, IsOpenImmersion (overlapToChart (k := k) t i.down) :=
    fun i ↦ overlapToChart_isOpenImmersion t ht i.down
  let : ∀ i : ULift.{u} Bool, LocallyOfFiniteType (chartBaseHom (k := k) t i.down) :=
    fun i ↦ chartBaseHom_locallyOfFiniteType t htr i.down
  exact WeilGluing.commonOverlapToBase_locallyOfFiniteType
    (fun i : ULift.{u} Bool ↦ chart (k := k) t i.down)
    (Spec (.of (normalizedOverlap (k := k) t))) (fun i ↦ overlapToChart (k := k) t i.down)
    (fun i ↦ chartBaseHom (k := k) t i.down) (overlapBaseHom (k := k) t)
    (fun i ↦ overlap_chart_base_comm (k := k) t i.down)

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.exists_model_functionField_equiv
statement:
theorem exists_model_functionField_equiv (t : F) (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (htr : Transcendental k t)
    [FiniteDimensional (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F] :
    letI : Algebra k (model (k := k) t ht).functionField
proof:
:=
      @ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAlgebra k _ (curve (k := k) t ht)
        (model_integral t ht)
    Nonempty ((model (k := k) t ht).functionField ≃ₐ[k] F) := by
  let A : CommRingCat.{u} := .of (normalizedRing (k := k) t)
  let : Algebra k A := normalizedBaseAlgebra (k := k) t
  let U := (Spec A).asOver (Spec (.of k))
  let M := curve (k := k) t ht
  have : IsIntegral U.left := inferInstanceAs (IsIntegral (Spec A))
  have : IsIntegral M.left := model_integral t ht
  let : Algebra A U.left.functionField := instAlgebraCarrierFunctionFieldSpec A
  have : IsFractionRing A U.left.functionField := functionField_isFractionRing_of_affine A
  let : Algebra k U.left.functionField := ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAlgebra U
  let : Algebra k M.left.functionField := ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAlgebra M
  let j : U ⟶ M := Over.homMk ((atlas (k := k) t ht).ι ⟨false⟩)
    (chart_modelHom t ht ⟨false⟩)
  have : IsOpenImmersion j.left := (atlas (k := k) t ht).ι_isOpenImmersion ⟨false⟩
  have : IsDominant j.left :=
    ⟨(IsOpenImmersion.isOpen_range j.left).dense (Set.range_nonempty j.left)⟩
  have : IsIso j.left.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap :=
    CurveCoordinateCover.isIso_functionFieldMap_of_isOpenImmersion j.left
  let Ej : M.left.functionField ≃ₐ[k] U.left.functionField :=
    AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv
      (f := (asIso j.left.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv)
      (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldMap_algebraMap j)
  have : IsFractionRing A F := (normalizedRing_properties t htr).2.2.1
  have : IsScalarTower k A F := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have : IsScalarTower k A U.left.functionField :=
    CurveCoordinateCover.spec_functionField_isScalarTower k A
  let EA : U.left.functionField ≃ₐ[k] F :=
    IsFractionRing.algEquivOfAlgEquiv (AlgEquiv.refl : A ≃ₐ[k] A)
  exact ⟨Ej.trans EA⟩

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.overlap_parameters_mul
statement:
theorem overlap_parameters_mul (t : F) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    normalizedToOverlap (k := k) t (normalizedParameter t) *
      inverseNormalizedToOverlap (k := k) t (normalizedParameter t⁻¹) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact mul_inv_cancel₀ ht

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.isOpenImmersion_of_target_valuation
statement:
theorem isOpenImmersion_of_target_valuation
    (X Y : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left] [IsIntegral Y.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [X.left.IsSeparated] [Y.left.IsSeparated]
    (hval : ∀ y : Y.left, ValuationRing (Y.left.presheaf.stalk y))
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsDominant f.left]
    [IsIso f.left.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap] : IsOpenImmersion f.left
proof:
:= by
  have hstalk (x : X.left) : IsIso (f.left.stalkMap x) := by
    have := hval (f.left x)
    exact stalkMap_isIso_of_target_valuation f.left x
  let Fmap := f.left.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap
  let A : Y.left.functionField ≃ₐ[k] X.left.functionField :=
    AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := (asIso Fmap).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv)
      (ActionFunctionField.functionFieldMap_algebraMap f)
  let E := A.symm
  have hF : Fmap = CommRingCat.ofHom E.symm.toRingHom := by ext z; rfl
  have hf : f.left.toRationalMap.fromFunctionField =
      Scheme.functionFieldMorphism E.toRingEquiv :=
    Scheme.PartialMap.fromFunctionField_eq_of_functionFieldMap_eq f.left.toPartialMap
      E.toRingEquiv hF
  let ψ : (Spec Y.left.functionField).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ X :=
    (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom E.toAlgHom).op ≫
      SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter X
  have hψ : ψ.left = Scheme.functionFieldMorphism E.symm.toRingEquiv := rfl
  have hbase : ψ.left ≫ X.hom =
      Y.left.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint Y.left) ≫ Y.hom :=
    (Over.w ψ).trans (Over.w (SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter Y)).symm
  let g := Scheme.RationalMap.ofFunctionField Y.hom X.hom ψ.left hbase
  have hg : g.fromFunctionField = Scheme.functionFieldMorphism E.symm.toRingEquiv :=
    (Scheme.RationalMap.fromFunctionField_ofFunctionField _ _ _ _).trans hψ
  have : g.IsDominant := by
    apply Scheme.RationalMap.isDominant_of_fromFunctionField_closedPoint
    rw [hg]
    exact Scheme.functionFieldMorphism_closedPoint _
  have hgf : g.compHom f.left = Scheme.RationalMap.id Y.left := by
    rw [← Scheme.RationalMap.comp_toRationalMap]
    exact Scheme.RationalMap.comp_eq_id_of_fromFunctionField_eq _ _ E.symm.toRingEquiv hg hf
  have hgi : Spec.map Fmap ≫ g.fromFunctionField =
      X.left.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X.left) := by
    rw [hg, hF]
    change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom E.symm.toRingHom) ≫
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom E.toRingHom) ≫
        X.left.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X.left)) = _
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
    have hid : CommRingCat.ofHom E.toRingHom ≫
        CommRingCat.ofHom E.symm.toRingHom = 𝟙 (CommRingCat.of X.left.functionField) := by
      ext z
      exact E.symm_apply_apply z
    rw [hid, Spec.map_id, Category.id_comp]
  exact isOpenImmersion_of_inverse_domain f.left g hgi hgf
    (inverse_domain_contains_image X Y f hstalk g hgi)

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.exists_chart_scheme_lift
statement:
theorem exists_chart_scheme_lift (t : F) (htr : Transcendental k t)
    {O K : Type u} [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [Field K]
    [Algebra O K] [IsFractionRing O K] [IsIntegrallyClosed O]
    (q : Spec (.of K) ⟶ Spec (.of (normalizedRing (k := k) t)))
    (s : Spec (.of O) ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (hq : q ≫ Spec.algebraMap k (normalizedRing (k := k) t) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap O K)) ≫ s)
    (hmem : (Spec.preimage q).hom
      (algebraMap (parameterRing (k := k) t) (normalizedRing (k := k) t) (parameter t)) ∈
        (algebraMap O K).range) :
    ∃ g : Spec (.of O) ⟶ Spec (.of (normalizedRing (k := k) t)),
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap O K)) ≫ g = q ∧
        g ≫ Spec.algebraMap k (normalizedRing (k := k) t) = s
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra k O := (Spec.preimage s).hom.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra k K := ((algebraMap O K).comp (Spec.preimage s).hom).toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower k O K := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have hbase : q ≫ Spec.algebraMap k (normalizedRing (k := k) t) =
      Spec.algebraMap k K := by
    rw [hq, ← Spec.map_preimage s, ← Spec.map_comp]
    rfl
  let φ := Spec.homEquivAlgHom (R := k) ⟨q, hbase⟩
  have hm : φ
      (algebraMap (parameterRing (k := k) t) (normalizedRing (k := k) t) (parameter t)) ∈
        (algebraMap O K).range := hmem
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, _⟩ := existsUnique_chart_lift t htr (O := O) (K := K) φ hm
  refine ⟨Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ.toRingHom), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Spec.map_comp]
    have hring : (algebraMap O K).comp ψ.toRingHom = φ.toRingHom := by
      exact congrArg AlgHom.toRingHom hψ
    rw [show CommRingCat.ofHom ψ.toRingHom ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap O K) =
      CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom from CommRingCat.hom_ext hring]
    exact Spec.map_preimage q
  · rw [← Spec.map_comp]
    have hr : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (normalizedRing (k := k) t)) ≫
        CommRingCat.ofHom ψ.toRingHom = Spec.preimage s := by
      ext c
      exact ψ.commutes c
    rw [hr, Spec.map_preimage]

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.exists_separating_parameter
statement:
theorem exists_separating_parameter [PerfectField k]
    [IsFunctionFieldOneVar k F] :
    ∃ t : F, Transcendental k t ∧
      FiniteDimensional (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F ∧
      Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, _, hfin⟩ := IsFunctionFieldOneVar.exists_transcendental_finite (k := k) (F := F)
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType k (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({x} : Set F)) :=
    IntermediateField.essFiniteType_iff.2
      (IntermediateField.fg_adjoin_of_finite (Set.finite_singleton x))
  have := hfin
  have : Algebra.EssFiniteType k F :=
    Algebra.EssFiniteType.comp k (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({x} : Set F)) F
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsep⟩ := exists_isTranscendenceBasis_and_isSeparable_of_perfectField k F
  have hcard : s.card = 1 := by
    have h := hs.cardinalMk_eq_trdeg
    rw [Cardinal.mk_coe_finset, SmoothCurveStalks.trdeg_eq_one_of_oneVar] at h
    exact_mod_cast h
  obtain ⟨t, hsingle⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hcard
  subst s
  have ht : Transcendental k t := hs.1.transcendental ⟨t, Finset.mem_singleton_self _⟩
  have hset : (({t} : Finset F) : Set F) = ({t} : Set F) := Finset.coe_singleton t
  have hsep' : Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F :=
    (congrArg (fun S : Set F ↦ Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k S) F) hset).mp hsep
  exact ⟨t, ht, finiteDimensional_adjoin_of_transcendental ht, hsep'⟩

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.stalkMap_isIso_of_target_valuation
statement:
theorem stalkMap_isIso_of_target_valuation
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsDominant f] [IsIso f.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap]
    (x : X) [ValuationRing (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x))] : IsIso (f.stalkMap x)
proof:
:= by
  let R := Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)
  let S := X.presheaf.stalk x
  let E := (asIso f.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  let : Algebra R X.functionField := (E.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap R Y.functionField)).toAlgebra
  have : IsFractionRing R X.functionField :=
    (IsLocalization.isLocalization_iff_of_ringEquiv (nonZeroDivisors R) E).mp inferInstance
  let φ : R →+* S := (f.stalkMap x).hom
  let g : S →+* X.functionField := algebraMap S X.functionField
  have hg : Function.Injective g := IsFractionRing.injective S X.functionField
  have hφ : g.comp φ = algebraMap R X.functionField := by
    exact (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom
      (CurvePointsPlaces.functionFieldMap_stalkMap f x)).symm
  have hbij := bijective_rangeRestrict_comp_of_valuationRing φ g hφ
  have hf : Function.Bijective φ := by
    refine ⟨fun a b hab ↦ hbij.1 (congrArg g.rangeRestrict hab), ?_⟩
    intro s
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hbij.2 ⟨g s, ⟨s, rfl⟩⟩
    exact ⟨r, hg (congrArg Subtype.val hr)⟩
  exact (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective (f.stalkMap x)).mpr hf

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.inverseAlgebra_eq_inclusion
statement:
theorem inverseAlgebra_eq_inclusion (t : F) :
    inverseOverlapAlgebra (k := k) t = (inverseParameterToOverlap (k := k) t).toRingHom.toAlgebra
proof:
:=
  Algebra.algebra_ext (inverseOverlapAlgebra (k := k) t)
    ((inverseParameterToOverlap (k := k) t).toRingHom.toAlgebra)
    (fun _ ↦ Subtype.ext rfl)

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.inverse_parameter_fraction_tower
statement:
theorem inverse_parameter_fraction_tower (t : F) :
    IsScalarTower (parameterRing (k := k) t⁻¹) (overlapRing (k := k) t) F
proof:
:= by
  let P (a : Algebra (parameterRing (k := k) t⁻¹) (overlapRing (k := k) t)) : Prop :=
    letI := a
    IsScalarTower (parameterRing (k := k) t⁻¹) (overlapRing (k := k) t) F
  have hcanon : P ((inverseParameterToOverlap (k := k) t).toRingHom.toAlgebra) :=
    Subalgebra.inclusion.isScalarTower_right (inverseParameterRing_le_overlapRing t) F
  exact (congrArg P (inverseAlgebra_eq_inclusion (k := k) t)).mpr hcanon

name: AclGeom.WeilGluing.commonOverlap_glue_condition
statement:
theorem commonOverlap_glue_condition (i j : J) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    f i ≫ (commonOverlapGlueData U W f).ι i =
      f j ≫ (commonOverlapGlueData U W f).ι j
proof:
:= by
  let D := commonOverlapGlueData U W f
  have hv : D.V (i, j) = W := by
    simp only [D, commonOverlapGlueData, CategoryTheory.GlueData.ofGlueData',
      commonOverlapGlueData', hij, ↓reduceDIte]
  let q := eqToHom hv.symm
  have h := congrArg (fun p ↦ q ≫ p) (D.glue_condition i j)
  dsimp only [q] at h
  simp only [D, commonOverlapGlueData, CategoryTheory.GlueData.ofGlueData',
    CategoryTheory.GlueData'.f', commonOverlapGlueData', hij, hij.symm,
    ↓reduceDIte, ← Category.assoc, Category.id_comp] at h
  erw [eqToHom_trans (C := Scheme.{u})] at h
  simpa only [commonOverlapGlueData, CategoryTheory.GlueData.ofGlueData',
    commonOverlapGlueData', eqToHom_trans (C := Scheme.{u}),
    eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp] using h.symm

name: AclGeom.WeilGluing.commonOverlap_isPullback
statement:
theorem commonOverlap_isPullback (i j : J) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    IsPullback (f i) (f j) ((commonOverlapGlueData U W f).ι i)
      ((commonOverlapGlueData U W f).ι j)
proof:
:= by
  let D := commonOverlapGlueData U W f
  have hv : D.V (i, j) = W := by
    simp only [D, commonOverlapGlueData, CategoryTheory.GlueData.ofGlueData',
      commonOverlapGlueData', hij, ↓reduceDIte]
  have H : IsPullback (D.f i j) (D.t i j ≫ D.f j i) (D.ι i) (D.ι j) :=
    { w := (D.glue_condition i j).symm
      isLimit' := ⟨D.vPullbackConeIsLimit i j⟩ }
  refine H.of_iso (eqToIso hv) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) ?_ ?_
    (by simp [D]) (by simp [D])
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, eqToIso.hom,
      D, commonOverlapGlueData, CategoryTheory.GlueData.ofGlueData',
      CategoryTheory.GlueData'.f', commonOverlapGlueData', hij, ↓reduceDIte]
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id, eqToIso.hom,
      D, commonOverlapGlueData, CategoryTheory.GlueData.ofGlueData',
      CategoryTheory.GlueData'.f', commonOverlapGlueData', hij, hij.symm,
      ↓reduceDIte, ← Category.assoc, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
    erw [eqToHom_trans (C := Scheme.{u}), eqToHom_trans (C := Scheme.{u})]

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.inverseNormalized_mem
proof: := hx.tower_top

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.inverseNormalized_parameter_tower
statement:
theorem inverseNormalized_parameter_tower (t : F) :
    IsScalarTower (parameterRing (k := k) t⁻¹) (normalizedRing (k := k) t⁻¹)
      (normalizedOverlap (k := k) t)
proof:
:=
  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun _ ↦ Subtype.ext rfl)

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.inverseNormalizedOverlap_isLocalization
statement:
theorem inverseNormalizedOverlap_isLocalization (t : F) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    IsLocalization.Away
      (algebraMap (parameterRing (k := k) t⁻¹) (normalizedRing (k := k) t⁻¹) (parameter t⁻¹))
      (normalizedOverlap (k := k) t)
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra (normalizedRing (k := k) t⁻¹) F :=
    (algebraMap (normalizedRing (k := k) t⁻¹) F).toAlgebra
  let : Algebra (normalizedOverlap (k := k) t) F :=
    (algebraMap (normalizedOverlap (k := k) t) F).toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower (normalizedRing (k := k) t⁻¹) (normalizedOverlap (k := k) t) F :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun _ ↦ rfl)
  have : IsLocalization.Away (parameter (k := k) t⁻¹) (overlapRing (k := k) t) :=
    inverse_overlap_isLocalization t ht
  have : IsLocalization.Away (algebraMap (parameterRing (k := k) t⁻¹) F (parameter t⁻¹)) F :=
    IsLocalization.away_of_isUnit_of_bijective F
      (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (inv_ne_zero ht)) Function.bijective_id
  exact IsLocalization.Away.integralClosure (R := parameterRing (k := k) t⁻¹) (S := F)
    (Rf := overlapRing (k := k) t) (Sf := F) (parameter t⁻¹)

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.overlapToChart_isOpenImmersion
statement:
theorem overlapToChart_isOpenImmersion (t : F) (ht : t ≠ 0) (b : Bool) :
    IsOpenImmersion (overlapToChart (k := k) t b)
proof:
:= by
  cases b
  · have := normalizedOverlap_isLocalization (k := k) t ht
    exact IsOpenImmersion.of_isLocalization
      (algebraMap (parameterRing (k := k) t) (normalizedRing (k := k) t) (parameter t))
  · have := inverseNormalizedOverlap_isLocalization (k := k) t ht
    exact IsOpenImmersion.of_isLocalization
      (algebraMap (parameterRing (k := k) t⁻¹) (normalizedRing (k := k) t⁻¹) (parameter t⁻¹))

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.chartBaseHom_isAffine
statement: theorem chartBaseHom_isAffine (t : F) (b : Bool) : IsAffineHom (chartBaseHom (k := k) t b)
proof:
:= by
  cases b
  · let := normalizedBaseAlgebra (k := k) t
    change IsAffineHom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (normalizedRing (k := k) t))))
    exact isAffineHom_of_isAffine _
  · let := normalizedBaseAlgebra (k := k) t⁻¹
    change IsAffineHom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (normalizedRing (k := k) t⁻¹))))
    exact isAffineHom_of_isAffine _

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.overlap_chart_base_comm
statement:
theorem overlap_chart_base_comm (t : F) (b : Bool) :
    overlapToChart (k := k) t b ≫ chartBaseHom (k := k) t b = overlapBaseHom (k := k) t
proof:
:= by
  cases b
  · change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (normalizedToOverlap t)) ≫
      Spec.map _ = Spec.map _
    rw [← Spec.map_comp]
    congr 1
  · change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (inverseNormalizedToOverlap t)) ≫
      Spec.map _ = Spec.map _
    rw [← Spec.map_comp]
    congr 1

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.chart_modelHom
statement:
theorem chart_modelHom (t : F) (ht : t ≠ 0) (i : ULift.{u} Bool) :
    (atlas (k := k) t ht).ι i ≫ modelHom (k := k) t ht = chartBaseHom (k := k) t i.down
proof:
:= by
  let : ∀ i : ULift.{u} Bool, IsOpenImmersion (overlapToChart (k := k) t i.down) :=
    fun i ↦ overlapToChart_isOpenImmersion t ht i.down
  exact WeilGluing.commonOverlap_ι_toBase
    (fun i : ULift.{u} Bool ↦ chart (k := k) t i.down)
    (Spec (.of (normalizedOverlap (k := k) t))) (fun i ↦ overlapToChart (k := k) t i.down)
    (fun i ↦ chartBaseHom (k := k) t i.down) (overlapBaseHom (k := k) t)
    (fun i ↦ overlap_chart_base_comm (k := k) t i.down) i

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.exists_model_lift_from_chart
statement:
theorem exists_model_lift_from_chart (t : F) (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (htr : Transcendental k t) (b : Bool)
    {O K : Type u} [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [ValuationRing O] [Field K]
    [Algebra O K] [IsFractionRing O K]
    (q : Spec (.of K) ⟶ chart (k := k) t b)
    (s : Spec (.of O) ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (hq : q ≫ chartBaseHom (k := k) t b =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap O K)) ≫ s) :
    ∃ g : Spec (.of O) ⟶ model (k := k) t ht,
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap O K)) ≫ g =
        q ≫ (atlas (k := k) t ht).ι ⟨b⟩ ∧ g ≫ modelHom (k := k) t ht = s
proof:
:= by
  have : IsIntegrallyClosed O := (ValuationRing.integers O K).isIntegrallyClosed
  let φ : chartRing (k := k) t b →+* K := (Spec.preimage q).hom
  by_cases hm : φ (chartParameter t b) ∈ (algebraMap O K).range
  · obtain ⟨g, hg, hgs⟩ := exists_chart_scheme_lift (chartValue t b)
      (chartValue_transcendental t htr b) q s
      (by simpa only [chart_base_spec] using hq) hm
    refine ⟨g ≫ (atlas (k := k) t ht).ι ⟨b⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← Category.assoc, hg]
    · rw [Category.assoc, chart_modelHom, ← chart_base_spec, hgs]
  · have hφ : φ (chartParameter t b) ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      apply hm
      rw [hz]
      exact ⟨0, map_zero _⟩
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hrecip⟩ := exists_chart_overlap_lift t ht b φ hφ
    let qC := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ρ)
    let q' := qC ≫ overlapToChart (k := k) t (!b)
    have hqC : qC ≫ overlapToChart (k := k) t b = q := by
      rw [← chart_overlap_spec]
      dsimp only [qC]
      rw [← Spec.map_comp]
      change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (ρ.comp (chartToOverlap t b))) = q
      rw [hρ]
      exact Spec.map_preimage q
    have hq' : q' ≫ chartBaseHom (k := k) t (!b) =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap O K)) ≫ s := by
      calc
        _ = qC ≫ overlapBaseHom (k := k) t := by
          dsimp only [q']
          rw [Category.assoc, overlap_chart_base_comm]
        _ = (qC ≫ overlapToChart (k := k) t b) ≫ chartBaseHom (k := k) t b := by
          rw [Category.assoc, overlap_chart_base_comm]
        _ = _ := by rw [hqC, hq]
    have hpre : (Spec.preimage q').hom = ρ.comp (chartToOverlap t (!b)) := by
      dsimp only [q']
      rw [← chart_overlap_spec, Spec.preimage_comp]
      simp only [qC, Spec.preimage_map]
      rfl
    have hmint : (φ (chartParameter t b))⁻¹ ∈ (algebraMap O K).range := by
      exact (ValuationRing.isInteger_or_isInteger O (φ (chartParameter t b))).resolve_left hm
    have hm' : (Spec.preimage q').hom (chartParameter t (!b)) ∈
        (algebraMap O K).range := by
      rw [hpre, hrecip]
      exact hmint
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hgs⟩ := exists_chart_scheme_lift (chartValue t (!b))
      (chartValue_transcendental t htr (!b)) q' s
      (by simpa only [chart_base_spec] using hq') hm'
    refine ⟨g ≫ (atlas (k := k) t ht).ι ⟨!b⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← Category.assoc, hg]
      change (qC ≫ overlapToChart t (!b)) ≫ _ = _
      rw [Category.assoc, ← overlap_glue_condition_bool t ht b, ← Category.assoc, hqC]
    · rw [Category.assoc, chart_modelHom, ← chart_base_spec, hgs]

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.modelHom_valuative_existence
statement:
theorem modelHom_valuative_existence (t : F) (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (htr : Transcendental k t) :
    ValuativeCriterion.Existence (modelHom (k := k) t ht)
proof:
:= by
  intro S
  obtain ⟨⟨b⟩, q, hq⟩ := exists_chart_factor t ht S.K S.i₁
  have hqbase : q ≫ chartBaseHom (k := k) t b =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S.R S.K)) ≫ S.i₂ := by
    rw [← chart_modelHom t ht ⟨b⟩, ← Category.assoc, hq]
    exact S.commSq.w
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgs⟩ := exists_model_lift_from_chart t ht htr b q S.i₂ hqbase
  exact ⟨⟨g, hg.trans hq, hgs⟩⟩

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.chart_stalk_properties
statement:
theorem chart_stalk_properties (t : F) (htr : Transcendental k t)
    [FiniteDimensional (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F]
    (b : Bool) (y : chart (k := k) t b) :
    IsIntegrallyClosed ((chart (k := k) t b).presheaf.stalk y) ∧
      ringKrullDim ((chart (k := k) t b).presheaf.stalk y) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hinv := separating_inverse t htr
  have := hinv.2.1
  have := hinv.2.2
  cases b
  · change PrimeSpectrum (normalizedRing (k := k) t) at y
    change IsIntegrallyClosed ((Spec (.of (normalizedRing (k := k) t))).presheaf.stalk y) ∧
      ringKrullDim ((Spec (.of (normalizedRing (k := k) t))).presheaf.stalk y) ≤ 1
    have : IsDedekindDomain (normalizedRing (k := k) t) :=
      (normalizedRing_properties t htr).2.1
    have : IsIntegral (Spec (.of (normalizedRing (k := k) t))) := inferInstance
    let : Algebra (normalizedRing (k := k) t)
        ((Spec (.of (normalizedRing (k := k) t))).presheaf.stalk y) :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.StructureSheaf.stalkAlgebra _ y
    have : IsLocalization.AtPrime
        ((Spec (.of (normalizedRing (k := k) t))).presheaf.stalk y) y.asIdeal :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.StructureSheaf.IsLocalization.to_stalk _ y
    have : IsDomain ((Spec (.of (normalizedRing (k := k) t))).presheaf.stalk y) :=
      IsLocalization.isDomain_of_atPrime _ y.asIdeal
    have : IsDedekindDomain ((Spec (.of (normalizedRing (k := k) t))).presheaf.stalk y) :=
      IsLocalization.AtPrime.isDedekindDomain (normalizedRing (k := k) t) y.asIdeal _
    exact ⟨inferInstance, (Ring.krullDimLE_iff).mp
      (inferInstance : Ring.KrullDimLE 1
        ((Spec (.of (normalizedRing (k := k) t))).presheaf.stalk y))⟩
  · change PrimeSpectrum (normalizedRing (k := k) t⁻¹) at y
    change IsIntegrallyClosed ((Spec (.of (normalizedRing (k := k) t⁻¹))).presheaf.stalk y) ∧
      ringKrullDim ((Spec (.of (normalizedRing (k := k) t⁻¹))).presheaf.stalk y) ≤ 1
    have : IsDedekindDomain (normalizedRing (k := k) t⁻¹) :=
      (normalizedRing_properties t⁻¹ hinv.1).2.1
    have : IsIntegral (Spec (.of (normalizedRing (k := k) t⁻¹))) := inferInstance
    let : Algebra (normalizedRing (k := k) t⁻¹)
        ((Spec (.of (normalizedRing (k := k) t⁻¹))).presheaf.stalk y) :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.StructureSheaf.stalkAlgebra _ y
    have : IsLocalization.AtPrime
        ((Spec (.of (normalizedRing (k := k) t⁻¹))).presheaf.stalk y) y.asIdeal :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.StructureSheaf.IsLocalization.to_stalk _ y
    have : IsDomain ((Spec (.of (normalizedRing (k := k) t⁻¹))).presheaf.stalk y) :=
      IsLocalization.isDomain_of_atPrime _ y.asIdeal
    have : IsDedekindDomain ((Spec (.of (normalizedRing (k := k) t⁻¹))).presheaf.stalk y) :=
      IsLocalization.AtPrime.isDedekindDomain (normalizedRing (k := k) t⁻¹) y.asIdeal _
    exact ⟨inferInstance, (Ring.krullDimLE_iff).mp
      (inferInstance : Ring.KrullDimLE 1
        ((Spec (.of (normalizedRing (k := k) t⁻¹))).presheaf.stalk y))⟩

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.model_stalk_properties
statement:
theorem model_stalk_properties (t : F) (ht : t ≠ 0) (htr : Transcendental k t)
    [FiniteDimensional (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F]
    (x : model (k := k) t ht) :
    IsIntegrallyClosed ((model (k := k) t ht).presheaf.stalk x) ∧
      ringKrullDim ((model (k := k) t ht).presheaf.stalk x) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, y, rfl⟩ := (atlas (k := k) t ht).ι_jointly_surjective x
  have hchart := chart_stalk_properties t htr i.down y
  have : IsIntegrallyClosed
      (((atlas (k := k) t ht).U i).presheaf.stalk y) := hchart.1
  let e := (asIso (((atlas (k := k) t ht).ι i).stalkMap y)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  exact ⟨IsIntegrallyClosed.of_equiv e.symm, e.ringKrullDim.trans_le hchart.2⟩

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.model_dimension_le_one
statement:
theorem model_dimension_le_one (t : F) (ht : t ≠ 0) (htr : Transcendental k t)
    [FiniteDimensional (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F] :
    topologicalKrullDim (model (k := k) t ht) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have he : Order.krullDim (model (k := k) t ht) =
      topologicalKrullDim (model (k := k) t ht) :=
    (Order.krullDim_eq_of_orderIso
      (irreducibleSetEquivPoints (α := model (k := k) t ht))).symm
  rw [← he, Order.krullDim_eq_iSup_coheight]
  refine iSup_le fun x ↦ ?_
  rw [← ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight x]
  exact (model_stalk_properties t ht htr x).2

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.affine_hom_eq_of_fraction_field
statement:
theorem affine_hom_eq_of_fraction_field
    {O K A : Type u} [CommRing O] [CommRing A] [Field K]
    [Algebra O K] [IsFractionRing O K]
    (f g : Spec (.of O) ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    (h : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap O K)) ≫ f =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap O K)) ≫ g) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply Spec.preimage_injective
  ext a
  apply IsFractionRing.injective O K
  have hh := congrArg Spec.preimage h
  rw [Spec.preimage_comp, Spec.preimage_comp, Spec.preimage_map] at hh
  exact congrArg (fun q ↦ q a) hh

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.normalizedOverlap_isLocalization
statement:
theorem normalizedOverlap_isLocalization (t : F) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    IsLocalization.Away
      (algebraMap (parameterRing (k := k) t) (normalizedRing (k := k) t) (parameter t))
      (normalizedOverlap (k := k) t)
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra (normalizedRing (k := k) t) F :=
    (algebraMap (normalizedRing (k := k) t) F).toAlgebra
  let : Algebra (normalizedOverlap (k := k) t) F :=
    (algebraMap (normalizedOverlap (k := k) t) F).toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower (normalizedRing (k := k) t) (normalizedOverlap (k := k) t) F :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun _ ↦ rfl)
  have : IsLocalization.Away (parameter (k := k) t) (overlapRing (k := k) t) :=
    overlap_isLocalization t ht
  have : IsLocalization.Away (algebraMap (parameterRing (k := k) t) F (parameter t)) F :=
    IsLocalization.away_of_isUnit_of_bijective F (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr ht) Function.bijective_id
  exact IsLocalization.Away.integralClosure (R := parameterRing (k := k) t) (S := F)
    (Rf := overlapRing (k := k) t) (Sf := F) (parameter t)

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.existsUnique_integral_lift
statement:
theorem existsUnique_integral_lift
    {R : Type u} {A : Type v} {O : Type w} {K : Type z}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [Field K]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R O] [Algebra R K] [Algebra O K]
    [IsScalarTower R O K] [IsFractionRing O K] [IsIntegrallyClosed O]
    [Algebra.IsIntegral R A] (φ : A →ₐ[R] K) :
    ∃! ψ : A →ₐ[R] O, (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R O K).comp ψ = φ
proof:
:= by
  let f := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R O K
  let e := AlgEquiv.ofInjective f (IsFractionRing.injective O K)
  have hmem (a : A) : φ a ∈ f.range := by
    have hi : IsIntegral O (φ a) :=
      ((Algebra.IsIntegral.isIntegral (R := R) a).map φ).tower_top
    exact (isIntegrallyClosed_iff K).mp inferInstance hi
  let ψ := e.symm.toAlgHom.comp (φ.codRestrict f.range hmem)
  have hψ : f.comp ψ = φ := by
    ext a
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (e.apply_symm_apply (φ.codRestrict f.range hmem a))
  refine ⟨ψ, hψ, ?_⟩
  intro θ hθ
  ext a
  apply IsFractionRing.injective O K
  exact AlgHom.congr_fun (hθ.trans hψ.symm) a

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.modelHom_isProper
statement:
theorem modelHom_isProper (t : F) (ht : t ≠ 0) (htr : Transcendental k t)
    [FiniteDimensional (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F] :
    IsProper (modelHom (k := k) t ht)
proof:
:= by
  have : LocallyOfFiniteType (modelHom (k := k) t ht) :=
    modelHom_locallyOfFiniteType t ht htr
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian (model (k := k) t ht) :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (modelHom (k := k) t ht)
  have : QuasiSeparatedSpace (model (k := k) t ht) := inferInstance
  have : QuasiSeparated (modelHom (k := k) t ht) := inferInstance
  apply IsProper.of_valuativeCriterion
  exact ValuativeCriterion.iff.mpr
    ⟨modelHom_valuative_existence t ht htr, modelHom_valuative_uniqueness t ht⟩

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.parameterRing_le_overlapRing
statement:
theorem parameterRing_le_overlapRing (t : F) :
    parameterRing (k := k) t ≤ overlapRing (k := k) t
proof:
:=
  Algebra.adjoin_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr (Set.mem_insert _ _))

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.overlap_isLocalization
statement:
theorem overlap_isLocalization (t : F) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    letI
proof:
:= overlapAlgebra (k := k) t
    IsLocalization.Away (parameter (k := k) t) (overlapRing (k := k) t) := by
  let P := parameterRing (k := k) t
  let T := overlapRing (k := k) t
  let := overlapAlgebra (k := k) t
  let a : T := ⟨t, Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_insert _ _)⟩
  let b : T := ⟨t⁻¹, Algebra.subset_adjoin (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_singleton _))⟩
  have hab : a * b = 1 := Subtype.ext (mul_inv_cancel₀ ht)
  have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap P T (parameter t)) := by
    change IsUnit a
    exact IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one b hab
  let S : Subalgebra k F :=
    { carrier := {x | ∃ (n : ℕ) (p : P), x * t ^ n = p}
      zero_mem' := ⟨0, 0, by simp⟩
      one_mem' := ⟨0, 1, by simp⟩
      add_mem' := by
        rintro x y ⟨n, p, hp⟩ ⟨m, q, hq⟩
        refine ⟨n + m, p * parameter t ^ m + q * parameter t ^ n, ?_⟩
        change (x + y) * t ^ (n + m) = (p : F) * t ^ m + (q : F) * t ^ n
        rw [pow_add, add_mul]
        rw [← mul_assoc, hp]
        congr 1
        calc
          y * (t ^ n * t ^ m) = (y * t ^ m) * t ^ n := by ac_rfl
          _ = (q : F) * t ^ n := congrArg (fun z ↦ z * t ^ n) hq
      mul_mem' := by
        rintro x y ⟨n, p, hp⟩ ⟨m, q, hq⟩
        refine ⟨n + m, p * q, ?_⟩
        change (x * y) * t ^ (n + m) = (p : F) * (q : F)
        rw [pow_add, mul_mul_mul_comm, hp, hq]
      algebraMap_mem' := fun c ↦ ⟨0, algebraMap k P c, by simp⟩ }
  have hT : T ≤ S := by
    apply Algebra.adjoin_le
    intro x hx
    rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hx with hx | hx
    · exact ⟨0, parameter t, by
        change x * t ^ 0 = t
        simpa only [pow_zero, mul_one] using hx⟩
    · have h := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hx
      exact ⟨1, 1, by simpa only [h, pow_one, Subalgebra.coe_one] using inv_mul_cancel₀ ht⟩
  refine IsLocalization.Away.mk (parameter t) hu ?_ ?_
  · intro z
    obtain ⟨n, p, hp⟩ := hT z.property
    exact ⟨n, p, Subtype.ext hp⟩
  · intro p q hpq
    exact ⟨0, by simpa using (Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : T ↦ (z : F)) hpq) : p = q)⟩

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.chart_overlap_isLocalization
statement:
theorem chart_overlap_isLocalization (t : F) (ht : t ≠ 0) (b : Bool) :
    letI
proof:
:= chartOverlapAlgebra (k := k) t b
    IsLocalization.Away (chartParameter (k := k) t b) (normalizedOverlap (k := k) t) := by
  cases b
  · exact normalizedOverlap_isLocalization t ht
  · exact inverseNormalizedOverlap_isLocalization t ht

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.chart_parameters_mul
statement:
theorem chart_parameters_mul (t : F) (ht : t ≠ 0) (b : Bool) :
    chartToOverlap (k := k) t b (chartParameter t b) *
      chartToOverlap (k := k) t (!b) (chartParameter t (!b)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  cases b
  · exact overlap_parameters_mul t ht
  · change inverseNormalizedToOverlap t (normalizedParameter t⁻¹) *
      normalizedToOverlap t (normalizedParameter t) = 1
    rw [mul_comm]
    exact overlap_parameters_mul t ht

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.chart_overlap_spec
statement:
theorem chart_overlap_spec (t : F) (b : Bool) :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (chartToOverlap (k := k) t b)) =
      overlapToChart (k := k) t b
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> rfl

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.chart_base_spec
statement:
theorem chart_base_spec (t : F) (b : Bool) :
    letI
proof:
:= normalizedBaseAlgebra (k := k) (chartValue t b)
    Spec.algebraMap k (chartRing (k := k) t b) = chartBaseHom (k := k) t b := by
  cases b <;> rfl

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.chartValue_transcendental
statement:
theorem chartValue_transcendental (t : F) (htr : Transcendental k t) (b : Bool) :
    Transcendental k (chartValue t b)
proof:
:= by
  cases b
  · exact htr
  · exact fun h ↦ htr (IsAlgebraic.inv_iff.mp h)

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.exists_chart_overlap_lift_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem exists_chart_overlap_lift_of_isUnit (t : F) (ht : t ≠ 0) (b : Bool)
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (φ : chartRing (k := k) t b →+* R)
    (hφ : IsUnit (φ (chartParameter t b))) :
    ∃ ρ : normalizedOverlap (k := k) t →+* R,
      ρ.comp (chartToOverlap t b) = φ
proof:
:= by
  let := chartOverlapAlgebra (k := k) t b
  have : IsLocalization.Away (chartParameter (k := k) t b)
      (normalizedOverlap (k := k) t) := chart_overlap_isLocalization t ht b
  exact ⟨IsLocalization.Away.lift (chartParameter t b) hφ,
    IsLocalization.Away.lift_comp (S := normalizedOverlap (k := k) t)
      (g := φ) (chartParameter t b) hφ⟩

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.exists_chart_overlap_lift
statement:
theorem exists_chart_overlap_lift (t : F) (ht : t ≠ 0) (b : Bool)
    {K : Type u} [Field K] (φ : chartRing (k := k) t b →+* K)
    (hφ : φ (chartParameter t b) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ ρ : normalizedOverlap (k := k) t →+* K,
      ρ.comp (chartToOverlap t b) = φ ∧
        (ρ.comp (chartToOverlap t (!b))) (chartParameter t (!b)) =
          (φ (chartParameter t b))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := exists_chart_overlap_lift_of_isUnit t ht b φ
    (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hφ)
  refine ⟨ρ, hρ, ?_⟩
  have hm := congrArg ρ (chart_parameters_mul (k := k) t ht b)
  rw [map_mul, map_one] at hm
  have ha : ρ (chartToOverlap t b (chartParameter t b)) =
      φ (chartParameter t b) := RingHom.congr_fun hρ _
  rw [ha] at hm
  change ρ (chartToOverlap t (!b) (chartParameter t (!b))) = _
  apply (mul_left_cancel₀ hφ)
  rw [hm, mul_inv_cancel₀ hφ]

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.overlapRing_inv
statement: theorem overlapRing_inv (t : F) : overlapRing (k := k) t⁻¹ = overlapRing (k := k) t
proof:
:= by
  change Algebra.adjoin k ({t⁻¹, (t⁻¹)⁻¹} : Set F) = Algebra.adjoin k ({t, t⁻¹} : Set F)
  rw [inv_inv, Set.pair_comm]

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.inverseParameterRing_le_overlapRing
statement:
theorem inverseParameterRing_le_overlapRing (t : F) :
    parameterRing (k := k) t⁻¹ ≤ overlapRing (k := k) t
proof:
:=
  Algebra.adjoin_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr
    (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_singleton _)))

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.inverse_overlap_isLocalization
statement:
theorem inverse_overlap_isLocalization (t : F) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    let
proof:
:= inverseOverlapAlgebra (k := k) t
    IsLocalization.Away (parameter (k := k) t⁻¹) (overlapRing (k := k) t) := by
  let := overlapAlgebra (k := k) t⁻¹
  let := inverseOverlapAlgebra (k := k) t
  exact (IsLocalization.isLocalization_iff_of_ringEquiv
    (M := Submonoid.powers (parameter (k := k) t⁻¹)) (inverseOverlapRingEquiv t)).mp
      (overlap_isLocalization (k := k) t⁻¹ (inv_ne_zero ht))

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.exists_chart_factor
statement:
theorem exists_chart_factor (t : F) (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (f : Spec (.of R) ⟶ model (k := k) t ht) :
    ∃ (i : ULift.{u} Bool) (g : Spec (.of R) ⟶ chart (k := k) t i.down),
      g ≫ (atlas (k := k) t ht).ι i = f
proof:
:= by
  let D := atlas (k := k) t ht
  change ∃ (i : D.J) (g : Spec (.of R) ⟶ D.U i), g ≫ D.ι i = f
  obtain ⟨i, y, hy⟩ := D.ι_jointly_surjective (f (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R))
  have : IsOpenImmersion (D.ι i) := D.ι_isOpenImmersion i
  have hr : Set.range f ⊆ Set.range (D.ι i) := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact ((IsLocalRing.specializes_closedPoint x).map f.continuous).mem_open
      (IsOpenImmersion.isOpen_range (D.ι i)) ⟨y, hy⟩
  refine ⟨i, IsOpenImmersion.lift (D.ι i) f hr, ?_⟩
  exact IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac (D.ι i) f hr

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.overlap_glue_condition
statement:
theorem overlap_glue_condition (t : F) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    overlapToChart (k := k) t false ≫ (atlas (k := k) t ht).ι ⟨false⟩ =
      overlapToChart (k := k) t true ≫ (atlas (k := k) t ht).ι ⟨true⟩
proof:
:= by
  let : ∀ i : ULift.{u} Bool, IsOpenImmersion (overlapToChart (k := k) t i.down) :=
    fun i ↦ overlapToChart_isOpenImmersion t ht i.down
  exact WeilGluing.commonOverlap_glue_condition
    (fun i : ULift.{u} Bool ↦ chart (k := k) t i.down)
    (Spec (.of (normalizedOverlap (k := k) t))) (fun i ↦ overlapToChart (k := k) t i.down)
    ⟨false⟩ ⟨true⟩ (by decide)

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.overlap_glue_condition_bool
statement:
theorem overlap_glue_condition_bool (t : F) (ht : t ≠ 0) (b : Bool) :
    overlapToChart (k := k) t b ≫ (atlas (k := k) t ht).ι ⟨b⟩ =
      overlapToChart (k := k) t (!b) ≫ (atlas (k := k) t ht).ι ⟨!b⟩
proof:
:= by
  cases b
  · exact overlap_glue_condition t ht
  · exact (overlap_glue_condition t ht).symm

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.overlap_isPullback
statement:
theorem overlap_isPullback (t : F) (ht : t ≠ 0) (b : Bool) :
    IsPullback (overlapToChart (k := k) t b) (overlapToChart (k := k) t (!b))
      ((atlas (k := k) t ht).ι ⟨b⟩) ((atlas (k := k) t ht).ι ⟨!b⟩)
proof:
:= by
  let : ∀ i : ULift.{u} Bool, IsOpenImmersion (overlapToChart (k := k) t i.down) :=
    fun i ↦ overlapToChart_isOpenImmersion t ht i.down
  exact WeilGluing.commonOverlap_isPullback
    (fun i : ULift.{u} Bool ↦ chart (k := k) t i.down)
    (Spec (.of (normalizedOverlap (k := k) t))) (fun i ↦ overlapToChart (k := k) t i.down)
    ⟨b⟩ ⟨!b⟩ (by cases b <;> decide)

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.parameter_overlap_isScalarTower
statement:
theorem parameter_overlap_isScalarTower (t : F) :
    IsScalarTower (parameterRing (k := k) t) (overlapRing (k := k) t) F
proof:
:=
  Subalgebra.inclusion.isScalarTower_right (parameterRing_le_overlapRing t) F

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.normalizedClosure_le_overlap
statement:
theorem normalizedClosure_le_overlap (t : F) :
    integralClosure (parameterRing (k := k) t) F ≤
      (integralClosure (overlapRing (k := k) t) F).restrictScalars (parameterRing (k := k) t)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact hx.tower_top

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.normalized_overlap_parameter_tower
statement:
theorem normalized_overlap_parameter_tower (t : F) :
    IsScalarTower (parameterRing (k := k) t) (normalizedRing (k := k) t)
      (normalizedOverlap (k := k) t)
proof:
:=
  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq (fun _ ↦ Subtype.ext rfl)

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.existsUnique_chart_lift
statement:
theorem existsUnique_chart_lift (t : F) (htr : Transcendental k t)
    {O : Type w} {K : Type z}
    [CommRing O] [IsDomain O] [Field K]
    [Algebra k O] [Algebra k K] [Algebra O K]
    [IsScalarTower k O K] [IsFractionRing O K] [IsIntegrallyClosed O]
    (φ : normalizedRing (k := k) t →ₐ[k] K)
    (hmem : φ (algebraMap (parameterRing (k := k) t) (normalizedRing (k := k) t)
      (parameter t)) ∈ (algebraMap O K).range) :
    ∃! ψ : normalizedRing (k := k) t →ₐ[k] O,
      (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k O K).comp ψ = φ
proof:
:= by
  let P := parameterRing (k := k) t
  let A := normalizedRing (k := k) t
  have : IsScalarTower k P A := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let e : Polynomial k ≃ₐ[k] P := Polynomial.algEquivOfTranscendental k t htr
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := hmem
  let g : P →ₐ[k] O := (Polynomial.aeval β).comp e.symm.toAlgHom
  have hg : (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k O K).comp g =
      φ.comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P A) := by
    have hp : ((IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k O K).comp g).comp e.toAlgHom =
        (φ.comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P A)).comp e.toAlgHom := by
      apply Polynomial.algHom_ext
      change algebraMap O K (Polynomial.aeval β (e.symm (e Polynomial.X))) =
        φ (algebraMap P A (e Polynomial.X))
      rw [e.symm_apply_apply, Polynomial.aeval_X]
      have heX : e Polynomial.X = parameter t :=
        Polynomial.algEquivOfTranscendental_apply_X k t htr
      rw [heX]
      exact hβ
    ext p
    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := e.surjective p
    exact AlgHom.congr_fun hp q
  let : Algebra P O := g.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let : Algebra P K := (φ.comp (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P A)).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower P O K := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun p ↦
    (AlgHom.congr_fun hg p).symm
  let φP : A →ₐ[P] K :=
    { φ.toRingHom with commutes' := fun p ↦ rfl }
  obtain ⟨ψP, hψP, _⟩ := existsUnique_integral_lift (O := O) (K := K) φP
  have : IsScalarTower k P O := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun c ↦
    (g.commutes c).symm
  let ψ : A →ₐ[k] O := ψP.restrictScalars k
  have hψ : (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k O K).comp ψ = φ := by
    ext a
    exact AlgHom.congr_fun hψP a
  refine ⟨ψ, hψ, ?_⟩
  intro θ hθ
  ext a
  apply IsFractionRing.injective O K
  exact AlgHom.congr_fun (hθ.trans hψ.symm) a

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.inverse_domain_contains_image
statement:
theorem inverse_domain_contains_image
    (X Y : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left] [IsIntegral Y.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsDominant f.left]
    [IsIso f.left.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap]
    (hstalk : ∀ x : X.left, IsIso (f.left.stalkMap x))
    (g : Y.left.RationalMap X.left)
    (hg : Spec.map f.left.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap ≫ g.fromFunctionField =
      X.left.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X.left)) :
    ∀ x : X.left, f.left x ∈ g.domain
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  have := hstalk x
  let y := f.left x
  let u := f.left.stalkMap x
  let φ := Spec.map (inv u) ≫ X.left.fromSpecStalk x
  have hφf : φ ≫ f.left = Y.left.fromSpecStalk y := by
    dsimp only [φ]
    rw [Category.assoc, ← Scheme.SpecMap_stalkMap_fromSpecStalk f.left,
      ← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, IsIso.hom_inv_id, Spec.map_id, Category.id_comp]
  have hφbase : φ ≫ X.hom = Y.left.fromSpecStalk y ≫ Y.hom := by
    rw [← Over.w f, ← Category.assoc, hφf]
  have hφgeneric : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap (Y.left.presheaf.stalk y) Y.left.functionField)) ≫ φ =
        g.fromFunctionField := by
    apply (cancel_epi (Spec.map f.left.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap)).mp
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp,
      CurvePointsPlaces.functionFieldMap_stalkMap f.left x,
      Spec.map_comp, Category.assoc]
    dsimp only [φ]
    rw [← Category.assoc (Spec.map u), ← Spec.map_comp,
      IsIso.inv_hom_id, Spec.map_id, Category.id_comp]
    exact (Scheme.SpecMap_stalkSpecializes_fromSpecStalk
      (genericPoint_specializes x)).trans hg.symm
  let p := Scheme.PartialMap.ofFromSpecStalk Y.hom X.hom φ hφbase
  have hy : y ∈ p.domain :=
    Scheme.PartialMap.mem_domain_ofFromSpecStalk Y.hom X.hom φ hφbase
  have hp : p.fromSpecStalkOfMem hy = φ :=
    Scheme.PartialMap.fromSpecStalkOfMem_ofFromSpecStalk Y.hom X.hom φ hφbase
  have hη : genericPoint Y.left ∈ p.domain :=
    (genericPoint_specializes y).mem_open p.domain.2 hy
  have hfac : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap (Y.left.presheaf.stalk y) Y.left.functionField)) ≫
      p.domain.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hy =
        p.domain.fromSpecStalkOfMem (genericPoint Y.left) hη := by
    apply (cancel_mono p.domain.ι).mp
    rw [Category.assoc, Scheme.Opens.fromSpecStalkOfMem_ι,
      Scheme.Opens.fromSpecStalkOfMem_ι]
    exact Scheme.SpecMap_stalkSpecializes_fromSpecStalk (genericPoint_specializes y)
  have hpg : p.toRationalMap = g := by
    apply Scheme.RationalMap.eq_of_fromFunctionField_eq
    rw [Scheme.RationalMap.fromFunctionField_toRationalMap]
    change p.domain.fromSpecStalkOfMem (genericPoint Y.left) hη ≫ p.hom = _
    rw [← hfac, Category.assoc]
    change _ ≫ p.fromSpecStalkOfMem hy = _
    rw [hp]
    exact hφgeneric
  exact Scheme.RationalMap.mem_domain.mpr ⟨p, hy, hpg⟩

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.isOpenImmersion_of_inverse_domain
statement:
theorem isOpenImmersion_of_inverse_domain
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y] [X.IsSeparated] [Y.IsSeparated]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsDominant f]
    (g : Y.RationalMap X)
    (hg : Spec.map f.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap ≫ g.fromFunctionField =
      X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X))
    (hgf : g.compHom f = Scheme.RationalMap.id Y)
    (hdom : ∀ x : X, f x ∈ g.domain) : IsOpenImmersion f
proof:
:= by
  let p := g.toPartialMap
  have hrange : Set.range f ⊆ Set.range p.domain.ι := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨f x, hdom x⟩, rfl⟩
  let j := IsOpenImmersion.lift p.domain.ι f hrange
  have hj : j ≫ p.domain.ι = f := IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
  have hη : genericPoint Y ∈ p.domain :=
    (genericPoint_specializes (f (genericPoint X))).mem_open p.domain.2
      (hdom (genericPoint X))
  have hgen : X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X) ≫ j =
      Spec.map f.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap ≫
        p.domain.fromSpecStalkOfMem (genericPoint Y) hη := by
    apply (cancel_mono p.domain.ι).mp
    rw [Category.assoc, hj, Category.assoc, Scheme.Opens.fromSpecStalkOfMem_ι]
    exact (Scheme.Hom.fromFunctionField_toPartialMap f).symm.trans
      (Scheme.PartialMap.fromFunctionField_eq_functionFieldMorphismOfHom f.toPartialMap)
  have : IsDominant (X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X)) :=
    Scheme.isDominant_fromSpecStalk_genericPoint
  have hjp : j ≫ p.hom = 𝟙 X := by
    apply ext_of_isDominant (X.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X))
    rw [← Category.assoc, hgen, Category.assoc, Category.comp_id]
    change Spec.map f.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap ≫ p.fromFunctionField = _
    rw [← Scheme.RationalMap.fromFunctionField_toRationalMap,
      g.toRationalMap_toPartialMap]
    exact hg
  have hpf : p.hom ≫ f = p.domain.ι := by
    have he : (p.compHom f).toRationalMap = (𝟙 Y : Y ⟶ Y).toRationalMap := by
      rw [Scheme.RationalMap.compHom_toRationalMap, g.toRationalMap_toPartialMap, hgf]
    have hh := (Scheme.PartialMap.equiv_toPartialMap_iff_of_isSeparated
      (S := ⊤_ Scheme)).mp (Scheme.PartialMap.toRationalMap_eq_iff.mp he)
    change p.hom ≫ f = p.domain.ι ≫ 𝟙 Y at hh
    simpa only [Category.comp_id] using hh
  let e : X ≅ p.domain.toScheme :=
    { hom := j
      inv := p.hom
      hom_inv_id := hjp
      inv_hom_id := by
        apply (cancel_mono p.domain.ι).mp
        rw [Category.assoc, hj, Category.id_comp]
        exact hpf }
  have : IsIso j := by
    change IsIso e.hom
    exact e.isIso_hom
  have : IsOpenImmersion j := inferInstance
  rw [← hj]
  exact IsOpenImmersion.comp _ _

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.exists_proper_normal_completion
statement:
theorem exists_proper_normal_completion
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left] [Smooth X.hom] [IsSeparated X.hom]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X.left = 1) :
    ∃ (Y : Over (Spec (.of k))) (j : X ⟶ Y),
      IsIntegral Y.left ∧ IsProper Y.hom ∧ IsOpenImmersion j.left ∧
        topologicalKrullDim Y.left = 1 ∧
        (∀ y : Y.left, IsIntegrallyClosed (Y.left.presheaf.stalk y))
proof:
:= by
  have : X.left.IsSeparated := by
    constructor
    rw [← CategoryTheory.Limits.terminal.comp_from X.hom]
    infer_instance
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian X.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian X.hom
  have : IsFunctionFieldOneVar k X.left.functionField :=
    scheme_functionField_isFunctionFieldOneVar k X hdim
  obtain ⟨t, htr, hfinite, hsep⟩ :=
    exists_separating_parameter (k := k) (F := X.left.functionField)
  have ht : t ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply htr
    rw [h]
    exact isAlgebraic_zero
  let Y := curve (k := k) t ht
  have : IsIntegral Y.left := model_integral t ht
  have : IsProper Y.hom := modelHom_isProper t ht htr
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian Y.left := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian Y.hom
  have : Y.left.IsSeparated := by
    constructor
    rw [← CategoryTheory.Limits.terminal.comp_from Y.hom]
    infer_instance
  have hYdim : topologicalKrullDim Y.left ≤ 1 := model_dimension_le_one t ht htr
  have hYnormal (y : Y.left) : IsIntegrallyClosed (Y.left.presheaf.stalk y) :=
    (model_stalk_properties t ht htr y).1
  have hYval (y : Y.left) : ValuationRing (Y.left.presheaf.stalk y) := by
    have := hYnormal y
    exact ProperCurve.stalk_valuationRing Y.left hYdim y
  let : Algebra k (model (k := k) t ht).functionField :=
    @ActionFunctionField.functionFieldAlgebra k _ Y inferInstance
  obtain ⟨E⟩ := exists_model_functionField_equiv t ht htr
  let φ : (Spec X.left.functionField).asOver (Spec (.of k)) ⟶ Y :=
    (algSpec (.of k)).map (CommAlgCat.ofHom E.toAlgHom).op ≫
      SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter Y
  have hφ : φ.left = Scheme.functionFieldMorphism E.symm.toRingEquiv := rfl
  have hφbase : φ.left ≫ Y.hom =
      X.left.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint X.left) ≫ X.hom :=
    (Over.w φ).trans (Over.w (SchemeGenericTranslate.genericParameter X)).symm
  let r := Scheme.RationalMap.ofFunctionField X.hom Y.hom φ.left hφbase
  have hr : r.fromFunctionField = Scheme.functionFieldMorphism E.symm.toRingEquiv :=
    (Scheme.RationalMap.fromFunctionField_ofFunctionField _ _ _ _).trans hφ
  have hrbase : r.compHom Y.hom = X.hom.toRationalMap :=
    ((Scheme.RationalMap.equivFunctionField X.hom Y.hom) ⟨φ.left, hφbase⟩).property
  have hrdom : r.IsDominant := by
    apply Scheme.RationalMap.isDominant_of_fromFunctionField_closedPoint
    rw [hr]
    exact Scheme.functionFieldMorphism_closedPoint _
  obtain ⟨f, hf, _⟩ := ProperCurve.existsUnique_extension hdim.le
    (SmoothCurveStalks.stalk_integrallyClosed X hdim) X.hom Y.hom r hrbase
  let j : X ⟶ Y := Over.homMk f hf.2
  have hfdom : f.toRationalMap.IsDominant := by rw [hf.1]; exact hrdom
  have : IsDominant f.toPartialMap.hom :=
    (Scheme.PartialMap.isDominant_toRationalMap_iff f.toPartialMap).mp hfdom
  have : IsDominant (X.left.topIso.hom ≫ f) := inferInstanceAs
    (IsDominant f.toPartialMap.hom)
  have : IsDominant f := IsDominant.of_comp X.left.topIso.hom f
  have : IsDominant j.left := inferInstanceAs (IsDominant f)
  have hfgeneric : f.toPartialMap.fromFunctionField =
      Scheme.functionFieldMorphism E.symm.toRingEquiv :=
    (congrArg Scheme.RationalMap.fromFunctionField hf.1).trans hr
  have hff : f.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap = CommRingCat.ofHom E.toRingHom :=
    Scheme.PartialMap.functionFieldMap_eq_of_fromFunctionField_eq
      f.toPartialMap E.symm.toRingEquiv hfgeneric
  have : IsIso f.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap := by
    rw [hff]
    exact (E.toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso).isIso_hom
  have : IsIso j.left.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsIso f.toPartialMap.functionFieldMap)
  have hj : IsOpenImmersion j.left := isOpenImmersion_of_target_valuation X Y hYval j
  have hdimY : topologicalKrullDim Y.left = 1 := by
    apply le_antisymm hYdim
    rw [← hdim]
    exact j.left.isOpenEmbedding.isInducing.topologicalKrullDim_le
  exact ⟨Y, j, inferInstance, inferInstance, hj, hdimY, hYnormal⟩

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.connectedGroup_completion_and_extensions
statement:
theorem connectedGroup_completion_and_extensions (G : ConnectedAlgebraicGroup k)
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim G.toGroupScheme.X.left = 1) :
    ∃ (Y : Over (Spec (.of k))) (j : G.toGroupScheme.X ⟶ Y),
      IsIntegral Y.left ∧ IsProper Y.hom ∧ IsOpenImmersion j.left ∧
        topologicalKrullDim Y.left = 1 ∧
        (∀ y : Y.left, IsIntegrallyClosed (Y.left.presheaf.stalk y)) ∧
        (∀ a : G.toGroupScheme.X ≅ G.toGroupScheme.X,
          ∃! F : Y ≅ Y, j ≫ F.hom = a.hom ≫ j)
proof:
:= by
  have : GrpObj (Over.mk G.toGroupScheme.X.hom) := by
    change GrpObj G.toGroupScheme.X
    infer_instance
  have : Smooth G.toGroupScheme.X.hom := smooth_of_grpObj _
  obtain ⟨Y, j, hY, hproper, hopen, hdimY, hnormal⟩ :=
    exists_proper_normal_completion G.toGroupScheme.X hdim
  have : IsIntegral Y.left := hY
  have : IsProper Y.hom := hproper
  have : IsOpenImmersion j.left := hopen
  exact ⟨Y, j, hY, hproper, hopen, hdimY, hnormal,
    fun a ↦ ProperCurve.existsUnique_iso_extension Y G.toGroupScheme.X hdimY.le hnormal j a⟩

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.parameterRing_isPrincipal
statement:
theorem parameterRing_isPrincipal (t : F) (ht : Transcendental k t) :
    IsPrincipalIdealRing (parameterRing (k := k) t)
proof:
:=
  IsPrincipalIdealRing.of_surjective (Polynomial.algEquivOfTranscendental k t ht).toRingHom
    (Polynomial.algEquivOfTranscendental k t ht).surjective

name: AclGeom.CurveCompletion.normalizedRing_properties
statement:
theorem normalizedRing_properties (t : F) (ht : Transcendental k t)
    [FiniteDimensional (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F] :
    letI
proof:
:= normalizedBaseAlgebra (k := k) t
    Module.Finite (parameterRing (k := k) t) (normalizedRing (k := k) t) ∧
    IsDedekindDomain (normalizedRing (k := k) t) ∧
    IsFractionRing (normalizedRing (k := k) t) F ∧
    Algebra.FiniteType k (normalizedRing (k := k) t) := by
  let := normalizedBaseAlgebra (k := k) t
  let : Algebra (parameterRing (k := k) t) (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Algebra (Algebra.adjoin k ({t} : Set F))
      (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)))
  have : IsFractionRing (parameterRing (k := k) t)
      (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (IsFractionRing (Algebra.adjoin k ({t} : Set F))
      (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)))
  have : IsScalarTower (parameterRing (k := k) t)
      (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have : IsScalarTower k (parameterRing (k := k) t) (normalizedRing (k := k) t) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have : IsPrincipalIdealRing (parameterRing (k := k) t) := parameterRing_isPrincipal t ht
  have : Module.Finite (parameterRing (k := k) t) (normalizedRing (k := k) t) :=
    IsIntegralClosure.finite (parameterRing (k := k) t)
      (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F (normalizedRing (k := k) t)
  have : IsDedekindDomain (normalizedRing (k := k) t) :=
    IsIntegralClosure.isDedekindDomain (parameterRing (k := k) t)
      (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({t} : Set F)) F (normalizedRing (k := k) t)
